ta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Isak in apa Abraham kungah, “Pa aw!” achia, tualeh aman “Tanah um ing e bawi” achia, tualeh aman a kungah, “Envawi, mei leh sing aum a, hinanleh halmang sillat ding Belamnou heia um ahiei?” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Abraham in, “Bawi Pasian in ama ading halmang sillat ding kingaituo naven” achia, tuachiin ani un azawhkhawm ta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in ahilna mun ava tungta ua, tuanah Abraham in maitam adaw a, a singte achieng khawm a, tualeh atapa Isaak akaan a, maitam a sing tungah asielta hi.","ref":"Jak. 2.21"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abraham in akhut alaam tou a, atapa thana dingin a temta alata hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa Van sawlsiengin van apat in ahan a, “Abraham, Abraham” achi a; aman “Tanah um ing e” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh aman, “Naupang tungah na khut ha sinlen, bangma zong law vawt sin, na tapa tang neisun na itlou ziehin Pasian na giing hi chi tuin ka theita hi” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abraham adahtou a, a et leh, ngaivawi, anualam ah Belamtal, Singbawh lah ah aki-a awh ana uma, Abraham in tua belamtal ava man a, atapa taangin halmang sillat in alanta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Abraham in tuamun min dingin Jehovah-Jire achita hi. Tuni donga “Mangpa tangah ngaituo ahi ding,” akichi zel bangin."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa Van sawlsiengin van a kipat in Abraham ani veina dingin ahan a,"},"16":{"text":"“Keimaleh keima kilouin ka kichiem hi; Mangpa’n achi, azieh pen tam sillat na bawl ziehin na tapa, na tapa tang neisun zong na it lou ziehin.","ref":"Heb. 6.13,14"},"17":{"text":"Hing guolzawl ngei ngei vangin, van a aasi za leh Tuipi gei a pieunel za in na hah nasuonte ka pungsah ngei ngei dinga, tualeh nahah nasuonten agalte kulkot a luopieh ding uhi.”","ref":"Heb. 11.12"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh “Ka thu naman ziehin na hah nasuonte ziehin leitunga nam zousie guolzawl in umva uh,” achi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 3.25"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abraham tangvalte kungah ahing kilekia a, adingdoh ua Beersheba ah apei khawmta ua, Abraham pen Beersheba ah aumta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh tamte nua in, “Ngaivawi, Milkah in zong na sanggampa Nahor dingin tate ahin piehta chiin Abraham ahing hil uhi."},"21":{"text":"A tapa tapen min Huz ahia, anaupa min Buz ahi. Tualeh Aram pa Kemuel toh."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph leh Bethuel zong ahi uhi.”"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Bethuel in Rebekah ahing hi. Tam pasal giette Milkah in Abraham sanggampa Nahor dingin ahinpieh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh ameinu, amin Reumah in zong Tebah Gaham, Thahash leh Maakah ahing hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sarah damsung kum za leh kum sawmni leh sagi ahia, tamte Sarah damsung kumte ahi.","title":"Sarah shina leh kivuina"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sarah Kirjath-Arba ah ashi a, tuami Kanaan gam a Hebron kichi ahia, tualeh Abraham pen Sarah suun ding leh kaa dingin ava hawta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abraham mishi luong kung apat in adingdoh a, Heth tate kungah."},"4":{"text":"“Na lah uah gamdang mi leh mikhuol bep ka hia, ka mishi luong ka mu nawnlou na dinga ka vui khiet theina dingin na lah uah kivuina mun ding goutan hing pie un,” achi hi.","ref":"Heb. 11.9,13; Nasep. 7.16"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Heth taten Abraham a dawng ua, a kungah."},"6":{"text":"“Ka mangpa uh ka thugen uh ngaikhie in, ka lah uah nang lal thupitah na hi; ka han uh na deina penpen ah na mishi vuiin, na mishi vuina dingin koiman ka han uh it sih va ung,” achi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abraham adingkhie a, tua gammi hahlesuonte kun in salam abuh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh amauh ahoupi a, a kung uah “Ka mishi ka mu lou dinga ka vui pha nang sahpi u’leh hing ngaikhie unlen, Zohar tapa Ephron kungah hing ngetpieh un."},"9":{"text":"A loutaw a um aneisa Makpelah Kokhuh hing pie henlen, nalah ua vuina mun goutan dingin aman hun nasah zaza uh la henlen, hing pie heh” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Ephron khu Heth tate lah ah atou zinga, tuachiin Hitmi Ephron in, Hitmite leh a khopi kulpi kotkha a lut zousie nangawn theiin."},"11":{"text":"Hilou e, “Ka mangpa hing ngaikhie in lou ka hing pie a asung aum kokhuh zong kahing pie hi. Ka chipite tate mitmu in ka hing pie hi, na mishi vui in,” chiin Abraham adawng hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abraham tua gam mite masang ah abohkhup hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh tua gam a tengte zah in Ephron kungah, “Pha nasah leh hing ngaikhie in, louman pen vang ka hing pe ding hi. Kei a kipat la inlen khunah ka mishi ka vui ding hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Ephron in Abraham a dawnga a kungah,"},"15":{"text":"Ka mangpa, hing ngaikhe vawi in, “Agam khu dangka Shekel zali hugiap ahia, tuami nang leh kei kaala gentham ahi amah? tuaziehin na mishi vui mai in,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Abraham in Ephron thugen a ngaikhie a, tualeh Abraham in Heth tate theipi in Ephron genza dangka Shekel zali, Summet bawlte zah zel ate pieh a Ephron apeta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ephron lou, Mamre mazawn a Makpelah gam a um alou toh, a sunga um kokhuh toh, alou lai leh agamgi kimkot a sing umte zousie toh."},"18":{"text":"Abraham kungah Heth tate theipi in, a khopi uh kotkhah a lut zousiete masang ah pieh kip in aumta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tamte zouin Abraham in azi Sarah Kanaan gam a Mamre mazawn a um Makpelah lou a kokhuh ah avuita hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n lou leh a sunga kokhuh um khu Heth taten Abraham kungah kivuina mun a nei den dingin apekipta hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Abraham akumte tam in ahing tehta a, Mangpa’n sil zousie ah a guolzawl hi.","title":"Isaak ziding puina"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abraham in anei zousie tunga vaihawm, asuohte lah a upapen kungah, “Hepitahin nakhut ka pheipi nuoi ah gol in."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Mangpa van Pasian leh lei Pasian min louin, ka umna Kanaan mite tanute ka tapa zi a neisah lou dingin ka hing kichiem sah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh ka gam lam ua ka be leh phungte lah uah pei inlen, ka tapa Isaak zi ding na valah pieh ding ahi” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh a suohpan a kungah, “A numei in tam gam lamah hing zui utlou thei hi, na tapa na hing pawtkhietna gamlam a ka pui kia ngaiding adiei?” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Abraham in a kungah, “Ka tapa tualang a puikia lou dingin pilvang in."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa van Pasian, ka pa inn leh ka pienna gam a kipat hing lakhepa leh na hah nasuonte tam gam ka peding chia, ka kung a thugen a kichiem pa’n, a vansawlsieng na masang ah sawl vanin, tuana kipat ka tapa zi na hing neisah ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh a numei in ahing zui ut vawt sih leh ka kunga na kichiemna thu ah na sieng dinga, abang abang hileh ka tapa tualang ah puikia vawt sin” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n asuoh pa’n akhut apu Abraham phei nuoi ah agol a, tuami thu ah a kichiemta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n a suohpa’n apu Sangawngsaute lah ah sawm ala a, apu neitah akhut aum zousie tawi in akipan kheta hi. Tuachi’n adingdoh a, Mesopotamia gam a Nahor umna khuo ah ahawta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh nitahlam a numeite tuitawi dinga akuon hun laitah un, daigei a tuikhuh kungah a sangawngsaute akhupdinsah a."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Aw Mangpa ka pu Abraham Pasian, hepitah in tunin hing lawchingsah inlen, ka pu Abraham tungah na hepina langsah in."},"13":{"text":"Ngaivawi, tanah tuikhuh gei ah ka ding a, khopi mite tanute tui tawiding in ahing kuon uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh tambang hiheh, nungahte koi hitaleh, hepitahin ka dawn dingin na tuibel ngiemsah vawiin kachi a, tualeh aman, dawn inlen na sangawngsaute zong kadawn sah ding hi hing chipen pen, tuami ngel khu na suoh Isaak zi dinga na miguot hihen; tuachi’n ka pu tungah hepina na sulang chi, ka thei ding hi” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, a thugen azaw masangin ngaivawi, Abraham sanggampa Nahor zi Mikah tapa Bethuel tanu Rebekah, alieng a tuibel puoin ahing kuon hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh nungah pen amel ahoi mama a, nungah siengthou, pasal pawl kha nai vawtlou ahia; tualeh tuikhuh ah akumsuh a, a tuibel adim a ahing katou kiata hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh suohpa ama dawn dingin atai a, “Hepitahin na tuibel a tui tawmnou khat hing dawnsah ve,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuichin aman, dawnve, “Ka mangpa” achia, tuachi’n kintahin atuibel akhai ngiemsuh a, adawnsah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh tui adawnsah zouin, “Na sangawngsaute a ding zong, akham masangsie uh ka tawipieh zel ding” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n manlangin atuibel a tuite gankuong ah asung a, tui thal dingin atai kia a, a sangawngsau zousie dingin tui athal pieh zel hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh tua mipa’n amanu a enzinga Mangpa’n a zinna alawchin sah leh chinsahlou theina dingin sip dide in a en khin khian hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing ahia, sangawngsauten tui adawn zoutah un tua mipan shekel kimkhat a gih sana bilba khat leh shekel sawm agih sana tau ni alakhie a,"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh “Koi tanu na hiei? hepitahin hing hil in, na pa inn ah giehna ding mun aum diei?” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n a kungah, “Nahor dinga Milkah in a hinpieh Bethuel tanu ka hi” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualouzong, “Gante ann neh ding bupawl leh tunna ding inndan zong aum hi” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua mipan alu akunsah a, Mangpa abeta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh aman, “Ka pu tunga akhotuona leh athutahna tawpsan ngailou Mangpa ka pu Abraham Pasian phat in um hen, kei zong Mangpa’n ka pu unaute innlam a ahing na pui ahi,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n nungahnu atai a tam silte anu innkuonpite avahil a,"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Rebekah in sanggam pasal khat anei a, amin Laban ahia, tualeh Laban tuikhuh a tua mipa kungah avatai ta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, aman a sanggamnu khuta taute leh bilbate amu a, tualeh a sanggamnu Rebekah in tua mipan ka kungah, “Tambangin agen hi achia, agen azah tahin tua mipa kungah ahing pei a, ngaivawi, ama tuikhuh ah sangawngsaute kungah ading hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n, hing lut in, nang Mangpa guolzawlpa; bang dinga innmai a ding na hiei? inn ah sangawngsaute dingin mun ka bawl zouta” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n, tua mipa inn sungah alut a, tualeh Laban in asangawngsau vante aphel a, sangawngsaute bupawl leh gan-ann apie a, tualeh ama leh a zawpite keng silna ding tui apie hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh amasang ah neh ding ann aluipieh a, hinanleh aman, “Kahing peina zieh thu ka gen masangin nesih vang,” achi hi. Tualeh aman, genveleh achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Abraham suohpa ka hia."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka pu nasatah in aguolzawl a, mi thupitah ahing hita hi. Belam honte, bawng honte, dangkate, sanate, suohnute, suohpate, sangawngsaute leh sabiltungte apie hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh ka pu zi Sarah in ateh nuain ka pu dingin tapa ahinpieh a, a kungah anei leh a lam zousie apeta hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh ka puin ka tapa zi dingin ka umna gam Kanaan mite tanute la sinlen."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh ka pa innkuonpite leh ka tanute kungah pei inlen, ka tapa zi ding na vala ding hi chiin ahing kichiem sah hi.’"},"39":{"text":"Tualeh ken ka pu kungah anumei in hing zui ut sih taleh, ka chi hi.’"},"40":{"text":"Hinanleh aman ka kungah, ‘Mangpa, amasanga ka umzing na pa’n avansawlsieng na kungah hing sawl van in, na peina ah ahing lawchingsah na ding hi. Tualeh ka tapa zi dingin ka sanggamte leh ka pa innkuonpite lah apat nala ding hi, ahing chi hi.’"},"41":{"text":"Ka sanggamte kunga na tun chiengin, ka kunga na kichiemna apat na sieng dinga, tualeh amanu ahing na pieh sih u’leh ka kunga na kichiemna apat na siengta ding hi ahing chi hi.’"},"42":{"text":"Tualeh tuni in Tuikhuh ah kahing tunga, tualeh, Aw Mangpa, ka pu Abraham Pasian; tunia ka peina a nahing lawchin sah ding leh;"},"43":{"text":"Ngaivawi, tuikhuh kungah ka ding hi, tualeh tambang hiheh, nungah tui tawi dinga ahing pei chieng in a kunga, “hepitahin dawnding na bel a tui tawmnoukhat hing pie’n,” ka chi a."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n ka kunga, “nang dawn inlen na sangawngsaute ading zong sawh vang achileh,” tua minu ngel khu Mangpa’n ka pu tapa dinga aguot numei hiheh, ka chi hi.’"},"45":{"text":"“Hinanleh ka lungsim a ka gen zou masangin, Ngaivawi, Rebekah, alieng a tuibel puoin ahing kuon a, tuikhuh ah akumsuh a, tui adim a, tualeh ken a kungah hepitahin tui hing dawnsah in ka chi hi.’"},"46":{"text":"Tualeh aman kintahin alieng a tuibel adom khie a, dawn inlen, na sangawngsaute zong dawnsah vang achi hi. Tuachi’n ka dawna ka sangawngsaute zong adawnsah hi.’"},"47":{"text":"Tuachi’n koi tanu na hiei? chiin ka donga, tualeh amanu’n Nahor dinga Milkah in ahinnpieh Bethuel tanu achia, tuachiin anahkuo leh abil ah bilba kaba sah a, taute zong akhut ah ka bunsah hi.’"},"48":{"text":"Tualeh ka lu kunsuhin Mangpa ka bie a, tualeh atapa zi dinga, ka pu naupa tanu puipieh dinga lampi dih a hing puipa Mangpa ka pu Abraham Pasian khu ka pahtawi hi.”"},"49":{"text":"Tuin, “Ka pu na hepi ua, a tunga chitahpi a bawl ding na hi u’leh zong hing hil un, tuachiin zietlam amah veilam amah a ka kihei theina dingin,” achi hi."},"50":{"text":"Tuachi’n Laban leh Bethuel in adawng ua, “Tam sil Mangpa apat hing kipan ahia, asie apha na kungah ka gen thei sih uhi."},"51":{"text":"Enin, Rebekah na masangah aum hi, pui inlen peitan; tualeh Mangpa’n agensa bangin na pu tapa zi in umta hen,” achi ua."},"52":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Abraham suohpan a thugente uh azahtah in leia bawhkhup in Mangpa abie hi."},"53":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abraham suohpan dangka kizepnate Sana kizepnate leh puonsil nihten ahing lakhie a, Rebekah apeta hi. Tualeh a sanggampa leh anu zong sil manpha pipi apie hi."},"54":{"text":"Tualeh aman aguolte toh ane in adawn ua, agiehta uhi. Tuachi’n zingmawng in athou ua, aman, “Kapu kungah hing peisah ta in” achi hi."},"55":{"text":"Hinanleh asanggampa leh anu’n nungahnu pen ka kung uah, “Tomnou khat atawmpen in ni sawm beeh umtadi henlen, tua zou chieng in hing pei nava” achi uhi."},"56":{"text":"Tualeh aman, akung uah, hing vai kai sah da un, “Mangpa’n lah ka haw na ahing lawching sah ta ngal a; ka pu kunga ka pei thei na dingin, hing sawl doh zomai vawi un,” a chi hi."},"57":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama un, nungahnu han vaiin ama nu kamteng ngaikhe vai achi uhi."},"58":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rebekah ahan ua, a kungah, “Tampa toh na zawhkhawm tading uh amah?” achi ua, tualeh amanu’n “Zawhkhawm tava ung” achi hi."},"59":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun asanggamnu uh Rebekah leh adonnu toh Abraham suohpa toh a guolte toh apeisah ta uhi."},"60":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Rebekah a guolzawl ua, a kungah, nang ka sanggamnu uh tul sawm ngen tul tampi nu hing hi inlen, nahah na suonten amauh mudate kul kotkhah luota uhen, achi uhi."},"61":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rebekah leh a suohnute adingkhie ua sangawngsaute tungah atuong ua, tua mipa azuita uhi. Tuachi’n Abraham suohpa’n Rebekah puiin apeita hi."},"62":{"text":"Tualeh Isaak khu Beer-lahairoi lam apat ahing pei a, simgam lam a teng ahi ziehin."},"63":{"text":"Tualeh Isaak nitahlam in lou ah kingaituo dingin a pawtdoh a, tualeh adah a, a et leh ngaivawi, sangawngsau hing peite amuta hi."},"64":{"text":"Tualeh Rebekah adah a, Isaak amutahin sangawngsau tung apat akum a."},"65":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n. Abraham suohpa kungah, “Eite dawn dinga lou a hing pei khu koi ahiei?” a chi hi. Tualeh a suohpa’n, “Kapu ahive” achi a, tuaziehin amanu’n akikhuna puon ala a, akikhuta hi."},"66":{"text":"Tualeh suohpa’n asil bawl zousie a unin Isaak ahilta hi."},"67":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isaak in Rebekah anu Sarah biehbuh ah apuilut a, Rebekah akitenpi ta a, azi ahing hita hi. Tualeh aman amanu a it mama a, tuachiin Isaak khu anu shi nuain alungmuang thei ta hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham in zi dang khat anei kia a, amin Keturah ahi.","title":"Abraham in Keturah akitenpi"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian Ishbak leh Shuah ahinpieh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Jokshan in Sheba leh Dedan ahing a, tualeh Dedan tapate Ashurim leh Letushim leh Leummim ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Midian tapate Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abidah leh Eldaah ahi uhi, tamte a unpi un Keturah tate ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Abraham in anei zousie Isaak kungah apeta hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh ameinu tapate kungah Abraham in silpiehte apie a, ama dam laiin atapa Isaak kunga kipat suolam gam ah asawlmang ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Abraham damsung kum za leh kum sawmsagi leh nga ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abraham kum tamtah a dama, vuoikawn vawt in a hagau aha a, ateh shita hi. Tualeh a chipite toh pui in aumta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh atapate Isaak leh Ishmael in, ama Mamre mazawn a um Hitmi Zohar tapa, Ephron lou a um Makpelah kokhuh ah avuita uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua lou pen Abraham in Heth tate kunga kipata alei ahia, tuanah Abraham leh a zi Sarah akivui ta uhi.","ref":"Siem. 23.3-16"},"11":{"text":"Tua zouin tambang ahing hi a, Abraham shi nuain, Pasian in a tapa Isaak aguolzawl a; Tualeh Isaak Beer-la-hai Roi ah a teng ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tu’n tamte Abraham ading a Sarah suohnu Izipt mi Hagar in ahinpieh Abraham tapa Ishmael hahlesuonte khanggui ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh tamte amin chiet u’leh ahah asuonte uh dungzuiin, Ishmael tate min ahi. Ishmael tapa masapen Nebajoth ahia, abanah Kedar, Adbeel leh Mibsam."},"14":{"text":"Mishma, Dumah leh Massa,"},"15":{"text":"Hadar, Tema, Jetur, Nephish, Kedemah ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tamte Ishmael tapate ahi uhi, atenna khuo u’leh agiehbuh uh dungzui a amin uh kigiel ahia, anam uh dungzuiin leeng sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Ishmael dam sung kum za leh kum sawm leh sagi ahia, tuachiin a hagau aha a, ashita hi. Achipite kungah pui in aumta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh ahahlesuonte Havilah gam akipat in Assiria zotna Izipt gam suolam toh kigaldot Shur dongin ateng ua, ama pen a unaute mitmu in ashita hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh tamte Abraham tapa Isaak tapate Jakob leh Isau tate khanggui ahi. Abraham in Isaak ahing a."},"20":{"text":"Isaak pen Siria mi Laban sanggamnu, Padan-Aram gam a Siriami Bethuel tanu Rebekah zi a anei laiin Kum sawmli mi ahia;"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh a zi achiin ziehin Isak in a zi a dingin Mangpa kungah a ngetpieh a, a ngetna khu Mangpa’n a ngaikhiet pieh a, tuachiin Rebekah ahing gaita hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh anau paite asungah akisuol ua, tuachiin amanu’n “Tambang giap ding ahi leh kahin bang e aphatuom?” achia, tuachi’n Mangpa dong dingin akuonta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n a kungah, “Nasung ah Nampi ni aum a, nagil sunga kipat in nam ni kikhen vanin, nam khat pen adang khat pen sangin hatzaw vanin, a upa penin a naupang zawpa na asem ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Rom. 9.12"},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n anau nei hun ahing tunin, ngaivawi, a sunga nau apeng ana hi a."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n amasapen asanin asan a, puonmul banga nel thiep thuop in ahing pienga, tuachiin amin dingin Esau aphuo uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuazouin anaupa ahing pienga, akhut in Esau ketul atu chinten a, tuachiin ama min Jakob ahisah uhi. Rebekah in amaute anei laiin Isaak kum sawmguh mi ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n naupangte ahing khang lien ua, Esau sabeng siem, gamvah mi ahia, Jakob pen mimawl puon inn a teng mi ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Isaak in Sakhisa aneh zel ziehin Esau a it a, hinanleh Rebekah in Jakob a it zaw hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in Bechiim ahuon a, Esau gamvah ahing tunga, a tha agim mama hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Esau in Jakob kungah, “Na bechim huon hing nesah in, ka basam gawpta hi” achia, tuaziehin ahi amin Edom akichina."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh Jakob in, “Tunin upa na hina hing leisah phot in” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Esau in, “Ngaivawi, gilkiel a shi ding ka hita a, upa hina in kei a dingin bang phattuomna hing tun ding ahei?” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in, a kungah, “Tunin ka kungah kichiem in” achia, tuachiin akichiemta a, upa hina Jakob kungah azuata hi.","ref":"Heb. 12.16"},"34":{"text":"Tuabepin Jakob in Esau kungah tanghou leh abuchiim apie a, tualeh aman ne in adawn a, akipeita hi. Tambangin Esau in upa hina amusit hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tua gam a Abraham damlai a kiel tung masapen chilou, kiel dang khat ahing tung kia a, tualeh Isaak Philistinte leengpa Abimelek kungah Gerar ah ava haw a.","title":"Abraham thuhun Isak in asukip"},"2":{"text":"Khumin Mangpa a kungah akilah a, a kungah, “Izipt gamah peisuh sinlen, gam ka hing hilding ah teng in."},"3":{"text":"Tam gamah umtadi inlen, ka hing umpi dinga ka hing guolzawl ding hi, tualeh nang leh nahah nasuonte kungah, tam gam zousie hing pevangin napa Abraham kunga ka kichiemna pen ka sukip ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 22.16-18"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh nahah nasuonte van a aasi za in pungsah vangin, nahah nasuonte kungah tami gam zousie pevangin, tualeh nahah nasuonte vangin leitung nam zousie guolzawl in umva uh."},"5":{"text":"Abraham in ka thu a manga, ka thuhilte, ka thupiehte, ka thuguotte leh ka dante azui ziehin,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isaak Gerar ah ateng ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh khuna umten azi tungtang adong ua, aman, “Ka sanggamnu ahi” achia, amel ahoiseng ziehin, Rebekah ziehin tam khomiten hing that khava uh chiin, ka zi ahi achi ngam sih hi.","ref":"Siem. 12.13; 20.2"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, khuna hun sawtpi aum nuain, Philistinte leengpa Abimelek in kotta a ahing dahleh, ngaivawi, Isaak in azi Rebekah anou lai amu a;"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abimelek in Isaak ahan a, “Ngaivawi, na zi hinapi, bang dinga ka sanggamnu ahi nachi ahiei?” achi hi. Khumin Isaak in a kungah, “Ama ziehin shi khavang kachi zieh ahi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Abimelek in, “Ka tung ua tam sil nabawl bang chidan ahiei? Mikhat in na zi ana luppi maithei asiei mah? Tuachi’n ka tung uah siemmaw hing tangsah thei nahi” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abimelek in, “Koizong tam mipa ahisihleh a zi sukha pouma suhlia tei tei ding ahi,” chiin amite zousie thu apie hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isaak in tua gamah bu a chiinga, tuami kumin ale za anei a, Mangpa’n a guolzawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama ahing thupi mama ta a, nasahtah a mi thupi hikhop hiel in ahing lawching deudeu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin aman belam hon leh bawnghon leh suoh tampi anei a, tuachi’n Philistinten athang sietta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n apa Abraham damlai a apa suohten tuikhuh ataw zousie uh Philistinten ahuh bing pieh ua, lei avuadim sieng uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Abimelek in Isaak kungah, “Ka kunga pat peimang doh in, kou sangin na thupi zawta hi achi hi.”"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isaak tuana kipat in apawt kheta a, Gerer phaihawm ah apuon inn azah a, tuanah atengta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Isaak in apa Abraham damlai a a tuikhuh tawte uh atou kia hi. Abraham shi nua a, Philistinten ana huhdim pieh sieng uh ahi. Tualeh apa’n ana minvawsa bang chietin amin uh ahisah denta hi."},"19":{"text":"Isaak suohten zong phaihawmah tuikhuh atou ua, tuanah tui nahnei khat amu uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Gerar khuo a ganchingten, “Kou tuikhuh ahi” chiin Isaak ganchingte akihaupi uhi. Tuachi’n ama toh akiniel ziehun tua tuikhuh min Esek achita uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun tuikhuh dang atoukia ua, tua zong a tupieh kia ziehun akihau ua, tuami min Sitnah achita uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh khummun akipat in akisuon a, tuikhuh dang atou kia a, tuapen atu nawnsih ua, sel zong akiselpi nawnsih uhi. Tuaziehin tammun min khu Rehoboth achita hi, “Tuin Mangpa’n ei a dingin mun kiningchingtah ahing bawl piehta a, tamgam sungah chi tampi isuong ta ding hi” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuana pat in Beersheba a zuonta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh khum zan mama in Mangpa, a kungah ahing kilah a, “Kei, na pa Abraham Pasian ka hi, zau vawt sin ka hing umpi zing hi; hing guolzawl vangin hinanleh ka suoh Abraham ziehin na hah nasuon ka hing pungsah ding hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh aman khunah maitam a bawla, Mangpa min a han a, biehbuh zong a jah a, tualeh Isaak suohten tuikhuh atouta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gerar akipat in Abimelek, a guolte lah a mikhat Ahuzath toh a galkap pawla lamkai lienpen Phikol toh a kungah ahing apei ua.","ref":"Siem. 21.22"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Isaak in a kungah, “Na hing muda ua, na kung ua kipat na hing nawdoh uh hitalou ka hiei amah? Bang chidan a ka kunga hing pei na hi uoi?” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh amaun, “Mangpa na kungah aum chi ka thei chien uhi. Tualeh ikikaal uah kou leh nang kikaal ngei ah kichiemna neiin nang toh thuhun khat bawlvai kachi uhi.’"},"29":{"text":"Na siet na ding ka bawl lou ua, silhoi loungal na tunga bangma ka bawl lou ua, hamuangtah a kahing sawlmang doh bang un, kou sietna ding mawngmawng na bawl louna dingin, tuin nang pen Mangpa guolzawl in na umta hi,” achi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n ama ua dingin annkuong a luipieh a, ne in adawnta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh zingmawng matah in athou ua, akichiem tuoh ua, tuachiin Isaak in asawl khie a, lungmuong tah in apeita uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, tuami ni mamain Isaak suohte ahing pei ua a kungah, tui tawdoh thu ahing hil ua, a kungah “Tui ka muta uhi” ahing chi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman tuami Sheba achita hi. Tuaziehin tua khopi min khu tuni tanin Beersheba akichi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Esau kum sawmli a upa ahi in Hitmi Beeri tanu Judith, leh Hitmi Elon tanu Basemath zi in anei hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuate khu Isaak leh Rebekah lungsim sugimte ahi uhi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, Isaak ahing tehta a, khomu theilou khop in amit ahing miel gawpta a, atapa upapen Esau a han a, a kungah, “Ka tapa” achi hi, tualeh aman, ngaiin “Tanah ka um hi” achi hi.","title":"Isaak in Jakob aguolzawl"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aman, “Ngaivawi, tuin ka teh sengta a, ka shi ni ding lah ka thei sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin hepitahin na hiemzah, na thaltang bawm leh na thalpi la inlen, gam vavah inlen sakhi hing matpiehin."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh ka du dan tahin me tuitahin hing bawl inlen ka kungah hing tawi in, ka shi masanga ne a ka hing guolzawl theina ding in” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Isaak in atapa Esau ahoupi lai, Rebekah in anaza hi. Tuachi’n Sakhi man a hing paw dingin Esau akuonta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rebekah in atapa Jakob kungah, “Ngaivawi, na pa’n na u Esau ahoupi lai ka za a, akungah."},"7":{"text":"‘Sakhi hing va puohpieh inlen, me tuitah hing bawlpieh in, ka neh a ka shi masanga Mangpa kunga ka hing guolzawl theina ding in, chia agen kaza hi.’"},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka tapa ka hing thupieh bangin ka thu mangin.’"},"9":{"text":"Tuin ganhon lah ah vapei inlen, Kelnou hoitah ni hing lain, napa dingin adu dantah in me tuitah ka bawl piehding achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuami ane a, ashi masang ngei a nang ahing guolzawl theina dingin, na pa kungah nava tawi ding hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in anu Rebekah kungah, “En in, ka upa Esau mi mul hau ahia, keipen mi vun mam kahi achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka pa’n ahing na zut kha thei hi, tua hileh ama ngaiin mi solpa ka bang dinga, guolzawl malahin samsiet kisui kawi ka bang kha zawsih ding amah?” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh anuin a kungah, “Na kisamsietna khu ka tungah tuzaw heh, ka tapa ka thu mang mai inlen, hing valah piehin,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n a pei a ava lata a, anu kungah ahing tawi a, tualeh anu in apa dudantah in me tuitah abawl piehta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rebekah in atapa upapen Esau puon hoipen, a kunga inn sunga um khu ala a, atapa a naupang zaw Jakob a silsah ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Kelnou vun khu akhut leh angawng mamna mun ah a koia,"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n me tuitah leh tanghou a bawlte khu atapa Jakob khut ah apie a,"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n apa kungah ahing pei a, “Pa aw”; achi hi, Aman, “Tanah um ing ei, koi na hiei? ka tapa,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in apa kungah, “Na tapa upapen Esau ka hi, na hing sawl bangin ka bawl zouta hi; hepitah in hing thou inlen, na hing guolzawl theina dingin ka Sakhisa ne vawi,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Isaak in atapa kungah, “Ka tapa, bangchidan a hiei? hing manlang na va-ia chie?” achi hi. Tualeh aman, “Mangpa na Pasian in ahing lawchinsah zieh ahi” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isaak in Jakob kungah, ka tapa, “Hepitah in hing naivawi, ka tapa Esau na hi tahtah nai? kahing zutding hi” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in apa Isaak anai a, aman ana zut a, Tualeh “A aw pen Jakob aw ahia, hinanleh akhut pen Esau khut ahi” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh a khutte a upa khut banga amul ziehin athei khen tasih a, tuachi’n ama a guolzawl ta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Ka tapa Esau na hi ngel nai mah?” achi hi, tualeh aman “Hi ma inge” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh aman ka kungah, “Hing tawiin ka hing guolzawl theina dingin, ka tapa Sakhisa ka ne ding hi” achi hi. Tuachi’n a kungah ahing tawi nai a, aman aneta hi; tualeh uain zong a hing tawia a dawnta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n apa Isaak in a kungah, “Tuin hing nai inlen hing tawp in ka tapa” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ava nai a atawpta hi. Tualeh aman a puon gimnam aza a, a guolzawlta hi, tualeh “Envawi, ka tapa gimnam pen Mangpa guolzawl gam gimnam abang hi.","ref":"Heb. 11.20"},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian in van daichimte leh lei hoinate, thaunate leh bu leh uoiin tampi hing peta hen."},"29":{"text":"Midang dangten na nna sem henlen, nam tuom tuomte na masangah kun uhen, na unaute tungah leeng in pang inlen, na nu tate na masangah kun uhen, tualeh hamsie hing lawte hamsiet in um henlen, ahing guolzawlte guolzawl in um uhen” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 12.3"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Isaak in Jakob a guolzawl zou tahin, Jakob apa Isaak apat a apeikhiet zou laitahin, a upa Esau sabeng ahing tung a.","title":"Isau in Isaak guolzawlna anget"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh aman zong me tuitah a bawla, apa kungah ahing tawia, tualeh apa kungah, “Pa aw, thou inlen, na hing guolzawl thei na dingin na tapa Sakhisa ne vawiin” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh apa Isaak in a kungah, “Koi na hiei? achi hi, aman na tapa upapen Esau kahi” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isaak nasatah in achitun a, tualeh apa Isaak in a kungah, “Sakhi va man a ka kunga hing tawia, tualeh na hing tun masanga ka na neh zou a ka guolzawl pa koi ahiei? Heisungah aumtai? Hinanleh ama guolzawl in aum ta ve ve ding” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Esau in apa thugente azah tahin, hase seng sengin hatang ka-in akapta hi, tualeh a kungah “Pa aw, kei zong hing guolzawl ve” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanleh aman, “Na naupan ahing sol a, na guolzawlna akilah mangta hi” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh aman, “Amin Jakob kichi dih va-ia tei e izaw? Nivei ahing suomna ahita hi, uzaw ka hina ahing lah pieha, ngaivawi, tuin ka guolzawlna tan ding ahing lapieh kiata hi,” achi hi. Tualeh aman, “Kei dinga guolzawlna hing khetpieh talou na hiei mah?” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 25.29-34"},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isaak in a dawnga, Esau kungah, “Ngaivawi, ama pen na mangpa dingin ka bawlta a, a unaute zousie asuoh dingin ka peta hi. Tualeh bu leh uain in ama ka vahta hi. Tuin nang a dingin bang kang bawlpieh ding ata diei, ka tapa” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Esau in apa kungah, “Pa aw, guolzawlna khat mai mai amah na nei? Aw pa, kei zong hing guolzawl ve, aw pa,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Esau aw ngaitahin ahing kapta hi.","ref":"Heb. 12.17"},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n apa Isaak in a dawnga, a kungah “Ngaivawi, na umna ding lei hoinatah leh tunglam a van daichimte kiehna ahi ding’ achi hi.","ref":"Heb. 11.20"},"40":{"text":"Na namsau in na hing dinga, na naupa nna nasem dinga: tualeh hichi ahing hi dinga, thuneina na hing nei chiengin na ngawng apat in a hahkol na thing kheta ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 36.8; 2 Leeng. 8.20"},"41":{"text":"Tuaziehin Esau in Jakob apa’n ana guolzawl taah ziehin amuda a, tualeh Esau in a lungsim in, “Ka pa lah shibai tavan, tuachiengin ka nau Jakob ka that mai ding hi.” Achi hi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh tam atapa upapen thugen Rebekah kungah hil in aumta a, tuachiin aman mi a sawl a, atapa naupang zaw Jakob ahan sah a, a kungah, “Ngaivawi, na upa Esau in na tungthu ah nangma tha hing sawm in akihenem hi.’"},"43":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka tapa, tuin ka thu mangin, thou inlen, Haran a ka sanggampa Laban kungah taiin.’"},"44":{"text":"Tualeh na upa lungthahna adai masangin a kungah ni tamlou khat va umin.’"},"45":{"text":"Na u thangpaina na tunga a dai a, a tunga na sil bawlte a mangngil masang sien, tuachiengin mi hing sawl vangin, tuana kipat ka hing puikhesah ding hi, bang dingin ni khat thuin na ni un ka hing taan diei?” achi hi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh Rebekah in Isaak kungah, “Heth tanute ziehin hin ka chimtah mama hi; Jakob zi dinga tam gam nungah Heth tanute bang aneikia nahlai levang kei dingin hin bang a phatuom diei?” achi hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Isaak in Jakob ahan a, a guolzawl a tualeh thu apie a, a kungah, “Kanaan gam nungah zi a na nei vawt lou ding ahi.’","title":"Jakob Bethel a atunna"},"2":{"text":"‘Thou inlen Padan-Aram ah na nu pa Bethuel inn ah vapei inlen, tuana kipat in na nu sanggampa Laban tanute lah a mi zi in vanei in.’"},"3":{"text":"‘Tualeh bangkimbawlthei Pasian in hing guolzawl henlen, nam tuomtuom tampi na hing hithei na dingin chi tampi hing suongsah henlen, hing pungsah tahen.’"},"4":{"text":"‘Tualeh mikhuol na hina gam, Pasian in Abraham kunga apiehna na luo theina dingin, Abraham guolzawlna khu nang leh na hah nasuonte kungah hing peta heh,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 17.4-8"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isaak in Jakob asawl kheta a, tualeh ama Jakob leh Esau nu Rebekah sanggampa Siria mi Bethuel tapa Laban kungah Padan-Aram ah apeita hi."},"6":{"text":"Esau in, Isaak in Jakob a guolzawla, zi nei dingin Padan-Aram ah a sawlta chileh a guolzawl laia. Kanaan gam nungahte lah a mi zi in na neiding ahisih chi in thu apie chileh,","title":"Esau in zi dang anei"},"7":{"text":"Jakob in anu leh apa thu mangin Padan-Aram ah apeita chi athei hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Esau in Kanaan gam nungahten apa alungkimsah sih chi athei a,"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Esau Ishmael kungah ava pei a, a zi neisate ban ah neibe dingin Abraham tapa Ishmael tanu Mahalath, Nebajoth sanggamnu zi in ava neita hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob Beersheba apat apeidoh a, Haran azuonta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh munkhat ah ahing tungta a, ni atumtah ziehin khum mun ah agiehta hi; tuanah suong khat ala a, taangkhap in anei a, tua nah i’mu dingin alumta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n mang anei a, ngaivawi, leitungah kellei ahing kidaw a, a dawnin van asu a, tualeh Pasian vansawlsiengte katou leh kumsuh amu hi.","ref":"Jn. 1.51"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh ngaivawi, Mangpa adawn vum ah a dinga, “Kei Mangpa na pu Abraham Pasian leh Isaak Pasian ka hi; na lupna gam khu nang leh nahah nasuonte kungah ka hing peding hi.’","ref":"Siem. 13.14,15"},"14":{"text":"‘Tualeh na hah nasuonte khu leia leivui za hivanin, tumlam ah bang, suolam ah bang, mallamte ah bang, tualeh simlamte ah na kithezah dinga, nang leh nahah nasuonte ah leitunga nam zousie guolzawlin umva uh.’","ref":"Siem. 12.3; 22.18"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh ngaivawi, hing umpi vangin, na peina phot ah hing veng vangin, tam gam ah hing puikia vangin; na kunga ka gen ka bawl zou masang sie’n ka hing nuasie sih ding hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh, Jakob imu ahing khanglou a, achientah in, “Tami munah Mangpa a um hi; chi ken kana theilou ahi” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n azauta a, “Tam mun zauhuoi gimnei hina va-ia e, tami pen mun dang hilou in, Pasian inn ana hi a, tualeh tam mun pen van kotpi ahi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Jakob zingmawng matahin athou a, a suong taangkhap ala a, khum mun ah aphut a, a tungah sathau abuohta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh khum mun min dingin Bethel achita hi. Hinanleh khum khopi min achiil in Luz ana kichi hi.’"},"20":{"text":"‘Tualeh Jakob in thu achiem a, “Pasian ka kungah aum a, ka peina lampi ah ahing venga, tualeh neh ding tanghou leh sil ding puon ahing pieh.’"},"21":{"text":"‘Tuachia ka pa inn a hamuongtah a ka tunkia nahleh Mangpa pen ka Pasian ahi ding hi.’"},"22":{"text":"‘Tualeh tam suong, suongphu dinga ka phu zong Pasian inn ahi ding a; tualeh ka kunga na hing pieh ding zousie ah sawm a khat ka hing pe ngei ngei ding hi” achi hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob apei zel a, suolam mite gam ahing tungta a,","title":"Jakob Haran ah aum"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n a enkawi a, lou a tuikhuh um khat amu a, ngaivawi, akungah Belam hon thum alum uhi. Tua tuikhuh apat Belam honte tui a dawnsah zel uhi. Tualeh suong lienpi khat in tuikhuh kam akisin hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Belamhon zousie aum khawm ua, tua tuikhuh kam a suong kisin alia khie ua, Belamte tui a dawnsah ua, tualeh suongpen tuikhuh kam ah aumna ngai ah akoi kia zel uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in a kung uah, “Ka unaute, heilam mi na hi uoi?” achi hi. Amaun, “Haran khuo lam mi ka hi uhi,” a chi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Nahor tapa Laban na theikha uoi?” achi hi, amaun, “Theima ung” achi ua."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Adam nai?” achi hi. Amaun, “Adam na hi, tualeh envawi, atanu Rachel zong Belamhon toh ahing pei hi,” achi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh aman, “En un, ni zong asang nalai hi, ganhon pui khawm hun zong ahinai sih hi; Belamte tui dawnsah unlen, tualeh ann vanesah tadi un,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun, “Ka hithei sihding uh, Belam hon zousie akipui khawm a, tuikhuh kam apat suong akiliadoh masang sien, tuazou chiengin Belamten tui ka dawnsah zel uhi,” achi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh amauh a houpi laiin, Rachel in apa belamte puiin, ahing pei a, ama b elam chingmi ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Jakob in anu sanggampa Laban tanu Rachel leh anu sanggampa Laban belamte amu tahin ava nai a, tuikhuh kam apat suong a liadoh a, anu sanggampa belamte tui a dawnsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in Rachel a tawpa, aw ngaitah a kikou in akapta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob apa tupa ahi chileh Rebekah tapa ahi chi Rachel a hil a, khumin amanu a tai a, apa ava hilta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Laban in a sanggamnu tapa Jakob tanchin azah tahin adawn dingin a tai a, tualeh angawngkawi a, a tawpa a inn ah ahing peipi hi. Tualeh aman tua thute zousie a un in Laban ahil hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in a kungah, “Nangpen ka gu leh ka sa chiet vawt hichie,” achi hi, tuachiin a kungah ha khat aumta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Laban in Jakob kungah, “Ka tupa na hi ziehin amawhna’n ka nna nasem ding amah? bang nalaw diei? hing hil vawi in,” achi hi.","title":"Jakob in Rachel leh Leah thalaw in Laban nna asem"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in tanu ni a nei a, a uzaw min Leah ahia, anau zaw pen Rachel ahi."},"17":{"text":"Leah khu a mit a zuongha a, hinanleh Rachel pen melhoitah leh ngaibang tah ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in Rachel a it a tualeh, “Na tanu naupang zaw Rachel dingin kum sagi na nna ka sem ding,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in amanu pen midang kunga, “Ka pieh sangin nang hing peleng hoizaw naven; ka kungah um in,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in Rachel a kitenpi theina dingin kum sagi a nna asep pieh a, hinanleh amanu a it seng ziehin tomnou kaal sungin a thei giap hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in Laban kungah, “Ka pawl theina dingin ka zi hing peta in, ka hun lah achingta ngal a,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in khum mun a mi zousie a hankhawm a, annkuong aluita hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, nitah miel in aman atanu Leah a puia, Jakob kungah a hing puilut a, tualeh aman ana luppita hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in, a suohnu Zilpah a tanu Leah suohnu dingin apie hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, zingmawng in ngaivawi, Leah ana hita a, Tuachi’n Jakob in Laban kungah, “Ka tunga na nasep bangchidan ahiei? Rachel dinga na nna ka sep hilou ahiei mah? Bang zieha na hing solbawl ahiei?” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Laban in, “Ka gam uah tambang a ta upazaw masanga a anaupang zaw pieh ngaina ahisih hi.’"},"27":{"text":"‘Amanu hapta suching phot inlen, tuachiin kum sagi dang ka nna nasep man dingin tami nu zong hing peva ung” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in tambangin abawlta a; ani sagi asu buching ta hi, tuachiin atanu Rachel zong azi dingin apeta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in a suohnu Bilhah khu a tanu Rachel suohnu dingin apie hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in Rachel zong a pawla, Leah sangin Rachel a it zaw a, tuachiin kum sagi dang Laban na asem hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Leah pen it ladeuin aum chi amu in, a naubu a honpieh a, hinanleh Rachel pen a chiing hi.","title":"Jakob tate"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Leah ahing gaita a, tapa khat a nei a, amin dingin Reuben aphuo hi. Aziehpen, “Mangpa’n ka gentheidan ahing muchien hi, tunvang ka pasal in hing it tava” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh a gai kia a tapa khat aneikia a, huot in ka um chi, “Mangpa’n azata a, tam tapa zong ahing pie hi” achi hi; tuachiin amin dingin Simeon aphuo hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh agai kia a tapa khat aneikia a, “Tuin tapa thum ka neipieh taah ziehin ka pasal in kei hing beltava” achi hi, tuaziehin amin Levi achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh agai kia a, tapa khat anei kia a; “Tuin vang Mangpa phat tavang,” achi hi. Tuaziehin amin Juda ahisah ta a, tuachiin naunei atawpta hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Rachel in Jakob ta ahinpieh sih chi akithei in, a sanggamnu a thangsietta a, Jakob kungah, “Ta hing pie in ahisihleh shi mai vang,” achi hi."},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob Rachel tungah alungthah ta a, “Na naubu a ga hing phalsah loupa Pasian thaheng ka hiei mah?” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n enve, “Ka suohnu Bilhah tanah aum hi, amanu pawl inlen, tuachiin ken zong ama a kipat tate ka nei theisam na dingin, ka pheitunga ta hing nei ding ahi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n asuohnu Bilhah a zi dingin apie a, tualeh Jakob in amanu a pawl a."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Bilhah agai a, Jakob tapa khat ahing pieh ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rachel in, “Pasian in ahing vaihawm pieh a, ka aw zong aza a, tapa ahing pie hi,” achi hi. Tuaziehin a min dingin Dan a phuo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh, Rachel suohnu Bilhah agai kia a, Jakob tapa anina a neipieh kia hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Rachel in, “Hatang pi’n ka sanggamnu ka buon a ka zouta” achi hi, tuachiin amin dingin Naphtali ahisah ta hi."},"9":{"text":"Leah in naunei atawpta chi akithei in a suohnu Zilpah a pui a, Jakob zi dingin apie hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Leah suohnu zilpah in Jakob tapa khat ahinnpieh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Leah in, “Vangphat huoi tei e izaw,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amin Gad ahisah hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Leah suohnu Zilpah in Jakob tapa anina ahinnpieh a."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Leah in, “Kipah sam ing e, aziehpen numeiten hamphanua hing chi ding uhi.” Achi hi. Tuachi’n amin Asher ahisah ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Bu lah laiin Reuben apawt khie a, loulai ah zawldei-ai ava mu a, anu Leah kungah ahing tawi hi. Tuachi’n Rachel in Leah kungah, “Hepitah in na tapa zawldei-ai hing hawm in” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh aman, “Ka pasal na hing lahpieh aneu tham a na ngai amah? Tualeh ka tapa zawldei-ai zong hing lahpieh na sawm nalai amah?” achi hi. Khumin Rachel in, “Ahisihleh na tapa zawldei-ai taangin tuzan ahing luppi ding” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh nitah lam in Jakob lou a pat ahing pei a, Leah adawn dingin a pei a, tualeh a kungah, “Hing pawl in ka tapa zawldei-ai in ka hing guoizouta hi,” achi hi, tuachiin tuami zan in a luppita hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in Leah ngetna a ngaikhie a, tuachiin amanu agaita a, Jakob dingin tapa ngana ahinnpieh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Leah in, “Ka suohnu ka pasal kunga ka pieh ziehin, Pasian in ka law ahing pie hi,” achi hi; tuachiin amin Issakar aphuota hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Leah agai kia a, Jakob dingin tapa a guhna ahinpieh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Leah in, “Pasian in vanken hoitah tah ahing neisah a, tuin tapa guh tah ka nei pieh ziehin ka pasal ka kungah teng taven, achi hi, tuachiin amin Zebulun a phuota hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua zouin ta numei khat a nei a, amin Dinah aphuo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in Rachel a theizinga, a thu ngetna angai khiet pieha, anau bu ahonpieh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n a gaia tapa khat a nei a, “Pasian in simmaw a ka umna hing lahkhiet piehta,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n amin Joseph aphuo hi. “Mangpa’n tapa khat hing belap pieh nalai ding hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, Rachel in Joseph anei zouin Jakob in Laban kungah, “Ka umna mun leh gam lam a ka pei theina dingin hing sawl kheta’n achi hi.","title":"Jakob leh Laban kihouna"},"26":{"text":"‘Na nasep a ka lawdoh ka zite leh ka tate hing pienlen, hing peisah ta in; na nna ka hing seppieh dan lah na thei ngal a,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in a kungah, “Na mitmu a deisahna katan leh hepitahin khawl tadi in; aziehpen nangma vangin Mangpa’n kei ahing guolzawl chi theina ka nei hi, achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Laban in na law ding guot inlen, hing hil in hing pevang” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in a kungah, “Na nna ka hing seppieh dan leh ka kunga na ganta bang chium ahiei? chi na thei asiei mah, achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka hing pei masangin tawmnoukhat na nei a, tu’n tampi in a pungta hi. Tualeh Mangpa’n ka hing pei a pat in a hing guolzawl a, hinanleh bangchih chieng in ahiei keima innkuonte dinga ka sep khiet sam ding,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Bang ka hing pe diei?” achi hi, tualeh Jakob in “Bangma hing pe sin, tami na hing bawlpieh ding leh na gan honte vengin ka ching kia ding hi,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuni’n na ganhonte kava enkhe dinga, Belam hon lah a avom pawl nah mama te leh avom pawl chiptep leh avom pouma leh Kel lah a akang pawl nah mama te leh apuong pawl chiptepte atuom in ka la kheding a, tualeh tuban tuabanga hing pieng pouma ka law ding ahi ding hi achi hi.","title":"Jakob ganhonte apung"},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n tubansie na mitmu a um ka law tungtang thu a, na hing pei hun chieng in ka dihtatnain ahing dawnpieh mai ding hi. Kel lah a apuong pawl nah mama lou leh apuong pawl chiptep lou leh belam laha, avom lou ka kunga namu teng ka guhin ngaisun maiin achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Laban in, “Hoi e! na gen bang hita venleh” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuami ni mama in keltal akaanga azing a pawlte leh akaang pawl chiptepte leh kelnu aha-pawl leh akaang a giel chiptepte leh a kaanna um pouma, belam lah a avom zousie toh apui tuom a atapate khutah apie a."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh ama leh Jakob kikaal ah nithum lam aum sah a, tualeh Jakob in Laban ganhon um teng ahata hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in hieng sing, zuonmuot sing leh sesing tuoite chiengpum dingin ala a, ahaw akhoh ngou chiet a, a chienga angou umte akilang sah hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh achieng haw khawte pen, Tui dawn dinga ahing pei chieng ua, agai thei na ding un, ganhonte tui dawnna kuong leh tui luonna ah, a belamte mazawn ah akoi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n ganhonte chieng zawn ah a hing gaita ua, a zinga pawlte bang aha pawl mama te bang, apawl chiptepte bang, ahing nei kheta uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh, Jakob in belam noute atuom in a koi a, tualeh ganhonte Laban ganhon lah a, adung pawl leh apuong teng lam angasah a, tualeh ama ganhonte atuom koi zel a, Laban ganhon lah ah akoi sih hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh, hichi ahing hi a, gan hat deute ahing gai pat chieng un, Chieng lah apat agai theina dingun, Jakob in tui luonna ah gantate mu dingin Chiengte akoi zel hi."},"42":{"text":"Hinanleh ganta zawngkhal deute akoi sih hi, a zawngkhalte Laban a ahia, a hatte Jakob a ahizel hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n amapa hatangpi in ahing pungta a, gantate, Suohnute, suohpate, sangawngsaute leh sabiltungte tampi ahing neita hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh aman, Laban tapaten, “Jakob in ipa nei zousie alah pieh siengta hi. I pa nei leh lam apat a tambang hausatna amu ahi” achi uh azata hi.","title":"Laban kunga pat Jakob taimangna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in Laban maisuo a en a, ngaivawi, tu malam a bangin a tungah ahoi nawn sih, chi a thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuazouin Mangpa’n Jakob kungah, “Na pu leh pate leh na sanggamte gamlang ah nua peitan, ka hing umpi zing na ding hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jakob in mi a sawl a, gamlah a ganhon umna ah Rachel leh Leah ava hansah ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Napa mel ka mu in tu malam bangin ka tungah a hoi nawn sih chi ka thei a, hinanleh ka pa Pasian ka kungah aum zing hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh ka theitawp suoin na pa uh nna ka sep piehta chi na thei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh na pa un hing sol in kalaw sawmvei tah ahing suh lamdang pieha, hinanleh Pasian in ka siet na ding abawl aphal sih hi."},"8":{"text":"A pawl zousie na law ding ahing chi chiengin gan zousie in ha pawl a pawl ahing nei ua, adung pawlte na law ding ahing chi chiengin a dung pawl ahing nei zel uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuabangin Pasian in na pa uh gante lah pieh in kei ahing pie hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, ganhonte ahing gai pat chieng un ka dahtoua ngaivawi, ka mangin belam talte ganhon ha pawl a pawl leh adung pawlte leh apawl chiptepte tunga kikhap ka mu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian vansawlsiengin ka mangin ka kungah, Jakob ahing chia, tualeh keiman, tanah ka um hi ka chi hi."},"12":{"text":"Aman dahkhien len envawi, ganhonte tunga kikhap belam talte khu adung pawlte, ha pawla pawlte, tualeh apawl chiptepte bang ahi uhi. Tualeh Laban in na tunga abawl zousie ka muta hi."},"13":{"text":"Kei khu suongphu sathau na buohkhumna leh ka kunga na kichiemna, tua Bethel Pasian khu ka hi. Tuin kisa inlen tam gam a kipat pei inlen, na pienna gam lamah peikia tain achi hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 28.18-22"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Rachel leh Leah in adawng ua, a kungah “Ka pa uh inn ah kouma ding tanvou leh gouluo ding leh gou tanding aum nalai amah?"},"15":{"text":"Koute mikhuol bang giap a, hing bawl hilou ahiei mah? A hing zua zouta a, ka man uh zong ane zou siengta hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasian in ka pa ua kipat a tam hausatna alah khiet zousie ei leh i tate a ahi, tuachiin tuin Pasian in na kung a aget pouma bawl in” achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob akipan khie a, atate leh azite sangawngsau tungah a tuongsah a,"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Kanaan gam a, apa Isaak kunga pei dingin a ganta zousie leh Padan-Aram a kholkhawmte, aneilelam zousie apeipi sieng hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Laban a belam mul met dingin akuonta a, Rachel in a pa milimte aguhpieh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob Siriami Laban theilou kal in aguhin akihem manga, a pei ding thu ahilsih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n anei zousie toh a taimang ta a, tualeh thouin luipi a galkai a, Gilead tanglam zuonin a peita hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh ani thum ni’n Jakob a taita chi Laban ahil uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman a unaute a zawpi a ni sagi lamtan a nuadel ua, tuachiin Gilead tang ah a phata uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian khu Siriami Laban kungah, zanin a mangin ahing pei a, a kungah, Jakob kungah “Ahoi hi in asie hitaleh bangma genlou dingin pilvangin,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Laban in Jakob a nuaphah ta a. Tuin Jakob in a puon inn tangah a zah touta a, tualeh Laban in zong a unaute toh Gilead singtang gam ah a zah uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in Jakob kungah, “Na silbawl bang chidan ahiei?” ka theilou kaal a na kigelmanga, ka tanute zong namsau galmat banga na puimang mawh?"},"27":{"text":"Bang dinga a guh a taimang a, ka kunga kipat a kipahtah leh late, khuongte leh tumging tetoh ka hing hahkhiet theina dinga hing hillou na hiei?"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh ka tapate leh ka tanute ka tawp ding hing phallou na hiei? na nasep a mothuoi seng hi."},"29":{"text":"Na sietna ding bawl thei ka hia, hinanleh na Pa Pasian in za nitah in ka kungah Jakob kungah ahoi hi in asie hitaleh bangma gen lou dingin pilvangin chiin a hing houpi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh tuin na pa inn na ngai seng zieha pei na hitah lezong, bang dinga ka Milim pasiente na hing guhpieh ahiei?” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in a dawnga, Laban kungah, “Na tanute pauhat thuin hing lahpieh khavateh ka chia, ka zau zieh ahi” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Koi koi hinanleh na milim pasiente na muna pouma hing sih heh, I unaute mitmu a bang ahiei na neisa ka kunga um en chien inlen kilah in achi hi. Tua milim pasiente Rachel in aguh lam Jakob in athei lou zieh in."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in Jakob puon inn leh Leah puon inn leh suohnu nite puon inn ah a lut a, hinanleh amu sih hi. Khumin, Leah puon inn apat peikhie in Rachel puon inn ah alut hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh milimte pen Rachel in analah ahia, sangawngsau van lah ah akoi a ana toukhum a. Tualeh Laban in a puon inn zousie aphele a amusih hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n a pa kungah, “Na masanga ka dinkhiet theilou ziehin ka mangpa lung himaw sin, numei ngaina ka nei zieh ahibou hi,” achi hi. Tualeh aman a sui a hinanleh milimte amu zou sih hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob a lungthah a, Laban a houseta hi. Jakob in Laban kungah, “Bang e ka gamtat khielna? Ka mawna bang ahiei? tambang va-ia a thangpai a nang nuadel ta lawm?"},"37":{"text":"Ka vanteng a un a phele ta chin a, na innsung neitah bang e na mu? Eigel kikaal a thu khensat dingin ka unaute leh na unaute masangah koi in;"},"38":{"text":"Kum sawmni vingveng na kungah ka umta a, na belam pite leh na kelpiten nou anei khiel ngai vawtsih hi."},"39":{"text":"Gamsa pelupte lah na kunga hing tut lou in, keiman aluongman ka toizel hi. Sun a kigu hi in, zan a kigu hitaleh na hing dinsah zel hi."},"40":{"text":"Tambangin ka umzing hi, sun a kholum leh zan a khovot in a hing sugenthei mama a, imutna hun zong ka mu ngaisih hi."},"41":{"text":"Tambangin kum sawmni vingveng na inn ah ka uma, na tanu nite thalaw in kum sawm leh kum li na nna ka sema, na ganta thalaw dingin kum guh na nna ka sema, tualeh kalaw sawm veitah na hing suh lamdang pieh nalai hi."},"42":{"text":"Ka Pa Pasian, Abraham Pasian leh Isaak zauna ka kunga umlou hileh tuin zong saguohin hing sawl khe ngei ngei ding na hi. Pasian in ka genthei thuohna leh ka khut sepgimna amu a, zani zan a ahing phawh ahi” achi hi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in a dawnga, Jakob kungah, “Tam tanute pen keima tanu ahi ua, tam naupangte zong keima naupangte ahi uhi. Tam gantate zong keima gantate ahi ua, tualeh na mu zousie zong kei a ngen ahi. Ka tanute tung leh atate uh tungah bang ahiei tunia ka bawlthei ding?"},"44":{"text":"Tuaziehin hing pei in tuin, kei leh nang kikaal ah thuhun bawl vaiin tuamipen nang leh kei kikaal a ahing theipitu hisah vai,” achi hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in suong khat ala a, tua suong pen aphutta hi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in a unaute kungah, “Suong tomkhawm un,” achia, tuachiin suong ala ua, asepvum ua, tua avum ah ann ane uhi."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in suong kisepvum khu Jegar-Sahadutha achia, hinanleh Jakob in Galeed achi hi."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in, “Tam suong kisepvum pen tuni in nang leh kei kikaal a ahing theipi ahi,” achia, tuaziehin amin Galeed a kichi hi."},"49":{"text":"Tualeh Mizpah zong akichi hi. Aziehpen Laban in i kikhen hun chiengin “Mangpa’n kei leh nang hing veng tuoh ta hen."},"50":{"text":"Ka tanute na suh gentheia, ahisihleh ka tanute loungal zi dang na nei leh koima i kungah aum sih, en in, nang leh kei kikaal ah Pasian ahing theipi hiheh” achi hi."},"51":{"text":"Tuachi’n Laban in Jakob kungah, “Nang leh kei kikaal a ka suong sevum en inlen suong kiphut en in, achi hi."},"52":{"text":"Sietna bawl dingin tam suong sevum kanin nang lam ah hing galkai sih vangin, nangzong tam suong sevum leh tam suongphu na hing galkai lou ding ahi, achi hi. Tam suong sevum atheipi ahia, tam suong phuzong ahing theipi ahi."},"53":{"text":"Abraham Pasian leh Nahor Pasian, apa uh Pasian in i kikaal ah thu khenta heh” achi hi, tualeh Jakob in apa Isaak in a giin, Pasian min lou in akichiem ta hi."},"54":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in muol tungah kithoina a bawl a, a unaute ann ne dingin ahan hi. Tuachi’n ane ua, zankhuo in taang tungah a giehta uhi."},"55":{"text":"Tualeh zingmawng matah in Laban a thou a, a tapate leh a tanute a tawpa a guolzawl hi. Tuachi’n Laban a peita a, a umna mun ah ahing tung kiata hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob apei zel a, Pasian vansawlsiengten ana lamdot uhi.","title":"Jakob Israel kichi ta"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in amauh amu tahin, tamte pen “Pasian galkapte ahi uh,” achi a tuachiin tuami mun khu Mahanaim achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in Seir gam a Edom langa a upa Esau kungah thangkou asawl masa hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh akung uah, “Ka mangpa Esau kungah tambangin vagen un, na suoh Jakob in tambangin agen hi, Laban kungah mikhuol in kava um a, tudongin ka um hi."},"5":{"text":"Bawngtalte, sabiltungte gan honte leh suohnute leh suohpate ka nei hi. Tuachi’n na mitmu a hepina ka mu theina dingin, ka mangpa hil dinga mi ka hing sawl ahi,’’ chi in vagen un, chiin amauh thu apie hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n thangkoute Jakob kungah, “Ahing kile kia ua, na upa Esau kung kava tung ua, amazong pasal zali toh nang lamtuo dingin ahing pei hi” achi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob azau seng senga, a lungkhamta hi. Tuachi’n a kunga mipi umte, Belam honte, Bawngtalte leh Sangawngsaute pawl ni in a khena."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh “Esau pawlkhat kung a ahing pei a, a tha taah a ahileh a pawldang pen a suohta ding” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in, “Aw! Ka pa Abraham Pasian leh ka pa Isaak Pasian, ka kunga, ‘na gamlam leh na tanaute kungah pei kia inlen, hoitahin hing bawl vang chipa Mangpa.’"},"10":{"text":"Na suoh tunga na latsah hepinate lah leh thutahte lah a a neupen zong tangtah ka hisih, ka chiengkhut toh tam Jordan gal ka kaia, tuin pawl ni ka hita uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hepitahin ka upa khut apat, Esau khut apat, in hing hundohin, numei naupang puma ahing na tha khah ding ka zau hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh nangman, hoitahin ka hing bawl dinga nahah nasuonte Tuipi a pieunel sim senglou bangin bawl vang na chi hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 22.17"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum zan in khum munah a gieha, tualeh aneitah laha pat a upa Esau nuomman ding alakhie a;"},"14":{"text":"Kelpi za ni, keltal sawmni; Belampi za ni leh Belamtal sawmni toh."},"15":{"text":"Sangawngsau nawi suhlai sawmthum leh anoute toh, Bawngpi sawm leh Bawngtal sawmni, Sabiltungpi sawmni leh Sabiltungnou sawm;"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuate atuom chiet in asuohte khutah a kemsah a, asuohte kungah, “Ka masang ah pei galkai unlen, pawl chin akaal umsah zel un” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh aman amasapen kungah, “Ka upa Esau in ahing kituohpi a, na kunga koi na hiei? heia haw ding na hiei? Tualeh na masanga umte koite ahi uoi? chia ahing doh leh;"},"18":{"text":"A kungah, na suoh Jakob a ahi uh, ka mangpa Esau kunga nuomman a apieh dinga ahing hah ahi; tualeh ngai in, ama zong ka nua uah aum hi, na chi ding hi,” chi in thu apie hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh aman a nina leh athumna leh ganhon hawlte zousie kungah, “Esau na mu chieng un hichibang main na chi ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh ngaivawi, na suoh Jakob ka nua uah aum hi chi chiet un chi’n thu apechiet hi. Aman “Nuomnante ka masangah pei leh a lung ka damsah dinga, tuazou chiengin amel mu vang, tuachi’n ana hing kipahpi khamaw sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n nuomman khu a masangah apei galkai sah a, amapen tua zan in apawlte lah ah agieh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh zan in a thou a, a zi tegel leh a suohte ni leh a tapa sawm leh khatte puiin Jabbok luita kaina ah a kaipi ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh amauh a zawpi a, lui agalkai sah a, anei zousie zong agal kaisah hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob amatangin aumta a, tualeh mi khat in phalvah dongin a kibuonpi hi.","title":"Jakob in Vansawlsieng a kibuonpi","ref":"Hos. 12.3,4"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh azou sih chi akithei in, akhelpi gu kituona atham pieha, tuachiin akibuon laiun Jakob khelpi gutuona akilawi ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman “Hing ha in, khuo vah ding ahita,” achia, Jakob in “Na hing guolzawl masangsie hing ha vawt sihvang” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman a kungah, “Na min bang e?” achi hi, Aman “Jakob” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Aman, “Na min Jakob kichi nawn sih vanin, Israel ahing kichi tading hi. Nangman Pasian leh mihing na buona, na zouta hi” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 35.10"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in, “Hepitahin na min hinghil vawi” chi in a donga, Aman “Bang zieh a ka min na hing doh ahiei?” achi a, tuachiin tuamun ah ama aguolzawl ta hi.","ref":"Vai. 13.17,18"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in tuamun min Peniel achita hi. “Pasian kimaituo in ka mu a, ka hinna ahing khawipieh nahlai ziehin,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Penuel a galkai lai in nisa in ama ahing khawta a, a khelpi ziehin abaita hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuni dongin Israel taten malpi gu kituona a sa pangpan um ane ngaisih uhi. Jakob malpi gu tuo a, a pangpan laitah akhoi pieh ziehin."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in dahtou a a-et leh ngaivawi, Esau khu pasal zali toh ahing pei hi. Tuachi’n aman atate khu Leah leh Rachel leh a suohnu nite kungah ahawm khen a.","title":"Jakob leh Esau kimuna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh suohnute leh atate uh amasapen in akoi a, Leah leh atate a ban ah akoi a, tualeh Rachel leh Joseph anukhiapen ah a koi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama khu amasang uah apei a, a upa kung atun masangin sagi vei tuol suin a bawhkhup hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Esau khu ana lamtuo dingin a tai a, a poma a ngawngkawi a atawpta hi. Tuachi’n ani un akap tuohta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachia Esau adah leh numeite leh naupangte amu a, “Na kunga umte koite ahiei?” achi hi, aman “Pasian in hepina toh na suoh ahing pieh naupangte ahi uhi” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n suohnute khu atate utoh ahing pei ua, kunin chibai abuh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Leah zong atate utoh ahing pei nai ua, kunin chibai abuh ua, tuazou in Joseph leh Rachel ahing pei ua kunin chibai abuh uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Esau in a kungah, “Ganhon ka hing kituohpi tengpi bang chidan ahiei?” achi hi, aman, “Tamte ka mangpa mitmu a hepina ka mu theina ding ahi.” Achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Esau in a kungah, “Nau aw, kenzong kichingtah in ka neina hi, nanei zousie nanga hizaw heh” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh, Jakob in, “Hilou e, na mitmu a hepina ka mu leh hepitahin ka nuomman hing piehte hing sanpieh in, aziehpen Pasian mel mu bangin na mai ka mu a, ka tungah lah na kipah ngal a."},"11":{"text":"Pasian in ahing khotuo ziehin hunkhop tahpi ka nei a, ka guolzawlna don, ka hing puohte hing sanpieh in chiin ka hing ngen ahi, achi a,” tualeh azawl paupau ziehin alata hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Esau in, “Kisa’n pei vaiin, keiman ma kai vangin zawhkhawm vai,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Jakob in a kungah, “Naupangte aneu seng nalai uh chileh belam hon leh bawngnou hat nailoute ka kungah aum uhi, chi ka mangpa’n na thei hi achi hi, ni khat maimai zong hattah a akihawl leh ganhon zousie ashi sieng ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hepitahin ka mangpa, na suohpa masangah pei inlen, tualeh Seir taanga ka mangpa kung ka hing tun masang sien, ka masanga pei ganhonte leh naupangte ahi thei dan danin awlnou nouin hing zawpi vang” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Esau in, “Tuin ka kunga um mi khenkhatte beeh hing nuasie lenglah,” achi hi. Hinanleh aman, “Bang ngaise ding e? Ka mangpa mitmu in hepina hing musah mai vawi?” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Esau khu tuami ni in Seir tanglam zuonin akia kiata hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob pen Sukkoth zuonin a pei a, ama dingin inn khat aki lam a, agantate dingin buh khat alampieh hi. Tuaziehin khum mun khu Sukkoth akichi hi.","title":"Jakob Kanaan ah atengta"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob Padan-Aram gam a kipat ahing pei a, Kanaan gam a um Shekem khopi ah damtahin ahing tunga, apuon-inn khopi mazon ah azahta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Shekem pa Hamor tate khut apat gam neunou khat Dangka za khat in a lei a, tuanah apuoninn azahta hi.","ref":"Josh. 24.32; Jn. 4.5"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum munah maitam khat adaw a, amin El-elohe Israel aphuo hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Leah in Jakob toh ahinpieh atanu Dinnah, khum gam a nungahte en dingin a pawtkhie a.","title":"Jakob in asepga alaw"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh tuagam Lengpa Hivmi Hamor tapa Shekem in ana mu a, aman a luppi a abuasah ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh aman Jakob tanu Dinnah khu alunggul vevaw a, angai seng manin kamsiem tahin ahoupi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Shekem in apa Hamor kungah, “Tam nungah ka zi dingin hing lah pieh in” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in atanu Dinnah, Shekem in abuasah chi aza a, tua hun laiin a tapate gamlah ah ganta toh aum ua, tuachiin amauh hing tun masangsie, Jakob asip khinkhian hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Shekem pa Hamor khu Jakob kihoupi dingin a kungah a hing pei a."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob taten tam thu azah tah un, gam lah apat ahing pei ua, tualeh Jakob tanu luppi a, Israelte lah a sil gilou mot-huoi, bawl vawt lou ding sil abawl ziehin a lunggim ua, a thangpai mama uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Hamor in amaute ahoupi a, a kung uah “Ka tapa Shekem in na tanu alunggul vevaw a, hepitahin azi dingin hing pie un” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh zi leh ta in kiteng tua va ui, na tanute uh hing pie unlen, kou tanute zong la un."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n kou toh na tengkhawm ding ua, gam zong ahing kihawm pieh dinga, summet bawl unlen tanah kikhuol ta un, nei leh lam khol in teng un,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Shekem in a nungahpa leh asanggampate kungah, “Hing hepi unlen, ka kunga na gen pouma uh hing pevang achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Manlemuol leh silpieh na hing nget nuom zaza uh ngen unlen, ka kunga na genbang bangun hing pevang, hinanleh nungah pen ka zi dingin hing pie un” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Jakob taten asanggamnu uh Dinnah abuasah ziehin Shekem leh apa Hamor sol bawlna toh adawng ua, thu agen uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh amaun akung uah, “Tam sil, teptanlou mi kunga ka naunu uh pieh pen bawl thei sih va ung, aziehpen kou dinga min sietna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh tambanga na bawl u’leh lem ka sa ding uhi, nalah ua pasal teng a tep na tan ua, kou banga na um u’leh."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka tanute uh hing pe va ungin, kon zong na tanute uh lava ungin, tuachi’n nou toh ka tengkhawm ding ua, chikhat ihita ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh teptan ding thu a ka thu uh na zui sih ding u’leh ka tanu uh zawpi va-ungin, pei mai va-ung,” achi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh a thugen un Hamor leh Hamor tapa Shekem akipah sah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n atangval pan Jakob tanu adei seng ziehin, ni sawt hallouin tua sil abawlta hi. Amapen apa innkuonpite zousie sanga mite zatat pen ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Hamor leh atapa Shekem khu akhopi kul Kotpi ah ahing pei ua, a khopi mite toh akihou lim ua akung uah."},"21":{"text":"“Tam mite eite toh kilemtah in aum uhi, tuaziehin tami gamah teng uhen len, tam gam sungah summet bawl uhen, ngaivawi un, ama ua dingin gam alien hun mama hi. A tanute uh zi dingin la vaiin, amaute zong i tanute uh pevai, achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tam mite toh kilemtah a tengkhawm a, chi khat namkhat ihi theina ding aum hi. Amaute teptan ahi bangun, pasal zousie teptan hilei."},"23":{"text":"A gamte uh anei alamte uh, aganta khoite zousie uh eite a hing himai lou ding amah? A thu uh lemsahpi vaiin, ikung uah a teng maiding uhi” achi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Hamor leh atapa Shekem thu khu Kulkot a pawt zousien a za ua, a khopi kul kotpi a pawt pasal zousie tep atanpieh ta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh, ni thum niin, hichi ahing hi a, a nat laitah un Jakob tate ni Simeon leh Levi, Dinnah sanggamten a namsau uh aman ua, hangsan tahin khopi ahing bulu ua, pasal zousie athat siengta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh amaun, Hamor leh atapa Shekem khu namsau hiemin a that ua, Shekem inn apat Dinnah apuikhie ua, a peita uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob tapaten ami thate uh ava tun khum ua, asanggamnu uh kisuh buana khopi asimta uhi."},"28":{"text":"A belamte, uh, a bawngtalte uh, asabiltungte uh khopi sunga sil umte pouma leh alou ua sil um poumate alah pieh uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh anei alam zousie uh, a taneute uh leh a zite uh sal in aman ua, innsunga um pouma atomgam pieh ta uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in Simeon leh Levi kungah, “Tam gam a umte lah a Kanaanmite leh Periz mite lah ah huot nang lawsah ua, nang lunggim sah seng uhi. Kei tawmnou khat ka hi ziehin ang dou dingin hing kikhawm va un, ahing that ding ua, ahing sumangthai ding uhi, kei leh ka innkuonpite toh,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh amaun, “Ka sanggamnu uh kizua banga abawl ding uh ahiei mah?” achi uhi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in Jakob kungah, “Kisa inlen Bethel ah peitou inlen, tuanah tengin. Tualeh khunah na upa Esau kunga kipat a na taimang lai a, na kunga kilah Pasian a dingin maitam bawl in,” achi hi.","title":"Jakob Bethel tungkia","ref":"Siem. 28.11-17"},"2":{"text":"Jakob in a innkuonpite kung leh a kunga um zousie kungah, “Na lah ua gamdang pasien umte paimang unlen, kisusiengthou unlen, tualeh na puon sil uh heng un."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n kisa vai in, Bethel ah peitou vai, tuanah ka lungdon lai a hing dawngpa leh ka pei peina lam a ka kunga um ngitnget Pasian a dingin maitam bawl vang” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Jakob kungah, a khut ua um gamdang pasien zousie leh abil ua aba uh bilba zousie Jakob kungah apie ua, Jakob in tuate zousie Shekem kunga um gangpi phung nuoiah a phuolta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh apei zel ua Pasian giinna khu akimvel ua khopite tungah aum a, Jakob tapate adelzui sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob Kanaan gam a um Luz khuo ahing tunga, tuakhu Bethel ahi, ama leh akunga um zousie toh."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh khunah maitam a bawl a, a sanggampa masanga kipat ataimang lai a Pasian akunga akilah ziehin khummun min El-Bethel aphuo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Rebekah donnu, Deborah ashi a Bethel nuoi a gangpi sing nuoi ah avui ua, tua gangpi sing min khu Allon-Bakuth akichi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob Padan-Aram gam a kipat ahing peidoh laiin, Pasian a kungah akilah kia a, tualeh ama aguolzawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in a kungah, “Na min Jakob ahi a, na min Jakob kichi nawnsih vanin, Israel ahizaw ta ding achi hi,” tuachiin amin Israel achita hi.","ref":"Siem. 32.28"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in a kungah “Kei Pasian bangkimbawlthei ka hi, chi tampi suongin hing pung inlen, genkham ching nam tampi leh nam tuomtuom nanga kipat hing um vanin, tualeh nangma tahsa akipat leengte zong ahing umdoh ding uhi.","ref":"Siem. 17.4-8"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Abraham leh Isaak kunga ka pieh gam khu nangma kungah hing pevangin, tualeh na nua a nahah nasuonte kungah gam khu pe zel vang,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in ama a houpina mun akipat apeitou santa hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in ama ahoupi na munah khuom khat a phuta, tua suong khuom tungah dawn ding sillat a sunga sathau a sun khum hi.","ref":"Siem. 28.18,19"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in, Pasian in ama a houpina mun khu Bethel achi ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Bethel apat apei zel ua, Ephrath tunna ding gamla simtah ahi nalai hi. Tuachi’n Rachel in nau a vei a, a gim mama ta hi.","title":"Rachel leh Isaak shi"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, agim mama laitahin naudomnu in a kungah “Zau vawtsin, tapa dang nei ding na hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, a hagau aha ding kuonin (a shita a) amin Ben-oni a phuo a, hinanleh apan Benjamin chiin ahan hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rachel a shita a, Ephrath lampi ah avuita ua, Tuapen Bethlehem ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in ahan tungah khuom a phuta, tuakhu tuni dongin Rachel han suongphu ahi zing hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Israel khu apei zel a, Migdol Eder inn sang gal lam ah a puon inn azah hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahi a, Israel khum gam a aten laiin, Reuben in apa meinu Bilhah ava luppi a, tuakhu Israel in athei ta hi. Tuachi’n Jakob tapate sawm leh ni ahi uhi.","ref":"Siem. 49.4"},"23":{"text":"Leah tapate Reuben, Jakob ta masapen leh Simeon, Levi, Juda, Issakar leh Zebulun."},"24":{"text":"Rachel tapate Joseph leh Benjamin."},"25":{"text":"Rachel suohnu Bilhah tapate Dan leh Naphtali."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Leah suohnu Zilpah tapate, Gad leh Asher; tamte pen Jakob tapate Padan-Aram gam a aneite ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob khu Abraham leh Isaak umna Kirjath-Arba khum khu Hebron ahi, Mamre ah apa Isaak kung ahing tungta hi.","ref":"Siem. 13.18"},"28":{"text":"Tuin Isaak damsung kum za leh kum sawmgiet ahita hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isaak upa vuoikawn vawt a damin ashita hi. A chipite kunga pui in aumta, a tapate Esau leh Jakob in avuita uhi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tamte Esau (Edom kichipa) hahlesuonte ahi uhi.","title":"Esau suonte min"},"2":{"text":"Esau in Kanaan gam a nungahte zi in anei hi. Hitmi Elon tanu Adah leh Hivmi Zibeon tanu, Anah tanu Aholibamah leh,","ref":"Siem. 26.34"},"3":{"text":"Ishamael tanu Nebaioth sanggamnu, Basemath ahi uhi.","ref":"Siem. 28.9"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Adah in Esau dingin Eliphaz ahin pieh a, Basemath in Reuel ahing hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Aholibamah in Jeush leh Jaalam leh Korah ahing hi. Tamte pen Esau tapate Kanaan gam a aneite ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Esau in a zite, a tapate a tanute a innsung mi zousie leh a gantate zousie, tualeh Kanaan gam a a sum lamdoh zousie puoin a naupa Jakob apat in gamdang ah apeita hi."},"7":{"text":"Anei a lamte uh a tam seng ziehin a tengkhawm thei sih uhi. Tualeh ganta a hau seng zieh un mi khuol ahina gam un adawl zou tasih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Esau khu Seir taangah a tengta hi. (Esau pen Edom ahi)"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh tamte Seir taanga Edom mite pa Esau hahlesuonte ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tamte Esau tapate min ahi; Esau zi Adah tapa Eliphaz leh Esau zi Basemath tapa Reuel."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Eliphaz tapate, min Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam leh Kenos ahi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Timna khu Esau tapa Eliphaz meinu ahia, aman Eliphaz dingin Amalek ahinpieh hi. Tamte Esau zi Adah tate ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh tamte Reuel tapate ahi uhi, Nahath, Zerah, Shammah leh Mizzah, tamte Esau zi Basemath tapate ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh tamte Esau zi Zibeon tanu Anah tanu Aholibamah tapate ahi uh, Aman Esau dingin Jeush, Jaalam leh Korah ahinpieh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tamte Esau tapate laha a lamkaite ahi uhi; Esau tamasapen Eliphaz tapate, Eliphaz tapate lamkai Teman, lamkai Zepho, lamkai Kanaz."},"16":{"text":"Lamkai Korah, Lamkai Gatam, tualeh lamkai Amalek, tamte Edom gam a Eliphaz akipat hing piengkhie lamkaite ahi uhi; tamte Adah tapate ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh tamte pen Esau tapa Reuel tapate ahi uhi, lamkai Nahath, lamkai Zerah, lamkai shammah, lamkai Mizzah, tamte Edom gam a Reuel akipat hing pawtkhie lamkaite ahi uhi. Tamte Esau zi Basemath tapate ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tamte Esau zi Aholibamah tapate ahi uhi. Lamkai Jeush, lamkai Jaalam, lamkai Korah, tamte Esau zi Anah tanu Aholibamah akipat a hing piengte ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tamte Edom kichi Esau tapate ahi ua, tualeh tamte a lamkaite ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tamte tua gam a teng Hormi Seir tapate ahi uhi. Loton, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah leh."},"21":{"text":"Dishon Ezer leh Dishan, tamte Edom gam a Seir tapate Hormite lamkai ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Lotan tapate Hori leh Hemam ahi uh. Lotan sanggamnu Timna ahi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh tamte Shobal tapate ahi uhi. Alvan Manahath; Ebal, Shepho leh Onam."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh tamte Zibeon tate ahi, Ajah leh Anah, tam Anah khu gamdai a apa Sabiltungte achin laia, gamdaia tuisa pulna luikhuh mukhepa ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Anah tate tamte ahi; Dishon leh Anah tanu Aholibamah."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh tamte Dishon tate ahi uh, Hemdam, Eshbon, Ithran leh Cheran."},"27":{"text":"Ezer tate tamte ahi uh, Bilhan, Zaavan leh Akan."},"28":{"text":"Dishan tate tamte ahi, Uz leh Aran."},"29":{"text":"Tamte Hormite akipat hing pawt lamkaite ahi uh, lamkai Lotan, lamkai Shobal, lamkai Zibeon, lamkai Anah."},"30":{"text":"Lamkai Dishon, lamkai Ezar, lamkai Dishan tamte Seir gam a hing pawt Hormite lamkaite ahi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh tamte Israel tate tunga leeng koiman vai ahawm masanga, Edom gam a vaihawm leengte ahi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Beor tapa Bela in Edom gamah vai ahawm a, a khopi min Dinhabah ahi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Bela ashi bepin Bozrah khuo a um Zerah tapa Jobab in vai ahawm hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Jobab ashi bepin Teman gam a mi Husham in a taangin vai ahawm hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Husham ashi bepin Moab gamlah a Midian thatpa, Bedad tapa Hadad in a taangin vai ahawm hi; a khopi min Avir ahi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Hadad ashi bepin Masrekah a um samlah in a taangin vai ahawm hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh samlah ashi bepin, luipi gei a teng Rehoboth a um Shaul in a taangin vai ahawm hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Shaul ashi bepin Akbor tapa Baalhanan in a taangin vai ahawm hi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Akbor tapa Baalhanan ashi bepin Hadar in a taang in vai ahawm hi. A khopi min Pau ahi, tualeh azi min Mehetabel, Mezahah tanu Matred tanu ahi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh tamte a innkuon u’leh a khomun u’leh amin uh dungzui a, Esau akipat hing pawt lamkaite minte ahi; Lamkai Timna lamkai Alvah, lamkai Jetheth."},"41":{"text":"Lamkai Aholibamah, lamkai Elah, lamkai Pinon."},"42":{"text":"Lamkai Kenaz, lamkai Teman, lamkai Mibzan."},"43":{"text":"Lamkai Magdiel, lamkai Irom, tamte agam neina sung ua a umna uh dungzui a, Edom lamkaite ahi uhi, amapen Edom mite pa Esau ahi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob khu apa mikhuol hina gam, Kanaan gamah atengta hi.","title":"Jakob khantan sutzopna"},"2":{"text":"Tamte Jakob hah leh suonte ahi uhi, Joseph in kum sawm leh sagi ahi in, a ute toh ganhon aching ua, tam valnou pen apa zite Bilhah tapate leh Zilpah tapate toh a umkhawm uhi. Tualeh Joseph in a gitlouna uh apa kungah ahing tun zel hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Israel in Joseph khu ateh nua-a ata ahi ziehin ata dangte sangin a it zaw hi. Tuachi’n Puon ah tuol ze tuom tuom a pawl khat abawl pieh hi;"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh apa un amapen a ute dang teng sangin a it zaw chi amaun a theitah un, ama amuda ua a kungah kampha mawngmawng a houpi aum sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in mang anei a, tuami a ute a hil a, tuachi’n amaun amuda deu deu ta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akung uah, “Hepitahin ta kamang thu ngaivawi un, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngaiun, lou ah buphai ina kaan ua, tualeh ngaivawi un, kei buphai ahing thou a, ahing ding hi. Tuachi’n ngaivawi un, nou buphaite khu akimvel ah ading ua, kei buphai chibai bawl in akhupboh uhi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh a uten a kungah, “Nangin ih ka tung ua vai na hawm phuat ding? Ahisihleh nang ih ka tung ua thunei phuat ding?” Achi ua, tuachi’n ama mang zieh leh a thugente ziehin amuda deu deuta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman mang dang khat anei kia a, tuami a ute ahil kia a, “Ngai un, mang dang khat kaman kia hi. Ni leh Ha leh aasi sawm leh khat ten chibai ahing buh ua, abohkhup uhi” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman tam thute apa leh a ute a hil a, tualeh apa’n aphawh a, a kungah, “Bang mang na mat valong ahiei? Kei leh na nu leh na ute na masanga lei a khupboh in chibai kang bawl talawm ding uh amah?” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n a uten ama athangsiet ua, hinanleh a pa’n athugente alungsim ah a vom zing hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.9"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh a ute, apa uh ganhonte ching dingin Shekem ah apei uhi.","title":"Joseph izipt gam a zuana"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Israel in Joseph kungah, “Na uten Shekem gamah ganhon ching hilou uh ahiei mah? Hing peivawi, a kung uah hing sawl vang,” achi hi, tuachiin aman “Tanah um inge,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman a kungah, “Hepitahin pei inlen, na ute leh aganhonte uh adamna uoi mah va en inlen, tualeh athu hinghil kia in” achi hi.
