Tuachi’n ama khu Hebron phaiguom akipat in apei a Shekem avatung hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n koi ahiei mi khat in gamlah a vah kawikawi amu a, tualeh tua mipan a kungah, “Bang ahiei na sui” chi’n a dong hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Ka ute sui ka hi, heitah ahiei aganhon chinna uh hinghil in” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua mipan, “Tana patin apawt kheta uhi. Dothan ah peivai akichi uh kaza hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Joseph in a ute anuadel a, ava muta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh amaun gamlapi apat in ana galmu ua, akung nai uh ahing tun masangin, ama tha ding thu ana phiel ta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh khat leh khat kikumin, “En un, mang neipa hing pei e."},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin hing pei un, that vaiin kokhuh sung khat ah khe vaiin, gamsa gilou in aneta chimai vai, tuachi’n amangte bang ahing suoh eimah envai?” akichi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Reuben in tam thu aza a, akhut ua pat a hunkhie a, “That talawm sih vai,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Reuben in akhut uapat a hunkhie a, apa uh kunga anuapei kia theina dingin, akung uah, “Sisan vang suo sih un, gamlah a guomkuoh sungah khie un, a tungah khut havawt sih un” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hia, Joseph a ute kunga ahing tunin, amaun Joseph in puonahtuol zetuom tuom a pawl asil khu asutpieh ua."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n apui ua, kokhuh sung khat ah akhie uhi. Tua kokhuh khu aguoh ahia, tui aumsih hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh ann ne dingin atou ua, tualeh dahdoh in a en ua, tualeh ngaivawi, Ishmael mite pawl khat Gilead gam akipat a sangawngsau ua gimtuite, Singnai damdawite leh murrahte puo a Izipt gam a peisuh dingte ahing pei uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda in a unaute kungah “I naupa uh that in imlei bang e aphattuom na ding?"},"27":{"text":"Hing peiun, Ishmael mite kungah zua vaiin, tualeh a tungah khut hasih vai, ama lah i naupa uh, i tahsa vawt ahi thuoi a,” achi hi. Tuachi’n anauten a thukimpi ta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Midianmi summet bawlte ahing pei ua, Kokhuh apat in Joseph alakhie ua, Ishmael mite kungah Dangka sawmni in azuata uhi. Tualeh amaun Joseph pen Izipt gamah atutta uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.9"},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Reuben khu kokhuh ah ahing pei kia a, tualeh ngaiun, kokhuh sungah Joseph ana umta sih hi. Tuachi’n aman a puonahte abotkeh ta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh a sanggamte kungah ahing kile kia a, “I nau lah aum nawn sin, kei heisung suding kata diei?” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Joseph puonah tuol ala ua, kelnou khat athat ua, apuonah tuol khu sisan lah ah adie uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n puonah tuol zetuom tuom a pawl ahah ua, apa uh kung ahing tut ua, “Tami maimai ka mu uhi, na tapa puonah tuol ahi nai? ahi siei? en in” achi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh aman athei pai a, “Tampen ka tapa puonah tuol hina, gamsa gilou khat in a neh hitaven maw, Joseph zong bawtel gawpa um hitaven maw?” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in a puon sillaite abotkeh a, akawng ah la-ip puon a tenga, a tapa ni tampi asuun hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh a tapate leh a tanute zousie ama henem dingin ahing pei ua, hinanleh amapa henem ding anuom sih a, kap kawmin akung uah “Kei zong ka tapa kungah han ah, lunggim pumin ka peisuh ding,” achi hi. Tambangin apa’n ama akaa hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n midianten Joseph khu Izipt gamah Pharoah nuoia milien Potiphar, veng pawlte lamkaipa kungah azuata uhi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuahun laiin hichi ahing hi a, Juda khu a unaute kung apat apeisuh a amin Hirah kichi Adullam mi khat avabel ta hi.","title":"Juda khelna zumhuoi hi"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Juda in tua muna Kanaan mi amin Shuoh kichipa tanu khat amu a, a kitenpi ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n nau a pai a, tapa a nei a, apa’n amin Er aphuo hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh agai kia a tapa khat anei kia a, amanu’n amin Onan ahisah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh agai kia zel a, tapa khat anei kia a, amin Shelah ahisah hi. Amapa anei lai in, Juda Kezib a um ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Juda in atapa masa Er dingin zi alah pieh a, amanu min Tamar ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Juda tamasa Er khu Mangpa mitmu in agilou a, tuachi’n Mangpa’n athat ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Juda in Onan kungah, “Na upa zi pawl inlen, kitenpi in, achi hi. Tualeh na upa dingin hahlesuon nei piehin” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Onan in hahlesuon pen ama a ding ahisih chi athei a, tualeh hichi ahing hi a, a upa zi apawl chiengin a upa dinga hahlesuon aum louna dingin leiah akesah zel hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh tuabanga asil bawl in, Mangpa alungdam sah tasih a, tuaziehin ama zong athat ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda in amounu Tamar kungah, “Ka tapa Shelah pichin masang sien na pa inn ah meithai in va umtadi in” achi hi; tua ahisihleh ama zong a ute bangin hing shi khava achi zieh ahi. Tuachi’n, Tamar a pei a apa inn ah atengta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh hun hing pei zel in, Juda zi Shuoh tanu ahing shita a, Juda in a-it angaina athen bepin, Timnah khuo a abelam mul heute kungah a lawmpa Adullam mi Hirah toh ahawta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Tamar kungah “En in, na innpipa a Belam mul heu dingin Timnah khuo ah peitou ding ahi,” chiin ahil ua."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh aman ameithai puonte a koikhie a, kikhuna puona kikhuin amel kitheilouna dingin akituom a, tuachiin Timnah khuo lampi a Enaim kotpi lutna lampi gei mun awng khat ah ana touta hi. Aziehpen Shelah zong apiching ahita ngal a, a zi dingin amanu akipsih chi athei hi."},"15":{"text":"Juda in amanu amu tahin kizuami hi dingin a ngaituo a, amai akikhu ziehin."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n lamgei a numeinu kungah akihei a, “Hepitahin hing peivawi, lum khawm vai” achi a, (aman amounu ahilam athei sih hi.) Tuachi’n amanu’n “Nahing luppi man bang na hing pe diei?” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Ganhonte lah a kelnou khat hing hah vang” achi hi, tualeh amanu’n “Tuami nang hah masangin ka kep ding kichiemna khat hing pelou ding na mah?” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh aman, “Na kep ding bang kichiemna kahing pe diei?” achi hi. Amanu’n “Na min namna leh na tau leh na khut a na chieng tawi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n apie a, aluppi a nau avopsah ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu ading khie a, apeita hi; tualeh amai khuna puon ahawhkhie a, meithai hina puon asilta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Juda in numeinu a sil kepsahte amu kia theina dingin a lawmpa Adullam mi khut ah kelnou ahah a, hinanleh amanu amu zou tasih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Enaim gawlzing gei a tou a kizuanu heia um atai?” chiin tuamun a mi umte kungah a donga, tualeh amauten “Tamnah kizua koima um ngaisih” achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh ama khu Juda kungah ahing kilekia a, amanu muzou sing. Tualeh khuna miten zong “Tanah kizua aum ngaisih achi uhi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda in “Neiden mai heh, tuachilou invang zala khavai, Ngaivawi, tam kelnou ka hah a, amanu lah vamu zoulou chin a,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh ha thum ding nuain, hichi ahing hia, Juda kungah, “Na mounu Tamar akizua hi,” tualeh “Ngai in, zawlta apaita hi chiin ava hilta uhi.’ Tuachi’n Juda in hing puikhie unlen hallup in um heh” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh ahing puidoh tah un, Tamar in “Tam silte neipa apat ahi nau ka pai chiin a innpipa kungah mi a sawl a,” tualeh amanu mama in “Tam silte, min namnate, taute leh chiengkhutte koi a ahiei? hepitahin enchien un,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda in ama-a ahi chi atheikhie a, “Kei sangin ama adihtat zaw hi, amanu ka tapa Shelah kunga kapieh lou ziehin” achi hi; tuachiin aluppi ngai nawn tasih hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh anauvei hun ahing tuntahin hichi ahi a, Ngai vawi, anaubu ah naupeng a um hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, anauvei laiin khatpa’n akhut ahing hadoh a, tualeh naudom nu’n akhut ah khausan khat akhi a “Tami ahing pawt masa ahi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, akhut anualah lut laiin, Ngai vawi, anaupa ahing pawtdohta hi. Tuachi’n naudomnu’n “Bang ding a pawtna ding kibawl na hiei? Tami bawsietna na tungah um heh,” achi a, tuaziehin amin Perez aphuo uhi."},"30":{"text":"Anuain a upa, akhut a khausan kikhi pen ahing pawt a, amin Zerah aphuo uhi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph khu Izipt gamah apui suh ua, Pharoah nuoi a milien veng pawlte lamkai, Izipt mi Potiphar in khuna hing puisuh Ishmael mite khut apat in aleita hi.","title":"Joseph in solna atuoh"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Joseph aumpi a, tuachi’n mi lawching tah ahia, apu Izipt mi inn ah aum hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.9"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh apu’n Mangpa’n ama aumpi a, asil bawl pouma ah Mangpa’n akhut ah a lawching sah chi a thei a."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in apu mitmu in hepina a tanga, ana asep pieh hi. Tuachi’n aman a innsung mite tungah vaisai in apangsah a, anei zousie a khutah a unin a koi sieng hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n innsunga vaisai a akoi akipat tambang ahing hi a, Mangpa’n Izipt mi innsung, Joseph zal in a guolzawl ta hi. Inn leh gam a anei zousie tungah Mangpa guolzawlna aum hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman anei zousie a unin Joseph khutah a koia, tuachiin ann neh chilou anei zousie bangma theiphah anei sih hi. Tualeh Joseph mi melhoi mama leh etlawm tah ahia."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tamte zouin hichi ahing hi a, apu zi in Joseph a dei et a, tuachiin “Hing luppi in” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh ama a ut sih a, apu zi kungah “En in, ka puin tam innsung ah, ka kungah bang aum ei chi athei vateh sih hi, anei zousie a unin ka khutah ahing kemsah hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam inn sungah keisanga lienzaw koima aum sih hi; a zi na hi ziehin nang chilou kei a dingin bangma it anei sih hi. Tuaziehin bang dingin tambang mawna lienpi bawl in, Pasian tungah sil gilou bawl in ka khiel thei diei?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing ahia, ni chinin Joseph zawl nanleh ama luppi thu leh ama toh umkhawm lam thu ah a ngaisah nuom vawtsih hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh tua hun laiin hichi ahing hia, a nasem dingin Joseph khu inn sungah ava lut a, tualeh inn sungah mi mawngmawng koima aum sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n a puonsil in ana man a, “Hing luppi in” a chi hi. Tualeh aman a khutah a puonsil a nuasie a, a taisanta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, a puonsil a khutah nuasiein ataikhie chi amutahin;"},"14":{"text":"Amanu’n a inn a mite a han a, a kung uah, “Envawi un, hing zumsah dinga Hebrumi khat i kung ua hing puilut ahita khula, hing luppi tumin ka kungah ahing lut a, tuachiin aw ngaitahin ka kikou ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, aw ngaitah a ka kikou azah tahin a puonsil ka kungah nuasie in a taidohta hi” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh apu inn ahing tun masangsie’n a puonsil a kungah ana koi den hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n akungah tambangin agen a, “Hebru suoh i kunga na hing puiin hing suhzalat tumin ka kungah ahing lut a."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, aw ngaitaha ka kikou leh a puonsil ka kunga nuasie in atai dohta hi” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, apu in a zinu’n a kunga “Tambang talawm a na suohpa’n a hing bawl” chithu azah tahin a lungthah ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph apu’n azawpi a, leengpa miliente akhumna uh suongkul ah akhumta hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n Joseph aumpi a, ahepina akilang sah a, suongkul vengpa mitmu ah deisahna a tangsah hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.9"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n suongkul vengpan suongkul aum suongkultang zousie Joseph khutah a unin akeem sah a, tuana abawl zousie uh Joseph bawl ahimai hi."},"23":{"text":"Suongkul vengpan Joseph khut nuoia um bangkim ava en nawn tasih hi. Mangpa’n Joseph aumpi a, tualeh abawl pouma Mangpa’n lawchinna apieh ziehin."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tam silte nuain hichi ahing hia, Izipt leengpa uain pepa leh a tanghou bawl pa’n apu uh Izipt leengpa a lungthah sah ua.","title":"Joseph in suoh nite mang a hilchienna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharoah milien nite uoin pete lah a lienpen leh tanghou bawlte lah a lienpen tungah alungthah ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh gel mi veng pawlte lamkai inn a, Joseph kikhumna suongkul ah a khumta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh mi veng pawl lamkai pa’n amaute gel Joseph a kemsah a, tualeh amaun ana asep pieh ua, hun tomkhat ataang uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh suongkul ataang Izipt leengpa uain pepa leh tanghou bawlpa ani un zan khat thuin mang akhietna tuom tuom tuoh aman uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph zingmawng in akung uah ahing pei a, amauh ahing kimupi a, tualeh ngaivawi, ana lungkham mama uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman apu inn a akikhumna-a ama toh taangkhawm Pharoah miliente kungah, “Bang achia tunia tambanga ngui mel puo na hi uoi?” chi in a dong hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh amaute gelin a kungah, “Koute gel in mang ka nei ua, a hinghil chien thei koima aumsih hi,” achi ua, tualeh Joseph in akung uah, “Hilchienna kichite Pasian a hilou ahiei mah? Hepitahin hinghil un” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh uain pie lienpen pa’n amang Joseph ahil a, “Ngai in, ka mangin grepgui khat ka masangah ahing um a,"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh grep guiin ba thum anei a, tualeh ahing sel doh a ahing pah khe ngal a, grep ga bomte ahing uma ahing minta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharoah nou ka khut ah ahing uma, tualeh Grep gate ka lou a, Pharoah nou ah ka suh a, tualeh anou pen Pharoah khut ah kana pie hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in a kungah “A hilchienna tami ahi, a ba thumte pen ni thum ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tu akipat ni thum sungin Pharoah in na lu adomkang dinga, na sep ngaima ahing semsah kia dinga, tualeh uain pepa nahi laia na pieh ngai bangin Pharoah nou akhut ah na pekia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh na hamphat kia chiengin kei hing manghil sinlen, hepitahin ka tungah na hepina hing langsahin, tualeh Pharoah kungah ka tungthu hing gen inlen, tam inn a kipat hing puikhie in."},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen Hebru mite gam a kipata mi’n ang guh mang uh ka hia, tanah zong suongkul khuh sunga ahing khumna dingun bangma ka bawl khiel sih hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tanghou bawl lienpen pan ahilchienna dih chi athei in, Joseph kungah, “Kei zong mang ka nei a, Ngaiin, tanghou ngou lawbeu thum ka lu in kana puo a,"},"17":{"text":"tualeh, lawbeu tungtapen sungah Pharoah ding, tanghou chi tuom tuom aum a; tuate pen vaten ka lutunga law a kapuoh na akipat ane siengta uhi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Joseph in a dawnga, “A hilchienna tami ahi, Law thumte khu ni thum ahia,"},"19":{"text":"Tua kipat ni thum sungin Pharoah in na tahsa akipat na lutang domkang vanin, sing dawn ah ahing khai dinga, tualeh vaten nasa ane sieng ding uhi” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh, hichi ahing hi a, ni thum ni in, Pharoah pien hun a hing tunga, aman anasemte zousie a dingin ann kuong alui a: tualeh ana semte lah a, uain pie alien penpa lutang leh tanghou bawl alien penpa lutang a domkang ta a."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n uain pie a lien penpa khu uain pe ma in apangsah kia a; tuachiin, Pharoah khutah nou apeta hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahivang in tanghou bawla lien penpa khu Joseph in amang a hilchien bangin akhai liata hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh uain pie alien penpa’n Joseph athei zing tasih a, amanghil ta hi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh kum ni vingveng nuain hichi ahing hi a, Pharoah in mang a nei a, tualeh ngaivawi, luigei ah ana dinga.","title":"Joseph In Pharoah mang a hilchienna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh ngaivawi, thakhat in lui akipan in bawngpi hoi mama thau tahtah sagi ahing pawt a, hampa lah ah ahing gamta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n ngaivawi, tuate nua ah lui akipat bawngpi dang ling thengthung gawng gemgom sagi ma ahing pawtkhie ua, bawngpi dangte kunga luigei ah ahing ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh bawngpi hoilou leh gawng gemgom ten bawngpi hoi leh thau mama sagite khu ane siengta uhi, tuachiin Pharoah akhanglou ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh a imu kia a, mang anei kia a, tualeh ngaiin, thakhat in bu kung khat ah buvui sagi lienpipi leh hoitah tah ahing um khie a,"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n ngaivawi, tami nuain buvui sagi ngat giugeu suolam huiin amut heu gawpte ahing umdoh kia hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh buvui sagi ngat giugeu ten buvui sagi lien leh hoite khu aval siengta uhi, tuachiin Pharoah a khanglou kia a, ngaiin a mang ana hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh, zingmawng in tambang ahing hia, alungsim ngaituona a buoi mama a, mi a sawl a, Izipt gam a mitphieldawi siemte leh mipilte zousie a unin a hankhawm sah a, tualeh Pharoah in amaute a mang ahil a, hinanleh amang Pharoah hilchien thei koima aum sih uhi.","ref":"Dan. 2.2"},"9":{"text":"Tualaitahin uain pie a lien penpa’n Pharoah kungah, “Tuni’n ka bawlkhelnate ka hing theidoh ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Pharoah a suohte tunga a lungthah laiin, kei leh tanghou bawl a lienpenpa, ka ni un suongkul veng lamkaipa inn a suongkul sungah ahing khumta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n zankhat ama leh ken mang khat ka nei tuoh ua, ka mangte un a khiehna atuom tuom anei tuoh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh tuanah vengpawl lamkai suohpa Hebru mi tangval khat ka kung uah aum a, tuachiin ama kahil ua, tualeh aman ka mang uh hilchienna ahing bawl a, ka mang uh dungzui in ahing hilchien tuoh tuoh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hia, aman a hilchien bang bangin ahing umta a, keipen ka sep ngaima ahing semsah kia a, amapen akhailiata hi” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharoah in mi a sawl a, Joseph a hansah a, tuachiin gangtahin suongkul apat ahing pui ua, tualeh akhamulte heuin apuon silte a henga, Pharoah kungah ahing lut hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Pharoah in Joseph kungah, “Mang khat ka nei a a hilchien thei koima aum sih a, hinanleh nang a thu nathei pouleh na hilchien thei chi thu kigen kaza hi” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in Pharoah a dawnga, “Tuapen kei a um ahisih a, Pasian in Pharoah hamuonhuoi tahin a dawng zawding hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharoah in Joseph kungah, “Ngaivawi, ka mangin luipi pieu ah kana dinga,"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh thakhat in lui akipat bawngpi athau a thau leh hoi tahtah sagi ahing pawtkhie a, loupa dawng lah ah ahing gamta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n ngaivawi, tuate nua ah, bawngpi dang ling letlut gawng gemgom ahoi a hoilou, tambang va-ia a hoilou, Izipt gam sunga ka mu khah ngai vawtlou ahing pawtdoh tou kia uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh bawngpi gawng gemgom leh hoilouten bawngpi athau a thau leh ahoi a hoi mama sagi hing pawt masate ane mangta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh, aneh zou nua un zong, anesiengta uh chi akithei tuom sih hi, achiillai mabangin hoilou tahin aum nalai uhi, tuachiin ka khanglouta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuamabangin ka mangin, bukung khat ah buvui sagi lien tahtah hoi mama ahing umdoh a,"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n ngaiin, tuate nua ah buvui sagi ma nang nit net ngat giugeu suolam huiin amut heu dohte ahing um doh kia uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh buvui ngat giugeu ten buvui hoi sagite avaltum sieng ta uhi, tualeh tami thu mitphieldawi siemte ka hil a, hinanleh ka kunga hinghil chien thei koima aum sih uhi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Joseph in Pharoah kungah, “Pharoah mang tegel pen khat ahia; Pasian in bawl dia akisahte Pharoah kunga atheisah ahi."},"26":{"text":"Bawngpi hoi sagite khu kum sagi, ahia, tualeh buvui hoi sagite zong kum sagi ma ahia, na mang tegel khu khat ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh bawngpi gawng leh hoilou sagi anua a hing pawtdohte khu kum sagi ma ahia, tualeh buvui hoilou suolam huiin amut siet gawp sagite khu kiel kum sagi dingte ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tam silte ahi Pharoah kunga ka gen; Pasian in bawl dinga atup silte Pharoah atheisah ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ngaivawi, Izipt gam sung tengteng ah nieng leh taitah a umna kum sagi ahing tung ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh tuate nuain kiel kum sagi ahing umkia dinga, tuachiin nieng leh tai a um nate Izipt gamah manghil sieng ahita dinga, kielna in gam sung ane segawp tading hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n kiel thupitahin azui ziehin gam sung pumpi ah nieng leh taitah a umlai theiphah ahi nawn tasih ding hi, a huoi siet seng ding ziehin."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Pharoah mang nivei anei thuosahna pen, sil bawl ding khu Pasian suhdet ahia, Pasian mama in atunsah pai ding ahizieh ahi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin Pharoah in mi lemtheitah leh piltah khat suikhie henlen, Izipt gam sungah houtu in koi hen."},"34":{"text":"Pharoah in tami bawl henlen, tualeh aman agam tungah houtu ding guot henlen, nieng leh taitah a um kum sagi sungin Izipt gam a pieng bu se-nga suo seni khonkhawm hen."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh amaun tua kum hoi sagi hing tung dingte a bu zousie lakhawm in Pharoah thuneina nuoi ah koi uhenlen tualeh khopite ah zong koikhawm uhen."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua bu khu Izipt gam sunga dingin kiginkholna a koikhawm ahi ding a, kiel zieh a gam amanthai louna dingin,” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n tami thu Pharoah leh asuohte tengteng ngaiin hoi asah lamtah uh ahi.","title":"Joseph Izipt gamah houtu in apang"},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Pharoah in asuohte kungah, “Tambang Pasian hagau umna mi imu zou ding amah?” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharoah in Joseph kungah, “Pasian in tamte zousie nang ahing theisah ziehin nang banga lemthei leh pil koima aum sih, achi hi.’"},"40":{"text":"Ka inn sungah vaihawmin na pang dinga, ka mite zousie na thupieh banga vaihawm pieh ahi ding hi. Lengtoupha ah athu mai maiin nang sangin ka lien zaw ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.10"},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Pharoah in Joseph kungah, “En in, Izipt gam pumpi ah vai hawm in ka hing koita hi,” achi hi.","title":"Joseph Izipt ah vaihawmin apang"},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharoah in akhut akipan in amin namna khutsip lakhie in Joseph khutah abunsah a, puon malngat puon silte asil sah a, angawng ah sana khainieng a awsah ta hi.","ref":"Dan. 5.29"},"43":{"text":"Tualeh a sakolleng nei anina ah atousah a, amasangah “Khupdin un” chiin akikou uhi. Tuachi’n ama khu Izipt gam zousie tunga vaihawmin a bawlta uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh Pharoah in Joseph kungah, “Kei Pharoah ka hi, nang thulouin koiman Izipt gam sung zousie ah akhut ahiei, akeng ahiei aleh thei sih ding,” achi hi."},"45":{"text":"Tualeh Pharoah in Joseph min Zaphnath-paneah ahisah ta hi. Tualeh a zi dingin On khuo a Siempu Potiphera tanu Asenath apie hi. Tuachi’n Joseph apawt khie a Izipt gam teng teng atuon suah ta hi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt leengpa Pharoah masanga adin laiin Joseph khu kum sawmthum a upa ahia, tualeh Joseph khu Pharoah masang akipat apawt khie a Izipt gam teng teng atuon suah ta hi."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh kum hoi kum sagi sungin leitangin bu leh bal tampi apieng sah hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Izipt gam a um, kum sagi sunga pieng bu zousie alakhawm a, tua bute pen khopite ah akoi khawma, khopi kimvel a bu zousie tua khopite ah akoi khawm hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in bu atama tam, tuipi pieunel bangin a sung khawm venvon a, simseng ding ahilou ziehin asim atawpsan vawt hi."},"50":{"text":"Tualeh kiel kumte tun masangin On khuo siempu Potiphera tanu Asenath in Joseph tapa ni ahinpieh hi."},"51":{"text":"Joseph in atapa masapen min Manasseh aphuo hi, “Aziehpen Pasian in ka sep gimna zousie leh ka pa innkuonpite zousie a hing manghil sahta” achi hi."},"52":{"text":"Tualeh atapa nina pen min Ephraim aphuo hi, “Pasian in ka gim thuohna gamah hahlesuon ahing siempieh ta hi,” achi ziehin."},"53":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt gam a kum hoi kum sagite ahing beita a,"},"54":{"text":"Joseph in ana gensa bang bangin kiel kum sagi khu ahing tung panta hi. Kiel khu gamteng ah ahing tunga, hinanleh Izipt gam sungah neh ding aum hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.11"},"55":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt gam pumpi ahing kiel ta a, mipite Pharoah kungah neh ding ngenin akikou ta uhi. Tualeh Pharoah in Izipt mite kungah, “Joseph kungah pei unlen, ama gen bang bangin bawl un” achi hi.","ref":"Jn. 2.5"},"56":{"text":"Tuachi’n leitung pumpi ah kiel ahing tungta a, khumin Joseph in bu sun khawmna inn zousie a honga, Izipt mite alei sah ta hi. Kiel pen Izipt gam sungah akhawh mama hi."},"57":{"text":"Tuachi’n gam tenga kiel akhawh mama ziehin gamchina mite Izipt gamah Joseph kungah bu lei dingin ahing pei uhi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob in Izipt gamah bu aum chi athei a, tuachi’n Jakob in a tapate kungah “Bang dinga khat leh khat ki entuo na hi uoi mah?” achi hi.","title":"Joseph unaute Izipt gamah bu lei in akuon uh"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Ngaivawi un, Izipt gamah bu aum chi ka za hi, khunah peisuh unlen shi lou a i hin theina dingun, ei a ding in bu valei ta un,” achi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.12"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph unau sawmte Izipt gamah bu lei dingin ang peisuh ta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Joseph sanggampa Benjamin pen Jakob in aunaute toh a zawhsah sih hi, silsie khat a tungah tung khava achi ziehin."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tapate zong Izipt gam a pua suidingte toh azawhkhawmta uhi. Kanaan gam a zong kiel atun ziehin."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph pen Izipt gam sung pumpi vaihawmpa ahia ama ma khu gamsung mite zousie kunga azua a pang ahia, tualeh Joseph unaute khu ahing pei ua, leisu in a masang ah akunta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in a unaute amutah in athei pai a hinanleh akung uah atheilou bang in aum a, midang bangin a unaute ana houpi a, tualeh akung uah, “Hei a kipat a hing pei na hi uoi?” achi hi, amaun, “Kanaan gam apat bu lei dinga hing pei ka hi uhi” a chi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in a unaute a theia, hinanleh amaun athei sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in amauh teng tungtang thu a manga amatte ahing theikheta a, akung uah, “Galguh na hi ua, mi enkhie a pang hiva uteh, tam gamsung umdan en a hing pei hibou uteh,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 37.5-10"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh amaun, akung ah, “Hi vawtsih ung, ka mangpa uh, na suohte bu lei dinga hing pei hibou ung."},"11":{"text":"Ka unpi un mi khat tate ka hi ua, midih hi ung, na suohte galguh bawla mi enkhie hisih ung,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh aman akung uah, “Tahsang sing gam sung guohtang hidan en dinga hing pei hi uteh,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaun “Na suohte unau sawm leh ni kahi ua, Kanaan gam a um mi khat tate ka hi uhi. Tualeh ngai in, tuin a tumpen ka pa uh kungah aum a, khatpen aum nawn tasih hi,” achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh, Joseph in akung uah, “Ka gensa mabangin noute galguh na hi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tambanga etchienin na um ding uh, na nau tumpen uh tam muna ahing pei sihleh tana pat in pawtkhe nawn sih va uteh chi Pharoah hinna a kichiem in ka hing chi ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nouma ah thutah aum ei aum siei etchien ahina dingin nalah ua khat sawl unlen, na naupa uh vapui sah un, tualeh noute pen suongkul ah na um phot ding uhi. Tua ahisihleh Pharoah hinna louin ka gen ngam ahi, noute galguh na hi uhi,” achita hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n aun un ni thum suongkul ah akhumta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in ni thum ni in akung uah, “Tami bawl unlen hing un, aziehpen Pasian ka giing hi."},"19":{"text":"Midih na hi u’leh na u naulah ua khat na suongkul lutna uah tangden henlen; noute pei unlen, kiel a um na unaupite ua dingin bu puo un."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh na nau tumpen uh ka kungah hing zawpi un, tuachi’n na thu uh akitheichien dinga, na shi sih ding uhi,” achi hi. Amaun tuachi’n abawl uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh amauh khat leh khat akihou ua, “I nau tunga i silbawl uh i na bawlkhiel tahtah uhi, hepina a nget va ngua lai a achimaw dan munapia, i ngaisah nuom vawtlou uh, tuazieh a tambang mangbatna itung ua hing tung ahita hi” aki chi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Reuben in “Naupang tungah sil bawlkhiel sih un, chiin na kung uah ka gen sih amah? Na ngaikhe ut sih ua, tuaziehin ngaivawi un, asisan phuba hing kila ahi” chiin amauh a dawnga.","ref":"Siem. 37.21,22"},"23":{"text":"Ahivang in a thugen uh Joseph in athei chi amaun a theisih uhi. Aman akung uah hamlet zanga thu agen ziehin."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh aman amauh ale ngatsan a, akapta hi. Tualeh akung uah ahing pei kia a amauh ahoupi a, tualeh alah uapat Simeon apui tuom a, amitmu uah akanta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in a ipte uah bu thundim ding leh a ipte ua amauh sum chiet koikia ding leh lampi a aneh ding uh pe dingin thu apia a; tambangin atung uah abawlta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n abute uh a sabiltungte un aposah ua, khum mun apat apei ta uhi.","title":"Joseph sanggamte Kanaan gamah akile kia"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh alah ua khat in giehbuh a sabiltung ann pe dinga a tumbu ahon leh a sum ahing mukhie a; a tumbu gong ah ana um hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman a unaute kungah, “Ka sum ana nuakoi kia mawh uhi, achi hi, envawi un ka tumbu sunga na um ahi achi hi,” tualeh amaun, Pasian in tambang talawma ahing bawl “Bang chidan adeh aw? chia lung himaw leh zau kawmin aki entuo uhi.”"},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kanaan gamah apa uh Jakob kungah ahing tung ua, atung ua sil tung zousie ahil uhi."},"30":{"text":"“Tua gam vaihawmpa’n khautahin ahing houpi a, agam uh enkhie galguh dingin ahing na ngaw hi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh kouten akungah, midih hi ung, galguh ka hisih uhi;’"},"32":{"text":"Unau sawm leh ni kahi ua, Pa khat hah ngen ka hi ua, khat aum nawn sih a, nau tumpen tuin ka pa uh kungah Kanaan gamah aum hi kachi uhi.’"},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuami gam vaihawmpa’n ka kung uah Tambangin midih na hi uh chi ka theina ding in na unau khat uh ka kungah nuasie unlen, na innkuonpi kielte a dingin bu puo unlen peita un,’ achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh na nautumpen uh ka kungah hing pui un; tuachi’n galguh na hi sih ua midih nahi zaw uh chi ka hing thei dinga, tuachi’n na naupa uh ka hing pekia dinga, tam gamah summet na bawl ta ding uhi” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hia, a ipte uh ahing buh khiet u’leh, a sum tun chiet uh a ipsung uah ana umchiet hi; tualeh amauh leh apa un sum tunte amu un azauta mama uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh apa uh Jakob in akung uah, “Nouten ka tate hing taansah hi uteh; Joseph lah aum nawn sih a, tualeh Benjamin puimang sawm na lai uchia, tam silte zousie in kei hing buohkhum ahita hi,” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n Reuben in apa kungah, “Ama na kunga kahing tut kia sihleh ka tapa nite that maiin; ama ka khutah hing pien len na kungah hing puikia na vang,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh aman, “Ka tapa pen na kung uah hing peisuh sihva, aziehpen a upa ashita a, ama maimai ahita hi. Na peina lamkaal uah tuohsie tuoh taleh ka lu kaang pen lungkhamna toh han ah tung suh sah ding hi uteh,” achi hi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh khum gamah kiel anase mama a,","title":"Joseph unaute Izipt gam a nivei ahawna uh"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Izipt gam a ahing bu puohte uh aneh zou un apa un akung uah “Peikia unlen, bu tawmnou khat beeh valei kia un” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Juda in a kungah, “Tua mipa’n na naupa uh na hing zawpi sih u’leh ‘ka mel na mu sih ding uh chiin ahing kal chinten hi.’"},"4":{"text":"Ka nau uh na hing zuisah ding leh peisuh va ungin, bu hing valei pieh va ung;"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh ama na hing sawl sihding leh pei sih va ung, Aziehpen tua mipa’n ka kung uah, na naupa uh na hing zawpi sih u’leh, ka mel mu thei sih va uteh achisa ahi ziehin chiin,” agen hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Israel in “Bang dinga kei lungkham na dinga nau dang khat nei nalai ung chia tua mipa nava hil sese uh ahiei,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute’n “tua mipa’n kouma leh i innkuon tungtang thu pilvangtah in ahing donga, na pa uh adam nalai ei? Pienpi sanggam dang na nei na uoi? Chi’n ahing dong a, tuachia ahing doh dungzui a ka hil mai uh ahi, Na naupa uh hing zawpi un achi ding lam ka thei va teh sih uhi,” chiin a dawng uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda in apa Israel kungah “Nautum in hing zuisah in, ka kisa ding ua ka kuon ding uh, nang leh kou leh ka tate uh ashi louna dingin."},"9":{"text":"Keima’n amaw paw vangin, keima lah ah amaw hing phut in, na kunga ka hing tut sih a na masanga ka hing dinsah sihleh tangtawn in amaw ka paw ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Kinawngkai den sih leh ani veina zong hing tungkia tham ta ding hi unga,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh apa uh Israel in akung uah, “Tuin tuachibang ahi vanglah leh tambang in bawl un, na nasepna chiet ua, tam gam a theiga hoi pente leh Singnai damdawi, khuoizute, gimtuite, murrahte, thei hawsate, makhate them khat chiet tua mipa nuomman dingin puo un."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh sum a leni a tam keng unlen, na tumbu gongte ua ahing sum puosahte u’zong tawikia un, a mukhiel hikhava."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh na naupa u’zong zawpisuh ta unlen tua mipa kungah haw kia un."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh na naupa khat pen u’leh, Benjamin ahing hakhiet na dingin bangkim bawlthei Pasian in tua mipa hing khotuosah tahen, ka tate taan kahileh kataan maiding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun, silpieh dingte atawi ua, sum aleni a tam akeng ua, Benjamin toh Izipt ah apeisuh ta ua, Joseph masang ah adingta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in akung ua Benjamin um amu tahin a innsung vaisaipa kungah “Tam mite innsung ah puilut inlen, sa gou inlen bawlin, tam miten kei toh sun chiengin ann a ne ding uhi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua mipa’n Joseph gen bangin a bawlta hi, tualeh aman tua mite Joseph inn sungah apuilut ta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph inn a puilut a aum bep un, a zauta ua, “I haw masah laiun, i ipte ua sum hing kinuapieh kia zieh a ahing puilut hita ven izaw? i tunga imawna ding uh sui a, hing kihoupi a, eileh i sabiltungte uh suoh leh sal a hing mat sawm ahita ve uoh,” akichi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph innsung vaisaipa kungah avapei ua, inn kotkhah zungah ama ahoupi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Pu aw “Ka hing hawmasah laiun ann lei dinga hing hawsuh ka hi ua,"},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh hichi ahing hi a, giehbuh ka tun ua ka ipte uh ka hon u’leh ngaivawi, ka sumte chiet uh ka ip gong chiet uah ana um hi, tua sumte abuh za mama ana um hi, tuate pen kahing paw kia uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh, bu leina ding zong sum dang ka hing keng kia uhi, ka sum uh ka tumbu sung ua koi na guon adiei chi ka thei sih uhi,” achi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh aman akung uah, “Hamuang tahin um unlen zau vawtsih un, na Pasian uh na pa uh Pasian in na tumbu sung ua gou ahing pieh ahi; na sumte uh ka mu na hi,” achi hi. Tualeh aman Simeon akung uah ahing pui hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n amapa’n tua mite khu Joseph inn sungah apuilut a, tui apie a, akeng uh asil ua, tualeh a sabiltungte uh ann apie hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n anuomman puohte uh Joseph ann ne dinga ahing pei chienga dingin mansain akoi ua, aziehpen tam mun a ann ne ding ahi uh chi athei uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachia Joseph inn ahing peitahin akhut ua nuomman umte inn sungah akung ah atawilut ua, khupboh in amasanga kunin chibai abuh uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman atung thu uh a donga “Na pa uh thu na gen uh tua puteh adam nalai ei? ahing nalai ei mah?” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh amauten a dawng ua, “Na suohpa ka pa uh adam nalai hi,” achi ua, tualeh alu uh kunin chibai abuh uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh ama adahtou a anu tapa, a sanggampa Benjamin amu a, “Tampa himaw, na nau tumpa uh, a tanchin na hing hil uh?” achi hi. Tualeh ama main, ka tapa, Pasian in hing hepi hen achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in anaupa amu tahin, ahase sengin kintah a pawtin akaana ding mun asui a, tuachi’n pindan a lut in ava kap kheta hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n amai aphiet a, ava pawtkhe kia a, kideh tei tei in “Ann neh ding bawl un” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama ding a tuom in, ama ua ding a tuom in, tualeh Izipt mite anehpi dingte ading a tuom in abawl uhi. Aziehpen Izipt miten Hebru mite toh ann ane khawm ngaisih uhi. Tuabanga bawl ama ua dinga sienglou ahi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n upa pen ta masa hina dungzui in nau tumpen anaupanna dungzui in akizom ditdet in Joseph masang ah atou ua, lamdang sa in khat leh khat aki-entuo uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in amasanga mite akipat in atanvou uh ann aban piehsah a, hinanleh Benjamin tan pen ama ua teng sangin ale nga in atam zaw hi, tuachi’n ama toh adawn ua nuom asa chiet uhi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman a innsung vaisaipa kungah, “Tua mite tumbu ah apuoh zaw zaza uh bu sung dim inlen, asum chiet uh a tumbu sung chiet uah guongin achi hi.","title":"Joseph in a unaute aze-etna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh tua ka Dangka nou pen anaupang penpa tumbu ah guongin, abu man sum toh chiin thu apie a,” tuachiin aman Joseph genbangin a bawlta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh zingmawng khuo ahing vah tahin tuamite a Sabiltungte utoh a sawl kheta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh khopi akipat apeikhiet nua uh gamla atun masangun Joseph in a innsung vaisaipa kungah, “Kisa inlen tua mite vadel in, tualeh na phah tah chiengin akung uah, bang chidan a hoina sietna a thuh na hi uoi?’"},"5":{"text":"Tami ka pu uain dawnna leh a aisanna nou hilou ahiei mah? Tambanga na namtat uh takhiel hi uteh va chi in,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh amaute adel phata a, akung uah tam thute abang bangin agen ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh amaun akung ah, “Pu bang chidana tambang thute na gen ahiei? na suohten tambang sil ka bawllou ding dan uh.’"},"8":{"text":"En in, ka tumbu gong ua ka sum mute uh zong Kanaan gam apat na kungah ka hing tawikia uhi, bang chidanin na pu inn apat dangka ahiei, Sana ahiei ka gu thei ding uoi?’"},"9":{"text":"Na suohte lah a na muna penpen ama lah shi henlen, kouma zong na suoh hi mai va ung,” achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Tuin na thu bangun hiheh, akimuna penpen ka suoh hi vanin, noupen getsiet banglou hi va uteh,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun a tumbu chiet uh akin theibangin leiah anga khe pai chiet ua, michin in a tumbu chiet uh ahong uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman a upa pen ua pat apan a anau tumpen pa tan dongin asui pai a, tuachiin nou khu Benjamin tumbu ah amuta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun apuonte uh abotkeh ua, a sabiltungte uh posah chiet in khopi lamah ahing kile kiata uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Juda leh a sanggamte Joseph inn ah ahing pei ua, ama khunah ana um nalai a, tualeh amasangah abohkhup chiet uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in akung uah “Bang sil bawla kinei na hi uoi? Kei bang mite aisan asiem teitei uh chi theilou na hi uoi mah?”"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda in a kungah “Bang kagen ta ding uoi? Bang e kang hil taah ding uh? ahisihleh bang kachi gen veng ta ding uoi? Pasian in na suohte khelna mukhie ahita, Ngaiin, kou leh akhut a nou kimunapa” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh aman, “Tuachibang a ka bawllou ding dan, hinanleh akhut a nou amuna pen pa vang ka suoh hivanin, noute pen na pa uh kungah hamuong tahin peita un” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda in Joseph ahing nai a, “Pu aw hepitahin na suohin ka mangpa bil a na zah dingin thu tengkhat hing gensah inlen, na lungthahna na suohpa tungah kuongsah sin, nang pen Pharoah bang nahi ta ngal a."},"19":{"text":"‘Ka pu in na suohte kungah, ‘Pa ahiei sanggam ahiei na nei uoi?’ chiin na hing donga,’"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh kouten ka pu kungah Pa tehsie khat leh ateh nua a anei tapa naupang nalai ka nei uh, a upa a shita a, anu hin lah ah ama ngen um ahita a, apan lah a it mama hi, kachi uhi.’"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n nang na suohte kungah, ama ka mit a ka mu theina dingin ka kungah hing puisuh un na chi hi.’"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh kouten ka pu uh kungah naupang in apa nuasie thei sih va, apa nuasie leh apan shi law ding hi ka chi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh nangman na suohte kungah, na nau tumpen uh na hing zawpi sih u’leh ka mel mu nawnsih va uteh, na hing chi hi."},"24":{"text":"“Tuachi’n hichi ahia, ka pa uh na suohpa kunga ka tuntou un, ka pu thu gente a kungah ka hil uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh ka pa un peikia unlen, bu tawmnou khat beeh valei kia un achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh kouten ka pei suh thei nawn sih ding uh, ka nau tum un ahing zuiding leh peisuh va ung, aziehpen ka nau tum un ahing zui sihleh tua mipa mel muthei lou ding hi ung, ka chi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n na suohpa ka pan ka kung uah, ka zi in tapa ni ahing hinpieh chi na thei ve uo le; achi hi.’"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh khat in ahing peimang santa a, bawtel a um hita valon ding hia, ka chia, tuami nualangsie ama ka mu kha nawn vawt tasih hi.’"},"29":{"text":"‘Tuachiengin tampa zong keia pat a na puimang ua, lamkaal ah tuosiet khat tuoh taleh ka lukaang khu lungkham tah a hankhuh tungsah ding na ve uoh maw,’ achi hi."},"30":{"text":"“‘Tuaziehin tuin ka nau un kou hing zuilouin um taleh na suohpa ka pa kungah tung taleng naupang hinna leh ahinna kigahkhawm ahi ziehin."},"31":{"text":"‘Tambang ahing hi dinga, naupang in hing zuilou chi amu chiengin ashi mai ding hi. Tuachi’n na suohten ka pa uh na suohpa lukaang khu lungkham tah a han a tungsah ding hita ve ung maw!’"},"32":{"text":"‘Tuazieh in, na suohpa’n na kunga ka hing tutkia sih pouma leh amaw ka pa lah a tangtawnin povang chiin ka pa kungah naupang tungtang ah maw puoin ka na pangta hi.’"},"33":{"text":"‘Tuaziehin tuin hepitahin na suoh khu naupang taangin kapu dingin suohin hing umsah in, tualeh naupang pen a ute toh peitou sahin.’"},"34":{"text":"Aziehpen ka nau toh zawhlouin bang chiin ka pa kungah ka pei tou thei diei? Ka pa tunga sietna tung ding ka mu ngamsih hi,” achi hi."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph pen a kunga dingte masangah akideh zou nawn sih a, “Mi zousie ka kung apat in pawt khesah un” chiin akikou a, tuachiin Joseph a unaute kunga akitheisah lai in a kungah koima ading sih hi.","title":"Joseph in a unaute aki theisahna","ref":"Nasep. 7.13"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh ngaitahin akap khie a, Izipt mite leh Pharoah innsung miten zong aza uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in a unaute kungah “Keima Joseph ka hi, ka pa adam nalai ei mah?” achi hi, tualeh a sanggamten a dawng thei tasih ua, amasangah abuoita uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in a unaute kungah “Hepitahin hing nai un” achi hi, tuachiin a nai ua, Aman “Kei Joseph na unaupa uh Izipt gam a na zuapa uh ka hi.”"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin tambanga na hing zua ziehun, lungkham sih unlen, zong kilungthah khum tua sih un, Pasian in mite hinna humbit dingin na masang ua ahing na sawl masah ahi."},"6":{"text":"Kum ni sung tam gamah kiel atung pan nalai a, kum nga in asam nalai hi, tua hun sungin lou akihou sih dinga bu zong akila sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh, leitunga nahah nasuonte uh hing kepbit pieh ding leh hutkhietna thupi taha na hinna uh hundam dinga Pasian in na masang ua kei ahing sawl masah ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin, tana hing sawl noute na hisih ua, Pasian ahizaw hi. Aman keima Pharoah dinga pa leh a innsung mi zousie dinga lamkai leh Izipt gam pumpi tunga vaihawmin ahing bawlta hi."},"9":{"text":"Manlangin ka pa kungah peitou unlen, tualeh a kungah, Na tapa Joseph in tambangin achi hi, Pasian in Izipt gam pumpi tunga lamkai in ahing bawlta hi, ka kungah sawt kiheh louin hing peisuh heh.","ref":"Nasep. 7.14"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Goshen gamah na teng dinga, ka kungah na um ding hi; nangma leh na tate leh na tate tate leh na belamte leh na bawng honte leh na nei zousie toh."},"11":{"text":"Khunah keiman ka hing vaa dinga, kiel na ding kum nga aum nalai ziehin. Khuchilouin nang leh na innkuonpite leh na nei zousie na hing tasam kha ding uhi, chiin va genta un."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh ngaivawi un, namit mu u’leh ka naupa Benjamin mit ngelngel in na kung ua keima kam ngelngel a ka thugen lai na mu uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka pa kungah, Izipt gam a ka thupina leh na sil mu zousie uh na hil ding ua, gangtah in kapa tammun ah hing puisuh un, achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n a naupa Benjamin ngawng kawiin a kap a, Benjamin zong ama ngawng kawiin a kapta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuathamlouin a unaute zousie atawpa, akakhum chiet a, tuazouin a unauten a houlimpi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n “Joseph sanggamte ahing tung uhi,” chi thuthang Pharoah inn sungah ana zata uhi. Tua thuin Pharoah leh a suohte akipahsah mama hi.","title":"Pharoah in Jakob leh a innkuonpite goshen a teng dingin ahan hi"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Pharoah in Joseph kungah “Na sanggamte kungah tambangin bawl un, na gante uh bu posah unlen, Kanaan gamah pei un,"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh na pa u’leh na innkuonpite va pui unlen, ka kungah hing pei un, Izipt gam a silhoite hing pe vangin gam sung thauna na ne ding uhi chi’n genin achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuin, thu ka hing pie hi, tami bawl in, na taneute u’leh na zite uh dingin Izipt gam a kipat sakollengte keng unlen na pa uh hing pui unlen hing pei un."},"20":{"text":"Na neitahte u’zong ngaituo data un, Izipt gam sunga silhoi pouma nou a ahi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten tuabangin abawl ua, Joseph in Pharoah thupieh bangin sakollengte a puia, tualeh lamkaal a neh ding zong apie hi."},"22":{"text":"A bawn un puonsil kihen nading ape chiet a, hinanleh Benjamin pen Dangka za thum leh puonsil kihenna ding nga apie hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh apa kungah tambangin ahah hi, Izipt gam silhoi puo sabiltung sawm, tualeh lamkaal a apa uh ding bu, tanghou leh neh thei puo sabiltungnu sawm ahah hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n a unaute asawl kheta a, apeita uhi, tualeh aman, akung uah, “Lampi a kihau lou dingin pilvang un” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt gam a pat in apeitou ta ua, Kanaan gamah apa uh kung atungta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh apa u kungah “Joseph ahing nalai hi, Izipt gam pumpi ah vaihawmin apang hi chiin ahil uhi. Hinanleh a thugen uh a tahsan lou seng ziehin Jakob alungtang ana vawt hi."},"27":{"text":"“Tualeh Joseph in akung ua athu gente ahilta ua, tualeh ama puoh na dinga, sakolleng Joseph in ahing sawlte amu in apa uh Jakob lungtang asu hal kiata hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh, Israel in, ahunta hi; ka tapa, Joseph adam nalai; peivangin ka shi masang in va muta vang,” achi hi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel, anei zousie toh ahing kipankhie a, Beer-sheba ahing tunga, apa Isaak Pasian kungah kithoinate alan hi.","title":"Jakob Izipt gam a apeisuhna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Pasian in Israel kungah zanlai a mangin ahoupi a, “Jakob, Jakob” achi hi, tualeh aman “Tanah um inge,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh, Aman “Kei Pasian na pa Pasian ka hi, Izipt gam a peisuh ding zausin, tuanah nang apat nam thupitah in ka hing siemding hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt gamah na kungah peisuh vangin tualeh pellouin hing puikhe tou kia vangin Joseph khut ngelin na mit asingsah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Jakob pen Beer-sheba apat apei a; Israel taten apa uh Jakob leh a taneute u’leh a zite uh tuonna ding a Pharoah in sakolleng ahahte ah a tuongsah uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Kanaan gam a a lamkhiet uh ganta leh neitahte hing puoin Izipt gamah ahing tung ua, Jakob leh ahahasuonte zousie toh.","ref":"Nasep. 7.15"},"7":{"text":"A tapate, atapate tapate, a tanute, a tapate tanute leh ahah a suonte zousie Izipt gamah ahing lutpita hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu Israel tate Izipt gam a hinglut Jakob leh a tapate min ahi. Reuben, Jakob tapa upapen."},"9":{"text":"Reuben tapate Hanok, Pallu, Hezron leh Karmi."},"10":{"text":"Simeon tapate: Jemuel, Jamin leh Ohad, Jachin leh Johar tualeh Kanaan numei khat toh anei, Shaul toh ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Levi tapate Gershon, Kohath leh Merari."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Juda tapate Er leh Onan leh Shelah leh Perez leh Zerah; hinanleh Er leh Onam pen Kanaan gamah ashita uhi. Tualeh Perez tapate Hezron leh Hamul ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Issakar tapate Tola, Puvah, Job leh Shimron."},"14":{"text":"Zebulun tapate Sered leh Elon leh Jahleel."},"15":{"text":"Tamte Leah tapate Padan-Aram gam a Jakob dinga ahin piehte a tanu Dinah toh ahi. A tapate leh a tanute a bawn un mi sawmthum leh thum ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Gad tapate Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi leh Areli ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Asher tapate, Jimna, Ishuah, Ishui Beriah leh anaunu uh Serah tualeh Beriah tapate, Heber leh Malkiel."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Laban in atanu Leah kunga apieh Zilpah tapate ahi uhi. Tamte aman Jakob dinga ahinnpieh mi sawm leh guhte ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob zi Rachel tapate Joseph leh Benjamin ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in Izipt gamah tapa Manasseh leh Ephraim anei a, tuate khu On kho siempu Potiphera tanu Asenath in ahinnpieh ahi.","ref":"Siem. 41.50-52"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Benjamin tapate Balah, Becher Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim leh Ard ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tamte Rachel in Jakob dinga ahin pieh a tapate ahi, a bawn un sawm leh li ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Dan tapa, Hushim ahi."},"24":{"text":"Naphtali tapate Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer leh Shillem te ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tamte Laban in atanu Rachel kunga apieh Bilhah tapate ahi uh, aman tamte Jakob dinga ahinpieh ahi a bawnun sagi ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Jakob tapate zite simlouin a tahsa a piengkhie Izipt gam a a lutpiteng bawnin mi sawm guh leh guh ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in Izipt gam a anei tapate ni ahi ua, Izipt gam a hinglut Jakob innkuonte zousie mi sawm sagi ahi uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.14"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in Goshen gam lampi kawhmu dingin Juda pen Joseph kungah a sawl masa hi, tuachi’n Goshen gamah ahing tungta uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in a sakolleng mansa in ana koia, Goshen ah apa dawn dingin apeitou a, a kungah akigen a, tualeh a ngawngkawi a sawtpi a ngawnga kiluoi in akap hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Israel in Joseph kungah, “Hing leh dam a na mel ka mu kia tah ziehin, tuin vang ka shi lezong shi taveng,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Joseph in, a sanggamte leh apa innsung mite kungah, “peitou vangin Pharoah kungah, ka sanggamte leh ka pa innsung mite Kanaan gam a umte ka kungah hing tungta uh chiin vahil vang” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Amaute belam chingmi ahi ua, gan khawimi ahi ziehun, tualeh a belam honte u’leh a bawng honte u’leh anei alam zousie uh ahing puo uhi chiin vagen tavang achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh hichi hing hivanin, Pharoah in ahing hat a noute, bang nasem na hi uoi chia ahing doh chiengin."},"34":{"text":"Na suohte sepna pen kou leh ka pu ka pate ua kipanin ka neu lai ua pat tu dongin gan khawimi kahi uh nachi ding uhi. Tuachi’n Goshen gamah na teng thei ding uhi, achi hi. Aziehpen belam chingmi pouma Izipt mite dingin kidahhuoi ahi."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Joseph Pharoah kungah “Ahing pei a, a kungah ka pate, ka sanggamte a belam honte uh, a bawng honte uh, tualeh anei alam zousie utoh Kanaan gam a kipat ahing pei ua, tualeh tu’n, Goshen gamah aumta uhi” achi hi.","title":"Jakob leh ahahasuonte kitawisang"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh, aman a unaute lah a mi nga azawpi a, Pharoah mai ah akilah sah hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharoah in a sanggamte kungah, “Bang nasemmi na hi uoi?” achi hi, Amaun Pharoah kungah, “Na suohte ka pu ka pa ua kipat a belam chingmi kahi uhi” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Pharoah kungah, “Ka ganhonte uh neh ding aumlou ziehin na suohte na gam a umtadi dingin ka hing pei uhi. Kanaan gam kiel akhawh seng ziehin. Tuaziehin hepitahin na suohte Goshen gam ah hing teng sahin” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharoah in Joseph kungah, “Na pa leh na unaute na kungah a hing peita uhi."},"6":{"text":"Izipt gam na masang ah aum hi, gam sung hoina mun pen Goshen gamah na pa leh na unaute tengsah inlen, tualeh alah ua mi silbawlthei tah nathei leh ka ganhonte tungah houtuin koiin” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in apa Jakob a zawpi a, Pharoah masangah ading sah hi, tualeh Jakob in Pharoah a guolzawl a."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Pharoah in Jakob kungah “Kum bangza na hi tai?” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Jakob in Pharoah kungah “Ka khuol zinna hun sung kumte kum za leh sawmthum ahi ta a, ka dam sung kumte a tawma, hinanleh genthei ahuoi hi, ka pu leh pate akhuolzin lai ua a dam kum tan zong ka pha nai sih hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in Pharoah aguolzawl kia a, Pharoah masang apat a peikheta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in apa leh a unaute Izipt gamah tenna a bawl pieha, Pharoah thupieh bangin gam sung hoina pen ah Rameses gam agou tan dingun apeta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in apa leh a sanggamte leh apa innsung mite zousie a innkuon dungzui in neh ding apie a, avaa ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh gam sung zousie ah neh ding mawngmawng aumta sih hi, kiel akhawh seng ziehin, tuachi’n Izipt gam leh Kanaan gam zousie kiel ziehin agim gawpta uhi.","title":"Joseph In izipt gam abawlhoi"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in Izipt gam sung leh Kanaan gam sung zousie bu lei na man sum zousie adon pieh sienga, Pharoah inn ah ahing tawi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt gam leh Kanaan gam sunga sum zousie ahing bei bepin Izipt mite zousie Joseph kungah ahing pei ua, “Ann hing piein bang dinga kiel shi ding ka hi uoi? ka sum ulah abei siengta hi achi” uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in “Na gantate uh hing pemai un, sum nanei nawnsih u’leh, na gantate uh manin bu kang peding,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n agante uh Joseph kungah ahing kai ua, Joseph in sakolte man ding, belam honte man ding ganhonte man ding, bawnghonte manding leh sabiltung man dingin neh ding ana pe zela, tuami kumin agantate uh manin amauh neh ding a pie a, avaa chiet hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua kum ahing beita a akum kia in a kungah ahing peikia ua, “Ka sumte uh ka zah bei dan uh ka pu uh kungah imsih va ung, ka pu un ka ganhonte uh na tangta a, ka tahsa u’leh ka gam uh chilou ka pu uh mitmu in bangma aum nawn vawtsih hi.’"},"19":{"text":"Bangzieh a kou leh ka gam uh na mitmu a shi ding ka hi uoi? kou leh ka gam uh ann manin hing lei maiin, tuachi’n kouma leh ka gam uh Pharoah suohte himai va ung; tuachia shilou a ka hin thei na ding un, tualeh gam asiet louna dingin bu chi hing pie in” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in Izipt gam tengteng Pharoah dingin alei pieh a, kiel anat seng ziehin michin in alou uh azuata uhi. Tuachi’n gam zousie Pharoah gam ahi siengta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh mite pen Izipt gamgi tawpna langkhat apat alaang khat dongin khopite ah abawnun akisuon ta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Siempute gam pen aleipieh sih a, aziehpen Siemputen Pharoah in apieh tanvou anei ua, Pharoah in apieh a tanvou uh ane ua, tuaziehin ama un agam uh azua sih uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in mite kungah, “Ngaivawi un, tunin nouma leh na gam uh Pharoah dingin ka hing leita a, envawi un, tanah bu chi nou ading aum hi, tam gam ah na tu ding uh hi, achi hi.’"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh bu lah hun chiengin tambang ahi ding hi; Pharoah a dingin Se-nga-suo sekhat na pe ding ua, Seli teng nou a ahi ding, tuapen na lou buchi ding uh, na neh ding uh, nouma leh na innkuonpite uh neh ding, nata neute uh neh ding, ahi ding hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaun, “Nang ka hinna uh nang humbit piehta a, ka pu uh mitmu ah hepina hing musah inlen, tuachi’n Pharoah suohte hi mai va ung” achi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in, Pharoah in se-nga suo sekhat atan ding chi Izipt gam pumpi ah tuni dongin danin a bawlta hi. Siempute gam pen ahileh Pharoah a hilou."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel khu Izipt gam a Goshen gamah atengta a, tuanah innbul tahin aumta uhi. Tualeh chi tampi suongin nasatahin a khang ua apungta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob Izipt gamah kum sawm leh sagi a tenga, tuachi’n Jakob damsung pumpi kum za leh sawmli leh sagi ahi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Israel khu ashi hun ding ahing naita a, tuachi’n atapa Joseph ahan a, a kungah, “Tuin na mitmu a hepina katan leh, hepitahin na khut ka malpi neiah gol inlen, ka tungah boh in, Hepitahin Izipt gamah hing vui mawngmawng sin.","ref":"Siem. 49.29-32; 50.6"},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh, ka pu ka pate kungah lum vangin, Izipt gam a kipat na hing paw ding ua, tualeh akivuina mun uah na hing vuizaw ding hi achi hi, khumin aman na gen bangin ka hing bawl ding” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh aman ka kungah “Kichiem in leh;” achi hi, tuachiin a kungah a kichiemta hi, Tuachi’n Israel khu lupna luhung ah akunsuh ta hi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tam silte nuain hichi ahing hi a, Joseph kungah “En in, na pa achina ahi” chi’n ahil ua, tuachiin aman a tapa tegel Manaseh leh Ephraim a zawpi a.","title":"Jakob in Ephraim leh Manaseh a guolzawlna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob kungah “Envawi, na tapa Joseph na kungah ahing pei hi” chiin ahil ua, khumin Israel ahing hal a, lupna tungah atouta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in Joseph kungah, “bangkimbawlthei Pasian khu Kanaan gam a Luz khuo ah ka kungah ahing kilah a, ahing guolzawl hi.’","ref":"Siem. 28.13,14"},"4":{"text":"Ka kungah hahlesuon tampi ka hing neisah dinga, ka hing pungsah nalai dinga, nangma apat Nam tampi ka siemdoh ding, tualeh tam gam pen na nua a nahah nasuonte kungah a kumtawn goutan dingun ka pe ding hi ahing chi hi.’"},"5":{"text":"“Tualeh tuin na tapa nite Izipt gam a na kunga ka hing pei masanga Izipt gam a na neite Ephraim leh Manaseh kei a ahi, Reuben leh Simeon mabangin keia ahi ding uhi.’"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh amauh nua a na hinte nanga hivanin, a goutan uah a ute uh min akikop mai ding uhi.’"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh kei ka hileh Padan gam apat a ka hing pei laiin Rachel Kanaan gamah lampi ah Ephrath khuo tunna ding nainou khat aum laiin ka kungah ashita a, khummun Ephrath khuo lampi ah ka vuita hi.” (Tuami Bethlehem ahi) achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 35.16-19"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Israel in, Joseph tapate a en a, “Tamte koite ahiei?” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in apa kungah “Tam mun a Pasian in ahing pieh ka tapate ahi uh,” achi hi. Tualeh aman, hepitahin ka kungah “Hing puiin, amauh guolzawl vang” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuin Israel mit pen a upat tah ziehin amiel ta a, tuachi’n amuchien thei tasih hi, Tualeh amauh a kungah ahing pei ua, aman ana tawpa ana pom hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Israel in Joseph kungah, “Na mel muding kilam en nawnlou hinga, hinanleh envawi, Pasian in nahah nasuon nasan ahing musahta hi” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in atapate apa pheipi kaal apat in a puikhie a, amai ah lei suin akunta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in amautegel akai a, akhut zietlam in Ephraim khu Israel khut veilam pangah a koia, Manaseh pen akhut veilam in Israel khut zietlam pangah ahing koi nai hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel in akhut zietlam phongin a naupang zaw Ephraim lutung ah anga a, akhut veilam Manasseh lutung ah anga hi, a theisa in akhut in asawh kokal a, Manasseh lah ta upa zaw ahi ngal a."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh aman Joseph a guolzawla, “Ka pu leh pate Abraham leh Isaak masanga aum zingna Pasian, tuni donga ka dam sung ni teng teng hing vahpa Pasian,"},"16":{"text":"Sietna teng teng laha kipata hing tanpa Vansawlsiengin naupangte guolzawl ta hen. Ka min leh ka pulepate Abraham leh Isaak min amauh min in puo u henlen, tualeh leitung ah mipi thupitah hi dingin hing khang uhen” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in Ephraim lutunga apan akhut zietlam akoi amu tahin a lungkim tasih a, Ephraim lutunga pat Manasseh lutunga koi dingin apa khut adom kanga."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in apa kungah “Pa tambang ding ahisih, tampa hibou ta masa, nakhut zietlam a lutungah koiin,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh apa a utsih a, “Ka tapa aw ka theina hi, amazong nam khat ahing hi dinga, ahing thupi ding hi, hinanleh anaupa pen ama sangin thupi zaw vanin, ahah asuonte pen nam tampi hing hi va uh” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob in “Israelten Ephraim leh Manasseh bangin Pasian in nang hing umsah hen,” chi’n nouma min louin ahing guolzawl zel ding uh chi’n tuani in amaute a guolzawl a. Tuachi’n Ephraim khu Manasseh masangah a umsahta hi.","ref":"Heb. 11.21"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel in Joseph kungah, “Ngaiin, shi ding ka hita a, hinanleh Pasian in nang hing umpi vanin, na pulepate gamah hing puilut kia ding hi.’"},"22":{"text":"Tuathamlouin na unaute tanvou sangin tankhat in ka hing petuon hi, ka namsau leh ka thalpi a Amormite khuta kipat ka lah pieh pen khu” achi hi."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in a tapate a han a, tambangin agen hi, “Ni nukhia lam chienga na tung ua sil hing tung ding ka hing hil theina dingin hing kikhawm un.","title":"Jakob in aasi kuona Israel tate aguolzawlna"},"2":{"text":"Nou Jakob tapate aw hing kikhawm unlen, ngaikhie un, na pa uh Israel thu ngaiun."},"3":{"text":"Reuben nang kata masa, ka sil bawl theina, ka hatna kipatna na hi, a sangpen hina leh thuneina nanga ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh tuibanga detlou na hia, tungnung pen hina na nei sih ding hi, napa lupna tunga na kal ziehin na buasah ta hi, ka lupna ah akal hi."},"5":{"text":"Simeon leh Levi unau ahi ua, gitlouna vanzahte khu atenna uah a um hi."},"6":{"text":"Aw ka hinna, nang vang akithukupna uah kigol sinlen; ka thupina nangpen a kikhopna uah pang sin, a lungthah un mi athat ua, aluhlul un bawngtal thahui asatbai uhi."},"7":{"text":"Alungthah na uh zauhuoitah ahi ziehin, ham sietin um henlen, a thangpaina u’zong hamsiet in um tahen, hinsetah ahi ziehun, Jakob sungah amaute ka khenkhe dinga, tualeh Israel sungah ka thethang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Juda nangpen na unauten ahing phat ding ua; na khut zong na galte ngawng ah na nga dinga: na pa tate na masangah kunva uh."},"9":{"text":"Juda khu Humpibahnei nou ahi; ka tapa na samat na peitou santa hi; na kun a, Humpibahnei bangin na boh a, tualeh Humpibahnei nu bangin koi ahiei ama phawng ngam ding?","ref":"Kisim. 24.9; Kihil. 5.5"},"10":{"text":"Lengchieng pen Juda toh kikhen sih vanin, dan pepa chieng zong akeng kaala kipat pawtmang vawtsih va, Shiloh ahing tun masang sie; tualeh nam chinin ama thu amang ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"A sabiltung grep kungah khi vanin, a sabiltungnou a grep kung deitel ah khiva, a puon silte greptui in sawp vanin, tualeh apuon zalte grep sisan in asawp nalai ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A mitte greptui a san sahin aum dinga a hate bawngnawi a vamsah in a um ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Zebulun tuipi geiah teng vanin kuong khawlna luipieu ahi dinga, a gamgi Sidon tandong ahi ding."},"14":{"text":"Issakar pen van gih lomni kikaal a kuol sabiltung hattah ahi."},"15":{"text":"Khawldam hoiin a thei a, tualeh gam zong nuomin athei hi, van po dingin alieng angiemsah a, paubawl a nasepsah ding suoh ahing hita hi."},"16":{"text":"Dan in Israelte lah ah nam khat bangin a mite avaihawm pieh ding."},"17":{"text":"Dan khu lamgei a gul um, lamlai a gulngan sakol kengpawng tuh pieh a, sakol tungtuong mi, a nua langa kithalngase a, thalkiehsahpa ahi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, na hundamna ka ngah zing hi."},"19":{"text":"Gad pen galhon in asim ding ua, hinanleh atawp ah aman anua del ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Asher khu aneh hoi vanin, leeng ann neh tuitah tah a piengsah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Nephtali pen Sazuhpi kihazan ahia, thu hoi tah tahte agen zel hi."},"22":{"text":"Joseph khu gui ga nuomtah tuikhuh kunga pou, a bate a baang tunga zam, hieng ga nuomtah ahi."},"23":{"text":"Thal kap miten ama nahpitahin asu genthei ua, akap ua, a muda uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh ama thal mung pen khautahin aum ngitnget a, akhut banthahat khu Jakob Pasian khut hattahin asuhat a, (Khuna pat Belampu, Israel suongpi ahing um hi.)"},"25":{"text":"Na pa Pasian nangma hing panpi ding, bangkimbawlthei pa, Tunglam van guolzawlnate leh Nuoilam a kipha Tuipi thuhtah guolzawlnate nawite leh naubu guolzawlna a nang hing guolzawl ding pa ngei khu suh hat in aum hi."},"26":{"text":"Na pa hing guolzawlnate in kei hing suongtute hing guolzawlnate, tangtawn muol tawptan dongin a khup zawta hi; tuate khu Joseph lutungah um vanin, a unaute akipat khentuom a umpa lusip ah aum ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Benjamin pen Ngie gongsan ahia, zingmawng in asa kei ne vanin, nitah lam chieng a gallah vante ahawm ding hi.”"},"28":{"text":"Tamte zousie Israel nam sawm leh nite ahi ua, tualeh tampen apa un akung ua a thugen leh a guolzawl nate ahi; Guolzawlna a tan ding bang chiet un a guolzawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute thugousie apie a, akung uah, “Ka chi pite kunga puia um ding ka hita a. Hitmi Ephron lou a um kokhuh ah ka pu leh pate kungah hing vui un.’"},"30":{"text":"Kanaan gam a Mamre mazawn a, Makpelah loua kokhuh Abraham in kivuina mun gou dinga Hitmi Ephron akipata alou toh alei khawm ahi.","ref":"Siem. 23.3-20"},"31":{"text":"Khummun ah Abraham leh azi Sarah avui ua, tuanah Isaak leh a zi Rebekah avui uhi, khunah ken zong Leah kana vuita hi.","ref":"Siem. 25.9,10; Siem. 35.29"},"32":{"text":"Lou leh a sunga um kokhuh Heth tate apat a kilei ahi,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob in a tapate kunga thugou a siepieh zouin a kengte lupna tungah anga tou a, ashita a, a chi pite kungah puiin aum ta hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.15"}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in apa mai leh amai sutuoin, a tawpa a kapta hi.","title":"Jakob kivuina"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in a suoh damdawi siemte apa luong muot theilou a bawl dingin thu apie a, tuachi’n daktorten Israel luong pen amuot theilou dingin a bawlta uhi."},"3":{"text":"A luong bawlna in ni sawmli alut a, tuabanga muot theilou dinga a bawlna in ni tuaza lut zel mawng ahi. Tualeh Izipt miten ama ni sawmsagi asuun uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh ama kaana nite abei nua in, Joseph in Pharoah innsung mite kungah “Tuin na mitmu ua deisahna katan leh hepitahin Pharoah zah ah thu gen un.”"},"5":{"text":"Ngai un, ka pa’n “Shi ding ka hita, Kanaan gam a ka han dinga ka tawsa ah, khum mun ngeiah na hing vui ding ahi’ chi in ahing kichiemsah hi, tuaziehin, tun hepitahin hing peitousah inlen, ka pa hing vuisah in, tualeh ka hing peikia na ding hi, chiin hing genpieh un,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 47.29-31"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh, Pharoah in, peitou inlen, ahing kichiemsah bangin na pa va vuita in achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph apa vui dingin a peitouta a, tualeh ama toh Pharoah suohte zousie leh a innsung upate Izipt gam upate zousie."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph innsung mite zousie leh a sanggamte leh apa innsung mite zousie a peitou uhi. A ta neunoute u’leh a Belamte u’leh a bawng honte uh maimai Goshen gamah anuasie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh ama toh kangtalai leh sakol tungtuong mite apeitou khawm ua, honchingtah ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jordan gal a um Atad phuol mun ahing tung ua, tuanah kap leh mauin thupitahin ni sagi sung apa suunna abawl uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tua gam a teng Kanaan miten Atad phuolmun a suunna amu un, “Tam pen Izipt mite dingin mishi suunna huoisetah ahi,” achi uhi. Tuaziehin tua mun min dingin Abel-Mizraim achita uhi. Tuami Jordan gal a um ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n a tapaten a thupieh bang zelin, abawl piehta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen a tapaten Kanaan gamah a zawnglut ua, Abraham in kivuina mun gou dinga Hitmi Ephron akipat a alou toh alei khawm, Mamre mazawna um Makpelah lou a kokhuh ah avuita uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.16"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in apa avui zouin ama leh a unaute toh apa vui dinga hawtou teng toh Izipt gam ah ahing kile kiata uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph sanggamten apa uh shita chi ahing ngaituo bep un “Joseph in hing muda vanin, a tunga sil gilou ibawl zousie itung uah phuba hing la khava” achi ua.","title":"Joseph in a unaute a hamuonna"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph kungah patong asawl ua, “Na pa’n ashi masangin tam bangin thu hing pie hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph kungah na gen ding uhi; hepitahin tuin na sanggamte khelna leh mawnate ngaidam in, aziehpen na tungah sil gilou abawl uh ahi. Tuaziehin tuin ka hing ngen uh ahi, na pa Pasian suohte khelna ngaidam in chiin achi ua, tualeh akung a thu agen lai un Joseph akapta hi.”"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n a sanggamte zong avapei ua, amasangah akhupboh ua “Ngaiin na suohte ka hi uh” achi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Joseph in akung uah, “Zau sih un aziehpen kei Pasian thaheng a um ka hiei mah?"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh nou vangin ka tungah sil gilou nana ngaituo ua; ahivangin Pasian in tuni bangin, mi tampite hingledam a a humbitna dinga silhoi tunna dinga ana ngaituo zoh ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin zau vawtsih un, nouma leh na ta na naute uh ka hing vaa nading hi” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph pen ama leh apa innkuonpite toh Izipt gamah a teng ua, tualeh Joseph kum za leh sawmli adam hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in Ephraim tate akhang thumna dong amu a, Manasseh tapa Makir tate zong Joseph pheitungah akhang lien uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in a unaute kungah, “Shi ding ka hita hi, hinanleh Pasian in noute ahing ve ngeingei dinga, tualeh tami gam akipat ahing puikhe dinga, Abraham, Isaak, tualeh Jakobte kunga pieh dinga achiem gamah a hing puilut ding hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in Israel tate akichiem sah a, “Pasian in noute ahing ve ngei ngei dinga, tualeh ka gute tana kipat in na potou ding uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 13.19; Josh. 24.32; Heb. 11.22"},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph kum za leh sawm a upa ahi in ashita hi; tualeh aluong muot theilouna in abawl ua, Izipt gam ah hankuong ah akoi ta uhi."}}}}},"2":{"info":{"name":"Pawtdohna","shortname":"Pawt.","abbr":[],"desc":"Mosi laibu nina pawtdohna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin tamte khu Izipt gam a hing lut Israel tate min ahi, michin leh a innkuonpite uh Jakob toh hing peikhawmte ahi.","title":"Israelte nasatah a punna","ref":"Siem. 46.8-27"},"2":{"text":"Reuben, Simeon, Levi leh Juda."},"3":{"text":"Issakar, Zebulun leh Benjamin."},"4":{"text":"Dan, Naphtali, Gad leh Asher."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob suon apat a hing pawtkhie mi zousie sawm sagi ahi uhi, Joseph pen Izipt gam a ana umsa ahita hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph ashita a, asanggamte zousie leh ama khanga mi zousie zong ashita uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel hahlesuonten chitamtah asuong ua, ahing pung ta mama ua, atam deudeu ua, hatchitahin ahing hatta ua, gam ahing luodim ta uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.17"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph theikhalou leeng tha khat Izipt gam ah ahing umta hi.","title":"Israelte suhgentheina","ref":"Nasep. 7.18"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh aman mipite kungah, “Ngaiun, Israel hahlesuonte eite sangin atam zawta ua, a hat zawta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Kisa un, pilvang tahin bawlvai, tuachilou in vang ahing pung sem sem ding ua, hichi ahing hiding hi, kidouna ahing um chiengin, i gal te langa pangin, eite ahing le dou kha ding uhi; tuaziehin gamsung akipat, amaute ideldoh ding uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.19"},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin puohgihte a amauh asuh gentheina dingun atung uah na sem houtu akiguot ua, puoh gih a guon uhi, tuachi’n Pharaoh a dingin, gou kholna khopite Pithom leh Rameses abawlta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh asuh genthei semsem u’leh apung sem sem ua, atam deu deu uhi. Tualeh Israel tate zieh in a lunggim ta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin Izipt miten, Israel tate nna gim tah in asem sah uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n nasep gim nain ahinkhuo uh nuomlou tah in akoi ua, simen leh tehlei bawl in, gamlahah nasep chinteng sem in, abawl genthei ua, ana uh asep sahna zousie uah, gimtahin asem sah uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt leengpa’n Hebru naudom mite a houpia, tuate lah a khat min shiphrah ahia adangpen Puah ahi.","title":"Israelte suh mangthaina ding silguon"},"16":{"text":"“Tualeh aman Hebru numeite lah a, naudom nna nasep chiengun toupha tungah en unlen, tapa ahileh that unlen, tanu ahileh hing khoi un,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh naudom miten Pasian agiing ua, Izipt leengpa thupieh bangin abawl sih ua, Pasal naupangte ahumhing zawta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin Izipt leengpa’n naudom mite ahan sah a, akung uah “Bang dinga tambang silte na bawl ua, pasal naupangte na huhhing uh ahiei?” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh naudom miten Pharaoh kungah, “Hebru numeite khu Izipt numeite bang ahisih ua, akizen ua, naudom mite a kung ua, atun masangun, nau ana nei zou pai pai uhi,” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian in naudom mite akem hoi mama a, tuachi’n mite ahing pung ua, ahat mamata uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, naudom miten Pasian agiin zieh un, Aman akung uah innkuonpi ding apie hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh in amite zousie thu apeta a, “Tapa hing pieng pouma luidung ah na pai ding ua, tualeh tanu hing pieng pouma na huhhing dinguh ahi,” chin thu apeta hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.19"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Levi phunga kipat pasal khat apeidoh a Levi tanu khat zi in anei hi.","title":"Mosi pien thu"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n numeinu agai a, tapa anei a, naupang mel hoitah ahi chi athei in, ha thum sung aphuolta hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.20; Heb. 11.23"},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh aphuol zou nawnlou bepin, phaipheng bawm aphan a, vahai buon leh chim in a zut bit a a sungah naungeh asiel a, lui panga pumpeng lahah akoi ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh asanggamnu gamla kuom ah adinga bang ang suoh mawng eimah chi thei dingin."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh tanu lui a kisil dingin ahing peisuh a, asuoh numeite luipang ah avah koi uhi, tualeh pumpeng kawma bawm amu in asuohnu ala dingin a sawlta hi."},"6":{"text":"A hon leh naupang amuta a, ngaiin naungeh akapta hi. Tuachi’n alungsiet ta a, “Tampen Hebru naupangte lah a khat ahi” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuatahin asanggamnu’n Pharaoh tanu kungah “Na nau hing chinpieh dingin Hebru numeite lah a, naudom mikhat kang va hat pieh diei?” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh tanu’n akungah, “Kuon in” achi a, tuachi’n nungah akuonta a, naungeh nu ava hanta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh tanu in akungah, “Tami naupang la khie inlen, kei a dingin hing kep pieh in, na law ding hing pe navang;” tuachi’n numei nu’n naungeh khu ala a, akem tahi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh naungeh ahing khanglien a, Pharaoh tanu kungah ahing pui a, tuachi’n atapa ahing hita hi. Tualeh amin dingin Mosi aphuo hi; “Tui a kipat ka lahdoh ahi ziehin” achi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.21"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh khum hunlai in hichi ahing hia, Mosi ahing pichin tahin asanggamte kungah ava haw a, a puohgihte uh ava mu hi, tualeh a unaute lah a khat, Hebru mi khat, Izipt mi khat in avuohlai ava muta hi.","title":"Midian gam ah Mosi taimang","ref":"Nasep. 7.23-28\n        ;     \n        Heb. 11.24"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n adah leplop a, koima a um sih chi athei tahin, Izipt mi khu athat ta a, senel lahah a phuol ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh ani ni nia ava haw kia leh, Ngaivawi Hebrumite lah a mi ni ana kilai ua, agilou zawpa kungah “Bang dinga na guolpa na vuoh ahiei?” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka tung ua lal ding leh thukhen dinga, “Nang koi hing guot ahiei? Izipt mipa na tha banga kei zong hing tha sawm na hiei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n Mosi azauta a, “Tam sil kitheidoh petma hita e,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Pharaoh in tam silte azah bep in, Mosi tha dingin asuita hi. Hinanleh Mosi Pharaoh mai a kipat in a taimangta a, Midian gamah atengta hi, tualeh tuikhuh gei khat ah atouta hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.29; Heb. 11.27"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Midian siempupa’n tanu sagi anei a, ahing pei ua, tui ahing tawi ua, apa uh ganhonte dawn dingin atuibelte uh adim uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n belam chingte ang pei ua, adelmang pieh zel ua, hinanleh Mosi ading doh a, amaute apanpi a, tualeh abelam honte uh tui apie hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n apa uh Reuel kunga ahing tun tahun, aman “Bangchidan ahiei tunia na hing hichi tun bai uh?” a chi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh amaun “Izipt mi khat in belam chingte khut a kipat ahing hunkhie a, tualeh ka tuibelte uh ahing dip pieh a, belam honte zong tui adawn sah hi.”"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n atanute kungah, “Ahileh ama heiah a um tai? bang dinga tua mipa nang nuasie uh ahiei? Ann ne dingin vahan un;” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in tua mipa toh tenkhawm ding pha asa ta a, tuachi’n aman atanu Zipporah Mosi apeta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n tapa khat aneipieh a amin Gershom aphuo hi; “Theilou gamah mikhuol in ka um hi,” achi ziehin."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n hun hing pei zel ah hichi ahing hia, Izipt leengpa ashita a, tuachi’n akol tanna zieh un, athum ua, akapta uhi; akoltanna zieh ua athumnate uh, Pasian kungah atungtou ta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in athumnate uh a za a, tualeh Pasian in Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob toh athuhun athei zing hi.","ref":"Siem. 15.13,14"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in Israeltate a en zinga, tualeh Pasian in amaute a ngaisah ta hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Mosi in asungpa Midiante siempu Jethro belam hon achinga, tualeh belam honte khu gamdai nualam muol ah apui a, Pasian muol Horeb mun ahing tung ta hi.","title":"Sawlbawh laha kilahna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh sawlbawh lah ah, Mangpa van sawlsieng meikuongin akungah ahing kilah a, tuachi’n a en a, tualeh ngaivawi sawlbawh khu akuonga, Hinanleh sawlbawhte akatum sih hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.30-34"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in “Kihei vangin tua sillamdang thupi, bangchidan a, sawlbawh ka lou ahieimah? va enta vawng,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh endingin akihei chi Mangpa’n amu tahin, sawlbawh kawma kipat in Pasian in ahan a, “Mosi, Mosi,” achia; Tualeh aman “Tamnah um ing e” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman “Tamlang hing nai sin, na kedap na kenga pat sutkhie in, na dinna mun lei siengthou ahi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Keima “Na pa Pasian, Abraham Pasian, Isaak Pasian leh Jakob Pasian ka hi” achi hi. Tuachi’n Mosi in amai aphuolta hi. Pasian a et ngamlou ziehin."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n “Izipt gam a um ka mite thuoh gimna ka mu a, atung ua nasem houtute zieha akikou uh ka za a, agentheinate uh ka thei hi.’","title":"Pasian in Mosi lamkai dia ahatna"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute Izipt mite khut a kipat a, hunkhie a gam hoi leh lien, nawitui leh khuoiju luonna gam Kanaanmite, Hitmite, Amormite, Perezmite, Hivmite leh Jebus mite, gam a puilut dinga hing peisuh ka hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin ngaivawi, Israel tate kikou aw ka kung ah ahing tung hi: tualeh Izipt miten amaute nuoisie tah a, agawtnate uh zong ka muta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin kisa in, Izipt gam a kipata ka mi Israeltate, na hing puidoh theina dingin, Pharaoh kungah ka hing sawl ding hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Mosi in Pasian kungah, “Kei koi kahiei? Pharaoh kunga va haw a, Izipt-a kipat Israeltate puidoh ding?” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman, “Pellou in kahing umpi ngeingei ding, tami nanga dingin, ka hing sawl ahi chi chiemtena ahi ding: Izipt gam a kipat mite na hing puidoh zou chiengin, tami muol tungah Pasian nna nasem ding hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Pasian kungah, “Ngaivawi Israel tate kung ah vapeiin akung uah, napu napate uh Pasian in na kung ua ahing sawl ka hi, kava chi chiengin, amaun amin bang ahiei? hing chita u’leh akung uah bang ka genta diei?” achi hi.","title":"Amin bang ahiei?","ref":"Pawt. 6.2,3"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in Mosi kungah, “KEIMA KHU KEIMA” ka hi, achi hi. Tualeh aman Israel tate kungah “KEIMA” in na kung uah “Ahing sawl hi,” nava chi ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 1.4,8"},"15":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Pasian in Mosi kungah, Israel tate kungah “Hichiin nava gen belap nalai ding hi, napu napate uh Mangpa Pasian, Abraham Pasian, Isaak Pasian leh Jakob Pasian in na kung ua ahing sawl ahi.
