Tami kumtawna ka min ahia, khang zousie tana ahing kithei zingna ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Pei inlen Israel upate va hankhawm inlen akung uah napu napate uh Mangpa Pasian, Abraham Pasian, Isaak Pasian, leh Jakob Pasian, ka kungah, ahing kilaha, hichi’n achi hi, “Ka hing ve ngaita a, Izipt gam a na tung ua sil kibawlte ka muta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Keima’n Izipt gam gimthuohna akipat in hing puidoh vangin, Kanaanmite, Hitmite, Amormite, Perizmite, Hivmite leh Jebusmite gam nawitui leh khuoiju luonna gam ah ka hing puilut ding hi,” ka chita hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun na aw angai khe ding ua, tuachi’n nang leh Israel upate, Izipt leengpa kungah navapei ding ua, akungah, Hebrute Mangpa Pasian in ahing kimupi a, tualeh na kungah ka hing ngen uhi, gamdai ah nithum lam ah hing peisah inlen, Mangpa ka Pasian uh kunga, kithoina kava bawl thei na dingun na chi ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Izipt leengpa’n khut hattah loungal in ahing peisah sih ding chi ka thei hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka khut ka zahdoh dinga, ka sil lamdang zousie ama u’lah mama ah bawlvangin, Izipt gam ka gawt dinga; tua zou chiengin noute ang pawtsah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Iziptmite mitmu in, tam mite deisahna ka pe dinga, tualeh tambang ahing hidinga, na pei chiengun khut guohin na pei sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.35,36"},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh numei chintengin, a innvengte leh, a inn gei a tengte kungah, sana-dangka kizepna ding leh nihten-puonsilte angen ding ua, khumte na tapate u’leh na tanute un na silsah ding uhi. Tua bangin Izipt mite na suom ding uhi,” achi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in adawnga, ahi vangin, “Ngaivawi, ahing tahsang sih ding ua, ka thu zong a ngaikhe ut sih ding uh: Mangpa na kungah kilah sihva achi ding zieh un,” achi hi.","title":"Hing tahsang sih va uh"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n akungah, “Na khut sunga khu bang ahiei?” achi a, aman “Chiengkhut” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman “Tuol ah khesuh vawi” achia, tuachi’n tuol a khieh suh leh gul asuohta hi, tuachi’n Mosi ataita hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah “Na khut zandoh inlen amei ah man in” achi hi. Aman akhut azandoh a amat leh akhut ah chieng ahing suoh kia ta hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tuachia amaun apu apate uh Mangpa Pasian Abraham Pasian, Isaak Pasian leh Jakob Pasian, na kungah ahing kilah hi chi, atahsan theina ding uh ahi.”"},"6":{"text":"Tua ban ah Mangpa’n akungah tu’n, “Na khut na awmah koi in” achia, tuachi’n aman akhut a awm ah akoi a, tualeh alahdoh tahin ngaivawi, akhut apha a vua abang tahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Na khut na awmah koi kia in” achia, tualeh aman akhut a awmah akoi kia a, tualeh a awm apat alah doh leh, ngaivawi, achi dang ahing bang kia ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n “Tambang ahing hiding, nang ahing gintat lou ua,” chiemtena khatna aw zong angaikhiet nuom sih u’leh, chiemtena nukhia pen aw, a gintat na ding uh ahi ding."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hi dinga, tam chiemtena nite a gintat lou ua, na aw zong angaikhiet tuom sih u’leh, lui apat tui na la dinga tuolgum tungah nasung ding, tualeh lui a kipat a, na tui lah khiet khu tuolgum ah sisan ahing suoh ding hi, a chi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Mangpa kungah, “Aw Mangpa, mi dangnal ka hi sih a, masang lai apat leh na suoh nang houpi nua in zong thu gen siem ka hi ngaisih a, tualemahin mi ham awh leh dang nal lou kahi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n akungah “Mihing kam bawl koi ahiei? Ahisihleh ham theiloute, bil bingte, mutheinate, mittote, koi bawl ahiei? Keima Mangpa’n ka bawl hilou amah?"},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin tu’n pei inlen, na kam ka umpi dinga, na gen ding kahing hil ding hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh ama’n ka hing ngen hi, “Aw ka Mangpa, midang sawl zaw mai in” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa lungthahna, Mosi tungah a kuongta a, akungah, “Levimi Aaron na sanggampa umlou ahiei mah? Ama mi kamsiem ahi chi ka thei hi. Ngaiin nangma hing lamtuo dingin ahing kuon hi, tualeh nang ahing mu chiengin akipah mama ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n nangman akungah thu na gen dinga, akam ah thu na mop ding hi, tualeh na kam leh akam umpi vangin, na bawl dinguh kang hil zel ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama khu mipite kunga, na thu genpa hivan in, ama khu nanga dingin na kam ahi dinga nang pen ama adingin a Pasian bang na hiding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh na khut in tam chieng na tawi dinga, tuatoh chiemtenate na bawl ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Izipt gam a Mosi apei kiana"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi apei a, asungpa Jethro kungah ahing kile kia a, akungah “Izipt gam a um ka unaute kunga peikia ding leh adamna uoi mah chi va-en dingin hing hawsah in chin ka hing ngen hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Jethro in Mosi kungah “Lungmuong tahin peita’n” a chi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Midian gam a Mosi kungah, “Pei inlen Izipt gamah kilekia ta’n nang hing tha sawmte a shi siengta uhi,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in a zi leh atapate azawpi a, sabiltung tung ah atuong sah a, Izipt gam langah ahing kile kia ta uhi. Tualeh Mosi in Pasian chieng a khut ah atawi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Izipt gam a kile kia dinga na pei chiengin, na khuta ka koi tua sil lamdang zousiete, Pharaoh masang ah bawl teitei in, hinanleh a lungtang ka sukhau dinga, mipite apeisah lou na dingin."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh nangman Pharaoh kungah, Mangpa’n Israel khu ka tapa ahia, ka ta masapen ahi, achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh na kunga ka gen ahi, ka nna ahing seppieh thei na dingin, ka tapa peisah in, na peisah nuom sihleh, ngaivawi na tapa, nata masapen that ding kahi,” achi hi va chiin.","ref":"Pawt. 12.29"},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n lampi a giehbuh ah tambang ahing hita a, Mangpa’n Mosi ahing kimupi a, tha dingin asuita hi.","title":"Mosi tapa teptanna"},"25":{"text":"Tualaitahin Zipporah in suong hiem khat ala a, atapa tep atan khie a, Mosi kengbul ah apai a, “Kei dingin sisan suo pasal na hi chienvawt hi” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n apeisanta a, khumin Zipporah in Teptan ziehin sisan suo pasal na hi, achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Aaron kungah, “Mosi kimupi dingin gamdai ah vapei in” achi hi. Tuachi’n apeita a, Pasian muol ah ava kimupi a, atawp ta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Aaron kungah ama sawlpa Mangpa thu zousie leh sil lamdang abawl dinga, athupieh zousie ahil tahi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Aaron apei ua, Israel tate upa zousie ahan khawm ua,"},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron in, Mangpa’n Mosi kunga, athugen zousie a gen a, mite masangah chiemtenate abawl hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n miten ana gingta ua, tualeh Mangpa’n Israel tate ahing ve a, athuohgimnate u’zong ahing enta chi azah un, alu uh akunsah ua, Pasian a bie uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tuate zou in Mosi leh Aaron Pharaoh kungah ava pei ua akungah, “Israelte Mangpa Pasian in tam bangin agen hi, gamdai a kei a dinga Pawi abawl thei na dingun ka mite pei sahin achi hi,” chiin, achi uhi.","title":"Pharaoh masangah Mosi leh Aaron a ding uh"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh in “Israelte peisah dinga athu kaman ding Mangpa khu koi ahiei? Tua Mangpa ka thei sih hi, Israelte zong peisah sihvang,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun “Hebrute Pasian in a hing kimupi a gamdai ni thum lam ah hing peisah inlen ka hing ngen uhi, Mangpa ka Pasian uh kungah kithoina hing bawlsahin, tua ahisihleh ka tung uah, natpi ahiei namsau ahiei ahing tungsah kha ding hi,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt leengpa’n a kung uah “Bang dinga nou Mosi leh Aaron in mipite a nasepna ua kipat khawlsah na hi uoi? na nasep uh vakisep khin khian un,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh in “Ngaiun, gamsung a mite ahing tam sengseng ta ua, tualeh a puohgih ua pat na khawlsah ta mawh ua,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuami ni mamain nasep vengtute leh houtute tambangin thu apie hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tumasang lai bangin tamite atehlei bawlna dinguh, Pawl penawn sih un, amaute kuon uhenlen pawl kitomkhawm uheh."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tumasanga atehlei bawl za ma uh atung uah na phut ding ua, na suh kiem pieh vawtlou ding uh ahi, athasiet man uh ahi, tuazieh a, ka Pasian kung uah va kithoi va ung achi uh ahi."},"9":{"text":"Gimtah a asep thei na dingun mite tung ah nna tamsem guon unlen, tualeh thuginalou ngaisah da uheh,” chin thu apie hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh nasem vengtute leh houtute apawtdoh ua, mipite kungah, “Pharaoh in pawl ka hing penawnsih ding hi, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Nouma pei unlen na mu theithei na uah, pawl kilahkhawm un, hinanleh nana sep uh bangma a ki kiem sah tuom sih ding hi,” ava chita uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n mite bu pawl taanga bu kungbulte lakhawm dingin Izipt gamsungah akithezahta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh nasep vengtuten, “Tumasanga bupawl hing kipieh lai mabangin, na nasep uh, na nichin nasep uh zou kin un” chi’n anaw uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh nasem vengtuten Israel tate lah a houtu dinga aguotte uh khu avuo ua, “Bang dinga tumasanga banga zani leh tuni tan a na tehlei bawlte uh zoulou na hi uoi mah?” chi’n a phuut uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuabepin Israeltate lah a, upate ahing pei ua, Pharaoh kungah akap ua, “Bangdinga na suohte nang hichi bawl tahlawm ahiei?","title":"Israel ten Mosi anuol uh"},"16":{"text":"Na suohte lah bupawl ahing pe nawn sih ua, ka kung uah tehlei khengun ahing chi uhi. Ngaivawi, na suohte ahing vuo uhi, hinanleh adih lou khu na mite ahi,” achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh aman akung uah, “Thasie na hi uh, thasie na hi uh, tuazieha hing pei sah inlen Mangpa kung ah hing kithoi sah in na chi uh ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin tu’n pei unlen nna vasem un, bupawl vang ang kipe sih ding a, hinanleh tehlei na khen ding ua kibituh za pen na pieh ding uh ahi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh “Na nichin nasep un, na tehlei khente uh, nakiem sah thei tuom sih ding uh,” achitah in, Israel tate upaten atansiet dan uh athei ta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh kunga kipat ahing pawtdoh tah un, amaute toh kimu dinga na ngah Mosi leh Aaron toh akimu ta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh amaun akung uah, “Mangpa’n nou hing enkhie henlen, vai hing hawm piehta hen, Pharaoh leh asuohte mitmu ah, huot huoi nang suota ua, koute tha na dinga a khut ua namsau na tawisah tah zieh un,” achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi Mangpa kunglam ah akile kia a, “Aw Mangpa bang ding a tam mite hichi banga hoilou tah a na bawl ahiei? bang dinga kei nang sawl ahiei?","title":"Pasian kungah Mosi lungkimlou"},"23":{"text":"Na min a Pharaoh kunga thugen dinga ka va pei apat aman tam mite tungah sil gilou abawlta a; nanglah na mite na puidoh vawt sih hi,” achi hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Tuin Pharaoh kunga bang ahiei ka bawl ding; khut thahatna ziehin amaute ka peisah ding a, khut thahat in amau’te a gam akipat in ahawlkhe ding hi” achi hi.","title":"Mosi ngetna Mangpa’n adawnna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in Mosi ahoupi a, akungah, “Kei Mangpa ka hi”, achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 17.1; 28.3; 35.11; Pawt. 3.13-15"},"3":{"text":"Abraham kungah Isaak kungah leh Jakob kungah bangkimbawlthei Pasian min in kana kilah ta a, hinanleh ka min JEHOVAH in akung uah thei ka hisih hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute kungah mikhuol ahina u’leh a khuolzinna gam uh Kanaan gam pe dingin amaute toh ka thuhun ka sudet ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt miten hentatna kol abu sah uh Israel tate kaa leh mauna zong ka zata a, ka thuhun zong ka thei zing hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin Israel tate kungah, kei Mangpa ka hi chi gen inlen, Iziptte puohgihna nuoi akipat ka hing puidoh dinga, ahing saltansahna ua kipat in ka hing suohtasah dinga, thukhenna thupitah toh banjahin ka hing tandoh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka mipite hi dingin ka hing la ding a, tualeh kei na Pasian uh ka hi ding; tuachi’n Izipte puohgihte nuoi a kipat hing hundohpa Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi chi, na hing thei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob kunga, pieh dinga kana chiemsa gam sungah hing puilut vangin, tualeh na gouluo dingun hing pe vang. “Kei Mangpa khu ka hi”."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Israel tate kungah tambangin thu agen tahi, hinanleh alungsim gentheina u’leh a koltanna uh gentheina ziehin Mosi thu gente angaikhe nuom sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah agen a,","title":"Pasian in Mosi asawl kiana"},"11":{"text":"“Vapei inlen, Izipt leengpa Pharaoh kungah, Israel tate agam apat pawtdoh sah dingin va gen in,” a chi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Mangpa maiah, “Ngaiin, Israel tate’n ka thu angai khiet nuom loupi uh. Kei muh teptanlou thugen bang chin Pharaoh in angai khe diei?” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron ahoupi a, Izipt gam akipat Israeltate puidoh dingin thu ka hing peta chi, Israel tate leh Izipt leengpa Pharaoh kungah vahil un chin thu apie hi."},"14":{"text":"Tamte khu aphung upate uh ahi: Israel tamasapen Reuben tapate, Hanok, Pallu, Hezron leh Karmi tamte Reuben innkuonte ahi uhi.","title":"Mosi leh Aaron in Israel upate min agiel uh"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Simeon tapate: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad Jachin, Zohar leh Kanaan numei tapa Shaul, tamte Simeon innkuonte ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh tamte akhang dungzui ua, Levi tapate min ahi uhi: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari: Tualeh Levi damsung kumte kum zakhat leh sawmthum leh sagi ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 3.17-20; 26.57,58; 1 Khang. 6.16-19"},"17":{"text":"Gershon tapate Libni leh Shimi ahi uhi, ainnkuon dung zui un."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Kohath tapate; Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel, tualeh Kohath damsung kumte, kum zakhat leh kum sawmthum leh kumthum ahi."},"19":{"text":"Merari tapate: Mahali leh Musho tamte a khang uh dung zuiin Levi innkuonte ahi uh."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Amram in apa sanggamnu Jokebed ziin anei a, amanu’n Aaron leh Mosi ahinpieh hi. Tualeh Amram damsung kumte, kum zakhat leh kum sawmthum leh sagi ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Izhar tapate, Korah, Nepheg leh Zikri ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Uzziel tapate: Mishael, Elzaphan leh Zithri."},"23":{"text":"Aaron in Amminadab tanu, Nahshon sanggamnu, Elisheba akitenpi a; tualeh amanu’n Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahinpieh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Korah tapate Assir, Elkanah leh Abiasaph: tamte Korah innkuonte ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Aaron tapa Eleazar in Puttiel tanute khat ziin anei a tualeh amanu’n Phinehas ahinpieh hi, Akhangguidan dungzui un tamte Levi mite khanggui hing kipatna upate, ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tamte Mangpa’n Aaron leh Mosi kunga, “Israel tate apawl pawl in, Izipt gam a kipat in puidoh un” achite ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tamte khu Izipt Lengpa Pharaoh vahoupi a, Israel tate Izipt gam a pat a pawtdoh sah dinga thu vagente, tua mite khu Aaron leh Mosi ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hia, Izipt gam a Mosi kunga Mangpa’n thu agen niin;"},"29":{"text":"Mangpa’n “Kei Mangpa khu ka hi, na kunga ka gen zousie, Izipt leengpa Pharaoh kungah gen in” chi’n Mosi ahoupi hi"},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh Mosi in Mangpa masangah “Ngaiin kei muuh temtanlou neimi ka hia, bangchin Pharaoh in ka thugen angaikhe diei?” a chi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “En in Pharaoh a dingin Pasian in kahing bawlta a, na sanggampa Aaron pen na guolnei ahi ding hi.","title":"Mosi kisawl kiana"},"2":{"text":"Thu kahing pieh zousie na gendoh dinga, na sanggampa Aaron in Pharaoh kungah, Israel tate agam akipat pawtdohsah dingin thu agen ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh lungtang ka khausah dinga, Izipt gamah ka chiemtenate leh sil lamdangte ka pungsah ding hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.36"},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh, Pharaoh in na thu angaikhe sih ding, tuachi’n Izipt tunga ka khut kangah theina ding leh gawtna thupitah toh Izipt apat ka galkap honte leh ka mi Israelte ka puidoh theina ding in."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt tunga ka khut ka hing zahkhiet a, alah ua kipat Israel tate kapuidoh chiengin, Izipt miten kei Mangpa ka hi chi hing thei va uh,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Aaron in tuabangin abawl ua, Mangpa’n amaute thu apieh bangjelin abawlta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh kunga thu avagen laiun Mosi kum sawmgiet leh kum thum a upa ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron kungah thu agen a,","title":"Aaron chiengin Pharaoh chieng aval"},"9":{"text":"“Pharaoh in na kung ua, sillamdang hing bawl di uole achi chiengin Aaron kungah, Na chieng la inlen Pharaoh masangah paiin na chi dinga, tuakhu gul ahing suoh ding hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi leh Aaron Pharaoh kungah ava pei ua. Mangpa’n thu apieh bangin ava bawlta uhi. Tuachi’n Aaron in achieng khu Pharaoh leh asuohte masangah apai a, tua khu gul ahing suohta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuabepin Pharaoh in zong, mipite leh dawithusiemte ahan a, tuachi’n Izipt gamsunga mitphiel dawisiem ten zong dawithu sam in tuabangin abawlta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amaun zong achieng chiet uh apai ua, gul ahing suoh ta uhi. Hinanleh Aaron chiengin amaute chieng aval tahi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n agensa bangin Pharaoh lungtang asuh khaupieh a, athugen uh a ngai khesih hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kung ah, “Pharaoh lungtang suhkhau in aumta a, mipite apeisah nuom tasih hi.","title":"Gawtna khatna"},"15":{"text":"Zingmawng chiengin Pharaoh kungah nava hawding a, ngaiin tui apat a ahing pawt doh chiengin luipang ah ama kimupi dingin na ngah inlen, tualeh na khut in na chieng gul suohthei khu natawi ding ahi.’"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh akungah, “Hebrute Mangpa Pasian in na kung ah keima ahing sawl hi “Gamdai a ka nna asep theina ding un, ka mite peisah in,” hinanleh ngaiin tutan in na ngaisah sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, “Tamte ziehin kei Mangpa khu ka hi chi na thei ding, En in ka khuta ka tawi chiengin luituite ka saat dinga, sisan ahing suoh ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 16.4"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n lui a nga umte ashi ding a, tualeh ahing ui dinga, Izipt miten luitui akidah ding ua, a dawn sih ding uhi, achi hi na chi ding,” a chi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah thu agen a, Aaron kungah “Na chieng la-inlen Izipt gam a tuite, aluitate uh aluipite u’leh atuikulte u’leh atuikhuhte uh tung ah na banzah in, tuachi’n tui zousie sisan asuoh dinga, Izipt gam sunga singhawm leh suonghawm a, tui um zousie sisan asuohna dingin,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Aaron in Mangpa’n thu apieh bangin abawlta uhi. Tualeh Pharaoh leh asuohte mitmu mama in Aaron in achieng alamtou a, lui a tuite asat a, tuachi’n lui a tui umte sisan asuoh siengta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh lui a nga um zousie ashita a, lui a uita a, Izipt miten luitui adawn thei ta sih uhi, tuachi’n Izipt gam pumpi ah sisan a umta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt gam a mitphieldawi siemten zong adawithu un tuama bangin abawl uhi. Tualeh Pharaoh lungtang suhkhau in a um a, Mangpa’n achibangin amau’te thu angaikhe tuom sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh akihei a, a innsungah alut a, tambang sil piengten alungtang akhoi kha vawt sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin, Izipt mite zousie tui dawn ding suiin lui geite akhuot ua, lui tuite a dawn theitahlou zieh un."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n lui asat zou ni sagi ahing ching ta hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah, “Pharaoh kungah va pei inlen, akungah ‘Mangpa’n ka miten ka nna asep theina dingun Pei sah in,","title":"Gawtna ni-na ukeng"},"2":{"text":"Na peisah nuom sihleh ngai in, na gamsung zousie ukenga ka gawt ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n lui in ukeng tampi ahing umdoh sah dinga, tuate ahing Peitou ding ua, na Innsungah ahing lut ding ua, na lupna pindan sunguh, na lupna tungah, na suohte innsung ah, na mite tungah leh na lungthu khuh sungah tualeh na tangbuong pawina kuong sung tanpha ah a dim ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh ukengte khu nang leh na mite tung leh na suohte zousie tung ah ahing kal ding uhi vachiin,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupia akungah, Aaron kungah “Luitate tungah, luipite tungah, tualeh tuikulte tungah na khut a nachieng tawi pum in na banzah inlen Izipt gam tungah ukengte umdoh sahin, chiin” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron in Izipt tuite tungah aban azah a tuachi’n ukengte ahing pawt khie ua, Izipt gam atuom suohta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh mitphieldawi siemten a dawi thu un, tuachi mabangin abawl ua, Izipt gam ah Ukeng aum sah uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuabepin Pharaoh in Mosi leh Aaron ahan a, “Kei leh ka mite akipat ukengte alah mang thei na dingin Mangpa kungah ngen un, tuachi’n Mangpa kunga ava kithoi theina dingun mipite ka pei sah ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Pharaoh kung ah “Tam zatatna pom inlen, nang apat leh na inn apat a ukengte sumanga luidung mai mai a, a um na ding u’leh nangma leh na suohte leh namite a dingin bangchih chieng in kang nget pieh diei,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh in “Zing chiengin” achi hi, Tualeh Mosi in “Mangpa ka Pasian uh bang koima a um sih chi na thei na dingin, na chibang hita hen. Achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh ukengte nang akipat, na innte akipat, nasuoh te akipat leh namite akipat apawtkhe ding ua, lui dungah a umta ding uhi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Aaron Pharaoh kung apat apawt khie ua, tualeh Mosi in Pharaoh tunga atunsah ukengte ziehin Mangpa kungah angenta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi thu bangin abawlta hi. Tuachi’n ukengte khu innte akipat, inn huongsungte akipat leh loute akipat ashi gamta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh miten aluoh khawm ua, asievum ua, gamsung a uita hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Pharaoh in ukengte abeita chi amu bep in, Mangpa’n agen bangin, alungtang akhausah a, a gen uh angaisah nawn sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Aaron kungah na chieng lamtou inlen Izipt gamsung a leivui zousie hit asuoh thei na dingin sat in, chiin” achi hi.","title":"Gawtna thumna Hit-a gawtna"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh tuabangin abawl ua, Aaron in akhut in achieng alamtou a, lei a leivui asat a, tuate khu mite tung leh sate tung ah hit ahing suoha Izipt gam pumpi a, leivui zousie hit a suohta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh mitphieldawi siemten zong a dawi thu un tuabanga hit umsah a tum ua, hinanleh a bawl thei sih uhi, tuachi’n mi tung leh sa tungah hit a umta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n mitphieldawi siemten Pharaoh kungah “Tami Pasian khut nasep ahi bou hi, achi ua, tualeh Pharaoh lungtang akhau semsem a, Mangpa’n agen taah mabangin a thu uh a ngai khe sih hi.","ref":"Luk. 11.20"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah “Zingmawng matahin thou inlen, Pharaoh masangah va dingin, ngai in, lui lam zuona hing pei ding ahi, tuachi’n akungah Mangpa’n tambangin achi hi, Ka nna asep thei nading un ka mite pei sah in, achi hi vachiin.”","title":"Gawtna lina thou"},"21":{"text":"Khuchilou a, ka mite na pei sah sihleh ngai in, nangma tung leh na suohte tung leh na mite tung leh na innsungah thou ka hing sawl ding a, Izipt mite innsung leh a umna leitung uh thou honin adim ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh tuami hun chiengin, ka mite tenna, Goshen gam khu, thou hon um lou dingin, ka khen tuom ding hi, tuachi’n leitungah kei khu Mangpa ka hi chi na hing thei ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh ka mite leh na mite kikaal ah ki khenna koi vangin, zing chiengin tam chiemtena a um ding hi.”"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n tuabangin abawla, tuachi’n Pharaoh innsung leh a suohte innsungah leh Izipt gamsung tengah thou hon lungjin huoitah ahing tung ta a, thou honte ziehin agam a segawp ta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh in Mosi leh Aaron ahan sah a, “Pei unlen tami gam sungah na Pasian kung uah va kithoi ta un,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in “Tuabanga bawl akilawm sih, aziehpen Mangpa ka Pasian uh kunga, Izipt mite dinga kidah huoi, kithoina lan ding ka hi uh; ngaiin Izipt mite mitmu a akidah huoi kithoina lanta uleng suongin hing sep lou ding uh amah?"},"27":{"text":"Gamdai a nithum lamah ka va pei ding ua, ahing thupieh ding banga Mangpa ka Pasian uh kunga kithoina bawl ding in.”"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh in “Gamdai a, Mangpa na Pasian uh kunga, na kithoithei na dingun kahing peisah dinga, hinanleh gamlapi va pei sih pou ulachin, kei dingin zong thu hing nget pieh un” a chi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in, “Ngaiin, na kunga kipat ka pawt khe dinga, Pharaoh apat leh asuohte apat leh amite apat a, thou honpi apeimang theina dingun, Mangpa kung ah ka ngen ding hi. Hinanleh Mangpa kunga kithoi dinga mite peisah lou dingin Pharaoh lepchie sih heh,” a chi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh kungah akipat Mosi apawtkhie a, Mangpa kungah thu a ngen ta hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi gen bangin a bawla, tualeh Pharaoh apat, asuohte apat leh amipite apat thou honte alakhie a, khat zong a um nawn sih hi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh tam hun in zong Pharaoh a lungtang a khausah a, mite apeisah tuom sih hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Pharaoh kungah valut inlen, Mangpa Hebrute Pasian in, tambangin agen hi, kei ahing bieh theina dingun, ka mite peisah in.","title":"Gawtna ngana: Hima"},"2":{"text":"Amaute peisah nuom lou a, na tuhtaang den nahlai leh;"},"3":{"text":"Ngaiin, Mangpa khut khu, na gantatna muna na ganhonte, na sakolte, na sabiltungte leh sangawngsaute, bawngtalte leh belamte tungah tuvanin, gan natpi huoisetah a um ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Israel gante leh Izipt gantate akhen tuom dinga, Israel tate neisa bangma ashi sih ding hi, chi’n vahil in achi hi.”"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n hun bise khat aguot a, “Zing chiengin Mangpa’n gamsung pumpi ah tam sil abawl ding,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n tua sil khu azing ni’n abawl a, Iziptte gan hon zousie ashi ta a, hinanleh Israel tate ganta khat zong ashi sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh in mi asawl a, ngaivawi, Israelte ganta khat zong ashi sih hi. Hinanleh Pharaoh lungtang akhau deu deu a mipite apeisah tuom sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron kungah “Tummeipi sunga vut na khut dim un la unlen, tua khu Mosi in, Pharaoh mu ngei ah, vanlam ah the hen, a chi hi.","title":"Gawtna guhna: Uilutpi mi le sa tungah"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh tami khu Izipt gamsung pumpi ah leivui nel hing suoh vanin, Izipt gamsung zousie a mite tung leh sate tungah chibaw leh uilutpi ahing suoh ding hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n tummeipi sunga vut ala ua, Pharaoh masangah ading ua, Mosi in vanlam ah athe tou a, mite tung leh gantate tungah chibaw leh uilutpi ahing suoh ta uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 16.2"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh uilut hima naikulte ziehin, mitphieldawi siemte Mosi masangah ading theita sih uhi; uilut khu mitphieldawi siemte leh Izipt mite zousie tunga atuh taah ziehin."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kunga agen tahmabangin, Mangpa’n Pharaoh lungtang asuhkhau pieh a agen uh a ngaikhe sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah “Zingmawng matahin thou inlen, Pharaoh masangah vading inlen a kungah, Mangpa Hebrute Pasian in tam bangin agen hi.” Kei ahing bieh theina dingun ka mite peisah in.","title":"Gawtna sagi giel"},"14":{"text":"Tutung in vang, na lungtang sung leh na suohte tung leh, na mite tungah, gawtna chinteng hing tung sah ding ka hi; Leitung pumpi ah keima bang koima a um sih chi na thei na dingin."},"15":{"text":"Tuin nangma leh na mite natpi a gawt ding in ka khut zahkhe taleng, tuachi’n leitung akipat in sat khiehin na um tading hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh, ngaiin, nangma a, Kasil bawl theina ensah dingin; leh leitung pumpi a ka min akithan theina dingin, tami zieh a kang tunding ahi bou hi.","ref":"Rom. 9.17"},"17":{"text":"Tutan amau’te peisah nuom lou in, ka mite tungah na kiliensah nalai hi."},"18":{"text":"Ngai in zingchieng tuhun in, Izipt gam aum chil akipat tutan a umkha ngainai vawt lou, gielpi huoisetah ka zusah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin mi sawl inlen, na ganta teng leh lougam a na neiteng khum khawmin, a zieh pen inn a kikhum lou a, lou gam a um mi leh sa pouma tungah giel ake dinga, ashi ding uhi, vachi’n achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Pharaoh suohte laha Mangpa thu zau pouma ten asuohte u leh agantate uh inn sungah a hawl lut uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa thu khawh salouten asuohte u’leh agantate uh gamlah ah a nuasie uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Izipt gam sung pumpi a, mite leh sate tung leh Izipt gam pumpi a, annte-louhing chinteng tunga giel akieh theina dingin, na khut vanlam ah zah tou in,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in achieng van langah aleh tou a, tuachi’n Mangpa’n vanpi ging leh gielpi ang sawlta a, tualeh leizul ah meikuong ahing tai ta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n giel, mei leh giel kihal huoise tah, Izipt mite nam khat ahing hi ua kipat a, Izipt gam a um kha ngainai vawtlou, ahing umta hi.","ref":"Kihil. 8.7; 16.21"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh giel in Izipt gam pumpi a, lougam a um mite leh sate zousie aseplia siengta a, lou a annte louhing chinteng asepsie a, gamlah a, sing chinteng aseptan sieng tahi."},"26":{"text":"Israeltate umna Goshen gamah vang giel ake sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh in mi asawl a, Mosi leh Aaron ahansah a, akung uah “Tutungin vang ka mawta hi. Mangpa athudiha, kei leh ka mite ka gilou uhi."},"28":{"text":"Mangpa kungah ngen un, van ging he hu leh giel te ahun gawpta, tuachi’n ka hing peisah dinga, na um nawn sih ding uh” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuabepin Mosi’n akungah, “Khopi apat ka pawtdoh chiengin, Mangpa lam ah ka khut zahtou vangin tuachi’n van gingte akhawl ding a, giel zong a um nawn sih ding hi, tuachi’n leitung khu Mangpa a, ahi, chi na thei ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh nang leh na suohten vang, Mangpa Pasian ging nai tuom sih va uteh chi ka thei hi,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuin pat leh barli bute gielin asep sie a, barli bute avui laitah ahia, pat zong aga laitah ahi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh mangbu leh buman pen apoudoh nailou zieh in asepse sih hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi Pharaoh kunga pat khopi pulam ah apawt ta a, tualeh Mangpa lang ah akhut a zahtou a, van ging leh gielpi a khawl a, leitungah guo azu nawn sih hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh in guo le giel leh vanging atawpta chi amu in, khelna tam sem abawl nalai a, ama leh a suohten a lungtang uh a khausah ta uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh lungtang suh khau in a um a, Israel tate apeisah nuom nawn sih hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah “Valut in, tam ka chiemtenate amasanga ka etsah theina dingin, alungtang leh asuohte lungtang ka khausah ta hi.","title":"Gawtna gietna: khauphe"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh nangman zong na tapa leh na tapa tapa zah a, Izipt gam a ka silbawldan leh alah ua chiemtena ka bawlte na hil theina dingin, kei MANGPA ka hi chi na theina dingun,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Aaron Pharaoh kungah ava lut ua, akungah, “Hebrute Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi, bangtan ahiei ka masanga ki-ngiemkhieh na niel ding? Kei ahing bieh theina dingun ka mite peisah in."},"4":{"text":"Khumbanga ka mite na peisah nuom sihleh ngai aw, zingchiengin na gamsungah khauphete ka hing tungsah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n lei mai atuom ding ua, koiman lei amu thei sih dinguh, giel sesiet mawh na kunga um nalai teng ane sieng ding ua, nanga dinga gamlah a singpou chinteng, ane zou sieng ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Na innte leh na suohte innte tualeh Izipt mite inn zousie aluodim ding ua; leitunga aum ua kipat, tuni tan a na pate ahiei ahisihleh na pate pate in zong amu ngailou uh,” a chi hi. Tuachi’n aki heia Pharaoh akipat a pawtkheta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh suohten akungah “Bangtan vei tam mipa ei dinga ithang uh hiding ahiei? Mangpa a Pasian uh abieh theina dingun, mite peisah mai in. Izipt gamsung suhsiet in a um chi thei nailou na hiei mah?” achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi leh Aaron Pharaoh kungah ahing zawpi kia ua, tualeh aman akung uah “Pei unlen Mangpa na Pasian uh vabeta un, hinanleh apei dingte koite ahi uoi?” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in “Ka naupangte utoh, ka tehsete utoh, ka tapate u’leh ka tanute utoh, ka belam honte u’leh ka bawng honte utoh, ka peiding uhi, Mangpa kunga annkuong luina neiding ka hi zieh un.”"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akung uah, “Mangpa na kung uah um ta hen, nata neu noute utoh kang peisah maiding hi hinanleh pilvang un, silhoilou na masang uah a um hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuabang hithei lou e, nou pasal piching teng pei unlen, Mangpa vabie un, tuami na lunggul uh ahi ngal a,” tuachi’n Pharaoh masang akipat amaute adeldohta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Izipt gam tungah na khut jahin, khauphete ahing um na dingun. Izipt gam a ahing peitou ua, gam sunga haichi giel in asuhsiet mawh umsun sun aneh gam thei na dingun,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in a chieng Izipt gam tungah alehtou a, tuachi’n Mangpa’n tuami ni sunnitum leh zan khovah in tuami gam tungah Suolam hui alaang sah a, tualeh zingmawng ahing hitahin, tua suolam hui in khauphe ahing tunta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh khauphete khu Izipt gam pumpi tungah a leeng ua, Izipt gamsung zousie ah atu ua, atam mama uhi. Tumasangin khauphe hichibang mawngmawng in ana umkha ngainai sih a, tunua chiengin zong a um ngai nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 9.2,3"},"15":{"text":"Lei mai zousie adapsuoh ziehun, gamsung amiel deel-duulvawt hi, tualeh giel suhsiet mawh, tua gam a annte louhing zousie leh theiga zousie ane zou sieng ua, tuachi’n Izipt gamsung pumpi a, lou a haichi hing mawngmawng, singlelouhing a um nawn vawt sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh in Mosi leh Aaron kintahin ahan sah a, akung uah, “Mangpa na Pasian u’leh noute tungah sil ka bawlkhielta, achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin hepitahin tutunga ka khelna hing ngaidam unlen, tam shina kei akipat a alahdoh theina dingin, Mangpa na Pasian ukung ah hing nget pieh un,” a chi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh kunga kipat apawtdoh a Mangpa kungah angenta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n tumlam hui hattah ahing langsah a, tua huipi’n khauphete asemmang sienga, tuipi sungah asemlut siengta hi, tuachi’n Izipt gamsung pumpi ah khauphe khat zong a um nawn sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n Pharaoh lungtang asuhkhau pieh a, tuachi’n Israel tate apeisah nuom tuom sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Na khut vanlam ah zahtou in, Izipt gamsunga miel thamkhah thei vawt, miel satah ahing um theina dingin,” achi hi.","title":"Gawtna kuona: mielna"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in akhut vanlam ah a zahtou a, tuachi’n Izipt gamsung pumpi ah nithum sung miel satah mai a umta hi.","ref":"Late. 105.28; Kihil. 16.10"},"23":{"text":"Koima akimuthei sih ua, nithum sung vingveng koima a umna uapat athou khe sih uhi. Hinanleh Israel tate zousie umna teng avah hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh in Mosi ahansah a, akungah, “Pei unlen Mangpa vabeta un, na belam honte u’leh na ganhonte uvang umsah unlen, na taneute u’zong zawpi un,” a chi hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh Mosi in “Mangpa ka Pasian uh kunga ka kithoi theina dingun, kithoina ding leh halmang sillat dingte, ka khut ua nang pieh tei tei ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ka gan honte un zong ang zui ding ahi, kengchin khat zong ka nuasie sih ding uhi, aziehpen tuate lah akipat a, Mangpa ka Pasian uh bieh na dinga ka lah dinguh ahi, tuamun ka tun masangsie un bang pen in ahiei Mangpa ka bieh dinguh ka theinai sih uhi,” a chi hi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n Pharaoh lungtang asuhkhau pieh a, amaute apeisah nuom tasih hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh in akungah, “Ka kunga kipat pawt mang inlen Pilvangin, ka mel mawngmawng hing mu nawnsin ka melna mu ni-ni na shi ni ahi ding,” a chi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in, “Genhoi bou chie, na mel ka mu nawn tasih ding hi,” a chi hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Pharaoh tung leh Izipt gam tungah gawtna khat ka tungsah nalai ding; tua zaw chiengin tam mun akipat ahing peisah ding, ahing peisah vanglah chiengin tam mun a kipat ahing hawl khiet thaw vawt ding hi.","title":"Gawtna sawm: ta chil shidinga vauna"},"2":{"text":"Tuin mipite zahin thugen inlen, Pasal chinin a innvengte kungah, numei chin in a innvengte kungah dangka kizepna leh sana kizepnate ngen uhen.”"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Israel mite khu Izipt mite mitmu ah deisahna atangsah a; tuathamlouin Mosi khu Izipt gamsunga Pharaoh suohte thei leh mite mitmu ah mithupi tah ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in “Mangpa’n tambang in agen hi, zankim vel chiengin Izipt gamsung palsuoh in ka hing pei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt gamsunga tamasapen zousie, amang touna atou Pharaoh tamasa pen akipat bu gawtguoina sumheh gei a tou suohnu ta masa pen dongin a shi ding ua, tualeh ganta pieng masa pen zousie toh zong."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt gamsung pumpi ah kale mauna huoisetah a um ding, tuabang aum khanai sih a, um zong a um kia nawn sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel hahlesuonte mawngmawng sietna ding in, mihing leh gantate tungah ui in zong alei apia sah sih ding, tuachi’n Mangpa’n Izipt mite leh Israel mite akhen tuomdan na thei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tam na suohte zousie ka kungah ahing peisuh ding ua, ka masangah a kun ding ua, pawt khie inlen nang hing zui mite zousie zong, tua zou chiengin ka pei khe ding, chiin,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Pharaoh kunga kipat lungthah sa in apawt kheta hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Izipt gam a ka sil lamdang bawlte suhpung a, aum theina dingin, Pharaoh in na thu angai khe sih ding hi,” a chi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Aaron in tamsil lamdangte zousie Pharaoh masangah abawl ua, tualeh Mangpa’n Pharaoh lungtang asuh khau pieh a, tuachi’n Israel tate agam apat apawtsah nuom tuom sih hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron Izipt gamah ahoupi a.","title":"Peikan belamnou gawna","ref":"Siempu. 23.5; Kisim. 9.1-5; 28.16; Danp. 16.1,2"},"2":{"text":"“Tu ha khu nou adingin ha simpatna ahi dinga, nou adingin kumkhat sunga hamasa pen ahi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel mipi kikhawmte zousie kungah, tuha ni sawm niin michin in apu apate uh innsuon dungzui in innkuon khat a dingin belam nou khat ala chiet ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh a innkuon uh belam nou khat thana ding khop a tawm taluo ahi u’leh, a innkuon a mitam dungzui in, a innveng naipen toh belam nou khat akikop ding ua, michin neh khop hun ding dungzui in belam nou na sim ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Na belamnou ukhu gensiet bei atal kumkhat a upa ahi dinga, na belam hon ahiei, na kelhon ahiei lah a kipat in na lakhe ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tuami ha ni sawm leh nili tan, na kem ding uhi. Tuachi’n Israel mipi kikhawmpi zousien ama ua chiet nitahlang ni dangsan hun chiengin a that ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh asisan ala ding ua, a nehna ding uh inn kot bieng khuomni te gel leh atung zawl ah na taat ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Khum zanin sa mei a emmin, tolsawlou tanghou leh ankhate toh ane ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"A siel in ne sih unlen, tui in zong huon vawt sih un, hinanleh alutang leh a keng leh asungkuo zousie toh mei in em unlen ne un."},"10":{"text":"A zing chieng tan adingin bangma val sah sih un, zingmawng chieng tan a val aum leh, mei a na haltum ding uh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tambangin na ne ding uhi; na kawng uh gahsa in, na kedap uh butsa in, tualeh na khut ua na chiengkhut uh tawisa in, kintah in na ne ding uhi, tam khu Mangpa peikan ann ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tu zan chiengin Izipt gamsung ka tuon suoh dinga Izipt gamsunga ta pieng masa pouma mi hihenlen ganta hitaleh that sieng ding ka hi ziehin, tualeh Izipt gam pasien zousie sietna dingin, thukhenna ka bawl ding, kei Mangpa ka hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n sisan khu nou adingin na umna innte uah chiemtena ahiding, tua sisan ka mu chiengin ka hing peikan ding Izipt gam ka gawt chiengin noute sumang dingin gawtna na tung uah atusih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuni khu nou a dingin thei zingna ni hivanin, na khang tan un Mangpa kunga annkuong luina niin na zang ding ua, kumtawn thugousie annkuonglui niin na mang ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.15; 34.18; Siempu. 23.6-8; Kisim. 28.17-25; Danp. 16.3-8"},"15":{"text":"Ni sagi sung tanghou tolsawlou na ne ding ua, ani masapen ni main, na innte ua kipat in tol na koimang ding uhi, aziehpen, ni masapen nia kipat a ni sagini donga, tanghou tolsaw ne pouma Israel lah a akipat satkhieh ahi ding hi.","title":"Tanghou tolsawlou pawi"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh ani masapen niin kikhopna siengthou aum dinga, tualeh ni sagi niin nou a dingin kikhopna siengthou aum kia ding hi, michin in nehletah chiloungal tua hun sungin, nna dang mawngmawng, a semsih ding hi, nehledawn vang na bawl thei ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n tanghou tolsawlou pawi ni khu na nit ding uhi. Tam ni mama a Izipt gam a kipat na mipite uh ka puidoh ahi zieh in, tami ni khu tangtawn a, na khang-thugousie ua umden dingin na nit ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ha khatna ni sawm leh nili ni nitah in, tanghou tolsawlou nane ding ua, tuami ha ma ni sawmni leh khat nitah tan dongin."},"19":{"text":"Ni sagi sung na innte ua tol akimu vawtlou ding ahi, koipou mikhuol hiin a gam sunga pieng hitaleh, tol kisaw nepouma Israel mipi kikhawmte lah apat sat khiet ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tol kisaw bangma naneh ding uh ahisih, na tenna munchin uah tol sawlou tanghou na ne ding uhi chi’n gen in” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in “Israel upate zousie ahansah a, akung uah na innkuon dungzuiun, belamnou va lakhie unlen, peikan na dingin that un.","title":"Peikan pawi masapen"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh hissop lomkhat la unlen, kuongsunga um sisan ah die unlen, tuachi’n kottung zawl leh kotbieng khuomte gel ah na taat ding uhi; zingmawng masangsie na lah ua koima a innkot pulam a a pawtlou ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Iziptte that dinga Mangpa hing peisuoh ding ahi ziehin, tuachia kottung zawl leh kotbieng a khuomte gel a, sisan amu chiengin Mangpa’n tua kot khu a peikan dinga, ahing that dingin na innsung uah sumangthaitu hing lut aphal sih ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 11.28"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh tam silte khu nou leh natate ua dingin tangtawn thugousie a na nit ding uh ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hidinga, Mangpa’n ahing chiemsa banga ahing piehding gam na tun chiengun, tamsil bawlte na bawl zom zel dinguh ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hidinga, na tate un na kung ua, tam sil kibawl bang etsahna ahiei? chia ahing doh chiengun;"},"27":{"text":"Nouten tam khu Mangpa peikan kithoina ahi, Mangpa’n Izipt mite atha laiin eihaw innte ana khawi a, Izipt gam a Israel tate innte ahing peikan hi, na chiding uhi” achi hi. Tuachi’n mipiten alu uh a kun sah ua, abeta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate apawt ta ua, Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron thu apieh bangin abawl ta uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahi a, zankhang laitah in Mangpa’n Izipt gam a pieng masa zousie leengtouna a tou Pharaoh tamasapen akipat suongkul sunga um saltangte tamasapen dongin, athatlia siengta a, gantate ta masapen zousie zong.","title":"Ta masa shina","ref":"Pawt. 4.22,23"},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n zanlai in Pharaoh leh asuohte zousie leh Izipt mite zousie athou ua, tuachi’n Izipt gamsung ah kaa leh mauna thupitah a umta hi, aziehpen mishi umlouna inn khat zong a um sih hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n azan azan in Mosi leh Aaron ahan sah a, “Thou unlen ka mite lah a kipat peikhie un, nougel leh Israeltate pawt un, tualeh na gensa bangun Mangpa va beta un.”"},"32":{"text":"Na gensa bangun, na belam honte u’leh na bawng honte u’zong zawpi unlen, pei un, tualeh kei zong hing guolzawl un achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt miten, agam ua kipata kintah a asawldoh theina dingun, anaw in anaw ta uhi, aziehpen “Shibei ding hitalou ihiei ma’h,” a chi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n miten atangbuong meh laite uh tol ahal masangun ala ua, atangbuong zoinate utoh, Puon vai a ziel in a liengkou uah a khai ta uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten Mosi gen bangin a bawl ua; Izipt mite apat dangka kizepnate sana kizepnate leh Puonsilte angen uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 3.21,22"},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n mite khu Izipt mite mitmu ah deisahna apie a, tuachi’n anget pouma uh akung uah apie uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate Rameses khuo akipat apawt ua, Sukoth atung ua, naupang simlou in pasal piching ngen nuoi guh vel keng in apei uhi.","title":"Israelten Izipt apawtsan uh"},"38":{"text":"Tualeh mipi kitohpol tampi zong amau’toh a peitou khawm ua, bawng hon leh belam hon tualeh ganta tampi zong a zawpi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt gam a kipat ahing puohdoh uh tangbuong in tolsawlou tanghou akang uhi, tolsawlou ahi zieh in, Izipt gam apat kintah a nawdoh ahi ziehun, a umsawt thei sih ua, aneh ding tah ngel u’zong abawl man ta sih uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate Izipt gam a aum sung uh, kum zali leh kum sawm thum ahi.","ref":"Siem. 15.13; Gal. 3.17"},"41":{"text":"Tualeh kum zali leh kum sawmthum beinua in hichi ahing hia, tuami ni mama in hichi ahing hi a, Mangpa mipite zousie Izipt gam a kipat apeidohta uhi."},"42":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipat a amauh ahing puidoh ziehin Mangpa adinga khum zan zatatna toh nit ding ahi. Tam Mangpa zan Israel hahlesuonten akhang akhang ua anit dinguh ahi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron kungah, “Tami Peikan pawi dan ahi, mikhuol koiman aneh lou ding ahi.","title":"Peikan pawi man danding"},"44":{"text":"Hinanleh mi’n sum a aleisa asuoh atep atan pieh nah pou leh anethei ding uhi."},"45":{"text":"Gamdang mi leh sum a ki guoi suohten anethei sihding uhi."},"46":{"text":"Innsung khat a neh ding ahia, asa them khat zong inn pulanga na tawidoh lou dinguh ahi, agu khat zong na tawnsah dinguh ahisih hi.","ref":"Kisim. 9.12; Jn. 19.36"},"47":{"text":"Israel mipi kikhawm zousien a zuidinguh ahi."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh na lah ua um gamdangmi khat in Mangpa peikan anitnuom leh Pasal zousie teptan hi henlen tuachi’n anit thei ding uhi, tuabang mite khu agam a pienga ngai ahiding uhi; hinanleh teptanlou mi’n vang aneh votlou ding ahi."},"49":{"text":"Gamsunga pieng mi leh, na lah ua teng gamdang mi adingin dan khat a um ding hi,” achi hi."},"50":{"text":"Israel tate zousien tuabangin abawl ua, Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron, thu apieh bangin abawlta uhi."},"51":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hia, tua ni mama in Mangpa’n Israel tate Izipt akipat apawl pawl in ahing puidoh ta hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupia, akungah;","title":"Ta masapen Mangpa a dia koi tuomna"},"2":{"text":"“Israel hahlesuonte lah a, ta chil naubu hong masapen pouma mihing hiin ganta hitaleh, ka kungah hing koituom un kei a ahi” chiin a gen hi.","ref":"Kisim. 3.13; Luk. 2.23"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in mite kungah, “Izipt gam a kolbun a, na saltanna inn ua kipat a, na hing pawtdoh ni uh, tuni thei zingun; Mangpa’n ban thahatna in tammun akipat noute ahing puidoh ahi, tol kisaw tanghou na neh dinguh ahisih.","title":"Tanghou tolsawlou pawi"},"4":{"text":"Abib ha, tuniin nahing pawtdoh uh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahi dinga, Mangpa’n Kanaanmite, Hitmite, Amormite, Hivmite, Jebus mite gam nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam, napu napate uh kunga kihahsiel a pieh ana chiem gam a ang puilut hun chiengin, tami ha in tami nasep na bawl ding uh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ni sagi sung tolsawlou tanghou nane ding ua, ani sagi niin Mangpa dingin pawi na bawl ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ni sagi sung tolsawlou tanghou akine dinga, na lah uah tol kisaw tanghou aumding ahi sih, na tenna mun zousie uah zong tol akimu vawt lou ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tuami ni chiengin na tapa kungah, Izipt gam akipat a ka hing pawtdoh nia Mangpa’n ka tunga asil bawlte zieha, tami kibawl ahi chiin na hil ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tami Mangpa dan na kam a aumden thei na dingin, na khutah chiemtena ahi dinga, na mitte gel kikaal ah thei zingna ahi ding hi. Mangpa’n ban thahattah toh Izipt apat ahing puidoh ziehin."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin tami thugousie kum china a hun tengin na nit dinguh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahidinga, “Mangpa’n nang leh napu napate kunga pieh dinga anachiem banga, Kanaan mite gam a ahing puilut a, tua gam ahing pieh chiengin.","title":"Tachil Mangpa ading"},"12":{"text":"Naubu hong masa pouma leh na ganta nei lah a pieng masapen zousie, Mangpa a dinga na koituom ding ahi, apate khu Mangpa a ahi ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.19,20; Luk. 2.23"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh sabiltung nou pieng masa pouma, belamnou a natat ding ahi; na tatsih ding leh a ngawng na heh tanding, tualeh na tate lah a, ta pasal pieng masa zousie na tatding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, hun hing tunga na tapa in tambang ahiei? Chia ahing doh chiengin, akungah Mangpa’n Izipt gam a ikoltanna inna Kipat in ahing puidoh ahi, na chiding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Pharaoh in ahing peisah nuomlou tahin, Mangpa’n Izipt gam a ta pieng masa zousie, mihing ta masapen leh ganta ta masapen athatgam sienga, tuaziehin naubu hong masapen apaa pouma Mangpa kunga ka piehkhiet ahi; hinanleh ka tate lah a pieng masa zousie ka tat ahi; chiin a chi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n na khut uah nou a dingin chiemtena ahi dinga; na mitte gel kikal ah tal gahna ahi ding; aziehpen khut hattahin Mangpa’n Izipt gam a kipat ahing puidoh ta hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Pharaoh in mipite a peisah bepin, Pasian in naizaw nanleh, Philistinte gamlam tawn in amauh apui sih a, a ziehpen Pasian in “Kidounate amu chiengun, kisia khava unin Izipt gamah nuakia khava uh,” achi hi.","title":"Israel taten Etham azuon uh"},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian in mipite Tuipisan gamdai lam ah apui kawizaw tahi; tuachi’n Israel tate khu Izipt akipat in ki galging sa in apeitou ta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Joseph gute khu apuo a, aziehpen Pasian in “Israel tate pellouin ahing ve ngeingei dinga tuachi’n ka gute tammun akipat na puohtou teitei dinguh ahi chin khautah in akichiem sah sa ahi.”","ref":"Siem. 50.25; Josh. 24.32"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sukoth akipat akipankhie ua, gamdai tuohchil Etham ah a gieh uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa khu sunin meilum khuom in, ama uh puidingin, tualeh zan in meikuong khuom in amaute vah pedingin amasang uah sun leh zanin a pei hi."},"22":{"text":"Mite masanga kipat in, sun a meipi khuom leh zan a meikuong khuom khu ala mang sih hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Mangpa’n Mosi a houpi a a kung ah,","title":"Tuipi san kanna"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah, kihei uhenlen Pi-hahiroth phahmasang Migdol leh Tuipi kikaal a Baalzephon gal ah giehphuol sat uhen, tuami kunga tuipi pieu ah gieh uheh chiin gen in."},"3":{"text":"Pharaoh in Israel tate tungthu ah, gamsung ah ataang ua, gamdai in a im khumta, achi ding hi.","title":"Pharaoh in Israelte anua del"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh lungtang ka khausah dinga aman Israel mite anua del ding a, tualeh Pharaoh tung leh a galkapte zousie tung ah pahtawi in ka um ding a, Izipt miten Kei Mangpa ka hi chi atheina ding un, chiin agen a,” tuachi’n amaun tuabangin abawlta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n mite ataita uh chi Izipt leengpa ahil ua; tuachi’n Pharaoh lungtang leh asuohte lungtang khu mite sietna dingin akilehei ta a, tuachi’n amauten i nna ahing seppieh na ua pat Israel tate ipeikhesah ta mawh ua, “Bangchidan a tambanga ibawl uh ata diei?” a chi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n asakollengte kimansan akoi a, mipite a zawpi ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh sakolleng teltuom zaguh leh Izipt gamsunga sakolleng zousie leh tuate zousie a, a houtute chiet utoh a pui a."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Izipt leengpa Pharaoh lungtang a khausah a, Israel tate a nua delta hi, tualeh Israel tate khu sumlepai tampi toh apawtdoh ta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt miten Pharaoh sakol leh sakolleng zousie leh sakol tuonsiem teng leh galkap teng toh anuadel ua, Baal-zephon phahmasanga, Pi-hahiroth gei a, tuipi pieu a agiehna mun uah anuaphah ta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh in ahing naitahin, Israel tate adahdoh u’leh, ngaivawi Izipt miten amauh ahing delta uhi, tuachi’n azau sengseng ua, Israel tate Mangpa kungah akapzahta uhi.","title":"Pasian tunga Israelte helna"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Mosi kungah, “Izipt gam a han aumlou zieh a gamdai a shidinga na hing puidoh ahiei mah? Bang zieh a hi chi bep dinga Izipt a kipat nang puidoh mawngmawng ahiei? achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Izipt mite nna ka sep pieh theina dingun hing umsah mai in, chia Izipt gam a na kunga kang gensa uh hilou ahiei mah? Gamdai a mawh shi sangin Izipt mite nasem uleng hoizaw mading hiven,” a chi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in mipite kungah, “Zau sih unlen ding khin-khien un, Mangpa’n tunia ahing etsah ding ahundamna khu en un: Tunia namu uh Izipt mite khu tangtawn in namu kia nawnsih ding uhi, achi hi.","title":"Tuipi luonglai akhawl"},"14":{"text":"Mangpa’n nou a dingin ahing doupieh dinga, noute lungmuong tahin um un.”"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah “Bangchidan a ka kung a kap na hiei? Israel tate kungah mailam nawin pei un chiin gen in."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh na chieng lehtou inlen, tualeh na khut tuipi tungah zah inlen tuipi kikhensah in. Tuachi’n Israel tate tuipi lai a tuol gaw ah apei ding uh."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh keiman, ngai in Izipt mite lungtang ka khausah dinga, amaute anuadel ding uhi: Tuachi’n ken Pharaoh tung leh a galkapte tung leh a sakollengte, tualeh asakol tung tuong mite tungah zatatna ka mu ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachia Pharaoh tungleh, asakollengte tungleh, a sakol tungtuong mite tunga, zatatna ka mu chiengin, Izipt miten kei Mangpa ka hi chi ahing thei ding uhi.”"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Israel mipite masang a pei, Pasian van sawlsieng khu akisuon a, anua lang uah apei a, tualeh meilum khuom khu amai lam ua kipat in akisuon a, anua lang uah ading ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Izipt galkapte leh Israel mipite kikaal ah aumta hi, tam khu ama ua dingin meilum leh miel ahing hita a, hinanleh zan in Israelte adingin vah apie a, tuachi’n khat leh khat kinai tuo thei lou in zan tungtawn in a umta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in tuipi tung ah akhut azah a, tuachi’n Mangpa’n zankhovah in, suolam hui hattah in tuipi a mut khen sah hi. Tualeh tuipi laiah gamgaw abawl a tuite akikhen ta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israeltate tuipi lai a, tuolgum ah a pei ua, tui khu a ziet lam u’leh aveilam uah ama ua dingin tuite baangin akisungta hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 10.1,2; Heb. 11.29"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt miten adel ua, Pharaoh sakolte, asakollengte, sakol tungtuong mite zousie’n tuipi sungah adel lut uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, zingmawng galven huntah in Mangpa’n meikuong leh meilum khuom apat ahing ensuh a, Izipt galkapte asubuoi ta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh asakolleng kengte uh alahkhiet pieh a, ahawl hat thei ta sih ua, tuachi’n Izipt miten “Israelte mai ah taizah maivai: Mangpa’n Israelte panpi in Izipt mite adoupieh hibou,” a chi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Izipt mite leh a sakollengte u’leh a sakol tung tuong mite uh tuiin ahing nuahup thei kia nadingin tuipi tungah na khut jahin,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in tuipi tungah a khut a zah a, zingmawng ahing hiin, tuipi aluon ngai bangin aluong kia ta hi. Tualeh Izipt mite khu tuipi lai ah anua taikia ua, Mangpa’n Izipt mite tuipi laiah apaimang ta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuite ahing luongmat kia ua, sakollengte, sakol tungtuong mite leh Pharaoh galkap, amauh hing nuadel a tuipi sunga lutte zousie atummang siengta ua, alah ua khat zong asuohta sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh tuipi lai a, tuol gum tungah Israel tate apei ua, tuite khu a zietlam u’leh aveilam uah baangin akisung uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuabangin Mangpa’n tua niin Izipt mite khuta kipat in Israelte a hundoh ta hi; tualeh Israelten tuipi pieu a Izipt mi shite a mu uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Izipt mite tunga sil thupi tah abawlte Israelten a mu ua, tuachi’n Mipiten Mangpa agiing ua, Mangpa leh asuoh Mosi agiing ta uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Israel taten, Mangpa Pahtawina’n tam la asa ua, a genkhawm va luoi uhi: “Mangpa phat in la ka sa ding, Thupitah a, a guol zaw ziehin, Sakol leh atung tuongmi khu tuipi ah, apaimang ta hi.","title":"Israelten Pasian aphat uh: Mosi la","ref":"Kihil. 15.3"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa ka hatna leh ka la ahi, Ama ka hundamna ahing hita hi. Ka Pasian ahi a, Ama ka phat ding hi, ka pa Pasian ahia, Ama ka pahtawi ding hi.","ref":"Late. 118.14; Isai. 12.2"},"3":{"text":"Mangpa khu galhatpa ahia, Amin zong Mangpa ahi,"},"4":{"text":"Pharaoh sakollengte leh, a galkap honte, Tuipi ah apaita a, a galkap lamkai teltuomte zong, Tuipi san lilai ah atumsiengta."},"5":{"text":"Tuithuh tahin atum zouta a, Tuipi thuhtah sungah suongtum bangin, atum siengta hi."},"6":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na khut zietlam khu, silbawltheina in a thupi a, Na khut zietlam in aw Mangpa, Melmate a gawt guoi ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Na hoina thupinain, nang hing dou dia thoute a zouta a, na thangpaina, na sawl khie a tuamin amauh, bu pawl bangin akatum ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Na nahkuo a huin tuite libang, aching sah hi, Tuite bangkhat chienkhawm bangin adinga; Tuipi sung gil lamah tuite, khalsah in a um hi."},"9":{"text":"Dougal pa’n sulnua zui in delpha vangin, gallah sesum tanding hawm vang; atung uah kalung deite mu vangin, ka namsau doh khe vangin, ka khut in amaute sumangthang vang, achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Na huikhi in nasem ngut a, Tuipi’n amaute puon bangin atuomta; Tuipi hattah ah ngen bangin atum uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aw Mangpa pasiente lahah, Nangma bang koi a um ei? Sienthouna a thupi, phatna a zauhuoi, sillamdang bawlna ah, Nangbang koi aum ei?"},"12":{"text":"Na khut zietlam na zandoh a, Lei in amauh avalta."},"13":{"text":"Na tatsa mite, na khotuonain na puidoh a, Na mun siengthou ah, na banhatin na pui hi."},"14":{"text":"Nam chin zatam in a za ding ua, azau ding uh, mangbatna in amanta Philistin gam a tengte."},"15":{"text":"Achija uhi Edom hausate, chitutnain amanta Moab lamkaite; zun siengta uh, Kanaan gam mite."},"16":{"text":"Zauna leh chizatna atung uah tuvanin, na ban zaitha vangletna, lumsuongpi bang a dai uh, Aw Mangpa, na mite Amuolkhup masang un, na leisa na mite, amuolkhum sieng masang un."},"17":{"text":"Hambang na huoilut ding amaute, na goutan muol ah na phut tadinga, Aw Mangpa, na umna dinga na bawl mun ah, Aw Mangpa, na khut ngel a na phudoh, mun siengthou ah."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa’n tangtawn tangtawn in vai ahawmding.”"},"19":{"text":"Pharaoh sakolte leh sakollengte tua leh, sakol tung tuong mite, tuipi sunga atum manglai un, Mangpa’n tuipi tuite a tung uah, a nua luon sah kia a, hinanleh Israel tate pen, tuipi lai a leihul tungah apei uhi.","title":"Miriamla"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron sanggamnu guolneinu, Miriam in akhut ah khuongta atawia, tualeh numei zousien amanu nuazuiin, khuongta tawi in lamkawm in ahing pawtdoh ua;"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Miriam in amauh adawnga: “Mangpa phat in la sa un, thupitah a a guolzawta ziehin, Sakol leh atung tuong mite, tuipi sungah apailutta hi.”"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Israeltate tuipi san a kipat hing puidohin, Shur gamdai ah apei ta ua; tualeh gamdai ah nithum apei ua, tui amu tasih uhi.","title":"Marah tuikha"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Marah mun ahing tun un, akhaat ziehin Marah tuite adawn thei sih ua, tuaziehin tua mun khu Marah aki chita hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite Mosi tungah aphunta ua, “Bang ahiei kadawn ding uh?” achi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi Mangpa kungah akapta a, tualeh Mangpa’n sing khat a ensah a, tua khu tuisunga a khieh leh tui khu ahing humta hi. Tua munah ama ua dingin thugousie leh danthupieh abawl pieh a, tualeh amaute a ze-et ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh “Mangpa na Pasian uh Aw, lunglut tah a na ngaikhiet ua, Amitmu a sildih na bawl ua, athupiehte na ngaisah ua, Adan thupiehte na zui u’leh, Izipt mite tunga natna-hipi ka tunsahte, na tung uah ka tungsah sih ding hi; aziehpen kei noute hing sudam Mangpa khu ka hi,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh tuitawdoh sawmleni leh tum kung sawm sagi umna Elim mun ahing tungta ua: tualeh tua mun a tuigei ah giehphuol a bawlta uhi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Elim akipat in ahing kipandoh ua, Israel mi honpi Izipt gam akipat apawtdoh nua uh aha nina, ni sawm leh ninga niin Elim leh Sinai kikaal a Sin gamdai ah ahing tungta uhi.","title":"Manna leh vamim piehna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate mipi umkhawmte, Mosi leh Aaron tungah gamdai ah aphun ta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten akung uah, “Izipt gam a sabel gei a ka toulai u’leh gilva tah a tanghou ka nehlai un Mangpa khut ah ana shi zaw tamai lei izaw, aziehpen tana mipi umkhawm zousie kiela thalup dinga gamdai a nang puidoh uh ahi” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Ngaiin nou a dingin van akipat tanghou ka hing zusah ding: tuachi’n mite apawtdoh ding ua, nichinin aneh khop ding uh a tomkhawm ding ua, amauten ka dan azui u’leh-azuilou uh ka etchien theina dingin.","ref":"Jn. 6.31"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh hi chi ahing hi dinga, a ni guh niin, atom khawmte uh abawlkhol ding ua, tua khu ni chin a atom khawm uh leni ahiding ahi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Aaron in Israel tate zousie kungah, “Nitah chiengin Mangpa’n Izipt gam a kipat ahing puidoh ahi, chi nathei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh zingmawng chiengin, Mangpa thupina na muding ua, Mangpa dem a atunga naphun nate uh azata a, kou bang ka hi ua na hing chi phunsan uh a hiei?”"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in tambang ahi ding hi, “Nitah lam chiengin Mangpa’n nehding sa ahing pe dinga, zingmawng chiengin tanghou khamtah a, nehding ahing peding hi; atunga Ama dema na phun nate uh Mangpa’n athei a; kou bang ka hi uoi? Na phun nate uh, kou gel tunga phun na hi sih ua, Mangpa tunga phun na hizaw uhi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Aaron kungah, “Israel tate umkhawmte kungah, Mangpa kung nai ah hing pei un, na phunnate uh azata, chin gen in” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh hi chi ahi a, Aaron in Israeltate umkhawmte zousie kunga thu agen lai in, gamdai lam a et uleh, ngaivawi, Mangpa thupina meilum lah ah ahing kilang ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah."},"12":{"text":"“Israeltate phunchieh nate ka zata a, akung uah nitah lam chiengin sa nane ding ua, zingmawng lam chiengin vatahin tanghou nane ding uhi; tuachi’n Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi chi nathei ding uhi, chiin gen in” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh hi chi ahing hia, nitah lamin mengkeng hon ahing leeng tou ua, giehphuol ahing tuom dim ua, zingmawngin giehphuol kim ah daitui a kia hi."},"14":{"text":"Daitui kie ahul tahin, ngaivawi, gamdai leitung pumpi ah daitui khal chie a neu bem bilbel a um a."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten amu tahun, “Bang ahiei” chi a theilou zieh un, bang ahiei chin khat leh khat akidongtuo uhi, Tuabep in Mosi in akung uah, “Tami Mangpa’n na nehding ua, a hing pieh tanghou ahi, a chi hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 10.3"},"16":{"text":"Tami Mangpa hing thupieh khu ahi, michin in na neh khop uh na tam leh tawm dungzui un, mi khat adingin omer khat tom unlen, michin in apuon inn ua umte a dingin zong tom un” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten tuabangin abawl ua, khen khatten tamdeu atom ua, khenkhatten tawm deu a tom uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachia Omer ate u’leh atom tam pa’n atang tam tuom sih a, atom tawm pan zong atawm tan tuom sih hi. Michin in akhamkhop ding chiet uh a tom uhi.","ref":"2 Kor. 8.15"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in “Koiman zingmawng tan a, na koi lou dinguh ahi,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Mosi thu asang sih ua, alah ua mi khenkhatten zingmawng dong akoi u’leh athan a, a uita hi, tuachi’n Mosi atung uah a lungthah ta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n zingmawng teng in michin in a kham khop ding chiet uh a tom ua; tualeh ni ahing sat chiengin azunmang zel hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n hi chi ahia, a ni guh niin tanghou aleni a tam a tom ua, mikhat a dingin Omer ni zel in atom ua, tualeh mipite lah a, vaihawmte zousie a hing pei ua, Mosi ahilzel uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n akung uah, “Tami ahi Mangpa’n ana gen leng zing chieng khu Mangpa khawlni siengthou khu ahi; na kan dingte uh tunin kang unlen, nahuon dingte u’zong huon unlen, aval teng zingmawng chienga dingin khet un.”","ref":"Pawt. 20.8-11"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in ahil bangin zingmawng dongin a koi ua, a ui sih a; than zong atha sih hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in “tuami khu tuni’n ne un; tuni khu Mangpa a ding khawlni ahi ziehin, tuni’n gamlah ah tanghou namu sih ding uhi, achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Niguh sung na tom ding ua, hinanleh ni sagi ni khu khawlni ahia, khumni’n bangma a umsih ding hi.”"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, ani sagi ni’n mi khenkhat atom dingin ava kuon ua, amu sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Ka thupiehte leh ka dante bang tanvei nit utlou ding nahi uoi mah?"},"29":{"text":"En un, Mangpa’n khawlni ahing pieh ziehin, a niguh niin ni ni ading tanghou ahing pie hi; michin aumna mun chiet uah um uhenlen, nisagi niin koima a umna ua pat pawtdoh sih uheh,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite ani sagi niin a khawl ta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Israel Inn kuonten tanghou min khu Manna achi ua; tuami khu Pasikhawm tang ngou bang ahia, atui dan tanghou khuoiju toh kihal bang ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 11.7,8"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in “Tam sil pen, Mangpa thupieh ahi, nakhang-nakhang ua koi dingin Omer khat dim thun un; Izipt gam a kipat a ka hing puidoh lai a, gamdai a ka hing vahna, ahi chi athei na dingun,” a chi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Aaron kungah, “Bel khat la-inlen Omer dim khat thun inlen, Mangpa masangah luikhie in, na hah nasuonte un akepden theina dingun” a chia.","ref":"Heb. 9.4"},"34":{"text":"Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin, Aaron in thuhun masang ah kepden dingin aluitou tahi."},"35":{"text":"Israel taten mihing tenna gam atun masang sie uh, kum sawmli sung Manna ane ua, Kanaan gamgi zul atun masang sie uh Manna ane uhi.","ref":"Josh. 5.12"},"36":{"text":"Omer khat khu ephah khat sesawm suo sekhat ahi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate mipi umkhawm zousie Mangpa thupieh dungzui in Sin gamdai akipat in apei ua, Rephidim munah giehphuol abawl ta uhi, tualeh tuanah mipite dawn ding tui a umta sih hi.","title":"Suongpi apat tui apawt","ref":"Kisim. 20.2-13"},"2":{"text":"Tuaziehin miten Mosi aphin ua, “Ka dawn dinguh tui hing pie’n” achi ua, tuachi’n Mosi’n akung uah, “Bang dinga kei nang phin uh ahiei? Bang dinga Mangpa ze-et nahi uoi?” a chi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite tuamun ah tuidu a dangtahin a um ua, tualeh mipite Mosi tungah aphunta ua, “Bangchidan a ka tate u’leh ka gantate uh puma dangtah a tha dinga Izipt akipat na’ng puidoh mawngmawng ahiei?” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi Mangpa kungah a kap a, “Tam mipite bang kalaw diei? Suonga hing seplia dingin akisata uhi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Israel upate khenkhat zawpi inlen, mipi masangah pei zel in, tualeh tumasanga lui na satna chieng khu na khut ah tawi inlen, pei in, achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ngaivawi khuna Horeb suongpi tungah na masang ah ka na ding dinga, tua suongpi khu na sat dinga, tuachi’n mipite dawn ding tui ahing luongdoh ding hi,” achi hi. Tualeh Mosi in Israel upate mitmu ah tua bangin abawl ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Mosi in tua mun min khu Massah leh Meribah achita hi. Israel tate a kiphin ua, “I lah uah Mangpa um ahiei umlou?” chiin Mangpa a ze-et zieh un."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amalek ahing kuon a Rephidim ah Israel ang dou ta hi.","title":"Amalek toh kidouna"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Joshua kungah “I lah a mite telkhie inlen Amalek dou dingin kuon khie in, zing chiengin ka khut a Pasian chieng tawi in muolvum ah ka hing ding ding hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in akunga agen bangin Joshua in abawla, Amalek ava douta hi. Tualeh Mosi Aaron leh Hur muolvum ah akaltou uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Mosi in akhut adop sang chiengin Israelin a zou a, a khut a ngiem sah chiengin Amalek in a zou hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Mosi khut ahing gih a tuachi’n suong ala ua, anuoi ah akoi ua, atungah a tousah uhi, tualeh Aaron leh Hur in akhut adoptou pieh ua, khat lam pang ah khat ale lampang ah khat; tuachi’n ni tum dongin akhutte pia lou in a umta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Joshua in Amalek leh a mite namsau hiem in a zouta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Tami thu theizingna dingin laibu sungah giel inlen Joshua bil ah zanonsah zel in, Amalek theizingna khu vannuoi apat phiet mang kilkel ding ka hi ziehin a chi hi.”","ref":"Danp. 25.17-19; 1 Sam. 15.2-9"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in maitam khat adaw a, amin Jehovah Nissi achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa akichiemta a, “Mangpa’n akhang akhangin Amalek mite a douding” achi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Midian gam siempu Mosi sungpa, Jethro in Pasian in Mosi leh ami Israelte dinga asil bawl zousie ana za a, tualeh Mangpa’n Israel Izipt gam a pat apuidohta chi aza hi.","title":"Jethro in Mosi avena"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi sungpa Jethro in Mosi zi Zipporah anua sawlkia zou in ahing pui a.","ref":"Pawt. 2.21,22"},"3":{"text":"Zipporah tapate ni toh, tuate lah a khat pen min Gersom ahia, azieh pen aman “Theilou gam ah mikhuol in ka va um hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.29"},"4":{"text":"Adang khat pen min Eliezer ahi, aman “Ka Pasian khu ahing panpi ahia, Pharaoh namsau apat ahing hunkhieh ziehin” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi sungpa Jethro khu, Mosi tapate leh azi toh, Pasian muol a, a giehphuol ua Mosi kungah ahing pei ua."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi kungah, “Kei na sungpa Jethro na zi leh na ta pa tegel toh na kungah ka hing pei uhi” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi a sungpa dawn dingin ava pei a, kun in chibai abuh a, atawp a, tualeh atanchin uh akidongtuo ua, apuonbuh sungah a lutta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in asungpa kungah, Israelte zieh a, Mangpa’n Pharaoh leh Izipt mite tunga, asil bawl zousie leh lampi a hamsatna atung ua hing tung zousie leh, tuate akipat Mangpa’n bangchibang a, amaute a hutkhiet zel ahiei chite zong ahil hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Jethro in Izipt mite khut a kipat ahutdoh a Israel tate tunga Mangpa’n silhoi a bawlpieh zousie ziehin akipah mama hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Jethro in “Izipt mite khut a kipat leh Pharaoh khut a kipata hing hundohpa leh Izipt mite khut nuoi akipat amipite tankhepa Mangpa’n thupha ngata hen, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuin pasien dang zousie sangin, Mangpa a thupi zaw hi chi ka thei ta, aziehpen kisatheitah a asilbawlte zousie tung ah Ama a um hi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi sungpa Jethro in halmang sillat leh kithoinate Pasian a dingin alan a, tualeh Aaron leh Israel upate zousie Pasian masangah Mosi sungpa toh nekhawm dingin ang pei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh azing ni’n hichi ahing hia, Mosi mite vaihawm dingin a tou a, tuachi’n mite zingmawnga kipat kitah dongin Mosi kung ah a ding uhi.","title":"Vaihawm ding guot na"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi sungpa’n mite kunga asilbawl zousie a muin, Mite kunga na silbawl khu bang a hiei? “Bang dinga, na tang a tou a, mite zingmawng a kipat nitah dong na kung a na dinsah ahiei?” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in asungpa kungah, “Mipite Pasian tungtang dong dinga ka kunga hing pei ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Thubuoi anei chiengun ka kungah ahing pei ua; tuachi’n ken khat leh khat kikaal thu ka khen pieh zel a, Pasian thupiehte leh adante ka na theisah zel hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi sungpa’n akungah, “Na silbawl dan ahoi sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Nang leh na kunga um, mipite kisu gimgawp ding hi uteh, tam silte nanga dingin agih taluo hi, nangma ngen in na bawl zou sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuin ka gen ngai khie in, lem hing guot pieh vang, Pasian na kungah umta hen; nang Pasian leh mipite kaal ah mite palai in pang inlen, athu buoite uh Pasian kungah na tut ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh danthupiehte leh dante ah na hil ding a, apeina lampi ding u’leh ana sepding uh na kohmu ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuathamlouin, mipite lah apat, Pasian zaumi leh mi thudih leh huoihamlou, mi kizen deu deu na teldoh dinga, tuabang mite, tul tampi tunga vaihawm ding, za tampi tunga vaihawm ding, sawm ngate tunga vaihawm ding, tualeh sawm khat tunga vaihawmtu ding bangin na koi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh tam miten bangchihlai pouin mipite vaihawm pieh uhenlen, tualeh hichi ahi ding hi, thu lien pouma nang kungah ahing tut ding ua, hinanleh thu neu zousie amauten angaituo ding uh ahi, tuachi’n nanga dingin jangkhai vanin, na puohgih ahing puohpi ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tam sil na bawl a, tualeh tuabanga Pasian in thu ahing pieh leh, khuchin napang sawt zou ding a, tualeh tam mipite zong lungdam in amun chiet uah apei ding uhi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in asungpa aw angaikhie a, agen zousie abawlta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Israelte zousie lah akipat in, mikizente atel khie a, mipite tunga lupen vaihawm abawla, tul te tunga vaihawmtu, za te tunga vaihawmtu, sawmngate tunga vaihawmtu leh sawmte tunga vaihawmtute in akoi ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun, bangchihlai pouin mipite vai ahawmpieh ua, thu hamsate Mosi kungah ahing tut ua, hinanleh thu neu deu pouma, amaun thu a kikhen ta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in a sungpa peisahin akikhenta ua, agam langzuon in apeita hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel tate Izipt akipat a apawtdoh nua uh, aha thumna khumi ni mama in Sinai gamdai ahing tung uhi.","title":"Sinai muol a Israelte hing tunna"},"2":{"text":"Rephidim a kipata pawtkhie in Sinai gamdai ahing tung ua, tuachi’n gamdai ah a puon innte uh a zah ua, tuamun tangbul ah Israelten giehphuol a satta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi Pasian kungah ahaw tou a, Mangpa’n muol a kipat in ama ahing han a, “Tambangin Jakob innkuonte kungah na gen ding a, Israel tate na hil ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Izipt mite tunga ka bawl dante na muta ua, tualeh muvanlai ha tunga ka hing puoh a, keima kunga ka hing tut dante na theita uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin ka thu na man ua, ka thuhun na zui tahtah u’leh, kei a dingin noute leitung mizousie te lah ah Gou manpha teltuom na hi ding uhi, aziehpen leitung pumpi kei a ahi.","ref":"1 Pet. 2.9; Danp. 4.20; 7.6; 14.2; 26.18; Tit. 2.14"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh noute kei a dingin, nam siengthou, lenggam siempu nahi ding uhi. Tam thute Israel tate kunga na gen ding thute ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Kihil. 1.6; 5.10"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi ahing pei a, mipite lah a upate ahan khawm a, Mangpa’n akunga apieh tam thute zousie amasang uah aluita hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite zousie’n kituohtahin adawng ua, “Mangpa’n agen zousie ka bawl ding uh achi uhi,” tuachi’n Mosi in mipite thu gente Mangpa kungah atut kia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Ngaivawi, miten na kunga thu ka gen chienga, azah theina ding u’leh, kumtawn a nang ahing gintat den theina dingun, meilum satah lah ah ka hing pei hi,” achi hi. Tualeh Mosi in mipite thu gen Mangpa kungah a hilta hi.","title":"Israelte kisuh siengna"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Mipite kungah vapei inlen tuni leh zing chiengin amaute susiengthou inlen, apuonte uh sawp uhen."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh ani thum nia dingin mansa in um uheh, ani thum niin Mangpa khu mizousie mitmu a Sinai tanga hing peisuh ding ahi zieh in."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh mite akimvel ah dai nakai pieh ding a, muol a kaltou lou ding leh muol kiim thamkha lou dingin pilvang un, koipou muol thamkhate shi ngei ngei ding ahi.","ref":"Heb. 12.18-20"},"13":{"text":"Koima khut in akhoikhah ding ahisih, tuachilouin suonga selia ahisihleh thal a kap pailet ahi ding, ganta hiin mihing hitaleh, ahing sih ding hi. Pengkul sawtpi agin chiengin, muolah ang kaltou ding uh hi,” a chi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n muol a kipat in mite kungah Mosi apei suh a, mipite asusiengthou a, tualeh amauten apuonte uh asawp uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh aman mipite kungah, “Nithum nia dingin mansa in um unlen, na zite utoh hing lumkhawm sih un,” a chi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh ni thum ni zingmawng in, hichi ahing hia, vanpi ging leh tunphe tualeh muol tungah meilum satah a hing kai a; pengkul angai a ngai ahing gingta a, tuachi’n gieh phuol a mipite zousie achitun ta uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 4.5\n        ;     \n        Danp. 4.11,12"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in gieh phuol a kipat in mipite Pasian toh kimu dingin ahing puidoh a, amaute muol nuoilang ah a ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh, Sinai muol a Mangpa khu meikuonga ahing kumsuh ziehin, muol khu meikhu’n apum tuom ta hi, tualeh amei khu haltuina meikhu bangin ajamtou a, tualeh muol pumpi nasatah in akiling hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh pengkul gin a sawt a angai semsem bepin, Mosi in thu agen a, Pasian in aw gingin adawnga."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa khu Sinai muol vum tunga kipat in ahing kumsuh a, tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi muolvum tungah ahan tou a, Mosi ava peitou hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Kumsuh inlen mipite thu hilin, tuachilouin en dingin Mangpa lam ahing phuvang kha ding ua, alah ua tampi’n amanthai law kha ding uhi, achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa kung nai a hing pei siempute zong ki susieng thou uheh tuachilouin Mangpa amaute tungah lungkimmaw khava,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Mangpa kungah “Mipite Sinai muol ah ang peitou thei sih dinguh, Muol kimvel ah dai kai inlen, susiengthou in chia nang hil zieh in” a chi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n akungah, “Pei inlen, kum suhin, tualeh Aaron toh nang hing kaltou kia un, hinanleh siempute leh mipite, Mangpa kunga hing pei dingin, hing phuvang sih uheh, tuachilouin amaute tungah Mangpa lungkim maw khava” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi mite kungah akumsuh a, mite kungah thu agenta hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n hichiin tam thute zousie agen hi.","title":"Thu sawm pieh"},"2":{"text":"“Kei Mangpa na Pasian, Izipt gam a na hentatna inn ua kipat a hing puidoh pa ka hi."},"3":{"text":"Keima loungal pasien dang mawngmawng na nei ding ahisih."},"4":{"text":"Milim khenthu ahiei, ahisihleh tunglam van a um ahiei, nuoilam lei a um ahiei, lei nuoi lam tuisung a um, sil bang ahiei kibahpi mawngmawng na siemthu lou ding uh ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.17; Siempu. 19.4; 26.1; Danp. 4.15-18; 27.15"},"5":{"text":"Amaute mai a, na kun ding uh ahi sih, tualeh a nna u’zong nasep lou ding ahi; kei Mangpa na Pasian uh, thangsetah Pasian ka hi ziehin keima hing mudate khelna, khangthum khangli tan a, pate gitlouna tate tunga phuba la zel ka hi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.6,7; Kisim. 14.18; Danp. 7.9,10"},"6":{"text":"Ahing ita ka thupiehte zui, sang tampite kunga, khotuona musah Pasian ka hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian min na mawh gen ding ahi sih, Amin mawha genmi khu gilou lou in asep sih ding hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.12"},"8":{"text":"Khawlni siengthou tah a nitding ahi, chi thei zingin.","ref":"Pawt. 16.23-30; 31.12-14"},"9":{"text":"Niguh sung na sem inlen, nasep ding zousie nasep suoh ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.12; 31.15; 34.21; 35.2; Siempu. 23.3"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh ni sagi ni khu, Mangpa na Pasian uh khawlni ahi; tami niin nna mawngmawng nasep ding ahi sih a, nangman zong, natapa in zong, natanu in zong, na suohpa in zong, na suohnu in zong, na gantatein zong, tualeh na huong sunga um mi khuol in zong."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen niguh sungin Mangpa’n lei leh van leh tuisuogiette leh a sung a um zousiete a siem a, ani sagi niin a khawlta hi. Tuaziehin Mangpa’n khawlni khu aguolzawl a, asusiengthou ta hi.","ref":"Siem. 2.1-3; Pawt. 31.17"},"12":{"text":"Nanu leh napa zatat in; Mangpa na Pasian in ahing pieh gam a na damsung nite asawt thei na dingin.","ref":"Danp. 27.16; Mat. 15.4; 19.19; Mak. 7.10; 10.19; Luk. 18.20; Eph. 6.2; Eph. 6.3"},"13":{"text":"Tuol na thading ahi sih.","ref":"Siem. 9.6; Siempu. 24.17; Mat. 5.21; 19.18; Mak. 10.19; Luk. 18.20; Rom. 13.9; Jak. 2.11"},"14":{"text":"Aang na kawm ding ahi sih.","ref":"Siempu. 20.10; Mat. 5.27; 19.18; Mak. 10.19; Luk. 18.20; Rom. 13.9; Jak. 2.11"},"15":{"text":"Na guh ding ahi sih.","ref":"Siempu. 19.11; Mat. 19.18; Mak. 10.19; Luk. 18.20; Rom. 13.9"},"16":{"text":"Na inn vengte langa techi dihlou a na panding ahi sih.","ref":"Pawt. 23.1;
