Mat. 19.18; Mak. 10.19; Luk. 18.20"},"17":{"text":"Na innvengte inn na en ding ahisih, na innvengte zi ahiei, asuohpa ahiei, asuohnu ahiei, abawngtal ahiei, a sabiltung ahiei, ahisihleh na innvengte neitah mawngmawng na en ding ahi sih,” achi hi.","ref":"Rom. 7.7; 13.9"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh mipite zousie in, vanpi gingte, tunphete, pengkul gingte, tualeh muol meikhu in apumtuom, amutahun, akinua tawn ua, gamlapi ah ading uhi.","title":"Israel mipite zauna","ref":"Heb. 12.18,19"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi kungah, “Nangman ka kung uah thugen inlen ka ngaikhe dinguh, hinanleh Pasian in vang ka kung uah thu genda mai heh, ka shi kha ding uh,” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in mipite kungah, “Zau sih un, Ama zauna na masang ua a um a, na khellouna ding un, Pasian noute hing en chien dinga hing pei ahi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite gamlapi ah a ding ua, Mosi in Pasian umna miel keikui lam a zuon hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Israel tate kungah tambang in thu va genin, Nouma ngel in van a kipat a ka thugen na zata uhi.","title":"Maitam siem dan ding"},"23":{"text":"Kei chilou pasien dang mawng mawng dangka asiem pasiente ahiei, sana asiem pasiente ahiei, nou adingin na siem dinguh ahi sih."},"24":{"text":"Kei a dingin lei ah maitam na bawl ding a, atungah na belamte, leh na bawngtalte, halmang kithoina leh kilemna kithoinate in na lan ding hi; ka min chiemtena dinga ka bawl na mun zousie ah, na kung uah kang pei dinga, ka hing guolzawl ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Suong maitam nang bawlpieh ding leh, suong kikheng a, na bawllou ding ahi: Suong tunga na hiemzah nalap leh na bua sah zou ahita hi.","ref":"Danp. 27.5-7; Josh. 8.31"},"26":{"text":"Ka maitam kaltouna kalbite a, na kaltou vawt louding ahi,” na saguoh hina adawh louna dingin."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tuin tamte khu ahi, akung ua na theisah ding vaihawmna dante khu.","title":"Suoh te kep dan ding"},"2":{"text":"Hebrumi suoh a, nalei leh, kum guhsung na nna asem dinga, kum sagi na ah bangma a tatlou in vaiveng tah a, apawt khiet ding ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 25.39-46"},"3":{"text":"Ama tanga hing lut ahileh amatang main apawt kia maiding ahi, zi nei ahileh azi zong ama toh a pawt khawm ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Apuin zi ana guona, tapate ahiei, tanute ahiei, azi in ana neipieh leh azi leh atate a pu a ahi ding ua, amatang a pawt ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh a suohpa’n, kichientah a, kapu ka it a, ka zi leh ka tate ka it a, zalen in ka pawt khesih ding achileh;"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n apu in vaihawmte masangah amapa ahing pui ding a, kotlam dong ahiei, kot khuom bul ahiei ah ahing pui dinga, tualeh apu in bil vu nain abil a vu vangpieh dinga; tuachi’n kumtawn in ana asem tading hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh mi’n atanu suohnumei dinga, a zua leh amanu khu suoh pasalte bangin apawt sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Apuin azi dingin na khamta henlen, ama nu’n apu sulungkim tasih leh, akitatsah ding ahi, ana solbawl tah ziehin, nam dangte kunga zua kia theina anei sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh atapa zi dinga akhampieh ahilehvang atanute abawldan banga abawl ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aman zidang nei kia nanleh zong, nehletah silleten leh azi ahinate akiemsah tuomlou ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tam sil thumte abawlpieh sihleh, sum pelou in zalentah in apawt khethei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Koipou in mi avuoh a, ashi tahleh, tuamipa khu tha teitei ding ahi.","title":"Kivuoh lia tung tang thu","ref":"Siempu. 24.17"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh min atup mawng hilou, Pasian laitan ahile-vang atailutna ding mun ka hing guot pieh ding hi.","ref":"Kisim. 35.10-34; Danp. 19.1-13; Josh. 20.1-9"},"14":{"text":"Hinanlezong mi’n tupna nei a, pilkheltah a zebawl a, a innveng tha atup leh ashi na dingin ka maitam apat na kaipawt ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi koi zong apa ahiei, anu ahiei vaw pouma, a shi ngeingei ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh mi koizong mihing gu a zua ahiei, ahisihleh akeplai akhut a akimu leh, tha ngeingei ding ahi.","ref":"Danp. 24.7"},"17":{"text":"Koizong anu ahiei, apa ahiei hamsie lawte khu tha ding ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 20.9; Mat. 15.4; Mak. 7.10"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh mi kihau uhenlen khat in khatpen suongtum ahiei ahisihleh khuttum ahiei in su henlen shi lou in lupna ngah in umta leh."},"19":{"text":"Hing thou kia theiin, chiengkhut khun a kholai avah thei leh, avawpa a siengding hi: ahun suhbei man alieu ding a, adamsieng sah ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh mikhat in asuohpa ahiei, asuohnu ahiei, chiengin sat henlen, akhutlum a ashi leh, tuamipa gawt ngeingei ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanlezong ni khat ahiei, ni ni ahiei adam le-vang gawt lou ding ahi, aziehpen ama nei le lam ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mite akihau ua, numei nauvop lai asuh khah ua, anau atol leh anualam a sietna bangma in azui sih nahleh; anumeinu Pasal in atunga anget bang banga lieusah ding ahi, hinanleh vaihawmten alep dungzui a lieu sah ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh sietna dang mawngmawngin azui khah leh hinna tanga hinna, na pieh ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Mit taanga mit, ha taanga ha, khut taanga khut, keng taanga keng.","ref":"Siempu. 24.19,20; Danp. 19.21; Mat. 5.38"},"25":{"text":"Meia hal tanga mei a hal, liem tanga liem, vuoh tanga vuoh."},"26":{"text":"Mikhat in asuohpa ahiei, asuohnu ahiei mit suh pieh in setaleh, amit ziehin ama zalenin apei sah ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh mi’n asuohpa ahiei, asuohnu ahiei ha asuh kieh sahleh, a ha ziehin ama zalen in apeisah ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Bawngtal in Pasal ahiei, numei ahiei, a suhlialeh tua bawngtal khu suonga selia ngeingei ding ahia, asa neh vawtlou ding ahi. Hinanleh bawngtal neipa tung thu asieng ding hi.","title":"Nei le lam tunga dante"},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh bawngtal khu tumasanglam a zong mi nasu ngai sa, tualeh a pupa kunga zong, na kihil zel ahi a, hinanleh abawngtal a khum nuom lou ziehin Pasal ahiei numei ahiei na sulia taleh, bawngtal suonga selia ding ahia, aneipa zong shisah ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"A tung a dangka sum pieh phut ahileh, ahinna tatna dingin akiphut za za apieh ding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Mi tapa ahiei tanu ahiei a suh lia leh zong tam vaihawmna dan dungzui a, atunga kibawl ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Bawngtal in suohpa ahiei suohnu ahiei, asuhlia leh bawngtal neipa’n, apu uh kungah dangka shekel sawm thum ape dinga, bawngtalpen suonga selia ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Mi khat in leikhuh vua-kia loua anua sie ahiei, ahisihleh leikhuh tou a, sinlou a akoi zieh a bawngtal ahiei sabiltung ahiei, tua leikhuh sunga akieh leh;"},"34":{"text":"Tua leikhuh neipa’n ganta man asan ding ahi; ganta neipa sum ape dinga, tuachi’n ganta shisa khu aman atang ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Mi khat bawngtal in midang bawngtal asuh liem a ahileh, abawngtal hing nalai pen a zua ding ua, a sum akihawm ding ua, tualeh bawngtal shi pen asa aki-hawm ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ahisihleh, tua bawngtal in tumalam a zong ganta na su zel zel sa ahi chi akitheidoh a, anei pan akhum utlou ahileh, bawngtal tangin bawngtal ma ape dinga, ashi pen aman atang ding hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi khat in bawngtal ahiei, belam ahiei, aguh a atha ahiei, ahisihleh azualeh, bawngtal khat tangin bawngtal nga tualeh belam khat tangin belam li, apieh ding ahi.","title":"Thubuoi tuomtuomte"},"2":{"text":"Guta khat in mi inn abulu a, ana kivuoh a, ashi leh, ama ziehin sisan akisuo sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ni’in asuoh khum manleh amazieh in sisan suo ahi dinga, aguhteng zong kimtahin apekia ding hi, pieh ding anei sih leh, aguhtat ziehin ama akizua ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A sil guhte bawngtal ahiei, sabiltung ahiei, ahisihleh belam ahiei hitaleh ahinga ama khuta akimu doh leh ale-ni in asang ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi khat in midang khat loulai ahiei, grep huon ahiei a, a ganta athangtatsah a, a nehtum sah taleh; ama lou hoipen leh agrephuon hoipen a adit ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Mei ahing kah a, ling-lomte ahing pe a, buphaite ahiei, bukung dinglaite ahiei, ahisihleh aloulai pumpi akah tumtah leh; tua mei halpan akatum zousie aun in a dit ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Mikhat in a innvengpa kungah, sum ahiei, avante ahiei kepsah dinga apieh a, tua vante akep sahpa innsunga pat akiguh manga, agupa akimat leh aleni in adin ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Agutapa akimatdoh lou leh, a inn neipa’n a innvengpa neitah tungah akhut aha kha eimah chithei chienna dingin, vaihawmte masangah ahing pui ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Suhkhelna pouma, bawngtal thu ahiei, sabiltung thu ahiei, belam thu ahiei, puon sil thu ahiei, van mang khat poupou tungtang thu mawngmawng ah mi dangin kei a ahi achileh, alang ni un vaihawmte mai ah athu uh tut hivan, vaihawmten a mawpai pen pen in a innvengpa aleni in a din ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi khat in a innvengpa kunga, sabiltung ahiei, bawngtal ahiei, belam ahiei, ahisihleh ganta khat poupou, kemsah ta henlen, koima theilou in ashi ahiei, aliem ahiei, ahisihleh na kikaimang taleh;"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n a innvengpa neitah akhoi khahleh khoi khahlou thu ah ani ua kikaal ah Mangpa min in kichiemna bawlva un, tuachi’n aneipa’n, tuami pom vanin, adin sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh ama apat a kigu ahileh, aneipa kunga adit ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Sapi in ape a ana malnen tahlevang adihna chi theichetna dingin a them khat ahing tawi dinga, tuachi’n malnen a umpen adin sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Min a innvengpa ganta akawm a, aneipa umlou kaal a aliem a, ahisihleh, ashi tahleh pellou a a dit ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh aneipa akunga aumleh adin sih ding hi, man nei a kawm ahileh akikawm dandan thu uh ahiding."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Pasal in, nungah koimatoh kikham nailou, azawla aluppileh, akitenpi teitei ding ahi.","title":"Tawndan kilawm leh kithoi dan","ref":"Danp. 22.28,29"},"17":{"text":"Nu ngahnu pa’n azi dinga apieh ut vawt sih leh nungah siengthoute man ngainaza sum apieh ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Dawi thusiem numei mawngmawng na hinkhawi lou ding ahi.","ref":"Danp. 18.10,11"},"19":{"text":"Koipou ganta toh lumkhawm pouma tha teitei ding ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.23; 20.15,16; Danp. 27.21"},"20":{"text":"Koipou Mangpa kung chilou, pasien dang kunga kithoina bawl pouma suhmangthang ding ahi.","ref":"Danp. 17.2-7"},"21":{"text":"Gamdang mite na suhbuoi ding ahi sih a, na bawlsiet ding zong ahisih hi; nouzong Izipt gam ah gamdang mi nana hitah ziehun.","ref":"Pawt. 23.9; Siempu. 19.33,34; Danp. 24.17,18; 27.19"},"22":{"text":"Meithai ahiei, naupang pa neilou ahiei na bawl genthei dinguh ahi sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute na bawl genthei ua, ka kunga kap kawma ang hat u’leh, ang hatna aw uh kana ngaikhe ngeingei ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka thangpaina a sou phut khadinga namsau in nou ka hing that kha dinga, tuachi’n na zite uh meithai ahi ding ua, na tate uh Pa neilou ahi ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Na kung ua um ka mi gentheite, koipou sum na palahsah u’leh, sumpung hawmte banga na bawllou ding uh ahi; tualeh sumpung zong na lah lou ding ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 25.35-38; Danp. 15.7-11; 23.19,20"},"26":{"text":"Na innvengte puonsil, lieukham dinga na lah leh, nitum masang ngei a na pieh ding ahi.","ref":"Danp. 24.10-13"},"27":{"text":"Tuami apuonsil neisun ahia, atahsavun tuomlum ding, puonsil ahi thuoi a, bang silin a imu ta diei? Tualeh hichi ahing hiding hi, kap kawma ang hat chiengin kaza ding hi, hepisiem ka hi ziehin."},"28":{"text":"Pasian na housiet ding ahisih a, na mite lah a vaihawmte zong na samsiet ding ahisih hi.","ref":"Nasep. 23.5"},"29":{"text":"Na thei min masapen leh na zukai masapen lat ding kiheh sinlen, na tapate lah a pieng masapen kei nang pieh ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachimabanga na bawngtalte leh na belamte zong na bawl ding ahi; ni sagi sung api toh um van in; ani giet ni chienga nang pieh ding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh kei a dingin misiengthou na hiding uh ahi, gamlah a gamsa in athasa mawngmawng na neh ding uh ahi sih, uite kunga na pai dinguh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 17.15"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Thuthang dihlou na gen sawn ding ahisih a, theipi dihlou hidingin mi giloute toh kikhutzop sin.","title":"Lang neilou a thukhenna dih","ref":"Pawt. 20.16; Siempu. 19.11,12; Danp. 5.20"},"2":{"text":"Sil gilou bawl dingin, mipite na zui ding ahi sih a, thutanna heikawina dingin, mipi atam zote lam a pangin, thubuoiah thu na gen ding ahi sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Migenthei zong athubuoi ah, na panpi tuom ding ahisih hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.15"},"4":{"text":"Na melmapa bawngtal ahiei, sabiltung ahiei, vahmang na mu leh akunga nang nuakai teitei ding ahi.","ref":"Danp. 22.1-4"},"5":{"text":"Nangma hing mudapa sabiltung avan gih puohin anetden namu leh, panpi nuomna lungsim neisih nanlachin zong, na panpi teitei ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Na migenthei khu athubuoi ah dihlou tah a thukhenna na bawlpieh ding ahisih hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.15; Danp. 16.19"},"7":{"text":"Thudihlou apat kikoi gamla inlen, mawna neilou leh midihtat that sin, migilou siem ka tangsah sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh golguhna kichi mawngmawng na lah ding ahi sih, aziehpen golguhna in vaihawmte mit amiel sah a, midihtat thugen aheikawi hi."},"9":{"text":"Gamdang mi na bawlsiet ding ahisih a, noute zong Izipt gamah, gamdang mi nana hitah ziahun, gamdang mi lungsim na thei uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 22.21; Siempu. 19.33,34; Danp. 24.17,18; 27.19"},"10":{"text":"Kum guh sung na gam ah, haichi na tudinga, tualeh haichi gate nala khawm ding hi.","title":"Khawl kum leh","ref":"Siempu. 25.1-7"},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh akum sagina kum in vang, na khawl sah dinga, na um sah khin khian ding ahi, tuachi’n na mite lah a gentheiten ane ding uhi. Tuamabangin na grephuon leh na Olive huon tunga zong na bawl ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ni guh sung nna nasep ding ahia, ni sagi nia na khawl ding ahi, tuachi’n na bawngtal leh na sabiltung a khawl theina ding leh na suoh nu tapate leh na gamdang mite zong akisuhhal theina ding un.","ref":"Pawt. 20.9-11; 31.15; 34.21; 35.2; Siempu. 23.3; Danp. 5.13,14"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n na kung ua, kagen zousie ngaisah unlen: pasien dangte min mawngmawng lou kha sih unlen, nakam sung ua kipat in zong kiza sah sih un."},"14":{"text":"Kum khat sungin, kei a dingin pawi thumvei na bawl ding u hi.","title":"Pawi thupi thum"},"15":{"text":"Tanghou tolsawlou Pawi na bawl dinga, (thu kahing pieh tah bangin ni sagi sung tanghou tolsawlou Abib ha a, hun kiguot ah na neh ding ahi; Izipt gam a kipat na hing pawtdoh u’khu tuami ha a ahiziehin tualeh ka masangah khut guoh in koima ahing kilah lou ding ahi.)","ref":"Pawt. 12.14-20; Siempu. 23.6-8; Kisim. 28.17-25"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh lou a na tu, na sepgimna ga masa pente, bulah pawi na bawl ding ahi; tualeh kumtawp chieng a, na bulahte inn a na hing khum zou chiengin pawltah pawi na bawl ding hi.","ref":"Siempu. 23.15-21; Kisim. 28.26-31; Siempu. 23.39-43"},"17":{"text":"Pasal zousie kum khat in thumvei Mangpa Pasian masanga ahing kilaah ding uh ahi."},"18":{"text":"Kei a dinga kithoina sisan leh tanghou tol kisaw na lat khawm lou ding ahi, ka kithoina sathau zong zingmawng tan a um ding ahisih."},"19":{"text":"Na gam a haitha ga masapente Mangpa Pasian inn a na hing tawilut ding ahi. Kelnou sa api nawitui a na huon ding ahi sih hi.","ref":"Danp. 26.2; Pawt. 34.26; Danp. 14.21"},"20":{"text":"Ngaivawi lampi a nang hing veng ding leh, ka mun bawlsa a nangma hing tut dingin, na masangah van sawlsieng ka hing sawl hi.","title":"Israelte puidinga vansawlsieng kisawlna"},"21":{"text":"Ama thu pilvang tahin ngaisah unlen, athu ngaikhie unlen suthangpai sih un, azieh pen na khelnate uh ahing ngaidam sih ding hi, ka min ama ah a um ngal a."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama aw na ngaikhiet a, ka thugen zousie na bawl leh, na melmate tungah melma ka hi dinga, nang hing doute ka dou ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Ka vansawlsieng na masangah apei zelding a, Amormite, Hitmite, Perizmite, Kanaanmite, Hivmite leh Jebusmite umna ah ahing puiding, tualeh amaute ka sumang ding hi."},"24":{"text":"A pasien te uh masangah kun sih unlen zong besih unlen, amauh bawldan in zong bawl sih un, hinanleh amaute na suchimit ding ua, amilimte u’leh akhuom siengthoute uh na satguoi ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa na Pasian nna nasem ding ua, tuachi’n aman naneh nadawn uh hing guolzawl van in, tualeh nalah ua kipat natna hii ka lamang ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Na gam sung uah, nau sietna leh chiing mawngmawng a um sih ding; na damsung nite ka hing suhbuching pieh ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka giin huoina na masangah ka sawl ding a, na peina dinguh gam a mipite zousie ka subuoi dinga, tuachi’n na melmate un kang nuangatsah ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh na masang uah tunpite sawlvangin; tuamin Hivmite, Kanaanmite leh Hitmite khu na masang ua kipat kadel mangsah ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Kum khat sungin amau’te na masang ua kipat, ka notmang sih ding hi, tuachilouin gam hing kieu gawp vanin, na sietna dingun gamsate hing pung kha va uh."},"30":{"text":"Na hing pun ua, gam na hing luodim masang sie un, tawm nou nou in na masang uapat in ka delmang ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh na gamgi dingun, Tuipi san apat Philistinte tuipi dongin, tualeh gamdai akipat luipi dong, hing bawlpieh vangin, aziehpen agam a tengte na khut uah ka hing pe dinga, tuachi’n amaute na delmang ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Amaute leh a pasiente utoh thuhun na bawl dinguh ahi sih."},"33":{"text":"Amaute na gamsunga aten dinguh ahi sih a, tuachilou in, ka tungah tatsietna ahing bawlsah khading uhi, a pasiente uh nna nasep khahlaizang u’leh nou a dingin thang ahi ding hi.”"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman Mosi kungah, “Nang toh Aaron toh Nadab toh Abihu, tualeh Israel upate sawmsagi toh, Mangpa kungah hing kaltou unlen; gamla tah a dingin hing bie un.","title":"Thuhun sisan a suhdet ahi"},"2":{"text":"Mosi maimai Mangpa kunga ahing pei ding ahi, hinanleh amaute’n ahing naithei louding uh ahi; mipite zong amatoh apeitou lou dinguh ahi.”"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi ahing pei a, Mangpa thu zousie leh thu khen vaihawmna zousie mipite kungah, a hil a, tuachi’n mipite zousien, aw kituohtahin a dawng ua, “Mangpa’n a gen zousie kabawl ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Mangpa thugen zousie agiel a, zingmawng matahin athou a, muol bulah maitam abawl a; Israel nam sawm leh nite dungzui in, suong khuom sawmleni aphut hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh aman Mangpa kunga bawngtal a, halmang sillat leh lemna sillat kithoi dingin Israel mipite lah a tangvalte asawlta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in sisan kimkhat ala a, maitam tungah athe hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n thuhunna laibu ala a, mipite zahin asim hi, tualeh “Mangpa gen zousie bawlva ungin athu ka mang ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in sisan ala a, mipite tungah athe a, tualeh “Ngaivawi, Mangpa’n tam thute zousie tungtang thu ah noutoh athuhun abawlna sisan khu ahi.”","ref":"Mat. 26.28; Mak. 14.24; Luk. 22.20; 1 Kor. 11.25; Heb. 10.29; Heb. 9.19,20"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi toh Aaron, Nadab leh Abihu, tualeh Israel upate sawm sagite toh akaltouta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh amaute’n Israelte Pasian amu ua, akeng nuoiah Saphire suonga kibawl hile kilawm, asien dan van sieng kilkel bangmai a um hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in Israeltate upate tungah akhut aha sih a, amauten zong Pasian amu ua, ane un adawn uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Muol tunga ka kungah hing kaltou inlen, khunah umin, tuachi’n mipite na hil dingin, suong peh a, dan leh thupieh ka gelte ka hingpe ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Mosi Sinai muol a akaltouna"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi leh anasempa Joshua a dingdoh ua, tuachi’n Mosi Pasian muol ah akaltou tahi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh aman upate kungah, “Na kung ua ka hing kile kia masangsie, tanah hing na ngah un, Aaron leh Hur toh umkhawm ding nahi uhi; mi koi inzong thubuoi bang ahiei na nei u’leh, akung uah na pei zel ding uhi.”"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi muol tungah ava kaltou a, meilum in muol atuom ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thupina khu Sinai muol ah a um denta a, meilum in ni guhsung atuomkhuma; ani sagi niin meilum lah a kipat Mosi a han a."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Israeltate mitmu a Mangpa thupina kilatdan khu muol tunga sil katumthei meikuong bang mai ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi meipi lahah avalut a, muoltungah a kaltou ta hi; tuachi’n Mosi khu muol vum ah sun sawmli leh zan sawmli ava um ta hi.","ref":"Danp. 9.9"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah.","title":"Biehbuh adinga sillat"},"2":{"text":"Israeltate kungah gen in, “Kei a dingin sillat hing tawikhawm uheh: michin alung tanga kiphaltah a pe poumate akipat, kei a dinga sillat dingin na la ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ama ua kipat a sillat na lah dingte khu tamte ahi; sanate, dangkate, sum engte;"},"4":{"text":"Vau zam engdumte, sandupte, sandangte, vau-malngatte, kelmulte;"},"5":{"text":"Belamtal vun bum-sante, saham vunte, gichil singte;"},"6":{"text":"Meivah a zahding thautuite, kinu ding thaunamtui leh hal ding sil gimnamtui tah toh;"},"7":{"text":"Siempu puon leh a awm tuomna a zedingin Onix suong leh suongte toh;"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh mun siengthou hing bawlpieh uheh, alah ua ka ten theina dingin."},"9":{"text":"Biehinn lim leh a sunga vanzah ding zousie, lim ka hing etsahte bangbang a na bawl ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh gichil singin bawm khat a bawl ding ua, adunglam tongni leh akim ahi dinga availam tong khat leh a kim, tualeh asanlam tongkhat leh akim ahi ding hi.","title":"Thuhun bawm leh hepina toupha"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Sanatui in na luonkhum dinga, asunglam leh apulam na luonkhum ding ahi, tualeh atung kimvel sana lal lukhu in na zem ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh tuami adingin sana taukuol li na sung dinga, tua aning lite ah nabul ding hi. Taukuol ni apang lang khat ah, taukuol ni apang lelam ah a um ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh gichil sing zawl ni na bawl dinga, sana tui naluon khum dinga,"},"14":{"text":"Tua zawlte khu bawm panga tau kuolte ah na thun ding hi, tua zawlte a bawm akizawn thei na dingin."},"15":{"text":"Jawlte khu bawm panga kikhai taukuolte sungah a um den dinga, tuana pat lahdoh louding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh bawmsungah theisahna ka hing pieh ding khu na koiding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh sana chiim in Hepina toupha na bawl dinga, a sandan tong nileh akim, availam tong khat leh akim ahi ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 9.5"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Sana in Cherubim ni na bawl dinga, Hepina toupha mong lamte gel a seh toh na khet lut thaw ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Cherub khat among lang khat ah bawl inlen, Cherub dang khat pen among lelam ah na bawl ding hi. Hepina toupha mongte gel ah Cherubimte nabawl ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Cherubimten hepina toupha khu in ahate uh tunglam ah azah ding ua; akimaituo ding uhi, Cherubimten hepina toupha lam angat dinguh ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hepina toupha khu bawm tungah na koiding a, tualeh bawm sungah ka hing pieh ding Techi panna na koi ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tuamun ah ka hing kimupi dinga, Techipanna bawm tunga um Cherubimte gel kikal a hepina toupha tunglam akipat in, Israel tate kunga thupieh ka hing piehding sil zousie tungtangah nangma ka hing houpi zel ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh gichilsingin dawkang na bawl dinga adunglam tong ni ahi dinga, availam tongkhat ahi dinga, tualeh asanlam tong khat leh akim ahi ding hi.","title":"Tanghou koina dawkang"},"24":{"text":"Tua dawkang khu sana siengset in na luonkhum dinga akimvelah sana lallukhu na bawl ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh khutpeh chie a lien in, akimvelah atemna na bawl dinga, atemna kimvel ah sana lallukhu a na zep ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh tami dingin, sana taukuol li na bawl dinga, tua taukuol lite khu, aning lite a um akeng lite ah na bul ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh dawkang zawnna ding chiengzawlte khillutna dingin taukuolte khu a geiah a um ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh zawlte khu gichil singin nabawl ding a, sanatui na luonkhum ding ahi; dawkang zawnna dinga akinei theina dingin."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh tuana dingin kuongte, hengte, haite leh asinte, abuohkhiehnadingin, noute na bawl ding ahi, tuate sanatui siengset a na luonkhum ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh dawkan tungah, ka masangah tanghousie na koi zing ding ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 24.5-8"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh sana siengset a kibawl thaumei khuom khat na bawl ding ahi. Thaumei tunna khuom leh a bate sehneu a khentuohsa ahi ding hi, apah mumte, amengdohte, apahpalte toh sakhat, akungpi toh kimat chiet ding ahi.","title":"Sana thaumei khuom"},"32":{"text":"Thaumei tunna pangtuoh ah aba guh ahing mengkhe dinga, thaumei khuompang lang khat ah ba thum, tualeh thaumei khuom lelam pangah ba thum ma ahing mengkhe ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Aba khatah Makha ga banga kibawl, nou thum leh apah mum leh, apahpal toh a um dinga tuabangma in aba lelam ah makha ga banga bawl nouthum apah mum leh, apahpal toh a um ding ahi; tuabangin thaumei tunna ba guhte na bawl ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n thaumei tunna kungpi ah makha ga bang a abaw nou li, apah mum toh apahpal toh a um ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh thaumei tunna akipata hing kadoh ba guhte dungzui in aba nite nuoi ah pah-mum khat a um dinga, tuatoh kizopin abate ni nuoi ah pah-mum ni a um ding hi, tualeh tuatoh kizopin aba nite nuoi ah pah-mum khat a um ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Apah mumte leh abate khu akungpi toh sakhat a kizop chiet ahi ding uhi: A unpi’n sana siengset a kikhen thaw a kibawl ahi ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh tuana detding thaumei sagi na bawl dinga, tuathaumeite khu detsa in atunna ah na tung ding hi; amazawn chiet uh atanvah theina ding un."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh meitena taitete leh meivam luohna kuongte zong sana siengset a bawl ahi ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuana vanzah um leh bel zousie sana siengset talent khat zang a na bawl ding ahi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh muoltunga alim ka hing etsah bang ngei a, na bawl ding ahi chi theizing in, achi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.44; Heb. 8.5"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuabanah, biehbuh puonzah sawm neiin na bawl ding ahi; tangching puon kopta a kigan, adum, asan-au leh asandupte, Cherubte lim tuong siemtah a kigan in na bawl ding ahi.","title":"Pasian tenna biehbuh"},"2":{"text":"Puonzah khat saudan tong sawmni leh giet ahi dinga, tualeh puonzah khat letdan tong li ahi ding a, Puonzah zousie aki kim chiet ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Puonzah ngate, khat leh khat aki thuop khawm chiet ding ahia, tualeh adang ngate zong a kithuop chiet ding uh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh akimat tuona apat in puonzah mong gei guolah adumin abil na bawl dinga, tuachimabangin Puonzah dang mong gei-guol zong mattuona ni a nabawl ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Puonzah khat ah abil sawmnga na bawl dinga, anina kimattuona a puonzah mongah zong abil sawmnga ma na bawl ding hi; abilte khat leh khat akimat chiet theina dingun."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh sana mehkil sawmnga na bawl dinga, tua mehkilten puonzah mongte atutuo dinga; tuakhu bieh-buh khat ahing hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh tung khuna dingin kelmul puonzah na bawl ding a; puonzah sawm leh khat na bawl ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Puonzah khat sandan tong sawmthum ahi dinga, Puonzah khat letdan tong li ahi ding; Puonzah sawm leh khatte akikim chiet ding ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh puonzah ngate atuom chiet in na khuikhawm dinga, puonzah guhte zong atuom chiet in na khui khawm ding hi; Puonzah guhna khu biehbuh mai ah na hip ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Puonzah khuikhawm masa mong gei guol ageita pen ah, abil sawmnga na bawl ding a, puonzah khuikhawm langkhat mongah zong abil sawmnga ma na bawl ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh sum-eng in mehkil sawmnga, na bawl dinga, tua mehkilte khu abilte ah na vaw dinga, puon inn khu khat ahi theina dingin na kilkhawm chiet ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh puon inn puonzah val nalaite, akimkhat um nalaite, biehbuh nualangah na khai-khe ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Biehbuh puonzah adunglam a, a gei langkhat tuoh a, tongkhat tuoh valte khu, tamlang pang leh khumlang pang khukhumding in akaikhe ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh puonbuh khuna dingin belamtal vun kibum san na bawl dinga, atung sawn khuna dingin saham vunte na bawl ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh adingin gichil singpeh lepkhawmsa tun dingin na bawl ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Singpeh khat sandan tong sawm ahi dinga singpeh khat vailam tongkhat leh akim ahiding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh singpeh khat ah kimattuona ni a um dinga; tuachi’n singpeh kilemtuote akiman tuoding uhi; tuachibangin biehbuh singpeh zousie na bawl ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh a dingin singpeh sawmni simlam pangah, simlam ngain na bawl ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Singpeh sawmni nuoiah, dangkasia in khuom ngahna ding khuohkuoh sawmli na bawl ding hi, akimatna nite adingin, singpeh khat nuoi ah akingahna khuohkuoh ni, tualeh sing peh dang nuoi ah akimatna nite a dingin akingahna khuohkuoh ni ma na bawl ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Biehbuh pang nina mallam pangah singpeh sawmni a um ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh a dangka-sia kingahna khuoh kuoh sawmlite singpeh khat nuoiah, kingahna khuohkuoh ni, singpeh dang khat nuoiah kingahna khuohkuoh ni ma a um ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh pangte tumlam a dingin singpeh guh bawl in."},"23":{"text":"Apang ni-ah biehbuh ningte adingin singpeh ni na bawl ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n a nuoi lam ah tuate khu akibulkhawm dinga; atunglam ah sia-kuol toh akibulkhawm ding hi; tuachibangin ani tuoh ua a kizopmat ding uh ahi; tualeh tamte gel khu aning gel a pang tuoh ding ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n singpeh giet ahidinga, tualeh adangka kingahna khuohkuohte uh kingahna sawm leh guhte; singpeh khat nuoi ah khuohkuoh ni, singpeh dang khat nuoiah khuokuoh ni a um ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh gichilsing zawl na bawl dinga, biehbuh pang langkhat a dingin zawl nga."},"27":{"text":"Biehbuh lelampang a dingin zawl nga tualeh biehbuh tumlam sih nite a dingin zawl nga ma na bawl ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n, sing pehte laikim taha sing zawl kihung laita penin among khat apat among lang khattan a phah ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh singpehte khu sanatui a na luonkhum ding ahi, tuate tholna dingin sana taukuol na bawl dinga, tualeh azawlte sanatui a na luonkhum ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n muoltunga alim hing ki-ensah dungzui in, biehbuh na tungding ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh puonzah ding Puondum, Puonsandup leh san-au in Puonmalngat kopta a, khutsiem taha Cherubim lim tuonga kigan, na bawl ding hi.","title":"Biehbuh sunga zahding puon"},"32":{"text":"Tuami khu sanatui a kiluonkhum gichilsing khuom lite tungah nazah dinga, akibaatna bilte sana a bawl ahi dinga, dangkasia khuohkuoh tunga kiphut ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh techipanna bawm puonzah sunglam a, na hing puohlut theina dingin puonzah khu mehkil a kil in na khai ding ahi; tuachi’n tua Puonzah in mun siengthou leh mun siengthoupen kikaal akhen ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 6.19; 9.3-5"},"34":{"text":"Tualeh mun siengthoupen a techipanna thuhun bawm tungah hepina toupha na koiding hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Puonzah pulam ah dawkan na koi dinga simlampang biehbuh siih ah dawkan toh kizawn in meivah khuom na tungdinga, mallam pang ah dawkan na koiding hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh kotkha adingin, Puondum, Puonsandup, Puonsan au, leh Puon malngat zem kilawmtah khut a kigan phin a kikhui na bawl ding ahi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh akhaina dingin gichilsing khuom nga na bawl dinga, sanatui na luonkhum dinga, a kibaatna khu sana abawl ahi ding hi. Tualeh khumte a dingin sum-eng kingahna khuohkuoh nga na sung ding hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh gichil sing in, Tong nga asau, tong nga alien maitam khat na bawl dinga; tua maitam khu ning li nei ahi dinga; asanlam tong thum ahi ding hi.","title":"Maitam biehbuh huongsung"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aning lite ah akii na bawl dinga, a kiite khu akibang chiet ding uhi; tuate khu sum-eng na luonkhum ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh meivam dawna ding belte leh a meiam luohnate, akuongte, ataite te leh a mei belte na bawl ding a, tuana umlebel zousie sum-eng in na bawl suoh ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh maitam adingin sum-eng len a kiphan khat na bawl dinga, tua len tungah sum-eng taukuol li aning lite ah na bawl ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuapen maitam zawlpi nuoia na khai ding alen kiphan khu maitam laikim tandonga a kikhai khiet theina dingin."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh maitam adingin gichilsing zawl ni na bawl dinga, sum-eng tui in na luonkhum ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Zawlte khu tau kuol sungah na thun dinga tualeh zawlte khu maitam pang lang khat tuoh ah azawnna dingin a um ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Singpehte alai hawmin na bawl dinga; muoltunga hing ki-en sah bangin na bawl ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh huongsung na bawl dinga, a sim lampang ngain asih langkhat adingin, Puon malngat kopta akigan tong zakhat a sau, puonzah langkhat a ding a um ding ahi.","title":"Biehbuh inntuol"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum khuom sawm nite leh akingahna khuohkuoh sawmnite khu sum-eng a bawl ahi dinga, khuomte a akhaina sia kawite leh Puonduongte dangkasia a bawl ahi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuamabangin mallam panga asaudan tongza asang puonkhai a um ding hi, tualeh khuom sawmnite leh akingah na khuohkuohte sum-eng a bawl ding ahi; a khuoma khaina te leh puonduongte dangkasia a bawl ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n tumlam panga huongsung vailam a dingin, Puonkhai tong sawmnga a sau a um ding hi; akhuom sawm, akingahna khuohkuoh sawm ahi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Huongsung let dan suolam pang ah tong sawmnga ahi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Kotpi sih langkhat lam a puon khaite tong sawm leh nga ahi ding; akhuom thum, akingahna khuohkuoh thum ahi ding."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh alangkhat lam pangah Puonkhai tong sawm leh nga a sau a um ding; akhuom thum leh a kingahna khuohkuoh thum ahi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh huongsung kotpi a dingin, puonkhai tong sawmni a sau adum, asandup, asan-au leh puonmalngat kopta akigan, tualeh phin a kikhuite a um ding hi, tualeh akhuom li leh akingahna khuohkuoh zong li ahi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Huongsung kimvel a khuomte zousie dangka puonduonga khikhawm a hi ding; abatnate dangkasia ahi dinga, tualeh akingahna khuohkuohte sum enga bawl ahi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A huong sung dunglam saudan, tong zakhat, a vailam letdan tong sawmnga ahi ding, tualeh asanlam puonmalngat kopta agat tong nga, tualeh angahna khuohkuoh sum-eng a bawl ahi ding."},"19":{"text":"Biehbuh sunga kizang um leh bel zousie leh akilbehna zousie, ahuong sung a sil khaina zousie sum-eng a bawl ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Thaumei mitlou a akuon zing thei na dingin, meivah a detding; Olive thau siengtah suhdoh hing tawi dingin Israel mipite thu nape ding hi.","title":"Meivah kep dan ding"},"21":{"text":"Kimutuona biehbuh sunga techipanna puonzah pulam ah, Aaron leh atapaten Mangpa masangah, nitah apat zingmawng dongin alim kep mama ding uh ahi. Tami Israeltate dinga akhang tungtawn ua, thugousie khat ahi ding hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tuin Israeltate lah a kipat in na sanggampa Aaron leh akunga um atapate na kungah pui inlen, aman kei a dinga siempu nna asep theina dingin Aaron leh atapate Nadab, Abihu leh Eleazar tualeh Ithamar tetoh.","title":"Siempute puonsil"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh na sanggampa Aaron a dingin athupisah ding leh akilawm sah dingin puonsil siengthou na bawlpieh ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n pilna hagau a ka dimsah, mi lungtang pilte zousie kungah thu gen in, siempu nasepna mun a, Ka nna asep theina dinga, Aaron ading akisuhsiengthou na ding puonsil abawlpieh thei na dingun."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh tamte ahi puonsil dinga abawl dingte uh, awmtuomna, siempu puon, Puonahtuol, Puonahjem, dielkhip leh konggah; tualeh na sanggampa Aaron leh atate a dingin, puonsil siengthou abawlpieh ding uhi; siempu mun a ka nna ang seppieh theina dingin."},"5":{"text":"Amaute’n sana khaute, khaudum, khausandup leh san au te, tualeh khau malngatte ala ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh amauten sana khaute, vau dumte, sandupte, san-aute, tualeh vau malngat Kopta a siemnel tah a kigan in siempu puonah abawl ding uhi.","title":"Siempu puonah"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tua puonah mong mailam leh nualam khui khawm liengkou ni nei sah ding ahi; tuachi’n akimatkhawm thei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh puonah tung kawnggah siemneltaha kigan khu Puonah toh chi khat ahi ding a, tuakhu sana khaute, adum, asandup, asan-au leh puonmalngat kopta a gat ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Onix suong mantam ni nala dinga, atung ah Israel tate min na giel ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh suong khat tungah aminte lah ua guh na giel dinga, tualeh suong dangpen tungah min guh ma amau piendan dungzui in na giel ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Suonggiel siemmi’n agel banguh, min namna a tuong bangin, Israel tate min tua suongtegel ah na giel dinga, tuate khu sana khau kipheh a khum dingin na bawl ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua suongte gel khu Israel tate theizingna suong dingin siempu puonah liengkou gel ah na bel dinga, tuachi’n Aaron in theizingna dingin Mangpa masangah aminte uh aliengkou gel ah apo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh sana in atuomna na bawl ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh amongte gel ah sana siengset a ki bawl khainieng nite pahkhi gui bangin apheh thawin na bawl dinga, akibultuonate ah tua pahkhi bang khainiengte na khi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh siemnel taha bawl vaihawmna awmtuom na bawl dinga, siempu puonah kibawl bangin na bawl ding hi, sana khaute vaudumte, sandupte, san-aute leh vau malngat hoi kopta in na bawl ding hi.","title":"Siempu awmtuom"},"16":{"text":"Tam khu hip ni a akihip chienga aning li kikim, asaudan khap khat, alet dan khap khat ahi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh tami sungah suongmantam guol li na zeplut ding a; guol khatna khu, Sardi, Topaz leh Karbunkul suongte ahi ding; tampen a guol khatna ahi."},"18":{"text":"Aguol nina pen, Emerald, Saphire, tualeh Diamond suong ahi ding;"},"19":{"text":"Aguol thumna khu Jachinth, Agate, tualeh Amethist suongte ahi ding."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh aguol lina khu, Beril, Onix leh Jasper suongte ahi ding hi, tuate khu sana a ki bawl a tuomna a tuom ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh tua suongte ah, Israel tate min dungzui in sawm leh ni, amin uh bang zel in min namna a tuong bangin ahi ding hi. Michin amin utoh nam sawm leh ni dungzui in ahi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh awmphaw tungah khau huol toh kibang khainieng sana siengset a kiphan na bawl ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Awmphaw tungah sana tau kuolni na bawl ding a, tua taukuol nite khu awmphaw mong gel ah na bul ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Sana khainieng kihuol nite khu awmphaw monga um taukuol nite sungah na thun ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh khainieng kihuol mong lelam nite khu sana khauphan nite ah na khi dinga siempu puonah liengkou mailam a nakhi ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh sana taukuol ni bawl inlen, tau khu siempu puonah sunglam panga um awmphaw ningte gel ah na koiding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Sana taukuol ni dang zong bawl inlen tuate khu siempu puonah liengkou mailam te gel nuoilam panga, kimattuona mun leh siempu puonah gahna, siemnel taha kigan tunglam ah na vaw ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh siemnel tah a, kigan siempu puonah gahna tunglam a aum theina ding leh siempu puonah apat awmphaw akol theilouna dingin, awmphaw khu tua taukuolte ah khauhuol dumin na khikhawm ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron mun siengthou a apei chiengin Mangpa masanga atheizing na dingin, alungtang tungah Israel tate min vaihawmna awmphaw ah apozel ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh vaihawmna awmphaw ah Urim leh thumim na koi ding ahi; tuate khu Aaron Mangpa masanga alut hun chieng, alungtang zawnah akoi zel ding ahi, tuachi’n Aaron in Israel tate vaihawmna khu Mangpa masanga apei hun chiengin alungtang zawnah a pozel ding hi.","ref":"Kisim. 27.21; Danp. 33.8; Ezr. 2.63; Neh. 7.65"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh siempu puonahtuol khu adum ngen in na bawl ding hi.","title":"Siempu kivonna dangte"},"32":{"text":"Atunglam laitahah lu thunna ding ahawm khat aum dinga; ahawm kimvel akehbai louna dingin, puonah bantawng bangin agei kimvel na aiha kat ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh among nuoilamah adum in, asandup in, tualeh asan au in, among kimvel ah kawlbuthei lim na bawl dinga; akimvel in akikaal uah sana dah na bawl ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Sana dah khat leh kawlbuthei khat, sana dah khat leh kawlbuthei khatma puonahtuol mong kimkot a, na bawl ding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron in Pasian na asep chiengin tam puonahtuol asil dinga; mun siengthou a Mangpa masanga alut leh apawt chiengin agin akiza ding, ashi lou na dingin."},"36":{"text":"Sana siengset peeh khat na bawl dinga atungah min namna a tuong bangin “MANGPA KUNGAH SIENGTHOUNA” chi na giel ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tami siempu dielkhip tunga a um theinading in khauhuol dum in dielkhip mailam zawn ah nakhi ding ahi."},"38":{"text":"Tami Aaron talpanga kitaa zing ding ahi, Israel taten asilpieh siengthou ding ua, alat dingte lah ua khelna umte khu Aaron in apuoh zel ding ahi; tuakhu Mangpa masanga santah a, a um theina dingin Aaron atalpanga a um zing ding ahi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh vaumalngat nem hoitah gan inlen, vaumalngat in siempu dielkhip na bawl dinga, tualeh kawnggah pen phin a siemtah a kijem a khui in na bawl ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron tapate adingin puonah na bawl pieh dinga, kawnggah zong na bawl pieh ding hi, tualeh athupisah ding leh akilawmsah dingin diel khip ding zong na bawl pieh ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Tamte khu na sanggampa Aaron leh akunga um atapate na silsah ding ahi. Kei a dinga siempu nna ahing seppieh thei na dingun, amaute sathau nanu dinga, na koituom dinga, na susiengthou ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh aguohtanna uh selna dingin, vau malngat in toka na bawl pieh ding a akawng ua pat a pheizum tan uh akhu dinguh ahi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron leh atapaten kimutuona biehbuh sunga ahing lut chieng u’leh mun siengthou a Pasian nasem dinga maitam phung lam ahing lut chieng ua, gitlouna apuohlut ua ashilou na dingun, tam puonte asil dinguh ahi. Tam dante Aaron leh anua a ahahasuonte dinga, abei theilou kumtawna thupieh ahi ding hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh siempu nna sem a ka nna asep theina ding ua, amau’te suhsiengthou na ding a, a tung ua na bawl ding tamte ahi: bawngtal tuoi khat leh gensietbei belam ni la inlen;","title":"Aaron leh atapate siempu dia bawlna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh tangbuong tolsawlou, tanghou beu tolsawlou sathau kinu, tualeh tanghou pheng tolsawlou sathau kinu; na hing tawi ding ahi, tuate khu tangbuong nel a na bawl ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu law sungah na koi dinga, a law in nangtawi dinga, bawngtal leh belamtalte gel toh."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron leh atapate kimutuona biehbuh kot kungah na hing pui dinga, amaute tuiin na sil ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Puonsilte la inlen, Aaron Puonah tungsil leh siempu Puontuol toh, siempu puon gahna siemnel tah a kigan in na gah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh a siempu dielkhip a lu ah na khip sah dinga, a dielkhip tung ah manglukhu siengthou na koiding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuazouchiengin nu ding sathau na la dinga, a lutung ah na sung dinga, sathau na nu ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n atapate na hing pui dinga, puonah tungsilte na silsah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh kawnggah in amau’te nagah dinga, Aaron leh atapate, tualeh alu uah diel na khip sah ding ahi, tuachi’n siempu nasepna khu tawp chi neilou a semden dingin namdet ahita ding uhi; tualeh Aaron leh atapate na susiengthou ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh kimutuona biehbuh mai ah bawngtal na hingkai dinga, Aaron leh atapaten bawngtal lutungah akhut uh angam ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh bawngtal khu, kimutuona biehbuh kotkhah bul ah, Mangpa masangah na that ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh bawngtal sisan khu na la dinga maitam kiite ah na khut me in na taat dinga, tualeh sisan khu maitam bul a na buoh sieng ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh asungthau zousie leh asin tuom thau leh akal nite leh atuomtu thaute na la dinga, maitam tungah na hal ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh bawngtal sa leh avun leh a eeh pum a giehphuol pulam a mei a na haltum ding ahi; tami khelna kithoina ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh belamtal khat zong hing kai inlen, Aaron leh atapaten tam belamtal lutungah akhut uh anga ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh belamtal khu na that dinga, asisan na la dinga maitam kimvel a na the ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh belamtal khu nasem nen dinga, asung sa zousie leh akengte na sawp ding a, na semnen sate leh alutang na koi khawm ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n belamtal sa apumin maitam tungah na haltum ding hi. Tami Mangpa dinga halmang sillat ahi. Tami Mangpa dinga mei a kihal gimnam tui ahi.","ref":"Eph. 5.2; Phil. 4.18"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh belamtal dang khat zong nang kai dinga, Aaron leh atapaten tua belamtal lutungah akhut uh anga ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n belamtal khu na that dinga, asisan na la dinga, Aaron bildawn zietlam leh atapate zietlam bildawn leh akhut zietlam uh khutpi leh azietlam kengpi tungte ah na nu ding ahi. Tualeh maitam kimvel ah sisan na the ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh maitam tunga um sisan leh sathau kinu te khu la inlen, Aaron leh apuonsilte leh atapate leh akunga um atapate puonsilte tungah na the ding ahi. Tuachi’n ama leh a puonsilte leh atapate leh akunga um atapate puonsilte suh siengthou ahi ta ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh belamtal thau, amei thautah leh a sungthau toh, asin tuom thau leh akalnite leh atuop thaute toh, alieng zietlam na la ding hi; tami kisuhsiengthouna belamtal ahi zieh in."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa masang a um tanghou tolsawlou law sunga um apat tanghou beu khat toh tanghou pheng sathau kitaat toh, tanghou phengneu khat na la ding a;"},"24":{"text":"Tuate khu Aaron khut leh atapate khut ah na koisieng dinga, Mangpa masanga vei sillat dingin tuate na nei ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh akhut ua pat in tuate zousie na nualah kia dinga, halmang sillatin Mangpa mai a gimnamtui dingin maitam tungah na haltum ding hi. Tami Mangpa dinga mei a hal kithoina ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron suhsiengthou na Belamtal a awm-pheng na la dinga; Mangpa masanga vei sillat dingin tua khu na vei ding hi, tua khu nang tanvou ahi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron leh atapate dinga suhsiengthouna belamte vei sillat awmpheng leh vei zousa, khai sillat lieng khu na susiengthou ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuakhu Israel tate lah a, kumtawn a Aaron leh atapate tanvou dinga guot ahi ding; tuakhu khai sillat ahi ziehin, Israeltate lemna sillat kithoinate akipat a, khai sillat ahi ding. Mangpa kunga, a khai sillat uh ahi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron puonsilte khu ama nua chienga atapate ading ahia, thau nuni leh kinamdet ni chiengin tam puonsilten akivon ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh ama taanga siempu a pang atapa in kimutuona biehbuh sunga mun siengthou a Pasian nna sem dinga angpei chiengin tua puonte ni sagi asil ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh kisuhsiengthouna belamtal khu na la dinga mun siengthou ah na huon ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron leh atapaten belamtal sa leh law sunga um tanghou khu kimutuona biehbuh kotzung ah ane ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh amaute suhsiengthouna ding leh kituomkoi na ding a, tatna kibawlna silte ane ding uhi. Hinanleh gamdang miten anetheisih ding hi, sil siengthou ahi ziehin."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh kisuhsiengthouna sa leh tanghou, zingchieng donga val aumleh, avalte mei a na haltum ding ahi, na neh lou ding ahi, sil siengthou ahi ziehin."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh na kunga ka hing thupieh dungzui a, Aaron leh atapate kunga na bawl ding ahi. Ni sagi sung amaute na susiengthou ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh nichin in khiel kithoina sillat dingin bawngtal khat lemna sillat in na lan ding hi, tuachi’n kilemna na bawl chiengin, maitam na suhsiengthouna dingin sathau na nu ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Maitam a dingin ni sagi sung kilemna na bawl dinga, na susiengthou ding hi, tuachi’n tami maitam siengthou pen ahi dinga, maitam khoikha pouma asiengthou ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n maitam tunga na sillat ding khu tamte ahi, ani aniin belam kum khatna ni ahi ngitnget ding hi.","title":"Nichin sillat dan"},"39":{"text":"Belam khat zingmawng nalan dinga, belam dang khatpen nitah in nalan ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh belam khat toh tangbuong ephah se sawm suo se khat thau hin seli suo se khat toh kihal, tualeh dawn sillat dingin uoin hin seli suo sekhat na pansah ding ahi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh belam dang khatpen maitam ah na lan ding a, zingmawng ann sillat dungzui leh dawnding sillat dungzuiin, gimnam tuidingin Mangpa adinga kihal sillat na lan ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuakhu nakhang nakhang ua, na hah nasuonte tan a, kimutuona Puonbuh kotkhah bula Mangpa masanga halmang sillat ahi zing ding hi: tuanah ang houpi dingin ka hing pei zel ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate toh tua munah ka kimutuo ding hi; tuachi’n biehbuh khu ka thupina a suh siengthou ahi ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh kimutuona biehbuh leh maitam khu ka susiengthou dinga; Aaron leh atapate zong siempu mun a ka nna semdingin ka susiengthou ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate lah ah ka teng dinga, a Pasian uh ka hi ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh amauten alah ua ka ten theina dinga, Izipt gam a kipat a amaute, hing puidohpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi, Kei Mangpa a Pasian uh ka hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh gimnamtui halna maitam na bawl dinga, gichil singin na bawl ding hi.","title":"Gimtui halna maitam"},"2":{"text":"Adunglam tong khat, availam tong khat ahi dinga ningli nei ahi ding a, asanlam tong ni ahi dinga, ningli nei ahiding a akiite akibang ahi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh maitam tung apanglam aziet avei kimvel leh a kiite sana sieng set tuiin na luonkhum dinga, a kimvel ah sana in ageituomna na bawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh agei tuom nuoiah sana taukuol ni aning sih tegel ah na bawl dinga, asihte gel ah na vaw ding hi; tuapen azawnna chieng zawl te kithunna ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh azawnna ding zawlte gichil sing in na bawl dinga, sanatui na luonkhum ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tami khu techipanna tunga kang houpi zelna ding, hepina toupha mai a techipanna bawm kunga puonzah bul ah na koi ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aaron in tuami tungah zingmawng tengin gimnamtui ahal dinga, thaumeite adet zou chiengin gimnamtui ahal ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron in nitahlam chienga thaumeite adet chiengin gimnamtui ahal zel ding ahi; nakhang nakhang ua Mangpa masanga gimnam tui ahi zing ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuami maitam tungah theilou gimtui ahiei, halmang kithoina ahiei, ann neh ding sillat na lan sih ding a, tualeh dawn sillat zong atunga na buoh ding ahi sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron in kum khat in khatvei kiite tungah lemna abawl dinga, lemna dinga khelna thoina sisan in kum tengin khatvei na hahnasuonte uh tan in kilemna abawl zel ding uh ahi: tuami Mangpa adinga maitam siengthou pen ahi ding hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah;","title":"Kitatdohna sum"},"12":{"text":"“Israeltate mi phaza na sim chiengin, aphaza uh nasim dungzuiin michin in ahinna uh tatna Mangpa kungah ape ding uhi, amaute na sim hun chienga alah ua natpi atun louna dingin."},"13":{"text":"Tam khu apieh dinguh ahi, sim sate lah a pang dinga peisuoh chin in mun siengthou a, kipe zel bang shekel khat ape ding uhi. (Shekal khat khu gerah sawm ni ahi): Shekel kimkhat pen Mangpa dinga sillat ahi ding hi.","ref":"Pawt. 38.25,26; Mat. 17.24"},"14":{"text":"Simsate lah a pang dinga peisuoh zousiete kum sawmni a upa leh atung lam in Mangpa kungah sillat ape ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Na hinna uh tatna dinga, Mangpa kunga sillat na pieh chiengun, ahauten aval ape sih ding ua, azawngten zong shekel kimkhat sanga tawmzaw ape sih ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate kitatna sum na la dinga, kimutuona puonbuh nasepna dingin na mang ding hi; na hinna uh tatna dinga Mangpa masanga Israel tate adinga theizingna ahi theina dingin,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupia akungah,","title":"Kisilna sum eng kuong"},"18":{"text":"“Kisilna ding sum-eng in tuikuong bawl inlen akeng zong sum-eng main na bawl ding hi, tuapen kimutuona biehbuh leh maitam kikaal ah na koi ding hi; tualeh asungah tui na koi ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 38.8"},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen Aaron leh atapaten tuanah akhut u’leh akengte uh asil zel ding uh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Kimutuona biehbuh sunga alut chieng uh ahiei, Mangpa dinga mei a hal sillat hal dinga, maitam phunga nasemdinga ahing lut chiengun, tua tuiin akisil zel ding uhi, tuachilouin ashi mai ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n ashi louna dingun akhutte u’leh akengte uh asil ding uhi, tuakhu amaute a ding leh ahah asuonte tandong ua dingin kumtawn thugousie ahi ding hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaban ah zong Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah;","title":"Kinu ding sathau","ref":"Pawt. 37.29"},"23":{"text":"“Gimnamtui lah a namtuipen Murrah tui shekel za-nga, singthal namtui tuaza kim khat, shekel zani leh sawmnga toh, kawltu gimnamtui shekel zani leh sawmnga."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh singthal chidang shekel zanga, mun siengthou a apieh zel uh shekel bang leh Olive thau hin khat toh hing toi inlen;"},"25":{"text":"Ginnamtui siemtu in asiem bangin, nuding sathau siengthou na bawl ding hi; tuapen nu ding sathau siengthou ahi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh kimutuona biehbuh leh theipina bawm na nu ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh dawkang leh umlebel zousie leh thaumei tunna leh avanzah zousiete leh gimnamtui koina maitam leh;"},"28":{"text":"Halmang sillat maitam avanzah zousie tualeh tui kuong leh adouna keng zong na nu ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n asiengthou penpen ahing hi theina dingun, tuate na susiengthou ding hi. Tuami thamkha pouma asiengthou ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron leh atapate sathau na nu ding a, na susiengthou ding hi; kei a dinga siempu nna asep thei na ding un."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate kungah, Tam sathau khu nakhang tungtawn ua kei a ding a, nu thei sathau siengthou ahi ding hi; chi’n gen in."},"32":{"text":"Mihing tahsa tunga sun ding ahi sih a, tualeh tam sathau kibawl bangin adang na bawl lou dinguh ahi, tami sathau siengthou ahita a, nou a dinga zong asiengthou ahi ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Koizong tam sathau toh kibang a bawl a hiei, ahisihleh gamdangmi tunga nukha a umleh, tua mipa khu amite lah apat satkhieh ahi ding,” chiin agen kia hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Gimnamtuitahte, stakte, onika, galbanum, la inlen, gimnamtui tah begaw siengtah abuh dan kibang la in.","title":"Gim namtui zahding dan"},"35":{"text":"Gimtui siempa siembang in chi kisaw chiim leh siengthou tahin gimnamtui na bawl ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh khenkhatte na gawtbuong ngingei dinga, kimutuona biehbuh a theipina bawm masang ah na koi ding hi, tuakhu nou adingin sil siengthou pen ahi ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Hinanleh gimnamtui na bawl ding khu, akihalkhawm dan dungzui in nangma dinga na bawl ding ahi sih hi. Tami Mangpa dinga siengthou a na kep dinguh ahi."},"38":{"text":"Koihitaleh tuatoh kibang nap ding bep a bawl aumleh, amite lah a kipat satkhieh ding ahi.”"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah;","title":"Khutsiem Bezalel leh Aholiab"},"2":{"text":"“En in Keima’n Juda phunga Hur tapa, Uri tapa, Bezalel amin in kahanta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian hagau in pilna, theisiemna, theitheina leh nasep siemna lam chintengah ama ka dimsah ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Khutsiemna toh bawldoh dingin, sana, dangka leh sum-eng nasem dingin,"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh suongmantamte bel dinga, atsiem siem nate, sing kilawm tah a atsiemnate sil zousie a, nasep siemna lam chin tenga sem dingin;"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh En in Keima’n, Dan nam a Ahisamak tapa Aholiab khu amatoh ka guot khawm tahi, na kunga ka hing thupieh zousie abawl thei na dingun siemna nei zousie lungtangah pilna ka koita hi."},"7":{"text":"Kimutuona biehbuhte, theipina bawmte atunga um hepina toupha leh biehbuh vanzah zousiete;"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh dawkang leh avanzah zousiete, gimnam tui halna maitamte;"},"9":{"text":"Halmang sillat maitam leh avanzah zousiete tuikuong leh a tunna toh."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh siempu nasepna puonsilte, siempu Aaron puonsil siengthoute, atapate puonsilte siempu nasepna dingin;"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh kinu ding sathaute, mun siengthoua dinga gimnamtui hal dingte; na kunga thu ka hing pieh dungzuiin abawl ding uh ahi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah,","title":"Sabbath chiemtena"},"13":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah tambangin thu gen in, ka khawlnite na nit ngeingei dinguh ahi, Na hah nasuonte uh tana keileh nou kikal a chiemtena ahi ding hi, kei Mangpa noute hing susiengpa khu ka hi chi na theina ding un."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin khawlni nanit dinguh ahi, Tuami nou a dingin ni siengthou ahi hi, koi hitaleh tam khawlni buasah pouma thalia teitei ding ahi. Koipou khawlni a nasem pouma, amite lah a pat satkhieh ahi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ni guhsung nna nasem thei ding ua, hinanleh ani sagi ni khu khawldam na dinga khawlni Mangpa adinga siengthou ahi ding hi. Koi hitaleh khawlni a nna sem pouma thalia tei tei ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.8-11; 23.12; 34.21; 35.2; Siempu. 23.3; Danp. 5.12-14"},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin Israeltaten akhang tungtawn ua thuhun tawp neilou a anit ding u’leh atan ding uh khawlni ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tami kei leh Israel tate kikaal a, kumtawn thuhun chiemtena ahi. Niguh sungin Mangpa’n lei le van asiema, ni sagini’n akhawla, atawldam ta hi, chi’n gen in, chi’n a gen hi.”","ref":"Pawt. 20.11"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman Sinai muol tunga Mosi ahoupi zouin, Pasian khut zunga giel theipina suongpeh ni Mosi apeta hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipiten Mosi muol a kipat in hing kumsuh ha seng asata ua, mipite Aaron kungah ahing peikhawm ua, akungah, “Kisa’nlen kama uh pui dingin pasien te hing bawlpieh in, Mosi kichipa Izipt gam a kipat a hing puidohpa lah bang chi atai mah atungtang thu malmal ka thei kha nawn sih uhi,” achi uhi.","title":"Sana bawngnou limbiehna","ref":"Nasep. 7.40"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron in akung uah, “Na zite uh na tapate u’leh na tanute un abil ua aba lai uh sana bilbate lakhie unlen ka kungah hing tawi un,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi zousieten sana bilba abil ua aba laite uh alakhie ua, Aaron kungah ahing tawi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh aman akhut ua pat sanate ana la a, Bawngnou lim khat in a bawl ta hi, tualeh amauten “Israelte aw tamte khu Izipt gam a kipat ahing puidoh pasien te ahi uh,” achi uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 12.28; Nasep. 7.41"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron in tami amutah in, bawngnou lim masangah maitam abawla, tualeh Aaron in thuphuon abawla; “Zing chiengin Mangpa dingin pawi kibawl ding a hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n azingni’n matahin athou ua, halmang sillatte alan ua, kilemna sillatte ahing tawi uhi, tualeh mipite ne leh dawn dingin atou ua, tualeh ki mawl dingin a ding uhi.","ref":"1 Kor. 10.7"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah, “Pei inlen kumsuh in; namite Izipt a kipat a na hing puidohte akisusegam sieng ta uhi.","title":"Pasian in Israel suhmangthai atum"},"8":{"text":"Azui ding ua ka thupieh akipat kintah in akiheimangta uhi; bawngnou lim a bawl ua abeta ua, akungah kithoina abawl ua, Aw Israel Izipt gam a kipat a noute hing puidoh pasien te tamte ahi uhi, achi uhi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Tamite ka en a ka mu chienta hi, Ngai in amaute thuhil ha leh sapzalou migenhatah ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin Keima ngentang hing umsah in, ka thangpaina amaute tung a, a kuon a, a kahtum theina dingin; hinanleh nang a kipat nam thupitah ka siem ding hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Mosi in Mangpa a Pasian kungah angen a, “Mangpa silbawltheina nasatah leh khut hattah a Izipt gam a kipat a na puidoh na mite tunga bang dinga na lungthahna na kuonsah ding ahiei mah?","title":"Mosi in Israelte dingin angetpieh","ref":"Kisim. 14.13-19"},"12":{"text":"Bangding a Izipt miten muol tungte a thading leh leitunga kipat a sumangthai dinga atung ua sietna tut dingin amaute apuidoh ahi chi ding ahi uoi? na lungthahna zauhuoitah a kipat kihei kia inlen, na mite tunga tam silsie na bawl dinga pat in na lunggel heng mai in."},"13":{"text":"Na suoh Abrahamte, Isaakte leh Jakobte kunga nangma ngei kihahsiel a na ki chiemnate theizing inlen, akung ua, nahah nasuonte uh van a aasi za in ka pungsah dinga, na kung ua ka gensa tam gam zousie ka pedinga, amaute’n tamgam kumtawn in a luo dinguh na chite khu thei zingin a chi hi.”","ref":"Siem. 22.16,17; 17.8"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n amite tunga silsie abawl tup a kipat akisia kia ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi akihei a, muol tunga kipat a kumsuh a, theipina suong pheng kigielte gel akhut in atawi a, suongphengte gel khu lelam lelam a laiteng kigiel ahi.","title":"Mosi in Suongphengte asep keh"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh suongpehte khu Pasian khutsuoh ahia, akigielte khu Pasian gel mama, suongpehte tunga kigiel ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in mipite kikou husa azah tahin Mosi kungah “Giehphuolah gal kidou husa gin a um hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh aman, “Tami husa pen guolzawna kikou ging ahisih a, tualeh guollelna kikou husa ging zong ahi tuom sih hi, ka husa zahpen lasah thawmging ahi bou hi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, giehphuol kung ahing tuntahin, bawngnou lim leh alam uh ahing muta a, tuachi’n Mosi lungthahna khu a kuongdoh ta a, asuongpeh tawite asep keh ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n a bawngnou lim bawl uh ala a, mei in ahal a, tualeh a gawtguoi a, tuitungah athe a, Israel tate a dawn sah hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Aaron kungah, “Tam mipiten na kungah bang abawl talawm ua, ahiei, hichi lawm lawm a khelna thupi leh huoisie atung ua na tunsah ta mai ahiei?” a chi hi."},"22":{"text":"Aaron in, “Kapu lungthahna kuongzah sih heh, tamite khu sil bawlkhiel utmi ahi uh chi na thei asiei mah, achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Amauten ka kungah, ka masang ua pei ding pasien te hing bawlpieh in; aziehpen Mosi Izipt gam a kipat a hing puidohpa lah heisunga um ahiei, hei a bangsuoh ataimah? chi ka thei kha nawnsih uhi, ahing chi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n keiman akung uah, koihitaleh sana kizepna nei zousien sutkhie unlen hing pie un ka chia, tuachi’n amauten ahingpie ua, tuachi’n ken mei ah ka pailut a, tami bawngnou ahing suoh ta hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuin Mosi in mipite sa guoh ahi uh chi amutahin (Aaron in amelmate ulah a azalatna ding un guohtang in ana umsah ta hi.)"},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi khu giehphuol lutna kotpi ah adinga, “Koi ahiei Mangpa lam a pang ding? Ka kungah hing pei heh” achia, tuachi’n Levitate zousie Mosi kungah apei khawm ta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh akung uah, “Israelte Pasian in tambang in agen hi, michin in anamsau apang uah kuo henlen giehphuol sungah alutna kotpi akipat in kotpi lelam dongin, michin in a unaupa, michin in alawmpa, michin in a innvengpa that uheh” a chi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levi taten Mosi thu dungzuiin abawlta uhi. Tuami niin mi tul thum vel ashi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in, “Tuni’n Mangpa kungah kisusiengthou un, michin in atapate, a unaupate na dou ta uhi, tuachi’n “Mangpa’n” ahing guolzawl thei na dingin,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh azing ni’n hichi ahing hia, Mosi in mipite kungah, “Nouten khelna thupitah na bawlta uhi, tuaziehin tuin kei Mangpa kungah ka peitou dinga, ahitheileh na khelna zieh ua thuphatawina kava bawl ding hi;” a chi hi.","title":"Mosi thupha tawina"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi Mangpa kungah ava tungkia a, “Aw tam mipiten khelna thupitah ana bawlta ua sana pasien te akibawl ta uhi."},"32":{"text":"Hitananlezong akhelna uh na ngaidam thei na diei, na ngaidam thei sih ding leh, kahing ngen hi, na laibu sunga na gelsa apat hepitahin hing thaimang mai in achi hi.”","ref":"Late. 69.28; Kihil. 3.5"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Koi inzong ka tunga sil abawl khiel leh ka laibu sunga pat ka thaimang ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin pei inlen na kunga ka genna mun ah mipite puiin; Ngai in ka van sawlsieng na masangah apei ding hi; Bangtenghitaleh, gawt ding a, ka hing ve hunchiengin, akhelna ngei uah ka gawt na ding hi,” a chi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n mipite khu Aaron bawngnou lim bawl ziehin a gawtta hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a a kungah, “Dingdoh inlen tana kipat in nang leh Izipt gam a kipat a na hing puidoh mipite toh, Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob kunga, nahah nasuonte kungah ka peding hi chia ka kichiemna gam ah peitou ta un.","title":"Mangpa’n Sinai muol potsan ding thu apie","ref":"Siem. 12.7; Siem. 26.3; Siem. 28.13"},"2":{"text":"Ka vansawlsieng na masangah ka sawl dinga; tualeh Kanaanmite, Amormite, Hitmite, Perezmite Hivmite leh Jebusmite ka notdoh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ki peitou ta un, nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam ah, kei noute lahah kang peitou sih ding hi, migenha na hi ziehun, tua ahisihleh lamkaal ah hing that gam khavang,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipiten tami thu hoilou kigen azah bep un akap ta ua, koima akizem aum nawn tasih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah “Israel hahlesuonte kungah gen in, migenhatah nahi uhi, na lah uah huntomnou khat noute toh zawhkhawm taleng ka hing mangthaisah siengta ding hi. Tuazieh in na sa tung ua na kizepna uh koikhie un, na tung ua ka bawl ding ka thei na dingin,” achita hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten Horeb muol kung ahing tun un, akizep nate uh asutkhie uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in apuonbuh asut a giehphuol pulam ah gamla simtah ah azah a, tuakhu kimutuona biehbuh achi hi. Tualeh hichi ahing hia, koizong Mangpa sui ut pouma giehphuol pulam a kimutuona biehbuh ah ava pei zel uhi.","title":"Mangpa tenna biehbuh"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, Mosi biehbuh zuon a apei chiengin mi zousie a thou ua, a puoninn kot khah bul chiet uah a ding ua, Mosi biehbuh sunga aluttum masang a en zel uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Mosi biehbuh sung a alut zou chiengin meilum ahing kaisuh a, biehbuh kot ah a ding zel hi, tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahing houpi zel hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi zousie’n biehbuh kot a meilum ding khu amu ua, mi zousie athou ua apuonbuh kot ua pat in abe chiet uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi pen mi’n alawmpa ahoupi bangin kimaituoin ahoupi hi, tua zou chiengin giehphuolah ang peikia zel hi. Hinanleh asuoh Joshua, Nun tapa, tangval khu biehbuh apat apawtdoh sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Mangpa kungah, “En in, tam mite hing puitou in nang chi a; tualeh akunga na sawlding koi ahiei nang thei sahsih hi, Ahinlah na min in ka hing thei a, ka mitmu in deisahna zong na tang hi, na hing chi ngal a.","title":"Mangpa’n mipite toh umkhawm achiem"},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin na mit mua hepina tang ka hileh, nang na hing thei na ding leh, na mitmu a hepina ka tanthei na dingin, na lampi hing theisah in, tualeh tam namte na mite ngei ahidan ngaituo in,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Aman “Ka umpina khu nang toh azawhkhawm dinga, khawldamna ka hing pe ding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Mangpa kungah “Na umpina in ahing zui sih ding leh tamna kipat hing puitou da mai ta’n."},"16":{"text":"Kei leh na miten na mitmu in hepina ka tanguh chi bang ka chi thei ding uoi? Koute na hing zawpi natah khu ahisih ding amah? Kei leh na mite leitung nam zousie apat khentuom in ka umta ding uh,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Tua zong na gen bangin ka hing bawlpieh ding hi, ka mitmu a hepina na tanziehin, na min zong ka thei chien hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in “Ka hing ngen hi, na thupina hing musah in” achi hi.","title":"Pasian in athupina Mosi aensah"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Aman “Ka hoina zousie na masang ah Ka peisah dinga, Mangpa min na masangah ka tangkoupi zel ding, tualeh ka lungsiet ut, ka lungsiet dinga, Ka khotuo nuom, Ka khotuo ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Rom. 9.15"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Aman “Ka mai namu thei sih ding hi, aziehpen ka mai mua hing koima a um theisih hi,” a chi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n, “En in, ka kungah munkhat a um, suongpi tungah ding inlen;"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi dinga, Ka thupina a hing pei sungin, suongpi kawm ah kang koi ding a, Ka hing peipel sungin ka khut in ka hing sel ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh ka khut ka ladoh dinga, tuachi’n ka nualam na mu dinga, hinanleh ka mai vang akimu sih ding hi.”"}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Amasa pen bang bangin suongpeh ni kheng inlen, tua suong pehte tungah, na sekeh suongpeh masate gel tunga kigiel thuhun zousie khu ka giel kia ding hi.","title":"Dan suongpeh pieh kiana"},"2":{"text":"Tuaziehin zingmawng chiengin mansain um inlen, zingmawng chiengin Sinai muol ah hing kaltou inlen, muolvum a ka masangah hing ding in."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh nang toh koima ahing kaltou louding ahi, muol kimvel a zong koima mawngmawng akimukhah lou ding ahi. Tualeh Muol mailam a belamhon leh bawng honte ann mai a atat louding uh ahi.”"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in amasapen bangin suongpeh ni akhengta a, tualeh Mangpa’n thu apieh bang in zingmawng matahin athou a Sinai muol ah suongpeh nite akhut a tawiin akaltouta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa khu meilum lah ah ahing kum suh a, ama toh tuamun ah a ding khawm ua, tualeh Mangpa min khu apuongzahta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa khu amasangah apei suoh a, “Mangpa, Mangpa Pasian lungsiet siem leh khotuo siem leh thuoh theitah leh hoina leh thutah a dim;","ref":"Pawt. 20.5,6; Kisim. 14.18; Danp. 5.9,10; 7.9,10"},"7":{"text":"Sang tampite tunga khotuona langsah zing a, gitlouna, bawlkhelna, leh khelna ngaidam zel a; hinanleh bangchihtana siemmawna a maw maisah lou, pate gitlouna tate tung leh tate tate tunga khang thum khang lina tan a phuba lapa chin a phuong doh hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi kintahin akisa a, lei lam ngain akun suh a Pasian abeta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Tuin na mitmu a lungsietna tang ka hileh Aw Mangpa, hepitahin ka lah uah Mangpa hing pei in; migenhate hinan uleng ka gitlouna u’leh ka khelna uh hing ngaidam inlen, koute na goutan dingin hing nei in,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Aman, “Ngai in, thuhun Ka bawl hi, na mite zousie masangah, leitung pumpi leh koi nam lah a zong ki bawl ngailou sil lamdang ka bawl ding hi: tualeh alah ua na umna mi zousieten Mangpa nasep a mu ding uhi; na kunga ka bawl ding lah sil chizathuoi ahi ngal a.","title":"Thuhun namdet kiana"},"11":{"text":"“Tunia na kunga Ka hing thupiehte zuiin: Ngai in na masangah Amormite, Kanaanmite, Hitmite Perezmite, Hivmite leh Jebusmite ka notdoh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Pilvangin, na peina gam a teng mite toh thuhun khat bawl khava uchin, na lah uah thang ahi kha ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh amaitamte uh na suchim ding ua, amilimte uh na suse ding ua, a pasiennu uh Ashera limte na phua pieh ding uhi.","ref":"Danp. 16.21"},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen pasien dang mawngmawng na bieh lou ding uh ahi, Mangpa amin khu thangsiet hat ahia; thangsiet hat Pasian ahi ziehin."},"15":{"text":"Tuachilouin agam a teng mite toh thuhun na bawl kha ding ua, apasiente utoh ang akawm kha ding ua apasiente uh kungah akithoi ding ua, tualeh noute ahing chiel ding ua, akithoina sa uh na nekha ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh na tapate ua dingin, atanu te uh na la ding ua, atanu te uh a pasiente utoh a angkawm ding ua, tualeh na tapa te uh apasien te utoh ang akawm sah kha ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Siemthu milim pasien na ki bawl dinguh ahisih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.4; Siempu. 19.4; Danp. 5.8; 27.15"},"18":{"text":"Tanghou tolsawlou pawi na bawl dinguh ahi. Thu ka hing pieh bangin Abib ha in ni sagi sung Tanghou tolsawlou na ne ding uhi; azieh pen Abib ha a, Izipt a kipat hing pawtdoh na hi uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.14-20; Siempu. 23.6-8; Kisim. 28.16-25"},"19":{"text":"Naubu hong masapen pouma kei a ahi, tualeh na ganhonte lah ua, bawngtal hiin belam hitaleh atal pouma toh,","ref":"Pawt. 13.2"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh sabiltung nou pieng masapen khu belamnou a na tat ding ahi, na tatlou a ahileh angawng na heh tanding ahi. Na tapa pieng masapente zousie na tat ding uh ahi. Koi ma ka masangah khutguoh in ahing kilah ding ahisih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 13.13"},"21":{"text":"Ni guhsung nna nasem ding ua, hinanleh a nisagi niin na khawl ding uhi, bu tu hun leh bu lah hun in zong na khawl ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.9,10; 23.12; 31.15; 35.2; Siempu. 23.3; Danp. 5.13,14"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Nipikaal pawi a kibawl pawi, mangbu ga masa pawi leh pawltah bu khum zou pawi zong na nit ding uh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 23.15-21; Kisim. 28.26-31; Siempu. 23.39-43"},"23":{"text":"Kum khat sungin thumvei na pasal naupangte zousie uh Mangpa Pasian, Israel Pasian masang ah akilah chiet ding uh ahi."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen na masangah namte kang deldoh pieh dinga, na gamgite ka hing kehlet pieh dinga; kum khat sunga thumvei Mangpa na Pasian masanga kilah dinga nang pei chiengin, koiman na gam ang deigaw pieh sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"“Kei adinga kithoina sisan tol toh na latkhawm ding ahi sih hi, tualeh Peikan pawi kithoina sa zong azing chieng tan a um ding ahi sih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.10"},"26":{"text":"Na gam a pieng ga masapente khu Mangpa na Pasian innah na hing tawi ding ahi. Kelnou sa anu nawitui a na huon ding ahi sih hi;” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 26.2; Danp. 14.21"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Tam thute giel in; tam thute dungzui a nang leh Israelte kunga thuhun ka bawl tah ziehin,” a chi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi khum munah Mangpa kungah sun sawmli leh Jan sawmli aum a; ann zong anesih a, tui zong a dawn sih hi. Tualeh aman suongpehte gel tungah thuhun thute, thusawmpiehte a giel hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Mosi khu Sinai muol a kipat theipina suongpeh nite a khut a tawi a ahing kumsuh laiin Ama toh akihouna ziehin amai vun ataang chi athei sih hi.","title":"Muol a pat Mosi hing kumsuh","ref":"2 Kor. 3.7-16"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron leh Israel tate zousie’n Mosi amu tahun, Ngaiin amai vun ataanga, tuachi’n akung nai ua, ahing pei ding azauta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in amaute a han a; tualeh Aaron leh mipi umkhawmte vaihawmte zousie, akungah ahing nuapei kia ua, Mosi in amauh ahoupi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua zouin Israel tate zousie’n ahing nai ua, Sinai muol a Mangpa’n akunga agen zousie, thupieh in a kung uah apeta hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in akung ua, thugen a zaw masang sien amai puon in akhu hi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh Mosi in Mangpa houpi dinga amasang a alut chiengin, ahing pawtdoh kia chieng in amaikhuna aladoh zel hi. Tualeh ahing pawtdoh zela, akunga thupiehte Israel tate ahilsawn zel hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten Mosi mel a en ua, Mosi maivun taang khu amu zel uhi. Tualeh Mosi Pasian houpi dinga alut kia masangsien Mosi in maikhuna in amai akhu hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Israelta kikhawmpite zousie ahankhawm a, akung uah, “Tam thute Mangpa’n na bawl ding ua, ahing thupieh thute ahi.","title":"Sabbath tandan ding"},"2":{"text":"Ni guh sung nna sep ahi dinga, hinanleh ani sagi pen nou adingin nisiengthou, Mangpa dinga khawldamna khawlni ahi ding hi: Koipou khumi nia nasem khu thalia ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.8-11; 23.12; 31.15; 34.21; Siempu. 23.3; Danp. 5.12-14"},"3":{"text":"Khawlnia na tenna innte ua mei na tawlou dinguh ahi” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Israelta kikhawm zousiete kungah, “Tam khu ahi Mangpa’n thu ahing pieh chiin agen a.","title":"Mangpa kunga Sillat"},"5":{"text":"Na lah ua pat, Mangpa dingin sillat hing la un, mi koi hitaleh alungtanga utna nei pouma in Mangpa adingin sillat hing tawiheh; sanate, dangkate, sum engte;"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh puondumte, asandupte, asan-aute, puonmalngatte, kelmulte,"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh belammul kibum sante, ngalvang vunte sittim singte,"},"8":{"text":"tualeh meivah ding sathaute, kinu ding sathau, hal namtui ding gimnam tuite."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Onix suongte, siempu puonah a ze ding leh awmtuom na a zah ding suongte."},"10":{"text":"“Tualeh na lah ua lungtang pilna nei poumate nang pei ding ua, Mangpa hing thupieh zousie na bawl ding uhi.","title":"Biehbuh a vanzah dingte"},"11":{"text":"Biehbuh te, a puon innte, akhunate, akilbehnate a singpehte, azawlte, akhuomte leh akingahna khuohkuohte,"},"12":{"text":"Bawm leh azawn na zawlte, khotuona toupha akhuna puonzahte,"},"13":{"text":"Dawkan leh azawlte, a bel leh kuongte leh tanghousie toh."},"14":{"text":"Meivah ading a thaumei koinate, avanzahte athaumeite, meivah ading sathaute."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh gimnamtui halna maitam leh azawlte, nuding sathaute, hal ding gimnamtuite, biehbuh lutna kot a puonzahte,"},"16":{"text":"Halmang sillatna maitam leh sum-eng a kizut azawnna zawlte, a umlebelte, sum-eng a kizut tui kuong leh atunnate."},"17":{"text":"A huongsunga puonzahte, a khuomte, akingahna khuohkuohte, a huongsung kotkhah puonzahte;"},"18":{"text":"Biehbuh kilbehnate, ahuongsung kilnate, akhaute."},"19":{"text":"Mun siengthou nasepna ding, nasepna puonsilte, siemputen nna asep hun chieng ua asil dinguh siempu Aaron puonsilte leh atapate Puonsilte, chi’n agen hi.”"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mipi kikhawmpi zousie Mosi kunga kipat in apeidoh siengta uhi.","title":"Mipiten sillat ding ahing tawina"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh michin alungsim a kilawpna nei zousie leh lungtanga phal pouma ahing pei ua, kimutuona biehbuh a zah ding leh nasepna dinga poimaw zousie leh puonsil siengthou dingin Mangpa kung ah ahing tawi khawm uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh lungtanga utna nei pouma numei hi in pasal hitaleh ahing pei ua, taute, bilbate, khutsipte, khite, sana a kibawl ngen ahing tawi uhi, tualeh michin sana pieh ding nei zousien Mangpa kungah silpieh apie uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n michin in Puondumte, asandupte, asan-aute, kelmulte, belamtal vun sante, ngalvang vun neiten ahing tawi khawm uhi."},"24":{"text":"Michin dangka leh sum-eng silpieh pepouma in Mangpa dinga sillat dingin ahing tawikhawm uhi, tualeh nasepna a zah theiding mawng mawng sittim sing neiten ahing tawi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh numei khutsiem pilna neiten akhut un vau a zom ua, tualeh a vau hehte uh adum, asandup leh asan-aute leh puonmalngatte ahing tawi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh khutsiemna pilna a, alungtang uh thanopna a tohthou a um numei zousie’n kelmulte a zom uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh vaihawm te’n siempu puonah leh awmphaw a siet dingin Onix suong leh suongmantamte leh;"},"28":{"text":"Gimnamtuite, meivah ading sathaute, nu ding sathaute leh gimnamtui dingte ahing tawi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Israeltaten ut thua sillat Mangpa kungah ahing tawi ua, michin numei leh Pasal kilawpna aneisah mipoumaten Mosi khut zanga bawl dinga thu apieh zousie bawlna dingin ut thua pieh sillatte Mangpa kungah ahing tawi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi’n Israel tate kungah “En un, Mangpa’n Juda phunga Hur tapa Uri tapa Bezalel khu amin in ahanta hi;","title":"Mangpa’n Bezalel leh Oholiab ahatna (Pawt. 31.1-11)"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman ama khu pilnate, theisiemnate thei ‘theinate leh nasep siemna chinteng nei dingin Pasian hagau in adimsah tahi."},"32":{"text":"Na sepding piltah a suongtuo theinate, sana, dangka leh sum-eng khen siemnate,"},"33":{"text":"Suongmantamte siet dinga atphal dan siemnate leh sing at siemnate leh lam chintenga khut siemnate nei dingin."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh ama toh Dan nam a mi Ahisamak tapa Oholiab toh ani ua mite ahil theina dingun pilna apeta hi."},"35":{"text":"Amautegel pen lamchintengah khutsiem nate, suong khuoh siemnate, khutsiemna tuom tuomte, puondum, Puonsandup leh asan-aute leh Puonmalngat gat siemnate, banglam pou a nasep siemnate, silbawl dingte piltah a ngaituo siemnate nei dingin lungtang pilna in a sudim ta hi, achi hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n “Bezalel leh Aholiab leh mi khutsiem koipou Mangpa’n thu apieh dungzui a, mun siengthou a nasepna zousie sem thei dinga pilna leh theisiemna apieh pouma in asep dinguh ahi” achi hi.","title":"Biehbuh
