bawlna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Bezalel leh Aholiab leh mi khutsiemte koizong Mangpa’n alungtang ua pilna apieh a, tuabang nasep sem ngap dinga alungtang ua thanopna nei zousie ahan ta a."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh amaute’n Mosi khut a kipat in, Israel taten munsiengthou nasepna vanzah ding silpieh a hing tawite zousie uh a la zel uhi, tualeh zingmawng chin in akungah ut thu a silpiehte ava tawi zel uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n mun siengthou a nasep zousie sem mipilte zousie, michin anasep na ua kipat ahing pei ua,"},"5":{"text":"Mosi kungah “Mangpa’n bawl ding a ahing thupieh bawlna ding hunza sang a tamzaw tham mipite’n a hing tawi ta uhi” chi’n ava gen uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in thu apie a, tuachi’n mun siengthou a dinga silpieh ding, “Numei leh Pasal koima’n nasep silbawl in nei nawn sih un chi’n giehphuol sung pumpi ah tang atawh sah ta uhi.” Tuachi’n mipiten sil ahing tawi uh kham ahita hi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen asil neisate uh bawl dinga poimaw zousie bawlna dingin akiching mama a, atam val seng lam ahita."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh nasep semte lah a khutsiemna pilna nei poumaten, puonmalngat kopta adum, asandup leh asan-au, Cherubim lim a asiemnel tah a kizem puonzah sawm abawl uhi.","title":"Mangpa tenna biehbuh bawl thu (Pawt. 26.1-37)"},"9":{"text":"Puonzah khat a dunglam tong sawmni leh giet ahia, puonzah khat vailam tong li ahia, puonzah zousie let dan akibang chiet ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh aman Puonzah ngate a zom khawma; tualeh nga dangte zong azopkhawm hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh akizopna akipan in puonzah gei ah adumin abil abawla, tuachibang main akizopna nina puonzah pulam geiah zong abawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Puonzah khatah abil sawm nga abawl a, anina kizopna, Puonzah geiah sawmnga ma abawl hi. A bilten Puonzah khat leh khat aki kaituo sah hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh sana in mehkil sawmnga abawl, tua mehkilten puonzahte akilbeh hi, tuachi’n biehbuh khat ahing hita hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh aman biehbuh tung khuna dingin kelmul puonzahte abawl a, puonzah sawm leh khat abawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Puonzah khat dunglam tong sawmthum ahia; Puonzah khat vailam tong li ahi, Puonzah sawm leh khat te letdan akibang chiet ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Puonzah ngate akikilmat chiet a, tualeh puonzah guhte zong akikilmat tua chiet ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh akizopna puonzah geikhieng pen guol mong ah abil sawm nga abawla; anina kizopna puonzah gei ah zong abil sawmnga abawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh puon inn khat ahing hitheina dinga mattuona dingin, sum-eng in mehkil sawmnga abawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh aman belamtal vun kibum san in puon inn khuna ding abawla, tuami tungah ngalvang vunin akhuna ding abawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Gichil sing in biehbuh singpeh ding a bawl a, tangtah in atung hi."},"21":{"text":"Singpeh saulam tong sawm ahia, aletdan tong khat leh akim ahi."},"22":{"text":"Singpeh khat in kigamlat dan kibang in kimat tuona ding at geng ni anei chiet hi, biehbuh singpeh zousie tuabangin abawl suoh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh a dingin singpeh abawla simlam pangah simlam dawin singpeh sawmni a bawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh tua singpeh sawmnite nuoi ah dangka in kingahna khuohkuoh sawmli abawl hi, singpeh khat nuoi ah akeng nite dingin kingahna khuohkuoh ni tualeh singpeh dang nuoi ah akeng nite a dingin ki ngahna khuohkuoh ni ma abawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh lelam pang mallam adingin singpeh sawm ni a bawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Dangka a kibawl akingahna khuohkuoh sawmli toh: Singpeh khat nuoi ah akingahna khuohkuoh ni singpeh dang nuoi ah akingahna khuohkuoh nima abawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh tum lamgpang biehbuh ninga dingin singpeh guh abawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh pang nite adingin singpeh ni abawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuate khu taukuol in atunglam leh anuoilam akitumat tuo hi, tuamabangin apang ni a, aning nite adingin abawl hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh singpeh giet leh akingahna khuohkuoh te dangka a ki bawl kingahna khuokuoh sawm leh guh a um hi, singpeh khat nuoiah akingahna khuohkuoh nizel a um hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Gichil sing zawl abawla, biehbuh pang khat a singpehte dingin zawlnga,"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh a lelam panga singpehte adingin zawl nga, tualeh biehbuh tumlam panga singpehte ding in zawl nga ma abawl a."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh singzawl laitapen khu, agei langkhat a kipan langkhat tan apei suoh sah hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh singpehte khu sanatui in aluonkhum a, azawl thunna ding taukuolte sana in abawla, azawlte sanatui a luonkhum hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Puondum, asandup leh asan-au leh puonmalngat kopta in Puonzah abawla, khutsiem tahin Cherubim lim tuongin abawl hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh khumi adingin gichil singin khuom li abawla, sanatui aluonkhum hi: abatna siakawi te khu sana abawl ahi. Tualeh tuate kingahna dingin dangka in khuohkuoh li asung hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh kotkha adingin adum, asandup, asan au leh puonmalngat kopta in phin a khui zem kilawmtah puonzah abawl a;"},"38":{"text":"Khuom ngate abaat na siakawite toh; tualeh akhuom mong bawte leh chiengte sanatuiin aluonkhum a, hinanleh akingahna khuohkuoh ngate khu sum-eng a bawl ahi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Bezalel in gichil singin bawm abawl a adunglam tong ni leh akim ahia availam tong khat leh akim ahi, asaulam tongkhat leh akim ahi.","title":"Thuhun bawm siem thu"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh sana siengset in asunglam leh apulam aluonkhum a, a kimvel ah sana lallukhu in a zem hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh aning li a vaw dingin sana taukuol li a sunga, taukuol ni apang lang khat ah, taukuol dang nite apang lelam a vaw dingin."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh aman gichilsing in zawl abawl a, tuate khu sana tui aluon khum hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh zawlte khu bawm panga taukuolte sungah apuohna dingin athun hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh aman sana siengset in hepina toupha abawl a; adunglam tong ni leh akim ahia, availam tong khat leh akim ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh aman seh a khen cherubim ni abawl a, hepina toupha mong tuoh ah abawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Cherub khat tamlang pang mongah, Cherub dang pen khumlang pang mongah; hepina toupha akipat among nite ah cherubte abawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Cherubimte gel in aha uh tunglam ah azah ua, ahate uh kimattuoin hepina toupha akhu ua; khat leh khat akimai ngattuo ua, khotuona toupha lam ah cherubimten amai angat tuoh uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh aman gichilsing in dawkan abawl a, a dunglam tong ni ahia, availam tong khat ahi, tualeh asanlam tongkhat leh akim ahi.","title":"Tanghou lat ding koina dawkan"},"11":{"text":"Tuakhu sana siengset in aluon khuma, akim vel ah sana in azem hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh khutpeh chie in agei guol abawl a, sana in a kimvel in azem hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuami adingin sana taukuol abawl a, tua taukuol lite khu akenga um ning lite ah avaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Agei guol zungah dawkan puohna ding zawlte guonlutna ding taukuolte a um uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh bawm zawnna dingin zawlte gichil singin abawl a, sanatuiin aluon khum hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh dawkan tunga akoi ding um leh bel te, akuongte, khete, noute, asun khiehna ding hengte leh uoin thawlte, sana siengset in abawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh aman sana siengset in thaumei tunna abawl a, tuami thaumei tunna khu seh a kikhenthaw ahia, akungpi leh aba leh anoubemte, amumte, apahte khu akizop chiet a bawl ahi.","title":"Thaumei khuom kibawlna dan"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh aba guh a pangah ahing mengdoh a; aba thumte thaumei tunna pang lang khat ah tualeh aba thumma thaumei tunna lelam pangah a um hi."},"19":{"text":"Aba khat ah, Almond sing pahmum bang nou thum, apahmum leh apahhoi, abawl a, tualeh aba dangah zong, Almond sing pahmum bang, nou thum ma abawl a, apahmum leh apahhoi abawl hi: Tuamabangin thaumei tunna ba guhte adingin abawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh thaumei tunna ah almond singga banga bawl noubem lite, amumte leh apahte a um hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh tua ba guh kizop nite nuoiah a mum khat a um a, meivah tunna apat mengdoh guhte ah a um chiet hi."},"22":{"text":"Amumte leh abate akizop chiet uhi, a unpi’n sana siengset sakhat a seh a khenthaw a bawl ahi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh aman thaumei sagi leh ataite te leh avut luohnate sana siengset in abawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Sana siengset talent khat in thaumei tunna leh avanzahte abawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh gichil singin gimnamtui halna maitam abawl a; adunglam tong khat ahia, a availam tongkhat ahi; ning li nei ahi; tualeh asanlam tong ni ahia; a kiite toh kizop chiet ahi.","title":"Gimnamtui halna maitam"},"26":{"text":"Tuakhu atung leh apang kimvel leh akiite sana siengset in a luonkhum a, tualeh akimvel ah sana in azem hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh akizepna nuoiah apuohna zawlte thollutna dingin apang gel tunga aningnite kung ah sana taukuol ni abawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh zawlte khu gichil singin abawl a sanatui aluonkhum hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh aman kinuding sathau siengthou leh gimnamtui bawlsiemten abawl uh gimnamtui halding siengthou tah abawl hi.","ref":"Pawt. 30.22-38"}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh aman gichilsing in halmang sillatna maitam abawl a, adunglam tong nga ahia, availam zong tong nga ma ahia, ningli nei ahi. Tualeh asanlam tong thum ahi.","title":"Halmang latna maitam"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aning lite ah akiite abawl a, tua akiite khu maitam toh kizop chiet ahi; tuakhu sum-eng in a luonkhum hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh maitam a vanzah zousiete, belte, vutluohte, tuikuongte, sathuana tawkeute leh mebelte abawl a, tambang vanzah zousiete sum-eng in abawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh aman maitam adingin sum-eng chieng maitam dawdan nuoiah akimkhat chieng dongin abawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh zawl gollutna dingin sum-eng chieng ning lite adingin taukuol li a sung hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh gichilsing in zawl abawl a, sum eng in aluonkhum hi."},"7":{"text":"Jawlte khu maitam panga taukuolte sungah, azawnna dingin athun a: maitam khu singpeh asung hawm in abawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n sum-eng in tuikuong leh atunna a bawl a, kimutuona biehbuh kotbul a nasem numeite himlang in abawl hi.","ref":"Pawt. 30.18"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh huongsung simlam ngat in simlam pang ah abawl a, ahuongsung puonzahte khu puonmalngat kopta a kigan tong zakhat a sau ahi.","title":"Biehbuh huongsung iim na"},"10":{"text":"Tuami adingin khuom sawmni leh sum-eng, khuom ngahna khuohkuoh sawmni a um hi, khuom baatna siakawite leh akaimatnate khu dangka abawl ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh mallampang a dingin zong Puonzahte tong zakhat ahia, khuomte zong sawm ni ahi, a khuom ngahna sum-eng khuoh kuoh sawmni ahi. Tualeh khuom baatna siakawite leh akaimatnate khu dangka a bawl ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh tumlam panga dinga puon khainate khu tongsawm nga ahi; akhuomte sawm akingahna khuohkuoh te sawm; abaatna siakawite leh akimatnate khu dangka abawl ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh suolam ngat in, suolam pang adingin tong sawm nga ahi."},"14":{"text":"Kotpi pang langkhat puonzah tong sawm leh nga; akhuom thum, akingahna khuohkuoh thum."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh huong kotpi pang lelam lelam adingin puonzahte tong sawm leh nga; akhuomte thum, akingahna khuohkuoh thum ahi."},"16":{"text":"Huongsung kimvel a puonzah zousie khu Puonmalngat kopta akigan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh khuomte kingahna khuohkuoh te khu sum-eng a bawl ahia; khuombaatna siakawite leh achingbaante dangka abawl ahi, tualeh akhuommong bawte khu dangkatui a luonkhum ahia, huongsung pal khuom zousie zong dangka a kaimat ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh huongsung kotpi puonzahte khu phin a khui khawm, adum, asandup, asan au leh Puonmalngat kopta akibawl ahi, asanlam tongsawm ni, apeh sanlam khu huongsung puonzahte toh kituoh in tong nga ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh akhuomte li ahia, akingahna khuohkuoh te zong li ahia, abaatna siakawite dangka abawl ahia, tualeh a mongbawte leh akaimatnate khu dangka abawl ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh leh ahuongsung kimvel kilbehna zousie sum-eng a bawl ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tam theipina biehbuh adinga vanzah, Mosi thupieh dungzui a, siempu Aaron tapa Ithamar khut zanga Leviten asimte uh dung zuiin tamte ahi.","title":"Biehbuh bawlna a van Lutza"},"22":{"text":"Juda phunga Hur tapa, Uri tapa, Bezalel in Mangpa’n Mosi kunga bawl dinga thu apieh zousie abawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh ama toh Dan phunga Ahisamak tapa Aholiab mikhutsiem, bangkhat gelsiem, Puondumte, sandupte, san-aute leh puonmalngatte kilawm tah in azem in agan hi."},"24":{"text":"Munsiengthou a dinga apoimawna zousie, azah dinga sana sillat kizang zousie, talent sawmni leh kuo leh mun siengthou a shekel apieh zelte uh sim bang a sim in shekel za sagi leh sawmthum ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh mipi kikhawmpite lah a simtel zousiete, sum pieh shekel tul khat leh zasagi leh sawmsagi leh nga ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 30.11-16"},"26":{"text":"Kum sawmni leh atunglam, kisimkhasate lah a pang dinga peite, tul zaguh leh tul thum leh zanga leh sawmnga te, munsiengthou a shekel sim banga sim in bekah khat chiet (shekel kimkhat ahi) pie bang ahi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 17.24"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh dangka talent zakhat, mun siengthou khuom ngahna khuohkuoh leh puonzahna khuom ngahna khuohkuohte dingin akisung hi: talent zakhat a khuom ngahna khuohkuoh zakhat, khuom ngahna khuohkuoh khat adingin talent khat ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh shekel tul khat leh zasagi leh sawmsagi leh nga tein khuomte baatna siakawite abawla, akhuommong bawte dangka tuiin aluonkhum a, azingte akimat sah hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh sillat sum-eng khu talent sawmsagi leh shekel sangni leh zali ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuate in aman biehbuh kotkha dinga khuom ngahna khuohkuohte leh sum-eng maitam leh sum eng chieng ding leh maitam a vanzah zousie leh;"},"31":{"text":"Huongsung kimvel a khuomngahna khuohkuoh te leh huongsung kotpi khuom ngahna khuohkuohte leh biehbuh kilna zousie leh huongsung kimkot a kilna zousie abawl hi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh amauten adum, asandup leh asan au te zangin mun siengthou a Pasian nasepna dingin nasepna puon zem hoitahte abawl ua, Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu apieh bangin, Aaron dingin puon siengthoute abawl uhi.","title":"Siempu puon gat dingdan"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh sanate, khau dumte, a sandupte, asan-aute leh puonmalngat kopta in siempu puonah abawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Sana khu pa dingdengin akhengpeeh ua, vau dum, sandup, san au leh vau malngatte, mi khutsiem tahin azem nei a siem dingin a bawl uhi."},"4":{"text":"A liengkou ah a hip in akhuikhawm ua, among tuoh tuoh ah a khuikhawm uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh siempu puonah tunga akonggah ding siemnel tah a kigan khu, puonah toh avaukhau kibang a bawl khawm ahia; sanate, vau dumte, sandupte, san-aute leh puonmalngatte kopta a gat ahi. Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bang in."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate min dungzui in, min namna a kigiel bang in sana khau nem a siettum Onix suongte agiel uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuate khu siempu puonah liengkou ah abel a, Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh banga, Israel tate adinga theizingna suong hi dingin."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh awmphaw khu siempu puonah ma bangin khut siemtahin sanate, Puon dumte, sandupte, san-aute leh puonmal ngat kopta in abawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuakhu ning li nei ahia; awmphaw khu akithuop in abawl uhi; asanlam khapkhat ahia, availam zong khapkhat ahia, akithuop ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh suong mantam guolli in asiet ua; aguol khatna khu Sardis, Topaz leh Karbunkul ahia, aguol khatna ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh aguol nina khu; Emerald, Saphire leh diamond ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh guolthumna khu: Jacinth, Agate leh Amethist ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh guol lina khu: Beril, Onix leh Jasper ahi: sana khau nema kipheh a siettum ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate minte dung zuiin, suong mantam sawm leh ni akiguol a, amin chiet utoh akigiel khawm chiet hi; suong khat chietah min namna a kigielte bang in, Israel nam dungzuiin nam sawm leh nite a dingin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh amauten awmphaw tunga dingin sana siengset khauhuol kiheh bangin khainieng abawl uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh sana vaungat kipheh nileh taukuol ni abawl ua; tua taukuol nite khu awmphaw ning a among geitegel ah akoi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh sana khainieng kipheh nite gel khu awmphaw monga taukuol nite gel sungah athun uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh khainieng kiphan nite mong khu sana khaupheh nite ah akhikhawm ua, tuakhu siempu Puonah aanglam liengkou ah abeh uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh sana taukuol ni a bawl ua, khumte gel khu awmphaw mongte gel tungah, siempu puonah sung nung gei ah akoi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh sana taukuol dang ni a bawl ua, tuate khu siempu puonah mailam a kibat guinei nuoi lampang ah, siempu puonah kawnggah siemnel tah a kigan tung lam ah avaw uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh awmphaw khu, taukuolte in siempu puonah a um, taukuolte ah khau dumin akhituo ua, khutsiem tah a kigan siempu puonah kawnggah tunglam a aum theina ding leh awmphaw khu siempu puonah a abe det theina dingin; Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu apieh bangin."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh aman siempu puonah tuol, adum ngen a kigan abawl hi.","title":"Siempu kivonna dang bawlna"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh puonah tuol laitahah puonah ban tawng bangin a suvanga, avanna akeh louna dingin akimvel in a aihakat hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh amauten puonahtuol mongah kawlbuthei lim adum in, asandup in, asan-au tualeh puonmalngat in abawl uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh sana siengset in dah abawl ua, tuate khu puonahtuol mong kimkot in kawlbuthei te kikal ah akhai suoh uhi."},"26":{"text":"Dahneu khat leh kawlbuthei khat zel nasepna puonah tuol mong kimkot tung suohin, a um hi; Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu apieh bangin."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh amauten Aaron leh atapate adingin puonmalngat akigan puonah tung sil;"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh puonmalngat in siempu dielkhip leh puon malngat hoitah kigan in lukhu kilawm tah leh tokasiing."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh puon malngat kopta leh adum, asandup leh asan au in kawnggah kikhui thaw abawl uhi. Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu apieh bangin."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh siempu lukhu siengthou a dingin sana peh, sana siengset in abawl ua, atungah min namna-a tuong bangin “MANGPA KUNG AH SIENGTHOUNA”, chi atuong sah uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh siempu dielkop tunglam ah vau dum in akhidet uhi, Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu apieh bangin."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n kimutuona puon inn biehbuh nasep zousie khu zaw sieng ahita. Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu apieh bang zelin Israel taten abawl uhi.","title":"Nasep zou ta uh"},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten biehbuh khu Mosi kungah ahing puo ua, apuon innte, avanzah zousiete, akilbehnate, asing pehte, azawlte, akhuomte, akhuom ngahna khuohkuoh te;"},"34":{"text":"a tung khuna belamtal vun kibumsante, akhuna saham vunte, akhuna puonzahte,"},"35":{"text":"Theipina bawmte, azawlte, khotuona touphate;"},"36":{"text":"Dawkante, tuana vanzah zousiete, tanghousie koinate,"},"37":{"text":"Sana siengset a kibawl thaumei tunnate, akizom a koi ding thaumeite, avanzah zousie leh thaumei detna ding sathaute,"},"38":{"text":"Tualeh sana maitamte, siempu nu ding sathaute, gimnam tuite, biehbuh kotkha puonzahte,"},"39":{"text":"Sum eng maitamte sum eng chiengte, azawlte avanzat zousiete, tuikuong leh atunnate,"},"40":{"text":"Ahuongsung puonzahte, akhuomte, akhuomngahna khuohkuohte, ahuongsung kotpi puonzahte akhaute, akilnate, kimatuonate, biehbuh sunga vanzah zousiete toh;"},"41":{"text":"Munsiengthou a siempu nasepna nihten Puonsil kilawmtah a kigante, siempu Aaron leh atapaten siempu nasep asep chieng ua asil dinguh sil leh ten siengthoute toh."},"42":{"text":"Mangpa’n Mosi athupieh zousie dungzuiin Israel taten abawl ding zousie uh abawl uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in tua nasep na zousie a en a, Ngaivawi; Mangpa’n thu apieh bang ngel in azousiengta uhi, tuachi’n Mosi in amaute a guolzawl hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupia akungah tam bangin agen hi.","title":"Biehbuh tundohna leh latna"},"2":{"text":"“Ha masapen nikhat ni in kimutuona puon inn biehbuh na tunding ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh asungah theipina bawm na koi dinga, tualeh bawm khu puonzah a na dantan ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh dawkan na lalut dinga, atunga sil um dingte na koitup ding ahi; thaumei tunna na lalut ding a, thau meite na devah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh theipina bawm masangah gimnamtui halna sana maitam na koi dinga, biehbuh kotkha puonzah na khai ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh halmang sillatna maitam khu kimutuona puon inn biehbuh kotkhah bul ah na daw ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh kimutuona biehbuh leh maitam kikal ah tuikuong na koi dinga, asungah tui na koiding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh akimvel in a huongsung na bawl dinga ahuongsung kotpi puonzah na zah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh thau nu ding khu la inlen, biehbuh leh asunga um zousie na nu ding a, na susienthou ding a, a umlebelte leh vanzah zousie toh, tuachi’n a siengthou ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh halmang sillat maitam avanzahte zousie sathau nanu dinga, maitam na susiengthou ding hi, tuachi’n maitam khu siengthou pen ahita ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tuikuong leh atunnate sathau nuin na susiengthou ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron leh atapate kimutuona biehbuh kotkha ah na pui dinga, tuiin na sil ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron in puon siengthoute na sil sah ding a, sathau na nu dinga, na susiengthou ding hi. Siempu nasep na mun a ka nna asep theina dingin."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh atapate nang zawpi dinga, puonah tungsil na silsah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amaute sathau nanu dinga, apa uh na nu bangin, siempu mun a Ka nna a sep thei na ding un, asathau kinu ukhu akhang akhang ua dinga siempu ahina uh chiemtena ahitah ding ziehin achi hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tuabangin Mosi in abawla, Mangpa’n akunga thu apieh bangin abawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hia, akum nina, ha masapen ani khat niin, biehbuh tun dingin a umta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in biehbuh khu atung dingta a, akhuom kingahna khuohkuohte aphut det a, asingpehte atung a azawlte ahunga, akhuomte aphut hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh puon inn khu biehbuh tungah azah a atung ah apuonbuh khuna akoi hi. Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu apieh bangin."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh aman theipina khu ala a thuhun bawm sungah akoi hi, bawm zawlte aguonga, thuhun bawm tungah hepina toupha akoi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh thuhun bawm khu biehbuh sungah alalut a, akhuna puonzah azah a, theipina bawm akhukhum hi. Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bang in."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh kimutuona biehbuh sunga biehbuh mallam panga puonzah pulam ah, dawkan akoi a."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh dawkan tungah, Mangpa masangah, tanghoute kituptah in akoi a, Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu apieh bangin."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh thaumei tunna khu kimutuona biehbuh sung biehbuh simlam panga dawkan tunna lelam ah akoi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa masangah thaumeite ataang ta hi, Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh kimutuona biehbuh masanga puonzah masangah sana maitam a koi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n atungah gimnamtui a hal hi, Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh aman biehbuh kotkha ah Puonzah azah hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh kimutuona puon inn biehbuh kotkha bul ah halmang sillat maitam akoi a, atung ah halmang sillatte leh ann sillat alan hi, Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh kimutuona biehbuh leh maitam kikaal ah, tuikuong akoi a, kisilna dingin kuong sungah tui alui hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi leh Aaron leh atapaten tuami tui in akhut u’leh akengte uh asil uhi."},"32":{"text":"Kimutuona biehbuh alut ding chieng u’leh maitam bul a apei ding chiengun a kisil uhi, Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh leh maitam kimvel ah huongsung abawl a, huongsung kotpi Puonzah akhai hi. Tuachi’n Mosi’n nasep azouta hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n kimutuona biehbuh khu meilum in ahing tuom a, Mangpa thupina in biehbuh ahing luodim ta hi.","title":"Pasian thupinain maitam aluodim na","ref":"1 Leeng. 8.10,11; Isai. 6.4; Ezek. 43.4,5; Kihil. 15.8"},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n biehbuh tunga meilum akhawlden tahzieh leh Mangpa thupina in biehbuh aluodim ziehin, Mosi khu kimutuona biehbuh sung ah alut thei tasih hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh tunga pat meilum akitawlmang chiengin, Israel tate akisuon zel uhi, akhuol zin sung sie un."},"37":{"text":"Hinanleh meilum akitawlmang masangsie’n, mailam nawt lou in a um uhi."},"38":{"text":"Mangpa meilum sun chiengin biehbuh tungah aum a, zanchiengin meikuongin Israel tate zousie mitmu in akhuol zin sung tengun a um hi."}}}}},"3":{"info":{"name":"Siempudan","shortname":"Siempu.","abbr":[],"desc":"Mosi laibu thumna siempudan"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Mangpa’n Mosi ahan a, kimutuona puon inn apat in ahoupi a;","title":"Halmang sillat"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mipite houpi inlen akung uah tambangin gen in: Na lah ua mi koipou in Mangpa kunga sillat na hing tawi chiengun ganta sillat ahileh; bawnghon lah leh belamhonte lah apat a nalat ding uh ahi."},"3":{"text":"“A sillat khu bawnghonte lah apat halmang sillat ahileh atal nuolnabei alat ding ahi; ama Mangpa mai a pom ahitheina dingin kimutuona puonbuh kotbul ah alan ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh aman halmang sillat ding lutungah akhut akoi dinga; tuachi’n ama adinga kilemna sillat dinga pompieh ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa masangah bawngtal khu athat dinga; Aaron tapa siemputen khum sillat sisan ala ding ua, kimutuona puonbuh kot bul a maitam tungah a the kawikawi ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh ahalmang sillat khu avun alem dinga asa asemnen ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron tapa siemputen maitam tungah mei ataw ding ua, mei tungah sing achieng khawm ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron tapate siemputen sa kisemnente, alu leh athau maitam a mei tungah kituptahin akoi ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh a sung sate leh akengte tuiin a sawp dinga, Mangpa dinga gimnamtuitah mei a sillat halmang kithoina dingin maitam tungah siempu’n ahaltum ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tualeh halmang kithoina dinga lat ding khu belam hon lah apat ahiei, kelhonte lah apat ahiei, ahileh atal nuolna bei alat ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh khum khu maitam mallam pangah Mangpa masangah agou dinga, Aaron tapate siemputen maitam kimvel ah sisan athe ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh asa asemnen dinga, alu leh athaute siempu in maitam tunga, mei tunga singtungah kituptahin akoi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh asungsa leh akengte tui in asawp dinga, siempuin ahing tawi dinga, maitam tungah ahaltum dinga, tami Mangpa dinga gimnamtuitah mei a lat, halmang sillat ahi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tualeh Mangpa kunga sillat ding halmang kithoina sillat va lampang ahileh palva alat ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tuakhu siempu’n maitam ah ahing tawi dinga angawng ahehtan dinga, asisan khu maitam gei ah aluongkang sah dinga, tuachi’n maitam tungah ahal ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh atangkhai khu amultoh abotkhe dinga, maitam gei suolam panga vutkholna munah apai ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh ahate abotkieu dinga, asate bottan louin; tualeh siempu’n maitam a meitunga singah ahal ding hi; tuakhu Mangpa dinga gimnamtuitah mei alat halmang sillat ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi koipou in ann sillat Mangpa kunga alat chiengin, a sillat khu tangbuong nel ngingei ahi ding hi, tualeh atungah sathau abuoh dinga, gimnamtui akoi ding hi.","title":"Ann sillat"},"2":{"text":"Tuakhu Aaron tapate siempute kungah ahing tawi dinga, tangbuong nel ngingei sipdim khat sathau leh gimnamtui teng toh alakhe dinga, tuakhu siempu in maitam tungah theizingna dingin, Mangpa dinga gimnamtuitah mei a sillat hi dingin ahal ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ann sillat a kizangmawhte khu Aaron leh atapate ading ahi ding; tuakhu Mangpa adinga mei a sillatte lah a asiengthou pen ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"“Tualeh ann sillat lungthu tunga em minsa lat dinga na hing tawi leh tangbuong nel sathau toh kipawi tolsawlou ahiei, ahisihleh sathau kinu tanghou tolsawlou tanghoupheng pan ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh na sillat khu khangbel a kikang ann sillat ahileh, tolsawlou sathau toh kimeh tangbuong nel ngingei ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Na atnen dinga sathau na buoh ding ahi; tam khu ann sillat ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh na sillat khu khangbel a kikang ann sillat ahileh, tangbuong nel nginngei sathau a kimeh ahi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tamte a kibawl ann sillat khu Mangpa kungah na hing tawi dinga, siempu kungah pieh ahizou chiengin, aman maitam ah ahing tawi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu in ann sillat apat theizingna tanvou alakhe dinga, maitam tungah ahal ding hi. Tam khu Mangpa a dinga gimnamtuitah mei a sillat ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh ann sillata kizangmawhte khu Aaron leh atapate ading ahi ding hi. Tam khu Mangpa a dinga mei a sillatte lah a, asiengthou pen ahi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Mangpa kunga na lat ding ann sillat mawngmawng tol kisaw ahilou ding ahi, aziehpen Mangpa a dinga mei a sillat lah ah tol leh khuoizu na hal lou ding uh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Gamasa sillat ding ahileh pen Mangpa kungah na lan ding hi; hinanleh tuate khu gimnamtui dingin maitam ah akihal sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh na ann sillat chintengah chi nasaw dinga, na Pasian thuhunna chi khu na ann sillatte a na kisapsah louding ahi. Na sillat zousie chi toh na latkhawm ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Na ga masa ann sillatte Mangpa kunga na lat chiengun, na ga masate ann sillat dingin buvui tha mei a kihanggawsa kidengpheng na lan ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Atungah sathau na buoh dinga gimnamtui na koi ding hi; tam khu ann sillat ahi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh siempu in tua bu kidengpheng themkhat leh sathau themkhat tualeh gimnamtui zousie, theizingna tanvou toh ahal ding ahi; khumkhu Mangpa dinga mei a sillat ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh asillat khu lemna sillat kithoina ahi a, ganhon lah a alat leh atal ahiei anu ahiei ahilezong Mangpa mai a nuolnabei alan ding hi.","title":"Lemna sillat"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh asillat tungah akhut akoi dinga, kimutuona biehbuh kotbul ah athat dinga, tualeh Aaron tapate siemputen maitam tung kimvel ah sisan athe ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman lemna sillat kithoina mei a sillat Mangpa kungah alan ding hi; a sungthau leh a gilbom tunga athau um zousie leh;"},"4":{"text":"kal nite leh atunga tuomtu a thaute leh asin tunga um athaute leh akalte alakhe ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron tapaten maitam tunga mei kitaw tunga sing kichieng tungah ahal ding uhi, tuakhu Mangpa a dinga mei a sillat gimnamtui tah ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa a dinga lemna sillat kithoina a asillat belam hon lah a ahileh atal hiin anu hitaleh nuolnabei alat ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"A sillat dinga belamnou alat leh Mangpa masang ah alan ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh a sillat tungah akhut angam dinga kimutuona biehbuh maiah athat dinga, Aaron tapaten sisan khu maitam kimvel ah athe ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillat kithoinate apat Mangpa adinga mei a sillat alat ding ahileh amei a um athaute achinggu tanin ala dinga, a sungthaute agilbom thaute leh;"},"10":{"text":"Akal nite tunga athau umte, athepnem a athaute leh asin tuomtu alap leh akalte nangawn alakhe ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tamte siempu in maitam tungah ahal dinga; tam khu Mangpa dinga mei a sillat ann ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh asillat khu kel ahileh Mangpa mai ah alan ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh aman asillat lutung ah akhut angam dinga kimutuona biehbuh mai ah athat dinga tualeh Aaron tapaten asisan khu maitam kimvel ah athe ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh khunah asillat pen alan dinga, Mangpa ading a, mei-a sillat bangin; agilzam tuom athaute leh gilzam thaute leh,"},"15":{"text":"a kal nite leh atunga thaute, athepnem kawma um alapte leh asin leh akalte tuomtu athaute nangawn alakhe ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh khum khu siempuin maitam tungah ahal ding ahi, tuakhu gimnamtui tah dinga mei a sillat ann ahi dinga, athau zousie Mangpa a ahi."},"17":{"text":"Sathau ahiei, sisan ahiei naneh dinguh ahisih chi nahah nasuonte ua dingin zong na tenna mun phot uah, thupieh ahi ding hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah;","title":"Khelna sillatte"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah tambangin genin, bawllou dinga Mangpa’n thu apiehte bangkhat poupou mi’n abawla ana suhkhiel khah a, abangpou zong ana bawltah leh,"},"3":{"text":"Sathau kinusa siempu in mipite tunga mawna tungsah a, khelna abawl leh asil bawlkhiel thoina dingin, Mangpa kungah bawngtal tuoi nuolnabei khat, khelna sillat dingin hing tawi heh."},"4":{"text":"Khum bawngtal khu kimutuona biehbuh kotpi bulah, Mangpa masangah ahing kai dinga, bawngtal lutungah akhut angam dinga, Mangpa mai ah bawngtal athat ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n thaunusa siempu in bawngtal sisan themkhat ala dinga, kimutuona biehbuh ah ahing tawi dinga;"},"6":{"text":"Siempu’n sisan lah ah akhutmete adie lut dinga, sisan themkhat mun siengthou puonzah Bul a, Mangpa maiah sagi vei athe ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh siempu’n kimutuona biehbuh sunga Mangpa masanga gimnamtui halna maitam kii te ah khum sisan ataat dinga, tualeh bawngtal sisan kimutuona biehbuh kotpi bula halmang sillatna maitam bulah asung ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh khiel kithoina bawngtal thau zousie ala dinga, agilzam tuomtu leh agilzama um athaute zousie;"},"9":{"text":"Akal nite leh athepnem kawma alapte leh akal tunga um asin tuom thaute alakhe ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Lemna sillat kithoina bawngtal apat kila bangin; siempu’n halmang sillatna maitam tungah ahal ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh bawngtal vun leh asatel zousie, alutang, akengte, agilzamte, a eeh toh,"},"12":{"text":"a bawngtal luong khu giehphuol pulam a vut buohna mun siengthou khat ah apodoh dinga, sing tungah mei in ahal dinga, vut buohna mun ah ahal ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Tualeh Israel mipi kikhawmten tupmawng hilou a sil abawlkhiel khah ua, mipi mitmu a phuol ahi a; Mangpa’n bawllou dinga thu apiehte lah a khat poupou abawl zieh ua, siemmaw tang ahing ahita ua,"},"14":{"text":"a sil gilou bawl uh theikhieh ahing hileh mipi umkhawmten khiel kithoina dingin bawngtal tuoi khat alan ding ua, kimutuona biehbuh kotbul ah ahing kai ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh mipi umkhawmte upaten Mangpa mai ah bawngtal lutung ah angam ding ua, bawngtal khu Mangpa mai a thalup ahi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh thaunusa siempu in bawngtal sisan khu kimutuona biehbuh ah ahing tawi dinga:"},"17":{"text":"Siempu in akhutme sisan ah adie dinga, Mangpa mai a puonzah masangah sagi vei athe ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh sisan themkhat kimutuona biehbuh a Mangpa mai a um maitam kii te ah ataat dinga, sisan khu halmang sillatna maitam tungah asung ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh athau zousie aladoh dinga maitam tungah ahal ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh tam bawngtal khu khelna sillat dinga abawl bangin abawl dinga; tualeh siempuin amaute dingin lemna abawlpieh dinga, tuachi’n ngaidam ahi ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh khum bawngtal khu giephuol pulam ah a po dinga, bawngtal masa ahal bangin ahal ding hi, tam khu mipi kikhawm te dinga khelna sillat ahi."},"22":{"text":"“Vaihawmtu khat in Mangpa Pasian in bawllou dinga a thupiehte lah a khat poupou theisiemlou zieh a abawlkhiel khah a, siemmaw ahing tan a;"},"23":{"text":"a hisihleh, asilbawl khiel ahing theidoh a ahileh, a sillat dingin keltal nou nuolnabei khat ahing kai ding;"},"24":{"text":"Tua kel lutungah akhut angam dinga; Mangpa mai a halmang sillat athana mun uah athat dinga, tam khu khelna sillat ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh siempu’n khelna sillat sisan themkhat akhutme in ala dinga, halmang sillatna maitam kii te ah ataat ding hi. Tualeh sisan valteng khu halmang sillatna maitam phungah asung bo ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillat kithoina thaute bangin, athau zousie maitam tungah ahal ding hi. Tuachi’n akhelna ziehin siempu in lemna abawlpieh dinga, ngaidam ahita ding hi."},"27":{"text":"“Tualeh mi nautang lah a koi ahiei khat in theisiemlou zieh a, Mangpa’n bawllou ding a athupiehte lah a khat poupou abawla siemmaw atanleh;","ref":"Kisim. 15.27,28"},"28":{"text":"Abawlkhiel na ahing theidoh chiengin, asillat dingin kelnou anu nuolnabei khat ahing kai ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua khelna sillat lutungah akhut angam dinga tuachi’n halmang sillat thana mun ah athat ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh siempu in asisan themkhat akhutme in ala dinga, halmang sillatna maitam kii te ah ataat dinga, sisan valteng maitam zungah a sung bo ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh athau zousie lemna sillat kithoina thaute alah bangun ala sieng ding a tualeh siempu’n Mangpa ading gimnamtui dingin maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Tualeh siempu’n lemna abawlpieh dinga, ngaidam ahi ding."},"32":{"text":"“Tualeh khelna kithoina sillat dinga belamnou ahing tawi leh anu nuolnabei ahing tawi ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Aman khelna sillat lutungah akhut angam dinga, halmang sillat athana mun uah athat ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh siempu’n khelna sillat sisan themkhat akhutme in ala dinga, halmang sillatna maitam kii te ah ataat dinga, sisan valteng khu maitam phungah asungbo ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh lemna kithoina sillat apat belamnou thaute akilahdoh bangin, athau zousie aladoh dinga, siempu in Mangpa a dinga mei a sillat bangin maitam tungah ahal ding hi. Tualeh siempu’n asilbawl khelna a dingin kilemna abawlpieh dinga, ngaidam ahi ding hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi koipou in asil mu ahiei, a thuzah ahiei a, theipitu hinapi a, thukhenna masanga gendoh dinga phut ahi nua azong gennuomlou a, khelna abawl leh, agitlouna maw aman akipuoh ding ahi.","title":"Khelna sillatte"},"2":{"text":"Ahisihleh koipouin gamsa sienglou shi luong ahiei, ganta sienglou luong ahiei, ahisihleh bohkhup a vah ganhing sienglou luong ahiei, atheilou kaala athamkhah leh ama zong sienglou ahi dinga, siemmaw tang ahi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahisihleh, mihinga sienlouna, mi subuathei bangchibang sienlouna hitaleh theikhollou a, athamkhah leh akitheidoh hun chiengin siemmawtang ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahisihleh mi koipouin silhoi hiin sil hoilou hitaleh ngaituona umloukei a, akama akimawh chiema, theipha nawnlou a aumleh atheidoh hun chiengin tam silte lah a khat penpen ah siemmawtang ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahi ding hi, tam silte lah a khat penpen a siemmaw atan chiengin, asil bawlkhiel aphuong ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh khiel kithoina dingin belamhon lah a anu ahiei, kelnoute lah anu ahiei, asil bawlkhiel zieh a Mangpa kunga lat dingin ahing tawi dinga, tuachi’n siempu in akhelna zieh a tatna abawlpieh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tualeh akhelna thoina dinga belamnou ahing tawi zou sihleh vakhu ni ahisihleh palva nou ni Mangpa kunga lat dingin ahing tawi dinga, khatpen khelna sillat dingin, khat pen halmang sillat in alan ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Khumte siempu kungah ahing tawi dinga, khelna sillat pen alan masa dinga, angawng apat alutang ahehtan dinga hinanleh akikhen sah sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh aman khelna sillat sisan themkhat maitam pangah athe dinga; sisan umnalai teng khu maitam zungah aluongkang sah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh halmang sillat ni na pen khu, dan dungzuiin alan dinga; siempu in asilbawl khelsa tungah kilemna abawlpieh dinga, tuachi’n ngaidam ahita ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Hinanleh vakhu ni ahiei, palva ni ahiei, ahing tawi zou sihleh, silbawl khieltu in asillat dingin tangbuong nel ephah sesawm suo sekhat khelna sillat dingin ahing tawi ding hi; sathau abuohkhum sih dinga, atungah gimnamtui zong akoi sih ding hi, tam khu khelna sillat ahi ziehin."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu kungah ahing tawi dinga, siempu in theizingna dingin asipdim khat aham dinga, mei a sillat bangin, Mangpa mai ah maitam tungah ahal ding hi, tami khelna sillat ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin tam silte lah a akhelna pen a dingin kilemna abawl pieh dinga, tuachi’n ngaidam ahi ding hi; avalteng khu ann sillat bangin siempu a ding ahi” ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah;","title":"Khelna sillat tuomtuom"},"15":{"text":"“Mi koipouin Mangpa sil siengthoute tunga, theimasa loua abawl khiel khahleh, abawl khelna sillat dingin belamhon lah a belamtal nuolnabei khat, mun siengthou a shekel bangin dangka shekel bangza ahiei guun a na ngai, suhkhelna sillat dingin Mangpa kungah ahing tawi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh sil siengthou tunga ana bawlkhiel khahte asangkia dinga, se nga suo sekhat abelap dinga, siempu kungah ape ding hi, tualeh abawlkhelna sillat dingin kilemna abawlpieh dinga, ngaidam ahi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tualeh mi koipouin, Mangpa’n bawllou dinga athupieh silte khat poupou theilou in bawlkhata leh thei sih nanleh zong maw apo thouthou ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh belamhon lah a belamtal nuolnabei, nangma ngai a kilawm hun nasah khat, siempu kungah bawlkhelna sillat dingin ahing tawi ding hi; tuachi’n theilou a sil ana bawlkhelna tung thu ah siempu in ama a dingin kilemna abawl pieh dinga, ngaidam ahi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tami bawlkhelna sillat ahi, Mangpa tungah abawlkhiel a siemmaw atang hi,” achi hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah;","title":"Bawlkhelna sillat","ref":"Kisim. 5.5-8"},"2":{"text":"“Mi koipouin sil abawlkhiel a, Mangpa thupiehte abawsiet a, sum kikep sah thu ahiei, solbawla lepguhna ahiei, guhpieh thu ahiei a, a innvengte sola azuou bawl leh."},"3":{"text":"Ahisihleh van kimangsah mu in, ka mu sih chiin zuou genin dihloutahin kichiem taleh zong, tam silte zousie khat poupou abawl khiel leh:"},"4":{"text":"Hichi ahi ding hi: sil bawlkhiel ngel ahi a, siemmaw atan ziehin avan guhte, zuouthu a asil lahte, akunga sum kikem sahte leh van mang a mute;"},"5":{"text":"Ahisihleh dihloutah a akichiemna zousiete, asan kia ding ahi; akim keiin asangkia sieng dinga, senga suo sekhat abelap ding hi, tualeh asil bawlkhelna sillat abawl niin aneitu kungah apeding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh akhelna sillat dingin belamhon lah a, belamtal nuolnabei, kilawmhun nasah khat khelna kithoina sillat dingin siempu kungah ahing tawi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu in Mangpa mai ah ama a dingin kilemna abawlpieh dinga, akhelna zousie ngaidam ahita ding hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupia, akungah;","title":"Halmang sillat"},"9":{"text":"“Aaron leh atapate kungah, Tami halmang sillat dan ding ahi: halmang sillat pen maitam tunga ahalna ah zan tungtawn in, zingmawng dongin a um dinga, tualeh maitam a mei khu akuong ngitnget ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh siempu in apuonmalngat puonsil asil dinga, asatung khuna dingin apuonmalngat tawka ateng ding hi, tualeh maitam a halmang sillat kangvamte ala dinga, maitam pangah akoi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua apuonsilte asutkhe dinga, puonsil dangte asil dinga, avamte giehphuol pulam a mun sieng khat ah ava sungbo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh maitam tunga mei khu akuongsah ngitnget dinga, amitsah ngai sih ding hi. Tuachi’n siempu in zingmawng chinin sing avang zel dinga, halmang sillat hoitahin akoi dinga, khunah lemna sillatte sathau ahal ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Maitam tungah mei akuong ngitnget dinga, amit ngai sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tualeh tam khu ann sillat danding ahi: Aaron tapaten Mangpa mai a maitam tungah alan ding uhi.","title":"Ann sillat"},"15":{"text":"Aman tangbuong leh sathau sipdim khat leh ann sillat tunga gimnamtui um zousie aladoh dinga, Mangpa a dinga gimnamtuitah, theizingna dingin maitam tungah ahal ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh avalteng Aaron leh atapaten aneh ding uh ahi: tanghou tolsawlou toh mun siengthou ah ane ding ua, kimutuona biehbuh huongsungah ane ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tol toh mehkhawm a kan ding ahi sih hi, tam mei a ka sillatte khu, atanvou ding ua ka pieh ahita, khelna sillat bang leh bawlkhelna sillat banga siengthou pen ahi."},"18":{"text":"Aaron hahlesuon pasal zousie’n aneh ding uh ahi. Tam pen Mangpa dinga mei a sillat tung thu a, na khang tungtawn ua, kumtawna dinga thugousie ahi dinga, koi zong tami tham pouma asiengthou ahi ding uhi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah;"},"20":{"text":"“Tami Aaron leh atapaten sathau nu a aum ni chieng ua, Mangpa kunga alat dinguh sillat ahi; ann sillat dinga latzom ngitnget ding tangbuong nel ephah sesawm suo sekhat zingmawng in akimkhat, nitahin akimkhat."},"21":{"text":"Khumte sathau toh mehkhawm in khangbel sunga na kan zou chiengin na hing lalut dinga, ann sillat apheng neu nou nou a kikang Mangpa a dinga gimnamtui dingin na lan ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Atapate lah a Aaron taanga pang ding mi, sathaunu siempu in alan dinga, kumtawn dan ahi a, haltum sieng ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Siempu in alat ann sillat pouma haltum sieng ding ahia, koiman aneh louding ahi.”"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah;","title":"Khelna sillat"},"25":{"text":"“Aaron leh atapate kungah tambangin gen in, Tam khu khelna kithoina sillat ding dan ahi; halmang sillat kithazelna munah, khelna sillat zong Mangpa mai a tha ahi ding hi, tuakhu sil siengthou pen ahi."},"26":{"text":"Khelna kithoina sillat lantu siempu in tami ane dinga, kimutuona biehbuh huongsung mun siengthou ah ane ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Koipou tua sa thamkha pouma asiengthou ding uhi. Tualeh asisan in bang puon hitaleh zong athekhah leh sisan banna puon pouma mun siengthou ah na sawp ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh akihuonna leibel khu satkeh ahi dinga, sum-eng bel a kihuon ahileh nawt sienga tui a khuo sieng ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Siempute lah a pasal zousie’n tami ane thei ding ua, tam khu asiengthou pen ahi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh mun siengthou pen sunga kilemna, sillat dinga, kimutuona biehbuh a hing kitawi sisan khu neh ding ahisih a, haltum ding ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tuachimabangin tam khu tatkhelna sillat dan ahia; a siengthou pen ahi.","title":"Tatkhelna sillatdan"},"2":{"text":"Halmang sillat athana mun ma uah, tatkhelna sillat zong athat ding uhi, tualeh asisan khu maitam kimvel ah athe ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh athau zousie alan ding ua, amei thau leh asung thaute,"},"4":{"text":"a kal nite leh atunga a thau umte leh athepnem a alap umte leh asin tuomtu athau leh akalte toh alakhe sieng ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Siempuin tuate khu Mangpa a dinga mei a sillat dingin maitam tungah ahal ding hi. Tam khu tatkhelna sillat ahi."},"6":{"text":"Siempute lah a pasal pouma in tam khu ane ding ua, mun siengthou a neh ahi ding hi, tami asiengthou pen ahi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tatkhielna kithoina khu khelna kithoina sillat bang ahi a, ani ua dingin dan khat ahi; tuabang kithoina lantu siempu in atang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh siempu koizong halmang sillat lat piehtu tua siempu ngeiin halmang sillat alat vunte atang ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh akan a kanthaw ann sillat leh khangbel leh kuonga kan zousie alantu siempu a ahi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh ann sillat sathau toh kimehkhawm ahisihleh akigawsah zousie Aaron tapaten kibang chiet in atang ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"“Tam khu min Mangpa kunga alat ding lemna kithoina sillat dan ahi.","title":"Lemna sillatte"},"12":{"text":"Kipahthugenna dinga lat ahileh, kipahthugenna kithoina dingin sathau toh kihal tolsawlou tanghou toh kimehkhawm, sathau kinu tanghou pheng toh, sa toh kimehkhawm tangbuong nel kikang toh alat khawm ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tanghou phengte chilou zong, kipah thugenna kithoina dinga lemna sillat kithoina ah tol kisaw tanghou zong alat tel ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh tam sillatte apat, Mangpa a dinga sillat dingin, khat chiet alan dinga, tuakhu lemna sillatte sisan thetu siempu’n atang ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Kipahthugenna dinga lemna sillat kithoina sa pen, sillat alat ni ma a nehbei ding ahia, azingmawng donga bangma themkhat zong koi lou ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh kithoina sillat khu, kichiemna ahiei, ahisihleh ama ut thu a sillat ahileh akithoina lat ni mama a neh zou ding ahi a, avalteng khu azingni chienga neh thei ahi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahivang in kithoina sa nithum donga um nalai teng khu mei a haltum ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Lemna sillat kithoina sa anithum donga neh ahileh, pompieh ahisih dinga, alantu zong alan a sim ahisih ding hi: Tam khu sil sienglou ahi dinga, koizong ane pouma in amaw akipuoh ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"“Tualeh sa silsienglou toh kisukha mawngmawng neh louding ahi, mei a haltum ding ahi. Tualeh sa sieng pouma asiengthou tengin aneh ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa tantuom lemna sillat kithoina sa netu khu, amite lah apat tuom koi ahi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuathamlouin koipouin sil sienglou mawngmawng, mi sienglou ahiei, ganta sienglou ahiei, sil sienglou kidah huoi ahiei, akhoi khah a, lemna sillat kithoina sa Mangpa tantuom aneh leh tuabang mi khu amite lah a pat tuom koi ahi ding hi, chiin gen in achi hi.”"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah;","title":"Sathau leh sisan nehlou ding ahi"},"23":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah Bawngtal ahiei, belam ahiei, kel ahiei, thau na neh lou ding uh ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh gamsa ama thu a shite thau leh gamsa in athalup thau khu sil dangah zahthei ahi dinga, hinanleh naneh hetlou dinguh ahi."},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen koipouin Mangpa adinga mei a sillat alat uh sathau ne mihing pouma amite lah a pat koituom ahi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuathamlouin na umna pou uah sisan mawngmawng va sisan hiin sa sisan hitaleh na neh votlou ding uh ahi.","ref":"Siem. 9.4; Siempu. 17.10-14; 19.26; Danp. 12.16,23; 15.23"},"27":{"text":"Koipou sisan ne pouma, tua mihing khu amite lah apat tuom koi ding ahi,” chi’n genin achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah;","title":"Siempu tanvou"},"29":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah: Koipou Mangpa kunga lemna kithoina sillat lanten, Mangpa kungah alemna sillat ahing tawi ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ama khut ngel in Mangpa adinga mei a sillat ahing tawi dinga, athau leh a awm ahing tawi ding hi, tua pen Mangpa mai a vei sillat ding a vei ahitheina dingin."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh athaupen siempu in maitam tungah ahal dinga: a awm pen ahileh Aaron leh atapate tanvou ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Amal zietlam pen lemna kithoina sillat apat sillat dingin siempu kunga na pieh ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Aaron tapate lah a lemna sillat sisan leh sathau lan penpen in samal zietlam atan ding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Aziehpen a awm leh amal veilam pen, Israel tate lah a lemna kithoina sillat akipat ka lata a, siempu Aaron leh atapate kungah Israel tate kumtawn dan thupieh dingin ka peta hi."},"35":{"text":"Tami ahi amaute siempu nasem dinga sathau akinu ni ua, Israel taten apieh ding ua, Mangpa’n thu apieh mei a sillat apat Aaron tanvou leh atapate tanvou ding khu."},"36":{"text":"Israel taten apieh dinguh chia, amaute sathau anu ni a, akhangtan ua kumtawn dan thupieh dinga thu apieh khu ahi.”"},"37":{"text":"Tami khu halmang sillat, ann sillat, khelna thoina sillat, bawlkhelna sillat, kisuhsiengna sillat leh lemna kithoina sillat, kithoina dan ahi."},"38":{"text":"Sinai gamdai a Mangpa’n Israel taten akithoina uh Mangpa kunga lan dinga thu apieh nia, Sinai tanga Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh khu ahi, chiin genin achi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah;","title":"Aaron leh atapate kisuhsiengthouna"},"2":{"text":"“Aaron leh atapate zawpi inlen, puonsilte toh, kisiensuona a nu ding sathau toh, khelna sillat ding bawngtal toh belamtal ni leh tolsawlou tanghou tawi inlen;"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh mi zousie kimutuona biehbuh kotbul ah han khawm in chiin agen hi.”"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Mangpa thupieh bangin abawl a, mipi zousie kimutuona biehbuh kotbul ah ahing kikhawmta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in mipi hing peikhawmte kungah; “Tami Mangpa’n bawl dinga thu ahing pieh khu ahi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuazouin Mosi in Aaron leh atapate ahing zawpi a, tui in asil hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh puonah asilsah a, kawnggah in agah a, puonah tuol asilsah a, siempu puonah in atuom a, siemtah a kigan siempu puonah gahna in agah a akhita hi.","title":"Siempu puonsilte"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu awmphaw abel pieh a, a awmphaw tungah Urim leh thumim akoi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh siempu diel alu ah akhipsah a Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu apieh bangin dielkhip tungah amailam zawn ah sana peh, lallukhu sieng akhai pieh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in kinuthaw sathau ala a, biehbuh leh asunga um zousie sathau anu a, asusiengthou tahi.","title":"Sathau nuna"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh maitam tungah sagi vei athe a, maitam leh umlebel zousie, tui kuong leh atunna siensuona dingin sathau anu hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh siensuona sathau khu Aaron lutungah asunga, asiensuona dingin sathau anu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuazouin Mosi in Aaron tapate ahing zawpi a puonah tungsil asilsah a, kawnggah in agah a, lukhu akhuhsah chiet hi, Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh khelna kithoina sillat bawngtal ahing kai a, Aaron leh atapaten khelna sillat bawngtal lutungah akhut uh angam ua:","title":"Sisan a siensuona"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in athat a, tuachi’n asisan ala a, akhutmete in maitam kiite ah ataat a, maitam asusieng thou a, tualeh sisan khu maitam phungah abuo a kilemna bawlna dingin asiensuota hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n agilzam tunga athau zousie leh asin tuomtu alap leh akalte gel a athau umte aladoh a, Mosi in khumte maitam tungah ahal hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh bawngtal khu avun leh asa tualeh a eeh toh giehphuol pulam ah ahal hi, Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh halmang sillat belamtal ahing kai a, Aaron leh atapaten belamtal lutungah akhut uh angam ua;"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in athat a, asisan maitam kimvel ah athe hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh belamtal khu asem a, alutang leh asa tualeh athaute Mosi in ahaltum hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh agilzamte leh akengte tuiin asawpa; Mosi in belamtal pumpi maitam tungah ahal hi; tami halmang sillat leh Mangpa adinga gimnamtui dinga mei a sillat ahi; Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh aman belamtal nina kisuhsiengthouna belamtal khu ahing kai a; tuachi’n Aaron leh atapaten belamtal lutungah akhut uh angam ua."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in athat a, asisan themkhat ala a, Aaron zietlam bildawn, azietlam khutpi dawn, azietlam kengpi dawn, ah anu pieh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron tapate ahing zawpi a, Mosi in sisan themkhat azietlam bil dawn u’leh azietlam khutpi dawn u’leh azietlam kengpi dawn uah anu pieh chiet hi. Tualeh sisan khu maitam tung kimvel ah athe hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh aman athaute, amei thaute, asung thau zousie, asin tuom athaute, akal tegel leh athaute leh azietlam mal a la a."},"26":{"text":"Mangpa mai a um tolsawlou tanghou bawm apat tanghou pheng khat leh sathau a kimeh tanghou pheng khat leh tanghou pheng pan khat aladoh a, maitam tungah akoi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh aman tamte zousie Aaron leh atapate khut sungah akoi a, Mangpa mai a sillat in alan hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in akhut ua pat ala khie a, maitam a halmang sillat tungah ahal hi: Tamte khu gimnam tui dinga Mangpa mai a kisuhsiengthouna ahi, tami Mangpa dinga mei a sillat ahi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in a awm ala a, Mangpa maiah vei sillat dingin avei a, kisuhsiengthouna belamtal ahileh Mosi tantuom ahi; Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu apieh bangin."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in kisiensuona sathau themkhat leh maitam tunga um sisan ala a, Aaron leh apuonsilte leh atapate leh apuonsilte uh tungah athe hi; tuachi’n Aaron leh apuonsilte leh atapate leh apuonsilte uh asiensuota hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Aaron leh atapate kungah, “Kimutuona biehbuh kotbulah asa huon unlen, tua mun ah Aaron leh atapaten aneh ding uh ahi chia ka hing thupieh bangin, tuakhu kisiensuona bawma tanghou toh ne un.","title":"Siempute Biehbuh a um ding"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh asa leh tanghou valteng khu meiin na haltum ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh na kisiansuoni uh abei masangsien ni sagi sung kimutuona biehbuh kot pulam a na pawt lou ding uh ahi. Aziehpen aman ni sagi sung ahing siensuo ding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Tunia abawltah bangin, nou dinga kilemna bawl ding, Mangpa’n thu apeta hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuaziehin kimutuona biehbuh kotpi bul ah ni sagi sung sunlezan na um ding ua, na shi louna dingun Mangpa thupieh na zui ding uhi; aziehpen tuabanga bawl ding thu ka hing pie ahi,” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron leh atapaten, Mangpa’n Mosi zanga athupieh zousie abawl uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, ani gietni in Mosi in Aaron leh atapate leh Israel upate ahankhawm a;","title":"Siempu a ding sillatte"},"2":{"text":"Aaron kungah, “Khelna sillat dingin bawngtal guol khat; halmang sillat a dingin belamtal nuolnabei khat la inlen, Mangpa mai ah lan in, a chi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate kungah, thu na gen dinga, khelna sillat dingin kelnou khat, halmang sillat dingin bawngnou khat leh belamnou kumkhat tuoh nuolnabei ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Lemna sillat dingin bawngtal khat leh belam khat, Mangpa mai a kithoina dingin hingkai unlen, tualeh sathau a kimeh ann sillat toh: tuni’n na kung uah Mangpa hing kilang ding ahi chi’n hil in,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in thu apieh bangin kimutuona biehbuh mai ah ahing kai ua, mipi kikhawmte zousien ahing nai khawm ua, Mangpa mai ah ading uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in, “Tami Mangpa’n na bawl ding ua, ahing thupieh ahi, tuachi’n Mangpa thupina na kung uah akilang ding hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Aaron kungah “Maitam ah pei inlen na khelna sillat leh na halmang sillat va lan inlen, nang a ding leh mipite a dingin kilemna bawlin, tualeh mipite sillat lan inlen ama ua dingin kilemna bawlpieh in, Mangpa thupieh bangin,” achi hi.","ref":"Heb. 7.27"},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aaron in maitam avazuon a khelna sillat bawngnou khu ama a dingin athat a."},"9":{"text":"Aaron tapaten asisan akungah ahing tawi ua, tualeh aman akhutmete sisan ah adie a, maitam kii te anu a, sisan khu maitam zungah a sung hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh khelna sillat thau leh akal nite leh a sin tuomtu alapte khu maitam tung ah ahal a, Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin."},"11":{"text":"Asa leh avun khu giehphuol pulam ah meiin ahal hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh aman halmang sillat khu athat a, Aaron tapaten asisan akungah ahing tawi ua, aman khumte maitam tung kimvel ah athe hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh amauten halmang sillat khu abat bat in asem ua, alu tawh akungah ahing tawi ua, aman tuate khu maitam ah ana hal hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh aman agilzamte leh akengte tuiin asawp a, maitam ah halmang sillat tungah ahal hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman mipite sillat ahing tawi a, mipite dinga khelna sillat kel ala a, athat a, amasa bangin khelna thoina dingin alan hi.","title":"Mipite dinga sillat"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh halmang sillat ahing tawi a, dan dungzuiin alan hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh tangbuong sillat ahing tawi a, sipdim khat aham a, zingmawng halmang kithoina chilou zong maitam ah ahal hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh mipite adinga lemna sillat kithoina dingin bawngtal leh belamtal zong athat a, Aaron tapaten asisan kuongah ahing tawi ua, tuakhu aman maitam tung kimvel ah athe hi.","ref":"Siempu. 3.1-11"},"19":{"text":"Bawngtal leh belamtal thaute leh amei thaute leh asung thaute, akal nite leh asin tuomtu alapte zong apie ua;"},"20":{"text":"Athaute khu a awm tungah akoi ua, aman athaute khu maitam ah ahal hi."},"21":{"text":"A awmte leh azietlam mal khu Aaron in Mangpa mai ah vei sillat in avei hi, Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin."},"22":{"text":"Aaron in mipite lam ah aban azah a, amaute a guolzawl a, khelna sillat, halmang sillat leh lemna sillatte alat zouin ahing kum suh hi.","title":"Mangpa’n sillatte apom","ref":"Kisim. 6.22-26"},"23":{"text":"Mosi leh Aaron khu kimutuona biehbuh sungah alut ua, tualeh ahing pawtdoh kia ua, mipite aguolzawl ua, tualeh Mangpa thupina khu mi zousie kungah ahing kilang hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa mai a kipan in mei ahing pawtdoh a, maitam tunga halmang sillat leh sathaute akatumta hi, khum khu mipi zousie’n amu ua, akikou ua, amai ua tuolsu in akhupbohta uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron tapate Nadab leh Abihu in amei bawm uh ala tuoh ua, asungah mei akoi ua, atung ah gimnamtui abuoh ua, Mangpa mai ah, Aman thu apiehlou mei tuom dang alanta uhi.","title":"Nadab leh Abihu khelna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa a kipat in mei ahing pawtdoh a, amaute a katum a, Mangpa mai ah ashita uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Aaron kungah, “Mangpa’n ka kungnai a hing pei poumate ah suh siengthou in ka um dinga, tualeh mi zousie masangah pahtawi in ka um ding, chia a gen khu tami ahi achia, tuachi’n Aaron hamlou keiin a um hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Aaron pa neu Uzziel tapate Mishael leh Elzaphan ahan a, akung uah, “Hing nai unlen, mun siengthou mai a kipat in na unaute uh luong giephuol pulam ah paw doh un,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n ava zuon ua, apuon tungsilte ua man in amaute giephuol pulam ah azawngdoh ta uhi, Mosi genbangin."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Aaron leh atapate Eleazar leh Ithamar kungah, “Na lu uh hawhdoh sih unlen, na puonte u’zong botkeh sih un: tuachilouin vang shi khava uchin, mipite zousie tungah alungthahna ahing tungkha ding hi. Hinanleh na unaute uh, Mangpa akipat mei in akahtumte, Israel innkuon zousie in suun uheh."},"7":{"text":"Kimutuona biehbuh kot pulam a na pawtdohlou ding uh ahi, tuachilouin na shi kha ding uhi, aziehpen Mangpa namdetna sathaunu khu na tung uah um ahi” achia, tuachi’n amauten Mosi gen bangin abawlta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Aaron ahoupi a, akungah;","title":"Siempute sillat ding dan"},"9":{"text":"“Nang na hiei, na tapate ahiei in zong kimutuona biehbuh sunga na lut chiengun zu leh zuchia dawn sih un, tuachilouin na shikha ding uhi; tami na khangtungtawn ua kumtawn a dinga thugousie ahi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuatekhu nouten sil siengthou leh siengthoulou, tualeh a sieng leh sienglou nakhen theina ding u’leh;"},"11":{"text":"Mangpa’n Mosi zanga akung ua agen thupieh zousie Israel tate na zilsah theina uh ahi ding hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Aaron leh atapa um nalaite Eleazar leh Ithamar kungah, “Mangpa a dinga mei a sillatte a, ann sillat valte la unlen maitam pang ah tanghou tolsawlou toh ne un, tuakhu sil siengthou pen ahi.","title":"Eleazar leh Ithamar khelna","ref":"Siempu. 6.14-18"},"13":{"text":"Tam khu mun siengthou khat a na neh ding uh ahi; aziehpen tami Mangpa a dinga mei a sillat kithoina apat nangleh na tapate tanvou ahi, tuabanga bawl dingin thupieh in ka um hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh sillat a awm leh azietlam mal pen nang leh na tapate leh na tanuten mun sieng khat a na neh ding uh ahi; aziehpen tuate khu, Israel tate lemna sillat kithoina apat hing kipie nang leh na tapate tanvou ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 7.30-34"},"15":{"text":"Vei sillat mal leh vei sillat awm khu Mangpa mai a vei sillat dingin, mei a sillat sathau toh ahing tawi ding uhi, tami nang leh na kunga um na tapate tanvou dinga kumtawn thugousie ahi, Mangpa’n thu ahing pieh bangin, a chi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in khelna sillat kel pen pilvang tahin a suichiena, hinanleh ana haltumta uhi. Tuachi’n Aaron tapa dam a um nalai Eleazar leh Ithamar tungah alungthah mama hi."},"17":{"text":"“Bangdinga khelna kithoina sillat sa mun siengthou khat a nelou nahi uoi? Tami sil siengthou pen ahi ngal a, tualeh Pasian in mipite gitlouna paw dinga, Mangpa mai a lemna bawlpiehna dinga noute ahing pieh ahi thuoi a.","ref":"Siempu. 6.24-26"},"18":{"text":"Envawi un tami sisan mun siengthou sunga ki tawilut lou ahi; thu ka hing pieh banga mun siengthou a na neh ding uh ahi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron in Mosi kungah, “Ngaivawi tuni’n amauten a khelna sillat u’leh ahalmang sillat uh Mangpa mai ah alanta uhi; tambang sil ka tungah ahing tungta mawh hi; tuni’n khelna kithoina sillat anane hitaleng Mangpa mitmu ah pomtah ahina diei” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in khum khu azahin alungkimta hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron ahoupi a, akung uah","title":"Asa neh thei gantate"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah gen unlen Leitunga gamsa zousie lah a naneh dinguh sate khu tamte ahi."},"3":{"text":"Sate lah a kengchin kaa peisuoh tualeh annkia hai pouma na neh thei ding uh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh annkia hai a achinkaate lah ah tamte nane thei sih ding uhi; sangawngsau bang annkia hai hinanleh achin akaalou ziehin nou a dingin a sienglou ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh kawl zupi zong khahai nanleh achin akaalou ziehin nou a dingin asienglou ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh bilpi kha hai nanleh achin kaalou ahi ziehin nou a dingin a sienglou ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh voh achin kaa peisuoh nanleh annkia hailou ahi ziehin nou a dingin a sienglou ahi."},"8":{"text":"Asa uh naneh lou dinguh aluong uh zong na khoilou ding uh ahi, nou a dingin asienglou ahi.","title":"Tuisunga um ganhing nehlou dingte"},"9":{"text":"“Tui sunga um zousie lah ah tamte na neh thei dingte uh ahi: Tuipite, luite leh tui sunga um hanei leh lip neite na nethei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh tui sunga um ganhing ha leh lip neiloute nou a dinga sienglou ahi ziehin na ne thei sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute nou a dingin sil kidahhuoi ahi ding ua, asa u’zong na nehlou dinguh ahia, ashi luongte u’zong sil kidahhuoi a na ngai dinguh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tui sunga um ha leh lip neilou zousie nou a dinga sienglou ahi."},"13":{"text":"“Tualeh tungleeng vate lah a kidahhuoi a na ngai ding u’leh asa na neh lou dinguh tamte ahi: Langta, muvanlai, tuivapi.","title":"Tungleeng va nehlou dingte"},"14":{"text":"Mukhau leh muvompi leh mu poupou,"},"15":{"text":"Va ah chi zousie"},"16":{"text":"Simbu, vabah, va ngawngsau, tuiva kaang leh musi chi zousie."},"17":{"text":"Simbu tanglit, kaikuonggal, tui simbupi"},"18":{"text":"Tui vatawt, va bungah leh simbu kaang,"},"19":{"text":"Inntung va leh tuiva kengsang chi pouma, suongpal leh baah ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Ha nei a leng ganhing kengli a lampei pouma nou a dinga kidahhuoi ahi uhi.","title":"Hanei ganhingte"},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh hanei a kengli a lampei ganhingte lah a, leitunga kitawmna dinga akengpeh tung ua keng kituona neite nane thei ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuate lah a naneh theiding uh tamte ahi, khaukhup chi pouma leh khaukhup mul neilou pouma, khuomkhit chi pouma leh khuongbai chi chinteng,"},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh ganhing hanei a, keng li nei dang zousie nou a dingin sil kidahhuoi ahi."},"24":{"text":"“Tualeh tamte ziehin sienglou nahi ding uh: Koipou khumte shi luong thamkha pouma nitah dongin sienglou ahi ding uhi.","title":"Ganta siengloute"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh koipou tamte shi luong pokha pouma in apuonte asawp dinga, nitah dongin sienglou ahi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ganta achin kaa peisuohlou, kha zong hailou pouma nou a dingin a sienglou ahi, koipou tuabangte thamkha pouma asienglou ahi ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Kengli apei ganhing zousie lah ah akengchinte pansan a vah pouma nou adingin asienglou ahi, khumte shi luong thamkha pouma nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh koipou ashi luonguh pokha pouma in apuonte uh asawp ding ua, nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding uhi. Amaute khu nou a dinga sienglou ahi uhi."},"29":{"text":"“Leitunga a awm a kithol a bohvah te lah a, nou a dinga siengloute khu Bui, chiapi chi pouma,","title":"Abohvah ganhing siengloute"},"30":{"text":"Innhih, talmam, tang, thangkhit, senel thangkhit."},"31":{"text":"Aboh a vahte lah ah tamte nou a dinga sienglou ahi; koipou tam ganhingte a shisa thamkha khu nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh koipou tamte lah a, ashisa in akhiehkhum khah pouma asienglou ahi dinga; singa kibawl umlebel ahiei, puonsil ahiei, savun ahiei, sai ip ahiei hinanleh akizang silkhat poupou ahileh tui a dia ding ahia, nitah donga sienglou ahi ding hi, tuachi’n ahing siengta ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh lei a kibawl umlebel tam ganhingte kiehlutna pouma khu, asunga um pouma sienglou ahi dinga, satguoi ding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh khum umlebelte a nehledawn umpouma khum tuiin abuoh khah zousie a sienglou ahi dinga, tualeh dawn ding sil khat poupou khum umlebelte a kikoi zousie a sienglou ahi ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh bangchibang sil hitaleh tam ganhing shisa luongin akhiehkhum leh anet khahna pouma abua ahi dinga, tanghou kanna khangbel ahiei, akanlumna ahiei zong satsiet ding ahia, nou adingin asienglou ahi ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Hinanleh tuikhuh ahiei, tuibem ahiei, tuitampi umna tuikulte asieng dinga, hinanleh aluonguh khoikha pouma asienglou ahi ding uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh haichi tu dinga kikoi, tam ganhing shisa luong heisung lai pou in akhiehkhum leh abua ahi ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh tui a kidiesa haichi tunga aluong uh atuh khah leh zong nou a dingin asienglou ahi ding hi."},"39":{"text":"“Tualeh asa na neh thei uh ganta zong ashisa luong koipouin athamkhah leh nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding hi.","title":"Ganhing siengthou luong khoikhate"},"40":{"text":"Tualeh koipou ashisa sa nekha pouma in apuonte asawp dinga, nitah dongin asienglou ahi dinga, koipou ashisa luong puo in zong a puonte a sawp dinga, nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding hi."},"41":{"text":"“Leitunga khupboh a vah ganhing pouma sil kidahhuoi ahi ua, na neh ding uh ahi sih hi."},"42":{"text":"Agil a kithol leh keng li a vah pouma ahiei, ahisihleh leitunga bohvahte lah a keng tampi nei pouma na nehlou ding uh ahi, aziehpen sil kidahhuoi ahi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Akhupboh a vah ganhing mawngmawnga na kisuhbua lou ding uh ahi; na kisuhthanghuoi louna dingun, khumte a na kisuhbua ding uh ahi sih."},"44":{"text":"Aziehpen kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi, tuaziehin na kisusieng ding ua na sienthou ding uh ahi, aziehpen kei ka siengthou hi: leitunga khupboh a vah ganhing bangma a, na kisuhbua lou ding uh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.2; 1 Pet. 1.16"},"45":{"text":"Na Pasian uh hidinga Izipt gam a kipat a hing puidoh Mangpa khu ka hi, tuaziehin kei ka sienthou banga noute zong na sienthou ding uh ahi.”"},"46":{"text":"Tami khu gamsate, vate tualeh tui lah a um ganhing chinteng leh leitunga khupboh a vah ganhing chinteng toh kisai a dante ahi."},"47":{"text":"Sienglou leh sieng khenna ding leh sa nehthei chi leh neitheilou chi khenna dingin chiin, achi hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah:","title":"Nau nei zou chienga numeite siensahna dan"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah genin, Numei in nau apai a, tapasal anei leh ni sagi sung asienglou ahi dinga, aniin nei hunlai banga sienglou ahi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ani giet ni in atep atanpieh ding ahi.","ref":"Siem. 17.12; Luk. 2.21"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n sisan apat kisiensuona dingin ni sawmthumle thum sung zia atang ding hi, akisiensuoni atun masangsie sil sieng mawngmawng atham sih dinga, mun siengthou ah zong apei sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh tanumei anei leh aniin neilai bangin hapta ni sung sienglou ahi dinga, tualeh amanu sisan apat akisiensuona dingin ni sawm guh leh guh sung zia atang ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tualeh akisiensuona nite abuchin chiengin tapasal ahiei, tanumei ahiei a dingin halmang sillat a dingin belamnou kum khat a upa khat leh khelna kithoina sillat a dingin vakhu ni ahiei, palva ni ahiei, siempu kungah, kimutuona biehbuh ah ahing tawi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Khum khu aman Mangpa maiah alan dinga, amanu dingin lemna abawl pieh dinga, tuachi’n asisan pawtna apat siensuo ahita ding hi; tami pasal ahiei, numei ahiei, neinu adinga dan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n belamnou ahing tawi zou sih leh vakhu ni ahiei, palvanou ni ahiei ahing tawi dinga, khat halmang sillat dingin adang khat pen khelna sillat dingin; tualeh siempu in amanu dingin kilemna abawl pieh dinga asiengthouta ding hi,” chiin achi hi.","ref":"Luk. 2.24"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron ahoupi a, akung uah,","title":"Phahnatna theina dan"},"2":{"text":"“Mi khat in achitunga apawm ahiei, akhem ahiei, aphol ahiei, anei a phah natna hileh kilawm atahsa vun tunga a umleh, siempu Aaron kung ahiei, siempu a pang atapate khat penpen kunga pui ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh siempu in tahsa tunga natna khu a en dinga, anatna umna mun a amul akan a, anatna pen avun sanga thuhzaw a akimu leh phah natna ahi, siempu in ama a en dinga, sienglou chi’n aphuong ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Atahsa tunga pholte akaan a hinanleh avun sanga thuhzaw a akimulou a, amulte akanlou leh siempu in natna nei mi khu nisagi sung atuom koi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh siempu in nisagi ni in ama a endinga, anatna angai ngai ahi a, avun tunga abantawn sihleh nisagi sungma atuom koi kia ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh siempu in nisagi ni in ama a en kia dinga, anatna avun tunga abantawn sihleh siempu in ama pen asiengthou chiin aphuong ding hi, tami akhem mai mai ahia apuonte asawp dinga, a siengta ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh siempu in a etchien nua a, ahima avun tunga abantawn leh siempu aki ensah kia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Siempu in a et a, ahima khu avun tunga ana bantawn leh siempuin asienglou chi’n a phuong dinga, tami khu phah natna ahi."},"9":{"text":"“Mi’n phah natna avom leh ama khu siempu kunga pui ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Siempu in a en dinga, ngaiin avun pawm khu akan a, amul zong akan sah a ahima khu adup deldul leh,"},"11":{"text":"Tami khu atahsa vun tunga phah kumlui um ahia, siempu in ama khu sienglou chi’n aphuong dinga, a tuom koi sih ding hi, aziehpen sienglou ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh aphah pen avun tunga azam zah a, phah natna neipa vun zousie alutang apat akengphang tan siempu etna zousie atuom suohleh;"},"13":{"text":"Siempu in angaituo dinga, ngaiin, phah in asatung zousie atuom suoh leh siempu in natna neipa khu asieng chi’n aphuong ding hi, akaang siengta a, ama khu asiengthou ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh asa adup deldul leh ama khu asienglou ahi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh siempu in asa dup deldul khu a en dinga, ama khu sienglou chin a phuong ding hi, aziehpen adup deldul pen asienglou ahia, tam khu phah ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahisihleh asa dup deldul khu akihena, ahing kandoh leh siempu kungah apei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Siempu in ana en dinga, ngaiin anatna ana kan tah a ahileh siempuin natna nei mi khu asieng chi’n aphuong dinga, asieng ahi."},"18":{"text":"“Tualeh atahsa vun tunga uilut um khu ana dam a;"},"19":{"text":"Uilut umna mun a akaang pawm ahiei akaang sansim ahiei ahing um leh siempu kunga etsah ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh siempu in a et chienga avun sanga thuhzaw a amu a, amul zong ana kantah leh siempu in ama khu asienglou chi’n aphuong ding hi. Tami khu uilut umna nua a phah hing umdoh ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh siempu in a et a, ngaivawi, mul kaang ana umlou a, vun sanga athuhzawh sih a, adup maimai ahileh, siempu in nisagi atuom koi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh avun a azamthang leh siempu in ama asienglou chi’n aphuong dinga, tami phah natna tahtah ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh adup maimai pen a umna ngai a aum den a azamthang sihleh uilut khem maimai ahi a, siempu in asiengthou chi’n a phuong ding hi."},"24":{"text":"“Ahisihleh atahsa vun mei kahna hing duo doh dup ahiei, kaang ahiei ahileh;"},"25":{"text":"Siempuin ana en dinga, ahing duo dohna mun a amul akan a, avun sanga thuhzaw a akilat leh mei kahna apat hing umdoh phah ahi, tuaziehin siempu in ama khu sienglou chi’n aphuong ding hi, tam khu phah natna ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh siempu in ana et a, aduona muna amul kaang aumlou a, avun sanga athuhzawh sih a, adup maimai ahileh siempu in ama nisagi sung atuom koi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Siempuin anisagi niin a en kia dinga, avun lah a ana zam nasat tahleh siempu in ama asienglou chi’n aphuong dinga, tami phah natna ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh a duo pen amun ngai a auma, avun lah a azam thang sih a, adup giap ahileh, mei kahna pawn giap ahia, siempu in ama asiengthou chi’n aphuong ding hi, aziehpen tami mei kahna pawn ahi."},"29":{"text":"“Tualeh pasal ahiei, numei ahiei khat in, alutang ahiei, akhamul ahiei a natna anei leh;"},"30":{"text":"Siempu in ahima a en dinga, avun sanga thuhzaw a, akimu a, mul eng ngat ngiungeu aum leh siempu in ama sienglou chi’n a phuong ding hi; tam khu himasunglut ahia, lutang leh khamul lah a um phah ahi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin himasunglut khu a et a, avun sanga thuhzaw a akimu lou a, mul vom zong a um sih leh siempuin himasunglut natna neipa khu ni sagi atuom khum ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Ni sagi ni in siempu in anatna a en kia dinga, himasunglut khu azamthang lou a amul eng zong akimu sihleh, tualeh hima sunglut khu avun sanga athuhlut sihleh;"},"33":{"text":"Ama leh ama akiheukieu dinga, hinanleh, himasunglut umna mun aheukieu sih ding hi, tuachi’n siempu in himasunglut nei mi khu ni sagi sung atuom koi ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Ni sagi ni in siempu in hima sunglut khu a en kia dinga, hima khu avun lah a ana zamthang loua, avun sanga thuhzaw a akimu sihleh, siempu in ama khu asiengin a phuong ding hi, apuonte a sawp dinga a sieng ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanleh ahima sunglut khu akisiensuo zou a avun lah a ana zamthang leh;"},"36":{"text":"Siempuin a en dinga, ahimasunglut khu avun lah a ana zamthang leh siempu in amul eng asui nalai angai sih dinga, asienglou a aphuon ding ahi."},"37":{"text":"Hinanleh ahimasunglut khu a umna ngai a, auma amul vom apou a, himasunglut khu adam ahitahleh ama khu asieng ahi, tuachi’n siempu in asiengin aphuong ding hi."},"38":{"text":"“Tualeh pasal ahiei, numei ahiei in asatung ua chipol ngou kilkel anei u’leh;"},"39":{"text":"Siempuin a enchien dinga, tualeh ngaiin, atahsa vun pol pen adup ngou sim giap ahileh, vun a kipat hing piengdoh chipol maimai ahia, ama a sieng ahi."},"40":{"text":"“Tualeh mi alutanga pat asam apul bei leh lukieu ahia, hinanleh asieng ahi."},"41":{"text":"Mi a lutanga pat amailam samteng apul leh talkoh ahia, hinanleh asieng ahi."},"42":{"text":"Hinanleh lu kieuna mun leh tal kolna mun a hima sansim a ngou ahing umleh, alu kieu ahiei, atal kol ahiei a kipat a pha natna hing umdoh ahi."},"43":{"text":"Siempu in a enchien dinga, ngaiin ahima pawn khu alukieu ahiei atal kol ahiei a, san sima angou tahsa vuna phah banga alat leh,"},"44":{"text":"Ama khu aphah ahia, sienglou ahi, Siempu in amapen sienglou phah natna vei ahi chi’n aphuong ding hi, anatna khu alutanga um ahi."},"45":{"text":"“Tuachi’n phah natna neimi puonsilte khu bawkeh ahi dinga, asamte akaikhe sah dinga, anephu atuom dinga sienglou sienglou chiin akikou ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Phahin abop laisie abua ahi dinga, ama khu asienglou ahi; ama tangin ateng dinga, giehphuol pulam khu ama tenna ahi ding hi."},"47":{"text":"“Phah natna hih umna Samul puon ahiei, puon malngat ahiei;","title":"Sil leh ten etkhiehna"},"48":{"text":"A kigatthaw hiin, akiphanthaw hitaleh puonmalngat ahiei, samul puon ahiei, ahisihleh savun a kibawl sil khat poupou;"},"49":{"text":"Tualeh khum natna khu aengsim ahiei, asansim ahiei, a puon tung ahiei savun tunga atuh khah leh; puon malngat hiin samul puon hiin tualeh savun akibawl sil khat pou pou hitaleh, tua phah natna bang ahia, siempu etsah ding ahi."},"50":{"text":"Siempu in natna khu a en dinga, tuabang natna neimi khu ni sagi sung atuom koi ding hi."},"51":{"text":"Tualeh ni sagi niin natna hihte aen dinga, natna hih pen puonsil gatthaw ah ahiei, phanthaw ah ahiei, savun a kibawl sil pouma tunga ana ban khah leh phah natna huoisetah ahia, tami asienglou ahi."},"52":{"text":"Tualeh siempu in a en dinga, ngaiin natna hit khu puonsil akigatthaw ahiei, aki phanthaw ahiei a, ahisihleh savun akibawl sil poupou a, a kithethang sihleh;"},"53":{"text":"“Aman khum puonsil khu akigatthaw hiin, akiphanthaw hitaleh, samulpuon hiin puon malngat hitaleh, savun a kibawl sil khat poupou hitaleh ahaltum ding ahi."},"54":{"text":"Siempuin natna umna silte sawp dingin thu ape dinga, tuazou chiengin nisagi sung atuom koi ding hi."},"55":{"text":"Tualeh akisawpzou chiengin siempu in natnapi a en kia dinga, ngaiin natnapi kilatdan akikhel tuom lou a, natnapi kithethang sihnanleh asienglou ahia, mei a haltum ding ahi; apulam ahiei asunglam ahiei anase thei chi
