ahiziehin."},"56":{"text":"“Tualeh siempu in a et a, tualeh ngaiin akisawp zoua natna khu adup sim maimai ahileh, puon apat ahiei savun apat ahiei, gatthaw puon apat ahiei, phanthaw apat ahiei khu abawtkeh ding hi."},"57":{"text":"Tualeh puonsil gatthaw ahiei, phanthaw ahiei, tualeh savun a kibawl sil khat poupou ahiei a, akilat nahlai leh natna dalzah thei chi ahia, natna kilawtheina neitah pouma mei a haltum ding ahi."},"58":{"text":"Tualeh apuonsil gatthaw ahiei, phanthaw ahiei ahisihleh savun a kibawl neitah khat poupou hilezong asawpa, natnapi in anuasie leh sawp kia ding ahia,” tuachi’n asieng ding hi."},"59":{"text":"Tami puonsil samul hiin, puon malngat hiin, gatthaw ahiei, phanthaw ahiei, savun a kibawl neitah ahiei a, phah natna asienthou leh sienthoulou phuondohna dan khu ahi, achi hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah tam bangin agen hi.","title":"Phah suhsiengna dan"},"2":{"text":"“Tami phah natna veite kisiensuo ni chienga bawl dan ding ahi; siempu kunga pui ding ahi.","ref":"Mat. 8.4; Mak. 1.44; Luk. 5.14; 17.14"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh siempu khu giephuol pulam ah apawtdoh dinga, ama ava en chien dinga, tualeh ngaiin ama phah natna apat ana dam tahleh;"},"4":{"text":"Siempu in siensuo a um ding mi khu va hing siengthou ni leh sidar sing leh vaukhau san tualeh Hissop hing tawi dingin thu ape dinga;"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin khat pen leibel sunga, tuiluonglai tunga tha dingin thu ape ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Va hing nalai pen sidar sing, vaukhau sandup leh Hissop toh atawi dinga, lui tuiluong tunga leibel sunga va kithatsa sisan lah ah adie ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh phah natna apata siensuo ding mi tungah sagi vei athe dinga, asiengthouta chi’n aphuong dinga, tualeh va hing nalai pen gamlah ah aha ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh siensuo a um ding mi in apuonten a sawp dinga, asam zousie aheu kieu ding hi, asienthou theina dingin, tuazou chiengin giehphuol ah alut dinga, hinanleh biehbuh pulam ah ni sagi aum ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh ni sagi niin hichi ahi dinga, alu apat asam zousie leh akhamul zousie leh amitmulte aheukieu dinga, amul zousie aheukieu dinga, tualeh apuonte asawp dinga akisilsieng ding ahi, tuachi’n ahing siengthouta ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tualeh ni giet niin belamtal nuolnabei ni leh belamnou nuolnabei kumkhat a upa khat leh ann sillat ding tangbuongnel ngingei Ephah se sawmsuo sethum sathau toh kimehkhawm leh sathau log khat atawi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n asiensuo ding siempupa’n ama leh asillat zousie kimutuona biehbuh kotbul a Mangpa mai ah akoi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh siempupan belamnou tal khat ala dinga tatkhelna sillat dingin alan dinga, tualeh sathau log khat khu sillat dingin Mangpa maiah anei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh aman khelna kithoina sillat leh halmang sillat atha zelna mun uh, mun siengthou ah belamnou tal pen athat ding hi, khelna thoina sillat khu siempu tanvou ahi bangin khelna sillat zong siempu tanvou ahi, tami sil siengthou penpen ahi."},"14":{"text":"Siempuin tatkhelna sillat sisan themkhat ala dinga, akisiensuo ding mi bildawn zietlam leh khutpi zietlam, tualeh kengpi zietlam ah anu ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Siempuin sathau log akipat them khat ala dinga, ama veilam khutphang sungah asung ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin akhutphang veilam a um sathau ah azietlam khutme adie dinga, tua sisan khu Mangpa mai ah sagi vei athe ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh akhut sunga sathau um nalaiteng khu siempuin siensuo ding mi bildawn leh akhutpi zietlam dawn tualeh akengpi zietlam dawn ah tatkhelna sillat sisan tungah anu ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Siempu khut sunga sathau aval um nalai teng khu siensuo ding mi lutungah asung dinga, siempuin Mangpa mai ah a ma dingin kilemna abawl pieh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin khelna thoina sillat alan dinga asienthoulou zieh a siensah ding mi adingin kilemna abawl pieh ding hi, tuazou chiengin halmang sillat athat ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin halmang sillat leh ann sillat khu maitam tungah alan dinga, siempuin ama dingin lemna abawl pieh ding a asiengthouta ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Hinanleh mi genthei ahi a, khumzapi aneizou sihleh tatkhelna sillat a dingin belamnou tal khat, tualeh tangbuong nel ngingei ephah se sawmsuo sekhat, sathau toh kimehsa ann sillat dingin sathau log khat toh atawi dinga;"},"22":{"text":"Vakhu ni ahiei, palva ni ahiei anei zou dandan atawi dinga, khut khelna kithoina sillat dingin adang khat pen halmang sillat dingin."},"23":{"text":"Ni giet niin akisiensuona dingin siempu kungah kimutuona biehbuh kotpi bul ah, Mangpa mai ah ahing tawi ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin tatkhelna thoina sillat belamnou leh sathau log khat atawi dinga, tualeh sillat dingin Mangpa mai ah siempuin alan ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh tatkhelna thoina belamnou pen, athat dinga siempuin tatkhelna, thoina sisan themkhat ala dinga, akisiensuo ding mi zietlam bil dawn, azietlam khutpi dawn leh azietlam kengpi dawnte ah anu ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin sathau khu ama veilam khutphang sungah asung dinga;"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin azietlam khutme in aveilam khutphang sunga um sathau themkhat, Mangpa mai ah sagivei athe ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin akhut a sathau um khu asiensuo ding mi zietlam bildawn leh azietlam khutpi dawn tualeh azietlam kengpi dawn a tatkhelna kithoina sisan umna mun ah anu ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh siempu khut a sathau um nalai teng Mangpa mai a kilemna bawlpiehna dingin akisiensuo ding mi lutungah anu pieh ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh aman anei zou bangbang vakhu ahiei, palva nou khat ahiei alan ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Anei zou bang bangin khatpen khelna thoina sillat dingin, adang khat pen halmang sillat dingin, ann sillat toh, siempuin siensuo ding mi a dingin Mangpa maiah kilemna abawl pieh ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tam khu phah natna vei, kisiensuona ding dan, anei zouloute dinga dan ahi,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron ahoupi a, akung uah;","title":"Phah natna umna Innte zui ding"},"34":{"text":"“Na luoding ua ka hing pieh Kanaan gam nalut chiengun, naluona gam ua inn khat poupou a, phah natna ka koi leh,"},"35":{"text":"Khum inn neipa’n, Tami innah natna hileh kilawmtah um in ka thei hi, chiin siempu kungah ahing hil ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh siempu natna en dinga alut masangin innsunga um zousie abualouna dingin innpen su awng dingin siempu in thu apeding hi; tuazou chiengin siempu inn en dingin alut ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin natna a endinga, ngaivawi natnapi umna munte a eng ahiei, asan sim ahiei a, inn bang aneh kuoh a, innbang sanga akuoh thuh zawh leh;"},"38":{"text":"Siempupa inn sunga pat kotpi ah apawtdoh dinga, tua inn khu ni sagi akhah ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh siempupa ni sagi niin ahing pei kia dinga, a en dinga, tualeh ngaivawi natnapi khu inn banga ana dalzah leh;"},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempuin natnapi umna suongte ladoh dingin thu ape dinga, khopi pulam a mun sienglou khat ah apai ding uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh inn sunglam akietsieng sah dinga, akiet khietna vuite uh khopi pulama mun sienglou khat ah abo ding uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh suong dang ala ding ua, tua suongte mun ah akoi ding uhi, Tualeh suong zutmatna dang ala ding ua, suongte azutmat kia ding uhi."},"43":{"text":"“Tualeh suong alahdoh nua a, in akiet siengsah zou a, akizutbit nua azong natnapi ahing kilat kia leh."},"44":{"text":"Siempupa ava lut kia dinga, a en dinga, tualeh ngaivawi natnapi inn a ana dalzah leh phah natna hat chi ahia, tami asienglou ahi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n inn khu aphetdoh dinga, asuongte, asingte leh inn zutmatna zousie tawh, khopi pulam a mun sienglou khat ah anawndoh ding uhi."},"46":{"text":"Tuathamlouin khum inn kikhah sung mawngmawnga koipou khum inn sunga lut pouma nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding hi."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh koipou khum inn a lum pouma in a puonte a sawp dinga, tualeh koipou khum inn a ann ne pouma in apuonte asawp ding ahi."},"48":{"text":"“Hinanleh siempu ahing pei a, a et kimvel a, ngaivawi, inn zutbit ahi nua a, natnapi ana dalzah sihleh, tua inn khu asiengthou chiin siempuin a phuong ding hi, natna adam tah ziehin."},"49":{"text":"Tualeh aman inn siensuona dingin va ni sidar sing leh vaukhau sandup tualeh hissop atawi dinga;"},"50":{"text":"Tuachi’n va khatpen leibel sungah luitui luonglai tungah athat dinga,"},"51":{"text":"Tualeh Sidar sing leh vaukhau sandup leh va hing nalaipen ala dinga, va kithatsa sisan leh luitui luonglai ah adie ding hi, tualeh inn ah sagivei athe ding hi."},"52":{"text":"Tualeh aman inn khu va sisan leh tui luonglai leh va hing nalai pen leh sidar sing leh vaukhau sandup in asiensuo ding hi."},"53":{"text":"Hinanleh va hing nalai pen khopi apat gamlah ah aleengdoh sah dinga, tuachi’n inn a dingin kilemna abawlpieh dinga, tuachi’n ahing siengthou ta ding hi.”"},"54":{"text":"Tamkhu phah natna leh hima sunglut chinteng;"},"55":{"text":"Puon a phah natnapi um leh inn a umte,"},"56":{"text":"Apawmthawte akhem neite leh anai umte dinga dan ahi."},"57":{"text":"Asienlou lai hun leh asienthou hun hilna ding, phah natna tungtanga dan ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron ahoupi a, akung uah;","title":"Mihing tahsa tunga buana pawtte"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate houpi unlen, akung uah, mi koizong atahsa apat aneitah tui apawt leh, aneitah tui pawt ziehin ama asienglou ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh aneitah tui pawt sungteng abua ahia, neitah tui pawt ngitnget ahiei, apawt tawpta nanlezong, abua mawngmawng ahita a;"},"4":{"text":"Aneitah tui pawtpa lupkhahna pouma abua ahi a, atoukhahna pouma zong a sienglou ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh koipou alupna thamkha poumain apuonte uh asawp ding ua, tuiin aki sil ding ua, nitah dong in sienglou ahi ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aneitah tui pawtpa touna tunga toukha pouma in apuonte asawp dinga, tuiin akisil dinga, nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh aneitah tui pawtpa tahsa thamkha pouma in apuonte asawp dinga, tuiin akisil dinga nitah dongin sienglou ahi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh aneitah tui pawtpa’n mi sieng khat achil asietkhum khahleh, apuonte asawp dinga, tuiin akisil dinga, nitah dongin sienglou ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Neitah tui pawtpa tuonna sil khat poupou a sienglou ahi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh koipou aneitah apat tui pawtpa nuoia sil um khat poupou thamkha pouma nitah dongin abua ahi dinga, tualeh koipou khum silte po pouma in apuonte asawp dinga, tuiin akisil dinga, nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh neitah tui pawtpa’n akhut tui a sillou a, atham khah pouma in apuonte asawp dinga, tuiin akisil dinga nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh neitah tui pawtpa’n athamkhah leibel pouma satsiet ding ahi, singa kibawl umlebelte tui a sawp siengding ahi."},"13":{"text":"“Tualeh neitah tuipawt mi khu, suhsieng ahi chiengin, akisiensuona dingin ni sagi angah nalai dinga, tualeh apuonte asawp dinga, tui luonglai in atahsa asil sieng dinga, asiengta ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Nigiet niin vakhu ni ahiei, palvanou ni ahiei ahingtawi dinga, kimutuona biehbuh kotpi bul ah, Mangpa mai ah ahing pei dinga, siempu kungah apeding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin khat khu khelna sillat in alan dinga akhatpen halmang sillat in alan ding hi; tualeh siempu in aneitah tui pawt ziehin Mangpa mai ah kilemna abawlpieh ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tualeh pasal khat poupou bawtui pawtkha aumleh tuiin akipumsil dinga, nitah dongin sienglou ahi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh amapa bawtui tuhkhahna puonsil leh savun pouma tui a sawp sieng ahi dinga, nitah dongin sienglou ahi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh numei pasal tawh alupkhawma abawtui apawt leh ani un tuiin akisil sieng ding ua, nitah dongin sienglou ahi ding uhi.","title":"Numei apat sienglou pawt"},"19":{"text":"“Tualeh numei khat poupouin a neitah apat tuipawt anei a, atui pawt khu sisan ahileh amanu ni sagi sung tuomkoi ahi dinga, koipou amanu thamkha khu nitah dongin sienglou ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Asienlou hun sunga amanu’n alupkhum khah pouma asienglou ahi dinga, tualeh atoukhum khah sil pouma zong asienglou ahi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Koipou alupna thamkha in apuonte asawp sieng dinga, tuiin akisil dinga, nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh koipou amanu’n atoukhumkhah sil khoikha pouma in apuonte asawp dinga, nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh amanu lupna tung ahiei atouna tung ahiei a, sil um khat poupou thamkha pouma nitah dongin sienglou ahi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi koipouin amanu aluppi a, asienlouna abankhah leh amapa ni sagi sung abua ahi dinga, amapa lup khahna pouma sienglou ahi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"“Tualeh numei koi ahiei in nitampi sipawt aneia, aniin nei hunsung sanga sawtzaw sipawt anei leh, aniin nei buadan ngaina sunga aumbang bangin, asipawt sienlou sungteng a um dinga; sienglou ahi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A sipawt sung tenga alupna pouma aniin nei hunlai a abua bangin abua dinga, atouna taphot zong aniin nei bua hunlai a abua bang abua ahi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh koizong tam silte thamkha pouma sienglou ahi dinga, apuonte asawp dinga, tuiin akisil dinga, nitah dongin sienglou ahi ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh asipawtna apat ahing sien chiengin, nisagi angah nalai dinga, tuazou chiengin asiengta ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh nigiet niin vakhu ni ahiei, palvanou ni ahiei, kimutuona biehbuh a, siempu kungah ahing tawi ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Siempu in khumte khat khu khelna kithoina sillat in alan dinga, akhat pen halmang sillat in alan ding hi; siempu in asipawtna sienlouna ziehin Mangpa maiah kilemna abawlpieh ding hi."},"31":{"text":"“Tuachibangin Israel tate asienlouna ua kipat na khentuom ding uh ahi, alah ua um ka biehbuh abua sah khah chieng ua zong, asienthou lou zieh ua ashi louna dingun.","title":"Sipawt dan kibawl zieh"},"32":{"text":"Tami neitah tuipawt neite leh bawtui pawtte dinga dan ahi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh asienlouna zieh a numei china nu leh neitah tuipawt nei numei, tualeh numei aniin nei lai a luppi zieh a siengloute zui ding zong ahi, achi hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron tapa nite’n Mangpa mai a mei sienglou alat zieh ua, ashi nua un Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi hi.","title":"Tatna ni"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Na sanggampa Aaron kungah, ashi louna dingin, bawm tunga um hepina toupha mai a puonzah sunga mun siengthou ah hun chintengin hing lutsih heh chiin genin; aziehpen hepina toupha tungah meilum a hing kilah ding ka hi.","ref":"Heb. 6.19"},"3":{"text":"Tambangin Aaron mun siengthou ah ahinglut ding hi, khelna sillat dingin bawngtal tuoi khat tualeh halmang sillat dingin belamtal khat ahing kai ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 9.7"},"4":{"text":"Puon malngat puon ah siengthou asil dinga, puonmalngat pheituom ateng dinga, puon malngat kawnggah in akigah dinga, puon malngat diel kop akop ding hi, tamte khu puonsil siengthou ahi; tuaziehin tui in akisil masa dinga, tuazou chiengin asil ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Israel mipi kikhawmte lah apat in khelna kithoina sillat dingin kelnou ni, tualeh halmang sillat dingin belamtal khat, ahing kai ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tualeh Aaron in khelna kithoina sillat bawngtal khu ama a dingin alan dinga, ama ading leh a innkuonpite a dingin kilemna abawl ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh aman kelte gel akai dinga, kimutuona puonbuh kotpi bul ah Mangpa mai ah akhi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron in kelte gel tungthu ah ai asan dinga, khat Mangpa adingin, adang khat pen Azazel a, ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron in a-aiphatna pen khu Mangpa ape dinga, ahing kai dinga khelna kithoina sillat dingin alan ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Azazel adinga guot kel pen ahing in Mangpa mai ah Ama toh kilemna bawlna dingin ahing kai dinga, tuazou in Azazel a dingin gamdai ah ahing in aha ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Tualeh Aaron in ama a tuom khelna kithoina bawngtal khu ahing kai dinga, ama ding leh a innkuonpi te adingin kilemna abawl dinga, ama a tuom khelna thoina bawngtal khu athat ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Mangpa mai a maitam akipat mei aam adim gimnamtui halna meibawm khat ala dinga, gimnamtui kigawt buong ngi ngei asipdim atawi dinga, puonzah sung lam ah alutpi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Bawngtal sisan bangza ahieikhat ala dinga, akhutmete in hepina toupha suolampangah athe dinga; tualeh sisan bangza ahieikhat akhutmete in hepina toupha mai ah sagi vei athe ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Bawngtal sisan bangza ahieikhat ala dinga, akhutme te in hepina toupha suolampangah athe dinga; tualeh sisan bangza ahieikhat akhutme te in hepina toupha mai ah sagi vei athe ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tuachi’n aman mipite adinga khelna thoina kel khu athat dinga, asisan puonzah sungah ahing tawi dinga, tuo sisan khu bawngtal sisan abawl bangin abawl dinga, khotuona toupha tung leh mai ah athe ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 9.12"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate sienlouna zieh leh agitlouna zieh ua akhelnate zousie uh ziehin, mun siengthoua dingin kilemna abawl ding hi. Tuamabangin assienlouna lah ua um kimutuona puonbuh adingin zong abawl ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mun siengthoua kilemna bawl dinga alut chiengin ama a ding leh a innkuonpi te ading leh Israel mipi pungkhawmte zousie a dinga, kilemna abawl zoua ahing pawtkhieh masang sie, kimutuona biehbuh sungah koima aum dinguh ahisih hi."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa mai a um maitam lamah apawtdoh dinga; khummi adingin kilemna abawl ding hi; tualeh bawngtal sisan leh kel sisan ala dinga maitam kii te ah ataat ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh atungah akhutme in sisan sagi vei athe dinga, asusieng dinga, Israel tate sienlouna apat asusiengthou ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Tualeh aman kimutuona biehbuh leh maitam a dinga kilemna abawlzou chiengin, kel hing pen ahing kai dinga."},"21":{"text":"Aaron in akhutte gel kel hing tungah angam ding a, Israel tate gitlouna zousie leh akhelna zousie zieh ua abawsietna zousiete uh kel tunga koiin atung ah aphuong dinga, guot a um mi khat in gamdai lam ah apuimang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n kel in atungah agitlouna zousie uh mi tenlouna gamlah ah apawta dinga; aman kel khu gamdai ah ahata ding hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tualeh kimutuona puonbuh sungah Aaron ahing lut dinga, mun siengthou a alut lai a apuonsil siengthoute a sut dinga, tuanah a nuasie ding hi.","ref":"Ezek. 44.19"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh mun siengthou ah tuiin aki pumsil sieng dinga, apuonte silin ahing pawtdoh dinga, halmang sillat alan dinga, ama a ding leh mipite a dingin kilemna abawl ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh khelna sillat sathau khu maitam tungah ahal ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh gamdai a kel hing vahadohpa khu tuiin akipum sil dinga, tuazou chiengin giehphuol ah ahing lut thei ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh khel thoina sillat ding bawngtal leh khel thoina sillat ding kel sisante mun siengthou a kilemna bawlna dinga hing kitawite khu, giehphuol pulam ah akipodoh dinga, avun u’leh asa u’leh a eeh uh mei ah ahal ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 13.11"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh khumte halpan apuonte asawp dinga, tui in akipumsil dinga, tuazou chiengin giehphuol ah ahing lut ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tami khu na kumtawn thugousie ding uh ahi. Ha sagina ani sawm niin, na lungsim uh na gimsah ding ua, na gamsung mi uh hiin, na lah ua um gamdang mi hitaleh, nna mawngmawng nasep lou dinguh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 23.26-32; Kisim. 29.7-11"},"30":{"text":"Aziehpen khum niin Mangpa mai a na khelna zousie ua pat na sienthou theina dingun, siempu in nou a ding in kilemna ahing bawlpieh ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua khu nou a dinga khawldamna, khawlni ahi ding hi, na lungsim uh na sugim dinguh, tuakhu nou a dingin kumtawn thugousie ahi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh siempu aman, apa tanga siempu nasem dinga sathau anu leh akoituompen in, kilemna abawl dinga, puonmalngat puonsil siengthoute a sil ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman mun siengthou a dingin kilemna abawl dinga, kimutuona biehbuh a dingin kilemna abawl dinga tualeh maitam adingin leh siempute a dingin, tualeh mipi kikhawmte adingin kilemna abawl ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tami khu Israel tate khelna zousie a dinga kilemna kum khat a khatvei abawl ding ahia; kumtawn thugousie ahi ding hi a chi hi.” Tuachi’n ama’n Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin abawl hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Kithoina mun khat"},"2":{"text":"“Aaron leh atapate leh Israel tate zousie houpi inlen akung uah, Tami Mangpa thupieh ahi chiin genin."},"3":{"text":"Koipou Israel innkuon mikhat in bawngtal ahiei, belamnou ahiei, ahisihleh kel ahiei, giehphuol sunga ahisihleh giehphuol pulam a atha a,"},"4":{"text":"Mangpa biehbuh mai a, Mangpa adinga, kimutuona biehbuh kotpi bul a hing tawilou pouma sisan suo a ngai ahi dinga, sisan suo ngei ahia, tuabang mi khu amite lah apat tuomkoi in a um ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua khu Israel taten gamlah a alat uh akithoinate uh ahing tawi ua, Mangpa a dinga kimu tuona biehbuh kotpi bul a siempu kunga ahing tawi ua, Mangpa adinga kilemna sillalte a dinga alat theina dinguh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin asisan khu kimutuona biehbuh kotpi bula Mangpa maitam tungah athe dinga, athau khu Mangpa a dinga gimnam tuitah dingin ahal ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A angkawm zelna uh dawite kungah akithoi dinguh ahi nawn sih hi, tami akhang tungtawn ua dinga kumtawn thupieh ahi."},"8":{"text":"“Tualeh akung uah, Israel innkuon mi ahiei, ahisihleh gamdang mi nalah ua tengte koipou in halmang sillat ahiei, kithoina sillat ahiei,"},"9":{"text":"Mangpa kunga lat dinga kimutuona puonbuh kotpi bul a hing tawilou pouma, amite lah a pat tuomkoi in aum ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Tualeh Israel innsung mite lah ahiei ahisihleh alah ua gamdang mi umte ahiei in sisan aneh u’leh, khum sisan nemi tungah ka mai ka khausah dinga, amite lah apat satkhieh ahi ding hi.","title":"Sisan neh lou ding","ref":"Siem. 9.4; Siempu. 7.26,27; 19.26; Danp. 12.16,23; 15.23"},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen tahsa hinna khu sisan a um ahi a, khum khu na hinna ding ua kilemna bawlna dingin maitam ah noute ka hing peta hi, aziehpen hinna dinga kilemna bawlna khu sisan ahi.","ref":"Heb. 9.22"},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Israel tate kungah, na lah ua koima’n sisan naneh dinguh ahisih a, gamdang mi na lah ua teng pouma in zong sisan aneh dinguh ahi sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate lah ahiei, ahisihleh gamdang mi na lah ua teng koipou gam avah a, sa ahiei, va ahiei, neh sieng chi amat leh asisan aluongdoh sah dinga, leivui avua ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Aziehpen tahsa zousie hinna ahia, asisan leh ahinna kibang lien ahi, tuaziehin Israelte kungah bangsa bangsa hitaleh asisan mawngmawng na nehlou dinguh ahi chiin ka gen hi, aziehpen tahsa zousie hinna khu asisan a um ahi, koi zong ane pouma satkhiehin a um ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh koipou gamsunga teng mi ahiei, gamdang mi na lah ua teng mi ahiei in gan puul sa ahiei ahisihleh gamsa in athalup sa aneh leh apuonte asawp dinga, tuiin akisil dinga, nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding hi, tuazou chiengin asiengta ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh apuonte asawplou a, akipumsil sihleh amaw akipuoh ding ahi, chi’n gen in achi hi.”"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Numei leh Pasal thang tatna kham ahi"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate houpi inlen akung uah, Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh Ka hi."},"3":{"text":"Na tenna uh Izipt gam mite bawl bangin bawl sih unlen, ka hing puilutna ding Kanaan gam mite bawl bangin zong bawl sih unlen, athugousiete u’zong na zuilou dinguh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ka vaihawmna dante na nit ding ua, ka dan thupiehte na zuiin na mang ding uhi, Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh Ka hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka thupiehte leh ka thugousiete na zui dinguh ahi, khumte min azui u’leh ahing ding uhi, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi.","ref":"Neh. 9.29; Ezek. 18.9; 20.11-13; Luk. 10.28; Rom. 10.5; Gal. 3.12"},"6":{"text":"“Noute koima’n na sanggam kinaipi numeite uh saguohna hawhkhe dinga nava nai mawngmawng lou dinguh ahi, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi."},"7":{"text":"Napa saguohna ahiei, nanu saguohna ahiei na hawh pieh ding ahi sih, ama nanu ahia, asaguohna na hawh lou ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Napa zi saguohna na hawh ding ahi sih, tami napa saguohna ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 20.11; Danp. 22.30; 27.20"},"9":{"text":"Na sanggamnu napa tanu ahiei, nanu tanu ahiei, na pienpi hi in, na pienpilou hitaleh asaguohna uh nahawh pieh lou ding ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 20.17; Danp. 27.22"},"10":{"text":"Na tapa tanu ahiei, na tanu ahiei, saguohna na hawh lou ding ahi, aziehpen amauh saguohna khu nangma saguohna ahi."},"11":{"text":"Na pa zi tanu, napa hinkhieh, saguohna na hawh lou ding ahi, ama khu na sanggamnu ahia, asaguohna na hawh lou ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Na pa sanggamnu saguohna na hawh ding ahisih, ama napa sanggam kinaipi ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 20.19,20"},"13":{"text":"Nanu sanggamnu saguohna na hawh ding ahisih, ama nanu sanggam kinaipi ahi."},"14":{"text":"Napa sanggampa saguohna na hawh lou ding ahi, azi zong na zuan ding ahisih, ama na nuneu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Na mounu saguohna na hawh ding ahi sih, hi, ama natapa zi ahi, asaguohna na hawh lou ding ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 20.12"},"16":{"text":"Na sanggampa zi saguohna na hawh lou ding ahi, tam khu na sanggampa saguohna ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 20.21"},"17":{"text":"Numei khat atanu toh asaguohna uh na hawh lou ding ahi, atapa tanu ahiei ahisihleh atanu tanu ahiei zong a saguohna hawh dinga na puilou ding ahi, amanu khu tanau kinaipi ahi ua, khum banga bawl khu gitlouna ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 20.14; Danp. 27.23"},"18":{"text":"Na zi lungkhamna dingin asanggamnu saguohna dingin napui ding ahisih a, na zi dam sungin na neikop ding ahi sih hi."},"19":{"text":"“Tualeh numei khat aniin nei hun sunga asaguohna dinga nava zotlou ding ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 20.18"},"20":{"text":"Tuathamlouin nangma kisubua dingin na innvengpa zi toh na lumkhawm ding ahisih hi.","ref":"Siempu. 20.10"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Molek mei ah na hahlesuonte koima na peisuoh sah ding ahi sih hi, na Pasian min zong nasuh thanghuoi ding ahi sih hi; kei Mangpa khu Ka hi.","ref":"Siempu. 20.1-5"},"22":{"text":"Numei toh kipawl banga pasal toh na kipawl lou ding ahi, tuakhu sil kidahhuoi ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 20.13"},"23":{"text":"Ki suhbuana dingin ganta mawngmawng na luppi ding ahi sih hi, tualeh numei mawng mawng zong kipawlsah dingin ganta mai a adin ding ahi sih hi, tami gitlouna tungtuong ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 22.19; Siempu. 20.15,16; Danp. 27.21"},"24":{"text":"“Tam silte khat poupou ah nouma leh nouma kisubua sih un, aziehpen tamsilte in, na masang ua kana nawdoh namte ana kisuthanghuoi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tam silte ziehin gam suhbua in aumta hi, tuabanga a gitlouna uh atung uah ka tung sah a, tualeh gam in asunga tengte alawkhe siengta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin nouten ka thupiehte leh ka thugousiete na zui ding ua, tam sil kidahhuoite a na kisuhbua lou dinguh ahi, na nam sung ua mi mawngmawng hiin, na lah ua um gamdang mi in zong."},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen tam sil kidahhuoite gam sunga umten ana bawl ua, gam sung ana thanghuoi sahta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Na masang ua um namte aluohkhieh ma banga nasuh bua ua gam in ahing luohkhiet louna dingin."},"29":{"text":"Koi zong tam sil kidahhuoite khat poupou bawl pouma amite lah ua pat satkhieh in a um ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaziehin nouten vang na masang ua ana bawl uh tam tawndan kidahhuoite na bawllouna ding u’leh tamte a na kisuhbua louna dingun ka thugousiete na zui ding uh ahi, Kei khu Mangpa na Pasian uh Ka hi,” achi hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Sienthouna leh dihna dante"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate mipi kikhawmte zousie houpi inlen akung uah, Na sienthou dinguh ahi, Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka siengthou hi.","ref":"Siempu. 11.44,45; 1 Pet. 1.16"},"3":{"text":"Michin in na nu leh na pate uh zaudan na siem ding ua, ka khawl nite na nit dinguh ahi, Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh Ka hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.12; Danp. 5.16; Pawt. 20.8; Danp. 5.12"},"4":{"text":"Milimte lam ah kihei sih unlen, nou a dingin pasiente bawlthu sih un, Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh Ka hi.","ref":"Siempu. 26.1; Pawt. 20.23; 34.17; Danp. 17.2-5"},"5":{"text":"“Mangpa kunga kilemna kithoina sillat na lat ding u’leh nouma kiphal na a nalat dinguh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tami na lat ni mama u’leh a zingni a na neh paiding uh ahi; ani thumni donga um nalaite mei a haltum ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ani thum ni a neh ahi pouma leh sil kidahhuoi ahia, pom pieh ahi sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin koizong ane poumain Mangpa sil siengthou asuh bua zieh in agitlouna maw akipuoh dinga, amite lah a pat tuom koi ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"“Tualeh nagam ua bu na at chiengun, na lou gei ningkawi donga na at sieng lou dinguh ahi, abu sangte zong na khop sienglou dinguh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 27.15; Danp. 24.19-22"},"10":{"text":"Na grep huon ua asangte na sui dinguh ahisih a, na grep ga tuol kie zong na tom ding ahi sih hi, tagate leh mikhuolte dinga na nuasie dinguh ahi; Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh Ka hi."},"11":{"text":"“Na guhtat dinguh ahi sih a, dihloutah a na bawl ding uh zong ahi sih, tualeh zuou na kihiltuo dinguh ahisih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.15; Danp. 5.19; Pawt. 20.16; Danp. 5.20"},"12":{"text":"Dihloutaha ka min a na kichiem ding uh ahi sih, na Pasian min u’zong thanghuoi taha na gen lou ding uh ahi; Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.7; Danp. 5.11; Mat. 5.33"},"13":{"text":"“Na innvengte na solbawl ding ahi sih a, na guhpieh ding zong ahi sih hi, kilaw mi thaman zankhuo a azing mawng donga na kep ding ahisih hi.","ref":"Danp. 24.14,15"},"14":{"text":"Bilbingte na hamsiet ding ahi sih a, mittote lampi a’zong akipalpuana ding na koipieh lou ding ahi, na Pasian na giin ding ahi, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi.","ref":"Danp. 27.18"},"15":{"text":"“Vaihawmna ah dihlou tah a na hawmding ahisih, mizawngte na khentuom lou ding, mi thupite zong na zatat tuomlou ding ahi, hinanleh dihtatna in na innvengte vai na hawmpieh ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.6-8; Danp. 16.19"},"16":{"text":"Na mite lah a thuse gen a na vah kawi ding ahi sih a, na innvengpa hinna thu a’zong ahiloulam a na pan ding ahi sih, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi."},"17":{"text":"“Na lungsim a na sanggampa na muda ding ahisih a, na innvengte phawh kawma na hil ngeingei ding ahi, ama zieh a khelna na puahlou na dingin.","ref":"Mat. 18.15"},"18":{"text":"Phuba na lah ding ahisih a, na chipite hahlesuonte huotna lungtang na pai ding ahi sih hi; Nangma na ki it bangin na innvengte na it ding ahi zaw hi, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi.","ref":"Mat. 5.43; 19.19; 22.39; Mak. 12.31; Luk. 10.27; Rom. 13.9; Gal. 5.14; Jak. 2.8"},"19":{"text":"“Ka thupiehte na zui dinguh ahi, Na gantate ganta chi tuom tuom tawh chihah na nei sah louding ahi, na lou a zong haichi tuom tuom na chiin lou ding ahi, vaukhau leh samul kigankhawm puon zong na silding ahi sih hi.","ref":"Danp. 22.9-11"},"20":{"text":"“Koi zong suoh numei, pasal nei dinga kikhamlai, tatdoh hinailou, zalenna zong pieh hinailou toh lum khawm khu vuoh ahi dinga, tha ding vang ahisih hi, amanu zalen ahilou ziehin,"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh amapa’n atatkhelna kithoina sillat dingin, kimutuona biehbuh kotpi bul ah Mangpa kunga lat dingin belamtal khat ahing kai ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh siempu in tatkhelna kithoina belamtal in atatkhelnate ziehin Mangpa maiah kilemna abawl pieh dinga, atatkhelna khu ngaidam ahita ding hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tualeh gam na valuo ua, neh ding theikung chi chinteng na suon chiengun, kum thum sung nou adinga sienglou ahi dinga, aga na nehlou ding uh ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh akum li na ahvang aga zousie Mangpa phatna dingin asiengthou siengta ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh akum nga na ah nou a dinga, aga tam sem theina dingin, na neta ding uhi; Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi."},"26":{"text":"“A sisan nangawn toh bangma na neh ding uh ahisih a, mitphieldawi leh aisan zong na chiin dinguh ahisih hi.","ref":"Siem. 9.4; Siempu. 7.26,27; 17.10-14; Danp. 12.16,23; 15.23; Danp. 18.10"},"27":{"text":"Na humsam ua kipat in nalu uh akimkot a na heu dinguh ahisih a, na khamul gei tuoh zong na heu dinguh ahisih hi.","ref":"Siempu. 21.5; Danp. 14.1"},"28":{"text":"Mishi ziehin na satung uh na at pop ding uh ahisih a, na satung u’zong na gelpawl dinguh ahi tuom sih hi, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi."},"29":{"text":"“Na tanu kizua dingin pe sinlen, gam sung khu kizuana ahing suoh kha ding a, gam sung gitlouna in adim kha ding hi.","ref":"Danp. 23.17"},"30":{"text":"Nouten ka khawl nite na nit ding ua, Ka munsiengthou na zatat dinguh ahi, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi.","ref":"Siempu. 26.2"},"31":{"text":"“Na kibuasah louna dingun aisan siemte leh dawithu siemte mawngmawng zuon sih un, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi.","ref":"Danp. 18.11; 1 Sam. 28.3; 2 Leeng. 23.4; Isai. 8.19"},"32":{"text":"“Tehsie samkangte mai ah na dingdoh dinga, Putehte na zatat ding ahi; Na Pasian giindan na siem ding ahi, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi."},"33":{"text":"“Tualeh na gamsunga gamdang mi na tenkhawmpi a umleh dihlou taha na bawl lou ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 22.21; Danp. 24.17,18; 27.19"},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh gamdang mi na lah ua tengte khu, na lah ua pieng bang ahi ding ua, nouma banga na it dinguh ahi, aziehpen noute zong Izipt gam ah mikhuol nana hi uhi; Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh Ka hi."},"35":{"text":"“Thukhennate ah, tena chiengte ah, agihdan tenate ah, tualeh atamlam tenate ah, dihtatlou taha na bawl dinguh ahisih hi.","ref":"Danp. 25.13-16; Thu. 20.10; Ezek. 45.10"},"36":{"text":"Buhna dihtah, gihna dihtah, ephah dihtah leh hin dihtah, na nei dinguh ahi, Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh Izipt gam a kipata noute hing puidohpa ka hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka thupieh zousiete leh ka vaihawmnate zousie na pom ding ua, tualeh na zui ding uh ahi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Thumanlouna gawtnate"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah genkia inlen, koipou Israel tate lah a mi ahiei, Israel gam a teng gamdang mi ahiei in zong atate Molek kunga pe pouma thalup ngei ngei ding ahi; gamsung miten ama khu suonga a selup dinguh ahi."},"3":{"text":"Khumpa tungah ka mai ka khausah dinga, amite lah a pat ka satkhe ding hi, aman ka munsiengthou suthanghuoi ding leh ka min siengthou suthanghuoi dinga, ata Molek kunga apieh ziehin."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh gamsung miten bangchi ahiei a, atate uh Molek kunga apieh uh, akimumaw bawl ua atha sih u’leh,"},"5":{"text":"Khumpa tung leh a innkuonpite tungah ka mai ka khausah dinga, ama leh anua a Molek toh angkawm dinga kizua zousiete amite lah a kipat ka satkhe ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tualeh a angkawmpi ding ua, aisan siemte leh dawithu siemte kung zuon mite tungah ka mai ka gum sah dinga, amite lah a kipat ka satkhe ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin kisusiengthou unlen, siengthou in um un, Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh Ka hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka thupiehte na pom ding ua, na zui dinguh ahi, Kei khu noute hing susiengthoupa, Mangpa khu Ka hi."},"9":{"text":"Koipou apa ahiei, anu ahiei, hamselaw khum khu thalup teitei ding ahi. Aman anu leh pa hamsie alaw khum ahia, asisan maw atungah aum ding hi.","ref":"Pawt. 21.17; Mat. 15.4; Mak. 7.10"},"10":{"text":"“Midang zi toh angkawm a, a innvengpa zi toh angkawm mi khu, angkawmpa leh angkawmnu thalup teitei ding ahi.","title":"Aangkawm khelna gawtna","ref":"Pawt. 20.14; Siempu. 18.20; Danp. 5.18"},"11":{"text":"Apa zi toh lumkhawm mi khu apa saguohna hawhpieh ahia, ani ua thalup teitei ding ahi uhi, asisan maw uh atung uah aum ding hi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.8; Danp. 22.30; 27.20"},"12":{"text":"Mi’n amounu aluppi leh ani ua thalup ding ahi uh, gitlouna tung tuong bawl ahi ua, asisan maw uh atung uah aum ding hi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.15"},"13":{"text":"Mi khat in numei aluppi banga pasal aluppi leh ani un sil kidahhuoi bawl ahi ua, thalup teitei ding ahi, asisan maw uh atung uah aum ding hi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.22"},"14":{"text":"Pasal khat in nuta zi a aneikop leh gitlouna ahia, amaute mei a hallup ahi ding uhi, na lah ua gitlouna a um nawnlouna dingin.","ref":"Siempu. 18.17; Danp. 27.23"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh mi khat in ganta aluppi leh thalup teitei ding ahia, ganta zong thalup ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 22.19; Siempu. 18.23; Danp. 27.21"},"16":{"text":"Numei khat in ki pawlpi dinga ganta ava nai a akibawlsah leh anumei leh aganta na thalup ding uh ahi; amaute thalup teitei ding ahi ua, asisan maw uh atung uah a um ding hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tualeh mi’n asanggamnu, apa tanu ahiei, anu tanu ahiei, akitenpi a, amanu saguohna amu a, amanu’n zong amapa saguohna amu leh tami silgiloutah ahia, amite uh mitmu ah, satkhiehin aum ding uhi, asanggamnu saguohna hawhpieh ahia, agitloutatna apo ding hi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.9; Danp. 27.22"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh mi’n numei aniin nei laitah a, aluppi a, asaguohna ahawh pieh leh asi pawtna hawhkhiet pieh ahia, tualeh amanu’n zong asi pawtna hohkhie ahi a, ani un amite lah ua pat satkhieh ahi ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.19"},"19":{"text":"Na nu sanggamnu ahiei, na pa sanggamnu ahiei, saguohna zong na hawh pieh ding ahisih a, asanggam kinaipi saguohna hawh pieh ahia, agitlouna uh maw akipuoh dinguh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.12-14"},"20":{"text":"Mi’n apaneu zi aluppi leh apaneu saguohna hawhpieh ahia; akhelna maw uh akipuoh ding ua, ta neilou in ashi ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Mi’n asanggampa zi akitenpi leh sil siengloutah ahi, asanggampa saguohna hawh pieh ahia, taneilouin a um ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.16"},"22":{"text":"“Tuaziehin ka thupiehte zousie leh ka thugousiete zousie na zui ding ua, na bawl ding uhi, teng dinga ka hing puilutna gamin ahing setkhieh louna dingin.","title":"Mipite sienthouna ding dante"},"23":{"text":"Na masang ua ka nawdoh namte umdan in na um ding uh ahisih hi, aziehpen amauten tam silte abawl ua, tuaziehin amaute ka kidahta hi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh na kung ua ka gentah bangin, agam uh nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam na luo ding un ka hing peding hi; Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh, namdangte akipat noute hing khentuompa khu ka hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin nouten gamsa siengleh sienglou, va siengleh sienglou, na khen tuom dinguh ahi; sa ahiei, va ahiei, ahisihleh leitunga bohvah ganhingte, nou apat asienglou chia ka khentuom sate a na hinna uh kidahhuoi a na kibawllou dinguh ahi."},"26":{"text":"Noute na sienthou ding uh ahi, aziehpen Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh Ka siengthou a, midangte apat noute keima adingin ka hing khentuom ta hi."},"27":{"text":"“Pasal hiin, numei hitaleh, aisan siem leh dawithu siem mi khu thalup teitei ding ahi, suongin aseplum ding ua, asisan maw uh atung uah aum ding hi ka chita hi,” chiin achi hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, “Aaron tapate, siempute kungah thu gen inlen, akung uah, amite lah a koima mishi zieha akisuhbua lou ding uh ahi.","title":"Siempute sienthou ding dan"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh atanau kinaipi mama, anu, apa, atapa leh atanu, tualeh asanggampa ziehin,"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh asanggamnu nungah siengthou akunga um pasal nei nailou ziehin akisubua thei ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh zileh ta a, kineina thu a, akinaipi pouma shiluong uop ziehin akisubua in akisuthanghuoi ding ahi sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Siempu koiman alu aheu kieu dinguh ahi sih a, akhamul gei tuoh uh zong aheu dinguh ahisih a, tualeh atahsa tung uh a at pop ding u’zong ahi sih hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.27,28; Danp. 14.1"},"6":{"text":"A Pasian a dingin mi siengthou ahi ding ua, a Pasian uh min asuthanghuoi sih ding uhi, Pasian kunga mei a sillatte lantu leh Pasian tanghou siengthou lantu ahizieh un, asienthou dinguh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Numei kizua ahiei, kisuthanghuoisa ahiei, ahisihleh apasal in akhulsa ahiei, akitenpi dinguh ahisih hi, aziehpen siempute khu a Pasian ua dingin mi siengthou ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin ama khu na suhsiengthou ding ahi, aman na Pasian tanghou alan zel ahi, nanga dingin mi siengthou ahi ding hi, aziehpen kei Mangpa noute hing susiengthoupa khu ka siengthou hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh siempu koipou tanu kizua a, akisuhthanghuoi leh apa suthanghuoi ahia, mei a hallup ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"“A unaute lah a siempu lienpen, alutunga sathau kinusa, siempu puon sil dinga namdetsa in asam akaisah nel nul ding ahisih a, apuon zong abawtkeh ding ahisih hi.","title":"Siempu lien adinga thupieh"},"11":{"text":"Mishi luong umna a alut ding ahisih a, anu ahiei, apa ahiei, luong zieh a zong akisuhbua ding ahisih hi."},"12":{"text":"Munsiengthou apawtsan ding ahisih a, a Pasian munsiengthou zong a suhthanghuoi ding ahisih hi, aziehpen a Pasian siensuona sathau kinu khu alutung ah a um hi, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh zi dingin nungah siengthou akitenpi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Meithai ahiei akikhulsa ahiei, suhthanghuoisa ahiei, tualeh numei kizua ahiei, akitenpi ding ahisih a, hinanleh achipite lah a nungah siengthou zi in anei ding ahizaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh achipite lah a, thanghuoi tah a, hahlesuon anei ding ahi sih hi, aziehpen Kei Mangpa’n ama Ka suhsiengthou ahita hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Siempu lien tawh kisai dante"},"17":{"text":"“Aaron kungah, na khang tungtawn ua na hahlesuonte lah a koipou suonlam ding nei aum leh a Pasian tanghou lan dingin hing zuon sih heh."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh koipou atahsa tunga bukimlouna nei mitto ahiei, kengbai ahiei, nahkawpheng ahiei, khut leh keng sau sengte ahiei;"},"19":{"text":"khut tawng kengtawngte ahiei;"},"20":{"text":"Ngumbaw ahiei, mi neu ahiei, sietna nei ahiei leh chitung kehna nei leh chithah veite leh chiltang kehte leh;"},"21":{"text":"Siempu Aaron hahlesuonte lah a, atahsa tunga nuolna nei poumain, Mangpa adinga mei a sillat lan dinga ka kung nai a ahing peilou ding uh ahi, mitmawna nei ahi ua, Pasian tanghou lan dingin ka kung nai a ahing pei vawtlou ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"A Pasian in tanghou ane ding a asiengthou pen leh asiengthou zong ani in ane thei ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh amitmawna ziehin puonzah sunglama lut in maitam azuon thei sih ding hi, ka mun siengthoute asuthanghuoi kha ding hi; Kei Mangpa’n amaute susiengthoupa ka hi,” chi’n gen in achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in tam thu Aaron leh atapate leh Israel tate zousie kungah ahilta hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Sillatte sienthou dan"},"2":{"text":"“Aaron leh atapate kungah, Israel tate sil siengthou kei dinga alatte u’leh, ka min siengthou asuhthanghuoi louna dingun, ka kunga ahing lat uh silte lah a kituomkoi dingin thu genin, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi."},"3":{"text":"A kung uah gen in; Na khang tungtawn ua, nahah nasuonte zousie lah ua, koipou atunga sienlouna nei a, Israel taten Mangpa dinga alat uh sil siengthoute kung nai a hing pei pouma, Kei a pat satkhiehin a um ding ahi; Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi."},"4":{"text":"Aaron hahlesuonte lah a phah ahiei, neitah tui pawt ahiei pouma asienthou masangsie ua sil siengthoute anehlou ding uh ahi, tualeh mishi suhbua ahiei, abawtui pawt ahiei pouma,"},"5":{"text":"a awm a kithol a bohvah ganhing thamkhah zieh a bua pouma leh ama akipata sil pawt bua theina bang ahiei leh sienthou louna khat poupou thamkha pouma;"},"6":{"text":"Khumbang thamkha mi khu nitah dongin sienglou ahi dinga, atahsa tui a asil sieng sihleh, sil kilan siengthoute aneh lou ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh ni atum chiengin asiengthouta dinga, tuazou chiengin sil kilan siengthoute ane theita ding hi, aneh ding ahi ziehin."},"8":{"text":"Shi ngaina a shi sa ahiei, gamsa in akeilia sa ne in ama leh ama kisuhbuana dingin ane ding ahisih hi, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin amauten ka thugousiete azui ding uh ahi, tuachilouin vang akisuhthanghuoina uah akhelna maw uh apo ding ua ashilaw kha ding uhi, Kei Mangpa amaute susiengthoupa khu Ka hi."},"10":{"text":"“Gamdang mi mawngmawngin sil siengthou aneh ding uh ahi sih hi, siempu kunga nasem ahiei, a inna a zin te ahiei in zong sil siengthou aneh ding uh ahi sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh siempuin koi ahiei mi khat a sum a alei miin ane thei dinga, tualeh a inn a piengten zong ane thei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Siempu tanu in gamdang mi akitenpi leh silsiengthou sillat ane thei sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh siempu tanu meithai ahiei, akikhul ahiei, ta neilou ahiei ahi a, apa inn a ahing phungkia kialeh anungah lai bangin apa neh bangbang ane thei ding hi, hinanleh pulam mi mawngmawngin aneh louding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh mi koi ahiei in thei masa loua, sillat siengthou ava nehkhah leh senga suo sekhat abelap dinga, tuakhu sil siengthou tawh siempu kungah ava pekia ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amauten Israel tate sil siengthou Mangpa kunga alatte uh athanhuoi sah lou ding uh ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahisihleh asil siengthou latte uh ne in bawsietna maw apuoh dinguh aphal ding uh a hisih hi, Kei Mangpa amaute susiengthoupa khu Ka hi, chi’n gen in achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Silpieh pom leh pomloute"},"18":{"text":"“Aaron leh atapate leh Israel tate zousie houpi inlen, akung uah, Israel innkuonte lah ahiei, Israel gamsunga um gamdang mi koipouin halmang sillat dinga, Mangpa kunga alat dinguh, athuchiemna uh ahiei, akiphalna silpieh lan pouma in;"},"19":{"text":"Nouma kiphalna bangin, ganhon lah a kipat atal nuolnabei, belamtal ahiei keltal ahiei na lan ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh nuolna um pouma lan sih un, ahing kipom pieh sih ding hi.","ref":"Danp. 17.1"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh koipou athuchiem suhtangtunna ding ahiei, akiphalna banga sillat ding ahiei, lemna kithoina sillat, ganhon lah a, belam ahiei, kel ahiei, lan pouma in pomtah ahi theina dingin ahoi bukim ahi ding a, nuolna bei ahi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Amittaw ahiei, akengbai ahiei, hima nei ahiei, chipaat vei ahiei te khu Mangpa kunga na lat dinguh ahisih a, Mangpa adinga maitam tunga mei a sillat azong na latlou dinguh ahi."},"23":{"text":"Bawngtal ahiei, belamnou ahiei, asa meeng sautuom ahiei, tom tuom ahiei khu kiphalna sillat dingin na lan thei ding ua, hinanleh thuchiemna sillat dingin vang akipom sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ganta achiltang sidup ahiei, kisukeh ahiei, ahisih leh achiltang liem kha pouma Mangpa kunga na lat ding uh ahisih hi, na gamsung uah khum bang mawngmawng kithoina dinga nalat ding u’zong ahisih hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh gamdang mi khut a kipat a la in tamte lah a mawngmawng na Pasian tanghou dingin na lan ding uh ahisih hi, aziehpen ama uah sietna leh nuolna banna a um a, pom pieh thei ahisih ding uhi, chi’n gen in achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,"},"27":{"text":"“Bawngtal ahiei, belam ahiei, kel ahiei, apien chiengin api kungah ni sagi sung aum ding ahi, tualeh anigietni akipat khum nua chiengin Mangpa dinga mei a sillat dingin pom pieh thei ahi ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Bawngpi ahiei, belampi ahiei, anoutoh ni khat in na goukhawm ding uh ahisih hi."},"29":{"text":"Mangpa kunga kipah thugenna kithoina a na lat chiengun nouma kiphalna banga na lat dinguh ahi."},"30":{"text":"Khummi ni mama a na neh bei dinguh ahi a, azingni dongin, bangma na um sah sih ding uhi, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi."},"31":{"text":"“Tuaziehin ka thupiehte na zui ding ua, na bawl ding uh ahi, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi."},"32":{"text":"Ka min siengthou na suthanghuoi dinguh ahi sih a, hinanleh Israel tate lah a pahtawi a ka um ding ahi, Kei noute hing pahtawipa khu Ka hi."},"33":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipata na Pasian uh hidinga noute hing puidohpa Mangpa khu Ka hi, Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi, chi in,” achi hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Hun kisesa sakhuo pawite"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah, Mangpa pawi hunbisete kikhopna siengthoua man dinga na phuon dinguh pawite khu tamte ahi."},"3":{"text":"Niguh sung nna nasep ding uh ahia, hinanleh ni sagi ni pen khawldamna ni siengthou, kikhopna ni siengthou ahi; tam ni in nna mawngmawng na sepding uh ahisih, tam nipen na tenna mun zousie uah Mangpa khawlni ahi ding hi.","title":"Sabbath ni","ref":"Pawt. 20.8-10; 23.12; 31.15; 34.21; 35.2; Danp. 5.12-14"},"4":{"text":"“Tamte khu Mangpa pawi, kikhopna siengthou hunbi nei a na phuondoh dingte uh ahi.","title":"Peikan pawi"},"5":{"text":"Ha masapen ni sawm leh li ni nitah khu Mangpa peikan pawi ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-13; Danp. 16.1,2"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tuami ha ani sawm leh nga ni khu tanghou tolsawlou pawi ahia, ni sagi sung tanghou tolsawlou na neh ding uh ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.14-20; 23.15; 34.18; Danp. 16.3-8"},"7":{"text":"Ani khat ni in kikhopna siengthou na bawl ding ua, nna mawngmawng na sep ding uh ahisih hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh mei a sillat Mangpa kungah ni sagi sung nalan ding ua, ani sagi ni khu kikhopna siengthou ahi ding hi; nna mawngmawng nasep ding uh ahisih chi’n gen in” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupia,","title":"Ga masa pawi"},"10":{"text":"“Israel tate houpi inlen akung uah, ka hing pieh ding gam a nava tun ua, khum gam a bute na laah chiengun, na bu tha gamasate uh buphai khat siempu kunga na hing tawi ding uh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Noute pom na hitheina dingun, noute thahengin siempu in buphai khu, Mangpa mai ah avei dinga, khawlni zing niin, siempuin tuakhu avei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh khum buphai na vei ni un belamnou atal, nuolnabei, kumkhat a upa halmang sillat in Mangpa kungah na lan ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh khum ann sillat khu, tangbuong neel ngi ngei ephah se sawm suo se ni, sathau toh kihalsa Mangpa dinga gimnamtuitah mei a sillat ahi dinga; tualeh dawn sillat khu uoin nou khat se li suo sekhat ahi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na Pasian ua dinga sillat na hing tawi masang un tanghouin ahiei, akan in ahiei, avui in ahiei a zong, naneh dinguh ahisih hi, tami na umna mun zousie ua, na khang tungtawn ua, kumtawna dinga thugousie ahi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tualeh khawlni zingni vei sillat buphai na hing tawi ni ua kipat in na sim ding ua, khawlni sagivei aching ding ahi.","title":"Nipikaal pawi (Pentikos)","ref":"Pawt. 23.16; 34.22; Danp. 16.9-12"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh khawlni sagi veina zing mawng akipat ni sawmnga nasim ding ua, Mangpa kungah ann tha sillat na lan ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na tenna mun ua pat in ephah se sawmsuo seni a kibawl tanghou beu ni vei dingin na hing tawi ding uhi, tuate khu tangbuong neel a bawl ahi dinga, tol kisaw a kanthaw ahi ding hi, tuate khu Mangpa a dinga gamasate ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tanghou lat toh kituoh in, belamnou nuolnabei kumkhat a upa sagi leh bawngtal guol khat tualeh belamtal ni na lan ding uhi; tuate khu a ann sillat u’leh adawn sillatte u’tawh Mangpa dinga halmang sillat, Mangpa dinga gimnamtuitah mei a sillat ahi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuazou chiengin khelna sillat ding kelnou khat tualeh lemna kithoina sillat dingin kum khat a upa belamnou ni na lan ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin tuate khu ga masa tanghou toh Mangpa mai a vei sillat dingin belamnou nite toh avei dinga, siempu tanvou, Mangpa a dinga siengthou ahi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh khumi ni main na phuong ding ua, khawmpi siengthou ahi ding hi, nna mawngmawng na sep ding uh ahisih hi, tuapen na khangtung tawn ua, na umna mun zousie ua, kumtawn a dinga thupieh ahi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tualeh na lou ua bu na lah hun chiengun, na loupam gei ua nangawn zong na lah sieng ding ahisih a, na busang zong na tom sieng ding ahi sih hi, mi gentheite leh gamdang mite dingin na nua sie ding uhi, kei Mangpa na Pasian uh Ka hi,” chiin genin achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.9,10; Danp. 24.19-22"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Pengkul pawi"},"24":{"text":"“Israel tate houpi inlen, akung uah, Ha sagina, khummi ha ani khat ni nou a dingin khawldamna khawlni ahi ding, pengkul mut a theizingna khawmpi siengthou ahi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Nna mawngmawng na sep dinguh ahi sih a, Mangpa dinga mei a sillat na lan ding uhi” chiin achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Lemna ni","ref":"Siempu. 16.29-34"},"27":{"text":"“Ha sagina ni sawmni khu Lemnani ahi ding hi, tami khu noute adinga khawmpi siengthou ahi dinga; na lungsimte uh na gimsah ding ua, Mangpa kungah mei a sillatte na lan ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Khumi niin nna mawngmawng nasep ding uh ahisih hi; aziehpen khum ni khu Mangpa na Pasian uh mai a kilemna bawlna dinga, kilemna ni ahi."},"29":{"text":"Koi hinanleh khumi ni a lungsim gimsahlou khu amite lah a pat satkhiehin aum ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh koi hinanleh khummi ni a nna khat poupou sem a umleh amite lah apat ka sumang ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Bangma mawngmawng nasep dinguh ahisih a, na khang tungtawn ua, na tenna zousie ua, khantawn dan thupieh ahi ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tami ni khu nou a dingin tawldamna khawlni ahi dinga, na lungsimte uh na suhgim ding uh ahi, khummi ha ni kuo ni nitahlam, apat, nitah lam kia dongin khawlni in na mang ding uhi.”"},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Hampheng pawi","ref":"Danp. 16.13-15"},"34":{"text":"“Israel tate houpi inlen akung uah, Tam ha sagina ni sawm leni khu Mangpa a dinga ni sagi sung Biehbuh pawi ahi ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Ani khat ni khu kikhopna siengthou ahi dinga, nna mawngmawng na sep dinguh ahisih hi."},"36":{"text":"Ni sagi sungteng mei a sillat Mangpa kungah na lan ding uhi; Ani giet ni in kikhopna siengthou ahi dinga; mei a sillat Mangpa kungah na lan ding uhi; Tami kikhopna siengthou ahia, nna mawngmawng na seplou dinguh ahi."},"37":{"text":"“Tamte khu ahi Mangpa pawi hunbi sesate, Mangpa a dinga mei a sillatte, halmang sillalte, ann sillatte, dawn sillatte, ani hunbise chiet ua lan dinga kikhopna siengthou a na man dingte uh."},"38":{"text":"Mangpa khawlnite, na silpiehte uh, na thuchiemte uh, na kiphalna dungzui ua nasilpiehte uh, Mangpa kunga na piehte uh chilou in ah."},"39":{"text":"“Tualeh ha sagina ni sawm leh nga niin, gamsunga haichi ga na lahkhawm zou chiengun, Mangpa a dingin ni sagi sung pawi na mang ding uhi. Ni khatni khu khawlni ahi dinga, ni gietni zong khawlni ahi ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh ni khatni in singkung kilawm mama gate, tum sing bawhte, singna bawhphate, lui a muisum bawhte na tawi ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah nuomsa tahin ni sagi sung na um ding uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tami pawi khu kumchin in Mangpa dingin ni sagi sung naman dinguh ahi. Tami na khang tungtawn ua khantawn a na dan zui dinguh ahi."},"42":{"text":"Ni sagi sung sawlbuh ah na um ding ua, Israel mi a pieng pouma sawlbuh ah a um ding uhi."},"43":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipat a amaute ka puidoh laiin, Israel tate sawl buh ah ka umsah hi, chi atheina dingun, Keima Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi, chiin” achi hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Israel tate kungah, Mangpa Pawi hunbisete apuong dohta hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Biehbuh thaumei"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah olive thau kisuh chiimtah, meivah kuonsah ngitngetna dingin, na kunga hing tawi dingin thu pie in."},"3":{"text":"Kimutuona biehbuh a theipina puonzah pulamah, nitahlam akipat zingmawng donga dingin, Mangpa mai ah Aaron in akoi zel dinga, tuakhu na khang tungtawn ua dinga khantawn thupieh ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman thaumei khu sana siengset a kibawl thaumei tunna tungah akoi ngitnget ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tualeh tangbuong neel ngingei na la dinga, tanghou sawmle ni na bawl dinga, tanghou khat ah ephah khat sesawm suo seni ahi ding hi.","title":"Biehbuh tanghou","ref":"Pawt. 25.30"},"6":{"text":"Tuate khu Mangpa mai a dawkan siengthou tungah guol niin, guol khat ah guh tuoh tuoh in na chieng ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tanghou guolni tegel tungah gimnamtui siengthoutah na koi dinga, theizingna Mangpa a dinga mei a sillat banga tanghou tunga aum theina dingin."},"8":{"text":"Khawlni chinin Mangpa mai ah akoi zel ding ahi; kumtawn thuhun Israel tate ading ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tami Aaron leh atapate tanvou ahi dinga, munsiengthou ah ane ding uhi, aziehpen tami kumtawn thugousie dinga, Mangpa a dinga mei a sillatte lah a ama dinga sil siengthou pen ahi,” chiin.","ref":"Mat. 12.4; Mak. 2.26; Luk. 6.4"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Israel numei tapa, apa Izipt mi khat, Israel tate lah ah ava pawtdoh a, tam Israel numei tapa leh Israel mi khat giephuol sungah akihauta uhi.","title":"Pasian min gensiet gawtna"},"11":{"text":"Israel numei tapa in Mangpa min gensie in awsie alawkhum hi. Tuachi’n ama khu Mosi kungah ahing pui ua (anu min khu Shelomith Dan nam ami Debri tanu ahi.)"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa akipat theisahna thu ngahnain ama khu suongkul ah akhumta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,"},"14":{"text":"“Awse suopa khu giehphuol pulam ah hing puidoh unlen, a awse suo za zousie in atungah khut ngam uhenlen, mipi kikhawmte zousien suongin sep u’heh."},"15":{"text":"Israel tate houpi inlen, akung uah, koipou a Pasian awsie lawkhum pouma’n akhelna maw akipuoh ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa min gense pouma pellou a thalia ding ahi, mipi kikhawmte zousie in suonga aselia ngeingei dinguh ahi, gamdang mi hiin gamsunga pieng hitaleh, Mangpa min agensiet leh thalia ahiding hi."},"17":{"text":"Koipou mi that pouma pellou a thalia ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 21.12"},"18":{"text":"Ganta that pouma in asankia ding ahi, ganta taangin ganta."},"19":{"text":"Min ainnvengpa amel sietsah leh, aman abawl bangin ama tungah zong akibawlding hi."},"20":{"text":"Gutawng taangin gutawng, mit taangin mit, ha taangin ha, mi amelsiet sah bangbanga ama zong bawl ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 21.23-25; Danp. 19.21; Mat. 5.38"},"21":{"text":"Koizong ganta thatin asan ding ahi, tuolthat pouma thalia ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Gamdang mite ading leh tamgam mite adingin dan kibang na nei dinguh ahi. Aziehpen Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh Ka hi” achi hi.","ref":"Kisim. 15.16"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Israel tate ahoupi a, awse suopa khu giehphuol pulam ah a puidoh ua, suongin asepta uhi. Mangpa’n agen bangin Israel taten abawlta uhi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Sinai tangah Mosi ahoupi a.","title":"Sabbath kumte leh Jubili kum","ref":"Pawt. 23.10,11"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate houpi inlen akung uah, na kung ua ka hing pieh gam na hing tunhun chiengun, gamin Mangpa a dingin, khawl ni amang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Kum guh sung na lou uah haichi na chiing ding ua, kum guh sung na grephuon uh na hou sieng ding ua, agate na la ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh akum sagi kum khu gam khawldam khinkhienna kum, Mangpa a dinga khawldamna kum ahi ding hi, na lou uah haichi na chiing sih ding ua, na grephuon u’zong na housieng sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama thua a hing pou na bute na at lou ding ahi, na hawlou na grep huon a grep ga zong na lawlou ding ahi, aziehpen gam khawldam kum ahi."},"6":{"text":"Gam khawldam kuma piengte khu na ann neh dinguh ahi dinga, nangleh na suohpa dingin, na suohnu leh na suoh kilaw mi adingin, tualeh na kung ua um gamdang mi adingin."},"7":{"text":"Na ganhonte ading leh na gam sunga um gantate dingin, apieng zousie aneh ding uh ann ahi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tualeh khawldamna kum, kum sagi na simdinga, kum sagi mun sagi khawldam kum, kum sagite sung khu kum sawmli leh kuo ahi ding hi.","title":"Jubili kum man dan ding"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n aha sagina ani sawm niin Jubili pengkul na mutsah dinga, Kilemna niin na gamsung pumpi uah pengkul na mut ging sah ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh kum sawmngana kum khu na susiengthou ding ua; gamsung pumpia teng zousiete adingin Jalenna thu na phuong ding uhi. Noute adingin Jubili ahi dinga, mi chin in aneilelamte atang kia ding ua, michin a innkuonpite kungah akile kia ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuami kum sawmngana khu nou a dingin Jubili ahi dinga, bangma na tu sih ding ua, ama thu a hing poudohte zong na at sih ding uhi; na hawlou uh grep huon a grep gate zong na lousih ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen Jubili ahia, nou a dingin asiengthou ahi dinga, na lou ua haichi gate na ne ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"“Tam Jubili kum in michin in aneilelam chiet uh anei kia ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh na innvengte kunga bang ahiei silkhat na zua a, ahisihleh na innveng khuta kipat bang ahiei sil khat na lei leh khat leh khat na kisol tuolou ding uh ahi."},"15":{"text":"Jubili nua a kum phaza dungzuiin na innveng sil na lei dinga, bulebal pieng dan dungzuiin na kungah azua ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"A kum tamdan dungzuiin aman na khangsah ding ua, tualeh akum tawmdan dungzuiin aman na ngiemsah ding uhi; aziehpen haichi ga kum tam dan dungzui a na kunga zua ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin khat leh khat na kisol dinguh ahi sih hi; na Pasian giindan na siem dinguh ahi zawhi; Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi."},"18":{"text":"“Tuachi’n ka thupiehte na zui ding ua, ka vaihawmnate na pom dinguh ahi; tuachi’n gamsungah bittahin na teng ding uhi.","title":"Kum sagina silpiehte"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamin aga asuong dinga, nieng le tai tahin na ne ding ua, bittahin na teng ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh akum sagina a bang ne ding it adiei? Ngaivawi haichi lah tulou ding ihi ua, loua silpieng bangma lakhawmlou ding ihi ngal ua, na chi ua ahileh;"},"21":{"text":"Akum guhna kumin ka guolzawlna na tung uah ka tung sah dinga, kumthum sunga ding ga asuo ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n akumgietna kumin bulebal na chiing ding ua, akum kuona tandongin bulebal luite na ne ding uhi; haichi tha hing tun masangsien na nei luite uh na ne ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Gam khu kumtawna dinga zuaden ahi sih dinga gam pen kei a ahia, noute pen ka kunga khuolzin tam bang giap na hibou uhi.","title":"Nei leh lam tatkiana"},"24":{"text":"Na luona gam zousie uah gam tatdoh zel na phal ding uh ahi."},"25":{"text":"“Na unau khat ahing genthei a, anei lelam azua a, a unau kinaipi koi ahieikhat atan dinga ahing kuon leh; a unaupa nei lelam zuasate atan ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahisihleh tua mi pan atan ding mi khatbeeh anei lou a, ama mama in atatzou ding leh,"},"27":{"text":"Azua khiet kum tuot henlen, azuanapa kungah aval teng pekia heh, tuachia anei lelam teng atan kia theina ding in."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh atatkia zou sihleh Jubili kum dong aleipa khut ah aum dinga, Jubili kum chiengin hakhiet ahi dinga, tuachi’n aman anei lelamte atangkia ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tualeh min kho kulbang nei sunga teng pasal khat in a inn azua leh, azua nua kum khat sungin atankia thei ding hi, kum khat sung a tatdoh kiana hun anei hi."},"30":{"text":"Kum khat sunga atatdoh theisihleh, khum kulbaang nei sunga inn khu aleipa khutah kumtawn in ahahlesuonte tandongin aumden dinga Jubili kum chiengin zong apawtdoh nawn sih ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh khoneu kulbaang neilou a innte pen gam sunga loute banga sim ahi dinga tatkia thei ahi ding hi, Jubili chiengin apawtdoh thei ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh Levimite khopite leh agoutan khopite uh sunga innte pen Levimiten bangchih laipouin atan thei ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh mi koi ahiei in Levimite apat alei leh, inn kizuapen leh akhopi khu Jubili chiengin apawtdoh ding hi. Aziehpen Levimite khopi a innte khu Israel tate lah a agoutan uh ahi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh akhopi kimvel ua loute khu zuathei ahisih ding hi. Aziehpen tamte khu akumtawn goutan uh ahi.","title":"Migentheite kep dan ding"},"35":{"text":"“Tualeh na lah ua khat ahing gentheia, nang ahing bel leh nana panpi ding ahi, mikhuol leh khuolzin mi banga na umpi ding ahi.","ref":"Danp. 15.7,8"},"36":{"text":"Ama apat summet ahiei, silpung ahiei, la sinlen, na Pasian khu ging zaw in, na unaupa na kunga aum theina dingin."},"37":{"text":"Apung deina in na sum na leitawi sah ding ahisih a, amet um dingin nehletah zong na palah sah ding ahi sih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 22.25; Danp. 23.19,20"},"38":{"text":"Keima Mangpa na Pasian uh Kanaan gam hing pe ding leh na Pasian uh hi dinga Izipt gam a kipat hing puidohpa khu ka hi."},"39":{"text":"“Na tenpi na unau khat ahing gentheia, na kunga ahing kizua vawt tahleh, suoh leh sal banga na bawl ding ahisih hi.","title":"Suoh hina toh kisai dante","ref":"Pawt. 21.2-6; Danp. 15.12-18"},"40":{"text":"Hinanleh nasem a kithalaw mi bang leh mikhuol bangin na kungah aum dinga, Jubili tandong na nna ahing seppieh ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Khumzou chiengin na kunga pat in atate tawh apawtdoh ding a, tualeh a innkuonpite tawh ateng khawm kia dinga, apu leh pate inn leh lou aluo kia ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Azieh pen amaute khu Izipt gam a kipata ka hing puidoh ka suohte ahi ua, henta, suohle sal banga zua ding ahisih uhi."},"43":{"text":"Khautaha atunga vai na hawm ding ahisih a, na Pasian na giin zawh ding ahi."},"44":{"text":"Suohnu leh suohpa a na nei dingte khu na kim na vel ua um namte lah a mi ahi ding ua; amau’lah a mi suohnu leh suohpa dingin na lei ding uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tuathamlouin gamdang mi na kung ua mikhuol a umte leh na gam ua pieng a innkuonpi te lah ua mite zong na lei thei ding uhi, tuate khu nami nasa uh ahi ding uhi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh na nua chieng ua na tate uh goutan dingin, ami asa ua anei den dingun amaute na la ding ua, kumtawnin na suoh un a umden ding uhi, hinanleh na unau Israel tate khat leh khat khautah a naki vaihawm khumlou ding uh ahi."},"47":{"text":"“Tualeh na kunga teng gamdang mi ahiei, mikhuol khat ahiei, ahing hausat a, tualeh akunga um na unaupa khat ahing gentheia, na kunga gamdang mipa ahiei, mikhuolpa ahiei kunga, ahisihleh gamdang mipa innkuonpite khat poupou kunga akizua leh;"},"48":{"text":"Akizua nuain tatdoh kia thei ahi dinga, aunaute khat in atan thei ding hi."},"49":{"text":"Apaneu ahiei, apaneu tapa ahiei in atandoh thei ding hi, ahisihleh a innkuonpite lah a akinaipi khat in atan thei ding hi, ahisihleh aman azaw leh ama leh ama akitan thei ding hi."},"50":{"text":"Ama leipa tawh akunga akizua akipata Jubili kum tandong atuot ding ua, akizuana man khu akum tam dan dungzuiin akunga suoh nasem a kilawte hunsung dungzuiin ahi ding hi."},"51":{"text":"Kum tampi a um nahlai leh atatna man khu akilei hunsung dungzuiin ape kia ding hi."},"52":{"text":"Tualeh Jubili kum tunna ding kum tomnoukhat aum tahleh, atuot khawm ding ua, aum nalai kum tamdan dungzuiin atatna man apekia ding hi."},"53":{"text":"Kum khatbi zela kiguoi suoh nasemte bangin a kungah aum dinga, na mit muin atungah khautahin vai ahawm khum ding ahisih hi."},"54":{"text":"Tualeh tami kumte sunga tat ahisihleh, Jubili kum chiengin ama leh atate tawh ha khiet ahi ding uhi."},"55":{"text":"Aziehpen Israel tate khu kei a dingin suoh ahi ua, amaute khu Izipt gam akipat ka puidoh ka suohte ahi uhi; Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Nouten milim khenthu na bawl dinguh ahisih a, milim bawlthu ahiei, suongphu ahiei, na dinsah ding uh ahisih hi, bieh dingin na gamsung uah suong milim zong na phut ding uh ahisih hi, aziehpen kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi.","title":"Thuman zieh a guolzawlnate","ref":"Siempu. 19.4; Pawt. 20.4; Danp. 5.8; 16.21,22; 27.1"},"2":{"text":"Ka khawlnite na tang ding ua, ka mun siengthoute na zatat dinguh ahi, Kei Mangpa khu ka hi."},"3":{"text":"“Ka danthute na zui ua, ka thupiehte na pom ua na bawl u’leh,","ref":"Danp. 11.13-15; 28.1-14"},"4":{"text":"Guotuite ahuntahin ka hing zusah dinga, leiin aga ahing piengsah dinga, gam a singten ga ahing suong ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Na phuol ua bu in grep lawhun abanpha dinga, na grep lawun haichi chiin hun abanpha ding hi, na tanghou uh nieng leh tai in na ne ding ua, na gam uah lungmuong tahin na teng ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Gamsung hamuong tahin ka umsah dinga, na lum hit hiet ding uhi, Koiman ahing zausah sih dinga, tualeh gamsa giloute gamsung akipat in ka delmang dinga, na gamsung uh atuonsuoh sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Na galte uh na del ding ua, na masang uah namsau in apua ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mi nga in mi zakhat na del ding ua, zakhat in mi tulsawm na delzah ding ua, na galte uh na masang uah namsau a thalupin aum ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen noute ka hing deisah dinga, gatampi ka hing suongsah dinga, ka hing pungsah dinga, ka thuhun noute tawh ka sudet ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Bu lui leh bu tha na kipha ding ua, bu tha koina dingin bu luite na hemsieng ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Na lah uah ka biehbuh ka phutdet dinga, ka hinna in noute ahing elngatsan sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na lah uah ka teng dinga, na Pasian uh ka hi dinga, noute ka mite na hi ding uhi.","ref":"2 Kor. 6.16"},"13":{"text":"Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh, sila henta na hilouna ding ua, Izipt gam a kipata noute hing puidohpa ka hi, na hahkolte uh ka hing suhtanpiehta a, tangtah in ka hing vah sahta hi."},"14":{"text":"“Hinanleh ka thu na man lou ua, ka thupiehte zousie na zui sih ua;","title":"Thumangloute gawtnate","ref":"Danp. 28.15-68"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh ka danthute na simmaw ua, ahisihleh na hinna un ka vaihawmnate ahuot a, ka thupieh zousie bawl nuomlou a, ka thuhun na bawsiet u’leh;"},"16":{"text":"Ken zong tami na tung uah ka tungsah ding hi: Na tung uah sil zauhuoi mama na hinna uh netum leh na mitte uh susie ding leh kumzawnnate tualeh khosih natnate ka tungsah ding hi, na haichi tute uh amawhna ahi dinga, na galte un aga ane zel ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na tung uah ka mai ka gumsah dinga, na galte uh masangah na guollel ding uhi, nou hing mudaten na tung uah vai ahawm ding ua, koima dellou in na tai ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tamte zousie zieh a ka thu na ngaikhieh tuomlou u’leh, na khelnate ziehun ale sagi in kahing gawt ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na kiletsahpi uh na thahhatna uh ka hiehtawng ding a, na van uh sia ka bangsah dinga, na leitung uh sum-eng ka bangsah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh na thahatna uh athawnin na mangbei ding uhi: aziehpen na gam un haichi apiengsah sih dinga, singten zong ga aneisih ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Tualeh kei toh kilengat a na gamtat ua, ka thu na ngailou u’leh, na khelna utoh kituoh gawtna ale sagi in ka tungsah ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Na lah uah gamsa hang ka hing sawl dinga, na tate uh ahing tawmangpieh dinga, na gantate uh ahing thapieh ding ua, na tawm deudeu ding ua, tualeh na lampite uh atulta ding hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tualeh tam silte a zong na kisiemphat tuomlou ua, ka deidan kal a na gamtat nalai u’leh;"},"24":{"text":"Kei zong noute kal in ka gamta dinga, na khelna ziehun ale sagi in ka hing gawt ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na tung uah namsau ka leengsah dinga, tuamin ka thuhun phuba ala dinga, tualeh na khopi sungte ua na kikhopkhawm chiengun, na lah uah natna hii ka leengsah dinga, na galte uh khuta piehlut in na um ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Na kingahna bulpi pen uh na tanghou uh ka khahtan hun chiengin, numei sawm in lungthu khat ah tanghou akang ding ua, na tanghou ding uh te detdet in ahing pe ding uhi; nane ding ua hinanleh na khamsih ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"“Hichi tan chienga zong ka thu na zui tuomlou ua, ka deidan kal a na namtat nalai u’leh;"},"28":{"text":"Kei zong na tung uah lungthah pumin na gamtatna uh kal in ka gamta dinga, keima ngelin na khelnate ziehun sagivei ka hing gawt ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Na tapate uh sa na ne ding ua, tualeh na tanute uh sa na ne ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Na mun sangte uh ka suse dinga, na gimnamtui halna maitamte uh ka satpua dinga, na luongte uh hinna neilou milim luongte tungah ka sepkhawm dinga; ka hinna in noute ahing muda ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Na khopite uh bangmalou ka suohsah dinga, na munsiengthoute uh nuasie in ka umsah dinga, tualeh na gimnamtui halte uh ka nam nawnsih ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh na gam uh ka hawmsuohsah dinga, khuna teng na melmate un lamdang asa ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Namdangte lah ah ka hing thethang dinga, nou hing delzui ding namsau ka dohkhe dinga, tuachi’n na gam uh ahawmsuoh dinga, na khopite uh nuasie in aumta ding hi."},"34":{"text":"“Tuachi’n gam nuasie a aum sung leh na melmate uh gam a na um sungsie un, gamsung akhawl dinga, tuachi’n akhawlnite ah nuom asa ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Nuasie a um sungteng gam akhawl dinga, a sunga na ten lai ua, na khawlnite ua akhawl khahlou ziehin."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh nuasie a um adam sunte, a melmate uh gamah, lungtang zawnkhalna ka pe dinga, singna kiloh gingin zong azausah dinga, namsau a kidel banga zauin atai ding ua, koima dellou in apua ding uhi."},"37":{"text":"Koima dellou in namsau masanga pua bangin, khatlekhat akipalpua ding ua, tualeh na galte uh dalna dingin thahatna mawngmawng na neisih ding uhi."},"38":{"text":"Namdangte lah ah na mangthai ding ua, na melmate uh gamin nou ahing ne gam ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh na lah ua adam um sunte na melmate uh gamah athulimlounate ziehun abeimang deu deu ding ua, apu le pate uh gitlouna ziehin zong a mautoh abeimang khawm ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"“Hinanleh agitlounate u’leh apulepate uh gitlounate leh kei douna a agamtatnate uh, akisia ua,","title":"Tunding kiana ding thuchiem"},"41":{"text":"Kei zong amauh kal a kana gamtatnate, amelmate uh gam a kana puilutdan akitheimaw bawllou ua, alungtang teptan lou uh akingaingiem ua, agitlouna zieh ua gawtnate apom u’leh;"},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ken zong Jakob kunga ka thuhun ka thei ngitnget dinga, Isak leh Abraham toh ka thuhunte zong ka thei zing dinga, gam zong ka thei zing ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 28.13,14; Siem. 26.3,4; Siem. 17.7,8"},"43":{"text":"Tualeh gam zong amaute nuasie in a um dinga, amaute umlou a ahawma nuasie a aum sungin nuomtahin a khawlnite amang ding hi, tualeh agitlouna zieh ua gawtna khu apom ding uhi; aziehpen ka vaihawmnate asimmaw ua, Ka danthupiehte ahinna un amu nuom sih uhi."},"44":{"text":"Khuchi pumpumin zong, amelmate gamsunga aum sungun, amaute sumang ding leh, akung ua ka thuhun suse dingin ama uh ka paimang sih dinga, ka muda sam sih ding hi; Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi."},"45":{"text":"Hinanleh a Pasian uh ka hi theina dinga, nam zousie mitmu a, Izipt gam a kipata ka puidoh apulepate uh thuhun ama u’ziehin ka thei zing ding hi, Kei Mangpa khu ka hi, chiin achi hi.”"},"46":{"text":"Tamte khu Sinai taanga Mosi khut zanga Mangpa’n ama leh Israel tate kikaal a abawl thupiehte leh vaihawmnate leh dante ahi hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Mihing siensuona"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate houpi inlen akung uah; Mi koiin zong Mangpa kunga poimawna vilvel tungtanga thu achiem leh a mihing man dinga na tuot khu Mangpa tanvou ahi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Na tuot danding khu pasal ahileh, kum sawmni apat kum sawm guh tan mi ahileh mun siengthou shekel a tuot in dangka sawmnga ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Numei ahileh na tuotdan ding khu shekel sawmthum ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh kumnga apat kum sawmnitan mite khu pasal ahileh shekel sawmni ahidinga, numei ahileh shekel sawm khat ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh ha khat apat kum nga tan mite khu pasal ahileh dangka shekel nga ahi dinga, numei ahileh dangka shekel thum ahi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh kum sawm guh apat atunglam mite pasal ahileh dangka shekel sawm leh nga ahidinga, numei ahileh shekel sawm khat ahi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh na tuotna sanga gentheizaw ana hi a pe zoulou ding ahileh, siempu mai ah ahing kipelut dinga, tuachi’n siempu in aman ding ana tuot pieh ding hi, athuchiempa zaw thei ding hun giap siempu in ana bihieh pieh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tualeh sillat Mangpa kunga alat dinguh ganta ahileh koipouin Mangpa kunga khumbanga apieh pouma uh sil siengthou ahi ding hi.","title":"Ganta siengthou latna"},"10":{"text":"Silpieh ding khu ahen lamdang ding ahisih hi, ahoi taanga asie, ase taanga ahoi a ahending ahi sih a, ganta ganta mama a hen teitei ding ahileh aniin, ahenna toh asianthou dinguh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa kunga kithoina a alat ngailou uh ganta sienglou ahileh, siempu kungah aganta khu ahing pe ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu in aman ana bihieh pieh dinga ahoi hiin asie hitaleh: nang, siempu in na bihieh dan bang bang ahi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh asillatte anua tatkia ut pouma leh aman ding kibihieh sa senga suo sekhat belapin atan ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tualeh mi’n a inn Mangpa kunga siengthou dinga alat leh, ahoile hoilou dungzuiin siempu in aman ding abihiehpieh dinga, siempu in a bihieh pieh dan bang bang ahi ding hi.","title":"Inn siensuona"},"15":{"text":"A inn lanpa’n anuatat ut kia leh aman dinga kibihiehsa se nga suo sekhat abelap dinga, atan kia dinga, tuachi’n ama a ahi kia ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Mi khat in aneisa alougam bangchia ahieikhat Mangpa dinga alat ding leh na bihieh pieh ding dan khu alou a haichi achiin dan dungzui ahi ding hi. Barli-bu homer khat mun khu dangka shekel sawmnga a tuot ahi ding hi.","title":"Gam leh lou siensuona"},"17":{"text":"Alou khu Jubili kum apat alat ahileh, na bihieh pieh bang bang ahitoupeh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh alou Jubili nualam a alat ahileh pen, siempu in Jubili tunkiana ding kum umnalai dungzui in aman atuot dinga, na tuot dan akipata kiemsah ahi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Alou lanpan anua tatkia ut leh aman kituotsa apat se nga suo sekhat abelap dinga atan kia ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh alou pen atatkia utlou ahiei, ahisihleh midang kunga ana zuasawn ahileh, akiitankia thei nawn sih ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahivangin alou Jubili kuma apawtdoh kia hun chiengin lou pen akipieh khiet dungzuiin, Mangpa a dinga siengthou ama tanvou ahia, siempu in atang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh mikhat in ama neisa hilou, lou khat alei a, Mangpa kunga alat leh."},"23":{"text":"Siempu in Jubili kum tan adinga na tuotsa bangin aman ding abihiehpieh dinga, na tuot bangin Mangpa adinga sil siengthou dingin khumni mama in ape ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Jubili kumin lou khu aleinapa, agamneipa kungah ahing tung kia ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh na tuotdan zousie khu mun siengthou shekel dungzui in ahi dinga, gerah sawmni in shekel khat ahi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"“Hinanleh ganta lah a piangmasapen, Mangpa ganta masapen hidingte khu koiman alat ding uh ahisih hi; bawngtal hiin belam hitaleh, tami Mangpa tanvou ahi.","title":"Ganta sieng piengmasa"},"27":{"text":"Ganta sienglou ahileh, na tuot dan dungzuia tat ding ahiding hi, se nga suo sekhat abelap ding hi, akitat sihleh a man na bihieh dungzuiin zua ahiding hi."},"28":{"text":"“Ahivang in sil lat dohsa, mikhat in aneisa laha sil khat poupou, mihing hiin, ganta hiin, aneisa lou hitaleh Mangpa kunga alatsa zuading ahisih a, tatding zong ahi sih hi, tuabang sil pouma Mangpa dingin asiengthou pen ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 18.14"},"29":{"text":"Mikoipou shi dinga thutankhum sa khu tatdoh kia ding ahisih a, ama khu shisah teitei ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"“Gamsunga sawma khat zousie, haichi hiin, sing ga hitaleh Mangpa a ahia, Mangpa adinga siengthou ahi.","title":"Sawma khat thu","ref":"Kisim. 18.21; Danp. 14.22-29"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh min asawm akhat anuatat utkia leh, se nga suo sekhat abelap in atan ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Bawnghon, belamhon, sawm a khat thu ah gan chingmi chieng nuoi a peisuoh pouma asawmna khu Mangpa adinga siengthou ahi ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Gantate ahoi leh hoilou aenchien ding ahisiha, ahen ding zong ahisih hi, ahentah leh zong ahenna pen leh ahen pen zong ani un asiengthou ding ahi; tat ding ahishi hi.”"},"34":{"text":"Tamte khu Sinai taanga Mangpa’n Israel tate dinga Mosi kunga thupieh apiehte ahi."}}}}},"4":{"info":{"name":"Kisimnabu","shortname":"Kisim.","abbr":[],"desc":"Mosi laibu lina kisimnabu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipata ahing pawtdoh nua uh kum nina, hanina, ani khat niin, Sinai gamdai a a umna uh kimutuona biehbuh sungah Mangpa’n Mosi kungah tambangin agen hi.","title":"Sinai a Israelte kisimna","ref":"Kisim. 26.1-51"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate mipi umkhawmte zousie, aphung aphung in, ahainet ahainet in, amin uh dungzui in pasal um zousie sim in."},"3":{"text":"Israel sunga galdou dinga kuon thei, kum sawmni apat atunglam zousie apawl pawlin nang leh Aaron in na sim ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh phung zousie, ahainet sung chiet ua akhai pa chiet, nouma toh na kung uah a um ding uh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tamte khu na kung ua, nouma toh um khawm ding te ahi uhi: Reuben phungah Shedeur tapa Elizur;"},"6":{"text":"Simeon phungah Zurishaddai tapa Shelumiel;"},"7":{"text":"Juda phungah Amminadab tapa Nahshon;"},"8":{"text":"Issakar phungah
