Zuar tapa Nethaneel,"},"9":{"text":"Zebulun phungah Helon tapa Eliab."},"10":{"text":"Joseph tate lah ah: Ephraim phunga Ammihud tapa Elishama; Manasseh phungah Pedahzur tapa Gamaliel."},"11":{"text":"Benjamin phungah Gideon tapa Abidan."},"12":{"text":"Dan phungah Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer."},"13":{"text":"Asher phungah Okran tapa Pagiel."},"14":{"text":"Gad phunga Deuel tapa Eliasaph."},"15":{"text":"Naphtali phungah Enan tapa Ahira.”"},"16":{"text":"Tamte khu mipi kikhawm ten atel doh uh phung zousie zungpipa chiet leh hainet upa chiet ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Mosi leh Aaron in tana amin chiet ua kiloute azawpi ua."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh amauten mipi umkhawm zousie khu aha nina ani khat niin a hankhawm ua, aphung aphung in, ahainet ahainet a amin uh kizawmdan dungzuiin kum sawmni akipat atunglam zousie amauh suongtu apu apate uh min atahlang uhi."},"19":{"text":"Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin amaute Sinai gamdai ah asimta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tapa upapen Reuben tate khu ahainet, ahainet u’leh aphung aphung un, amin uh akizomdan dungzuiin, pasal kum sawmni akipat atunglam galkap dia kuon thei zousie a sim ua."},"21":{"text":"Reuben phung a asim za uh, tul sawmli leh tul guh leh zanga ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Simeon tate akhang u’leh aphung aphung leh ahainet ahainet dung zui ua, amin uh kizom dan in, Pasal kumsawmni akipat atunglam gal kuon thei zousie a sim ua;"},"23":{"text":"Simeon phunga asim za uh, tul sawmnga leh tul kuo leh zathum ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Gad tate akhang u’leh aphung u’leh ahainet dung zui ua, amin uh kizomdan in, pasal kum sawmni akipat atunglam galdou a kuon thei zousie asim ua;"},"25":{"text":"Gad phunga asim za uh, tul sawmli leh tul nga leh zaguh leh sawmnga ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Juda tate akhang u’leh aphung uh, tualeh ahainet, hainet dungzui ua, amin uh ki zom dan in pasal kum sawmni akipat atunglam, galkuon thei, zousie asim ua;"},"27":{"text":"Juda phunga asim za uh, tul sawmsagi leh tul li leh za guh ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Issakar tate akhang u’leh, aphung u’leh, ahainet ahainet ua, amin uh kizomdan dungzuiin, Pasal kum sawmni akipat atunglam gal kuon thei zousie a sim ua;"},"29":{"text":"Issakar phunga asim za uh, tul sawmnga leh tul li leh za li ahi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Zebulun tate akhang u’leh, aphung ua, tualeh a hainet ahainet ua, amin uh kizom dan dungzui in, Pasal kum sawmni akipat atunglam, gal kuon thei zousie asim ua;"},"31":{"text":"Jebulun phunga asim za uh, tul sawmnga leh tulsagi leh zali ahi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Joseph tate chipen Ephraim tate akhang u’leh aphung uh tualeh ahainet ahainet ua, amin uh kizom dan dungzuiin, pasal kum sawmni akipat atunglam gal kuon thei zousie asim ua;"},"33":{"text":"Ephraim phunga asim za uh, tul sawmli leh za nga ahi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Manasseh tate akhang u’leh aphung uh tualeh ahainet ahainet dungzui ua, amin uh kizom dan dungzuiin, Pasal kum sawmni akipat atunglam gal kuon thei zousie a sim ua;"},"35":{"text":"Manasseh phunga asim za uh, tul sawmthum leh tul ni leh za ni ahi."},"36":{"text":"Benjamin tate akhang u’leh aphung, aphung u’leh ahainet ahainet dungzui ua, amin uh kizomdan dungzui in, pasal kum sawmni akipat atunglam gal kuon thei zousie, asim ua;"},"37":{"text":"Benjamin phunga asim za uh, tul sawmthum leh tul nga leh zali ahi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Dan tate akhang u’leh aphung aphung u’leh ahainet ahainet ua amin uh kizom dan dungzuiin pasal kum sawmni akipat atunglam, galkuon thei zousie, asim ua;"},"39":{"text":"Dan phunga asim za uh, tul sawmguh leh tulni leh za sagi ahi uhi."},"40":{"text":"Asher tate akhang u’leh aphung aphung u’leh ahainet ahainet dungzui ua, amin uh kizom dan dungzui in, pasal kum sawmni akipat atunglam gal kuon thei zousie asim ua;"},"41":{"text":"Asher phunga asimza uh, tul sawmli leh tul khat leh za nga ahi uhi."},"42":{"text":"Naphtali tate akhang u’leh aphung aphung uh tualeh ahainet ahainet ua, amin uh kizom dung zuiin, pasal kum sawmni apat atunglam gal kuon thei zousie asim ua;"},"43":{"text":"Naphtali phunga asim za uh, tul sawm nga leh tul thum leh zali ahi uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tamte ahi uh, Mosi leh Aaron in Israel nam lamkai sawmleni asimte uh, amaute aphung sung chiet ua u pate ahi uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate aphung aphung un, kum sawmni apat atunglam, gal kuonthei zousie Israel gam ah asim ua;"},"46":{"text":"Asim zousie uh a bawnun, tul za guh leh tul sawm thum leh za nga leh sawm nga ahi uhi."},"47":{"text":"Hinanleh Levimite suongtu apu apate uh pen alah uah asimtel sih uhi.","title":"Biehbuh enkol dinga Levite kiguotna"},"48":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n Mosi kungah;"},"49":{"text":"“Levi phungpen na sim sih dinga, Israel tate lah ah zong amaute na sim tel lou ding ahi."},"50":{"text":"Hinanleh Levimite pen theipina biehbuh enkol ding leh, asunga vanzah zousie leh van um zousie kem dinga na guot ding ahi. Amauten biehbuh apoding ua, avanzah zousie toh, Tualeh tuate zousie a enkol ding ua, biehbuh akim kot in a imkhum ding uhi."},"51":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh akisuon ding chiengin Levi miten aphet ding ua, tualeh biehbuh tunding ahi chiengin, Levimite ma in atung ding uhi; namdang mi akung nai a ahing pei leh thalup ding ahi."},"52":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten ama uh mun chiet ah apawl pawl in atam dan uh dungzui zelin apuon innte uh azah ding uhi."},"53":{"text":"Hinanleh Levimiten theipina biehbuh kim kot in apuon innte uh azah ding uhi; Israel mipi kikhawmte tunga lungthahna atun louna dingin Levimiten theipina biehbuh a enkol ding uhi;” achi hi."},"54":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten Mangpa’n Mosi athupieh zousie dungzuiin tuabangin abawl ta uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron ahoupi a akung uah tam bangin agen hi.","title":"Giehphuol mun kihawm dan"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate’n aphung chiemtena puonlap uh taa chiet in apawl uh bawl dan bangin a puon inn uh azah ding uhi: kimutuona biehbuh nai senglou in akimkot in biehbuh lam ngat chietin azah ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Nisuohna lam suolam pangah apawl uh tamdan dungzuiin Juda pawlin Puonzah azah ding uhi. Amminadab tapa Nahshon khu Judate lamkai ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh galkap pawl sima umte tamdan, tul sawmsagi leh tul li leh zaguh ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh aban a puoninn zah ding Issakar phung ahi dinga; Zuar tapa Nethaneel khu Issakarte lamkai ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh galkap pawl sima umte tamdan tul sawmnga leh tul li leh za li ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaban ah Zebulun phung ahi dinga, tualeh Helon tapa Eliab khu Zebulun tate lamkai ahi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh galkap pawl sima umte tamdan, tul sawmnga leh tul sagi leh za li ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Apawl uh tamdan bangzela Juda pawl lah a simtelte tamdan tul za leh tul sawm giet leh guh leh zali ahi uhi. Amauten ma apui zel ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Simlam pangah: Reuben pawlte apawl uh tam dan dungzuiin a um ding uhi: Reuben tate lamkai dingin Shedeur tapa Elizur ahi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh galkap pawl sima umte tamdan tul sawmli leh tul guh leh za nga ahi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh ama kunga puon inn zah ding khu Simeon phung ahi dinga: Simeon tate lamkai ding khu Zurishaddai tapa Shelumiel ahi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh galkap pawl sima umte tamdan khu tul sawmnga leh tul kuo leh zathum ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ban ah Gad phung ahi dinga, tualeh Gad tate lamkai dingin, Reuel tapa Eliasaph ahi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh galkap pawl sima umte tamdan, tul sawmli leh tul nga leh zaguh leh sawm nga ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Apawl uh tamdan dungzuia Reuben pawl a sim telte tamdan tul za leh tul sawmnga leh khat leh zali leh sawm nga ahi uhi. Amaute aguolni na ah apei ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"“Tuachi’n kimutuona biehbuh apat apawt doh dinga, Levimite khu alai ah a um ding ua, Amauh diellap chiet toh gieh phuol abawl bangun apei ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"“Tumlam pangah: Ephraim pawl, akichiemtena uh puonlap taa in atamdan dungzui un a um ding ua, Ephraim tate lamkai ding Ammihud tapa Elishama ahi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A galkap sima umte tamdan tul sawmli leh za nga ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh aban ah Manasseh phung a um dinga, Manasseh tate lamkai Pedahzur tapa Gamaliel ahi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh agalkap pawl sima umte tam dan tul sawmthum leh tul ni leh zani ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuazouin Benjamin phung ahi dinga, Benjamin tate lamkai, Gideon tapa Abidan ahi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh agalkap pawl sima umte tamdan, tul sawm thum leh nga leh zali ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ephraim giehphuol a mipite apawl apawl a akisim leh tul za leh giet leh za khat ahi uhi. Mailam nawt a apei chiengun amaute a guol thumna ahi ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Mallam pangah: atam dan dungzui un Dan phungte a um ding ua; Dan tate lamkai Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer ahi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh agalkap pawl sima umte tamdan tul sawmguh leh tul ni leh za sagi ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh aban ua puon zah dingte, Asher phung ahi ahi ding a, Asher tate lamkai Okran tapa Pagiel ahi ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh agalkap pawl sima umte tamdan tul sawmli leh tul khat leh za nga ahi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ban ah Naphtali phungin puonbuh azah ding ua Naphtali tate lamkai Enan tapa Ahira ahi ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh a galkap pawl sima umte tamdan tul sawm nga leh tul thum leh zali ahi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Dan pawla sima um zousiete tamdan tul za leh tul sawmnga leh tul sagi leh zaguh ahi uhi. Amaute apuonlap utoh aguol nukhia pen ah apei ding uhi.”"},"32":{"text":"Tamte Israel tate aphung aphung ua kisimte ahi ua, agieh phuol ua, mipi kisim zousie agawmkhawm in tul zaguh leh tul thum leh za nga leh sawmnga ahi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh Levi mitepen Israel tate lah a simtel ahi sih uhi; Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh zousie dungzuiin abawl ua; tuabangin apawl apawlin puon inn azah ua, Tualeh aphung aphung leh ahainet ahainet dung zuiun akipan khezel uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tamte khu Sinai muoltunga Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi lai a, Aaron leh Mosi hahlesuonte ahi uhi.","title":"Aaron tapate"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu Aaron tapate min ahi uhi; a upa pen Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 26.60"},"3":{"text":"Tamte khu Aaron tapate siempu nasem ding a sathau nu a namdet a umte min ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nadab leh Abihu in Sinai gamdai a Mangpa masang a, mei sienglou alat ziehun Mangpa masang ah ashita uhi. Amauten tapa anei sih uhi: Tuachi’n Eleazar leh Ithamar in apa uh Aaron damsung tengin siempu nna asem tawntung uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 10.1,2; Kisim. 26.61"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah,","title":"Levite siempu nasem dinga tel ahi uh"},"6":{"text":"“Levi phung khu siempu Aaron kung ah hing zawpi inlen ana asep pieh theina dingun akung ah um sahin."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh amauten biehbuh nasem in, kimutuona biehbuh masangah akul leh poimaw bangzel in ama leh mipite’n nna asem ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh kimutuona biehbuh sunga vanzah zousie akemding ua, Israel tate a dingin biehbuh nasep asem ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Levimite pen Aaron leh atapate kungah na pe ding a: amaute khu Israel tate lah a kipata a pumpia akunga pieh ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron leh atapate na teldoh dinga, siempu hina nasep asem den ding uhi; namdang hing kigolkha a um leh thalia ahi ding hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah."},"12":{"text":"“Ngaiin Keima’n Levimite khu, Israel tate lah a kipat ta masa naubu hong masapen zousie taangin Israelte lah a kipat ka lata hi. Tuaziehin Levite khu keia ahi uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 13.2"},"13":{"text":"Tachil zousie lah kei a ahi ngal a, Izipt gam a tachil pieng masa zousie, mihing hiin ganta hitaleh kei a dinga ka koi siengthou ahita hi. Keima Mangpa kahi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Sinai gamdai ah Mosi ahoupi a akungah,","title":"Levitate kisimna"},"15":{"text":"“Levi tate aphung aphung, ahainet ahainet in sim inlen; pasal ha khat a kipat atunglam zousie nasim ding ahi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in akunga thu kipie dungzui leh Mangpa thu bang in amaute asim ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tamte khu amin uh dungzui a Levi tapate ahi uhi: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari;"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu aphung dung zui un Gershon tapate min ahi uh; Libni leh Shimei."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh aphung dungzui zel un Kohath tapate, Amram Izehar, Hebron leh Uzziel ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh aphung dungzui ua Merari tapate, Mahli leh Mushi ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Gershon apat Libnite phung leh Shimeite phung ahing umdoh a, tamte khu Gershon hahlesuonte ahi uhi.","title":"Gershon phung kisimna"},"22":{"text":"Pasal hakhat apat atunglam min sima um zousie a unin tul sagi leh zanga ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Gershon phung miten, biehbuh tumlam pangah apuonbuh uh azah ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Gershon tate lamkai ding Lael tapa Eliasaph ahi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Gershon taten kimutuona biehbuh akep ding ukhu biehbuh leh atung khunate, kimutuona biehbuh a puonzahte;"},"26":{"text":"Ahuongsung puonzahte, biehbuh huongsung tunkot leh maitam kimvel a puonzahte, tualeh, tua mun a nasepna zousie a zah ding khaute ahi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Kohath apat Amram mite phung Izharmite phung leh Hebronmite phung leh Uzzielmite phung ahing umdoh hi; tamte khu Kohath mite innkuonte ahi uhi.","title":"Kohath phung kisimna"},"28":{"text":"Pasal ha khat akipat atunglam min sim a um zousiete aun un tul giet leh za guh ahi ua mun siengthou kem dingte ahi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Kohath tapaten biehbuh simlam pangah apuon inn uh azah ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Kohathmite lamkai ding khu Uzziel tapa Elizaphan ahiding hi."},"31":{"text":"Amaute etkol ding khu Thuhun bawm, dawkan, thaumei tunna, maitamte, munsiengthou sunga Siempu nasepna a vanzah umlebelte leh munsiengthoupen lutna kot a puonzahte leh tam vanzah zousie toh kisai a mawpuohna nei ahi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Siempu Aaron tapa Eleazar khu Levimite lamkaite lamkai lienpen ahi dinga, mun siengthou etkolna ah houtu ahi ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Merari apat Mahlite phung leh Mushite phung ahing umdoh hi. Tamte Merari phungte ahi uhi.","title":"Merari phung simna"},"34":{"text":"Tualeh pasal ha khat apat atunglam min sima um zousie, tul guh leh zani ahi uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Merari phungte upa pen Abihail tapa Zuriel ahi; Amauten biehbuh sahlam pang ah apuon innte uh azah ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Merari tapate etkol dinga kiguot khu biehbuh singpehte a zawlte, akhuomte, khuom phuna khuohkuohte, umlebelte zousie leh nasepna a vanzahte zousie ahi ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh ahuong kimkot a khuomte leh akhuom ngahna khuohkuohte, akilbehnate leh akhaute toh ahi ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuaban ah nisuonalam biehbuh mai a kimutuona biehbuh mai a, suolam panga Puon inn zah ding khu Mosi leh Aaron leh atapate ahi ding ua, Israeltate taangin munsiengthou a enkol ding uhi. Namdang mi akung nai ua ahing pei leh thalup in a um ding ahi."},"39":{"text":"Mangpa thupieh banga Mosi leh Aaron in a aphung phunga pasal hakhat apat atunglam zousie asimte uh tul sawmni leh tul ni ahi uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Israel tate lah ah tachil pasal ha khat apat atunglam zousie sim inlen amin uh giel lut in:","title":"Pieng masapente taangin Levite"},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Levimite khu kei a tuom ahi ua (Kei Mangpa khu Ka hi). Israel tate lah a tachil piengmasa zousie taangin na la ding hi, tualeh Levimite gantate khu Israel ganta pieng masapen taangin na la ding ahi” achi hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n thu apieh bangin Mosi in Israel tate lah a tachil zousie a sim hi."},"43":{"text":"Tachil pasal amin uh kizom bang zel un, ha khat a upa apat atunglam a sim zousie uh, tul sawmni leh tul ni leh zanile sawm sagi leh thum ahi uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah,"},"45":{"text":"“Levimite khu Israel tate lah a tachil zousie taangin la inlen, tualeh Levimite ganta khu agantate uh taangin lain; Levimite kei a ahi ding uh: Kei Mangpa khu ka hi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh Levimite sanga atam zohna uh, Israel tate tachil zani leh sawm sagi leh thumte tatna dingin,"},"47":{"text":"Mi khat ah Shekel nga chiet na la ding hi, mun siengthou a shekel dungzuiin (Shekel khat khu Gerah sawmni ahi)"},"48":{"text":"Tualeh tatna sum avalteng khu Aaron leh atapate na pieh ding ahi,” achi hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levimiten atatzou ban ua umnalai tatna sumte khu Mosi in ala a:"},"50":{"text":"Israel tate tachil lah a kipat in sum khu ala a, munsiengthou shekel dungzuiin shekel tul khat leh zathum leh sawm guh leh nga, ala hi."},"51":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin, Mangpa thu dungzuiin Mosi in tatna sumte khu Aaron leh atapate kungah apie hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron ahoupi a akung uah,","title":"Levite laha Kohath tate sepding"},"2":{"text":"“Levi tapate laha kipat in Kohath tapate aphung aphung u’leh ahainet ahainet un,"},"3":{"text":"Kum sawmthum apat atunglam kum sawm nga tanchieng kimutuona biehbuh a, nasem thei ding zousie sim un."},"4":{"text":"Kimutuona biehbuh mun siengthou pen a Kohath tapate nasep ding khu tamte ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ummun akisuon ding chiengun Aaron leh atapate ahing pei ding ua, mun siengthou puonzah alakhe ding ua, theipina bawm akhu ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh atungah saham vun akoi ding ua, tuami tungah, puon apum tanga dumin akhu ding ua, azawnna zawlte avaw ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tanghousie dawkan tungah puondum apha ding ua, tuami tungah, kuongte, tawkeute, hengte leh asitnate akoi ding uhi; tualeh kitatlou in, tanghousie khu tuami tungah a um ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tuate tungah Puonsandup apha ding ua, saham vun in akhu khum ding ua, azawnna zawlte avaw ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh puondum khat ala ding ua, khuoilu meivah tunna leh khuna a a zah ding uh meivahte leh ataitete, avutluohnate leh Olive sathau buhte zousie akhu ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh tamte leh avanzah zousie khuna saham vun a tuom in tuakhu azawnna zawltungah akhang ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh sana maitam tungah Puondum apha ding ua, saham vunin akhu ding ua, azawlte aguonglut ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh mun siengthoua a nasepna a vanzah umlebelte zousie khu ala sieng ding ua, Puon dum in atun ding ua, saham vunin akhu ding uhi, tualeh azawnna ding zawl tungah akikhang chiet ta ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh maitam a pat in vutte aluohdoh ding ua, atungah puonsan au apha ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh atungah a nasepna vanzah uh umlebelte zousie, mei lahnate, sathuana siakhutkate, vut luohnate, tuikuongte leh maitam umlebelte zousie akoi ding ua, tualeh akhuna saham vun in akhu ding ua, azawnna zawl avaw ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron leh atapaten, mun siengthou leh mun siengthou umlebelte zousie akhu zou chieng ua, giehphuol akisuon ding chiengun, Kohath tapate azawng dingin ang kisa zel ding ua, hinanleh sil siengthou bangma akhoi sih ding uhi; Tuachilouin ashi kha ding uhi. Tamte khu kimutuona biehbuh a Kohath tapate nasep dingte ahi."},"16":{"text":"“Tualeh siempu Aaron tapa Eleazar nasep ding khu thaumei dette, gimnamtui halte leh nichin kitatlou a tanghou sillatte leh sathau nu dingte, biehbuh leh asunga um zousie, mun siengthou leh tuana asunga umlebelte zousie a etkol ding hi.”"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron ahoupi a, akung uah;"},"18":{"text":"“Kohath tate phung khu Levi namte lah a kipat satkhe mai sinlen;"},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh silsiengthou pente ava nai chieng ua, shi lou a ahin theina dingun, tambangin bawl un; Aaron leh atapate ava lut ding ua, michin anasep ding u’leh a mawpuohna uh ana guot pieh ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh sil siengthoute akikhu laiin a en dinga alut ding uh ahi sih, alut u’leh ashi ding uhi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah","title":"Gershon phungte nasep ding"},"22":{"text":"“Gershon tate aphung aphung u’leh ahainet ahainet in sim in."},"23":{"text":"Kum sawm thum apat kum sawmnga tandong kimutuona biehbuh sunga lut a nasem thei dingte zousie sim in."},"24":{"text":"Gershon tate mawpuoh ding khu nasep leh vanpuoh ahi."},"25":{"text":"Amauten biehbuh puonzahte leh kimutuona biehbuh leh akhunate, atung khuna saham vunte leh kimutuona biehbuh kotkhah puonzahte;"},"26":{"text":"Ahuongsung imna puonzahte, biehbuh kunga um maitam leh akimvel huongsung imna kotpi puonzahte leh khaute, tualeh anasepna vanzah zousiete apo ding ua, bawl ding poimaw zousie abawl ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Aaron leh atapate thuhil dungzuiin Gershon taten nna asem ding ua, vante zong apo ding uhi, tualeh avanpuoh ding zousie hil dingin mi na guotpieh ding uh ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tamte khu kimutuona biehbuh a Gershon tate nasep ding ahi. Amaute tunga thuneina khu Siempu Aaron tapa Ithamar khut nuoi ah a um ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Merari tapate aphung aphung leh ahainet ahainet un nasim ding ahi.","title":"Levi nam a Merari tate nasepding"},"30":{"text":"Kum sawm thum apat atunglam kum sawm nga a upa tan chieng, kimutuona biehbuh a nasem dinga lut thei zousie na sim ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh kimutuona biehbuh a anasep uh, a mawpuoh na ding uh tamte ahi, biehbuh singpeh te, azawlte, akhuomte leh akingahna khuohkuohte;"},"32":{"text":"Ahuong kimvel a khuomte, angahna khuohkuohte, akilnate, akhaute, vanzah zousie leh vanzah dang dang puoh ding; amin uh lou chietin apuoh ding uh na guot pieh ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Tamte Siempu Aaron tapa Ithamar khut nuoi a kimutuona biehbuha Merari tapate hahlesuonten abawl ding uh dungzui a asep ding uh ahi,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Aaron tualeh mipi kikhawm lamkaiten, Kohath tapate a phung aphung u’leh ahainet ahainet in asim ua,","title":"Levite kisimna"},"35":{"text":"Kum sawm thum apat atunglam kum sawmnga tan chieng, kimutuona biehbuh a nasem dinga lut thei zousie asim ua;"},"36":{"text":"Aphung leh ahainet dungzui ua asim doh teng uh tul ni leh za sagi leh sawmnga ahi uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tamte khu ahi, kimutuona biehbuh a nasem theiding Kohath hahlesuonte asimte uh, Mosi zanga Mangpa thupieh dungzui a Mosi leh Aaron in asimte uh ahi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Gershon tapate aphung aphung u’leh ahainet ahainet ua kisimte;"},"39":{"text":"Kum sawm thum apat atunglam kum sawm nga tan dong, kimutuona biehbuh a nasem dinga lut thei zousiete;"},"40":{"text":"Aphung aphung u’leh ahainet ahainet ua kisimte tul ni leh zaguh leh sawmthum ahi uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tamte khu Mangpa thupieh dungzui a, Mosi leh Aaron in asimte uh, kimutuona biehbuh a nasem thei ding Gershon tate hah lesuonte asimte uh ahi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh Merari tapate aphung aphung u’leh ahainet ahainet ua kisimte;"},"43":{"text":"Kum sawm thum apat atunglam kum sawm nga tan chieng, kimutuona biehbuh a nasem dinga lut thei zousiete;"},"44":{"text":"Aphung u’leh ahainet ua kisim teng tul thum leh zani ahi uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tamte khu Mangpa’n Mosi tungtawna athupieh dungzuia Mosi leh Aaron in Merari tapate hahle suonte asimte uh ahi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh Levimite aphung aphung u’leh ahainet ahainet ua, Mosi leh Aaron leh Israel lamkaiten asimte uh;"},"47":{"text":"Kum sawm thum apat atunglam kum sawmnga tanchieng, kimutuona biehbuha nasem dinga lut thei zousie;"},"48":{"text":"Akisim zousie tul giet leh zanga leh sawm giet ahi uhi."},"49":{"text":"Mangpa’n Mosi zanga athupieh dungzuiin michin anasep ding dungzui leh avan puoh ding dungzui a sim ahi ua, tuachimabangin Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin asim ta hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah;","title":"Mi buate giehphuol pulam ah"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate lah a pha zousie leh siluonga kisubua zousie giehphuol pulam a koidoh dingin thu pie in, a chi hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasal hi’n numei hitaleh giehphuol pulam ah na koi ding ahi, alah ua ka tenna agiehphuol uh a suhbua lou na dingun,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten tuabangin abawl ua, amaute giehphuol pulam ah akoidoh ua, Mangpa’n Mosi kunga agen bangin Israel taten abawl uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah;","title":"Sil bawl khielte sankiana","ref":"Siempu. 6.1-7"},"6":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah gen in, Pasal ahiei numei ahiei in, Mangpa tungah sil bawlkhiel in siemlou tang ta leh;"},"7":{"text":"Abawl khelna zieh ua thupha a tawi ding uh ahi: tualeh abawlkhel man uh kimtahin adin ding uhi. Tualeh Se nga suo sekhat abelap dinga, abawl khelna pa ape ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh bawlkhelman sang dingpa’n, sanggam kinaipi anei sih leh bawlkhel man khu Mangpa a dingin siempu kunga pieh ahi dinga; kilemna belamtal chilou zong ama a dingin kilemna akibawlpiehding a hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten sil siengthou lat ding siempu kunga ahing tawi pouma uh, alantu siempuin atang ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Michin asillat siengthoute ama a ahidinga, siempu kunga apieh pouma siempu a ahi ding,” chiin achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah;","title":"Zi leh pasal kal a kigin lelna thu"},"12":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah gen inlen, akung uah mi a zi vahthap a ginumloutah a agamtat a;"},"13":{"text":"Midangin a luppi a hinanleh, apasal in a theilou a, aguh a bawl ahi a, hinanleh amanu suhbua a um a, amanu tunga theipitu lah umlou a, angkawm ahi kipuong zong hilou koiman lah man lou a aum a;"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh apasal in ginlelna lungsim nei in azinu thangsiet na toh aginlel bangin na zawntat taleh, ahisihleh azi zawntat loupi a aginlel teitei leh;"},"15":{"text":"Tuabang thu ah apasal in azi siempu kungah ahing zawpi dinga, amanu sillat dingin barli bu ephah se sawmsuo sekhat ahing tawi ding a tua sillatte tung ah sathau leh gimnamtui a sung sih ding hi; a ziehpen gitlouna kithei dohna ding leh thangsietna sillat theizingna ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tualeh siempuin amanu ahing pui nai ding a, Mangpa masangah ading sah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin leibel in tui siengthou a hing tawi dinga, tualeh biehbuh tuol a leivui siempuin ala dinga tui lah ah akoi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin numei khu Mangpa masangah ading sah dinga, numei nu’n asam ahamkhe sah dinga, theizingna sillat leh thangsietna sillat khu amanu khut sungah akoi dinga, tualeh siempuin akhut ah hamselawna tuikha atawi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin amanu akichiemsah dinga, Numeinu kungah, Pasal koima na luppi lou a, na pasal chilou midang koima toh kisubua dinga na thangvah loua ahileh tami hamse tungsah tuikha apat siengthou tain;"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh na pasal chilou midang toh angkawm a na kisuhbua a, na pasal chilou koi ahiei in ahing luppi leh vang na siengthou sih ding hi; achi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempuin numei khu gausapna kihahsielna a neisah dinga, siempuin numeinu kungah Mangpa’n na pheipi hing muot sah henlen, nagilpi hing puohsah henlen, Mangpa’n na mite lahah hamse thuoh in hing bawl ta hen."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh tam gausapna tangtungsah tui khu na gilpi puohsah dingin leh na pheipi muotsah dingin, na gil sungah alut ding hi achi ding hi, tualeh numei nu’n Amen, amen achi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tualeh siempuin tam hamsietna thute zousie laibu sungah agiel dinga, tuikha in anuoimang ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin numeinu’n hamsietna tangtungsah tuikha khu adawn sah dinga, hamsietna tangtungsah tuikha khu asungah alut dinga ahing kha ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin ginlelna ann sillat khu, numeinu khut apat ala dinga, tangbuong sillat khu Mangpa masangah avei dinga, maitam tungah alan ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin ann sillat theizingna khu sip dim khat aham dinga, maitam tungah ahal ding hi, tuazouchiengin tua tui khu numeinu adawn sah ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh numeinu’n tui adawn sah zou chiengin, hichi ahing hiding hi, suhbua aum ahia, apasal tunga sil abawlkhel leh hamsietna tang tungsah tui agil sung ah alut dinga, ahing kha dinga, tualeh agilpi ahing puoh dinga, apheipi ahing muot dinga, numeinu khu amite lah a hamsethuoh ahing hita ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh numeinu khu suhbuo ahilou a, asienthou leh azalen dinga, ta leh nau anei ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tam dan khu numei thapvah, apasal hilou midang ang a akisuh bua chienga ginmawna dan ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ahisihleh pasal in azi ginmawna lungsim ahing nei chienga, numei Mangpa masanga adin sah hunchiengin siempuin tam dan zousie a tungah abawl ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n pasal pen gitlouna akipat asieng dinga, numei in agitlouna akipuoh ding hi,” chiin achi hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah;","title":"Nazir hina dinga thuchiemte"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah thu gen inlen, akung uah, Pasal ahiei, numei ahiei in, Mangpa dinga kituom koi dinga, Nazir mi hina dinga kichiemna anei lai un;"},"3":{"text":"Zu leh zu chia apat akituom koi ding ahi, grep zu leh grep zu chia zong adawn ding ahisih, greptui zong adawn sih dinga, grep ga vuoi leh agaw zong anesih ding hi.","ref":"Luk. 1.15"},"4":{"text":"Akituomkoi sungsie grep guia kipata kibawl, atanga kipat ahaw tan dongin bangma ane sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Kituomkoi dinga akichiem sungsie alutang leh sam heuna tem akithu khah louding ahi, Mangpa adinga akituomkoi hun achin masangsie ama pen asiengthou dinga, asam akhoi ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"“Mangpa adinga akituomkoi sungteng, shiluong kunga zong apei khah vawt lou ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Apa ahiei, anu ahiei, asanggampa ahiei asanggamnu ahiei shi ziehin zong akisu bua ding ahi sih hi; Pasian a dinga akikoi siengthouna alutunga um ahi ziehin."},"8":{"text":"Akituomkoi sungsie Mangpa adinga siengthou ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Ama kunga mi thakhat a ashi a akikoisiengthouna lutang asuh bua tahleh, akisiensuo ni ani sagi niin alu aheu ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh ni giet niin, kimutuona biehbuh kotkha a, siempu kungah vakhu kopkhat ahiei, vapal nou khat ahiei ahing tawi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Siempuin, khat khelna thoina dingin alan dinga adangkhat pen halmang sillat in, mi shi zieha abawlkhelna ziehin kilemna abawl pieh dinga, tualeh tuani main alu asu siengthou ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh akituom koina nite Mangpa masanga akoi siengthoukia na dingin belamnou atal kum khat a upa khat tatkhelna kithoina dingin ahing tawi ding hi; hinanleh akituom koina buasah ahitah ziehin amasanga nite bangmalou asuohta hi."},"13":{"text":"“Tualeh Tamkhu Nazir miin akituomkoina nite abuchin chienga abawl ding dan ahi, ama pen kimutuona biehbuh ah kotkhabul ah akipui dinga,","ref":"Nasep. 21.23,24"},"14":{"text":"Belamnou tal kum khat a upa gensiet bei khat halmang sillat dingin, belamnou anu kum khat a upa, gensietbei khat khelna sillat dingin, belam tal gensiet bei khat, lemna sillat dingin alan ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh tanghou tolsawlou leh sathau toh kihal tangbuonga kibawl tanghou beu leh sathau toh kimeh tolsawlou tanghou pheng law khat toh, a ann sillat u’leh adawn sillat uh alan ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin tuate khu Mangpa masangah ahing tawi dinga, akhelna sillat leh ahalmang sillat alan ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh belamtal khu law sunga um tolsawlou tanghou toh Mangpa kunga lemna sillat dingin alan dinga: siempuin a ann sillat leh dawn sillat zong alan ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Nazir mipan kimutuona biehbuh kotphung ah, akituomkoina lu aheu dinga, akituomkoina lu a sam ala dinga, lemna sillat kithoina nei a um mei khuh a avah ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin belamtal lieng kihuon min leh law sunga um tolsawlou tanghou beu khat leh tanghou pheng khat ala dinga, akituomkoina sam aheu zou chiengin Nazir mipa khut ah atawi sah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin Mangpa masangah vei sillat ding in avei ding hi; tam pen siempu satan sil siengthou ahi ding hi, a awm vei sillat leh amal vei sillat toh. Tuazou chiengin Nazir mipa’n uoin adawn thei ta ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Tamte Mangpa masanga Nazir mi kichiemna leh a sillat dan ahi, ama ut thua alat simlou in, akituomkoina kichiemna dan dungzuiin abawl ding ahi,” chiin achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah,","title":"Siempu guol zawlna phuiteng"},"23":{"text":"“Aaron leh atapate kungah gen inlen tambangin Israel tate na guolzawl ding uh ahi, akung uah chiin;"},"24":{"text":"“Mangpa’n nang hing guolzawl henlen, hing kemta henlen,"},"25":{"text":"Mangpa’n a mel na tungah tangsah henlen, hing hepi zel ta hen."},"26":{"text":"Mangpa nanglam hing nga henlen, lungmuonna hing peta hen, chiin achi hi."},"27":{"text":"“Tuachi’n amauten Israel tate tungah, Ka min atuongsah ding ua, tuachi’n ken amaute ka guol zawl ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in biehbuh adinsah zou diema, sathau anu zou a, asuhsiengthou zou a, avanzah zousie leh amaitam leh atuium abelsuon zousie sathau anu a, asuhsiengthou niin tam bang ahing hi a;","title":"Maitam kipahpina a silpiehte"},"2":{"text":"Israel lamkaite, a innkuon ua upa pente aphung chiet ua kisimte tunga anam lamkaite un sillat alan uhi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa masanga akithoina sillat uh sakolleng buhnei guh leh bawngtal sawmle ni ahing tawi ua, sakolleng khat lamkai ni zela dingin leh lamkai khat ading bawngtal khat chiet, biehbuh mai ah ahing tawi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah,"},"5":{"text":"“Kimutuona biehbuh a nasepna dingin tamte la inlen; Levite kungah anasepna dungzuiin na pe ding hi” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in sakolleng buhneite leh bawngtalte ala a, Levite apeta hi."},"7":{"text":"Sakolleng ni leh bawngtal li Gershon tapate kungah anasep dan dungzui un apie hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh sakolleng li leh bawngtal giet, Merari tapate kungah anasep dan dungzui un, Siempu Aaron tapa Ithamar khutah apeta hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Kohath tapate kungah bangma apesih hi, aziehpen munsiengthou nasep amaute mawpuohna ahia, vanzah dingte aliengkou ua apuoh zel uh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n lamkaite’n sathau kinu niin maitam kisiensuona dingin sillatte alan ua, asillatte uh maitam masangah alan uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah “Lamkai chinin, maitam siensuona dinga a sillatte uh nichin akizomzel in alan ding uhi.”"},"12":{"text":"Anikhat nia sillat lan dinga hing tawi khu Juda phunga Amminadab tapa Nahshon ahi."},"13":{"text":"Asillat khu dangkasia kuong khat, agih dan shekel za leh sawm thum, mun siengthou a shekel tedan a, shekel sawm sagi toh kikim agih dangkasia heng kuong khat, ann sillat dingin sathau toh kihal tangbuong nel ngingei khum heng kuong dim tuoh ahi;"},"14":{"text":"Gimnamtui shekel sawm toh kikim a gih, sana tawkeu dim khat:"},"15":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding bawngtal nou khat, belamtal khat, kum khat a upa belam nou khat;"},"16":{"text":"Khelna sillat dingin kelnou khat;"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh lemna kithoina sillat dingin bawngtal ni, belamtal nga, keltal nga, kum khat a upa belamnou nga: tamte Amminadab tapa Nahshon sillatte ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ani ni niin Issakar phung lamkai Zuar tapa Nathaneel in alan hi."},"19":{"text":"Aman a sillat dingin mun siengthou shekel tena bangin, shekal za leh sawmthuma gih, dangka sia kuong khat leh shekel sawm sagi agih, dangka sia hengkuong khat alan a, ann sillat dingin sathau toh kihal tangbuong nel ngingei heng kuongte gel dim tuoh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Shekel sawm toh kikim a gih, gimnamtui sana tawkeu dim khat;"},"21":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding bawngtalnou khat, belamtal khat kum khat a upa belamnou khat;"},"22":{"text":"Khelna sillat dingin kelnou khat;"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillat dingin bawngtal ni, belam tal nga, keltal nga, kum khat a upa belamnou nga; tamte Zuar tapa Nathaneel sillatte ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ani thum ni’n Zebulun tate lamkai Helon tapa Eliab in alan hi."},"25":{"text":"A sillatte khu mun siengthoua shekel tena bangin, shekel za leh sawmthum a gih, dangka sia kuong khat leh shekel sawmsagi a gih dangka sia hengkuong khat alan a, ann sillat dingin sathautoh kihal, tangbuong nel ngingei hengkuongte gel dim tuoh ahi."},"26":{"text":"Shekel sawm toh kikim a gih, gim namtui sana tawkeu dim khat;"},"27":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding bawngtal nou khat, kum khat a upa belamnou khat;"},"28":{"text":"Khelna sillat dingin kelnou khat;"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillat dingin, bawngtal ni, belam tal nga, keltal nga, kum khat a upa belamnou nga, tamte Helon tapa Eliab sillatte ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ni li niin Reuben tate lamkai Shedeur tapa Elizur in alan hi."},"31":{"text":"A sillat khu mun siengthou a shekel tena bangin, shekel zale-sawmthum a gih, dangka sia kuong khat, shekel sawm sagi agih dangkasia hengkuong khat alan a, ann sillat dingin, sathau toh kihal tangbuong nel ngi ngei hengkuongte gel dim tuoh ahi."},"32":{"text":"Shekel sawm toh kikim a gih, gimnamtui sana tawkeu dim khat;"},"33":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding bawngtal nou khat, belamtal khat kum khat a upa belamnou khat;"},"34":{"text":"Khelna sillat dingin kelnou khat;"},"35":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillat dingin bawngtal ni, belamtal nga, keltal nga, kum khat a upa belamnou nga, tamte Shedeur tapa Elizur sillatte ahi."},"36":{"text":"Ni nga niin Simeon tate lamkai Zurishaddai tapa Shelumiel in alan hi."},"37":{"text":"A sillat khu mun siengthou a shekel tena bangin, shekel za leh sawmthum a gih dangka sia kuong khat, shekel sawmsagi a gih dangka sia hengkuong khat alan a, ann sillat dingin, sathau toh kihal tangbuong nel ngi ngei hengkuongte gel dim tuoh ahi."},"38":{"text":"Shekel sawm toh kikim a gih gimnamtui sana tawkeu dim khat,"},"39":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding bawngtal nou khat, belamtal khat, kum khat a upa belamnou khat;"},"40":{"text":"Khelna sillat dingin kelnou khat;"},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Lemna sillat dingin bawngtal ni, belamtal nga; keltal nga, kumkhat a upa belamnou nga, tamte Zurishaddai tapa Shelumiel sillat ahi."},"42":{"text":"Ni guh niin Gad tate lamkai Deuel tapa Eliasaph in alan hi."},"43":{"text":"A sillat khu mun siengthou a shekel tena bangin shekel za leh sawmthum a gih dangka sia kuong khat shekel sawm sagi a gih dangka sia hengkuong khat alan a; ann sillat dingin sathau toh kihal tangbuong nel ngi ngei hengkuongte gel dim tuoh ahi."},"44":{"text":"Shekel sawm toh kikim a gih gimnamtui sana tawkeu dim khat;"},"45":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding bawngtal nou khat, belamtal khat kum khat a upa belamnou khat;"},"46":{"text":"Khelna sillat dingin kelnou khat;"},"47":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillat dingin bawngtal ni, belamtal nga, keltal nga, kum khat a upa belamnou nga, tamte Deuel tapa Eliasaph sillatte ahi."},"48":{"text":"Ni sagi niin Ephraim tate lamkai Ammihud tapa Elishama in alan hi."},"49":{"text":"A sillat khu mun siengthoua shekel tena bangin shekel za leh-sawm thum a gih dangkasia kuong khat, shekel sawm sagi a gih dangka sia hengkuong khat alan a; ann sillat dingin sathau toh kihal tangbuong nel ngi ngei hengkuongtegel dim tuoh ahi."},"50":{"text":"Shekel sawm toh kikim a gih gimnamtui sana tawkeu dim khat;"},"51":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding bawngtalnou khat, belamtal khat; kum khat a upa belamnou khat;"},"52":{"text":"Khelna sillat dingin kel nou khat;"},"53":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillat dingin bawngtal ni, belamtal nga, keltal nga, kum khat a upa belamnou nga, tamte Ammihud tapa Elishama sillat ahi."},"54":{"text":"Ani giet niin Manasseh tate lamkai Pedahzur tapa Gamaliel in alan hi."},"55":{"text":"A sillat khu mun siengthoua shekel tena bangin shekel za leh sawmthum a gih, dangka sia kuong khat leh shekel sawm sagi a gih dangka-sia hengkuong khat, alan a; ann sillat dingin sathau toh kihal tangbuong nel ngi ngei hengkuongte gel dim tuoh ahi."},"56":{"text":"Shekel sawm toh kikim a gih gimnamtui sana tawkeu dimkhat;"},"57":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding bawngtal nou khat, belamtal khat, kum khat a upa belamnou khat;"},"58":{"text":"Khelna sillat dingin kelnou khat."},"59":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillat dingin bawngtal ni, belamtal nga, keltal nga, kum khat a upa belamnou nga: tamte Pedahzur tapa Gamaliel sillatte ahi."},"60":{"text":"Ni kuo niin, Benjaminte lamkai Gideon tapa Abidan in alan hi."},"61":{"text":"A sillat khu mun siengthou a, shekel tena bang in shekel za leh sawmthum a gih, dangka sia kuong khat leh shekel sawm sagi a gih dangka sia heng kuong khat alan a; ann sillat dingin sathau toh kihal, tangbuong nel ngi ngei hengkuong tegel dim tuoh ahi."},"62":{"text":"Shekel sawm toh kikim a gih gimnamtui sana tawkeu dim khat."},"63":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding bawngtal nou khat, belam tal khat, kum khat a upa belam nou khat;"},"64":{"text":"Khelna sillat dingin kelnou khat;"},"65":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillat dingin bawngtal ni, belam tal nga, keltal nga, kum khat a upa belamnou nga; tamte Gideon tapa Abidan sillatte ahi."},"66":{"text":"Ani sawmni in Dan tate lamkai Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer in alan hi."},"67":{"text":"A sillat khu mun siengthou a shekel tena bangin shekel za leh sawmthum a gih, dangka sia kuong khat leh shekel sawm sagi a gih dangka sia heng kuong khat alan a; tangbuong sillat dingin, sathau toh kihal tangbuong nel ngi ngei hengkuongte gel dim tuoh ahi."},"68":{"text":"Shekel sawm toh kikim agih gimnamtui sana tawkeu dimkhat;"},"69":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding bawngtal nou khat, belamtal khat, kum khat a upa belamnou khat;"},"70":{"text":"Khelna sillat dingin kelnou khat;"},"71":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillat dingin bawngtal ni, belamtal nga, Keltal nga, kum khat a upa belamnou nga; tamte Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer sillatte ahi."},"72":{"text":"Ni sawm leh khat niin Asher tate lamkai Okran tapa Pagiel in alan hi."},"73":{"text":"A sillat khu mun siengthoua shekel tena bangin shekel za leh sawmthum a gih dangka sia kuong khat leh shekel sawm sagi a gih dangka sia hengkuong khat alan a, ann sillat dingin sathau toh kihal, tangbuong nel ngi ngei hengkuong tegel dim tuoh ahi."},"74":{"text":"Shekel sawm toh kikim a gih gim namtui sana tawkeu dim khat."},"75":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding bawngtal nou khat, belamtal khat, kum khat a upa belamnou khat."},"76":{"text":"Khelna sillat dingin kelnou khat."},"77":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillat dingin bawngtal ni, belamtal nga, keltal nga, kum khat a upa belamnou nga; tamte Okran tapa Pagiel sillatte ahi."},"78":{"text":"Nisawm leh nini niin Naphtali tate lamkai Enan tapa Ahira in alan hi."},"79":{"text":"A sillat khu mun siengthou a shekel tena bangin shekel za leh sawmthum a gih dangka sia kuong khat leh shekel sawm sagi a gih dangka sia hengkuong khat alan a; ann sillat dingin, sathau toh kihal, tangbuong nel ngi ngei hengkuong tegel dim tuoh ahi."},"80":{"text":"Shekel sawm toh kikim a gih gimnamtui, sana tawkeu dim khat."},"81":{"text":"Halmang sillat dingin, bawngtal nou khat, belam tal khat, kum khat a upa belam nou khat;"},"82":{"text":"Khelna sillat dingin kelnou khat;"},"83":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillat dingin bawngtal ni, belamtal nga, keltal nga, kum khat a upa belamnou nga: tamte Enan tapa Ahira sillatte ahi."},"84":{"text":"Maitam sathau anu ni ua, Israel lamkaite sillatte tamte ahi: Dangka sia kuong sawm leh ni, dangka sia hengkuong sawm leh ni, sana tawkeu sawm leh ni ahi."},"85":{"text":"Dangka sia kuong khat shekel za leh sawmthum a gih; chiet, hengkuong shekel sawm sagi a gih chiet; dang ka sia kuong zousie aun in, mun siengthou shekel simdan bangin shekel tul ni leh zali a gih ahi."},"86":{"text":"Sana tawkeu sawm leh ni, gimnamtuia dim, mun siengthou shekel tena dan bangin shekel sawma gih chiet ahia; tawkeu a sana zousie aun in shekel za leh sawmni ahi."},"87":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding bawngtal zousie a un in sawm leh ni ahia, belamtal sawm leh ni, belamnou kum khat a upa sawm leh ni, tualeh khelna sillat ding kelnou sawm leh ni ahi."},"88":{"text":"Tualeh lemna kithoina sillat ding bawngtal sawmni leh li, belamtal sawm guh, keltal sawmguh, tualeh belamnou kum khat a upa sawmguh, Tamte maitam sathau kinu zoua akisiensuona sillatte ahi."},"89":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi, Pasian be dinga kimutuona biehbuh sunga alut leh Cherubimte gel kikaal a, hepina thuhun bawm tunga um hepina toupha akipat in ama hing houpi aw khat aza a, tuachi’n aman zong ahoupi ta hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah","title":"Thaumei detding dan","ref":"Pawt. 25.31-40; 37.17-24"},"2":{"text":"“Aaron kungah thu gen inlen, akungah meivahte nadet chiengin, meivah sagiten thau mei tunna mailam asalvah ding uh ahi,” chiin achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron in khumbangin abawl a; Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin thaumei koina mailam atanvah thei na dingin thaumeite ade kuong hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh tam thaumei tunna kibawl dan khu, sana a kikheng ahia, atunna kungpi apat apapete tan a kikheng ahi: Mangpa’n alim Mosi amusah bangbang in thaumei tunna abawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah,","title":"Levite siensuona"},"6":{"text":"“Israel tate lah a kipat in Levite atuomin khen inlen susiengthouin."},"7":{"text":"Amaute suhsiengthouna dingin tambangin bawl in; atung uah suhsiengna tui the inlen, asa tung zousie ua amul uh heusiengsah inlen; apuonte uh sawp sah inlen, kisusiengsah in."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n bawngtalnou khat leh ann sillat tangbuong nel sathau toh kihal lasah inlen, tualeh khelna sillat dingin bawngtalnou dang khat zong na lah ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh kimutuona biehbuh maiah nang zawpi dinga; Israel tate zousie na kikhawm sah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Levite Mangpa masangah na hing zawpi ding a; Israel taten Levite tungah akhut uh angam ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron in Levite khu Mangpa nna asep thei na dingun, Israel tate a dingin vei sillat in Mangpa masangah a lan ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Leviten akhut uh bawngtal lutungah angam ding ua, Levite dinga kilemna bawlna dingin; bawngtal khat khelna sillat dingin, tualeh adang khat pen halmang sillat dingin Mangpa kungah alanding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Levite khu Aaron leh atapate masangah na umsah dinga, Mangpa kungah amaute vei sillat in na lan ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tuachibangin Levite khu Israel tate lah a pat in na khentuom ding a; tuachi’n Levite khu kei a ahi ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuazouchiengin Levite khu kimutuona biehbuh a nasep sem dingin alut ding ua, tualeh nangman amaute na susieng dinga, vei sillat in amaute na lan ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel tate lah a kipat keima dinga hing kipe siengthou ahita uhi, Israel tate lah a tachil naubu hong masa pen zousie taangin keima dingin amaute ka kilah ahi ta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Israel tate lah a tachil pieng masa zousie mihing hiin ganta hitaleh keima a ahi uhi; Izipt gam a tachil piengmasa zousie ka thalup lai a, amaute Kei a dinga ka suhsiengthou ahita uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 13.2"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate lah a kipat in tachil pieng masa zousie tangin Levite khu kala ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Keima’n Levite khu, Israel tate lah apat in, Aaron leh atapate kunga, kimutuona biehbuh a Israel taten a seppieh ding leh Israel tate munsiengthoua ahing pei chieng ua Israel tate lah a natna hii alen louna dinga lemna kithoina bawl pieh dingin ka peta hi.”"},"20":{"text":"Tuabangin Mosi leh Aaron tualeh Israel mipi kikhawmte zousiein, Mangpa’n Mosi kunga Levite tungtanga thu apieh zousie dungzuiin Levite tungah abawl ta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levite akisusiengthou ua, apuonte uh a sawp uhi; tualeh Aaron in amaute khu sillat bang in Mangpa masangah alan a; Aaron in amaute suhsiengna dingin kilemna abawl pieh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuazouin Levite khu kimutuona biehbuh ah Mangpa nasep semdingin Aaron leh atapate masangah alut ta uhi. Mangpa’n Mosi kunga Levite tungtanga thu apieh dungzuiin amauten atung uah abawl uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akung ah;","title":"Levite nasepding hun chiem"},"24":{"text":"“Levite tanvou khu tambang ahi; kum sawmni leh nga apat atunglam tengin kimutuona biehbuh nasep sem dingin alut ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh kum sawmnga a upaten nasepna akhawlsan ding ua, nna asem nawnsih ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh kimutuona biehbuh kep thu ah a unaute uh apanpi ding ua, nasep pen asem nawn sih ding uhi. Tuabangin Levite nasep ding na guot pieh ding ahi” achi hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Izipt gam apat ahing peidoh nua uh akum nina aha khatna ah, Sinai gam dai ah Mosi ahoupi a, akungah,","title":"Peikan pawi kimandan","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-13"},"2":{"text":"“Israel taten peikan pawi ahunbi guot ah neizel uheh."},"3":{"text":"Tami ha ni sawmleh li ni nitahlam ahunbi guot ah na zang ding ua, abawl ding dan zousie dungzui leh atat dan ding kiguot dungzuiin tam pawi na mang ding uhi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Israel tate Peikan pawi aman ding uh ahi chi’n ahil ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh amauten hakhatna ni sawm leh li ni, nitah lamin Sinai gamdai ah peikan pawi abawl uhi. Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin Israel taten abawl uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh mi koite ahiei mishi luong zieha kibuasah a um ua, tua ni in peikan pawi abawl thei tasih ua, tualeh amaute Mosi leh Aaron masangah ahing pei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua miten akungah “Tam bangin agen uhi, mishi luong zieh in kaki buasah khata uhi. Tuazieh in Israel tate lah a ahunbi guota Mangpa kunga sillat lan theilou dinga, bang dinga kham ka hi uoi?” achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mosi in akung uah, “Hing na ngahta di un, na tung thu uah Mangpa’n bang thupieh ang pie ei mah hing ngaikhe ta di vang” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah,"},"10":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah thu gen inlen, nalah u’leh nahah nasuonte lah ua mi koipou mishi luong zieha ahing sienthou taahsih u’leh zong ahisihleh khuolgamlapi ah zinmang leh zong, Mangpa adingin peikan pawi amang thei veve ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ha nina ni sawm leh li ni, nitah lam in tam pawi a mang ding ua, tolsawlou tanghou toh anntekha aneh ding uh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Zingmawng dongin avaal bangma a nuasie sih ding ua, agu khat zong na sutan sih ding uhi; Peikan pawi bawl ding dan zousie dungzuiin, na mangding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.46; Jn. 19.36"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh siengthou napi a, khuol zin zong hilou a peikan pawi aman nuom sihleh tua mipa khu amite lah a pat satkhieh ahi ding hi, Mangpa adinga sillat ahunbi guota ahing tawilou ziehin, tua mipan ama khelna maw akipuoh ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh gamdang mi na lah ua teng a uma, Mangpa dinga Peikan pawi aman ding leh Peikan pawi man dan dinga thu guot dungzui leh tawndan dungzuiin abawlding hi: gamdang mileh gam sunga pieng mi a dingin dan kibang khat na nei ding ahi,” chiin achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh lam zou niin, biehbuh khu meilum in atuom a, nitah lamin biehbuh tungah meikuong bang bang khat zingmawng dongin a um hi.","title":"Puitu meipi ding"},"16":{"text":"Tuachibangin a um den a, sun in meilumin atuom a, zanin meikuongin akilang hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh akipat a meilum lahtou ahi chiengin Israel tate aki pandoh zel uhi. Tualeh meilum akhawlna mun pouma ah Israel taten giehphuol asat ua apuon inn uh azah uhi."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa’n thu apieh chiengin Israel tate apeidoh zel ua, Mangpa thupiehin giehphuol asat zel uhi, biehbuh tunga meilum a um laisie apuon innte uah a um uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh tunga meilum nitampi a um leh Israel taten Mangpa thupieh amang ua, apeidoh sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Khatveivei meilum khu puonbuh tungah tomnou khat teng a um zela, tuachi’n Mangpa thupieh bangin akhawl ua, Mangpa thupieh bangin a peidoh zel uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahi a, khatvei vei meilum nitah lam apat zingmawng dong a um a, tualeh meilum tung lam a akikhaisang tou chiengin apei zel uhi; sun hiin zan hileh meilum khu tunglam a akikhai sang tou hun hunin apei zel uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ahisihleh meilum khu biehbuh tunga ni ni ahiei, ha khat ahiei, kum khat ahiei a uma, tuabanga a um den leh Israel tate a puon innte uah a um ua apeidoh sih uhi; hinanleh akikhaisang chiengin a pei zel uhi."},"23":{"text":"Mangpa thupiehin apuon inn uah a um ua, Mangpa thupieh ma bangin apei zel uhi, Mosi zanga Mangpa thupieh bangin amauten Mangpa thu amang uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah,","title":"Dangka sia a kibawl pengkul"},"2":{"text":"“Dangkasia pengkul ni bawl inlen, sehta a khenthaw in bawl in, mipite hatkhawmna ding leh giehphuol kisuon dohna dinga na zah ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tuate gel a mut khawm chiengun mipite zousie na kungah kimutuona biehbuh kot phungah ahing kikhop ding uh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh pengkul khat maimai amut u’leh, Israel phung lamkaite zousie na kungah ahing kikhawm ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh kigalginna pengkul na mut chiengun giehphuol suolam panga umte apawt khe ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh kigalginna pengkul ni veina na mut chiengun, simlam panga umte a potkhe ding uhi; apawtdoh ding chiengun galzauna patau pengkul mut bangin amut ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh mipite kikhop khawm na dingin pengkul na mut ding ua, hinanleh Patau pengkul mut banga na mut lou ding uh ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tueleh Aaron tapate siemputen pengkulte amut ding ua, tuate nou a dingin na khang tungtawn ua nahah nasuonte uh donga dan thupieh ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Na gamsung ua, nou hing nuoisie melmate dou dinga na kuon chiengun, Patau Pengkul na mut ding ua, tuachi’n Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah theidoh in na um ding ua, na melmate ua pat hundamin na um ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh nuom nasah nite u’leh ahun chiem nei a na pawi bawl chiengun, na ha tha chiengun tualeh na halmang sillatte u’leh na lemna kithoina sillatte uah pengkul na mut ding uh ahi: tuachi’n na Pasian uh masangah nou adingin thei ngitngetna ahi ding: Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh kum nina, ha nina, ni sawmni niin hichi ahing hia, thiepina biehbuh apat meilum khu akikhaisang touta hi.","title":"Sinai apat Israelte kipandoh"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate Sinai gamdai akipat in apeidoh ta ua, meilum khu Paran gamdai ah akhawlta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi zanga Mangpa thupieh bangin apei masa phot uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amasapenin Juda pawlte aphung chiemtena uh tawi in apawl pawl in apawt ua, alamkaipa uh Amminadab tapa Nahshon ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Issakar tate phung lamkaipa khu Zuar tapa Nathana-el ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Zebulun tate phung lamkaipa khu Helon tapa Eliab ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh biehbuh khu aphel ua, Gershon tapate leh Merari tapate biehbuh puo a pangte khu akipandoh uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Reuben pawlte aphung chiemtena uh tawiin apawl pawl in apawt ua, alamkaipa uh Shedeur tapa Elizur ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Simeon tate phung lamkaipa khu Zurishaddai tapa Shelumiel ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Gad tate phung lamkaipa khu Deuel tapa Eliasaph ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Kohath miten munsiengthou vante puoin akipan doh ua, tualeh adangten amauh hing tun tah in biehbuh atung ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Ephraim pawlte aphung chiemtena uh tawiin apawl pawl in apawt ua, alam kaipa ukhu Ammihud tapa Elishama ahi."},"23":{"text":"Manasseh tate phung lamkaipa khu Pedahzur tapa Gamaliel ahi.","title":"Israel mipite apeidoh uh"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Benjamin tate phung lamkaipa khu Gideon tapa Abidan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tuazouin Dan tate giehphuol akipat aphung chiemtena uh tawi in apawl pawl in ahing pawt ua, amaute khu apawl nukhia pente ahi ta uhi, alamkaipa ukhu Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Asher tate phung lamkaipa khu Okran tapa Pagiel ahi."},"27":{"text":"Naphtali tate phung lamkaipa khu Enan tapa Ahira ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tambangin ahi Israel tate amaute phung chiemtena tawidan dungzui a apawtdoh lai ua apeidan uh."},"29":{"text":"Tuin Mosi in asungpa Midian mi Reuel tapa Hobab kungah “Mangpa’n ka hing peding achina muna pei ding ka hi ua, ka kung uah hing pei inlen, na tungah hoitahin ka hing bawl ding ua, Mangpa’n Israelte tungtang hoitah a agen tah zieh in,” achi hi.","title":"A sungpa kunga Mosi ngetna"},"30":{"text":"“Tualeh aman hing pei da konvang, hinanleh ka gam lam leh ka sanggamte kungah ka peizaw ding hi,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in akungah, “Hing peisan sin, ka hing ngen ahi, gamdai ah giehphuol satna mun ding na thei zaw a, kou a dingin mit na hing hi ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi dinga, ka kung ua nang peileh hichi ahiding, Mangpa’n ka tung ua silhoi abawl pouma, kou zong na tungah ka bawl ding uhi,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa muol a kipat ni thum lamah apeita uhi: Ama ua dinga kingahna mun lemtang sui a ni thum lam a apei lai un, Mangpa thuhun bawm khu amasang uah a pei zel hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh giehphuol a kipat apawtdoh chiengun Mangpa meilum khu sun chiengin atung uah a um zel hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Thuhun bawm akipatdoh pouma chiengin, Mosi’n “Mangpa aw hing thoudoh inlen, na melmate kithezah sah inlen, tualeh Nang hing mudate na masangah taizahta uhen” a chi hi.","ref":"Late. 68.1"},"36":{"text":"Tualeh aki ngah pouma chiengin aman “Aw Mangpa, Israel mi sangtampite kung ah hing kile kia in” achi zel hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh mipite ahing phunta ua, tuabanga aphunnate un Mangpa akipah sah sih a, tua khu Mangpa’n azata a, tuachi’n alung thahna ahing kuongdohta a, giehphuol tawplam ninga umte akatum ta uhi.","title":"Taberah a mipite phunna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite Mosi kungah akikou ua tualeh Mosi’n Mangpa kungah thu angen a, meikuong ahing mitta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman tua mun min khu Taberah achi ta hi, Mangpa mei alah ua akuon ziehin."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh alah ua namdang toh kitengpolten sa lunggulna ahing nei ta ua, Israel tate zong akap kiata ua, “Koi ahiei ineh ding sa hing pe ding?"},"5":{"text":"Ut uta Izipt gam a ngasa inehte ithei zinga, tangmaite, dawnkhawte, louthul pumte, louthul sielnehte louthul kaangte zong man bei in ine uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin vang ihinna uh agaw gawpta a, imitmu uah manna chilou kinepna ding bangma aum non sih hi,” achi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Manna pen Koriander tang bang ahia, amel lat dan in tuikepsuong bang ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 16.31"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n miten atomkhawm ua, gawt guoina ah agawt ua, sum sungah asu guoi ua, bel sungah a huon ua, tanghouphengin abawl uhi, ineh leh sathau a kikang tanghou bang ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 16.13-15"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh zan lai a giehphuol a daitui akieh chiengin manna toh ahing kekhawm zel hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite a innkuon kuon un apuon inn kotzung chiet ua akaa uh Mosi in azata a, tualeh Mangpa lungthahna khu nasatahin ahing kuongkhe ta a, Mosi zong alungkim tasih hi.","title":"Mosi lungkimlouna"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Mangpa kungah “Bang dinga na suohpa nang hichi bawl genthei ahiei mah? Bangdinga na mitmu a deisahna tanglou a, tam mipite puohgih ka tunga na ngah ahiei?"},"12":{"text":"Tam mipite zousie ka gil sunga nau vop banga ka vop ahiei mah? Apu leh pate kunga pieh dinga na chiem gam a puilut dingin, naudon mi’n nau nawitep lai apom bangin na angsungah pomin nang chi dinga ka hinkhiet nasa amah?"},"13":{"text":"Heisung sa ka lah a, mipi hiza zouzai ka pieh ding ahiei mah? Amauten lah ka kungah kapkawm in ka neh ding uh sa hing pie’n chiin a ngen uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tam mipi zousiete keima tangin ka paw zou sih hi, Kei a dingin agih taluo hi."},"15":{"text":"Hichibanga nang bawl ding ahileh hepitah in hing that vanglah mai inlen, na mitmu a deisahna ka tan leh tambanga ka gentheina hing musah nawn da mai in,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Israel upate leh mipite upa, tualeh atung ua lamkai hi a na theite mi sawmsagi ka kungah hing hankhawm inlen, kimutuona biehbuh ah hing zawpi inlen nangma toh hing dingkhawm ta un.","title":"Upa sawmsagi guotna"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka hing kumsuh dinga, nang ka hing houpi ding hi: na tunga um hagau khu kala dinga amauh tungah ka koi ding hi; nangma tanga na puohlou na dingin, mipite puohgih khu nang toh apokhawm ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh mipite kungah hichi’n gen in, zing chienga dingin kisusiengthou unlen, sa neding na hita uhi, Mangpa zahin, “Koi ahiei sa hing pe ding? Izipt gam a nuom isahsah utoh chia na kaa tahziehun, Mangpa’n sa ahing pe ding a na ne ding uhi.”"},"19":{"text":"Nikhat ahiei, ni ni sungbep ahiei, ni nga sung bep ahiei, ni sawm sungbep ahisih leh ni sawmni sung bep na ne sih ding ua;"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh hakhat sung ving veng, na nahkohom ua, ahing pawtdoh a, nou a dinga luohsuoh huoi ahing himasang sie na ne ding uhi; Na lah ua um Mangpa khu na huot ua, “Bang dinga Izipt gam a kipat hing pawtdoh ita diei, chia amasanga na kaa zieh un; na chi ding hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in, “Alah ua ka umna mipite kenga peithei tul zaguh tah ahi ua; tualeh nangman, ha khat sung pumpi aneh dingun sa pevang na chi hi."},"22":{"text":"Belam nou leh ganhonte thapieh nanlei zong akham ding uh amah? Ahisihleh tuipi sunga nga um zousie man khawm nanlei akiching ding adiei?” a chi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Mangpa khut suh toma umta ahiei mah? Na tungah ka thu atun leh tunlou tuin na mu ding hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi apeidoh a, Mangpa thugen khu mipite ava hil a, tualeh mipite upa sawm sagite ahankhawm a, biehbuh kimvel ah ading sah hi.","title":"Eldad leh Medad genlawhna"},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa meilum in ahing kumsuh a, ama ahoupita hi; tualeh atunga um hagau khu ala a, upa sawmsagite kungah apie a, tualeh hichi ahing hia, atung ua hagau ahing tun tahin thu agenta ua, hinanleh hun sawtpi aki kou sih uhi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh giehphuol ah mi ni a um nalai ua, khat min Eldad ahia, adang pen min Medad ahi; tualeh atung uah hagau atungta a, amaute khu min kigielte lah a tel ahi ua, hinanleh biehbuh ah ava pei sih ua, giehphuol ah thu aphuong denta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh tangval khat ava tai a, Mosi kung ah “Eldad leh Medad in giehphuol sungah thu a phuong phuong mai uhi” chi’n ava hil ta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nun tapa Joshua akhangdawn lai a kipat a Mosi nasempa’n adawnga “Pu Mosi amaute kham mai ve” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in akungah “Kei zieha na thangsiet ahiei mah? Mangpa mite zousie guolnei hi sieng uhenlen, Mangpa’n ahagau atung uah koi chiet leh ichi hibang laitah a,” achita hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Israel upate giehphuol lam ah ahing kinuale ta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa kunga kipat in hui ahing langa tuipi lam a pat in vamim ahing taw a, giehphuol langkhat lampang ni khat lam leh a lelampang ni khat lam leh giehphuol kimvel daap suoh in, leitunga pat tong ni vel a sangin akesah hi.","title":"Kibroth-hattava ah vamim sa ane uh"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh mipiten khum ni sunnitum leh zankhovah leh azingni sunnitum in vamimte ava tomkhawm ua, atomkhawm tawm pen in zong homer sawm atom ua tuate khu giehphuol kimvel ah aphou uhi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh asa nehte uh akam sung ua aum lai in, Mangpa lungthahna khu mipite tungah akuongdoh ta a, tuachi’n mipite khu Mangpa’n natpi huoise tah in agawtta hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuaziehin tua mun khu Kibroth-hattavah achita hi, tuamun a sadu a gongsante avui tah zieh un."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh mipite Kibroth-hattava akipat in Hazeroth ah apei ua, Hazeroth ah aumta uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Miriam leh Aaron in Ethiopia numei akiten pi zieh in Mosi agensie ua, Ethiopia numei akitenpi ngut hi.","title":"Miriam leh Aaron in Mosi agensietna uh"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh amautegel in “Mosi kung guoh ah ahiei mah Mangpa’n thu agen tuom?” Eite kungah zong thu agen sih amah? Achi ua, Mangpa’n tua khu azata hi."},"3":{"text":"Mosi khu leitunga mi zousie lah a nunnem pen ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n, Mosi kung leh Aaron leh Miriam kungah, “Na thum un hing pawtdoh unlen, kimutuona biehbuh ah hing pei un,” thakhat in achi ta hi. Tuachi’n athum un ava pei ta uhi.","title":"Miriam phahna"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa khu meilum dingin ahing kumsuh a, biehbuh kot bulah adinga, Aaron leh Miriam ahan hi: tuachi’n amautegel ahing pawtdoh uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Tu’n ka thu ngai un: Na lah ua guolnei a umleh Kei Mangpa’n kilahnain akungah ka kitheisah dinga, akung ah manglam in thu ka gen ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka suoh Mosi pen tuabang ahisih hi, ka innsung tungtang thuah a muon huoi ahi.","ref":"Heb. 3.2"},"8":{"text":"Ama toh vang kimaituo in, thuguh umlouin kichientahin ka kihou ding ua; Mangpa mel zong amu ding: tuaziehin ka suohpa Mosi bang chi dan a gense ngam na hi uoi?” a chi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa lungthahna khu atung uah akuong ta a, apeisan ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh meilum ding khu akitawlmang ta a; tualeh ngaivawi, Miriam a hing phata a; vua bangin ahing ngouta hi, tualeh Aaron in Miriam a en a, ngaivawi amanu apha ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron in Mosi kungah, “Pu aw, ka tung uah mawna nga vawtsin, mot huoi tahin sil kana bawl ua kana bawlkhiel ta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amanu vang, mi anu gilsunga kipata ahing pien chiil apata phalshisa bangin um sah vawt sin,” a chi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Mangpa kungah, “Amanu tuin sudam in, Aw Pasian ka hing ngen ahi,” chi in akikou hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Apa’n amaitang ah chil phitkhum hitaleh ni sagi sung azum sih ding amah? Giehphuol pulam ah ni sagi sung tuomkoi in um henlen, tuazou chiengin puilut kia hi hen,” achi hi.","ref":"Kisim. 5.2,3"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Miriam khu giehphuol pulam ah ni sagi sung, tuom koiin a um a, mipite khu Miriam kipuilut kia masangsie, akisuon thei ta sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuazouin mipite khu Hazeroth akipan akisuon ua, Paran gamdai ah giehphuol a sat uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah,","title":"Gam enkhe dingte sawlna"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate kunga ka pieh Kanaan gam va enkhe dingin mi sawl in: Israel nam sawm leh nite lah a lamkai, phung china vaihawmpa chiet na sawl ding ahi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Paran gamdai akipat in Mangpa thupieh bangin amaute a sawl ta hi: amaute abawn un Israel tate lah a lamkai chiet ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tamte amin uh ahi; Reuben phunga pat Zakkur tapa Shammua."},"5":{"text":"Simeon phung apat Hori tapa Shaphat."},"6":{"text":"Juda phung apat Jephunneh tapa Kaleb."},"7":{"text":"Issakar phung apat Joseph tapa Igal."},"8":{"text":"Ephraim phung apat Nun tapa Hoshea."},"9":{"text":"Benjamin phung apat Raphu tapa Palti."},"10":{"text":"Zebulun phung apat Sodi tapa Gaddiel."},"11":{"text":"Joseph phung apat chipen Manasseh phung apat Susi tapa Gaddi."},"12":{"text":"Dan phung apat Gemalli tapa Sethur."},"13":{"text":"Asher phung apat Mikael tapa Sethur."},"14":{"text":"Naphtali phung apat Vophsi tapa Nahbi."},"15":{"text":"Gad phung apat Maki tapa Geuel."},"16":{"text":"Tamte gam enkhe dinga Mosi in a sawlte min ahi. Tualeh Mosi in Nun tapa Hoshea khu Joshua achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in amaute Kanaan gam enkhe dingin asawlta a, tualeh akung uah “Simlam gam zuon in pei unlen, singtang gam ah peitou un."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh gam bang chibang ahiei? a Gam sunga teng mite ahat uoi ahat sih uoi? Atam uoi atawm uoi chi leh;"},"19":{"text":"Atenna gam uh ahoi leh hoilou, atenna khopi te uh puon inn ahiei, ahisihleh kulpi nei khopi ahiei chite,"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh gam hausa leh hoi ahiei, gam zawng ahiei? Gammang ahiei hilou; va enkhie unlen, hangsantahin um unlen agam theigate hing puo un achi hi.” Khum hun khu grep ga masa min hunlai ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute apeitou ua, Zin gamdai a kipat in Hamath lutna Rehob tan dongin gam ava enkhie uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh simlam gam ah apeitou ua, Hebron ava tung uhi, tuamun ah Anak tate Ahiman, Sheshai, leh Talmaite a um uhi (Hebron pen Izipt gam a Zoan khuo sangin kum sagi in akisat masa zaw hi.)"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh amaute Eshkol luiguom ahing tung ua, khunah Grep ga bomkhat asatkhie ua, mi niin chiengin a zawng khop vawt uhi. Tualeh amaun, kawlbuthei ga them khat leh theipiga zong ang puo uhi."},"24":{"text":"Khum mun khu Eshkol luiguom achi uhi, Israel taten khum mun apat grep ga bom asat khieh ziehun."},"25":{"text":"Ni sawmli gam enkhie a atham zou un, ahing kilekia ta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahing pei ua, Paran gamdai a Kadesh ah Mosi leh Aaron leh Israel mipite zousie kungah ahing tung ua; akung uah leh mipi zousie kungah thu ahing tut ua, agam theigate a ensah uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh amauten Mosi kungah “Na hing sawlna gam ah kava pei ua, nawitui leh khuoizu luonna ana hi ngut ngei hi, tamte agama theigate ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh agam a mi umte mi thahat tah tah ahi ua, akhopite uh kulbang nei leh thupi tah tah ahi; tuathamlouin khum munah Anak tate zong ka mu uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tua gam simlam ah Amalek mite a teng ua; tualeh Hitmite, Jebusmite leh Amormite singtang gam ah ateng uhi, tualeh Kanaanmite tuipi gei leh Jordan luipangte ah ateng uhi.”"},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kaleb in Mosi masangah mipite a daisah duam a, “Kisa un peitou paivai in, tua gam khu vala va ui, izou ngei ding uhi,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh apeipi miten, “Tua mite va zou vawt sih vai, eite sanga ahat zoh zieh un,” achi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten Israel tate kungah ava gam etkhiehna uh thu ahilou lam in atut ua; “Ka va etkhieh na gam sunga teng mite khu mi nehgam ching mi ahi ua, Tualeh tua gam sunga ka mi mute ukhu mi lien pipi ahi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh khummun ah Nephilim a hing kipan Anak mite tua gam ah ka mu uhi. Amaute toh tein kou khu khuongbai bang bep ka hi ua, amaute mit mu in zong khuongbai bang bep ma ka hi uhi.”","ref":"Siem. 6.4"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi umkhawmte zousie aw ngaitah in akikou ua, khum zan in mipite akapta uhi.","title":"Israelte Pasian tungah ahel uh"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate zousie Mosi leh Aaron tungah aphunta ua, mipi umkhawmte zousie’n a kung uah, “Pasian in Izipt gamah hing na that gam vanglah zaw leh aw, ahisihleh Pasian in tam gamdai mun ah hing sulum sieng mai leh maw."},"3":{"text":"Bangdinga namsau a shidinga, izite leh itate mat a um ding giap a, Mangpa’n tam gam a ahing puitung adiei? Eite dingin Izipt gam a kilekia hoi zaw lou ding ade aw,” a chi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh khat leh khat akihou ua, “Lamkai khat bawl va ui, Izipt gamah kinuale kia mai vai,” achi u hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Aaron khu Israel mipi kikhawmte zousie masangah abohkhup ta ua;"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh gam enkhete lah a tel, Nun tapa Joshua leh Jephunneh tapa Kaleb in a puonte uh abotkeh ua;"},"7":{"text":"Israel tate kikhawm zousiete kungah, “En khe dinga kava vahna gam ukhu gam hoi mama ahi."},"8":{"text":"Itung ua Mangpa alungdam leh tua gam ah ahing puilut dinga, ahing pe ding hi. Nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam khu."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa tungah kiphin sih unlen, tua gam mite zong zau sih un, ineh ding tanghou ahi mai uhi, akidal na uh bangmalou a suohta, Mangpa eite kungah aum asiei mah, amaute zausih un,” achi uhi.","ref":"Heb. 3.16"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh mipi umkhawmte zousien suonga se atum uhi. Tuachi’n Mangpa thupina khu, kimutuona biehbuh ah Israel tate zousie masang ah ahing kilang ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Tam miten bangtan vei ahiei ahing thusimlou ding uh? Tualeh alah ua chiemtena ka bawl zelte nangawn zong bangtan vei ahiei agintat lou ding uh?","title":"Mosi’n mipite dingin angetpieh"},"12":{"text":"Amaute natpi in ka thatgam dinga, tualeh nangma akipat in amauh sanga thupi leh hatzaw nam khat bawlkhe zaw mai vang,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Mangpa kungah “Izipt miten za kha va uh; tam mite alah ua kipat a na thahatna a, na pui doh ahi ngal ua.","ref":"Pawt. 32.11-14"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh amauten tam gammite ahil kha ding ua; azieh pen amauten, Nang Mangpa tam mite lah ah na um a, Mangpa nangma kimaituo in ahing mu ua, meipi atung uah aum lenga, tualeh sunin meipi khuomin, zanin meikuong in amasang uah na pei zel hi, chi azata uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuin tam mipite zousie thakhat a mikhat banga na tha leh vang Na minthanna za namten,"},"16":{"text":"Mangpa’n tam mipite kunga pieh dinga achiem na gam a apuitung thei nawn lou ziehin, amaute gam dai ah athatgam ta hi chin agen ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin ka hing ngen ahi, ka Mangpa silbawltheina khu suhthupi in umta hen."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa khu lungnemtah, khotuona lienpi nei, khelna leh thulimlouna ngaidam zel, siemtanglou a kiguotte mawh ha doh ngailou, pate khelna tate tunga khang thum khangli tan donga zong thuh zelpa chia na gen dung zui in.","ref":"Pawt. 20.5,6; 34.6,7; Danp. 5.9,10; 7.9,10"},"19":{"text":"Na khotuona letdan dungzui leh tam mite Izipt gam a kipata tutan donga na ngaidam bangin, ngaidam in chi’n ka hing ngen ahi,” a chi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh “Mangpa’n na thu bangin ka ngaidam hi.","title":"Israel gamdai a vahvai a shiding"},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hinna leh Mangpa thupina in ahing dimsah ding leitung pumpi louin ka gen a hi;","ref":"Heb. 3.18"},"22":{"text":"Izipt gam leh gamdai a, ka thupina leh ka sillamdang bawlte mu a, hichi pipi a zong sawm vei ving-veng hing ze et nalai lai a, ka thu zuilou nalai zousie ten;"},"23":{"text":"Apu leh pate uh kunga, kichiem a pieh dinga ka chiem gam amu vawt sih ding uhi, alah ua kei hing thusimlouten zong amu het sih ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh ka suoh Kaleb in lungsim tuom apuo a, bukimtah a ahing zui ziehin ava peina gamah ka puilut dinga, ahahasuonten tua gam aluo ding uhi.","ref":"Josh. 14.9-12"},"25":{"text":"Tuin Amalekmite leh Kanaanmite phaijang gam a aten ziehun; Zingchiengin kihei unlen; Tuipi san zotna lampi langah gamdai ah lut un,” achita hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron ahoupi a akung uah."},"27":{"text":"“Tam mi thulimlou umkhawmte, ka tunga phun phunte bangtan ahiei kadaw thei ding, Israel tate ka tunga aphun na uh ka za hi."},"28":{"text":"Akung uah gen in, ka hinna louin ka gen ahi, Mangpa’n achi hi, ka bila ka zah ngei a na gen bangun, tuabangin na tung uah ka bawl ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Na luong uh tam gamdai ah alum dinga, na lah ua mi kisimna a telsa zousie, kum sawm ni a upa apat atunglam ka tunga phun zousiete;","ref":"Heb. 3.17"},"30":{"text":"Na tenna ding ua hing bawl pieh dinga ka chiemna gam ah Jephunneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua chilou na lut het sih ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh mi mat ding giap ahi ding uh chia na gen uh na tate uh ka puilut dinga, na deilou gam uh a thei ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh Noute pen na luong uh tami gamdai ah a lum ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh na tate uh gamdai ah kum sawmli sung avah vai ding ua, na luong uh gamdai a abeimang masang sie, na kizua ziehun athuoh ding uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.36"},"34":{"text":"Gam nava etkhiet ni za uh ni sawm li, nikhat leh kum khat kibangin, kum sawm li sung na gitlouna uh, na thuoh law ding uhi. Tuachi’n ka tup ka hendan na thei ding uhi."},"35":{"text":"Kei Mangpa’n miginalou umkhawm, kei hing dal a pungkhawmte tungah tam sil kabawl ngei ngei ding ka chita hi. Tam gamdai ah amangthai ding ua, ashi gam sieng ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi chiin,” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh gam enkhe dinga Mosi in asawl hing kinualeten, gam umdan ahoilou lam a gen a mipi umkhawmte Mangpa tunga phun sahte;","title":"Gam enkhete ashi"},"37":{"text":"Khum gam umdan aselam a hing tutte ngel khu Mangpa masangah natna hii in ashita uhi."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh Nun tapa Joshua leh Jephunneh tapa Kaleb, gam enkhe dinga asawlte lah a telte, ashi sih uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in tam thute Israel tate zousie kungah ahil a: mipite lungkham in akapta uhi.","title":"Hormah a Israelte gal lelna"},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n zingmawng matahin athou ua, muolvum ah akal tou ua, “En un, tam mun ah i um ua, Mangpa’n ang chiemna gam ah ipeitou ding uh, ina bawlkhielta uhi” achi uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in akung uah, “Bang dinga Mangpa thupieh bawtsie na hi uoi? Apha tuom sih ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Na melmate uh masanga thagama na umlou nading un, peitou da mai un, azieh pen Mangpa’n ahing umpi sih hi, a chi hi."},"43":{"text":"Na masang uah Amalekmite leh Kanaan mite a um uhi. Namsau a thagam in na um ding uh, Mangpa na kiheisan tah ziehun, na kung uah Mangpa a um sih ding hi” a chi hi."},"44":{"text":"Hinanleh amauten muolvum a peitou atumtei tei ua; hinanleh Mangpa thuhun bawm leh Mosi giehphuol apat akisuon sih uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua muol tunga teng Amalek mite leh Kanaan mite ahing kumsuh ua, amaute ahing satlum ua, Hormah mun dongin asatlum zeng zung uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah.","title":"Silpieh dan tuomtuom"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate houpi inlen akung uah, na kung ua ka hing pieh na tenna ding uh gam na hing tun chieng ua;"},"3":{"text":"Mangpa kunga mei sillat ahiei, halmang sillat ahiei, thuchiem tangtunna kithoina ahiei, nouma ut thu a sillat ahiei, na pawibawl ngaina hun guotte uh a hiei, ganhon lah ahiei, belam hon lah ahiei a, Mangpa dinga gimnamtui mei a sillat na bawl chiengun."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa adinga sillat lan pa’n tangbuong nelte ephah se sawm suo sekhat, sathau hin se li suo se khat mehkhawm a alat ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh dawn sillat dingin uoin hin khat seli suo sekhat halmang sillat ahiei, kithoina ahiei a, belamnou khat chiet a na bawl ding uh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahisihleh belamtal adingin, ann sillat, tangbuong nelte ephah se sawm suo se ni sathau hin sethum suo sekhat kimehkhawm na bawl ding uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh dawn sillat dingin, Mangpa dinga gimnamtui dingin uoin hin khat sethum suo sekhat na lat ding uh ahi."},"8":{"text":"Halmang sillat ding ahiei, thuchiem tangtunna dinga kithoina ding ahiei, Mangpa kunga lemna sillat ding ahiei a, bawngtal na zah chiengun;"},"9":{"text":"Bawngtal na lat toh kiton in ann sillat, tangbuong nelte ephah khat sesawm suo sethum sathau hin kim khat mehkhawm nalat ding uh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh dawn sillat dingin uoin hin kim khat, Mangpa dinga gimnamtui dingin, mei a sillat na lat ding uh ahi."},"11":{"text":"“Tuachibangin bawngtal a ding ahiei, belam tal ading ahiei, belam nou a dingin ahiei, kelnou adingin ahiei akibawl ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Atam dan dungzui in na bawl ding ua, atam dan bang zel un na lan ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Khum gam sunga pieng zousie’n, Mangpa adinga gimnamtui mei a sillat alat ding chiengun tam bang in, tam sillatte abawl ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Namdang mi na lah ua na tengsate ahiei, ahisihleh koipou na lah ua akhang akhanga na tengsaten, Mangpa dinga gimnamtui mei a sillat alat ding u’leh noute bawl bangin aman zong abawl ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Na khangtan ua dingin leh nou mipi umkhawmte leh nam dang na lah ua umte a dingin zong thugousie khat ahi ding ahi. Mangpa masang ah nam dangte zong noute bang ahi ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Nou a ding leh na kung ua um nam dangumte adingin dan khat leh tawndan kibang khat a um ding ahi,” chiin achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 24.22"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah."},"18":{"text":"“Israel tate houpi inlen akung uah, ka hing puina ding gam na hing tun chiengun;"},"19":{"text":"Hichi ahing hi ding a, agam a pieng ann na neh chiengun, Mangpa kungah vei sillat na lan ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Na tanghou meh masapen lah ua, beu khat vei sillat dinga na lat ding uh ahi;
