phuola vei sillat na vei bangun, na vei ding uh ahi."},"21":{"text":"Na khang tungtawn un na tanghou mehmasahpen uh, Mangpa kunga vei sillat dinga na lat zel ding uh ahi."},"22":{"text":"“Tualeh na tuploupi ua na suhkhel ua, Mangpa’n Mosi kunga agen thupiehte zousie na zui sih u’leh;","title":"Tuploupi a khelna zieha sillatte"},"23":{"text":"Mangpa’n Mosi khut zanga, na kung ua thu ahing pieh zousie: Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh ni a kipat a, na khang tungtawn ua dinga athu piehte na zui sih u’leh;"},"24":{"text":"Hichi ahi dinga, mipi um khawmte theiloua, bawl khel khah ahileh, mipi umkhawmte zousie in halmang sillat Mangpa dinga gimnamtui dingin, bawngtal tuoi khat alan ding ua, adan ngaina bangin ann sillat leh dawn sillat toh khelna kithoina ding in kel tal khat zong alan ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Siempuin Israel tate umkhawm zousie dingin kilem na abawlpieh dinga tuachi’n ngaidam ahi ding uhi; tuploupi a bawl khelna ahi ziehin: Tuachi’n amaun tuploupi a abawlkhelna zieh ua, Mangpa dinga mei a kithoina sillat leh Mangpa masanga khelna sillat ahing tawi ding uh ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate umkhawmte zousie, ngaidam ahi ding ua, alah ua namdang umte zong; mipiten atupmawng ua abawlkhel uh ahi lou ziehin."},"27":{"text":"“Tualeh mi khat in tupmawng hiloua bawlkhel anei khahleh aman khelna sillat dingin kum khat phapan kelnou anu khat alat ding ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 4.27-31"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin tupmawng hilou a sil bawlkhielpa a dingin kilemna abawl pieh dinga: Mangpa masang a tupmawng hilou sil abawlkhiel chiengin kilemna abawl dinga; tuachi’n ngaidam ahi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tupmawng hilou a sil bawlkhiel mi a dingin leh, a gam sunga pieng Israel tate leh nam dang alah ua umte adingin zong dan khat na nei ding uh ahi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh thei sasa abawl ahileh vang gam sunga pieng hiin namdang mi hitaleh, Mangpa gensie ahia, tuapa khu amite lah a pat satkhieh ding ahi.","title":"Thei sasa a khelna dingin kithoina umlou"},"31":{"text":"Aman Mangpa athusim sih a, athupiehte apalsan ziehin, tua mipa khu satkhieh hil hel ding ahi, agitlouna man aman akipuoh ding ahi,” chiin achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate gamdai a a um lai un, khawlni a singtom mi khat a mu ua."},"33":{"text":"Tua mipa sing tom laitah mutengin amapa khu Mosi leh Aaron leh mipi umkhawmte kungah ahing zawpi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tua mipa bang law ding ahiei chi agen chien thei nailou zieh un suongkul ah akhum uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah “Tuamipa thalia ngei ngei ding ahi; giehphuol pulam ah mipi zousien suonga aselup ding uh ahi,” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin mipi zousiein giehphuol pulam ah akaidoh ua, suongin aseplum ta uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah,","title":"Puon monga khaupumte"},"38":{"text":"“Israel mipite kungah, akhang tungtawn un a puonmong uah khaupum kigah bawl uhenlen, among tep bawh ah khaudum khai uhen.","ref":"Danp. 22.12"},"39":{"text":"Tua puon monga khaupum kigah na et ua nouten Mangpa thupieh zousie na thei zing na ding u’leh na zui na ding uh ahi; tualeh kizua a na um zel bang ua na lungtang deilam u’leh na mit la pouma uh dei a na umlou na dingun."},"40":{"text":"Ka thupieh zousiete na theizing ua, na zui ua, tualeh na Pasian ua dinga na sienthou thei na ding uh ahi."},"41":{"text":"Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi. Na Pasian uh ka hi theina dinga Izipt gam a kipata noute hing puidohpa Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi,” chiin achi hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Levi tapa Kohath tapa Izhar tapa Korah leh Eliab tapate Dathan leh Abiram leh Peleth tapa On, Reuben tapaten mite a pui ua;","title":"Korah, Dathan leh Abiram helna","ref":"Jud. 1.11"},"2":{"text":"Israel tate mi langsal deu deu mipi lah a lamkai vaihawmtu a telte lah a mi zani leh sawmngate toh Mosi masangah adingdoh ua."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi leh Aaron dou dingin akikhawmta ua, akung uah, “Kisathei sengta uteh, mipite lah a siengthou chiet ngal ua, michin a siengthou ua, Mangpa zong alah uah a um hi; bang zieh a Mangpa mipi umkhawmte tunga kikoi tungnung tuom na hi uoi?” a chi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in tua thu azah tahin alu tuolsu in akhupboh ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh aman Korah leh apawlte zousie ahoupia akung uah “Zing chiengin Koite ahiei Ama ahi a, koite ahiei asiengthou chi ahing musah dinga; amauh akungah ahing pei sah ding hi chi’n agen hi."},"6":{"text":"Hichiin bawl un, nou Korah leh apawlte zousie in gimnamtui halna belte kilah chiet unlen;"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh asungah mei leh gimnamtui koi unlen zing chiengin Mangpa masang ah hal un, tualeh hichi ahi ding, Mangpa’n atel pouma asiengthou ding; nou Levi tapate aw na kisathei sengta uhi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Korah kungah “Nou Levi tapate aw ngaikhie un."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa biehbuh a nasep sem ding leh mipite masang a ana uh semdinga ding dinga Israelte Pasian in Ama nai dinga Israel mipite lah akipat a ahing koituom na khu nou adingin sil neunou khat banga kilang giap ahiei mah."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akungah ahing um naisahta a, na kung ua um na unau Levi tapate zousie toh; Siempu hina na sui nalai u’maw?"},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin nang leh na pawlte zousie Mangpa dou ding in na kikhawm uh hi, Aaron bang ahia ahiei, atunga na hichi phun uh?” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Eliab tapate Dathan leh Abiram han ding mi asawl a, amauten “Hing pei tou sih va ung:"},"13":{"text":"Gamdai a thadinga, nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam apat na hing puidoh khu sil neu noukhat ahiei mah? Katung uah leengtapa bangin vai na hawm viel nalai a."},"14":{"text":"Tuagentahlou nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam a lah nang pui lut sih a, lou leh grep huon luo ding zong na hing pe sih hi: tam mite mit kheudoh sawm na hiei mah? Kang peitou sih ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi alungthah sengsenga, Mangpa kungah, “A sillat uh pompieh vawt sin, Ama ua kipat sabiltung khat zong ka la sih a, tualeh koimakhat siet na ding zong ka bawl sih hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Korah kungah, “Zing chiengin nang leh na pawlte Mangpa masangah hing um un, nang leh amaute tualeh Aaron toh."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh mi chin in na gimnamtui halna bel uh lachiet unlen, asungah gimnamtui koi un, tualeh Mangpa masangah michinin amei bel hing tawi uhen, mei bel zani leh sawm nga; nang leh Aaron in zong na mei bel uh hing tawi tuoh un,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n michin in amei bel uh a tawi ua, asung ah mei akoi ua, tualeh gimnamtui ahal ua, Mosi leh Aaron toh kimutuona biehbuh kot phungah a ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Korah in Mosi leh Aaron dou ding in mipi zousie kimutuona biehbuh kotpi phungah aumkhawm sah a, tualeh mipi zousiete tungah Mangpa thupina ahing langta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron ahoupi a, akung uah;"},"21":{"text":"“Tam mipite lah a pat kihemkhie un, tha khat a ka suhmangthai thei na dingin”, achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n amautegel abohkhup ua, “Aw Pasian tahsa zousie hagaute Pasian, mikhat gitlou ziehin mipite zousie tungah na lungthah ta lawm ding amah?” a chi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah,"},"24":{"text":"Mipi umkhawmte kungah, “Korah leh Dathan leh Abiramte biehbuh akipat kikhin khieh san un chiin gen in,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi a dingdoh a, Dathan leh Abiram kungah ava haw a, Israel upaten azui uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh aman mipi umkhawmte kungah, “Tam migiloute puoninn apat pawtkhie unlen, abangma uh khoi sih un, tua chilouin akhelna uoh na katum kha ding uhi,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute Korah, Dathan leh Abiramte biehbuh akipat apawtdoh zeng zung ta ua, tualeh Dathan leh Abiram ahing pawtdoh ua, apuoninn uh kotkha phungah a zite u’leh atapate u’leh atangehte utoh ading uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in “Keima lungsim a hing potdoh in bangma ka bawl sih a, tam silzousie bawl dingin Mangpa’n ahing sawl ahi chi na thei ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tam mite mi zousie shi dan ngaina banga ashi ua, ahisihleh mi zousie gawt ngaina banga gawt ahi giap u’leh Pasian in ang sawllou ahi ding."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n siltha khat abawla lei tangin akam akah a, anei zousie utoh amaute avaltum a, leimidawng a kintah a apeisuh u’leh tam miten Mangpa adei sih uh chi na thei ding uhi,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, tam thute agen zoutahin, anuoi ua leitang ahing khipoh a,"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh leitangin akam akah a, amaute a innkuon un Korah mite zousie anei alam zousie utoh avaltum siengta hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama u’leh anei alam zousie utoh ahingtang un lei kohawmah akesuhta uhi, tuachi’n lei khu ahing kichi kia a, mipite lah a kipat a mangthai ta uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n akim ua um Israel mi zousiete khu akikou husa uah ataizah ta uhi, “Eite zong leitangin hing valtum khava achi uhi.”"},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa a kipat in mei ahing Pawtkhie a, gimnamtui toi a um mi zani leh sawmngate akatum ta hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah,"},"37":{"text":"“Nangman mei khu tendoh inlen siempu Aaron tapa Eliazar khu mei lah a pat gimnamtui halna lakhe dingin hil in, silsiengthou ahi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Amauh hinna tung ngei a giloute gimnamtui halna belte zong la inlen, tuate khu maitam khuna kuong dingin kheng uheh, Mangpa masanga latsa ahi ziehin, asiengthou ahi, tuachi’n Israel tate dingin chiemtena ahi ding hi,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu Eleazar in mi katumten analatsa uh gimnamtui halna sum-eng belte khu ala a, maitam khuna dingin akhengta hi."},"40":{"text":"Israel tate adinga atheizing na ding un, Aaron tate chilou namdang mawngmawng, Mangpa masanga gimnamtui hal dinga ahing pei nai lou na ding un, Mangpa’n Mosi zanga akunga agen bangin."},"41":{"text":"Hinanleh azing ni’n, “Mangpa mite na that gam tauh chi’n Israel tate mipi zousie Mosi leh Aaron tungah aphun ta uhi.”","title":"Aaron in mipite ahundoh"},"42":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, mipite Mosi leh Aaron dou dinga apunkhawm lai un, kimutuona biehbuh lam a en ua, tualeh ngaiun, meilum in ahing khu a, Mangpa thupina ahing kilang hi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi leh Aaron kimutuona biehbuh kotphungah ahing pei uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupia akungah,"},"45":{"text":"“Tam mipite lah a kipat kihemkhie un, thakhat a ka suhmangthai theina dingin achi hi,” tuachi’n amautegel amai uh leisu in bohkhup in apuo ta uhi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Aaron kungah, “Gimnamtui halna bel la inlen asungah maitam a kipat a na lah, mei koi in, tualeh gimnamtui hal inlen kintah in mipite kungah pei inlen ama-ua dingin kilemna bawlpieh in, Mangpa akipata lungthahna apawt khiet tah ziehin hii aleeng panta hi,” achi hi."},"47":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aaron in Mosi gen bangin, ala a, mipi lah ah atailut a, tualeh ngaiin hii khu mipite lah ah aleeng panta a, tualeh aman gimnamtui ahalkhum a, mipite dingin kilemna abawl pieh hi."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh ama khu mi shi leh mihing kikaal ah adinga hii khu athengta hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n Korah tungtang thua a shite chilou hii a shite zousie tul sawm leh tul li leh za sagi ahi uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron khu kimutuona biehbuh kotphung ah Mosi kungah ahing kile kia a, hii khu atheng ta hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah;","title":"Aaron chiengsel"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate houpi inlen, Israel phung chin akipat chiengkhut khat chiet la inlen, aphung aphung dungzui zel ua, lamkaite upa pen zousie chiengkhut sawmleni la inlen tualeh achieng chiet uah amin chiet uh giel in."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Levi chieng ah Aaron min gielin, aphung chin ua upa zousie adingin chiengkhut khat chiet a um ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n kimutuona biehbuh masanga ka hing kimupina mun a na koi ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi dinga, ka teldingpa chiengkhut ahing seldoh dinga, tuachi’n Israel tate phunna na tunga aphunna uh ka tawp sah ding hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Israel tate ahoupi a, tuachi’n a phung chiet uh dungzui in, aphung lamkai chinteng un chieng khat chiet zelin chiengkhut sawm leh ni apie ua, tualeh Aaron chieng zong achieng lah uah atel hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in chiengte khu, theipina biehbuh ah, Mangpa masangah akoita hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh azingni in hichi ahing hia, Mosi theipina biehbuh sungah ava lut a, tualeh ngaiin, Levi phungte a dinga Aaron chieng khut aseldoh a, apahmum a, ahing apahkhie a, kawlthualu ana gata hi.","ref":"Heb. 9.4"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in chieng zousie Mangpa masanga kipat in Israel tate zousie kungah ahing tawidoh a, tualeh amauten a en ua, michinin achieng chiet uh akilah uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Hel hatte ahi uh chi chiemte na dingin Aaron chiengkhut pen theipina masanga koi dingin hing nua tawi kia in, tuachi’n keima a kipat in ahelna uh na lamang ding hi ashilaw lou na ding un.”"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in tuabangin abawl a, Mangpa’n thu apieh bang ngei in abawl ta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Mosi kungah, “En in, ka shita uh, Mangthai ka hita uh, Mangthang sieng ka hita uh."},"13":{"text":"Koi hinanleh Mangpa biehbuh kung nai a hing pei pouma ashi ding: I unpi ua mangthai sieng ding ihita uh amah?” achi uhi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Aaron kungah, “Nang leh na tapate leh na pa innkuonpiten munsiengthou toh kisai a thulimlouna, bawlkhelna maw na pawding ua, tualeh nang leh na tapaten na siempu hina uh khelna maw na paw ding uhi.","title":"Siempute leh Levite nasep dingte"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh na pa chipi Levi phunga na unaute zong nang toh a sepkhawm theina dingun na kungah na um sah dinga, hinanleh nang leh na tapate theipina biehbuh masangah na um ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh amauten na nasep ahing hu ding ua, biehbuh nasep zousie asem ding ua, hinanleh munsiengthou a tuium belsuonte leh maitam pen hing nai sih uheh, amaute leh nangma na shi lou na ding un."},"4":{"text":"Amauten nang toh asemkhawm ding ua, biehbuh nasepna zousie a dingin, kimutuona biehbuh nasep atang ding ua, namdang mi na kung nai a ahing pei ding uh ahi sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh mun siengthou nasepna leh maitam nasepna nangman na tang ding hi; Israel tate tunga lungthahna a um nawnlou na dingin."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh ngaiin Keima mama in na unau Levite, Israel tate lah akipat in ka ladoh a, kimutuona biehbuh a nasep semdingin, Mangpa adinga silpiehin na kungah ahing kipeta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin, nang leh na tapaten maitam leh puonzah sunglam a, na siempu nasep uh nasem ding ua, tualeh nangman nna nasem ding; Na siempu nasepna mun khu silpieh a nasepna banga ka hing pieh ahi: hinanleh nam dang mi na kung nai a hing pei pouma shi sah ding ahi,” a chi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Aaron ahoupi a, “Ngaiin, Keima’n Kei a ding vei sillat, Israel tate sil lat siengthou zousie nang leh na tapate kumtawn a na tantuom dingun thugousie a ka hing pieh ahi.","title":"Siempute tanvou ding"},"9":{"text":"Mei a hal val silsiengthoute nanga ahi dinga, asillat chinteng uh, a ann sillatte uh, akhelna kithoina sillatte uh, a gitlouna kithoina sillatte uh, ka kunga ahing lat ding zousiete uh, nang leh na tapate tantuom siengthou ahi ding."},"10":{"text":"Mun siengthou pen ah tuami na ne ding ua, Pasal tengin ane ding ua; na tantuom ahi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tami zong na tantuom ahi, ann sillat dinga asil piehte uh, Israel tate vei sillat zousiete tanin; nang leh natapate leh na tanute toh kumtawn a na tantuom dingun ka hing pie ahi; na Inn a mi siengthou zousien ane thei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Sathau hoipente leh uoin tha hoipente leh bu hoipente leh Mangpa kunga alat ding uh ga masate nang ka hing peta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh loua ga min masapen, Mangpa a dinga ahing tawite uh nanga ahi dinga; na inn a mi siengthou zousien ane theiding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Israelte sillat pouma nanga ahi ding.","ref":"Siempu. 27.28"},"15":{"text":"Mangpa dinga apieh uh naubu hong masapen mihing hi in ganta hitaleh nanga ahi dinga; hinanleh ata chilpen vang na tat ngei ngei ding ahia, tualeh ganta sienglou anou pieng masapen zong na tat ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ha khat a chin chiengin tat dingte tatna man na guot dan dungzuiin shekel nga a na tat ding ahi; (mun siengthou a kizah dung zuiin shekel khat Gerah sawmni) ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh bawngnou pieng masapen, belamnou pieng masapen leh Kelnou pieng masapen, na tat ding ahi sih, asiengthou ahi uhi; a sisan uh maitam tungah na the dinga, Mangpa a dinga gimnamtui dingin athaute uh mei a sillat dingin na hal ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Asa uh nanga ahi dinga, vei sillat awm leh amal zietlam nanga ahi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Sil siengthou vei sillat, Israel taten Mangpa kunga alat zousie uh, nang leh na tapate leh na tanute kungah kumtawn a thugousie dingin ka hing peta hi, tami nanga ding leh nahah nasuonte kunga, Mangpa masanga kumtawna ding chi a bawl thuhun, ahi ding hi,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Aaron kungah, “Agam uah goutan na nei sih dinga, alah uah tanvou zong na nei sih ding hi: Israel tate lah a na tanvou leh na goutan khu Keima ka hi."},"21":{"text":"“Ngaiin, Keima’n Levi tate khu kimutuona biehbuh nasep asep man un, Israel gamsunga sawm a khat zousie agoutan dingun ka peta hi.","title":"Levite tanvou ding","ref":"Siempu. 27.30-33; Danp. 14.22-29"},"22":{"text":"Tua kipat in Israel taten kimutuona biehbuh nai a ahing pei ding uh ahi sih hi, tuachilouin khelna man puoin ashi khading uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh Leviten kimutuona biehbuh nasep asem ding ua, athulimlouna maw uh apo ding uh: Israel tate lah a goutan anei sih ding uhi, tami na khang tungtawn ua kumtawn thupieh ahi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahivang in Israelte tate sawma khat, Mangpa a dinga vei sillat dinga alat ukhu Levite goutan dingin ka peta ahi: tuaziehin akung uah Israel tate lah-ah goutan na nei sih ding uh, ka chisa mawng ahita hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah,","title":"Levite Sawma khat pieh dan ding"},"26":{"text":"“Tambangin Levite houpi inlen, akung uah hichiin gen in, na goutan ding ua Israel tate sawma khat ka hing pieh na lah chiengun, tuami sawma khat apat sawma khat Mangpa a dingin vei sillat in na lan ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n na vei sillatte uh nou adingin phuola bu kipie bang leh uoin suhna dim banga sim ahi ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Hichibangin nou zong Israel tate akipat a na mu uh, na sawm ua khatte ua pat Mangpa dinga vei sillat dingin na lan ding uhi; tualeh tua Mangpa vei sillat khu Siempu Aaron kungah na pe ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Silpieh na mu zousiete lah a pat ahoipen, a siengthou pen, zousie Mangpa vei sillat dingin na lan ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaziehin akung uah, tua ahoipen na vei chiengin, tua khu Levite a dingin phuola bu tung leh uoin suhna a uoin tung banga sim ahi ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuakhu nang leh na innkuonpiten heisung mun pou ah zong na ne thei ding uhi, kimutuona biehbuh a na nasep man uh ahi ziehin."},"32":{"text":"Ahoipen na vei chiengun akhelna maw na paw sih ding ua, Israel tate sil siengthou na suthanghuoi ding uh ahi sih, tuachilouin na shi khading uhi chiin.”"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron ahoupi a, akung uah;","title":"Bawngla san a siensuona"},"2":{"text":"“Tami Mangpa dan thupieh thugousie khu ahi. Israel tate kungah, bawngla san gensiet bei khat, a ngawnga hahkol kibat ngainailou, na kunga hing kai dingin gen in."},"3":{"text":"Tuakhu siempu Eleazar kungah na peding ua, aman giehphuol pulam ah a kaidoh dinga, amasang ah koi ahiei khat in athat ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Siempuin akhutme in asisan ala dinga, kimutuona biehbuh mailam ah sagi vei athe ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n bawngla khu koi ahiei khat in amitmu ah ahaldinga; avunte, asate, asisante leh a eehte toh ahal ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin sidar sing leh hissop leh puonsandup ala dinga bawngla kihalna laiah apailut ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempuin apuonte asawp dinga, tuiin akisil ding a, tuazou chiengin giehphuol ah ang pei dinga, tualeh siempu khu nitah lam dongin sienglou ahi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh ahal pa’n tui in apuonte asawp dinga, tuiin akisil dinga, tualeh nitah dong in sienglou ahi ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh mi sieng khat in tua bawngla kihalna vamte ala khawm ding a, giehphuol pulam a mun sieng khat ah akoi dinga, Israel mipi kikhawmte dingin kisiensuona tui dinga koi ahi ding hi: tuakhu khelna suhsiengthouna ahi ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 9.13"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh bawngla vam luohkhawm pa’n apuonte a sawp dinga, nitah dongin sienglou ahi ding hi; Tam khu Israel tate ding leh alah ua mi namtuom umte dingin kumtawn thugousie ahi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Koipou mishi luong khoikha pouma abua ahi ding hi.","title":"Mishi luong khoi"},"12":{"text":"Tua mi khu ni thum ni in akisusieng dinga ni sagi ni’n asiengta ding hi, hinanleh nithum ni a akisuhsieng sihleh ni sagi ni’n asieng sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Koipou mishi luong khoi a akisuhsieng sihleh Mangpa biehbuh asubua ahi; tuabang mi khu Israel tate lah a pat satkhieh ding ahi, kisiensuona tui atunga the ahilou ziehin asieng sih ding hi, asienlouna atungah a um nalai hi."},"14":{"text":"“Puoninn sunga mi ashi chienga dan ding tami ahi: puoninn sunga hing lut zousie leh puoninn sunga um zousie ni sagi a sieng sih ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh tuium belsuon asin neilou a kihong pouma abua ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh koizong gam lah a namsau a mi kithat ahiei, mishi luong ahiei, mishi gu ahiei, han ahiei khoikha pouma ni sagi sung asienglou ahi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh mi siengloute sienna dingin, khelna silsiengna bawngla halna vam ala ding ua, bel ah tui luonglai tui toh a sung ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Mi sieng khat in hissop ala dinga, tui ah adie dinga, puoninn tungleh, tui um belsuonte zousie tung leh khuna um mi zousie tung leh mishi gu ahiei, akithat luong ahiei, ashi ahiei, ahisihleh han khoikhapa tungah athe ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh mi siengpa’n asiengloupa tungah nithum ni leh ni sagi niin athe dinga, ni sagi niin akisusieng dinga; apuonte asawp dinga, tuiin akisil dinga, nitah lam in asiengta ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Hinanleh mi sienglou hi a, tualeh kisuhsienglou mi khu, mipi umkhawmte lah apat satkhieh ahi ding hi, aman Mangpa mun siengthou asubuata a, kisuhsiengna tui atunga akithe khah lou ziehin, ama pen a sienglou ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tami ama ua dingin kumtawna zuiding dan ahi ding, koipou kisiensuona tui the phot in apuonsilte a sawp ding a, tualeh koipou kisiensuona tui sukha pouma nitah dongin asienglou ahi ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh mi koizong mi sienglouin asuhkhah pouma asieng lou ahi ding ua, tualeh tua mipa khoi kha pouma zong nitah dongin asieng sih ding uhi,” achi hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mipi umkhawm zousie ahakhatna in Zin gamdai ah alut ua, tualeh mipiten Kadesh ah giehphuol abawl ua, tua mun ah Miriam ashi a, khunah avui uh hi.","title":"Miriam shina"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh mipi umkhawmte dingin tui a um tasih a; tuachi’n Mosi leh Aaron tungah lungkimlou in akikhawm uhi.","title":"Meribah a sil lamdang","ref":"Pawt. 17.1-7"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh mipiten Mosi akiselpi ua, “Mangpa masanga i unaute ashi lai un, Pasian in hing na that lum zawta mai leh maw, achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Bangdinga Mangpa mipite gamdai a shi dinga na hing puilut ahiei? Kou leh ka gantate utoh."},"5":{"text":"Bangdinga tam mun hoilou a puilut dinga Izipt gam a kipat a nang pawtsah ahiei? Bu leh balte, theipite, grepte, kawlbutheite umlouna mun ahi a, tui dawnding mawngmawng lah a um sih a,” chi’n Mosi akinielpi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Aaron khu mipi umkhawmte lah a kipat in kimutuona biehbuh kotphungah apeita ua, khupbohin apuata uhi. Tuachi’n Mangpa thupina akung uah ahing kilang ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a akungah.","title":"Mosi bawl khelna"},"8":{"text":"“Na chiengkhut la inlen, mipite hankhawm inlen, nang leh na sanggampa Aaron toh, a mit mu ngei ua tui hing pulkhesah dingin tua suongpi khu houpi in, tuachi’n suongpi akipat tui na lahdoh pieh dinga, tuachi’n mipite leh aganhonte uh dawn ding tui na pe ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Mangpa masanga pat chieng khut athupieh bangin ala ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi leh Aaron in, suongpi masangah mipite akikhawmsah ua, akung uah, Tuin nou mihelhatte aw “Ngai un, tam suongpi akipat tui ka hing lahkhiet pieh ding uh ahiei mah?” achi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in aban azah a, achiengin suongpi nivei asat a, tuitampi ahing luongkhie a, tualeh mipi kikhawmte leh aganhonte un adawn uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron kungah “Na hing gingta sih ua, Israel tate mit mu ah na hing pahtawi ut sih uhi; tuaziehin tam mipite ka piehna gamah na puilut sih ding uhi.”"},"13":{"text":"Tami Meribah tuite ahi: aziehpen Israel taten Mangpa aphin ua, amasang uah pahtawi in ka um sih hi, achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Kadesh a kipat in Edom Lengpa kungah thangkou asawl a, “Na sanggampa Israel in tambangin agen hi, ka tung ua gentheina hing tung zousie na thei a:","title":"Edom in Israel peisuoh phallou"},"15":{"text":"Ka pu leh pate uh Izipt gam ah apeisuh ua, Izipt gam ah hun sawtpi ka teng uhi, tualeh Izipt miten kou leh ka pu leh pate uh ahing genthei bawl mama uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa kunga ka kikou u’leh ka aw uh aza a, vansawlsieng ahing sawl a, Izipt gam a pat ahing puidoh ta hi, tualeh ngaivawi na gamgi ninga khopi khat Kadesh ah ka um uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hepitahin na gam tawnin hing pei sah in; loute ahiei, grep huonte ahiei lah ah ka pei sih ding ua, tuikhuh a tuite zong ka dawn sih ding uhi. Leengpa lamlien zuiin ka pei ding ua, na gamgi ka hen masansie uh zietlam ahiei, veilam ahiei ah zong ka kihei sih ding uhi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Edomin akungah, “Ka gam nang tot ding ahi sih, ahisihleh noute dou dingin namsau toh ka hing kuon ding hi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten akungah, “Lamlien zuiin ka pei ding uh, kou leh ka gantate un na tui kadawn ua ahileh aman ka’ng pe ding uh, kengin pei va ung in bangma bawl sih va ung,” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Nang pei thei sih ding uh” achi hi. Tuachi’n Edom ama dou dingin galkap thahat tahtah leh mipi tampi toh ahing kuonkhe ta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuabangin Edom in agam sunga Israel peisuoh ding aphal sih hi. Tuachi’n ama apat in Israel mite a kihem mangta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kadesh apat in apawtkhie ua, Israel mipite leh mipi kikhawm zousie Hor muol ah ahing tungta uhi.","title":"Hor muol a Aaron shina"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Edom gam zula um Hor muol ah Mosi leh Aaron ahoupi a,"},"24":{"text":"“Aaron pen achipite kunga pui ahita ding, Meribah tui mun a ka thupiehte kal a na hel ziehun, Israel tate kunga ka pieh gam ah alut sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Aaron leh atapa Eleazar Hor muol ah hing zawpi tou in:"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron puonsilte hohkhie’n len, atapa Eleazar silsahin, Aaron pen achipite kungah puitou in aumta dinga, tua mun ah ashi ding hi,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thupieh dungzuiin Mosi in abawla; mipi umkhawm zousie mitmu in Hor muol ah apeitouta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Aaron puonsilte ahohkhiet pieh a, atapa Eleazar asilsahta hi; tualeh Aaron tua muolvum ah ashita hi. Tuachin Mosi leh Eliazar khu muol a kipat in ahing kumsuhta uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 29.29; Kisim. 33.38; Danp. 10.6"},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi umkhawm zousie in Aaron ashita chi athei un, Israel innkuon mi zousie in ni sawmthum sung Aaron asuun uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n simlam a teng Kanaan mi Arad leengpa’n Israel tate Atarim lampi ah ahing pei uh chi azah in Israel tate anadouta hi, tuachi’n mi pawlkhat sal in amanta hi.","title":"Israelten Kanaan mite azawna uh","ref":"Kisim. 33.40"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten Mangpa kungah thuchiem abawl ua, “Tam mite ka khut ua na hing pieh pouma leh akhopite uh ka susietpieh sieng ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Israel tate aw angaikhiet pieh a, Kanaan mite akhut uah apekheta hi, Tualeh Israelten amaute leh akhopite uh asusegam sieng uhi, tuaziehin tua mun khu Hormah akichi ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute Hor muol a kipat in tuipi san lam zuon in Edom gam kimkot a pei dingin akipankheta uhi; tualeh lampi ah mipite alungke mama uhi.","ref":"Danp. 2.1"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh mipiten Mosi leh Pasian phin in, “Bang dinga gamdai a shi dinga, Izipt gam a kipata na hing puidoh ahiei? Tanghou lah umlou, tui lah umlou, tami pannabei tanghou ka hinna un achimtaah gawpta hi,” achi uhi.","title":"Mosi’n sum-eng gul akhaina","ref":"1 Kor. 10.9"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n mipite lah ah gul gusuate ahing sawl a, mite atu ua, Israel mipite tampi ashi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin mipite Mosi kungah ahing pei ua, akungah, “Nangma leh Mangpa douna thu kana gen tahzieh un sil ka bawlkhielta uhi, kalah uapat gulte lahdoh dingin Mangpa kungah ngen in” achi ua; tuachi’n Mosi in mipite adingin thu anget pieh ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah “Gul gusuachi khat lim bawl inlen khuom dawn ah khai in tualeh hichi ahing hi dinga, koi hinanleh gul tuh pouma in tuakhu a et leh adam ding,” a chi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in sum-eng in gul abawl a khuom dawn ah akhai a, tualeh hichi ahing hi a, gul tuh mi pouma in tua sum-eng gul lim a et u’leh a dam zel uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 18.4; Jn. 3.14"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate apei zel ua, Oboth munah giehphuol abawl uhi.","title":"Moab gam kimvel a Israelte peina"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Oboth a kipat apei kia ua, nisuonalam a Moab gamdai bul Iye-barim mun ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuana kipat in apei kia ua, Zared phaijang ah giehphuol asat uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuana kipat in apei kia ua, Amonmite gamgi akipat a hing dawh tuom gamdai a um Arnon lelampangah giehphuol abawl ua, Arnon khu Moab mite gamgi ahia, Moab mite leh Amor mite kikaal a um ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa galdouna laibu ah “Suphah a um waheb Arnon luita guomte."},"15":{"text":"Ar tenna a luongsuh luitate tui, Moab gamgi zul a, Arnon luita guom ah akinga hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tuana kipat in Beer ah apei kia ua, khum khu Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Mipite hankhawm inlen, tui ka pe ding,” achina tuikhuh mun khu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel ten tami la asa uhi, “Aw tuikhuh hing luongkhie inlen, zailan awi un."},"18":{"text":"Leng tapate leh mipi lamkaite leh, Dansiem miten alal chieng utoh atawdoh uh tuikhuh, chi’n la asa uhi.” Tualeh gamdai a kipat in Matanah lam zuonin apeita uhi."},"19":{"text":"Matanah akipat in Nahaliel ah, Nahaliel apat in Bamoth ah:"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Bamoth akipat in, Moab phaijang leh gamdai kimu suh theina, Pisgah muolvum ahing tungta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten Amormite leengpa Sihon kungah thangkou asawl ua.","title":"Israel in Sihon leengpa azawna"},"22":{"text":"“Na gamsung tawnin in hing pei suoh sah in, loute ahiei, grephuonte ahiei ah lam piel sih va ung, tuikul a tuite zong ka dawn sih ding uhi, na gamsung uh ka kantan masang sie uh leengpa lamlien zuiin ka pei ding uh,” achisah hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh Sihon in Israelte agamsung tawn a apei ding uh aphal sih hi: tuachi’n Sihon in amipite zousie ahankhawma, gamdai ah Israel dou dingin akuon a, Jahaz mun ahing tunga, Israelte toh akidouta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelten Sihon khu namsau hiemtah in athat ua azouta uhi, tuachi’n agam khu Arnon apat in Jabbok tan, Ammon mite gam dongin, Ammon mite gamgi khu kulpi a ki-im ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten tam khopite zousie ala ua; tuachi’n Heshbon gamsunga Amormite khopi zousie sungah ateng ua, akhota zousie uah zong ateng uhi."},"26":{"text":"Heshbon khu Amormite leengpa Sihon khopi ahia, Aman Moab gam leeng masapa akidoupi a akhut a pat agam zousie alah pieh a, Arnon tandongin alah pieh ta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin laphuo siemten, “Heshbon ah hing pei unlen, Sihon khopi siemtha leh tunding hi hen."},"28":{"text":"Heshbon apat in mei apawtkhie a, Sihon khopi akipat in mei akuongdoh a, Moab a Ar akatumta. Arnon mun sanga mi liente.","ref":"Jer. 48.45,46"},"29":{"text":"Na tung uh agih hi, Moab, Suhmang na hita, Aw Kemosh mipite, Atapate khu taimang dingin, Atanute khu sal a pui dingin Amormite leengpa Sihon kungah."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute a kap ua, Heshbon suhsiet ahita, Debon dongin, Tuachi’n Nophah dongin ka sugam siengta uh, Medeba tan dongin.”"},"31":{"text":"Hichibangin Israelte, Amormite gamah ateng uhi.","title":"Israel in Bashan a Og azawna"},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi-in Jazer enkhe dingin mi asawl a, tuatah a, akhuote ala ua, tuana um Amormite adeldoh uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh akihei ua, Bashan lampi ah apeitou uhi. Tuachi’n Bashan leengpa Og amite zousie toh Israelte dou dingin Edrei mun ah ahing kuonta hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kung ah, “Ama giing sin ama leh amite zousie leh agam na khut ah ka hing pekheta hi. Heshbona teng Amorte leengpa Sihon tunga na bawl bang in atungah na bawl ding hi,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama leh atapate leh amite zousie hing khawi mawngmawng neilou in, amite zousie toh athatgam ua agam aluo pieh ta uhi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate apei zel ua, Jerikou zawn a Jordan suolam panga Moab phaijang ah giehphuol asat uhi.","title":"Moab leengpa Balak in Balaam achielna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Zippor tapa Balak in Israel miten Amormite abawl dan zousie uh athei a."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Moab miten Israelte agiing mama ua, atam mama ziehun; Moabte khu Israel tate ziehin azau mama ua, achimawta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Moab miten Midian upate kungah, “Tam mipiten bawngtal in gam lah a hampa amaitum bangin,” tu’n i kimvel ua mi zousie maitum sieng ding ahi uh achi uhi. Khum hunlaiin Zippor tapa Balak Moabmite leengpa ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin aman Beor tapa Balaam, Pethor a um kungah mi asawl a, (tua khu amite hahlesuonte gam a luong lui kunga um ahi) ama ava han a, akungah “Ngaiin Izipt gam a kipat a hing pawtdoh mihonpi a um ua, ngai in leitung zousie atuom suoh ua, Keima toh kigalsai in a um uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 31.8; 2 Pet. 2.15,16; Jud. 1.11"},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin hepitahin hing pei inlen tam mite hing gausap piehin, Kei a dingin ahat seng taluo uhi; ka zaw thei khah laizang ua, ka gam uapat ka deldoh thei khah u’leh; na guolzawl poumate guolzawl in a um ua, na samsiet poumate samsiet in a um uh chi ka thei hi,” chi dingin mi asawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Moab upate leh Midian upaten aisan manding tawi in apawtkhe ta ua, tualeh Balaam kungah ahing tung ua, Balak thu hahte akungah agen ua."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah “Tuzan vang tanah gieh unlen, Mangpa’n ang hil bangbangin na kung uah, thu kahing tut kia ding” achi hi. Tuachi’n Moab mi liente Belam kungah agieh ta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam kungah Pasian ahing pei a, “Na kunga mite koite ahi uoi?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam in Pasian kungah, “Zippor tapa Balak Moab leengpa’n ka kungah mi ahing sawl a,"},"11":{"text":"Ngaiin Izipt gam a kipata hing pei mipiten leitung zousie atuom suoh ua, hing pei inlen hing gausap piehin, amaute ka zaw-a, ka deldoh zou khah laizang leh chiin mi ahing sawl hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in Balaam kungah, “Akung ua nava haw ding ahi sih; tua mite zong na gausap ding ahi sih: amauh mi hamphate ahi uh” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam zingmawng in athou a, Balak miliente kungah, “Na gam lam uah peikia ta un, aziehpen Mangpa’n na kung ua haw ding ahing phal sih hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Moab miliente khu adingkhie ua, Balak kungah apei ua, “Balaam kou toh hing pei ding a ut sih hi,” achi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balak in milien tamsem, asang ua zatat um zaw sem asawlkia a."},"16":{"text":"Amaute Balaam kungah ahing tung ua, akung uah, “Zippor tapa Balak in tambangin achi hi; ka kunga nang pei ding bangmain hing dal sih heh."},"17":{"text":"Mi thupi tahin ka hing bawl dinga ka kunga na gen pouma ka bawl zel ding hi. Tuaziehin hepitahin hing pei inlen; tam mite hing gausap pieh mama mai in,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam in Balak mite adawnga, akung uah “Balak in dangka leh sana a inn dim hing pe ding hinanleh achinglou leh avaal bawl dingin Mangpa ka Pasian thu kal in ka gamta thei sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, Mangpa’n ka kunga bang ahiei agen nahlai ding ka theina dingin hepitahin tuzan zong tamnah ka kungah gieh un” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in Balaam kungah, zanlaiin ahing pei a, akungah “Mite nangma han dinga hing haw ahi u’leh, kisa inlen amaute toh peiin, hinanleh na kunga ka gente maimai na bawl ding ahi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam zingmawng in athoudoh a, asabiltung asiem a, Moab miliente toh apeikhawm ta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n ava pei ziehin Pasian alungthah mama ta a, tualeh alampi dal dingin, Mangpa vansawlsieng a lampi ah a dinga, amapen sabiltung tungah atuonga, asuohte ni zong ama toh azawhkhawm uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh sabiltung in Mangpa vansawlsieng lampi a ding amu a, akhutin namsau atawi a, tualeh sabiltung khu lampi apat apielkhie a, gam lah ah apei a tuachi’n Balaam in sabiltung khu lampi zuisah kia tum in azep a."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa vansawlsieng khu grep huon kikaal lampi khat ah adinga alelam tuoh ah grep huon iimna baang a um hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh sabiltungin vansawlsieng amu tahin baang ava phu a, tuachi’n Balaam keng khu bang toh anamdenta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa vansawlsieng khu apam deu ah apei a, zietlam leh veilam a kiheina ding umlouna mun kochih khat ah ana dingta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh sabiltungin Mangpa vansawlsieng amutahin, Balaam nuoi ah apua a; tuachi’n Balaam alungthah a, sabiltung khu chiengin ajep hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n sabiltung khu aham sah a, Balaam kungah, “Na tungah bang ka bawla ahiei? Thum vei tah na hing hichi zep?” a chi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Balaam in sabiltung kungah “Na hing simmaw ziehin ahi, namsau na tawita maleng ka hing satlum zouta ding hi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n sabiltungin Balaam kungah, “Nanga ka hi ni a kipat a tuni donga ka tunga na tuon zingna na sabiltung hilou ka hiei mah? Hichibangin na tungah ka bawl ngai amah?” Achi a, a man “bawl ngailou” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Balaam mit a suh vah pieh a, Mangpa vansawlsieng lampi a ding leh akhut a namsau dawsa tawi amuta a; tuachi’n akuun a, amai a leisu in akhupbohta hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa vansawlsiengin akungah, “Bangdinga na sabiltung thum vei zen na zep ahiei? Ngai in sietna bawl dinga ka hing mu ziehin nangma dal dingin ka hing pawtdoh ahi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n sabiltungin kei ahing mu a, thum vei zen kei apat akihei mang ahi. Kei apat a, kiheimanglou na hitaleh, ama that louin, nangma ka hing that zouta ding hi,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Balaam in Mangpa vansawlsieng kungah, “Sil ka bawlkhielta hi; aziehpen keima dal in lampi ah na ding chi ka thei sih hi. Tuaziehin tami na lung damna ahisihleh, ka kile kia mai ding hi,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa vansawlsieng in Balaam kungah, “Mite toh peiin: hinanleh na kunga ka gen bang banga na gen ding ahi,” achi hi, tuachi’n Balaam khu Balak mi liente toh azawh ta hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Balak in Belam ahing pei chi azahin gam ning tawpa Arnon gamgi a um Moab khopi khat ah ama dawn dingin akuonta hi.","title":"Balak leh Balaam"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Balak in Balaam kungah, “Phatuom ngaitahin Nangma han dingin mi ka hing sawl asiei mah? Bang dinga ka kung hing haw nuomlou na hiei? Mi thupi tahin hing bawl zoulou ding ka hiei mah?” a chi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam in Balak kungah, “En in na kungah kang hawta hi: tuin bang thu gen theina mawngmawng ka nei a ahiei mah? Pasian in ka kama thu akoite maimai ka gen ding ahi,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam, Balak toh azawhkhawm ta a Kirjath-huzoth mun ahing tung ua."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balak in bawngtal leh belam kithoi na’n alan a, Balaam leh akunga um miliente kungah ahalta hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n azing ni’n hichi ahing hi a, Balak in Balaam azawpi a, Baal mun sangte ah azawpi tou a, tua mun a kipat in mipite umna chieng chieng amu theina ding in."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam in Balak kungah, “Tam mun ah maitam sagi hing bawlpieh inlen, tualeh bawngtal sagi leh belamtal sagi hing suhtuo piehin,” achi hi.","title":"Balaam genlohna Masa"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Balak in Balaam gen bang in abawla, Balak leh Balaam in maitam chinteng tungah bawngtal khat leh belamtal khat alan uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Balaam in Balak kungah, “Na halmang sillat kungah ding inlen, kei kava pei tuom ding hi; Mangpa kei hing kimupi dingin ahing pei kha thei hi, tualeh ahing, theisah pouma kang hil ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n muol sang khat ah apeitou ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in Balaam akimupi a, tualeh aman akungah, “Maitam sagi ka bawla, maitam chinteng tungah bawngtal khat leh belamtal khat ka lanta hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Balaam kamah thu akoi a, Balak kungah “Kile kia inlen tam bangin va gen in,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Balaam khu Balak kungah ahing kile kia ta a, tualeh ngaivawi, ama leh Moab milien tengtoh halmang kithoina sillat kungah ana ding nalai uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman thu agen ta a, “Aram akipat in Moab leengpa Balak in suolam muol a kipat in ahing zawpi a, Hing pei inlen Jakob hing gausap piehin, Hing pei inlen Israel hing housie in achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Bangchin Pasian gausap loupi ka gausap thei diei? ahisihleh Pasian housiet loupi ken bangchi housiet ding ka hiei?"},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen Suongpi tungte akipat in ama ka mu a, muolte akipat in ama ka en hi: Ngaiin tam mite nam tuom ahi ua, nam dangte lah ah simtel ahi sih ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Koi ahiei Jakob leivui sim zou a, tualeh Israel se li suo sekhat sim zou ding? Midihtatte shi bangin ka shi dinga Katawpna khu ama a bang hileh,” achi ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balak in Balaam kungah, “Nang bawldanpi bangchidan ahiei? Ka melmate gausap dingin ka hing zawpi a, Ngai in bailamtahin na guolzawl zawta hi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam in adawnga, “Mangpa’n ka kam a akoi gen dinga ka pilvang ngeingei ding hi zawlouding amah?” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balak in akungah, “Hepitahin Mundang ah pei vai in, tuatah a pat in amaute na mu thei ding, a umna chieng chieng uh na mu thei dinga, a bawn un vang na mu sieng kholsih dinga; tuatah a kipat in hing gausap piehin,” achi hi.","title":"Balaam thu genlawh niveina"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Zophim lougam a Pisgah muol vum ah azawpi tou a, maitam sagi abawl a, maitam teng tungah bawngtal khat leh belamtal khat chiet alan hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh aman Balak kungah, “Pamlam a Mangpa kava ki houpi sungin, na halmang sillat kungah na ding khin-khian in,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Balaam ana kimupi a, akam ah thu akoi a, Balak kungah “Pei kia inlen, tuabang ma in gen in” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n akungah ahing pei a, Ngaiin ahalmang kithoina sillat kungah ana ding nalai a, Moab miliente zong akungah a um uhi, tuachi’n Balak in akungah, “Mangpa’n bang ana gen eile?” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman tam thute agenta hi: “Thou inlen Balak Ngaikhiein, Zippor tapa ka thu ngaikhie in."},"19":{"text":"Pasian khu zuouhat mihing ahisih a, Kisia pai mihing tapa zong ahi sih hi. Athugen bawl lou ding ahiei mah, Agensa atangtungsah sih ding amah?"},"20":{"text":"Ngaiin, guolzawl ding thupieh ka mu a, Aguol zou ahita hi, ka bawl lamdang thei sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Aman Jakob ah thulim louna amu sih a, Israel ah phengphitna amu vawt sih hi, Mangpa a Pasian akungah a um a, Lengpa pahtawina kikou husa a um hi."},"22":{"text":"Izipt akipat in Pasian in apuidoh a, Gam bawngtal thahatna anei hi."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen Jakob tungah bum-ngolna aum sih a; Israelte tungah dawi-aisanna a um sam sih hi: Tuin Jakob tungtang leh Israel tungtangah, Pasian in bang ahiei abawltaah, akichi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ngai in tam mipite khu humpibahneipi bangin athou a, humpibahnei lunlai bangin a ding doh ding a; asa mat aneh masangsie leh asa tha si adawn masangsie a lum sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Balak in Balaam kungah, “Amaute, gausap sinlen, guol zong guolzawl sin,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh Balaam in adawnga, Balak kungah, “Mangpa’n agen zousie ka bawl ding ahi chi ka hing hil sih amah?” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Balak in Balaam kungah, “Hepi tahin hing zui inlen mun dang khat ah ka hing zawpi ding: tua mun akipat in amaute na hing gausap pieh Pasian in aphal kha maw sih ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Balaam genlawhna thum veina"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balak in Balaam khu Peor muol vum a senel gam etsuhna ah azawpita hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam in Balak kungah, “Tam munah maitam sagi hing bawl pieh inlen bawngtal sagi leh belamtal sagi hing suhtuo piehin,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Balak in Balaam gen bangin abawla, maitam teng tungah bawngtal khat chiet leh belamtal khat chiet alanta hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam in Israelte guolzawlpieh khu Pasian lungdamna ahi chi amutah in, nidanga abawl bangin aisan na bawl dingin apei sih a, gamdai lam azuon zawta hi.","title":"Balaam thugenlawh nukhiate leh Balak peina"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Balaam adahdoh leh Israel mite amauh aphung dungzui chiet ua giehphuol ua um amu a, Pasian Hagau atungah ahing tung hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman tam thute agenta hi, “Beor tapa Balaam in thu agen a, amit suhvah pieha umpa’n agen hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian thute za a, Bangkimbawlthei kilahna mu a, khupboh a pua a mit hing vahpa thugen:"},"5":{"text":"Na puon innte kilawm hina e Aw Jakob! Na biehbuhte Aw Israel."},"6":{"text":"Phaijang bangin akipha diem duoma, lui gei a huonte bang ahia, Mangpa’n asuonsa aloe singkung bang ahia; Tui gei a Sidar sing bang ahi uh."},"7":{"text":"Atui bel apat tui asungkhe dinga, Tuitamna mun ah haichite achiing dinga, Aleengpa Agag sangin athupi zaw ding a, Aleenggam khu pahtawi in a um ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian in Izipt apat in apuidoh a, Gam bawngtal thahatna bang anei hi, Amelma namdangte ane tum ding a, Aman agute uh ahieh guoipieh dinga, Athal tang un akap pailet ding hi."},"9":{"text":"A kun a humpibahnei bangin alum a, Tualeh humpibahnei bang maiin; Koi ahiei ama phong ngamding? Nangma hing guolzawl pouma, Guolzawl in um henlen, Nangma hing gausap pouma, gausap in umta heh,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 49.9; Siem. 12.3"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam tungah Balak alungthah mama ta a, akhutte gel atum a, Balak in Balaam kungah, “Ka melmate gausap dingin ka hing han a, tuin Ngai in thum vei vingveng na guolzawl zawta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin na umna mun ah taimangin: thupitah a hing tawisang ding ka hingchi na hi a, hinanleh ngaiin Mangpa’n pahtawi a na um ding ahing dalta hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Balaam in Balak kungah, “Ka kunga na hing sawl thangkoute kungah zong kana gen sih amah?"},"13":{"text":"Balak in a inn dim dangka leh sana hing pe ding hinanleh keima thua ahoilam ahiei, aselam ahiei bawl dingin Mangpa thupieh ka palsan thei sih ding hi. Mangpa’n agen pouma ka gen ding ahi, achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh tuin ngaiin, ka mite kunga peiding ka hita: tuaziehin hing pei inlen, ni nukhia lam chienga tam miten, na mite tunga abawl ding uh ka hing hil ding hi,” a chi hi.","title":"Balaam thugenlawh lina"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman tam thute agen ta hi: “Beor tapa Balaam, mit vah sah a um pa’n thu agen hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasian thute za a, Tungnung pen bangkimbawlthei pa kilaahna mu a, khupboh a pua a, mit hing vah tain:"},"17":{"text":"Ama ka mu ding, tuin vang hilouin, ama ka en a nainou khat vang hilouin, Jakob akipat Aasi khat ahing suoh dinga, Israel akipat in lalchieng khat ahing dingkhe dinga, Moab gamsung asun pailet dinga Sheth tate zousie asumangthai ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Edom khu atan ahita dinga, Seir zong amelmate tan ahita ding hi, Israel in hangsan tahin abawl ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Jakob akipat in gam uhpa ding ahing pieng dinga, tualeh khopi sunga um sun teng akisumang sieng ding hi,” a chi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Amalek lam a en a, tam thu a gen hi. “Amalek khu namte bulpipen ahi na a, Hinanleh a dawnlam manthaina ahi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Ken lam a en a, thu agen a, “Na umna mun adet hi, na bu suongpi tungah na sep hi."},"22":{"text":"Bangtenghileh Kenmite khu Assiria sal a ahing puimang masangsie’n suh mangthai in a um ding hi.”"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh aman tam thu agenkia a, “Kadeisei! Pasian in tambanga sil abawl leh, koita ahing zou diei?"},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Kittim gam akipat tembawhte a hing. Tung dinga. Asshur leh Eber asugenthei ding ua, Tualeh ama zong amangthai ding hi;” achita hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Balaam a thoukhie a inn langah apei kiata hi; tualeh Balak zong a inn langah akipeita hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte Shittim ah a um ua, tualeh mipiten Moab tanute toh angkawmna khelna ahing bawl panta uhi.","title":"Peor mun a Israel in Baal abiehna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh amauten a pasiente u’kunga akithoinate uah achiel ua, tuachi’n annte aneh pi ua, apasiente uh bie in amasangah abohkhupta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelten Baal-Peor azopta ua, tualeh Mangpa lungthahna khu Israelte tungah ahing kuongkhe ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Mipite lamkai zousie zawpi inlen. Mangpa lungthahna zauhuoi tah mai Israelte tunga kipata akikhimmang theina dingin sun nisa vah nuoi a Mangpa masangah khailia siengin,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Israel thukhen vaihawmte kungah, “Michin in Baal-peor toh kizopna nei na mite uh that sieng un achita hi.”"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh ngaiin, Israeltate lah a khat in, kimutuona biehbuh kot phunga akaa laitah un Mosi mitmu leh Israel mipi kikhawmte mitmu in Midian numei khat a unaute kungah ahing zawpi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh siempu Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in amutahin mipi lah akipat in adingdoh a, akhut in teipi khat ala hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Israel pasalpa khu biehbuh sungah adellut a, Israel pasalpa leh numeinu khu ani ua agilpi uah asun pailet a. Tuachi’n Israel mite lah a natpi khu athengta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh tambang natpi a shite khu tul sawmni leh tul li ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupia, akungah,"},"11":{"text":"“Siempu Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in ka thangsietna banga alah ua athangpainain ka lungthahna Israel tate lah akipat a khinkheta hi, tuachi’n ka lungthahna ziehin Israel tate ka sumang nawn sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ngaiin kilemna thuhun atungah ka hung ding a;"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh ama leh anua a, ahahasuonte dingin kumtawnna siempu hina thuhun ahi dinga, a Pasian thangsietna khu athangsietpi zieh leh Israel tate ding a, kilemna abawlpieh zieh in, chiin,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Israel pasal Midian numeinu khat toh athapa uh min khu Salu tapa Zimri ahia, Simeon phung sunga azungpipa uh ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Midian numei atha uh min khu Zur tanu Kozbi ahia, Midiante phung khat sunga upa khat ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupia, akungah"},"17":{"text":"“Midian mite khu sumangbang unlen, that gam sieng un."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun zong Peor zieha natpi tun nia kithat a sanggamnu uh Midian lamkai khat tanu Kozbi tungtang leh Peor mun a thu piengte ziehin khelpil tah in ahing sumangbang uhi.”"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh gawtna aven nuain hichi ahing hi a, Mangpa’n Mosi leh siempu Aaron tapa Eleazar ahoupi a,","title":"Israel khangthate kisimna","ref":"Kisim. 1.1-46"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mipi kikhawmte zousie kum sawmni apat atunglam teng, aphung aphung un, Israel gam a gal kuon thei ding zousie sim in,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh siempu Eleazar in Moab phaijang a, Jordan gei a Jerikou kungah amaute ahoupi ua;"},"4":{"text":"“Mipite kum sawmni apat atunglam teng sim un,” Mangpa’n Mosi leh Izipt gam a kipata hing pawtdoh Israel tate thu apieh bangin, achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Reuben Israel ta upa pen: Reuben tate Hanok phung kipatna Hanok mite, Pallu akipat Pallu mite inn kuon."},"6":{"text":"Hezron akipat Hezron mite innkuon, Karmi apat Karmi mite innkuon,"},"7":{"text":"Tamte khu Reuben mite innkuonte ahi uhi, akisim zousie tul sawmli leh tul thum leh za sagi leh sawmthum ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Pallu tapa Eliab ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Eliab tate, Nemuel, Dathan leh Abiramte ahi uhi, tamte khu Mangpa aphin lai ua Korah toh kithuo a, Mosi leh Aaron kal a mipi kikhawmte lah a tel ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh tua mi pawlte ashi lai un, lei in akam akah lai in Korahte toh avaltum khawm a, mei in zani leh sawm nga akahtum laiin: Tuachi’n chiemtena ahing hita uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Korah tate ashi sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"A innkuon dungzui ua, Simeon tapate. Nemuel tapate: Nemuel apat Nemuel mite: Jamin apat Jemin mite: Jakin apat Jakinmite."},"13":{"text":"Jerah apat Jerahmite, Shaul apat Shaulmite,"},"14":{"text":"Tamte khu Simeon innkuon hahlesuonte ahi ua, tul sawmni leh tul ni leh zani ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"A innkuon dungzui ua Gad tapate: Zephon apat Jephonmite, Haggi apat Haggimite, Shuni apat Shunimite;"},"16":{"text":"Ozni apat Oznimite, Eri apat Erimite."},"17":{"text":"Arod apat Arodmite, Areli apat Arelimite;"},"18":{"text":"Tamte khu Gad tate hahlesuonte ahi uhi. Akisim na uh dungzuiin, tul sawmli leh zanga ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Juda tapate khu Er leh Onan ahi ua, Er leh Onan khu Kanaan gamah ashita uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh a innkuon bang dungzui ua Juda tapate khu Shelah apat Shelahmite innkuon, Perez apat Perezmite innkuon, Zerah apat Zerahmite innkuon;"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Pharez tapate khu Hezron apat Hezronmite innkuon, Hamul apat Hamulmite innkuon ahi uh."},"22":{"text":"Tamte Juda innkuonte ahi uhi, akisimna uh dungzuiin tul sawm sagi leh tul guh leh za nga ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"A innkuon bang dungzui ua, Issakar tapate khu Tola apat Tolamite, innkuon, Pua apat Puamite innkuon."},"24":{"text":"Jashub apat Jashubmite, innkuon, Shimron apat Shimronmite innkuon."},"25":{"text":"Tamte khu Issakar innkuonte akisimna uh dungzuiin tul sawmguh leh tul li leh zathum ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"A innkuon bang dungzui ua Zebulun tapate khu Sered apat Seredmite innkuon, Elon apat Elonmite innkuon, Zahlel apat Zahlelmite innkuon;"},"27":{"text":"Tamte khu Zebulun innkuonte akisimna uh dungzuiin tul sawmguh leh za nga ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"A innkuon bang dungzui ua Joseph tapate khu Manasseh leh Ephraim ahi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Manasseh tapate ahileh Makir apat Makirmite innkuon tualeh Makir in Gilead ahinga, Gilead apat Gileadmite innkuon ahi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tamte khu Gilead tapate ahi uhi, Jeezer apat Jeezermite innkuon, Helek apat Helekmite innkuon."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Asriel apat Asrielmite innkuon, Shekem apat Shekemmite innkuon;"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Shemida apat Shemidamite innkuon, Hepher apat Hephermite innkuon;"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Hepher tapa Zelophehad in tapa anei sih a, Hinanleh tanute anei hi. Tualeh Zelophehad tanute min khu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah tualeh Tirzah ahi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tamte khu Manasseh innkuonte ahi ua, akisim dan dungzuiin, tul sawmnga leh tul ni leh za sagi ahi uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tamte khu a innkuon bang dungzui ua, Ephraim tapate ahi uhi, Shuthelah apat Shuthelahmite innkuon, Becher apat Bechermite innkuon, Tahan apat Tahanmite innkuon."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu Shuthelah tapate ahi uhi; Eran apat Eranmite innkuon;"},"37":{"text":"Tamte khu Ephraim tapate innkuon ahi ua, akisimna uh dungzuiin tul sawm thum leh tul ni leh za nga ahi uhi. Tamte khu a innkuon dungzui a, Joseph tapate ahi uhi."},"38":{"text":"A innkuon uh dung zui a, Benjamin tapate, Bela apat Belamite, innkuon, Ashbel apat Ashbel mite innkuon Ahiram apat Ahirammite innkuon."},"39":{"text":"Shupham apat Shuphammite innkuon, Hupham apat Huphammite innkuon."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh Bela tapate khu Ard leh Naaman ahi uhi. Ard apat Ardmite innkuon, Naaman apat Naamanmite innkuon."},"41":{"text":"Tamte a innkuon bang dungzui ua Benjamin tapate ahi uhi. Tualeh amaute kisimna dungzuiin tul sawmli leh tul nga leh za guh ahi uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tamte khu a innkuon uh dungzuiin Dan tapate ahi uhi. Shuham apat Shuhammite innkuon; Tamte khu a innkuon uh dungzuiin Dan innkuonte ahi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Shuhammite innkuonte zousie akisimna dungzuiin tul sawm guh leh tul li leh zali ahi uhi."},"44":{"text":"Asher tapate a innkuon uh dungzui in Jimna apat Jimnamite innkuon, Jesui apat Jesuimite innkuon, Beriah apat Beriahmite innkuon;"},"45":{"text":"Beriah tapate ahileh Heber apat Hebermite innkuon, Malkiel apat Malkielmite innkuon;"},"46":{"text":"Tualeh Asher tanu min khu Sarah ahi."},"47":{"text":"Tamte khu a innkuon bang dungzui ua, Asher tapate ahi uhi, akisimna dungzui un, tul sawm nga leh tul thum leh zali ahi uhi."},"48":{"text":"Naphtali tapate a innkuon uh dungzuiin, Jahzeel apat Jahzeelmite innkuon Guni apat Gunimite innkuon."},"49":{"text":"Jezer apat Jezermite innkuon: Shillem apat Shillemmite innkuon;"},"50":{"text":"Tamte khu a innkuon uh dungzuiin, Naphtali innkuonte ahi uhi; akisimna dungzui un tul sawmli leh tul nga leh za sagi leh sawmli ahi uhi."},"51":{"text":"Tamte khu Israel tate kisim teng ahi ua, tul za guh leh tul khat leh zasagi leh sawmthum ahi uhi."},"52":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah,","title":"Gam kihawm dan","ref":"Kisim. 34.13; Josh. 14.1,2"},"53":{"text":"“Tamte kungah gam khu agoutan ding ua amin phaza dungzui ua hawmpieh ahi ding hi."},"54":{"text":"A phung tamte kungah goutan lien na pe dinga, a phung tawmte kungah goutan neudeu nape ding hi, mi chin kungah akisim bang dungzuiin atan ding chiet uh na pe ding hi."},"55":{"text":"Hinanleh gam khu aisan a hawm ding ahi. Apute uh phung min dungzuiin gam khu atang ding uhi."},"56":{"text":"Aisan dungzuiin gam tan khu atam leh atawmte kunga hawm ahi ding hi.”"},"57":{"text":"Tamte khu a innkuon uh dungzui a, Levimi kisimte ahi uhi. Gershon apat Gershonmite innkuon, Kohath apat Kohathmite innkuon, Merari apat Merarimite innkuon."},"58":{"text":"Tamte khu Levimite innkuon ahi uhi. Libnimite innkuon, Hebron mite innkuon, Mahlimite innkuon, Mushimite innkuon, Korathmite innkuon. Tualeh Kohath in Amram ahing hi."},"59":{"text":"Tualeh Amram zi min khu Jokebed Levi tanu ahia, Izipt gam a Levi lah a pieng ahia, Amanu’n Amram dingin Aaron, Mosi leh asanggamnu Miriam ahin pieh hi."},"60":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron in Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahing hi.","ref":"Kisim. 3.2"},"61":{"text":"Nadab leh Abihu in Mangpa masanga mei sienglou a lat lai un ashita uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 10.1,2; Kisim. 3.4"},"62":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama ulah a akisim zousie pasal ha khat apat atung lam teng tul sawmni leh tul thum ahi uhi. Israel mite leh gam kihawm tanglou ding ahi zieh un, Israel tate lah a simtel ahi sih uhi."},"63":{"text":"Tamte khu Jerikou kunga Jordan gei a, Moab phaijanga Israel tate simpa Mosi leh siempu Eleazar in asimte ahi uhi."},"64":{"text":"Hinanleh Sinai gamdai a, Israel tate Mosi leh siempu Aaron in asimte lah ua khat zong a um, a um non sih uhi."},"65":{"text":"Aziehpen “Mangpa’n gamdai ah ashigam ngei ngei ding uh ahi ana chi sa ahi ta hi,” Jephune tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua chilou koima adam a um non sih uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 14.26-35"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph tapa Manasseh phung sunga mi Manasseh tapa, Makir tapa Gilead tapa, Hepher tapa Zelophehad tanute ahing pei ua, tamte atanute min ahi, Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah Milkah leh Tirzah.","title":"Gam hawm dan"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh amaute kimutuona biehbuh mai ah Mosi leh siempu Eleazar leh miliente leh mipi kikhawmte zousie masangah ading ua."},"3":{"text":"“Ka pa uh gamdai ah ashita a, Mangpa tung a hel dinga kikhawm Korah pawlte lah ah apang sih a, hinanleh ama khelna ziehin ashi a, tapa anei sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Bang dinga tapa aneilou zieha ka pa uh min a innkuonte lah apat phietmanga um ding ahiei mah? Tuaziehin ka pa uh sanggamte lah ah tanvou ding hing pie un,” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in athu uh Mangpa masangah atun ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,"},"7":{"text":"“Zelophehad tanute thugen adih ahi, amaute apa uh unaute lah ah goutan na bawl pieh ding a apa uh goutan khu amaute na pieh sawn ding ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 36.2"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate kungah, Mi tapa neilou a ashi leh agou atanute na pieh ding uh ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tanu anei sih leh agou asanggam pasalte kungah na pe ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachia sanggam pasal anei sih leh agou khu apa unau pasalte kungah na pe ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Apa’n sanggam pasal anei sih leh agou khu a innkuonte lah a akinaipipen na pe ding a; aman atang ding hi. Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu apieh bang in Israel mite dingin dan leh thupieh a umden ding ahi,” achita hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Abarim muolvum ah kaltou inlen Israel tate kunga ka pieh gam khu va en in.","title":"Mosi thaheng dingin Joshua guot in aum","ref":"Danp. 3.23-27; 32.48-52"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Na va et zou chiengin na sanggampa Aaron bangin, nang zong na mipite toh puikhawm in na umta ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Zin gamdai a mipi kikhawmte a phun lai ua, amit mu ua, tui a Kei hing pahtawi dinga, ka hing thupieh kal a na hel zieh ahi;” tuakhu Zin gamdai a, Kadesh a Meribah tuite ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Mangpa ahoupi a;"},"16":{"text":"“Mangpa tahsa hagau zousie Pasian in mipi kikhawmte tunga um dingin mikhat guot heh;"},"17":{"text":"Mangpa mipi kikhawmte ching ding neilou belam hon bang ahilouna dingun, amaute puidoh a, tualeh puilut dingin,” achi hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 22.17; Ezek. 34.5; Mat. 9.36; Mak. 6.34"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kungah “Nun tapa Joshua mi lungsim neitah zawpi inlen atungah na khut ngam in.","ref":"Pawt. 24.13"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh ama khu siempu Eleazar leh mipi kikhawmte zousie masangah dingsah inlen amit mu uah thu neina pie in."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Israel mipi kikhawm zousieten athu azui theina dingun, atungah na thuneina khenkhat pie in."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama siempu Eleazar masangah ading dinga, aman Mangpa masangah Urim thukhenna in thu adong ding hi; ama thu in apawtdoh ding ua, ama thu main alut ding uhi, ama leh Israel mipi kikhawmte zousie,” achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 28.30; 1 Sam. 14.41; 28.6"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Mangpa’n thu apieh bangin abawl a Joshua azawpi a, siempu Eleazar leh mipi kikhawmte masang ah adingsah a:"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh atungah akhut angama, Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin thuneina apeta hi.","ref":"Danp. 31.23"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Kithoi na sillat ding dante"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate thu pie inlen, akung uah genin, kei a dinga gimnamtui dinga mei a sillat kithoina ding ka sillat leh ann khu ahun chiet uah ka kungah nalan zel ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh akung uah tami mei a sillat Mangpa kunga na sillat ding uh ahi: belamnou atal kum khat a upa, gensietbei nichin in ni, halmang sillat a lat gige ding in, gen in, achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Belamnou khat pen zingmawng lam in lan inlen, a dang khatpen nitah lam chienga na lat ding ahi.","title":"Nisima sillat ding"},"5":{"text":"Ann sillat dingin tangbuong nel ephah sesawm suo sekhat, sathau kihehsa hin se li suo sekhat toh kihal."},"6":{"text":"Tami Mangpa dinga gimnamtui dinga, mei a sillat kithoina, Sinai muol a kiguotsa bawlzom zing ding halmang sillat ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh dawn sillat pen belamnou khat a dingin hin seli suo sekhat ahi dinga; Mangpa dinga dawn sillat uoin chia khu mun siengthou a na buohsuh ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Belamnou khat pen nitahlam chiengin na lan ding hi; zingmawnga ann sillat leh dawn sillat bangin mei a sillat Mangpa dinga gimnamtui na lan ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tualeh khawlni in kum khat a upa nuolnabei belamnou ni leh ann sillat dingin tangbuong nelte ephah sesawm suo seni sathau toh kihal leh tua dawn sillat toh na lat ding ahi.","title":"Khawlni a sillat dingte"},"10":{"text":"Tam khawlni china halmang sillat, lat ngitnget leh khum dawn sillat simlou a, halmang sillat lat ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"“Na ha tha tengun Mangpa adingin halmang sillat na lan ding ua, bawngtal tuoi ni leh belam tal khat, belamnou melhemlou kum khat a upa sagi.","title":"Ha tha sillat"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh bawngtal khat chiet adingin ann sillat dingin tangbuong nel ephah sesawm suo sethum, sathau toh kihal, tualeh belamtal khat a dingin ann sillat dingin tangbuong nel ephah sesawm suo seni sathau toh kihal ahi ding."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh belamnou khat chiet ah ann sillat a dingin tangbuong nel sathau toh kihal ephah sesawm suo sekhat, tami halmang sillat gimnamtui Mangpa adinga mei a sillat ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh a dawn sillatte ukhu bawngtal khat adingin uoin hin kim khat ahi dinga, belamtal khat adingin hin se thum suo sekhat, tualeh belamnou khat a dingin hin seli suo sekhat, tamte kum khat sunga ha chin a halmang dingte khu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh keltal khat zong, Mangpa kunga khelna kithoina sillat a na lat ding ahi; dawn sillat leh tawplou a sillat dingte simlou in."},"16":{"text":"“Tualeh ha khatna ni sawm leh li ni khu Mangpa peikan pawi a hi.","title":"Tanghou tolsawlou pawi a lat ding","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-13; Danp. 16.1,2"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh tami ha ni sawm leh nga ni khu annkuongluini ahia; ni sagi sung tanghou tolsawlou na neh ding uh ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.14-20; 23.15; 34.18; Danp. 16.3-8"},"18":{"text":"Ni khat niin khawmpi siengthou a um dinga; nna mawngmawng na sep ding uh ahi sih."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa dinga halmang sillat dingin mei a kithoina sillat na lan ding uhi, bawngtal tuoi ni leh belamtal khat leh belamnou kum khat a upa sagi, tuate khu nuolnabei ahi ding chi na thei ding uh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh a ann sillatte ukhu tangbuong sathau toh kihal ahi ding hi, bawngtal khat adingin ephah sesawm suo sethum leh belamtal khat a dingin Ephah se sawm suo seni ahi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Belamnou sagite adingin ephah se sawm suo sekhat chiet ahi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh nouma dingin kilem na bawlna dinga khelna sillat dingin keltal khat."},"23":{"text":"Tamte khu zingmawng a halmang sillat, tawplou a lat ding halmang sillat simlou a na lat ding uh ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tambangmain Mangpa dinga gimnamtui mei a sillat neh ding nichin in, ni sagi sung na lat ding uh ahi; tawplou a halmang sillat leh dawn sillat simlou in, na lan ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh ni sagi niin khawmpi siengthou na nei ding ua, nna mawngmawng na sep lou ding uh ahi."},"26":{"text":"“Tualeh na nipikal pawi u’leh na ga masa pawi ni chieng ua, Mangpa dinga ann tha sillat haithate na hing lat ni chieng un zong khawmpi siengthou na nei ding ua; nna nasep ding uh ahisih hi.","title":"Ga masate","ref":"Pawt. 23.16; 34.22; Danp. 16.9-12"},"27":{"text":"Mangpa dinga gimnamtui halmang sillat na lan ding uhi; bawngtal tuoi ni, belamtal khat, belamnou kum khat a upa sagi."},"28":{"text":"A ann sillat uh, tangbuong neel sathau toh kihal, bawngtal khat chiet adingin ephah se sawm suo sethum belamtal khat chiet adingin ephah se sawmsuo se ni."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh belamnou teng adingin ephah sesawm suo sekhat chiet."},"30":{"text":"Nouma dinga kilemna bawlna dingin keltal nou khat zong na lat ding uh ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ann sillat leh akilan zomzing halmang sillat chilou, dawn sillat toh na lan khawm ding uhi, na sillatte uh nuolnabei ahi ding uh, chi thei un."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh Ha sagina ani khat niin khawmpi siengthou na bawl ding uh ahi, nna nasep ding uh ahi sih hi. Nouma dinga pengkul mutni ahi ding hi.","title":"Pengkul pawi"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa kungah gimnamtui halmang sillat na lan ding ua, bawngtal tuoi khat, belamtal khat, belamnou atal kum khat a upa sagi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh a ann sillat ua dingin tangbuong nel sathau toh kihal, bawngtal adingin ephah khat sesawm suo sethum, belamtal adingin sesawm suo seni;"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh belamnou sagite khat chiet adingin ephah khat sesawm suo sekhat."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh nouma adinga kilemna bawlna dingin khelna sillat dingin keltal nou khat."},"6":{"text":"Tamteng ban ah, ha tha halmang sillat leh ann sillat, nichin halmang sillat leh ann sillat leh a dawn sillatte uh thupieh dan dungzui in Mangpa dinga gimnamtui dinga mei a sillate simlou in."},"7":{"text":"“Tualeh aha sagina ni sawmni in khawmpi siengthou na nei ding uhi, tualeh na hinna uh na sugim ding ua, tua hun sungin nna mawngmawng nasep lou ding uh ahi.","title":"Kilemna silbawlni","ref":"Siempu. 16.29-34"},"8":{"text":"Mangpa kungah gimnamtui halmang sillat na lat ding uh ahi, bawngtal tuoi khat belamtal khat tualeh kum khat a upa belamnou sagi, tuate nuolnabei ahi ngei ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"A ann sillat uh, tangbuong nel sathau toh kihalsa bawngtal khat a dingin ephah khat sesawm suo sethum tualeh belamtal khat adingin ephah sesawm suo seni."},"10":{"text":"Belamnou sagite dingin, ephah sesawm suo sekhat chiet."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n kilemna bawlna dinga khelna sillat, tualeh tawplou a halmang sillat leh ann sillat leh dawn sillatte ban ah khelna sillat dingin keltal khat zong na lat ding uh ahi."},"12":{"text":"“Tualeh aha sagina ni sawm leh nga niin, khawmpi siengthou na nei ding ua; nna mawngmawng na sem sih ding uhi, tualeh Mangpa dingin ni sagi sung pawi na mang ding uhi.","title":"Biehbuh pawite","ref":"Siempu. 23.34; Danp. 16.13-15"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa dinga gimnamtui mei a kithoina halmang sillat na lat ding uh ahi, bawngtal tuoi sawm leh thum, belamtal ni, tualeh belamnou kum khat a upa sawm leh li, gensietbei chiet ahi ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh a ann sillat uh, tangbuong nel sathau toh kihal khawm ahiding, bawngtal sawm leh thum, bawngtal khat chiet adingin ephah khat se sawm suo sethum, belamtal khat chiet a dingin sesawm suo seni."},"15":{"text":"Belam nou sawm leh li, belamnou khat adingin sesawm suo sekhat chiet."},"16":{"text":"Tawplou a halmang sillat, ann sillat leh dawn sillatte simlou in khelna kithoina sillat dingin keltal khat zong na lat ding uh ahi."},"17":{"text":"“Ani ni niin bawngtal tuoi sawm leh ni, belamtal ni, belamnou kum khat a upa nuolnabei sawm leh li na lan ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Danpieh dungzuiin, atam leh tawm dan un bawngtalte, belamtalte leh belamnoute toh lat khawm dingin, ann sillat leh dawn sillat zong ahi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh akizom a halmang sillat, a ann sillat, a dawn sillalte uh simlou in khelna sillat dingin keltal khat zong na lat ding uh ahi."},"20":{"text":"“Ani thum ni chiengin, bawngtal sawm leh khat, belamtal ni, belamnou kum khat a upa nuolnabei sawm leh li;"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh danpieh dungzui in atam leh tawm dan un bawngtalte, belamtalte leh belamnoute toh lat khawm dingin, ann sillat leh dawn sillatte zong ahi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh halmang sillat, ann sillat leh dawn sillat simlou in keltal khat zong khelna sillat dingin na lan ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"“Ani li niin bawngtal sawm, belamtal ni, belamnou kum khat a upa nuolnabei sawm leh li."},"24":{"text":"Dan pieh dungzuiin, atam leh tawm dan un bawngtalte belamtalte leh belamnoute toh lat khawm dingin ann sillat leh dawn sillatte zong ahi ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tawplou a halmang sillat, ann sillat leh dawn sillat na lat uh simlou in keltal khat khelna sillat dinga na lat ding uh ahi."},"26":{"text":"“Ani nga niin, bawngtal kuo, belamtal ni, belamnou kum khat a upa, nuolnabei sawm leh li."},"27":{"text":"Danpieh dungzuiin atam leh tawm dan un bawngtalte, belamtalte leh belamnou toh lat khawm dingin, ann sillat leh dawnding sillat zong ahi ding hi;"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh tawplou a halmang sillat, ann sillat leh dawn sillat simlou in, keltal khat khelna sillat a na lat ding uh, ahi."},"29":{"text":"“Ani guh niin, bawngtal giet, belamtal ni, belamnou kum khat upa nuolnabei sawm leh li,"},"30":{"text":"Danpieh dungzuiin atam leh tawm dan un, bawngtalte, belamnoute toh lat khawm dingin, ann sillat leh dawn sillatte zong ahi ding hi;"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh tawplou a halmang sillat, ann sillat leh dawn sillat simlou in keltal khat khelna sillat dinga na lat ding uh ahi."},"32":{"text":"“Ani sagini in, bawngtal sagi, belamtal ni belamnou kum khat a upa nuolnabei sawm leh li."},"33":{"text":"Danpieh dungzuiin atam leh tawm dan un bawngtalte, belamtalte leh belamnoute toh lat khawm ding, ann sillat leh dawn sillatte zong ahi ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tawplou a halmang sillat, ann sillat leh dawn sillatte, simlou in, khelna sillat dingin keltal khat na lat ding uh ahi."},"35":{"text":"“Ani giet niin, khawmpi thupitah na nei ding ua, tua hun sungin nna mawngmawng nasep ding uh ahi sih hi."},"36":{"text":"Mangpa adinga gimnamtui dingin mei a kithoina halmang sillat na lan ding uhi: bawngtal khat, belamtal khat belamnou kum khat a upa nuolnabei sagi."},"37":{"text":"Danpieh dungzuiin atam leh tawm dan un, bawngtalte, belamtalte leh belamnoute toh lat khawm dingin, ann sillat leh dawn sillatte zong ahi ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tawplou a halmang sillat, ann sillat leh dawn sillatte simlou in, khelna sillat dingin keltal khat zong na lat ding uh ahi."},"39":{"text":"“Tam silte khu na pawi hunguotte uah, Mangpa kungah na lan ding uhi, na halmang sillatte uh ding leh na ann sillatte uh ding leh na dawn sillatte uh ding leh na lemna sillatte uh ding a na thuchiemte u’leh na kiphalna sillatte uh simlou in,” chiin achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh zousie bangin Mosi in Israel tate ahilta hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Israel tate phung sunga lamkaite a houpi a; “Tami ahi Mangpa thupieh.","title":"Thu chiemna dante"},"2":{"text":"Mi’n Mangpa kunga thu achiem ahiei ahisihleh lungsim a amaleh ama kigah a, akichiem leh athuchiem apel ding ahi sih, akam a pawt bang banga abawl ding ahi.","ref":"Danp. 23.21-23; Mat. 5.33"},"3":{"text":"Numei in anungah lai a, apa inn a, a um lai in, Mangpa kungah thu achiema, athuchiem ah akigah a;"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh apa’n akichiemna leh amaleh ama thuchiem a, akigahna thu zanapi a, bangma genlou a aumleh akichiemna zousie a supiching dinga, tualeh thuchiem a akigahna zousie adet ahi ding."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh apa’n azah ni a, aphal sihleh, athuchiemte akigahna thuchiemten amanu akan kha nawnsih ding hi; apa’n aphal louziehin Mangpa’n amanu angaidam ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A thuchiem lai a, ahisihleh athuchiemin amanu agah zinglai a pasal anei a;"},"7":{"text":"Apasal in tam thute azah a, azahni a bangma agen sihleh akichiemna atangtung dinga, akigahna thuchiem zong adet ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh apasal in tam thu azah nia aphal sih leh akichiemna leh akigahna akam a agente khu bangmalou asuoh dinga, Mangpa’n amanu angaidam ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Meithai leh akikhul numei in amaleh ama kigah a akichiemna ukhu a det ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh apasal innsunga kichiemna anei a, ahisihleh amaleh ama kigah a thuchiem abawl a:"},"11":{"text":"Apasal in tam thute azah a, asipsan a, a awimawsih leh akichiemna zousie a tangtung ding a, akigahna thuchiem zousie zong a det ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh apasal in tua thute azah nia, bangmalou asuohsah leh athuchiem tungtanga akam a pawt pouma leh amaleh ama kigahna zousie adet sih dinga, apasal in bangmalou asuo sah tah zieh in, Mangpa’n amanu angaidam ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Kichiemna zousie leh amanu hinna sugenthei dinga kichiemna zousie apasal in asudet thei dinga ahisihleh bangmalou asuoh sah thei ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh apasal in azah nia kipata bangma agen sihleh, akichiemna zousie leh kigahna zousie anamdet ahi; azah nia bangma agenlou ziehin."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh azah nua a, bangmalou asuoh sah leh aman amanu mawna apo ding hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tamte khu apasal leh azi leh apa leh atanu anungah lai a, apa inn a a um lai a, akikal ua dan thupieh dinga Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu apieh khu ahi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Midiante Suhsietna"},"2":{"text":"“Midianmite tungah Israel tate phuba lain: Tuazou chiengin na mite kunga pui nahita ding hi.”"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in mipite ahoupi a, a kung uah, “Na lah uah mi bangza ahiei kigalthuom u’henlen Midiante dou dingin kuon uhenlen, Midianmite tungah Mangpa phuba vala uheh;"},"4":{"text":"Israel phung zousie lah a, phung china mi, tul khat, galdou dingin na sawl ding uh ahi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tul tampite lah a, phung chin a kipan in tul khat chiet; kidouna a kuon dingin galkap tul sawm leh tul ni apekhe ta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in phung chin apat, mi tul khat chiet leh siempu Eleazar tapa, Phinehas khu mun siengthou a vanzahte leh thupieh nadinga mut ding, pengkulte kengin kidou dingin asawlta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin, Midiante adou ua, pasal zousie athat ta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh amithate lah uah Midiante leengte zong atel uhi, Midiante leeng nga athate uh min: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur leh Reba ahi uhi. Beor tapa Balaam zong namsau in athat uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Midian numeite zousie atangehte u’toh sal in apui ua, aganhon zousie u’leh a belamhon zousie u’leh anei alam zousie uh, agallah sum dingun ala uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh atenna khopite zousie u’leh akulpi zousie uh mei in ahaltum pieh uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh mihing leh ganta, galmat leh gallah sum zousie apeipi ta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun galmatte, salte leh gallah sum zousie, Mosi leh Siempu Eleazar leh Israel mipi kikhawmte kungah, Jerikou gal Jordan luipanga um Moab phaijang a, agiehphuol uah ahing tut uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi leh siempu Eleazar leh mipi kikhawmte lamkai zousie giehphuol pulam ah amaute vaidawn dingin a kuonta uhi.","title":"Numeite thana leh galvan lahte siensuona"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi khu, galkap lamkaite, tul khat tunga lamkai, za khat tunga lamkaite tungah alungthahta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in, akung uah, “Numei zousie nang hing khawi uh ave maw? achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ngaiun, Balaam lemguotna ziehin Peor tungtang thu ah Israel tate Pasian tunga atakhielsah ua, tuachi’n Mangpa mipi kikhawmte lah ah mi puul ahing tungsah uh hilou ahiei mah?","ref":"Kisim. 25.1-9"},"17":{"text":"Tuazieh in naupang teng lah a pasal zousie that unlen, tualeh numei, pasal toh lumkhawmsa zousie zong that un."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh numei naupang pasal toh lumkhawmkha nailoute khu nouma dingin hingkhawi un."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh giehphuol pulam daigei ah ni sagi gieh unlen, mi koi zong mithat leh mi kithatsate khoikha pouma ani thum ni leh ani sagi niin nouma leh nasuoh nasalte u’zong kisusiengthou ta un, achita hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh na puonsil zousie uh, savun a kibawl zousie leh kelmul a kigan sil zousie tualeh singa kibawl sil zousie na suhsieng ding uh ahi.”"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh siempu Eleazar in kidouna a kuon galkapte kungah, “Tami Mangpa’n Mosi kunga apieh dan thugousie khu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Bangteng hileh, sanate, dangkate, sum-eng te, Siate langva leh hangehte leh;"},"23":{"text":"Mei a ka theilou sil pouma, mei ah na hal ding ua, tuachi’n a siengthou ding, hinanleh suhsiengna tui a suh sieng ahi ding uhi; tualeh mei a katum thei zousie tui a sawpsieng ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh ni sagi niin na puonte uh na sawp sieng ding ua, na siengta ding uh, tuazou chiengin giehphuol ah na hing lut ding uhi,” a chi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah,","title":"Gal van lahte hawmna"},"26":{"text":"“Nang leh siempu Eleazar leh mipi kikhawmte phung upate toh, na galmatte uh mihing leh gantate zousie leh vante sim un."},"27":{"text":"Tueleh galvan lahte khu mun ni ah khen un; galdoudinga kidouna a kuonte ading leh mipi kikhawmte a
