dingin."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh galdou dinga kidouna a kuonte apat Mangpa dinga sie a apieh ding uh koituom zel unlen, mihingte lah a kipat in, bawngte lah a kipat in, sabiltungte lah a kipat in, belamte lah a kipat in za khat chiet tuom koidoh un."},"29":{"text":"Tuate khu akimkhat la unlen siempu Eleazar kungah Mangpa vei sillat dingin pie un."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate tan kimkhat apat in, sawmnga lah a khat na la dinga, mihing apat bang, bawnga pat bang, sabiltunga pat bang, belam apat bang leh ganta phot a kipat bang ladoh inlen, tuate khu Mangpa biehbuh kem Siempute kungah na pieh ding ahi,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh siempu Eleazar in Mangpa’n Mosi kunga athupieh bangin abawlta uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh galkapten a mat uh, gallah sumte simlou a, alah uh, belam tul zaguh leh tul sawm sagi leh tul nga,"},"33":{"text":"Bawng tul sawm sagi leh tul ni,"},"34":{"text":"Sabiltung tul sawm guh leh tul khat."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh mihing: numei pasal toh lumkhawm kha nailou tul sawm thum leh tul ni, ahi uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh akimkhat, gal a kuon galkapte tanvou ahia atam lam, belam tul zathum leh tul sawmthum leh tul sagi leh za nga ahi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa dinga sie a kipie, belam zaguh leh sawm sagi leh nga ahi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh bawng, tul sawmthum leh tul guh ahia, tua lahah Mangpa dinga sie a kipie, sawm sagi leh ni ahi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh sabiltung tul sawmthum leh za nga ahi, tua lah ah Mangpa dinga sie a kipie, sawm guh leh khat ahi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh mihing tul sawm leh guh ahia, Mangpa dinga sie a kipie sawm thum leh ni ahi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin, Mangpa vei sillat dingin sie, Siempu Eliazar kungah apie hi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in galkap mite tanvou apieh zou a Israel mite tanvou khu;"},"43":{"text":"Belam tul zathum leh tul sawm thum leh tul sagi leh za nga."},"44":{"text":"Bawng tul sawm thum leh tul guh."},"45":{"text":"Sabiltung tul sawmthum leh zanga,"},"46":{"text":"Tualeh mihing tul sawm leh tul guh."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate tanvou kimkhat apat in Mosi in mihing leh ganta sawmnga leh khat ala a, Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin, Mangpa biehbuh kem Levite kungah apie hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkap lamkai, tul tunga lamkai leh za tunga lamkaite Mosi kungah ang pei ua.","title":"Galkap lamkaite sillatna"},"49":{"text":"Mosi kungah, “Na suohten ka khut ua um galkap mite ka sim ua, koima akimlou ka um sih uhi achi uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka hinna dingun Mangpa masanga kilemna bawlna dingin, Mangpa ding sillat michin in ka nei sun uh sana a kibawl kizepna vante, banbute, taute, minnamna khutsipte, bilbate leh khite, ka hing tawi uhi.”"},"51":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Siempu Eleazar in, sana a kisiem akivonna zousie uh ala ua;"},"52":{"text":"tul tunga lamkaite leh za tunga lamkaite sana, Mangpa kunga vei sillat a alat zousie uh shekel tul sawm leh tul guh leh za sagi leh sawm nga ahi."},"53":{"text":"(Galkap miten agallah sum uh amaun akitan uhi.)"},"54":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Eleazar in a tul tunga, lamkaite leh aza tunga lamkaite sana ala ua, Israel tate thei zingna dingin kimutuona biehbuh ah Mangpa masang ah ahing tawi uhi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Reuben leh Gad taten ganta tampi anei ua, tualeh Jazer gam leh Gilead gam amu tahun, tua mun khu ganhon dinga mun hoitah hiin athei ta uhi.","title":"Reuben, Gad leh Manasseh phung kimkhat Jordan suo lam a ten phal ahi"},"2":{"text":"Gad tate leh Reuben taten Mosi leh siempu Eleazar leh mipi kikhawmte lamkaite ahoupi ua."},"3":{"text":"“Ataroth gamte, Dibon gamte, Jazer gamte, Nimrah gamte, Heshbon gamte, Elealeh gamte, Shebam gamte Nebo gamte leh Beon gamte,"},"4":{"text":"Israel mipi kikhawmte masanga Mangpa’n asuh mang gamte khu gantate dinga gamhoi ahi a, na suohten ganhon ka hau uhi,” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin “Na mitmu a deisahna katan u’leh tam gam na suohte kung ah ka luo dingun hing pie inlen, Jordan gal hing kaipi da mai in chi’n ahing gen uhi.”"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Gad tate leh Reuben tate kungah, “Na unaute uh galdou a kuon ding ua, noute tam mun a tou mai ding maw?"},"7":{"text":"Bangdinga Mangpa’n amauh apieh gam a lutlou dinga Israel tate lung kesah na hi uoi?"},"8":{"text":"Tambangmain napu leh pate un Kadesh-Barnea akipat a gam enkhe dinga ka sawl laiin abawl uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 13.17-33"},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen amaute Eshkol phaijang dong ava tung ua, a gam ava mu tahun Mangpa’n amauh apieh gam lutlou dingin Israel tate alung kesah uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n, tua niin Mangpa lungthahna khu meibangin akuongdoh a, tualeh akichiem ta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 14.26-35"},"11":{"text":"Izipt gam akipat a hing pawtdoh, kum sawm ni apat atung lam, mi mawngmawng in, Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob kunga kichiema ka pieh gam khu, lungsim siengthou taha ahing zuilou zieh un koiman amu sih ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Keniz mi Jephuneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua chiloungal, aziehpen amauten Mangpa azui bukim uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua Mangpa lungthahna khu Israelte tungah, akuong ta a, Mangpa mit mu a sil gilou bawl mite khang zousie abeimang sieng masangsie uh gamdai ah kum sawmli sung avahvai sah ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh ngai un, Israel tunga Mangpa lungthahna zauhuoitah belap dingin nou khang giloute na pate uh taangin na dingta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa zuilou a, na kiheimangsan ngeingei u’leh Aman amaute gamdai ah anuasie kia mai ding ahi, tualeh tam mite zousie na mangthaisah sieng ding uhi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh amaute akungah ahing peikia ua, “Ka ganhonte ua dingin, belam honte leh ka taneute ua dingin khopite ka bawl ding ua:"},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh koute ahileh, amaute amun ding ua, ka lutsah masang sie uh, Israel tate masang a pei zel dingin ka kigalvon ding uhi; tam gam mite ziehin ka taneute uh kulpi nei khopite ah ateng ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Israel tate mi chinin agamluo ding uh aluo chiet masangsie un, ka inn lam uah ka kinuale sih ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen koute gamluo ding Jordan gal nisuoh lam ahi ziehin, Jordan gal khatlam leh akallam ka luopi sih ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in akung uah, “Tam sil na bawl ua, galdou dinga Mangpa masanga, kigalvon a na pei ding ua;"},"21":{"text":"Amasanga kipata, melmate na nawmang masangsie ua, Jordan gal a Mangpa masanga na bawn ua kigalvon a na pei ding ua;"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa masanga gal zaw ahi zou chiengin, na hing kinuale ding ua, Mangpa masang leh Israelte masangah mawnabei na hi ding uh, tualeh tam gam Mangpa masangah na luo ding uh ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh tuabanga na bawl sih u’leh, Ngaiun, Mangpa tungah sil na bawl khiel uh ahi dinga, na khelna un ahing mukhe ngei ngei ding chi thei un."},"24":{"text":"Na ta neute ua dingin khopite bawl unlen, na belamte ua dingin belam huongte bawl unlen, tualeh na kam ua thu pawtsa khu bawl ngei ngei un,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Gad tate leh Reuben tate’n Mosi kungah, “Na suohten ka pu uh thupieh bangin ka bawl ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ka ta neute uh, ka zite uh, ka belamhonte u’leh ka ganhonte uh, Gilead khopite ah ana um ding ua."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh na suohte pen ka pu uh gen bangin galdou dingin Mangpa masangah mi chin kigalvon in kava galkai ding uhi, chi’n agen uhi.”"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in amaute tungthu ah siempu Eleazar leh Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel phung sunga upa pente thu apie a.","ref":"Josh. 1.12-15"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in akung uah, “Gad tate leh Reuben tate, kidou dinga kigalvon zousieten Mangpa masangah Jordan gal ahing kaipi ua, tualeh na masang ua gam na zaw u’leh, Gilead gam pen aluo ding ua na pieh ding uh ahi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh kigalvon a ahing galkaipi sih u’leh, Kanaan gam ah na lah uah atel mai ding uhi,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Gad tate leh Reuben taten “Na suohte kunga Mangpa’n agen bangin ka bawl ding uh."},"32":{"text":"Kigalvon a Mangpa masanga galkai in, Kanaan gam ah ka lut ding ua, tuachi’n ka gam luo ding uh pen Jordan luigal tam langpang ahi ding hi,” chiin adawng uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Gad tate leh Reuben tate kungah tualeh Joseph tapa Manasseh nam kimkhatte kungah, Amormite leengpa Sihon gam, Bashan leengpa Og gam, tualeh tua gamte leh akhopi teng leh akimvel gam khopite toh, apie hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Gad taten Dibon leh Ataroth leh Aroer toh"},"35":{"text":"Atroth, Sophan, Jaazer, Jogbehah,"},"36":{"text":"Beth-nimrah tualeh Beth-haran, khopi kulpi neite leh belam huongte abawlta uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Reuben tate Heshbon, Elealeh leh Kirjathaim."},"38":{"text":"Nebo leh Baal Meon (aminte akiheng ta hi) tualeh Sibmah atungdoh ua, a khopi bawlte uh min dang a phuo uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Manasseh tapa Makir tate Gilead gam ah ava kuon ua, ala ua, tua muna um Amormite adeldoh ta uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Manasseh tapa Makir khu Gilead gam apeta a, asungah atengta hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Manasseh tapa Jair in tua khuote avala a, Havoth-Jair aphuo hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nobah ava kuona, Kenath avala a, akhopite Ama min tapin Nobah aphuo ta hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mosi leh Aaron lamkaina nuoi a, Izipt gam a kipat a, Israel tate apawl apawl ua, apawtdoh lai ua, apei zel dan uh tamte ahi.","title":"Izipt apat Sinai"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa thupieh a, apawtdoh ua, apei zel dan uh Mosi in agiel a, apawtdoh ua kipat aban ban a apei nate uh tam munte ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ahakhatna, ni sawm leh ni nga niin Rameses akipat in akipandoh ua, peikan ni zing niin Israel tate khu Izipt mite mitmu ah hangsan tahin apawtdoh ta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Izipt mite tachil Mangpa’n athalup piehte avui ua, apasiente uh tungah zong Mangpa’n gawtna atung sah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate Rameses akipat in apawtdoh ua, Sukkoth ah giehphuol asat uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Sukoth akipat in akipandoh ua, gamdai zul a um Etham ah puon inn azah uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Etham a kipat in akisuondoh kia ua, Baal-Zephan suolam pang a um Pi-hahiroth lam ah akinuahei kia ua, Migdol kungah giehphuol asat uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Pi-hahiroth mun akipat in akipandoh ua, tuipi apal tan ua, gamdai ah alut ua, Etham gamdai ah nithum apei ua, Marah mun ah giehphuol abawlta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Marah akipat in apawtdoh ua, Elim ahing tung uhi. Elim ah tuinahnei sawm leh ni leh tum kung sawm sagi a um a, tua mun ah giehphuol asat uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Elim akipat akisuon ua, tuipi san gei ah giehphuol asat uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuipi san akipat akipan doh ua, Sin gamdai ah giehphuol a sat uhi."},"12":{"text":"Sin gamdai akipat in apawtdoh ua, Dophkah ah giehphuol a sat uhi."},"13":{"text":"Dophkah akipat in apawtdoh ua, Alush ah giehphuol a sat uhi."},"14":{"text":"Alush akipat in apawtdoh ua, Rephidim ah giehphuol abawl ua, tua mun ah mipite dawn ding tui a umsih hi."},"15":{"text":"Rephidim akipat in apawtdoh ua, Sinai gamdai ah giehphuol a bawl uhi."},"16":{"text":"Sinai gamdai akipat in akipandoh ua, Kibroth-hattavah ah giehphuol a sat uhi.","title":"Sinai akipat in Kadesh"},"17":{"text":"Kibroth Hattavah akipat in apawtdoh ua, Hazeroth ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hazeroth akipat in akipandoh ua, Rithmah ah giehphuol asat uhi.","title":"Gamdai a vahvaina"},"19":{"text":"Rithmah akipat in apawtdoh ua, Rimmon Perez ah giehphuol a bawl uhi."},"20":{"text":"Rimmon Perez akipat apawtdoh ua, Libnah ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"21":{"text":"Libnah akipat in apawtdoh ua, Rissah ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"22":{"text":"Rissah akipat in apawtdoh ua, Kehelathah ah giehphuol a bawl uhi."},"23":{"text":"Kehelathah akipat apawtdoh ua, Shapher muol ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"24":{"text":"Shapher muol akipat in apawtdoh ua, Haradah ah giehphuol a bawl uhi."},"25":{"text":"Haradah akipat in apawtdoh ua, Makheloth ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"26":{"text":"Makheloth akipat in apawtdoh ua, Tahath ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tahath akipat in apawtdoh ua, Terah ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"28":{"text":"Terah akipat in apawtdoh ua, Mithkah ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"29":{"text":"Mithkah akipat in apawtdoh ua, Hashmonah ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"30":{"text":"Hashmonah akipat in apawtdoh ua, Moseroth ah giehphuol a bawl uhi."},"31":{"text":"Moseroth akipat in apawtdoh ua, Bene-Jaakan ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"32":{"text":"Bene-Jaakan akipat in apawtdoh ua, Hor Hagidgad ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"33":{"text":"Hor Hagidgad akipat in apei ua, Jotbathah ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"34":{"text":"Jotbathah akipat in apawtdoh ua, Abronah ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"35":{"text":"Abronah akipat in apawtdoh ua, Ezion Geber ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ezion Geber akipat in apawtdoh ua, Zin gamdai a Kadesh ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"37":{"text":"Kadesh akipat in akipandoh ua, Edom gamgi gei a Hor muol ah giehphuol asat uhi.","title":"Kadesh apat Moab"},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu Aaron khu, Mangpa thupieh in Hor muolvum ah akatou a; Israel mipite Izipt gam a kipat a, ahing pawtdoh uh kum sawm li na ha ngana, ni khat ni’n tua mun ah ashita hi.","ref":"Kisim. 20.22-28; Danp. 10.6; 32.50"},"39":{"text":"Aaron khu Hor muol a ashi laiin kum za leh sawmni leh thum ahi."},"40":{"text":"Tuin Kanaan gam simlam a teng, Kanaan mite leengpa Arad in, Israel tate hing pei thu azata hi.","ref":"Kisim. 21.1"},"41":{"text":"Tualeh amaute Hor muol a kipat in ahing kipandoh ua, Zalmonah ah giehphuol a sat uhi."},"42":{"text":"Zalmonah hing pawtsan in Punon ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"43":{"text":"Punon hing pawtsan in, Oboth ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"44":{"text":"Oboth hing pawtsan in, Iye-Abarimah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"45":{"text":"Iyim hing pawtsan in Dibon-Gad ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"46":{"text":"Dibon-Gad akipat in in apawtdoh ua, Almon-Diblathaim ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"47":{"text":"Almon-Diblathaim akipat in apawtdoh ua, Nebo maijawn a um Abarim muolte ah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"48":{"text":"Abarim muolte akipat in apawtdoh ua, Jordan gei a Jerikou kung a um Moab phaijangah giehphuol abawl uhi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n Beth-eshimoth apat in Abel-Shittim tan dong in, Moab phaijang Jordan lui gei ah giehphuol abawl ta uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tuin Jerikou kunga Jordan lui gei a Moab phaijang ah, Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah","title":"Kanaan gam a ki hawmnauh"},"51":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah gen inlen, akung uah, Jordan gal kaia, Kanaan gam na lut chiengun;"},"52":{"text":"Tua gam sunga noute masanga na tengte zousie na notdoh ding ua, suonga kikheng amilim zousie uh na suhsiet pieh ding ua, tualeh amilim khenthute uh na suse sieng ding ua, tualeh amun sangte zousie uh na phietmang pieh ding uh ahi."},"53":{"text":"Tua gam sunga tengte na deldoh ding ua, tuachi’n na luoding ua, na teng ding uhi, aziehpen na luo ding ua ka hing piehsa ahi."},"54":{"text":"Tualeh aphung dungzuiin aisan in gam na goutan dingun na hawm ding ua, atam deute khu gam lien deu na pe ding ua, atawmte gam neu deu na pe ding ua; michin goutan khu ai-san tuh tuhna ahi ding hi. Napu napete uh phung dungzui in na luoding uh ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 26.54-56"},"55":{"text":"Hinanleh tua gam a na teng masate na lah ua kipat na nawmang sih u’leh, hichi ahing hi dinga, na lah ua na umden sahte uh khu na mit ua dingin ahing sunthei chiengzum bang ahi ding ua, tualeh na tahsa ua dingin ling bang ahi ding uhi, tualeh na tenna gam uah ahing sugentheite ahi ding uhi."},"56":{"text":"Tuathamlouin hichi ahi dinga, amaute tunga ka bawl tup bangin noute tunga kabawl ding hi chiin,” achi hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a, akungah","title":"Kanaan gamgite"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate thu pie inlen, akung uah gen in, Kanaan gam a na lut chiengun tami na goutan ding ua na khut ua hing lut ding Kanaan gam, agamgite toh ahi."},"3":{"text":"Simlam ah: Simlam a na luo ding chieng ukhu Zin gamdai a kipat Edom gamgi zul ahi dinga, simlam a na gamgi ding ukhu, suolam ah tuipishi gei tawptan ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh na gamgi ukhu, Akrabbim tawn in simlam pangah akawi dinga, tualeh ahing pawtdohna khu Kadesh-Barnea sim lam ah ahidinga, tualeh Hazar-adar ah apei dinga, Azmon ah apei zel ding."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh gamgi Azmon akipat in Izipt luitan in a kawi dinga, atawpna tuipi ah ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tualeh tumlam panga gamgi dingin Tuipi lien gamgi in na nei ding ua, tam tumlam gamgi ahi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tam mallam a na gamgi uh ahi ding a, Tui suohgiat a kipat in Hor tang huomin na siem ding ua,"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Hor tanga kipat in Hamath lutna tan dongin na gamgi uh na siem ding ua, gamgi hing suohdohna Zedadah ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh gamgi khu Zephron ah apeitou peh dinga, asuohdoh na Hazer-enan ah ahi ding, tam khu na mallam gamgi uh ahi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tualeh na suolam gamgi ding ukhu Hazar-enan akipat in Shepham tan dongin na siem ding ua:"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh gamgi khu Shepham a kipat in Riblah tan dongin Ain nisuona lam pangah apei suh dinga, tuachi’n gamgi khu apeisuh zel dinga, suolam a Kinneveth tuipi dongin akihung suh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh gamgi khu Jordan dongin apei suh dinga, atawpna khu chituipi dong ahi ding hi. Tami akimvel a gamgi peidan banga, na gam ding uh ahi ding hi” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Israel tate thu apie a, “Tami Mangpa’n nam kuo leh nam kimkhatte kunga pieh dinga thu apieh aisan a na luoding uh gam khu ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 26.52-56\n        ;     \n        Josh. 14.1-5"},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Reuben tapate phung in a innkuon dungzui ua, tualeh Gad tapate phung in a innkuon dungzui ua, tualeh Manasseh phung kimkhat in zong agam luo ding uh amuta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Phung ni leh phung kimkhatten agam luoding ukhu Jerikou kung nisuolam Jordan gal tamlang pangah atangta uhi,” chiin."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupia, akungah","title":"Gam hawmna a lamkaite"},"17":{"text":"“Tamte khu na gam luo ding uh hing hawm pieh dingte min ahi uhi: Siempu Eleazar leh Nun tapa Joshua ahi ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh luo dinga gam hing hawm pieh dingin phung chin a lamkai khat chiet na guot ding uh ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tua mite min khu tamte ahi uhi: Juda phung apat Jephuneh tapa Kaleb."},"20":{"text":"Simeon tate phung apat Ammihud tapa Shemuel."},"21":{"text":"Benjamin phung apat Kislon tapa Elidad."},"22":{"text":"Dan tate phung lamkai Jogli tapa Bukki."},"23":{"text":"Joseph tate phung lamkai Manasseh tate phunga dingin Ephod tapa Hanniel."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Ephraim tate phung lamkai Shiphtan tapa Kemuel."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Zebulun tate phung lamkai Parnak tapa Elizaphan."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Issakar tate phung lamkai Azzan tapa Paltiel."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Asher tate phung lamkai Shelomi tapa Ahihud."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Naphtali tate phunga lamkai Ammihud tapa Padahel ahi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tamte khu Kanaan gam a, Israel tate kunga gam luo ding hawm dinga, Mangpa’n thu apiehte ahi uhi.”"}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Jerikou kunga, Jordan gei a Moab phaijang ah Mosi ahoupi a, akungah,","title":"Levite khopi dingte","ref":"Josh. 21.1-42"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate thu pie inlen, agam luona uah, Levimite tenna ding khopite apieh ding uh ahi, tualeh Levimite kungah khopi kimvel a gamte zong na pieh ding uh ahi."},"3":{"text":"Khopite khu atenna ding uh ahi dinga, akimvel a gamte khu a bawnghonte u’leh abelamhonte ua ding leh aganta khoite zousie ua ding ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Levimite kunga napieh ding uh khopi kim vel a gam khu khopi kulbang akipat tong tul khat kim kot ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh khopi pulam apat in na te dinga, suolam ah tong tul ni, sim lamah tong tul ni, tumlam ah tong tul ni, tualeh mallam ah tong tul ni. Tuachi’n khopi khu alai ah a um ding hi. Tami ama ua dingin akhopi kim ua agam uh ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Levite na pieh ding uh khopite lah ah, tuolthatte taina ding, kihumbitna ding khopi guh ahi dinga; tuate chilou khopi sawmli leh ni na pieh be nalai ding uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Levite napieh ding khopi zousie, khopi sawmli leh giet ahi dinga, akimkot gamte toh na pieh ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh napieh dinguh khopi khu, Israel tate luosa khopite apat ahi dinga; atam neite a kipat tam na pe ding ua, a tawm neite a kipat tawm na pe ding uhi, michin in Levite kungah agam luo tam leh tawm dan dungzuiin khopite apieh ding uh ahi.”"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a,","title":"Kihumbit na khopite","ref":"Danp. 19.2-4; Josh. 20.1-9"},"10":{"text":"“Israel mipite kungah thupie inlen, akung uah, Jordan gal kai a, Kanaan gam na hing lut chiengun;"},"11":{"text":"Tualthatte, tupna mawng neilou a, mithat khate, taina ding kihumbitna khopite na guot ding uh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tuate khu nou a dingin phubalami apat kihumbitna khopite ahi ding ua, mipi kikhawm vaihawmte mai a adin masanga tuolthat mi ashilouna dingin."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n nou a dinga kihumbitna dinga na guotte uh khopi guh ahi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Jordan gal tam lang pangah khopi thum na guot ding ua, tualeh Kanaan gam sungah khopi thum na guotding uhi, tuate kihumbitna khopite ahi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tam khopi guhte khu, Israel tate ading leh namdangte tualeh alah ua mikhuol tengte a dingin, kihumbitna ahi ding; mi koizong tupna neilou a, tuolthat khate atailut theina dingin."},"16":{"text":"“Hinanleh aman sia hiem zanga asatlup ahi leh tuolthat ahia, pellou a thalia ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh mi shi theina ding khop a akhut a suong a mi ase a ashi leh, tuolthat ahia, tuolthat mi khu thalia ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ahisihleh ashina ding khop a singa mi asata, ashi leh tuolthat ahia, tuolthat khu pellou a ashi ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Sisan phubalapan tuolthatpa khu athat dinga, amu hun hun in athat ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh aman amuda zieha, asawnpua a, ahisihleh ana mudapa ana suoma ahileh;"},"21":{"text":"Ahisihleh akilungnopmo zieh ua akhut a atupa ashitahleh atumliapa khu thalia ding ahi, aziehpen tuolthat ahi a, sisan phubalapa’n amu hun hun in tuolthat pa khu athat ding hi."},"22":{"text":"“Hinanleh aman kituohmawna neilou a, thakhat a asawnpua a, ahisihleh aguh a abuh hilou a, atunga bang ahiei khat a aselia khah a ahileh;"},"23":{"text":"Ahisihleh amelma lah hiloua, asietna ding tum mawng zong hilou a, ama muloupi a, shi theina ding khop suong ahiei a asekhah a ashi tahleh;"},"24":{"text":"Mipi kikhawmten tam vaihawmna dan dungzuiin mithattu leh sisan phubalatu kikal vai ahawm pieh ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh mipi kikhawmten tuolthat mi khu sisan phubalami khut apat in ahunkhe ding ua, mipi kikhawmten amapa tailutna kihumbitna khopi ah akoi kia ding ua, tualeh sathau siengthou kinu siempu lien shi masangsie tuamun ah a um den ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh bangchihlai pou a, tuolthattu ataina, akihumbitna khopi pulam a ahing pawtdoh a;"},"27":{"text":"Sisan phubalami in, akihumbitna khopi pulam a ama amu a, sisan phubalami in, tuolthatpa atha leh sisan maw apo sih ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen akihumbitna khopi sunga siempu lien shi masangsie aum ding ahia; hinanleh siempu lien shi nua chiengin tuolthatpa khu agam luona ah apei kia ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tuachi’n tam silte khu na tenna mun zousie ua, na khang tan ua dinga, na vaihawmna dan uh ahi ding hi.","title":"Theipitu panna leh kitatkhiehna"},"30":{"text":"Mi koi ahiei in mi athaleh tuolthatmi pen theipite kam a kipat a theipitu panna toh tha ding ahi; hinanleh mi khat shi sah na dingin theipitu khat ahun sih hi.","ref":"Danp. 17.6; 19.15"},"31":{"text":"Tuabanah, shina khop a mawpai tuolthatmi, tatna sum na lah ding uh ahi sih; hinanleh ama khu na thalia ngeingei ding uh ahi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh siempu lien ashi masangin, akihumbitna khopi a tailut tuolthatmi, agama aum kia nadinga tatna sum na lah dinguh ahi sih hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n na tenna gam uh na suhthanghuoi lou ding uh ahi; sisan in gam khu abua sah a, sisan suomi sisan loungal in, sisan kisuona gam asil sieng thei sih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuaziehin na lah ua ka tenna, naluo ding uh gam khu subua sih un, aziahpen Kei Mangpa Israel tate lah ah ka teng hi, chiin” achi hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph tate lah a mi, Manasseh tapa, Makir tapa, Gilead tate phung sunga haitawi upaten Mosi leh lamkaite leh Israel tate phung sunga haitawi upate masangah ahing pei ua, akung uah thu ahing gen uhi.","title":"Numei gouluo dan thu"},"2":{"text":"Amauten “Israel tate kunga ai san a, aluo ding gam uh pe dingin, Mangpa’n ka pu thu ahing pie a, tualeh kapu, ka unaupa uh Zelophehad gam luo ding, a tanute kunga pe dingin Mangpa’n thu ahing pie hi.","ref":"Kisim. 27.7"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh amauten Israel tate lah a phung leh taang dang mi pasal neita u’leh ka pulepate uh goutan gam a kipat akilakhe dinga, tuachi’n atuhna phungte uh gamluopa adingin akibelap dinga, tuachi’n ai san a ka gam tansate ua pat lahdoh ahing hita ding hi, achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate Jubili ahing tun chiengin, agamluo ukhu ava tuhna phungte uh gamluo ah belap ahitading a, tuachi’n kou phunga dingin manna ahing hitading hi.”"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Mangpa’n thu apieh dungzuiin, “Israel tate thu apie a, Joseph tate phung in agen dih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Zelophehad tanute tungtang thu a Mangpa thupieh khu tami ahi, Hoi asah penpen uh kitenpi u’henlen, hinanleh apu apate uh belephung mi toh akiten ding uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate gamluo khu phung khat a pat phung dangah, akisuon kawi kawi thei sih ding hi, aziehpen Israel tate michin in apulepate uh phung gamluo khu akinei den ding uh ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Israel mite lah a gouluoding nei tanu pouman, Israel taten apulepate uh gam aluo chiet theina dingun apa belephung sunga pasal anei ngeingei ding uh ahi."},"9":{"text":"A gamluo ukhu phung khat apat phung dang kungah akisuon kawi kawi lou ding ahi; hinanleh Israel tate phunga michin in agamluo uh akinei den dinguh ahi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin Zelophehad tanuten abawl uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Zelophehad tanute Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Noah in apa uh unaute akitenpi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ama uten Joseph tapa Manasseh tapate innkuonte akitenpi ua, tuachi’n agamluo ukhu apa innkuonpite phung sungah a um denta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tamte khu Mangpa’n Mosi khut a, Jerikou kunga Jordan lui gei Moab phaijang a Israel tate kunga apieh, thupiehte leh vaihawmna dante ahi hi."}}}}},"5":{"info":{"name":"Danpiehnina","shortname":"Danp.","abbr":[],"desc":"Mosi laibu ngana danpiehnina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam thute Jordan suolampang, gamdai, Paran leh Tophel, Laban Hazeroth leh Dizahab kikaal a Suph gal a Arabah a, Mosi in Israel mite zousie kunga agen ahi.","title":"Thuhun thupi"},"2":{"text":"Horeb akipat in Kadesh-barnea tan Seir muol lam zuiin ni sawm leh khat lam ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh kum sawmlina, ha sawm leh khatna khum ha, ni khat niin hichi ahing hia, Mangpa’n amauh kunga hil dinga thupieh akunga apieh zousie dungzuiin Mosi in Israel tate kungah agenta hi."},"4":{"text":"Heshbon a teng Amormite leengpa Sihon leh Edrei a Ashtaroth a teng Bashan leengpa Og atha nua in:","ref":"Kisim. 21.21-35"},"5":{"text":"Jordan suolam Moab gam ah tami dan agen panta hi."},"6":{"text":"“Mangpa i Pasian un Horeb muol ah ahing houpi a, tami taangah na um sawt sengta uhi.","title":"Sinai apat Kadesh"},"7":{"text":"Kihei unlen kipandoh ta un, tualeh Amormite taanggamte leh akimvel a Arabah phaijang leh taang te ah, phaigamte, simlamte leh tuipi pangte ah, tuipi leh Euphrates luipi tan in pei un."},"8":{"text":"Ngai un gam khu na masang uah a um hi. Lut unlen, Mangpa’n na pu leh pate uh Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob kunga ama u’leh a nua ua, ahahasuonte kunga pieh achiem gam khu luo ta un, achi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tualeh khumhun laiin na kung uah keima ngen in ka hing paw zou sih a,","title":"Mosi in lamkai ding atelna"},"10":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un noute ahing pung sah a, ngaivawi un, tuin na tamdan uh van a aasite bang na hita uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa na pule pate uh Pasian in ahing thu chiem bangin, tu sangin ale tul tampi in hing pung sah henlen hing guolzawl ta hen."},"12":{"text":"Bangchi’n keima ngenin, na buoinate uh, na puohgihte u’leh na kiheh tuonate uh ka po zou diei?"},"13":{"text":"Na phung lah ua mipil, theisiem mi, adan ding thei mi teldoh unlen, amaute na lah ua vaihawm dingin ka bawl ding hi, chiin ka gen a."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh nouten ka bawl ding ua na sil gente a hoi hi, chiin na hing dawng ua,"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n na phung lah ua, lamkai mipilte leh adan ding theite kala a, na tung ua vaihawm thunei dingin ka bawl hi, tul tunga lamkaite, za tunga lamkaite; sawmnga tunga lamkaite, sawm tunga lamkaite in leh na phung lah ua lamkaite toh."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh khum hun laiin na vaihawmte uh thu ka pie a na unaute uh kaal a thubuoi ngaikhie unlen, unau leh unau tualeh gamdangmi akung ua umte kikaal thu dihtahin vaihawmpieh un."},"17":{"text":"Vaihawmna ah mi deisah tuom na nei ding uh ahisih, milien leh mineu kibangtahin na ngaikhietpieh ding uh ahi, koima na giin ding uh ahisih hi, vaihawmna khu Pasian a ahizieh in. Tualeh nou a ding a thu hasa taluote ka kungah hing tut zel unlen, tuachi’n keiman ka ngaikhe zel ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh khum hunlai in sil na bawl ding zousie uah thu ka hing pie hi."},"19":{"text":"“Tualeh Mangpa i Pasian un thu ahing pieh bangin Horeb a kipat in ipawt kheta ua, Amormite tang gam lampi a, gamdai lienpi leh zauhuoi na mu ukhu tawnsuohin ipeita ua, Kadesh barnea mun ihing tungta uhi.","title":"Kadesh apat enkhe mi sawlna"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Keima’n na kung uah, Mangpa i Pasian un ahing pieh Amormite tang gamte na hing tungta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ngai un, Mangpa na Pasian un gam ahing pe zouta hi, Peitou unlen Mangpa napu leh pate uh Pasian in na kung ua agen bangin va luo ta un, zau sih unlen, lung zong lung kesih un, ka hing chi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh ka kungah na bawn un, na hing pei chiet ua, agam umdan va enkhie a, ipei touna ding lampi leh ilutna ding khopi tanchin hing hil ding mi imasang ah sawl vai na chi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuabanga na ngaituona un ahing kipah sah mama a, tuachi’n na lah ua pat mi sawm leh ni, phung khat apat mi khat zel kala a."},"24":{"text":"Amaute a kuon ua, taangte ah apeitou ua, tualeh Eshkol phaijang ahing tung ua, gam ava enkhie uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh amauten tua gam a theigate alou ua, ikung uah ahing posuh ua, tualeh Mangpa i Pasian un ahing pieh gam khu gam hoitah ahi chi thu ahing tut uhi."},"26":{"text":"“Hinanleh na peitou ut sih ua, Mangpa na Pasian uh thupieh kaal in na helta uhi.","title":"Mangpa tunga helna","ref":"Danp. 9.23; Heb. 3.16"},"27":{"text":"Na puon innte uah na phun ua, Mangpa’n ahing muda ziehin suhmang ding a, Amormite khuta piehlut dinga, Izipt gam a kipata ahing puidoh ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hei sungah ipeitou thei diei? i unaute un, “Agam mite khu eite sangin a lienzaw ua, asang zaw uhi, akhopite uh alien a, van sun in kulbang anei uhi; tualeh Anakim tate khum mun ah ka mu uh chiin ahing lung kesah uhi na chi uhi.”"},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Keima’n na kung uah amaute ging sih unlen, zau zong zau sih un."},"30":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh na masang ua peipan, na mit mu uah nou ding a, Izipt gam a abawl zousie bangin ahing doupieh ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh mi’n gamdai a, ata apuoh banga, Mangpa na Pasian un na peina lam zousie ua, tammun na hing tun masangsie ua ahing puoh dan na mu uhi, ka chi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 13.18"},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh tuachi pumpum in zong, Mangpa na Pasian uh, na gingta tuom sih uhi.","ref":"Heb. 3.19"},"33":{"text":"Na puon inn zah na ding uh sui pieh ding leh na peina lampi uh kawhmu dinga zan a meikuong leh sun a meipi a nou hing puipa khu."},"34":{"text":"“Tualeh Mangpa’n na thu gente uh a za a, a lungthah a, akichiemta hi.","ref":"Heb. 3.18"},"35":{"text":"Tam khang giloute lah a mi khat in zong, napu leh pate uh kunga, pieh dinga ka chiem gam hoi khu na mu sih ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Jephuneh tapa Kaleb chilou ngal in, ama’n vang amu dinga, tualeh ama kung leh atapate kungah a kenga ava tot gam ka pe ding hi, azieh pen aman Mangpa azui bukim hi, achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Noute ziehin kei tungah zong Mangpa a lungthah a, nang zong khum gam ah na lut sih ding ahing chi hi."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh nang hing panpipa Nun tapa Joshua pen a lut ding hi, ama hanthawn in, aman Israel tate khum gam aluo sah ding ziehin."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh na taneute uh, gallah in ahing kilah pieh ding hi, na chite uh leh tunia sie leh pha thei nailou na tate uh tua gam ah a lut ding uhi, akung uah ka pe ding a, amauten aluo ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"Hinanleh noute pen kihei unlen, Tuipi san lam gamdai ah pei un, achi hi."},"41":{"text":"“Tuachi’n nouten ka kungah, Mangpa tungah kana khielta uhi; Mangpa i Pasian hing thupieh bangin ka peitou ding ua kava dou ding uhi, chiin na hing dawng uhi. Tualeh michin na bawn ua galvan a na kivon chiet zou un, taanga kaltou dingin na kisa zouta ua."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah, peitou sih unlen dou zong dou se da mai un, azieh pen na lah uah ka um sih hi: tuachilouin na melmate un ahing zou ding uhi, chi’n akung uah gen in ahing chi hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n na kung uah thu ka gen a, nouten na ngaikhe sih ua, hinanleh Mangpa thupieh kalin na helta ua, kisathei tahin taangah na kaltou teitei uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum taanga teng Amormite noute dou dingin ahing pawtdoh ua, khuoi in mi adel bangin noute ahing del ua, Seir ah Hormah tan dongin ahing na that uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tualeh na hing kile kia ua, Mangpa maiah na kapta ua, hinanleh Mangpa’n na aw uh angaikhe ut sih a, abil zong ahing daw ut tuom sih hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum muna na um sung uh dungzuiin Kadesh ah nitampi na um ta uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tuachi’n ikihei ua, Mangpa’n ka kunga agen bangin Tuipi san lam ah gamdai ah ilutta ua, tualeh Seir taang khu ni tampi ivel uhi.","title":"Edom buoisah louding","ref":"Kisim. 21.4"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ahing houpi a,"},"3":{"text":"Tam muol na vel sawt sengta uhi, mallam zuon in kihei un."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh mipite khu, Seir tanga teng, Esau hahlesuon na unaute uh gam sung kantan a pei ding na hi ua, amauten nou a hing na giing ding ua, tuaziehin pilvang dingin mipite thu pie in.","ref":"Siem. 36.8"},"5":{"text":"Amaute kidoupi sih un, azieh pen agam uh kengphang chie khat zong noute ka hing pe sih ding hi, aziehpen Seir tang khu Esau luo dinga ka piehsa ahita hi."},"6":{"text":"Na neh ding uh a ann u’zong sum in na lei ding ua, tualeh na dawn ding uh a tuite u’zong sum in na lei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un, na khut nasep zousie uah ahing guolzawl zel ding hi, Aman tam gamdai lienpi na palsuoh dan u’zong athei hi. Tam kum sawmli sung Mangpa na Pasian un ahing umpi zing a, bangma tahsap na nei sih uhi, chiin thu pie in, achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elath leh Ezion-geber akipat in Arabah lamlienpi a peiin Seir taanga teng i unau Esau hahlesuonte gam itot peisuoh zou un, “I kihei ua Moab gamdai lampi ah i peita uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah “Moabte subuoi sih unlen, gal in zong kidoupi sih un, aziehpen agam uh noute luo dingin ka hing pesih ding hi. Lot hahlesuonte kungah Ar atan ding ua ka pieh tah zieh in, achi hi.","title":"Moab subuoi sih un","ref":"Siem. 19.37"},"10":{"text":"Masanglaiin tuamun ah Anakimte banga milien leh tam leh sang pipi Emimte ana teng uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua mite khu Anakimte banga miliente a sim ahi ua, hinanleh Moab miten Emimte achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Masanglaiin Hormite zong Seir ah ana teng ua, hinanleh Mangpa’n apieh gam sunga Israel taten abawl mabangun, Esau taten aluokhum uhi; athat ua agam uh aluo pieh ta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuin thou unlen, Zered luita kan un, kachi a, tuachi’n Zered luita ikanta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kadesh-Barnea apat i hing pawt khie ua, Zered luita ikaan ua, Mangpa’n akung ua akichiem banga, mipite lah apat galkap mite khang zousie abeisieng tandong khu kum sawm thum leh giet ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 14.28-35"},"15":{"text":"Amaute a bawn ua giehphuol a mipite lah akipat ashi gam masangsie un, amaute sumangthai dingin, Mangpa khut atung uah atuta hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, tuabanga galkap thei mi zousie a manthai ua, ashi sieng nua un;","title":"Ammonte subuoi sih un"},"17":{"text":"Mangpa’n ahing houpi a, ka kungah;"},"18":{"text":"Tuni’n Moab gam Ar na tot peisuoh ding ahi:"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Ammon mite gamgi zul nailam na hing tun chiengin, amaute subuoi sinlen, ha u’zong kihaupi sin, aziehpen Ammon mite gam beh khat zong noute ka hing pesih ding hi, Lot hahlesuonte kunga atenna ding ua ka piehsa ahi tahzieh in.","ref":"Siem. 19.38"},"20":{"text":"(Tua gam zong Rephaim gam banga sim a hi, masanglaiin Rephaim mite ana teng ua; Ammon miten amaute khu Zamzum mite a chi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Anakimte banga milien pipi leh atam a tam tualeh sang pipi ahi ua, hinanleh Mangpa’n amasang uah amaute asumanga, tualeh amauten adeldoh ua, amun uah akitenta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Seir muol a um Esau hahlesuonte ding a, Hormite a suhmangthai pieh lai a, abawl bangin; tuachi’n amauten aluo ua, amun uah tuni dongin ateng denta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Gaza tandonga khoneu nounou a na teng Avimte khu Kaphtor akipat a hing pawtdoh kaphtor miten a sumang ua, amunte uah ateng ta uhi.)"},"24":{"text":"Thou unlen kipandoh un, tualeh Arnon lui kan un; Ngai un, na khut uah Heshbon leengpa, Amormi Sihon leh agam na khut ah kahing peta hi; luo panta unlen, galin kidoupi un.","title":"Sihon gal leh kizawna"},"25":{"text":"Tuni in nangma giinna leh nangma zauna vannuoi pumpi a um namte tungah ka koi pan dinga, amauten na tanchin aza ding ua, achitun ding uhi; tualeh nangma ziehin lunggim in a um ding uhi, achi hi."},"26":{"text":"“Tualeh Kedemoth gamdai akipat in Heshbon leengpa Sihon kungah lemna thupuo mi ka sawl a."},"27":{"text":"Na gam sungah hing pei suoh sah in, lamlien zuiin ka pei ding a, zietlam ahiei, veilam ahiei ah zong ka piel sih ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Ka neh ding ann sumin nang leisah dinga, ka dawn ding tui zong sum in nang lei sah ding hi, keng in hing pei suoh sah in."},"29":{"text":"Jordan ka galkai a, Mangpa ka Pasian un ahing pieh gam ka lut masangsie a (Seir muol a teng Esau hahlesuonte leh Ar a teng Moab miten ka tunga abawl bang un) kachi hi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh Heshbon leengpa Sihon in agam a hing tawn sah ut sih a, aziehpen Mangpa na Pasian un tunia na mu mabangun, na khut ua ahing pieh khiet thei na dingin alungsim akhausah a, alungtang a paupeng sah hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah Ngaiin, Sihon leh agam na masangah ka hing peta hi; agam na tan theina dingin luo panta in ahing chi a."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sihon leh amite zousie eite dou dingin Jahaz ah ahing kuonta uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa i Pasian un amau khu ei kungah ahing pe khie a, a ma leh atate leh a mite zousie ithat uhi."},"34":{"text":"Khum hun laiin akhopite zousie ila ua, khum khopite a, pasal leh numei zousie leh naupang zousie ithat gam ua, khat zong ikhawi sih uhi."},"35":{"text":"I khopi lahte apat a, gallah sil a ilah vante leh gantate eima dingin ikilah uhi."},"36":{"text":"Arnon lui gei a um Aroer a kipat leh lui guom a um khopi akipat Gelead tandongin, eite dou dinga hattaluo khopi khat zong a um sih hi, Mangpa i Pasian un ahing pekhe siengta hi."},"37":{"text":"Ammon mite gamah bou na hing lut sih ua, Jabbok luipang zousie a gamte leh taanggam a khopite leh Mangpa i Pasian un ahing phallouna poumate toh."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tuachi’n i kihei ua, Bashan lampi ah i peitou ua, tualeh Bashan leengpa Og khu amite zousie toh, eite doudingin ahing kuon hi.","title":"Bashan leengpa Og kizawna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah, Ama giing sin, ama leh amite zousie leh agam na khut a ka hing pieh tahziehin; Heshbon a teng Ammon mite leengpa Sihon tunga na bawl bangin ama tungah zong na bawl ding hi, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa i Pasian un, Bashan leengpa Og zong amite zousie toh i khut ah ahing pekheta a, tuachi’n khat beeh zong hingkhawilou in i that siengta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Khum hunlai in Bashan a Og leenggam a, Argob gam kai sunga khopi sawmguh umte zousie a abawn in ilah pieh sieng ua, ilah piehlou khopi khat zong a um sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tam khopite zousie kulpi baang sang tahtah te kulkotpite leh kotpite kalna nei ngen ahi ua, kul bang neilou khopi neu tamtah simlou in zong."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Hebron leengpa Sihon tunga ibawl bangun, khopi chin a Pasal leh numei leh naupangte a unpi un i that sieng ua, i suchimit siengta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh ganta zousie leh khopi sungte a van um zousie eima dingin galvan lah in ikilahta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh khum hunlai in Amormite leeng nite khut akipat in Arnon lui apat Hermon taang dongin, Jordan gal tamlang panga um gam ila uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hermon khu Sidon miten Sirion achi ua, Amormiten Senir achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Phaijanga khopi zousie, Gelead gam zousie, Bashan gam zousie, toh, Bashan gam a Og leenggam khopite Salekah leh Edrei tan adongin."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen miliente lah a adam sun khu Bashan leengpa Og ngentang ahi. Ngaivawi, alupna khu sia a kibawl ahia, tam lupna khu Rabbah a, Ammon mite lupna mama khu ahisih amah? Mihing tonga tein adunglam tong kuo, availam tongli ahi."},"12":{"text":"“Tualeh khum hunlaia, iluo uh tam gam, Arnon lui kunga um Aroer akipat Gelead taanggam kimkhat leh tuana um khopite khu Reuben mite leh Gad mite kungah ka pie hi.","title":"Reuben, Gad leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte gam piehna"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Gelead gam um nalai teng leh Bashan gam zousie khu Og leenggam ahia, Manasseh nam kimkhatte kungah ka pie hi; Argob gamkai zousie leh miliente gam achi uh Bashan gam zousie toh."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh manasseh tapa Jair in Argob gam zousie, Geshurmite leh Maakath mite gamgi tandongin ala a, tuni tandongin ama min puoin Bashanhavoth-Jair akichi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Gelead gam khu Makir ka pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Reuben mite leh Gad mite kungah Gelead apat Arnon lui tan, phaijang kim khat leh Ammon mite gamgi Jabbok lui tandong gamgi ka pie hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh phaijang zong Jordan leh akai gamte, Kinnereth apat Arabah tuipi lien (chituipi) suolam panga Pisgah nuoi muolpang ken tandongin kana pie hi."},"18":{"text":"“Tualeh khum hunlai in noute thu ka hing pie a, Mangpa na Pasian un tam gam na luo ding un, ahing peta hi; na unaute uh Israelte masangah, galkuon thei zousie nava galkai ding uh ahi.","ref":"Josh. 1.12-15"},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh na zite u’leh na taneute uh tualeh na gantate uh (ganta na hau mama uh chi ka thei ngal a) ka hing piehsa khopite ah ana um ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa’n nouma banga na unaute uh galmuonga akhawldam sah masangsie leh Mangpa na Pasian un Jordan gal a amaute gam apieh ding aluo masangsie un: Tuazou chiengin nouma ka hing gampieh na luona uah na hing kile kia ding uhi, chiin thu ka hing pie hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh khum hunlai in Joshua thu ka pie a, tam leeng nite tunga, Mangpa na Pasian uh sil bawl zousie na mit ngel in na mu siengta hi. Tuachibangma in Mangpa’n na valuo ding uh gam zousie tungah abawl ding hi.","title":"Lamkai kihenna"},"22":{"text":"Amaute na giin ding uh ahi sih, Mangpa na Pasian un, nou a dinga ahing doupieh ding zieh in, achi hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tualeh khum hunlai in, keiman Mangpa kungah ka ngen a.","ref":"Kisim. 27.12-14; Danp. 32.48-52"},"24":{"text":"Aw Mangpa Pasian, na suohpa kungah na thupidan leh na khut thahat dan na musah pan ta hi; aziehpen Nang banga, tambang sil bawlthei leh hattah lei leh van ah pasien koi a um ei mah?"},"25":{"text":"Hing galkai sah inlen, Jordan lui gal gam nuom leh singtang gam hoi leh kilawm leh Lebanon hing musah in, chiin ka ngen hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh noute ziehin Mangpa ka tungah alungthahta a, tuachi’n ka ngetna asang ta sih a, tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah hunsah ta’n, tam thute ah hing houpi nawn sin, achita hi."},"27":{"text":"Pisgah muolvum ah kaltou inlen, suolam leh tumlam, tualeh simlam leh mallam ngain, kihei inlen na mitin en in, aziehpen Jordan lui na galkai nawn sih ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh Joshua thu pie inlen, hanthawn inlen suhat in, aziehpen ama mipite masangah agalkai dinga, nava mu ding gam amaute aluo sah ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Beth-Peor gal a phaijang ah i umta uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Khaile, Israelte aw, tuin na hintheina ding u’leh, na pu leh pate uh Pasian in ahing piehsa gam a na lut ua na luo theina ding ua, vaihawmna dan ka hing hilte leh thupiehte ngai khie un.","title":"Thu sawmpieh gen kiana"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh thupieh, ka hing piehte, na zui theina dingun, ka hing thupiehte na belap ding uh ahi sih a, na lahkiem ding u zong ahi sih hi.","ref":"Kihil. 22.18,19"},"3":{"text":"Baal-peor zieha Mangpa silbawlte na mit ngel un na muta ua, Baal-peor bie mi zousie, Mangpa na Pasian un na lah ua kipat a sumang siengta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 25.1-9"},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh noute Mangpa na Pasian uh dettah a pom zousie tuni tandongin hing leh damin na um nalai uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ngai un, Mangpa ka Pasian hing thupieh bangin na luo ding uh gam a na lut chieng ua na zuizel dingun dan piehte leh vaihawmna dan thupiehte kahing hilta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin pilvang tahin nit unlen zui un, aziehpen tuami khu, nam dangte mitmu a, na pilna u’leh na theisiemna uh hivan in, amaun tam thupiehte zousie aza ding ua, tam nam thupitah, piltah leh sil theisiem tah ahi ngut ma uhi, achi ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen ihat pouma chienga Mangpa i Pasian in ahing nai banga, amauh nai zel pasien nei nam thupi koi a um ei?"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tunia na masang ua ka koi danthupieh zousiete, vaihawmna dan, dihtahte, bang nei nam thupi a um amah?"},"9":{"text":"“Bangteng hileh pilvang mai unlen, pilvangtahin kikem phot mai un, tuachilouin na mit ua na silmusa zousie uh na manghil kha ding ua, na damsung un na lungtang ua kipat apawtmang kha ding hi; hinanleh na tate u’leh na tate uh tate hilzaw un.","title":"Horeb a Israelte thuohna genkia na"},"10":{"text":"Adiehdiehin Horeb muola Mangpa na Pasian uh masanga na din ua, Mangpa’n ka kung a mipite hing hankhawm inlen, leitung a adam sung ua, Keima giindan azil theina ding u’leh atate uh ahil theina dingun, ka thute ka theisah ding hi achi ni na manghil kha ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n na hing kikhawm ua muol nuoiah na hing ding ua, vanlaizawlhol in muol khu mielnate, meipite, miel keikuinate umsah in muol khu a kata hi.","ref":"Pawt. 19.16-18; Heb. 12.18,19"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n meilum lah a kipat in na kung uah thu agen a, awging naza ua, hinanleh alim leh mel bangma na mu sih ua; awging maimai na za uhi."},"13":{"text":"Athuhun na zui ding ua, noute ahing thupieh; thu sawmpieh na kung uah ahing phuongdoh a, tuate suongpeh ni tungah a giel hi.","ref":"Pawt. 31.18; 34.28; Danp. 9.10"},"14":{"text":"Khumhun laiin, luodinga nava galkaina gam ua na tun chieng ua na zui ding uh thupiehte leh vaihawmna dante nouma hing hil dingin thu ahing pie hi.","ref":"Pawt. 21.1"},"15":{"text":"“Tuaziehin kipilvang mai un, Horeb muol a mei lah a kipat a Mangpa’n noute ahing houpi niin, alim leh mel bangma na mu sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Khuchilouin nouma siemthu anu ahiei, apa ahiei lim leh melpuo, milim khengin na ki suse ding uh ahi sih.","ref":"Pawt. 20.4; Siempu. 26.1; Danp. 5.8; 27.15"},"17":{"text":"Leitunga um gamsa kibahpi ahiei, vanlaizawl a leeng aha nei vate kibahpi ahiei;","ref":"Rom. 1.23"},"18":{"text":"Leitunga bohvah ganhingte kibahpi lim bang ahiei, leinuoi a tui sunga nga lim leh mel puo na bawl thu ua, na bieh lou na dingun pilvang un."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh vanlam nga a, na ettou chieng ua, ni leh ha leh aasite leh van a um zousie na mu chiengun, Mangpa na Pasian un, van sin nuoi a, mi zousie ding a, aguot piehte’n ahing hip a, na bieh ua, ana naseplou na dingun pilvang un."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n noute pen tunia na hi bang ua, amite leh agoutante hi dingin, Izipt gam sia haltuina mei a kipat ahing puidoh ta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 19.5; Danp. 7.6; 14.2; 26.18; Tit. 2.14; 1 Pet. 2.9"},"21":{"text":"Tuathamlouin noute ziehin Mangpa ka tungah alungthahta a, Jordan gal ka kailou na ding leh, Mangpa na Pasian un na goutan ding ua ahing pieh tua gam hoi sunga ka lutlou na dingin akichiemta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 20.12"},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin, keipen tami gam sungah ka shi ngei dinga, Jordan gal kailou ding ka hita, hinanleh noute pen na galkai ding ua, tua gam hoi khu na luo ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Pilvangun khuchilouin Mangpa na Pasian un nou leh Ama kikaal a athuhun bawl na manghil kha ding ua, milim khenthu ahiei, ahisihleh Mangpa na Pasian un ahing phalpieh vawtlou sil bang ahiei kibahpi limte na ki bawl kha ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa na Pasian ukhu mikahtum hat meikuong bang leh thangsiet hat Pasian ahi.","ref":"Heb. 12.29"},"25":{"text":"“Tate leh tute na hing nei ua, gam sunga hun sawtpi, na tehsiet dong uh na hing um nua chieng un, na hing kisuhsiet ua, milim kikhenthu, sil khat kibahpi lim, khat poupou na bawl ua, Mangpa na Pasian uh sulungthah dinga, amitmu a silgilou na bawl u’leh vang;"},"26":{"text":"Jordan galkai a, na valuo ding uh gam akipat na mangthai pai ding uh, chi na tungtang thu uh theipitu dingin tunin lei leh van ka han ahi; na tengsawt sih ding ua, hinanleh huoisetah a suhmang in na um ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n nam zousie lah ah ahing thethang dinga, Mangpa’n ahing delzahna namte lah ah tawmnou khat na pha ding uhi.","ref":"Danp. 28.36"},"28":{"text":"Khunah mihing siemthu sing leh suonga kibawl khomu theilou, khoza theilou, bangma ne theilou leh gimnam zong theilou pasiente nna nasemta ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh khum gamsung ma a, Mangpa na Pasian uh na sui ua, na lungtang zousie u’leh, na hinna zousie utoh na sui u’leh, na mu ding uhi.","ref":"Jer. 29.13"},"30":{"text":"Genthei thuoh a na um chieng u’leh, ni nukhia chienga tam silte na tung ua, ahing tun chiengin, Mangpa na Pasian uh kunglam ah na hing kihei ding ua, athu na mangta ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"(Mangpa na Pasian u khu khotuo siem Pasian ahi ngal a.) Aman ahing taisan sih dinga, ahing sumang sih ding hi. Tualeh na pu leh pate uh kunga akichiemna thuhun amanghil sih ding hi."},"32":{"text":"“Noute um masang, tumasanglai a hun umsate sui unlen, leitunga Pasian in mihing asiem chiila kipat, van mongkhat akipat lelamtawp tandong ngaituo un, tambanga sil thupi bang ahiei a um ngai tai mah ahisihleh hichibang akiza ngai ta ei mah?"},"33":{"text":"Ngai un, Meikuong lah a kipata Pasian aw na zah ua, na hin nahlai bangun mi’n Pasian aw za in ahing ngai uh amah?"},"34":{"text":"Ahisihleh Mangpa na Pasian un, noute dinga Izipt gam a abawl banga, Pasian in ze etnate a, chiemte nate a sillamdangte a, kidounate a, khut hat a, banzahte a, tualeh silchizathuoite a, nam dang lah a kipat nam khat puidohna a um kha ngai ta amah?"},"35":{"text":"Mangpa khu Pasian ahia, Ama loungal adang a um sih chi na theina dingun tam silte khu na kung ua ahing kimusah ahi.","ref":"Mak. 12.32"},"36":{"text":"Thu ahing hil theina dingin, van a kipat in aw ahing zasah a, leitungah ameikuong thupitah ahing musah hi, tualeh meikuong lah a pat athu gente naza uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Aman napu leh pate uh a it ziehin, anua ua hing um ding, ahahasuonte uh ateldoh a, Izipt gam a kipat in asilbawltheina hattahin, Ama ngel umpina toh ahing puidohta hi."},"38":{"text":"Nam dang nang sanga thupi zaw leh hatzawte notdoh ding leh tunia na hibang ua, hing puilut a agam uh na luoding ua hing pe dingin."},"39":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuni’n thei unlen, na lungtang uah vom un, tunglam van ah leh nuoilam lei ah, Mangpa khu Pasian ahi chi thei un, adang mawngmawng a um sih hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuaziehin kumtawn a dinga, Mangpa na Pasian un, nou ahing pieh gam a, nouma leh na hah na suonte uh hoina ding leh na damsawt theina dingun, adante leh athupiehte, tua ka hing piehte khu, na zui ding uh ahi,” achi hi.","title":"Kihumbitna khopite"},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Jordan gal nisuohna lampang ah, kihumbitna dingin khopi thum a sepkhie hi.","ref":"Josh. 20.8,9"},"42":{"text":"Tupna neilou leh tumasanga zong kimudana neilou, a inn vengte that khate tailut theina dingin; tam khopite khat poupou a tailut in akihumbit ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Khumte khu Reuben mite adingin gamdai muolvumjanga um Bezer khopi a guot pieh a, Gadmite a dingin Gelead gamsunga um Ramoth khopi a guot pieh a, tualeh Manasseh mite a dingin Bashan gamsung a um Golan khopi a guotpieh hi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh tam khu Mosi in Israel tate kunga a dan pieh khu ahi."},"45":{"text":"Tamte khu Izipt gam a kipata ahing pawtdoh nua ua, Mosi in Israel tate kunga agen theipina thupieh leh vaihawmna dan thute khu ahi.","title":"Danthupiehte Mosi in agenna"},"46":{"text":"Jordan suolam gal Beth-peor toh kigalsai phaijang a, Izipt gam a kipata ahing pawtdoh nua ua, Mosi leh Israel taten atha uh Heshbon a teng Amormite leengpa Sihon gam ahi."},"47":{"text":"Ama gam leh Bashan leengpa Og gam, Jordan gal ni suona lam a Amormite leeng nite gam aluo uhi."},"48":{"text":"Arnon lui panga Aroer akipat Hermon kichi Sion tang tandongin."},"49":{"text":"Jordan gal suolam pang phaijang zousie, Pisgah muol hap nuoi suh Arabah tuipi dongin."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Israel tate zousie ahankhawm a akung uah, “Aw Israel Ngai un, na zil ua, na zui ua, tualeh na bawl dingun tunia na zah ua ka gen thupiehte leh vaihawmna dan thute ngaikhie un.","title":"Thusawm pieh genkiana"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa i Pasian un Horeb muol ah thuhun ahing bawlpi ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa’n tam thuhun khu ipu leh pate uh ana bawlpi sih a, hinanleh eite tunia dam a um zousiete toh abawl zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa’n muol tungah meikuong lah apat noute toh kimaituoin thu agen a."},"5":{"text":"Khum hun laiin, Mangpa thu noute kunga hing phuong dingin, kei khu Mangpa leh noute kaal ah ka ding a, meikuong ziehin na zau ua, muol ah na kaltou sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"“Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh, Izipt gam a na saltanna inn ua pat a hing puidohpa khu ka hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ka masangah Keima loungal pasien dang na nei dinguh ahi sih hi."},"8":{"text":"“Milim khenthu tunglam van a um ahiei, nuoi lam lei a um ahiei, lei nuoilam tui sunga um bang ahiei kibahpi sil mawng mawng na bawl ding ahi sih.","ref":"Siempu. 26.1; Danp. 4.15-18; 27.15"},"9":{"text":"Tuate bie a amasanga na kunding ahi sih a, ana uh zong naseppieh ding ahi sih, “Kei Mangpa na Pasian khu thangsiet hat Pasian Ka hia, Pate gitlouna zieh a, tate gawt zel, ahing mudate tunga, khangthum, khangli tandonga, gawtna tut zelpa leh;","ref":"Pawt. 34.6,7; Kisim. 14.18; Danp. 7.9,10"},"10":{"text":"Kei hing it a, ka thupiehte zui mi sang tampite kunga khotuona langsahpa Pasian ka hi."},"11":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian min amawhin na lou ding ahi sih hi; Mangpa’n Ama min amawh a loute khu siemmaw tangsah lou a akoilou ding ziehin.","ref":"Siempu. 19.12"},"12":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian in thu ahing pieh bangin khawlni siengthou sah ngitnget dingin tangin.","ref":"Pawt. 16.23-30; 31.12-14"},"13":{"text":"Nasep ding zousie uh ni guh sungin na sem ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.12; 31.15; 34.21; 35.2; Siempu. 23.3"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh ni sagi ni khu Mangpa na Pasian khawlni ahi, tua niin nna mawngmawng nasep ding ahisih; nang leh na tapa in zong, na tanu in zong, na suohpa in zong, na suohnu in zong, na bawngtal in zong, na sabiltung in zong na ganta khatpou in zong na innhuong sunga um gamdang mi in zong, nna asep lou ding uh ahi, nangma banga na suohpa leh na suohnu zong akhawlding uh ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh nang zong Izipt gam ah sila nava hita a, Mangpa na Pasian in khuna kipat in khut hattah leh banzahin ahing puidoh hi chi thei zingin, tuaziehin Mangpa na Pasian in khawlni tang dingin thu ahing pie hi."},"16":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian in thu ahing pieh bangin nanu leh napa zatat in, tuachi’n Mangpa’n gam ahing piehna mun ah, na lawching dinga, na damsawt ding hi.","ref":"Danp. 27.16; Mat. 15.4; 19.19; Mak. 7.10; 10.19; Luk. 18.20; Eph. 6.2; Eph. 6.3"},"17":{"text":"“Tuol na that ding ahi sih.","ref":"Siem. 9.6; Siempu. 24.17; Mat. 5.21; 19.18; Mak. 10.19; Luk. 18.20; Rom. 13.9; Jak. 2.11"},"18":{"text":"“Aang na kawm ding ahi sih.","ref":"Siempu. 20.10; Mat. 5.27; 19.18; Mak. 10.19; Luk. 18.20; Rom. 13.9; Jak. 2.11"},"19":{"text":"“Na guh ding ahi sih.","ref":"Siempu. 19.11; Mat. 19.18; Mak. 10.19; Luk. 18.20; Rom. 13.9"},"20":{"text":"“Na innvengte tungah theipitu dihloua napan ding ahi sih.","ref":"Pawt. 23.1; Mat. 19.18; Mak. 10.19; Luk. 18.20"},"21":{"text":"“Na innvengpa zi na deigaw ding ahi sih a, Na innvengpa inn ahiei lou ahiei, asuohpa ahiei, asuohnu ahiei, abawngtal ahiei, a sabiltung ahiei, ahisihleh na innvengpa neilelam mawngmawng ahiei zong deigawna lungsim na nei ding ahi sih.","ref":"Rom. 7.7; 13.9"},"22":{"text":"“Tam thute Mangpa’n muoltunga meikuongte, meilumte leh mielna huoisetah lah a pat, aw ngaitahin na bawn ua kikhawmte kungah agenta a, abelap nawn tuom sih hi. Tualeh tuate khu Aman suongpeh ni tungah a giel a, keima ahing peta hi.","title":"Mipite azau uh","ref":"Heb. 12.18,19"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, muol khu meikuong thupitahin akah laiin, miel lah a pat a a aw na zah lai un, na namlah ua lamkai leh upate ka kunglam nai in na hing pei uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Ngaiin, Mangpa i Pasian in i kung uah athupi dan leh alet dan ahing kilang sahta a, tualeh meikuong lah a pat a aw iza ta ua, Pasian in mihing ahoupi in zong shina ahituon loudan tuni’n ithei ta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin bangdinga shi ding ihi uoi? Tam meikuong thupitahin ahing katum ngei ding hi. Mangpa i Pasian aw izah kia u’leh vang i shita valon ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Meikuong lah a pata Pasian hing aw izah bang ua za a, hing ngal tahsa nei zousie lah ah koi a um ei?"},"27":{"text":"Nangman Akung va nai inlen, Mangpa i Pasian in agen ding zousie va ngai khe vawiin, tualeh Mangpa i Pasian in na kunga agen zousie, nangman koute kungah nang gen sawn ding a, tuachi’n kana ngaikhe ding ua, ka zui ding uh, na chi uhi."},"28":{"text":"“Tualeh nang houpi lai ua, na thu gen uh Mangpa’n ana za a; tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah, Tam mipiten na kunga thu agen uh kana za a athu gen zousie uh a gen dih mama uhi."},"29":{"text":"Aw, tambang lungsim paw den uleh keima, giindan ahing siem ding ua, ka thupieh azui ngitnget ding ua, ama u’leh atate uh kumtawnin alawching mama ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"A kung uah pei inlen, “Na puon innte uah nua pei kia ta un,” chi in."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh nang pen, tanah ka kungah ding inlen, aluo ding ua ka pieh gam a, abawl theina ding ua, a kung ua na hilding thupiehte, danthute leh vaihawm thukhenna dante zousie, na kungah ka hing gen ding hi, achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa na Pasian un thu ahing pieh zousie zui dingin na pilvang ding ua, zietlam ahiei, veilam ahiei ah na piel sih ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Na valuo ding uh gam a na hin theina ding u’leh, na hoi theina ding u’leh, na damsung nite uh a sawttheina dingin, Mangpa na Pasian un ahing thupieh lampi zousie na zui ding uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh tamte khu nava luoding uh gam a, nava galkai chieng ua, na zui ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian un, noute hildinga thu ahing pieh, thupiehte leh vaihawmna dante ahi.","title":"Thupieh loupi"},"2":{"text":"Nouma leh na tapate u’leh na tupate un Mangpa na Pasian uh zaudan na siem ua, na kung ua ka hing pieh athupiehte leh adan thute na dam sung ua na zuina ding u’leh na dam sung nite uh asawt na dingin."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aw Israel, napu leh pate uh Mangpa Pasian in ahing chiemsa, nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam a, na hoina ding u’leh, nasataha na hing pun theina dingun, Ngaikhie unlen pilvang tahin zuiun."},"4":{"text":"“Aw Israel ngaikhie un, Mangpa i Pasian ukhu Mangpa khat ahi.","ref":"Mak. 12.29"},"5":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian khu na lungtang zousie, na hinna zousie leh na hatna zousie a, na it ding ahi.","ref":"Mat. 22.37; Mak. 12.30; Luk. 10.27"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tam thu, tunia ka hing thupieh, na lungtang uah vom ngitnget un.","ref":"Danp. 11.18-20"},"7":{"text":"Na tate uh phatuomngaitahin na zil sah ding ua, na innsunga na tou chieng bangin, lampi a na pei chieng bangin, na lup chieng bangin, tualeh na thaw chieng in zong na hil zel ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh chiemtena dingin, na ban uah na viel ding ua, na mittegel kaal uah, talpang gahna bangin na nei ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh na inn kotbiengte u’leh na kotpi khuomte uah na giel ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, Mangpa na Pasian un napu leh pate uh, Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob te kunga pieh dinga a chiem gam a, na bawl u’zong hi lou khopi thupi tah leh hoi tahtahte leh;","ref":"Siem. 12.7; Siem. 26.3; Siem. 28.13"},"11":{"text":"Na suhdim uh hi vawtlou silhoi adim innte leh na tawdoh uh hilou tuikhuh tawsate leh na suon khah u’zong hilou grep huonte leh Olive singte umna a ahing puilut a, nieng leh tai a na neh ua, na tai tah chiengun,"},"12":{"text":"Pilvangun, tuachilouin Izipt gam a na saltanna inn ua pat a nou hing puidohpa Mangpa na Pasian uh na manghil kha ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian u khu na giing ding ua, ama nna nasem ding ua, Ama min louin na kichiem kha ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 4.10; Luk. 4.8"},"14":{"text":"Pasien dangte, na kimvel ua um namte pasiente na bieh ding uh ahi sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Na lah ua um Mangpa na Pasian uh thangsiet hat Pasian ahi, khuchilouin Mangpa na Pasian lungthahna, na tung uah hing kuongdoh kha vanin, leitunga pat ahing sumang kha ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Massah a na ze et bang ua, Mangpa na Pasian uh na ze et ding uh ahi sih hi.","ref":"Mat. 4.7; Luk. 4.12; Pawt. 17.1-7"},"17":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un ahingpieh thupiehte, a theipina thute tualeh athugousiete pilvang tahin na zui ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa mitmu a dih leh hoi na bawl ding uh ahi; Nang dinga na hoina ding leh Mangpa’n napu leh pate uh kunga achiem gam hoi lut a na luo theina ding un."},"19":{"text":"Mangpa’n a gensa banga, na masang ua kipat na melmate zousie uh delmang dingin."},"20":{"text":"“Tualeh hun hing tung dingte a, na tate un Mangpa i Pasian uh hing thupieh theipina thute leh thupiehte leh vaihawmna danthute bang china ahiei? chia ahing doh chiengun;"},"21":{"text":"Na tapate uh kungah, Izipt gam a Pharaoh sal in kana taang ua, Mangpa’n khut hattah in Izipt a kipat ahing puidoh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka mitmu un Izipt gam tung leh Pharaoh leh a innkuonpite tungah, chiemtenate leh sil lamdang thupi tahte leh chizat huoite ahing musah hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n eite pen ipu leh pate kunga ana chiemsa gam khu pe dinga ahing puilut theina dingin, khuna kipat in ahing puikhie hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh tam dan thupiehte zousie zui ding leh i hoi tawntung na dingin, Mangpa i Pasian zaudan siem dingin Mangpa’n thu ahing pie a, tuni a banga ang hingkhawi theina dingin."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman thu ahing pieh banga, Mangpa i Pasian masanga athupieh zousie zui dinga ipilvang u’leh idihtatna uh ahi ding hi, chiin na chi ding uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Msngpa na Pasian un, na luoding gam ua, a hing puilut chieng a, na masang ua nam tamtah, Hitmite, Girgashmite, Amormite, Kanaanmite, Perizmite, Hivmite tualeh Jebusmite, noute sanga lienzaw leh hatzaw nam sagite anawdoh hun chiengin,","title":"Kituom koidinga thuhilna","ref":"Nasep. 13.19"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian un, amaute, noute kunga ahing pieh a, na thagam hun chieng un, amaute khen nei louin na thatgam siengding ua, amaute toh thuhun na bawl ding uh ahi sih hi; na hepi ding u’zong ahi vawt sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute toh zi leh ta a, na kiten vawtlou ding uh ahi, na tanute u’zong atapate utoh na kitensah ding uh ahisih a, tualeh na tapate uh zi dinga atanute uh na lah vawt lou ding uh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen na tapate keima hing zuilaite, pasien dangte biehna lam ah apuikawi kha ding uhi; tuachi’n Mangpa lungthahna khu na tung uah mei bangin a kuong dinga, thakhat in a hing sumang kha ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahivang in atung uah hichi bangin na bawl zaw ding uhi, amaitamte uh na suhsiet pieh ding ua, a suong milimte uh na satguoi pieh ding ua, singa kibawl a pasien limte uh na haltum pieh ding uh ahi.","ref":"Danp. 12.3"},"6":{"text":"“Noute Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin, nam siengthou na hi uhi. Mangpa na Pasian un leitunga nam zousiete lah a Ama a tuom hidinga ahing tel tuom na hi uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 19.5; Danp. 4.20; 14.2; 26.18; Tit. 2.14; 1 Pet. 2.9"},"7":{"text":"Namdangte sanga na tamzawh zieh ua, Mangpa’n a itna na tung ua atunsah leh ahing tel na hi sih uhi; nam zousie lah a tawmpen nahi bou uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n noute ahing it zieh leh napu leh pate uh kunga ana kichiemna tangtun sah a ut ziehin, na saltanna inn uh Izipt leengpa Pharaoh khut a pat in, khut hattahin ahing puidoh a, ahing tankheta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa na Pasian ukhu, Pasian ahi chi thei un, Pasian muonhuoi, Ama it a, a thupieh zui mite tunga, khang tul tandonga athuhun leh a khotuona, koi zing ahi;","ref":"Pawt. 20.5,6; 34.6,7; Kisim. 14.18; Danp. 5.9,10"},"10":{"text":"Ama mudate sumang dinga, amaitanga thuhpai zel ahi, Ama mudate tungah azekai sih dinga; amai tang ah a thuh kia pai ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin tunia bawl dinga ka hing pieh thupiehte leh thugousiete leh vaihawmna dan thute na zui ding uh ahi."},"12":{"text":"“Tuaziehin hichi ahing hi dinga, tam vaihawmna thute na ngaikhiet ua, na zui ua, tualeh na bawl ua ahileh, Mangpa na Pasian un, napu leh pate u’kunga, akichiemna thuhun leh khotuona na tung uah azui ding hi.","title":"Thuman zieh a guolzawlna","ref":"Danp. 11.13-17"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Aman noute ahing it dinga, ahing guolzawl dinga, tualeh ahing pungsah ding hi. Napu leh pate uh kunga pieh dinga akichiemna gam ah, na gil ua ga leh na gam gate u’zong a guolzawl nalai ding a, na bute uh, na zute uh, na sathaute uh, na bawng noute u’leh na belam noute u’zong a guolzawl ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Nam zousie tungah guolzawl na hi ding ua, noute lah leh na gan honte lah uah, atal leh anu, a chiing mawngmawng a um sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa’n nou akipat natna hii zousie athengsah sieng dinga, na theisa uh Izipt gam natna hiite, na tung uah atusah sih dinga, nou hing mudate tung ah akoi zaw ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian un ahing piehkhiet ding namte zousie, na suhmang sieng ding uh ahi, na hepi ding uh ahi sih a, apasiente uh nna zong nasep ding uh ahi sih hi, aziehpen noute ding a thang ahi ding ziehin."},"17":{"text":"“Na lungsim ua, tam namte ei sangin atam zaw ua, bang ichi deldoh zou diei, na chi u’leh."},"18":{"text":"Amaute na giinlou ding uh ahi. Mangpa na Pasian un Pharaoh leh Izipt mite zousie tunga asilbawlte thei zing un."},"19":{"text":"Ze-etna thupitah na mit mama ua na mute uh, chiemtenate, sillamdangte, khut hattahte leh banzahte a Mangpa na Pasian un, noute ahing puikhiet dante; tuabangmain Mangpa na Pasian un, na mi giinte uh tungah abawl zel ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaban ah Mangpa na Pasian un, adam nalai na lah ua kipata kibudapte amanthai masangsie un alah uah tunpi asawl ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaute na giin ding uh ahi sih hi; Mangpa na Pasian uh, Pasian hat leh chizat huoi na lah ua a um ziehin."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un, tua namte na masang ua kipat awl awl in ahing deldoh pieh ding a, thakhat thu in na sumang pai ding uh ahisih, tuachilouin gamsate na tung uah ahing pung kha ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa na Pasian un amaute na khut uah ahing pekhe dinga, amanthai masangsie un buoina nasatah atung uah atung ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh aleengpate uh na khut uah ahing pekhe dinga, amin uh vannuoi akipat in na phietmang masangsie un, na masang uah koima ading ngam sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"A milim pasien khenthute u’zong meiin na haltum ding ua, tam milimte atuomna uh dangka leh sanate na deigaw ding uh ahi sih a, lah zong na lah vawt lou ding uh ahi; khuchilouin thang ah na awh kha ding uhi. Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin sil kidahhuoi ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Na innsung uah sil kidahhuoi na hing puohlut lou ding uh ahi, khuchilouin tua silte bangin hamsiet in na um kha ding uhi, tuate khu na huot ua, na kidah mama ding uh ahi. Aziehpen tuate khu hamse thuoh sil ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Chidam lu dam a na um ua na hing pun sem sem ua, noute hing pieh dinga, napu leh pate uh kunga Mangpa’n akichiemna gam nava luo theina ding un, tunia ka hing thupiehte zousie zuiding in na pilvang ding uhi.","title":"Mangpa thei zing dinga thupieh"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh athupiehte na zui ding uoi, nazuisih ding uoi, chi na lungsim uh theina dinga ze et ding leh hing kingaingiem sah dinga, gamdai a kum sawmli sung ahing puina lampi zousie thei zing un."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh mihing tanghou guohin ahing sih ding a, hinanleh, Mangpa kam a pat a pawt thu chintengin mihing ahing zaw ding hi chi ahing theisah theina dingin, Aman ahing sungiem a, gilkiel na thuoh uh ahing phal pieh hi. Tualeh na thei ngailou uh napu napate un zong athei ngailou uh, manna in ahing vah hi.","ref":"Mat. 4.4; Luk. 4.4"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh tam kum sawmli sung na satung ua, na nihten napuonsilte uh ase tuom sih a, na kengte u’zong a pawm sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh mi’n ata aphawhhil zel bangin, Mangpa na Pasian un, ahing phawhhil zel ahi chi, na lungtang un thei zingun."},"6":{"text":"Tuazieh in alampite zuiding a, Ama zaudan siem dingin, Mangpa na Pasian uh thupiehte na zui ding uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un, muol leh guomte a kipata hing luong luituite, tuikhuhte leh tuinahte umna gam hoi;"},"8":{"text":"tualeh mangbute, barli bute leh grepte leh theipite tualeh kawlbutheite leh Olive thaute leh khuoizu tamna gam;"},"9":{"text":"Tasam loua tanghou na nehna ding uh gam ah ahing puilut ta hi, tam sungah bangma tahsap na nei sih ding ua, tualeh agama suongte sia ahia, a muol leh taangte sum-eng laikhieh theina gam hoi mama ah ahing puilut ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh na neh ua, na tai mama hun chiengun, gam hoi mama ahing pieh ziehin, Mangpa na Pasian uh na phat ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"“Tunia thu ka hing pieh, athupiehte leh avaihawmna dan thute leh adanthupiehte, zuilou dinga, Mangpa na Pasian manghillou dingin pilvang un.","title":"Mangpa manghillou dinga pilvan ding","ref":"Hos. 13.5,6"},"12":{"text":"Khuchilouin vang na neh ua, natai ua, inn hoitahte na lam ua, na ten chiengun."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh na ganhonte u’leh na belamte uh ahing pun a, na dangkate leh na sanate uh ahing pun a, na nei nalam zousie uh ahing pun chiengin;"},"14":{"text":"Na lungtang ahing kiliensah dinga, Izipt gam a na saltanna ua kipat a nou hing puidoh Mangpa na Pasian uh;"},"15":{"text":"gamdai lienpi leh zauhuoi gulngan leh mom ai tamna, tui umlouna leh dangtahna gam a hing puipa, tualeh meisa suonga kipata tui pawtdoh sahpa."},"16":{"text":"Nouma suhngiemna ding leh tu nua chienga, na hoina ding ua, hing etkhiehna dinga, napu leh pate thei ngailou manna a gamdai a, noute hing vahpa na manghil kha ding ua;"},"17":{"text":"tualeh na lungtang ua, ka silbawltheina leh ka khut hatna zieh a, tam sumlepai hausatnate ka nei ahi na chi kha ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa na Pasian uh na thei zing ding uh ahi. Tunia abawl banga napu leh pate uh kunga athuchiem asuhdet theina dinga, hausatna na mu theina ding ua, hatna hing pepa khu Ama ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi ding a, Mangpa na Pasian uh na manghil pouma ua, pasien dangte na zui ua, ana naseppieh ua, na bieh pouma u’leh pellou in na mangthai teitei ding uhi chi na tungthu uah tuni’n khautahin ka hing hil ahi."},"20":{"text":"Na masang ua Mangpa’n asuhmang namte bangin, Mangpa na Pasian uh thu na manlou ziehun na mangthai ding uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Aw Israelte Ngaivawi un, Nou sanga thupi zaw leh hatzaw namte, vanzih hol a khopi kulpibang nei leh thupi tahtahte luo dinga tunia Jordan galkai ding na hita ua.","title":"Israelte hel mundan Mosi in agen kiana"},"2":{"text":"Mi lien leh sang Anakim hahlesuonte, na theisa u’leh na zah sa uh, miten Anak tate masangah koi a ding ngam diei? a na chi uh na thei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin na masang ua pei, Mangpa na Pasian uh mei katumhat bang ahi chi tunin thei un. Aman amaute asumang dinga, ahing suhngiem pieh dinga, tuachi’n Mangpa’n na kung ua, agensa bangin amaute na deldoh ding ua, na sumang pai ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian un, amaute na masang ua kipat ahing deldoh pieh nua chiengin, na lungtang un idihtat zieh ua tam gam luo dinga, Mangpa’n ahing puilut ahi, chiin ngaituo vawt sih un. Tami namte khu agitlou zieh ua, Mangpa’n ahing deldoh pieh, ahizaw bou hi."},"5":{"text":"Na dihtat zieh uh ahiei, ahisihleh na lungtang dih zieh uh ahiei in, agam uh na luo sih ding ua, hinanleh tam namte agitlouna zieh ua, Mangpa na Pasian un, napu leh pate uh Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob te kunga, ana chiemsa asuhtangtung theina dinga amaute anawdoh ahizaw hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mangpa na Pasian un tam gam hoi khu na dihtatna zieh ua, na luoding ua ahing pieh ahi sih chi theisiem un; nam paupeng tah na hi bou uhi."},"7":{"text":"Gamdaia Mangpa na Pasian uh, na lungthah sah dante uh theizing unlen manghil sih un. Izipt gam a kipat a na hing pawtdoh ua kipat, tam mun na hing tun dongun Mangpa tungah na hel ngitnget uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Horeb ah zong, Mangpa na sulungthah ua, tuachi’n noute sumang nuom khop in Mangpa na tung uah a thangpai hi."},"9":{"text":"Suongpeh, Mangpa na Pasian un na kung ua thuhun ahunna suongpeh la dinga muol a ka kaltou laiin ni sawmli leh zan sawmli muol tungah kava uma, ann lah ka ne sih a tui zong ka dawn sih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 24.18"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah Pasian khutzunga kigiel suongpeh ni ahing pie a, khummun a na kikhop lai ua, mei kuong lah a pat a, Mangpa’n na kung ua athu gen zousie bangin tuate tungah akigiel hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh ni sawmli leh zan sawmli bei nua in hichi ahing hi a, Mangpa’n suongpeh ni thuhun suongpehte ngel a hing pie hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah, thou inlen, tam mun a kipat peisuh mengin, aziehpen Izipt gam a kipat a na puidoh na mite akisusegawp siengta uhi; azuiding ua ka thupieh lampite a kipat in kintahin apielmang paita uhi, milim sunthu akibawl ta uhi, achi hi."},"13":{"text":"“Tuabanah, Mangpa’n ka kungah, Ngaivawi, tam mite ka et leh mi genhapi ahi uhi, chiin agen hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute sumang ding leh Vannuoi apat amin uh phietmang dingin ka law law ka law mai ding, tualeh nangma akipat amaute sanga hatzaw leh thupizaw nam khat ka siemzaw maiding, chiin ahing houpi nalai hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka kihei a, muol a kipat ka hing kumsuh a tualeh muol khu mei in akata a, thuhunna suongpeh nite ka khut lang niin ka tawi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh ka en a Ngaivawi, Mangpa na Pasian tung uah sil na bawl khielta ua, bawngnou lim sunthu na kibawlta uhi; Mangpa’n thu ahing pieh lampi akipat in na piel mang zuaita uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n suongpeh nite ka domtou a, ka khut lang ni apat ka pai a, na mitmu uah ka sepkeh ta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tumasanga ka bawl bangin, ni sawmli leh zan sawmli, Mangpa masangah ka bohkhupa, Mangpa sulungthah dinga amitmu a, giloutah a na bawl uh na khelnate zousie uh ziehin ann lah kane sih a tui zong ka dawn sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen noute sumang dinga Mangpa lungthahna, athangpaina leh alungkimlouna chizat huoi khu ka giinga, Hinanleh tuahun laiin zong Mangpa’n ka thugen a ngaikhie hi.","ref":"Heb. 12.21"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa khu Aaron sumang nuom khopin athangpai mama a, hinanleh ken Aaron a ding in zong khumhun mama in ka nget pieh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh na khelna zieh ua na bawl uh bawngnou lim khu ka la a, mei ah ka hal a, ka satguoi a, leivui banga nel in kagawt guoi a, tualeh a vuinel khu muol a kipat a hing luongsuh lui ah ka paita hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tualeh Taberah leh Masaah ah tualeh Kibroth-hattava ah zong Mangpa na sulungthah uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 11.3; Pawt. 17.7; Kisim. 11.34"},"23":{"text":"Tuabangmain Mangpa’n, peitou unlen, ka hing gam pieh va luo un chia, Kadesh barnea apat ahing sawllai in, Mangpa na Pasian uh thupieh kal in na kiphin san ua, a aw zong na ngaikhe sih uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 13.17; Danp. 1.21; Kisim. 13.31; Danp. 1.26; Heb. 3.16"},"24":{"text":"Ka hing theichil nia kipat in, Mangpa tunga hel hat mi na hi ngitnget uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Tuachi’n Mangpa’n noute ka sumang ding ahing chi ziehin Mangpa masangah ka khupboh a, ni sawmli leh zan sawmli ka khupboh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa kungah, ka ngen a, Aw Mangpa Pasian, na thupina a na tatdoh, khut hattah a, Izipt gam a kipat na tatkhieh na mite leh na goutante sumang sin."},"27":{"text":"Na suoh Abraham Isaak leh Jakob te thei zing inlen, tam mite aphengphitnate uh, agitlounate u’leh akheldante uh en sin."},"28":{"text":"Khuchilouin vang na hing puidohna gam a miten, “Mangpa’n akung ua achiem gam a a puilut zoulou zieh leh amaute a muda zieh a, gamdai a thagam dinga apuidoh ahi,” achi kha ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Amaute khu na silbawltheina thupitah leh na banzah a na puidoh, na mite leh na goutante ahi uhi, ka chi hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Khum hun laiin Mangpa’n ka kungah, suongpeh ni tu masanga bangin kheng kia inlen, muol tungah ka kungah hing kaltou inlen, singkuong bawl in.","title":"Mosi in Pasian khotuona agen kiana"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh tua suongpehte tungah, tu masanga suongpeh na sekehte tunga thu kigielte ka giel dinga, singkuong sungah na koi ding hi, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n gichil sing giltahin singkuong ka bawla, tumasanga, bang suongpeh ni ka khenga, tua suongpeh nite tawiin muol tungah ka kaltouta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh suongpeh tegel ah, tumasanga kigiel bang bangin, na kikhop khawm ni ua, muol tunga meikuong lah apat a, Mangpa’n agensa thusawmpiehte khu agiela; tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah ahing pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka kihei a, muol a pat ka hing kumsuh a, suongpehte khu ka singkuong bawl sungah ka koi a, tualeh Mangpa hing thupieh bangin khunah a um denta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate khu Be-eroth Bene Jaakante tuikhuh a kipat in Moserah atung ua, tua mun ah Aaron a shi a, avuita uhi. Tuachi’n atapa Eleazar in ama thahengin siempu na asem hi.","ref":"Kisim. 20.28; 33.38"},"7":{"text":"Khum mun apat in akipandoh ua, Gudgodah mun atung ua; Gudgodah akipat in lui tuite tamna gam Jotbath atung uhi."},"8":{"text":"Khum hun laiin Mangpa’n Levi phung khu, tuni tana Mangpa thuhun bawm pawding leh A nna seppieh a, Mangpa masanga ding diing leh Amin phat dingin akhentuom ta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 3.5-8"},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin Levi in a unaute lah ah tanvou leh goutan anei sih hi; Mangpa na Pasian un akung ua a chiemsa bangin, Mangpa khu a goutan uh ahi."},"10":{"text":"“Tualeh masanglaima bangin muol tungah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli ka um a, tualeh khumlaiin zong Mangpa’n ka thu angaikhie a, Mangpa’n noute ahing sumang nuom ta sih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.28"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah, Thou inlen mipite makai inlen pui in; amaute pieh dinga apu leh pate uh kunga ka kichiemna gam aluo theina dingun, achi hi."},"12":{"text":"“Khaile, Israelte aw, Mangpa na Pasian un nou apat ahing phut bang ahiei: Mangpa na Pasian khu na giin ua, alampite na zui ua tualeh Ama na it ua na lungtang zousie leh na hinna zousie ua ana nasep u’leh;"},"13":{"text":"Tunia na hoina ding ua, thu ka hing pieh, Mangpa thupiehte leh adanthute zui khu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ngai un, van leh vansangpente leh leitung leh a sunga um zousie Mangpa na Pasian ua ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh napu leh pate uh it ding pen Mangpa kipahna lamtah ahia, anua ua ahahasuonte uh noute mama khu midang zousie tungah ahing na telta hi, tunia
