na hi bangun."},"16":{"text":"Tua ziehin na lungtang tep uh tan unlen paupeng nawn sih un."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa na Pasian u khu, pasiente Pasian leh mangpate Mangpa, Pasian silbawlthei leh thupi leh chizat huoi, koima deisah tuom neilou, golguh na zong la ngailou, Pasian ahi.","ref":"1 Tim. 6.15; Kihil. 17.14; 19.16; Nasep. 10.34; Rom. 2.11; Gal. 2.6; Eph. 6.9"},"18":{"text":"Aman Pa neiloute leh meithaite tungthu vai ahawm pieh a, Aman gamdang mite khu nehletah, sille ten pie in alungsiet hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin gamdang mite it un; nou zong Izipt gam ah mikhuol nana hi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian u’khu na giin ding uh ahi, Ama nna nasep pieh ding ua, Ama na tudet ding ua, tualeh Amin a na kichiem ding uh ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ama khu na phat dingpa uh ahi, tam na mit ua na mu taah uh, sil thupitah leh chizat huoi tahte hing bawlpiehpa khu na Pasian uh ahi."},"22":{"text":"Napu leh pate uh mi sawm sagi Izipt ah a peisuh ua, tuin vang Mangpa na Pasian un a tamlam in van a aasi zain ahing tam sah ta hi.","ref":"Siem. 46.27; Siem. 15.5; 22.17"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mangpa na Pasian uh it unlen, athupiehte adanthute leh avaihawmna danthute leh a thupiehte na zui ding uh ahi.","title":"Thupiehte zila zui ding"},"2":{"text":"Tuni’n thei un, Mangpa na Pasian uh, thununnate, athupidante, akhut hatdante, abanzah dante;"},"3":{"text":"Achiemtenate, asilbawlte, Izipt gam sunga, Izipt leengpa Pharaoh tung leh agam sung zousie a abawlte.","ref":"Pawt. 7.8—12.13"},"4":{"text":"Izipt galkapte tung leh asakolte uh tung leh asakollengte utunga abawl dante, noute ahing nuadel lai ua; tuipisan a amaute atumsah dante leh tunia Mangpa’n amaute asuhmang dante.","ref":"Pawt. 14.28"},"5":{"text":"Tam mun na hing tun masangsie ua, gamdai a na tung ua, asilbawl dante;"},"6":{"text":"Reuben tapa Eliab tapa Dathan leh Abiram tunga abawl dante: lei in akam akah a, a innkuonpite zousie u’leh, a puonbuhte u’leh, Israel tate lah a kipat a, anei alam zousie utoh avaltum dan, theikhalou leh mu khalou, na tate kung ua, thu gen ka hi sih hi.","ref":"Kisim. 16.31,32"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh na mit ngei un, Mangpa sil thupi bawl zousie na mu uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Tuaziehin na hing hat theina ding u’leh, na va luo ding uh gam a, na lut ua na luo theina ding un;"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh khuoizu leh nawitui luonna gam, napu leh pate u’leh ahah asuonte u’kunga pieh ding a Mangpa’n achiemsa gam a naten sawt theina dingun, tunia thupieh ka hing piehte zousie na zui ding uh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tua nava luo ding uh gam khu, na hing pawtdoh na uh Izipt haichi na tu ua, na keng ua tui nabuoh uh ante louhing huon bang ahi sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh na valuo ding uh gam khu, van guo tui ne muol leh guomte ahizaw uhi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un akep zing gam ahia; Mangpa na Pasian uh mit, atungah atu ngitnget hi, kumbul a kipat in kumtawp tandong in."},"13":{"text":"“Tualeh hichi ahing hiding a, Mangpa na Pasian uh it ding leh na lungtang zousie u’leh na hinna zousie ua, ana semdinga ka thupieh tunia ka hing piehte phatuomngaitah a, na zui u’leh;","ref":"Siempu. 26.3-5; Danp. 7.12-16; 28.1-14"},"14":{"text":"tuachi’n na gam guotui uh ahuntahin, guotui ke masa leh guotui ke nukhia ka hing pe ding a, tuachi’n na bute uh, na uoin tha te uh leh na sathaute uh na lakhawm thei ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh na ganhonte ua dingin na gam uah hampa ka pousah dinga; nouten zong na ne ding ua na tai ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Pilvang un khuchilouin na lungtang uh sol in aum dinga, na piel mang ua, pasien dangte nna nasem ding ua, na be kha ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na khuchi u’leh, Mangpa lungthahna khu na tung uah akuong ding a, guo zuhlouna ding in vankot a khah dinga, leiin aga asuo sih dinga; tualeh Mangpa’n ahing pieh gam hoi a kipat in na mangthai ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"“Tuaziehin tam ka thute na lungtang u’leh, na hinna uah na koi ding ua, chiemtena ding in na khut uah naviel ding ua, na mit kaal uah talgahna bang in na nei ding uhi.","ref":"Danp. 6.6-9"},"19":{"text":"Tamte khu na tate uh na hil ding ua, na inn ua na tou chieng un, lampi a na pei chieng un, tualeh na thaw chieng bang un, na gen zel ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh na kotbiengte u’leh na kottungte uah na giel ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n napu leh pate u’kunga pieh dinga akichiemna gam ah na dam sung nite u’leh na tate uh dam sung nite vante nite bang in asawt ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh it ding leh alampite zousie zui dinga, tualeh Ama tudet chinten dinga, na bawl ding ua nou ka hing pieh tam thupiehte pilvangtah a na zuipou u’leh;"},"23":{"text":"Mangpa’n tam namte zousie ahing deldoh pieh dinga, nou sanga thupizaw leh silbawlthei zaw namte gam na luo ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Na keng phang ua, na totkhahna pouma uh nou a ahi dinga, gamdai akipat Lebanon dong, tualeh Euphrates lui akipat tumlam tuipi dongin, na gam uh ahi ding hi.","ref":"Josh. 1.3-5"},"25":{"text":"Mi koima na masang uah ading ngam sih ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian un na kung ua agensa bangin, nava tot ding gam zousie uah, noute giinna leh zauna a um sah ding hi."},"26":{"text":"“Ngai un tuni in na masang uah guolzawlna leh gausapna ka koi hi."},"27":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh thupieh tunia ka hing piehte na zui u’leh guolzawlna;"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian uh thupiehte zuilou a, na thei ngailou uh pasien dangte be dinga tunia ka hing thupiehte na pielsan u’leh gausapna."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi ding a, nava luoding uh gam a, Mangpa na Pasian un ahing puilut chiengin, guolzawlna khu Gerizim muol ah na koi ding ua, gausapna Ebal muol tungah.","ref":"Danp. 27.11-14; Josh. 8.33-35"},"30":{"text":"Na theisa bangun, tam muolte gel khu Jordan luigal nitumna lam a, lampi Arabah gamsunga teng Kanaanmite gamsung Gilgal toh kigalsai Moreh gangpi sing kunga um ahi sih uh amah."},"31":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh gam, valuo dingin Jordan na kan ding uh ahi, na luo ding ua khunah na teng ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh tunia na masang ua ka koi thupiehte leh vaihawmna dante zousie zui dingin na pilvang ding uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mangpa napu leh pate uh Pasian in ahing pieh gam na luo ua, leitunga na um sungsie ua, pilvangtah a, na zui ding uh dante leh vaihawmna dante tamte ahi hi.","title":"Munsiengthou dan khat mai mai"},"2":{"text":"Na valuo ding uh gam a namten taang tungte leh muol tungte leh sing hing chinteng nuoi lah a, a pasiente uh abiehna munte zousie uh na suhsiet pieh ding uh ahi."},"3":{"text":"A maitamte uh na suhsiet pieh ding ua, amilim suongphute uh na satguoi ding ua, tualeh singa kibawl a pasien limte uh mei in na hal ding ua; amilim khenthute uh na satpua pieh ding ua, tua mun akipat aminte uh na phietmang pieh ding uh ahi.","ref":"Danp. 7.5"},"4":{"text":"Tuabang silte toh Mangpa na Pasian uh na bieh lou ding uh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa na Pasian un, na nam zousie lah ua amin umna dinga aguot min na sui zaw ding ua khunah na peizawding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuamun ah na halmang sillatte uh, na kithoinate uh, na sawma khatte uh, na thuchiemna sillatte uh, na khut ua na vei sillatte uh, na kiphalna sillatte uh leh na ganhonte u’leh na belamhonte u’lah a, pieng masapente na hing tawi ding uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh khummun ah Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah na ne ding ua, nou leh na innkuonpite utoh, Mangpa’n ahing guolzawlna, na khut nasep tung uah nuom tahin na um ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Michin in amauh mitmu a hoi asahdan banga, tunia ibawl bang ua, na bawl ding uh ahi vawt sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un na luo ding ua ahing pieh gam leh khawlna mun leh gam ah nahing tung naita di sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Jordan lui na galkai ua, Mangpa na Pasian un luodinga, ahing piehna gam a na ten chiengun, bittah a na um theina ding ua, na kimvel ua na melmate zousie ua kipat khawldamna ahing pieh chiengin;"},"11":{"text":"Tuatahchiengin Mangpa na Pasian un, Amin umsahna dinga aguotna mun ah na hing tawi ding ua, thu ka hing pieh zousie khunah na hing tawi ding uh ahi, na halmang sillalte uh, na kithoinate uh, na sawma khatte uh, na khut ua na vei sillatte uh, na Mangpa kunga na kichiemna sillat hoi nou noute uh na hing tawi ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah, nou leh na tapate u’leh, na tanute u’leh, na suohpa u’leh, na suohnute utoh, nuomsatahin na um ding uhi, na huongsung ua um Levi mite toh zong; aziehpen amaun na lah uah tanvou anei sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mun na muna pou ua, na halmang sillatte uh lan lou dingin pilvang un."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh na namte u’lah a Mangpa’n a guot ding mun ah na halmang sillatte uh na lan zaw ding ua, khummun ah thu kahing pieh zousie na bawl ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"“Bangtenghileh, Mangpa na Pasian un, guolzawlna ahing pieh dungzui a, na hinna un alunggul pouma na huongsung zousie uah, sa na gou thei ding ua, na ne thei ding uhi; a siengloute leh a siengten zong sangaite, sakhi sate akibangin ane thei ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Sisan vang na neh ding uh ahisih a, lei a tui buoh banga na buoh ding uh ahi.","ref":"Siem. 9.4; Siempu. 7.26,27; 17.10-14; 19.26; Danp. 15.23"},"17":{"text":"Na huongsung uah na bu uh sawma khatte ahiei, na uoin thate uh ahiei, na sathaute uh ahiei, na ganhonte u’leh na belam honte uh tapieng masate ahiei, na sillatte uh khat poupou, na kichiemna sillatte uh ahiei, na kiphalna bang ua na sillatte u’ahiei na khut ua na vei sillatte u’ahiei, na neh theilou ding uh ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa na Pasian un amun guot ding ah, Mangpa na Pasian u’masangah, noute leh na tapate u’leh, na tanute u’leh, na suohpate u’leh na suohnute u’leh na huongsung ua um Levimite toh na ne zaw ding uhi, tualeh Mangpa na Pasian uh masanga na khut ngapna pou uah nuomsa tahin na um ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na gam ua na dam sungsie un Levimite ngaisah lou a koi lou dingin pilvangun."},"20":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian un ahing thuchiem banga, na gamgi uh ahing kehlet pieh chiengin, na hinna un saneh alunggul zieha sa kane ut hi na chi hun chiengun, na hinna un a lunggul pouma na ne thei ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un Amin umna dinga deitel a aguotna mun khu nou apata agamlat seng leh Mangpa’n ahing pieh na ganhonte u’leh na belamhonte lah ua te, thu ka hing pieh bangin na gou thei ding ua, na hinna un alunggul lampang na huongsung uah na ne ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Sangai sa leh sakhi sate akineh bang in, na ne ding ua, asieng leh asienglou ten zong akibangin na ne ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Asisan ne vawtlou dingin pilvang un, sisan khu hinna ahi, hinna nangawn toh sa na neh ding uh ahi sih hi.","ref":"Siempu. 17.10-14"},"24":{"text":"Na ne vawtsih ding ua, tui banga lei a, na buoh ding uh ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa mitmu a sildih na bawl u’leh, nou leh na nua chieng ua na tate ua dinga ahoi theina ding in tuakhu na ne sih ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Na sil siengthou neite u’leh na kichiemna sillatte maimai uh tawi unlen, Mangpa’n deitel a aguot na ding mun ah na pei zel ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh na halmang sillatte u’leh sa leh sisan khu Mangpa na Pasian uh maitam tungah na lan ding ua, tualeh na kithoina sisan khu Mangpa na Pasian maitam tungah na sungbaw ding ua, asa na ne ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tam ka hing thupiehte zousie ngaisah unlen, pilvang tahin ngaikhie un, tuachi’n Mangpa na Pasian uh mitmu in sil hoi leh dih na bawl ding ua, nou ding leh na nua ua na tate uh dingin kumtawnin ahing hoitou zel ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian un, na luoding uh gam a namte na masang ua kipat ahing suhbei pieh sienga, na deldoh ua, agam ua na ten hun chiengun;","title":"Milim biehlou ding"},"30":{"text":"Na masang ua pat a suhmangthai a aum bang ua na awhkhahlou na dingun pilvang unlen, tam namten bangchibangin ahiei a pasiente uh nna aseppieh uh? a bawl bangun eiten zong ibawl ding uh chiin, a pasiente uh tungtang kan se sih un."},"31":{"text":"Tuabangin Mangpa na Pasian tung uah na bawl ding uh ahisih hi; a pasien tung uah Mangpa theiin sil kidahhuoi chinteng ahuot mamate abawl zel ua, atapate u’leh atanute ngel u’zong a pasiente ua dingin mei ah ahal zel uhi."},"32":{"text":"“Zui dinga thu ka hing pieh pouma pilvang tahin zui un, na belap dinguh ahisih a, na lahkiem ding uh zong ahi sih hi.","ref":"Danp. 4.2; Kihil. 22.18,19"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Na lah ua guolnei ahiei, mangsan mi hiei, a hing umdoh a, chiemtena ahiei, sillamdang ahiei, ahing etsah a;","title":"Milim bieh zieha gawtna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh chiemtena ahiei, sillamdang ahiei ahing etsah khu ahing tangtun a na kung ua, na thei ngailou uh pasien dangte izui ding ua, ana uh iseppieh ding uh, achi u’leh;"},"3":{"text":"tua guolneipa ahiei leh mangsanpa ahiei, thu gente na ngaikhieh ding uh ahi sih hi. Mangpa na Pasian uh na lungtang zousie u’leh na hinna zousie un na it na uoi mah chi theina dinga Mangpa na Pasian un ahing etkhiehna ahi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh nua na zui ding ua, Ama giindan na siem ding ua, athupiehte na zui ding ua, athugente na mang ding ua, anate na sem ding ua, Ama na tuhdet chinten ding uh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh tua guolneipa ahiei, Mangsanmi ahiei khu, thalia ding ahi, azieh pen aman Izipt gam a kipat a, nou hing puidohpa leh na saltanna inn ua kipata hing tandohpa, kihei mangsan dingin, Mangpa na Pasian un zuidinga thu ahingpieh lampi akipat hing piel sah tum a, Mangpa na Pasian uh tunga helna thu agen ziehin. Tuabangin na lah ua kipat a sil hoilou na koimang ding uh ahi."},"6":{"text":"“Na sanggampa, na nu tapa ahiei, na tapa ahiei, na tanu ahiei, na pom lai na zi ahiei, na lawm nangma hinna banga na ngaivawt ahiei nangawn in zong, simthama ahing solbawl ua, kisa vaiin, nangleh napu leh paten zong athei ngailou, pasien dangte na sem vai chia aguh a ahing zawl u’leh;"},"7":{"text":"Na kim navel u’leh na kung nai ua um ahiei, nou a kipata gamlapi kawlmong langkhat akipata kawlmong lelam donga um mite pasiente, bevai in ana u’zong sem vai achi u’leh;"},"8":{"text":"Pha na sahpi ding uh ahi sih, athu zong na ngaikhieh ding uh ahi sih a, hepina mit a zong na et ding uh ahisih, na khawi ding u’zong ahisih a, tualeh na iim ding u’zong ahi sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh na thalia ngei ngei ding uh ahizaw hi, thatlia dingin khut naha masa pen dinga, tuazou chiengin midang zousie in aha ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh ama khu ashi masangsie na sep dinga, na selia tei tei dinguh ahi, Izipt gam a na saltanna inn a kipat a hing puidohpa Mangpa na Pasian uh kunga kipat a ahing puimangna ding a sui ziehin."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelmi zousie in a za ding ua, a zau ding ua, na lah ua tuabang tatsietna mawngmawng a bawl nawn sih ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian un na tenna ding ua ahing pieh na khopite uh khat a, na lah ua pat migilou lawikhat hing pawtkhie a;"},"13":{"text":"Khum khopi a mite, na thei ngailou uh pasien dangte be dingin apuimang chi na thei u’leh;"},"14":{"text":"Kan chien unlen sui chien un, tualeh phatuomngai tahin dongun. Tualeh tam thu khu thudih ana hi a khumbanga sil kidahhuoi na lah ua a kibawl nahi chi theichien ahileh;"},"15":{"text":"Khum khopi a tengte, namsau a na satlia ngei ngei ding uh ahi; asunga tengte zousie leh aganhon zousie u’toh namsau a na suhmang thai sieng ding uh ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh gallah sum zousie khu khopi laikim tah ah na sie khawm ding ua, khuo leh gallah sum zousie khu Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin meiin na haltum ding uhi; khumkhu tungvum lienpi asuoh denta ding a, tunding kia ahinawn sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin hamsethuoh sil bangma na khut ua aum ding ahi sih hi, tuachi’n Mangpa’n alungthahna zauhuoitah akiheisan dinga, napu leh pate u’kunga akichiemna bang in noute ahing khotuo ding a, na tung uah hepina anei ding a, ahing pung sah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh mitmu a sil dih bawl ding a, tunia ka hing pieh a thupieh zousie zui dinga Mangpa na Pasian uh thugen na ngai khiet bang un."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Noute Mangpa na Pasian uh tate na hi ua, mishi ziehin na tahsa tunguh na at ding uh ahisih a, na hum sam u’zong na heukieu ding uh ahi sih hi.","title":"Lawkite mishi uopdan zuilou ding","ref":"Siempu. 19.28; 21.5"},"2":{"text":"Noute Mangpa na Pasian ua dinga nam siengthou na hi ua, tualeh leitung nam zousie lah apat Ama goutan tuom ding mawngmawng a, Mangpa’n ahing teldoh na hi uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 19.5,6; Danp. 4.20; 7.6; 26.18; Tit. 2.14; 1 Pet. 2.9"},"3":{"text":"“Sil kidahhuoi mawngmawng na nehlou ding uh ahi.","title":"Sa sieng leh sienglou"},"4":{"text":"Tamte na neh thei ding uh gantate ahi: Bawngtal, belam leh kel."},"5":{"text":"Sakhi, sangai, sazuhtal, gamkel, sakel, Zangsiel leh gambelam."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh sate lah a akeng chin kaa a aka peisuoh, ann kia hai pouma na ne thei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahivang in sate lah a annkia hai a, a keng chin u’lah kaa ngalte, sa ngawngsau bang, zupi leh bilpite bang na neh lou ding uh ahi; aziehpen tam saten annkia ahai vang un akeng chinte uh akaa sih a, tuaziehin nou a dingin a siengsih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh voh pen akeng chin akaa vangin annkia ahai lou ziehin nou adingin sienglou ahia, asa na neh ding uh ahisih a, ashiluong zong na tham khah ding uh ahisih hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tuisunga tengte lah ah tamte na ne thei ding uhi; veng leh lip nei zousie na ne ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh veng leh lip neilou pouma na ne thei sih ding uhi; tuate nou a dinga sienglou ahi."},"11":{"text":"“Va sieng zousie na nethei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh tamte vang na nehlou ding uh ahi, mukel langta, muvanlai,"},"13":{"text":"Musan, mubuong, mukhau leh mu zat mawngmawngte,"},"14":{"text":"Va-ah zat pouma."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Simbu, vabah, va ngawngkieu leh tuivakhu, tualeh mukhau leh mu neu zat pouma."},"16":{"text":"Simbuneu, simbulien leh simbukangte,"},"17":{"text":"Tuivatawt, musane, kaikuong gal."},"18":{"text":"Tuivakengsang, tuiva ngawngsau leh azat pouma, suongpal leh baah;"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh ganhing bohvah leengthei pouma nou a ding in sienglou ahi dinga, na nehlou ding uh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Va sieng zousie na ne thei ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Ama a shi bangma na neh ding uh ahisih, na huongsunga um gamdang mite neh ding in nape thei ding uhi, ahisihleh namdang mite kungah zong na zua thei ding uhi, aziehpen Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin noute nam siengthou na hi uhi. “Kelnou api nawitui a na huon ding ahi sih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.19; 34.26"},"22":{"text":"“Kumchin in nalou ua na hawsuo pieng zousie uh, sawma khat dihtah a, na pieh ngei ngei ding uh ahi.","title":"Sawma khat pieh dante","ref":"Siempu. 27.30-33; Kisim. 18.21"},"23":{"text":"Mangpa na pasien uh giindan na theisiem ngitnget na dingun na bu u’leh, na uoin tha u’leh, na sathaute uh sawm a khat, na ganhon u’leh na belamhon lah ua pieng masapente uh, Mangpa na Pasian uh masang ah, Amin umna dinga a guotna ding mun ah, na neh ding uh ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa na Pasian un ahing guolzawl hun chienga, Mangpa na Pasian un amin umna dinga aguotna mun khu nou a dinga agamlat seng tahluot zieh a, ahisihleh alampite asau seng zieha, na sawm ua khatte na hing tawi thei sih u’leh."},"25":{"text":"Tuate khu sum na suo ding ua, tua sum khu na khut un na hing tawi ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian un a umna ding a guotna mun ah, na pei ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh tua sum khu na lungtang un alunggul pouma, bawngtal ahiei, belam ahiei, uoin ahiei, zuchia ahiei, ahisihleh na lungtang un adeilam pouma adingin na zang ding ua, tualeh khunah Mangpa na Pasian uh masang ah na ne ding ua, nou leh na innkuonte utoh nuomsa tahin na um ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Na huongsung ua um Levimite ngaisah louin na taisan ding uh ahi sih hi; azieh pen amauten na lah uah tanvou leh goutan anei sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"“Kumthum achin kum tawp chiengin, khum kuma na hawsuoh sil tungte zousie ua, sawma khat na hing tawikhawm ding ua, na umna huong sung uah na koi ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh na huongsung ua um Levimite zong (Amaun na lah ua tanvou leh goutan anei lou zieh un) tualeh na huongsung ua um gamdangmi, paneiloute leh meithaiten ane ding ua, ahing khosa thei ding uhi, tuachi’n Mangpa na Pasian un na khut nasep leh silbawl zousie uah ahing guolzawl thei ding hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Kum sagi abei chin in, leibat ngaidamna na bawl ding uh ahi.","title":"Sabbath kum"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh ngaidam ding dan khu tambang ding ahi, leiba basahmi poumain a innvengte aleitawisah khu angaidam ding uh ahi, a innveng ahiei, a unau ahiei zong aphul paupau ding ahisih hi, aziehpen tam khu Mangpa ngaidamna kichi khu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Gamdangmi ahileh na phul teitei thei ding uhi, hinanleh na unau in nou a abat khah pouma na ngaidam ding uh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tami ziehin koima na gentheisah sih ding uhi, azieh pen Mangpa na Pasian un na luo ding ua ahing pieh gam ah thupitahin a hing guol zawl ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tunia ka hing pieh tam thupiehte zousie zuidinga Mangpa na Pasian uh thugen pilvang tah a na ngai khieh pou ua ahileh;"},"6":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un ahing chiem bangin, ahing guolzawl dinga, nam tampite na leitawi sah ding ua, nou vangin na leitawi sih ding uh, nam tampite tungah vai na hawm ding ua; noute tungah koiman vai ahawm sih ding uh."},"7":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh ding gam a na umna ua, na khopi huongsung ua, na unaute lah a, mi genthei a um leh na unau gentheipa tungah na lungtang khausah sih unlen, chip zong na chiplou ding uh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 25.35"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh atung uah na silphal mama ding ua, atahsapna uh awng huhna ding khop na leitawi sah ding uh ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ngaidamna kum, kum sagina hing tung ding ahita chiin na unau genthei tunga mudana lungsim nei a, bangma pephallou a na lungtanga ngaituona giloutah um loudingin pilvangun, khuchilou in aman na tungah Mangpa ahan dinga, nanga dingin khelna ahi kha ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Na pieh ngei ngei ding uh ahi, na pieh chieng ua zong na lungtang uh na natsah ding uh ahisih hi, tam silte ziehin ahi, Mangpa na Pasian un, na sil bawl zousie u’leh nasep zousie u’leh na khut ngatna zousie uh ahing guolzawl ding."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen khum gam alah migenthei umlou lai a um sih dinga, tuaziehin na gam ua na unaute uh tung leh mi tasamte leh gentheite tungah panpina lungsim nei a silphal mama dingin thu ka hing pie hi.","ref":"Mat. 26.11; Mak. 14.7; Jn. 12.8"},"12":{"text":"“Na unau Hebru pasal ahiei, Hebru numei ahiei, na kung ua ahing zua u’leh, kum guhsung na nna uh asem ding ua, akum sagina kum ah navahtahin na pawt sah ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 25.39-46"},"13":{"text":"Nou a kipat a zalentah a, na pawtsah hun chiengun khutguoha na pawtsah lou ding uh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Na belamhonte ua kipat, na buphuol ua kipat, na uoin suhna khuh ua kipat in, itlou tahin na pe ding uhi; Mangpa na Pasian un ahing guolzawl dan dungzui in nape ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Izipt gam ah suoh leh sal in na nna umta ua, Mangpa na Pasian un ahing tandoh chi na thei zing ding uh ahi; Tuaziehin tuniin tam thute ka hing pie ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, noute leh na innkuonpite uh angai man u’leh, na kunga um nuom asah zieh ua, ka hing pawtsan sih ding achi u’leh;"},"17":{"text":"Siatul khat na la ding ua, kotlam zungah abil uh na vu pieh ding uhi, tuachi’n kumtawn in na suoh uh ahi ding uhi. Tualeh na suohnu u’zong tua mabangin na bawl ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Na kung ua pat a na pawtsah ding u’pen nou a dinga sil hasa a, na ngailou ding uh ahi, aziehpen kilaw suoh nasep leni sem in kum guh sung na nna ahing sep piehta hi. Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian un nasep nabawl zousie uah ahing guolzawlta hi."},"19":{"text":"“Na ganhonte lah u’leh na belam honte lah ua atal pieng masapente zousie, Mangpa na Pasian uh tuom dingin na pe ding uhi; na bawngtal pieng masapen uh nna sema na zah ding uh ahisih a, na belam pieng masapen u’zong amul na met ding uh ahi sih hi.","title":"Ganta pieng masa Mangpa ading","ref":"Pawt. 13.12"},"20":{"text":"Nang leh na innkuonpiten, Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah, kum chinin Mangpa’n adei tel mun guot ding munah nane ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh nuolna um ahiei, akengbai ahiei, mitto ahiei, nuolna um mawngmawng, Mangpa na Pasian uh kunga kithoina dinga na zah ding uh ahi sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Na khopi sungte uah na ne ding uhi; mi siengloute leh siengten zong kibangin sangaite leh sakhite bangin na ne thei ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"A sisan pen vang na neh vawtlou ding uh ahi; tuol a tui buoh banga na buoh ding uh ahi.","ref":"Siem. 9.4; Siempu. 7.26,27; 17.10-14; 19.26; Danp. 12.16,23"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“ABIB ha tang unlen, Mangpa na Pasian ua ding in peikan annkuong luina dingin zang un. Abib ha in Mangpa na Pasian un Izipt gam a kipat zanlai a, ahing puidoh ziehin.","title":"Pawi bawl dante peikan pawi","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-20; Siempu. 23.5-8; Kisim. 28.16-25"},"2":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n amin umna dinga adeitelna ding mun ah, Mangpa na Pasian kung uah, na ganhon lah u’leh na belam honte lah ua kipat in peikan pawi dingin na kithoi ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tanghou tol kisaw toh na neh ding uh ahisih hi; na damsung teng ua Izipt gam a kipat a, na pawtdoh ni uh na theizingna dingun, kisuhgimna tanghou tolsawlou toh ni sagi sung na ne ding uhi; aziehpen Izipt gam apat kinawtah a pawtdoh na hi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh na gam sung uah ni sagi sung mawngmawng tol akimukhah vawtlou ding ahi, tualeh ni khatni nitahlam a na kithoina sa uh zan tungtawn leh azingni zingmawng tandongin bangma a um ding ahi sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh na khopi huongsung kholai pou ah peikan pawi kithoina na bawl thei sihding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa na Pasian un Amin umna dinga a guotna ding mun maimai ah ahidinga, khum mun ah, Izipt gam a kipat a na hing pawtdoh hun laitah uh nitahlam nitumkuon chiengin, peikan pawi kithoina in na kithoi ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh mei ah na em ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian un aguot ding mun ah nane ding uhi, tualeh zingmawng chieng in na kinuale ding ua, na puon inn uah na pei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ni guh sung tanghou tolsawlou na ne ding ua, tualeh ani sagini pen Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin khawmpi siengthou ahi dinga, khum hun sungin nna nasep ding uh ahi sih hi."},"9":{"text":"“Nipikaal sagi nasim ding ua, na bu lah chiil ua kipat in na pan ding uhi.","title":"Nipikaal pawi","ref":"Siempu. 23.15-21; Kisim. 28.26-31"},"10":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un ahing guolzawl bang zel a na khut nasep ga suote lah ua, nouma ut thu a na silpiehte uh lan in, Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin nipikaal pawi na bawl ding uh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian un Amin umna dinga a guotna mun dingah, na suohpate uh, na suohnute uh, na khopi huongsung ua um Levimite, na lah ua um gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite toh Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah nuomsa tahin na um ding uh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt gamah suoh leh sal na hi uh chi zong na theizing ding uh ahi, tualeh tam dan thupiehte pilvangtah a na zui ding uh ahi."},"13":{"text":"“Na buphuol ua kipat leh na uoin suhna khuh ua kipat a na sehkhawm zou chiengun, ni sagi sung hampheng pawi na bawl ding uh ahi.","title":"Hampheng pawi","ref":"Siempu. 23.33-36,39-43; Kisim. 29.12-38"},"14":{"text":"Na pawi bawlna uah noutoh, na tapate, na tanute, na suohpate, na suohnute leh na khopi huongsung ua um Levimite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite toh nuomtahin na um ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa’n adeitelna mun ah, Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin ni sagi sung vingveng pawi na bawl ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian un na hawsuo zousie u’leh na khut nasep silbawl zousie uh ahing guolzawl dinga, kipahtah in na umkhawm chiet ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Kumkhat sungin na pasalte zousie uh, Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah Aman ahing guotpiehna ding mun ah akilang ding uhi, tolsawlou tanghou pawi ah, nipikalte pawi ah, tualeh hampheng pawi ah; Mangpa masangah khutguoh a akilat ding uh ahi sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un guolzawlna ahing musah bang zelin michin in apieh thei kham kham uh ape ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh na khopi huongsung zousie uah, na nam sung chiet ua pat in vaihawmte leh lamkaite na kiguot chiet ding uh ahi, tualeh amauten mipite vai dihtah in a hawm pieh ding uhi.","title":"Thudih a vaihawm ding dan"},"19":{"text":"Thudih khu na ut dan un heikawi sih unlen, koima deisahtuom na nei ding uh ahi sih, ne zong negu sih un, nehguhin mipilte mit atosah a, midihte dihna zong aheikawi pieh hi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.6-8; Siempu. 19.15"},"20":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh gam, dama na luo theina dingun dihtatna na zui ding uh ahi."},"21":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian uh maitam na bawlna gei ah singa kibawl milimte na phulou ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.13"},"22":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un a huot suong milim khuomte zong na phu dinguh ahi sih hi.","ref":"Siempu. 26.1"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Bawngtal ahiei, belamtal ahiei, nuolna nei leh genbang mawngmawng a, Mangpa na Pasian u’kunga na kithoi ding uh ahi sih hi, khum khu Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin sil kidahhuoi ahi."},"2":{"text":"“Na lah ua Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh na umna khopi huongsung khat poupou uah zong pasal ahiei, numei ahiei, thuhun palsan a, Mangpa na Pasian uh mitmu a, silgilou abawl ua;","title":"Milim bieh tungtang"},"3":{"text":"Ka thupiehte zuilou a, pasien dangte ni hiin, ha hiin van a um van thupina khat pou pou nna asep ua, amaute a bieh u’leh;","ref":"Pawt. 22.20"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh tua khu ahing kihil a, nouten na zah ua, phatuomngaitah a na kan chien ua; tualeh ngaiin tuabang sil kidahhuoi Israelte lah a akibawlna hi chi adih a, akichientah ngel ahileh;"},"5":{"text":"Tua silgilou bawlmi pasal ahiei, numei ahiei, khu na kulpi kotkha pulam ah na puidoh ding ua, tua Pasal ahiei, numei ahiei khu suongin na seplia ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Theipimi ni ahiei, thum ahiei, kam a kipata theichet na toh suhlup ding mi khu, suonga selia ahi dinga, hinanleh theipimi khat kam a pat selia ding ahi sih hi.","ref":"Kisim. 35.30; Danp. 19.15; Mat. 18.16; 2 Kor. 13.1; 1 Tim. 5.19; Heb. 10.28"},"7":{"text":"Ama selupna ding in theipi miten atung ah khut aha masa ding ua, tuazou chiengin mipite zousie’n a khut uh aha ding uh, tuabangin na lah ua pat silgilou na koimang ding uh ahi.","ref":"1 Kor. 5.13"},"8":{"text":"“Na khopi sung ua sisan suo thute, dihna kituna thute, kivuoh kisatna thute, kituoh louna thu zousie nou a dinga thukhen hamsataluo ahing um leh, Mangpa na Pasian un mun ahing guot piehna ding mun ah na pei ding ua,","title":"Vaihawm dan leh kilepna dan"},"9":{"text":"Khum hun a siempu Levite leh vaihawm mite kungah na hing pei ding ua, na dong ding uhi; tuachi’n amauten na thukhen dan ding ahing hil ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n nouten Mangpa’n mun ahing guot piehna ding a kipat a, thutan dingdan ahing na kawhmu dung zui un na bawl ding ua, tualeh ahing kawhmu dan bang zel un pilvang tahin na bawl ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Thutan dan ang na hilte u’leh vaihawm dan ang na kawhmu dan bang zel in na bawl ding uhi, thutan dan ang na kawhmute uh zietlam ahiei, veilam ahiei a, na pielsan ding uh ahi sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh masanga, nasem a ding zing siempu leh, thukhenmi, thugen sanglou a, engtat tei tei mi khu, ashi ngei ngei ding ahi. Israelte lah ah tuabang mi gilou na suhmang ding uh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi zousien aza ding ua, azau ding ua a engtat ngam nawn sih ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh ding gam nava tun ua, nava luo ua, nava ten ua, i kim ivel a nam zousiete bangin leeng nei va ui, na hing chi hun chieng un.","title":"Leengpa vaihawm ding dan","ref":"1 Sam. 8.5"},"15":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un ateldoh pen pen leengpa in na nei ding uh ahi, na unau lah ua mikhat na leengpa ding ua na bawl dinguh ahi, na unau uh hilou, gamdangmi na bawl ding uh ahi sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh aman sakol tampi nei atup ding ahi sih a, sakol tampi anei theina ding in mite Izipt gam a anua sawlkia ding zong ahi sih hi; Mangpa’n lah Tubansie khum gamah na kinuale kia nawn sih ding uhi, chiin na kung uah ana genta ngal a.","ref":"1 Leeng. 10.28; 2 Khang. 1.16; 9.28"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh alungtang akiheimang louna ding in zi tampi anei ding zong ahi sih a, dangka leh sana zong tampi anei tuplou ding ahi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 11.1-8; 1 Leeng. 10.14-22,27; 2 Khang. 1.15; 9.27"},"18":{"text":"“Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, agam Mangtoupha tunga atou chiengin Levimi siemputen a kep zing uh dan khu laibu khat ah agielkhe sah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuakhu akem ding a, adam sung teng asim zel ding hi. Tam danthute leh athupiehte zousie pom a zui leh bawl ding a, Mangpa a Pasian zaudan akizil theina ding leh;"},"20":{"text":"A unaute tunga alungtang akisahthei louna ding leh, thupiehte apat zietlam ahiei, veilam ahiei a, a pielmangsan louna ding leh Israelte lah a ama leh ahahasuonte aleenggam a adamsawt theina dingun."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Levi siempute leh Levi nam zousie in Israelte lah ah, tanvou leh goutan bangma anei sih ding uhi; amauten Mangpa dinga mei a sillatte leh atantuomte uh ane ding uhi.","title":"Siempute tanvou ding"},"2":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaun a unaute ulah ah goutan anei sih ding uhi, Aman a kung ua achiem tah ma bang in Mangpa khu agoutan uh ahi ding hi.","ref":"Kisim. 18.20"},"3":{"text":"Kithoina sillat lan mipite lah apat in siempu tanvou ding khu bawngtal hiin, belam hitaleh, siempupa alieng leh akhaphang leh agilpi apieh ding uh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Na bulebal uh, na uoin uh, na sathau tung masapente u’leh na belam mulmet masahpente u’zong ama na pieh ding uh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un ama leh atapate kum tawn a Mangpa mina nasem a ding dingin na nam zousie lah ua pat atelta hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tualeh Levimi khat in Israel gam sung zousie a na khopi huongsung khat poupou pawtsan a, Mangpa’n a guot ding mun lunggul chinten a, ahing pei leh;"},"7":{"text":"Khum mun a Mangpa masanga ding zing a unau Levite mabangin, Mangpa a Pasian min in nna asem ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Asiemput man uh simlouin, midangte tanvou bang neh ding atang veve ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh gam a na hing tun chiengun, khum gam a namte sil kidahhuoi bawlte na zui ding uh ahi sih hi.","title":"Guolnei umdan leh nasepdan"},"10":{"text":"Na lah ua mi koipou atapa ahiei, atanu ahiei, milim pasien biehna kithoina sillat dinga meikuong lai a paite, ahiei, aisanmi ahiei, mangsan mi ahiei, mit phiel dawitawi ahiei, dawithu a mibumsiemte ahiei,","ref":"Siempu. 19.26; Pawt. 22.18"},"11":{"text":"Ahisihleh zawldei ai tawi mi ahiei, hagau buate toh kihoute ahiei, mishite donga aisante ahiei, mawngmawng na lah ua mukhah ahilou ding ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.31"},"12":{"text":"Azieh pen tam bang sil bawlte pouma, Mangpa dinga kidahhuoi ahia, tualeh tam sil kidahhuoite ziehin Mangpa na Pasian un amaute na masang ua pat a adelmang ahi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah na hoibukim ding uh ahi.","ref":"Mat. 5.48"},"14":{"text":"Na valuo dinguh gam a namten, mangsante leh aisante thu angaikhe leng ua, noute vang Mangpa na Pasian un tuabanga na bawl ding uh aphal sih hi."},"15":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian un keima bang na lah u’leh na unaute lah ua apat guolnei ahing tungdoh ding a; Ama thu na ngaikhieh ding uh ahi.","title":"Messiah tungtang genlawhna","ref":"Nasep. 3.22; 7.37"},"16":{"text":"Mangpa i Pasian aw hing zasah nawn sinlen, tam meikuong zong hing musah nawn sin ka shi khading uhi, chia Horeb muola na kikhopkhawm ni ua, Mangpa na Pasian uh na lunggul bangun."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah, athu gen uh agen hoi mama uhi."},"18":{"text":"A unaute lah ua kipat nangma bang guolnei khat ka tundohpieh dinga, akam ah ka thute ka koi dinga, akunga ka thupieh pouma akung uah a gen ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, ka min a agending ka thute pomlou pouma keiman ka ngaituo ding hi.","ref":"Nasep. 3.23"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh gen ding thu ka piehloupi ka min a gen teitei guolnei ahisihleh pasien dangte min a thugen guolnei ahiei, tuabang guolnei khu ashi ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Na lungtang ua Mangpa’n agenlou thu ahi chi, bangchiin ithei diei na chi ua ahileh;"},"22":{"text":"Guolnei khat in Mangpa min a thu agen a, athugen pen ahing tangtun sih a, alawchin sihleh, tua khu Mangpa genlou ahi, guolnei in agintat thu agen ahia, ama na giin ding uh ahi sih hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian un agam uh ahing pieh ding namte, Mangpa na Pasian un a suhmanga, nouten zong amaute na deldoh ua, akhopite u’leh a innte ua na ten hun chieng un;","title":"Kihumbitna khopite","ref":"Josh. 20.1-9"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un na luoding ua ahing piehna gam ah, nou a dingin khopi thum na tuom guot ding uh ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tualthat kha pouma tailut theina dingin lampite na bawl ding ua, tualeh Mangpa na Pasian un na luoding ua ahing pieh gam khu mun thum in na khen ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"“Tualeh mithatte khum mun a tailut a kihumbit thei dingte khu tambangte ahi: a innvengte toh tumasang a, kimudana zong neilou a, khut khel zieh a thatkha poumate;"},"5":{"text":"Mi a innvengpa toh sing phua dinga gamlah a kuon a, sing phua dinga aheipi alap laitah a, a heiga akipata, aheitang kitol in a innvengpa a selia khah leh, khum khopite khat pen pen ah ahinna hum bit dingin a tailut thei ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachilouin alungthah soulaitahin sisan phubala pa’n mithatpa khu nuadel vanin, lampi asau seng zieh a, delpha in asatlum kha ding hi; tumasang hun peisa a, kimudana nei ahilou ziehun shitah ahi sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin nou a dingin khopi thum na tuom guot ding uh ahi, chiin thu ka hing pie hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian un napu leh pate u’kung a ana kichiemna banga, na gam uh ahing kehlet pieh a, tualeh napu leh pate ukunga pieh achiem gam zousie ahing pieh chieng leh;"},"9":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh it ding leh alampite zui zing dinga, tunia thu ka hing piehte na bawl ua tam thupieh zousiete na zui pou ua ahileh, tam khopi thumte simlou khopidang thum ahing belap pieh ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un na goutan ding ua ahing pieh gam a mawnabei sisan akisuo lou a, na tung ua sisan maw a umlou na dingin."},"11":{"text":"“Hinanleh mi koi ahiei in a innveng a muda a, abuhdapa, asuom a, shi khop hiela, avuoh a, tualeh tam khopite lah a khat a atailut leh;"},"12":{"text":"a khopi upate un mi sawl uhenlen, khuna pat in ang pui ding ua, ashi theina dingin sisan phubalami kungah apekhe ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ama na hepi ding uh ahisih a, nou dinga a hoizawh na dingin, Israel gam akipat in mawna neilou sisan suona na koimang ding uh ahi."},"14":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian un na luo ding ua ahing pieh, na goutan gam uh na luo hun chiengun, masanglai a ana phusa na innvengte gamgi na suon pieh ding uh ahi sih hi.","title":"Gamgilui suonlou ding","ref":"Danp. 27.17"},"15":{"text":"“Mi athulimlouna ahiei, akhelna ahiei, tungtangah theipimi khat ahun sih dinga, theipimi ni kam ahiei, thum ahiei kam akipat thu suhkip ding ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 35.30; Danp. 17.6; Mat. 18.16; Jn. 8.17; 2 Kor. 13.1; 1 Tim. 5.19; Heb. 10.28"},"16":{"text":"Theipimi dihlou khat in, mi khat silbawl a dihlou a ngoh dinga akisah leh;"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n akiniel mitegel khu, Mangpa masang leh khum hunlai a siempu leh vaihawmte masang ah a ding diing uhi."},"18":{"text":"Vaihawm miten pilvangtahin akanchien ding ua, tua theipimi theipina khu adihloupi ahia, aunau tunga dihloupi a ngoh ahi leh,"},"19":{"text":"a unau tunga bawl atup bangin, ama tungah na bawl ding uhi, tuabangin na lah ua sil hoilou na suhmang ding uh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh a um nalaiten aza ding ua, a zau ding ua, tunua chiengin, tam bang silgilou na lah uah koiman abawl nawn sih ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Na hepi ding uh ahi sih a, hinna taangin hinna, mit taangin mit, ha taangin ha, khut taangin khut, keng taangin keng, ahi ding hi.","ref":"Pawt. 21.23-25; Siempu. 24.19,20; Mat. 5.38"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Na galte uh dou dinga na kuon doh ua, sakolte leh sakollengte, galkap nou sanga tamzaw na mu chiengun, na zau ding uh ahi sih hi. Izipt gam a kipat a nou hing puidohpa, Mangpa na Pasian uh na kung uah a um hi.","title":"Galdouna dante"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh na kidou kuon chiengun, siempupa mipite kungah va pei henlen, va houpi henlen a kung uah,"},"3":{"text":"Israelte aw, Ngaivawi un, tuni in na galte u’toh kidou ding na hita ua, lungkesih unlen zau sih un, chitunsih unlen, amaute giing sih un,"},"4":{"text":"Noutoh zawhkhawma na galte uh hing doupieh ding leh noute hing hundam dinga na masang ua peipa Mangpa na Pasian uh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n, lamkaiten mipite kungah, inn tha lam a lan nailou na um uoi? a inn ah nua peikia heh, kidouna ah ava shi kha dinga, midang khat in a inn a luo kha ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh grep huon bawla aga ne nailou na um uoi? a inn lamah pei kia heh, galdouna ah ava shi kha dinga mi dangin ane kha ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh, zi ding dawpsa kitenpi nailou na um uoi? a inn lamah pei kia heh, kidouna ah ashi kha dinga, mi dangin akitenpi kha ding hi, chiin agen ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n lamkaiten mipite kungah, zau leh lungkie na um uoi? a inn langah nua pei kia heh, alung kieh bangin a unaupa alung kesah kha ding hi, achi ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi ding a, lamkaiten mipite kunga thu agen zou chiengun mipite mapui ding in lamkaite aguot ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Khopi khat sim dinga na kuon ua nava nai chiengun kilemna thu gen phot un."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, ahing nakileppi ut ua, ana kipah u’leh hichi ahi ding, khuna mi um zousie, na sem dinga goi ding ahing hita ding ua, na nna uh ahing sep pieh ta ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh nou toh kilep a ut sih ua, ahing na dou u’leh na imkhum pai ding uh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian un, na khut ua ahing pieh chiengin, khunah pasal zousie namsau in na satlia sieng ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh numeite leh naupangte, tualeh ganhonte leh khopi sunga um zousie leh galvan lah sil zousie na kilah ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh na galte gallah silte zousie na kineh ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuabangin tam namte khopite hilou, na umna ua kipat a gamlapi a um khopite zousie tungah tuabangin na bawl ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa na Pasian un na goutan ding ua ahing pieh tam namte khopite a um hinna nei zousie, na hingkhawi ding uh ahisih hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa na Pasian hing thupieh banga, Hitmite, Amormite, Kanaanmite, Perizmite, Hivmite tualeh Jebusmite na thagam sieng ding uh ahi."},"18":{"text":"A pasiente uh tunga abawl leng uh sil kidahhuoi zousie ahing zilsah louna dingun, khuchilouin Mangpa na Pasian u’tungah sil na bawlkhiel kha ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"“Lah tum a na kidoupi uh khopi khu hun sawtpi na imkhum tah chieng un, tua khopi sunga singte heipi in na phua ding uh ahi sih a, na neh ding uh ahia, na khopi sim uh imna dingin phua sih un, (aziehpen gam a sing khu mihingte neh ding ann ahi.)"},"20":{"text":"Aga neh theilou singkung ahi chi na theite u’pen na phua ding ua, na sattan ding ua, ahing doute khuo asiet masangsie kul in na imkhum ding uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian un na luoding ua ahing pieh gam a, mi kithat a, gamlah a aluong lum akimu a, koitha ahiei chi akithei sih leh;","title":"Tuolthat matdohloute tunga thu khenna"},"2":{"text":"Na upate u’leh na vaihawmte uh ahing pei ding ua, mi shi kithana mun apat a kim vel a khuote gamlat dan ate ding ua."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, luong umna akipat a kho naipen, upaten bawngla nasem nailou, hahkol zong ponailou khat ahing kai ding ua,"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh khum khopi upaten bawngla khu, tui luonna, lou a kihou ngainailou, haichi zong kichiin khah nailouna guomah ahing kai suh ding ua, khum guom ah bawngla ngawng atan ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levi tapa siempute akung uah ahing pei ding ua: Mangpa na Pasian un amaute anasem ding leh Mangpa mina guolzawl dingin atelta hi; amaute thuin thu buoi leh kivuoh thu zousie vaihawm leh thukhen ahi ding."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh mi kithatpa luong umna naipen khopi upate zousie’n guoma bawngla ngawng kitan tungah akhut uh asil ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka khut un tam sisan asuo sih a, tualeh ka mit un zong amu kha sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa aw natatsa na mi Israelte ngaidam inlen, na mi Israelte tungah mawna neilou sisan suona khelna a um phal sin, chi’n adawng ding uhi. Tuachi’n sisan thu ah ngaidam ahi ding uh."},"9":{"text":"Tuabangin Mangpa mitmu ah sildih bawlin, mawna neilou sisan suona khu na lah ua pat na koimang thei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Nagalte uh sim dinga na kuondoh ua, Mangpa na Pasian un amaute na khut ua ahing pieh a, sal a na pui chiengun;","title":"Sal numeite pasal neidan"},"11":{"text":"Na sal matte lah ua numei melhoi na mu ua, na deigaw ua, zi dinga na kitenpi ut ua ahileh;"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu na inn uah na puilut ding ua, alu aheukieu dinga, akhut chinte atan ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n asaltanna puonte asutkhe ding a, na inn uah a um denta dinga, ha khat vingveng anule apa asuun ding a, tuazou chiengin amanu na luppi dinga, apasal na hita ding a amanu zong na zi ahita ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, atunga na lungkim sih u’leh, a ut utna a, na pei sah phal ding uh ahi, hinanleh sum leh pai a na zua lou ding uh ahi, na suh dai tahziehun, sum met bawlna a zong na neilou ding uh ahi."},"15":{"text":"“Mi koi ahiei in zi ni nei henlen khatpen it in khatpen muda taleh, a it nu leh amuda nu’n, ta neipieh tuoh ta u’henlen, tualeh tapa pieng masa khu a muda nu ta hitaleh;","title":"Tapa masa gou pieh ding dan"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahi ding hi, agoute, atapate kunga ahawm pieh hun chiengin a it nu tapa pen mudanu tapa sanga upa zawin abawl thei sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh agoute aleni pie in, mudanu tapa khu ta piengmasain apom ding ahi, ahatna kipatna ahi a; ta upa hina ama a ahi."},"18":{"text":"“Mi koi ahiei in tapa paupeng leh helhat, anu leh apa thu zong mang nuomlou, agawt vang ua zong athuhilna uh ngaikhe utlou tapa anei leh.","title":"Tapa sapla gawtna"},"19":{"text":"Anu leh apa’n aman ding ua, akhopi upate kung ah, khopi kulkot bul ah ahing zawpi ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh anu leh apa’n khopi upate kung ah, Tam ka tapa uh lungpeng tah leh helhat tah tuaban ah sapzalou ahia, ann hai leh zukham hat mi ahi, achi ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n khopi a um mi zousie’n amapa suongin aseplia ding uhi. Tuachi’n na lah ua gitlouna umte na sumang ding ua, Israelte zousien a za ding ua, a zau ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"“Mi koi ahiei in shina khop khelna abawla, shi sah ding ahi a, sing dawna na khai u’leh;"},"23":{"text":"Aluong khu zan tungtawn singdawn a aumding ahi sih a, bangtenghileh khum ni mama a navui ding uh ahi. Singdawna kikhailia pouma Pasian hamsie thuoh ahi uhi. Mangpa na Pasian un na goutan ding ua ahing piehna gam khu na suh bua louna dingun.","ref":"Gal. 3.13"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Na unaute uh bawngtal ahiei, belam ahiei, amang na mu u’leh, na kitheimaw bawlsan ding uh ahi sih a, na unaute uh inn a na kailut ngeingei ding uh ahi zaw hi.","title":"Ganta mangte kepdan","ref":"Pawt. 23.4,5"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh na unaute uh na inn kung nai ua umte a ahi sih a, aneipa na thei khahlou ahileh, na inn lang uah na kai ding ua, na kem ding ua, na unau un ahing sui hunhun chiengin na pieh kia ding uh ahi."},"3":{"text":"Asabiltung zong khum banga na bawl ding uh ahi, khumbangma in apuon silte u’zong na bawl ding uhi. Khumbangma in na unaute uh van mang na mukhah tapou uh na bawl ding ua, na kitheimaw bawl lou ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Na unaupa uh sabiltung ahiei, bawngtal ahiei lampi a pua na mu u’leh na kitheimaw bawla na kilepsan ding uh ahisih a, tuate na phoh pieh tei tei ding uh ahi."},"5":{"text":"“Numei in pasal kivonna van asil ding ahisih a, pasal in zong numei puonsil asil ding ahisih hi, koizong hichibanga bawlte zousie Mangpa na Pasian ua ding in mi kidahhuoi ahi ding uhi.","title":"Umdan ding tuom tuom"},"6":{"text":"“Lampi a vabu singdawn ahiei, leitung ahiei a, anou ahiei, atui ahiei um; anou ahiei, atui ahiei api in a opkhum lai na mu u’leh, anou api toh nalah khawm lou ding uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Api na hadoh ngei ngei ding uh ahi, anou pen na la thei ding uhi, tuachi’n nou a dingin ahoi ding a, na damsawt ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Inn tha na lam chieng ua, mi akieh a, na inn uh sisan suona inn ahilouna ding in, na inn tunguh na iim ding uh ahi."},"9":{"text":"“Tualeh na grep huon uah haichi tuom tuom na chiin ding uh ahi sih hi, khuchilouin na haichi tu gate leh na grep gate abua kha ding hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.19"},"10":{"text":"Bawngtal leh sabiltung zang khawmin lou nakai ding ahi sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Samul leh vaukhau kigan khawm puon chituom tuom na sillou ding uh ahi."},"12":{"text":"“Na kituomna puonsil gei lite ah among khibawh na bawl ding uh ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 15.37-41"},"13":{"text":"“Mi koi ahieiin zi anei a, aluppi a, amuda kia a,","title":"Numei thanghuoi leh thanghuoilou theina dante"},"14":{"text":"Tam numei zi in ka nei a, ka luppi leh nungah siengthou ahina ka musih chia, zumhuoitaha, abawla aminsiet sah leh,"},"15":{"text":"Nungahnu nu leh paten khopi kulkotpi a, tua khopi upate kungah nungah siengthou ahina ava tahlang ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Nungahnu pa in upate kungah, tam mipa ka tanu toh ka kiteng sah a, amuda kia ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuin ngai un, “Na ta nu nungah siengthou ahina ka mu sih chiin zalat huoi tahin abawla, hinanleh tamte ka tanu nungah siengthou ahina chiemte na ahi,” achi ding hi. Tuachi’n tua khopi upate masang ah puon apha ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tua khopi upaten tua mipa a zawpi ding ua agawt ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Israel nungah siengthou asuh minsiet ziehin dangka shekel zakhat alieu sah ding ua, nungah pa ape ding uhi. Tuachi’n azi ahi dinga, adamsung in akikhenpi thei sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh khum thute ana dih a, nungahnu khu nungah siengthou ahina akimu sih leh;"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua nungah khu apa inn kotphungah ahing puidoh ding a, atenna khuo a mipiten suong in aseplia ding uhi, apa inn a kizua a, Israelte lah a silgilou mothuoitah abawl ziehin; tuabangin na lah ua kipat sil gilou na sumang ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"“Mi koi ahieiin Pasal neisa numei aluppi akimu leh alupkhawmpi pasalpa leh numeinu ani un ashi tei tei ding uh ahi. Hichibangin Israelte laha kipat gitlouna silte na sumang ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"“Nungah siengthou mi zi dinga kikhamlai, mi khat in khopi sunga amu a, aluppi leh;"},"24":{"text":"Ani un, tua khopi kulkot bul ah na hing puidoh ding ua, suongin na seplia ding uhi; nungahnu khopi sunga um ngal a akikoulou ziehin tualeh apasal pen a innvengpa zi asuhminsiet ziehin, tambangin na lah ua pat silgilou na koimang ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Hinanleh mikhat in mi zikham lai gamlah a amu a, apawng suol a aluppi leh aluppi pasalpa maimai ashi ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh nungahnu pen bangma na law lou ding uh ahi, nungahnu tungah shina khop khelna a um sih hi. Aziehpen mi khat in a innveng amuonsuom a, atha toh kibang ahi."},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen tua mipan gamlah a ava tuohkha ahia, mi zi ding kikhamsa nungah khu akikou vangin panpi ding a um sih hi."},"28":{"text":"“Mi koi ahiei in nungah koima kham nailou amu a, amat a, a utlou sasa a alupkhawmpi akimuleh;","ref":"Pawt. 22.16,17"},"29":{"text":"Amanu luppipa’n nungahnu pa kungah, dangka shekel sawmnga ape dinga, amanu zi in anei ding hi, asuh minsiet ziehin, adam sungin akikhenpi thei sih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"“Mi’n apa zi akitenpi ding ahi sih a, tualeh apa zi nih zong alem pieh ding ahi sih hi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.8; 20.11; Danp. 27.20"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi achiltang keh leh aneitah tan khu Mangpa mite kikhopna ah apanlou ding uh ahi.","title":"Mangpa mite lah a tellou dingte"},"2":{"text":"“Zawlta pouma Mangpa mite kikhopna ah apang thei sih ding ua, ahah asuon akhang sawmna dongin, Mangpa mite kikhopna ah apan lou ding uh ahi."},"3":{"text":"“Ammon mi ahiei, Moabmi ahiei zong Mangpa mite kikhopna ah atellou ding uh ahi, akhang sawmna tandongin Mangpa mite kikhopna ah a pan lou ding uh ahi.","ref":"Neh. 13.1,2"},"4":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipata na hing pawtdoh lai un tanghou leh tuiin ahing na dawn sih ua, tualeh Mesopotamia gam a Pethor khuo a Beor tapa Balaam noute gausap dinga agoi zieh un.","ref":"Kisim. 22.1-6"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa na Pasian un Balaam thugen apom nuom sih a, Mangpa na Pasian un nou ahing it ziehin, Mangpa na Pasian un tua hamsiet khu nou a dingin guolzawlna asuohsah zawta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 23.7—24.9"},"6":{"text":"Na damsung teng uh, amautoh kilepna leh alam zanna ding uh na ngaituo pieh ding uh ahi sih hi."},"7":{"text":"“Edom mite na huot ding uh ahi sih a, na unaute uh ahi zaw uhi, Izipt mite zong na huot louding uh ahi, aziehpen agam uah mikhuol nana hita uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahah asuonte uh, khang thumna kipat in, Mangpa mite kikhopna lah ah apang theita ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Na galte uh dou dinga nava giehna mun uah, sil hoilou chinteng lah apat na kihep khiet ding uh ahi.","title":"Giehphuol kep siengthou ding"},"10":{"text":"“Na lah ua mi koizong zan chienga ama akipat sil pawt zieha thanghuoi na um u’leh giehphuol apat apawtdoh dinga, giehphuol a alut kia nawn lou ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh hichi ahi dinga, nitahlam chiengin tui in akisil dinga, nitum chiengin giehphuol ah ahing lut ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Giehphuol pulam ah dailenna mun khat na nei ding ua, tuamun ah nava pei zel ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh na vanzah lah uah lei taw theina ding chiengpum na kipuoh ding ua, tuamin na dailenna ding uh lei na tou ding ua, nathah zou chiengun na vua kia ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh nouma hunkhe ding leh na galte uh na khut ua hing pe dingin, na giehphuol lai uah avah koi hi, tuaziehin na giehphuol uh asienthou ding ahi, tua chilouin na lah ua sil sienglou Amu dinga ahing kiheimangsan kha ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Apu hing taisan suoh na kung ua ahing tun leh, apu kunga na nua pieh kia ding uh ahi sih hi.","title":"Dan zuiding tuomtuom"},"16":{"text":"Ama dinga hoi adeitelna mun ah, na lah uah ateng dinga; na nuoisie lou ding uh ahi."},"17":{"text":"“Israel tanute lah ah kizua a um ding ahisih a, tualeh Israel tapate lah ah zong, pasal kizua a um ding uh ahisih hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.29"},"18":{"text":"Kizuana man ahiei leh uiman man ahiei khu Mangpa na Pasian uh inn a thuchiemna dinga, na tawi ding uh ahi sih, tamte aniin Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin sil kidahhuoi ahi."},"19":{"text":"“Apung umin na unaute na leitawi sah ding ahi sih a, sum pung ahiei, bulebal pung ahiei, sil zousie apung del a na palah sah lou ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 22.25; Siempu. 25.36,37; Danp. 15.7-11"},"20":{"text":"Gamdang mite amet um dingin na leitawi sah thei ding ua, hinanleh na unaute pen amet dinga na leitawisah ding uh ahisih hi, tuachi’n na valuo ding uh gam a na khut nasep nate zousie uah, Mangpa na Pasian un ahing guolzawl ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian u’kunga thu na chiem u’leh hunsawt hallou a na pieh pai ding uh ahi, aziehpen Mangpa na Pasian un ahing phul ngeingei ding ahi ngal a, tua khu nou a dingin khelna ahi ding hi.","ref":"Kisim. 30.1-16; Mat. 5.33"},"22":{"text":"Thuchiem lam sanga na kideh u’leh nou a ding in gitlouna ahi sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na kam ua pawtsa pen na bawl tei tei ding uh ahi, ut thua sillat na kam ua na chiemsa uh, Mangpa na Pasian u’kunga na chiem dungzui un."},"24":{"text":"“Na innvengte grep huona na vah chiengun, na dei zaza uh na ne thei ding uhi, a hivangin na seu sung ua na guon ding uh ahisih hi."},"25":{"text":"Na innvengte uh bulei a navah chiengun, buvui na dei zaza uh na khut un na hiet thei ding ua hinanleh buvui dinglaite koite a na at louding uh ahi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi khat in zi a pui a, akitenpi a, amanu sienlouna bang ahiei khat amu zieha, amit atun sihleh, hichi ahi dinga, kikhulna lai agel pieh dinga, akhut ah ape ding a, a inn a pat asawldoh ding hi.","title":"Kikhul leh kitenkia dan","ref":"Mat. 5.31; 19.7; Mak. 10.4"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh a inn apat apawtdoh nua chiengin pasal dang anei thei kia ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh a pasal nukhia penin amuda a, kikhulna lai agel pieh a, akhut a apieh a a inn a pat asawldoh leh, ahisihleh apasal nukhia pen ashi a ahileh;"},"4":{"text":"a pasal masa amanu khul masa pa’n asuhthang huoisa ahi ziehin akitenpi kia theinawn sih ding hi, Mangpa a dingin sil kidahhuoi ahia, Mangpa na Pasian un goutan ding a ahing pieh gam ah khelna na lutsah lou ding uh ahi."},"5":{"text":"“Mi zi neichil a um leh galkap a akuon ding ahi sih a, bangma nna semdinga phut ding zong ahi sih, a inn ah kum khat a ut bang bangin a um ding a, azi toh nuomsa tah a, a um ding uh ahi."},"6":{"text":"“Mi koiman mi sumheh anuoilam ahiei, atunglam ahiei, leibamana ahentang lou ding ahi, mi hinna hentang pieh ahi ding hi.","title":"Dan tuom tuom"},"7":{"text":"“Mi koi ahiei in a unau Israel tate koi ahiei khat a guh a suoh leh sal bawla abawl ahiei, azua ahiei, akimatdoh leh tua gutapa khu a shi ding ahi; tuabang in na lah ua pat silgilou na koimang ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 21.16"},"8":{"text":"“Phaa natna hii tungtang thu ah hoitah a, etchien a, Levi siempute hing hil banga bawl dingin pilvang un; amaute thu ka pieh bangin pilvang tahin na bawl ding uh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 13.1—14.54"},"9":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipata nahing pawtdoh lai ua, lampi a, Mangpa na Pasian un Mirriam tunga abawl dan thei zing un.","ref":"Kisim. 12.10"},"10":{"text":"“Na unaute bang ahiei khat na leitawisah chiengin akhamna la dingin a inn sunga nava lut ding ahi sih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 22.26,27"},"11":{"text":"Inn pulam ah na ding dinga, na leitawisahpan khamna khu inn pulam ah ahing tawidoh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Amapa migenthei ahileh, akhamna na luppi ding uh ahi sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Abang abang hitaleh, apuon sila a imut thei na ding leh ahing guolzawl theina dingin, tua khamna khu nitum chienga na nuapieh kia ngei ngei ding ahi, tam khu nou a dingin Mangpa na Pasian u’masanga na dihtatna uh ahi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Na sem dinga na mi goite uh genthei leh tasamte, na unau uh ahiei, na gam ua na tenna khopi sung ua teng gamdangmi ahiei zong, na bawl gentheilou ding uh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.13"},"15":{"text":"Asepni mama a alaw na pieh ding uh ahi, niin atumkhum ding ahi sih, aziehpen migenthei ahia alungtang tuanah akoi den kha ding hi; khuchilouin na tungtang uah Mangpa ahan dinga, nou a dingin khelna ahing hi kha ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tate ziehin pate thalia ahisih ding ua, pate ziehin tate zong thalia ahisih ding uhi, michin amauh khelna chiet zieh a thalup ding ahi uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 14.6; 2 Khang. 25.4; Ezek. 18.20"},"17":{"text":"“Gamdang mite leh pa neiloute dihloutah a vai na hawmpieh dinguh ahisih hi; meithai puon zong khamna dinga na lah dinguh ahi sih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.9; Siempu. 19.33,34; Danp. 27.19"},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh nang zong Izipt gam ah sal in na tanga, Mangpa na Pasian in tuana pat in ahing tandoh chi na thei ngitnget dinguh ahi, tuaziehin tam silte bawl dingin thu ka hing pie ahi."},"19":{"text":"“Na lou ua bu na at, chiengun, lou lai a buphai na manghilte uh, na nualah kia nawnlou ding uh ahi; tuate khu gamdang mite, pa neiloute, leh meithaite ading ahi ding hi, Mangpa na Pasian un na khut nasep zousie uh ahing guolzawl theina dingin.","ref":"Siempu. 19.9,10; 23.22"},"20":{"text":"Na Olive singte uh na sat chiengun, abate na sat ding uh ahi sih hi, tuate khu gamdang mite, Pa neiloute leh meithaite ading ahi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Na grep huon ua grep na law chiengun, asang na nuasui kia ding uh ahi sih hi; tuate khu gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite ading ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh nou zong Izipt gam ah, sal in nana taangta uh chi na thei ngitnget ding uh ahi. Tuaziehin tam silte bawl dingin thu ka hing pie ahi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mite kikaal a kinielbuoina a um a, thukhenna zum a ahing pei u’leh, thukhen miten athu uh ana khen pieh ding ua, midih khu siem atangsah ding ua, migilou khu amawpai ding uhi.","title":"Dantuom tuom"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, migiloupa zeptuoh ahileh thukhenpa’n amapa amasangah alum sah dinga, a khelna toh kituoh bangza vei ahiei azep ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Sawmli vei azep thei dinga, tuasanga tamzaw ahi thei sih ding hi; akan avala, tuasanga tamzaw azep leh na unaupa uh na zalahsah seng khading uhi.","ref":"2 Kor. 11.24"},"4":{"text":"“Bawngtal in bu achil laiin akam na kanlou ding uh ahi.","ref":"1 Kor. 9.9; 1 Tim. 5.18"},"5":{"text":"“Sanggamhon aten khawm ua, alah ua mikhat tapa neilou a ashileh, ashipa zi a innsung mi hilou gamdang mi akitenpi thei sih ding a, apasal sanggampa’n aluo dinga, ziin anei dinga; tualeh min asanggampa zi abawl ding ngaina bang atungah abawl ding hi.","title":"Sanggamte zi luo dingdan","ref":"Mat. 22.24; Mak. 12.19; Luk. 20.28"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, Israelte lah a amin manlouna dingin, atapa pieng masa in a sanggampa shisa min apo ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh aman asanggampa zi akitenpi utsih leh asanggampa zi kulpi kotkhah bul a upate kungah ava peitou dinga, ka pasal sanggampa’n Israelte lah. A asanggampa min umsah zel a ut sih a, ka pasal sanggampa bawl ding lawm ka tungah abawl nuom sih hi, achi ding hi.","ref":"Ruth. 4.7,8"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n a khopi upate un amapa ahan ding ua, ahoupi ding ua, tualeh amapa’n ka kitenpi utsih hi chia apan leh;"},"9":{"text":"Asanggampa zi khu akungah upate mitmu in a hing peitou dinga, akedap asutpieh dinga, amaitang ah achilphit dinga, asanggam innkuon tungding nuomloute tungah, hichi kibawl zel heh achi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte lah ah tam mipa min, akedap ki sutpiehpa innkuon akichita ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Mi khat leh khat akihau ua, khatpen pa zi in apasal hunkhe dinga, khatpen pa neitah a amat leh,"},"12":{"text":"Amanu khut na tanpieh ding ua, na hepi vawt lou ding uh ahi."},"13":{"text":"“Na ip sungah tena suong tuom tuom agih leh ajang tena na nei ding uh ahisih hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.35,36"},"14":{"text":"Na innsung uah tena chi tuom tuom alien leh a neu na nei lou ding uh ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh tena dihtah leh kituohtah na nei ding ua, van gih tena kituohtah zong na nei ding uh ahi, tuachi’n Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh gam a na damsung nite uh a sawt theina dingin."},"16":{"text":"Hichibanga sil bawlte leh dihtatlou tah a bawl mi zousie, Mangpa na Pasian ua ding in sil kidahhuoi ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"“Izipt gam a na hing pawtna lampi ua, Amalek ten ahingna bawldan uh thei zing un.","ref":"Pawt. 17.8-14; 1 Sam. 15.2-9"},"18":{"text":"Pasian zong giinglou a, na gim laitah u’leh na basap laitah ua, lampi a ana hing doudan u’leh, a nukhiate leh na nua ua hing pha zouloute ang na suom dante uh theizing un."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa na Pasian un, na luoding ua ahing piehna gam a, na kimvel ua na galte zousie lah ua kipata, galmuonga khawldamna ahing pieh hun chieng in, vannuoi apat Amalek thei zingna khu na phietmang ding uh ahi, na manghil ding uh ahisih hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, Mangpa na Pasian un na goutan ding ua, ahing pieh gam a na hing tun ua, na luo ua, tualeh a sunga naten chiengun.","title":"Gamasate lat dingdan"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un ahing piehna gamleitang ga tung masapen chiet uh na hing tawi ding ua, seu sungah na koi ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian un amin um na dinga ahing aguot pieh ding mun ah na pei ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.19"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh khum hun lai a um siempu kungah na va pei ding ua, akungah, Mangpa’n ipulepate kunga pieh dinga ana chiem gam ah ka hing tungta chi tuni’n Mangpa na Pasian kungah ka phuongdohta hi, na chi ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh siempupa’n na khut a pat seu khu ala dinga Mangpa na Pasian maitam masangah akoi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tualeh nouten Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah, ka pu uh Asiria mi beimang ding kuon khat vahvai ana hia, Izipt gam ah apeisuh a, ava tenga, tawmnoukhat ahi ua, tualeh khummun ah nam thupitah, silbawltheitah leh tamtah ahing hita uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Izipt miten ahing bawlsie ua, ahing sugenthei ua, nasep hasa tahtah ahing semsah uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa ipulepate Pasian i han ua, Mangpa’n i aw uh ana za a, igenthei dante, isepgim dante, nuoisie a i umdante amu a;"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt a kipat in, khut hattahte, banzahte silzauhuoitahte, chiemtenate, sillamdangte, in ahing pui doh a."},"9":{"text":"Tam munah ahing puilut a, tam gam nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam ahing peta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh tuin ngaivawi, Aw Mangpa, Nangman na hing pieh gam a leiga masapente chiet ka hing tawi uhi, na chi ding uhi. Tuachi’n Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah nava lui ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian uh bie in amasangah na kun ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa na Pasian un nouma leh na innkuonpite u’leh Levimite leh na lah ua um gamdangmite kunga sil hoi ahing pieh zousiete ziehin nuomsa tahin na um ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Tualeh kum thumna kum, sawma khat piehna kum a na sil tung zousie uh sawma khat na hing luikhawm ua, tualeh Levi mite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaiten, na umna huong sung ua, a neh ua a tai theina ding ua na pieh zou chieng un;","title":"Sawma khat pieh thu","ref":"Danp. 14.28,29"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah; na hing thupieh, na thupieh zousie dungzui in, ka inn ua kipat asiengthou sawma khatte ka koidoh ua, Levimite, gamdangmite, pa neiloute leh meithaite kungah ka peta uhi; tualeh na thupiehte khat beeh zong ka palse sih ua, manghil zong ka manghil sih uhi, na chi ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ka da lai un tuate ka ne sih ua, ka bua lai un zong ka zangthang sih uhi, tualeh mishi dingin zong ka pe sih uhi. Mangpa ka Pasian uh, aw ka ngaikhe zing ua, na hing thu pieh zousie bangin ka bawl uhi."},"15":{"text":"Na umna siengthou van a kipat in hing ensuh inlen, nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam, ka pule pate uh kung a pieh ding a na kichiemsa bangin, na mi Israelte leh na gam hing piehsa guolzawl in, nachi ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Tuni’n Mangpa na Pasian un tam dan thupiehte leh vaihawmna dante zui dingin thu ahing pie hi; tuaziehin na lungtang zousie u’leh na hinna zousie un na pom un na zui ding uhi.","title":"Mangpa dinga na siengte"},"17":{"text":"Tuni’n nouten Mangpa khu na Pasian uh hi ding leh alampi zui a, athupiehte, adanthute leh avaihawmna dante zui a, a aw te ngaikhe dingin na telta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh ahing thuchiemsa bangin, leh a thupieh zousie na zui na dingun, Mangpa’n tuni’n noute Ama atuom, Amite hi dingin ahing teldoh ta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 19.5; Danp. 4.20; 7.6; 14.2; Tit. 2.14; 1 Pet. 2.9"},"19":{"text":"Ana gentah mabangin, Mangpa na Pasian ua dinga nam siengthou, na hing hi theina ding u’leh, nam a abawl zousie tunga sangtah a, pahtawina, minthanna leh zatathuoi nahi theina dingun Mangpa’n ahing telta hi,” achi hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi leh Israel upaten, mipite kung ah thu apie ua, “Tunia ka hing thupieh zousie zui un.","title":"Ebal muol a dan suongte"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh ding gam a teng ding a Jordan na kan ni chiengun, hichi ahi ding a, suong lienpipi na phut ding ua, suonglou in na zut ding uhi.","ref":"Josh. 8.30-32"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh na galkai zou chiengun tua suongte tungah tam danthute zousie na giel ding uhi, tuachi’n Mangpa napu leh pate uh Pasian in pieh dinga ana chiemsa bangin nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh gamah na pei thei ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jordan na kan zou chiengun hichi ahi ding a, tunia phu ding a thu ka hing pieh tam suongte khu Ebal muol ah na phut ding ua, suonglou in na zut ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh khummun ah Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin maitam, suong maitam na bawl ding ua; atung uah sia vanzah mawngmawng na zah dinguh ahi sih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.25"},"6":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh maitam khu suong kikhenglou in na bawl ding ua, atungah Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin halmang sillatte na lan ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh lemna sillatte na lan ding ua, khummun ah na ne ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah nuomtahin na um ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh suongte tungah, tam dan thute zousie kichientahin na giel ding uhi” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi leh Levi siemputen Israel tate zousie a houpi ua, akung uah, “Israel tate aw pilvangtah in ngaikhie un, tuni’n Mangpa na Pasian uh mite na hing hita uhi.","title":"Gerizim apat guolzawlna leh Ebal apat gausapna"},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa na Pasian uh thu na manding uh ahi, tunia ka hing thupieh, athupiehte leh adanthute na zui ding uh ahi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in khumni ma in mipite thu apie a."},"12":{"text":"“Jordan gal na hingkai chiengun mipite guolzawl dingin tam namte Gerizim muol tungah ading diing uhi: Simeon namte, Levi namte, Juda namte Issakar namte, Joseph leh Benjamin namte;","ref":"Danp. 11.29; Josh. 8.33-35"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh hamselaw dingin tam namte Ebal muol tung ah ading ding uhi: Reuben namte, Gad namte, Asher namte, Zebulun namte, Dan namte leh Naphtali namte."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Leviten Israel mi zousie kungah, aw ngaitahin thu agen ding ua;","title":"Hamsietna sawm leh nite"},"15":{"text":"“Mi khutsiemte siemna a kibawl, Mangpa a dinga kidahhuoi milim khenthu ahiei, sunthu ahiei, bawla koidap pouma hamsiet in um heh achi ding ua; Mipi zousie’n Amen a chi ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.4; 34.17; Siempu. 19.4; 26.1; Danp. 4.15-18; 5.8"},"16":{"text":"“Anu ahiei, apa ahiei, zatatlou pouma hamsiet um heh, achi ding ua. Mipi zousie’n Amen achi ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.12; Danp. 5.16"},"17":{"text":"“A innvengte gamgi suonmi hamsiet in um heh chi ding ua. Mipi zousie’n Amen, chi ding uhi.","ref":"Danp. 19.14"},"18":{"text":"“Lampi a kipata mitto lampi hilou a, peisah pouma hamsiet in um heh achi ding ua. Mipi zousien, Amen, achi ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.14"},"19":{"text":"“Gamdang mite, Pa neiloute leh meithaite dihloutah a vaihawm pieh mi, hamsiet in um heh, achi ding ua Mipi zousie’n Amen, achi ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 22.21; 23.9; Siempu. 19.33,34; Danp. 24.17,18"},"20":{"text":"“Apa zi luppi mi hamsiet in um heh apa lupna zatatlou ahi ziehin achi ding ua. Mipi zousie’n Amen, achi ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.8; 20.11; Danp. 22.30"},"21":{"text":"“Ganta khat pou pou toh lumkhawm mi hamsiet in um heh a chi ding ua. Mipi zousie’n Amen, achi ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 22.19; Siempu. 18.23; 20.15"},"22":{"text":"“A sanggamnu apa tanu ahiei, anu tanu ahiei luppimi hamsiet in um heh achi ding ua, Mipi zousien Amen achi ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.9; 20.17"},"23":{"text":"“Asungnu luppi pouma hamsiet in um heh achi ding ua. Mipi zousie’n Amen, chi ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.17; 20.14"},"24":{"text":"“A innvengte that dap mi hamsiet in um heh achi ding ua, Mipi zousie’n Amen, achi ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Mawna neilou thana dinga golguhna la pouma hamsiet in um heh achi ding ua. Mipi zousie’n Amen, achi ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"“Tam dan thupieh zousie zuidinga pomkip lou pouma hamsiet in um heh achi ding ua. Mipi zousie’n Amen, achi ding uhi.","ref":"Gal. 3.10"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh hichi ahing hidinga, Mangpa na Pasian aw uh hoitah a na ngaikhieh ua, tunia thu ka hing pieh athupiehte zousie pilvang taha na zui u’leh, Mangpa na Pasian un leitunga nam zousie tunga tungnungpen in ahing bawl ding hi.","title":"Thuman a hamphathuoina","ref":"Danp. 11.13-17"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian uh thu na zui pouma u’leh tam guolzawlna zousie na tung uah ahing um ding a ahing zuizel ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Khopi sung leh gamsung ah guolzawl in na um ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Na gil ua gate, na leitang gate, na ganhonte, na bawnghonte leh na belamhonte u’zong guolzawlna tangin ahing pung ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Na seu u’leh na tanghou mehna hengkuongte uh guolzawl in a um ding a."},"6":{"text":"Na lut u’leh na pawtdoh chiengun zong guolzawl in na um ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Mangpa’n nouma hingdou dinga kipan na melmate uh na masang uah ahing zaw pieh dinga, nou hing dou dingin lampi khat ah ahing kuon ding ua, na masang uah lampi sagi ah ataizah ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa’n na annbuhte u’leh na khut nasepna zousie tung uah, guolzawlna thu ape ding a, Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh gam ah ahing guolzawl ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh thupiehte na pom ua, alampite na zui pou u’leh, na kung ua akichiemtah mabangin, Mangpa’n noute Ama ading a nam siengthouin a hing sukip ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n leitunga nam zousie’n, Mangpa mina hatdoh na hi uh chi athei ding ua, ahing giing ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n nouma pieh dinga napu leh pate uh kunga ana chiem gamah, na gil ua gate, na ganhon pungte u’leh na leitang gate uah, nasatahin ahing supung ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa’n na gam uh ahun huna, guotui pe ding leh na khut nasep zousie uh hing guolzawl dingin, van a a goubawm hoite akihong sah dinga; tuachi’n nam tampi na leitawi sah ding ua, nou vangin na leitawi ngai sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Tunia ka hing thu pieh, Mangpa na Pasian uh thupiehte pilvang taha na zui u’leh, Mangpa’n noute alu in ahing pangsah dinga, a mei ahing hisah sih ding hi, na khangtou ding ua nakiem ngai sih ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh tunia ka hing thupiehte apat zietlam ahiei, veilam ahiei a na piel sih ua, pasien dangte nna sem dinga na zui sih pou u’leh, khumbangin na um ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"“Hinanleh hichi ahing ahidinga, tunia ka hing pieh athupieh zousie pilvang tah a zui ding a, Mangpa na Pasian aw na ngaikhieh sih u’leh, tam hamsietna zousie na tung uah ahing tung dinga, ahing phazui zel ding hi.","title":"Thumanlou zieha hamsietna"},"16":{"text":"Mangpa’n na khopite u’leh na lougamte uh sapsiet atangsah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na seute u’leh na tanghou mehna kuongte uh hamsietin a um ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Na talenaute u’leh na gam gate u’leh na ganhonte uh, tualeh na belamhon punglaite uh, sapsiet in a um ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na hing lut chieng un sapsiet in na um ding ua, na pawtdoh chieng un zong sapsiet in na um ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Mangpa’n na tung uah leh, na khut nasep na zousie uah sapsiet na leh lungkiehnate ahing tungsah dinga, tualeh na silbawl giloute zieh ua kei na hing ngaisahlou nate ziehun, na guollel ding ua na mangthai pai ding uhi.","title":"Natna leh guollelna"},"21":{"text":"Luo dinga na lutna gam ua kipat ahing suhmang masangsie’n, Mangpa’n natna hii ahing vomsah ngitnget ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa’n kumzawnnate, khosih natnate, chipawmna te, chisatna zauhuoite, namsaute, gawnnate leh muotna te, in ahing gawt dinga, na manthai masangsie uh ahing del zel ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na tunglam ua van khu sum-eng asuohsah dinga, na umna leitung u’zong sia a suohsah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Mangpa’n na gam guotuite uh leivui leh vutvai asuoh sah dinga, na manthai masangsie uh, van a kipat in na tung uah ahing kesuh ding hi."},"25":{"text":"“Mangpa’n na galte uh masangah ahing guollel sah dinga, na galte uh dou dingin lampi khat ah na kuonkhe ding ua, amasang uah lampi sagi ah na taikeh ding uhi, tualeh leitung namchin zousie lah ah, nam chizat huoi leh liengvai na hi ding uh."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh na luongte uh tunga leeng vate leh gamsa zousie ann ahi dinga, koiman adelmang sih ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Suhdam theilou Izipt gam vohpi uilutte, chibawte, vun ngotnate, chipawmnate, tualeh uithahte in Mangpa’n ahing gawt ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Mangpa’n mot nate, mittawtnate leh lungsim buoinate’n ahing gawt dinga;"},"29":{"text":"Mittaw miel lah a akimaimaw bangin noute zong suntang laiin na kimaimaw ding ua, tualeh na lamzang ngai sih ding ua, tualeh nuoisie leh gallah ding bep na hi ding ua, koiman ahing hundoh sih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Zi ding numei na khaam ding ua, mi dangin aluppi ding ua, inn na lam ding ua na teng sih ding ua, grep huon na bawl ding ua, aga na ne sih ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Na mitmu un na bawngtalte uh akithat dinga, hinanleh asa na ne kha sih ding uhi, na maitang ua kipat na sabiltungte uh ahing kilah pieh dinga, ahing kipe kia nawn sih ding hi, na belamte u’zong na melmate uh pieh ahi dinga, nou hing panpi ding koima a um sih ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Na tapate, na tanute uh nam dang mite kunga pieh ahi ding ua, sunnitumin amaute ngaiin na en ngetngut ding ua, na et et nalam un na mitte uh avai dinga, na khut ah bangma bawltheina mawngmawng na nei nawn sih ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Na gam gate u’leh na sepgim ga zousie uh, na thei ngailou uh namten ane zou sieng ding ua, noute pen nuoisie ding leh engbawl ding bep na hi ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n na mit ua khum silte na mu ziehun na motlaw ding uhi."},"35":{"text":"Mangpa’n na khupte uah, na kengte uah suhdamtheilou uilut, na kengtaw ua kipat na jangsip tan un ahing veisah ding hi."},"36":{"text":"“Nou leh na leengpa nangawn u’leh, napu leh pate tan ua, na thei khah ngailou uh namte kung ah, Mangpa’n ahing pui dinga, khunah sing leh suonga kibawl pasien dangte nna nasem ding uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ahing puimangna ding nam zousiete lah ah, nam chizat huoi leh paunah leh aselam gentena na hing hita ding uhi."},"38":{"text":"Na lou uah haichi tampi na tu ding ua, hinanleh tawmnoukhat nala ding uhi, khauphe in aneh zou ding zieh in."},"39":{"text":"Grep huon na bawl ding ua, na kem ding ua, hinanleh grep zu na dawn kha sih ding ua, grep ga zong na lou khatuom sih ding uhi, lungin aneh zou ding zieh in."},"40":{"text":"Na gamsung zousie uah Olive sing na suon ding ua hinanleh athau na kinu sih ding uhi, agate apul sieng ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Tapate, tanute na nei ding ua hinanleh nou a ahi sih ding ua, suoh leh sal a puimangin a um ding uhi."},"42":{"text":"Na theikung zousie u’leh na gam hawsuoh leigate uh khauphe in ane gam ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Na lah ua gamdangmi umte noute sangin asang zaw vahiei ding ua, noute pen na ngiem suh deu deu ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"A hing leitawi sah ding ua, nouten na leitawi sah sih ding uhi; amaute alu ahi ding ua, noute pen amei na hi ding uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tuaban ah, tam samsietna zousiete na tung uah ahing tung ding a, ahing nuadel dinga, ahing pha zui zel ding hi; suhmanga na um masangsie un, azieh pen athupiehte leh athugousie zui dingin Mangpa na Pasian uh aw pilvangtahin na ngaikhe sih uhi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh tuate khu nou leh na hah nasuonte uh tungah kumtawna dinga chiemtena leh sil lamdang ahi ding hi."},"47":{"text":"“Sil zousie a na hing kiningchin zieh ua, Mangpa na Pasian uh nna lungsim kipah tah leh lungnuom tah a nasep lou zieh un."},"48":{"text":"Nouma hing dou dinga Mangpa’n ahing sawlding na melmate uh na gilkiel pumin leh dangtah pumin tualeh saguoh pumin leh sil bangkim a tasam pumin naseppieh dinga, ahing suhmangthai masangsie un na ngawng ah sia hahkol ahing posah ding uhi."},"49":{"text":"Mangpa’n nouma dou dingin gamlapi kawlmong a kipat in nam khat, muvanlai banga gang, a ham uh na thei ngailou dinguh nam khat ahing sawlding hi."},"50":{"text":"Nam giinhuoi melpuo, tehsie zong khawhsalou, khanglaite zong deisah tuomlou;"},"51":{"text":"Tualeh na ganhonte u’leh na hawsuoh leigate uh na manthai masangsie uh ahing nehpieh ding ua, tualeh ahing suhmangthai masangsie un na bute uh, na uoin thate uh, na sathaute uh, na ganhon pungte uh leh na belamnoute uh ahing khawipieh sih ding ua, na manthai masangsie uh ane ding uhi."},"52":{"text":"Na gam pumpi ua na muon pen uh na kulpi sang pen uh achipmang masangsie’n, na kulkotpi zousie uah ahing im ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian un nou ahing pieh na gam sung zousie ua, na kulkotpi zousie uah ahing im khum ding uhi."},"53":{"text":"Na galte un ahing
