imchimit zieh ua, neh leh tah ding neilou a nalungkham seng ziehun, Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh na tapate u’leh na tanute uh sa na ne ding uhi."},"54":{"text":"Na lah ua mi umdan hoileh pha penpenten zong asanggampate uh, akawilai azi deimamate u’leh a ang sung ua apomlai ata it mamate nasan zong neh ding in a enla ding uhi."},"55":{"text":"Bangma anei nawnlou zieh un atate uh sa ane ding ua, koima ahawm utsih ding uhi, na galte un na kulpite uh a imchimit ua, na kulpi kotpite zousie uh khakhuma ahing imtawmtah zieh un."},"56":{"text":"Na lah ua numei chinou leh chingeh tah, achinou u’leh achingeh zieh ua lei zong akeng ua tuon nuomlou ten zong a ang ua lumlai apasal it mamate u’leh atanu leh atapa it mamate u’leh;","ref":"2 Leeng. 6.28,29; Kaala. 4.10"},"57":{"text":"Apom lai uh ata ngehsen leh ata pieng nalai dingte u’zong a enla ding ua, sil zousie a tahsap siengtah ziehun anedap ding uhi; na galte un na khopi kulpi kotpite zousie ua panga ahing imchimit a, ahing imtawm ua na chimaw sengtah ziehun."},"58":{"text":"“Mangpa Na Pasian uh min thupitah leh zauhuoitah na giin thei na ding ua, tam laibu a kigiel thu zousie pilvang tah a na zui sih u’leh;"},"59":{"text":"Mangpa’n nouma leh nahah nasuonte uh tungah natna hi lamdang thoidam theilou leh natna damtheilou leh huoisie leh chizat huoi ang tungsah ding hi."},"60":{"text":"Tualeh na giin mama uh Izipt gam natna ahing tungsah dinga, ahing nuasie ngainawn sih ding hi."},"61":{"text":"Tualeh natna chinteng tam laibu a kigiel khalou natna hiite zong, na manthai masangsie un, Mangpa’n na tung uah atungsah nalai ding hi."},"62":{"text":"Tuachi’n van a aasi banga tam hina’n ulachin tawmnoukhat na hing hita ding uhi, Mangpa na Pasian uh aw na man lou zieh un."},"63":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi dinga, nouma bawl hoi ding leh supung dinga, Mangpa na tung ua akipah mabang in, nouma sumang ding leh suse dingin Mangpa akipah dinga, na valuo ding uh gam na lutna ua kipat suonmang na hi ding uhi."},"64":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n noute kawlmong langkhat akipat alelam tan in, nam zousie lah ah ahing thethang dinga, khunah noute leh napu napate un zong athei ngailou uh pasien dang, sing leh suongte nna nasep pieh ding uhi."},"65":{"text":"Tualeh tam namte lah ah tawldamna mawngmawng na mu sih ding ua, na kengtaw un zong tawldamna amu sih ding hi, hinanleh Mangpa’n lungdonna, mitgimna, lungsim a kingamlana, a hing pezaw ding hi."},"66":{"text":"Tualeh na hinna uh patau ngitnget in a um dinga sun leh zan in na zau ngitnget ding ua, na hinna un kithei chienna anei sih ding hi."},"67":{"text":"Zingmawng chiengin nitah hitaleh aw nachi ding ua, nitah chiengin zingmawng hitaleh aw! na chi ding uhi; shi zauhuoina na lungtang un a giin ding zieh leh na mit ua na sil mu dingte uh zieh in."},"68":{"text":"Na kung ua, na mu kia nawn sih ding uh chia ka gensa lampi ah, Mangpa’n noute Izipt gam ah tembawin ahing nua sawl kia dinga, tuachi’n khum gam a na melmate uh suohpa leh suohnu dingin na kizuading ua, hinanleh koiman ahing lei nuom sih ding uhi,” achi hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tamte khu Horeb muol a amautoh abawl thuhun chilou Mangpa’n Moab gam a Israel tate kunga bawl dinga Mosi kunga thu apieh thuhun thute tamte ahi.","title":"Moab gam a Mangpa’n Israel toh kikaal a athuhun bawl"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Israel mipite zousie ahankhawm a a kung uah, “Izipt gam a Pharaoh tung leh agamsung pumpi tunga na mitmu ua Mangpa’n abawl zousie na muta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ze et na thupi tahtahte, chiemtenate, sillamdangte, na mit ngei ua na mute uh;"},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n tuni tandongin theisiemna lungtangte, mu theina mitte leh zahtheina bilte, ahing pe nai sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Gamdai ah kum sawmli sung vingveng ka hing puita a, na satung ua na puonsilte uh ase sih a, na keng ua na kengdapte uh zong ase sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Kei khu Mangpa na Pasian uh kahi chi na hing theina dingun, tanghou na ne sih ua, uoin ahiei, zu chia ahiei zong na dawn nai sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tam mun na hing tun un Heshbon leengpa Sihon leh Bashan leengpa Og eite dou dingin ahing kuon ua, amaute ina zouta uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 21.21-30; Kisim. 21.31-35"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh agam uh ila ua, Reuben mite, Gad mite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kung ah aluo dingun ipeta uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 32.33"},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin na silbawl zousie ua na lamzan theina dingun tam thuhun thute pom unlen zui un."},"10":{"text":"“Tuni’n na unpi un Mangpa na Pasian uh masangah na phung lamkaite uh, na upate u’leh, na houtute uh, tualeh Israel mipite zousie leh;","title":"Israel mite thuchiemin akaanna"},"11":{"text":"Na taneute uh, na zite uh, tualeh na giehphuol sung ua um gamdang mi na singtomte u’leh na tui tawi ua pangte nangawn toh na ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tunia Mangpa na Pasian un noute toh kikaal a abawl Mangpa na Pasian uh thuhun leh akichiemna a na lut theina ding ua;"},"13":{"text":"Napu leh pate uh Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob te kunga ana kichiem bang leh na kung ua a gensa banga, tunia noute amite dinga ahing suhdet theina ding leh Ama khu na Pasian uh ahitheina dingin."},"14":{"text":"Tam thuhun leh kichiemna khu nou kung guoh a bawl ka hisih a,"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh tunia Mangpa i Pasian uh masanga, idinpite leh tunia ikung ua umloute toh zong ka bawl ahi."},"16":{"text":"“Izipt gam a ina tendante, namdangte palsan a ipei suoh dante na thei uhi.","title":"Milim biehlou ding"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh alah ua um sil kidahhuoi abawlte u’leh sing leh suong, sana leh dangka a, abawl uh amilimte u’zong na mu uhi."},"18":{"text":"Khuchilouinvang na lah ua pasal ahiei, numei ahiei, innkuon ahiei, phung ahiei, khum namte pasiente be ding leh ana uh sem dingin na lungtang un tuin Mangpa i Pasian uh kiheisan in na lah uah sil kha leh gamsai seldohna zungte ahing um kha ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 12.15"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh khuchi ahia, tam samsietna thute azah nua a dangtana-a, azukhamna belap dinga, ka lungtang ngaituona dandan in um nanleng lungmuonna ka nei ve ve ding, chia alungtanga akiguolzawl tup leh;"},"20":{"text":"Mangpa’n ama akhawi sih dinga, tuathamlouin Mangpa lungthahna leh thangsietna in atungah akuong ding hi, tualeh tam laibu a kigiel hamse zousie atungah atung dinga, Mangpa’n vannuoi apat in amin aphietmang ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ama khu tam dan laibu a kigiel hamsietna thuhun zousie dungzuiin Israel phung zousie lah apat silgilou tang dingin akhentuom ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n na nua chieng ua khangtha hing pieng zel ding na tate u’leh, gamlapi a kipata gamdangmi hing pei dingten Mangpa’n khum gam tunga akoi gawtna hii leh natna aveisahte amu chiengun;"},"23":{"text":"Agam pumpi kaatsuong leh chikhal gam, kahgawna leh haichi tutheilouna, tualeh sing leh loupa pou louna, gam kieu Mangpa’n alungthah thangpai ni a asuhsiet Sodom leh Gomorrah, Admah leh Zeboiim abawl banga, a bawl amutah chiengun.","ref":"Siem. 19.24,25"},"24":{"text":"Nam zousieten zong bang zieha tam gam Mangpa’n tambang talawm a abawl adiei? Hichi talawma thangpaina meibanga kuongdoh va-ia bang chidan adiei? achi ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n miten Izipt gam a kipat a apuidoh lai a apulepate uh Pasian in amaute toh athuhun amanghil zieh uh ahi achi ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen nidanga athei ngailou u’leh Mangpa’n aphal vawtlou pasien dangte bie a ana uh asep pieh zieh uh ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin tam laibu sunga kigiel hamsie zousie hing tungsah dingin, Mangpa lungthahna khu tam gam tungah akuongdoh ta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh tunia abawl bangin, Mangpa’n amaute agam ua kipat in lungthahna leh thangpaina mama toh gamdang ah anot mangta hi, achi ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"“Sil kiphuolte khu Mangpa i Pasian a ahi a, hinanleh sil kilangte pen tam danthute zousie izui theina ding ua kumtawna eite leh ihah isuonte ua ahi ngitnget ding hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh hichi ahing hi dinga, na masang ua ka koi tam guolzawlna leh hamsietnate zousie na tung ua ahing tun a, tualeh Mangpa na Pasian un ahing thethangna nam zousie lah ah tuate na hing theidoh kia ua;","title":"Hindoh kiana leh guolzawlna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian kunga na hing kile kia ua, tunia thu kahing pieh dungzui a, nou leh na tate utoh na lungtang zousie u’leh na hinna zousie ua athu na zui hun chiengun;"},"3":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un na saltaanna uh ahing suhbei pieh dinga, ahing hepi dinga, Mangpa na Pasian un ahing thethangna nam zousiete lah a kipat ahing puikhawm kia ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Na lah ua mi koi ahiei vantawp tanna gamla a delmang aum u’leh Mangpa na Pasian un khuna kipat in ahing puikhawm ding a, khuna kipat in ahing ladoh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa na Pasian un napu leh pate un aluo gam uah, ahing puilut kia dinga na luo ding uhi, Aman ang lamzang sah dinga, napu leh pate uh khupin ahing pungsah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh na hin theina dingun Mangpa na Pasian uh na lungtang zousie leh na hinna zousie ua na it theina ding un, Mangpa na Pasian un na lungtang u’leh na hahnasuonte uh lungtang tep ahing atanpieh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian un tam hamsete zousie khu na melmate u’leh nou hing muda leh hing sugentheite tung ah atungsah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh na hing kihei kia ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian thu na hing zuita ding ua, tunia thu ka hing pieh athupiehte zousie na bawlta ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa na Pasian un, nasep nabawl zousie uah, nagil ua gate uah, na ganhonte uah leh na gam gate uh nasatah in ahing supung ding hi; napu leh pate uh tunga akipah bang in Mangpa na tung uah akipah kiata ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tam dan laibu a kigiel athupiehte leh athugousiete zui dinga Mangpa na Pasian uh aw na ngaikhieh ua, na lungtang zousie u’leh na hinna zousie utoh Mangpa na Pasian uh lam na ngat kia phot u’leh."},"11":{"text":"“Tam athupieh tunia ka hing pieh, nou adinga sil lamdang kiphuol ahi sih a, gamlapi a um zong ahi sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Koi ahiei eite a dinga van a kaltou a, izah theina ding u’leh, ibawl theina ding ua ikung ua hing puohsuh ding, na chi ding ua van a um ahi sih hi.","ref":"Rom. 10.6-8"},"13":{"text":"Ahisihleh, izah theina ding u’leh ibawl theina ding ua koi ahiei tuipi gal a hing vagalkai pieh a, hing valah pieh ding? na chi ding ua, tuipi gal a um zong ahi sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh na zui theina dingun thuin ahing nai mama a, na kam u’leh na lungtang ua um ahibou hi.","title":"Zuiding lampi nite"},"15":{"text":"“En in, tuni’n na masangah hinna leh hoina, tualeh shina leh sietna ka koi hi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh it dinga, alampite zui dinga, tualeh athupiehte leh adanthute leh avaihawmna dante pom dinga tunia ka hing thupiehte na zui u’leh na hing ding ua, na pung ding ua, na valuo ding gam uah Mangpa na Pasian un ahing guolzawl ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh ngaikhe nuom lou dinga, na lungtang uh akiheimanga, puimanga na um ua, Pasian dangte na bieh ua, anate nasep u’leh:"},"18":{"text":"Na mangthang teitei ding uh chi tuni’n ka hing hil ahi; Jordan lui galkai a luo dinga na valutna gam uah na dam sawt sih ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na masang uah hinna leh shina, guolzawlna leh hamsie ka koi hi chi tuni’n na tungtang thu ua theipi ding in lei leh van ka han hi; tuaziehin noute leh nahah nasuonte uh na hin theina dingun hinna tel un."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh na it ua, athu na man ua, ama a na kiluoi bembom ngitnget na dingun, ama lah na hinna u’leh na damsawtna uh ahi thuoi a, tuachi’n napu leh pate uh Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob kunga pieh dinga akichiemna gam ah na teng thei ding uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 12.7; Siem. 26.3; Siem. 28.13"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Israel mipite zousie kungah tam thute agen a:","title":"Mosi thahenga Joshua apanna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Tuin kum za leh sawmni ka hita a, vaikuon leh vaitung zou ding ka hi nawn sih hi, tualeh Mangpa’n Jordan luigal kailou ding na hi, ahing chi hi.","ref":"Kisim. 20.12"},"3":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh na masang uah apei dinga, na masang ua kipat tam namte ahing suhmang pieh dinga, agam uh na luo ding ua, tualeh Mangpa’n agen tahmabangin Joshua in na mauh apuita ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n asuhmang Amormite gam leh aleengte uh Sihon leh Og tunga abawl bang in atung uah abawl ding hi.","ref":"Kisim. 21.21-35"},"5":{"text":"Mangpa’n amaute na khut uah ahing pe ding a, thu ka hing pieh thupieh zousie dungzuiin atung uah na bawl ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hattah leh hangsantahin um unlen, zau sih unlen amaute giing sih un, aziehpen Mangpa na Pasian uh noute toh zawhkhawm ahia, ahing nuasie sih dinga, ahing taisan sih ding hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Joshua ahan a, Israelte zousie mitmu ah “Hattah leh hangsantahin um inlen aziehpen Mangpa’n apulepate uh kunga pieh dinga achiemna gam ah tam mite na zawpi dinga amaute na luosah ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa khu na masang ah apei dinga, Aman ahing umpi dinga, ahing nuasie sih dinga, ahing peisan sih ding hi, zau sinlen, lunglel vawt sin,” achi hi.","ref":"Josh. 1.5; Heb. 13.5"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in tam dan agiel a, Levi tate siempute leh Mangpa thuhun bawm zawngte kung leh Israel upate zousie kungah apie hi.","title":"Siempute kunga dan apiehna"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in amaute thu apie a, “Kum sagi kum ngaidamna kumtenga hampheng pawi bawlna a;","ref":"Danp. 15.1,2; Danp. 16.13-15"},"11":{"text":"Israelte zousie Mangpa Pasian masanga a kilat na ding ua, Mangpa’n aguot mun a ahing kilat chiengun Israelte zousie zah dingin na sim ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mipite numei, pasal leh naupangte tualeh na kulpi huongsung ua um gamdang miten a zah ua, azil ua, Mangpa na Pasian uh zaudan asiem ua, tami thute zousie pilvang tah a azui theina ding u’leh;"},"13":{"text":"Atate uh a thei nailouten zong azah ua, Jordan luigal kan a na valuo ding uh gam a na ten sungsie ua Mangpa na Pasian uh giin dan asiem ua, a kizil theina dingun han khawmin,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Ngai in, na shi hun ahing naita, Joshua han inlen kimutuona biehbuh ah vakilang in khunah ama thu ka pe ding hi” achi hi. Tuachi’n Mosi leh Joshua apei ua kimutuona biehbuh ah ava kilangta uhi.","title":"Mangpa’n Mosi a vaihahna nukhia"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa khu biehbuh ah meilum khuom in ava kilah a, tualeh meilum khuom khu biehbuh kotpi tungah a ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Mosi kungah, “Ngaiin napu leh pate kunga imu ding nahita a, tam mite ahing thou ding ua, ava umna dingte u’lah a, khum gamdang pasiente lah ah akizua ding ua, Kei ahing lengatsan ding ua, amaute toh kikaal a ka thuhun abawtse ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum hun chiengin atung uah ka lungthahna akuongdoh dinga, ka lengatsan dinga, alah ua kipat ka mai ka phuol mangta dinga, nehtum in a umta ding ua, atung uah sietna leh mangbatna tampi atung dinga, tuachi’n khum ni chiengin amauten i Pasian uh ilah ua aumlou zieha tam silgiloute itung ua hing tung hilou ahiei mah? achi ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Khum ni chiengin, pasien dangte lam ngaa a asilgilou bawl zousiete uh ziehin ka mai ka phuol ngeingei ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin tam la giel inlen Israel tate zilsah in. Israel tate tungtang thu ah, tam la kei a dinga theipitu ahi theina dingin akam uah koi in."},"20":{"text":"Apu leh pate uh kung a ka na chiem nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam a ka puilut chiengin, ne le dawn in, atai ding ua, a hing thau chiengun, pasien dangte lam anga ding ua, ana asep pieh ding ua, Kei ahing nuol ding ua, ka thuhun abotse ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi dinga, sil hoilou leh mangbatna tampite atung ua ahing tun hun chiengin, tami lain bang zieh a genthei ahi uoi chi theipitu ana hi ding hi; ahah asuonte uh kam a gen mangmaw ahi ding zieh in, tuin ka chiemna gam a ka puilut masang in zong alungsim ngaituona uh a le vah kawi dante uh ka thei zouta hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin khum ni mama in Mosi in tam la agielkhie a Israel tate ahilta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Nun tapa Joshua ahoupi a, akungah, “Hattah in um inlen kisuhangsan in, pieh dinga ka chiem gam ah Israel tate puilut ding na hi, tualeh keiman kang umpi ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Kisim. 27.23; Josh. 1.6"},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahi a, Mosi in tam dan thute laibu sungah agiel zou sienga mansa a akoi diem zou in."},"25":{"text":"Mosi in Mangpa thuhun bawm zawng Levite thu apie a."},"26":{"text":"“Tam danbu la unlen, na tungtang thu ua theipitu ahi theina dingin, Mangpa na Pasian uh thuhun bawm gei ah koi un."},"27":{"text":"Na helhat dan u’leh na paupen dan uh ka thei hi. Ngai un, tu a ka hing dampi lai a bawn, Mangpa tunga hel a kiphin hatte na hi ua, ka shi nua chiengin bang na hing suoh tabep ding uoi izaw!"},"28":{"text":"Abil ngei ua azah ua tam thute ka gen theina ding leh atungtang thu ua, theipitu dinga lei leh van ka hat theina dingin na phung sung ua upate zousie leh na lamkaite uh hing hankhawm un."},"29":{"text":"Aziehpen ka shi nua chiengin nasetah in na hing kisusegawp ding ua, ka hing thupieh lampi akipat na pielmang ding uh chi ka thei kilkel hi; tualeh atawp lam chiengin sil hoilou in ahing buohkhum dinga, na khut nasep silbawlte zousie zieh un Mangpa na Pasian uh na sulungthah ding ua, amitmu a silhoilou na bawl ding zieh un.”"},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in tami laguite khu adawng tawpna dongin Israel mipi kikhawmten abil ua azah dingun agen sieng hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Aw nou vante bil daw in na ngaiun, thu hing gen ding kahi. Tualeh Aw leitungin ka kam a thu pawtte, na ngaikhie in.","title":"Mosi la"},"2":{"text":"Ka thuhilnate van guotui bangin azu ding, ka thugente khu daitui bangin atakhe dinga, Loupa hing dipdep tunga guonel phin bang leh, Hampa tunga daitui kie bangin."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa min ka tangkoupi dinga, Thupina i Pasian pie un."},"4":{"text":"“Ama suongpi ahia, anasep ahoi bukim hi. Alampite zousie, dihtatna ahi, dihna Pasian leh gen banglou dihtat leh hoi ahi."},"5":{"text":"Atungah na ginum sih ua, Amite chitaah zong na hi sih uhi, Khangthulimlou leh Nam lepchiete na hi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tambanga Mangpa thuh ding na hi uoi mah, Nou mimo leh pilloute aw. Ama noute hing siempa leh, Nam khat a hing tung dingpa, Na pa uh ahi sih amah?"},"7":{"text":"Khanglui lai nite thei zing unlen, khang tampi na peisa kumte ngaituo un, Na pate uh dongun, ahing kawhmu ding ua, Na upate uh dong un, tuachi’n atangthu ahing hil ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tungnung sangpen in namte agoutan ding uh, gamte ahawm pieh lai in, Mihing tate a tuom khen lai in, Israel tate atam dan dungzui un Namte gamgi ahunpieh hi.","ref":"Nasep. 17.26"},"9":{"text":"Mangpa tanvou khu amite ahi ua, Jakob khu agoutan tuom ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aman Jakob khu Gamdai gamgaw mun ah amu a, Gamdai huisie mau he hute lah ah akem a, thu ahila, Amit laidum bangin adiem hi."},"11":{"text":"Muvanlai in abu a anoute atoh thou a, aha zahkhum in anoute tungah aleng a, aha jahin atungah atuong sah kia a, len akizil sah bangin, Mangpa’n Israel pua ding a veng zing hi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa bou khu ahi amite pui, Gamdang mite pasien hilou in."},"13":{"text":"Aman amaute leitung munsangte ah atuongsah a, Lou a siltungte aneh theina ding un, Suongpi akipat khuoizu aluongkhe sah a, Meisa suonga kipat in sathau apawt sah hi."},"14":{"text":"Bawngpi akipat bawngnawi khalte leh, Belamhonte akipat nawitui, Belamnou thaute toh, Bashan gam belamtalte leh kelte, deituom Mangbu hoipente leh, uoin hoi pente na dawn uhi."},"15":{"text":"“Hinanleh Jeshurunte ahing thauta ua, Akiphin hat ua, athau ua, na sa uh ahing pha ta, Thaunain ahing tuomta hi. Tuachi’n asiempa Pasian ale ngatsanta ua, Ahundamna suongpi uh angai neuta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Gamdang pasienten thangsietna atoh thou ua, kidahhuoina in alungthah sah uhi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian hilou dawite kungah, Athei khah ngailou uh pasiente kungah, napu napate un zong ana thei khah ngailou uh, atha a hing kisiemthu pasiente, kung pou ah, akithoi uhi.","ref":"1 Kor. 10.20"},"18":{"text":"Nang hing suongpa Suongpi khu Na ngaisah sih a, Nang hing siempa, Pasian na manghilta hi."},"19":{"text":"“Tualeh tam khu Mangpa’n amu tahin, atapate u’leh atanute uh suh lungthahna zieh in, amauh amuda tahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Aman amaute akipat, ka mai ka phuol dinga, Bang ahing suoh mawng uoimah, ka enkhe ding hi, khang ginalou leh ginna neilou ahi uh a chi hi."},"21":{"text":"Pasian hilou silte in ka thangsietna leh, thangpaina ahing toh thou ua, a milim mot huoite un ahing lungthah sah ua, Mipi a simkhamloute zangin, Ka suthangpai dinga, nam pilvang loute zangin, amaute ka sulungthah ding hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 10.22; Rom. 10.19"},"22":{"text":"Ka lungthahna meibangin akuong doh a, gawtmun tawdop dongin aka ding a, Leitung leh a sunga um zousie akatum dinga, taang bul kingahnate a halkuong ding hi."},"23":{"text":"“A tung uah sietna ka sevum dinga, Atung uah ka thaltang ka kap ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Gil kielnain amauh amangthai sah dinga, sietna leh natpi in meikuong bangin, akatum ding ua, atung uah gamsa ha hiemte leh, leivui a kithol gul gukhate zong ka sawl ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Pulam ah namsau in, sunglam ah chizatna leh zauna in, nungah tangval leh, Naungeh nawitep laite leh tehsie samkangte zong a sumangthai sieng ding hi."},"26":{"text":"“Amaute ka thelthang sah dinga, mihing lah akipat amaute theizingna khu, ka phiet mangding chi in ka ngaituo a.”"},"27":{"text":"A melmate un theikhielin, “I khutte tawisangin a umta, Tamte zousie Mangpa bawl ahi vawtsih, Melma lungthahten chi khava uh, chi zausih leng.”"},"28":{"text":"“Pilna neilou namte ahi ua, ama uah theisiemna a um sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Aw pil u’leh tamte atheisiem ding ua, Atunualam thu uh ngaituo ding hima ve un."},"30":{"text":"Bang dinga mi khat in tul khat azaw a, tul sawm mi niin a zaw thei ahiei, Mangpa a Pasian un amaute a nuasie a, Bangkimbawlthei Pasian in amauh, ataisan tah zieh ahi."},"31":{"text":"A pasien uh eite Pasian bang ahi sih, chi i melmate nangawn in athei uhi."},"32":{"text":"A grep guite uh Sodom grep gui ahia, Gomorrah gam a ahia, Agrepte uh sinkha grep ahia, aga bomte zong akha hi."},"33":{"text":"A uointe u’khu dragon gu leh, gulha gupha tah ahia."},"34":{"text":"“Khum khu ka kholkhawm ka goubawma, ka bil hilou ahiei mah?"},"35":{"text":"Phulah leh thuh kiana khu kei a ahia, apansia uh ahing teu hun chiengin, a sietna ni uh ahing naita, a tung ua sil hing tung dingte, a hing tung paita ding hi.","ref":"Rom. 12.19; Heb. 10.30"},"36":{"text":"Mangpa’n amite vai ahawmpieh dinga, Tualeh ahatna uh abeita a, Khakhum leh nuasie koima a um nawn sih uh, chi amu chiengun, asuohte tungah lainatna aneita ding hi.","ref":"Late. 135.14"},"37":{"text":"Aman a pasiente u’leh, a muon suongpi uh hei a um ahiei?"},"38":{"text":"A kithoina thau nete leh, Adawn sillalte uh dawnte, Hing thoudoh u’henlen, hing panpi u’heh nou hing humbittute hi uheh, achi ding hi."},"39":{"text":"“Tuin ngaiun, kei keima mama ka hi, thei unlen pasien dang a um sih uh, Kathatlia a ka suhing zel hi, ka suliema kadamsah zel hi, Ka khut a kipat a la doh thei koima a um sih hi."},"40":{"text":"Vanlam ah ka khut ka zahtou a, kumtawn a hing ka hi ka chi a."},"41":{"text":"Ka namsau val lihleh ka tat hiema, ka khutin vaihawmna atuuh leh, Ka melmate tungah phuba kala dinga, Ahing mudate ka thuh kia ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Ka thaltangte sisan ka dawnkham sah dinga, ka namsau in sa aval ding hi; a kithatte leh salte sisan toh, melma lamkaite lu a kipat in."},"43":{"text":"“Aw nou nam chinte aw, amite toh kipah un, Aman a suohte phuba ala ding hi, Ama doutute tungah phuba ala ding, Agam leh amite adingin kilemna buching abawl ding hi.”","ref":"Rom. 15.10; Kihil. 19.2"},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh Nun tapa Joshua ahing pei ua, mipite zah in tam la thute zousie agen uhi.","title":"Mosi thu vaihah nukhia"},"45":{"text":"Tualeh tua thute zousie Israelte zousie kung a agen zouin, akung uah;"},"46":{"text":"Tunia na kung ua “Ka hing thu theisahte ah na lungtanguh koi kip unlen, tam danthu zousie pilvang tah a zui ding in na tate uh thu pie un."},"47":{"text":"Tam thute nou a dingin bangmalou maimai ahisih a, na hinna uh ahi zaw hi, tualeh tam thute zieh in luo ding a Jordan lui nava galkaina gam uah na dam sawt ding uhi; achi hi.”"},"48":{"text":"Tualeh khum ni mama in Mangpa’n Mosi ahoupi a.","ref":"Kisim. 27.12-14; Danp. 3.23-27"},"49":{"text":"“Jeriko gal a um Moab gam a Abarim taangdunga Nebo muolvum ah kaltou inlen, Israel tate kunga aluo ding ua ka pieh Kanaan gam va gal et in."},"50":{"text":"Tuachi’n na sanggampa Aaron Hor muol ah a shi a, achipite kunga pui ahitah mabangin, na kaltouna muolvum ah na shi dinga na chipite kunga pui na hita ding hi."},"51":{"text":"Aziehpen Zin gamdai a Meribah Kadesh tuimun a Israel tate lah ah ka tungah na takhielta a, Israel tate lah a na hing pahtawilou zieh in."},"52":{"text":"Khum gam nava galmu dinga, hinanleh Israel tate kunga ka pieh gam ah na lut sih ding hi;” achi hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam guolzawlnate in, Pasian mi Mosi in ashi masangin Israel tate aguolzawl hi.","title":"Mosi in Israel nam sawm leh nite aguolzawl"},"2":{"text":"Ama’n agen a, “Mangpa khu Sinai muol dawn ah ahing pei a, Seir akipat in atung uah ni bangin ahing suoh a, Paran muoldawna kipat ahing taanga, Mi siengthou tul sawmte toh ahing pei a, a khut zietlam apat ama ua dingin dan meikuong, bangin ahing pawtdoh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi Aman amite a it a, Ami siengthoute zousie akhut sungah akem hi, ama u’khu na kengbul ah atou ua na thu apom chiet uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mosi in dan ahing pie a, Jakob mipite gouluo dingin."},"5":{"text":"Mipi lamkaite leh Israel tate kikhop khawm laiin, ama khu Jeshurun ah leeng ahita hi."},"6":{"text":"“Reuben dam henlen, shi sih heh, amite zong tawm sih uheh;” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu Juda vangphatna hi hen, “Mangpa Juda aw ngaikhie inlen, amite kung ah puilut in, akhut ama a dingin kiching henlen, amelmate apat ama panpitu hiin,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh “Levi tung thu ah pen, Na thumim leh, na Urim khu na misiengthoute kung ah a um a, Massah ah na ze et a, Meribah tui mun ah na kinielpi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 28.30; Pawt. 17.7; Pawt. 17.7; Kisim. 20.13"},"9":{"text":"Ka nu leh ka pa ka thei sih chiten, a sanggamte zong athei sih a, ama tate ngel zong athei tuom sih a, na thu apom ua, na thuhunte azui uhi."},"10":{"text":"Jakob kung ah na vaihawm dante ahil ding ua, Israelte na danthute ahil ding uhi; Na masang ah gimnamtui akoi ding ua, Halmang kithoina na maitam tungah, alan ding uhi, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa, aneilelamte uh guolzawl inlen, akhut nasepte uh pom pieh inlen; ama dou dinga kisate leh ama mudate kawng, athawdoh nawnlou nading un sat pieh in.”"},"12":{"text":"Benjamin tung thuah hichiin agen a, “Mangpa’n a itpa khu bit tahin a kung ah, a umsah dinga, Mangpa’n sun nitum in aliekhu dinga; aliengkou tungah atuongsah ding hi;” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Joseph tung thu ah Aman hichiin agen hi; Van daitui manpha tahte leh leinuoi thuhpi, atuite in “Mangpa’n agam guolzawl hen."},"14":{"text":"Nisa a piengkhie theiga manpha tahte leh, sil manpha hate a piengkhete in."},"15":{"text":"Nidang lai muolte a sil hoipente leh, kumtawn muolte a sil deihuoi pente toh."},"16":{"text":"Leitunga sil mantamte leh abukimna toh, sawlbawh a umpa deisahnain, guolzawlna khu Josephte lutungah leh, asanggamte apat khentuom a umpa jangsip ah."},"17":{"text":"A thupina khu bawngtal pieng masa thupina bang ahi a; aki gam bawngtal kibang ahi, tuamin nam zousie, kawlmong dongin anotdoh dinga, Ephraimte tul sawm ahi ua, Manasete tul te ahi uhi.”"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Jebulunte tungthu ah hichiin agen hi, “Jebulun na vahdohnate ah kipah inlen, tualeh Issakar na puoninnte ah lungmuongin."},"19":{"text":"Amaun muol tungah mite ahan khawm ding ua, khunah dihtatna kithoinate a lan ding uhi, amaun tuipi hausatna leh pieunel a, kiphuol gou manphate ane ding uhi;” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Gad tungthu ah pen, “Gad sulientu khu guolzawl in um hen, Humpibahnei bangin a kuola, akhut leh a jangsipte a eehmal hi."},"21":{"text":"Aman tan hoipen akilah a, Aziehpen vaihawmpa tanvou ama din akikhet a, Mipi lamkaite toh ahing pei a, Mangpa vaihawmna dih, Israelte vaihawmnate a zui hi;” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Dan tung thu ah pen, “Dan khu humpibahnei nou ahia, Bashan muol a kipat hing dingdoh ahi” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Naphtali tungthu ah hichiin agen hi; “Aw Naphtali deisahna leh, Mangpa vaihawmna leh guolzawlna adim, tumlam leh simlam luoin,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Asher tungthu ah agen a, “Asher pen tate ah guolzawl in um hen, Asanggamte pom thei hi henlen, tualeh a sathau uah akengte die uhen."},"25":{"text":"Na kedap khu sia leh sum-eng ahi dinga, Na damsung nite bangin na hatna zong a um ding hi, achi hi."},"26":{"text":"“Jeshurun Pasian bang koima a umsih, Nang hing panpi dinga vantunga tuonga, A thupina a vanlaizawl a toupa khu."},"27":{"text":"Kumtawn Pasian khu na kihumbitna ahia, nuoilam ah kumtawn ban in ahing dom dinga, Na masanga kipat in na melmate adel mang dinga, sumangin achi ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel khu galmuongin a um dinga, Jakob tuinah khu bu leh uoin pienna gam ahidinga, Vanten zong daitui chiim ahing kesah ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Na hampha hi Aw Israel, Nangbang koi a um ei, Aw nang ahing panpina phaw leh, na thupina namsau! Mangpa hundam mite, Na melmate khu na masangah ahing kipelut ding ua. Tualeh nangman amun sangte uh, na totchil piehta ding hi;” achi hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi khu Moab phaijang a kipat in Jeriko gal a Nebo taanga Pisgah muolvum ah akaltou a. Tualeh Mangpa’n Gelead gam zousie Dan gam dongin a en sah hi.","title":"Mosi shina"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Naphtali gam zousie leh Ephraim leh Manaseh leh Juda gam pumpi tumlam tuipi dongin;"},"3":{"text":"Simlam gam leh Tumsing khopi Jeriko phaijang Zoar dongin aensah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n akungah “Tam gam khu ahi Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob te kunga, nahah nasuonte kung ah ka pe ding hi chia ka chiemna gam khu ahi; tam gam na mit in ka hing musah ta hi, hinanleh tua gam ah na lut sih ding hi;” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 12.7; Siem. 26.3; Siem. 28.13"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa suohpa Mosi khu Mangpa thu bangin Moab gam ah ashita hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Beth-peor gal a Moab phaihawm khat ah avui ua, hinanleh ahan pen tunitan in koiman athei sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi ashi in kum za leh sawmni a upa ahia, amit amiel sih a, atha zong akiem sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Mosi khu Moab phaijang ah ni sawmthum sung a suun uhi, tuachi’n Mosi suunna leh kaana nite ahing beita hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Nun tapa Joshua khu pilna hagau in adim a, Mosi in atunga akhut akoi tah ziehin; tualeh Israel taten athu azui ua, Mangpa’n thu apieh bangin abawl uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh khum zou langkalsie, Mangpa’n kimaituo a ahoupi Mosi bang guolnei a um nawn mawngmawng tasih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 33.11"},"11":{"text":"Chiemtena zousie leh sil lamdang zousie, Pharaoh leh asuohte zousie kung leh Izipt gam zousie a ensah hi."},"12":{"text":"A khut hattah leh zauhuoi pipi a, Israelte zousie mitmu a, Mosi in abawl banga bawl koima a um nawn sih hi."}}}}},"6":{"info":{"name":"Joshua","shortname":"Josh.","abbr":[],"desc":"Joshua laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa suohpa Mosi shi nuain hichi ahing hi a, Mosi panpipa Nun tapa Joshua ahoupia.","title":"Kanaan gam lading a kisah kholna"},"2":{"text":"“Ka suohpa Mosi lah ashita a, tuaziehin tuin thou inlen, nang leh tam mipite zousie, Israel tate kunga kapieh gam zuon dingin tam Jordan galkaita un."},"3":{"text":"Mosi kunga ka gensa bangin, na kengphang un atot khahna gam zousie, ka hing peta hi.","ref":"Danp. 11.24,25"},"4":{"text":"Gamdai leh tami Lebanon akipat luipi lien Euphrates luipi tandonga, Hitmite gam zousie leh nitumna lam a tuipilien tandongin na gam uh ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na damsung siein koima mawngmawng in ahing nang zou sih dinga, Mosi kunga ka um bangin, nang zong ka hing umpi dinga, ka hing zuousan sih dinga, pei zong ka hing peisan sih ding hi.","ref":"Danp. 31.6,8; Heb. 13.5"},"6":{"text":"Hattah leh hangsantahin umin, apulepate u’kunga pieh dinga kana chiemsa gam khu agoutan dingun na hawm pieh ding ahi.","ref":"Danp. 31.6,7,23"},"7":{"text":"Ka suohpa Mosi in dan zousie zui dinga thu ahing pieh zousie zui chinten a bawl dingin, hattah leh hangsantahin um pouma photin: na peina pou a na lamzan zel theina dingin na zietlam ahiei, na veilam ahiei ah, pielsan vawt sin."},"8":{"text":"Tami dan laibuin na kam pawtsan vawt sih heh, hinanleh asunga kigielte zousie na zui chinten a na bawl theina dingin, sun leh zan in na ngaituo zaw ding hi; tuachi’n na lampite ah na tuohpha dinga, tualeh lawchinna hoitah nanei ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Thu ka hing pie hilou amah? Hattah leh hang tahin um in, zau sinlen, lungke vawt sin, Mangpa na Pasian in hing umpi ding ahi;” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in mipi vaisaite thu apie a,","title":"Joshua in mipite thu apiehna"},"11":{"text":"“Giehphuol sung tuonsuoh unlen, mipite kungah, na neh leh taah ding uh sutuo un, nithum sungin Mangpa na Pasian un, gam luo dinga ahing pieh, luo dingin tami Jordan lui kan ding nahi uhi chi’n, thu pie un, achi hi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Reubenmite, Gadmite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kungah Joshua in thu agen a.","ref":"Kisim. 32.28-32; Danp. 3.18-20; Josh. 22.1-6"},"13":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian un noute khawldamna ahing peta a, tualeh tam gam ahing peding chia Mangpa suohpa Mosi in thu ahing pieh thei ngitnget un."},"14":{"text":"Na zite u’leh, na taneute u’leh na ganhonte u’pen Mosi in Jordan gal suolampanga ahing pieh gam ah aum ding ua; hinanleh nou mihat hangsante zousie pen na unaute uh masangah napei ding ua, na panpi ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa’n noute ahing pieh banga na unaute uh khawldamna apieh masang sie leh Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh gam amauten zong aluo masang sie un: Tuachi’n Mangpa suoh Mosi in Jordan lui gal nisuohna lam gam noute goutan dinga ahing napieh langah na kinuale kia ding ua naluo ding uhi,” chin agen hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh amaute’n “Bawl dinga na hing thupieh zousie ka bawl zel ding ua, tualeh na hing sawlna pou ah zong ka pei zel ding uhi"},"17":{"text":"Sil bangkim a Mosi thu ka zuizel bang un nang thu zong ka zuizel ding uhi: Mosi a umpi bangin Mangpa na Pasian in nang hing umpi phot mai hen."},"18":{"text":"Koipou na thupieh tunga hel a, na thupieh zui nuomlou pouma khu shisah ahi ding uh, hattah leh hangsan tahin umpouma phot mai in, chi’n Joshua adawng uhi.”"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Nun tapa Joshua in, “Agam leh adiehin Jeriko khuo aguhin va enkhie un,” chi’n mi ni Shittim mun a kipat in aguh a enkhe dingin asawl hi, tuachi’n ava kuon ua, kizua numei khat amin Rahab kichinu inn ah ava lut ua, khunah atungta uhi.","title":"Jerikou khopi enkhe ding sawlna","ref":"Heb. 11.31; Jak. 2.25"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh tam thu Jeriko leengpa hilin a umta a, “Ngaiin, tuzanin gamsung enkhe dingin Israel tate lah a mi tammun ah ahing pei uhi,” chi’n."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeriko leengpan Rahab kungah mi asawl a, “Na inn a hing tung mikhuolte hing pui in, gam sung pumpi aguh a enkhe dinga hingkuon ahi uhi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n numeinu’n mi nite khu a pui a, aphuolta hi, tuachi’n akung uah tam bangin agenta hi, “Ka kungah mite ahing haw ngutma uhi, hinanleh hei langa kihei mang ahita uoi ka thei sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahia, khomiel kuon a kul kotpi khah hun ding lai velin tua mite apawtkhe kia ta ua, heilang a pei ahi uoi chi ka thei kha nawn sih hi, kintahin delpai u’lachin na delpha nalai ding uhi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahivang in amanu’n amaute inntungah a zawpi tou a ziza kung alom lom a, asiekhawmna lah ah aphuolta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh miten amaute khu Jordan lui agalkaina tandong ava nuadel ua, tualeh adel mite apawtdoh tahun kul kotpi a khata uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh alup masangun amanu khu inntungah akung uah ava peitou a."},"9":{"text":"Mite kungah, “Tam gam khu Mangpa’n nou ahing peta chi leh na zauhuoina uh ka tung uah ahing tuta a, noute ziehin tam gam a tengte zousie na masang uah azunmang gawpta uh chi ka thei hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin Izipt gam a kipat a na hing pawtdoh laiun, Mangpa’n noute dinga Tuipisan asuhkang dan leh, Jordan gallam a um Amor mite leeng nite, Sihon leh Og na bawl dan u’leh na suhmang dante uh kana zata uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 14.21; Kisim. 21.21-35"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh kana zah tahun ka lungtangte uh ana zun zouta a, noute zieh in lungzaulou mawngmawng koima aum sih uhi; Mangpa na Pasian ulah tunglam van leh nuoilam lei ah Pasian ahi ngal a."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin keiman na tung ua hepina kana suhlat tah ziehin, nou zong ka pa innkuonpi mite tungah na hepina uh hing sulang sam unlen;"},"13":{"text":"Ka nu leh ka pa, ka sanggam pasalte, ka sanggam numeite leh anei alam zousie uh khawi unlen, shina laha kipat ka hinna uh hing humbitpieh dingin ka kungah kichiem unlen, chiemtena dihtah hing bawl pieh un” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh mitegel in adawng ua, akungah, “Ka sil bawl uh mi kunga na gendoh sih ding leh na shi tang un ka shi ding uhi, Tuachi’n hichi ahi ding hi. Mangpa’n gam ahing pieh hun chiengin, ka hing hepi ding ua, na tungah muonhuoi tahin kabawl ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n amautegel kotta ah khauhuolin akhaikhesuhta a; a inn lah kulbang tunga um ahi ngal a, tualeh amanu khu kulbang tunga teng ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n akung uah “Muollam zuon in peita un khuchilou in ahing nuadelten ahing mukha ding uhi, ahing nuadelte hing kinuale kia masangsie’n ni thum sung kiphuol un; tuazou chiengin napei kia na ding uhi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n mite gel in akungah; “Na hing kichiem sahna pen, na chitahtah ahisihleh amaw ka posih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ngaiin, gamsung ka hing lut chiengun, tam na hing khaikhiehsuhna khau sandup kotta ah nakhi inlen, tualeh na kungah na nu, na pa, leh na sanggam pasalte leh na pa innkuonte zousie na inn a nana puilut ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi ding a, na inn kotpi a kipata kholai a pawtkhe pouma sisan maw ama lutungah aum dinga, kouten a maw ka posih ding uhi, tualeh koipou innsunga na kung a um pouma tunga khut kihakha aumleh asisan maw uh ka lutung uah aum ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh ka sil bawl uh na gendoh leh nang kichiem sahna thu ah mawsiet in ka umsih ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n “Na gen bangbang uh hita heh achia,” tuachi’n amautegel asawldohta a apeita uhi, tuachi’n amanu’n akotta ah khau sandup akhita hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh amautegel apeita ua, muol ahing tung ua, anuadelte ahing kinuale kia masangsie un khum mun ah nithum sung a umta uhi, tualeh anuadelten lampi tungtawn in amaute asui ua, hinanleh amuzou sih uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi nite khu ahing kile kia ua, muol tunga kipat in ahing kumsuh ua, tualeh agalkai ua, Nun tapa Joshua kung ah ahing tung ua, sil tung zousie a kung ah ahilta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh amaute gelin Joshua kungah Mangpa’n gam pumpi ikhut uah ahing pe tahtah ta hi; a ziehpen eite ziehin a gam sung ua teng mi zousie achitun siengta uhi, achi uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua zingmawng matah in athou a, Israel tate zousie toh Shittim mun akipat in akisuon ua, Jordan lui ava tung uhi; agalkai masang un khum mun ah agieh uhi.","title":"Jordan lui kanna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahia, nithum nuain, a lamkaite un giehphuol ava tuon suoh sieng ua,"},"3":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian uh thuhun bawm leh Levi mite siemputen tami azawn uh namu chiengun, na umna ua kipat in na kisuon ding ua, na zui ding uh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahivang in noute leh tami thuhun bawm kikaal tethaw in tong tul ni vela akigamlat ding ahi, na peina lampi ding uh na thei theina dingun, a naiah hing pei sih un, aziehpen tami lampi tumasang lamin na zuikha ngai nai sih uhi,” chi’n thu apie uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in mipite kungah, “Kisusiengthou un, aziehpen zing chiengin Mangpa’n nalah uah sillam dang tah bawl ding ahi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in siempute kungah, “Thuhun bawm zawng unlen, mipite masangah galkai un” chi’n agen hi. Tuachi’n amaun thuhun bawm a zawng ua mipite masangah apei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Joshua kung ah, “Mosi ka umpi bangin nang zong ka hing umpi ding hi, chi athei theina dingun, tuni’n Israel zousie mitmu ah nang ka hing pahtawi pan ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh thuhun bawm zawng siempute kung ah, Jordan lui gei na hing tun chiengun, Jordan lai ah na din dide ding uh ahi, chi’n thu na peding hi” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in Israel tate kungah, “Talang ah hing pei unlen Mangpa na Pasian u’thu hing ngaikhie un,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in “Tanah Pasian hing na lah uah aum a, na masang uah Kanaanmite, Hitmite, Hivmite, Periz-mite, Girgashmite, Amormite leh Jebusmite a delmang ngeingei ding chi na thei ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ngaiun leitung pumpi Mangpa thuhun bawmin na masang uah Jordan lui akan hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Israel nam lah apat in, namchin lah a pat in, nam khat thahengin mi khat zel, mi sawm leh ni telkhie un."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hidinga, Mangpa, leitung pumpi Mangpa bawm zawng siempute kephangin Jordan tui atotkhah tahin, Jordan tui sahlam a kipat a hing luongsuhte a kipat in ahing kangtan dinga, ahing kiching venvon ta ding hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, mipite Jordan luigal kaidingin apuonbuhte ua pat in ahing pawtdoh ua, siemputen mipite mai ah thuhun bawm zawngin apei uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh bawm zawngte Jordan lui ahing tung ua, bawm zawng siempute kengin tui mong atot tahin; (aziehpen bu lahhun sungteng Jordan lui akuong dimlet in aluong zing hi)"},"16":{"text":"Sahlam a kipata hing luongsuh tuite akhawlta a, gamla kuomtah a Zerethan gamgi zula um Adam khuo tandongin akiching venvon a, tualeh Arabah tuipi, Tuipi Al lam a luongsuh lai akangtanta a, tuachi’n mipite Jeriko kho gal tah ah agalkaita uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thuhun bawm zawng siempute Jordan lui lai a leigaw tungah, mipite zousie Jordan lui agalkai sieng masangsie un ading denta uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, mipi zousien Jordan lui agalkai sieng zou un, Mangpa’n Joshua ahoupi a, a kung ah;","title":"Thei zingna suong phu"},"2":{"text":"“Mipite lah apat mi sawm leh ni, nam tenga mi khat zel teldoh inlen;"},"3":{"text":"a kung uah, Jordan luilai a siempute dinna laitah a suong sawm leh ni la unlen, gieh phuol tuzan a na giehna ding mun uah koi un, chi’n thupie in,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in Israel tate lah a mi sawm leh ni, nam tenga mi khat zel atelkhiehte ahan a;"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in akung uah, “Mangpa na Pasian uh bawm masangah Jordan luilai ah galkai unlen, Israel tate nam phaza dungzui in michin in suong khat chiet la unlen na liengkou uah puo un."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n tamte na lah uah chiemte na ahing hidinga, tunua chienga na tate un, Tam suongte nou a dinga bang na china uh ahiei chia ahingdoh hun chieng un;"},"7":{"text":"Nouten akung uah, Mangpa thuhun bawm masangah Jordan tuite ahing kangsan a, Jordan lui agalkai lai in, Jordan lui tuite ahing kichingtan ta hi, tuachi’n tam suongte khu Israel tate adingin kumtawnna theizingna ahi ding hi; chi’n na dawng ding uhi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Joshua kunga thu agen bangin, Israel taten Joshua thupieh bangin abawl ua, Israel tate nam phaza dungzuiin Jordan luilai apat in suong sawm leh ni ala ua, agiehna mun uah apophei ua, khum mun ah akoita uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Thuhun bawm zawng siempute dinna lai tah, Jordan luilai ah khum suong sawm leh nite aphut a, khumte tuni dongin aum nalai hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi in Joshua thu apieh zousie banga, Mangpa’n mipite kunga bawl ding a, Joshua thu apieh zousie abawlzou sieng masangsie uh, siempu bawm zawngte Jordan luilai ah ading den ua, tuachi’n mipite akinaw ua agal kaita uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, mipi zousie agalkai siengzou nua un, Mangpa bawm leh siempute mipi mitmu in agalkai ta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Reuben tate, Gad tate leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte, Mosi in akung ua agenzousa bangin Israel tate masang ah galvan a kivon in agalkai uhi."},"13":{"text":"Galdou dinga kimansa mi tul sawmli vel, Jeriko phaijangte ah Mangpa masangah agalkai uhi"},"14":{"text":"Khumi ni’n Mangpa’n Israel mi zousie mitmu in Joshua apahtawita a, Tualeh amauten Mosi agiin bangun Joshua zong adamsungteng agiingta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Joshua ahoupi a, akung ah"},"16":{"text":"“Theipina umna bawm zawng siempute Jordan lui a kipat ahing pawtdohna ding un thu pie in” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in siempute, “Jordan lui akipat hing pawtdoh ta un chi’n” thu apie hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hi a, Mangpa thuhun bawm zawng siempute Jordan lui lai a kipat in ahing pawtdoh ua, tualeh siempute kephangin leigaw ahing tot tahun, Jordan tuite amasanga bangin aluon ngaiin ahing luong kia a, akuom zousie ah aluongdim kiata hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite ha khatna ni sawmni in Jordan lui a kipat in ahing pawtdoh ua, Jeriko suolam a um Gilgal ah giehphuol abawlta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Jordan lui akipata ahing puoh uh, khum suong sawmlenite khu Joshua in Gilgal ah aphut ta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in Israel tate kungah thu agen a, “Tunua chienga na tate un apate uh kunga, tam suongte bang china ahiei? chia adoh chiengun;"},"22":{"text":"Israel tate tam Jordan lui ah tuolgaw tungah ahing gal kai uhi, chi’n na tate uh na hing theisah ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa na Pasian un nidanglai a igalkai zou sieng masangsie ua, imasang ua Tuipi san ana kangtansah mabangin Jordan tuite na galkai zou sieng masangsie un na masang uah akangtansah ahi."},"24":{"text":"Leitunga mizousie in Mangpa khut ahat ahi chi atheinading u’leh, Mangpa na Pasian uh kumtawna na giin theina ding un,” achi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Jordan luigal tumlam a um Amormite leengte zousie leh Tuipi gei a um Kanaanmite leengte zousie’n igalkaizou masangsie uh, Mangpa’n Jordan tuite Israel tate masangah akangtan sahta hi chi ana zah un, Israel tate ziehin alungtanguh ana zun zouta a, tualeh achizalou koima a um sih hi.","title":"Gilgala teptanna leh Peikan pawi manna"},"2":{"text":"Khum hunlai in Mangpa’n Joshua kung ah “Meisa suong temta hiemtah bawl inlen, Israel tate tep aniveina tanpieh kia in,” achi hi.","title":"Teptanna abawl uh."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in meisa suong temta hiemtah abawla, Gibeath ha araloth ah Israel tate tep atan piehta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in atep uh atanpiehna zieh khu tami ahi, Izipt gam a kipata hing pawtdoh pasal galkap thei zousie, Izipt akipat ahing pawtdoh nua un lamkaal ah gamdai ah ashi beita uhi hi.","ref":"Kisim. 14.28-35"},"5":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipat a hing pawtdohte zousie ahileh teptansa ngen ahi ua, hinanleh Izipt gam a kipat ahing pawt lai ua lamkaal a gamdai a piengte zousie khu teptanlou ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen Izipt gam akipat ahing pawtdoh galkap thei mi zousie, Mangpa aw angaikhiet utlou zieh ua thalia a aum sieng masangsie un, Israel tate khu gamdai ah kum sawm li sung a viel vahta uhi, tua mite kungah Mangpa’n nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam pieh dinga ahing chiem khu amusah sih ding hi, chiin ana kichiemta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n atate uh amaute thahenga adindoh sahte Joshua in atep uh atan pieh hi, lamkaal a atep uh atanpiehlou ziehin teptanlou ana hi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahia, mipite zousie tep atan zou un, adam masangsie un, giehphuola aumna mun chiet uah a um dentadi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Joshua kung ah, “Tuni’n Izipt miten noute ahing simmawna uh nouma ua kipat in kalia mangta hi,” achi hi. Tuaziehin khum mun min khu tuni tandongin Gilgal akichi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Gilgal ah giehphuol asat ua, Jeriko phaijangah khum ha ni sawm leh li niin peikan pawi amang uhi.","title":"Peikan pawi bawlna","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-13"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh peikan pawi zou azingni mama in agam a pieng tanghou tolsawlou leh vaimim kante ane uhi"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh khum gam a pieng bu aneh zingmawng ua kipat in manna ake nawn sih a, Israel taten manna zong amu nawnsih uhi, khumi kum in Kanaan gam bulebal ane zawta uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 16.35"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Joshua Jeriko khogei a aum laiin adahtou a, a en a, tualeh ngaivawi amai toh kitangin mi khat a namsau dawsa a khuta tawi a ding amu a, tuachi’n Joshua in ava zuon a, akungah, “Kou langa pang na hiei, ahisihleh ka melmate ulanga pang?” a chi hi.","title":"Joshua in namsau dawsa tawi mi amuna"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Hilou e, Mangpa galkapte lamkai dinga hing pei ka hi zaw hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Joshua amai a tuolsu in akhupboh a, abie a, akungah “Ka Mangpa’n asuoh kungah bang gen ding nei a tai leh?” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa galkapte lamkai pa’n Joshua kungah “Na kengphang akipat na kengdap sutkhie in, na dinna mun mun siengthou ahi,” achi a, tuachi’n Joshua in tuabang in abawlta hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Jeriko khu Israel tate ziehin akikhah bih beh a; koima apawtdoh sih ua, koima zong a lut sih uhi.","title":"Jerikou lahna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Joshua kung ah, “En in, Jeriko khopi leh aleengpa u’leh amihat hangsante uh na khut ah ka hing peta hi."},"3":{"text":"Na galkapmi zousie in khopi khatvei nava kimvel suoh phot ding ua, khumbanga ni guhsung na bawl dinguh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh siempu sagi in bawm masangah belamtal kii pengkul sagi atawi ding uhi; tuachi’n ani sagi niin khopi sagi vei navel suoh ding ua, siemputen pengkulte amut ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi dinga, belamtal kii pengkul amut ging uh na zah chiengun mipi zousie aw ngaitahin akikou ding ua, tuachi’n khopi kulpi achimzah dinga, mipite amauh mazawn chietah tangtah in apei ding uhi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nun tapa Joshua in siempute ahan a, akung uah “Thuhun bawm zawng unlen siempu sagiin, Mangpa bawm masangah belamtal kii pengkul tawi u’hen achi hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh aman mipite kungah “Peizel unlen khopi vel suohun, tualeh mi galthuom a kithuomte Mangpa bawm masangah pelzel uhen,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hita a, Joshua in mipite kunga thu agen zou in, Mangpa masanga belamtal kii pengkul sagi tawi siempu sagite apei zel ua, pengkul amut ua, Mangpa thuhun bawm in azui hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh galthuom a kithuom mite khu pengkul mut siempute masangah apei ua, tualeh anualam vengte bawm nua ah apei ua, siemputen apeikawmun pengkul amut zel uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in mipite kungah, “Kikou dinga thu ka hing pieh ni atun masangsie, na kikou dinguh ahisih a, na aw u’zong zah ahi lou ding ahi, tualeh na kam ua kipat in thu mawngmawng pawtsih heh, khum ni chiengin na kikou nading uhi chi’n thu apie hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa bawm in khopi kimvel in khat vei avelsuoh sah a, tuazou chieng giehphuol ah ahing pei ua, giehphuolah ahing gieh zel uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua zingmawng matahin athou a, siemputen Mangpa bawm azawng uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa bawm masangah belamtal kii pengkul tawi siempu sagite apei zel ua, pengkul amut ua, tualeh galvan a kivon mite amaute masangah apei ua, tualeh anualam vengte, Mangpa bawm zawngte nua ah ahing pei ua, siemputen a peikawm un pengkul amut zel uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh ani ni in khopi khat vei avelsuoh kia uhi, khum bangin ni guhsung abawl uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, ani sagi niin zingmawng phalvahin athou ua, abawl ngaima bangun sagi vei avel suoh uhi, khum ni maimai in khopi sagivei avel suoh uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh a sagi veina ah hichi ahing hi a, siemputen, pengkul amut tahun, Joshua in mipite kung ah “Kikou un Mangpa’n khopi nou ahing pe zou ta hi, achita hi."},"17":{"text":"Tam khopi leh asunga um zousie Mangpa a dinga hamsethuoh leh suhmang thang dinga kipesa ahita, Rahab kizuanu leh a innsunga akunga um zousiete pen, imi sawlte ana phuol ziehin ahing ding uhi.","title":"Jeriko suhmangna"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh nou pen hamselaw silte akipat kihemkhie un, khuchilou in khum hamselaw sil na lah u’leh hamsethuoh in na umkha ding uhi, tualeh Israelte giehphuol khu hamsethuohin na umsah kha ding ua, lungkham leh mangbangin na um kha ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh sana, dangka, sum-eng leh sia leh umlebelte zousiete a un in Mangpa tanvou ngen ahi a, Mangpa sumbuh a koi ahi ding uhi.”"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n siemputen pengkul amut tahun akikouta ua, tualeh hichi ahing hi a, mipiten pengkul ging azahtah un, tualeh mipite aw ngaitah a akikou tahun, kulpi bang khu achimkhe zengzungta hi, tuachi’n mipite ama uh mazawn chiet ah tangtahin khopi sung alut chiet ua, khopi khu alata uhi.","ref":"Heb. 11.30"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh khopi sung a um zousie, numei leh pasal, aneu alien, bawngtalte, belamte, sabiltungte a un in namsauin athatgam kilkel uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Joshua in gam enkhedinga vakuon mi nite kungah, “Tua kizuanu inn sungah valut unlen, akunga nava kichiemna bangun, khum numei anei alam zousie toh hing puidoh un,” achi hi.","title":"Rahab leh a inn kuonte a suohta uh"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n gam vil a kuon tangval tegel khu avalut ua, Rahab, anu apa leh asanggam pasalte leh anei zousie toh ahing puidoh ua, asanggam, aunau zousie zong ava puidoh ua, Israelte giehphuol pulam ah aum sah uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh khopi leh asunga um zousiete khu mei in ahaltum sieng ua, Sana, dangka, sum-eng leh sia, tualeh tui um belsuonte maimai Mangpa sumbuh ah akoi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ahivang in Joshuain kizuanu Rahab leh apa innkuonpite zousie leh anei zousie ahinkhawi a, tuachi’n tunitanin Israelte lah ah ateng denta uhi; Jeriko khuo enkhe dinga Joshua in asawlte ana phuolguh ziehin.","ref":"Heb. 11.31"},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in khum hunlai in, “Tam Jeriko khopi hing tungding kia pouma Mangpa masangah hamsiet in um heh, “Ata masapen luong toh ainn suongphum phumkhawm henlen, ata tumpen luongtoh akulkotpite alemkhawmta heh,” achi hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 16.34"},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Joshua a umpi a, tualeh agam pumpi ah ahing minthangta hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel taten hamselaw silte ah ahing takhielta ua, Juda nam a Zerah tapa, Zabdi tapa, Karmi tapa Akan in hamselaw sil sienglou ana lata a, tuachi’n Israel tate tungah Mangpa a lungthahta hi.","title":"Akan khelna leh Ai khuo a guollelna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in Jeriko apat in Bethel suolam a Beth-Aven kho kunga um Ai khuo ah mi asawl a, akung uah, “Va peitou unlen gam va en khie un” achi a, tuachi’n mite ava pei ua, Ai khuo khu ava enkhie uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh amaute Joshua kungah ahing kile kia ua, akungah “Mi zousie kuontouse da uhen mi tul ni ahiei tul thum ahiei, va kuontou uhenlen, Ai khuo va sim uheh, mi zousie va suhgim se ngai sih va, tawmnoukhat ahibou uhi.”"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite lah apat mi sang thum dingvel a kuontou ua tualeh Ai mite masangah ataithangta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Ai miten mi sawmthum le guh vel ana that ua; kulpi kot gei a kipat in Shebarim tandongin ahing nuadel ua, akumsuhna ah athabe nalai uhi. Tuaziehin mipite lungtang ahing zun zouta a, tui bang mai ahing hita uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in apuonte abotkeha, Mangpa thuhun bawm masangah ama leh Israel upate amai ua tuolsu in nitahlam tandongin abohkhup ua, tualeh alutung uah leivui akibuohkhum uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in “Tamoh zangde izaw! Mangpa Pasian aw bang dinga suhmangthai ding giapa, Amor mite khut a piehlut dinga Jordan lui na hing pui galkai mama ata diei, Jordan lui gal a lungkim taha um khinkhian zawhmaiding hia aw."},"8":{"text":"Aw Mangpa Israelte hichi banga, a melmate uh masanga ataizah taah mai u’khu bang kalawta diei?"},"9":{"text":"Kanaanmite leh tam gam sunga tengte zousie in aza ding ua, ahing im ding ua, leitunga kipat ka min uh sumang ding hita ve un maw? Na min thupitah khu bang nalawta diei?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Joshua kungah, “Thou in bangdinga hichibanga bohkhupa lum den na hiei?"},"11":{"text":"Israelten sil abawl khiel ua asieimah, tualeh akung ua zui dinga ka pieh ka thuhun khu abotseta uhi, aziehpen amaun hamselaw silte themkhat nasan ala nalai ua, guh zong agu nalai uhi, tualeh a im bawl ua, avan lahte uh aphuol nalai uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuazieh in ahi, Israel tate agalte uh masanga ding zoulou a, ataizah na uh, azieh pen amaute hamselaw ahita uhi; hamselaw silpen na lah ua kipat na suhmang phot sih u’leh na kung uah ka um nawn sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Thou inlen mipite susiengthou in, tualeh akung uah zing chienga dingin kisusieng un; Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi; “Na lah uah hamselaw sil a um hi, Aw Israel na lah ua pat a khum hamselaw sil na lahmang masangsie uh, na galte uh na zouthei sih ding uhi.”"},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin zingmawng chiengin, anam anam in na hing kilang ding ua, tualeh hichi ahi dinga, Mangpa’n amatdoh nam khu aphung aphung in ahing kilang ding ua, Mangpa’n amatdoh phung khu a innkuon kuon un ahing pei ding ua, Mangpa’n ana matdoh innkuon khu amimal mal in ahing pei ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, koipou hamselaw sil la a kimankha pouma khu ama pum in anei zousie toh mei a haltum ahi ding, Mangpa thuhun abawsiet zieh leh Israelte lah a silgilou mothuoitah abawlziehin achi hi chi’n gen in,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua zingmawng matahin athoudoh a, Israel tate anam anamun ahing kilang sah a, tuachi’n Juda namte mat ahing hita ua;"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda namte ahing kilang sah kia a, tuachi’n Zerah phung mat ahita a, tualeh Zerah phungte ami mal mal in ahing kilang kia ua, tuachi’n Zabadi mat ahing hita hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ami mal mal in ahing kilangsah kia a, tuachi’n Juda nam a Zerah tapa, Zabadi tapa, karmi tapa Akan khu mat ahing hita hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in Akan kungah, “Ka tapa Mangpa Israelte Pasian kungah thupina pie inlen, akungah na khelna phuongin, na Silbawl hing hilin, kei kungah im vawt sin,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Akan in Joshua adawnga, akungah, “Mangpa Israelte Pasian tungah sil kana bawl khielta ngut ngei hi, tambangin ahi kana bawl."},"21":{"text":"Gal vanlahte lah a Babilon puon hoitah leh dangka shekel zani, sana tang shekel sawmnga buh ka mu a ka enla senga kana lata mawh hi, tualeh ngaiin ka puonbuh sunga lei a ka guhphuol ahia, dangka pen khumi nuoi ah a um hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in mite asawl a, puonbuh sungah ava tailut ua, tualeh ngaiin puonbuh sungah ana phuol ngut ngei a, anuoi ah dangka a um hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh tua silte khu puonbuh apat in ahing ladoh ua, Joshua leh Israel tate zousie kung ah ahing tawi ua, tualeh Mangpa masangah ahing luikhie uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua leh Israelte zousie’n Zerah tapa Akan leh a dangka te, puonsilte, sana tangte, atapate, atanute, abawngtalte, asabiltungte, abelamte, apuonbuhte leh aneizousiete toh aman ua, Akor guom ah ahing puitou uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in “Bangdinga hing sumangbang na hiei? Mangpa’n tuni’n nang zong ahing sumangbang sam ding ahi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Israelte zousie in ama suongin asep ua, tuazouin meiin ahal uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n atungah suong a sepvum venvon ua, tunitanin aum nalai hi. Tuachi’n Mangpa khu alungthahna zauhuoitah akipat akiheita hi. Tuaziehin khum mun min khu tuni tandongin Akor guom akichi denta hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Joshua kungah, “zau sinlen, lungke vawt sin, Thou inlen, galkap thei zousie pui inlen, Ai khuo ah kuontou in, Ngaiin Ai khuo leengpa leh amite leh akhuo leh agam, na khut ah ka hing peta hi.","title":"Ai khuo lahna"},"2":{"text":"Jeriko khopi leh a leengpa utunga nabawl bangin, Ai khuo leh aleengpa tungah zong na bawl ding ahi, gallah salte leh gantate maimai na tanvou dingun na kilah ding uhi, khopi aguh a buh dingin anua langah mi koidapin;” a chi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua leh galkap theiteng zousie, Ai khuo lam a kuontou dingin akisata ua, tualeh Joshua in mihat hangsan sang sawmthum ateldoh a, zanlai in asawltouta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Ngai un, khopi sim dingin khopi nualangah nana guh pan ding uh ahi, khopi apat gamla pei sengsih unlen, hinanleh kimansain um chiet un."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n kei leh ka kunga umte zousie in khopi kava zuon ding ua, tualeh hichi ahing hidinga, amasa a abawl bang ua eite dou dinga ahing pawtdoh chiengun amasang uah itai ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n eite nuadel dingin ahing pawtdoh ding ua, khopi akipat gamla simtah ihemhah masang sie un, amaun tumasanga mabangin imasangah taizahta u’e ahing chi ding ua; tuachi’n amasang uah itaizah ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n na buhdapna mun ua pat na hing pawtdoh ding ua, khopi nala ding uhi, Mangpa na Pasian un na khut uah ahing pekhe ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, khopi na lah chiengun, khopi khu mei in na hal ding ua, Mangpa thupieh bangin na bawl ding uhi; Ngaiun, thu ka hing peta hi,” chiin thu apie hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in a sawldoh ta hi, tuachi’n amaute aguh a buhdap dingin akuonkheta uhi, Bethel leh Ai khuote kikaal ah, Ai khuo tum lam ah ava um uhi, Joshua pen khum zanin mipite lah ah agieh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua zingmawng matahin athoudoh a, mipite asim a, tualeh ama leh Israel upate khu mipite masangah Ai khuo lam zuon in apeitou uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh akunga galkap thei mipi umte zousie akuontou ua, ava zuon ua, khopi kung naitah ah ahing tung ua, tualeh Ai khuo mallam pangah giehphuol abawl uhi, Ai khuo toh akikaal uah phaihawm a um hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh aman mi tulnga ding vel azawpi a, khopi tumlam pangah Bethel leh Ai khuo kikaal ah aguh a buhdap dingin mi akoi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh galkap mipihon zousie mallam pangah a koi a, tualeh anualam veng dingte khopi tumlam ah a koi zou tahun, Joshua pen khum zanin phaihawm laitah ah ava pei hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Ai khopi leengpan khum thu atheitahin, zingmawng matahin ama leh khum khopi a um mite kintahin athou ua, amun guotna mun uh phaijang ah Israelte doudingin akuonta uhi, hinanleh khopi nualangah amaute aguh a buhdap a um hi chi athei sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua leh Israelte zousie amasang uah guollel banga kibawlin, gamdai lampi langah ataita uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ai khuo a um mi zousie amaute del dingin akihankhawm ua, tualeh amauten Joshua anua delta ua, tuachi’n khopi apat gamla simtah hemhahin a umta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Israelte nuadel a pawtdohlou Ai leh Bethel ah mi khat zong a um tasih a, khopi ahawmin anuasieta ua, Israelte anuadelta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Joshua kungah, “Tua na khuta na teipi tawi Ai khuo lam ngain lehtou in, na khuta hingpe ding kahi,” a chia. Tuachi’n Joshua in akhut a ateipi tawi khu Ai khuolam ngain alehtou ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh aguh a buhdap mipite apanmun ua kipat in ahing pawtdoh ua, akhut azah tahin ahing tai ua khopi sungah alut ua, ala ua, kintahin khopi khu mei in ahalta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Ai miten anualang uh a et u’leh, Ngaivawi khopi ki halna mei khu vanlam a zamtou ngei ngui amu ua, tuachi’n amauten heilangheilanga taitheina thalezung mawngmawng aneita sih uhi, tualeh gamdai lam a taiten amauh nuadelte khu ana le nuadelta mai uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua leh Israelte zousie in, aguh a pangten khopi alata uh chi leh khopi kihalna meikhu vanlam a zamtou amu tahun akinuahei ua, Ai mite athatta uhi"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh amauh dou dingin khopi sunga pat midangte ahing pawtdoh ua, tuachi’n Israelten akalte ta ua, akimkhatte alang khat ah, kimkhat dangte ale lang khat ah aum ua, tuachi’n athat ua, khat zong hing khawilouin leh suohtalou in a satlia siengta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh Ai khopi leengpa pen ahingin aman ua, Joshua kungah ahing pui uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Israelten Ai khomi gamlah a um zousie, gamdai a ava nuadelna mun ua atha zou ua, tualeh aunpi ua namsau a avatha nua un, Israel mi zousie Ai khuo ah ahing kile kia ua, namsau in athatgamta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahi a, khum nia shi Ai khuo mite numei pasal aunpi un tul sawm leh tul ni ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ai khuo a teng mi zousie thachimit ahi masangsie’n Joshua in ateipi ale touna akhut anua koisuh kia sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Mangpa’n thu apieh a, bawl ding achi bangbangin khum khopi a gantate leh gallah silte maimai Israelte adingin, ama u’tantuom dingin akilahta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshuain Ai khuo ahal a, kumtawna dingin leisevum in abawla, tunitan in koima tenlouna asuohta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Ai khuo leengpa khu nitah dongin singdawn ah akhai a, tualeh ni atum tahin Joshua in aluong sing dawn apat lakhe dingin thu apie a, khopi kulkotpi lutna ah aluong apai ua, atungah suong asevum venvon ua, tuni tandongin a um nalai hi."},"30":{"text":"Khumi’n Joshua in Israelte Mangpa Pasian a dingin Ebal muolah maitam abawla;","title":"Ebal muol a dan thupieh simna","ref":"Danp. 27.2-8"},"31":{"text":"Mangpa suoh Mosi in Israel tate thu anapiehsa Mosi dan laibu a kigiel bangin “Koiman atunga seh alap khahlou suong kikheng hiloua kilem maitam abawla; Tuami tungah Mangpa a dingin halmang sillat leh lemna sillatte alan uhi.”","ref":"Pawt. 20.25"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh khunah Israelte mitmu mama a Mosi in dan gelsate, suong tungte ah atei sawn hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte zousie, a upate u’leh, a houtute u’leh, avaihawm te u’toh, bawm le lampang tuohtuoh ah, Mangpa thuhun bawm zawng siempu Levite leh, gamdang mite leh alah ua piengte, ading khawm chiet ua, akimkhat Gerizim muol zawn ah, akimkhat Ebal muol zawn ah, Mangpa suoh Mosi in Israel tate a guolzawl ding uh hi chia masanglai a thu ana pieh bangin ading sahta hi.","ref":"Danp. 11.29; 27.11-14"},"34":{"text":"Tuazou in Joshua in danthute zousie guolzawlna leh samsietnate, dan laibu sunga kigiel zousie dungzui in asimta hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in Israel mipi kikhawmte zousie, numeite, naupangte leh alah ua um gamdang mite masanga asimlou Mosi thupieh khat zong a um sih hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Jordan gal tumlam pang a, muol tungate leh muol zul gamngiemlah leh Lebanon mazawn a um tuipi lien panga teng Hitmite, Amormite, Kanaanmite, Perizmite, Hivmite leh Jebusmite leengpate zousie in tam thu azah tahun;","title":"Gibeon miten Joshua asol uh"},"2":{"text":"Joshua leh Israelte dou dingin lungsim munkhat puoin akikhawmta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Gibeon a tengten Joshuain Jeriko leh Ai tunga asil bawl azah tah un;"},"4":{"text":"Pil lepchie tahin agamta ua, tualeh apei ua, palai sawl bangin akibawl ua, ip luipipi asabiltungte uh aposah ua, uoin thawl lui kehsa leh ip kiphaw nemnomte bang a keng ua;"},"5":{"text":"Kengtawdap lui kiphaw nemnomte abut ua, tualeh puon sesate asil uhi, tualeh aneh ding ua atanghou puohte uh agogemgom, ap khetkhut a hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh amaute Gilgal giehphuol ah Joshua kungah ahing pei ua, akungah leh Israelte kungah, “Gamla tah a kipata hing pei ka hi ua, tuin koute toh thuhun bawl un a chi uhi.”"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel miten akung uah, “Ka lah ua teng na hikhamawsih ding uhi, bangchin noutoh thuhun kabawl thei ding uoi?” achi uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.32; 34.12; Danp. 7.2"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Joshua kungah “Na suohte kahi uh” achi ua, tuachi’n Joshua in akung uah “Koite nahi uoi? tualeh heia hing kipan nahi uoi?” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, “Mangpa na Pasian min ziehin na suohte gamlapitaha hing kipan kahi uhi, aziehpen Amin than dan leh Izipt gam a asilbawlte leh;"},"10":{"text":"Jordan gal a um Amormite leeng nite, Heshbon leengpa Sihon leh Ashtaroth a um Bashan leengpa Og tunga asilbawl zousie kana za uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 21.21-35"},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka upate u’leh ka gam sung ua tengte zousie in ka kung uah, na zin na lampi ua naneh ding uh keng unlen amauh vahoupi unlen, akung uah, “Na suohte kahi uh, tuaziehin tuin koute toh thuhun bawl un, nachi ding uhi,” chiin a gen uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tam ka neh ding ua ka hing tanghou puoh u’khu na kung ua hing hawdinga ka hing kipatdoh ni ua, ka guon laiun alum nalai ahia, hinanleh en un tu’n vang agawta a, a ap siengta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh tam uoin thawlte khu atha a ka hing thun uh ahia, tualeh en un akehta hi, tualeh tam ka puonsilte u’leh ka kengtodapte u’zong ka hing peina uh agamlat seng ziehin alui gawpta hi,” achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh miten anehding ken uh ala ua, hinanleh Mangpa kung ah thuhilna angen sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in amautoh lemna abawl a, amaute hingkhawi dingin thuhun abawl hi; tualeh mipi kikhawm lamkaiten zong akung uah thu achiem uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh amautoh thuhun abawl nua uh nithum zou in hichi ahing hi a, amaute khu akung nai ua mi ahi ua, alah ua teng ahi uh chi ahing theidohta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate apei zel ua, nithum ni in a khopite uh ahing tungta uhi. Akhopite uh ahileh Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth leh Kirjath-Jearim ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh mipi kikhawmte lamkaiten Israelte Mangpa Pasian min a akung ua thu ana chiemtah ziehun Israel taten amauh adousih uhi. Tualeh mipi kikhawmte, lamkaite tungah aphunta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n lamkaite zousie in mipikikhawmte zousie kung ah, “Israelte Mangpa Pasian min in akung uah ina kichiemta ua, tuaziehin tuin ama uh ikhoikha thei sih ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tambangin atung uah i bawl ding uhi, akung ua ithuchiemna ziehin hingkhawi mai vai, khuchilouin itung uah lungthahna ahing tungkha ding hi,” achi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh lamkaite’n akung uah “Hingkhawi in um u’henlen, hinanleh amaute khu mipite zousie ding a, singtom leh tuitawiin pang uheh, lamkaite’n akung ua ana chiemtah mabangun,” achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in amaute ahansah a, akung uah, ka lah ua teng hinapi a, “Bang dinga gamlapi a kipat a hing pei kahi uh chia hing sol nahi uoi?"},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin hamsethuoh na hita uhi, na lah ua mi khatbeh zong suoh hilou dinga zalen na umsih ding ua, ka Pasian inn adinga singtom leh tuitawi in napang ding uhi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Joshua adawng ua, “Mangpa na Pasian in a suoh Mosi kunga gam zousie na kung ua hing peding leh gamsunga teng zousie na masang ua kipat a sumang dinga thu apieh thu, na suohte chientah a hil in ka um ua, tuaziehin noute zieha ka hinna uh taan ka zau seng seng ziehun tam sil kana bawlta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh ngaivawi, tuin na khut ah ka um uhi, ka tung uah hoi le dih nasah bang bangin bawl mai in achi uhi.”"},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n atung uah khumbangin abawla, tuachi’n Israel tate khut a kipat ahunkhie a, athat nawn sih uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in khum niin amaute khu mipite ading leh aguotna muna Mangpa maitam a dinga sing puo leh tuitawi dingin apangsah a, tuni dongin apang nalai uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hia, Jerusalem leengpa Adoni-Zedek in Joshua in Ai khuo alah a, asuhmang a, Jeriko khuo leh a leengpa tunga abawl bangin, Ai khuo leh a leengpa tungah zong abawlta hi; tualeh Gibeon a tengten Israelte toh kilemna abawlta ua, alah uah atengta uhi chi azahtah in;","title":"Israelten Amor mite azawna"},"2":{"text":"a zauta mama hi, aziehpen Gibeon khuo pen leengpa khopite laha khopi lien khat bang leh Ai khuo sanga lienzaw ahi a, asunga teng zousie mihattah ngen ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jerusalem leengpa Adoni-Zedek in Hebron leengpa Hoham, Jermuth leengpa Piram, Lakish leengpa Japhia leh Eglon leengpa Dabirte kungah mi asawl a;"},"4":{"text":"“Ka kungah hing peitou unlen, Gibeonmite ithagam theina dingun hing panpi un, amauten Joshua leh Israel tate toh kilemna abawlta uhi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin Amor mite leeng ngate, Jerusalem leengpa, Hebron leengpa, Jarmuth leengpa, Lakish leengpa leh Eglon leengpate akikhawm khawm ua, ama u’leh a galkap honpi utoh akuontou ua, Gibeon kho gal ah giehphuol abawl ua, adouta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Gibeonmiten Gilgal a giehphuol ah Joshua kungah mi asawl ua, “Na suohte hing taisan vawt sin, kintahin ka kung uah hing peitou inlen, hing hundam inlen hing panpi in, aziehpen singtang gam a teng Amor mite leengte zousie koute dou dingin akikhawmta uhi,” ava chita uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua leh akunga um galkap thei miteng leh mihat leh hangsan zousie Gilgal a kipat in akuontou ua;"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Joshua kungah, “Amaute giing vawt sin, na khut ah ka hing pedohta hi, na masangah mi khat zong ading ngam aum sih ding uhi,” a chi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua thakhat in akung uah ahing tungta hi, zan khovah a Gilgal akipat a hing peitou ahita hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Israelte masangah amaute asubuoi gawpta a, Gibeon khuo ah tampi athat a, tualeh Beth-Horon zottouna lampi ah adel a, Azekah leh Makkedah tan dongin athat toupeh nalai uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, Israelte masang akipat atai ua, Beth-horon zotsuhna lam a aum laiun, Mangpa’n van a kipat in gieltang lienpipi atung uah Azekah tandongin akesah a, ashita uhi. Israel taten namsau a atha sang un gieltang in a selia atamzaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Amor mite Israel tate apieh niin Joshuain Mangpa kungah thu agen a, Israelte mitmuin, “Ni, Gibeon khotungah ding den inlen, Ha, nang zong Aijalon guom ah um den in,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n miten a melmate uh tunga phuba alahzou masangsie uh Ni ading den ta a, Ha zong akhawl denta hi. Tam thu khu Jasher laibu ah gel hilou ahiei mah? Tuachi’n ni khu vanlaizawl ah ading denta a, ni khat tungtawn tum ding vai ahawmta sih hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 1.18"},"14":{"text":"Mangpa’n khumbanga mihing aw angaikhiet ni bangin, amasangin ni aum ngai mawngmawng sih a, Mangpa’n Israelte dingin adoupieh ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua leh Israelte zousie Gilgala a giehphuol uah akinuale sieng kiata uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh khum leeng ngate ataimang ua Makedah leihawm ah akibuta uhi."},"17":{"text":"“Tualeh leeng ngate Makedah leikohawm sunga kibu in akimudoh hi” chiin Joshua ahil ua."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in “Leikohawm kamah suong lien pipi lia unlen, aveng dingin mi koi un;"},"19":{"text":"Noute umden sih unlen, na melmate uh nuadel unlen anualang vengte that unlen, akhopite uah lutsah vawt sih un, Mangpa na Pasian un amaute na khut uah ahing piehsa ahita hi”"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing ahi a, Joshua leh Israel taten amaute athagam sieng masangsie uh hatha in athat ua, alah ua suohta teng khu kulbangnei khopite ah atailutta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh mi zousie Makedah giehphuola Joshua kungah galmuong tahin ahing kinuale kia ua, koima’n Israel tate gensietna in aleiuh aloh sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in “Leikohawm kam hong unlen, tua leeng ngate leikohawm a kipat ka kungah hing pui un,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh amaun tambangin abawl ua, tua leeng ngate, Jerusalem leengpa, Hebron leengpa, Jarmuth leengpa, Lakish leengpa leh Eglon leengpa te leikohawm akipat in Joshua kungah ahing pui uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hi a, Tua leengte Joshua kunga ahing pui tahun, Joshua in Israel tate zousie ahankhawm a, amatoh kuontou galkap mite lah a lamkai deu deute kungah, “Hing nai unlen, tam leengte ngawng na kengun tuon un: achi a,” tuachi’n ahing pei ua angawnguh ahing totpieh uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in akung uah, “Zau sih unlen lungke tuom sih un, hattah leh hangsan tahin um un, Mangpa’n tambangin na kidoupi na galte uh tungah abawl ding ahi,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuazouin Joshua in amaute asat a, athatta hi, tualeh amaute sing dawn ah akhai a, tuachi’n nitahlam tandongin singdawn ah akikhai uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahi a, nitum kuon in Joshua in thu apie a, singdawn akipat in alakhie ua, akibutna uh leikohawm ah apailut ua, aleihawm kam suong lien pipi in ahu ua, tuni tanin zong aum nalai hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in khum niin Makedah khuo ala a, aleengpa uh nasan zong namsau in athat a, khum khuo ateng mi zousie khat zong khawilouin athatgam kilkel a, Jeriko leengpa tunga abawl bangin Makedah leengpa tungah zong abawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua Israelte zousie toh Makedah a kipat in Libnah ah apei ua, Libnah ava kidoupita uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n khum khuo a aleengpa nasan utoh, Israelte khut ah apekhe kia leuleu a, tuachi’n aman namsau hiem tahin a sunga teng zousie asatgama, khat zong ahinkhawita sih hi, Jeriko leengpa tunga abawl bangin, tam khuo leengpa tungah zong abawl hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua khu Israelte zousie toh Libnah akipat in Lakish khuo lam ah apei ua, panmun akhaw ua, akidoupita uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Lakish khuo khu Israelte khut ah apie a, aman ani ni niin tam khuo ala a, tualeh akho sunga mi um zousie namsau in asatlia sienga Libnah khotunga abawl bangin abawlta hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gezer leengpa Horam khu Lakish khuo panpi dingin akuontou a, Joshua in ama leh amite khat beeh zong khawilouin athat gam sieng hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Lakish akipat in Joshua khu Israelte zousie toh Eglon ah apei ua, panmun akhaw ua, akidoupita uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh amauten khumni mama in tam khuo ala ua, namsau hiemtahin a satgamta uhi, tualeh asunga mihing um zousie Lakish tunga abawl bangbangin a un pi’n asumang sieng kilkel uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua akunga um Israelte zousie toh Eglon khuo akipat in Hebron khuo lamah apei ua, ava kidoupita ua;"},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum khuo ala ua, aleengpa u’leh akhopi leh asunga teng mihing zousie toh namsau hiemin asat gam sieng uhi, Eglon khotunga abawl bangbangin khat beeh zong khawi louin akhuo nasan pumin asumang thai sienga, asunga um zousie toh asumangthai sieng hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua leh Israelte zousie Debir ah a kuon kia ua, ava kidoupi ua."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n ala ua, a leengpa leh akhopi zousie toh, tualeh namsau hiemin asatgam sieng ua, asunga um mihing zousie khat beeh zong hinkhawi louin asumangthang sieng uhi. Hebron tunga abawl bangbang in Debir tung leh aleengpa tungah abawla, Libnah khuo leh aleengpa tunga abawl bang in zong a bawl hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in gam pumpi abawn in, tanggam zousie, simlam gam zousie, muolhap gam ngiem zousie leh phai gam zousie leh a leengpate zousie uh athat gam a khat beeh zong hinkhawi louin, Israelte Mangpa Pasian thu pieh bangin hinna nei pouma asuchimit sieng hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in amaute gam zousie Kadesh-Barnea akipat Gaza todongin, tualeh Goshen gam zousie, Gibeon tandongin azou a, alata hi."},"42":{"text":"Tam leengte zousie leh agamte uh Joshua in khatvei thuin ala sieng hi; aziehpen Israelte Mangpa Pasian in Israelte adingin adoupieh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua leh Israelte zousie Gilgala agiehphuol uah ahing kinuale kiata uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tamte zou in, Hazor leengpa Jabin in khum thute azah tahin, Madon leengpa Jobab leh Shimron leengpa tualeh Akshaph leengpate,","title":"Joshua in Jabin leh apanpite azawna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh tang gam mallam a um leengte leh Kinneroth simlam Arabah leengte leh gam ngiem aum leengte, tualeh tumlam Dor gamgi zula um leengte kung leh;"},"3":{"text":"Suolam leh tumlam a um Kanaan mite kungah, tanggam aum Amormite leh Hitmite, Perizmite, Jebusmite leh Mizpah gam Hermon muol nuoi a um Hivmite kungah mi asawl a."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute a galkap honpite utoh mi atama tam, atam dan uh tuipi pieua, pieunel bang mai atam sakol leh sakolleng tampitoh akuonta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh tam leengte zousie ahing kimu khawmta ua, Israelte dou dingin, Merom tuite ah panmun akhawkhawmta uhi,"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Joshua kung ah, “Amaute, giing sin;
