zingchieng tuhun in, amaute a unpi un thaliasa in Israelte hing pe ding kahi ziehin, asakolte uh za nua na sattan pieh ding ua, asakollengte u’zong mei in na haltum pieh ding uhi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua leh agalkapte amauh doudingin Merom tuite ah thakhat in ahing tung phutta mai ua, theiloukal in aluonkhumta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n amaute khu Israelte khut ah apekheta a, tuachi’n Israelten amaute athat gam ua, azouta ua, Sidon lien leh Meraphoth-Maim tandongin, tualeh suolam a Mizpah phaihawm dongin anuadel ua, khat mama zong suohta sahlouin athatgam sieng uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n thu apieh bangin Joshua in atung uah abawl hi, asakol zanuate uh asat pieh ua, asakollengte uh mei in ahaltum pieh uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh khum hunlai in Joshua akinua le a, Hazor khuo ala a, aleengpa uh namsauin athat a, aziehpen tumasang laiin Hazor khu khum leenggamte lah ah khopi pen ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh khum khuo a um mihing zousie athat sieng ua, asuchimit sieng ua, hinna nei pouma khat zong anuasie sih ua, Hazor khu mei in ahalta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum leengte khopite zousie leh aleengpate zousie uh Joshua in aman a, namsau hiemin asatlia sienga, tualeh Mangpa suoh Mosi in thu apieh bangin asumang sieng hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Hazor chilou muol tunga khopi na kibawl zousate zousie Israelten ahal sih ua, Hazor pen ahileh Joshua in ahalvam vawt hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh tam khopite a gallah silte sum leh gantate zousie khu Israel taten amauh tantuom dingin akilah ua, hinanleh mihingte ahileh athagam masangsie un namsau hiemtahin a satlia sieng ua, hinna nei khat zong ahinkhawi sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa’n asuoh Mosi thu apieh bang in, Mosi in Joshua thu apie a, tualeh Joshua in tuabangin abawl hi; Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh zousie bawllouin bangma anuasie sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in khum gam zousie, singtang gam pumpi leh Negev gam sung zousie tualeh Goshen gam ngiem zousiete, Arabah gam zousie, Israel singtang gam leh gam ngiem leh aphaigamte utoh ala sieng kei hi.","title":"Joshua in gam pumpi alahna"},"17":{"text":"Seir muol vasuntou Halak muol a kipat a Hermon tang nuoi a, Lebanon phaiguom a Baal-gad tandong in ala siengta hi, tualeh aleengpate zousie uh aman a, asata, athat siengta hi."},"18":{"text":"Joshua in khum leengte zousie sawtpi vei akidoupi hi."},"19":{"text":"Gibeon khuo a teng Hivmite chilou, Israel tate toh lemna bawl khopi khat zong a umsih uhi; adangteng pen kidou a alah ngen uh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh banga asuhchimit sienga, deisahna neivawt lou a, a suhmangthang theina ding ua alungtang uh asuhkhau pieh a, Israelte dousah zelpa lah Mangpa ahi ngal a.","ref":"Danp. 7.16"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua tua hunlai in ahing kuon a, Anakimte singtang gam a pat in, Hebron akipat in, Debir akipat in, Anab akipat in tualeh Juda tanggam zousie akipat leh Israel tanggam akipat in Anakimte asatkhe sienga, Joshua in amaute akhopite u’toh asuchimit sieng hi."},"22":{"text":"Israel tate gam ah Anakimte khat zong nuasie in a um sih hi. Gaza aleh Gath aleh Ashdod khuote ah aum nalai uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi kunga agen bangin Joshua in gam pumpi alata a, tualeh Joshua in Israelte anam uh kikhen dan dungzui zelin agouluo dingun ape chiet hi; Tuachi’n gam khu galmuongin a umta hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tamte khu ahi Israel taten azaw uh, Jordan luigal lelam nisuohna lam a, Arnon lui a kipata Hermon muol tandong leh, suolam phaijang gam zousie a, agam uh aluo pieh uh leengte ahi uhi.","title":"Mosi in azaw leengte","ref":"Kisim. 21.21-35; Danp. 2.26—3.11"},"2":{"text":"Heshbon a tenga, tualeh Arnon luipanga um, Aroer a kipat leh luikim laia kipan leh Gilead gam kimkhat a kipan a Ammonmite gamgi zula um Jabbok lui tandonga vaihawm Amormite leengpa Sihon ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Jordan phaijang suolam a kipat Kinneroth tuipi tandong ahia, tualeh suolam ah Beth-Jeshimoth zotna lampi lam a Arabah tuipi, Tuipi Al tandong ahia, tualeh simlam ah Pisgah muolpang ken bul tandong ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Ashtaroth leh Edrei khuote a um Rephaim nam um sunte lah a Bashan leengpa Og in vai ahawm a."},"5":{"text":"Aman Hermon taang ah leh Salkah khuo leh Bashan gam zousie ah, Geshurmite leh Makathmite gamgi leh Gilead gam kimkhat tandongin, Heshbon leengpa Sihon gamgi tandongin vai ahawm hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa suoh Mosi leh Israel taten amaute athat ua, tualeh Mangpa suoh Mosi in Reuben namte, Gad namte leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kungah agoutan dingun ahawm pieh hi.","ref":"Kisim. 32.33; Danp. 3.12"},"7":{"text":"Tamte khu ahi, Joshua leh Israel taten Jordan gal nitumna lampanga athate uh. Lebanon guom Baal-gad a kipat a Seir muol suntou Halak muol tandongin; Tualeh Joshua in Israel namte akikhen dan dungzui zel un khum gamte agouluo dingun ape chiet hi.","title":"Joshua in leengte azou"},"8":{"text":"Tua a gam kihop uh huop sung khu, singtang gamte, phai gamte, Phaijang gamte, muolpang ken leh zang kichin a gamte, gamdai gam, simlam gamte, Hitmite gam, Amormite gam, Kanaanmite gam, Perizmite gam, Hivmite gam leh Jebus mite gam zousie ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Aleengte u’khu, Jeriko leengpa, Bethel khopam a um Ai leengpa;"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem leengpa, Hebron leengpa,"},"11":{"text":"Jarmuth leengpa, Lakish leengpa,"},"12":{"text":"Eglon leengpa, Gezer leengpa,"},"13":{"text":"Debir leengpa, Geder leengpa,"},"14":{"text":"Hormah leengpa, Arad leengpa,"},"15":{"text":"Libnah leengpa, Adullam leengpa,"},"16":{"text":"Makkedah leengpa, Bethel leengpa,"},"17":{"text":"Tappuah leengpa, Hepher leengpa,"},"18":{"text":"Aphek leengpa, Lasharon leengpa,"},"19":{"text":"Madon leengpa, Hazor leengpa,"},"20":{"text":"Shimron-meron leengpa, Akshaph leengpa,"},"21":{"text":"Tanak leengpa, Megiddo leengpa,"},"22":{"text":"Kadesh leengpa, Karmel-Jokneam leengpa,"},"23":{"text":"Dor gamgi zula Dor leengpa, Gilgal gam namte leengpa,"},"24":{"text":"Tirzah leengpa, Lengte zousie sawmthumle khat."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Joshua ahing tehta a, akum zong ahing tam mama ta a, tualeh Mangpa’n akungah, “Na tehta a, na kum zong atam ta hi, hinanleh gam lah ding lah atam mama nalai hi.","title":"Gam hawm ding dan Mangpa’n Joshua ahilna"},"2":{"text":"Gam lah nailou khu tamte ahi, Philistin gamgi zul zousie leh Geshuri gam zousie,"},"3":{"text":"Izipt suolam aum Shihor apat mallam a Ekron gamgi tandongin (tam khu Kanaan mite gam a sim ahi.) Philistinte leeng ngate Gaza mite, Ashdod mite, Ashkelon mite, Git mite, Ekron mite gam leh Avim mite gam zong."},"4":{"text":"Simlam akipat Kanaan mite gam zousie leh Sidon mite gam Mearah akipat a Amormite gamgi zula Aphek tandongin;"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Gebal mite gam leh ni suohna lam Lebanon zousie Hermon tang nuoia um Baal-gad a kipat a Hamath kho lutna tandongin."},"6":{"text":"Lebanon akipat Miserephoth-maim tandonga singtang gam a tengte zousie leh Sidon mite zousie Keima’n Israel tate masangah ka deldoh dinga, na kunga thu ka hing pieh tahmabangin nangman tamte Israel tate kungah agouluo dingun nahawm pieh ding ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 33.54"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin tam gam khu nam kuote leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kungah agouluo dingun hawm pieh ta in.”"},"8":{"text":"Manasseh nam kimkhatte Reuben namte leh Gad namten Mangpa suoh Mosi in apieh bangin Jordan gal suolam pangah Mosi in amauh apieh a goutan uh ana tangta uhi.","title":"Manasseh, Reuben leh Gad namte goutan gam hawmna","ref":"Kisim. 32.33; Danp. 3.12"},"9":{"text":"Arnon luipanga um Aroer leh guom laizanga um khopi leh Medeba phaijang zousie a pat Debon dong leh;"},"10":{"text":"Heshbon a teng Amormite leengpa Sihon khopi zousie Ammon mite gamgi tandongin."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Gilead leh Geshurmite leh Maakathmite gamgi leh Hermon Singtang gam zousie leh Bashan gam zousie Salkah tandongin."},"12":{"text":"Ashtaroth leh Edrei a vaihawm Bashan a Og leenggam zousie toh (khum Rephaim nam umsunte ahi uh) aziehpen amauh Mosi in anadoulai a adeldohte ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel taten Geshurmite leh Maakath mite adeldoh sih ua, tuaziehin Geshur mite leh Maakath mite tuni tandongin Israel tate lah ah ateng uhi."},"14":{"text":"Levi namte kung bou ah gouluo ding ape sih a, aman a kung ua agensa bangin, Israelte Mangpa Pasian a dinga mei a sillatte khu amauh Goutan ahi.","title":"Levite gamgi","ref":"Danp. 18.1"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Reuben namte kungah ainnkuon dungzui in agoutan ding uh ana peta hi.","title":"Reuben namte gamgi"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh gamgi khu Arnon luipanga um Aroer akipat a guom laizanga khopi leh Medeba kunga phaijang gam zousie;"},"17":{"text":"Heshbon leh khum phaijang gam a khopi zousie, Debon, Bamoth-bal leh Bethbal-Meon."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Jahaza, Kedemoth leh Mephaath"},"19":{"text":"Kiriathaim, Sibmah, phaihawm gei a um Zereth-Sahar"},"20":{"text":"Beth-peor, Pisgah muolpangte leh Beth Jeshmothte"},"21":{"text":"Phaijang gam khopite zousie leh Heshbon a vaihawm Amormite leengpa Sihon leenggam zousie leh Mosi in ana thagamsa Midian leengte Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur leh Reba leenggam sunga teng Sihon leeng tapate ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Beor tapa Balaam aisan siempa zong Israel taten amithate lah uah, namsau in athat tel uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Reuben tate gamgi khu Jordan leh apang chieng ahi. Tamte khu Reuben tate dinga ainnkuon uh dung zui a, agoutan ding ua, khopite leh khoneute khu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Gad namte kung ah zong a goutan ding uh ana pie a, Gad tate kung ngei ah, a innkuon dungzui in ana pie hi.","title":"Gad namte gamgi"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh agamgi u’khu Jazer leh Gilead gam khopi zousie leh Ammon mite gam kimkhat Rabbah suolam a Aroer tandong."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Heshbon akipata Ramath-Mizpah leh Betonim dong, tualeh Mahanaim akipat in Debir gamgi tandong ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Phaihawm lam ah Beth-aram leh Beth-nimrah, Sukkoth, Zaphon leh Heshbon leengpa Sihon leenggam dang teng toh Jordan lui khu agamgi ahia, Jordan ni suona lam a Kinnereth Tuipi tandong ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tamte khu Gad tate dinga a innkuon u’dungzui a goutan a anei uh khopite leh khoneute toh atan khawm uh ahi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in Manasseh nam kimkhatte kungah goutan ding apie a, Tamte khu a innkuon uh dungzui a, Manasseh nam kimkhatte goutan gam ahi.","title":"Manasseh nam kimkhatte gamgi"},"30":{"text":"Agamgi ukhu Mahanaim akipat in Bashan gam zousie, Bashan leengpa Og leenggam zousie leh Bashan a um Jair khopite zousie khopi sawmguh ahi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Gilead gam kimkhat leh Bashan gam leengpa Og gam a Ashtaroth leh Edrei khuote khu Manasseh tapa Makir tate ainnkuon uh dungzui a Makir tate kimkhat tan dinga guot ahi."},"32":{"text":"Tamte khu Jeriko suolam a Jordan gal langkhat lam a, Moab phaijang a goutan dinga Mosi in ahawm gamte khu ahi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh Levi namte kung ah Mosi in goutan ding bangma ape sih hi, akung ua agensa bangin Israelte Mangpa Pasian khu agoutan uh ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 18.20; Danp. 18.2"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tamte khu Israel taten Kanaan gam a aluo uh gamte: Siempu Eleazar leh Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel tate nam upaten, akung ua agoutan ding ua ahawm pieh u khu ahi.","title":"Aisan a Kanaan gam hawmna"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n Mosi khut zanga thu apieh bangin, nam kuote ading leh nam kimkhatte dinga agoutan u’khu aisan a kihawm ahi uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 26.52-56; 34.13"},"3":{"text":"Mosi in nam nite leh nam kimkhatte Jordan lui gal langkhat lam ah agoutan ding uh apeta a, hinanleh Levi mite kung ah goutan ape sih hi.","ref":"Kisim. 32.33; 34.14,15; Danp. 3.12-17"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph tate khu nam ni, Manasseh leh Ephraim ahi ua, tualeh khum gam ah Levi tate khu tanvou pieh ahi sih uh; atenna ding uh khopite leh aganhonte uh tatna ding gamhingte leh aneilelamte uh koikhawmna ding adaikim te uh chilou akung uah tanvou bangma ape sih uhi"},"5":{"text":"Mangpa’n Mosi thu apieh bangin, Israel taten abawl ua, gam khu ahawmta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda tate khu Gilgal ah Joshua kung ah ahing pei ua; tualeh Keniz mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb in akungah, “Kadesh-Barnea mun a Pasian mipa Mosi kunga, Nang leh kei tungtang thu agen nathei hi, achita hi.","title":"Kaleb gamgite","ref":"Kisim. 14.30"},"7":{"text":"Mangpa suoh Mosi in gam enkhe dinga Kadesh-Barnea apata ahing sawl laiin kum sawmli a upa kahi a, tualeh ka lungtanga um bangin akung ah thu ka nua tut kia hi.","ref":"Kisim. 13.1-30"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh ka kuontoupi ka unauten mipite lungtang azunmang sah ua, hinanleh kenvang Mangpa ka Pasian nua dettah in ka zui hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum ni in Mosi akichiem a, tambangin agen hi: Na kengphang a na tot khahna gam pouma nang leh nahah nasuonte kumtawn goutan ahi ding hi, Mangpa na Pasian khu lungkelou a na zuizieh in, ahing chi hi.","ref":"Kisim. 14.24"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh tuin Ngaiin, Mangpa’n Mosi kunga tam thu agen zou, Israelte gamdai a avahvai sungun, Mangpa’n agensa bangin kum sawmli leh kum nga tah ahing dam sah a, tuachi’n ngaiin tuni’n kum sawmgiet leh kumnga ka hita hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuni dongin Mosi in ahing sawl ni a ka thahat ma bangin tuin zong kahat nalai hi; galdou dinga kuondoh ding leh vai tung dingin tuin zong kahat nalai hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, Mangpa’n khum ni a ana gensa tami muoltung gam khu hing peta in, aziehpen, khuna Anakimte a um dan uh, akhopite uh thupidan leh kulpi dettah a ki im khum ahi dan uh, khum niin na zata hi. Mangpa’n ahing umpi pouleh, Mangpa’n agensa bangin amaute ka notdoh zou ding hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in ama aguolzawl a, tualeh Jephunneh tapa Kaleb kungah agoutan dingin Hebron khuo apeta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin Hebron khuo khu tuni tandongin Keniz mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb goutan ahita hi; aziehpen aman Israelte Mangpa Pasian nua dettahin a zui hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Hebron min khu Kirjath-Arba ana kichi ahia, Arba khu Anakimte lah a, milientah ahi, tuachi’n gam khu galmuongin akhawlta hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n tamte a innkuon uh dungzui a Juda namte tanvou ahi, simlam pangah Edom gamgi dongin, simlam gammong tawp Zin gamdai tan dong ahi.","title":"Juda tanvou gam"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh simlam panga a gamgi uh Tuipi Al mong tawpna a kipan ahia;"},"3":{"text":"Simlam ah Akrabbim kaltouna dong aphasuh a, Zin gamdai zul zul ah Kadesh-Barnea simlam dongin ahing kihung tou a, Hezron ah asuohtou a, Addar ava pha a, Karkas kuol khum in akihei a;"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Azmon ah apei zel a, Izipt luita ah asuohdoh a, Tuipi tan ah atawpta hi. Tam khu simlam panga na gamgi uh ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh suolampanga gamgi khu Tuipi-Al Jordan tunna laitah ahi a, tualeh mallam gamgi khu, Jordan luinah tuipi pangah akipan a,"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamgi pen Beth-Hoglah ah atou pei a, Beth-arabah mallam ah asuoh a, tuachi’n Reuben tapa Bohan gamgi suongphu tan avapha hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamgi khu Akor guom akipat in Debir ah a peitou a, tualeh mallam nawt in tua guom simlam ah Adummim kaltouna toh ki maingat aum Gilgal langah akihei a, tuachi’n gamgi khu En-Shemesh tuite azuisuh a, tuachi’n gamgi khu En-rogel ah asuoh khie hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamgi khu Hinnom tapa guom ah, Jebuste (Jerusalem ahi) gam pang simlam dongin apeitou a, tualeh gamgi khu Hinnom guom gal tumlam ah ahing kihung suh a, Rephaim guom sahlam a muol vum dongin a kihung phei hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh gamgi khu muolvum a hing kipan in Nephtoah tuite dongin apeisah ua, Ephron muola khopite ah apei zel a, tuachi’n gamgi khu Baalah (Tua khu Kirjath-Jearim ahi) tandong avel suoh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh gamgi pen Baalah akipat in tumlam pang ah Seir muol dongin akihei kuol kia a, mallam pang ah Jearim (tuakhu kesalon ahi) muol zuiin mallam ah apeitou a, tualeh Beth-shemesh dongin akiheisuh kia a, tuachi’n Timnah azui suh hi."},"11":{"text":"Gamgi khu Ekron mallam muol pangah apei a tuachi’n Shikkeron tandong ah akiviel a, tualeh Baalah muol a zui a, Jabneel ah apawt khie a, tuachi’n gamgi khu tuipi ah atawp hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh tumlampang gamgi pen tuipi Lien gei zul a, apieu tandong ahi, tami Juda tate a innkuon dungzui zel a atan uh gamgi ahi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa’n Joshua kunga thu apieh bangin, tuin Joshua in Jephunneh tapa Kaleb kungah, Juda tate lah a agoutan tuom dingin Kirjath-Arba apie hi, tua khu Hebron zong akichi hi. (Arba kichipa khu Anak pa ahi)","title":"Kaleb in Hebron leh Debir azawna","ref":"Vai. 1.20"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Kaleb in tuana kipat in, Anak tapa thumte, Sheshai, Ahiman leh Talmai kichi Anak tate adeldoh ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Khuna kipat in Debir khuo a mite vasim dingin a kuontou ua, Debir khu masanglai in Kiriath-Sepher akichi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Kaleb in “Koizong Kiriath-Sepher vasim a, vala zou pouma kungah ka tanu Aksa azi dingin ka pe ding hi” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kaleb sanggampa Kenaz tapa Othniel-in khum khopi ava lata a, tuachi’n aman atanu Aksa azi dingin apeta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Amanu apasal kung ahing tun in, apasal in apa kungah gam angen sahta a, tualeh a sabiltung tunga kipat akum a, Kaleb in amanu kungah “Bang dei na hiei” ana chi hi."},"19":{"text":"Amanu’n “Guolzawlna khat hing pie’n, simlam gam a na hing umsahtah ziehin tuinah neite zong hing pie’n” achi a. Tuachi’n Kaleb in tuinahnei sahta leh tuinahnei hangtate apeta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam khu a innkuon dungzui zel ua Juda tate kung a kipie agoutan uh ahi.","title":"Juda khopite"},"21":{"text":"Simlang gam mong tandonga, Edom gamgi langa Juda namte khopi zousie khu Kabzeel, Eder leh Jagur ahi."},"22":{"text":"Kinah, Dimonah leh Adadah,"},"23":{"text":"Kadesh, Hazor leh Ithnan,"},"24":{"text":"Zipti, Telem leh Bealoth."},"25":{"text":"Hazor, Hadattah, Kerioth leh Hezron, (tuakhu Hazor ahi)"},"26":{"text":"Amam, Shema leh Moladah,"},"27":{"text":"Hazar, Gaddah Heshmon, Beth Pelet,"},"28":{"text":"Hazar, Shual, Beer-sheba leh Bizjothjah,"},"29":{"text":"Baalah, Ijim, Ezem,"},"30":{"text":"Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,"},"31":{"text":"Ziglag, Madmannah, Sansannah,"},"32":{"text":"Lebaoth, Shillim, Ain, Rimmon: Khopite zousie leh kho neute toh a unpi’n sawmni leh kuo,"},"33":{"text":"phaijang gamngiem ah: Eshtaol, Zoreah leh Ashnah"},"34":{"text":"Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah leh Enam."},"35":{"text":"Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh leh Azekah."},"36":{"text":"Sharaim, Adithaim, Gederah leh Gederothaim, khopi sawm leh li akhoneute utoh."},"37":{"text":"Zenan, Hadashah, Midgal Gad,"},"38":{"text":"Dilean, Mizpah, Jokthel,"},"39":{"text":"Lakish, Bozkath, Eglon"},"40":{"text":"Kabbon, Lahmas, Kithlish."},"41":{"text":"Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Namah leh Makkedah: Khopi sawm leh guh leh akhoneute utoh."},"42":{"text":"Libnah, Ether, Ashan,"},"43":{"text":"Jiphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,"},"44":{"text":"Keilah, Akzib leh Mareshah, khopi kuo leh akhoneute utoh."},"45":{"text":"Ekron akhopite leh akhoneute toh."},"46":{"text":"Ekron a kipat Tuipi tandongin Ashdod kung nai a um zousiete akhoneute utoh."},"47":{"text":"Ashdod a khopite leh akhoneute toh, Gaza akhopite leh a khoneute toh, Izipt luita kunga tuipi Lien leh apang zulte toh ahi."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh singtang gam a Shamir, Jattir leh Sokoh."},"49":{"text":"Dannah, Kirjath Sannah (tua khu Debir ahi)"},"50":{"text":"Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim."},"51":{"text":"Goshen, Holon leh Giloh: khopi sawm leh khat akhoneute utoh."},"52":{"text":"Arab, Dumah, Eshean"},"53":{"text":"Janum, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,"},"54":{"text":"Humtah, Kirjath-Arba (tua khu Hebron ahi) leh Zior: khopi kuo leh akhoneute utoh."},"55":{"text":"Maon, Karmel, Ziph, Juttah,"},"56":{"text":"Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,"},"57":{"text":"Kain, Gibeah leh Timnah: khopi sawm leh a khoneute utoh."},"58":{"text":"Halhul, Beth-Zur, Gedor,"},"59":{"text":"Maarath, Beth-Anoth leh Eltekon: khopi guh leh akhoneute utoh."},"60":{"text":"Kirjath Baal (Kirjath-Jearim zong akichi hi) leh Rabbah: khopi ni a khoneute utoh."},"61":{"text":"Gamdai ah Beth-Arabah, Middin, Sekakah."},"62":{"text":"Nibshan, Chi khopi leh En-Gedi: khopi guh leh akhoneute utoh."},"63":{"text":"Jerusalem khuo a teng Jebus mite ahileh Juda taten a notdoh zou sih ua, tuachi’n Jebus mite khu tuni dongin Juda mite toh Jerusalem ah ateng khawm uhi.","ref":"Vai. 1.21; 2 Sam. 5.6; 1 Khang. 11.4"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph tate tanvou dinga gam kipie khu; Jeriko kunga Jordan akipat in, gamdai suolam panga Jeriko tuinahte ah ahing suoh a; Jeriko akipat in singtang gam ah Bethel dongin apeitou zel hi.","title":"Joseph tate gamgi"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Bethela kipat in Luz ah asuoh a, Ark mite gamgi a Ataroth dongin apei zel a;"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh tumlam panga Japhlet mite gamgi ah apeisuh a, Beth-Horon hangta zaw ah asuoh suh a Gezer tandongin apeisuh zel a, tuipi ah atawp hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph tate Manasseh leh Ephraim namten a goutan uh alata uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh a innkuon uh dungzui a Ephraim tate gamgi pen tambang ahi, suo lampangah a goutan gamgi uh khu Ataroth-addar ahia, Beth-Horon sahta zaw tandongin;","title":"Ephraim namte gamgi"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh gamgi khu tuipi mallam panga Mikmethath ah apei a, tualeh gamgi khu suolam a Tanath-Shilloh ah apei kuola, suolam a, Janoah ah apei zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Janoah apat in Ataroth ah leh Naarah ah apei suh a, Jeriko ahing sukha a, tualeh Jordan ah ahing suoh doh hi."},"8":{"text":"Gamgi khu tumlam a Tappuah apat in Kanah luita dongin apei zel a, Tuipi ah asuohdoh hi, tami a innkuon dungzui ua Ephraim tate goutan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Ephraim tate khopi goutan tuomte khu Manasseh tate goutan lah ah aumta hi, khopi zousie leh akhoneute u’toh."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Gezer-a teng Kanaan mite khu adelmangta sih ua, tuachi’n Kanaan mite khu Ephraim mite lah ah tuni tandongin atengta ua, hinanleh pau bawlna toh nasep sah suohte ahi uhi.","ref":"Vai. 1.29"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh nam a dingin zong Goutan tuom khat a um hi; tuaziehin ama khu Joseph tapa upapen Makir, Gilead pa khu galhat mi ahiziehin, Gilead leh Bashan gam atangta hi.","title":"Manassehte gamgi"},"2":{"text":"Manasseh ta dangte adingin zong ainnkuon dungzui ua atan ding uh khat a um hi; Abiezar tate adingin, Helek tate adingin, Asriel tate adingin, Shekem tate adingin, Hepher tate adingin tualeh Shemida tate adingin, tamte khu a innkuon uh dungzui zel a Joseph tapa Manasseh tapate ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Manasseh tapa, Makir tapa, Gilead tapa, Hepher tapa Zelophehad in tapa anei sih a, tanu maimai anei hi. Tualeh tamte khu atanute min ahi; Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah tualeh Tirzah ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh ama ute khu Siempu Eleazar masang, Nun tapa Joshua masang leh lamkaite masang ah ahing pei ua, akung uah, ka unaute u’lah a goutan hing pe sam dingin “Mangpa’n Mosi kungah thu apie hi,” achi ua. Tuaziehin Mangpa thupieh dungzui in ama ute apa uh unaute lah ah Goutan ape samta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 27.1-7"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jordan gal lelam a um Gilead leh Bashan chiloungal Manasseh in goutan sawm atangta hi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen Manasseh tanuten, atapate lah ah goutan anei ua, Manasseh tapa dangten Gilead gam atang uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Manasseh gamgi khu Shekem suolam a um Asher akipata Mikmethath dong ahi, tualeh gamgi khu zietlam pangah En-tappuoh mite tenna dongin apei suh suoh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Manasseh in Tappuah gam atanga, hinanleh Manasseh gamgi zula um Tappuah pen Ephraim tate tan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh gamgi khu Kanah luita, luita simlam ah a peikhesuh hi. Tam Ephraim khopite khu Manasseh khopite lah ah a um hi. Manasseh gamgi zong mallam pang ah a um hi. Tualeh Tuipi ah atung hi."},"10":{"text":"Simlam pang pen Ephraim a ahia, Mallam pang pen Manasseh a ahi; Tuipi khu agamgi ahi, mallam ah Asher tandong ahia, suolam ah Isaakar tandong ahi tou hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Isaakar leh Asher gam sungah Manasseh in Beth-Shean leh akim a khopite: Ibleam leh akima khopite, Dor a umte akim a khopite Endor-a umte leh akim a khopite, Taanak-a umte leh akim a khopite, Megiddo a umte leh akim a khopite, singtang gamkai thum anei hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Manasseh taten khum khopite a tengte anotdoh zou sih ua, tuachi’n Kanaan mite pen khum gam ah ateng denta uhi.","ref":"Vai. 1.27,28"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Israel tate ahing hat vahiei tah un, Kanaan mite khu anuoi ua nasem dingin a guoi ua, hinanleh adeldoh sieng zou sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph taten Joshua kungah, “Bangchidan ahiei gouluo ding goutan sekhat leh tan khat maimai na hing pieh tuom, ka goutan tuom utoh, Mangpa’n lah tutan hatangpiin ahing guolzawl ngal a, mi zong tampi ka hita uhi.”"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in amauh adawnga; “Mi tampi nahi u’leh, gammang gam ah peitou unlen Perizmite leh Rephaimte gam na umna dingun vala un, Ephraim tanggam pen noua dinga, neuseng taluo ahileh,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph taten “Singtanggam koua dingin ahun sih hi, tualeh phaijang gam a um Kanaan mite zousiein, Beth-Shean leh akhopi-a umte leh Jezreel phaihawm a umten sia-sakolleng anei chiet uhi” achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Joshua in Joseph innkuonte Ephraim leh Manasseh kungah, “Na tam mama ua hat zong nahat mama ua, tuaziehin tan khat mai mai tang sih va uteh."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh tanggam nou a ahi ding hi, gammang singlah hinanleh na vat ding ua, agamgi mongtawp dongin naluo ding ua nou a ahi ding hi; aziehpen Kanaan miten sia sakolleng nei in hat mama nan u’leh zong amaute khu na notmang ding uhi,” achi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Israel hahlesuon mipi zousie Shiloh ah akikhawm ua, khum mun ah kimutuona biehbuh a tungdingta uhi, agam khu athunuoi uah a umta hi.","title":"Shiloh mun a gam hawmna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate lah ah agoutan uh kipe nailou nam sagi a um nalai uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in Israel tate kungah, “Mangpa napu leh pate uh Pasian in nou ahing piehsa gam luo dinga bangtan vei kiheh nalai ding nahi uoi?"},"4":{"text":"Nam chinteng in mi thum chiet hing teldoh unlen, ken amaute ka sawl dinga, akuon ding ua, gam ava enkhe ding ua, agoutan ding uh dung zui in ahing giel ding ua, ka kungah ahing kile kia ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh amaun mun sagi in ahawm ding ua, Juda tate simlam ah agoutanna mun uah a um ding, tualeh Joseph innkuonte mallam agoutanna mun uah a um ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin gam khu se sagi in na khen ding ua, tualeh na khenna uh hing pie unlen, Mangpa i Pasian uh masangah keiman ai kahing na sanpieh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Leviten na lah uah goutan anei sih ding uhi, Mangpa dinga siempu hina khu amauh goutan ahi. Tualeh Gad leh Reuben leh Manasseh nam kimkhatten, Mangpa suoh Mosi in amaute apiehsa Jordan gal suolam ah agoutan uh amuta uhi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n mite khu akipankhie ua akuonta uhi, tualeh Joshua in gam khen dinga kuonte kungah, “Pei unlen gam vatuon suoh unlen, va khen un, tualeh Shiloh a Mangpa masanga nou a dinga ai ka hing sanpieh theina dingin, ka kungah hing kile kia un” chiin thu apie hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh mite akuonta ua, gam ava tuonsuoh ua, se sagi in akhen ua, akhuo akhuo in laibu ah agiel khie ua, Shiloh giehphuol a Joshua kungah ahing pei kia uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in Shiloh ah Mangpa masangah ama ua dingin ai asanpieh a, tualeh Joshua in Israel tate kungah akikhenna dungzui un gam ahawm piehta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Benjamin namte dinga ai san khu a innkuon dungzuiun ahing pawtdohta a, agam tan ding ukhu Juda tate leh Joseph tate kikal ahi.","title":"Benjaminte gamgi"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh mallam ah agamgi u’khu Jordan akipan ahia, gamgi khu Jeriko siih-ah mallam pangah apeitou a, tualeh tumlam a singtang gamte ah apeitou a, Beth-aven gamdai ah atawp hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh gamgi khuna kipat in Luz lamah, Luz khuo (tua khu Bethel ahi) dongin simlam nawt in apeisuh a, tualeh gamgi khu Ataroth-adar ah, Beth-horon hangta simlam panga um taang kawmah apeikhesuh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh khuna kipat in gamgi akihei a, simlam Beth-horon ninga um muola kipat in tumlam a simlam pangah akuol phei a, Kirjath-Baal (tua khu Kirjath-Jearim ahi) Juda tate khopi ah atawp hi, khum khu tumlam pang gamgi ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh simlam gamgi khu Kirjath-Jearim tawpna a kipan ahia, tumlam ah a suohdoh a, Nephtoah lui tuite ah ahing pawtdoh a;"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh gamgi khu Rephaim mallam pang guoma, Hinnom tapa guom ninga muol mongah apei suh a, tuachi’n Jebusmite umna lampang Hinnom guom ah apei suh a, tualeh En-rogel-ah ahing kum suh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh mallam zuon in akihei kawitou a, En-Shemesh dong apeitoua, Adumim katouna toh kigalsai lelam Gililoth tandongin apei a, tualeh Reuben tapa Bohan suongphu na dongin apei suh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Arabah siih mallam ah apei zela, Arabah tandong apeisuh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamgi Beth-hogla ning mallam pangah apei zel a, tualeh gamgi hing suohdohna khu, simlam Jordan lui tawpna Tuipi Al pieu mallam ahi a, tua khu simlam gamgi ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Jordan khu suolam panga agamgi ahi. Tami Benjamin tate a innkuon dung zui a, agoutan gam kuol sung uh ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n a innkuon uh dungzui a, Benjamin namte khopite khu Jeriko, Beth-hogla leh Emek-Keziz."},"22":{"text":"Beth Arabah, Zemaraim leh Bethel,"},"23":{"text":"Avim, Parah leh Ophrah,"},"24":{"text":"Kephar Hammoni, Ophni leh Gaba: khopi sawm leh ni leh akhoneute utoh."},"25":{"text":"Gibeon, Ramah leh Beeroth,"},"26":{"text":"Mizpah, Chephirah leh Mozah,"},"27":{"text":"Rekem, Irpeel leh Taralah,"},"28":{"text":"Zelah, Eleph, Jebus, (tua khu Jerusalem ahi) Gibeath leh Kirjath: khopi sawm leh li leh akhoneute toh, Tamte ainnkuon uh dungzui a Benjamin tate goutan dinga ki guot ahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh aisan ni na khu Simeon a ding ahia, a innkuon uh dungzui a Simeon tate adingin ahing pawtdoh a, amauh goutan khu Juda tate goutan lah ah apang hi.","title":"Simeon gamgi"},"2":{"text":"Ama uh goutan dingte, Beer-sheba, (Sheba) leh Moladah,","ref":"1 Khang. 4.28-33"},"3":{"text":"Hazar-Shual, Balah leh Azem"},"4":{"text":"Eltolad, Bethur leh Hormah"},"5":{"text":"Ziglag, Beth-Markaboth leh Hazar-Susah,"},"6":{"text":"Beth Lebaoth leh Sharuhen khopi sawm leh thum leh akhoneute utoh."},"7":{"text":"Ain, Rimmon, Ether leh Ashan; khopi li leh akhoneute u’toh."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Baalath beer, Simlam a Ramath tandonga khopite kimvel a khoneu um zousie. Tamte a inn kuon uh dungzui a Simeon tate goutan gam ahi."},"9":{"text":"Juda tate goutan lah apat a Simeon tate goutan ahi: Juda tate goutan ding khu amauh innkuon dungzui in alien seng taluo hi, tuaziehin Simeon taten amauh goutan sungah, goutan anei uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ai san thumna khu ainnkuon uh dungzui a, Zebulun tate a dingin ahing suohdoh a, agoutan uh gamgi khu Sarid tandong ahi.","title":"Zebulun tate gamgi"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh agamgi u’khu tumlam ah Marala dongin apeitou zela, Dabeseth ava suntou a, tualeh Jokneam suolam a luita dong asuntou hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sarid apat in suolam ah Kisloth-Tabor tandongin, ni suohnalam zuonin akihei a, tuachi’n Daberath ah asuohdoh a, Japhia ah apeitou hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh khuna kipat in suolam ah Gittah-hepher ah, Ittah-Kazin ah apei peh a, Remmon-methoar ah, tualeh Neah ah asuoh doh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh gamgi in mallam pangah Hannathon ah akihei kuol phei kia a, Jiphthah-El phaijangah atawpta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Katath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah leh Bethlehem: khopi sawm leh ni leh akhoneute utoh zong apangkhawm hi"},"16":{"text":"Tamte khu ainnkuon uh dungzui a Zebulun tate goutan ahi, tam khopite leh akhoneute u’toh."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh aisan lina khu Issakar tungah, Issakar tate adingin ainnkuon uh dungzui in ahing suohdoh a.","title":"Issakar tate gamgi"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh agamgi uh ahileh, Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem leh;"},"19":{"text":"Haphraim, Shion, Anaharath leh"},"20":{"text":"Rabbith, Kishion, Abez leh,"},"21":{"text":"Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah,"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh agamgi-in Tabor, Shahazimah leh Beth-Shemesh tandong asu a, tualeh agamgi uh Jordan ah ahing suohdoh hi: khopi sawm leh guh akhoneute utoh."},"23":{"text":"Tamte ainnkuon uh dungzui a, Issakar tate goutan ahi, khopite leh akhoneute utoh."},"24":{"text":"Ai san ngana khu ainnkuon uh dungzui in Asher nam hahlesuonte adingin ahing suohdoh kia a.","title":"Asher tate gamgi"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh agamgi u’khu Helkath, Hali, Beten leh Akshaph"},"26":{"text":"Alamelek, Amad, Misheal, ahia: tualeh tumlam ah Karmel leh Shihor-libnath tandong ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh nisuohna lam ah Beth-dagon ah akiheia Zebulun leh Beth-emek leh Neiel lampanga Jiphthah-El phaihawm tandong asu tou a, veilam pangah Kabul ah asuohdoh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Hebron, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah leh Sidon thupi tandong ah apeitou zela."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh gamgi khu Ramah leh kulpi nei Tai-ar khopi lam ah akihei phei a, tuachi’n gamgi khu Hosa ah akiheikuola gamgi khu Akzib gam kuol Tuipi ah atawpta hi."},"30":{"text":"Umah, Aphek leh Rehob zong ahia; khopi sawm leh ni leh akhoneute utoh ahi."},"31":{"text":"Tamte khu a innkuon uh dungzui a, Asher nam hahlesuonte goutan ahi, akhopite u’leh akhoneute utoh."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh ai san guhna khu a innkuon uh dungzui in Naphtali nam hah leh suonte a dingin, Naphtali tate tungah ahing pawtdoh a.","title":"Naphtali tate gamgi"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh agamgi u’khu, Heleph akipat, Zaananim a gangpi sing akipat, Adami Nekeb leh Janeel akipat Lukkum tandong ahi a, tualeh Jordan ah atawpta hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamgi khu tumlam pangah Aznoth-tabor ah apei suh a, khuna kipat in Hukkok ah apei a; Tualeh simlam pangah Zebulun ava tunga, tualeh ni suona lam ah Juda gam a Jordan dong ava pha hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh khopi kulpi neite khu Ziddim, Zer tualeh Hammath, Rakkath leh Kinnereth;"},"36":{"text":"Adamah, Ramah leh Hazor,"},"37":{"text":"Kadesh, Edrei leh En-hazor,"},"38":{"text":"Iron, Migdol-el, Horem, Beth-anath leh Beth-Shemesh ahi a: khopi sawm leh kuo akhoneute u’toh."},"39":{"text":"Tamte a innkuon uh dungzui a, Naphtali nam hahlesuonte goutan ahi; akhopite u’leh akhoneute u’toh."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh aisan sagina khu a innkuon uh dungzui in Dan nam hahlesuonte adingin ahing suohdohta hi.","title":"Dan tate gamgi"},"41":{"text":"Tualeh agoutan uh gamgi khu Zorah, Eshtaol leh Ir-shemesh."},"42":{"text":"Shaalabin, Aijalon leh Jethlah;"},"43":{"text":"Elon, Thimnathah leh Ekron,"},"44":{"text":"Eltekeh, Gibbethon leh Baalath,"},"45":{"text":"Jehud, Bene-berek leh Gath-rimmon"},"46":{"text":"Tualeh Me-jarkon, Rakkon leh Joppa toh kimaingat a um gamte ahi."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh Dan tate gamgi in tam munte ava hengtou a, Dan taten Lesem ava dou ua, ala ua, namsau in asumang ua, atangta uhi, tuachi’n khum munah ateng paita ua, apu uh Dan min phuo in Lesem khu Dan anachita uhi.","ref":"Vai. 18.27-29"},"48":{"text":"Tamte khu Dan nam hahlesuonte ainnkuon uh dungzui a agoutan uh ahi, akhopite u’leh akhoneute utoh."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun gam khu a goutan ding ua gamgi abawl bang dungzui un gam ana hawm zouta ua, tuachi’n Israel taten Nun tapa Joshua zong alah uah gam apie uhi.","title":"Joshua goutan"},"50":{"text":"Mangpa thupieh dungzui in amaun akhopi nget Ephraim singtang gam a um Timnath-Serah a pie uhi. Tualeh aman khopi abawl a, khunah a umta hi."},"51":{"text":"Tamte ahi Shiloh a, Kimutuona biehbuh kotpi bul a Mangpa masanga siempu Eleazar leh Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel tate lah a nam upa penten agoutan ding ua ai san a, ahawm gamte ukhu tamte ahi. Tuachi’n agam hawm uh a zouta uhi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Joshua ahoupi a,","title":"Ki humbitna khopi guhte","ref":"Kisim. 35.9-34; Danp. 4.41-43; 19.1-13"},"2":{"text":"“Israel tate kungah gen inlen, Mosi zanga na kung ua ka gensa bangin, nou a dingin kihumbitna ding khopite bawl un."},"3":{"text":"Koi zong tupna nei mawng hilou, thakhat thu a tuolthat khate khuna atailut theina dingun, tuachi’n nou a dingin sisan phubala mi lah a na kihumbitna uh ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh khum khopite khat penpen a atailut a, khopi kulpi kotkha bul ah avading dinga, khum khopi upate bil a zahngei in atungthu avatut dinga, tualeh amaun khopi sungah akung uah azawpi ding ua, alah ua aten theina ding in aumna ding a guotpieh ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh sisan phubala mi in ahing nuadel leh tuol that mi khu akhut ua ana pieh ding uh ahisih hi, aziehpen aman a innvengpa atup mawnga atha ahi sih hi, huotna zong anei sih hi"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh atungthu vaihawm piehna dinga mipi mai a adin masangsie leh khum hunlai a, um siempu lien shi mangsie khum khopi ah ateng ding hi. Tuazou chiengin tuolthat mi khu ahing taikhiehsan ama khopi leh, ama inn sung ah alut kia ding ahi, chiin gen in,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Naphtali singtang gam a Galili ah Kadesh leh Ephraim singtang gam a Shekem leh Juda singtang gam a Kirjath-Arba (tua khu Hebron ahi) khopite."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh suolam a Jeriko kunga Jordan gal lelampangah Reuben namte gam a Gilead a um Ramoth leh Manasseh namte gam a Bashan a um Golan a guotta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tamte khu Israel tate zousie ading leh alah ua teng gamdangmite adinga, koipou tupmawng hilou a, mithat khate atailut ua, tualeh mipite masanga adin masang sie a sisan phubala mi khut a ashi louna dinga, kiguot khopite khu ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levi namte lah a upa pente khu, siempu Eleazar leh Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel tate nam upa pente kungah ahing haw ua.","title":"Levite khopite"},"2":{"text":"Kanaan gam a Shiloh khuo ah: “Mangpa’n Mosi zangin ka umna ding uh khopite leh Kagantate uh tatna ding a kimvel gamte toh na hing pieh dinguh thu ana peta hi,” chiin ahing gen uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 35.1-8"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten Mangpa thupieh bangin agoutan ua kipat in khum khopite leh akimvel gamte toh Levi namte apeta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh ai san khu kohath mite innkuonte ading in ahing suohdohta a, tuachi’n Levi nam Aaron taten ai san in, Juda namte apat in, Simeon namte apat in tualeh Benjamin namte apat in khopi sawm leh thum atangta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Kohath ta dangten Ephraim tate goutan akipat in, Dan namte goutan akipat in, Manasseh nam kimkhatte goutan akipat in khopi sawm ai san in atangta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Gershon taten Issakar namte goutan akipat in, Asher namte goutan akipat in, tualeh Naphtali namte goutan akipat in leh Bashan gam a Manasseh nam kimkhatte akipat in, khopi sawm lethum atang uhi."},"7":{"text":"Merari taten a innkuon uh dungzui in Reuben namte goutan akipat in, Gad namte goutan akipat in, Zebulun namte goutan akipat in khopi sawm leh ni atang uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten Mangpa’n, Mosi zanga thu apieh bangin Levi mite kungah tam khopite leh akimvel gamte aisan in apeta uhi.","title":"Kohathmite khopite"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Juda namte goutan akipat leh Simeon namte goutan akipat in tamna amin kigen khopite apie uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tamte Levi tate lah a, Kohath innkuonte ahiziehun Aaron taten atang uhi; aziehpen ai san masapen khu ama ua ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Juda singtang gam a Kijath-Arba khopi akimvel a gamte toh apia ua, tua Arba khu Anak pa ahi a (tuakhu Hebron ahi)"},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh khopi kimvel gamte leh akhoneute khu Jephunneh tapa Kaleb kungah aluo dingin apie uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tambangin amaun siempu Aaron tate kungah Hebron leh akimvel gamte, Libnah leh akimvel gamte, tuolthat mi kihumbitna khopi dingin apie uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Jattir leh akimvel gamte, Eshtemoa leh akimvel gamte,"},"15":{"text":"Holon leh akimvel gamte, Debir leh akimvel gamte,"},"16":{"text":"Ain leh akimvel gamte, Juttah leh akimvel gamte, Beth-shemesh leh akimvel gamte, toh, khum nam nite goutan akipat khopi kuote apie uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Benjamin nam akipat in Gibeon leh akimvel gamte, Geba leh akimvel gamte;"},"18":{"text":"Anathoth leh akimvel gamte, tualeh Almon leh akimvel gamte toh: khopi li."},"19":{"text":"Aaron tate siempute khopi zousie, khopi sawm leh thum leh akimvel gamte chiet toh."},"20":{"text":"Kohath tate lah a um nalai, Levi mite Kohath tate innkuonten, Ephraim nam apat in aisan in atan dinguh khopite atang uhi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun akung uah, Ephraim singtang gam a Shekem leh akimvel gamte toh, tualeh Gezer leh akimvel gamte khu tuolthat mite dinga kihumbitna khopi dingin apie uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Kibzaim leh akimvel gamte, Beth-horon leh akimvel gamte"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Dan nam apat in Eltekeh leh akimvel gamte Gibbethon leh akimvel gamte,"},"24":{"text":"Aijalon leh akimvel gamte, Gathrimmon leh akimvel gamte: khopi li."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Manasseh nam kimkhat apat in, Taanak leh akimvel gamte, Gath-rimmon leh akimvel gamte toh khopi li."},"26":{"text":"Kohath tate umnalaite a dinga, khopi zousie khu khopi sawm leh, akimvel gamte toh ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Levi mite innkuon a Gershon tate kungah Manasseh nam kimkhatte goutan akipat, tuolthat mite kihumbitna khopi, Bashan gam a um Golan leh akimvel gamte toh tualeh Be-estera leh akimvel gamte toh: khopi ni apie uhi.","title":"Gershon mite khopite"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Issakar namte goutan akipat in, Kishion leh akimvel gamte, Debareh leh akimvel gamte;"},"29":{"text":"Jarmuth leh akimvel gamte, En-gannim leh akimvel gamte toh; khopi li."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Asher namte goutan a kipat in, Mishal leh akimvel gamte, Abdon leh akimvel gamte;"},"31":{"text":"Helkah leh akimvel gamte, Rehob leh akimvel gamte toh khopi li."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Naphtali namte goutan akipat in, Galili gam a Kadesh leh akimvel gamte, Hammoth-dor leh akimvel gamte, tualeh Kartan leh akimvel gamte toh, tuolthat mite kihumbitna khopi hi dingin: khopi thum apie uhi."},"33":{"text":"A innkuon uh dungzui a, Gershon mite khopi zousie khu khopi sawm leh thum leh akimvel gamte toh."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Levimi um nalai Merari tate innkuonte kung ah, Zebulun namte Goutan apat in, Jokneam leh akimvel gamte, Kartan leh akimvel gamte,","title":"Merari mite khopite"},"35":{"text":"Dimnah leh akimvel gamte, Nahalal leh akimvel gamte; khopi li."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Reuben namte goutan a kipat in, Bezer leh akimvel gamte, Jahazah leh akimvel gamte"},"37":{"text":"Kedemoth leh akimvel gamte, Mephaath leh akimvel gamte; khopi li."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Gad namte goutan a kipat in Gilead a um Ramoth leh akimvel gamte, Mahanaim leh akimvel gamte khu tuolthat mite kihumbitna khopi hi ding in."},"39":{"text":"Heshbon leh akimvel gamte, Jazer leh akimvel gamte abawn in khopi li."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levite innkuonte lah a um nalaite, ainnkuon dungzui ua, Merari tate adinga khopi kiguot aisan a atan uh khopite sawm leh ni ahi."},"41":{"text":"Israel tate gam luo sunga Levi mite khopi zousie khu sawm li leh giet leh akimvel gamte toh ahi."},"42":{"text":"Tam khopiten akimvel gam akinei chiet ua, tam khopite hichi bang ngen ahi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n apulepate u’kunga pieh dinga ana chiemsa gam zousie Israel tate apeta a, tuachi’n khum gam aluo ua, atengta uhi.","title":"Israelten Kanaan gam aluo zouta uh"},"44":{"text":"Tualeh apulepate uh kunga akichiemna zousie bang dungzui in Mangpa’n amaute khawldamna apeta a; agalte zousie uh, koima amai ua pangthei mawngmawng a um sih uhi. Mangpa’n agalte zousie uh akhut uah apekhe siengta hi."},"45":{"text":"Mangpa’n Israel innkuonte kunga silhoi ana gen zousie atangtunglou khat beeh a um sih a, atangtung sieng kei hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in Reuben mite, Gad mite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte ahan a.","title":"Joshua in suolam gamluo namte anua sawlna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh akung uah Mangpa suoh “Mosi in na kung ua thu ahing pieh zousie na zuita ua, tualeh thu ka hing pieh pouma nouten zong na zuizel uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 32.20-32; Josh. 1.12-15"},"3":{"text":"Tuni tandongin, ni tampi, na unaute uh na nuasie sih ua, hinanleh Mangpa na Pasian un bawl dinga ahing thupiehte na bawl zel uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin, Mangpa na Pasian un akung ua ana chiemsa mabangin na unaute uh khawldamna apeta hi; tuaziehin, Mangpa suoh Mosi in Jordan gal lelam a na goutan ding ua ahing piehsa gam a na puon inn lamte uah nuapei kiata un."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa suoh Mosi in, Mangpa na Pasian uh it a, alampi zousie zui a, athupiehte pom a, Ama bel chinten a, na lungtang zousie u’leh na hinna zousie ua, Ama nna na seppieh theina ding ua, ahing thupiehte leh adan thute ngaisah ding in pilvang mama un,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in amauh a guolzawla, asawldoh ta hi; tualeh amaute apuon inn lam uah apeisah ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Manasseh nam kimkhatte Mosi in Bashan ah gam luo ding ana peta a, akim khat dangte pen Joshua in Jordan gal tumlam panga aunaute lah ah gam luo ding apie hi. Tualeh Joshua in amau’te a innlam ua apeisah ding kuon in aguolzawl hi."},"8":{"text":"A kung uah, “Na puon innte uah hausatna tampi toh, ganhon tampi toh, Dangka, Sana leh sum-eng toh, sia tampi leh nihten puonsil tampi toh, nuapei kiata unlen, na gallah silte uh na unaute u’toh kihawm dildiel un,” chiin avaihah hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Reuben tate, Gad tate leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte akinuale kiata ua, Kanaan gam a um Shiloh khuo ah, Israel tate toh akikhen ua, Mangpa’n Mosi zanga thu ana pieh bangin, agam luo ding uh Gilead gam lam a, pei dingin akipandohta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Kanaan gamsunga um Jordan lui a gamgi ahing tun un, Reuben tate, Gad tate leh Manasseh nam kimkhatten khunah Jordan luigei ah maitam lienpi leh lunglut huoitah khat alam uhi.","title":"Jordan lui gei a maitam dawna"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten “Ngai un, Reuben tate, Gad tate leh Manasseh nam kimkhatten Kanaan gamgizul Jordan lui gei, Israel tate luona gam lam ah maitam khat abawl uhi,” chi a kigen azata ua."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten tam thu azah tah un, Israel tate mipi zousie, amauh dou tumin Shiloh khuo ah akikhawmta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Gilead gam a Reuben tate leh Gad tate leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kungah siempu Eleazar tapa Phinehas a sawl ua."},"14":{"text":"Ama toh Israel nam zousie apat innsunga upapen leh lamkai lien chiet sawm asawlkhawm uhi; amaute khu namte innkuon sunga upa pente chiet ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh amaute Gilead gam a Reuben tate, Gad tate leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kungah avahaw ua, akung uah;"},"16":{"text":"Mangpa mipi kikhawmte zousie in tambangin achi uhi; “Tunia Mangpa tunga na hel theina ding ua, maitam na bawl ua, tunia Mangpa Israelte Pasian zuilou a, kiheimang san dinga, silsie bawla leptat na hi uoi?","ref":"Danp. 12.13,14"},"17":{"text":"Peor mun a itatsietnate uh ei a dinga huntalou amah? Mangpa mipi kikhawmte lah a gawtna atun zieh a tuni tan a zong khum khelnate apat isiengthou nai sih uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 25.1-9"},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh tunia Mangpa na zui na ua kipata kiheimangsan na tup tahtah uh amah? Mangpa tunga hel nahi u’leh hichi ahi ding hi; zing chiengin Israel mipi kikhawm zousiete tungah Ama alungthah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh na gam luo uh abua leh, Mangpa biehbuh umna, Mangpa gam luona mun ah hing pei galkai unlen, koute lah ah goutan hing nei mai un, hinanleh Mangpa i Pasian uh maitam chilou maitam dang bawlin, Mangpa tungah hel sih unlen, koute tungah zong helsih un."},"20":{"text":"Zerah tapa Akan in hamselaw sil tunga atatkhel zieh a Israel mipite zousie tunga lungthahna tung hilou ahiei mah? tualeh agitlouna ah ama maimai ashi sih hi,” chiin ava gen uhi.","ref":"Josh. 7.1-26"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Reuben tate leh Gad tate leh Manasseh nam kimkhatten adawng ua, Israel nam lah a upa pente kungah;","title":"Maitam hilchienna"},"22":{"text":"“Mangpa pasiente Pasian, Mangpa, pasiente Pasian Aman athei hi, tualeh Israelte mama in zong thei u’hen; ka maitam bawl uh Mangpa kiheimangsan tum a hel tupna ahiei, ahisihleh sil bawlkhiel tupna ahiei a, bawl kahi u’leh tuni’n zong hing hinkhawi da mai un."},"23":{"text":"Mangpa zuiloua kiheimangsan na ding ahiei, ahisihleh, halmang sillat ahiei, neh ding sillat ahiei, latna dinga, ahisihleh, lemna sillat latna dinga maitam bawl kahi u’leh Mangpa mama in aphu hing la maileh asih diei."},"24":{"text":"Tunua chiengin nahah nasuonte un, ka hah kasuonte uh kungah, nouten Israelte Mangpa Pasian toh bang kizopna na nei uoi? achi khah ding uh ka zau zieh uh ahi."},"25":{"text":"Nou Reuben tate leh Gad tate aw, Mangpa’n noute leh koute Jordan lui gamgi in abawlta hi; Mangpa ah tan bangma nanei sih uhi, ahing chi kha ding ua, tuachi’n na tate un, ka tate uh, Mangpa agiinna uh asuh tawp pieh khah ding uh zauna zieh a, zieh neitah a kabawl uh ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin Tuin kisa un maitam ibawl ding uh, halmang sillat latna ding leh kithoina ding zong hilou in;"},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh ka halmang sillatte u’leh, ka kithoinate u’leh ka lemna sillatte utoh, Mangpa nna ka septheina dingun leh tunua chienga na tate un ka tate uh kunga “Mangpa ah nouten tan bangma na neisih uh, achilouna ding ua, kou leh nou kikaal a, tua leh inua chienga ihah-isuonte kikaal a, theipitu hi zaw dingin ka chi ua ahi.”"},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin hichi ahi dinga, tunua chienga ka kung uh ahiei, ka hah ka suonte uh kung ahiei a, khumbanga ahing chi hun chieng ua, kouten, En ve ua ka pule pate un Mangpa maitam bangbang khat abawl uh, halmang sillatna ding leh kithoina hilouin kou leh nou kikaal a, theipitu ahi kachi theina ding ua, ka bawl uh ahi zaw hi."},"29":{"text":"Abiehbuh mai a um Mangpa i Pasian uh maitam chilou ngal, halmang sillatna ding ahiei, nehding sillatna ding ahiei, ahisihleh kithoina ding ahiei a, maitam bawla, ka ut dan ua helna bawla Mangpa elngatsan a ka umna ding u’pen agamla mama hi.”"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh siempu Phinehas leh akunga um mipi tunga vaihawmte, Israel nam chinte upa penten Reuben tate leh Gad tate leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte thu gen azah tahun akipah mama ta uhi.","title":"Tumlam aum namte guolnopna"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh siempu Eleazar tapa Phinehas in Reuben tate, Gad tate leh Manasseh nam kimkhat te kungah, Mangpa tunga sil na bawl khellou ziehun, “Tuin Mangpa ilah uah a um nahi chi ka theita uhi, tuachi’n Israel tate Mangpa khut akipat na hunkheta uhi,” a chi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu Eleazar tapa Phinehas leh miliente khu Gilead gam a Reuben tate leh Gad tate kunga kipat in, Kanaan gam a Israel tate kungah anua pei kia ta ua, akung uah thu ahing tut kiata uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh khum thuten Israel tate akipahsah mama a, tuachi’n Israel taten Pasian aphatta uhi; tuachi’n Reuben tate leh Gad tate tenna gam suse dinga, vakidoupi ding in kuon asawm nawn sih uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Reuben tate leh Gad taten maitam min khu Theipitu achi uhi. “I kikaal ua Mangpa khu Pasian ahi chi theipitu ahitah ding ziehin,” achi uhi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tauleh hichi ahi a, hun sawtpi nua in Mangpa’n Israel tate kunga a kimvel ua amelmate ua kipata tawldamna apieh nuain, Joshua ahing tehta a, ahing upa mama ta hi.","title":"Joshua in mipite avaihahna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in Israel mi zousie leh a upate u’leh a lamkaite uh, avaihawmte u’leh a upate uh ahan sah a, akung uah, “Kei pen ka tehta a, ka upa mama ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un noute zieha tam namte zousie tunga abawl dan na muta uhi, aziehpen nou a dinga hingdou piehpa khu Mangpa na Pasian uh, Ama mama ahi."},"4":{"text":"En un, Keima’n tua um nalai namte, Jordan akipat a nitumna lam a Tuipi Lien tandonga ka suhmang sa nam zousie pumin na namte uh gouluo dingin ai san in ka hing hawmpiehta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian un, na masang uah amauh anotdoh dinga, na muphah louna uah adelmang sieng ding hi, tuachi’n Mangpa na Pasian un na kung ua ahing chiemsa bangin agam uh naluo ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mosi dan laibu a kigiel zousie, zietlam ahiei, veilam ahiei a, na pielsan vawt louna dingun hangsan tahin zui unlen bawl un."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tam nam na lah ua um nalaite toh kizahallou a, a pasiente uh min zong lou lou a na kichiem lou ua, ana u’zong semlou a, amasang ua kun a na bieh louna ding un;"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh tuni tandonga na bawl mabang un Mangpa na Pasian uh tukip chinten un."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n na masang ua pat in nam thupi leh hattahte ahing deldoh piehta hi, hinanleh tuni tandongin noute masangah koima ading zou a um sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Na lah ua mi khat in tul khat na delzah ding ua, aziehpen na kung ua akichiemsa mabangin Mangpa na Pasian un nou a dingin ahing doupieh ahi.","ref":"Danp. 32.30; Danp. 3.22"},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa na Pasian uh it dingin pilvang mama un."},"12":{"text":"Khuchilou a, bang chi ahiei a, na leengatsan ua, na lah ua kinuasie den tam nam dang um sunte na bel ua, tualeh amaute toh zi leh ta a na kiten ua amaute lah a nalut ua, ama u’zong noute lah a ahing lut u’leh;"},"13":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un na masang ua pat in tam namte ahing deldoh pieh nawn sih dinga: Mangpa na Pasian un ahing piehsa tam gam hoitah akipat na manthai masangsie uh, amaute noute a dingin piel leh thang leh na elduong ua dingin satna chieng leh na mit ua dingin ling ahing hi zawding uhi chi, chientahin thei un."},"14":{"text":"“Tualeh ngaiun, tuni’n leitung pumpi ngaina dan bangin ka shi hun ahing tungta hi. Mangpa na Pasian un na kung ua agensa sil hoi zousie zong alawsam sih chi na lungtang zousie leh na hinna zousie un na thei uhi, abawn in na tung uah ahing tangtung sienga khat zong apelhem a um sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin hichi ahi dinga, Mangpa na Pasian un ahing chiem sil hoi zousie na tung ua ahingtun siengtaah mabangin, Mangpa na Pasian un ahing pieh tam gam hoitah a kipata ahing suhmang sieng masangsie Mangpa’n sil hoilou zousie na tung uah ahing tungsah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian un zuidinga ahing pieh Thuhun na pal siet ua, pasien dangte nna na sep pieh ua, na bieh ua, amasang ua na kuntah chiengun Mangpa lungthahna na tung uah akuongdoh dinga, na kung ua ahing pieh gam hoi akipat na mangthang ding uhi,” achi hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in Israel nam zousie Shekem ah ahankhawm a, Israel nam upate leh alamkaite u’leh, a vaihawmte leh athukhente, uh ahan sah a, tuachi’n Pasian mai ah ahing peikhawm chiet uhi.","title":"Joshua Mangpha hahna thugen nukhia"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in mipite zousie kungah, “Israelte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi. Napu leh pate uh nidang laiin tuipi gal lelam ah ana teng ua, Tera Abraham leh Nahor pa te ngel zong: Tualeh ama u’ten pasien dangte ana bie uhi.","ref":"Siem. 11.27"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n keiman na pu uh Abraham khu khum luigal lelam akipat ka hankhie a, Kanaan gam sung teng ah ka pui kawi kawi a, ahahlesuonte ka pungsah a, Isaak ka pie hi.","ref":"Siem. 12.1-9; Siem. 21.1-3"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Isaak kungah Jakob leh Esau ka pie a, tualeh Esau kungah agoutan dingin Seir singtang gam ka pie a, tualeh Jakob leh atate pen Izipt ah apeisuh uhi.","ref":"Siem. 25.24-26; Siem. 36.8; Danp. 2.5; Siem. 46.1-7"},"5":{"text":"Tuazouin Mosi leh Aaron zong ka sawl a, Izipt gam khu ka silbawltheina lamdang toh ka gawta, tuachi’n noute ka hing puidoh hi.","ref":"Pawt. 3.1—12.42"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt gam a kipat in napu leh pate uh ka puidohta a, tualeh tuipi na hing tung ua, tuachi’n Izipt miten napu leh pate uh kangtalai leh sakoltung tuong mite toh tuipi san tandong ahing nua del uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 14.1-31"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Mangpa ahanta ua, tuachi’n Aman noute leh Izipt mite kikaal ah miel ahing koita a, tualeh amau’te tuipi in atuomsah a, atummangta uhi. Tualeh Izipt gam a ka silbawl na mit ngel un amu a. Tuachi’n gamdai ah sawtpi na um uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Jordan luigal lelam a um Amor mite gam ah noute ka hing puilut a, amaun ahingna dou ua, tuachi’n agam uh naluo theina ding un amau’te na khut uah ka hing pekhie hi, tualeh na masang uah amaute ka sumangthang ta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 21.21-35"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Moab leengpa Zippor tapa Balak ahing kisa a Israelte ana kidoupi a, tualeh nou hing hamsiet dingin Beor tapa Balaam han dingin mi asawl hi.","ref":"Kisim. 22.1—24.25"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Balaam thu ka ngaikhe nuom sih a, tuaziehin nou ahing guolzawl zawta hi, tuachi’n akhut a kipat in ka hing hunkheta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jordan na galkai ua, Jeriko ah na hing tung uhi, tualeh Jerikomiten ahing dou ua, Amormite, Periz mite, Kanaanmite, Hitmite, Girgashmite, Hivmite leh Jebusmiten zong ahing dou uhi. Hinanleh amaute na khut uah ka hing peta hi.","ref":"Josh. 3.14-17; Josh. 6.1-21"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh na masang uah tunpi ka sawl a, tuaten na masang uah amaute leh Amormite leeng nite adelmang ta uhi. Hinanleh na namsaute u’leh na thalpi uh ahiei ahisih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.28; Danp. 7.20"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh na sepkhiet uh hi vawtlou gam leh nabawl uh hivawtlou khopite ka hing pie a, asung ah na teng uhi; na suonlou kei uh grep huon a agate leh Olive huona agate nane uhi.","ref":"Danp. 6.10,11"},"14":{"text":"“Tuaziehin tuin Mangpa giing unlen, gin umna leh thutah toh Ama nna sem unlen, napu leh pate un Lui gal leh Izipt gam a ana anasep uh pasiente paimang unlen, Mangpa na sem un.","title":"Israelten Mangpa Pasian atelna uh"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa nasep khu nou adinga sil hoilou banga na gel u’leh koi nna ahiei nasep ding uh tuni’n tel mai un; napu leh pate un Lui gal a a nna asep uh pasiente nna ahiei, ahisihleh agam sung ua na ten na uh Amormite pasiente nna ahiei nasep dinguh, hinanleh keileh ka innkuonpiten vang Mangpa nna ahi ka sep ding uh” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipiten adawng ua, pasien dangte nna sem dingin “Mangpa ka taisan vawt sih ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa i Pasian uh Ama ngel khu Izipt gam a isaltaanna inn a kipat a eite leh ipu leh pate uh hing puidohpa leh imitmua, chiemtena thupi bawla ipeina lam zousie leh inawh peisuoh mipite zousie lah a hing vengbitpa ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n imasang ngel ua kipat in nam chin tua gam a um Amormite ngel adeldoh sienga, tuaziehin kouten zong Mangpa nna ahi ka sep ding uh Ama lah ka Pasian uh ahi ngal a achi ua,” adawng uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Joshua in mipite kungah, “Mangpa nna nasem thei sih ding uhi, Ama Pasian siengthou ahi a, thangsiet hat Pasian ahia, Aman na tatkhelnate u’leh na khelnate uh a ngaidam sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Nouten Mangpa na taisan ua, gamdang pasiente nna nasep u’leh vang, na tung ua sil hoi abawl nuain, kihei in na tung uah silsie bawl in ahing sugam ding hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh mipiten Joshua kungah, “Hilou e, kouten Mangpa nna ka sem ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in mipite kungah, Ama nna sem dingin “Mangpa na telta uhi chi theipite nouma mama nahi uhi,” achi a, tualeh amaun “Theipite kahi uh,” achi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aman tuin, “Na lah ua gamdang pasien umte koimang unlen, Mangpa Israelte Pasian langah na lungtang uh hei un,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh mipiten Joshua kungah, “Mangpa i Pasian nna ka sem ding ua, athu ka zui ding uh,” achi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in tua niin mipite toh thuhun abawl a, Shekem ah ama ua dingin danthu leh vaihawmna dante aguot pieh hi.","title":"Shekem a thuchiemna"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in tam thute Pasian dan laibu ah agiellut a, tualeh suong lienpi khat ala a, Mangpa mun siengthou kunga gangpi sing nuoi ah aphut hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh mipi zousiete kungah, “Ngai un, tam suong ithu hing theipitu hi hen, aziehpen tami’n Mangpa’n ikung ua athu gen zousie azata hi, tuaziehin tami na thu uh hing theipitu ahi ding hi, tuachilou in na Pasian uh na kitheimaw bawlkha ding uhi” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua in mipite khu amauh goutan gam chiet uh zuon in akikhen sah ta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh tam silte nua in hichi ahing hi a, Mangpa suoh Nun tapa Joshua kum za leh kum sawm a upa ahiin ashita hi.","title":"Joshua shina"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Gaash muol mallampang, Ephraim singtang gam a ama goutan gamgi sunga Timnath-Serah ah avuita uhi.","ref":"Josh. 19.49,50"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua dam sung leh upate khup a damsawt zawte dam sung leh Mangpa’n Israelte a ding a, asil bawl zousie theipi mite dam sungin Israelten Mangpa nna asem zel uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Izipt a kipat a ahing puoh uh Joseph gute khu, Shekem pa Hamor tate a kipat a Jakob in dangka zakhat a, aleina mun Shekem ah avuita uhi. Tualeh khum khu Joseph tate goutan ahing hita hi.","title":"Joseph gu leh Eleazar shina","ref":"Siem. 33.19; 50.24,25; Pawt. 13.19; Jn. 4.5; Nasep. 7.16"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron tapa Eleazar ashi a, tualeh Ephraim singtang gam atapa dinga apiehna mun uh atapa Phinehas khopi Gibeah ah avuita uhi."}}}}},"7":{"info":{"name":"Vaihawmte","shortname":"Vai.","abbr":[],"desc":"Vaihawmte laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Joshua shi nuain hichi ahing hia, Israel taten “Kanaanmite dou a, kou a dinga vadou dingin koi ahiei va kuontou masa ding?” chi’n Mangpa a dong uhi.","title":"Juda leh Simeon in Adonibezek amatna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n “Juda kuontou heh: Ngai un akhut ah gam ka peta hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda in asanggampa Simeon kungah, “Kanaanmite dou dingin ka goutan a hing kipie gam ah hing zuitou in, tualeh kei zong khum bangma in na goutan a hing kipie gam tandong ka hing zuina ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Simeon in azuitou ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Juda akuontou a, Mangpa’n Kanaanmite leh Periz mite akhut uah apeta a, tualeh Bezek ah mi tulsawm athatta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Bezek khuo ah Adoni-Bezek amu ua, adou ua, Kanaanmite leh Perez mite athat ua, azou uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Adoni-Bezek atai a, amaun anuadel ua, aman ua, akhutpi tegel leh akengpi tegel atansan pieh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Adoni-Bezek in “Leng sawm sagi ka dawkan nuoi a ann neng kie tawm zelte, akhutpi u’leh akengpite uh kana tansan pieh bang banga Pasian in kei tunga ahing thuh ahita,” achi hi. Tualeh ama khu Jerusalem ah apui ua, khunah ashita hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Juda taten Jerusalem adou ua, ala ua, tualeh namsau hiem in asatlia ua, akhopi meiin ahal uhi.","title":"Juda in Jerusalem leh Hebron alahna"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh khumzou in Juda tate Kanaanmite singtang gam a umte, simlam gam a umte leh phaijang gam a umte dou dingin akuon suh ua."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda in Hebron khuo (Hebron khu masang lai in Kiriath-Arba aki chi hi) a teng Kanaanmite ava dou a. Tualeh amaun Sheshai, Ahiman leh Talmai athat uhi."},"11":{"text":"Khuna kipat in Debir khuo a tengte ava dou ua, (masanglai in Debir khuo khu Kiriath-Sepher akichi hi).","title":"Othniel in Debir khopi azawna"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Kaleb in “Koipou Kiriath-Sepher vadou a, valazou aumleh ka tanu Aksa azi dingin ka pe ding,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Kaleb naupa Kenaz tapa Othnielin ala a, tuachi’n Kaleb in zong atanu Aksa khu Othniel zi dingin apeta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, amanu akunga ahing tun tahin Othniel in apa kunga gam ngen dingin asawl a, tualeh amanu asabiltung tunga kipata ahing kumsuh in Kaleb in amanu kungah, “Bang deina hiei?” chi’n ana dong a."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n akungah, “Hing guolzawl inlen, sim lamgam na hing pieh ngal leh, tuinah neite zong hing pie’n” achi a. Tuachi’n Kaleb in amanu kungah tui nahnei sahta zaw leh tuinah nei hangta pen apeta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi sungpa kenmi hahlesuonte khu tum sing khopi apat in Arad simlam a um Juda gamdai ah Juda tate toh apeitou ua, tuachi’n agam mite lah ah ava tengta uhi.","title":"Juda leh Benjamin in gal azawbe na uh"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Juda khu asanggampa Simeon toh akuon ua, Zephath khuo ateng Kanaanmite avasim ua, a thatgam sieng ua, asuchimit uhi, tuachi’n khum khopi khu Hormah akichita hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Juda miten Gaza khopi leh agam, Ashkelon khopi leh agam tualeh Ekron khopi leh agam ala uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh, Mangpa’n Juda mite a umpi a, tuachi’n amaun singtang gam a tengte adeldoh sienga, hinanleh sia kangtalai anei ziehun phaijanga tengte pen adeldoh zousih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in ana gensama bangin Hebron khuo pen Kaleb kungah apie uhi: tuachi’n aman Anak tapa thumte khuna pat in adeldoh ta hi.","ref":"Josh. 15.13,14"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Benjamin hahlesuonten Jerusalem a teng Jebusmite adeldoh sih ua, tuachi’n tuni dongin Jebusmite khu Jerusalem ah Benjamin hahle suonte toh ateng khawm ta uhi.","title":"Benjamin guolzawna bukimlou","ref":"Josh. 15.63; 2 Sam. 5.6; 1 Khang. 11.4"},"22":{"text":"Tuin, Joseph innkuonte zong Bethel dou dingin akuontou ua, tualeh Mangpa’n amauh a umpi hi.","title":"Joseph tate guolzawna bukimlou"},"23":{"text":"Khumin, Joseph innkuonten Bethel khuo endap dingin mi asawl uhi. (Masanglai in tua khomin khu Luz ahi)."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh endap miten mi khat khosung akipata hing pawtdoh amu ua, akungah, “Hepitahin khopi sung lutna hing hilin, tuachi’n kouzong na tungah khotuona ka hing musah ding uhi,” achi ua."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n amapa’n khopi sung lutna a ensah a, tuachi’n amaun namsau hiemin khum khopi asatgam sieng ua, hinanleh tua mipa leh a innkuonte zousie apei sah uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh khum mipa khu Hitmite gam sungah alut a, khopi abawla, tua khopi min dingin Luz achi a, tuni dongin khum kho min apo nalai hi."},"27":{"text":"Manasseh in zong Beth-Shean leh akhoneu a tengte, Taanak leh akhoneu a tengte, Dor leh akhoneu a tengte, Ibleam leh akhoneu a tengte, tualeh Megiddo leh akhoneu a tengte, adeldoh sih a, tuaziehin Kanaanmite khum gam ah ateng den zawta uhi.","title":"Manasseh guolzawna bukimlou","ref":"Josh. 17.11-13"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Israelte ahing hattah un, Kanaanmite sie lieuin akoi ua, hinanleh adeldoh sieng sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ephraim in zong Gezer a teng Kanaanmite adeldoh sih a tuachi’n Kanaanmite Gezer khuo ah alah uah atengzawta uhi.","ref":"Josh. 16.10"},"30":{"text":"Zebulun in zong Kitron a tengte leh Nahalol a tengte adeldoh sih ua, hinanleh alah uah sie lieu in ateng den sahta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Asher in zong Akko khuo a tengte, Sidon khuo a tengte, Ahlab khuo a tengte, Akzib khuo atengte Helba khuo a tengte, Aphik khuo a tengte, Rehob khuo a tengte adeldoh sih hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Asher mite khu khum gam a teng Kanaanmite lah ah ateng zawta uhi, aziehpen amauh adeldoh sih uhi."},"33":{"text":"Naphtali in zong Beth-Shemesh a tengte leh Beth-Anath a tengte adeldoh sih a, Kanaanmite leh khum gam a tengte lah ah ateng zawta uhi; hinanleh Beth-Shemesh a tengte leh Beth-Anath a tengte sie-alieu sah uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Amor miten Dan tate khu singtang gam ah anot tou ua, phaijanga ahing peisuh ding uh aphal sih uhi."},"35":{"text":"Amor mite pen Heres muol leh Aijalon khuo leh Shaalbim khuo te ah ateng den ua, hinanleh ama uh akhut nuoi ua nasem a pangsah dingin Joseph innkuonte khut ahat zawsem nalai hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Amor mite gamgi khu Akrabbim kaltouna akipat in Sela leh atung lam dongin ahita bou hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gilgal a kipat in Mangpa van sawltah khat Bokim khuo ah apeitou a, tualeh akung uah “Izipt akipat in ka hing puidoh a, napu leh pate uh kunga ka kichiemna gam ah ka hing puilutta a, nou toh ka thuhun ka bawtse sih ding hi.","title":"Bokim mun a Mangpa vansawltah"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh tam gam a teng te toh thuhun bawl sih unlen, amaitamte uh na suhchip pieh dinguh ahi, ka chi a, hinanleh ka thupiehte na zuisih uhi; bang dinga tami na bawl uh ahiei?","ref":"Pawt. 34.12,13; Danp. 7.2-5"},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin na masang ua kipat a mau’te ka hing deldoh pieh nawn sih dinga, na pangthep ua ding in ling ahi zawta ding ua, tualeh a pasiente u’zong nou a dingin thang ahi ding uh zong kachi nalai hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Mangpa vansawltah in Israel tate zousie kunga agen lai in, mipiten a aw uh asuo ua akapta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum mun min Bokim achita uhi, tualeh khum mun ah Mangpa kungah akithoita uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Joshua in mipite akikhenzahsah nua in, Israel tate zousie amauh goutan gam chiet zuon dingin apeita uhi.","title":"Pasian mite shina"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joshua dam sung leh, Joshua sanga dam sawt zaw upate dam sung leh Mangpa’n Israelte a dinga sil thupi tahtah abawl zousie mu zel mite dam sungin mipiten Mangpa nna asem uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa suohpa Nun tapa Joshua kumza leh kumsawm a upa ahiin ashita hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Gaash taang mallam panga, Ephraim singtaang gam a ama goutan gamgi sunga Timnath Heres mun ah Israel taten avuita uhi.","ref":"Josh. 19.49,50"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh khum khanga mizousie khu apulepate uh kungah puikhawmin a um siengta uhi, tualeh ama ute nuain, Mangpa theilou, Israel tate dinga abawl pieh silte thei mawngmawng lou khangtha dang khat ahing umdohta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten Mangpa mit muin sil gilou abawlta ua, Baalte nna asemta uhi.","title":"Israelten Pasian alengatsan uh"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa apu leh pate uh Pasian Izipt gam a kipata puidohpa alengatsan ua, pasien dang akim avel ua, mite pasiente azui ua, tualeh amasang uah akun ua, tuachi’n Mangpa alungthah sahta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa alengatsan ua, Baal leh Ashtoreth te nna asem uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa Israelte tungah a lungthahta a, tuachi’n amauh dou mite khut ah apekheta hi. Amelma uh akim avel ua umte khut ah akhawngta a, tuachi’n a galte uh a zou nawnta sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Gal dou dinga akuon khietna lam pou uah Mangpa khut a tung uah aselam ngenin atunga, Mangpa’n akung ua kichiem a anagen bangin, buoi chitahin abuoita uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n alah uah vaihawm mi ding atun ding pieh a, tuaten amauh va doute khut apat ahunkhe zel uhi."},"17":{"text":"Khuchi pipi in zong a vaihawm mite uh thu a zuisih ua, pasien dangte lah ah akizua ua, abie uhi. Apu leh pate un Mangpa thupiehte pom a azui leng uh lampite apielsan pai zuai ua, azuita sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n amaute dinga vaihawm mite abawl pieh bep in, Mangpa’n vaihawm mite a umpi a, vaihawm mite damsungin a melmate uh khut akipat in ahundoh zel hi, amauh nuoisie mite leh bawlgenthei mite zieha amaunate uh ziehin Mangpa’n ahepi a, akisiata hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, vaihawm mi ashi chiengin anuatol kia ua, pasien dangte nna asem ua, bie in amai ah akun ua, apu leh pate uh sangin ase zawin agamta uhi. Tualeh asil bawlte u’leh a lungtang ua apaupen nate uh zong akhetuom sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte tungah Mangpa athangpai mama ta a, tualeh “Tam namten apu leh pate uh kunga ka thuhun apalsie ua, ka thu azuita sih uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin ken zong tuban sie, Joshua in ashi a anuasie namte amasang ua kipat ka deldoh pieh nawn sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh apulepate zui banga Mangpa dan azui u’leh azuilou uh ze etna dingin amaute ka mangta ding hi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n khum namte thakhat a deldoh pailouin anuasieta a, tualeh Joshua khut ah zong ape diehta sih hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam namte ahi, Mangpa’n Kanaan gam a gal kidouna thei nailou Israel mite ze etna dinga aumdensahte.","title":"Gam sunga nam um nalaite"},"2":{"text":"Tami Israel hahlesuonte tumasanga bangma thei nai vawtlouten ahing theina ding u’leh gal doudan amauh zilsah na ding maimai a a umsah ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tam namte khu Philistin Leeng ngate, Kanaanmite zousie, Sidonmite, Baal-Hermon taanga kipat a Hamath lutna tandonga Lebanon taanga teng Hiv mite ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa’n Mosi khut a apu leh pate uh kunga anapieh, Mangpa thupiehte azui u’leh zuilou uh theina dinga, Israel tate ze etna dinga kinuasie namte ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate khu Kanaanmite, Hitmite, Amormite, Perizmite, Hivmite tualeh Jebus mite lah ah ateng ua.","title":"Saltaanna khatna"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh atanute uh ziin anei ua, tualeh amauh tanute a tapate uh zi dingin apie ua, apasiente uh nna asem uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten Mangpa mitmu in silgilou abawlta ua, Mangpa a Pasian uh amanghil ua, Baalte leh Ashtorethte nna asemta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa khu Israelte tungah athangpaita a, tuachi’n amaute Mesopotamia leengpa Kushan-Rishathaim kungah a zuata hi. Tuachi’n Israel taten kum giet sung Kushan-Rishathaim nna asemta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Mangpa ahat tah un, Mangpa’n Israel tate kungah amauh hundoh ding mi apie a, ama khu Kaleb naupa Kenaz tapa Othniel ahi.","title":"Othniel vaihawmtu masapen"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa hagau atungah ahing tunga, Israelte tungah vai ahawm a, tuachi’n galdou dingin akuonkhie a, Mangpa’n Mesopotamia leengpa Kushan-Rishathaim akhut ah apekhie a, Kushan-Rishathaim azouta, akhut nuoi ah akoita hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n gam khu kum sawmli sung galmuongin a umta hi. Tualeh Kenaz tapa Othniel ashita hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Mangpa mitmu in sil gilou abawl kiata ua, tuachia Mangpa mitmu a sil ana bawl kheltah zieh un, Mangpa’n Moab leengpa Eglon Israelte sangin ahatsah zawta hi.","title":"Saltaanna ni na"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Ammon mite leh Amalek mite akaikhawm a, tualeh akuon ua, Israelte ava dou ua, tumsing khopi ala ua, aluota uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate Moab leengpa Eglon thu nuoi ah kum sawm leh kum giet a um ua, anna asemta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel taten Mangpa ahat kiatah un Mangpa’n Gera tapa Ehud, Benjamin nam a, miveilawng, amaute hundoh ding in aguot pieh hi. Tualeh Israel taten Moab leengpa Eglon kunga Sie pe dingin Ehud asawl uhi.","title":"Ehud vaihawmtu ni na"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ehud in namsau alangni a hiem tongtan a sau khat akhenga, tuakhu apheipi zietlam puon nuoi ah avomdap hi."},"17":{"text":"Aman sie lieu ding khu Moab leengpa Eglon kungah atawi a, tualeh Eglon khu mi thau mama khat ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh sie apieh zou tahin, tua sie pomite asawlmanga."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh ama pen Gilgal khuo kunga suong milim khenna mun a pat in akinuale kia a, akungah “Leengpa na kunga hing hil ding thuguh ka nei hi,” achi a, tuachi’n Lengpan, “Sip khin khian un” achi a, tuachi’n akunga um zousie’n apawtdohsanta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Ehud akungah ava pei a, Eglon leengpa pen ni pi lai chienga khawldamna dinga kibawl inntung lam a apindan ah ana tou a. Tualeh Ehud in na kungah “Pasian thu vaihah gen ding ka nei hi” achi a, tualeh ama atouna akipat ahing dingdoh a."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ehud in akhut veilam in apheipi zietlam a namsau asatdoh a, agilpi ah asunlutta hi."},"22":{"text":"Atembul nangawn atumsuh a, tualeh athau in atem ma ahubit a, Ehud in agil akipat namsau adohkhe sih a, tuachi’n agilchimkha tui apawtta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ehud pen innhim langah apawta, inntung pindan kotte akhakhum a, apulam ah akilkhum bihbeh hi."},"24":{"text":"Khuchia apawtdoh zou tahin, Eglon suohte ahing pei ua, a et u’leh, inntung pindan kot ki kilte amu ua lamdang asa ua; “Anipi pindan a va tuom umtadi hiva” achi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachia lung nopmawtah a angah ngah vang un pindan kotkhate ang hong tuom mawngmawng tasih a, tuachi’n sawhonna ala ua, ahongta uhi. Tualeh, khumnah aleengpa uh tuong lai ah a shi sain ana lumta hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh, khuchia akiheh a azekai lah kal un Ehud ana taimangta a, suong milim khenna ana heng man a, Seirah ah atailut a a asuohta ta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, khum mun atun in Ephraim muolte ah pengkul amut a, tualeh Israel tate khu khum muol a kipat in akumsuh ua, aman amauh alamkaita hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Hing zuiun, Mangpa’n na melma uh Moab mite na khut uah ahing pekheta hi,” achi a. Tuachi’n amaun anua azuisuh ua, Moab gam a Jordan lui galkaina mun tandong ala ua, koima agal kai ding aphal sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Khumi tungin Moab mite mihat leh hangsan ngen tul sawm athat ua, mi khat zong a suohta a um sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum ni in Moab mite khu Israelte khut nuoi ah akipelutta uhi. Tuachi’n kum sawm giet sung gam galmuongin aumta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh ama nua in Anath tapa Shamgar ahi a, aman bawng sutna chieng zum in Philistinte za guh athat a, aman zong Israelte ahun khie hi.","title":"Shamgar vaihawmtu thumna"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Ehud a shi nuain, Israel taten Mangpa mitmu in sil abawl khiel kiata ua.","title":"Saltaanna thum veina"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n amaute Hazor a vaihawm Kanaan gam leengpa Jabin khut ah a zuata a, ama galkap lamkaipa khu Sisera ahia, Haroseth-Hagoiim khuo a teng ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Mangpa ahan ua, azieh khu ama’n sia kangtalai zakuo tah anei hi; tualeh kum sawmni sung vingveng Israel tate nasatah a nuoisie in asugenthei hi."},"4":{"text":"Khum hunlai in guolneinu Deborah Lappidoth zi in Israelte vai ahawm hi.","title":"Deborah leh Barak vaihawmtu lina leh ngana"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh amanu Ephraim singtang gam a Ramah leh Bethel kikaal a tum sing nuoi ah atou zel a. Tuachi’n Israeltate amanu kungah vaihawmpieh dingin a hawtou zel uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n Kedesh Naphtali gam a kipat in Abinoam tapa Barak athuhah a, akungah, “Mangpa Israelte Pasian in Naphtali tate leh Jebulun tate mi tul sawm la khawm inlen, Tabor muol ah pui tou in."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kishion lui ah Jabin galkap lamkai Sisera leh a kangtalai leh agalkap hon tampi toh kang sawl dinga, tualeh amauh na khut ah ka hing peding hi, chiin thu ahing pie asiei mah,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Barak in akungah, “Nang toh izawh ding leh ka kuon dinga, hinanleh nang zawpi sih ding leh kang kuon sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n akungah, “Ka hing zawpi ding hi, ahivangin nava kuon na ah minpha na lawsih ding hi, aziehpen Mangpa’n Sisera khu numei khat khuta pelut ding ahi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Deborah adingdoh a Barak toh Kedesh langah akuonta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Barak in Naphtalite leh Jebulunte Kedesh ah ahankhawm a, tualeh ama mi tul sawm toh akuontou ua, tualeh Deborah zong amautoh akuontou ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh ken mi Heber, Mosi sungpa Hobab tate lah apat in atuom ten a, Kedesh kunga Zanaim a gangpi lienpi phungah apuon buh azah hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Abinoam tapa Barak Tabor muol ah akuon touta chi Sisera ahil ua."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sisera in zong a sakolleng, zousie, sia sakolleng zakuo leh Haroseth-Hagoiim a kipat kishon lui donga mipi zousie akhawm khawmta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Deborah in Barak kungah, “Khaile tuni Mangpa’n Sisera na khut sunga ahing pieh ni ahi, Mangpa na masangah apei asiei mah?” achi hi. Tuachi’n Barak Tabor muol a kipat akuonsuh a, tualeh mi tul sawm in ama azui uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Sisera leh asakolleng zousie leh agalkap hon zousie Barak masangah namsau hiem in abuoithangsahta a, tuachi’n Sisera khu asakolleng tunga kipat akumkhie a, a kengin ataimangta hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Barak in sakolleng leh galkapte khu Haroseth-Hagoiim tandong anuadel a, tualeh Sisera galkapte zousie namsau in athatgam sienga, khat zong ahing sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanlezong Sisera pen ken mi Heber zi Jael puoninn ah kengin atailut hi: aziehpen Hazor leengpa Jabin leh Ken mi Heber innkuonte kikaal ah kilemna ana um ngitnget hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Jael khu Sisera kimupi dingin apawtdoh a, akungah “Pu aw hingkihei in, ka innsungah hing lut in, zausin,” achi a, tuachi’n puon inn sunga amanu kung a alut tahin, amanu’n puonkhou khat akhu khum hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sisera in akungah, “Hepitahin dawn ding tui themkhat hing pie’n ka dang atah mama hi” achi hi.
