Tuachi’n amanu’n bawngnawi bel ahonga, a dawn sah a, puon akhu khum kiata hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n amanu kungah “Puon inn kot ah ding inlen, tualeh hichi ahi ding hi, mi koi ahiei ahing pei a, Tamnah mi a um khai chia ahing doh leh umlou na chi ding hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Heber zi Jael in puon inn themkhet khat ala a, akhut in seh khat atawi a, kaangnoukhat in azuon phei a, a ankhaibaw laitah ah akhen tumsuh a, tuol toh akilbehta hi, aziehpen alunggim thatawl toh a imut tui mama laitah ahi, tuachi’n ashita hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Envawi, Barak in Sisera ahing nuadel a kimupi dingin Jael ahing pawtdoh a, akungah, “Hing pei in nami suipa ka hing ensah ding hi” achi a, tuachi’n amapa puon inn sunga avalut tahin, envawi Sisera shisa a lum ava mu a, a ankhaibaw ah themkhet ana kiphu vengvong hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum ni in Pasian in Kanaan leengpa Jabin khu Israel tate masangah a guollel sahta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Kanaan leengpa asuh mangthai masangsie uh, ahat deudeu ua, Kanaan leengpa Jabin azouta uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum ni in Deborah leh Abinoam tapa Barak in,","title":"Deborah leh Barak guolzawna La"},"2":{"text":"“Israelte sunga lamkaiten ma apui lai un, Mipite a ma uh kiphalna toh akipumpieh lai un, Mangpa khu pah tawi un."},"3":{"text":"“Aw, nou leengte ngaikhie unlen; Nou, leeng tapate aw, bildaw un; Keima, ahi keima ngelin, Mangpa Israel te Pasian phat na’n La kasa ding."},"4":{"text":"“Mangpa Seir a kipat a navai kuondoh lai in, Edom gam a na peilai in, Simlei akilinga, vanten abokhie ua, Meilum ten zong tui abokhie uhi."},"5":{"text":"Muol leh tangte Mangpa mai ah tui in aluongkhie ua, Israelte Mangpa masang ah, Sinai muol zong zil bangin aling hi.","ref":"Pawt. 19.18"},"6":{"text":"“Anath tapa Shamgar hunlai leh, Jael damlai nite in, Lamlienpite kikhul in, khuol zin mite lampelte ah apei uh."},"7":{"text":"Loubang tulta Israel gam vangkhuote, Israel gam tunnu Deborah kei ka thou doh a, Adingdohta Israel tunnu."},"8":{"text":"Amaun pasien thate atel ua, dougal pat bang asai uh, khopi kul dawngkotte ah, muding umlou, Lum leh phaw, Israel mi sang sawmli lah ah."},"9":{"text":"Aum hi ka lungtang, Mipi dinga ki pum pieh, Israel vaihawmte lah ah, Mangpa phat un."},"10":{"text":"“Siem un, Nou sabiltung kaang tunga toute, Nou vaihawmna phawipi tunga toute leh, Nou lampi a peite in zong."},"11":{"text":"Thal kap mite husa mawngmawng, zah phahlouna tuikhuh te ah, Mangpa sildih bawlte agen ua, Israel galhangte dihna zong agen uhi, “Tuachi’n Mangpa mipite, khopi kulpi dawngkot ah apeisuh uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Thou in, thou in, Deborah, thou in, thou in, zaila sain dingdohin, Thou in Barak nang Abinoam tapa, Na galmatte suoh leh sal dingin pui in."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahing pei uh mihat, um sunte leh mipite, Ahing kuonsuh ta uh ama adingin, Mipite Mangpa mihatte dou dingin,"},"14":{"text":"Apei suh uh Amalek zungzamte Ephraim akipat in, Benjamin na mipiten ahing zuisuh uhi, Makir akipat in vaihawm mite ahing pei suh ua, Ahing pei suh uhi Zebulun akipat, Laigiel mi chieng tawi mite,"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Issakar Leng tapate, Deborah toh apangkhawm uhi. Issakar bangin Barak zong, Atai suh hi phaijang ah, Thupieh amu dung zui in, Reuben namte kihawm khenna ah, lungtanga ngaituona thupi tahte a um hi."},"16":{"text":"Bang dinga belam huong sung a touden nalai, Belamhon hatna theile tumging, ngai na hiei? Reuben namte lah ah, lungtang ki et chienna thupitah a um hi."},"17":{"text":"Gilead mite Jordan gal ah akhawl den ua, Tualeh bangdinga Dan mite tembaw sunga umden ahi uoi? Asher mite tuipi pieu ah a umden ua, luipieu neute ah ateng denta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Zebulun mite shina zauhuoi ah ading ua, Tuamabangin Naphtali zong munsang, Galphuolte ah a um uhi."},"19":{"text":"“Lengte hing peiin ahing dou ua, Tuachi’n Kanaan leengten Megiddo luigei ah, Tanak khuo ah akidoupi ua, Gal sillah khat zong alazou sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Van akipat adou a, Thangvan aasite’n alampi chiet ua kipat Sisera adou uhi."},"21":{"text":"Kishion lui in atawmang hi amaute, Nidanglai Kishon lui tuisua in, Aw ka hinna hattah in pei zelin."},"22":{"text":"“Tuachi’n leithuong akihot hi, Sakol kengtaw gin in, Sakolte akitawm akitawm zieh un."},"23":{"text":"“Meroz aw sie lawkhum un, Mangpa vansawltahin achi hi, Khumna tengte awsekhal toh samsie un, Amaute Mangpa panpi dingin ahing pei sih. Mihatte dou a Mangpa’n panpi dingin."},"24":{"text":"“Numei lah ah Jael, Ken mi Heber zi avanglien pen hi. Puon inn a teng numei lah ah avanglien ahi."},"25":{"text":"Amapa’n tui angen a, Bung nawi a pie hi; Milien nou in bawngnawi khal ahing tawi hi."},"26":{"text":"A khutin puon inn them khet ala a, Azietlam in nasem mi sehta atawi hi, Sisera lutang akhen a, Akhen pailetta hi; A ankhaibaw ah akhen lutta hi."},"27":{"text":"Amanu kengbul ah khupbohin apua a, alum denta anu kengbul ah, a pua hi khupboh in akengbul ah, Ashi denta a puana mun ah."},"28":{"text":"“A hing dahhi Sisera nu kotta ah, Ahing han hi vathangkal hawm ah, Bangding a sakolleng hing tung ha ahiei? Bangzieha sakolleng gingte zekai ahiei?"},"29":{"text":"Anumei pilten amanu ana dawng ua, Ahi ama leh ama kidawng hibou."},"30":{"text":"Amu zouta sih uh amah? Akihawmta sih amah galvanlahte? Michin in nungah khat le ni chiet, Sisera tan ding pen, gallah puon zem tuom tuom, gallah puon zem kilawm, khut a kiphan zemtuom tuom leh, alang ni a zem kilawm ngawnga awding, chiin."},"31":{"text":"“Tuabangin aw Mangpa, Mangthang sieng uheh na melmate zousie, Hinanleh Ama it leh ngaite pen, Hattaha pei ni bang hi uhen, chi in la asa uhi.” Tuachi’n gam khu kum sawmli sung galmuongin a umta hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Mangpa mitmu in Silgilou ana bawlta ua, tuachi’n Mangpa’n amaute kum sagi sung Midiante khut ah apedohta hi.","title":"Saltaanna liveina"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Midianten Israelte a zouta ua; Midiante ziehin Israelten muolte ah, kokhuhte, leikohawmte leh kulte abawl uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahia, Israelten haichi achiin pou pou chiengun, Midiante, Amalek mite leh suolam mite ava kuontou ua ava simzel uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh amaun panmun akhawkhum ua, Gaza khuo tandongin lei a haichi poute asuhsiet pieh ua, tuachi’n Israel gam ah neh ding mawngmawng a khawi pieh sih ua, belamte, bawngte leh sabiltungte akhawi pieh sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute, aganhonte u’leh, apuon innte u’leh asangawngsau te utoh, khauphe simsenglou tawn bangin ahing kuontou ua; tuachi’n atun tunna gam uh asuse zel uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Midiante ziehin Israelte ahing zawngkhal mamata ua, tuachi’n Israel tate Mangpa kungah akikouta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Israel taten Midiante zieha Mangpa ahat tah un;"},"8":{"text":"Mangpa’n Israel tate kungah guolnei khat ahing sawl a, tualeh aman akung uah, Israelte “Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, Izipt akipat in ka hing puidoh a, na saltanna mun ua kipat in ka hing lakhie hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt mite khut akipat leh nou hing nuoisie zousiete khut akipat in ka hing hundoh a, na masang uah amaute ka delmanga, agam uh nou ka hing pie hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh na kung uah Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi; Na tenna gam ua Amormite pasiente zong giing sih un ka chi a, hinanleh ka thu nasang sih uhi, achi hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa vansawlsieng khat ahing pei a, Ophrah khuo a um Abiezermi Joash gangpi sing nuoiah atou a: tualeh atapa Gideon in Midian mite mu theilou dingin grep suhna khuh ah bu ana chil hi.","title":"Gideon vaihawmtu guhna"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa vansawlsieng akungah ahing kilah a, akungah, “Nang mihat hangsan Mangpa na kungah aum hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Gideon in akungah, “Ka Mangpa aw, Mangpa ka kung a um ahileh bangchidan a tam silte zousie ka tung ua hing tung thei adiei? ka pule pate un Mangpa’n Izipt gam akipat ahing puitou hilou amah? chia, asil lamdang mama bawlte ahing hil zousiete uh heilanga bangchi sieng ata diei? Tu’n vang Mangpa’n hing pampai sieng ahita a, Midiante khut ah ahing pedohta hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa ama lamah akiheia akungah, “Tam na hatna toh pei inlen, Midiante khuta kipat in Israelte hundam in: ka hing sawl hilou amah?” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh aman akungah, “Aw Mangpa, bangchin ken Israelte kava hundam thei mawh diei? Ngai in, Manasseh phungte lah a genthei pen kahi ua, kei lah ka pa innkuonte lah a neupen ka hinalai a” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n akungah, “Na kungah ka um dinga, tuachi’n Midiante mi khat bangin bailam tahin na zou sieng ding hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akungah, “Na deisahna tang kahi leh nangma mama in nahing houpi chi ka theina dingin chiemtena khat hing musahin achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Na mai a lat ding silpieh kava lah a, na kunga ka hing tunkia masangsie, hepitah in, tam na kipat in na peidoh vawt sin achi hi,” tualeh aman “Nang peikia masangsie kana um zing ding hi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gideon inn sungah alut a, kelnou khat leh tangbuong tolsawlou ephah khat abawl a, asa pen law sungah akoi a, atui pen bel sungah akoi a; tuachi’n gangpi sing nuoiah akungah ahing tawi a ama apeta hi."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa vansawlsieng in akungah, “Sa leh tanghou tolsawlou la inlen tam suongpi tungah koi inlen, tualeh atuipen sungbuo in achi a,” tualeh aman tuabangin abawlta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa vansawlsieng in akhut a um achiengkhut dawn in, sa leh tanghou tolsawlou khu akhoi a; tualeh, suong a kipat in mei ahing pawt a, sa leh tanghou tolsawlou khu akatumta hi. Tualeh Mangpa vansawlsieng khu amangta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu’n Gideon in ama khu Mangpa vansawlsieng ahi chi atheichienta hi. Tuachi’n Gideon in “Eh, Mangpa Pasian Aw! Tu’n vang Mangpa vansawlsieng kimaituo in ka muta hi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n akungah “Lungmuong tahin um inlen, zausin, shi sih vateh” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gideon in tua munah Mangpa a dingin maitam khat abawl a, Jehovah shalom achi hi. Tuni dong in tami Abiezer mite khuo Ophrah ah aum nalai hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh khum zan main hichi ahing hi a, Mangpa’n akungah, “Na pa bawngtal tuoi anina kum sagi phapen la inlen, na pa bawl Baal maitam satsie inlen akunga um Ashera zong phua in."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian a dingin tami suongpi vum tungah zenei tahin maitam khat bawl inlen, tualeh bawngtal ni na khu la inlen, Ashera na phua ding khu singin zang inlen, halmang sillat lan in” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gideon in asuohte lah a mi sawm azawpi a, Mangpa’n akunga agen bangin abawlta hi; hichi ahi a, apa innkuonte leh akhomite a giin ziehin sunlaiin abawl ngam sih a, zanlai in abawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh khopi mite zingmawng matah a ahing thaw tah un, Baal maitam satchip in ana um a; akunga Ashera zong satpua in ana um a, tualeh bawngtal ni na khu maitam kibawl tungah lat in ana umta hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tami koi bawl ahiei?” chi’n khat leh khat akidong tuo kawi ua, tualeh akidawp ua, akan kawi kawi u’leh “Joash tapa Gideon bawl ana hita hi.”"},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua khopi miten Joash kungah, “Na tapa hing la dohin, ashi teitei ding ahi, Baal maitam asat chip zieh leh akunga Ashera aphua ziehin” achi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Joash in ama nielkalte zousie kungah, “Baal humding na hi uoi? Ama hundam ding nahi uoi? koipou ama hum pouma zingmawng chieng mama a tha ding ahi; Pasian tahtah ahileh amaitam kisuhsiet ziehin ama leh ama kihun leh avele,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaziehin, khum niin ama khu Jerubaal achi ta hi, “Baal in amapa demta heh,” azieh pen amaitam asatchip piehta hi, achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Midianmite zousie leh Amalek mite, tualeh suolam gam mipite ahing kikhawm khawm ua, Jordan agalkai ua, Jezreel phaijangah pan mun akhaw uhi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa hagau Gideon tungah ahing tunga, tualeh aman pengkul a mut a, Abiezer mipite anua ah akikhawm uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh aman Manasseh gamsung pumpi ah thangkou mi asawl a, amaute zong anua ah ahing kikhawm ua, tualeh Asherte, Zebulunte leh Naphtali kungah thangkou asawl a, amauh kimupi dingin ahing peitou uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Gideon in Pasian kungah. “Na gen banga kei khuta Israelte na hundam ding leh;"},"37":{"text":"En in, bu phuol ah belam mul lom khat ka koi dinga, tam belam mul tung maimai a daitui ana kieh a, akimvel leitangte ana gaw leh na gen bangin keima khut in Israelte na hundam ding chi ka thei ding hi,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh tuabangin ana um ngut a, azingni zingmawng matah in athou a belam mul aheh leh belam mul a um daitui heng kuong dim khat ana um hi"},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Gideon in Pasian kungah, “Ka tungah lungthah sinlen, khat vei maimai hing gen kiavang, ka hing ngen a hi, tam belam mul mama toh ka en khe kia ding hi; tuin belam mul ana hul henlen, akim avel a leitung tengah daitui nakie heh” achi a."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in khumi zan in zong tuabangma in abawl hi, belam mul maimai ana hul a, akim vela lei tung tengah daitui ana um kia hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerubaal (tua khu Gideon ahi) leh akunga um mipi zousie zingmawng matahin athou ua, Harod tuikhuh gei ah akikul ua, tualeh Midiante pen amauh sahlam phaijang, Moreh muol pangah aum uhi.","title":"Kidou dinga kisahna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Gideon kungah, “Midian mite akhut ua ka pieh na dingin, na kunga umte kei dingin atam seng uhi; tuachilouin vang Israelten eima khut ngei a, kihundam ihi uh chi’n aki uongsah kha ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin, tuin mipite zah ngeiin gen in, koipou zau leh linga umte, nua pei kia uheh,” Gilead muol akipat in nua peikia uheh, chi’n puong khie in achi a. Tuachi’n mipite tul sawmni leh tul ni anua pei kia ua; tualeh tul sawm a um nalai uhi.","ref":"Danp. 20.8"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Gideon kungah, “Mipite atam seng nalai uhi, lui ah zawpi suh inlen, tuanah keiman ka hing khen pieh ding hi, tualeh hichi ahi dinga, Na kunga tam mipa nang toh zawhkhawm heh ka chi pouma na zawpi dinga, tualeh tam mipa zawpi sin kachi pouma na zawpi lou ding ahi.”"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite lui ah apui suh a, tualeh Mangpa’n Gideon kungah, “Ui banga alei a tui lieh thaw pouma atuom in koikhe zel inlen, tuabang main koipou tui adawn chienga khupdin a chipthaw pouma zong atuom in um sah in,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh akhutpeh uh akam ua koi a liehthawte mi zathum ahi ua, adang teng pen kun a khup din a chip thaw ngen ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Gideon kungah, “Mi zathum alieh a liehthawte zangin nou ka hing hundam dinga, Midiante na khut uah ka hing peding hi, tualeh mi dang zousie amauh mun chiet ah pei kiata uheh” achi a.","title":"Gideon mi zathumte"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipiten akhut uah neh ding leh pengkul atawi ua, tualeh Israel mi zousie a puon inn lam chiet uah apeisah sienga, mi zathumte maimai aum sahta hi. Tualeh Midian galkapte panmun khu amaute umna hanglam phaijanga um ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh khum zanin, hichi ahing hi a, Mangpa’n akungah, “Thou inlen apanmun uh sim dingin kuon suh in, na khut ah ka hing peta hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh, kuonsuh ding na zau leh na suohpa Purah zawpi inlen agiehphuol ah vapei suh un."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh bang a gen uoi chi nava za dinga; tuazou chiengin na khut suhhatin a um dinga, agiehphuol uah nava kuon ngamta ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n asuohpa Purah toh agiehphuol panmun ua galvenna tuoh masah pente umna dong apei suhta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Midiante leh Amalekte tualeh suolam mipite zousie, simsenglou khauphehon bang maiin phaijang ah a um ua, tualeh asangawngsaute uh tam dan pen tuipi pieu a senel simsenglou bangmai ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Gideon ahing tunsuh tahin, mi khat in alawmpa kungah amang ana gen a, akungah, “Ngaivawi mang ka nei a, tualeh barli bu tanghou khat Midiante giehphuol ah ahing kilia suh a puon buh sungah akilia lut a, puonbuh apuasah a, akikhule sah a, tuol ah akiphengpha sahta hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh alawmpan adawnga akungah, “Tam pen Israel mi Joash tapa Gideon namsau loungal bangma dang ahisih hi, Pasian in Midiante leh agalkapte zousie akhut a apekhiet ahita maive” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hi a, Gideon in tua mang kigen leh akhiehna akihilchien uh azahtah in Pasian abeta hi; tuachi’n Israelte gieh phuol ah anua peikia a, “Thou un Mangpa’n na khut uah Midian galkapte ahing pekheta hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi zathumte khu pawl thum in akhen a, tuachi’n michin khut ah pengkul khat leh leibel hawm a sunga meisel koisa khat chiet a pie hi.","title":"Midiante tunga guolzawna"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Hing en unlen kabawl bang bangin bawl zel un, tualeh, agiehphuol monguh ka tuntah chienga kabawl bang banga nang bawl zel dinguh ahi."},"18":{"text":"Kei leh ka kunga um zousie tengin pengkul ka hing mutging tah chiengun, agiehphuol kimvel a um tengin pengkul nang mutging chiet ding uh ahi, Tualeh Mangpa leh Gideon a dingin, na chi chiet ding uhi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gideon leh akunga um mi zakhat ten zan galven laita kihen hun laitahin giehphuol monga galveng dinna bul ahing tungsuh ua, tualeh pengkul amut ua, abel tawite uh atawkeh uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh apawl thum un apengkul chiet uh amut ua, abelte uh a tawkeh ua, aveilam khut un meisel atawi ua, a khut zietlam un pengkul mut ding atawi uhi. Tualeh “Mangpa leh Gideon namsau chiin akikou uhi.”"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh giehphuol kimvel ah michin amauh pan mun chiet ah ading ua, tuachi’n Midian galkapte zousie atai ua, ataizah kawm un akikou uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachia mi zathumten apengkul chiet uh amut ging tah un, Mangpa’n Midian galkapte zousie ama u’leh amauh namsau in akisattuo sahta a, tuachi’n a galkapte uh guollel in Zeverah gam a Beth-Shitah langah leh Tabath kunga Abel-meholah gamgi tandong ataizahta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate, Naphtali, Asher leh Manasseh akipat akikhawm khawm ua, Midiante anuadelta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gideon in Ephraim singtang gam zousie ah thangkou asawl a, Midian mite dou dingin “Hing pei suh unlen, Beth-Barah leh Jordan luite tandongin” na kheltan un ava chisah hi. Tualeh Ephraim mite zousie a kikhawm ua, Beth-Barah leh Jordan luite tandongin ana khelta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Midiante leeng tapate ni Oreb leh Zeebte ahingin aman ua, Oreb khu Oreb suongpi tungah athat ua, Zeeb pen Zeeb greptui suhna ah athat uhi. Tualeh Midiante anuadel zel ua, tualeh Oreb leh Zeeb lutangte khu Jordan gallam a Gideon kungah ahing puo uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tuin Ephraim miten akungah, “Bang zieha tambanga na hing bawl a, Midiante toh na kidouna a bang dinga koute na hing chiellou ahiei?” achi ua, hatangpi’n a phawh uhi.","title":"Ephraimte thangsietna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akung uah, “Noute toh tekahh dinga bang ahiei ka bawl khiel? Abiezerte grep law sangin Ephraimte grep sang khon athupi asiei mah?"},"3":{"text":"Pasian in Midiante leeng tapate Oreb leh Zeeb na khut uah ahing pekheta hi; tuachi’n noutoh tekahh dingin bang ka bawl thei tuom a ahiei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n tuabang thute agen bepin atunga alungthahna uh athengta hi.","ref":"Late. 83.11"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Gideon leh akunga mi zathum umten Jordan lui apha suh ua, akaan ua, gim sasa in anuadel zel uhi.","title":"Gideon in Midian leengte amatna"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sukoth khuo a mite kungah, “Tam kanua zuite hepitahin tanghou hing pieh pieh vawi un gilkiel in ahusam siengta uhi; Tualeh Midian leengte Zebah leh Zalmuna nuadel ka hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Sukoth khuo a a lamkaite un, “Zebah leh Zalmuna na khut sunga um ahita uoimah? Bangdinga na galkapte tanghou kapieh mawh ding uh ahiei?” achi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Gideon in, “Aw le tua ahileh, Mangpa’n Zebah leh Zalmuna ka khut sunga ahing pieh chiengin, gamdai ling leh louling neite in nasa tunguh ka kuikeh zengzung na ding hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n khuna kipat in Penuel ah apei touta ua, tuabang main ngetna abawl kia a, Penuel khuo a miten zong Sukoth khomite dawn bangma in ana dawng uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman zong Penuel khomite kungah, “Lemna toh galzou a ka hing kinuale kia chiengin tam kulpi ka satchim ding hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuin Zebah leh Zalmuna pen, suolam mite galkap ashimawh umsun tul sawm leh ngate toh Karkor ah ana um uhi, galkap namsau dohthei ngen tul za leh tul sawmni ashi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gideon khu Nobah leh Jogbehah suolam a puon inn a tengte lampi ah a kuontou a, galmuong tah a um galkapte ava bing phawn a."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Zebah leh Zalmuna ataimang bep un anuadel pai a, tuachi’n Midiante leeng nite gel Zebah leh Zalmuna ani un aman ua, tualeh agalkapte uh abuoithang sahta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joash tapa Gideon khu Heres kaltouna, kidounaphuol akipat in ahing kinuale kiata hi,"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Sukoth khomi tangval khat aman a, thu adonga tualeh Sukoth khuo a miliente leh upate min agiel sah a, sawm sagi leh sagi ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sukoth khuo a mite kungah ahawtou a, “Zebah leh Zalmuna tu’n en chiet di uo leh tamte ave ua leh Zebah leh Zalmuna na khuta umsa bang mai a, na galkap gilkiel husamte tanghou ka pieh kawi dinguh chia na hing enghou nate uh;” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum khopi upate aman a, gamdai ling leh loulingneite’n Sukoth mite a zep hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh aman penuel khopi kulpi asatchima, tualeh akhopi mite zong athat hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Zebah leh Zalmuna kungah, “Tabor muol a, na mithate uh mibangchi bang ahi uoi?” achi hi. Tualeh amaun “Nang bang ngen ahi ua, leeng tapate toh kibahna anei chiet uhi,” chi’n adawng uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Amaute ka unaute kanu tapate vawt ahi uhi, Mangpa ahin bangin, na hingkhawi hi ulachin, nou hing that louma ding hiveng maw,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh atapa upapen Jether kungah, “Kisa’nlen nang amauh va that in” achi a, hinanleh tangval pan anamsau adoh sih a, aziehpen khang dawng ahi nahlai ziehin azau hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zebah leh Zalmuna in, “Nangma hing kipan inlen hing that maive; piching leh piching ikibuon ding ahi,” achi ua. Tuachi’n Gideon ading doh a, Zebah leh Zalmuna athatta hi, tualeh a sangawngsaute uh ngawng a kizepma ngawngkuolte alata hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel miten Gideon kungah, “Nang ka tung uah vaihawm inlen, na tate leh na tuten zong; nangman Midiante khut akipat na hing hundoh tah zieh in,” a chi uhi.","title":"Gideon nasep dangte leh ashina"},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh Gideon in akung uah, “Noute tung ah vai ka hawm sih ding, ka tapa in zong na tung uah vai ahawm sih dinga, Mangpa’n na tung uah vai ahawm zaw ding hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gideon in akung uah, “Nou apat in nget ut sil khat ka nei hi, michin in na galvanlah bilba uh hing pe chiet ve ua,” achi a. (Ishmael mite ahiziehun sana bilba anei uhi)."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten “Kipahtahin ka hing peding uhi” chi’n adawng uhi; tuachi’n puon apha ua, michin in a gallah bilba uh ahing sep khawm chiet uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua sana bilba angette gihdan shekel tul khat leh zasagi ahi a; tuate chilou Midian leengte satung a, kizepnate, ngawng awte, puon sandupte tuate ban ah a sangawngsaute uh ngawnga khainiengte bang ahi nalai hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Gideon in khum silte in Ephod khat abawla, tua khu atenna ophrah khopi ah a koi hi; tualeh Israel tate zousie’n Pasian a nuangat san ua, tuakhu bie in ang ana kawm siengta uhi; tuachi’n Gideon leh a innkuonpite nasan adingin zong thang ahing hita hi."},"28":{"text":"Tambangin Midiante khu Israelte masangah ngiemsahin a um ua, tuachi’n, akipan kia zou nawn sih uhi. Tualeh Gideon damsungin gam kum sawmli sung galmuongin a umta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joash tapa Jerubal apeia, ama inn ah atengta hi."},"30":{"text":"Gideon in ama hindoh ngelngel tapa sawm sagi anei hi; zi tampi anei ziehin."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Shekem khuo a um ameinu’n zong tapa khat ahinpieh nalai a, amin dingin Abimelek ahisah ta hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Joash tapa Gideon tehsetah ahiin ashi a, Abiezer mite gam a Ophrah kichi mun apa Joash kivuina han ah avuita uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Gideon shi zoutahin, Israel tate akilehei ua Baal bie in ang akawm ua, tuachi’n Baal-Berith khu pasien in aneita uhi.","title":"Saltaanna ngana: buoina hun"},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten, akim avel ua amelmate uh lah a kipata hunkhepa Mangpa a Pasian uh athei kha nawnta sih uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Jerubaal (Gideon china) in Israelte dinga silhoi abawl zousie dungzuiin, amauten Gideon innkuonpite kungah hepina alangsah nawn sih uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Jerubal tapa Abimelek khu anu sanggamte tenna Shekem khuo ah ava pei a, amau’leh anu pa inn sungmite zousie toh ava kithukum uhi.","title":"Abimelek vaihawmna"},"2":{"text":"“Hepitahin Shekem khuo a mizousie zah dingin thugen unlen; Jerubaal tapa sawm sagiten na tung ua vai ahawm uh na dei uoi? ahisihleh mi khat in ahawm na deizaw uoi? chiin adongta a. Kei na tahsa u’leh na gu nataang uh ka hi chi theizing un;” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh anu sanggamten, Shekem khuo a mi zousie zahin ama tungtang thu agen ua, tualeh alungtangte uh Abimelek zui dingin a awn siengta hi. Tualeh amaun “Ama pen isanggampa uh ahi,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Baal-Berith inn sunga kipat in amapa dangka Shekel sawm sagi apie ua, tuami toh Abimelek in mi thulimlou leh mi ginalou pipite aguoi a, tualeh amaun amapa nua azuita uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama khu Ophrah khuo a apa innkuonte kung ah apeita hi; tualeh asanggamte Jerubaal tapa sawmsagite abawn un suongpi tungkhat ah abantha siengta hi. Hinanleh Jerubaal tapa tum pen Jotham ana kiphuol khah ziehin dam in asuohta kha hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Shekem khuo a mipite zousie leh Beth-millo a mipite zousie akikhawm khawm ua, tuachi’n Abimelek Shekem khuo a suongphu kunga gangpi bul ah leeng in abawlta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tamthu Jotham ahil tahun, apeitou a, Gerizim muolvum ah ava dinga, tualeh aw ngaitahin akikou a, akung uah, “Nou Shekem khuo a mite aw ka thugen na ngaikhie un, Pasian in nou a hing ngai khieh theina ding in."},"8":{"text":"Singte khu khatvei atung ua leengpa ding sathau nu dingin akuonkhie ua, Olive sing kungah, ka tung uah nang vaihawmin achi ua."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Olive singin akung uah, Pasian leh mihingte zatat a aumna ka thau piehlai tawpsanin singte tungah lelam lelam ah ka kiloh kawi ding amah? achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n singten theipi sing kungah, Nang hing pei inlen ka tung uah, vai hing hawm maiin achi ua,"},"11":{"text":"hinanleh, theipi singin akung uah, ka humna leh ka ga hoite tawpsan in singte tungah lelam lelam ah ka kiloh koi ding amah? achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n singten grepgui kungah, Nang hing pei inlen ka tung uah vai hing hawm mai in, achi ua."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh grep guiin akung uah, Pasian leh mihing kipahsah zing ka uoin thate tawpsan in singte tungah, lelam lelam ah ka kiloh kawi mawngmawng ding amah? achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n sing zousie’n theimiling kungah, Nang hing pei inlen ka tung uah vaihawmin hing pang mai in achi ua."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh theimilingin singte kungah, Na leengpa ding ua sathau hing nu sawm tahpi nahi u’leh ka him nuoi hing bel un, hinanleh na chi tahpi uh ahisihleh, theimi ling a pat mei hing pawt henlen Lebanon muol a Sidar sing zousie katum sieng heh achi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tuaziehin, tuin dihtah leh ginum tah a Abimelek na leengpa ding ua bawl na hi ua, tualeh Jerubaal leh a innkuonpite tunga hoitah a gamta a, anasep dantoh kituoh dungzui a bawl nahi u’leh;"},"17":{"text":"Ka pa’n na galte uh ahing dou pieh a, ahinna taan khop in Midiante khut akipat in noute ahing hunkheta hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh tuni’n ka pa innkuonte tungah na hel ua, atapate sawmsagi tah suongpi khat tungah na that ua, na sanggampa uh ahiziehin suohnu tapa Abimelek Shekem mite tunga na leengpa dingun na bawlta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachia tunia Jerubaal leh a innkuonpite tunga thutah leh ginumtah a na gamta na hi nahpou u’leh, Abimelek tungah kipah un, tualeh Abimelek zong na tung uah kipah heh."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh tuabang ahisihleh Abimelek akipat meikuong hing pawtdoh henlen, Shekem leh Beth-Millo khuo a mite zousie katum sieng henlen, tualeh Shekem mite akipat leh Beth-Millo mite akipat in mei hing pawtdoh henlen Abimelek zong katumta heh,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Jotham atai a, Beer langah ataimanga, asanggampa Abimelek agiin ziehin khunah ateng denta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abimelek in Israelte tungah kum thum vai ahawm hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasian in Abimelek leh Shekem mite kikaal ah lungsim gilou apieng sah a, tuachi’n Shekem khuo a mite Abimelek tungah lepchie tahin a zuoutat ta uhi.","title":"Shekem sietna"},"24":{"text":"Tuakhu Jerubaal tapa sawm sagite tunga chizat huoi tah a atatsiet zieh ua, atung ua phubalahna ahing tun theina ding leh amauh thatpa asanggampa uh Abimelek tung leh asanggamte that dinga ana kithuopi Shekem mite tunga asisan maw uh aum theina ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Shekem khuo a miten muolvumte ah ama buhdap a lamtaan dingin mite akoi ua, khuna pei poumate ana suom zel uhi; tuachi’n tua thute Abimelek ahil uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Ebed tapa Gaal khu a unaute toh ahing kuon ua, Shekem khuo ah alut ua, Shekem mite zousie in ama amuong uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n lou langah ava pei ua, a grep gate uh alou ua, achil ua, ane un adawn ua, a pasien innte uah alut ua, guolnop abawl ua, Abimelek awsie alawkhum uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ebed tapa Gaal in, “Abimelek nachi uh koi ahiei? Shekem kichi zong koi ahiei? eiten anna isep pieh phuat ding? Jerubaal tapa hibou lou ahiei mah? Zebul houtupa hilou ahiei mah? Shekem pa Hamor lawite nna semlei asih diei? bang ziehin ama nna isem ding uoi."},"29":{"text":"Tam mipite ka khut nuoi ah umta mai u’leh aw! tuachi’n Abimelek pen ladoh mai ding hi vengin, achi hi. Tuachi’n aman Abimelek kungah na galkapte khawm inlen kidou dingin hing kuon in” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Khum khopi a vaihawmpa Zebul in, Ebed tapa Gaal thu gen azahin, alungthahna thakhat in ahing souta a."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh pilkheltahin Abimelek kungah thangkou mi adap sawl a; “Ngaiin, Ebed tapa Gaal leh a unaute Shekem ah ahing kuon ua, tualeh ngaiin nangma dou dingin khopi mite ahantawh uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, azan azan in hing kisa unlen nang leh na kunga na umpite hing kuon unlen gam lah ah nabuh un."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahi dinga, zingmawng ni suoh pat tahin na kipan pai inlen khopi sung hing sim in; tualeh ngaiin ama leh amipi akunga umte nang doudinga ahing kuondoh chiengun hoinasah bang bangin atung uah na nabawl mai ding hi,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abimelek leh amipi zousie azan azan in athou ua, pawl li-in akikhen ua, Shekem khuo a imta uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Ebed tapa Gaal ava pawtdoh a, khopi lutna kulkotpi phungah ava dinga, tuatahin Abimelek leh agalkapte aki butna ua kipat ahing kuondoh ua."},"36":{"text":"Gaal in amutahin Zebul kungah “En un, muolvum akipat in mipite ahing peisuh uhi,” achi hi. Hinanleh Zebul in akungah “muol himte khu mihing banga namu khat hiva” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gaal in, “Envawi, gamlaizang ah mipi ahing peisuh uhi, pawl dang khatte phunsante gangpi sing lang manawin ahing pei uhi” achi kia hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zebul in akungah, Abimelek koi ahia ana isep pieh ding uh? chia na genna “Nakam hei a umta ahiei? Tamte hilou amah na mi simmawte? Tun kuon inlen vadou ngut ve,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gaal in Shekem mite alamkai a, Abimelek toh ava kidouta uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh Abimelek in ama anadel a, ama ana taimanga, ataina lam uah khopi lutna kulpi kotphung dongin mi tampi liem le bai in apua zengzung uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abimelek khu Arumah khuo ah atengta a, tualeh Zebul in Gaal leh a unaute Shekem a teng theilou dingin adeldoh ta hi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, azing ni’n mipite lou langah apei ua, Abimelek ahil uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n amipite azawpi a, pawlthum in akhen a tualeh gamlah ah ana buh uhi. Tualeh a en a, mipite khopi akipat a hing pawtdoh uh amutahin, adingdoh a ana dou ua athatta uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh Abimelek leh alawiten mailam nawt in adel zel ua, khopi lutna kulpi kotphungah ava ding ua, tualeh pawldang nite’n gamlah a umte abawin abawthaw ua, athatta uhi."},"45":{"text":"Khum ni’n Abimelek in khopi khu sun nitumin adou a, khopi ala a, asunga um mi zousie athatgam a, tualeh khopi asusie dimdem hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n Shekem kulpi a um mi zousie’n tua thu azah tah un, El-Berith pasien biehinn dettah sung ah alutta uhi."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh Shekem kulpi a um mi zousie akikhawm khawmta uh chi’n Abimelek ahil uhi."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh Abimelek leh akunga um zousie Zalmon muol ah akaltou ua, Abimelek in heipi khat akeng a, singba khat asatkhie a, aliengkou ah apuo-a, tualeh akunga um mite kungah, “Ka bawl dan namu uhi, ka bawl bang bangin nouten zong kintah in bawl un,” achi hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi zousien khumbangmain singba asatkhe chiet ua, Abimelek azui ua, kulpi dettah ah asepkhawm ua, tualeh kulpi khu mei in ahal khumta ua, tuachi’n Shekem kulpi a um mi zousie ashi siengta uhi, pasal leh numei tul khat vel ahi uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tuazouin Abimelek Thebez khuo ah ava pei a, Thebez a im khum ua, alata hi.","title":"Abimelek shina"},"51":{"text":"Hinanleh khum khopi sungah, kulpi innsang dettah khat a um a, tualeh khum kulpi sungah mi zousie anu apa atailut ua, akikhakhumta uhi, tualeh khum kulpi innsang sungah a umkhawmta uhi."},"52":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abimelek kulpi langah apei a, akidoupi a tualeh mei a haltum sawm in kulpi kotkhah lam zuon in apeita hi."},"53":{"text":"Hinanleh numei khat in bu hehna suong atunglam khat Abimelek lutung zawn ah akhiehkhum a, tuachi’n alugu akehta hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 11.21"},"54":{"text":"Tuatahin agalvan tawipa tangval khat a hanpai a, akungah, “Na namsau doh inlen hing that in, miten numei in athatta achilouna dingin” achi hi. Tuachi’n tangvalpa’n a asun pailet a, ashita hi."},"55":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelten Abimelek ashita chi amu bep un, michin a inn lang chiet uh zuon in apeita uhi."},"56":{"text":"Abimelek in asanggamte sawm sagi atha a apa tunga atatsietnate ziehin Pasian in tambangin athuhta hi."},"57":{"text":"Tualeh Shekem khomite tatsietna zousie khu Pasian in amauh lutung chiet mama ah athuh ta hi; tualeh Jerubaal tapa Jotham samsietna awsie khu ama uh tung ah atungta hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abimelek shinua in Israelte hunkhe dingin Issakar nam a mi Dodo tapa, Puah tapa Tola, ahing kipandoh a, tualeh amapen Ephraim singtang gam a Shamir kichi khuo ah ateng hi.","title":"Tol a vaihawmtu sagina"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aman Israelte tungah kum sawmni leh kum thum vai ahawma, tuachi’n ashi a, Shamir khuo ah avuita uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ama nua in Gilead mi Jair ahing kipan doh a, tuachi’n Israelte tungah kum sawmni leh kumni vai ahawm hi.","title":"Jair vaihawmtu gietna"},"4":{"text":"Aman tapa sawmthum, sabiltungnou tunga tuong zel anei a, tualeh amauten khopi sawm thum anei ua, tuate tuni dongin Havoth-Jair akichi hi, tuate Gilead gam sunga um ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jair ashita a, Kamon khuo ah avui uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten Mangpa mitmu in silgilou abawl kiata ua, tualeh Baalte, Ashtorethte, Siriate pasiente, Sidonte pasiente, Moabte pasiente, Ammon mite pasiente, leh Philistinte pasiente nna asemta ua, tuachi’n Mangpa aleengatsan ua, a nna zong asep pieh ta sih uhi.","title":"Nuoisiena leh saltaanna guhna"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte tungah Mangpa lungthahna akuongdohta a, tuachi’n Aman Philistinte leh Ammon mite khut ah azuata hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh khumi kum apat in, Israel tate asubuoi ua, anuoisie ua, asugenthei mama uhi. Jordan gal a Gilead gam a Amorte gamsunga Israel tate zousie kum sawm leh kum giet sung nuoisie in abawlgenthei mama uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Ammon mite zong Judate, Benjaminte leh Ephraim innkuonte dou dingin Jordan agalkai ua, tuachi’n Israel tate buoi chitahin abuoiseta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten I Pasian uh ina leengatsanta ngut ua, Baalte nna iseppieh ziehun “Atungah ina bawlkhielta uhi; chiin Mangpa kunga kikou in ahanta uhi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Israeltate kungah, “Izipt mite leh Amormite lah a kipat, tualeh Ammon mite leh Philistin mipite lah akipat in noute ka hing hundoh asiei mah?"},"12":{"text":"Sidon mite, Amalek mite leh Maonmiten zong noute ahing bawl genthei ua, tuachi’n nang han ua, tuachi’n akhut ua kipat in ka hing hundoh hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten nangle ngatsan ua, pasien dangte nna nasem zawta uhi; tuaziehin ka hing hundoh nawn sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Pei unlen na pasien deitelte uh han ve uo, amaun na buoi hun chiengun hing hundohleh asih diei,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuabepin Israel taten Mangpa kungah, “Sil kana bawlkhielta uhi. Nangman hoi nasah bangbang in ka tung uah bawl mai inlen; kang ngen uhi, tutung beeh hing hundam teitei in,” achi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n alah ua namdang pasiente akoimang sieng ua, Mangpa nna asemta uhi. Tualeh Israelte gentheinate Alungsim Hagauin athuoh zou nawnta sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ammonmite akikhawm khawm ua, Gilead ah panmun akhaw uhi. Tualeh Israel tate zong akikhawm khawm ua, Mizpah khuo ah panmun akhawta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh mipite, Gilead gam lamkaite khat leh khat akihou ua, “Ammon mite dou masa dinga kuon ding koi ahiei? Gilead gam a tengte zousie tungah lamkai in apang ding” achi uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tuin Gilead mi Jephthah khu mihat, hangsan ahia, hinanleh ama khu kizuanu tapa ahia; tualeh Jephthah pa Gilead ahi.","title":"Jephthah kinua hatna"},"2":{"text":"Gilead zi in tapate ahin pieh a, tuachi’n azi tapate ahing khanglien ua, Jephthah khu anotdoh ua, tuachi’n akungah, “Nangpen numei tuom tapa na hi ziehin ipa innsungah gou naluo thei sih ding hi,” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jephthah a unaute akipat in ataimang a, Tob gam ah atengta hi. Tualeh Jephthah kungah mithulimlou ngentang ateng khawm ua, ama a zuizel uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, Hun phabeppi zou in Ammon miten Israelte adouta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, Ammon miten Israelte adou tahun, Gilead upate, Tob gam a um Jephthah vala ding in akuonta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Jephthah kungah, “Hing pei inlen ka gallamkai dingun hing pangin; Ammon mite kadou theina dingun,” achi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jephthah in Gilead upate kungah, “Kei na hing muda ua, ka pa inn akipata nang nawdoh uh hilou ahiei mah? Bangchidan a tua na buoi bep chieng ua, ka kunga hing pei nahi uoi?” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Gilead upaten Jephthah kungah, “Tuaziehtah ahi tu a na kunga ka hing pei kiana uh, Ammon mite dou dingin ka lah uah hing pei inlen, Gilead gam a teng mi zousie tunga vaihawma na hing pan theina dingin,” achi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jephthahin Gilead upate kungah, “Ammon mite dou dinga inn langa nahing zawpi kia ua, tuachia Mangpa’n amauh ka khut a ahing pieh leh na tung ua vaihawm in ka pang tahtah na diei?” a chi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Gilead upaten Jephthah kungah, “Mangpa khu ikikaal thu uh theipipa hiheh, na thu bangbang in ka bawl ngeingei ding uhi,” achi ua."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jephthah khu Gilead upate toh azawhta a; tuachi’n mipiten atung ua vaihawm ding leh lamkai dingin ana bawlta uhi. Tualeh Jephthah in Mizpah khuo ah Mangpa mai ah thu zousie agenta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin Jephthah in Ammon mite leengpa kungah, “Bang dinga ka tunga bang lungdam louna nei a, ka gamsung doudinga hing kuon mawh na hiei?” chia gen dingin mi asawl hi.","title":"Jephthah vaihawm kuona"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Ammon mite leeng pa’n, Jephthah misawlte kungah, “Israelte Izipt gam a kipat ahing pei laiun ka gam Arnon akipat Jabbok tandong leh Jordan donga alah zieh uh ahi. Tuaziehin tuin lungkim tahin khum gamte hing nua pieh kia maiin,” chi’n ana dawng hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Jephthah in, Ammon mite leengpa kungah mi asawl kia a;"},"15":{"text":"tualeh akung ah “Tambangin Jephthahin agen hi; Israelten Moab gam alahpieh sih ua, Ammon mite gam zong alahpieh sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Israelte Izipt akipat ahing pawtdoh laiun, tuipi san leh Kadesh tandong gamdai zui in ahing pei zaw uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelten Edom leengpa kungah, hepitahin na gamsung zui in hing pei suohsahin, chi a gen dingin palai asawl ua, hinanleh Edom leengpa’n ana phalpieh sih hi. Tualeh khumbangmain Moab leengpa kungah asawl kia a, hinanleh ama’n zong ana phalpieh kia sih hi, tuaziehin Israelte Kadesh ah aumdenta uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 20.14-21"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamdai ah apei suoh ua, Edom gam leh Moab gam kimvel in apei kuol ua, Moab gam suolam pangah apei ua, Arnon lelam pangah giehphuol abawl ua, Moab gamsungah vang alut sih uhi. Arnon khu Moab gamgi lah ahi ngal a.","ref":"Kisim. 21.4"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelten Amor mite leengpa Heshbon a vaihawmpa Sihon kungah palai asawl kia ua, Israel taten akungah, ka mun lam ua ka peina dingun hepitahin na gam zawt in hing pei suoh sahin ava chi sah uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 21.21-24"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Sihon in Israelte khu agamsung zawta apei suoh ding uh amuongzou sih hi. Tuachi’n Sihon in amite zousie kaikhawm in Israelte dou dingin Jahaz mun ah panmun ana bawl ua, Israelte adouta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa Israelte Pasian in Sihon leh amite zousie Israelte khut ah apekheta a, tuachi’n amauh athat ua, tuachi’n Israelten khum gam a teng Amor mite gam zousie atang siengta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Amormite gam zousie Arnon akipat Jabbok dong leh gamdai akipat Jordan lui tandong atangta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin Mangpa Israelte Pasian in ami Israelte masangah Amormite alahpieh a, nang amauh na tang ding amah?"},"24":{"text":"Na pasien Kemosh in na tan dinga na kunga ahing pieh khu tanglou ding na mah? Tualeh Mangpa ka Pasian un ka masang ua kipata anawdoh koipou gam khu ka tang zel uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh tuin, nang Moab leengpa Zippor tapa Balak sangin na hoizaw ei mah? Aman Israelte tohbuoi in adou ngam ngai amah?","ref":"Kisim. 22.1-6"},"26":{"text":"Israelte Heshbon leh akhoneute, Aroer leh akhoneute tualeh Arnon luipanga khopi lien um zousie a kum zathum sung na teng uh hitalou ahiei mah? bang dinga khum hun sunga na nua lahlou na hiei?"},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin na tungah bangma ka bawlkhiel sih hi; Hinanleh nang hingdou na tup ziehin ka tungah na bawlkhiel zaw hi. Mangpa vaihawmpain tuni’n Israel tate leh Ammon mite kaal ah thukhen heh achi hi” achi sah hi."},"28":{"text":"Bangtenghileh, Ammon mite leengpa’n Jephthah mi sawlte thugente ana thusim pieh sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa Hagau Jephthah tungah ahing tunga, tualeh Gilead leh Manasseh gam apalsuoh a, Gilead gam a Mizpah ah apei suoh a, tuachi’n Gilead gam Mizpah akipat in ma asawn zel a, Ammon mite gam atungta hi.","title":"Jephthah kichiemna chizat huoi"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Jephthah in Mangpa kungah “Thuchiem abawla, Ammon mite ka khut a nang pieh tah tah a ahileh,"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahiding hi, Ammon mite kunga kipat a galmuonga innlam zuona ka hing kile kia hun chienga, ka inn kotpi a kipata kei hing dawn dinga hing pei masa penpen Mangpa a ahi dinga, tualeh halmang kithoina’n ka lan ngeingei ding hi,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jephthah khu Ammon mite dou dingin akuon ta a, tualeh Mangpa’n amaute akhut ah apedohta hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Aroer apat in Minnith tandongin aguolzou zel a, khopi lien sawm ni ah gal azou a, tualeh Abel Keramim dongah thupitah in athat uhi. Tambangin Ammon mite khu Israelte masangah guollel in a umta uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Jephthah khu Mizpah a atenna inn a ahing tun tahin, Ngaivawi atanu khuongta toh lam kawmin ama dawn dingin ahing pawtdoh a, ata khattang nei sun ahia, amanu chilou tanu ahiei tapa ahiei, dang mawng mawng anei sih hi.","title":"Jephthah tanu latna"},"35":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, amanu amutahin, apuonte abotkeh a, “Ka dei ka tanu hing suneu va-ia teichie izaw, ka buoina thupi khat na hita hi. Aziehkhu Mangpa kungah thu kana chiem khata hi, tualeh ka nualah kia thei tasih hi;” achi hi.","ref":"Kisim. 30.2"},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n akungah, Pa “Mangpa kunga nana kichiem taahleh, na kama thupawt bangbangin ka tungah bawlmai in, Mangpa’n na galte Ammon mite tung ngei ah phuba alata hi” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n apa kungah “Tambangin hing bawl piehin; hani sung keima tangin hing umsah inlen, taangte a ka pei a ka vah kawi theina dingin, tualeh nungah sieng thou ka hina ka suun ding hi, kei leh ka lawmte toh,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n “Va pei in,” achi a, tuachi’n amanu hani sung tham dingin asawl kheta hi. Tuachi’n akhanguolte toh apei ua, taang tungte ah a nungah siengthou hina ava suun uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, hani achin zou in amanu khu apa kungah ahing kile kia a, tuachi’n apa’n ana kichiemna dung zui in, amanu tungah abawlta hi. Amanu khu nungah siengthou ahia, pasal koiman alup khawmpi ngai sih uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte lah ah Israel tanu ten, Gilead mi Jephthah tanu kum chinin nili sung asuun zel uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Ephraim mite akihan khawm ua, Zephon gam kantan in ang pei ua, Jephthah kungah, “Bang dinga koute hing chiellou a, Ammon mite dou dinga ka gam uh Kantan a pei na hi uoi? Na inn utoh ka hing buhal ding uhi,” achi uhi.","title":"Ephraimte thangsietna ni na"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Jephthah in akung uah, “Kei leh ka miten theitawp suo a Ammon mite kadou ua ka hing thuhah laiin, akhut ua kipat nang hundoh sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n na hing hundoh nuom sih uh chi ka thei tahin, shi ki it vawtlou in ka panga, Ammon mite dou dingin ka kuon a, tuachi’n Mangpa’n amauh ka khut ah ahing peta hi, tuaziehin bangdinga ahing dou dinga hing kuon na hi uoi?” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin Jephthah in Gilead mi zousie ahankhawm a, Ephraimte ava douta hi, tualeh Gilead miten Ephraimte tha chitahin athat uhi, “Nou Gilead mite apat taimang Ephraimte leh Manasseh te lah a kisim tel maimai, Nam mangthang nahi uh achi zieh uh ahi.”"},"5":{"text":"Gilead miten Ephraim mite tun masangin Jordan lui gal kaina mun ana lata ua, “Ephraim mi daptaiten hing galkai vang” achi chiengun, Gilead miten akungah, “Ephraim mi na hiei” chi’n ana dong zel ua, “Ka hisih” achi leh;"},"6":{"text":"Akungah “Shibboleth chi vawileh” achi ua, tualeh ama’n “Sibboleth” ana chizaw zel a, alaw chien siem thei lou ziehin aman ua, Jordan luigal kaina mun ah athat zel uhi. Tua tungin khum mun ah Ephraim mite tul sawm li leh tul ni athat uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jephthahin kumguh sung Israelte tungah vai ahawm hi. Tuachi’n Gilead mi Jephthah ashita, tualeh Gilead gam a khopi khat ah avuita uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh ama nua in Bethlehem khopi a um Ibzan in vai ahawm hi","title":"Ibzan vaihawmtu sawmna"},"9":{"text":"Aman tapa sawm thum anei a. Tualeh a tanu sawm thumte gamdangah pasal neiin asawl a, tualeh atapa sawmthumte a dingin, midangte tanute mou in alalut hi. Aman kum sagi sung Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ibzan ashita a, Bethlehem ah avui uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh ama nua in, Zebulun mi Elon in Israelte tungah vai ahawma, tuachi’n aman Israelte tungah kumsawm sung vai ahawm hi","title":"Elon vaihawmtu sawm leh khatna"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zebulun mi Elon ashita a, tualeh Zebulun gam a Aijalon khuo ah avuita uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh ama nua in, Pirathon mi Hilel tapa Abdon in Israelte tungah vai ahawm hi.","title":"Abdon vaihawmtu sawm leni na"},"14":{"text":"Aman tapa sawmli leh tupa sawm thum, sabiltungnou tunga tuongzel anei hi. Aman kum giet sung Israelte tungah vai ahawm hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pirathon mi Hilel tapa Abdon ashita a, Ephraim gam a Pirathon khuo ah Amalek mite taangah avuita uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Mangpa mitmu in silgilou ana bawl kiata ua, tuachi’n Mangpa’n amaute Philistin mite khut ah kum sawm li sung a aum sahta hi.","title":"Suoh leh sal a taanna sagina leh Samson pienthu"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Zorah khuo a um Dan inn kuon mi khat a um a, amin khu Manoah ahi, azi achiinga ta anei sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa vansawlsieng numeinu kungah “Ahing kilah a, akungah ngai in, tuin na chiinga, nau navop ngai sih a ta zong nanei sih hi, hinanleh nagai dinga tapa khat nanei ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin, tuin pilvang inlen, uoin leh akibahpi khamthei mawngmawng dawn sinlen, tualeh sil sienglou mawngmawng zong ne sin."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen ngai in na gai dinga, tapa nanei ding hi, tualeh alu tungah samheuna bahte mawngmawng zah ahi sih dinga, naupang pen anu sunga a um a kipat in Pasian a dingin Nazir mi ahi dinga, aman Philistin mite khuta kipat Israelte hundamna a pan ding hi.”","ref":"Kisim. 6.1-5"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n numei ava pei a apasal kungah, “Pasian mi khat ka kungah ahing pei a, amel umdan khu Pasian vansawlsieng mel asun a, giin huoitah ahi, hinanleh heilanga hing kipan ahiei chi ka dong vateh sih a, aman zong amin ahing hil tuom sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh ka kungah, ngai in nagai dinga, tapa na nei dinga, tuachi’n uoin leh akibahpi khamthei mawngmawng dawn sinlen neh sienglou sil mawngmawng zong ne vawt sin naupang pen naubu sunga aum lai a kipat in ashi dongin Pasian adinga Nazir mi ahi ding ziehin, achi hi,” chi’n ava gen hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Manoah in “Mangpa kungah tambangin angen ta a, Aw ka Mangpa, Pasian mi nahing sawl pen khu hepitahin ka kung uah hing peikia henlen, ahing pieng ding naupang khu bang kalaw ding uh ahiei, chi hinghil heh,” a chi hi.","title":"Manoah ngetna"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in Manoah thunget angaikhie a, tualeh numeinu khu loulai a atou laiin akungah Pasian vansawlsieng ahing peikia a, apasal Manoah akungah aum sih hi;"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n numeinu kintahin atai pai a, apasal avahil a, akungah “En in, khatvei nia ka kunga hing pei mipa khu ka kungah ahing kilah kia hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Manoah adingdoh a azi azui a, khum mipa kung ava tung ua, akungah, “Nang na hiei, tam numei kunga thugen pa?” achi a, Tualeh aman “Keima ka hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Manoah in, “Na thu bangzelin hing umta hen, naupang um dingdan bang chibang ahi diei? asep ding bang ahi diei?” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa vansawlsieng in Manoah kungah, “Numei kunga ka thugen zousie tungtangah pilvangta hen."},"14":{"text":"Grep guia kipata sil kisiemdoh mawngmawng numei nu’n aneh ding ahi sih a, uoin leh akibahpi khamthei mawngmawng adawn sih dinga, sil sienglou mawngmawng zong ane sih ding hi. Akunga thu kapieh zousie pilvang tah in vom heh,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Manoah in Mangpa vansawlsieng kungah, “Hepitahin ka hing hou ding uhi, nanga dinga kelnou khat kang bawl pieh zou masang sie uh na um tadi in,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa Vansawlsieng in Manoah kungah, “Hing hou nanlachin zong na ann kane sih ding, tualeh halmang sillat a nalat ding ahi leh Mangpa kunga nalat ding ahi,” achi hi. Manoah in lah Ama Mangpa vansawlsieng ahilam athei sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Manoah in Mangpa vansawlsieng kungah, “Na min bang ahiei? na thugente ahing tangtun chienga ka hing pahtawi theina dingun,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa vansawlsieng in akungah, “Sillamdang munapi a, Bang dinga ka min nang doh ahiei?” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Manoahin tua kelnou neh ding sillat toh ala a, suongpi tungah Mangpa kungah alan a, tualeh vansawlsieng in sillamdang tah a bawlta a, tuakhu Manoah leh azi in a enden uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, maitam apat meikuong vanlam a apei tou laiin, Mangpa vansawlsieng khu maitam a meikuong lah ah akaltou tahi. Tualeh Manoah leh azi in tua khu a en ua, tualeh tuol leh amai uh sutuo in apuata uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachia Mangpa vansawlsieng khu Manoah leh azi kunga akilah nawnlou tahin, Manoah in Mangpa vansawlsieng ahi chi atheita hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Manoah in azi kungah, “Pasian imu ziehin shi teitei ding ihi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n azi in akungah, “Mangpa’n tha hing tum hileh ikhut apat a halmang sillat leh neh ding sillat ilatte asang nuom sih dinga, tualeh tambang silte zong ahing hil sam sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum numei in tapa anei a, amin ding in Samson aphuo uhi. Tualeh naupang khu ahing khang lien a, Mangpa’n a guolzawl hi.","title":"Samson pienna"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa Hagau in ama khu Zorah leh Eshtaol kikal a Mahaneh Dan mun ah ahing thahat sah panta hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Samson khu Timnah khuo ah apei suh a, tualeh Timnah ah Philitia tanute lah a khat ava mu ta hi.","title":"Samson vaihawmtu sawmlethumna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahing peitou kia in anu leh apa ahila, akung uah, “Timnah khuo ah Philistinte tanute lah a mi numei khat kava mu a, ka zi dingin hing va lah pieh un,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n anu leh apan akungah, “Na unaute tanute lah ahiei ahisihleh ka chi leh namte zousie lah ah numei umlou ahiei mah, teptanlou Philistinte lah a zi ding nava sui laizang?” achi ua. Tualeh Samson in apa kungah, “Hing valah pieh mai un, amanu’n kalung atuoh mama hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh anu leh apaten khum khu Pasian a kipata hing kuon ahilam leh Philistin mite tunga hunlem asui ahilam athei sih uhi, khum hunlai in Philistin miten Israelte tungah vai ahawm uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samson anu leh apa toh Timnah khuo ah ahaw suh ua, Timnah khuo a grep huon ahing tung ua, tualeh ngai in humpibahnei khat in ana ngih hi.","title":"Samson leh Humpibahnei"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa hagau khu thupitahin atungah ahing tunga, tuachi’n kelnou malnen bang maiin amalnen thopa, akhut ah bangma atawi sih hi. Hinanleh asil bawl anu leh apa ahil sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh apeisuh a, khum numei toh ava houlim uhi, tualeh amanu’n Samson lung asu mama hi."},"8":{"text":"Hun tomkhat nuain amanu vala ding in akuon kia a, tualeh humpibahnei luong en dingin lampam ah apiel a, tualeh ngaiin humpibahnei shiluong sung ah khuoikai leh azu ana um a."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n khum khu ala a, apei kawm in ane a, tualeh anu leh apa kung ahing tuntahin, ama u’zong apie a, tuachi’n amaun zong ane uhi. Hinanleh tua khuoizu khu humpibahnei shiluong sung apat alah ahi chi ahil sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n apa numeinu kungah ava haw suh a, tualeh Samson in annkuong luina abawla, tua khu tangvalte bawldan ngaina ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, ama amu tahun, ama toh umkhawm dingin lawmleguol sawmthum ahing zawpi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samson in akung uah, “Tuin thuhasa khat ka hing donga, pawi bawl ni sagi sunga, na theidoh thei ua, nang hilchien thei u’leh, tuachi’n puonmalngat zal sawm thum leh kihenna puon sawm thum ka hing pe ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh nang hilchien thei sih u’leh, puonmalngat zal sawm thum leh kihenna puon sawm thum kei na hing pieh ding uh ahi,” achi hi. “Na thu hasa hing gen vawile, na ngaikhe va ung,” achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah; “Netu akipat neh ding hing pawt, Tualeh hattah akipat sil humtah hing pawt chi khu ahi,” achi hi. Tualeh nithum sungin tua thuhasa ahilchien thei tasih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, ani sagi niin Samson zi kungah, “Thuhasa ka kung ua hing hilchien dingin na pasal na zawlin, tua-ahisihleh nang leh napa innkuonte mei in ka hing haltum ding uhi. Ka sil neite uh lah pieh dinga na hing chiel ahiei mah?” achi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samson zi’n amasangah kap kawm in, “Kei nang it sih a, ahing muda nana hi zaw hi, ka mite kungah thuhasa na donga, kei kungah lah ahilchienna bangma nagen sih a,” achi hi. Tualeh aman “Ngaiin ka nu leh ka pa zong ka hil sih hi, nang kang hil mai ding amah?” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n a pawi bawl uh ni sagi sungteng amai ah akap zinga, tualeh ani sagi niin hichi ahing hi a, anget nget vanguo ziehin ahil khong khongta hi, tualeh amanu’n thuhasa khu amite kungah ahilsawnta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n ni sagini nitum masangin khum khuo a miten akungah; “Khuoizu sanga hum zaw bang ahiei? Tualeh humpibahnei sanga hatzaw bang ahiei?” achi uhi. Tualeh aman akung uah, “Ka bawnglain lou kai sih ulachin, ka thuhasa theikhe zoulou ding hive uchin,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa Hagau thupitahin ahing tunga, tuachi’n Ashkelon khuo ah apei suh a, mi sawmthum athat a apuon sil uh ahawh khietpieh a, thuhasa akhieh na hilchien mi sawmthumte kungah kihenna puonsil sawm thum toh apeta hi. Tuachi’n lungthah sengseng in apa inn langah apeitou ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Samson zi khu akigoppi pa, a kiten ni ua lawm a azah pa kungah pieh in a um ta hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hun tomkhat nua in, bu lah hun laiin, Samson in kelnou khat tawi in azi ava ve a; “Tualeh aman ka zi umna pindan sungah kava lut ding achi hi,” Hinanleh apa’n alut aphal tasih hi.","title":"Samson vaihawmna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh apa’n akungah, “Amanu na muda tahtah hiva ka chia; tuaziehin na lawmpa kana peta hi, anaunu ama sangin a mel hoizaw hilou ahiei mah? Hepitahin amanu taangin pui maiin,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Samson in akung ah; “Tutungin Philistin mite sietna bawl nanleeng siemmaw ka tang sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samson ava kuon a, Si-al zathum ava man a, meisel ala a, si-alte amei lam chiet uh akingatuo sah a, amei u’leh amei uh ape khawma, ameite uh kikaal chiet ah meisel akoi chiet a.","title":"Si-al leh meisel"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh meiselte mei a ahal chiet tahin si-alte khu Philistinte bu at nailou lah ah atailut sah a, buphai leh bu dinglaite leh grep huon leh Olive huonte nangawn toh akatum siengta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistinten “Koi bawl ahiei?” achi ua, tualeh amaun “Timnah khuote mahpa Samson, azi alah pieh ua alawmpa kunga apieh zieh ua abawl ahi” chiin adawng ua, tuachi’n Philistinte akipan ua, amanu leh apa meiin ahalta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Samson in akung uah, “Tambangin bawl nan ulachin zong na tung uah phuba ka la veve nalai diing hi, tuazou chiengin ka tawp ding,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n chin leh ha toh pang in ava dou a, mi tampi ava that hi; tuachi’n apei suh a, Etam suongpi tetuo kal hawm ah ava umta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh, tuin Philistinte avakuontou ua, Juda gam ah panmun abawl ua, tualeh Lehi mun ah akijeeh uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Juda miten “Bang dinga kou dou dinga hing kuon na hi uoi?” achi uhi. Tuachi’n amaun akung uah, “Samson man dinga hing kuon kahi uh, aman ang bawl bang banga, bawl dinga hing kuon ka hi uh,” chiin adawng uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda mi tul thum Etam suongpi kawmah ava pei ua, Samson kungah, “Philistinte itung ua vaihawm ahi uh chi theilou na hiei mah?” bang dinga ka tung ua “Tambanga na hingbawl ahiei?” achi ua. Tualeh aman ahing bawl bang bang ua, atung ua ka bawl ahizaw hi, achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Philistinte kunga, “Ka hing pieh theina ding ua, nangma hing man dinga hing kuon kahi uh” achi ua. Tualeh Samson in akung uah “Nouten hing that lou dingin kichiem un,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh amaun akungah “That lou e, hinanleh ka hing kaan ding ua, akhut uah ka hing pe ding uhi. Kouten ka hing that sih ding uhi,” achi uhi. Tualeh amauten khauhuol tha in akaan ua suongpi apat in a zawpi touta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Khuchia Lehi mun ahing tun in, Philistinten ana kikou khum ua, Tualeh Mangpa Hagau atungah lamdang tahin ahing tunga, tuachi’n aban a akanna khauhuolte uh la ip khau mei in akahtan bangin akitan a, akhut a akaanna uh khauhuol zousie atat a akiphelkhe sieng ta hi.","title":"Samson in Philistinte tulkhat athana"},"15":{"text":"Samson in sabiltung khagu tha khat amu a, akhut a zam in ala a, khumi zangin mi tul khat asat lia tahi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samson in, “Sabiltung khagu in singsie suongsie in kasie vum hi;” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahia, thu agen zouin sa khagu atawi khu apaidoh a, Khum mun khu Ramath Lehi achita hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n adang ata mama a, tuachi’n ki kou in Mangpa ahan a, akungah “Na suohpa khutah hundamna thupitah na pie a, tualeh tuin dangta a shi ding kahi a, tuin teptanloute khuta pualut kia ding kahita amaah?” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in Lehi mun a leihawm akhipawh sah a tuanah tui ahing pulta, tualeh khum tui adawn tahin alungsim ahing navah a, atha ahing kiham kiata a, tuaziehin khum mun min En-Hakkore achita hi. Tua khu tuni dongin Lehi ah a um nalai hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistinte hun lai in Israelte tungah kum sawmni sung vai ahawm hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samson Gaza khuo ah ava haw a, khunah numei kizua khat amu a, ava luppi ta hi.","title":"Samson in Gaza kotpi apuohmangna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh “Samson tanah ahing pei hi,” chi’n Gaza khomite ava hil ua, tuachi’n a im khumta ua, khopi kul kotkha zousie ah zan tungtawn in abuh ua, “Zankhovah in asip dingdeng hi, zingmawng khuo ahing vah chiengin that navei” akichi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Samson zankim tan alum a; tualeh zankim laiin athou a, khopi kul kotkhah leh akhuom nite abotdoh a, akilnate pum in abotdoh a, aliengkou ah apuo a, Hebron toh kimai ngat muolvum ah apotou ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Khum nua in hichi ahing hi a, Sorek phai ah numei khat amin Delilah kichi nu angai a.","title":"Samson leh Delilah"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Philistin miliente amanu kungah ahing pei ua, akungah “Ama ka zaw ua, ka kantom thei ua, ka bawl gentheina dingun, ahatna hei a bangchi um ahiei, chi theina dingin na zawl in; tuachi’n mi khat in dangka tul leh zakhat chiet ka hing peding uhi,” achi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Delilah in Samson kungah, “Hepitahin hing hil ve, na hatna zieh bang ahiei, heisunga bangchi um ahiei? bawl genthei dinga ahing hentom theina dingun,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Samson in amanu kungah, “Khauhuol gaw nailou zam sagi’n hing kaan u’lachin, tuachi’n hat nawn sih vangin, midangte bangin ka umta ding hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin milienten khauhuol agaw nailou zam sagi ang tawi ua, tuachi’n amanu’n khum khauhuolte’n ana kaanta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin innsung tawnga pindan ah aguhin mi a um sah hi. Tuachi’n amanu’n Samson kungah “Philistin mite hing pei e, Samson” achi hi, tualeh aman tua khauhuolte khu vaukhau mei in akah tan bang giap in abottan siengta hi. Tuaziehin athahatna thuguh athei zou sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Delilah in Samson kungah, “Ngai in, nang kei nang mot bawla, zuou nang hil hi. Hepitahin tuin hing hil in, bangchileh hentom a um thei ding na hiei,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh aman amanu kungah, “Zah ngainai mawngmawng lou khauhuolte in hing kaan u’leh ka hat nawn sih dinga, midangte ka bang mai ding hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Delilah in khauhuol tha lihleh ala a, akaanta a, akungah “Philistinte hing pei uh e, Samson” achi hi. Tualeh innsung tawnga pindan sungah abuh dapte aum uhi. Tuachi’n vaukhau bawtan bang mai in akhut apat in atan siengta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Delilah in Samson kungah, “Tutan in nang mot bawl nalai a, zuou ngen nang hil nalai hi, kaan a na um theina ding bang ahiei hinghil in, achi hi. Tualeh aman amanu kungah “Ka sampheh lom sagi puontoh gaankhawm lachin,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n dettahin asiem toh agatkhuma, tuhkil in dettahin akil a, Tualeh akungah “Philistinte hing pei uh e, Samson,” achi hi. Hinanleh imulai ahing thoudoh a, asiembu leh akilna pum in abotdoh siengta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n akungah, “Na lungsim hing pelou pia, bangchidan a ka hing it nachi thei ahiei? Tutoh thum vei nahing motbawlta a, na hatna heia um ahiei chi nang hil nuom nai sih hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hita a, nichin a aphut aphut zieh leh anget vanguo ziehin, alungsim shipi ding khopin ahing buoita hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n alungsim zousie ahil siengta a; akungah “Ka lu tungah sam heuna tem mawngmawng akizang ngai nai sih a; Kanu gilsunga ka um laia kipat in Pasian adinga Nazir mi ka hia; ka lutunga sam kiheu leh ka hatna in ahing nuasieta dinga, tuachi’n ka hat nawnsih dinga, midangte ka bangta ding hi;” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh alungsim zousie ahilta chi Delilah in athei bepin Philistin miliente ahan sah a, “Hing peitou pai un, alungsim zousie ahing hilta hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Philistin miliente akungah apeitou ua, tualeh dangka zong atawi chiet uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n apheipi tungah a i mu sahta a; tualeh mikhat ahan a, alutunga sampheh lom sagite atepkhe sahta hi. Tuachi’n amanu’n abawl genthei panta a, ahatna in anuasie ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n akungah “Philistinte hing kuon ta uh e Samson” thou in achi hi, tuachi’n a i mu lai ahing khanglou a, “Ni danga bangin, kitungdoh vangin pawtdoh naveng,” achi a, hinanleh Mangpa’n ama anuasieta chi athei sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin miten aman ua, amittang akheikhie ua, tualeh Gaza khopi ah azawpi suhta ua, sum-eng kol abun sah ua, suongkul sungah bu heh in a umta hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh alu tunga asam kiheute ahing pou pan pan kiata hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh tuin Philistin miliente a pasien uh Dagon kunga kithoina lan ding leh guolnop thupitah bawl dingin ahing kikhawm ua, tuachi’n amaun “I pasien un igalpa Samson ikhut sungah ahing pekheta,” achi uhi.","title":"Samson shina"},"24":{"text":"Mipiten ama amu tahun apasien uh aphat ua; “I pasien un igalpa leh igam, hing suh siet piehpa, mitampi tah hing thatpa i khut sung uah ahing pedohta hi,” a chi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hia, alungsim uh ahing kipah mama tah in, etnop bawl dingin “Samson va hansah un” achi uhi. Tuachi’n suongkul apat in Samson ava hankhie ua; tualeh etnop a bawl in, khuom ni kikaal ah akoi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Samson in ama kai naupangpa kung ah, “Tam inn doupen khuom nite hing tham sah in, ka kingap theina dingin,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua biehinn sungah numei pasal leh Philistin miliente zousie adim phing phengin a um ua, tualeh Samson etnop banga en mite inntung langah numei leh pasal tul thum tah a um uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh, Samson in Mangpa ahan a, “Aw Mangpa Pasian, hepitahin hing thei ngitnget inlen, tutung mai mai hing suhat inlen, Aw Pasian, ka mit langni phuba Philistin mite tunga khatvei thu a kalah theina dingin,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh, Samson in khum inn doupen sutpi nite athama, a khut ziet lam in khat apansan a, aveilamin khat."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Samson in “Philistin mite toh hing shi khawm sah in,” achi a, tualeh atheitawp a pangin asawn tuoh a, tuachi’n tua inn khu miliente leh khuna um mi zousie toh achim khawmta hi. Tuachi’n adam lai a athate sangin, ashi khumte atam zaw uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n, a unaute leh apa innkuonpite zousie ahing pei suh ua, aluong ava la ua, apotou ua, Zorah leh Eshkol kikaal a apa Manoah kivuina ah avuita uhi. Aman kum sawmni sung Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Ephraim singtang gam ah mi khat aum a, amin Mikah ahi.","title":"Mikah leh amilimte"},"2":{"text":"Aman anu kungah “Dangka tul khat leh za khat, na kunga pat a kilamang, tungtang a awsie na law khu kabil mama in kaza hi, khum dangka ka kungah aum hi, keima lah ahi,” achi hi. Tualeh “Mangpa’n hing guolzawl heh, ka tapa” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n dangka tul leh zakhat anu kungah apekia a, tualeh anu’n “Tam dangka keima khut mama in ka tapa sum tuom ding leh amilim khenna ding leh milim a asun dingin Mangpa kungah ka lan hi, tuaziehin tuin nangma kungah ka hing pe kia hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Khum dangka khu anu kungah apeta a, tuachi’n anu’n dangka zani ala a, dangka kheng mi kungah apie a, tuachi’n aman milim dingin akhenga, milim dingin ana sungta hi: tua khu Mikahinn ah a um hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua mipa Mikah in pasiente biehna inn khat anei a, ephod leh teraphim abawla, atapa khat aseptuoma, ama khu siempu ahita hi."},"6":{"text":"Khum hunlai in Israel gam ah leeng ana um nai sih a, michin ama uh hoisah dan danin agamta uhi.","ref":"Vai. 21.25"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Juda gam a Bethlehem khuo ah, Juda phung sunga um; Levi tangval khuol zin mikhat a um a."},"8":{"text":"Tua mipa khu umna ding mun suiin Bethlehem Juda khuo a pat in apawtdoh a; khuchia avah kawi kawi nalam ah Ephraim singtang gam a Mikah inn ava tung hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Mikah in akungah, “Hei a hing kipan na hiei?” achi hi. Tualeh aman akungah, “Bethlehem-Juda mi, Levi nam a mi ka hia, umna ding sui a vah kawi kawi kahi” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mikah in akungah, “Ka kungah um inlen, kei dingin ka pa leh siempuin pang inlen, kum chinin dangka sia tang shekel sawm hing pe vangin, puon sil khat leh neh leh taah dingte zong,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Levi mipa alutta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levi mipa’n khum mipa kunga um lem asata a; tuachi’n tangval pa zong atapate lah a khat bangin a umta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mikah in Levi mipa khu atuom in akoi tuomta a. Tualeh tangvalpa khu a siempuin apangta a, tuachi’n Mikah inn ah a umta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mikah in, “Tuin Levimi siempuin ka neita a, Mangpa’n ahing lamzang sah ngeingei ta ding chi ka thei hi,” achi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hunlai in Israel gam ah Leng a um sih a; tualeh, khum hunlai in Dan namten gam luo ding asui ua; tualeh khum hunlai in Israel namte lah ah gam luo ding atang nai sih uhi.","title":"Mikah leh dan namte"},"2":{"text":"Dan miten agam ua kipat in anam pumpi sung ua mi nga, pasal hat leh hangsan, Zorah leh Eshtaol akipat in gam enkhe ding leh sui dingin asawl ua; akung uah, “Vakuon unlen gam va enkhie un” achi ua; tuachi’n amauh Ephraim singtang gam a Mikah inn ava tung ua, agiehta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Mikah inn a aum laiun, Levi mi tangvalpa aw aza ua, akihei ua, akungah “Tam laitah a koi hing zawpi na hiei? Tanah bang bawl na hiei? Tam mun a bangchi ten a, bang ahiei na bawl?” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Mikah in tambangin ahing bawla, asiempu dingin ahing guoi a, tuachi’n kana pangta hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Khumin, ama un akungah, “Kava hawna ding uah ka lam zanna ding uoi chi ka thei thei na dingun hepitahin Pasian hing doh pieh dive,” achi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh siempu’n akung uah, “Lungmuong tah in peiun; na peina ding lampi uah Mangpa’n a hing umpi zel ahi,” a chi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuabepin pasal ngaten, khum mun pawtsan in, apeita ua Laish ava tungta uhi. Tualeh khuna um mite pen Sidon mite mabanga bangma phawhlou a, lungmuong tah leh bittah a um ava mu ua; khum gam ah bang thu ahiei amauh a zumsuo ding thukhen leh vaihawm a um sih a, Sidon mite akipat gamlapi a kihal ahi ua, tualeh koima toh kizopna mawngmawng anei sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zorah leh Eshtaol a aunaute uh kung ahing nua tun kia tah un, aunaute un “Bang thu na hing tun uoi?” chi’n ana dong uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akung uah, “Kisa un vakuon tou vaiin vadou vaui, khum gam kava mu ua, tualeh gam hoi mama ahi. Nouten bangma bawl sawmlou nahi uh amah? khum gam a valut a valuo dingin kiheh sih un."},"10":{"text":"Nava pei chiengun galmuonga um mite leh agam letdan nava mu ding uhi. Tua gam khu Pasian in na khut ua ahing piehsa ahita hi. Leitunga sil um bangma tahsap mawngmawng umlouna mun ahi,” achi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Dan namte, Zorah leh Eshtaol akipat in, kidouna galvan kengin mi za guh akuonkheta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n akuontou ua, Juda gam a Kiriath-Jearim ah panmun akhaw ua, tuaziehin khum mun khu tuni dongin Mahaneh-Dan achita uhi. (Kiriath Jearim tum lam panga um ahi)"},"13":{"text":"Khuna kipat in Ephraim singtang gam lang azuon ua, Mikah inn ava tung uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Laish gam enkhe dinga kuon mi ngaten a unaute u’kungah, “Tami inn sungah, Ephod leh milimte, milim khenthute, milim sunthawte, aum chi na thei uoi? tuaziehin tuin bang ahiei na bawl ding uh, ngaituo un,” achi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama uh khuna kipat in akihei ua, Levi mi tangvalpa umna Mikah inn ah apei ua, bang na chi zel ei ava chi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Dan mite kidouna galvan tawi mi za guhte, khopi kul kotpi lutna ah ading uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh gam enkhe dinga kuon mi ngate, apeitou ua, tuachi’n ava lut ua, milim kikhengte, Ephod leh milim kisiemthute ava la ua; tualeh siempupa khu kulkotpi lutna ah galvan tawimi zaguh toh ading khawm uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh khum mite Mikah inn ah ava lut ua, milim kikhengte, Ephod leh milim kisungte ava la ua, tuachi’n siempuin “Bang ahiei na bawl uh?” achi a."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh ama un akungah, “Haam Sin, na khutin na kam hum inlen, tualeh ka kung uah hing pei inlen kou a dingin pa leh siempu’n hing pangin, nanga dingin innkuon khat giap siempu apan ahoizaw amah? ahisihleh nam khat leh Israel innkuon khat siempu apan?” achi ua."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua siempupa lungtang akipahta a, tualeh Ephod, milimte leh milim kisungte ala a, mite lah ah apeita hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n akihei ua, anaupang neute uh, aganhonte u’leh, avante uh masuon in apeisanta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Mikah inn akipat gamla simtah aphah tahun Mikah inn kim nai a umte akikhawm ua, anuadel ua, anua phahta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Dan mite anuahat ua, tualeh amauh akinua hei ua, Mikah kungah “Bang pen in na lungsim hing subuoi a mi hizapi na khop khawm ahiei?” achi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Ka pasiente keiman ka kibawlte leh siempu zawpi in na kipeimangpi mawh ua, tuin bang ka nei nalai ei? Bangchidan a bangin hing subuoi ahiei? hing chi nalai nahi uoi?” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Dan miten akungah, “Ka lah uah mawh ham sin, mi lungtom khat khut na thuoh kha dinga, na innkuonpite toh na hinna uh nataan kha ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Dan mite akipeita ua, tualeh Mikahin ama sang a hatzaw leh dou guollou ahi uh chi a mu ziehin, a inn langah akinuale kiata hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mikah in abawl silte leh asiempupa apeipi ua, Laish khuo a gal muonga um khinkhiante kung ava tung ua, namsau in aban satlia ua, khopi mei in ahal tumta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Sidon akipata agamlat seng ziehin, ahunkhe ding koima aum sih hi, tualeh koima toh kizopna anei sih uhi. Tualeh tami Beth Rehob phaijang kung a um ahi. Tuachi’n khopi khu asiempha ua, khunah atengta uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh amauten tua khopi apu uh Israel suon Dan min lain Dan achita uhi, hinanleh amin masa Laish akichi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Dan taten milim bawlthu atung dingta ua, tualeh Mosi tupa, Gershom tapa Jonathan leh atapate, tua gam mite sal a puimang ahi masangsie uh Dan namte siempu in apang denta uhi.","title":"Dan mite milim biehna"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mikahin abawlthu milim, khu Shiloh khuo a Pasian inn a aum sungteng in ading sahta uhi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh khum hunlai in hichi ahi a, Israel gam a leeng aumlou lai in, Levi nam mikhat Ephraim singtang gam tawplam ah aum a, Juda gam a Bethlehem numei khat mei dingin anei hi","title":"Levi mi leh ameinu"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh ameinu’n ang akawmsana, tuachi’n Bethlehem-Juda gam a apa inn ah apeisan a, khunah hali tah ava um hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n apasal akipan doh a, asuohpa leh sabil tung ni azawpi a, kamdam a houpi a puikia tumin ava nuadel a, tuachi’n amanu’n apa inn ah ana pui lut a, tualeh nungahnu pa’n tuami ana muin akipahpi mama hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh asungpa, nungahnu pain ahouta a, tuachi’n nithum sung akungah ataam sah a, tuachi’n ane ua adawn ua, khunah agiehta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh ani li niin hichi ahing hia, zingmawng matahin athou a, apei dingin akisa a, tualeh nungahnu pain amahpa kungah, “Tanghou them khat beh ne inlen na lungtang suhal tadi inlen tuazou chiengin na pei nasih diei mah,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n atou ua ane in adawn khawm ua, tualeh nungahnu pain tua mipa kungah, “Hepitahin tuzan gieh nalai mai inlen lungmuong tahin umin achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tua mipa pei dinga kisa in adingdoh a, hinanleh asungpa’n azawl zawla, tuabepin agieh kiata hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n ninga achinni zingmawng matahin athou a pei dingin akisa a, hinanleh nungahnu pa’n “Hepitahin na lungsim halsah tadi lachin asih diei,” achi hi, tuachi’n nitahlam nikai tan akhawl khawm ua ann ane khawmta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh tua mipa khu ameinu leh a suohpa toh pei dinga akisah leh, asungpa, nungahnu pa’n akungah “En in, ni zong akaita a, nitah lam ahita hi; tuzan giehkia tadi mawngmawng un, en ve, khuo zong miel pai ding ahita hi; hepitahin kisuhal inlen, lung nuom tahin um un, tuachi’n zing chiengin, zingmawng matahin na thou dinga, na peibai nasih diei” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh tua mipi khu khum zan agieh ut nawn sih a, adingdoh a, apeita hi. Tualeh Jebus khogal ahing tunga, (tua khu Jerusalem ahi) Sabiltung siemsa ni leh ameinu toh ahi uhi"},"11":{"text":"Jebus kho gei ahing tun in, ni a ngiem mama ta a; tualeh a suohpa’n apu kungah, “Hepitah in hing peiin, tam Jebus mite khopi ah lut vaiin, igieh mai ding hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh apu in akungah, “Israel mi hilou, nam dang khuo ah lut ngal lou e, Gibeah khuo lam izuon zaw ding hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh aman, asuohpa kungah, “Hing pei inlen, Gibeah khuo ahiei, Ramah khuo ahiei anai penpen ah gieh zaw mai vai,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh apei suoh ua, Gibeah kho gei atun un, ni atumta hi, tua khu Benjamin mite tenna khuo ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Gibeah khuo a gieh dingin alutta ua, kholai lamthuom khat ah atouta hi, tuachi’n koima khat in zong ka inn ah tuzan hing gieh in achi sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Khum hun laitahin Puteh aloukuonna apat ahing vaitunga, amapa zong Ephraim singtang gam a nateng ngaimi ahia; Gibeah khuo a na tungtha pan ahi, khum khomite pen Benjamin mite ngen ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh tehsepu kihei a a dahdoh leh kholai a tou zinte amu a; “Heisunga hing kipan a, Hei a haw ding na hi uoi?” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n akungah, “Bethlehem-Juda gam a kipan a Ephraim singtang gam tawp a peitum kahi, khum gam a teng ka hia, Juda gam Bethlehem a vahaw ka hi;
