tuin Mangpa inn a haw sawm ka hia, hinanleh koima ahing zintun nuom a um sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka Sabiltungte ua dingin bupawl leh gan ann ka nei ua, kei leh na suohnu ading tualeh na suohpa tangval a dingin tanghou leh uoin a um hi, bangma tahsap ka nei sih uhi;” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh tehse, pu’n, “Hamuong tahin um un, na tahsap zousie uh keiman tuoh navang kholai ah vang gieh damai un,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n ainnsungah a puilut a, tualeh asabiltungte gan ann apie a, tualeh akengte uh asil ua, ane un a dawnta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuabanga lung muongleh nuomtah a, a um lai un thakhat in khum khuo a mi Belial tapate pawl khat in a umna inn uh ahing imta ua, kot avasu ua, tualeh innneipa tehsepu kungah, “Na inn sunga hing lutpa ka pawl theina dingun hing pawt sahin,” achi uhi.","title":"Gibeate tatsietna","ref":"Siem. 19.5-8"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n inn neipa ava pawtdoh a, akung uah, “Hilou e, Hilou e, ka unaute! hichi talawm in silgilou bawl sih un! tam mipa ka inn a hing tung ahi chi nathei ua, hepitahin tambang sil mothuoi bawl mawngmawng sih un."},"24":{"text":"En un tanah ka tanu nungah siengthou khat leh amapa meinu a um a, ama-utegel hing puidoh vang in, zala sah unlen, hoinasah bang bangun atung uah bawl un, hinanleh tam mipa tungah tambang sil mothuoi bawl sih un,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh khum miten athugen asang nuom sih ua, tuachi’n tua mipa’n ameinu aman a amaute ava peta hi, tualeh amaun ana luppi ua, zan tungtawn in aluppi ua, asumel sie ua, tualeh khovah kuonin apei sahta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua numei nu khu khovah tahin ahing pei a, apasal tunna tehsepu inn kot bul ah, apuata-a, khovah dongin aumdenta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh zingmawng in apasal athoua, peidia kisa a, kot ahing honleh, En in, ameinu kotphungah ana pua a, akhutte kotlam zungah ana zam a, tuakhu apasal in amuta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akungah “Thouta in peita vai,” achi a, hinanleh adawngta sih hi. Tuachi’n tua mipa’n amanu khu sabiltung tungah akhangdoh a, tuachi’n akipan a aumna munlam zuonin apeita hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh ainn a atuntahin, temta ala a, ameinu aman a, agute toh amanu tahsa se sawm leh seni asuo a, tua khu Israelte tenna gam zousie ah, athot suohta hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 11.7"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, amu kha tapouin, “Israel tate Izipt gam a kipat a ahing pawtdoh nua un, tunitan in, tambanga sil kibawl mawng mawng a um ngainai sih a, mu zong aki mungainai sih hi, ngaituo unlen, kihou unlen genvawi un” achi uhi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate zousie ahing kithing doh ua, thukhat satin, Dan akipat Beersheba tandongin, Gilead gam akipat a mipi zousie mihing khat bangmai in. Mizpah a Mangpa kungah akikhawmta uhi.","title":"Israelte leh Benjaminte kidouna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh mipi Lamkai zousiete leh Israel nam zousie Pasian mipite kikhop khawmna ah ava pang chiet uhi, pasal namsau tawi thei galkap tul zali ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Banjamin miten, Israeltate Mizpah khuo ah akuontou uh chi ana zata ua. Tuachi’n Israel taten, “Bangchidan a tambanga gitlouna hing piengdoh ahiei?” hing hil un achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n, tha a um khum numeinu pasal Levi mipa’n, “Benjamin namte tenna Gibeah khopi ah ka meinu toh gieh dingin kava lut ua."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Gibeah miten ahing bulu ua, kei ziehin ka tunna in zanlai in ahing imtawm ua, tha ahing tum ua, ka meinu aluppi ua, asuol lia ta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n, ka meinu luong ka sem nen a Israelte tenna gam tenga ka hing hawm zah ahi; Israel gam ah sil kidahhuoi leh mot huoi tah ana bawlta mawh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Nou Israel tate zousie aw, Ngaiun, tuin tam mun ah na ngaidan u’leh hoi nasah dan uh genvawi un,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite zousie lungkhat puoin, adingdoh duom ua, “Koima ipuon innte ah peivawt sih va ui, koima i inn lang uah inua peisih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Gibeate ibawl ding dan, hichibang ahi ding hi, ai isaan ding ua, adou dingin ikuontou ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Gibeah muna Benjamin mite iva dou chieng ua, neh ding ann pedingin, Israel nam zousie apat in, mi zakhat ah sawm, tul khat ah zakhat, tul sawmah tul khat, zel itel doh ding ua; Benjamin miten Gibeah a, Israel gamsunga sildihlou abawl uh dungzui ua, athuh theina ding un,” achi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mi zousie, mikhat bang mai a kithutuohin akikhawmta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel namten Banjamin nam zousiete kungah, “Na lah ua hichibang gitlouna hing umta mawh khu bangchidan ahiei?"},"13":{"text":"Gibeah khuo a Belial tate hing pedoh unlen, tuachi’n ka that ding ua, Israelte lah a kipat in gitlouna ka hemmang ding uhi,” chiin agen sah uhi. Hinanleh Benjamin suonten a unaute uh, Israel suonte thugente a ngaisah shi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Khuchinahsangin, Benjamin tate khu Israel namte dou ding in akhopite ua kipat in ahing kuonkhie ua, Gibeah ah akikhawmta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh khum hunlai in Benjamin mite khopite a kipat a namsau tawia pawtdohte khu, Gibeah khuo a mi hangsan kiteldoh tuom za sagite simlou, in tul sawmni leh tul guh ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua mite zousie lah ah tel tuom za sagi ahi ua, abawn un veilawng ngen ahi uhi. Tualeh a unpi un saili kap siem chiet ahi ua, samzang chie zong khiel ngailou chiet ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Benjaminte simlou in, Israel mite namsau tawi mi ngen tul zali ahi ua, abawn un galdou dan siem ngentang ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate adingdoh ua, Bethel a Pasian inn ah apeitou ua, tualeh Pasian ava dong ua, “Benjamin mite dou dingin ka lah uah koi ahiei kuon masa pen ding?” achi ua; Tualeh Mangpa’n “Juda kuontou masa heh” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate khu zingmawng in athou ua, Gibeah dou dingin Gibeah khuo a imta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Israel mite Benjamin namte dou dingin akuondoh ua, Tuachi’n Israel tate amauh dou dingin Gibeah khuo ah pan mun akhaw uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Benjamin mite Gibeah akipat in ahing kuon ua, tuami niin Israel tate tul sawmni leh tul ni ahing that uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Israel mipite khat leh khat akihantawh ua amasanga apanna mama uah pan mun asiem kia uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate akuontou ua, Mangpa mai ah nitahlam tandong ava kap ua. “Ka unau uh Benjamin namte dou dingin ka kuon kia nading uoi?” chi’n Mangpa adong ua, tuachi’n Mangpa’n “Vakuon kia un,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten ani ni ni’n Benjamin tate dou dingin akuontou kia ua."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Benjaminte zong amauh dou dingin Gibeah apat in ani ni niin Gibeah akipat in apawtdoh ua, tualeh Israel tate mi tul sawm leh tul giet ava that ua, tamite zousie namsau tawi ngentang ahi uhi,"},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate zousie Bethela a Pasian inn uah ava pei ua, ava tou ua, nitah dongin ann ngawl in ava kap ua, tualeh Mangpa mai ah halmang sillat leh lemna sillat ava lan uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Mangpa kungah, thu adong ua. (Khum hunlai in Pasian thuhun bawm khu khunah a um hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron tapa Eleazar, Eleazar tapa Phinehas khum hun lai in amasangah a ding hi.) “Ka unaupa Benjamin dou dingin ka kuon kia diei? Ahisihleh ka tawpsan mai diei?” achi a. Tualeh Mangpa’n “Kuon tou in zingchiengin na khut ah ka hingpe ding,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Israel miten Gibeah khopi kim ah aguh a buhdap ding mi akoi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh anithum niin Israel tate Benjamin namte dou dingin akuontou ua, amasanga bangin Gibeah dou dingin pan mun asiem uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Benjamin namte zong mite dou dingin akuontou ua, tualeh khopi apat in apawtdoh ua, amasa a bangin mite dou in athat pan kiata ua, lamliente ah, Bethela Pasian inn zotna lampite ah, tualeh Gibeah zotna lam liente ah Israel mi sawm thum vel athat uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Benjamin miten “Amasa mabangin imasang ah zala kia ta uh e,” achi ua. Hinanleh “Israel tate’n itai ding ua khopi akipat lamlien langah kihemkhe suh vai ui e,” akichi ua,"},"33":{"text":"tuachi’n Israel mi zousie’n apan mun uh apawt san ua, Baal tamar mun ah panmun abawl ua, tualeh Israel mite aguh a na buhdapte zong Gibeah tumlam apat in ahing pawtkhie uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Israelte zousie lah a teltuom ngentang tul sawmten Gibeah khuo ava bulu ua, akidou uh athupi mama hi. Hinanleh Benjaminten atung ua vangsietna hing tung ding ahilam athei sih uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Benjamin namte Israelte masangah aguollel sahta hi; Tualeh khum ni’n Israel taten Benjamin namte tul sawmni leh tul nga leh zakhat athat ua, tuate khu abawn un namsau tawi ngen ahi uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Benjamin namten aguollelta uh chi ahing kitheita ua, Israel taten Gibeah khuo dou dinga aguh a tangpanga akoite uh amuon zou zieh un, Benjamin namte akinuakhin san zawta uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh aguh a tangpangten Gibeah khuo thakhat in abulu ua, tuachi’n aguh a tangpangte akikhenjah ua, khosunga mi um zousie namsau in asatlia siengta uhi."},"38":{"text":"Israel tate leh aguh a tangpangte akithei tuona ding ua chiemtena aguot uh ahileh khopi sunga meikhu van lang a meilum banga zamsah tou vevaw ding ahi."},"39":{"text":"Israelte galdou banou khat akhawl tahdi kal un, Benjamin namte akipan ua, Israel mi sawm thum athat ua, “I kidou chilni mabangin imasang uah guollel kia ding ahita uhi,” achi uhi."},"40":{"text":"Hinanleh khopi sunga meikhu meilum banga ahing kituntou ngei ngui tahin, Benjamin mite kihei a anua et u’leh, ngai in, khopi pumpi vanlam ah meikhu in azamtouta hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Israelte ahing kinuale kia tah un, Benjaminte abuoiseta ua, tansie atung ua tung ahi chi atheita uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tuaziehin Israelte masangah, kinua heiin gamdai lang manawin ataijahta uhi, hinanleh kidouna in alapman a, tuachi’n khopi a kipat a hing pawtten ana thatta uhi."},"43":{"text":"Benjaminte a im khum ua, anuadel ua, Gibeah suolam gal dongin that kawm kawm in adelphata uhi."},"44":{"text":"Khunah Benjamin mi tul sawm leh tul giet athat ua, amaute pasal hat leh hangsan ngen ahi uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n akilehei ua, gamdai a Rimmon suongpi lang ah ataijahta uhi, tualeh Israel taten mi tul nga lamlien dungah asatlia uhi, tualeh Gidom tandong Benjamin mite anuadel peh ua, alah ua mi tul ni athat nalai uhi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum ni a Benjamin mi ki thatte zousie tul sawmni leh nga ahia, aunpi un namsau tawi thei chiet ahi ua, mihat leh hangsan ngen ahi uhi."},"47":{"text":"Hinanleh mi zaguhte pen gamdai a Rimmon suongpi langah ataizah ua, tualeh amaute Rimmon suongpi ah hali sung ava um uhi."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh Israel mite, Benjaminte dou dingin akipan pha kia ua, khopi sunga um zousie mihing hiin ganta hileh amu zousie uh namsau hiem in asat lia zel uhi. Tualeh khopi aphah khahna pouma u’zong mei in ahaltum zel uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Tuin Israel miten Mizpah khuo ah, “I lah ua mi koima’n itanute uh, Benjamin mite zi dingin ipe mawngmawng sih ding uh,” chi’n akichiemta uhi.","title":"Israelte kichiemna mot huoi"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite Bethel a Pasian inn ah ahaw ua, nitah dongin amasangah atou ua, aw ngaitah a kikou in, hasetahin akapta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ama un “Aw Mangpa, Israelte Pasian, bangchidan a Israelte lah a tambang sil hing um ahiei? tunia Israelte nam khat a samta maiding adiei?” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n azingni’n hichi ahi a, zingmawng matah in mite ahing thou ua, maitam abawl ua, tuanah halmang sillat leh lemna sillatte alan uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten, “Israel nam pumpi kikhopna a, Mangpa masanga khawmpi a hing panglou koi a um ei?” achi ua. Mizpah khuo a “Mangpa masanga hawlou pouma thalup ahi ding” chiin kichiemna thupi tah ana neita uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate khu aunaupa uh Benjamin ziehin alungdong mama ta uhi. “Tuni’n Israelte lah ah nam khat sat khieh ahita hi."},"7":{"text":"Bang ilawta ding uoi leh? adam sunte zi dingin itanute koiman pelou dingin Mangpa mai ah ina kichiemta ngal ua,” achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh amaun “Israel namte lah a, Mizpah khuo a Mangpa mai a, hing pang khalou koi nam pen ahiei?” achi ua. Tualeh ngaiin kikhopna ah Jabesh-Gilead mite koima khat zong ahawsih uhi.","title":"Jabesh Gilead mi tellou"},"9":{"text":"Mipite akisim u’leh Ngaiin Jebesh Gilead mite khat zong ana umta sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi kikhawmten mihat leh hangsan ngen mi tul sawm leh tul ni asawl ua, “Kuon unlen, Jebesh-Gilead a teng zousie, numei leh naupang pum in namsau in va satlia siengun, chiin thu apie uhi."},"11":{"text":"Na bawl ding dan uh tambang ahi ding hi, pasal kichi pouma na that ding ua, tualeh numei pasal toh lumkhawmsa pouma zong na that gam ding uhi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tua Jabesh-Gilead a tengte lah ah, nungah siengthou pasal toh kipawl kha nai vawtlou zali amu ua, tualeh amaute Kanaan gam a um Shiloh giehphuol ah ahing zawpita uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi kikhawm zousieten Rimmon suongpi aum, Benjamin mite kungah mi lawi khat lemna thu gen dingin asawl ua."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Khumi tungin Benjamin te ahing nua pei ua, tualeh, Jabesh Gilead numei ahing puite uh azi dingun apie ua, hinanleh atangkim zounai sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa’n Israel namte lah a, suhgemna abawltah ziehin mipite Benjaminte ziehin alungdong mama uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi kikhawm upate’n “Benjamin numeite lah ithat gamta uh chi ithei ngal ua, ahingsun pasalte zi ding bang ichi ngaituo piehding uh ata diei?” akichi uhi.","title":"Shiloh nungahte matthopna"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh amaun “Israelte lah a nam khat suhmanga a umlou na dingun, Benjamin nam um sunten hahle suon bangchin inei sah thei ding uoi? akichi ua,"},"18":{"text":"Itanute u’lah azi dingun ipe thei tasih ua,” aziehpen Israel tate koipou in “Benjaminte toh atanu kitengsah pen pen gausap in um heh” chi’n, ina kichiemta uhi achi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun, “Ngaivawi, Bethel mallang, Bethel akipat Shekem zottouna lamlien suolam a Lebanon simlang a um Shiloh khuo ah kum chin in, Mangpa adinga ann zaluina a um zel hi,” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaun Benjamin tate thu apie ua, “Pei unlen grep huon lah ah na buhdap unlen;"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh na ngah unlen, Shiloh nungahte lamphuola lam dinga ahing pawtdoh chiengun, grep huonna pat hing pawtdoh unlen, michin in Shiloh nungahte na zi dingun, khat chiet na kimat unlen, Benjamin gam lam ah peipi ta un."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahi dinga, apate uh ahiei, ahisihleh asanggam pasalte uh ahiei, tam thu gen dinga, ka kung ua, ahing pei chiengun, kouman akung uah, koute zal in nahepi un, kidouna alah azi ding uh, ikhawi pieh sih ua, nouten lah tutan in azi ding uh nana pe tuom sih ua, napie hita ulachin zong na kichiemnate zieh un; na lung sim uah kisiem tansih va uchin, kana chi mai ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Benjamin miten tuabangin abawlta ua, tuabanga nungahte ahing lamtah un, mi khat in azi ding uh nungah khat chiet aman ua, tuachi’n azi ding un a peipita uhi, tuachi’n agam luona uah anua pei kia ua, khopite asiemtha ua, khunah atengta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate khum hun in, tua mun akipat in akikhen ua, michin ama ama namte lah leh a innkuonpite lah ah tualeh ama uh mun chiet ah apeita uhi."},"25":{"text":"Khum hunlai in Israel gam ah leeng a um sih a, michin amauh hoisah dan bang chiet in akigamtat uhi.","ref":"Vai. 17.6"}}}}},"8":{"info":{"name":"Ruth","shortname":"Ruth.","abbr":[],"desc":"Ruth laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachia thukhen vaihawmten vai ahawm laiun, hichi ahi a, gam sungah kiel ahing tunga. Tualeh Bethlehem a Juda mi khat Moab gam a um dingin ama leh azi leh atapate ni toh apeita ua.","title":"Alimalekte innkuon Moab a apemna uh"},"2":{"text":"Khum mipa min Elimelek ahia, azi min Naomi ahi, tualeh atapate gel min Mahlon leh Kilon, Bethlehem-Juda Ephrath mi ahi uhi. Tualeh Moab gam ah ahing pei ua, khunah a umdenta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Naomi pasal Elimelek ashi a, amanu leh atapate ni maimai a umta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Moab numeite zi in anei ua, khat nu min Orpah ahia, adang khat nu min pen Ruth ahi. Tualeh khunah kum sawm ding vel ateng uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mahlon leh Kilon zong ani un ahing shita ua, tuachi’n numeinu khu atate nileh a pasal in ashi santa uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu amoute gel toh Moab gam akipat nua pei kia dingin akisata ua, Mangpa’n amite neh ding pie a ave dan thu Moab gam a kipat a na zah zieh in.","title":"Ruth in Naomi apeisanna ding hun lemtang"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin a umna akipat in amoute geltoh apawt ua, Juda gam a nua pei kia dingin apeita uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Naomi in amoute gel kungah, “Pei unlen na nute uh inn tuoh ah nuapei kiata un; Mangpa’n mi shi tung leh ka tunga na bawl bangun na tung uah siemtah in hing bawlta hen."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa’n na ni un pasal dang na neinate uh innsung tuoh ah khawl damna namu theina dingun hing hepita hen,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amautegel atawp a, tuachi’n aw ngaitahin akapta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh amaun, “Pei sih va ung, na mite kunga napei peina ah ka hing pei ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Naomi in, “Ka tanute aw, pei kia zaw un; bang zieh a ka kunga hing pei mama ding nahi uoi mah? Na pasal dinguh tapa ka pai kia thei na ding amah?"},"12":{"text":"Ka tanute aw kisa unlen pei un; pasal nei dingin ka teh sengta hi. Ki nepna ka nei nalai chiin tuzan mama in pasal nei vangin tapate ka nei ding chinan leng zong;"},"13":{"text":"A pichin tan uh na ngah na ding u’amah? Pasal neilou in na umden ding uh amah? Hitalawmlou e ka tanute aw; nou ziehin ka lungkham sengseng hi, Mangpa’n kei douna’n akhut ka tungah atu sahta hi.”"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n, aw ngaitah suo in akap kiata uhi; tuachi’n Orpah in api atawpa, hinanleh Ruth in pen api atu chinten hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n “En in, na moupinu, amite leh a pasiente kung lam ah anua pei kiata hi, nang zong na moupinu del inlen nua pei kia maita in” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Ruth in, “Nang nuasie ding leh nang zuilou a nua pei kia dingin hing zawl teitei sin; napei peina ah ka pei dinga, na gieh giehna ah ka gieh dinga; na mite ka mite ahi dinga, tualeh na Pasian, ka Pasian ahi ding hi.","title":"Ruth in Naomi toh um khawm atelna"},"17":{"text":"Na shina ah ka shi dinga, khunah ka kivui ding hi; nang leh kei shina loungal sildangin a hing khen ding leh Mangpa’n alawlaw hing law mai henlen, tua sanga thupi zawin zong hing bawl ta heh,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akungah pei atum chinten hi chi atheitahin, bangma a gen nawn sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n ani un Bethlehem tan apei khawmta uhi, tualeh hichi ahi a, Bethlehem ahing tun un, akho pumpi amaute gel zieh in achizata ua, numeiten “Tamnu Naomi hi lou i?” achi uhi.","title":"Ruth leh Naomi Bethlehem ah apei khawmta uh"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akung uah, “Naomi hing chisih unlen Marah hing chi zaw un, Bangkimbawltheipa’n ka tungah hasiet huoitahin a hing bawlta hi."},"21":{"text":"Buchingtahin ka pawtdoh a, Mangpa’n khut guohin ahing nua pui kiata hi: Mangpa’n ka tungah alungkimlouna alang sahta hi, Bangkimbawltheipa’n ahing suh genthei dan thei gehguh a, Bangdinga Naomi, nangchi nalai uh ahiei?” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Naomi ahing kinuale kiata a, amounu Moab numei Ruth toh Moab gam a kipat in ahing nua pei kiata uhi; tualeh barli bu at pat hun lai in Bethlehem ahing tung uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Naomi in apasal sanggam kinaipi Elimelek innkuonpite lah a mi hausatah khat anei a; amin Boaz ahi.","title":"Ruth leh Boaz kimuna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Moab numei Ruth in Naomi kungah, “Lou lam ah va kuon vangin, lou a mi ahing hepi pouma kungah, bu sang vasui vang aw,” achia, tualeh Naomi in, “Va kuon ve ka tanu” achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.9,10; Danp. 24.19"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu akuonta a, lou Lai a bu lamite lahmanghil bu sangte ava sui a; Tuachi’n Elimelek innkuonpipa Boaz lou ah ava kuon khata hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ngai vawi, Boaz khu Bethlehem akipat in alou ah ava haw a, bu lamite kungah, “Mangpa noute toh umkhawmta hen,” achia, tualeh amaun “Mangpa’n hing guolzawlta hen” chiin adawng uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Boaz in asuoh bu lamite lamkaipa kungah, “Tami nu heilam nungah ahiei?” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh asuoh abu atmite tunga lamkaipa’n, Moab nungah, “Moab gam a kipata Naomi toh hing peikhawm ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n Hing hepi inlen, na busang uh sui vangin, bu atmiten abu phai uh alahkhawm zou chiengun suizel vang aw achia; tuachi’n ahing pei a, inn a tomnou khat ava um chilou, zingmawng akipat tutan khawllou in asem hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Boaz in Ruth kungah, “Ngaiin ka tanu; bu sang suiin lou dangah kuon sinlen, tana kipat in peidoh sinlen, ka suoh nungahte kungah um khinkhian in.","title":"Boaz in Ruth adeisah"},"9":{"text":"A bu at uh en ngitnget inlen, anua uh suizel in; tangvalte nang bangma hing lawlou dingin thu ka pe zouta hi. Tualeh na dangta pouma chiengin tuibel a tangvalte tui tawisa vadawn zel in” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu amai tuolsu in akhupboha, akungah “Gamtuom mi lah ka hi ngal a, hichibanga na hing thei nuom a, na hing lungsiet bang chidan ahiei?” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Boaz in adawnga akungah, “Na pasal shi nua akipat na pinu tunga nasil bawl zousie kimtah in ahing kihil sieng keei a, tualeh nanu leh napa leh na pienna gam nuasie a, nidanga na thei ngailou mite kunga na hing peidan zousie zong ahing kihil ta hi, achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa’n na sepman hing thuh henlen, Israelte Mangpa Pasian kihumbitna dinga ahalim nuoi na hing belin kipahman bukim hing peta hen,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n, “Na mitmu ah deisahna hing tangsahin, na suoh nungahte lah a khat hisih nanleng zong, nang na hing hamuon a, na suohnu hoitahin na hing houpita hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh ann neh hun in Boaz in akungah, “Hing pei inlen tanghoute hing ne inlen, tanghou themte uointhua lah ah hing die sam in,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amanu bu at mite kungah atou a; aman bu kan ana pie a, ane a, akham nua in zong aval nalai hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh bu sang sui dinga adindoh in, Boaz in atangvalte kungah “Bu phai lah ate zong tom zel henlen, phawh sih un."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh alom lah a butangte kesah unlen atom dingin nuasie zel unlen, phawh sih un,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n lou ah nitahlam dongin busang a sui a, tualeh atomsate achil a, barlibu Ephah khat apha hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n apuo a khuo ah apeita hi; tualeh a innpinu’n abu sang sui ana mu a, tuachi’n amanu’n akham zou a, aneh valte ahing ladoh a akungah pie hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh a innpinu’n a kungah, “Tuni’n heilang ah busang nava sui ei? heisungah nava sem ei? nang hing na thei nuompa guolzawl in umta hen,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amanu’n koi kunga nna vasem ahiei chi a innpinu ahila; “Tunia kava nasepna pa min Boaz ahi,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Naomi in amounu kungah, “Mihing leh mishi tunga ahepina tawpsah ngailou Mangpa’n ama guolzawlta hen” achi hi. Tualeh Naomi in akungah “Tua mipa khu ikinaipi ahing zomtu i sanggampa i bul pi pa ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 25.25"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Moab numei Ruth in, “Aman zong ka kungah ka bu lahzou sieng masangsie uh ka tangvalte kungah na pan ngitnget ding ahi, ahing chi hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Naomi in Amounu Ruth kungah, “Hoi e ka tanu lou danga ahing mulouna dingun anungahte maimai toh zawhkhawm zel in,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n barli bu leh bupi lah zou masangsie Boaz nungahte lah ngen ah bu sang suiin akuon akuon zela, tualeh api toh ateng khawm hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n a innpinu Naomi in akungah, “Nanga dinga hoi dingin inn suon thei na ding hing suipieh taleng hoilou ding amah?","title":"Naomi in Ruth tandohtu ding asuina"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh i sanggampa, asuoh nungahte toh ana nava sepnapa uh Boaz a um hilou amah? Ngaiin tuzan chienga bu phuol a barli bu zapsieng ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin kisilsieng inlen, sathau kinu in, tualeh na puon sil inlen, phuol ah va peisuh in; hinanleh aneh a adawn zou masangsie kitheisah vawtsin."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, alup chiengin alupna chiemte inlen, tuachi’n lut inlen, akeng lempieh inlen lum suhin; tuachi’n aman nabawl ding ahing hilding hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n, “Ka kunga nagen bangin ka bawl ding hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n phuol ah apeisuh a, api’n ahil bang bangin abawlta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Boaz in ann ane a adawn zou in, tualeh alungsim a nuom asah mama bepin, bu vum bul a lum dingin apeita hi, tuachi’n amanu zong awl awl in ahing pei a, akeng alem a alumsuhta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, zankim lai in Boaz ahing khanglou a, ahing kihei leh akengbul ah numei khat ana lum hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n “Koi na hiei?” a chi a, amanu’n na suohnu “Ruth ka hi, na puonsil na suohnu hing zawn in, ka sanggam kinaipi na hi,” chin adawng hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Ka tanu Mangpa’n hing guolzawlta hen, tangval genthei ahiei, hausa ahiei, na zuilou dan in, achiil lai sangin atawp lam ah hoina na sulang zaw ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh ka tanu zausin, nagen bangbangin na tungah ka bawl ding hi, ka khuo a mi zousie’n numei kizen tah nahi chi ahing thei uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh, kei na sanggam kinaipi kahi chipen adih ahi, hinanleh kei sanga sanggam kinaipi a um hi.","ref":"Ruth. 2.20"},"13":{"text":"Tuzan gieh inlen, zingmawng chiengin hichi ahi dinga aman na tungah sanggam kinaipi bawl ding lawm abawl nop leh ahoi ahi dinga; bawl mai heh; hinanleh sanggam kinaipi bawl ding lawm ahing bawlpieh nuomsih leh na tungah sanggam kinaipi bawl ding pen, Mangpa ahin bangin keiman ka bawl ngeingei ding hi, zingmawng dong lum tadi maiin,” a chi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu zingmawng dong akeng bul ah a lumta hi, “Tualeh koima kimu chien thei masang in athou a, tualeh amapan phuol ah numei ahing pei hi chi mawngmawng koiman theida heh,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh aman akungah, “Na puonsil hing tawi inlen dawin achi a,” tualeh amanu’n adaw a, barli bu chin tena guh ate pieh a, aliengah apat a, tuachi’n amanu khuo ah apeita hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh api kung ahing tunin, “Naomi in ka tanu bang na hing chiei?” ana chi hi, Tuachi’n amanu’n tua mipan atunga ana bawldan zousie ahilta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Ruth in, “Tam barli bu chin tena guh ahing pie a, napi kungah khut guohin pei sin ahing chi hi,” a chi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Naomi in, “Ka tanu bangchibanga sil hing um ding ahiei chi nathei masang sien um khinkhian phot maiin, tunia tam sil abawl zou masangsie’n tua mipa asip nawn sih ding hi,” a chi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Boaz kulpi kotkhah bul ah apeitou a, tua mun ah atou a; tualeh ngai vawi, Boaz in agenpa a sanggam kinaipi pen u’khu ahing pei a. Boaz in tua mipa kungah, “Lawm aw hing kihei inlen, tanah hing tou in,” achi a, tuachi’n akihei a, atouta hi.","title":"Boaz leh Ruth kitenna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Boaz in khum khopi a upate lah a mi sawm azawpi a, akung uah, “Tanah hing tou un” achia, tuachi’n atouta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh a sanggam kinaipi penpa u’kungah, “Moab gam a kipata hing nua pei kia Naomi in isanggampa Elimelek gam azua a:"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n na kunga tana toute mitmu leh ka mite upate mitmu in leiin. Na tat nop leh tan inlen, hinanleh natat nuom sih leh hing hil in ka thei nuom hi. Aziehpen nanglou ngal atan ding dang a um sih hi, tualeh nang zom in kei ka hi chi hing theisah poimaw hiin ka thei hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n aman “Ka tan ding hi” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuchin Boaz in “Naomi khut akipat agam nalei ni niin, mi shipa zi Moab numei Ruth akipata mishi min manglou a, agouluo ding mi a um zel theina dinga mishipa zi meithai Moab numei Ruth zong anei alamteng toh nalei khawm ding ahi,” a chi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh asanggam kinaipi penpa’n, “Keima dingin vang ka tan thei sih ding hi; khuchilouin pen keima gouneisate ka suthelthang kha ding hi, tan thei ka hina khu nangman tangmai in, tan zoulou ding ka hi zieh in,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Nidanglai a Israelte lah a sil bangkim a suhdetna ding ua, akitatdan u’leh akihentuo dan uh tambang ahi; mi khat in akedap asut a, a khatpa kungah apie u’hi; tua khu Israelte lah a abawldan uh ahi.","ref":"Danp. 25.9"},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin asanggam kinaipipa un Boaz kungah “Nanga dingin lei zawmai in achi a; tuachi’n aman akedap asutta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Boaz in upate leh mipi zousiete kungah, Naomi khut a kipat in Elimelek nei zousie leh Kilion leh Mahlon nei zousie ka leita hi chi, tuni’n atheipitute na uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua guoh hilouin, asanggamte lah a kipat leh tam khopi min gelna bu akipat mishi min amanlou na dingin leh gouluotu abawlpieh theina dingin Mahlon zi Moab numei Ruth zong ka zi dingin kaleita hi chi, tuni’n noute tuami theipitute nahi uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 25.5,6"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh kul kotpi a um mi zousie leh upaten, “Theipitute ka hi uh. Na innsunga numei hing lut khu Mangpa’n Israel innkuon dingsahtu nite, Rachel leh Leah bangin siemta hen, tualeh nang pen Ephrathah phung sungah suonhuoi tahin um inlen, Bethlehem ah minthang tahin hing umta in.","ref":"Siem. 29.31"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n tam nungah akipat hahlesuon nang ahing pieh ding khu Tamar in Juda ahinpieh Perez innkuon bang hing hita hen,” achi uhi.","ref":"Siem. 38.27-30"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Boaz in Ruth apui a, azi ahing hita hi; tuachi’n aluppi a, Mangpa’n nau apai sah a, tapa aneita hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n numeiten Naomi kungah, “Tuni mama a Israelte lah a, amin manlouna dinga, sanggam kinaipi tasamlou a hing umsahpa Mangpa khu phat in umta hen."},"15":{"text":"Ama khu na hinna tungdingpa leh na teh nua chienga hing vaa dingpa ahi ding hi; na mounu nangma hing it nu; tapa sagi sanga hoizawnu in ama ahingta hi, achi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Naomi in nausen khu ala a, a angsungah apom a, tuachi’n nauching nu ahing hita hi.”"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh a innveng numeiten amin aphuo pieh ua, “Naomi dingin tapa khat ahing pieng hi achi ua,” amin dingin Obed aphuota uhi. Ama David pu Jesai pa khu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tamte Perez hahlesuonte ahi uhi. Perez in Hezron ahinga,"},"19":{"text":"Hezron in Ram ahinga, Ram in Amminadab ahinga"},"20":{"text":"Amminadab in Nahshon ahinga, Nahshon in Salmon ahinga;"},"21":{"text":"Salmon in Boaz ahinga, Boaz in Obed ahinga,"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Obed in Jesse ahinga, Jesse in David ahing hi."}}}}},"9":{"info":{"name":"1 Samuel","shortname":"1 Sam.","abbr":[],"desc":"Samuel laibu khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephriam singtang gam a Ramathaim Zophim khuo ah mikhat a um a, amin Elkanah ahi. Tuakhu Jeroham tapa, Alihu tapa, Tohu tapa, Zuph tapa ahi.","title":"Shiloh a Elkanah leh a innkuon te"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman zi ni anei a, khatnu min Hannah ahia, akhat zopennu min khu Peninnah ahi. Peninnah in tate anei a, hinanleh Hannah in ta anei sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tam mipa akhuo ua kipan in Shiloh khuo ah Galkapte Mangpa be ding leh akunga kithoi dingin kumchin in ahawtou zel hi. Tualeh khum mun ah, Eli tapate Hophni leh Phinehas Mangpa siempute a um uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Elkanah sillat hun ahing tun tahin azi Peninnah leh atapate leh atanute zousie tanvou apie a,"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Hannah kung ah tanvou ni ape zel hi. A it mama zieh in. Hinanleh Mangpa’n anaubu akhah pieh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n anaubu akhah pieh zieh a, alungthah na ding leh alung gim semsem na dingin alang nu’n Hannah a phin phin ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n kumtenga abawlzel bangin Mangpa Inn a, amanu ahawtou pouma chieng in, alungthah na dingin ana phin phin zing zieh in Hannah akap kapta a, bangma anesih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n apasal Elkanah in akung ah “Hannah bang dinga kap kap na hiei? bang ding a ann nelou na hiei? bang ding a na lungtang dasah na hiei? tapa sawm sangin zong nanga dingin ka hoizaw sih ama?” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Shiloh khuo a, a neh ua adawn zou un Hannah, ading doh a, tualaitah in Siempu Eli khu Mangpa bieh Inn kot khuom bula a touna tung ah atou hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hannah khu lunggim tahin auma Mangpa kung ah thu a ngen a, Lungkham sengin akap ta hi.","title":"Hannah thungetna"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n thuchiem khat abawl a, “Aw Galkapte Mangpa na suohnu gentheina muchien leh theizing a, nang manghil lou a, na suohnu tapa nang pieh leh ama khu a damsung teng ken zong Mangpa kungah ka pe kia ding hi, tuachi’n a sam akiheusih ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Kisim. 6.5"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, Mangpa mai a Hannah athum sanlai in, Eli in anephu phun ana chiemte hi."},"13":{"text":"Hannah in alungsim in thu angen a; anephu mai mai apia hi, a aw akizasih hi, tuaziehin Eli in zukham hiva achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Eli in amanu kungah, “Bangtanvei ahiei zukham a na um ding? na zukham tawpta’n” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hannah in adawnga, “Kham vawt sing e pu, numei lungkham leh liengvai nu ka hibou hi, zu leh khamthei dawn kahi sih a, Mangpa masanga kalungsim luikhie ka hizaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Na suohnu, Belial numei dingin ngaituo sin, kalung kimlouna leh ka chimawna dimlette zieh a tutan thugen ka hi bou hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Eli in adawnga akungah, “Hamuongtah in peitan Israel Pasian in akung a, na nget khu hing peta hen.”"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amanu’n, akung ah “Na suohnu’n na mitmu ah deisahna tang ta hen,” achia, tuachi’n tua numei apeita a, ann ane a, tualeh amaisuo ah dana a um nawn sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Khumin zingmawng matah in athou ua, Mangpa abie ua apei ua, Ramah khuo a, a Inn uah atung kia ta uhi. Tualeh Elkanah in azi Hannah ave a, Mangpa’n amanu atheizing hi.","title":"Samuel pienna"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, Hannah in nau apai a, ahun ahing tunin tapa anei a, Mangpa kunga “Ka nget khieh ahi” chiin, amin Samuel aphuota hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Elkanah leh a Innkuonpite zousie, Mangpa kunga kumchin kithoina leh thuchiem lan ding in apeitou uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Hannah pen ahaw tousih a; apasal kungah, “Keivang naupangin nawi angawl masangsie, kang hawtou sih ding hi. Hunkhat chienga Mangpa masanga akilat theina ding in ka hing pui ding a, khum mun ah aum denta ding hi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n apasal Elkanah in amanu kungah “Hoi nasah bang bang in bawl in, nawi na ngawlsah masangsie ngahtadi in, Mangpa’n athu sudet ta hen” achia, tuachi’n numei khu anau nawi angawlsah masangsie a umta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachia nawi angawlsah zou in, tangbuong ephah khat zu savun thawl dim khat leh Bawngtal kum thum a upa khat toh, Shiloh khuo a Mangpa inn ah naupang khu apuitou ta hi. Tualeh naupang khu a neu mama nalai hi.","title":"Hannah in Eli kunga Samuel a puina"},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n bawngtal khu atha zou in naupang khu Eli kung ah ahing pui uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n “Pu aw, nangma na hin mabangin kei khu aw Pu, na kunga ding a Mangpa kunga thu ngennu khu kahi, achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tam naupang ngen in ka thum a, tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka nget ahing peta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin ken zong Mangpa kung ah, ka pie ahi, adamsungteng Mangpa dinga pieh ahi, achia; tuachi’n khum mun ah” Mangpa abie hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Hannah athum a, “Mangpa tung ah ka lungtang a nuom seng seng a; ka kii zong Mangpa ah tawisangin a um hi. Ka melmate tungah ka kam zong letsah in a um a, aziehpen na hundamna ah ka nuom seng seng hi.","title":"Hannah phatna la","ref":"Luk. 1.46-55"},"2":{"text":"“Mangpa banga siengthou koima aum sih, Nangma chilou koima aum sih hi. I pasien uh bang suongpi dang a um sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Kisathei tah in thugen nawnsih unlen, ki uohsahna zong na kam ua pat in pawt sih heh. Mangpa khu pilna Pasian ahi a, Ama’n nna kisemte abuuh zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihatte thalpi atanta a, mi kipalpuate khu hatna a gahin aum uhi."},"5":{"text":"Nieng leh tai a umte’n neh ding asuithu ta ua, tualeh gilkielte khu agilkiel nawnsih uhi. Chiingnu’n ta sagi aneita a, ta tampi neinu abasamta hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n athat a, ahingsah zel hi, han ah apuisuh a, tualeh apuidoh zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa’n a zawngsah a, tualeh ahausa sah zel hi; Aman mi asungiem a, tualeh atawisang zel hi."},"8":{"text":"Aman leivui apat migentheite atung dinga, vut vum akipat khutdawte aphongdoh a, miliente lah ah amauh apangsah a, thupina mangtoupha aluosah hi. Aziehpen leitung kingahna khuomte Mangpa a ahi a, Tuate tungah leitung buppi angam hi."},"9":{"text":"“Ami siengthoute kalsuondan veng vanin, hinanleh migiloute khu miel lah ah asip dide ding uhi; hatna ziehin koiman azou sih ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa doute khu, akehnen dimdem ding ua, van a kipat in vantou in amauh adouding a, kawlmong tawp dong in Mangpa’n vai ahawm dinga; aleengpa kungah hatna ape ding a, athau nupa kii atawisang ding hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elkanah khu Ramah khuo a a inn ah apeita hi. Tualeh naupangpa’n siempu Eli masang ah Mangpa nna asemta hi."},"12":{"text":"Eli tapate khu migiloutah ahi ua, Mangpa athei sih uhi.","title":"Eli tapate khelna"},"13":{"text":"Mipite lah a siempute bawldan ngaina ahileh, min kithoina ahing lat chieng un, sa akihuon laitah in Siempupa suohpain sa thuana tawkeu kathum nei ahing tawi zel hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh khangbel ahiai, singpibel leh khangbel banga akhaina nei ahiei sungah tawkeu in asunsuh a, tua tawkeu kathum a, hing bangkha pouma khu siempu tanvou ahia, akilah zel hi. Khum bangin Israel mi Shiloh a hing pei zousie tungah tuabangin abawl zel uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh asathaute ahal masang un siempu suohpa khu ahing pei a, kithoina hing lanpa kungah, “Siempu a ding em min ding sa hing pie in; nasa huon khu adeisih hi, asiel vateh adei ahi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Khuchin kithoina sil lan mi in akung a “Athaupen kihal sah masa phot unlen tuazou chiengin nadei zaza uh na la nading uhi” anachi chiengin zong, “Hilou e, nangpieh pai ding ahi, nangpieh sihleh ka paulah ding ahi,” achizel hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n tangvalte khelna khu Mangpa mitmu in akhawh sengseng ta a; miten Mangpa kunga sillatte angaidau law gawpta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh, Samuel in aneu lai a pat in, siempu puontuol silin Mangpa nna asem hi.","title":"Shiloh ah Samuel"},"19":{"text":"Tualouin zong anu’n puon ah tuol neu abawlpieh zel a, kumchin a kithoina uh lan dinga apasal toh ahing kuon chiengun ahing puoh zel uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh siempu Eli in Elkanah leh azi khu aguolzawl a, akung uah “Mangpa kunga nalat uh tam sil ziehin Mangpa’n tam numei apat hahlesuon in hing thuh tahen” achia, tuazou in a inn lam uah akinuale zel uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Hannah ave a ahing gai a, tapa thum leh tanu ni anei hi; tuachi’n naupang Samuel khu Mangpa masang ah ahing khanglienta hi."},"22":{"text":"Eli khu ateh sengta a, Israelte tunga atapate gamtatdan teng leh kimutuona biehbuh kot zunga nasem numeite ana luppi dante uh ana zata hi.","title":"Eli tapate tungtangthu"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akung uah,” Bangdinga hichibang silte na bawl uh ahiei? Mizousie a kipat in na gamtat hoiloute uh kana za hi."},"24":{"text":"Ta lawm! ka tapate aw! na tungtang uh kana zahte ahoilou lam ngen ahi. Mangpa mite na takhiel sah uhi."},"25":{"text":"Mi khat midang tunga akhel leh Pasian in thu akhen pieh ding, hinanleh mi Mangpa tunga akhel leh koiin thu anget pieh ta diei? ‘achi hi. Hinanleh Mangpa’n amaute tha atup ziehin apa uh thupiehte asang nuom tuom sih uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n naupang Samuel khu ahing khanglien deudeu a, Mangpa leh mihingte deisah in aum hi.","ref":"Luk. 2.52"},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian mi khat Eli kungah ahing pei a, akung ah Mangpa’n tambang in agen hi, “Izipt gam a Pharaoh Inn a, aum laiun napu napate uh kungah kichien tahin ka kilah sih amah?","title":"Eli vauhilna"},"28":{"text":"Israel namzousie lah a lienpen in ka maitam a gim namtui halding leh ka masang a siempu puontuol sil dingin ama ka teldoh hilou ahiai mah? Tualeh na pa innkuonpite kungah Israel tate a pat a mei a sillat zousie kapieh hilou ahiei mah?","ref":"Pawt. 28.1-4; Siempu. 7.35,36"},"29":{"text":"Bangdinga ka tenna a ka kithoina ding leh sil lat dinga thu kana piehte na peh gawp a, ka mi Israelte sillat zousie ahoipente a, kivahthau dinga, kei sanga na tapate zatatzaw na hiei? achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Israelte Pasian in; keima ngelin na innkuonte leh napa innkuonte zousien kumtawnin ka masang ah nna nasem dinguh ka chi ngei ngut a, achi hi, hinanleh tuin vang Mangpa’n kei a kipat in kikhinmang un; Kei hing zatat te khu ka zatat dinga, tualeh Kei hing simmaw te khu Ken zong ka simmaw ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Ngaiin, na ban thahatna te, napa innkuonte ban thahatnate ka tansan ni hing tung ding ahita, na innsung ah teh kun a dam mawngmawng aum sih ding."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Israel mite Pasian in hausatna zousie apieh hun chiengin ka umna inn ah melma khat na hing mu dinga, tualeh na innsung ah tehsie a dam mawngmawng kumtawn in aumsih ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh na mi, ka maitam a kipat a ka satkhiet louding pen khu na mittang vaidou hitui suohna leh na lungkhamsahpen ahi dinga na innsunga hing pieng poumate khangdawng in ashi zel ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"Khumin na tapate Hophni leh Phinehas tunga hing tung ding khu nanga dingin chiemtena ahi dinga, nikhat thu in ani un ashi ding uhi.","ref":"1 Sam. 4.11"},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu muonhuoitah keima dingin ka tungdoh dinga aman ka lungtang leh ka lungsim toh kituoh in nna asem ding, ama khu inn kiptah in ka siem dinga, tuachi’n ka sathaunu masang ah kumtawn in nna asem ding."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, na innsunga adamsun tapou khu, dangka leh tanghou ngen in akuon ding ua, tanghou themkhat beeh ka neh thei na dingun siempu nna khat hing sem sah dive, achi ding hi, achi hi.”"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Naupang Samuel in Eli nuoi ah Mangpa nna asem a, khum hunlai in Mangpa thu akikhaat mama a, alangtanga kilahna a um zepzep sih hi.","title":"Eli kungah Mangpa thu tung nawnlou"},"2":{"text":"Khum hun laiin hichi ahing hi a, Eli a umna mun a alup lai in amitte ahing miel panta a khuo amuthei mang nawn sih hi.","title":"Samuel kihatna"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian bawm umna Mangpa biehinn a meivah ami masangin Samuel khu imut sawm in alum a."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa’n “Samuel ahan ta a,” tualeh aman “Tanah ka um hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Eli kungah ava tai a, akung ah “Tanah ka um hi, na hing han a,” achi hi. Hinanleh aman “Kahing hankha sih hi, vaki lup ta’n,” achi hi. Tuachi’n apei a alumta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n “Samuel” chi’n ahankia a, tuachi’n Samuel thou doh kia in Eli kungah avapei a, “Tanah ka um hi, nahing han a,” ava chizel hi; hinanleh aman akung ah, “Kahing hansih hi, valum kia ta’n” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Khum hun laiin Samuel in Mangpa athei naisih a, tualeh Mangpa thu zong akungah akiphuongdoh nai tadi sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n athumvei na in Samuel ahing han kiata hi. Tualeh Samuel athou a, Eli kungah avapei a, akung ah, “Tanah ka um hi, na hing han a,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Eli in Mangpa’n naupang khu ahat ahi chi atheita hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Eli in Samuel kungah, “Pei inlen valum ta’n, tualeh ahing hat kia a ahileh, “Mangpa thugen in, na suoh in angai khie hi,” na chi in, achi hi. Tuachi’n Samuel apei a alupna mun ah alumta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa ahing pei a, ahing dinga, ahat ngai bangin, “Samuel! Samuel!” chi in ahing han kiata hi. Aman zong “Thu genin na suoh in a ngaikhie hi” achi ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Samuel kungah, “Ngaiin, Israel gamah aza pouma bil langni ua bil ap huoi khop in silkhat bawl ding ka hi."},"12":{"text":"Khum ni chiengin, a innkuonpite tungtang thu kanagen zousie abul a kipat in atawp dong in Eli tungah ka bawl ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Atapaten Pasian agensietna khelna uh thei zing napi a akhaamlou ziehin a innsung khu kumtawn a dingin gawtna toh vai ka hawm pieh ding hi, chi’n kana hil zouta hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Eli innkuonte kungah, Eli innkuonte gitlouna khu kithoina ahiei, sillat ahiei in bangchih tanin zong siemtangsah nawnsihvang chi’n ka kichiemta hi.” Achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel khu zingmawng dongin alum a, tualeh Mangpa inn kot khahte khu ahong a, tuachi’n Samuel in khum kihilna khu Eli hil ding azauta hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Eli in Samuel ahan a, “Samuel ka tapa” achia, tuachi’n aman zong, “Tanah ka um hi” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Bang ahiei Mangpa’n na kung a agen? Ka kungah bangma imsin; na kung a agen zousie ka kunga im nanei leh na tungah Pasian in alaw law hinglaw tahenlen, khum sanga thupi zaw in zong bawlta hen,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in im neilou keei in abawn in ahilsieng keei a, tuabep in aman “Ama khu Mangpa ahi, pha asah bang bangin bawlta hen,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Samuel ahing khanglien deudeu a, tualeh Mangpa’n ama a umpi a, athugente mawngmawng tuol ah akemangsah sih hi.","title":"Samuel lamkai tha ahina"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Dan a kipat Beersheba dongin Israelte zousien Samuel khu Mangpa guolnei dinga namdet ahita chi ana theita uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa khu Shiloh ah akilah kia a, Mangpa khu Shiloh khuo ah Samuel kungah Mangpa thu in akilah toupeh hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel thu khu Israel mizousie kungah athangkheta hi. Tuachi’n Israelte Philistin mite dou dingin akuonta ua, Ebenezer gei ah panmun abawl ua, tualeh Philistin miten Aphek ah panmun abawl uhi.","title":"Pasian bawm Philistin mite khuta aum na"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistinte khu Israelte doudingin, akiguol ua, ahing kidou tahun Israelte khu Philistinten azouta uhi. Kidouna phuol ah galkap tul li vel athatta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh mipite giehphuol ahingtun tahun, Israel upaten “Bangzieh a tunia Mangpa’n Philistin mite masanga ang guollelsah ahiei? I lah ua a um a igalte lah a kipat ahing hundam theina dingin tua Pasian thuhun bawm khu Shiloh a kipat va pokhe vai achi uhi.”"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipiten Shiloh ah mi asawl ua, Cherubim tegel kikaal a um galkapte Mangpa thuhun bawm khu avalata uhi, tuachi’n Eli tapa tegel Hophni leh Phinehas tua mun ah Pasian Thuhun bawm toh aum ta uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 25.22"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa Thuhun bawm khu agiehphuol ua ahingtun tahin Israelte zousie leithuong kihawt zenin akikouta uhi,"},"6":{"text":"Philistin miten akikou husa uh azah tahun Hebrute giehphuol a kikou thawmging vengvung khu “Bang chidan ahiei le, akichituo uhi;” khumin agiehphuol ua Mangpa bawm tung ahita hi chi athei ta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin mite khu azau ta mama ua, “Pasian giehphuol ah ahing tung hi” achi ua ama un itung agih hi, “Nidangin tambang sil apiengkha naisih hi, achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Itung uh agih hi, tam tha hattah pasiente khut a kipat ahing hundoh ding koi ahiei? Tam pasiente khu ahi, Izipt mite gamdai a, natna chi tuomtuom a thatliate,"},"9":{"text":"“Aw nou Philistin mite aw, nasuoh leh sal ua a um bangun, noute Hebrute suoh leh sal a na umlou na dingun hattah in um unlen, kipasalsah unlen, kihantawh kawm in dou un,” achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin miten adou zel ua, Israelte khu azouta ua, mizousie apuon inn lam chiet uah ataizahta uhi; kithana thupitah ahia, tualeh Israel galkap tul sawm thum ashi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian bawm khu alahpieh ua, tualeh Eli tapate gel Hophni leh Phinehas zong athatta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Benjamin mikhat alutunga lei bang nianua leh apuonsil eehtelsa nemnom pi’n akidou na phuol ua kipat ahing tai a, khum ni main Shiloh ahing tung hi.","title":"Eli leh atapate shina"},"13":{"text":"Amapa ahing tun tahin, Eli in lamgei a touna tung khat a touin; Pasian bawm ziehin lungsim chitun kawm kawm in ana en ngitnget hi. Tualeh tam pasalpa khopi sung ahingtun tahin thu umdan zousie agen leh khopi sunga mizousie akikou zahta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Eli in mikikou husa azah tahin tua thawmging vengvung khu “Bang chidan ahiei?” achia, tualeh tua pasalpa kintahin ahing pei a, thu zousie Eli ahilta hi."},"15":{"text":"Eli khu kum sawmkuo leh kum giet a upa ahita a, amitte amielta a, khuo zong amuthei nawnsih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua mipan Eli kungah, “Keima kidouna phuol a pat a hing pawtdoh a, tunia kidouna phuol a kipat a hing taidoh ka hi,” achi tahi. Tualeh Eli in, “Ka tapa gal kidouna bang asuoh tai?” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n thu hing tut pan adawng a, akung ah, “Philistin mite masang ah Israelte ataizahta hi, tualeh kithana thupitah mipite lah ah aum nalai a, na tapa tegel Hophni leh Phinehas zong ashita ua, Pasian Thuhunbawm zong ahing kilah pieh ta hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing ahia, Pasian thuhun bawm thu ahing genkhah tahin kotgei a atouna a pat in athalpua a, angawng atawng a, ashita hi, tehsie leh gihtah ahi ziehin. Tualeh aman Israelte tungah kum sawmli vai ana hawm hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh amounu Phinehas zi in nau apai a, anau nei ahun mamata hi, tualeh amanu’n Pasian bawm alata uh chi leh a innpipa leh apasal ashita chi thu azah tahin, anauvei in atut ziehin akunsuh a, nau aneikheta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh ashi ding kuon a akunga ding numeiten akung ah, “Zausin tapasal na neita hi,” achi ua, Hinanleh amanu’n adawng tasih a, angaisah tasih hi."},"21":{"text":"Khumin “Thupina in Israel ataisanta hi,” chi’n tua naupang min dingin Ikabod aphuah ta hi, aziehkhu Pasian bawm alah pieh ta ua, a innpipa leh apasal lah ashitah ziah ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n “Pasian thuhun bawm ahing kilah mangpieh tah ziehin thupina in Israel ataisanta hi,” achi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistinten Pasian bawm alata ua, Ebenezer apat in Ashdod khuo ah ahing tutta uhi.","title":"Pasian bawm in Philistin dinga lunggimna atut"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Philistinten Pasian bawm khu ala ua, Dagon umna innsung ah ahing polut ua, Dagon kungah akoita uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Ashdod khuo a mite zingmawng matah a ahingthaw u’leh, Mangpa bawm masang ah Dagon lim khu bohkhup in tuol ah ana pua hi. Tuachi’n Dagon khu ala ua a umna mun ah atungkia uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh azingni zingmawng matah a athaw u’leh ‘En in’ Dagon khu akhup in tuol ah Mangpa bawm masang ah ana pua kia a, tualeh Dagon lutang leh khutphang tegel akitanbongsa in kot phung ah ana um a, Dagon pumpi maimai ana umta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin Dagon siempute leh Dagon biehinn a hing pei zousien Ashodod khuo a Dagon kotphung khu tuni dongin atuon ngam nawnsih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa khut khu Ashodod khuo ah mizousien athuohlaw ta a, sietna atungsahta a, Ashodod khuo leh agam sunga mizousie, uilut natna in agawtta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Ashodod khuo a umte’n sil umdan ahingthei tahun, “Israelte Pasian bawm ikung ua a umlou ding hibou, aziehpen Pasian khut khu itung uah leh i pasien Dagon tungah ithuohla sengta uhi, achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin Philistinte vaihawm zousie akung uah ahankhawm sah ua, akung uah “Israelte Pasian bawm khu bang ilaw diei?” akichituo uhi. Tualeh amaute’n “Israelte Pasian bawm khu Gath khuo lam ah vakoi ta un chi’n” adawng uhi. Tuachi’n amaute’n Israelte Pasian bawm khu Gath khuo lam ah avakoita uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahinghi a, apeipi zou tahun, Mangpa khut in tua khopi tungah sietna nasatah atungsahta a, tua khopi sunga mite alien aneu uilut natna hii atung uah atungsah tahi,"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute’n Pasian bawm khu Ekron khuo ah athahdohta uhi. Tualeh Pasian bawm Ekron khuo ahingtun in, Ekron miten “Ei leh imite thatlia dingin Israelte Pasian bawm ikung uah ahing tutta uhi,” chi’n akikou zahta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin Philistin vaihawmte hankhawm dingin mi asawl ua, akung uah “Eite leh imite ahing thalia louna dingun Israelte Pasian bawm khu hakhedoh unlen, a umna mun ngaima ah va koikiata un,” aziehpen khuo pumpi a mi zousie manthaina khop a shina in buoigawpna a umta hi. Pasian khut lah tua khuo tungah agih mama hi, achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh ashi loute zong uilut in atuom a, tualeh tua khopi a mihingte kikou husa in van athawnta hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian bawm khu Philistinte gamsung ah hasagi aum hi.","title":"Pasian bawm hing kinuale na"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Philistinten siempute leh aisan siemte ahankhawm ua, “Mangpa bawm khu bang ilaw ding uoi? A umna ngai ah bang toh ka hakhe ding uoi?” Hing hil un, achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun “Israelte Pasian bawm na hahkhiet ding u’leh zong aguoh in hakhesih un; ahithei tan in akung ah khelna kithoina lan teitei un, tuachi’n damsah in na um ding ua, tualeh bang ding a akhut khu na tung ua kipat a ladohlou ding ahiei, chi na thei ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama un Akunga, “Tatsietna kithoina sillat a kapieh ding uh khu bang ahi diei?” achi uhi. Amaute’n “Philistin vaihawm milien phazat toh kituoh in, uilut lim a kibawl sana nga leh sansim lim a kibawl sana nga bawl un, tua natna khu noute leh na vaihawmte zousie uh tunga leng hii khu khat ahizieh in,"},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin na uilut lim u’leh na gam uh susetu sansim limte bawl unlen, tualeh Israelte Pasian kungah thupina pia un, tuachi’n na tung u’leh na pasien u’leh na gam sung uah akhut ajangsah ut khamaw sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Pharaoh leh Izipt miten alungtang uh akhausah bang ua bangdinga na lungtang uh khausah nahi uoi? Alah ua sil lamdangtah bawl in a mite apeisah ua, akikhenpi ta uh hilou amah?"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin, tuin bawngleng tha khat bawl unlen bawngpi ni anawi kisuh lai, angawng a hahkol kivawkha ngainailou; tua bawngpi tegel ngawng ah bawngleng khu vaw unlen, tuachi’n anoute khu inn lam ah kaikia un."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa bawm khu la unlen, bawngleng tungah khang unlen; tualeh Mangpa kunga khiel kithoina dinga na silpiehte uh, sana limte khu singkuong sungah thun unlen, Pasian bawm pangah koi unlen; tuachi’n hakhie unlen, peisahta un."},"9":{"text":"Khuchia agamlam uh lampi zui a, Beth-Shemesh zuon in apei naimah? chi en un, apei a ahileh itung ua sil hoilou tah hing tung khu Ama bawl ana hi ding a; apei sihleh eite hing gawt khu Ama khut ahisih hi chi ithei ding ua, itung ua hing tung kha maimai ahiding hi,” achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n miten tuachibangin abawl ua, bawngpi anawi suhlai ni ala ua, bawngleng ah avaw ua, anoute khu inn ah akhum chipta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa bawm khu bawngleng tungah sana a kikheng sansim lim leh uilut limte kikoina singkuong toh akhang khawmta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n bawngpi tegel Beth Shemesh lam zuon in lampi tang taha zuiin ham kawm kawm in apei ua, zietlang ahiei veilang ahiei ah zong apiel vawt sih uhi. Philistin vaihawmten Beth Shemesh gamgi dong azui uhi."},"13":{"text":"Beth-Shemseh khuo a mite phaijanga bu la-a aum’ lai un, adahtou u’leh Pasian bawm khu amu ua, akipah mama uhi.","title":"Beth-Shemesh a Pasian bawm tunkiana"},"14":{"text":"Bawngleng khu Beth Shemesh khuo a um Joshua loulai ah ahinglutta a, suongpi lien khat umna mun ah adingta hi; tualeh bawngleng singte khu asut ua, Mangpa kunga halmang kithoina dingin bawngpi tegel alanta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Levi miten Mangpa bawm leh sana leh silmanpha umna singkuong khu alakhie ua, suongpi lien tungah akoi ua, tualeh Beth-Shemesh khuo a miten khumni main halmang sillatte leh kithoina sillatte, Mangpa kungah alanta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuakhu Philistin vaihawm lien nga ten khumte amu zou un, tuani main Ekron ah aki nualeta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Philistin miten sana a kikheng uilut lim Mangpa kunga khiel kithoina dinga alatte uh khu tamte ahi; Ashdod khuo mite a dingin khat, Gaza khuo mite a dingin khat, Ashkelon khuo mite a dingin khat, Gath khuo a mite a dingin khat, Ekron khuo a mite dingin khat."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh sana a kibawl sansim lim khu, khopi kulpi nei leh singtang khoneute zousie sim in Philistin vaihawmlien nga te khoneiza ahi. Mangpa bawm angahna uh suongpi mama khu Beth Shemesh khuo a teng Joshua loulai ah tutan in aum hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa bawm sung a et ziehun Beth Shemesh khuo a mite agawt a, mi sawmsagi athat a, tuachi’n Mangpa’n mi tampi thalia ziehin amauten asuunta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuazouin Beth-Shemesh khuo a miten “Asiengthou Mangpa Pasian masang a ding ngam ding koi ahiei? tualeh ikung ua kipat in koi kung ah ipeisah diei?” achi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kirjath-Jearim khuo a mite kungah thangkou ding mi asawl ua, tam bangin “Philistin miten Pasian bawm khu ahing paw kiata uhi, hing pei suh unlen hing kilahta un,” achi uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kirjath-Jearim khuo mite apeisuh ua Mangpa bawm alatou ua, singtang a um Abinadab Inn ah atutta ua, atapa Eleazar Mangpa bawm kemtu dingin asusiengthou ta uhi.","title":"Pasian bawm Abinadab inn ah","ref":"2 Sam. 6.2-4; 1 Khang. 13.5-7"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hia, Kirjath-Jearim khuo a Pasian bawm a umsung khu sawtpi ahia, kum sawmni sung ahi, tuachi’n Israel innkuonte zousie’n Mangpa alamnai kiata uhi.","title":"Samuel Israelte vaihawm a apanna"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in Israel innkuonte zousie kungah, “Na lungtang zousie u’toh Mangpa kunga hing kinuale nahi u’leh, gamdang pasiente leh Ashtorethte nalah ua kipat in paimang unlen, nalungtang uh Mangpa a dingin kisa kholsah unlen, Ama nna bou sem un; tuachi’n Philistin mite khut a kipat ahing hunkhe ding hi,” chi’n agen hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelten Baal leh Ashtaroth akoimang ua, Mangpa nna bou asemta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in “Israel mi zousie Mizpah ah hing kikhawm unlen, Mangpa kungah nouma dingin thu ka hing ngetpieh ding hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mizpah ah ahing kikhawm ua, tui atawi ua, Mangpa masang ah asungkhie ua tuamun ah tuani in ann a ngawl ua, “Mangpa tungah ina khielta hi,” achi uhi. Tualeh Samuel in Mizpah ah Israel tate tungah vai ahawmta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistinten Mizpah khuo ah Israel mipite akikhawm uh chi azah tahun, Philistin vaihawm liente khu Israelte dou dingin akuonta uhi. Tualeh Israel taten tua thu azah tahun Philistin mite agiing ta mama uhi.","title":"Philistinte tunga Israelte guolzawna"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelten Samuel kungah, “Philistin mite khuta kipat a ahing hundam thei na dingin, Mangpa i Pasian uh kunga na kikou khu khawlsan vawtsin” achi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in Belamnou nawinelai khat ala a, halmang sillat in apum in Mangpa kungah alanta hi. Israel mite a dingin Samuel in Mangpa ahan a, tuachi’n Mangpa’n adawng hi."},"10":{"text":"Samuel in halmang sillat alatlai tahin, Philistinten Israel doudingin ahing nai deudeu ta uhi. Hinanleh tuani in Mangpa’n Philistinte tungah vanpi ngai tahin aging sah a, tuachi’n a amzahta ua, tualeh Israelte masang ah aguollelta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Israel mite Mizpah a pat in akipankhie ua, Bethkar khuo dongin Philistin mite anuadel ua, athatgamta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in suong khat ala a, Mizpah leh Shen kikal ah aphut a, “Tamtan chieng Mangpa’n ahing panpi hi” chi in amin dingin Eben-ezer achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin mite anuoisieta ua, Israel gam ah ahing nualut kia nawn tasih uhi; tualeh Samuel damsung tengin Mangpa khut in Philistin mite adou zing ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Philistinten Israelte khuo alahpieh zousiete uh Ekron a kipan Gath tan in, Israelten Philistinte khut a kipat anualah kia uhi, tualeh Amor mite leh Israel kikaal ah zong kilemna ahing umta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in adamsung tengin Israelte tungah vai ahawm hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in kumchin in Bethel, Gilgal leh Mizpah, khuote ave zel a tua khuote a kipan Israelte vai ahawmpieh hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh atenna khuo Ramah ah ahing pei kia zel a tuamun ah Israelte vai ahawmpieh a, tualeh tuamun ah Mangpa a dingin maitam khat abawl hi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahinghi a, Samuel ahingteh bep in atapate Israelte tungah vaihawm in abawl hi.","title":"Israelten leeng khat angetna uh"},"2":{"text":"Atapa tahpen min Joel ahia, aninapa min, Abijah; ahi. Amautegel in Beer-Sheba ah vai ahawm uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh atapaten ama umdan azuisih uhi; gin umlou tahin sum leh pai asui ua, golguhnate ala ua, thudih khu alengatsanta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel upate zousie ahing kikhawm ua Ramah khuo a Samuel kungah ahing pei ua,"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh akung ah, “En in, natehta a, na tapaten lah na umdan azuisih ua, namdangte bangin ka tung ua vaihawm ding leeng khat hing guot pieh in” achita uhi.","ref":"Danp. 17.14"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh akung a, “Vaihawm ding leeng khat hing pie in” achi thu un, Samuel alungkimsah tasih hi. Tuachi’n Samuel Mangpa kungah athumta hi."},"7":{"text":"Khumin Mangpa’n Samuel kungah, “Mipiten na kung a agen zousie khu zui in; nangma ahingdeilou zieh uh ahi sih a, atung ua leeng a um dingin, keima hing nuol ahizaw uhi."},"8":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipat a kapuidoh ni a kipat tuni dongin asil bawldan zousie uah ahing lengatsan ua, pasien dangten nna ahing sepsan zel uh mabangin nangma tungah zong abawl uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin tu’n, athu uh ngaikhie inlen, ahivangin atung ua vaihawm ding leengpa gamtatdan ding chientah leh guntah in akung uah hilchien masa in” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in Mangpa thu zousie leengpa ngen mipite kungah ahilchien ta hi.","title":"Samuel in Israelte ahilchienna"},"11":{"text":"Aman “Natung ua vaihawm ding leengpa gamtatdan dingte tambang ahi ding hi; natapate uh sakol leh asakolleng hawl ding leh atunga tuong dingte aguot ding a, sakolleng masang a taiding mi zong aguot ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh galkap tul khat tunga lamkai ding leh sawm nga tunga lamkai ding, kim khatte aloukai ding leh abu at ding in akoi dinga, kimkhat te kidouna galvante kheng ding leh sakolleng bawl dingin apang sah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Aman na tanute uh gimnamtui siemding leh ann huonding, tualeh tanghou bawl dingin azang ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Aman nalou hoipente uh, na grep huonte u’leh na olive huon hoi penpente uh ahing lahpieh dinga, a suohte kungah ape ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Aman nabu leh balte uh leh na grepte uh sawma khat ahing lahpieh dinga, asuohte leh alamkaite uh kungah ape ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Aman na suohpate u’leh na suohnute uh na tangval mel hoipente u’leh na sabiltungte uh ang lahpieh ding a, ama nna asemsah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na Belam honte lah a a sawma khat ahing lahpieh dinga, tualeh noute asuoh in napang ta ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh khum hun chiengin nouma ngelin na tel uh, leengpa ziehin nakap ding ua, hinanleh tuahun chiengin Mangpa’n ahing ngaikhe sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh mipiten Samuel thugen khu adeisih uhi; amaun “Hilou e, ka tung ua vaihawm dingin leeng khat ka nei ding uhi,"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n koute zong nam dangte bangin ka leengpa un ka tung uah vai ahawm dinga, tualeh ka masang ua peiin ka galte uh ahing doupi ding hi.”"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in mipite zousie thugen khu angaikhie a, Mangpa kungah atutsawnta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Samuel kungah, “Athugen uh ngaikhiet pieh inlen leeng khat bawlpieh in” achi hi. Tuachi’n Samuel in Israel mite kungah, “Mizousie nouma khopi chiet ah peita un” achi hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin gam a, Benjamin mi mihat leh hangsan mama khat a um a, amin Kish ahi; tuakhu Abiel tapa ahia, tuakhu Zeror tapa ahia, tuakhu Bekorah tapa ahia, tuakhu Aphiah tapa ahi.","title":"Saul leeng ding a tel na"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aman tapa khat aneia, amin Saul ahi, tangval deihuoitah leh melhoitah ahi. Israel tate lah ah ama sanga duong ching leh melhoi koima aum sih hi: aliengkou sanga sang zaw koima a um sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Saul pa Kish Sabiltungte amanga, Kish in atapa Saul kungah, “Hepitahin kisa inlen suohte khat pui inlen Sabiltungte va suita vawi un,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Ephraim singtang gam leh Shalisha gam atuon suoha, hinanleh amu sih uhi. Tualeh Shaalim gam zong ava tuon suoh ua amu sih uhi. Tualeh Benjamin mite gam ava tuon suoh ua, hinanleh amu zou tuom sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Zuph gam ahingtun tahun, Saul in azawpi asuohpa kungah, “Hingpeiin nua kiata maivai akhuchi sih leh ka pa’n sabiltungte ngaituo nawnlou in eitegel hing na lunggimpi zaw tava,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh asuohpa’n akungah, “Ngaiin, tam khuo ah Pasian mikhat a um a, mizatat huoitah ahia, agen zousie ahing tung teitei zel hi, kisa in khunah va haw vai, ipei nading lampi ang hil thei khamaw sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in asuohpa kungah, “Ahina a en in, vahaw talei tua mipa adingin bang ipuoh diei? Ithungpi sunga itanghou puohte lah abeita a, tua Pasian mipa ipieh ding bangma a um nawnsih hi, bang inei nalai ei le?” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh asuohpa’n Saul adawng kia a, akungah, “En ve, Dangka Shekel khat se li sua sekhat tanah ka nei nalai hi, ipei nading lampi ahing hil man dingin Pasian mipa ka pe ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"(Nidang laiin Israelte lah ah, min Pasian adoh nop chiengun, tambangin achi uhi, “Hingpei vawi, Mutheipa kung ah vahaw tavai” achi ua, aziehpen tulai a guolnei kichi khu masang laiin Muthei ana chi uhi)."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in asuohpa kungah, “Hoi e, vahaw tavai leh,” achi a, tuachi’n Pasian mi umna khuo ah ava hawta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Khopi lam zuona muol langa apeitou laiun, nungah hon khat tuitawi dinga hingkuon amu ua, akung uah, “Mutheipa tanah a um ei?” chi’n adong uhi.","title":"Samuel in Saul akimupina"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh amaun um mah e, “En un, na masang uah apei hi, kinaw un; tuni’n mipiten mun sanga kithoina anei zieh un tam khopi ahing haw ahi, chi’n adawng uhi."},"13":{"text":"Khosung na lut lut chiengun, munsanga ann nedinga apeitou masanga, nava mupai ding uh ahi. Tua kithoina khu ama’n aguolzawl masah ding ahi, ziehin; amapa hing tun masangsie’n mipiten ann ane sih ding uhi, tua zou chiengin amichielte un aneding uhi. Tuaziehin peitou meng un, hichi hun laitahin ama nava mupaiding uhi,” achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n khopi ah apeitou ta uhi, tualeh khopi sung alut laitah un, munsanga peitou ding, amaute lam zuon a hing pei Samuel toh akituoh uhi."},"15":{"text":"Saul va pei masang nikhat aumlai in Mangpa’n Samuel kungah ana genta hi."},"16":{"text":"“Zingchieng tuhun laitahin, Benjamin gam akipat mikhat ka hing sawl ding a, nangman amapa khu ka mi Israelte tunga vaihawm dingin sathau na nu ding ahi, Philistin mite khut akipat ka mite ahundam theina dingin; akikouna aw uh ka kunga ahing tuntaah ziehin, ka mite ka ngaisahta hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in Saul amutah in, Mangpa’n akungah, “En vawi, na kunga kana genpa, amapa’n ka mite tungah vai ahawm ding hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in Samuel khu kelkot ah ava zuon a, akungah, “Hepitahin hing hil in, Mutheipa inn heisung ahiei?” a chi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in Saul adawnga, akungah, “Tua Mutheipa khu keima ka hi; munsang tandongin ka masangah pei inlen, tuni’n ka kungah ann na ne ding hi; tualeh zing chiengin ka hing peisah dinga, tualeh na lungsim a um zousie zong kang hil sieng ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh ni thum masanga na sabiltung mangsate tungtang thu ah lung himaw nawn sin, akimuta hi. Tualeh Israelte lunggul zousie koi tunga um ding ahiei? Nang leh na pa innsung mite ading hilou ahiei mah?” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Saul in adawnga akungah, “Israel namte lah a neupen Benjamin nam a mi kahi sih amah? tualeh ka innkuon sung u’zong Benjamin innkuon zousie lah a, aneupen ahi sih amah? Bangchidan a kei kunga tambang thute na gen ahiei?” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in Saul leh asuohpa azawpi a, michiel tuomte pindan sungah apuilut a, misawm thum vel chieltuom a umte dinga mun zatathuoi ah atou sahta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in annhuonpa kungah, “Na kunga koituom ding chia, ka hing pieh khu hing tawi in,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n annhuonpa’n amal leh atunga um khu ahing tawi a, Saul masangah ahing lui a. Tualeh Samuel in “En vawi, ka hing tuom koi pieh khu na masangah akiluita hi, Nein; mi kana chiel khawmta hi, kachi ni akipat a, tutan a ana kikoituom khu ahi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Saul in khum ni in Samuel toh ann anekhawmta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Munsang akipat a, khopi sung ahing peisuh un, Samuel in ainn tungah Saul ahoupi hi."},"26":{"text":"Zingmawng matah in athou ua, ni suoh ding kuon velin Samuel in “Inntung langah Saul ahan a, kisa in ka hing pei sahta ding hi” a chi hi. Tuachi’n Saul adingdoha, tualeh Saul leh Samuel, ani un pulam ah apawtdohta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuabanga khogei lam a apeisuh laiun, Samuel in Saul kungah, “Suohpa khu masa sahin achia (tuachi’n amasa ta hi). Hinanleh nangpen tanah khawltadi inlen, Pasian thu ka hing theisah theina dingin,” achi hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in sathau bawm khat ala khie a, Saul lutungah asunga, atawpa, akungah, “Mangpa’n agoutante tunga vaihawm dingin sathau ahing nu hilou ahiei mah? achi hi.","title":"Samuel in Saul leengpa dinga sathau anuna"},"2":{"text":"Tunia ka kunga kipata na peidoh chiengin Benjamin gam leh Zelzah gamgi a Rachel han gei ah, mi ni na kituohpi dinga, tualeh amaun na kung ah, sabiltung na suite khu akimuta hi, tu’n napa’n sabiltungte alung khampi nawn sih a, “Ka tapa bang ka lawta diei?” chi’n nangma ahing lunggimpi zawta hi, achi hi, ahing chi ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuamun akipat in na mailam uah na pei zel ding ua, Tabora Gangpi sing phung na tung ding ua, khum mun ah mithum Bethel a Pasian kunga haw dingten ahing kituohpi ding ua, khat in kelnou thum apodinga, khat pen pa’n tanghou beuthum, tualeh adang khat penpa’n uoin savun thawl khat apo ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh amaun ahing chibai ding ua, tualeh tanghou beu ni ahing pe ding ua, tua khu akhut uapat nasang ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuazou Chieng in Philistin galkapte umna Gibeah a Pasian muol na tung ding ua, tualeh hichi ahi ding a, khuo na tun kuon chieng un, guolnei hon khat mun sanga kipata hing pei suh, amasang ua, pehging, khuongta, theile leh kaiging tumte na kituohpi ding ua, amauten thu mavang agen ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa Hagau na tungah ahing tung ding a, tuachi’n nang zong amautoh, thu mavang na gen khawmta dinga, tuachi’n mituom na hing suohta ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tam chiemtenate na tunga ahing tun chieng in, sil hing umdan dungzui zel a, na bawl ding ahi, Pasian in ahing umpi ding zieh in."},"8":{"text":"Ka masangah Gilgal ah na haw masa inlen; tualeh, kei zong halmang sillatte leh lemna kithoina sillatte, lan dingin, na kungah ka hing pei ngeingei ding hi, ka hing pei masangsie nisagi tan nang na ngah dinga, tuachi’n na bawl ding ka hing hil ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh hichibang ahing hi ngut ma a, Samuel peisan dinga anuangatsan laitah in, Pasian in lungtang tuom apeta hi. Tualeh tua chiemtena zousie khum ni mama in atung siengta hi.","title":"Saul kinuale kiana"},"10":{"text":"Saul leh asuohpa Gibeah muol ahing tun tahun, guolnei honkhat in Saul ana kituohpi ua; tuachi’n Pasian Hagau atungah ahing tunga, tuachi’n aman zong alah uah thumavang agenta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, tumasanga ama na theisaten, guolneite lah ah thumavang gen in apang chi amu tah un, mite khat leh khat akihou ua, “Kish tapa tunga sil hing tung khu bang chidan atai leh?” Saul zong guolneite lah ah pangta hi maw? akichi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh khuna teng mi khat in adawnga, “Apate uh koi ahi uoi?” achia, “Tuaziehin Saul zong guolneite lah a khat ahita amah?” chi khu paunah khat ahing hita hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 19.23,24"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in thumavangte agen zou in, munsang ah apeitou ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Saul paneu in Saul leh asuohpa kungah, “Heilang a vahaw nahi uoi?” achia, tuachi’n aman a kungah, “Sabiltung vasui kahi ua, tualeh ka muzoulou tahun Samuel kungah kava hawta uhi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul paneu in akungah, “Samuel in na kungah bang ahiei agen, hepitahin hinghil in,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in a paneu kungah, “Sabiltungte akimuta hi chi chientahin ahing hil hi,” achi hi. Hinanleh leenggam tungtang Samuel in agente ahil sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in mipite Mizpah khuo a Mangpa kungah ahankhawm a.","title":"Saul leeng hina thuphuon"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate kungah, “Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi, Israelte Izipt akipat in ka puidoh a, Izipt mite khuta kipat leh nouma nuoisie taha hingbawlgenthei leenggam zousiete khut a kipat in ka hing hundoh a."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh tunia na gentheina zousie u’leh na chimawna zousie ua hing hundohpa na Pasian uh na dei nawn sih ua, akungah leengkhat hing bawl piehin nachi zawta uhi. Tuaziehin tuin anam anam leh aphung aphung in Mangpa masang ah hing kilang un,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in Israel nam zousie ahing kilat sah zouin, Benjamin nam khu teldoh ahing hita hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Benjamin namte a innkuon, ainnkuon a akilatsah laiin, Matri innkuon tel in aumta hi. Tualeh Kish tapa Saul khu telin aumta hi, tualeh ahing suitah un amuzouta sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa adong kia ua, “Tua mipa khu tamlangah ang pei kha ei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n Mangpa’n adawnga, “Amapa khu vanlom lah ah akibu hi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n atai ua ava puidohta uhi, tualeh mipi lah a ahing din leh mite lah ah asang pen a, koima aliengkou sanga sangzaw a um sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in mipi zousiete kungah, “Mangpa miteldohpa khu na mu uoi? mipite zousie lah ah amabang koima aum sih uhi,” achi hi. Tualeh mipi zousie akikou ua, “Pasian in leengpa humbit hen,” achi ta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in mipite kungah, leenggam um danding ahil chienta a, tualeh laibu sungah agiel a, Mangpa masangah akoita hi. Tuachi’n Samuel in mipite ainnlam chiet ua peidingin asawlta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Saul zong Gibeah khuo a ainnlam zuonin apeita hi. Tualeh mihangsan Pasian in alungtang uh akhoi pieh ten zong azui uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh mi-hel leh gilou koite ahieiin, “Tam mipa’n bang ahing chi hundam ding adiei?” achi ua, tuachi’n amapa asimmaw ua, tualeh kipahman silpieh zong apenuom sih uhi. Hinanleh amapa asip khinkhian hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ammon mi Nahash ahing kuontou a, Jabesh-Gilead dou dingin giehphuol ava sat khuma, tualeh Jabesh-Gilead mite zousie’n Nahash kungah, “Ka kung uah kilemna thuhun bawl inlen, tuachi’n na nna ka semding uh,” achi uhi.","title":"Saul in Jabesh Gilead ahuhdohna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Ammon mi Nahash in amauh adawnga, akung uah, “Tambangin noute toh kilemna thu hun ka bawl ding hi, Na mit zietlam zousie uh ka kheikhe dinga; tuakhu Israel nam pumpi a dingin minsietna ahi ding hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jabesh khuo a upaten akungah, “Israel gamsung pumpi a thangkou ka sawltheina ding un ni sagi hing na hungaitadi in, tuazou chieng a, koute hing hundam ding koima a um sih leh nangma kungah ka hing kipelutna ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n thangkou asawlte uh Saul umna Gibeah khuo ahing tung ua, tualeh mipiten abil ua azahna ngel ua tua thute agen tahun; mipite aw ngaitah a kikou in akapta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh, lou akipat in bawnghon nua ah Saul bawng hawl in ahing pei a, tualeh Saul in “Bang achi ua ahiei mipite ahichi ka uh?” achi hi. Tuachi’n amaun Jabesh khuo a mite thugen ahil ua."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in tam thu azah tahin, Pasian Hagau atungah ahingtunga, tuachi’n hatangpi’n alungthahta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n bawngtal kop khat agou a, asa asem nena, Israel gamsung zousie ah thangkoute ahawm sah a, akung uah, “Koipou kidouna a Saul leh Samuel nua zui utlou pouma, abawngtal uh tambanga bawl ding ahi achi hi;” Tuachi’n Mangpa giinna khu mipite tungah ahing tuta a, pum khat banga kithutuoh in ahing kuondohta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Saul in Bezek khuo a, ama uh asim leh Israel mite tul zathum apha ua, Juda mite tul sawmthum apha uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun thangkou hing peite kungah, “Jabesh Gilead a umte kungah tambangin na gen ding uhi, zingchieng nisat sanlaitahin, hundoh nahi ding uh, vachi un,” achi ua, tuachi’n thangkoute ahing pei ua, Jabesh mite ava hiltah un, ana kipah mama uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jabesh miten Ammon mite kungah, “Zing chiengin na kung uah ka hing kipelut ding uhi, tuachi’n ka tung ua hoi nasah bangbang un bawl mai un,” achi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n azingni in hichi ahing hia, Saul in mipite khu hon thumin akhen a; tualeh zingmawng galven hun laitahin agiehphuol sung uah alut ua, Ammon mite khu sun nisa ham laitah dongin athat uhi. Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, ahing sunte zong akithezah sieng ua, mi ni a umkhawm mawngmawng in zong a nua sieta sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipiten Samuel kungah, “Saul in itung ah vai ahawm na ngel diei chi khu koi ahiei? Tua mite hing kaikhie in ka that ding uhi,” achi uhi.","title":"Saul leeng dinga aphuondohna uh"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Saul in “Tuni’n koima tha ahi sih ding, aziehpen tuni’n Mangpa’n Israelte lah a hundamna abawlta hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in mipite kungah “Hing pei un, Gilgal ah iva hawding ua, tuamun ah Lenggam ibawl tha ding uh,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi zousie Gilgal ah ava pei ua, tualeh Gilgal a Mangpa masangah Saul khu leeng in abawlta uhi. Tua mun ah amauten Mangpa masangah lemna kithoinate alan ua, tualeh tua mun ah Saul leh Israelte zousie akipah mama uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tuin Samuel in Israel mi zousie kungah “Ngaiun, ka kunga nagen zousie uh ka hing bawl piehta hi, tualeh na tung ua leeng ding zong ka hing guot piehta hi.","title":"Samuel in vaihahna thu agen"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh, tu’n, leengpa’n na mauh akaita hi, keipen ka tehta a ka sam zong a kaangta hi, tualeh en un, ka tapate zong na kung uah aum uhi, tualeh ka neu lai apat tuni tandongin na lamkai un ka pang hi."},"3":{"text":"Ngai un tanah ka um hi, Mangpa leh asathau nupa masangah hing niel un, koi bawngtal ahiei ka lahpieh ngai? ahisihleh koi Sabiltung kalah pieh ngai ei? koi kabawl genthei ngai ei? Ahisihleh ka mit tawsah dingin koi khuta kipat ahiei golguhna ka lah? ka hing din sieng kia ding hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh amaun akungah, “Nang sol ngai sih a, nang bawl genthei sih a, koima khut akipat in lahtuohlou zong nala ngai sih hi,” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Ka khut ah bangma kilawmlou namu sih uh chi tuni’n Mangpa na lah uah atheipipa ahi a, asathau nupa zong tuni’n atheipipa ahi,” achi hi. Tualeh amaun, “Ama atheipipa ahi” chi’n adawng uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in mipite kungah, “Mosi leh Aaron teldohpa leh Izipt gam a kipata napu leh pate uh puidoh pa khu Mangpa ahi.","title":"Samuel in Jehovah hutdohna agen kiana","ref":"Pawt. 6.26"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin ding khinkhian un, Mangpa masang ah, na tung u’leh napu leh pate uh tunga Mangpa’n sil dihtaha ana bawldante zousie ka hing sutpi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Izipt gam a Jakob alut nua in, napu leh pate un Mangpa ahan ua, tuachi’n Mangpa’n Mosi leh Aaron asawl a, amaute gel in Izipt gam a kipat in napu leh pate uh ava puidoh ua, tualeh tammun ah ateng sahta uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 2.23"},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun Mangpa a Pasian uh amanghil ua, tuachi’n Aman Hazor galkap lamkai Sibera khut ah leh Philistin mite khutah tualeh Moab leengpa khut ah azuata a, tualeh amauten adou uhi.","ref":"Vai. 4.2; Vai. 13.1; Vai. 3.12"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute Mangpa han in akikou ua, Mangpa ka taisanta ua, Baal leh Ashtorethte nna kana sep tah zieh un, sil kabawl khielta uhi, hinanleh ka melmate uh khut akipat in hing hundoh inlen, tuachi’n Nangma nna ka semta ding uhi, achi u hi.","ref":"Vai. 10.10-15"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Jerubaal bang, Barak bang, Jeptha bang, Samuel bang asawl a, tualeh munchin a na galte uh khut akipat in ahing hundohta a, tuachi’n bittahin na umta uhi.","ref":"Vai. 7.1;
