Vai. 4.6; Vai. 11.29; 1 Sam. 3.20"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Ammonmite leengpa Nahash noute dou dinga hingkuon namu tahun, ka kungah, Ahisih, ka tung uah Lengpa’n vaihawm zaw heh, nachi ua, Mangpa na Pasian uh na leengpa uh hina piin.","ref":"1 Sam. 8.19"},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin en un, na lunggul bang ua na teldoh pa uh leeng, tanah aum hi, tualeh ngaiun Mangpa’n leengpa ahing bawlpiehta hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa giindan na siem ua, anna nasep ua, athu na man ua, tualeh Mangpa thupiehte dou a, na kiphin sih u’leh, tuachi’n noute na tung ua vaihawm leengte leh Mangpa na Pasian uh thu zuite nahi ding ua, ahoi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa thu na ngaikhieh sih ua, Mangpa thupiehte na helsan ua, na kiphin u’leh, napu leh pate un, Mangpa khut athuoh mabangun noute’n zong na thuoh ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin ding khinkhian unlen, Mangpa’n na mitmu ua, sil thupitah abawl ding khu en un."},"17":{"text":"Tuni khu bu lahni hilou ahiei mah? Mangpa ka han dinga Aman van ging leh guo ahing sawl dinga, tuachi’n leengpa na ngetna thu uah, Mangpa mitmu a sil na bawl khelna uh thupidan, nathei ding ua, tualeh namu ding uhi,” achi hi.","title":"Van ging leh guo a chiemtena"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in Mangpa ahan a, tualeh khum niin Mangpa’n van ging leh guo asawl a, tuachi’n mipi zousien Mangpa leh Samuel nasatah in agiing mama ta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh mipite zousie in Samuel kungah, “Ka shi louna dingun Mangpa na Pasian kungah, na suohte thu hing nget pieh mengin, tam sil hoiloutah leengpa kana ngetna ziehun ka gitlouna uh ka belap sawn sawnta uhi,” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in mipite kungah, “Zau sih un, tam silgilou zousie nana bawlta ngutngei uhi, hinanleh Mangpa na zuina ukhu pielsan tuom sih unlen, na lungtang zousie un Mangpa nna semzaw un."},"21":{"text":"Kinepna ding bangmalou leh nou hing hundam theilou zui in pielsan sih unlen, phattuomna neilou ahi ziehun."},"22":{"text":"Amin thupitah ziehin Mangpa’n lah amite alengatsan sih dinga, noute Ama mi dinga bawl khu Mangpa kipahna lamtah ahizaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuathamlouin noute dinga kathumnate tawpsan in Mangpa tungah ka gamta khiel sih dinga, hinanleh lampi hoi leh dih ka hing hil zaw ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Mangpa giindan siem phot mai unlen, na lungtang zousie un chitah leh muonhuoi tahin Ama nna sem unlen, noute dinga silthupi abawldante ngaituo zaw un."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh giloutah a, na bawl nahlai lai u’leh noute na leengpa uh pumin phietmang in na um ding uhi,” achi hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul kum sawm thum ahiin vai ahawm pan a; Tualeh Israete tung ah kum ni vai ahawm hi.","title":"Saul in Philistinte adouna"},"2":{"text":"Saul in Israel mi tul thum ateldoha, tul nite khu Mikmash leh Bethel singtang gam a Saul kung ah aum ua, tualeh tul khatte pen Banjamin gam a Gibeah ah Jonathan kungah aum uhi, tualeh adang zousie khu apuon inn lam chiet uah anua sawl kiata hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Jonathan in Geba a Philistin galveng mite panmun ava sim a, tuakhu Philistin miten ana za ua. Tuachi’n Saul in “Hebru miten naza uheh” chi’n agam pumpi ah pengkul amut sah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Israelte zousie in Saul in Philistin galvil galkapte asim chi leh Israelten zong Philistin mite huot in aum uh chi thute ana zata uhi. Tuachi’n mipite Gilgal ah Saul kungah akikai khawmta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin mite khu Israelte dou dingin akikhawmta ua, Sakol tul sawm thum, sakol tung tuong tul guh leh galkapmi tuipi pieu a senel bang mai a tam ahi uhi. Tualeh akuontou ua, Beth-Aven apata nisuona lam panga, Mikmash mun ah panmun akhaw uhi.","title":"Saul sillat khelna"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Israel galkap miten imchimit ahita uh chi akitheitah un (mipite achimaw mama hi) tualaitah in mipite leihawm sungah, lingnoh lah ah, Suonghawm lah leh suongpi pang lah pou ah, akibuta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Hebru mi lawikhatte khu Jordan gal a Gad leh Gilead gam ah atai ua, Saul pen Gilgal ah aum a, tualeh mipi zousie’n chitun pum in ama azui uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in aguotsa hun bituh dungzui in nisagi Saul in ana ngah a, hinanleh Samuel Gilgal ah ahing peita sih hi, tuachi’n mipiten Saul ataisan siengta uhi.","ref":"1 Sam. 10.8"},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin Saul in “Halmang sillat leh lemna sillat khu ka kungah hing tawi un,” achia, tuachi’n ama’n halmang sillatte alanta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, halmang sillatte alatzou tahin ngai in Samuel ahing tunga, tuachi’n ama vadawn ding leh chibai buh dingin Saul apawtta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in akungah “Bang ahiei nana bawl?” achi hi. Tualeh Saul in “mipiten ahing taisan uh chi ka thei a, tualeh nanglah na nichiem sunga na hing tunlou zieh in, tualeh Philistin mite lah Mikmash ah akikhawm uh chi ka thei ngal a."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Philistin miten Gilgal a hing kuon suhin hing dou ding ahita ua, ken lah Mangpa kungah, deisahna ka ngen naisih a, tuaziehin bawllou theilou in ka kingaituo a, halmang sillat kana lanta hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in Saul kungah, “Mot huoi tahin sil na bawlta hi. Mangpa na Pasian thu pieh, nangma ahing thupieh na zui sih hi. Mangpa’n Israelte tunga na lalna kumtawn a suhdet tum hi maven izaw."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh tu’n vang na leenggam atawpta ding hi, Mangpa’n thu ahing pieh na zuilou ziehin. Mangpa’n Ama lungtang bang puo mi asui a, tualeh Mangpa’n ama khu amite, tunga vaihawm dingin aguotta hi.”","ref":"Nasep. 13.22"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel adingdoh a, Gilgal a kipat in Benjamin gam a Gibeah khuo ah apeitouta hi. Tualeh Saul in akunga mipi umte asimleh, zaguh vel ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Saul leh atapa Jonathan leh akunga umte Benjamin gam a Gibeah khuo ah a um ua, hinanleh Philistinten Mikmash ah pan mun abawl uhi.","title":"Galdou dinga kisahna"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin mite giehphuol akipat in galbawl mite pawl thumin ahing kuon ua, pawl khat in Shual gam a Ophrah zotna lampi azuon uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh pawl dang khat in Beth Horon zotna lampi azui ua, tualeh pawl dang khatten gamdailam toh kinai Zeboim phaijang kimuna gamgi lampi zuiin apei uhi."},"19":{"text":"Israel gamsung pumpi ah sia kheng mawngmawng koima a um sih uhi, aziehkhu Philistin miten, “Hebru miten namsau ahiei, teipi ahiei, abawl kha ding uh” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel mi zousiein, alei laina uh khenchi heipi leh atupite uh taat hiem dingin Philistinte kungah ahaw suh zel uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh khenchi leh tupite khenman khu Shekel sethum suosekhat ahia, tualeh heipite khenman leh ze zang man khu Shekel sethum suo sekhat ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin kidou ni ahing tun tahin, Saul leh Jonathan kunga um mipite khut ah, namsau leh teipi khat zong aumta sih hi. Hinanleh Saul leh atapa Jonathan in tuate anei uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Philistin galkapte Mikmash phaihawm ah apawtdohta uhi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh ni khat khu hichi ahing hia, Saul tapa Jonathan in agalvan puo tangvalpa kungah, “Kisa in, gallang khat a Philistin galkapte umna ah iva pei ding hi,” achi hi. Hinanleh apa ahil sih hi,","title":"Jonathan galzawna thupi"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Saul khu Gibeah pulam a Migron mun a kolbuthei sing nuoi ah atou a, akunga galkap umte khu zaguh vel ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Shiloh khuo a Mangpa siempu Eli tapa Phinehas tapa Ikabod sanggampa Ahitup tapa Abijah zong siempu puonahtuol silin a um hi. Hinanleh Jonathan akuonta chi mipite koiman athei sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Jonathan in Philistin galkapte panmun a va peisuh atupna guom leh guom kikaal alang tuoh ah suongpi sangtah a um tuoh a, khat min Bozez ahia, tualeh adang khat pen min Seneh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Kawl suongpi khat khu Mikmash toh kigalsai, mallam a um ahia, suongpi dang khat pen Gibeah toh kigalsai simlam, a um ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan in agalvan tawi tangvalpa kungah, “Hing pei vawi, tam teptanlou galkapte umna ah vahaw tavai, Mangpa’n ei a dingin sil hingbawl pieh khamawlou ding hi, Mangpa ading in tam leh tawm thuin hundamna adal tuom sih hi” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n agalvan tawipan akungah, “Na lungsim a um bang tahin bawl in, en in, keima na kungah ka um hi, na lungsim bang bang ka puo hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan in, “Ngai vawi, akung uah iva galkai dinga, iva kimu sah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaun ikunga, Na kung ua ka hing pei masang sie uh hing na ngahun achi u’leh, i umna mun ah ding khinkhian vaiin, akung uah vapei davai."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh ka kung uah hing peitou un achi u’leh, iva peitou dinga; Mangpa’n amaute ikhut ah ahing pie hi chi ei a dingin chiemtena ahi ding” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute gel zong ani un Philistin galveng mite ava kimu sah ua, tualeh Philistin miten “En vawi un, Hebru mite akibutna uh leikohawm akipat in ahing pawldohta uhi,” achi ua."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n galveng galkapten, Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa ahan ua, ka kung uah “Hing peitou unlen, sil khat ka hing ensah ding uhi,” achi ua. Tualeh Jonathan in agalvan tawipa kungah, “Hing zui in Mangpa’n amaute Israelte khut ah apekheta hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan akhut leh keng toh pangin akaltou a, agalvan tawipa’n azui hi, tualeh amaute Jonathan mai ah apuata ua, tualeh agalvan tawipa’n anua ah athat zuizel hi."},"14":{"text":"Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa’n atha masah chiil un lou chiing kimkhat sungah mi sawmni vel athat uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkapte zousie tung ah buoi na ahing tunga, giehphuol sung leh kidouna phuol a umte tualeh galveng mite umna mun leh galbenga kuon galkapte nangawn leh mipite zousie chitun in akiling siengta ua. Tualeh leitung zong zil akilinga; tuachi’n chitutna leh kilinna nasatah ahing umta hi.","title":"Israelten Philistinte aluna uh"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Benjamin gam a Gibeah muna Saul galveng miten ana en ua, tualeh ngaiin, mite azun in azunkhe zeng zung ua; lelam lelam ah akiphutuo niai nuai uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in akunga um mite kungah, “Tuin kisim unlen, ilah uah koi ahiei kimlou um, en un” achi hi. Tuachia ahing kisim u’leh ngaiin, Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa ana umta sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in Ahijah kungah, “Pasian bawm tam langah hing la un” achi hi (khum hunlai in Israel tate toh Pasian thuhun bawm aum khawm hi)."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, Saul in siempupa ahoupi zing laiin, Philistin galkapte giehphuol a buoina husa a huoise semsem a, Tuachi’n Saul in siempu kungah “Nakhut nua kai in,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul leh akunga mipi um zousie akikhawm ua, kidouna mun ah avapei ua; tualeh ngai vawi, Philistin galkapte zousie amauleh amauh khat lekhat namsau a kisattuo, buoina chizat huoi tah um khu ava muta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuathamlouin, tumasang lai a, khum gam a na um Hebru mite, Philistinte panpi a, agiehphuol ua va umte na ngawn zong, Saul leh Jonathan kunga um Israelte lamah alepanta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuamabangin Ephraim singtang gam a kiphuol Israel mite zousie’n zong Philistin mite ataizahta uh chi ana zahtahun, amaute zong kidouna a pangin hadel in ava nua delta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n khum niin Israelte tuabang in ahundohta hi, tualeh Beth-Aven dongin akidou ta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh khum niin Israel mite alungdong mama ua, Saul in lah ka galte tunga phu kalah zou masangsie’n “Nitah lam donga koizong ann ne aumleh hamse sawngin um heh,” chi’n mipite avau hi; tuachi’n koiman ann mawngmawng achiem sih uhi.","title":"Jonathan in khuoizu anehna"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh mipi zousie gam lah ah atungta ua, tualeh lei lah ah khuoizu ana uma."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh mipite gamlah ava tun tahun, ngaiin khuoizu ana tahkhie hi, hinanleh koiman akhut in akhoi sih uhi, aziehpen mipiten tua kichiemna khu agiing uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Jonathan in apa’n mipite kungah vauna thuchiem abawllam athei sih a; tuachi’n akhut a achiengtawi mongin khuoiphang adawt a, khuoizu khu aneh leh amit ahing vahta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite lah a khat in akungah, “Napa’n khautah a kichiem in mipite avau a, Tunia ann ne penpen hamse sawngin um heh,” achi hi; tualeh mipite zong abasamta mama uhi achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh Jonathan in, “Ka pa’n gamsung abuoi sah bep hi. En un, tam khuoizu themkhat kachep ziehin kamit hoitahin avahta hi, achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Mipiten agallah silte uh tuni’n a ut ut un nethei hita mai u’leh, bangzata a thupi leh nasazaw ahita diei? Tuazieha Philistin mite nasataha that theilou law ihita ve uoh,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Khum niin Israel taten Mikmash akipat in Aijalon dongin Philistin mite adou ua, tualeh mipite zong aba mama uhi.","title":"Mipiten biehna dan abawl khelna"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh mipiten agallah silte uh abawin abawthaw ua, belamte, bawngtalte leh bawngnoute aman ua, tualeh tuol ah athat ua, mipiten asisantoh ane thopta uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Saul ahilta ua, akungah, “En in, mipiten sisan toh aneh ziehun Mangpa tungah anamta khielta uhi,” achi uhi. Tualeh aman “Lepchietah in na gamta ua, Tuni’n ka kungah suongtum lienpi khat hing lia un,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 9.4; Siempu. 7.26,27; 17.10-14; 19.26; Danp. 12.16,23; 15.23"},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in “Mipi lahah vah zah unlen akung uah, michin in abawngtal u’leh abelam uh, ka kungah hingkai u’henlen, tammun ah gou u’henlen, ne u’heh, asisan toh ne khawmin Mangpa tungah gamta khiel nawn sih un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n mipite zousiein abawngtal uh khumi zanin ahingkai chiet ua, tuamun ah agouta uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in Mangpa adingin maitam abawl a, tuakhu Saul in Mangpa dinga abawl masah pen maitam ahi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in, “Zan chiengin Philistin mite iva nuadel suh ding ua, zingmawng khovah tandong in gallah sil i vala ding ua,” tualeh pasal pouma ihinkhawi mawngmawng sih ding uhi, achi hi. Tualeh amaun “Hoi nasah bangbangin bawlin,” achi uhi. Tuachi’n siempupa’n “Tam mun ah Pasian nai tadivai” achi hi.","title":"Jonathan bawl khelna leh mipiten atatdohna"},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in Pasian adonga, “Philistin mite doudingin kava kuon suh diei? amauh Israelte khut ah na pedoh diei? achi hi. Hinanleh tua niin Pasian in adawng sih hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in, Nou mipi lamkaite zousie hing peikhawm di uo, tualeh tuni’n tam khelna khu bangpen tah ahiei chi thei khiet tum unlen, en vawi un."},"39":{"text":"Aziehpen Israelte hundampa ahinzing bangin, ka tapa Jonathan ahizongin ashi teitei ding ahi,” achi hi. Hinanleh mipite lah a koiman athugen adawng sih uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in Israel zousiete kungah, “Noute langkhat ah atuom in um unlen, kei leh ka tapa Jonathan langkhat ah ka um ding uhi,” achi hi. Tualeh mipiten Saul kungah “Hoi nasah bangbangin bawlin,” achi uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tuaziehin Saul in “Israelte Mangpa Pasian kungah, Adihtah hing sulangin,” achi hi. Tualeh Saul leh Jonathan tungah atu a, mipite pen a awngtangta uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 27.21; 1 Sam. 28.6"},"42":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in “Kei leh ka tapa kaal ah aisan un” achi hi. Tuachi’n Jonathan tungah atua, amankheta uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in Jonathan kungah, “Bang ahiei na bawl hing hil in,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Jonathan in ahilta a, akungah “Ka khut a ka chiengtawi mongin khuoizu neu khat ka chiemkha ngut hi, tuaziehin ka shi ding ma ahi” achita hi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in adawnga, “Pasian in alaw law hing law henlen, tua sanga nasa zaw in zong: Na shi ngei ding ahi, Jonathan,” achi hi."},"45":{"text":"Hinanleh mipiten Saul kungah, “Israelte lah a tambanga hundamna thupitah bawlpa Jonathan ashi thei mawh diei mah? shi vawtlou ding, Mangpa ahinbangin, alutunga samzang khat zong tuol ah akesih ding hi. Aziehpen tuni’n Pasian toh nna asem khawm hi,” achi uhi. Tuachi’n mipiten Jonathan ahundoh ua, tualeh ashita sih hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in Philistin adel khu anuakia santa hi. Tualeh Philistin mite zong amauh munlam ah apeita uhi."},"47":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul Israelte tungah leeng in apanga, tualeh ningchin tenga gal zousie, Moabte, Ammon mite, Edommite, Zobah leengte, tualeh Philistin mite toh akidou a. Tualeh anawhna lam pouma azou zel hi.","title":"Saul leenga apan sungthu"},"48":{"text":"Tualeh galkapte akhawma, tuachi’n Amalekte adoua tualeh amauh doute khut akipat in Israelte ahundoh ta hi."},"49":{"text":"Tualeh Saul tapate khu, Jonathan, Ishvi leh Malkishuah ahi ua. Atanu upa pen min khu Merab, ahia, anaupang zawnu min khu Mikal ahi."},"50":{"text":"Tualeh Saul zi min khu Ahinoam, Ahimaaz tanu ahia; tualeh agalkap lamkaipa min khu Saul paneu Ner tapa Abner ahi."},"51":{"text":"Tualeh Kish khu Saul pa ahia, tualeh Abner pa Ner khu Abiel tapa ahi."},"52":{"text":"Saul damsungteng Philistin mite toh kidouna zauhuoitah aum zinga, tualeh Saul in pasal hat leh hangsan amu pouma amatoh pang khawm dingin ala zel hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samuel in Saul kungah, “Mangpa’n ami Israelte tunga leeng hidinga, nangma sathau nu dingin ahing sawl hi. Tuaziehin tuin Mangpa thugen awte ngaikhie in.","title":"Saul thumanna bukimlou","ref":"1 Sam. 10.1"},"2":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, Israelte Izipt gam a kipata ahing pei lai ua, Amalek miten lamkaal lah a ana lamtaan ua, abawl sietnate ziehun, tu’n keiman ka gawt ding hi.","ref":"Pawt. 17.8-14; Danp. 25.17-19"},"3":{"text":"Tu’n vakuon inlen, Amalek mite va sim in, tualeh anei zousie uh khawi neilou in sumang sieng inlen, Numei, pasal, naungeh leh nawi nelaite, tualeh bawngtal leh belam, tualeh sangawngsau leh sabiltungte abawn in that gam siengin, achi hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in mipite ahankhawm a, Telaim khuo ah asim a, galkap tul zani leh Juda mi tul sawm apha uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Saul Amalekte khopi khat ah ahing tunga, tualeh guom ah ana buh a."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in Kenmite kungah, “Hing pawtdoh unlen Amalek mite akipat kihem khie un, tuachilouin vang amaute toh ka hing that khawm kha ding hi, Aziehpen Israelte Izipt gam a kipata ahing peilai un nouten Israel tate zousie tungah na hepina uh nana sulang uhi.” Tuaziehin Kenmite khu Amalekmite lah a kipat in akihemkheta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in Amalekmite khu Havilah akipat in Izipt gam nisuona lam a um Shur dongin adouta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in Amalekte leengpa Agag khu ahingmat a, tualeh mipite zousie namsau hiem in athatgamta hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Saul leh mipiten Agag ahinkhawi ua, Tualeh belam hoi penpente, bawngtal hoi penpente leh athau thaute, belamnoute tualeh sil hoi zousie athatgam ut tasih uhi. Hinanleh pannabei leh adeihuoiloute zousie athatgam sieng uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu Samuel kungah ahing tunga.","title":"Pasian in Saul anuolna"},"11":{"text":"“Saul leenga kana pansah ka kisia mama hi, Kei hing zui nawnlouin ahing nuangatsanta a, tualeh ka thupiehte bangin abawlsih hi,” achi hi. Tualeh tam thuin Samuel a lunggim sah a, zantungtawn in Mangpa ahanta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel khu Saul kimupi dinga zingmawng matah a athaw laiin, “Saul Karmel muol ah ahaw a, tualeh ngaiin, khunah theizingna suong aphut a; tualeh akinuale kia a, apei zel a, Gilgal ah apei suh ta hi,” chiin Samuel ahil uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel, Saul kungah ava haw a, tualeh Saul in akungah “Mangpa’n hing guolzawl hen, Mangpa thupieh kava bawlzouta hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Samuel in “Ka bil a belam ham ging leh bawngtal hamging ka zahte khu bangchidan ahiei leh?” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in “Amalekmite a ahing lahpieh uh ahi; Mangpa na Pasian kunga kithoina dingin, mipiten belam hoipen pente leh bawngtal hoipenpente akhawi ua; adangteng athatgam sieng uhi, achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in Saul kungah, khawl tadi vawi! Mangpa’n zani zan a ka kunga agen khu ka hing hilding hi, achi hi. Tualeh Saul in hing gen ve, achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in, Nangma ngaiin mi neunoukhat hinanlachin zong, Israel nam pumpi lutang hilou na hiei mah? Tualeh Mangpa’n Israelte leengpa dingin sathau ahing nu hilou na hiei mah?"},"18":{"text":"Tuin Mangpa’n nang nna khat semdingin ahing sawlkhie a, na kungah, kuon inlen Amalek migilou haw, thatgam sieng inlen, a unpi ua amanthai masangsie uh dou zel in, ahing chi hi."},"19":{"text":"Bangdinga Mangpa thu manglou a, gallah silte, abaw a na bawthaw a, Mangpa mitmu a sil hoilou na bawl ahiei?” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in Samuel kungah, “E! Mangpa thu ka zui vele, Mangpa’n ahing sawlna ah ka pei a, Amalek leengpa Agag ka hingmat a, tualeh Amelekmite ka thatgam siengta hilou ahiei amah."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh mipiten thagam ding hinazenpi, gallah sil belamte, bawngtalte, sil hoi penpente, Gilgal a Mangpa na Pasian kunga kithoina dingin ala uhi.”"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in: “Mangpa’n, Mangpa thuman a kipahpi bangin, Kithoi na leh halmang sillatte akipahpi a mah? Ngai in kithoina sangin, thuman ahoizaw a, Belamtal thaute sangin, thuzui ahoizaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen helna khu ai san siemte gitlounatoh kibang ahia, Thuman louna khu, sil bawl khiel na leh milim biehna khelna toh kibang ahi. Mangpa thu na deilou ziehin, Ama’n zong leengpa dingin ahing dei nawn sih hi,” a chi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in Samuel kunga, “Kana khielta hi, Mangpa thupieh leh nangma thute kana palsanta hi; mipite ka giin ziehin athu uh kana zuikhata hi, achi hi.","title":"Saul ngaidam ngetna phatuomlou"},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, hepitahin ka khelna hing ngaidam inlen, Mangpa ka bieh theina dingin hingkinuale pi kia in chi’n kahing ngen hi,” achita hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh Samuel in Saul kungah, “Mangpa thu na nuol ziehin ka hing kinualepi sih ding hi, tualeh Mangpa’n Israelte tunga leenga pang dingin ahing nuolta hi,” achita hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel peidinga akihei laitahin Saul in apuontuol mong atuh leh akehta hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 28.17; 1 Leeng. 11.30,31"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in akungah, “Tuni’n Mangpa’n Israel leenggam nanga kipat in alakheta hi. Nang sanga hoizaw na innveng kungah apeta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Israel thupina Pasian azuou sih dinga, alungsim zong akhel sih ding hi. Lungsim khel dingin Ama mihing ahisih hi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in “Kana khielta hi, hinanleh ka mite upate masang leh Israelte masanga hing pahtawi hamham nalai dingin ka hing ngen hi. Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian ka bieh theina dingin hing kinualepi kia teitei in” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in Saul akinuale pi kiata a, Saul in Mangpa abeta hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in “Amalek leengpa Agag” ka kungah hing zawpiin, achi a, tuachi’n Agag akungah chitun pumin ahing pei a, tualeh Agag in “Shina kha tah pel hita vang emaw,” achi hi.","title":"Agag shina leh Samuel peimangna"},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh Samuel in, “Na namsau in numeite ta neilou a akoi bangin, nanu zong numeite laha ta neilou in aum ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Samuel in Agag khu Gilgal a Mangpa masang ah atenbuongta hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel Ramah khuo ah apeita hi. Tualeh Saul zong a inn langah, Gibeah khuo ah apeitouta hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in ashi ni dongin Saul kung pha in akimupi nawn sih hi. Hinanleh Samuel khu Saul ziehin akap ngitnget hi. Tualeh Israelte tunga leeng dinga Saul ana pansah ziehin Mangpa akisia mama hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Samuel kungah, “Israel mite tunga vaihawm dinga ka deinawnlousa Saul zieh a bangtan vei kap ding na hiei mah? Na saki sungah sathau thundim inlen kuon in, Bethlehem mi Jesse kungah ka hing sawl ding hi; atapate lah a mi khat leengpa dingin ka guot zouta hi,” achi hi.","title":"Samuel in David leeng ding a sathau anuna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in, “Bang kachi kuon thei mawh diei? Saul in na za leh ahing” that ding hi,” achi hi. Tualeh Mangpa’n akungah “Bawngla khat kai inlen, Mangpa kunga kithoi dinga hing pei kahi, na chi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh kithoina ah Jesse chiel inlen, tuachi’n na bawl ding ka hing ensah ding hi: tualeh amin ka hing hilpenpa khu keima dingin sathau hing nu pieh in,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in Mangpa gen bangin abawl a, Bethlehem ah ava hawta hi. Tualeh khuo a upaten chitun kawmin ama ana dawn ua akungah, “Lungmuonna toh hing pei na hina amah?” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Lungmuonna thutoh Mangpa kunga kithoi dinga hing pei ka hi, kisusiengthou unlen, kithoina ah hing hing haw un,” achi hi. Tualeh aman Jesse leh atapate asusiengthou a, kithoina a dingin achielta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahi a, ahing pei tahun, Eliab ana en a, “Mangpa sathau nupa pen amasanga umpa ahi ngeingei ding,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n Samuel kungah, “Amel ahiei asanlam ahiei en sin, ama ka deisih hi, Mangpa’n mihing et bangin a en sih hi, mihing ten pulam mel puoh danin a en ua, hinanleh Mangpa’n lungtang sunglam a en zaw hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesse in Abinadab ahan a, Samuel masang ah apei sah hi. Tualeh aman “Tami Mangpa’n atel sih hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesse in Shammah apeisah kia a, tualeh aman “Tampa zong Mangpa’n atel naisih,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuabangin Jesse in atapa sagite Samuel masangah apeisah a, Tualeh Samuel in Jesse kungah, “Mangpa’n tam mite atel sih hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in Jesse kungah, “Na tapate aunpi un tanah aumkimna uh amah?” achia, tualeh Jesse in “Atumpen aum nalai hi, tualeh ama pen belam ching ahi,” achi hi. Tualeh Samuel in Jesse kungah, “Mi sawl inlen vahan sahin, ahing tun masangsie tou lou ding ihi uh,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi ava hansah a, amapa ahing puilut ua. Ama khu asan thiutheu, mit haa kilawm leh melhoitah ahi. Tualeh Mangpa’n “Dingdoh inlen sathau nuin; tam mipa ngel ahi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel in sathau koina saki ala a, asanggamte lah ah ama sathau anuta hi; Tualeh khum ni apat in Mangpa Hagau David tungah atungta hi. Tuachi’n Samuel adingdoh a, Ramah khuo ah apeita hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa Hagau in Saul a pawtsanta a, tualeh Mangpa sawl hagau gilou khat in Saul asubuoita hi.","title":"David Saul lapu leh galvan puo a apanna"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Saul suohten akungah, “Ngai in, Pasian hing sawl hagau gilou in nang ahing subuoita hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuin kapu un na masanga um na suohte thu hing pie inlen tumging tumsiem mikhat sui sahin; tualeh hichi ahi dinga, Pasian sawl hagau gilou na tunga ahing um chiengin, aman tumging khu akhut in atum dinga, tuachi’n nadam ding hi,” achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in asuohte kungah, “Tumging tum siemmi khat hing sui pieh unlen ka kungah hing pui un,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n asuohte khat in adawnga, akungah, “En in, Bethlehem mi Jesse tapa khat ka mu a, amapa khu tumging tumsiem, mihangsan, galdou siem, thugen siem tualeh mel hoitah ahia; akung ah zong Mangpa a um hi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin Saul in Jesse kungah mi asawl a, “Na tapa David belam chinga um khu ka kungah hing sawl in,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Jesse in sabiltung khat, tanghou leh uoin savun thawl khat leh kelnou khat ala a, Saul pieh dingin David aposah a, Saul kungah asawlta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n David Saul kungah ahing tunga, tualeh amasangah ava dingta a, tualeh Saul in ana it mama a, tuachi’n agalvan puoin apangta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in Jesse kungah mi asawl a, “David ka kungah umdenta heh, ka mit atung mama hi,” achi sah hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, Pasian akipat a hagau gilou khu Saul tunga aum chiengin David in tumging ala a atum zel hi, tuachi’n Saul ahing dam zel a, tuachi’n hagau gilou in Saul apawtsan zel hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Philistin miten kidou dingin agalkapte uh akaikhawm ua, tualeh Juda gam sunga Sokoh khuo ah akikhawm ua, tualeh Sokoh leh Azekah kikaal a Ephes Dammim mun ah panmun abawl uhi.","title":"David leh Goliath"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Saul leh Israel mite zong akikaikhawm ua, tualeh Elah phai ah panmun abawl ua, Philistin mite dou dingin akiguoldimta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Philistin mite khu alang khat a muol tung ah apang ua, tualeh Israelte khu alelamgal muol tung ah apang ua, akikaal uah phaijang khat a um hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Philistin mite panmun akipat in mihat mama khat amin Goliath Gath khuo aum, asan lam tong guh leh khap khat, ahing pawtdoh a."},"5":{"text":"Aman sum-eng lukhu akhu a, sum-eng awmphaw asil a, tualeh a awmphaw gihdan shekel tulnga ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh a ngal ah sum-eng ngal tuomna abun a, tualeh aliengkoutegel kikaal ah sum-eng teipi apuo hi."},"7":{"text":"Ateipi bul khu siemkol bang ahia, tualeh ateitong khu agihdan shekel zaguh ahia, tualeh a phaw popa amasang ah apei hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n adinga Israel galkapte lam ngain akikou a, akung uah “Bang dinga, kidou dinga hing kiguoldim nahi uoi? Kei Philistin mi, noute Saul suohte nahi sih uoi mah? Mikhat hing kiteldoh unlen ka kungah hing peisuh heh."},"9":{"text":"Kei ahing ki buonpi theia ahing tha zou leh na suoh un ka um ding ua, hinanleh ken ka zaw a ka tha zou leh ka suoh un na um ding ua, ka nna uh nasem ding uhi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh tuni in Philistin mipa’n “Israel galkapte ka tawh ahi, mikhat hing kuon sah un,” kana kisatpi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Saul leh Israelte zousie in tua Philistin mipa thugen azah chiengun, alungkie ua, azau mama uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh David khu Juda gam a Bethlehem khuo a teng Ephrathmi Jesse tapa ahia, Jesse in tapa giet anei a, tualeh ama Saul vaihawm hun laiin, ateh ta a, akum zong atamta hi.","title":"Gieh mun a David hing tunna"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Jesse tapa upa pente thumin kidouna ah Saul nua azui ua, tualeh kidouna a kuon atapa thumte min, a upa pen Eliab, azom in Abinadab, tualeh athumna khu Shammah ahi."},"14":{"text":"David khu nautum ahia, a upapen thumte’n Saul azui uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh David khu apa belamte kem dingin Saul kunga kipat in Bethlehem ah ava pei zelzel hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Goliath in ni sawm li sung, zingmawng leh nitah tengin, ava nai a, ava kitahlang zel hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesse in atapa David kungah, “Tam butang kikanggaw ephah khat leh tanghou beu sawm na ute dingin puo inlen agiehphuol uah manlangin va pei in."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tami bawngnawidat beu sawm galkap tul khatte tunga lamkaipa dingin puo inlen, tualeh na ute bang achi na uoi mah, va en inlen, atanchin uh theina dingin bang ahiei khat hing tawi in.”"},"19":{"text":"Tuin amaute Saul leh Israel mizousiete toh Elah phaijang ah Philistin mite toh kidou dingin a um uhi, achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n David zingmawng matahin athoua, belamte khu aching mi khat akemsaha, Jesse thu pieh bangin avante apuo a, apeita hi. Tualeh galkapte kidou dinga kuonkhie a, akikou vapual laitah un David giehphuol ah ahing tung hi."},"21":{"text":"Israelte leh Philistin mite khu kidou dingin alang alang ah akiguol dim ua, galkap leh galkap a kimaituota uhi."},"22":{"text":"David in avan puohte khu van kempa khut ah anuasie a, galkapte kungah ava tailut a, a ute bang na chi na uoi chi’n ava dong hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachia ahoulim laitah un, ngai in, Philistin galkapte lah a kipat in Goliath kichipa Gath khuo a Philistin mi, ami hatpa uh ahing pawtdoh a, agen ngaiteng ahing genkia a, tuate David in anaza hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mizousien tua mipa amutahun ataizah ua, azau mama uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel miten, “Khuna hing kuontou mihingpa na mu ei? Israelte tawh dinga hingkuon tazing ahi, tualeh hichi ahi ding a, koipou ama that zou a umleh, leengpa’n hausatna thupi tahin ahausa sah dinga, atanu toh akitengsah dinga, tualeh apa innkuonte Israel gam sungah anuom lensah ding hi,” achi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in akunga ding mite kungah, “Tam Philistin mipa that a Israelte minsietna lamangpa khu banglaw ding adiei? Tami teptanlou Philistin mipi koi ahi phuata, Pasian hing galkapte tambanga atawh mawngmawng ahiei?” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh mipiten tambangin adawng uhi. “Koi zong ama that pouma, ka gen bang ua bawl ahi ding,” achi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Mite kunga athu gen khu, a ute lah a upapen Eliab in ana za a, tuachi’n Eliab khu David tungah alungthah a, David kunga “Bang zieh a tana hing peisuh na hiei? Tualeh gamdai a belam tawmnoukhat umte khu koi kunga nahing nuasie ahiei? Na kiletsahna leh na huot huoina ka thei hi, gal kidou ending a hing peisuh nahi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh David in “Bang ahiei ka bawl? Azieh a um sih amah?” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman midangte lam ngain akiheisan a, tualeh agen ngaiteng agen a, tualeh mipiten amasang a adawn bangun adawng kia uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh David thugente azah bep un, Saul kungah ava gen sawnta uhi. Tualeh Saul in David ahansah ta hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Saul kungah, “Ama ziehin koima lungke sih heh, na suohpa kava kuon dinga tam Philistin mipa kava kisuolpi ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"David in Goliath athana"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in David kungah “Nangpen Philistin mipa dou dingin kuon theisih vateh, khangdawngnou nahi nalai a, amapen aneu apat a, kidou mi ahi hi,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh David in Saul kungah, “Na suoh in ka pa belamte ka chin laiin, humpibahnei ahiei, vompi ahiei ahing pei a, belam honte lah akipat belamnoute ahing tawdoh chiengin;"},"35":{"text":"Ka nuadel a, ka satlia a, akam apat in belamnoute ka hundoh zel hi, tualeh keima suol dinga ahing thawdoh chiengun abah ah kamana, ka satpua a ka that zel hi."},"36":{"text":"Na suohpa’n humpibahnei leh vompite ka thata, tualeh tam teptanlou Philistin mipa zong tuate mabangin a um mai ding hi, Pasian hing galkapte atawh phuat a.”"},"37":{"text":"Tuathamlouin David in “Humpibahnei chin hiemleh vompi chin hiem akipata hing hunkhe zel Mangpa’n tam Philistin mipa khut akipat ahing hundoh ngei ding hi,” achi hi. Tualeh Saul in David kungah, “Kuon in, Mangpa na kungah umta heh,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in agalthuomte David asil sah a, alu ah sum-eng lukhu akhusah a, a awmphaw zong a sil sah hi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh David in agalvan tungah namsau akuo a, peipi dinga akisah leh apei theita sih hi. Aziehpen ama khumbangin akivonngai sih hi, Tuachi’n David in Saul kungah, “Tamteng ka vahpi thei sih hi, tambang in kana ki von ngainai sih hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n David in asutkheta hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n achieng tawi khu ala a, luita suongtang zol kilkel nga atawm a, abelam chinna thungpi sung ah aguong hi, tuachi’n asaili a tawi a, Philistin mipi khu ava zuonta hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin mipa khu ahing pei a, David lam ahing zuonta a, tualeh agalvan tawipa amasangah apei hi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh Philistin mipa’n dah kawikawi in ahing en a, David a mu tahin tangvalnou san thiutheu melhoitah ahi ziehin asimmaw mama hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin mipa’n David kungah, “Ui ka hiei mah? chieng tawi a ka kunga nahing pei,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Philistin mipa’n a pasiente min lou in David ahamsiet ta hi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh Philistin mipa’n David kungah, “Hing pei in, nasa tunga leeng vate leh gamsaten ka nesah ding, achi hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Philistin mipa kungah, Nang namsau teipi leh lum leh phaw toh nahing kuon a, hinanleh kei pen galkapte Mangpa, Israel galkapte Pasian na tawhpa Ama min in ka hing kuon hi.”"},"46":{"text":"Tuin Mangpa’n nang ka khutah ahing pe dinga, ka hing satlia dinga, nalu katan dinga: tualeh Philistin galkapte luongte khu tunga leeng vate leh gamsate kane sah ding hi; tuachi’n leitunga um mi zousie’n Israelte lah ah Pasian aum hi chi athei ding uhi"},"47":{"text":"Tualeh tammun a kikhawm zousie’n Mangpa’n namsau leh teipiin koima ahundam sih chi athei chiet ding uhi, aziehpen kidouna khu Mangpa a ahibou hi, Tualeh aman noute ka khut ah ahing pe ding hi,” achi hi."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, Philistin mipa adingdoh a, David dou dinga ahing zot tahin, David zong galkapte langah Philistin mipa doudingin, a naw tai chinten ta hi,"},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in akhut in athungpi sung asawh a, suongtang khat alakhie a, akap leh Philistin mipa talpang akha a, asuong atal ah atum a, tuachi’n akhupboh in tuol ah apua helhul ta hi."},"50":{"text":"Tuabangin David in Philistin mipa khu saili khat leh suongtang khat in azouta a, Philistin mipa asat a athat ta hi, hinanleh David in namsau atawi sih hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 21.19"},"51":{"text":"Tuaziehin David atai a, Philistin mipa tungah adinga, anamsau ala a, apai apat adohkhie a, tua namsau in alu atan a athatta hi. Tualeh Philistin miten ami hatpa uh ashita chi amutahun ataizah ta uhi.","ref":"2 Sam. 21.19"},"52":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mite leh Juda mite adingdoh ua, akikou ua, tualeh phaijang lutna leh Ekron kulpi kotkha tandong Philistin mite anuadel ua. Tualeh Philistin mi gal a liemte Shaaraim lam tungtawn ah Gath leh Ekron dongin apua lemlum uhi."},"53":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate Philistin mite nuadel, ahing kinuale ua, apuon innte uah gal vanlah neitah leh sum leh pai avala uhi."},"54":{"text":"David in Philistinpa lutang ala a, Jerusalem ah apuo a, agalvante pen puonbuh sungah akoi hi."},"55":{"text":"Saul in David khu Philistin mipa dou dinga akuon khieh amu tahin, galkap lamkai Abner kungah, “Abner tam tangval pa koi ta ahiei?” achi hi. Tualeh Abner in akungah, “Na hinna louin kagen ahi, Aw leengpa ka thei vawt sih hi,” achi hi."},"56":{"text":"Tualeh leeng pa’n “Tam tangvalpa koita ahiei chi kandoh in,” achi hi."},"57":{"text":"Tuachia Philistin mipa that zou a David ahing kinuale kia tahin, Abner in ama ana zawpi a, akhut a Philistin mipa lutang tawi pum in Saul masangah alutpi tahi."},"58":{"text":"Saul in David kungah, “Tangval koi tapa na hiei?” chi’n adonga, tualeh David in “Bethlehem mi na suohpa Jesse tapa ka hi,” chi’n adawng hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahi a, Saul kunga thu agenzou tahin, Jonathan hinna leh David hinna ahing kizopta a, tuachi’n Jonathan in ama hinna a it bang in David a it ta hi.","title":"Jonathan in David a it"},"2":{"text":"Tuami ni mama in Saul in David a umpi paingal a apa inn lam ah apei sah nawn sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan in ama hinna a it bang a David a it ziehin thuhun abawlta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan in apuonahtuol sillai asutkhie a, agalvante, anamsau, athalpi leh akawnggah nangawn toh David apeta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in asawlna pou ah David apei zel a, pilvang tah in agamta hi. Tualeh Saul in ama khu agalkapte tunga vaihawm in apangsah hi. Tualeh mi zousie mitmu leh Saul nasemte mitmu in zong pahtat leh kipahpi in a um hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, David in Philistin mipa that zou, mipi innlam zuon a ahing kile kia ua inn lam zuona ahing pei laiun, Israel khopi zousie akipat in numeite ahing pawtdoh ua, lasa a lam kawm in khuongta leh sil gingtheitengtoh nuomsatahin leengpa Saul dawn dingin ahing pawt ua.","title":"Saul in David athangsietna leh tha atupna"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh numeite alam kawm un akikhieng tuo ua, “Saul in a tul a tul in athat a, David in a tul sawm a tul sawm in athat hi,” achi ua.","ref":"1 Sam. 21.11; 29.5"},"8":{"text":"Tambanga ala sahte un Saul alungthah sah mama ta a, alungkim ta sih hi. “David tul sawm that in angai ua, kei atul atul giap that in ahing ngai uhi, leenggam atan ding chilou bang ahiei aum nalai achita hi.”"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuani akipat in Saul in David mittang vaidou in anei panta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh azing niin hichi ahing hi a, Pasian sawl hagau gilou Saul tungah atungta a, inn sungah thu mavang gen in aham bielbuol a, tualeh David in abawl ngai bangin atumgingte atum a, ahivangin Saul in a khutah teipi khat a tawi zing hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in “David bang toh ka kilden ding chiin ateipi in akhaw pheita hi,” hinanleh David in niveitah akihepkhiet san hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuin Saul in David agiingta mama hi, aziehpen Mangpa’n David a umpi a, Saul anuasieta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin Saul in David khu ama kunga kipat in asuondoh a, galkap tul khatte tunga lamkai in apangsah tahi, tualeh mipite masangah alutin apawt zel hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh David pen abawl taphot ah kituptah in agamta zel a, tualeh Mangpa’n ama a umpi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin, kitup tah a gamta ahi chi Saul in amu in agiing semsem ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Israelte leh Judate zousie in amasang ua lut a apawt zel ziehin David ait mama ta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in David kungah, “Ka tanu upazaw Merab tanah aum hi, amanu na zi dingin ka hing peding hi; kei dingin hangsan tahin um phot mai inlen, Mangpa kidouna dou in,” achi hi. Aziehkhu Saul in “Atungah keiman khut halouin Philistin miten atung ah khut hazaw uheh,” achina ahi.","title":"David zi neina"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh David in Saul kungah, “Kei koi ka hia, ka hinna zong bang ahia, ka innkuonpite leh ka pa innkuonpi zong Israelte lah ah bang ahi ua, leengpa mahpa kahina dingin” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh hichi ahia, Saul tanu Merab David toh kiten sah ding hun ahing tun kuontahin Melohath mi Adriel zi dingin apeta mawh hi."},"20":{"text":"Saul tanu Mikal in David angai mama a; Tua thu Saul ahil ua, tua thu in Saul akipah sah hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in, “Amanu David adinga a awhna ding thang ahing hi theina ding leh Philistin miten atunga khut ahah theina dingun, amanu David ka pe ding hi,” achi hi. Tuaziehin Saul in David kungah “Tuni’n ka mahpa nahi kia thou thou ding hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in asuohte thu apie a, “Aguh in David houpi unlen, akungah, En in Lengpa na tung ah akipah a, tualeh asuohte zousie’n ahing ngaina mama uhi, tuaziehin tuin, leengpa mahpa in pang in;” chi un, achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul suohten David zah mama ah tua thu zousie ava genta uhi. Tualeh David in “Migenthei leh koima ngaisahlou kei banga dingin, leengpa mahpa a panding khu sil namai hi dingin na ngaisut uoi mah?” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Saul suohten akungah, “David in hichibang in agen hi,” chiin ahilta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in “David kungah, tambangin gen un. Lengpa’n agalte tunga phu alah theina dingin Philistinte vuntep zakhat chilou azi man ding bangma adeisih hi, achi hi,” chi un, achi hi. Hinanleh Saul in David pen Philistin mite khuta shisah atum chinten hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n asuohten tam thute David ahil u’leh, Lengpa mahpa a apan ding David akipah mama hi. Hinanleh ani chiem abei nai sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin David ading doh a, amite toh ava kuon ua, Philistin mite avathat ua, tualeh atepvun uh ahing puo a, leengpa mahpa ahitheina dingin leengpa kungah kimtah in apie hi, tuachi’n Saul in atanu Mikal azi dingin apeta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tambangin Mangpa’n David aumpi hi chi Saul in amu in athei chienta hi; tualeh Saul tanu Mikal in ama a it ta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in David agiing sem semta hi. Tualeh Saul khu David melma ahi denta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin miliente galdou dingin a kuonkhe zel uhi. Tualeh hichi ahi a, akuon khieh pouma chiengun David khu Saul suohte zousie sanga pilvang zawin agamta zel a, tuachi’n amin tawisangin aumta hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in atapa Jonathan leh anasemte zousie kungah, David na tha ding uh ahi chin thu ahilta hi; Hinanleh Jonathan in David angaina mama hi.","title":"Saul in David amudana"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul tapa Jonathan in David kungah, “Ka pa Saul in tha dingin ahing sui hi, tuaziehin zingmawng chiengin pilvang tahin kikem hoi inlen munsip khat ah kiphuol dap maiin, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh na kiphuolna gamlah ah keima hing peivang in, ka pa kungah ka va ding dinga, na tungtang thuah ka pa ka houpi dinga, tuachi’n thuzah ka nei pouma leh ka hinghil ding hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Jonathan in apa Saul kungah, David agen phata hi, akungah, “Leengpa’n asuohpa David tungah sil bawlkhiel vawt sih heh; aziehpen David in na tungah gitlouna abawl ngai sih hi, asilbawl zousie lah nanga dingin ahoimama ngal a."},"5":{"text":"Aman ashi ding zong khawhsalou in Philistin mipa athat a, tuachi’n Mangpa’n Israel mi zousie a dingin hundamna thupitah ahing tungsahta hi, tuakhu nangman zong namu a, na kipah mama hi. Tuaziehin azieh bei a David that a, mawna neilou sisan tunga khiel ding na hiei mah?” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in Jonathan thugente angaikhie a, Saul akichiema, “Mangpa hinna louin ka kichiem hi, David akithat sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Jonathan in David ahandoh a, tam thu zousie ahilta hi. Tualeh Jonathan in David khu Saul kungah ahing zawpi a, tuachi’n nidanga aum ngaibangin akungah a umta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh kidouna aum kia a, David ava kuon a, Philistinte ava douta a, thachitahin ava that a, amasang ah ataizahta uhi.","title":"Saul in David tha atupna"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Saul akhut a teipi tawi a innsunga atou laiin, Mangpa akipat a hagau gilou atungah ahing tungta a, David in tumging akhut a atum laitah ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in David khu a teipi a bangtoh khawdeen atum a, hinanleh David pen Saul akipat in ana kitholmang hiau a, tuachi’n teipu khu bangah akiphut tang vevong hi, tuachi’n David atai khie a khum zan in asuohta tahi."},"11":{"text":"Saul in buhdap a, zingmawng chienga that dingin David inn ah mi asawl a. Hinanleh David zi Mikal in David kungah, “Tuzan a, na hinna na humbit sihleh, zing chienga hing that ding ahi uh” chi’n ahil hi.","title":"Mikal in David ahundohna","ref":"Late. 59"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mikal in David kotta ah akhaikhe suh a, tuachi’n ataimanga, asuohta ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mikal in milim khat ala a, lupna ah asiel a, alu lam ah kelmul tangkhap akoi a, tuachi’n puon akhut a hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in David pui dinga mi asawl chiengin, amanu’n “Achi na hi,” ana chi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in David en dingin mi asawl kia a, “Ka tha theina dingin alupna pum in ka kungah hing zawng un,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh ami sawlte avalut u’leh, lupna ah milim alu lam a kelmul tangkham khap in ana um hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in Mikal kungah, “Bangdinga tambang a, nang sola ka galpa na sawlmanga, na suotatsah ahiei?” achi hi. Tualeh Mikal in Saul adawnga, “Hingpei sahin, bangzieh a nang hing that ding ka hiei mah?” achi hi, achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n David ataimang a, asuohta ta hi. Tualeh Ramah khuo a Samuel kungah ava tunga, Saul in atunga abawl zousie ahilta hi. Tualeh ama leh Samuel apei ua, Naioth ah ava um uhi.","title":"Pasian hagau in David avenbitna"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh, “Ngai in, Ramah khuo a Naioth ah David a um hi,” chi’n Saul ahil ua."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in David pui dingin mi asawl a. Tualeh guolnei pawlte thumavang genna kikou lai leh atung ua Samuel lamkai apang amutah un Saul misawlte tungah Pasian Hagau atungta a, tuachi’n ama un zong thu mavang agenta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Saul ahil u’leh, aman midangte asawl kia a, ama u’zong tuabanga thumavang gen in aumta uhi. Tualeh Saul in athumveina dingin mite asawl kia a, tua miten zong tuabangma in thu aphuong zelta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama zong Ramah khuo ah ava haw a, Seku mun a tuikul lienpi kung ava tunga, tualeh “Samuel leh David hei a um ahi uoi?” chi’n adonga. Tualeh mi khat in, “Ngai in, Ramah khuo a Naioth ah aum uhi, achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul zong Ramah khuo a Naioth ah ava pei a, tualeh Mangpa Hagau ama tungah zong ahing tungta a, Ramah khuo a Naioth mun atun dongin apei kawm in thumavang aphuongta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh aman zong apuonsilte asutkhie a Samuel masangah thu mavang aphuongdoh a, tuami ni sun nitumin leh zan khovah in, puonsillou in guohtangin alumta hi. Tuaziehin “Saul zong guolneite lah a pang sam hi maw?” akichi zel hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 10.11,12"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n David khu Ramah khuo Naioth akipat in ataidoh a, Jonathan kungah ava haw a, akungah, “Bang kana bawla ahiei? tualeh bang tatsietna ka nei a ahiei? Tualeh napa masanga bang ahiei kabawl khiel pentah leh ka khelna? hichia tha dinga ahing sui kawi,” achi hi.","title":"Jonathan in David ahumbitna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan in akungah “That laizang lou e, shi vawt sihvateh, Ngaiin, ka pa’n kei hing theisah masalou in bangma zousie lien in neu taleh abawl ngai sih hi, bang zieha tam thute hing im ding ahiei? Ahing im vawt sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n David akichiem kia nalai a akungah, “Na pa’n na mit mua deisahna katan athei chien mama a, Jonathan in tam thu pen theida mai heh khuchilouin lunggim seng khava achi ahi ding, tualeh na hinna lou in ka gen ahi, shina leh kei kikaal ah kal khat bep a um hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan in David kungah, “Na hinna in alunggul pouma ka hing bawl pieh zel ding,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh David in Jonathan kungah, “Ngai in, zing chieng hatha ni ding ahia, leengpa kunga pellou a annkuong im ding ka hi a, hinanleh ani thum ni nitah lam dongin gamlah a kibu dingin kava kuon zaw mai ding hi.","ref":"Kisim. 28.11"},"6":{"text":"Na pa’n ka umlou ahing theidoh chiengin, David in akhuo uh Bethlehem a, ainnkuonpite zousie toh kumchin kithoina nei ding ahi ziehun, vahaw tavang chin ahing ngen va ngut hi, na chiin, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"A hoive achileh, na suohpa lung muongin ka um dinga, hinanleh alungthah leh vang sil hoilou bawl tum ahi chi theimai in."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin na suohpa Mangpa thuhun na bawlpi tah ngal leh, hoitahin bawl mai in, ahivangin thulimlouna ka neileh nangman hing that suh mai in, bangdinga napa kunga nang puise ding ahiei mah?” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Jonathan in akungah, “That laizang lou e, ka pa’n na tunga sil hoilou bawl atum chi ka thei pouma leh nangma hing hillou in ka um diei mah?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Jonathan kungah, “Na pa’n hing na huotdawn taleh koi in kei ahing hilta diei?” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Jonathan in David kungah, “Hing pei vawi gamlah ah va vah tadi vai,” achi a; tuachi’n ani un gamlah ah ava vahta gel uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan in David kungah, “Mangpa Israelte Pasian ahing theipipa hihen, zing chieng tuhun ahiei ahisihleh anithum niin ahiei, chiengin ka pa kungah thu ka va dawp dinga, ngaiin David tungtang thu ahoi ahileh mi hing sawl in kang theisah sih diei mah?"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh ka pa’n na tunga sietna abawl tup ka hing hillou a, na lung muonna dinga ka hing sawlmang sihleh, Mangpa’n Jonathan aut dandan in bawl henlen tua sanga nasa zaw in zong bawlta hen, tualeh Mangpa’n ka pa ana umpi bangin nang zong hing umpi tahen."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh ka shilouna dinga ka damsung maimai Mangpa lung sietna hing musah hilouin;"},"15":{"text":"Khangtungtawn in ka innkuonpite tungah na khotuona tawpsah sin, Mangpa’n leitung maikai a David melmate asuhmang tandongin zong tawpsan sin, achi hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 9.1"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan in David melmate lah ah, Mangpa’n phuba lata hen, chiin David innkuonpite kungah thuhun abawl hi.”"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Jonathan in ka hing it hi chiin David in thu achiemsah kia hi, aziehpen Jonathan in ama hinna ait bangin David ait hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan in David kungah, “Zing chienga ha tha ding ahi a; na touna a awng ding ahi ziehin, na umlou akilang ngei ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ni thum nava umzou chiengin, hing peisuh pai inlen, masanga tam buoina ahing kipat chiillai a, na kibutna mun ah hing pei inlen, Ezel suong pang ah na um denin."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n muichiemna khat neibangin, tua suong pang lam ah thal tang thum ka hing kap ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh ngaiin naupang khat ka hing sawl dinga, pei inlen thaltangte va suiin kachi dinga, thaltangte na umna apat tamlang pangah aum hi; tawm inlen hing peiin, kachi leh Mangpa hinna louin ka gen ahi, nanga dingin lungmuonhuoi leh zauna ding umlou ahi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh naupangpa kunga, En in, thaltangte na gallangah a um hi, ka chileh peimang maiin, Mangpa’n ahing peimang sah ahi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh nang leh ken sil igensate tungtang thu ah ngaiin, nang leh kei kikaal ah kumtawn in Mangpa aum ngitnget hi, achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n David gamlah ah akibu denta a, tualeh ha tha ahing hiin, leengpa annkuong im dingin adawkanah atouta hi.”"},"25":{"text":"Lengpa khu nidanga atou ngaina bangin, bang gei a atouna ah atou a, tualeh Jonathan adinga, Abner Saul gei ah atou a, tuachi’n David touna a awng hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh Saul in tua ni in bangma agen sih hi. Aziehpen aman atungah bang ahiei khat aum a asienglou hiva, asienglou ahi ngeingei ding chi’n a ngaisut hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh azing ni’n hichi ahia, hatha a ni ni in David mun khu a awng nalai a, tuachi’n Saul in atapa Jonathan kungah, “Bang zieha Jesse tapa tuni leh zani a ann ne dinga hing peilou ahiei?” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan in Saul adawnga, akungah “David in Bethlehem a hawdingin phalna ahing ngen va ngua hi."},"29":{"text":"Aman hepitahin hing hawsah teitei in, aziehpen ka innkuonpiten khosunga kithoina nei ding ahi uhi, tualeh ka u in khuna pang dingin thu ahing pie hi, tualeh tuin na mitmu a deisahna katan leh, hepitahin hing phal maiin kava haw ding hi, tuachi’n ka sanggamte ka va ve ding achi hi. Tuazieh a leengpa dawkan a ann ne dinga hing peilou ahi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul khu Jonathan tungah alungthah phuta, “Nang numei gilou leh paupeng tapa, nangma zumna ding leh nanu guohtanna zum sah dingin Jesse tapa na tel ahi chi na theisih amah?"},"31":{"text":"Aziehpen Jesse tapa leitunga adam laisie nangma leh nagam suhdet ahi sih ding hi, Tuaziehin tuin vahan sahin, ashi ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Jonathan in apa Saul adawnga akungah, “Bangzieh a ama na tha ding ahiei? Aman bang ahiei abawl?” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in ama kho tum in ateipi alam a, tuaziehin Jonathan in apa’n David tha atum tahtah na hi chi athei chienta hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan khu adawkan apat in lungthah sengin adingdoh a, tuami ha nina ni ni’n ann aneta sih hi, apa’n David azalat sah zing ziehin alung gimpita hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, azingmawng in Jonathan in naupang khat azawpi a, David toh akichiemna mun guot u’leh hun guot dung zui un gamlah ah ava peita uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh aman naupangpa kungah, “Tai inlen ka thaltang kapte va tawmin,” achi hi. Tualeh khum naupang atai lai in Jonathan in thaltang gallam ah akap hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Jonathan in akap thaltang tuhna a, naupangpa atun tahin, Jonathan in naupangpa anua hat a, akungah, “Na gallam ah thaltang aum hilou amah?” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Jonathan in naupangpa ahan a, “Kinaw in, hing pei mengin, zekai sin” achi hi. Tuachi’n Jonathan naupangpa’n thaltangte akhawma, apu kungah apeita hi."},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh naupangpa’n bangma athei vateh sih a, Jonathan leh David behin thu umdan athei giap uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh Jonathan in agalvante naupangpa kung ah apie a, akungah “Pei inlen galvante khu khuo ah na peipi in,” achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua naupangpa apei zoutahin, David aumna mun simlam pang akipat adingdoh a, amai lei lah a phain thumvei abohkhup hi. Tualeh akikawi ua, akitawp ua, akikaatuo ua, hinanleh David ahakaa dieh hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonathan in David kungah, “Lungmuong tahin pei tan aw; Mangpa nang toh ikaal ah leh nahah nasuonte leh ka hah ka suonte kaal ah kumtawn in umta hen, achi hi. Mangpa min in ikichiem tuoh zouta hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n adinga apeita hi. Tualeh Jonathan pen khuo ah alutta hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n David Nob khuo a siempu Ahimelek kungah ahing pei a: tualeh Ahimelek in chitun kawm in David ana dawn a, akungah “Bangchidan ahiei na hichi tangtat a, zawpi neilou na hiei mah?” achi hi.","title":"Siempu in David ahutdohna","ref":"Mat. 12.3,4; Mak. 2.25,26; Luk. 6.3"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh David in siempu Ahimelek kungah, “Leengpan sil khat bawl dingin thu ahing pie a, tualeh ka kungah ka hing sil bawlsah tup leh ka hing thupieh khu koiman theisih heh, achia; tualeh tangvalte umna ding mun ka guot siengta hi, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin na khut ah bang aum ei? Tanghou beu nga hing pie in, ahisihleh na nei lam lam achi hi.”"},"4":{"text":"Siempuin David adawnga, “Tanghou khatpou ka khut ah aum sih a, hinanleh tanghou siengthou vang ka nei hi, tangvalte numei lah a kipat akikep siengthou pou u’leh,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in siempupa adawnga, akungah “Adihtahin tu nithum sung numei lah ah ka siengthou chietna uhi; Tualeh ka hing pawtkhiet ding lai un zong tangvalte um le belte zong asiengthouna hi, sawlna khohtah a akuon chiengun akikem siengthou ua, tuaziehin akikem siengthou nah mama uhi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempuin tanghou siengthou khu apeta a, aziehpen khum mun a tanghou kikoite alah ni ua tanghou lum a hen zel ding Mangpa masanga kipata kila tanghou siengthou chilou tanghou dang mawngmawng aum sih hi.","ref":"Siempu. 24.5-9"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh khum niin Saul suohte lah a mi khat Mangpa masanga hentang in ana um a, amapa min Doeg, Edom mi ahia, Saul ganchingte lah a lamkaipa ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh David in Ahimelek kungah, “Tanah, teipi ahiei namsau ahiei, na khut ah na kem khasih amah? Lengpa mai a kintah a nasep akiphatmaw ziehin, Ka namsau leh ka galvan khat beh ka hing keng man sih hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh siempupa’n “Philistin mi Goliath Elah phaijang a na thapa namsau en in, puon a kituom in siempu puonah lie ah aum hi, tuami nadei leh lain, tuami chilou adang a um sih hi,” achi hi. Tualeh David in “Tuasanga hoi zaw a um diei mah hing pie’n” achi hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 17.51"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n David adingkhie a, khum ni in Saul giing in ataimangta hi, tualeh Gath leengpa Akish kungah apeita hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Akish suohten akungah, “Tam mipa agam leengpa uh David hilou amah? Saul in atul atul in athat a, David in atul sawm atul sawm in athat hi chia lam kawm a kikhieng in la asa uh hilou amah?” achi uhi.","ref":"1 Sam. 18.7; 29.5"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh David in tam thute alungtang ah avom a, tuachi’n Gath leengpa Akish agiing mama ta hi.","ref":"Late. 56"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n amasang uah a umdan ahenglamdang a, amit mu uah akimosah a, kul kotkhate akhuot a, akhamul lah ah akhatetui aluong sah niai nuai ta hi.","ref":"Late. 34"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Akish in asuohte kungah, “En un, tam mipa amo ahi, chi na thei sasa ua, bangdinga ka kunga nang zawpi uh ahiei?"},"15":{"text":"Mi maw kaki tahsap zieh a, tam mipa, amot dan sulang dinga ka umna a na hing zawpi uh amah? Tam mipa ka innsungah ahing lut talawm ding amah?” achi hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin David khum mun akipat in apawtdoh a, Adullam kawlhawm ah aumta hi. Tualeh a sanggamte leh apa innkuonpi zousie’n tua thu azah tahun khummun a akungah ava haw suhta uhi.","title":"Adullam kawlhawm ah David akibu","ref":"Late. 57; 142"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh michin lunggimna nei pouma, leiba nei pouma tualeh lungkimlouna neite zousie akungah ahing peikhawm ua, tuachi’n David khu atung ua lamkai in apangta hi, tuachi’n akungah mi zali vel a um uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n David tua mun akipat in Moab gam a Mizpah ah apei a, tualeh Moab leengpa kungah, “Pasian in bang ahiei ahing bawlpieh ding chi ka thei masangsie, ka nu leh ka pate hing pei u’henlen na kungah hing um uheh, chi’n ka hing ngen hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Moab leengpa masangah, amauh ahing zawpia, tualeh kawhawm sunga David a um sung sie’n akungah a umta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n goulnei Gad in David kungah, “Kawlhawm sungah umden sinlen, pawtdoh inlen, Juda gam lam ah pei in,” achi hi. Tuachi’n David apawta Hareth gammang ah alutta hi."},"6":{"text":"Saul in David leh akunga umte amudohta uh chi ana zata a tuin Saul Gibeah khuo a Tamarisk sing nuoi ah akhut a teipi tawi in atou a, tualeh asuohte zousie akim ah ading uhi.","title":"Nob a Saul in siempute athagamna"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in akiima ding asuohte kungah, “Tuin nou Benjamin mite aw ngaikhie un, Jesse tapa in nouhaw, loute leh grep huonte ahing pe chiet na diei mah, tualeh galkap atul atulte tungah leh aza azate tungah lamkai in ahing pangsah na diei mah?"},"8":{"text":"Na unpi un na hing phielgu ua, ka tapa in Jesse tapa toh thuhun abawl uh koima khat in zong na hing theisah sih uhi; kei dinga khawhsa mawngmawng koima na um sih ua, tualeh ka tapa in ka suohpa kei hing douding leh tuni nasan a zong kei hing lamtan dinga achiil nahlai thu ka kunga sulang na um sih uhi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul suohte toh ding khawm Edom mi Doeg in adawnga, akungah, “Jesse tapa Nob khuo ah Ahitup tapa Ahimelek kunga hing pei kana mu hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 21.7-9; Late. 52"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh aman Mangpa kungah adoh pieh a, neh ding apie a, tualeh Philistin mi Goliath namsau zong ape nalai hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Ahitup tapa Siempu Ahimelek leh apa inn sungmi zousie leh Nob khuo a siempu um zousie ahan sah a; Tualeh amaute abawn un leengpa kungah ahing pei uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in, “Nang Ahitup tapa tuin na ngaikhie in” achi hi. Tualeh aman adawnga “Pu aw tanah ka um hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in akungah, “Bangdinga nang leh Jesse tapa kithukup a kei hingdou nahi uoi? Tanghou leh namsau na pie a, bangdinga keima ahing douna dinga Pasian kunga thu nadoh pieh a tuni donga kei ahing lamtan ahiei?” achita hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahimelek in adawnga akungah, “Leengpa mahpa na mi dohpen, na innsunga zatat um pen, na suohte zousie lah a David banga muonhuoi koi aum ei?"},"15":{"text":"Ama dinga Pasian thu ka dohpieh apatna ahiei mah? ahi keisih hi. Lengpa’n asuohpa ahiei, ka pa innsungmi zousie ahiei hing ngoh vawt sih heh, na suohpa’n tam thute alien aneu bangma ka theikha mawngmawng sih hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n akungah, “Ahimelek na shi teitei ding ahi, nang leh napa innsung mizousie toh,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n akim a ama venga ding galkapte kungah, “Kihei unlen Mangpa siempute that un, David lam a apan zieh u’leh ataina lam theinazen a, ahing hillou ziehun,” achi hi. Hinanleh leengpa suohte koiman Mangpa siempute tung ah khut aha nuom sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n Doeg kungah, “Nangma kihei inlen, siempute satlia in,” achi hi. Tualeh Edom mi Doeg akihei a siempute a satlia ta hi. Tua ni in siempu puontuol sil ngen sawm giet leh nga athat hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh siempute khuo a um numei, pasal, naupang leh nausen nawine lai nasan leh bawngte sabiltungte leh belamte zong namsau hiem in asatliata hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Ahitup tapa Ahimelek tapate lah a khat amin Abiathar asuohta a, David kungah atai lutta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Abiathar in, Saul in Mangpa siempute atha thu David ahila."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh David in Abiathar kungah, “Tuami niin Edom mi Doeg a um chileh Saul ahil ngei ngei ding chi ka thei hi, na pa innkuonte keima zieh a shi ahi"},"23":{"text":"Nang ka kungah um inlen zausin, kei tha hing tumten nang zong tha ahing tum ding uhi, ka kungah umlachin na suohta ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n “Ngaiin Philistin miten Keilah khuo asim ua, phuola bute alahpieh uhi chi’n David ahil uhi.”","title":"Keilah khuo ah David aum"},"2":{"text":"Tuaziehin David in Mangpa adong a; “Ka va pei in Philistinte ka va bulu ta diei?” achi hi. Tualeh Mangpa’n David kungah, “Philistin mite va bulu inlen Keilah khuo va humbit in,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh David miten akungah, “En in, tam Juda gam a um zong kizau nalai a, Keilah khuo a Philistin mite dou dinga va kuon ding zauhuoi dieh ven,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Mangpa adong kia a, Tualeh Mangpa’n adawnga, “Thou inlen Keilah khuo ah kuon suh in, Philistin mite na khut ah ka hing pe ding;” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh David leh amite Keilah khuo ah akuon suh ua, Philistin mite ava dou ua, mi tampi athat ua, agantate uh alahpieh uhi. Tuachi’n David in Keilah khuo a mite ahundohta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahia, Ahimelek tapa Abiathar Keilah khuo a David kung a, atai laiin, siempu puonahtuol akhut a tawi pum a pei suh ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Keilah khuo ah David apeita chi Saul ahil uhi. Tuachi’n Saul in, “Pasian in ama ka khut a hing pie ahi tave; kul kotpi leh akilna nei khopi alut in akikhah khumta ngal a,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in mi zousie, Keilah khuo a peisuh a, David leh amite imtawm ding leh dou dingin ahankhawmta hi."},"9":{"text":"Saul in atungah aguh in silhoilou abawl hi chi David in ana thei a; Siempu Abiathar kungah “Siempu puonahtuol hing tawi in,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in, “Aw Israel Mangpa Pasian na suoh keima ziehin Saul in khuo suse dingin Keilah khuo ah hing kuonsuh atum hi chi kana za hi."},"11":{"text":"Keilah khuo miten akhut ah ahing pekhe ding uoi? Na suoh in azah bangin Saul ahing kuonsuh tahtah diei? Aw Israel Mangpa Pasian, na suohpa hing hil in, ka hing ngen ahi,” achi hi. Tualeh Mangpa’n akungah, “Hing peisuh ding ahi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in, “Keilah khomiten Kei leh ka mite Saul khut ah ahing pekhe ding uoi?” achi hi. Tualeh “Mangpa’n ahing pe ding uhi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n David leh amite zaguh dingvel adingdoh ua, Keilah khuo apat in apawtdoh ua, apeitheina lam lam chiet uah apeita uhi. Tualeh Keilah khuo akipat in David ataikheta chi Saul ahil ua, Tuachi’n agal kuon ding akhawlsah tahi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh David khu gamdai a, leikohawmte ah a um a, tualeh Ziph gamdai a singtang gam ah aumdenta hi. Tuachi’n Saul in ni simin David asui a, hinanleh Pasian in akhut sungah David apesih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n David Ziph gamdai a Horesh mun a aum laiin Saul in ama tha tumin asui kawi hi chi athei hi.","title":"Horesh mun a David aum lai a Jonathan in ava vena"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Saul tapa Jonathan adingdoh a, Horesh mun a um David kungah ava haw a, Pasian in na khut ahing hatsah zel ding hi chi’n David ava hanthawn hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh akungah, “Zau vawtsin, ka pa Saul khut in ahing suidohbut sih ding hi. Israelte tungah leeng na hing hidinga, nang ban ah kei kahi ding hi; tam thu ka pa Saul in athei kilkel hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute gelin Mangpa masangah thuhun abawl ua, tualeh David khu Horesh mun ah aumdenta a, Jonathan pen innlang ah apeita hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 18.3"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ziph mite Gibeah khuo a Saul kungah ava peitou ua, “David ka kung ua Jeshmon simlang a um Hakilah singtaang gam a Horesh leikohawm lah a, kiphuol hilou ahiei mah?","title":"David Saul khut apat asuohtatna","ref":"Late. 54"},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, Aw leengpa na hinna in atup bangin hing peisuh inlen, tualeh koute bawl ding ahileh leengpa khuta ama hing na piehkhiet ding ahi” achi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in, “Noute Mangpa’n hing guolzawlta hen, nouten kei nang hepi mama uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hepitahin pei unlen akibutna mun va thei chien zawsem unlen, anua vazui unlen, tualeh khum mun a koi vamu ahiei hing kanchien un. Ama khu pilkhel tah a gamta ahi chi mi’n ahing hil hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin akibutna mun zousie hing thei unlen, tualeh thu chientah toh ka kungah hing peikia tei tei unlen, tuachi’n nou toh ipei suh ding hi. Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, gamsunga um ahi nahpouleh Juda namte zousie lah akipat in ka suidoh nading hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n akipandoh ua, Saul masangah Ziph gam ah apeita uhi. Hinanleh David leh amite khu Maon gamdai a, Jeshmon simlam phaijangah a um uhi."},"25":{"text":"Saul leh amite David suidinga akuon tahun, David kungah ava hil ua. Tuaziehin Maon gamdai a, suongpi umna lam zuon in apei suhta hi. Tua thu Saul in azahtah in Maon gamdai ah David anuadel ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n taang pang lang khat ah apei a, tualeh David leh amite taang lelam pang langkhat ah apei uhi. Tualeh David khu Saul zau in kintah a kihepmang atum hi; aziehpen Saul leh amiten David leh amite mattum in a imkuol ta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanlezong Saul kungah “Thangkou mi ahing tunga, kintahin hing pei in, Philistin miten igam ahing dou uhi,” achi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin Saul in David anuadel lai akinualesan a, Philistin mite dou dingin akuonta hi; tuazieh in tuamun khu (suotat na suongpi) achita uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n David khum mun akipat in apeitou a En Gedi suong kohawmte ah aumta hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, Saul Philistin mite vadel ahing ki nuale kia laiin, “Ngai in, David khu En-Gedi gamdai ah a um hi,” chi’n ahil uhi.","title":"David in Saul hinna akhoi pieh"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in Israel mite zousie lah akipat mi tul thum atel tuomte azawpi a, David leh amite sui dingin gam sakelte umna suongpite lang ah akuonta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n lamkaal a belam huong kohawm umna ava tung ua, tualeh Saul khu khawl tawldam dingin ava lut hi. Tualeh David leh amite khu kohawm sunggil lam ah aum uhi.","ref":"Late. 57; 142"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh David miten akungah, “Ngai in, Mangpa’n na kungah, na khut ah na melma ka hing pe dinga, a tungah hoi nasah dandan in bawlin achi khu tuni ahi,” achi uhi. Tualeh David adingdoh a, Saul puontuol mong aguhin ava attan piehta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaminuoin hichi ahia, Saul puontuol mong ava attan pieh ziehin David lungsim ana mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh aman amite kungah, “Mangpa sathau nu ahi chi thei sasa a, atunga ka khut ha a, Mangpa sathau nusa ka pu tunga khut ka hah khu Mangpa’n aphal sih hi,” achi hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 26.11"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in tua thu toh amite azawl lungdam a, Saul dou dinga akuon ding uh aphal sih hi. Tualeh Saul athou a, kolhawm akipat apawtdoha, apeita hi."},"8":{"text":"Anua deu in David zong adingdoh a, kawlhawm a kipat in apawtdoh a, “Ka pu leengpa aw,” chi’n Saul anuahat a, tualeh Saul hing kinuahei a, a et leh David in tuol a bohkhup in zana apeta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh David in Saul kungah, “David in na sietna ding abawl hi chia miten na kunga agen uh bangdinga tahsang na hiei?"},"10":{"text":"Ngaiin tuni’n kawlhawm sunga na umlai in Mangpa’n nang pen ka khut sunga ahing piehkhiet dan na mit ngeiin namu hi. Nang that dinga hing sawl pawl aum ua, hinanleh keiman ka hing hinkhawi nalai hi, ka pu tungah khut ha vawt sih vang ama lah Mangpa sathau nusa ahingal a, ka chi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuathamlouin, pa, en in, na puon mong zong ka khut ah ka tawi nalai hi; na puon mong attan thei ngal inga, ka hing thalou khu ka khutah silhoilou leh bawlsietna leh helna lungsim a um sih chi leh, na tungah khelna ka nei sih chi leh ka hinna lah tumin hing sui kawi nanlachin zong na tungah ka khiel sih hi chithei teitei in."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa’n nang toh ikaal thu ngaituota hen, Mangpa’n na tungah phu hing lahpieh tahen; hinanleh ken vang na tungah khut ka havawt sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Nidanglai paunah in, Migilou akipat in gitlouna apawt zel achi a; hinanleh ken vang na tungah khut ka hasih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel leengpa koi sui a hingkuon na hiei? koi ahiei na nuadel? Ui shisa leh uihit nuadel na hiei?","ref":"1 Sam. 26.20"},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa, khu thukhentu hi henlen, tualeh nang leh kei kikaal ah thu akhen dinga, ka tung thu ah en chien in hing genpieh henlen, na khut akipat in hing hundohta hen” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing ahia, David in tamthute Saul kunga agen zou in, Saul in “Tam khu nang awsuo ama ka tapa David?” achita hi. Tualeh Saul aw ngaitah in akapta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman David kungah “Kei sangin nang na dihtat zaw hi, nangma’n keitung ah sil hoi na bawl ziehin, ken na tungah sil hoilou in ka hing thuh hi."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa’n na khut sunga kei ahing pieh lai a zong na hing tha tuomlou zieh in, tuni’n ka tung a silhoi na bawldan na sulangta hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi’n a melma mu taleh damtahin apeisah mawh ding ama? Tuaziehin tunia ka tunga na silhoi bawlte ziehin Mangpa’n silhoi in nang hing thuhta hen."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh tuin, ngaiin leengpa na hing hi dinga, Israel leenggam na khutah suhkip ahi ngei ding achi hi, tunvang ka thei chienta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka nua a, ka hahlesuonte that gamlou ding leh ka pa innsunga kipat ka min sumanglou dingin, Mangpa min in kichiem in achita hi.”"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n David zong Saul kungah akichiemta hi. Tuachi’n Saul a innlangah apeita hi; Hinanleh David leh amite pen kawlhawm lam zuon in apeitouta uhi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel ashita a; tualeh Israel mite zousie ahing kikhawm ua, asuunta uhi. Tualeh Ramah khuo a ainn ah avuita uhi. Tuazou in David adingdoh a Paran gamdai ah apei suhta hi.","title":"Samuel shina, Nabal leh Abigail tangthu"},"2":{"text":"Maon khuo ah mi khat a um a, anasepna mun khu Karmel muol ahi. Amapa khu mihausa tah ahia, belam tul thum leh kel tul khat anei hi, Karmel muol ah belam mul amet hi.","title":"David leh Nabal"},"3":{"text":"Tua mipa min Nabal ahia, azi min Abigail ahi. Tualeh amanu sil theisiemna nei numei leh melhoi tah ahi; Hinanleh apasal khu mi genha leh gamtat hoilou mi ahia, Kaleb hahlesuon ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh David in gamdai akipat in Nabal in belam mul amet hi chi ana za hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in tangval sawm asawl a; tualeh David in tangvalte kungah, “Karmel muol ah va peitou unlen, Nabal kungah vahaw unlen, ka min in chibai va buh un."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh mi neizoupa kungah hichibangin hing gen un, Na tungah, na innkuonpite tungah leh na nei zousie tungah hamuonna umta hen."},"7":{"text":"Belam mulmet mite nanei chi kana za a, na belam chingte ka kungah ahing um zel ua, bangma kalaw ngai sih ua, Karmel muol a aum sungsie uh bangma amansuo ngai sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Na tangvalte donglachin ahing hil mai ding uhi. Tuaziehin ka tangvalten na mitmu ah deisahna tangta uhen. Pawi bawl huntah a hing pei ka hi ziehun, na suohte leh na tapa David nanei dandan na pie in, achi hi, chi’n vagen un” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n David tangvalten ava tun tah un, David min in tua thu zousie Nabal kungah agen ua, angahta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Nabal in David suohte adawnga, “David koi ahiei, tualeh Jesse tapa zong koi ahiei? Tulai in suoh tampi apute uh taimangsan atam uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ka tanghou, ka tui leh ka belam mulmette dinga ka gawsa maw la a, ahing kipatna uh ka theilou mite, ka pieh kawi mama ding?” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n David tangvalte akihei ua, anua peikiata uhi; tualeh atun un, tua thu zousie David ahilta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in amite kungah, “Na namsau uh kuo chietun” achi hi. Tuachi’n anamsau uh a kuo chiet ua, tualeh David in zong anamsau akuo a, tualeh mi zali in David azui ua, tualeh mi zani neitahte vengin aum uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh asuohte lah a khat in, Nabal zi Abigail ana hil a, “En in, David in gamdai akipat in kapu uh chibai buh dingin mi ahing sawl a, aman ana housie hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh tua mite kou a dingin ahoi mama ua, ka sietna dinguh bangma abawl sih uhi, gam lahah ka um ua, ama u’toh ka um khawm sungun bangma ka mansuo sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Belam chinga ama u’toh ka um sungsie un, sun leh zan in kou a dingin kulpi ahi mai uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, ngaituo in bang ahiei na bawl ding, aziehpen kapu uh tung leh a innkuonpite zousie tungah sietna bawl tum a um hi; Amalah mithusie koima houpi theilou ahi ngal a,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abigail in kintahin tanghou pheng zani, uoin thawl ni toh, huon dinga bawlzousa belam nga toh, bu ki kangsa atena dim nga toh, grepga kiphou gaw um dim zakhat toh, theipi ga apat kibawl tanghou pheng zani ala khawm a, sabiltungte tungah akhangtou tahi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n asuohte kungah, “Ka masangah pei unlen, ngai un na nua uah ka hing pei ding hi,” achi hi. Hinanleh amanu’n Nabal ahil sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing ahia, Amanu sabiltung tunga tuonga muol pang ken a ahing pei suh laiin; David leh amite amanu lam zuon in ahing pei suh ua, tuachi’n amanu’n ana lamtuo hi."},"21":{"text":"David in “Bangma amansuo louna dingin, gamdai ah tua mipa nei zousie athawn a na ven pieh suoh ka hita ve; Aman lah silhoi silhoilou in ahing thuh ta hi."},"22":{"text":"Zingmawng khovah chienga, anei zousie pasal khat zong ka hinkhawi leh Pasian in David melmate alaw law lawta hen, tuasanga thupi zawin zong bawlta heh,” ana chi zouta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Abigail in David amu tahin sabiltung tunga pat in akum suh pai a, amai a tuol suin khupboh in chibai abuh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh akengbul ah aboh a, “Kei tungah Pu aw keima tung mama ah, tam thulimlouna um henlen, tualeh na suohnu’n na zahin thu gensah inlen, na suohnu thugen hing ngaikhiet pieh in."},"25":{"text":"Pu aw hepitahin tam miphatuom loupa Nabal bangman ngaisin amin leh ama kibang lien ahi, amin Nabal ahia, mimaw ahi. Hinanleh kei na suohnu’n ka pu hing sawl tangvalte kana mukha sih hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin pu aw, Mangpa hinna leh nangma hinna lou in ka gen ahi, Mangpa’n sisan suolou ding leh nangma khut ngei a phuba la dingin ahing phal sih chi thei in, Tuachi’n na melmate leh ka pu sietna ding bawl mite Nabal bangin um mai uheh."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh tu’n na suoh nu’n ka pu dinga ka hing tawi tam silpiehte ka pu hing zui tangvalte pieh hihen."},"28":{"text":"Hepitahin na suohnu gamtatkhelnate hing ngaidam in. Mangpa’n kapu innkuon kiptahin ahing bawl ngei ding hi, kapu in Mangpa kidouna adou ziehin, na damsung tengin sil hoilou nangma ah mu ding aum sih ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Nang hing nuadel ding leh na hinna sumang dingin mite hing kipan nan u’leh, kapu hinna khu Mangpa na Pasian hinna lom lah a kaan khawm ahi dinga; tualeh na melmate hinna khu, saili kuonga sailungtang kapmang bangin akapmang ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi dinga, Mangpa’n nangma tungtang thu a, anagensa silhoi zousie, ka pu tunga abawl hun chienga, tualeh Israelte tunga vaihawma ahing pansah chiengin;"},"31":{"text":"a sisan na suolou zieh leh phuba na lahlou zieh in, nangma dingin lunggimna leh lungnop mawna mawngmawng ahisih ding hi. Hinanleh Mangpa’n kapu tunga silhoi ahing bawl hun chiengin na suohnu hing thei zingin aw,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh David in Abigail kungah, “Tunia keima hingdawn dinga hing sawlpa Israelte Mangpa Pasian phat in um hen."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh na lemguot siemna guolzawl in um henlen, tualeh sisan suona apat leh ka khut ngei a phuba lahna dinga pat a, hing na hunkhie nangma zong, guolzawl in umta’n."},"34":{"text":"Kei hing dawn dinga hing pawtkhe pailou hi lachin, Nangma ka hing liemsah na dinga pat a hing hemkhepa Israelte Mangpa Pasian hinna louin ka gen hi, zingmawng khovah chiengin, Nabal a dingin pasal naupang khat zong ka hinkhawi pieh sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in amanu hing sil tawite ala a, akungah, “Lungmuong tahin na inn lamah peitouta in, Ngaiin na thu ka zui hi, tualeh na ngette zong ka hing pom pieh hi,” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Abigail Nabal kungah ahing tunga, tualeh ngaiin, Nabal in leengte annkuong luina bang mai in a inn ah guolvahna pawi ana bawl hi. Tualeh zu akham mama ziehin Nabal lungsim anuom mama hi, tuaziehin zingmawng khovah masang sie’n amanu’n atawm atam bangma ahil sih hi."},"37":{"text":"Hinanleh azingmawngin hichi ahing ahia, Nabal zu kham ahing thentah in, azi in tam thute ahilta hi, tuachi’n alungsim a bangma ngaituo thei louin, suongtum bang mai in aumta hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh ni sawm nua ding vel in, Mangpa’n Nabal tungah akhut aha a, ashita hi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh David in Nabal ashi chi azah tahin, ka minsietna dinga, “Nabal sil bawlte akipat ahing genpi a, asuohpa silhoilou bawllou dinga hing kempa, Mangpa phat in um hen.
