Nabal gitlounate Mangpa’n ama tung mama ah atusah ta hi achia,” tualeh David in Abigail azi dinga va dawp dingin mi asawlta hi.","title":"Abigail David zi in aum"},"40":{"text":"Tualeh David suohte Karmel muola Abigail kunga ava tun tahun, “David in azi dinga nangma hing dawp dingin ahing sawl hi,” chiin amanu ahoupi uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Abigail adingdoh a, tuol a khupbohin chibai abuh a, akung uah “Ngaivawi un, na suohnu uh kapu suohte keng sil dinga suoh kahi bou hi,” achi hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abigail adingdoh vat a, Sabiltung tung ah atuonga, anuazui nungah ngate toh, David misawlte azui ua, azi in a umta hi."},"43":{"text":"David in Jezreel khuo a mi Ahinoam zong ana puita a, tuachi’n ani un azi in a um tuoh ta uhi."},"44":{"text":"Hinanleh Saul in atanu David zi Mikal khu Gallim khuo a Laish tapa Paltiel toh ana kiteng sahta hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 3.14-16"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu’n Ziphmite Gibeah khuo a Saul kungah “Ahing pei ua, Jeshmon lelam panga Hakilah muol ah David akiphuol hilou amah?” chiin ahing hil uhi.","title":"David in Saul hinna akhawi ni veina","ref":"Late. 54"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul a dingdoh a, Ziph gamdai ah David sui dingin Israel mi teltuom tul thum zawpi in Ziph gamdai ah akuon suhta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in Jeshmon lelampanga um lampi a Hakilah muol ah panmun akhaw a, hinanleh David khu gamdai ah aum den a, tualeh Saul ama sui in gamdai ah ahing pei hi chi ana thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin David in enkhemite asawl a, Saul ahing pei nahi chi atheichienta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh David a dingdoh a, Saul panmun khawna ah ava haw a, tualeh David in Saul leh agalkap lamkai Ner tapa Abner lupna ava mu a, Saul khu giehphuol sungah a lum a, agalkapten ama kimkot in giehmun abawl uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Hitmi Ahimelek leh Joab sanggampa Zeruiah tapa Abishai kungah, “Saul giehphuol a keima toh va kuon suh ding koi nahi uoi le?” achia. Tualeh Abishai in “Keima toh iva kuon suh ding,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n David Abishai toh zanlai in galkapte umna ah ava peita ua, tualeh giehphuol sungah Saul alum a, aluhung ah ateipi lei ah aphut a, tualeh Abner leh galkapte akimkot in alum uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abishai in David kungah, “Tuin Pasian in na melma na khut sungah ahing pie hi, tuaziehin teipi in tuol toh ka sunbet suh aw, nivei sut ngainawn sih va” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh David in Abishai kungah, “That sin, aziehpen Mangpa sathau nu tunga khut ha a, mawtanglou koi a um thei diei?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"David mama in “Mangpa hinna lou in kagen hi. Mangpa’n ama tungah khut ha naven, ahisihleh zong ashini hing tung nava, ahisileh kidouna ah kuon van in, mangthai nava."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa sathau nu tunga ka khut ka hah ding Mangpa’n aphal sih hi. Hinanleh aluhunga teipi leh tuithawl hing la inlen tuachi’n ipei sanding,” achi hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 24.6"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Saul lu hung a um teipi leh tuithawl ala a, apeikiata uhi, tuachi’n koima’n amu sih ua, koima’n athei sih ua, tualeh koima zong akhanglou sih uhi, Mangpa’n nuomtah a, a imut sah ziehin, a imu chiet uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n David khu agal lang khat ah apei a, gamlapi a muolvum ah adinga, akikaal uh gamlapi ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh David in galkapte leh Ner tapa Abner ahan a, akungah, “Abner aw, hing dawnglou ding na hiei mah?” achia, tuachi’n Abner in ahing dawnga, “Leengpa han khu koi na hiei?” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Abner kungah, “Mi hangsan khat na hi sih amah? Israelte lah ah nang bang koi aum ei mah? Bang dinga napu leengpa venglou na hiei? Aziehpen napu leengpa sumangthai dingin mi koi ahiei ahing pei hi, achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Na silbawl ahoi sih hi. Mangpa hinna lou in ka gen ahi. Na pu Mangpa sathau nu khu navenlou ziehin shitah nahi, tualeh tu’n en in leengpa luhung a teipi leh tuithawl heisunga um atai?” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in David aw ahi chi atheikheta a, akungah “Tua khu nangma aw hina maw, ka tapa David?” achi hi. Tualeh David in kapu leengpa “Aw tami keima aw ahi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh David in akungah, “Bang zieh a kapu leengpa’n asuohpa hichibanga anuadel kawi ahiei? Bang khelna ka nei ahiei? ahisihleh ka khut ah sil hoilou bang aum a ahiei mah?"},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin kapu leengpa’n na suoh thugen na ngaikhie in; Keima dou dinga a nang hing hanthawn Mangpa ahileh, sillat pom henlen, hinanleh mihing ahi u’leh hamsietin um uheh, aziehpen amaun tuni’n Mangpa gou ka luo theilouna dingin, pei inlen pasien dangte nna vasem in chi’n ahing notdohta uhi"},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin tu’n ka sisan Mangpa mu phahlou in gamdangte leitang tungah luong sih heh, muoldawn a vala man dinga mite gam avah bangun, Israel leengpa ui hit nengpou sui dinga hing kuondoh zel hie izaw,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in, “Ka khielta hi, hing peikia in ka tapa David. Tuni a na mitmu a ka hinna amanphat mama ziehin na tungah sietna mawngmawng ka bawl nawn sih ding hi. Ngaiin mot huoitah in sil kana bawla, kana sukhiel naah mama hi,” achi hi.","title":"Saul in akhelna aphawhdoh na"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh David in adawnga, “En in leengpa teipi ka kungah aum hi, tangvalte khat hing pei henlen hing la heh."},"23":{"text":"Mangpa’n michin adihtatna leh amuonhuoina bangin kipahman a peding hi, tuni’n Mangpa’n nangma ka khut ah ahing pe na a, hinanleh Mangpa sathau nu tungah ka khut kaha nuom sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh ngaiin tunia na hinna ka mit mua amanphat bangin, Mangpa mitmu in keima hinna zong manpha tahen, tualeh genthei bawlna zousie apat in hing hundoh tahen,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in David kungah, “Ka tapa David guolzawl in um in, sil thupi tah tah na bawl dinga tualeh na zou zel ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n David apeita a, tualeh Saul zong a inn langah apeita hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh David in alungsim in, “Bangchih ni ahiei chiengin Saul khut a mangthai khong khong ding ka hia, Philistin mite gam a Kintah a tailut a suotat sanga kei dinga hoizaw um nawnlou ding hi. Saul in Israel gamsung teng ahing sui chiengin alungdongta dinga, tuachi’n akhut a kipat in ka suohta ta ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Gath a David galtaina"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n David a kipandoh a, ama leh akunga um mi zaguh toh, Gath leengpa Maok tapa Akish kungah ava peita hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n David khu amipite toh, michin ainnkuonpite chiet utoh, tualeh David zong azi tegel Jezreel mi Ahinoam leh Karmel mi Nabal zi Abigail toh Gath khuo a Akish kungah ava tengta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n David Gath khuo ah atai chi Saul ahil ua, tuachi’n asui nawnta sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Akish kungah, “Na mitmu a deisahna katan leh na gam sunga khopite lah khat ah tenna ding mun hing pie in, khunah ka teng ding hi, bang zieh a na suohpa nangma toh leengpa khopi sunga teng ding ahiei?” achi hi.","title":"David in gam lienpi aneina"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua niin Akish in Ziglag khuo apeta hi, tuaziehin tuni dongin Ziglag khuo khu Juda leengte a ahi denta hi."},"7":{"text":"Philistinte gam a David a ten hun sung khu kum khat leh ha li ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh David leh amite akuontou ua, Geshur mite, Girzimite leh Amalek mite ava sim uhi. Aziehpen tua namte khu nidanglai akipat a, Shur gam a kipata Izipt gam donga na tengte ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh David in ava simna gam taphot numei leh pasal koima ahinkhawi sih hi, hinanleh belamte, bawngtalte, Sabiltungte leh sangawngsaute leh puonsilte alah pieh a, ahing kinuale zel a, Akish kungah ahaw zel hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Akish in, “Tuni’n heilang nava sim ei?” ana chizel a, tualeh David in “Juda gam simlam-Jerameel mite gam simlam” tualeh “Ken mite gam simlam te, kava simzel hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh David in Philistin mite gam sunga aten sung tengin, “David in hichibangin abawl zel hi, chi’n hing gen khava uh achi zieh in,” Gath khuoa thu polut thei ding numei hiin pasal hitaleh hinkhawi mawng mawng anei sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Akish in David thugen atahsangta a, “Ami Israelte akimuda sah mama a, tuaziehin kumtawn in ka suohin a umden ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hunlai in hichi ahing ahia, Philistin miten Israelte dou dingin agalkapte uh akaikhawm ua. Tualeh Akish in David kungah, “Nang leh na mite kidouna a ka kungah na hing kuon ngei ngei dinguh ahi chi thei in,” achi hi.","title":"Philistinten Israelte adou uh"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh David in Akish kungah, “Hi e, na suohpa sil bawlthei dan theina ve chin” achi hi. Tualeh Akish in David kungah, “Tuaziehin kei hing veng lamkai dingin ka hing bawl kumtawnta ding hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tu’n Samuel ashita a, tualeh Israelte zousie’n ama asuun chiet ua, tualeh akhuo Ramah ah avuita uhi. Tualeh Saul in aisan siemte leh dawithu siemte agam apat in adeldoh ta hi.","title":"Pasian in Saul adawng sih hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 25.1\n        ;     \n        Siempu. 20.27; Danp. 18.10,11"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin mite ahing kikaikhawm ua, Shunem ah panmun akhaw uhi. Tualeh Saul in zong Israel mi zousie akaikhawma, Gilboa ah panmun abawlta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Saul in Philistin galkapte amutahin azauta mama a, alungsim ha tangpi in atuun gawpta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in Mangpa adoh chiengin, manglam ahiei, Urim ahiei, guolneite kam ahiei in zong adawng mawngmawng sih hi.","ref":"Kisim. 27.21"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in asuohte kungah, “Numei dawi ai san siem kunga ka haw a, ka doh thei ding hing sui piehun,” achi hi. Tualeh asuohten akungah “Ngai in, Endor khuo ah dawizawl aisan siem numei khat a um hi,” achi uhi.","title":"Saul leh Endor dawisiemnu"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul khu akisiem lamdanga, puon dangte asil a, tualeh ama leh midang ni toh apei ua, tualeh zanlai in numeinu kung ava tungta uhi. Tualeh akungah “Dawi ai hing san pieh inlen amin kalaw penpen hing hat pieh in,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n numei nu’n, akungah, “Ngai in, Saul in agamsunga pat in dawi ai san siemte, dawisiemte asumang sienga, asilbawl dan nathei hi, bang achia ka shina dinga ka hinna thang kamkhum dia kisa na hiei mah?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in amanu kungah, “Mangpa min in akichiem a, tam silziehin gawtna bangma na tungah atungsih ding hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh numei nu’n “Koipen ka hing hatdoh pieh diei?” achi a. Tualeh aman “Samuel hing hatpieh in,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Numei nu’n Samuel amu tahin, aw ngai tahin akikoukheta hi. Tualeh numei in Saul kungah, “Bangdinga hing solna hiei Saul lah na hi ngal a” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh leengpan “Zau sin bang ahiei na mu?” achi a. Tualeh “Numeinu’n leilah akipata pasien hing pawtdoh ka mu hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh aman numeinu kungah, “Bang mel apuo ei?” achia, tualeh amanu’n “Tehse pu khat a hing pawttou a, puontuol asil hi,” achi a. Tualeh Saulin Samuel ahi chi athei a, amai tuolsu in chibai abuh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in Saul kungah, “Bangzieha hichibanga buoihuoi taha hing handoh na hiei?” achi a, Saul in “Ka lunggim senga ahi, chi’n adawng hi. Philistin miten ahing dou ua, Pasian in lah ahing kiheimangsanta a, manglam leh guolneite in zong ahing dawng nawn mawngmawng sih hi, Tuazieh in bang bawl ding ka hiei? chi hinghil dinga ka hing hatdoh ahi,” achita hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Samuel in akungah, “Mangpa’n ahing leengatsanta a, na melma ahita chi theina zenpi a, bangdinga kei na hingdoh nahlai ahiei?"},"17":{"text":"Mangpa’n keima zanga agen bangbangin abawl ahita hi. Mangpa’n na khuta kipat in na leenggam ahing lah pieh a, na innvengpa David apeta hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 15.28"},"18":{"text":"Mangpa thu na manlou a, athangpaina mama Amalek mite tunga na tangtunlou zieh in, Mangpa’n tam silte tuni’n na tungah abawlta hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 15.3-9"},"19":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Mangpa’n Israelte nangma toh Philistin mite khutah ahing pekhe dinga, tualeh zing chiengin nang leh na tapate ka kungah na hing umta ding uhi. Mangpa’n Israel galkapte Philistin mite khut ah ahing pekhe ding hi.”"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samuel thugente ziehin Saul azau sengsenga lei ah apua lieng luong a; tha le zung mawngmawng anei sih hi, sun nitum leh zankhovah a ann nelou ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh numei khu Saul kungah ahing pei a, abuoi mama chi amu a, “Ngai in, na suohnu’n na gen ka manga, shi zong khawh salou in, ka kunga na thugen ka hing ngaikhie hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin tu’n nang zong na suohnu thugen hing ngaikhieh pieh sam inlen, tuachi’n ann themkhat ka hing lui dinga, ne in, na lampeina a tha nanei na dingin,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh a ut sih a, “Kane sih ding” achi hi, hinanleh asuohte leh numei nu’n asawl teitei ua, tuachi’n athu uh amangta hi. Tuachi’n lei akipat in athou a, lupna tungah atouta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n numeinu’n ainn ah bawngnou vahthau khat anei a, kintah a kisa in ava thata, tualeh tangbuong ala a, ameh a, tangbuong tolsawlou akang hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Saul leh asuohte masang ah ava lui a, tuachi’n ane uhi, tuachi’n adingdoh ua, khum zan in apeita uhi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin miten agalkap zousiete uh Aphek mun ah ahankhawm ua, tualeh Israelten zong Jezreel tuikhuh kungah panmun akhaw uhi.","title":"Philistinten David aginglel uh"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Philistin mite lamkai liente aza tel leh atul tel in galkapte endih dingin avah viel viel ua, hinanleh David leh amiten Akish toh galnua aveng uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin galkap lamkaiten “Tam Hebru mite tam mun a bang hing bawl ahi uoi?” achi uhi. Tualeh Akish in Philistin galkap lamkaite kungah, “Tam mipa Israelte leengpa Saul suohpa David kum hitan veipi ka um khawmpi a, ahing um akipat tuni donga atatkhelna ka mu nailoupa hilou ahiei mah?” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Philistin miliente atungah alungthah ta ua, tualeh Philistin galkap lienten akungah, “Amapa atenna dinga na piehna mun ah nua sawl kia in, kidouna ah eima toh hing kuonda mai heh. Tuachilouin kidouna ah igalte langah pang khava. Tana pasal teng lutang alah masah sih leh apupa toh bang achi kilem thei kia diei?"},"5":{"text":"Tam David khu hilou ahiei mah, Saul in atul atul in athat a, David in atul sawm atul sawm in athat hi, chia. Lam kawma la asah khumpa ukhu? achita uhi.”","ref":"1 Sam. 18.7; 21.11"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Akish in David ahana, akungah, “Mangpa hinna lou in ka gen ahi, mi dihtah na hi a, galkapte lah a na kuon khieh leh na hing tun dante, ka mitmu in ahoi hi. Ka kunga na hing tun nia kipat tuni dongin na tung ah bangma sietna mawngmawng ka mu keei sih hi, hinanleh zong galkap lamkai ten ahing ngaisih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin Philistin galkapte lungkimlou a na koi sang in, hamuong tahin nua pei kia maiin,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Akish kungah, “Ahileh bang kana bawl khiel a ahiei? kapu galte dou dinga ka kuon theilou ding? Tuni donga na kunga ka um sungtengin na suohpa tungah bang na mu ei?” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Akish in adawnga David kungah, “Ka mitmu ah Pasian vansawlsieng bang maiin na hoi hi chi ka thei hi, hinanleh Philistin galkap lienten kidouna ah, ikungah hing kuon mawngmawng sih heh achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin, na kunga um napu suohte toh zingmawng matah in thou unlen, zingmawng phalvah chiengin, matah in peita un,” achita hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n David leh amite Philistin gam a ki nuale kia dingin, zingmawng matah a pei dingin, phalvahin athouta uhi. Tualeh Philistin mite zong Jezreel lam zuon dingin akuontou ta uhi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, ani thum nia David leh amite Ziglag ahingtun tahun, Amalek miten Simlam leh Ziglag khuo ana sim ua, tualeh Ziglag ana bulu ua, mei in ana haltumta uhi.","title":"Pasian in David thumna adawng"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh khosunga mi um zousie alien aneu leh numeite, suoh leh sal in aman ua, koima khat zong that lou in, anazawpi ta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n David leh amite khuo ahing tung ua, tualeh ngaiin ana katum siengta hi, tualeh azite uh, atapate, atanute uh, sal in ana puimang ta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh David leh akunga um miteng kap in aw ngaitah in akikou ua, atha zawt dongun akapta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh David zite gel Jezreel mi Ahinoam leh Karmel mi Nabal zi meithainu Abigail zong sal in ana pui ta uhi.","ref":"1 Sam. 25.42,43"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh David khu chimawin amangbang mama a, michin atapate u’leh atanute uh ngaituo a daa mama ahi ziehun, David suonga se ding thu agen ta uhi, hinanleh David pen Mangpa a Pasian ah akisuhat hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Ahimelek tapa siempu Abiathar kungah, “Hepitahin siempu puonah ka kung ah hing tawi vawi in,” achi hi. Tualeh siempu Abiathar in siempu puonah khu David kungah ahing tawi a.","ref":"1 Sam. 22.20-23"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh David in Mangpa kungah, “Tam galkap honte ka nuadel diei? ka pha zou na diei?” chiin adonga. Tualeh “Aman a dawnga, Del in, na pha ngei ngei dinga, tualeh na hunkhe sieng ngeingei ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n David leh akunga um mi zaguhte akuon ua, Besor luita ava tung ua, tua nah ami nuasiete uh aumta uhi.","title":"David in agalte athana"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh David leh mi za li ten anuadel zel ua, mi zanite pen agim sengtah zieh un Besor luita galkai zoulou in khunah aum denta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamlah ah Izipt mi khat amu ua, David kungah ahing zawpi ua, tualeh tanghou apie ua, tuachi’n aneta a, tualeh tui zong a dawn sah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh theipi apata kibawl tanghou them khat leh akiphougaw lom ni apie ua, tualeh anehzou tahin atha ahing hatkia ta a, aziehpen nithum leh zan thum nelou dawnlou a na um ana hita hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in akungah, “Koi na hiei? hei a hing kipan na hiei?” achi hi. Tualeh aman “Kei Izipt tangval ka hi, Amalek mi khat suohpa ka hia, tualeh ni thum peita sung teng ka chinat zieh in ka pu’n ahing nuasie ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Kereth simlam gam leh Juda gam simlam leh Kaleb simlam gam zong ka sim ua, tualeh Ziglag khuo zong mei in kahal tumta, uhi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh David in akungah, “Tam mihonte kungah nang zawpi suh thei diei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n aman “Hing thatlou ding leh kapu khuta hing pekia lou dingin Pasian min in ka kungah kichiem inlen, tuachi’n tua mihonte kungah ka hing zawpi ding hi,” achita hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman azawpi suh tahin, ngai in, Philistin gam leh Juda gam a gallah sum tampi alah zieh un ne leh dawn leh lam in munchin ah ana umthang sieng uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh David in nitah khomiel kuon a kipat azing ni nitah lam dongin Amalek mite adou a, tangval sagawngsau tunga tuonga taimang mi zali suohtate chilou koima khat zong dam a suohta mawngmawng a um sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amalek miten ana puohmang sieng zousie uh David in anua lah kia siengta hi. Tualeh azite gel zong ahundoh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n aneu alien in, atapate uh hiin, atanute uh hitaleh, gallah sil mawngmawng bangma khat zong mansuo neilou in, David in anualah sieng kiata hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh David in belamhon leh ganhon zousie ala a, tuate khu ganta dangte masang ah akai ua, “Tamte khu David gallah silte ahi, “achi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh David khu, agim seng zieh ua David zui zou nawnlou mi zani Besor luita a na umdente kung ah ahing tunga. Tuachi’n amaute David leh akunga umte na dawn dingin apawtdoh ua, tualeh David mipite kung ahing tuntahin, amauh chibai abuh hi.","title":"Gallah silte kihawmna"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n David nuazui a va kuonte lah a migilou leh buoinabawl mite zousie in, “Amaute ikung ua ahing kuonlou zieh un, pasal pouma’n azite u’leh atate uh akipui ua, apeipi uh iphal pieh uh chilou ngal, igallah vante leh iva nualah kia neitahte mawngmawng amaute ipe sih ding,” achi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh David in, “Ka unaute aw, Mangpa’n ahing vengbit a, eima hing dou dinga hingkuonte ikhut a hing pe pa’n ahing pieh silte tuabang a na bawl ding uh ahi sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Khuchia tambang thu nagen uh koi ahiei ngaikhie a zui ding? kidouna a kuonte tan bangbang van leh neitah venga na umten zong atan ding uh ahi, akibanga tanchiet ding ahi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum nia kipat in tuni tandongin, Israelte lah ah thupieh leh dan dingin abawlta uhi."},"26":{"text":"David Ziklag atun kiatahin, galvanlah khenkhatte khu, “Mangpa melmate lah a kipata kila gallah vante kipahman a nana tan dingin,” chiin Juda upate leh alawi aguolte kungah ahahta hi."},"27":{"text":"Bethel a umte kungah, Ramoth simlam a umte kungah, Jattir a umte kungah."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Aroer a umte kungah, Siphmoth a umte kungah, tualeh Eshtemoa a umte kungah,"},"29":{"text":"Rachel a umte kungah, Jerahmeel mite khopi a umte kungah, Ken mite khopi a umte kungah,"},"30":{"text":"Hormah khuo a umte kungah, Korashan a umte kungah, Athak khuo a umte kungah."},"31":{"text":"Hebron khuo a umte kungah, leh David leh amiten azin kawi kawi na ua atotkhah na mun leh gam a umte kungah ahah uhi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin miten Israelte adou ua, tualeh Israelte khu Philistin mite masangah atai zahta ua, Gilboa muol ah tha in a um zelzul ta uhi.","title":"Gilboa a Saul leh atapate shina"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin miten Saul leh atapate hadel in anuadel ua, tualeh Philistin miten Saul leh atapate Jonathan, Abinadab leh Malkishuah athatta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Saul tawh kidou a kisattuona anase mama a, tualeh thalkapten akap khata ua, tuachi’n thal in aliem nase mama ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in agalvan tawipa kungah, “Na namsau dohkhie inlen hing sunlia in, tuachilouin tam teptanloute ahing pei ding ua, ahing dawtlum ding ua ka tungah akithang al kha ding uhi,” achi hi. Hinanleh agalvan tawipan abawl nuomta sih a, azau mama ta hi. Tuabep in Saul in anamsau ala a, abaw ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh agalvan tawipan zong Saul ashita chi athei tahin, aman zong anamsau abaw a ashi khawmta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul leh atapa thumte leh agalvan tawipa tualeh agalkap zousie toh khumni mama in ashi khawm chietta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh phaijang gallang khat a um Israel mite leh Jordan gallang khat a umten, Israel galkapte taizah leh Saul leh atapate ashita uh chi amu tah un, akhopite uh anua sie ua, ataimangta uhi. Tuachi’n Philistin mite ahing pei ua, tua khopite ah atengta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n azingni in, hichi ahi a, Philistin miten agal thate uh puonsil hawh dinga ahing pei u’leh Gilboa muol tunga Saul leh atapa thumte luong ava muta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n alu atan ua, agalvan ahawh ua, tuami thu khu amilim biehna innte u’leh mipite kunga phuongzah dingin Philistin gamsung pumpi ah thangkou asawl uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n agalvante khu Ashtoreth bieh inn ah akoi ua, tualeh aluong khu Bethshan kulpi bang ah ata uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Jabesh-Gilead khuo a teng miten Saul abawl dante uh ana zah tah un;"},"12":{"text":"Mihangsan zousie akipandoh ua, zan tungtawn in apei ua, Saul leh atapate luong Beth-Shan kulpi banga kipan ava lakhie ua, tualeh Jabesh ahing tut ua, tuanah ahaltumta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n agu teng uh a la khawm ua, Jabesh mun a Tamarisk sing nuoi ah avui ua, ni sagi sung ann angawl uhi."}}}}},"10":{"info":{"name":"2 Samuel","shortname":"2 Sam.","abbr":[],"desc":"Samuel laibu nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Saul shi nua in hichi ahing hia, David Amalekte va sim gal zou a ahing kinuale kia in, David Ziklag ah ni ni a um a.","title":"David in Saul shi atheita"},"2":{"text":"Ani thum niin hichi ahing hia, ngaiin mi khat Saul panmun akipat in, apuonte kibottel gawp leh alutunga a leivui bang niainuai in ahing pei a, tualeh hichi ahia, David kunga ahing tun tahin lei a khupboh in chibai abuh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh David in akungah, “Hei a hing kipan na hiei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n aman akungah, “Israelte pan mun akipat a hing suohta ka hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh David in akungah, “Bangthu a um ei? hing hil in,” achia, tualeh aman adawnga, “Kidouna ah mipite ataizah ua, mipite lah ah tampi apua ua ashi uhi, tualeh Saul leh atapa Jonathan zong ashi uhi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in ama hil tangvalpa kungah, “Bangchidan a Saul leh atapa Jonathan ashi uh chi na thei ahiei?” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh ama hing hil tangval pan, “Bang chidan ahiei in Gilboa muol ah kava um kha laizanga, tuanah Saul ateipi a kingam in aum a; tualeh ngai in. Sakolleng leh sakol tungtuong miten ama ahing delkhawm ua.","ref":"1 Sam. 31.1-6; 1 Khang. 10.1-6"},"7":{"text":"Anua lang ahing et leh kei ahing mu a, ahing han a, tualeh ken, Tanah ka um hi chi’n ka dawng hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh aman ka kungah, koi na hiei? ahing chi a, tualeh ken Amalek mi ka hi chi’n kadawng hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh aman kei kungah, ka kungah hing ding inlen hing thatsuh mai in shi dinga chimawnain ahing buohkhumta a, ka hinna lah aum nalai veu vou a, achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n akungah ka dinga, tuabanga puase gawpsa adamzou nawn sih ding chi ka theichien ziehin ka thatta hi. Tualeh a alutunga amanglukhu leh aban tuomna tau kala a, kapu kungah ka hing tawi hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in apuonsilte abotkehta a, tualeh akunga um zousie’n zong tuabangin abawl uhi"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Saul leh atapa Jonathan leh Mangpa mite leh Israel innkuonte asuun ua, akap ua, nitah tandongin ann angawl uhi, namsau a thalia ahi zieh un."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh David in ama hil tangvalpa kungah, “Heilang mi na hiei?” achia, tualeh aman adawnga, “Kei gamdang mi Amalekmi tapa kahi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh David in akungah, “Mangpa sathaunu that dinga atunga khut na hah, bangchidan a chizalou na hiei mah?” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in tangval khat ahan a akungah “Zuonphei inlen satlia in,” achi hi. Tualeh ava sat a ashita hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in akungah, “Na sisan maw nangma lutungah um heh, aziehpen Mangpa sathaunu ka thatta hi chi nangma kam ngel in apuongta hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Saul leh atapa Jonathan tam kala in a awi hi.","title":"David in Saul leh Jonathan asuunna"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tam Thalpi la, Juda tate hil dingin mi asawl a; Ngai in, Jasher laibu ah akigiel hi.","ref":"Josh. 10.13"},"19":{"text":"“Aw Israel na kilawmna na munsangte ah athat ua, Bangchidan ahiei, miliente apua mai uh."},"20":{"text":"Gath ah gensih unlen, Ashkelon kholaiah phuong sih un, Khuchilouin vang Philistin tanute akipah ding ua, teptanlou tanute nuomsa in akikou kha ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Nou Gilboa muolte aw, na tung uah Daitui ke sih henlen, guo zong zu sih henlen, sillat dingte zong poudoh sih heh. Tuamun ah mihat, lum leh phaw kidahhuoitah in apaita ua, Saul lum leh phaw zong, sathau nulou banga paimang ahita."},"22":{"text":"“Mi kithatte sisan akipat leh mihatte tahsa akipat, Jonathan thal anuakia ngai sih a, tualeh Saul namsau zong aguohin akinuale kia ngai sih hi."},"23":{"text":"“Saul leh Jonathan hindan lah adeihuoi in akilawm ua, tualeh ashi un zong akikhen sih ua, mipite sangin ahatzaw ua, humpibahneite sangin zong ahat zaw uhi."},"24":{"text":"“Nou Israel tanute aw, Saul sun unlen kap un, Puonsandup kilawmtahte ahing silsah a, na puonsilte u’tungah sana a kizepnate, ahing baat pieh hi."},"25":{"text":"“Kidouna kim laitah a, mi hatte apua taah mai uh; “Aw Jonathan, na mun sangte a tha a na umtah mai!"},"26":{"text":"Ka lung azing hi na tung thu ah, Aw ka unaupa Jonathan; ka tungah na hoi mama a, Nang itna alam dang a; Numei itna akhup hi."},"27":{"text":"“Mi hatte bangchidan a pua a kidouna galvante amanthaitah mawh;” achi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tamte nua in hichi ahia, David in “Mangpa adonga, Judate khopi lah a khat ah ka peitou diei?” achi hi. Tualeh Mangpa’n “Peitou in” achi hi. Tualeh David in “Heipen ah ka peitou diei?” achia, tualeh Mangpa’n “Hebron khuo ah,” achi hi.","title":"Judaten David leeng a abawlna uh"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n David khunah apeitoua, tualeh azite gel, Jezereel mi Ahinoam leh Karmel mi Nabal zi Abigail zong azawpi hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 25.42,43"},"3":{"text":"David in akunga um mite zousie apuitou a, michin a innkuonpite chiet utoh, tuachi’n Hebron leh a khopi te ah atengta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda mite ahing pei ua, Juda mite tunga leeng dingin David sathau anuta uhi. Tualeh amaun “Saul vui mite Jabesh-Gilead mite ahi uh” chi’n David ahil uhi.","ref":"1 Sam. 31.11-13"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Jabesh-Gilead mite kungah mi asawl a, akung uah, “Na pu uh Saul na hepina uh na sulang ua, nana vui ziehun Mangpa’n hing guolzawlta hen, achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n na tung uah hepina leh thutah langsah henlen, tualeh tambang silte na bawl ziehun ken zong tambang hepina na tung uah ka hing thuh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin na khutte uh hatsahin um henlen hangsan tahin um un, na pu uh Saul ashitah ziehin Juda miten atung ua leeng dingin sathau ahing nuta uhi.”"},"8":{"text":"Khumbangkal ah Ner tapa Abner, Saul galkap lamkaipa’n, Saul tapa Ishbosheth khu Mahanaim tan dong apui a.","title":"Abner in Ishbosheth Israel leeng dinga asiemna"},"9":{"text":"Gilead tungah, Ashur tungah, Jezereel tungah, Ephraim tungah, Benjamin tungah, tualeh Israel nam zousie tungah leengpa in abawlta hi."},"10":{"text":"Saul tapa Ishbosheth khu Israelte tunga vai ahawm pat lai in kum sawmli a upa ahia, tualeh kum ni sung vai ahawm hi. Hinanleh Juda miten David azui zaw uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh David in Hebron a Juda innkuonte tunga avaihawm hunsung kum sagi leh haguh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Ner tapa Abner leh Saul tapa Ish-bosheth suohte khu Mahanaim akipat apawtkhie ua, Gibeon ah apeita uhi.","title":"Israel leh Juda kidouna"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Zeruiah tapa Joab leh David suohte zong akuondoh ua, Gibeon dil ah akituoh ua, tuachi’n dil gal langkhat ah pawlkhatte atou ua tualeh dilgal lelam pangah lawi khatte a tou uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abner in Joab kungah, “Tangvalte hing kisa u’henlen imasang ah hing kisattuo u’heh” achi hi. Tualeh Joab in “Kisa u’leh asih diei?” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul tapa Ishbosheth lam a pang Benjamin nam a mi sawm leh ni tualeh David mite sawm leh ni ma akisa ua, agal kaita uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh akituohpi alangpa chiet utoh alu uah akiman ua, namsau in akidawt tuo chiet ua, apuakhawm chiet uhi, tuaziehin khum mun min Helkath-Hazurim achi uhi, tuakhu Gibeon a um ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuani a kidouna khu ahuoise mama a, Abner leh Israel mite khu David leh amite masangah aguollelta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuanah Zeruiah tapa thumte, Joab, Abishai leh Asahel a um uhi, tualeh Asahel khu gam sazuhpi bangmai a ngalhat ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Asahel in Abner anuadela, zietlam ahiei veilam ahiei a, piellou kei in Abner adel vevaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abner akinuahei a, akungah, “Asahel na hiei?” achi a, tualeh aman “Ka hi nahi,” chi’n adawng hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Abner in akungah, “Na zietlam ahiei, na veilam ahiei ah kihei inlen, tangval khat man inlen agalvan lahpiehin,” achi hi. Hinanleh Asahel in ama adel a, akiheisan nuomsih hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abner in Asahel kungah, “Hing kiheisanin, bang dinga hing sunlia a lei lah a hing puasah ding ka hiei mah? Na sanggampa Joab mel bang kachi mungam nawn diei mah?” achi kia hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh aman akiheisan nuom sih a, tuaziehin Abner in atei tong lamin agil ah ana dawt a, a lelam ah apaileta, tualeh tuamun ah apua a, ashita hi. Tualeh hichi ahia, Asahel pua a, ashina mun a hing peikha pouma adinkhawl zel uhi."},"24":{"text":"Joab leh Abishai in zong Abner anuadel ua, tualeh Gibeon gamdai lampi a Giah phah masang a um Ammah muol aphah lai un ni atumta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Benjamin mite Abner kungah ahing kikhawm ua, pawlkhat in ahing kibawl ua, tualeh muolvum ah ava dingta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abner in Joab ahan a, akungah, “Namsau a kidou kumtawn ding ihiei mah? atawp na khu kimudana khat ahi ding chi na thei sih amah? mipite a unaute uh anuadelna ua kipat a nuakia dinga hillou a bangtan vei ahiei na um ding?” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Joab in akungah, “Pasian hinna lou in kagen ahi, bangma na genlou hilachin, mipiten a unaute uh anuadel uh zingmawng a tawpsanta ding hi ua,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab in pengkul amut a, tuachi’n mipite zousie adin khawl chiet ua, Israelte anuadel nawnsih ua, dou zong adou nawn sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abner leh amite zan khovah in phaijang tawn in apei suoh ua, tualeh Bithron akaantan ua, Mahanaim atung uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab zong Abner anuadelna apat anua kiata a, tualeh mipi zousie ahing kikhopkhawm u’leh David mite sawm leh kuo leh Asahel akimta sih uhi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh David miten, Benjamin mi, Abner mite zathum leh sawm guh athat uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Asahel luong ala ua, Bethlehem a um apa han ah avuita uhi. Tualeh Joab leh amite zan tungtawn in apei ua, Hebron atun un, khuo avah hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul innkuonte leh David innkuonte, sawtpi akidou ua, hinanleh David ahat deu deu a, tualeh Saul innkuonte ahatmaw deu deu uhi."},"2":{"text":"David in Hebron ah tapate anei a, ata masapen Amnon ahia, Jezreel mi Ahinoam in ahinpieh ahi.","title":"Hebron a David tapate"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh anina khu Karmel mi Nabal zi Abigail in ahinpieh Kileab ahi a, tualeh athumna khu Geshur leengpa Talmai tanu Maakah tapa Absalom ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh alina khu Haggith tapa Adonijah ahia, angana khu Abital tapa Shephatiah ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aguhna khu David zi Eglah in ahinpieh Ithream ahi. Tamte khu Hebron a pieng David tate ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahi a, Saul innkuonte leh David innkuonte kikaal a kidouna aum sungin Abner in Saul innkuon sung a apan mun asuhat semsem hi.","title":"Abner David kungah atai sawm"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in mei khat anei a, amin Rizpah ahia, Aiah tanu ahi. Tualeh Ishbosheth in Abner kungah, “Bangchidan a ka pa meinu nava luppi ahiei?” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ishbosheth thugen in Abner alungthahsah mama a, tualeh akungah, “Kei Judate langa pang ui lutang ka hiei mah? Tuni tandonga napa Saul innkuonte tung leh a unaute tung leh a lawi aguolte tung ah gin umna ka sulanga, David khut sung ah ka hing pe sih a, hinanleh nangman tuni’n tam numei tunga khiel dingin na hing ngawh mawha."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa David kunga ana kichiemnate bangbanga ka bawl a ka tangtun sah sih leh Pasian in Abner tungah alaw law, law henlen, tua sanga thupi zaw in zong bawl heh.","ref":"1 Sam. 15.28"},"10":{"text":"Dan apata Beer-sheba tandonga Saul innkuonte apat leenggam lehei a, Israel leh Judate tunga David mangtoupha suhkip dingin,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh azau mama ziehin kam khat in zong Abner adawng ngam sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Abner in ama thahengin David kungah mi asawl a, “Tam gam koi a ahiei? ava chi sah a, tualeh ka kungah thuhun bawl inlen, tuachi’n ngai in, Israel mi zousie nangma lam a pang dingin, ka hing panpi ding achisah nalai hi.”","title":"Abner leh David kilemna"},"13":{"text":"David in “Ahoi hi, na kungah thuhun kabawl ding, hinanleh sil khat ka hing phut ding hi, tua khu tami ahi, ahing kimupi dinga na hing pei chieng Saul tanu, Mikal nang zawpi sihleh ka mel na muthei sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Saul tapa Ishbosheth kungah “Ka zi Mikal Philistin mite tepvun zakhat a ka leisa khu hing pie in,” chi’n mi asawl hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 18.27"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Ishbosheth in mi asawl a, pasal Laish tapa Paltiel kunga kipat in ava ladoh sahta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n apasal in lam tungtawn in kap kawm in Bahurim tandong azui a, tuachi’n Abner in akungah “Nua peikia tain” achi a; anuakia ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Abner in Israel upate ahoupi a, “Tumasanglai in David na tung ua leeng dingin nana dei ua:"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin pangsah ta un, Mangpa’n David tungthu ah, ka suohpa David zangin ka mi Israelte Philistin mite leh amelmate uzousie apat in ka hundam ding hi, chi’n ana genta hi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Abner in Benjamin namte zah in zong a gen a, tuachi’n Abner in Israelte leh Benjamin innkuonte zousie in hoi asah dan uh, Hebron a David zah a vagen dingin apei ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abner in Hebron khuo a, David kung ah mi sawmni toh ava pei a, tualeh David in Abner leh azawpite adingin annkuong alui a."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abner in David kungah, “Ka dingdoh dinga, na kunga thu ahun theina ding u’leh na deitel na bang tah a vai na hawm theina dingin Israel mi zousie ka pu leengpa kunga khawmkhawm dingin ka va kuon ding,” achi hi. Tualeh David in Abner akuonsah ta a, tuachi’n lungmuong tahin akuonta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuazou in, David mite leh Joab galdouna muna pat a hing kinuale ahing tung ua, gallah van tampi ahing tut uhi; Hinanleh Abner khu Hebron a David kungah aum nawn sih hi; David in ana sawldoh a, ama zong lungmuong tahin ana peita hi.","title":"Joab in Abner athana"},"23":{"text":"Joab leh akunga azawpi galkap zousie ahing tun tah un, “Ner tapa Abner leengpa kungah ahing haw a, tualeh aman ana peisah kia ta a, ama zong lungmuong tahin apeita hi,” chi’n Joab ahil uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab leengpa kungah ahing pei a, akung ah, “Nasil bawl bang chi dan ahiei? Ngai in Abner na kung ah ahing haw a, bangdinga na sawldoh a, na nua peisah kia ahiei?"},"25":{"text":"Ner tapa Abner na thei a, nangma sol dingin, na vaikuon leh na vaitun thei tum leh na sil bawl zousie thei tum a hing haw ahibou hi,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh David kunga kipata Joab ahing pawt in Abner nuadel dingin mi asawl a, Sirah tuikhuh akipat in ahing nuazawpi kia ua, hinanleh David in tuabang agamtatnate uh athei kha sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Abner Hebron a ahing nuatun kia tahin, Joab in kulpi kotkhah pulam ah houpi dingin azawpi tuom a, asanggampa Asahel sisan phuba lahna in agil ah adawt a ashita hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh anua a David in tamthu azah tahin “Kei leh ka leenggam in Ner tapa Abner shina tungtang ah Mangpa mai ah ka siengthou kumkhuo ding uhi, achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Joab lutung leh apa innkuonpite zousie tung ah kibungta heh Joab innkuonte lah ah sipawt ahiei, phah ahiei, chiengkhut tunga kingam a um ahiei, namsau a tha ahiei, nehletah kitasamlou in um sih heh,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gibeon a kidouna a, asanggampa uh Asahel atha ziehin Joab leh asanggampa Abishai in Abner athat ta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Joab leh akunga um mipite zousie kungah, “Na puonte uh botkeh unlen sai ip puon sil unlen, Abner sun un,” achi hi. Tualeh leengpa David in aluong azui hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abner Hebron ah avui ua, tualeh leengpa’n aw ngaitah suo in Abner han ah akapta a, tualeh mipi zousie zong akap uhi.","title":"Abner kivuina"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n Abner a kaa a, “Akaa tengin Abner mi maw shi banga shi ding ahiei mah?"},"34":{"text":"Na khut lah kan ahisih a, Na keng zong kolbu lah ahi sih a, Migilou masanga mi apua bangin,” Nang zong na puata mawh a, achi hi. Tuachi’n mi zousien Abner akaa chietta uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh sun ahi lai in mi zousie David ann ne sah dingin ahing pei ua, hinanleh nitum masanga ann ahiei, sil dang mawngmawng ahiei, aneh a ka neh tahleh, “Pasian in alaw law hing law heh, tuasanga thupi zaw in zong,” chiin David akichiemta hi."},"36":{"text":"Mipi zousie in tuathu athei un akipah mama uhi, leengpa sil bawl pouma in mipite akipah sah zel hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi zousie leh Israel mite zousie in, tua ni in Ner tapa Abner kitha khu leengpa thu a kithat ahisih chi atheita uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n amite kungah, “Tuni’n Israelte lah a mi lien leh mithupi mama khat ashita chi theilou na hi uoi mah?"},"39":{"text":"Lengpa dinga sathau nu hinanleng zong tuni’n ka hat zou sih hi. Tualeh tam Zeruiah tapate haw, kei a dingin thuoh ha hina va-ia uh e, Mangpa’n sil hoilou bawl mi agitlouna uh dung zui in thuhta heh,” achi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Saul tapa Ishbosheth in Hebron ah Abner ashita chi ana zah tahin akhutte ahing hat nawn sih a, tualeh Israelte zousie zong alung keta uhi.","title":"Ishbosheth kithana"},"2":{"text":"Tuin Saul tapa in galkap lamkai ni anei a, khat min Baanah ahia adang khatpa min Rekab ahi. Benjamin hahlesuon Beeroth khuo ami Rimmon tapate ahi uhi (Beeroth khu Benjamin gam a um a ngai ahi.)"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Beeroth mite khu Gataim ah atailut ua, tuni dongin khunah aumdenta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Saul tapa Jonathan in tapa a keng langni a bai anei a, Jezreel a kipata Saul leh Jonathan tanchin ana kithei lai in, kum nga a upa ahia, tuachi’n ama ching nuin apom a ataimang pi a, tualeh hichi ahi a, taimang dinga akintat nalam ah akesah a, akeng ahing baita hi. Amin Mephibosheth ahi.","ref":"2 Sam. 9.3"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Beeroth mi Rimmon tapate Rekab leh Baanah ava kuon ua, Ishbosheth inn ah sun nisat laitahin ava tung ua, ama khu a lupna tungah ana sun lup hi."},"6":{"text":"Bu vala ding hi u’leh kilawm in innsung tawng lam ah ava lut ua, tualeh agil ah adawt ua, tuachi’n Rekab leh asanggampa Baanah ataimangta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Inn sunga ava lut laitah un alupna pindan a lupna tungah ana lum a; tuachi’n ava dawtlia ua, alu atan ua, tualeh alutang apuo ua, Arabah kantan in zan tungtawn in apei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Ishbosheth lutang khu Hebron a David kungah ahing tawi ua, leengpa kungah, “En in, Nang hing thatum na melmapa Saul tapa Ishbosheth lutang ahi, Mangpa’n ka pu leengpa phuba tuni’n Saul leh ahah asuonte tungah alahpiehta hi,” achi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Beeroth mi Rimmon tapate Rekab leh asanggampa Baanah a dawnga, akung uah, “Ka melmate zousie lah a pat a hing tanpa Mangpa min lou in ka gen ahi.","title":"Ishbosheth thatte tunga thukhenna"},"10":{"text":"Mi khat in thupha hing tut a kingaituo in, Ngai in Saul ashita chiin ahing hil a, amapa ka man a Ziklagah ka that hi, aman lah athupha puoh zieh a, bang ahiei kipahman ka pieh dingin akigingta hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 1.1-16"},"11":{"text":"Mi dihtat ama innsunga alupna tung ngel a lumlai migilou in atha uh sisan man na tung uah ka hing phut nasa zaw hi, lei tunga kipat in ka hing sumang nasa mama ding hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in atangvalte thu apie a, tuachi’n amauh athat ua, akhut u’leh a keng uh atan pieh ua, Hebron luikhuh gei ah akhai ua, hinanleh Ishbosheth lutang ava la ua, Hebron a Abner han ah avuita uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel nam zousie Hebron a David kungah ahing pei ua, “Ngai in, na gu leh nasa ka hi uh.","title":"David Israelte tungah leeng ahita"},"2":{"text":"Tuamabangin, Tumasanga Saul ka tung ua leeng ahi lai in, nangma Israel gam ah puidoh leh puilut tu na hi zel a; tualeh Mangpa’n na kungah, ka mi Israelte na vaa dinga, tualeh Israelte tungah vai nahawm ding hi achi hi,” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel upate zousie Hebron a leengpa kungah ahing pei ua, tualeh Leengpa David in Hebron ah Mangpa masangah amautoh thuhun abawla tuachi’n Israelte tunga leengpa dingin David sathau anu uhi."},"4":{"text":"David in vai ahawm chiil lai in kum sawmthum a upa ahi a, kum sawmli sung vai ahawm hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 2.11; 1 Khang. 3.4; 29.27"},"5":{"text":"Hebron ah Judate tungah kum sagi leh ha guh vai ahawm a, tualeh Jerusalem ah Israelte leh Judate zousie tungah kum sawm thum leh kum thum vai ahawm hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh, leengpa leh amite khu agam a teng Jebus mite dou dingin Jerusalem ah a pei ua; tualeh khuna teng miten David kungah, “Tam mun ah na hinglut thei sih ding, mitto leh kengbaiten a hing nang ding uhi,” achi ua. “David hinglut thei sih va” chi’n angaisut uhi.","title":"David in Jerusalem alahna (1 Khang. 11.4-9)","ref":"Josh. 15.63; Vai. 1.21"},"7":{"text":"Ahivang in David in Zion kulpi alata a, tua khu David khopi ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh David in khumi niin “Jebus mite douding poumate tuilawng kiphumna langah peitou u’henlen, David muda kengbai leh mittote that u’heh” achi hi. Tuaziehin “Amauten kengbai leh mitto leeng innsungah alut thei sih ding” achi zel uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n David kul sungah a um a, tualeh David khopi achita hi. Tuachi’n David in Millo akipat in khopi kimkot in asung lam ah kulpi abawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n David ahing thupi deu deu a, galkapte Mangpa Pasian akungah a um zel hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Tai-ar leengpa Hiram in David kungah mi asawl a, Sidar singte ahah a, khut siemte leh suongkhen siemte zong asawl a, tuachi’n David inn a lampieh uhi.","title":"Tai-ar leengpa’n David toh lemna abawl"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh David in Mangpa’n ama Israelte leengpa a pang dingin asudet a, tualeh ami Israelte ziehin a leenggam zong apahtawi ahi chi atheita hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh David in Hebron akipat ahing pawt nuain Jerusalem ah zi leh meite aneibe nalai a, tuachi’n David in tapate leh tanute anei nalai hi.","title":"Jerusalem a pieng David tate"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu Jerusalem a piengte min ahi; Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon."},"15":{"text":"Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Elishama, Eliada, tualeh Eliphalet ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Philistin miten David khu Israel mite leengpa dingin sathau anu uh chi azah tahun, Philistin mite zousie David sui dingin akuontou ua, tualeh David in tua thu azah tahin kulpi ah apei suh a.","title":"David in Philistinte a zou"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Philistin mite zong ahing pei ua, Rephaim phaijang ah akiguol ta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh David in Mangpa adonga, “Philistin mite dou dingin ka kuon diei? amauh ka khutah na hing pe diei?” achi hi. Tualeh Mangpa’n David kungah “Kuontouin, Philistin mite na khut ah ka hing pe ngeingei ding hi,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n David Baal-Perazim ah ahing pei a, khunah David in amauh akidoupi a, tualeh “Mangpa’n ka galte tuikiching hakhiet bang maiin ka masang ah ahing delzah piehta hi,” achi hi. Tuaziehin khummun min dingin Baal Perazim achita hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua mun ah amilimte uh anuasie ua, tualeh David leh amiten tuate khu apomangta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Philistin mite ahing kuontou kia ua, tuachi’n Rephaim phaijang ah akiguoldim kiata uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh David in Mangpa adonga, “Aman peitou sin hinanleh anualang uah imkhum inlen, kawlsathau sing langa pat in va dou in."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi ding a, kawlsathau sing dawn a mi pei ging na zah chiengin kintahin del pai in Philistin mite dou dingin na masangah Mangpa apeita china ahi ding hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh David in Mangpa’n thu apieh bangin abawla, tualeh Philistin mite Geba apat in Gezer tandongin ale nawdohta hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in Israel mite lah a teltuom ngentang tulsawm thum akaikhawm kia a.","title":"David in Pasian bawm Jerusalem ah apolut (1 Khang. 13.1-14)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh David akipandoh a, Juda gam a Baale khuo akipat in Cherubim te kikaal a um Galkapte Mangpa min apuohsah uh, Pasian bawm latou dingin akunga mipi um zousiete toh akuonta uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 25.22"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian bawm khu muol tunga Abinadab inn apat in aladoh ua, bawngleng tha khat tung ah aguong ua, Abinadab tapate Uzzah leh Ahio in bawngleng tha khu aveng uhi.","ref":"1 Sam. 7.1,2"},"4":{"text":"Muol tunga Abinadab inn akipat in Pasian bawm ala khie ua, Ahio khu Pasian bawm masangah apei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n David leh Israel mipi zousie in Mangpa masangah silging thei chi tuom tuom, kaigingte chingtangte, khuong leh jamte, pengkul bineite leh sum-eng khutbehte atum ua atheitawp un aguolnuom uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Nakon phuol ahing phahtah un, Uzzah in Pasian bawm azamphei a atudet a, bawngtal tegel a kipal khah zieh un."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Uzzah tungah Mangpa alungthah phuta asilbawl khel ziehin Pasian in tua mun ah asuliata a, Pasian bawm kungah ashita hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa Uzzah tunga alungthah ziehin David alungkim ta sih a, khum mun khu Perez-Uzzah tuni tan in akichita hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh khum niin David in Mangpa agiing ta mama a, tualeh “Bangchi’n Pasian bawm ka kungah ka tut theita diei?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Pasian bawm khu David khopi ah ama kungah atawllut nuomta sih a, hinanleh David in Gitmi Obed-Edom inn ah atutta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa bawm khu Gitmi Obed-Edom inn ah ha thum a umdenta hi. Tualeh Obed-Edom leh a innkuonte Mangpa’n aguolzawlta hi.","ref":"1 Khang. 26.4,5"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian bawm ziehin “Mangpa’n Obed-Edom innkuonte leh anei alam zousie aguolzawl hi chi’n” David ahil ua. Tuachi’n David akuon a Pasian bawm khu Obed-edom inn akipat in David khopi ah kipahtahin alata hi.","title":"David in Pasian bawm alahtouna. (1 Khang. 15.25)"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Mangpa bawm zawngten kal guh asuon tah un bawngtal leh belam thau in akithoi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n David Mangpa mai ah theitawpin alaam a, tualeh David khu puon malngat siempu puon in akivon hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n David leh Israel mi zousie in kikou zoi zoi leh pengkul mut ging toh Pasian bawm ahing puo uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa bawm khu David khopi ahing tunin, Saul tanu Mikal in kotta apat in ana en a, tualeh Mangpa mai a, David laam a kidieng amu in, alungsim guh in asimmaw mama hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa bawm khu alalut ua, tualeh akoina dinga David in abawl mun puon inn sunga maitam ah akoita uhi. Tuachi’n David in halmang sillatte leh lemna sillatte Mangpa mai ah alaan hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh David in halmang sillatte leh lemna sillatte alat zou tahin mipite khu galkapte Mangpa min in aguolzawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in mipite zousie Israel mipumpite, numei leh pasalte lah ah michin in atanchiet ding un, tanghou beu khat, saba khat leh grep kiphougaw bawm khat chiet ahawm a. Tuachi’n mi zousie amauh inn lam chiet ah apeita uhi.","ref":"1 Khang. 16.43"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n David zong ama innkuonpite guolzawl dingin anua pei kiata hi. Tualeh Saul tanu Mikal ama dawn dingin ava pawt a, akungah “Tuni’n Israelte leengpa thupi hina mai e, miginalou leh zumdan theilou guohtanga um bang mai in, tuni’n asuoh numeite masangah guohtangin zum theiloute bangin a um hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Mikal kungah, “Na pa leh a innkuonte zousie sanga kei hing teldoh Mangpa mite; Israelte tunga leeng dinga hing guotpa Mangpa Ama ahi. Tuazieh a Mangpa masanga ka lam ding mawng ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tam sangin zong ka zumpi huoi zaw nalai ding, keima zong ka kisit nalai ding hi, hinanleh tua suoh numei na gente lah ah pahtawi in ka um ding hi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin Saul tanu Mikal in ashi tandongin ta anei sih hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, leengpa a inn ah atenga, akim avel a agalte lah akipat Mangpa’n galmuong a atawldamsah tah in.","title":"David in Pasian biehinn lam atupna (1 Khang. 17.1 , 2)"},"2":{"text":"Lengpa’n guolnei Nathan kungah, “Tuin kei Sidar sing inn ah ka tenga, hinanleh Pasian bawm pen puon inn ah a um hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Nathan in leengpa kungah, “Na lungsim a um bang tahin va bawl in, Mangpa na kungah aum hi, achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh khum zan mama in, hichi ahia, Mangpa thu Nathan kungah ahing tunga,"},"5":{"text":"Pei inlen ka suoh David va hil in, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi. Ka tenna ding inn nangman nahing lam pieh ding amah?"},"6":{"text":"Israel tate Izipt gam akipat ka puidoh a kipat in tuni tandongin inn ah ka um sih a, puon inn leh biehbuh ah ka um zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel tate zousie lah a ka peina tengah zong ka mi Israelte vah dinga thu ka pieh vaihawm mite kungah, bangdinga sidar singa inn hing lam piehlou nahi uoi chi’n ka genta amah?”"},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka suohpa David kungah, Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, Belamte tatna mun a belamte na zui kawina a kipat, ka mi Israelte tunga vaihawm dingin ka hing ladoh a:"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh na peina pou ah na kungah ka um zel a, na masangah na melmate zousie ka sumang zel a, leitunga mithupi tahte min bang min thupitah nei in ka hing bawlta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuathamlouin ka mi Israelte dingin mun khat ka guot dinga, amauh mun mama a aum ua, akisuon nawnlou na dingun, ka phutdet dinga, tumasanglai bangin gitlouna taten asugenthei nawn sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh ka mi Israelte tunga vaihawm mite ka guot laibang ahinawn sih ding hi. Tualeh na melmate zousie lah akipat in galmuongin ka hing khawldam sahta ding hi; Tualouin zong Mangpa’n innkuon ahing siem pieh ding thu zong ahing hil hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh na nite a hing bei a, napu leh pate kunga na lup hun chiengin, na nua a nahah nasuonte ka tungding dinga, tualeh aleenggam ka sudet ding hi.","title":"Pasian in David tate aguol zawlna","ref":"Late. 89.3,4; 132.11; Jn. 7.42; Nasep. 2.30"},"13":{"text":"Aman ka min a dingin inn khat alam dinga, tualeh a leenggam mangtoupha kumtawn a dingin ka sudet ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Kei apa ka hi dinga, ama ka tapa ahi dinga, sil abawlkhiel leh mihing chiengin ka taihil dinga, mihing tate vuohna in ka thunun ding hi.","ref":"Late. 89.26,27; 2 Kor. 6.18; Heb. 1.5"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh na masanga ka lahmangpa Saul akipat a, kalahmang bang zen in nangma akipat ka hepina ka lamang sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh na innkuon leh na leenggam na masang ah kumtawna suhdet ahi dinga, na mangtoupha zong kumtawn a suhdet ahi ding,” achi hi, chiin gen in, achi hi.","ref":"Late. 89.36,37"},"17":{"text":"Tam thu zousie bangbang leh kilahnate bangbangin, Nathan in David kungah agenta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa David alut a, Mangpa mai ah atou a, akungah, Mangpa Pasian aw, “Kei koi ka hia? Tualeh ka innkuonte zong bang ahi ua, hichi tan chieng chieng na hing pui?","title":"David thumna leh kipah thugenna (1 Khang. 17.16-27)"},"19":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian aw, tamte Nangma mitmu ah bangma tham ahi sih hi, hinanleh na suoh innkuonte umdan ding thu zong kum tampi sunga dingin na genzouta hi. Mangpa Pasian aw, tam khu mihingte kunga na bawl dan ngaina ahina a mah?"},"20":{"text":"David in na kunga bang ahiei agen nawn tuon ding? Aziehpen Mangpa Pasian in na suohpa na thei chien hi."},"21":{"text":"Na suohpa thei dingin, na thu zieh leh nangma lungtang bang zelin, tam sil thupitah zousiete na bawl zouta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aw Mangpa Pasian, nangvang na thupi ahi. Ka bil ua ka zah zousie uh dungzui mabangun, nangma bang mawngmawng aum sih a, nang loungal Pasian dang a um sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipat leh namchin leh apasiente ulah a kipat a, Nangma a dinga nateldoh na mite masanga nangma adinga sil thupitah leh na gam a dinga sil chizat huoitah bawl ding leh ama min thupitah siem dinga, Pasian in ama mite hi dinga ateldoh na mi Israelte bang mawngmawng a um sih a, Nang loungal pasien dang mawngmawng aum sih hi.","ref":"Danp. 4.34"},"24":{"text":"Na mi Israelte kumtawn a namite ahitheina dingun Nangma adinga na suhdettah ziehin, tualeh Nang Mangpa khu a Pasian uh na hita hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh tuin Mangpa Pasian aw, na suohpa tungtang leh a innkuonte tungtang thu nana gente kumtawn a dingin sudet inlen, tualeh Na gensa bangin bawl in."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh galkapte Mangpa khu Israelte Pasian ahi chi’n Na min kumtawn in tawisangin umta hen, tualeh Na suohpa David innkuonte na masangah suhdet in umta heh."},"27":{"text":"Aw galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian, Na suohpa kungah innkuon kang phupieh ding chi’n Na phuongta ngal a, tuaziehin Na suohin tam thumna Na kungah ka tun ngam hi."},"28":{"text":"Aw Mangpa Pasian tuin Nang Pasian nahi a, Na thu zong thutah ahia, tualeh tam hoina khu Na suoh kungah Na chiemta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin Na suoh innkuonte kumtawna Na masanga aum ngitnget theina dingun guolzawl in, Aw Mangpa Pasian Nangma’n nana gen ta a, tualeh na guolzawlna a na suoh innkuonte kumtawn a guolzawlin umta u’hen” achi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Tambang nuain hichi ahing hia, David in Philistin mite adoua, azou a, tuachi’n David in Philistin mite thuneina bulpi Metheg Ammah a lahpiehta hi.","title":"David in Philistinte azawna (1 Khang. 18.1)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Moab mite adou a, azou kia a, tuol ah alumsah a, tena khau in ate a, guol ni khu suhlia dingin ate a, guol khat pen atawn a hingkhawi dingin ate hi. Tuachi’n Moab mite khu David suohin aumta ua, sie apie uhi."},"3":{"text":"David in Euphrates lui donga gam la dinga akuon malam in Zobah leengpa Rehob tapa Hadadezer adou a."},"4":{"text":"David in sakolleng tul khat leh sakol tungtuong galkap zasagi tualeh keng apei galkap tul sawmni aman a, tualeh sakollengkai zousie azahui uh asattan pieh a, sakolleng kai ding za khat akhawi hi."},"5":{"text":"Damaska a Siria mite Zobah leengpa Hadadezer panpi dinga hing kuon David in Siria mi tul sawmni leh tul ni athat hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Siria gam a Damaska ah galkapte akoi a, tualeh Siria mite David suoh in a umta ua, sie alieu uhi. Mangpa’n David khu apei nalam lam ah gal azousah zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh David in Hadadezer galkap liente sana lumte alah pieh a, Jerusalem ah apawta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hadadezer khopite Betah leh Berothai apat in David in sum-eng tampi ala hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Hamath leengpa Toi in David in Hadadezer adou a azouta chi ana za a.","title":"David in gallah sil tampi amu (1 Khang. 18.9-12)"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hadadezer adou a azaw zieh a, chibai va buh ding leh guolzawl dingin Toi in atapa Joram David kungah asawl a, Hadadezer in Toi ana kidou pi zieh ahi, Tualeh Joram in a Dangka belte uh sana belte ahing tawi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuate khu gamdang ava zaw zousie akipata alah Dangka leh sanate zousie toh David in Mangpa kungah alan hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuate khu Siriate, akipat, Moabte akipat, Ammon mite akipat, Philistin mite akipat, Amalek mite akipat, Zobah leengpa Rehob tapa Hadadezer apat a gallah silte bang ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh chi phaiguom a Siria mite tul sawm leh tulgiet va that zou ahing kinuale kia lam in David ana minthangta hi.","title":"David in Israelte tungah dihtahin vai ahawm","ref":"Late. 60"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh aman Edom gam pumpi ah zong galkap akoi a, tuachi’n Edom mite zousie David mite ahing hita uhi. Tualeh apeina phot ah Mangpa’n David gal a zousah zel hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Israelte zousie tungah vai ahawm a, tualeh David in amite zousie tungah kituptah leh Dihtat tahin vai ahawm hi."},"16":{"text":"Zeruiah tapa Joab khu galkap lamkai ahia, tualeh Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat khu tanchin gielpa ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Ahitub tapa Zadok leh Abiathar tapa Ahimelek khu siempute ahi ua, tualeh Seraiah khu laigielpa ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoiada tapa Benaiah khu Kereth mite leh Palethmite lamkai ahi a, tualeh David tapate khu vaihawm bulpite ahi uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tuin David in “Jonathan zieh a hepina ka suhlat theina dingin, Saul innkuonte lah a mi adam nalai a um de aw?” achi hi.","title":"David leh Mephibosheth","ref":"1 Sam. 20.15-17"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Saul innkuonte suoh khat amin Ziba a um a, David kunga haw dingin ahan ua, tualeh leengpa’n akungah “Ziba na hiei?” achia, tualeh aman Hi e, “Kei na suohpa ka hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n akungah, “Saul innkuonte lah a mi khat beh um nawnlou ahi uoi mah? Pasian hepina atunga ka suhlat theina dingin,” achi hi. Tualeh Zibain leengpa kungah, “Jonathan in tapa khat anei nalai a, akeng zong abai hi,” achi hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 4.4"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n akungah, “Ama hei ah a um ei?” achi a, Ziba in akungah, “Ngai in, Lodebar a Ammiel tapa Makir inn ah aum hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa David in mi asawl a, Lodebar a Ammiel tapa Makir inn akipat in ava puisah ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Saul tapa Jonathan tapa Mephibosheth David kunga ahing tun tahin amai a tuolsuin abohkhup a, chibai abuuh hi. Tualeh David in “Mephibosheth” achia, tualeh aman “Enin, na suohpa tanah ka um hi” chi’n adawng hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in akungah, “Zau sin, na pa Jonathan ziehin ka hing hepi ngei ngei dinga, napu Saul gam zousie ka hing tangsah kia dinga, tualeh ka dawkan ah ann na ne ngitnget ta ding hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n kun suhin chibai abuh a, “Kei ui pul bang bep na suoh bang ka hia, nang hichi ngaisah talawm ahiei?” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Saul suohpa Ziba ahan a, akungah, “Na pu tapa kungah, Saul leh a innkuonte neilelam zousie a un in ka peta hi, achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin nangman na tapate leh na suohte toh ama a dingin lou nahaw pieh dinga, tuachia na pu tapa in neh ding anei theina dingin. Hinanleh na pu tapa Mephibosheth in vang ka dawkan ah ann ane ngitnget tading hi,” achi hi. Ziba in tapa sawm leh nga leh suoh sawmni anei hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ziba in leengpa kungah, “Ka pu Lengpa’n asuohpa kunga thu apieh bang zel in na suohin ka bawl ding hi,” achi hi. Lengpan Mephibosheth in vang ka dawkan ah leengpa tapa khat bangbang in annkuong a im ding hi, achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mephibosheth in tapa tangval khat anei a, amin Mika ahi. Tualeh Ziba inn a um zousie Mephibosheth suohte ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mephibosheth khu Jerusalem ah a umta hi. Tuachi’n leengpa dawkan ah ann ane ngitnget ta a, tualeh akengte gel alang ni in abai hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tamte nua in hichi ahing hi a, Ammon mite leengpa ashi a, tualeh atapa Hanun in ama mun ah vai ahawm hi.","title":"Ammonte toh kidouna (1 Khang. 19.1-5)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in “Apa’n ahing hepi bangin ken zong Nahash tapa Hanun tungah hepina ka sulang sam ding” achi hi. Tuachi’n apa tungtang thu a hamuon dingin David in asuohte asawl a. Tuachi’n David suohte Ammon mite gam ava tung uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Ammon mite lamkaiten, apu uh Hanun kungah, David in “Na pa azatat zieh a, na kunga hamuon mi ahing sawl hi dingin na gingta amah? David in amite, khopite enkhe ding leh suhsiet tum a enchien dinga ahing sawl hizaw lou ding amah?” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin Hanun in David mi sawlte aman a akhamul uh kimkhat chiet aheu pieh a, tualeh apuonsilte uh alaikim tah ah atawbou uh pha bep in, atan pieh a, anua sawlta hi."},"5":{"text":"David ahil tahun aman ava dawn dingin mi asawl a, azum mama ziehun, leengpa’n na khamul uh ahing sau kia masangsie “Jerikou ah, umtadi unlen, tuazou chieng in hing peikia un,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ammon miten David melma in abawl khata uh chi akithei bep un, Ammon miten, Beth-Rehob a Siriate leh Zoba a Siriate galkap tul sawmni leh leengpa Maakah akipat mi tul khat tualeh Is-Tob akipat mi tul sawm leh ni athuhah uhi.","title":"Ammonte toh kidouna leh zawna"},"7":{"text":"David in tua thu azah tahin Joab leh galkap hangsan zousie asawl a."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ammon mite zong ahing kuon khie ua, khopi lutna kotpi lam ah pan mun abawl ua, tualeh Zoba leh Rehob a Siria mite leh Ish-top mite tualeh Maakah mite pen atuom in daigei ah aum uhi."},"9":{"text":"Joab in, amailam leh anua lam ah ahing dou tum uhi chi athei tahin, Israelte lah a teltuomte lah a hoipente ateldoh a, Siria mite dou dingin panmun ana bawl a."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh adang teng a unaupa Abishai khut ah akoi a, Ammon mite dou dinga panmun alep theina dingun."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh akungah, “Kei dou dinga Siriate ahat seng u’leh, nang hing panpi inlen, nang dinga Ammonte ahat seng u’leh, nangma panpi dingin ka hing kuon ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hangsan tahin um unlen, imite leh i Pasian khopi adingin na ikipasalsah ding uhi; Mangpa’n hoi asah bang bangin hing bawlta heh,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab leh akunga um mite Siriate toh kidou dingin, kidouna munlam azuonta uhi; tualeh amasangah ataithangta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Ammon miten Siriate ataithangta uh chi atheitah un ama u’zong Abishai masangah ataikeh ua, khuo ah alutta uhi. Tualeh Joab in Ammon mite akiasana, Jerusalem ah apeita hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Siriaten Israelte masangah aguollelta uh chi akithei tah un, akikhawmta uhi.","title":"David in Siriate azou (1 Khang. 19.16-19)"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hadadezer in mi asawl a, lui gal a um Siria mite ava pui ua, Hadadezer galkap lamkai Shobak in ma akai a, Helam ah ahing tung uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tam thu David ahil tah un, aman Israel mite zousie akaikhawm a, Jordan lui akan ua, Helam ava tungta uhi. Tualeh Siria miten zong Israelte dou dingin panmun ana lem ua, akidoupita uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siria mite Israelte masang ah ataizahta ua, tualeh David in Siriate sakolleng tungtuong mi za sagi leh sakol tungtuong mi tul sawmli athat a, tualeh agalkap lamkai uh Shobak zong athat a khum mun ah ashita hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Hadadezer nasem a um leengte zousie Israelte masangah aguollelta uh chi atheitah un, Israelte toh kilemna abawl ua, ana uh asemta uhi. Tuachi’n Siriaten Ammon mite a panpi ngam nawn sih uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, kumte hing kihei a, khallai, leengte gal dou dinga akuon zel hun lai un, David in Joab leh leengpa mite tualeh Israel galkap zousie toh asawl a, Ammon mite ava sim ua, asuse gawp ua, tualeh Rabbah ah a um ua, hinanleh David pen Jerusalem ah aum hi.","title":"David, Bathsheba leh Uria","ref":"1 Khang. 20.1"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahia, nitah lam ninem in, alupna akipat in David athou a, leengpa inn tungah avah a, tualeh inntunga kipat in numei khat kisillai amu a, tua numei khu melhoi tah ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in mi asawl a, “Tua numeinu tanchin akan chien sah a. Tualeh mi khat in Eliam tanu Bath-Sheba, Hitmi Uria zi hilou ahiei mah?” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh David in mi asawl a, ava pui ua, tualeh akungah ahing tunga, ana luppita a, aniin neizou laitah ahi a, tuachi’n a inn lam ah anua pei kiata hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n numei ahing gaita a; tualeh “Nau ka paita hi” chiin David athei sah hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Joab kungah, “Hitmi Uria ka kungah hing sawl in,” achi hi. Tualeh Joab in David kungah Uria asawlta hi.","title":"Uria in Bathsheba luppilou."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Uria akung atun tahin, David in Joab leh mipite bang a chi uoi? tualeh kidouna bang achi zel ei? chiin ana dong a."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh David in Uria kungah, “Inn lam ah pei inlen na kengte va silin,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Uria leengpa inn akipat apawtkhie a, tualeh leengpa’n neh ding silpieh in adelzui sah hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Uria khu leengpa inn kotphung ah asuohte lah ah alumta a, ainn lam ah apeita sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n “Uria a inn lam ah apei sih chi David ahiltah un,” David in Uria kungah, “Khuol haw hing tung hilou na hiei mah? Bang dinga na inn a peilou na hiei?” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Uria in David kungah, “Pasian bawmte, Israelte leh Judate, puonbuhte ah aum ua; tualeh ka pu Joab leh ka pu suohte gamlah ah akikul ua, kei ka inn ah ne ding leh dawn dingin, tualeh ka zi toh lumkhawm dingin ka pei ding amah? Na hinna louin ka gen ahi, tamvang ka bawl vawt sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n, David in Uria kungah, “Tuni zong tanah um tadi inlen, zing chiengin hing peisah navang” achi a. Tuachi’n Uria khum ni leh azing ni Jerusalem ah aumta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in ahan a, amasangah ane in adawn a, tualeh ate kham a, tuachi’n nitah lam in a inn lam a peilou in apu suohte lah a lum dingin apawtkheta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n zingmawngin hichi ahi a, David in Joab lai ahah a, Uria aposah hi.","title":"David in Uria kithana dingin thu apiehna"},"15":{"text":"Tua alai hah ah, “Kidouna huoisietna pen mun ah Uria amaphuin pangsah inlen, atha ua, ashi theina dingin, kikhin san un,” chi’n agiel hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahi a, Joab in khopi abulu laitah in, agalte hatna mun a atheina pen mun ah Uria apangsah a."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n khopi mite apawtdoh ua Joab toh akidou ua, tua mun ah David mite bangza ahiei ashi ua, tualeh Uria zong ashi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab in mi asawl a, kidouna tungtanga sil umdan zousie David ahil hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh ami sawlpa thu apie a, akungah leengpa kunga, “Kidouna a sil umdante na gen zou chienga;"},"20":{"text":"Lengpa ahing lungthah phut a, Bangdinga khuo nava lu lai ua, khum bang lawm lawm a nava nai uh ahiei? kulpi banga kipat in ahing kap ding uh chi theilou nahi uoi mah?"},"21":{"text":"Jerubeth tapa Ahimelek that koi ahiei? Numei khat in bu gawtguoina suong khat in kulpi tunga kipat a khe suh a, Thebez mun ah ashi hilou ahiei mah? achi leh na suoh Hitmi Uria zong ashi hi chiin,” achi hi.","ref":"Vai. 9.53"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n a mi sawlpa ava pei a, atun tun in David kungah Joab in asawlna zieh zousie ahilta a."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh ami sawlpan David kungah, “Mite’n ahing nawh gawp ua, mun awng tan in ahing dou ua, hinanleh kou zong khopi lutna kulkotkhah tan ka nua naw kia uhi."},"24":{"text":"Thalkap miten kul banga kipat in na suohte ahing kap ua, tuachi’n leengpa suohte bang za ahiei ashi ua, tualeh na suoh Hitmi Uria zong ashi hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in mi kisawl pa kungah, “Joab kungah tambangin na gen ding hi, tam sil tungin na lungsim sunuomlou sih heh, aziehpen namsau in koima akhentuom sih hi. Nasa zawsemin khopi dou unlen, susie un, chiin Joab hanthawn in,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Uria zi in apasal ashita chi azah tahin a suun a.","title":"David in Bathsheba akitenpi"},"27":{"text":"Asuunna hun abei tahin, David in mi asawl a, a inn ah ava puisah a, tuachi’n azi ahing hita, tualeh tapa anei a; hinanleh David silbawl in Mangpa alungkim sah sih hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n David kungah Nathan asawl a, tualeh akungah ahing pei a, akungah, “Khuo khat ah mi ni aum a; khat pen mi hausa ahi a, tualeh khat pen mi genthei ahi.","title":"Nathan gentena thu leh David kisia na","ref":"Late. 51"},"2":{"text":"Mi hausapa’n belam hon tampi leh ganhon tampi anei a."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh mi gentheipan belam nou anu neunou khat alei a, akhawi a, anou neunou khat chiloungal bangma anei sih a; akunga atate toh khanglien ahia, aneh neh anehpi a, adawn dawn a dawnpi a, tualeh a angsung ah aluppi a; ama a dingin atanu bang mai ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh mi hausapa inn ah khuolzin mi khat ava tunga, tualeh akunga va tungpa gaw dingin ama belam leh ganhonte phallouin migentheipa belamnou alahpieh a; a inn a tungpa agaw zawta hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n David khum mipa tungah alungthah mama ta a, tualeh Nathan kungah “Mangpa hinna louin ka gen ahi, tuabang sil bawlpa khu ashi ngeingei ding ahi!"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh hichi bang sil abawl zieh leh hepina aneilou ziehin abelamnou ale li a adit ding ahi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nathan in David kungah, “Tua mipa khu nangma nahi! Israelte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi; Israelte leengpa dingin sathau ka hing nu a, Saul khut akipat in, ka hing hundoh a;"},"8":{"text":"Na pu inn leh na pu zite na angsung ah ka hing pie a, tualeh Israel leh Juda innkuonte ka hing pie hi. Tualeh tuate atawm seng nahlai lezong adang hing piehbe nalai ding hing a!"},"9":{"text":"Bangdinga Mangpa thupieh na simmaw a, amit mua sil gilou na bawl ahiei? Hitmi Uria na that a; azi na zi dingin na lahpieh a, ama Ammon mite namsau in na that hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, namsau in na innsung akikhinsan vawt sih ding hi, nangman kei na hing simmaw a, Hitmi Uria zi na zi dinga na lahpieh ziehin."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin achi hi, Ngai in nangma innsung ngei apat in na tungah sil hoilou ka piengsah dinga; na mitmu mama in na zite ka hing lahpieh dinga, na innvengte kungah ka pe dinga, tualeh aman suntanglai in na zite aluppi ding hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 16.22"},"12":{"text":"Nang aguh in na bawla, hinanleh Ken vang Israel mite zousie mitmu in suntang lai in ka bawl ding hi,” chiin achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Nathan kungah, “Mangpa tungah kana bawlkhielta hi,” achi a; tualeh Nathan in David kungah, “Mangpa’n zong na khelna akoimangta hi; na shi sih ding hi.","title":"David akhelna ziehin akisia"},"14":{"text":"Bangtenghileh na sil bawl a Pasian gensietna lemtangtah, Mangpa melmate adinga na bawl ziehin nangma akipat a nau pieng ashi ngei ngei ding hi.”"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nathan in a inn lam ah apeisanta hi. Tualeh Uria zi in David ahinpieh tungah Mangpa’n akhut aha a, hatangpi in achi ana ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin David in naupang a dingin Pasian kungah angen va ngua a tualeh ann a ngawl a, aluta tualeh zan tungtawnin tuol ah alum hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n a innkuonte lah a upate adingdoh ua tuol a kipat a kaithou dingin akungah ading ua, hinanleh athou nuom sih a, akung uah ann zong ane ut sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n anisagi niin hichi ahia, naupang khu ashita hi. Tuachi’n asuohten naupang shi thu David ahil ngam ta sih ua, “Ngai in naupang adam laiin ithu gen angaikhe ut sih a, naupang ashita chi bangchin ihil ngam diei? bangchi ahiei in akisuna kha ding hi,” achi uhi."},"19":{"text":"David in asuohte kidaphou amu tahin, naupang ashi ahita chi atheita a. Tuaziehin David in asuohte kungah, “Naupang ashita amah?” achi a, tualeh amaun “A shita” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n David tuol a kipat athou a, akisil a, sathau akinu a, tualeh apuonsilte ahenga, Mangpa inn ah aluta, Pasian abie hi; tuachi’n a inn lam ah apei a, neh ding a kan a, tuachi’n amasang ah ann alui ua, aneta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n asuohten akungah, “Tambanga na silbawlte bangchidan ahiei? Naupang adamlai in ann na ngawl a, na kap a, hinanleh naupang ashi tahin na thou a, ann na ne pai valong mawh a,” achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Naupang adamlai in ann ngawl in ka kap ngut a, naupang adam theina dingin, Mangpa’n ahing hepi khamaw diei mah chi koi in athei ei? ka chia ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin ashita a, bangdinga ann ka ngawl ding ahiei? ka nua hat thei kia ding amah? kei ama kungah ka pei dinga, hinanleh ama kei kungah ahing peikia thei sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in azi Bathsheba ahamuon a, tualeh akungah ava pei a, aluppi a, tuachi’n amanu’n tapa khat anei a, amin Solomon aphuo hi, tualeh Mangpa’n ama a it hi.","title":"Solomon pienna"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh aman guolnei Nathan avaihah a; tualeh amin dingin Mangpa kitap in Jedidiah aphuo ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab in Ammon mite khopi Rabbah ava sim a, tualeh leengpa tenna khopi alata hi.","title":"David leh Joab in Rabbah alahna uh (1 Khang. 20.1-3)"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Joab in David kungah mi asawl a, “Rabbah ka dou a, atuilahna mun dong uh ka lata hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin mipi um nalai teng khawm inlen khopi dou dingin zuon inlen va la in, tua ahisihleh keiman khopi kala dinga ka min apo kha ding hi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in mipite zousie ahan khawm a, Rabbah ah akuon ua, asim ua, alata uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh aleengpa uh lallukhu alutunga um khu alah pieh a, tuakhu suongmantam akibawl sana talent khat buh ahi, tualeh David akhusah uhi. Tualeh khum khopi a gallah sum tampi ahing puo uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh khopi sunga mipite ahing puidoh a, sing atnate, lou hawna sia-zumte, sia heipite zangin nna asem sah a, Ammon mite khopi zousie tuabangin abawl hi. Tualeh David leh mipite zousie Jerusalem ah anua pei kiata uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tamte nua in hichi ahi a, David tapa Absalom in sanggam numei melhoi mama khat anei a, amin Tamar ahi, tualeh David tapa Amnon in amanu adeigaw hi.","title":"Amnon in asanggamnu Tamar aluppina"},"2":{"text":"Amnon khu a sanggamnu Tamar angai seng ziehin achimaw senga achina ta hi, amanu lah nungah siengthou ahi ngal a. Tualeh atunga sil bang ahiei bawl ding lah, Amnon dinga hasa tah ahi a."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Amnon in lawm khat anei a, amin Jonadab ahia, David sanggampa Shimeah tapa ahi. Jonadab khu mi khelpil tah ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh aman Amnon kungah, “Bangchidan a, nang leengpa tapa ani sim a na hichi gawn deu deu tah mai? na hing hil thei sih ding amah?” achi hi. Tualeh Amnon in akungah, “Ka sanggampa Absalom sanggam nu Tamar ka ngai senga ahi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Jonadab in akungah, “Kichinasah inlen na lupna tungah lum khin khian inlen, na pa’n ahing et chiengin, akungah, hepitahin ka sanggamnu Tamar ka kungah hing pei henlen, tanghou neh ding hing pie henlen, tualeh ka mitmu mama ah neh ding hing bawlpieh heh, amanu khut tung pansan ka ne ding hi, chi’n ana genin,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amnon a china kipangin lupna ah alumta a. Tuachi’n leengpa David ama en dinga ahing pei tahin, Amnon in leengpa kungah, “Hepitahin ka sanggamnu Tamar hing pei henlen, ama khut apata ka neh theina dingin, tanghou tuitah ka mitmu ah hing bawl pieh henlen ama khut ngei akipat ka ne ding hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Tamar kungah, “Na sanggampa Amnon inn ah va haw inlen, aneh ding va bawl pieh in chiin,” a inn ah mi asawl a."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Tamar asanggampa Amnon inn ah ava haw a, amapa ana lum a, tualeh tangbuong ala a, ameh a amitmu ah tanghou abawla, akangta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh akanna khangbel ala khie a, amasang ah alui a, hinanleh ane nuom sih hi. Tualeh Amnon in “Mi zousie in hing pawtsan uheh” achia, tuachi’n mi zousien apawtsanta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amnon in Tamar kungah, “Na khut a pat ka neh theina dingin nehdingte ka lupna pindan sungah hing tawilut in” achi hi. Tualeh Tamar in atanghou bawlte ala a, pindan sunga asanggampa kungah atawilutta hi."},"11":{"text":"Neh dingte akunga atawilut tahin, amanu ana pummat a, “Hing lum vawi, ka sanggam nu,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Amanu’n adawnga “Hilou e, ka sanggampa, hing pawng bawlsin, Israelte lah ah tambang sil bawl ding ahi sih hi, tam minsiet huoi sil bawl vawt sin."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh ken ka minsietna hei ah ka phuol ta diei? tualeh nang zong Israelte lah a mimaw khat a sim na hing hi kha ding hi. Tuaziehin, tuin hepitahin leengpa houpi zaw in, nang kitenpi ahing phal khamaw sih ding hi;” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Bangtenghileh athugen a ngaipieh sih a, ama sangin ahatzaw ngal a, apawng bawla tuachi’n aluppita hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amnon in huot chitahin ahuo a, ana ngai lai a, angaina sangin ahuotna alien zaw ta hi, tuachi’n Amnon in akungah “Thou inlen, peimangin” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n akungah, “Hichi ding ahi sih, hichi banga dihlou tah a nang deldoh khu ka tunga na tatsietna teng sangin ahoi sih zaw hi,” achi hi. Hinanleh anahsah tuom sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n aneh leh dawn bawl asuohpa a han a, “Tam numeinu ka kunga kipat inn pulam ah kaidoh inlen kot kil det in,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Amanu’n puonah zem tuom tuom a kizem asil a, tuabang puonahtuol khu leengpa nungah siengthouten asil zel mawng uh ahi. Tuachi’n asuohpa’n akaikhie a kot akhah det ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Tamar in alu tungah vut akibuoh a, apuonah tuol zem tuom tuom a kizem asil khu abotkeh a, azangsip ah akhut toh akoi a, Aw ngaitah a kap kawm in apeita hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh asanggampa Absalom in akungah, “Na sanggampa Amnon na kunga hing lut hi e? Hinanleh ka sanggamnu sip khin khian in, na sanggampa ahi; ngaisah dain,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Tamar asanggampa Absalom inn ah nguitahin, akikhum denta hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa David in tam thute azah tahin alungthah mama hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Absalom in asanggampa Amnon kungah asie hiin apha hitaleh bangma agen sih hi, asanggam nu Tamar apawng suol ziehin, Amnon amuda mama hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh kumni pumlum nua in hichi ahi a, Ephraim kunga Baal-Hazor ah Absalom in belam mul amet sah a, tualeh Absalom in leengpa tapate zousie achiel a.","title":"Absalom in Amnon athat"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Absalom leengpa kungah ava pei a, akung ah, “Ngai in na suohin belam mul ka met sah a, leengpa leh asuohte, na suohpa kunga hing haw dingin ka hing ngen hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa’n Absalom kungah, “Hilou e, ka tapa tutungin ka unpi un hing hawda kon va ung, nang hing subuoi giap va ung,” achia, tuachi’n aman achiel teitei a, hinanleh a ut tuom sih a, aguolzawl zawta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Absalom in akungah, “Ka sanggampa Amnon beeh ka kungah hing hawleh asih diei,” achi hi.
