Tualeh leengpa’n akungah, “Bangdingin ahing haw tuomse diei?” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Absalom in Amnon leh leengpa tapa zousie beeh hawsah dingin angen teitei a."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Absalom in a suohte kungah, “Ngai un, Amnon in zu ahing kham a ahing lungnop hun chiemte unlen, tualeh Amnon that un kachi chiengin, that un, zau sih un, thu ka hing pie hilou ahiei mah, hangsan tah leh kipasalsah tahin um un,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Absalom suohten Amnon tungah Absalom in thu apieh bangin abawl ua, tuachi’n leengpa tapate zousie ading doh ua, asabiltung chiet uah atuong ua, ataimangta uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, lam lah a aum lai un, “Absalom in leengpa tapate zousie athat sienga khat zong akhawi sih” chiin David kungah thu ahing tung hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa adingdoh a, apuonsilte abotkeh a, lei ah alumta a, tualeh asuohte zousie in zong apuonte uh botkeh in akungah ading ua."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh David sanggampa Shimeah tapa Jonadab in adawnga, “Ka puin leengpa tapa tangvalte zousie athat gam siengta hi chi, gingta sih heh, Amnon maimai ahi ashi. A sanggamnu Tamar apawngsuol ni akipat, Absalom in hichi banga bawl ding atup mawng ahita hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka pu leengpa’n alungtangin leengpa tapate zousie ashi uh hi dingin alung gelsih heh, Amnon mai mai shi ahi bou hi.”"},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Absalom atai manga. Tualeh galveng tangvalpa’n dahdoh a, a et leh ngaiin, anua lam muolpang lampi ah mitampi ahing pei uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Jonadab in leengpa kungah, “En in, leengpa tapate ahing pei uhi, na suohin agen bangbang ana hina hi,” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahia, athugen azaw leh zawlou kichinin, En in leengpa tapate ahing tung ua, tualeh hakain a kapta uhi. Lengpa leh asuohte zousie zong kaa chitahin akap uhi."},"37":{"text":"Hinanleh Absalom ataimanga; Geshur leengpa Ammihud tapa Talmai kungah ava peita hi. Tualeh nichin in David in atapa asuun hi.","title":"Absalom taimangna","ref":"2 Sam. 3.3"},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n Absalom ataimanga, Geshur gam ah apei a, tuanah kum thum ava um hi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Lengpa David khu Absalom kunga vahaw a ut mama a, Amnon tungtang thu ah a lung muong ta hi. Ama lah ashi taah zieh in."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zeruiah tapa Joab in leengpa lungsim Absalom tungah aum chi athei hi.","title":"Absalom hing nua pei kiana"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Joab in Tekoa khuo ah mi asawl a, tuana kipat in numei piltah khat ava puisah a, akungah “Lusun bangin kibawl inlen, mi shi suunna puon sil inlen, sathau kinu sin, hinanleh hun sawtpi mishi suunna a na um numei bangin um in."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa kungah va pei inlen,” tambangin a kungah va gen in, achi hi. Tambangin Joab in amanu thu amop hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Tekoa khuo a numeinu’n, leengpa kunga thu agen ding kuonin amai tuol suin akhupboh a, chibai abuh a, akungah “Aw leengpa hing panpi in,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n amanu kungah, “Na buoi na bang ahiei?” achi a. Tuachi’n amanu’n “Kei meithai ka hia, ka pasal ashita hi, chiin adawng hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh na suohnu’n tapa ni ka nei a, ani un lou ah akihau ua, aphel ding koima aum sih a khat pen in adang khat pen asatlia ta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh ngaiin, tuin a innkuonpi tengin na suohnu adou huon ua, tualeh asanggampa thatpa khu hing pedoh in, asanggampa atha zieh a ama zong ka tha theina dingun, tualeh gouluo dingpa zong ka thatlia ngal ding uhi, achi ua. Tuabangin ka mei-am um nalai sunsun asumit ding ua, ka pasal min neilou leh leitunga hah le suon neilou a umsah ding ahita uhi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n numeinu kungah, “Na inn ah kipeita’n na tungtang thu ah thu ka pe nading hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Tekoa numeinu’n leengpa kungah, “Lengpa Aw, kapu thulimlouna mawna keima leh ka pa innkuonpite tungah tung mai henlen, leengpa leh aleeng toupha in mawposih heh,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n, “Koihinanleh na kunga thu hing gen pouma ka kungah hing zawpi inlen; tuachi’n ahing khawi nawn sih ding uhi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n “Sisan suomite tunga phuba alah nawnlouna dingin leengpa’n Mangpa na Pasian thei ngitnget in, khuchilou in ka tapa asulum kha ding uh,” achi hi. Tuachi’n aman “Mangpa hinna lou in ka gen ahi, na tapa samzang khat zong tuol ah ake sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n numeinu’n akungah, “Kapu leengpa kungah thu kam khat ka hing gen ding,” achi a; tualeh aman “Siem ve,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh numeinu’n akung ah, ahileh Pasian mite doudal a “Bangdinga hichibanga na bawl sawm ahiei? tam athu gen a kipat in leengpa maw nanei mi khat bangin akilang hi, leengpa’n ami tai mangpa anua pui kia lou zieh in."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen ashi chiet ding ihi ua, tualeh tui leitunga kibosa luoh kia theilou bang ihi uhi. Pasian in hinna alahmang ahi sih a, taimangpa khu ama lah a mi tuom ahilouna dingin alung geel zaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin kapu leengpa kunga tam thu gen dinga ka hing peina zong mite ka zau zieh ahi a, tualeh na suohnu’n leengpa kungah gen phot leng, leengpa’n asuohnu ngetna alawching sah khamaw diei mah."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen leengpa’n kei leh ka tapa Pasian in goutan ahing pieh luolou dinga hing sumang ding mi khut akipat na suohnu hing hunkhe dingin leengpa’n ahing ngaikhe ding ka chia ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n na suohnu a dingin kapu leengpa thu khu hamuon huoitah ahi dinga; asie apha khen dingin kapu leengpa lah Pasian vansawlsieng bangmai ahi ziehin Mangpa na Pasian in ahing umpi zel ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 19.27"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n adawnga, numeinu kungah “Kang doh pouma ka kungah bangma im sin aw” achi hi. Tualeh numeinu’n “Kapu leengpa’n hepitahin hing gen heh,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n “Tam thu ah Joab in pankhahna anei ei?” achi a. Tualeh numeinu’n “Kapu leengpa hinna louin ka gen ahi, kapu leengpa’n agensa koiman zietlam ahiei, veilam ahiei ah apel thei sih ding uhi: na suohpa Joab in ahing sawl a, tam thu zousie na suohnu kam ah amop sieng ahi."},"20":{"text":"Sil umdan sulamdang dingin, tam sil zousie na suoh Joab in abawl ahi, tualeh kapu pen leitunga sil um zousie thei dingin, Pasian vansawlsieng pilna bangmain apil hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n Joab kungah, “Ahoi hi, tam sil ka bawl ding hi; Tuaziehin kuon inlen, tangval Absalom va puikia in,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab amai a tuol suin abohkhupa, chibai abuh a, leengpa aguolzawla, Tualeh Joab in kapu leengpa aw, ka pu’n asuohpa ngetna alawchinsah ziehin “Tuni’n na suohin na mitmu ah deisahna ka tang hi chi na suohin ka theita,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab adingdoh a, Geshur ah apei a, tualeh Absalom Jerusalem ah ava puita hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n “Absalom ama inn ah pei henlen, ka mel mu sih heh,” achi a, tuachi’n Absalom ama inn lam ah apeita, leengpa mel amu sih hi."},"25":{"text":"Israelte zousie lah ah Absalom banga melhoi phat ding koima aum sih a, akeng akipat alu tandongin demna ding mawngmawng a um sih hi.","title":"Absalom melhoidan"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh asam aheu chiengin (kum kihei chin a aheu zel ahia) abuh zela, leengpa sil buh na a buh in Shekel zani agih ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Absalom in tapa thum leh tanu ni anei a, atanu min khu Tamar ahia, numei melhoi tah ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Absalom khu kum ni pumlum Jerusalem ah aum a, hinanleh leengpa mel amu sih hi.","title":"Absalom David toh kilem"},"29":{"text":"Tuaziehin Absalom in leengpa kunga, ama hawsah dingin Joab ahan sah a, hinanleh ahaw nuom sih hi, ani veina in athuhah kia a, ahaw nuom tuomsih hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaziehin aman asuohte kungah, “En un, Joab lou khu kei lou kungtah ahia, barli bu achiing hi, pei unlen vahal pieh un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Absalom suohten ava hal piehta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab adingdoh a, Absalom kungah a inn ah ava haw a. “Bangdinga na suohten kalou ahal uh ahiei?” ava chi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Absalom in Joab adawnga, “Ngai in, bangdinga Geshur akipat a hing pei ka hiei? khunah um khin khian leeng kei dinga hoizaw ma ding hiven chia gen dinga, leengpa kunga ka hing sawl theina dinga hing haw in chia, ka hing thuhah ahia, tu’n zong leengpa mel hing musah in, ka thulimlouna um ahileh hing that suh mai heh,” chiin, achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab leengpa kungah ava haw a, ava hilta hi. Tualeh Absalom ahan sah a, leengpa kung ah ahing pei a, tualeh leengpa mai ah amai a tuolsu a bohkhup in chibai abuh a, tuachi’n leengpa’n Absalom ana tawp hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tamte zou in, hichi ahia, Absalom in sakollengte leh sakolte tualeh mi sawmnga a masanga tai ding abawl a.","title":"Absalom in helna lungsim aneina"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Absalom zingmawng matah in athou a, kul kotkhah lampi gei ah ana dinga, tualeh hichi ahi a, mi koipou thu buoi nei a, leengpa kunga kihehna thukhensah dinga ahing pei chiengun, Absalom in ana han a, “Koi khuo na hiei?” ana chi zel a. Tualeh amaun “Na suohpa Israel namte lah a khat ka hi,” achi zel uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Absalom in akungah, “En in na thu khu ahoi in adih a, hinanleh na thu hing ngai tuopieh ding koima aguot sih hi,” ana chi zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Absalom in E! khai, “Kei vaihawm in pang leng aw, michin thubuoi nei pouma ka kungah ahing pei dinga, keiman dihtah a ana ngaituo pieh ding hi ing a,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, mi koi ahiei in chibai buh dinga ava zot chiengin ana tuden a atawp zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuabangin Israel mi leengpa kunga, thutut dinga hing kuon pouma kungah ana bawl zel hi. Tuachi’n Absalom in Israel mite lungsim ana hip pieh zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh kum li nua in hichi ahi a, Absalom in leengpa kungah, “Hepitahin Mangpa kunga ka thu chiem sutangtung dingin Hebron khuo ah hing hawsah in.","title":"Absalom helna"},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen na suohin Siria gam Geshur a ka um lai in, Jerusalem a na hing puikia pouma leh Mangpa nna ka sem ding, chiin thu kana chiem ta hi” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n akungah, “Hamuong tahin kuon in” achi hi. Tuachi’n adingdoh a Hebron ah ahawta hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Absalom in, “Pengkul gin na zah pouma chiengun, Hebron ah Absalom leeng ahita chiun” chiin, Israel nam zousiete kungah mi a dap sawl zouta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Absalom kungah, amichielte, mi za ni Jerusalem akipat in ava haw ua, lungsim hoitah puo a vahaw ahi ua, bangma athei sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Absalom in kithoinate alat laiin, Gilon mi Ahithophel, David vaihawmpi a khuo Giloh akipat athuhah a, athuphiel uh athupi mama a, Absalom lam pang mi lah apung deu deu ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh David kungah, “Israel mite lungsim Absalom langah a awn zouta” chiin thangkou khat ahing pei a.","title":"Jerusalem apat David taimangna"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in akungah “Jerusalem a mi um zousiete kungah, kisa un itai ding uh, Absalom akipat i suohta sih kha ding uh, kisa kin un, khuchilouin ahing lap man dinga, itung uah sil hoilou ahing tung dinga, namsau in khopi ahing dou ding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa suohten, leengpa kungah, “Ngaiin na suohte leengpa ka pu un aguot pouma bawl dingin mansa ka hi uhi,” achi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa apawtdoh a, tualeh ainnkuonpite zousie’n azui ua. Tualeh leengpa’n ainn ngah dingin ameite numei sawm a nuasie hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa apawtdoh a, mipite zousie’n anua azui ua, tualeh khopi pulam mun khat ah a khawl tadi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n asuohte zousie in amakhel ua, tualeh Kerethmite zousie, peleth mite zousie, leh Gath akipata ama zui Gitmi zaguhte leengpa makhel in amasang ah apei uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Gitmi Ittai kungah, “Bangchidan a, koutoh zawhkhawm ding na hiei mah? nua peikia inlen, leengpa kungah va um in, nang pen mikhuol leh gamdang mi, na gam a pat a nawdoh na hi ngal a."},"20":{"text":"Zani mama a hing tung pan na hia, tunia ka kung ua, asuh atou a hing zawpi dingin ka hing chi sam diei mah? kei pen ka pei theina lam lam a pei maiding ka hia, nangpen kia kia mai inlen na unaute zousie nua zawpi mai in, hepina leh thutah na kungah um heh” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Ittai in leengpa adawnga, akungah “Mangpa hinna leh kapu hinna lou in kagen ahi, shina hiin hinna hitaleh kapu leengpa umna lam lam ah na suohpa ka um ding hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh David in Ittai kungah, “Peiin, masa in” achi hi. Tuachi’n Gitmi Ittai khu amite zousie leh ata neu noute zousie utoh apei zel uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh agam pumpi aw ngaitahin akapta ua, tualeh mipi zousie apei ua. Lengpa mama in gamdai lampi lang zuonin, kidron luita akaan a, tualeh mipi zousiein zong akaan uhi."},"24":{"text":"Khunah Zadok zong Levi mite zousie toh Pasian thuhun bawm zawngin akungah apei ua, Pasian bawm anga khie ua, tualeh mipite zousie in khopi ahen masang sie un, Abiathar apeitou hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Zadok kungah, “Pasian bawm khopi sungah zawnglut kia un, Mangpa mitmu a deisahna ka tanleh, ahing pui kia dinga, Pasian bawm leh aumna ahing mu sah kia na ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh nangma ah kipahna mawngmawng ka neisih achileh, tanah ka um a, Aman hoi asah bangbangin ka tungah bawl mai heh” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Lengpan siempu Zadok kungah “Mutheipa na hi sih amah? Lungmuong tahin khopi sungah nuakia kia in, nangma leh na tapa ni, na tapa Ahimaz leh Abiathar tapa Jonathan toh."},"28":{"text":"En in, nou akipat a theisahna thu ka zah masang sie’n kei pen, gamdai a lui kanna ah kaana um ding hi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaziehin Zadok leh Abiathar in, Jerusalem lam ah Pasian bawm azawng kiata ua khunah a um denta uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n David khu Olive muol peitouna ah apeitou a, apei kawm in akap zel a, akilukhu a, akeng guohin apei a. Tualeh ama toh zawhkhawm mi zousie zong akilukhu ua, apeitou ua, apei kawm un akap uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n koi ahiei khat in, “Absalom thu phielpite lah ah, Ahithophel. Zong apang hi” chiin David ahila, tuachi’n “Aw Mangpa Ahithophel lem guotna khu, motna suoh sah in, chi’n ka hing ngen hi,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahia, David in Pasian abiehna muolvum atun tahin, Ark mi Hushai apuonah botkeh niai nuai leh alutunga leivui kai niai nuai in ama kimupi dingin ahing pei a."},"33":{"text":"David in akungah, “Ka kunga na hing pei leh keima dingin puohgih nahi ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh khopi ah kia kia zaw inlen, Absalom kungah, Aw leengpa na suohin ka pang ding hi, tu masang lai a napa suoh a ka napan bangin ka pang kia ding, chi lachin, Ahithophel lemguotna hing dal pieh nahi ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh khunah siempute Zadok leh Abiathar toh zong na um khawm hilou amah? tuaziehin hichi ahi dinga, leengpa innsunga na zah pouma siempute Zadok leh Abiathar kungah na hil sawn zel ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Ngai in, amaun atapate uh ni, Zadok tapa Ahimaz leh Abiathar tapa Jonathan a umpi uhi, na thuzah pouma uh theisah dingin amauh na hing sawl zel ding uhi.”"},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n David lawmpa Hushai khopi ah alut a, tualeh Absalom zong Jerusalem ah alut hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in muol vum ahen zep nua in Mephibosheth suohpa Ziba in ana dawn a, sabiltung van puo ni, avan sunga, tanghou beu zani, grep phougawsa bawh za khat, nipi theiga za khat leh uoin savun thawl khat aposah hi.","title":"David leh Ziba","ref":"2 Sam. 9.9,10"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n Ziba kungah, “Tamte bangchidan ahiei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n Ziba in “Tam sabiltung tegel leengpa innkuonpite tuonna ding ahia, tanghou leh nipi theite khu tangvalte neh ding ahia, tualeh uoin pen gamdai a dangta a basam poumate dawn ding ahi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n akungah, “Napu tapa hei ah a um ei?” achi a. Tualeh Ziba in leengpa kungah, “Ngai in Jerusalem ah aum hi, aman tuni’n Israel innkuonten ka pa gam hing pe ding ahi uh, achi uh, chi’n agen hi,” achi hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 19.25-27"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Ziba kungah, “Ngai in Mephibosheth sil nei tengteng nangma a ahita,” achi hi. Tualeh Ziba in akungah, “Aw kapu leengpa, na mitmu a deisahna katan theina dingin, kingai ngiem tahin na mai ah ka kun hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa David Bahurim ahing tun tahin, ngai in, Saul innkuonte lah a mi, Gera tapa amin Shimei ahing pawtkhie a, hamsielaw kawm in ahing pei a,","title":"Shimei in David sam sietna"},"6":{"text":"David suongin asep a, tualeh leengpa David suohte zousie leh mipi zousie tualeh galkap hat hangsan zousie zong aziet leh vei ah aum uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Shimei in ahamsiet sungin, hichiin achi hi, “Pawtmangin, pawtmangin, nang sisan suo hatpa leh khansepa."},"8":{"text":"Ataanga leenga napan, Saul innkuonte phuba zousie, Mangpa’n na tungah ale heita a, tualeh agam khu Mangpa’n natapa Absalom khut ah apeta hi. Tuachi’n tuin ngaiin, sisan suohatmi na hi ziehin, nangma sietna sukha na hita hi” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zeruiah tapa Abishai in leengpa kungah, “Bangzieh a tam ui pul khat in kapu leengpa hamsiet luon ding ahiei, ka kuon dinga alu kava tan pieh aw” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n “Zeruiah tapate aw, nou hing theipi ding bang a hiei um? Mangpa’n akunga David samsie in achileh ahing samsiet ding mawng ahi. Bangding a hichi banga bawl na hiei, koi in achi thei diei?” achi hi. (Kaala. 3.38); Rom. 9.20"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh David in Abishai leh asuohte zousie kungah, “Ngai un keima khaal a pieng ka tapa ngel in tha ahing tup leh; Tam Benjamin mi in hing tum nama louding ahiei mah? don da un, aw sie suo mai heh, Mangpa’n asuosah ahi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa’n ka gentheina hing mu van in, tunia ahing samsietna, ahoilam in Mangpa’n hing thuhta hen,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachia David leh amite lampi a apeilai un, Shimei zong muolpang zul zul ah apei a, apei kawm in aw sie alawkhum zela, suongin asep zel a, tualeh leivui athe zel hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa leh akunga um mi zousie, gim tahin atung ua, tuanah akhawl tawldam uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuabang hunlai tahin, Absalom leh Israel mipite zousie Jerusalem ah ahing tung ua, alah uah Ahithophel zong apang hi.","title":"Ahithophel leh Hushai in David athuhil uh"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, David lawmpa Ark mi Hushai Absalom kunga atuntahin, Hushai in Absalom kungah “Leengpa damsawt hen, Leengpa damsawt hen,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Absalom in Hushai kungah, “Tam khu na lawmpa na hepina ahiei? bang dinga na lawmpa kunga peilou na hiei?” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Hushai in Absalom kungah, “Peilou e, koi hinanleh Mangpa leh tam mipite leh Israel mi zousie’n atel phot pouma a ka hi dinga, ama kungah ka um den ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh koi nna ahiei ka sep ding? atapa masang ah nna ka sem sih diei mah? na pa nna kana sep bangin nangma nna zong ka sem ding hi,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Absalom in Ahithophel kungah, “Na lunggel inlen hing hil in, bang ahiei ibawl ding?” achi hi.","title":"Absalom in David zite aluppina"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Ahithophel in Absalom kungah, “Na pa mei innngah dinga akoite va luppi in tuachi’n Israel mi zousie in, na pa’n ahing muda hi chi aza ding ua, tuachi’n na kunga um zousie khut na suhat ding hi” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Absalom adingin, inntung vum ah puon inn azah pieh ua, tualeh Israel mi zousie mitmu in suntang laiin Absalom in apa meite aluppi ta hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 12.11,12"},"23":{"text":"Khum hun lai in Ahithophel lemguotnate khu, miten Pasian kam suoh bangin angai ua; tuachimabangin Ahithophel in David leh Absalom alemguot pinate khu ngai ahi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuathamlouin, a Ahithophel in Absalom kungah “Tuin galkap tul sawm leh ni hing teldoh inlen, tuachi’n ka kipandoh dinga, tuzan mama in David kava nuadel ding hi.","title":"Ahithophel leh Hushai lemguot akikal"},"2":{"text":"Agim leh ahatlou laitahin kava nua phah ding a, kava zausah dinga, akunga mi zousie ataimang ding ua, tuachi’n leengpa maimai kava that mai ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi zousie na kungah ka hing pui kia dinga, na mi suipa shina khu mi zousie hing kinuale bang ahi ding a, tuachi’n mi zousie lungmuong tahin a um mai ding hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Athu genin Absalom leh Israel upate akipah sahta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Absalom in “Ark mi Hushai zong hing han un, ama thugen zong ingaikhe ding uhi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Absalom kunga Hushai ahing tun tahin, Absalom in akungah, “Ahithophel in tambangin a gen a, ama gen bang bangin ibawl diei le? ibawllou ding leh nang hing gen in,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hushai in Absalom kungah, “Tutunga Ahithophel lemguot ahoi sih hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hushai in, “Na pa leh amite na thei a; mihat leh hangsan ngen ahi ua, gam lah a vompi anou kilahpieh bang mai ahi ua, tualeh na pa zong galdou siem mi ahia, mipite lah ah agieh sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ngai in leihawm sung ahiei, ahisihleh heisung mun ahiei khat ah akibu ahi ding, tualeh hichi ahi dinga, kidou chiilna ah mi pawl khat pua taleh aza pouma in Absalom nua zuite kithat gamta chia kigen ding ahibou hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi hangsantah humpibahnei banga lungsim pawte zong alungke sieng ding uhi, aziehpen Israel mi zousie’n na pa galhangtah ahidan leh akunga mi umte mi hangsan tahtah ahidan uh athei sieng uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin keima lemgel dan in, Israel mi zousie Dan akipat Beer-Sheba tandongin, tuipi pieunel za ding phiel na kungah ki kaikhawm in, nangma tahsa ngel zong kidouna ah kuon inlen."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n heisung mun hitaleh ikituoh tuohna ah, leitunga daitui kie bang mai in ikibawhuon ding ua, tuachi’n ama leh akunga mi um zousie khat zong ikhawi sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahisihleh khuo a ana lut tah leh zong, Israel mi zousie in khauhuol tawi in khum khuo ah iva lut ding ua suongnou khat zong nuselou in lui ah ikaikhe suh mai ding hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Absalom leh Israel mi zousie in “Ark mi Hushai lemguot khu Ahithophel lemguot sangin ahoizaw,” achi uhi. Aziehpen Mangpa’n Absalom tunga sil hoilou atunsah theina ding a, Mangpa’n Ahithophel lemguotna hoitah dalna dinga ana guotzou ahita hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hushai in siempute Zadok leh Abiathar kungah, “Ahithophel in Absalom leh Israel upate alemguotpi danleh, aman alemguotpi dan ahil sawnta a."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin David kungah mi sawl pai inlen akungah, tuzanin gamdai lui kaanna ah gieh nawn sinlen akinthei pen in kaan zawin, khuchilou in leengpa leh akunga um zousie valzouin aumkha ding uh, chisah in,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Jonathan leh Ahimaaz khu En Rogel ah a um ua, suoh numei khat in amauh ava hil zel hi; tuachi’n amaun leengpa David ava hil sawn zel uhi. Khopi a alut uh koiman amulou na ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh naupang khat in ana mu a, Absalom ava hil a, tuachi’n ani un ataimang pai ua, Bahurim a mi khat inn ah atung ua, tuapa’n a inn huong sungah tui kul khat anei a, khunah alutta uhi.","title":"David in luigal akaan"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n numei in tuikul kam khu a sitna in asinkhum a, tualeh atungah bu aphou a, tuakhu koiman athei sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Absalom suohte khu numeinu kunga ahing tuntah un, “Ahimaaz leh Jonathan hei ah a um uoi?” achi ua, tualeh numei in “Akung uah lui kaanta uh,” achi hi. Asui ua amu zoulou tah un Jerusalem ah anua kiata uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahia, apei zou bep un tuikul akipat apawtdoh ua, David ava hil uhi. David kungah “Kisa inlen lui kaan mengin, Aziehpen Ahithophel in nangma kalin lem aguot hi,” achi ua."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n David leh akung a um, mi zousie akisa ua, Jordan akaan ua, phalvah in koima Jordan galkailou a um sih uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ahithophel in ama lemguotna akizang sih chi athei tahin, asabiltung vante aguonga, akisa a, akho lang ua a inn ah apeita hi. Tualeh a innkuonte um dan ding abawlpieh dimdiem a, akikhailum a, ashita hi, tuachi’n apa han ah avuita uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n David Mahanaim atunga, tualeh Absalom in akunga um Israel mi zousie toh Jordan lui akaan ua;","title":"David Mahanaim atung"},"25":{"text":"tualeh Absalom in Joab thahengin Amasa khu galkap lamkai dingin akoi a. Amasa khu mi khat amin Ithra, Israel mi, Joab nu sanggampa Nahash tanu Abigail luppipa tapa ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mite leh Absalom in Gilead gam ah panmun abawl uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, David Mahanaim atunin, Ammon mi Rabbah khuo a mi Nahash tapa Shobite, Lodebar khuo a mi Amiel tapa Makirte, Rogelim khuo a Gilead mi Barzillai ten;"},"28":{"text":"lupnate, maiphiet kuongte, leibelte, mang bute, barli bute, tangbuongte, be kan gawte;"},"29":{"text":"khuoizute, bawng nawi datte, bawng nawi a pat a kibawl sathaute, belamte, David leh akunga um mipite neh dingin ahing tawi uhi. Gamdai ah “Mipite agilkiel ua, a gim ua, adang uh taa kha va achi zieh un.”"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in akunga um mipite asima, galkap tul tunga lamkaite, za tunga lamkaite aguonga.","title":"Ephraim taanga kidouna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in galkapte asawl khie a, mun thum akhen mun khat Joab khut ah akoi a, mun thum a khena munkhat Zeruiah tapa Joab sanggampa Abishai khut ah akoi a, tualeh mun thum akhen a mun khat Gitmi Ittai khut ah akoi a, Lengpa ngel ngel in “Keima mama zong na kung uah galdou in ka hing kuon tei tei ding hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh mipiten adawng ua, “Nang vang na hing kuon lou ding a hi; aziehpen, koute na taizahta u’leng zong khawh asa sih ding ua; tualeh akim khat va shita u’leng zong khawh asa naituom sih ding uhi, hinanleh nang pen koute tul sawm toh kibanga manpha na hi, tuazieh in khopi a kipata, hing panpi dinga nana um ahoizaw hi,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n akung uah, “Hoina sah pen dan dan un ka um ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n leengpa kulpi kotkha bul ah adinga, tualeh mipite aza aza in tualeh atul tul in akitawl zung zung uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n Joab, Abishai leh Ittai kung ah, “Keima zal in tangval Absalom nem tahin hing bawl ta un” chiin thu apie hi. Tualeh Absalom tungtang thu a leengpa’n lamkaite zousie thu apieh khu mipiten aza chiet uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite Israelte toh kidou dingin kidouna mun langah akuondohta ua, tualeh akidouna u’khu Ephraim gammang ahi."},"7":{"text":"Israel mite khu David mite masangah aguollelta ua, tuamun ah tua niin galkap tul sawmni tah athat uhi."},"8":{"text":"Akidouna un khum gam pumpi ahuop sieng a, tua niin namsau a shi sangin gammang in avallup atam zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Absalom in David galkapte a tuoh phut a, tualeh Absalom khu Sabiltung tunga tuong ahi a, tualeh sabiltung khu gangpi sing bawhpha mama nuoi ah atai lut a, tuachi’n alutang gangpi singah a awhta a; vanle lei kikaal ah akikhai dengdong denta a, tualeh asabiltung lah ataimangta hi.","title":"Absalom shina"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh koi ahiei khat in ava mu a, tuachi’n Joab ahil a, akungah, “Ngai in, Absalom gangpi singa kikhai ka mu hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab in ama vahilpa kungah, “Ngaiin mu ngal chin a, Bang dinga that a tuol a kesah pai ngal lou na hiei? Tuabanga bawl hi lachin dangka shekel sawm leh kawnggah khat hing pe ding hima veng in,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh tua mipa’n Joab kungah, “Dangka shekel tulkhat muding hinan leng zong leengpa tapa tungah khut kaha mawngmawng sih ding, achi a, aziehpen ka zah ngelngel un leengpa’n Nangma leh Abishai leh Ittai, thu ahing pie a, Absalom bangma lawlou dingin pilvangun achi ngal a, achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Khuchilouin vang keima hinna ngel sietna ding leptatna bawl ka hi dinga, leengpa mai ah lah bangma phuol thei ahi ngal sih a, nang lah na hing kisuhsiengsan ut pai ngal mai ding hi” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab in “Hichibangin ka hing ngah sawt thei sih ding,” achi hi. Tualeh akhut ah teipi thum atawi a, gangpi singa ahinga na um nalai Absalom lungtang zawntah adawt pailet a,"},"15":{"text":"tualeh galvan tawi tangval sawm in aim ua, athatta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab in pengkul amut a, tuachi’n Israelte nuadel mipite akhawlta uhi, Joab in akham ziehin."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Absalom luong ala ua, gammanga leihawm lienpi khat ah apailut ua, atung ah suong asep vum uhi. Tuachi’n Israel mi zousie amauh puon inn chiet ah ataizah ta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Absalom in adam lai in, Lengpa phaijang ah suong khat ana phut a. Ka min manlouna dingin, “Tapa lah ka nei sih a,” achi hi. Tua suong phu khu ama min aposah a, tuni dongin Absalom thei zingna; akichi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zadok tapa Ahimaaz in, “Tu’n vatai vangin, Mangpa’n amelmate tunga phuba alah pieh dan tanchin leengpa kava hil aw,” achi hi.","title":"Absalom shi thu David kihilna"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab in “Tuni’n vang tanchin va hil nai sin, nidang chiengin vahil nava teh. Hinanleh tuni’n leengpa tapa ashi ziehin tanchin va hil da tadi mai in,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab in Kush mi kungah, “Pei inlen leengpa kungah na silmu va hil vawi leh” achi hi. Tualeh Kush mi khu Joab mai ah akuna, tualeh ataita hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zadok tapa Ahimaaz in Joab kung ah, “Abang abang hitaleh Kush mi va nua del vang” achi kia a. Joab in adawnga, akungah “Ka tapa aw, tanchin hilman lah mulou ding hichi’n a, bang dinga tai teitei ding na hiei?” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh aman “Asuoh nuom” suoh heh, “Tai mai vang,” achia, tualeh Joab in “Tai mai ve leh” achi hi. Tuachi’n Ahimaaz khu phaijang lampi langah atai a Kush mipa ama khel hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh David khu kulpi kotkha nitegel kikaal ah atou a, tualeh galvengpa khu kulpi pulamtazaw banga pat in inntung lam ah akaltoua a dah kawi a a et leh, ngaiin mi khat amatangin ahing tai a."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n galvengpa akikou a, leengpa ahilta hi. Tualeh leengpa’n “Amatang ahileh thu hing hil ding anei hiva achi a, ahing taihat deu deu a, ahing nai deudeu ta hi.”"},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n galvengpan midang hing tai khat amu kia a, tuachi’n galvengpan kulpi kotkhah ngahpa ahan a, “En vawi midang khat amatang in ahing tai kia hi,” achi hi. Tualeh leengpa’n “Aman zong tanchin hing tut ding anei hiven” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh galvengpan “Ahing tai masa penpa khu Zadok tapa Ahimaz tai abang hi,” achi hi. Tualeh leengpa’n “Ama mi hoitah ahia, tanchin hoi hing tut ding ahi,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Ahimaaz in ahan a, leengpa kungah “Bang kim ahoi hi,” achi hi. Tualeh leengpa mai ah boh khupin chibai abuh a, akungah, “Ka pu leengpa douna a atunga khut ha zousie hing pedohpa Mangpa na Pasian phat in umta hen,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Lengpa’n “Tangval Absalom adam nai mah?” achi a. Ahimaaz in adawnga, “Joab in leengpa suoh pa keima, a hing sawlkhieh lai in abuoi he hu uh ka mu a, hinanleh bang ahiei chi ka thei sih hi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n, “Kihei inlen ka pam ah ding tadi in,” achi a, tuachi’n akiheia apam ah adingta hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua zou tahin Kush mipa ahing tunga, leengpa kungah “Ka pu leengpa adingin tanchin hoi ka hing puoh hi, Nang hing doute zousie tungah tuniin Mangpa’n phuba ahing lahpieh tahi,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Lengpan Kush mipa kungah, “Tangval Absalom adam nai?” achi hi. Tualeh Kush mipan adawnga, “Kapu leengpa melmate leh na sietna ding sui mite zousie tua tangvalpa bangin um sieng uheh,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa ada mama a, kulpi kotkhah tunga pindan ah ava peitou a, akapta hi. Tualeh apeitou kawmin, “Aw ka tapa Absalom nang sangin kei shi zaw mai leeng izaw, Aw Absalom ka tapa, ka tapa,” achi hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh “Ngai vawi, leengpa’n Absalom suun in akap kap mai hi,” chiin Joab ava hil ua.","title":"Joab in David aphawh thopna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum ni a aguolzawna ukhu mipi zousie a dingin mi shi suunna asuohzawta hi, mipite zousie’n “Leengpa a tapa shi ziehin ada mama mai hi,” chia kigen ana zata uhi."},"3":{"text":"Mipite khu kidouna a guollel a taizah, azum zieh ua adap vah bangun, khum ni in aguhin khopi adap lut uhi."},"4":{"text":"Lengpa’n amai ahum a, “Aw ka tapa Absalom, aw Absalom, ka tapa, ka tapa!” chi’n aw ngaitah suo in akap het hut hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab, leengpa inn sungah alut a, leengpa kungah, “Nangma’n tuni’n, Na hinna, na tapa leh na tanute hinna, na zite hinna leh na meite hinna humbit na mite zousie na zumsuota hi."},"6":{"text":"Na melmate na it a, na lawmte na muda in na huo hi. Na galkap lamkai liente leh na suohte bangman na ngaisih chi tuni’n na sulangta hi. Aziehpen tuni’n Absalom pen dam henlen, kou adang zousie shi sieng u’leng na kipahna lamtah leh hoi nasah lamtah hileh kilawm in ka theita hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, dingdoh inlen, hing pawtdoh inlen na suohte kungah lungmuon huoi tatah thu hing gen in. Mangpa min in ka kichiem ahi, na hing pawtdoh sihleh, tuzan in khat zong na kungah a um nawn sih dinga. Tuakhu na tangval akipat a tutan a sil hoilou na tunga tung zousie sangin ahoizaw sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa adingdoh a, kulpi kotpi ah atou a. Tualeh “Ngai un, leengpa kotpi phungah atou hi,” chiin mipi zousie ahilta ua; tuachi’n mipite zousie leengpa masangah ahing pei khawm uhi. Hinanleh Israelte pen ama u’puon inn chiet ah ataizahta uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Lengpan imelmate khut a kipat in ahing hunkhie a, Philistinte khut akipat ahing hundamta a, tualeh tuin Absalom ziehin gamsung ataisanta hi.","title":"David Jerusalem ah peikiata"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh itung ua i leengpa ding ua sathau inupa Absalom lah kidouna ah ashita a; Bangdinga leengpa hat kia ding a kamkhat beh a zong vaihawm lou na hi uoi mah chiin mipite akisel valuoi uhi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa David in siempute Zadok leh Abiathar kungah, “Juda upate houpi unlen, bangdinga leengpa a inn a nuapui kia nadinga akiheh pen a pang na hi uoi mah? Israel mipiten leengpa pui kia ding thu agen u’lah leengpa’n ana zata ngal a."},"12":{"text":"Ka unaute na hi ua, ka gu leh ka tahsa na hi ua, bang dinga azekai pen a pang na hi uoi? chiin va gen un achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Amasa kungah, kagu leh ka tahsa hilou na hiei mah? Joab taanga ka masanga galkap lamkai a, kang bawllou pouma leh Pasian in alawlaw hing law heh, tua sanga thupi zawin zong, chiin va gen un,” chi’n mi asawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuabangin Juda mite zousie lungsim mi khat lungsim bang mai in athuzawta hi, tuachi’n leengpa kungah, “Na mite zousie toh hing pei kiata un! chi dingin mi asawlta uhi.”"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa anua pei kiata a, Jordan ava tunga. Tualeh Judate leengpa dawn ding leh Jordan lui a na pui galkai dingin Gilgal ah ava pei uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Behurim a um Benjamin mi Gera tapa Shimei zong kintah a kisa in leengpa David dawn dingin Judate toh zawhkhawm dingin ahing pei suh hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 16.5-13"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh akungah Benjamin mi tul khat leh Saul innkuonte nasem Ziba leh atapate sawm leh nga leh asuohte sawm azawpi a, tualeh leengpa masang ah Jordan agalkaita uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa innkuonte pui kaina ding leh hoi asah bangbanga abawl dingin gunkuong khat agalkaipi uhi. Jordan lui agalkai tahin Gera tapa Shimei khu leengpa mai ah akhupboh a.","title":"David in Shimei angaidam"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa kungah, “Ka pu in thulim louna nei in hing ngoh da thei tei tei henlen, tualeh ka pu leengpa’n Jerusalem na nuasie nia, na suohpa gamtat khelna zong melchi pieh sinlen, tualeh leengpa lungsim ah thamden sih heh achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen na suohpan ka khielta chi ka theita a, tuaziehin ngai in, Joseph innkuonte lah ah ka pu dawn dinga, tunia hing kuon masa pen zong kahi hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Zeruiah tapa Abishai in adawnga, “Mangpa sathau nupa asamsiet zieh in Shimei thalia ahisih ding amah?” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh David in “Nou Zeruiah tapate aw nouten na hing thei sah ding uh bang ahiei um? tuni’n kei hing doute na hisih uh amah?” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Shimei kungah, “Na shi sih ding hi,” achi hi. Lengpa akungah akichiemta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Saul tupa Mephibosheth leengpa dawn dingin ahing kuon suh a, Lengpa apawtdoh ni akipat a galmuonga ahing kile kia ni tanin, akengte asil sih a, akhamul aheu sih a, tualeh apuonsilte asawp sih hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 9.1-13; 16.1-4"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Jerusalem a leengpa dawn dinga a ahing pei in, leengpa’n akungah, “Mephibosheth bangdinga ka kunga hing pei lou na hiei?” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh aman adawnga, “Ka pu leengpa aw, ka suohpan ahing sol a ahi, na suohpan leengpa kunga pei dingin ka tuonna ding sabiltung ka siem ding ka chia, na suoh lah kengbai kahi ngal a."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh aman leengpa kapu kungah na suohpa aheh a, hinanleh kapu leengpa, Pasian vansawlsieng bang ahi a, tuaziehin hoi nasah bangbangin bawl mai in."},"28":{"text":"Kapa innkuonpite zousie kapu leengpa masanga thalia sieng dinga kilawm ahi ngut ua, hinanleh na suohpa na dawkan a ann nete lah ah na pang sah nalai hi. Tuaziehin leengpa kunga sildang phut ngam nalai dingin ka kilawm na amah?” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n “Na tungtang thu bang dia genkia zel na hiei mah? Nang leh Ziba gam kihawm un kana chita hi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Mephibosheth in leengpa kungah, “Aman tang sieng mai heh, kapu leengpa lah ama tenna inn mama ah lungmuong tahin ahing tungta ngal a,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Gilead mi Barzillai Rogelim a kipat in ahing pei suh a; Lengpa Jordan a pui galkai dingin akungah Jordan akaan hi.","title":"David in Berzilai tungah itna aen sah","ref":"2 Sam. 17.27-29"},"32":{"text":"Barzillai khu upa pi ahita a, kum sawm giet a upa ahi. Mahanaim a leengpa aumlai in neh leh taah ding ana pie hi, mi hausatah ahi ziehin."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n Barzillai kungah, “Ka kungah hing pei inlen, Jerusalem a ka kungah um in ka hing kem ding,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Berzilai in leengpa kungah, “Bangtan vei dam nalai ding ka hiei? Jerusalem a leengpa kunga ka pei tou na dingin?"},"35":{"text":"Tuin kum sawm giet kahi ta a, asie leh apha ka khen theina ding amah? na suohin ka sil neh leh dawnte zong atui a al zong ka thei nawn amah? Pasal leh numeite la sah ging zong ka zah thei nawnlou pi, tuaziehin na suoh bangdingin ka pu leengpa dinga puohgih hi ding ka hiei mah?"},"36":{"text":"Na suohin leengpa kunga Jordan galkai tei sam ding bou ka tup ahi. Bangdinga leengpa’n hichibang a hoiman ahing thuh se se ding ahiei mah?"},"37":{"text":"Hepitahin na suohpa hing peisah kia maiin, ka hing ngen ahi, ka nu leh ka pa han umna keima khuo ngei ah ka kivui ding hi. Hinanleh na suohpa Kimham tanah a um hi, ama kapu Lengpa kungah galkai henlen, atungah hoi na sah bangbangin bawlin” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n adawnga, “Kimham ka kungah agalkai dinga, hoi nasah bang bangin atung ah ka bawl ding; tualeh na hing nget pouma ka hing bawl pieh ding,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi zousiein Jordan lui akaan ua, tualeh leengpa zong agal kai a, tuachi’n leengpa’n Barzillai atawpa, aguolzawl a, tuachi’n a umna lam ah akile kiata hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Gilgal ah agalkai a, Kimham zong akungah agalkai hi. Tualeh Judami zousie’n leengpa apui galkai ua, Israel mi kimkhat zong apang uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tua laitah in, Israel mizousie leengpa kungah ahing pei ua, tualeh akungah, “Bangdinga, ka unau uh Juda miten nang ahing guhmang ua, tualeh leengpa leh ainnkuonte, tualeh David mite zousie zong Jordan gal a puikhawm sieng uh ahiei?” achi uhi.","title":"Judate leh Israelte kiselna"},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda mi tengtengin Israel mite a dawng ua, “Leengpa ka kinaipi uh ahizieh ahi; bangdinga tam thu zieh a lungthah nahi uoi? leengpa neisa ne kahi uoi mah? ahisihleh sil pieh bang ahiei ahing pekha amah?” achi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh Israel miten Juda mite adawng ua. “Lengpa ah tan sawm ka nei ua, David ah noute sangin sunglaitang zaw ka hi uhi, bang ding a hing simmaw na hi uoi? leengpa pui kia ding sawm masate kahi sih uh amah?” achi uhi. Tuachi’n Juda mite thugen khu Israel mite thugen sangin a gum zaw hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh khum mun ah, gamtat hoilou mi khat aum a, amin Sheba ahia, Bikri tapa Benjamin mi ahi. Tualeh aman pengkul amut a, “David ah tan bangma inei sih a, Jesse tapa ah zong gouluo ding inei tuom sih uhi. Israelte aw michin na puon inn chiet uah kipeita un,” achi hi.","title":"David Jerusalem atung kiata","ref":"1 Leeng. 12.16; 2 Khang. 10.16"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mi zousie in David azui uh atawpsan ua, Bikri tapa Sheba azuita uhi, hinanleh Juda miten Jordan akipat Jerusalem tandongin a leengpa uh azui chinten uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n David khu Jerusalema a inn ah ahing tunga; tualeh leengpa’n ameite sawm inn ngah dinga akoite apui a, inn ah akoi a, aneh ding uh apie a, hinanleh aluppi sih hi, tuachi’n ashi tandong un, khum innah aum ua, meithai bangin a umta uhi.","ref":"2 Sam. 16.22"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Amasa kungah, “Ni thum sung in Judamite hing khop khawm pieh inlen, tualeh nangma zong hing pei in,” achi hi.","title":"Joab in amasa athana"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amasa Judate hankhawm dingin akuon a, hinanleh ahun bihieh sung sang in ava taam sawt zawta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Abishai kungah, “Tuin Bikri tapa Sheba in Absalom sangin zong ipoi uh khoi zaw ding ahita; na pu mite zawpi inlen del un, khuchilouin, kulpi nei khopite ah alutman dinga ihasuo kha ding uhi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab mite, Kerethmite, Pelethmite leh a mihat zousie in ama azuita ua, Jerusalem akipat in Bikri tapa Sheba del dingin akuonkheta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Gibeon a suongpi umna ava tun un, Amasa in amaute ana dawn a, tualeh Joab in kidouna vonte asil a, tualeh atungah namsau apai toh kawnggah a kigah akawng ah akuo a, tualeh amai lam zuon a apei lai in aketa hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Joab in Amasa kungah, “Na damzel na maw, ka sanggampa?” achi hi. Tualeh Joab in Amasa tawp tum in azietlam khut in a khamul ah atu a."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Joab namsau tawilam Amasa in ana thei sih a, tuachi’n agilah adawt a, agilzamte tuol ah akaikhe suh niai nuai a, sut kia ngailouin khunah ashita hi. Tuachi’n Joab leh asanggampa Abishai in Bikri tapa Sheba adelta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualai tahin Joab mite lah a tangval khat Amasa kungah a dinga, “Koipou Joab deisah pouma leh David lam a pang pouma in Joab zui uheh,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Amasa khu lamlien lai ah ama sisan lah ah akisai sai hi, Tualeh khum mipa’n mi zousie ding depdup amu in Amasa luong khu lam lien a kipat ala khie a, gam lah ah akoi doh a, puon akhu a; akunga hing pei pouma ding zela amu zieh in."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh lam lien akipat asuondoh nua un, mizousie Bikri tapa Sheba del dingin Joab azuita uhi.","title":"Sheba helna suhtawpna"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Sheba in Israel nam zousie umna mun Abel leh Beth-Maakah tan dongin ana tuon suoh a, tualeh Bermite gam zousie zong ana tuon suoh a, tualeh akikhawm khawm ua, Sheba azuita uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab leh anua zuiten, Beth-Makaah gam a Abel khuo ah Sheba a imta uhi; Khopi imna’n pal abawl ua, khopi kulpi toh kizopin leipal asep sang ua, kulpi pulam ah avum vengvong mai hi. Tualeh Joab kunga um mi zousie in, suhchip sawm in a leitangte akhuot uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n khopi sunga kipat numei pilvang khat ahing kikou khie a, “Ngai un, Ngai un, Joab kungah, na kunga thu ka gen theina dingin hing nai heh chi’n hing gen pieh un,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahing pei nai bepin, numei in akungah “Joab na hiei?” achia, tualeh Joab in adawnga “Kei kahi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amanu’n akungah, “Na suohnu thugen ngaikhe vawiin,” achi hi. Tualeh aman “Ka ngaikhie hi” chi’n adawng hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n thu agenta a, “Nidanglai in pei inlen na thudoh adawnna Abel khopi ah va ngaikhie in, ana chi zel ua, tuabangin thu atawp sah zel uhi."},"19":{"text":"Koute Israelte lah a kituoh na dei leh gin um ka hi ua, nang pen in Israelte khuo lah a, kho bulpi pen suhsiet tum in na sui hi, bangdinga Mangpa goutan na nawmval tup ahiei?” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Joab in adawnga, akungah, “Tuabang katum laizang sih hi, suh siet ahiei, nawmval ahiei ka tum mawngmawng sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Khuchibang lamsang ahisiha, Ephraim singtang gam a hing kipan Bikri tapa amin Sheba, leengpa tungah helna abawl a, David ngelngel dou in akhut alaam a, ama hing pedoh pou u’lachin khopi ka pawtsan mai ding hi,” achi hi. Tualeh numei in Joab kungah, “Na en in, alutang kulpi pulam ah ka hing paikhieh pieh ding uh,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n numei in apilna thawin mipi zousie kungah ava pei a, tualeh Bikri tapa Sheba lutang atan ua, tualeh Joab kung langah apai kheta uhi. Tuachi’n Joab in pengkul amuta, a innlam chiet uh zuon in, khopi nuasie in apeita uhi. Tualeh Joab pen Jerusalem a leengpa kungah akinua le ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Joab khu Israelte zousie tunga lamkai ahia, Benaiah (Jehoiada tapa) khu Kerethmite leh Pelethmite lamkai ahi.","title":"David miliente"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Adoram khu nasem a kiguoite lamkai in apanga, tualeh Alihud tapa Jehoshaphat khu tanchin giel in apang hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Sheva khu lai gielpa ahia, tualeh Zadok leh Abiathar khu siempute ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Jair mi Ira zong David vaihawmpa lien pen ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh David damlai in kumthum kizom in kiel atunga, Tualeh David in Mangpa adonga, tualeh Mangpa’n adawnga, “Saul zieh leh a innkuonte sisan suo mite zieh ahi, Gibeonte atha zieh uh ahi,” achi a.","title":"Saul hahlesuonte kithana"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n Gibeonte ahan a, akung uah, (Gibeonte Israelte hah le suon ahi sih ua, Amormi um sunte ahi zaw uhi; tualeh Israel leh Juda hahlesuonte dinga, aphattuom ngai lai un, amauh tha tumin Saul in ana sui sui hi).","ref":"Josh. 9.3-15"},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin David in Gibeonte kungah, “Bang ahiei ka hing bawl pieh ding? Tualeh Mangpa goutan na guolzawl theina dingun, bangchibang kilepna ka bawl diei?” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Gibeonten a kungah, “Saul leh a innkuonte tung thu ah, Sana leh dangka lam thu ahi sih a, Israelte lah ah kou a dingin mi thalia thei lah ahi sih hi” achi uhi. Tualeh aman, “Na chichi uh ka hing bawl pieh ding,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh amaun leengpa adawng ua, “Ahing sumangpa leh Israel gamsung mawngmawng a umsah lou dinga hing sumang dia kisapa;"},"6":{"text":"Atapate sagite hing pekhie inlen, tualeh kouten Mangpa mitel Saul umna Gibeah khuo ah Mangpa masang ah ka khai ding uh” achi uhi. Tualeh leengpa’n amaute “Hing pe vang,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa’n Mangpa kunga David leh Saul tapa Jonathan kikaal a, ani ua kikaal a kichiemna ziehin Saul tapa Jonathan tapa Mephibosheth akhawi hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 20.15-17; 2 Sam. 9.1-7"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa’n Aiah tanu Rizpah tapa nite Saul a dinga ahin pieh Armoni leh Mephibosheth apui a, tualeh Meholath mi Barzillai tapa Adriel dinga ahinpieh, Saul tanu Mikal tapa ngate zong a pui khawm a.","ref":"1 Sam. 18.19"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute Gibeonte ape khie a, tualeh amun muol tungah Mangpa masangah akhai ua, tuachi’n asagi un mun khat ah ashi khawm uhi; tualeh bu lah hunlai barli bu lah kipat ani khat ni’n thalia in aumta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Aiah tanu Rizpah in sai ip puon ala a, bu lah chiil akipat van guotui in aluongte uh abuoh khum masangsie a, aumna dingin suongpi tungah apha a, sun chiengin tungleng vate atung uah atusah sih a, zan chiengin gamsaten akhoisah sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Saul meinu Aiah tanu Rizpah sil bawl khu David ava hil uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh David ava kuon a, Philistin miten Gilboa a Saul atha ua, Philistinten akhaina mun uh Beth Shan kholai akipata aguh a vala dap Jabesh Gilead mite akipat in Saul gu leh atapa Jonathan gute khu avala a.","ref":"1 Sam. 31.8-13"},"13":{"text":"Khuna Saul leh atapa Jonathan gute alatou a, tualeh akikhailiate gu ala khawm uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Saul gu leh atapa Jonathan gute khu Benjamin gam a Zelah khuo ah apa Kish han ah avui ua, leengpa thupieh zousie a subuching uhi. Tuazouin khum gam tungah Pasian alungdamta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuate zouin Philistinten Israelte adou kia ua; David amite toh akuon suh a, tualeh Philistinte toh akidou ua, David abasamta hi.","title":"Philistinte toh kidouna (1 Khang. 20.4-8)"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Ishbi-benob miliente tapate lah a mikhat ahia, ateipi gihdan zong sum-eng buhnain shekel zathum agih ahi, aman namsau tha khat akuo a, David tha atum hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Zeruiah tapa Abishai in ava hundoh a, Philistin mipa asat a athatta hi. Tuachi’n David miten Israelte meivah na misah louna dingin, “Nang pen kalah uah galdou a, nang kuon nawnlou ding ahi,” chi’n akungah akichiem ta uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 11.36; Late. 132.17"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tuate zouin hichi ahia, Gob khuo ah Philistin mite toh kidouna aum kia a. Tuami tungin Hushath mi Sibekai in, miliente tapate lah a mi khat Saph athat hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Gob khuo ah Philistin mite toh kidouna aum kia leuleu a, khunah Bethlehem mi Jaare-oregim tapa Elhanan in Gitmi Goliath athat kia a, ateipi khu siemgante chiem bang mai ahiem ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Gath khuo ah kidouna aum kia a, khunah mi alet a lien khat, akhutphangte gel a a khutme guh tuah, akengphangte gel a akengme guh tuoh um, akigawma sawmni leh li nei aum a, ama zong miliente lah a pieng ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh aman Israelte asimmaw ziehin David sanggampa Shimei tapa Jonathan in athatta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tam mi lite khu Gath khuo a miliente hahlesuonte ahi uhi. Tualeh David leh amite khut ah ashi uhi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n amelmate zousie khut akipat leh Saul khut akipat a Mangpa’n ahutkhiet zou in David in Mangpa Pasian kungah tam lathute a gen hi.","title":"David hundamna la (Late. 18)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aman, “Mangpa khu ka suongpi, leh ka kulpi, leh ahing hundampa ahi;"},"3":{"text":"Ka Pasian khu ka kibutna suongpi ahia, Ka phaw leh ka hundamna kii ahia, Ka innsang leh ka kihumbitna ahi, Gumtat na lah a kipat Nangma’n, Nang hundam hi."},"4":{"text":"Pahtawi taah Pasian ka han ding a, Tuachi’n ka galte lah akipat in, hundam in ka um ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Shina tuipi kihot in ahing kimkot a, Sietna tuipi in ahing tum mang hi."},"6":{"text":"Shina khauhuolten ahing viel khuma, shina thangte ka kimvel ah akikam hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ka lungkham in Mangpa ka han a, Panpi dingin ka Pasian ka han zel hi. Aman abieh inn akipat ka aw aza a, Panpi ngai a ka kikouna angaikhie hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tuachi’n lei akilinga, akinuh hi, Alungthah ziehin, Van kingah nate zong akinuh in a kiloh hi."},"9":{"text":"Anahkuo hawm gel akipat meikhu apawt khie a, Akamsunga kipata mei pawt in; akatum zeng zung a, tuamin mei aamte a kuong sah pempom hi."},"10":{"text":"Aman vante zong a luoi kun a, ahing kunsuh hi; tualeh miel zong akeng nuoi ah a um hi."},"11":{"text":"Cherub tung ah atuonga, alengta hi, tualeh huipi hatungah Ama mu in a um hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh miel khu ama tuomtu dingin abawl a, Tuipi miel kheng khungte leh vanlaizawl a meilum satahte akaikhawm a."},"13":{"text":"Ama masanga vahphatnate ziehin, Suong meiholte akuong zei zoi hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa’n van akipat in van a ging sah a, Tualeh Tungnung pen in a Aw a suoh sah hi."},"15":{"text":"Athaltangte a kapdoh a athethang hi, Tunphe aphesah a amaute asubuoi ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa housietna zieh a anahkuo hawm a hu a, asem ziehin tuipi lampi ahing kilanga, leitung kingapnate mudoh in aum hi."},"17":{"text":"“Aman tunglam akipat in ahing sawhsuh a, Ahing tudet a, tuipi tampi akipat ahing kaikhie hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahat mama ka galte lah akipat ahing hunkhie a, Kei hing mudate lah ah zong; kei ding in lah amauh a hat seng taluo uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ka tuohsiet ni in ahing dou ua, Hinanleh Mangpa khu ka kingahna ahi."},"20":{"text":"Aman mun navah tahah ahing zawpi a; ka tunga akipah ziehin ahing na humbit hi."},"21":{"text":"“Mangpa’n ka dihtatna bang zelin, Kipahman ahing pie a; Ka khutte asienthoudan dungzui in, nuomman ahing pie hi."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa lampite ka zui a, ka Pasian akipat Gilou tahin ka piel mang ngai sih hi."},"23":{"text":"A vaihawmna zousie ka masangah aum zel a; Athupiehte ka kileheisan ngai sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Amasangah zong gensiet bei ka hinalai a, Ka thulimlouna akipat ka kihem khe zel hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n ka dihtatna dungzui in, ahing na thuhta amitmu a, ka sien thouna dung zui in."},"26":{"text":"“Mi khotuo siemte kungah, khotuosiemin na sulang dinga, Mi hoikimte kungah, hoikim in naki sulang ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Mi siengthoute kungah siengthou in Na kisulang ding a, tualeh mi genhate kungah genha in Na kilang ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Mi kingiemkhiehte na hundam dinga; mi kisatheite pen na ngiemkieh sah theina dingin, a tung ah na mit a tu zing hi."},"29":{"text":"Mangpa aw, kei dingin ka meivah na hia; tualeh Mangpa’n ka mielna ahing vahsah ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Nang ziehin galte ka del a; Ka Pasian panpina ziehin kulpite ka tawm kaan hi."},"31":{"text":"Pasian lampite ahoi bukim a, Mangpa thu atangtung zel hi; Ama muongte zousie a dingin Ama lum le phaw ahi."},"32":{"text":"“Mangpa chilou Pasian dang koi aum ei? I Pasian loungal suongpi koi a um ei?"},"33":{"text":"Pasian khu ka hatna leh silbawltheina ahi, Aman ka lampi ahoi bukimsah zel hi."},"34":{"text":"Aman ka kengte sazuhpi keng bangin abawl a, Ka munsangte ah ahing umsah zel hi.","ref":"Haba. 3.19"},"35":{"text":"Ka khutte galkap dan azil sah a, Tuachi’n, Ka banten sum-eng thalpite aluoitan zou hi."},"36":{"text":"Nangman na hundamna lum leh phaw na hing pie a, Na nunnemna in na hing siem lienta hi."},"37":{"text":"Ka nuoi a ka kalsuonte Na liensah a, Tuachi’n ka kengte a kitawl sih hi."},"38":{"text":"Ka melmat a ka delpha a, amauh ka sumanga, Ka suhchimit masang sie’n ka kiheisan ngai sih hi."},"39":{"text":"Athawzou nawn lou na dingun, Ka thatgam siengta a; ka masangah aguollel ua, ka keng nuoi ah apuata uhi."},"40":{"text":"Nangman galdou dingin hatna in, kakawng Na gah a, kei hing doute ka nuoi ah na thalpaita hi."},"41":{"text":"Kei hing mudate ka suhmang theina dingin, Nangman ka galte nang nua ngatsan sahta hi."},"42":{"text":"Adah kawi kawi ua, hinanleh amauh hundam ding koima a um sih hi; Mangpa nangawn a en ua, hinanleh Aman adawng sih hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken lei a leivui bangmai in ka satguoi dim dem a; kholai gawlzing buonnawi bang in ka tuon chil a, ka thezah ta hi."},"44":{"text":"“Nang ka miten ahing helkhumna ua kipat in zong, Nang humbit a; namte lutang dingin na hing koi a, ka thei ngailou miten ka nna asem ding uhi."},"45":{"text":"Gamdang mite ka kungah ahing kitulut ua; ka tanchin azah chiengun, ka thu azui uhi."},"46":{"text":"Gamdang mite alungke ding ua, akulpi ua kipat in chitun kawm in a hing pei suh ding uhi."},"47":{"text":"“Mangpa ahing ngitnget a, ka suongpi phat in um hen, ka hundamna suongpi! ka Pasian khu tawisangin umta hen!"},"48":{"text":"Phuba hing lahpiehpa leh, namchin ka nuoia hing thalpai piehpa khu Pasian ahi."},"49":{"text":"Aman ka galte lah a kipat ahing hundam a, Nangman ahing doute tunglam ah Na hing khaang sanga, Mi gumtatte lah akipat in na hing hunkheta hi."},"50":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Aw Mangpa namte lah ah, Na kungah kipah thu ka gen ding a, tualeh Na min phat in la kasa ding hi.","ref":"Rom. 15.9"},"51":{"text":"Ama khu leengpa ding in hundamna innsang a hia, tualeh asathaunu David leh, ahahasuonte tungah khotuona kum tawn in a langsah ding hi.”"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tamte David thugen nukhia pente ahi. Jesse tapa David in tambangin agen hi; Sangtah adopsanga um, Jakob Pasian sathau nupa, Israel phatna la ngai tah phuohpain, tam bangin agen hi.","title":"David kamteng nukhiate"},"2":{"text":"“Mangpa Hagau in keima mangin thu agen a, tualeh athu ka lei ah a um hi."},"3":{"text":"Israelte Pasian in agen a, Israelte suongpi in ahing houpi a, mite tunga vaihawmpa leh, Pasian giing kawm a vaihawmpa khu; adih ngei ding."},"4":{"text":"Zing mawng ni hing suoha, meilum kailou khovah bang ahi dinga, guo zuh zouchienga khuo hing sieng singseng, leitung hampa hing poudoh nou mitmet bang ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka innkuonte Pasian a kipan ahi sih uh amah? kumtawn thuhun ka kungah ahunga, bangkim kitup tah a sudet in, ka hundamna kim leh deidan kim, adawnsuong sah sih ding amah?"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh mi helhatte pen lingle khau kinilmang bang ahi dinga, azieh pen khut a kithamtheilou ding ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh ama uh khoi ding mite pen, sia leh teipia akivon ding uh ahi, tualeh amaute khu amun mama ah mei a haltum in aum sieng ding uhi.”"},"8":{"text":"Tamte David mi hat leh hangsante min ahi. Takmon mi Joseb-Basshebeth khu galkap lamkaite lah a lien pen ahi a: ama khatvei thu a mi zagiet that pa Eznit mi Adino achipa ukhu ahi.","title":"David mi hatte sil bawl"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh ama zomin Ahoh mi, Dodo tapa Eleazar ahi, tua mipa pen Philistin mite kidou dinga akikhop khawm lai ua amaleh David in simmaw tahin atawh ua, Israelte anua tai sieng lai ua David kunga galkap hangsan thum umte lah a khat ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ama adingdoh a, akhut akham a, akhut in namsau atuh thei laisie, Philistin mite asatlia a, tualeh khum niin Mangpa’n nasatahin gal azousah hi. Tualeh mipite khu gallah sumte lading giap in ahing nuakia kia uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ama zou in Harar mi Agee tapa Shammah ahi. Philistin mite khu be tampi pouna mun khat ah, akikaikhawm ua, tualeh Israelte khu Philistin mite akipat atai zahta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Shammah in belei laikim tah a dingin, avenga, Philistinte athat a, tualeh Mangpa’n nasatah in azou sah hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n lamkai lien sawmthumte lah a thumte, bu lah hun laitahin David kungah Adullam leihawm ah apei suh ua, tualeh Philistin galkapten Rephaim phaihawm ah panmun abawl uhi."},"14":{"text":"Khum hunlai tahin David khu kulpi sungah aum a, tualeh Philistin galkapte khu Bethlehem ah aum uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh David in “Tui adu mama a, Bethlehem a tuikul a tui, kulpi kotkhah kunga um khu dawn dinga hing pie um le izaw!” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkap hangsan thumten Philistin galkapte aphuzah phei ua, kul kotkhah kunga Bethlehem tuikul a tui ava thal ua, David kungah ahing tawi uhi. Hinanleh David in ana dawn nuom sih a, Mangpa kungah abokhe zawta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh “Aw Mangpa tami ka dawnlou dingdan, shi ngap a va kuonte sisan hilou ahiei mah?” achi a, tuaziehin David in a dawn nuom sih hi. Tamte mi hangsan thumte sil bawl ahi."},"18":{"text":"Zeruiah tapa Joab sanggampa Abishai khu mi thumte lah a lamkai lienpen ahi. Aman a teipi in mi zathum athat a, tuachi’n thumte lah ah min hoi alaw hi."},"19":{"text":"Thumte lah ah ama pahtawi tuoh ahisih a mah? Tuaziehin alamkai dingun abawl uhi, hinanleh tungnung pen thumte lah a sim tel phah ahi sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Kabzeel mi, mi hangsan Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in sil thupi tahtah tampi abawla, aman Moab galkap minthang humpibahnei bang mai a kigen ni athat a. Tualeh akuon suh a, vua kieh san laitahin lei hawm sunga humpibahnei khat ava that hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt mi, milientah khat athat hi. Izipt mi in teipi khat atawi a, hinanleh aman chieng tawi in ava zuon a, Izipt mipa teipi tawilai ava lahpieh a, ama teipi in ava sunliata hi."},"22":{"text":"Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in tambang silte abawl ziehin mihat leh hangsan thumte lah ah min hoi alaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Mihat sawmthumte sanga pahtawi tah zaw ahia, hinanleh mihat leh hangsan thumte lah ah apangpha zou sih hi. Tualeh David in ama vengte lamkai in akoi hi."},"24":{"text":"Joab sanggampa Asahel khu sawmthumte lah a khat ahi. Bethlehem khuo a um Dodo tapa Elhanan;"},"25":{"text":"Harod mi Shammah, Harod mi Elika"},"26":{"text":"Pal mi Helez, Tekoa mi Ikkesh tapa Ira."},"27":{"text":"Anathoth mi Abiezer, Hushath mi Mebunnai,"},"28":{"text":"Ahoh mi Zalmon, Netophath mi Maharai,"},"29":{"text":"Netophath mi Baanah tapa Heleb, Benjamin hahlesuonte lah a Gibeah khuo a Ribai tapa Ittai."},"30":{"text":"Pirathon mi Benaiah Gaash luite a hing kipan Hidai,"},"31":{"text":"Arbath mi Abi-Albon, Barhum mi Azmaveth,"},"32":{"text":"Shaalbon mi Eliahba, Jashen tapate lah a Jonathan."},"33":{"text":"Harar mi Shammah, Harar mi Sharar tapa Ahiam,"},"34":{"text":"Makath mi Ahasbai tapa Eliphelet, Gilon mi Ahithophel tapa Eliam."},"35":{"text":"Karmel mi Hezrai, Arb mi Parai,"},"36":{"text":"Zobah khuo a Nathan tapa Igal, Gad mi Bani"},"37":{"text":"Ammon mi Zelek, Beerothmi Nahari, Zeruiah tapa Joab galvan tawipa,"},"38":{"text":"Ithrimi Ira, Ithrimi Gareb"},"39":{"text":"Hitmi Uria, abawn un sawmthum leh sagi ahi uhi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israelte tungah Mangpa alungthah kia a, “Kuon inlen Israel mi leh Juda mite va sim in,” chia atung ua thusie bawl dingin David atohthou hi.","title":"David in mipi asim zieh a khelna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n akunga um galkap lamkai Joab kungah, “Israel nam zousie Dan a kipat Beer-Sheba tandong vatuon suoh unlen mi bangza apha uoi chi ka theina dingin va sim in,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Joab in leengpa kungah, “Mangpa na Pasian in Israel mipite tampi in pungsah henlen ale za a tamzaw in zong pung sah hen, tuachi’n ka pu leengpa’n amit ngei in mu heh. Hinanleh bang dinga kapu leengpa’n tuami thei ut sese ahiei mah?” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Bangtenghileh leengpa thuin Joab leh galkap lamkai liente azouta a, tuachi’n Joab leh galkap lamkaite Israel galdou thei mipite sim dingin leengpa kunga kipat in apawtkheta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Jordan gal ava kai ua, tualeh Gad guom lai tah a um Aroer khopi simlam Jazer dong in giehphuol abawl uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gilead leh Tahtim Hodshi gam ah apei ua, tualeh Dan-jaan leh Sidon gam kimvel atung uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Tai-ar kulpi lam zuon in apei ua, Hivmite khopi zousie leh Kanaan gam ava tung ua, tuachi’n Juda gam simlam leh Beer-Sheba atung uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachia gam pumpi aphah suoh zou un, ha kuo leh ni sawmni abei in, Jerusalem ah ahing nua pei kiata uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab in mi phaza leengpa kungah apie a, Israel gam ah namsau tawi mi hangsan tul za giet a um ua, tualeh Juda mi tul za nga a um uhi."},"10":{"text":"David in galkap mite asim zou in, alungsim ana mama a, tualeh David in Mangpa kungah, “Ka sil bawl ah kana khiel nasa mamata hi. Aw Mangpa na suohpa thulimlouna hing lahmang pieh dingin ka hing ngen hi, aziehpen mothuoi tahin ka bawl khata hi,” achi hi.","title":"David in gawtna thum lah akhat atel ngai"},"11":{"text":"Azing ni zingmawnga David thawmasangin, David guolneipa Gad kungah Mangpa thu ana tunga."},"12":{"text":"Pei inlen David kungah, “Mangpa’n tam bangin a gen hi, na tunga ka tun sah ding sil thumte lah ah khat tel in, achi hi,” vachi in."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gad David kungah ava haw a; akungah, “Gamsunga na tungah kum thum kiel tun ding ahiei? ahisihleh ha thum sung na galten ahing nuadel a tai tai ahiei? ahisihleh ni thum sung na gamsunga natna hipi len ahiei? tuin kingaituo inlen, ahing sawlpa bangchibanga dawng ding ka hiei? hing hil in” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh David in Gad kungah, “Ka lung azing mama mai hi, Mangpa khut sungah pualut mai lei, akhotuona lah athupi mama ngal a, mihing khut sungah vang hing pua lut sah vawt sin,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Israel mite tungah ahun guotsa sungteng, natna hipi asawlta a, Dan apat Beersheba tan in mi tul sawm sagi ashi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian vansawlsieng in suse dinga Jerusalem tunga akhut alaptou laitahin Mangpa’n sil hoilou abawl tup akipat alungsim ahenga, tualeh mipite sumangtu vansawlsieng kungah, “Hunta, na khut zah nawn sin,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Mangpa vansawlsieng khu Jebusmi Araunah phuol kungah a um hi."},"17":{"text":"David in mite thatgamtu vansawlsieng amu tahin, Mangpa ahoupi a, “Ngai in, ka khielta hi, gitlouhuoi tahin ka bawl khata hi, hinanleh tam belamten bang sil abawl ua ahiei? Na khutin keima leh ka pa innkuonte hing khoi zaw heh,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Khum niin Gad David kungah ava haw a, akungah, “Peitou inlen Jebus mi Araunah phuol ah Mangpa a dingin maitam khat bawlin,” achi hi.","title":"David in maitam abawlna"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n thu apieh banga, Gad in agen dungzui in David a peitouta hi."},"20":{"text":"Araunah in a et leh, leengpa leh asuohte ama lam zuon a hing pei amu a, tuachi’n Araunah ava pawt a, amai a tuolsuin chibai abuh a."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Araunah in akungah, “Bangzieh a kapu leengpa asuohpa kunga, hing haw laizang ahiei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n David in akungah, “Mipite lah a natna hipi leng atawp theina dingin, Mangpa adinga, na phuol lei dinga hing pei ka hi uh,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Araunah in David kungah, “Ka pu leengpa’n kitan henlen, adei bangin lan heh, En in, halmang sillat dingin bawngtalte tanah aum hi, tualeh avan zah dingin phuol van zahte leh bawng vante a um hi."},"23":{"text":"Aw leengpa tamte zousie kei Araunah in leengpa ka hing pe sieng hi.” Tualeh Araunah in leengpa kungah, “Mangpa na Pasian in hing pompiehta hen” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Araunah kungah, “Hilou e, aman nei a, alei a ka hing lei pieh mawngmawng ding ahi, bangma senna umlou in Mangpa ka Pasian kungah, halmang sillatte ka lan mawngmawng sih ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n David in phuol leh bawngtalte khu dangka Shekel sawmnga in aleita hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh David in Mangpa adingin maitam khat abawl a, tualeh halmang sillat leh lemna sillat alan hi. Tuachi’n Mangpa’n a thumna te adawnga, gam tungah alungdamta a, Israel akipat natna hipi aladohta hi."}}}}},"11":{"info":{"name":"1 Leengte","shortname":"1 Leeng.","abbr":[],"desc":"Leengte laibu khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David leengpa atehta a, akum zong atamta hi; tuachi’n puon tampi a sil sah ua, hinanleh lum asa tuom sih hi.","title":"David tehlam kumte"},"2":{"text":"Tuaziehin a suohten akungah, “Ka pu uh leengpa a dingin nungah siengthou khat kisui henlen; amanu’n leengpa kem henlen, tualeh ka pu uh leengpa’n lum asah theina dingin; amanu na angsungah lum zel heh,” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel gamsung pumpi ah, nungah melhoi a sui ua, Shunam mi Abishag amu ua, tualeh leengpa kungah ahing zawpi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua nungah khu a mel ahoi mama a, leengpa akem a, neh leh taah abawl pieh a, hinanleh leengpa’n apawl sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Haggith tapa Adonijah in, “Kei leengpa a pang ding ka hi” chiin akiliensah mama hi, tualeh sakolleengte, sakol tungtuong mite leh mi sawm nga, amasanga tai ding a guong zou diem a.","title":"Adonijah in leeng hiding adap tup","ref":"2 Sam. 3.4"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh apa’n zong lah, “Bang dinga, tambanga gamta na hiei” chi’n aphawh kha ngai sih hi. Tualeh ama zong mi mel hoi mama ahia, anu’n Absalom zou a anei ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zeruiah tapa Joab leh siempu Abiathar toh akithukup ua, amaun Adonijah panpi in azui uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Siempu Zadok, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah guolnei Nathan, Shimei leh Rei, te tualeh David mi hat leh hangsante pen Adonijah langah apang sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Adonijah in belamte, bawngtalte, ganva thaute, En-rogel kunga um; Zoheleth suongpi tungah athat a, tualeh a sanggam leengpa tapate zousie leh leengpa suohte, Juda mi zousie achiel hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh guolnei Nathan leh Benaiah te leh mi hat hangsante tualeh asanggampa Solomon achiel sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nathan in Solomon nu Bathsheba ahoupi a, akungah, “I pu David theilou kal in Haggith tapa Adonijah leeng in apangta chi za lou na hiei mah?","ref":"2 Sam. 12.24"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin hing pei inlen, nangma hinna leh na tapa Solomon hinna na humbit theina dingin lem ka hing guotpieh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Lengpa David kungah va lut inlen akungah, Aw leengpa ka puin na suohnu kungah, “Na tapa Solomon keima nua ah leeng in apang ngeingei dinga ka leengtoupha ah atou ding chiin na kichiem asiei mah? bang chidan a Adonijah leenga hing pang atai mah?” vachiin,"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa toh na houlim lai mama un kei zong na nua ah ka hing lut dinga, na thugen ka hing suhdet pieh ding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Bathsheba leengpa indan sungah ava lut a, leengpa ateh mama ta a, Shunam mi Abishag in leengpa neh leh taah abawl pieh hi."},"16":{"text":"Bathsheba in kun in leengpa chibai abuh a, Tualeh leengpa’n “Bang ahiei na dei?” ana chi hi."},"17":{"text":"Amanu’n akungah, “Pu aw, Mangpa Pasian min in na suohnu kungah, Na tapa Solomon keima nua ah leeng in apang ngeingei dinga, ka leengtoupha ah atou ding, chiin na kichiem a."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh En in, tuin Adonijah, leeng in apanga, tuami ka pu leengpa’n na theikha sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh aman bawngtalte, gan vathaute leh belamte tampi athat a, tualeh leengpa tapate zousie, siempu Abiathar leh galkap lamkai lien Joab te achiel a, hinanleh na suohpa Solomon achiel sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh ka pu leengpa aw, nangma nua a, ka pu leengpa, leengtoupha a tou ding na phuondoh ngah in Israel mipite zousie mit nangma tungah atu hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahisihleh hichi ahi dinga, ka pu leengpa apulepate kunga, a imut hun chiengin, kei leh ka tapa Solomon pen sil bawlkhiel a ngohin ka um ding uhi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh ngaiin tuabanga leengpa ahoupi laitah in guolnei Nathan zong ava lut a."},"23":{"text":"“En in guolnei Nathan ahing lut hi” chiin leengpa ahil ua. Tuachia leengpa masanga ava lut tah in, leengpa masangah amai tuol suin chibai abuh a."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Nathan in “Aw leengpa ka pu in, ka nua chiengin Adonijah leeng ahi dinga, ka leengtoupha tungah atou ding na chikha amah?"},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen tuni in akuon suh a, bawngtalte, gan va thaute leh belamte kiningching tahin athat a, leengpa tapate, galkap lamkai liente leh siempu Abiatharte achiel a, tualeh ngaiin amasangah ne in adawn ua, Pasian in leengpa Adonijah humbit hen, achi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh na suoh kei bang, siempu Zadok bang Jehoiada tapa Benaiah bang, tualeh na suohpa Solomon bang ahing chiel sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Kapu leengpa thu a tam sil kibawl ahiei mah? Tualeh ka pu leengpa, leeng toupha a ama nua chienga tou ding koi pen ahiei chi, na suohte na hil nailou hivateh izaw?” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa David in adawnga, “Bathsheba hing hatpieh un” achia, tuachi’n amanu khu leengpa umna ah ava lut a, amasang ah ava ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa akichiema, “Ka mangbat gentheina zousie a, hing hundohpa Mangpa min in ka gen ahi."},"30":{"text":"Na kunga Mangpa Israelte Pasian min loua, Na tapa Solomon, ka nua chiengin leeng in apang ngeingei ding a, ka suohpa ka leeng toupha tung ah ahing tou ding hi chia, ka kichiem bangbang in tuni’n ka bawl ding hi,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Bathsheba khu amai a tuolsuin akhupboh a, leengpa chibai abuh a, “Ka pu leengpa David kumtawn in damta hen, achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa David in, “Siempu Zadok leh guolnei Nathan tualeh Jehoiada tapa Benaiah hing hatpieh un” achi hi. Tuachi’n amaute amasangah ahing pei uhi.","title":"Solomon leeng dinga sathau nuna"},"33":{"text":"Lengpan akung uah, “Na pu uh suohte pui unlen, tualeh ka tapa Solomon khu keima Sabiltung mama tungah tuongsah unlen, tualeh Gihon mun ah va pui suh un."},"34":{"text":"Khummun ah Israel leengpa dingin siempu Zadok leh guolnei Nathan in sathau nu sah un, tualeh pengkul mut unlen, Pasian in leengpa Solomon humbit hen, chiin kikou un."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama hing zuitou unlen, tualeh ama ahing pei dinga, ka leeng touna tungah atou ding a, keima thahengin vai ahawm ding hi. Israelte leh Judate tunga vaihawm dinga keiman ka guot ahita,” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in leengpa adawnga, “Amen, Mangpa ka pu leengpa Pasian in lem sahpi tahen."},"37":{"text":"Mangpa kapu leengpa kunga a um bangin Solomon kungah zong umta hen, aleeng toupha zong ka pu leengpa David leengtoupha sangin thupi sah zawta hen,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachibangin, siempu Zadokte, guolnei Nathante Jehoiada tapa Benaiahte, tualeh Kereth mite, Pelethmite, apei suh ua, Solomon khu David sabiltung tungah atou sah ua, Gihon mun ah apui uhi."},"39":{"text":"Siempu Zadok in Bieh buh akipat in sathau koina saki ala a, Solomon sathau anuta hi. Tuachi’n pengkul amut ua, mi zousie in “Leengpa Solomon damsawt hen,” achi uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh mi zousie in azui ua, theile atum ua, akipah mama ua, ahusa un leithuong akihot sah kei hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n Adonijah leh akunga um ami chielte zousie in a ann neh zou un, tua husa khu azata ua, tualeh Joab in pengkul gin azah tahin, “Khopi sunga husa pialpual pi bangchidan ata diei?” achi hi.","title":"Adonijah kipieh lutna"},"42":{"text":"Khuchia agen laitahin, Abiathar tapa Jonathan ahing tunga, tualeh Adonijah in, “Hing lut in, nang pasal pha na hia, thuhoi thupha hing tut navateh maw,” achi hi."},"43":{"text":"Jonathan in Adonijah adawnga, “Tut sing e, ipu leengpa David in Solomon leengpa in apang sah ta hi."},"44":{"text":"Lengpa’n ama toh siempu Zadokte guolnei Nathante, Jehoiada tapa Benaiahte, tualeh Kereth mite leh Peleth mite asawl a; tualeh amauten Solomon khu leengpa sabiltung tungah atousah ua."},"45":{"text":"Siempu Zadok leh guolnei Nathan in Gihon ah leengpa dingin sathau anu uhi; tualeh khuna kipat in nuomsa tahin apeitou ua, tuachi’n a husa un khopi sung leithuong akihotsah hi. Tuami husa ahi na zah uh."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh Solomon zong leengpa, leengtouna tungah atou hi."},"47":{"text":"Tuathamlouin leengpa nasem miliente zong ipu leengpa David thupha pedingin ahing pei ua, Pasian in nangma min sangin Solomon minthangsah zaw henlen, tualeh aleengtoupha zong nangma leengtoupha sangin thupi sah zawta hen achi ua; tuachi’n leengpa alupna tungah Pasian bie in akuun hi."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n zong tambangin agen hi, ka mit mu ngei a, tunia ka leengtouna a tou ding hing guot piehpa Mangpa Israelte Pasian min phat in umta hen, achi hi,” achi hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n Adonijah kunga um ami chielte zousie azauta mama ua, tualeh adingdoh ua a inn lam chiet uah akipeita uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tuachi’n Adonijah in Solomon agiingta a, adingdoh a, ava pei a, maitam kii ava tuta hi."},"51":{"text":"“Tuachi’n, Adonijah in leengpa Solomon agiinga, leengpa Solomon in a suohpa namsau a thatlou dingin kichiem phot heh, chiin maitam kii atu hi,” chiin Solomon ahil uhi."},"52":{"text":"Solomon in adawnga, “Mi gin um leh dihtah ahina asuhlat thei leh asam zang khat zong tuol ah ake sih dinga, hinanleh gitlouna anei le vang ashi ding ahi,” achi hi."},"53":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Solomon in mi asawl a, maitam akipat in azawpi suh ua, tualeh ama ahing pei a, kun in Solomon chibai ava buh a, tualeh Solomon in “Na inn langah peita in,” ana chi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n David shi ding hun ahing nai tahin, atapa Solomon kungah thu apie hi.","title":"David in Solomon athuhilna"},"2":{"text":"“Leitung pumpi ngaina dan banga pei ding ka hita a, tuaziehin hattahin um inlen, kipasalsah in."},"3":{"text":"Na sil bawl pouma leh na kiheina lam tenga na lamzan theina dingin, Mosi dan a kigiel bangin Mangpa na Pasian in alampite zuiding leh athupiehte, atawndan thuguotte, avaihawmna dante leh athutheisahte pom dinga athupiehte zui in."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa’n keima tungtang thua, Na suohten alungtang zousie u’leh, ahinna zousie ua, ka mitmu a thutah a gamta dinga, aumdan ua apilvang u’leh Israel leengtoupha a tou ding mi akibansam sih ding hi chia agen khu, asutangtung ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tuathamlouin Zeruiah tapa Joab in ahing bawldante, Israel galkap lamkai ni Ner tapa Abner leh Jether tapa Amasa abawldan na thei hi Amaute athat a, galmuon lai a, kidou sisan asuo a, atai a agah akawnggahte leh akenga abu akengdapte sisan aluonkhum sah dante na thei hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 3.27; 2 Sam. 20.10"},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin na pilna dungzui in bawl inlen, tualeh alu a samkang pou in, lungmuong tahin han ah lut sah sin."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Gilead mi Barzillai tapate tungah hepina langsah inlen, na dawkan a ann nete lah ah pangsah in, na sanggampa Absalom zieh a ka taimang lai in ka kungah ahing pei hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 17.27-29"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh ngaiin Bahurim khuo a Benjamin mi Gera tapa Shimei na kungah a um hi, aman Mahanaim lam zuon a ka pei niin awsie chizat huoi tahtah ahing lawkhum a, hinanleh Jordan ah adawn in ahing pei suh a, tuachi’n namsau a that lou dingin Mangpa min in kana kichiemta hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 16.5-13; 19.16-23"},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin ama khelna neilou bangin ha sin, mi pil nahi ziehin atunga na bawl ding dan na thei hi, hinanleh alu a asamkang sisan toh han na zuon sah ding ahi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n David khu apu apate kungah a imuta a, David khopi ah avuita uhi.","title":"David shina (1 Khang. 29.26-30)"},"11":{"text":"Israelte tunga David leenga apan sung kum sawm li ahi a; Hebron ah kum sagi leeng in apanga, tualeh Jerusalem ah kum sawm thum leh thum leeng in apang hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 5.4,5; 1 Khang. 3.4"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon khu apa leengtoupha tungah atou a, tualeh agam khu nasa taha sudetin ahing umta hi.","ref":"1 Khang. 29.23"},"13":{"text":"Haggith tapa Adonijah khu Solomon nu Bathsheba kungah ava haw a, amanu’n “Hoilam thu a hing haw hina vateh maw?” ana chia, tualeh aman “Hoilam thu ah hi e,” achi hi.","title":"Adonijah tha na"},"14":{"text":"Aman na kungah “Siem ding bang ahiei khat ka nei hi,” achi kia a, Amanu’n “Siem ve,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tuachi’n aman leenggam khu kei a ahita chi na thei a, tualeh Israel mi zousie’n leengpa hi dingin kei lam ahing en chiet uh chi na thei hi, hinanleh leenggam khu na lehei a, tuachi’n ka sanggampa a ahita hi, Mangpa a kipan ahi zieh in."},"16":{"text":"Tuin sil khat nget ding ka hing nei hi, hing it vawt sin aw,” achi a. Tualeh amanu’n “Siem vawita,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Hepitahin leengpa Solomon hing houpi pieh inlen (nang thu asel ngai sih ding hi) Shunam mi Abishag khu ka zi dingin hing phal pieh heh,” achi hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 1.3,4"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Bathsheba in, “Ahoi hi, leengpa kung ah ka hing gen pieh ding,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin Bathsheba khu Adonijah adinga leengpa Solomon houpi dingin akungah ava hawta hi.
