Tualeh leengpa amanu kimupi dingin adingdoh a, amanu masangah akuun a, tuachi’n atouna ah atou a, tualeh leengpa nu touna ding leengtouna khat akoi sah a, azietlam ah atouta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n akungah, “Sil neu noukhat hing ngen vang, hing niel vawt sin,” achi a, tualeh leengpa’n akungah, “Ngen ve nu, ka hing niel vawt sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n “Shunam mi Abishag na sanggampa Adonijah ziin nei sah in,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Solomon in adawnga, anu kung ah, “Bangchidan a, Shunam mi Abishag, Adonijah dinga na nget valong ahiei? leenggam zong nget pieh vanglah ve, ama ka upa hilou i? ama ading leh siempu Abiathar ading leh Zeruiah tapa Joab a dingin zong ngen vanglah ve leh,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Solomon “Mangpa min in akichiemta a, Adonijah in tam thu ama shina ding a, agen ahi lou pouma leh Pasian in alaw law hing law henlen tua sanga thupi zaw in zong, achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, ahing sudet a, ka pa David leengtoupha a hing tou sah a, athu chiem banga innkuon hing na phukhietpiehpa Mangpa min in ka gen ahi, tunia Adonijah tha ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Lengpa Solomon in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah asawl a, aman ava that ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh siempu Abiathar kungah “Leengpa’n Anathoth khuo ah nangma inn leh lou ah peimang in shi tah na hi, hinanleh ka pa David masanga Pasian bawm na zawn zing zieh leh ka pa hasatna thuohna zousie a hasatna nana thuoh ziehin tutung in vang ka hing that sih ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Abiathar siempu hina kitawpsah","ref":"2 Sam. 15.24; 1 Sam. 22.20-23"},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin Solomon in Abiathar khu Mangpa siempu ahina atawpsah a; Mangpa’n Shiloh khuo a, siempu Eli innkuonte tungtang thu a ana gen atangtun theina dingin.","ref":"1 Sam. 2.27-36"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum thu Joab kungah ahing tunga; Joab in Absalom ana zuilou vangin, Adonijah lam ah apang hi. Tuachi’n Joab khu Mangpa biehbuh sungah atailut a, tualeh maitam kiite ava tudenta hi.","title":"Joab kitha na"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Lengpa Solomon kungah, “Joab Mangpa biehbuh sungah atailut a, maitam kungah aum denta hi,” chiin ava hil ua. Tuachi’n Solomon in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah asawl a, “Kuon inlen va satlia in,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Benaiah khu Mangpa biehbuh ah ava lut a, Joab kungah “Leengpa’n hing pawtkhie heh” achi hi, ava chi a hinanleh aman, “Hing pawt sihvang, tanah ka shi den mai ding hi,” achi hi. Tualeh Benaiah in Joab in “Hichibangin ahing na dawng hi,” chi’n leengpa kungah thu atut hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Benaiah thu apie a, “Agen bangin va that inlen, vui ngal in; azieh umlou pi a, Joab in sisan asuona akipat kei leh ka pa innkuonte na hing suhsieng theina dingin."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama sanga hoizaw leh kizenzaw mi ni Ner tapa Abner Israelte galkap lamkai lien leh Jether tapa Amasa Judate galkap lien tegel ka pa David theilou a, namsau a ana tha ziehin Mangpa’n asisan phuba ama tungah athuh zawta hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaute sisan mawna Joab lutung leh ahahlesuonte lutungah kumtawn in um henlen, hinanleh David tung leh ahahasuonte tungah tualeh aleengtouna tungah pen Mangpa a kipat lungmuonna kumtawn in aumdenta ding hi,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoiada tapa Benaiah ava kuontou a, ava satlia a, athatta hi, tualeh gamdai a ama inn ah vui in aumta hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Lengpa’n Joab mun ah Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, galkapte lamkai lienpen in apang sahta hi, tualeh siempu Zadok khu Abiathar mun aluo sahta hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n Shimei ahan sah a, akungah “Jerusalem khopi sungah na inn ding bawl inlen, heimah pawtdoh sin.","title":"Shimei kithana"},"37":{"text":"Na pawtdoh a kidron lui na kaan ni niin na shi ngeingei ding ahi chi theiin, na sisan mawna nangma lutung mama ah a um ding hi,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Shimei in leengpa kungah, Adih hi ka pu leengpa’n na gen “Bangbangin na suoh in ka bawl ding hi,” achi hi. Tualeh Shimei khu Jerusalem ah hun sawt tah aum hi."},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh kumthum zou in Shimei suohte ni Gath leengpa Maakah tapa Akish kungah ataimang ua, tualeh Shimei kungah “Na suohte Gath ah aum” chin ahil uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Shimei akisa a, asabiltung vante a guonga, Gath khuo a Akish kungah ava haw a, asuoh tegel Gath khuo akipat ava ladohta hi."},"41":{"text":"Shimei Jerusalem a kipat Gath khuo ah ava haw a, ahing tung kiata chiin Solomon ahilta uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Shimei ahan sah a, akungah Na pawtdoh a, gam danga khuolnahaw ni niin na shi ngeingei ding chiin, “Mangpa min in ka hing kichiem sahin, ka hing thei sah hilou ahiei mah? tualeh nang zong ka kungah, na thu gen ahoi hi, na chi hi."},"43":{"text":"Bangdinga Mangpa kunga na kichiemna leh ka hing thu pieh nitlou na hiei?” achi hi."},"44":{"text":"Lengpa main Shimei kungah, “Ka pa David tunga na lunggil a gitlouna toh na gamtatna zousie na thei sieng hi, tuaziehin Mangpa’n nangma gitlouna maw khu nangma lutung mama ah aum sah ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa Solomon vang guolzawl in um van in, tualeh David leengtoupha khu Mangpa masang ah kumtawn in suhkip in aum ding hi,” achi hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Jehoiada tapa Benaiah thu apie a, ama akuontou a, ava sat pua a, athatta hi. Tuachi’n leenggam khu Solomon khut ah suhkip in aumta hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Solomon in Izipt leengpa Pharaoh toh kizopna abawla, tualeh atanu akitenpi hi. Tuachi’n ama inn leh Mangpa inn alam zou masangsie leh Jerusalem khopi kulpi a im zou masangsie David khopi ah aum sah hi.","title":"Solomon leh Pharaoh kizopna leh atanu toh kitenna"},"2":{"text":"Khum hunlai in mipiten mun sangte ah kithoina abawl zel uhi, khum hun masang a Mangpa min a ding inn akibawl nai tadi lou ziehin."},"3":{"text":"Solomon in Mangpa a it a, apa David tawndan thupiehte azui zel a, mun sangte ah kithoiin gimnamtuite ahal zel chilou ngal."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa, Gibeon khuo ah kithoi dingin akuon a, tua mun khu mun sang poimaw tah ahi a; Solomon in tua maitam tungah halmang sillat tul khat tah alaan hi."},"5":{"text":"Gibeon khuo ah Mangpa zanlai in Solomon kungah amangin ava kihil a; tualeh Pasian in ngen in, “Bang ahiei kang pieh ding?” achi hi.","title":"Solomon in pilna angen (2 Khang. 1.2-13)"},"6":{"text":"Solomon in akungah, “Nangma’n na suoh ka pa David na masangah dihtatna leh muonhuoina toh lungtang kituptah a aum dungzuiin, atungah hepina thupitah Na lang sah ngitnget a, aleeng touna a tou dingin tapa Na pie a, tunia ahing um tah mabangin."},"7":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka Pasian tuin Nangman na suohpa ka pa David taangin leengpa dingin Na hing pangsahta a, hinanleh kei pen naupang neu nou ka hia, thusuh thutou bangma ka thei sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Na suohpa khu Na mitelte, mipi tampi sim senglou, atam zieh a thei seng guolloute lah ah ka um hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin asie apha ka thei thei a, Na mite vai ka hawm theina dingin, Na suohpa asie leh apha khen siem theina lungtang hing pie in, Na mi tamzapite koi in avaihawm pieh thei diei?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Solomon in tam silte anget zieh in, Mangpa akipah sah mama hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in akungah: “Nangma damsawtna ding bang, hausatna ding bang, tualeh na melmate shina ding bang, ngenlou a, tam sil na hing nget a, vaihawm siemna leh theisiemna, na hing nget zawh ziehin;"},"12":{"text":"Ngai in, na nget dung zuiin ka bawlta hi; pilna leh theisiemna lungtang ka hing pie a, tuachi’n nangma masangin nang bang koima a um ngainai sih a, nang nua chiengin zong nangma bang koima ahing um nawn sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachieng leh na nget khahlou hausatna leh mite zatatna zong ka hing piehbe nalai hi; tuachi’n na damsungin nang toh kibang leeng dangte lah ah koima aum sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na pa David in azui mabanga ka thugousiete leh ka thupiehte na pom a, ka lampite na zui leh ka hing damsawt sah nalai ding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon akhanglou a; ngaiin amanglam ana hi a, tualeh Jerusalem ah apei a, Mangpa thuhun bawm masangah adinga, tuachi’n halmang sillat leh lemna sillatte alan a, tualeh asuohte zousie a dingin annkuong alui hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n numei kizua ni leengpa kungah ava pei ua, amasangah ava ding uhi.","title":"Solomon in pilna toh thu akhen hi"},"17":{"text":"Numei khatnu’n akungah, “Aw ka pu, tam numeinu leh kei inn khat a um khawm ka hi ua, tualeh amanu toh inn sunga ka um laiun, keima’n nau ka nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka nau nei zou nithum niin, tam numeinu’n zong nau ahing nei a, tuachi’n ka um khawm ua, tua inn sungah koumagel chilou midang umpi ka nei sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Zanlai in tam numeinu’n ata anet khum khah ziehin ashita hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu zan kimlai in athou a, ka imut lahkal in ka tapa ka panga pat in aladoh a amanu angsungah asiel a, tualeh ama tapa shisa khu ka angsungah ahing siel hi."},"21":{"text":"Zingmawng a nau nawi pe dinga ka thaw leh ama ashisa ana hita hi, hinanleh zingmawng a, ka et chien leh ngaiin ka tapa keima hin pen ana hita sih hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh numei khatpen in, “Ahisih hi, nausen hing pen kei a ahia, ashi pen nangma tapa ahi,” achi a, tualeh khatnupen inlah ashipen nang tapa ahia, ahing pen kei tapa ahi zaw, achia, tuabangin leengpa masang ah agen tuoh uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n “Tam minu’n ahing pen kei tapa hia ashi pen nang tapa ahi, achi a; tualeh akhat pen in lah, Hilou ashi pen nang tapa ahia, ahing pen kei tapa ahi, achi zel hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n “Namsau hing la un” achia, tuachi’n leengpa masangah namsau khat ahing tawi ua."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n “Nau ngeh hing nalai pen tun ni suo unlen, akim khat khatnu pie unlen, tualeh akimkhat ma adang khatnu kungah pie un,” chiin thu apie hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n anau hing zawpen neinu in atapa ait mama ziehin; leengpa kungah, “Pu aw hepitahin nausen hing pen amanu pe zaw mai in,” that vawt sin achia. Hinanleh khatnu pen in, “Kei a lah hisih henlen, nanga zong hi tuom da mai heh,” tumtan zaw in, achita hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n adawnga, “Nausen hing zawpen amanu pie un, that sih un, ama anu ahi,” achita hi."},"28":{"text":"Israel mi zousie’n leengpa thu khenna athutan dan azah tah un leengpa a giingta mama uhi, aziehpen dihtah a thukhenna dingin Pasian akipat pilna ama ah aum chi atheidohta uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Solomon khu Israelte zousie tungah leeng ahi.","title":"Solomon milien sawmle khatte"},"2":{"text":"Tamte amilien neite ahi uhi. Zadok tapa Azariah siempu ahi a."},"3":{"text":"Shisha tapate Elihoreph leh Ahijah laigieltute ahi ua; Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat khu tanchin gielpa ahi."},"4":{"text":"Jehoiada tapa Benaiah khu galkap lamkai lienpen ahia, tualeh Zadok leh Abiathar khu siempute ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Nathan tapa Azariah khu miliente houtu ahia, Nathan tapa Zabud pen khu siempu leh leengpa thu moppa ahi khawm hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahishar khu innsung lam kem lamkai lien ahia, tualeh Abda tapa Adoniram pen, na sem a kiguoite enkoltu lamkai lien ahi."},"7":{"text":"Solomon in Israelte zousie tungah vaihawm lien sawm leh ni anei a, tuaten leengpa leh a innkuonte adingin neh leh taah angaituo zel uhi; mi khat in kum khat in ha khat zel neh leh taah ding angaituo ding ahi.","title":"Vaihawm lien sawm leh nite"},"8":{"text":"Tamte amin uh ahi. Ephraim singtang gam ah Benhur."},"9":{"text":"Ben-Deker in, Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-Shemesh, tualeh Elon Beth-Hanan khuote apuo hi."},"10":{"text":"Ben-Hesed in Aruboth gam a puo a; aman Sokoh leh Hepher gam pumpi zong a puo hi."},"11":{"text":"Ben-Abinadab in Dor gamkai zousie apuo a; aman Solomon tanu Taphath ziin anei hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahilud tapa Bana in Taanak leh Megiddo khuote, Jezreel kho nuoi, Zerethan kho kunga um, Beth-Shean biel zousiete ah, Beth-shean akipat Abel-mehola tan, tualeh Jokneam lelam gal tan dongin apuo hi."},"13":{"text":"Ben-Geber in Ramoth-gilead khopi leh Gilead gam sunga Manasseh tapa Jair khopite atanga, tualeh Bashan gam aum Argob gamkai leh akhopi lien tahtah sawm guh kulbang leh akalna sum-eng zawl neite zong atang khawm hi."},"14":{"text":"Iddo tapa Ahinadab in Mahanaim atang hi."},"15":{"text":"Naphtali gam Ahimaaz in atanga; aman zong Solomon tanu Basemath ziin anei hi."},"16":{"text":"Asher leh Aloth gam Hushai tapa Baanah in atang hi."},"17":{"text":"Issakar gam Paruah tapa Jehoshaphat in atang hi."},"18":{"text":"Benjamin gam Elah tapa Shimei in atang hi."},"19":{"text":"Gilead gam, Amor leengpa Sihon gam, tualeh Bashan leengpa Og gam, Uri tapa Geber in atanga; tualeh ama pen khum gam a, lamkai lien umsun ahi."},"20":{"text":"Judate leh Israelte khu tuipi pieu a, Pieunel bangmai in atam ua, ane un, adawn ua, nuomsa tahin a um uhi.","title":"Solomon nichin a neh leh taah kining chindan"},"21":{"text":"Solomon leenggam pumpi tungah, Euphrates lui akipat in Philistin gam tandongin, tualeh Izipt gamgi tandongin vai ahawm a, tua gamten Solomon dam sungin sie apie ua, ana asem uhi.","ref":"Siem. 15.18; 2 Khang. 9.26"},"22":{"text":"Ni khat sunga Solomon neh leh taah maimai tangbuong nel hoite seu sawm thum leh neh ding miluh sawm guh ahi."},"23":{"text":"Bawngtal vathau sawm, gantatna mun a hampa ne bawngtal sawmni, belam za khat tualeh sakhite, sazuhte, sakhitalte leh aah kiva thaute ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n luigal langkhat gam pumpi tungah Tiphsah apat a, Azzah tandongin lui gal lelam a leengte zousie tungah vai ahawm a, tualeh akimvel a mite zousie toh galmuong in aum chiet uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Solomon dam sung tengin Dan akipat in Beer-Sheba tandongin Judate leh Israelte michin ama uh grep nuoi leh atheipi nuoi chiet uah bit tahin aum chiet uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Solomon in sakolleng kai, sakol tul sawmli leh sakol tungtuong mi tul sawm leh tul ni anei hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 10.26; 2 Khang. 1.14; 9.25"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh tam milienten amauh tan ha sung chiet uah Solomon leh leengpa Solomon dawkan a a annkuong impite zousie neh ding angaituo zel ua, bangma akitasam sah sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Mi chinin amauh panmun dinga kiguot dungzuiin, akoina dinga kiguot mun ah sakolte leh ganta taihatte adingin barli bu leh bupawlte ahing polut zel uhi."},"29":{"text":"Pasian in Solomon pilna leh theisiemna, thupi mama leh lungsim letna tuipi pieu a pieunel bang mai a tam apie hi.","title":"Solomon pilna"},"30":{"text":"Solomon pilna in suolam mite zousie pilna leh Izipt mite pilna zousie akhup hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama mi zousie sangin apil zaw a, Mahol tapate Ezra mi Ethante, Hemante, Kalkolte Dardate sangin zong apil zaw hi, tuachi’n akimvela namte zousie lah ah amin athang suohta hi.","ref":"Late. 89"},"32":{"text":"Aman thupil tul thum agen a, tualeh late tul khat leh nga aphuo hi.","ref":"Thu. 1.1; 10.1; 25.1; Solo 1.1"},"33":{"text":"Sing tanchinte zong, Lebanon taanga sidar sing kungte akipat in kul banga hing poudoh hissop tangthu dongin agen hi. Aman sate leh tungleeng vate tangthu agen a, tualeh bohvah a peite leh ngate tanchin zong agen zel hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon pilna zakha pouma, nam chin a mite leh leitunga leengte zousie akipat mite Solomon pilna ngaikhe dingin ahing kuon uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tai-ar leengpa Hiram in Solomon khu apa David thaheng a leengpa a pang dingin ama sathau anu uh chi azah tahin Solomon kungah mi asawl hi, Hiram khu David na ngaina ngitnget khat ana hi mawng hi.","title":"Solomon biehinn bawl dingin akisa (2 Khang. 2.3-12)"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in Hiram kungah mi asawl a, akung ah;"},"3":{"text":"“Mangpa’n akeng nuoi a amelmate akoi masang sie’n ka pa David in akim avel a, ning chin tenga kidounate ziehin, Mangpa a Pasian min dingin inn alam thei sih chi na thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin vang Mangpa ka Pasian in mun chin tengah galmuonna ahing peta a, tuachi’n melma aum nawn sih a, vangsietna zong aum nawn sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Ngai in, Mangpa’n ka pa David kunga na thaheng a na leengtoupha a ka tousah ding na tapa’n ka min adingin inn alam ding chia ana gentah mabangin, tuin Mangpa ka Pasian min a inn lam ka tum hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.12,13; 1 Khang. 17.11,12"},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin Lebanon taanga Sidar singte ahing sat pieh na dingun thu na pie inlen, ka nasemte leh na nasemte apangkhawm ding ua, na nasemte thaman pha nasah bangbangin ka pena ding hi, aziehpen Sidon mite banga sing sui siem ka lah uah aum sih” chi na thei hi."},"7":{"text":"Hiram in Solomon thu gen azah tahin akipah mama a, “Tam nam thupitah tunga vaihawm ding a, tapa pil tah David pepa Mangpa khu tuni’n phat in umta hen,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hiram in Solomon kungah mi asawl a, “Na hing sil thuhahte ka ngaituota hi, tualeh Sidar sing leh taa singte tungtang thu ah zong na dei bang bangin kana bawl ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka nasemten Lebanon taanga kipat in tuipi dongin ahing tawlsuh ding ua; tualeh akoina dinga na guotna mun tuipi pieu a tawl suh dingin ka gah khawm dinga, pum in ka hing tawl suh dinga tua mun ah ka ngakhesah dinga, tuachi’n nana la ding hi, tualeh nang zong ka innkuonpite neh leh taah nana tuoh dinga, kadei na hing buchin sah ding hiven,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hiram in Sidar sing leh taa singte Solomon in adei zaza apie hi."},"11":{"text":"Solomon in Hiram kungah a innkuonte neh dingin bu seu tul sawmni leh sathau siengthou chin sawmni apie hi. Hichibangin kum chinin Solomon in Hiram ape zel hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n achiemsa mabangin Solomon pilna apie a, tuachi’n Hiram leh Solomon kikaal ah kilemna aum a, tuachi’n ani un kizopna thuhun abawl uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Solomon in Israel mi zousie lah ah na sem mi ki guoi teitei pawl abawldoh a, tua banga akiguoi teitei na sem pawl mi tul sawm thum apha uhi.","title":"Biehinn bawl dinga nasemte"},"14":{"text":"Lebanon taangah ha khat in mi tul sawm asawldoh a, Lebanon ah ha khat ava um ua, inn lam ah hani a um zel ua, akihengzel uhi. Adoniram khu tam banga kiguoi teitei nasemte lamkai ahi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 12.18"},"15":{"text":"Solomon in van gih puo mi tul sawm sagi leh suong kheng mi tul sawm giet sing tang gamte ah anei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuate simlou in Solomon in nasem mite tunga enkai ding mawngmawng in lamkai mi tul thum leh zathum anei hi."},"17":{"text":"Lengpa thupieh bangin inn suongphum ding suong khensa lep dingin suong lien pipi leh suong mantam tahtah ahing puo uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon innlam mite leh Hiram innlam mite tualeh Gebal mi suong khen siemten, suongte akheng ua, a inn lamna dingun sing leh suongte abawl uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, Israel tate Izipt gam a kipata ahing pawtdoh nua uh, kum zali leh kum sawm gietna, tualeh Israelte tunga Solomon leengpa a apan zou kum lina, hani na Ziv hain Mangpa inn bawl apan hi.","title":"Solomon in biehinn alampatna (2 Khang. 3.1-14)"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa inn dinga leengpa Solomon in abawl inn khu asaulam tong sawm guh availam let dan tong sawmni ahia, tualeh asan lam tong sawm thum ahi.","title":"Biehinn let dan leh van kizangte"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh khum inn, amun siengthou mailam a inn him khu, a inn vailam tantan tong sawmni a sau ahia, tualeh amailam a pen, vailam tong sawm ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh inn adingin kottate vathangkal neu nounou nei in abawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Inn baang kimkot leh biehinn baang kimkot in, tualeh mun siengthou leh mun siengthou sungta zaw kimkot in pindan abawl a, tualeh akimvel in chiel adaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Chiel nuoi nung pen tong nga in alien a, alaita pen tong guhin alien a, tualeh athumna pen tong sagi a lien ahi, tualeh akalvaite khu inn baanga gollut ngaise louin, apulam baangah akingahna akibawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Biehinn kibawllai in asuongte khu akilahna mun a khen tuohsa diem a kibawl ahia, tuachi’n abawl sungun seh ginte leh hei ginte, tualeh sia vanzah gin mawngmawng tua biehinn kibawl kim ah akiza sih hi."},"8":{"text":"A pindan laita pen lutna kot khu a inn zietlam pangah a um a, tualeh adan laita pen kaltouna kellei kivielin akal tou a, tualeh alaita akipat in athumna ah akaltou hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Biehinn ahing lam a, azouta hi. Tua inn khu Sidar sing zawl leh singpehte in akhu hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh innpi toh kizopin pindante abawla, tua pindan khat khu tongnga in asang chiet a, tuate khu Sidar sing zawlte a Biehinnpi toh zop ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu Solomon kungah ahing tung hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tam inn na lam laitah tungtang thu ah, ka tawndan thu guotte na nit a, ka vaihawmna dante na zui a, ka thupiehte zousie zui dinga na zop leh, na pa David kunga ka gensa, ka thu na tungah ka subuching ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel tate lah ah ka teng dinga, tualeh ka mi Israelte ka nuasie sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in tua Biehinn alama, azouta hi."},"15":{"text":"Biehinn sunglam baang dingin Sidar singpeh azang a, atuong leh abichiing nuoi dal dingin zong Sidar singma akhen hi, tualeh atuong dingin taa sing peh apha hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Biehinn sia lang tong sawmni a lienpen zong atuong leh abaangte Sidar sing peh in abawla, mun siengthou leh mun siengthou pen a dingin zong a sunglam ah azang hi.","ref":"Pawt. 26.33,34"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Biehinn, munsiengthou khu tong sawmli a sau ahi."},"18":{"text":"Biehinn sung lam a pape mum leh pape pahpal bang lim a kikhengte a un in Sidar sing ngen a kibawl ahia, suong mawngmawng akimu sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasian thuhun bawm koina dingin zong tua Biehinn sungta pen langah mun siengthou pen kichi khat zong abawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua Biehinn sung tawng pen khu tong sawmni in asau a, availam zong tong sawmni ma ahia, tong sawmni in asanga, inndan sung pumpi sana siengthou ngen in aluon khum hi, tualeh Sidar sing akibawl maitam zong sana a luonkhum ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in Biehinn sung khu sana siengthou in aluonkhum a, tualeh mun siengthou tawngpen mailang ah sana khainieng in dantanna abawl a, tua khu sana tuiin aluonkhum hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Biehinn azaw sieng masangsie’n mun siengthou sunglam zousie sana tui aluon khum a, tualeh mun siengthou pen maitam zong sana tui aluon khum hi.","ref":"Pawt. 30.1-3"},"23":{"text":"Mun siengthou pen sungah Olive singin tong sawm tuoh a sang, Cherubim ni abawl a.","ref":"Pawt. 25.18-20"},"24":{"text":"Cherub khat ha langkhat tong nga a, sau ahia, tualeh aha langkhat pen zong tong nga ma a sau ahi. Tua Cherub ha mong lang khat akipat lang khat lam ha mong tan, tong sawm ahi."},"25":{"text":"Cherubim khat pen zong tong sawm ma ahia, tua Cherubim tegel alet aneu akibang ahia, tualeh apien dan gel zong thakhat ahi."},"26":{"text":"Cherub tegel sandan tong sawm tuoh ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Cherubim tegel khu pindan sungta zaw ah akoi a, Cherubim tegel in aha uh azah tuoh ua, Cherubim khat ha in baang lang khat asukha a, tualeh Cherubim dang khat pen ha in zong alelam baang asukha hi. Tualeh pindan laikim tah ah aha u’leh aha uh akisutuo hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua Cherubimte zong sana tui aluonkhum a hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Biehinn baang zousie leh munsiengthou baang zousie asunglam leh a pulam zong, cherubim limte leh tum singte tualeh pape pahlai limte gielin azem hi."},"30":{"text":"Biehinn sung leh apulam tuongtung leh mun siengthou tuongtung zong sana tui in aluonkhum hi."},"31":{"text":"Mun siengthou lutna ding kotkhate Olive singin abawl a, akotpi tung leh akotpi biengte, abaang senga suo sekhat ahi."},"32":{"text":"Kotpi nite gel zong Olive singa kibawl ahia, tualeh atungah Cherub lim bang, pape pahpal lim bang giel in sanatui aluon khum a, tualeh Cherub leh tum sing limte sana tuiin aluon khum hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n mun siengthou kotkhah dingin zong Olive sing khuom ningli neiin abawl hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua kotpi nite khu taa singa kibawl ahia, kotkha khat a singpeh ni akihip thei a kibawl ahia, tualeh akot dangkhat peh ni zong akihip thei ma ahi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh atungah Cherubte, tumsingte tualeh pape pahpal limte agiela, tualeh tuabanga kilawm tah a, kizemte khu sana tui in aluon khum hi."},"36":{"text":"Biehinn huongsung leituol sungta zawpen khu suong kikhengsa guolthum leh sidar sing peh thuo khat in abawl hi."},"37":{"text":"Akum li na Ziv hain Mangpa inn suongphum lep pat ahia;"},"38":{"text":"Tualeh akum sawm leh khatna aha gietna Bul hain, bawl ding bangbangin bangma zousie mansa sienga ahita hi. Tuachi’n kum sagi alam hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh Solomon in ama inn ding kum sawm leh kum thum sung alam a, tuachi’n ama inn ding alam zou siengta hi.","title":"Solomon inn ding kilamna"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in Lebanon gammang ah sing inn khat zong ana lam hi, adung tong za khat ahia, avai tong sawm nga ahi, tualeh tong sawm thum a sang ahi. Sidar sing khuom guol li a kiphut atunga sidar sing innkam kikhang tunga bawl ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tua khu khuom sawm li leh nga tunga kikhang innkam tunga Sidar singpeh kipha khum ahia, aguol khatna ah singpeh sawm leh nga ahi."},"4":{"text":"Abaang lang khat tuoh ah kimaingat chietin kotta guol thum a um hi."},"5":{"text":"A kotpite leh kotpi khuom zousie ning li nei a kibawl chiet ahia, tualeh kottate guol thum in akimaingat tuo chiet uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aman khuom lienpi ngen kiphut kikhopna inn khat zong abawl a, asau lam tong sawm nga ahia, availam tong sawm thum ahi. A innhim khu khuom te mailam ah aum a, amaidoh khuna nei zong aum hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n avaihawm na ding leh athu khenna ding Mangtoupha umna dingin inn lienpi abawl a, tua khu atuong alang khat apat alelam tan Sidar singpeh kipha ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh ama tenna inn in, a innhim sungah huong khat anei a, tua zong khuchimabanga bawl ahi. Solomon in azi Pharaoh tanu adingin zong tuabang innhim khat abawl pieh hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 3.1"},"9":{"text":"Tamte zousie suong mantam pipi, akituoh hun giap chiet akikheng, aki at thaw suong, tualeh akisuithaw suong ngen a kilam ahia, apulam zong asuong phum akipat among tandongin, tuabang in a pulam huong lienpi tandong akibawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh asuong phum khu, suong mantam tahtah leh suong lienpipi, tong sawm bang tong giet bang a lep khawm ahi."},"11":{"text":"Atung lam ah suong mantam tahtah, akituoh chitchet a kikheng suong leh Sidar singte ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh akimkot in ahuong sung inntuol khu suong guol thum leh Sidar singpeh thuokhat a ki im ahi. Mangpa innhuong sungta zaw leh a innhim mabangin."},"13":{"text":"Lengpa Solomon in mi asawl a, Tai-ar khuo akipat in Hiram ava puisah hi.","title":"Biehinn van zahte (2 Khang. 3.15—5.1)"},"14":{"text":"Amapa khu Naphtali phung sunga meithainu tapa khat ana hi a, apa khu Tai-ar gam sunga sum-eng khen siem ahi. Hiram khu sum-eng bawllam ah theisiemna, pilna tualeh khut siemna nei vawt mi khat ahi. Ama leengpa Solomon kungah ahing pei a, akunga sep dinga kipie nna zousie asem hi."},"15":{"text":"Aman tong sawm leh tong giet a sang sum-eng khuom ni aphut a, akhuom pum letdan zong tong sawm le ni tuoh tuoh ahi."},"16":{"text":"Khuom dawn a taa ding sum-eng sunbaw ni abawla, abaw khat sanlam tong nga ahia, akhat pen san dan zong tong nga ma ahi."},"17":{"text":"Khuom dawna abawte gel zepna dingin sum-eng pape guilien kiham bangin agiel a, bawkhat ah sagi a um a, tualeh khat pen ah zong sagi ma a um hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n khuomte abawla, tua khuom lubawte tuomna dingin kawlbuthei lim kigiel khat tungah akimvel in guol ni a um a, tua mabangin khat tung ah zong a um hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh innhim khuom dawn a abawte ah tong li tuoh in lilipah lim aum hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua khuom nite dawn a abawte ah, apawl biil biel gei ah kawlbuthei banga kikhengte a um hi, tualeh tua abawte ah kawlbuthei zani tuoh tuoh a um hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua khuomte khu Biehinn innhim ah aphut a, a zietlam khuom aphut a, amin dingin Jakin ahisah a, tualeh aveilam khuom zong aphut kia a, amin dingin Boaz achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua khuomte dawn vum ah lili pape liente atuonga tuachi’n khumte bawl zou ahita hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman tuikuong lienpi khat sum-eng kisungin abawl a, agei lang khat apat, langkhat tan tong sawm ahi. Tuikuong khu abem ahia asan dan tong nga ahi.","title":"Sum-eng tuikuong"},"24":{"text":"Agei nuoi ah pa mum lim in akimkot a, tong sawm ahia, tuikuong kimkot in a um a, tualeh pa mum limte khu, akisun lai in guolni a kisung pai ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tua tuikuongpi khu sum-eng a kibawl bawngtal sawm leh ni tungah a kikoi a; bawngtal lim thum in mallam anga a, thum in tumlam anga a, thumin simlam anga a, thumma in suolam anga hi; Tualeh atuikuong khu ama uh tungah akinga a, innsung lam anua ngat chiet uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuikuong gei khu khutpeh chia a sa ahia; agei zong nou gei bang ahi, agei ah lili pah lim atuonga. Tui tena bath tul ni dawl ahi."},"27":{"text":"Hiram in khuomte tunna ding sum-eng khuom tunna sawm a siem a, tuami khuom tunnate tong li chiet a sau ahia, alet dan zong tong li chiet ma ahi, tualeh asan dan tong thum ahi."},"28":{"text":"Khuom tunna zousie kisiemdan pen tambang ahi, akuoh ning li nei a bawl ahia, tua akuohte khu agei kikaal ah aum hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh agei kikaal a kuohte ah, humpibahnei limte, bawngtal limte tualeh cherub limte bang aum hi; Tualeh agei tungah khuom tunna a um a, tualeh anuoi lam ah humpibahnei limte, bawngtal limte, nuoiah akilawmna dinga kibawlte a um diudeu uhi."},"30":{"text":"Khuom tunna khat chietin sum-eng kari keng li chiet leh sum-eng zawl li chietma anei hi. Aning li zousie ah atunna ding akiphut chiet a, tualeh kisilna bel nuoi lam ah atunna a um a, tua atunna sih chiet ah azepna a um chiet hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh bel gong kuol sunglam gei khu tong khat a lien ahia, agong gei khu akuola bem ahia, tong khat leh alanga lien ahi, akuohte khu abem sih a, ning li nei ahi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh akuohte nuoi langah bawnglengte a um a, tualeh a bawnglengte tunga innte khu, khuom tunna toh akizop a, tualeh bawnglengte san dan khu tongkhat leh alang ahi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh tua bawngleng kengte kibawl dan khu sakolleng keng toh kibang ahi, atung sinte abelvielte akikaal a sia kiphante leh alaibawte akisunthaw ngen ahi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh khuom tunna khat ning li chiet ah, akingahna li chiet ma aum a, tua akingahna khuom tunna toh pumkhat chiet ahi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh akhuom tunna tungah abem a kiviel in tong kimkhat a sang a um hi, khuom tunna tunga akeng kuohte zong pumkhat ahi uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh atunna kuongdaite leh akuohte ah azah bang bangun Cherubte humpibahneite, tum singte a tuong sah a, akimkot in azem dim diem hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuabangin atunna sawmte abawla, a bawn in pum khat a sun ahi chiet a, bawldan kibang chiet ahi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n sum-eng kisilna kuong sawm abawl a, kisilna kuong khat in tui bath sawm li adawla, tualeh kisilna kuongte khu tong li chiet ahi ua, tualeh khuom tunnate tung chiet ah kisilna kuong khat akitung chiet hi.","ref":"Pawt. 30.17-21"},"39":{"text":"Tualeh a inn zietlam pangah khuom tunna nga atunga, tualeh zietlam pangah khuom tunna nga ma atunga, tualeh tuibel khu inn zietlam pangah suolam ah simlam nga in atung hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hiram in kisilna kuongte, vut luohnate maiphiet kuongte abawl a, tuachi’n Hiram in Mangpa inn dinga, Solomon abawl pieh zousie azou siengta hi."},"41":{"text":"Khuom ni tegel dawn a bel banga abaw nite tuomna dinga len kiphan banga pawl bimbemte."},"42":{"text":"Tua len banga kiphan pawl bimbem tuomna dinga kawlbuthei za lite, khuom dawna bel banga baw nite tuomna dinga pawl bimbem tuoh kawlbuthei guol nite."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh khuom tunna sawmte leh khuom tunna tunga, tuikuong sawmte bang;"},"44":{"text":"Tualeh tuikuong khat leh tuikuong nuoia bawngtal sawm leh nite bang;"},"45":{"text":"Belte vut luohte leh maiphiet kuongte, tualeh Mangpa inn a dinga, leengpa Solomon in Hiram anawt valsah sitset sum-eng um leh bel zousie;"},"46":{"text":"Jordan phaijanga Sukoth leh Jaretan kikaal a, bellei ki khenna mun ah ahi, leengpa’n asun."},"47":{"text":"Solomon in um leh belte atam sengseng zieh in buh ngaise louin a um sah a, sum-eng te zong bang za a gih ahiei chi, theidoh butlou in aumta hi."},"48":{"text":"Solomon in Mangpa inn a um leh bel zousie abawl a, tualeh sana maitam tanghou siengthou koina ding zong abawl hi.","ref":"Pawt. 30.1-3; Pawt. 25.23-30"},"49":{"text":"Tualeh mun siengthou sungta pen mai ah thaumei koinate zietlam ah nga, veilam ah nga, sana siengset in abawl a, papete, thaumeite, taitete zong sana in abawl hi.","ref":"Pawt. 25.31-40"},"50":{"text":"Noute, thaumei puontenate, maiphiet kuongte, tawkeute, gimtui halna bawmte, khu sana siengset a bawl ahia; Munsiengthou pen kotte leh biehinn kotte leh akhainate sana sieng set a kibawl ahi."},"51":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in Mangpa inn ding abawl zousie azouta a, tualeh apa David in ana latsa silte Solomon in ala lut a, dangkate leh um leh belte Mangpa inn a gou koinate ah akoi hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 8.11; 1 Khang. 18.11"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in Israel upate zousie, nam lah a lamkai zousie tualeh Israelte lah a phung lamkai zousie David khopi Zion akipat Mangpa thuhun bawm potou dingin Jerusalem a leengpa Solomon kungah ahankhawm a.","title":"Pasian bawm lah lutna (2 Khang. 5.2-12)","ref":"2 Sam. 6.12-16; 1 Khang. 15.25-29"},"2":{"text":"Israel mi zousie leengpa Solomon kungah Ethanim ha, aha sagina ann kuong luina ah ahing kikhawmta uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 23.34"},"3":{"text":"Israel upate zousie ahing tun tah un, siemputen, thuhun bawm azawng uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amauten Mangpa thuhun bawm leh kimutuona puon buh, tualeh, biehbuh sunga tuiumbelsuon siengthou zousie apotou ua, siempute leh Leviten azawng uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Solomon leh akung a Israel hing kikhawmte zousie Pasian bawm masangah a um khawm ua, belamte, bawngtalte atam seng zieh a sim senglou leh aphaza thei zaw lou in akithoi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n siemputen Mangpa thuhun bawm khu a umna ding mun Biehinn mun siengthou sungta zaw, mun siengthou pen a, Cherubimte ha nuoi ah akoi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Cherubimten thuhun bawm umna tung aha un azah khum ua, tualeh Cherubimten thuhun bawm leh atunga azawnna chieng zawlte aha un a lie khum uhi."},"8":{"text":"Azawnna chieng zawlte asau a, azawnna chieng zawl mongte, mun siengthou sungtazaw mai a, mun siengthou akipat in akimuthei a, hinanleh inn pulam akipat akimu sih hi; tualeh tuni tanin khunah aum denta hi."},"9":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipat a ahing pawtdoh lai ua, Israel tate kunga, Mangpa’n thuhun abawl lai a, Mosi in Horeb muol a, suongpeh ni akoite loungal, tua bawm sungah bangma dang a um sih hi.","ref":"Danp. 10.5"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, Siempute mun siengthou a kipat a ahing pawtdoh tah un, Mangpa inn meilum in ahing tuom dim khiang khuongta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 40.34,35"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n meilum ziehin siemputen anasep uh asunzom theita sih uhi. Mangpa thupina in, Mangpa inn aluodim tah zieh in."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in thu agen a: “Mangpa’n meilum miel lah ah, ka um ding ana chita mawnga.","title":"Solomon thugen (2 Khang. 6.1-11)","ref":"Late. 18.11; 97.2"},"13":{"text":"Keima’n na tenna dingin, kumtawn a Na tenna ding in, Inn ka hing lam pieh hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa akinuahei a, Israel kikhawmte zousie aguolzawl a, tuachi’n Israel kikhawmpite zousie a ding demdum uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Mangpa Israelte Pasian pahtawi in umta hen; Aman ka pa David kungah Ama kam mama in agen, tualeh Ama khut mama in atangtung sahta hi."},"16":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipat a ka mi Israelte ka puidoh ni a kipat in, ka min umna ding inn bawl dingin Israel nam pumpi khuote lah ah khat zong ka na tel kha sih a; hinanleh David pen ka mi Israelte tunga vaihawm dingin kana tel hi, achi hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.4-11; 1 Khang. 17.3-10"},"17":{"text":"Ka pa David in Mangpa Israelte Pasian min a inn khat lam ding alungsim in ana tum zel hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.1-3; 1 Khang. 17.1,2"},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n ka pa David kungah, ka min a inn khat bawl ding chia na lungsim a na atup khu, tambang lungsim na puoh zieh in ahoi hi."},"19":{"text":"Bangtenghileh nangman inn nalam sih dinga, na khaal akipata hing pieng na tapa in ka min a ding in inn alam zaw ding hi, achi hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.12,13; 1 Khang. 17.11,12"},"20":{"text":"Mangpa’n ana thu gensa khu a sutangtungta a, Mangpa’n thu ana chiemsa mabangin, ka pa David mun ka luo a, Israel leengtoupha ah ka hing touta hi, tualeh Israelte Mangpa Pasian min dingin inn khat kana lamta hi."},"21":{"text":"Khunah, Izipt gam a kipata, Apuidoh lai a, ipu ipa te kunga Ana hun Mangpa thuhun umna bawm koina dingin mun khat ka guotta hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon khu, Israel kikhawmte zousie masanga, maitam mai ah adinga, tualeh van lam ngain akhut azah a;","title":"Solomon biehinn latna thumna (2 Khang. 6.12-39)"},"23":{"text":"“Aw Mangpa Israelte Pasian, na suohte alungtang zousie ua, na masanga nasemte kunga Na thuhun sutangtunga itna langsah zel, Nangma bang Pasian dang vantung leh leitungah koima aum sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Nangman na suoh ka pa David kunga, na chiemsate Na sukipa, Na kam in thu na gen a, Na khut mama in Na sutangtungta hi, tuni a aum tahma bangin."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin Israelte Mangpa Pasian aw, Na suoh ka pa David kunga, Israelte leengtoupha tunga ka mitmu a, touding mi akiphasam sih ding, tualeh ka masanga na gamtat mabanga, na hahlesuonte a umdan ua apilvang pou u’leh, chia Nana thuchiem khu sukip in.","ref":"1 Leeng. 2.4"},"26":{"text":"Aw Israelte Pasian, Na suoh ka pa David kunga na thu gen khu tuin hing sutangtung in, chiin ka hing ngen hi."},"27":{"text":"“Hinanleh Pasian khu lei tungah ateng tahtah na diei mah izaw? Ngai in van leh vante vanah zong tazoulou na hia, tuachi’n tam ka inn lam ah tatzou tuoh sih na va-ia chie maw?","ref":"2 Khang. 2.6"},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa ka Pasian tunia Na suohin kikou a athumna leh thungette hing sang inlen, Na suohpa thumna leh ngetna hing ngaikhieh pieh in."},"29":{"text":"Na mit in sun leh zan in tami biehinn lam en ngitnget henlen, ka min khunah a um ding Na china mun lam nga a, Na suoh thungetna Na ngai pieh theina dingin.","ref":"Danp. 12.11"},"30":{"text":"Na suohpa leh Na mi Israelten tam mun lam nga a, thu anget chiengun, angetnate uh Na umna vantung akipat Na ngaikhieh pieh inlen; Na zah chiengin ngaidam in."},"31":{"text":"“Mi koi ahiei in a innvengte tungah sil bawlkhiel in, kichiem sah hiel ahing kiphatmaw tahleh tam bieh inn a, Na maitam masangah hing kichiem henlen;"},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nangman vantung akipat Na ngaikhie inlen, mi khielpa khu akhelna bangin ama lutung ah tusah inlen, mawpai in, tualeh midihtat khu adihtatna dungzuiin siemtangsah inlen, Na suohte vaihawm pieh in."},"33":{"text":"“Na mi Israelten Na tunga sil abawlkhiel zieh ua, agalte uh masanga aguollel chieng ua, Nangma lam a ahing kihei ua, Na mina akhelna uh akiphuonkhieh ua, Na kunga thu ahing nget chiengun;"},"34":{"text":"Nang vantunga kipat in Na ngaikhiet pieh inlen, Na mi Israelte khelna ngaidam inlen, apu a pate uh kunga gam Na piehna mun ah puilut kia in."},"35":{"text":"“Akhelna zieh ua, van akikha a, guo azuhlou chienga, tami mun lam nga a, athum ua, Na min aphat ua, Na suhgentheinate zieha akhelnate uh alengatsan ua akisia u’leh;"},"36":{"text":"Nang van akipat Na ngaikhie inlen, Na suohte leh Na mi Israelte khelna ngaidam inlen, apeina ding uh lampi hoi kawhmu inlen, agoutan ding ua Na piehna gam ah guo zusahin."},"37":{"text":"“Gam sunga kiel ahing tun a, natna hii ahing len a, gawna leh muotna ahing uma, khaukhup ahiei, lung ahiei ahing um a, amelmate un akhopite uh ahing im kimkot ua, bangchibang hii ahiei, natna ahiei ahing um hun chiengin;"},"38":{"text":"Na mi Israelte lah a koi ahiei in, alungtanga thuoh gimna nei a akithei a, tam Na biehinn lam nga a, banzah a, thumna leh thungetna anei chiengin;"},"39":{"text":"Na umna van akipat in Na ngaikhie inlen, ngaidam inlen, pan piin, Nang michin lungtang theipa’n aumdan uh dungzui in thuhin; Nangma bou in mihing lungtang na thei hi."},"40":{"text":"Ka pu leh pate uh kunga na pieh na gam a aten sung sie ua, amaute’n nang giin dan ahing theisiemna ding un."},"41":{"text":"“Tuathamlouin na mi Israelte hilou gamdang mi, na min zieh a, gamla pia kipata hing peite tungtang thu zong;"},"42":{"text":"(Na min thupitah leh na khut hattahte tualeh na ban na zah thute miten ana zah ua) tuaten tami Biehinn lam nga a, ahing thum chieng un;"},"43":{"text":"Na umna van akipat in Na ngaikhie inlen, tualeh gamdang miten ahing nget zousie uh Na bawlpieh in, Na mi Israelte mabanga leitunga namchin in Na min athei ua, ahing giinna ding un, tualeh tam ka inn lam Nangma min puo ahi chi a theina dingun."},"44":{"text":"“Na mite amelmate uh dou dinga, Na sawlna lam lam a akuon chieng un, Na tel khopi lam nga a, tualeh Namin dinga ka biehinn lam, lang nga a, Mangpa kunga athum chieng un;"},"45":{"text":"Athumna u’leh ngetna uh, nangman van akipat na ngaikhie inlen, amauh guolzawna pie in."},"46":{"text":"“Na tunga sil abawlkhiel u’leh (koima khiellou aum ngal sih a) atung ua na lungthah a, agalte uh kunga na piehkhieh chiengin, agamla leh anai hitaleh, melma gam a sal a apuimang chiengun;"},"47":{"text":"Tualeh sal a puimanga a umna gam ua, ahing kingaituo doh ua, kana khielta ua, dihloutah leh giloutah in ka bawlkhata uhi chia, Na kunga thu ahing nget chieng un;"},"48":{"text":"Amelma ama uh sal a puite gam a, alungtang zousie u’leh ahinna hagau zousie ua, Nangma lam ahing ngat kia ua, apu apate uh na pieh gam lam leh Na khopi tel leh Na min dinga ka biehinn bawl lam nga a, Na kunga thu ahing nget chiengun;"},"49":{"text":"Athumna u’leh angetna uh Nang, Na umna van akipat Na ngaikhie inlen, angette uh na bawl pieh in."},"50":{"text":"Tualeh Na miten Na tunga atatkhelna u’leh Na tunga ana gitloutatna zousiete uh ngaidam inlen, ama uh ana hepi theina dingun ama uh sal a puite masang ah lainatna neisah in."},"51":{"text":"Aziehpen amauh Na mite Na goutan, Izipt gam akipat leh haltuina mei sunga kipata Na puidohte ahi uhi."},"52":{"text":"Ahing hat pouma chieng ua Nana ngaikhiehna dingin Na suoh thungetna leh na mi Israelte thungetna lam Na mit in hing en in."},"53":{"text":"Aw Mangpa Pasian Izipt gam a kipata ka pu leh pate uh nana pui lai a, Na suoh Mosi zanga nana gen mabangin na goutan dingin leitung nam zousie lah a kipat a na khentuom sa ahita hi,” achi hi."},"54":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahia, Solomon in Mangpa kunga thumna leh thungetna zousie agen zou tah in Mangpa maitam mai a van lam a banzah a akhup dinna mun akipat in adingdoh a.","title":"Athunget zou a Solomon guolzawlna"},"55":{"text":"Tuachi’n adingden a, Aw ngai tahin, Israel mipi kikhawmte zousie aguolzawl a;"},"56":{"text":"“Athuchiem zousie dungzui a ami Israelte khawlna pepa Mangpa pahtawi in um hen; asuoh Mosi zanga, a thuchiem hoi zousie thumal khat zong apelhem a um sih hi, achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 12.10; Josh. 21.44,45"},"57":{"text":"Mangpa i Pasian i pu leh pate kunga ana um mabangin ilah uah zong umta hen, hing nuasie sih henlen, hing taisan sam sih heh;"},"58":{"text":"Alampi zousie zui ding leh ipu leh pate ana piehsa mabanga, athupiehte, athugousiete, avaihawm dante, nit thei dingin ilungtang Ama lam ngasahta hen."},"59":{"text":"Asuohpa tungtang thu ah, tualeh Ami Israelte tung thu ah, nisim a apoimaw dung zui a, agamtat theina dingin tam ka thu gen, Mangpa masanga thungetna ka tutte, asun azanin Mangpa i Pasian masang ah um ngitngetta hen."},"60":{"text":"Mangpa khu Pasian ahi a, adang koima aum sih hi, chi leitunga namchin in athei theina ding un."},"61":{"text":"Tuachi’n athuguot banga um ding leh athupiehte zui dingin Mangpa i Pasian lam ah na lungtangte uh hoi bukim hen, tunia mabangin.”"},"62":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa leh akunga um Israelte zousie in Mangpa masangah kithoina alan uhi.","title":"Kithoina leh kipahna (2 Khang. 7.4-10)"},"63":{"text":"Tualeh Solomon in, Mangpa kunga alat kilemna sillat, kithoina dingin bawngtal tul sawm leh tul ni leh belam tul za khat leh tul sawmni; alan hi. Tuabangin leengpa leh Israelte zousie in Mangpa inn alanta uhi."},"64":{"text":"Khum ni mama in leengpa’n Mangpa inn mai a um leituol huong laita a susiengthou a, khunah aman halmang sillatte, ann sillatte, tualeh lemna sillat sathau alan hi, aziehpen Mangpa mai a um tua sum-eng maitam khu, halmang sillatte, ann sillatte, tualeh kilemna sillatte sathau latna dingin aneu seng taluo hi."},"65":{"text":"Tuachi’n khumi tungin Solomon leh Israelte zousie, mipi tampi kikhawmte khu, Hamath lutna akipat a Izipt gamgi lui tandonga miten Mangpa i Pasian masangah ni sagi leh ni sagi dang, ni sawm leh nili sung pawi abawl uhi."},"66":{"text":"Ani giet ni in mipite akikhen sah a, tualeh amaun leengpa aguolzawl ua, tualeh Mangpa’n asuoh David leh ami Israelte tunga khuchi lawm lawm a alatsah ziehin lungsim kipah mama in a inn lam chiet uah apeita uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, Solomon in Mangpa inn leh leengpa inn, alung tup banga alam zou sieng bepin;","title":"Pasian Solomon kunga nivei kilahna (2 Khang. 7.11-22)"},"2":{"text":"Gibeon khuo a akunga akilah bangin, Mangpa Solomon kungah aniveina in ahing kilah kia hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 3.5; 2 Khang. 1.7"},"3":{"text":"Mangpa’n akungah, “Ka masanga na thumna leh na thunget Ka kunga na hing tutte Ka za a, kumtawn a Ka min umna dinga na bawl tam inn ka susiengthouta hi; tualeh Ka mit leh Ka lungsim khum mun ah a um ngitnget ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh nang zong Ka hing thupieh pouma dungzui a, bawl dinga, na pa David mabanga lungtang dih leh kitup taha, Ka masanga na um a, Ka thugousiete leh Ka vaihawm dante na zui leh;"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n na pa David kunga Israelte leengtoupha tunga tou ding mi na kiphasam sih ding chia, Kana kichiem mabangin; Israelte tunga na gam leengtoupha Ka sukip ding hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 2.4"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh nangma na hiei, nahah nasuonte ahiei in, na hing zuina ua kipata, na hing kinua heisan ua, Ka thupiehte leh Ka dan thute na zui sih ua, pasien dangte zui dinga na piel ua, ana nasep ua, na bieh u’leh;"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh ka piehsa tam gam akipat Israelte Ka sumang dinga, tualeh ka min umna dinga ka suhsiengthou tami biehinn zong Ka mitmu akipat Ka paimang dinga, tuachi’n Israelte khu namchin lah ah paunah leh aselama gentena leh enghouna in apang ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tami biehinn tuin thupi nanleh; a apkai bep dinga, akunga peikha pouma in lamdang asa ding ua, achiza sengin achiukawh ding ua, tualeh bangchidan a tam gam leh biehinnpi Mangpa’n hichitalawma abawl adiei? achi ding uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.9; 2 Khang. 36.19"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n miten Izipt gam a kipata apulepate uh puidohpa Mangpa a Pasian uh ataisan ua, pasien dangte abelsan ua, abie ua, ana uh asep zieh uh ahi. Tuazieh a Mangpa’n tam sil hoilou zousie atung ua atunsah ahi,” chi’n adawng ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, Solomon in inn nite, Mangpa biehinn leh leengpa inn abawl sung kum sawmni abei nua in;","title":"Solomon nasep dangte. (2 Khang. 8.1 , 12)"},"11":{"text":"(Tai-ar leengpa Hiram in Sidar singte taasingte, sanate, adei zousie apieh ahi a), tuachi’n leengpa Solomon in Hiram kungah Galili gam a khuo sawmni apie hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hiram khu Tai-ar khuo akipat in Solomon in akho piehte en dingin ahing pei a, hinanleh adei lam ahi tasih hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n akungah, “Ka unaupa na hing kho piehte bangchibang khuote ahiei?” achi hi. Tuaziehin tuate khu Kabul gam akichi denta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hiram in leengpa sana talent za leh sawmni ahah hi."},"15":{"text":"Lengpa Solomon in nasem dinga goi teitei pawl abawlna ziehpen tami ahi. Mangpa biehinn leh ama inn lam ding leh Millo leh Jerusalem kulpite leh Hazor khuo, Megiddo khuo leh Gezer khuote bawl dingin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Izipt leengpa Pharaoh akuontou a, Gezer khuo ava la a, mei in ahaltum a, tualeh khum khopi a teng Kanaan mite athat a, tualeh atanu Solomon zi kungah vanken silpieh in ana pezouta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Solomon in Gezer khuo abawla, Beth Horon nuoita zaw khuote,"},"18":{"text":"Balath khuo leh Juda gamdai a Tadmor khuote,"},"19":{"text":"tualeh Solomon neitah koina, khuote zousie a sakolleng koina khuote, sakol tungtuong mite, Jerusalem, Lebanon leh agam pumpi sunga Solomon in bawl atupte zousie abawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate hilou, Amormite, Hitmite Perezmite, Hivmite leh Jebusmite aum nalai namte zousie."},"21":{"text":"Ahah asuonte uh khum gam a um nalai, Israelten asuhmang zou sieng theiloute uh lah a, Solomon in suoh nasem dinga goi teitei pawl abawla tuni tan in."},"22":{"text":"Israel tate pen Solomon in suoh nasem teitei pawl in abawl sih a, aziehpen amaute, galkap mite innsung vaisaite, miliente, galkap lamkaite, asakolleng leh sakol tungtuong pawl lamkaite in apang zaw uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuate khu Solomon nasepna tunga lamkai lien pente ahi ua, tualeh zanga leh sawm ngate khu nasemte vengmite ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Pharaoh tanu khu David khopi akipat in Solomon in amanu inn dinga alam pieh langah apeitou a, tuachi’n Millo abawlta hi."},"25":{"text":"Solomon in Mangpa adinga abawl maitam tungah halmang sillatte, kilemna kithoina sillalte kum khat in thum vei alan zel a, tualeh Mangpa masanga maitam tungah, gimnamtui ahal zel hi. Tuachi’n Biehinn lam azouta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.17; 34.23; Danp. 16.16"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Solomon in Edom gam a tuipi san pieu ah, Eloth kunga um Ezion Geber mun ah tembaw hon abawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hiram in tua tembawte a Solomon mite toh na sem khawm dingin, tuipi umdan thei siem mite leh tembawh hawlsiem mite asawl a."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh amaute Ophir ah ava pei ua, khuna kipat in sana talent zali leh sawmni ava puo ua, Solomon leengpa kungah ahing tut uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian min zal a Solomon minthan dan Sheba leengnu’n ana zah tahin thu hamsa pipi donga amapa ze et tumin ahing pei a.","title":"Solomon leh Sheba leengnu (2 Khang. 9.1-24)","ref":"Mat. 12.42; Luk. 11.31"},"2":{"text":"Amanu nuazui thupitah toh, gimnamtuite, sana tampi, tualeh suongmantamte puo sangawngsaute hing zawpi in Jerusalem ah ahing pei a; tualeh, amanu Solomon kunga ahing tun in alung sim thu dei guotteng agen a adongta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in athudoh zousie adawnga; leengpa a dingin hilchien ding hamsa bangma aum sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Sheba leengnu’n Solomon pilna zousie amu leh a inn bawl te;"},"5":{"text":"Adawkan a ann neh dingte, anasemte toudan, neh leh dawn petute nasepdan, akhohei dan uh, nou petute umdan leh Mangpa biehinn a kilan halmang sillatte amutahin, lungsim bangma zong aneithei ta sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa kungah, “Na silbawlte leh na pildante ka gam a thu kigen kana zahte khu adih mama ana hi ngut ngei hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh keiman ka mit mama a, ka mu masangsie in agen uh kana tahsang sih a; tuachi’n ngaiin akimkhat zong ahing na hil zou sih uhi, agen uh kana zah sangin, na pildan leh na lawchindan athupi zaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Na masanga ding ngitnget a, na pilna ngaikhezing na mite leh na suohte ahampha uhi!"},"9":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian na tunga kipah mama, Israelte leengtoupha a hing tousahpa pahtawi in umta hen; Mangpa’n Israelte khantawn in a ita, tuaziehin dihtat tah a vaihawm dingin leengpa in ahing pang sah hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n leengpa sana talent za leh sawmni, gimnamtui atama tam leh suongmantamte apie hi. Sheba leengnu’n Solomon leengpa apieh gimnamtui za koiman ape nawn sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Ophir akipat a sana hing puo, Hiram tembawhte in zong, ophir akipat in Almug sing atama tam leh suongmantam tampi ahing polut uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n almug singte khu Mangpa biehinn leh leengpa inn bawlna ding leh lasamite kaiging leh pehging bawlna ding bangin azang hi. Tuni tan in tuabangin almug sing ahing kipolut nawn mawngmawng sih a, mu zong akimu kha nawn sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Lengpa Solomon in adeisah zieh a apiehte ban ah zong, leengpa Solomon in Sheba leengnu’n adei teng leh anget pouma apie hi. Tuachi’n agam lam ah asuohte toh anua peikiata uhi."},"14":{"text":"Solomon kunga kumkhat sunga sana lut gihdan talent za guh leh sawm guh leh guh ahi.","title":"Solomon hausat dan leh minthan dan"},"15":{"text":"Summet bawl mite apat a kila, gimnamtui a kivaimite, Arab gam leengpa apat a kila, tualeh agam sung vaipote apata kimute, simkhahlou ahi nalai hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Solomon in sana lum lien zani apeh in akhenga, lum khat ah sana shekel za guh alut hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh sana khen pheng main awmphaw zathum abawl a; awmphaw khat ah sana minas thum alut a, tuate leengpa’n Lebanon gammanga a inn ah akoi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Lengpa’n saiha in leengtoupha thupitah khat abawl a, tuakhu sana hoipen tuiin aluon khuma."},"19":{"text":"Lengtoupha in ketot guh anei a, tua leengtoupha nualam tungah abem in ahing kikuol suh a, touna sih tuoh ah ban ngapna a um a, aban ngapna douna tegel khu humpibahnei lim ni in adou hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh tua ketot guhte gei langkhat tuoh ah humpibahnei sawmleni lim adinga, tuabanga kibawl koima gam ah zong aum sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Solomon zu dawnna nou zousie sana akibawl ngen ahia, tualeh Lebanon gammanga a inn a bel leh kuong zousie zong sana siengthou a, kibawl ngen ahia, dangka akibawl aum sih hi, tuakhu Solomon damlai in bangmatham in akingaisih hi."},"22":{"text":"Lengpan tuipi ah Hiram tembawh hon kithuopi ding summet bawlna tembawh hon anei hi. Tua summet bawlna tembawh hon ten kum thum hal in, sanate, dangkatate, saihate, zawngliente leh utongte puo in ahing kile zel uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Solomon in leitunga leengte zousie hausat lam leh pilna lam ah akhup sieng hi."},"24":{"text":"Pasian in alungtanga pilna akoipieh ngaikhe dingin leitunga mi zousie in Solomon ahing zuon zung zung uhi."},"25":{"text":"Kumchina akunga hinghaw michin in kipahman pieh ding dangka akibawl bel leh kuongte, Sana akibawl bel leh kuongte, puonsilte, galvante, gimnamtuite sakolte, sabiltungte ahing pezel uhi."},"26":{"text":"Solomon in sakollengte leh sakol tungtuong mite akhawm khawm a, sakolleng tul khat leh zali leh sakol tungtuong mi tul sawm leh tul ni anei a, tuate sakolleng koinate ah, Jerusalem khopi a leengpa umna ah aum sah hi.","title":"Solomon in sakollenga summet abawlna (2 Khang. 1.14-17 ; 9.25-28)","ref":"1 Leeng. 4.26"},"27":{"text":"Lengpan Jerusalem khopi sunga dangkasia atam seng seng ziehin suong bang vawt a tam in sievum in a um sah a, tualeh sidar singte lah phaijanga theipi sing bang giap a ngai in aum sah hi.","ref":"Danp. 17.17"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Solomon in Izipt gam leh Keveh gam akipata hing kitawl lut sakolte anei a; tualeh leengpa summet bawl miten Keveh kichi mun ah ava lei zel uhi.","ref":"Danp. 17.16"},"29":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipat in sakolleng khat dangka shekel za guh in akilei a, sakol khat dangka shekel za leh sawmnga in akileizou hi. Tuabangin leengpa summet bawlte akipat in Hitmite leengte zousie leh Siria leengte kungah a zua sawn sah zel uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Solomon in namdang numei tampi adeigaw a, Pharaoh tanu bang, Moab numei bang Ammonte, Edomte, Sidonte, Hit numeite adeigaw a.","title":"Pasian akipat Solomon lungsim kiheimang","ref":"Danp. 17.17"},"2":{"text":"Tua namte tungtang thu, Mangpa’n Israel tate kungah, “Amaute kipawlpi sih unlen amaun zong noute hing kipawlpi sih uheh, aziehpen a pasiente uh zui dingin na lungsim uh a puimang ngei ngei ding uhi,” chia ana gensa mawng ahia, hinanleh Solomon in amaute akitenpi teitei hi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.16; Danp. 7.3,4"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n leeng innsung mi zi zasagi anei a, tualeh mei zathum anei hi; tuaziehin aziten alungsim ahei kawi piehta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen hichi ahing ahi a, Solomon ahing upat nua in, aziten pasien dangte zui dingin alungsim ahei kawi piehta ua, tualeh apa David mabangin alungtang khu Mangpa a Pasian lam ah ahoibukim zou tasih hi.","title":"Milim biehna"},"5":{"text":"Tuazieh in Solomon in Sidon mite pasiennu Ashtoreth leh Ammon mite pasien kidahhuoitah Milkom azuita mawh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in Mangpa mitmu in silgilou ahing bawlta a, apa David mabangin Mangpa azui chinten tasih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in Jerusalem suolam a muolkhat ah Moabte pasien kidah huoitah Kemosh ading leh Ammon mite pasien kidah huoitah Molek a ding in munsang ana bawlta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachimabangin a namdang zite zousie adingin abawla, amauten khunah apasiente chiet ua dingin gimnamtui leh kithoinate ahal zel uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n akunga nivei kilah Israelte Mangpa Pasian alungtanga akiheisan ziehin, Mangpa khu Solomon tungah alungthahta mama hi.","title":"Pasian lungthahna"},"10":{"text":"Tami tungtang thu ah Ama’n pasien dangte na zui ding ahi sih chiin zong thu ana pieh sa ahita a, hinanleh aman Mangpa thupieh azui sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n Solomon kungah, “Tambangin sil na bawlta a, Ka thuhun leh, Ka thuguotte, pom dinga Ka hing thupiehte na zuitahlou ziehin na leenggam Ka hing phalsuo pieh ngei ngei dinga, na suohpa kungah Ka pe ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Bangtenghileh, na pa David zal in nangma damsung in Ka bawl naisih dinga, hinanleh na tapa khuta kipat in Ka phalsuo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh gam pumpi Ka hing lahpieh sih dinga, Ka suoh napa David zal in nam khat na tapa kungah Ka pe ding hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Edom mi Hadad, Solomon melma dingin ahing dingdoh sahta a, ama khu Edom gam leengpa hahlesuon ahi.","title":"Solomon melmate"},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen hichi ahia, David Edom gam a aum laiin, galkap lamkai Joab, Edom gam a pasal taphot atha zou nua in ami thate vui dingin ava kuon tou hi."},"16":{"text":"(Aziehpen Edom gam a pasal pouma atha zou masangsie’n Joab khu Israel mi zousie toh khunah ha guh sung ava um uhi.)"},"17":{"text":"Hadad khu apa suohte lah a Edom lawikhat toh Izipt gam a pei ding in atai ua. Hadad khu naupang neu nou ahi nalai hi."},"18":{"text":"Midian gam a kipat in apawtdoh ua, Paran ava tung ua, tualeh paran akipat in mite azawpi ua, tuachi’n Izipt gam leengpa Pharaoh kung atung suh ua, aman inn ana pie a, neh dingte ana ngaituo pieh a, tualeh gam zong ana pie hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hadad in Pharaoh mitmu in deisahna thupitah atanga, azi sanggamnu toh akiteng sah a, tuakhu leengnu Tahpenes sang gam nu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Tahpenes sanggamnu’n tapa Genubath ahin pieh a, amapa khu Tahpenes in Pharaoh innsungah a nawineh tawptan akep pieh a, tuachi’n Genubath khu Pharaoh inn sungah Pharaoh tate toh a um khawm uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hadad in Izipt gam akipat in David apu le pate kungah a imuta chi leh galkap lamkai Joab zong ashita chi azahtah in; Hadad in Pharaoh kungah “Ka gam a ka pei theina dingin, hing peisanta vang” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh in akungah, “Ka kunga na um in bang tahsap na nei a ahiei thakhat a na gam lam a pei na sawm mawh?” achi hi. Tuachi’n ama’n “Bangma ka tasam sih, hinanleh hing peisah mawngmawng in,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in Solomon a dingin melma dang khat, Eliadah tapa Rezon, apu Hadadezer Zobah leengpa, kunga kipat a taimangsa ahing dingdoh sah kia a."},"24":{"text":"David in Zobah khuo a mite atha lai in Rezon in mite akungah akhawm khawm a, Tua ahel pawlte lamkai in apanga, tualeh Damaska khuo ah apei ua, khunah ava teng ua, tualeh vaihawm in apangta hi."},"25":{"text":"Rezon in Hadad silgilou bawlte belapin Solomon damsung teng Israelte melma ahi ngitnget a, Israelte amuda mama a, tualeh Siria gam pumpi tungah vai ahawm hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon suohpa Zereda khuo a Ephrath mi Nebat tapa Jeroboam, anu min Zeruah meithai khat ahi, ama zong leengpa douin ahelta hi.","title":"Jeroboam dindohna"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa tunga ahelna zieh pen hichi bang ahi; Solomon in Millo abawla, tualeh apa David khopi sietna munte abawlpha hi."},"28":{"text":"Jeroboam khu mihat leh hangsan ahia; tualeh Solomon in tua tangvalpa khu mi thanuomtah ahi chi theiin, Joseph innkuonte nasep zousie tunga houtu dingin abawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua hun lai in hichi ahing hia, Jereboam Jerusalem akipata apawtkhiet lai in, Shiloh khuo a mi guolnei Ahijah in lampi ah ana tuoh a; tualeh aman puon tha khat asil a, tuachi’n amaute gel guoh gamlah ah aum uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Ahijah in apuon tha sillai ala a, abotkeh a phal sawm leh phal ni asuo a;"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh aman Jeroboam kungah “Phal sawmte kilah in, aziehkhu Israelte Mangpa Pasian in tam bangin achi hi; Ngai in Solomon khut a pat in leenggam ka botkeh dinga, nam sawmte nangma ka hing pe ding hi."},"32":{"text":"(Hinanleh aman ka suohpa David zal leh Israel nam zousie lah a ka tel khopi Jerusalem ziehin nam khat atang ding hi.)"},"33":{"text":"Ama un Kei ahing taisan ua, Sidonte pasiennu Ashtoreth bang, Moab mite pasien Kemosh bang, Ammon mite pasien Milkom bang abieh zieh un leh, Ka mitmu a silhoi bawl ding leh Ka thugousiete leh, Ka vaihawmna dante pom dinga apa David banga Ka lampite azuilou zieh in."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh aleenggam pumpi pen akhut akipat in Ka lahpieh sieng sih dinga, hinanleh Ka thupiehte leh Ka thugousiete pompa Ka tel Ka suoh David ziehin adamsung leeng in ka pangsah nalai ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanleh atapa khut akipat aleenggam Ka lahpieh dinga, tuachi’n nangma kungah nam sawmte Ka hing pe ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Ka suohpa David in Ka min umna dinga Ka tel khopi Jerusalem a, Ka masanga thau mei avah sah ngitnget theina dingin, nam khat atapa Ka pe ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n nang Ka hing guot dinga, na lungtangin adei bangbangin vai na hawm dinga, Israelte tungah leeng in na pang ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, Ka hing thupieh zousie na pom a, Ka lampite na zui a, tualeh Ka suoh David mabanga, Ka thugousiete leh Ka thupiehte zui dinga, Ka mitmu a silhoi na bawl leh Ka hing umpi dinga, David adinga innkuon dettah Ka bawl pieh mabangin innkuon dettah mai Ka hing bawlpieh ding a, Israel Ka hing pe ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Tamte ziehin David hahlesuonte ka sugenthei ding hi, hinanleh kumtawn in vang ahisih ding, achi hi, achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuaziehin Solomon in Jeroboam tha atumta a, hinanleh Jeroboam adingdoh a, Izipt gam leengpa Shishak kungah ataimangta hi, tuachi’n Solomon shi masang sie’n Izipt gam ah a umdenta hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuin Solomon nasep dangte a silbawl zousie leh apilnate Solomon nasepte gelna laibu ah akigiel hilou ahiei mah?","title":"Solomon shina (2 Khang. 9.29-31)"},"42":{"text":"Solomon in Israelte zousie tunga Jerusalem khuo a, avaihawm sung khu kum sawm li ahi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon apu a pate kungah a imuta a, apa David khopi ah avuita uhi, tualeh atapa Rehoboam in ama thahengin leeng in apangta hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rehoboam Shekem khuo ah apei a, Israelte zousie zong ama leengpa a bawl dingin Shekem khuo ah ahing pei uhi.","title":"Rehoboam leenga apanna (2 Khang. 10.1-5)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahia, Nebat tapa Jeroboam in tam thu ana zahin (Jeroboam pen leengpa Solomon akipata taimang Izipt gam a va tengden ahi.)"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeroboam ava hansah ua. Tualeh Jeroboam leh Israel kikhawmte zousie ahing pei ua, Rehoboam kungah,"},"4":{"text":"“Na pan ka hahkol uh agih sah thei mama a, tuaziehin tuin na pa’n ahing suhgimnate leh hahkol gihtah ka tung ua akoi khu hing suh jang pieh inlen, tuachi’n na nna ka sem ding uhi,” chi’n ava gen uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Ni thum sung vanua pei kia phot unlen, tuazou chiengin hing peikia un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n mipite apei kiata uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Rehoboam in apa Solomon damlai a, ana vaihawmpi zel zel upate kungah, “Tam mite ka dawn dingdan ngaidan kituptah bang na nei uoi?” chi’n adong hi.","title":"Rehoboam dawna mothuoi (2 Khang. 10.6-15)"},"7":{"text":"Amaun akungah, “Tunia tam mite nasema na um a, amauh na dawn a, akung ua thu hoitah na gen leh kumtawn in na suoh in apang ding uh” chiin agen uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh ama’n upate lem guotpina amang sih a, ama khanguol avaihawmpite adongta hi."},"9":{"text":"Akung uah, “Na pa’n ka tung ua hahkol gihtah ahing koi hing suh jang piehin chia hing genmite idawn theina dingun bang na hing lemguot pi uoi?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n akhanguol tangvalten akungah, “Na pa’n ka hahkol uh agihsah a, hinanleh nangman hing suh jang pieh in chite kungah tambangin na chi ding hi, ka khutme ka pa kawng sangin alienzaw ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka pa’n hahkol gihtah ahing guon leh agihzaw sem ken ka hing guon dinga, ka pa’n chienga ahing zep leh ken sia chiengin ka hing zep ding hi chiin,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeroboam leh mipi zousie leengpa’n nithum nua chiengin ka kungah hing pei kia un chia ana hil bangin, anithum niin Rehoboam kungah “Ahing pei kia” uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n mipite khautahin ana dawnga, upate lemguotpina apom sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Tangvalte lemguotpi bangin, ka pa’n na hahkol uh ana gihsah a, ken na hahkol uh ka belap nalai ding hi; “Ka pa’n chiengin ahing zepa ken sia chieng in kahing zep ding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n mipite thugen apomta sih hi; tam silte Mangpa a hing kipan ahiziehin, Nebat tapa Jeroboam kunga Shiloh mi Ahijah zanga athugen atangtun theina dingin."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mi zousiein leengpa’n athu uh apom sih chi atheitahun, “David ah goutan bang inei uoi? Jesse tapa ah gou luo ding bang ma inei tuom sih uh,” Israelte aw na puon inn lam chiet uah pei ta un, Aw David na innkuon kingaituo maiin, chi in leengpa adawng ta uhi. Tuachi’n Israelte apuon inn chiet uah a ki pei ta uhi.","title":"Lenggam kikhenna leh Jeroboam Israelte leeng ahina","ref":"2 Sam. 20.1"},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Juda gam a khopite a teng Israel tate zousie tungah Rehoboam in vai a hawm hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Rehoboam in nasem dinga agoi teitei pawlte lamkai Adoram asawl a, hinanleh Israelte zousie’n suongin ana sep ua ashita hi. Tuaziehin leengpa Rehoboam Jerusalem khopi a tai tumin asakolleng tungah kintah in atuong hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte David innkuonte tungah tuni tan in ahelta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, Israelte zousie’n Jeroboam ahing nua pei kiata chi azah tahun, akikhop khawmna uah ahansah ua, tuachi’n Israelte tunga leeng ding in abawlta uhi. Juda nam chilou ngal David innkuonte zui koima aum sih uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Rehoboam in Jerusalem khopi atun tahin Israel innkuonte dou a, Solomon tapa Rehoboam ading a, nualah kia dingin Juda nam zousie leh Benjamin nam mihangsan teldoh ngentang tul zakhat leh tul sawm giet galkap akaikhawm a."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian mi Shemaiah kungah, Pasian thu ahing tunga."},"23":{"text":"“Juda gam leengpa Solomon tapa Rehoboam kung leh Benjamin innkuonte kungah, tualeh mipi um nalaite kungah va gen inlen;"},"24":{"text":"Tambangin Mangpa’n agen hi, Na sanggamte uh Israelte dou dingin na kuontou ding uh ahisih hi, michin a inn lam chiet uah nua peikia uheh, Tami keima bawl ahi chiin genin,” achi hi. Tuaziehin amaun Mangpa thu amang ua, tualeh Mangpa thu dungzuiin anua peikia chietta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeroboam in Ephraim muol ah Shekem khuo abawla, khunah ateng a, tualeh khuna kipat in apeidoh a. Penuel abawl hi.","title":"Jeroboam khelna"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Jeroboam in alungsim in “Tuin tami leenggam pen David innkuonte a ahing hi kia mai thei hi, achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tam mite Jerusalem khopi a Mangpa inn ah kithoi dingin kuontou zelta u’leh, tuachi’n tam mite lungsim apu uh Juda leengpa Rehoboam lam ah ahing kihei kia dinga, tuachi’n kei ahing that ding ua, Juda leengpa Rehoboam abel kia mai ding uhi,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n mi adonga, sana in bawngnou lim ni abawla, akung uah “Nou a dingin Jerusalem khopi a vahawtou zel ahamsa taluo hi, Aw Israel en un Izipt gam a kipata hing puidoh na pasiente uh” achia;","ref":"Pawt. 32.4"},"29":{"text":"tuachi’n khat Bethel ah akoi a, adang khatpen Dan khuo ah akoi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tam sil khu khelna ahing hita hi, mipite tam bawngnou limte be dingin Dan tandonga apei taah zieh un."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh aman munsangte ah innte alam a, Levi mite hilou mipite lah apat in siempu ding mi abawla."},"32":{"text":"Jeroboam in Juda gam a annkuongluina pawi abawl mabangun, aha gietna, ni sawm leh ninga ni khu annkuong luina pawi bawlna ni dingin aguot a, maitam tungah sil alan hi. Tuachimabangin Bethel a abawngnou lim bawl kungah kithoina alan hi, tualeh amun sang bawlna siempute Bethel ah akoi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 23.33,34"},"33":{"text":"Tuachibangmain aman alungtanga adei mabangin, aha gietna ni sawm leh ninga niin Bethel a amaitam bawl ah sil alan a, Israelte adingin annkuong luina pawi ni ding aguot a, aman zong maitam tungah sil alan a, tualeh gimnamtui zong ahal hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh ngai in, Mangpa thu in Juda gam a kipat in Pasian mi khat Bethel ah ahing pei a, tualeh Jeroboam khu maitam gei ah gimnamtui hal dingin ading hi.","title":"Jeroboam maitam tunga genlawhna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n amapan Mangpa thuin maitam akikou khum a, “Aw maitam, maitam, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, David innkuonte lah ah naupang khat amin Josiah kichi ahing pieng dinga, na tunga gimnamtui hal zel munsang siempute na tunga kithoina dingin ahing lan dinga, na tungah mihing gute ahing hal ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.15,16"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian mipa in tuani main chiemtena apie a, “Tami Mangpa’n agensa chiemtena ahi ding, Ngaiin maitam ahing khipoh dinga, tualeh atunga vutte ahing kibo ding hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, leengpa Jeroboam in Bethel maitam kikou khum Pasian mipa thugen azahtah in, “Man un” chiin akhut in azam phei a. Tualeh mat tum a akhut azan khu azaw denta a, anua kai kia theita sih hi.","title":"Jeroboam tunga Pasian a pat a chiemtena"},"5":{"text":"Pasian mipa’n Mangpa thu ana gen chiemtena bangin maitam akhipawh a, tualeh avutte zong maitam akipat in akibuo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n adawnga Pasian mipa kungah, “Ka khut ahing dam theina dingin Mangpa na Pasian kungah ngen inlen hing thum pieh in achi hi. Tualeh Pasian mipan Mangpa kungah angen a, tuachi’n leengpa khut khu amasanga bangin ahing dam kiata hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Pasian mipa kungah, ka kungah ka inn lam ah hing pei inlen hing khawl tawldam in, kipahman ka hing pe ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Guolneipa khelna"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian mipa’n leengpa kungah, “Na inn kimkhat hing pe ding hinanlachin zong na inn ah ka hing pei sih ding hi; tualeh tanah tanghou mawngmawng ka ne sih dinga, tui zong ka dawn sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen tanghou va ne sinlen tui mawngmawng zong va dawn sin, tualeh na peina lampi a zong na kinuale kia ding ahi sih chia Mangpa thu a sawl ka hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n lampi tuom ah apei a, Bethel a ahing peina lampi ah zong apei kia nawnta sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Bethel khuo ah guolnei tehsepu khat aum a, atapaten khum nia Bethel a Pasian mipa sil bawl zousie ahil a, leengpa kunga athu gente zong apa uh ahil sawn uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh apa un akung uah, “Heilang lampi ah apei ei?” achi hi. Aziehpen ataten Juda gam a hing kipan Pasian mipa peina lampi athei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh aman atapate kungah, “Sabiltung hing bawl pieh un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n sabiltung abawl pieh ua, tuachi’n atuongta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian mipa anuadel a, gangpi sing nuoia tou ava muta hi, tuachi’n akungah “Nang hiteh izaw Juda gam a kipat a hing pei Pasian mipa?” achi hi. Tualeh aman “Hima ing e,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akungah, “Ka inn langah hing pei inlen, tanghou hing ne dive,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian mipain na kungah, “Ka hing nua pei kia thei sih dinga, na inn ah zong kang pei thei sih ding a na kungah tanghou nein tui zong ka dawn thei sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen Na nein na dawn sih dinga, na hing peina lampi ah zong na ki nuale lou ding ahi, chia Mangpa thu a sawl ka hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh aman akungah, “Kei zong nangma banga guolnei khat ka hi; vansawlsieng khat in Mangpa thuin ka kungah, tanghou aneh a tui adawn theina dingin na inn lam ah va puikia in chi’n ahing houpi hi achia,” hinanleh akungah zuou agen ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n akungah anua pei kia a, a inn ah ane in adawnta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, dawkan a ann ne a atou laiin, ama va nua puikia guolneipa kungah Mangpa thu ahing tunga.","title":"Guolneipa tung thu khenna"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh aman Juda gam a kipat a hing pei Pasian mipa akikou khumta a, “Tambangin Mangpa’n agen hi, Mangpa thu na man lou zieh leh Mangpa na Pasian in thu ahing pieh, athupiehte zuilou a;"},"22":{"text":"Na hing nua pei kia a, Mangpa’n tanghou ne sinlen tui zong dawn sin achina mun mama a, “Tanghou na neh a, tui na dawn ziehin” na luong na pu napate han ah akivui sih ding hi,” chiin agenkheta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, tanghou aneh a tui adawn zou in, Pasian mi ava nua pui kia pa tuonna ding sabiltung abawl pieh a."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n apeita a, lam kaal ah humpibahnei khat toh akituoh ua, ana petliata hi, tualeh aluong lampi ah alum den a, sabiltung akungah ading den hi, tualeh humpibahnei zong aluong kung ah ading den hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh ngaivawi mite ava pei ua, lampi a mishi luong lum leh aluong kunga humpibahnei ding nalai ava mu ua, guolnei tehsepu umna khuo ah ava genta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama vanua puikia guolnei pan tua thu azah tahin, “Mangpa thu manglou Pasian mipa ahi khu, tuaziehin Mangpa’n akunga athu gen bangbang a, humpibahnei kungah apie a ana pelia ahita ve,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n atate kungah, “Sabiltung hing bawlpieh un achia,” tuachi’n abawl piehta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n ava pei a, aluong lampi a lum leh humpibahnei aluong kunga ding ava mu a, humpibahnei in mishi luong ana ne sih a, sabiltung zong bangma alawsih hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua guolneipan Pasian mipa luong khu ala a, a sabiltung tungah akhanga, anua puoh kia a, tua guolnei tehsepu khu ama suun ding leh vui dingin kho sung ahing tungta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n aluong khu ama han ah asiel a, “Kadei ka unaupa aw” chi’n akaa uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh avui zou tahun atapate kungah, “Ka shi chiengin Pasian mipa kivuina mun ah hing vui unlen agute gei ah ka gute hing koi un."},"32":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian thua Bethel a maitam leh Samaria gam khopite a, munsang inn zousie akikou khumna thu hing tangtung ngeingei ding ahi,” chi’n agen hi."},"33":{"text":"Tam sil umte nuain zong Jeroboam in a umdan hoiloute akiheisan tuom sih a, mivantang lah a mi mun sang siempu dingin apang sah a, adei dei akoi tuom a, tuachi’n munsangte a siempuin apangsah zel hi.","title":"Jeroboam in akhelna tawpsanlou"},"34":{"text":"Tualeh tam sil khu Jeroboam innkuon khelna leh amauh ingamsah a, tualeh leitunga kipat a sumangthaitu ahing hita hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuahun lai in Jeroboam tapa Abijah achi ana hi.","title":"Jeroboam douna a Ahijah thugenlawh"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Jeroboam in azi kungah, “Kisa inlen Jeroboam zi na hilam ahing kithei louna dingin kisiem lamdang inlen, Shiloh khuo ah va haw in, ngaiin khunah guolnei Ahijah, tam mite tunga leengpa a ka pan ding tungtang thugenpa a um hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh tanghou beu sawm leh tanghou pheng tamlou leh khuoizu thawl khat keng inlen akungah va hawin, naupang tung a sil hing um ding ahing na hil mai ding hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Jeroboam zi in tuabangin abawla, adingdoh a, Shiloh khuo ah ahaw a, Ahijah inn ava tung hi. Hinanleh Ahijah in khuo amu thei nawn sih a, a upat seng tah ziehin amit amielta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Ahijah kungah, “Ngai in Jeroboam zi atapa tungtang thu dongin ahing pei hi, aziehpen achi ana hi; tambangin akungah thu na gen ding ahi, ahing lut chiengin numei dang khat bangin ahing kisiem lamdang ding hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahijah in kotpi a ahing lut a aketot ging azah tahin, “Hing lut in nang Jeroboam zi, bang achia hing kisiem lamdang na hiei? tanchin hoiloutah hil dinga sawl ka hi."},"7":{"text":"Pei inlen Jeroboam kungah, “Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi, Mipite lah akipat ka hing tawisang a, ka mi Israelte tungah vaihawm in ka hing pangsah hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh David innkuonte a kipat in gam ka lahpieh a, nangma kahing pie hi; hinanleh nang ka suoh David bangin na um sih a, ama’n ka thupiehte azui a, tualeh ka mitmu a sildih ngentang bawl dingin alungtang zousie in ahing zui hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang penin na masanga mite zousie sangin zong sil hoilou na bawl sese a, nang lungthahsah theina dingin na levah a, milim kisunthaw pasien dangte na bawla, nang nuangatsanta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin ngaiin, Jeroboam innkuonte tungah sietna ka tungsah dinga, Jeroboam akipat in pasal kichi pouma, Israel gam a mi saltang leh zalen zong, tualeh Jeroboam innkuon umsunte na ngawn zong ka sumang sieng dinga, mi’n eeh aphiet sieng kilkel bang vawt in Jeroboam innkuonte atumgam sieng masang sie uh ka phiet mang ding hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 15.29"},"11":{"text":"Jeroboam innkuonte lah a mi khopi sunga shi pouma ui in ane dinga, tualeh gam a shi pouma tunga leeng va ten ane ding uhi, chia Mangpa’n ana gensa ahi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin kisa’n len, na inn langah pei kia mai in, tualeh khopi sung na kengin atot tah in, naupang a shi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mi zousie’n asuun ding ua, avui ding uhi, aziehpen Jeroboam innkuonte lah a ama maimai han a kivui giap ding ahi, Jeroboam innkuonte lah a ama mai mai ah Mangpa Israelte Pasian tunga hoina bang ahiei khat akilat zieh in."},"14":{"text":"Tuaban ah Mangpa’n Israelte tunga leeng ding khat ahing tungdoh dinga, ama’n khum niin Jeroboam innkuonte asumang ding hi; tuin zong bangchi ahita diei?"},"15":{"text":"Mi’n tui lah a pumpeng alawling bangmai in Mangpa’n Israelte ahing satling dinga, apulepate uh kunga ana pieh khum gam hoitah a kipat in Israelte abotdoh dinga, tualeh luigal langah athethang ding hi, Mangpa sulungthah dinga Asherte abawl zieh un."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Israelte khelna bawlsahpa Jeroboam khelnate ziehin Israelte anuasie ta ding hi.”"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeroboam zi adingdoh a, apeita a, Tirzah khuo atungta hi, tualeh kotlam atun tahin naupang ashita hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh avui ua, tualeh Mangpa’n asuohpa guolnei Ahijah zanga ana gen bang mama in Israel mi zousien a suun uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Jeroboam silbawl dangte, agaldou dante avaihawm dante, Israel leengte khangthu gelna bu ah atuong hi.","title":"Jeroboam shina"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Jeroboam vaihawm sung khu kum sawmni leh ni ahia, tuachi’n apulepate kungah a imuta a, tualeh atapa Nadab amathahengin leeng in apang hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Solomon tapa Rehoboam Juda gam ah leeng in apang hi. Lenga apan chiil laiin Rehoboam kum sawmli leh kum khat a upa ahia. Mangpa’n amin umna dinga Israel nam zousie lah a atel khopi Jerusalem ah kum sawm leh sagi leeng in apang hi.
