Anu min Naamah ahia, Ammon mi ahi.","title":"Rehoboam nuoi a Judate kiehngiemna"},"22":{"text":"Judaten Mangpa mitmu in silgilou ahing bawlta ua, apu leh pate uh silbawl zousie khupkhel a, akhelnate un, Athangsietna lungthahna atohthou sah hi."},"23":{"text":"Azieh khu amaun zong muol sang tungte leh sing hing chinteng nuoi ah munsangte milimte leh Asherte abawl uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 17.9,10"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh khum gam ah pasal kizuate zong aum ua, tualeh Israelte masanga kipata Mangpa’n ana nawdoh namte silbawl kidahhuoi chinteng amaun zong abawlta uhi.","ref":"Danp. 23.17"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Lengpa Rehoboam leenga apan kum ngana kumin hichi ahing hia, Izipt leengpa Shishak in Jerusalem khuo ava sima.","title":"Shishak in Jerusalem adouna (2 Khang. 12.2-16)","ref":"2 Khang. 12.2-8"},"26":{"text":"Aman Mangpa biehinn a goute leh leengpa inn a goute aunpi’n ala siengta hi, tualeh Solomon in sana abawl lum leh phaw zousie alamang ta hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 10.16,17; 2 Khang. 9.15,16"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Rehoboam in tuate taangin sum-eng in lum leh phaw abawl hi, Tuachi’n leengpa inn kotkhah vengpa lamkaipenpa khut ah akem sah hi."},"28":{"text":"Lengpa, Mangpa inn a alut chiengin vengmiten atawi ua, tuachi’n venna pindan ah akoi zel uhi."},"29":{"text":"Rehoboam tanchin leh asilbawl zousie Juda leengte khangthu gelna laibu ah atuong hilou ahiei mah?"},"30":{"text":"Adam sung tengin Rehoboam leh Jeroboam kikaal ah kidouna aum ngitnget hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rehoboam apulepate kungah a imuta a, tualeh David khopi ah apulepate toh avuita uhi. Tualeh anu min Naamah ahia, Ammon mi ahi. Tualeh ama thahengin atapa Abijam leeng in apang hi.","title":"Rehoboam shina"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nebat tapa leengpa Jeroboam leenga apan kum sawm leh kum gietna kum in Judate tungah Abijah leeng in apang hi.","title":"Abijah (Abijam leenga apan chilna) (2 Khang. 13.1 , 3 ; 14.1)"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem ah kum thum vai ahawm a, tualeh anu min khu Abishalom tanu Maakah ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ama masang ah apa’n silgilou abawl zousie aman zong abawl a, apu David lungtang mabangin alungtang Mangpa a Pasian lam ah ahoi kim sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh David ziehin Mangpa a Pasian in ama nua a Jerusalem a vaihawmding leh Jerusalem khuo ding kip sah dingin atapa Abijah apie hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 11.36"},"5":{"text":"Hit mi Uria tungtang chilou David in Mangpa mitmu in sil dih abawla, adam sung tengin akunga bawl dinga athupiehte zousie aleengatsan ngai sih hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 11.1-27"},"6":{"text":"Ama damsung tengin Rehoboam leh Jeroboam kikaal ah kidouna aum ngitnget hi.","ref":"2 Khang. 13.3-21"},"7":{"text":"Abijah tanchin dangte leh asilbawl zousie Juda leengte vaihawm lai tanchin kigelna laibu sungah atuong hilou ahiei mah? Tualeh Abijah leh Jeroboam kikaal ah kidouna aum zelzel hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Abijam apu apate kungah a i muta a, tualeh David khopi ah avuita uhi. Tualeh atapa Asa ama thahengin leeng in apang hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Israelte leengpa Jeroboam leenga apan kum sawmni achin kumin, asa khu Judate tungah leeng in apang hi.","title":"Asa leenga apanna (2 Khang. 14.2 ; 15.16-18)"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem ah kum sawm li leh khat vai ahawm hi, tualeh api min khu Maakah Abishalom tanu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Apu David mabangin asa in Mangpa mitmu ah sil hoi abawl zel hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman agamsunga kipat in pasal kizua zousie adelmanga, tua leh apa milim bawl zousie asumang sieng hi.","ref":"2 Khang. 15.8-15"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh api Maakah nangawn zong Asher milim kidahhuoi abawl ziehin leengnu nu ahina atawpsahta a, tualeh Asa in a milim bawl asatpua a, Kidron lui ah ahaltumta hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh munsangte asuse sih a, hinanleh Asa lungtang khu adam sungteng Mangpa lamah ahoi bukim hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh apa’n sil ana latsate leh ama mama in alatsa, dangka, sana leh bel leh kuongte Mangpa inn sungah ala lut hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh adam sung teng uh Asa leh Israel leengpa Baasha akidou ngitnget uhi.","title":"Asa thumanlouna (2 Khang. 16.1-6)"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Israel leengpa Baasha Judate dou dingin ava kuontou a; Juda leengpa Asa kunga lut leh pawt dalna dingin Ramah khuo abawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Asa in Mangpa inn a goute lah a kinuasiete dangka leh sana ala a, asuohte kungah apie a; tualeh Damaska khuo a um Siria leengpa Tabrimon tapa Hezion tupa Benhadad kungah asawl a, akungah"},"19":{"text":"“Na pa leh ka pa kikaal a kilemna ana um bangin kei leh nang kikaal ah zong kilemna umsah vai, chi’n tam kipahman dangka leh sanate kahing hah hi, Israel leengpa Baasha in ahing tawpsan theina dingin ama toh na thuhun suse mai in,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Benhadad in Asa leengpa thu ana pom a, tuachi’n Israel khuote dou dingin galkap lamkaite asawl a tuachi’n Izon, Dan, Abel Beth Maakah, Kinneroth gam zousie leh Naphtali gam zousie ava sim a."},"21":{"text":"Baasha in tua thu azah tahin, Ramah kho bawl atawpsan a, tuachi’n Tirzah khuo ah aumta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Asa in Juda gam sung pumpiah thu aphuonga, koima a awl umtuomlou in, Baasha in Ramah khuo bawlna dinga, sing leh suong azahte anawn ua, tualeh khumte zangin leengpa Asa in Benjamin gam a Geba leh Mizpah khuote abawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Asa tangthu dang zousie, asilbawltheina zousie leh a khopi bawl zousie, Juda leengte vaihawmna tanchin kigelna laibu sungah atuong hilou ahiei mah? Hinanleh ahing tehsiet bepin akengah hii sie ahing veita hi.","title":"Asa shina leh Jehoshaphat leenga panna (2 Khang. 16.12—17.1)"},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Asa khu apute kungah a i muta a, tualeh David khopi a apu leh pate kungah avuita uhi, tualeh ama thahengin atapa Jehoshaphat leeng in apangta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Judate leengpa Asa leenga apan kum nina in Jeroboam tapa Nadab Israelte tungah kumni leeng in apang hi.","title":"Israelte tunga Nadab vaihawmna"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa mitmu in silhoilou abawl leenga, apa lampi azui a, tuachi’n Israelte akhelsahna, khelna silbawlte khu aman zong abawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Issakar innkuonte lah a, Ahijah tapa Baasha in ama tungah thu adap phiela, tuachi’n Baasha in ama Philistinte khuo Gibbethon ah athat a; Nadab leh Israelte zousie in Gibbethon khuo a im laitah uh ahi.","title":"Baasha helna"},"28":{"text":"Juda leengpa Asa leenga apan kum thumna in Baasha in Nadab athat a, ama thahengin leeng in apangta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, leenga ahing pan bepin Jeroboam innkuonte zousie athat gam sienga, Jeroboam a dinga hinna nei khat zong ahinkhawipieh sih hi. Mangpa’n Shiloh khomi asuohpa guolnei Ahijah zanga ana gensa mabangin.","ref":"1 Leeng. 14.10"},"30":{"text":"Tuakhu Israelten sil abawl khielsah na dinga Jeroboam khelnate zieh leh Mangpa Israelte Pasian alungthah sah zieh ahi."},"31":{"text":"Nadab silbawl dangte leh asil bawl zousie Israel leengte khangthu gelna bu ah akigiel hi lou ahiei mah?"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Asa leh Israelte leengpa Baasha avaihawm sungteng uh akidou ngitnget uhi.","title":"Baasha Israelte leenga apanna"},"33":{"text":"Juda leengpa Asa leenga apan kum thumna in Ahijah tapa Baasha Tirzah khuo ah Israelte leeng in apang pan a, tualeh kum sawmni le li vai ahawm hi."},"34":{"text":"Mangpa mitmu in silgilou mamate abawl a, Jeroboam lampi azui a, Israelte khelna abawl sah a, tuabang khelnate abawl hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachin Baasha tungtang thu ah, Hanani tapa Jehu kungah, Mangpa thu ahing tunga.","title":"Baasha sietna leh shina"},"2":{"text":"“Leivui akipat in ka hing domsang a, ka mi Israelte tunga leeng in ka hing pang sah a, hinanleh Jeroboam lampi na zui a, akhelnate ua ahing lungthahsahna dingun, ka mi Israelte sil na bawlkhiel sahta hi."},"3":{"text":"Ngaiin, Baasha leh a innkuonte ka sumang ding hi; tualeh na innkuonte zong Nebat tapa Jeroboam innkuonte bangin ka bawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Baasha innkuonte lah a mi khopi sunga shi poumate ui in ane dinga; tualeh gamlah a shi poumate tungleeng vaten ane ding uhi.”"},"5":{"text":"Baasha na sep dangte, asilbawlte, athahatdante Israel leengte khangthu gelna bu ah atuong hilou amah?"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Baasha apute kungah a imuta a, Tirzah khuo ah avui uhi. Tuachi’n ama thahengin atapa Elah leeng in apang hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Baasha leh a innkuonte tungtang thu ah, Jeroboam innkuonte mabanga Mangpa mitmu a sil hoilou ana bawl zousie leh akhut nasep a Mangpa asuhlungthah zieh leh ama atha ziehin Hanani tapa Jehu zanga agen Mangpa thu ahing tungta hi."},"8":{"text":"Juda leengpa Asa leenga apan kum, kum sawmni leh guhna ah Baasha tapa Elah Tirzah khuo ah Israelte tungah kum ni leeng in apang hi.","title":"Elah Israelte leenga apanna"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh asuohpa Zimri asakolleng kimkhat tunga lamkai pa’n ama tungah aguh in thu aphiel a, khumbang hun laitahin ama Tirzah khuo a, a inn sung lam kemte lamkai lien Arzah innah zu adawn kham a;"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Judate leengpa Asa leenga apan kum sawmni leh sagina kum in Zimri ava lut a, asat a, a thatta hi, tuachi’n ama taangin leeng in apangta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hia, leeng in ahing panga, leengtoupha a ahing tou tahin, Baasha innkuonte zousie athat gam sienga, atanaute leh alawmte lah a mi pasal pouma khat zong ahinkhawi sih hi.","title":"Zimri Israelte leenga apanna"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Jehu zanga Baasha tungtang thu Mangpa’n ana gen dungzui in Zimri in Baasha innkuonte asumang siengta hi."},"13":{"text":"Aginatlounate zieh ua Israelte Mangpa Pasian sulungthahin, Baasha khelnate zousie leh atapa Elah khelnate in Israelte abawlkhielsah zieh un."},"14":{"text":"Ela tangthu dangte leh a silbawl zousie, Israel leengte khangthu kigelna laibu sungah atuong sih amah?"},"15":{"text":"Juda leengpa Asa leenga apan kum sawmni leh sagi achin kum in Zimri Tirzah khuo ah ni sagi leeng in apang hi. Tualeh miten Philistinte gam Gibbethon khuo dou dingin panmun abawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh panmun bawl miten “Zimri in leengpa aguhin aphiel dapa, athatta” chi ana za ua, tuaziehin Israel mi zousie in, khum niin apan mun ua galkap lamkai Omri khu Israelte leengpa dingin abawlta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Omri khu akunga um Israelte zousie toh Gibbethon akipat akuontou ua, Tirzah khuo ava bu imta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahia, khuo alata uh chi Zimri in atheitah in, leengpa inn kulpi ah atailut a, leengpa inn toh mei in akibuhal khuma ashita hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa mitmu a sil hoilou abawl a akhelnate zieh leh Jeroboam lampi zui a Israelte sil abawl khielsah zieh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Zimri tangthu dangte leh a phiel dapna thute Israel leengte khangthu kigelna laibu ah atuong hilou amah?"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mite pawl ni in ahing kikhenta ua, mipi pawl khat in Ginath tapa Tibni leeng dinga bawl tumin azui ua, tualeh kimkhat in Omri azui uhi.","title":"Omri Israelte leenga apanna"},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Omri zui miten Ginath tapa Tibni zuite azou ua, tuachi’n Tibni ashi a, Omri leeng in apangta hi."},"23":{"text":"Juda leengpa Asa leenga apan kum sawmthum leh khat kum in Omri Israelte tungah leeng in apang a, Tirzah khuo ah kum guh sung leeng vai ahawm hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh aman dangka talent ni in Shemer a pat in Samaria muol alei a, tualeh muol tungah khuo abawl a, akhomin dingin amuol neipa Shemer min louin Samaria ahi sah hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh Omri in Mangpa mitmu in sil hoilou abawl zel a, amasanga mi zousiete sangin agilouzaw sem nalai hi."},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen Nebat tapa Jeroboam lampi azui a, aginatlou zieh ua Mangpa Israelte Pasian lungthahsah dingin ana gilou uhi."},"27":{"text":"Omri silbawl dangte, asilbawltheidan ana suhlat thute Israel leengte khangthu gelna bu ah atuong sih amah?"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Omri apu apate kungah a i muta a, Samaria khopi ah avuita uhi, tualeh atapa ama thahengin leeng in apang hi."},"29":{"text":"Juda leengpa Asa leenga apan kum sawmthum leh kum gietna kumin Omri tapa Ahab Israelte leeng in apang hi. Tualeh Omri tapa Ahab in Samaria khopi ah kum sawmni leh kum ni sung leeng vai ahawm hi.","title":"Ahab Israelte leengpa ahina"},"30":{"text":"Omri tapa Ahab in ama masanga mite zousie sangin Mangpa mitmu ah silhoilou mama abawl zing hi"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelnate banga gamtat khu bangma thama ngailou in Sidon leengpa Ethbal tanu Jezebel zi in anei a, Baal nnate sem in abeta mawh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samaria khopi a Baal inn abawl ah, Baal adingin maitam khat abawl hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahab in Asher abawl a, tuachi’n ama masanga Israel leengte tengteng sangin Ahab in Mangpa Israelte Pasian lungthah sahna sil atam bawl zaw dieh nalai hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahab leenga apan hun sungin Bethel mi Hiel in Jerikou alamtha a, atachil Abiram taan in asuongphum alem a, tualeh atapa tumpen Segub taanin kulkotkhate atungdoh hi. Nun tapa Joshua zanga Mangpa’n ana gensa mabangin.","ref":"Josh. 6.26"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gilead gam a Tishbe khuo a mi Elijah in Ahab kungah “Amasanga ka din zingna pa Israelte Mangpa Pasian min lou in ka gen ahi, kum bangza ahiei sung ka thulouin daitui ahiei guo ahiei ake sih ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Guo zuhlouna leh Elijah va-ahten avahna","ref":"Jak. 5.17"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thu akungah ahing tunga."},"3":{"text":"“Tana kipat pawt inlen suolam ah kihei inlen, Jordan lui a luongsuh Kerith luita pang ah vakibu in."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahi dinga, tua lui tui na dawn dinga, tualeh tuamun a nangma hing vah dingin va-ahte thu ka pe zouta hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n apei a, Mangpa thu bangin ava kibuta hi. Jordan lui a luongsuh Kerith luita pangah ava umta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n va-ah ten zingmawng lamin tanghou leh sa ava puoh zel ua, nitah lam chiengin zong tanghou leh sa ava puoh zel uhi, tualeh luitui adawn zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh hun tomkhat zou in hichi ahing ahia, gam sunga guo azuhlou ziehin tua lui tui ahing kangta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thu akungah ahing tunga.","title":"Elijah Zarephath khuo ah"},"9":{"text":"“Dingdoh inlen Sidon gam a Zarephath khuo ah va pei inlen, khunah va um in, En in, nangma hing vaa dingin meithai khat thu ka pe zouta hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Luk. 4.25,26"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n ading doh a Zarephath khuo ah apeita hi. Tualeh khum khopi kulkotpi atun tah in, ngai in meithainu khat singkang tom in ana um a. Tualeh amanu ahan a, “Hepitahin ka dawn ding tui nou khat hing tawiin,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tui la dinga kuon lai ahan a, akungah “Tanghou neukhat zong hing tawiin,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh meithainu’n akungah, “Mangpa na Pasian min louin ka gen ahi, tanghou ka nei sih a hinanleh bel sungah tangbuong sip khat, leh a uum sungah sathau tawmnoukhat ka nei hi; tualeh en in, ka pei chienga kei leh ka tapa ading kanna dingin singkang ni tou khat ka tom a, tuachi’n kane ding ua, ka shi suh mai ding uhi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Elijah in akungah “Zausin, pei inlen na chi bangin va bawlin; hinanleh kei a dingin tanghou themnoukhat hing bawl pieh masa inlen, hing tawiin; tuazou chiengin nang leh na tapa adingin bawlin."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi; Mangpa’n leitunga guo ahing zuhsah masangsie’n, tangbuong bel ahawm ngai sih ding a, tualeh sathau uum zong akang ngai sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu apei a, Elijah gen bangbangin ava bawl a; amaute gel leh ainnkuonten nitampi aneta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Elijah zanga ana gen Mangpa thu dungzuiin tangbuong bel lah ahawm ngai sih a, sathau uum zong akang ngai sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu’n tambang teng a hing hi nua in, inn neinu, numei tapa achi ahing nata a. China ahing gim mama ta a, anaah atawpta hi.","title":"Elijah in meithainu tapa akaithou"},"18":{"text":"Amanu’n Elijah kungah, “Aw nang Pasian mipa, ka tunga na lung himawna bang ahiei? ka khelnate hing theidoh sah ding leh ka tapa hing thalia pieh dinga hing pei na! hiei mah?” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh amapa’n a kungah, “Na tapa hingpe vawi” achia, tuachi’n apomlai alahpieh a, ama umna pindan tung ah apomtou a, ama lupna tung vateh ah a siel hi"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa han in akikou a, “Aw Mangpa ka Pasian, ka umna meithainu tungah zong, atapa that a chimawna tungsah ding na hiei mah?” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n naupang tungah thumvei akhupboh a, Mangpa ahan a, “Aw Mangpa ka Pasian, hepitahin tam naupang hinna, ama sungah hing umsah kia in” achi hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 4.34,35"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Elijah kikou aw a zata a; tuachi’n naupang hinna ama ah ahing um kia a, ahing haldohkia ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuabepin Elijah in naupang khu ala a, ama pindan akipat in inn sungah azawpi suh a, anu apie hi, tuachi’n Elijah in, “En in, na tapa adam kiata hi!” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n numei in Elijah kungah, “Tuin vang tami ziehin Pasian mi na hi chi leh, na kam a Mangpa thupawt khu thutah ahi chi ka thei chienta hi,” achi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh nitampi nua in hichi ahing hia, khokhal kum thum chin kumin Elijah kungah Mangpa thu ahing tunga, “Pei inlen Ahab kungah vakilang inlen leitung ah guo hing zusah ding ka hi,” vachi in.","title":"Elijah Ahab toh kimu dingin akuon"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elijah khu Ahab toh kimu dingin akuonta hi. Tualeh Samaria khopi ah kiel anase mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Ahab in a innsung vaihawmpa Obadiah ahan a; Obadiah khu Pasian giing mi ahi,"},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen hichi ahi a, Jezebel in Mangpa guolneite abantha lai in, Obadiah in guolnei za khat azawpi a, sawm nga nga in leihawm ah aphuol a, tanghou leh tui in avaa zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahab in Obadiah kungah, “Pei inlen gamsunga tuinah umnate, luita dung zousie va sui vawiin, sakol leh sabiltungte i huhhing theina dingin loupa imu pieh thei kha ei mah, tuachilouin gantate itaan sieng kha ding uhi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n gam totsuoh ding akihawm ua, Ahab pen lampi dang khatah amatangin apei a, tualeh Obadiah zong amatang ma in lampi dang khat ah apei hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachia Obadiah apei laiin, Elijah toh thakhat in akituoh ua; Obadiah in ama atheina lai a, tuachi’n akhupboha akungah, “Ka pu Elijah hina teh izaw?” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elijah in adawnga, “Ka hina hi, Pei inlen, Elijah tanah aum hi chiin na pu vahil in,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh aman akungah, “Bang khelna ka nei a, na suoh Ahab kunga ahing tha dinga, na hing pieh khiet ding ahiei mah?"},"10":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian hinna louin ka gen ahi, ka puin nang ahing suisah louna nam leh gam mawngmawng a um sih hi. Tanah aum sih achi chiengun nang ahing mulouna thu uah gam leh namte akichiemsah zel hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuin nang kuon inlen, “Elijah tanah aum hi” chiin na pu va hilin nachi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, Nang ka hing nuasie tahin, Mangpa Hagau in ka theilouna mun khat ah ahing na lamang dinga; tuachia Ahab kava hil ngal a, nang ahing muthei sih leh vang, kei hing that mai ding ahi; hinanleh na suohpa in ka tangvalnou apat in Mangpa zaudan siem zingmi ka hi."},"13":{"text":"Jezebel in Mangpa guolneite abantha lai a, ka silbawl Mangpa guolneite za khat, sawmnga nga leihawm sunga tanghou leh tui a kava dante ka pu kunga hing hillou uh ahiei mah?"},"14":{"text":"Tuin nang pei inlen, “Ngai in Elijah tanah aum hi chi’n napu vahil in nang chi mawh a, ahing na that ngeingei ding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elijah in akungah “Amasanga kadin zingna galkapte Mangpa hinna louin ka gen ahi, tunin akungah keima ngel ka kilah ding ahi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Obadiah Ahab houpi dingin akuon a, ava hilta a; tuachi’n Ahab Elijah mu tumin akuon kheta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hia, Ahab in Elijah ava mu laitahin, Ahab in akungah “Nang hite izaw, Israelte subuoipa?” achi hi.","title":"Elijah leh Ahab kimuna: Elijah in atawhna"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Elijah in adawnga, “Ken Israelte ka subuoi sih a, hinanleh nang leh na pa innkuonten na suhbuoi uh ahi zawbou hi; Mangpa thupiehte na taisan ua, Baal na zui zieh uh, ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, Israel mite zousie leh Baal guolnei zali leh sawm ngate tualeh Asher guolnei Jezebel dawkan a annkuong iim zelzel zali te ka kunga Karmel muol ah va hankhawm in,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahab in Israel tate zousie kungah mi asawl a, Karmel muol ah guolneite ahankhawm hi."},"21":{"text":"Elijah in mipite zousie anai a, akung uah, “Ngaidan ni saikah a, avanglah a bang tan vei um ding na hi uoi? Mangpa khu Pasian ahi leh zui unlen; hinanleh Baal ahilelah ama zui zaw un,” achi hi. Mipiten kamkhat in zong adawng sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elijah in mipite kungah, “Mangpa guolnei umsun kei maimai ka hi a; Baal guolneite zali leh sawmnga ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin bawngtal ni hing pie unlen; tualeh amaun atan dingun bawng khat tel u’henlen, satguoi dil del uhenlen, sing tungah koi u’henlen, anuoi a mei tawlou in; tuachi’n akhat pen ken ka bawl dinga, singtungah ka koi dinga, anuoi ah mei ka koi sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n nouten na pasiente uh min han unlen, tualeh ken zong Mangpa min ka han ding hi; tuachi’n mei a hing dawng Pasian penpen Pasian hi heh,” achi hi. Tualeh mi zousie’n “Na gen ahoi hi,” achi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuin Elijah in Baal guolneite kungah, “Bawngtal khat tel unlen bawl masa un, nou atam zaw na hi uhi; tualeh na pasiente uh min han un, ahivangin anuoi ah mei tawsih un,” achi hi.","title":"Elijah Karmel muol a guol zawna"},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n akung ua kipie bawngtal khu ala ua, asem ua, “Baal aw hing dawngin!” chiin zingmawng a kipat in suntan dongin Baal min ahan uhi, Hinanleh aw zah ding a um sih a; tualeh bangma in adawng tuon sih hi. Tualeh amaitam bawl kim uah akitawm tawm uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh sun ahing hi bepin hichi ahing ahia, Elijahin amauh a enghou a, akung uah, “Hakou in kikou un, ama pasien ahia, akingaituo tadi ahiei, avahdoh zuai ahiei, khuolzin ahiei, ahisihleh a imu khattou hikha va, phawng unlen khanglou sah teitei un” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n aw ngai sem in akikou ua, abawl ngaina dan bangun, temta leh sia hiem ten si pawt zeng zungin aki-at gawp gawp uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh ni ahing kaai bepin hichi ahing ahia, nitah lam kithoi hun tandongin thu aphuong nalai ua, hinanleh dawnna aw mawngmawng a um sih a, dawngding leh ngaisahding mawngmawng zong aum sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elijah in mipi zousiete kungah, “Hing kikhin nai vawi un,” achia, tuachi’n mipiten a kunglam ahing zuon ta uhi. Tualeh aman Mangpa maitam chimzousa a siempha kia a."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh na min “Israel ahi ding” chia Mangpa thu tunna Jakob tapate nam za suong sawm leh ni ala a.","ref":"Siem. 32.28; 35.10"},"32":{"text":"Tua suongte in Mangpa min in maitam abawl a, Tualeh maitam kimkot ah buchi tena ni dawla lien in lei atou kuoh a."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh ahi ding bangtahin sing achieng khawm a, bawngtal asem neen a, sing tungah akoi a, tualeh “Bel li tuiin dim sah unlen, halmang sillat leh singte buoh khum un,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh “Buoh kia un” achia, tuachi’n abuoh kia ua; tualeh athum veina dingin “Buoh kia nalai un” achi a, tuachi’n athum veina dingin “Tui abuohbe nalai” uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n maitam kimkot ah tui aluonga, lei kitou kuoh ah avei denta hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh nitahlam kithoina lat hun laiin hichi ahing ahia, guolnei Elijah in maitam ava nai a, “Aw Mangpa Abraham, Issak leh Israel Pasian, Nang Israel gam a Pasian Na hi leh kei na suohpa ka hi dan leh tam silte Nangma thu a ka bawl ahi chi tuni’n thei chienta uhen."},"37":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, hing ngai khie inlen, ka thumna hing sanpieh in, Tam miten Nangma khu Mangpa Pasian na hia, alungtangte uh Nangma lam ah Na kileheisah kiata hi chi athei theina dingun,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa mei ahing kie a, halmang kithoina sillatte, singte, suongte, leivuite akatum sienga, tualeh lei tawkuoh sunga tuite zong atawp kangta hi."},"39":{"text":"Mipi zousie in tuakhu amutahun, akhupboh ua, “Mangpa Ama khu Pasian ahi, Mangpa Ama khu Pasian ahi,” achita uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh Elijah in akung uah, “Baal guolneite man unlen khat beh zong suohta sah sih un” achi hi. Tuachi’n aman ua, Elijah in kishon lui ah azawpi suh a khunah amaute athatta hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elijah in Ahab kungah, “Va peitou inlen ne in va dawn in, guo tampi zu ding husa a um hi,” achi hi.","title":"Lamdang tah in guo azuta"},"42":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ahab khu ne ding leh dawn dingin apeitou a, tualeh Elijah zong Karmel muolvum ah apeitou a, tualeh tuol ah akun suh a, akhuptegel kikal ah amai akoi hi.","ref":"Jak. 5.18"},"43":{"text":"Asuohpa kungah, “Peitou inlen tuipi lang va enta vawi,” achia, tuachi’n apeitou a ava en a; “Bangma a um sih hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Elijah in “Sagi vei kuon inlen va en in,” achi hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n a sagi veina in hichi ahing ahia, Tuanah “Tuipi akipat in meilum khal mihing khuttum chie khat, aleengtou vi-viei hi, achia. Tualeh ama’n va peitou inlen Ahab kungah, na sakolleng bawl inlen, pei suh tain, guo in ahing lap kha ding hi,” vachiin achi hi."},"45":{"text":"Tualeh tomkhat kallou in van khu meipi leh hui in adup kei kuita a, guopi thupi tah ahing zuta hi. Tuachi’n Ahab a sakolleng tunga tuongin Jezreel khuo ah apeita hi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa khut Elijah tungah aum a; tuachi’n apuon atenga Ahab masangah Jezreel kholutna tandong ataita hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Ahab in Elijah sil bawl zousie, namsau a guolnei zousie atha thu Jezebel ahilta hi.","title":"Pasian in guolnei gimsie a kepna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jezebel in Elijah kungah, mi asawl a, “Zingchieng tuhun vel a na hinna amau’lah a mi khat hinna banga ka bawl sih leh pasienten alaw law uh hing law u’henlen tua sanga zong nase zaw in zong,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh khum thu athei bepin adingdoh a, ahinna humbit tumin ataita a, Juda gam a Beer-Sheba khuo ava tunga, khunah a suohpa anuasieta hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh amatangin gamdai ni khat lam ah apei a, luonglau phung nuoi khat ah atou a, tualeh shi angenta hi, “Ahunta hi, Mangpa aw, tuin ka hinna la maita in, ka pute sang in lah ka hoizaw tuom sih hi,” achi hi.","title":"Elijah in shi alunggulna","ref":"Jon. 4.3"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n luonglau phung nuoi ah alum a, a i mut laiin, ngai in bakhat loukal in vansawlsiengin ama ahing khoi a, akungah “Thou inlen ne in” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n a en a, aluhung ah suongsa tunga ki em minsa tanghou leh tuithawl ana um a, tuachi’n ane a, adawn a, alum kiata hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa vansawlsieng ahing pei kia a, ama akhoikia a, akungah “Thou inlen ne in, na peina ding nanga dingin ahasa seng hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh athou a ann ane a tui adawn a, tua a ann neh huvangin ni sawm li leh zan sawmli ving veng lam apei zou a, Pasian muol Horeb atungta hi.","title":"Elijah Horeb muol ah"},"9":{"text":"Khunah suongkohawm sung khat ah alut a, azan giehta hi; Tualeh ngai vawi, Mangpa thu akungah ahing tunga, “Elijah tamna bang bawl na hiei?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akungah, “Mangpa galkapte Pasian adingin phatuom ka ngai mama a, aziehpen Israel taten lah na thuhun a leengatsan ta ua, na maitamte achim sah ua, na guolneite namsau in asatlia ta ua, aum sun kei mai mai ka hita hi, kei nangawn hing tha tum in ahing sui uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Rom. 11.3"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n akungah, “Pawt inlen Mangpa masangah khuna muol tungah va dingin,” achi hi. Tualeh ngai in, Mangpa khu ahing pei a, huipi hattah in muol leh taangte a sem khipoh a, Mangpa masangah suongpite apawhkeh ua, hinanleh hui lah ah Mangpa aum sih a, tualeh hui lanzou in zil ahing kilinga, hinanleh zil ling lah ah zong Mangpa aum sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Zil lin zou in meikuong ahing pawt a, hinanleh meikuong ah Mangpa a um sih, tualeh meikuong nua ah, aw ngat ngiungeu khat ahing pawt hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahi a, Elijah in tuakhu azahtah in, apuonin amai akhu a, ava pawtdoh a, suonghawm lutna kot ah ava dinga, tualeh aw in thakhat in, “Elijah, tanah bang bawl na hiei?” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Galkapte Mangpa Pasian a dingin phatuom ka ngai mama zela, Aziehpen Israel taten lah na thuhun ale-ngatsan ua, na maitamte asuchim ua, na guolneite namsau in asatlum siengta ua, aum sun kei ka hi a, ka hinna lah tumin ahing sui uhi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n akungah, “Peikia inlen Damaska gamdai lampi lang ah nua kiata in; tualeh na tun chiengin, Siria leengpa dingin Hazael sathau nu in.","ref":"2 Leeng. 8.7-13"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Nimsi tapa Jehu Israel leengpa dingin sathau nu inlen, tualeh nangma thahenga guolnei a pang dingin Abel-meholah khuo a Shaphat tapa Elisha sathau nu in.","ref":"2 Leeng. 9.1-6"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hidinga, Hazael namsau a kipat suohta pouma Jehu namsau in athat ding; tualeh Jehu namsau akipat suohta pouma, Elisha in athat ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel gam ah, Baal masanga khupdin ngai nailou leh ama tawp kha ngai nailou mi tul sagi kei a dingin ka koi nalai hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Rom. 11.4"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n khuna kipat apawtkhie a, Shaphat tapa Elisha ava mudoh a, aman bawngtal kop sawm leh ni masot a lou kaiin ana um a, asawm leh nina ama’n ana hawla, tualeh Elijah ava pei a, apuon ava se khum hi.","title":"Elisha hatna"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh aman bawngtalte anua sie a, Elijah anuadel a, akungah “Ka nu leh ka pa kava tawp phot dinga, tuazou chiengin ka hing zui ding,” achia, tualeh aman “Nua pei kia ta’n, ken bang kang law a ahiei?” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elisha ama nua zui lai anua kia kia a, bawngtal kopkhat ahawl a, agou a, abawng vante in ahuon a, mipite kungah apie a, aneta uhi. Tuachi’n adingdoh a, Elijah nua zui a, ana asep piehta hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siria leengpa Benhadad in agalkapte zousie akaikhawm a, ama lam ah leeng sawmthum leni apang ua, sakol leh sakolleng toh akuontou ua, Samaria khuo ava im a, asimta hi.","title":"Ahab in Siria leengpa Benhadad azou"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n khopi sunga Israel leengpa Ahab kungah mi asawl a, akungah Benhadad in “Tambangin agen hi."},"3":{"text":"Na dangka leh sana teng kei a ahia, na zite, na tate tualeh na nei hoipente zong kei a ahita chiin,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa’n adawnga, akungah, “Ka pu, Aw leengpa’n, na chi mabangin ka nei zousie toh nanga ka hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n ami sawlte ahing pei kia ua, a kungah “Benhadad in tambangin agen hi. “Na dangkate, na sanate, na zite, na tate nang pieh ding ahi,” chitanan leeng zong;"},"6":{"text":"Zing chieng tubang hun ding velin ka mite na kungah ka hing sawl dinga, na innsung leh na mite inn sung along ding ua, hoi na sah pouma akhut un ala ding ua, apomang ding uhi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa’n agam sunga upate zousie ahankhawm a, akung uah, “Tam mipan sil hoiloutah bawl atupdan na thei chiet ua, ka kungah mi ahing sawl a, ka zite, ka tate, ka dangkate leh ka sanate ahing ngen a, aniel ding zong lah hilou ing a,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh a upate zousie leh mipite zousiein akungah, “Ngaisah sinlen, lem zong sahpi sin,” achi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Benhadad mi sawlte kungah, “Kapu leengpa kungah, Na suohpa kunga mi sawl a na hing nget masah teng bangin bawlvangin hinanleh tam sil penvang ka bawl thei sih ding achi hi,” chi’n va hil un, achi hi. Tualeh ami sawlte apei ua, thu ava tut kiata uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Benhadad in akungah mi asawl kia a, “Ka nuazuite zousie in a khut dim a aham khop chiet uh zong Samaria khopi leivui ka khawipieh leh pasienten alaw law hinglaw uhenlen tuasanga nase zawin zong hing bawl mai heh,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa’n adawnga, akungah, “Mi galvan toh kivonlai kisuokhia bang zen in kiuongsah sih heh, chiin vahil un,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Benhadad in tam thu khu leeng dangte toh pindan sunga zu ana dawn khawm laiun ana za a, tualeh amite kungah “Kisa un,” achia, tuachi’n khum khopi dou dingin akisata uhi."},"13":{"text":"Khum hunlaitahin guolnei khat Israel leengpa Ahab kungah ahing pei a, akungah, “Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; Tam mipi tampite na mu ei? Ngai in tamte tuni’n na khut ah ka hing pekhe ding hi, tuachi’n kei Mangpa ka hi chi na hing thei ding,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Ahab in akungah, “Koi zang in lah?” achia, tualeh aman adawnga, “Mangpa’n hichiin achi hi,” gamkai a miliente tangvalte zangin achi hi. Tuachi’n leengpa’n kidouna “Koi in apan diei?” achi kia a, Tualeh aman adawnga, “Nangman,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamkai lamkai miliente tangvalte asim a, zani leh sawm thum leh ni ahi ua, tuazouin mipite asim ua, Israel tate zousie tul sagi apha uhi.","title":"Siriate tunga Ahab guolzawna"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n sunlaitah in akuon khie ua, tuahun laitahin Benhadad leh ama panpi leeng sawmthum leh nite khu thupiehna buh sungah zudawnkham in a um uhi."},"17":{"text":"Gamkaite a lamkai tangvalte akuondoh masa ua. Tualeh Ben-Hadad in enkhe dingin mi asawl a, tualeh amaun, “Samaria khopi apat in mite ahing pawtdoh uhi,” chi’n ahil ua."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Kilemna bawl tum a hing pawtdoh ahi u’leh ahing in na man unlen, kidou dinga hing pawtdoh ahi u’leh zong ahing ma in na man un,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam gamkai a lamkai milien tangvalte khu khopi akipat amauh nuazui galkapte toh apawtdoh ua."},"20":{"text":"Michin in amauh kituohpi chiet athat ua, tuachi’n Siriate ataizah ua, Israelten anuadel ua, Tualeh Siria leengpa Ben-Hadad khu sakol tungah sakol tungtuong mite toh asuohta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa akuon a, sakol leh sakollengte ava dou a, tualeh Siria mite tampi ava that hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Israel leengpa kungah guolnei ahing pei a, akungah “Pei inlen, ki suhat inlen; na bawl dan ding en in, chiemte inlen theiin, aziehpen, kum kihei a khallai ahing hi kia chiengin Siria leengpa’n hing dou kia ding ahi,” achi hi.","title":"Ahab in Siriate ni vei azawna"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siria leengpa suohten akungah, “Apasiente u’khu singtang gam pasiente ahi ua, tuazieh a ei sanga hatzaw ahi ua, hinanleh phaijang ah kidou lei vang ama u’sangin ihat zaw ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin tambangin bawl in: leengte apan mun ua kipat tawpsah inlen, amauh mun ah galkap lamkaite koi inlen;"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh na mansuo sa, galkapte, sakolte, sakollengte, sim inlen, na mansuo za za alien galkap pawl dingdoh sah kia inlen; tuachi’n phaijang ah idou ding ua, ihat zaw ngei ngei ding uhi,” achi ua; tuachi’n athu gen uh atahsang a, tuabangin abawlta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh akum kia khallai ahing hi kia tahin Ben-Hadad in Siriate akhawmkhawm a, Israelte dou dingin Aphek khuo ah akuontou uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate zong akikhawm ua, neh ding kengin Siriate dou dingin akuonta uhi. Israel tate khu amasang uah kelhon tawmnoukhat hon nia, kisuo bangin giehphuol asat nimnem ua, hinanleh Siriaten agam alei atuom suoh uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian mi khat ahing pei a Israel leengpa ahoupi a, akungah “Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, Siriate’n “Mangpa khu singtang gam Pasian ahia, phaijang Pasian ahi sih” achi ua, tuaziehin, tana mipi tamtahte khu na khut ah ka hing pekhe dinga, tuachi’n Mangpa ka hi chi nang thei ding hi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n ni sagi sung kimaituo in akingimtuo ua, tualeh ani sagi niin akidouta ua, tualeh Israel taten Siria galkapte nikhat in tul zakhat athat uhi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh adangte Aphek ah atai ua, khopi sung ah alut ua, tualeh a um sun mi tul sawmni leh tul sagite kulpi bangin achip khum hi. Tualeh Ben-Hadad ataimanga, khopi sunga inndan sung gil khat ah atai lut hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh asuohten akungah, “Ngai in, tuin Israel innkuonte lah a leengte khu mi lungsiet siemtah leengpate ahi uh chi ka za uhi, tuaziehin sai ip puon tengin ka lu ua khau a kikhi in Israel leengpa kungah hing va hawsah in, aman na hinna ahing khawi pieh nuom khamaw sih ding hi,” achi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n sai ip puon ateng ua, alutang uah khau akikhi ua, Israel leengpa kungah ava hawta uhi, akungah, “Na suohpa Ben-Hadad in, hepitahin hing hinkhawi heh achi hi,” achi ua, tualeh ama’n “Dam nalai hi maw, ama ka unaupa ahi,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua miten lungnuom tahin alungsim thu tah agen hinava chi gingtain, “Na unaupa Ben-Hadad hima e” achi pai uhi. Tuachi’n aman “Pei unlen hing zawpi un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Ben-Hadad ahing pawtkhie a, akungah ahing pei a, tuachi’n aman sakolleeng tungah ana tuongsah hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ben-Hadad in akungah, “Ka pa’n napa akipat a khopi ana lahte ka hing pekia dinga, tualeh ka pan Samaria khopi sunga summet bawlna munte abawl bangin nang zong Damaska khopi sungah summet bawlna munte na bawl ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Ahab in “Tuabang a thuhun bawlin ka hing pei sah ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n ama toh thuhun abawla apei sahta hi."},"35":{"text":"Guolnei tapate lah a koi ahiei khat in, Mangpa thu in a innvengpa kungah, “Hing sat in” achi a. Tuapan asat nuom sih a.","title":"Ben-Hadad akhawi zieh a Ahab khelna"},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akungah “Mangpa thu na man lou ziehin, ngai in kei apata na peidoh hun hun chiengin humpibahnei khat in ahing that ding hi,” achi hi. Tualeh apeidoh tahin humpibahnei khat in ana mu a, athatta hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 13.24"},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n midang khat ava mu a, akungah “Hepitahin hing sat in,” achi a. Tuachi’n ana sat a, asat liemta hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua guolneipa apawtdoh a, lampi ah leengpa ngah in ana dinga, atal gahna diel in amit khusahin ana kisiem lamdang hi."},"39":{"text":"Lengpa lampi a ahing peitahin, ana han a, akungah “Kei na suohpa kidouna phuol sungah kava haw a; tualeh ngai in mi khat hing kihei in, mi khat ka kungah ahing zawpi a, tam mipa na vengin ataimang leh ahinna taangin na hinna na taan dinga, ahisihleh dangka talent khat na lieu ding ahi, achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Kei na suohpa ka pum buoi lahkal in ana peimangta hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Israel leengpa’n akungah, “Tuabang lien in, na tung thu nangman na kikhenta hi” achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Amit akipat atal gahna alem zuai a, tuachi’n Israelte leengpa’n guolneite lah a mi khat ahi chi atheita hi."},"42":{"text":"Aman leengpa kungah, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: suhmang ding a ka hamsiet sa na hakia zieh in ahinna taangin na hinna, amipi taangin na mipite na taan ding hi, chiin ahing chi hi,” achi hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuaziehin Israelte leengpa khu nguitah leh lungkimlou tah mai in Samaria khopi a a inn ah apeita hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tam silte nuain hichi ahing ahia, Jezreel khuo a um Naboth in, grep huon khat anei a tuakhu Jezreel kho sunga Samaria leengpa Ahab leeng inn kung nai a um ahi.","title":"Naboth grephuon"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahab in Naboth ahoupi a, akungah “Ka inn gei taha um ahi ziehin, annte louhing huon dingin na grep huon hing pie in, tualeh tami sanga hoizaw grep huon hing pe na vang ahisihleh hoi nasah zawh leh zong aman akituoh nasah zaza asum in ka hing pe mai ding hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Naboth in Ahab kungah, “Kapu ka pate gou nang kunga ka hing pieh ding Mangpa’n aphal sih hi,” achita hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jezreel mi Naboth in, tuabanga thu akunga agen ziehin Ahab khu nguitah leh lungkimlou tahin a inn langah apeita hi; “Ka pute gou kang pe thei sih ding” ana chi chinten hi. Tuachi’n alupna tungah alum a, alelam anga a, ann zong ane nuomta sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Azi Jezebel akungah ahing pei a, “Bang zieh a hichi lungkham na hiei ann leh tui nelou a na um tah lawm?” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman azi kungah “Jezreel mi Naboth ka houpi a, akungah na grep huon hing lei sahin ahisihleh pha nasah leh ataangin grep huon dang khat ka hing pe mai ding hi ka chi leh, ama’n ka grep huon kang pe thei sih ding chi’n ahing dawng hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n azi Jezebel in akungah, “Israelte tunga na thuneina tambang giap ahiei mah? Thou inlen ann ne inlen na lungsim kipah sah in; Jezreel mi Naboth grephuon khu keiman hingpe navang” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahab min in lai agiel a, asuoi namna in anam a, tualeh Naboth tenna khopi a milien te leh upate kungah ahah a."},"9":{"text":"Alaihah ann ngawl thu na phuong unlen, “Mipi lah ah Naboth sang tahin na koi unlen;"},"10":{"text":"Migilou thugen siem ni Naboth mai ah tousah unlen, Pasian leh leengpa na gensie hi chia theipitu dingin bawl un. Tuachi’n Naboth puidoh unlen suongin seplum un” chi’n agiel hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n atenna khopi mite, akhopi sunga teng upate leh milienten Jezebel in akung ua alaihah a agel bangin abawlta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ann ngawl thu aphuong ua, Naboth zatatna mun sang ah mipite lah ah atousah uhi."},"13":{"text":"Migilou thugen siem ni ahing pei ua, amai ah atouta uhi, tualeh Migiloute gel in mipite masang ah, “Naboth in Pasian leh leengpa agensie hi” chiin ahehta uhi. Tuachi’n khopi akipat azawpi ua, khopi pulam ah suongin a sep ua, ashita hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jezebel kungah mi asawl ua, “Naboth suongin akisep a ashita hi,” chi’n thu ava tutsahta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Jezebel in Naboth suongin asep ua ashita chi azah tahin, Jezebel in Ahab kungah, “Thou inlen, Jezreel mi Naboth grephuon ahing leisah nuomlou khu va neita in, aziehpen Naboth ahing nawn sih a, ashita hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachia Ahab in Naboth ashita chi azah bepin Jezreel mi Naboth grephuon vala a tang dingin kuon suh asawmta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu khu Tishbe mi Elijah kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Ahab shiding genlawhna"},"18":{"text":"“Thou inlen Samaria khopi a um Israel leengpa Ahab kimupi dingin kuon suhin. Naboth grep huon ah aum a, tuakhu nei tum a pei suh ahi."},"19":{"text":"Akungah Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, “Na that a, ahuon lahpieh nalai ding na hiei?” achi hi. Tualeh Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, Naboth sisan ui ten aliehna mun ngei ah, Nangma sisan zong ui ten alieh ding hi, chiin akung ah va gen in, achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahab in Elijah kungah, “Na hing mudoh ta maw, Aw ka melma pa?” achi hi. Tualeh aman adawng a, “Ka hing muta hi; Mangpa mitmu a sil hoilou bawl dinga na kizuataah ziehin."},"21":{"text":"Ngai in, na tungah sietna ka hing tungsah dinga, tualeh nangma kang phietmang dinga, Ahab akipata ta pasal pouma Israel gam a saltang hi in, zalen hitaleh ka sumang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Nangma’n na hing lungthah sah a, Israelte khelna na bawl sah ziehin na innsung khu Nebat tapa Jeroboam innkuonte leh Ahijah tapa Baasha innkuonte bangin ka bawl ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Jezebel tungtang thu zong Mangpa’n agen a, Jezreel kulpi bang gei ah uiten Jezebel ane ding uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 9.36"},"24":{"text":"Ahab innkuonte lah a mi khopi sung a shi pouma te uiten ane ding a, tualeh gam a shi poumate lah tungleeng vaten ane ding uhi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh azi Jezebel in a chiil sietna zieh a Mangpa mitmu a silgilou bawl dinga, apuma kizua Ahab bang lawmlawm koima dang aum sih hi."},"26":{"text":"Israel tate masanga Mangpa’n ana nawdoh Amorte gamtat mabangin milim kidahhuoite azui hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahab in khum thute azah tahin, a puonte abotkeh a, ann ngawl in sai ip puon asila, tualeh sai ip puon toh alum a, kingiemkhieh tahin apeita hi.","title":"Ahab kisiana"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thu Tishbe mi Elijah kungah ahing tunga;"},"29":{"text":"“Ka masanga Ahab kingaingiem khu na mu ei? ka masanga akingai ngiem ziehin khum silhoilou ama dam sungin ka tung sah sih dinga, hinanleh tua sil hoiloute atapa khangin a innkuonte tungah ka tungsah ding hi” achi hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n kum thum sung, Siria gam leh Israel gam kidou louin aum uhi.","title":"Siriate toh kidou thum veina (2 Khang. 18.2-11)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh akum thumna in, Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat Israel leengpa kungah ava hawsuh a."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Israel leengpa’n asuohte kungah, “Gilead gam a Ramoth ei a hinapi a, hinanleh tutan a Siria leengpa khut a kipat a lahpieh nuomlou a i um na thei uoi?” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Jehoshaphat kungah, “Ramoth Gilead a galdoudingin ka kungah nang kuon diei?” achi hi. Tualeh Jehoshaphatin, Israel leengpa kungah, “Kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pumkhat ihi ua, ka sakol leh na sakol zong pumkhat ahi ve uo le” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Jehoshaphat in Israel leengpa kungah, “Mangpa thu tuni’n hungaitadi in” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa’n guolneite mi zali tah ahankhawm a, akung uah, “Rimoth Gilead khuo dou dingin ka kuon tou diei, ka kuontou sih diei?” achi hi. Tualeh amaun “Kuontou in, Mangpa’n leengpa khut ah ahing pe ding hi,” achi uhi.","title":"Ahab guolnei zuoute (2 Khang. 18.4-11)"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Jehoshaphat in, “I doh thei ding Mangpa guolnei dang Tanah koima um nawnlou ahiei amah?” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel leengpa’n Jehoshaphat kungah, “Mangpa hing doh pieh ding mi khat Imlah tapa Mikaiah a um nalai ma ve, hinanleh ama ka muda mama hi, aziehpen ka tungtang thu aselam loungal ahoilam agen ngai vawt sih hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Jehoshaphat in “Leengpa’n tuabangin thu gen da leh,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa’n amiliente khat ahan a, “Imlah tapa Mikaiah kintahin hing pui in,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel leengpa leh Juda leengpa Jehoshaphatte Samaria khopi lutna kotpi kunga phuol zang ah a leeng puonte uh silin, a leengtoupha tuoh uah atou ua, tualeh guolnei zousien amai uah thumavang agen uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuin Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in sia kiite abawla, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, “Tam toh Siriate amanthai sieng masangsie un na sun ding, achi hi,” achi a."},"12":{"text":"Tuamabangin guolnei zousie in zong Ramoth Gilead ah, “Va kuontou inlen va lawching in Mangpa’n leengpa khut ah ahing pe ding hi,” achi chiet uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mikaiah han dinga asawlpa un akungah, “Ngai in, tuin guolneite zousie in thu khat a luongkhawmin ahoilam in leengpa kungah thu aphuong chiet ua, nang zong amauh gen mabangin, hepitah in gen mai in,” achi hi.","title":"Mikaiah thugen lawh adih na (2 Khang. 18.12-27)"},"14":{"text":"Mikaiah in, “Mangpa min in ka gen ahi, Mangpa’n ka kunga agente bou ka gen ding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa kung ahing tunga; Lengpa’n akungah “Mikaiah Rimoth Gilead dou dingin ka kuon ding uoi, ka kuon sih ding uoi?” achia, tualeh aman adawnga, “Kuon unlen va lawchingta un, Mangpa’n leengpa khutah ahing pekhe ding hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n akungah, “Thutah chilou ngal Mangpa min a genlou dingin, bangza vei atai ka hing kichiem sah?” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Israelte zousie ching ding neilou belam bangin muol le taangte a taizah a kithethang ka mu hi. Mangpa’n Tamten ching ding aneita sih uh, michin ama uh innlam chietah lungmuong tahin pei mai uheh achi hi,” achita hi.","ref":"Kisim. 27.17; Mat. 9.36; Mak. 6.34"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Israel leengpa’n Jehoshaphat kungah, “Ka tungtang thu ah aselam loungal, ahoilam mawngmawng agen sih ding, chi ka hing hil hilou ahiei mah?” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Mikaiah in agenbe nalai a, “Tuaziehin Mangpa thu ngaikhe in, Mangpa a Mangtoupha tunga tou ka mu a, van a mipite zousie aziet lam leh avei lam a toute toh.","ref":"Job. 1.6; Isai. 6.1"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n, Ramoth Gilead dou dinga va kuontou a, gal a shi dinga, koi in ahiei Ahab va sol lungdam ding? achi hi. Tualeh khat in thu khat agen a, a dangten thu tuom agen zel hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n hagau khat ahing pawt a, Mangpa masangah ava dinga, keiman ka sol lungdam ding achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa’n akungah bang na chi sol diei? a chi hi. Tualeh aman kava kuon dinga, aguolneite zousie kam ah zuou gen hagau in kava um ding achi hi. Tualeh Mangpa’n Nang va sol inlen zou zong nava zou ding hi, kuon pai inlen va bawl in, achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, en in, Mangpa’n tam na guolneite zousie kam ah hagau zuouthei a koia, tualeh Mangpa’n na tungtang thu ahoilou lam in agen zouta hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in ahing zuon a Mikaiah pheta ava beenga, akungah, “Mangpa Hagau in na kunga thu gen ding, kei heilanga ahing peisan ahiei?” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Mikaiah in, “Ngai vawi, dantan sunggila kibu dinga na lut ni chiengin na thei ding,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Israel leengpa’n “Mikaiah man unlen, khopi sung vaipopa Amon leh leengpa tapa Joash kungah peipi kiata un."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n hichi bangin achi hi, “Tam mipa suongkul ah khum unlen, lungmuong tah a ka hing pei kia masangsien, gimthuohna ann leh, gimthuohna tui nana pie un, achi hi,” chi un."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Mikaiah in “Lungmuong taha na hing peikia pouma leh Mangpa’n kei hing zanga thu genlou ahi ngei ding,” achi hi. Tualeh ama mama in, “Nou mipite aw, ana ngaikhe chiet ma di uo le,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa leh Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat Ramoth Gilead ah akuontouta uhi.","title":"Ramoth-Gilead a kidouna leh Ahab shina"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Israel leengpa’n Jehoshaphat kungah, “Ka hing kisiem lamdang dinga, tuachi’n kidouna ah ka hing pang ding hi, hinanleh nang pen in na leeng puon hing sil in,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Israel leengpa akisiem lamdanga, kidouna ah akuon touta hi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh Siria leengpa’n a sakollengte tunga thunei lamkaite sawmthum leh nite kungah “Israel leengpa chiloungal, mineu hiin milien hitaleh koima dou sih un,” chi’n thu apie hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n sakollengte tunga lamkaiten, Jehoshaphat amu tah un, “Israel leengpa hiva achi ua, dou tum in a imta ua,” tuachi’n Jehoshaphat akikou kheta hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh sakolleeng tunga lamkaiten, Israel leengpa ahisih chi athei tah un, ama nuadel lai akinua heisanta uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh koi ahiei khat in, tup tuom neilou in athalpi aluoi a akap leh Israel leengpa lum kawm kikaal akap kha a, tuachi’n a sakolleeng hawlpa kungah, “Kihei kuol inlen gal phuola kipat hing pawtkhietpi ta’n, ka liemta hi,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Khum ni’n kidouna ahuoise mama a, leengpa zong Siriate lang nga in asakolleng ah akingam hi, tuachi’n nitah lam in ashita hi. Tualeh aliemna apat asisan sakolleng sungah hawhtui vei abang hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua nitum ding kuon in galkapte lah ah, “Michin ama kho lam chiet ah, michin ama gam chiet ah, kipeita heh chiin, kikou a tangtoh na” a um tahi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa ashita, a, Samaria khopi ah apolut ua, Tualeh Samaria khopi ah leengpa avuita uhi.","title":"Ahab shina"},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi khat in sakolleng khu Samaria khuo a tuikhuh (numei kizuate kisilna zel) ah ava sawp a tualeh uiten asi ana lieh uhi, Mangpa’n akunga ana gensa mabangin."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahab tanchin dangte, asilbawl zousiete, asaiha innlamte, akhopi bawl zousiete, Israel leengte khang thu gelna laibu sungah atuong hilou ahiei mah?"},"40":{"text":"Tuabangin Ahab apulepate kungah a imuta a, tuachi’n atapa Ahajiah ama thahengin leeng in apangta hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Israelte leengpa Ahab, Israelte tunga leenga apan kum lina kumin Asa tapa Jehoshaphat Juda leengpa in ahing pang hi.","title":"Judate tunga Jehoshaphat vaihawmna (2 Khang. 17.1 ; 20.31)"},"42":{"text":"Jehoshaphat leenga ahing pan chiil lai in kum sawmthum leh kum nga ahia, Jerusalem ah kum sawmni leh nga, leeng in apanga, tualeh anu min Azubah ahia, Shilhi tanu ahi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh apa Asa lampite azui a, Mangpa mitmuin sil hoi leh dih abawla, aleengatsan sih hi. Hinanleh munsangte asuse sih hi, aziehpen mipiten munsangte ah sil alan ua, gimnamtui ahal zel uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoshaphat in Israel leengpa toh zong kilemna thuhun ahung hi."},"45":{"text":"Jehoshaphat tanchin dangte, asilbawltheidan atahlat thute, agaldou thute, Juda leengte khangthu gelna laibu sungah atuong sih amah?"},"46":{"text":"Tualeh apa Asa damlai a, pasal kizua um sunte agam apat in adelmang hi."},"47":{"text":"Khum hunlai in Edom gam ah leengpa aum sih a, uhpipa ten leeng vai ahawm mai uhi."},"48":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in Ophir a sana po dingin summet bawlna tembawte abawla, hinanleh Ezion Geber mun a tembawte asiet sieng tah ziehin akuon thei ta sih uhi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahab tapa Ahaziah in Jehoshaphat kung ah, “Ka mite namite toh tembawte ah kuon khawm sah lei-la,” achia, hinanleh Jehoshaphat a ut sih hi."},"50":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoshaphat apu apate kungah a imuta a, tualeh David khopi ah apute kungah avuita uhi, tualeh atapa Jehoram ama thahengin leeng in apang hi.","title":"Jehoshaphat shina"},"51":{"text":"Tualeh Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat leenga apan kum sawm leh sagi kum in, Ahab tapa Ahaziah Samaria khopi ah Israelte tungah kum ni leeng in apang hi."},"52":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa mitmu in silgilou abawla apa lampi leh anu lampi azui a, Israelte khelna bawlsah, Nebat tapa Jeroboam lampi azui hi."},"53":{"text":"Aziehpen Baal a zui a, abie a, apan ana bawl zousie mabangin, Israelte Mangpa Pasian ana sulungthah hi."}}}}},"12":{"info":{"name":"2 Leengte","shortname":"2 Leeng.","abbr":[],"desc":"Leengte laibu nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahab shinua in Israelte tungah Moabte ahel ua.","title":"Ahaziah tunga Pasian thukhen na"},"2":{"text":"Tuin Ahaziah khu Samaria khuo a, a inn pindan tungnung vathang kikal hawm ah akie a, aliemta hi; tuachi’n thangkou mi asawl a, akung uah, “Va peita unlen, ka liemna apat kadam kia zouna diei mah chi Ekron pasien Baal-zebub va dongta un,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa vansawlsiengin Tishbe mi Elijah kungah, “Kisa inlen Samaria leengpa mi sawlte houpi dingin va kuontou inlen, akung uah, Israel gam a Pasian a umlou zieh ahiei mah Ekron khuo a pasien Baal-zebub dong dinga na kuontou uh? va chi in, achi hi.","title":"Ahaziah kunga Elijah thugen"},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; Lupna na kaltou pen na kumsuh kia nawn sih dinga, na shi ngeingei ding hi” chiun, a chi hi. Tuachi’n Elijah akuonta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh ami sawlte akunga ahing kinuale kia tahun, aman akung uah “Bang dinga hing kinuale kia nahi uoi?” ana chi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, “Mikhat koute hing kimupi dingin ahing pei a, ka kung uah, Pei unlen nou hing sawl leengpa kungah nua kia unlen, akung ah, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, Israel gam ah Pasian umlou ahiei mah, Ekron khuo a pasien Baal-zebub dong dinga mi na sawl? tuaziehin lupna a na kaltou, na kum suh nawn sih dinga, hinanleh na shi ngeingei ding hi, va chi un, ahing na chi hi,” achi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Nou hing houpi dinga hing pei, tua thu hing genpa mi bangchibang ahiei?” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun adawng ua, “Ama mi mul theuthou ahia, savun kawng gahin akawng agah hi,” a chi ua; Tualeh aman “Tishbe mi Elijah avele,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 3.4; Mak. 1.6"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n galkap sawm nga tunga lamkai agalkapte sawm nga toh asawl a; tualeh ama muol vum ah ana tou a. Tualeh aman akungah, “Nang Pasian mi Lengpa’n hing peisuh in achi hi,” ava achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elijah in adawnga, galkap sawm nga lamkaipa kungah, “Pasian mi kahi tahpi leh van akipat in mei hing kesuh henlen nang leh na galkap mi sawm ngate hing katumta heh” achi a, tuachi’n van a kipat mei ahing kesuh a ama leh akalkap mi sawm ngate akatum siengta hi.","ref":"Luk. 9.54"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n sawm nga lamkai dang khat leh galkap sawm nga Elijah kungah asawl kia a. Tualeh galkap lamkai pa’n, akungah “Nang Pasian mi leengpa’n kintahin hing pei suh heh achi hi!” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Elijah in adawnga, akungah, “Pasian mi ka hi tahpi leh van a kipat in mei hing kesuh henlen, nang leh na galkapte hing katum heh” achi a, tuachi’n van akipat mei ahing kesuh a, ama leh mi sawm ngate akatum siengta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sepai sawm nga lamkai dang akalkapte sawm nga toh asawl kia zel a, tualeh khum galkap sawm nga dang lamkaipa akuontou a, Elijah mai ah ava khupdin a, akungah “Pasian mi aw, ka hinna leh tam na suohte mi sawm nga hinna na mitmu ah manpha tahen, chi’n ka hing ngen hi."},"14":{"text":"En in, van akipat mei ahing kie a, sawm nga lamkai nite leh a mite uh sawm nga tuoh toh akatumta uhi, hinanleh kei hinna pen na mitmu in hing manphata hen,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa vansawlsiengin Elijah kungah “Ama toh pei suhin; zausin,” achi hi. Tualeh ading doh a leengpa kungah ama toh apei suhta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman leengpa kungah, “Mangpa’n tambangin achi hi, Ekron a pasien Baal-zebub houpi dinga mi na sawl, Israel gam a thu doh ding Pasian a umlou zieh ahiei mah? tuaziehin lupna a na kaltouna akipat, na kum kia nawn sih dinga, na shi ngeingei ding ahi zaw hi,” achi hi, achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elijah in agen Mangpa thu bangin Ahaziah ashita hi. Tualeh Ahaziah in tapa anei lou ziehin, Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehoram leenga apan kum ni na in ama thahengin asanggampa Joram leeng in apangta hi.","title":"Ahaziah shina leh Jehoram leenga panna"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahaziah tanchin dangte, Israel leengte khangthu gelna laibu ah atuong hilou a hiei mah?"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Elijah pumpei a van a alahtou ding lai in Elijah leh Elisha khu Gilgal a kipat in apawtkhie uhi.","title":"Elijah meikuong sakolleng in alahtouna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elijah in Elisha kungah, “Hepitahin tanah ana umtadi in, Mangpa’n Bethel a pei dingin ahing sawl hi,” achi hi. Hinanleh Elisha in “Mangpa hinna leh nangma hinna louin kagen ahi, Kang nuasie vawt sih ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Bethel ah apeikhawm suhta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Bethel a um guolneite tapate Elisha kungah ahing haw ua, akungah “Tuni’n Mangpa’n nangma akipat na pu hing lahmang pieh ding ahi chi nathei ei?” achi uhi. Tualeh aman “Thei ma inge, sip khinkhien un,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elijah in Elisha kungah, “Hepitahin tanah na um tadi vawi, Mangpa’n Jerikou a haw dingin ahing sawl hi,” achi hi. Tualeh Elisha in “Mangpa hinna leh nangma hinna louin ka gen ahi, hing nuasie vawt sih vang,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Jerikou ah ahaw khawmta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Jerikou khuo a um guolneite tapate Elisha kungah ahing pei ua akungah, “Tuni’n Mangpa’n nangma akipat na pu hing lahmang pieh ding ahi chi na thei ei?” achi ua, “Aman theima ing e, sip khin khian un,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Elijah in akungah, “Hepitahin tanah na um tadi vawi, Mangpa’n Jordan a haw dingin ahing sawl hi,” achi hi. Tualeh Elisha in “Mangpa hinna leh nangma hinna louin kagen ahi, kang nuasie vawt sih ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n ani un apei khawmta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh guolneite tapate mi sawmnga ava pei ua, amauh lamnga in gamla kuom tah ah ava ding ua, tualeh amaute gel pen Jordan ah ading uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Elijah in apuon ala a, alomziela, tui asat a, tuachi’n alangkhat tuoh ah akikhenta a, tuachi’n ani un lei gaw ah apeita uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh agal kaizou tahun hichi ahing hia, Elijah in Elisha kung ah, “Na kunga kipata lahmanga ka um masangin, bang ahiei ka hing bawl pieh ding?” hing ngenin achi hi. Tualeh Elisha in akungah, “Hepitahin na Hagau tanni hing tang sah in” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 21.17"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Sil hasapi khat na hing ngen hi, hasa nanleh na kunga kipata lahmanga ka um laitah a na hing mu leh na tang ding hi; tuachilou in vang, na tang sih ding,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, azawhkhawm ua ahoulim lai un, tha khat in mei sakolleng leh mei sakolte ahing kilang ua, amaute gel ahing tuom khenta a; tuachi’n Elijah khu pumpeiin van ah apeitouta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Elisha in khum amu a, “Ka pa, ka pa, Israelte sakolleng leh sakol tungtuongte aw! chi’n akikou hi. Tualeh Elijah amu nawn sih a, tuachi’n apuonte aman a, abotkeh a phalni asuota hi.”","title":"Elijah hagau Elisha tungah aumta","ref":"2 Leeng. 13.14"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elijah puon hing kesuh zong ala a, tuachi’n anuakia-kia a, Jordan lui gei ah ading hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elijah puon hing kie khu ala a, tui asat a, “Elijah Mangpa Pasian hei a um atai?” achi hi. Tualeh tui asat laitahin ale langtuoh tuoh ah akikhenta a, tuachi’n Elisha agal kaita hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuin Jerikou khuo a um guolneite tapaten amu tahun, “Elijah Hagau khu Elisha tungah umta e,” achi uhi. Tualeh ama kimupi dingin ahing pei ua, tualeh amasanga bohkhupin chibai abuh uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh amaun akungah, “Tu’n en in, na suohten pasal hat mi sawmnga ka umpi ua, napu sui dingin sawl in, Mangpa Hagau in ala tou a, muol tung a hiei guom sung ahiei khatah akoi khat ahi maithei hi,” achi uhi. Tualeh ama’n, “Koima sawl sih un,” chi’n adawng hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh ama dinga zumhuoi khop a anget nua un, “Kuon sah tave ua leh,” achi khongkhong hi. Tuachi’n mi sawm nga asawl ua, nithum a sui ua, hinanleh amu zouta sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Jerikou khuo a ani tuon laiin, akungah ahing pei kia ua, aman akung uah, “Kuon sah sihun ka chi mawng hilou amah?” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum kho miten Elisha kungah, “Kapu un na theisa mabangin, tam kho mun anuom mama a, hinanleh atui ahoi sih a, agam ma zong bangma pien theilouna gam ahi,” achi uhi.","title":"Elisha sillamdang bawl na"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Tuithawl tha khat hing la unlen, asungah chi thun un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n tua khu akungah ahing tawi ua."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuikhuh ah ava haw ua, tua chi khu tui sungah ava thelut a. Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; “Tam tui ka damsahta, tubansie shina leh nausietna aum nawnta sih ding,” chiin achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elisha in agen ma bangin tua tui khu tuni tandongin ahoita hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tualeh khuna kipat in Bethel ah apeitou a, tualeh lampi a apei laiin, khuo akipat in pasal naupang pawl khat ahing pawtkhie ua, ama simmawtahin, Nang lu kieupa va peitouin, nang lu kieupa va peitou in” achi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n akinua hei a, amauh a en a, Mangpa min in awsie alaw khum a, tuachi’n gamlah a kipat in vompi ni ahing pawtkhie a, alah ua naupang sawm li leh ni ahing bottel uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n khuna kipat in, Karmel muol ah apei a, tualeh khuna kipat in Samaria ah a nua pei kiata hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat leenga apan kumsawm leh giet achin kum in, Ahab tapa Jehoram Samaria ah Israelte tungah leeng in apang a, tualeh kum sawm leh ni vaihawm in apang hi.","title":"Israelte tunga Jehoram leenga panna"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa mitmu in sil gilou abawl zel a hinanleh apa leh anu bang talawm vang ahi sih hi; ama penin, a pa’n ana bawl Baallim suong phute a pai mang hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Israelte khelna bawlsahpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelnate ah abeh chinten a; apeisan nawn sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Moab leengpa Mesha khu belam khawimi ahi a; aman Israel leengpa kungah belamnou tul za khat leh belamtal tul za khat amul toh kumchin in sie a sung zing hi.","title":"Israelte tunga Moabte helna"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Ahab shi nua in, Moab leengpa Israel leengpa tungah ahelta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum hunlai in Jehoram khu Samaria khuo apat in apawtdoh a, Israelte zousie akhawmkhawm hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n apei a, Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat kungah mi asawl a, “Moab leengpa ka tungah ahel a; Moab dou dingin ka kungah nang pei diei?” achi hi. Tualeh aman “Ka hing kuontou ding hi, kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat ihia, tualeh ka sakolte leh na sakolte zong pumkhat ahi uhi.” Achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Heilang lampi ah ikuontou diei?” achi a, tualeh Jehoram in adawnga, “Edom gamdai lampi ah” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa Juda leengpa leh Edom leengpa toh akuonta ua, ni sagi akuol pei ua, tualeh galkapte leh azawpi uh gantate adingin tui a umta sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa’n, “E heilah! Mangpa’n tam leeng thumte Moab te khut a pieh ding a ahing khopkhawm ahi ve maw,” a chi hi.","title":"Elisha in Juda leh Israel leengte aphawhna"},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Jehoshaphat in akungah, “Mangpa idoh theina dingin tanah Mangpa guolnei umlou ahiei mah?” achi hi. Israel leengpa suohte lah a mi khat in adawnga, akungah “Tanah Elijah khut tui a buoh zelpa Shaphat tapa Elisha a um hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoshaphat in “Mangpa thu akungah aum hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Israel leengpa leh Jehoshaphat leh Edom leengpa Elisha kungah apei suhta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elisha in Israel leengpa kungah, “Nang leh ken bang ahiei ibawl ding? napa guolneite kung leh nanu guolneite kungah vakipei ta’n,” achi hi. Israel leengpa’n akungah, “Peilou e, Moabte khuta pieh dingin tam leeng thumte Mangpa’n ahing pui khawm ahita,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Elisha in akungah “Ana ka sep galkapte Mangpa min in kagen ahi, Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat zatatlou hileng, nang kang en nuom sih dinga, mu zong ka hing mu nuom sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh tumging tum siem mi khat hing puiun,” achi hi. Tualeh tumging tumsiem mi in ahing tum tahin, Mangpa khut atungah ahing umta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh aman Mangpa’n “Tambang in agen hi; ‘Tam phaijang lei tawkuoh in dim sah un, achi hi.","title":"Elisha in tui leh guolzawna pieh achiem"},"17":{"text":"Mangpa mama in tambangin agen hi; Hui lang mawngmawng na mu sih ding ua, guo zuh lam mawngmawng zong na theikha sih ding uhi; hinanleh phaijang tuiin ahing dim dinga, tuachi’n noute leh na gantate u’leh na ganta khawi dangte un na dawn ding uhi, achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tam pen Mangpa adingin sil neu nou khat ahi bou hi; Aman Moabte zong na khut uah ahing pieh belap nalai ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh kulpi a ki im khopite leh khopi deihuoi te na suse ding ua, singhoi zousie na sat pua ding ua, tuikhuh zousie na hubing ding ua, tualeh gam hoi chinteng suongin na sep se sieng ding uhi,” a chi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh zingmawngin ann sillat hun ding velin Edom gam langa kipat in tui ahing luong suh a, agam pumpi tuiin adimta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Moabmite zousie in leengte amauh dou dingin akuontou uh chi azah tahun, galkap thei tengteng ana khawmkhawm ua, gamgi ah ana pang uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n zingmawng matah in athou ua, tualeh nisa in tuitung a sal a; Moab miten agal langkhat a a et u’leh tui khu sisan bang mai a san in amu uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh amaun “Sisan ahi, leengte ama u’leh ama uh kidou a, kithat ahi ngeingei ta ve uoh, tuaziehin Moab mite aw kisa un, agalvan lahte uh iva tuu ding uh,” akichi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte giehphuol ava tun tahun, Israelte Moabte dou dingin thakhat in akipan ua, tuachi’n ama sang uah ataizahta uhi. Tualeh Moabte that malam kawm in agam uah adellutta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n khopite a susie ua, agam hoi zousie uh michin in suongin asep ua, suongin adim siengta hi, tualeh tuikhuh zousie ahubing ua, sing hoi zousie aphua ua, Kir-Haraseth khuo a suongte maimai ahi akhoilou uh, hinanleh saili tawiten akimkot in a imkhum ua adou uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Moab leengpa’n kidouna khu ama ua dinga panna guollou a huoisie ahi chi athei tahin, namsau tawi mi za sagi apui a, Edom leengpa langa taidoh atuma, hinanleh ataidoh theita sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n atapa upa pen ama thahenga leenga hing pang dingpa khu kul dawn ah, halmang kithoina sillat in alanta hi; Israelte tungah alungthah mama ua, tuachi’n apeisan ua, agam lang uah akinuale kiata uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Guolneite tapate zite lah a khat in Elisha kungah, “Na suohnu ka pasal ashita a, tualeh na suohin Mangpa agiing mama hi chi na thei hi. Tualeh asum batnapa ka tapate gel ani ua a sila dinga pui ding in ahing kuon hi,” chi’n alungdonna thu genin avakap hi.","title":"Meithainu sathau suhpungna"},"2":{"text":"Elisha in akungah “Bang ahiei ka hing bawl pieh ding? hing hilin, na inn ah bang na nei ei?” achi hi. Tualeh amanu’n “Na suohnu’n sathau um khat chilou ngal bangma ka neisih hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman pei inlen, “Na innvengte bel awng zousie va kawm in, tawmnou khat kawm sin."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh inn sunga na luttah chiengin, na tapate toh kot kikha khum unlen, tuachi’n tua belte ah sathau sung inlen adim masa atuom in koi zelin,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n akunga kipat in apawt a, atapate toh kot akikhakhum ua, atapaten bel ahah zel ua amanu’n ana sung zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh bel teng ahing dim sieng bepin, atapate kungah “Bel hing lahbe nalai un” achia, tualeh amaun amanu kungah, “Bel a um nawn sih hi,” achi a, tuachi’n sathau akangta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu ava pei a, Pasian mipa ava hilta hi. Tualeh aman “Pei inlen sathau va zua inlen, na leiba sang inlen, aval um nalai tengin na tapate toh va khosata un,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh ni khat Elisha in Shunam khuo ava pha a, khunah numei neizoutah khat aum a, tualeh amanu’n ann ne dingin ana hou a, tualeh apei pouma chiengin khunah ann ne dingin alut zel hi.","title":"Elisha leh Shunam numei"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n apasal kungah, “Ngaiin, tam ikunga hing tung zingpa, Pasian misiengthou khat ahi chi ka theichienta hi."},"10":{"text":"Hepitahin inn tung langah Pindan neu khat bawl pieh vai in, asungah lupna khat, dawkan khat, touna khat leh thaumei khat ikoi pieh dinga, tualeh ikunga ahing pei pouma chieng in khunah atung zel ding hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh ni khat ava haw leh, tua pindan ah alut a, alumta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n asuohpa Gehazi kungah, “Tam Shunam numei hing han vawi,” achi hi. Tualeh avahat zouin amanu amasangah ava dinga."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh aman akungah, “En in, nang na hing dei sah seng senga, ken nanga dingin bang ka hing bawl pieh sam diei? Lengpa kung ahiei, ahisihleh galkap lamkai kungah hing genpieh leng na ut ei?” va chiin, achi hi. Tualeh amanu’n “Ka nam pite lah a teng ka hina hi,” chiin adawng hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akungah “Bang kang bawl piehta diei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n Gehazi in adawnga, “Tapa anei ngut sih ve, apasal lah a upata ngal a,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Va han vawi,” achia, tualeh ava hat zou in kotlam ah ahing dinga."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Kum kia tuhun chiengin tapa na pomta ding hi,” achi hi. Tualeh amanu’n akungah, “Ka dei aw pu, Nang Pasian mi in na suohnu kungah zuou gensih ve,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 18.14"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n numei agai a, Elisha in akunga agen bangin, akum kia tua hun ahingtun tah in tapa khat aneita hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua naupang ahing khang lien a, ni khat apa kungah bu atte kungah ava kuon a.","title":"Elisha in Shunam numei tapa shisa ahinsahna"},"19":{"text":"Apa kungah, “Ka lu, ka lu achi a” tualeh aman asuohpa kungah anu kungah “Vakoi in” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman naupang khu apuo a, anu kung ah ahing tut a, sun dongin anu phei tungah atou a, tuachi’n ashita hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh amanu apeitou a, Pasian mipa lupna tungah asiel a, kot akha khum a apawtta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n apasal ahan a, akungah, “Hepitahin tangvalte lah a khat leh sabiltungte lah a khat hing sawlin, Pasian mipa kunga kava tai a, ka hing pei kia pai theina dingin,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akungah “Bangzieh a tunia akunga va haw ding na hiei?” ha thalah ahi naisin, khawlni zong lah ahi sin, achi a, tualeh amanu’n “Ahoi mai ding,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n sabiltung tungah touna phaw apha a, a suohpa kungah “Kinaw inlen sabiltung muon pei sahsin, thu ka hing pieh sih nahpouleh hing vaigei sahsin,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n apeita a, Karmel muol a Pasian mipa kungah ava tunga. Tualeh Pasian mipa in amanu gamlatah a kipat in ana mua, asuohpa Gehazi kungah, “En in khunah Shunam numei ahing pei hi."},"26":{"text":"Hepitahin amanu kimupi dingin vatai inlen, akungah, Na dam nai? Na pasal adam nai? tualeh naupang adam nai?” va chiin achi hi. Tualeh amanu’n “Damna uh,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh muol a Pasian mipa kung ahing tun tahin akeng atu chintena, Gehazi in amanu sawnkhieh tumin ava nai a, “Hinanleh Pasian mipa’n bangma law sin, um sah khinkhian in, alunggim senga ahi, Mangpa’n kei akipat aphuol tadi a, ahing hil nai tadi sih hi” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n ka pu kungah “Tapa ka hing ngen kha amah? Hing sol sin kachi sih amah?” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elisha in Gehazi kungah “Na puon teng inlen kisa inlen ka chieng khut tawi inlen peiin, mi na kituohpi le zong chibai buh sinlen, mi dangin nangma chibai ahing buh u’le zong dawng sin, tuachi’n ka chieng khut khu naupangpa mai ah va ngam in,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh naupang nu in akungah, “Mangpa hinna leh nangma hinna louin, ka gen ahi, ka hing nuasie vawt sih ding hi,” achi hi. Tualeh adingdoh a, amanu azuita hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gehazi khu amautegel masangah ana pei a, tualeh naupangpa mai ah achieng khut ana ngam a, hinanleh aw leh zahna bangma a um sih hi. Tuachi’n Gehazi Elisha kimupi dingin anua pei kia a, “Naupang akhanglou sih hi” chiin ahilta hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Elisha tua inn ahing tuntahin naupang ashi sa ana hita, ama lupna tungah alum sah na lai uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n alut a, ani un kot akikha khum ua tualeh Mangpa kungah thu angenta hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh apeitou a, naupangpa tung ah aboh khum a, akam leh akam, amit leh amit tualeh akhut leh akhut a sutuo a; tuachi’n naupang chi-lah ahing lum hii hiei ta hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 17.21"},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n akum suh kia a, tualeh innsungah aviel vah kawi kawi a; tualeh lupna tungah akaltou kia a, naupang tungah abohkhup kia a; tuachi’n naupang khu sagi vei ahing hahthiei a, tualeh amit ahing hahta hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gehazi ahan a, “Tam Shunam numei hing han vawi” achi hi. Tuachi’n ava han a, tualeh amanu akunga ahing tun in, “Na tapa pomta in” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu ava lut a, akeng bul ah apua a, tuol a bohkhupin chibai abuh a, tualeh atapa apom a apawtdohta hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Elisha Gilgal ah ahing nuapei kia a, tualeh khum gam ah kiel atunga. Tuin guolneite tapate amasang ah ahing tou khawm ua, tualeh aman a suohpa kungah “Bel lienpi suong inlen guolneite tapate a dingin buchim huon pieh in,” achi hi.","title":"Elisha sillam dang bawl nite"},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute lah a mi khat gamlah a annte lou dingin akuon a, gam umgui khat ava mu a, tuana kipat in gam um a angdim tahin alou a, ahing puo a, bang ahiei chi theiloupi in a atnen a, buchim bel ah abuata hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n khuna umte neh dingin athuata uhi. Tualeh buchim aneh laitah un, akikou ua “Aw nang Pasian mipa bel sungah shi theina um bou e,” achi ua, tuachi’n ane theita sih uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Tangbuong themkhat hing tawi un” achi a, tualeh “Bel sungah asep lut a, tualeh aman mipite adingin thua un, ane theita ding uhi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n bel sungah bangma nehmaw ding aum nawn sih hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n Baal Shalisha akipat in mi khat ahing pei a, Pasian mipa a dingin barli butha masa pen a kibawl tanghou pheng sawmni leh bu vui-tha a ip in ahing tawi a, tualeh Elisha in “Tam mite neh dingin pie in,” achi hi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh asuohpa’n, “Bang e, mi zakhat masang ah tami bang kachi lui diei? Aman aneh ding un tam mite pie in, achi kia a, Mangpa’n tam bangin agen hi, ane ding ua akham val nalai ding uhi,” achi hi, achi hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n alui a, ane ua, Mangpa chi mabangin akham val nalai uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siria leengpa galkap lamkai Naaman khu Mangpa’n Siriate galzawna apieh ziehin, apu mitmu in mi zatat huoi leh ngaisanghuoi tah ahia, ama khu mihat leh hangsan zong ahia, ahivang in, phah natna nei ahi.","title":"Naaman suhdamna","ref":"Luk. 4.27"},"2":{"text":"Siria galkapte ahon hon in galdou in akuon ua, Israel gam akipat in numei naupang nou khat sal in ahing man ua, amanu’n Naaman zi nna asem hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n api kungah, “Kapu Samaria khuo a guolneipa kungah va hawleh chi tei ing e aw, aphah na suhdam pieh mai ding hi a,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Naaman apu inn ah ava haw a, Israel gam a naupang nu’n “Tambangin agen hi,” chiin apu avahil a."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Siria leengpa’n akungah “Tu’n kisa inlen vahawin, Israel leengpa kungah lai ka hah ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n akuonta a, dangka talent sawm, sana tang tul guh, tualeh kihenna puonsil sawm akeng a."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa kungah “Tua laihah tambang a kigel apieh hi. “Tam laihah na mumu chiengin, ka suohpa Naaman aphah nat na sudam dingin na kungah ka hing sawl hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Israel leengpa’n laihah khu asim tahin apuonte abotkeh a, mite sulia a hingsah kia thei “Pasian ka hiei mah tam mipan phah sudam dinga ka kunga ahing sawl mawh? Tuaziehin hepitahin ngaituo un, thuse bawla hing phin ahi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahia, Pasian mi Elisha in Israel leengpa’n apuonte abotkeh hi chi ana zahin, leengpa kungah mi asawl a, “Bang dinga na puonte botkeh na hiei? Ama ka kungah hing sawlin, tuachi’n Israel gam ah guolnei a um chi athei ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Naaman asakolte leh asakollengte toh ahing pei a, tualeh Elisha tenna inn kotmai ah ava dinga."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elisha in akungah mi ahing sawl a, “Pei inlen Jordan lui ah sagi vei vaki die in, tuachi’n na tahsa ngaima na hing pota ding a; na siengthouta ding hi” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Naaman alungthah mama a, anua peikia a, “Ngaiun, ama ka kungah ahing pei dinga, Mangpa a Pasian min ahing lou dinga, akhut apha nate tungah koi in pha hingdam sah va chi ngel hima vengin maw, achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Abana leh Pharpar, Damaska luite, Israel gam luite sangin ahoizaw sih amah? tuate a kisil in ka kisusiengthou theisih ding amah?” achi hi. Tuachi’n akilehei a, lungthah pum in apeita hi."},"13":{"text":"Asuohten Naaman ava zuon ua, akungah “Pu aw, guolnei in sil thupitah bawl in ahing chi leh nang bawllou ding na hiei mah? va kisil inlen siengthou in achi kalval bang hing chileh chinalai na hiei mah?” achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n apei suh a, Pasian mipa gen bangin Jordan lui ah sagi vei ava kidie a, atahsa naungeh chilah bangmai ahing hita a, asiengthouta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Naaman leh a lawite zousie Pasian mipa kungah, anua peikia ua, atun tahun amasangah ava dinga, akungah, “Ngai in, tam Israel gamsung chilou ngal, leitung pumpi ah Pasian aum sih chi ka theita, hi, tuaziehin na suohpa kipahmante hing sanpieh in,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh guolnei in adawnga, “Ana ka sep Mangpa min in ka gen ahi, khat zong kala sih ding” achi a. Naaman in la maive chi’n angen va ngua a hinanleh ala nuom sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Naaman in, “Ahi sihleh kei na suohpa kungah leitang sabiltung puoh ni hepitahin hing pie in; aziehpen na suohin tua kipat in Mangpa kungah chilou ngal pasien dangte kungah sillat leh halmang kithoina mawngmawng ka lan nawn sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tam sil tungah Mangpa’n na suohpa ngaidam heh; ka pu leengpa Siriate pasien be dinga Rimmon biehinn a ka zawpi a, kei zong kava bieh a, Rimmon biehinn a kava kuontah chieng in Mangpa’n hing ngaidam heh, achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elisha in “Lungmuong tahin peita’n,” achi a, tuachi’n akunga kipat apeita a, bangtan ahiei apei manta hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian mi Elisha suohpa Gehazi in, amaleh ama kihou in, “En vawi, Siria mi Naaman hing sil tawite khat zong lalou in anua pei sah kiata a; Mangpa hinna louin ka gen ahi, kava nuadel dinga, bang ahiei khat beeh kava lah pieh ding,” achi hi.","title":"Gehazi khelna leh khelman"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gehazi in Naaman ava nuadelta hi.
