Tualeh Naaman in koi ahiei in adel ana mu tahin na houpi tumin sakolleng tunga kipat in ana kum khie a, “Thuhoi lam ahi naima?” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Gehazi in, “Hoilam thu hi e, a tahtah in kapu’n, Ephraim singtang gam a kipat in, guolnei tapate ni ka kungah ahing pei ua, hepitahin dangka talent khat leh kihenna puonsil ni, pie in, achi hi,” ava achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Naaman in akungah, “Talent ni la maive achi a,” tuachi’n la dingin azawl va ngua a, tuachi’n dangka talent ni leh puonsil kihenna ding ni toh ip ni ah athun a, asuohte mi ni in aposah a, amasangah apeipita uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Elisha tenna muol atun tah un Gehazi in tua ip nite akhut ua, kipat alakhie a inn sungah ama’n apolut a; tuachi’n mite apei sah a, akikhenta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh ama alut a, apu masangah ava dingta hi. Tualeh Elisha in “Hei a va hawta na hiei Gehazi?” achi hi. Tualeh aman “Na suoh heimah hawsing,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elisha in akungah, “Nang hing houpi dinga asakolleng tunga kipat tua mipa ahing kum suh laitahin hagau in na kungah ka um sih amah? Dangkate, puonsilte, Olive huonte, grep huonte, belamte, bawngtalte, suohpate leh suohnute lah hun ahiei mah?"},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin Naaman phahnain ahing man dinga, kumtawnin nahah nasuonte zong aman zel ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n akunga kipat vua banga vam in phahsa in apeidohta hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh guolneite tapate’n Elisha kungah, “En in, na kunga ka um khawmna uh inn khu kou a dingin aneu seng taluo hi.","title":"Heitang tui tunga kilaam"},"2":{"text":"Jordan lui ah ka kuon suh ding ua, khunah zawl khat chiet kava la ding ua, ka tenna dingun khunah mun va bawlta va ung aw,” achi ua. Tualeh aman “Va kuonta un,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n mikhat in “Na suohte kungah hing kuon sam ve,” achi hi. Tualeh aman “Hing kuon leng asih diei,” chiin adawng hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n akung uah ava kuonta hi. Tualeh Jordan lui atun tah un sing aphua uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh mi khat in sing aphua laiin, aheitang tui sungah aketa a, tuachi’n aman, “Ehei leh! pu mi hei kikawm pen ahi” chi’n akikou hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian mipa’n akungah “Hei laitah ahiei akiehna?” achia; tuachi’n akiehna mun a en sah a, tuachi’n sing tuoi khat asat a, akiehna mun ah apailut a, tuachi’n heitang tuitungah ahing kilaam dohta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Tawm aw le,” achi a, tuachi’n akhutin azam a, atawmta hi."},"8":{"text":"Siria leengpa’n Israelte akidoupi a, “Hei sung ah ina pang ding uoi” chiin agalkap lamkaite toh thu akikum uhi.","title":"Elisha in Benhadad siltupte agendoh zel"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian mipan Israel leengpa kungah, “Tuabang mun a va suohkhalou dingin pilvang un, Siria te hing pei suh ding ahizieh un,” chi’n mi asawl zel hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Israel leengpa’n Pasian mipa’n ahilna mun ah mi asawl a, ava enkhe sah zel a, khunah khatvei nivei mai zong hilou in akihumbit zel uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin tam thu ah Siria leengpa alungdong seng sengta a, tuachi’n asuohte ahankhawma akung uah, “I lah ua mi koi ahiei Israel leengpa lang a pang, nang hil nuom sih ding uh amah?” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh asuohte lah a mi khat in akungah, “Aw leengpa kapu aw, koima ka pang sih uhi; hinanleh Israel gam a um guolnei Elisha in, na pindan sunggil a na gente, Israel leengpa kungah ahil zel hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Hei sunga um ahiei, kamat sah theina dingin, kuon unlen va enkhie un,” achi hi. Tualeh Ngai in, “Dothan khuo ah aum hi,” chi’n ahil uhi.","title":"Dothan khuo a Elisha"},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin aman sakolte, sakollengte leh galkap tampi asawl a, zanlai in ava kuon ua, khopi kimkot in ava imta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Pasian mipa suohpa zingmawng matah in athou a, ava pawtkhieh leh, sepai honin asakolte u’leh asakollengte u’toh khopi ana imkuol suohta uhi. Tuachi’n asuohpan, “Ehei lah, pu aw! bang i suoh ta diei?” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Zau sin, amauh lam a pang sang in ei lam a pang atam zaw hi,” chi’n adawng hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Elisha in, “Aw Mangpa, amu theina dingin amit vah sahin” chiin angen a. Tuachi’n Mangpa’n tangvalpa mit avah sah a, tuachi’n amu theita a, tualeh Ngai in, Elisha kimkot a um taangte khu mei sakollengte leh mei sakolte in a dim phengphung mai hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siria galkapte akunga ahing tun suh tah un, Elisha Mangpa kungah thu a ngen a, “Tam mite amit uh tawsah in,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Elisha thungetna bangin amit uh atosahta hi.","title":"Siria galkapte mittawtna"},"19":{"text":"Tu’n Elisha in akung uah, “Tami lampi ahi sih a, tamsung zong khuo ahi sih hi, hing zui unlen, na mi suipa u’kungah ka hing zawpi ding hi,” achi a, hinanleh Samaria khopi ah azawpi zawta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Samaria khopi sung atuntah un, Elisha in “Aw Mangpa tam mite mit vahsah in, amu theina dingun,” achia. Tualeh Mangpa’n amit uh avah sah a, amu theita uhi. Tualeh amau’te Samaria khopi sungah ana umta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Israel leengpa’n ama uh a mu tahin Elisha kungah, “Pa, ka that diei? ka that mai diei?” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh aman “That laizang lou ve, na namsau leh na thalpi toh na salmatte pi na that ding amah? Ann leh tui amasang uah lui pieh inlen, ne in dawn uhenlen, apu u’kungah nuapei kia uheh” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n annkuong luina thupitah abawl pieh a, tualeh aneh ua adawn zou un, amaute asawldoh a, tuachi’n apu u’kung langah akinuale kiata uhi."},"24":{"text":"Khum nua in Siria leengpa Benhadad in agalkapte zousie akhawm a, akuontou ua, Samaria khuo ava imta uhi.","title":"Samaria khopi kielna"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh a im sawt seng zieh un Samaria khopi sungah kiel thupitah atungta a; ngai vawi, sabiltung lutang dangka sawm giet in azua ua, vakhu eeh kab khat seli suo sekhat dangka shekel nga in azua uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa kulpi dawna apei laiin numei khat in “Aw, leengpa ka pu hing panpi in” chi’n ana kikou hi."},"27":{"text":"Lengpa’n adawnga, “Mangpa’n ahing panpi loungal leh ken heisunga kipat in ka hing panpi thei mawh diei? buphuol akipat ahiei, grep chilna khuh a kipat in adiei?” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n akungah “Bang ahiei na buoina?” chi’n adong kia a. Tualeh amanu’n adawnga, “Tam numei in ka kungah, tuni’n na tapa ineh dingin hing tuoh in, zing chiengin kei tapa ine kia nasih diei ahing chia."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n kei tapa ka huon ua, ka neta uhi. Tualeh azing ni ken akungah Na tapa ineh dingin hing tuohta ve leh ka chia, hinanleh atapa aphuol mangta hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 28.57; Kaala. 4.10"},"30":{"text":"Lengpa’n tua numeinu thugen azah tahin apuon abotkeh a; kulpi dawna apeilai in, mipiten a et u’leh, en in apuon nuoi ah sai ip puon ana sil hi.","title":"Elisha in siltung ding atheimasa"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n “Leengpa’n tunia Shaphat tapa Elisha lu atahsa tunga aum nahlai pouma leh Pasian in alawlaw hing law mai heh, tua sanga zong thupi zaw in,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh Elisha a inn ah atou a, upate zong akung ah atou uhi, tualeh leengpa’n akungah mi khat asawl a, hinanleh ami sawlpa akunga atun masangin, Elisha in upate kungah, “Tam tuolthatpa tapa in ka lu la dingin mi ahing sawl chi na thei uoile? ham sih vawi un, ami sawlpa ahing tuntah chieng in kot na kha unlen, kotkha in na dal un, anua langah apu kal suon ging akiza lah abangin?” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuabanga amauh ahoupi laiin, a mi sawl pa ahing tungsuh a; tuachi’n leengpa’n, “Ngai in tam sil hoilou Mangpa hing sawl ahi; bang tan vei Mangpa ka hungai nalai diei?” achi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elisha in “Mangpa thu na ngai un. Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; zing chieng tuhun ding vel in Samaria kulpi kotkha bul ah tangbuong nel, tena khat shekel khat in azua ding ua, barli bu tena ni shekel khat in akizua ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Siria galkapte taizahna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkap lamkai akhut a leengpa kingapna khat in Pasian mipa adawnga, “En in, Mangpa’n van kottate ahon ding leh tambang silte apieng diei mah?” achi hi. Tualeh Elisha in, “Ngai in na mit in na mu ding a, hinanleh na nekha sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh kulpi lutna kotpi bul ah phah li a um ua, tualeh amauh khat leh khat akihou ua, “Bangdinga shi ngah giap a, tana tou ihi uoi?"},"4":{"text":"Khopi sungah lutvai chi leilah, khopi sungah kiel aum a, va shi giap ding ihi ua, tualeh tanah tou den leilah shi veve ding ihi ua. Tuaziehin kisa vawi un, Siria galkapte kung langah peivai in vakipekhe maivai in, ahing na hinkhawi u’leh ihing ding ua, ahing na tha u’leh lah ishi suh mai ding uh,” akichi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siria galkapte giehphuol a haw dingin khomiel zul in akuonta uhi; tualeh Siriate giehphuol tuoh masah ava tuntah un, koima ana um sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n Siria galkapte, sakollengte husate, sakol husate, galkap tampi husate bang ana za sah a; Tuachi’n “Ngai un, Israel leengpa’n Hit leengpa, Izipt leengpa te ei hing dou dingin aguoi ahita ve,” chi’n khat leh khat akihouta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin khomiel zul in adingdoh ua, ataizahta uhi, apuon innte uh, asakolte u’leh, asabiltungte uh agiehphuol ua a um ngaingai bangun anuasie ua ataizah santa uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tam phahte khu Siriate giehphuol geikhieng tuohmasah pen ava tun un, puon inn khat ah avalut ua, ane un adawn ua, tualeh dangkate, sanate leh puonsilte ala ua ava phuol ua, tualeh ang pei kia ua, puon inn dangah alut ua, ava nawndoh zel ua, aphuol zel uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n khat leh khat akihou ua, “I bawl dan uh adih sih hi, tuni tanchin kipahhuoi tunni ahi a, i sip den ua, zingmawng khovah ingah u’leh vang, gawtna bang ahiei khat itung uah ahing tung ding hi. Tuaziehin kisa un, leengpa innkuonpite iva hil ding uhi,” akichi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahing pei ua, khopi kotkha vengpa ahing han ua, akungah “Siriate giehphuol ah kava pei ua, ahileh koima mawngmawng ana um sih a, hinanleh sakolte, sabiltungte khisa in ana um ua, puonbuhte zong a um ngaingai in a um uhi,” chi’n ahilta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh kotkha veng mite tua thuhoi gen in akikou ua, tualeh amaun leengpa innkuon mite ava hilta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa zanlai in athou a, asuohte kungah, “Tuin Siriaten itung ua abawl dan uh ka hing hil ding. Igilkiel lamtah ahing thei ua, tuaziehin khopi apat a ahing pawt chiengun ahingin iman ding ua, khopi sungah ilut ding uhi, chia agiehphuol ua pat a kibu dinga kihemkhie ahi uh,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh asuohte lah a mikhat in adawnga, akungah, “Khopi sunga sakol um sunte nga koite ahiei in vala sah inlen. En in, Israel mipi dam nalai um sunte, ngen ahi ua, tualeh ama u’zong Israel mipi beimangsate bangbang ahi uh, ka chi ahi. Tuachi’n mi isawl dinga i enkhe sah ding hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin sakolleng ni asakol ni toh ava la ua, tualeh leengpa’n “Pei unlen va en un” achi a, tualeh Siriate gieh phuol langah enkhe dingin asawlta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jordan lui tandong ava nua del ua; tualeh atahtah in, Siria te akinaw zieh ua apaithang uh puonsilte leh neitah tampi lam tungtawn in athaang zengzunga, tuachi’n ami sawlte ahing kinuale ua, leengpa ahing hilta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite apawtkhie ua, Siriate puon innte ava lu ua. Tuachi’n tangbuong nel tena khat shekel khat in azua ua, tualeh barli bu tena ni Mangpa thu dungzui in shekel khat in azua uhi.","title":"Elisha thugen atang tunna"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n akhut angapna galkap lamkaipa khu leengpa’n kulpi kotkha veng lamkai dingin aguot a, tualeh kulpi kotkha ah mipiten amapa atuonchil ua, Pasian mipa’n akunga leengpa ava hawsuh lai a agen bangin ashita hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian mipan leengpa kungah, “Zing chieng tuhun velin, Samaria kulpi kotkhah bul ah, tangbuong nel tena khat shekel khat in tualeh barli butena ni shekel khat in azua ding uh chia ana gen ahing tangtung ta hi.”"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua galkap lamkaipa’n Pasian mipa adawng a, “Ngai in, Mangpa’n van kottate ahong ding adiei?” achi a, Pasian miin, “Ngai in namit in namu dinga, na nekha sih ding” ana chi khu;"},"20":{"text":"Agen dungzui in atang tungta a, mipi in kulpi kotkha bul ah atuonchil kha ua, a shi ta hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elisha in atapa shisa ahinsah pieh kia numei khu ahoupi a, a kungah, “Kisa inlen, nang leh na innkuonte na ten theitheina mun uah va teng tadi un; aziehpen Mangpa’n kiel tungsah ding ahi, tam gam ah kum sagi sung kiel tung ding ahi,” chi’n ana genta hi.","title":"Elisha leh Shunam numei","ref":"2 Leeng. 4.8-37"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n numeinu akisa a, Pasian mipa gen bangin abawlta hi, a innkuonpite toh Philistinte gam ah kum sagi ava tengta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh kum sagi bei nua in Philistin gam akipat in ahing nuapei kia ua; tualeh a inn leh lou nua nget kia dingin leengpa kungah ava hawta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualaitahin leengpa khu Pasian mipa suohpa Gehazi toh ana houlim ua, “Hepitahin Elisha silbawl thupite zousie hing hil in,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, naupang shisa ahinsah kia thu leengpa kunga ana gen laitahin, tua numei atapa ahin sah nu’n, leengpa kungah a inn leh lougamte ava ngen a. Tualeh Gehazi in, “Kapu Lengpa aw, tam nu ahi tua numei tualeh tam mipa ahi, atapa Elishain ahinsah kia,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n tua numei adonga, amanu’n zong agenta hi. Tuachi’n leengpa’n galkap milien khat aguot pieh a, “Amanu a nei zousie leh agam a pieng zousie toh, tam gam apawtsan akipat tuni tana te pekia siengun,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Elisha Damaska khuo ah ahing haw a, Tualeh Siriate leengpa Benhadad achina a; tualeh “Pasian mipa tanah ahing haw hi,” chi’n ava hil uhi.","title":"Ben-Hadad shi na"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n Hazael kungah, “Kipahman tawi inlen, Pasian mipa houpi dingin va kuon inlen, tua ka natna akipat ka dam zou kia na diei mah? Mangpa hing doh pieh heh,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hazael khu Elisha houpi dingin akuon a, kipahman dingin Damaska khuo a silhoi chinteng sangawngsau sawmli puoh khop akenga; amasangah ava ding a, akungah, “Na tapa Siria leengpa Benhadad in, tami natna akipat ka damdoh kia na diei?” chiin na kungah kei ahing sawl hi, achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Elisha in akungah, “Pei inlen akungah na damdoh kia na ding hi, va chi in; Bangtenghileh Mangpa’n ashi veve ding hi, chi’n ahing hil hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hazael a dinga zumhuoi khopin mit sal ha in a en den a, tuachi’n Pasian mipa akapta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Hazael in akungah “Pu aw bang dinga kap na hiei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n aman adawnga, “Israel tate tunga na silhoilou bawl ding ka theiziehin ahi; akulpi thupitahte uh mei in na halpieh dinga, atangvalte uh na namsau in na that dinga, ata neute uh tuol satna’n na nei dinga, anumei gailaite uh na phihkeh ding” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Hazael in “Kei na suohpa uital bep in tuabang sil thupi bawl thei ding ka hiei mah?” achia, Elisha in “Mangpa’n Siriate leengpa in na hing pang ding, chi ahing hil hi,” chiin adawng hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 19.15"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elisha kunga kipat in apeidoh a, apu kung ah atunga, apu’n akungah, “Elisha in na kungah bang ana gen ei?” ana chia, aman “Na damdoh kia ngeingei na ding hi chi’n ahing hil hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh azing ni’n puon sa thiep thuop khat ala a, tui ah adie a, amai atuom a ashita hi. Tualeh ama thahengin Hazael leeng in apangta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Israel leengpa Ahab tapa Joram leenga apan kum ngana kum in (khum hunlai in Jehoshaphat Juda leengpa ahi) Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehoram leeng in apanga.","title":"Juda leengpa Jehoram (2 Khang. 21.5-10 , 20)"},"17":{"text":"Lenga apan chiil lai in, kum sawmthum leh kum ni a upa ahi a, Jerusalem khuo ah kum giet vai ahawm hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahab innkuonte bangin, Israel leengte lampi azui a, Ahab tanu zi in anei a; tuachi’n Mangpa mit mu in sil gilou abawl zel hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahivang in Mangpa’n asuoh David ziehin Juda gam asuse nuom sih a, ama leh ahah asuonten vai ahawm zing ding uh chia ana chiemsa ahita hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 11.36"},"20":{"text":"A dam lai in Edomte Juda tungah ahel ua, a tung ua leengpa ding akibawl uhi.","ref":"Siem. 27.40"},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin Joram-Zair khuo tandong asakolleng zousie toh akuontou a, zanlai in akisa a, ama imkhum Edommite leh asakolleng hawl lamkaite ava sim a, hinanleh ama mite apuon inn langchiet uah ataizah ta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Edomte tuni tan in Judate tungah ahel nalai uhi. Khum hunlai mama in Libnah te zong ana hel uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoram tanchin dangte leh asilbawl zousie Juda leengte khang thu kigelna laibu ah akigiel hilou amah?"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoram khu apu leh pate kungah a imuta a, apu leh pate lah ah, David khopi ah avuita uhi. Ama thahengin atapa Ahaziah leeng in apangta hi."},"25":{"text":"Israelte leengpa Ahab tapa Joram leenga apan kum sawm leh ni kum in, Juda leengpa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah leeng in apang hi.","title":"Ahaziah Judate leengpa (2 Leeng. 9.29 ; 2 Khang. 22.1-4)"},"26":{"text":"Lenga apan chiilin kum sawmni leh kumni a upa ahia, Jerusalem ah kum khat vai ahawm a, tualeh anu min Athaliah ahia, Israel leengpa Omri tanu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Ahab innkuonte lampi azui a, tualeh Mangpa mitmu ah silgilou abawl hi. Ama Ahab innkote mahpa ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Ramoth-Gilead ah Siria leengpa Hazael toh kidou dingin Ahab tapa Joram toh akuon khawm uhi, tualeh Siriaten Joram ana suliem uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Joram khu Siria leengpa Hazael toh akidouna ua, Siriaten Ramah khuo a ana suhliem na uh khu Jezereel khuo a, kisudam dingin anua kiata hi. Tualeh leengpa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah khu Ahab tapa Joram adamlou ziehin ave dingin Jezreel khuo ah ahaw suhta hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh guolnei Elisha in guolneite tapate lah a khat ahan a, akungah, “Kisa inlen, tam sathau um tawi inlen Ramoth-Gilead khuo ah vahaw in.","title":"Israel leeng dinga Jehu sathau nuna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh nava tun chiengin, Nimsi tupa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehu va suidoh inlen, inn sungah lut inlen, tualeh aguolte lah akipat handoh inlen pindan sung gil lam ah lutpi in."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n sathau um la inlen, alutungah sung inlen, akungah Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, Israelte tunga leengpa dingin sathau kang nu hi, chi in, Tuachi’n kot hong inlen taikhie in, kihehsin,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n goulnei tangvalpa Ramoth-Gilead ah ava hawta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh ava tun tahin, galkap lamkaite ana toukhawm ua, tualeh akungah, “Aw lamkaipu na kungah thuvaihah gen ding ka nei hi,” achia. Tualeh Jehu in “Koipen kungah e?” achia. Aman “Aw lamkaipu nangma kungah,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh adingdoh a inn sungah alut a. Tualeh guolnei in Jehu lutungah sathau asunga, Mangpa Israelte Pasian in “Tambangin agen hi; Mangpa mipi Israelte tunga leengpa dingin sathau ka hing nu hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 19.16"},"7":{"text":"Ka suoh zawlneite sisan leh Mangpa nasemte zousie sisan phuba Jezebel tunga kalah theina dingin napu Ahab innkuonte na that gam sieng ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen Ahab inkuonte zousie abeimang sieng ding ua, Ahab hahlesuon pasal pouma, Israel gam a saltang hiin zalen hitaleh ka sumang ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahab innkuonte Nebat tapa Jeroboam innkuonte leh Ahijah tapa Baasha innkuonte mabangin ka bawl ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Uiten Jezreel khopi kulpi gei ah Jezebel ane ding ua, ama vuiding mi koima aum sih ding,” achia. Tualeh kot ahonga ataipawtta hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 21.23"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehu apu suohte kungah ahing pawt a, alah ua mi khat in, “Hoilam thu ahina amah? tua mi mopa bangchidan a na kunga hinghaw ahiei?” achi hi. Tualeh Jehu in akung uah, “Tua mipa na thei ua, athugen zong na thei uhi,” achi hi.","title":"Israel galkapten Jehu leengpa a aphuonna uh"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh amaun “Thei laizang sih unge, hinghil di ve,” achi ua. Tualeh aman “Tambangin ahing chi hi. Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, Israelte leengpa dingin sathau ka hing nu hi, ang achi hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n kintahin akisa ua, michin in apuontuol uh asut pialpual ua, Kellei tung ah apha chiet ua; “Jehu leengpa ahita” chi’n pengkul amutta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nimsi tupa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehu in Joram aguhin aphiela. (Siria leengpa Hazael ziehin Joram leh Israelte zousie in Ramoth-Gilead khuo aveng uhi.","title":"Jehu in Jehoram athat"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa Joram khu Siria leengpa Hazael toh akidou lai ua, Siria miten ana suhliem uh Jezreel khuo a kisudam dingin anua kiata hi.) Tualeh Jehu in, “Kei langa pang na hi u’leh, Jezreel khuo a tam thu gen dinga pei tumte, koima tam khopi a kipat pawtdoh sahsih unlen, suohtasah sihun,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehu sakolleng khat ah atuonga Jezreel khuo ah haw dingin akuonta hi, aziehpen Joram khuna lumden ahi. Tualeh Juda leengpa Ahaziah zong Joram vave dingin ahawsuh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Jezreel kulpi tungah galveng khat adinga, tualeh aman Jehu leh apawlte hing pei ana mua, “Mi honpi hing pei ka mu hi” achi hi. Tualeh Joram in “Sakol tungtuongmi amauh va dawn dingin sawl inlen aman, Hoilam thu ahinai? chi’n va dong heh, achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh va dawn dingin sakol tungtuong mi khat akuonta a, akungah, “Leengpa’n hichi’n achi hi, Hoilam thu ahinai?” achi hi, achia. Tualeh Jehu in, “Hoilam thu ah nang thei ding bang ahiei um? ka nua ah peiin,” achi hi. Tualeh galvengpa’n “I mi sawlpa akung uah ava tunga, hinanleh ahing kinuale kia nawn sih hi,” chiin ava hil a."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sakol tungtuongmi khat asawl kia a, tua mipa zong akung uh ava tunga, “Lengpa’n hichiin achi hi, Hoilam thu ahinai?” achi hi, achia. Tuachi’n Jehu in adawnga “Hoilam thu hileh hisihleh nang thei ding bang ahiei um?” ka nua ah peiin achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh galvengpan ama zong akung uh ava tunga, “Ahing nuapei kia nawn zel sih hi; tualeh asakolleng hawldan zong Nimsi tapa Jehu hawldan abang hi, azieh khu aman gumtah in ahawl hi!”"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Joram in “Ka sakollengte man sain koi un,” achi a, tualeh asakolleng man sain akoi ua. Tuachi’n Israel leengpa Joram leh Juda leengpa Ahaziah apawt ua; asakolleng tuoh ua tuongin Jehu dawn dingin akuon ta ua, Jezreel mi Naboth huon ah ava kituoh uhi."},"22":{"text":"Joram in Jehu amutah in, “Hoilam thu ahinai mah Jehu?” achi a. Jehu in adawnga, “Bang thu hoi e, Nanu Jezebel in kizuana leh dawithu abawl laisie in, hoilam thu bang ahiei um thei ding?” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joram akinua hei a, atai kawm in Ahaziah kungah, “Kiphiel guhna aum hi, Ahaziah!” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Jehu in athalpi theitawp in akuoi a, Joram liengkop tah akap a, athaltangin alungtang avut pailet suh a, tualeh asakolleng sungah a op denta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehu in agalkap lamkai Bidkar kung ah, “Domdoh inlen Jezreel mi Naboth huon sungah paiin, aziehpen apa Ahap nua a sakol tunga i ni a ituon lai a, Mangpa’n tam puohgih atunga angatsa ahita hi, chithei zing in, achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Mangpa’n zani’n Naboth sisan leh atapate sisan ka mu tahtah nahi achi a, tualeh tammun ma ah aphuba ka la ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Tuaziehin tuin dom inlen Mangpa thu bangin tam mun ngel ah paiin,” achi hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 21.19"},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Juda leengpa Ahaziah in tua sil umdante amu in Beth Haggan langah ataita hi. Tualeh Jehu in anua del a, ama zong asakolleeng sungah “That doh un,” achi a, tuachi’n Ibleam kho kunga Gur zottouna ah akapliemta uhi. Tuachi’n Megiddo ah atailut a, khunah ashita hi.","title":"Jehu in Ahaz athat"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh amiten sakolleng khat in Jerusalem khuo ah avapuo ua, tualeh David khopi ah, apute kungah ama han ngei ah avuita uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Ahab tapa Joram kum sawm leh khat leenga apan kum in Ahaziah Judate leeng in apang hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Jehu Jezreel khuo ava tung, chi Jezebel in anaza a; tuachi’n amitte anu a, asamte azem a, kotta ah ana en hi.","title":"Jezebel shina"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehu kul kotpi a ahing lut laitahin, Jezebel in, “Hoilam thu ahinai ma, nang, napu thatpa, Zimri?” ana chi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n kotta lam en in adahtou a, “Koi nahi uoi kei lam apang? Koi ahiei?” achi hi. Tualeh michilge ni leh thum in ama ana ensuh uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman amanu “Hing paikhe suhun,” achia, tuachi’n amanu apaikhe suh ua, tualeh asisan khu kulpi bangte leh sakolte tungah akithe zengzung hi. Tualeh aman akeng nuoi ah ana tuonchil hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh innsungah alut a, ane in adawn a. Tualeh “Pei unlen tam hamse thuohnu va kem unlen va vuita un, leengpa tanu ahi khu la,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n vui dinga ava kuon u’leh, alugu, akengbom leh akhutphang bomte chilou ngal amuta sih uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahing nuapei kia ua, Jehu ahilta uhi. Tualeh aman tampen, “Mangpa’n asuohpa Tishbemi Elijah zanga ana gen, Jezreel kulpi gei ah uiten Jezebel sa ane ding uh, Ana chisa ahi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 21.23"},"37":{"text":"Jezebel luong umsunte zong Jezreel khuo kulpi gei a, loulai a eeh kithezah bang mai ahi dinga, tuachi’n koiman tami Jezebel ahi, achi louna dingun, chia ana gen khu ahi,” achi hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Ahab in Samaria khopi ah tapa sawm sagi anei a. Tuachi’n Jehu in Samaria khut ah, Jezreel khuo a vaihawmte kungah, upate kung leh, Ahab tapate na kem a na khanglien sah mite kungah laithot agiela, ahahta hi.","title":"Ahab innkote achigapna"},"2":{"text":"“Tam laihah na mutah chieng un, napu tate na kung ua um ahia, tualeh sakollengte, sakolte, kulpi nei khopite leh galvante zong na nei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Na pu uh tapate lah a a hoipen leh chingpen teldoh unlen, apa leengtoupha ah tousah unlen, tuachi’n na pu uh innkuonte a dingin, dou un,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute azauta mama ua, “En un, leeng nite’n zong azawlou sa uh ahia, eiten ibangchi zaw mawngmawng diei?” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa innsunga vaihawm lamkaite, khopi sung vaihawm liente, upate leh naupangte na kema na khanglien sahten; Jehu kungah thu ahah ua, “Na suohte ka hi ua, bawlin na chi dandan in ka bawl ding uhi, leengpa dang koima ka bawl sih ding uh, hoi nasah bangbang in bawl in” chiin mi asawl uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua leh alaihah gel nivei na ah, “Kei lam a pang na hi ua, ka thu na zui ding u’leh napu uh tate lutang hing la unlen, zingchieng tu hunin Jezreel khuo ah ka kungah hing pei un, “chiin lai ahah kia hi. Lengpa tapate mi sawmsagi ahi ua, khopi sunga vaihawm liente leh ama uhna kemte kung ah a um uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n laihah amu tahun, leengpa tapate aman ua, mi sawmsagi athat ua, alutangte uh bawmlang sungah aguong ua, Jezreel khuo ah, akungah ahahta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n thangkoute ahing tungta ua, “Leengpa tapate lutang ahing tutta uhi,” chi’n ava hil ua. Tualeh aman kulpi lutna kotpi kungah “Mun ni in siekhawm unlen, zingmawng dongin um heh,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh azingmawngin ava pawtkhie a, adinga, mipi zousie kungah, “Na dihtat uhi, Ngai un, ken kapu ka phiella ka thatta hi; hinanleh tamteng pi koi tha ahiei?"},"10":{"text":"Ahab innkuonte tungtang thu a, Mangpa’n Ana gen Mangpa thu pelhem aum sih ding chi tuin thei un, Mangpa’n asuoh Elijah zanga agen ahing tangtung sahta hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehu in Ahab innkuonte Jezreel khuo a umsun teng, amilien zousie u’leh alawm kinaipi zousie tualeh asiempute khat zong hinkhawi lou in athatgam siengta hi.","ref":"Hos. 1.4"},"12":{"text":"A kisa a, apei a, Samaria khuo ah ahawta hi. Tualeh lampi a, belampute belam mul heuna inn ava tunin;"},"13":{"text":"Jehu in Juda leengpa Ahaziah sanggamte akituohpi a, akung uah “Koite nahi uoi?” chi’n adonga, Tualeh amaun “Ahaziah sanggamte ka hi uh; leengpa tapate leh leengpa nu tapate chibai buh dinga hing pei suh ka hi uhi,” chi’n adawng uhi.","title":"Lengpa Ahaziah sanggam te kithat"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Ahingin man un” achia, tuachi’n ahingin aman ua, belam mul heuna inn kunga lei kitou kuoh gei ah athatta hi; mi sawmli leh ni tah ahi ua, khat zong ahinkhawi sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh khuna kipat a apawtkhieh nua in, Rekab tapa Jehonadab ama dawn dingin sakoltunga tuongin ahing pei a; Jehu in chibai abuh a, tualeh akungah “Na tunga lungsim dihtah ka puoh bangin, nang zong na ponai mah?” achi a, tualeh Jehonadab in “Puo e, “chiin adawng hi. Jehu in ahileh “Na khut hinghahin” achi a, tuachi’n akhut ahahtou a, aman asakolleng tungah ana kaitou hi.","title":"Ahab sanggam um nalaite kitha-be"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh akungah, “Ka kung ah hing pei inlen, Mangpa adinga ka phattuomngai dan hing mu in” achi hi. Tuachi’n a sakolleeng tungah atuong sahta hi."},"17":{"text":"Samaria khuo ahing tuntah un, Elijah zanga ana gen Mangpa thu mabangin, Samaria a umsun Ahab innkuonte asuhmang masangsien athat zel hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehu in mi zousie ahankhawm a, akung uah “Ahab in Baal nna themkhat ana sem a, hinanleh Jehu in nasazaw sem in asem ding hi, achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, Baal zawlneite zousie, ana semte zousie leh siempute zousie, ka kungah hing hankhawm un, aziehpen Baal kungah kithoina thupitah bawl ding ka hi ziehin, ahing peilou pouma hinkhawi louding ka hi,” achi hi. Hinanleh Jehu in, Baal biete zousie athagam siengtheina dinga ngien a abawl ahi.","title":"Jehu in Baal biehna atawpsah"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Jehu in “Baal adingin khawmpi thupitah phuong un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n aphuongta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Jehu in Israel gamsung pumpi ah mi asawl a; tuachi’n Baal bete zousie khatzong kinuasie louin ahing pei ua, khat zong akimlou aum sih uhi, tualeh Baal inn ah alut ua, tuachi’n Baal biehinn akotlam apat aning tawng dongin aluodim phingpheng uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh kivonna puon kem mi kungah, “Baal be mite zousie kivonna puonte hing la in,” achia, tuachi’n kivonna puonte ahing la doh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehu leh Rekab tapa Jehonadab, Baal innsung ah ava lut ua, tualeh Baal bie mite kungah, “Baal be mite chilou ngal na lah ua Mangpa nna semte koima khat zong a umlouna dingin kisui unlen ki en kawi vawiun” achi ua."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh kithoina leh halmang sillatte lan dinga alut tahun, Jehu in inn pulam ah mi sawm giet apang sah a, akung uah, “Na khut ua ka hing pieh tam mite lah a koi ahiei khat suohta aumleh, ahinna taang uh nouma hinna in na lei ding uhi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh halmang sillat alat zou tahun, Jehu in galvengpa leh a galkap lamkaite kungah, “Va lut unlen va thatgam un; koima suohta sah sih un!” achi hi. Tuachi’n namsau in asatlia ua, tualeh galvengmi leh galkap lamkai pan, inpu lang ah apaikhie ua, tualeh Baal biehinn pindan sungah alut uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Baal inn a milimte ala khie ua, ahal tum uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Baal suongphute asat chim gawp ua, Tualeh Baal biehinnte asawnpua ua, tuni dongin eeh buh dingin azangta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuabangin Jehu in Israel gam a kipat in Baal asumang ta hi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelna, Israelte khelna abawl sahte atawpsan tuom sih a, tua khu Bethel leh Dan a sana akibawl bawngnou lim bieh khu ahi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 12.28-30"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Jehu kungah, “Ka mitmu a silhoi na bawl ziehin leh ka lungtang a um mabanga Ahab innkuonte na bawltah ziehin, natu natate khang lina tandongin, Israel leengtoupha ah atou ding uhi,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh Jehu in alungtang tengteng a, Israelte Mangpa Pasian danzui ding angaisah sih a; aman Israelte khelna a puasah Jeroboam khelnate atawpsan sih hi."},"32":{"text":"Khum hunlai in Mangpa’n Israelte anuasie panta a, tuachi’n Hazael in Israel gam zousie azou panpanta hi."},"33":{"text":"Jordan akipat suolam, Gilead gam zousie, Gadte Reubente, Manassehte, Arnon lui gei a Aroer akipat in Gilead leh Bashan gam tandongin."},"34":{"text":"Jehu tangthu dangte leh asilbawl zousie, asilbawltheina zousie khu Israel leengte khang thu gelna laibu ah a kigiel a siei mah?","title":"Jehu shina"},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Jehu khu apu apate kungah a imuta a, Samaria khuo ah avuita uhi. Tualeh atapa Jehoahaz ama taangin leeng in apang hi."},"36":{"text":"Samaria khuo a, Israelte tunga Jehu vaihawm sung kum sawmni leh kum giet ahi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Ahaziah nu Athaliah in atapa ashita chi athei bepin, akisa a, leengpa tate zousie athat siengta hi.","title":"Joash hundamna (2 Khang. 22.10-12)"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh Ahaziah tapa Joash khu, leengpa Joram tanu Ahaziah sanggam nu Jehoseba in leengpa tapa athate lah ua kipat apuimanga, adonnu toh lupna pindan ah aum sah ua, Athaliah mutheilou dingin aphuol ua, tuachi’n akithat kha sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama khu a donnu toh kum guh sung Mangpa inn ah phuol in aum ua. Tuachi’n khum gam ah Athaliah in vai ahawmta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh akum sagi na ah Jehoiada in Kerith mite leh galvengte lah a galkap za tunga lamkaite, ahan sah a, Mangpa inn a akungah ahing puilut sah a, tualeh thuhun abawlpi a, Mangpa inn ah akichiem sah a, tualeh leengpa tapa amu sah chiet hi.","title":"Joash Judate leeng in apang (2 Khang. 23.1)"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh ama uh thu apie a, akung uah, “Tam sil na bawl ding uh ahi; na lah ua khawlni a hing kuon dingte sethum suo sekhat in leengpa inn na veng ding ua;"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh sethum suo sekhat pen Sur kulpi kotpi ah na um ding uhi, tualeh sethum suo sekhat ma, galveng mite nua langa kulpi kotkha ah na um ding uhi, Tuachibangin suhsiet a aumlou na dingin inn ngah in na um ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh na lah ua, honni khawlni a nna sem a pawtdoh dingten Biehinn a um Lengpa na veng ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh mi chin in galvan na khut ua tawi chiet in Lengpa na im kimkot ding ua, tualeh koi zong na imkimkotna sung ua hing lut pouma na that zel ding uhi, tualeh leengpa alut leh apawt chiengin na zui kawikawi ding uhi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu Jehoiada in thu apieh bangin galkap za te tunga lamkai ten abawl ua, tualeh amauh pawlte chiet khawl ni a, hing kuon ding te leh khawlni apei dingte, apui ua, siempu Jehoiada kungah apei zel uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh siempuin galkap za te tunga lamkaipa kungah, Mangpa biehinn sunga um David teipi leh lum apie hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh galveng galkapten galvan tawi chietin Biehinn ning zietlam akipat veilam ning tan in, maitam leh biehinn kimkot in leengpa adin khum metmut uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoiada in leengpa tapa pulam ah ahing puidoh a, leenglukhu akhusah a, theipitu hina apie a, tuachi’n leengpa in abawl ua, sathau anuta uhi, tuachi’n akhut uh abeeng ua, “Lengpa damsawt hen,” achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Athaliah in galveng galkapte leh mipite husa azah tahin, Mangpa inn sunga mite kungah ava haw a.","title":"Athaliah kithana (2 Khang. 23.12-15)"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh a et leh, ngaina dan dung zuiin khuom zul ah ana dinga; tualeh leengpa kungah mi liente leh pengkul mutte ading uhi. Tualeh gamsung mi zousie kipah sengsengin pengkul amut uhi. Tuachi’n Athaliah in apuontuol abotkeh a, “Kiphielguhna, Kiphielguhna, ahi,” chiin akikou zahta hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.3"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh siempu Jehoiada in galkap za te tunga lamkai dinga kiguongte thu apia a, akung uah “Galkapte kikaal ah pawt sah unlen, koipou ama zuite namsau a satlia ding ahi,” achia, aziehpen siempupa’n “Mangpa biehinn sungah that sihun” ana chi zouta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu aman ua; leengpa inn huong sunga sakolte lutna lampi ah apei a, khunah athatta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoiadain Mangpa mite ahina ding un, Mangpa leh leengpa, tualeh mipite kikaal ah thuhun abawl a, tualeh leengpa leh mipite kikal ah zong abawl hi.","title":"Thuhun siemthana (2 Khang. 23.16—24.1)"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n agamsung mipite zousie Baal inn ah alut ua, asu chim ua, amaitamte leh amilimte asat nen dildel ua, tualeh maitam maiah siempu Mattan athat ua. Tualeh siempu Jehoiada in Mangpa inn veng lamkai ding mite aguot hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkap za te tunga lamkaite, galveng ding galkapte, tualeh mipite zousie azawpi a, tuachi’n leengpa khu Mangpa inn a kipat in azawpi suh ua, galveng galkapte umna kulkotkhah lutna lampi langah apeipi ua, leengpa inn ah atung ua. Tuachi’n leengpa leengtoupha tungah atouta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum gam a mizousie akipah ua, tualeh khopi buoilou in aumta hi. Tualeh Athaliah khu leengpa inn ah namsau in athatta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Joash leenga apan kipat chiil laiin kum sagi a upa ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehu leenga apan kum sagi na in, Joash leeng in apanga, Jerusalem khuo ah kum sawm li leeng in apanga anu min Zibiah ahia, Beer-sheba khuo mi ahi.","title":"Joash in temple asiemthana (2 Khang. 24.1 , 2)"},"2":{"text":"Siempu Jehoiada in athuhil sungsiein Joash in adamsungin Mangpa mitmu ah silhoi abawl ngitnget hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh mun sangte phiet mang sieng ahi tuom sih a, mun sangte ah mipite akithoi ua, gimnamtuite zong ahal nalai uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Joash in Siempute kungah “Mangpa inn a hing kitawilut, kithoina sillat siengthoute, kisimna sumte, mimal kichiemna sumte, ama kiphalna banga hing kitawilut sumte zousie;","title":"Ginna neilou siempute (2 Khang. 24.4 , 5)","ref":"Pawt. 30.11-16"},"5":{"text":"Siempu tengin ama u kung chiet a hing kithoite hing tawi sumte nala uhenlen; tuachi’n inn sietna zousie bawlpha uheh,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa Joash kum sawmni leh thum leeng a apan sung in zong siemputen tua inn sietnate abawlpha sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Joash in siempu Jehoiada leh siempu dangte ahankhawma akung uah, “Bangdinga Mangpa inn sete bawlphalou na hi uoi? Tu a kipat in na kung ua kithoi dia hing peite kunga kipat sum la nawn sih unlen, inn sie bawlna dingin pekhe zota un,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n siemputen mite kunga kipat a sum lah nawnlou leh inn sietnate bawllou pha asata uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu Jehoiada in singkuong khat ala a, asitna avutvanga, Mangpa inn lutna zietlam panga maitam siih ah akoi a, Mangpa inn a sum hing tawilut zousie khuna kotkha veng siemputen ana koilut pieh zel uhi.","title":"Bieh inn bawlphatna (2 Khang. 24.8-14)"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua singkuong sungah sum tampi aum chi atheitah un, leengpa lai giel mi leh siempu lien pen ahing pei ua, ip sungah akoi ua, Mangpa inn a sum um khu asim uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n asum sim uh Mangpa inn a nasem mite lamkaite khut ah ape khie ua; tualeh amaun Mangpa inn a nasem a um sing bawlsiem mite leh inn bawl mite thaman dingin ape zel uhi."},"12":{"text":"Suong khengte leh suong gielte kungah Mangpa inn sietna munte bawlphatna dinga sing leh suongte leh inn bawlna akul leh poimawna a zah dingin apekhe zel uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahivang in Mangpa inn sunga sum ahing tawite un, Mangpa inn a ding dangka kuongte, puontena bahte te leh tuithena noute leh pengkulte leh sana akibawl bel photphot ahisihleh dangka bel pouma abawl sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh tuate khu nasem mite kungah ape zel ua, tuate Mangpa inn bawlna in azang zel uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh nasem mite pieh dinga, sum akep sah mite uh zong a et zuipi tuom sih uhi, aziehpen ama un gin umtah in abawl zel uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 22.7"},"16":{"text":"Tatkhielna thoina sumte leh khelna thoina sumte khu, Mangpa inn ah ala lut sih uhi, tuate khu siempute tanvou ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 7.7"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siria leengpa Hazael akuontou a, Gath ava sim a, alata hi; Tualeh Hazael Jerusalem lam a kuon dingin akisa hi.","title":"Siriaten Gath alahna uh"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Judate leengpa Joash in Juda leengte apute, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram leh Ahaziahten ana latsa uh, silsiengthou zousie leh ama sil siengthou zousie, tualeh Mangpa inn leh leengpa inn a gou koikhawmna a um sana zousie ala a, Siria leengpa Hazael kungah ahah a, tuachi’n Hazael in Jerusalem anuasie a, apei kiata hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Joash tanchin dangte leh asilbawlte zousie Juda leengte khangthu kigelna laibu sungah akigiel hilou ahiei mah?","title":"Joash shina (2 Khang. 24.25-27)"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh amite akipan ua, a sawm dap ua, Joash khu Silla zot suhna lampi a Millo inn sungah athatta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ama mite Shimeath tapa Jozakar leh Shomer tapa Jehozabad ten athat uhi; tuachi’n apulepate kungah David khopi ah avui ua, tualeh atapa Amaziah ama thahengin leeng in apangta hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judate leengpa Ahaziah tapa Joash kum sawmni leh thum leenga apan kum in, Jehu tapa Jehoahaz Israelte tungah leeng in apanga, tuachi’n kum sawm leh sagi leeng in apang hi.","title":"Israel leengpa Jehoahaz"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa mitmu in silgiloutah abawla, Israelte khelna bawlsahpa, Nebat tapa Jeroboam gitlounate aman zong azui a, apeisan sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa lungthahna khu Israelte tungah a kuongzahta hi. Tuachi’n Siriate leengpa Hazael khut ah ape kheta, tualeh adam sung nite uh Hazael tapa Ben-Hadad khut ah apekheta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoahaz in Mangpa kungah nget chitahin angen a, tuachi’n Mangpa’n a thunget angaikhie a; Siria leengpa’n Israel te a bawl gen thei seng zieh in, tualeh a nuoisie nate athei hi.","title":"Jehoahaz kisiana"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siriate khut akipat asuotat theina dingun Mangpa’n Israelte kungah hundampa khat apie a; tuachi’n nidanglai mabangin Israel tate apuon inn uah atengta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Israelte khelna bawlsahpa Jeroboam innkuonte khelna ataisan sih ua, azuiden ua, tuachi’n sing a kibawl milimte khu Samaria khopi ah a um den nalai hi."},"7":{"text":"Jehoahaz khu amite lah ah, sakol tungtuong mi sawm nga leh sakolleng sawm leh galkap tul sawm chiloungal adang nei ding aphal pieh sih hi; aziehpen Siria leengpa’n asumanga, leivui chil buongbangin abawlta hi."},"8":{"text":"Jehoahaz tangthu dangte, asilbawl zousiete leh asil bawltheinate, Israel leengte khangthu kigelna laibu sungah akigiel sih amah?","title":"Jehoahaz shina"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoahaz khu apu leh pate kungah a imuta a, tualeh Samaria khopi ah avui ua, tualeh ama thahengin atapa Jehoash leeng in apangta hi."},"10":{"text":"Juda leengpa Joash leenga apan kum sawm thum leh sagi ahi in, Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash khu Samaria khuo ah leeng in apanga, tualeh kum sawm leh guh leeng in apang hi.","title":"Israelte leengpa Jehoash (2 Leeng. 14.15 , 16)"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa mitmu in silgilou abawla, Israelte khelna bawlsahpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelnate anuasie sih a, abawl zom zawsop hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoash tanchin dangte, asilbawl zousie, Juda leengpa Amaziah adou lai a, asil bawlthei dante, Israel leengte khangthu kigelna laibu ah akigiel a siei mah?"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoash apulepate kungah a imuta a, tuachi’n Jeroboam aleeng toupha tungah atou a, tualeh Jehoash khu Samaria khopi a Israel leengte kungah avuita uhi."},"14":{"text":"Elisha khu ashipi ding natna in achinata a. Tualeh Israelte leengpa Joash akungah ava hawsuh a, amasangah ava kapta a, “Aw ka pa, ka pa, Israelte sakolleng leh sakol tungtuong mite lamkaipa,” achi hi.","title":"Elisha natna: Joash in ava vena","ref":"2 Leeng. 2.12"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Elisha in akungah “Thalpi leh thal tangte la in,” achia. Tuachi’n aman thalpi leh thaltangte ala a,"},"16":{"text":"tualeh Israel leengpa kungah “Thalpi nakhut in tu in” achia. Tualeh aman atu a. Tualeh Elisha in Israel leengpa khut tungah atuhkhum hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n akungah “Suolam kotkhah hong vawi” achia. Aman ahonga. Tuachi’n Elisha in “Kaap in” achia. Tuachi’n aman akaapta a. Tualeh akungah “Mangpa hundamna thal, Siriate akipata hundamna thal ahi. Aphek khuo ah Siriate sumangthai khopin na zou ding hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Thaltangte la in” achia, tualeh leengpa’n ala a. Tualeh aman Israelte leengpa kungah “Tuol sun in” achia; Tuachi’n thumvei asun a akhawlta hi.","title":"Joash ginna tasam"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian mipa khu atungah alungthaha, “Nga vei guhvei na sut ding ahia; tuachi’n Siriate mangthai sieng khopin na zou ding hi, Tuin ahileh Siriate thum vei bep zou ding na hita ve,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Elisha ashi a, avuita uhi. Tualeh akumkia in Moab galkap honin agam uh ahing sim ua.","title":"Elisha shina: ahan a sillamdang"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, Mi khat avui kuon laitah un, galkap hon khat amu ua; tuachi’n tua mi shipa khu Elisha han sungah asep lut ua; tualeh aluong in Elisha gute asuh khah tahin, ahingkia a, adingta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Siria leengpa Hazael in Jehoahaz damsung tengin Israelte anuoisie ngitnget a."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n, Abrahamte, Isaak leh Jakobte kunga athuhun ziehin, amauh ahepi a, alainat a, angaisah a, amasanga kipat in asumang nuom sih a, akunga kipat apaikhe nuom sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siria leengpa Hazael ashita a, ama thahengin atapa Benhadad leeng in apang hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash in Hazael tapa Benhadad in apa Jehoahaz asim lai a, khuo alah piehte anua lah pieh kia sienga, Joash in thum vei azou a, Israelte khopite ala kia sieng hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel leengpa Jehoahaz tapa Joash leenga apan kum ni nain Juda leengpa Joash tapa Amaziah Juda te tungah leeng in apang hi.","title":"Amaziah Judate Lengpa (2 Khang. 25.1-4)"},"2":{"text":"Lenga apan chiillai in kum sawmni leh nga ahia, tualeh Jerusalem ah kum sawmni leh kuo leeng in apang hi. Tualeh anu min Jehoadan, Jerusalem mi ahi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa mitmu in sildih leh hoitahte abawla, hinanleh apu David abang zou sih hi; Apa Joash bawl bangin sil zousie abawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Bangtenghileh, mun sangte aphietmang sih a, mipite munsangte ah akithoi ua, gimnamtuite ahal nalai uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh akhut a leenggam suhkip ahing hitahin, apa leengpa ana that amite athat a."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh tuolthat tate, athat kha sih hi, Mosi dan laibu a, kigiel, tate zieh in pate suhlia ahi sih ding a, “Pate ziehin tate suhlia ahi sam sih ding hi; michin ama khelna ziehin ashi ding uhi, chia, Mangpa thu pieh bangin.”","ref":"Danp. 24.16"},"7":{"text":"Aman chi phaijang ah Edom mite tul sawm athat a, Selah khuo adou a, alata hi, tualeh amin dingin tuni dongin Joktheel akichita hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amaziah in Israel leengpa Jehu tapa Jehoahaz tapa Joash kungah, “Hing pei inlen kimaituo in iki en ding,” chia gen dingin mi asawl a.","title":"Israelte leh Judate kidouna (2 Khang. 25.17-24)"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Israel leengpa Jehoash in, Juda leengpa Amaziah kungah “Lebanon taanga lingin Lebanon taanga sidar sing kungah mi asawl a, Na tanu ka tapa zi dingin hing pie in, achia, tualeh Lebanon taanga gamsa ahing pei a, tua ling khu ahing tuonchilta hi."},"10":{"text":"Edomte nava zou ngut ma a, na lungsim a hing ki uongsah nahi tave, na thupina inn ah umpi khinkhian in, Bang dinga na sietna ding leh Judate nangawn in na kieh ngiem lawna ding uh, sil bawl kawi na hiei mah?” chiin adawng hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Amaziah in ana ngaikhe nuom sih a. Tuaziehin Israel leengpa Jehoash akuontou a, tuachi’n ama leh Judate leengpa Amaziah Juda gam a Beth-Shemesh ah kimaituo in aki-enta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Judaten Israelte azou sih ua, aguollelta ua, michin apuon inn lam chiet uah ataita uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa Jehoash in, Ahaziah tapa Jehoash tapa Juda leengpa Amaziah khu Beth-Shemesh ah aman a, tuachi’n Jehoash Jerusalem ah apei suh a, Jerusalem kulpi Ephraim kulkotkhah akipat kotkha ningta pen dongin tong za li asu chim hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa inn leh leengpa inn a gou koikhawm na a, sana, dangka leh tui uum bel suon zousie amu taphot ala a, Samaria khopi ah akinuale ta hi, tualeh aman thuchiem tangtunna dinga hentanga umte zong azawpita hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoash tanchin dangte leh asilbawlte leh asilbawltheidante, Juda leengpa Amaziah toh akidou dante, Israel leengte khang thu kigelna laibu ah akigiel asiei mah?"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoash apu a pate kungah a imuta a, Samaria khopi a Israel leengte lah ah avuita uhi. Tualeh ama thahengin atapa Jeroboam leeng in apang hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Juda leengpa Joash tapa Amaziah khu Israelte leengpa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash shi nua in kum sawm leh nga adam nalai hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amaziah tanchin dangte khu, Juda leengte lal lai khangthu gelna laibu ah agiel sih uh amah?"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem ah ama kalin aguh in thu aphiel ua, tualeh Lakish khuo ah atai a, hinanleh Lakish khuo a ama nuadel dingin mi asawl ua, khunah athatta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh aluong sakol in ahing puo ua, David khopi Jerusalem ah apu a pate kungah avuita uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Juda mipi zousiein kum sawm leh kumguh a upa Azariah azawpi ua, apa Amaziah thahengin leengpa in abawlta uhi.","title":"Azariah Judate leengpa ahina"},"22":{"text":"Aman Elath khuo abawl hoi kia a, Juda gam ah aum sah kia a, tuazouin leengpa apu a pate kungah a imu ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Juda leengpa Joash tapa Amaziah kum sawm leh kum nga leenga apan kum in, Israel leengpa Joash tapa Jeroboam Samaria khuo ah leeng in apanga, tualeh kum sawm li leh khat leeng in apang hi.","title":"Jeroboam nina Israelte leeng ahina"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa mitmu in silgilou pipi abawl zel a, Israelte khelna a na puilut pa Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelnate zousie ataisan sih hi."},"25":{"text":"Mangpa Israelte Pasian in asuohpa Gath-hepher khomi Amittai tapa goulnei Jonah zanga athu gen bangin, Hamath lutna akipata Arabia tuipi dongin Israel gam ah apang sah kia hi.","ref":"Jon. 1.1"},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n Israelte gentheina ahuoise mama chi athei a, saltang hi in zalen hita u’leh Israelte panpi ding koima aum sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Israelte min vannuoi akipat a suhmang ding ana genkha mawngmawng sih a; Joash tapa Jeroboam zangin ahundam zawta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeroboam tanchin dangte, a nasep zousie leh asilbawltheidante, agaldou thute, tu masang lai a, Juda gam a na um Damaska leh Hamath khopite, Israelte adinga ana nualah pieh kia thute, Israel leengte khangthu kigelna laibu ah akigiel asiei mah?","title":"Jeroboam nina shina"},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeroboam khu apu leh pa, Israel leengte kungah a imuta a, tuachi’n atapa Zekariah ama thahengin leeng in apangta hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel leengpa Jeroboam kum sawmni leh sagi leenga apan kum in, Juda leengpa Amaziah tapa Azariah leeng in apang hi.","title":"Azariah (Uzziah) Judate leengpa (2 Khang. 26.1-23)"},"2":{"text":"Lenga apan chiillai in kum sawm leh kumguh a upa ahia, tualeh Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga leh ni leeng vai ahawm hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh apa Amaziah bawl bangbangin, Mangpa mitmu in sil hoi tahtah abawl zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh munsangte phietmang ahi tuom sih a. Munsangte ah mite akithoi nalai lai ua, gimnamtuite ahal ngitnget uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n leengpa agawt a ashi todongin apha a, inn tuom ah ateng hi. Tualeh leengpa tapa Jotham in agam mite vai ahawm pieh a, leeng innsung vaihawm lamkai in apang hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Azariah tanchin dangte, asilbawl zousie Juda leengte vaihawmna khangthu gelna laibu ah akigiel hi lou a mah?"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Azariah apu a pate kungah a imuta a, tualeh David khopi ah apu apate kungah avuita uhi.","ref":"Isai. 6.1"},"8":{"text":"Judate leengpa Azariah leenga apan kum sawmthum leh giet kum in Jeroboam tapa Zekariah Israelte tungah Samaria khopi ah haguh leeng in apang hi.","title":"Zekariah Israelte leenga apanna"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh apa bawl mabangin Mangpa mitmu ah silgilou abawla, Israelte khelna bawlsahpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelnate apeisan tuom sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Jabesh tapa Shallum in ama aguhin aphiel a, mipite mai ah asuol a athat hi; ataangin leeng in apangta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zekariah tanchin dangte, ngaiin, Israel leengte khangthu gelna laibu ah akigiel hi."},"12":{"text":"Tam khu Mangpa’n Jehu kunga anagen, “Na tapate khang lina tanin, Israelte leeng toupha ah atou ding uh,” achi khu ahing tangtung tahi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 10.30"},"13":{"text":"Judate leengpa Uzziah leenga a pankum sawmthum leh kuo ahi in, Jabesh tapa Shallum leeng in apang hi, Tuachi’n ha khat pumlum leeng in apang hi.","title":"Shallum leenga panna leh shina"},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Gadi tapa Menahem Tirzah khuo akipat in akuontou a, Samaria khuo ah atunga, Samaria khuo ah Jabesh tapa Shallum ava satlum a, ama taangin leeng in apangta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n tanchin dangte a mi phielguhna thute ngai in Israel leengte vaihawmlai khangthu gelna laibu ah akigiel hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Menahem in Tirzah akipat in Tiphsah khuo leh asunga um zousie leh agamte ava sim hi, aziehpen ama un akotpite uh ahon pieh nuom sih uhi. Tuachi’n khopi sunga numei gailai zousie aphihkeh hi.","title":"Menahem Israelte leengpa ahina"},"17":{"text":"Juda leengpa Azariah kum sawmthum leh kum kuo leenga apan kumin, Gadi tapa Menahem Israelte tungah leeng in apang hi, tualeh Samaria ah kum sawm leeng vai ahawm hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa mitmu in silgilou abawla, adamsung tengin Israelte khelna bawlsahpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelnate atawpsan sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Asiria leengpa Pul in, agam ahing dou a, tualeh ama panpina anga theina ding leh aleenggam asuhhat pieh theina dingin Menahem in Pul kungah dangka talent tul khat apie hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Menahem in Asiria leengpa pieh dingin Israel mi hausate kungah Dangka shekel sawm nga chiet akhonkhawm a, tuachi’n Asiria leengpa akinuale kiata a, agamsungah a umdenta sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Menahem tanchin dangte, anasep zousie Israel leengte khangthu kigiel na laibu ah akigiel asiei mah?"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Menahem khu apu apate kungah a imuta a, tuachi’n atapa Pekahiah ama thahengin leeng in apangta hi."},"23":{"text":"Juda leengpa Azariah kum sawm nga leenga apan kum in, Menahem tapa Pekahiah Israelte leeng in apanga, tualeh Samaria ah kumni sung leeng vai ahawm hi.","title":"Pekahiah leenga panna leh shina"},"24":{"text":"Pekahiah in Mangpa mitmu in silgilou abawla; tualeh Israelte sil bawlkhiel sahpa, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelnate atawpsan dieh sih hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh galkap lamkai Remaliah tapa Pekah in ama aguhin aphiela, Argob leh Arieh toh Gilead mi sawm nga azawpi a; Samaria khuo a leengpa inn huongsungah, asuol ua, athatta ua, tualeh ama taangin leeng in apang hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Pekahiah tanchin dangte, anasep zousie Israel leengte khangthu gelna laibu ah akigiel hi."},"27":{"text":"Juda leengpa Azariah kum sawm nga leh kum ni leenga apan kum in, Remaliah tapa Pekah Israelte leengpa in Samaria khopi ah apanga, kum sawmni leeng vai ahawm hi.","title":"Pekah Israelte leenga panna leh shina"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa mitmu in silgilou abawl a, Israelte khelna bawlsahpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelnate atawpsan tuom sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Israel leengpa Pekah vaihawm laiin, Asiria leengpa Tiglath-Pileser ahing kuon a, Izon, Abel, Beth, Maakah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, khuote zousie leh Gilead leh Galili gamte leh Naphtali gam zousie ala a, tualeh amipite, Asiria gam ah sal in azawpita hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elah tapa Hoshea in Remaliah tapa Pekah aphiel gu a, tualeh adou a, athatta a; tuachi’n Uzziah tapa Jotham kum sawmni leh nga apan kum in, ama thahengin leeng in apangta hi.","title":"Jotham Judate leenga panna"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pekah tanchin dangte, asilbawl zousie, Israel leengte khangthu gelna laibu sung ah akigiel hi."},"32":{"text":"Israel leengpa Remaliah tapa Pekah leenga apan kumni na in Juda leengpa Uzziah tapa Jotham leeng in apang hi."},"33":{"text":"Lenga apan chiillai in kum sawmni leh kumnga a upa ahia, tualeh Jerusalem ah kum sawm leh kum guh leeng vai ahawma. Tualeh anu min Jerusha ahia, Zadok tanu ahi."},"34":{"text":"Mangpa mitmu in sildih abawla, apa Uzziahin ana bawl zousie mabangin abawl hi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanleh munsangte aphietmang sih a, munsangte ah mipite akithoi ua, gimnamtuite ahal nalai uhi. Aman Mangpa inn kotpi sahtazaw abawl hoi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jotham tanchin dangte, asilbawl zousie Juda leengte khangthu gelna laibu ah akigiel hilou a mah?"},"37":{"text":"Khum hunlai in Siria leengpa Rezin leh Remaliah tapa Pekah khu Judate dou dingin Mangpa’n asawl patna ahi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Jotham apu leh pate kungah a imuta a, apu David khopi ah apu leh pate kungah akivuita hi. Tualeh ama thahengin atapa Ahaz leeng in apangta hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Remaliah tapa Pekah, kum sawm leh sagi leenga apan kum in, Juda leengpa Jotham tapa Ahaz leeng in apang pan hi.","title":"Judate tunga Ahaz leenga apanna (2 Khang. 28.1-4)"},"2":{"text":"Lenga apan chiillai in Ahaz kum sawmni a upa ahia, Jerusalem ah kum sawm leh guh leeng in apang hi. Apu David bangin Mangpa a Pasian mitmu in silhoi abawl sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel leengte gamtat bangin agamta hi; Mangpa’n Israel tate masanga adeldoh namten sil kidahhuoi tah abawl zel bangun atapa mei ah kithoina in alan hi.","ref":"Danp. 12.31"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh munsangte, muoltungte, tualeh sing hing nuoi chintengah akithoi a, gimnamtui ahal zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siria leengpa Rezin leh Israel leengpa Remaliah tapa Pekah khu Jerusalem dou dingin akuontou ua, tualeh Ahaz a im ua, hinanleh azou sih uhi.","title":"Siriate leh Israelten Judate asim uh (2 Khang. 28.5-8)","ref":"Isai. 7.1"},"6":{"text":"Khum hunlai in Siria leengpa Rezin in Elath khuo Siria gam a dingin anualah kia a, Elath khuo akipat Judate adeldoh hi. Tuachi’n Siriaten Elath khuo ava luo ua, tuni tan in ateng nalai uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahaz in Assiriate leengpa Tiglath-Pileser kungah, “Na suohpa leh na tapa ka hi, kei hing dou dinga hing kuon Siria leengpa leh Israel leengpa khuta kipat hing hunkhie in” chi’n mi asawl a.","title":"Ahaz in Assiriate panpina angen (2 Khang. 28.16-21)"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Ahaz in Mangpa inn leh leengpa inn a gou koi khawmna a um dangka leh sana teng ala a, Assiria leengpa kungah kipahman dingin ahah hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Assiria leengpa’n athugen ana pom a, tuachi’n Assiria leengpa Damaska khopi sim dingin akuontou a, ava la a, tualeh a mipite Kir gam ah sal in azawpi a, Rezin athat hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Ahaz khu Assiria leengpa Tiglath-Pileser kimupi dingin Damaska khuo ah ahaw a, tualeh Damaska khuo a maitam khat avamu a; tuachi’n leengpa Ahaz in tua maitam lim a bawldan bangbang et ton dingin siempu Urijiah kungah ahah hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu Urijiah in leengpa Ahaz in Damaska akipata ahah bangbangin maitam khat ana bawla; tuachi’n siempu Urijiah in, Lengpa Ahaz Damaska akipat a ahing kinuale kia masangin ana bawl zou siengta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Damaska akipata leengpa ahing tuntahin, leengpa’n maitam khu amu a; tualeh leengpa’n maitam ava zuon a, atungah sillat alanta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh maitam ah halmang sillatte hal in, ann sillatte alan a, dawn sillatte asungbuo a, tualeh kilemna sillat sisan zong athe hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa masanga um sum-eng maitam, Mangpa inn leh maitam kikaal a um khu ala khie a, mallam pangah akoi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 27.1,2; 2 Khang. 4.1"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Ahaz in “Maitam lienpi tungah zingmawng halmang sillalte, nitah lam ann sillalte, leengpa halmang sillalte, gamsunga mipite zousie sillatte leh a ann sillalte u’leh dawn sillalte toh hal inlen lan in; tualeh halmang sisan sillatte zousie leh kithoina sisan zousie atungah the inlen, tualeh sum-eng maitam khu keiman ka houpi na ding hi,” chiin siempu Urijiah kung ah thu apie hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu Urijah in leengpa Ahaz thupieh bangbangin abawlta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Ahaz in atunna kuohte asusie a, asunga kisilna kuongte khu ala doh hi; tualeh atunna sum-eng bawngtalte akipat tuikuongpi khu alakhie a, suong kilem tungah atungta hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 7.23-39; 2 Khang. 4.2-6"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh khawlni ading atungnei lampi biehinn a abawl u’leh, biehinn pulama leengpa lutna pen zong Assiria leengpa kipah sahna dingin alakheta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Lengpa Ahaz tanchin dangte asilbawlte, Juda leengte khangthu gelna laibu ah atuong hilou ahiei mah?","title":"Ahaz shina: Hezekiah leenga panna (2 Khang. 28.26 , 27)"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Ahaz apulepate kungah a imuta a, apu leh pate kungah David khopi ah avuita uhi. Tualeh atapa Hezekiah ama thahengin leeng in apangta hi.","ref":"Isai. 14.28"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Ahaz kum sawm leh kumni leenga apan kumin, Ela tapa Hoshea Israelte tungah Samaria khopi ah leeng in apanga, kum kuo leeng vai ahawm hi.","title":"Israelte leengpa Hoshea"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa mitmu in silgilou tahtah abawla, hinanleh ama masanga Israel leengte bang zen in vang abawl sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Assiriate leengpa Shalmaneser in ava sim a, tuachi’n Hoshea khu asuohin apanga, siete ape zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Assiria leengpa’n Hoshea in aguhin ana deeh hi chi athei a; aman Izipt leengpa So kungah mi asawl a, tuachi’n kum chin a, apieh zel bangin Assiria leengpa kungah sie apeta sih hi. Tuaziehin Assiria leengpa’n ama hensa in suongkul ah akhumta hi.","title":"Israelte Assiria gam a puimangna"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Assiria leengpa’n gam pumpi atuon suoh sienga, tualeh Samaria ah akuontou a, kum thum sung ava umta hi."},"6":{"text":"Hoshea kum kuo leenga apan kum in, Assiria leengpa’n Samaria ala a, tualeh Israelte Assiria gam lam ah, apuimanga, Halah gamte leh Gozan lui kunga Habor gamte tualeh Medes khopite ah aum sah hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuabanga ana umna ziehuh pen, Israel taten Izipt leengpa Pharaoh akipat leh Izipt gam a kipata amauh puidohpa Mangpa a Pasian uh tungah sil abawl khiel ua, pasien dangte agiing zaw uhi.","title":"Israelte sal a puimanga aumna ziehuh"},"8":{"text":"Mangpa’n Israel tate masanga adeldohsa namte tawndan leh Israel leengten apom uh khelnate azui zieh uh ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Mangpa a Pasian uh tungah sil hoilou aguhin abawl zing ua, akhuote zousie uah galveng mi umna kulpi nei khuote tandongin munsangte abawl uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh muol sangte leh sing hing nuoi chinteng ah milimte atung ua, Asherte a phut uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 14.23"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh amasang ua kipat a, ana deldohsa namte bawl bangbangin munsangte ah gimnamtuite ahal zel ua; tualeh Mangpa lungthah sah dingin silgilou tahtah abawlbe nalai uhi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa’n akung ua “Tam silte na bawllou ding uh ahi” chia, Agen milimte nna zong asemsem nalai uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n na umdan hoiloute uh tawpsan unlen, napu napa te uh kunga Kana thupieh leh Ka suoh zawlneite zanga Ka hing theisah dan zousiete dungzuiin “Ka thupiehte leh Ka dante zui un chi’n guolneite leh mutheite zousie zangin Israelte leh Judate thu ana theisah hi.”"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh angaikhe nuom sih ua, apu leh pate un Mangpa a Pasian uh gingta nuomlou a, alungtangte uh akhausah mabangun apaupeng zawta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh apu apate uh kunga thupiehte thuhun ana bawlte adei sih ua, akung ua Atheisah Athu theisahte zong khawh asa sih uhi. Tualeh amauh tung thu a, Anathupieh, amaute bawl banga na bawl ding uh ahisih, chia Ana gen akim avel ua nam umte zui in, milimte abie ua, azuoutat ua, sil phatuomlou milimte nna sem in a umta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa a Pasian uh thupieh zousie anuasie ua, bawngnou lim sunthu ni abawl ua, tualeh Asher abawl ua, van a um zousie abie ua, Baal nna asem uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 12.28"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh atapate u’leh atanute uh kithoina in meikuong lai ah apai ua, aisante leh bumte achiing ua, Mangpa suthangpai dingin Amit muin silgilou tahtah bawl dingin akizua uhi.","ref":"Danp. 18.10"},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa khu Israelte tungah alungthahta sengsenga, Amuphahlouna ding ah asuonmanga; Juda nam chiloungal koima a hen sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Judaten zong Mangpa a Pasian uh thupieh azuita sih ua, Israelte tawndan bawlthute azui zawta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Israel hahle suonte adei nawn sih a, amaute agenthei bawla, amuphah louna dinga apaimang masang sie in, amauh sugentheite kungah apekheta hi."},"21":{"text":"Mangpa’n Israelte pen David innkuonte apat in abotkheta a, tualeh amaun Nebat tapa Jeroboam aleengpa dingun abawl ua, tualeh Jeroboam in Israelten Mangpa azuilai uh apaimanga khelna thupitah abawl sahta hi."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen Jeroboam in ana bawl khelnate Israel taten ataisan sih ua, azui zing zawta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Mangpa’n asuoh aguolneite zanga Ana gensa banga, Israelte Amitmu apata, asuonmang masang siein. Tuachi’n Israelte ama uh gam ngei akipat in Assiria gam ah apui ua, tuni tanin aum nalai uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Assiria leengpa’n Babilon khuo a mite, Kuthah khuo a mite, Ava khuo a mite, Hamath khuo a mite, tualeh Sepharvaim khuo a mite, ahing zawpi a, Samaria gam khuote ah, Israel mite munte aluo sah a, tuachi’n akhuote uah atengta uhi.","title":"Israel khuote ah nam dangte ateng uh"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh khuna aten chiillai un Mangpa agiing sih ua; tuaziehin Mangpa’n alah uah humpibahneite asawl a, tuachi’n mi Phabepkhat athat hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Assiria leengpa kungah, “Samaria khuote ateng dinga na lahdoh namten, agam Pasian biehdan athei sih ua; tuaziehin alah uah humpibahneite asawl a, tualeh ngaiin, tam gam Pasian biehdan atheilou ziehun athat zel uhi,” chi’n agen uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Assiria leengpa’n, khuna sal a na hing puidoh uh, siempute lah a khat zawpi unlen; “Ama va peiin vateng sam henlen, tuagam Pasian biehdan vahil heh,” chi’n thu apie hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samaria khuo akipata apuimang uh, siempute lah a khat, ahing pei a, Bethel khuo ah ava tenga, tualeh Mangpa giindan siemdan ding avahil hi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh nam chin in ama uh pasien chiet abawl ua, Samaria miten munsang ana bawl innte uah, nam chin in amauten na khuo chiet ah akoi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Babilon miten Sukoth Benoth abawl ua, tualeh Kuthmiten Nergal abawl ua, tualeh Hamath-miten Ashima abawl uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Ava miten Nibhaz leh Tartak abawl ua, tualeh Sepharvaim miten a pasiente uh Adramelek leh Anamelek kungah atate uh mei ah ahal zel uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa a giing ua, alah ua um namchin lah akipat in munsang a siempu ding akiguot ua, tuaten mun sangte ah kithoina abawl pieh zel uhi."},"33":{"text":"Mangpa agiing ua, tualeh ava puidohna gam ua namte bawldan bangbangin amauh pasiente nna asem uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tumasang lai a abawl dan bangun, tuni tanin abawl nalai uhi; Mangpa giindan asiem sih ua, Mangpa’n Jakob tate Israel chia amin vawte kunga athupiehte leh adan thute, azuisih uhi.","ref":"Siem. 32.28; 35.10"},"35":{"text":"Amaute toh Mangpa’n thuhun ana bawla, akung uah, “pasien dangte na giin ding uh ahisih a, amasang uah zong na kun ding uh ahisih a, ana u’zong semsih unlen, akung uah zong kithoi sih un.","ref":"Pawt. 20.5; Danp. 5.9"},"36":{"text":"Hinanleh silbawltheina nasatah leh banzah a Izipt gam a kipat a nou hing puidohpa Mangpa khu giing zaw unlen, Ama bie unlen Ama kungah kithoi un.","ref":"Danp. 6.13"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Athupiehte, Avaihawmna dante, tualeh Athuchiemna dante, Ahing na gelpiehsate khantawn in na zui ding a, pasien dangte na giin dinguh ahi sih hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh na kung ua Ka thuhun pen na manghil ding uh ahisih a, pasien dangte zong na giin ding uh ahisih hi."},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa na Pasian u’khu giing unlen, tuachi’n na melma zousiete uh khut a kipat in noute Ahing hundam ding hi,” chiin thu apie hi."},"40":{"text":"Bangteng hinan leh a thunung sih ua, tumasang lai a abieh dan bangbang un abawl nalai lai uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n tami namten Mangpa agiing ua, hinanleh atute atate u’toh a milim khenthute uh nna asem ua, apu apate uh bawl dandan in abawl nalai lai uhi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel leengpa Elah tapa Hoshea kum thum leenga apan kum in, Juda leengpa Ahaz tapa Hezekiah leeng in ahing pang hi.","title":"Judate leengpa Hezekiah (2 Khang. 29.1)"},"2":{"text":"Lenga apan chiil laiin kum sawmni leh nga a upa ahia, tualeh Jerusalem ah kum sawmni leh kumkuo leeng in apang hi. Anu min Abi ahia, Zekariah tanu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh apu David sil bawlte zousie bawl in, Mangpa mitmu in sil hoitah abawl zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman mun sangte aladoh a, milim khuomte a phua a, singa kibawl milimte asattan a, tualeh Mosi in anabawl sum-eng gul zong a susie a; khum hunlai tandong in Israel taten tuami kunga gimnamtui a hal nalai zieh un, tualeh amaun tua khu Nehushtan achi uhi.","title":"Hezekiah vaihawm sunga halna (2 Khang. 29.3—31.1)","ref":"Kisim. 21.9"},"5":{"text":"Aman Israelte Mangpa Pasian amuonga; tuachi’n ama nua a Juda leengte zousie lah ah, ama bang koima aum nawn sih a, ama masangah zong koima ana um ngaisih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen aman Mangpa atu chinten a, Ama nua azuina atawpsan nuom sih a, Mangpa’n Mosi kunga Apieh, Athupiehte apomdet zaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa akungah auma; akuondohna pou ah alawching zel hi. Tualeh Assiria leengpa tungah ahel a, anna asem sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Aman Philistinte Gaza khuo tandongin, tualeh agam tan uh; galveng mite innsang apat khopi kulpinei tan in azou hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Hezekiah kumli leenga apan nua in hichi ahia, Israel leengpa Elah tapa Hoshea kum sagi leenga apan kum in, Assiria leengpa Shalmaneser Samaria dou dingin akuontou a, ava imta uhi.","title":"Assiria in Israel adouna (2 Leeng. 17.5-7)"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh kum thum abei tahin, ala ta ua. Tuakhu Hezekiah kum guh leenga apan kum leh Israel leengpa Hoshea leenga apan kum kuona ah Samaria khopi lahin aumta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Assiria leengpa’n Israelte Assiria gam ah sal in apuimanga tualeh amaute Gozan luipanga Halah leh Habor gam ah tualeh Medes khopite ah akoi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa a Pasian uh thu ana mang nuomsih ua, athuhun apalsan zawsop ua, Mangpa’n asuoh Mosi thu apiehte zousie; angaikhiet nuomlou zieh u’leh azui nuomlou zieh uh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Hezekiah kum sawm leh kumli leenga apan kum in, Assiria leengpa Sennakerib in Juda gam pumpi khopi kulpi neite dou dingin akuontou a, tualeh ava lata hi.","title":"Assiria leengpa Sennakerib in Juda asimna"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Juda leengpa Hezekiah in Lakish khuo ah Assiria leengpa kungah mi asawl a, akungah “Sil kana bawlkhielta hi; hing nuakiasan mai inlen; na hing phut dandan ka bawlna ding hi,” chiin avaihah hi. Tuachi’n Assiria leengpa’n Juda leengpa Hezekiah dangka talent zathum leh sana talent sawmthum abituh pieh a."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hezekiah in Mangpa inn aum dangka taphot leh leengpa inn asum koina a um taphot a pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin Hezekiah in Mangpa biehinn kotkhate leh a khuomte sana tui a aluonkhum zousie akipat sanate akhohkhe sienga Assiria leengpa apeta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Assiria leengpa’n Tartan, Rabsari leh Rabshakeh te galkap tampi toh Lakish a kipat in Jerusalem a leengpa Hezekiah kungah asawl a. Tualeh akuontou ua, Jerusalem ava tung ua, ava tuntou tah un, puonsawpmite lamlien gei a tuikul sahtazaw tuilahna ah ava ding ua.","title":"Sennakerib in Jerusalem galvengte agihna (2 Khang. 32.9-19)"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa ahat tah un, inn sunglam kemte lamkai, Hilkiah tapa Eliakim leh lai gielpa Shebna leh tanchin gielpa Asaph tapa Joah te ava pawtkhie uhi,"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rabshakeh in akung uah, “Tuin Hezekiah kungah gen unlen, leengpa thupitah Assiria leengpa’n tambangin agen hi, koi pang bela kimuong na hiei mah?"},"20":{"text":"Kidouna dingin lemguot siemna leh hatna ka nei na, na chi a; hinanleh tuate pen thulahlou ahi bou hi, koi muonga ka tunga hel na hiei?"},"21":{"text":"Tuin en in tam pumpeng chieng tawngsa Izipt muong na hi a; tua mi tunga mi akinga leh akhut asun ding hi. Tuabangin Izipt leengpa Pharaoh khu ama muongte zousie tungah ahi zel hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahisihleh ka kunga “Mangpa ka Pasian uh ahi ka muon uh” na chi u’leh; ama khu Hezekiah in amun sangte leh amaitamte alahmanga, Judate leh Jerusalem mite kunga, Jerusalem ah “Tam maitam masangah Pasian na be ding uh, achi hilou ahiei mah?”"},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, ka pu Assiria leengpa toh thuchiem bawl inlen, tuachi’n sakol sangni ka hing pe dinga, atunga tuong ding namu nahding pouleh!"},"24":{"text":"Izipt te sakollengte leh sakol tungtuong mite muong nahi leh bangchidan in ahiei, ka pu suohte lah a galkap lamkai neu pen khat zong na nan zou mama ding?"},"25":{"text":"Tuin Mangpa thu lou a tam mun suse dinga hing kuontou ka hiei mah? Mangpa’n ka kungah, tam gam dou dingin kuon inlen, va susie in, achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, Shebna leh Joah in Rabshakeh kungah, “Hepitahin na suohte kungah Aramaik ham in thugen zawin, ka thei siem na uhi, tualeh kulpi tunga mite zah dingin Hebru ham in hing houpi nawnda maiin,” achi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Rabshakeh in akung uah, “Ka pu’n, napu leh nang maimai kung a, tam thu gen dinga ahing sawl ahiei mah? kulpi tunga tou mite noute toh a eeh uh ne a, azun uh dawn dingte kungah zong ahing sawl hilou ahiei mah?”","title":"Rabshakeh thugenna"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rabshakeh adingdoh a, Juda hamin aw ngaitahin akikou a, tualeh “Leengpa thupitah Assiria leengpa thu ngai un!”"},"29":{"text":"Tambangin leengpa’n agen hi; Hezekiah in hing sol sih heh, ka khut a kipat in ahing hunkhe theisih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Hezekiah in Mangpa’n ahing hunkhe teitei dinga, tam khopi Assiria leengpa khut ah pieh ahisih ding, chiin Mangpa hing muong sah sih heh."},"31":{"text":"Hezekiah thugen ngaikhe sih un; aziehpen Assiria leengpa’n tambangin agen hi; kipahman kengin ka kungah kilepna bawl unlen, ka kungah hing pei un, tuachi’n michin in ama grep kineh henlen, tualeh michinin ama theipi kunga theipi ga kineh chiet u’henlen, michin in ama tuikhuh a tui dawn chiet uheh."},"32":{"text":"Nouma gam mabanga bu leh uoin tha pienna gam, tanghou leh grep tui pienna gam, Olive sing leh khuoizu pienna gam, shi loua na hin theina ding gam ua ka hing pui masang sie’n; Hezekiah in Mangpa’n ahing humbit na ding hi chi a noute ahing sol chiengin zong tahsang sih un."},"33":{"text":"Assiria leengpa khuta kipat in, Namte pasiente laha khat beeh in agam ahundoh kha mawngmawng tai mah?"},"34":{"text":"Hamath leh Arpad pasiente hei a umta uh adiei? Sepharvaimte, Hena te leh Ivah pasiente hei aum ata uoi? ka khuta kipat in Samaria khuo ahumbit uoi mah?"},"35":{"text":"Gamte pasiente lah a koipen in ahiei, ka khuta kipat agam uh a hunkheta uoi? Mangpa’n ka khuta kipata Jerusalem ahutkhiet mama ding? achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Hinanleh mite asip dide ua, kam khat in zong adawng sih uhi; leengpa thupieh khu “Koiman dawng sih un,” chi ahi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n innlam kemte lamkai Hilkiah tapa Eliakimte, Laigielpa Shebnate, tanchin gielpa Asaph tapa Joah ten apuonsilte uh botkeh in leengpa Hezekiah kungah ava pei ua, Rab-Shakeh thugente ava hil uhi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahia, Hezekiah in tam thu a zah tahin, apuonsilte abotkeh a, sai ip puon asila, Mangpa inn ah alutta hi.","title":"Hezekiah in Isai kungah mi asawl"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n innsung lam a lamkai Eliakim, laigielpa Shebna leh siempute lah a upate, sai ip puon sil in Amos tapa Isai kungah asawl a."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh amaun akung ah, “Hezekiah in tambang in agen hi, Tuni khu lungzin na phawhna leh minsietna ni ahi; aziehpen Naute lah apien uh ahunta a, pien sahna dingin lah hatna mawngmawng aum nawnta sih hi."},"4":{"text":"A pu Assiria leengpa’n Pasian hing gense dinga asawl Rab-Shakeh thugen zousie Mangpa na Pasian in anaza ahita maithei dinga, athu gente Mangpa na Pasian in Aza in, Ana phawh khata ding, tuaziehin aum sunte adingin aw ngaitah in thum pieh in” achi hi, achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Hezekiah mi sawlte Isai kung ava tung uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Isai in akung uah, “Napu uh kungah tambangin na gen ding uhi. Mangpa’n tambang in achi hi, Assiria leengpa miten keima ahing gensiet thu na zah ziehin zausin.","title":"Isai dawnna"},"7":{"text":"Pellouin, asungah hagau ka umsah dinga, thuthang aza dinga, ama gam ah akinuale kia ding a, tuachi’n ama gamsung mama ah namsauin ka puasah ding hi,” achi hi, va chi un."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rab-shakeh akinuale kia a, Assiria leengpa’n Libnah anadou laitah ava mu a; Lakish khuo apawt santa chi ana zahsa ahita hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh nangma hing dou dingin, Tirhakah Ethiopia leengpa “Akuondohta chi thuthang Sennakerib in azah tahin,” leengpa Hezekiah kungah mite asawl kia a."},"10":{"text":"“Tambangin Juda leengpa Hezekiah kungah thu nava gen ding uh ahi: Na muon na Pasian in Jerusalem Assiria leengpa khut ah piehkhieh ahisih ding chiin hing sol sih heh."},"11":{"text":"En in! Assiria leengten gamteng asuhsiet sieng ua, atung ua abawl dan uh na zata hi; nang humbit na hi tuom diei mah?"},"12":{"text":"Namte pasienten ka pule pate un ana suhsiette uh, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph leh Telassar gam sunga Eden mite, a humbit uoi mah?"},"13":{"text":"Hamath leengpa, Arpad leengpa leh Sepharvaim khopi sung leengpa, Hena leengpa ahisihleh Ivah leengpate hei sunga um ahita uoi?”"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Hezekiah in a misawlte khut akipat in laithot amu a, asim a; tuachi’n Hezekiah Mangpa inn ah ava lut a, tualeh Mangpa mai ah laithot khu aphata hi.","title":"Hezekiah thumna (2 Khang. 32.20)"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hezekiah in Mangpa masangah thu angen a; “Aw Mangpa Israelte Pasian. Cherubimte kikaal a um, leitung gam zousie ah Nang bou Pasian na hia, lei leh van Nangma siemsa ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 25.22"},"16":{"text":"Mangpa aw Na bil hing daw inlen, na ngaiin, Mangpa Namit hah inlen, Mangpa aw en in, Pasian hing gense dinga Sennakerib in ahing thugente ngaikhe vawi in."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa adihtahin, Assiria leengten namte leh gamte asuse ngut ma uhi;"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh apasiente uh zong mei sung ah apai zel uhi; ama haw pasiente ahisih ua, mihing khut a kibawlthu sing leh suongte ahi bou uhi, tuaziehin amaute asumang uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, Aw Mangpa ka Pasian uh, leitung gam zousie in Nang, Nangbou Mangpa Pasian nahi chi ahing theina ding un, akhut apat hing hundam in chiin,” ka hing ngen ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amos tapa Isai in, Hezekiah kungah “Tambangin Israelte Mangpa Pasian in achi hi; ka kunga Assiria leengpa Sennakerib sietna dinga na ngetna ka zata hi."},"21":{"text":"Tami amapa tungtanga Mangpa thugen ahi: Zion tanu nungah siengthou in nang ahing simmaw a, chiemnui in ahing nuisan uhi, Jerusalem tanu in, nanua langah alu ang thin khum hi!"},"22":{"text":"Koi na gensie a, koi namin sesah a, koi tungah ahiei na aw, nasan sah a, Na mit ha nasan sah? Israelte Misiengthoupa tungah ahi."},"23":{"text":"Na mi sawlte zangin Mangpa na gensie a; “Ka sakolleng tampite toh, Lebanon gam gil a muol sangte, ka hing tungtouta a; khuna sidar sing sangtahtahte leh, taa sing deihuoi penpente ka phua dinga, agammang sung gil pen leh, gammang hoina pen ah ka lutding hi;"},"24":{"text":"Gamdangah tuikhuhte ka tou a, gamdang tuite ka dawnta a, ka kengtaw in Izipt luite ka tuon kangta hi,” chi’n na kilien sah hi."},"25":{"text":"Keima’n nidanglai akipat tuate kabawl ahidan, tumasang lai akipata, ka siem ahidan, na zangai sih amah? Tuin khopi kulpi nei sesa chiengkhawm maimai banga um dingin, ka hing koiding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin asunga umten hatna aneisih ua, achimaw ua, azala gawpta uhi.
