Gamlah hampa bang leh loupa dawng bang, leh inn tung a hampa bangleh bu kung akhan let, masanga lung vei sieng bang mai ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh natenna mun, na lut leh na pawt, tualeh ka tunga na lungthah nate ka thei hi."},"28":{"text":"Ka tunga na lungthah zieh leh, ki uongsah taha na hamte ka bil ah ahing lut touta a, Tuaziehin ka siakawi na nahkuo ah ka thun dinga, na nephu ah ka siakuol ka vaw dinga, Na hing kuonna lam ma ah ka hing ki nuale sah ding hi, achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tami nanga dingin chiemtena ahi ding hi; tu kum in bu sang na ne ding ua, tualeh akum kia chieng in zong tua ma na neding uhi; tuabangin a kum thum na ah bu na tuu ding ua, at unlen, Grep guite suon unlen, aga na neding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Juda innkuonte lah a, asuohta um sunten, thahui aha suh ding ua, atung lam ah aga ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Jerusalem akipat in a um sunte, Zion muola kipat in adam nalaite, apawtdoh ding ua, Mangpa phattuomngaina in tamte abawl ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n Assiria leengpa tungtang thu ah, tambangin agen hi; tam khopi sungah ahing lutsih dinga, athal zong ahing kaplut sihding a, tualeh tam khopi masangah lum toh ahing pei sih dinga, tualeh khopi kim ah leipal asep sang sih ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahing kuonna lam ma ah akinuale kia dinga; tam khopi sungah ahing lutsih ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Keima’n keima zieh leh ka suohpa David ziehin tam khopi hundam dingin ka veng ding hi,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Khumi zan in Mangpa vansawlsieng akuon khie a, Assiriate giehphuola mi tul zakhat leh tul sawm giet leh tul nga ava that a; tualeh zingmawng matah a ahing thaw u’leh, mi shi luong ngen ana umta hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Assiria leengpa Sennakerib anua pei kiata a, tuachi’n Nineveh khopi ah aumta hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, apasien Nisrok inn a apasien abieh laiin, ama tapate Adramelek leh Sharezer in namsau in ava thatta uhi. Tualeh Ararat gam ah ataimangta uhi. Tualeh atapa Esar-haddon ama thahengin leeng in apangta hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hunlaiin Hezekiah shi ding khopin achina a, tualeh Amos tapa goulnei Isai akung ah ahing pei a, akungah, “Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, Na innsung um danding sutupin, shi ding nahi, na damdoh zou nawn sih ding hi,” achi hi achia.","title":"Hezekiah damlouna leh dam kiana (2 Khang. 32.24 ; Isai. 38.1-8)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hezekiah banglam nga in akihei a, Mangpa kungah thu angen a."},"3":{"text":"“Aw Mangpa, Na mai a gin umtah leh lungtang hoibukim a, ka gamtat dan leh Na mitmu a silhoi ka bawl zeldan thei zing in chiin athum a, tualeh Hezekiah hasetah in” akapta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hia, Isai in leengpa inn huongsung laita pen ahen masangin, Mangpa thu akungah ahing tunga, akungah;"},"5":{"text":"“Nuakia inlen, ka mite lamkaipa Hezekiah kung ah vagen in, Mangpa napu David Pasian in hichiin achi hi, Na thumnate Kaza a, na hitui luong zong Ka mu hi, Ngaiin ka hing damsah dinga, nithum ni in Mangpa inn ah na haw tou ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh na damsung kum sawm leh kum nga Ka belap ding, tualeh nang leh tam khopi Assiria leengpa akipat in Ka humbit dinga, tualeh Keima zieh leh Ka suoh David ziehin, tam khopi Ka vengbit ding hi, achi hi, chiin vagen in,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isai in “Theipi ga beu khat hing la un achia, tuachi’n ahing la ua, auilut ma ah abet a ahing dam kiata hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Hezekiah in Isai kungah, “Mangpa’n ahing damsah dinga, anithum niin Mangpa inn ah ka haw tou ding chi, achiemtena bang ahi diei?” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Isai in akungah, “Mangpa’n agensa khu abawl teitei ding hi, chi tam chiemtena akipat in na mu ding hi; Nihim kalbi sawm akikhin tou ahiei na dei, ahisihleh kalbi sawm akinua khin?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Hezekiahin adawnga, “Nihim kalbi sawm akikhin abailam senga, tua hizawlou in Nihim kalbi sawm kinua khin zaw heh,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Isai in, Mangpa ahan a, tualeh Aman, Ahaz hunbi theina a nihim ngiemsa khu kalbi sawm akinua tawnsahta hi."},"12":{"text":"Khum hunlai in Baladan tapa Babilon leengpa Merodak-baladan in, Hezekiah kungah lai hah leh kipahmante ahah a, Hezekiah a chi ana hi chi a zah zieh in.","title":"Hezekiah in Babilon palaite agou a etsahna"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hezekiah in amauh ana kipahpi a, asil manpha koina inn zousie a, dangkate, sanate, gimnamtuite, sathau mantamte, agalvan koina inn sungte, a gou umna inn sung zousie a en sah a; a inn sung leh agam sunga zousie Hezekiah in a amauh te a et sahlou mawngmawng a um sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua zouin guolnei Isai leengpa Hezekiah kungah ahing pei a, a kungah, “Tam miten bang a gen uoi? Hei sunga kipat a nang kunga hing haw ahi uoi?” achi hi. Tualeh Hezekiah in, “Babilon gam, gamlapi akipata hing pei ahi uh,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Isai in akungah, “Na inn ah bangbang amu uoi?” achia, tualeh Hezekiah in “Ka innsunga sil zousie amu sieng ua, ka goute amauh ka etsahlou mawngmawng a um sih hi,” chiin adawng hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isai in Hezekiah kungah, “Mangpa thu ngaikhie in."},"17":{"text":"Ngai vawi, ani ahing tung dinga, napu leh paten ana khol tuni tan a um, na inn sunga um zousie, Babilon gamsungah puohdoh in a um dinga; bangma nuasie mawngmawng a umsih ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.13; 2 Khang. 36.10"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh natu na tate, nahah nasuon hing pieng dingte zong sal in apuimang ding ua, Babilon leengpa inn ah michilge in a um ding uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.14,15; Dan. 1.1-7"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hezekiah in Isai kungah, “Mangpa thu na gen khu ahoi hi,” achi hi. Tualeh aman “Ka damsunga lemna leh thutah a um ding pouleh, ahoi mai hilou i?” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hezekiah tangthu dangte, asilbawltheidan zousie, tuikul leh tuilahna abawl dante, khopi sunga tui azawllut dante, Juda leengte khangthu kigelna laibu sungah atuong hilou ahiei mah?","title":"Hezekiah shina (2 Khang. 32.32-33)"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Hezekiah khu apulepate kungah a imuta a, tualeh ama thahengin atapa Manasseh leeng in apangta hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh leenga apan chiillai in, kum sawm leh ni ahia, Tualeh Jerusalem khopi ah kum sawm nga leh kum nga leeng vai ahawm hi. Tualeh anu min khu Hephzibah ahi.","title":"Manasseh Judate leenga apanna (2 Khang. 33.1-9)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Israel tate masanga ana deldohsa namten sil kidahhuoitah ana bawlte uh bangbangin, Mangpa mitmuin sil hoilou tahtah abawl zel hi.","ref":"Jer. 15.4"},"3":{"text":"Apa Hezekiah in asuhsietsa mun sangte abawlpha kia a, Baal adingin maitamte abawl kia a, tualeh Israelte leengpa Ahab bangin Asherte abawla, tualeh van a um zousie abie a, ana uh asem hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Jerusalem ah “Ka min Ka umsah ding” achina Mangpa inn ah maitamte abawl hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.13"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa inn huongsung nitegel ah van a um zousie a dingin maitam abawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh atapa kithoina in mei ah ahallia a, aisante achiinga, bumte bang abawla, dawi aisan siemte leh dawi lawm neite toh akigopa, Mangpa sulungthah dingin Amitmu in silgilou chinteng abawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n David leh Solomon kunga, “Tam inn leh Israel nam zousie lah a Kana tel Jerusalem ah, kum tawnin Ka min Ka umsah ngitnget ding chia Ana genna mun, Mangpa inn sungah, aman Asher milim kikhenthute aphut hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 9.3-5; 2 Khang. 7.12-18"},"8":{"text":"Apu apate u’kunga ka piehsa gam a kipat in, Israelte keng ka vahvai sah nawn sih dinga, Ka suoh Mosi kunga Kana thupieh dan zousie leh akung ua Ka thupieh zousie banga bawl dinga, pilvang taha aum pou u’leh,” ana chisa mabangin."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun angaisah sih ua; tualeh Mangpa’n Israel tate masanga ana suhsietsa namte silbawl sanga zong gilouzaw sem bawl dingin Manasseh in mite azawl zawl zaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n asuoh guolneite zang in thu agen a."},"11":{"text":"Juda leengpa Manasseh in, “Tam sil kidahhuoite ana bawla, ama masanga na um, Amormite sang in zong abawlkhiel huoise zaw thamtham hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi; Ngaiin aza pouma bil lang ni khen dingin Jerusalem kho tung leh Juda gam tungah gimthuohna Ka hing tungsah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Samaria tena khau leh Ahab innkuonte sialum kikhai ka zandoh dinga; miten akhup athal a kuong asuh sieng bangun, Jerusalem khopi ka nawt sieng ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh ka goutan umsunte, ka taisan dinga amelmate u’khut ah ka pekhe dinga, amelmate uh kivah nan apang ding ua, midangte gal hingmatin apang ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Apulepate uh Izipt gam a kipata, ahing pawtdoh ua kipat in, tuni dongin ka mitmu ah silgilou abawl ua, ahing suhlungthah zieh un.”"},"16":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Manasseh in Jerusalem khopi agei langkhat a kipat ale lam gei tandong, mawnabei sisan tampi suo in aluong dim sah a, Judate akhiel sah a, akhelna bawl gentahlouin, Mangpa mitmuin silgilou abawl hi.","title":"Manasseh vaihawmna leh shina (2 Khang. 33.18-20)"},"17":{"text":"Manasseh tanchin dangte, asilbawl zousie, asil bawlkhelnate, Juda leengte khangthu gelna laibu sungah atuong asiei mah?"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Manasseh apulepate kungah a imuta a, Uzza huona ama inn gei a, ahuonah avuita uhi. Tuachi’n atapa Amon ama taangin leeng in apangta hi."},"19":{"text":"Amon leenga apan chiil in kum sawmni leh ni a upa ahia, Jerusalem ah kum ni leeng in apanga, anu min Meshullemeth ahia, Jotbah khuo a Heruz tanu ahi","title":"Judate leengpa Amon (2 Khang. 33.20-23)"},"20":{"text":"Apa mabangin Mangpa mitmuin silgilou abawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n apa lampi tot teng azui a, apa’n ana uh anasep leh ana bieh milimte bie in ana uh asem hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh apu apate Mangpa Pasian anuasie a, tualeh Mangpa dan bangin agamta sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Amon suohten ama kalin thu aphiel ua, tualeh leengpa khu ama innsung ngei ah athatta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh agam mipiten leengpa Amon kala thuphiel zousie athat ua, tuachi’n agam mipiten atapa Josiah ama thahengin leeng in apang sahta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amon silbawl dangte Juda leengte khangthu gelna laibu sungah atuong asiei mah?"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh ama Uzziah huon sunga, ama han ah akivuita a, atapa Josiah ama taangin leeng in apangta hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah leenga apan chiil in kum giet a upa ahia, Tualeh Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum leh khat leeng in apang hi. Tualeh anu min Jedidah ahia, Bozkath khuo a Adaiah tanu ahi.","title":"Josiah vaihawmna (2 Khang. 31.1)","ref":"Jer. 3.6"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aman Mangpa mitmu in sil dihtah abawla, tualeh apu David lampi zousie azui a, zietlam ahiei, veilam ahiei ah zong apielsan sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Josiah kum sawm leh giet achin kum in hichi ahi a, leengpa’n Meshullam tupa, Azaliah tapa laigielmi Shaphan, Mangpa inn ah asawl a.","title":"Biehinn abawl phatna (2 Khang. 34.8-13)"},"4":{"text":"“Siempu lien Hilkiah kungah hawtou inlen, kotkha vengmiten mipite kunga ana lah khawm uh, Mangpa inn a kilalut dangkate sim u’henlen;"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Mangpa inn a nasem lamkaite khutah pekhie u’henlen, tualeh amaun inn se munte bawlphatna dingin Mangpa inn a nasemte khut ah pe sawn uhenlen;"},"6":{"text":"Sing bawl siemte, inn bawlmite, tualeh innse bawlte kungah ape ding ua, inn bawl phatna ding sing leh suong khensate alei na dingun, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh muonhuoi tah a ana sai zel ziehun, akhut ua dangka apiehte uh aendih nawn sih uhi.”","ref":"2 Leeng. 12.15"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh siempu lienpen Hilkiah in lai gielmi Shaphan kungah, “Mangpa inn sungah danlaibu ka mudohta,” achi hi. Tualeh Hilkiah in tua dan laibu khu Shaphan kungah apie a, aman asimta hi.","title":"Mosi dan laibu kimuna (2 Khang. 34.14 , 15)"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n laigielmi Shaphan, leengpa kungah ava haw a, leengpa kungah thu ava tut kia a. “Na nna semten inn a dangka umsunte ka la khawm ua, Mangpa inn a nasem lamkaite khutah ka pekhe siengta uhi,” achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh laigielmi Shaphan in “Siempu Hilkiah in laibu khat ahing pie hi,” chiin leengpa alaata a, tualeh Shaphan in leengpa mai ah tuami asimta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Lengpa’n dan laibu a thute azah tahin apuonte abotkeh a,","title":"Josiah kisiana (2 Khang. 34.19-22)"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n siempu Hilkiah, Shaphan tapa Ahikam, Mikaiah tapa Akbor, laigielmi Shaphan leh leengpa nasem Asaiah te kungah thu apie a, akung uah;"},"13":{"text":"“Pei unlen, Kei dingin, mipite dingin, tualeh Juda gam pumpi a dingin, tam laibu kimudoh sunga thute tungtang Mangpa hing dongun; Ipu ipate un eima tungthu a ana kigiel zousie dungzui a bawl dingin tam laibu thute ana ngaisah lou ziehun, itung uah Mangpa thangpaina a sangsengta hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siempu Hilkiah, Ahikam, Akbor, Shaphan leh Asaiahte, puonsil kempa Harhas tupa Tikvah tapa Shallum zi guolneinu Huldah kungah ava haw ua, Amanu Jerusalem khuo a ummun nina a um ahi a; tualeh ava houpita uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n akung uah “Tambangin Mangpa Israelte Pasian in achi hi, ka kunga noute hing sawlpa hil un.","title":"Guolneinu Huldah thugen (2 Khang. 34.22-28)"},"16":{"text":"Khuziehin, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, Ngai in, tam mun leh asunga tengte tungah sietna ka hing tungsah ding, Juda leengpa’n laibu sunga, athu sim tengteng bangin."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin akhut nasepte ua, keima ahing suhthangpai theina dingun, ahing taisan ua, pasien dangte kungah gimnamtui ahal uhi; tuaziehin ka thangpaina tam mun tungah akuongzah dinga, suhmit ahi sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa dong dinga nou hing sawlpa kungah hichibangin na chi ding uhi; Mangpa Israelte Pasian in hichibangin agen hi, na thuzah tungtang thu ah:"},"19":{"text":"Tam mun leh asunga tengte, suhgam ding leh hamsietin ahing um ding uh chi thu ka genna zah bep a, na lungtang anema, Mangpa mai a na kingaingiem a, na puonte na bawkeh a, ka mai a na kaa ziehin ken zong na thu kana zata hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin ngaiin, na pule pate kungah ka hing pui dinga, na han ah lungmuong tah a puiin na um dinga, tam mun tunga sietna ka tun sah ding zousie na mitin amu sih ding” achi hi chiin, achi hi. Tualeh leengpa kungah thu ava tut kia uhi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Juda gam leh Jerusalem khopi a upa zousie akunga han khawm dingin mi asawl a.","title":"Mipite kunga dan sim khiehna (2 Khang. 34.29-32)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Juda gam a mi zousie leh Jerusalem khuo a mi zousie toh, siempute leh guolneite toh, mipi zousie toh, alien aneu in Mangpa inn ah apeitou ua, tualeh Mangpa inn a alaibu mudoh uh, thuhun laibu sunga kigiel zousie abil ua azah dingun asim hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa khuom phungah adinga, tua laibu sunga kigiel thuhun thute sudet dingin, a lungtang zousie leh a hagau zousie a, Mangpa zui ding leh athupiehte, athu theisahte leh athugousiete pom dingin Mangpa mai ah thu ahunga, tualeh mipi zousie in zong thuhun abawl uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n siempu lienpen Hilkiah leh azom a siempute, tualeh kotkha vengmite Mangpa biehinn sunga Baal, Asher leh van a sil um zousie a dinga kibawl um leh bel zousie lakhe sieng dingin thu apie a; tualeh aman tuate khu, Jerusalem khopi pulama kidron loute ah ahaltuma, tualeh avutvamte khu Bethel ah apolut hi.","title":"Thuhun zieh a siemphatna (2 Khang. 34.33)","ref":"2 Leeng. 21.3; 2 Khang. 33.3"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh aman milimbie siempute, Juda leengten Juda gam mun sangte leh Jerusalem kimvel a munte a gimnamtui hal dinga, ana namdette uh atawpsah a, tualeh Baal ading, ni ading, hapi a ding, aasite a ding tualeh van a um zousie a dinga gimnamtui halte zong atawpsah sieng hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa inn a, sing a kibawl milim khu, Jerusalem pulam a kidron lui dongin a ladoh a, tualeh kidron lui ah ahala, atuon buong dildel a, avuite minautangte han tungah athe hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Asher puon gaan numeite umna Mangpa inn a pasal kizuate umna innte aphesiet pieh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Juda khopite akipat in siempute zousie a puidoh a, Geba akipata Beersheba donga siempute gimnamtui halna mun sangte a suhbua pieh a; tualeh khopi kotkhah veilam panga um, vaihawmpa Joshua kot lutna a, mun sangte asuchim hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh mun sang siempute pen, Jerusalema Mangpa maitam ah hawtou sih na’n u’leh, a unaute uh lah ah tanghou tolsawlou ane zel uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh koiman atapa ahiei, atanu ahiei, Molek biehna dinga mei a apei suoh sah louna dingun, Hinnom tate phaijang a um Tophet khu asubuata hi.","ref":"Jer. 7.31; 19.1-6; 32.35; Siempu. 18.21"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa innlutna inn huong sunga leengpa inn a innvengmi Nathan-Malek, dantan kunga, Juda leengten ni dinga alatsa uh sakolte alamanga; ni sakollengte mei in ahaltum hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Ahaz pindan tungnung zaw vum a, Juda leengten ana bawl uh maitamte, tualeh Mangpa innhuongte geela Manasseh maitam bawlte leengpa’n asuchima, asuguoi sienga, anengte kidron lui ah apai hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 21.5; 2 Khang. 33.5"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa Solomon in, Sidon mite kidahhuoina Ashtoreth dinga, Moabmite kidahhuoina Kemosh ading, tualeh Ammonmite kidahhuoina Milkom ading banga abawl, thulimlouna muol zietlam aum, Jerusalem suolam a um mun sangte asubua hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 11.7"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh milim suong kiphutte asuse gawp sienga, Asherte aphua a, tua munte mi shi guin asudim hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Israelte khelna bawlsah Nebat tapa Jeroboam in, ana bawl Bethel a maitam leh amunsang nangawn pumin asuchim a, mun sangte ahaltuma, atuon guoi gawpa, Asherte ahaltum hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 12.33"},"16":{"text":"Josiah ahing kileheileh muola hante amu a, mi asawl a, hante a mi shi gute ava lasah a, tam thute ana phuongdoh Pasian miin ana phuonsa Mangpa thu bangin, mishi gute khu maitam tungah ahal a asubuata hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 13.2"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Bang suongphu ahiei khuna ka mu?” achi hi. Tualeh khum khomiten Juda gam a kipata hing pei, “Bethel maitam tunga, na silbawl ding ana phuongdoh Pasian mipa hansuong ahi,” chi’n ahil uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 13.30-32"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Bangma lawsih un, koiman agute ladoh sih uheh,” achi hi. Tuachi’n agute Samaria gam akipata guolnei hing peipa gute toh bangma alawsih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Samaria khopi a um, Israel leengten, Mangpa suhlungthahna dinga abawl uh, mun sang innte zousie, Josiah in asumanga, tualeh Bethel khuo abawl mabangin abawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n maitam tunga um munsang siempute zousie, athat sienga, tuachi’n atungah mihing gute ahal a, tualeh Jerusalem ah akinuale ta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n mi zousie kungah, “Tam thuhun laibu a kigiel mabangin Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin peikan pawi mangun,” chiin thu apie hi.","title":"Peikan pawi kimang kia"},"22":{"text":"Israel tunga vaihawm miten vaiahawm ua kipat in, Israel leengte zousie leh Juda leengte vaihawm sung tengin hichibangin peikan pawi ana nei kha nawn sih uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa Josiah kumsawm leh giet leenga apan kum in Mangpa a dingin tam peikan pawi Jerusalem ah akimang hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuathamlouin siempu Hilkiah in, Mangpa inn a amudoh laibu a kigiel dan thute asuhbuchin theina dingin, aisan siemte, dawithu siemte, dawizawlte, innsung milim pasiente, tualeh Juda gam sung leh Jerusalem a, kidahhuoi kimu kha zousie, Josiahin apaimang sieng hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi dan dungzui a, alungtang zousie, ahinna zousie, tualeh ahatna zousie toh, Mangpa lam nga ama bang mawngmawng amasangin leengpa koima ana um kha sih a, ama nuain zong koima a um nawn sih hi."},"26":{"text":"Khuchi pumpumin zong, Mangpa’n alungthahna thupitah, Manasseh in athangpai sahna zousie zieh a. Juda tunga alungthahna kuongzah apat in akilehei tuom sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n “Israelte ka suonmang bangin Judate zong ka muphahlouna ah ka suonmang dinga, ka tel tam Jerusalem ngel leh khunah ka min a um ding kana chi ngel khu ka paimang ding,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Josiah tanchin dangte, asilbawl zousie, Juda leengte khangthu kigelna laibu ah atuong hilou ahiei mah?","title":"Josiah shina (2 Khang. 35.20-27)"},"29":{"text":"Avaihawm laiin Izipt leengpa Pharaoh-neko, Assiria leengpa dou dingin Euphrates luiah akuontou a, tualeh leengpa Josiahin ama avadou a, tualeh Pharaoh Neko in ama amutahin Megiddo kidouna galphuol ah athatta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n a miten Megiddo akipat in aluong sakolleng in apuo ua, Jerusalem ah ahing polut ua, ama han ah avuita uhi. Tuachi’n khum gam miten, Josiah tapa Jehoahaz apui ua, sathau anu ua, tualeh apa taangin leengpa in abawlta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Jehoahaz leenga apan chiillai in kum sawmni leh thum ahia, tualeh Jerusalem ah hathum leeng vai ahawm hi. Tualeh anu min Hamutal ahia, Libnah khuo a, Jeremiah tanu ahi.","title":"Jehoahaz leenga pansung (2 Khang. 36.1-2)"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh apulepate mabangin Mangpa mitmu in silgilou abawl hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Pharaoh Neko in, Jerusalem a vaihawm thei nawn lou dingin Hamath gam a Riblah khuo ah suongkul ah akhum a, tualeh agam uh dangka talent za khat leh sana talent khat sie alieu sah hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh Neko in leengpa Josiah tapa Eliakim apa Josiah taangin leeng in apangsah a, amin zong Jehoiakim chi’n ahen piehta hi. Pharaoh in Jehoahaz Izipt gam ah apui a, khunah apei a, ashita hi.","ref":"Jer. 22.11,12"},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoiakim in dangka leh sana Pharaoh kungah apie a, hinanleh Pharaoh thupieh dungzui a, sum pe dingin agam ah sie alieu sah hi. Pharaoh-Neko kunga pieh dingin michin alieu dinga aguot za chiet bangin agamsunga mite dangka leh sana alieu sah zel hi.","title":"Jehoiakim vaihawmna (2 Khang. 36.5-8)"},"36":{"text":"Lenga apan chiil in Jehoiakim khu kum sawmni leh kum nga a upa ahia, tualeh Jerusalem ah kum sawm leh khat leeng in apang hi. Tualeh anu min Zebudah ahia, Rumah khuo a Pedaiah tanu ahi.","ref":"Jer. 22.18,19; 26.1-6; 35.1-19"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh apulepate bawl dan bangbangin, Mangpa mitmuin silgilou abawl hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehoiakim vaihawm hunlaiin, Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in agam ahing dou a, tualeh Jehoiakim zong ama thuneina nuoi ah kumthum sung a um a, khumnua in akiheisan a, atungah ahelta hi.","title":"Nebukadnezzar kunga Jehoiakim silpieh (2 Khang. 36.6-7)","ref":"Jer. 25.1-38; Dan. 1.1,2"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ama dou dingin Kaldai galkap honte, Siria galkap honte, Moab galkap honte tualeh Ammon hahlesuon honte asawlta a, asuoh guolneite zanga agen Mangpa thu bangin Juda gam suse dingin asawlkheta hi."},"3":{"text":"Manasseh khelnate, asilbawl zousie zieh a, amu phahlou a, amauh suonmang dingin tam Judate tungah Mangpa thupieh ahingtung petma ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh mawnabei sisan asuo zieh zong ahia, mawna neilou sisan in Jerusalem adim sah ziehin, Mangpa’n angaidam nuom sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoiakim tanchin dangte, asilbawl zousie Juda leengte khangthu gelna laibu ah atuong hilou ahiei mah?"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoiakim apulepate kungah a imuta a, tuachi’n atapa Jehoiakin ataangin leeng in apangta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt leengpa agam akipat in ahing kuon kia nawn sih hi. Aziehpen Babilon leengpa’n Izipt lui a kipat Euphrates lui tan Izipt leenggam ala siengta hi."},"8":{"text":"Leenga apan chiil laiin Jehoiakin kum sawm leh kum giet ahia, tualeh Jerusalem ah ha thum vai ahawm hi. Tualeh anu min Nehushta ahia, Jerusalem a um Elnathan tanu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh apa bawl dan zousie mabangin, Mangpa mitmu in silgilou abawl zel hi."},"10":{"text":"Khumhunlaiin, Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar mite Jerusalem dou dingin akuontou a, tualeh khopi ahing imta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh khumbanga amiten aimkhum lai un Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar khum khopi dou dingin ahing kuontou a.","title":"Babilon a puimangna masa pen"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda leengpa Jehoiakin khu, anu, asuohte, amiliente leh alamkaite toh Babilon leengpa kungah ava kipe khie ua, tualeh Babilon leengpa’n, avaihawm kum gietna in Jehoiakin ana man a, ahentaangta hi.","ref":"Jer. 22.24-30; 24.1-10; 29.1,2"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ana gentah mabangin, Nebukadnezzar in Mangpa inn a gou zousie leh leengpa inn a gou zousie apodoh a, tualeh Mangpa biehinn a, Israel leengpa Solomon in ana bawl sana um leh belte asatguoi sienga apomangta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem a mi zousie, milien tengteng, mihat hangsan leh silbawlthei zousie leh saltang mi tul sawm toh, tualeh khutsiem leh siakhen siem mi zousie apui siengta a; Agam sunga mi zawng leh chimawte loungal koima anuasie nawn sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh aman Jehoiakin khu Babilon ah sal in apuita a, tualeh leengpa nu, leengpa zite, amiliente, agam a mihatte, Jerusalem a kipat in Babilon ah sal in apui hi.","ref":"Ezek. 17.12"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Babilon leengpa’n pasal hat leh hangsan ngen tul sagi, khut siem leh siakhen siem mi tul khat, mi hat leh galdou thei ngentang, Babilon ah sal in apui siengta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Babilon leengpa’n, Jehoiakin paneu Mattaniah, ama thahengin leeng in apang sah a, tualeh amin Zedekiah chi’n ahen pieh hi.","title":"Zedekiah leengpa dia abawlna (2 Khang. 36.10-18)","ref":"Jer. 37.1; Ezek. 17.13"},"18":{"text":"Zedekiah leenga apan chiil in, kum sawmni leh khat ahi a, tualeh Jerusalem ah kum sawm leh khat vai ahawm hi. Tualeh anu min Hamutal ahia, Libnah khuo a Jeremiah tanu ahi.","ref":"Jer. 27.1-22; 28.1-17"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoiakim bawl dan zousie bangin, Mangpa mitmu in silgiloute abawl zing hi."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa lungthahna ziehin amitmu akipat apaimang masangsie in, Jerusalem leh Juda gam tungah tam silte ahing tung zel hi. Tuachi’n Zedekiah khu Babilon leengpa tungah ahelta hi.","ref":"Ezek. 17.15"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zedekiah leenga apan kum kuo na, ha sawmna ni sawmni in, hichi ahing hi a, Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar agalkap zousie toh Jerusalem dou dingin ahing kuontou ua, panmun abawl ua, tualeh akim vel ah, kulte abawl uhi.","title":"Jerusalem matna leh sietna","ref":"Jer. 21.1-10; 34.1-5; Ezek. 24.2"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n akhopi khu leengpa Zedekiah vaihawm kum sawm leh khatna dongin a imkhum hi."},"3":{"text":"Aha lina ni kuo niin, khopi sungah kiel ahing naseta a, agam mite a dingin neh ding mawngmawng a umta sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n khopi kulbang a suvang ua, Babilon miten khopi a imkuol vang un, galkap thei mi zousie zanlai in leengpa huon gei a, bang nite kikaal lampi ah ataimangta uhi. Tualeh leengpa khu phaijang lam nawin apei hi.","ref":"Ezek. 33.21"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Babilon galkapten leengpa Zedekiah anuadel ua, Jeriko phaijang ah anua phah ua, agalkapten ataizah san siengta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa aman ua, Riblah khuo a Babilon leengpa kungah azawpi ua, tualeh atungtang thu angaituo uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Zedekiah tapa khu amitmu ngei ah athat ua, tualeh Zedekiah mit akheu khie ua, sum-eng kol abul sah ua, tualeh Babilon gam dong apui uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 12.13"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar vaihawm kum sawm leh kum kuona ha ngana ni sagi niin Babilon leengpa veng pawla galkap lamkai Nebuzaradan Jerusalem ah ahing pei hi.","title":"Biehinn suhsietna"},"9":{"text":"Aman Mangpa inn meiin ahal a, leengpa inn leh Jerusalem a inn zousie, miliente inn teng zong mei in ahal a.","ref":"1 Leeng. 9.8"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh galkap lamkaipa kunga um Babilon galkapte zousie in Jerusalem kimkot a kulbangte a suchim sieng uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n khopi sunga um nalaite leh Babilon leengpa kunga na kipelutte, tualeh mipi um nalaite zousie, vengpawl a galkap lamkai Nebuzaradan in sal in apuimang siengta hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh galkap lamkai pa’n agam sunga mi zawng leh genthei, grep gui kem ding leh lou hou ding in anuasie hi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa inn a sum-eng khuomte leh atunnate, tualeh sum-eng a kibawl tuikuong lienpi Babilon galkap ten asatse dildel ua, tuate Babilon gam ah apomang sieng uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 7.15-26; 2 Khang. 3.15-17; 1 Leeng. 7.23-26; 2 Khang. 4.2-5"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh belte vut luohnate, thaumei puon tetannate, tawkeute sum eng a kibawl, siemputen azah uh um leh bel zousie zong a lamang sieng uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 7.45; 2 Khang. 4.16"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh mei lah na kuong, maiphiet kuongte toh, sana leh dangka a kibawlte zousie Babilon galkap lamkai pan alamang sieng hi."},"16":{"text":"Solomon in Mangpa inn a dinga abawl, khuom nite, tuikuonglien leh atunnate, tam sum-eng bel leh kuongte zousie agihdan theiseng guollou ahi."},"17":{"text":"Khuom khat sandan khu tong sawm leh giet ahia, atungvum a alihbaw khu sum eng ahia, alihbaw san dan tong thum ahia, tualeh abaw tungah, apawl bilbiel bang, kawlbutheite abaw kimvel ah sum-eng ngen in akizema, tualeh hichibang main, akhuom khat pen zong akizem hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh galkap lamkai pa’n, siempu lienpen Seraiah, siempu nina Zephaniah, tualeh kotkhah vengmi thum aman hi."},"19":{"text":"Khopi sunga kipat in galkap thei mite lamkai khat leh leengpa thumoptu apang mi nga khopi sung a um nalaite tualeh, galkapte laigiel lienpen agam mipite tunga thuneipa leh khopi sunga um agam mite sawm guh aman hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkap lamkai lien Nebuzaradan in tam mite aman a, Riblah khuo Babilon leengpa kungah apeipita hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Babilon leengpa’n Hamath gam a Riblah khuo ah amauh athatta hi. Tuachi’n Judate agam ua kipat in puimangin a umta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in Juda gam anuasie lai a, a gam a um nalai mite tungah Shaphan tupa Ahikam tapa Gedaliah vaihawm dingin apang sah hi.","title":"Gedaliah uhpipa dinga bawlna","ref":"Jer. 40.7-9"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkap pawl lamkaite zousie leh amite un Babilon leengpa’n Gedaliah vaihawmtu dingin apangsah ta chi azah tahun Mizpah khuo a Gadaliah kungah ahaw ua, tuate khu Nethaniah tapa Ishmael, Kareah tapa Johanan, Netophath mi Tanhumeth tapa Seraiah, Makathmi tapa Jaazaniah te khu amite uh ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gedaliah khu ama u’leh amite uh masangah akichiema, akung uah “Babilonte suoha um ding zau sih un, tam gam ah umzing unlen, tualeh Babilon leengpa nna sem un, tuachi’n nou a dingin ahoi ding hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh aha sagi na ah, hichi ahing hia, leengpa insungmi, Elishma tapa Nethaniah tapa Ishmael mi sawm toh ahing kuon ua, Gadaliah leh Judate tualeh Babilon mi akunga aumpite toh ava that uhi.","title":"Gedaliah kithana","ref":"Jer. 41.1-3"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh mipi zousie alien aneuin galkap lamkaite nasan zong akisa ua, Izipt gam ah apeita uhi; Babilon mite agiin sengseng zieh un.","ref":"Jer. 43.5-7"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Juda leengpa Jehoiakin sal tanna kum sawm thum leh kum sagina, aha sawm leni na, ani sawmni leh sagi niin, Babilon leengpa Evil-Merodak avaihawm pat kum in Juda leengpa Jehoiakin khu suongkul akipat in aha dohta hi.","title":"Jehoiakin kihadohna"},"28":{"text":"Akungah hepina neitahin thu agen a, tualeh Babilon a aumpi leengte leengtouna sanga thupizaw ah, atou sah hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoiakin in asuongkul tanna puonsilte ahenga, tualeh adamsung tengin leengpa toh ann ane khawm ngitnget ta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n alaw ding apie a, tualeh adam sung teng nichin a, atulmaw dungzui in tanvou atuom in abawl pieh nalai hi."}}}}},"13":{"info":{"name":"1 Khangthute","shortname":"1 Khang.","abbr":[],"desc":"Khangthute laibu khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Adam, Sheth, Enosh","title":"Adam tapate (Siem. 5.1-32)"},"2":{"text":"Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,"},"3":{"text":"Enok, Mathuselah, Lamek,"},"4":{"text":"Noah, Shem, Ham leh Japheth."},"5":{"text":"Japheth tapate: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek leh Tiras.","title":"Japheth tapate (Siem. 10.2-5)"},"6":{"text":"Gomer tapate: Ashkenaz, Diphath leh Togarmah."},"7":{"text":"Javan tapate: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim leh Rodanim,"},"8":{"text":"Ham tapate: Kush, Mizraim put leh Kanaan.","title":"Ham tapate (Siem. 10.6-18)"},"9":{"text":"Kush tapate: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, Sabteka tualeh Raamah tapate: Sheba leh Dedan."},"10":{"text":"Kush in Nimrod ahinga, leitungah mihat khat ahing hipanta hi."},"11":{"text":"Mizraim in Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim leh Naphtuhim,"},"12":{"text":"Pathrusim, Kaslulim (Philistinte hing kipatna ahi) tualeh Kaphtorim ahing hi."},"13":{"text":"Kanaan in atapa masapen Sidon leh Heth,"},"14":{"text":"Jebusmite, Amormite leh Girgashmite,"},"15":{"text":"Hivmite, Arkmite, Sinmite,"},"16":{"text":"Arvadmite, Zemarmite, tualeh Hamath mite ahing hi."},"17":{"text":"Shem tapate: Elam, Asshur, Arpaksad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether leh Meshek.","title":"Shem tapate (Siem. 10.21-29 ; 11.10-26)"},"18":{"text":"Arpaksad in Shelah ahinga, tualeh Shelah in Eber ahing hi."},"19":{"text":"Eber in tapa ni anei a, khatpen min Peleg ahia (ama hunlai in leitung akikhen hi) tualeh asanggampa min Joktan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Joktan in Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,"},"21":{"text":"Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah"},"22":{"text":"Ebal, Abimael, Sheba"},"23":{"text":"Ophir, Havilah, Jobab, ahing hi. Tamte zousie Joktan tatate ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Shem, Arpaksad, Shelah.","title":"Shem khanggui Abraham dongin"},"25":{"text":"Eber, Peleg, Reu."},"26":{"text":"Serug, Nahor, Terah leh;"},"27":{"text":"Abram, tua khu Abraham ahi."},"28":{"text":"Abraham tapate: Isaak leh Ishmael."},"29":{"text":"Tamte akhanggui uh ahi. Ishmael ta masapen Nabaioth, tuazou in Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,","title":"Ishmael tapate (Siem. 25.1-4 , 12-16)"},"30":{"text":"Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,"},"31":{"text":"Jetur, Naphish, Kedemah, ahing pieng ua tamte Ishmael tapate ahi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Keturah Abraham meinu tapate: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak leh Shuah, anei hi. Tualeh Jokshan tapate Sheba leh Dedan.","title":"Keturah tapate"},"33":{"text":"Midian tapate: Ephah, Epher, Henok, Abida leh Eldaah. Tamte zousie Keturah tapate ahi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Abraham in Isaak ahinga. Isaak tapate Esau leh Israel ahi."},"35":{"text":"Esau tapate: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jaalam leh Korah,","title":"Esau tapate (Siem. 36.1-30)"},"36":{"text":"Eliphaz tapate: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna tualeh Amalek."},"37":{"text":"Reuel tapate: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah leh Mizzah."},"38":{"text":"Seir tapate: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezar leh Dishan."},"39":{"text":"Lotan tapate: Hori, Homan, tualeh Timna khu Lotan sanggamnu ahi."},"40":{"text":"Shobal tapate: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi leh Onan. Tualeh Zibeon tapate: Aiah leh Anah."},"41":{"text":"Anah tapate: Dishon, tualeh Dishon tapate; Hamran, Eshban, Ithran leh Keran."},"42":{"text":"Ezer tapate: Bilhan, Zaavan leh Jaakan, Dishan tapate: Uz leh Aran."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte tunga leeng koiman vai ahawm masang a, Edom gam a vaihawm leeng masate tamte ahi uhi. Beor tapa Bela, tualeh akhopi min khu Dinhabah ahi.","title":"Edom leeng masate (Siem. 36.31-43)"},"44":{"text":"Bela ashi bepin, Bozrah khuo a mi Zerah tapa Jobab in ama mun ah vaihawm in apang hi."},"45":{"text":"Jobab ashi bepin, Temanmite gam a, Husham in ama thahengin leeng vai ahawm hi."},"46":{"text":"Husham ashi bepin, Bedad, Moab gam a Midian thatpa tapa Hadad in vai ahawm hi, akhopi min Avith ahi."},"47":{"text":"Hadad ashi bepin Masrekah khuo a Samlahin ama thahengin vai ahawm hi."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh Samlah ashi bepin, lui gei a Rehoboth khuo a, Saul in ama thahengin vai ahawm hi."},"49":{"text":"Saul ashi bepin Akbor tapa Baal-Hanan in ama thahengin vai ahawm hi."},"50":{"text":"Tualeh Bal-Hanan ashi bepin, Hadad in ama thahengin vai ahawm hi, tualeh akhopi min khu Pai ahia, azi min khu Mehetabel ahi a, Mezahab tunu Matred tanu ahi."},"51":{"text":"Tualeh Hadad zong ashita a, tuachi’n Edom hausate, Timna, Alvah, Jetheth;"},"52":{"text":"Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,"},"53":{"text":"Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,"},"54":{"text":"Magdiel leh Iram. Tamte Edom hausate ahi uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tamte Israel tapate ahi uh; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Juda, Issakar, Zebulun;","title":"Jakob (Israel) tapate, khanggui (Siem. 29.31—30.24 ; 35.16-18)"},"2":{"text":"Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad leh Asher."},"3":{"text":"Juda tapate; Er, Onan, Shelah, tua mithumte khu Kanaan numei Shua tanu’n ama adinga ahin piehte ahi uh. Tualeh Juda tapa masapen Er khu Mangpa mitmuin agilou a, tuachi’n athatta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh amounu Tamar in Perez leh Zerah ahinpieha, Juda tapate abawn un nga ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Perez tapate; Hezron leh Hamul."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Zerah tapate; Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol leh Dara; abawn un nga ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Karmi tapate, Israel subuoipa, hamselaw sila natakhielpa Akan.","ref":"Josh. 7.1"},"8":{"text":"Ethan tapa; Azariah."},"9":{"text":"Hezron tapate zong ama adinga hin ahi ua; Jerameel, Ram, tualeh Kelubai."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Ram in Aminadab ahinga, tualeh Abinadab in Juda suonte lamkaipa Nahshon ahing hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Nahshon in Salma ahinga, tualeh Salma in Boaz ahing hi."},"12":{"text":"Boaz in Obed ahinga, tualeh Obed in Jesse ahing hi."},"13":{"text":"Jesse in atapa masapen Eliab ahinga, anina Abinadab, athumna Shimma;","title":"Jesse hahlesuonte"},"14":{"text":"Alina Nethaneel, angana Raddai,"},"15":{"text":"Aguhna Ozem, asagina David ahing hi."},"16":{"text":"Asanggamnute uh Zeruiah leh Abigail ahi uhi. Tualeh Zeruiah tapate; Abishai, Joab leh Asahel, thum."},"17":{"text":"Abigail in Amasa ahinga, tualeh Amasa pa khu Ishmaelmi Jether ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Hezron tapa Kaleb in Azubah akitenpi a, tanu anei ua amin Jerioth ahia, tapa thum zong anei a, atapate tamte ahi uh; Jesher, Shobab leh Ardon.","title":"Kaleb hahlesuonte"},"19":{"text":"Azubah ashi bepin, Kaleb in Ephrath anei a, amanu’n Hur ahin pieh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Hur in Uri ahinga, tualeh Uri in Bezalel ahing hi."},"21":{"text":"Khummi nua in Hezron Gilead pa in Makir tanu akitenpi a, khum hunlai in Hezron kum sawm guh ahita a, tuachi’n amanu’n Segub ahin pieh hi.","title":"Makir tanu akipat a Hezron hahlesuonte"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Segub in Jair ahinga, Jair khu Gilead gam sunga kho sawmni leh thum tunga vaihawmpa ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh Geshur leh Aram leenggamten Jair khopineute pum in khopineu sawm guh leh Kenath alah pieh uhi. Tamte zousie abawn un Gilead pa Makir hahlesuonte ngen ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hezron Kaleb Ephrathah khuo a ashi nua in Hezron zi Abijah in Tekoa pa Ashhur ahin pieh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Hezron ta masapen Jerameel tapate Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem leh Ahijah, ahi uhi.","title":"Jerahmeel hahlesuonte"},"26":{"text":"Jerahmeel in zi dang khat amin Atarah kichi zong anei a, amanu khu Onam nu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Jerameel tapa masapen Ram tapate; khu Maaz, Jamin leh Eker ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Onam tapate Shammai leh Jada ahi uhi tualeh Shammai tapate; Nadab leh Abishur ahi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Abishur zi min khu Abihail ahia, amanu’n Ahban leh Molid ahin pieh hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Nadab tapate; Seled leh Appaim ahia, Hinanleh Seled ta neilou in ashi hi."},"31":{"text":"Appaim tapa Ishi ahia, tualeh Ishi tapa; Sheshan, tualeh Sheshan tapa Ahlai ahi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Shammai sanggampa Jada tapate: Jether leh Jonathan: tualeh Jether tapa neilou in ashi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Jonathan tapate; Peleth leh Zaza ahi. Tamte zousie Jerahmeel tapate ahi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Sheshan in tanu chilou tapa anei sih hi. Tualeh Sheshan in Izipt mi suoh khat anei a, amin khu Jarha ahi.","title":"Sheshan hahlesuonte"},"35":{"text":"Sheshan in atanu khu asuohpa Jarha zi dingin akiteng sah a, tualeh amanu’n Attai ahin pieh hi."},"36":{"text":"Attai in Nathan ahinga, tualeh Nathan in Zabad ahing hi."},"37":{"text":"Zabad in Ephlal ahinga, Ephlal in Obed ahing hi."},"38":{"text":"Obed in Jehu ahinga, Jehuin Azariah ahing hi."},"39":{"text":"Azariahin Helez ahinga; Helez in Eleash ahing hi."},"40":{"text":"Eleash in Sismai ahinga, Sismai in Shallum ahing hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Shallum in Jekamiah ahinga, Jekamiah in Elishama ahing hi."},"42":{"text":"Jerahmeel sanggampa Kaleb hahlesuonte tamte ahi uhi; atapa masapen Mesha ahia, tuakhu Ziph pa ahi, tualeh Hebron pa khu Meresha tapate ahi uhi.","title":"Kaleb hahlesuon dangte"},"43":{"text":"Hebron tapate: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem leh Shema ahi uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh Shema in Raham, Jorkoam pa ahinga, tualeh Rekem in Shammai ahing hi."},"45":{"text":"Tualeh Shammai tapa khu Maon ahia, Maon khu Beth-zur pa ahi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh Kaleb meinu Ephah in Haran, Moza leh Gezez ahinga, tualeh Haran in Gazez ahing hi."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh Jahdai tapate: Regem, Jotham, Geshan Peleth, Ephah, tualeh Shaaph."},"48":{"text":"Kaleb meinu Makah in Sheber leh Tirhanah ahing hi."},"49":{"text":"Amanu’n Madmannah pa Shaaph, Makbenah pa Sheva, tualeh Gibeah pa ahinga, tualeh Kaleb tanu khu Aksa ahi."},"50":{"text":"Tamte khu Ephrathah taluchil Hur hahlesuonte ahi uhi. Kirjath Jearim pa Shobal,","title":"Hur tapa Kaleb hahlesuonte"},"51":{"text":"Bethlehem pa Salma, Beth-gadar pa Hareph."},"52":{"text":"Tualeh Kirjath Jearim pa Shobal in tapate anei a; Haroeh leh Manaheth mite kim khat."},"53":{"text":"Tualeh Kirjath Jearim innkuonte, Ithrit mite, Puth mite, Sumath mite leh Mishrai mite. Ama ua kipat in Zorathmite leh Eshtaol mite ahing pieng doh uhi."},"54":{"text":"Salma hahlesuonte: Bethlehem, Netophathmite, Atroth-Beth Joab, Manahath mite kimkhat, Zormite;"},"55":{"text":"Tualeh Jebez khuo ateng laigiel mite phungte Tirathte, Shimethte, tualeh Sukathte. Tamte khu Rekab innkuonte pa Hemath apat hing piengdoh Ken mite ahi uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tamte Hebron khuo a pieng David tapate ahi uhi: Ata chil Amnon Jezreel numei Ahinoam lah a pieng ahia, anina Karmel numei Abigail tapa Daniel ahi.","title":"David innkuon Hebron a piengte (2 Sam. 3.2-5 ; 5.13-16)"},"2":{"text":"Athumna Geshur leengpa Talmai tanu Maakah tapa Absalom, a lina Hagigith tapa Adonijah;"},"3":{"text":"Angana, Abital tapa Shephatiah ahia, aguhna azi Eglah tapa Ithream ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tam guhte khu Hebron khuo a anei ahi. Tualeh khunah kum sagi leh haguh sung vai ahawm a, tualeh Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum leh kumthum vai ahawm hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 5.4,5; 1 Leeng. 2.11; 1 Khang. 29.27"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu Jerusalem a aneite ahi uhi; Shimeah, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, ali un Ammiel tanu Bath-Shua tapate ahi uhi.","ref":"2 Sam. 11.3"},"6":{"text":"Ibhar, Elishama leh Eliphelet;"},"7":{"text":"Nogah, Nepheg leh Japhia;"},"8":{"text":"Elishama, Eliada leh Eliphelet kuo."},"9":{"text":"Tamte zousie meinute tapate chilou David tapate ahi uhi. Tualeh asanggamnu uh Tamar ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Solomon tapa Rehoboam, ahia, atapa Abijah, atapa Asa, atapa Jehoshaphat;","title":"Solomon hahlesuonte"},"11":{"text":"Atapa Joram, atapa Ahaziah, atapa Joash;"},"12":{"text":"Atapa Amaziah, atapa Azariah atapa Jotham;"},"13":{"text":"Atapa Ahaz, atapa Hezekiah, atapa Manasseh;"},"14":{"text":"Atapa Amon, atapa Josiah."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Josiah tapate: ata masapen Johanan, anina Jehoiakim, athumna Zedekiah, alina Shallum."},"16":{"text":"Jehoiakim tapate: atapa Jekoniah, atapa Zedekiah."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh sal a taang Jekoniah tapate: atapa Assir, atapa Shealtiel;"},"18":{"text":"Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, tualeh Nedabiah."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Pedaiah tapate: Jerubbabel, Shimei, tualeh Jerubbabel tapate: Meshullam, Hannaniah, tualeh asanggamnu uh Shelomith;"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah leh Jushab-Hesed-abawn un nga ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Hananiah tapate khu: Pelatiah leh Jeshaiah, Rephaiah tapate, Aman tapate, Obadiah tapate, Shekaniah tapate."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Shekaniah tapate; Shemaiah, tualeh Shemaiah tapate: Hattush, Igeal, Bariah, Neariah leh Shaphat-abawn un guh ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Neariah tapate: Elioenai, Hezekiah leh Azrikam abawn un thum ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Elioenai tapate: Hodaiah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Dalaiah, tualeh Anani abawn un sagi ahi uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda tapate: Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur leh Shobal.","title":"Juda hahlesuonte khangthu"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Shobal tapa Reaiah in Jahath ahinga, tualeh Jahath in Ahumai leh Lahad ahing hi. Tamte khu Zorathmite innkuonte ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu Etam pa tapate ahi uhi; Jezreel, Ishma leh Idbash, tualeh asanggamnu u’min Hazelelponi ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Gedor pa Penuel, tualeh Hushah pa Ezer, tamte khu Hur Bethlehem pa, Ephrathah ta masapen Hur tapate ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Tekoa pa Ashur in zi ni anei a, Helah leh Naarah."},"6":{"text":"Naarah in Ahuzam, Hepher, Temeni leh Haahashtari ahin pieha. Tamte khu Naarah tapate ahi uhi"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Helah tapate: Zereth, Jezoar leh Ethnan ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Koz in Anub, Zobebah leh Harum tapa Aharhel innkuonte ahing hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Jabez khu asanggamte sang in azatat huoi zaw a, tuachi’n anu’n amin Jebez ahisah hi, “Lunggim tah a ka nei ahiziehin,” achi hi.","title":"Jabez tungtang leh athumna"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Jebez in Israel Pasian ahan a, “Aw hing guolzawl inlen, ka tenna gam hing lien sah in, na khut in hing umpi henlen, silgilou lah a kipat in hing kem in, ahing lunggim sahlou na dingin” achi hi. Tuachi’n Pasian in angetna apie hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Shuah sanggampa Kelub in Mehir ahinga tuakhu Eshton pa ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Eshton in Beth-Rapha, Paseah leh Irnahash pa Tehinah ahing hi. Tamte khu Rekah mite ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Kenaz tapate: Othniel leh Seraiah. Tualeh Othniel tapate; Hahath leh Meonothai."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Meonothai in Ophrah ahinga, tualeh Seraiah in Ge Harashim pa Joab ahing hi, aziehpen tam phaijang a tengte khutsiem ngen ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Jephuneh tapa Kaleb tapate: Iru, Elah leh Naam ahi ua; tualeh Elah tapa Kenaz ahi."},"16":{"text":"Jehaleleel tapate: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria leh Asarel."},"17":{"text":"Ezrah tapate: Jether, Mered, Epher leh Jalon. Tualeh Mered zi in Mirriam, Shammai leh Eshtemoa pa Ishbah ahing hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh a zi Jehudijahin Gedor pa Jared leh Sokoh pa Heber leh Zanoah pa Jekuthiel ahing hi. Tualeh tamte Meredin akitenpi azi Pharaoh tanu Bithiah tapate ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh azi Naham sanggamnu Hodiah tapate khu: Garmi mite pa Keilah leh Makath mite pa Eshtemoa ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Shimon tapate: Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan leh Tilon ahi uhi. Tualeh Ishi tapate: Zoheth leh Benzoheth ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Juda tapa Shelah tapate: Lekah pa Er leh Mareshah pa Laadah, leh puonmalngat hoi bawlte innkuonte leh Ashbea inn kuonte, ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Jokim leh Kozebamite leh Joash leh Moab gam a vaihawma napang Saraph leh Jashubi-lehem. Tamte khu khangluilai chiemtena sil lui mama ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute khu Netaim leh Gederah khuote a, na teng leengpa nasem a pang, belkheng mite ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Simeon tapate khu Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah leh Saul ahi uhi.","title":"Simeon hahlesuonte leh akhopite uh (Siem. 46.10)"},"25":{"text":"Atapa Shallum, atapa Mibsam, atapa Mishma."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Mishma tapate: Atapa Hamuel, atapa Zakkur, atapa Shimei, ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Shimei in tapa sawm leh guh leh tanu guh anei hi. Hinanleh a sanggamten ta ahau sih ua, amauh be leh phung pen Juda phung leh taangte bangin a apung sih ua, atam sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Amaute Beer-Sheba leh Moladah leh Hazar-Shual,","ref":"Josh. 19.2-8"},"29":{"text":"Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,"},"30":{"text":"Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,"},"31":{"text":"Beth-Markaboth, Hazar-Susim, Beth-Biri leh Shaaraim te ah ateng uhi. Tamte khu David vaihawm tan dongin akhopite uh ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh akhoneute uh Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token, tualeh Ashan, ahia, khuo nga."},"33":{"text":"Akimvela khoneu zousie Baalath sim tumlam dongin ateng ua. Tamte khu atenna khuote u’leh akhanggui sutna, min gelna, akep hoite uh ahi."},"34":{"text":"Meshobab, Jamlek leh Amaziah tapa Joshah."},"35":{"text":"Joel leh Asiel tapa, Seraiah tapa, Joshibiah tapa Jehu;"},"36":{"text":"Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel leh Benaiah."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Shemiah tapa, Shimri tapa, Jedaiah tapa, Allon tapa, Shiphi tapa Zizah ahi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tam amin ua kigenkhate khu ainnkuon sung ua lamkaite ahi uhi, tualeh apate uh innsung khu nasatahin ahing pungta uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n aganhonte ua ding hampa hing sui dingin, phaijang suolam panga Gedor khuo lutna tandong apeita uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh lou dawng mitmetna leh hoina munte avamu ua, tualeh agam alien a, asip a, agalmuong hi, aziehpen nidang laiin khum gam ah Ham mite ana teng uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh tam min kigielte, Juda leengpa Hezekiah damlai in ahing kuon ua, Hammite leh khuna na teng Meunmite asim ua, apuon innte uh, tuni tan donga mutheiin asumangthai uhi. Tuachi’n amauh tua munte luoin ateng uhi, aziehpen khunah agantate ua ding loudawng hoitah a um hi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh Simeon mite zanga in, Ishi tapate Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, leh Uzziel lamkaina in Seir singtang gam ava bulu ua."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh Amalek mi asuohta um nalaite ava that ua, tuachi’n tuni tandongin khum mun ah ateng uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel ta masapen Reuben tapate (amapa tapa masapen ahia, hinanleh apa lupna asuhbua ziehin ata upa hina, Israel tapa Joseph tapate kunga pieh ahita a, tuaziehin a upatna dungzuiin khangthu akisim sih hi.","title":"Reuben hahlesuonte","ref":"Siem. 35.22; 49.3,4"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Juda asanggamte lah ah ahatpen a, tuachi’n ama akipat in vaihawmtu ahing um a, hinanleh upa hina pen Joseph a ahi.)","ref":"Siem. 49.8-10"},"3":{"text":"Israel tapa masapen Reuben tapate: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron leh Karmi, ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Joel tapate: atapa Shemaiah, atapa Gog, atapa Shimei;","ref":"2 Leeng. 15.29"},"5":{"text":"Atapa Mikah, atapa Reiah, atapa Baal."},"6":{"text":"Atapa Beerah, ama khu Assiria leengpa Tilgath-Pileser in sal a apuimang ahi a, ama Reuben mite lah a lamkai ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Reuben namte khangthu sutna a aphung sung ua a unaute uh u pate khu, Jeiel leh Zekariah;"},"8":{"text":"Azaz tapa Bela, shema tapa, Joel tapa. Amaute Aroer gamkai akipat a Nebo leh Baal-Meon tandongin atengta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh suolam ah Euphrates luipi akipat gamdai lutna dong ateng uhi; aziehpen aganhonte uh Gilead gam ah ahing pung mama ta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Saul damlaiin Hagri mite toh akidou ua, tuate azou ua, tualeh Gilead gam suolam zousie luo suoh in apuon innte uah ateng uhi."},"11":{"text":"Gad namte khu Reuben namte tenna mallam Bashan gam leh suolam-a Selekah tandong ah ateng uhi.","title":"Gad tapate leh atennate uh"},"12":{"text":"Joel khu aphung sung ua upa pen ahia, aban ah Sapham, Jaanai leh Bashan gam a Shaphat."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh apate uh innkuon a a unaute u’khu; Mikael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jurai, Jakan, Zia leh Heber abawn un mi sagi."},"14":{"text":"Ama u’khu Huri tapa Abihail, hahlesuonte ahi ua, apu uapat khanggui kizopna khu, Abihaik, Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Mikael, Jeshishai, Jahdo leh Buz, ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Guni tupa Abdiel tapa Ahi, khu tam phungte u pa pen ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Amauh pen Bashan leh Gilead gamkai sung a akhopite u’leh Sharon phaijawl louhing tamna gam ah ateng uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tam khangthu sutna pen, Juda leengpa Jotham leh Israel leengpa Jeroboam vaihawm lai a naki giel ahi."},"18":{"text":"Reuben mite, Gadmite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte, mihangsante, namsau leh lum thuothei mite, thalkap siemte leh kidoudan zilsiemsa, galkap dinga kuon mi tul sawm li leh tul li leh zasagi leh sawm guh ahi uhi.","title":"Suolam namte galkapte"},"19":{"text":"Amaun Hagrimite, Jatur, Naphish leh Nodab mite ava kidoupi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amaun Pasian ah aginna uh a nga ua, kidou laiin akungah panpina angen ua, tuachi’n Pasian in angetna uh adawnga, Hagri mite leh akijoppite uh tungah galzawna apeta hi."},"21":{"text":"Agalte ua kipat in sangawngsau tul sawm nga, belam tulza leh tul sawmnga, sabiltung tul ni leh mihing tul za khat galhing in aman uhi."},"22":{"text":"Kidouna khu Mangpa a ahi ziehin midang tampi zong athat uhi. Tuachi’n sal a puimang a aum masangsie un tua gam ah ateng denta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Manasseh nam kimkhatte khu, khum gam sung Bashan akipat Baal-Hermon tuakhu Senir (Hermon muol) dongin ateng ua, apung deudeu uhi.","title":"Suolam Manasseh mite"},"24":{"text":"Tamte aphung sung ua upate ahi uhi: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah leh Jahdiel amauh mihat hangsan leh aphung sung ua tulpipa chiet ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute apu apate uh Pasian tungah agin umta sih ua, Pasian in amasang ua ana suhsietsa gam a na um mite milim pasiente bie in akizua ua.","title":"Suolam namte kipuimangna"},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin Israelte Pasian in Assiria leengpa Pul (tua khu Tiglath Pileser Assiria leengpa ahi) lungtang atohthou a, tuachi’n aman Reubenmite, Gadmite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte khu sal in apuimanga, tuachi’n amaute, Halah, Habar leh Hara, tualeh Gozan luipi gei ah tuni tan dongin ateng sah hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 15.19; 2 Leeng. 15.29; 2 Leeng. 17.6"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Levi tapate: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari.","title":"Levi tapate (Siem. 46.11)"},"2":{"text":"Kohath tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel."},"3":{"text":"Amram tapate: Aaron, Mosi leh Miriam. Tualeh Aaron tapate: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar."},"4":{"text":"Eleazar in Phinehas ahinga, Phinehas in Abishua ahing hi."},"5":{"text":"Abishua in Bukki ahinga, tualeh Bukki in Uzzi ahing hi."},"6":{"text":"Uzzi in Zerahiah ahinga, tualeh Zerahiah in Meraioth ahing hi."},"7":{"text":"Meraioth in Amariah ahinga, Amariah in Ahitup ahing hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahitup in Zadok ahinga, Zadok in Ahimaaz ahing hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahimaaz in Azariah ahinga, Azariah in Johanan ahing hi."},"10":{"text":"Johanan in Azariah ahinga, (ama khu Jerusalem a Solomon in alam biehinn a siempu nna sempa ahi)"},"11":{"text":"Azariah in Amariah ahinga, Amariah in Ahitup ahing hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahitup in Zadok ahinga, Zadok in Shallum ahing hi."},"13":{"text":"Shallum in Hilkiah ahinga, Hilkiah in Azariah ahing hi."},"14":{"text":"Azariah in Seraiah ahinga, Seraiah in Jehozadak ahing hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Nebukadnezzar khut zang a Juda leh Jerusalem mite zousie a puimang lai in Zehozadak khu saltangte lah ah puimang in atelkha hi."},"16":{"text":"Levi tapate: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari.","title":"Gershon, Merari leh Kohath hahlesuonte","ref":"Pawt. 6.16-19"},"17":{"text":"Tamte Gershon tapate min ahi; Libni leh Shimei."},"18":{"text":"Kohath tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel."},"19":{"text":"Merari tapate: Mahli leh Mushi. Tualeh apu apate uh khanggui dungzuiin tamte Levi innkuonte ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Gershon innkuonte: atapa Libni, atapa Jahath, atapa Zimmah."},"21":{"text":"Atapa Joah, atapa Iddo, atapa Zerah, atapa Jeaterai."},"22":{"text":"Kohath tapate: atapa Amminadab, atapa Korah, atapa Assir."},"23":{"text":"Atapa Elkanah, atapa Ebiasaph leh atapa Assir."},"24":{"text":"Atapa Tahath, atapa Uriel, atapa Uzziah, tualeh atapa Saul."},"25":{"text":"Elkanah tapate: Amasai leh Ahimoth."},"26":{"text":"Ahimoth tapate khu: Elkanah, Zophai leh Nahath."},"27":{"text":"Eliab, Jeroham leh Elkanah ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Samuel tapate: atapa masapen Joel ahia, anina khu Abijah ahi."},"29":{"text":"Merari tapate: atapa Mahli, atapa Libni, atapa Shimei leh atapa Uzza."},"30":{"text":"Atapa Shimeah, atapa Haggiah, atapa Asaiah."},"31":{"text":"Tamte khu, thuhun bawm akingah nua a, David in Mangpa biehinn sunga la lam nasepna mawpuohna ladinga aguot mite ahi uhi.","title":"Biehinn a tumging siempawl"},"32":{"text":"Solomon in Jerusalem a Mangpa inn alam masangsien amaun kimutuona biehbuh mai ah la lam nasem in aum uhi. Tualeh ama ua dinga hun kiguot dungzui in asem uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh tam mite khu apate utoh nasem khomte ahi uhi. Kohathmite tapa te; Joel tapa lasapa Heman, Samuel tapa."},"34":{"text":"Elkanah tapa, Jeroham tapa, Eliel tapa, Toa tapa."},"35":{"text":"Zuph tapa, Elkanah tapa, Mahath tapa,"},"36":{"text":"Amasai tapa,"},"37":{"text":"Elkanah tapa, Joel tapa, Azariah tapa, Zephaniah tapa,"},"38":{"text":"Tahath tapa, Assir tapa, Abiasaph tapa, Korah tapa."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh azietlama ding asanggampa Asaph, Berakiah tapa, Asaph ngel, Shimeah tapa,"},"40":{"text":"Mikael tapa, Baaseiah tapa, Malkijah tapa,"},"41":{"text":"Ethni tapa, Zerah tapa, Adaiah tapa,"},"42":{"text":"Ethan tapa, Zimmah tapa, Shimei tapa,"},"43":{"text":"Jahath tapa, Gershon tapa, Levi tapa."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh a unaute uh Merari tapate khu aveilampangah ading ua: Kishi tapa, Ethan tapa, Abdi tapa, Malluk tapa."},"45":{"text":"Hashabiah tapa, Amaziah tapa, Hilkiah tapa,"},"46":{"text":"Amzi tapa, Bani tapa, Shemer tapa,"},"47":{"text":"Mahli tapa, Mushi tapa, Merari tapa, Levi tapa."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh a unaute uh Levimite zong Pasian biehbuh a nasepna chintenga dinga guot ahi uhi."},"49":{"text":"Hinanleh Aaron leh atapate pen, Pasian suohpa Mosi in thu apieh zousie dungzuiin halmang sillatte maitam tung leh gimnamtui halna maitam tungah sil alan ua, Munsiengthoupen a nasepna zousie a ding leh Israelte a dinga tatna bawl dinga guot ahi uhi.","title":"Aaron hahlesuonte"},"50":{"text":"Tamte khu Aaron tapate ahi uhi: a tapa Eleazar, atapa Phinehas, atapa Abishua,"},"51":{"text":"atapa Bukki, atapa Uzzi, atapa Zerahiah,"},"52":{"text":"atapa Meraioth, atapa Amariah, atapa Ahitup,"},"53":{"text":"atapa Zadok leh atapa Ahimaz, ahi uhi."},"54":{"text":"Tamte khu agamsung ua apuoninn jahnate uh dungzui a, atenna munte uh ahi; Aaron tapate, Kohath mite innkuonte’n gam atang masa pen uhi, aziehpen a aisan uh ama uh tungah atumasa pen hi.","title":"Siempute leh Levite khopite"},"55":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh kungah Juda gam a Hebron leh akimvel gamte apie uhi."},"56":{"text":"Hinanleh khuna khopi kimvel a gamte leh khoneute Jephuneh tapa Kaleb kungah apie uhi."},"57":{"text":"Tualeh Aaron tapate kungah kihumbitna khopite Hebron leh Libnah tualeh akimvel gamte toh, Jattir leh Eshtemoa leh akimvel a gamte toh apie uhi."},"58":{"text":"Hilen leh akimvel gamte, Debir leh akimvel gamte,"},"59":{"text":"Ashan leh akimvel gamte, tualeh Beth-shemesh leh akimvel gamte toh apie uhi."},"60":{"text":"Tualeh Benjamin nam akipat: Geba leh akimvel gamte, Alemeth leh akimvel gamte, Anathoth leh akimvel gamte toh. Amaute a innkuon zousie ua a khopite zousie uh a bawn in khopi sawm leh thum ahi."},"61":{"text":"Tumlam gam a um Manasseh nam kimkhatte akipat khopi sawm, kohath phunga mi umnalaite kungah, ainnkuon uh dungzui zel in aisan in ahawm uhi."},"62":{"text":"Gershon phungte khu, ainnkuon uh kizom dan dungzuiin, Issakar nam akipat, Asher nam akipat, Naphtali nam akipat, Bashan suolam gam a Manasseh nam kimkhat akipat, khopi sawm leh thum apie uhi."},"63":{"text":"Hichibangma in Merari phung mite ainnkuon uh kizom dan dungzui in, Reuben namte akipat, Gad namte akipat, Zebulun namte akipat in, aisan in khopi sawm leh ni apie uhi."},"64":{"text":"Hichibangin Israel taten Levi mite kungah tam khopite leh akimvel gamte apie uhi."},"65":{"text":"Tualeh Israel taten Levi mite kungah, Juda nam akipat, Simeon nam akipat leh Benjamin nam akipat amin ua kihan tam khopite aisan in akung uah apie uhi."},"66":{"text":"Tualeh Kohath phungte innkuon khenkhat ten Ephraim nam akipat, amau a dingin khopite leh akimvel gamte apie uhi."},"67":{"text":"Tualeh amaun akung uah, kihumbitna khopite apie ua; Ephraim singtang gam a Shekem khopi leh akimvel gamte leh Gezer khopi leh akimvel a gamte toh apie uhi."},"68":{"text":"Jokmeam leh akimvel gamte, Beth-Horon leh akimvel gamte toh."},"69":{"text":"Aijalon leh akimvel gamte, Gath-Rimmon leh akimvel gamte toh."},"70":{"text":"Tumlam gam a um Manasseh nam kimkhatte akipat in Aner leh akimvel gamte, Bileam leh akimvel gamte Kohath phunga innkuon umnalaite kungah apie uhi."},"71":{"text":"Tualeh suolam Manasseh nam kimkhatte a kipat in, Gershon phungte apieh ukhu, Bashan gam a Golan leh akimvel gamte, leh Ashtaroth leh akimvel gamte ahi."},"72":{"text":"Tualeh Issakar nam apat in; Kadesh leh akimvel gamte, Daberath leh akimvel gamte,"},"73":{"text":"Ramoth leh akimvel gamte, Anem leh akimvel gamte apie uhi."},"74":{"text":"Tualeh Asher nam apat in, Mashal leh akimvel gamte, Abdon leh akimvel gamte,"},"75":{"text":"Hukok leh akimvel gamte, Rehob leh akimvel gamte,"},"76":{"text":"Tualeh Naphtali nam apat in, Galili gam a Kadesh leh akimvel gamte, Hammon leh akimvel gamte, Kirjathaim leh akimvel gamte ahi."},"77":{"text":"Merari phungte lah a innkuon umnalaite kung ah, Zebulun nam apat in, Rimmon leh akimvel gamte, tualeh Tabor leh akimvel gamte pieh ahi."},"78":{"text":"Tualeh Jerikou kunga Jordan gal suolam panga Reuben namte apat in, gamdai a Bezer leh akimvel gamte, Jahzah leh akimvel gamte;"},"79":{"text":"Kedemoth leh akimvel gamte, Mephaath leh akimvel gamte toh ahi."},"80":{"text":"Tualeh Gad nam apat in Gilead-Ramoth leh akimvel gamte, Mahanaim leh akimvel gamte;"},"81":{"text":"Heshbon leh akimvel gamte, tualeh Jazer leh akimvel gamte, apie uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Issakar tapate khu: Tola, Puah, Jashub leh Shimron li ahi uhi.","title":"Issakar hahlesuonte (Siem. 46.13)"},"2":{"text":"Tola tapate khu: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Jibsam leh Shemuel; tamte Tola phungsunga a innkuonte lah ua upa pen chiet ahi ua, galhangsan zong ahi uhi. David damlai in amauh innsungmi pouma tul sawmni leh tul ni leh zaguh ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Uzzi in tapa khat anei a, Izrahiah ahi. Izrahiah in tapa li anei a, Mikael, Obadiah, Joel leh Ishiah ahi ua, aphung sung ua upa ahi chiet uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n zi tampi leh ta tampi anei ua, a innkuon dungzui un galdou thei galkap pawl mi tul sawm thum leh tul guh apedoh thei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Issakar innkuonte lah a a unaute u’khu mihat hangsan ngentang akhanggui uh sutna a kigiel dungzui in, aunpi un tul sawm giet leh tul sagi ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Benjamin in tapa thum anei a: Bela, Beker leh Jediael abawn un thum ahi uhi.","title":"Benjamin leh Dan hahlesuonte (Siem. 46.21)"},"7":{"text":"Bela in tapa nga anei a, Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth leh Iri ahi ua, a phungsung ua upa chiet leh galkap hangsan ngen ahi uhi; tualeh galdou thei pasal tul sawmni leh tul ni leh sawm thum leh li ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Beker in tapa kuo anei a, Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jerimoth, Abijah, Anathoth leh Alemeth, ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"A hahlesuonte uh ainn kuon kuon ua kisim dan dungzui in pasal galdou thei tul sawmni leh zani apha uhi."},"10":{"text":"Jediael in tapa khat anei a, Bilhan ahi. Tualeh Bilhan in tapa sagi aneia, Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Jethan, Tarshish leh Ahishahar."},"11":{"text":"Amau’te aphungsung chiet ua upa leh galhang ngen ahi uhi. Galdou thei ngentang pasal tul sawm leh tul sagi leh zani ahi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ir tapate Shuppim leh Huppim te khu tamte lah a tel ahi uhi, Aher in tapa khat anei a Hushim ahi."},"13":{"text":"Naphtali in tapa li anei a, Hahziel, Guni, Jezer leh Shallum te ahi uhi, (Bilhah suonte ahi uhi.)","title":"Naphtali hahlesuonte"},"14":{"text":"Manasseh tapate: Azipi in Asriel ahinga (ameinu Aram numei in Gilead pa Makir ahing hi.","title":"Manasseh hahlesuonte (Siem. 46.24)"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Makir in Huppim leh Shuppim sanggamnu Makah zi in anei hi) tualeh anina min khu Zelophehad ahi, Zelophehad in tanute anei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Makir zi Makah in tapa khat anei a, amin Peresh ahia, asanggampa min Sheresh ahi. Peresh in tapa ni anei a, Ulam leh Rekem ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Ulam tapate khu: Bedan ahia, tamte khu Manasseh tupa Makir tapa Gilead hahlesuonte ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Gilead sanggamnu Hammoleketh in tapa thum anei a, Ishod, Abiezer leh Mahlah ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Shemidah in tapa li anei a, Ahian, Shekem, Likhi leh Aniam, ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tamte akhanggui dungzui ua, Ephraim hahlesuonte ahi uh: Ephraim tapate Shuthelah leh atapa Bered, Tahath, Elada leh Tahath;","title":"Ephraim hahlesuonte"},"21":{"text":"Zabad leh Shuthela, tualeh Shuthela chilou Ephraim in tapa ni anei be nalai a, Ezer leh Elead ahi ua, amaute gelin tam gam a na teng Gath mite gantate ava guh sawm zieh ua ana thate uh ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n apa uh Ephraim in ni tamtah amauh asuun a, asanggamten ama ang henem uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n azi aluppi kia a, agai a, tapa ahing nei a, ainnsung uh vangsietna’n abuohkhum ziehin amin dingin Beriah aphuo hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh atanu khu Sheerah ahia, amanu’n Beth-Horon nuoinung zaw leh sahta zaw tualeh Uzzen Sheerah khopi abawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Ephraim in tapa khat anei a amin Rephah ahi, ahahlesuonte khu, Resheph, Telah leh Tahan;"},"26":{"text":"Laadan, Amihud leh Elishma,"},"27":{"text":"Nun leh Joshua ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Agam lahte u’leh atennate u’khu Bethel leh akhopelte, suolam ah Naaran leh tumlam ah Gezer leh akhopelte toh, tualeh Shekem leh akhopelte, Ayyah dongin akhopelte toh;"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Manasseh hahlesuonte gamgi zulah Beth-Shean, Taanak leh akhopi neute, Megiddo leh akhopineute Dor khopite leh akhopi neute tungah thu anei uhi. Tam khopite zousie ah Israel tapa Joseph hahlesuonte ateng uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tamte Asher hahlesuonte ahi uhi: Aman tapa li anei a, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi leh Beriah leh asanggamnu uh Serah ahi uhi.","title":"Asher hahlesuonte (Siem. 46.17)"},"31":{"text":"Berah in tapa ni anei a, Heber leh Malkiel ahi uhi. (Ama Birzaith pa ahi.)"},"32":{"text":"Heber in tapa thum anei a: Japhlet, Shomer leh Hotham leh asanggamnu uh Shua ahi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Japhlet in zong tapa thum anei a; Pasak, Bimhal leh Ashvath ahi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Asanggampa Shomer tapate khu: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah leh Aram ahi uhi."},"35":{"text":"Asanggampa Hotham tapate khu: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh leh Amal ahi uhi."},"36":{"text":"Zophah tate khu: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri leh Imrah;"},"37":{"text":"Bezer, Hod, Shammah, Shilshah, Ithran leh Beera ahi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Jether tate suonte khu: Jephunneh, Pispah leh Ara;"},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Ulla tate khu: Arah, Hanniel leh Rizia ahi uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tamte zousie khu Asher tate ahi ua, ama uh phungsunga upa pen chiet leh, mihat hangsan leh lamkai muonhuoi ngen ahi uhi. Asher hahlesuonte lah ah pasal galdou thei ngentang tul sawmni leh tul guh aum uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin in tapa nga anei a, a upat dung zui un, Bela, Ashbel, Aharah,","title":"Benjamin hahlesuonte (Siem. 46.21)"},"2":{"text":"Nohah leh Rapha ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Bela tapate khu: Addar, Gera leh Abihud,"},"4":{"text":"Abishua, Naaman leh Ahoah,"},"5":{"text":"Gera, Shephuphan leh Huram ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu Ehud tapate ahi ua: Tamte khu Geba a teng aphung sung ua upate chiet ahi ua, Manahath ah sal in apuimang ua:"},"7":{"text":"Tuate khu Naaman, Ahijah leh Gera te ahi ua, sal a apuina uah aman Uzza leh Ahihud ahing hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Shaharaim in azite Hushim leh Baara akhulnua in, Moab gam ah tapate anei a."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh azi Hodesh aluppi a, tapa sagi anei a: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malkam,"},"10":{"text":"Jeuz, Shakia leh Mirmah, tam atapate khu amauh phungsung upa pente ahing hi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh aman Hushim toh tapa ni anei a, Ahitub leh Elpaal, ahi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Elpaal in tapa thum anei a: Eber, Misham leh Shamed ahi ua, amaun Ono leh Lod khopite leh akim avel a khoneute ana siem uhi."},"13":{"text":"Gath khopi a tengte a notdoh a, Aijalon khopi a aphung sung tuoh ua upa pente khu Beria leh Shemate ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Beria tapate khu: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,"},"15":{"text":"Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,"},"16":{"text":"Mikael, Ishpah leh Joha te ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Elpaal tapate khu: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hezeki leh Heber;","title":"Jerusalem a Benjamin hahlesuonte"},"18":{"text":"Ishmerai, Jizliah leh Jobab ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Shimei tapate khu: Jakim, Zikri, Zabdi,"},"20":{"text":"Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,"},"21":{"text":"Adaiah, Beraiah leh Shimrath te ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Shashak tapate khu: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,"},"23":{"text":"Abdon, Zikri, Hanan,"},"24":{"text":"Hananiah, Elam, Antothijah"},"25":{"text":"Iphdeiah leh Penuel te ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Jeroham tapate khu: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,"},"27":{"text":"Jaareshiah, Elijah leh Zikir te ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tamte khu Jerusalem ateng apu leh pate uh khanggui a aphungsung ua upa pente leh lutang pente ahi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Gibeon pa Jeiel in Gibeon khopi asiem a khunah atenga, azi min Maakah ahi."},"30":{"text":"Atapa upapen min khu Abdon ahia, tualeh adangte min khu, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,"},"31":{"text":"Gedor, Ahio, Zeker"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Mikloth, ahia; Mikloth in Shemeah ahinga. Amaute zong a sanggamte u’toh kigalsai in Jerusalem ah ateng uhi."},"33":{"text":"Ner in Kish ahinga, Kish in Saul ahinga, Saul in Jonathan, Malkishuah, Abinadab leh Esh-bal ahing hi.","title":"Saul inn kuonte"},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Jonathan tapa khu Merib-bal ahia, Meribbal in Mikah ahing hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Mikah tapate khu: Pithon, Melek, Tarea leh Ahaz ahi uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ahaz in Jehoada ahinga, Jehoada in Alemeth, Azmaveth leh Zimri ahing hi, tualeh Zimri in Moza ahing hi."},"37":{"text":"Moza in Binea ahinga, atapa Rapha ahia, atapa Eleasah ahia, tualeh atapa Azel ahi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Azel in tapa guh anei a, amin uh tamte ahi: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah leh Hanan te ahi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Asanggampa Eshek tapate khu: Atapa masapen Ulam ahia, anina Jeush ahia, tualeh athumna khu Eliphelet ahi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh Ulam tapate khu mihat hangsan leh thalkap siem mite ahi ua, tapate, tupate tampi anei a, za leh sawm nga ahi uhi. Tamte zousie a bawn un Benjamin hahlesuonte ahi uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mipite zousie a innkuon uh dungzui in sim ahi ua, tam min khumna khu Israel leengte vaihawm lai a minkhumna laibu sungah akigiel hi. Hinanleh Juda mite khu aginumlouna zieh ua Babilon lam a sal-a puimangin a umta uhi.","title":"Saltanna apat hing kile kia Israel nam sawm leh nite khang thu"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh amauh gam leh akhopite uh luo kia masate khu Israelte lah a mi vantangte, siempute, Levite leh biehinn nasemte ahi uhi.","ref":"Ezr. 2.27; Neh. 7.73"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem ah Juda mite, Benjamin mite, Ephraim mite leh Manasseh mite ateng uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amihud tapa Uthai, Omri tapa, Imri tapa, Mani tapa, Juda tapa Perez hahlesuonte,"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Shilon mite lah a ata masa Asaiah, tualeh a tapate."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh atapate lah ah, Jeuel leh asanggamte mi zaguh leh sawmkuo. Juda tapa Shelah hahlesuonte."},"7":{"text":"Benjamin tapate lah ah, Meshullam tapa Sallu, Meshullam khu Hassenuah tapa; Hodaviah tapa ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ibneiah khu Jeroham tapa ahia, Elah khu Uzzi tapa ahia, Mikri tupa ahi. Meshullam khu Shephatiah tapa ahia, Shephatiah Reuel tapa ahia, Reuel khu Ibnijah tapa ahi."},"9":{"text":"Akhanggui uh dungzui in Amaute innkuon za kuo leh sawm nga leh guh. Tamte khu amauh phungsunga upa chiet ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tamte khu Jerusalem a Pasian inn a vaisai siempute: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jakin leh,","title":"Jerusalema siempu tengte"},"11":{"text":"Hilkiah tapa Azariah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth leh Ahitup ten Pasian inn a vaihawmte ahi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Jehoram tapa Adaiah pu leh pate khu Peshur, Malkijah. Adiel tapa Maasai pu leh pate khu Jahzera, Meshullam, Meshillemith leh Immerte ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Siempu amauh innsung chiet a upa pente chiet khu tulkhat leh zasagi leh sawmguh ahi ua, Pasian biehinn nasepna siemtah ngen ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem a Levi tengte khu: Hashub tapa Shemai ahia, apu leh pate khu, Azrikam, Nashabi leh Merari phungte ahi uhi.","title":"Jerusalem a Levi tengte"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal leh Mikah tapa Mattaniah ahi ua, apu leh pate ukhu, Zikri leh Asaph ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Shemai tapa Obadiah ahi a, apu leh pate u’khu Galal, Jeduthun ahi ua, Asa tapa Berekiah khu Elkanah tupa ahia, Netophath mite khuote a tengte ahi uh."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh kotkha vengmite khu, Shallum, Akkub, Talmon leh Ahiman te ahi ua, tualeh a unaupa uh Shallum khu alamkaipa uh ahi"},"18":{"text":"Khum hun lai apat in, Lengpa kulpi kotkha suolampang ah khum phungsunga mite kotkha veng in apang uhi, masang lai in Levi miten giehphuol kotkha angah uhi."},"19":{"text":"Korah tapa khu Shallum ahia, Eliasaph tupa ahi a, Korah phungsunga a innkuonte u’toh Mangpa umna puon inn sunga nasem lamkaite ahi ua, biehbuh vengin zong apang ua, apu apate uh Mangpa giehphuol venga apan bangun ama u’zong kulpi lutna kotkha vengin apang uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Eleazar tapa Phinehas masang laiin atung uah vaihawm in ana pang a, tualeh Mangpa’n ama a umpi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Meshelemiah tapa Zekariah khu kimutuona biehbuh kotkha vengtu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Kotkha vengtu dinga kitel doh zousie zani leh sawm leh ni ahi ua, Tamte khu David leh guolnei Samuel in anasepna mun det a, ana guot uh, ama uh kho chiet a, akhangthu sutna ua sim ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama u’leh atate uh Mangpa inn kotkha vengtu in apang ua, biehbuh enkol in zong apang uhi."},"24":{"text":"Aning li tengah kotkha veng mite, suolam ah, tum lam ah, mallam ah tualeh simlam ah a um uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh a unaute uh khoneu a umte khu, ni sagi danin ama u’toh um khawm dingin, amauh hunhun in ahing pei zel uhi."},"26":{"text":"Kotkha vengmite lamkai lien lite khu Levimite ahi ua, tualeh Pasian biehinn a gou koinate leh pindante enkol lamkai zong ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh amauh tunga etkolna mawpuohna, a um ziehin Pasian inn kim ah ateng ua, tualeh zingmawng tenga kotkhate hon khu ama uh nasep ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh alah ua Levi nam dangten, biehinn a kizang bel leh kuongte akem ua, akoilut chieng u’leh alahdoh ding chiengun asim zel uhi.","title":"Levi dangte nasep"},"29":{"text":"Alah ua, loikhatte khu mun siengthou a, umlebelte leh vanzah zousie, tualeh tangbuong nelte, uointe, Olive thaute, begawte tualeh gimnamtuite enkol leh kem dinga guot ahi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh siempute tapate lah a loikhatten gimnamtuite nu thaw dingte tohhal in abawl uhi."},"31":{"text":"Korah mi Shallum tapa masapen, Levi mite lah khat Mattithiah in khangbela sillat dingte kan khu ama mawpuohna ahi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh a unau dangte uh Kohath tapaten khawlni chin a tanghou siengthou kitup tah a koi zel ding mawpuohna anei uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu lasa mite ahi uhi. Levi mite apu apa ua pat a aphungsung ua upa chiet ahi ua, biehinn sung leh apindante ah ateng ua, nasep dang tengah a awl ua, sun leh zan in lasahna nasep sem in apang uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tamte akhang simna dan dungzui ua, Levi mite apu apa ua kipat a, phungsung ua upa pente chiet ahi ua, Jerusalem a tengte ahi uhi."},"35":{"text":"Gibeon pa Jeiel in Gibeon khopi abawla khunah atenga, azi min khu Maakah ahi.","title":"Saul khang simna"},"36":{"text":"Ata masapen Abdon ahia, azom Zur ahia, tualeh Kish, Baal, Ner leh Nadab,"},"37":{"text":"Gedor, Ahio, Zekariah leh Mikloth te ahi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Mikloth in Shimeam ahinga, amaute zong a sanggamte u’toh kigal sai in Jerusalem ah ateng uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Ner in Kish ahinga, Kish in Saul ahing hi; tualeh Saulin Jonathan, Malkishuah, Abinadab leh Esh-bal, ahing hi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh Jonathan tapa khu Merib-bal ahia; Meribbal in Mikah ahing hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Mikah tapate khu Pithon, Melek, Tahrea leh Ahaz, ahi uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh Ahaz in Jarah ahing a, tualeh Jarah in Alemeth, Azmaveth leh Zimri ahinga, Zimri in Moza ahing hi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh Moza in Binea ahinga, Benea in Rephaiah ahinga, Raphaiah in Eleasah ahinga, Eleasah in Azel ahing hi."},"44":{"text":"Azel in tapa guh aneia, amin uh tamte ahi uhi: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah leh Hanan. Tamte Azel tapate ahi uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Philistine miten Israelte adou ua, Israel mite khu Philistin mite mai ah ataizahta uhi, tualeh Gilboa muol ah tha in aumta uhi.","title":"Saul leengpa shina (1 Sam. 31.1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistinten Saul leh atapate hadelin adel ua, tuachi’n Philistinten, Jonathan leh Abinadab tualeh Malkishuah, Saul tapate athatta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Saul toh kidouna khu ahuoise mama a, thalkapte’n Saul akap khata ua, thalkapten ama aliemsahta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in agalvan tawipa kungah, “Na namsau doh inlen hing dawt pailet mai in, tua ahisihleh tam teptanloute ahing pei ding ua, apmai na’n ahing neikha ding uh,” achi hi. Hinanleh azau sengseng ziehin agalvan tawipa a ut sih hi. Tuachi’n Saul in ama namsau aladoh a, abawkhumta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh agalvan tawipa’n Saul ashita chi athei tahin aman zong ama namsau abawkhum a ashita hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul ashita a, tualeh atapa thumte leh a innsung mite zousie zong ashi siengta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Phaijang a um Israel mite zousie in galkapte taizah leh Saul leh atapate ashita chi amutahun akhopite uh nuasie in ataizahta uhi; tuachi’n Philistin mite ahing pei ua, akhuote uah atengta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Azing ni a ami thate uh kivonnate sutkhe dinga Philistin mite ahing pei u’leh, Saul leh atapate Gilboa muol ah ashisa a lum aluong uh amuta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh atunga akivonnate asut zou tah un, alutang leh agalvante ala ua, amilim bieh innte u’leh mipite kunga tam thuthang kipahhuoi tut dingin Philistin gamsung pumpi ah thu athotta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n agalvante ukhu apasiente uh inn ah akoi ua, alutang pen Dagon biehna inn ah ataa uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Jabesh-Gilead mi zousie in, Philistin miten Saul tunga abawl dan zousie uh a zahtah un;"},"12":{"text":"Pasalpha leh galhangsan zousie akipan ua, Saul luong leh atapate luong ava la ua, Jabesh ah ahing puo uhi; tualeh agute ukhu, Jabesh khuo a gangpi sing nuoi ah avuita ua, ni sagi ann angawl uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul Mangpa tunga amuonhuoilou zieh leh Mangpa thute kal a dawi toh kizawl ai san siemte kunga agamtat dingdan adoh ziehin Saul ashita hi.","title":"Saul shina zieh","ref":"1 Sam. 13.8-14; 15.1-24; Siempu. 19.31; 20.6; 1 Sam. 28.7,8"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa adong ta sih a, tuaziehin Mangpa’n ama athatta hi, tuachi’n aleenggam khu Jesse tapa David kungah apeta hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mite zousie, Hebron ah David kungah ahing peikhawm ua, “Ngaivawi, koute na gu leh na tel navoute ka hi uhi.","title":"Israelte leengpa ding a David sathau nuna (2 Sam. 5.1-3)"},"2":{"text":"Tu masang lai a, Saul leenga apan lai ngei in zong nangman Israelte na puidoh a, na puilut zel hi. Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian in na kungah, Nangma’n ka mi Israelte na ching dinga, Ka mi Israelte tungah vai na hawm ding,” achi hi, achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin Israel upate zousie, leengpa kungah Hebron ah ahing pei ua, tualeh David in ama u’toh Hebron ah, Mangpa mai ah thuhun ahung ua, tualeh Samuel zanga Mangpa thugen dungzui in David khu Israelte tunga leengpa dingin sathau anuta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh David leh Israel mi zousie Jerusalem ah ahaw ua tuakhu Jebus ahia, Jebusmite khu a gam a tengte ahi uhi.","title":"Jerusalem lahna (2 Sam. 5.6-10)","ref":"Josh. 15.63; Vai. 1.21"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jebus a tengten David kungah, “Tamnah hing lut thei sih vateh” ana chi uhi. Ahivang in David in Zion kulpi ala a, tuakhu David khopi ahi."},"6":{"text":"David in “Koizong Jebusmite douding a kuon masa penpen khu galkap lamkai lienpen ahi ding hi,” achi a.
