Tuachi’n Zeruiah tapa Joab akuontou masa pen a, lamkai lienpen ahita hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n David kulpi sungah atenga, tuaziehin amaun David khopi achita uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Millo kimvel akipat in khopi kimhot in kulpite abawl ua tualeh Joab in khopi dangte abawlpha sieng hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n David khu galkapte Mangpa’n a umpi ziehin, ahing thupi deudeu ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu Israelte tungtang thu a, Mangpa thu dungzui a, David leengpa a bawl dinga aleenggam a, Israel mite zousie leh ama suhat dinga, David mihat neite lah a apen pente ahi uhi.","title":"David mihat hangsante (2 Sam. 23.8-12)"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu David in mihat anei phaza ahi: Hakmon mite tapa Jashobeam, mihat sawm thumte lah a lien pen; zathumte dou dingin ateipi aleh a, khatvei thu in amaute abawn un athat hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh ama zom in Ahoh mi Dodo tapa Eleazar ahia. Ama khu mihat thumte lah a khat ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ama khu David toh Pas-Dammim ah a um a; tualaitahin Barli bu a dim, loulai ah Philistin mite galdou dingin akikhawm ua, tualeh mipite khu Philistin mite masangah ataizahta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute tua loulai laikim tah a dingin apang ua, ahunkhie ua, Philistinte athat ua, tualeh Mangpa’n amaute guolzawna thupitah toh ahundamta hi."},"15":{"text":"Lamkai lien pen sawm thumte lah thumte khu suongpi langa, David kungah Adullam kawlhawm sungah apei suh ua, tualeh Philistin galkapten Rephaim phaijangah panmun akhaw uhi.","title":"Mihat hangsan penpen sawmthumte (2 Sam. 23.13-23)"},"16":{"text":"Khum hunlai in David khu kulpi sungah aum a, Philistin galkapte Bethlehem ah a um uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh David in tui alunggul a, “Oh! koi ahiei khat in kulkotkha bula um Bethlehem tuikul a tui dawn dingin hing pe thei leh izaw,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n mihat hangsan thumten Philistin galkapte giehphuol palsuohin kulpi kotkha bula um, Bethlehem tui ava thal ua, ahing tawi ua David kungah ahing tut uhi; Hinanleh David in tuakhu ana dawn nuom sih a, Mangpa kungah a sungbaw zawta hi."},"19":{"text":"“Tam sil ki bawl ding khu ka Pasian in hing phal vawt sih heh, ahinna uh taan ngam a kuon tam mite sisan ka dawn diei mah? amaun shi ngap a ahing tawi uh ahiziehin,” achi hi. Tuaziehin adawn nuom sih hi. Tam silte khu mihat thumte nasep ahi."},"20":{"text":"Joab sanggampa Abishai khu mi thumte lah a lamkai lienpen ahi. Aman za thumte dou dingin ateipi alaamtou a, amauh athatta hi, tuachi’n mi thumte lah ah aminthangta hi."},"21":{"text":"Thumte lah ah nite sangin ama azatat huoi zaw hi. Tuaziehin alamkaipa un apang hi. Hinanleh thumte lah a khatna ahi zou sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Kapzeel a kipat mihangsan pa tupa, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in sil thupi tampi abawl hi. Aman Humpibahnei bangmai a hat Moab mi ni athat a, tualeh vua kiah ni khat in akuon suh a, leikohawm sunga um humpibahnei khat athat hi."},"23":{"text":"Aman Izipt milien tong nga a sang khat athat a, tua Izipt mipa khut ah siemganmite siemkol bangmai teipi khat aum hi, tualeh ama chieng khat toh akuon suh a, Izipt mipa khuta kipat in ateipi a lah pieh a, tualeh ama teipi mama in Izipt mipa athatta hi."},"24":{"text":"Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in, tam silte abawla, tuachi’n mihat thumte lah ah aminthangta hi."},"25":{"text":"Ngai vawi, ama khu mi sawm thumte sangin a zatat huoi zaw a, hinanleh amasa thumte apha zou sih hi. Tuachi’n David in ama khu vengmite lamkai dingin aguot hi."},"26":{"text":"Galkap hangsan leh hatte khu Joab sanggampa Asahel, Bethlehem khuo a um Dodo tapa Elhanan,","title":"Mihat galhang diehte (2 Sam. 23.24-30)"},"27":{"text":"Haror mi Shammoth, Pelon mi Helez,"},"28":{"text":"Teko mi Ikkesh tapa Ira, Anathoth mi Abiezer,"},"29":{"text":"Hushath mi Sibbekai, Ahoh mi Ilai,"},"30":{"text":"Netophathmi Maharai, Netophathmi Baanah tapa Heled,"},"31":{"text":"Benjamin tate gamsunga um Gibeah mi Ribai tapa Ithai, Pirathon mi Benaiah;"},"32":{"text":"Gaash luitate a um Hurai, Arbath mi Abiel,"},"33":{"text":"Baharum mi Azmaveth, Shaalbon mi Eliahba,"},"34":{"text":"Gizon mi Hashem tapate, Harari mi Shagee tapa Jonathan"},"35":{"text":"Harari mi Sakar tapa Ahiam, Ur tapa Eliphal"},"36":{"text":"Mekerath mi Hepher, Pelonmi Ahijah,"},"37":{"text":"Karmel mi Hezro, Ezbai tapa Naarai,"},"38":{"text":"Nathan sanggampa Joel, Haggeri tapa Mibhar,"},"39":{"text":"Ammon mi Zelek, Beroth mi Naharai, Zeruiah tapa Joab galvan tawipa"},"40":{"text":"Ithrimi Ira, Ithrimi Gareb."},"41":{"text":"Hit mi Uria, Ahlai tapa Zabad,"},"42":{"text":"Reuben mi Shiza tapa Adina, Reuben mite lamkai lienpen leh ama toh mi sawm thum."},"43":{"text":"Maakah tapa Hanan leh Mithni mi Joshaphat"},"44":{"text":"Ashterath mi Uzzia, Shama leh Jehiel, Aroer mi Hothan,"},"45":{"text":"Shimri tapa Jediael leh Tiz mi asanggampa Joha."},"46":{"text":"Mahav mi Eliel leh Jeribai, Joshaviah, Elnaam tapate, tualeh Moab mi Ithmah,"},"47":{"text":"Eliel, Obed leh Mezoba mi Jasiel."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam mite khu, Kish tapa Saul leengpa giing a, David Ziklag khuo a akibut lai a, akunga hing hawte ahi uhi. Amaute galhangsan, lah a mi ahi ua, kidouna a, ama panpimite ahi uhi.","title":"Benjamin nam sunga David zui masate"},"2":{"text":"Amaute thal toh akigalvon ua, thalkap leh sailikap asiem ua, ziet lam leh veilam khut azang thei chiet uhi, Amaute khu Benjamin nam a Saul unaute ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"A lamkai lienpen uh Ahiezer ahia, aban ah Joash, Gibeath mi Shemaah tapate ahi ua, tualeh Azmaveth tapate Jeziel leh Pelet, tualeh Anathothmi Berakah leh Jehu;"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh sawmthumte lah a tel leh lamkai pasalpha Gibeon mi Ishmaiah; Jeremiah, Jahaziel Johanan, Gederah mi Jozabad,"},"5":{"text":"Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah leh Haruph mi Shephatiah,"},"6":{"text":"Korahmite Elkanah, Isshiah, Azareel, Joezer leh Jashobeam,"},"7":{"text":"leh Gedormi Jeroham tapate gel Joelah leh Zebadiah te ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Gad mite lah a, mihat hangsan, galdou dan siemsa, lum leh teipi zah dan siem chiet khenkhatte’n gamdai a akulpi ah David ava bel uhi, amaute amaitang uh humpibahnei maitang abang ua, tualeh muoltunga sakhital banga tuongang ahi uhi.","title":"Gad nam a kipat David zuite"},"9":{"text":"Ezer lamkai lienpen ahia, azom Obadiah, athumna Eliab, ahi,"},"10":{"text":"Alina Mishmannah, angana Jeremiah,"},"11":{"text":"aguhna Attai, asagina Eliel,"},"12":{"text":"agietna Johanan, akuona Elzabad,"},"13":{"text":"a sawmna Jeremiah, tualeh sawm leh khatna Makbanai ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tamte khu Gad mite lah a galkap lamkaite ahi ua, aneupen zong za tunga lamkai ahia, alien pen khu tul tunga lamkai ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tam mite khu Jordan lui apieua let a aluon lai a, ha masapen a va galkai a, khum phaijang a tengte suolam leh tumlam a va delzahte khu amaute mama ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Benjamin mite lawikhat leh Judate lawikhat David umna kulpi ah ava haw uhi.","title":"Benjamin leh Juda nam a kipat a anua zuite"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh David amauh kimupi dingin ava pawt a, adawnga, akung uah, “Kei hing panpi dinga lemna dei a, ka kunga hing haw na hi u’leh ka lungtang nou toh ka phankhawm dinga, hinanleh ka khutin silgilou abawl sih chi theinapi a, na hing hemhah ua, ka melmate hing mat sah tum a hing kuon nahi ulehvang ipu ipate Pasian in hing en henlen thu hing khenta heh” ava chi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n sawmthum tunga lamkai Amasai tungah, Hagau ahing tunga, “David aw nang a ka hi uhi, Jesse tapa aw nang lam a pang ka hi uhi, hamuonna, hamuonna na kungah um henlen, Nangma hing panpite kungah, hamuonna umta hen,” na Pasian in nang ahing panpi ziehin, achi hi. Tuachi’n David in amauh ana kipahpi a, galkapte lamkai dingin a guotta hi."},"19":{"text":"Saul dou dinga Philistin mite toh ahing kuon khawm lai in, Manasseh nam akipat pawlkhat in David ana zopta uhi, hinanleh Philistinte apanpita sih uhi, aziehpen Philistin galkap lamkaite akikum ua, apu “Saul lam ah hing pang kha van in, ei dingin ilu buh khohna higiap va,” achi ua, anua sawl kiata uhi.","title":"Manasseh nam apata David zuite"},"20":{"text":"David Ziklag khuo zuon a anua pei kia lai a Manassehte lah a galkap tul tunga lamkai David lam a pangte khu tamte ahi uhi; Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Mikael, Jozabad, Elihu leh Zillethai te ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amauten mi suompawl dou dingin David apanpi ua, aziehpen amaute, mihat leh galhangsan ngen leh a galkap lamkaite ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Khum hun laiin ani ani in, a panpi dingin David kungah mi ahing pei ua, Pasian galkap pawl banga pawl thupitah ahing hi masang sie un."},"23":{"text":"Mangpa thu dungzui a Saul leenggam David kunga lehei dinga, Hebron khopi a hing peikhawm galvan a kivon galdou dinga kiman sa galkapte ahon ahon a, atam dan uh tam bang ahi:","title":"Hebron a David galkapte"},"24":{"text":"Juda mite lum leh teipi tawi, kidouna galvon a kivon, tul guh leh za giet ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Simeon mite galdouna pang thei, mihat hangsan pasalpha, tul sagi leh za khat ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Levi mite lah akipat tul li leh za guh ahi uh."},"27":{"text":"Jehoiada khu Aaron mite lah a lamkai ahia, ama toh galkap tul thum leh za sagi aum uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tangval hat leh hangsan Zadok leh apa innkuon te galkap lamkai sawmni leh ni a um uhi."},"29":{"text":"Benjamin mite, Saul unaute tul thum, tamte khu masanglai in atamzawte Saul lam a pang ana hi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Ephraim mite lah a mihat hangsan, apulepate innkuon lah a na minthang toupeh mi tul sawmni leh zagiet."},"31":{"text":"Manasseh nam kimkhat David leengpa a bawl dinga amin kigendohsate, tul sawm leh tul giet."},"32":{"text":"Issakar mite lah hun theisiemna neite, Israel in bang ahiei abawl ding, chi thei ding, lamkai zani ahi ua, tualeh a unaute zousie uh ama uh thunuoi a um ahi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Zebulun nam akipan galdou siem galdou dinga kimansa, galvan chikima kivon, David adinga miginum tul sawm nga."},"34":{"text":"Naphtali nam akipat in galkap lamkai tul khat, amaute toh lum leh teipi tawi mi tul sawm thum leh tul sagi;"},"35":{"text":"Dan nam akipat galdou siem galkap tul sawmni leh tul giet leh zaguh;"},"36":{"text":"Asher nam akipat galdou akuon thei galdou siem mi tul sawm li,"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Jordan suolam gal a um Reuben mite, Gad mite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte, kidouna dinga galvan chikim a kivon, mi tulza leh tul sawm ni."},"38":{"text":"Tam mite zousie galdou mi, kidou dan siem ngen ahi ua, David khu Israelte tunga leenga bawl dingin, lungtang munkhat puoin Hebron ah ahing peikhawm ua, tualeh Israel midangte zousiein zong David leengpa a bawl dingin lungsim munkhat apo chiet uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tua miten khum mun ah David toh ni thum sung ne leh dawn in aum ua, a unaute un amauh dinga ana siempieh sa uh ahi."},"40":{"text":"Tuabep hilouin, akim nai ua umte, Issakar leh Zebulun, tualeh Naphtali tandongin zong, sabiltungte, sangawngsaute, sakolte leh bawngtalte in neh ding tanghoute, theipi beute, grepga kiphou gawte, uointe, sathaute, ahing puo ua, bawngtalte leh belamte ahing kai uhi. Israel gam khu kipahna a, adim tah ziehin."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in galkap lamkai zousie, tul telte tunga lamkaite leh za telte tunga lamkaite ahoupi a.","title":"Thuhun bawm Kiriath Jearim apat lah khiehna (2 Sam. 6.1-11)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in mipi kikhawmte zousie kung ah, “Nouten hoi na sah ua, Mangpa i Pasian un pha ahing sahpi leh, Israel gam sung pumpi a, mun chin tenga nuasie a um i unaute kungah thu ithezah ding ua, tualeh akhopite ua amautoh um khawm, akim avel ua louhing gam a teng siempute leh Levite zong, thu i hah ding a, tuachia ikunga ahing kikhop theina dingun."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh i Pasian bawm uh ikung uah ila kia ding uhi, aziehpen Saul hunlai akipat in ina kansui kha nawn sih uhi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi kikhawmte zousie in tuabanga bawl ding ahi achi ua, aziehpen tua thu khu mipite zousie mitmu ah adih mama hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Kiriath-Jearim apata Pasian bawm la dingin, Izipt gamgi, Sihor apat Hamath lutna donga, Israel mi zousie akhawm khawmta hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 7.1,2"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n David leh Israelmi zousie Baalah ah, tua khu Kiriath Jearim ahi a, Juda gam a um ahi, khuna cherubimte kikaal a um, atunga Mangpa min tuonna, Mangpa Pasian thuhun bawm va la dingin akuon touta uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 25.22"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Pasian bawm khu Abinadab inn akipat in bawngleng tha khat in ahing podoh ua, Uzza leh Ahio in bawngleng ahawl uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n David leh Israel mi zousie’n theitawp suo in lasa kawm in, pehgingte, chingtangte, kaigingte, khuongtate, siakhutbehte leh pengkulte toh lungdam pawi abawl uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Kidon buphuol ahing tun un, bawngtalte akipal khah zieh un Uzza in bawm khu tuh tum in akhutin azam a, atham khat a hi.","title":"Uzza in thuhun bawm atham zieha ashina"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa lungthahna khu Uzza tungah asou phut a, Pasian bawm atham khah ziehin a sulumta a, tuanah Pasian masangah ashita hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Uzza tunga khut ahah ziehin David alungkimta sih a, tuaziehin tua mun khu Perez-Uzza achi a, tuni tan in akichi denta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh David in khum niin Pasian agiingta a, “Bangchin Pasian bawm khu inn ah ka polut theita diei?” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Pasian bawm khu David khopi ah ama kungah apolutta sih a, Gitmi Obed-Edom inn ah atawllut zawta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian bawm khu Obed-Edom innsungah a innkuonpite toh ha thum sung aum khawm ua, tuachi’n Pasian in Obed-Edom khu nei leh lam in aguolzawlta hi.","ref":"1 Khang. 26.4,5"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Tai-ar leengpa Hiram in David kungah sidar singte toh, suongkheng mite leh singbawl mite, David inn lam pieh dingin asawl a.","title":"David inn ding kilamna (2 Sam. 5.11-12)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Mangpa’n ama Israelte tunga leengpa a pang dingin asukipta a, ami Israelte ziehin aleenggam tawi sangin a umta hi, chi atheita hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Jerusalem ah zite aneibe nalai a, tuachi’n David in tapate leh tanute anei be nalai hi.","title":"Jerusalem a pieng David tate"},"4":{"text":"Tamte Jerusalem a anei atate min ahi, Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,"},"5":{"text":"Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,"},"6":{"text":"Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,"},"7":{"text":"Elishama, Beeliada, Eliphelet."},"8":{"text":"Philistinten David khu Israelte zousie tunga leengpa a pang dingin sathau akinuta chi azah tah un, Philistin mite zousie David sui dingin akuon touta uhi. Tualeh David in tua thu azah tahin amauh dou dingin ahing kuonkheta hi.","title":"David in Philistinte azawna (2 Sam. 5.17-25)"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistin mite khu akuon tou ua Raphaim phaijang ahing imta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh David in “Philistin mite dou dingin ka kuon tou diei? Amauh ka khut ah na hing pe diei?” chi’n Pasian adonga; tualeh Mangpa’n akungah “Kuontou in, amaute na khut ah ka hing pe ding hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute Baal-Perazim ah akuontou ua, khunah David in amauh azouta hi. Tuachi’n David in “Pasian in tuisan suoh bangin ka khutah ka galte anuoimangta hi,” achi hi. Tuaziehin tuamun min khu Baal-Perazim achita uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh amaun tua mun ah a pasiente uh anuasie ua, David in thu apie a, tuate ahaltum ta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistinten khatvei toh phaijang ahing im kia uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin David in Pasian adong kia a, tualeh Pasian in akungah, “Amauh del tou sinlen, hing kuolkhum zaw inlen; kawlsathau singte maizawn ah amauh dou zawin."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi ding hi, kawlsathau sing dawnte a mihing pei thawmging na zah chiengin kidou ding in kuon dohin, aziehpen Philistin mite thatgam dingin na masangah Pasian akuonkhe zouta hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Pasian thupieh bangin abawla, tuachi’n amaun Philistin mite khu Gibeon a pat in Gezer tandongin anua delta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n David khu gamsung pumpi ah ahing minthangta a, tualeh Mangpa’n nam zousie tungah ama giinna atungsahta hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in, David khopi ah ama dingin innte abawla, tualeh Pasian bawm umna dingin mun abawl a, puon inn azah hi.","title":"Thuhun bawm la dinga kiguonna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in “Levimite chilou, koiman Pasian bawm apo thei sih ding hi; Mangpa’n amaute Pasian bawm paw ding leh kumtawna ama nasem dinga amauh ana teldoh sa ahiziehin,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 10.8"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh David in Mangpa bawm koina dinga abawlna mun a, zawngtou dingin Jerusalem ah Israel mite zousie akhawm khawm hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Aaron tate leh Levi mite zong akhawm khawma."},"5":{"text":"Kohath tapate lah a, lamkai lienpen Uriel leh a sanggamte za leh sawm ni;"},"6":{"text":"Merari tapate lah a lamkai lien Asaiah leh asanggamte zani leh sawmni;"},"7":{"text":"Gershon tapate lah a, lamkai lien, Joel leh a sanggamte za leh sawm thum;"},"8":{"text":"Elizaphan tapate lah a lamkai lien, Shemaiah leh asanggamte za ni;"},"9":{"text":"Hebron tapate lah a lamkai lien Eliel leh asanggamte sawm giet;"},"10":{"text":"Uzziel tapate lah a lamkai lienpen Amminadab leh asanggamte za leh sawmkhat leh ni,"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh David in siempute Zadok leh Abiathar tualeh Levimite Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel leh Amminadab ahan sah a,"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n akung uah, “Noute Levimite na pu napate uh innkuonte lah a upa haitawi chiet na hi uhi, Israelte Pasian, Mangpa bawm khu aumna dinga ka bawlpieh na muna, na zawntou theina dingun, nou leh na sanggamte uh kisusiengthou un."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen amasa in zong nouten na zawnlou ziehun Mangpa i Pasian un itung uah sietna ahing tung sahta hi, ibawl ding dan tah a ibawl khah lou zieh un,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempute leh Levimite, Mangpa Israelte Pasian bawm zawngtou dingin, akisusiengthouta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa thu dungzui a Mosi thupieh bangin Levi miten aliengkou uah azawnna chieng zawlte in Pasian bawm khu azawngta uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 25.14"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Levimite lamkaite ahoupi a, akung uah, a unaute uh lasa mite, tumgingte, pehgingte, kaigingte tualeh siakhutbehte toh, nuomsa tah leh lungdam taha la ngaitaha sa ding mite guot dingin thu ahil hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levi miten Joel tapa Heman, a unaute ulah a Berekiah tapa Asaph te, a unaute Merari tapate, tualeh Kusaiah tapa Ethante a guotta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh amautoh a unaute uh pawl ninate, Zekariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Elipheleh, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, kotkha veng mite;"},"19":{"text":"Lasamite, Heman, Asaph, tualeh Ethante sum-eng khutbeh tum dinga guot ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Zekariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, leh Benaiahte khu kaiging gui neite toh Alamoth la sa dinga guot ahi uhi;"},"21":{"text":"Mattithiah, Elipheleh, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, Azaziah te khu chingtangte toh Sheminith la sa a, ma pui dinga guot ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Levite lah a lamkai lienpen Kenaiah khu lasa lamkai ahia, asiem ziehin tumging hiltu in apang hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Berekiah leh Elkanah khu Pasian bawm umna kotkha vengtute in apang uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh siempute, Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethaneel, Amasai, Zekariah, Benaiah leh Eliezer ten Pasian bawm masangah, pengkul amut ua, tualeh Obed-Edom leh Jehiah khu Pasian bawm kotkha vengtute ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n David leh Israel upate leh tulte tunga lamkaite, Obed-Edom inn a kipata Mangpa thuhun bawm potou dingin kipah thanuom tahin akuontouta uhi.","title":"Thuhun bawm Jerusalem kitutna (2 Sam. 6.12-16)"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Mangpa thuhun bawm zawngtu Levi mite khu Pasian in apanpi ziehin amaun zong bawngtal sagi leh belamtal sagi in kithoina abawl uhi."},"27":{"text":"David khu puonmalngat puonah tuol in akivon a, tuachibangmain thuhun bawm zawng Levi mite zousie leh lasa mite leh lasamite lamkaipa Kenaniah in zong puon malngat asil chiet uhi, tualeh David in siempu puon ah tuol zong asil hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachibangin Israel mite zousie in Mangpa thuhun bawm khu kikou thawmging toh, pengkul gingtoh sa kii sat ging toh, peh gingte, sum-eng khutbehte, pehging gui neite leh khuong leh dahte toh husa thupi tah toh apotouta uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Mangpa thuhun bawm David khopi a ahing tun tahin, Saul tanu Mikal kotta a ahing dahdoh leh David leengpa lam a kidieng amu a, alungsim in asimmaw dapta hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian thuhun bawm khu, ahing tutta ua, David in akoina ding a ana bawl puon inn laikim tah ah akoita ua, tualeh halmang kithoina leh lemna sillat, Pasian mai ah alan uhi.","title":"David kithoina pawi (2 Sam. 6.17-19)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh David in halmang sillat leh lemna sillat alat zou tahin Mangpa min in mipite aguolzawla,"},"3":{"text":"tuachi’n Israel mite zousie, numei leh pasal chin teng kungah, tanghou beu khat leh saba khat chiet leh grep min kiphougaw tun khat chiet toh ahawm sah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Israelte Mangpa Pasian pahtawi ding leh lungdam thu gen dingin, tualeh Mangpa bawm masanga nasem dingin Levi mite phabepkhat apangsahta hi."},"5":{"text":"Asaph khu lamkai lienpen in apanga, ama zom in Zekariah ahia, tuachi’n Jeiel, Shimiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom leh Jeiel, tamte khu pehging leh kaiging gui neite tum ding ahi ua, Asaph khu dah khutbeh tum in apang hi."},"6":{"text":"Siempute Benaiah leh Jahaziel in Pasian thuhun bawm masangah pengkul amut zel uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum ni in David in Asaph leh aunaute khut ah, Mangpa kunga lungdamthu genna, tam phatna la masapen apekheta hi.","title":"David phatna la"},"8":{"text":"Mangpa kungah nuomthu gen unlen, Amin han unlen, mite lah ah asilbawlte thei sah un."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa kungah la sa unlen, akungah pahtawina late sa un, asilbawl lamdangte zousie gen in houlim un."},"10":{"text":"Amin siengthou suong unlen, Mangpa sui mite lungsim kipah hen."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa leh ahatna sui unlen, Amel tawpchin neilou in sui un."},"12":{"text":"Asil bawlsa lamdangte theizing unlen, Anasep lamdangte leh, a kam a vaihawmna thute thei zingun."},"13":{"text":"Aw nou asuoh Israel hahlesuonte, nou ateltuom Jakob tate."},"14":{"text":"Ama khu Mangpa i Pasian uh ahi a, Avaihawmnate leitung pumpi huop ahi."},"15":{"text":"A thuhun khu kumtawn in thei zing unlen, khang tulkhat dinga athupiehte khu."},"16":{"text":"Abraham kunga athuhun leh, Isaak kunga akichiemnate.","ref":"Siem. 12.7; Siem. 26.3"},"17":{"text":"Tua thu khu dan dingin Jakob kungah asudet a, Israel kunga kumtawn thuhun dingin.","ref":"Siem. 28.13"},"18":{"text":"Na kungah “Kanaan gam, na goutan tuom dingin ka hing pe ding,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi tawmnou khat na hi ua, ahi tawm nou khat khuol zin giap na hilai un zong, achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Nam khat akipat nam dangte kunga, tualeh lenggam khat akipat midangte kunga, apei lai un."},"21":{"text":"Koima nuoisie ding aphal sih a, Ahi amauh ziehin leengte a phawhhil zel hi.","ref":"Siem. 20.3-7"},"22":{"text":"“Ka sathau nusate khoisih unlen, Ka guolneite poikhoi sih un,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Leitung pumpi in, Mangpa pahtawina lasa unlen, Nichin in ahundamna thupha puongzah un."},"24":{"text":"Namchin lah ah athupina gen unlen, michin kungah asilbawl lamdangte phuongzah un."},"25":{"text":"Mangpa khu athupi a, thupitah a phat ding ahi. Ama khu pasien dang zousie sanga giin zoh ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Namte pasien khu milimte, ahi ua, hinanleh Mangpa’n vante asiem hi."},"27":{"text":"Zatatna leh vangletnate Amasangah aum a, thahatna leh lungdamna ama umna mun ah aum hi."},"28":{"text":"Namchin a mite aw, Mangpa kungah pie un, Mangpa kungah thahatna leh thupina pie un."},"29":{"text":"Mangpa kungah Amin toh kituoh thupina pie unlen, sillat ding tawi in amasangah hing pei unlen, asienthouna toh kilawm in Mangpa bie un."},"30":{"text":"Leitung pumpite aw Amasangah chitunin kithing un, Ahi, leitung akilin louna dingin suhdet in aum hi."},"31":{"text":"Vante kipah tahin um henlen, leitung zong nuom hen, tualeh namchin teng lah ah “Mangpa’n vai ahawm hi,” chi u’hen."},"32":{"text":"Tuipi leh asunga um zousie ging hum hum uhenlen, gamte leh asunga um zousiete zong kipahin nuom uhen."},"33":{"text":"Tuahun chiengin, gammanga sing um zousieten, Mangpa mai ah nuom in la asa ding ua, leitung vaihawm dinga, ahing pei ding ziehin."},"34":{"text":"Mangpa kungah kipah thu gen un, Ama lah ahoi ngal a, Akhotuona kumtawn in aum ding hi.","ref":"2 Khang. 5.13; 7.3; Ezr. 3.11; Late. 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer. 33.11"},"35":{"text":"“Aw ka hundamna uh Pasian, koute hing hundam in, na min siengthou pahtawi ding leh, na thupina suong dingin, namchin lah a kipat hing puikhawm inlen, hing humbitin, chiin kikou un."},"36":{"text":"Mangpa Israelte Pasian, kumtawn a kipat kumtawn dongin phat in umta hen,” achi a, tuatahin mipite zousiein “Amen” achi ua, Mangpa apahtawita uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in khuna Mangpa thuhun bawm masanga nichin a apoimaw dan bang zela, nasem dingin Asaph leh a unaute anuasieta hi.","title":"Thuhun bawm kem ding Levite aguotna"},"38":{"text":"Obed-Edom leh a unaute sawmguh leh giette anasep uh panpi dingin, tualeh kotpi veng dingin Jeduthun tapa Obed-Edom leh Hosah akoita hi."},"39":{"text":"David in siempu Zadok leh a unau siempute khu Gibeon mun sanga, Mangpa biehbuh masang a,"},"40":{"text":"Halmang sillat maitam tunga zingmawng leh nitah a, Mangpa kunga halmang sillat lan ngitnget ding leh Mangpa’n Israel tate kunga athu pieh dana kigiel zousie dung zuia bawl dingin, aguotta hi."},"41":{"text":"A itna dettah kumtawn a aum ziehin Mangpa kunga nuom thu tut dingin, amautoh Heman leh Jeduthun tualeh midang amina hat a telkhiette toh, aguot hi."},"42":{"text":"Heman leh Jeduthun in la siengthou sah chienga tumging toh kituoh dingin Pengkulte, dahkhutbehte leh tumging dangdangte leh vanjahte tungah maw apuo uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite zousie amauh innlam chiet ua peiin akikhenta ua, tuachi’n David zong a innkuonpite guolzawl dingin a innlam ah apeita hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 6.19,20"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David leeng innpi sunga a um lai in, guolnei Nathan kungah, “Ngai vawi, Kei Sidar sing inn ah ka tenga, hinanleh Mangpa thuhun bawm khu puonbuh sungah a um hi,” achi hi.","title":"David kunga guolnei Nathan thutut (2 Sam. 7.1-17)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nathan in David kungah, “Na lungsim a um bang tahin bawlin, Mangpa na kungah a um hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh khum zan mama in Mangpa thu Nathan kungah ahing tunga,"},"4":{"text":"“Pei inlen ka suoh David va hil in; Tambangin Mangpa’n achi hi, Nangman ka tenna ding inn nang lampieh sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Israelte Izipt gam a kipat a ka puidoh ni a kipat tuni dongin inn ah ka teng nai sih a, hinanleh puonbuh khat a kipat puonbuh dangah, tualeh biehbuh khat a kipat adang khat ah ka na kisuon kawi kawi zel zaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Israelte zousie toh ka pei kawi kawi na munte uah leh ka mite kem dinga thu ka pieh, Israel vaihawmte kungah, “Bangdinga sidar sing inn hing lam piehlou na hi uoi ka chi ngaita amah?”"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka suohpa David kungah tambangin gen in, Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; Belamte tatna nua zui a louhing mun a belamte ching lai, ka mi Israelte tunga vaihawm dingin ka hing ladoh ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh na peina zousie ah na kungah ka um zela, na melmate na masanga kipat ka nuoimit zela; Tuin leitunga mithupipente bangin, na min thupi tahin ka hing bawl pieh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuathamlouin ka mi Israelte dingin mun khat ka guot pieh dinga, akisuon nawnlou ua, amauh tan tuom gam a aum den theina dingun, amauh ka phut ding hi,"},"10":{"text":"Tumasang lai a, ka mi Israel tunga vaihawm ding mite ka guot lai a, thulimlouna taten abawl zel bangun asugenthei nawn sih ding ua, na melmate zousie zong ka zala sah ding hi. Tuathamlouin Mangpa’n innkuon ahing tun ding pieh ding chi ka hing hil hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh na damlai nite ahing bei a, na pulepate kunga na pei hun chiengin, na nua ah nangma tapate lah a kipat in na hah nasuonte ka tungding dinga, tualeh aleenggam ka suhkip pieh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Aman inn ahing lam pieh dinga, tualeh aleengtouna kumtawn in ka sukip ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n keima apa ka hidinga, ama ka tapa ahiding hi, na masanga pa akipata ka khotuona ka lahmang bangin, ama akipat in ka lamang sih ding hi.","ref":"2 Kor. 6.18; Heb. 1.5"},"14":{"text":"Ka inn ah leh ka leenggam ah ama kumtawn in ka tungdet ding hi, tualeh aleengtouna kumtawn in suhkip in aum ding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tam thute zousie dungzui leh tam kilahna zousie bangbang in Nathan in David kungah agen hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa David ahing lut a, Mangpa mai ah atou a, Mangpa Pasian aw, “Kei koi ka hia? ka innkuonte zong bang ahi ua, hichi tan chieng na hing pui?","title":"David kipah thugen a athumna (2 Sam. 7.18-29)"},"17":{"text":"Aw Pasian, tamte zong na mitmu in silneu nou khat ahi a, hinanleh Aw Mangpa Pasian, na suohpa innkuon hing um danding thu, kum tampi sunga ding nana genta a, mi lien khat bangin na hing koi nalai hi, aw Mangpa Pasian."},"18":{"text":"Na suohpa na pahtawina tungtang ah, David in na kungah, bang agen tuon nawn mama diei? Na suohpa lah na thei chien mama ngal a."},"19":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na suohpa zieh leh, nangma lungsim a hing pawt dungzui in, tam sil thupite zousie theisah ding in, sil thupi tahtahte na bawlta hi."},"20":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka bil ua ka zah zousie dung zui un, nangma bang koima a um sih a, tualeh nang lou Pasian dang koima a um mawngmawng sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipata na tatdoh na mite masanga namdangte na delzah a, sil thupitah leh chizat huoi tah bawla, min thupitah bawlpieh dinga, Pasian in ama mite hi dinga ahing tatdoh, na mi Israelte bang mawng mawng leitung ah namdang koi a um uoi?"},"22":{"text":"Na mi Israelte khu kumtawn a na mite dinga na bawl taah ziehin, aw Mangpa nang khu a Pasian uh na hing hita hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh tuin, aw Mangpa na suohpa tungtang leh a innkuonte tungtang thua na gensa khu kumtawn a dingin sukip inlen, na gensa bangin bawl in."},"24":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa khu Israelte Pasian, Israelte mama Pasian na min kumtawn in sukip leh tawisangin um henlen, na suohpa David innkuonte na masangah suhkip hi uhen."},"25":{"text":"Aw Nang ka Pasian, na suohpa kungah, innkuon na tungding ding chi na phuongta a, tuaziehin na suohpan na kungah ka ngenngam nalai hi."},"26":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nang Pasian na hi a, tam hoina na suohpa na chiemta hi."},"27":{"text":"Na suohpa innkuonte, na masanga kumtawn a aum theina dingin na guolzawlta a, aw Mangpa na guolzawlna kumtawn guolzawlna ahi,” achi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tamte nuain, David in Philistinte ava dou a, a zou a, athunuoi ah akoi a, tualeh Philistinte khut akipat in Gath leh akhopite ala hi.","title":"David leenggam kehletna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Moabte zong azou a, tuachi’n Moab mite David suohin apang ua, sie ape zel uhi."},"3":{"text":"Euphrates luipi dong agam sukip dinga akuon lai in David in Zobah leengpa Hadadezer Hamath tandong akidoupi malam a azouta hi."},"4":{"text":"David in a sakolleng tul khat, sakol tungtuong mi tul sagi leh keng galkap tul sawmni amat pieh a; David in sakolleng kai, sakol zousie zahui asattan pieh a; hinanleh sakolleng zakhat kai ding akhawi hi."},"5":{"text":"Zobah leengpa Hadadezer panpi dingin Damaska ateng Siria mite ahing kuon ua, David in Siria mite tul sawmni leh tul ni ana that hi.","title":"Siriate tunga galzawna (2 Sam. 8.5-13)"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Damaska a Siria mite lah ah galkapte akoi a, tuachi’n Siria mite khu David suohte ahing hita ua, sie ape zel uhi. Tambangin Mangpa’n apeina pou ah David ahumbit zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh David in Hadadezer galkap lamkaite sana lumte alah pieh a, Jerusalem ah ahing tut hi."},"8":{"text":"Hadadezer khopite Tibhat leh Kun akipat in David in sum-eng tampi ahing puo a, tua sum-engte in Solomon in tuikuong leh khuomte tualeh tuium bel suonte abawl hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 7.40-47; 2 Khang. 4.11-18"},"9":{"text":"Hamath leengpa Tou in, David in Zobah leengpa Hadadezer galkapte zousie azouta hi chi azah tah in,"},"10":{"text":"Hadadezer adou a, atha zieh a va nousiet ding leh nuompi dingin atapa Hadoram David kungah asawl a, aziehpen Hadadezer leh Tou ana kidou zel uhi, tualeh aman, sana, dangka leh sum-eng a kibawl van tampi akengsah nalai hi."},"11":{"text":"Tamte zong leengpa David in tam Edom leh Moab namte leh Ammon leh philistin tualeh Amalek namte a kipata alah sana, dangkate toh Mangpa kungah alan khawmta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Zeruiah tapa Abishai in Chi phaijang ah Edom mite tul sawm leh giet athat hi.","title":"Edomte tunga galzawna (2 Sam. 8.14-18)","ref":"Late. 60"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Edom ah zong galkap akoi a, tualeh Edom mite zousie khu David suohte ahing hita uhi. Tuachi’n Mangpa’n David apeina lam pou ah ahumbit hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n David Israel mite zousie tungah vaihawm in apanga, tualeh amite zousie tungah dihtatna toh vai ahawm hi.","title":"David upa vaihawma pangte"},"15":{"text":"Zeruiah tapa Joab khu galkap lamkai ahi a, tualeh Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat khu tanchingiel in apang hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahitub tapa Zadok leh Abiathar tapa Abimelekte siempu ahi ua; Shavsha khu laigiel in apang hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoiada tapa Benaiah khu Kerethmite leh Peleth mite tunga vaisai ahia, tualeh David tapate khu leengpa kim a vaihawm lienpente ahi uhi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte nuain Ammon mite leengpa Nahash ashita a, ama thahengin atapa leeng in apang hi.","title":"David mite kinuoisie bawlna (2 Sam. 10.1-5)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in, “Apa’n ahing hepi ziehin, ken zong Nahash tapa Hanun ka hepi sam ding hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n David in apa tungtang thu a hamuon dingin mi asawl hi. Tuachi’n ama hamuon dingin David mite khu Ammon mite gam ah Hanun kung ah ahing haw uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Ammonte milienten Hanun kungah, “David in na pa a zatat bawl zieh a, na kunga mi ahing sawl hi va chi na gingta amah? Amite gam suse ding leh enchien ding leh enkhe dinga, na kunga hing pei hikha maw zawlou ding uh ahiei mah?” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin Hanun in David mite aman a, akhamul uh aheu kieu pieh a, apuonsilte uh atawbou uh huoppha hamham in atan pieh a, asawl dohta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n koite ahiei in amite abawldan uh, David kungah ava hilta uhi. Tuachi’n adawn dingin mi asawl a, aziehpen khum mite azum mama uhi. Tualeh leengpa’n akung uah, “Na khamulte uh asau masangsie’n Jerikou ah umtadi unlen, tuazouchiengin hing kile kiata un,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ammon miten David zahdalam ana bawlta uh chi akithei tah un, Hanun leh Ammon miten, Mesopotamia, Aram-Maakah leh Zobah gam a kipata sakollengte leh sakol tungtuong mite goina dingin dangka talent tul khat ahah hi.","title":"Ammon mite tunga guolzawna (2 Sam. 10.6-14)"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun sakolleng tul sawm thum leh tulni leh Maakah leengpa leh agalkapte aguoi ua, Medeba ah pan mun akhaw uhi. Tualeh Ammon mite zong akhopite ua kipat in ahing kikhawm ua, galdou dingin akuonta uhi."},"8":{"text":"David in tam thu azahtah in, Joab leh agalkap hat zousie asawlta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ammon mite ahing pawtdoh ua, khopi kotkha mai ah galsat dingin aki chiengdimta uhi; tualeh leengte zong atuom in kidouna phuol ah ahing kuon uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab in amailam leh anualam a, hing dou ding uh ahi chi athei tahin, Israel mi hangsan pente ateldoh a, Siriate dou dingin ana guoltuohta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh midangteng a sanggampa Abishai khut ah akoi a, Amahaw zong Ammon mite dou dingin akichiengdimta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Siria mite kei a dinga ahat seng ua ahileh na hing panpi dinga, tualeh Ammon mite nanga dinga ahat seng u’leh ken kang panpi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hangsantahin pang unlen, i mite leh i Pasian khopite humbit dingin, ikipasalsah ding uh; tualeh Mangpa’n amitmu a hoi asah dandan in bawl heh,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab leh akunga um mipiten kidou dingin Siria mite lam azuon ua, tuachi’n ama uh amasang ah ana taizahta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ammon miten Siriate ataizahta uh chi amu tahun amahaw zong, tuabangma in asanggampa Abishai mai ah ataizahta ua khopi sungah alut uhi. Tuachi’n Joab Jerusalem ah a peita hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuin Siriaten Israelte mai ah atan uh ase mama chi athei tah un thangkou mi asawlta ua, luipi gal lam a um Siria mite ahan ua, tualeh Hadadezer galkap lamkai Sophak in ma akai hi.","title":"Siriate tunga galzawna (2 Sam. 10.15-19)"},"17":{"text":"Tam thu David ahil tah un, aman Israel mi zousie akhawm a, Jordan agal kai ua, amauh kung ava tung ua, Kidou dinga galkapte aguol tuoh zou in, Siriate toh akidouta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siriate khu Israelte masangah ataizahta ua, tuachi’n David in Siriate sakollenga galdou mi tul sagi leh keng galkap mi tul sawm li athat a, galkap lamkai lien Sophak zong athat hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Hadadezer galkapten Israelte masangah atan uh ase mama chi amu tahun, David toh kilemna abawl ua, David suohte ahing hita uhi. Tuaziehin Siria miten Ammon mite apanpi ut nawn sih uhi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh khumi kum tavang lai a, galdou ding a leengte akuondoh hun lai un, Joab in galkapte apuidoh a, Ammon mite gam ava nuoichimit a, tualeh ahing pei a Rabbah khuo asim malam uhi. Hinanleh David pen Jerusalem ah ana um hi. Tualeh Joab in Rabbah khuo adou a asuseta hi.","title":"David in Rabbah khopi alahna (2 Sam. 12.26-31)","ref":"2 Sam. 11.1"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in aleengpa uh lutunga kipat a leenglukhu alah pieh a, agihdan sana talent khat ahi a, tualeh tamlukhu ah suongmantamte zong aum hi; tuakhu David akhuh sahta uhi. Tualeh aman khum khopi akipat in galvanlah tampi zong ahing polut hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh aman khuna mipi umte ahing puidoh a, amauten sing atnate, sie hiemte leh heitangte in nna asem sah hi. Tuabangin David in Ammon mite khopi zousie tungah abawl hi. Tuachi’n David leh mipite zousie Jerusalem ah ahing kinualeta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tamte nuain Philistinte toh Gezer ah kidouna a um a, tuachi’n Hushath mi Sibbekai in milien tate lah a khat Sippai kichipa athatta a, tuachi’n athunuoi uah amauh akoita uhi.","title":"Philistin miliente athat uh. (2 Sam. 21.18-22)"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Philistinte toh akidou kia ua, Jair tapa Elhanan in Gitmi Goliath sanggampa Lahmi athat hi; amapa teipi siemgan mite chiempeh bangmai ahi.","ref":"1 Sam. 17.4-7"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Gath ah kidouna aum kia a, khunah pasal duong lientah khat, akhutmete leh akengmete sawmni leh li, akhut langni tuoh a khutmete guh, tualeh akeng langni a kengmete guh tuoh apha hi, tualeh ama zong miliente hahlesuon khat ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Israel mite ava tawh laitah in, David sanggampa Shime a tapa Jonathan in athatta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tamte khu Gath khuo a miliente hahlesuonte ahi ua; tua mite khu David leh amite khut ah ashita uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tuin Setan khu Israelte dou dingin adingdoh a, tuachi’n David Israelte sim dingin atohthouta hi.","title":"David misim zieha khelna (2 Sam. 24.1-9)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Joab kung leh galkap lamkaite kungah “Pei unlen, Beer-Sheba apat Dan tandong a mite va sim unlen, tuachi’n aphaza ka theina dingin hing hil un,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Joab in leengpa kungah, “Mangpa’n amite ale za in pungsah tale zong ka pu leengpa mite ma hilou uh ahiei mah? Bang dinga ka pu’n khumte thei ding phamaw asah ahiei? Bang dinga Israelte siemlou tangsah ding ahiei mah?” chi’n adawng hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa’n Joab athuzawta a, tuaziehin Joab apawtdohta a, Israel gam pumpi atuonsuoh a, tuachi’n Jerusalem ah ahing pei kiata hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joab in David kungah mihing galdou umza ahil kia a; Israel gamsung pumpi ah namsau tawi thei ngentang maktaduoi khat leh tul zakhat apha uhi; tualeh Juda gamsungah namsau tawi thei ngentang tul zali leh tul sawm sagi apha uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Levite leh Benjamin namte alah uah asimtel sih hi, leengpa thugen khu Joab dingin zahda huoitah ahizieh in."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tam sil ah Pasian alungkimta sih a, tuaziehin Israelte agawtta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Pasian kungah, “Tam sil kana bawl tah ziehin kana gamta khiel sengta hi, hinanleh na suohpa thulimlouna koimang tain chin kahing ngen hi; Mot huoi tahin kana bawl khata hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n David guolneipa Gad kungah;","title":"David in gawtna ding atelna"},"10":{"text":"“Pei inlen David kungah Mangpa’n tam bangin agen hi, sil thum na tel ding ka hing pie hi, na tunga ka bawl dingin alah a khat penpen tel in chi’n va hilin” chi’n agen hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n David kungah Gad ava haw a, akung ah, “Tambangin Mangpa’n agen hi, na deipen tel in, achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Na gamsung a kum thumsung kiel tun ding ahiei, na melmate namsau a delphah a um a, ha thum sung na melmate nuoisie a um ahiei, ahisihleh ni thumsung, Mangpa namsau, hipi leenga, Mangpa vansawlsiengin Israel gamsung pumpi a mite asuhmangthai ahiei? achi hi. Tuazieh in tuin kingaituoin kei hing sawlpa kunga dawnna ka tut kia ding bang ahiei, hing hilin,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Gad kungah, “Ka lunggimna alien seng hi, Mangpa khut sungah ka pualut phot mai ding hi; akhotuona lah athupi mama ngal a, hinanleh mihing khut ah vang hing pualut sah malmal sih heh,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Israelte lah ah hipi aleeng sahta a, tuachi’n Israel mi tul sawm sagi ashi pai ngal uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in Jerusalem suse dingin vansawlsieng khat asawl a, hinanleh asuhsiet kuon laitah in Mangpa’n a en a, tambang sietna tun sah ding atup khu akhawlsan a, suse dinga asawl vansawlsieng kungah, “Ahunta na khut lam nawn sin,” achita hi. Tualeh Mangpa vansawlsieng khu Jebusmi Ornan phuol kungah ading hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n David adahtou a, Mangpa’n vansawltah namsau dawsa akhut a tawi kawm a Jerusalem lam ngim a lei leh van kikaal a ding amuta hi. Tuachi’n David leh a upate, sai ip puon sil in lei ah akhupbohta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Pasian kungah, “Mipite kisimna ding thupepa keima hilou ka hiei mah? Akhiel leh silgilou bawl keima hilou ka hiei mah? Hinanleh tam belamten bang sil ahiei abawl uh? Aw Mangpa ka Pasian keima leh ka pa innkuonte tungah na khut ha zaw inlen, hinanleh na mite tungah hipi leengsah nawn sin, chi’n ka hing ngen hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa vansawlsieng in Gad kungah, David peitou henlen, Jebusmi Ornan phuol ah Mangpa dingin maitam khat siem heh, chia vagen dingin thu apie hi.","title":"Ornan phuol a, David kithoina (2 Sam. 24.18-25)"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gad in Mangpa min a agen tahmabangin David akuontouta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua buphuol a Ornan in bu achil lai in akinua hei leh vansawlsieng amu a, tualeh akung a um atapa lite akibuta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n David Ornan kungah ahing pei a, Ornan akihei leh David amuta a, phuol a kipan apawtkhie a tuol a amai suin David mai ah akhupboh ta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Ornan kungah, “Tam phuol Mangpa adinga maitam ka bawlna dingin hing pe vawiin, aman kimtahin la inlen hing pemai in, mipite lah a natsie hileeng athen theina dingin,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ornan in David kungah, “Tangin, ka pu leengpa’n hoi asah bangin bawl heh, halmang kithoina a sillat dingin bawngtalte, asing dingin phuol imna vanjahte, tualeh ann sillat dingin bute abawn in ka hing pie hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Lengpa David in Ornan kungah, “Hilou e, aman kimtah a pie in ka hing lei ngei ngei ding ahi, aman bei in nang vante Mangpa a dingin ka la sih ding hi. Tualeh halmang sillat zong aman beiin ka lan thei sih ding,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Ornan kungah, khum mun man dingin sana shekel zaguh agih apeta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in khum mun ah, Mangpa dingin maitam abawla, halmang sillatte leh lemna sillatte, alan a, Mangpa ahanta hi. Tualeh Mangpa’n van a kipat in halmang sillat latna maitam tungah mei in adawngta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n vansawlsieng khu thu apie a, tualeh aman anamsau apaiah asiet kiata hi."},"28":{"text":"Khum hun lai in, David in Jebusmi Ornan phuol ah Mangpa’n ama adawngta chi athei tahin, khummun ah akithoita hi."},"29":{"text":"Mosi in gamdai a abawl Mangpa biehbuh leh halmang sillat maitam khu, khum hunlaiin Gibeon khuo a munsang ah aum hi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh David Pasian dong dingin tuami mai ah apei thei sih hi, Mangpa vansawlsieng namsau zieh in azau mama hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in “Tami, Mangpa Pasian inn ahi a, tualeh Israelte halmang sillatna maitam ahi,” achi hi.","title":"Pasian biehinn lam dinga David kisahna (2 Sam. 12.26-31)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in Israel gam a namdang umte hat khawm ding thu apie a, tualeh Pasian inn lamna dingin suongkheng miten suong akheng sah a."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh David in kotpi kotkhate kilna ding leh akibultuohna ding siatuhkil tampite leh sum-eng abuh a buh senglou ana khol masa hi."},"4":{"text":"Sidar sing tampi zong ala khawm a, Sidon mite leh Tai-ar miten Sidar sing tampi David kungah ahing puo uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh David in “Ka tapa Solomon lah anaupang nalai a, bangma athei nai sih a, tualeh Mangpa dinga inn kilam ding lah nasatah a thupi leh lamdang gam zousie a minthang mama ding ahiziehin, tuin kana kisa khol ding hi,” achi hi. Tuaziehin David in ashi masangin van tampi ana kholkhawm masata hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in atapa Solomon ahan a, Mangpa Israelte Pasian inn lam dingin thu apie hi.","title":"David biehinn toh kisai a athuhilna"},"7":{"text":"David in Solomon kungah, “Ka tapa, Keima’n Mangpa ka Pasian min dinga inn lam ding ka lungsim in ka tum ngitnget a;","ref":"2 Sam. 7.1-16; 1 Khang. 17.1-14"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa thu ka kung ah ahing tunga, Sisan tampi nana suota a, tualeh gal lienpipi nana bawlta hi, ka mitmu a leitunga sisan tampi na suotah ziehin, ka min dingin inn na lam sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ngai vawi, tapa khat na nei dinga, ama khu lemna dei mi ahi dinga, akimvel gam a amelmate zousie lah ah galmuonna ka pe dinga, amin zong Solomon ahi ding a, ama vangin Israelte galmuong leh lungmuongin ka um sah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aman ka min a dingin inn alam dinga, ama ka tapa ahi dinga, tualeh kei apa ka hi ding. Tualeh Israelte kungah aleenggam leengtoupha kumtawna dingin ka sukip ding hi, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuin ka tapa Mangpa’n hing umpi henlen, lamzang zel inlen, na tungtang thu ana gen kholsa bangin Mangpa na Pasian inn lam in."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa’n pilna leh theisiemnate hing pie henlen, Israelte tunga thuneina ahing pieh chiengin, Mangpa na Pasian thu na zui theita ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte tung thua Mangpa’n Mosi kunga thu ana pieh danthute leh vaihawmna dante sutangtung dinga na pilvang phot leh na lamzang ding hi, hattahin um inlen, hangsan tahin um in, zau sinlen, lung zong lungke tuon sin,","ref":"Josh. 1.6-9"},"14":{"text":"Ngai in, gentheina lienpitoh, Mangpa inn a ding in sana talen tul zakhat leh dangka tang maktaduoi khat leh sum-eng leh sia buh senglou kana kholkhawmta hi, tualeh sing leh suong zong ka kholkhawmta hi, tuate na sunzom theita ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuathamlouin na semmite tampi zong na nei hi, suongkhengmite, sing at mite leh na sep chintenga banglampoua bawl thei khutsiem tampi na kung ah aum hi."},"16":{"text":"Sana dangka leh sum-eng leh sia sim senglou a um hi. Tuaziehin kipan inlen nasep pan paiin, Mangpa’n hing umpita hen,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"David in Israel gam a lamkai zousie kungah zong atapa Solomon panpi dingin thu apia hi."},"18":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian na kungah aum hilou ahiei mah? Na kimvel gamtengah galmuonna ahing pie hilou ahiei mah? Tam gam a tengte zousie Mangpa’n ka khut ah ahing pekheta a, tualeh Mangpa leh amipite mai ah lahzou sieng ahita hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuin na lungtang u’leh na hinnate uh Mangpa na Pasian uh sui dingin Ama lam ngasah un. Tuaziehin kisa unlen, Mangpa min a kilam ding innsunga Mangpa thuhun bawm leh umlebelte puohlutna dingin Mangpa Pasian munsiengthou lamta un,” achi hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n David ahing tehta a, akum zong ahing upat mama bepin, atapa Solomon khu Israelte tunga leeng a pang ding in abawlta hi.","title":"Levi mite kisimna","ref":"1 Leeng. 1.1-40"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aman Israelte lah a milien lamkaite leh siempute tualeh Levimite ahankhawm ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levimite kum sawmthum a upa apat atunglam akisim a, amimal mal a kisim dan a atam lam uh, tul sawm thum leh tul giet ahi."},"4":{"text":"“Tuate lah a mi tul sawmni leh tulli te khu Mangpa inn bawlna a nasem vaisai a pang dingin aguot a, mi tul guhte khu lamkaite leh thukhente ding in aguot hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi tul lite khu kotkha vengte ahi ua, tualeh mi tul li ma in phatna dinga tumging van ka bawl David in achite zanga Mangpa phatte ahi uhi.”"},"6":{"text":"David in amauh Levi tapate, Gershon, Kohath leh Merari te lah ah apawl pawl in ahawm khen hi."},"7":{"text":"Gershonmite pawl ah Laadan leh Shimei.","title":"Gershonmite pawl"},"8":{"text":"Laadan tapate a upa pen, Jehiel, Zetham leh Joel."},"9":{"text":"Shimei tapate: Shelomith, Haziel leh Haran-thum Tamte Laadan pute lah a upa pente ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Shimei tapate: Jahath, Zina, Jeush leh Beriah. Tamte khu Shimei tapa lite ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Jahath khu a upa pen ahia, azom khu Zizah ahi. Hinanleh Jeush leh Beriah in tapa tampi anei sih ua, tuazieh a innkuon khat a sim ahi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Kohath tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel, abawn un li.","title":"Kohathmite pawl"},"13":{"text":"Amram tapate: Aaron, Mosi, tualeh Aaron pen ama leh atapate, kumtawn a dinga sil siengthoupente, susiengthou ding leh kumtawn a Mangpa mai a gimnamtui hala, na sem ding leh amin a guolzawlna pe dinga tuomkoi ahi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 28.1"},"14":{"text":"Pasian mipa Mosi tapate pen Levi nam laha simtha ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mosi tapate khu Gershon leh Eliezer ahi uh."},"16":{"text":"Gershon tapate lah ah, Shebuel a upa pen uh ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Eliezer tapate khu, Rehabiah a upa pen ahia, tualeh Eliezer in tapa dang anei sih a, hinanleh Rehabiah in tapa tampi anei hi."},"18":{"text":"Izhar tapate lah ah, Shelomith a upa pen ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hebron tapate lah ah Jeriah a upa pen ahia, azom khu Amariah ahia, athumna khu Jahaziel tualeh alina khu Jekameam ahi."},"20":{"text":"Uzziel tapa lah ah a upa pen Mikah ahia, Jessiah anina ahi."},"21":{"text":"Merari tapate Mahli leh Mushi ahi ua. Mahli tapate khu Eleazar leh Kish ahi.","title":"Merarimite pawl"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Eleazar ashita a, tapate anei sih hi, hinanleh tanute anei a, tuachi’n a sanggamte uh Kish tapaten amauh alata uhi."},"23":{"text":"Mushi tapate khu: Mahli leh Eder leh Jeremoth mithum ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tamte apulepate uh innkuon dungzui a Levi tapate ahi uhi; a innkuon uh dungzui a min giela asim uh innkuon upapente Mangpa inn lamna a nasepna a nna sem ding kum sawmni apat atunglamte ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"David in “Mangpa Israelte Pasian in amite Jerusalem a kumtawn a aten theina ding un khawldamna apie hi, achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Leviten zong biehbuh leh anasepna ding in tui um belsuon zousie a zawn uh angainawn sih ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 10.8"},"27":{"text":"David thupieh nukhia pen dungzui in, Levite kum sawmni apat atunglam teng sim ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"“Levimite nasep ding khu, Mangpa inn a Aaron tapate nasep panpi a inn huongsung leh dantan sunga sil siengthou umte zousie suhsiengthou leh Mangpa inn a nasepna dangdangte khu ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 3.5-9"},"29":{"text":"Tanghou sieng maitam a koi dingte, ann sillat dinga tangbuong nelte, tanghou pheng pandingdengte, tolsawlou tanghou bawl leh khangbel a kante leh upthaw ahieite, tualeh aletdan te leh buhte zong ahi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh zing mawng chin a, Mangpa kunga kipah thu gen ding leh phat dinga din leh nitahlam chienga zong tuachibangma a bawl ahi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh khawlnite a, ha thate a, pawi bawl ni chieng a, abawl ding ua kiguot dungzui a, Mangpa mai a lan zing dingin."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh kimutuona biehbuh kepte, munsiengthou kepte, tualeh Mangpa inn a nasepna a, a unaupa uh Aaron hahlesuonte nasepnate panpi khu amaute mawpuoh leh anasep uh ahi.”"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aaron tapate pawl kikhendan tambang ahi. Aaron tapate: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi uhi.","title":"Siempute nasep ding kihawmna"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh Nadab leh Abihute apa uh sangin ashi masa zaw ua, tapate anei man sih uhi, tuaziehin Eleazar leh Ithamar in siempu nna asem uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 10.1,2"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh David in Eleazar tapate lah a Zadok leh Ithamar tapate lah a Ahimelek panpina toh anasep dingdan uh ahawm piehta hi."},"4":{"text":"Ithamar tapate sangin Eleazar tapate lah apat in upa lamkai lien atam zaw uhi, tualeh tambangin akikhen uhi; Eleazar tapate lah akipat a, apu apate uh innkuon upa lamkai lien sawm leh guh ahi ua, tualeh Ithamar tate lah ah apu apate uh innkuon dungzui in giet ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amaun deisah tuom neilou in ai asan ua, tuachi’n Eleazar leh Ithamar tapate lah ah munsiengthou a miliente leh Pasian inn a milien vaihawm ding aum tuoh tuoh uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Levimite lah a khat laigielmi Nethaneel tapa Shemaiah in, leengpa leh amiliente, siempu Zadok leh Abiathar tapa Ahimelek, tualeh siempute leh Levimite bulpi deu deute mai ah agiel a; Innkuon bulpi tan khat khu Eleazar in atanga, khat pen Ithamar in atang hi."},"7":{"text":"Ai san masa pen Jehoiarib tungah atu a, anina khu Jedaiah tungah atu hi,"},"8":{"text":"Athumna Harim tungah, alina Seorim tungah,"},"9":{"text":"Angana Malkijah tungah, aguhna Mijamin tungah,"},"10":{"text":"Asagina Hakkoz tungah, agietna Abijah tungah,"},"11":{"text":"Akuona Jeshua tungah, a sawmna Shekaniah tungah,"},"12":{"text":"Asawm leh khatna Eliashib tungah, asawm leh nina Jakim tungah,"},"13":{"text":"Asawm leh thumna Huppah tungah, asawm leh lina Jeshebeab tungah,"},"14":{"text":"Asawm leh ngana Bilgah tungah, asawm leh guhna Immer tungah,"},"15":{"text":"Asawm leh sagina Hezir tungah, asawm leh gietna Aphses tungah,"},"16":{"text":"Asawm leh kuona Pethahiah tungah, asawmnina Jehezekel tungah,"},"17":{"text":"Asawmni leh khatna Jachin tungah, asawmni leh nina Gamul tungah,"},"18":{"text":"Asawmni leh thumna Delaiah tungah, asawmni leh lina Maaziah tungah, atu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tamte khu Israelte Mangpa Pasian in apu uh Aaron, thu ana pieh banga, Mangpa innsunga, na sep ding dan a guoltuoh dan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Levi dangte hahlesuonte khu tamte ahi uhi. Amram tapate lah apat in Shubael; Shubael tapate lah a pat in Jedeiah.","title":"Levi midangte"},"21":{"text":"Rehabiah tungtang: Rehabiah tapate laha amasa pen Isshiah ahi."},"22":{"text":"Izharmite lah ah: Shelemoth, Shelemoth tapate lah ah Jahath."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Hebron tapate upapen Jeriah ahia, anina Amariah, athumna Jahaziel, alina Jekameam."},"24":{"text":"Uzziel tapa: Mikah, Mikah tapate lah ah Shamir."},"25":{"text":"Mikah sanggampa Isshiah ahia, Isshiah tapate lah ah, Zekariah."},"26":{"text":"Merari tapate khu Mahli leh Mushi ahi ua, Jaaziah tapa: Beno."},"27":{"text":"Merari tapate: Jaaziah akipat, Beno, Shoham, Zakkur leh Ibri."},"28":{"text":"Mahli lah akipat in, Eleazar ahia, aman tapa anei sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Kish akipante: Kish tapa Jerahmeel ahi."},"30":{"text":"Mushi tapate: Mahli, Eder leh Jerimoth. Tamte khu apu apate uh innkuon dungzui a, Levimite tapate ahi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tamten zong asanggamte uh Aaron tapate bangin leengpa leh Zadok, Ahimelek leh siempute tualeh Levimite pulepate Innkuon upa lamkaite maiah ai asan ua, ainnkuon upa lamkai lienpente leh aneu pente zong deisah tuom umlou in akibang chiet in ai asan uhi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David leh agalkap lamkaiten, Asaph, Heman leh Jeduthun tapate pawlkhat, kaigingte, pehgingte leh dah khutbehte toh kithuo a, genlawhna nasem dingin atuom koituom uhi. Tualeh anasep dungzui ua, atam dan uh tambang ahi.","title":"Lasa mite"},"2":{"text":"Asaph tapate laha kipat in: Zakkur, Joseph, Nethaniah leh Asarelah ahi ua, amaute khu leengpa etkolna nuoi a, thumavang genlawhpa Asaph thu thu a um ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Jeduthun tungtang ah: Juduthun tate lah a kipat Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Hashabiah leh Mattithiah, abawn un miguh, kipahthu gen ding leh, Mangpa phat dinga kaiging toh kithuo a, thumavang gen apa uh Jeduthun thu thu a um ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Heman tapate: Heman tapate lah a kipat in, Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romantiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, tualeh Mahazioth:"},"5":{"text":"Tamte zousie abawn un, Pasian thu lam a leengpa guolnei Heman tapate ahi uhi. Amaun Pasian thuchiem dungzui in Ama pahtawinan pengkul mut ding a guot Heman tapate ahi uhi. Pasian in Heman tapa sawm leh li leh tanu thum apie hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam mite zousie abawn un apate uh etkolna nuoi a, Mangpa inn a, dahkhutbehte, kaigingte leh pehgingte toh, lasa a Pasian inn a nasemte ahi uhi. Tualeh Asaph, Jeduthun leh Hemante khu leengpa etkolna nuoi a um ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Atamlam uh a unaute uh Mangpa dinga lasah leh tumging kizilte leh asiemsate pum in zani leh sawmgiet leh giet ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n aneu alien, azilsah siete leh azillai miten nasep atan ding uh akibang chietin ai asan uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n ai san khatveina khu Asaph tapa Joseph tungah atu a, anina khu Gedaliah: ama leh a unaute leh atapate pum in sawm leh ni ahi uhi.","title":"Aisan a pawl sawmni leh li a akikhenna uh"},"10":{"text":"Athum veina khu Zakkur tungah, ama leh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leni ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aliveina khu Izri tungah atu a, ama leh a unaute leh atapate toh sawm leni ahi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Anga veina, Nethaniah tungah atu a, amaleh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni, ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aguhveina, Bukkiah tungah atu a, ama leh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Asagina, Jesharelah tungah atu a, ama leh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Agietna, Jeshaiah tungah atu a, ama leh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Akuona, Mattaniah tungah atu a, ama leh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Asawmna, Shimei tungah atu a, ama leh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Asawm leh khatna, Azareel tungah atu a, ama leh a unaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Asawm leh nina, Hashabiah tungah atu a, ama leh a unaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Asawm leh thumna, Shubael tungah atu a, ama leh a unaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Asawm leh lina, Mattithiah tungah atu a, ama leh a unaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Asawm leh ngana, Jeremoth tungah atu a, ama leh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Asawm leh guhna, Hananiah tungah atu a, ama leh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Asawm leh sagina, Joshbekashah tungah atu a, ama leh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Asawm leh gietna, Hanani tungah atu a, ama leh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Asawm leh kuona, Mallothi tungah atu a, ama leh a unaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Asawmni na Eliathah tungah atu a, ama leh a unaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Asawmni leh khatna, Hothir tungah atu a, ama leh a unaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Asawmni leh nina, Giddalti tungah atu a, ama leh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Asawmni leh thumna, Mahazioth tungah atu a, ama leh aunaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Asawmni leh lina, Romamti-ezer tungah atu a, ama leh a unaute leh atapate toh sawm leh ni ahi uhi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kotkha veng pawlte kikhendan: Korahmite lah a kipat, Asaph tapate lah ah Kore tapa Meshelemiah ahia.","title":"Kotkha veng pawl"},"2":{"text":"Meshelemiah in tapate anei a: Ata masapen Zekariah, anina Jediael, athumna Jebadiah, alina Jethniel,"},"3":{"text":"Angana Elam, aguhna Jehohanan leh asagina Eljehoenai, ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Obed-Edom in zong tapate anei a: Ata masapen Shemaiah, anina Jehozabad, athumna Joah, alina Sakar, angana Nethaneel;","ref":"2 Sam. 6.11; 1 Khang. 13.14"},"5":{"text":"Aguhna Ammiel, asagina Issakar leh agietna Peulthai ahi uhi. Obed-Edom Pasian in aguolzawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Atapa Shemaiah in zong tapate anei a, amauten apulepate uh innkuonte tungah vaihawm lamkai in apang uhi, aziehpen amauh mi silbawl thei ngen ahi chiet uhi."},"7":{"text":"Shemaiah tapate: Othni, Rephael, Obed leh Elzabad, te ahi ua, aunau kinaipite uh, Elihu leh Semakiah te zong silbawl theitah ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tamte zousie abawn un Obed-Edom hahlesuonte ngen ahi ua, atapate u’leh a unau kinaipite uh nasepna lamsangah silbawlthei tah ahi uhi. Obed-Edom hahlesuonte zousie abawn un mi sawmguh leh ni apha uhi."},"9":{"text":"Meshelemiah in tapate leh unaute silbawlthei tah tah ngen sawm leh giet anei hi."},"10":{"text":"Meraritapate apat Hosah in zong tapate anei a, a upa pen Shimri (ama aupapen hisih nanleh a pa’n a upa pen in abawl hi.)"},"11":{"text":"Anina Hilkiah, athumna Tebaliah, alina Zekariah, Hosah tapate leh a unaute zousie abawn un sawmle thum ahi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Kotpi vengte khu ainnkuon uh dungzui a, a lamkaite chiet utoh Mangpa inn a nasem dingin, a unaute uh banga tan nei chiet in akihawmkhen uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amaun alien aneu akibang chietin apulepate uh innkuon dungzuiin kotpi chintenga dingin ai asan uhi."},"14":{"text":"Suolam kotpi a dinga ai san khu Shelemiah tungah atu a; lemgel siem leh mipil tah atapa Zekariah dingin ai asan kia ua, sahlam kotpi ama tungah atu hi."},"15":{"text":"Hanglam kotpi a dingin ai asan ua, Obed-edom tungah atu a, tualeh sil koi khawmna inn khu atapate tung ah atu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tumlam kotpi leh atunglam kaltouna Shalleketh kotpi adinga ai san khu Shuppim leh Hosah tungah atu hi. Vengmite ki maingat tuo in."},"17":{"text":"Sualam ah Levite guh aum ua, mallam ah ni chin in mi li, simlam ah nichin in mi li, tualeh van koikhawmna inn ah ni ni tuoh in."},"18":{"text":"Tumlam a inn huongsung zotna lampi ah mi li tualeh ahuongsungah mi ni."},"19":{"text":"Tamte khu Kore tapate lah leh Merari tapate lah akipata kotpi vengmite kihawmkhen dan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Levite lah a pat in Ahijah khu Pasian sum koikhawmna inn leh sil siengthou koikhawmna inn enkoltu lienpen ahi.","title":"Biehinn sum koikhawmna tunga thunei Levi pawlte"},"21":{"text":"Laadan hahlesuon, Gershonmite, Laadan a kipante apulepa innkuonte lah a upa pen; Jehieli ahi."},"22":{"text":"Jehieli tapate: Jetham leh asanggampa Joel, Mangpa inn a sum koikhawmna inn enkoltu lienpente ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amram mite, Izharmite, Hebronmite, tualeh Uzzielmite apat:"},"24":{"text":"Mosi tapa Gershon hahlesuonte, Shubael khu sum koikhawmna enkoltu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh aunaute Eleazar akipat in atapate Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zikri leh Shelomith."},"26":{"text":"Shelomith leh aunaute khu leengpa David leh apulepate leh galkap tul tunga lamkaite, za tunga lamkaite leh galkap lamkaiten alat uh sil siengthoute koikhawmna inn zousie kemte ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Kidouna a gallah vante uh Mangpa inn siemphatna dingin alan siengthou uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh guolnei Samuel leh Kish tapa Saul leh Ner tapa Abner leh Zeruiah tapa Joab in alat siengthousa zousie u’leh midangten ana lat siengthou zousie uh khu Shelemoth leh a unaute kep ngen ahi."},"29":{"text":"Izharmite akipat: Kenaniah leh atapate khu biehinn pulam a Israelte tunga vaihawm lamkaite ahi uhi.","title":"Milien leh vaihawmte"},"30":{"text":"Hebronmite lah a kipat: Hashabiah leh a unaute silbawlthei ngen mi tulkhat leh za sagite, Jordan gal tumlam a Israelmi umte lah a Mangpa nasep leh leengpa nasepna a mawpuohna nei lamkaite ahi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Hebronmite lah ah apu apate uh khanggui dungzui in Jeriah khu a tulpipa uh ahi. David vaihawm kum sawmli achin kum in mihat leh hangsan kisuina aum a, Gilead gam a Jazer khuo ah amaute mukhiet ahi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Jeriah in unau mi hangsan leh sil bawlthei ngen tul ni leh za sagi anei hi, tuate apu apauh innkuon a upa pente, leengpa David in Pasian lam toh kisai sil zousie leh leengpa toh kisai nasepna lam thu a, Reubenmite, Gadmite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte lamkai dinga aguotte ahi uhi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami Israel tate tam dan ahi: apulepate uh tulpipente leh galkap tul tunga lamkaite, za tunga lamkaite, ahun dungzui a banglam pou a leengpa nasemmite kum khat sunga hachin a kiheng zelzel pawl chin a mi tulsawmni leh tul li ahi uhi.","title":"Galkap lamkai sawmlenite"},"2":{"text":"Pawl khatna! ha masapen a lamkai khu Zabdiel tapa Jashobeam ahia, ama pawl ah tul sawmni leh tul li aum uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ama Perez tate lah a mi ahia, hakhatna a galkap lamkai zousie tunga lamkai lienpen ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahanina a pawl lamkai khu Ahohmi Dodai ahia, Milkoth khu ama zom a lamkai ahi a, ama pawl ah mi tul sawmni leh tulli aum uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aha thumna a galkapte lamkai khu siempu Jehoiada tapa Benaiah ahi a, ama pawl ah mi tul sawmni leh tul li aum uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tam Benaiah pen mihat sawmthumte lah a tel pha leh sawmthumte tunga mihat leh hangsan ahia, ama pawlah atapa Ammizabad lamkai khat ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aha lina a, galkap lamkai khu Joab sanggampa Asahel ahia, ama ban ah atapa Zebadiah a hi, ama pawl ah mi tul sawmni leh tulli aum uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahangana a, lamkai khu Izrahmi Shamhuth ahia, ama pawlah mi tul sawm ni leh tulli aum uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aha guhna Tekomi Ikkesh tapa Ira ahia, ama pawl ah mi tul sawmni leh tulli aum uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aha sagina a galkap lamkai khu Ephraim hahlesuon Pelon mi Helez ahia, ama pawl ah mi tul sawmni leh tulli aum uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahagietna a galkap lamkai, Zera hahlesuon Hushath mi Sibbekai ahia, ama pawl ah mi tulsawmni leh tulli aum uhi."},"12":{"text":"Aha kuona a galkap lamkai, Benjamin hahlesuon Anathoth mi Abiezer ahia, ama pawl ah mi tul sawmni leh tulli aum uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aha sawmna a, galkap lamkai, Zerah hahlesuon Netophath mi Maharai ahia, ama pawl ah mi tul sawmni leh tulli aum uhi."},"14":{"text":"Aha sawm leh khatna a, galkap lamkai, Ephraim hahlesuon, Pirathon mi Benaiah ahia, ama pawl ah mi tul sawmni leh tul li aum uhi."},"15":{"text":"Aha sawm leh nina a, galkap lamkai, Othniel phung sunga, Netophathmi, Heldai ahi a, ama pawl ah zong mi tul sawmni leh tulli aum uhi."},"16":{"text":"Israel namte tunga Uliente: Reuben mite tungah Zikri tapa Eleazar vaihawmpa ahia, Simeonmite tungah Maakah tapa Shephatiah ahi hi.","title":"Nam sawm leh nite lah a uliente"},"17":{"text":"Levimite tungah Kemuel tapa Hashabiah ahia, Aaronmite tungah Zadok ahi."},"18":{"text":"Judate tungah David sanggamte lah a Elihu ahia, Issakarte tungah Mikael tapa Omri ahi."},"19":{"text":"Zebulunte tungah Obadiah tapa Ishmaiah ahia, Naphtalite tungah Azriel tapa Jerimoth ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ephraimmite tungah Azaziah tapa Hoshea ahia, Manasseh nam kimkhatte tungah Pedaiah tapa Joel ahi."},"21":{"text":"Gilead gam a Manasseh nam kimkhatte tungah Zekariah tapa Iddo ahia, Benjaminte tungah Abner tapa Jaasiel ahi."},"22":{"text":"Danmite tungah Jehoram tapa Azareel ahi. Tamte khu Israel namte lah a Ulian vaihawmte ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"David in kum sawmni apat anuoilam asim sih hi, Israelte pen van a aasi za in ka pungsah ding chia Mangpa’n ana chiemsa ahitah ziehin.","ref":"Siem. 15.5; 22.17; 26.4"},"24":{"text":"Zeruiah tapa Joab in asim pan a, hinanleh asim zou man sih a, Israelte tungah zong lungthahna ahing tungta a, David leengpa vaihawm laitanchin gelna laibu ah zong aphaza gellut ahi sih hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 24.15; 1 Khang. 21.1-14"},"25":{"text":"Lengpa gou koikhawmna enkolpa khu Adiel tapa Azmaveth ahia, tualeh gamsungte, khopi sungte, khoneu sungte leh innsangte a gou koikhawmnate khu Uzziah tapa Jonathan in a enkol hi.","title":"Leengpa gou koi khawmna enkoltute"},"26":{"text":"Lou lam a louhoute enkolpa khu Kelub tapa Ezri ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ramathmi Shimei grep huonte enkolpa ahia, tualeh greptui suhsa koikhawmte enkolpa khu Shephmi Zabdi ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh muolpang gamngiem lah a Olive sing leh theipi kungte enkolpa khu Gedermi Baal-Hanan ahia, Olive thau koikhawmna enkoltu khu Joash ahi."},"29":{"text":"Sharon phaijawl a tazel ganhonte enkoltu khu Sharon mi Shitrai ahia, tualeh phaijang a ganhonte enkoltu khu Adlai tapa Shaphat ahi."},"30":{"text":"Sangawngsaute enkol khu Ishmaelmi Obil ahi a, Sabiltungte enkol khu Meronothmi Jehdeiah ahi."},"31":{"text":"Belamhonte kempa khu Hagrimi Jaziz ahi. Tamte zousie khu Lengpa David neilelam enkol Uliente ahi uhi."},"32":{"text":"David paneu Jonathan khu, thumoptu, sil umdan theisiem leh laigiel mi, ahia, tualeh Hakmoni tapa Jehiel leengpa tapate hil leh zilsahpa ahi."},"33":{"text":"Ahithophel khu leengpa lemguotpi a thumoppa ahia, tualeh Arkmi Hushai khu leengpa lawmpa ahi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Ahithophel zom in Benaiah tapa Jehoiada leh Abiathar ahi uhi, tualeh leengpa galkap lamkai lienpen khu Joab ahi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in Israel milien zousie, namte lah lamkaite, leengpa nasema hachin a kiheng zelzel pawl lamkaite, galkap tul tunga lamkaite leh zatunga lamkaite leh leengpa leh atapate nei leh lam leh agante zousie tunga houtute tualeh leengpa innsung vaisaite zousie, mihat hangsante zousie Jerusalem ah ahankhawm hi.","title":"Biehinn lamding thu David in Israelte angansie"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa David adingdoh a, “Ka unaute leh ka mite aw, ka thu na ngaikhe un, Ken Mangpa thuhunna bawm kikoina ding leh i Pasian kengngapna dingin inn lamding lungsim in ka tum ngitnget a, tualeh inn lamna dingin kigingsa diem ka hita hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.1-16; 1 Khang. 17.1-14"},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in ka kungah, Nangpen galdou mi leh sisan suomi nahi ziehin ka min a dingin inn na lam sih ding, ahing chi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahinlah Mangpa Israelte Pasian in, Israelte tunga kumtawna leengpa hi dingin ka pa innkuonpite zousie lah a kipat ahing na telta hi. Juda khu vaihawm dingin ana telta a, tualeh Juda innkuonte akipat, Keima innkuonte tualeh ka pa tapate lah a kipat, Israelte tunga leengpa hidingin kei ahing na deita hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka tapate lah ah (Mangpa’n tapa tampi ahing peta hi.) Israelte tunga leengpa hi dingin Mangpa leenggam leengtoupha tunga tou dingin ka tapa Solomon ana telta hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman ka kungah na tapa Solomon in ka inn leh ka inn huongte alam ding hi, ama ka tapa ding in ka telta hi, tualeh Kei apa ka hi ding a;"},"7":{"text":"Ka thupieh leh ka vaihawmna dante tunia banga apom ngitnget leh agam kumtawna dingin ka suhkip ding hi, achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin Mangpa mipi kikhawm Israelte zousie mitmu leh i Pasian uh zahin, Mangpa na Pasian uh thupieh zousie nit a suidingin pilvang un, tuachi’n tam gamhoi tahte na luo ding ua, na nua ua nahah nasuonte un, kumtawn a dingin na luo sawn sah zel ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Tualeh nang ka tapa Solomon na pa Pasian thei inlen, na lungtang hoi bukim leh lungsim kilawp tahin ana sem in; Mangpa’n lah lungtang zousie a enchien a, lungsim a ngaituonate zousie athei sieng hi; Ama na sui leh na mu dinga, hinanleh Ama na taisan leh kumtawn in nang ahing nuasie ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuin pilvangin, mun siengthou a dinga mun bawl dingin, Mangpa’n nang ahing telta hi kisuhat inlen, na sep pan in,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in atapa Solomon kungah, Biehinn him, limte, a inn limte, gou koikhawmna inn leh adan tungnung leh adan nuoinung leh zangaina toupha lim kigielte;"},"12":{"text":"alungsim a hagau in atheisah dan zousie, Mangpa innhuongsung leh akimvela pindan zousie leh Pasian inn a gou koikhawmna inn leh sil latsiengthousate koina, limte apie hi."},"13":{"text":"Siempute leh Levite apawl pawla a umna dinguh leh, Mangpa inn a nasepna lam toh kisaia asepding dan zousie u’leh, Mangpa inn nasepna ding tuium belsuon zousie lim zong a pie hi."},"14":{"text":"Aman nasepna chi chin a dingin, Sana vanjah dingte, Sana tedohsa in apie a, dangka vanzah tuom tuom a zah dingin dangka tedohsa in apie hi."},"15":{"text":"Sana meivah tunna leh ameivahte a dinga Sana gihdan, meivah tunna khat chiet gihdan leh a meivah te gihdan, dangka meivah tunna ding leh nasepna a apoimaw dungzui a zah ding meivah zousie, gihdan zong abawnin atedoh sieng hi."},"16":{"text":"Tanghou latsiengthousa koina sana dawkan zousie gihdan, dangka dawkan ading dangka gih ding dan, leh,"},"17":{"text":"Sana siengthou tokeuka, kuongdai leh noute, sana belte leh agihdan chiet, dangka bel leh agihdan chiet tedohsa chiet in apie hi."},"18":{"text":"Gimnamtui halna maitam dingin Sana siengthou tesa in apie hi; tualeh Mangpa thuhunna bawm aha te ua zahkhum cherubimte tuonna ding leng ding lim kigielsa apie hi."},"19":{"text":"David in tamte zousie Mangpa’n ka kungah akhut a gielin, nasep danding lim zousie tungah theisiemna ahing pie hi, achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Davidin atapa Solomon kungah, “Hattah leh hangsan tahin um inlen, nna sem in. Zau sinlen, lungke sin, Mangpa Pasian ka Pasian na kungah aum hi. Mangpa inn lamna a, nasep zousie a un a, na zaw masangsie’n, ahing nuasie sih dinga, donlou in ahing koi sih ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh ngai vawi, Siempute leh Levite apawl pawlin Pasian inn a nasepna zousie a dingin mansa ahi uhi; tualeh bang nasep hitaleh, banglam poua kizang thei leh nasep siemte na kungah a um uhi; miliente leh mipite zousie in na thupiehte zousie azui zel ding uhi.”"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n David in mipi kikhawmte zousie kungah, “Pasian teldoh ka tapa Solomon, anaupang nalai a, bangma athei nai sih a, anasep ding lah athupi mama hi; Biehinn mihinga ding ahisih a, Pasian ading ahi zaw hi.","title":"Biehinn lamna dinga David thawlawm ngetna: dawnna","ref":"1 Khang. 22.5"},"2":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin ka Pasian inn dingin, sana zahna dingah sana, dangka zahna dingah dangka, sum-eng zahna dingah sum-eng, Sia zahna dingah sia, sing zahna dingah sing, aphuding Onix suongte, suong tesingsengte, suong mantam chituomtuomte leh marbul suong tampi kana kholkhawm zouta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuate ban ah zong, ka Pasian inn lamna dinga ka kiphalna bangin keima sum, sana leh dangka te zong, tami inn siengthou lamna dinga kana kholkhawmsate chilou zong ka Pasian inn a dingin ka pie hi;"},"4":{"text":"Sana (ophir sana) talent tul thum leh dangka sia siengthou talent tul sagi, inn bangte luonkhumna ding in;"},"5":{"text":"tualeh mi khutsiemte zah dingin abawn in sana zahna ding mun ah sana, dangka zahna ding mun ah dangka te ka pie hi. Tuni’n Mangpa ding a kiphal taha penuom koi na um uoi?” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n innkuonte laha upapente, Israel namte lah a lamkai liente leh tul tunga lamkaite leh za tunga lamkaite leh leengpa nasem vaihawmte’n kiphal tahin ape chiet uhi.","title":"Mangpa inn lamna ding kiphal tahin apie uh"},"7":{"text":"Amauten Pasian inn lamna dingin sana talent tulnga, darik sana talent tul sawm, dangka sia tul sawm, sum-eng talent tul sawm leh tul giet tualeh sia talent tul zakhat, apie uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh suong mantam neiten, Mangpa inn a gou kempa Gershonmi Jehiel khut ah apie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n alamkaite un kiphaltah leh lunglut tah a Mangpa kunga apieh zieh un mipite akipah mama ua; David zong nasatahin akipah mama hi."},"10":{"text":"David in mipi kikhawmte zousie masangah, “Mangpa aphata, tualeh David in; Aw Mangpa ka pu uh Israel Pasian, kumtawn kumtawn in Phatin umta in.","title":"David kipah thugenna leh thumna"},"11":{"text":"Aw Mangpa vangletnate, silbawltheinate leh thupinate, pahtawinate, guolzawnate, Nanga ahi, aziehpen, lei leh van a sil um zousie nanga ahi. Lenggamte nanga ahia; Aw Mangpa, Nang khu bangkim tunga lien pen a tawisangin na um hi.","ref":"Mat. 6.13"},"12":{"text":"Hausatnate, za umnate, Nanga hing kipan ahia, Bangkim tunga vaihawmpa na hi. Na khutah hatna leh silbawltheina aum a, Na khutah mizousie suhthupi theina leh, hatna pieh theina aum hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin ka Pasian uh, Na kungah kipah thu gen kawm in Na min thupi ka phat uhi."},"14":{"text":"“Hinanleh Kei koi ka hia, ka mite zong koi ahi ua hichibanga kiphaltah a ka hing kipieh thei uh? Sil zousie nangma a hing kipandoh ngen ahia, Nangma a ma ka hing pieh kia uh ahibou hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka pule pate uh zousie ma bangin koute na mitmu ah mi khuol leh khuolzin thaam bang giap kahi ua, leitung ka dam lainite uh mei lim bang mai ahia, lam et ding mawngmawng aum sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka Pasian uh, na min siengthou a dinga inn ka hing lam piehna ding ua, Kana kisahna uh tam sil zousie nangma a hing kipan ahia, nanga ngen ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka Pasian nangman lungtang zousie na enchien zela, dihtatnate na kipahpi hi chi zong ka thei hi. Keivangin lungsim tahtahin tam sil zousie, kipahtahin ka hing lan ahi, tualeh tuin tana um na miten kiphaltah a, na kunga sil ahing piehte u’zong ka mu in ka kipah mama hi."},"18":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, ka pulepate uh, Abraham, Isaak leh Israel te Pasian, na miten tambang lungsim apuoh ngitnget theina dingun, alungsimte uh nangma adingin suhkip pieh in."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh ka tapa Solomon kungah, na thupiehte, na thutheisahte, na dante zui a, tam silte zousie bawl ding leh kana kisahkholna inn lam dingin lungsim hoibukim hing posahin,” David in achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh David in mipi kikhawmte zousie kungah, “Tuin Mangpa na Pasian uh phat un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n mipi kikhawmte zousie in, apu leh pate uh Mangpa Pasian aphat ua, Mangpa leh aleengpa uh maiah khupboh in abeta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh azingni in, Mangpa kungah kithoinate leh Mangpa kunga halmang sillat dingin bawngtal tul khat leh belamtal tul khat, adawn sillatte u’toh Israelmi zousie a dingin kithoina tampi alan uhi."},"22":{"text":"Khum niin Mangpa mai ah nuomsa tahin ane un, adawn chiet uhi. Tualeh David tapa Solomon khu leengpa ding leh vaihawmpa hi dingin, aniveina dingin sathaununa abawl uhi, tualeh Zadok siempu in apang hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon khu Mangpa Mangtoupha tungah apa David thahengin leengpa in atou a, alawchingtou zel hi, tuachi’n Israel mi zousie in athu a zui uhi.","title":"Solomon leeng hina (1 Leeng. 2.12)","ref":"1 Leeng. 2.12"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Israel milien zousie leh mihat zousie tualeh leengpa David tapate zousie zong Solomon leengpa mai ah kichiem in akitulut chiet uhi."},"25":{"text":"Mangpa’n Solomon khu Israel mi zousie mitmu ah, nasatahin atawisangta a, Israel gam a leengpa koima’n ana tan ngailou leeng hina thupitah akhuhsahta hi."},"26":{"text":"Jesse tapa David khu Israelte zousie tungah leengpa in ana pang hi.","title":"David shina"},"27":{"text":"Israelte tunga leenga apan sung kum sawmli ahi a, Hebron khuo ah kum sagi sung vai ahawm a, tualeh kum sawm thum leh kum thum Jerusalem ah leeng vai ahawm hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 5.4,5; 1 Khang. 3.4"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh upa tah leh tehse kun vawta dam in, hausatah leh za umtah in ashi hi, tuachi’n atapa Solomon ama thahengin leengpa in apangta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin leengpa David nasep zousie abul a kipat atawp tanin mutheitu Samuel laibu ah leh guolnei Nathan khangthu laibu ah leh mutheitu Gad khangthu laibu ah atuong
