hi."},"30":{"text":"A leeng vaihawmna thute, asilbawltheidan zousie leh ama leh Israelte tung leh leenggam dang zousie tunga siltungte zousie zong akigiel hi."}}}}},"14":{"info":{"name":"2 Khangthute","shortname":"2 Khang.","abbr":[],"desc":"Khangthute laibu nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David tapa Solomon khu aleenggam ah suhhat in a um a, Mangpa a Pasian in aumpi a, tualeh nasatah a thupi in abawlta hi.","title":"Solomon in pilna angen (1 Leeng. 3.4-15)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in Israelmi zousie kungah leh atul tunga lamkaite aza tunga lamkaite leh vaihawmte leh Israel lamkaite zousie leh aphungsung ua upate kungah, thu agenta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Solomon leh mipi kikhawmte zousie, Gibeon khuo aum mun sang ah ahaw ua, khunah Mangpa suohpa Mosi in gamdai a ana bawl kimutuona biehbuh aum hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian bawm khu David in Kiriath-Jearim akipat in aman akoina dinga abawlna mun ah ala touta hi, aziehpen aman akoina dingin Jerusalem ah puoninn ana zah zouta hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 6.1-17; 1 Khang. 13.5-14; 15.25—16.1"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Hur tapa Huri tapa Bezalel in ana bawl sum-eng maitam khu Gibeon khuo a, Mangpa biehbuh mai ah aum a, tuachi’n Solomon leh mipi kikhawmten khunah Pasian ava bie uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 38.1-7"},"6":{"text":"Solomon khu kimutuona biehbuh aum, Mangpa mai a sum-eng maitam lam ah apeitou a, halmang sillat tul khat alan hi."},"7":{"text":"Khum zan in Solomon kungah, Pasian ava kilah a, akungah, “Bang ahiei kang pieh ding? hing ngen in” achi hi.","title":"Pilna ngen a Solomon thumna (1 Leeng. 3.5-9)"},"8":{"text":"Khumin Solomon in Pasian kungah, “Kapa David kungah hepina thupitah na langsah a, tualeh ama thahengin leengpa in kei na hing pang sahta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuin aw Mangpa Pasian, ka pa David kunga na thuchiem sukipin um hen, aziehpen leitunga a leivui za atam mipite tungah leengpa in na hing pang sahta hi.","ref":"Siem. 13.16; 28.14"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi te masanga pawt leh lut a ka um theina dingin pilna leh theina hing piein, na mi tamzapite tungah koi in ahiei vaihawm pieh thei ding?” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in Solomon kungah, “Tambang lungsim na puoha, neilelamte leh hausatnate pahtawinate, ahisihleh na melmate hinna ngenlou a, damsawtnate zong ngenlou a, atung ua leengpa a ka hing pansahna mipite vaihahawm pieh theina dinga, pilna leh theinate na hing nget zawh ziehin;"},"12":{"text":"Pilna leh theina pieh nahita hi, tualeh nang masanga leengten zong ana nei ngailou uh tualeh nang nua a leengte koiman zong anei ngailou ding uh, sumlepai leh hausatnate, pahtawinate ka hing piehbe nalai ding hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon khu Gibeon khuo a munsang mai aum kimutuona biehbuh akipat in Jerusalem ah ahing pei a, Israelte tungah vai ahawmta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Solomon in sakollengte leh sakoltung tuongmite akhawm khawma, tualeh sakolleng tul khat leh zali tualeh sakol tungtuongmi tul sawm leh tul ni anei a, tuate sakolleng koina khopite ah leh Jerusalem a leengpa kungah akoi hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 4.26"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n dangka sia leh sana Jerusalem ah suong bang mai a tam in akoi a, tualeh sidar sing lah phaijanga theipi sing banga tam in akoi hi."},"16":{"text":"Solomon in sakolte Izipt gam leh Kue gam a kipata alah lut ahia, leengpa summet bawlmiten Kue akipat ava lei zel uh ahi.","ref":"Danp. 17.16"},"17":{"text":"Izipt gam akipat sakolleng khat ah dangka shekel zaguh leh sakol khat ah dangka shekel za leh sawmnga a lei in ahing tawllut ua, tuabangmain Hitmite leengte leh Siria leengte kungah atawlpawt zel uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in Mangpa min a dingin biehinn khat, tualeh ama dingin leeng innpi khat lam asawm hi.","title":"Solomon biehinn bawl dinga kisahna (1 Leeng. 5.1-16)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Solomon in vanpawding mi tul sawm sagi leh singtang gam a suong kalkhe dingin mi tul sawm giet tualeh amahaw veng ding mi tul thum leh zaguh ateldoh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in Tai-ar leengpa Huram kungah, mi asawl a, akungah “Ka pa David tenna ding inn lamna dinga Sidar sing na tuoh pieh bangin kei zong hing tuoh pieh in,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngai vawi, khawlnite a, hathate a leh Mangpa ka Pasian uh pawi bawl nite a, amasanga gimnamtui hal a, tanghou siengthou koi ngitnget a, tualeh zingmawng leh nitahlam a halmang sillatte latna dingin, Mangpa ka Pasian min adingin inn khat ka lam ding hi. Tami Israelte adinga kumtawm a dinga thugousie ahi."},"5":{"text":"Koute Pasian pen pasien dangte zousie sanga thupi zaw ahiman in ka biehinn lamding khu athupi mama ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh ama lah vante leh vansangpen in zong dawlzoulou ahiman in, koi adiei ama dinga inn lampieh zou ding? Amasanga gimnamtui halna munding bep loungal, kei koi ka hia Ama inn lampieh ding ka hiei?","ref":"1 Leeng. 8.27; 2 Khang. 6.18"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin Juda gam leh Jerusalem a mi khutsiemte, ka pa David in ana zahsa tua ka kunga umte toh sem khawm dingin, Sana, dangka sia, sum-eng leh sia khensiem leh khuoh siem tualeh puon sandup, san au leh adum gan siem mikhat hing sawlin."},"8":{"text":"Lebanon a Sidar singte, taa singte leh algum singtunte zong hing hah in, na mite Lebanon a sing sat dan asiem uh chi ka thei hi, tuachi’n ka miten na mite toh asem khawm ding ua,"},"9":{"text":"Sing tampi ahing khol pieh ding uhi, aziehpen ka biehinn lamding khu lien leh thupi mama ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ngai vawi, na mi singsatte leh singbawl mite, mangbu Kor tul sawmni, mimbu kor tul sawmni, uoin bath tul sawmni leh Olive thau bath sawmni, ka pe ding hi, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Tai-ar leengpa Huram in laihahin tambangin Solomon adawng hi: “Mangpa’n amite a it zieh a, nang amaute leengpa a ahing bawl ahi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ban ah tambangin agenbe nalai hi; “Lei leh van siempa Mangpa Israelte Pasian phat in um hen, Aman leengpa David kungah, tapa pil, lungsimpilna leh sil theikah siemna nei apie a, aman Mangpa adingin biehinn leh ama tenna ding leeng innpi lam ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"“Khutsiem mama Huram Abi na kung ah kang sawl ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Anu Dan mi ahi a, apa pen Tai-ar mi ahi. Amapen sana, dangka, sum-eng leh sia, tualeh sing leh suong leh puon sandup, ausan leh dum leh puonmalngat te bawldan kizil siemsa ahi. Ama khu akhuohthaw chituom tuom zong siemsa ahi a, alim gelsa a kipie bangbanga bawl theimi ahi. Na mi khutsiemte leh napa ka pu David mi siemte toh asemkhawm ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuin ka pu in na chiemsa, mangbu mim bu, Olive thau tualeh uointe na suohpa kungah hing hahta in;"},"16":{"text":"tualeh kouten na tulmaw za za Lebanon muol a singte ka hing sat ding ua, tualeh Joppa dong tuipi tungah pum in ka hing tawl suh ding ua, tuachi’n nang Jerusalem ah na potou ding hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Solomon in, apa David in mi simna abawl zou nua a, Israel gam a gamdang mi hing um thate zousie asim a, tul za khat leh tul sawm nga leh tul thum leh zaguh apha hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuate lah ah van paw ding mi tul sawm sagi, muola suong toukhe ding mi tul sawmgiet asep a, amaute nasep entup dingin mi tul thum leh zaguh aguot nalai hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in Jerusalem a Moria muol tungah, apa David kunga Mangpa kilahna, Jebusmi Ornan phuol a David mun bawlkholna ah Mangpa inn abawl panta hi.","title":"Solomon in biehinn alamna (1 Leeng. 6.1-29)","ref":"Siem. 22.22"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in avaihawm kum, kum lina, aha lina, ani ni niin innlam apanta hi."},"3":{"text":"Solomon in Pasian biehinn lamna dinga, suongphum abawl khu, tong sawm guh a sau, tong sawmni a lien ahi. (Tua khu tena lui a kite ahi.)"},"4":{"text":"Biehinn mailam innhim khu innpi vailam mabangin tong sawmni a sau ahia, tong sawmni a sang ahi. Asunglam sana siengset tuiin aluonkhum hi."},"5":{"text":"Innsung lienzawpen bangte tasing peh in athuopa, tua khu sana siengset tui in aluonkhum a, tum sing leh khainieng limte in azem hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman tua biehinn khu akilawmna dingin suongmantamte in azem a, tuana azah sanate khu Parvaim sana ahi."},"7":{"text":"Atung dalna innkamte, kotbiengte leh biehinn bangte sana tuiin aluonkhum a, bangte ah cherubim limte akhuoh thawin agiel hi."},"8":{"text":"Aman mun siengthoupen abawl a, asaulam khu biehinn vailam toh kikim ahia, tong sawmni ahi, tualeh availam zong tong sawmni ma ahia, sana siengset talent za guhin aluonkhum hi.","ref":"Pawt. 26.33,34"},"9":{"text":"Sana innkilnate khu Shekel sawmnga agih ahia, atunglam teng zong sana a luonkhum ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tua mun siengthou pen ah, Cherubim limni abawla, sana in aluon khum hi.","ref":"Pawt. 25.18-20"},"11":{"text":"Tua Cherubimte hate gel saudan tong sawmni ahia, Cherubim khat ha langkhat saudan tong nga ahia, ainn bang langkhat asukha hi, tualeh aha langkhat saudan zong tong nga ma ahi a, Cherubim dang khat pen ha toh aki sutuo hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuamabangin Cherubim dang khatpen ha lang khat tong nga ma ahi a, ainnbang langkhat asupha hi, tualeh aha lang khat zong tongnga ma ahi a, Cherubim khatpen ha toh aki sutuo hi."},"13":{"text":"Tam Cherubim tegel ha khu tong sawmni huopin akizah a, innsunglam ngain akengun ading uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh puonjah dingin, adum, asandup leh asan au leh puon malngatte abawl a, Cherubim limte atuongsah hi.","ref":"Pawt. 26.31"},"15":{"text":"Biehinn mailam ah tong sawm thum leh tong nga a sang khuompi ni aphut a, tua khuomtegel adawn zum khu tongnga tuoh tuoh ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tua khuom dawnte ah khainieng kiphante aviel a, tualeh kawlbuthei zakhat abawla, Khainiengte ah akhai hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuompite gel biehinn mailam ah aphut a, khat simlamah, khatpen mallam ah aphut hi, simlam tapen min Jakin ahisah a, mallam tapen min Boaz ahisah hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuathamlouin ama’n sum-eng maitam khat tong sawmni a sau, tong sawmni ma a lien leh tong sawm a sang abawl hi.","title":"Biehinn van zahte (1 Leeng. 7.23-26 , 38-51)","ref":"Pawt. 27.1,2"},"2":{"text":"Aman sia kisunthaw in tuikuongpi khat abem in abawl a, agei leh agei kikaal tong sawm ahia, asan lam tong nga ahi, tualeh agei kimvel a te-in tong sawmthum apha hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh nuoi lam kimvel ah bawngtal lim ngen in a imkuol a, tongkhat sungah sawm zel aum a, tua bawngtal limte, guolni in tuikuongpi toh sunkhawm ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tua tuikuongpi khu bawngtal sawmleni tungah akitung a, thum in tumlam anga a, thum in mallam anga a, thum in simlam, tualeh thum in suolam anga hi. Tuikuongpi khu atung uah akinga a, alailam anua ngat chiet uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua tuikuongpi khu khutpeh chia in asa a, agei zong nou gei bang ahia, lilipah pal bang ahi a, tualeh tuikuongpi in bath tul thum adawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman khut silna dingin kuongdai sawm abawla, simlam pangah nga tualeh mallam pangah nga akoi hi. Tuate halmang sillat dingte silsiengna in akizang hi. Hinanleh tuikuongpi pen siemputen kisilna a azah ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 30.17-21"},"7":{"text":"Aman abawl dan ding a kiguongsa dungzui in sana thaumei tunna sawm abawl a, simlampang ah nga, tualeh mallampangah nga akoi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 25.31-40\n        ;     \n        Pawt. 25.23-30"},"8":{"text":"Aman dawkan sawm zong abawla, bieh innsung ah, simlam ah nga tualeh mallam ah nga, akoi hi. Tualeh aman sana hengkuong zakhat zong abawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Aman siempute huongsung inntuol abawl a, huongsung lien leh akotkhate abawl a, akotkhate sum-eng in aluonkhum hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuikuongpi pen simlampang, sim suo lam ning zietlam ah akoi hi."},"11":{"text":"Aman belte, vutluohnate, hengkuongte zong abawl hi. Tuachi’n Huram-Abi in leengpa Solomon dinga Pasian biehinn sunga van ding, abawl pieh dingte zousie abawl zouta hi."},"12":{"text":"Khuompi nite, dawna nou bemte leh khuompi nite dawnna belkuong lukhuzum bangte zepna khainieng kiphan nite;"},"13":{"text":"Tua khainieng kiphan nite tunga kolbuthei zalite, tualeh tua khuom nite dawn a belkuong banga kibawl khuom lukhute zepna khainieng kiphante a kikoi kawlbuthei guolnite;"},"14":{"text":"Atunnate leh kuong daite, abawl a;"},"15":{"text":"Tuikuongpi leh anuoi a bawngtal sawm leh nite,"},"16":{"text":"Belte, vutluohnate, sa lepna sia khutkate leh akisaipi vandangte zousie abawl hi. Mangpa biehinn a dinga, Huram-Abi in, Solomon a dinga abawlpieh van zousie sum-eng tesitset in abawl pieh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuate zousie Jordan phaijang ah Sukoth leh Jeredathah kikaal a bellei munah leengpa’n asung hi."},"18":{"text":"Solomon in abawl tam vante zousie atam sengseng a, sum-eng gihdan a kite seng sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Solomon in Pasian biehinn sunga vanjah ding, sana maitam, tanghou sieng koina dawkan:"},"20":{"text":"Akiguotsa banga mun siengthou sungnung masanga det ding, meivah tunna leh ameivahte;"},"21":{"text":"Sana pahlim leh meivahte leh taite, sana siengset a bawl ngen ahi."},"22":{"text":"Sana siengseta kibawl thau mei eeh tetannate, maiphiet na kuongte, gimnamtui halna hengkuongte, tualeh biehinn kotkhate, Mun Siengthou pen kotkha sungnung leh innsungpi a kotkhate sana a kibawl ngen ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in Mangpa biehinn dinga, anasep zousie azawtahin, apa David in ana latsa silte: dangka, sana leh vanjahte zousie, ala lut a, Pasian biehinn a gou koikhawmna ah, akoilut hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 8.11; 1 Khang. 18.11"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in Israel upate leh nam chin a lamkaite tualeh Israel innkuonte lah a alutang pente uh, David khopi Zion a kipat a Mangpa thuhun bawm latou dingin Jerusalem ah ahankhawm hi.","title":"Pasian bawm biehinn sunga lah lutna (1 Leeng. 8.1-21)","ref":"2 Sam. 6.12-15; 1 Khang. 15.25-28"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelmite zousie, hasagina pawi bawlna hunin leengpa kungah ahing peikhawm uhi."},"4":{"text":"Israel upate zousie ahing tun tahun, Leviten Pasian bawm akipat ua,"},"5":{"text":"tualeh amaun, bawm leh kimutuona biehbuh leh biehinn sunga um leh bel vanjah siengthou um zousie apotou uhi."},"6":{"text":"Lengpa Solomon leh Israel mipi kikhawm, ama kunga hing kikhawm zousie bawm maiah aum ua, belamte leh bawngtalte sim senglou a tam in akithoi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n siemputen Mangpa thuhun bawm khu biehinn sunga munsiengthou sungnunga, Mun siengthou pen mun a, ama koina ding mun a, cherubimte gel halim nuoi ah ahing polutta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua cherubimte gelin bawm umna mun khu aha un azah khum ua, tua bawm leh azawnna zawlte akhu uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tam zawlte asau mama a, bawm akipat a aval hingdohkhie munsiengthou sungnung mai apat in akimuthei a, Munsiengthou pen pulam apat in vang akimu thei sih hi. Tuni dongin tua zawlte tua munah aum uhi."},"10":{"text":"Izipt akipat a ahing pawtdoh lai ua, Mangpa’n Israel tate toh Horeb muola thuhun abawl lai a Mosi in tua bawm sunga akoi suongpeh nite chiloungal, Pasian bawm sungah bangma dang aum sih hi.","ref":"Danp. 10.5"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, mun siengthou pen akipat siempute ahing pawtkhieh tah un. Tua mun a um siempute zousie koima pawl tuom umlou in akisusiengthou chiet uhi.","ref":"1 Khang. 16.34; 2 Khang. 7.3; Ezr. 3.11; Late. 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer. 33.11  ;     \n        Pawt. 40.34,35"},"12":{"text":"Tumging tum Levite zousie, Asaph, Heman leh Jeduthun te leh atapate u’leh aunaute uh, puonmalngat sil in, dahkhutbehte, kaigingte leh pehgingte tum in maitam suolampang ah ading uhi. Siempu za leh sawmni in zong pengkul mut in amaute adinpi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Pengkul mutte leh lasate Mangpa phat ding leh Ama tunga kipah thu gen dingin, aw khat suoin apangkhawm uhi. Pengkul te, dahkhutbehte leh tumging dangte thuo in, Mangpa phat a aw ngaitah suo in, “Ama ahoi hi; Aitna kumtawn in aum ding hi,” chia Mangpa phat a la asah tahun, Mangpa biehinn khu meilum in ahing tuomdimta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua meilum ziehin siemputen anasep ding uh asem theita sih uhi, aziehpen Mangpa thupina in Pasian biehinn aluo dimta hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in “Mangpa’n meipi miel keei kuui lah a um ding kahi, ana chi zouta hi, achi hi.","title":"Biehinn a Solomon thugen (1 Leeng. 8.12-21)"},"2":{"text":"Ken kumtawna na tendenna dingin biehinn thupitah ka hing lampiehta hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua mun a Israel mipi kikhawmte adin lai un leengpa ahing kihei a, amaute aguolzawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman, “Kapa David kungah akam in thu ana chiem a, akhut mama a sutangtungpa Mangpa Israelte Pasian phat in umta hen.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.1-13; 1 Khang. 17.1-12"},"5":{"text":"Aman: Izipt gam a kipata ka mite ka puidoh akipat ka min umna dinga biehinn lamna ding mun leh Israel nam lah a khopi khat zong ka tel nai sih a, ka mi Israelte tunga lamkai ding zong koima ka tel naishi hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh tu’n ka min umna dingin Jerusalem ka telta a, ka mi Israelte tunga vaihawm dingin David ka telta, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka pa David in Mangpa Israelte Pasian min a dingin biehinn khat lampieh ding alung gul hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n ka pa David kungah, ka min a dinga biehinn khat lam ding nana lunggul a, tambang lungsim na nei ahoi ahi;"},"9":{"text":"Hinanlezong nangman tua biehinn na lamsih dinga, na tahsa leh sisan mama a pieng na tapain ka min adingin tua inn khu alam zaw ding hi, achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa’n athuchiemsate atudet a, tuin ka pa David thahengin, Mangpa’n ana chiemsa mabangin Israelte leengtoupha tungah ka touta a, Israelte Mangpa Pasian min dingin biehinn ka lamta hi."},"11":{"text":"Khunah Pasian bawm ka koi a, tua bawm sungah Mangpa’n Israel mite toh kaal a thuhun abawl aum hi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mipi kikhawmte masanga Mangpa maitam mai ah Solomon adinga aban azah hi.","title":"Solomon biehinn latna thumna (1 Leeng. 8.22-53 ; Late. 132.8-10)"},"13":{"text":"Solomon in sum-eng dawkang, tong nga asau, tongnga alien leh tong thum a sang abawla huongsung inntuol pulam tazawpen laikim tahah akoi a, ama tua dawkang tungah adinga, tuachi’n Israel mipi kikhawmte mai ah akhup din a, vanlam ah akhut azahtou hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama athum a: “Aw Mangpa Israelte Pasian leitung leh vantungah nangma bang Pasian aum sih hi. Lungtang zousie toh na lampite zui a gamta, na suohte toh kikaal a itna thuhun hung Pasian dang aum sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Na suoh ka pa David kunga na thuchiem, na tangtung sah a, tualeh na kam in thu nana chiem a na khut ngelin na sutangtung hi, tuni mabangin."},"16":{"text":"Tuin Mangpa Israelte Pasian aw, na suohpa ka pa David kunga, nahah na suonte, nang um banga um dinga, agamtat dan ua apilvang pou u’leh, ka mitmu ah Israelte leengtoupha a tou ding akitasam sih ding, chia na kichiemna khu tangtung sah in.","ref":"1 Leeng. 2.4"},"17":{"text":"Mangpa Israelte Pasian aw, na suoh David kunga, na thuchiem khu, tuin hing sutangtung teitei in."},"18":{"text":"“Hinanleh Pasian leitunga mihingte toh atengkhawm tahtah talawm ding adiei? van leh van sangpente nangawnin nang hing dawllou hi a, tam ka biehinn lam in, hing dawlzou maw va-ia samva e maw.","ref":"2 Khang. 2.6"},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa Pasian na suoh thumna leh zangaina anget hing ngaikhieh pieh inlen, na masanga na suoh kikouna leh thumna ngaipieh in."},"20":{"text":"Sun leh zan in tami biehinn, ka min a um ding na china mun lam na mit in hing en zing hen. Tam mun lam nga a na suoh thumna na ngaikhie in.","ref":"Danp. 12.11"},"21":{"text":"Na suohpa leh Israel na mi Israelte tam munlam nga a, athum chiengun, athumna ngetnate uh na na za inlen, Na tenna mun vantunga apat in na ngaikhie inlen, na zah chiengin, ngaidam in."},"22":{"text":"“Mi khat in a innveng tunga sil asuhkhiel zieh a, kichiemna neisah akiphatmaw a, tam biehinn maitam mai ahing zot chiengin;"},"23":{"text":"Vantunga pat na ngaikhie inlen thukhen in. Na suohte kikaal ah nangman thu khen inlen, mikhielte, akhelna uh ama lutungah tusah inlen mawpai in, tualeh mawna neilou mi khu mawnaneilou ahidan phuong inlen, adihna uh kilang sahin."},"24":{"text":"“Na mi Israelte na tunga akhel zieh ua, a gal lel ua, chimaw a hing kinuahei a na min loua tami biehinn a athum ua, ahing nget chiengun;"},"25":{"text":"Vantunga kipat na ngaikhie inlen, na mi Israelte khelna ngaidam inlen, amauleh apu apate uh kunga na piehsa gam ah puilut kia in."},"26":{"text":"“Na mite na tunga akhelna zieh ua, vante akikhabinga guo azuhlou chienga, akhelna zieh ua amauh na suh gentheina zieh a, tammun lam nga a, ahing thum ua, na min ahing law ua, akhelnate uh kisia a ahing kinua heikia chieng un;"},"27":{"text":"Van a kipat na ngaikhie inlen, na suohte, na mi Israelte khelna ngaidam in. Hindan lampi dih amaute zuiding hil inlen, goutan dinga na mite na piehna gam ah guo zusahin."},"28":{"text":"“Gam sunga kiel ahiei, natna hipi ahiei, gawtna ahiei, muotna ahiei, khauphete ahiei, khaukhupte ahiei, ahing tun chieng ahiei, ahisihleh amelmate un akhopite uh alu ua, aimkhum chieng ua, bangchibang hasatna ahiei, ahisihleh natna ahiei, atuoh chiengun;"},"29":{"text":"Na mi Israelte khat poupou in agentheinate uh leh anatnate uh hing kiphawhdoh a, Tami biehinn lam nga a, akhut uh zah a thumna leh thungetna ahing tut chieng un;"},"30":{"text":"Tuabang hunchiengin, na umna van a kipat in na ngaikhie inlen, ngaidam in, mi chin lungtang nang na thei a, anasep dan dungzui un thukhen piehin, aziehpen nang bouin mihing lungtang na thei hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua chin amauten nang ahing giing ding ua, kapu le pate uh na piehna gam a aten sungsie uh na lampite azui ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"“Na mi Israelte hilou gamdangmi hinapi a, na min thupitah leh na khut hattah leh na banzah zieh a, gamlapi a kipat a, hing pei a, tami biehinn lam nga a, ahing thum chiengun;"},"33":{"text":"Tuabang hun chiengin, na umna van a kipat in ana ngaikhie inlen, tua gamdangmi in angetnate bawl piehin. Tua hileh namite mabangin, leitunga mi zousiein na min theiin, azau ding ua, tualeh tam ka inn lam na min puo ahi, chi athei ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"“Nang namite nasawlna lam lam a, amelmate uh dou dinga akuon chiengun, na telsa tam khopi leh na min dinga ka lam tami biehinn lam nga a, ahing thum chiengun;"},"35":{"text":"Van akipat in athumna u’leh angette uh na ngaikhieh pieh inlen, guolzawlna pie in."},"36":{"text":"“Akhiellou lah koima um samlou a, amauh zong na tunga atawnkhel ua, atung ua na lungthah a, amelmate uh kunga na piehkhieh a, gamdang agamla leh anai a sal a apuimang chiengun;"},"37":{"text":"Asaltanna gam ua, ahing kigeldoh thei ua, alungtangte uh henga, ahing kisia ua, asaltanna gam ua, kana khielta ua, dihlou tahin kana bawl uh a, giloutahin kana gamta khata uhi, chia na kunga ahing thum ngetngut chiengun;"},"38":{"text":"Sal a amaute kipuimangna gam a, alungtang zousie u’leh ahinna zousie ua, apu leh pate uh na pieh gamlam leh na telsa tami khopi lam leh na min ding a ka lam tami biehinn lam nga a ahing thum u’leh;"},"39":{"text":"Tuabang hun chiengin, na umna van a kipat in athumna u’leh angetnate uh na ngaikhie inlen, bawl piehin, tualeh na tunga khiel na mite ngaidam in."},"40":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw, “Tuin hepitahin tam mun a ka thumnate, ah na mitte hah inlen, na bilte na daw in."},"41":{"text":"Aw Mangpa Pasian, Tuin thou inlen, na khawlna, mun ah hing peita in. Nangma leh na hatna bawm na siempute, Hundamna silsahin um uhen len; Na mi siengthoute, na hoina ah nuom uhen.","ref":"Late. 132.8-10"},"42":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian aw, Na sathau nupa nuolsin, Na suoh David kunga na chiemsa, Itna thupi thei ngitnget in,” achi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in thumna azaw tahin van akipat in meikuong ahing kesuh a, halmang sillat leh kithoinate akatum a, biehinn sungah Mangpa thupina in biehinn sung aluo dim hi.","title":"Biehinn latna","ref":"Siempu. 9.23-24"},"2":{"text":"Tuabanga Mangpa thupinain, biehinn sung aluodimtah zieh in, siempute Mangpa biehinn sung ah alut theita sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Israel mite zousie in, meikuong hing kesuh leh inn tunga Mangpa thupina amu tahun, leituol ah amai ua leisu in abohkhup ua, Mangpa abie ua, tambangin kipah thu agen uhi: “Ama ahoi a, a khotuona khu kumtawn a um ding ahi zieh in” achi uhi.","ref":"1 Khang. 16.34; 2 Khang. 5.13; Ezr. 3.11; Late. 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer. 33.11"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa leh mipite zousie in Mangpa mai ah kithoinate alan uhi.","title":"Kithoina leh kipahna (1 Leeng. 8.62-66)"},"5":{"text":"Lengpa Solomon in zong bawng tul sawmni leh tul ni leh belam leh kel tul zakhat leh tul sawmni kithoina in alan hi. Tuachi’n leengpa leh mipite zousie in, Pasian biehinn alan uhi."},"6":{"text":"Siemputen amun uh aluo chiet ua, Leviten zong Mangpa pahtawina tumging vanzahte tawi kawm in, amun uh aluo uhi. Tua tumgingte khu leengpa David in Mangpa phatna dinga ana bawl ahia, tuate zangin aman Mangpa kungah kipah thu ana gen a: A itna khu kumtawn in aum hi, ana chi hi. Tuachi’n Levite mai zawn ah siemputen pengkul amut ua, Israel mipite zousie ading uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuate ban ah Solomon in Mangpa biehinn mai leituol laita pen zong asusiengthou a, tuanah halmang sillatte leh lemna sillat sa thau alan hi, aziehpen ama bawlsa sum-eng maitam in halmang sillatte ann sillatte leh thau sillatte adawl zoulou zieh ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tuami tungin Solomon, akunga Israel mi zousie Hamath lutna akipat a Izipt luipi donga mipi kikhawmte atam a tamte toh ni sagi sung pawi abawl uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ni giet niin kikhopna siengthou anei uhi, nisagi sung maitam latna lopna anei ua, tualeh ni sagi sungma pawi abawl be nalai uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ha sagina, ni sawmni leh nithum niin, mipite a inn lam chiet uah apei sahta a, Mangpa’n David kung leh Solomon kung leh ami Israelte kunga hoina alatsah ziehin nuom leh kipah tahin aum chiet uhi."},"11":{"text":"Solomon in Mangpa biehinn leh leeng innpi alam zouta a, Solomon in alungsim a atup bang taha, Mangpa biehinn leh ama inn lamzang tah a apichin sah tah in;","title":"Solomon kunga Mangpa kilahna"},"12":{"text":"Mangpa Solomon kungah zankhang lai in ahing kilah a, akungah; “Na thumnate ka za a, tualeh kithoinate latna biehinn hi ding in tam mun ka telta hi."},"13":{"text":"Vante ka kha binga, guo azuh sih a, ahisihleh gam suse dinga khauphete thu kapieh ahiei, ahisihleh ka mite lah a hipi ka lensah chieng ahiei in;"},"14":{"text":"Ka min a kilou, ka mite ki ngaingiem a, athum ua, ka maipha asui ua, a umdan giloute uh akiheisan u’leh, van a kipat in kana ngaikhe dinga, akhelna uh ka ngaidam dinga, agam uh kadamsah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuin ka mitte ka hah sah dinga, tam mun a athumnate uh bil ka daw ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuin kumtawna ka min umdenna dingin tami biehinn ka telta a, ka susiengthouta, hi; ka mit leh ka lungtang tuamun ah, hun chin in a umdenta ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Nang na hileh, na pa David banga, ka masanga na pei a, ka thupiehte zousie na zui a, ka thu gousiete leh ka dan thute na nit leh;"},"18":{"text":"Israelte lah a vaihawm ding na tasam sih ding chia na pa David kunga thu kana hun dungzuiin na leenggam toupha ka sukip ding hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 2.4"},"19":{"text":"“Hinanleh na kiheimang ua, ka thugousiete leh ka thupiehte, taisan a, pasien dangte nna sem ding leh amaute be dinga na kuon leh;"},"20":{"text":"Amauh ka piehsa ka gam a pat in Israel ka botdoh dinga, ka min dinga ka suhsiengthousa tami bieh inn zong ka dei nawn sih dinga, ka mu phahlou ah ka suonmang dinga, nam zousie lah ah paunah leh aselama mite houlim nopna in ka bawl ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tami biehinn tuin thupisahna toh ding viel vuol nanleh akunga pei kha pouma in dip hum zenin lamdang asa ding ua, Bang zieha Mangpa’n tam gam leh tami biehinn tunga tam banga abawl va-ia adiei? achi ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Mite’n a dawng ding ua, Izipt gam a kipata amaute puidohpa, apu leh pate uh Mangpa Pasian, ataisan ua, pasien dangte abel ua, abie ua, tualeh a nna uh asep pieh zieh uh ahi, tuazieh a amaute tunga tambang sietna zousie atun sah ahi,” achi ding uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in Mangpa biehinn leh ama innpi alamsung kum sawmni ahing bei bepin,","title":"Solomon silbawl dangte (1 Leeng. 9.10-28)"},"2":{"text":"Hiram in apiehsa khotate, Solomon in alam tha kia a, tuate ah Israel mite ateng sah hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in Hamath-Zobah ava dou a, alata hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman gamdai ah Tadmor alam a, tualeh Hamath a van koikhawmna khopi alamsate zong alam toupeh hi."},"5":{"text":"Beth-Horon sahta leh Beth Horon hangta zong kulpinei khopite in abawl a, kulpi baangte leh akotpite leh akalna zawlte zong abawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ban-ah Baalath leh van koikhawmna khopite, sakollengte zousie leh sakolte koina ding khopite leh Jerusalem leh Lebanon tualeh avaihawmna gam sunga abawl guot zousie abawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Israel mite hilou, Hitmite, Amormite, Perizmite, Hivmite, lah a kipat kinuasiete zousie,"},"8":{"text":"hahlesuonte Israel gam sungah aum ua, tuate Israelten asumangthai sih uhi. Solomon in tuabang mite khu suoh nasem dingin akoi a, tuni tan in tuabangin aum uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Solomon in Israel tate koima suohnasem in apangsah sih a, galkap lamkaite lah a lienpente, sakollengte leh sakolleng hawlte lamkaite in apang sah zaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Tamte khu Solomon leengpa lamkaite leh ulienpente in apang ua, mite nasep enkoltu, zani leh sawm nga apha uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Solomon in Pharaoh tanu David khopi apat in, amanu dinga a inn bawl pieh ah apuitou a, aziehpen, “Kazi Israel leengpa inn ah aum thei sih ding hi, Pasian bawm hing lutna ahi, ziehin amun asiengthou hi” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon in biehinn mailam a abawl, Mangpa maitam tungah Mangpa adingin halmang sillatte alan hi."},"13":{"text":"Mosi thupieh dungzui a, ni chin a dinga bituh mabangin, khawlnite, ha tha nite, leh kum sim akibawl pawi thumte: Tanghou tolsawlou pawi, Nipikaal pawi leh Biehbuh pawite; adingin alan zel hi.","ref":"Kisim. 28.9,10; Kisim. 28.11-15; Pawt. 23.14-17; 34.22,23; Kisim. 28.16—29.39; Danp. 16.16"},"14":{"text":"Apa David thupieh dungzui in, apawl pawl a kikhen siempute sep ding aguon a, Levite phatna lamkai ding leh nichin a akulna banga siempute hu dingin aguot hi. Aman kotkha vengmite zong kotkha tuom tuom a apawl pawl a pang dingin aguot hi, aziehpen tambangin Pasian mi David in thu apie hi."},"15":{"text":"Lengpa’n siempute ahisihleh Levite thu apieh pouma bang thu hitaleh, sum koikhawmna thu toh kisai nangawn zong suilou in apielsan sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa biehinn suongphum akiphum ni apat inn lam akizaw dongin, alung tup bangin asemtou zel a, tuachi’n Mangpa biehinn lam zou ahita hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Edom gam a tuipi gei a, Ezion Geber leh Elath ah ava haw hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Hiram in tuipi a gamta siem mama ama uliente lamkaina in tembawte asawl hi. Tam mite Solomon mite toh zoh khawm in Ophir ah avahaw ua, khuna pat in sana talent zali leh sawm nga ahing puo ua, leengpa Solomon kungah ahing tut uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sheba leengnu in Solomon minthandan azah tah in dohna hasa pipi toh Solomon etchien tum in, nuazui atama tampi toh gimnamtui pua sangawngsaute toh sana atam atam leh suongmantamte hing puo in Jerusalem ah ahing haw a, tualeh Solomon kung ahing tun tahin alungsim a um zousie pholkhe siengin ama ahoupi hi.","title":"Solomon leh Sheba leengnu (1 Leeng. 10.1-13)","ref":"Mat. 12.42; Luk. 11.31"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in adohna zousie a dawnga, ahilchien theilou mawngmawng bangma aum sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Sheba leengnu’n Solomon pilna leh a inn bawldan amu bepin;"},"4":{"text":"adawkan a a annnehte, amiliente toudante, anasemte nasepdante leh apuon tuol silte uh uoin pemite leh apuon tuol silte uh tualeh Mangpa biehinn a halmang sillatte amu tahin lamdang sahna in adim hi."},"5":{"text":"Amanu’n leengpa kungah, “Na silbawlte leh na pilna thu kigente ka gam a ka zahte adih ana hi ngut hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh hing pei a, ka mit mama a ka hing mu masangsie’n kana tahsang sih hi; atahtahin na pilna thupi dan akim alang zong hing na kihillou ahi. Na minthanna thu kigensawn kana zahte na khup khel hi."},"7":{"text":"Na mite nah hamphat hina uh e, na masang a ding ngitnget a, na pilna thu ngaikhie na uliente hampha hina mai uh e."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian a dinga, vaihawm dinga a leengtoupha a, nang hing tousah dinga na tunga kipah Mangpa na Pasian pahtawi in umta hen; Na Pasian in Israelte a it zieh leh amaute kumtawn a tunding den a ut man a, thudih leh dihtatna kem dinga, amaute tunga nang leengpa a ahing bawl ahi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman sana talent za leh sawmni leh gimnamtui tampi tualeh suongmantamte toh leengpa apie hi. Sheba leengnu’n, leengpa Solomon apieh bang gimnamtui mawngmawng a um ngai nai sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Hiram mite leh Solomon miten Ophir akipat sana ahing puo ua, algum sing leh suongmantamte zong ahing puo uhi."},"11":{"text":"Leengpa’n tua algum singte, Mangpa biehinn kellei leh leeng innpi kelleite bawlna ding leh tumging tumte adinga pehgingte leh kaigingte bawlna dingin azang hi. Juda gam ah tambang mawngmawng akimukha ngai nai sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Lengpa Solomon in Sheba leengnu kungah alunggul pouma leh anget pouma apie hi. Tuachi’n leengnu akipandoh a, ahing zawpi anuazuiteng toh agam lam ah akinuale kiata hi."},"13":{"text":"Solomon in kum chin a amu sana gihdan talent za guh sawmguh leh guh ahi.","title":"Solomon thupina (1 Leeng. 10.14-29)"},"14":{"text":"Tuate lah ah summet bawlte leh vanzuate’n sie apiehte uh kisimtel nailou ahinalai hi. Arabia gam leengte leh agam uhpipaten zong sana leh dangka Solomon ahing puoh uhi."},"15":{"text":"Lengpa Solomon in sana khenthawin lum lien zani abawl a, lum khat bawlna in sana shekel zaguh chiet alut hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaban ah sana khenthaw in lum neu zathum abawla, lum khat bawlna in sana shekel zathum chiet alut hi. Lengpa’n tuate Lebanon gammang innpi ah akoi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuathamlouin leengpa’n saiha leengtoupha thupitah abawl a sana sieng tui in aluonkhum hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua leengtoupha kalna kellei guh a um a, leengtoupha toh kizop sana kengngapna abawl hi. Tua toupha siih tuoh ah, khutngapna toupha bante leh akunga humpibahnei ding lim ni a um hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua leengtoupha kellei guhte mong chietah humpibahnei sawm leh ni ading a; leenggam dangten tuabang mawngmawng abawl ngai nai sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Lengpa Solomon noute zousie sana akibawl ahia, tualeh Lebanon gammang innpi sunga um vanzahte zousie sana sieng set a kibawl ngen ahi. Solomon hun lai in dangkasia pen manphalou zaw a, ngai ahi ziehin dangkasia in bangma akibawl sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Lengpa’n sum met bawlna tembawpi Tarshish gam donga pei thei tampi anei a, tuate Hiram miten ahawl uhi. Kum thum hal in tua Tarshish tembawte, sana, dangka sia leh saiha, tualeh zawng liente leh utongte puo in ahing kinua le zel uhi."},"22":{"text":"Lengpa Solomon pen leitunga leeng dang teng sangin hauna leh pilna ah atungnung zaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in Solomon lungtanga akoi pilna thute ngaikhe nuom in, leitung leengte zousie in Solomon kung ahing zuon uhi."},"24":{"text":"Kum chin a ama kunga hing pei zousieten, silpieh: sana leh dangka a kibawl vante leengpuontuolte, galvante, gimnamtuite, sakolte leh sabiltungte ahing puoh zel uhi."},"25":{"text":"Solomon in sakolte leh sakollengte koina dingin buh tul li anei a; sakollengte koina khopite a akoite leh ama kunga Jerusalem a akoi sakol tul sawm leh tul ni zong anei hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 4.26"},"26":{"text":"Euphrates luipi apat Philistinte gam dong leh Izipt gamgi chieng donga leengte zousie tungah vai ahawm hi.","ref":"Siem. 15.18; 1 Leeng. 4.21"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n Jerusalem ah dangka siate khu atam seng ziehin suongtum bang mai in tualeh sidar singte zong muol zung phaijangte a theipi sing bang giapin abawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Solomon sakolte khu Izipt gam leh gam dang danga kipat a lah lut ahi.","ref":"Danp. 17.16"},"29":{"text":"Solomon vaihawm sunga siltung dang dangte abul apat atawp dongin, guolnei Nathan sil chiemtena laibu leh Shilonmi Ahijah genlawhna leh Nebat tapa Jeroboam toh kisai a, mailam thumavang genpa guolnei Iddo mengmuna laibu ah akigiel hilou ahiei mah?","title":"Solomon shina (1 Leeng. 11.41-43)"},"30":{"text":"Solomon in Jerusalem ah Israelte zousie tungah kum sawm li vai ahawm hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Solomon apu leh pate kungah a i muta a, apa David khopi ah akivuita hi. Atapa Rehoboam ama thahengin leengpa in apangta hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rehoboam leengpa a bawl dinga Israelte zousie Shekem a apeitah ziehun ama zong Shekem ah ava hawta hi.","title":"Rehoboam tunga Israelte helna (1 Leeng. 12.1-15)"},"2":{"text":"Nebat tapa Jeroboam leengpa Solomon akipata taimang Izipt gam a um in, tuathu azah tahin Izipt akipat in Jeroboam ahing kinuale kia ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeroboam ahansah ua, ama leh Israel mi zousie Rehoboam kungah ava haw ua, akungah;"},"4":{"text":"“Na pan koute hahkol gihtah angna guon a, hinanleh tuin nang nasep hasa leh hahkol gihtah na pa’n ana hing guon khu jangsah inlen, tuachi’n na nna sem in ka hing zui ding uh,” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Rehoboam in adawnga, “Nithum zou chiengin hing pei kia un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n mipite apeita uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Rehoboam in apa Solomon dam lai a, anna nasem, upate thu akikuppi a, “Tam mipite dawn ding dan, bang ngaidan nang pe thei uoi?” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Amauten adawng ua, “Tam mite na hepi siem a amaute na lungkim sah a, dawnna hoitah na pieh leh na suohte ahiden ding uh, achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Rehoboam in upate thuhilna a sangta sih a, ama khanguol a nna sem tangvalte thu akikuppi zawta hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama’n amaute kungah, ka kunga, “Na pan koute hahkol gihtah ahingna guon hing suh jangkhai piehin chia hing gen mipite bang chi dawn ding ihi uoi? Nouten bang thu ahiei nang mop thei uh?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama khanguol tangvalten adawng ua; “Na kunga Na pan hahkol gihtah koute ahing guon a, hinanleh tuin ka hahkol uh hing suh jang piehin chia hing gen mipite kungah, ka khutme ka pa kawng sangin alien zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka pa’n hahkol gihtah noute ahing guon a, Ken agih zaw sem kang guon dinga, ka pa’n zepna khauhuol in noute ang zepa, ken khauhuol lingneite in kang zep ding hi,” chi in, achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Lengpa’n ni thum nua chiengin ka kungah “Hing hawkia un achi dungzui in, Jeroboam leh mipite zousie, ni thum zouin Rehoboam kungah ahing haw kia uhi.”","title":"Lenggam kikhenna (1 Leeng. 12.16-24)"},"13":{"text":"Lengpa’n upate thu hilna sangtalouin, amaute khautah in ana dawngta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tangvalte thuhilna zui in amaute kungah, “Ka pa’n na hahkol uh ana gihsah a, ken kang gihsah sem nalai ding hi. Ka pa’n khauhuolin ang zep a, ken khauhuol lingneite in kang zep ding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n mipite thu angaikhiet piehta sih hi; Aziehpen Mangpa’n Shilon mi Ahijah zanga, Nebat tapa Jeroboam kunga ana gensa athu tangtunna ding a, Pasian a hing kipan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Israelmi zousiein leengpa’n athu uh angaikhiet pieh nuom sih chi a theitah un, leengpa adawng ua, “David ah bang tanvou ahiei ka nei uh? Jesse tapa ah goutan bangma ka nei sih uhi. Israel aw na puon inn chiet uah peita un, Aw David na inn sung kingaituo mai in” achi uhi. Tuachi’n Israelmite zousie a inn lamchiet uh zuon in apeita uhi.","ref":"2 Sam. 20.1"},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Juda khopite a teng Israelte tungah Rehoboam in vai ahawmkhum nalai hi."},"18":{"text":"Leengpa Rehoboam in nasem a pauhat a kiguoite tunga lamkaipa Adoniram asawl a, tuachi’n Israel mipiten suongin ana seplumta uhi. Bangteng hileh leengpa Rehoboam a sakolleng ah atuong thei hamham a, Jerusalem tandong asuohta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte tuni dongin David innkuonte tung ah ahel denta uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rehoboam Jerusalem a ahing tun tah in, Israel dou ding leh Rehoboam a dinga leenggam nualah kia dingin Juda leh Benjamin innkuonte akipat galkap mi tul za leh tul sawm giet akhawm khawm hi.","title":"Rehoboam Jerusalem a anuakiana"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh tam Mangpa thu Pasian mipa Shemaiah kungah ahing tung hi."},"3":{"text":"“Juda leengpa Solomon tapa Rehoboam kungah leh Juda leh Benjamin gam a Israelmi um zousiete kungah tam thu va gen in:"},"4":{"text":"Tambangin Mangpa’n agen hi, na sanggamte uh dou dingin kuontou sih un, na bawn un na inn lam chiet uah peita un, tam sil keima bawl ahi chi in,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amaun Mangpa thu amang ua, Jeroboam dou dinga kuon nawnlou in anua kiata uhi."},"5":{"text":"Rehoboam Jerusalem ah atenga, Juda gam venbitna dingin khopite abawl hi. Tuate khu:","title":"Rehoboam in Juda asuhhatna (1 Leeng. 12.21-24)"},"6":{"text":"Bethlehem, Elam leh Tekoa,"},"7":{"text":"Beth-zur, Sokoh leh Adullam,"},"8":{"text":"Gath, Mareshah leh Ziph,"},"9":{"text":"Adoraim, Lakish leh Azekah,"},"10":{"text":"Zorah, Aijalon leh Hebron, ahi. Tamte khu Juda leh Benjamin gam a kulpi nei khopite ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aman kulpite akhokhum a, asungah lamkai dingte akoi a, nehletah, Olive thau leh uointe akoikhawm hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua khopite zousie ah lum leh teipite akoi a, tua khopite zousie muonhuoi tahin abawla, Tuate khu khopi muonhuoi tahin abawla, tuachi’n Juda leh Benjamin ama a ahita hi."},"13":{"text":"Israel gam pumpi a siempute leh Leviten atenna gamkai chiet ua kipat in Rehoboam lam ah apang chiet uhi."},"14":{"text":"Leviten a louhing gamte u’leh anei alamte uh nua sie in Juda gam leh Jerusalem ah ahing pei uhi. Aziehpen Jeroboam leh atapaten, Mangpa dinga a siempu nasepna ua pat amaute atawpsah zieh in.","title":"Jeroboam in Pasian bieh adeilouna"},"15":{"text":"Jeroboam in mun sangte a ding leh kel leh bawngnou lim abawlte a dingin leh ama Siempu ding atuom in aguot hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 12.31"},"16":{"text":"Israel nam tuom tuomte lah a mi, Mangpa Israel Pasian sui nuomte zousie in, Mangpa apu apate uh Pasian kunga kithoina lan dingin Levite Jerusalem ah azui suh uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amaun kum thum sung Juda leenggam asuhat ua, Solomon tapa Rehoboam a panpi uhi. Aziehpen amaun khum hun sung David leh Solomon lampite azui uhi."},"18":{"text":"Rehoboam in David tapa Jerimoth tanu Mahalath zi in anei a, Jesse tapa Eliab tanu Abihail zong zi in anei hi.","title":"Rehoboam innkuonte"},"19":{"text":"Mahalath in tapate ahinga: Jeush, Shemariah leh Zaham ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua zou in Absalom tanu Maakah akitenpi a, amanu’n, Abijah, Attai, Zizah leh Shelomith ahinpieh hi."},"21":{"text":"Rehoboam in azipite leh ameite zousie sangin Absalom tanu Maakah a it pen hi. Aman zipi sawm leh giet anei a, tualeh mei sawm guh anei hi. Tapa sawmni leh giet leh tanu sawm guh anei hi."},"22":{"text":"Rehoboam in Maakah tapa Abijah leengpa a bawl ding alung gul ziehin asanggamte lah ah lamkai pen in abawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Pilvang tahin abawl a, atapate zousie Juda gam leh Benjamin gam a khopi kulpi neite ah a umsah chiet a, tualeh neh leh taah ding kiching tah in amaute apie a, tualeh zi tampi aguon chiet hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rehoboam leengpa hina din mun dettah ahi nua-in leh ama ahing hattah in, Ama leh Israelte zousie in Mangpa danthupiehte ataisan uhi.","title":"Shishak in Jerusalem adouna (1 Leeng. 14.25-28)"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa tunga amuonhuoilou ziehun, Rehoboam vaihawm akum ngana kum in, Izipt leengpa Shishak in Jerusalem adou hi."},"3":{"text":"Sakolleng tul khat leh zani leh sakol tungtuongmi tul sawm guh toh, Izipt akipat a hing zui Libia mite leh Sukmite tualeh Ethiopia mite galkap simsengloute toh,"},"4":{"text":"Juda gam a khopi kulpi nei tampi ala a, Jerusalem dong ahing tungta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Shemaiah Rehoboam kung leh Shishak zau zieh a Jerusalem a hing peikhawm lamkaite kungah ahing haw a, amaute kungah, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; “Nouten kei na hing taisanta ua, tuazieh a ken zong tua Shishak khuta noute hing taisan ka hita, achi hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Israel lamkaite leh leengpa akingiemkhieh ua, “Mangpa khu adihtat ahi,” achi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa’n amaute akingaingiemta uh chi amu tahin, Mangpa thu Shemaiah kungah ahing tunga, “Aman, amaute akingaingiem tah ziehun ka sumang sih dinga, hinanleh hutkhiehna ka pe pai zaw ding hi. Ka thangpaina zong Shishak zangin Jerusalem tungah ka sungbaw sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh asuohte in apang ding uhi, tuachi’n kei nna asep u’leh gamdang leengte nna asep uh kibahlou dan athei ding uhi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Izipt leengpa Shishak in Jerusalem adou tah in, Mangpa biehinn leh leengpa inn a gou kikoikhawmte apomanga, Solomon in ana bawl sana lumte zong apomang siengta hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 10.16,17; 2 Khang. 9.15,16"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Rehoboam in tuate taangin sum-eng lumte abawl a, leengpa innpi lutna kotpi vengmi lamkaite azangsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Lengpa Mangpa bieh inn a ahaw chiengin, vengmiten tua lumte tawi in azui ua, tuazou chiengin vengmite umna inndan sungah akoi kia zel uhi."},"12":{"text":"Rehoboam akingngaingiem ziehin Mangpa lungthahna ama akipat in heimang in a um a, suhmang kilkel in aum sih hi, tuachi’n Juda gam ah sil apei hoitou zel hi."},"13":{"text":"Lengpa Rehoboam khu Jerusalem ah akisukip a leeng ahi zomtou zel hi. Rehoboam leeng a apan chiil lai in kum sawmli leh khat a upa ahia, Mangpa’n amin umna dinga Israel nam zousiete lah a kipat a atel tuom khopi Jerusalem ah kum sawm leh sagi vai ahawm hi. Tualeh anu Ammon mi ahia, amin Naamah ahi.","title":"Rehoboam shina (1 Leeng. 14.21-22 , 29-31)"},"14":{"text":"Rehoboam in Mangpa sui dinga lungtang asiemphatlou ziehin, sil gilou abawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rehoboam vaihawm sunga siltung zousiete abul apat atawp dong, guolnei Shemaiah laibu leh guolnei Iddo khangthu gelna laibu ah akigiel hilou ahiei mah? Tualeh Rehoboam leh Jereboam kikal ah kidouna aum tawntung hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rehoboam apu apate kungah a imuta a, David khopi ah akivui hi; tualeh ama thahengin atapa Abijah leeng in apang hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jeroboam vaihawm kum sawm le gietna kum in Abijah Judate tungah leeng in apang hi.","title":"Abijah Juda leengpa ahina: Jeroboam toh kidouna (1 Leeng. 15.1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem ah kum thum sung vai ahawm a, anu min Maakah ahia, Gibeah mi Uriel tanu ahi. Abijah leh Jeroboam kikaal ah kidouna a um leng hi."},"3":{"text":"Abijah galkap kidou dan siem leh hangsan ngen tul zali toh kidouna phuol ah akuonta hi, tualeh Jeroboam in zong galkap kidou siem mi leh hangsan ngen tul za giet toh ama dou dingin pan mun akhaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Abijah khu Ephraim singtang gam a Zemaraim muol tungah adinga, “Jeroboam leh Israelte zousie aw, hing na ngai khie un;"},"5":{"text":"Mangpa Israelte Pasian in, Israelte tunga leengpa hina David leh ahah asuonte kungah chi a thuhun in kumtawn ding in apieh ahi chi theilou na hi uoi mah?"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Nebat tapa Jeroboam David tapa Solomon nasemte lamkaipa, apu tungah ahelta a."},"7":{"text":"Mi lungsim sie, namanlou pawlkhat ama nua zui in akikhawm ua, Solomon tapa Rehoboam kal in apang uhi. Khum hun lai in Rehoboam anaupang nalai a, thukhentat dan asiem nai sih a, tualeh amaute nang dingin ahatzou nai sih hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tuin nouten David hahle suonte khuta um Mangpa leenggam dal na tum uhi; Galkap tampi zong na hi ngut uh a, tualeh Jeroboam in noute pasiente hi dinga ang bawl pieh sana bawngnou limte zong na kung uah aum nalai hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa siempute, Aaron tapate leh Levite delmangin gamdangte bawl dan a, nouma siempu a kibawl tawm hilou nahi uoi mah? Mi khat poupou hing pei a bawngtal guol khat leh belamtal sagi ahiei toh akisiensuo pouleh Pasian tah hilou bawlthu pasien te siempu a pang mai hilou uh amah?"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh koute adingin Mangpa khu ka Pasian uh ahi a, Ama ka taisan ngai sih uhi. Mangpa nasem a pang siempute khu Aaron hahlesuonte ahi ua, Leviten amaute apanpi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Zingmawng leh nitah lam tengin amauten Mangpa mai ah halmang sillalte leh gimnamtuite alan ngitnget uhi; dawkan siengthou tungah, tanghou siengthou aguol guol in akoi zel uhi; nitah lam tengin sana thaumei tunna a thaumeite ade kuong zel uhi. Mangpa ka Pasian uh thupieh ka nit zing uhi, hinanleh nouten ama na taisanta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ngai un, Pasian in koute ahing umpi a, Ama ka lamkaipa uh ahi hi. Ama siempute zong noute dou a, kidouna pengkul mut ding ahi uhi. Israel mite aw, Mangpa na pu leh pate uh Pasian dou sih un, na lawching tuom sih ding uhi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Jeroboam in anua lam uah guhtan dingin mi akuolin akoi dapa, ama uh Judate mai lam ah a um ua, aguh a buh pawl anua lam uah a pang sah hi."},"14":{"text":"Judate kinuahei a a et u’leh, anua lam u’leh amai lam uah ahing douta uh chi amu uhi. Tuachi’n amaun Mangpa ahanta ua, siemputen pengkul amut uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judate galdouna kikou in ahing kikou zoi zoi tah un, Pasian in Jeroboam leh Israelte zousie, Abijah leh Judate mai ah aguollel sahta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel mite khu Judate masangah ataijahta ua, Pasian in Judate khut sungah Israelte apeta hi."},"17":{"text":"Abijah leh amiten amaute tungah manthaina nasatah atun ua, Israel galhat-hangsan ngen tul zanga ashi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuami tungin Israelte zawin aumta ua, Judate pen Mangpa apu leh pate uh Pasian tunga kinga ahi man un suhatin aum uhi."},"19":{"text":"Abijah in Jeroboam anuadel a, ama a kipat in akhopite, Bethel leh akho neute, Jeshanah leh akho neute tualeh Ephron leh akhoneute alahpieh hi."},"20":{"text":"Jeroboam in Abijah dam sungin thahatna anei zou nawn sih hi. Mangpa’n atungah khut aha a ashita hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Abijah pen ahat deudeu a, zi sawm leh li anei a, tapa sawmni leh ni leh tanu sawm leh guh anei hi."},"22":{"text":"Abijah vaihawm sunga siltung dangte asil bawlte leh athugente guolnei Iddo laibu ah akigiel hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Abijah apu leh pate kungah a imuta a, tualeh David khopi ah avuita uhi. Ama thahengin atapa Asa leeng in apangta hi. Ama vaihawm sungin gam sung pumpi kum sawm sung galmuongin aum hi.","title":"Abijah shina leh Asa leenga panna (1 Leeng. 15.7-12)"},"2":{"text":"Asa in Mangpa a Pasian mitmu in sil hoi leh adih abawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Gamdang pasien maitamte leh mun sangte asubei a, suong milimte a satguoi a, Ashera songlaite aphua hi."},"4":{"text":"Apu apate uh Mangpa Pasian sui ding leh adanthute leh athupiehte zui dingin Judate thu apie hi."},"5":{"text":"Juda gam khopite zousie akipat in mun sangte leh gimnamtui halna maitamte alamang sienga, ama nuoi ah aleenggam galmuongin a um hi."},"6":{"text":"Gam in galmuonna nei ahitah manin Juda gam a kulpinei khopi abawl a, Mangpa’n ama galmuong a aum sah ziehin, tua hunlaiin koima toh akidou sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Aman Juda mite kungah, “Tam khopite ilam ding ua, akimkot ah kulbangte in i imkhum ding ua, innsangte, kotpite leh akalnate ibawl ding uhi. Mangpa i Pasian isui ua, Ama isui zieh un aman zong mun chinteng ah tawldamna ahing peta hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n alamta ua, alawching zel uhi."},"8":{"text":"Asa in Juda nam apat galkap lum leh teipi tawi thei tul za thum anei a, Benjamin nam akipat in lum tawi leh thal kapmi tul zani leh tul sawmgiet anei hi; abawn un mihat leh galhangsan ngen ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ethiopia mi Zerah galkap maktaduoi khat leh sakolleng za thum toh amaute dou dingin ahing kuon a, Mareshah tandong ahing tung hi.","title":"Zerah tunga Asa guolzawlna (2 Khang. 16.8)"},"10":{"text":"Asa zong amau’toh kidou dingin akuonkhie a, Mareshah kunga Zephathah phaijangah panmun a khaw uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Asa in Mangpa a Pasian ahan a, akung ah, “Mangpa aw ahatte dou dinga hatna neiloute panpi dingin nang loungal koima a um sih hi. Mangpa koute Pasian aw, Hing panpi in, nangma tunga kinga leh na min suonga, galkap hizapi dou dinga hing kuon kahi bou uhi. Mangpa koute Pasian na hi. Mihingin kizousah vawt sin,” achita hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Asa leh Judate masangah, Ethiopia mite tungah akhut aha a, Ethiopia mite ataijahta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Asa leh agalkapten Gerar dong anuadel ua, Ethiopiamite aguollel seng tah ziehun apang thei nawn sih uhi. Mangpa leh agalkapte mai ah totchilin aum ua, Judaten galvanlah tampi apokhie uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Gerar kimvel a khoneute zousie asumang sieng uhi, aziehpen Mangpa zauna chizatna in amaute amanta hi. Tua khoneute ah galvan lah atam seng seng a, tuate akipuohmang siengta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ganchingte giehphuolte zong abulu ua, belamhon, kel hon leh sangawngsaute akaimang uhi. Tuachi’n Jerusalem ah akinuale kiata uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Obed tapa Azariah tungah Pasian hagau ahing tunga.","title":"Guolnei Azariah in avauhilna (1 Leeng. 15.16-22)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Azariah Asa kimupi dingin akuon khie a, akungah, “Asa leh Juda leh Benjaminte zousie in, ka thu na ngaikhie un. Mangpa lam a na pan u’leh ama zong noute lam ah apang dinga, Ama na sui u’leh na mu ding uhi, hinanleh ama na taisan u’leh aman zong noute ahing taisan ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen hun sawtpi sung Israelte Pasian dihtah neilou, hil ding mi siempu neilou leh dan neilou in a umta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh amangbat hun chieng ua, Mangpa Israelte Pasian lam a akihei ua, Ama asui chiengun, amaute mu in aum hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua gam a tengte zousie apum buoi gawp zieh un, khum hun lai in, apawtdoh ding leh ahing lut dingin hamuonna aum sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian in amaute mangbatna chintenga asuh buoi ziehin, Nam khat in nam dang, tualeh khopi khat in khopi dang, simmaw in asusie uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh noute pen kisuhat unlen, na nasep uh tawpsan sih un, azieh pen na sepman uh mu ding na hi uhi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Asa in tam thute leh Obed tapa guolnei Azariah thugenlawhte azah tahin akisuhangsan a, Juda leh Benjamin gamsung pumpi apat leh Ephraim singtang gam a khopi neute akipat in milim kidahhuoite a paimanga, tualeh Mangpa biehinn him mai a, Mangpa maitam asiemtha kia hi.","title":"Asa nuoi a kisiemphatna (1 Leeng. 15.13-15)"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Judami leh Benjamin mite leh alah ua teng Ephraim, Manasseh leh Simeon namte ahankhawm hi. Amauten Mangpa a Pasian in Asa a umpi chi amutahun, Israel gam akipat in mi tampi in ama kung ahing zuonta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute Asa vaihawm kum, akum sawm leh ngana, aha thumna ah, Jerusalem ah ahing peikhawm uhi."},"11":{"text":"Khumi tungin gallah sil a ahing puoh uh bawng za sagi leh belam leh kel tul sawm sagi Mangpa mai ah alan uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amauten alungtang zousie u’leh ahinna zousie u’toh Mangpa apu apate uh Pasian sui dingin, thuhun abawl uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa Israelte Pasian sui nuomlou pouma alien hiin aneu hitaleh, Numei hiin pasal hitaleh tha ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Thanuom tah a kikouna aw ging ngaitah toh, pengkul leh belamtal kii te mut ging toh Mangpa tungah kichiemna abawl uhi."},"15":{"text":"Alungtang zousie ua kichiem ahi zieh un, Judate zousie akichiemna thu uah lungnuom in akipah uhi. Kilawptahin Pasian asui ua, tuachi’n Ama, amaute muin a um hi."},"16":{"text":"Lengpa Asa in api Maakah zong, akidahhuoi Ashera songlai aphu ziehin Lengpanu ahina dinmun akipat aza kesah hi. Asa in tua asonglai phu aphua a, asatnen gawpa, kidron luipang ah ahal hi."},"17":{"text":"Aman Israel gamsunga kipat in mun sangte phietmang sieng sih nanleh, Asa in adamsung tengin Mangpa kungah alungtang zousie apie hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama leh apa’n ana latsa uh sana, dangka sildangte, aman Mangpa biehinn sungah apolut hi."},"19":{"text":"Asa vaihawm kum, akum sawm thum leh ngana tandongin kidouna aum nawn sih hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Asa vaihawm kum sawmthum leh guhna kum in Israel leengpa Baasha Juda gam dou ding in ahing kuontou a, Juda leengpa Asa gam sunga koima lut leh pawt ding dalna in Ramah ah kulpi abawl hi.","title":"Asa hun nukhia lam (1 Leeng. 15.16-22)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Asa in Mangpa biehinn a gou koina leh ama leeng innpi a gou koina akipat in sana leh dangka aladoh a, Damaska a vaihawmpa Siria leengpa Benhadad kungah ahah hi."},"3":{"text":"“Aman Benhadad kungah: ka pa leh napa kikaal a lemna thuhun ana um bangin, kei leh nang kikaal ah zong lemna thuhum um hen. En in sana leh dangka kang hah hi. Israel leengpa Baasha in kei ang kihepmangsan theina dingin, amatoh kikaal a lemna thuhun na nei uh phel mai ve,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Benhadad in leengpa Asa thugen pha asah pia, Israel khopite dou dingin agalkap lamkaite asawlta hi. Amauten Ijion, Dan, Abel-Maim leh Naphtali gam a van koina khopite ava zou uhi."},"5":{"text":"Baasha in tam thu azah tahin Ramah alam atawpsan a, anasep akhawlsanta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Asa in Juda gam a mi zousie azawpi a, Baasha in Ramah khopi abawlna a azah sing leh suongte abawn in ava pomang ua, tuate zang in Geba leh Mizpah alam hi."},"7":{"text":"Khum hunlai in guolnei Hanani Juda leengpa Asa kungah ahing pei a, akungah; “Mangpa na Pasian tunga kingalou a, Siria leengpa tunga na kingah zawh ziehin, Siria leengpa galkapte na khut sunga kipat in asuohta ta uhi.","title":"Guolnei Hanani in Asa aphawhna"},"8":{"text":"Ethiopia leh Libiate galkap hon thupitah, sakolleng leh sakol tungtuongmi tampi neite ahi sih uh amah? hinanleh Mangpa na muon ziah in na khut ah ahing pe khie hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa mit khu ama tunga lungtang dihtah paw mite hatsah dingin leitung pumpi ah avah kawikawi hi. Mot huoi tahin sil nana bawlta a, tuaziehin tulang kalsie gal na nei zingta ding hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin Asa guolneipa tungah alungthahta a, alungthah seng ziehin guolneipa suongkul ah a khumta hi. Tua hunlai mama in Asa in mi pawl khatte nuoisie tahin abawlse nalai hi."},"11":{"text":"Asa vaihawm sung sil tungte abul apat atawp dong, Juda leh Israel leengte khangthu gelna laibu ah akigiel hi.","title":"Asa shina (1 Leeng. 15.23 , 24)"},"12":{"text":"Ama vaihawm kum sawmthum leh kum kuona ah Asa kengah natna khat ahing umta a, a natna pen ahing nase deudeuta hi, hinanleh aman anatna ziehin Mangpa asui tuom sih a, damdawi siemte a dong zawta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Asa apulepate kungah a imuta a, kum sawm li leh kum khat avaihawm kum in ashita hi."},"14":{"text":"David khopi a ama mama in abawl han ah avuita uhi, tualeh gimnamtui bawlmite gimnamtui leh lounamtui chituom tuom a dim lupna tungah asiel ua, ama zana in meikuong thupitah abawl uhi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama thahengin atapa Jehoshaphat leengpa in apang a, Israelte dou dingin ahing kisuhatta hi.","title":"Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat"},"2":{"text":"Aman Juda gam a khopi kulpinei zousie ah galkapte akoi a, Juda gam leh apa Asa in Ephraim gamsung a, khopi ana lahte ah zong galkapte akoi hi."},"3":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in achiil lai a apu David totna lampi azui ziehin leh Baalte thu adohlou ziehin, Mangpa’n ama a umpi hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh apa Pasian asui a, Israelte gamtat banga gamta lou in, Pasian thupiehte azui zaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n akhut ah lenggam asuhkip a; Judate zousie in Jehoshaphat kungah silpiehte ahing tawi uhi; tuachi’n hausatna leh pahtawina kiningchingtah angata hi."},"6":{"text":"Alungtang zousie toh kipezou tahin Mangpa lampi azui hi. Tuate gentahlouin, Juda gam akipat in mun sangte leh Ashera songlaite aphietmang hi."},"7":{"text":"Avaihawm kum thumna ah, Juda khopite a zilsah dingin ami liente, Ben-Hail, Obadiah, Zekariah, Nethaneel, leh Mikaiah asawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Amautoh Levimite, Shemaiah, Nathaniah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah leh Tob-Adonijah leh siempute Elishama, leh Jehoram te zong asawl khawm hi."},"9":{"text":"Amauten Mangpa dan laibu akeng ua, Juda gamsung zousie ah azil sah ua, Juda khopite zousie ah ava haw kawi kawi ua, mipite ava zilsah uhi."},"10":{"text":"Juda gam kimvel a leenggam zousie tungah Mangpa giinna ahing tunga, Jehoshaphat toh akidou nawn sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philistinte pawlkhat in sie dan in silpiehte leh dangka siate Jehoshaphat ahing puoh uhi. Tualeh Arabten zong ama a dingin belam leh kel hon ahing puoh uhi; tuate belamtal tul sagi leh za sagi tualeh kel tul sagi leh za sagi, apha hi."},"12":{"text":"Jehoshaphat ahing thahat semsem a, Juda gamsungah kulpite leh van koikhawmna khopite abawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Juda khopite ah neh leh taah tampi anei a, tualeh aman Jerusalem ah galdou siemsa mite zong akoi hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute aphung aphunga kisimna lai bu a min kikhumdan tambang ahi: Juda nam akipat tul tunga lamkaite; lamkai lienpen Adna amakaina nuoi ah galkap tul za thum aum hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh azomin galkap lamkai Jehohanan ahia ama nuoi ah galkap tul zani leh tul sawm giet a um hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh ama zom in Mangpa nasem dinga ama ut-thu a kipie Zikri tapa Amasiah ahi a ama nuoi ah galkap tul zani a um hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Benjamin nam akipat in galkap hangsan Eliada ahi a, thal leh lumte a kigalvon tul zani aum hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama zomin Zehozabad ahia, ama nuoi ah galdou dinga kimansa galkap tul za leh tul sawm giet aum hi."},"19":{"text":"Tamte in, Juda gamsung pumpi a kulpinei khopite a leengpa’n akoite simlou in leengpa vengin aum ngitnget uhi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Jehoshaphat in hausatna leh zatatna thupitah ahing neita a, zi leh ta a kineina tungtawnin Ahab toh kizopna ahing bawlta hi.","title":"Ahab leh Jehoshaphat pankhawmna (1 Leeng. 22.2-28)"},"2":{"text":"Kum bangza ahiei nua in, Samaria ah Ahab ve dingin ahaw suh a, Ahab leengpa’n Jehoshaphat leh azawpi mipite belam leh bawng tampi ana gaw a, tualeh Ramoth Gilead dou dingin ana dawp hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel leengpa Ahab in, Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat kungah, “Ramoth Gilead dou dingin nang kuontoupi diei?” chiin adong hi. Jehoshaphat in adawnga, “Kei leh nang tualeh ka mite leh na mite pum khat ihi uhi; galdouna kang doupi ding uh” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Jehoshaphat in Israel leengpa kungah, “Mangpa thu dong masa phot in,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa’n guolneite za li ahan khawm a, akung uah; “Ramoth Gilead dou dingin ka kuon ding uoi? ahisihleh ka khawlsan zaw ding uoi?” chi’n adongta hi. Amauten adawng ua, “Kuon in Pasian in leengpa khut ah tua gam hingpe ding ahi,” achi uhi.","title":"Ahab guolnei zuoute (1 Leeng. 22.5-12)"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Jehoshaphat in, “Tanah Mangpa guolnei idoh thei ding a um sih amah?” chiin adong hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel leengpa’n Jehoshaphat adawnga, akungah, “Mangpa hing doh pieh thei ding guolnei khat um nalai mah e, hinanleh ama ka huo hi, aziehpen aman ka tungtang thu ahoilam mawngmawngin agen ngai sih a, aselam ngen in agen hi; ama khu Imla tapa Mikaiah ahi,” achi hi. Tualeh Jehoshaphat in,” Lengpa’n tuabang na chi ding hilou ahi,” chiin adawng hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa’n ami liente khat ahan a, akungah, ‘Kintahin Imla tapa Makaiah hing zawpi in” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel leengpa leh Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat khu aleeng puontuol tuoh uh sil in, Samaria kotpi lutna kunga buphuol ah, aleengtoupha tuoh uoh atou uhi, Amaute gel mai ah guolnei zousie zong thumavang gen in aum uhi."},"10":{"text":"Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in sia in kiite abawl a tami Mangpa thu agen ahi, “Aman Siriate suhmangthai a aum masang sie uh tamte toh amaute na sun ziel ziel ding hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Guolnei dangte zousie in zong akibang in thumavang agen chiet ua, “Ramoth Gilead va dou inlen, va guolzou in. Mangpa’n leengpa khut ah tua gam ahing pe ding hi,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Mikaiah han dinga va kuon pa’n akungah, “Ngai vawi, guolnei dang tengin mi khat bang mai in leengpa lawchinna dingin ahoilam ngen in thumavang agen chiet uhi; tuaziehin nang zong amaute lah a khat bangin ahoilam in thu gen maiin” achi hi.","title":"Mikaiah thu mavang gen dihtah (1 Leeng. 22.13-28)"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Mikaiah in akungah, “Mangpa min sielin ka gen ahi, ka Pasian gen teng kagen ding ahi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama ahing tun tah in, leengpa’n ama adong a, “Mikaiah Ramoth Gilead dou dingin ka kuon ding uoi? ahisihleh ka khawlsan zaw ding uoi? achi hi. Aman adawnga, va kuontou unlen, va guolzou un, amaute na khut ah pieh ahi ding uhi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Lengpa’n akungah, “Mangpa min a thutah loungal bangma dang ka kunga hing hillou dingin bangza vei hing kichiem sah ding ka hiei?” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mikaiah in adawnga, “Israelte zousie aching ding umlou belamte banga, muol tunga kithethangin ka mu hi; Mangpa’n tam miten lamkai anei sih uh, tuaziehin michin lungmuong tahin a inn lam chiet uah pei chiet ta uheh,” achi hi.","ref":"Kisim. 27.17; Ezek. 34.5; Mat. 9.36; Mak. 6.34"},"17":{"text":"Israel leengpa’n Jehoshaphat kungah; “Aman kei tungtang thu ah ahoilam agenlawh ngai sih a, aselam ngen a genlawh ngitnget hi, chi’n kang hil sih amah?” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mikaiah in “Thu agenbe nalai a, Mangpa thu ngaikhie un, Mangpa aleengtoupha tunga tou a, aziet leh avei a van mipi zousie ding ka mu hi."},"19":{"text":"Mangpa’n Ramoth-Gilead dou ding leh khuna va shi dingin Israel leengpa Ahab koiin ahiei va zawl ding? achi hi. Khat in tambangin agen a, adang khat in, tua bangin agen hi, achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Atawpin hagau khat ahing pawtdoh a, Mangpa mai ah adinga, Ken ama ka zawl ding, achi hi. Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Bang zangin e, chiin adong hi."},"21":{"text":"Aman kava kuon dinga aguolneite zousie kam ah hagau zuouthei kava hi ding, achi hi. Mangpa’n ama na zawl zou ding hi. Va kuon inlen tuabangin va bawl in, achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, Mangpa’n tam na guolneite kam ah hagau zuouthei akoita hi, Mangpa’n nang a dingin sietna a guotsa ahita hi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in azuontou a Mikaiah maitang abeenga, “Mangpa akipat tua hagau nang hing houpi dinga kei akipat apawtdoh laiin heilang ah apei ei?” chiin adong hi."},"24":{"text":"Mikaiah in adawnga, “Inndan sungnung a kibu dinga na lut ni in thei na ve chin,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa’n thu apie a; “Makaiah man unlen khopi uhpa Amon leh leengpa tapa Joash kungah nua zawpi kia unlen;"},"26":{"text":"Lengpa’n tambangin agen hi; tam mipa suongkul ah khum unlen, damtah a ka hing kinuale kia masang sie’n, tanghou leh tui loungal bangma pe sih un, achi hi,” chi un, achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Mikaiah in “Damtah a nang kinuale kia pouma leh Mangpa’n keima zanga thu genlou hiva,” chiin aphuong hi. Tuachi’n “Nou mipite zousie aw ka thugen chiemte un,” achibe nalai hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa leh Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat, Ramoth Gilead ah akuontou ua;","title":"Ramoth Gilead kidouna leh Ahab shina (1 Leeng. 22.29-40)"},"29":{"text":"Israel leengpa’n Jehoshaphat kungah; “Kei kisiemlamdangin galphuol ah ka lut dinga, nang pen in na leeng puontuol silin,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Israel leengpa akisiemlamdanga galphuol sungah alutta hi."},"30":{"text":"Siria leengpa’n asakolleng hawl lamkaite thu apie a, “Israel leengpa chiloungal midang alien hiin aneu hitaleh koima kisatpi sih un,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Sakolleng hawl lamkaiten Jehoshaphat amu tah un “Israel leengpa hiva” achi ua, tuachi’n ama kisatpi ding in azuon ua, hinanleh akikoukhie a, Mangpa’n ama apanpi hi. Pasian in ama akipat in amaute aheimang paita hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua sakolleng hawl lamkaiten ama Israel leengpa ahisih chi atheitah un, ama adel nawnsih uhi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh koi ahiei khat in athal kuoi a amawh kap leh, Israel leengpa awmphaw kisuhtuona kaaltah ah akapkha a, tuatahin leengpa’n asakolleng hawlpa kungah, “Kihei inlen galphuol apat in hing pawtkhietpi in, kaliemta hi,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Khummi ni sun nitum in kidouna ahuoise mama a, Israel leengpa asakolleng tunga kingam in Siriate lam ngain nitahlam dongin a umdenta hi. Nitum kuon tahin ashita hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat Jerusalem a aleeng innpi ah damtah in akinuale kia tah in;","title":"Jehu in Jehoshaphat aphawhna"},"2":{"text":"Hanani tapa guolnei Jehu leengpa kimupi dingin ahing pawtdoh a, akungah, “Nang migilou panpi a, Mangpa mudate it ding na hiei mah? tuaziehin Mangpa thangpaina na tungah a umta hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh nangma ah silhoi bangza ahiei a um hi, aziehpen gamsunga kipat in Ashera songlaite na paimanga, Pasian suina lam ah na lungtang na koi ziehin,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Jehoshaphat Jerusalem ah atenga, tualeh Beersheba apat Ephraim singtang gam dongin mipite zousie kungah ava haw kia a, Mangpa apu apate uh Pasian lam ah amaute apui kia hi.","title":"Jehoshaphat in Pasian biehna abawlphatna"},"5":{"text":"Aman Juda gamsunga kulpinei khopi zousie ah, thukhen vaihawmte akoi chiet hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh aman vaihawm mite kungah, “Na silbawlte uh pilvang tahin ngaituo un, mihing a dinga thukhen vaihawm na hi sih ua, Mangpa a dinga thukhen vaihawm na hi zaw uhi. Thukhenna na bawl pouma chiengun, Aman noute ahing umpi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin Mangpa giinna na tung uah um hen, pilvangtah in thu khen un, aziehpen Mangpa i Pasian uah gitlouna aum sih a, mideisah tuomna leh golguhna zong aum sih hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Jehoshaphat in Jerusalem ah zong Levite, siempute leh Israel innkuonte lah a aphung sung ua upate, Mangpa dan dungzui a vaihawm ding leh thubuoite khen dingin mi akoi hi."},"9":{"text":"Aman amaute kungah “Tam thupiehte apie a, Mangpa giinna toh muonhuoitah leh lungtang hoibukimtah in nna sem un."},"10":{"text":"Atenna khopite ua kipat a, na gammi hipite ua kipata thubuoi pouma sisan suona thu hitaleh, dan leh thupieh thu hitaleh, thuguot leh vaihawmna thu hitaleh ahing kitut pouma, Mangpa tunga khiellou dingin, amaute na vauhil ding uh ahi. Tuabanga na bawl sih u’leh, Ama thangpaina noute leh na sanggamte uh tungah ahing tungkha ding hi. Tami bawl un, na khiel sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa toh kisai thu zousie ah, siempu lien Amariah, noute tungah vaihawm ahi dinga, tualeh Lengpa toh kisai thu zousie ah Ishmael tapa Zebadiah, Juda nam lamkaipa khu noute tungah vaihawm ahi ding hi, tualeh Leviten zong noute mai ah u lien hina toh nna asem ding uhi. Hangsan tahin gamta unlen, asem hoite Mangpa’n umpi tahen,” achi hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tamte nuain Moabmite leh Ammon mite’n Meun mite pawl khat toh Jehoshaphat tunga galbawl dingin ahing kuon uhi.","title":"Moabten Juda gam ahing sim uh"},"2":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat ahing pei ua, Jehoshaphat kungah, “Nangma hing dou dingin galkaphon tampi, tuipi gal Asiria gam akipat in ahing kuon uhi, tuin Hazazon Tamar (tua khu En-gedi ahi) mun ah a umta uhi,” chi’n ava hil uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoshaphat apatau mama ta a, Mangpa thu doh ding atum chinten a, Juda gamsung zousie ah ann ngawl ding thu aphuongta hi.","title":"Jehoshaphat thumna"},"4":{"text":"Juda gam a mite zousie Mangpa akipat panpina sui dingin ahing peikhawm ua, Ahi, Mangpa sui dingin Juda gam khochin akipat ahing pei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoshaphat khu Juda leh Jerusalem mipi kikhawmte lah ah, Mangpa biehinn huong leituol tha mai ah adinga,"},"6":{"text":"“Mangpa kapu ka pate uh Pasian aw, Nang vantunga um Pasian hilou na hiei mah? Nang namte leenggam zousie tungah vai na hawm a, silbawl theina leh thahatna na khut ah aum a, koiman ahing nang zou sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Koute Pasian aw, na mi Israelte masanga tam gam a tengte notdoh a, na lawmpa Abraham hahlesuonte kunga kumtawn a ama ua dinga na pieh hilou ahiei mah?","ref":"Isai. 41.8; Jak. 2.23"},"8":{"text":"Amaute tam gam ah atengta ua, na min dingin tam gam sungah munsiengthou khat a lam ua;"},"9":{"text":"Ka tung ua tuohsietna: namsau a vaihawmna ahiei, natna hipi ahiei ahisihleh kiel ahiei, ahing tun a ahileh, na umna, na min pua tami biehinn mai ah kang ding ding ua, chimaw in na kungah ka hing ki kou ding ua, na ngaikhe dinga, nang hundam ding hi achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin tanah Ammon, Moab leh Seir muol a kipan mite a um uhi. Israelte Izipt akipan a ahing pei lai un, agam uh dou dingin Israelte na phal sih hi, tuachi’n amaute apat akiheimang ua, asumang sih uhi.","ref":"Danp. 2.4-19"},"11":{"text":"Tuin ang thuh dan uh en in, goutan dinga na hing pieh gam akipat nawdoh tum in ahing kuon uhi."},"12":{"text":"Koute Pasian aw, amaute tunga gawtlou ding na hiei mah? Aziehpen koute dou dinga hing kuon tam galkaphon tampi maituo dingin kouten hatna ka nei sih ua, bang law ding ahiei chi zong ka thei sih uhi, hinanleh nangbou ka hing mit suon uhi.”"},"13":{"text":"Juda mite zousie, a zi atate u’leh ata neute utoh khum mun a Mangpa mai ah ading uhi."},"14":{"text":"Levimi Asaph hahlesuon Mattaniah tapa, Jeiel tapa, Benaiah tapa, Zekariah tapa Jehaziel, tua mipi kikhawmte lah a adin lai in Mangpa Hagau atungah ahing tung a:","title":"Jahaziel manga Jehovah dawnna"},"15":{"text":"“Aman leengpa Jehoshaphat leh Juda leh Jerusalem a tengte zousie aw na ngai un, Mangpa’n na kung uah tambangin agen hi; tam galkap hon tampite ziehin zau sih unlen, lungke vawt sih un, aziehpen kidouna noute a ahi sih a, Pasian a ahi zaw hi.","ref":"Danp. 20.1-4"},"16":{"text":"Zing chiengin amauh dou dingin kuon suh un. Amaute Ziz muol a hing kaltou ding ahi ua, Jeruel gamdai gamgaw mai a luita tawpna lam ah amaute na mu ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tam kidouna ah noute dou a akuul sih ding panmun khaw unlen, kip tahin ding unlen, Mangpa’n hundamna ahing pieh ding khu en un, Juda leh Jerusalemte aw zau sih unlen, lungke vawt sih un. Zing chiengin amaute tuoh dingin kuonkhie un, Mangpa’n hing umpi ding ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 14.13,14"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoshaphat amai a tuol suin akun a, Juda leh Jerusalem mite zousie zong Mangpa mai ah bohkhupin Ama abie uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levimite a kipat kohath mite leh Korah mite pawl adingtou ua, Mangpa Israelte Pasian aw ngaitahin aphat uhi."},"20":{"text":"Zingmawng matahin Tekoa gamdai zuon in akipan khie uhi. Akipat khieh laitah un Jehoshaphat ading doh a; “Juda leh Jerusalem mite aw hing ngaikhie un, Mangpa na Pasian uh muong un, tuachi’n na dingdet ding ua, aguolneite gingta un, tuachi’n na lawching ding uhi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Mipite toh akithumu zouin Jehoshaphat in, galkap honte masanga peikawm a Mangpa sienthouna thupi mama zieh a, amai a lasa ding leh ama phat ding mite aguot a, “Mangpa phat un a itna kumtawn a um ding ahi ziehin,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuabanga amauten la sah leh phat ahing pat tah un, Mangpa’n Juda gam dou dinga hingkuon Ammonte Moabte leh Seir muol a tengte, aguh a buh a dou ding akoi a, amaute zaw in a umta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ammon mite leh Moab miten Seir muol a tengte sumang ding leh suchimit ding in ading khie uhi. Seir muola tengte athagam nua un, amauh kisumangthai tuo dingin akidou kia leu leu uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Juda mite gamdai kimu suhna galvenna innsang lam zuon a ahing peilai un, tua galkap hon tampite agal et ua, ngai vawi, lei lah a mishi luong lum phengphung ngen a mu uhi. Asuohta mawngmawng aum sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoshaphat leh amite gallah sumte pawdingin ahing kuon ua, mishi luongte lah a kipat in galvan leh puonsil leh sil manpha tampi a puoh senglou uh amu uhi. Gallah sum atam seng senga, ni thum sung vingveng akhop tham uh aching hi."},"26":{"text":"Ani li niin amaute Berakah phaijang ah akikhawm ua, tuanah Mangpa aphat uhi. Tuaziehin tua mun khu tuni dongin Berakah phaijang akichi hi.","title":"Guolzou a Jerusalem a akilekiana uh"},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoshaphat lamkai nain, Juda mite zousie leh Jerusalem khuo a tengte zousie kipahtahin Jerusalem ah akinuale kiata uhi. Aziehpen Mangpa’n amaute amelmate uh tungah kipahtahin a umsahta hi."},"28":{"text":"Amaute Jerusalem ah alut ua, kaigingte, gawsemte leh pengkul ging toh Mangpa biehinn ah apei uhi."},"29":{"text":"Mangpa’n Israelte adingin agalte uh adoupieh hi chi azah tah un, gamdang leenggam zousie tungah Pasian giinna atungta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n a Pasian in kil chintenga tawldamna apieh ziehin, Jehoshaphat leenggam sung galmuongin aumta hi."},"31":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in Judate tungah vai ahawm a, Lenga apan chiil lai in kum sawmthum leh kum nga ahia, Jerusalem ah kum sawmni leh kumnga sung vai ahawm hi. Anu min Azubah ahia, Shilhi tanu ahi.","title":"Jehoshaphat vaihawmna nukhia lam (1 Leeng. 22.41-50)"},"32":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in apa Asa lampite azui a, tuate apielsan ngai sih a, Mangpa mitmuin sildih abawl hi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh mun sangte phietmang ahisih a, mipiten zong apu apate uh Pasian langah alungtangte uh a awnsah sih uhi."},"34":{"text":"Jehoshaphat vaihawm sunga siltung dangte abul apat atawp dong, Israel leengte khangthu gelna, Hanani tapa Jehu laibu ah akigiel hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahun nukhia lam in Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat in Israel leengpa Ahaziah gitlouna a kheltah a gamtapa khu akizoppita hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n summet bawlna tembaw hon khat bawlkhawm dingin thukimna abawla, Tamte zou in amaun Ezion-Geber ah tembawte abawl uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mareshah aum Dodavahu tapa Eliezer in Jehoshaphat kalin thumavang agen a, “Ahaziah toh kizopna na bawl ziehin Mangpa’n na silbawlsate sumang ding ahi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n tembawte akisie a, summet bawlna dingin tuitungah apei theita sih uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoshaphat apu apate kungah a imuta a, David khopi ah apulepate kungah akivuita hi. Ama thahengin atapa Jehoram leeng in apang hi.","title":"Juda leengpa Jehoram (1 Leeng. 8.16-24)"},"2":{"text":"Jehoram pienpi sanggamte, Jehoshaphat tapate anei a: Azariah, Jehiel, Zekariah, Azariah, Mikael leh Shephatiah: tamte zousie Juda leengpa Jehoshaphat tate ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Apa un amaute kungah silpieh tampi, sana, dangka leh sil manphate leh Juda gam a khopi kulpi neite apie hi. Hinanleh Jehoram pen ata upapen ahi ziehin leenggam apie hi."},"4":{"text":"Jehoram in apa leenggam ahing tanga, ahing kisuhdet tah in, asanggamte zousie namsauin athat sieng a, tualeh Israel gam a miliente pawlkhat zong athat hi."},"5":{"text":"Jehoram leenga ahing pan chiil lai in, kum sawm thum leh kumni a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum giet sung vai ahawm hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman Ahab tanu zi a anei ziehin, Ahab innkuonte leh Israel leengte lampite a zui hi. Aman Mangpa mitmu in silgilou abawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n David toh thuhun ana bawltah zieh in, Mangpa’n David leh ahahasuonte kunga mei vah khat apieh ut ziah in, David khanggui asumangthai ut sih hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 11.36"},"8":{"text":"Jehoram vaihawm sungin Juda tungah Edom ahel a, aleengpa ding uh akibawlta uhi.","title":"Gamdangte hing hel patna (2 Leeng. 8.20-22)","ref":"Siem. 27.40"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoram, amiliente leh a sakolleeng zousie toh khunah ava kuon a, Edom miten ama leh a sakolleng hawl lamkaite ana imkuol khum ua, hinanleh ama zankhang lai in athou khie a, Edom mite adouta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Edom mite tuni dongin Judate tungah ahel ngitngetta uhi. Tua hun laima in Libnah zong Juda tungah ahel hi. Aziehpen Jehoram in Mangpa apu apate Pasian ataisan zieh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Aman Juda gam muol tungte ah mun sangte alam a, Jerusalem mite kizua sah a Judate alampiel sah zieh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Jehoram in guolnei Elijah akipat in laihah khat amu a, tambangin: na pa David Mangpa Pasian in thu agen hi. Na pa Jehoshaphat leh Juda leengpa Asa lampite na zui sih hi.","title":"Elijah thuvai hah"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel leengte lampite na zui zaw a, Juda leh Jerusalem mite Ahab bawl bangin amaute ki zua dingin na lampiel sahta hi.
