Na sanggamte mama, na pa innkuonsung mite, nang sanga mi hoizawte nangawn na that hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin Mangpa’n na mite, na tapate, na zite leh na nei-nalam zousie tungah gentheina gihtah hing tungsah ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nangma mama in zong sung natna damtheilou na nei dinga, na natna zieha ani ani a gilzam zousie alawtkhiet bei masangsie in,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa’n Jehoram dou dingin Ethiopiamite toh kinai a teng Philistin mite leh Arab mite lungsim atohthouta, hi.","title":"Arabte leh Philistinten Juda gam adouna"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten Juda gam ahing sim ua, abulu ua, leengpa innpi sunga um vante zousie leh atapate leh azite nangawn toh apomang siengta uhi. Atapa tumpen Ahaziah loungal atapa dangte khat beeh zong anuasie sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tam silte zousie nuain Mangpa’n Jehoram sunglam natna damtheilou in agawtta hi."},"19":{"text":"Hun hing pei zela, akum nina bei tahin, anatna ziehin agilzamte alawtkhie a, genthei tahin ashita hi. Amiten apu apate abawl bangun, ama zatatna tumphuolpi mei atawpiehta sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ama leenga apan chiil lai in kum sawm thum leh kum ni a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum giet vai ahawm a, koima henla louin ashita a, David khopi ah akivui a, hinanleh leengte han ah aki vui sih hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem miten Jehoram tapa tumpen Ahaziah apa thahengin leeng in apang sahta uhi. Aziehpen Arabmite toh hing kuonkhawm galsim mite, agiehphuol ua hing lutten Jehoram tapa upa zawte zousie athat siengta uhi. Tuachi’n Jehoram tapa Ahaziah Judate leengpa’n apangsah ua vai ahawm panta hi.","title":"Ahaziah Judate leengpa a apanna (2 Leeng. 8.24-29 ; 9.21-29)"},"2":{"text":"Ahaziah leenga apan chiil lai in kum sawmni leh ni a upa ahia, Jerusalem ah kum khat sung vai ahawm hi. Anu min Athaliah ahia, Omri tanu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ahaziah in zong Ahab innkuonte lampi azui a, aziehpen sil dihlou bawl dingin anu’n ama athusawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman Ahab innkuonte mabangin Mangpa mitmuin silgilou abawl hi, Aziehpen apa shi nuoin amaute asietna dinga thuhilmite ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aman athuhilnate uh azui a, Ramoth-gilead ah Siria leengpa Hazael dou dingin Israel leengpa Ahab tapa Joram toh akuon khawm a, khunah Siriaten Joram ana liem sahta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siria leengpa Hazael toh akidouna a, Ramah khuo a liemna atuoh ziehin Jezreel ah kisudam dingin akile kiata hi. Tualeh Juda leengpa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah zong Ahab tapa Joram damlou zieh a vave dingin Jezreel ah ahaw suh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahaziah in Joram ava vena ziehin Pasian in Ahaziah tungah sietna atung sahta hi. Ahaziah ahing tuntah in, Nimsi tapa Jehu dou dingin Joram akuonkhie ua, Jehu pen Ahab innkuon sumang dinga Mangpa’n sathau anusa ahita hi."},"8":{"text":"Jehu in Ahab innkuonte tunga gawtna thukhenna atut laiin, Juda gam miliente leh Ahaziah nasem a unaute amukhie a, athatta hi.","title":"Jehu in Juda miliente athana (2 Leeng. 10.12-14)"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahaziah sui dingin akuon a, a miten Samaria khuo a akibutna mun ah ava manta uhi. Jehu kungah ahing zawpi ua, athat ua, avuita uhi. “Amauten ama pen alungtang zousie toh Mangpa suipa Jehoshaphat tapa ahi” achi uhi. Tuachi’n Ahaziah innkuon sungah leenggam vaihawmna thaneina nei koima a um nawn sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahaziah nu Athaliah in atapa ashita chi amu tahin, Juda leeng innkuon pumpi sumangthai dingin akipanta hi.","title":"Athaliah leh Joash (1 Leeng. 11.1-21)"},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa Jehoram tanu Jehoseba in Ahaziah tapa Joash, tha dinga um leengpa tapate lah akipat agudoh a, ama leh nau donnu lupna pindan sung ah aphuol hi. Aziehpen leengpa Jehoram tanu, Ahaziah sanggamnu Jehoseba khu siempu Jehoiada zi ahi a, amanu’n Athaliah apat in naupang Joash aphuola, tha in a um kha sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Athaliah in tua gam a kum guh vai ahawm sung sie in, Pasian biehinn ah amaute toh Joash phuol in aum denta hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Akum sagina kum in Jehoiada ahing kisuhat a, galkap zakhat tunga lamkaite, Jeroham tapa Azariah, Jehohanan tapa Ishmael, Obed tapa Azariah, Adaiah tapa Maaseiah leh Zikri tapa Elishaphat te toh thuhun abawl hi.","title":"Joash Judate leenga apanna (2 Leeng. 11.4-12)"},"2":{"text":"Amauten Juda gam sung zousie atuon suoh ua, khopite a kipat in Levite leh Israel innkuonte lah a upa pente, ava khawm ua, Jerusalem ah ahing tung uhi."},"3":{"text":"Mipi kikhawmte zousie in Pasian biehinn ah leengpa toh thuhun abawl uhi. Jehoiada in amaute kungah; “Ngai un, Mangpa’n David hah lesuonte tungtanga ana chiemsa mabangin, leengpa tapa pen leengpa a apan ding ahi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.12"},"4":{"text":"Na bawl ding u’khu tami ahi: Nou siempute leh Levite, Khawl nia nasepna tangte sethum suo se khat kotkhapi ngah in pang unlen;"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh sethum suo sekhat leengpa innpi ah na um ding ua, sethumsuo sekhat dangte pen kulpi kotpi ah na um ding uhi, tualeh mipi zousie Mangpa biehinn huong sungah a um ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Nasem a um siempute leh Levite chi loungal koima Mangpa biehinn sung alut ding uh ahi sih hi, amaute pen akisusiengthou ahi zieh un alut thei ding uhi, hinanleh midangte pen Mangpa’n veng dinga aguotna mun aveng ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Levite leengpa kimkot ah aum ding ua, mi chin in a galvan atawi chiet ding ua, koipou biehinn sunga hing lut pouma tha ding ahi. Lengpa peina tengah, akung nai ah um zing un,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levimite leh Judamite zousie in Siempu Jehoiada in thu apieh dungzui in abawl ua, mi chin in khawl ni a lut ding leh pawt ding ami chiet uh akipui uhi, aziehpen siempu Jehoiada in apawl pawl a nasepna atawpsah nai sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu Jehoiada in galkap zatel tunga lamkaite kungah, Mangpa biehinn sunga um, leengpa David neisa teipite lum lien leh neute ape chiet hi."},"10":{"text":"Tambangin Jehoiada in mi zousie leengpa kimkot ah maitam kung leh biehinn kim a, amauh pan mun dinga aguotna mun chiet ah, akhut ua galvan tawi kawm chietin akoi hi. Biehinn simlam panga kipat amallam dongin apang uhi."},"11":{"text":"Jehoiada leh atapaten leengpa tapa Joash ahing puidoh ua, leenglukhu akhusah ua, theipina thuhun kiteikhie khat apie ua, leengpa ahi chin aphuong kheta uhi. Ama sathau anu ua, “Lengpa damsawt hen,” chiin akikouta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Athaliah in mipite tai duomduom leh leengpa kipahpina husa azah tahin, Mangpa biehinn sunga mipite kungah ava haw hi.","title":"Athaliah kithana (2 Leeng. 11.13-16)"},"13":{"text":"Amanu’n a et leh biehinn lutna a Sutpi kungah leengpa adinga, miliente leh pengkul mutte leengpa kungah aum uhi, tualeh gamsung mipite zousie akipah ua, pengkulte amut uhi, lasa miten tumgingte toh thuoin phatna ma akai uhi. Tuachi’n Athaliah in apuonsilte abotkeh a, “Phielguhna phielguhna,” chiin akikou hi."},"14":{"text":"Siempu Jehoiada in galkap za tunga lamkaite asawlkhie a, akung uah, “Mipite kikaal akipat Athaliah hing puidoh unlen, amanu zui pouma namsau in that un,” achi hi. Aziehpen siempuin amanu “Mangpa biehinn sungah that sih un,” anachi zouta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa inn zotna sakol kotkha lutna mun ahing tuntahin Athaliah aman ua, tua mun ah athatta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoiada in ama leh mipite leh leengpa kikaal ah Mangpa mite hiding chiin thuhun khat abawl hi.","title":"Jehoiada lamkaina a halna tung (2 Leeng. 11.17-20)"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite zousie akuon ua Baal biehna inn asuchim ua, amaitamte leh milimte asat guoi ua, tua maitamte mai ah Baal siempu Mattan athat uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoiada in, Mosi dan laibu a kigiel bang a, kipahtah a lasa kawm a, David in Mangpa biehinn a Mangpa kunga halmang sillatte lan dinga ana guot siempu Levimite khut a David in thu ana pieh dungzui a Mangpa biehinn kepna nasep siempute khuta ana koi ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Aman sienthoulouna nei mi pouma asunga alut louna dingin Mangpa biehinn kotpite ah kotkha vengmite zong akoi hi."},"20":{"text":"Aman galkap za tel tunga lamkaite leh miliente, mipi tunga vaihawmte tualeh gamsunga mipi zousie azawpi a, Mangpa biehinn akipat in leengpa apuisuh uhi. Amaute kotpi sahta zaw tawn in leengpa innsung ah alut ua, leengtoupha tungah leengpa atousah uhi."},"21":{"text":"Gamsung mipite zousie lungnuom in akipah mama uhi. Athaliah tha a aumtah ziehin khopi sung zong adai a, asipta hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joash leenga apan chiillai in kum sagi a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmli sung vai ahawm hi. Anu min Zibia ahi a, Beersheba mi ahi.","title":"Joash leenga panna (2 Leeng. 12.1-8)"},"2":{"text":"Siempu Jehoiada damsung teng Joash in Mangpa mitmu ah sildih abawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Jehoiada in amapa zi ni aneisah a, tapate leh tanute anei hi."},"4":{"text":"Hun bangtan ahiei nua in, Joash in Mangpa biehinn puophat ding lungsim ahing neita hi."},"5":{"text":"Aman siempute leh Levite ahankhawm a, akung uah, Juda gam a khopite ah “Vahaw unlen, na Pasian uh biehinn puophatna dingin, Israel mite zousie kum chin a apieh ding uh sumte va dongkhawm un, tu mama in bawl pai un,” achi hi. Hinanleh Leviten abawl pai sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin leengpa’n siempu lienpen Jehoiada ahan a, akungah, “Bangzieh a Mangpa suohpa Mosi leh Israel kikhawmpiten theipina biehbuh a dinga sie sum apieh ding ua kiguotsate, Juda gam leh Jerusalem akipat dongkhawm dinga Levite phutlou na hiei,” achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 30.11-16"},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen tua numei gilounu Athaliah tapaten Pasian biehinn asuseta ua, Mangpa inn adinga kilan siengthou sate nangawn Baalte a dingin ana zang siengta uhi, achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Lengpa thupiehin sumbawm khat abawl ua, Mangpa biehinn kotpi ah akoi uhi.","title":"Biehinn puophatna (2 Leeng. 12.9-16)"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda gamsung pumpi leh Jerusalem ah, Pasian suohpa Mosi in gamdai a, Israelten apieh chiet ding ua aphut sie sum Mangpa a dinga hing tawi dingin thuphuon khat akibawlta hi."},"10":{"text":"Miliente zousie leh mipite zousie in kipahtahin amauh thaw dingte ahing tawi ua, tua sumbawm sungah adim masang sie’n akhie uhi."},"11":{"text":"Leviten leengpa miliente kunga, tua sumbawm ahing puohlut pouma chiengun, tualeh sum tampi aum chi amu chiengun leengpa laigielpa leh siempulienpa nasempa ahing pei ua, tua sumbawm asuokhie ua, akoina mun ngai ah akoi kia zel uhi. Ni sim in hichibangin abawl ua, sum tampi akhonkhawm uhi."},"12":{"text":"Lengpa leh Jehoiada in, Mangpa biehinn puophat kul bang banga nasem mite kung leh, Mangpa biehinn lamtha kia dinga kiguoi suongkheng siemte leh singbawl siemte, tualeh Mangpa biehinn siemphatna dinga sia leh sum-eng khengsiem mite kungah apie uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n nasem miten kukal tahin nna asem ua, azouta uhi, tualeh Pasian inn angaima bangin atungding kia ua, asuhat ta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Na sep azaw siengtah un, sum val teng leengpa leh Jehoiada kungah ahing tawi ua, tuate in Mangpa biehinn ading vanzahte abawl uhi. Tualeh halmang sillata zah ding sana leh dangka akibawl bel leh kuongte zong abawl uhi. Tuachi’n Jehoiada damsung sie in Mangpa biehinn ah halmang sillalte alan ngitnget uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuin Jehoiada ahing upata a, ateh mama ta hi, kum za leh sawmthum aphah in ashita hi.","title":"Siempu Jehoiada shina leh anua a siltungte"},"16":{"text":"Pasian leh abiehinn a dinga Israelte lah a anasep hoite ziehin, David khopi ah, leengte lah ah avui uhi."},"17":{"text":"Jehoiada shi nua in, Juda miliente ang pei ua leengpa kung ah zana ahing pie ua, tuachi’n leengpa’n athu uh ana ngaikhie hi."},"18":{"text":"Amauten Mangpa apa apate uh Pasian biehinn nuasie in Ashera songlaite leh milimte abeta uhi. Tambanga akhelnate zieh un Juda gam leh Jerusalem tungah Mangpa thangpaina ahing tungta hi."},"19":{"text":"Mangpa’n amaute akung a nua pui kia dingin, mipite kungah guolneite sawl in, amauten akhelnate uh theisah nan u’leh zong, angaikhe nuom sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa hagau siempu Jehoiada tapa Zekariah tungah ahing tungta hi. Zekariah, mipite masang ah adinga, akung uah, “Tami Pasian thugen ahi, Bangdinga nouten Mangpa thupiehte zuilou na hi uoi? Na lamzang sih ding uhi, Ama na taisantah ziehun, Aman zong noute ahing taisanta hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 23.35; Luk. 11.51"},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh ama kalin thu adap phiel ua, leengpa thupieh in Mangpa biehinn huongsung ah ama suongin aseplumta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Leengpa Joash in, atunga Zekariah pa Jehoiada hepinate athei ngitnget sih a, atapa athatta mawh hi. Zekariah in ashi ding kuon in “Mangpa’n tami mu henlen, phuba lata hen,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, kum bei kuon in Siria galkapte Joash dou ding in ahing kuon ua, Juda gam leh Jerusalem ahing sim ua, mipi lamkaite athatta uhi. Tualeh a gallah sumte zousie uh, Damaska a leengpa kung ah ahahta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Siria galkapte tawmnoukhat hing kuon hinanleh zong, Mangpa’n amaute khut sung ah atam zaw, tham galkap honte apie hi. Aziehpen Juda in Mangpa apu apate uh Pasian ataisan zieh ua, Joash tunga gawtna tung ahi."},"25":{"text":"Siriate anuakia tah un, Joash zong nasatah a liem in anuasie uhi. Ama miliente mama in, Jehoiada tapate phuba lahna in atungah thu aphielgu ua, alupna tungah athatta uhi. Tuachi’n ashita a, David khopi ah akivui a, hinanleh leengte han ah akivui sih hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama tunga thu phielgute khu tamte ahi uhi. Ammon numei Shimeath tapa Zabad leh Moab numei Shimrith tapa Zehozabad, ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joash tapate tungtang thute leh, ama tungtang genlawhnate, Pasian biehinn alamtha thute leengte khangthu kigelna laibu ah akigiel hi. Ama thahengin atapa Amaziah leeng in apang hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amaziah leenga apan chiil lai in kum sawmni leh kum nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmni leh kuo sung vai ahawm hi. Anu min Jehadin ahi a, Jerusalem mi ahi.","title":"Judate leengpa Amaziah (2 Leeng. 14.1-2)"},"2":{"text":"Aman Mangpa mitmu in sildih abawl a, hinanleh alungtang zousie toh abawl sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Aleenggam ama thuneina nuoi a sudet ahi tahin, apa that amiliente athat hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh atapate uh athat sih a Mosi dan laibu a kigiel bangin, tate zieh a pate ashi ding ahi sih a, “Pate zieh a tate zong ashi ding ahi sih hi, hinanleh michin ama khelna zieh a ashi ding ahi, chi a Mangpa thupieh bangin agamta zaw hi.”","ref":"Danp. 24.16"},"5":{"text":"Amaziah in Juda gam mite ahankhawm a, Juda leh Benjamin mite zousie adingin ainnkuon uh tul tungah leh za tungah galkap lamkai abawl hi. Tuachi’n aman kum sawmni apat atunglam zousie asim a, galdouna a pang thei, teipi leh lum zang thei, galkap tul za thum apha hi chi amu hi.","title":"Edom mite toh kidouna"},"6":{"text":"Aman dangka sia talent za khat in, Israel akipat galdou siem mi tul zakhat zong aguoi nalai hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian mi khat akungah ahing haw a, “Lengpa aw, Israel apat a hing kuon galkapte nangtoh kuon khawm sih uheh, aziehpen Mangpa’n Israelte a umpi sih a, Ephraim mi khat beh zong umpi lou ahi."},"8":{"text":"Kidouna ah hangsantahin pang nanlachin zong Pasian in na melmate masangah ahing guollel sah veve ding hi, azieh pen Pasian in panpi theina leh guollel sah theina, thahatna anei hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaziah in Pasian mipa kungah, “Israel galkapte ka goina talent za khat ka pieh bang chita ding adiei?” chiin adong hi. Pasian mipa’n adawnga “Mangpa’n tua sanga tamzaw hing pethei ahi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amaziah in Ephraim akipat a hing kuon galkapte atawp sah a, ainn lam uah apei sahta hi. Tuachi’n amaute Juda tungah alungthah mama ua, thangpai tahin innlam ah anua peita uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amaziah akisuhat a, agalkapte chi phaijang ah azawpi suh a, khunah Seir mi tul sawm athat hi."},"12":{"text":"Juda galkapten zong mi tul sawm ahingmat ua kawltung khat ah azawpi ua, asawnkhie ua, tuachi’n abawn un akitat guoi dimdem uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuahunsung mama in, Amaziah in kidouna, apansah utlou a, anua sawl kia galkap honten Juda khopite, Samaria akipat Beth-Horon dong ana bulu ua, mi sangthum athat ua, gallah sum tampi apomang uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amaziah Edommite that zou a ahing kinuale kia tahin, Seir mite pasiente ahing puo a, ama pasiente dingin atunga, amaute bie in akun a, amasang uah gimnamtuite ahal hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amaziah tungah Mangpa lungthahna akuongta a, akungah guolnei khat asawl a, aman: “Na khut a kipata amauh mite mama bawn hundoh theilou mite pasiente bangdinga thu dong mawngmawng na hiei?” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuabanga thu agenzinglai in, leengpa’n akungah, “Leengpa thuhil dingin nang koi hing guot ahiei? tawp in, bang dinga satpua a um ding na hiei mah?” achi hi. Tuachi’n guolneipa atawp a, hinanleh akungah, “Tam sil na bawl zieh leh kang thuhilna na ngaikhieh utlou ziehin, Pasian in nang hing suhmang tum chinten ahi, chi ka thei hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda leengpa Amaziahin ama thuhil mite, akikuppi nua in, Jehu tupa Jehoahaz tapa Israel leengpa Jehoash kungah tambanga phinna thu ahah a, “Hing pei inlen kimaituo in hing kimupi in,” achi hi.","title":"Judate leh Israelte kidouna (2 Leeng. 14.8-14)"},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel leengpa Jehoash in Juda leengpa Amaziah kungah, “Lebanon a lingkungin, Lebanon a sidar sing kungah, ka tapa zi dingin na tanu hing pie in achi a, tuazou in Lebanon gamsa hang khat ahing pei a, lingkung khu atuonchilta hi."},"19":{"text":"Ngai in, Edommite ka zouta na ki chi a, na lungsim in na ki uongsah a, na kisathei hi. Hinanleh inn ah um khin khian in; Bangdinga buoina ngen a nangma leh Juda gam sietna ding sui a kitahla na hiei?” chi in mi asawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Amaziahin angaikhe nuom sih hi. Aziehpen Edommite pasiente abiehtah zieh ua, amelmate uh khuta, apieh khieh theina dinga, Pasian in tuabanga ana bawl ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel leengpa Jehoash in adouta hi. Ama leh Judate leengpa Amaziah, Juda gam a Beth-Shemesh ah akimaituo uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte mai ah Judate aguollelta ua, michin ainn lam chiet uah ataita uhi."},"23":{"text":"Israel leengpa Joash in Juda leengpa Amaziah, Joash tapa, Jehoahaz tapa Beth-Shemesh ah aman a, Jerusalem ah ahing zawpi a, Jerusalem kulbang Ephraim kotpi akipat aninga kotpi dong tong za li vel a sau asat chim hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa biehinn sunga um amu pouma sana leh dangka zousie leh um leh bel zousie akempa Obed-edom pum in, amankhawm a, tualeh leengpa inn sunga gou umte leh ami matte zong apokhawm a, Samaria ah aki nuale kiata hi."},"25":{"text":"Juda leengpa Joash tapa Amaziah, Israel leengpa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash shi nua in kum sawm leh kum nga adam nalai hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaziah vaihawm sunga siltung dangte, abul apat atawp dong, Juda leengte leh Israel leengte khangthu gelna laibu sungah akigiel hilou ahiei mah?"},"27":{"text":"Amaziah in Mangpa akiheisan akipat in amiten Jerusalem ah ama aphielgu ua, ama Lakish ah atai hi. Hinanleh Lakish tandong ama nuadel ding mi asawl ua, tuanah athatta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama khu sakol in ava nua puoh kia ua, Juda khopi a apu leh pate kungah avuita uhi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda mipite zousie in kum sawm leh guh a upa Uzziah apui ua, apa Amaziah mun ah leengpa in abawlta uhi.","title":"Juda leengpa Uzziah (2 Leeng. 14.21-22 ; 15.1-3 , 5-7)"},"2":{"text":"Lengpa Amaziah apu apate kunga a imut nua in Uzziah in Eloth alamtha kia a, Juda gam a dingin alakia ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Uzziah leenga apan chiil lai in kum sawm leh guh a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga leh kum ni vai ahawm hi. Anu min Jakoliah ahi a, Jerusalem mi ahi."},"4":{"text":"Uzziah in apa Amaziah bangin, Mangpa mitmu ah sildih abawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian giindan ama hilpa Zekariah damsung in Uzziah in Pasian asui a, Mangpa asui sung tengin Pasian in ama lawchinna apie hi."},"6":{"text":"Uzziah akuondoh a, Philistinte ava dou a, Gath, Jabneh leh Ashdod kulbangte ava satchim hi. Tuachi’n aman Ashdod gam leh Philistinte lah ah khopite alamtha hi.","title":"Kidouna a Uzziah guolzawna"},"7":{"text":"Pasian in ama, Philistinte leh Gur-bal a teng Arabte leh Meun mite lah ah apanpi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ammon miten Uzziah kungah Sie apie ua, tuachi’n athahat mama tah ziehin, aminthanna in Izipt gamgi dong azel hi."},"9":{"text":"Uzziah in Jerusalem ah, Aning a kotpi ah, Guom kotpi leh kulpi bang kawina ning kiu te ah innsang alam a, kulbangin a imkhum nalai hi."},"10":{"text":"Gamdai ah inn sangte alam a, tuikhuh te atou hi, aziehpen aman muolbulte leh phaijang ah ganhon tampi anei hi. Muoltungte leh Karmel ah lou bawl mite leh grep huonte kem ding mi zong akoi hi. Aziehpen ama loubawl lam a lunglut mi ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Uzziah in galdou dan kizil siemsa galkapte ahon hon a kuondoh thei dinga mansa zong anei hi. Tuate atam dan uh dungzui in, laigielpa Jeiel leh vaihawmpa Maaseiah in, leengpa galkap lamkai Hananiah thupieh dungzui a a sim detdet uh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Aphung sung upa pente u’lah a, galdou thei mihat hangsan chiet tul ni leh zaguh apha uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute lamkaina nuoi ah kidou dinga chiilsiemsa galkap pawl tul za leh tul sagi leh zanga a um uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Uzziah in galkapte zousie a dingin, lumte, teipite, sia lukhute, awmphawte, thalpite leh suong kapna ding sailite, abawlpieh hi."},"15":{"text":"Aman Jerusalem ah, khutsiemte bawl thalkap dohna ding leh suongtumte khiehkhumna ding, khawlte innsang tungte leh kulbang ning kiute ah akoi hi. Tuachi’n gam pumpi ah aminthangta hi, aziehpen ama thahat tah ahing hi masang sie in, panpina nasatah pieh in aum hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Uzziah ahing hat mama tah in, ahing kisatheita a, alungtang kisahtheina in apuana atun hi. Aziehpen Mangpa a Pasian tungah amuonhuoita sih a, gimnamtui halna maitam tunga, gimnamtui hal dingin, Mangpa biehinn sungah alut ta hi.","title":"Uzziah khelna"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu Azariah in, Mangpa siempu hangsan dang sawm giette toh ama azui lut uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amaun leengpa Uzziah adal ua, akungah, “Uzziah, Mangpa mai a gimnamtui hal ding nang tanvou ahi sih hi. Tam pen Aaron hahlesuon siempute, gimnamtui hal dinga kisiensuote bawl ding ahi bou hi, munsiengthou akipat pawtdoh in, na gamta khielta hi. Mangpa Pasian in nang hing zatat bawl nawn lou ding ahi,” achi uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 30.7,8; Kisim. 3.10"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Uzziah akhut a gimnamtui halna belkuong tawisa a, haldinga mansa a umlai, alungthahta hi. Mangpa biehinn sunga, gimnamtui halna mai a, siempute tunga, alungthah laitah in, atalpang ahing phata hi."},"20":{"text":"Siempu lienpen Azariah leh siempu dangte zousie in ama a et u’leh, atalpang ah phahna aumta chi amu ua, tuachi’n ama apawtdoh sah pai uhi. Mangpa’n a gawt tah ziehin ama zong kintah a pawtdoh a utta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Uzziah ashi dongin apha a, aphah tah ziehin inn tuom ah atenga, Mangpa biehinn a kipat puse ahita a, tuachi’n atapa Jotham in leeng innpi angah a, gamsung mite vai ahawm piehta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Uzziah vaihawm sunga siltung dangte abul akipat atawp dong, Amos tapa guolnei Isai in agiel hi."},"23":{"text":"Uzziah apu apate kungah a imuta a, leengte kivuina mun ah, amaute kung nai ah akivui hi, amaun, ama khu “Aphah ahi” achi zieh uh ahi. Tuachi’n atapa Jotham ama thahengin leeng in apangta hi.","ref":"Isai. 6.1"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jotham leeng a apan chiil lai in kum sawmni leh kum nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm leh guh sung vai ahawm hi. Anu min Jerusha ahi a, Zadok tanu ahi.","title":"Juda leengpa Jotham (2 Leeng. 15.33-38)"},"2":{"text":"Jotham in apa Uzziah bawl bangin, Mangpa mitmu ah sildih abawl a, hinanleh apa bawl bangin, Mangpa biehinn ah alut ngai sih hi. Hinanleh mipiten silhoilou lam ngen abawl nalai lai uhi."},"3":{"text":"Jotham in Mangpa biehinn kotpi sahta zaw abawltha a, tualeh Ophel kulbang tungah zong inn tampi alam be hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Juda singtang gamte ah khopite alam a, gammang lah ah zong kulte leh innsangte alam hi."},"5":{"text":"Jotham in Ammon mite tungah gal abawla, amauh azou hi. Tuami kum in Ammon miten ama kungah dangka sia talent zakhat mangbu bu, atena kor tul sawm leh barli bu atena kor tul sawm apie uhi. Akum nina leh akum thumna ah zong tuazama apie uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa a Pasian mai a alampite abawlphat zieh in Jotham ahing thahat deu deuta hi."},"7":{"text":"Jotham vaihawm sunga siltung dangte, agaldouna zousie leh siltung dangte, Israel leh Juda leengte khangthu gelna laibu sungah akigiel hi."},"8":{"text":"Jotham leenga apan chiil lai in, kum sawmni leh kum nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm leh guh sung vai ahawm hi."},"9":{"text":"Jotham apu apate kungah a imuta a, David khopi ah akivuita hi. Atapa Ahaz in amun alua a, leeng in ahing pangta hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahaz leenga apan chiil lai in kum sawmni a upa ahia, Jerusalem ah kum sawm leh guh vai ahawm hi. Hinanleh apu David bangin Mangpa mitmuin sildih abawl sih hi.","title":"Juda leengpa Ahaz (2 Leeng. 16.1-20)"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen aman Israel leengte umdan azui a, Baalte biehna dingin sunthaw milimte abawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Aman Hinnom tapa phaijang ah kithoinate ahal a, Mangpa’n Israelte mai a anawdoh namte chindan kidahhuoi zui in, atapate mei a, hallumin kithoina abawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Muoltungte ah mun sangte leh singbawhpha nuoi chinteng ah, kithoinate alan a, gimnamtuite ahal hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa a Pasian in ama, Siria leengpa khut ah ape khie a, Siriaten ama azou ua, amite tampi sal in apuimang ua, Damaska khopi ah apuitung uhi. Tualeh Israel leengpa khut sungah zong piehkhiet in aum a, Israelten zong amite tampi athat uhi.","title":"Ahaz leh Pekah kidouna (2 Leeng. 16.5 , 6)","ref":"2 Leeng. 16.5; Isai. 7.1"},"6":{"text":"Ni khat sungin Remaliah tapa Pekah in Juda gam ah galkap tul zaleh tul sawmni athat hi. Juda gam in Mangpa apu apate uh Pasian ataisan tah zieh uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Ephraim mite lah a galdou hangsan khat Zikri in leengpa tapa Maaseiah leh leengpa innsung a vaihawm lien Azrikam leh leengpa zom a lienpen Elkanah athat hi."},"8":{"text":"Israelten a unaute uh Juda numei leh atapate u’leh atanute uh tul zani galhing in aman uhi, tualeh gallah vante tampi zong ala ua, Samaria ah apuo uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa guolnei khat khunah aum a, amin Obed ahi, Samaria a hing kinuale kia galkapte dawn dingin akuonkhie hi. Aman akung uah, “Mangpa napu napate uh Pasian Judate tunga alungthah ziehin Aman amaute na khut sung uah ahing pekhie hi, tualeh nouten thangpai tah in amaute na that ua, tua khu van ah atungta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuin Juda leh Jerusalem numeite leh pasalte suoh leh sal a bawl na sawm uhi, hinanleh noute ngel zong Mangpa na Pasian uh tunga khelna nei hilou na hi uoi mah?"},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin ka thu ngaikhie unlen, na unaute uh sal a na matte uh hadoh kia un, aziehpen Mangpa lungthahna zauhuoi tah na tung uah aum hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ephraim mite lah a lamkai pawl khat, Jehohanan tapa Azariah, Meshillemoth tapa Berekiah, Shalum tapa Jehizkiah leh Haldai tapa Amasa ten galdouna mun akipat a hing tungte ana maituo ua, akung uah;"},"13":{"text":"“Na salmatte uh tam mun a na hing tut lou ding uh ahi; Mangpa mai a isuhkhelnate ban ah, ikhelnate leh ibawlsietnate belap na tum nalai uh amah? Aziehpen i khelnate uh alien sengta a, Israelte tungah Ama lungthahna zauhuoitah aum hi,” achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkapten miliente leh mipi kikhawmte mai ah asalmatte u’leh agallah vante uh anuasieta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Amin a kihan a nasep ding kiguotte adingdoh ua, salmatte azawpi ua, gallah vante lah a kipat puonsilte ala ua, guohtang a umte a silsah ua, kedap abun sah ua, neh leh dawn ding leh kizutdamna ding damdawi apie uhi, ahatlou leh azawngkhalte zousie sabiltung tungah apuo ua, Tumsing khopi Jerikou ah, a unaute u’kungah ava nua koi kiata uhi. Tuachi’n Samaria ah akinuale kiata uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuami hun lai in leengpa Ahaz in Asiria leengpa kungah panpina ngen dingin mi asawl hi.","title":"Edomte leh Philistinten Judate adouna"},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen Edom mite ahing kuon kia ua, Juda gam ahing dou ua, sal in apuimangta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Philistinten zong mun ngiem gam leh Juda simlam gam a khopite ahing sim ua, Beth-Shemesh, Aijalon Gederoth, Sokoh leh akimvel a akhoneute toh, Timnah leh akimvel a akhoneute toh, tualeh Gimzo leh akim vela akhoneute toh, ala ua, khunah atengta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Israel leengpa Ahaz ziehin Mangpa’n Juda gam asungiemta hi; aziehpen aman Juda gam gitlouna gasuo in aum sah a, Mangpa tungah muonhuoilou in a um sahta hi."},"20":{"text":"Asiria leengpa Tilgath Pileser akungah ahing haw a hinanleh panpina pieh nahsangin ahing subuoi zaw hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahaz in Mangpa biehinn akipat leh leengpa innpi a kipat leh amiliente inn akipat in silte ala khawm a, Asiria leengpa kungah apie hi, hinanleh ama adingin aphatuom sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Lengpa Ahaz alungkham a abuoi hun chiengin Mangpa tungah amuonhuoi maw semsem hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama nuoisie Damaskate pasiente mai ah kithoinate alan hi. “Aman Asiria leengte pasienten amauh apanpi zel a, tuaziehin kei zong ahing panpi na ding un, akung uah ka kithoi ding hi,” achi hi. Hinanleh amaute ama leh Israelte zousie sietna ahing hi zawta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ahaz in Pasian biehinn sunga kipat in, vanzah bel leh kuongte zousie alakhawma asat guoi sieng a, Mangpa biehinn kotpite akha a, Jerusalem kholai ning kawi chinteng ah maitamte adaw hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Juda gam a khopi chintengah, pasien dangte mai a kithoina gimnamtui halna dingin mun sangte abawla, tuachi’n Mangpa apu leh pate Pasian alungthah sahta hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama vaihawm sunga siltung dangte leh agamtatna zousie abul akipat atawp dongin, Juda leh Israel leengte khangthu gelna laibu sungah akigiel hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ahaz apu apate kungah a imuta a, Jerusalem khopi ah avuita uhi. Hinanleh Israel leengte han sungah asiel sih uhi. Atapa Hezekiah in amun aluo a leeng in apangta hi.","ref":"Isai. 14.28"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekia leenga apan chiil lai in kum sawmni leh kum nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmni leh kum kuo vai ahawm hi. Anu min Abijah ahi a, Zekariah tanu ahi.","title":"Hezekiah Judate leenga apanna (2 Leeng. 18.1-3)"},"2":{"text":"Aman apu David in ana bawl zousie bangin Mangpa mitmu ah sildih a bawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Aman avaihawm kum, kum khatna, hakhatna ah, Mangpa biehinn kotkhate ahonga, abawlpha hi.","title":"Hezekiah nuoi a halna tung (2 Leeng. 18.3-7)"},"4":{"text":"Siempute leh Levi mite ahing puiluta, suolam panga mun jang ah akikhawm sah hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute kungah, “Hing ngaikhie un, Nou Levimite aw tuin kisiensuo unlen, Mangpa na pu napate uh Pasian biehinn siensuo un. Tualeh mun siengthou a kipat kisuhbua na silte zousie sumang sieng un."},"6":{"text":"I pu ipate ana muonhuoi sih ua, Mangpa i Pasian uh mitmuin silgilou ana bawl ua, Ama ana taisanta uhi. Mangpa tenna mun akipat amaitang te uh alengatsah ua, Ama anua ngatsanta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Biehinn kotkhate akha ua, meivahte amit sahta uhi. Tualeh Israelte Pasian kungah, gimnamtuite ahal nawn sih ua, munsiengthou ah halmang sillatte zong alan nawn sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin Juda tung leh Jerusalem tungah Mangpa lungthahna atungta a, na mit ua na mu bangun, aman amaute khu buoina chizatna leh enghouna dingin apekheta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tamte zieh in ahi ipu ipate uh namsau a ana puana u’leh itapate leh itanute u’leh izite uh suoh leh sal a ana kimatna uh."},"10":{"text":"Alungthahna zauhuoi tahin eite ahing kiheimangsan theina dingin, tuin Israelte Mangpa Pasian toh thuhun bawl ka lungtang ah aum hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka tapate aw tuin ngaisah louin um sih un, Mangpa’n ama mai a ding ding leh ama bie a, anasem ding leh gimnamtuite hal dingin ahing tel ahi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam Leviten nna asem panta uhi. Amaute: Kohath mite akipat in, Amasai tapa Mahath leh Azariah tapa Joel, Merari mite akipat in, Abdi tapa Kish leh, Jehalelel tapa Azariah; Gershon mite akipat in: Zimmah tapa Joah leh Joah tapa Eden."},"13":{"text":"Elizaphan hahlesuonte akipat in: Shimri leh Jeiel, Asaph hahlesuonte akipat in: Zekariah leh Mattaniah."},"14":{"text":"Heman hahlesuonte akipat in: Jehiel leh Shimei; Jeduthun hahlesuonte akipat in: Shemiah leh Uziel."},"15":{"text":"Asanggamte uh akhopkhawm ua, akisiensuo zou tah un, Mangpa thu a leengpa thupieh dungzui in, Mangpa mun siengthou susieng dingin alut uhi."},"16":{"text":"Siempute Mangpa biehinn ah, susieng dingin alut ua, Mangpa biehinn sunga sil sienglou zousie Mangpa biehinn pulam ah alakhie uhi. Tuate khu Levimiten ala ua, kidron lui guom lam ah azawngdoh uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amaun hakhatna nikhat ni in siensuona nasep apan ua, tuami ha ni gietni in Mangpa innhim ah ahing tung uhi. Ni giet dang sungin Mangpa biehinn asiensuo uhi; Aha khatna ni sawm leh guh niin azou sieng uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Hezekiah kungah ava pei ua, anasep thu uh ava hil uhi: “Mangpa biehinn abawn in ka siengsahta ua, halmang sillatna maitam leh abel akuongte leh tanghou siengthou koina dawkan, leh avanzahte zousie toh ka siengsahta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Lengpa Ahaz, leenga apan lai a, amuonhuoilou zieh a, alah khiet bel leh kuongte zousie zong ka bawlpha ua, ka susiengthouta uhi. Tuate tuin Mangpa maitam mai ah a um siengta uhi,” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n azing ni zingmawng matah in leengpa Hezekiah in, khopi vaihawm liente ahankhawma, Mangpa biehinn ah apeitoupi hi."},"21":{"text":"Amauten leenggam a ding leh munsiengthou a ding leh Judate a dinga khelna sillat dingin, bawngtal sagi, belam nou sagi, belamtal sagi leh keltal sagi ahing kai uhi. Lengpa’n Aaron hahlesuon siempute kungah, Mangpa maitam tunga lan dingin thu apie hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n bawngtalte athat ua, siemputen asisan ala ua, maitam tungah athe uhi; tuamabangin belam talte athat ua asisan maitam tungah athe uhi, belam noute zong athat ua asisan maitam tungah athe uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh khelna sillat ding keltalte, leengpa mai leh mipi kikhawmte mai ah ahing kai ua, amaun atung uah akhutte uh anga uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n siemputen tua keltal sagite athat ua, Israel mi zousie adinga khelna tatdohna kithoina dingin, maitam tungah asisan un kilemna abawl uhi; aziehpen leengpa’n halmang sillat leh khelna sillat, Israel mizousie a dinga lan dingin thu apie hi."},"25":{"text":"Aman David leh leengpa guolnei Gad leh guolnei Nathan thupieh dung zui in, Mangpa biehinn ah Levimite, dah khutbehte, kaigingte leh pehgingte tawi in a umna mun chiet uah akoi hi, tambanga bawl khu aguolneite tungtawn a Mangpa thu pieh ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n David tumgingte tawi in Levite mansa in ading ua, siempute zong apengkulte uh tawi in ading uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hezekiah in maitam tunga halmang sillatte lan dingin thu apie hi. Tua halmang sillat akipat tahin, Pengkul gingte leh leengpa David tum gingte toh Mangpa phatna lasah zong akipan pai ngal hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi kikhawmte zousie Pasian bie in akuun ua, lasaten la asa ua, Pengkul mutten pengkulte amut uhi. Halmang sillatte akizaw masang sie in tambang biehna zousie apeitou zel hi."},"29":{"text":"Sillalte azaw tah un, leengpa leh akunga um mi zousie akhupdin ua, Pasian abie uhi."},"30":{"text":"Lengpa Hezekiah leh ami lienten, David leh guolnei asaph in aphuo uh Mangpa phatna lasa dingin Levite thu apie uhi. Tuachi’n amauten kipahtahin phatna la asa ua, alu uh kun in Pasian abie uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hezekiah in adawnga, “Tuin Mangpa adingin na kisiensuota ua, Hing pei unlen Mangpa biehinn ah, kithoinate leh kipah thugen na sillatte hing tawi un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n mipi kikhawmte kithoinate leh kipah thugenna sillatte ahing tawi ua, tualeh lungtanga kiphalna nei pouma in halmang sillatte ahing tawi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Mipi kikhawmten halmang sillat ahing tawite uh bawngtal sawm sagi, belamtal zakhat, belamnou atal zani apha hi. Tamte zousie Mangpa mai a, halmang sillat ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Kithoina dinga kisiensuo ganta zousie abawn in bawngtal za guh, belam leh kel tul thum apha hi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh tua halmang sillat zousie vun hawh dingin siempute atawm seng ua, tuazieh in a unaute uh Leviten, tua nasep akizaw masang sie in leh siempu dangte akisiensuo masang sie un apanpi uhi. Aziehpen kisiensuo thu ah siempute sangin Leviten sielepha theina siengtah toh agamta zaw uhi."},"35":{"text":"Halmang sillatte atam mama ban ah, lemna sillat sathaute leh dawn sillatte toh sim in sillat atam mama hi. Tuachi’n Mangpa biehinn a nasepna akisiempha kiata hi."},"36":{"text":"Pasian in mipite tambang silte thakhat a bawldoh thei dinga apanpi zieh in leengpa Hezekiah leh mipite akipah mama uhi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekia in Israel leh Juda gam sung pumpi ah thu ahah a, Ephraim leh Manasseh te kung ah zong lai ahah a, Mangpa Israelte Pasian kunga peikan pawi lopna mang dinga, Jerusalem a Mangpa biehinn a hing haw dingin chielna abawl hi.","title":"Peikan pawi bawl dinga kisahkholna","ref":"Kisim. 9.9-11"},"2":{"text":"Lengpa leh amiliente leh Jerusalem a kikhawmte’n ha nina a peikan pawi bawl dingin thupuana abawl uhi."},"3":{"text":"Kisiensuosa siempu kiching a umlou zieh leh mipiten Jerusalem a kikhopna aneilou zieh un ahun ngaina in pawi ana nei thei sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tam asil sawm uh, leengpa leh mipiten dih asa uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel gamsung pumpi, Beer-Sheba a kipat Dan tandonga mite Jerusalem a hing pei a, Mangpa Israelte Pasian kunga Peikan pawi lopna hing zou dinga hatna thuphuon bawl ding pha asata uhi. Aziehpen akigielsa dungzui in mi tampi in, hun sawttah tuabangin abawl nawn sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Lengpa thupieh bangin, laihah paw miten, leengpa leh miliente a kipat laihah khu, “Israel leh Juda gam sung pumpi a hawm dingin akuonta uhi. Laihah khu tambangin aki giel hi: ‘Israel mipite Asiria leengte khuta kipata suohta sun noute kunga, Mangpa Abraham leh Isaak leh Israel Pasian ahing kinua leh kia theina dingin, noute ama kunglam ah nuakia kia un."},"7":{"text":"Noute, na pu na pate u’leh na sanggamte uh bang sih un. Amaute pen Mangpa apu apate uh Pasian tungah ana muonhuoi tasih ua, Aman na mu bangun chizatna mite asuoh sahta hi."},"8":{"text":"Na pu napate uh bangin genha sih unlen, Mangpa kungah kitulut un. Aman kumtawn a dinga asiensuo sa, amunsiengthou ah lut un. Alungthahna zauhuoitah noute akipat akiheimang theina dingin Mangpa na Pasian uh nna sem un."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa kunga na hing kinuahei kia u’leh, na sanggamte u’leh na tate uh tungah, amauh sal a puite’n lainatna anei ding ua, tam gam ah ahing nuapei kia ding uhi; aziehpen Mangpa na Pasian u’khu hepisiem, leh lainatna hau ahi. Ama kunga na hing kinuale u’leh ahing kiheisan vawt sih ding hi.”"},"10":{"text":"Laihah pawte khu khopi chin ah aban ban in Ephraim leh Manasseh gam pumpi ah, Zebulun tandong in apei ua, hinanleh miten amauh ana engbawl ua, ana nuisan uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Asher leh Manasseh leh Zebulun mi lawikhatte akingiemkhieh ua Jerusalem ah ahaw uhi."},"12":{"text":"Juda gam ah zong, Mangpa thu a, leengpa leh miliente thupieh zui ding leh lungsim mun khat posah dingin Pasian khut mipite tungah a um hi."},"13":{"text":"Aha ni na ah, tanghou tolsawlou pawi lawm dingin mipi tampi Jerusalem ah apeikhawm uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amauten Jerusalem a maitamte ala doh ua, gimnamtui halna maitamte ahemkhe sieng ua, kidron luiguom ah apai siengta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Aha ni na ni sawm leh ni li ni in peikan belam nou agou uhi. Siempute leh Levite azumta ua, akisiensuo ua, Mangpa biehinn ah halmang sillatte ahing tawi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian mi Mosi dan laibu akigiel bangin amun chiet uh aluota uhi; Siempute’n Levite khut akipat alah uh sisante athe uhi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen mipi kikhawmte lah a mi tampi kisiensuo lou a um uhi, tuaziehin Mangpa a dinga susiengthou dingin, asiengthou michin a dinga peikan gan gaw mawpuohna Levimiten atang hi."},"18":{"text":"Ephraim, Manasseh, Issakar leh Zebulun akipata hing pei mi tampi kisusienglou hinan u’leh zong, akigielsa dan lou bangtahin peikan ankuong ane veve uhi. Hinanleh Hezekiah in amaute athum pieh a, “Mangpa hoi in michin hing ngaidamta hen;"},"19":{"text":"Munsiengthou dan a siengthoulou hinapi a, alungtang zousie utoh Mangpa apu apate uh Pasian sui mi pouma ngaidamta hen,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa’n Hezekiah thumna aza a mipite adam sahta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem a um Israel miten tanghou tolsawlou pawi ni sagi sung kipahtahin amang ua, tua hun sung tengin Levite leh siempute’n ni chin in, Mangpa kunga tumging toh la sain Mangpa aphat uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hezekiah in Mangpa nasep dan theisiem mama Levite kungah hanthawn na thute agen hi. Amauten tua pawi kibawl ni sagi sung lemna sillatte lan in; Mangpa apu leh pate uh Pasian kungah kipah thu gen kawm in apahtawi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Mipi kikhawmte zousie in, ni sagi dang peikan pawi belap dingin akithukim ua, tuachi’n ni sagi dang kipahtah in azang nalai uhi."},"24":{"text":"Lengpa Hezekiah in mipi kikhawmte a dingin, bawngtal tul khat leh belam leh kel tul sagi apie a, milienten bawngtal tul khat leh belam leh kel tul sawm apie uhi."},"25":{"text":"Juda kikhawmpite abawn un siempute leh Levite tualeh Israel akipat a hing kikhawmpite leh Israel gam a kipat a hing peite leh Juda gam a teng gamdang mite toh akipah mama uhi."},"26":{"text":"Israel leengpa David tapa Solomon hun akipat Jerusalem a tambanga kipahna Jerusalem ah aumkha ngai nawn sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempute leh Levi mite adingdoh ua, mipite a guolzawlta uhi; tualeh athumnate uh Atenna mun siengthou van a atun tou ziehin Pasian in aza hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam peikan pawi ahing bei tahin, tua mun a um Israelte, Juda khopite ah ahaw ua, suonga kibawl milimte asat guoi ua, Ashera sawl khuomte aphua uhi. Juda leh Benjamin gam leh Ephraim leh Manasseh gam sunga, munsangte leh maitamte aphietmang uhi. Tuate zousie asuh siet sieng nua un Israelte amauh khopite leh ama-uh gam ah akinuale kiata uhi.","title":"Milimte suhmangna (2 Leeng. 18.4)"},"2":{"text":"Hezekiah in siempute leh Levite apawl pawla kikhente kungah, michin anasep dan dungzui chiet un, siempute leh Levite halmang sillatte leh, lemna sillatte lan ding leh Mangpa tenna kotpite a nasem ding leh kipah thugen na leh phatna lasadingin aguot chiet hi.","title":"Biehna ding thawlawmte (2 Leeng. 18.5-7)"},"3":{"text":"Lengpa’n ama neisa akipat in, zingmawng leh nitahlam a halmang sillat ding leh khawlni a halmang sillat ding leh ha tha nite leh Mangpa danbu akigiel hunbi nei pawite adingin atan ding uh aguot pieh hi.","ref":"Kisim. 28.1—29.39"},"4":{"text":"Aman siempute leh Levite, Mangpa dan toh kisai a akipumpieh theina dingun ama uh tanvoute pie un, chiin leengpa’n Jerusalem a tengte kungah thu apie hi.","ref":"Kisim. 18.12,13,21"},"5":{"text":"Tuabang thupieh a um tahin Israelten aga masate uh, bute, zute, sathaute, khuoizute leh alou ua pieng gamasate ahing tawi ua, tualeh sil zousie a kipat sawm-a khat tampi ahing pie uhi."},"6":{"text":"Juda khopite ateng Israel mite leh Juda miten zong aganhonte u’leh abelamhonte ua kipat sawma khat tualeh, Mangpa a Pasian ua dinga sillat siengthoute apat in sawm a khat ahing tawi ua, a sekhawm ua, avum venvon mai hi."},"7":{"text":"Aha thumna a akoi khawm pat uh ahia, aha sagi na ah azou uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hezekiah leh amiliente ahing pei ua, tua sil kisievumte amu tah un, Mangpa aphat ua, ami Israelte aguolzawl uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hezekiah in tua sil kisievumte tungtang siempute leh Levimite adong hi."},"10":{"text":"Zadok innkuon a siempu lienpen Azariah in adawnga, akungah, “Mipiten athawlawmte uh Mangpa biehinn a, ahing tawi lut kalsie uh, neh leh tah kiching ka nei ua, aval zong aum nalai hi; aziehpen Mangpa’n amite aguolzawl a, tamzapi val nalai seusou ahi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hezekiah in, Mangpa biehinn sunga vankoina pindante bawl ding thu apie a, akibawlta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n gin umtah in athawlawmte uh, sawma khatte leh latsa silpiehte ahing polut uhi. Tam silte tungah Levi mi Konaniah enkoltu lamkai ahi a, tualeh a unaupa Shimei ama zom in apang hi."},"13":{"text":"Lengpa Hezekiah leh Pasian biehinn toh kisai a mawpuo milien Azariah in aguot, Konaniah leh asanggampa Shimei nuoi ah, Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Neromoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakiah, Mahath leh Beraiah te nasep enkaitu in apang uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh suolam kotpi vengpa Levimi Imnah tapa Kore khu Pasian kunga, kiphalna silpiehte kemtu leh Mangpa kunga silpieh kipete leh sil siengthou pente, hawmtu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ama nuoi ah Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah leh amauh nasep hun bang zel a aunaute alien aneu kunga apawl pawla gin umtah a tan hawmtute ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuate ban ah, khangthu gellutna laibute a, min kikhumte pasal kum thum akipat atunglam, amawpuohnate uh dungzui a, ni chin a, nasep ding poimaw nei a, apawldan dung zui ua, Mangpa biehinn a kuon zelte kungah zong ahawm uhi."},"17":{"text":"Khangthu gellutna a, innkuon kuon a minkhum siempute kungah ahawm ua, Levite kum sawmni apat atunglamte kungah zong amawpuohna dung zui u’leh apawl pawla kikhenna bangun, ahawm uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tam khangthu gelna laibute a, minkhumte zousie lah ah azite uh, atapate u’leh atanute uh zong atel hi, Amaute pen ginumtah a kisiensuote ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Khopi kim a lougam a teng, ahisihleh khopi dangte a teng Aaron hahlesuon siempute lah a pasalte leh Levite khangthu gelna laibu a, min khumte lah a atanvou uh hawm dingin, amin min a kilou in mi aguot uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hichibangin Hezekiah in Juda gam pumpi ah, Mangpa a Pasian mai ah sil hoi leh dih tualeh gin umna silte abawlta hi."},"21":{"text":"Mangpa biehinn a nasep silbawlna zousie leh danthu leh thupiehte zuina ah, Hezekiah in a Pasian maipha asui a, alungtang zousie toh asem a, alawching zel hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekia in muonhuoitah a abawl sieng nua in, Asiria leengpa Sennakerib ahing kuon a, Juda gam ahing lut a, khopi kulpi neite ama a dinga lah sawm in khopite kimkot ah abulu theina dingin panmun akhaw hi.","title":"Asiria leengpa Sennakerib in Juda gam asimna (2 Leeng. 18.17-35 ; 19.35-37 ; Isai. 36.2-20 ; 37.36-38)"},"2":{"text":"Sennakerib Jerusalem dou dingin ahing kuon chi Hezekiah in amu tah in,"},"3":{"text":"amiliente leh galkap lamkaite toh khopi pulam a tuinahte akipat tuite khahbing ding thu akikum ua, tuachi’n amaun apanpi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mi tampi akikhawm ua, gamsunga tuinahte leh luitate akhahbingta uhi. “Ama un bang dinga Asiria leengpa hing pei a, tui tampi mu ding ahiei?” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh ama akisuhata kulbang sietnate zousie asiemtha a, atungah innsangte alam hi. Kulbang umsa pulam ah kulbang dang alamthuo a, tua ban ah David khopi lei kisesangna mun luite abawl pha a, galvan leh lum tampi abawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman mipite tungah galkap lamkaite akoi a, khopi kotkhah bul a mun awng ah ama kungah amaute apuikhawm a, akung uah, hanthawn thu tambangin agen hi."},"7":{"text":"“Hattah leh hangsan tahin um un, Asiria leengpa leh akunga um galkap hon tampite zieh in zau sih unlen, lungke vawt sih un, aziehpen ama lam a pang sangin eilam a pang atam zaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama kunga um pen mihing banthahatna ahi a, hinanleh eite hing umpi a hing panpi ding leh igalte hing doupi dinga ikung ua um khu Mangpa i Pasian uh ahi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n mipite khu Juda leengpa Hezekiah thugen in, akingam sahta hi."},"9":{"text":"Khum nua in Asiria leengpa Sennakerib leh agalkap honte zousie in Lakish abulu laitah un, Sennakerib in Juda leengpa leh Jerusalem a um Juda mite zousie kungah, amiliente asawl a, akung uah;","title":"Sennakerib in Jerusalem mipi asuhzau tupna (2 Leeng. 18.17-25)"},"10":{"text":"“Asiria leengpa Sennakerib in tambangin agen hi: Koi muonga Jerusalem lah ding gingta lou a um nalai na hi uoi?"},"11":{"text":"Hezekiah in, Asiria leengpa khut akipat in “Mangpa i Pasian in hing hundoh nava achi laiin, gilkiel leh dangta a shi dinga hing kimuongkhiel sah ahi bou hi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tam Hezekiah mama in, amunsangte leh amaitamte phietmangin, Juda leh Jerusalem a tengte kung ah, “Maitam khat mai ah Pasian na be ding ua, atungah gimnamtui na hal ding uh ahi, chi’n thu ahing pie hilou amah?”"},"13":{"text":"Kei leh ka pu leh paten gamdang mite zousie tunga bang ahiei ka bawl uh, theilou na hi uoi mah? khum gam a namte pasien ten ka khuta pat in amauh ahunkhe thei ngel uoi mah?"},"14":{"text":"Ka pu leh paten ana suhmang siengsa namte, pasiente lah ah koi ahiei, ka khut a kipata amite a hunkhe thei ngai ei, noute Pasian in zong ka khut akipat nou ahing hunkhe zou tuom ding amah?"},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin Hezekiah in hing solbawl sih henlen, tam bangin hing sol lungdam sih heh, tualeh ama zong gingta sih un, aziehpen koima nam pasien leh koima leenggam pasien in ka khut apat leh ka pu leh pate khut akipat amite ahunkhe zou ngai sih uhi. Noute pasien in ka khut apat ahing hunkhe tuom dieh sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Sennakerib milienten Mangpa Pasian leh asuohpa Hezekiah demsietna thu agen uhi."},"17":{"text":"Aman Mangpa Israelte Pasian gensietna leh demna dingin laihah agiel nalai a, “Gamdang leh nam dangte pasien in ka khut apat ahuhdoh theilou mabang un, Hezekiah Pasian in zong ka khut a kipat amite ahundoh zou tuom sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun khopi alah theina ding ua, suh zau na ding leh asuh chizat theina dingun, kul bang tunga um Jerusalem mite kungah Juda ham in aw ngaitahin agal hat uhi."},"19":{"text":"Amaun leitunga midangte pasiente, mihing khut suoh leltahte agen siet bangun, Jerusalem Pasian a gensie uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin leengpa Hezekiah leh Amoz tapa guolnei Isai athum ua, vanlam ngain akapta uhi.","title":"Hezekiah leh guolnei Isai thumna (2 Leeng. 19.14-19)"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n vansawlsieng khat asawl a, Aman Asiria leengpa giehphuol a galkapte leh lamkaite, tualeh miliente abawn un athatgam sieng hi. Tuachi’n Sennakerib maizum tahin agam langah akinuale kiata hi. Tualeh apasien biehinn sunga ahing lut laitah in, ama tapate mama in namsau in asunlumta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Hezekiah leh Jerusalem mite, Asiria leengpa Sennakerib khut akipat in leh midang zousiete khut a kipat in ahunkheta hi. Tuachi’n Aman lamchinteng ah amaute akhotuo hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi tampiten Jerusalem ah Mangpa a dingin silpiehte ahingtawi ua, tualeh Juda leengpa Hezekiah adingin zong kipahmante ahing tawi uhi. Tua hun a kipat in nam zousie mitmu ah tawisangin aumta hi."},"24":{"text":"Khum hun lai in Hezekiah ahing china a, shi dingkhopin aum hi; tuachi’n Mangpa kungah athum a Aman adawnga, akungah chiemtena lamdang khat apie hi.","title":"Hezekiah natna leh damkia na (2 Leeng. 20.1-10 ; Isai. 37.21 ; 38.8)"},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh Hezekiah lungtang akisathei a, atunga deisahna kibawlpen sil hoi bawlin athuh sih hi. Tuaziehin Mangpa thangpaina khu ama tung leh Juda leh Jerusalem tungah atungta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuabepin Hezekiah alungtang kisahtheina apat kisia in akingaingiem a, Jerusalem mite zong akisia uhi. Tuaziehin Mangpa thangpaina Hezekiah damsungin amaute tangah atungta sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Hezekiah in hausatna leh zatatna thupitah atang a, sana, dangka leh suongmantamte, gimnamtuite leh lumte leh sil manpha namkim koina ding goukholna innte abawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Bu leh bal leh uoin thate leh sathaute koina ding innte zong abawl a, ganta chituom tuom a dingin buhte alam pieh a, belam honte adingin huongte abawl pieh hi."},"29":{"text":"Aman khotate abawla, ganhon tampi leh kel leh belam hon tampite anei hi. Pasian in hausatna thupi mama apieh zieh ahi."},"30":{"text":"Tam Hezekiah mama ahi Gihon tuinah pawtna sahta zaw hubinga David khopi tumlam panga leinuoi a tui zawla luong sahpa. Anasepna pouma ah alawching hi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh gamsunga sil lamdang kibawlte kankhe dinga Babilon vaihawm lienten patongte asawl tah un, Pasian in ama ze et ding leh alungtang a um zousie theina dingin ama apat akihemkheta hi."},"32":{"text":"Hezekiah vaihawm sunga siltung dangte leh anasep hoi zousiete, Amoz tapa guolnei Isai laibu ah akigiel hi."},"33":{"text":"Hezekiah apulepate kungah a imuta a, David hahlesuonte han sahta zaw ah akivuita hi. Ama a shi tah in, Juda mi zousie leh Jerusalem mi zousie in thupi tahin agaal uhi. Tuachi’n ama thahengin atapa Manasseh leeng in apangta hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh leenga apan chiil lai in kum sawm leh ni a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga leh nga sung vai ahawm hi.","title":"Juda leengpa Manasseh (2 Leeng. 21.2-9)"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh aman, Mangpa’n Israelte mai a anawdoh namte kidahhuoina zui in, Mangpa mitmu ah sil dihlou abawl hi.","ref":"Jer. 15.4"},"3":{"text":"Aman apa Hezekiah in aphietmangsa, munsangte alamtha kia a, Baal maitamte zong atungding kia a, Ashera songlaite zong aphut hi."},"4":{"text":"“Mangpa’n Jerusalem ah ka min kumtawn in aum ding” achina mun Mangpa biehinn sungah aman maitamte abawl hi.","ref":"2 Khang. 6.6"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh aman Mangpa biehinn huongsung leituol tegel ah van a um aasi honte a dingin maitamte abawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Ben-Hinnom guom ah atapate mei ah haltum in alan a, tualeh dawi ai san siemte aguoi a, bum siemte azanga, hagau bua neite leh mitphieldawi siemte zong thu adong hi; Mangpa suthangpai dingin amitmu ah silgilou tampi abawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasian in David leh atapa Solomon kunga, “Israel mamte zousie mai a ka na telsa tami biehinn sung leh Jerusalem ah ka min kumtawn in ka koi ding hi, chia ana genna Pasian biehinn sungah leh;","ref":"1 Leeng. 9.3-5; 2 Khang. 7.12-18"},"8":{"text":"Mosi zanga ka thupieh dan thute leh thuguotte leh thugousiete dungzui a bawl dinga, apilvang u’leh, apu leh pate uh kana piehsa gam akipat in, Israelte keng ka suondoh nawn sih ding, achina mun ah, aman ama bawlthu milim khenthu khat atungdoh hi.”"},"9":{"text":"Manasseh in Judate leh Jerusalem mite apuimanga, Mangpa’n Israelte mai a asuhmang namte sangin zong atatse zaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa’n Manasseh leh amite kungah, thu agen a, hinanleh amaun angaikhe ngaisih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n Asiria galkap lamkaite amauh dou dingin ahing kuon sah a, amauten Manasseh aman ua, kol abun sah ua, anahkuo ah siakuol avaw ua, sum-eng kol in akan ua, Babilon gam ah azawpita uhi.","title":"Manasseh saltaanna leh pawtkiana"},"12":{"text":"Alungkham mangbat laitah in Mangpa a Pasian deisahna asui a, apu apate Pasian mai ah nasatah in akingaingiem hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama kunga athum tahin, athumna in Mangpa lung akhoi a, angetna angaikhie a, Jerusalem leh a leenggam ah atut kiata hi. Tuachi’n Manasseh in Pasian ahoi hi, chi atheita hi."},"14":{"text":"Khum nuain aman Gihon luinah guom tumlam a David khopi kulbang pawnungzaw, Nga kotpi lutna dong, Ophel muol imkuol in asiempha a; asang zaw sem in abawl hi. Aman Juda gamsunga khopi kulpi nei zousie ah galkap lamkaite akoi hi."},"15":{"text":"Gamdang pasiente leh Mangpa biehinn sunga milimte leh Mangpa biehinn muol tunga amaitam bawlte zousie, tualeh Jerusalem kholai a maitamte zong aladoh a, khopi pulam ah apaimang sieng hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Mangpa maitam abawltha kia a, atungah lemna sillatte leh kipah thugenna sillatte alan hi; tualeh Mangpa Israel Pasian nna a sem a, Ama be dingin Juda mite thu apie hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh mipite munsangte ah akithoi zing nalai lai ua, ahivangin tuate Mangpa a Pasian uh kung bou a alat uh ahita hi."},"18":{"text":"Manasseh vaihawm sunga siltungte, a Pasian kung a athumna leh guolneiten Mangpa Israel Pasian mina ama kunga athunget utoh, Israel leengte khangthu gelna laibu ah akigiel hi."},"19":{"text":"Athumna leh Pasian hepina amu dante, akingaingiem masanga agitlounate leh amuonhuoi lounate leh munsang abawlnate leh Ashera sawlkhuom aphunate leh milim khenthu atundohnate thute abawnin guolneite laibu ah akigiel hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Manasseh apu apate kungah a imuta a, ama innpi ah akivuita hi. Ama thahengin atapa Amon leeng in apangta hi."},"21":{"text":"Amon leenga ahing pan chiillai in, kum sawmni leh kum ni a upa ahia, Jerusalem ah kumni sung vai ahawm hi.","title":"Juda leengpa Amon (2 Leeng. 21.19-24)"},"22":{"text":"Apa Manasseh bangin Mangpa mitmu ah silgilou abawl hi. Amon in apa Manasseh in ana bawlsa milimte zousie kungah kithoina abawl a, tua milimte abie hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh apa Manasseh kingai ngiem bangin Mangpa mai ah akingaingiem sih a, Amon atakhiel deu deu hi."},"24":{"text":"Amon amilienten aguhin aphiel ua, aleeng innpi sungah athatta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh agamsung miten leengpa Amon tunga thu phielgu zousie athat sieng ua, agam mipiten atapa Josiah ama thahengin leeng in apang sahta uhi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah leenga apan chiil lai in kum giet a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm thum leh kum khat vai ahawm hi.","title":"Josiah leeng hina leh asilbawl phatte (2 Leeng. 22.1-2)","ref":"Jer. 3.6"},"2":{"text":"Aman Mangpa mitmu in sildih abawl a, apu David lampite azui a, veilam ahiei, zietlam ahiei, ah zong apielsan sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Avaihawm kum gietna ah, naupang ahi lai in, apu David Pasian sui apanta a, kum sawm leh ni na ah Juda leh Jerusalem akipat munsangte Ashera sawlkhuomte, milim kikhenthute leh milim kisunthawte, aphietmang panta hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama thupiehna nuoi ah, Baal maitamte asatchim ua, atung ua um gimnamtui halna maitamte asat guoi ua, Ashera sawlkhuomte, milim khenthute leh milim kisunthawte, asatguoi sieng hi. Tam banga asatguoina neente u’khu, tam milimte kunga kithoite, hantung ah athe hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 21.3; 2 Khang. 33.3"},"5":{"text":"Aman siempute gu te amaitamte u’tungah ahal a, tambangin Juda leh Jerusalem asusiengta hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 13.2"},"6":{"text":"Tuachibang main, Manasseh, Ephraim, Simeon leh Naphtali donga khopite leh akimvela um khopineute abawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh maitamte leh Ashera sawl khuomte asat pua a, milimte agawt guoi a, tualeh Israel gamsung pumpi a, gimnamtui halna maitamte asat guoi sienga, Tuachi’n Jerusalem ah akinuale kiata hi."},"8":{"text":"Josiah vaihawm akum sawm leh gietna ah gamsung leh biehinn asuhsieng zou in, Azaliah tapa Shaphan leh khopi vaihawmpa Maaseiah tualeh laigielpa Joahaz tapa Joah te, Mangpa a Pasian biehinn bawlpha dingin asawl hi.","title":"Josiah in biehinn abawlphatna (2 Leeng. 22.3-7)"},"9":{"text":"Amaute siempulien Hilkiah kungah ava haw ua, Pasian biehinn a hing kitawi sumte apie uhi. Tua sumte pen kotpi veng Levite, Manassehte, Ephraim mite leh Israel mi umsunte, tualeh Juda leh Benjamin mite zousie leh Jerusalem a tengte zousie apat adon khieh uh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Amauten Mangpa bieh inn bawl, nasemte enkai dinga kiguot mite khut ah akem sah uhi. Tam miten biehinn siempha nasem mite kungah anasep thaman un apie uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amaun, sing nasemte leh inn lam mite kungah zong, suongkhensa leh inn zawlnuoinung pen leh inn kam ding zawl liente leina ding sum apie uhi. Tuabang vante pen Juda leengte’n keplou donlou a ana koi uh innte lamtha kia nading ahi."},"12":{"text":"Miten gin umtahin nna asem ua, amaute tungah nasep dan enkai dingin Merari hahlesuon, Levimite Johath leh Obadiah, tualeh Kohath hahle suon Levi mite Zekariah leh Meshullam, apang uhi. Tumging tum siem Levi mite pen;"},"13":{"text":"nna semte tunga vaihawm in apang ua, tualeh nna sepna tuom tuom a, nasemte a enkai uhi. Tualeh Levi mi lawikhatte pen laigiel mite leh Uliente leh kotpi vengin apang uhi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa biehinn sunga kikoilut sumte ahing lahdoh lai un siempu Hilkiah in, Mosi tungtawn a kipie Mangpa Dan laibu amukhie hi.","title":"Mosi dan laibu mudohna (2 Leeng. 22.8-13)"},"15":{"text":"Hilkiah in laigielpa Shaphan kungah, “Mangpa biehinn sungah, Dan laibu ka mukheta hi” achi a, Shaphan kungah apekheta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Shaphan in tua Dan laibu khu leengpa kungah ava tawi a, akungah, “Na u lienten amauh sep dinga kipete zousie asem uhi, achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaun Mangpa biehinn a sum kimu zousie alakhawm ua, Nasep enkhe mite khut leh nasem mite khut ah akem sah zel uhi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n laigielpa Shaphan in leengpa kungah, “Siempu Hilkiah in laibu khat kei ahing pie hi,” achi a, leengpa mai ah tua laibu asimta hi."},"19":{"text":"Lengpa’n tua Dan thute azah tahin, apuonsilte abotkeh hi."},"20":{"text":"Lengpa’n Hilkiah leh Shaphan tapa Ahikam leh Mikah tapa Abdon leh laigielpa Shaphan leh leengpa suohpa Asaiah thu apie a:"},"21":{"text":"“Pei unlen, kei a ding leh Israel leh Juda kinuasie umsunte adingin tam laibu kimudoh sunga kigiel thute tungtang toh kisai in Mangpa hing doh pieh un; Ipu Ipaten Mangpa thu amanlou zieh ua, Mangpa lungthahna eite tunga kisung buo, athupi sengta hi, aziehpen amaute tam laibu sunga kigiel banga na gamtalou uh ahi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Hilkiah leh ama toh zawhkhawm dinga leengpa misawlte guolneinu Huldah houpi dingin akuon uhi. Huldah pen Shalum zi ahia, Shalum khu Tokhath tapa ahi a, Tokhath khu Hasrah tapa ahi a, Hasrah pen puonsilte kempa ahi. Huldah khu Jerusalem vengtha lam a teng ahi. Amanu kungah khum thute ava genta uhi.","title":"Guolneinu Huldah thugen (2 Leeng. 22.14-20)"},"23":{"text":"Amanu’n akung uah, “Israelte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi. Ka kunga noute hing sawlpa kungah na gen un."},"24":{"text":"Tambangin Mangpa’n agen hi. Ngai un, keiman tam mun leh asunga teng zousiete tungah sietna ka hing tung sah ding hi; Juda leengpa mai a asim uh, tua laibu sunga kigiel hamsie zousiete tungsah ding ka hi."},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen kei ahing taisan ua, pasien dangte mai a gimnamtui ahal ua, amauh khuta abawlthu zousiete uh zanga ahing lungthah sah zieh un, ka lungthahna tam mun tungah sunbuoh in a um dinga, kiphelmit zoulou ding ahi, achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Mangpa thu dong dinga noute hing sawlpa Juda leengpa tung thu ahileh, tambangin akungah na gen un, Israelte Mangpa Pasian in, na thuzahte tung tangah tambangin agen hi."},"27":{"text":"Na lungtangin thu na ngaikhe nuom a, tam mun leh asunga tengte zousie sietna ding thu kigen na zah laitah a, Pasian mai a, na kingaingiem a, na puonte na botkeh a, ka mai a na kaa ziehin, Ken zong ka hing ngaikheta hi, Mangpa’n achi hi, achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuin Na pu leh pate kungah ka hing pui dinga, Hamuong tah in na kivui dinga, tam mun leh asunga tengte tunga ka tunsah ding sietna, na mitin amu sih ding hi,” achi hi, achi hi. Tuachi’n Huldah dawnna leengpa kungah atut kiata uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Juda leh Jerusalem upate ahankhawm hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa khu, Juda mite, Jerusalem mite, siempute leh Levi mite toh, aneupen akipat alienpen dongin Mi zousie toh, Mangpa biehinn ah apeitou uhi. Aman, amaute zah in, tua Mangpa biehinn a kimukhie, thuhun laibu a thute zousie asim khie hi.","title":"Mipite kunga dan laibu simkhiehna"},"31":{"text":"Lengpa ama mun ah adinga, tam laibu a kigiel thuhun thute bawltha kia dinga, alungtang zousie leh ahinna zousie toh Mangpa zui ding leh athupiehte, adanthupiehte, athugousiete leh athu theisahte, zui dingin Mangpa mai ah thu ahung tha kia hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem leh Benjamin gam a mi zousie tam thuhun zui dingin akichiem sah a, Jerusalem miten Pasian apu apate uh Pasian thuhun dungzui in abawlta uhi."},"33":{"text":"Josiah in Israelte gamsung pumpi akipat in milim kidahhuoi zousie aphietmanga, Israel gam a um mi zousieten Mangpa a Pasian uh nna asem sahta hi. Tualeh Josiah damsung tengin, amauten apu apate uh Pasian tawp sanlou in azui uhi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah in Jerusalem ah Mangpa dingin Peikan pawi abawl a, aha khatna ni sawm leh li niin, peikan belam nou agou hi.","title":"Peikan pawi manna (2 Leeng. 23.21-23)"},"2":{"text":"Aman siempute kungah, anasep ding uh aguotpieh chiet hi. Mangpa biehinn a, nasem dingin ahantawh hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel mite zousie thuhilte, Mangpa adinga kisiensuo, Levimite kungah, “Israelte leengpa David tapa Solomon in alam biehinn sungah bawm siengthou koilut un; tam pen na liengkou ua mun tuom tuom a puoh ding ahi nawn sih hi. Tuin Mangpa na Pasian u’leh ami Israelte na sem un."},"4":{"text":"Israel leengpa David leh atapa Solomon thupieh kigiel dungzuiin, na pu leh pate uh innkuon kikhen dung zui in, apawl pawl in kisakhol un.","ref":"2 Khang. 8.14"},"5":{"text":"Mipi vantang na gammi hipite uh, apawl pawl a kikhente dinga kiguot Levite pawl khat chiet toh mun siengthou ah ding khawm un."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n peikan belamnoute gou u’len, kisiensuo unlen, Mangpa’n Mosi zanga thu apieh dungzui in, na chi na namte uh kimansa in umsah un,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Josiah in mipi nautang um zousie dinga, peikan sillat dingin belam leh kel tul sawm thum leh bawngtal tul thum mipite kungah apie hi, tamte khu leengpa neisa apat ngen ahi."},"8":{"text":"Josiah u lienten zong amauh kiphalna in mipite leh siempute tualeh Levite dingin atuoh uhi. Pasian biehinn vaisai lien, Hilkiah, Zekariah leh Jehiel in siempute kungah peikan sillat dingin belamnou leh kelnou tul ni leh za guh leh bawngtal zathum apie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Konaniah leh asanggamte Shemaiah leh Nathaneel in zong, tualeh Levite lamkaite Hashabiah, Jeiel leh Zozabad ten zong Peikan sillat dingin belamnou leh kelnou tul nga leh bawngtal za nga Levite kungah apie uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peikan nasepna dingte bawl tup diem ahitah in, leengpa thupieh dungzui in siempute amauh mun chiet ah ading ua, Levite zong apawl kikhen dan dungzui un ading uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peikan belamnou a gou ua, siempute’n amauh kunga kipie sisante athe ua, avunte pen Leviten alem uhi."},"12":{"text":"Mosi dan laibu a kigiel mipite a innkuon kikhen dan dungzui ua Mangpa kunga lat ding apieh theina dingun, halmang sillatte akoituom zel uhi. Tuabangma in bawngtalte zong abawl uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amauten thugousie dungzui in Peikan belamnou khu mei in a em min ua; sillat siengthoute pen belpum te, belpite leh khangbelte in ahuon ua, mipite kungah kintah in aluikhe pai pai uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.8,9"},"14":{"text":"Tuazou in amauleh siempute dingin neh ding abawl uhi. Aaron hahlesuon siempute pen halmang sillat leh sathaute lan a zan donga buoi ahi zieh un, Leviten ama ua ding leh Aaron tapa siempute a ding in neh ding abawl uhi."},"15":{"text":"Asaph hahlesuon lasa mite, khu David leh Asaph leh Heman tualeh leengpa guolnei Jeduthun thupieh dungzui in amauh mun chiet ah aum uhi. Kotpi vengte zong akotpi venna mun chiet uah aum uhi, a Levipi aunaute un amaute neh ding abawl pieh zieh un, anasepna mun uh ataisan uh akuul sih hi.","ref":"1 Khang. 25.1"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Josiah thupieh bangin, Peikan pawi mang ding leh, Mangpa maitam tunga halmang sillat dingin, Mangpa nasepna zousie, tua ni ma in bawlzou diem ahita hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua mun a um Israelte zousiein tuami hun in peikan pawi abawl ua, tualeh tanghou tolsawlou pawi ni sagi abawl uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-20"},"18":{"text":"Guolnei Samuel hunlai a kipat in Israelte lah ah tambangin peikan pawi aki bawl khanai sih hi, tualeh Israel leengte zousie leh siempute, Levimite leh tua mun a um Juda mite leh Israel mi zousie leh Jerusalem a, tengte’n zong Josiah bawl banga peikan pawi a bawlkha ngainai mawngmawng sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Josiah avaihawm kum sawm leh gietna kum in tami peikan pawi akibawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Tamte zousie nua in, Josiah in biehinn abawl tha zou tahin, Izipt leengpa Neko in Euphrates luipi panga um Karkemish dou dingin akuontou a: Josiah zong ama dou dingin akuondoh ta hi.","title":"Josiah shina (2 Leeng. 23.28-30)"},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Neko in Josiah kungah patong asawl a, akung ah, “Nang leh Kei kidouna ding bang thu a um ei mah? aw Nang Juda leengpa? Tuni’n nangma dou dinga hing kuon ka hisih a, ka kidoupisa innkuonte dou dinga hing kuon ka hibou hi. Pasian in kintah a kuon dingin ahing hil ahi, tuaziehin kei hing umpi Pasian in ahing suhmang louna dingin hing kikum da maiin,” ahing chi hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Josiah in ama akiheisan nuom sih a hinanleh ama akidoupi theina dingin akisiem lamdanga, Pasian thupieh a Neko thugente asang nuom sih a, tuachi’n Megiddo phaijang ah kidou dingin akuon suhta hi."},"23":{"text":"Thalkap miten leengpa Josiah akapkha ua, tuachi’n leengpa’n a Uliente kungah, “Hing peimangpi ta un, ka liem nah sengta hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n a Ulienten a sakolleng akipat alakhie ua, ama sakolleeng nina pen ah akoi ua, Jerusalem ahing tut ua, khunah ashita hi. Apu apate han khuh ah aki vui a, Juda leh Jerusalem mite zousie in ama a suun uhi."},"25":{"text":"Jeremiah in zong Josiah kala toh akaa a, tualeh pasal lasamite leh numei lasamite zousie in tuni dongin aka chiengun Josiah min aloukha nalai ua, Tam pen Israel gam ah chin dan ngaina khat a hing suohta a, kalate sungah tam late aki giel hi."},"26":{"text":"Josiah vaihawm sunga siltung dangte leh Mangpa dan sunga kigiel dungzui a, ginumtaha anasep hoite;"},"27":{"text":"tualeh anasepna zousie abul akipat atawp dong Ngai vawi, Israel leengte khangthu kigelna laibu ah akigiel hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua gam miten Josiah tapa Jehoahaz azawpi ua, apa thahengin Jerusalem ah leeng in apang sahta uhi.","title":"Jehoahaz leenga panna (2 Leeng. 23.30-33)"},"2":{"text":"Jehoahaz leenga apan chiil lai in kum sawmni leh kum thum a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah hathum vai ahawm hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt leengpa’n Jerusalem ah aleeng hina asuhbei pieh a, Juda gam akipat dangka sum talent zakhat leh sana talent khat sie lieu dingin akoita hi."},"4":{"text":"Izipt leengpa’n Jehoahaz sanggam Eliakim Juda leh Jerusalem tunga leengpa in apang sah a, amin Jehoiakim in ahen pieh hi, tualeh Neko in asanggampa Jehoahaz aman a Izipt ah azawpita hi.","ref":"Jer. 22.11,12"},"5":{"text":"Jehoiakim leenga apan chiil lai in kum sawmni leh kum nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm leh khat vai ahawm hi. Aman Mangpa a Pasian mitmu in silgilou abawl hi.","ref":"Jer. 22.18,19; 26.1-6; 35.1-19"},"6":{"text":"Ama dou dingin Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar ahing kuontou a, Babilon lam ah sal a pui dingin sum-eng kol abun sah hi.","ref":"Jer. 25.1-38; 36.1-32; 45.1-5; Dan. 1.1,2"},"7":{"text":"Nebukadnezzar in Mangpa biehinn akipat in vanzah tui um belsuonte ala a, Babilon a ama pasien biehinn ah akoi hi."},"8":{"text":"Jehoiakim vaihawm sunga siltung dangte sil kidahhuoi abawlte leh ama umdan zousie, ngai in, Israel leh Juda leengte khangthu gelna laibu sungah aki giel hi. Ama thahengin atapa Jehoiakin leeng in apangta hi.","title":"Juda leengpa Jehoiakin (2 Leeng. 24.6-10)"},"9":{"text":"Jehoiakin leenga apan chiil lai in kum sawm leh giet a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah hathum leh ni sawm sung vai ahawm hi. Aman zong Mangpa mitmuin silgilou abawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Kum hing kihei a, khawkhal hun lai in leengpa Nebukadnezzar in mi asawl a, ama leh Mangpa biehinn a van manpha bel leh kuongte toh Babilon ah apui a, asanggampa Zedekiah Juda leh Jerusalem tunga leeng in apang sahta hi.","ref":"Jer. 22.24-30; 24.1-10; 29.1,2; Ezek. 17.12; Jer. 37.1; Ezek. 17.13"},"11":{"text":"Zedekiah leenga apan chiil lai in kum sawmni leh kum khat ahia, Jerusalem ah kum sawm le khat vai ahawm hi.","title":"Zedekiah leenga panna (2 Leeng. 24.17 , 18)","ref":"Jer. 27.1-22; 28.1-17"},"12":{"text":"Aman Mangpa a Pasian mitmu in silgilou abawl a, Mangpa kam a kipata thugenpa Jeremiah mai ah akingiemkhieh ut sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian min a kichiemsahpa leengpa Nebukadnezzar tungah zong ahel a, angawng avaipuoh a, Mangpa Israelte Pasian langa kinuahei nuomlou in alungtang akhau sah hi.","ref":"Ezek. 17.15"},"14":{"text":"Tuathamlouin siempu lamkaite zousie leh mipiten nam dangte gamtatna kidahhuoite zuiin, agin um maw semsem uhi; tuachi’n Mangpa’n asiensuosa Jerusalem a Mangpa biehinn abua sahta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa apu apate uh Pasian in amite leh atenna mun alainat seng ziehin, amaute kungah thangkoute asawl sawnsawn hi.","title":"Jerusalem puana leh Babilon gam a saltanna (2 Leeng. 25.1-21 ; Jer. 52.4-27 ; Ezr. 1.1-3)"},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun Pasian thupotute ana nuisat ua, athugente uh ana thusim pieh sih ua, amipite tunga Mangpa thangpaina atun masangsie leh athoidam kia nading aumlou nuasang dongin zong aguolneite a enghou nalai uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuazieh in aman Kaldai mite leengpa amauh dou dingin ahing puitou a, aman atangvalte uh amunsiengthou ah athat a, tangval hiin, nungah hitaleh tehsete leh mizawngkhalte hitaleh hepina bei in namsau in athat hi.","ref":"Jer. 21.1-10; 34.1-5"},"18":{"text":"Aman Pasian biehinn a vanzah um leh belte zousie alien hiin aneu hitaleh, tualeh Mangpa bieh inn a goute leh leengpa leh a vaihawm liente inn a goute zousie Babilon ah apomang siengta hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaun Pasian biehinn ahal ua, Jerusalem kulbangte asatchim ua, asunga leengpa innpite zousie mei in ahaltum ua, tualeh van manpha zousie asusie uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 9.8"},"20":{"text":"Namsau akipat a suohta sunsunte, Babilon langah apuimanga, Persia leenggam hing kitunding tan dong in, leengpa leh atapate suoh leh sal in apang denta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Jeremiah kam a nakigen Mangpa thute atangtun na dingin kum sawm sagi abei masangsie’n tua gam in khawlni amang denta ding uhi.","ref":"Jer. 25.11; 29.10"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Persia leengpa Sairas vaihawm akum khatna ah Jeremiah kam zanga Mangpa’n agen thute atangtun theina dingin, Mangpa’n Persia leengpa Sairas lungtang atohthou a, tuachi’n aleeng gam pumpi ah thuphuon abawla, tua khu agelkhie hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tami Persia leengpa Sairas thugen ahi, Aman Mangpa van Pasian in leitung leeng gam zousie kei ahing pie a, Juda gam a um Jerusalem ah ama ading biehinn bawl pieh dingin ahing guotta hi. Noute lah a ama mite koi ahiei kuon ding? Mangpa a Pasian in umpi henlen, kuon heh,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 44.28"}}}}},"15":{"info":{"name":"Ezra","shortname":"Ezr.","abbr":[],"desc":"Ezra laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Persia leengpa Sairas vaihawm kum khatna ah, Jeremiah kam a, Mangpa thugen atangtun theina dingin, Mangpa’n Persia leengpa Sairas lungtang atohthou a, tuachi’n aleenggam pumpi a thuphuon khat bawl ding leh agel a zong koi dingin thu apie hi.","title":"Persia leengpa Sairas in Judate kile kiana ding aphalna","ref":"Jer. 25.11; 29.10"},"2":{"text":"“Persia leengpa Sairas in tambang in agen hi. Mangpa van Pasian in leitung leenggam zousie keima ahing peta hi. Aman Juda gam a um Jerusalem ah Ama dinga inn lampieh dingin kei ma thu ahing pie hi.","ref":"Isai. 44.28"},"3":{"text":"Nou amite zousie lah a koi na hi uoi? akung ah, a Pasian um henlen, Juda gam a um Jerusalem khuo ah kuontou henlen, Mangpa Israel Pasian biehinn va lam heh. Ama pen Jerusalem a teng Pasian ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh mi koipou akhuolzinna hei mun pou a, nuasie a, a umna mun a mite’n, akiphalna bang ua apieh uh chilou in dangka, sana leh nei leh lam tualeh gantate’n, Jerusalem a Pasian inn bawlna dinga atuoh ban uah, panpi uheh,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda leh Benjamin innkuon a, a upate u’leh siempute leh Levimite leh Pasian in alungtang uh atawhthoute zousie, Jerusalem a Mangpa biehinn lam dinga kuontou dingin akisa ta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Akim avel ua a innvengte zousie un, akiphalna ua apieh uh silpiehte zousie ban ah, sana leh dangka a kibawl vante leh van dangte leh gantate leh vanmantamte in apanpi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuathamlouin leengpa Sairas in, Jerusalem a Mangpa biehinn a kipat a Nebukadnezzar in apuohdoh a, ama pasien biehinn a akoi vante zong alakhe sieng hi."},"8":{"text":"Persia leengpa Sairas in sum kempa Mithredath khut in aladoh sienga Juda lamkai lien Sheshbazzar khut a pie in asim sah hi."},"9":{"text":"Apha za tambang ahi. Sana kuong sawm thum, Dangka kuong tul khat, dangka kuongdai sawmni leh kuo."},"10":{"text":"Sana hengkuong sawm thum, dangka hengkuong dangte zali leh sawm khat, tualeh van dangdang tul khat."},"11":{"text":"Dangka leh sana akibawl bel leh kuong zousie abawn in tulnga leh zali ahi. Tamte zousie Sheshbazzar in Babilon saltanna akipat a Jerusalem a ahing zawpi saltangte toh ahing potou uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nebukad-nezzar in Babilon a suoh leh sal a apuimang, tua sal taanna apat a hing kinuale Juda leh Jerusalem a, amauh khopi chiet a hing tung kiate tamte ahi uhi.","title":"Saltaang hing kinualete simna (Neh. 7.4-73)"},"2":{"text":"Amaute toh hing zawhkhawm, Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seriah, Reelaiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mizpar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah, ahi uhi. Israel mite lah a pasal phaza tamte ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Parosh hahlesuonte, sang ni leh za leh sawm sagi leh ni."},"4":{"text":"Shephatiah hahlesuonte zathum sawm sagi leh ni."},"5":{"text":"Arah hahlesuonte zasagi sawm sagi leh nga."},"6":{"text":"Pahath-Moab hahlesuonte (Jeshua leh Joab khanggui akipat) tulni leh zagiet leh sawm leh ni."},"7":{"text":"Elam hahlesuonte, tul khat leh zani leh sawm nga leh li."},"8":{"text":"Zattu hahlesuonte, Zakuo leh sawm li leh nga."},"9":{"text":"Zakkai hahlesuonte, zasagi leh sawm guh."},"10":{"text":"Bani hahlesuonte, zaguh leh sawm li leh ni."},"11":{"text":"Bebai hahlesuonte, zaguh sawmni leh thum."},"12":{"text":"Azgad hahlesuonte, tulkhat zani leh sawmni leh ni."},"13":{"text":"Adonikam hahlesuonte, zaguh sawmguh leh guh."},"14":{"text":"Bigvai hahlesuonte, Tul ni leh sawm nga leh guh."},"15":{"text":"Adin hahlesuonte, zali leh sawm nga leh li."},"16":{"text":"Hezekiah khanggui apat, Ater hahlesuonte sawmkuo leh giet."},"17":{"text":"Bezai hahlesuonte, zathum sawmni leh thum."},"18":{"text":"Jora hahlesuonte, za leh sawm khat leh ni."},"19":{"text":"Hashum hahlesuonte, zani sawmni leh thum."},"20":{"text":"Gibar hahlesuonte, sawm kuo leh nga."},"21":{"text":"Bethlehem mite, za leh sawmni leh thum."},"22":{"text":"Netophah mite, sawm nga leh guh."},"23":{"text":"Anathoth mite, za leh sawmni leh giet."},"24":{"text":"Azmaveth mite, sawmli leh ni."},"25":{"text":"Kiriath Jearim Kephirah leh Beeroth mite, zasagi sawm li leh thum."},"26":{"text":"Ramah leh Geba mite, zaguh sawmni leh khat."},"27":{"text":"Mikmash mite, za leh sawm khat leh ni."},"28":{"text":"Bethel leh Ai mite, zani sawmni leh thum."},"29":{"text":"Nebo mite, sawmnga leh ni."},"30":{"text":"Magbish mite, za leh sawmnga leh guh."},"31":{"text":"Elam dang mite, tul khat zani sawmnga leh guh."},"32":{"text":"Harim mite, zathum leh sawmni."},"33":{"text":"Lod, Hadid leh Ono mite, zasagi sawmni leh nga."},"34":{"text":"Jeriko mite, zathum sawmli leh nga."},"35":{"text":"Senaah mite, tul thum leh zaguh leh sawm thum."},"36":{"text":"Siempute: Jeshua khanggui a, Jedai hahlesuonte, Zakuo leh sawm sagi leh thum."},"37":{"text":"Immer hahlesuonte, tul khat leh sawm nga leh ni."},"38":{"text":"Pashur suonte, tul khat zani sawm li leh sagi."},"39":{"text":"Harim suonte, tul khat leh sawm leh sagi."},"40":{"text":"Levite: Hodaviah khang gui akipat Jeshua leh Kadmiel suonte, sawm sagi leh li."},"41":{"text":"Lasate: Asaph suonte, za leh sawmni leh guh."},"42":{"text":"Kotpi vengte: Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita leh Shobai hahlesuonte abawn un, za leh sawmthum leh kuo."},"43":{"text":"Nethinimte: Ziha tate, Hasupha tate, Tabbaoth tate."},"44":{"text":"Keros tate, Siaha tate, Padon tate,"},"45":{"text":"Lebanah tate, Hagabah tate, Akkub tate,"},"46":{"text":"Hagab tate, Shalmai tate, Hanan tate,"},"47":{"text":"Giddel tate, Gahar tate, Reaiah tate,"},"48":{"text":"Rezin tate, Nekoda tate, Gazzam tate,"},"49":{"text":"Uza tate, Paseah tate, Besai tate,"},"50":{"text":"Asnah tate, Meunim tate, Nephusim tate,"},"51":{"text":"Bakuk tate, Hakupha tate, Harhur tate,"},"52":{"text":"Bazluth tate, Mehida tate, Harsha tate,"},"53":{"text":"Barkos tate, Sisera tate, Temah tate,"},"54":{"text":"Nezia leh Hatipha, hahlesuonte."},"55":{"text":"Solomon suohte
