hahlesuonte: Sotai tate, Hasophereth tate, Peruda tate,"},"56":{"text":"Jaala tate, Darkon tate, Giddel tate,"},"57":{"text":"Shephatiah tate, Hatil tate, Pokereth tate, Hazebaim leh Ami hahlesuonte,"},"58":{"text":"Nethinimte leh Solomon suohte hahlesuonte: zathum sawm kuo leh ni."},"59":{"text":"Tamte khu, Tel-Melah, Tel-Harsha, Kerub, Addan leh Immer, akipat a hing peitoute ahi uhi; hinanleh amaun apu apate uh innkuon khanggui dungzuiin Israel mi ahina uh, chi atahlang thei sih uhi."},"60":{"text":"Delaiah tate, Tobiah tate leh Nikoda tate, zaguh, sawmnga leh ni."},"61":{"text":"Siempute lah a kipat: Hobaiah tate, Hakkoz tate leh Barzillai suonte, (Barzillai pen Gileadmi Barzillai tanu toh kiteng pasal khat ahia, tua min a kihan ahi)"},"62":{"text":"Tam miten ainnkuon khanggui minkhumna laibu asui ua, hinanleh amu sih uhi. Tuaziehin amaute asienglou banga ngai ahi ua, siempu hina apat koidoh in aumta uhi."},"63":{"text":"Gamsung vaipopan zong siempu khat in Urim leh Thumim zanga, nasepna khat anei masangsien ann siengthou pente ane thei sih ding uh chiin, ana agen hi.","ref":"Kisim. 27.21"},"64":{"text":"Mipite zousie abawn un, tul sawmli leh tul ni leh zathum leh sawm guh ahi ua,","title":"Jerusalem zuon a peikiate"},"65":{"text":"tuate lah ah suoh pasal leh suoh numei, tulsagi leh zathum leh sawmthum leh sagite simtel lou ahi. Amaute lahah lasami pasal leh numei zani zong aum uhi."},"66":{"text":"Amaun sakol zasagi leh sawm thum leh guh leh sakol neute zani leh sawm li leh nga anei uhi."},"67":{"text":"Sangawngsau zali leh sawmthum leh nga leh sabiltung tul guh leh za sagi leh sawmni zong anei uhi."},"68":{"text":"Jerusalem a Mangpa inn ahing tun tah un, phung upa lawikhat in, amun tah ah, Pasian inn lamkiana dingin amauh kiphalna silpiehte apia uhi."},"69":{"text":"Amauh bawlthei khamkham Tami nasepna dinga sum koina inn a apieh uh sana drakma tul sawm guh leh tul khat leh dangka mina tul nga leh siempu puonsil zakhat apie uhi."},"70":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempute, Levi mite, lasate, kotpi vengte leh biehinn nasemte leh mi dangte toh amauh khopite chiet uah ateng ua, tualeh Israel midangte zong amauh khopi ah ateng chiet uhi.","ref":"1 Khang. 9.2; Neh. 11.3"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aha sagina ahing tuntahin, tualeh Israelten amauh khopi chiet ua aten zou tah un, mipite mikhat bang mai in Jerusalem ah ahing kikhawm uhi.","title":"Maitam bawlphatna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zozadak tapa Jeshua leh asiempu hipite leh Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh aunaute akisa ua, Pasian mipa Mosi danbu a kigiel dungzui a, halmang sillatte atunga alatna dingun, Israelte Pasian maitam abawl uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 27.1"},"3":{"text":"Akim apam ua mite giing nan u’leh zong, asuongphum tungah maitam adaw ua, atungah Mangpa adingin Halmang sillalte zingmawng leh nitah in alan uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 28.1-8"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akigiel bangbangin Hampheng pawi abawl ua, Maitam tunga Mangpa masangah halmang sillatte alan ua, dan dungzui a nichin a alat ding u’khu alanta uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 29.12-38"},"5":{"text":"Tuazouin halmang sillat ngainate alan ua, Hatha sillatte leh akiguotsa Mangpa pawi siengthoute zousie leh Mangpa adinga michin kiphalna sillatte alan uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 28.11—29.39"},"6":{"text":"Mangpa biehinn suongphum kiphum nai sih nanlezong, aha sagina, ani khat ni in Mangpa mai ah halmang sillatte alan panta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun suong khengte leh, sing bawl siemte kungah sum apie ua, Sidon mite leh Tai-ar mite kungah Lebanon a kipata Joppa tuipi donga sidar singte, hing puoh dingin neh dingte leh dawn dingte apie uhi.","title":"Biehinn lamtha kiana"},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem a Pasian inn a ahing tun nua uh akum nina, aha nina ah, Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel, Jozadak tapa Jeshua leh aunau dangte uh, siempute leh Levite, saltanna apat a Jerusalem a hing pei kiaten nasep apan ua, Levimite kum sawmni apat atunglamte, Mangpa inn lamna nasep enkai dingin aguot uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeshua leh atapate leh aunaute, Kadmiel leh atapate (Hodaviah hahlesuonte) leh Henadad tapate leh asanggamte abawn un Levite ngen ahi ua, amaute Pasian inn lamte enkai in apangkhawm uhi."},"10":{"text":"Inn lammiten Mangpa biehinn suongphum aphum tah un, amaun Israel leengpa David thugousie dungzui in, Mangpa phat dingin siempute’n apuon uh silin, pengkulte atawi ua, Asaph tapate Leviten dah khutbehte atawi ua, amauh mun chiet ah a ding uhi.","ref":"1 Khang. 25.1"},"11":{"text":"Mangpa kunga lungdam thu gen kawm in, phatna la asa uhi: “Ama ahoi hi. Israel a itna khu, kum tawn in aum ngitnget hi.” Achi uhi. Mangpa inn suongphum akiphum zieh a, Mangpa aphat lai un, mipite zousie aw ngaitah in akikou uhi.","ref":"1 Khang. 16.34; 2 Khang. 5.13; 7.3; Late. 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer. 33.11"},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh biehinn masapen mukha siempute, Levimite leh Innkuon a upapenten, amit ngel ua tam biehinn suongphum kiphum amu tahun akapta uhi, tualeh mi tampite pen lungdam in akikou uhi."},"13":{"text":"Husa angai seng ziehin lungnop aw leh ka aw koiman akhenkah thei sih hi. Aziehpen mipite ngaitah in akikou ua, akikou husa uh gamla pi ah akiza hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda leh Benjaminte melmaten, saltang hing kinuale ten, Mangpa Israelte Pasian adingin bieh inn alam uh chi azah tah un;","title":"Melmaten innlam adal tupna"},"2":{"text":"Zerubbabel leh phungsunga upate kungah ahing pei ua, akung uah, “Ka hing lampi ding uhi azieh pen nouten na Pasian uh na bieh bang un, kouten zong ka bie uhi, tualeh, tam mun a koute hing puipa Asiria leengpa Esar-Haddon hun lai a kipat in, ama kungah ka kithoi ngitnget ta uhi” achi uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 17.24-41"},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Jerubbabel, Jeshua leh Israel phungsunga upa pen ten akung uah, ka Pasian ua dinga biehinn lam na ah, “Koute lah ah bangma na bawl ding uh aum sih hi, hinanleh Persia leengpa Sairas hing thupieh dungzui in kouma tangin Mangpa Israelte Pasian biehinn ka lamna ding uh,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n agam miten Juda mipite alung kesah ua, tualeh abiehinn lam ding u’zong azausahta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Persia leengpa Sairas vaihawm sung teng leh Persia leengpa Darius vaihawm dongin, amauten Persia gamsung miliente agolgu ua, asiltup ua pat lung kieh sah atum uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ahasuerus in leeng vai ahawm kum kipat chiillai in, amauten Juda leh Jerusalem a tengte ahehna lai uh akungah agiel uhi."},"7":{"text":"Persia leengpa Artekserses vaihawm hunlai in zong, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabel leh akipawlpiten, Persia leengpa Artekserses kungah hehna lai agiel uhi, tua lai pen Aramaik ham leh Aramaik laitenga kigiel ahi."},"8":{"text":"Gam uhpa Rehum leh laigielpa Shimshai in Jerusalem hehna in leengpa Artekserses kungah tambangin lai agiel uhi."},"9":{"text":"Gam uhpa Rehum leh lai gielpa Shimshai leh aseppite uh, thukhente, palaite, kumpi nasemte, Persia mite, Erek mite, Babilon mite, leh Susa khopi a Elam mite ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh mi thupi leh zatat huoi Osnappar in ahing puilut Samaria khopi sung leh luipi gal gamkai a tengte leh mun dang dang a um namte toh ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Leengpa Artekserses kunga alaihah uh tambang ahi. “Lengpa Artekserses kungah: Kou luipi gal gam a teng na suohten kang nousietna lai uh Kang hah uhi.","title":"Artekserses kunga melmate laihah"},"12":{"text":"Na kunga kipat a, koute kunga hing peitou Judate, Jerusalem ah apei ua, tua khopi helhat leh gilou alam tha uhi, chi na thei lachin ka chi uhi. Kulbangte alam tha ua, asuongphumte apuo pha uhi"},"13":{"text":"Tuin leengpa’n na thei heh, tam khopi akilam tha a, akulpi bangte aki tunding zou leh leimante siete, summet bawlna mante ape nawn sih ding ua tuachi’n leenggam sum munate akiem ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuin kouten leengpa innpi akipat panpina mu ka hi ziehun, leengpa’n zalatna atuoh ka mu ding uh koute a dingin akilawm sih hi, tuaziehin leengpa kungah mi hing sawlin ka hing theisah uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin napu napate sillui koikhawmna a, sil chiemtena laibu akipat kisui doh heh, tuahileh tam khopi khu helhattah leh nidanglai akipat leengte leh gamkaite adinga liemna leh helna kipatna mun ahilam akimudoh ding hi. Tuazieh a tam khopi susiet a na um ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tam khopi akilam tha kia a, akulbangte, akibawl tha kia zou pouma leh, Luipi gal gamlam pouma ah tan na nei zou nawn sih ding chi, ka hing hil uh ahi,” achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Lengpa’n tambangin dawnna ahah hi: “Gam uhpa Rehum leh Laigielpa Shimshai leh aseppi dangte u’leh Samaria leh Luipi gal gamkai a, tengte zousie ka hing nousiet hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuin na hing laihah uh, ka mai ah keima ham a kilet in akisimdoh ta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Keima’n thu ka pie a, akisui sui leh Tumasang lai in leengte douin tam khopi ana panga, tualeh helna leh buoina kipatna ahi chi akimudoh hi."},"20":{"text":"Jerusalem in leeng hattahte ana nei ngai a, Luipi gal gam zousie ah vai ana hawm ua, leimante, siete leh summet bawlna mante ana la uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin tam mite nasep tawp ding thu pie un, Keima’n thupieh ka bawl kia masang sie in tam khopi kilam nawn sih heh."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh tam thu ngaisah lou a na umlouna dingun pilvang un, bangding in leengpa sietna dinga hoilouna khang sem sem ding ahiei mah?”"},"23":{"text":"Lengpa Artekserses lai hah, Rehum leh laigielpa Shimshai leh aseppite uh kunga akisimdoh tah in, Judate dal ding leh thagum zanga anasep uh tawpsah dingin Jerusalem ah akuontou pai uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem a Pasian inn lamna pen, Darius Persia leengpa a ahing pan kumni na tandong akhawl dide ta hi.","ref":"Hag. 1.1; Zek. 1.1"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laiin guolnei Hagai leh Iddo tapa guolnei Zekariah in Juda gam leh Jerusalem a um Judate kungah, Israelte Pasian min in thu agen uhi.","title":"Guolneiten biehinn bawl ding atawhthouna (Hag. 1.1 ; Zek. 1.1)","ref":"Hag. 1.1; Zek. 1.1"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sealtel tapa Zerubbabel leh Zadok tapa Jeshua akipandoh ua, Jerusalem a Pasian inn lam tha kia dingin akuonta ua, Pasian guolneiten amaute apanpi uhi.","ref":"Hag. 1.12; Zek. 4.6-9"},"3":{"text":"Tua hun lai main Luipi gal gam a uhpipa Tattenai leh Shethar Bozenai leh aseppite uh, amaute kungah ang pei ua, “Tam biehinn lam tha kia ding leh akulbangte bawl kia dinga, koi in noute thu hing pie ahiei?” ahing chi uhi."},"4":{"text":"“Tam inn lam a pangte amin uh koiteng ahi uoi?” chi’n zong ahing dong nalai uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh a Pasian uh mit in Juda upate aveng zinga, athu uh leengpa Darius kunga akitut a, adawnna agelthaw a ahing kilekia masang siein, amaute nasep khawlsah ahi sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Luipi gal gam uhpipa Tattenai leh Shethar-Boznai leh aseppite uh tua luipi gal a ulienten leengpa Darius kungah laihah khat agiel uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua laihah ah tambangin akigiel hi: “Darius leengpa kungah, lungmuonna bukim umta hen."},"8":{"text":"“Koute Juda gam leh Pasian thupitah biehinn ah kava haw uh chi leengpa’n na thei heh. Tam biehinn khu suong lienpipi toh alam uh a, akulbangte ah singzawl lienpipite akham ua; Phatuom ngaitahin tami nna asem ua akhut nasepna uah alawchingtou mama uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Tuachi’n a upate uh ka houpi ua, Tam bieh inn lam ding leh akulbangte bawlzou dinga noute koi in thu hing pie ahiei? chiin zong ka dong uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute lah a lamkaite min na kunga agel a ka hing theisah theina dingun aminte u’zong ka dong uhi."},"11":{"text":"“Tualeh amaun tambangin ahing dawng uhi. Koute pen Van leh leitung Pasian nasemte ka hi ua; kum tampi peisa lai a, Israel leeng thupi khat in tami inn ana lamzousa ahia, tuin kouten ka lam tha kia uh ahibou hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh kapu ka pate un van Pasian ana suhthangpai ziehun, Aman Babilon leengpa Kaldaimi Nebukadnezzar khut ah amaute ana pekhie a tuachi’n aman tam biehinn asusie a, mipite khu Babilon lam ah apomangta hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.8-12; 2 Khang. 36.17-20; Jer. 52.12-15"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Babilon leengpa Sairas vaihawm kum khatna ah leengpa Sairas in Tami Pasian inn pen lam tha kia na ding thupieh khat abawl hi.","ref":"Ezr. 1.2-11"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem bieh inn sunga kipat a alahdoh a Babilon biehinn sunga akoi sana leh dangka a kibawl um le belte, leengpa Sairas in Babilon biehinn apat aladoh a, gam uhpa a apansah Sheshbazzar kichipa khut ah apekhie hi."},"15":{"text":"Lengpa Sairas in ama kungah, “Tam um leh belte la inlen, pei inlen, Jerusalem biehinn sungah vakoi in, tualeh Pasian inn pen amun ngai mama a lam tha kia ding ahi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam Sheshbazzar ahing pei a, Jerusalem ah Pasian inn suongphum ahing phum hi; tuani apat tuni dongin akilamtou zela, akizou nai sih hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tuaziehin tuin tami leengpa’n pha asah leh Babilon a um leengpa laigelna laibute kisui henlen, leengpa Sairas in Jerusalem a tam Pasian inn lam ding thupieh abawl tahtah na amah chi kithei hen. Tuazou chiengin tam thu ah leengpa’n athupuana hing hah ta heh, chiin agiel uhi.”"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Darius in thupieh abawl a, Babilon a, silluite koikhawmna a laibu poimawte asuita uhi.","title":"Darius in Sairas thupieh anamdetna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Media gam a Ekbatana khopi a leeng innpi sungah laibuziel khat akimudoh a, tuanah hichibangin akigiel hi."},"3":{"text":"“Leengpa Sairas vaihawm kum khatna ah, leengpa Sairas in Jerusalem a Pasian inn tungtangah thupieh khat abawl hi; kithoinate latna mun leh halmang sillalte hing kitawina mun mama ah, Pasian inn lam thakia hi henlen, asuongphumte dettah a phum hi heh, asan lam tong sawm guh, availam zong tong sawm guh hi henlen;"},"4":{"text":"suong lien pipi guol thum leh sing zawl tha lienpipi guol khat in kilam hen, sum sen pouma pen leengpa innpi apat piehdoh hihen."},"5":{"text":"Tuathamlouin, Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem biehinn apat alahdoh a, Babilon a akoi, Sana leh dangka a kibawl um leh belte, nua pieh kia sieng hi henlen, Jerusalem biehinn sunga ama uh mun chiet ah, Pasian inn sungah koi hi uheh,” chiin akigiel hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tuaziehin tuin luipi gal gam a uhpipa: Tattenai leh Shethar-bozenai tualeh nou aseppite, luipi gal a uliente aw, tua mun apat kikhin khie un."},"7":{"text":"Tami Pasian inn lamna ah koima kikum nawn sih un, Judate uhpipa leh Juda upaten tam biehinn amun ngai mama ah lam uhen."},"8":{"text":"Tuathamlouin, tami Pasian inn lam tha kia na ah Juda upate kunga na bawl ding uh, thupieh khat kabawl hi; akilamna sum lut zousie akinthei banga, kim tah a, luipi gal gam a kipata leenggam summunate, sie sum kimute apat a pieh ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Van Pasian mai a halmang sillatte a dinga apoimawte uh bawngtal tuoite, belamtal leh belamte, tualeh Jerusalem a siempute poimaw dungzui in mangbu, chi, grep zu leh sathau tasam lou kei a michin pieh hi heh."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n van Pasian lungkimna dinga sillatte alat theina ding u’leh, leengpa leh atapate hinna dinga, athum pieh theina ding uh ahi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaban ah mi koiin zong tam dan thupiehte ahen leh a inn apat a innkam loikhieh a, tuakhu phudet a, atunga ama khailup ding ahi, tualeh a inn zong eehvum suohsah ding ahi, chiin thupieh kabawl ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tam thupieh henglamdang ahiei, ahisihleh Jerusalem a, Pasian inn suse ding ahiei a khut laam pouma leengpa leh mite zousie, tua mun a teng dinga amin umsahpa Pasian in sumangthai heh. Kei Darius in tam thupieh ka bawlta a, thanuom tah a bawlpai hi heh,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n luipi gal gam a uhpipa Tattenai leh Shethar-Boznai tualeh aseppiten leengpa Darius thupieh ahing hah dungzuiin thanuom tahin abawl pai uhi.","title":"Biehinn zawsiengna"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Hagai leh Iddo tapa Zekariahte thugenlawhna zal in, Juda upaten inn alamtouzel ua, alawchingtou zel uhi. Tuachi’n amauten Israelte Pasian thupieh dungzui leh Persia leengte Sairas leh Darius tualeh Artekserses thupieh dungzui in biehinn alamzou siengta uhi.","ref":"Hag. 1.1; Zek. 1.1"},"15":{"text":"Tuin inn pen Darius leengpa vaihawm akum guhna, Adar ha, anithum ni in lam zou ahita hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel mipite, siempute, Levite leh saltang hing kinuale dang dang ten, Pasian inn latna kipahtahin alawm uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tam Pasian inn latna dingin amaun, bawngtal zakhat, belamtal zani leh belamnou zali alan ua, Israel mi zousie adinga khelna kithoina sillat dingin, Israelte nam zaza keltal sawm leh ni zong alan uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem a Pasian nasem dingin, Mosi laibu a kigiel bangin siempute apawl pawl in tualeh Levite zong amauh tan mun chiet ah akoita uhi."},"19":{"text":"Aha khatna ani sawm leh li ni in saltang hing kinuale ten Peikan pawi abawl uhi.","title":"Peikan pawi","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-20"},"20":{"text":"Siempute leh Levite kisiensuo zousa ahi zieh un, abawn un dan banga siengthou ahita uhi. Tuachi’n saltangte zousie ading leh a unaute uh siempute ading leh ama haw a dingin peikan belam nou agou uhi."},"21":{"text":"Saltanna kipat a hing kinuale Israel tate zousie leh gamsunga Pasian theilou namte kisuhbuana pat a Israelte Mangpa Pasian sui dinga, akung ua hing kituom koite zousie in, tua peikan annkuong a imkhawm uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ni sagi sung tanghou tolsawlou pawi lungdamtah in alawm uhi. Aziehpen Mangpa’n amauh akipahsah a, tualeh Pasian in, Israelte Pasian inn nasepna akhut suhat dingin, Assiria leengpa lungtang amauh lam ah aheita hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte zou in, Persia leengpa Artekserses vaihawm lai in, Seraiah tapa Ezra, Azariah tapa, Hilkiah tapa,","title":"Ezra leh alawite Jerusalem ahawna uh"},"2":{"text":"Hilkiah khu Shalum tapa ahia, Shalum khu Zadok tapa ahia, Zadok khu Ahitup tapa ahia,"},"3":{"text":"Ahitup khu Amariah tapa ahia, Amariah khu Azariah tapa ahi a, Azariah khu Meraioth tapa ahia,"},"4":{"text":"Meraioth khu Zerahiah tapa ahia, Zerahiah khu Uzzi tapa ahia, Uzzi khu Bukki tapa ahi."},"5":{"text":"Bukki khu Abishua tapa ahia, Abishua khu Phinehas tapa ahia, Phinehas khu Eleazar tapa ahia, Eleazar khu siempulian Aaron tapa ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tam Ezra pen Babilon akipat a hing pei ahi. Ama khu laigiel mi leh Mangpa Israel Pasian in apieh Mosi danthu siem mama khat ahi. Mangpa Pasian khut atunga aum ziehin, anget pouma leengpa’n apie hi."},"7":{"text":"Lengpa Artekserses vaihawm kum sagi na kum in Israelte lawikhat, siempute, Levite, lasate, kotpi vengte leh biehinn a nasemte, Jerusalem ah ahing peitou uhi."},"8":{"text":"Lengpa vaihawm akum sagina, aha ngana ah Ezra Jerusalem ah ahing tung hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuami kum aha khatna ani khat ni in, Babilon akipat ahing kipankhie a, a Pasian hepina khut in ama a umpi ziehin, aha ngana ani khat ni in Jerusalem ah ahing tung hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen Ezra in Mangpa danthute sui dingin leh, bawl dingin, tualeh, Israelte lah a adanthu guotte leh avaihawmna dante hil dingin, alungtang akisingsata hi."},"11":{"text":"Lengpa Artekserses in Mangpa thupieh thute, leh Israelte kunga athu guotte, thei leh siemna sangtah nei, laigielpa siempu Ezra kunga apieh laihah kiteikhie khu tami ahi.","title":"Ezra a dinga Artekserses thupieh"},"12":{"text":"Artekserses leengte leengpa’n Van Pasian danthute gielpa siempu Ezra kungah, hamuonna umta hen."},"13":{"text":"Ka leenggam sunga Israelte koizong, asiempute u’leh Levimite zong nang toh zawhkhawm a, Jerusalem a pei nuom pouma apeitou thei ding uhi, chiin keiman thupieh ka bawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Lengpa leh athuhilmi sagi ten, na khut aum na Pasian danthupieh dungzui a Juda gam leh Jerusalem a thu kan dingin nangma ahing kisawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuabanah Jerusalem a teng Israel Pasian kunga, leengpa leh ama thuhil miten akiphalna bang ua apieh uh sana leh dangkate zong na paw dinga,"},"16":{"text":"Babilon gamsung pumpi a na mu ding sana leh dangka zousie leh Jerusalem a um a Pasian uh inn a dinga mipite leh siempute kiphalna sil piehte toh zong na paw khawm ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tam sumte in bawngtalte, belamtal noute leh belam talte leh ann sillatte leh dawn sillatte lei ngei ngei inlen, Jerusalem a na Pasian biehinn a maitam tungah lan in."},"18":{"text":"Nang leh na sanggam Judaten na Pasian uh deina bangbang leh, nouman pha nasah bangun, tua Sana leh dangka kizang valte zang un."},"19":{"text":"Biehinn a na Pasian uh biehna dinga, na khut a tui um belsuon hing kipete zousie, Jerusalem a Pasian mai ah kimtah in pie in."},"20":{"text":"Sil dang na Pasian uh bieh inn a dinga kisam kul leh poimaw na nei pouma leh leengpa sum koina inn akipat na pe thei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Kei leengpa Artekserses in luipi gal gam a um sumkem zousiete kungah, Van Pasian dan gielpa siempu Ezra in na kung ua ahing nget thanuomtah a pieh hi heh, chi in thupieh ka bawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Dangka sia talent zakhat tan, mangbu kor za khat uoin bath zakhat, tualeh Olive thau bath zakhat leh chi tese ngailou in na pie un."},"23":{"text":"Van Pasian in thu apieh poumate, Van Pasian biehinn a dingin, kithalawp tah in kibawl heh. Bangdinga leenggam leh leengpa leh atapate tunga thangpaina tung ding ahiei mah?"},"24":{"text":"Tami zong na thei ding uh ahi. Siempute, Levite lasate, kotpi vengte, biehinn nasemte, ahisihleh tam Pasian bieh inn a nasem dang dangte, tung ah, leiman, sie leh summet bawlna tunga sie lah theina thuneina na nei sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Tualeh nang Ezra in zong, na Pasian pilna na nei bang zel in, tua luipi gal a um, zousie tunga vai ahawm pieh theina dingun, na Pasian danthupieh theimite, thukhen ding leh thubuoi sai mi ding guong in, tualeh Pasian danthupieh theiloute zong zil sah in."},"26":{"text":"Koipou na Pasian dan leh leengpa dan zui nuomlou tungah gawtna khautah, shina khop ahiei, gam a pat delmang ahiei, anei-alam tomgamna ahiei, ahisihleh suongkul a khumna ahiei, thuoh sah tei tei ding ahi,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Jerusalem a um Mangpa Pasian inn kilawmsah dinga, leengpa lungtanga hichibang sil koipa leh;"},"28":{"text":"leengpa leh ama thuhil mite leh amiliente zousie mai a, deisahna hing pepa ipulepate Pasian phat in um hen. Mangpa ka Pasian khut ka tunga um ahiziehin, ka kihangsan sah a, Kei toh zawhtou dingin Israelte lah a lamkaite ka kaikhawmta hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Artekserses vaihawm hun lai a, Babilon apata kei toh peitou khawmte lah a min kikhum innkuon upate tamte ahi uhi.","title":"Ezra toh kile kia innkuon upate"},"2":{"text":"Phinehas hahlesuonte lah a kipat Gershom, Ithamar, hahlesuonte lah a kipat Daniel, David hahlesuonte lah apat Hattush."},"3":{"text":"Shekaniah hahlesuonte lah apat. Parosh hahlesuonte lah a pat, Zekariah ama toh khangthu suina a min khum khawm pasal za leh sawmnga ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pahath-Moab hahlesuonte lah apat, Zekariah tapa. Elihoenai, ama toh min khum khawm mi zani ahi."},"5":{"text":"Zattu hahlesuonte lah ah, Jahaziel tapa Shekaniah, ama toh min khum khawm mi za thum ahi."},"6":{"text":"Adin hahlesuonte lah apat, Jonathan tapa Ebed, ahia, ama toh min khum khawm mi sawm nga ahi."},"7":{"text":"Elam hahlesuonte lah apat, Athalia tapa Jeshaiah ahia, ama toh, min khum khawmte mi sawm sagi ahi."},"8":{"text":"Shephatiah hahlesuonte lah ah, Mikael tapa Zebadiah ahia, ama toh min khum khawmte pasal sawm giet ahi."},"9":{"text":"Joab hahlesuonte lah a pat, Jehiel tapa Obadiah ahia, ama toh min khum khawmte mi zani leh sawm khat leh giet ahi."},"10":{"text":"Bani hahlesuonte lah a pat, Joshiphiah tapa Shelomith ahia, ama toh min khum khawmte mi za leh sawm guh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Bebai hahlesuonte lah apat, Bebai tapa Zekariah ahia, ama toh min khum khawmte mi sawmni leh giet ahi."},"12":{"text":"Azgad hahlesuonte lah apat, Hakatan tapa Johanan ahia, ama toh min khum khawmte mi za leh sawm khat ahi."},"13":{"text":"Adonikam hahlesuonte lah apat a ahing pei nukhiate amin uh tamte ahi, Eliphelet, Jei el leh Shemaiah ahi ua, amautoh min khum khawm mi sawm guh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Bigvai hahlesuonte lah apat, Uthai leh Zakkur ahi ua, amautoh min khum khawm mi sawm sagi ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ken amaute, Ahava lam a luong suh tuilam ah ka puikhawm a, tuanah ni thum sung giehphuol ah ka kikul uhi, tualeh mipite leh siempute lah ka et leh Levimite khat zong ka muta sih hi.","title":"Jerusalem a kinuale kiana"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute lah a lamkai Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekariah leh Meshullam te leh theisiemna nei Joiarib leh Elnathante zong ka han sah hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh amaute Kasiphia mun a lamkai Iddo kungah ka sawl a, Iddo leh a unau Nethinimte Kasiphia mun a biehinn a anaseppite kungah, i Pasian biehinn a nasem ding mihing sawl dingin gen un chi’n ka hil hi."},"18":{"text":"I Pasian uh hepina khut ka tung ua, a um ziehin, amauten theisiemna nei mi, Israel tapa, Levi tapa, Mahli hahlesuonte lah a khat Sherebiah kichipa leh atapate leh aunaute, uh sawmni leh giet,"},"19":{"text":"tualeh Hashabiah leh Merari hahlesuonte lah a Jeshaiah toh unaute leh atapate abawn un sawmni zong ahing zawpi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaban ah David leh avaihawmpiten Levi mite kithuopi dinga ana guot tuom uh biehinn nasem mi za ni leh sawmni, zong ahing zawpi uhi. Amaute amin min ua, minkhumna a min kikhumte ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n i Pasian mai a ka kingai ngiem theina ding u’leh, katu ka tate utoh, ka nei ka lam zousie utoh bit tah a, ka zinsuoh theina ding ua, ka thum theina dingun, Ahava lui gei ah, ann ngawl ding thu ka phuongta hi.","title":"Ahava lui a ann ngawlna"},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen lampi a melmate lah a kipat hing veng ding, leengpa kunga galkapte leh sakoltungtuong galkapte nget ding zum huoi kasa hi. Aziehpen kouten leengpa kungah, “Ka Pasian uh maipha sui poumate tungah akhotuona khut a um a, Ama taisan poumate tungah alungthahna a um hi,” chiin kana gen zouta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n ann ka ngawlta ua, tualeh tami a dingin ka Pasian uh kungah ka ngen ua, Aman ka ngetna uh ahing dawng hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu lamkaite lah a kipat in sawmleh ni, Sherebiah, Hashabiah leh aunau uh sawm khat toh ka guot tuomta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh i Pasian inn a dinga, leengpa leh ama thuhilmite leh avaihawm liente leh khuna um Israelmi zousie in, apieh uh sana dangka leh um le belte tua ka mi guot tuomte puoh dingin ka te piehta hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka khut mama ua ka te pieh dangka sia talent za guh leh sawmnga dangka sia ma a kibawl um leh bel, talent zakhat leh sana talent zakhat leh,"},"27":{"text":"Sana a kibawl hengkuong sawmni, darik tulkhat man leh sum-eng kinawtval singseng a kibawl sana banga mantam um le bel ni toh ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Ken amaute kungah, “Noute Mangpa a dingin na siengthou ua, um leh belte zong a siengthou hi, tualeh sana leh dangkate pen, Mangpa na pu napate uh Pasian mai a ut thu a sillatte ahi."},"29":{"text":"Jerusalem a Mangpa inn a indante sunga na siempu lamkaite leh Levite tualeh Israel innkuon a upate mai a na te masangsie un pilvang tahin tam silte kembit un,” ka chi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempute leh Leviten, Jerusalema Mangpa inn a dinga, sana, dangka leh um leh bel siengthou kite sate puoh dingin alata uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n aha khatna ani sawm leh ni niin, Jerusalem lam a pei dingin, Ahava lui a kipat in ka kipankhie ua, tualeh i Pasian uh khut ka tung uah a um a, melmate khut apat leh lampi a, hing na guhtante khut apat in, ahing humbitta hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem ah ka hing tung ua, khunah ni thum ka um uhi."},"33":{"text":"Ani li niin, i Pasian inn sungah, sana, dangka leh um leh bel siengthoute, siempu Uria tapa Meremoth khut ah te dohin a um a, ama kungah Phinehas tapa Eleazar a um a, Levite Jeshua tapa Jozabad leh Binnui tapa Noadiah zong a um uhi."},"34":{"text":"Bangkim atam dan leh agih dan akisim a, akite a, tua hun mama in laibu ah akichiemte hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n saltanna a hing kinuale kiaten, Israel Pasian kungah, Israel pumpi a, dinga halmang sillat dingin, bawngtal sawm leh ni leh khelna sillat dingin belamtal sawmkuo leh guh, belamnou sawm sagi leh sagi tualeh keltal sawm leh nih alan uhi tamte zousie abawn un, Mangpa adinga halmang sillat ahi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa thupiehte khu leenggam uhpipate leh luipi gal gam uhpipate kungah apekhie uhi, tuachi’n amaun mipite leh Pasian inn lamna, panpina apie uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte akibawl zou in, lamkaite ka kungah ahing pei ua, “Israel mipite, siempute leh Levimite tam gam mite apat akituomkoi sih uhi, Kanaanmite, Hitmite, Perizmite, Jebusmite, Ammonmite, Moabmite, Iziptmite leh Amormite, kidahhuoi gamtatnate apat akituomkoi sih uhi.","title":"Agam mite toh kitenpolna"},"2":{"text":"Amaun ama ua ding leh atapate uh zi dingin tam mite tanute ala ta ua, tuachi’n chi siengthou khu tam gam mite toh akitohpolta hi. Tambanga gitloutatna ah lamkaite leh vaihawmte khut amasa pen in apang uhi,” chiin ka kungah ahing gen uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ken tam thu ka zah tah in ka puonah leh ka puontuol ka botkeh a, ka lujang a ka sam leh ka khamul ka botkhie a, mangbangin ka touta hi.","title":"Ezra lungkhamna"},"4":{"text":"Tuabepin sal a puimanga umte tatkhelna zieh a, Israel Pasian thu a zau a chitunte pouma ka kungah ahing kikhawm ua, kei pen nitah lam kithoi hun tandong lamdang sain ka tou hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh nitahlam kithoi hun in, ka ann ngawlna a kipat ka puonah leh ka puontuol kibokehsa pumin ka khupdin a, Mangpa ka Pasian kunga ka khutte jahin thu ka ngen hi.","title":"Pasian muonhuoina"},"6":{"text":"“Ka Pasian aw, Nang ka Pasian lam en a dahtou ding ka zum senga, ka zala seng hi; ka gitlounate uh ka luvum sang un asang zawta, ka khelnate un van asuta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate hun lai a kipat in tuni tandongin ka khelna uh alien sengta hi, tualeh ka khelnate uh ziehin koute leh ka leengpate u’leh, ka siempute uh, gamdang leengte khut sungah, namsau a tha ding, sal a puiding leh sietna leh maizumna tuoh dinga tuni a banga piehkhiet kana hita uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin vang ka Pasian un ka mit uh ahing suhvahpieh theina ding leh ka saltanna ua pat halthana neu khat ahing pieh theina ding a suohta pawl khat hing khawi sah ding leh amun siengthou a umdetna hing pe dingin, Mangpa ka Pasian ua pat hun tomkhat sunga dingin hepina ahing musahta hi."},"9":{"text":"Saltang nan uleng zong, ka Pasian un ka saltan na ua kipat ahing nuasie sih a, Aman Persia leengte mitmu in a itna muonhuoi ahing langsah a ka Pasian uh inn lamdoh ding leh asietnate bawltha dingin hinna tha ahing pie hi."},"10":{"text":"“Hinanleh tuin, Aw ka Pasian uh, tamte nuain bang ka genta ding uoi leh? Aziehpen na thupiehte kana taisanta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Na nasem guolneite tungtawn a na thugen, Luo dinga na valutna ding uh gam pen agam mite thangtatna zieh a gam bua ahia, agamtatna kidahhuoite un, gam mong khat a kipat among langkhat dong sienthoulouna in adimsah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin na tanute uh atapate uh zi dingin pesih unlen, atanute uh na tapate uh zi dingin zong lasih un, tualeh anopsahna u’leh ahausatna uh suisih un, tuachi’n na hat ding ua, agam hoina gate na ne ding ua, tualeh na tate ua dinga kumtawn goutan dinga na nuasie theina dingun.","ref":"Pawt. 34.11-16; Danp. 7.1-5"},"13":{"text":"Ka gitlouna u’leh ka khelnate uh athupi seng taah zieh a, ka tung ua hing tung silte zousie nua in, Nang ka Pasian un, ka khelnate uh zieh a ka mu ding u’toh kituoh gawtnate sanga tawmzaw in na hing gawt a, tualeh tambangin adam um sunte na hing khawi nalai chi, ka mu un;"},"14":{"text":"Na thupiehte palsan kia in, tambang sil kidahhuoi bawl mite toh ka kitengtuo kia ding uoi mah? a um sun um nawnlou ding leh asuohta umsah nawnlou ding khop a na hing suhgam masangsie’n ka tung uah na thangpai sih ding amah?"},"15":{"text":"Aw Israelte Mangpa Pasian, nang na dihtat hi tuni a bangin kou asuohta um nalai sunsunte, nang khawi nalai hi; ka khelnate uh zieh a, na mai a ding taah hisih nan uleng zong, ka khelnate u’pum in na mai ah ka um uhi.”"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ezra kap kawm a Pasian inn mai a, kilawmlie a, khelnate phuong a thupha tawi a athum lai in, Israelte lah a pat in pasal, numei leh naupang tampi, mipi nasatah in ahing kikhawm ua, amaute zong hasetahin akapta uhi.","title":"Anamdangmi zite utoh kikhenna"},"2":{"text":"Elam hahlesuonte lah a khat, Jehiel tapa Shekaniah in Ezra kungah, agam sunga teng namdang numeite zi a kana kitenpitah zieh un, “I Pasian u’tung ah kana gitloutat khata uhi, Hinanleh, tuin tami tungtang ah Israel ding in kinepna a um nalai hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, ka pu hing thuhilna leh i Pasian thupieh zau a chitun poumate thuhilna dung zuiin zite zousie leh ama-ua pieng tate zousie koimang dingin, i Pasian u’toh thuhun ibawl ding uhi, tualeh tami dan dungzui tah a bawl hi heh."},"4":{"text":"Kisa inlen bawl in, tami nang nasep ding ahi, kouten ka hing panpi ding uhi, kisuhangsan inlen bawl in,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ezra adingdoh a, siempu lamkaite leh Levimite leh Israel mi zousie, akigensa thute banga bawl dingin akichiem sahta hi, tuachi’n akichiemta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ezra khu Pasian inn mai a kipat in a dingdoh a, Eliashib tapa Jehohanan pindan ah alut a, khunah ann nelou tui dawnlou in, saltangte gin umlounate zieh a lungkham in, khumi zan a um hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda gamsung leh Jerusalem a um, saltang hing kilekia zousie kungah, Jerusalem a hing kikhawm dingin thuphuon abawl uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ni thum sunga hing peilou pouma, vaihawmte leh upate thuphuon dungzui a, anei alam zousie uh lahpieh ding ahi tualeh saltaangte lah a pat khenkhiet ahi ding hi chi aphuong uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n ni thum sungin, Juda gam leh Benjamin gam sunga mite zousie Jerusalem ah ahing kikhawm uhi. Aha kuona ani sawmni niin, mi zousie Pasian bieh inn mai leituol ah, tami thu zieh leh guo ha zuh seng zieh a chitun in atou uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu Ezra adingtou a, amaute kungah, “Noute na muonhuoi sih ua, gamdang numeite na kitenpi ua, Israelte khelna na pungsah semsem uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin Mangpa napu napate uh Pasian kungah na khelna uh phuong in, thupha tawi unlen, a deilam bawl un, agam mite leh na gamdang zite utoh kikhen unlen kituomkoi un,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mipi kikhawmte zousie in aw ngaitah in adawng ua, “Ahima hi, na genbangin ka bawl ngei ngei ding uhi, achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh mipi atam mama a, guo tampi zuh hun laitahma ahi a, leituol ah ka ding zou nawn sih uhi, tualeh tami nasep pen ni khat ni ni sunga kibawlzou thei ding ahi sih hi, aziehpen tami tungtangah mi tampi kana khielta uhi."},"14":{"text":"I vaihawm miliente uh mipi kikhawm zousiete taangin ding u’henlen, tam sil zieh a i Pasian uh thangpaina eite akipat akiheimang masang siein i khopite ua, gamdangmi zi a neite zousie, khopi chin a upate leh vaihawmte toh, hun kiguot pieh chiet ah hing peita uheh.”"},"15":{"text":"Asahel tapa Jonathan leh Tikvah tapa Jazeiah maimai in tam thu aniel ua, tualeh Levimi Meshullam leh Shabbethai in amaute apanpi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n saltang hing kile kiaten, tuabangin abawlta uhi. Siempu Ezra in, apulepate uh innkuon dung zui a, a upate aphung min chiet dungzui in atelkhie hi. Aha sawm na, ani khat niin tua thu en chien dingin atoukhawmta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Aha khatna ani khat niin, gamdang numei zi a neite zousie akan chien zouta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Siempute hahlesuonte lah a, gamdang numei kitenpite mudoh ahita a, amaute tamte ahi uh: Zadok tapa Jeshua hahlesuonte leh a unaute lah ah: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib leh Gedaliah, ahi uhi.","title":"Gamdang numei zi a kitenpite"},"19":{"text":"Amauten azite uh koidoh dingin thuchiem abawl ua, mawtanga um ahi zieh un, mawna thoina dingin belam hon lah akipat belamtal khat chiet alan uhi."},"20":{"text":"Immer hahlesuonte lah ah, Hanani leh Zebadiah."},"21":{"text":"Harim hahlesuonte lah ah, Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel leh Uzziah."},"22":{"text":"Pashur hahlesuonte lah ah, Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad leh Elasah."},"23":{"text":"Levite lah ah: Zozabad, Shemei, Kelaiah, (tua khu Kelita ahi) Pethahiah, Juda leh Eliezer."},"24":{"text":"Lasate lah ah: Eliashib kotpi vengte lah ah: Shallum, Telem leh Uri."},"25":{"text":"Israelte lah ah: Parosh hahlesuonte lah ah: Ramiah, Izziah, Malkijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah leh Benaiah."},"26":{"text":"Elam hahlesuonte lah ah. Mattaniah, Zekariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth leh Eliah."},"27":{"text":"Jattu hahlesuonte lah ah: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad leh Aziza."},"28":{"text":"Bebai hahlesuonte lah ah: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai leh Athlai."},"29":{"text":"Bani hahlesuonte lah ah: Meshullam, Malluk, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal leh Jeremoth."},"30":{"text":"Pahath-Moab hahlesuonte lah ah: Adna, Kelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui leh Manasseh."},"31":{"text":"Harim hahlesuonte lah ah: Eliezer, Ishijah, Malkijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,"},"32":{"text":"Benjamin, Malluk leh Shemariah."},"33":{"text":"Hashum hahlesuonte lah ah: Mattenai, Matattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh leh Shimei."},"34":{"text":"Bani hahlesuonte lah ah: Maadai, Amram, Uel,"},"35":{"text":"Benaiah, Bedeiah, Keluh."},"36":{"text":"Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,"},"37":{"text":"Mattaniah, Mattenai leh Jaasu."},"38":{"text":"Binnui hahlesuonte lah ah: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,"},"39":{"text":"Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,"},"40":{"text":"Maknadebai, Shashai, Sharai,"},"41":{"text":"Azareel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,"},"42":{"text":"Shallum, Amariah leh Joseph."},"43":{"text":"Nebo hahlesuonte lah ah: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel leh Benaiah."},"44":{"text":"Tamte zousie in gamdang numei zi in anei ua, tualeh alah ua mi loikhat in azite u’toh ta lenaute zong anei uhi."}}}}},"16":{"info":{"name":"Nehemiah","shortname":"Neh.","abbr":[],"desc":"Nehemiah laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hakaliah tapa Nehemiah thute; kum sawmnina kum, Kisleu ha in, susa leeng innpi a ka um lai in, hichi ahing hi a.","title":"Nehemiah in Jerusalem tanchin azahna"},"2":{"text":"Ka sanggamte mi khat Hanani leh mi pawl khat Juda gam a kipat ahing pei uhi. Ken amaute kungah, sal a puimanga umlou a nuasie a um sun Judate tungtang thu leh Jerusalem tungtang thu kana dong hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaun ka kungah, “Sal a pui a umlou a nuasie a suohta sun, tua gam a um nalaite, gim thuohna nasatah leh zum leh simmaw in a um ua, Jerusalem kulbangte lah suhchip in a uma, akotpite mei in akatumta hi,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tam thute ka zahtah in ka tou suh a ka kapta hi, ni bangza ahiei sung hasie in ann ka ngawl a, van Pasian mai ah ka thumta hi.","title":"Nehemiah thumna"},"5":{"text":"“Aw Mangpa Van Pasian, Pasian thupi leh zauhuoi, Nang hing it a, na thupiehte zui mite toh kaal a itna thuhun kem ngitngetpa aw,"},"6":{"text":"na suohpa’n na mi Israelte a dinga tu a, asun azan a, na masanga ka thumna za dingin, na bil hing daw inlen, na mit hah sah in, Israel taten na tunga ka khelnate uh thupha ka hing tawi uhi. Kei leh ka pa innkuonte kana khielta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na tungah giloutahin Kana gamta ua, na suoh Mosi kunga na thupiehte, na thugousiete leh na vaihawmna dan thute kana zuita sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Na suoh Mosi kunga na thupieh; Na muonhuoi sih ua ahileh namte lah ah ka hing thethang ding hi.","ref":"Siempu. 26.33"},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh ka kunga na hing kile kia ua, ka thupiehte na zui ua na bawl u’leh, vantawp gamlapen tan a nawdohin umnan ulachin zong, tuana kipat in amauh ka khawm dinga, ka min umna dinga ka telna mun ngei ah ka puikhawm kia ding hi, na chi thute thei ngitnget dingin ka hing ngen ahi.","ref":"Danp. 30.1-5"},"10":{"text":"Tamte na silbawltheina nasatah leh na khut hat a na tatsa na suohte leh na mite ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa aw, ka hing ngen ahi, hepitahin na suohpa thumna leh na suohte thugetna na bil in za henlen na min zatat nuom na suohte langah na bil hing daw inlen, tuni’n tam mipa mitmu in na deisahna hing pie inlen, hing lawching sahin. Khum hun lai in kei leengpa nou dompa ka hi.”"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Artekserses vaihawm kum sawmnina kum Nisan ha in, leengpa mai ah uoin a um a: tuakhu kala a leengpa ka pie hi. Amai ah nidangin damel ka pokha ngai sih hi.","title":"Artekserses in Nehemiah Jerusalem a asawlna"},"2":{"text":"Tuazieh in leengpa’n ka kungah, “Adammaw lah na hi vawtsin, bangzieh a damel puo na hiei? Tam pen lungtang dana loungal bangma dang ahisih hi,” achia, tuachi’n kei ka zau mamata hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ken leengpa kungah, “Leengpa dam sawt hen, ka pu ka pate kivuina khopi susiet gawp in a um a, akawtpite mei in akatum sienga, bang zieh a damel louthei ding ka hiei?” ka chi hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.8-10; 2 Khang. 36.19; Jer. 52.12-14"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n ka kungah, “Bang na ngen ut ei?” a hing chi a, tuachi’n van Pasian kungah ka thum a,"},"5":{"text":"tuachi’n leengpa kungah, “Leengpa’n pha nasah a, na suohpan na mitmu a deisahna katan leh Juda gam ah kapu ka pate kivuina khopi ka lamtha theina dingin hing sawl dingin ka’ng ngen hi,” ka chi hi."},"6":{"text":"Lengpa’n ka kungah (Lengnu zong akungah atou a) “Na khuolzin sung bang tan a sawt ding ahiei? tualeh bangchih chienga hing kile kia ding na hiei?” chi’n ahing dong hi. Tuachi’n leengpa’n ahing sawl ding pha asah ziehin, Ken ahun bihieh khat leengpa ka pie hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa kungah, “Lengpa’n pha na sahleh, Juda gam ka tun masangsie a bittah a ka pei suoh theina dingin, luipi gal gam a uhpipate ading laihah hing tawi sah in;"},"8":{"text":"tualeh leengpa gammang kempa Asaph in biehinn kul kotpite a ding, khopi kulbaang ading leh ka umna ding inn ading singtunte ahing pieh theina dingin ama lai ding hing tawi sah in,” ka chi hi. Tuachi’n ka Pasian hepina khut ka tunga aum ziehin leengpa’n ka ngette ahing phal pieh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Luipi gal gam a uhpipate kungah ka hing tunga, a kung uah leengpa laihahte ka pie hi. Lengpa’n galkap lamkaite leh sakol tungtuong miten zong kei ahing zui sah hi."},"10":{"text":"Horon mi Sanballat leh Ammon mite ulien Tobiah in tam thu azah tah un, Israel mite hoina ding sui ding mi khat ahing tungta chi azah tah un, apatau mamata uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem ka hing tunga, tuanah nithum ka um hi.","title":"Jerusalem tunna leh kulbaang velna"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n zanlai in ka thou khie a, mi phabepkhat toh ka kithuo a, Jerusalem bawl dingdan ka Pasian in ka lungtanga akoi khu koima ka hil sih hi; atunga ka tuonna ganta chilou ka kungah ganta khat zong a um sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Zanlai in ka pawtdoh a, phaiguom kotpi zui in ka pei a, dragon tuikul leh eehvum kotpi ka tunga, Jerusalem kulbang chimsate leh mei kahtumsa kotpite ka en hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuinah kotpi leh leengpa dil manaw in ka pei a, hinanleh ka tuonna ganta pei theina ding mun a um sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n zanlai in phaiguom zui in ka peitou a, kulbangte ka vel hi. Tuachi’n ka kinuale kia a, phaiguom kotpi ah ka lut a, ka hing kile-kiata hi."},"16":{"text":"Vaihawmte leh mi lienten, hei a pei a, bang ahiei ka bawl, chi athei sih uhi, aziehpen tam thu Judate kungah hitaleh siempute leh miliente tualeh vaihawm mite leh nasem dingte kung hitaleh koima kungah ka hil nai sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute kungah, “I din mun asiet dan na mu ua, Jerusalem asiet gawp dan leh a kotpite mei in akatumta chi namu uhi, kisa un, simmaw a ium nawnlou na ding un, Jerusalem kulbaangte lamtha kia vai,” ka chi hi.","title":"Nehemiah in mipite ahantawhna"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka tunga ka Pasian hepina khut a um dan leh leengpa’n ka kunga agen thute zong amaute ka hil hi. “Tuachi’n amauten kisa vai in kulbang ilam ding uhi,” achi uhi. Tuachi’n na hoi sem dingin akhutte uh asuhatta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Horon mi Sanballat leh Ammon mite ulien Tobiah leh Arab mi Geshem in, tam thu azah tahun, simmaw leh enghou in ahing nuisan ua, “Bang bawla kinei nahi uoi? Lengpa tunga hel sawm na hi uoi mah?” ahing chi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ken amauh ka dawnga, “Van Pasian in koute ahing lawching sah ding hi, tuaziehin ama suoh koute, ka kipanta ding ua, ka lam ding uhi, hinanleh noute’n Jerusalem ah tanvou ahiei, thuneina ahiei, nou a na chi thei ding u’zong na nei sih uhi,” ka chi hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siempu lien Aliashib leh asiempu hipite toh akipan ua, belam kotpi alamtha uhi. Asiensuona abawl ua, akotkhate a thuo uhi, Zakhat innsang dong leh Hananeel innsang tan dong alam ua, asiensuo uhi.","title":"Kulbaang lamte"},"2":{"text":"Ama ban ah Jerikou miten alam ua, tualeh amaute ban ah Imri tapa Zakkur in alam hi."},"3":{"text":"Hassenaah tapaten Nga kotpi alam ua, amauten ainnkam zawlte ahung ua, akotkhate akilnate leh akalna zawlte abawl uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amauh ban ah Hakkoz tapa Uria tapa Meremoth in abawlpha hi. Amaute ban ah Meshezabeel tapa, Berekiah tapa Meshullam in asiempha hi, tualeh amauh ban ah Ban a tapa Zadok in asiempha hi."},"5":{"text":"Amauh ban ah Tekoa miten abawlpha ua, hinanleh a mi liente un, a Mangpa uh nasepna ah athanuom sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Paseah tapa Joiada leh Besodeiah tapa Meshullam in kotpi lui abawlpha ua, azawlpite hungin akotkhate leh akilnate leh azawlte athuo uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute ban ah Gibeon mi Melatiah leh Meronoth mi Jadon, Gibeon mi leh Mizpah miten luipi gal gam uhpipa thuneina nuoi a kikoina tandong abawlpha uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute ban ah sana kheng mite lah Harhaiah tapa Uziel in abawlpha hi. Ama ban ah gimnamtui bawl mi khat Hananiah in abawlpha a, amauten kulbang lienpi dongin Jerusalem kulbang asiempha uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute ban ah, Jerusalem gamkai kimkhat a vaihawmpa, Hur tapa Rephaiah in abawlpha hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute ban ah Harumaph tapa Jedaiah in ama inn toh kimaingat tan abawlpha hi. Ama ban ah Hashabneiah tapa Hattush in abawlpha hi."},"11":{"text":"Harim tapa Malkijah leh Pahath-Moab tapa Hashub in mundang leh meikhuh innsang abawlpha uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute ban ah, Jerusalem gamkai kimkhat a vaihawmpa Hallohesh tapa Shallum in atanute toh abawlpha uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hanun leh Zanoah a tengten phaiguom kotpi abawlpha ua alamtha ua, akotkhate leh akilnate leh azawlte abul ua, eehvum kotpi dong kulbang tong tul khat dong asiempha uhi."},"14":{"text":"Rekab tapa Malkijah, Beth-Hakerem gamkai kimkhat a vaihawmpain Ehvum kotpi abawlpha a, aman alamtha a, akotkhate leh akilnate leh azawlte abul hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh tuikhuh kotpi khu Mizpah gamkai kimkhat a vaihawmpa Kol-Hozeh tapa Shallum in abawlpha a, aman alamtha a, akhu khum a, tualeh akotte leh akilnate leh azawlte abul tuoh hi. Lengpa huon gei a Shelah diil kulbang zong abawlpha a, David khopi akipat a chiel kidawsuh dong abawlpha hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama nua ah, Beth-Zur gamkai kimkhat a vaihawmpa Azbuk tapa Nehemiah in David han toh kimaingat mun dong leh diil kibawlthu leh Mihatte inn tandong a siempha hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama nua ah, Bani tapa Rehum lamkaiin Levi miten abawlpha uhi. Ama ban ah Keilah gamkai kimkhat vaihawmpa Hashabiah in ama gamkai sung abawlpha hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama nua ah Hadad tapa Binnui Keila gamkai kimkhat a danga vaihawmpa lamkai in agammi hipite toh kulbang abawlpha uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ama ban ah Mizpah gam vaihawmpa Jeshua tapa Ezer in mun dang, galvan koina mai a peitouna akipat aningkiu dong abawlpha hi."},"20":{"text":"Amaute ban ah Zabbai tapa Baruk in tuami ningkiu akipat in siempulien Eliashib inn kotkha dong kulbang sekhen dang khat abawlpha hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama ban ah, Uria tapa Meremoth in Sekhen dang, Eliashib inn kotkha akipan tua inn tawp dong asiempha hi. Uria khu Hakkoz tapa ahi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute ban ah, tua gam mite leh siempute’n abawlpha uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute ban ah, Benjamin leh Hashub in amauh inn mazawn abawlpha ua, amaute ban ah Maaseiah tapa Azariah in amauh inn kung abawlpha uhi. Maaseiah khu Anania tapa ahi."},"24":{"text":"Amauh ban ah Henadad tapa Binnui in sekhendang khat Azariah inn akipat kulbang kawina tan, aning tan dongin abawlpha hi."},"25":{"text":"Uzai tapa Palal in kulbang kawina leh galveng mite inntuol kunga, leengpa a innsang sahta zaw hing dawhkhie zawn a kipat, abawlpha hi. Ama ban ah Parosh tapa Pedaiah leh,"},"26":{"text":"Ophel muola teng biehinn a nasemten suolam a, tui kotpi leh innsang dawhkhie zawn tandong abawlpha uhi."},"27":{"text":"Amaute ban ah, Tekoa miten sekhen dang khat, Ophel kulbanga kipat innsang dawhkhie thupi tandong abawlpha uhi."},"28":{"text":"Sakol kotpi tunga pat siempute’n amauh inn zawn chiet abawlpha uhi."},"29":{"text":"Amaute ban ah, Immer tapa Zadok in ama inn zawn abawlpha hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama ban ah Shelemiah tapa Hananiah leh Zalaph tapa guhna Hanun in Sekhen khat abawlpha uhi. Amaute ban ah, Berekiah tapa Meshullam in ama tenna inn zawn abawlpha hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama ban ah, sana kheng mi tapa Malkijah in biehinn nasemte leh summet bawl mite inn toh kimaingat a um etdihna kotpi dong leh aninga inndan tungnung tandong abawlpha hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh aningkawi a, inndan tungnung leh belam kotpi kikaal pen sana kheng mite leh summetbawl miten abawlpha uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh hichi ahi a, Sanballat in kulbang ka lam uh chi azahtah in, alungthah a, athangpai mama a, Judate asimmawta hi.","title":"Simmaw bawlna toh dalna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh a unaute mai ah leh Samaria galkapte mai ah: “Tam Juda zawngkhalten bang ahiei abawl uh? Abangte lamtha kia ding uh adiei? Kithoinate anei ding uh adiei? Ni khat sunga lamzou ding uh adiei? Tam baang chimsa leh akagawpsa suong kisievumte bawltha thei kia ding uh adiei?” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualaitah in Ammon mi Tobiah akungah aum a, “Akulbang lamsate uh tungah Si-al nangawn va kaltou leh asuongbangte uh asuchim siengta sih diei,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Aw ka Pasian uh, hing ngaikhie in, simmaw in ka umta uh, ahing engbawlnate uh amaute lutungah tusah inlen, saltanna gam a gallah vante bangin amauh pekhie in."},"5":{"text":"Agitlounate uh liekhu sinlen, na mitmu in akhelnate uh nuoimang sin, aziehpen kulbang lam mite mai ah nangma ahing lungthah sahta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n kulbang ka lam ua, Kulbang lam miten nasep thanopna lungsim anei zieh un, kulbang zousie asanna kimkhat tan dong ka lamtouta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Sanballat leh Tobiah tualeh Arab mite, Ammonmite leh Ashdod miten, Jerusalem kulbang akibawltha a, ahawmte akihubit panta chi azah tah un, alungthah mama uhi."},"8":{"text":"A bawn ua hing kuon a, Jerusalem hing dou leh ka nasep uh hing subuoi dingin thu akikumta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka Pasian uh kungah ka thum ua, tualeh amaute apat a sun leh zan a hing veng dingin galveng mite ka koi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuabang hunlaitahin Juda in “Nasem mite hatna lah agimgawpta a, van sete lah atam mama nalai a, tuaziehin kulbang lam theilou ka hita uh,” achi hi.","title":"Lungkiahsahna toh dal tupna"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh ka melmate un, “Alah ua iva pei a, i vatha ua, anasep uh itawpsah masangsie’n theilou leh mu theilou ding ahi uh,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute kim a teng Judate ahing pei ua, sawmvei tah ka kung uah, “Atena mun zousie ua kipat hing dou ding uh ahi,” chiin ahing gen uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n kulbang nualam a ngiem na munte leh mun awngte ah, a innkuon dung zui un, anamsaute utoh, ateipite u’leh athalpite utoh ka koita hi."},"14":{"text":"Tamte ka et kimvel zouin, ka dingdoh a, miliente leh vaihawmte leh mipi dangte kungah, “Amaute zau mawngmawng sih un, athupi leh agiinhuoi mama Mangpa thei ngitnget unlen, na sanggamte u’leh, na tapate u’leh na tanute u’leh na zite u’leh na innte ua dingin galdou un” ka chi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka melmate un asil guh bawlte uh kana theikheta uh chi leh Pasian in asil guh bawlte uh alawsam sahta chi athei tahun, ka bawn un kulbang lam a ka nasepna mun chiet uah ka hing kinuale kiata uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ni akipat in ka mite kimkhat in nna asem ua, akimkhat in, teipite, lumte, thalte leh awmphawte in akivon uh a, tualeh lamkaite pen Juda innkuonte nua langah a um uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kulbang lam mite leh vansete nawn a puohgih paw miten akhut langkhat ua galvan tawi in, akhut langkhat un nna asem uhi."},"18":{"text":"Kulbang lamte zousie in zong alam kawm un apang uah, namsau akuo chiet uhi. Pengkul mutpa pen ka kungah aum ngitnget hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh milien leh vaihawmte leh mipi dangte kungah, “Nasep athupi in alien a, eite lah kulbang tungah gamla pipi in iki hal uhi."},"20":{"text":"Heisung mun ah zong pengkul ging na zah pouma chiengun, koute lam ah hing taikhawm chiet un Pasian in eite a dinga hing doupieh ding ahi,” ka chi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n nna ka sem ua, akimkhatten zingmawng phalvah akipat in aasi hing kilat dong in teipite atawi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuami hunlai in zong Ken mipite kungah, “Zan chiengin pasal koizong apanpipa toh Jerusalem khosung ah zan tungtawn in um uheh, zankaal a koute ahing ven ua, sun chienga nna asep theina ding un,” chiin zong ka gen hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuazieh in, kei hita leng, kei hing zui ka unaute hitaleh, ka kunga hing zui vengmite hitaleh, koiman ka puonsilte uh ka sut sih ua, michin in azietlam khut uah galvan atawi chiet uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin mipite leh azite uh, a unau Juda te ‘tungah nasatah a lungkim lou in ahing kikouta uhi.","title":"Gentheite panpina dinga Nehemiah dan bawl"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen pawl khat in “Koute leh ka tapate u’leh ka tanute utoh tampi ka hi ua, ka neh ua ka hin theina ding un bu leh bal ka nga ding uh ahi,” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Midang pawl khat ma in lah, “Kiel sunga nehletah ka mu theina dingun, ka loute u’leh ka grep huonte uh tualeh ka innte uh mikhut ah kana koi zouta uhi,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Pawl khatte leu leu inlah, “Ka loute u’leh ka grep huonte uh mikhut a koi in leengpa kungah sie pieh dingin sum kana bat lah uhi, achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuin ka unaute utoh chi khat sa khat ka hi ua, ka tapate u’zong amauh tapate bang bang ahi uhi. Ahivang in ka tapate u’leh ka tanute uh suoh leh sal dingin ut lou sasa in ka sawlta uh a, ka tanute uh pawlkhat sal in atang zouta uhi, achi uhi. Amauh tatdohna dingin kouten thahatna bangma ka nei sih uhi, aziehpen ka loute u’leh ka grep huonte uh midangten atangta uhi,” chi zong a um uhi."},"6":{"text":"Akikouna u’leh tam thute a alungkim lounate uh ka zahtah in ka lungthah mamata hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachia, ka kingaituo zouin, miliente leh vaihawmte ka phawh a, akung uah, “Nouten na unaute uh tungah apung dei in sum na batlah sah uhi,” ka chi hi. Tuachi’n atungthu uh ngaituo dingin kikhopna thupitah khat ka bawlta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 22.25; Siempu. 25.35-37; Danp. 23.19,20"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken akung uah, “Namdangte kung a kizua i unau Judate ithei kham kham un inua tatdoh kiata uhi, hinanleh tuin nouten inua tat kia dingin na unaute mama uh na zua uhi,” ka chi hi. Tuachi’n amauh gen ding theilouin asipta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n akung uah, “Na sil bawlte uh ahoi sih hi. I melma namdangte hing simmawna ipel theina dinga, Pasian zau kawma na gamtat ding uh hilou ahiei mah ka chi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuathamlouin kei leh ka sanggamte leh ka nna semten zong sumtang leh bu leh balte mite ka leitawi sah uhi. Hinanleh tambanga sumpung lah pen itawpsan ding uh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tuni mama in, aloute uh, agrep huonte uh, a Olivehuonte u’leh ainnte uh, tualeh asumpungte, u’leh abu leh balte u’leh a uointe u’leh, a sathaute uh, mun seza suo sekhat pung na lahte zousie uh nua pieh kia un,” ka chi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun, “Na gen bangin ka pe kia ding ua, ama ua kipat bangma ka phut sih ding uhi,” achi uhi. Tuachi’n akichiemna bang ua kihahsielna bawl sah dingin siempute ka han hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka puontuol kihipte ka thinga; “A thuchiem tangtunlou mi pouma, Pasian in tambang in, ainn leh anei alam apat in, thing sieng henlen, Tambangma in thinkhieh leh aguohin um heh” ka chi hi. Tuachi’n mipi kikhawmte zousie in “Amen” achi ua, Mangpa aphat uhi. Tuachi’n mipiten athuchiemna bangun abawlta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Artekserses leenga apan kum sawmnina kum a, Juda gam uhpipa dinga guota ka um akipat, akum sawmthum leh ni na dong, kum sawm leh kum ni sung, kei leh ka unaute koima’n uhpipa tan dinga kiguot ann kane sih uhi.","title":"Nehemiah kingai ngiemna"},"15":{"text":"Kei masanga uhpipa a na pang masaten, mipite tungah puohgih ana guon uh a, amaute akipat in tanghou leh uain ban ah dangka shekel sawmli ana lah zel ban uah, asuohte uh nasan zong mipite tungah ana kiliensah mama uhi. Hinanleh Kenvang Pasian giinna ziehin tuabangin kabawl sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuanahsangin tami kulbang lamna ah ka kipumpieh ua, gam mawngmawng ka lei sih ua, tualeh ka mi nasemte zousie tua nasepna mun ah akisukhawm zel uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuathamlouin ka kim ka vel ua um namdangte lah a kipat a, ka kung ua hing peite chilou Juda mite leh milien leh vaihawmte za le sawm nga in ka dawkan ah ka annkuong a im uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin ka nichin neh dinga kibawl khu, bawngtal khat, belamtal thau tah guh leh Aate ahing bawlpieh zel ua, ni sawm dan in savun zuthawl in uoin kichingtah in ahing kipie hi, hinanleh tam mipite tung gih ahizieh in, Ken uhpipa a dinga kiguotsa annte ka phut ngai sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Aw ka Pasian tam mite a dinga ka sil bawl zousiete, dungzui in ka hoina dingin hing thei ngitnget in aw."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuahunlaiin, akotpite ah kotkhate vaw nai sih nanleng kulbaang lam ka zouta a, ahawmte ka hubit zouta chi, Sanballat leh Tobiah leh Arab mi Geshem tualeh ka melmate zousie in azah tah un,","title":"Kilempina zanga dal tupna"},"2":{"text":"Sanballat leh Geshem in thu ahing hah ua, “Hing pei in Ono phaijanga khuo khat ah ikimu ding uhi,” ahing chi uhi. Hinanleh ka tunga sil hoilou bawl tum ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ken nna thupitah sem ka hi a, ka hing pei suh thei sih hi, “Tam ka nasep nuasie a, noute kunga kahing pei kaal a, bang dinga nasep khawl ding ahiei mah? chiin amaute kungah mi ka sawl hi.”"},"4":{"text":"Livei tah tam thu ka kungah ahing hah ua, Ken zong ka dawn ngai bangin ka dawng zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sanballat in anga veina dingin asuohpa, khutah laihah honsa tawi in, athu kibangmama puo in ka kungah ahing sawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua laihah sungah; “Nang leh Judaten hel na sawm zieh ua, kulbangte na bawl uh ahi chi namte lah ah athanga, tualeh Geshem in zong ahing gen hi. Tualeh thutut kiza dan in nang khu aleengpa uh hi ding na lunggul hi."},"7":{"text":"Juda gam ah leeng khat a um, chia Jerusalem a nangma tungtang phuongzah dingin guolneite nangawn na guotta hi, tam thute dungzui in leengpa kungah hil ahi ding ahi. Tuaziehin hing pei inlen, iki kum ding hi,” chi’n aki giel hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n, “Ken na genbanga sil kibawl bangma aum sih hi, hinanleh nangma lungsim a, na phuo tawm thu ahi bou hi,” chi’n mi ka sawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen, ama uten, “Anasep uh alawchin louna ding un akhutte uh suhzoi in um heh, chia ngaituo a ahing suhzau sawm ahi uhi.” Hinanleh, Aw Mangpa tuin ka khutte hing suhhat pieh in."},"10":{"text":"Ni khat, Mehetabeel tupa Delaiah tapa Shemaiah umna inn ah Kava haw a, tualeh aman, “Pasian biehinn sungah kimu vai in, biehinn kotte ki khakhum vai, aziehpen nangma that dinga zanlai a hing pei ding ahi uhi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Ken, “Kei bang mi ataimang ngai amah? Tualeh Kei bang mi koi ahiei ahinna humbitna dinga biehinn sunga tailut ding? ka lut sih ding hi,” ka chi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n, ama Pasian sawl ahi sih a, Tobiah leh Sanballat in ana gol guh uh ahia, ka sietna dinga thumavang gen ahi, chi ka theikheta hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama Kei hing zau sah a, tualeh khelna bawl sah a ahing suhminsiet theina ding u’leh, ahing simmaw theina ding ua, ana gol guh uh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Aw ka Pasian, Sanballat leh Tobiah, tualeh guolneinu Noadiah leh guolnei dangte, kei hing suhzau tumte nasepna dungzuiin amaute thei ngitnget in."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elul ha ni sawmni leh ni nga ni, ni sawm nga leh ni ni sungin kulbang akilamzou siengta hi.","title":"Kulbaang lam zouna"},"16":{"text":"Ka melmate un tam thu azahtah u’leh, tam nasep ka zouta uh chi, ka kim ka vel ua namte zousie in amu tah un, ka Pasian uh silbawl ahi chi a thei ua, akimuong ngam nawn sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuathamlouin khum hunlai a, Juda milienten Tobiah kungah laihah tampi ana hah hahta uhi, tualeh Tobiah laihah zong amauh kungah ana tung zel zel hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen Tobiah khu Ara tupa Shekaniah a ding in amahpa ahi ziehin Juda gam a mitampite Tobiah panpi dinga thuchiem a kigahsa ana hita ua, tualeh Tobiah tapa Jehonanan in Berekiah tapa Meshullam tanu akitenpi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh amauten Tobiah nasep hoite zong ka kungah agen ua, tualeh ka thugente zong ama kungah ana tutzel uhi, tuazieh a Tobiah in kei hing suhzau tum a, laihahte ahing hah zel ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n a kulbaangte ahing kilam zoutah in, kotpi kotkhate ka tunding zou in, kotkha vengmite, lasamite leh Levimite akiguot zou in.","title":"Nehemiah in Jerusalem vaihawm ding atelna"},"2":{"text":"Ka sanggampa Hanani Jerusalem uhpipa in ka bawl a, mi tamtahte sanga mi ginum leh Pasian giingmi ahi ziehin."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh amaute kungah, “Vaihamsang ahi masang siein Jerusalem kotpite hong sih un, kotpi vengten aven laisie uh kotpite khasa leh kilsa a koi ding ahi. Jerusalem a tengte zong galvengmi in guot unlen, pawl khatte amauh pan mun dinga kiguotna mun ah, pawl dangte amauh inn mai chiet ah pangsah un,” ka chi hi."},"4":{"text":"Khopi agol a, alien hi, hinanleh asunga teng mite atawm a, innte zong akilam nai sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka Pasian in miliente leh vaihawm mite tualeh mipite, akhanggui uh dung zui a, min khum dinga khopkhawm ding lungsim ahing nei sah hi. Tualeh Sal tanna akipata hing kile masate khangthu sutna laibu ka mukhie a, tuana kigielte tambang ahi.","title":"Puimanga umte hing kinualete (Ezr. 2.3-63)"},"6":{"text":"Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in sal a apuimang saltanna gam a kipat a hing kile kia a, Jerusalem leh Juda gam a, michin amauh khuo chiet a, peitou a, khum gam a umte, tamte ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute khu, Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilshan Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah, ahi ua, tamte toh hing zawhkhawm, Israel mipite tam dan, tam bang ahi:"},"8":{"text":"Parosh hahlesuonte, tul ni leh zakhat leh sawm sagi leh ni."},"9":{"text":"Shephatiah hahlesuonte zathum leh sawm sagi leh ni."},"10":{"text":"Arah hahlesuonte zaguh leh sawmnga leh ni."},"11":{"text":"Jeshua leh Joab khanggui apat Pahath-Moab hahlesuonte tul ni leh zagiet leh sawm leh giet."},"12":{"text":"Elam hahlesuonte tul khat leh zani leh sawmnga leh li."},"13":{"text":"Zattu hahlesuonte zagiet leh sawm li leh nga."},"14":{"text":"Zakkai hahlesuonte zasagi leh sawmguh."},"15":{"text":"Binnui hahlesuonte zaguh leh sawm li leh giet."},"16":{"text":"Bebai hahlesuonte zaguh leh sawmni leh giet."},"17":{"text":"Azzad hahlesuonte tul ni leh zathum sawmni leh ni."},"18":{"text":"Adonikam hahlesuonte zaguh sawmguh leh sagi."},"19":{"text":"Bigvai hahlesuonte tul ni leh sawmguh leh sagi."},"20":{"text":"Adin hahlesuonte zaguh leh sawmnga leh nga."},"21":{"text":"Hezekiah khanggui a Ater suonte Sawmkuo leh giet."},"22":{"text":"Hashum hahlesuonte za thum sawmni leh giet."},"23":{"text":"Bezai hahlesuonte zathum sawm sawmni leh li."},"24":{"text":"Hariph hahlesuonte zakhat sawmkhat leh ni."},"25":{"text":"Gibeon hahlesuonte Sawmkuo leh nga."},"26":{"text":"Bethlehem leh Netophah mite zakhat sawmgiet leh giet."},"27":{"text":"Anathoth mite zakhat sawmni leh giet."},"28":{"text":"Beth Azmaveth mite sawm li leh ni."},"29":{"text":"Kiriath Jearim, Kephirah leh Beeroth mite zasagi sawmli leh thum."},"30":{"text":"Ramah leh Geba mite zaguh sawmni leh khat."},"31":{"text":"Mikmash mite zakhat sawmni leh ni."},"32":{"text":"Bethel leh Ai mite zakhat sawmni leh thum."},"33":{"text":"Nebo danga mite sawmnga leh ni."},"34":{"text":"Elam danga mite tulkhat zani sawmnga leh li."},"35":{"text":"Harim mite zathum leh sawmni."},"36":{"text":"Jerikou mite zathum leh sawmli leh nga."},"37":{"text":"Lod, Hadid leh Ono mite zasagi sawmni leh khat."},"38":{"text":"Senaah mite tulthum zakuo leh sawmthum."},"39":{"text":"Siempute: Jeshua khang gui a kipat Jedaiah hahlesuonte zakuo sawmsagi leh thum."},"40":{"text":"Imer hahlesuonte tulkhat leh sawmnga leh ni."},"41":{"text":"Pashur hahlesuonte tulni leh sawmli leh sagi."},"42":{"text":"Harim hahlesuonte tulkhat leh sawm leh sagi."},"43":{"text":"Levimite: Kadmiel leh Hodaviah khanggui apata Jeshua hahlesuonte sawmsagi leh li."},"44":{"text":"Lasamite: Asaph hahlesuonte zakhat sawmli leh giet."},"45":{"text":"Kotpi vengte: Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita leh Shobal hahlesuonte zakhat sawmthum leh giet."},"46":{"text":"Biehinn nasemte: Ziha tate, Hasuph tate, Tabbaoth tate,"},"47":{"text":"Keros tate, Sia tate, Padontate,"},"48":{"text":"Lebanah tate, Hagaba tate, Shalmai tate,"},"49":{"text":"Hanan tate, Giddel tate, Gahar tate,"},"50":{"text":"Reaiah tate, Rezin tate, Nekoda tate,"},"51":{"text":"Gazzam tate, Uzza tate, Paseah tate,"},"52":{"text":"Besai tate, Meunim tate, Nephusesim tate,"},"53":{"text":"Bakbuk tate, Hakupha tate, Harhur tate,"},"54":{"text":"Bazluth tate, Mehida tate, Harsha tate,"},"55":{"text":"Barkos tate, Sisera tate, Temah tate,"},"56":{"text":"Neziah tate leh Hatipha tate."},"57":{"text":"Solomon suohte hahlesuonte. Sotai tate, Sophereth tate, Perida tate,"},"58":{"text":"Jaala tate, Darkon tate, Giddel tate,"},"59":{"text":"Shephatiah tate, Hattil tate, Pokereth-Hazebaim tate leh Amon tate,"},"60":{"text":"Biehinn nasemte leh Solomon suohte hahlesuonte, zathum leh sawmkuo leh ni."},"61":{"text":"Tam mite, Tel-Melah, Tel-Harsha, Kerub, Addon, leh Immer a kipata hing peitoute ahi ua, hinanleh amaun apu leh pate uh khang gui leh Israel mi ahina uh khanggui asut thei sih uhi."},"62":{"text":"Delaiah tate, Tobiah tate leh Nikoda tate, zaguh sawmli leh ni."},"63":{"text":"Siempute lah a kipat in, Hobaiah tate, Hakkoz tate leh Barzillai (Tam Barzillai pen mi khat, Gilead mi Barzillai tanu akitenpi zieh a Gilead mipa min a kihan, Barzillai) hahlesuonte ahi uh."},"64":{"text":"Tam miten amauh be le phung khang gui kigelna laibu asui ua, hinanleh amu zou sih uhi, tuazieh in asienglou banga ngai ahi ua, siempu hina apat koidoh ahita uhi."},"65":{"text":"Tuazieh in uhpipan amaute Urim leh thumim zanga siempu nasem ahimasangsie uh, ann siengpen aneh lou ding uh ahi, achita hi.","ref":"Pawt. 28.30; Danp. 33.8"},"66":{"text":"Mipi kikhawmte abawn un tul sawmli leh tul ni zathum sawm guh ahi uhi."},"67":{"text":"Asuoh pasal te u’leh asuoh numeite uh tul sagi zathum leh sawm thum leh sagi te simlou ahi nalai hi. Amaun pasal leh numei lasa mi zani leh sawmli leh nga anei uhi."},"68":{"text":"Amaun sakol zasagi leh sawm thum leh guh leh sakol neu zani leh sawmli leh nga leh,"},"69":{"text":"sangawngsau zali sawm thum leh nga leh sabiltung tulguh leh zasagi leh sawmni anei uhi."},"70":{"text":"Tuin akhang gui dung zui ua aphung sung ua upa pente pawl khat in nasepna dingin athaw uh hi. Gam uhpipan sum koina ah sana darik tul khat, maiphietna kuong sawm nga leh siempu puonsil zanga leh sawm thum, apie hi."},"71":{"text":"Phung sunga upa pen pawl khat in inn lamna dingin sum koina ah, sana darik tul sawmni leh dangka mina tul ni leh zani apie uhi."},"72":{"text":"Midangte pieh kigawm khawm sana darik tul sawmni leh dangka mina tul ni leh siempu puonsil sawm guh leh sagi apha hi."},"73":{"text":"Tuachi’n, siempute, Levimite, kotpi vengte, lasa mite leh midang pawl khat leh Biehinn nasemte leh Israel mizousie amauh khopi chiet ah atengta uhi. Aha sagi na ah Israelte zousie amauh khopi chiet ah ateng det chietta uhi.","ref":"1 Khang. 9.2; Neh. 11.3"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mipi zousie mi khat bang mai a kithutuohin Tui kotpi mai a mun awng ah akikhawm ua, laigielpa Ezra kungah, Mangpa’n Israelte kungah athupieh Mosi dan laibu hing tawi dingin ahil uhi.","title":"Ezra in danthu asimna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n ha sagina ani khat ni in, siempu Ezra in mipi kikhawm pasal leh numeite leh thu ngaikhe thei zousiete mai ah danbu ahing tawita hi."},"3":{"text":"Aman zingmawng phalvah apat sun dong tua Tui kotpi mai a mun awng lam ngat in pasalte leh numeite tualeh thutheisiem zousie mai ah asimkhie a, mipi zousie in dan laibu kisim khu lunglut lahin angaikhie uhi."},"4":{"text":"Laigielpa Ezra tuami dinga kibawl dawkan tungah adinga, aziet lam pang ah Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uria, Hilkiah leh Maaseiah, ading ua, Aveilam pangah, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanan, Zekariah leh Meshullam, ading uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ezra mipite sanga sangzaw in adinga, mipite zousie mitmu ah laibu aphen a, tua laibu aphen laitahin mipite ading uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ezra in Mangpa Pasian thupitah khu aphat a tualeh mipi zousie’n akhut uh zahtou in, “Amen, Amen,” chiin adawng uhi. Tuachi’n alu uh akun sah ua, amai ua tuol su in Mangpa abie uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozbad, Hanan, Pelaiah leh Levimiten danthu atheisiemna dingun ahilchien ua, mipite amauh mun chiet ah ading uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten Pasian dan laibu kichientah in asimkhie ua, aum zie ahilchien ua, laibu kisim khu athei siemsah uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh gam uhpipa Nehemiah leh siempu leh laigielpa Ezra leh mipite hil apang Levimiten mipite zousie kungah, “Tuni khu Mangpa na Pasian ua dingin ni siengthou ahi, daa sih unlen, kap sih un” achi uhi. Aziehpen mipite zousie in dan thute a zahtah un akapta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nehemiah in akung uah, “Pei unlen ann tuitui ne unlen, uoin hum dawn unlen, bangma kiguot piehloute adingin tanvou hah un aziehpen tuni khu i Mangpa ua dingin ni siengthou ahi, hase sih un, aziehpen Mangpa lungdamna khu na hatna uh ahi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levimiten mipite zousie kungah, “Dai dide un, tuni khu ni siengthou ahi ziehin, hase sih un,” chin mipite zousie asip sah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite ne ding leh dawn dingin leh tanvoute hah ding leh lungkim tah a, guolnuom dingin apeita uhi. Aziehpen akung ua kiphuongkhie thute atheisiemta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ani ni niin mipite zousie apu leh pate uh innkuon dungzui a aphungsung ua upa pente leh siempute leh Levimite toh laigielpa Ezra kungah danthute zil dingin ahing pei khawm uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Mangpa’n Mosi zanga thu apieh dan laibu ah, ha sagina pawi sungin, Israel tate hampheng buh sunga a um ding uh ahi, chi leh;","title":"Hampheng pawi amanna uh","ref":"Siempu. 23.33-36,39-43; Danp. 16.13-15"},"15":{"text":"“Taang gamte ah pei unlen, Olive singbate, gamlah Olive singbate, mui singbate, tumnate leh sawlbawh phate danlai bu a kigiel banga hampheng buhte bawlna dingin vala un,” chiin akhuote u’leh Jerusalem ah phuong zah unlen tangkou un chia, thu kigielte amukheta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite akuonkhie ua, singbate ava puo ua, michin in a inntung chiet u’leh, ahuong sung leituol chiet leh Pasian inn huong leituol leh Tui, kotpi mai a mun awng ah, tualeh Ephraim kotpi kunga mun awng ah hampheng buhte alamta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh saltanna pat a hing kile kia mipi kikhawmte zousiete in hampheng buh abawl uhi, aziehpen Nun tapa hunlai akipat tuami ni tandongin, Israel taten tuabangin pawi abawl ngai sih uhi. Tualeh akipahna uh alien mama hi."},"18":{"text":"Ni masa pen akipat ani tawpna dongin, Ezra in Pasian dan laibu asim zing hi. Tualeh amaun ni sagi pawi amang ua, angaina dungzui in ni giet ni in khawmpi siengthou anei uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami ha, ni sawmni leh ni li niin, Israel mipite ann ngawl leh sai ip puon silin leh alu tung ua leivui kibuoh khum in ahing kikhawm uhi.","title":"Ann ngawl a kisiana"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israelte khu gamdang mite zousie akipat akikhen kheta ua, tualeh adingdoh ua, akhelnate u’leh apu apate uh gitloutatnate aphuongkheta uhi."},"3":{"text":"A umna mun chiet uah a ding ua, ni khat seli suo sekhat sung Mangpa a Pasian uh Dan laibu simna in azang ua, seli suo sekhat sung dang pen, khelna thupha tawina leh Mangpa a Pasian uh biehna in azang uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n dawkan tungah Levi mite, Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani leh Kenani adingtou ua, Mangpa a Pasian u’kungah aw ngaitah in akikouta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levimite Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bini, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah leh Pethahiah ten mipite kungah, “Dingtou unlen, Mangpa na Pasian u’khu kumtawn kumtawn in phat un, tualeh phatna pahtawina zousie tunglam a tawisanga um na min thupi phat in umta hen.”"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Ezra in, “Nangma bou Mangpa na hia, nangman vante van leh asunga um zousiete, lei leh leitunga um zousiete, tualeh tuipi leh asunga um zousiete na siem a, amaute zousie kungah hinna na pie a, van a um zousieten nangma ahing bie uhi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma Abram telpa leh Kaldaimite khopi Ur a kipat a puidohpa leh Abraham chi a min phuopa Mangpa Pasian na hi.","ref":"Siem. 11.31; 12.1; Siem. 17.5"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh na masangah alungtang muonhuoiin na muta a, tuachi’n, Kanaanmite, Hitmite, Amormite, Perezmite, Jebusmite leh Girgashmite, gam ahahlesuonte kunga pe dingin ama toh thuhun na bawl a, tualeh na thu na sutangtungta hi, dihtattah na hi zieh in.","ref":"Siem. 15.18-21"},"9":{"text":"“Tualeh Izipt gam a ka pu ka pate uh thuohgimna na mu a, tuipi san gei a akaa leh maunate u’zong na za hi.","ref":"Pawt. 3.7; Pawt. 14.10-12"},"10":{"text":"Pharaoh tungah leh asuohte tungah, tualeh gam sunga mi zousie tungah, chiemtenate leh sil lamdangte na kilang sah hi, aziehpen amaun simmawhuoitahin ka pu ka pate uh ana bawlsie uh chi na thei a, tuni tandong a aum bangin na min na kitheisahta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 7.8—12.32"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tuipi lai a lei gaw a apei theina dingun, tuipi khu phalni in na kikhentan sah a, tualeh amauh nuadelte tuipi thuhtah sungah suongtum bangin na pailutta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 14.21-29; Pawt. 15.4,5"},"12":{"text":"Tuathamlouin, sun in amaute meilum khuom in na pui a, zan in, apeina lampite uh tanvah dingin mei kuong ding in amauh na pui hi.","ref":"Pawt. 13.21,22"},"13":{"text":"Sinai muol ah zong na hing kum suh a, amauh van a kipat in na houpi a, vaihawmna dihtahte, dan dihtahte, thugousie leh thupieh hoitahte, amauh na pie hi.","ref":"Pawt. 19.18—23.33"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh akung uah na khawlni siengthoute na theisah a, Na suoh Mosi zangin akung uah, thusete leh thugousiete, tualeh danthute, azah ding un na pie hi."},"15":{"text":"Agilkiel chiengun van a pat in amauh tanghou na pie a, adangta chiengun ama ua dingin suongpi apat in tui na pawtdoh sah hi, tualeh amauh pieh dinga na kichiemna gam luo dinga pei ding in thuchiem na pie hi.","ref":"Pawt. 16.4-15; Pawt. 17.1-7; Danp. 1.21"},"16":{"text":"“Hinanleh ama u’leh ka pu leh pate un, kisatheitah leh ngawng vaipuohin agamta ua, na thupiehte azui sih uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 14.1-4; Danp. 1.26-33"},"17":{"text":"Thu amang nuom sih ua, alah ua na sil lamdang bawlte zong angaituo ut sih uhi. Hinanleh a ngawng uh akhau sah ua, agenha ua, Izipt gam a asaltanna ua kile kia ding asawm zaw uhi. Hinanleh Nang pen ngaidam dinga mansa, hepina hau, khotuona adim, lungthah paipailou leh it siem Pasian na hi a, amauh na taisan sih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.6; Kisim. 14.18"},"18":{"text":"Ahi, bawngnou sunthu lim abawl ua, Izipt gam a kipat a noute hing puidoh, na Pasian uh tami ahi, chi a, Nang ahing minsietsah ua, nahpitah a Pasian agensiet lai nangawn un zong,","ref":"Pawt. 32.1-4"},"19":{"text":"na hepina alet seng zieh in, amaute gamdai ah na taisan sih hi, sun a amauh puitu meilum khuom in lah amauh ataisan sih a, tualeh apeina ding ua vah pe dinga zan a puitu mei kuong dingin zong ataisan tuom sih hi.","ref":"Danp. 8.2-4"},"20":{"text":"Amaute hil dingin, na hagau hoitah na pie a, Nangman akam ua pat na manna na taangsah den sih a, adangta chieng un tui na pie hi."},"21":{"text":"Kum sawmli sung gamdai gamgaw ah amaute na vah a, Bangma atasam sih uhi. Apuonsilte uh ase sih a, akengte uh zong apawm ngai sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh leeng gamte leh namte amauh na pie a, gam, ningkawm teng zong na hawm pieh a, tuachi’n amaun, Heshbon leengpa Sihon gam leh Bashan leengpa Og gamte aluota uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 21.21-35"},"23":{"text":"Ahah asuonte uh van a aasite bangin na pung sah a, apu apate u’kunga va luo dinga na gensa gam ah na puilutta hi.","ref":"Siem. 15.5; 22.17; Josh. 3.14-17"},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahahasuonte uh ava lut ua, aluota uhi. Nang amaute masangah tua gam ateng Kanaan mite na sungiemta a, tua gam mite leh aleengte uh, a ut ut ua abawl ding un, amaute khut sungah ana pie hi.","ref":"Josh. 11.23"},"25":{"text":"Amauten kulpi nei khopite leh gam hoite ala ua, sil hoi a dim innte, tuikhuh tawsate, grep huonte, Olive huonte leh theikung tampite aluota uhi. Tuachi’n ane ua, nieng leh tai in aum ua, ahing thauta uhi. Tuachi’n na hoina thupitah zal zouin akipah mamata uhi.","ref":"Danp. 6.10,11"},"26":{"text":"“Ahivang in thu amang sih ua, Na tungah a helta ua, na dan anuangatsan ua, Nang lam a ahing kiheina ding ua, amaute phawhhilna thugen na guolneite athat ua, nasatah in ahing lungthahsah uhi.","ref":"Vai. 2.11-16"},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaute amelmate uh khutah na pekhie a, amauten asugenthei uhi. Tuachi’n agenthei hun chieng ua, nang ahing hat chiengun, van apat in na za a, na khotuona thupitah ziehin, amelmate khut ua pat a hundam dingin mi na pe zel hi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh akhawldam zou chiengun, na masangah silgilou abawl zel uhi. Tuazieh in nang amaute amelmate uh khut ah na nuasie zel a, tuachi’n amaun atung uah thu aneikhum zel uhi, ahivangin ahing kinuahei kia ua, nang ahing hat chiengun, van akipat in na za a, na khotuonate ziehin tam veipi amauh na hunkhe zel hi."},"29":{"text":"Na dan lam a amauh na puilut kia theina dingin adihlouna uh na theisah hi. Hinapiin kisathei tahin agamta ua, na thupiehte azui sih ua, hinanleh na vaihawmnate kalin akhiel ua, tuate mi’n azui leh, hing ding ahi bou hi. Tualeh aliengkou uh asawisah ua, angawng uh avaipuoh ua, aza nuom sih uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.5"},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh kum tampi amaute na thuohzou a, na guolneite zang in na hagau in amaute dihlounate uh na theisah a, hinanleh angaikhe nuom sih uhi. Tuaziehin amaute agam mite khut ah na pekheta hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 17.13-18; 2 Khang. 36.15,16"},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh na khotuona aletseng ziehin amauh na sugam sih a, na taisan tuom sih hi, aziehpen nang hepina hau leh khotuo siem Pasian na hi."},"32":{"text":"“Tuaziehin tuin, ka Pasian uh, thuhun leh itna dettah a vomzing, Pasian thupi leh hat leh giinhuoi ka tung u’leh ka leengpate utung leh kapu leh pate u’leh na mipite zousie tunga, Assiria leengte hunlai apata tuni tandonga hing tung hasatnate zousie, na masangah sil neunoukhat bangin hing gel pieh sin.","ref":"2 Leeng. 15.19,29; 17.3-6; Ezr. 4.2,10"},"33":{"text":"Bangteng hitaleh ka tung ua sil hing tung zousie ah, nang na dih hi; aziehpen nangma’n dihtah in na bawla, hinanleh kouten giloutah in ka bawl uhi."},"34":{"text":"Ka leengpate u’leh, ka miliente uh, ka siempute u’leh kapu leh pate un na dan azui sih ua, na thupiehte leh amauh kal a na gen na thu theisahnate zong angaikhe nuom sih uhi."},"35":{"text":"Atung ua na hoina thupitah zieh a gam lien leh hausa tah napiehna, aleenggam sung nangawn uah, nangma nna asem ut sih ua, a nasep gilou ua pat in akihei kia ut sih uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tuni in tam gam ah suoh leh sal ka hita uh, ngaivawi kapu ka pate un, agam gate leh asilhoite aneh ua nuom asah theina ding ua na piehna gam sungah suoh leh sal, ka hita uhi."},"37":{"text":"Ka khelnate zieh ua, ka tung ua leengpa dinga na guotten ahausat lawta ua, Amauten ka tahsa pumpite u’leh ka gantate uh tungah a ut dan dan un thu anei ua, gentheitahin ka umta
