uhi.”"},"38":{"text":"Tamte zousie zieh in, thuchiem dettah bawl in ka giel ua, ka lamkaite uh, ka Levite u’leh, ka siempute un, anamkip uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua thuchiem namdetna suoi bawlte tamte ahi uhi: Hakaliah tapa Nehemiah gam uhpipa leh Zedekiah,","title":"Thuchiem a suoi bawlte"},"2":{"text":"Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,"},"3":{"text":"Pashur, Amariah, Malkijah,"},"4":{"text":"Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluk,"},"5":{"text":"Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,"},"6":{"text":"Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruk,"},"7":{"text":"Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,"},"8":{"text":"Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah, tamte khu siempute ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Levimite: Ajaniah tapa Jeshua, Henadad tate lah ah Binnui leh Kadmiel."},"10":{"text":"Aseppite uh: Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan."},"11":{"text":"Mika, Rehob, Hashabiah,"},"12":{"text":"Zakkur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,"},"13":{"text":"Hodijah, Bini, Beninu."},"14":{"text":"Mipite lamkaite: Parosh, Pahath-Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani."},"15":{"text":"Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,"},"16":{"text":"Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,"},"17":{"text":"Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,"},"18":{"text":"Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,"},"19":{"text":"Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,"},"20":{"text":"Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,"},"21":{"text":"Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,"},"22":{"text":"Pellatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,"},"23":{"text":"Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,"},"24":{"text":"Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,"},"25":{"text":"Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,"},"26":{"text":"Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,"},"27":{"text":"Malluk, Harim, Baanah."},"28":{"text":"Midangte Siempute, Levimite, kotpi vengte, lasa mite, Biehinn a nasemte leh tua gamsung ateng mite lah apat a, Pasian dan zui dinga hing ki koituom zousiete, azite uh, atapate u’leh atanute uh, pilna leh theisiemna nei ten,"},"29":{"text":"Amauten a unaute u’leh, amiliente uh azui chinten ua, Pasian suohpa Mosi in apieh, Pasian dan thupieh zui ding leh Mangpa i Mangpa uh thupieh zousiete leh avaihawmna dante leh athugousiete zui ding leh bawl dingin,"},"30":{"text":"Ka tanute uh, tam gammite kungah ka pe sih ding ua, tualeh ka tapate ua dingin atanute uh kala sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.16; Danp. 7.3"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh tam gam miten khawlni a, van ahiei, anntang ahiei, ahing zua u’leh, khawlni in ahiei, ahisihleh ni siengthou ni ahiei in, ka lei pieh sih ding uhi; tualeh kum sagina kum chin in nna semlou ding leh leibate phullou dingin hamse lawna leh kihahsielna ka nei uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.10,11; Siempu. 25.1-7; Danp. 15.1,2"},"32":{"text":"Ka Pasian uh inn a, nasepna dingin kum chin a shekel khat sethum suo sekhat pe dingin dan ka siem uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 30.11-16"},"33":{"text":"Tanghou siengthou ading leh ann sillat ngitnget a ding leh halmang sillat ngitnget a ding leh khawlni leh hathate, hun kiguotsa pawite, sil siengthoute, Israel mite a dinga lemna bawlna dinga khelna thoina ding leh ka Pasian uh inn a nasepna zousie a dingin ka pie uhi."},"34":{"text":"Dan laibu a kigiel banga, Mangpa i Pasian uh maitam tunga hal ding, kum chin a ahun kiguot bang zel a, apu apate uh innkuon dungzui a sing sillat, Mangpa i Pasian uh inn a hing polut dingin, siempute, Levimite leh mipite lah ah ai ka san zel uhi."},"35":{"text":"Kum chin a i loua pieng ga masa pente leh sing zousie gam a sa pente zousie, Mangpa inn a tawi chiet ding chiin danthu ka bawl uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.19; 34.26; Danp. 26.2"},"36":{"text":"Dan laibu a kigiel bangin, ka tapate lah ua pieng masa pente leh ganhonte lah a pieng masa pente tualeh belamhon leh kelhon lah a pieng masah pente zong, Pasian inn a nasem siempute kunga tawi ding ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 13.2"},"37":{"text":"Ka Pasian uh inn dantan sunga siempute kungah ka tangbuong meh masa pente, i sillalte, sing kunga ka thei ga masa pente zousie uh, ka uoin thate u’leh, ka sathau masa pente u’leh, ka lou ua ga masa sawm a khatte, Levite kungah ka hing tawi uhi, tua Leviten ka tenna uh khopi sungte ua, sawm a khat atan theina ding un.","ref":"Kisim. 18.21"},"38":{"text":"Tualeh siempute’n sawm a khat alah chiengun Aaron hahlesuon siempu khat Levimite toh a um khawm ding hi. Tualeh Levimiten sawm a khat khu i Pasian uh inn pindan sungah atawilut ding uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 18.26"},"39":{"text":"Aziehpen, Israel mite leh Israel taten, bu, uoin tha leh sathau sillatte, mun siengthou a bel leh kuongte, lasamite umna pindan sunga ahing tawilut ding uh ahi, tualeh eiten i Pasian uh inn i nuasie lou ding uh ahi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin mipi lamkaite Jerusalem ah ateng ua, tualeh midangten khopi siengthou Jerusalem a teng dingin, mipi sawm lah a khat hing pui dingin leh sekuote khu khopi dangte a teng dingin, ai asan uhi.","title":"Jerusalem a tengte"},"2":{"text":"Mipiten amauh ut thu a Jerusalem a teng dinga deitelna bawlte aguolzawl uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tamte pen gamkai khat a lamkai, Jerusalem a tengte ahi uhi; hinanleh Juda gam a khopite ah michin anei alam utoh amauh tenna ding khopi chiet ah ateng uhi, tuate khu Israel mite, siempute, Levimite leh biehinn nasemte, tualeh Solomon suohte hahlesuonte ahi uhi.","ref":"Neh. 7.73"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem ah Juda hahlesuon pawlkhat leh Benjamin hahlesuonte ateng uhi. Juda mite lah apat in: Perez hahlesuonte lah ah Mahalalel tapa Shephatiah, Shephatiah tapa Amariah, Amariah tapa Zekariah, Zekariah tapa Uzziah, Uzziah tapa Athaiah leh,"},"5":{"text":"Shilon mite hahlesuon lah ah, Zekariah tapa Joiarib, Joiarib tapa Adaiah, Adaiah tapa Hazaiah, Hazaiah tapa Kol-Hozeh, Kol-Hozeh tapa Baruk, Baruk tapa Maaseiah ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Perez hahlesuon Jerusalem a tengte zousie mihangsan ngen, zali leh sawmguh leh giet ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Jeshaiah tapa, Ithiel tapa Maaseiah, Maaseiah tapa Kolaiah, Kolaiah tapa Pedaiah, Pedaiah, tapa Joed, Joed tapa Meshullam, Meshullam tapa Sallu ahi uhi.","title":"Tualeh tamte Benjamin hahlesuonte ahi uhi:"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh asanggamte, Gabbai, Sallai, mi za kuo leh sawmni leh giet ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Zikri tapa Joel khu nasepna lam entuppa ahi, Hassenuah tapa Juda khu khopi tunga vaihawm nina ahi."},"10":{"text":"Siempute lah apat: Joiarib tapa Jedaiah leh Jakin,"},"11":{"text":"Ahitub tapa Meraioth, Meraioth tapa Zadok, Zadok tapa Meshullam, Meshullam tapa Hilkiah, Hilkiah tapa Seraiah khu Pasian biehinn a vaihawmpa ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh tua inn a anaseppi asanggamte khu za giet leh sawmni leh ni ahi uhi, tualeh Malkijah tapa Pashur, Pashur tapa Zekariah, Zekariah tapa Amzi, Amzi tapa Pelaliah, Pelaliah tapa Jeroham, Jeroham tapa Adaiah leh"},"13":{"text":"anaseppite apulepate uh innkuon aphung sung atulpipate utoh abawn un, zani leh sawmli leh ni apha uhi. Tualeh Immer tapa Meshillemoth, Meshillemoth tapa Ahzai, Ahzai tapa Azareel, Azareel tapa Amashai leh;"},"14":{"text":"anaseppite uh gal hangsan ngentang za leh sawmni leh giet ahi uhi. Amauh entuppa khu Haggedolim tapa Zabdiel ahi."},"15":{"text":"Levimite lah apat: Bunni tapa Hashabiah, Hashabiah tapa Azrikam, Azrikam tapa Hashub, Hashub tapa Shemaiah leh,"},"16":{"text":"Levi mite lamkai Shabathai leh Zozabad in Pasian inn pulam nasepna entup in apang uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Asaph tapa Zabdi, Zabdi tapa Mika, Mika tapa Mataniah te khu kipah thugenna thumna lamkai leh pantu ahi uhi, tualeh Bakbukiah khu anaseppi a unaute lah a anina ahi a, tualeh Jeduthun tapa Galal, Galal tapa Shammua, Shammua tapa Abda ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Khopi siengthou a Levimite zousie zani leh sawm giet leh li ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Kotpi vengte lah apat in tamte ahi uhi. Akkub, Talmon leh aseppi asanggamte uh kotpi vengte za leh sawmsagi leh ni ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Israel dangte leh siempute leh Levimite khu Juda khopite zousie ah, michin amauh gouluona mun chiet ah a um uhi.","title":"Khopi danga tengte"},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Biehinn nasemte pen Ophel ah ateng ua, tualeh Ziha leh Gispa khu biehinn nasemte tungah vaihawm in apang uhi."},"22":{"text":"Jerusalem a Levimite entupa pang, Bani tapa Uzzi ahia, Bani khu Hashabiah tapa ahia, Hashabiah khu Mattaniah tapa ahia, Mattaniah khu Mika tapa ahia, Uzzi pen Asaph hahlesuonte lah a khat ahia, tualeh Asaph hahlesuonte pen Pasian inn a lasa a nasemte ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amauh tungtang thu ah leengpa thupieh ahileh lasamite nichin a neh leh tah atulmaw bangbang ua pieh ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Juda tapa Zerah hahlesuonte lah a Meshezabeel tapa Pethahiah khu mipite tungtang thu toh kisai a, leengpa khut nuoi a, thu zousie saipa ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh akho neute u’leh aloute u’toh, Juda tate pawlkhat Kiriath-Arba leh a kho neute uah, tualeh Dibon leh akho neute uah leh Jekabzeel leh akho neute uah ateng uhi.","title":"Jerusalem khopi pulam a tenna"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Jeshua, Moladah, Beth-pelet ah,"},"27":{"text":"Hazar-Shual, Beersheba leh akim a kho neute ah,"},"28":{"text":"Ziglag, Mekona leh akim a kho neute ah,"},"29":{"text":"En-rimmon, Zorah ah leh Jarmuth ah leh,"},"30":{"text":"Zanoah, Adullam leh akho neute ah, Lakish leh akim a loute ah, Azekah leh akim a kho neute ah ateng uhi. Tuachi’n Beer-sheba apat in Hinnom phaijang dongin ateng uhi."},"31":{"text":"Benjamin mite zong Geba apat in Mikmash, Aiza, Bethel leh akho neute uah ateng uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah"},"33":{"text":"Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,"},"34":{"text":"Hadid, Zeboim, Nebalath,"},"35":{"text":"Lod leh Ono, khutsiemte phaihawm ah ateng uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Juda gam a um Levimi pawl khenkhatte zong Benjamin mite toh ateng khawm uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tamte khu Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh Jeshua toh hing kinuale siempute leh Levimite ahi uhi, Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezr.","title":"Siempute leh Levite min khumna"},"2":{"text":"Amariah, Malluk, Hattush,"},"3":{"text":"Shekaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,"},"4":{"text":"Iddo, Ginnethon, Abijah,"},"5":{"text":"Mijamin, Moadiah, Bilgah,"},"6":{"text":"Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,"},"7":{"text":"Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah leh Jedaiah. Tamte khu Jeshua damlai a siempute leh anaseppi lamkaite ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Levimite khu, Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Juda leh Mattaniah zong ahi ua, amaute leh anaseppi aunaute un, lungdam thugen a lasahna ah ma akai uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute toh kimai ngat in, Bakbukiah leh aseppi a unaute nasem in ading uhi."},"10":{"text":"Jeshua in Joiakim ahinga, Joiakim in Eliashib ahing hi, tualeh Eliashib in Joiada ahing hi."},"11":{"text":"Joiada in Jonathan ahinga, Jonathan in Jaddua ahing hi."},"12":{"text":"Joiakim damlai a apu leh pate uh innkuon dungzui a siempute phung upate: Seraiah phung ah Meraiah, Jeremiah phungah Hananiah,"},"13":{"text":"Ezra phungah Meshullam, Amariah phungah Jehohanan,"},"14":{"text":"Meliku phungah Jonathan; Shebaniah phungah Joseph;"},"15":{"text":"Hiram phungah, Adna; Meraioth phungah Helkai;"},"16":{"text":"Iddo phungah Zekariah, Ginnethon phungah Meshullam."},"17":{"text":"Abijah phungah Zikri, Miniamin leh Moadiah phungah Piltai;"},"18":{"text":"Bilgah phungah Shammua, Shemaiah phungah Jehonathan;"},"19":{"text":"Joiarib phungah Mattenai, Jedaiah phungah Uzzi."},"20":{"text":"Sallai phungah Kallai; Amok phungah Eber;"},"21":{"text":"Hilkiah phung ah Hashabiah; Jedaiah phungah Nethaneel."},"22":{"text":"Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan leh Juddua te damlai a, Levimite leh siempute aphung sung ua tulpipa pente Persia leengpa Darius vaihawm lai donga, khanggui sutna laibu ah amin uh akikhum hi."},"23":{"text":"Eliashib tapa Johanan damlai dongin Levi tapate pu leh pate tulpipa pente khu khanggui sutna laibu ah amin uh akikhum hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Levimite lamkaite, Hashabiah, Sherebiah leh Kadmiel tapa Jeshua leh a unaute utoh, Pasian mipa David thupieh dung zui a, Kimaingat a apawl pawla, kikhel zel a, phatna leh lungdam thu gen dinga umte ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshallum, Talmon leh Akkub te khu kotpi bul a van koikhawmna inn leh kotkha vengte ahi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tamte khu Jozadak tapa, Jeshua tapa Joiakim damlai leh uhpipa Nehemiah leh siempu leh laigielpa Ezra damlai a um ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem kulbang latna ah Levimite a tena mun chiet ua pat a suikhie a, kipahtah a lungdamthu genna leh lasah toh, dahkhutbehte, kaiging guineite leh pehgingte thuo a kipahtah a, kulbang latna lawm dingin Jerusalem ah ahing zawpi uhi.","title":"Jerusalem kulbaang latna"},"28":{"text":"Lasa pawlte zong Jerusalem kimvel gam a kipat leh Netophath mite khoneute a kipat in ahing kikhawm uhi."},"29":{"text":"Beth-gilgal akipat leh Geba gamkai akipat leh Azmaveth gam akipan in zong lasa pawlte ahing peikhawm uhi, aziehpen lasa pawlten, Jerusalem kim ah tenna ding khuote ana satta uhi."},"30":{"text":"Siempute leh Levimite akisiensuo zou tah un, mipite leh kotpite tualeh kulbangte asiensuo uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ken Juda lamkaite kulbang tungah ka zawpitou a, nuomthu gen kawm a kholai nawh dingin pawl lientah ni ka guot a, Pawlkhatte ziet lang panga kulbang tungah, eehvum kotpi lam zuon in akizui uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Hoshaiah leh Juda lamkai kim khatten amaute azui ua,"},"33":{"text":"Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,"},"34":{"text":"Juda, Benjamin, Shemaiah leh Jeremiah,"},"35":{"text":"tualeh pengkul tawi siempu khanglai pawlkhat: Jonathan tapa Zakaria, Jonathan khu Shemaiah tapa ahia, Shemaiah khu Mattaniah tapa ahia, Mattaniah khu Mikaiah tapa ahia, Mikaiah pen Zakkur tapa ahia, tualeh Zakkur khu Asaph tapa ahi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh a unaute, Shemaiah, Azareel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, Juda leh Hanani ahi ua, Pasian mipa David in ana guotsa bangin tumgingte atawi ua, tualeh laigielpa Ezra in ma apui hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuikhuh kotpi apat in ama zawn ua, David khopi kaltouna kalbi ah kulbang tunglam kalna ah akaltou ua, David inntung zawn a Tui kotpi suolam ah apei uhi."},"38":{"text":"Nuomthu gen lapawl dangte veilam pang manaw in akizui ua, Ken mipi kimkhatte toh kulbang tungah amauh ka zuitou hi, Meikhuh innsang tunga kulbang lienpi tan ka zuitou hi."},"39":{"text":"Ephraim kotpi tunglam, kotpi lui tunglam, Nga kotpi tunglam leh Hananeel innsang leh Zakhat innsanga kipat in, belam kotpi tandong pei ua, suongkul kotpi ah akhawlta uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian inn a nuomthu gen lapawl nite amauh mun chiet ah ading ua, Kei leh vaihawmte kimkhat zong ka ding uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh siempute Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Mikaiah, Elioenai, Zekariah leh Hananiah te zong apengkulte u’toh ading ua,"},"42":{"text":"Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam leh Ezer, zong a um uhi. Tualeh lasamiten a lamkaipa uh Jezrahiah toh ngaitahin la asa uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tua niin kithoina thupitahin alan ua, Pasian in lungnopna thupitah apieh ziehin akipah mama uhi, numei leh naupangte zong alung nuom mama uhi. Jerusalem a lungnopna husa gamlapi ah zong akiza hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuami ni in, tuohkhawmte, ga masate leh sawma khatte koikhawmna inndante enkol ding mi a kiguot a, dan in aphut dungzui a, Siempute leh Levimite tanvou ding, khopi kim leh avel loute apat lakhawm dingin zong mi akiguot hi, azieh pen, nasem siempute leh Levimite tungah Judate akipah mama uhi."},"45":{"text":"Lasa mite leh kotpi veng mite’n David leh atapa Solomon thupieh dungzui in a Pasian uh inndan leh kisuhsiengna inndan akem uhi.","ref":"1 Khang. 25.1-8; 1 Khang. 26.12"},"46":{"text":"Aziehpen nidanglai a, David leh Asaph damlai in lasamite lamkai leh Pasian kunga phatna lasahnate leh kipahthu genna dinga lamkaite ana umsa ahita hi."},"47":{"text":"Tuabangin Israel mite zousie in Zerubbabel damlai leh Nehemiah damlai nite in lasa mite leh kotpi vengmite, adingin nichin a atanvou ding uh apie ua; tualeh Levi mite tanvou ding atuom in akhenkhe zel ua, tuachi’n Leviten zong Aaron hahlesuonte tanvou ding atuom in akhenkhe sawn zel uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua niin mipite zah in Mosi laibu asimkhie ua, tua sungah Amon mite leh Moab mite koima, Pasian mite kikhopna ah atel ngailou ding uh ahi chi, amudohta uhi.","title":"Dan puothana","ref":"Danp. 23.3-5"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun Israelte tanghou leh tui toh ana lamdawn sih ua, hinanleh amauh hamse law dingin Balaam ana guoi zawsop uhi, hinanleh i Pasian un hamsietna khu guolzawlna asuohsah zawta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 22.1-6"},"3":{"text":"Mipiten tam danthu azahtah un, gamdang mite hahlesuon zousie, Israelte lah a pat in atuom khenta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tami masangin, siempu Eliashib i Pasian uh inn a vankoina dantante enkoltu ana hi a, ama pen Tobiah toh ana kikhutzop hi."},"5":{"text":"Aman Tobiah luo dingin inndan lienpi khat, abawl pieh a, tua inndan khu nidanglai a, Levite, lasamite, kotpi vengte leh siempute a dinga ann sillatte, gimnamtuite, um leh belte, bu leh bal sawm khatte, uoin thate, sathaute, koikhawmna a, na ki zang ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tambang sil um laitah in, kei pen Jerusalem ah ka um sih hi, aziehpen Babilon leengpa Artekserses vaihawm kum sawmthum leh kum ni kum in, leengpa kungah kava pei a, ni bangza ahiei nuain leengpa phalna ka muta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem ah ka hing pei kia a, Eliashib silbawl hoilou, Pasian inn huong sunga inndan Tobiah apieh thu ka theikheta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuabepin ka lungthah mamata a, tuachi’n Tobiah inn sunga vante zousie, pindan apat in ka paidoh siengta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n thu ka pie a, pindante a susieng ua, tuachi’n Pasian inn a um leh belte leh ann sillatte leh gimnamtuite ka hing koilut kia ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Levi mite tanvou akung uah akipesih chi ka theidohta a, aziehpen Levimite leh Lasamite zousie khu a nasep ding ua a mawpuohnate uh nuasie in amauh lou lam chiet ah akinua tai chietta uh chi zong ka theikheta hi.","ref":"Danp. 12.19"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n vaihawmte ka kinielpi a, akung uah, “Bang dinga Pasian biehinn nuasie a um ahiei?” ka chi hi. Tuachi’n amaute ka hankhawm a, amauh mun chiet ah ka umsah kia hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda mite zousie in bu sawm a khatte, uoin thate leh sathaute van koikhawmna inn ah ahing tawi khawm uhi.","ref":"Mala. 3.10"},"13":{"text":"Ken van koikhawm na sum kem dingin siempu Shelemiah, laigielpa Zadok levimite lah a khat, Pedaiah ka guot a, tualeh amaute ban ah Mattaniah tapa, Zakkur tapa Hanan ahi, aziehpen amaute mi ginum a ngai ahi uhi, amaute nasep ahileh a unaute lah ua, neh leh taah hawm pieh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tamte tungtang ah hing thei ngitnget inlen, Aw ka Pasian, tualeh ka Pasian inn a ding leh khuna nasepna dinga ka ka sepzousa ka nasep hoite hing nuoimang pieh sin chi in ka thum hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua hunlai in, Juda gam ah khawlni a uoin suhna a grep chil a, bute puo a, grep gate, theigate leh vangih chi tuom tuomte, sabiltungte a guongte ka mu a; amauten tam silte zousie khawlni in Jerusalem ah ahing polut uhi. Tuaziehin amaute tua ni a nehletah zua lou dingin ka vauhilta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.8-10; Danp. 5.12-14; Jer. 17.21,22"},"16":{"text":"Tai-ar mi Jerusalem khopi a tengten zong nga leh van tuom tuomte ahing polut ua, Jerusalem a Juda mite lah ah khawlni in ahing zua uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ken Juda miliente ka vauhil a, akung uah, “Khawlni buasah a, na sil hoilou bawlte uh bang chi dan ahiei?"},"18":{"text":"Napu leh pate un tambangin abawl ua, i Pasian un eite tung leh tam khopi tungah tam sil hoilou zousie hing tungsah hitalou ahiei mah? Hinapiin nouten khawlni na buasah zieh un Israel tungah thangpaina tamsem na kibelap sah nalai uhi,” ka chi hi."},"19":{"text":"Khawlni kipat masanga, nitahlam ni himten Jerusalem kotpite aphah tah chienga kotkhate kha ding leh khawlni bei masangsie a kotte honglou ding in thu ka pie a, tualeh khawlni a vante ahing ki puohlut louna dingin ka nasemte pawl khatte kulkotpite veng dingin ka koi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n summet bawlte leh van chi tuom tuom zuate khu khatvei ahiei, nivei ahiei, Jerusalem pulam ah agieh uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute ka vau a, akung uah, “Bangdinga kulbang bul a gieh na hi uoi? tambanga na bawl kia u’leh, na tung uah khut ha ding ka hi,” ka chi hi. Tua ni akipat in khawl niin ahing peikia nawn sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Ken, khawlni siengthoutaha akitan theina dingin Levite ki susiengthou a, kotpite veng dingin thu ka pie hi. Tuachi’n Ken Aw ka Pasian, tamte ziehin Kei hing thei ngitnget inlen, Na itna thupidan dungzui in hing humbit in, chiin ka thum hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua hunlaiin, Ashdod, Ammon leh Moab numeite Juda miten zi a akitenpi uh ka mu hi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.11-16; Danp. 7.1-5"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh atate uh kimkhat Ashdod ham in aham ua, Juda ham in aham theisih uhi, hinanleh nam dang dangte ham in aham uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute ka phawh a, hamsie ka lawkhum a, pawlkhatte ka vuo a, ka humsamlai a, asamte uh kabaw khiet pieh hi. “Namdangte tapate adingin na tanute uh na pieh ding uh ahi sih a, na tapate u’leh nouma a dingin zong atanute uh na lah lou ding uh ahi, chiin Pasian min in ka kichiemsah hi."},"26":{"text":"Israel leengpa Solomon zong tambang numei tunga na gamta khiel hilou ahiei mah? Nam tampite lah ah ama banga Pasian in a it leengpa koima a um sih a, Pasian in ama khu Israelte zousie tunga leengpa ding in abawl a, hinanleh ama ngel zong gamdang numeiten ana khiel sahta uhi.","ref":"2 Sam. 12.24,25; 1 Leeng. 11.1-8"},"27":{"text":"Nouten zong tambanga gamdang numeite kitenpi in tam giltouna thupitah leh i Pasian tunga khelna chizat huoi na bawl uh, chi tuni a ngaikhe ding ka hi uoi mah?” ka chi hi."},"28":{"text":"Siempulien Eliashib tapa Joiada tapate lah a khat khu Horon mi Sanballat mahpa ana hi a, tuazieh in ama khu ka kunga pat in ka delmang hi.","ref":"Neh. 4.1"},"29":{"text":"Aw ka Pasian, amauh thei ngitnget in, aziehpen amaun siempu hina leh siempute leh Levite thuhun a buasahta uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tambangin Keima’n amaute gamdangmi zousie apat in ka siensuota a, siempute a ding leh Levimite a dingin, michin amauh sep ding chiet ka guot piehta hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh hun bi kiguotsate a, sing sillat ding leh ga masa te ading in zong ka guot hi. Hoina dingin hing thei ngitngetin, Aw Mangpa ka Pasian."}}}}},"17":{"info":{"name":"Esther","shortname":"Est.","abbr":[],"desc":"Esther laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahasueras damlai a sil tung tambang ahi. Tam Ahasueras khu India apat Ethiopia dong, gamkai za leh sawmni leh sagi tunga leeng vaihawm a na pang ahi.","title":"Leengnu Vasti tangthu","ref":"Ezr. 4.6"},"2":{"text":"Tua hunlai a leengpa Ahasueras Shushan khopi a aleengtoupha tunga atou lai in,"},"3":{"text":"avaihawmna kum thum achin kum in akhawnbawl upate leh amiliente zousie adingin annkuongluina abawl hi. Persia leh Media gam galkap lamkaite, gam sung miliente leh gamkai a uhpipate atel kim chiet uhi."},"4":{"text":"A leenggam hausatna thupidan, aletna thupina leh azatat huoina zousie ni tampi, ni za leh ni sawmgiet sung vingveng a en sah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tam nite ahing beitahin leengpa’n aleeng innpi shushan sunga, um mi zousie aneu pen apat alien pen donga dingin ni sagi sung leengpa innpi huon sungah annkuong alui hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua huon sungah, puonkhai kaangte dumte puonmalngat leh vaukhau sandang in dangka sia kuolte a ki khituo in suong kaang khuom ah kihung hi. Sana leh dangka a kibawl touphate khu, suongkang, sandang leh adum a kizem, suongpeh tuong kipha tungah akitung hi."},"7":{"text":"Sana chi tuom tuom a kizem noute in dawn ding zu ahawm ua, leengpa silphalna dungzui in zu chia akiching mama hi."},"8":{"text":"Zu khu noubem lienpi a hawm ahia, koima kipaubawl aum sih a, koipou in ama ut dan dan a adawn uh phal ahi, azieh pen michin in adei bangbang ua bawlsah dingin leengpa’n a innpi huong sunga zu lam sai miliente thu apiehsa ahita hi."},"9":{"text":"Lengnu Vasti in zong leengpa Ahasueras leeng inn huong sungah numeite adingin annkuong luina khat abawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Ani sagi ni a, leengpa Ahasueras lungtang zuin akipahsah laitah in, anasem michilge sagite, Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha leh Abagtha, Zethar leh Karkas te thu apie a,","title":"Leengnu Vasti nielna"},"11":{"text":"Lengnu Vasti aleeng lukhu khuin, leengpa mai ah hing zawpi unlen, mipite leh miliente mai ah amel hoina ala ding ahi, achi hi, aziehpen amanu a melhoi mama zieh in."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh leengnu Vasti in, tua michilgete thugen leengpa thupieh niel in ahing pei nuom sih hi. Tam thu ah leengpa alungthah mama a asungah athangpaina akuong hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpan dan thei mite leh hun umdan theisiem mipilte akikuppi a (aziehpen hichibanga dan leh tawn dan thei siem mite kikuppi khu leengpa bawldan ngaina ahi),"},"14":{"text":"Lengpa zom a miliente pen Karshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena leh Memukan ahi ua, amaute Parsia leh Media milien sagi, leengpa kunga haw thei ngitnget te leh tua leenggam a dinmun sanga tou masa pente ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"“Lengpa Ahasueras in michilgete agensah athupieh amanlou ziehin dan dungzuiin leengnu Vasti bang law ding ahiei?” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Memukan in, leengpa leh amiliente mai ah, “Lengpa tung guoh ah leengnu Vasti akhiel sih a, leengpa Ahasueras gam sung pumpi a miliente zousie leh mipite zousie tunga dihloutah a sil bawl ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen numei zousiein leengnu Vasti thuman louna athei ding ua, Lengpa Ahasueras in leengnu Vasti amai a hing pui dingin thu apie a, hinanleh ahing pei ut sih hi, chi athei ding ua, apasalte uh asimmaw ding uhi, achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuni mama akipat in Persia leh Media milien numeiten leengnu gamtat dan aza ding ua, tuachi’n leengpa miliente kungah tuabangin agen ding ua, tuachi’n nahpitah a kisimmawna leh lungthahna ahing umdoh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin leengpa’n pha asah leh leengpa’n thupieh khat suo henlen, Vasti khu leengpa Ahasueras mai ah hing kilang nawn sih heh, chi in henlamdang theilou dingin, Persia leh Media dante lah ah gellut hi henlen, tualeh leengpa’n Vasti sanga melhoizaw midang khat kungah tua leengnu hina dinmun pie hen.","title":"Leengpa thupieh"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua leengpa thupieh bawl khu aleenggam sung pumpi a akihawmjah tah chiengin (a leenggam alien mama thuoi a) numeite zousie in apasalte uh alien leh aneu kungah zatatna ape ding uhi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tambang thuhilna in leengpa leh amiliente akipahsahta a, tuachi’n leengpa’n Memukan thu gen bangin abawlta a,"},"22":{"text":"aman a leenggam sung pumpi leh gamkai zousie ah amauh laizem leh amauh ham chietin agiel a, namchin kungah, pasal pouma ama innsung chiet ah thuneipen ahi ding ahi, chiin thuphuon ahah suohta hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte nua a leengpa Ahasueras lungthahna ahing dambep in, aman Vasti in bang ahiei abawl a, atunga bang thupieh kikesah atai chi ahing ngaituodoh hi.","title":"Vasti mun luo ding suina."},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa nasem asuohten leengpa kungah, “Leengpa adingin nungah siengthou dawnglai melhoi khat kisui hen, achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n nungah siengthou melhoi zousie susa leeng innpi a numeite umna inn ah, numeite kempa, leengpa michilge Hegai etkolna inn a hing puikhawm dingin aleenggam sung leh gamkai pumpi ah miliente guot henlen, akizepna ding uleh akinu ding uh van leh sathaute kipie hen."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh nungah leengpa lungkimna pen khu Vasti taangin leengnu hita hen,” achi uhi. Tam thu in leengpa akipahsah a, aman tuabangin abawlta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualaitah in susa leeng innpi huong sungah Juda mi khat aum a, amin Mordekai ahia, Jair tapa ahi. Jair khu Shimei tapa ahia, Shimei khu Kish tapa ahia, Benjamin mite khat ahi."},"6":{"text":"Kish khu Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in Judate leengpa Jakoniah toh Jerusalem apata sal a apui khawmte lah a khat ahi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.10-16; 2 Khang. 36.10"},"7":{"text":"Mordekai in apaneu tanu asanggam numei khat Hadassah tua khu Esther ahi, ana kem piching a, amanu’n nu leh pa a nei nawn sih a, tam nungah khu amelhoi in aduong ching mama hi, tualeh anu leh apa ashitaah ziehin Mordekai in ama tanu dinga a lah ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa thupieh leh athuphuonte akizah tahin, nungah tampi Shushan a leeng innpi a Hegai mikepna inn a ahing kikhopkhawm tah un, Esther zong leengpa leeng inn huongsungah ahing zawpi ua, Hegai in akikemsah hi. Hegai pen numeite umna enkolpa ahi."},"9":{"text":"Esther in Hegai alungkim sah a, adeisahna anga hi. Tuachi’n aman melhoina dinga, kinu leh kizutna ding leh ann neh ding hoitah leh leengpa innpi sung a kipat in nungah teltuom sagi kintah in ape pai a, tualeh aman amanu leh anungahte umna dingin numeite umna innsunga mun hoipen aguot piehta hi."},"10":{"text":"Mordekai in genlou ding chia akham ziehin, Esther in, achi anam leh abe aphung koima kung ah agen sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Mordekai in Esther bangchin aum ei, tualeh atungah bang thu aum ei, chi thei nuom in numeite umna innmai leituol ah nichin in avah kawi kawi hi."},"12":{"text":"Nungah chinteng leengpa Ahasueras mai a akilah hun uh ahing tuntahin, numeite dinga dan kibawlpieh ha sawm leh hani a um nua un, tuabanga akisiensahna nite uh suhbukim ahi zel hi, ha guh sung mura thau akizut ding, haguh sung gimnamtuite a kizut ding, tualeh numeite melhoina ding a kizutna dang dangte kinu ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nungahte leengpa mai a ava kilah hun chieng un, numeite umna inn-a kipat a leengpa innpi a alut chieng a aken ding adei dei pieh ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nitahlam in amanu ava haw a, azingni zingmawng in numeite umna inn nina ah, leengpa michilge Shaashga, leengpa meite kempa kunga ahing kinuale kia ding ahi. Lengpa’n amanu tunga alungkim a amin a nua hat kia ahilou ngal leh leengpa kungah ahawkia thei nawn sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Atanu dinga amanu lapa Mordekai paneu Abihail tanu leengpa kunga ahaw hun ahing tun tahin, amanu’n numeite kempa leengpa michilge Hegai in athumopna chiloungal bangma angen sih hi. Esther in ama ente zousie deisahna atangta hi.","title":"Esther kiteldohna"},"16":{"text":"Lengpa Ahasueras vaihawm kum sagina, aha sawmna, Tebeth ha in Esther leengpa innpi ah puilut in aumta hi."},"17":{"text":"Lengpan numei dangte zousie sangin Esther a it penta a, nungah siengthou dangte sangin leengpa deisahna leh hepina atangta hi, tuazieh in leengpa’n Esther lutungah a leenglukhu akhusah a, Vasti mun ah leengnu in apangsahta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpan amiliente leh avaihawmpite adingin annkuong Esther annkuong kichi thupitah in alui a, agam sung pumpi ah khawlni aphuonga, akiphalna dungzui in kipahman ahawm hi."},"19":{"text":"Nungah siengthoute aniveina dinga ahing kikhop khawm lai un, Mordekai khu leengpa innpi kotkha ah atou hi.","title":"Mordekai in leengpa kiguh phielna agen khiehna"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Mordekai in ahil bangin Esther in amanu hing kipatna innkuon leh aminam hina agenkhe nai sih hi, aziehpen Esther in Mordekai thuhilnate ama innsung a, akhawi piching lai mabangin a zui nalai hi."},"21":{"text":"Khummi hunlai a, Mordekai leengpa innkotpi a atou lai in, leengpa michilge nite Bigthan leh Teresh, kotpi venga umtegel alungthah ua leengpa Ahasueras tha tum in thu aguh phiel uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tam thu kiphielgu khu Mordekai in atheikhata a, aman tam thuguh leengnu Esther kungah ahil a, tualeh Esther in Mordekai min in leengpa kungah ahil hi."},"23":{"text":"Tam thu ahing kikanchien tahin, adih ahi chi akimuta a, tuachi’n tua mi nite kikhailupna tau tungah akikhailumta uhi. Tam thute leengpa muna ngel ah, leengte khangthu gelna laibu ah akigiel hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte zouin, leengpa Ahasueras in Agag mi Hammedatha tapa Haman akaisang sah a, atawisanga akunga um milien dangte zousie sanga sangzaw touna ah atou sah hi.","title":"Haman kaisangna: Mordekai in zana abawl tuonlou"},"2":{"text":"Lengpa kotpi bula um, leengpa suohte zousie in kun in Haman zatatna abawl uhi, aziehpen leengpan Haman khu, tuabanga bawl ding ahi chi in thupieh abawl hi. Hinanleh Mordekai akun sih a, zana zong ape sih hi"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa kotpi bul a um leengpa suohten Mordekai kungah, “Bangdinga leengpa thupieh zuilou na hiei?” achi uhi"},"4":{"text":"Tuabang in nichin in agen ua, hinanleh aman angaikhiet tuonlou tah in, Mordekai gamtatdan Haman in athuoh theina diei mah, chi in, Haman ahilta uhi, aziehpen aman Juda mi ahi amauh ana hilta hi."},"5":{"text":"Mordekai in kun in ama zana ape nuom sih chi Haman in amu tahin alungthah mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh aman Mordekai tung maimai a, khut hah ding ahawmthaw a, Mordekai mite koite ahiei chi ana hilta ua, tuaziehin Haman in leengpa Ahasueras leenggam a teng Mordekai chipi Judate zousie thagam siengna ding lampi asuita hi."},"7":{"text":"Lengpa Ahasueras leenga apan kum sawm leh nina, aha khatna Nisan ha in, alungtup bawldoh na ding ani leh aha atel theina ding in Haman mai ah Pur kichi ai sanna abawl ua, tua ai san pen aha sawm leh nina Adar ha ni sawm leh thum ni a, tua ai san akieh tandongin ai asan uhi.","title":"Haman in Judate thagamna aguh a angaituona"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Haman in leengpa Ahasueras kungah “Na leenggam a, gamkai zousie a kithethang leh kikhentuom minam khat a um a, amaute ngaina dan leh tawndante uh midangte ngaina dan leh tawndan toh akibang sih a, tualeh leengpa thupiehte zong azui sih uhi, tuaziehin amaute tambanga um sah pen leengpa adingin thuohzou huoilou ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tami leengpa’n na deidan ahileh, amaute suhchimitna ding, thukiehna khat kisuodoh henlen, tam nna semkhete a dingin keiman dangka sum talent tul sawm leengpa sumkoina ah ka pe ding hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n asuoi namna khutsip akhut apat alakhie a, Hamedatha tapa Agag mi Haman, Judate melmapa apeta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n Haman kungah, “Dangka sum leh tua mite na dei bang banga na bawl dingin na kunga pieh ahita hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n ha khatna ni sawm leh thum ni in leengpa’n laigiel mite akihankhawm a, Haman thupieh dungzuiin leengpa miliente leh gamkai chin a uhpipate, tualeh gamkai tenga mipite tunga vaihawmte kungah amaute laiteng leh amauh ham chiet a kigiel in, leengpa Ahasueras min a kigiel in, tualeh leengpa khutsip in akinam hi."},"13":{"text":"Lengpa leenggam sunga, gamkai zousie ah lai taite akisawl a, leengpa leenggam sunga gamkai zousie a Judate zousie, ateh akhang leh numei naupang zousie ha sawm leh nina Adar ha, ni sawm leh ni thum ni a nikhat thu a thagam a suhchimit ding, tualeh anei alamte zousie uh, galvan lah a lah pieh ding, chi in laihah ahawmzahta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua thupieh lai kigiel teikhiet khat chiet, gamkai zousie ah akihawmzah a, laihah sunga thupieh kigiel banga, ani chiem ni a, mansa a aum theina ding un, nam chinteng kunga phuonzah ahita hi."},"15":{"text":"Laihah khu leengpa thupieh in laitaiten akin akin in ataipi ua, tua thuphuon khu Shushan innpi a phuonkhieh ahi. Lengpa leh Haman zu dawn in atoukhawm ua, hinanleh Shushan khopi amangbangta hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mordekai in tua thu kibawl zousie atheitah in apuonte abotkeh a, sai ip puon asil a, leivui akibuoh khum a, khopi sungah apei a, aw ngaitah leh hase tahin akapta hi.","title":"Judate ann ngawlna"},"2":{"text":"Leengpa inn lutna kotpi tan ahing pei hi, aziehpen leengpa huong sungah sai ip puon sil in koima akilut sah sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa thupieh leh thukhennna tunna gamkai zousie ah, Juda mite lah ah kana leh mauna nasatah a umta a, ann ngawlnate, kanate, danate leh mi tampite sai ip puon sil in leivui lah ah alum uhi."},"4":{"text":"Esther zen numeite leh mi chilgete ahing pei ua, tamthu amanu ahing hil tah un, leengnu Esther alungkham mama hi, Mordekai in a sai ip puonte sutkhie a asil ding puonte Esther in ahah a, hinanleh Mordekai in asang nuom sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Esther in ama kem dinga kiguot leengpa michilge Hathak kichipa ahan a, bang zieha tam thute pieng ahiei chi theikhe dingin, Mordekai kunga va haw dingin asawlta hi."},"6":{"text":"Hathak khu leengpa kotpi mai a khopi gawl zing aum Mordekai kungah ava hawta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mordekai in atunga siltung zousie leh Judate suhchimitna dinga, Haman in leengpa sum koina a pieh dinga achiem sum za zong ana hilta hi."},"8":{"text":"Mordekai in amaute suhchimitna dinga Shushan khopi a kiphuong thupiehna lai teikhiet lai dalkhat Esther kunga ala ding leh ahilchet dingin amapa ana pie a, tualeh leengpa kunga valut a amite a dinga khotuona ngen a va guitam dinga, ngen tei tei dingin asawlta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hathak ahing kile kia a, Mordekai thugen zousie Esther kungah a hilta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Esther in Hathak ahoupi a, akungah Mordekai a ding thuvaihah khat ahil hi."},"11":{"text":"“Lengpa suohte zousie leh leengpa gamkai a mite’n, koipou pasal hi in numei hitaleh hatloupi a leengpa inn huong sungnung a lut khu tha ahi ding a, tambang pel theina um sun khu leengpan asana lengchieng ama lam a alenate ahing ding chi dan khat um khu athei chiet uhi. Hinanleh kei pen ni sawmthum sung vingveng leengpa kunga lut ding a hat in ka umta sih hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Esther thugente Mordekai kunga ava hil tah un,"},"13":{"text":"Aman tam dawnna thu anuahah kia hi; “Leengpa innpi sunga um nahi zieh a, Juda mite zousie lah a nang mai mai suohta dingin kingaituo sin."},"14":{"text":"Tambang huna sip dide a na umleh, panpina leh hutkhietna mundanga kipat ahing pieng dinga, nang leh na pa innkuonte na mangthai ding uhi. Tambang hun a dinga leengnu dinmun hing tung nahi mel koi in athei ei?” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengnu Esther in tambang dawnna Mordekai kungah ahah hi."},"16":{"text":"“Pei inlen Susa khopi a Juda mite zousie khawm inlen, Kei a dingin ann ngawl unlen, nithum sung ann nelou tuidawnlouin sun lezan in um un, Kei leh ka nungahten zong tuabangin ann ka ngawl ding uhi. Tuazou chiengin dan toh kituoh sih nanleh, leengpa kungah ka vahaw dinga, ka manthai tah leh amangthai ka himai ding hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mordekai akuondoh a, Esther thuhil zousie abawlta hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ani thum niin, Esther in leengnu puon asil a, leengpa inndan lien mai a, thukhenna inndan sungta pen ah ava dingta hi. Lengpa pen tua inndan lienpi sunga aleengtouna tungah, kotpi lam nga in atou hi.","title":"Leengpa mai ah Esther"},"2":{"text":"Lengpan leengnu Esther thukhenna inndan sung a, ding amu tahin, amanu ana kipahpi a, akhut a asana lengchieng Esther lam ah alehtou a, tuachi’n Esther in azuon a, aleengchieng mong ava thamta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n akungah, “Leengnu Esther aw, bang e na dei? Bang ngen nuom na hiei? Ka leenggam kimkhat nangawn ka hing pe ding hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Esther in adawnga, “Leengpa’n pha nasah leh tuni in leengpa adinga ka annkuong lui Haman toh hing nehpi un aw,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Lengpa’n Esther genbanga ka bawl theina dingun “Haman akinthei pen in hing zawpi un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n leengpa leh Haman khu Esther annkuong luina ah ahawta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Zu adawn lai un, leengpa’n leengnu Esther adong kia a, “Bang ahiei na thumna? pieh na hi ding, tualeh bang ahiei na nget?” leenggam kimkhat nangawn phal ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Esther in adawnga, “Ka silnget leh ka dei khu tami ahi."},"8":{"text":"Lengpa deisahna katan a, leengpan ka ngetna ahing phal pieh ding leh zing chienga leengpa leh Haman a dinga ann kuong ka lui pieh ding ah hing pei unlen, tuachiengin leengpa dohna ka dawng ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua niin Haman kipahtah leh lungnuom tah in apei hi. Hinanleh leengpa kotpi bul a Mordekai ding lou leh amai a zauna mel zong pawlou a pielou kei a um amu in, Mordekai tungah alungthah mama ta hi.","title":"Mordekai thana ding kem kidawna"},"10":{"text":"Ahivang in Haman akideh ham hama a inn ah apeita hi. Tuachi’n alawmte leh azi Zeresh ahan sah a,"},"11":{"text":"amaute kungah Haman in ahausatna thupi dante, atapa neitam dante leh leengpa’n ama lam tampi a apahtawinate leh milien leh vaihawmte tunga akaisang sah dante siel in aki-otsahpi hi."},"12":{"text":"Haman in agenbe nalai a, “Lengnu Esther nangawn in zong a annkuong luina ah leengpa toh zawhkhawm dingin Kei chilou koimadang achiel sih hi, tualeh zing chieng a zong leengpa toh annkuong imkhawm dingin ahing chiel nalai hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa kotpi bula tou Juda mi Mordekai ka mu laisie in, tamte zousiein lungkimna ahing pe sih hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n azi Zaresh leh alawmte zousie in akung ah, “Tong sawm nga a sang kikhailupna kem khat bawl hi henlen, tuami tunga Mordekai khailup dingin, zingmawngin leengpa kungah gen inlen, tua zou chieng in, leengpa toh annkuong im dingin kuon in” achi uhi. Tam thute’n Haman akipahsah a, kikhailupna kem abawlsah ta hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum zan in leengpa khu a imu theita sih a, ama’n leengte khangthu kigelna laibu hing tawi un chi’n thu apie a, tuachi’n tua thute leengpa mai ah asim uhi.","title":"Mordekai kipahtawina"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n kotkha venga pang leengpa michilge nite Bigthan leh Teresh in, leengpa Ahasueras tha atupna uh tungtang, Mordekai in ana genkhieh thu kigiel khu ahing mukheta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n “Tami ziehin Mordekai tungah zana leh pahtawina kibawlkhalou amah?” achi hi. Akunga nasem leengpa suohten, ama dingin “Bangma akibawlkha sih hi,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Lengpa’n “Innhuong sungah koi a um ei?” achi a, tualaitahin Haman khu kikhailupna ding bawla Mordekai khailup sah ding thu gen dingin leengpa huongsung pawnungzaw ah ahing lut hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa suohten akungah, “Haman inn huong sungah ading hi” achi uhi, tualeh leengpa’n “Hing lut heh,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Haman aluta, leengpa’n akungah, “Leengpa’n apahtawi nuompa tungah bang chi kibawl ding ahiei?” achi hi. Haman in alungsim in, “Kei khel a leengpa’n apahtawi nuom ding koi a um diei mah?” chiin angaituo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Haman in leengpa kungah, “Leengpa’n apahtawi nuom mi a dingin,"},"8":{"text":"leengpa’n asil ngel leengpuontuol leh leengpa tuonna sakol leh alutunga akhuh zel leenglukhu kilasah henlen,"},"9":{"text":"tam puontuol leh sakol khu leengpa milien zatathuoi pente lah a khat in, leengpa’n a pahtawi nuom mi khu silsah henlen, tua sakol tungah kituongsah henlen, khopi gawlzing teng zui in kizawpi henlen, amasangah, leengpa’n apahtawi nuom mi tungah tambanga kibawl ding ahi, chiin kiphuong malam zel heh,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Haman kungah, “Kintah in pei pai inlen, na gen bangin leengpuontuol leh sakol vala inlen, leengpa kotpi a tou Judami Mordekai tungah vabawl in, na gensate khat zong bawllou nei vawt sin,” achita hi.","title":"Haman in Mordekai apah tawina"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Haman in leengpuontuol leh sakol avala a, leengpa puontuol Mordekai asil sah a, sakol tung a tuongsah in khopi gawlzing tengah akai a, “Leengpa’n apahtawi nuom mi khu tambanga kibawl ahi,” chi in aphuong malam zel hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuazou in Mordekai pen leengpa kotpi ah akinuale kia a, Hinanleh Haman khu nguitah leh alu kikhukhum in a inn ah kintah in apeita hi"},"13":{"text":"Haman in azi Zeresh leh alawmte zousie kungah, atunga siltung zousie ahilta hi. Tuachi’n ama thuhil mipilte leh a zi Zeresh in akungah, “Amai a na pua kipatna Mordekai Judami pa ahile vang na zou vawt sih ding hi, hinanleh amasang ah na guollel ngeingei ding hi,” achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuabanga akihoulim laitah un, leengpa michilgete ahing tung ua, Esther in abawl ankuongluina atel dingin, Haman kintahin azawpita uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa leh Haman khu leengnu Esther annkuongluina imkhawm dingin akuonta uhi.","title":"Esther ankuonglui niveina leh Haman khailupna"},"2":{"text":"Ani ni niin annkuongluina zu adawn lai un, leengpa’n leengnu Esther kungah, “Leengnu Esther bang ahiei na thumna? hing kipe ding ahi. Bang ahiei na nget? Ka leenggam kimkhat nangawn zong hing kipe ding ahi,” achita hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengnu Esther in adawnga, “Aw leengpa na mitmu a deisahna katan a, leengpa lungkimna ahileh, ka hinna hing khawi pieh in, chi ka thumna ahi, tuaban ah ka mite hinna zong khawipieh in chi ka ngetna ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Kei leh ka mite suhmangthai ding, thagam ding leh suhchimit dinga khohzou sieng ka hita uhi. Suohpa leh suohnu ding beeh ahiei a khohkhiet hi ulengvang, melmapan leengpa silsuhsiet dinzou ngailou ding hita nanleh hamlou a sip khinkhien ding hi ing a,” achita hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Ahasueras in leengnu Esther kungah, “Tuabanga bawl dinga lungtanga tumngam khu koi ahiei? tualeh tu’n ama hei ah a um ei?” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Esther in, “Langpangpa leh melmapa tam tatsepa Haman ahi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Haman khu leengpa leh leengnu masang ah zau in achitun denta hi."},"7":{"text":"Lengpa lungthah sengin annkuong luina pat in adingdoh a, leeng inn huongsunga huon lai ah apeita hi, hinanleh Haman in leengpa’n atunga abawl ding dan thukhenna abawlta chi athei zieh in leengnu Esther mai ah ahinna humbit dinga ngen dingin a umdenta hi."},"8":{"text":"Lengpa leeng inn huonsunga kipat in annkuongluina inndan sungah ahing peikia tahin, Haman khu leengnu Esther lupna tungah ana pua a, tuachi’n leengpa’n “Ka innsung na ngawn a, ka mitmu a leengnu nasan suol tum nalai ahiei mah?” achi hi. Lengpa kam a thu apawt tahin, Haman mai atuom piehta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Lengpa kem michilgete lah a khat Harbona in, “En in, leengpa hutkhietna dinga thugenpa Mordekai a kikhailupna dinga Haman in tong sawm nga a sang kem adaw a inn ah a um nalai hi, achi hi. Tuachi’n leengpa’n tuanah ama khailia un” achita hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n “Mordekai khailupna dinga abawl kem ah Haman akhailumta uhi.” Tuachi’n leengpa lungthahna, aphata hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua niin leengpa Ahasueras in Judate melmapa Haman inn kuonte leengnu Esther kungah apeta hi. Tualeh Esther in Mordekai toh akinai dan uh agenkhiettah ziehin Mordekai leengpa mai ah ahing peita hi.","title":"Haman inn Mordekai kipiehna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n asuoi namna khutsip, Haman kunga kipata alah khiet pen asutkhie a Mordekai khut ah apeta hi. Tualeh Esther in Mordekai khu Haman innsunga vaihawm in apangsahta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Esther khu leengpa kengbul ah khupbohin ahitui toh thu agenkia a, Judate sietna ding bawlpa Agagmi Haman silgilou bawltupte heimang dingin angen ngut ngut hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n asana leengchieng Esther lam ah avihtou a,"},"5":{"text":"tuachi’n Esther ahing thoudoh a, leengpa maiah adingta hi. “Tualeh amanu’n tami’n leengpa alungkim sah a, adeisahna tangtah ka hileh, tualeh leengpa masanga tam khu sildih ahi a, amitmu a lungkimhuoi ahileh, leengpa leenggam sung zousie a um Juda mite suhmangna dinga Agagmi Hammedatha tapa Haman in laihah ahawmte phietmang dingin thupieh khat giel henlen, hawm heh."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen ka mite tunga vangsietna tung ding Ken bangchi’n ka thuohzou mama diei? Tualeh ka chipite suhmangna bangchi a Ken en ngam mama ding ka hiei?” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Ahasueras in leengnu Esther leh Juda mi Mordekai kungah, “En un Haman inn khu Esther kungah ka peta a, tualeh Judate tunga khut ahah ziehin ama zong khailupna kem dawn ah akhailumta uhi.","title":"Leengpa Ahasueras thupieh dang"},"8":{"text":"Tuin na dei bangbang un leengpa min in Juda mite a dingin lai giel unlen, leengpa suoi namna khutsip in nam un; aziehpen leengpa min a thupieh lai a kigiel a leengpa suoinamna khutsipa kinam khu koiman phel theilou ahi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua hun laiin leengpa laigiel mite khu ha thumna Sivan ha ni sawmni leh nithum ni in ahankhawm pai ua, India akipat Ethiopia donga gamkai za leh sawmni leh sagi a um Judate kungah leh uhpi neute leh uhpipate leh miliente kungah Mordekai thupieh dungzui in laihah ding agiel uhi. Gamkai chin ah amauh laiteng chietin tualeh namchin amauh ham chiet in akigiel a, tualeh Judate kungah zong Juda lai leh ham in akigielta hi."},"10":{"text":"Mordekai in leengpa Ahasueras min in lai agiel a, leengpa suoinamna khutsip in anam a, laitaite pen leengpa dinga kikhawituom sakol hat mamate a tuongin, tua laite ahawm uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua leengpa thupieh in khopi chintenga Judamite kikhopkhawm theina ding leh amaute kihumbit theina ding phalna apie a, tualeh tua thupieh in, koi chi koi nam leh koi gam hitaleh ama uleh anumei naupangte uh doudinga galvan tawi pouma, suhmang theina, tha theina leh agalte uh neisa lahpieh theina thuneina apie hi."},"12":{"text":"Lengpa Ahasueras gamsung pumpia, Judaten tambanga abawl theina ding ua ni kiguot khu, ha sawm leh nina, Adar ha, ni sawm le thum ni ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tam thupieh teikhiet dalkhat chiet, gamkai pumpi a, khumi ni chienga Judaten amelmate uh tunga phuba la thei dinga mansa a aum theina ding ua, danthupieh a gellut dinga nam zousie kunga phuonzah ahita hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa thupieh kinaw mama ziehin, laitaite khu leengpa sakol taihat pente a tuongin atai khie uhi. Tualeh tua thupieh khu Shushan khopi a leengpa innpi sungah zong akiphuong khie hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mordekai khu leengpuon dum leh ngou silin sana leenglukhu thupitah khu in, puonmalngat sandup puontuol sil in leengpa kunga kipat in apawtkhie a, Shushan khopi mite zousie lungdam in akikou uhi."},"16":{"text":"Judate a dingin navahna, kipahna leh lungnopna leh zabawlna ni ahi."},"17":{"text":"Lengpa thupieh leh thukhenna tunna gamkai teng leh khopi zousie a, Juda mite lah ah lungdamna leh kipahna tualeh khawlni leh pawi thupitah a umta hi. Tuaban ah gamsung a namdang tampiten Judate a giin zieh un Judami asuohta uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin ha sawm leh nina, Adar ha, ni sawm leh thum niin, leengpa thukhenna leh thupiehte suhtangtun ahi ding laitah in leh Judate melmaten amaute zaw a thuneikhum akinem uhi. Hinanleh Judaten amelmate uh tunga thunei dingin ni khat thu in sil ahing kilumletta hi.","title":"Judate guolzawna ni"},"2":{"text":"Lengpa Ahasueras gamkai sung pumpi a Judate amauh tenna khopi chiet ah akikhawm ua, amaute suhmang sawmte dou dingin akisata uhi. Namdangte zousie in amauh agiin tah zieh un, amaute koiman anang zouta sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Gamkai pumpi sunga miliente, uhpi neute leh uhpi liente tualeh leengpa vaihawmten Mordekai agiintah zieh un, Judate apanpita uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Mordekai khu leengpa innpi sungah athunei mamata a, gamkai zousie ah aminthang suohta a, ahing thunei semsemta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judaten amelmate uh asatlum sieng ua, athatgam ua, amauh mudate tungah a ut dan dan un abawl uhi."},"6":{"text":"Shushan khopi a leeng inn huongsungah mi za nga athat ua, asumang uhi."},"7":{"text":"Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha leh,"},"8":{"text":"Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha leh"},"9":{"text":"Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai,"},"10":{"text":"tualeh Judate melmapa Hammedatha tapa Haman tapate sawm zong amaun athat uhi, hinanleh gallah sum bangma ala sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ni a Shushan khopi a leeng inn huongsunga kithatte aphaza leengpa kungah ahil pai uhi."},"12":{"text":"Lengpa’n leengnu Esther kungah, “Judaten Susa khopi ah mi zanga leh Haman tapate sawm zong athatta ua, leengpa gamkai dangte ah bangachi bawlta uoi? Tuin bang ahiei na nget? Pieh na hi ding, ahisihleh na dei bang ahiei? ahing kibawlpieh ding hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Esther in akungah, “Leengpa’n pha asahleh, Susa a um Judaten tunia thupieh bangbang zingchienga zong abawl uh phal hi henlen, Haman tapa sawmte khailupna dawn ah khai hi uheh,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n tuabanga bawl dingin thupieh abawlta a, tualeh Shushan khopi ah thukhenna khat asuo a, Haman tapa sawmte akikhailum siengta hi."},"15":{"text":"Adar ha ni sawm leh li niin zong Shushan khopi a um Judate akikhawm kia ua, tualeh Shushan ah mi za thum athat uhi, hinanleh gallah sumte bangma akhoi sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuin leengpa gamkai sunga um Judami umsunten zong ahinna uh humbit dingin akikhawm uhi, tualeh amelmate ua kipat in suotatna amu ua, tualeh amauh mudate lah a mi tulsawm sagi leh tulnga athat ua, hinanleh agallah sum bangma akhoi sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tam pen Adar ha ni sawm leh thum ni a siltung ahi a, ani sawm leh li ni in akhawldamta ua, pawi bawlna ni leh kipahna ni in azangta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Shushan khopi a, um Judate pen ni sawm leh thum ni leh ni sawm leh li niin akikhawm ua, ni sawm leh nga ni in akhawldam ua, pawi bawlni leh kipah ni in azang uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin khoneu a tengte leh kulpi neilou khopi neu a teng Judaten, Adar ha ni sawm leh li ni khu kipahna ni leh pawi bawlna ni tualeh khawl ni leh silpiehte kipieh tuona ni leh ann neh khawmna ni in azang uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mordekai in tam thute agielkhie a, leengpa Ahasueras gamkai zousie a, anai leh gamla a um Judami zousie kungah ahahta hi.","title":"Purim pawi kibawl patna"},"21":{"text":"Kumchin a Adar ha ni sawm leh li ni leh ni sawm leh nga ni khu, nit ding, chi tua laihah ah atuong hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua nite khu Judate agalte ua kipat akhawldamna ni u’leh adanate uh lungnopna asuohna ha, tualeh akana ni uh lungdam pawi bawlna ni asuohna ha, ahitah zieh in, amaun tua nite khu lungdam pawi bawl ni leh kipahna ni, tualeh khat leh khat ann kithah tuona leh gentheite kunga silpiehte piehna ni a zah ding ahi, achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judaten ana bawlpatsa bang u’leh Mordekai in akung ua agel banga tawndan a nei in bawl atumta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen Judate melmapa Agagmi Hammedatha tapa Haman in Judate suhmangna ding in thu asimphiel a, Pur ana santa hi, tuakhu amauh thagamna ding leh suhmangna dinga ai san na ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh Esther leengpa mai a ahing dintahin, Judate sietna dinga athugilou phiel ama lutunga atuhna ding leh ama leh atapate khailupna dawn a, khailupna dingin leengpa’n thu apie hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaun tam nite khu Pur thumal akipat la in Purim achi uhi. Tuaziehin tam laihah thute leh tam sil tungtanga asil mute u’leh atung ua siltungte zieh in,"},"27":{"text":"Judaten amaute leh ahahasuonte u’leh amauh zuiten ahun kiguot dungzui a tam ni nite pellou a, kum chin a nitna dinga tawndan a pomkip ding chiin thu a bawlta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tam nite, akhang akhanga, innkuon chinteng leh gamkai chinteng leh khopi chinteng in atheizing ua, anit ua, tualeh tam Purim nite khu Judate lah a thei ngitngetna ahah asuonte lah ua pat a abeimanglouna dingin anamdetta uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Purim toh kisai tam laihah nina namdet na dingin, Abihail tanu leengnu Esther leh Judami Mordekai in thuneina toh lai agiel uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Mordekai in leengpa Ahasueras gamkai za leh sawmni leh sagi sunga teng Judamite zousie kungah, deisahna leh hamuonna laihahte ahah hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Judami Mordekai leh leengnu Esther in amaute dinga aguot bang uleh, ann ngawl hun leh da leh ka hun toh kisai a, amaute leh ahah asuonte ua dinga aguot bang ua, Purim nite namdetna ding in lai ahah uh ahi."},"32":{"text":"Lengnu Esther thupieh in Purim bawl dan ding toh kisai dante asukip a, tualeh sil chiemtena laibu sungah akigielutta hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Ahasueras in agamsung leh tuipi kuolkhum gamte ah sie lah ding aguonggalta hi.","title":"Mordekai thupina"},"2":{"text":"Athuneina leh ahatna a, asilbawlte zousie leh leengpa’n Mordekai atawisangna, thupina kigennate, Medes leh Persia leengte khangthu laibu sungah akigiel hilou amah?"},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Mordekai khu leengpa Ahasueras zom a lienpe’n ahi a, aman amipite hoina ding asui a, akituohna ding uh agen ziehin a unau Judate lah a athunei a, achipite lah ah athupi mamata hi."}}}}},"18":{"info":{"name":"Job","shortname":"Job.","abbr":[],"desc":"Job laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uz gam ah mi khat ana um a, amin Job ahi; tua mipa khu gensiet bei, mi thudih, Pasian giindan siem leh silgilou lah apat a kihemmang mi ahi.","title":"Setan in Job aze etna"},"2":{"text":"Aman tapa sagi leh tanu thum anei hi."},"3":{"text":"Aman belam tul sagi, sangawngsau tul thum, bawngtal loukai thei kop zanga, sabiltungpi za nga, tualeh suoh tampite anei a, tuachi’n ama suolam mite zousie lah a mi thupi pen ahi."},"4":{"text":"Atapaten aban ban a kiha in, a inn chiet uah annkuongluina anei ua, amaute toh nekhawm dawnkhawm dingin asanggam numei thumte uh achiel zel uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuabanga annkuongluina azawtah chiengun amaute ahankhawm a, asusiengthou a, tualeh zingmawng matahin athou a, a unpi ua, miphaza dungzui in halmang kithoina alan zel hi, aziehpen Job in “Ka tapaten sil na bawlkhiel in alungsim un Pasian na hamsiet kha maithei uhi,” achi hi. Tambangin Job in abawl ngitnget hi."},"6":{"text":"Ni khat Mangpa mai a kilaah dingin Pasian tapate ahing pei ua, alah uah Setan zong ahing pei hi.","title":"Job ze etna khatna","ref":"Siem. 6.2"},"7":{"text":"Mangpa’n Setan kungah, “Hei a kipat a hing pei na hiei?” achi hi. Setan in Mangpa adawnga, akungah, “Leitunga ka vah kawikawina leh asunga ka suhvah ka touvahna akipata hing pei ka hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Setan kungah, “Ka suohpa Job na geeldoh kha ngaita ei? Leitungah ama banga nuolnabei leh mi thudih, Pasian giing mi leh silgilou kiheimangsan mi aum sih hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Setan in Mangpa adawnga, azieh umlou a “Job in Pasian agiin ahiei mah?","ref":"Kihil. 12.10"},"10":{"text":"Nang ama leh a inn tualeh anei alam zousie kimvel ah dai in na imkhum hilou ahiei mah? Nang akhut nasepte, na guolzawla, anei alam zousie gamsungah ahing pungta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin nakhut zankhie inlen, anei zousie tungah na khut ha vawi in, aman na maitangah ahing hamsiet ngei ngei ding hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Setan kungah, “Tua ahileh hoi e, anei zousie tungah thuneina na nei hi, hinanleh ama tungah vang na khut hasin,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Setan khu Mangpa mai akipat in apawtdohta hi."},"13":{"text":"Ni khat, Job tapate leh tanuten, asanggam upa penpa uh inn sunga nekhawm, dawnkhawma aum laitah un;","title":"Job tuohsietna: Pasian phalpieh: thuguh"},"14":{"text":"Job kungah thangkou khat ahing tunga, akungah “Bawngtalten lou akai ua, sabiltungte akiim ua agamtat lai un,"},"15":{"text":"Sabeanmiten ahing sim ua, akaimangta uhi, tualeh suohte khu namsau hiem in athat uhi. Tam thu nang kunga hil dingin kei maimai kang suohta giap hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tambang a thu agen laitahin mi dang khat ahing pei a, akungah, “Van apat in Pasian meikuong ahing kesuh a, belamte leh suohte zousie ahaltum siengta hi, tam thute nang kunga hil dingin kei maimai ka hing suohta giap hi,” a chi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuabanga thu agen laitah in midang khat zong ahing tung kia a, Job kungah, “Kaldai mite pawl thum a kisuoin, sangawngsaute ahing sim ua, akaimang siengta uhi, keima ngentang suohta ka hia, tam thute nangma hing hil ka hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuabanga thu agen laitah main midang khat zong ahing pei kia leuleu a, akungah, “Na tapate leh na tanute, a upa penpa uh inn a nekhawm dawnkhawm a a um lai tah un,"},"19":{"text":"thakhat in, gamdai lam a kipat in khopihui nasatah ahing laanga, tuachi’n inn ning lite ah ahing sem a, ahing chim a, khanglaite zousie anetkhuma ashi siengta uhi, tam thu nang hing hil dinga suohta sun kei maimai ka hi,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job adingdoh a, apuonsil abotkeh a, asam aheu kieu a, tuol a bohkhupin Pasian abeta hi."},"21":{"text":"Job in, “Kanu naubu apat in guohtangin ka hing pienga, guohtang ma-a kilekia ding ka hi, Mangpa’n apia a, Mangpa’n alamangta hi, Mangpa min phat in umta hen,” a chi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tamte zousie ah, Job akhiel sih a, Pasian zong a mawsiet tuom sih hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat Pasian tapate, Mangpa mai a kilaah ding in ahing pei kia ua, tualeh Setan zong Mangpa mai a kilaah dingin, amaute lah ah ahing pei hi.","title":"Job aze et kia na"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n Setan kungah, “Heisunga kipata hing pei na hiei?” achi hi. Setan in Mangpa adawnga “Leitunga ka vah kawi kawina leh asuh atou a ka vahna akipat a hing pei ka hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Setan kungah, “Ka suohpa Job na geeldoh kha ngai ei? Leitungah amabanga nuolnabei leh mithudih, Pasian giing mi leh silgilou kiheimangsan mi aum sih hi, tualeh azieh bei a ama suse dingin hing gamta sah nan lachin zong agin umna ahasuo tuom sih hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Setan in Mangpa adawnga, “Vun taangin vun ahi! Mihingin ama hinna huhdohna dingin anei alam teng uh ape ngam ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin na khut zankhie inlen, agu leh atahsa tungah na khut ha lachin aman na maitangah ahing hamsiet pai ngeingei ding hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n Setan kungah, “Tua ahileh hoi e, ama na khut ah a um hi, hinanleh ahinna na khawipieh ngeingei ding ahi.”"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Setan khu Mangpa umna akipat apeidoh a, tualeh Job khu akengtaw apat aluzang dongin hima huoisetahin apumtuom sahta hi."},"8":{"text":"Job in akikhuotna dingin belphou khat ala a, vut lah ah a tousuh ta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n azi in akungah, “Na gin umna tudet nalai ding na hiei mah? Pasian hamsiet inlen shi suh mai ve” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Job in azi kungah, “Numei mote thugen bangin nagen mawh a, Pasian a kipat in ahoi imu dinga, ahoilou zong imusih diei mah?” achi hi. Tamte zousie ah Job in akam in sil asukhiel sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Job khanguol thumte, Teman mi Eliphaz, Shuh mi Bildad leh Namath mi Zophar ten, Job tunga silhoilou tung zousie atheitah un, a umna inn chiet ua pat in ahing kuonkhie ua, kithukimna nei in ama henem ding leh hamuon dingin ahing peikhawmta uhi.","title":"Job leh alawm thumte kihouna"},"12":{"text":"Gamla kuomtah a kipat a agal mu lai un, amel athei sih ua, tuachi’n aw ngaitaha kikouin akapta uhi, tualeh apuontuolte uh abotkeh ua, alutung uah leivui akibuoh khumta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuolpuong leivui lah ah ama toh ni sagi leh zan sagi sung atouta ua, koiman kamteng khat in zong ahoupi sih uhi, anat thuohna huoisiet dan amu zieh un."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zouin Job in akam ahing kaah a, apien ni ahamsietta hi.","title":"Job Pasian tunga aphunna","ref":"Jer. 20.14-18"},"2":{"text":"Job in thu agen a,"},"3":{"text":"“Ka pien ni beimang henlen, Pasal naupang khat pai in, aum kichi zan zong beimang hen, achita hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ni khu mielna suoh henlen, Tung Pasian in ngaisah se da henlen, atungah zong vah taangda se hen."},"5":{"text":"Mielna leh shina lim in tuom henlen, Meilum sa tahin khukhum henlen, Avahna zong mielvom keikui in, zau sah hen."},"6":{"text":"Tua zan khu mielna sa tahin, man henlen kum sunga nite lah ah, kipah sih henlen, Ha kisimna nite lah ah tel sih heh."},"7":{"text":"Oh! tuami zan khu, hut henlen, lungnopna kikou aw zong kiza sih heh."},"8":{"text":"Nite hamsiet miten, tuami ni hamsiet henlen, Leviathan phin hang theiten, tuami ni gausap uheh."},"9":{"text":"Tami ni a zingsol aasite miel henlen, khovah ngahla uhenlen, hinanleh bangma nei sih heh, tualeh zing khovah zong mu sih heh."},"10":{"text":"Ka nu naubu kot ana khalou zieh leh, Mangbat nate ka mit a kipat, ana phuolmang tahlou zieh in."},"11":{"text":"“Bangding a naubu a pat shisa a, pieng mailou ka diei, Bangdinga gilsunga pat, ka pawtkhiet a, shi pai mailou ka diei?"},"12":{"text":"Bangdinga kei hing na dom dinga, khupte na um a diei, Bangdinga ka tep dinga, nawite na um sese adiei?"},"13":{"text":"Tua hileh dai dide a, na lum ding inga, khawldam a, na i muta ding hi ing a."},"14":{"text":"Mun sesate ama ua dinga, bawlpha kia leitung leengte leh, athuhilmite toh,"},"15":{"text":"Ahisihleh sana nei mite leh, a inn uh dangka a dimsah, leeng tapate toh."},"16":{"text":"Ahisihleh bangdinga, khovah mu ngailou, nau ngeh bang a, ahunlou a pieng kiphuolmang, naungeh banga, na umlou himai leeng Aw!"},"17":{"text":"Tua mun ah migilouten, buoina atawpsan ua, semgimte akhawldamta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua mun ah Thongkete nasan, nuomtahin akhawl khawmta ua, Amauh nuoisiete aw ging, aza nawn sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tua mun ah aneu alien, aum khawm ua, tualeh silate zong, apu ua pat azalenta uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Bangzieh a genthei thuohte, khovah kipie a, tualeh hin genthei mi kunga, hinna kipe kawilaizanga,"},"21":{"text":"shi ding lunggulte tungah lah, shina atung thei sih a, gou kiphum sui sanga, shina hankhuh tou zawte’n.","ref":"Kihil. 9.6"},"22":{"text":"Haan amu chieng un, akipah un, anuom uh hilou amah?"},"23":{"text":"Bangzieh a Pasian in, dai a imkhum a, alampi phuol a um mi kunga, khovah kipie ahiei?"},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen genthei a, khawi ka sahnate, ka ann asuohta a, Ka thum ka maunate, tui kisung buo bang ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ka zau mama khu, ka tungah ahing tunga, ka giin mama sil in, ahing tun khumta hi."},"26":{"text":"Lungnuom in ka um sih a, sip dide in zong ka um sih a; Khawldam in ka um tuon sih a, Buoisietna ahing tung zaw hi.”"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Teman mi Eliphaz in adawnga, tam bangin a gen hi.","title":"Eliphaz thugen masah pen"},"2":{"text":"“Koi ahiei khat in na kungah, thu gen leh, dawzou louin na um diei? Hinanleh hamlouin, Koi a um thei diei?"},"3":{"text":"Ngai in, mi tampi na thuhil ta a, khut hatloute na hatsah ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Na thu in kipalpuate aphonga, khup zawte zong na khau sahta hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh tu in nangma tunga, ahing tun leh na lungkie a, Nangma ahing khoikhah tahin, na patau hi."},"6":{"text":"Tami hilou ahiei mah na giin, na muon na kinepna, tualeh na lampite a, na muonhuoina?"},"7":{"text":"“Tuin thei ngitnget in, ka hing ngen ahi, mawna neilou mi koi, amangthang ngai ei? Ahisihleh mi thudih khu, heisungah sattan in, aum ngai ei?"},"8":{"text":"Keima mu dan in, thulimlouna leitang kal a, buoina tu ten, buoina ma a at zel uhi."},"9":{"text":"Pasian huha khum in, amangthai ua, alungthahna hu a mut in, amangthang zel uhi."},"10":{"text":"Humpibahnei ngihna, hutumte leh Humpibahnei zau huoite, aw gingte leh Humpibahnei hatlaite, ha atawngsah ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Sa mat ding tahsap ziehin, humpibahnei Hattahte, amangthang ua, Humpibahnei noukai, noute zong akithethangta uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Tuin ka kungah thuguh khat, ahing tunga, ka bil in tua thu, kaangnou a kigen aza hi."},"13":{"text":"Zankhanglai mengmuna, akipat a ngaituonate ah, mite a imut tuilai tah un.","ref":"Job. 33.15"},"14":{"text":"Zauna leh chitutna ka tungah, ahing tunga ka gu ka taang teng, akiling sahta hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka maitang nawt in, hagau khat ahing pei a, ka chimul ahing thou hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua khu ading denta a, hinanleh alim amel umdan, ka theichien sih a, alim dingdan ka mit ha in, amu thei a, asip dingdenga, tuachi’n aw khat ka zata hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian sangin shithei mihing, adihtat zaw diei mah? Asiempa sangin mihingte, asiengthou zaw na diei mah?"},"18":{"text":"Aman asuohte lah nangawn ah, muonna a koi sih a, avansawltahte dihlou a angawh leh,"},"19":{"text":"Buon inn a teng a, akingahna suongphum leivui hi a, leikha mai a chimgawpte, nah gintat huoi zawsih samva e maw!"},"20":{"text":"Zingmawng phalvah leh khomielzui, kikaal a suhchimit in aum ua, koima theilou kaal in kumtawn in, amangthang denta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Alah ua apuonbuh kaina khaute uh, kiziellawm pieh a, pilna bei a shi hilou uh amah? achi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tuin han vawita, nang hing dawng ding, koi ahiei um? Misiengthou koipen kunga, kihei ding na hiei?","title":"Eliphaz thugen zopna"},"2":{"text":"Lungthahna in, mi maw a that leenga, thangsietna in, mimawl asulumzel hi."},"3":{"text":"Keima’n mimote, huihahdan ka muta a, hinanleh atenna inn uh aw sie, kalaw khum zuai hi."},"4":{"text":"Atate uh, bitna apat gamlapi ah aum ua, Kul kotkha phungah totchil in, a um ua amauh hundoh ding, koima a um sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Gilkielten a bu lahsa, ling leh khau lah a, akhonkhawmte nasan, anehkhawng pieh ua, tualeh dangtahten, anei alam uh dugaw in, alunggul uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen gimthuohna khu, leivui apat hing pawtdoh, ahi sih a buoina zong leilah a, hing mengdoh ahi dieh sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Meisi khu tunglam a, alentou bangin Mihingte khu, abuoi ding mawnga, hing pieng ahi."},"8":{"text":"“Kei vangin Pasian ka sui dinga, tualeh ka tungtang thu Pasian, ka aapta ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Aman suikhiet guollou, sil thupite leh sim seng guollou, sil lamdangte abawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Aman leitungah guo azu sah a, lou lai lah ah zong tui aluongsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Mi ngiemte adomsanga, da leh kap a umte, bitna mun ah adomtou zel hi."},"12":{"text":"Aman mi lepchiete tupna, achimaw sah a, mi pilkhelte khut in lawchinna, amu sah sih hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 3.19"},"13":{"text":"Aman mipilte alepchie na uah, aman a mi pilkhelte siltup, aphietmang pieh vadang hi."},"14":{"text":"Sun lai in mielna atuoh ua, suntanglai in zong zanlai bangin, akimaimaw sahta hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh aman mi tasamte khu, namsau akipat leh, mihat kamsung akipat leh, akhut ua kipat in ahunkhie hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi gentheiten, kinepna anei ua, tualeh thudihlou a, vaihawmna in akam ahum hi."},"17":{"text":"“Ngai vawi, Pasian in mi aphawhhila, abawlhoite khu mi nuomsa ahi uhi. Tuaziehin bangkimbawltheipa, thununna khu simmaw vawt sin.","ref":"Thu. 3.11,12; Heb. 12.5,6"},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen aman aliem sah a, Ama main atuom kia a, Aman asuliem a, ama khut mama in adamsah zel hi.","ref":"Hos. 6.1"},"19":{"text":"Aman nangma buoina, guh lah a pat in ahing hunkhe dinga, asagina ah sietna in nangma, ahing khoikha nawn sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Kielpi ahing tun chiengin, Aman shina apat in, nang ahing tankhe dinga, tualeh Kidou chiengin zong, namsau apat in, nang ahing hunkhe ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ham gilou a kizeptuona lah a pat in, phuol in na um dinga, Sietna ahing tun chiengin zong, na zau sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Sietna leh, kielna na nuisanta dinga, leitung gamsate zong, na giing nawnta sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen gamlah suongte toh, na kithutuohta ding ua, tualeh gamsa hangte zong, nang toh kilem in a umta ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Na puonbuh agalmuongta, chi na theita dinga, na umna huongsungte na ve dinga, akimlou bangma na mu sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na hahlesuonte tampi ahi ding, chi na thei dinga, na suon napah phatdan pen leitunga, hampa pou bang ahing hiding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Kum ching tah leh teh kun in, na han lam na zuon dinga, ahuntah a bu phuol a, buphai lahkhawm bang mai ding, na hita."},"27":{"text":"Envawi, tami kouten ka suikheta ua, tami adih ahi tuazieh in, Ngaikhie inlen, nanga dinga hoi ahi” chi thei in."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job in adawnga,","title":"Job in Eliphaz adawnna"},"2":{"text":"“Oh! ka lungkhamnate buhin umta henlen, ka vangsietnate phala ah, kikoikhawm ta mai leh, china inge maw!"},"3":{"text":"Tuipi pieu a senel sangin zong, gihzaw tham ding hiven, tuaziehin ka thugente ahuham hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen bangkimbawltheipa, thaltangte keima ah ataang a, ka hagau in agu uh adawn a, Pasian zauhuoinate kei hing douin, akiguolta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Gamsabiltung in loupa a nehlai in, aham ngai amah, ahisihleh bawngtal a ann neh tungah, aham ngai amah?"},"6":{"text":"Gimnam neilou chi sawlou in, akine ngai amah? ahisihleh aatui kaang ah, tuina mawngmawng a um amah?"},"7":{"text":"Ka hinna in akhoikhah nuom lou silte, Kei dingin ann kidahhuoi ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Ka ngetna mu thei hitama leng aw, Pasian in ka lunggulte, hing pe ding hileh."},"9":{"text":"Pasian in hing gawtguoi nuom hi henlen, akhut zankhie in, hing sattan mai leh aw!"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n zong lungmuonna ka nei nalai dinga, ahi, lungkham natna ah ka kipah ding hi, hing khawi sih heh, aziehpen Misiengthoupa thute ka iim sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Bang thahatna nei a, kinem nalai ding ka hiei? Bang kinepna nei a, thuoh kenkon ding ka hiei?"},"12":{"text":"Ka hatna khu suong thahatna ahiei mah? Ka tahsa zong sum-eng ahiei mah?"},"13":{"text":"Kipanpi theina keima ah umlou ahiei mah? Tualeh thahatna kei akipat delmang ahita amah?"},"14":{"text":"“Suhgenthei a umpa kungah, alawmpa’n hepina asulang ding a, hinanleh aman Bangkimbawlthei zauna ataisanta hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka unauten luita tuiging bangin, ahing lepchiesanta ua, Luita tui bangin aluongmang uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuate vuakhal ziehin avom gawpta a, tualeh vuakhal azunmang zel hi."},"17":{"text":"Kholum hun chiengin a zun mang ua, khokhal chiengin aumna ua pat aluongmang siengta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Khuolzin mite alampi ua pat apiel ua, gamse lah ah apei ua, amangthangta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tema ganta vanpuo kizuiten tui umna asui ua, Seba summetbawl a khuolzin miten, kinepna asui uhi."},"20":{"text":"Akimuon zieh un alungketa ua, tua mun atung ua. Abuoita uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuamabangin tuin noute zong, kei hing panpi dinga phatuomlou na hi ua, ka tunga sietna tungte na mu ua, na zauta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hing pie un, ahisihleh na nei nalam ua-pat, kipahman kei-a dingin hing pie un, ka chi eimah?"},"23":{"text":"Ahisihleh melma khut apat in hing hundoh un, ahisihleh ahing sugenthei khut apat in; hing tandoh un, ka chi ngai a mah?"},"24":{"text":"“Hing hil un, tuachi’n ka sip khin khian ding hi; hing theisiem sah un, bang kachi suhkhel ahiei mah."},"25":{"text":"Thudih thute hat hina va-ia e. Hinanleh nang mawsahnate uh, bangchibang mawsahna ahiei mah?"},"26":{"text":"Thute mawsahna ngen a na ngaisut ahiei mah? Michimawte thugen hui bang bep ahiei mah?"},"27":{"text":"Tagate tung nangawn ah, ai na-san nuom ua, na khanguolpa na ngawn uh van deh bangin, na deh ut nalai uhi."},"28":{"text":"“Tuaziehin tuin hepitah in, kei hing enta un, aziehpen na mai uah zuou ka gen sih ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuin kihei kia mai un, ka hing ngen ahi, sildihlou hida heh, tuin kihei mai un, ka dihtatna khu ading det hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka lei ah dihlouna a umkha amah? Ka lei in silhoilou atheikhen thei sih ding amah?"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mihingin leitungah semgimlou ahiei mah? Anite kithalaw mi nite bang hilou ahiei mah?"},"2":{"text":"Sila in nitum kaal angahla bangin, kithalaw a nasem mi in, athaman angahla hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n bangmalou hate tang dinga guot ka hia, tualeh zan lungkhamhuoite ka tanvou ahita."},"4":{"text":"Ka lupsuh chiengin, bangchih chiengin ka thou diei? tualeh bangchih chiengin zan abei diei? ka chi a, ning kitel in phalvah tandong kilumle nain ka dim hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka tahsa pumpi than leh leivui khal in atuom a, ka vun akeh a, ahitol gawpta hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka nite khu siemgan mite khothei sangin agangzaw a, tualeh kinepna umlou a zat bei zel ahi."},"7":{"text":"“Ka hinna khu khatvei nah-huha bang giep ahi, chi thei ngitnget inlen, ka mitin silhoite amukia nawnta sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu a hing en mitin, kei ahing nuamu nawn sih dinga, na mit a na hing et laitah in, kei ka um nawn sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Meilum alenmanga, a um nawnlou bangin, hankhuh sunga peisuh mi koima ahing peitou kia nawn sih hi."},"10":{"text":"A inn lamah a kinuale kia nawn sih ding a, aumna mun in, ama athei nawn sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Tuaziehin ka kam ka hum sih dinga, ka lungsim gimna ah thu ka gen ding a, ka hagau gentheina ah ka phun ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei tuipi ka hiei mah? ahisihleh, tuipi a ganhing ginhuoi ka hiei mah? Tambanga ka tunga vengmi na koi?"},"13":{"text":"Ka lupna in hing hamuon nava, ka touna in lungkim lou-a ka phunnate, phadawmsah nava ka chi chieng nangawn in,"},"14":{"text":"Nangman, mang zauhuoi na hing mansah a, mengmuna chizathuoi na hing musah se se hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka hinnain kilawlmehlup atel zaw a, hinna sangin shina atel zaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka hinna ka chimtah a, ka hing den nuom sih hi, Keima tangin hing umsah khinkhien in, ka damsung nite nah-hu bang mai ahi."},"17":{"text":"Mihingte bang ahi va-ia a, tambanga na thupi bawl a, hichi talawm a na ngaisah va-ia a,","ref":"Late. 8.4; 144.3"},"18":{"text":"Zingmawng chin a na ve a, mitphietkaal chin a na ze et e?"},"19":{"text":"Bangtan vei hing le-ngatsan lou ding na hiei? ahisihleh ka chil kaval masang sie-a, keima tanga hing umsah lou ding na hiei mah?"},"20":{"text":"Ana khielta ka hileh, na tunga khelna ka bawl bang ahiei? Aw nang mihing vengpa, bang dinga muichiema nang nei a ahiei? Nanga dingin puohgih ka suohkhata amah?"},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh a ka tatkhelna ngaidamlou a, ka gitlounate lamanglou na hiei? Aziehpen tuin leivui a lum paita ding ka hi a, tualeh na hing sui dinga, hinanleh ka um nawn sih ding hi.”"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Shuhmi Bildad in adawnga. Tambangin agen hi.","title":"Bildad thugenna"},"2":{"text":"“Bangtan vei ahiei tam thute na gen nahlai ding, na kam a na thugente huipi hattah abah nalai ding?"},"3":{"text":"Pasian in thukhenna alehei kawi amah? ahisihleh bangkimbawltheipa’n thudih alehei kawi amah?"},"4":{"text":"Na tate ama tunga akhel uleh, atatkhelna zieh un amauh apaimangta hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian na sui a, bangkimbawltheipa kunga thumna na nei pou-leh,"},"6":{"text":"Nang pen siengthou leh thudih mi nahi pouleh, ama nanga dingin pellou in adingdoh dinga, na mun dihtah ah hing tungding kia ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Na kipatna neunou hinan leh, na ni nukhia lam ah na hing thupi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Khang masate kansui kia inlen, tualeh apulepate un ana mukhietsate uh, ngaituo in."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen eite zani mi bangma theilou ihi ua, aziehpen leitung idam sung nite uh, nihim bang giap ahibou hi."},"10":{"text":"Amauten nang ahing hil un, a hing theisah sih ding uh amah? Tualeh atheisiemna ua pat in, thute agendoh sih ding uh a mah?"},"11":{"text":"“Chihnawng umlouna ah, laiphai akhangdoh thei eimah? Tui umlouna ah, pumpeng akhanghoithei amah?"},"12":{"text":"sattan lou a pape a apah lai in zong, hampa dangte sangin avuoi masa zaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuabangmain Pasian manghilte lampi a um hi. Pasian neiloute lam etna zong, tuabangin abeimang leng hi."},"14":{"text":"Akimuonna khu sattan in a um ding a, akingamna zong momlen bang ahi giap hi."},"15":{"text":"Ainn ah akingam a, hinanleh a ding sih ding hi, atudet kenkon a, hinanleh ahou zou tuom sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama khu nisa nuoi ah ahing ngingei a, abate a huonsung ah azam hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahuite suong kichiengte viel in azam a, suongpite lah ah mun asui hi."},"18":{"text":"Amun ua kipat suhsiet, ahi chiengun leh, tua mun in nou ka hing mu ngaisih, chiin ana nuol ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ngaivawi, tamte khu adamsung kipahna lampite uh ahi. Tualeh leitunga kipat adangte ahing poudoh ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Ngai vawi, Pasian in gensiet banglou mi khu a nuol sih dinga, tualeh silgilou bawl mi khut zong apanpi sih ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Aman na kam nuina in adim sah dinga, na lei zong nuomna in adim sah nalai ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Nangma hing mudaten zumna puon asil ding ua, tualeh migiloute puonbuh zong aum nawn sih ding hi.”"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job in adawnga, tambangin agen hi.","title":"Job thugenna","ref":"Job. 4.17"},"2":{"text":"“Adihtah in tuachi ahi chi ka thei hi, hinanleh Pasian masangah, ashithei mi bang achi dihtat thei diei?"},"3":{"text":"Mi khat in ama kinielpi ut taleh, tul khat vei lah ah khat vei zong, ama a dawng thei sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama lungtang piltah ahi a, hatna nei ahia, koi ahiei ama kinielpi a zou ding."},"5":{"text":"Aman muolte asuonkhie a, lungthah a amauh alumle laiin, athei sih uhi,"},"6":{"text":"Leitung aumna mun apat a nuhthopa, akhuomte akinuh hi."},"7":{"text":"Aman ni kungah thu apie a, ahing suohta sih hi. Aasi taangte zong akhukhum a, ataang nawn sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ama bouin vante azahkhie a, tuipi kihawtte tungah apei hi."},"9":{"text":"Aman Jangkhuo leh bawmluoi leh Zuheisuhtun, tualeh simlam aasi umkhawmna munte a bawl hi.","ref":"Job. 38.31; Amos. 5.8"},"10":{"text":"Aman theisenglou sil thupite abawl a, sil lamdang simsenglou tamtah a bawl hi."},"11":{"text":"En vawi, ama ka kungah a pei a, ama ka mu sih a, ama ka kunga apei lai in, ka theidoh tuom sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Aman alahmang leh, koi ahiei ama khaam ngam ding? Koi ahiei ama kunga, bang ahiei na bawl chi ngam ding?"},"13":{"text":"“Pasian in alungthahna, heimang lou hitaleh, mi panpi Rahabte zong, a nuoi ah akun ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n kei bang
