bepin, bangchin ama ka dawng ngam in, ama toh ngaituokhawm dingin, ka thute ka tel ngam diei?"},"15":{"text":"Mawna neilou hitamananleng, ama ka dawng ngam sih ding, kei siemmaw hing tangsahpa kungah, ahepina ka ngen zaw ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama ka hat chiengleh, kei eina dawnga, ka aw hing ngaikhiet pieh dingin, ka gingta sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Aman khopihuiin ahing nuoigawp sah a, ka liemnate aziehbei in abelap nalai hi."},"18":{"text":"Aman ka nah ding ahing phal sih a, sietna leh khatna in, ahing tuomdim sah zaw hi."},"19":{"text":"Hatna thu a kidem ding hitaleh, ama athahatpa ahi a, thudih a vaihawmna ahileh, koi ahiei ama han ngam ding."},"20":{"text":"Mawna neilou hitaleng, ka kam in siemlou hing tang sah ding a, gensietbei hita leng zong, ka kam mama in, na khielna hi chiin ei ngawh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mawna neilou hinan leng zong, keima ka ki awlmaw sih a, ka hinna ka kidah gawpta hi."},"22":{"text":"Aunpi in silkhat ahia, tuaziehin mawna neiloute leh, migiloute zong aman akibangin, asumangthang tuoh tuoh hi, ka chi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuohsietnain thakhat in, shina tun ta leh, aman mawna neiloute, gentheina khu anuisan giap ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Leitung khu migiloute khut a piehkhiet ahi a, aman thukhente mit atuom pieh a, tua khu ama ahisihleh koi dang ahita diei?"},"25":{"text":"“Ka nite lah mi taihat sangin agang zaw a, aleengmang ua, silhoi amu sih uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ka hinna khu tembawh taihat abang a, asamat ding gangtah a bawsuh, muvanlai abang hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka phunnate manghil ta vang in, Ka lunggimna nuasie in, maitaitahin umta vang chinan leeng;"},"28":{"text":"Ka thuohgimna zousie khu, giin pen in ka nei a, aziehpen mawna neilou, nang chi tuomlou ding uh, ka thei hi."},"29":{"text":"Siemmaw tang veve ding lah ka hia, bangdinga amawh a gimna thuoh ding ka hiei?"},"30":{"text":"Sabon in kisil sieng in, ka khutte tang al in silsieng nanleng zong;"},"31":{"text":"Khuchi pum in zong nang man guomsunga, buonnawi lah ah nang die lut veve dinga; Ka puon sillai nasan in zong, kei ahing kidah ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama ka dawn thei ding leh, thukhenna mun a, kei toh zawhkhawm thei dingin, Ama lah kei banga mihing a hi sih hi."},"33":{"text":"Koutegel kikaal a phit mut ngam ding leh, khut ha ngam ding mi um mai leh izaw."},"34":{"text":"Kei akipat in, Pasian chieng lamang ding, mi um mai leh maw, azauhuoina in, hing zausah nawn lou ding hiven,"},"35":{"text":"Tuahileh ama zaulou a, hamngamta ding hi inga, aziehpen kei tuabang mi ka hisih, chi ka ki thei hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka hagau in, ka hinna mama a chimtah a, ka nop kaningin ka kiphun ding a, ka hinna aichimkha bang kawm in, thu ka gen ding hi.","title":"Job thugen zawpna"},"2":{"text":"Pasian kungah hing mawsah sinlen, bangdinga nang doubawl ahiei mah hing theisah zaw in ka chi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nuoisie tah a nang suh genthei a, na khut nasepna na simmaw a, tualeh migiloute lemguotna na kipahpi khu, Nanga dingin ahoi amah?"},"4":{"text":"Nang tahsa mit na nei amah? Nang mihingte mu thei bangin, na muthei amah?"},"5":{"text":"Na nite mihingte nite bang ahiei mah? Nakumte zong, mihingte kumte bang ahiei mah?"},"6":{"text":"Ka gitlounate na kansui a, kakhelnate na sui-lumle paupau,"},"7":{"text":"mawlou ka hi chi thei nanlachin zong, koiman lah na khut apan, hing hunkhe thei vawtlou dinga."},"8":{"text":"Na khutten kei na hing siem, na hing bawla, ahinlah na hing sumang zel hi."},"9":{"text":"Tungman banga na hing bawl kahi dan, thei ngitnget inlen, tualeh kei leivui hing suoh sah kia ding, na hiei mah?"},"10":{"text":"Nawitui banga na hing sunkhiet a, nawituidat banga na hing lomkhawm, ka hi sih amah?"},"11":{"text":"Vun leh tahsa in na hing tuom a, gu leh thahuite in na hing phankhawm hi."},"12":{"text":"Nangman hinna leh itna tullou na hing pie a, na kepna ziehin ka hagau humbit ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh na lungtang sungah, tam silte na phuol a; tamte nangma lungsim ah a um chi ka thei hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka khel chiengin lah na hing chiemte ding a, ka thulimlouna apat na hing ha vawt sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka gitlou leh ka tung agih a, ka dihtat leh ka lutang ka phong ngam sih ding a, buoina in ka dim hi, tuazieh in ka thuoh gimna en mai in."},"16":{"text":"Ka lutang ka sang koi chiengin, nang humpibahnei savai bangin na hing vai a, ka tungah lamdang tahin na hing kitheisah hi."},"17":{"text":"Keima dou dingin thei pimi na bawltha zela, tualeh ka tungah na thangpaina, na belap sem sem a, kei hing dou ding galkap hon tha, na hing sawl zel hi."},"18":{"text":"“Bangdinga naubu sunga pat a, hing na lakhie na hiei? Koima hing mu masanga, na shi hita mai zawleng maw!"},"19":{"text":"Ana um khalou ma bang tading hi’ng a, naubu apat hankhuh a puohtung hita ding hi’ng a."},"20":{"text":"Ka damsung nite tawmnou khat hitalou amah? Themkhat beeh lungnop a ka um theina dingin, keima tangin hing umsah khinkhian mai ve."},"21":{"text":"Hing kinuale nawnlouna gam ka zot masang, mielna leh shina limguom sapi gam ka tun masangin,"},"22":{"text":"khovah na ngawn khomiel toh akibahna gam lungzinna leh buoina gam ka pei masangin,” achi hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Namath mi Zophar in adawnga, tambangin agen hi.","title":"Jophar thugenna"},"2":{"text":"“Thu hizata a tam kigente dawnlou a um ding ahiei mah, tualeh mi kamhat in siem tang ding ahiei mah?"},"3":{"text":"Na zuou thugente in midangte daisah ding ahiei mah? Na simmaw chiengin, koima’n nang hing zumsahlou ding ahiei mah?"},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen nang ka thuhilte asiengthou a, Pasian mitmu ah ka sieng hi, na chi viel hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian hing hamkhie henlen, na tungah akam hing kaah tama leh,"},"6":{"text":"Apilna thuguhte nang ahing ensah ding a, aziehpen theina in thuo tampi anei hi. Tuaziehin, Pasian in na thulimlouna sanga, tawmzaw ahing phut ahi, chi thei in."},"7":{"text":"“Suithawin Pasian thugil na muzou ding amah? Hoibukimna in Bangkimbawltheipa, na mu thei diei mah?"},"8":{"text":"Tuakhu Van sanga sangzaw ahi a, bang na law diei? Hankhuh thuhte sanga thuhzaw ahi a, bang na chi theikhiet diei?"},"9":{"text":"Atena khu leitung sangin a sau zaw a, tualeh tuipi sanga lienzaw ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ama peisuohta henlen, suongkul ah hing khum henlen, thukhen na ah hing hankhawm taleh, koi ahiei ama dal ngam ding?"},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen aman mi mannabei athei a, aman gitlouna zong amu hi, tuachi’n Aman angaituo sih ding amah?"},"12":{"text":"Gam sabiltungnou mihing banga, apien chiengin mibanglouten zong, theisiemna aneita ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"“Na lungtang na bawlhoi a, ama lam a na khut na zah leh;"},"14":{"text":"Na khuta thulimlouna aum leh koimang inlen, Na puon inn sungah gitlouna um nawn sih heh."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n gensietbei in, na mai na dahdoh sah ngamta ding a, tuachi’n na dingdet dinga, na zau sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na gentheina na manghilta dinga, tui luongmangsa bangin na theizingta ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh na hinna khu suntang lai sangin, ataangphazaw dinga, a mielna zong zingkhovah abangta ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh lam etna aum ziehin, na lungmuong ta ding a, kepbit in na um dinga, hamuong tahin na khawldamta ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na lumsuh dinga, koiman nang ahing zausah nawnsih ding hi, tuachi’n mi tampiten na deisahna asui ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh mi giloute mit khu mawhna ahita dinga, asuohta sih ding ua, tualeh a kinepna u’zong anah tawpna uh ahi ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job in a dawnga, tambangin a gen hi.","title":"Job thugenna"},"2":{"text":"“Ginlahuoilou mite na hi ua, tualeh noute toh pilna ashi khawm ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh noute mabangin theisiemna ka nei a, noute sangin ka ngiem zaw tuom sih hi. Tambang silte koiin atheimaw talawm diei?"},"4":{"text":"Keipen ka lawm leh guolte nuiha-buohna, ka hita a, Pasian ka han a, Aman ahing dawng hi, mi dih leh gensietbei, mite simmaw leh nuisat a umpa ka hita hi."},"5":{"text":"Nuomtah a umten vangsietna kichi khu, ketot teute tan dinga guot sa ahi, a chi ua a simmaw uhi."},"6":{"text":"Suomhatte puonbuh khu alawchinga, Pasian sulungthahte abit uhi; tuate khu a pasien uh akhut ua tawite ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Hinanleh tuin sate va dong lachin, ahing hil ding uhi, tunga leeng vate zong dong lachin, ahing hil ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Leitunga hampa poute dong lachin, ahing sinsah ding ua, tualeh, tuipi a nga ten na kungah aphuongkhe ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tamte zousie lah a koi pen in ahiei, Mangpa khut in tami abawl ahi, chi theilou ding koi ahiei?"},"10":{"text":"Ama khut ah sil hing chinteng hinna leh, mihing zousie nahna zong a um hi."},"11":{"text":"Bil in thute azahchien bangin, kam in ann achiem sih amah?"},"12":{"text":"Teehsete lah ah pilna a um a, damsawtna ah theisiemna a um hi."},"13":{"text":"“A kungah pilna leh hatna a um a, aman lemguotna leh theisiemna anei hi."},"14":{"text":"Aman asuhsiet leh koiman alamtha thei sih a, aman mi kot akhakhum leh, koiman ahong zou sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Aman tuite atuhtang leh akang mai hi, aman tuite ahaa chiengin, leitungah tuisang alet hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama kungah thahatna leh pilna a um a, sol a umpa leh a solpa zong, Ama a ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aman lemguot mite lawsam in apuimanga, thukhen mite amawsah hi."},"18":{"text":"Lengte kolbu asut pieh a; akawng uah puon in agah pieh hi."},"19":{"text":"Aman siempute lawsam in apuimanga, mihatte anuoikieh sah hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi muonhuoi thugente zong alamanga, upate sie leh pha khensiem theina zong alamang hi."},"21":{"text":"Leng tapate tungah simmawna abuohkhum a, mihatte kawnggah zong asut pieh hi."},"22":{"text":"Aman miel sa tah a sil kiphuolte akilangsah a, shina lim zong khovah asuoh sah hi."},"23":{"text":"Aman namte thupitahin abawl a asumang zel hi. Aman namte a sulien a, athezah zel hi."},"24":{"text":"Aman leitung lamkaite pilna alahmang pieh a, lampi umlouna gamdai ah avahthap sah hi."},"25":{"text":"Vah umlouin miel lah ah akimaimaw ua, tualeh zukham bangin ahawilen sah kawi hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Envawi, Ka mit in tamte zousie amuta a, Ka bil in zong azata a atheisiemta hi.","title":"Job thugen ki sunzomna"},"2":{"text":"“Na thei bangbang un ken zong ka thei a, noute sangin ka ngiemzaw sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Bangkimbawltheipa ka houpi ding a, tualeh Pasian toh ka tungtang thu, ngaituo khawm ka lunggul zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Noutepen zuou phuote na hi ua, na bawn un pannabei daktorte na hi bou uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hamlou in sip khinkhian u’lachin, tua khu nou a dingin pilna hi zaw ma ding hiven maw!"},"6":{"text":"Tuin ka thugente na ngai unlen, ka kam a ka ngetnate na ngaikhie un."},"7":{"text":"Pasian a ding a giloutah a gen ding na hi uoi mah? Ama a ding a lepchietah a houlim ding na hi uoi mah?"},"8":{"text":"Ama lamah deisah tuom na neina uh, sulang ding na hi uoi mah? Pasian a dinga pawngpan ding na hi u’maw?"},"9":{"text":"Aman noute ahing sui-doh chiengin, nou a dingin a hoi na diei? Ahisihleh mi khat in mi dang khat, a sol bangin ama na sol ding uoi?"},"10":{"text":"Simthama deisah tuom na nei pouma uleh, aman hing phawhhil ngei ngei ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"A thupina in ahing zausah sih ding amah, tualeh azau huoina na tung uah, atusih ding amah?"},"12":{"text":"Na khanglui thupilte uh, vut bang lel a mannabei paunahte ahi a, Na kidalnate u’zong tungman kidalna bang giap ahi bou hi."},"13":{"text":"“Sip khinkhian un keiman thu hing gen vang, tua chiengin ka tungah atung nuom nuom tungta heh."},"14":{"text":"Bangdinga ka tahsa ka ha a pet a, Ka hinna ka khut a koi ding ka hiei mah?"},"15":{"text":"En vawi, Aman kei hing that hil hiel nanlezong, Ama ah ka lam etna ka koi nalai ding a, Amasangah ka lampite ka keem hoi nalai ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama ka hundamna ahita dinga, milepchiete amasang ah ahing pei thei sih ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ka thugen pilvang tah in ngaikhie unlen, tualeh ka thu phuondohte na bil un za heh."},"18":{"text":"Ngai un, ka tungthu geelsa diemin ka koita a, Siem tansah a um ding ka hi chi ka theita hi."},"19":{"text":"Kei hing kinielpi ding koi ahiei um? sip khinkhian in umta leng, shi mai ding ka hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka tungah sil ni bawlda phot inlen, tuachi’n nangma apat in ka kiphuol sih ding hi,"},"21":{"text":"kei akipat gamlapi ah na khut ladoh inlen, tualeh na zauhuoina in, kei hing zausah nawn sih heh."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n hing han inlen, ka hing dawng dinga, ahisihleh, kang houpi dinga, nang nahing dawng ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Ka thulimlouna leh ka khelnate, bangza a tam ahiei mah? Ka mawnate leh ka khelnate hing theisah in."},"24":{"text":"Bangdinga na mai na phuol a, na melma banga nang ngai ahiei mah?"},"25":{"text":"Nata hui mut leeng na gawtbe nalai ding amah? bupawl gawsa na nuadel ding amah?"},"26":{"text":"Nangman kei demna dingin, sil khatah na giel a, ka khangdawnlai thulimlounate nangawn, na hing luosahta hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka kengte kol na bunsah a, ka lampite zousie vengin na kaihit a, Ka kephangte totna dongin gamgi nang hun piehta hi.","ref":"Job. 33.11"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n sil muot bangin, mihing a muot manga, nget nehsiet puonsil bangin amangthang zel hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Numei apat a hing piengdoh, mihing damsung nite tom mama napi, lungkham buoina toh akidim hi."},"2":{"text":"Ama pape bangin ahing pahkhie a, avuoi gawp pai hi. Nihim bangin ataimanga, a um den sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuabang mi tungah mitphelou in na ensaal in, thukhenna ah nangma toh na hing zawpi ei mah?"},"4":{"text":"Koi in ahiei sil nieh lah a kipat, asiengthou ladoh thei ding? Koiman la theisih va."},"5":{"text":"Mihing damsung nite guotsa ahi a, ha bangza dam ding ahiei, chi nangman na theisa ahi a, akaan theilou dingun gamgi na hun pieh hi."},"6":{"text":"Kilawmi banga ani nuomtah a azah bukim masangsie a, akhawldam theina dingin, kiheimangsan in."},"7":{"text":"“Aziehpen singkung ah kinepna a um a, kiphua nanleh zong, ahing mengtha kia ding a, a dawn suong kia ve ve ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahuite leinuoi ah teh gawp nanleh, akungpi zong lei lah ah shi nanlezong."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi pumin zong tui nom zieh in, ahing mengdoh kia dinga, singtuoite bangin abate, ahing zamdoh ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh mihingte a shi a, ngiemtah a siel in a um a, mihingte hinna abei chiengin, amauh hei ah a umta uoi?"},"11":{"text":"Tuipi akipat tuite, tuihu a alenmang bangin, tualeh lui tuite akiema akan gaw bangin,"},"12":{"text":"tuabang main mihingte zong alumsuh ua, athou kia nawn sih uhi; Vante aum nawnlou masangsie’n, akhanglou kia nawn sih ding uhi, ahisihleh a imutna ua pat phawhkia in, a um nawn sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Oh! Sheol a hing phuol himai lachin, na lungthahna bei masang sie’n, hing na kemdenta mai lachin, kei a dingin hunbise khat hing guot pieh va chin, tuachi’n nang thei ngitngetta ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihingte shitaleh ahing kia na diei? Ka sepgimna nite zousie a kipat a, ka kihenna hun atun dongin ka ngah den ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Nangman na hing han dinga, ken ka hing dawng ding hi. Na khutsuoh na siemsate na lunggul ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka kalsuonte na sim ding a, ka khelnate na kaihit nawn sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka tatkhelnate ip sungah na khakhum a, ka thulimlounate na khuikhumta hi."},"18":{"text":"“Hinanleh muolte chim in akitawlmang dinga, suongpite zong amun ua pat in akiliamang ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tui in suongte atawmanga, hawhtui in leitang atawmang bangin, nangman mihingte lam etnate, na mangthangsah siengta hi."},"20":{"text":"Kumtawn in ama tungah na guolzou a, apei zel a, amel na heng lamdanga, na sawlmangta hi."},"21":{"text":"Atapate zatat in ahing um ua, tuakhu aman athei sih hi, suh ngiem in a um ua, hinanleh aman amauh ahilam athei sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh atahsa tung ah natna anei ding a, tualeh asunga hinna hagau in asuun ding hi.”"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Teman mi Eliphaz in adawnga, tambangin agen hi:","title":"Eliphaz thugenna"},"2":{"text":"“Mipil in theina bangmalou toh adawng a, suolam hui in akigilvasah ding adiei?"},"3":{"text":"Houlimna phatuomlou toh angaituokhawm ding adiei? ahisihleh ahoi bangma bawl theilouna ding, thugen toh ageel ding adiei?"},"4":{"text":"Ahi, zauna na paimanga, tualeh Pasian masang a thungetna na dal hi."},"5":{"text":"Na thulimlouna in na kam azilsah a, mi lepchiete thugen na tel zawta hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma kam ngel in ahing mawpai a, ken kang mawpai sih hi, na kam in nangma demna thu atheisah hi."},"7":{"text":"“Nang mihing lah a pieng masa pen na hiei mah? Muolte um masanga pieng na hiei mah?"},"8":{"text":"Pasian thuguh na zakha taimah? Pilna nanga dingbou nasa amah?"},"9":{"text":"Koute theilou nang bang ahiei na thei tuom? Koute theisiemlou, theisiemna bang ahiei na nei tuom?"},"10":{"text":"Samkaangte leh putehte ka lah uah apang uhi, tuate na pa sanga upa zaw ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian henepnate, nanga dingin aneuseng taluo amah? Ahisihleh kam nem a thu kigente, na ia a zong namkhalou ahiei mah?"},"12":{"text":"Bangdinga na lungtang in, nang hing puimang ahiei mah? Bangding a na mitte phelap lap ahiei?"},"13":{"text":"Tuabanga Pasian kal a, na lungsim na heimang a, tambang thute na kam a na pawtsah ahiei?"},"14":{"text":"Mihing bang ahia, khuchia asienthou thei ding? ahisihleh numei apat piengkhie koi ahiei, adihtat thei ding?","ref":"Job. 25.4-6"},"15":{"text":"Pasian in a misiengthoute tung a, muonna akoingam sihleh, amitmu a vante nangawn asienthou sihleh;"},"16":{"text":"Thulimlouna tui dawn bang a dawn mihing, kidahhuoi leh nieh zaw sem hina va-ia unchie maw!"},"17":{"text":"“Na ngaikhie in, ka hing ensah ding, ka na mute, ka hing phuong ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Mipilten ana gensa uh, tualeh apu apate un zong ana imlou uh."},"19":{"text":"Amaute kung maimai a gam ana pieh laiin, alah uah gamdang mi koima avah kha sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Migilouin adamsung nite natna thuohgimna in amanga, mi nuoisie hat mi a dingin damsawtna phuolguhin a um hi."},"21":{"text":"Zauhuoina thawm gingten a bil uh adim sah a, akiningchin laiin zong atungah, sugamtu ding atungah ahing tung ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mielna apat hing kile kia ding chi agingta sih a, tualeh namsau a tha ding ngah in aum hi."},"23":{"text":"Aneh ding suiin avah vai a, hei a um ahiei? achi hi. Mielna ni atung a hing tung pai ding ahi chi athei hi."},"24":{"text":"Buoina leh lungzinnaten ama uh azausah a, galdou dinga kisa leengpa bangin amauh azouthaw hi."},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian dou dingin khuttum aleh ua, Bangkimbawltheipa douin aki-uongsah hi."},"26":{"text":"A phaw laipawng sapi toh, ngamthaw tahin atungah atai hi."},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen amaite athauna in tuom a, a kawngte uh athau in dimsah nanleh,"},"28":{"text":"khopi tulsate ah ateng a, akilawisa leh chimsesa, koima luo nawnlou innte ah ateng ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahausa sih ding a, anei leh lamte u’zong a umden sih ding hi, leitungah aneisate adimlet nawn sih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Miel apat in apawtdoh sih ding a, Ahing mengdohte zong meikuong in ahulgawp dinga, apallun laite zong hui in asemmangta ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Bangmalou sil hawmguohpi muongin, ama leh ama kisol sih heh aziehpen, bangmalou khu akipahman ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Ama hun chin masang nangawn in, kimtah a bawlzou sieng ahi ding a, abazamte ahing sih ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Aman grep gui a aga min nailoute athingkhe dinga, Olive singkung bangin apahlunte khu apulsah ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Aziehpen milepchiete kipawl khawmna ahawm guoh ahi a, nehguh chiingte puonbuh zong meiin akatum ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Amaun lungkham buoina naupai in apai ua, sietna ahing doh uhi, alungsimte un lepchiena ngen angai tuo uhi.”"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job in adawnga. Tambangin agen hi:","title":"Job dawnna lina"},"2":{"text":"“Tambang sil tampi ka zata hi, na unpi un mi lung buoisah, henemtu ngen na hibou uhi, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Thuginalou na gente un, tawp ni nei theilou ding ahiei mah? Ahisihleh bang thuohla nei a, ham hangsan na hi uoi mah?"},"4":{"text":"Kei din mun a dingkha hi ulachin, kei zong noute kalin, thu gen thei sam ding hi veng in maw! tualeh ka lu ka hing thinkhum thei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka kamsuohin noute ka hing suhat ding a, tualeh ka hamuonna kam in noute, gimthuohna ka hing henem ta ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Thu gen nanleng zong, ka lunggimna henepin aum tuom sih a, thuoh tei tei nanleng bang ahiei, nop ka sah tuon na?"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin Pasian in ahing sugim gawpta a, ka khan leh guolten zong na hing taisan sah siengta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh na ahing vuoigawp sah a, tuami kei demna theipitu in apang hi, tualeh ka gawng suh deu deu a, tua khu ka maitangah theipitu in apang hi."},"9":{"text":"Aman a thangpaina in ahing bottel a, ahing muda hi, aha ahing gawtkhuma, ka melma in kei dounain amit ataat hiem hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaun akam uh angna kahkhum ua, simmawhuoi tahin ka pheta ahing beh pieh ua, keima hing dou dingin akithutuoh ua, apangkhawm uhi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian in migiloute khut sungah eina pekhie a, Pasian theiloute khut se nan ei neita hi."},"12":{"text":"Nopsataha ka umlai in Ama’n phalni ahing suo a, ka ngawngpengah ahing man a, ahing thing neen a, tualeh amelchina dingin ahing tungdoh hi."},"13":{"text":"A thalkap miten ka kimkot ah ahing im chimit ua, lainatnabei in ka lungtang akappailet ua; ka sinkhatui zong tuol ah abuo uhi."},"14":{"text":"Sietna tungah sietna ahing thuoh sah sawn sawn a, galhatpa bawl bangin ahing tuonchil gawp hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka vun tuomna dingin la ip puon ka khui a, ka hatna khu leivui lah ah ka lumsahta hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka kaa kaa nain ka mai amiel gawpta a, ka mitvunte ah shina limliep a um hi;"},"17":{"text":"tuachi pum in ka khut in silsie abawl sih a, ka thungetna zong asiengthou hi."},"18":{"text":"“Aw leisiet ka sisan khukhum sinlen, Ka kaanain zong khawldamna mu ngaisih heh."},"19":{"text":"Tulai tah ngel in kei hing theipipa vantungah a um a, Kei hing genpiehpa tunglam sangpi ah a um hi.","ref":"Job. 19.25"},"20":{"text":"Ka lawmten ahing simmaw ua, Ken Pasian mai ah ka hitui ka sungbuo hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihingin a innvengte a dinga anget pieh bangin, Pasian toh mihing kaal a genpieh ding umleh maw!"},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen, kum tamlou khat ahing beichiengin, kinuale nawnlouna lampi ah ka peita ding hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka hagau akehgawpta a, ka damsung nite atomta a, hante kei a dingin mansain a um hi.","title":"Job dawnna sutzopna"},"2":{"text":"A hing simmawten hing imkhum uh hitalou ahiei mah? athangpaina uah ka mit aumden sih amah?"},"3":{"text":"“Tuin thuchiem khat Nangma toh kei a dingin, ka tungah koi inlen, kei a dinga mawpo ding koi ahiei um?"},"4":{"text":"Theisiemna akipat alungtangte uh na phuol piehta a, tuaziehin amauh na pahtawi sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi’n nuomman deina zieh a akhanguolpa alebawl leh, atate mit nangawn lawsam ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Aman mite houlimna paunah in ahing bawl a, tualeh keipen, maitanga mite chilphit khum ahing hisahta hi."},"7":{"text":"Lunggimna ziehin ka mitte amiel gawpta, ka tahsa hiengte zousie zong nihim bang ahita uhi."},"8":{"text":"Midihten tami muin lamdang asa ua, mawnaneilou miten zong, milepchiete douin akithathousah ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinapiin, midihtatten alampite uh atudet ding ua, khut siengthou nei mi khu ahat sem sem ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanlezong noute na bawn un, hing nua pei kia un, aziehpen noute lah ah mipil khat zong ka mu sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka nite a beita a, kalungsim a ka tup zousiete leh, ka lunggulteng akisegawp siengta hi."},"12":{"text":"Amauten zanlai khu sunlai asuohsah ua, khovah in khomiel ahing naita, achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ngah taleng han khu ka inn ahi a, miel lah ah, ka lupna ka pha hi."},"14":{"text":"Muotna kungah, nang ka pa nahi ka chi a, thante kungah nang ka nu ahisihleh, ka sanggam nu na hi, chi kawita leng,"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka lam etna hei a um hita ding adiei? Koi in ka lam etna a mutheita diei?"},"16":{"text":"Tua lam etna khu shina kotgawlte a lut suh ding adiei? Leivui lah a ikhawlkhawm ta ding uoi leh?” achi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Shuhmi Bildad in adawnga, tam bangin agen hi.","title":"Bildad thugenna"},"2":{"text":"“Bangtan vei thu sui sui ding na hiei mah? Kingaituo in, tuachi’n kouten ka gen ding uh."},"3":{"text":"Bangdinga koute na mitmu a, gamsa banga na hing ngaisut a, mi mote banga na hing bawl ahiei?"},"4":{"text":"Na lungthah laitah a nangma leh, nangma ki-ehmalpa aw, nang zieh a leitung nuasie a um ding ahiei mah? ahisihleh suongpite a umna mun uapat, kiliamang ding ahiei mah?"},"5":{"text":"“Ahi, migilou meivah akimutmit a, ameikuong zong a taang nawn sih hi.","ref":"Job. 21.17"},"6":{"text":"Apuonbuh sung a vah zong amiel a, atung a thaumei zong amielta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahatna akalsuonte zong tomsah ahita a, alemguotnate un amauh asawn pua hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen amauh keng ngei in len sungah apailut a, tualeh thang tungah aviel vah kawi hi."},"9":{"text":"Thangah aketul a awh a, thanggui in ama atudenta hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama dingin thangkhau lei lah ah akiphuol a, alampi ah gathang akikam hi."},"11":{"text":"Ningchin ah zauna in ama achiza sah a, azanung ah adel zui ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A hatna gilkielna in anegam dinga, akipalpuana dingin vangsietna a gei ah mansa in aum hi."},"13":{"text":"Natnaten avun ane khawngta a, tamasapen shina in, akhut akeng anekhawngta hi."},"14":{"text":"A muonna khu puonbuh apat bawdoh in a umta a, azauhuoi mama leengpa kungah atun ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama a hilou puon inn sungah ateng ding ua, atenna inn tung uah, kat akithe zah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Athahuite zong leinuoi ah agaw gawpta a, atung lam ah abazamte avuoi siengta hi."},"17":{"text":"Amauh thei zingna khu leitung apat amang ding a, kholai dungah amin uh a umkha nawn sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Amauh vah akipat miel lah a delmang in a um ding a, leitung apat nawmangin a umta ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Amaun amite lah uah tapa anei sih ding ua, tupa zong anei sih ding a; atena mun ua teng ding mi aum nawn sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tumlam gam miten adam sung nite uh, lamdang asa ma ma uh a, Suolam mite zong lamdangsa sengin a chiza vawt uhi."},"21":{"text":"Adihtahin migiloute tenna khu tambang mawng ahia, Pasian thei khaloute mun leh muol tambang ngenma ana hi leng hi.”"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job in adawng a. Tambangin agen hi,","title":"Job thugen ngaveina"},"2":{"text":"“Bangtan vei ahiei ka hinnain na thuohgimsah ding ua, thu a nang suhguoi dildel ding uh?"},"3":{"text":"Tambangin sawm vei tah nang houseta ua, kei dihlouna ahi; nang chi uh zumlou na hi uoi mah?"},"4":{"text":"Suhkhiel na neitama nanleng zong, ka suhkhelna keima ah a um zing ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima kal a kiliensah na hitaah u’leh, ka minsietna ka tungah gen ma un."},"6":{"text":"Pasian in dihlou ahing tangsah a, tualeh aleen in ahing tun ahi, chi thei un."},"7":{"text":"Pawngbawl a mawtansah ka hi chiin ka kikou a, ahing ki dawng sih hi. Ngaitah in ka kikou a, hinanleh thudih a thukhenna a um sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Aman ka pei theilouna dingin ka lampi, daiin a im a, tualeh ka peina lampi ah miel akoi hi."},"9":{"text":"Kei akipat ka thupina ahawhkhie a, Ka lutunga pat, Manglukhu alakhie hi."},"10":{"text":"Aman ningchin ah ahing susie a, amangthang ka hita, ka ki nepna zong singbul kal bangin akalkheta hi."},"11":{"text":"Alungthahna ka tungah akuongsah nalai a, amelmate lah a khat in ahing simtel hi."},"12":{"text":"Agalkap honte ahing kikhawm ua, Kei dou dingin ahing kuon ua, Ka puon inn kimkot in panmun akhaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"“Aman ka unaute kei a kipat, gamlapi ah ahing koi pieh a, tualeh ka meltheite zousie, kei apat in azintangsahta hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka hieng ka sante’n ahing nuasieta ua, ka lawm hoiten ahing manghilta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ka inn a tengte leh ka suoh numeiten, mituom in ahing ngaita ua, amitmu uah meltheilou gamdang mi ka hita hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka suohpa ka han a, ahing dawngta sih a, kamdam in ama ka zawl teitei hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka zi adingin ka nahhu anamsie a, ka tahsa mama ka tate adingin thet huoitah ka hita hi."},"18":{"text":"Naupang neute nangawn in ahing simmaw ua, ka thaw chiengin kei kal in thu agen uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ka khanguol ngaite zousie in zong, ahing kidah siengta ua, Ka it leh ngaite nangawn in, kei ma douin alangpangta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ka gute khu ka vun leh ka tahsa ah abeh chinten a, tualeh ka ha avun toh ka suohtasah ham ham hi."},"21":{"text":"Nou ka lawmte aw, hing khotuo un, hing khotuo un, aziehpen Pasian khut in ahing thamkhata hi."},"22":{"text":"Bangdinga Pasian hing suhgenthei banga, nouten na hing suhgenthei uh ahiei mah? Ka tahsa thuohgimna a, lungkim zoulou na hi nalai uoi mah?"},"23":{"text":"“Ka thute gelkhieh himai leh aw! tuate khu laibu a kigiel hita mai leh!"},"24":{"text":"Suongpi tungah siazum leh ngen in, kumtawna ngamden dingin ki giel leh aw."},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen, kei hing tanpa ahing chi ka thei, ni nukhia chiengin, leitungah ading ding chi ka thei hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka vunte suhsiet a aum nuachiengin, ka tahsa mama in Pasian ka mu ding, chi ka thei hi."},"27":{"text":"Keima mamain, ka mu dinga, Keima mitngel in midang hilou, Ama ka en ding a, ka sunga ka lungtangin alunggul pen khu."},"28":{"text":"Ama bang ichi suhgenthei ding uoi, na chi uleh sil bulte keima ah mu in aum chi thei un."},"29":{"text":"Namsau giing un, thangpainain namsau a gawtnate tun ding ahi, tuazou chiengin, thukhenna um ding ahi,” chi na thei ding uhi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Naamath mi Zophar in adawng a. Tambangin agen hi.","title":"Zophar thugenna"},"2":{"text":"“Tuaziehin ka ngaituonate in kei dawnna ahing pie a, tami ziehin ka kinaw ahi,"},"3":{"text":"Keima hing kizumsuona leh, hing kigendaina khu ka za hi. Tualeh ka theisiemna hagau in, ahing dawng sah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tanglai leitung a mihing akikoi chiil a kipat a, tam sil na um ahita chi na thei sih amah?"},"5":{"text":"Migiloute kitawisangna tomnou kaal ahi giap a, Pasian neiloute kipahna khu, mitphietkaal bep ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Athupina in vante suntouin, alutang in meipite phatou nanleh zong;"},"7":{"text":"Amaute eeh bangin amangthai ding ua, Amauh na mukhaten, Hei a um ata uoi, achi ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Zanmang bangin a leengmang ding ua, akimu nawnta sih ding uhi, Zanlai mengmuna bangin, akidelmang ta ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Amauh na mu ngai mitten, a nua mu nawn sih ding ua, a umna mun in zong ama a en nawn sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ataten mi zawngte deisahna asui ding ua, akhutte un anei alamte uh, anua pieh kia ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Akhanglai thahatna a dim agute khu, ama toh leivui lah ah a lum khawm ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“A kam uah gitlounate hum sa in, alei nuoi uah phuolnan ule zong,"},"13":{"text":"agenkhiet ding uh ut vawtlou in, akam sung uah imden sawm nan uleh,"},"14":{"text":"agilsunga ante khu akikhule dinga, asungah gul gukha ahi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amaun hausatna anawmval ua, tuami mama alawkhe kia zel ua, Pasian in agil ua pat apaidoh hi."},"16":{"text":"Gulngan gute atawp ding ua, muoltan lei in amauh athat ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaun lui te, lui liente khuoizu leh, Bawngnawidat lui a luongte, lungngul in a mu sih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Asepgimna ga anua pieh kia ding ua, tualeh asummet bawlna ua pat a, amette zong aval tumsuh nawn sih ding ua, nuomsa tahin aum sih ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun migentheite anuoisie ua, tualeh ataisan uhi, tualeh amauh lamlou inn apawng lahpieh uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Adihtah in alungtang sung uah muonna mawngmawng athei sih ding ua, atuppente uh akhol tuom sih ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Aneh zou nua un avaal bangma a um sih ding a, tuaziehin anopsahna un sawt adai sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Akiningchin sanlaitah un, vangsietna atuoh ding ua, gentheina chinteng atung uah, atung ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Agilpi vasah dinga akisah lai in, Pasian in alungthahna zauhuoitah, atung uah atungsah dinga aneh laitah un, atung uah guo bangin azusah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Sia galvan akipat ataidoh dinga, sum-eng thalpi in asun pailet ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua khu adohkhie a, atahsa apat ahing pawtdoh a, asinkha ua pat thaltang tesetset apawtdoh a, zauhuoina atung uah atung hi."},"26":{"text":"Miel satah khu agou kholkhawm uh ahi a, koima semlou mei in amauh akatum dinga, puonbuh a kinuasiete nangawn, akamang sieng ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Vanten athulimlouna uh asulang ding a, leitung ama dou ding in akisa ding hi."},"28":{"text":"A inn ua asil pungte uh lahmangin a um dinga, Pasian thangpaina ni ah anei alamte uh, aluongmang ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tami khu Pasian apata, migiloute tanvou ahi a, Agouluo ding ua Pasian in aguotpieh khu ahita hi.”"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job in adawnga, tambangin agen hi:","title":"Job thugenna"},"2":{"text":"“Ka thugen khu pilvangtah in na ngaikhie unlen, tami na henepna thu uh hita hen."},"3":{"text":"Hing thuohpi ham ham unlen, thu kang gen ding hi; ka genzou chiengin hing enghou nava u’teh."},"4":{"text":"Ka phunnate mihing tunga phun a nei gen uh ahiei mah? Bangzieh a dawtheilou tah a, umlou ding ka hiei mah?"},"5":{"text":"Kei hing en un, na chi uh aza ding hi, na khut un na kam uh hum un."},"6":{"text":"Tami ka ngaisut khah chiengin, ka chiza senga, zau in ka chi akithing hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangchidan a, migiloute hing ua, ahing upa ua, vanglien tah a, thunei sem sem uh adiei?"},"8":{"text":"Ahah asuonte uh amitmu uah, amautoh suhkip in a um ua, amitmu ngel ua ata uh suhkip a um amu uhi."},"9":{"text":"A innte u’zong, zauhuoina lah ah agalmuong a, Pasian chiengpum zong atung uah atukha sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Abawngtalte un chi ha louin alawsam ngai sih ua, abawngpite un nou anei ua, anau se ngai sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Atate uh belam hon bangin avah khawm sah ua, ataneute uh alam va liei uhi."},"12":{"text":"Pehging leh gawsem thuo in la asa ua, atheile tumging uah aguolnuom uhi."},"13":{"text":"Adamsung nite uh nei leh lam toh azang ua, hamuong tahin, hankhuh a zuon uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh a mauten Pasian kungah, koute hing nuasie in, na lampite theinuom in ka lunggul sih uhi,"},"15":{"text":"Bangkimbawlthei koi ahia, ana ka seppieh ding uh ahiei? Ama kunga ka thunget zieh ua, bang metna ahiei ka mu ding uh? a chi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh a nopsahnate uh amauh khut a um ahisih a, tuaziehin migiloute lemguotna khu kei a pat in agamla hi."},"17":{"text":"“Migiloute meivah khu mit mun hina e! atung uah vangsietna tung mun hina e! Pasian lungthahna in, atung uah lunggimna ape chiet hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama u’khu hui masanga bupawl bang leh, huipi mai a bushi mut mang bang ahi uhi?"},"19":{"text":"Pasian in athulimlounate uh, atate ua dinga ana koikhawm pieh ahi, aman athuh a, tualeh athei hi achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amit mama un asietna uh mu u’henlen, bangkimbawltheipa thangpaina khu dawn uheh."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen ama ua dinga kiguotsa, adamsung ha te uh sattan ahi nua chiengin, anuasie sa a innkuonte uh, khuolna bang anei nawn ding uoi?"},"22":{"text":"Mi’n Pasian kungah pilna ahil thei diei? tunglam sangtah a umte zong, aman thukhenna abawlpieh ahi, chi thei in."},"23":{"text":"Mi khat ahat laitah leh a nopsah laitahin ashi hi."},"24":{"text":"Atahsa nawitui in adim a, tualeh, agute khu chintuigu in anou sah hi."},"25":{"text":"Midangte lah hinkhuo gentheitah leh, kipahtah a ann tuitah chiemkhalouin, ashi zel uhi."},"26":{"text":"Akibangin leivui lah ah a lumkhawm ua, thanten atuom tuoh uhi."},"27":{"text":"“Ngai vawi, ka tunga dihlou tah a, na ngaituona lunggelte ka thei hi."},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen, nangman, milien milalte inn heisunga um ahiei? tualeh migiloute tenna puon inn, heisunga um ahiei? na chi hi."},"29":{"text":"Lamlien apei khuolzin mite nadong kha ngaisih amah? achiemtenate uh nathei sih amah?"},"30":{"text":"Migiloute khu vangsiet ni chieng a dingin khawi in a um ua, lungthah ni chiengin puidohin a um ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Koi ahiei aumdan uh amaitanga hil ngam ding? Koi ahiei a sil bawlte thuh ngam ding?"},"32":{"text":"Hankhuh zuon a akizawn chiengin, ahan khu ven in a um hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama dingin guom a leitangte a hum dinga, michin in anua azui ding ua, amasanga peite sim senglou ahi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n bangchidan a, aphatuomlou thute a kei hing hamuon na hi uoi? bangchi hamuon sawm nahi uoi mah? Na hing dawnnate uah zuouthu chilou,” bangma aum sih hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Teman mi Eliphaz in a dawnga, tambang in agen hi.","title":"Eliphaz thugenna","ref":"Job. 35.6-8"},"2":{"text":"“Mipil ama a dinga aphattuom mabangin, mihing Pasian a dingin aphatuom thei diei?"},"3":{"text":"Nangma dihtat talechin, bangkimbawltheipa kipahna khat ahi diei le? ahisihleh na lampite dembei in koita lachin, ama a dingin punna ahi diei?"},"4":{"text":"Ama na giinna ziehin, nang hing phoh hil ding ahiei mah? tualeh ama nang toh thukhenna ah a lut diei mah?"},"5":{"text":"Na gitlouna alien hilou amah? tualeh na thulimlouna tawp neilou ahisih amah?"},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen bangmaloupiin, na unau a pat khaamna na la ua, apuonte uh na hawhkhie ua saguohin na koi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Mi gim leh tawlte kungah dawn ding tui na pe sih a, tualeh gilkielte a dingin na tanghou na it hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh mihat in gam anei a, mi zatat huoi khunah ateng hi."},"9":{"text":"Meithaite khut guohin na sawlmanga, tualeh pa neiloute ban zong na hehlawi piehta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin na kimvel ah thangte akikam a, tualeh thakhata zauna in nang ahing buoisah hi,"},"11":{"text":"Ahisihleh, na mutheilou na dingin ahing miel a, tui tampi in nangma ahing tum hi."},"12":{"text":"“Vantung sang ah Pasian a um sih amah? aasi sangpente san dan en in, bangzata a sang ahita uoi mah?"},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin nangman Pasian in bang achi thei ahiei? Tuabang miel sapi lah ah thu akhen thei diei mah? na chi hi."},"14":{"text":"Meilum satah in ama tuomkhum a, tuachi’n aman amu thei sih hi, tualeh van kikuol tungah avah kawi kawi hi."},"15":{"text":"Migilouten ana zuisa lampi lui khu, zui nalai ding na hiei mah?"},"16":{"text":"Amaute ahun uh chin masangin, lahmangin a um ua, akingapna uh suongphumte nasan uh, tui sanglet in ataimangta hi."},"17":{"text":"Amauten Pasian kungah koute hing taisan in, Bangkimbawltheipa’n, amauh bang alaw zou diei mah? achi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama’n a innte uh silhoi in asuhdim pieh nalai a, hinanleh migiloute lemguotna khu kei a kipat a gamla hi."},"19":{"text":"Midihtatten ana mu ua, akipah uhi; mawnaneilou miten a nuisan uhi,"},"20":{"text":"Pellouin igalte uh sattan in umta uh a, tualeh a um sunteng zong mei in akatum siengta hi, a chi uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Tuin Pasian toh kilem inlen, hamuong tahin um in, tuachi’n silhoi in nang ahing zuon ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama kam a kipat thuhilna sang inlen, na lungtang ah athute kholkhawm in."},"23":{"text":"Bangkimbawltheipa kunga na kinuale leh, Aman ahing siemtha dinga, na puon innte apat in thulimlouna, na koimang ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Na sanate leivui lah a na koi a, na ophir sanate luita suong lah a na koikhiet pouleh;"},"25":{"text":"Ahi Bangkimbawltheipa khu na sana leh, na dangka manpha ahi ding a,"},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n bangkimbawltheipa kungah, na kipahta dinga, Pasian kungah na mai nasangdah sahta ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama kungah thumna na nei ding a, aman aza ding hi. Tualeh nang na thuchiemte na tangtun ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Thupuasah khat na bawl dinga, tuakhu nanga dingin ahing suhdet pieh ding hi, tuachi’n na lampite vah in ahing salvahta ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Amauten nang ahing suhngiem chiengun, nang dindohna aum na chi ding hi, aziehpen ama’n kingaingiemte ahundam hi."},"30":{"text":"Aman mawna nei lou mite nangawn zong ahundam dinga, Ahi na khut sienthouna zieh in amaute a suohta ding uhi.”"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job in adawnga, tambangin agen hi.","title":"Job thugenna"},"2":{"text":"“Tuni tandongin ka phunnate a nasa deu deu a, ka thuohna ka mauna sangin agih zaw hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama ka muna ding mun theita maleng aw, ama touna mun a va pei thei hitama leng aw."},"4":{"text":"Ka thute amasangah lui vangin, ka kam kinielna in ka dimsah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama hing dawnna ding, ka theikhe ding a, ka kunga agen ding ka theisiemta ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A silbawltheina thupitahin, Aman kei ahing kinielpi nuom diei izaw? niel nuomlou e, Aman kei ahing ngaisah zaw ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Khunah midihin ama toh ava kikum thei ding ua, tuachi’n keima thu hing khenpiehpa apat in, hutkhiet ka hidenta ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“En vawi mailam ah ka pei a, Ama khunah ana um sih a, nualam a ka pei zel a hinanleh, ama ka mu tuom sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Veilam panga nna aseplai in ka mu thei sih a, zietlangah akihei a ama ka mu thei sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh aman ka lampi zui athei a, Aman kei ahing ze et zou chiengin, sana bang maiin ka hing suohdoh ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka kengin aketotna nua ka zui zinga, alampite ka zui a, ka pielsan vawt sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Akam a thupiehte akipat in ka pielmang sih a, akam a a thupawtte khu gou bangin kana kikhol zaw a, ka nisim annneh sangin manpha kasa zaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama khu lungtang henglou ahia, Koi ahiei Ama kiheisah thei ding? Aman a ut bangbangin abawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Kei a dinga aguotte a tangtung sah zel hi, tualeh hichibang sil tamtah akungah a um hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ama mai ah ka zau a, ka ngaituo chiengin Ama ka giing hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasian in ka lungtang aba sah a, Bangkimbawltheipa’n ahing zausah hi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen khomiel lah a kipat in, satkhieh in kana um sih a, khomiel satahin ka mai akhu khum sih hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Bangzieh a Bangkimbawltheipa apat a, hunte phuolguh a aum thei a, bangdinga ama theiten a nite khu mu lou ahi uoi?","title":"Job thugen zopna"},"2":{"text":"Mi kimkhatten gamgi asuon ua, tualeh pautatin belam honte agu ua, akikhawita hi."},"3":{"text":"Tagate sabiltung adelmang pieh ua, thuchiemna dingin meithaite bawngtal alahpieh uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mitasamte lam gei ah a sawnkhie ua, leitunga migentheite akiphuolmang sahta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Envawi, gamgaw gam a sabiltungte bangin, mizawngten ann neh ding a sui ua, semgim in akuondoh uhi; tualeh hawlou gamdaiin atate ua dingin, anneh ding apiengsah hi."},"6":{"text":"Neh ding ann loulai ah akhawm kawi ua, migiloute grep huon ah asang asui uhi."},"7":{"text":"Zan tungtawn in puon sillou in saguohin alum khovah ua, khovot a silding bangma anei sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Muol leh taang a guomalphinte’n amauh apahsah a, belding neilou in suongpi akawi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Pa neilou naungeh nawitep laite asatkhie ua, tualeh mi zawngte ta ngehlaite, leiba ditna dinga kichiemna dingin alahpieh uhi."},"10":{"text":"Mi zawngte puon sillouin saguohin akawivah sah ua, gilkielte akipat in, buphaite alahpieh uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amaun a huongsungte uah Olive thau asuh ua, a uoin suhna uh a chil ua, dangtah athuoh uhi."},"12":{"text":"Mi shikuonte khopi sungah atau ua, aliemte hinna akikoukhie a, hinanleh Pasian in amauh adon sih hi."},"13":{"text":"“Khovah dou a helte zong a um ua, amaun khovah lampite athei sih ua, alampite zong azui sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualthat mite khovah philphiel in athou ua, mi zawngte leh tasamte athat ua, zanlai chiengin guta bangin a um uhi."},"15":{"text":"Aangkawmpa mit in zong khomui angah a, koiman hing musihva chiin amai asiem lamdang hi."},"16":{"text":"Khomiel chiengin sunlai a achiemtesa uh, innte avutpailet ua khovah athei sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen ama ua ding in zingmawng zong, shina limliep bang ahi a, mi’n amauh theita u’leh, shina limliep zauhuoi a um ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"“Amaute tuitungah gangtah a tawlmangin aum ua, Leitunga atanvou uh hamsiet ahi a, agrep huonte uah koima apei sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Khokhal nisa leh kholum in vuate azunmangsah bangin, hankhuhin mikhielte alamang hi."},"20":{"text":"Naubuin amauh amanghilding a, thanten amauh kivahnan anei ding uhi; amaute theikhah ahinawn sih ding ua, gitlouna khu sing bangin atawngsan ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Amaun taneilou numei chiingte kivah nan anei ua, meithaite tungah silhoi abawl sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in mihat khu asilbawltheina in a hiip a, athoudoh a koima’n ahinna thu atheichien sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Aman amaute bitna apie a, tualeh tuanah akhawl uhi, hinanleh amit in agamtatnate uh a en hi."},"24":{"text":"Hun tomnou sung tawisang in a um ua, abeimangta uhi tuachi’n suhngiem in a um ua, Midang zousie bangin, lampi apat lahmangin a um ua, buvui banga attan in a um uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuabang hilou hitaleh, koi ahiei kei mizuou a hing bawl ding? Tualeh ka thugente zong bangmalou asuoh sah ding?” a chi hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Shuh mi Bildad in adawnga akungah tambangin agen hi.","title":"Bildad thugen"},"2":{"text":"“Vaihawmna leh zauna Pasian kungah a um a, Aman van sangte ah lemna abawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Agalkapte simseng guol ahi uoi mah? tualeh koi tungah ahiei avah asuolou."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi ahileh Pasian masangah, mihing bangchin asiemtang thei diei? Ahisihleh numei apata pieng bangchi sien thei ding?"},"5":{"text":"Ngai vawi, hapi nangawn atangpha sih a, aasite zong ama mitmu ah asieng sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Khuchi ahitaahleh lungnou bang giap mihingte, bangchituh a sienglou zaw sem ding ata diei? Tualeh mihing tapa lah talteng bang giap ahi bou hi.”"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job in adawnga, tambang in agen hi.","title":"Job thugenna"},"2":{"text":"“Silbawltheina neiloupa nah panpi nalaizang chie! bantha hatna neiloupa bangchi dan a na hundam kawi ahiei?"},"3":{"text":"Pilna neilou ama bangding a thu na mop laizang ahiei? bangding a thumopna hoi tampi na hil kawi laizang ahiei?"},"4":{"text":"Koi kungah ahiei thute na gen khiet? Koi pen hagau ahiei nangma akipat a hing pawtdoh?"},"5":{"text":"Tui nuoi a um mishite leh, khuna tengte zousie lungdongin achitun uhi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian masangah hankhuh guohtang ahi a, sietna zong akhuna neilou ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aman mallam khu mun awng tungah apha a, leitung khu bangmalou tungah akhai hi."},"8":{"text":"Aman ameilum satah sungah tuite a kaankhawm a, hinanleh tuiten anuoilam a meilumte aphukeh sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aman halia lai maitang akhu khum a, atungah meilum azah hi."},"10":{"text":"Aman tui tungah chiemtena agitkuol a, tuakhu vah leh miel kikaal a gamgi ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian in aphawh hilna zau in van khuomte akiling hi."},"12":{"text":"A silbawltheina in tuipi ahot a, atheisiemna in Rahab a asatgawp hi."},"13":{"text":"Anah hu in vante a zemhoi a, akhut in gulpi lenglai asun hi."},"14":{"text":"En vawi, tamte zousie anasepte lah a, athem nengkhat ahi bou hi, i bilkawm a ahing houpi ina zahte, ngat hina hiu hiau e, hinanleh asilbawltheina, vanpi ging koi ahiei theisiem ding?”"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job in athugente agenzomtou nalai a.","title":"Job thugen sutzopna"},"2":{"text":"“Ka dihna lamang Pasian leh, ka hinna khatah mai hing chiemsah, Bangkimbawltheipa hinna siel in ka gen ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ka sunga hinna hu a um laisie, ka nahkuo hawmte a Pasian hu a um lai siein;"},"4":{"text":"ka kam in thudihlou agen sih dinga, ka lei in solna thu agen sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na dih hi, ka hing chi ngaisih ding a, ka shi masangsie’n ka ginumna kei a kipat, ka koimang vawt sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka dihtatna ka kemden dinga, ka hasuo ngai sih ding hi, ka damsung siein, ka lungtangin ahing phawh sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ka melmate migiloute bang uhenlen, kei hing doute mi dihtatloute bang uhen."},"8":{"text":"Punna tampi mu nan uleh, Pasian in ahinna uh alahmang chiengin milepchie dingin bang kinepna aum diei?"},"9":{"text":"Atung ua buoina ahing tun chiengin, Pasian in akikouna uh aza diei?"},"10":{"text":"Amauh Bangkimbawltheipa tungah akipah ding uoi? Hun chinteng in Pasian ahan na ding uoi?"},"11":{"text":"Ken Pasian khut tungtang nou ka hing hil dinga, Bangkimbawltheipa toh umkhawm silte, phuolguh ka nei sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Adihtah in na bawnun tami na mu chietta ua; bangchi dan a hichibanga bangmalou, hing suoh sieng na hi ta uoi?"},"13":{"text":"“Tua khu Pasian akipata amu ding uh tanvou khu ahia, Bangkimbawltheipa akipat a, mi nuoisiete gouluo ding khu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Atate uh apun uleh zong namsau a ding ahia, tualeh ahah asuonte uh tanghou in atai sih ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Anua ua dam nalaite zong natpi in avui ding ua, ameithaite un amaute suunlou ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amaun dangkasiate leivui bangin sievumin, nihten puonsil tungvum bangsah nan uleh."},"17":{"text":"Aman a khol khawm thei a, hinanleh midihtatten asil ding ua, mawna neilou miten adangkate uh akihawm ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"A inn lamte u’zong lungbu bang bep ahia, grep huon vengmi sawlbuh bang bep ahi bou hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi hausa alum ding a, hinanleh khopkhawm in a um sih ding hi, amit ahah a, a umta sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuisang let bangin a mauh zauna in aman a, huipi in amauh zan kaal in atawmangta hi."},"21":{"text":"Suolam hui in amauh atawmang a, apeimangta uhi. A aumna mun ua pat amutmangta hi."},"22":{"text":"Lungsietna bei in hui in alumle dinga, huipi thahatna zieh in, lu bungbuin aleeng mang ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Miten amauh simmawin akhut uh abeh khum ding ua, amun ua pat amutmang ding hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Adihtahin dangka ki tawdohna khuh a um a, sana suhsiengna mun zong a um hi.","title":"Pilna phatna"},"2":{"text":"Lei akipat in sia akitoudoh a, tualeh suong akipat in dan akisung khie hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihingten mielna abei sah ua, mun gamla pente leh, miel nasatah leh shina lim guom a suongte zong asui uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mihing tenna akipat gamlapi ah, lei khuh atou ua, mihing kengin atotkhahlouna munte atou suh ua, mite akipat gamla tah ah akikhai khe suh uhi."},"5":{"text":"Leitung khu neh ding ann hing pienna ahi a, hinanleh asung khu mei ahi mabangin a kilumlet hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuami suongpite khu Saphire suongmantamte ahing kilah khietna ahia, tuate’n sana vui a nei hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tuami lampi khu sa sielne vaten athei sih ua, langtate mitin zong amu sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Humpibahnei kisatheiten zong atuonkha ngai sih ua, humpibahnei giinhuoi te zong apei kha ngai sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Amaun meisa suongpi tungah akhut uh akoi ua, taangte azung tandongin alumlet uhi."},"10":{"text":"Suongpite lah ah tuilamte atoudoh ua, amit un sil manpha chi-chin amu uhi."},"11":{"text":"Luongkhe-sahlou keiin luinahte achingtan ua, sil kiphuolte vah ah alakhie uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Hinanleh pilna hei sungah akimu thei diei? tualeh theisiemna khu hei sunga um adiei?"},"13":{"text":"Mihing in pilna manphatna atheikhe zou sih a, mihing gam ah mu ahi sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Tui thuhpi in kei sungah a um sih, achi a, tuipi in kei kungah a um sih achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Pilna khu sana hoipenin zong akilei thei sih a, aman zong dangka toh kibuh theilou hi."},"16":{"text":"Ophir sana toh zong amanphat dan akite thei sih a, Onix suongmantam ahiei, Saphire suongmantam ahiei toh zong kite theilou hi."},"17":{"text":"Pilna manphat dan pen, sana leh suongval in zong atuhzou sih a, sana siengthou toh zong akiheng thei sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Koral suongmanpha leh Jasper suongmanphate gentaah ahisih a, pilna man in Rubi suongmantamte a khup hi."},"19":{"text":"Ethiopia gam a Topaz toh te guol ahisih a, Sana sieng sitset toh zong tekah guol hilou hi."},"20":{"text":"“Tuachibang ahileh, pilna hei a pat a hing umdoh ata diei le? theisiemna mun zong heisung ata diei?"},"21":{"text":"Silhing chinteng mitmu ah akiphuol a, vanlai zawl a vate mitmu apat nangawn in a kiphuol hi."},"22":{"text":"Sietna leh shina thuthang ka bil un kana zata uhi, achi ua,"},"23":{"text":"“Pasian in alampi atheisiem a, tualeh a umna mun zong athei hi."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen aman leitung tawpna aen suoh a, tualeh vannuoi pumpi a mu suoh hi."},"25":{"text":"Aman huipi kung ah gihna apie a, tualeh tuite tenain ate-tuoh hi."},"26":{"text":"Aman guo a dingin thupieh abawl lai in, vanging leh tunphe adinga lampi abawl pieh lai in;"},"27":{"text":"Aman pilna amuta a, tualeh aphuongdohta a, Aman tuami abawlkhola, asuikhie hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh aman mihing kungah, Pasian giin khu pilna dihtah ahia, sil hoilou kiheimangsan khu theisiemna ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Late. 111.10; Thu. 1.7; 9.10"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job in athugen ban agen zom nalai a,","title":"Job thugenna nukhiepen"},"2":{"text":"“Aw nidanglai ha beisate a, Pasian in ahing ven lai bangin."},"3":{"text":"A meivah ka lutunga ataan lai a, Ama vah a, miel lah a ka pei lai in,"},"4":{"text":"Ka khangdawng lutlai nite a ka um bangin, Pasian toh kilawm hoi hina, athuguh ka puon inntunga a um lai in."},"5":{"text":"Bangkimbawltheipa kei toh a um khawm lai in, ka tate ka kimvel a, a um lai un,"},"6":{"text":"Ka kalsuonte nawitui dat a sawp ahi lai in, kei dinga suongpi in sathau luite aluon sah lai in."},"7":{"text":"Khopi kulkotpi a ka pawtdoh lai a, mipi kikhopna mun a ka tou lai in,"},"8":{"text":"Tangvalten ahing mu ua akiphuol ua, upate zong adingtou uhi."},"9":{"text":"Lengtapate houlimlai akhawl ua, tualeh akam uh akhut un ahum uhi."},"10":{"text":"Miliente aw asip dide a, tualeh alei uh adangtawng uah abeh hi."},"11":{"text":"Bil in azah chiengin hampha angchi ua, mit in ahing mu chiengin theipina ahing pie hi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen mi zawng leh pa neilou panpi ding neilou a, kikoute ka hundoh zel hi."},"13":{"text":"Mangthai dinga mansa mite, guolzawlna ka tungah ahing tunga, meithai alungnop zieh a, lasa dingin ka um sahta hi."},"14":{"text":"Dihtatna ka sil a tualeh ahing tuom hi, dihna khu ka puontuol leh ka diel khip ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Mittaw a dingin mit ka hi a, Kengbai a dingin keng ka hi."},"16":{"text":"Tasamte adingin pa ka hi a, ka meltheilou mite thubul zong ka suidoh pieh hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi giloute khagu ka suhtan pieh a, akamsung ua kipat in asuh gentheite uh, ka loidoh pieh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka inn ah ka shi dinga, ka nite pieunel bangin ka pungsah ding, ka chi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka huiten tui lah ah zung ahasuh dinga, zankhovah in ka bazamte tungah daitui akai ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka thupina khu ka sung ah atha zel a, ka thalpi zong ka khut sungah, siemtha in a um zel hi."},"21":{"text":"“Miten ka thugente lunglut tah in angaikhie ua, ka lemguotte dai dide in angah uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ka genzou chiengin agen kia nawn sih ua, ka thugente atung uah daitui bangin a umden hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaun guotui ngah bangin ahing ngah ua, guotui nukhia ngah bangin akam uh akaah uhi."},"24":{"text":"Amauh lam nga a ka nui mel chiengin, agingta ngam sih ua, ka melvah ah amauh alung kesih uhi."},"25":{"text":"A lampi uh ka telpieh a, amaute lamkaipa bangin ka tou a, agalkapte lah uah leengpa bangin ka um a, mishi suunte hamuonpa bangin ka um hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Hinanleh tunvang kei sanga naupang zawten, nuihatangbuohna’n ahing neita ua, apate uh ka ganhon veng uite toh, koi dinga ka deiloute’n;","title":"Job genthei liengvainate"},"2":{"text":"Amaute bantha hat in kei a dingin, bang phattuomna anei ding adiei? ahatna uh beimangsa ten."},"3":{"text":"Tahsapna leh gilkielna ziehin agawnggawp ua gamsie leh luolou, gamdai ah atailut uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amaun pawn lah a loupa zung khate alou ua, munphekung huite ane uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mite lah a pat in delmangin a um ua, gutate akihawhkhum bang in, anua uah ahawhkhum uhi."},"6":{"text":"Guomkuoh kaal leh leikohawm lah leh, suongkawm lah a teng ding in."},"7":{"text":"Singbawh lah ah a eu tehtuh ua, lingle khau nawng lah ah akilom sie uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amauh mimaw tate ahi ua, miginalou tate ahi ua, gamsung apata delmang ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Tuin keipen la el ahingphuo khum ua, alah uah kamthau hauna ka suohta hi."},"10":{"text":"Amauten ahing kidah ua, ka kung apat akikaangkoi ua, kisuongla lou keiin, ka maitang ang chilphit khum uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in ka thalpi gui akolsah a, ahing sugentheita hi, Amaun ka mitmuin kamkaina aha kheta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ka khut zietlam ah, migilou hon adingdoh ua, ka keng asawnmang ua, ka sietna ding lampite a siel uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ka lampi asusie ua, ka vangsietna ding ngen asui ua, panpi ding mi anei sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"A sietna awng kaal lienpi ah ahing lut ua, a sietna mun ah ahing kilia lut uhi."},"15":{"text":"Zauhuoinaten ahing tuom khum a, ka zatat huoinate huibangin anuadel ua, Ka nopsah nate meilum bangin akitawlmangta hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tualeh tuin ka sungah, ka hinna tuibanga sun buohin a um a, gimthuohna nite’n ahing mantangta hi."},"17":{"text":"Zan chiengin ka gu ka tangten ahing chipa, ka natna in ahing ngietngiet ziehin, ka thahuite a khawldam thei sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka natna akhawhseng ziehin ka puonsil akihengta a, ka puonah ngawng bangin kei ahing gah hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasian in buonnawi lah ah ahing pai lut a, tuachi’n leivui leh vut ka suohta hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangma hanin ka kikou a, nang lah na hing dawng sih a, ka dingtou a, hinanleh khoh nasa sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka tung ah na tatse mama a, na banthahatin na hing sugenthei hi."},"22":{"text":"Nangman hui tungah na hing domkangtou a, atungah na hing tuongsah nalai a, huipi ging lah ah sah leh hang sena’n na hing nei hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi zousie ading a kiguotsa shina mun, hing tun ding nahi chi ka thei hi."},"24":{"text":"“Adihtahin sietna a puagawp mi’n atuohsietna ah kikou nan uleh. Aman akhut azah sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Buoi leh lungdong chimawte adingin, ka kap leng sih amah? Mizawngte adingin ka hinna alunggim sih amah?"},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh hoina ka lam et lai in, ka tungah sietna ahing tunga, vah ka ngah laiin miel ahing tung hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka lungsim abuoi a khawlna amu sih a, thuohgimna nite’n ahing maituo hi."},"28":{"text":"Nisa taang mulouin ka vahkawi a, mipi kikhawmte lah ah ka dingtou a, panpina ngen in ka kikou hi."},"29":{"text":"Kei pen si-alte sanggampa ka hita a, gam va ngawngsaute lawmpa ka hita hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka vunte lah avom gawpa akilip hi, ka gute natna in mei-am sa abang sahgawpta hi."},"31":{"text":"Ka kaigingte suunna asuohta a, ka tumgingte mi kapte aw asuohta hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka mit toh thuhun ka bawl zouta a, Bangdingin nungah kamel nalai diei?"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen tung Pasian akipat ka tanvou ding bang ahia, tualeh vansanga um Bangkimbawltheipa akipat a, ka gouluo ding bang ahi diei?"},"3":{"text":"Migiloute adingin sietna tualeh, thulimlouna nasemte adingin, vangsietna hilou ding adiei mah?"},"4":{"text":"Aman ka lampite mu lou in, ka kalsuon chinteng simlou ahiei mah?"},"5":{"text":"“Dihloupi a ka gamtat a, ahisihleh, solna del a ka kalsuon akinaw leh,"},"6":{"text":"Pasian in buhna dihtah in hing buh henlen, ka dihtatna hing theita hen."},"7":{"text":"Ka kalsuonte lamgei a apiel a, ka lungtangin ka mitte azui leh, tualeh ka khut a sil sienglou bang ahiei abaan khah leh,"},"8":{"text":"Ka tu dinga midang in ne mai henlen, ka haichi poute kiphungkal mai heh."},"9":{"text":"“Numei in ka lungsim a zawl zou a, ahisihleh ka innvengte kotbul a, aguh a buhdap a ka lup khah leh,"},"10":{"text":"Ka zi in midang ann supieh henlen, midangin amanu luppi heh."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen tuakhu khelna zumhuoi, tawpkhoh vawt ahi a, thukhente gawt a um ding thulimlouna khat ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tam khu sietna tun dinga katum meikuong ahi a, Tami’n ka sepgimga zousie aphungkaldoh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Ka suohpa leh ka suohnute, ka tunga lungkimlou a aphun chieng ua, dihloutah a kana bawl leh."},"14":{"text":"Pasian in kei ahing kimaituopi chiengin bang kalawta diei? Tualeh ka tungthu gen dinga hat a ka um chiengin, bang chi’n ka dawngta diei?"},"15":{"text":"Naubu sunga kei hing bawlpa’n, amaute zong a bawl hilou ahiei mah? Naubu sunga khat in koute, ahing bawl tuoh ka hisih uh amah?"},"16":{"text":"“Mi gentheiten alunggul uh ana pe nuomlou ka hi a, ahisihleh meithaite mit na lawsam sah kana hileh;"},"17":{"text":"tualeh keima tanga ann kineh a, tagate na hawmkhalou ka hileh;"},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen ka neu lai a kipata, tagate apa banga kana keptou ahita a, tualeh ka nu gilsung akipat, meithaite kana makai ahita hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi koi ahiei puonsil tasam a mangthang ahisihleh, Puonsil neilou tasam mi khat ka mu a."},"20":{"text":"A lungsim a kei hing guolzawl ding khop a, ka belam mul a ama kana tuomlum sihleh;"},"21":{"text":"tukhenna mun a panpitu ka nei zieh a, tagate douna a ka khut kana tun khah leh."},"22":{"text":"Ka lieng apat ka ban kie henlen, ka khut zong abul apat kilawikhie heh."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian apat a tuohsietna khu, kei a dingin chizat huoi ahi a, Athupina ka mu ngam sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"“Sana ka kinepna a ka bawla, sana siengset kungah ka muonna nahi kana chi leh;"},"25":{"text":"Ka hausatna thupitah zieh ahiei leh, ka khutten tampi ana mute zieh a, lungnuom kana hileh,"},"26":{"text":"Ni avah phat laitah ahiei, ahisihleh hapi tangpha tah a kihei, en mai mai kana hileh,"},"27":{"text":"tualeh ka lungtang aguh a tuate zawl zoua ana um a, ka kam in ka khutte ana tawp a ahileh."},"28":{"text":"Tamte zong thukhenpa’n, agawt ding thulimlouna ahi, aziehpen tung Pasian dinga, dihlou ka hita ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Kei hing na mudate vangsietna tunga kana kipah a, ahisihleh atung ua sietna tun zieh a, suh genthei ahi chienga kana awiam khah leh,"},"30":{"text":"amauh hinna hamsie lawkhum a, khiel dingin ka kam ka phal sih hi."},"31":{"text":"Ka puon inn a umten ama ann ne sih lei, gilva lou ding hi hai a ana chi ngailou ahi uleh,"},"32":{"text":"Khuolzin mi koima gawlzing ah agieh khangai sih a, khuolzin mite adingin, ka kotte honsa in ka koi ngitnget hi."},"33":{"text":"Midangte banga ka khelna ka iim a, ka thulimlounate ka lungsim sunga kana iim mang khah leh,"},"34":{"text":"tuapen mipite ka zauna zieh ahiei mah, ahisihleh innkuonpite simmaw ding zauna zieh a, sip dide a uma kotpu kaanlou ka hi leh."},"35":{"text":"Aw mi khat beeh in hing zahpi ta mai leh, Ngai in ka deipen khu, Bangkimbawltheipa’n ei dawng henlen, tualeh ka melma in laibu khat a agel khu ahi."},"36":{"text":"Adihtahin ka liengkou ah ka paw dinga, ka tungah Manglukhu bangin ka kaan ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Ka kalsuonna zousie ama kungah ka phuong dinga, leeng tapa bangin ama ka zuon ding hi."},"38":{"text":"“Ka gam keima dou a akikou a, tualeh lou kihousa leitangte zousie akaa khawm uleh."},"39":{"text":"A man pelou a agamga ka neh a, tualeh lou neipa shina ding kana bawlkhah leh,"},"40":{"text":"Bu taangin loulingnei barli bu taangin, lingle khaute pou zaw mai heh,” Job thugente abeita hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job khu ama mitmu a ama leh ama akisiemtan zieh in mi thumten dawng nawnlou in atawpsanta uhi.","title":"Elihu thugente"},"2":{"text":"Tuabep in Ram phunga mi, Buzmi, Barakel tapa Elihu ahing lungthahta hi, Pasian awimaw a ama leh ama akisiemtan ziehin Job tungah a lungthahna akuongdohta hi."},"3":{"text":"Alawm thumte tungah zong alungthahna akuong hi, aziehpen amaun, adawnna ding neiloupi in Job amawpai uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuin tam mi thumte ama sanga upa zaw chiet ahizieh un, Elihu in Job thugen zoutan ana ngahta hi."},"5":{"text":"Elihu in tam mi thumte kamah dawnna a um nawnsih chi amu tahin alungthahna akuongta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuabepin Buz mi Barkel tapa Elihu in adawnga, hichiin achi hi. “Ka kum atawm a khangdawng kahi nalai hi. Hinanleh noute pen na upata uhi. Tuaziehin kana zau a, ka ngaidan noute kungah, kana gen ngam sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Kum tam lamten thu agen dinga, akum upaten pilna azil sah ding hi, ka chi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh mihingah lungsim a um a, Bangkimbawltheipa huin ama uh pilna apie hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi thupite khu apil ahi zing tuom sih ua, upaten a theisiem ngitnget tuom sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin, ka thugen ngaikhie unlen, ken zong ka ngaidan ka hing gen ding hi, ka chi ahi."},"11":{"text":"“Ngai un, Na thugente uh kana ngah a, na thugen ding dan uh na sui lai un, na ngaituodan uah kabil kana daw hi,"},"12":{"text":"Ahi, na thugente uh hoitahin kana ngaikhie a, Hinanleh na lah ua koiman, Job na niel zou sih ua, adawng thei zong na um sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Pilvangun, pilna imuta uh mihing hilouin, Pasian in ama zou nava na chikha ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Job in kei demna dingin thu agen sih a, ken noute selnate zanga, ama sel lou ding ka hi hi."},"15":{"text":"“Amauten lamdang asa ua, adawng nawn sih ua, gen ding anei nawn sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ka ngah lai in hamlouin a ding dildel ua, a dawng nawn sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ken zong ka dawng sam ding a, ka ngaidan ka gendoh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen ken thugending adimin ka nei a, ka sungah hagau in ahing sawl tei tei hi."},"19":{"text":"Ngai in, ka gilpi khu pawtdoh na ding neilou uain bang ahia, uain savun thawltha bangin pohkeh dinga mansa ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ka hal theina dingin thu hing gen sah un, ka kam kaah in ka dawng ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ken koima deisah tuom ka nei sih ding a, koima ka maitang phat sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen mi maitang phat dan ka siem sih a, tua hisihleh kei hing siempa’n, ahing lamang paita ding hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Hinanleh Job aw, ka thugente na ngai inlen, ka thute na ngaikhie in."},"2":{"text":"Ngai in, ka kam ka kaah a, ka kamsunga ka leiin thu agen hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka lungtang dihna akipat in, ka thute ahing pawtkhie a, ka kam in theina sieng agen hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian hagau in kei ang bawl a, tualeh Bangkimbawltheipa hu in hinna ahing pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang dawn thei leh hing dawng inlen, na thute ka masangah guoltuoh inlen, dingdet in."},"6":{"text":"En vawi, kei zong Pasian mai ah nangma bang ka hia, kei zong tungman apat a siem ka hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka zauhuoina in hing supatau sih henlen, ka khut zong na tungah gih sih heh."},"8":{"text":"“Adihtahin nangman ka zahin thu na gen a, tualeh na thugen ging kaza hi."},"9":{"text":"Tatkhelna neilou in ka siengthou a, poikhoilou ka hi, keima ah thulim louna a um vawt sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in kei demna ding azieh a mu a, a melma in ahing ngai hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka kengah kol ahing bun a, Ka lampite zousie achiemte hi, na chi hi.","ref":"Job. 13.27"},"12":{"text":"“En in, tamnah na dih sih hi, Keima’n ka hing dawng ding hi. Aziehpen mihing sangin Pasian athupi zaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Bang dinga Ama dou na hiei? aziehpen Aman athute khat zong azieh ape ngai sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in lam khat lam ni in thu agen a, hinanleh mihingin atheizou sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Mang bangin zan a mengmuna bangin, mite imut tuitah a a imut lai bangin, lupna tunga a imut lai bang un,","ref":"Job. 4.13"},"16":{"text":"tuabang hun chiengin, Aman mite bil ahon pieh a, tualeh amaute giihna toh apatausah hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihing asilbawl a pat akinuaheisah thei nading leh, mihing a pat a akiletsahna a phuol theina dingin,"},"18":{"text":"Aman kokhuh a kipat a, a hagau akep bit pieh kia na ding leh, namsau a amanthaina apat, ahinna ahutdohna ding ahi zaw hi."},"19":{"text":"“Mihingte alupna tung uah zong, natna thuoh in aphawhhil thei hi. Tualeh nasatahin agu ataangte anasah hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuabang hun chiengin ahinna un, ann tui pen nangawn akidah ua, adu sih uhi."},"21":{"text":"A tahsa akiemmangsuh deu deu a, et apha nawn sih a, nidang a agu atahsain atuom zieh a, kimu theiloute tuin chiengkang bangin, ahing dawhkheta hi."},"22":{"text":"A hinna in hankhuh anai a, tualeh ahinkhuo in shina tuntu kung anai hi."},"23":{"text":"Akunga palai ama dinga thupha theisah dingin, vansawlsieng tul khat lah ah khat beeh, mihing kunga ama dihna ensah ding a um leh,"},"24":{"text":"tuachi’n ama khu ama dinga hepisiem ahi a, tualeh ama hankhuh a apei suh louna dinga hundoh in, ama tandoh ding ka muta, achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Atahsa khu naupang chingeh hingbang kia dinga, akhangdawng thahat lai ahing bang kia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama Pasian kungah athum dinga, adeisahna anga dinga, kipahtahin a mel amu ding hi, aziehpen Aman mihing kungah, adihtatna ape kia ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Aman mite mai a la sain, kana khielta a thudih kana heikawi a, hinanleh ahing thuh sih hi."},"28":{"text":"Aman ka hinna hankhuh sunga, peisuh lou dingin atankheta hi, tualeh ka hinna in khovah a muta ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Ngai in Pasian in mihingte tungah, tambang silte ni vei, thum vei dongchieng abawl hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuapen ahinna uh hankhuh sung apat, nualah kia na ding leh amaun, hinna khovah amu theina ding uh ahi."},"31":{"text":"Job aw na bil daw inlen, ka thugen ngai in, sip khinkhian in, hing gen ding ka hi."},"32":{"text":"Nangman gen ding na neileh, hing dawng in, gen in hing siemtan nuom ka hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahisihleh hing ngaikhie inlen, sip dide in, pilna ka hing hil ding hi.”"}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Elihu in athu agenbe nalai a, tambang in agen hi."},"2":{"text":"“Nou mipilten ka thugente na ngai un, tualeh kei lam ah na bil uh hing daw un, nou theina nei miten."},"3":{"text":"Azieh pen dangtawngin ann a chep bangin, bil in thute aza chien hi."},"4":{"text":"Eima a dingin thudih itel ding ua, bang pen ahiei ahoi eima lah ah, ikithei ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Job in mawna neilou ka hi, hinanleh Pasian in ka dihtatna alamangta,"},"6":{"text":"A dih hinanleng zuou thei banga sim ka hita, akhiellou hinanleng ka liemna damtheilou ahita hi, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Job banga simmawna tui banga, dawnbei koi ahiei?"},"8":{"text":"Ama pen silhoilou bawlte toh akigop ua, migiloute toh azawhkhawm hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen Job in, Pasian tunga kipah a aum ding, mihing a dingin phattuomna anei sih, a chi hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tuaziehin hing ngaikhie un, nou theisiemna neiten, Pasian in silgilou abawl ngai sih a, Bangkimbawltheipa’n thulimlouna abawl ngai sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen mihingte ana sep bang dungzui ua, Pasian in athuh kia ding ahia, tualeh michin a umdan dungzui ua, musah ding ahi.","ref":"Late. 62.12"},"12":{"text":"Adihtahin Pasian in giloutahin abawl sih dinga, tualeh Bangkimbawltheipa’n thukhen dihna, aheilamdang sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Koiin ama leitunga thuneina apieh ahiei? Ahisihleh koiin ahiei, ama leitung pumpi a thunei a aguot?"},"14":{"text":"Pasian in mihing hinna hagau leh, ahu hakhum khu nualah kia ding hitaleh,"},"15":{"text":"Tahsa zousie a mangthang khawm sieng ding ua, mihing leivui ah akilekia ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Na theisiem taah leh tami za inlen, ka thugen ngaikhie in."},"17":{"text":"Thudih homiin vai a hawm thei ding amah? Midih leh silbawltheipa mawpai ding na hiei mah?"},"18":{"text":"Lengpa kunga panna bei na hi chipa leh, milien milalte kunga migilou nahi chi, akilawm ei?"},"19":{"text":"Aman miliente deisah tuom anei sih a, mi zawngte sangin mi haute azatat zaw tuom sih hi, aziehpen amaute ama khut suoh ngen ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mitphiet kaal sungin a shi ua, mite zankhanglai in akithing ua, apeimangta uhi tualeh mihatte zong, mihing khut tellou a lahmangin a um uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Aziehpen Ama mitte’n mihing lampite a en a, akalsuon zousie uh amu hi."},"22":{"text":"Thulimlouna bawlte kibut theina mun ding, khomiel a um sih a, shina limliep zong a um sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian mai a thukhenna a pei dingin, mihing angaituo nahlai akiphamaw sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Aman athu ala uh kan sese louin, mihatte agawtguoi dimdem a, amaute mun ah midangte akoi zel hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin anasepte uh athei a, zankhanglai in amaute alumle a, suhmang in a um uhi."},"26":{"text":"Midangte mitmu mama ah, migiloute bangin amauh agawt hi."},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama zuilouin apielsan ua, alampite angaituo nuom sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun migentheite akap sah ua, akaana kikoute uh Ama kung atung sah ua, Aman suhgenthei a umte kaana aza hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama sip khinkhian leh, koi in amawpai thei diei? Aman amai phuol leh koi in ama amu thei diei? Namte leh mimal tungah akibangin aum hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuazieh in Pasian neilouten vai ahawm louna ding un, tuachilouin mite thang ah a awhkha ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"“Aziehpen mi koiin zong Pasian kunga, gawtna ka thuohta a, ka khiel nawn sih ding;"},"32":{"text":"Ka sil muloute hing zilsah inlen, thulimlouna kana bawl tah leh zong, ka bawl nawn sih ding achi akilawm hi."},"33":{"text":"A thuhna na dei bang ahina diei, tuabanga na niel? Aziehpen nangman na tel ding ahia, kei tel ding ahisih hi, tuaziehin na theite gen mai in."},"34":{"text":"Theisiemna nei miin ka kungah gen uhenlen, mipil ka thugen angaikhe ten:"},"35":{"text":"Job in theina neiloupi in thu agen a, athugente zong thuhtah theina umloupi ngen ahi."},"36":{"text":"Job in migiloute dawn banga adawn ziehin, atawp dongin ama ze et in um thei leh."},"37":{"text":"Aziehpen aman khelna tungah helna abelap a, ilah uah akhut abenga, Pasian demna thu agen tam seng hi.”"}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Elihu in agen be kia nalai a, tambang in agen hi:"},"2":{"text":"“Nangman ka dihtatna Pasian dihtatna sangin, asang zaw na chikhu a dih hinava, chi’n na ngaisut amah?"},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen nangman khielsih nanleng zong, nang a dinga bang lemtanna umtuon a, nang a ding a phat tuomna bang a hiei um? na chi hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma leh na kunga um nalawmte, ke’n ka hing dawng ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Van lam entou inlen, mu in, tualeh nang sang a sangzaw meilumte en in,"},"6":{"text":"Na kheltaah a ahileh Ama demna in bang na bawl ei? Ahisihleh na natatkhelnate punsah a aumleh, Ama dingin bang na bawl ei?","ref":"Job. 22.2,3"},"7":{"text":"Dihtat na hileh ama bang na pie ei? ahisihleh na khuta pat in Aman bang amu ei?"},"8":{"text":"Na gitlouna in nangma ang suhnat bangin, midangte asuna thei hi, tualeh na dihtatna in zong, mihing tapa asuphatuom thei hi."},"9":{"text":"“Nuoisiena atam seng ziehin, nuoisie a umte akikou zah ua, mihatte khut ziehin, panpina ngen in akikou khie uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh koiman kei hing siempa Pasian, zankhang lai a thahatna la hing pepa, hei ah aum ei? achi sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aman leitunga gamsate sangin, eite a hing hil tamzaw a, tualeh tungleng vate sanga pilzaw in eite ahing bawl hi,"},"12":{"text":"Khunah akikou ua hinanleh, migiloute kiletsahna ziehin koiman adawng sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Adihtah in Pasian in thumanlou a, houlimna angaikhe sih dinga, Bangkimbawltheipa’n athudon sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama ka mu sih chinanlachin zong, vaihawmna amasangah a um nalai hi; tualeh Ama na ngah tei tei ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh tuin Ama lungthahna in ahing gawt nailou ziehin, khelnate angai thupi naisih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin Job in phattuomna bei in, akam akaah a theina tellou in, thu tampi agen a hi.”"}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Elihu in tambang in thu genzom nalai hi."},"2":{"text":"“Hing na thuohpi zou nalai tei tei inlen, Pasian taanga gen ding themkhat ka nei nahlaite ka hing ensah ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ken gamlapi akipat ka theina, ka hing lakhawm dinga, tualeh kei hing siempa kungah, dihtatna ka pe ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen adihtahin, ka thute adihlou ahisih a, theina bukim ama khu na kungah a um hi."},"5":{"text":"“Envawi, Pasian khu athahat a, tualeh koima asimmaw ngai sih hi; hatna leh pilna a silbawlthei ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ama’n migiloute ahinkhawi sih a hinanleh, suhgenthei a umte kungah dihna apie hi."},"7":{"text":"Aman midihtatte akipat amit alakhe ngai sih a, hinanleh leengte toh leengtoupha tung ah aum a, kumtawn a dingin in amauh asukip a, tualeh tawisangin a um uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh kol busaha aum ua, suhgentheina khau a henchip ahi chieng un;"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n, anasep uh amauh a ensah a, atatkhelnate uh akiletsahpina u’toh."},"10":{"text":"Aman thuhilna lam ah abil uh ahon pieh a, thulimlouna akipat a nuakia dingin thu apie hi."},"11":{"text":"A thu aman ua anna asep uleh, lawchingtah in adamsung nite uh amang ding ua, adamsung kumte uh lungkimtah in azang ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh athuman sih uleh pen, namsau in amangthai ding ua, theina beiin ashi ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"“Alungtang ua lepchiete’n lungthahna akholkhawm ua, Aman amauh akaantom chieng in, panpina ngen in akikou sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Khangdawng ahilai un ashi ua, ahinna uh zumhuoitah in abei zel hi."},"15":{"text":"Migentheite khu agimthuohna ua kipat ahundoh a, nuoisie na ah abil uh ahonpieh hi."},"16":{"text":"Aman lungkhamna akipat in, mun lien leh kichingtah, kigahchipna umlouna ah ahing puilut dinga, tualeh na dawkantunga kiluite khu, thauna in a dim ding hi."},"17":{"text":"“Hinanleh migiloute vaihawm piehna in na dim a, vaihawmna leh thudih in nang ahing man hi."},"18":{"text":"Lungthahna aum zieh in pilvangin, tuachilou in mi simawna lungsim in, ahing hip kha ding a, tua toh kipel dingin tatna thupitah in, ahing panpi thei sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na hausatnate leh, na thahatnate zousie in na lungkhamnate a kipat, ahing hundoh zou na ding amah?"},"20":{"text":"Mite a mun ua pat a, satkhieh ahina ding in zan hun lunggul sih un."},"21":{"text":"Pilvang in, thulimlouna lam ah kihei sin, aziehpen gimthuohna sangin tami na telzawta hi."},"22":{"text":"En vawi, Pasian khu asilbawltheina a tawisang ahi a, Ama banga thuhil mi koi ahiei?"},"23":{"text":"Ama lampite guot pieh mi koi ahiei um? ahisihleh Ama kunga na bawlkhielta chi thei koi ahiei?"},"24":{"text":"“Mihingten anasep thupisah na dinga, la ana sah uh thei ngitnget in."},"25":{"text":"Mi chintengin tua khu a muta ua, mi zousie’n gamlapi apat a en uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ngai un, Pasian athupi mama a, eite’n itheisiem sih uh, tualeh akum tamdan zong suidoh guol ahi sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman tuimal neu nounoute alatou a, tuate kihitsiengna tuimeite guo in azu sah hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuami guotuite meizun in ahing tahkhesah a, kiningching tahin mihingte tungah ahing zu suh hi."},"29":{"text":"Aman meilum akiphasah dante, koi in atheisiem dinga, A inn sang akipat a vantoute koi ahiei atheisiem ding?"},"30":{"text":"Envawi, Aman akimvel ah avahpha a, tualeh tuithuhpi nuoi a khu khum hi."},"31":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman tambangin namte vai ahawmpieh a, neh leh taah kichingtahin apie hi."},"32":{"text":"Aman tunphein akhutte atuom a, achiemtena munte khaw dingin thu apie hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuami vantou gingin, Pasian khu thulimlouna huo in, lungthahna leh thangsietna in adim hi, chi aphuongkhie hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tamthu ah ka lungtang akiling a, a umna mun ah aphu dutdut hi."},"2":{"text":"Ama aw ging lungluttah in ngai unlen, A kam a kipat a pawtdoh a aw ging khu ngai un."},"3":{"text":"Aman vannuoi pumpi ah tunphe a sawlkhie a, kawlmong dongin aphesah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuami nua chiengin a aw aging a, avangletna aw kehin akesah a, tualeh a aw akizah chiengin, tunphe pheding lai atawp sah dieh sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian in aw ging lamdang tahin, vanpi aging sah a, itheisiem theilou uh sil thupite abawl zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen aman vua kungah leitungah kie in achi a, tuamabangin guomalte leh guote kungah nasatahin zuin, a chi hi."},"7":{"text":"Aman asiemsa mi zousie in anasep atheina dingun, michinteng khut amelchi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamsate akawhawm sung uah alut ua, akaw sung uah aumden uhi."},"9":{"text":"Sim lam pindan sunga kipat in pingpei ahing kuon a, tualeh mallam hui in kho vawt ahing puo hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian huin vuakhal a um sah a, tui lienpite zong akhal sah hi."},"11":{"text":"Aman meilum satahte tui apaisah a, A meilum vamte khu athezah hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama etkolna nuoi ah, athupiehte semkhe dingin leitung maikai ah, akitawl kawi kawi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aman tamkhu bawlhoina ding ahiei, ahisihleh aleitang tui buoh ding leh, a
