khotuona sulang dingin, ahing umsah hi."},"14":{"text":"Job aw tami ngaikhie inlen, ding khinkhian inlen, Pasian sillamdang bawlte ngaisut in."},"15":{"text":"Pasian in meilumte athu thua aum sah dan, leh ameilumte lah a vah ataansah dante, na thei sih amah?"},"16":{"text":"Meipite kikhai kawm a apei dante, theina a bukimpa sillamdang bawlte, na thei sih a mah?"},"17":{"text":"Simlam hui ahing laan zieha, leitung avot dide lai a, na puonsilte hing lum ahiei mah?"},"18":{"text":"Vante sumtang himlang banga taah, Ama toh na zahpal ahiei mah?"},"19":{"text":"Ama kunga bang gen ding ka hi uoi hing hilin, mielna zieh in kouten ka thu gen ding dan uh, kalemkhawm thei sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ka thu gen nuom khu ama hil kul ding adiei? Mi koiinzong thu agen leh, adihtahin ama khu nawmval in aum ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Tuin miten vanlai a taang. Vah ataanphat laitahin a en thei sih a, hinanleh hui alaanga asemmang zel hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama mallam apat in sana banga vahpha ahing kitawla, Pasian thupina chizathuoi tahin a im kimvel hi."},"23":{"text":"Bangkimbawltheipa Ama eite mudoh guol ahisih a, Ama silbawltheina leh, vaihawmna leh thudihna kichingtah ah. Ama atungtuong a Aman koima asugenthei sih hi,"},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ama miten agiing ua, Aman lungtang kipilsahte, koima bangma’n aseptuom sih hi.”"}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n pingpei lah a kipat in Job adawnga, tambangin agen hi.","title":"Mangpa’n Job thugen adawnna"},"2":{"text":"“Theina tellou thute a, thumawpna mielsah khu koi ahiei?"},"3":{"text":"Ki pasal sah inlen na kawng gah in, ka hing dong dinga, tualeh nangman nang dawng ding hi."},"4":{"text":"“Leitung kingahna ka phum laiin hei ah na um ei? theisiemna na neileh hing hil in."},"5":{"text":"Alet aneu tetuoh koi ahiei na thei amah? ahisihleh atunga tenakhau hung koi ahiei?"},"6":{"text":"A suongphumte bang tunga kinga ahiei? ahisihleh aninga suongphum koi ahiei?"},"7":{"text":"Zingsol aasiten la asah khawm lai u’leh, Pasian tapate zousie nuom a akikou lai un, koi phat ahi uoi?"},"8":{"text":"“Ahisihleh naubu a kipat a, pawtdoh bang mai a apawhkhiit lai a, tuipi kotpi va khakhum koi ahiei?","ref":"Jer. 5.22"},"9":{"text":"A puonsil dinga meilum ka bawl lai leh, atuomna dinga miel satah ka bawl lai in,"},"10":{"text":"agamgite ka bawl pieh a, akotpite leh akilna ding ka siem pieh lai in."},"11":{"text":"Tam tan chieng nang pei thei dinga, aban nang pei thei sih ding, tualeh tanah na tuikihot kisatheite, akhawl ding uh kachi lai in!"},"12":{"text":"“Na hing pien ni a kipat in zingmawng kungah, thupieh na pekha ngaita amah? Ahisihleh zingkhovah kungah amun ding, na theisah kha ngai amah?"},"13":{"text":"Tuabanga leitung aning a tudet a, khuna kipata migiloute thindoh a a um theina ding un."},"14":{"text":"Chiemtena nuoi a tungman bangin amel ahing um a, tualeh puon alou a kibum bangin zie nei in adingdoh uhi."},"15":{"text":"Migiloute apat in avah ukhu tuhtang pieh ahi a, aban lapsangte u’zong sattawng pieh ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Tuipi nahte ah nava lut khat a a mah? Ahisihleh tuipi thuh kilkawi teng na pha suohta amah?"},"17":{"text":"Shina kotkhate nang kungah, ahing ki ensah kha ngaita amah? Ahisihleh shina limliep kotkhate, na mukha ngaita amah?"},"18":{"text":"Leivailam let dan na theikheta amah? Tamte zousie na thei kim leh hing hil in."},"19":{"text":"“Khovah umna lampi heisung ahiei? tualeh miel umna mun heisung ahiei?"},"20":{"text":"Tuachia a inn zotna lampite na theina dingin, amauh tenna gam ah na zawpi thei na diei?"},"21":{"text":"Tuahun lai a na pientah ziehin na thei ei mah? Ahisihleh na kum atam mama taah ziehin."},"22":{"text":"“Vuate koikhawmna inn ah na lut ngaita amah? Ahisihleh gielpi kikoikhawmna inn, na mu ngaita amah?"},"23":{"text":"Tuate lungkham buoina hunte leh, gal kidouna nite adinga ka khet ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Khovah hing kihawmzahna mun, zotna lampi heisung ahiei leh? Ahisihleh, suolam huite leitunga, akithezahna mun heisung ahiei?"},"25":{"text":"“Koi ahiei guotuite luonletna ding tuilam siel a, ahisihleh tunphe leh keeh peina ding, lampi sielpieh koi ahiei?"},"26":{"text":"Koima tenlouna gam leh, mihing umlouna gamdai a guo zusah leh,"},"27":{"text":"Bangma umlouna gamsie leh, mun guoh khu lungtai sah dinga, tualeh haichite dawn suong sah ding, koi ahiei?"},"28":{"text":"“Guo in pa anei amah? Ahisihleh daitui mal hing takhete koi piensah ahiei?"},"29":{"text":"Vuakhalte koi naubu sunga hing piengkhie ahi uoi? tualeh van a kipata daituikhalte, hing sungkhie koi ahiei?"},"30":{"text":"Tuite suong banga atah chiengin, tui thuhpi mai ahing khal sieng hi."},"31":{"text":"“Nang akilawm mama bawmluoite, khau in na kaankhawm thei amah? Ahisihleh zuheisuhtun kikankhawmte na sut thei amah?","ref":"Job. 9.9; Amos. 5.8"},"32":{"text":"Nang aasi sawmleng khu ahuntah a, kum kihei dungzuiin na heithei ei mah? ahisihleh ngambawm uital leh, anoute na pui koi thei ei mah?"},"33":{"text":"Vanlamte kivaipuohna dan na theina amah? Amauh kivaipuoh dan khu leitungah, na polut thei ding amah?"},"34":{"text":"“Tui tampi in ahing khu khum theina dingin, meilumte han in na aw na vawhsang thei nangel amah?"},"35":{"text":"Kawlphete peidoh a na kunga tanah ka um uhi, chi dingin na sawlkhe theina ei?"},"36":{"text":"Pilna sunggil lam a koi a, ahisihleh lungsim sunga, theisiemna pie koi ahiei?"},"37":{"text":"Meilumte sim theina pilna nei koi ahiei? Ahisihleh koi ahiei van tuithawlte, sungbaw thei?"},"38":{"text":"Bangchih chienga leivuite hing khal a, buonte hing kilomkhawm ahiei?"},"39":{"text":"“Humpibahnei samat ding na sui pieh thei ding amah? Ahisihleh humpibahnei lunlai gilkielte khu, na gilva sah thei na diei le?"},"40":{"text":"A kuo ua aboh a samat ding abuh lai un, nang ama ua dingin sa nava mat pieh ngai amah?"},"41":{"text":"Va-ah noute gilkiel a Pasian kunga, kikou a a ann neh ding uh sui a, aleen kawikawi chieng ua, va-ah te ann vape zel khu koi ahiei?"}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Kawl lah a sakelte nou nei hun na thei ei? Ahisihleh sakhiten bang hun chienga, nou anei uh ahiei na chiemte thei ei?"},"2":{"text":"Ha hiza sung agai uh chi na sim thei ei? Tualeh asuoh hun uh na thei ei?"},"3":{"text":"Amaute abohsuh ua anoute asuoh sah ua, asuohzou chiengun anauvei natna uh abeita hi,"},"4":{"text":"Anoute uh ahing hat ua, gamlah ah hampa nein ahing khanglien ua, avahkhie ua ahing kinuale kia nawn sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"“Gamsabiltung zalen tah a hakhie koi ahiei? Koi ahiei akhina khaute sutkhie?"},"6":{"text":"A inn dingun gamlah ka bawl a, atenna ding un gamdai ka pie hi."},"7":{"text":"Aman khopi sung buoi vengvung khu anuisan giap a, tualeh sakolleng hehte kikou awging angaisah sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Muoldungte khu ama gamtatna mun ahi a, tualeh hampa hingte asui kawi kawi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Gambawngtal in na nna asem nuom diei mah? Ahisihleh na gan ann piehna kuong gei ah, azan gieh nuom diei le?"},"10":{"text":"Loukaina langkawn khu angawngah, khau in nakhi theina diei leh? Ahisihleh na nua a pei in lou nakai sah theina diei leh?"},"11":{"text":"Athahat mama ziehin, na muong theina diei leh? tualeh na nasep ama tungah na ngansie ngam na diei?"},"12":{"text":"Na bu leh balte na inn a hing nawnlut ding leh, na buphuol a na bute hing nawnkhawm dingin na gingta diei?"},"13":{"text":"“Ostrik in ahate ki uongsahtahin azap nanleh hakuite leh, multe vahuong a bangin akituupna amah?"},"14":{"text":"Ostrik in lei lah ah tui atha a, leivui in a op lumsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Keeng in tuonkek kha ding, ahisihleh gamsain tuon keh, khava chi khuolse louin, amanghil leng hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama noute nangawn ama a bangloutahin, huhamtah in akeem a, asepgimna khu amawhna suoh khava chi zauna a neisih hi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in ama pilna alahmang pieh a, theisiemna zong ape sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tai ding a ahate azah chiengin sakol leh, atunga tuongpa anuisan hi."},"19":{"text":"“Sakol kungah hatna na pie ei mah? amulnem in angawng na tuom eimah?"},"20":{"text":"Khauphe bangin ama na zausah thei eimah? anahkawhawm a hu pawt khu chizat ahuoi hi."},"21":{"text":"Akengchin in phaijangte a khuot a, a hatna aki pah pi hi, kidouna kigal thuom mi kituohpi dingin, apawtkhie hi."},"22":{"text":"Aman zauna anuisan a azau ngai sih a, namsau lah ah akinua hei ngai sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Atungah thaltang bawm aging leng lenga, teipi leh chieng zumte ate set set hi."},"24":{"text":"Giinhuoi tah leh thangpaina toh, lei akhuot gup gup a, Pengkul ging azah chiengin, ading khinkhien thei sih hi."},"25":{"text":"Pengkul a gin chiengin, Ehe! achi a, gamlapi akipat kidouna husa leh, gal lamkaite thupieh kikou leh, galnawhna kikou thawm ging zong athei hi."},"26":{"text":"“Nangma pilna zieha mupi leeng tou a, simlam nawt a aha zah ahiei mah?"},"27":{"text":"Muvanlai leengtou a, sangtah a bu ava bawl khu, nangma thupieh zieh ahiei mah?"},"28":{"text":"Ama kawlkhou tungte ah atenga, suongkawhawm muonhuoina munte ah agieh leeng hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuana kipat in neh ding asui a, gamlapi a kipat in ganhing amat dingte, agal mu pai hi."},"30":{"text":"Anouten zong sisan atawp ua, akithatsa saluongte umna munah ama zong a um hi.”","ref":"Mat. 24.28; Luk. 17.37"}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Mangpa’n Job adawnga, tambangin agen hi."},"2":{"text":"“Bangkimbawltheipa toh kikhingpa’n, ama athuhil diei mah? Koi zong Pasian toh kiniel miin,” tami dawng heh."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job in Mangpa adawng a,"},"4":{"text":"“Envawi, Kei bangmatham ka hisih hi, nang bang ka hing chi dawn diei? Ka khut in kakam ka hum hi."},"5":{"text":"Khatvei ka genta a, hinanleh ka dawng sih ding hi, nivei thu kagenta a, ka ham nawn sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n pingpei lah a, kipat in Job adawnga;"},"7":{"text":"“Ki pasal sah inlen na kawng gah inlen, thu ka hing dong dinga, ka kunga na phuondoh ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ka vaihawmna bangmalou suohsah ding, na hiei mah? Nangma siem na kitantheina dingin, kei hing mawpai ding na hiei mah?"},"9":{"text":"Pasian bangin bantha na nei ei mah? Ama bangin aw in, van na ging sah thei ei mah?"},"10":{"text":"“Nang leh nang hoina leh, za umna toh kizem inlen, thupina leh kilawmna toh kithuom ve leh."},"11":{"text":"Na lungthahna dimlet zousie, tuibangin bokhe sieng inlen, mi kisathei chinteng en inlen su ngiem in."},"12":{"text":"Mi kiliensah zousie en inlen ngiemkieh sahin, tualeh migiloute adinna mun uah tuonchil in."},"13":{"text":"Amaute abawn un leivui lah ah phuol khawm inlen, miel kiphuol lah ah amaite uh kaan in."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n na khut zietlam in, nang ahing hundam thei hi, chi keima mama in na kungah, ka phuongkhe ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Enin tuin Nangma toh ka siemkhawm, Behemeth in bawngtal bangin, hampa ane hi."},"16":{"text":"Enin tuin akawngah a thahatna a um a, tualeh agilpi satel lah ah thahatna aum hi."},"17":{"text":"Amei sidar sing banga khau in apiesah a, amalpi thahuite ka phankhawm hi."},"18":{"text":"Agute sum-eng zawl bang mai ahi a, agu leh taangte sia chieng banga khau ahi."},"19":{"text":"“Ama khu Pasian khut suohte lah a, akhatna pawl ahi a, ama siempa’n anamsau toh, ama kunglam azuon thei giap hi."},"20":{"text":"Adihtahin taangten a ann neh ding apieng sah ua, gamsate zousie khunah akimawl uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ama thamna pah kung nuoite ah aboh a, Luonglau phung leh chihnawng lah ah."},"22":{"text":"Thamna pah kungbawh limten, ama alie khum ua, tualeh lui gei a huisum singten, ama a imkuol uhi."},"23":{"text":"En vawi luidung tuilet henlen, luonkhum nanleh apatau sih hi, Jordan lui akam dong hum in luong nanleh alung muong hi."},"24":{"text":"Akiven laitahin mi’n siakawi in, ama aman thei diei? ahisihleh anahkuo thangin, avutpailet thei ding amah?"}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ngakuoi in Leviathan na kaikhe thei diei mah? Ahisihleh khauhuolin alei na khi thei diei mah?","ref":"Late. 74.14; 104.26; Isai. 27.1"},"2":{"text":"Anakaw sungah khauhuol na thun thei ding amah? Hisihleh siakawi in akhagu na vut pailet thei ding amah?"},"3":{"text":"Aman na kungah zangaina ang ngen ding amah? kam nem in nang ang houpi ding amah?"},"4":{"text":"Ama’n nang toh thuhun abawl diei mah? Kumtawn a na suoh dingin, ama na bawl diei mah?"},"5":{"text":"Vate na khawizuol bangin, ama na khawizuol thei na diei leh, Ahisihleh na nungahte a dingin, ama na khi thei diei leh?"},"6":{"text":"Na lawm leh guolten ama mangin, ankuong a lui ding uoi mah! Summet bawlten alah uah, ama a hawm ding uoi mah?"},"7":{"text":"Avunte siakuoika in na sun thei ding amah? Ahisihleh alutang nga matna teipi in, khaw thei ding amah?"},"8":{"text":"Atungah na khut koi inlen; kidounate thei ngitnget lachin, na bawlkia nawn sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ngai in, ama tunga kinepna khu athawn ahi a, amu mai in zong mi paikhieh in a um sih diei mah?"},"10":{"text":"Ama tohthou ngam ding khopin koima ahangsan sih hi. Ahileh koi ahiei ka mai a ding ngam ding?"},"11":{"text":"Ka sankia dinga sil hing pe masa koi ahiei um? Van nuoi pumpi a sil um zousie kei a ahi."},"12":{"text":"“A tahsa hiengte ahisihleh asilbawltheinate, apien hoinate tungtang thu ah, iim ka nei nawn sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Apuonsil tungnung pen, hawhkhiet pieh thei ding koi ahiei? ahisihleh akamkaina thuo ni toh, ama zuon ngam ding koi ahiei?"},"14":{"text":"Amai a kotte hong ngam ding koi ahiei? Aha kimvel ah zauhuoina a um hi."},"15":{"text":"A lipte akiletsahpi ahia, aguolguol a suoi namna a dettah a, kikhahkhum bang ahi."},"16":{"text":"A kaal a hui lutlouna dinga, kimat zeta kidaaptuo ahi."},"17":{"text":"Khat leh khat akimattuo chiet ua, phelkhiet thei ahi sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahahthiei chiengin tunphe aleengkhie a, amitte gel zong zingmawng mitvunte bang mai ahi."},"19":{"text":"Anakawhawm akipat in meikhu apawtdoh a, meisite aleengdoh zeng zung hi."},"20":{"text":"Anakawhawm akipat in meikhu apawtdoh a, bel a tui kisuong sou leh, hampa kihal khute abang hi."},"21":{"text":"Anahhu in meiholte akuong sah a, tualeh akam apat in mei kuong apawtdoh hi."},"22":{"text":"Angawngah hatna aum ngitnget a, amai ah lunggimna alaam hi."},"23":{"text":"A tahsa kihipte kiptah in akimattuo ua, phekhiet guol ahisih uhi."},"24":{"text":"Alungtang suong bangin atah a, bu gawtguoina suong nuoipha bangin atah hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama athaw chiengin mi hatte azau ua, azauseng zieh un amauh akimanghil hiel uhi."},"26":{"text":"Min ama namsau in sat nanlezong aphatuom sih a, teipi leh thal leh sia zum in dawt nan uleh zong, aphatuom sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Aman sia zong bupawl bangin angai a, sum-eng zong sing muotsa bang in angai giap hi."},"28":{"text":"Thaltangin ama atai sah zou tuom sih a, ama dingin suong saili kap zong, bupawl bang giap ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Phohbulte zong ama a dingin, bupawl bang giap a ngai ahia, chieng zum a khawte anuisan giap hi."},"30":{"text":"Anuoilang pen belphou keh hiem bang ahia, buonnawi tunga bu satna chieng bangin akipha hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuithuh pite zong belta tuisou abang sah a, Tuipi zong bel sunga sathauman bel bangin abawl hi."},"32":{"text":"Aman apeina nuo zousie ataangsah selsol a, miten tuithuhpi khu samkang bang asa ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Leitungah ama banga zaulou a siem, ganhing dang a um sih hi."},"34":{"text":"Aman akisang sah leh kiliensah zousie a en a, akisathei zousie tunga leengpa ahi.”"}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job in Mangpa adawnga, tambang in agen hi:"},"2":{"text":"“Nang silbangkim nabawlthei hi chileh, na sil tupte koima khamthei ahisih, chi ka thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Nang, theina neiloupi a, thuhilna phuolgu koi ahiei? chiin na donga, tuaziehin ka theisiemlou kei a dinga, lamdang taluo silte ka gendoh khat a hi.","ref":"Job. 38.2"},"4":{"text":"Ngai in, ka hing ngen a hi, thu ka hing gen dinga, tualeh nang ka hing phuut dinga, nangman ka kungah phuongdoh in, na hing chi hi.","ref":"Job. 38.3"},"5":{"text":"Ka bil ngel in na thugen ka zata a, tu’n vang ka mit mama in ka hing muta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin keima leh keima ka ki kidah a, leivui leh vut lah ah ka kisiata hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Mangpa’n Job kunga tam thute agen zou nuain, “Mangpa’n Teman mi Eliphaz kungah, ka lungthahna nangma tung leh na lawm nite tungah akuong hi; azieh pen ka suohpa Job banga nouten ka tanchin adihtah na genlou zieh uh ahi.","title":"Pasian in mipil thumte ahousietna"},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin bawngtal sagi leh belamtal sagi kai unlen ka suohpa Job kungah pei unlen, nou a dingin halmang sillat lan unlen, tuachi’n ka suohpa Job in noute adingin thu ahing nget pieh dinga, ama ziehin ka sang dinga, na khelna dungzui un na tung uah ka hing thuh sih ding hi. Ka suohpa Job bangin ka tanchin dihtah nouten na gen sih uhi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Teman mi Eliphaz leh Shuhmi Bildad leh Namathmi Zopharte ava pei ua, Mangpa’n akung ua agen bangin ava bawlta uhi, tuachi’n Mangpa’n Job thungetnate ana pompiehta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh alawmte dinga thu angetpieh lai in, Mangpa’n Job manna zousie ape kia a, Mangpa’n aguolzawl a, anei leh lamte nidang a sanga aleni a tamzaw apieh be kiata hi.","title":"Mangpa’n Job aguolzawlna","ref":"Job. 1.1-3"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n akungah asanggam pasalte leh asanggam numeite zousie leh masang lai a, ameltheite zousie ahing pei khawm ua, a innsungah ama toh ann ane khawm ua, tualeh amaun Mangpa’n atunga atunsah silhoilou zousie tungtangah ama ahenem ua, ahamuon uhi; tualeh michin in sum neu khat chiet leh sana khutsip khat chiet apie uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Job khu nidanglai sangin ahun nukhia lamah nahpitah in aguolzawl a, tuachi’n aman belam tul sawm leh li leh sangawngsau tul guh leh bawngtal kop tul khat tualeh sabiltung tul khat aneita hi."},"13":{"text":"Aman tapa sagi leh tanu thum zong anei hi."},"14":{"text":"Amasapen min Jemimah achia, anina nu min Keziah achi a, athumna nu min Keven happuk achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamsung pumpi ah Job tanute banga melhoi numei a um sih a, tualeh apa un asanggam pasalte u’lah ah amauh goutan zong ahawm pieh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tamte nuain Job kum za leh kum sawmli adam a, atapate, atupate khang li na tandong a mu hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Job khu teh mama in kum tampi dam in ashita hi."}}}}},"19":{"info":{"name":"Late","shortname":"Late.","abbr":[],"desc":"Late"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian ngaisahloute lemguot bang a, um ngai lou a, migiloute lampi a zong ding ngailou a, mi simmawhatte toupha a, zong tou ngailou mi khu ahampha hi.","title":"BU KHATNA (Late. 1-41) Mihoi leh migiloute lampi"},"2":{"text":"Akipahna khu Mangpa dan ah ahizaw a, tualeh adan thute sun leh zan in angaituo ngitnget hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama khu luiluong gei a sing kisuon ahun a ga zel, ana zong vuoi ngailou bang ahi ding a, asil bawl pouma ah alamzang ding hi.","ref":"Jer. 17.8"},"4":{"text":"Pasian ngaisahloute pen tuabang ahisih ua, hui in bushi amutmang bang ahi zaw uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian ngaisahloute pen, vaihawmna ah ading thei sih ding ua, mikhielte zong midihtatte kikhopna ah, a um thei sih ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n midihtatte lampi a thei a, hinanleh Pasian ngaisahloute lampi pen, amangthang ding hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bangding a namte lungthah a, tualeh bang dinga miten silphatuomlou, angaituo uh adiei?","title":"Mangpa sathau kinupa vaihawmna","ref":"Nasep. 4.25,26"},"2":{"text":"Leitunga leengte akisa ua, tualeh vaihawm mite zong akikum khawm ua, Mangpa leh asathaunupa tungah thu aphiel uhi."},"3":{"text":"“Ahing kaan na siakhaute uh bottan vai in, tualeh ahing khina khauhuolte uh, ei a kipat in ipaimang ding uhi,” akichi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa’n van pan in a nuisat a, alung guotte uh nuijat huoi asa hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuazou chiengin Aman thangpai tahin, akung uah thu agen ding a, lungkimloutahin amauh a sumangbang ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Keima’n ka muol siengthou Zion ah, ka leengpa ka tousahta hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa thuguotsa ka phuongkhe ding hi; Mangpa’n ka kungah “Nangpen ka Tapa na hita a, tuni in ka hing hingkheta hi.","ref":"Nasep. 13.33; Heb. 1.5; 5.5"},"8":{"text":"Hing ngen inlen, tuachi’n, namte na gouluo dingin, kawlmong tawp tandong na goutan dingin. Ka hing pe ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangma’n sia chieng in amauh, na satsegawp dinga, bel khengten bel apai keeh bangun, na sep guoi dimdem ding,” achi hi.","ref":"Kihil. 2.26,27; 12.5; 19.15"},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin nou leengte aw pilta un, nou leitung vaihawmte aw giihna ngaisah un."},"11":{"text":"Zau dan siem in Mangpa nna sem unlen, chitun pum in amai ah kun un."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa khu bie un tuachilouin, alungthah kha dinga, lamkaal ah na mangthang kha ding uhi. A thangpaina mitphietkal loua kuong thei ahi a, Ama a aginna uh koite zousie a hampha uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa aw ka galte pung hina va-ia e! Kei hing doute tampi ahi uhi.","title":"Zingmawnglam phatna la Atapa Absalom apat atai mang lai a David phatna la"},"2":{"text":"Ama a dingin Pasian ah, panpina mawngmawng a um sih, chi a ka tungtang thugente tampi aum uhi. Selah"},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw! Mangpa nangpe’n, kei a dingin ka lum leh phaw na hi a, Ka thupina leh ka lu domkangpa na hi."},"4":{"text":"Kap kawm in Mangpa ka han a, Aman amuol siengthou akipat in, ahing dawng zel hi. Selah."},"5":{"text":"Ka lumsuh a Ka imuta hi, Mangpa’n ahing na tuh ngitnget zieh in, ka khanglou ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Kei hing dou a ka kimkot a, hing im mi tul sawm zong ka zau sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa aw hing thou inlen, ka Pasian aw hing hundam in, Nangma’n ka galte zousie, abienggu uh na sattawng pieh a, migiloute hatu zong na suhbal pieh hi."},"8":{"text":"Hundamna khu Mangpa a ahi, Na guolzawlna khu na mite tungah umta hen. Selah."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka dihtatna Pasian aw, ka hing hat chiengin hing dawngin. Ka chimaw vawt chiengin, nangma’n na hing khotuo a, ka tungah zangai inlen, ka thungetna ngaikhie in.","title":"Hundamna dinga nitahlam thungetna Lapu lien a ding; pehging toh sah ding. David phatnala"},"2":{"text":"Nou mihing tate aw, bangtan vei ahiei ka thupina, zalatna na suohsah ding uh? Bangtan vei ahiei sil ginalou na ngainat ua, zuou thu na sui ding uh? Selah."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa Pasian ngaisah mi, ama a dingin akoituom ahi chi thei zaw un; Ama ka hat chiengin, Mangpa’n ahing ngaikhe ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Lungthah unlen khiel vang khiel sih un, na lupna tung uah na lungtang un, ngaituo unlen sip dide un. Selah.","ref":"Eph. 4.26"},"5":{"text":"Dihtatna kithoina laan unlen, Mangpa muong un."},"6":{"text":"“Mi tampite’n Koi in ahiei, silhoi eite ahing ensah thei ding? achi uhi. Mangpa na melvah ka tung uah taang sah in.”"},"7":{"text":"Abu uleh a uoin uh ahing pun chienga, akipahna uh sanga kipahna thupi zaw, ka lungtang ah na umsah hi."},"8":{"text":"Hamuongtahin ka lumsuh dinga, ka imu ding hi. Aziehpen Mangpa aw, Nang bouin bittahin na hing umsah hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka thute ah na bil hing daw inlen, Aw Mangpa ka thumnate hing ngaituo in.","title":"Humbitna dinga zingmawng thungetna Lapulien a ding: Theile toh sah dinga David laphuo."},"2":{"text":"Ka kaa na aw ngaikhie in, ka Lengpa leh ka Pasian aw, Nangma kunga thungen ka hi bou hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa aw zingmawng in ka aw na za dinga, Zingmawngchiengin na kungah ka thungetna, ka hing tun dinga, tuachi’n nang dawnna aw, ka na ngah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen gitlouna kipahpi Pasian na hisih a, gitlouna khu nang toh aumkhawm theisih hi."},"5":{"text":"Mikiliensahte khu na mitmu ah ading thei sih ding ua, Nang silgilou bawlte zousie na huo hi."},"6":{"text":"Zuouthu gente nangman na sumangthang dinga, Mangpa’n sisan suohatte leh mi solhatte akidah hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh kei pen, na khotuona kiningchingtah zieh in, na inn ah Ka hing lut dinga, zau kawmin na biehinn siengthou lam ngain, ka hing be ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa aw, ka galte ziehin na dihtatna ah hing pui inlen, ka masangah na lampi tangtahin kihung sah in."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen a kam uah thudih mawngmawng a um sih a, alungtang sung uah sietna a um a; agong uh han kihong ahi a, alei un solna thu agen uhi.","ref":"Rom. 3.13"},"10":{"text":"Aw Pasian, amauh siemmaw tangsah in, amauh lemguotna ma ah puasah inlen, atatkhelna uh tampite zieh in, ama uh paikhie in, aziehpen ama ute na tungah ahel uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh nangma hing muongte zousie, nuom uhenlen, amaute nahumbit ziehin nuom in kikou uheh, na min itte zong nangma ah nuom in um uhen."},"12":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, nangma’n, midihtatte, na guolzawl dinga, deisahna toh lumbangin na sung ding hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa lungthah in hing phoh sin len, thangpai in hing sugenthei vawt sin.","title":"Pasian khotuona ngetna Lapu lien a ding; kaiging guinei toh sah ding. Sheminith","ref":"Late. 38.1"},"2":{"text":"Hing khotuoin Aw Mangpa, aziehpen ka gimgawpta hi; Mangpa aw hing damsah in; ka gu kataangteng ana siengta hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka hinna zong nasatah in suh mangbang in a um hi; Aw Mangpa bangtan vei ahiei, donlou a na hing umsah ding?"},"4":{"text":"Mangpa aw, hing kihei kia inlen ka hinna hundam in, Na khotuona ziehin hing hundam in."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen shi nua chiengin, nangma thei ngitngetna a um sih hi. Sheol ah koi ahiei na tunga kipahthu gen ding?"},"6":{"text":"Ka kaa kamauna ziehin ka ba gawpta hi, zan simsiel in ka lupna tungah hitui avei denta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka mitte lungkhamna ziehin ase gawpta a, ka melmate zieh in ka vuoi hiei hieita hi."},"8":{"text":"Gitlouna nasem noute zousie aw, hing peisanta un, Mangpa’n ka ka na awging azata hi.","ref":"Mat. 7.23; Luk. 13.27"},"9":{"text":"Mangpa’n ka ngetnate azata a, Mangpa’n ka thungetna ahing sangta hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka melmate zousie zumsahin um uhenlen, nahpitahin buoi gawp uheh; kinua hei uhenlen, thakhat in zalah uhen."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa ka Pasian Aw, nangma ka hing muong hi. Keima hing sugentheite zousie lah akipat in, hing hundam inlen hing hunkhie in.","title":"Hutkhietna dinga ngetna: David shiggaion la Benjamin mi Kush thungen tungtanga, Mangpa kunga pahtawina la asah."},"2":{"text":"Tuachilouin hunkhe ding mi umlou in, humpibahnei bangin ka hinna, abottel kha ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka Pasian, tami kana bawl a, ka khut a bawlkhielna ana um a,"},"4":{"text":"Keima toh kilem a um mite, silgilou a thuh kana hi a, azieh bei a ka galte bulu kana hileh;"},"5":{"text":"Ka galpan hing nuadel henlen, hing nuaphah mai henlen, ka hinna lei lah ah tuonchil henlen, ka zatat huoina leivui lah ah sielpua mai hen."},"6":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, lungthah in thou inlen, ka melmate thangpaina doudingin kisa in, kei a dingin khanglou inlen, nangma’n vaihawmna ding thu na piehsa ahita hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi kikhawmten nang hing im kuol uhenlen; amaute ziehin sangtahin hing kile kia in."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa’n mipite tungah thu akhen zel a, Mangpa aw keima a dihtatna leh, Ka lungsim a hoina um dungzui in ka tungah vaihawm in."},"9":{"text":"Aw migiloute gitlouna beita mai henlen, hinanleh midihtatte pen sukip in. Aziehpen Pasian dihtat in, lungtangte leh lungsimte a enchien zel hi.","ref":"Kihil. 2.23"},"10":{"text":"Ka kihumbitna Pasian ahi a, lungtanga dihtatte ahundam hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian pen dihtah a vaihawmpa ahia, Pasian khu migiloute tungah, nichin in alungthah hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi koipou akisia sihleh, Pasian in a namsau ataat hiem ding a; Athalpi aluoita a, kap ding a mansa ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aman shina vanzahte mansain akoita a; Athaltangte akuong theiin abawl hi."},"14":{"text":"En in, gitlouna khu nau vop in avom a, thulim louna nau vei in avei a, zuouthu apiengsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Migilouin midangte ki-etna dingin leihum abawl a, thuhtah in a tou a, ama tawsa leihum sungah akie hi."},"16":{"text":"Asil bawlkhielna khu ama lutungma ah atu kia dinga, hiemngamtah a asil bawl khu, ama jangsip ah ake ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Adihtatna bangzel in Mangpa ka phat dinga, Tungnung sang pen, Mangpa pahtawina in la kasa ding hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, Koute Mangpa aw, leitung pumpi ah na min hoi hina va-ia e; nang vante tungah na thupina na koi hi.","title":"Pasian thupina, leitunga mihing vaihawmna Lapulien a ding: Gittith a sah ding. David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Na melma leh phubala mite, na sip sah theina dingin; nang hing doute ziehin, naungehte leh nausen nawiteplaite kam a kipat, hatna na sudetta hi.","ref":"Mat. 21.16"},"3":{"text":"Na khutsuoh na vante, hapi leh aasite amun mun ua, dettah a na koite Ka ngaituo chiengin;"},"4":{"text":"mihing bang ahitalawma, hichi va-ia a na ngaisah e? tualeh mihing tapa zong bang ahitalawma, hichikhopa na ve zel ahiei?","ref":"Job. 7.17,18; Late. 144.3; Heb. 2.6-8"},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen nangma’n amaute vansawltahte, sanga ngiemzaw deu in na bawl a, thupina leh zatatna na khusah hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma’n na khutsuohte tungah, amaute thuneina na pie a, akephang nuoi ah sil bangkim na koi hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 15.27; Eph. 1.22; Heb. 2.8"},"7":{"text":"Belam leh bawng talte zousie, ahi, gamlah a gamsate nangawn zong;"},"8":{"text":"tung leeng vate leh tuipi sunga ngate, tuipi sunga lamha a pei poumate toh."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa koute Mangpa aw leitung pumpi ah, na min hoi hina va-ia e."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa aw ka lungtang tengteng in, nang ka hing phat ding hi. Na sil lamdang bawlte zousie ka gengen ding hi.","title":"Guolzawna zieh a Pasian phatna Lapulien a ding: Muth labben a kai a sah ding David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Nangma ah kipah in ka nuom dinga, Aw Tungnung pen na min phat in, la kasa ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka melmate anuatai kia chiengun, na masangah apua ding ua, amangthai ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen nangma’n ka dihna tungtang ah na hing hum a; dihtah a vaihawm in, Mangtoupha ah na tou hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang namte na vau a, migiloute na sumang hi. Amin u’zong kumtawn kumtawn a dingin na thaimangta hi."},"6":{"text":"Aw melma, kumtawn a bei mang dingin, sietna ahing tung ta tualeh nangma’n khopite na susie a, amauh thei zingna khu amautoh abeimangta hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa khu kumtawn in aum ding a; a Mangtoupha khu vaihawmna dingin atungdohta hi."},"8":{"text":"Aman dihtatna toh khovel vai ahawm dinga; namchin tungah thudihna toh vai ahawm pieh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Bawlgenthei a umte a dingin Mangpa khu kibutna kulpi ahi a; Mangbat hun chienga bel ding kulpi ahi."},"10":{"text":"Na min thei poumaten nangma ah muonna a koi ding ua; aziehpen Mangpa aw, nangma hing sui mite na taisan ngaisih hi."},"11":{"text":"Zion a teng Mangpa phat in lasa unlen, mite lah ah asil bawlte phuongza un."},"12":{"text":"Aman sisan phuba alah chiengin; amaute a thei zing dinga, suhgenthei a um mite kikou aw, amanghil sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, kei hing khotuo inlen, kei hing mudate hing suhgenthei dan en in; Shina kotkha akipat a hing domkang nangma na hi bou hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Zion tanu kulpi dawngkot a, na pahtawina ka phuong thei dinga, na hundamna ah ka nuom ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Namte amauh tawsa kokhuh sungah akie ua, aguh a amauh lenthang kam sate ah, akeng uh a awhta hi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa pen athukhenna dihtah apat in akithei hi. Migiloute pen amauh bawlsa thangah a awh uhi. Higgaion Selah."},"17":{"text":"Migiloute khu gawtmun ah akiheilut ding ua, tualeh Pasian manghil nam zousiete zong."},"18":{"text":"Tasamte manghil in a um den sih ding ua, migentheite kinepna zong a beiden sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Aw Mangpa hing thou inlen, mihing guolzou sah sin; namte nangma mitmu ah, vaihawmkhum in um uheh"},"20":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, amaute zausah inlen, namten mihing leltah ahi uh chi, akitheina ding un. Selah."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa bangdinga gamlatah a ding na hiei? Bangdinga mangbat hunlai a, kiphuol na hiei?","title":"Migiloute tunga Pasian thukhenna ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Migilouten kisathei tahin, mizawngte abawl genthei ua, guhsima asilgilou ngaituonate uah, amauh mama awh uheh."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen migilouten alungtang, ut lam uh asuong ua, tualeh Pasian theilou mi huoihamte aguolzawl uhi."},"4":{"text":"Migilouten kiletsah mel puoin Pasian asui sih ua; angaituonate uah “Pasian a aum sih hi.”"},"5":{"text":"Agamtatnate ah alawching ua, akisathei uhi; tunglam sangtah a na thukhennate amupha sih ua, amelmate zousie uh anuisan uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amaun alungsim ah, “Lawsam ngai sih vang, vangsietna zong ka tuohsih ding,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Akam khu hamse lawnate, solbawlnate leh mi enghounate in adim a, alei nuoi ah thusie leh thulimlouna a um hi.","ref":"Rom. 3.14"},"8":{"text":"Khosung ah mi lambuhna munte ah, mi buhin adap tou a, mun sip ah mawna neiloute athat a, amit in migentheite aguh et zing hi."},"9":{"text":"Humpibahnei sa buh bangin aguhin mi abuh a, mi gentheite man dingin abuh zel a, alen in akaimang zel hi."},"10":{"text":"Akuun suh ua, aboh ua, panpi ding neiloute athahatna nuoi uah apua uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aman alungsim in, “Pasian in amanghilta, Aman amai aphuolta, amu ngai nawn sih ding,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Aw Mangpa thou inlen, Aw ka Pasian na khut zahtou inlen, bawlgenthei a umte manghil vawt sin."},"13":{"text":"Bangdinga migilou in “Pasian asimmaw ahiei? alungsim a na phuut sih ding” achi zel ahiei."},"14":{"text":"Mu pen na muta tham a, na khut a thuh dingin; bawlkhelna leh suhhasietna na en zing hi, migentheite na kung ah ahing kikemsah ua, Nang pa neiloute panpipa na hi."},"15":{"text":"Migiloute leh silgilou bawlte ban suhtan pieh inlen, agitlouna uh na mu sieng masangsie in suikhie in."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa khu kumtawn kumtawn a dinga leengpa a hiden ding hi, agama kipat in namte amangthai ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangma’n mi kingaingiemte, lunggul na ngaikhie a alungtang uh, na suhhat pieh dinga amaute lang ah, na bil na daw ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Pa neiloute leh bawlsiet a umte, leitung mi’n abawlsiet nawnlouna dingun, vai na hawmpieh ding hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa ah ka tahsanna ka nga zel a; “Bangchidan ahiei ka hinna kunga, na muol uah va bangin leengmang un, na chi uh ahiei?","title":"Mangpa midihtatte kihumbitna Lapulien a ding: David phatna la"},"2":{"text":"En in, migilouten lungtang dihtah pomi, aguh a akap theina ding un, athalpi te uh aluoi ua, athaltangte uh athalpi gui ah athuo uhi."},"3":{"text":"Abulpi suongphumte kisuseta leh, midihtatin bang ahiei abawlthei ding?”"},"4":{"text":"Mangpa khu abiehinn siengthou ah a um a, Mangpa mangtoupha khu van ah a um a; amit vun in a en a, mihing tate a en chien zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa’n midihtatte a en chien zel a, hinanleh migilou leh thagum suo ut mite pen, ahinna in ahuo hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n migiloute tungah, mei leh kaat leh huipi lumtah guobangin azusah dinga, tuakhu a haitan uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa khu thudih ahiziehin, aman dihtatna a it a, midihtatten a mel amu ding hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa hing panpi in, aziehpen Pasian ngaisah mi a um nawn sih hi; mihing tate lah a kipat miginumte amangta uhi.","title":"Mangpa thu siengthoute Lapu lien a ding: Pehging gui giet nei a sah ding. David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Michin in a innvengte kungah thumanlou agen ua, maitangphat leh lungsim thuoni neiin thu agen uhi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa’n maitangphatna kam zousie a atkhe dinga, kisatheitah a thu lienpipi gen leite toh."},"4":{"text":"Amaun ilei in iguolzou ding ua, “I kamte uh eima a ahi, i tung ua houtu koi ahiei um?” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"“Mi zawng gentheite kibawlsietna zieh leh tasamte thumna ziehin,” Mangpa’n tuin ka dingdoh dinga nuisantup akipat in, “Ama bittah in ka umsah ding,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa thute khu thu siengthou ahia; leitunga dangka haltuina mei a sagi vei, kisusiengthousa bang ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma’n amauh na keem dinga, Aw Mangpa tam khang thate lah a pat in, kumtawnin amauh na humbit ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihingte lah a khelna pahtawi a aum chiengin, ning chin ah migiloute avah viel viel uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa bangtanvei ahiei? Kei na hing manghil dending? Bangtanvei kei akipat na mai phuol ding na hiei?","title":"Lungkhamna zieh a thumna Lapulien a ding: David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Bangtan vei ahiei nisim a, ka hinna lungkham a akingaituo ding? Bangtan vei ahiei ka galte, ka tunga pahtawi a um ding?"},"3":{"text":"Mangpa ka Pasian aw, ngaituo inlen hing dawngin; Ka mitte hing vahsah in; tuachilou in shina imutna in ka imu kha ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh ka melma in, “Ama ka zouta” achi kha ding a; tualeh ka chitut zieh in, kei hing douten nuom asa kha ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh kei vangin na khotuona, ka muong ta a, na hundamna ah ka lungsim akipah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka tunga silhoi a bawltah ziehin, Mangpa pahtawi in la kasa ding hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mimaw in alungtang in “Pasian a um sih” achi a, amaute atawnkhiel siengta ua, sil kidahhuoite abawl ua, silhoi bawl mawngmawng a um sih uhi.","title":"Pasian theiloute umdan Lapulien a ding: David phatna la","ref":"Rom. 3.10-12"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n van a kipat in mihing tate a ensuh a; a theisiem leh Pasian sui mi mawngmawng, a um uoi mah chi’n a ensuh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahilou lam ah alam piel siengta ua, abawn un akise gawp zouta ua, sil kidahhuoi abawl ua silhoi bawl mawngmawng a um sih ua, khat beh zong a um sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Silgilou bawl zousiein, theina neilou ahi uoi mah? Tanghou neh banga ka mite ne ten, Mangpa a sui talawm sih uh amah?"},"5":{"text":"Pasian khu midihtat hah lesuonte lah a um ahizieh in; amaute zauin a um uhi."},"6":{"text":"Migenthei te lemguotna na selphou ua; hinanleh Mangpa khu a kihumbitna uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Zion akipat in Israel hundamna hing tung maileh Aw! Mangpa’n amite sal a ataan uhanuapui kia chiengin, tuahun chiengin Jakob a nuomta dinga, Israel akipah ta ding hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa Aw, Koi ahiei na biehbuh inn a umden thei ding? Na muol siengthou a koi ahiei teng thei ding?","title":"Pasian ngaisahte umdan David phatna la"},"2":{"text":"Dihtah a gamta mi leh sildih bawl mi; tualeh alungtanga a thutah gen mi;"},"3":{"text":"a lei a mi gense ngailou mi; a innveng tunga silgilou bawl ngailou leh, akhanguolte minsietna ding bawl ngailou mi."},"4":{"text":"Amit ua migiloute muda a, hinanleh Mangpa zau mite pahtawi a, ama thuohna ding nangawn a, athuchiema zuoutat ngailou mi."},"5":{"text":"Sumpung del a, sum pahah ngailou mi, mawna neilou, mawpai ding a sum negulou mi. Tambanga gamta mi khu, bangchih tan in suhling in aum sih ding hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian Aw, Nangma muongin ka hing bel hi, hing humbit in.","title":"Ama muongte dinga tangtawn hinna David: Miktam"},"2":{"text":"Aw ka hinna Mangpa kungah, “Nang ka Mangpa na hi a, nangma kung chilou ah ka hoina bangma ahisih hi;"},"3":{"text":"Leitunga misiengthou umte pen mi hoipente, ka kipahnate umnate ahi uh ka chita hi."},"4":{"text":"Koizong pasien dang tel mite, alungkhamna uh a pung ding a, a sisan dawn kithoinate uh ken ka laan sih ding, ahisihleh ka kam in amin uh ka lou malmal sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa khu ka goutan leh ka haitan ahi a, nangman ka tanvou nang suhdet pieh zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Gamgi khaute khu kei a dingin, mun nuomtah ah aketa a, goutan hoitah ka luota hi."},"7":{"text":"Lemguotna hing pepa, Mangpa ka phat dinga, ka lungtang in zong zanlai chiengin, ahing thuhil zel hi."},"8":{"text":"Bangchihlai pouin Mangpa khu, ka masangah ka umsah ngitnget a, Ama ka ziet lam a a um ziehin ka kilohsih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka lungtang akipah a, ka hinna in nuom asa hi; Ka tahsa zong lungmuongtah in akhawldam hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen, ka hinna hankhuh ah na nuasie sih ding a, na mi siengthou zong Mishikhuo mu dingin, na phal sih ding hi.","ref":"Nasep. 13.35"},"11":{"text":"Nangman hinna lampite na hing musah ding a, Na umna mun ah kipahna bukim a um a, Na ziet lam ah kumtawn nopna a um hi.","ref":"Nasep. 2.25-28"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, ka dihna thu za inlen, ka kikou aw hing ngaikhiet pieh in, zuouthu genhat kam a pawt hilou, ka thungetna lamah na bil hing dawin.","title":"Ahalim nuoi kibuhna David thumna"},"2":{"text":"Ka thupuasahte khu nangma masang apat a pawt hihenlen; na mit in sildih mu hen."},"3":{"text":"Nangma’n ka lungtang na enchienta a, zanlai chiengin na hing ve a, na hing chienta a bangma na mu sih hi, ka kam in agenkhiel sih ding; ka chi chinten hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihingte nasepna thu ah pen, na kam a thupawt ziehin susemi, lampi apat in ka kihemkheta hi."},"5":{"text":"Na lampi ah dettah in kal kasuonta a, ka kengte akitaal sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Aw Pasian, nangman hing dawng ding na hiziehin, nang ka hing han hi; na bil hing daw inlen ka thugen ngaikhie in."},"7":{"text":"Nangma a aginna uh koi poumate, amauh doute akipat a na khut ziet lam a hundampa aw, na khotuona lamdang kilangsah in."},"8":{"text":"Na mit laidum bangin hing keem inlen, na halim nuoi ah hing sel in."},"9":{"text":"Kei hing nuoisie migiloute leh, ka shi theina melma hing imkimkotte, lah akipat in hing sel in."},"10":{"text":"Amaun alungtang uh hepina nei lou in akhachip ua, akam un kisahtheitahin thu agen uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuin ka kalsuonna pou uah, ahing imkuol ua tuoltang satna dingin, ahing mittuh uhi."},"12":{"text":"Asamat bottel ding kilawp humpibahnei bang leh, samat ding buhdap humpibahnei lunlai bang ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aw Mangpa thou inlen, amaute kimaituopi inlen, tuol ah paikhie inlen, Ka hinna khu migiloute akipat in, na namsau in hunkhie in."},"14":{"text":"Aw Mangpa mihingte lah a kipat in, na khut in hing hunkhie in. Amaute pen leitung mihing ahi ua, leitung damlai hinkhuo, atanvou uh ahibou hi. Amaute dinga na kholpieh ann in agil uh va sah inlen; atate un neh ding kichingtah nei uhenlen, ata neute ua dingin, anei vaalte uh nuasie pieh uhen."},"15":{"text":"Ken vang dihtatnain na mel ka mu dinga, nangma batna nei a ka khahlaw chiengin, ka lungkim ta ding hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka hatna Mangpa aw, Nang ka hing it ding hi.","title":"Lapulien kunga Mangpa suohpa David in agalte leh Saul khut apata Mangpa’n ahuhdoh ni a Mangpa aphatna la"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa khu ka suongpi, ka kulpi leh kei hing hunkhepa ahi. Ka Pasian ka kibutna suongpi ahi a, Ama ah ka ginna ka koi ding hi, ama ka lum leh phaw, ka hundamna kii leh ka kulpi ahi."},"3":{"text":"Phattaah Mangpa ka han ding a, tuachi’n ka galte lah a kipat in, hundam in ka um ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Shina khauhuolten ahing viel a, Pasian ngaisahlouna tuilien in ahing zausah hi."},"5":{"text":"Mishikhuo khauhuolten ahing viel a shina thangte ka kimvel ah a um hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka chimaw lungkham chiengin, Mangpa ka han a ka Pasian kungah, panpina ngen in ka kikou a; Aman a biehinn apat in ka aw aza a, ka kikou husa ama bil ah atungtouta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n leitung akiling a, akiloh hi, Ama alungthah zieh in taangte kingahnate, akinuh a akithing hi."},"8":{"text":"Anakawhawm akipat in meikhu apawtdoh a, Akamsunga kipat in katum thei meikuong apawtdoh a; tuana kipat in mei-amte akuongdoh hi."},"9":{"text":"Aman vante aluoi kun a, ahing kumsuh hi; mielna khu akeeng nuoi ah a um hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama Cherub tunga tuongin aleeng hi; Ama khu huipi hate tunga tuongin hat tahin aleeng hi."},"11":{"text":"A ki khuna dingin akimkot ah khomiel abawl a; atunga khusuh dingin guo puo van meivomte abawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Amasanga vahna ziehin meipi satah athenga, gieltangte leh mei-amte ake lemlum hi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa khu van ah vanging bangin aginga, Tungnung pen in a aw asuohsah a, gieltang leh mei-amte akie hi."},"14":{"text":"Aman athaltangte akapkhie a; amaute athe zah hi. Tualeh tunphe aphesah a, amaute asubuoi veng vung hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n aw Mangpa lungthah a na vauna leh, na nakawhawma hu pawt in asem zieh in, tui luonnate ahing kilanga, leitung kingapnate muthei in ahing umta hi."},"16":{"text":"Aman tunglam apat in ahing sawhsuh a, ahing tu a, tui tampi akipat in ahing kaidoh hi."},"17":{"text":"Aman ahat mama ka galte leh, kei hing muda ka melmate lah a kipat in, ahing hunkheta hi, amaute kei a dingin ahat mama uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute’n ka vangsiet ni in ahing dou uh a; hinanleh Mangpa khu kei hing panpi pa ahi."},"19":{"text":"Aman mun awngthawl ah ahing pui a, ka tunga akipah ziehin ahing hunkheta hi."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa’n ka dihtatna dungzui in, nuomman ahing peta hi; Ka khutte asienthou dungzui in ahing din kiata hi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa lampite ka zui a, ka Pasian a kipat in giloutahin, ka lampiel ngai sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Adan thupiehte zousie ka masangah a um a, tualeh athupiehte keima akipat in, ka koimang ngai sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Amasangah genbanglou in ka um a, gitlouna apat in keima ka kihemkhe zel hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n ka dihtatna dungzui leh, amitmu a ka khutte sienthouna dungzui in, ahing din kiata hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi khotuosiemte kungah, khotuosiemin na kilang ding a, genbangloute kungah, genbangloua kilang ding na hi hi."},"26":{"text":"Mi siengthoute kungah, siengthou in na kilang ding a, genhate kungah, genhatah in na kilang ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen Nang mi kingaingiemte na hundam a, amit ha ua kisatheite na sungiem zel hi."},"28":{"text":"Nangma’n ka thaumei na hing detpieh ding a, Mangpa ka Pasian in, ka mielna ahing suhvah pieh ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Nangma panpina zieh in, galkap honte ka nuoigawp zoua, tualeh ka Pasian panpina zal in, kulpi bang nangawn ka tawmkan zou hi."},"30":{"text":"Pasian lampi ahoibukim a, Mangpa thu etchien ahi a, Ama muong a belte zousie adingin, Ama khu lumlephaw ahi."},"31":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa chilou Pasian koi a um ei? Eite Pasian loungal suongpi koi ahiei?"},"32":{"text":"Thahatna toh hing thuom a, ka lampite hoibukimsahpa khu ka Pasian ahi."},"33":{"text":"Aman ka kengte sazuhpi keng bangin abawl a, ka munsangtungte ah bittah in ahing umsah hi.","ref":"Haba. 3.19"},"34":{"text":"Aman ka khutte galdou dan ding a zilsah a, tuachi’n ka khutten sum-eng thalpi aluoi zou hi."},"35":{"text":"Nangma’n na hundamna phaw na hing peta a, tualeh na zietlam khutin na hing tu a, na nunnemnain kei ahing thupi sah hi."},"36":{"text":"Ka nuoi ah ka kalsuonte na liensahta a, tuachi’n ka kengte ateu sih hi."},"37":{"text":"Ka galte ka nuadel a, ka nua phah hi; thagam a a um masangsie un ka kinuale sih hi."},"38":{"text":"Amaute thoukia nawnlou dingin ka satpua a; ka keng nuoi ah apua uhi."},"39":{"text":"Aziehpen Nangma’n kidouna thahatna toh, kei na hing thuom a, kei hing doute ka nuoi ah na kun sahta hi."},"40":{"text":"Ka galte kei hing nua ngat in, na nuatai sah a tualeh kei hing mudate, ka mangthaisahta hi."},"41":{"text":"Amaute akikou ua, hinanleh amauh hundam ding koima a um sih hi. Mangpa kungah akikou ua, hinanleh Mangpa’n amaute adawng tuon sih hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuatahin hui in leivui amutleeng bangin, ken amaute ka satguoi a, gawlzing buonnawi bangin, ka paimang ta hi."},"43":{"text":"Nangma’n helna bawl mite lah a kipat in, na hing hundoh a, namte lutangin na hing pangsahta a; ka thei ngailou mite ka nasem in apangta uhi."},"44":{"text":"Ka tanchin atheitah chiengun, ka thu amang pai ngal ua, gamdang mite ka kungah ahing kitulut uhi."},"45":{"text":"Gamdang mite alung kie ua; akibutnate ua kipat in, zau kawm in ahing pawtdoh uhi."},"46":{"text":"Mangpa ahing hi; ka suongpi phat in um hen; tualeh ka hundamna Pasian pahtawi in um hen."},"47":{"text":"Phuba hing lahpiehpa leh, namte hing zousah a ka nuoi a, hing koi piehpa Pasian ahi."},"48":{"text":"Aman ka melmate lah a kipat ang hunkhie a; ahi, ahing doute tunglam ah na hing domsanga, mi gumtatte lah akipat in na hing hundoh hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuaziehin, Aw Mangpa, namte lah ah, na min phat in la kasa ding hi.","ref":"Rom. 15.9"},"50":{"text":"Aman aleengpa kungah guolzawna thupitah apie a; Asathau nu David leh ahah asuonte tungah, a itna tulngailou alangsahta hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vante’n Pasian thupina aphuong ua, huikhuo in akhut nasep asulang hi.","title":"Pasian nasepna leh athupina Lapulien ading: David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Sunin sun kungah thu agen a, Zan in zan kungah theina a sulang zel hi."},"3":{"text":"Thugen a um sih a, ham lah a um sih a, a aw uh bil a zah a hi sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuabang hinapi in, a aw uh leitung pumpi ah akiza a, athu uh khovel kawlmong dongin akiza hi; Tuate lah ah, aman ni a dingin puon inn abawl pieh hi.","ref":"Rom. 10.18"},"5":{"text":"Tua ni khu mouneipa adantan a kipat a hing pawtdoh bang ahi a, mihat kitaidemna taiding bangin nuom asa hi."},"6":{"text":"Van mong langkhat akipat in ahing suoh a, Van mong langkhat zuon in apeikuol a, asatna akipat bangma a kiphuol thei sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa dan khu ahoibukim a hinna abawlhoi hi; Mangpa thuhilna khu amuonhuoi a, mimawl apil sah hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa thuguotte adih a, lungsim a nuomsah hi. Mangpa thupieh asiengthou a, mit avahsah hi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa zaudansiemna khu asiengthou a, kumtawn in a umden hi. Mangpa danthupiehte adih a, adihtat kimvel hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuate khu sana sangin adeihuoi zaw a, ahi, sana sieng set sangin zong adeihuoi zaw hi. Khuoizu sangin ahum zaw a, Ahi, khuoi khaah a khuoizu luong khie sangin ahumzaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuathamlouin, tuate zieh in, na suohpa vauhil in ka um a; tuate zui khu nuomman thupitah muna ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh koi ahiei ama dihlouna theisiem thei ding? Dihlouna kiphuolte lah apat hing siengsah in."},"13":{"text":"Sil bawlkhiel teitei lou dingin na suohpa hing veng inlen, ka tungah khelna in thu neisah sin. Tuachi’n, tatkhielna thupitah apat genbanglou leh, mawna neilou in ka um ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka suongpi leh ka hundampa, ka kam a thupawtte leh, ka lungtanga ka ngaituonate khu, na mitmu ah pomtah hi hen."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungkham Mangbat ni in, Mangpa’n hing dawng henlen, Jakob Pasian min in hing veng hen.","title":"Sakol leh kangtalaite sanga Pasian muonna Lapulien a ding: David phatnala."},"2":{"text":"Aman a mun siengthou a kipat in, panpina hing sawl henlen, Zion a kipat in hing suhatta hen."},"3":{"text":"Aman na sillat zousie thei ngitnget henlen, na halmang kithoinate hing sanpiehta hen."},"4":{"text":"Na lungsim a na lunggulte hing pie henlen, na siltupte hing tangtung sahta hen."},"5":{"text":"Na hundamna ah nuom in ka kikou ding ua, tualeh ka Pasian uh min in ka puonlapte uh ka zah ding uhi. Mangpa’n na ngetna zousie hing lawchingsah hen."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n asathau nupa ahundam chi tuin ka theita hi; akhut zietlam hundamna thahat in avan siengthou a kipat in, ama ahing dawng ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Khenkhat in sakollengte amuong ua, pawl khat in sakolte amuong uhi; hinanleh eite vangin, Mangpa i Pasian min i muong zaw ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute kaikun in a um ua, apuata uhi hinanleh eite pen ithou ua, idingtang zawta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa Aw leengpa galzawna pie inlen, kang hat chiengun hing dawngin."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na thahatna sungah, leengpa a nuom ding a, na hundamna ah nuomsana va-ia inchie!","title":"Pasian in leengpa aguolzawlna Lapulien ading: David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Alungtang deilam nang na pie a, akam a angette na it sih hi. Selah."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen hoina guolzawlna toh ama nana lamdawt a, alutungah sana lukhu siengset na khusah hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman na kung ah hinna ahing ngen a, ama na peta hi; kumtawm kumtawn a damna toh."},"5":{"text":"Na hundamna ah athupina alien hi, pahtawina leh thupina ama tungah na ngata hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma’n kumtawn a thupha lienpen nga ding in, ama na bawl a, na umpina lungdamna toh ama nasatahin na kipahsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen leengpa’n Mangpa amuonga, tualeh Tungnung pen khotuona zieh in akiling sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Na khutin na melmate zousie a suidoh dinga, na khut zietlam in nangma hing mudate amudoh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Na lungthah hun chiengin amaute, haltuina meikuong bangin na bawl dinga, Mangpa thangpainain amaute avaltum ding hi. Tualeh mei in amaute akatum ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma’n atate uh leitunga kipat na phietmang ding a, tualeh ahah asuonte uh, mihing tate lah akipat na sumang nalai ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Na tungah silgilou bawl atum ua, sietna adap ngaituo uhi, tua lah asutangtung thei sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin nangma’n amauh na kinua hei sah dinga, thalpi gui a na thaltang te na thuozou diem chiengin, amaitanguh na ngim ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa aw, na hatnate ziehin pahtawi in um in; tuachi’n na silbawltheina phat in la kasa ding hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pasian, ka Pasian, bang dinga hing taisan na hiei? Bangdinga panpi ka ngetna leh ka thum, ka maunate a kipat a hichi talawm a hing gamlat na hiei?","title":"Hundampa thuohna Lapulien a ding: Zingmawng khovah kuon a sah ding: David phatna la.","ref":"Mat. 27.46; Mak. 15.34"},"2":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw sun in ka kikou a, hinanleh na hing dawng sih a, zan in ka kikou a, tawldamna ka mutuom sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh nangpen na siengthou a, Israelte pahtawina Mangtoupha tungah na tou hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka pule pate un nang ahing muong ua, tuachi’n nang na hunkhe zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang ahing han ua, tuachi’n humbit in a um zel uhi; ahing muong ua, tuachi’n zalatsah in a um ngai sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Kei pen mihing mawngmawng ka hi sih a, tangtel giap ka hibou hi; mite gensiet leh simmaw ka hi."},"7":{"text":"A hing mu zousie in simmawin ahing nuisan ua, ahing ne phen ua alutang uh ahing thinkhum uhi.","ref":"Mat. 27.39; Mak. 15.29; Luk. 23.35"},"8":{"text":"“Mangpa muong hiven; Aman hunkhe leh asih diei! A tung a akipah mama ziehin hunkhe leh avele,” ahing chi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 27.43"},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh nangpen naubu a kipata a hing lakhepa na hi a, Ka nu angsunga nawitep a ka um lai in na hing gingtasah ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka nu naubu sung a kipat a nangma tunga kinga kana hita a, Nangpen Kanu gilsung a ka um lai in zong ka Pasian na hita hi."},"11":{"text":"Kei apat in gamla sin, aziehpen lungkham mangbatna anai a, ahing panpi ding a um sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Bawngtal tampi in ahing im kuol ua Bashan bawngtal hatten ahing imchip uhi."},"13":{"text":"Humpibahnei humham bangin, kei ahing kamkah khum uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tui banga sunbuoh in ka um a, ka gu ka taang zousie akilawi siengta hi; ka lungtang khuoinun bangin, ka sungah azun gawpta hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka hatna lah belphou bangin agawta a, ka lei zong ka dangtawng ah abehta a; shina leivui lah ah kei na hing lumsahta hi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen uiten ahing imkuol ua, migilou kikhawmten kei ahing im chimit ua, amaun ka khut leh ka kengte avut uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ka gu ka taangte zousie ka simthei a, amaun kei ahing du et uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ka puonsilte akihawm ua, ka puonahtuol a dingin ai asan uhi.","ref":"Mat. 27.35; Mak. 15.24; Luk. 23.34; Jn. 19.24"},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh, Aw Mangpa, nang kei hing gamlat sinlen, Aw nang ka hatna, panpi dingin hing kinaw in!"},"20":{"text":"Namsau akipat in ka hinna hundam inlen; ui silbawltheina lah a kipat, ka hinna manphatah hunkhie in."},"21":{"text":"Humpibahnei kamsung apat in kei hing hundoh inlen, gam bawngtal kiite lah akipat in, na hing hunkheta hi."},"22":{"text":"Ka unaute lah ah na min ka genzah dinga, mipi kikhawmte lah ah na min ka phat ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 2.12"},"23":{"text":"Nou Mangpa zau mite aw, Ama phat un, Jakob hahlesuonte aw Ama pahtawi un, Israel tate aw, Ama giing un."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman suhgenthei mite, gimthuohna asimmaw sih a, kidah zong akidah sih hi, tualeh amai alah uah aphuol sih a, hinanleh a hat chiengin a ngaikhe zaw hi."},"25":{"text":"Kikhopna thupitah ah, ka phatna khu nangma ah ahi ding a, Ama giing mite masangah ka thuchiem ka tangtun ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Mi zawngten ane ding ua, atai ding uhi; Ama sui miten Mangpa aphat ding uhi; Na lungtang uh kumtawn in ahing ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Kawlmong tan a miten athei ngitnget ding ua, Mangpa lam anga ding uhi, tualeh chichin namchin na mai ah akun ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen Lenggam khu Mangpa a ahi; Ama pen namchin tunga vaihawmpa ahi."},"29":{"text":"Leitunga mihausate zousie in ane ding ua, Ama bie in akun ding uh a, Leivui a peisuhte zousie amasang ah ahing kun ding ua; koiman ahinna ahundoh theisih ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Khang sawnten Ama nna asem ding ua, Khang sawnsawn dongin Mangpa thu akigen ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Pieng nailou, hing pieng dingte kungah, atatdohna nasep thute aphuongzah ding uhi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa khu kei hing chingpa ka belampu ahi a, ka tasam sih ding hi.","title":"Mangpa belampu ahina David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Aman lou dawn dipdepna munte ah. Kei ahing lumsah a tui vei sip dide gei ah, ahing pui zel hi.","ref":"Kihil. 7.17"},"3":{"text":"Aman ka hinna ahing bawlhoi pieh zela, Ama min zieh in dihtatna lampi ah ahing pui zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi, shina limguom tawn in pei nanleng; silgilou mawngmawng ka zau sih ding hi; Aziehpen nangman na hing umpi a, na khetbuh leh na chiengin ahing hamuon zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangman ahing doute mitmuin ka masangah, annkuong na lui a, ka lu sathau na nu a, ka nou adimlet hi."},"6":{"text":"Pellou in hoina leh zangaina in, ka damsung tengin ahing zui dinga, tualeh Mangpa inn ah kumtawn in ka tengdenta ding hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitung leh asunga um zousie Mangpa a ahi; Leitung leh asung tengte zousie toh.","title":"Thupina leengpa phatna David phatna la","ref":"1 Kor. 10.26"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen aman tua khu tuipi tungah amukhie a, tualeh luipite tungah asudet hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa muol ah koi ahiei kaltou ding? Ahisihleh amun siengthou ah koi ahiei ding ding?"},"4":{"text":"Khut sieng leh lungtang siengthou nei mi leh, dihlouna lam a ahinna koi ngailou a, zuouthu a kichiem ngailou mite ahi.","ref":"Mat. 5.8"},"5":{"text":"Amaun Mangpa akipat in guolzawlna amu ding ua, ahundamna Pasian akipat in dihtatna amu ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuakhu ama sui mi hahlesuon ahi, Jakob Pasian aw, na meel suite khu. Selah."},"7":{"text":"Kotpite aw na lutang uh dom sang un, Nou tangtawn kotkhate aw, na kikhai sang un; thupina leengpa ahing lut theina dingin."},"8":{"text":"Thupina leengpa khu koi ahiei? Mangpa hattah leh sil bawlthei; kidouna a silbawlthei Mangpa khu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Kotpite aw na lutang uh domsang unlen, Tangtawn kotkhate aw na kikhai sang un; thupina leengpa ahing lut theina dingin."},"10":{"text":"Thupina leengpa khu koi ahiei? Galkapte Mangpa, Ama ngel khu thupina leengpa ahi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na kungah ka hinna ka hing domsangtou hi.","title":"Panpina, puihuoina leh ngaidam ngetna David phatna la"},"2":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw, nangma ka hing muong hi, hing zalasah sinlen, ka galte ka tungah guolzousah sin."},"3":{"text":"Ahi, Nangma hing ngahte koima zala in umsah sinlen, aziehbei a giloute zalatah in um sah in."},"4":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na lampite hing theisah inlen; Na lampi zuidan hing hilin."},"5":{"text":"Na thutah ah hing pui inlen, hing sinsah in, aziehpen Nangma ka hundamna Pasian na hi a; sunnitum in ka hing ngah hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa aw na khotuona leh, na itna tullou thei ngitnget in, aziehpen tanglai a pat a na umsa mawng ahita uhi."},"7":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka khangdawnlai khelnate leh, bawsietnate thei ngitnget sinlen, Aw Mangpa na itna tultheilou leh, na hoina ziehin hing thei ngitngetin."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa khu ahoi leh adih a hi a, tuaziehin mi khielte lampi ahil hi."},"9":{"text":"Aman mi kingaingiemte vaihawmna ah apui ding a, mi kingaingiemte Aman alampi ahil hi."},"10":{"text":"A thuhun leh athutheipina zui poumate a dingin, Mangpa lampi zousie khu khotuona thudih leh ginumna ahi."},"11":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na min ziehin ka khelna ngaidam in; ka khelna alien sengta hi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa zaudansiem mi koi ahiei? Aman alampi tel ding ahil ding hi."},"13":{"text":"A hinna nuomsatahin a um ding a, ahah asuonte’n lei gou aluo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa thuguh khu ama giing mite kungah a um a; a thuhun khu amaute kungah atheisah hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka mitin Mangpa lam a en ngitnget a, aziehpen aman ka kengte len akipat in asutkhe ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Kei lam hing nga inlen hing khotuo in; aziehpen khattanga genthei thuoh a um ka hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka lungbuoinate ahing lien hi; ka gentheinate akipat hing lakhie in."},"18":{"text":"Ka gimthuohna leh ka nat nate en inlen, ka khelnate zousie hing ngaidam in."},"19":{"text":"Ka galte ngaituoin, aziehpen tampi ahi ua, tualeh huotna kheltah toh ahing muda uhi."},"20":{"text":"Aw ka hinna hing kep hoi pieh inlen, hing hunkhie in, zala in hing um sah sin; Nangma hing muong ka hi bou hi."},"21":{"text":"Lungsim dihna leh hoina in hing humbit hen, aziehpen Nangma ka hing ngah hi."},"22":{"text":"Pasian aw alungkhamna zousie akipat in, Israel hunkhie in."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, vai hing hawmpiehin, lungsim hoitah puoin ka um hi, k Mangpa ka muongta a, ka taalpua sih ding hi.","title":"Humbitna leh tatdohna ngetna David phatna la"},"2":{"text":"Aw Mangpa hing enchien inlen, hing endih in, ka lungtang leh ka lungsim Nang enkhie in."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen na itna tul ngailou ka masangah a um a; tualeh na thutah zui a um ngitnget ka hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi thulimloute toh ka toukhawm ngai sih a, mi lepchiete toh zong ka zawhkhawm sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Sil gilou bawlte kikhopna ka huo a, migiloute toh ka toukhawm sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa aw, mawnabei in ka khutte kasil ding a, tuachi’n na maitam kim ah ka vahkoi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Kipah thugenna toh aw ngaitah a ka phuon theina dingin; Na silbawl lamdangte ka genzah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa na umna inn leh na thupina umna mun ka it hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi khielte toh ka hinna la khawm sinlen, ka hinna zong sisan suohatte toh lakhawm sin."},"10":{"text":"Tuabang mite khut ah silgilou bawltupna a um a; azietlam khutte u’zong golguhna in a dim hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh kei pen genbanglou, lungsim hoitah puoin ka um ding hi; hing tandoh inlen hing khotuo in."},"12":{"text":"Lei kituohna mun ah ka keng a ding a, mipi kikhawmte lah ah Mangpa ka phat ding hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa khu ka meivah leh ka hundamna ahi a, koi ka giing diei? Mangpa khu ka hinna kulpi ahi a, koi ahiei ka zau ding?","title":"Zaulou a Pasian muonna David phatna la"},"2":{"text":"Migilouten ka sa ne ding a ahing sui chiengun, ka galte leh kamelmaten ahing dou chiengun, akisui ua apua uhi."},"3":{"text":"Galkap honten hing dou ding in giehphuol satnan u’leh, ka lungtang azau sih ding a, ka tungah kidouna hing tung nanleh, ka kimuong nalai ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa apat ka dei sil khat ka ngen a, tuakhu ka sui ding hi; Mangpa kilawmna mu ding leh, Abieh inn sunga thukan ding leh, Ka damsung teng Mangpa inn a, ka um ngitnget theina dingin."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen mangbat ni chiengin abuhneu ah, kei ahing phuol ding a, akihumbitna biehbuh sungah kei ahing sel ding a; suongpi sang tungah kei ahing koi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin ka kimvel a hing dou ka melmate, tunglam ah ka lu dop sangin a um ding hi; tuaziehin ken abieh inn sungah, lungnopna kikouna aw toh kithoina ka landinga, ginglawm toh Mangpa phatna la kasa ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, ngaitah a ka kikou chiengin, hing ngaikhie inlen, hing khotuo inlen, hing dawng in."},"8":{"text":"“Nang ka meel sui un” na chi chiengin, ka lungtangin Aw Mangpa, “Na meel ka suiding hi” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Kei akipat in na mai phuol sinlen, na suohpa na lungthah man in kiheisan sin, nangpen kei hing panpipa nahi. Ka hundampa Pasian aw hing nuasie sinlen, hing taisan sin."},"10":{"text":"Ka nu leh ka pa’n ahingtaisan chiengun, Mangpa’n kei ahing keem ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na lampi hing hil inlen, Ka galte ziehin lamphei ah hing pui in."},"12":{"text":"Ka galte deina bangin akhut uah hing pekhe sin; aziehpen theipitu dihloute ahing kipan ua, ka tunga tatsietna sekhe gigeten ahingdou uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mihing gam ah Mangpa hoina mu ding, kigingtalou hileng ka lungke gawpta ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa ngah inlen hangsantahin um in; Tuachi’n Aman na lungtang ahatsah ding hi. Kachi ahi Mangpa ngah in."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa, ka suongpi aw, Nang ka hing han ding hi; hing dawng louin hing sipsan sin, aziehpen na sip dide leh, hankhuh a peisuhte bang ka hi ding hi.","title":"Thungetnate dawnna David phatna la"},"2":{"text":"Nang ka hing hat a na mun siengthou lam nga a, ka khut ka zah chiengin, ka ngetna aw te hing ngaikhieh pieh in."},"3":{"text":"Migiloute leh silgilou bawlmite toh, hing puimang khawm sin; Amaun a innvengte u’kungah kilemna thu agen ua, hinanleh alungtang uah gitlouna aum hi."},"4":{"text":"Asilbawlte uh dungzui leh, asilbawl giloute uh dungzui in, nangman thuh inlen, akhut nasepte uh thuh in; Agitlouna u’toh kikhom aman pie in.","ref":"Kihil. 22.12"},"5":{"text":"Mangpa nasepte leh akhut silbawlte, bangma a angailou ziehun, amaute aphelzah dinga alamtha kia nawn sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa phat in um hen, aziehpen aman ka ngetna aw te angaikheta hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa khu ka hatna leh ka phaw ahi; ka lungtangin ama amuonga tuachi’n panpi in ka um hi. Tuaziehin ka lungtang in nuom asa mama a, tualeh ka lain ama ka phat ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa khu amite a dingin ahatna uh ahi a, asathau nupa a dingin hundamna kulpi ahi."},"9":{"text":"Na mite hundam inlen, na goutante guolzawl in; amauh ching inlen, kumtawn in amauh pom in."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nou mi silbawltheitahte aw, Mangpa kungah pie unlen, Mangpa kungah thupina leh thahatna pie un.","title":"Pasian silbawltheina hatdan David phatna la.","ref":"Late. 96.7-9"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa kungah amin thupina pie unlen, siengthou kilawmna toh kivon in Mangpa bie un."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa aw khu tuite tungah a um a, thupina Pasian khu vanpi ging bangin, tuipi tampite tungah a um hi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa aw khu silbawltheitah ahi a, Mangpa aw khu thupina a dim ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa aw in sidar singkungte a sutan a, Ahi Mangpa’n Lebanon sidar singte atawng sah hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman Lebanon bawngnou bangin akidieng sah a, Lebanon leh Sirion zong gam bawngtal bangin, akitawm sah hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa aw in meikuongte akhenzah zel hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa aw in gamdaite akiling sah a, Mangpa’n Kadesh gamdai te asuling hi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa, aw in sazuhpite nou atolsah a, gammang sing nate amutpul sienga akieusah hi. Tualeh abieh inn ah michin in a “Thupina” agen chiet uhi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa khu tuisanglet tung a aleengtoupha ah atou a, Ahi, Mangpa khu kumtawn a dingin leeng in atou hi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa’n amite kungah hatna ape ding a, Mangpa’n hamuonnain amite aguolzawl ding hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangma ka hing pahtawi ding hi; aziehpen nangman na hing phong ding a, tualeh ka galte ka tungah nuomsain na koi sih ding hi.","title":"Hundohna zieh a David phatnala Biehinn latna la"},"2":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka Pasian, hing panpi dingin nangma ka hing han a, tuachi’n na hing sudamta hi."},"3":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangman ka hinna, Sheol akipat in na lakhie a, kokhuh sunga lutte lah a kipat in, keima nang hingsah kiata hi."},"4":{"text":"Aw nou a misiengthoute, Mangpa phat in lasa unlen, tualeh amin siengthou theizingna ah kipah thu gen un."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen alungthahna khu mitphietkaal bep ahi a, adeisahna ah hinna aum hi, kaana pen zankaal khat aum thei a, hinanleh kipah na khu zingmawng chiengin ahing tung zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka nopsah lai in keima “Suhling in, ka um ngaisih ding” ka na chi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa nang deisahna ziehin, ka taang na dingdetsah ta a, hinanleh na mai na phuol a, lungdongin ka umta hi."},"8":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangma ka hing han hi, tualeh Mangpa kungah panpina ka ngen hi."},"9":{"text":"“Hankhuh a ka peisuh chiengin ka sisan ah, bang phattuomna a um diei? Leivui in nang ang phat diei mah? Na thutah zong aphuongzah ngel diei?"},"10":{"text":"Aw Mangpa hing ngaikhie inlen, hing khotuo in, Aw Mangpa kei hing panpi pa hi in."},"11":{"text":"Nangman ka kaanate lamna na suoh sah a, Ka sai ip puonte na hing sutpieh a, lungnopna puon na hing sil sahta hi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka hinna in siplou a, nangma ahing phat thei na ding in; Aw Mangpa ka Pasian, na kungah kipahthu kumtawn in kagen ding hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangma ah ka muonna ka koi hi, kei hing zalasah ngai sin len, na dihtatna in hing tandoh in.","title":"Lunggim chieng a Pasian muonna Lapulien a ding: David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Kei langah na bil hingdaw inlen, manlangin hing hundoh in. Ka kibutna suongpi hi inlen, ka hundamna kulpi muonhuoi hing hiin."},"3":{"text":"Ahi, Nangma ka suongpi leh ka kulpi na hi; na min ziehin hing makai inlen hing pui in."},"4":{"text":"Ka awhna dinga aguh a apha uh lenthang lah apat; hing kaidoh in nang ka hatna na hi."},"5":{"text":"Na khut sungah ka hagau ka hing keem sah hi; Aw mangpa thutah Pasian, nangman na hing tandohta hi.","ref":"Luk. 23.46"},"6":{"text":"Mannabei milim thupi ngaite ka huo a, hinanleh ken vang Mangpa ka muong hi."},"7":{"text":"Na khotuona ah kipah leh nuom in ka um ding hi, aziehpen nangman ka mangbatna na ngaituo a, ka hinna lunggim a aum laiin zong, na thei ngitnget hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh ka galte khut sungah, na hing pekhe sih a, ka kengte mun awngthawl ah, na ding sah zawta hi."},"9":{"text":"Aw mangpa, ka tungah zangai in, ka lung adong hi; Lunggim na ziehin ka mitte a miel gawpta a; Ahi, ka hinna leh ka tahsa pumpi aba gawpta hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen ka damsung lunggimna in kamang zouta a, tualeh ka kumte khu thumlemauna in abeita hi; ka thulimlouna ziehin ka hatna aba a, ka gute a zawngkhalta hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahing doute zousie lah ah, adieh in ka innvengte lah ah, Ka meltheite adingin mizauhuoi ka suohta a, kholai a hing mute kei akipat akihemkhie uhi."},"12":{"text":"Mishi kimanghil bang in manghil in ka umta a, leibel keh bang ka hita hi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen mi tampite hing hehna ka za a, ka kimvel zauna in adim hi; hing tha ding thu akikup khawm lai un, ka hinna hing lah pieh atum uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh “Aw Mangpa nangma ka hing muong hi,” nang ka Pasian nahi, ka hing chi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka hunte na khut sungah aum hi; ka galte leh ahing bawlgentheite, khut apat in hing hunkhie in."},"16":{"text":"Na mel vah na suoh tungah taangsah inlen; na khotuona zieh in hing hundam in."},"17":{"text":"Aw Mangpa hing zalasah vawt sin, aziehpen nangma ka hing han ahi, Migiloute muolphou uhenlen, hankhuh sungah dai dide in um uheh."},"18":{"text":"Zuou genna kamte khu ham theilou in um uheh, kisathei leh simmaw kawm in, midihtatte douna thu agen leng uhi."},"19":{"text":"Aw na hoina khu kiningching hina va-ia e, Nangma hing zaute a dingin na kholkhawm a, mizousie mitmu a, Nangma hing muongte dinga na bawlpieh khu."},"20":{"text":"Nang amauh mihingten aphielguh tupna ua pat, na mitmu a humbitnain na phuol gu dinga, lei selhatte akipat amauh na buhneu ah na koidap ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mangpa phat in um hen, aziehpen ahepina lamdangtah khu, khopi dettah ah ahing musahta hi."},"22":{"text":"Patau in, “Na mitmu apat paimang in ka umta kana chita a,” Ahivang in panpina ngen a, Nangma han a ka kikouna aw te nana za leng hi."},"23":{"text":"Aw nou a misiengthoute zousie in, Mangpa it un; Mangpa’n mi ginumte akembit a, hinanleh kisatheitah a gamtate pen, buching tahin athuh kia hi."},"24":{"text":"Mangpa a kinem zousiete aw, Hangsan tahin um unlen, na lungtang uh ahing hatsah ding hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A tawnkhielna ngaidam a um a, a khelna liekhu a um mi ahampha hi.","title":"Ngaidamna hamphat huoina David phatna la: Maskil.","ref":"Rom. 4.7,8"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n gitlouna nei a aselou mi leh, alungsim a zehemna umlou mi khu ahampha hi."},"3":{"text":"Hamlou kei a ka um lai in, sunnituma ka maunate zieh in, ka gu katang zousie angawn suoh siengta hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen sun leh zan in, ka tungah na khut agih mama hi; Ka thahatna zong nipilai nisa kahgaw bangin agaw gawpta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka khelna, na kungah ka hing theisah a, ka gitlouna na kungah ka im nawn sih hi. “Ka tatkhelnate Mangpa kungah gendoh vang ka chi a,” tuachi’n nangman ka khel na thulim lounate na hing ngaidamta hi. Selah."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian ngaisah mi zousiein, mu bailam a na um lai in nangma kungah thungen uhen; Lunggimna tuipi ahing leet chiengin, amaute abanpha sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma ka kibutna mun na hi a, lungkham buoina apat na hing humbit ding a; Na tatdohna late in na hing imkhum ding hi. Selah."},"8":{"text":"Na peina ding lampi ka hing hil ding a, ka hing zilsah dinga, ka mit a, en kawm in ka hing thuhil ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Theisiemna neilou sakol ahiei, ahisihleh sabiltung ahiei, bangin um sih un, amau’te pen kamkaina khau leh siabat atudet angai hi; tuachilou in ahing nai ngai sih ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Migiloute a dingin gentheina atam a, hinanleh Mangpa muongte pen khotuonain a im kuol ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Nou midihtatte aw, Mangpa ah kipah unlen, nuom un, tualeh Nou lungtang dihtah pozousiete aw; Nuom in kikou un."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nou mi dihtatte aw, Mangpa ah nuom un, midihtatte adingin Pasian phat akilawm mawng ahi.","title":"Sil bangkim siempa phatnala"},"2":{"text":"Kaigingin Mangpa phat unlen, pehging gui sawm nei in ama phat in lasa un."},"3":{"text":"Ama pahtawi in la tha sa unlen, husa thupi toh siemtahin tum un."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa thu adih a, anasep zousie muonhuoi tah a bawl ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aman dihtatna leh vaihawmna dih a it a, leitung Mangpa hoi nain adim hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa thu in vante siem ahi a, van a umte zousie zong a kama hu pawt a siem ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Aman tuipi tuite bangkhat koikhawm bangin akoi khawm a, tuipi thuhpi tuite koikhawmna inn ah akoikhawm hi."},"8":{"text":"Leitung pumpi in Mangpa giing henlen, khovel a tengte zousie ama zau in chiza uhen."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen aman thu agen a, ahing umta mai hi aman thu apie a, tuachi’n ahing um detta hi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa’n namte lemguotna khu, bangmalou asuoh sah a, mite siltupte khu phattuomna neilou in abawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa lemguotna khu kumtawn in ading den hi; alungsim ngaituonate zong akhang akhangin, a um den ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa a Pasian ua nei nam ahampha uh, aman a gouluo dinga atel nam khu nam hampha ahi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa’n van a kipat in a en suh a, mihing tate zousie amu suoh hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa’n atouna mangtoupha apat in, leitunga tengte zousie a en ngitnget hi."},"15":{"text":"Aman amaute zousie lungtangte abawlhoi pieh a, asilbawl zousie uh a ngaituo ngitnget hi."},"16":{"text":"Lengpa koima galkapte tam ziehin, humbitin a um ngai sih a, mihat zong athahatna ziehin hunkhieh ahi sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Bitna dingin sakolte zong bangma aphatuom sih a; ahatna thupitah ziehin koima ahunkhe tuom sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ngaivawi, Mangpa mit khu ama giingte tungah atu a, A khotuona kinemte tungah atu hi;"},"19":{"text":"Ahinna uh shina akipat a hunkhe ding leh, kiel hun chienga amauh hingsah dingin."},"20":{"text":"Ka hinna un Mangpa angah ngitnget a, Ama khu ahing panpipa leh iphaw uh ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ama ah ka lungtang uh anuom dinga, Amin siengthou ka muon zieh un."},"22":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na khotuona ka kinep na bang ngei un, ka tung uah hing umta hen."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bangchihlai pouin Mangpa ka phat dinga, aphatna ka kam sungah a um den ding hi.","title":"Mangpa’n amite ahunkhie Abimelek masanga aki motsah a, aman adeldoh a peisan lai a. David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Ka hinna in Mangpa asuong dinga, mi kingaingiemten tami aza ding ua, akipah ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Oh! Mangpa hing pahtawipi unlen, amin itawisang khawm ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa ka han a, tuachi’n aman ahing dawng hi; ka zauna zousie akipat ahing hunkheta hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama en un na mai uh ahing taang ding a, tuachi’n na mai zum ngai sih ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tam mi genthei a kikou a, Mangpa’n azata hi; alungkhamna zousie apat in ahundamta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama zau mite pen akimvel uah Vansawlsiengten, giehphuol bawl in a imkuol ua, amaute ahunkhie uhi."},"8":{"text":"Oh! Mangpa hoidan chiem unlen, en mawng vawi un; Ama muong miten nuom asa uhi.","ref":"1 Pet. 2.3"},"9":{"text":"Nou amisiengthoute aw, Mangpa giing un, Ama giing mite atasam ngai sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Humpibahnei lunlaite atasam ua a gilkiel zel uhi, Hinanleh Mangpa sui miten vang, silhoi mawngmawng atasam sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ka tate aw! hing pei unlen, ka thu ngaikhie un, Mangpa giing dan kang hil ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na lah uah hinna it a, damsung ni hoi tampi mu ding lunggul mi koi ahiei?","ref":"1 Pet. 3.10-12"},"13":{"text":"Gilou lah ah na lei veng hoi inlen, zuou genna akipat na kam veng hoiin,"},"14":{"text":"Gilou taisan inlen, sil hoi bawl in, lemna sui inlen, adel in del zel in."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa mit khu midihtatte tungah atu a, akikouna uh ngaikhe dingin abil adaw ngitnget hi."},"16":{"text":"Silhoilou bawlte tungah Mangpa amai guma, leitunga kipat in amaute thei zingna khu, aphietmang ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Midihtatte akikou chiengun Mangpa’n aza hi, tualeh abuoinate ua kipat in ahundoh zel hi."},"18":{"text":"Lungtang hasete Mangpa’n anai a, tualeh hagau a kisiana neite ahundam hi."},"19":{"text":"Midihtat in thuohgimna tampi anei a, hinanleh tuate zousie apat in, Mangpa’n ahunkhie hi."},"20":{"text":"Agute zousie uh akembit a, khatbeh zong atawng sih ding hi.","ref":"Jn. 19.36"},"21":{"text":"Silhoilou in migilou athat dinga, tualeh midihtat muda pouma mawpai ahi ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa’n asuohte hinna atandoh zel a, Ama belte koima mawpai in a um sih ding uhi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa kei hing doute, nangman dou inlen, kei hing suolte nangman suolin.","title":"Phuba la ding a, Mangpa ngetna David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Lum leh phaw la inlen, Kei hing panpi ding in dingin."},"3":{"text":"Teipi zong zundoh inlen, “Kei hing nuadelte na dal inlen,” ka hinna kungah na hundamna kahi chi in."},"4":{"text":"Ka hinna lah tum a suite, zalasah inlen zum sahin, Ka sietna ding bawlte zong, lungkie in nua tai sah in."},"5":{"text":"Amaute busi hui mutleng bang uhenlen, Mangpa vansawlsiengin ama uh delmang hen."},"6":{"text":"A lampi uh miel in naal henlen, Mangpa vansawlsieng in amaute nuadelta hen."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun azieh beiin ka awhna dingin, lenthang adapsie ua azieh umlou pi’n, ka hinna matna dingin leihum atou uhi."},"8":{"text":"Kiging manlouin atung uah, sietna thakhat in tung henlen, alenthangsie uah amaute mama awh uhenlen, manthaina lei hum sung ah amauh mama kie uheh."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka hinna Mangpa ah anuom dinga, ahundamna ah akipah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka gu ka taangte zousie in, “Mangpa aw Nang bang mawngmawng, koi a um ei mah? Amaute sanga hatzawte akipat in, atha zawngkhalte na hunkhie a, mi zawngkhalte leh tasamte pen, amauh tomgam leh negamte apat in na hunkhie hi,” achi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Theipimi dihloute ahing kipandoh ua, ka theikhah ngailou silte ahing dong uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ka hoinate, hoilou in ahing thuh ua, ka hinna alungkhamsah uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh kei pen in achinat chiengun, ka puonsil sai ip ahia, ann ngawl in keima ka kisugenthei a. Ka thungetnate ka ang sungah ahing kinuale kia hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka lawm ahiei, ka sanggam ahiei, suun banga da ing a, mi anu suun a kap bangin, vul ningnieng in kunsa in ka vah kawi hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh kei ka kipalpua chiengin, nuomsa in akikhawm uhi;
