mivuohhat gumtatte, kei hing dou ding in akikhawm ua, kenlah ka thei sih a, ahing bottel ua atawp sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Pawi bawlnate ah Pasian theilou misimmaw hatte toh, aha uh ahing gawtkhum uhi."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa aw bangtan ahiei nang sim et ding? ang bawlsietna ua pat in kei hing hunkhie inlen, humpibahneite lah a kipat in, ka hinna manphatah hundam in."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken mipi kikhawm thupitahte lah ah, kipahthu na kungah ka gen dinga, mi tampi lah ah nangma ka hing phat ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka galte dihloutahin ka tungah nuomsa sah sinlen, Azieh bei a kei hing mudate mit sih-at in kihousah sin.","ref":"Late. 69.4; Jn. 15.25"},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun kilemna thu agen sih ua, hinanleh gamsunga galmuonga um khin khiante, sol theina ding angaituo zaw uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amaun akam uh lienpipi in ahing kah khum ua, “Katei, katei! imit un muta hai e” akichi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangman tami na muta hi, sip dide in um sin Aw Mangpa hing gamlat sin."},"23":{"text":"Khanglou inlen kei hing hun dingin kisa in; ka Pasian leh ka Mangpa kei hing panpi in."},"24":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka Pasian, na dihtatna dungzuiin vai hing hawmkhum inlen, ka tungah amauten nuomsa sih uheh."},"25":{"text":"Amauten alungsim un, “Nuom e, tambang hilou ahiei mah idei” chi sih uheh, amauh “I valzouta” zong chisih uheh."},"26":{"text":"Ka sietna tunga kipah a nuomsate khu, zum a buoi gawpin um uhenlen, Ka tunga kiliensahte, muolphouna leh zumna sil sahin um uheh."},"27":{"text":"Ka dihtatna hing kipahpite pen, nuom leh kipah in kikou uhenlen, asuohpa vangphatna a kipah “Mangpa khu, pahtawi in um heh” chi ngitnget uhen."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka lei in na dihtat na thu agen dinga, tualeh sun nitum in nangma phatna thu ka gen ding hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Migilou tatkhielna in, ka lungsim thuhtah sungah thu agen a, amitmu uah Pasian giingna malmal a um sih hi; achi hi","title":"Pasian itna leh hoina lamdang Lapulien ading: Mangpa suohpa David phatna la.","ref":"Rom. 3.18"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen akhelna amudoh chiengun amuda sih dinguh, chiin ama mitmu ah ama leh ama akiphat ngal a."},"3":{"text":"Akam ua thu pawtte khu gitlouna leh solna ahi a; piltah a nasep leh silhoi bawl atawpsanta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Alupna tung nangawn ah gitlouna ageel geel ua, lampi hoilou ah apei tei tei ua, gitlouna anuol sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na khotuona khu vante ah aum a, tualeh na gin umna in zong meipite a sun hi."},"6":{"text":"Na dihtatna khu taang thupitahte bang ahi a, na vaihawmnate khu tuipi thuh bang a hi a; Mangpa aw nangman mihingte leh, gamsate na humbit zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Aw Pasian na khotuona khu manpha hina va-ia e; Mihing zousie in na halim nuoi abel uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amauten na innsung kiningchinna toh, nuomsa in atai ding ua; na kipahna lui tuite na dawn sah nalai ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen na kungah hinna tuikhuh a um a; na vah taangah vahna ka mu ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Oh! Nangma, hing theite tungah, na itna tulngailou umsah zel inlen, tualeh lungtang dihtahte tungah, na dihtatna langsah ngitnget in."},"11":{"text":"Mikisatheite keng kei dou dingin kalsuonsah sinlen, tualeh migiloute khut in kei hing notmang sih heh."},"12":{"text":"Khunah silgilou bawlte akipua ua, thalpaiin a um ua athouzou nawn sih uhi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Silhoilou bawlte ziehin, kisulungkham nuom sinlen, dihloutaha bawlte zong eng sin;","title":"Midihtat leh giloute David phutna la."},"2":{"text":"aziehpen amaute hampa banga at pua pai in aum ding ua, louhingte banga vuoi pai ding ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa muonginlen silhoi bawl in, tuachi’n gamsungah na teng ding a, bittah in na um ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa tungah kipah inlen, tuachi’n aman na lungtang deilamte ahing pe ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na umdan ding Mangpa tungah nga inlen, Ama muongin Aman abawl sieng ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman na dihtatna vah bangin ataang sah dinga, tualeh na dihna thute sunlai nisa bangin, ataang sah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa mai ah sip dide inlen, Ama ngah khinkhian inlen agamtatna ua, lawchinna mute zieh in kilunggimsah sinlen, a silgilou bawl tupte ua alawchin chiengun kilunggimsah sin."},"8":{"text":"Lungthah kideh inlen thangpaina taisan in, kisulunggim nuomda in, silhoilou a puilut in a um zel uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen migiloute sattan in a um ding ua, hinanleh Mangpa ngahten gam aluo ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tomnou kaal in migilou a um nawn sih dinga, a umna mun uh hoitahin en nanlachin zong, a um nawn sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh lungnemten gam aluo ding ua, nopsahna kiningchingin akipah ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 5.5"},"12":{"text":"Migilou in midihtat sietna ding ngaituo in, aha agawtkhum leng uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n migilou a nuisan a, ani uh hing tung pai ding athei zieh in."},"14":{"text":"Mi gentheite leh tasamte luoi ngiem ding leh, umdan dihte that dingin migilouten namsau adoh ua, athalpite uh kuoi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Anamsau un amauh lungtang asun dinga, athalpite uh akihiehtawng pieh ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Midihtat in sil tawmnou khat anei khu, migilou tampite hausatna sangin ahoizaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen migilou bante akihiehtawng ding a, hinanleh Mangpa’n midihtatte atudet ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa’n midihtatte ni athei a, agouluo uh kumtawn in a umden ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hun hoiloute ah a zala sih ding ua, kiel tun chiengin zong atai ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Migiloute pen amangthang ding ua, Mangpa melmate zong loupa dawng dipdep bang ahi ding ua, suhmangthai in a um ding ua, meikhu bangin azammang ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Migilouten aleitawi ua apekia nawn sih uhi; hinanleh midihtatte pen in, khotuona langsahin ape zaw uhi."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa guolzawl miten, gam aluo ding ua; hinanleh aman asamsiette pen, sattan in a um ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Mi hoi kalsuonte pen Mangpa suhdet ahi a, alampi uah akipah zel hi."},"24":{"text":"Kipalpua nanleh abungbusip in atusah sih dinga, Mangpa’n akhut a ama atuh det zieh in."},"25":{"text":"Naupang kana hi a, tuin tehsie ka hing hita hi; hinanleh midihtatte taisan a a um lam, ka mukha nai sih a atate u’zong, khutdaw a vah ka mu ngaisih hi."},"26":{"text":"Amauten mi akhotuo zing ua apie ua, aleitawi sah ngitnget ua, atate u’zong guolzawl in a um uhi."},"27":{"text":"Gilou peisan inlen silhoi bawl in, tuachi’n kumtawn in na teng den ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n thudih a it a, Ami muonhuoite ataisan ngai sih ding a; midihtatte pen kumtawn a kepbit in a um uhi. Hinanleh migilou tate pen sattan ahi ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Midihtatten gam aluo ding ua, khunah kumtawn in ateng ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Midihtat kam in pilna thu agen a, alei un dihna thu agen hi."},"31":{"text":"Alungtang sung uah Pasian danthute a um a, akalsuon akitaal sih hi."},"32":{"text":"Migilouin midihtatte abuhdap ua, tha dingin asui kawi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Mangpa’n amaute khutsung ah, midihtatte anuasie sih dinga, thukhenna mai ah amawpai sih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Mangpa ngah inlen, alampi zuiin, tuachi’n gamluo dingin aman nang ahing tawisang dinga, Migiloute suhmanga aum chiengin, tuakhu na mu ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Keima’n migilou misugenthei leh, Lebanon muola Sidar sing bawhpha banga, mi nuoisie ka mu hi."},"36":{"text":"Ka hing pei kia lamin ana um nawn sih uhi; ka sui kawi vangin ka muzou nawn sih hi."},"37":{"text":"Genbanglou mi khu melchi inlen midih en in, aziehpen tuabang mite tawpna khu, hamuonna ahi ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh mitawnkhielte pen, suhmang khawm ahi ding ua, migilou te tawpna khu suhmang ahi ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Midihtatte hundamna khu Mangpa a kipat ahi a, Amakhu alungkham chimaw hun chieng ua, akibutna uh ahi."},"40":{"text":"Mangpa’n amaute apanpi a, ahunkhie hi; Ama abel zieh un, Aman! Migiloute akipat in amaute ahunkhie ding a, ahundam ding hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa lungthah in hing phawh sinlen, thangpai in hing thunun vawt sin.","title":"Khelna zieh a lunggimna leh theitha kiana ding David phatnala."},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen na thaltangten ahing kap pailet ua, tualeh ka tungah na khut ahing tusuh ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Na lungthahna ziehin ka sa tungah, chidamna mal mal a um sih hi; ka khelna zieh in ka gu ka taangte ah, damna a umta sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka thulimlounate’n ka lujang ahing netkhum a, puohgihtah bangin kei dingin agih seng taluo hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka motna ziehin, ka liemnate muot in a ui gawpta hi."},"6":{"text":"Lunggim in ka kun khiukheu a; sun nitum in ka thum in ka tau hit hit hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka kawng mei kah bangin a sa hethut a, ka tahsa pumpi ah chi damna, mun mawngmawng a um sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei pen zawngkhal gawpin, ka basamta a, ka lungtang natna ziehin ka tau tau hi."},"9":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka lunggul teng, nangman na thei sieng hi, ka maunate zong nang akipat phuol ahi sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka lungtang aphu dut dut a, ka thahatna abeita a, tualeh ka mit khomunate zong, kei a pat in apeimangta hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka thuohgimna apat in ka lawm kaguolte, akihemdoh zel ua ka sanggamte zong, gamlapi ah ading uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ka hinna lah tum a hing suiten, ka awhna dingin thang akam ua, Ka liemna ding suiten zong, manthaina thu ngen agen ua, tualeh sun nitum in solna thu ngen akikum uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Kei pen bilbing bangin khozalou in ka um a; hamtheilou thu gentheilou bangin ka um hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi, kei pen mi khoza theilou leh, a kama dawng theilou bang in ka um hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa nangma hing kineppi ka hi, Aw Mangpa ka Pasian nangma’n na hing dawng ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Hing ngaikhie in kachi a, tuachilouin ka keng ateu khah chiengin, ahing otkhun ding ua,” ka tungah akiliensah kha ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kei pua dingin kakisata a, ka lunggimna zong ka masangah aum ngitnget hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka thulimlounate ka phuongkhe dinga, ka khelnate ziehin lunggim in ka um ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Azieh umloupi a kei hing dou kamelmate, adamthei ua ahat uhi; tualeh dihloutah a hing mudate pung deu deu uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ka hoina silhoilou a hing thuhte khu ka melmate ahi uhi, aziehpen ken ahoilam pouma ka zui zel hi."},"21":{"text":"Aw Mangpa hing taisan sinlen; Aw ka Pasian kei a kipat gamla vawt sin."},"22":{"text":"Ka hundamna Mangpa Aw, kei hing panpi dingin manlangin hing kinaw in."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka lei a khelna thu kagenlouna dingin, ka umdante ka veng hoi dinga, migiloute ka masanga a um laisie uh, ka kam mugahna in ka gah ding,” ka chi hi.","title":"Mihing damsung tomdan Lapulien a ding: Juduthun ading David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Hamlou in sip dide in ka um a, ahoi lam zong genlou a daidide a, ka um chiengin ka lunggimna tohthou in umta hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka sungah ka lungtang asa hut hut a, ka ngaisut sut chiengin, tuami mei in ahing kaang a, tuachiengin ka lei in thu agenkha zel hi."},"4":{"text":"“Mangpa ka hinkhuo bei hun ding leh, ka damsung bangtan ahi diei, chi hing theisah inlen, ka hinna bei kin dan hing theisah in."},"5":{"text":"Ngaivawi, ka damsung khutpeh chie bepin na siem a, ka damsung kumte sawt dan zong, na mitmu ah bangma tham ahi sih hi. Mihing zousie ahoilai nite u’zong, bangmalou mai ahi. Selah"},"6":{"text":"Adihtah in, mihing pen nihim banga vah kawi ahi a, abuoi thawn maimai uhi. Gou akhol khawm ua aluo ding pen athei sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Aw Mangpa tuin kei bang ngah nalai ka hiei? Ka kinepna Nangma ah a um hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka tatkhielna zousie akipat hing tandoh inlen, mi mote gensiet in hing umsah sin."},"9":{"text":"Nangma bawl ahiziehin ka ham sih a, ka kam zong ka kaah sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Na hing vuohna kei akipat lamang inlen, na khut hahna zieh a mangthai kahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihingte atatkhelna zieh ua, na phawhhil chiengin, akilawmna pen uh leikha bangin, na zunmangsah hi. Adihtah in mihing zousie tuihu. Bang ahi bou uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Aw Mangpa, ka thungetna ngaikhie inlen, ka kikouna lam ah na bil hing daw in; ka hitui luongte donlouin koi sin, aziehpen mikhuol ka hi a, kapu leh pate banga khuolzin taam bang mai ka hi."},"13":{"text":"Tam mun a kipat a ka pawtdoh a, ka um nawnlou masangin, ka haat thei kia na dingin, gumtah a nang etna mai kei apat in heimang in.”"}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kukaltahin Mangpa ka ngah a, Kei lam ah ahing kihei a, ka kikou azata hi.","title":"Pahtawina leh panpina ngetna Lapulien a ding: David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Aman manthaina kokhuh leh, buonnawi lah a kipat in, kei ahing kaikhe tou a tualeh, suongpi tungah ka kengte a koi a, ka kalsuon a kipsah hi."},"3":{"text":"Aman ka kam ah la tha akoi a, i Pasian phatna la ahing pie hi, mi tampi in amu ding ua azau ding ua, tuachi’n Mangpa amuong ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa a muonna nei a, kiliensahte lam ngalou a, zuou thu gente kiheisan mite ahampha uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka Pasian, na nasep lamdang tahte leh, koute dinga na lunggeelte atam mama a, tuate na masanga suhlat seng guol ahi sih hi. Tuate phuongzah a gen ding hita leng, simseng guol ahisih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kithoina leh sillat na lunggul sih a, ka bilte na hing vutvangta hi. Halmang sillatte leh khelna zieh a, sillatte na phuut sih hi.","ref":"Heb. 10.5-7"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken “Ngaivawi kei tanah ka um hi; laibu ziel sungah ka tungthu akigiel hi."},"8":{"text":"Aw ka Pasian na deilam bawl khu ka kipahna ahi a, na danthute ka lungtang sungah a um hi;” ka chi hi."},"9":{"text":"Kikhopna thupitah ah dihtatna thupha ka genta a, Ngaivawi! Aw Mangpa, ka kam ka hum sih chi nangman na thei hi."},"10":{"text":"Na hundamna panpina kalungtang sungah, ka imden sih a na gin umna leh, na hundamna thu ka phuongdoh zaw hi. Na itna tulngailou leh na gin umna, khawmpi thupitahte ah ka im mang sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na khotuona nemtah it sinlen, na itna tulngailou leh na gin umna leh, na thutahin hing humbit ngitnget zaw in."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen silhoilou simseng louten, kei ahing imkuol uhi. Ka khelnaten ahing nuaphah ua, ka dahdoh ngamta sih hi. Ka khelnate ka lutunga samzangte sangin, atamzaw a ka lungtang abaa gawpta hi."},"13":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, ka hundamna ah kipah inlen; Aw Mangpa, kintah in hing panpi mengin."},"14":{"text":"Ka hinna lahmang tum a suite zousie, buoigawp leh zumsah in um uhen; ka sietna ding dei mite zousie, zalah leh maizum in nuakia sah in um uhen."},"15":{"text":"“Awi ngel ing e, Awi ngel ing” chia hing koute’n azalatna zieh un, mangbang tahin um uheh."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh nangma hing suite zousie pen, nangma ah nuom in kipah uhenlen, na hundamna ngai poumaten, “Mangpa pahtawi in um heh,” chi ngitnget uhen."},"17":{"text":"Kei pen mi genthei leh tasam ka hi a, hinanleh Mangpa’n ahing ngaituo ngitnget a, nang pen ahing panpipa leh, ahing tandohpa na hia; Aw ka Pasian hing kiheh vawt sin."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gentheite khotuo mite ahampha uhi, amangbat ni chiengun Mangpa’n ahunkhe ding hi.","title":"Pasian ngaisahte panpina Lapulien a ding David phatna la"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n amauh ahumbit dinga, ahingsah ding hi; leitungah guolzawl in aum ding ua, agalten aut ut a abawl ding un, a pekhe sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Alupna tung ua china a alup chiengun, Mangpa’n ahatsah dinga, adamllouna uleh ahatlouna zousie uh zong, na damsah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ken, “Aw Mangpa hing khotuo inlen hing sudam in, na tungah ka khielta hi,” ka chi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka melmate’n “Bangchih chiengin, ashi in a min amangthang diei?” chiin ahing gensie uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh kei ve a ahing pei chiengun, thuginalou pou a gen ua, alungtang uah thulimlouna akholkhawm ua, apawtdoh chiengun mi ahil zel uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kei hing mudate zousie’n kidaphou in, ahing gensie ua ka sietna ding lemtang angaituo uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute’n “Shi theina natna in aman detta a, alupna akipat athoudoh sih ding” ahing chi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ka muon mama ka annkuong impi, ka lawm it pen nangawn in zong, ka tungah aketul alehta hi.","ref":"Mat. 26.23; Mak. 14.18; Luk. 22.21; Jn. 13.18"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa, hing khotuo inlen, amaute ka thuh theina dingin hing kaithou in."},"11":{"text":"Ka tungah lungdam nahi, chi ka theina tami ahi; ka melmate ka tunga aguolzaw lou zieh un."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh keipen lungsim dihtah ka puoh ziehin, na hing tudet a tualeh kumtawn in na masangah, nang koidenta hi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa Israel Pasian khu, kumtawn akipat kumtawn tanin phat in umta hen, Amen.","ref":"Late. 106.48"}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sakhi in lui tui luong dieldiel alunggul bangin, Aw Pasian, ka hinna in nangma ahing lunggul hi.","title":"BU NINA (Late 42-72) Lungkham hun lai a Pasian ngaina Lapulien a ding: Korah tate lapi Maskil"},"2":{"text":"Ka hinna in Pasian angai a, Pasian hing ngai in adangtah hi, bangchih chienga Pasian kunga tungin, Amasang ah ka kilah thei diei?"},"3":{"text":"Miten ka kungah “Na Pasian hei a um ahiei?” Ahing chi lai un sun leh zan in ka hituite, ka ann ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tam silte ka geeldoh chiengin, ka hinna ka sungah ka sungbuo a, mipite lah ah ka pei a; lasa a kikou aw toh lungdam kipahna leh, phatna ging toh Pasian biehinn lam zuon in, ama uh kai in ka pei zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Aw ka hinna bang dinga lungkham a kun na hiei? bang ding a ka sunga lungmuong maw na hiei? Pasian ah kinem in, aziehpen amel a panpina ziehin, ama ka phat ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Aw Ka Pasian, ka hinna ka sungah akuun denta hi. Tuazieh in Jordan gam leh Hermon leh Mizar muol akipat, Nangma ka hing geldoh ngitnget ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Na teutui luong zuozuote ah, tuithuh leh tuithuh akihan tuo ua, na tui kihotte leh tui kinawng zousie in, kei ahing tum ta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Sun chiengin Mangpa’n a itna tulngailou khu, thu ape dinga zan chiengin, a la in ahing umpi ding hi. Tuakhu ka hinna Mangpa kunga ka thumna ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ka Pasian ka suongpi kung ah, “Bangdinga kei hing manghil na ahiei?” Bangdinga ahing doute zieh a, lunggim a mau mau ka hiei? ka chi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka tahsa tunga shi theina khop liemna bangin, kei hing doute’n “Na Pasian hei a um ahiei?” chiin ahing phin ngitnget uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aw ka hinna bangdinga da a kun na hiei? Bangzieh a ka sunga lungmuong maw na hiei? Pasian ah kinem in, aziehpen ka hundampa leh, ka Pasian phat nalai ding ka hi hi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian vai hing hawmpieh inlen, Pasian ngai sahlou namte lah ah, ka tungtang thu hing genpieh inlen, migilou leh solhatte lah apat in hing hunkhie in.","title":"Mangbat chimaw lai a thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen nang ka bitna Pasian na hi; bangding a nang pampai ahiei? Bangzieh a ka galte nuoisiena zieh a, kap kawm a vah kawi ding ka hiei?"},"3":{"text":"Aw na vahna leh na thutahna hing sawlkhie inlen, tuate’n kei hing zawpi uhenlen; na muol siengthou leh na tenna mun ah, hing puitung uheh."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian maitam ah ka peidinga, ka kipahna mama Pasian kungah ka pei ding hi, Aw Pasian ka Pasian nangma tumging toh, ka hing phat ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Aw ka hinna bangdinga da a kun na hiei? Bangdinga ka sunga lungmuong maw na hiei? Pasian ah kinem in ka hundampa leh, ka Pasian phat nalai ding ka hi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian, adamlai hun ua, na sil bawlte ka pu ka pate un ahing hil ua, ka bil un kaza ta hi.","title":"Pasian hundamna dinga ngetna Lapulien a ding: Korah tate lapi: Maskil."},"2":{"text":"Nangma’n na khut ngei in namte na notdoh a, hinanleh amauh na phudet dante. Namte na sugenthei a na paidoh dante ahing hil uhi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen agam luo uh amauh, namsau a alah uh ahi sih a, tualeh amauh bantha hat a, kihundam zong ahi sih uh hi; atung ua na kipah zieh a, na khut zietlam leh na banthahat leh, na meel vah in ahundam ahi zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Aw Pasian Nang ka leengpa na hi, Jakob guolzawna dingin thu pie in."},"5":{"text":"Nangma vangin ka galte uh ka sawnpua ding ua, Nangma min zal in ahing doute ka tuonchil ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen ka thalpi ka muong sih ding a, tualeh ka namsau in ahing hundam zou sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh ka galte akipat in nang hundamta a, kou hing mudate khu na zala sahta hi."},"8":{"text":"Sun nitum in Pasian ka suong ua, kumtawn in na min ka phat ding uhi. Selah."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi hinapiin tuin koute na hing paidohta a, tualeh na hing zumsahta hi; tualeh ka galkapte utoh, na pawtdoh khawm nawn sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka galte uh masang ah nang nuatai sah a, kou hing mudate’n galsum lahte, a dei dei un akilahta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Nang koute belam thadingte bangin, na hing bawlta a tualeh namte lah ah, nang thethangta hi."},"12":{"text":"Na mite bangmalouin na hing zuata a, a man ding un tampi na ngen sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka innvengte uh bawlsiet in na hing umsah a, ka kim ka vel ua umte simmaw leh, nuisat in na hing umsahta hi."},"14":{"text":"Namte lah ah aselam a paunah, na hing suoh sahta a mite lah ah, nuizatbuh na hing hisahta hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka zalat na khu sun nitum in, ka mai ah a um zinga, ka mai zumna in ahing tuom zouta hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahing phinte leh ahing gensete thu zieh leh, melmate leh phuba la mite zieh ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tamte zousie ka tung uah ahing tungta a, hinanleh nang ka hing manghil ngai sih ua, na thuhun zong ka zuoutatsan ngai sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ka lungtang uh akinuahei kia sih a, ka kalsuonte un na lampi apielsan ngai sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua hinapiin Nang koute na hing kehgawp sah a, si alte umna mun na hing suoh sahta hi."},"20":{"text":"Kouten ka Pasian min uh ka manghil ua, gamdang pasien lang a ka khut uh ka zah ua ahileh;"},"21":{"text":"Pasian in asuidoh sih ding amah? Aziehpen Aman lungtang sunga thuguhte athei hi."},"22":{"text":"Nangma zieh in sun nitum a tha in ka um ua, gaw ding belam banga simtha ka hi uhi.","ref":"Rom. 8.36"},"23":{"text":"Aw Mangpa hing thoudoh in, bang dinga imu na hiei? Thou inlen, kumtawn a dingin hing paimang sin."},"24":{"text":"Bangding a na mai phuol na hiei? Bangdinga ka thuohgimna uleh, nuoisie a ka umnate uh manghil na hiei?"},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen ka hinna uh leivui suin akuun suh a, ka tahsa uh tuol ah abehdenta hi."},"26":{"text":"Thou inlen hing panpi in, na khotuona ziehin hing tandoh in."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka lungtang sungah la ngaitah aluong let a; Lengpa tungtang thu a ka laphuo ka gen ding hi; ka lei zong laigel siem mi laikung bang ahi hi.","title":"Leengpa leh akilawmna Shoshannima sah ding Korah tate adinga, Maskil, Lapulien a ding, ki itna la"},"2":{"text":"Mihing tate sangin nang na mel ahoi zaw hi, na nephu ah khotuona buohkhum ahi a, tuaziehin Pasian in kumtawna dingin, nang ahing guolzawlta hi."},"3":{"text":"Aw mihatpa na kawngah na namsau kuo inlen, na thupina leh na kilawmna toh hing kizem in."},"4":{"text":"Thutah leh kingaingiemna leh, dihtatna ziehin na kilawmna sil in, lamzangtahin sakol tungah tuongin kuonkhie in; tuachi’n na zietlam khut in sil chizat huoite ahing hil ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na thaltang khu leengpa melmate lungtang ah ahiem a, namte na keng nuoi ah apua uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aw Pasian na leengtoupha khu kumtawn kumtawn in, aumden dinga; na lenggam lengchieng lah dihna lengchieng ahi ngal a.","ref":"Heb. 1.8,9"},"7":{"text":"Nangman dihtatna na it a gitlouna na huo hi. Tuaziehin Pasian na Pasian in, na lawm na guolte tunglam peh ah ahing koi a, lungnopna sathau ahing nuta hi."},"8":{"text":"Na puontuolsilte zousie gimnamtui mirrah, aloe leh sing gimnamtui kibuoh ahi, Saiha a kibawl leng innpi akipat, tumging gui neiten nang ahing kipah sah uhi."},"9":{"text":"Na numei zatathuoite lah ah leengpa tanute atel uh a, na zietlam ah Ophir sana a kizem in leengnu ading hi."},"10":{"text":"Tanu aw, ngaikhie inlen ngaituo inlen, na bildawin; na mite leh napa innkuonte manghil in."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n na melhoina Lengpan alunggul ding hi; ama na mangpa ahi a ama zatatin."},"12":{"text":"Tai-ar tanuten silpieh tawi in na deisahna asui ding ua, mite hausaten na deisahna angen ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Lengpa inn sungah leengpa tanu khu athupi mama a, apuonsilte sana toh kigankhawm ahi."},"14":{"text":"Puonkhui kilawmtah silin leengpa kunga pui in, aum ding a ama zui nungah siengthoute khu, na kunga pui ahi ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Lungnuom leh kipahtah in apui ding ua; leengpa innsungah alut ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Na pu na pate mun na tapaten aluota ding ua, nangman amaute leitung zousie ah, leeng tapate in na bawlta ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na min pen akhang akhanga theizing dingin, ka bawl dinga tuachi’n michin in kumtawn in, nang ahing pahtawi zingta ding uhi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian iki humbitna leh i hatna, mangbat lai a hing panpi paipai, nai ngitnget ahi.","title":"Pasian kihumbitna leh hatna Lapulien a ding: Korah taten Alamoth a asah ding."},"2":{"text":"Tuaziehin leitung pumpi hing kiheng lamdangin, taangte tuipi sunga tumsuh dingin, kiling nanleh izau sih ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Atuite mau vengvung in phul noi noi nanleh, tuipi kilohten taangte ki lingsah nanleh, izau sih ding uhi. Selah."},"4":{"text":"Lui khat a um a tuami luikaten tungnung pen, tenna mun siengthou Pasian khopi akipahsah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuami khopi lai ah Pasian a um a, akiling sih ding hi. Pasian in zingmawng phalvah in ama apanpi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Namte lungthah in akitom ua, leenggamte akiling uhi, Aman a aw asuo a leitung azunmang hi."},"7":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa eite toh a umkhawm a, Jakob Pasian khu eite kibutna ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hing pei unlen, Mangpa nasepte hing en un, Aman leitung asuhsiet dante en un."},"9":{"text":"Aman leitung pumpi a kidounate atawpsah a, thalpite akuoitan a, teipite ahiehtawnga sakollengte mei in ahaltum hi."},"10":{"text":"“Dai dide unlen Pasian ka hi chi thei un, namte lah ah pahtawi in ka um dinga,” Leitungah pahtawi in ka um ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa eite lah ah a um a, Jakob Pasian khu eite kibutna ahi. Selah."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nou michinte aw, na khut uh beng unlen, guolzawna aw toh Pasian kungah kikou un.","title":"Leitung Vaihawmpa Pasian phatna Lapulien a ding: Korah tate phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen tungnung pen Mangpa khu azauhuoi a, leitung pumpi ah leeng thupitah ahi."},"3":{"text":"Aman nam zousie inuoi uah akoi dinga, nam zousie ikeng nuoi uah akoi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman, igouluo ding a hing tel pieh a, a it Jakob thupina ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian khu lungnopna kikou aw toh apeitou a, Mangpa pengkul ging toh apeitou hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian phat in la sa unlen phatna la sa un; I leengpa phat in la sa unlen phatna la sa un."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian khu leitung pumpi leengpa ahi; theisiemna toh phatna la sa un."},"8":{"text":"Pasian khu nam zousiete tunga leengpa ahi a, Pasian khu Amangtoupha siengthou, tungah atou hi."},"9":{"text":"Michin lah a leeng tapate Abraham Pasian mite khu, akikhawm khawm uhi; Aziehpen leitunga galdouna lum leh phawte, Pasian a ahi Ama khu thupitah a, pahtawi in a um hi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa khu athupi a, i Pasian khopi a, amuol siengthou ah thupitah a phat ding ahi.","title":"Zion a Pasian thupina la Korah tate phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Tua khopi sanna akilawm mama a, leitung pumpi kipahna Zion muol ahi; Mallam a um Zion muol khu leeng thupitah khopi ahi.","ref":"Mat. 5.35"},"3":{"text":"Tua leeng innpi huongsungte ah, Pasian khu kihumbitna ahi chi’n akithei hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen En in leengte akikhawm ua, ahing pei khawm uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua khopi amu ua lamdang asa ua, chiza sengin ataimangpai uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuanah zauna in amauh aman a, numei nauvei bangin, natna in amauh amanta hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangman suolam hui in, Tarshish tembaw liente na susie hi."},"8":{"text":"Kouten ka zahtah mabangun, galkapte Mangpa khopi ah ka muta uhi; i Pasian in tua khopi khu kumtawn a dingin, asukip ding hi. Selah."},"9":{"text":"Aw Pasian na biehinn sunggil ah, na itna tulngailou khu ka ngaisut uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aw Pasian na min dungzui in, nangma phatna kawlmong tandong ah a um a, Na khut zietlam dihtatna in adim hi."},"11":{"text":"Na vaihawmnate ziehin Zion muol khu, nuom in kipah henlen Juda tanute kipah uhen."},"12":{"text":"Zion khopi sungah vah kawi unlen, akimvel ah pei kawi unlen; agal venna innsangte sim un."},"13":{"text":"Akulpi bangte chiemte hoi unlen, aleeng inpi huongsungte lungin geel un, khang sawn sawnte kunga na hil theina ding un."},"14":{"text":"Tami Pasian khu kumtawn kumtawn a, i Pasian uh ahi a, Aman shitan dong in ahing pui ding hi."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nou mi zousiete aw, tami za unlen, Nou leitunga tengte zousie aw, na bil uh daw chiet un.","title":"Hausatna in mihing atandoh theisih hi Lapulien a ding: Korah tate phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Mi neu leh mi lien azawng leh, ahauten kibangin ngai un."},"3":{"text":"Ka kam in pilna thu agen dinga, Ka lungtang ngaituonate khu, theisiemna ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Paunah ah ka bil kadaw dinga, tumgingin ka thu hasate ka genchien ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ni hoilou ahing tun chienga, kei hing sugentheite thulimlouna in, ahing im kimkot chieng in, bang dinga zau ding ka hiei?"},"6":{"text":"Ahausatna uh muongte ahi ua, Ahausatna kisahtheipite ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Adihtah in mihing koima’n, a unau atandoh thei sih dinga, tatna zong Pasian kungah ape thei sih ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen hinna tatna man atam sengsenga, pieh sengguol ahi ngai sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Kumtawn a ahinden ding leh, muotna amulouna dingin, tatdohna man kiching umlou ding a hi."},"10":{"text":"Mipilte ashi ua mimaw leh mimawlte zong, ashi tuoh tuoh ua, ahaunate uh midangte kungah a nuasie zel uhi, chi ama’n amu hi."},"11":{"text":"A innte uh kumtawna umden ding leh, atenna munte uh khang sawnsawn dong a, umden dingin alungsim un angaituo ua, agamte uh amauh min avaw uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahivang in mihingte khu pahtawi in, a um ngitnget sih a, amangthai thei gamsate bang ahi bou hi."},"13":{"text":"Tam khu mi kimotmuonte tan ahi a, hinanleh anua chiengun miten, athu gen uh hoi asa uhi."},"14":{"text":"Belamte banga hankhuh tung dinga guotsa ahi ua, shina khu belam chin bang a amauh chingtu ahi a; tangtah in hankhuh azuonsuh ding ua, alim amelte uh a muotmangta dinga; hankhuh khu a inn uh ahita ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in hankhuh thahatna a kipat in, ka hinna atandoh dinga, aziehpen aman ahing na pom ding hi. Selah."},"16":{"text":"Mi ahing hausat chienga, a innsung thupina ahing khan chiengin, zau sin."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen ashi chiengun, bangma akeng sih ding ua, athupina in amauh zuisuh theilou ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Adamsung un nuomsa nan uleh, nangma a dinga silhoi na bawl chiengin, miten hing phat nan uleh;"},"19":{"text":"Apu apate uh kungma a pei ding ahi ua, tuaten khovah amu ngai sih ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mihing pahtawi a um a theisiemna neilou mi pen, amangthai thei gamsa bang bep ahi bou hi."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bangkimbawlthei Mangpa Pasian in thu agenta a, ni suona lam a kipat ni tumna lam tan in leitung ahanta hi.","title":"Pasian thukhenpa dihtat Asaph phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Kilawmna bukim Zion a kipat in, Pasian ataang kheta hi."},"3":{"text":"I Pasian uh ahing pei dinga, asip khinkhian sih ding hi; amasangah haltumna mei a kuonga, akimkot ah huipi hattah alaang ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amipite tunga thukhen theina dingin tunglam akipat, van leh lei ahan ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Ka misiengthoute ka kungah hing puikhawm unlen, kithoina a keima toh thuhun bawlte.”"},"6":{"text":"Vanten adihtatna phuongzah uhen, aziehpen Pasian ama ngel khu vaihawmpa ahi."},"7":{"text":"“Ka mite aw ngai un, thu gen ding ka hi. Aw Israel ngaikhie un, ka hing hilchien ding hi; Kei Pasian, na Pasian uh ka hi."},"8":{"text":"Na kithoinate uleh na halmang sillatte uh ka masanga, a um ngitnget zieh in ka hing house sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Na inn ua kipat bawngtal ka pom sih dinga, na ganta huong akipat keltalte ka pom tuom sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen gamlah a gamsate zousie kei a ahi a, muol tulkhat tunga um ganta zousie zong kei a ahi."},"11":{"text":"Vanlaizawl a vate zousie ka thei suoh a, gamlah a vah gamsate zousie kei a ahi."},"12":{"text":"“Ka gil akiel a ahileh, nang kang hil sih ding hi, aziehpen leitung leh asung a um zousie kei a ahi."},"13":{"text":"Bawngtalte sa ka ne in, ahisihleh kelte sisan ka dawn ding amah?"},"14":{"text":"Pasian kungah kipahthu genna sillatte laan unlen; Tungnung sangpen kungah na thuchiem uh tangtungsah un."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh na mangbat ni chieng un hing han un, keiman ka hing hunkhe dinga, tuachi’n na hing pahtawi ding uhi.”"},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in migiloute kungah; “Ka danthupiehte gen dinga bang thuneina nei na hiei mah? Ahisihleh ka thuhun na kam a gen ding a, bang thuneina nei na hiei mah?"},"17":{"text":"Thununna na huo a ka thute na nualang sena’n na nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Guta na mu leh phaze sa in na zui a, angkawm mite toh na kigop hi."},"19":{"text":"“Na kam zong thuse genna ngen in na zanga, na lei zong zuouthu bawlna in na zang hi."},"20":{"text":"Toukawm in na sanggamte na gensie a, Na nu tapate nangawn hehsie in na pang hi."},"21":{"text":"Tam silte na bawlta a, kei pen ka sip ding deng hi. Nangma bang giap dingin na hing ngaituo a, hinanleh ka hing phawhhil ding a, na maitangah akizom zelin ka sulang sieng ding hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tami kimelchi un nou Pasian manghilte aw, ahisihleh ka hing bottel dinga koiman ahing hunkhe thei sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Koipou kipah thugenna kithoina laan miin, Kei ahing pahtawi a tualeh ahinna lampi dihtah a, peipi pouma kungah Pasian hundamna ka ensah ding hi;” achi hi."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian na itna tulngailou dungzui in, ka tungah zangai inlen, na khotuona kiningching dungzui in, ka tawnkhelnate hing phietmang pieh in.","title":"Kisiana toh ngaidam ngetna Lapulien a ding: Bethsheba tunga akhel a, guolnei Nathan in akunga thu agen lai a, David kisiana. David phatna la"},"2":{"text":"Ka thulimlouna apat in hing sawpsieng kilkel inlen, ka khelna apat hing siengsah in."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen ka tatkhielnate ka thei ngitnget a, ka khelnate ka masangah a um den hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang tungah Nangma tung bou ah kana khielta hi; Na mitmu ah tam silgilou kana bawlta hi; Thu nagen a siem na tangsah thei a, na vaihawmnate zong gensiet bei ahi.","ref":"Rom. 3.4"},"5":{"text":"Ngaivawi, thulimlouna a suhtuo in ka um a, ka nu’n ahing pai lai a khielsa kana hita hi."},"6":{"text":"Ngaivawi, Nang sunggil lam a thutahna na dei a; tualeh ka sung gil lam ah pilna theithei na hing pie in."},"7":{"text":"Hissop in hing silsieng in, tuachi’n ka siengthou ding hi; hing silsieng inlen, tuachi’n vua sangin ka vam zawding hi."},"8":{"text":"Nuomna leh kipahna hing zasah inlen, na suhtansa gu leh taangte nuom a akipah theina ding un."},"9":{"text":"Ka khelnate apat na mai phuol inlen, ka gitlouna zousie hing phietmang pieh in."},"10":{"text":"Aw Pasian keima ah lungtang siengthou siem inlen, ka sungah lungsim dihtah siemtha kia in."},"11":{"text":"Na umna apat hing paimang sinlen, Keima akipat Na Hagau Siengthou lakhe sin."},"12":{"text":"Na hundamna kipahna hing pe kia inlen, Hagau thanopna toh hing tudet zing in."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n takhielte kungah na lampite ka hil dinga; mikhielte nang lam ah ahing kihei kia ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Aw Pasian, nang ka hundamna Pasian aw, sisan suote lah apat in hing hunkhie inlen, tuachi’n ka lei in na hundamna, la in kasa ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka kamte hing honpieh inlen, tuachi’n ka kam in na phatna atheisah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen kithoina sillalte ah na kipah sih a, tuachilou hileh ka hing peta ding hi, halmang sillat tungah kipahna mawngmawng na nei sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian deilam kithoina sillat pen, Hagau kisia a hasie lungtang keh gawp khu ahi. Aw Pasian hagau hasie leh, lungtang kisiate na simmaw ngai sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Na lungdamna bangin Zion tungah silhoi bawl inlen; Jerusalem kulbang te lem in."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n dihtatna kithoina sillatte tungah na kipahta ding a, tualeh halmang Kithoina leh haltum pumpiehna sillatte ah zong, na kipahta dinga, tuachi’n na maitam ah bawngtalte kalanta ding uhi."}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihat Aw, bang dinga silgilou bawl suong na hiei? Pasian hoina khu a um ngitnget ahi.","title":"Mi zuoubawlhatte tunga Pasian thu khenna Lapulien a ding, Maskil Edom mi Doeg in Saul kunga “David Ahimelek inn ah apeita,” chi a ava hil lai a. David phatna la"},"2":{"text":"Mulmetna temhiemtah bangin na leiin, zuou thu gen in silgilou angaituo leng hi."},"3":{"text":"Hoina sangin gitlouna na dei zaw a, thudih gen sangin zuou thu na gen ut zaw hi. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Nang lei misol hat aw, mi valtum thei thute ngentang na dei lam ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian in tuachibangmain kumtawn a dingin, Nang ahing suse dinga ahing lamang dinga, na umna apat in ahing luoikhe dinga, mihing gam akipat in ahing botdoh ding hi. Selah"},"6":{"text":"Midihtatten amu ding ua, a zau ding ua anuisan ding uhi;"},"7":{"text":"“En un, Pasian a hatna a nei lou a, a hausatna thupitah muong a agitlouna a ama leh ama, kisuhat zopa khu."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Kei pen Pasian inn a, Olive singkung kiduo ngihngeh bang ka hi a, Pasian khotuona kumtawn kumtawn in ka muong ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tambang silte na bawl ziehin, kumtawn in ka hing phat ding hi. Na mi siengthoute umna mun ah, na min ka phuongzah ding hi; aziehpen tami ahoi ahi."}}},"53":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mimo in alungtangin “Pasian a umsih” achi hi. Amaute asegawpsa ahi ua, sil hoilou kidahhuoitah abawl ua; koima silhoi bawl mawngmawng a um sih hi.","title":"Pasian ngaisahloute umdan Lapulien a ding Mahalath-a sah ding, Maskil, David phatna la.","ref":"Rom. 3.10-12"},"2":{"text":"Theisiem a Pasian sui mi a um uoi mah chi mu tum in, Pasian in van akipat mihing tate ahing ensuh hi."},"3":{"text":"Michin alelam anga chiet ua, a bawn un asegawp siengta uhi; koima silhoi bawl mawngmawng a um sih uh; khat zong a um sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Sil hoilou bawl miten, theina mawngmawng neilou ahi uoi mah? Tanghou aneh bangun ka mite anezouta uh. Pasian min lah alou ngai sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Zauna umlouna mun ah, nasatah in azau ua. Aziehpen Pasian in nangma hing dou ding a, hing imsuohte gu leh taangte a thethang ta hi. Pasian in amauh anuoltah ziehin, nangma’n amauh na zumsahta hi."},"6":{"text":"Oh, Zion a kipat in Israelte hundamna, hing tung mai leh izaw! Pasian in amite vangphatna apieh kia hun chiengin, Jakob anuomta dinga Israel akipah ta ding hi."}}},"54":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian na min in hing hundam inlen, na hatnain vai hing hawmpieh in.","title":"Galte akipata hutkhietna ngetna Lapulien a ding: kaiging guinei a sah ding. Ziph miten Saul kunga “David koute lah ah ahing kiphuol hi,” chi a genlai ua. David phatna la"},"2":{"text":"Aw Pasian ka thumna ngaikhie inlen, ka kam a ka thugente ah na bil hingdaw in."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen gamdang miten kei ahing dou ua, mi gumtatten ka hinna suhmang tum in asui ua; Pasian amasuon sih uhi. Selah."},"4":{"text":"Ngai vawi, Pasian khu keima hing panpipa ahi a; Mangpa khu ka hinna tudette toh a umkhawm hi."},"5":{"text":"Aman ka melmate gitlouna athuh dinga, Na thutah zieh in amauh sumang in."},"6":{"text":"Keima kiphalna toh na kungah, kithoina sillat ka lan ding hi; Aw Mangpa na min ka phat ding hi, tambanga bawl ahoi hi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama’n ka mangbatna zousie lah a kipat in, ahing hunkheta a ka melmate tunga, ka dei pen ka mitin ahing musahta hi."}}},"55":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian ka thungetna ah nabil hing daw inlen, ka ngetna apat hing kiphuolsan sin.","title":"Lawmte muonhuoilou lai a Pasian muonna. Lapulien a ding Kaiging gui nei a sah ding, Maskil, David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Hing ngaipieh inlen hing dawngin, ka buoina in ahing tawlnga sah thei sih a, thum in ka maumau hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka melma husa leh migiloute hing nuoisiena zieh in. Amau’n ka tungah lunggimna ahing tun ua, tualeh lungthah in ahing huo uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka sungah ka lungtang ana sengseng a, ka tungah shina zauna in ahing netkhum hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka tungah zauna leh chitutna ahing tunga, zauna chizathuoiin ahing pumtuom hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh keiman “Vakhu bang a hanei hi mai leng aw! Ka lengmang dinga ka khawldamta ding hi;"},"7":{"text":"Adihtah in, gamlapi ah ka leengmang dinga, gamdai ah ka gieh ding hi. Selah."},"8":{"text":"Huipi leh guopi apat kintahin kakihemkhe ding a ka suohta ding,” ka chi hi."},"9":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ahamte uh subuoi inlen khenthangin, khopi sungah thagumsuona leh kihauna ka muta hi."},"10":{"text":"Sun leh zan in khopi kulbang tungah avah kawi kawi ua; thulimlouna leh buoina lah ah ka um hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualaitah ah sietna a um a; kinuoisiena leh lepchiena in kholai anuasie sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei hing gensete ka melmate ahi sih ua, hilehvang thuohzou ding hi ing a, ka tunga kiliensah lah ahing mudate ahi sih ua; hileh vang ka kibuhmangsanta ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh, nangpen ka kibahpi ka kigoppi, ka kitheipi, ka lawm na hibou hi."},"14":{"text":"Kam humtah in i kihoukhawm zel a, Pasian biehinn a mipite lah ah, kigop in ivah khawm kawi hi."},"15":{"text":"Shina atung uah thakhat in tung henlen, ahing in hankhuh ah peisuh uheh; aziehpen atenna mun lah uah, gitlouna a um hi."},"16":{"text":"Ken vang Pasian ka han ding a, Mangpa’n ahing hundam ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Nitah leh zingmawng leh sunlai in thu ka ngen dinga, tualeh ngaitah in ka kikou dinga Aman ka aw aza ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka tunga kidouna apat in, Aman ka hinna hamuongtahin ahunkheta hi; Kei hing doute lah tampi ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tanglai apat ana um ngitnget Pasian in aza ding a amauh asungenthei ding hi. Selah amauten kihen lamdanna anei lou zieh un, Pasian zong a giing sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amatoh lungmuongtah a kigopte tungah, akhut aha a athuhun abot seta hi."},"21":{"text":"A kam a thupawtte bawngnawidat sangin, aneem zaw a hinanleh alungtang sungah, kidouna a um hi. Athugente sathau sangin azol zaw a, hinanleh namsau dohte ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Na puoh gih Mangpa tungah nga in, Aman na hinna akem ding hi; Aman midihtat apua ding aphal ngai sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Pasian nangman amauh khu, manthaina kokhuh ah na puisuh ding a, sisan suohatte leh lepchiete khu, adamsung kimkhat u’zong adamzou sih ding uhi. Hinanleh ken vang nangma ka hing muong ding hi."}}},"56":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian, hing khotuoin miten hing nomval atum uhi, ni chin in ahingdou ua ahing bawlgenthei uhi.","title":"Pasian muonhuoina Lapulien a ding; Gamlapi a dai dide vakhu (Jonath elem rehokima) kai a sah ding. Philistin miten Gath khopi a David amat lai ua. David phatnala"},"2":{"text":"Sun ni tum in ka galten ahing tuonchil ua, Aw Tungnung pen, kei hing doute atam seng uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ka zau hun chiengin nangma ka hing muong ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A thu ka phat Pasian ka muong a, ka zau sih ding hi. Mihing in bang ang law thei diei?"},"5":{"text":"Ni chin in ka thute alakawi ua, angaituona zousie uh ka sietna ding ngen ahi."},"6":{"text":"A kikhawm ua akiphuolmang ua, ka kalsuon a chiemte ua ka hinna abuhdap uhi. Selah."},"7":{"text":"Thulimlouna gawtna apumpel thei ding uh amah? Aw Pasian Na thangpaina ziehin mite paimang in."},"8":{"text":"Nangma’n ka vahvainate na melchi zel a, ka hituite na savun thawl ah thun in, Na laibu a na chiemtesa ngen hinalou amah?"},"9":{"text":"Nangma han a ka kikou ni chiengin, ka galte anuatai kia ding uhi tami ka thei hi, tuakhu Pasian kei lamah apang hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian thu ka pahtawi dinga, Mangpa thu ka phat ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa ka muonga ka zau sih hi; Mihing bep in kei bang ahing law thei diei?"},"12":{"text":"Aw Pasian na kunga ka kichiemnate ka tangtung sah dinga, Na kungah kipahna sillat in ka hing thuh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen shina akipat in ka hinna na hunkheta a, kipalpuana apat ka kengte na hunkhezel sih amah! Tuachi’n Pasian masanga hinna khovah ah, ka kalsuon theita ding hi."}}},"57":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hing khotuo in Aw Pasian hing khotuoin, kahinna in nangma ahing muong hi; vangsietnate abei sieng masang sie in, Na halim nuoi ka hing bel ding hi.","title":"Mi sugentheite a pat a suotatna ngetna Lapulien a ding: Miktam Sumangthang sin (Al-tash’heth) kai a sah ding. Saul giinga David kawlhawm sunga atai lai a David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Kei dinga bangkim hing bawlpiehpa, Tungnung pen Pasian han in ka kikou ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Aman van a kipat in panpi ding ahing sawl dinga, ahing nawmval tumpa simmawna apat in, ahing hundam ding hi. Selah. Pasian in a khotuona leh athutahna ahing sawlkhe ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka hinna humpibahneite lah ah a um a, gamsa gongsan bang mite lah ah alum hi; a hate uh teipi leh thaltang hiem ahi a, aleite uh namsau hiemtah ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aw Pasian nang pen vante tunglam peh ah, tawisangin um inlen; Na thupina khu leitung pumpi ah umta hen."},"6":{"text":"Amaun ka kengte awhna dingin lenthangte akam ua; ka hinna akun khiu kheu hi; Amaun ka lampi ah hum atou ua, amaute mama tuami sungah akie uhi. Selah."},"7":{"text":"Ka lungtang akip hi Aw Pasian ka lungtang akip hi. La kasa dinga phatna ginglawm ka gingsah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Thou in ka thupina thou in peging leh tumging, kei zingmawng phalvah in ka thou ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Aw Mangpa mite lah ah nangma ka hing phat ding a; namte lah ah nangma phat in la kasa ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen na khotuona khu vantung bangin asanga; Na thutahna in meilumte asuntou tabou hi."},"11":{"text":"Aw Pasian nang pen vante tunglam peh ah, tawisangin um inlen Na thupina khu, leitung pumpi tungah ah umta hen."}}},"58":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw! nou mipi dai dide te, dihtatna thu nagen na uh amah? Nou mihing tate aw, thudihtah in vai nahawm na uh amah?","title":"Phuba la dinga ngetna Lapuliena ding: Miktam Mangthangsah sin (Al tash heth) kai a sah ding. David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Hilou, na lungtang uah, gitlouna na bawl leng ua; leitunga na khut un gumtatna na uh na te zel uhi."},"3":{"text":"Migiloute pen anu gilsung akipat, nangawn a Pasian apat khentuom in a um ua, apienkhieh ua kipata zuou gen a lampiel ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Agu uh gulgu bang ahi a, thangtom bilbing khozalou bang ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuabangmiten gul ai tawite aw angaikhe sih ding ua, Bangchikhop a siem in him nan uleh."},"6":{"text":"Aw Pasian akam sung ua a hate uh, suhtawng pieh inlen, Mangpa aw humpibahnei lunlaite hapite, suhtawng pieh in."},"7":{"text":"Amaute khawllou a luongmang, tuibangin luongmang uhenlen, loupa bangin amaute kituonchil henlen, vuoigawp uheh."},"8":{"text":"Tohtawl banga apei lai un, zunmang uhenlen a hunlou a pieng bangin, ni mu ngailouin shigam uheh."},"9":{"text":"Na belte un lingsing kuong sat dan, atheimasangun, Aman pingpei in amauh alamang ding a, ahing nalai leh akuong nalaite zong."},"10":{"text":"Midihtatten phuba lahna amu chieng un, akipah ding ua migloute sisan in, akengte uh asil ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n miten “Midihtatte ading in, kipahman a um ding mawng ahi; Leitunga thukhenpa Pasian hitah tah na e;” achi ding uhi."}}},"59":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw ka Pasian ka galte lah a kipat hing hundoh inlen, kei hing dou dinga kisate apat hing humbit in.","title":"Hiamgamna apat hutkhietna ngetna Lapulien a ding: Mangsah sin (Al-tash heth) chi kai a sah ding. Saul in mi sawl a ama that dinga a inn a aumsah lai a, David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Gitlouna nasemte lah akipat in hing hundoh inlen, sisan suohatte apat in hing hundam in."},"3":{"text":"Envawi tunasan in zong ka hinna abuhdap ngitnget uhi; Aw Mangpa, ka tatkhelna zieh hilou a, ka khelna zieh zong hilou in. Mi hatte ahing dou dingin akikhawm uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka dihlouna umloupi in atai ua, kei hing dou dingin akisa uhi. Hing panpi dingin hing thou inlen, en in."},"5":{"text":"Nang galkapte Mangpa Pasian, Israelte Pasian aw; Nam zousie gawt dingin hing kisa inlen; Migilou takhielte tungah zangai sin. Selah."},"6":{"text":"Nitahlam chiengin ahing kinuale ua, ui bang in ahing ngih ua, khopi kimvel ah avah kawi khienkhuon uhi."},"7":{"text":"Envawi, akam uah asa-ih khie ua, a kam uah namsau banga hiem thute agen ua; “Koiman eite thugen za sih va,” akichi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa nang amauh na nuisan ding a; namte zousie na simmaw in na nuisan ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka hatna ziehin Nangma ka hing ngah ngitnget ding hi, aziehpen Pasian ka kihumbitna kulpi nahi."},"10":{"text":"Kei hing khotuona adim ka Pasian in ahing kimupi dinga, ka melma tunga ka dei ka Pasian in ahing musah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amauh that sin, tuachilouin ka miten amanghil kha ding uhi; na silbawltheina in amauh thezah inlen, sungiemin Aw Mangpa ka phaw uh na hi."},"12":{"text":"Akam ua akhelna zieh u’leh, amuh ua a thugente uh ziehin tualeh, ahamselawna u’leh a zuouthu gente zieh un, akisahtheina ngei uah awh uheh."},"13":{"text":"Pasian in Jakob tunga vaihawm ahi chi, lei mong donga akitheina dingin tualeh, amaute um nawnlouna dingin lungthah inlen, amauh ka tumsah in Ahi, ka tumsah in. Selah."},"14":{"text":"Nitahlam chiengin ahing kinuale ua, ui bangin ahing ngih ua; khopi kimvel ah avah kawi khienkhuon uhi."},"15":{"text":"Amaute ann neh ding suiin, suh dien tou dien uhenlen; agilva zoulou chieng un, ham nguou nguou uhen."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh ken vang na silbawltheina la in kasa ding a, zingmawng chieng in na khotuona phat in, nuomtahin la ka sa ding hi. Aziehpen Nangma ka mangbat ni chienga, ka kibutna kulpi na hia ka kihumbitna zong na hi."},"17":{"text":"Aw ka hatna nangma phat in la kasa ding hi. Aziehpen nangma ka kulpi na hi a, khotuona hing musahpa Pasian na hi."}}},"60":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian Nang koute na hing paikheta a, nangman ka bitna uh kulpi na suseta a, na lungkimta sih hi. Tuin kou lam ah hing ki nuale kia mai inlen, hing siemtha kia in.","title":"Nam hutdohna dinga ngetna Lapulien a ding: Theipina lili (Shushan eduth) kai a sah ding Aram nahara mite leh Aram Jobab mite toh akidou a, Joab ahing kinuale langa Edom mite tul sawm leh ni athagam lai a, David phatna la, Miktam"},"2":{"text":"Nang leitung na kiling sah a na susegawpta hi. Tuin apohkehnate siemtha kia inlen, akiling nalai hi."},"3":{"text":"Na mite sil hasa tatah na thuohsah a; buoigawpna uoin na hing dawnsah ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma hing giingte kungah puonlap na peta a, thutah zieh a zahpal ahi theina dingin."},"5":{"text":"Nangman na it mite hutkhiet a, a um theina dingun, na khut ziet lamin hundam inlen, ka ngetna hing dawngin."},"6":{"text":"Pasian in asianthouna toh thu agenta a, “Ka nuom ding a Shekem ka khenzah dinga, Sukkoth phaijang ka hawmzah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Gilead kei a ahi a, Manasseh gam zong kei a ahi; Ephraim ka sia lukhu ahi a, Juda khu ka danpetu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Moab ka kisilna kuong ahi a, Edom tungah ka kedap ka pai dinga, Philistin aw Keima zieh a guolzou in kikou in.”"},"9":{"text":"Khopi kulpi nei sungah kei koi in, hing puilut ding adiei? Edom ah koiin ahiei ahing pui tung ding?"},"10":{"text":"Aw Pasian koute hing paikhepa? Nangma hilou na hiei mah, Aw Pasian Nang hilou na hiei mah, ka galkapte utoh gal kuonkhawm ut nawnlou?"},"11":{"text":"Melmate douna dingin panpina hing pie in; aziehpen mihing panpina khu, bangmalou ahi bou hi."},"12":{"text":"Pasian zal in hangsan tahin ka dou ding uhi; aziehpen Ama ahi i melmate uh tuonchil ding pa."}}},"61":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian ka kikouna ngaikhie inlen, ka thungetna hing ngaikhieh pieh in.","title":"Pasian venbitna muonna Lapulien a ding: Kaiging guinei a sah ding, David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Lungtang a bagawp chiengin, kawlmong akipat in ka hing han ding hi; kei sanga sangzaw suongpi ah hing pui in;"},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Nangma ka kibutna na hi a, ka galte apat a ka kihumbitna galvenna, innsang kiptah na hi."},"4":{"text":"Na bieh buh ah kumtawn in ka um dinga, na ha lim nuoi kibutna ka bel ding hi. Selah."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian aw nang ka thuchiemte na zata a; na min zaudan siemte gouluo khu na hing peta hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangman leengpa damsung nite na suh sau pieh dinga, adamsung kumte zong khang tampi bang ahi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama khu Pasian masangah, kumtawn in aum ngitnget ding a, ama humbit dingin khotuona leh thutahna siempieh in."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka thuchiemte ni sim a, ka suhtangtung theina dingin na min phat in, kumtawn in la kasa den ding hi."}}},"62":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Adihtahin Ka hinna hamlou a sip dide in, Pasian angah zing a Ama a kipat, ka hundamna ahing tung hi.","title":"Pasian ngahna Lapulien a ding: Jeduthun ading David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Ama bou khu ka suongpi, ka hundamna leh ka kulpi ahi a, linthaw guol ka hi ngaisih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi khat dou dinga bangtan vei ahiei, silhoilou na ngaituo ding uh? Na bawn un thain na um ding ua, bang awn diaiduai leh dai pua dihdih, bang na hi ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Athupina akipat a sawnkhe dingin akikum ua, zuouthu gen nuom asa ua, akam un aguolzawl uh a, hinanleh asunggil lam uah ahamsiet uhi. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Ka hinna in sip dide in Mangpa bou angah hi; ka kinepna khu ama ahi ziehin."},"6":{"text":"Ama bou ahi ka suongpi leh ka hundamna, Ama ka kihumbitna ahi a ka kiling sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka hundamna leh ka thupina khu Pasian, ka hatna suongpi ahi a, ka kihumbitna Pasian ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nou mipite aw bangchih laipouin ama muong unlen; Amasangah na lungtang uh sungbuo un; Pasian khu eite kihumbitna ahi. Selah"},"9":{"text":"Adihtahin mi ngiemte khu bangmalou ahi ua, mi nam sangte lah zuou leltah ahibou uhi. Buhnain kibuh khawmtaleh ani ua kigawmin, tuihu sangin azang zaw ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Pauhat thu a mi neisa lahpieh muong sinlen, kisuomna vante ah zong kinem sin, Hausatna ahing pun leh, atungah na lungtang uh nga sih un."},"11":{"text":"Pasian in khat vei thu agenta a, tami nivei ka zata hi; silbawltheina pen Pasian a ahibou hi."},"12":{"text":"Aw Mangpa khotuona khu nanga ahibou hi. Aziehpen michin anasep dungzui un na thuh kia ding hi.","ref":"Job. 34.11; Jer. 17.10; Mat. 16.27; Rom. 2.6; Kihil. 2.23"}}},"63":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian nangma ka Pasian na hi, zingmawng matahin Nangma ka hing sui ding hi, ka hinna nangma ngai in adangta hi, gamgaw tui umlouna leh gimna gam ah ka tahsain Nangma ahing ngai hi.","title":"Pasian ngai a hagau dangta-na Juda gamdai-gamgaw a aumlai a David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n na silbawltheina leh, na thupina mu dingin munsiengthou ah, nangma ka hing sui hi."},"3":{"text":"Na itna tulngailou khu hinna sanga hoizawh, ahiziehin ka kam in Nangma ka hing phat ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka damsung tengin nangma ka hing phat dinga, na min in ka khutte ka zahtou ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka hinna khu chintuigu leh, thauna a tai bangin atai dinga; Ka kam in kipahna muh toh, nangma ahing phat ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka lupna tunga nangma, ka hing geldoh hun chiengin, zan ven sung tenga na tungthu, ka ngaituo hun chiengin;"},"7":{"text":"Nangma a hing panpipa na hizieh in, na halim nuoi ah nuom in la kasa ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka hinna in nangma ahing zui chinten a, na zietlam khut in ahing tudet hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hinna suhmang tum a suite pen, lei nuoi mun thuhpi ah apeisuh ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute namsau in apua ding ua, si alte tanvou ahita ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa pen Pasian ah anuom ding hi; Ama min lou a kichiem pouma in amin aphat ding ua, hinanleh zuouthu gente kam pen akihumpieh ding hi."}}},"64":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian, ka mangbatna thu ka gen lai in, ka aw na za inlen, Ka galte ka zauna apat in, ka hinna humbit in.","title":"Pasian venbitna ngetna Lapulien a ding: David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Migiloute kihouguhna apat leh, silgilou bawlte buoina bawlna apat in hing phuol in."},"3":{"text":"Amaun alei uh namsau bangin ataat hiem ua, thusie thaltang banga kap dingin athalpite uh aluoi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ami dapbuh na ua kipat in, genbanglou mite kap dingin akisa ua, thakhat in akap ua azau sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Silgilou bawl dingin akihantawh ua, aguh a thang kamdap dingin akithukup ua, “Koiman tuate mu sihva” achi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Thulimlou na a suidoh zel ua, kukal tahin isui zouta achi ua, asunglam ngaituona uleh, alungtang ulah a thuhtah ahi ngal a."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in amauh athaltangin akap dinga, thakhat in aliem ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman amauh lei ngeiin akipalpuasah dinga, amauh mu zousie’n chiza sengin alu uh athing ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n michin in azau chiet ding ua, amaun Pasian nasepte agen ding uhi, tualeh a silbawlte piltahin angaituo ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Midihtatte Mangpa ah akipah ding ua, Ama amuong ding uhi, Lungtang dihtah po zousie tungah thupina tungta hen."}}},"65":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian phatnain Zion ah nang ahing ngah hi. Na kungah thuchiemte tangtun sah ahi ding hi.","title":"Anasep lamdangte zieh a Pasian phatna Lapulien a ding, David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Aw nang thungetna sangpa na hi a, nangma kungah tahsa mi zousie ahing pei ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Thulimlounate’n koute ahing pumtuom lai in, nangman ka tawnkhielnate uh nang na silsieng ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Na biehinn huongsunga aum theina ding a, na tel leh na kung na naisahte mi hampha ahi uhi. Na inn leh na bieh inn siengthou, hoina toh tai ding ka hi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ka hundampa uh Pasian aw, na sil chizat huoi bawltein na hing dawng dinga a. Nang kawlmong tan a um mi zousie leh, tuipi tunga gamlapi a um zousie muon leh kinepna na hi."},"6":{"text":"Na thahatna in muol leh taangte na phutdet a, thupina in na kigah hi."},"7":{"text":"Nang tuipi kihot ging honhonte, tuihuol ging zuazuate leh. Mipi buoi husa ging vengvungte daisahpa na hi."},"8":{"text":"Kawlmong gamlapi a umte’n zong, na chiemtenate azau ua zingmawng leh, nitahlam pawtdohnate nuomin na kikou sah hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang leitung na ve a tui in na tapnou a, nasatah in na hausa sah hi; Pasian luidungte tui a dim a; leitung tuabanga na bawlzou in, mihingte a dingin bulebal na siem pieh hi."},"10":{"text":"Loukaina leitangte tui kiningching tahin na buoh a, leikhalte na zel jang pieh a, guotui in lei na nip sah a, haichi hing poudohte na guolzawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumte na hoinain na khusah a, na lampite ah nieng leh taina na takhe sah hi."},"12":{"text":"Gamdai gantatna munte ah atakhie a, muolneute zong nuom in akikou uhi."},"13":{"text":"Gantatna loupa munte ganhon in atuom a, Phaizangte zong haichi in adim a. Nuomin akikou ua la zong asa uhi."}}},"66":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitung gam zousiete aw Pasian kungah, nuomin kikou un.","title":"Pasian guolzawlna zieh a phatna Lapulien a ding: La phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Amin thupidan lain sa unlen, a phatna thupisah un."},"3":{"text":"Pasian kungah, “Na nasepte chizat huoi hina va-ia e, Na silbawltheina thupina ziehin, Na melmate na kungah akipelut ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Leitung pumpi in nangma ahing be ding ua, Na min phat in la asa ding uhi” chi un. Selah."},"5":{"text":"Hing pei unlen Pasian nasepte hing en un, mihingtate lah a asilbawlte chizat huoitah ahi."},"6":{"text":"Aman tuipi gamgaw asuohsah a, amaun kengin tuipi apal galkai uhi. Khunah eite Ama ah inuom uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 14.21; Josh. 3.14-17"},"7":{"text":"Aman a silbawltheina in kumtawn in vai ahawm a, amitte gel in namte a en ngitnget hi; mihelhatte amauleh amauh kipahtawi sih uheh. Selah."},"8":{"text":"Michinte aw i Pasian pahtawi unlen, Ama phatna aw ging kiza sah un."},"9":{"text":"Ama’n ihinna uh ahing asuhing pieh ngitnget a, i kengte uh kitawl aphal sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen Aw Pasian nang koute na hing enchien a, dangka sia etchien bangin na hing en chien hi."},"11":{"text":"Nangman len thang sungah na hing puiluta; Ka el uah hasatna vangih na hing posah hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka lutung uah mite na tuong sah a, meikuong leh tuite kantan in ka pei ua; hinanleh zong mun hausatah ah na hing puilutta hi."},"13":{"text":"Halmang sillatte toh na biehinn ah ka hing lut ding a; ka thuchiemte na kungah ka tangtun ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi, lungkham mangbang a ka umlai a, ka kam in aphuondohte leh ka kam in, agendohte khu."},"15":{"text":"Na kungah ganthautah halmang kithoinate ka lan dinga, belamtal kithoina meikhu gimnamtui toh ka lan dinga; bawngtalte leh kelte zong ka lan ding hi. Selah."},"16":{"text":"Nou Pasian zaudan siemte zousie hing pei unlen, hing ngaikhie un, ka hinna dinga asilbawlte ka hing theisah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Akungah ah ka kam in ka kikou a, Ka lei a pahtawi in aum hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka lungtanga gitlouna ka ngaituo leh, Mangpa’n ahing ngaikhe sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in ahing ngaikhe tahtah a, ka thungetna aw gingte angaikheta hi."},"20":{"text":"Pasian phat in um hen, Aziehpen aman ka thumna aniel sih a; a khotuona zong ahing it sih hi."}}},"67":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian in eite hing khotuo henlen, hing guolzawl henlen, eite tungah amai tangsah hen. Selah.","title":"Pasian in leitung vai ahawm ding Lapulien a ding: kaiging asah-Phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Na lampi khu leitunga mithei ahitheina dingin leh, nam zousiete lah ah na hundamna akitheina ding in."},"3":{"text":"Aw Pasian, miten nangma hing phat uhenlen, namte zousie in nangma hing phat uhen."},"4":{"text":"Aw namte kipah uhenlen nuom in la sa uhen, aziehpen dihtattah in namte vai na hawmpieh dinga, leitung nam zousie tungah thu na nei ding hi. Selah."},"5":{"text":"Aw Pasian miten nangma hing phat uhenlen, mi zousie in nangma hing phat uhen."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n leitungin ga tampi asuong dinga, Pasian i Pasian ngei un ahing guolzawl ding a,"},"7":{"text":"Pasian in ahing guolzawl ding a, Tualeh kawlmong tana mi zousiein Ama agiing ding uhi."}}},"68":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian thou henlen, amelmate thethang henlen ama mudate, zong amasangah taizah uheh!","title":"Pasian pa neiloute pa Lapulien ading: David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Meikhu semmanga a um bangin amauh semmang in, khuoilu meisa a azunmang bangin, migiloute Pasian masangah mangthai uhen."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh midihtatte vang kipahtahin um uhenlen, Pasian masangah nuom uhen Ahi kipahtah in nuom uhen."},"4":{"text":"Pasian pahtawi in la sa unlen, amin phat in la sa un; meilum tunga tuongpa a dingin la ngaitah sa un. Amin MANGPA ahi amasangah pahtawi un."},"5":{"text":"Pasian a umna Siengthou a um khu; Pa neiloute Pa leh meithaite kembitpa ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian in mitangkhatte innkuon ding abawlpieh a; Aman hentate zong lawchinna mun ah apuidoh zel a, helhatte pen gamgaw ah ateng sah hi."},"7":{"text":"Aw Pasian na mite pui a amasang ua, na hing pawtdoh lai in, gamdai gamgaw a na peisuohpi lai in. Selah."},"8":{"text":"Leitung akilinga vanten zong, Pasian mai ah guo azu sah ua, Sinai muol nangawn zong, Pasian masangah Israelte Pasian, masangah akiling hi.","ref":"Pawt. 19.18"},"9":{"text":"Aw Pasian nangman guo tampi na zu sah a, tuakhuin nagoutan basama athatawl lai un na sudet hi."},"10":{"text":"Nami pui mipite tua mun ah ateng ua, Aw Pasian Nangman na hoina in, gentheite a dingin na bawlpieh hi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa’n thu apie a, tuami thuphuongzahte khu pawl thupitah ahi uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Galkapte leengte ataizah ua atai mang ua,” inn ngah a um numeiten galvanlahte akihawm uhi."},"13":{"text":"Belam kul sungah lum nan u’leh zong, vakhu ha dangka tui a luonkhum a ahamulte zong, sana eng tui a luonkhum bang na hing hiding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Bangkimbawlthei pa’n tua mun a leengte athethang lai in, Zalmon taang a vua kia bang ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Pasian taang khu Bashan muol ahi a, Bashan taang khu muolsang tampite umna ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nou muolsang tampite aw bangdinga Pasian in, atenna dinga alunggul muol khu thangsiet na hi uoi, Tami taang khu Pasian in atenna ding a adei taang khu ahi. Khunah Mangpa kumtawnin ateng den ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian sakollengte tul sawmni, tualeh atul atul atam ahi uhi. Mangpa khu Sinai muola a um bangin, alah uah mun siengthou ah aum hi."},"18":{"text":"Nang muol tungsang lamah na kaltou a, na galhing matte sal in na zawpi a, mihingte dingin silpiehte na mu a; mi helhatte lah nangawn ah zong, tuachia Mangpa alah ua aten theina dingin.","ref":"Eph. 4.8"},"19":{"text":"Mangpa nichin a sil phatuom hing guonpa i hundamna Pasian ngel khu phat in umta hen. Selah."},"20":{"text":"Eite Pasian khu hundamna Pasian ahi a, tualeh Mangpa Pasian kungah, shina akipata suotatna thute a um hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in amelmate lutang leh, atatkhelna lampi ua pei nalaite, samphatna luvunte asuliem ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa’n, “Bashan a kipat amaute ka puikia dinga, tuipi thuhpi tah akipat in amauh ka puidoh ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachia, na kengte uh na melmate sisan a, na die theina ding uleh na uite un zong, na melmate uh sisan alieh theina ding in,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Aw Pasian mi honpi kizui a na puidan a muta ua; ka Pasian ka Lengpa, amun Siengthou a apei laite amuta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Lasa pawlte amasangah apei ua, tumging tumten a zui ua alah uah nungahten, khutbeh gingtheite tawi in apei uhi."},"26":{"text":"“Mipi kikhopnate ah Pasian phat unlen, Israel tuinah akipat in Mangpa phat un.”"},"27":{"text":"Amaute lamkai in nautum Benjamin apanga, Juda phung a miliente, Zebulun miliente leh Naphtali miliente, tampi zong alah uah a um uhi."},"28":{"text":"Pasian in na hatna thu apeta hi. Aw Pasian, koute dinga na bawlsate suhat in."},"29":{"text":"Jerusalem a na biehinn ziehin, leengten na kungah nuomman silpiehte, ahing tawi ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Pumpeng lah a gamsate, bawngnoute lah a bawngtal honte, mite bawngnoute leh dangka tang tawi a, ahing kipiehlut masangsie un phawh hil in. Kidou lunggul mite nangman thelthang sahin."},"31":{"text":"Izipt apat miliente ahing pawt ding ua, Ethiopia in Pasian langah kintah in, akhut uh azah ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Nou leitung leenggamte aw, Pasian kungah pahtawina la sa unlen. Oh! Mangpa phat in la sa un. Selah."},"33":{"text":"Vante van taanglai vante tunga tuongpa’n, ngai in aw asuo a aw thahattah, ahing sawlkhie hi."},"34":{"text":"Pasian kungah vangletna pie un, athupina chizat huoi Israelte tungah a um hi. Asilbawltheina vanmeipi tungah a um hi."},"35":{"text":"Aw Pasian nang pen na amunsiengthou sangin, na zauhuoi zaw hi, Israel Pasian in amite kungah, silbawltheina leh hatna apie hi. Pasian phat in um hen."}}},"69":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian hing hundam in, aziehpen tuiten ka ngawng tan chieng ahing tumta hi.","title":"Simmawna thuohmi phuba lah ding ngetna Lapulien a ding. Shoshanim a sah ding David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Buonnawi thuhpi sungah ka tum a, pansie ding um vawtlou hi; tui thuhpi sung ah ka kie a, tuilet in ahing vuakhumta hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka kikou kounain ka gimgawpta a, ka dang zong a gaw gawpta hi. Ka Pasian ka ngahna lam in, ka mitte a miel gawpta hi."},"4":{"text":"Azieh bei a hing mudate lah ka luzang a, samzangte sangin atamzaw uhi; dihloutah a hingdou a, suhmang hing tumte atam mama uhi, ka guhloupi zong ahing dinsah uhi.","ref":"Late. 35.19; Jn. 15.25"},"5":{"text":"Aw Pasian Nangman ka motdan na thei hi, ka khelnate na masang ah phuolguh ahi sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Aw Mangpa galkapte Pasian nangma hing ngahte, keima zieh in maizum sahin um sih uheh; Aw Israelte Pasian nangma hing suite khu, Keima ziehin zala in um sih uheh."},"7":{"text":"Nangma ziehin gensietna ka thuoh a, zumna in ka mai akhuta hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka unaute lah ah zong khuolzin mi bang kana hita hi, ka nu tate lah nangawn ah gamdang mi ka suohta hi."},"9":{"text":"Na inn a dinga ka phattuom ngaina in ahing nebeita a; Nangma hing gensete hing gensietna khu ka tungah, akibungta hi.","ref":"Jn. 2.17; Rom. 15.3"},"10":{"text":"Ka kap a tualeh ka hinna ann ngawl a, ka ki suhgim chiengin lah gensiet a ka umna giap ahita hi."},"11":{"text":"Puonsila Sai ip ka zah chiengin, ama ua dingin houlim nopna bep ka hita hi."},"12":{"text":"Kulpi kotkha a toute houlimna leh gensiet ka hi a, zukhamte la kana hita hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa kei pen hun kipahhuoi ah, Nangma kungah ka hing thum hi. Aw Pasian na khotuona thupitah leh, Na hundamna thutahin hing dawngin."},"14":{"text":"Buonnawi lah a kipat in hing kaidoh inlen, hing tumsah vawt sin, ahing mudate leh tui thuhpi akipat in hing hunkhie in."},"15":{"text":"Tui lien in hing tummang sih henlen, tui thuhpi in zong hing valmang sih heh, kokhuh in zong akam hing chikhum sih heh."},"16":{"text":"Aw Mangpa hing dawngin, Na itna tulngailou ahoi hi, na khotuona kiningchingtah dungzui in, kei langah hing kihei in."},"17":{"text":"Na suohpa akipat in na mai phuol sin, aziehpen chimaw a mangbang ka hi, hing dawng meng in."},"18":{"text":"Ka hinna hing nai inlen hing tandoh in, ka galte zieh in hing hundoh in."},"19":{"text":"Nangman mite hing gensietna ka zumnate, mi hing simmawnate na thei hi, ka melmate zousie na masangah aum uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mite hing gensietnate in ka lungtang hasie in akehzah a, tualeh lungkham mangbangin in ka um hi; ahing hepi ding mi ka sui a hinanleh ka mu sih hi; tualeh ahing hamuon ding mi ka sui a, hinanleh koima ka mu zou sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka ann dingin shitheina gu ahing pie ua, ka dangtah chienga ka dawn dingin, zupawng thuapi ahing pie uhi.","ref":"Mat. 27.48; Mak. 15.36; Luk. 23.26; Jn. 19.28,29"},"22":{"text":"Amasang ua adawkan uh thang hing suoh henlen, anopsahnate uh zong ama ua dingin piel suohta heh.","ref":"Rom. 11.9,10"},"23":{"text":"Akhomu theilouna dingun amitte uh hing miel henlen, akawngte uh kithingsah ngitnget in."},"24":{"text":"Na thangpaina amaute tungah sungbuo inlen, na lungthahna meikuongin amaute man heh."},"25":{"text":"Atenna munte khogemnua suoh henlen, apuon innte uah koima teng sih u heh.","ref":"Nasep. 1.20"},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen nang na vuohpa amauten asuhgenthei ua, nang na liemsah mite lungkhamna khu houlim na’n anei uhi."},"27":{"text":"A gitlouna tung uah gitlouna belap inlen, na dihtatna ah lut sih uheh."},"28":{"text":"Hinna laibu apat thaimangin um uhenlen, midihtatte lah ah gel tel hi sih uheh.","ref":"Pawt. 32.32; Kihil. 3.5; 13.8; 17.8"},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh kei pen genthei leh lunggim ka hi a, Aw Pasian na hundamna in kei mun sangah hing koi hen."},"30":{"text":"Pasian min lain ka phat dinga, kipahthu genna toh amin ka pahtawi ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tami’n, kii leh chin nei bawngtal leh bawngpa sangin, Mangpa alungdamsah zaw ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Mikingaingiemte’n tami amu ding ua akipah ding uhi. Nou Pasian suite aw na lungtang uh ahing ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n tasamte aw aza a, ami saltangte asimmaw ngai sih hi."},"34":{"text":"Lei leh van in ama phat henlen tuipi leh asunga, ganhing pia thei poumain ama phat hen."},"35":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in Zion ahundam dinga, Juda khopite alamtha kia ding hi; khuna amite aten ua, a nei theina ding un."},"36":{"text":"A suohte hahlesuonte’n tua mun aluo ding ua, tualeh Ama min itte asungah ateng ding uhi."}}},"70":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian kei hing hunkhe dingin hing kin mengin, Aw Mangpa ang panpi dingin hing kinawin.","title":"Genthei leh tasamte a dinga thungetna Lapulien a ding: David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Ka hinna lahmang tum a suite maizum uhenlen, buoizah uheh, ka liem ding lunggulte khu, nuakia sah in um uhenlen, zalatah leh chimaw tah in um uhen."},"3":{"text":"“Tuohkha e, tuohkha e,” chite a maizum zieh un kinuale sah kia in."},"4":{"text":"Nangma hing sui poumate, nangma ah nuomin kipah uhen, Na hundamna it poumaten, “Pasian pahtawi in um hen;” chi ngitnget uhen chi uhen."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh keipen genthei leh tasam ka hi a, Aw Pasian ka kungah hing pei mengin, Kei hing panpipa leh ka tanpa Nang na hi, Mangpa aw hing kiheh sin."}}},"71":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangma ah ginna ka koi hi, maizum in hing um sah ngai vawt sin.","title":"Pasian hundamna suongpi"},"2":{"text":"Na dihtatnain hing hunkhie inlen hing suotasah in, kei langah na bil hingdaw inlen hing hundam in."},"3":{"text":"Kei a dingin kibutna suongpi leh kulpi dettah, hi inlen hing hundam dingin thu pie in; aziehpen nang ka suongpi leh ka kulpi na hi."},"4":{"text":"Aw ka Pasian, migiloute khut apat in, midihtatlou leh, mitatsete khut a kipat in hing hunkhie in."},"5":{"text":"Aw Pasian nangma ka kinepna na hi a, ka khangdawn lai a kipat a ka muon na hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka pien a kipat in Nangma tudet in ka um a, ka nu gilsung a kipat a hing lakhie nangma na hi. Nang ka hing phat den ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi tampite’n lamdang ahing sah uh ka hi a, hinanleh nangpen ka kihumbitna dettah na hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka kam nangma phatnain dim henlen, sun nitum in nangma pahtawina in dim hen."},"9":{"text":"Ka tehsiet chiengin hing paikhe sinlen, ka thahatna abei chiengin hing taisan sin."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen ka melmaten ahing gensie ua, ka hinna lahmang sawma ngahte akikumkhawm uhi."},"11":{"text":"“Pasian in ama anuasieta, nuadel unlen man un, ama hunkhe ding koima a um sih hi,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Aw Pasian hing gamlat sinlen, Aw ka Pasian kei hing panpi dingin kin mengin!"},"13":{"text":"Ka hinna hing doute suhmangin um uhenlen, ka liemna ding sui mite khu gensietna leh, zumna in tuomkhumta hen."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh kei vang ka kinem ngitnget dinga, tualeh ka hing phat sem sem nalai ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka kam in na dihtatna nasepte ka gen dinga, sun nitum in na hundamna nasepte ka gen ding hi; atamdan ka pilna in theizou sih nanlehzong."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian hatna in ka hing pei ding a, na dihtatna nangma a bou khu ka genzel ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Aw Pasian ka naupan lai akipat in, nangman na hing hilta a, tuni tan in na sil lamdang bawlte, ka phuongzah nalai hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka hing tehsiet a, ka sam ahing kaan chiengin zong, Aw Pasian hing taisan sin, Na hatna leh na silbawltheina, khangtha hing um nalai dingte kunga, ka phuonzah masangsie in."},"19":{"text":"Aw Pasian na dihtatna zong asang mama a, Nang sil thupitahte bawlpa na hia, Aw Pasian nangma bang koi ahiei um?"},"20":{"text":"Nang lungkham buoina leh vangsietna, tampi hing musahpa’n na hing halthasah kia dinga, leimun thuhpi apat in na hing puidoh kia ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Nangman ka thupina na khangsah dinga, mun chin ah na hing hamuon ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Aw ka Pasian na gin umna zieh in, tumging toh ka hing phat dinga, Aw nang Israel Misiengthoupa; pehging toh nangma phat in la kasa ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Nangma phatna la ka sah chiengin, ka kam nuomsa in akikou ding hi; Na tatsa ka hinna mama zong akipah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka lei in zong sun nitum in, na dihtatna thute agen ding hi, aziehpen kei hing liemsah tumte, zalatsah leh maizum sah in aumta uhi."}}},"72":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian na vaihawmna dihtah khu, leengpa pie inlen, na dihtatna khu leengpa tapa pie in.","title":"Messiah leenggam vaihawmna Solomon phatna la"},"2":{"text":"Aman na mipite tungah, dihtatna toh vaiahawm pieh dinga, na migentheite thudih in vaiahawm pieh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Taangten mipite kungah, hamuonna atungsah dinga, muol neuten dihtatna atungsah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman mite lah a gentheite vaiahawm pieh ding a, mitasam tate ahunkhe ding hi, tualeh mi nuoisiehatte a gawt guoi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaun, ni leh ha um sungsie akhang akhangin, Nang ahing giing ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ama khu hampa ki metmai tunga guozu bang leh, leitung tapnou guomal phin bang ahi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama damsung nite in dihtatna akhanglien dinga, hapi um nawnlou tan dongin lemna leh, muonna akhang lien ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aman tuipi akipat tuipi langkhat tan dong tualeh, luipi akipat leimong tawp dong vai ahawm ding hi.","ref":"Zek. 9.10"},"9":{"text":"Gamdai a tengte amasangah akun ding ua, tualeh amelmaten leivui alieh ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tarshish gam leh tuikuolkhum gam leengten, silpiehte ahing tawi ding ua, Sheba leh Seba leengten silpiehte ahing tawi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi, leengte zousie amasangah akun ding ua, nam zousie’n ana asem ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen mitasamten ahat chiengun aman ahunkhe dinga, mi genthei leh panpi ding neiloute zong ahunkhe ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Aman mi zawngte leh tasamte akhawi dinga, tasamte hinna a hundam ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Suhgentheina leh hiemngamna a kipat in, amauh hinna ahunkhe dinga, ama mitmu ah asisan uh amanpha ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama ahing dinga, akungah, Sheba gama sanate pieh ahi ding hi, Ama a dingin thunget tawp louin akinei pieh zing dinga, Ni chin in ama phat in a um ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Leitung ah butang kiningchingtah in a um ding a, taangte tungah bu vuite Lebanon bangin akiil ding ua, tualeh khopi mite khu leitunga hampa bangin, aphung pha ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amin kumtawn in a um dinga, ni ataan laisie aminthang tawntungta ding hi. Nam zousiete ama vangin guolzawl in a um ding ua, Nam zousie in ama hampha achi ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian Israelte Pasian phat in um hen, Ama bou in sil lamdangte abawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama min thupitah kumtawn a phat in um henlen; leitung pumpi ah athupina dim sah in um hen Amen, Amen."},"20":{"text":"Jesse tapa David thungetna abeita hi."}}},"73":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Adihtahin Pasian Israelte tungah ahoi a, lungtang siengthoute tungah ahoi tahtah hi.","title":"BU THUMNA (Late 73-89) Tangtawn um dan. Asaph phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh kei pen ka kengte akipalpua dihdih a, ka kalsuonte akitaal dihdih hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen migiloute vangphatna ka mu chienga, mi kisatheite eng kha zel ka hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen tuabang miten ashi chiengun, thuonatna mawngmawng anei sih ua, ahatna uh adet zawsop hi."},"5":{"text":"Midangte bangin lungkhamna atuoh khasih ua, midangte bangin vangsietna zong atuoh khasih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuazieh in kiletsahna in khi bangin a ngawng uh aviel a, hiemngamna in puon bangin atuom khum hi."},"7":{"text":"Thauna zieh in amitte uh apawngdoh lelaw a, alungtangin adei sanga tamzaw anei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amauten suhgentheina thuohte giloutahin asimmaw ua, ki uongsahtah in aham uhi."},"9":{"text":"A kam un vante douna thu agen ua, alei un leitung pumpi atuonsuoh uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin mite tamlang ah anua kia ua, Tui nou a dim khu amauh dawnkangin a um hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh aman Pasian in “Bang achithei diei? Tungnung pen in theina anei amah?” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Envawi, tamte khu Pasian phawhkhalou a, mivangpha leh nuomsate ahi ua, ahausatna uh apung semsem hi."},"13":{"text":"Adihtahin athawn giap in ka lungtang, ka susienga ka khut gensiet bei in ka silsieng hi,"},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen sun nitum in gawt in ka uma, zingmawng chin in thunun in ka um hi."},"15":{"text":"“Ken tambangin thu gen vang na chita leng,” Ngaivawi, nahah nasuonte tate tunga thudihlou ka na hita ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tami theisiem ding dan ka ngaituo chiengin, kei a dingin ana seng taluo hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian mun siengthou ka lut a abeina ding uh, ka theidoh masangsie’n."},"18":{"text":"Adihtah in nang amaute anaalna mun ah na koi a, manthaina ah na kesah zel hi."},"19":{"text":"Bangchidan a mitphiet kallou a ingam sieng atamawh di uoi; gimnei leh chizathuoi tah a suhmangthai in a umta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mi akhahlaw chieng a amang uh bangma ahilou bangin, Aw Mangpa na khahlaw chiengin alim ukhu, Bangma nasa sih ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuabanga ka hinna agenthei chiengin, ka lungtang sut bang in ana hi."},"22":{"text":"Kei pen mimawl leh, bangmatheilou gam sa bang giap ka hi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahivang in kei pen na kungah ka um ngitnget a, ka khut zietlam na hing tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Nangman na lemguotna in na hing pui dinga, tuazou chiengin thupina ah na hing latou ta ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Van ah nang chilou koi ahiei ka nei?
