Leitungah zong nang chilou koima ka lunggul sih hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka tahsa leh ka lungsim gim in aba ta hi, hinanleh Pasian khu kumtawn a ka lungtang hatna leh ka goutan ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ngaivawi, nangma hing gamlatte amangbei ding ua, nang hing nuasie a hing ang kawmsan poumate, na sumangthang ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh kei a dingin vang Pasian nai ahoi hi; Na nasepte zousie ka phuondoh theina dingin, Mangpa Pasian nangma ah ka ginna ka koi hi."}}},"74":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian, bangdinga koute hing paimang den na hiei? Bangdinga na gantatna mun a belamte tunga, na lungthahna meikhu ahiei?","title":"Pasian mite panpina ngen a thumna Asaph phatna Late Maskil"},"2":{"text":"Nidang lai a na leisa na mikikhawmte, na goutan nam hidinga na tatsate leh, na umna Zion muol thei ngitnget in."},"3":{"text":"Kumtawn sietna lam ah kal hing suon in; melmaten munsiengthou ah silgilou chinteng abawl uhi."},"4":{"text":"Na melmate na mite kikhopna munte lah ah akikou ua, apuonlapte uh chiemtena dingin azah uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mi gammang sing heipi a satding a ngimte bang ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin vang akhuohthaw a kilawmtah a kizem zousiete, heitang leh sehta in asuse sieng uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na munsiengthou mei in ahaltum ua, na min umna mun leilah a paiin asubuata uhi,"},"8":{"text":"Amauten alungtang un, “Mangthaisah sieng vai” akichi ua, gamsunga Pasian mina kikhopna inn zousie, ahaltum sieng keei uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ka chiemtenate uh ka mu nawnsih ua, guolnei mawngmawng lah a um nawn sih a, tambang gentheinate bangtan a sawt ding ahiei chi, athei mawngmawng ka lah uah koima a um sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Aw Pasian bangtan vei ahiei melmaten ahing gensiet ding uh? Melmaten na min agensiet kumtawn ding uh ata diei?"},"11":{"text":"Bangdinga na khut, na zietlam khut nangawn na nua lahkia ahiei? Na awm a pat in zandoh kia inlen amaute sumang in."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian khu nidanglai peh a kipat a ka leengpa ahi a, leitunga hundamna siempa ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nangman na hatna in tuipi na kikhen sah a, tui sunga um gulpi lutang na satkeh pieh hi.","ref":"Pawt. 14.21"},"14":{"text":"Leviathan lutangte na satguoi pieh a, gamdai a mi umte ann dingin na pie hi.","ref":"Job. 41.1; Late. 104.26; Isai. 27.1"},"15":{"text":"Nang tuikhuh leh luipi nahte na khen a, kang ngailou luipiliente na kangtansah hi."},"16":{"text":"Sun nanga ahia zan zong nanga ahi, nang khovah leh ni na siem hi."},"17":{"text":"Nangman leitung gamgi zousie na hun pieh a, Nipi leh phalbi zong na bawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, tami thei ngitnget in, melmaten ang simmaw dan uleh, nam moten na min asuhsiet dan uh!"},"19":{"text":"Oh! na vakhu hinna gamsahangte kungah pe vawt sinlen, na migentheite hinna zong kumtawn in manghil den sin."},"20":{"text":"Na thuhun zatat inlen, aziehpen leitung khomielna munte ah, bawlsietna umna in a dim hi."},"21":{"text":"Oh! nuoisiena thuohte khu zala in nuakia sih uhenlen, mizawngte leh tasamten na min phat u’hen."},"22":{"text":"Aw Pasian thou inlen na tungtang thu ki gen in; mi moin sun nitum a ahing gensiet dan thei ngitnget in."},"23":{"text":"Na melmate aw suoh khu manghil sinlen, nang hing doute kikou husa dailou in aging tawntung hi."}}},"75":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian na kungah kipahthu ka hing tut uh a, nuom thu Ka hing gen uhi, na min anai ngal a. Na sil lamdang bawlten na min anai hi chi’n aphuong uhi.","title":"Thukhen dihtah Pasian Lapulien ading, Al tash’heth a sah ding Asaph phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Hun lemtang ka muchiengin dihtahin vai ka hawm ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Leitung leh asunga umte zousie azunmang siengta, akhuompite phutdetpa keima ka hi. Selah."},"4":{"text":"Ki uongsahte kungah “Kiuongsah sih un” kachi a, migiloute kungah zong “Na kii uh sangsah sih un, ka chi hi."},"5":{"text":"Na kii uh vanlam ah vihsang sih unlen, tualeh ngawng vaipuohin thu gen sih un.”"},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen kaisangna khu suolam ahiei, tumlam ahiei simlam ahiei ahisihleh gamdai ahiei a, hing kipan zong ahi sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian khu vaihawm thukhenpa ahi, Aman khat angiemsah a adang khat adomsang hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa khut ah nou khat a um a, uoin khu asan hi hoitah a kitohhal ahi a, Aman tuakhu asungkhe dinga leitunga migiloute zousie in, a hineng nasan adawn sieng kiukiau ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh ken vang kumtawn in, nuomtahin ka phuongzah ding a, Jakob Pasian phat in la kasa ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Migiloute kii zousie ka sattan dinga, hinanleh midihtatte kii khu tawisang in a um ding hi."}}},"76":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judate lah ah Pasian thei ahi a, Israelte lah ah amin athupi hi.","title":"Pasian thahatna leh guolzawna Lapulien a ding: Kaiging guinei toh sah ding: Asaph phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Salem ah zong abiehbuh a um a, Tualeh Zion ah a umna mun a um hi."},"3":{"text":"Khunah Aman thalpi thaltangte asutana a, lum leh namsaute tualeh galvante toh."},"4":{"text":"Nang pen sabehna taangte sangin, na thupi zaw a tualeh na hoi zaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Lungtang khaute pen gallah in a um ua, a imu ua a imu denta uhi; tuachi’n a mihatte uh koiman akhut uh, aphongdoh zou nawn sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aw Jakob Pasian na phawhhilna ziehin sakolleng leh, sakolte ashi banga imutsah in a um tuohta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma mama giin ding na hi. Na lungthah chienga na masanga ding ngam ding koi ahiei?"},"8":{"text":"Nang na vaihawmna thu van a pat in, naza sah a leitung pumpi zau in asip dide ta hi."},"9":{"text":"Leitunga suhgenthei a umte hundam dinga, Pasian thu khenna bawl dinga ahing kipatdoh lai in. Selah."},"10":{"text":"Pellou in mihing lungthahna in nang ahing phat ding a, lungthahna vaal in na kigah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian kung uah thuchiem bawl unlen sutangtung un, akimvel a mi zousie in a zaudingpa Ama kungah silpieh hing tawi uheh."},"12":{"text":"Aman leengtapate kideikhopna lungsimte asattan dinga, leitung leengte a dingin ama azauhuoi ahi."}}},"77":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka aw in Pasian ka han a, ka aw in Pasian ngei ka han a; Aman kei lam ah abil ahing daw hi.","title":"Lungkham ni chienga Pasian thupina phohdoh kiana Lapulien a ding Jeduthun-a sah ding; Asaph phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Ka lungkham ni chiengin Mangpa ka sui a, zan tungtawn in ka khutte lakhelou in ka zah den a, ka hinna in hamuongtah a um adei sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasian ka thei ngitnget a ka buoita a, ka lungkim sih a ka hagau abata hi. Selah."},"4":{"text":"Nang ka mitte na hahsah a, ham theilou khop in ka buoita hi."},"5":{"text":"Nidanglai hunte ka ngaituo a tanglai kumte khu,"},"6":{"text":"Zanlai a ka lasahte ka geldoh a, zanlai in ka lungsim toh kaki houlim a, ka hagauin phatuomngaitahin a kansui zel hi."},"7":{"text":"“Mangpa’n kumtawn in apaikhe den ding adiei? Bangchihtan a deisah kia nawn lou ding ata diei?"},"8":{"text":"A khotuona khu mangden ding ata diei? Athuchiemkhu kumtawna tangtunglou den ding ata diei?"},"9":{"text":"Pasian in ahepisiemna manghil ata diei? Alungthahna in ami khotuona nemnou a khahkhum ahita diei?” Selah."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh ken “Tam pen ka lungkham man hibou; hinanleh Tungnungpen zietlam khut kumte ka thei ngitnget ding hi,”"},"11":{"text":"Mangpa nasepte ka thei ngitnget dinga, nidanglai a Na silbawl lamdangte ka geldoh zing ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na nasep zousiete zong ka ngaituo dinga, Na silbawlte houlimnain ka nei ding hi, ka chi hi."},"13":{"text":"Aw Pasian na lampite khu munsiengthou ah aum hi. Eite Pasian banga thupi koi pasien ahiei?"},"14":{"text":"Nang pen sillamdangte bawlpa Pasian na hi a, michinte lah ah na hatdan na phuongdohta hi."},"15":{"text":"Nang na banthahat in na mite na tandoh a, Jakob leh Joseph hahlesuonte. Selah."},"16":{"text":"Aw Pasian tuiten nang ahing mu ua, tuiten nangma ahing mu chieng un azau ua, tuithuhpite na ngawn zong akiling uhi."},"17":{"text":"Meilumten tui asungbuo ua, vanten aw asuo ua na thaltangte akikap phe zotzot hi."},"18":{"text":"Na vanpi ging khu pingpei lah ah a um a, kawlphie in leitung atanvah zotzot a, leitung ling in, akithing hi."},"19":{"text":"Na lampi tuipi tungah akihunga, na keng lampi zong tuipi thupitah tungah apei a, hinanleh na ketotte koiman a mu sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangman Mosi leh Aaron khut in na mipite belamhon bangin na pui hi."}}},"78":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka mite aw, ka danthu ngaikhie unlen, ka kam a thupawtte ah na bil uh daw un.","title":"Israelte tunga Pasian nasep Lapuliena ding: Asaph phatna la, Maskil."},"2":{"text":"Gentena thu gen in ka kam ka kah dinga, nidanglai a thugil kigente ka gendoh dinga,","ref":"Mat. 13.35"},"3":{"text":"I bil ua izahsa u’leh itheisate, ipu ipaten ang na hilsate uh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tuate khu atate lah uah i im sih ding ua, khangtha hing um dingte kungah, Mangpa phatna thu leh athahatdan leh, asillamdang bawl dante ihil zaw ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aman Jakobte lah ah athutheisahte asukip a, Israelte lah ah dan aguot hi. Tuakhu Aman ipu i pate kungah, atate uh kunga ahilsawn ding un thu ana pie hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuakhu khangtha hing um dingte leh, naupang hing pieng dingte nangawn in atheina dingun, tualeh amaute athaw ua atate uh kunga ahil sawn zel ding uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Pasian a akinepna uh akoi theina ding u’leh, Pasian nasepte amanghillou ua, athupiehte azui theina dinguh ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh apu apate uh banga khang genha leh helhat, lungtang dihlou nei khangte leh ahinna hagaute uh, Pasian a dinga gin umlou ahilouna ding uh ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ephraim tate thalpi tawikawm a kigal thuom hinapiin, kidou ni chiengin ataizah uhi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian thuhun azui sih ua, adanthu zong azui nuom sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"A silbawlte leh a sillamdang bawl amusahte amanghilta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Aman Izipt gamsunga Zoar phaijangah apu apate uh, mitmu in sillamdangte abawl hi.","ref":"Pawt. 7.8—12.32"},"13":{"text":"Aman tuipi akikhensah a, amaute apei galkai sah hi; tuite khu bangkhat kichieng bangin ading sah hi.","ref":"Pawt. 14.21,22"},"14":{"text":"Sun chiengin meipi in apui a, zan tungtawn in meikuongin apui hi.","ref":"Pawt. 13.21,22"},"15":{"text":"Gamdai gamgaw mun ah suongpite akhipawh sah a, tuithuhpi akipat a hing luongdoh bangin tui dawn ding apie hi."},"16":{"text":"Suongpi akipat in tuinahte apuldoh sah a, tuite luipi bangin aluongkhe sah hi.","ref":"Pawt. 17.1-7; Kisim. 20.2-13"},"17":{"text":"Khuchi pumpum in zong Atungah sil abawl khiel ua, gamdai ah Tungnung pen tungah ahel nalai lai uhi."},"18":{"text":"A gongsan uh phatna dingin ann ngen in, alungtang un Pasian a ze et uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 16.2-15; Kisim. 11.4-23,31-35"},"19":{"text":"Ahi Pasian douin thu agen ua, “Pasian in gamdai ah annkuong ang luipieh thei na ngel diei izaw?"},"20":{"text":"En di ua suongpi asat a tuite ahing puldoh a, tuite lui bangin aluonglet hi, ann zong ang pe thei diei izaw? Amite a dingin sa ang pe thei ngel diei?” achi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuazieh in Mangpa’n tam thu azah tahin alungthah mama a, tuachi’n Jakob tungah mei akuongdoh a, Israel tungah athangpaina asouta hi."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun Pasian agingta sih ua, ahundamna zong amuong zou sih uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinapiin Aman tunglam vante thu apie a, tualeh van kotkhate ahonpieh a,"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh a neh ding un atung uah manna guo bangin azu sah a, amaute van akipat ann neh ding apie hi.","ref":"Jn. 6.31"},"25":{"text":"Mihingten vansawltahte ann ane ua, aman amaute kiningching tahin neh ding apie hi."},"26":{"text":"Vanlaizawl ah suolam hui alaang sah a, a silbawltheina in simlam hui zong alangsah hi."},"27":{"text":"Amaute tungah leivui bangmai a tam sa guohzuh bangin azusah a, tuipi pieunel bang mai a tam aha nei vate a zusah hi."},"28":{"text":"Aman agiehphuol sung uah akesah a, a umna kimvel uah atusah hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n ane ua agilva ngel uhi. Aman alunggulte uh amauh apie hi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh agongsan uh apha nai tuom sih a, akamsung ua a ann um nalai in."},"31":{"text":"Pasian lungthahna atung uah asouta a, alah ua mi hat penpente athat a, Israel tangval thahat leh hoite asatpua lemlumta hi."},"32":{"text":"Hichi pumpumin zong akhiel nalai lai ua, asillamdang bawlte mu napi in, agingta theisih uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n adamsung nite uh bangmalouin asuhbei pieh a, akumte uh zaunain aumsah hi."},"34":{"text":"Pasian in amauh atha chiengin Ama asui ua, akisia ua lungtanga kithalawp tahin Ama asui uhi."},"35":{"text":"Pasian khu asuongpi uh ahi chi leh, Pasian Tungnung Pen khu amauh tanpa ahi chi atheidoh zel uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ahivang in akam un Ama aphat khem ua, alei un akungah zuouthu agen uhi."},"37":{"text":"Alungtangte uh Ama tungah adet sih a, Athuhun ah zong amuonhuoi sih uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 8.21"},"38":{"text":"Khuchi hinapiin zong Ama pen lainatna a dim ahiziehin, agitlouna uh angaidam a amaute asumang sih hi. Tamveipi alungthahna akideh a, athangpaina asupiching nuom sih hi."},"39":{"text":"Aziehpen tahsa giap ahi uh chi leh, nahna hu hing nua kia nawnlou ding bang ahi uh, chi athei ngitnget hi."},"40":{"text":"Gamdaiah Ama tungah ahel mun mama ua, gamgaw mun ah Ama lungkham sah mun hina va-ia uh e!"},"41":{"text":"Ahi, akinuahei kia ua Pasian a ze et zih zeh ua, Israelte Misiengthoupa alunggim sah uhi."},"42":{"text":"A silbawltheina alungsim uah akeem sih ua, amelmate ua pat a amaute atatdoh nite ageldoh ngai sih uhi."},"43":{"text":"Izipt gama chiemtena abawlte leh, Zoan gamlah a sil lamdang abawlte atheikha nawn sih uhi."},"44":{"text":"Aman aluipite uh sisan asuoh sah a, lui a pat tuite adawn theita sih uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 7.17-21"},"45":{"text":"Aman thoupihon alah uah asawl a, tuate’n amauh anekhawnga, tualeh u kengte zong asawl a, tuate’n amauh asumangthai hi.","ref":"Pawt. 8.20-24; Pawt. 8.1-6"},"46":{"text":"Aman ahaichi zousie uh lungnoute kungah apie a; tualeh anasep gimgate uh khauphete kungah apie hi.","ref":"Pawt. 10.12-15"},"47":{"text":"Aman agrepguite uh giel in asuse sah a, atheipi kungte uh vua in asumang hi.","ref":"Pawt. 9.22-25"},"48":{"text":"Agantate u’zong giel in akhieh lia pie a, aganhonte uh keh zauhuoitah in keh in akhieh lia pieh hi."},"49":{"text":"Sumangthai thei vansawltahte alah uah asawl a, alungthahna huoisetah, athangpaina nasatah, leh lungkham mangbatnate atung uah atung sah hi."},"50":{"text":"Aman alungthahna ding lampi abawl a, ahinna uh shina lah a kipat in ahinkhawi sih a, ahinna uh natna hipi kungah ape zawta hi."},"51":{"text":"Aman Izipt gama tachil zousie athatlum a, Ham puon inn a ahatna gamasa pente uh asumangthaita hi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.29"},"52":{"text":"Hinanleh amite pen ganhon bangin gamdai ah apuidoh hi.","ref":"Pawt. 13.17-22"},"53":{"text":"Bittahin amauh apui a, tuachi’n amauten zauna anei sih uhi; hinanleh amelmate uh pen tuipi ah atummang sahta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 14.26-28"},"54":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute amun siengthou gamgi ah ahing puitunga, akhut zietlam a aleisa taangah atunta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 15.17; Josh. 3.14-17"},"55":{"text":"Amaute mai ah namte adelmang a, agamte uh agoutan dingun ahawm pieh a, Israel namte apuon innte uah ateng sahta hi.","ref":"Josh. 11.16-23"},"56":{"text":"Tuabang hinapi in zong, amauten Tungnung Pen Pasian a ze et uh a, Atungah ahel ua athutheisahnate azuisih uhi.","ref":"Vai. 2.11-15"},"57":{"text":"Hinanleh akilehei ua apu apate uh mabangin agin um sih ua; thalpi muonhuoilou bangin apeikawita uhi."},"58":{"text":"Aziehpen amunsangte un Ama alungthah sahta ua, amilim siemthute un Ama athangsesah uhi."},"59":{"text":"Pasian in tami azahtah in thangpaina in adim a, Israelte nasatah in akidahta hi."},"60":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman mihingte lah a akoi, Shiloh mun a apuon inn anuasieta hi.","ref":"Josh. 18.1; Jer. 7.12-14; 26.6"},"61":{"text":"Thu hun bawm khu sal in amansah a, athupina uh zong melmate khut sungah apelutta hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 4.4-22"},"62":{"text":"Aman amite namsau in agalten athat gam sah siengta a, agoutan tungah alungthahta hi."},"63":{"text":"Mei in atangvalte uh akatum a, anungahte un zong kitenna mawngmawng aneita sih uhi."},"64":{"text":"Asiempute uh namsau in apua ua, ameithaite u’zong akap nawn sih uhi."},"65":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa khu imu khanglou bangin athouta a; pasal galhang zukham bang maiin akikouzahta hi."},"66":{"text":"Aman amelmate anua dou kia a, minsietna tawp neilou ah akoita hi."},"67":{"text":"Tuathamlouin aman Joseph puonbuh adei nawn sih a, Ephraim nam zong atelta sih hi."},"68":{"text":"Hinanleh Juda nam leh A it Zion muol atel zawta hi."},"69":{"text":"A munsiengthou khu leengpa innsang bangin abawla kumtawn a dinga sudet leitung bangin."},"70":{"text":"A suoh David atel a, belam huongsung apat in alakhie hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 16.11,12; 2 Sam. 7.8; 1 Khang. 17.7"},"71":{"text":"Belam noukaite azuina apat in amite Jakob leh, agoutan Israelte ching dingin ahandohta hi."},"72":{"text":"David in lungtang dih leh muonhuoina toh amaute achinga, khutsiemna toh apuita hi."}}},"79":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian, namte na goutante lah ah alut ua, Na bieh inn siengthou abuasah ua, Jerusalem zong vutvai asuoh sahta uhi.","title":"Jerusalem suhsietna thuh dinga ngetna Asaph Phatna la.","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.8-10; 2 Khang. 36.17-19; Jer. 52.12-14"},"2":{"text":"Na suohte luong khu tungleeng vate neh dingin apeta ua, Na misiengthoute sa khu leitung gamsate ann dingin apie uhi."},"3":{"text":"Asisante uh Jerusalem kimkot ah tui sunbuoh bangin, a luongsah uh a amauh vui ding koima a um sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka innvengte ua dingin mudahuoi ka suohta ua, ka kim ua mite simmaw leh nuisatin ka umta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa bangtan vei ahiei? Kumtawnin na lungthah den talawm ding amah? Na thangsietna mei banga kuong ding adiei?"},"6":{"text":"Nang hing theilou namte leh na min lou ngailou gamte, tungah na lungthahna sungbuo in."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun Jakob anetumta uh a atenna mun uh asusegamta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate uh khelnate ka tung uah thei ngitnget sinlen; na lainatna in kintah in hing nadawn pai hen, Aziehpen nahpitah a suhngiemin ka umta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aw ka hundamna uh Pasian, na min thupina dingin hing panpi inlen, hing hunkhie in, na min ziehin ka khelnate uh hing silsieng in."},"10":{"text":"Bangdinga namdangten “A Pasian uh hei a um ahiei?” Chise se ding ahi uoi mah? Na suohte sisan luong phuba lahna, ka mitmu un namchin lah ah kithei heh."},"11":{"text":"Suongkul taangte thumna na masang hing tung henlen, na silbawltheina thupitah dungzui in shi dinga guotte humbit in."},"12":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka innvengte un a angsung ua, Nangma ahing selphounate uh ale sagi in thuh kia in."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n kou na mite leh na gantatna mun a belamten, nangma kungah kumtawn in kipahthu ka hing gen ding ua, Nangma phatna akhang akhangin ka theisah zel ding uhi."}}},"80":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Israel chingpa, Nang belamhon banga Joseph puipa, Na bil hing daw in, Nang cherubimte kikal a umpa hing tankhie in.","title":"Pasian khotuona ngetna Lapulien a ding: Shoshannim-a sah ding, Asaph phatna la.","ref":"Pawt. 25.22"},"2":{"text":"Ephraim, Benjamin leh Manasseh masangah na hatna tohthou inlen, hing pei inlen hing hundam in."},"3":{"text":"Aw Pasian koute hing siemtha kia inlen na mel vahsah in, tuachi’n hundam in ka um ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aw galkapte Mangpa Pasian, bangtan vei na mite thungetna tunga lungthah ding na hiei?"},"5":{"text":"Nang amaute khu hitui tanghou in na vah a, a dawn dingun hitui tenalien dim na pie hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka inn vengte uh kihaupi ding bep in na hing bawl a, ka melmate un simmaw tahin ahing nuisan uhi."},"7":{"text":"Aw Galkapte Pasian koute hing siemtha inlen, Na mel tangsah in tuachi’n hundamin ka um ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipat in grep gui khat na hing puo a, namte na notdoh a tua grepgui na suonta hi."},"9":{"text":"Na suonna ding mun na susienga, thutah in ahui na hasah a tuachi’n gamsung aluodimta hi."},"10":{"text":"Muolte khu ahim in akhu a, abamengte khu Pasian Sidar singte bang mai ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"A kahiengte tuipi dongin azam a, Aba mengte luipi tandong azam hi."},"12":{"text":"A kunga peiten aga alaw theina ding ua, bangdinga a inn a daite na susiet sieng ahiei mah?"},"13":{"text":"Gamnuoi a ngalten aphungkal gawp ua, gamlah a gamsaten anegam sieng uhi."},"14":{"text":"Galkapte Pasian aw, ka hing ngen uhi, hing kihei kia inlen van a kipat in hing ensuh inlen, tam grep gui en inlen hing ve in."},"15":{"text":"Na khut zietlam ngeiin asuon grep gui ahia, Nangma a dinga na hatsah abate ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Mei in akihalta a phuain a umta hi, na mel a phawhhilna ziehin abeimang zel uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh na zietlam a um mipa tungah na khut um hen, Nanga dinga suhat mihing tapa tungah."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n nangma ka hing nuangat san sih ding ua, hing suhal kia in tuachi’n na min ka hing han ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Pasian aw, koute hing siemtha kia inlen, Na meel vahsah in tuachi’n huhdam in ka um ding uhi."}}},"81":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"I hatna uh Pasian kungah ngaitah in la sa unlen; Jakob Pasian kungah nuom tah in kikou un.","title":"Kilawm tah a Pasian be dinga chielna Lapulien a ding: Gittith tumginga sah ding, Asaph phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Phatna la ngai sa unlen khuongta tum unlen, pehging kilawm leh kaiging ngainop huoi tahte tum un."},"3":{"text":"Ha tha ni leh ha lia ni in, tualeh pawi thupi bawl ni chiengin pengkul mut un.","ref":"Kisim. 10.10"},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen tami Israelte dinga danthu guot ahi a, Jakob Pasian dan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ka theikhah ngailou ham ka zahna gam, Izipt dou dinga agamsung atotsuoh lai a, Jakob Pasian in Joseph a dinga anamdet theipina khu tami ahi."},"6":{"text":"“Keima’n na liengkou ua na puohgihte uh ka ladoh a, na khutte uh zong tehlei gih apat hakhieh in aumta hi."},"7":{"text":"Na mangbat ni un na hing han ua, ken kang hunkhie hi; aguh a van ginna mun ah ka hing dawng a; Meribah tuite ah ka hing ze et hi. Selah.","ref":"Pawt. 17.7; Kisim. 20.13"},"8":{"text":"Aw ka mite ngaikhie unlen, tuachi’n ka hing theisah ding hi, Aw Israel ka thu na ngai nuom uleh."},"9":{"text":"Na lah uah gamdang pasien a um ding ahi sih a, gamdang pasien mawngmawng na bieh ding u’zong ahisih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.2,3; Danp. 5.6,7"},"10":{"text":"Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi a, Izipt gam a kipat a hing puidohpa khu ka hi; na kam uh lienpiin kaah unlen tuachi’n ka sudim ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Hinanleh ka miten ka aw angaikheta sih ua, Israelten ahing nuolta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n alungtang uh gen ha bang dungzui ua um ding in, ka umsanta a amauh lemsah dan bang a umta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ka miten ka thu ngaikhie u’henlen, Israelin ka lampi zui mai uleh aw!"},"14":{"text":"Keima’n amelmate uh zawpieh ding inga, agalte uh tunga ka khut lampai mai ding hi vengin maw."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa mudate akung uah akipelut ta ding ua, hinanleh avang uh pen kumtawn in a umta ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Aman amauh ann hoipen in avah ta ding a, tualeh suongpi apat khuoizu in kahing taisahta ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"82":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian khu mihatte kikhopna ah adinga, pasien te lah ah vai ahawm hi.","title":"Israel vaihawm dihtatloute Asaph phatna la."},"2":{"text":"“Bangtan vei ahiei dihloutah a vai na hawm ua, migiloute na deisah tuom ding uh? Selah."},"3":{"text":"Mi gentheite leh pa neiloute hunkhie unlen, thudih in vaihawm pieh unlen mi nuoinungte leh, genthei thuohte tungah dihtah in thu khen un."},"4":{"text":"Mi hatloute leh tasamte hunkhie unlen, migiloute khut sung apat hunkhie un.”"},"5":{"text":"Amaun a thei sih ua, theisiemna zong anei sih uhi; miel lah ah avah kawi ua, leitung kingahna suongphumte akiloh uhi."},"6":{"text":"“Noute pasien tate na hi ua noute na bawn un, Tungnung Pen tate na hi uh ka chita hi.","ref":"Jn. 10.34"},"7":{"text":"Bangtenghileh mihingte bangin na shi ding ua,” leeng tapate khat bangin na pua ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aw Pasian thou inlen leitung vai hawm pieh in; Nam zousiete khu na goutan ahi ding uhi."}}},"83":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian, hamlou kei in um sin, Aw Pasian um khinkhien sinlen, sip dide in um mama sin.","title":"Melmate manthaina ding ngetna Asaph phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Ngai in Na melmate akisabuoi vengvung ua, Nangma hing mudaten alu uh aphongsang uhi."},"3":{"text":"Na mite tungah pil lepchietah in thu aphiel ua, Na mi phuolguhte tungah aselam in a kihoukhawm uhi."},"4":{"text":"“Kisadi uo, anam hina uh mang khopin, Israel min mawngmawng thei zing a, a um nawnlou na ding in iphiet dinguh,” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Lungsim munkhat puo a kithutuoh in akihoukhawm ua, Nangma hing dou dingin thuhun abawl uhi."},"6":{"text":"Edom mite leh Ishmael mite puonbuh leh, Moab mite leh Hagar mite puonbuhte;"},"7":{"text":"Gebalte leh Ammonte, Amalekte, Philistinte, leh Tai-ar mite puonbuh a tengte toh."},"8":{"text":"Assiriate nangawn zong amaute langah apang a, Lot hahlesuonte apanpi uhi. Selah."},"9":{"text":"Midiante tunga na bawl bangin, Kishion lui a Sisera leh Jabin tunga na bawl bangin, amaute tungah zong bawl in.","ref":"Vai. 7.1-23; Vai. 4.6-22"},"10":{"text":"Tua mite khu En Dor khuo ah amangthaita ua, lei a dingin silnieh deilou bang ahing hita uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ami liente uh Oreb leh Zeeb bangin bawl inlen, Ahi, aleeng tapate uh abawn un Zeba leh Zalmuna bangin bawl in.","ref":"Vai. 7.25; Vai. 8.12"},"12":{"text":"“Amaun Pasian loupahing munte lahpieh vai in eiman kitanvai,” achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aw ka Pasian, leivui kipei vengvung bang leh, bushi hui in amut leeng bangin amauh bawl in."},"14":{"text":"Mei in gamlah akahtum bang leh, meikuong in muol leh taangte akah bangin."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n huipi hattah in amauh nuadel inlen, na khopihui in amauh zausah in."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa aw, miten na min asui theina dingun, amel uh zumna in dimsah in."},"17":{"text":"Kumtawn in zalah leh mangbang tahin um uhenlen, suhmuolphou a um in mangthai denta uheh."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n miten nangma min bou Mangpa ahi chi leh, Leitung pumpi ah nangbou Tungnung Pen na hi chi, atheina dingun."}}},"84":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw galkapte Mangpa, Na biehbuh ngaihuoi hina va-ia e,","title":"Pasian toh tenkhawm anopna Lapulien a ding-Gittith tumginga sah ding. Korah tate phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Ka hinna in Mangpa inn huongsung angai nama a, ahi, aba vawt hi. Ka lungtang leh ka tahsa khu Pasian hing ngai in akikoukhie hi."},"3":{"text":"Vatou na ngawn in tenna ding inn amu a, Sielpaleeng in zong ama dingin anoute koina ding bu aki nei hi. Aw galkapte Mangpa ka leengpa leh ka Pasian aw, tuate khu na mai tamte ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Na inn a teng mite ahampha uhi, Nang ahing phat nalai ding uhi. Selah."},"5":{"text":"Nangma a hatna nei mi ahampha hi, alungtanga Zion zotna lampi lunggul khu."},"6":{"text":"Amaute kaana luiguom a azawt lai un, tuakhu tuikhuh in abawl zel uhi. Khaal guo zu masate’n zong tuikulte adimsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute hatna a kipat hat zawh semna ah apei ua, Zion ah Pasian masang ah akimusah chiet ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aw galkapte Mangpa Pasian, ka thungetna za inlen, Jakob Pasian aw, na bil hing daw in. Selah."},"9":{"text":"Aw Pasian ka kidalna phaw uh, ngai in, na sathau nupa mel zong envawi in."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen mundanga ni tul khat um sangin, Na inn huongsunga ni khat um ahoi zaw a; gitlouna puon innte a um sangin, ka Pasian kotkha ngah a pan ka ut zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa Pasian khu ni leh phaw ahi a, Mangpa’n hepina leh thupina ape dinga; Dihtah a umte lah ah silhoi mawngmawng a it ngai sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Aw galkapte Mangpa, Nangma hing muong mi ahampha hi."}}},"85":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa, Nangma na gam tungah na kipah a, a saltanna ua kipat Jakob na nua puikiata hi.","title":"Saltang tungkiate thungetna Lapuliena ding: Korah tate phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Na mite gitlouna na ngaidam a, akhelnate zousie uh na liekhu hi. Selah."},"3":{"text":"Na thangpaina zousie na lamangta, Na lungthahna zauhuoina apat na kiheimangta hi."},"4":{"text":"Aw ka hundamna Pasian uh hing kiheisah kia inlen, ka tung ua na lungthahna tawp sah in."},"5":{"text":"Ka tung uah na lungthah den ding amah? Na lungthahna akhang akhanga, umsah den ding na hiei mah?"},"6":{"text":"Nangma a na mite a kipah theina ding un, na hing suhal kia sih ding amah?"},"7":{"text":"Mangpa aw, na khotuona hing musah inlen, na hundamna zong hing pie in."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian thugen ding ka ngaikhe dinga, aziehpen Aman amite leh amisiengthoute kungah, lungmuonna thu gen ding ahi; hinanleh amaute motna lam ah kihei nawn sih uhen."},"9":{"text":"Pellou in a hundamna khu ama giing mite nai ah a um hi, thupina i gam a aum theina dingin."},"10":{"text":"Khotuona leh thutah akimutuo ua; dihtatna leh hamuonna akitawptuo uhi."},"11":{"text":"Leitung apat thutah ahing poukhe tou ding a, dihtatnain van akipat in ahing ensuh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi, Mangpa’n silhoi ahing pe dinga, tualeh igam un ga tampi asuong ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amasangah dihtatna apei dinga, akalsuonna lampite ah eite ahing koi ding hi."}}},"86":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa kei langah na bil hing daw inlen, hing dawngin aziehpen genthei leh tasamtah ka hi.","title":"It siem Pasian kunga thungetna David thumna."},"2":{"text":"Ka hinna keem hoi inlen Ka siengthou ngal a, Aw Nang ka Pasian na hi a, Nangma hing muong na suohpa hundam in,"},"3":{"text":"Aw Mangpa hing khotuo in, aziehpen nichin in nangma ka hing han hi."},"4":{"text":"Aw na suohpa hinna nuomsah sah in aziehpen, Aw Mangpa ka hinna nangma kunga ka domsang hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen Aw Mangpa nang na hoi a, ngaidam dinga mansa na hi a, Nangma hing han poumate tungah khotuona na hau hi."},"6":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, ka thungetna ah na bil hing daw inlen, hepina ngen a ka kikounate ngaikhie in."},"7":{"text":"Ka lungkham mangbat ni chiengin, Nangma ka hing han ding hi; na hing dawn ding zieh in."},"8":{"text":"Aw Mangpa pasien te lah ah, Nangma bang mawngmawng koima a um sih hi, na silbawl banga bawlthei mawngmawng a um sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa aw na siemsa nam chinte ahing pei ding ua, nang ma ah ahing be ding ua, Na min apahtawi ding uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 15.4"},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen Nang na thupi a, sillamdang tahtahte na bawl a, Nang bou Pasian na hi."},"11":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na lampite hing hil in, tuachi’n na thutah ka zui thei ding hi Na min zau dingin lungtang khat hing pie in."},"12":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka Pasian ka lungtang, zousie in ka hing phat ding a, tualeh na min thupi ka pahtawi kumtawnta ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen na khotuona khu kei a dingin athupi hi, Nangman ka hinna hankhuh nuoinungpen a kipat in na hunkheta hi."},"14":{"text":"Aw Pasian mikiliensahte’n ahing dou ua, mi ngongtat umkhawmten tha dingin ka hinna asui uhi, tualeh amasang uah Nangma ahing koikha sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa nang pen lainatna a dim, hepisiem lungthah bailou, khotuona leh thutah a dim Pasian na hi."},"16":{"text":"Oh! Kei lam hing nga inlen hing khotuo in, Na suohpa kungah na hatna hing pie inlen, na suohnu tapa hundam in."},"17":{"text":"Hoina ding chiemtena hing lah in, ahing mudate’n tuakhu amu ua azumthei na dingun; aziehpen Mangpa nangman na hing panpi a, na hing hamuon hi."}}},"87":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Asuongphum khu muol siengthou a um ahi.","title":"Pasian khopi Zion thupina Korah tapate phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n Zion kulpi kotkhate khu, Jakobte umna zousie sangin angaina zaw hi."},"3":{"text":"Aw Pasian khopi na tungtang thu thupitahte agen uhi. Selah."},"4":{"text":"Kei hing theite kung ah Rahab leh Babilon tungtang ka gen ding a, Ngai in, Philistin leh Tai-ar Ethiopia toh, “Envawi tamte khuna pieng ahi uhi.”"},"5":{"text":"“Zion tungtang thu ah tami leh tuomi,” ama a pieng ahi ua, Tungnung pen mama in tua khopi aphutdet ding hi, chi’n agen ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n michin min akhum chiengin, “Tami pen Zion a pieng ahi,” chi’n achiemte ding hi. Selah."},"7":{"text":"Lasa mite’n tumging tumte toh, “Ka lungnopna tuikhuh zousie nangma ah a um hi,” achi ding uhi."}}},"88":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw ka hundamna Mangpa Pasian, sun leh zan in na masang ah ka kikou kou hi.","title":"Suhgentheina apat hatna Lapulien a ding: Mahalath Leonnoth a sah ding, Ezra mi Heman Maskil. Korah tapate phatna la"},"2":{"text":"Ka thungetna na masang ah hing tung henlen, ka kikou thawm ah na bil hing daw in."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen ka hinna buoina in adimta a, ka hinna in hankhuh lam anai hiei hiei ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Hankhuh a peisuhte lah a simtel ka hita a, hatna neilou mi bang giap ka hita hi."},"5":{"text":"Gal tha, han a lumte bang a mishi lah a paikhiet, na theizing nawnlou bang giap kahi ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Kokhuh nuoinung pen leh, amielna mun thuhtah ah na hing lumsahta hi."},"7":{"text":"Na thangpaina gihtah in ahing netkhum a, na tui kihotte’n na hing sugimta hi. Selah."},"8":{"text":"Ka meltheite kei a pat in gamlapi ah na umsah a, ama-ua dinga kidahhuoipi in na hing bawlta hi; khakhum in ka um a ka pawtkhe thei nawn sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Gimthuohna zieh in ka mitte ase hiei hiei a; Aw Mangpa nichin in nangma kung lam a, ka banzah in ka hing han hi."},"10":{"text":"Mishite a dingin sillamdang na bawl ngai amah? Mishi sate hing thouin nang ahing phat ding uoi mah? Selah."},"11":{"text":"Hankhuh sungah na itna tulngailou, akiphuong thei ngelna diei mah? ahisihleh manthaina mun ah na ginumna, theisahin in aum na diei mah?"},"12":{"text":"Amielna mun ah na sillamdang bawlte akitheina ngel diei? Na dihtatna khu manghilna gam ah akithei diei mah?"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa nangma ka hing han hi; Zingmawng tenga ka thungetna, na masangah ahing tung ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, bangdinga ka hinna paikhie na hiei? Bangdinga kei akipat na mai phuol na ahiei mah?"},"15":{"text":"Ka naupan chiil a kipat in gimthuoh leh shi dihdihin ka um a, na silbawl chizat huoite ka thuoh lai in suhmangbat in ka um hi."},"16":{"text":"Na thangpaina zauhuoi tahin ahing tuomkhum a, na zauhuoina in ahing sumangthaita hi."},"17":{"text":"Amauten nichin in tuilien bangin ahing imkuol uhi. Ka kim vel ah ahing tuom chintuo uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ahing it ka lawm kaguolte kei a pat in na koi gamla ta a, ka meltheite miel lah ah na umsahta hi."}}},"89":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na khotuona te kumtawn in lain kasa ding a; Ka kam in na ginumdan khang sawnsawnte kungah ka theisah ding hi.","title":"Pasian leh David kikaal a thuhun Ezrah mi Ethan Maskil."},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen khatuona khu kumtawn in lamtouin a um dinga, Na ginumna khu vante ngei ah na sudet ding, ka chita hi."},"3":{"text":"“Ka mi telpa toh thuhun ka bawlta ua, ka suohpa David kungah thu ka chiemta hi:"},"4":{"text":"Nahah nasuonte kumtawn in ka sukip dinga, Na leengtoupha zong khang zousie tan in, ka sudet ding hi,” na chita hi. Selah","ref":"2 Sam. 7.12-16; 1 Khang. 17.11-14; Late. 132.11; Nasep. 2.30"},"5":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, vanten na silbawl lamdangte aphat ding ua, misiengthoute kikhopna ah, Na ginumna zong aphat ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa toh tekah thei ding vante ah koi a um ei? mi silbawltheitah tapate lah ah, Mangpa toh kibatsahthei koi ahiei um?"},"7":{"text":"Pasian khu misiengthoute kikhopna ah, nasatah a giinding ahi a; Akimvel a mi zousiete lah ah zatat ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Aw galkapte Mangpa Pasian, Nang banga thahat koi ahiei, Aw Mangpa? Na muonhuoina in Nang ahing imkuol hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang tuipi kihot zua zua tungah vai na hawm a, tuikihotte akiseptou chiengin na daisah zel hi."},"10":{"text":"Nang Rahab khu galtha bangin na satnen dimdem a, Na banthahat in na galte na delzahta hi."},"11":{"text":"Vante nanga ahi a leitung zong nanga ahi. Leitung leh a sunga umte zousie zong, Nangma mukhiet ngen ahi."},"12":{"text":"Sim leh mal zong Nangma siem ahi a, Tabor leh Harmon muolte Na min in anuom uhi."},"13":{"text":"Nangman ban thahattah na nei a na khut ahat a, Na khut zietlam pahtawi in a um hi."},"14":{"text":"Dihtatna leh vaihawmnadih khu, Na leengtoupha kingahna ahi a, khotuona leh thutah na masangah apei uhi."},"15":{"text":"Lungnopna aw ging za namte ahampha uhi, Mangpa aw amaute na mel vah ah avah uhi."},"16":{"text":"Na min ziehin sun nitum in anuom ua, na dihtatna ziehin pahtawi in aum uhi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen athahatna uh thupina nangma na hi a, Na deisahna ziehin ka kii uh pahtawi in a um ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen ka lum uleh ka phaw uh Mangpa ahi a, Israel Misiengthou khu ka leengpa uh ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tuahun lai in na misiengthou kungah, “Mengmunain thu na gen a, mi hattah khat tungah panpina ka ngata a, mite lah a kipat a ka teldohpa mi khat, ka pahtawita hi, na chi hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka suohpa David ka mukheta a, ka sathau siengthou ama ka nuta hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 13.14; Nasep. 13.22; 1 Sam. 16.12"},"21":{"text":"Ama ah ka khut suhkip in a um ding a, ka bantha in ama asuhat ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Amelmate koima’n ama azouthaw sih ding a, gitlouna ta in zong asugim sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Amasang ah agalte ka satpua dinga, ama mudate natnain ka gawt ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh ka ginumna leh ka khotuona khu, ama toh aumkhawm dinga, ka min ziehin akii tawisangin a um ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Akhut zong tuipi tungah ka ngasah dinga, tualeh akhut zietlam zong luipite ah ka ngasah ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Aman kei ang han dinga Nang ka Pa na hi a, Ka Pasian, ka hundamna suongpi na hi; ahing chi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ken zong ama ka tachil in ka bawl dinga, leitung a leengte lah a sangpen in ka bawl ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 1.5"},"28":{"text":"Ka khotuona khu ama a dingin, kumtawn in ka kep hoipieh dinga, ka thuhun khu a kungah dettah in aum ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahah asuonte zong kumtawn in ka umsah dinga; aleengtoupha zong vante um sungsie, ka umsah ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Ataten ka dan alengatsan ua, ka vaihawmnate dungzui a a um sih uleh;"},"31":{"text":"Ka danthupiehte apalsan ua, ka thupiehte azui sih uleh,"},"32":{"text":"atawnkhielnate ziehun, chieng in ka gawt dinga, akhelna zieh un khauhuol in ka zep ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahivang in ama a kipat ka itna tulngailou, khu ka lamang sih dinga, ka ginumna in azuousan ka phal sih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Ken ka thuhun ka bawtse sih dinga, ka kam a thupawtsa zong, ka heng lamdang vawt sih ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Khatvei ka sienthouna louin ka kichiemta a; David kungah zuou ka gen sih ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahah asuonte kumtawn in a um den ding ua, aleengtoupha zong ka masangah, ni bangin a umden ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Hapi bangin kumtawn in sudet in a umden dinga, vanlai a theipitu gin um bang in a umden ding hi,” na chita hi. Selah."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin na paikheta a na kidahta a; na sathau nusa tungah na thangpai mamata hi."},"39":{"text":"Na suohpa thuhun na don nawn sih a, amanglukhu zong tuol sena a nei in na sungiemta hi."},"40":{"text":"A daite zousie na phesiet pieh a, akulpite zousie na susiet pieh ta hi."},"41":{"text":"A kung a peikha pouma in asuom ua, a inn vengte simmaw ahita hi."},"42":{"text":"Nang ama doute khut zietlam na tawisanga, amelmate zousie na lungnuom sah ta hi."},"43":{"text":"Nang anamsau mahiem na lehei pieh a, kidouna mun ah ama na dingkipsah nawn sih hi."},"44":{"text":"A thupina na suhtawp pieh a, aleengtoupha zong tuoltang se na’n na nei piehta hi."},"45":{"text":"Atangval lai nite na suhtom pieh a, zumna leh zalatna in na tuom khumta hi. Selah."},"46":{"text":"Aw Mangpa bangtan vei ahiei mah? Kumtawn a kiphuol den ding na hiei mah? Na thangpaina mei banga kuong ding ahiei mah?"},"47":{"text":"Ka hun tomdan thei ngitnget in, Bangding a mihingte zousie, bangmalou dinga na siem ahiei?"},"48":{"text":"Koi ahiei shina mel mulou a hing ding? Koi ahiei shina hankhuh a pat ahinna hun thei ding? Selah."},"49":{"text":"Mangpa nidanglai a na itna tulngailou leh, Na thutahna a David kunga na thuchiem hei a umta ahiei?"},"50":{"text":"Mangpa aw na suohte a simmaw na uh thei ngitnget inlen, mitampite’n ahing simmawna uh, ka angsunga ka thuoh zel dan thei ngitnget in."},"51":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na melmaten ang simmawna uleh, na sathau nupa kalsuonte asimmawna uh thei ngitnget in."},"52":{"text":"Mangpa khu kumtawn in phat in umta hen, Amen, Amen."}}},"90":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa Nang khang zousie a ka umna uh na hi a;","title":"BU LINA (Late 90-106) Damsung nite simdan ngetna. Pasian mi Mosi thumna."},"2":{"text":"Muol leh tangte pien masanga, leitung leh khuovannuoi na siem masang peh a, kumtawn akipat kumtawn donga Pasian na hi."},"3":{"text":"Nang mihingte khu manthaina ah na kesah a, “Mihing tate aw lei vui ah kia kia un” na chi hi."},"4":{"text":"Na mitmu ah kum tulkhat zong apeisa zani bang giap ahi a, zan ven khat sung bang bep ahi.","ref":"2 Pet. 3.8"},"5":{"text":"Tuilien bangin amaute na taimang a, khangkhat imu bang giap ahi uhi; zingmawng a loupa hing dawhkhie bang ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Zingmawng in ahing poudoh a, ahing dawnkhie a, nitahlam chiengin a muol a avuoi gawpta hi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen na lungthahna in koute ahing katum a, na thangpaina ah suhmangbat in ka um uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ka gitlounate uh na masangah na koi a, aguh a ka khelnate uh na mel vah ah na sulangta hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen ka damsung nite uh na thangpaina ah abeimang zel a, ka damsung kumte uh khatvei nahhuoi bangin ka beisah zel uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ka damsung kumte uh kum sawmsagi ahi a, hatna zieh in kum sawm giet zong ahi thei hi. Hinanleh asawtna khu sepgimna leh lungkhamna giap ahi a, abei pai a ka lengmang zel uhi."},"11":{"text":"Koi in ahiei na lungthahna silbawlthei dan thei? Na zauhuoina bang zel in na thangpaina a um hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka damsung nite uh sim dan hing hil in, pilna lungtang ka nei theina ding un."},"13":{"text":"Aw Mangpa hing kihei kia in, bangtan vei lungthah ding na hiei mah? Na suohte tungah lainatna nei in."},"14":{"text":"Ka damsung nite zousie ua, nuom a ka kipah theina dingun, zingmawng in na khotuona in hing taisah in."},"15":{"text":"Na hing suhgimna nite leh, sil hoilou ka tuoh kum sungte bang dungzui in, hing kipah sah in."},"16":{"text":"Na suohte kungah na nasep kilang henlen; na thupina khu atate uh kungah kilang hen."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa ka Pasian uh kilawmna ka tung uah um henlen, Ka khut nasep uh koute a dingin sukip inlen, Ahi, ka khut nasep uh suhkip in."}}},"91":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tungnungpen kibutna mun guh a um mi khu, Bangkimbawltheipa lim nuoi ah a um ngitnget ding hi.","title":"Ama belte Pasian in avenghi"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa tungthu ah “Ama khu ka kibutna leh ka kulpi, Ka Pasian ahi, Ama ka muong ding kachi ding hi.”"},"3":{"text":"Pellou in Aman thangkammi thang leh, natna hi leng zauhuoi lah a kipat in ahing hunkhe ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman ahain in ahing liekhu dinga, ahalim nuoi ah na muong ding a; athutah khu na lum leh phaw ahi ding hi;"},"5":{"text":"Zanlai a sil chizathuoite na zau nawn sih dinga, suntang lai a thaltang leng zong na zau sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Miel nuoi a natna hii leeng na zau sih dinga, sunlai a silhoilou sietna zong na zau sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Na geiah mi tulkhat a pua ding ua, na zietlangah tulsawm a pua ding uhi, hinanleh nang ahing nai sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Na mit in na en dinga, migiloute kithuhna na mu ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen nangman Mangpa khu kihumbitna in na nei a, Tungnungpen mama khu na umnain na bawlta hi."},"10":{"text":"Sil hoilou mawngmawng na tungah atung sih dinga, natna hi in zong na tenna ahing nai sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman a vansawltahte, na gamtatna zousie veng dingin thu ape ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 4.6; Luk. 4.10"},"12":{"text":"Amaun akhut un ahing domtou ding ua tuachilouin, na kengin suong na suikha ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 4.6; Luk. 4.11"},"13":{"text":"Humpibahnei leh gulha na tuonden dinga, humpibahnei khanglaite leh gulte na tuonchil ding hi.","ref":"Luk. 10.19"},"14":{"text":"Ka tunga a itna angap ziehin ka hundam ding a, ka min athei zieh un munsang ah ka koi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Kei ahing han ding ua ka dawng dinga; amangbat chiengun ka umpi dinga, amauh ka hunkhe dinga tualeh ka pahtawi nalai ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Damsawtna in amauh ka lungkim sah dinga, ka hundamna zong ka musah ding hi."}}},"92":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa kunga kipah thugen leh, Aw Tungnung pen, na min phat a lasah sil hoitah a hi.","title":"Pasian phat aki lawmna Sabbath ni phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Na itna tulngailou zingmawng a suhlat leh, na ginumna zan chin a phuondoh ahoi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tumging gui sawm neite, theile leh gawsem ging hasiet huoitah toh phat khu ahoi hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa aw Nangma nasep ahoi a, ahing kipah sah a, na khut nasepte zieh a kipah in la kasa ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa aw na nasepte thupi hina va-ia e, na ngaituonate zong athuh mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi mawl in tami athei sih a, mi moten zong atheisiem sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Migiloute hampa bangin ahing khangkhie ua, silgilou bawlte zousie’n nuom ahing sah chiengun, kumtawna Mangthang ding ahibou uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa, Nang pen kumtawn a Tungnung Pen na hi hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen Aw Mangpa, ngai in, nangma hing doute, ngaivawi, Nang hing doute mangthai ding ahi uhi, sil bawlkhielte zousie thethangin aum ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh ka kii pen gam bawngtal kii bangin, na pahtawi dinga, sathau tha nuin ka umta ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka mit in ka galte guollelna ka mu dinga, ka bil in kei hing dou migiloute tunga, ka dei azata ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Midihtate khu tumsing bangin akhanpha ding uh a, Lebanon muol a Sidar singte bangin a khang ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa inn a kisuonte pen, i Pasian uh bieh inn huong sungah, akhanpha zeizoi ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"A upat nua chieng nangawn un zong, ga asuong nalai ding ua, a hing dipdep ding ua abawhpha mama ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuapen Mangpa khu adihtat ahi chi phuondohna ding ahi a, Ama ka suongpi ahi a, Ama ah dihtatlouna mawngmawng a um sih hi."}}},"93":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa leeng vaihawm in atou a, athupinain akithuom hi; Mangpa’n leeng puontuol asil a, thahatna in akawng agah hi. Leitung zong akilin louna dingin, suhdet in aum hi.","title":"Mangpa thupina"},"2":{"text":"Na Mangtoupha nidanglai peh a sudet ahi a; Nang pen kumtawn akipat umden na hita hi."},"3":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, tuisanglette akivawhtou ua, tuisang lette’n a aw uh asuo ua, tuisanglette aging henhon uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tunglam a um Mangpa khu, tui tampi gin sangin ahat zaw a, tuipi kihawt sangtah sangin zong ahat zaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Na thutheisahte khu amuonhuoi mama hi; Aw Mangpa, sienthouna khu kumtawn in, na inn toh akilawm hi."}}},"94":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa Pasian Nang phubalahna neitu na hi a, Phuba lapa Pasian hing taangkhie in.","title":"Phuba lahna khu Pasian a ahi"},"2":{"text":"Aw leitung vaihawmpa, kipan inlen, kiliensahte kungah a gitlou man uh thuh in."},"3":{"text":"Aw Mangpa bangtanvei ahiei, bangtan vei ahiei migiloute a guolzaw ding uh?"},"4":{"text":"Amauh kisathei tahin a ham ua, thulimlouna nasemten ki uongsah tah in thu agen uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, amaun na mite abottel gawp uh a, na goutante asugenthei uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amaun meithaite leh mikhuolte athat ua, pa neiloute a that uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Amaun Mangpa’n amu sih ding a, Jakob Pasian in phamaw asa sih ding hi,” achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mite lah a mimawlte aw, theisiem un, Mimote aw, bang chih chienga pil ding na hi uoi?"},"9":{"text":"Bil bawlpan zalou ding ahiei mah? Mit bawlpan mulou ding ahiei mah?"},"10":{"text":"Pasian theilou Namte Thununpa’n asudih sih ding amah? mite pilna hilpa’n athei sih ding amah?"},"11":{"text":"Mangpa’n mihingte ngaituonate bangmalou ahi chi athei hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 3.20"},"12":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangman na phawhhil leh, na dan a pat a na hil mite ahampha uhi."},"13":{"text":"Migilou a dinga akuo uh taw a aum masangsie, mangbatna nite apat khawldamna na pieh theina ding in."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n amite anuasie ngai sih dinga, agoutan ataisan ngai sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Vaihawmna khu dihtat na lamah akinuale kia dinga, lungtang dihtah po zousie’n tuakhu azui ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Koi ahiei silgilou bawlte hing doupieh dinga kipankhe ding? Ahisihleh koi ahiei thulimlouna bawlte, hing doupieh dinga ding ding?"},"17":{"text":"Mangpa kei hing panpipa hisih leh, ka hinna kintah in sip didena mun ah aumta ding hi."},"18":{"text":"“Ka keng ateu hi” ka chi chiengin, Aw Mangpa, na khotuonain a hing tudet zel ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka lunggimna atam seng chiengin, na hamuonnate’n ka hinna akipahsah zel hi."},"20":{"text":"Dan bawl a khelna umsahte gitlouna leengtouphain, nangma toh kithuokhawmna anei diei?"},"21":{"text":"Midihtat hinna dou tum in akikhawm ua, mawna neilou sisan siemlou atangsah uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa khu ka kivenbitna ahi a, Ka Pasian khu ka kihumbitna suongpi ahi."},"23":{"text":"Aman amaute thulimlouna ngei khu atung uah akesah ding a, agitlouna ngei uah amaute asattan ding a Mangpa i Pasian un amaute a sattan ding hi."}}},"95":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw hing pei un, Mangpa phat in la isa ding uh; i hundamna suongpi pahtawi in, nuomtahin ikikou ding uhi.","title":"Pasian be dinga hanthawnna"},"2":{"text":"Kipahthu gen kawm in amasangah ipei ding ua, phatna la sa a Ama pahtawi in, nuomtah in aw i suo ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa khu Pasian thupitah ahia, pasien zousiete tunga leengpa thupitah ahi."},"4":{"text":"A khut ah lei mun thuhtahte a uma, muolvum sangte zong Ama a ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuipi Ama a ahi a, Ama siemsa ahi, a khut in gamgaw zong asiem hi."},"6":{"text":"Aw hing pei un Ama bie in kunva ui; Mangpa eite hing siempa mai ah khupdin chiet va ui."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen ama i Pasian uh ahi a, eite agantatna muna mite leh akhut a belamte ihi uhi. Tunia, a aw na zah ua ahileh!","ref":"Heb. 3.7-11\n        ;     \n        Heb. 3.15; 4.7"},"8":{"text":"a suh lungthah lai bang uleh, gamdai a aze et lai ni ua bang in, na lungtang uh khausah sih un;","ref":"Pawt. 17.1-7; Kisim. 20.2-13"},"9":{"text":"Khum hunlai in napu napate un ahing ze et ua, ka silbawlte munapiin ahing enkhie nalai lai uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen kum sawmli sung ving veng, tua khangte tungah “Ka lungkimta sih a, alungtang ua lampiel ngitnget nam ahi ua, ka lampite azui sih uhi,” ka chita hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka khawldamna ah alut sih ding uh chiin, atung uah lungthah in ka kichiemta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 14.20-23; Danp. 1.34-36; Heb. 4.3,5; Danp. 12.9,10"}}},"96":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa pahtawi in la tha sa unlen, leitung pumpi in Mangpa phat in la sa un.","title":"Pasian thupina phatna"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa pahtawi in la sa unlen, amin phat un; Ni simin ahundamna thu gen un."},"3":{"text":"Namte lah ah athupina phuong unlen, mizousie lah ah asilbawl lamdangte phuongzah un."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa khu athupi a, thupitah a, pahtawi ding ahi, pasien zousiete sanga Ama giin ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen namte pasien zousie khu milimte ahi ua, hinanleh Mangpa’n vante asiem hi."},"6":{"text":"Zatatna leh vangletnate amasangah a um a, thahatna leh kilawmna amunsiengthou ah a um hi."},"7":{"text":"Aw nou michin namchinte, thupina Mangpa kungah pie unlen, Ahi, thupina leh hatna Mangpa kungah pie un.","ref":"Late. 29.1,2"},"8":{"text":"Mangpa kungah Amin thupina pie unlen, sillatte tawi in ahuong sungah hing lut un."},"9":{"text":"Oh! asienthouna kilawmna toh Mangpa bie unlen, leitung pumpi amasangah chitun un."},"10":{"text":"Namte lah ah “Mangpa’n vai ahawm hi, chi’n genkawi un, leitung zong kiptah a phudet ahia, akiling nawn sih ding hi. Aman dihtatna toh mite vai ahawm pieh ding hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Vante nuom uhenlen, leitung zong kipah hen; tuipi leh asunga um zousie kikou uhen,"},"12":{"text":"leitung leh asunga um zousie kipah uhen, tuachi’n gamlah singkung zousie zong, nuomsatah in Mangpa masangah aum ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama hing pei pai ding ahia, leitung vaihawm dinga hing pei pai ding ahi; Aman dihtatna toh leitung thu akhen dinga; A thutahin mite vai ahawm pieh ding hi."}}},"97":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n vai ahawm hi, leitung nuom henlen, tui laisie gam zousie kipah hen.","title":"Mangpa’n dihtatna toh vai ahawm ding"},"2":{"text":"Meilum leh mielna khu akimvel ah a um a, aleengtoupha kingahna khu dihtatna leh, thudih a vaihawmna ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amasangah meikuong apei a, akimvel a agalte akatum hi."},"4":{"text":"A tunpheten leitung atanvah vapom a, leitungin amu a, achitun hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa mai ah muolte khuoilu bangin azunmang a, leitung pumpi Mangpa mai ah azunmang sieng hi."},"6":{"text":"Vanten Adihtatna aphuongkhie ua, mi zousie’n athupina amu uhi."},"7":{"text":"Siemthu milim bete zousie, suhmuolphouin um uhenlen, milim kisahtheipite, nou pasiente zousiete Ama bie un."},"8":{"text":"Zion in aza a, kipah tah in aum hi, tualeh Aw Mangpa, Na thukhenate ziehin Juda tanuten nuom asa uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa nang leitung pumpi tunglam peh a, sangpen Na hi a, pasien zousiete tungah tawisangin na um hi."},"10":{"text":"Nou Mangpa itten, sil hoilou huo un. Aman amisiengthoute hinna akeem hoi a, migiloute khut a pat in ahumbit hi."},"11":{"text":"Midihtat adingin khuo avah a, mi lungtang dih adingin kipahna a um hi."},"12":{"text":"Nou midihtatte aw Mangpa ah nuom unlen, Amin siengthou theizingna ah kipahthu gen un."}}},"98":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa pahtawi in la tha sa un, aziehpen Aman sillamdangte abawlta a, akhut zietlam leh aban siengthouin Ama aguolzou sahta hi.","title":"Adihtatna zieh a Mangpa phatna ding Phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n ahundamna atheisahta a, adihtatna namte mitmu ah chientah in a langsahta hi."},"3":{"text":"Aman Israel innkuonte tungah akhotuona leh, agin umna athei ngitnget hi. Kawlmong tan a mi zousie in i Pasian uh, hundamna amu suohta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Leitung luo zousiete aw, Mangpa pahtawi in nuomtahin aphatna la sa in kikou un."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa phat in kaiging toh la sa unlen, tumging leh phatna lasah ging toh."},"6":{"text":"Pengkul ging leh belamtal kii kimut ging toh, Lengpa, Mangpa mai ah nuomtah in kikou un."},"7":{"text":"Tuipi leh a sunga um zousie ging zoizoi uhenlen, leitung leh asunga um zousie toh."},"8":{"text":"Luipiten akhut uh beng uhenlen, muolten Mangpa masangah nuom in la sa khawm uhen."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen, Ama leitunga vaihawm dinga hing pei ding ahi. Aman dihtatna toh leitung pumpi vai ahawm dinga, khentuom neilou in vai ahawmpieh ding hi."}}},"99":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n leeng vai ahawm hi, mipite chitun uhen, Ama cherubimte kikaal ah atou hi, leitung kiling hen.","title":"Pasian letna leh a sienthouna Zatat kawm a phatna,","ref":"Pawt. 25.22"},"2":{"text":"Zion ah Mangpa athupi hi; Namchinte tungah atungnungpen hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaun na min thupitah leh chizathuoi phat uhen; Ama asieng thou hi."},"4":{"text":"Lengpa thahatna in thukhenna dih a it hi, Nangman khentuom neilouna na sudet zel a, Jakob tate lah ah vaihawmna leh, dihtatna na bawl zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa i Pasian pahtawi unlen, akeng ngahna bulah bie un, Ama asiengthou hi."},"6":{"text":"A siempute lah ah Mosi leh Aaron apang ua, Amin hante lah ah Samuel apanga, Amauten Mangpa ahan ua, tuachi’n Aman adawng zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Aman meilum khuom akipat in amauh ahoupi a, amaun athu theisahte leh, adanthupiehte azui zel uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 33.9"},"8":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka Pasian uh, Nang amauh na dawng a, asilbawlkhelnate uh tungah phuba la zel nanlachin zong, amaute ngaidampa Pasian na hi hi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa i Pasian khu tawisang unlen, amuol siengthou ah Ama bie un, aziehpen Mangpa i Pasian u’khu asiengthou ahi."}}},"100":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nou gam zousiete aw, Mangpa pahtawi in nuomsatah in kikou un.","title":"Kipahna leh kipahthugenna Pahtawina: Phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Kipahkawm in Mangpa nna sem unlen, lasa kawm in amasang ah hing pei un."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa khu Pasian ahi chi thei un, ahing siempa Ama ahi a, eite Ama a ihi ua, amite leh agantatna mun a abelamte ihi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Kipah thugen kawm in akotpi ah lut unlen, phat kawm in A biehinn huongsung ah lut un, Akungah kipahthu gen unlen, Amin phat un."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa khu ahoi a, A khotuona khu kumtawn in a um ding hi, tualeh athutahna zong akhang akhangin a umden ding hi.","ref":"1 Khang. 16.34; 2 Khang. 5.13; 7.3; Ezr. 3.11; Late. 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer. 33.11"}}},"101":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na khotuona leh vaihawmna dih thu khu la in kasa dinga; Aw Mangpa Nangma phat in la ka sa ding hi.","title":"Hinkhaw siengthou David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Lampi hoibukim ah piltahin ka um dinga; Oh! bangchih chiengin ka kungah na hing pei diei? Ka innsungah lungtang hoibukim puoin ka um ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Sil gilou mawngmawng ka mitmu ah ka koi sih dinga, Lampielte silbawl ka huo a keima ah abeh sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Lungtang genhain ahing peisan dinga; gitlouna zong ka theikha sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Koipou a innveng simtham a gensie pouma ka sumang dinga, mit sangha leh Lungtanga kisathei pouma ka thuoh thei sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Gamsunga mi ginumte tungah ka mit atu dinga, kei toh atengkhawm ding uhi; Koipou hoibukim a, ka lampi zuiten ka nna asem ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Milepchie koima ka inn ah ateng sih ding ua, zuougen hat mi koima ka kungah a um thei sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Gamsunga migiloute zousie zingmawng tengin ka sumang dinga, silgilou bawl mi zousie Mangpa khopi apat ka sumang ding hi."}}},"102":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, ka thungetna hing ngaikhie inlen, ka kikouna husa Nangma kungah hing tung hen.","title":"Misiengthou thumna Gimthuoh mi’n aba laitah a Mangpa mai a alungkhamna thu atutna."},"2":{"text":"Ka genthei ni chiengin kei a pat na mai phuol sin. Na bil kei langah hing daw inlen, ka hing hat ni chiengin hing dawng paiin."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen ka damsung nite meikhu bangin azammang zel hi. Ka gute zong taptunga mei-amsa abang ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka lungtang vuoh in a uma, hampa bangin avuoita a, ka ann neh ding nangawn ka manghilta hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka thum ka mauna aw zieh in, ka gute ka vun ah abeh chinten hi."},"6":{"text":"Gamdai simbupi bang ka hita a, khogem nua a simbuneu bang giap ka hita hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka hah ngitnget a, Inntunga vatou amatanga um bang kana hita hi."},"8":{"text":"Sun nitum in ka melmaten ahing gensie ua, ka tunga hangsanten ka tungah hamsie alou uhi."},"9":{"text":"Vut khu ann bangin ka ne a, ka dawn ding khu ka hitui toh akihal hi."},"10":{"text":"Na thangpaina zieh leh na lungthahna zieh in, Na hing domkanga na hing paikheta hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka damsung nite lah nitahlam nihim kihei bang giap ahi a; hampa bangin ka vuoigawpta hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa, nang pen kumtawn a um ding na hia, na min theizingna zong akhang akhangin, a umden ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Na thou dinga, Zion muol na khotuo ding a, lainatna na nei ding hi; a ma deisahna ding hun atung ta ngal a, ahi, hun guot khu atungta hi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen na suohten asuongte adeithaw mama ua, a leivuite na ngawn angaina uhi."},"15":{"text":"Namten Mangpa min a zau ding ua, leitunga leengte zousie in na thupina azau ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n Zion alamtha kia dinga, athupina toh ahing kilang kia ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Aman bangmaneiloute thumna angaisah dinga, athumnate uh asimmaw sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tam thu khangtha hing um dingte dinga gel ahi ding a, nam hing kisiemkhe dingte’n, Mangpa apahtawi theina ding uh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n amun siengthou sangtah akipat in ahing ensuh a, Mangpa’n van a kipat in leitung a ensuh hi."},"20":{"text":"Aman suongkul taangte tau thawm aza dinga; shi dinga kiguotte aphelkhe ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zion ah Mangpa min akiphuongzah dinga, tualeh Ama phatna Jerusalem ah kiphuongzah ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mipite leh leenggamte Mangpa be dinga, ahing kikhop khawm hun chiengun,"},"23":{"text":"Aman lamkaal ah ka tha atawlsah a, ka damsung nite asutomta hi."},"24":{"text":"Ken, “Aw ka Pasian,” ka damsung hatlai nite ah, “Hing lamang nai sin; Nangma kumte pen akhang akhang a umden ding ahi hi.”"},"25":{"text":"Nangma’n leitung kingahna nidanglai peh a na phumsa ahi a, vante zong na khutsuoh ahi.","ref":"Heb. 1.10-12"},"26":{"text":"Tuate ahing mangthang ding ua, hinanleh Nang pen na umden ding hi; Ahi tuate zousie pen puonsil bangin ahing lui ding ua, puonsil bangin na hengta ding a, tuachi’n ahing kihengta ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Nang pen angai ngai na hi a, Na kumte zong a bei ngaisih ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Na suohte tate pen aumzing ding ua, tualeh ahah asuonte uh zong na masang ah suhdet in aum ding uhi. Ka chi hi."}}},"103":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw ka hinna Mangpa phat in, ka sunga umte zousie aw! Amin siengthou phat un.","title":"Pasian hoina phatna David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Aw ka hinna, Mangpa phat inlen, phattuomna ahing bawlpieh zousie manghil vawt sin."},"3":{"text":"Aman na khelnate zousie angaidam a, na natna zousie asudam hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman manthaina kokhuh apat in na hinna atandoh a, Itna tulngailou leh khotuona ahing khusah hi."},"5":{"text":"Na kam silhoi in ahing taisah a, tuachi’n na khangdawnna khu muvanlai banga siemtha in a um kia zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n suhgentheina thuohte zousie a dingin, dihtatna leh thudih in vai ahawmpieh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Aman alampite Mosi kungah atheisah a, asil bawlte Israelte kungah atheisah hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa khu lainatsiem leh hepisiem ahi a, lungthah bailou leh khotuona hau ahi.","ref":"Jak. 5.11"},"9":{"text":"Aman eite ahing phawhthop ngitnget sih dinga, alungthah ngitnget sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aman ikhelnate dungzui in itungah nna asem sih a, gitlounate dungzui in ahing thuh sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen vante leitung sanga asan zawh bangin; A khotuona khu ama giing mite a dingin alien mama hi."},"12":{"text":"Suolam leh tumlam akigamlat bangin, Aman itawnkhelnate eima akipat akoimangta hi."},"13":{"text":"Pa in tate ahepi bangin, Mangpa’n Ama giing mite ahepi ngitnget hi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman itahsa pumpi kisiem dan athei a, leivuigiap ihi dan zong athei ngitnget hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihing pen adam sung nite hampa bang bep ahi a, gamlah a pahpe pah bangin ahing pah lun hi;"},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen hui in a mut chiengin aleengmang pai ua, a umna mun nangawn a kithei nawnsih hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa khotuona khu ama giingte tungah, kumtawn akipat kumtawn tanin a umden dinga; tualeh adihtatna zong atu khang ata khang tan in a umden ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A thuhun zui poumate leh athupiehte zui tum a theizingte kungah."},"19":{"text":"Mangpa’n vantungah aleengtouna asudet a, A leenggam in zong bangkim tungah vai ahawm hi."},"20":{"text":"Nou athu ngaikhie a athu mang, hatna thupi nei Vansawlsiengte aw, Mangpa phat un."},"21":{"text":"Nou agalkapte zousie leh nou adeilam bawl a, Ama nasemte zousie aw, Mangpa phat un."},"22":{"text":"Ama vaihawmna mun phot a, Asilbawl zousiete aw, Mangpa phat un; Aw ka hinna Mangpa phat in."}}},"104":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka hinna aw Mangpa phat in, Aw Mangpa ka Pasian Nang na thupi mama a, pahtawina leh vangletnain na kithuom hi.","title":"Sil zousie siempa Pasian phatna"},"2":{"text":"Khovah puon bangin na sil a, vante zong puon inn bangin na zah hi."},"3":{"text":"Aman a pindan tungnung innkam zawlte khu tui lah ah ahunga, meilumte khu sakolleng in abawl a, huipi ha tungah atuong hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman huite thupotu in azang a, meikuongte anasem in azang hi.","ref":"Heb. 1.7"},"5":{"text":"Aman leitung kingahna suongphum aphum a, kumtawmna akilin louna dingin."},"6":{"text":"Aman leitung khu tuithuhpi in puon bangin akhukhum a; taangte tungah tuite a um zeizoi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na phawhthop chieng in tuipite ataimanga, na vanging thawmte zieh in akikhin mangta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Taangte tungah apeitou ua, amauh dinga na mupiehna mun phaihawmte ah apeikhesuh zel uhi."},"9":{"text":"Akantan louna dingun gamgi na hung a, leitung tummang ding a anuakia louna ding un."},"10":{"text":"Aman guomte ah tuinahte a pul sah a, tuate taang kikaalte ah a luong uhi;"},"11":{"text":"tuaten gamsa chinteng kungah dawn ding apie a, gam sabiltungten adangtah uh aphasah zel uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuami luipangte ah tungleng vate’n umna anei ua, luising bazamte lah ah vaten la asa uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aman a pindan tungnung apat in taangte tui in ahing tapnou zel a; leitung na khut nasep gate ah taitah in a um uhi."},"14":{"text":"Gantate a dingin hampa a pousah a, ante louhingte mihingte zah ding in a pousah hi; leitunga kipat neh ding apawtsah theina dingin."},"15":{"text":"Mihingte lungnopna dingin zu na siema, amai uh suhnouna dingin sathau, tualeh mihing lungtang suhat dingin tanghou a bawlpieh hi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa singkungte khu abawhpha mama ua tuiin atapnou a, Lebanon taanga asuon singte khu."},"17":{"text":"Tuami singkung lah ah vaten bu abawl ua, vaiva a dingin tasingte a inn ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tang sangte khu sakelte dinga umna ahi a, suongpite khu zupite kibutna ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Aman kum kihei dan chiemtena dingin hapi abawl a, ni in atum hun ding athei ngitnget hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangma’n miel na bawl a, zan ahing hi a, zan nuoi ah gamsa zousie avahdoh uhi."},"21":{"text":"Humpibahnei lunlaiten asamat ding uh angih ua, Pasian apat neh ding asui uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ni ahing suoh chiengin, aum khawm zel ua akawsung uah alum uhi."},"23":{"text":"Mihingte zong anasepna mun chiet uah akuon ua, nitahlam tandong a semgim uhi."},"24":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na silbawlte tam hina va-ia uh e! amaute khu pilna a na bawl ngen ahi ua, leitung na siemsatein a dim uhi."},"25":{"text":"Khunah tuipi lien leh thupi a um a, asungah simsenglou ganhing alien aneu tampi a um uhi."},"26":{"text":"Khunah tembawh apei a, asunga ki-apmai dingin nana bawl a, Leviathan ahing kuonta hi.","ref":"Job. 41.1; Late. 74.14; Isai. 27.1"},"27":{"text":"Tuate zousie in, ahuntah a ann na pieh theina dingin Nangma ahing ngah chiet uhi."},"28":{"text":"Amauh kung a na pieh pouma atom khawm ua, Na khut na zah a, hoina in atai zel uhi."},"29":{"text":"Na mai na phuol a achimaw uh a, anahna uh na lamang a ashi ua, leivui ah nua kia kia zel uhi."},"30":{"text":"Na hagau na sawlkhie a siem in a um uhi; tualeh leitung zong na siemtha kia zel hi."},"31":{"text":"Mangpa thupina khu kumtawn in um henlen; a siemsate zousie tungah Mangpa kipah in nuomta hen."},"32":{"text":"Aman leitung a en a akiling zel hi, taangte akhoi a meikhu apawt zel hi."},"33":{"text":"Ka damsung teng Mangpa phat in la kasa dinga; ka hinlaisie ka Pasian phat in la kasa ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Ka ngaituona khu Ama a dingin humtah hi henlen, Kei pen Mangpa ah ka nuom ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Leitung a pat in mikhielte suhmangin um uh henlen, migiloute zong um nawn sih uhen. Aw ka hinna Mangpa phat in. Mangpa khu pahtawi chiet un."}}},"105":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa kungah kipahthu gen unlen, Amin siengthou han unlen, mite lah ah asibawlte theisah un.","title":"Israelte tunga Pasian gin umna"},"2":{"text":"Ama pahtawi in la sa unlen, Ama phat in la sa un, asilbawl lamdang zousie ah houlim un."},"3":{"text":"Amin siengthou suong unlen, Mangpa sui mite lungtang kipah hen."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa leh ahatna sui unlen, bangchilai pouin Amel sui ngitnget un."},"5":{"text":"Asil lamdang bawlsate thei ngitnget unlen, asillamdangte leh akam a vaihawmnate thei ngitnget un."},"6":{"text":"Aw nou, Asuohpa Abraham hahlesuonte leh, atel tuom Jakob tate."},"7":{"text":"Ama khu i Mangpa Pasian uh ahi a, A vaihawmnate leitung pumpi ah a um hi."},"8":{"text":"Aman athuhunte kumtawn in athei ngitnget a, khang tulkhat tan a ana thupiehsate ngei khu."},"9":{"text":"Abraham kunga athuhun leh, Isak kunga akichiemna ngei khu.","ref":"Siem. 12.7; 17.8; Siem. 26.3"},"10":{"text":"Tuami khu adan thupieh dingin Jakob kungah asudet a, Israelte kungah kumtawn thuhun dingin asudetta hi.","ref":"Siem. 28.13"},"11":{"text":"“Noute kungah Kanaan gam ka hing pe ding hi, na goutan tuom ding un,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi tawmnou khat ahilai uleh, simtham ching lou ahi lai un, tualeh khum gam a mikhuol ahi lai un;"},"13":{"text":"Nam khat akipat namdang kunga, tualeh leenggam khat apat leenggam dang kung a avahvai lai un,"},"14":{"text":"Koima’n amauh anuoisie ding aphal sih a, ahi, amauh ziehin leengte na phawhhil zel hi.","ref":"Siem. 20.3-7"},"15":{"text":"“Ka sathau nusa khoisih unlen, ka guolneite bawlse sih un,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Khum gama tung dingin kiel ahan a, neh ding mawngmawng a um sah ta sih hi.","ref":"Siem. 41.53-57"},"17":{"text":"Amasanguah mi khat Joseph ngei asawl a, Ama khu suoh dinga zuain a um hi.","ref":"Siem. 37.28; 45.5"},"18":{"text":"A kengte kolbun in aliemsah ua, sia khainieng bulin a umta hi.","ref":"Siem. 39.20—40.23"},"19":{"text":"Athugen ahing tangtun masangsie in; Mangpa thuin ama aze etta hi."},"20":{"text":"Lengpan mi asawl a ahakhe sah a, mipite vaihawmpa’n ama azalen tahin apeisahta hi.","ref":"Siem. 41.14"},"21":{"text":"Ama’n a innsunga houtu ding leh, anei alam zousie tunga thunei dingin leh;","ref":"Siem. 41.39-41"},"22":{"text":"A miliente a ut thu thu a kaan ding leh, a upate pilna thu hil dingin ama abawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel zong Izipt gam ah ahing lut a, tuachi’n Ham gam ah Jakob khuolzin bangin atam tadi hi.","ref":"Siem. 46.6; Siem. 47.11"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n amite nasatah in apungsaha, amelmate uh sanga hatzaw in abawlta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 1.7-14"},"25":{"text":"Aman amite muda dingin Izipt mite lungtangte ahei pieh a, asuohte tunga lepchietah a bawl dingin."},"26":{"text":"Aman asuoh Mosi asawl a Aaron ami tel toh.","ref":"Pawt. 3.1—4.17"},"27":{"text":"Amaute gel in chiemtenate alah uah abawl ua, tualeh Ham gam ah sillamdangte abawl uhi."},"28":{"text":"Aman miel asawl a, amiel sahta a; athu kal in ahel tasih uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 10.21-23"},"29":{"text":"Aman atuite uh sisan asuohsah a, angate uh ashisah ta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 7.17-21"},"30":{"text":"Agam uh ukengin ahing dimta a, aleengpa uh pindansung nangawn ah adimta uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 8.1-6"},"31":{"text":"Aman thu agen a, thou tampi ahing um a, tualeh hit zong agamsung pumpi uah ahing dimta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 8.20-24; Pawt. 8.16,17"},"32":{"text":"Aman akung uah guo taang in giel apie a, agamsung uah tunphe toh kithuo keh akesah hi.","ref":"Pawt. 9.22-25"},"33":{"text":"Agrepguite uleh atheipi kungte uh asuhlup pieh a, agamsung ua singkungte nangawn asuhtan pieh sieng hi."},"34":{"text":"Aman thu agena, khauphete ahing um ua, khauphe nou simsengloute ahing um uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 10.12-15"},"35":{"text":"Tuaten agamsung pumpi ua, haichi zousie anegamta ua, aleigate uh anekhawng siengta uhi."},"36":{"text":"Agamsung ua taluchil zousie athat a, ahatna ga masapente uh zousie khu.","ref":"Pawt. 12.29"},"37":{"text":"Aman dangka leh sana toh amauh apuidoh a, tualeh Ama namte lah ah mihatlou khat zong a um sih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.33-36"},"38":{"text":"Amaute apawtdoh laitah un Izipt mite akipah mama uhi; Israelte zauna atung ua atuh zieh in."},"39":{"text":"Aman Israelte lie dingin atung uah meilum akaisah a, zanlai chienga tanvah dingin meikuong apie hi.","ref":"Pawt. 13.21,22"},"40":{"text":"Miten angen ua, vamimte apie a, Van ann in amauh ataisah hi.","ref":"Pawt. 16.2-15"},"41":{"text":"Aman suongpi apohkhisah a, tui ahing luongdoh a mun gawte ah lui bangin tui aluong hi.","ref":"Pawt. 17.1-7; Kisim. 20.2-13"},"42":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman athuchiem siengthou leh, asuohpa Abraham athei ngitnget hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n amite khu nuomsatah in apuidoh ta a, a mi telte kipah kawm in apuidoh ta hi."},"44":{"text":"Aman namte gam khu amauh apeta a, amaun agam mite sepgimna aluota uhi.","ref":"Josh. 11.16-23"},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun athuguotte azui ua, adanthute a nit theina ding uh ahi. Mangpa phat un. Mangpa pahtawi un."}}},"106":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa phat un, Mangpa kungah kipahthu gen un, Ama ahoi ngal a, A khotuona kumtawn in a um ding hi.","title":"Israelte khelna kiphuondohna","ref":"1 Khang. 16.34; 2 Khang. 5.13; 7.3; Ezr. 3.11; Late. 100.5; 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer. 33.11"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa silbawl thupitahte koi ahiei gen thei ding? Ahisihleh aphatna koi ahiei phuong thei ding?"},"3":{"text":"Vaihawmnadih kem hoi mite ahampha uhi, hunchintenga dihtatna bawl mite toh."},"4":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, na mite na deisahnain kei hing thei ngitnget inlen; Na hundamna toh kei hing ve in aw."},"5":{"text":"Na mi telte hamphatna ka mu theina ding leh, Na namte kipahna a ka nuom theina ding leh, na goutante toh ka thupi khawm theina dingin."},"6":{"text":"Kapu ka pate uleh koute kana khielta ua, silgilou ka bawlta ua, giloutahin ka gamta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kapu leh pate un Izipt gama na sillamdang bawlte atheisiem sih ua, Na khotuona thupitah atheizing ta sih ua; Tuipi san gei ah Tungnung Pen tungah ahelta zawsop uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 14.10-12"},"8":{"text":"Ahivang in Mangpa’n Ama min zieh in amauh ahundamta hi; tuachi a amaun asilbawltheina thupitah atheisah theina dingin."},"9":{"text":"Aman tuipi san aphawh a, akangsanta a, tuachi’n gamdai a pei bangin tui thuhpi ah amaute apui galkaita hi.","ref":"Pawt. 14.21-31"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh mudate khut apat in ahundamta a, agalte uh khut apat in atankheta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuipi in amelmate uh atummangta a, khat zong asuohta sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun athute agingta ua, ama phat in la asa uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 15.1-21"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh A silbawlte amanghil pai ua, alemguotnate angahzou sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh gamdai ah agongsan mama ta ua, gamgaw mun ah Pasian aze etta uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 11.4-34"},"15":{"text":"Pasian in anget uh apie a, hinanleh ahinna uah gawnna atun ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Agieh phuol uah Pasian misiengthou Mosi leh Aaron tungah athangsie uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 16.1-35"},"17":{"text":"Leitung in akam akah a Dathan avaltum a Abiram lawmte avuamangta hi."},"18":{"text":"A pawlpi lah uah mei ahing kuonga, tua meikuongin migiloute akatumta hi."},"19":{"text":"Horeb muol ah bawngnou lim abawl ua, milim kisunthu khu abeta uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 32.1-14"},"20":{"text":"Tambangin amaun athupina u khu, hampane bawngtal lim khat toh ahengta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Izipt gam a sil thupitah tah bawlpa, ahundampa uh Pasian amanghilta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ham gamsunga sillamdangtah leh Tuipi san gei a silchizathuoitah bawlpa amanghilta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin sumang khava e, chiin athangpaina kiheimangsah dingin, atel Mosi khu alutna ding amasang ah ding kha laizang sih leh, ka sumang ding chi Ama’n agen hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua gam nuomtah khu asimmaw ua, athugente agingta thei sih uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 14.1-35"},"25":{"text":"A puon inn sung uah aphun ua, Mangpa thugen angaikhe nuom sih uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuazieh im Aman akhut alaamtouta a, gamdai a amauh puasah dingin akichiem a,"},"27":{"text":"ahah asuonte u’zong namte lah a pua sah ding leh, gam chin a athethang na dingin.","ref":"Siempu. 26.33"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute Peor mun a Baal toh akizop ua, mi shite kunga kithoina sa ane ta uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 25.1-13"},"29":{"text":"Tuabanga asilbawlte un Mangpa asulungthah ua, alah uah natna hipi ahing lengta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Phinehas adingdoh a, thu anget pieh a, tuachi’n natna hi leng akhawlta hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua asilbawl khu Phinehas a dingin, kumtawn a khang zousie tan a dingin dihtatna a sim ahita hi."},"32":{"text":"Amaun Meribah tuite ah Mangpa asulungthah ua, amaute ziehin Mosi tungah silhoilou atunghielta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 20.2-13"},"33":{"text":"Aziehpen a hagau tungah ahel ua, tuachi’n akam in thu kilawmlou agenkhata hi."},"34":{"text":"Mangpa’n akung ua sumang dinga thu apieh bangin, tua gam mite asumang sih uhi.","ref":"Vai. 2.1-3; 3.5,6"},"35":{"text":"Hinanleh namte lah ah akihalthang ua, asilbawlte uh azui zawsop uhi."},"36":{"text":"Amilim pasiente uh abie ua, tuate ama ua dingin thang ahing hita hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahi dawite kungah atapate uleh atanute un akithoi ua.","ref":"2 Leeng. 17.17"},"38":{"text":"Mawnaneiloute sisan asuo ua, atapate uleh atanute uh nangawn Kanaan, milimte kungah kithoina in anei uh a, tua gam khu sisan a suhbua in ahing umta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 35.33"},"39":{"text":"Tuabangin amauh nasep mama in akisuthanghuoi ua, asilbawlte ngei uah kizua asuohta uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuaziehin amite tungah Mangpa lungthahna akuongta a, agoutante akidahta hi.","ref":"Vai. 2.14-18"},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman amaute namdangte khut ah apeta a, amauh mudaten atung uah vai ahawmta uhi."},"42":{"text":"Amelmate un anuoisie ua, akhutnuoi uah akoi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Aman amauh tampivei ahunkhie a, hinanleh alunggeelna uah atungah ahel ua, akhelnate zieh un suhngiem in a um uhi."},"44":{"text":"Khuchi pumpum in zong, akikouna thawmte uh azahpieh zel a, agentheinate uh angaisah zel hi."},"45":{"text":"Amaute ziehin athuhun athei ngitnget a, A khotuona thupidan dung zui in alungsim akisiata hi."},"46":{"text":"Amauh suoh leh sal a puite zousiein amauh ahepisah nalai hi."},"47":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka Pasian uh, hing hundam inlen, namte lah a kipat hing puikhawm in, Na min siengthou pahtawi ding leh, Na phatna a guolzou dingin.","ref":"1 Khang. 16.35,36"},"48":{"text":"Mangpa Israelte Pasian kumtawn apat kumtawn tan in, phat in um hen, Mipi zousiein “Amen” chi hen, Mangpa phat un."}}},"107":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa kungah kipahthu gen un, aziehpen ama ahoi a, A khotuona kumtawn in a umden ding hi.","title":"BU NGANA (Late 107-150) Pasian in Hagau dangtahte ataisah hi","ref":"1 Khang. 16.34; 2 Khang. 5.13; 7.3; Ezr. 3.11; Late. 100.5; 106.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer. 33.11"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa tatsa miten tuabangin gen uhen, melma khut a kipat a atatdoh miten;"},"3":{"text":"Suolam leh tumlam, simlam leh mallam gamteng akipat a apuikhawmten, kipahthu gen un."},"4":{"text":"Amauh gamdai lampi ah, avahvai ua, tenna ding khopi mawngmawng amu sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Gilkiel leh dangta in a hinna uh asung uah abata hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n lungkham leh mangbang in Mangpa ahan ua, Aman agentheina ua kipat amauh ahunkhe zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Aman amauh mihing umna khuoa aten theina ding un, lampi tangtah ah apuita hi."},"8":{"text":"Aw, mihingte’n Mangpa khu ahoina zieh leh, mihing tate tunga asillamdang bawlte zieh in, kipahthu gen uleh aw!"},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman lunggul mama neite hinna ataisah a, tualeh hinna gilkielte silhoi in agilva sah hi."},"10":{"text":"Miel nuoi leh, shina lim nuoi a toute, thuohgimna leh siakhau a kihente mama khu;"},"11":{"text":"Pasian thu doua ahel zieh un, Tungnung Pen lemguotte asimmaw uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aman alungtangte uh sepgimnain akunsah a, apuasuh ua hinanleh panpi ding koima a um tasih hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Lungkham sengin Mangpa ahan ua, Aman abuoina ua kipat amauh ahundoh zel hi."},"14":{"text":"Aman miel lah akipat leh, shina lim a kipat in amauh apuidoh a, a kaanna khaute uh asutanta hi."},"15":{"text":"Aw mihingten Mangpa khu ahoina zieh leh, mihing tate a dinga asillamdang bawlte zieh in, kipahthu gen uleh aw!"},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman sum-eng kulkotkhate asusie a, akalna sia zawlte asutan ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihingte akhelna zieh uleh, agitlouna zieh un gimthuoh sah in a um uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ahinna un nehthei chinteng akidah a, shina kulkot anai zel uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n mangbang in Mangpa ahan ua, Aman agimthuohna ua pat amauh ahunkhe zel hi."},"20":{"text":"Aman athu asawl a amauh asudam a, a manthaina ua kipat amauh ahunkhie hi."},"21":{"text":"Aw mihingte’n Mangpa khu ahoina zieh leh, mihing tate a dinga asillamdang bawlte ziehin, kipahthu gen u leh aw!"},"22":{"text":"Amaun kipahthugenna kithoina lan uhenlen, asilbawlte nuomin phuongzah uhen."},"23":{"text":"Tuipi tunga tembaw akitawl suh a, tuipi lientah tunga summet bawl a
