kivaite’n;"},"24":{"text":"Mangpa nasepte leh tuipi thuhtah nuoi a, asillamdang bawlte amu uhi."},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman thu apie a, tui kihawt sousang sah thei huipi alaangsah hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuate vanlam ah akivawhtou ua, tui thuhpi ah akesuh zel uhi. Tuahsietna ziehin ahinna uh azunmangta hi."},"27":{"text":"Zukham bangin alang alangah ahawilen kawi ua, kimakhup dihdih in aum ua, umdan mawngmawng a thei sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n mangbang sengin Mangpa ahan ua, Aman agentheina ua pat apuidoh zel hi."},"29":{"text":"Aman huipi adaisah a, tui kihawtte zong adai duom zel uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi a adai dide tah zieh in akipah ua, tuachi’n Aman alunggul uh kuongkhawlna mun ah apui tung zel hi."},"31":{"text":"Aw mihingte’n Mangpa khu ahoina zieh leh, mihing tate mihingte dinga asillamdang bawlte zieh in, kipahthu gen uleh aw!"},"32":{"text":"Mipi kikhawmte lah ah Ama pahtawi uhenlen, upa kikhawmte lah ah Ama phat uhen."},"33":{"text":"Aman luite gamdai asuohsah a, tuinahte zong leigaw asuohsah hi."},"34":{"text":"Asunga tengte gitlouna ziehin, bu leh bal pienna gamte zong, bangma pien theilouna gamgaw asuohsahzel hi."},"35":{"text":"Aman gamdai zong tui veina dil asuohsah a, gamgawna mun zong tuinah asuoh sah zel hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua mun ah gilkielte atengsah a, tualeh amauten atenna ding uh khopi abawl uhi."},"37":{"text":"Loute ahou ua, grep huonte zong abawl ua, tuaten ga tampi hing piengte amu theina ding un."},"38":{"text":"Amauh aguolzawl a, nasatah in ahing pung ua, agantate uh khu akiem aphal sih hi."},"39":{"text":"Nuoisiena, suhgentheina leh lungkhamna zieh in, ahing kiem hiei hiei zel ua, suhngiem in ahing umta uhi."},"40":{"text":"Aman miliente tungah simmawna asungbuo a, lampi mawngmawng umlouna gamdai ah avahvai sah hi."},"41":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman mitasamte agentheina ua kipat in adomkangtou a, mun sangah akoitou a, a innkuonte uh belamhon bangin apungsah hi."},"42":{"text":"Midihtatten tuakhu amu ua akipah ua; thulimlouna zousie in akam ahum ding uhi."},"43":{"text":"Koizong mipil pouma in tam silte akem hoi ding ua, Mangpa itna tulngailou atheisiem ding uhi."}}},"108":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Pasian ka lungtang adet hi, la ka sa dinga ka thupina toh, ka hing phat ding hi.","title":"Pasian phatna leh guolzawlna la David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Tumgingte leh pehgingte aw, hing thou unlen, zingmawng phalvah phong ding ka hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa aw, mipite lah ah nangma ka hing phat dinga, namte lah ah nangma phat in la kasa ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen na khotuona van khup hielin athupi a, Na thutahnain meilumte asunpha hi."},"5":{"text":"Aw Pasian vante tunglam peh ah tawisangin um inlen, Na thupina zong leitung pumpi ah pahtawi in um hen."},"6":{"text":"Na itte hutkhiet a a um theina dingun, Na khut zietlam in hundam inlen, tualeh hing dawng in."},"7":{"text":"Pasian in asiengthounain thu agenta hi, “Ka nuom ding a Shekem khuo ka hawmdinga, Sukoth phaijang ka tekhen ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Gilead kei a ahi a, Manasseh kei a ahi; Ephraim ka sia lukhu ahi a, Juda pen ka dan petu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Moab khu ka kisilna bel ahi a, Edom tungah ka kedap ka pai ding a, Philistin tungah guolzouin ka kikou ding hi;”"},"10":{"text":"Kulpi nei khopi a hing puilut ding koi ahiei? Edom gam hing tun ding koi ahiei?"},"11":{"text":"Aw Pasian koute hing paikhepa nangma hilou na hiei mah? Aw Pasian ka galkapte utoh kuondoh nawnlou ding na hiei mah?"},"12":{"text":"Ka buoina ua kipat in hing panpi in, mihing panpina pen bangmalou ahibou hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian zal in hangsantah in ka dou ding ua; ka galte uh hing totchil pieh ding Ama ahibou hi."}}},"109":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw ka pahtawina Pasian, aw hamlou in um sin.","title":"Phuba lahpieh ding a ngetna Lapulien a ding David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen migiloute kam leh mi solhatte kam kei hing dou in akikaah hi; Amaun zuou hat leiin ka kungah thu agen uhi."},"3":{"text":"Mudana thu in ahing imkuol ua tualeh azieh umloupiin ahing dou uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka itna thuhna in ahing hehte ahita uhi, Hinanleh kei pen thunget nalam ah ka kipe chinten hi."},"5":{"text":"Tambangin ka hoina sil hoilou in ahing thuh ua, ka itna khu mudana in ahing thuh uhi."},"6":{"text":"Nangman atung uah migilou koi inlen, aziet lam ah hehmi ding sah in."},"7":{"text":"Atunga thukhenna a um chiengin, siemawtangin um henlen, athungetna zong khelna suoh heh."},"8":{"text":"Adamsung nite tom henlen, anasepna mun midangin tang hen.","ref":"Nasep. 1.20"},"9":{"text":"Atate pa neilou in um uhenlen, azi zong meithai in um hen."},"10":{"text":"Atate vahvai ngitnget uhenlen, khutdaw uhen, a neh ding uh amun sete lah uah sui uhen."},"11":{"text":"Aleibatna pa’n anei zousie uh lahpieh sieng henlen; gamdang miten asepgim gate uh lahpieh hen."},"12":{"text":"Ama khotuo ding mi koima um vawtsih henlen, pa bei a um atate zong adeisah ding koima um sih hen."},"13":{"text":"Ahah asuonte uh suhmangin um uhenlen; khangtha hing um dingte lah ah amin uh thaimangin um uhen."},"14":{"text":"Apu apate uh gitlouna khu Mangpa masang ah thei ngitnget in um henlen, anu khelna zong kithaimang sih hen."},"15":{"text":"Amaute thei zingna leitung apat suhmang ahi theina dingin, Mangpa masangah akhelnate uh um ngitnget hen."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen aman khotuona etsahna dan athei sih a, hinanleh lungtanga kingaisete atha theina dingin, migenthei leh tasamte asugenthei zaw leeng hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi gausap nuom asah lamtah ahi zieh in, tuakhu ama tungah tu hen, guolzawlna adeilou ziehin, guolzawlna in ama gamlat hen."},"18":{"text":"Aman gausapna khu puon silbanga asil ziehin, tuakhu atahsa sungah tui bangin lut henlen, agu sungah sathau bangin lut hen."},"19":{"text":"Hamsie khu ama a dingin asil ngitnget puonsil bang hi henlen, akigah zingna kawnggah bang hing hi hen."},"20":{"text":"Tuakhu kei hing hehte leh, ka hinna hing gensete tunga Mangpa thuhna hi hen."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa ka Pasian, Nangman na min ziehin hing bawlpieh inlen, Na khotuona ahoi ziehin hing hunkhie in."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen kei genthei leh tasam ka hi a, ka sungah ka lungtang aliem hi."},"23":{"text":"Ni him kiem bangin ka manga, khauphe bangin mutleng in ka um hi."},"24":{"text":"Ann ngawl ziehin ka khup azaw gawpta a, ka tahsain thauna atahsap zieh in ka tha aneem hi."},"25":{"text":"Agensiet uh ka hing hita a, ahing et chiengun alu uh ahing thinkhum uhi.","ref":"Mat. 27.39; Mak. 15.29"},"26":{"text":"Mangpa ka Pasian aw hing panpi inlen, Na khotuona dungzuiin hing hundam in."},"27":{"text":"Tami na khut ahi chi athei ua, Mangpa, Nangma bawl ahi chi a theina ding un."},"28":{"text":"Amaun gausap uhenlen, hinanleh Nangman guolzawl in, athawdoh tahchieng un, zala uhenlen, hinanleh Na suohte nuom uhen."},"29":{"text":"Kei hing hehte zumna in tuom henlen, azalatna un puon bangin tuomkhum hen."},"30":{"text":"Ka kam in Mangpa uongtahin ka phat ding a, mi tampite lah ah Ama ka phat ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama gentheite zietlam ah ading ding a, ahinna mawpaite lah a kipat a hundam dingin."}}},"110":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mangpa’n ka Mangpa kungah, Na melmate na kengphang ngahna a, ka bawl masangsie’n ka ziet lang ah tou in,” achi hi.","title":"Ahing pei ding Leeng-Siempu Vaihawmna phatna, David phatna la.","ref":"Mat. 22.44; Mak. 12.36; Luk. 20.42,43; Nasep. 2.34,35; 1 Kor. 15.25; Eph. 1.20-22; Kolo. 3.1; Heb. 1.13; 8.1; 10.12,13"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n Zion a kipat in na hatna leengchieng asawldoh dinga, na melmate lah ah nangman vaihawm in!"},"3":{"text":"Na mite khu na silbawltheina ni ah, amauh ut thuin akipe ding ua, zingmawng gilsunga kipat a, siengthou kilawmnain na khangdawng hina, daitui khu na nei hi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa akichiemta a, alungsim heng kia sih ding hi. “Nang pen Melkizedek umdan banga kumtawn siempu na hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Heb. 5.6; 6.20; 7.17,21"},"5":{"text":"Mangpa na zietlam a umin, Athangpaina ni ah, leengte asatpua sieng ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman namte lah ah vai ahawm ding a, munchin ah mishi luong adim sah dinga, gam tampite ah lutangte asatphel lemlum ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Lam gei a luita tui adawn dinga, tuaziehin lutang khu atawisang ding hi."}}},"111":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa phat un, Ken midihtatte kikhopna leh mipi kikhawmte lah ah, ka lungtang zousie in Mangpa ka phat ding hi.","title":"Pasian nasep lamdangte phatna"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa nasepte athupi a, tuate kipahna neite’n asuikhe zel uhi."},"3":{"text":"Anasep khu azatathuoi in athupi a, tualeh adihtatna khu kumtawn in a umden ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman asillamdang bawlte thei ngitnget dingin abawla, Mangpa khu hepisiem leh lainatna a dim ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aman Ama ging mite kungah neh ding apie a, Athuhun khu kumtawnin athei ngitnget ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A nasep thupidante amite kungah aphuongta a, namte agouluo ding ua apieh theina ding in."},"7":{"text":"Akhut nasepte khu thutah leh vaihawmnadih ahi a, Athuhilnate zousie amuonhuoi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuate khu kumtawn kumtawn a dingin adet a, thutahna leh dihtatna toh bawl ahi."},"9":{"text":"Aman amite kungah tatna ahing sawl a, athuhun khu kumtawn a dingin thu apie a, Siengthou leh zatat huoi khu Amin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa giin khu pilna bul ahi a, athupieh zuite poumain theisiemna hoitah anei uhi. Ama phatna khu kumtawn in a umden ding hi.","ref":"Job. 28.28; Thu. 1.7; 9.10"}}},"112":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa phat un, Mangpa giing mi, athupiehte nasataha kipahpi mi ahampha hi.","title":"Midihtatte nunnopna"},"2":{"text":"Ahah asuonte leitungah mi hattah ahi ding ua, midihtatte khang guolzawl in a um ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A suonte khu leitungah mi hattah ahi ding ua, midih hahlesuonte khu guolzawl in aum ding hi. Adihtatna kumtawn in a umden ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Midih a dingin mielna lah ah vah ahing tangkhe zel ding a, ama khu mi hepisiem, lainatna a dim, dihtattah ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mi hoiin deisahna asulang zela, aleitawisah hi, ama tungthu pilvangtahin angaituo ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangchihtanin suhling in a um sih dinga, midihtatte pen kumtawn a theizingin a um ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Thuthang hoiloute azau sih ding ua, alungtangte uh Mangpa muongin adet zaw ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Alungtang uh adet a, amelmate uh tunga adei uh, hing tung amu masangsie uh azau sih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amaun ahawmzah ua, gentheite kungah apie ua, adihtatna uh kumtawnin a um ding a, akii u’khu pahtawina toh tawisangin a um ding hi.","ref":"2 Kor. 9.9"},"10":{"text":"Migilouin tuakhu amu dinga alungthah ding a; Aha agawt dinga, azunmang ding hi. Migiloute lunggul pen a mangthang ding hi."}}},"113":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa phat un, Aw nou Mangpa suohte, Ama phat unlen, Mangpa min phat un.","title":"Pasian phatna tawpneilou"},"2":{"text":"Tu a kipat kumtawn dongin Mangpa min phat in um hen."},"3":{"text":"Nisuohna lam apat, nitumna lam dongin Mangpa min phat ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa khu nam zousiete tunglam peh ah aum a, athupina zong vante tunglam peh ah a um hi."},"5":{"text":"Tunglam sangtah a um, Mangpa i Pasian uh bang koi ahiei um?"},"6":{"text":"Van a sil umte leh lei a sil umte en dinga, kingaingiem ama bang koi ahiei?"},"7":{"text":"Aman migentheite leivui a pat in akaithou a, mi tasamte vut vum a kipat in adomkang zel hi."},"8":{"text":"Amauh miliente kunga atousah theina dingin, amite lah a miliente toh atoukhawm sah hi."},"9":{"text":"Aman numei chiing kungah inn apie a, tualeh nuomtaha um tualeh ta neinuin asiem zel hi. Mangpa phat un."}}},"114":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipat Israelte apawtdoh ua, Jakob innkuonte hamtuom namte lah a kipat a apawtdoh lai un;","title":"Izipt a pat a pawtdohna phatna","ref":"Pawt. 12.51"},"2":{"text":"Juda khu Pasian mun siengthou ahi a, Israel khu avaihawmna leenggam ahita hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuipi in amu a ataimangta a; Jordan lui zong aleluonta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 14.21; Josh. 3.16"},"4":{"text":"Tangte belamtal bangin akidieng ua, muolneute zong belam noute bangin adieng uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aw nang tuipi bang achileh taimang na hiei? Aw Jordan lui bang dinga nua luonkie na hiei?"},"6":{"text":"Tangte aw bang achileh belamtal banga kidieng nahi uoi? Muolneute aw bang achileh belamnoute banga kidieng na hi uoi?"},"7":{"text":"Aw nang leitung, Mangpa masang ah kiling inlen Jakob Pasian masangah kiling in."},"8":{"text":"Aman suongpi zong dil asuohsah a, meisa suong zong tuinah a suohsah hi.","ref":"Pawt. 17.1-7; Kisim. 20.2-13"}}},"115":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa kou hing pe louin, koute hing pe louin, Na khotuona leh na thutahna ziehin, thupina khu Na min pe zawin.","title":"Pasian kung bou ah thupina aum"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh a namdangten “A Pasian uh heia um ahiei,” ahing chi sese ding uh ahiei?"},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh ka Pasian uh van ah a um a, Aman a ut ut abawl hi."},"4":{"text":"A milimte ukhu sana leh dangka akibawl, mihingte khut suoh ahibou hi.","ref":"Late. 135.15-18; Kihil. 9.20"},"5":{"text":"Kam a nei ua, hinanleh ahamthei sih ua, mit a nei ua, hinanleh amuthei sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Bil a nei ua, hinanleh a za thei sih ua, nahkuo a nei ua, hinanleh bangma gimnam anam thei tuom sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Khut a nei ua, hinanleh bangma atham thei sih ua, keng a nei ua, hinanleh apei thei sih ua, alawl uoh zong ham theina a um sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuabang a milim bawlmite khu a milim bawlte bang ahi ua, tuate muong pouma zong tuabang ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aw Israel Mangpa muong in. Ama khu Ama uh panpipa leh a phaw uh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aw Aaron innkuonte, Mangpa muongun, Ama muongte panpipa leh a phaw uh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nou Mangpa zaute aw, Mangpa muongun, Ama khu ama muongte panpipa leh a phaw uh, ahi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa’n eite ang thei ngitnget a, ahing guolzawl ding hi. Israel innkuon a guolzawl ding a, Aaron innkuon zong a guolzawl ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Aman Mangpa zaudan siemte alien aneu a guol zawl ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 11.18; 19.5"},"14":{"text":"Mangpa’n noute a hing pungsah deu deu ding a, noute leh na tate utoh."},"15":{"text":"Lei leh van siempa Mangpa’n noute hing guolzawl hen."},"16":{"text":"Van, vante nangawn Mangpa a ahi a, Aman leitung khu mihingtate kungah apie hi."},"17":{"text":"Mishiten Mangpa aphat sih ua, mun sip a peisuhte mawngmawngin aphat thei sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh eiten tu a kipat kumtawn dongin, Mangpa iphat ta ding uhi. Mangpa phat un."}}},"116":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa ka it hi, aziehpen Aman ka ngetna leh ka aw aza hi.","title":"Tatsate Mangpa tunga kipahna"},"2":{"text":"Kei lang a bil ahingdaw ziehin, ka damsung teng in Ama ka han ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Shina khauhuolten ahing viel a, Sheol natnaten ahing man a, Lungkhamna leh danaten ahing tuom hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuatahin Mangpa min ka han a, “Aw Mangpa ka hinna hundam in” chi in ka hing ngen hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa khu mi hepisiem leh dihtat ahi a, Ahi, i Pasian khu lainatna dim ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n mi mawlte ahumbit zel a, suhngiem in ka um a, Aman ahing hundam hi."},"7":{"text":"Aw ka hinna, na khawlna ah kinua le kia ta in, aziehpen Mangpa’n na tungah hoitah in abawlta hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa nangman ka hinna khu shina lah ah, Ka mitte khu hitui lah ah, tualeh ka kengte puana lah a kipat in na humbit ta hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihing gam a Mangpa masangah ka vah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka gingta a tuaziehin thu ka genta hi, “Nasatah a suhgenthei in ka um hi.”","ref":"2 Kor. 4.13"},"11":{"text":"Ka kinaw hehu zieh in, “Mi zousie zuouthei ahi uh,” ka chita hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka tung a silhoi tampi abawl zousiete ziehin Mangpa kungah bang ahiei ka pieh thuh thei ding?"},"13":{"text":"Hundamna nou ka la dinga, Mangpa min ka lou ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa kunga ka thuchiemte, Amite zousie masangah ka tangtun ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A misiengthoute shina khu Mangpa mitmu in amanpha mama hi."},"16":{"text":"Aw Mangpa adihtahin kei na suohpa ka hi a, Na suoh ka hi a, Na suohnu tapa ka hi. Nangman ka henkol bu na hing sutpiehta hi."},"17":{"text":"Kipahthugenna sillat na mai ah ka hing lan dinga, Mangpa min ka lou ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa kunga ka thuchiemte amite zousie masangah ka tangtun ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Mangpa inn huongsung leituol ah, Aw Jerusalem, na kholaitah ah ka tangtun ding hi. Mangpa phat un."}}},"117":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nou nam zousiete aw, Mangpa phat un, Nou michinte aw, Ama pahtawi un!","title":"Mi zousie’n Mangpa phat ding","ref":"Rom. 15.11"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen itung uah akhotuona athupi hi; tualeh Mangpa thutah khu kumtawn in a um ding hi. Mangpa phat un."}}},"118":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa kungah kipahthu gen un, aziehpen Ama ahoi hi, A khotuona kumtawn in a umden ding hi.","title":"A hundamna zieh a Pasian phatna","ref":"1 Khang. 16.34; 2 Khang. 5.13; 7.3; Ezr. 3.11; Late. 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 136.1; Jer. 33.11"},"2":{"text":"Tuin Israelten, “Khotuona kumtawn in a umden ding,” chi uhen."},"3":{"text":"Aaron innkuonten, “A khotuona kumtawn in a umden ding,” chi uhen."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa zaudan siem zousie in, “A khotuona kumtawn in a umden ding hi,” chi uhen."},"5":{"text":"Ka mangbat lai in Mangpa ka han a, Mangpa’n ahing dawnga, mun awngthawl ah ahing koita hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa kei lam a pang ahi a, ka zau sih ding hi; Mihingin bang ahing law thei diei?","ref":"Heb. 13.6"},"7":{"text":"Mangpa khu keilam a pang, a hing panpipa ahi a, tuaziehin ahing mudate tung a ka deite ka mu ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihing tahsan sangin, Mangpa muon ahoizaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Lengtapate tahsan sangin, Mangpa muon ahoizaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Nam chin in ahing imkuol ua, hinanleh Mangpa min in amauh ka sumang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amauten ahing imkuol ua, ning chinteng ah ahing imsuoh ua; Mangpa min in amauh ka sumang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Khuoi bangin ahing tuom suoh ua, linglah meikuong bangin suhmit in a um pai ua, Mangpa min in amauh ka sumang ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka pua na dingin nasatah in ahing sawn ua, hinanleh Mangpa’n ahing panpita hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa khu ka hatna leh ka la ahi a, ka hundamna zong ahing hita hi.","ref":"Pawt. 15.2; Isai. 12.2"},"15":{"text":"Nuomna leh hundamna aw khu midihtatte puon inn ah a um a, “Mangpa khut zietlam in hangsantah in abawl zel hi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa khut zietlam tawisangin a uma, Mangpa khut zietlam in hangsantah in guolzawna abawl zel hi.”"},"17":{"text":"Ka shi sih dinga, ka hing ding hi, Mangpa silbawlte ka phuongzah zaw ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa’n nasatahin ahing thunun a, hinanleh shina kungah ahing pedoh hiel sam sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Dihtatna kulkotkhate hing honpieh un, khunah ka lut dinga, Mangpa ka phat ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tami Mangpa kotpi ahi a, midihtatte alut ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Nangma ka hing phat ding hi, aziehpen Nangman na hing dawngta a, ka hundamna na hing hita hi."},"22":{"text":"Innlam mite suong deilou khu, aninga suong poimaw pen ahing hita hi.","ref":"Luk. 20.17; Nasep. 4.11; 1 Pet. 2.7  ;     \n        Mat. 21.42; Mak. 12.10,11"},"23":{"text":"Tami Mangpa bawl ahi a, i mitmu ah alamdang mama hi."},"24":{"text":"Tami Mangpa ni siem ahi a, tam sungah nuom in ikipah ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka hing ngen hi tuin hing hundam in, Aw Mangpa ka hing ngen hi, tuin vangphatna hing sawl in.","ref":"Mat. 21.9; Mak. 11.9; Jn. 12.13"},"26":{"text":"Mangpa min a hing pei khu ahampha hi, Mangpa inn a kipat in nang ka hing guolzawlta uhi.","ref":"Mat. 21.9; 23.39; Mak. 11.9; Luk. 13.35; 19.38; Jn. 12.13"},"27":{"text":"Mangpa khu Pasian ahi a, Aman khovah ahing peta hi, kithoina ding khu khauhuolin, maitam kiite ah khi un."},"28":{"text":"Nang ka Pasian na hi a, Ka hing phat ding hi, Nang ka Pasian na hi a, ka hing pahtawi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Mangpa kungah kipahthu gen un. Aziehpen ama ahoi a, A khotuona kumtawn in a umden ding hi."}}},"119":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lampi a kisuthanghuoi lou a, Mangpa danzuite ahampha uhi, agamtatna genbangloute ahampha uhi.","title":"Pasian hoina phatna ALEPH."},"2":{"text":"Athutheisah zuite leh lungtang zousie a Ama suite ahampha uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amaun thulimlouna mawngmawng abawl sih ua, Alampite azui zaw uhi."},"4":{"text":"Nangman phatuom ngaitah a Na thuzawna thute Keem dingin koute thu Na hing pie hi."},"5":{"text":"Aw na thuguotte zui dingin ka umdante suhkip in um thei leh aw!"},"6":{"text":"Tuahun chiengin ka zala sih dinga, Na thupiehte zousie khawh ka sah hun chiengin."},"7":{"text":"Lungtang dihtah puoin ka hing phat ding, Na vaihawmna dihte ka zil hun chieng in."},"8":{"text":"Na thuguotte ka zui ding hi, Aw hing nuasie den sin."},"9":{"text":"Khangdawng in bangchin ahiei a umdan asuhsiengthou thei ding? Na thu dungzui a umdan kem hoiin.","title":"BETH"},"10":{"text":"Ka lungtang zousie toh Nangma ka hing sui hi, Na thupiehte a kipat hing pielmang sah vawt sin aw."},"11":{"text":"Na tunga ka khellouna dingin, Na thu ka lungtang ah ka kemta hi,"},"12":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, Nang na hampha hi, Na danthuguotte hing zilsah in."},"13":{"text":"Na kam a pawt vaihawmnate zousie, ka kam in ka phuongdohta hi."},"14":{"text":"Na thu theisahna lam ah nuom kasa a, hausatna zousie a nuom ka sah bang hiel in."},"15":{"text":"Na thuzawna thute ka ngaituo ngitnget dinga, Na lampite ka ngaisah belap nalai ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na thuguotte ah ka kipah dinga Na thu ka manghil sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka hin theina dingin leh Na thu ka zui theina dingin, Na suoh tungah hoitah in bawlin.","title":"GIMEL"},"18":{"text":"Na danthute apat sillamdangte ka mu theina dingin, ka mitte hing suhvah pieh in."},"19":{"text":"Leitungah khuolzin taambang ka hibou hi, Na thupiehte kei akipat phuol sin."},"20":{"text":"Bangchihlaipoua, Na vaihawmnate ka ngainat ziehin ka hinna akehgawpta hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi kiliensah hamse thuohte khu na phawhhil a, Na thupiehte pielmangsan te khu."},"22":{"text":"Gensiatna leh simmawnate kei apat lamangin, Na thutheisahte ka zui zingna hi."},"23":{"text":"Lengtapate zong a tou ua a hing gensie uh, Hinanleh na suohin na danthute ka ngaituo zaw hi."},"24":{"text":"Na thutheisahte zong ka kipahna ahi a, tuate khu kei hing thuhilte ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ka hinna khu leivui ah abeh chinten hi, Na thu bang zel in hing suhal in.","title":"DALETH"},"26":{"text":"Ka umdante ka phuongdohta a Nangman na hing dawng ta a, Na thugousiete hing hil in."},"27":{"text":"Na thuzawna lampi umdan hing theisiemsah in, tuachi’n na sillamdang bawl thute ka ngaituo ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Lungkhamna ziehin ka hinna a zunmang zel hi, Na thu bang zelin hing suhat in."},"29":{"text":"Umdan zuouhuoi kei akipat lamang inlen; hepitahin na dan hing pie in."},"30":{"text":"Thutah lampi ka telta a, Na vaihawmnate ka masangah ka pha hi."},"31":{"text":"Na thutheisahte ah kabeh chinten hi, Aw Mangpa hing zalasah sin."},"32":{"text":"Na thupieh lam ah ka tai ding hi, aziehpen ka lungtang nang suhlet pieh ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Aw Mangpa Na thuguotte zuidan hing zilsah in, tuahileh atawp tanin ka zui thei ding hi.","title":"HE"},"34":{"text":"Theisiemna hing pie in, tuachi’n na dan ka kem hoi dinga, Ahi, ka lungtang zousie in ka zui ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Na thupieh lampi ah hing peisah in, khunah kipahna ka nei hi."},"36":{"text":"Na thutheisah lam ah ka lungtang kiheisah inlen, huoihamna lam ah hilou in."},"37":{"text":"Sil bangmalou enlou dingin ka mitte kiheisah inlen, Na lampi ah hing suhal in."},"38":{"text":"Na thu khu na suohpa kungah sukip inlen, Nangma giinna a hing kipelutpa kungah."},"39":{"text":"Ka giinpen gensietna khu lamang in, Na vaihawmnate lah ahoi ngal a."},"40":{"text":"Envawi, Na thuzawna thute khu ka lunggul a Na dihtatna in hing suhhal in."},"41":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na khotuonate zong ka kungah hing tung hen, na thubang zel in Na hundamna ngei khu.","title":"WAW"},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken ahing gensete dawnna ding ka nei ding hi, Na thu lah ka muong ngal a."},"43":{"text":"Thutah ka kam apat lamang sieng sin, Na vaihawmnate ka kineppi ahi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n na dan thu kumtawn kumtawn in ka zui ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Tualeh zalentahin ka vah dinga, Na thuzawnathute ka sui zieh in."},"46":{"text":"Na thutheisahte leengte mai ah ka gen dinga, ka zum sih ding hi."},"47":{"text":"Na thupiehte ah ka kipah ding hi, tuate ken ka it hi."},"48":{"text":"Na thu peihte lam ah ka khut zong ka zah tou ding hi; tuakhu ka ngainat ahi. Tualeh na thugousiete ka ngaituo ding hi."},"49":{"text":"Na suoh kunga na thuchiem thei ngitnget in, tua thu ah kei na hing kinem sah hi.","title":"ZAYIN"},"50":{"text":"Ka gimthuoh chiengin tami ka lung muonna a hi; Na thuin hinna ahing pie hi."},"51":{"text":"Mikiliensahten kisathei tahin hing khelhou nan uleh, ken na danthu ka pielsan sih hi."},"52":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, nidang lai a Na vaihawmnate ka theizing a ka kihamuon zel hi."},"53":{"text":"Na dan taisan migiloute ziehin lungthahna nasatahin, ahing buohkhum zel hi."},"54":{"text":"Ka khuolzinna inn ah Na danthupiehte ka la ahi ngitnget hi."},"55":{"text":"Aw Mangpa zankhang laiin zong na min ka theizing a, na dan zong ka zui ngitnget hi."},"56":{"text":"Na thuhilna thute kavom zing zieh in, tami ka neita hi."},"57":{"text":"Aw Mangpa Nang ka tanvou na hi a, Na thu ka zui ding kana chita hi.","title":"HETH"},"58":{"text":"Ka lungtang zousie in na deisahna ka hing ngen hi, na thubang zelin hing khotuo in."},"59":{"text":"Ka umdante ka ngaituo a. Na thutheisahna lam a kihei in ka kal kasuonta hi."},"60":{"text":"Na thupiehte zui dingin ka kinaw mama a, ka kiheh sih hi."},"61":{"text":"Migilou khauhuol in a hing kaan lawmta a, Hinanleh Na dan ka manghil tuom sih hi."},"62":{"text":"Na vaihawmna dihtah ziehin, zankhang laiin kipahthu gen dingin ka thou ding hi."},"63":{"text":"Nangma hing giingte zousie leh na thuhilna zuite pouma ka lawmte ahi uhi."},"64":{"text":"Aw Mangpa leitung pumpi Na khotuonain adim hi; Na danthupiehte hing hil in."},"65":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na thu dungzui in na suoh Na bawlhoi zel hi.","title":"TETH"},"66":{"text":"Vaihawmna siemna leh theina hing hilin, Na thupiehte ka gingta hi."},"67":{"text":"Suhgenthei a ka um masangin, Kana vahmang kha zel a, tui’n vang na thu ka zuita hi."},"68":{"text":"Nang pen na hoi a, silhoi na bawl zel hi; Na thuguotte hing hil in."},"69":{"text":"Mi kisatheiten ka tungah zuou aphuo ua, hinanleh kenvang ka lungtang zousie in, na thuhilnate ka vom hoi ding hi."},"70":{"text":"Alungtang uh sungthau bangin athau a, hinanleh kei pen na danthu ah kakipah hi."},"71":{"text":"Na danthute ka zil theina dinga, suhgenthei a kana um khu kei dingin ahoi ahi."},"72":{"text":"Na kama dan pawt khu, kei a dingin sana leh dangka tul tampi sangin ahoizaw hi."},"73":{"text":"Na khutin na hing siemta a, ka lim leh mel na hing nabawl hi. Na thupiehte ka zil theina dingin theisiemna hing pie in.","title":"YOD"},"74":{"text":"Nangma hing giingten kei ahing mu chiengun akipah ding uhi, Na thu ka kineppi zieh in."},"75":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na vaihawmnate khu adih a, tualeh nangman ginumnain na hing sugenthei hi chi ka thei hi."},"76":{"text":"Na suoh kunga na thuchiem dungzui in, na khotuona tulngailou khu ka lungmuonna ding hi hen, chiin ka hing ngen hi."},"77":{"text":"Ka hin theina dingin, Na khotuona khu, ka kungah hing tung hen, Na dan lah ka kipahna ahi ngal a."},"78":{"text":"Mi kisatheite zalatsah in um uhen, aziehpen amaun azieh beiin dihloutahin kei ahing bawlsie uhi, hinanleh kenvang na thuhilna thute ka ngaituo zaw ding hi."},"79":{"text":"Nangma hing giingte leh, Na thutheisahna theite’n kei lam hing nga uhen."},"80":{"text":"Ka zalatlouna dingin, na danthute ah ka lungtang gensietna beiin um hen."},"81":{"text":"Na hundamna ngai in ka hinna aba mama a, hinanleh Na thu ka kineppi ngitnget hi.","title":"KAPH"},"82":{"text":"Na thu suinain ka mitte avai gawpta a, “Bangchih chienga kei hing hamuon ding na hiei?” ka chi ka chi hi."},"83":{"text":"Meikhu tunga kihang gaw savun zuthawl bang ka hita hi, hinanleh na thuguotte ka manghil sih hi."},"84":{"text":"Na suoh damsung ni ding bangtan hi ding ahiei? Kei hing sugentheite tungah bangchih chienga, thukhenna bawl ding na hiei?"},"85":{"text":"Mi kiliensahten ka kiehna dingin, Na dan banglouin kokhuh atou uhi."},"86":{"text":"Na thupieh poumate a muonhuoi hi; amaun dihloupi in ahing sugenthei uhi, hing panpi in."},"87":{"text":"Amaun leitunga kipat ahing sumang dihdihta uhi, hinanleh ken vang na thuhilnate ka taisan sih hi."},"88":{"text":"Na itna tulngailou dungzui in hing suhal in, tuachi’n Na kam a thutheisahna ka zui ding hi."},"89":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na thu kumtawn a dingin, van ah suhdet ahita hi.","title":"LAMEDH"},"90":{"text":"Na ginumna akhang akhangin a um ding hi, leitung na sukip a, a umdenta hi."},"91":{"text":"Tuate khu tunitan in, Na thupieh dungzui in aum gige uhi; aziehpen tuate na suohte ahi uhi."},"92":{"text":"Na dan khu ka kipahna hilou hileh, ka gimthuohna ah ka mangthaita ding hi."},"93":{"text":"Na thuhilnate ka manghil ngai sih ding hi, tuate zieh in hinna na hing petathuoi a."},"94":{"text":"Nanga ka hi, hing hundam in, Aziehpen na thuhilnate ka suikheta hi."},"95":{"text":"Migilouten kei hing suhmang tum in ahing ngah uhi, hinanleh kenvang na thutheisahnate ka ngaituo zaw ding hi."},"96":{"text":"Hoibukimna zousie tawpna ka muta a; hinanleh na thupieh khu alien mama hi."},"97":{"text":"Oh! na dan it hina va-ia ing e, tami sun nitum a ka ngaituo ngitnget khu ahi.","title":"MEM"},"98":{"text":"Nangman na thupiehte ziehin ahing doute sanga pilzawin na hing bawl a; kumtawn a ka kunga aum ngitnget zieh in."},"99":{"text":"Ang hiltute zousie sangin theisiemna ka neizaw hi, Na thutheisahte ka ngaituo ahi zel zieh in."},"100":{"text":"Na thuhilnate ka vomhoi ziehin tehsete sangin theisiemna ka neizaw hi."},"101":{"text":"Na thu ka zui theina dingin, lampi gilou a ka kengte akalsuon mawngmawng ka phal ngai sih hi."},"102":{"text":"Nangman na hing zilsah zieh in, Na vaihawmna akipat ka pielmang sih hi."},"103":{"text":"Na thute kei a ding in hum hina va-ia e, ahi, ka kam a dingin khuoizu sangin ahum zaw hi."},"104":{"text":"Na thuhilna thute apat in theisiemnate ka nei a, tuaziehin umdan dihlou pouma ka huo hi."},"105":{"text":"Na thu khu ka kenga dingin meivah ahi a, ka lampi a dingin vah ahi.","title":"NUN"},"106":{"text":"Na vaihawmna dihtatte zui dingin ka kichiemta a, ka sudetta hi."},"107":{"text":"Nasatah a suhgenthei in ka um hi, Aw Mangpa, na thu bangzel in hing suhal in."},"108":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka kam kiphalna silpiehte hing pompieh dingin ka hing ngen hi; tualeh Na vaihawmnate hing hil in."},"109":{"text":"Ka hinna ka khut ah a um ngitnget a, hinanleh na dan ka manghil sih hi."},"110":{"text":"Migilouten ka awhna dingin thang akam ua, hinanleh na thuhilnathute ka pielsan ngaisih hi."},"111":{"text":"Na thutheisahte kumtawn a ka gouluo ding bangin ka lata a, ka lungtang sunuompen ahi zieh in."},"112":{"text":"Na danthupiehte atawp donga semkhe ngitnget dingin, ka lungtang ka kiheisahta hi."},"113":{"text":"Lungsim thuop ni neite ka huo a, hinanleh na danthu ka it hi.","title":"SAMEKH"},"114":{"text":"Nangma ka kibuhna mun leh ka phaw na hi a, Na thu ka kinepna ahi."},"115":{"text":"Nou silgilou bawlte, hing peisan un, Ka Pasian thupiehte zui ding ka hitaah ziehin."},"116":{"text":"Ka hin theina dingin Na thu bangzelin hing tuzing inlen, ka kinepna ah muolphouin hing umsah sin."},"117":{"text":"Hing tudet in tuachi’n ka bit ding hi, tualeh na thuguotte ka zui ngitnget ta ding hi."},"118":{"text":"Na thuguotte akipat a pielkhete zousie na deisih a, asolbawlna ulah zuouthu ahibou hi."},"119":{"text":"Leitunga migilou zousie sia-eeh bangin na sumang zel a, tuazieh in Na thutheisahte ka it hi."},"120":{"text":"Nangma zau in ka tahsa akithing a, Na vaihawmnate zong ka zau hi."},"121":{"text":"Thudih in vai ka hawma, dihtattahin ka bawl zel hi, a hing nuoisiete khut ah hing nuasie sin.","title":"AYIN"},"122":{"text":"Na suoh tungtang thu ah ahoina dingin, theipipa in pang inlen, mi kiliensahte’n hing nuoisie sih uheh."},"123":{"text":"Na hundamna etna in ka mit avai gawpta a, Na dihtatna thu etna zieh in."},"124":{"text":"Na khotuona dungzuiin na suoh tungah bawl inlen, Na thuguotte hing hil in."},"125":{"text":"Na suohpa ka hi a, na thutheisahte ka theisiemna dingin, theisiemna hing pie in."},"126":{"text":"Mangpa nang dingin nasep ahunta hi; Na dan bangmalouin abawlta ngal ua."},"127":{"text":"Adihtah in sana leh sana siengset sangin, na thupiehte ka it zaw hi."},"128":{"text":"Tuaziehin sil zousie thu a na thuhilnathu pouma, adihin ka thei a, umdan dihlou pouma ka huo hi,"},"129":{"text":"Na theipina te alamdanga, Tuaziehin ka hinna in a vom hoi zel hi.","title":"PE"},"130":{"text":"Na thu hilchienna in vahna apie a, mi mawlte kungah theisiemna apie hi."},"131":{"text":"Ka kam ka kaah a ka hai hut hut hi, Na thupiehte ka lunggul zieh in."},"132":{"text":"Kei lam hing nga inlen, hing hepi in, Na min itte tunga na bawl zel bangin."},"133":{"text":"Na thu bang zel in hing kalsuon sah inlen, gitlouna mawngmawng in ka tungah thu neisah sin."},"134":{"text":"Mihing suhgentheina a kipat hing tandoh in, tuachi’n na thuhilnate ka zui thei ding hi."},"135":{"text":"Na suoh tungah na mel vah sah inlen, na danthute hing hil in."},"136":{"text":"Mite’n na dan a zuilou zieh un, ka mit a pat in hituite luitui bangin aluong hi."},"137":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nang na dihtat a, tualeh na vaihawmnate zong adih hi.","title":"TSADDE"},"138":{"text":"Nangman napieh na thutheisahte khu, adihtat a aginum mama hi."},"139":{"text":"Ka phatuomngaina in ahing sugamta hi, ahing douten na thu amanghiltah zieh un."},"140":{"text":"Na thu khu asiengthou mama a, tua ziehin Na suohin ka it hi."},"141":{"text":"Mi neu leh simmawhuoi ka hi a, hinanleh na thuhilnate ka manghil sih hi."},"142":{"text":"Na dihtatna khu kumtawn dihtatna ahi a, Na dan zong thutah ahi."},"143":{"text":"Buoina leh mangbatna in ahing buohkhum ta a, hinanleh na thupiehte ka kipahna ahi."},"144":{"text":"Na thutheisahna khu kumtawn dihtatna ahi a, theisiemna hing pie in, tuachi’n ka hing ding hi."},"145":{"text":"Ka lungtang zousie in ka hing han hi, Mangpa aw hing dawngin, Na danthute ka kemhoi ding hi.","title":"QOPH"},"146":{"text":"Nangma ka hing han hi, hing hundam in, tuachi’n na thutheipinate ka zui ding hi."},"147":{"text":"Zingmawng phalvah masangin ka thou a, panpina ngen in ka kikou a, Na thu ka kineppi hi."},"148":{"text":"Na thu ka ngaituo theina dingin, zanven sung pumpi ka mitte ahah hi."},"149":{"text":"Na itna hepina bang zel in, ka aw ngaikhie inlen, na vaihawmnadih bangzel in hing suhal-in."},"150":{"text":"Gitlouna delte’n ahing nai deu deu uh hi, amaute na dan apat agamla uhi."},"151":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangma na nai a, Na thupiehte zousie thudih ahi."},"152":{"text":"Na thutheisahte tungtang ahileh, kumtawn a dinga suhdet ahita chi, nidanglai peh akipat in kana theita hi."},"153":{"text":"Ka gentheina ngaituo inlen, hing hunkhie in, aziehpen na dan ka manghil ngai sih hi.","title":"RESH"},"154":{"text":"Ka tungtang thu hing gen pieh inlen, hing tandoh inlen, Na thu bang zelin hing suhal in."},"155":{"text":"Migiloute apat hundamna agamla hi, aziehpen na danthu asui sih uhi."},"156":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na khotuo na khu athupi a, na vaihawmna dungzuiin hing suhal zel in."},"157":{"text":"A hing sugentheite leh a hing doute tampi ahi ua, hinanleh na thutheisahte ka pielmangsan ngai sih hi."},"158":{"text":"Lepchietah a bawlte ka en a, ka lungkim sih hi. Na thu azuilou zieh un."},"159":{"text":"Na thuhilna thute ka it dan ngaituo inlen, Aw Mangpa na itna hepina dungzuiin hing suhal zel in."},"160":{"text":"Na thu kigawmkhawmte khu abawn in thutah ngen ahi a, na vaihawmna dihtahte zousie kumtawn in a umden ding hi."},"161":{"text":"Lengtapaten azieh beiin ahing sugenthei uh a, hinanleh ka lungtang khu na thute zau in a um hi.","title":"SCHIN"},"162":{"text":"Gallah sum mupa kipah bangin na thu ah ka kipah hi."},"163":{"text":"Zuouthu ka huo a, ka kidah hi, hinanleh na dan ka it hi."},"164":{"text":"Na vaihawmna dihtahte zieh in, ni khat in sagi vei ka hing phat hi."},"165":{"text":"Na dan itten hamuonna thupitah anei ua, bangmain akipalpua sah sih ding hi."},"166":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na hundamna ki nem in, Na thupiehte bangin ka bawl zel hi."},"167":{"text":"Ka hinna in na thutheipinate azui zel a; tuate ka ngaina mama hi."},"168":{"text":"Na thuhilnate leh na thutheipinate ka zui zel hi, aziehpen ka umdan zousie na masang ah a um hi."},"169":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka kikouna thawm na masangah hing tung henlen, Na thu bang zelin theisiemna hing pie in.","title":"TAU"},"170":{"text":"Hepi ka ngetna na masangah hing tung henlen, Na thu bang zel in hing hunkhie in."},"171":{"text":"Ka kam in phatna thu agen ding a, Na danthute nang zilsah zel zieh in."},"172":{"text":"Ka leiin na thu lain sa hen, Na thupieh zousie dihtatna ahi ziehin."},"173":{"text":"Na khut in kei hing panpi heh, Na thuhilnate ka teltah zieh in."},"174":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na hundamna ka lunggul mama hi; Na dan khu ka kipahna ahi hi."},"175":{"text":"Ka hinna khu hing hen, tuachi’n, Nang ahing phat ding hi."},"176":{"text":"Belam mang bangin kana vahmangta a, Na suoh hing sui in, aziehpen Na thupiehte ka manghil ngai sih hi."}}},"120":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka mangbatna ah Mangpa ka han a, Aman ahing dawng hi.","title":"Suotatna dinga thungetna La tung"},"2":{"text":"“Aw Mangpa kam zuouthei leh solhat lei apat in,” ka hinna hunkhie in."},"3":{"text":"Oh! nang lei solhat, nang kungah bang a hing pie un, bang ahing law ding uh ahiei?"},"4":{"text":"Mihat thaltang hiemte leh Junipar sing mei-am toh."},"5":{"text":"Meshek gam ah khuolzin tambang ka hi a, Kedar puon inn lah ah ka um a ka tung agih hi."},"6":{"text":"Lemna huo a deiloute lah ah kana teng sawt seng khata hi!"},"7":{"text":"Ken lemna ka dei a, hinanleh kei ka hamkhah chiengin amaute kidou a ut zel uhi."}}},"121":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tangte langah ka mit ka dahtou sah ding hi, Heilanga kipan in ahiei keima panpina hing tun ding?","title":"Ama suite panpipa Pasian ahi David la tung"},"2":{"text":"Kei hing ki panpina pen, Mangpa lei leh van siempa akipat hing tung ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Aman na kengte akitaal aphal sih dinga, nang hing chingpa a lusu sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngaivawi Israel chingpa khu alusu sih dinga, aimu sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa khu nang hing chingpa ahi a, Mangpa khu na ziet lam a nang hing liepa ahi."},"6":{"text":"Sunlai chiengin nisa in ahing kasih dinga, zanlai chiengin zong hapi in ahing khawkha sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa’n sil hoilou chinteng akipat ahing veng dinga, na hinna ahing kep pieh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa’n na pawt leh na lut aveng ding hi tu a kipat kumtawn dongin."}}},"122":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mangpa inn ah haw vai” chia ka kunga agen chiengun ka kipah hi.","title":"Jerusalem dinga kinepna nuom um David La tung"},"2":{"text":"Aw Jerusalem na kulkotpi sungah ka kengte uh ading hi."},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem khopi khu, dettah a gawmkhawm khopi khat bang a kilam ahi."},"4":{"text":"Khunah namte, Mangpa namte, Israelte kunga thutheisah bangin, Mangpa kunga kipahthu gen dingin apeitou uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen khunah vaihawmna dingin Mangtouphate akidaw a, David innkuonte Mangtouphate khu ahi."},"6":{"text":"“Jerusalem hamuonna dingin thunget pieh un, nang hing itte alawching ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na kulbang sungah lungmuonna um henlen, na leeng innpi sungah lawchinna um hen.”"},"8":{"text":"Ka sanggamte leh ka lawmte ziehin, “Na sungah hamuonna um hen;” tuin ka chi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa i Pasian uh inn zieh in, na hoina ding ka sui ding hi."}}},"123":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Nang vante a tengpa, Nang ma lam ka hing entou hi.","title":"Pasian khotuona kinepna la David La Tung"},"2":{"text":"Ngai vawi, suohten apute uh khut lam a et bang uleh, suohnu mit in api khut lam a et zingbangun, koute mit in zong Mangpa ka Pasian uh lam a en ngitnget hi, Na hing khotuo masang sie in."},"3":{"text":"Koute hing khotuo inlen, Aw Mangpa koute hing khotuo in, aziehpen nasatah a simmawna in ka dimta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka hinna uh mi nuomsate simmawna leh, mi kiliensahte musitnain adim siengta hi."}}},"124":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ei lam a pang Mangpa hilou hileh, tuin Israelten chi uhen.","title":"Pasian amite lam-a apan dan David la tung."},"2":{"text":"Miten ahing dou lai un, ei lam a pang Mangpa hilou hileh,"},"3":{"text":"Khum hun laiin eite ahing hingvalta ding uh, itung ua athangpai lai un."},"4":{"text":"Khum hun lai ma in, tuiten ahing tummangta ding a, tui hattah in ihinna uh a tummangta ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuahun lai main tuipi hattah in ihinna uh atummangta ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Sa sielneh ding banga akam sung ua hing pelut loupa Mangpa phat in um hen."},"7":{"text":"Thang kamte thang apat vate asuohtat bangin ihinna uh asuohtata hi, Thangte aseta a, eite isuohtata uhi."},"8":{"text":"Eite hing panpi pa khu, Mangpa lei leh van siempa a hi."}}},"125":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa muongte khu, Zion tang suhling guollou kumtawn a um ngitnget bang ahi ding uhi.","title":"Mangpa hing venna La tung."},"2":{"text":"Tangte Jerusalem kimvel a aum bangin, Mangpa khu a mite kimvel ah, tua kipat kumtawn in aum ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen gitlouna leengchieng khu, midihtat gam tat tungah akinga sih dinga, khuchilouin vang midihtatten akhut un gitlouna azam kha ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aw Mangpa mi hoite tungah silhoi bawl inlen, lungtanga dihtatte tungah zong."},"5":{"text":"Alampi kawite lam a pielte ahileh pen, Mangpa’n silbawlkhielte toh apuimang ding a; Israel tungah lungmuonna um hen."}}},"126":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n saltangte Zion a ahing nuo puikia laiin, mang mantute bang ihi uhi.","title":"Zion a lungnuom a kinuale na Latung."},"2":{"text":"Tua hunlai in ikam uh nuina in adim a, ilei u’zong lungnop lasahna in adim hi. Tua hunlai in namchinte lah ah Mangpa’n ama ua dingin, “Sil thupitahte abawl pieh ahi,” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi, Mangpa’n eite a dingin sil thupite ahing bawlpieh a, tuaziehin i kipah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aw Mangpa sal a ka tan uh hing puikia inlen, Simlam luite bangin."},"5":{"text":"Hitui luong kawm a haichi tuten, lungnuom tahin a at ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Kap kawm a buchi puo a kuonkhe ten, lungnopna bu phaite puoin nuomsatahin ahing kinuahle ngeingei ding uhi."}}},"127":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n inn alam sihleh, alam miten asemgim thawn giap uhi; Mangpa’n khopi aven sihleh aveng mite ahah thawn giap uhi.","title":"Tate khu Pasian goutan ahi Solomon la: Latung."},"2":{"text":"Zingmawng matah a thou a, vaigei tah a tou a, sepgimna tanghou na neh uh nou a dingin athawn giap ahi, tuabangin Aman a itte khu a imusah zel hi."},"3":{"text":"Ngaivawi tate khu Mangpa apata igoutan uh ahi a, tualeh gil a ga zong akipahman ahing pieh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hatlai tate khu mihat khut a, thaltangte bang ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Athal bawm dim a thaltang nei mite ahampha uhi, kulpi kotkha a agalte toh akihou lai un zong azala sih ding uhi."}}},"128":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa giing poumaten nuom asa uhi, alampi zuiten.","title":"Pasian giingte innsunga vangphatna La tung."},"2":{"text":"Na khut sepgim ga na ne ding a, kipah tahin na um dinga, navah tahin zong na um ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Na zi zong na innsung a grepgui ganuom mama bang ahi dinga, na tate zong na dawkang kimvel a Olive selte bang ahi ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ngaivawi Mangpa giing mi khu tuabanga guolzawl in a um ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa’n Zion a kipat in ahing guolzawl ding a, tualeh na damsung tengin Jerusalem hoina na mu ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi, na tute na mu ding a, Israel tungah hamuonna um hen."}}},"129":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka naupan lai a kipat mi’n tamveipi ahing sugimta uh,” Israelte’n tuin chi uhen.","title":"Suhgenthei a umte panpina ngetna La tung."},"2":{"text":"“Ka naupan lai a kipat in mi’n tamveipi ahing suhgentheita uhi; hinanleh ahing zou tuom sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Lou kai miten ka eljang ah lou akai ua, aloukaina kuohte uh asausah thei mama uhi.”"},"4":{"text":"Mangpa adihtat a, Aman migiloute khauhuol asattanta hi."},"5":{"text":"Zion mudate pouma zalatsah in um uhenlen, taizahsah in um uhen."},"6":{"text":"Amaute khu inntung a hampa pou akhanlet masanga vuoi zel bangin um uhen."},"7":{"text":"Tuate in bu at mi in akhut asudim ngai sih a, buphai khawm mi in zong a angsung asudim ngai sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa guolzawlna na tung uah umta hen, “Mangpa min in ka hing guolzawl uhi chiin, akung ua va peiten zong achi ngai sam sih uhi.”"}}},"130":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa tuithuhtah apat in ka hing han hi.","title":"Ka hinna in Mangpa tatna a ngahna La tung."},"2":{"text":"Mangpa ka aw za inlen, ka ngetna za dingin na bil hing daw in."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa nang khelnate na chiemte leh, koi ahiei ding zou ding?"},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh na kungah ngaidamna a um hi, giin a na um theina dingin."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa ka ngah ngitnget a, ka hinna in angah hi, tualeh athu zong ka kineppi hi."},"6":{"text":"Galveng miten zingmawng angahla sang un, ka hinna in Mangpa angahla zaw hi. Ka chi ahi, veng miten zingmawng khovah a ngahla sang un."},"7":{"text":"Aw Israel Mangpa ah kinem in, aziehpen Mangpa kungah khotuona aum hi, tualeh Ama kungah tatna kichingtah a um hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Aman Israel akhelna zousie apat atan khe ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 1.21; Tit. 2.14"}}},"131":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka lungtang akisathei sih a, ka mitte zong asangha sih hi; sil thupite leh kei a dinga sillamdang taluote ah zong ka kikumthaw sih hi.","title":"Mangpa muonna David la Tung."},"2":{"text":"Naupang nawineh tawpta anu kunga um bangin, ka hinna khu ka sungah naupang nawineh tawpta bangin asip dide in aum hi."},"3":{"text":"Aw Israel Mangpa ah kinem un, tua kipat kumtawn dongin."}}},"132":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa David leh, athuohgimna zousie thei ngitnget in;","title":"David Pasian muonna La tung."},"2":{"text":"Mangpa kunga akichiemtah dan leh, Jakob Pasian hattah kunga akihahsiel dante."},"3":{"text":"“Ka umna inn pindan sung ah ka lut vawt sih dinga, ka lupna tungah zong ka kaltou sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka mitte ka imu sah sih dinga, ka mitvunte zong ka imutsuoh sah sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa ading mun khat ka mudoh masangsie, Jakob Pasian hattah tenna ding munkhat,” achi khu thei zingin."},"6":{"text":"En un, Ephrathah ah tami ka za ua, gammang sing lah ah ka muta uhi.","ref":"2 Khang. 6.41,42"},"7":{"text":"“Abiehbuhte ah i haw ding ua, Akeng ngahna bul ah Ama i be ding uhi.”"},"8":{"text":"Aw Mangpa thou inlen, na khawlna mun ah pei in, Nang leh na hatna bawm toh."},"9":{"text":"Na siemputen dihtatna puonbangin sil u’henlen; na misiengthoute nuom in kikou uhen."},"10":{"text":"Na suoh David ziehin, na sathau nupa mai kiheimang sah nawn sin."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa khu David kungah thutahin akichiem ta a, akiheimangsan sih ding hi. “Na tate lah akhat na leengtoupha ah ka tousah ding hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.12-16; 1 Khang. 17.11-14; Late. 89.3,4; Nasep. 2.30"},"12":{"text":"Na tapaten ka thuhun azui ua, ka thutheipina akung ua ka hil dingte azui uleh, atapate uh zong na leengtoupha ah kumtawn in ka tousah ding hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n Zion atelta hi, Aman atenna mun dingin adei hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tami kumtawn a ka khawlna mun ding ahi a, ka deitelna mun ahi a, tanah ka tengden ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Nehletah kiningching tahin ka guolzawl dinga, a migentheite tanghou in ka taisah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Asiempute khu hundamna in ka thuom ding a, amisiengthoute nuomsa in ngaitahin akikou ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Zion ah David a dingin kii khat ka poudoh sah ding a, ka sathau nupa a dingin thaumei khat ka tungdoh ding hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 11.36"},"18":{"text":"A melmate khu muolphounain ka thuom dinga, hinanleh ama lutungah leenglukhu ataang singseng ding” hi, achi hi."}}},"133":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngai un, Unaute kituoh diil diel a umkhawm anah hoiin, nuom hina va-ia e.","title":"Unau kituoh a umkhawm anop dan David la tung."},"2":{"text":"Lu tunga thau manpha kinu, khamul a luong khie, Aaron khamul ngei a luongkhie, apuonah tuol monga luongkhie bang ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hermon daitui chiim, Zion taangte a ke zel bang ahi, Tuanah Mangpa’n guolzawlna thu apie a, kumtawnna hinna ding ngei."}}},"134":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngai un nou zan a Mangpa inn a ding zel, Mangpa suoh zousiete aw, Mangpa phat un.","title":"Zan chienga Mangpa phatna la tung"},"2":{"text":"Na khutte uh munsiengthou lam ah zahtou unlen, Mangpa phat un."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa lei leh van siempa ngeiin, Zion a kipat in noute hing guolzawlta hen."}}},"135":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa phat un, Mangpa min phat un, Aw nou Mangpa suohte, Mangpa phat un.","title":"Pasian leh milimte tekahna"},"2":{"text":"Nou Mangpa inn a dinga, i Pasian inn huongsunga dingte aw;"},"3":{"text":"Mangpa phat un, Mangpa lah ahoi ngal a. Amin phatna la sa un, tua lah anuom ngal a."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n Jakob khu ama adingin atelta a, tualeh Israel ama goutan tuom dingin atel hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa thupitah ahi chi leh, i Mangpa khu pasien te zousie sanga tungnung zaw ahi, chi ka thei hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n lei leh van ah, tualeh tuipi leh athuhna munte zousie ah a ut ut abawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Aman kawlmong akipat meilumte akaitou sah a, kawlphete guo dingin a siem a, akoikhawmna inn apat huipite alangsah zel hi."},"8":{"text":"Aman Izipt gam a tamasa athat a, mihing leh ganta pum in."},"9":{"text":"Aw Izipt gam, Aman na sungah chiemtenate leh sillam dangte ahing sawl a, Pharaoh leh asuohte zousie tungah zong asawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Aman nam tampite asatlum a leeng thupi leh hat tahtahte athat hi."},"11":{"text":"Amormite leengpa Sihon leh, Bashan leengpa Og leh, Kanaan leenggamte zousie athat hi."},"12":{"text":"Agam uh gouluo dingin apie a, Ami Israelte goutan dingin."},"13":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na min kumtawn in a umden ding a, Aw Mangpa Nangma theizingna khang zousie dongin aum ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n amite tungah thu akhen dinga, a suohte tungah lainatna anei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Namte milimte lah dangka leh sana a kibawl, mihingte khutsuoh ahibou uhi.","ref":"Late. 115.4-8; Kihil. 9.20"},"16":{"text":"Tuaten kam anei ua, aham thei sih ua, mitte a nei ua, amu thei sih uhi;"},"17":{"text":"bil anei ua, aza thei tuom sih ua, akam uah nahna aum sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuabang milim bawlte khu tuo milimte bangin aum ding ua, tuate gingta poumate zong."},"19":{"text":"Aw Israel innkuonte Mangpa phat un. Aw Aaron inn kuonte Mangpa phat un."},"20":{"text":"Aw Levi innkuonpite Mangpa phat un, Nou Mangpa giing poumate aw, Mangpa khu phat un!"},"21":{"text":"Mangpa Jerusalem a tengpa ngei, Zion a kipat in phat in um hen. Mangpa khu phat un!"}}},"136":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa kungah kipahthu gen un, Ama lah ahoi ngal a, akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a.","title":"Aitna zieh a Pasian phatna","ref":"1 Khang. 16.34; 2 Khang. 5.13; 7.3; Ezr. 3.11; Late. 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; Jer. 33.11"},"2":{"text":"Aw pasien te Pasian kungah kipahthu gen un, A khotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"3":{"text":"Aw mangpate Mangpa kungah kipahthu gen un, A khotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"4":{"text":"Ama tanga sillamdang thupitah bawl zelpa kungah, A khotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"5":{"text":"Theisiemna pilna zieh a vante siempa kungah, A khotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a.","ref":"Siem. 1.1"},"6":{"text":"Tuite tunga leitung kiphasahpa kung ah, Akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a.","ref":"Siem. 1.2"},"7":{"text":"Vah thupitahte siempa kungah, Akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a.","ref":"Siem. 1.16"},"8":{"text":"Sun hun a vaihawm dinga nisa bawlpa kungah A khotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"9":{"text":"Zan hun a vaihawm dinga hapi leh aasite bawlpa kungah, A khotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"10":{"text":"Izipt gamsunga tamasate thatpa kungah, A khotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a.","ref":"Pawt. 12.29"},"11":{"text":"Izipt mite lah akipat a Israelte puidohpa kungah, A khotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a.","ref":"Pawt. 12.51"},"12":{"text":"Khut thahat leh ban zah a amauh puidohpa kungah, Akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"13":{"text":"Tuipi san kikhentansahpa kungah, A khotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a.","ref":"Pawt. 14.21-29"},"14":{"text":"Tuipi san laikim a Israelte galkaisah pa kungah, Akhotuona kumtawn aumden ding ahi ngal a."},"15":{"text":"Pharaoh leh akalkapte tuipi san a tummang sahpa kungah, Akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"16":{"text":"Gamdai gamgaw a amite puipa kungah, Akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"17":{"text":"Leng thupi thahatte thatgampa kungah, Akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"18":{"text":"Leng minthang tahtahte thatpa kungah, A khotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"19":{"text":"Amor mite leengpa Sihon thatpa kungah, Akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a.","ref":"Kisim. 21.21-30"},"20":{"text":"Bashan leengpa Og thatpa kungah, Akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a.","ref":"Kisim. 21.31-35"},"21":{"text":"Agam uh goutan dinga pepa kungah, A khotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"22":{"text":"Asuoh Israel kunga goutan pepa kungah, Akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"23":{"text":"I nam din mun uh a ngiem laitah a hing thei zingpa kungah, Akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"24":{"text":"Igalte u lah apat a hing tandohpa kungah, Akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"25":{"text":"Tahsa zousie neh leh tah pepa kungah, Akhotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."},"26":{"text":"Aw van Pasian kungah kipahthu gen un, A khotuona kumtawn a umden ding ahi ngal a."}}},"137":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon luigeite ah, khunah itou ua, ikapta uhi, Zion ingaituo chieng un.","title":"Saltanna hitui"},"2":{"text":"Khuna lui lai a huisum bazamte ah i kaigingte uh ikhai uhi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen khulaitah a sal a hing puiten la sa dingin ahing phuut ua, ahing sugentheiten thanuom tah in, “Zion late khat hing sahpieh un chi in ahing phut uhi.”"},"4":{"text":"Mi gam ah Mangpa la bangchin isa thei mawh diei?"},"5":{"text":"Aw Jerusalem nang ka hing manghil leh, ka khut zietlam in akhutsiemna manghil hen."},"6":{"text":"Nang kang thei ngitnget sih a ahileh, ka lei ka dangtawngah behden henlen, Kanopsahna pen sanga sangzaw a, Jerusalem ka hing dei zaw sih leh."},"7":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, Jerusalem pua ni a Edom mite’n suchim un, suchim un, “Asuongphumte nangawn suchim un” achi zieh un. Amauh aselam in thei ngitnget in."},"8":{"text":"Aw suhmanga um ding Babilon tanu, ka tung ua na bawlbanga hing thuh dingpa khu kipah in a um ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 18.6"},"9":{"text":"Na tangehte hing lahpieh a, suongpi satna a nei dingpa khu kipahtah in a um ding hi."}}},"138":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka lungtang zousie in Nangma ka hing phat dinga; pasien te masangah nangma phatna la kasa ding hi.","title":"Thumna dawnna zieh a phatna la David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Na biehinn siengthou lam nga in ka hing be dinga; Na itna tulngailou leh na thutahna ziehin, Na min ka phat ding hi; aziehpen Na thu khu na min zousie tungah Na tawisangta hi."},"3":{"text":"Kang hat niin Nang na hing dawng a, ka hinna na hing suhhat pieh hi."},"4":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, leitung pumpi leengte zousie in Na kam a thu pawt azah hun chiengun ahing pahtawi ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi, Mangpa umdan thute phat in la asa ding uhi, Aziehpen Mangpa vangletna athupi sengseng hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa khu sangtah a um hinapiin mi ngiemte angaisaha, hinanleh mi kiliensahte pen gamlapi akipat in athei hi."},"7":{"text":"Lungkham gentheina lah ah vahkawi nanleng zong, Nangman nahing suhal ding hi, ka melmate lungthahna tungah, Na khut na zah ding a, na zietlam khutin nahing hundam ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa’n ka tungtanga abawl ding khu abawl bukim dinga. Aw Mangpa, na khotuona khu kumtawn in a umden ding hi. Na khut nasepte taisan vawt sin."}}},"139":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangman chientahin nahing sui a, nahing theita hi.","title":"Aw Pasian hing suiin, hing hundoh in Lapulien ading. David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Nang ka tousuh leh ka dintou lai na thei a, ka ngaituote gamlapi akipat in na theithei hi."},"3":{"text":"Nang ka pei leh ka lup na en chien zel a, ka umdan zousie na theisuoh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngai in, Aw Mangpa, nangma theilou ka lei ah thu mawngmawng a um sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangman ka nualam leh ka mailam ah nang imsuoh a, ka tungah na khut na nga nalai hi."},"6":{"text":"Tambang va-ia a theina, kei dingin alamdang seng taluo hi, asang senga ka phazou sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Na hagau kunga kipat hei ah ka pei thei diei? ahisihleh na masanga pat hei ah ka taimang thei diei?"},"8":{"text":"Van ah kaltou ding chileng lah khunah Nang na um a, Sheol ah lupna bawl vang chileeng lah khunah Na um zel hi."},"9":{"text":"Zing ha zah in tuipi tawp peh ah va um nanleng zong,"},"10":{"text":"Khunah zong na khut in nahing pui dinga, Na khut zietlam in na hing tu ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Pellou in mielin ahing khu khum dinga, zan zong ka kim ah vah ahi ding chinanleng zong;”"},"12":{"text":"Miel in zong nanga kipat bangma alie sih a, zan zong sun bangin avah hi; Nang dingin miel leh vah akibang ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen ka lungsim sunggillam na bawlta a, ka nu gilsungah nahing phankhawm hi."},"14":{"text":"Nangma ka hing phat ding hi, aziehpen zauhuoitah leh lamdang tah a siem ka hi; Na nasepte alamdang seng hi, tua khu ka hinna in athei chien mama hi."},"15":{"text":"Aguuh a siem a ka um lai leh, leimun nuoinung pen a kilawmtah a bawl a ka umlai in, ka gu ka taangte nanga kipat phuol ahi sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka lim kibawlkim nailou khu na mit in amu a, ka tahsa ka hiengte na laibu sungah akigiel siengta hi. Khat beh zong aum nailou laiin nite kei a dinga bawl in aum hi."},"17":{"text":"Aw Pasian na ngaituonate kei a dingin manpha hina va-ia e, akigawmkhawmna khu thupi hina e."},"18":{"text":"Sim ding hita leng senel sangin atam zaw ding hi, ka khatlaw chiengin na kunga um kana hinalai hi."},"19":{"text":"Aw Pasian migiloute na that ngei dinga, tuachi’n sisan suohat miten ahing peisan ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amaun giloutah in nang ahing gensie ua, Na melmaten na min bangmalouin agen zel uhi."},"21":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, Nang hing mudate ka muda sih amah? Tualeh Nang hing doute ka haw sih amah?"},"22":{"text":"Amaute huot chitahin ka huo a, ka melmate in ka ngai hi."},"23":{"text":"Aw Pasian hing enchien inlen, ka lungtang thei in, hing enkhie inlen, ka ngaituonate thei in;"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh keima ah umdan gilou a um eimah, en inlen, kumtawn lampi ah hing pui in."}}},"140":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa silgilou bawlmite lah apat hing hunkhie inlen; ngongtatte lah akipat in hing humbit in.","title":"Humbitna ding ngetna Lapulien a ding: David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Amaun alungtang uah sil gilou angaituo uhi, nisim in galdou dingin akikhawm ngitnget uhi."},"3":{"text":"Alei uh gul lei bangin ahiemsah ua, amuh uah thangtom gu a um hi. Selah.","ref":"Rom. 3.13"},"4":{"text":"Aw Mangpa migiloute khut apat in hing veng hoi inlen, hing suhpua sawm migumtatte lah akipat in hing humbit in."},"5":{"text":"Mikiliensahten ka awhna ding thang leh khauhuol aguhin aphuol ua, lampi gei ah a lenthang apha ua, ka awhna ding thang akam uhi. Selah."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa kungah nang ka Pasian na hi ka chi a, Aw Mangpa hepina ka ngetna awte hing na ngaikhie in."},"7":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka Pasian ka hundamna suhatpa, kidou ni chiengin ka lutang na liekhuta hi."},"8":{"text":"Aw Mangpa migiloute deilam pe sinlen, asiltup guhte u’zong lawching sah sin, tuachilouin akipahtawi kha ding uhi. Selah."},"9":{"text":"Kei hing imkuolte lu khu amauh kam a, athugilou gente un khukhum heh."},"10":{"text":"Mei-am sa in amauh buohkhum henlen, meikhua lai ah pai in um uhenlen, athawkia nawnlouna ding un kokhuh thuh tah ah khieh in um uhen."},"11":{"text":"Thu gilou genmi khu leitung ah tundingin umsih hen, migumtat khu suse dingin silhoilouin delpha hen."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa’n suhgenthei a umte tungtang thu apanpi ding a. Migentheite adingin dihtaha vaihawmna abawlpieh ding hi chi ka thei hi."},"13":{"text":"Pellou in midihtatten na min aphat ding ua, mithudihte na masang ah a um ding uhi."}}},"141":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa nangma ka hing han hi, kintah in hing del pai inlen, ka hing hat chiengin ka aw za dingin na bil hing daw in.","title":"Ka kam ah vengtu koiin David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Ka thungetna na masangah gimnamtui bangin zamtou henlen, tualeh ka banzahtoute zong, nitahlam kithoina bangin sangin.","ref":"Kihil. 5.8"},"3":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, ka kam bul ah veng mi tousah inlen, ka muh kotkhah vengin."},"4":{"text":"Silgilou bawlte toh gitlouna bawlkhawm dingin, ka lungtang silhoilou lam mawngmawng ah kiheisah sinlen, a neh tuitahte uh zong hing nesah sin."},"5":{"text":"Midihtatin hing vuo heh, tuakhu hepina ahi ding a, tualeh hing phawhhil heh, tuakhu lu a sathau manpha kinu bang ahi dinga, ka luin deilou sih heh. Aziehpen ka thungetna khu migilou silbawlte douna ahi nalai ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Avaihawm mite uh kawlsuongpi gei a paikhieh a aum chiengun, ka thute angaikheta ding uh, ahum ngal a."},"7":{"text":"Mi’n leitang akal a, akhetnen bangun ka gute uh hankhuh gei ah thezah in aum hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa Pasian, ka mit in nangma lam a en a, Nangma ah kibutna ka sui a, ka hinna khu chimawin nuasie sin."},"9":{"text":"Ka awhna ding a thang akam lah uah, tualeh silgilou bawlte thangkam lah ah hing vengbit in."},"10":{"text":"Kei ka suohtat lai in, migiloute amauh lenthang ah awh uhen."}}},"142":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka aw in Mangpa ka han a; ka aw in Mangpa kungah, hepina ka ngen zel hi.","title":"Hasatna apat huhdohna David Maskil, suongkohawm a aumlai a thungetna."},"2":{"text":"Amasangah ka lungkimlounate ka sungbuo a, ka buoinate Ama kungah ka phuong hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka hagau ka sunga achimaw chiengin, Nangman ka lampi na thei hi. Ka peina lampi ah amaun aguh in thang akam uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka zietlam ka en a, tualeh ka dah a, koima kei hing thei mawngmawng aum sih hi, kihumbitna ding a um sih a, koiman ka hinna ahing donpieh sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nang ka hing han a; Nang ka kibutna na hi a, mihing gam a ka tanvou na hi, ka chi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka kikou ngaikhie in, aziehpen nasatah a suhngiem in ka umta hi, ahing sugentheite akipat in hing hunkhie in, kei sangin ahatzaw uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na min ka phat theina dingin, ka hinna suongkul apat lahdoh in, midihtatten kei ahing imkuol ding uhi, Nangman ka tunga kiningching tah a na hing bawl ding ziehin."}}},"143":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka thungetna ngaikhie inlen, hepi ka ngetnate ah Na bil hing daw in, Na ginumna leh na dihtatna ziehin hing dawngin.","title":"Pasian deilam lunggulna David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Na suohpa tungah thukhenna bawlkhum sin, aziehpen na masangah mihing koima siemtang a um sih ding hi.","ref":"Rom. 3.20; Gal. 2.16"},"3":{"text":"Melmain ka hinna asugenthei a, ka hinna lei lahah asatpua a, sawtpi a shisate bangin mun miel ah ahing umsah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka sunga ka hagau achimaw gawpta a, ka sunga ka lungtang zong amangbang hi."},"5":{"text":"Nidanglai nite ka thei ngitnget a, Na nasep zousie ka ngaisut a, na khut silbawlte ka geldoh zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma kung lamah ka khutte ka zah zel a, gamgaw bangin ka hinna nangma ngai in adangta hi. Selah."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa aw hing dawng meng in ka hagau agim gawpta hi, Kei apat in na mai phuol sin, tuachilou in kokhuh a peisuhte bangin ka um kha ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Zingmawng chiengin na itna hepina hing zasah in, Nangma ka hing muong hi, Ka peina ding lampi hing theisah in, Aziehpen ka hinna in nanglam ang entou hi."},"9":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka galte lah a kipat hing hundoh in, Nangma hing bel ka hibou hi."},"10":{"text":"Na deilam bawl dingdan hing zilsah in, Nang ka Pasian na hi thuoi a. Na hagau ahoi hi, dihna gam ah hing puilut in."},"11":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na min ziehin hing suhal inlen; Na dihtatna ziehin buoina akipat in ka hinna puidoh in."},"12":{"text":"Na khotuona ziehin ka galte sattan sieng inlen, ka hinna sugentheite zousie sumang in, na suoh ka hi thuoi a."}}},"144":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa ka suongpi phat in um hen, Aman ka khutte galdou dan azilsah a, ka khutmete galkap dan ahil hi.","title":"Pasian muonna la David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Ama ka itna tulngailou leh ka kulpi, ka kibuhna innsang leh hing hunkhepa, ka phaw leh ka muonna kingahna, mite ka nuoi ah a koi zel hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa mihing bang ahia ahiei, tambanga na theikhah zel? Ahisihleh mihing tapa zong koi ahi a, na hichi ngaituo ahiei?","ref":"Job. 7.17,18; Late. 8.4"},"4":{"text":"Mihing pen nah hu bang bep ahi ua, adamsung nite u’zong himliep mangzel bang bep ahi bou hi."},"5":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na vante luoikun inlen, hing kumsuh in, tangte tham in tuachi’n akhu ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tunphesah inlen amauh delzah in, Na thaltangte kapdoh inlen, amaute sumangin."},"7":{"text":"Tunglam a kipat in na khut in hing sawhsuh inlen, tui lienpi a pat leh gamdang mite khut apat in hing hundoh in."},"8":{"text":"Akam un zuou thu agen ua, azietlam khut u’zong zuoutatna khut ahi."},"9":{"text":"Aw Pasian, Nangma pahtawi in la tha kasa ding a, pehging gui sawm neiin nangma phat in la kasa ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Leengte kunga hundamna pie a, Asuohpa David shi theina namsau, a kipat a hunkhepa khu Ama ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hing hundoh inlen, gamdang mite khut apat hing humbit in, Akam un thuginalou pou agen ua, akhut zietlam u’zong khut zietlam zuoutat ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ka tapate uh khangdawng ahilai un, singnou khanghoinou bang ahing hi theina ding uleh, ka tanute uzong leeng innpi huong sunga aninga, suong kikhuoh khuompite bang ahi theina ding un."},"13":{"text":"Ka bu innte uzong silpieng chintengin dim henlen, ka belamte u’zong atul atul leh, atulsawm atulsawm in ka kholai uah piengta hen."},"14":{"text":"Ka bawngtalte un zong van gih tahtah apuoh ua, alut leh apawt ua sietna um lou na ding in, ka kholai gawlzingte ua zong, lungdon kanate a um louna ding in."},"15":{"text":"Tambanga um mite pen kipahtahin aum zel uhi, Ahi, Mangpa a Pasian ua nei mite khu kipahtah in a um zel uhi."}}},"145":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A Leengpa ka Pasian nang ka hing tawisang dinga, Na min kumtawn kumtawn in ka phat ding hi.","title":"It siem Pasian phatna David phatna la."},"2":{"text":"Ni chinin Namin ka phat dinga, kumtawn kumtawn in na min ka phat ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa athupi a, thupitah a pahtawi ding ahi, athupina koima suiguol ahisih hi."},"4":{"text":"Khang khat in khangkhat dang kungah na silbawlte aphat sawn zel ding a, na nasep thupitahte agen sawn ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Nangma pahtawina kilawmdan thupitah leh, Na sillamdang bawl thute ka ngaisut ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Miten na silbawl chizathuoi tahte hatdan aphuongzah ding ua, tualeh ken zong na thupina ka phuongzah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaun na hoina thupidan atheizingte uh agen ding ua, Na dihtatna phat in la asa ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa khu mi hepisiem, lainatna a dim lungnem tah leh khotuona"},"9":{"text":"Mangpa khu silbangkim tungah ahoi a, asilsiem zousie tunga lainatna hau ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na silsiemsate zousie in, Na kungah kipahthu ahing gen ding ua, Na misiengthouten Nang ahing pahtawi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Na leenggam thupidan agen ding ua, Na silbawltheidan thute houlimna’n a nei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Mihing tate zousie kungah Na silbawl thupitahte leh, Na leenggam kilawmna thupi dan atheisah ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Na leenggam khu kumtawn leenggam ahi a, Na thuneina zong akhang khangin a umden ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa’n apua zousiete atudet a, akunsuh khiukheu a umte zousie akaidingzel hi."},"15":{"text":"Mizousie mit in kinemtahin Nang ahing en ua, Nangman ahun, tah in neh ding amauh na pe zel hi."},"16":{"text":"Na khut na zah a, tuachi’n silhing chintengte dei na pia a, na taisah zel hi."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa khu agamtatna zousie ah a dihtat a, Anasepna zousie ah mi hepina ahau hi."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa Ama hante pouma leh, thutah a Ama hante zousie anai zel hi."},"19":{"text":"Mangpa’n Ama zaudan siemte pouma deilam atangtungsah dinga, akikou uh aza dinga, a hundam ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa’n Ama itte zousie avengbit a, hinanleh migiloute asumang ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka kam in Mangpa phatna thu agen dinga, tahsa hinna nei zousie’n, Amin Siengthou kumtawn kumtawn in aphat ding uhi."}}},"146":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa phat un, Aw ka hinna Mangpa phat in.","title":"Miliente muonlou ding"},"2":{"text":"Ka damsung tengin Mangpa ka phat dinga, ka damlai sie’n Pasian phat in la kasa ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Miliente muong sinlen, panpitheina mawngmawng neilou ashithei mihing pou muong sih un."},"4":{"text":"A nahna hu in apawtsan a, lei asuoh kiata hi, tuachi’n khum ni mama in angaituonate abeimang pai hi."},"5":{"text":"Jakob Pasian panpi tu-a nei miin nuom asa hi, akinepna khu Mangpa a Pasian ah aum hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama lei leh van leh, tuipi leh asunga um zousie siempa ahi a, Ama’n thutah akem ngitnget hi.","ref":"Nasep. 4.24; 14.15"},"7":{"text":"Aman suhgenthei a umte avaihawm pieh a, gilkielte kungah ann neh ding a pe zel hi. Mangpa’n suongkul taangte ahadoha, azalen sah zel hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa’n mittote mit avahsah a, Mangpa’n akunsuhte aphongtou a, Mangpa’n midihtatte a it hi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa’n mikhuolte avengbit a, Aman tagate leh meithaite apanpi a, hinanleh migiloute lampi alumle pieh hi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa’n kumtawn in vai ahawm dinga, Aw Zion, na Pasian in akhang akhangin Vai ahawm ding hi. Mangpa phat un."}}},"147":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa phat un, I Pasian phata lasah ahoi mama a, tuakhu anuom a, tualeh Ama phat akilawm mawng ahi.","title":"Israelte akhop kia zieha Pasian phatna"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n Jerusalem atungding kia a, Aman sal a puimanga um Israelte apuikhawm kia hi."},"3":{"text":"Aman lungtang hasete adamsah a, aliemnate uh atuom pieh hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman aasite tamdan asim a, amin uh aphuo pieh chiet hi."},"5":{"text":"I Mangpa uh athupi a, silbawltheina kiningchingtah nei ahi, atheisiemnain tawp anei sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n kingaingiemte adomsang a, migiloute pen tuolsenan anei hi."},"7":{"text":"Kipahthu gen kawm in Mangpa phat in la sa unlen, kaiging toh i Pasian uh phat in la sa un."},"8":{"text":"Aman meipi in van akhusah a, leitungah guo azu sah a, taangte tungah hampa apousah hi."},"9":{"text":"Aman gantate kungah ann neh ding apie a, va ah noute aham chiengin ann apie hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama pen sakol hatna ah akipah sih a, mihing keng ah zong kipahna mawngmawng anei sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa khu Ama giingte tungah akipah a, A khotuona kineppite tungah akipah hi."},"12":{"text":"Aw Jerusalem Mangpa pahtawi in, Aw Zion na Pasian phat in."},"13":{"text":"Aman na kulkotkhah kilna zawlte akipsah a, na sunga na tate a guolzawl zel hi."},"14":{"text":"Aman na gamgite sungah lemna asiem a, bu hoipen in ahing dimsah hi."},"15":{"text":"A thupiehte leitung ah asawldoh a, athu gangtah in atai hi."},"16":{"text":"Vua khu belam mul bangin a pie a, Vua kie ku vut bangin athezah hi."},"17":{"text":"Aman gielte khu tanghou themnen bangin apaidoh a, avotna masangah koi ahiei ding thei ding?"},"18":{"text":"A thu asawldoh a, tuate azun sah hi, Ahuite alaang sah a, tuachi’n tuite a hing luong zel hi."},"19":{"text":"Aman Jakob kungah athu aphuong doh a, adanthute leh avaihawmnate Israelte kungah akilang sah hi."},"20":{"text":"Aman koima nam tungah tambangin abawl ngai sih a, tualeh avaihawmna thute zong athei ngai vawt sih uhi. Mangpa phat un."}}},"148":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa phat un, vante akipat Mangpa phat unlen, munsangte ah Ama phat un.","title":"Silsiem chintengin Mangpa aphat"},"2":{"text":"Avansawltahte zousie in ama phat unlen, Agalkapte zousie in ama phat un."},"3":{"text":"Ni leh ha in ama phat unlen, Aasi taangte zousie in ama phat un."},"4":{"text":"Vante van in ama phat unlen, vante tung a um tuiten ama phat un."},"5":{"text":"Amauten Mangpa min phat uhen, aziehpen ama’n thu apie a, siem in ahing umta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aman tuate khu kumtawn kumtawn a dingin asukip a beithei nawnlou ding in thu abawl khumta hi."},"7":{"text":"Nou tuipi ganhing liente leh tuithuhpite aw, leitunga kipat in Mangpa phat un."},"8":{"text":"Mei leh gielte, vua leh meilumte leh, athu zui khopihuiten,"},"9":{"text":"Muol leh taangte zousie leh, ganei singte leh sidar sing zousieten,"},"10":{"text":"Gamsate leh ganta zousiete, ganhing bohvahte leh tungleeng vate in,"},"11":{"text":"leitung leengte leh michintengin, leengtapate leh leitung vaihawmtein;"},"12":{"text":"tangval leh nungahte’n, Putehte leh naupangten, a kibangin Mangpa phat un."},"13":{"text":"Amauten Mangpa min phat uhen, aziehpen Mangpa minbou tawisangin a um a, athupinain lei leh van akhup hi."},"14":{"text":"Aman amite kii zong atawisanga, Amisiengthoute zousie phatna khu; Ami Israel tate akung nai mite phatna khu. Mangpa phat un."}}},"149":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa pahtawi unlen, Mangpa phat in la tha sa unlen, misiengthoute kikhopna ah Aphatna la sa un.","title":"Zion taten Pasian phat hen"},"2":{"text":"Israelte khu amauh siempa tungah kipah uhenlen; Zion tate khu aleengpa uh tungah kipah uhen."},"3":{"text":"Amin khu laamkawm in phat u’henlen, khuongta leh kaiging kilawm toh ama phat in la ngai sa uhen."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen amite tungah Mangpa alungdam a, Aman mi kingaingiemte guolzawna toh kilawmtah in azem hi."},"5":{"text":"Misiengthoute khu thupina ah nuom uhenlen, alupna tung uah nuom in la sa uhen."},"6":{"text":"Pasian phatna sangtah akam uah um henlen, akhut uah namsau langni a tathiem um nalai hen."},"7":{"text":"Namte tunga phuba lahna leh, michin tunga gawtna tungsah ding leh,"},"8":{"text":"aleengte uh siakhainieng a akihenna dingin, tualeh ami thupite uh kolbunsah dingin;"},"9":{"text":"Thukhenna kigielsa atung ua tungsah dingin: Tami thupina khu Amisiengthoute zousie a ding ahi. Mangpa phat un."}}},"150":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa phat un, Amunsiengthou ah Pasian phat unlen, A silbawltheina huikhuo ah Ama phat un.","title":"Pasian phat un"},"2":{"text":"Asilbawl thupitahte zieh in Ama phat unlen; Athupina nasatdan dungzuiin Ama phat un."},"3":{"text":"Pengkul gingtoh Ama phat unlen, kaiging leh pehgingin Ama phat un."},"4":{"text":"Khuongta leh laam in Ama phat unlen, Tumging guinei leh theile toh Ama phat un."},"5":{"text":"Dahkhutbeh ging toh Ama phat unlen, dahkhutbeh ging zia zua toh Ama phat un."},"6":{"text":"Nah hu nei chintengin Mangpa phat chiet uhen! Mangpa phat un."}}}}},"20":{"info":{"name":"Thupilte","shortname":"Thu.","abbr":[],"desc":"Thupilte"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel leengpa David tapa Solomon thupilte:","title":"Tate kunga thuhilna leh hasotna","ref":"1 Leeng. 4.32"},"2":{"text":"Pilna leh kithuhilna theina ding, theisiemna thugil thute theikah ding;"},"3":{"text":"pilna, thudihna, vaihawmna, leh khentuom neilou a thuhilna pomdan siemnate,"},"4":{"text":"Mi mawlte kunga pilna tualeh khanglaite, kunga theina leh lunggelsiemna, thuhilna dingin,"},"5":{"text":"Mipilten zong tam thu azah ua, atheina uh akibelap na ding leh theisiemna nei mi in, thuhilna piltah anei theina ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Thupilte leh ahilchiennate, mipilte thu leh athugil gente uh akhiehna theisiemna ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa giin khu theina kipatna ahi a, hinanleh mi moten pilna leh thuhilna asimmaw uhi.","ref":"Job. 28.28; Late. 111.10; Thu. 9.10"},"8":{"text":"Ka tapa na pa thuhilna ngaikhie inlen, na nu thuhilna kiheisan sin."},"9":{"text":"Na lutanga dingin pahkhi kilawmtah ahi dinga, na ngawng a dingin khigui hoitah ahi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka tapa mikhielten ahing zawl chieng un, zop sin.","title":"Lawm hoilou toh kigop louding"},"11":{"text":"“Amaun hing zuiin, sisan suo dingin mi buh vaiin, azieh beiin mawnaneiloute buhdap vai;"},"12":{"text":"Sheol bangin ahingtangun pumval vai in, kokhuh a kesuhte bangin inawmval ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Van manpha namkim ilahpieh dinga, gallah vante inn dim in ikoi ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Koute lah ah hing tel inlen, isumbawmte uh ikitaang ding uhi,” achi chiengun."},"15":{"text":"Ka tapa alah uah va tel sinlen, alampite ua pat kihemkhie in."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen akengte un sietna lam anaw del a, sisan suo dingin akinaw uhi."},"17":{"text":"Vate muna a lenthang zah khu amawhna ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh tuabang miten amauh sisan ma abuh ua, ahinna uh buhdap ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Punna dihlou a huoiham poumate lampi khu tuabang ahi a, aneitute hinna alah pieh zel hi."},"20":{"text":"Kholai ah pilna akikoua, gawlzing tengah ngaitah in akikou hi.","title":"Pilna suiin","ref":"Thu. 8.1-3"},"21":{"text":"Mitamna mun pente ah akikou a, khopi kulpi kotkhate ah thu agen hi."},"22":{"text":"“Nou mi mawlte aw bangtanvei mawl ut nalai na hi uoi? Mi nuoisieten bangtanvei ami nuoisie bawlna kipah ding ahi uoi? Tualeh mi moten pilna bangtanvei ho nalai ding ahi uoi?"},"23":{"text":"Ka phawhhilna langah hing kihei un, na tung uah ka hagau ka sungbaw dinga, na kung uah ka thute ka hing theisah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen ka hing hat laiin, na hing nuol ua, ka khut ka zah a, koiman na ngaisah sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ka hing thuhilna zousie na nelsie siengta ua, ka hing phawhhilnate khatbeh na zui nuomlou zieh un;"},"26":{"text":"Ken zong na tuohsietni chieng un kang nuisan dinga, na zau a nachimaw chieng un kang engbawl nalai ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Na zauna un khopihui banga ahing nawh chiengin, tualeh tuohsietna in pingpei banga noute ahing phah chiengin, Lunggimna leh chimawna na tung ua ahing tun chieng in;"},"28":{"text":"Tuabang hun chiengin keima ahing han ding ua, hinanleh amauh ka dawng sih dinga, pawnthaw tahin kei ahing sui ding ua, hinanleh ang musih ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun pilna ana hota uh a, Mangpa giin khu atel sih uhi."},"30":{"text":"Ka thuhilna khatbeeh zong adei sih ua, ka phawhhilna a simmaw uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaziehin agamtatna ga uh ane ding ua, angaituonate mama uh amauh tungah akibung sieng ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Aziehpen mi mawlte kiheimangna in amauh athat dinga, mi mote lawchinna in amauh asumang ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh ka thu ngaikhe pouma bittah in a um ding ua, silhoilou zauna neilou in lungmuong tahin a um ding uhi.”"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa ka thute na san a, ka thupiehte na lungsunga na kholkhawm a,","title":"Pilna phattuomna"},"2":{"text":"pilna lam a nabil nadaw a, theisiemna lam a na lungtang na ngat leh,"},"3":{"text":"Ahi, theikah siemna theinuom a na kikou a, theisiemna aw ngaitah suo a na hat leh,"},"4":{"text":"Dangka banga na sui a, gou kiphum banga na sui chien a ahileh,"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa giindan na hing theisiem dinga, tualeh Pasian theina na mudoh ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n pilna apie a, akam a pat in theina leh theisiemna ahing pawt hi."},"7":{"text":"Aman midihtat a dingin pilna dihtah akholkhawm a, dihtat taha gamtate a dingin ama khu lum le-phaw ahi."},"8":{"text":"Aman dihtatna lampite avenga, tualeh Amisiengthoute lampi avengbit pieh zel hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n dihtatnate leh thudihnate, tualeh vaihawmna siemnate, deisahtuom neilounate na hing theisiem ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Pilna na lungtang sunga ahing lut chiengin, na hinna in theina nuom asah hun chiengin;"},"11":{"text":"Sie leh pha khensiemna in nang ahing kembit dinga, theisiemna in nang ahing kem ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Pilna in migiloute lampi akipat leh, thusie ngen gente akipat ahing hunkhe ding hi,"},"13":{"text":"Mielna lampi a pei dingin, dihtatna lampite anuasie uh
