a,"},"14":{"text":"Silgilou bawl khu akipahna uh ahi a, tualeh silgilou bawlte kipahpi mite,"},"15":{"text":"Alampite uh akawi a, gamtat uh kawi mite lah a kipat leh,"},"16":{"text":"Numei gamtat thanghuoi leh, kam zol zuou gensiemte lah akipat in, ahing hunkhe ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama nu’n asenlawm ngai anuasie a, a Pasian thuhunte amanghilta hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen a inn shina lam anga a, amanu lampi khu shina ahi."},"19":{"text":"Amanu kunga va hawkha pouma anua peikia nawn sih ua, hinna lampite amankha kia nawn sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mi hoite lampi a na pei a, midihtatte lampi na zui theina ding in."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen midihtatten gamsung aluo ding ua, mi hoibukimte’n gam aluo den ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh migiloute pen gamsung akipat suhmang ahi ding ua, tualeh mi ginumloute tua gam akipat akibotdoh ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa ka thuhilna manghil sinlen, ka thupiehte na lungtang in kem heh.","title":"Thumang dinga kihantawhna"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen tuaten na damsung ni leh kumte, asausah dinga lungmuonna kiningching, ahing pieh belap nalai ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Khotuona leh thutah hasuo sinlen, na ngawngah viel inlen, na lungtang suongpeh tungah giel in."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian leh mihing mitmu ah deisahna leh, ngaisangna na nga ding hi.","ref":"Luk. 2.52"},"5":{"text":"Na lungtang zousie in Mangpa muong inlen, nangma theina ah kinga sin."},"6":{"text":"Na lampi zousie ama theisah in, tuachi’n Aman na lampite atangsah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma theina toh kipilsah sinlen, Mangpa giing inlen, gilou taisan in.","ref":"Rom. 12.16"},"8":{"text":"Tami na tahsa pumpi a dingin damna ahi dinga, na gute adingin hatna ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Na nei nalam leh na louma a gamasate zousie in, Mangpa pahtawi in."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n na annbuhte khu bu in ahing dimlet dinga, na belpi liente zong uoin tha in adimlet ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka tapa Mangpa phawhhilna ngaidau sinlen, ahing suhdihnate zong chimtah sin.","ref":"Job. 5.17\n        ;     \n        Heb. 12.5,6"},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen pa in apahtat atapa athunun bangin, Mangpa’n a itte ahoina dingun aphawhhil zel hi.","ref":"Kihil. 3.19"},"13":{"text":"Pilna mu khu mi hampha ahi a, theisiemna mu mi khu mi nunnuom ahi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen dangka sum nei sangin aphatuom zaw a, tualeh apunna zong sana siengset sangin ahoizaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Pilna khu suongmanpha rubi sangin amanpha zaw a, tualeh na deithusam a na lunggulte toh zong, tekah thei guol ahi sih hi."},"16":{"text":"A khut ziet lam ah damsawtnate a um a, akhut veilam ah hausatna leh pahtawinate a um hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama lampite khu lungnopna lampi ahi a, tualeh alampite zousie hamuonna lampite ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama tuchintente a dingin hinna sing ahia, ama nei denten nuom asa uhi."},"19":{"text":"Mangpa’n pilna in leitung amukhie a, theisiemna in vante asudet hi."},"20":{"text":"Atheina in tuithuhtahte apohkeh sah a, meilumten vandaituite atakhe sah hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka tapa na mitte akipat in tamte peimang sah sinlen, pilnagil leh sie leh pha khensiemna kem ngitnget in."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n na hagau a dingin hinna ahi dinga, na ngawnga dingin kizepna kilawmtah ahi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n na lampi ah bittah in na pei dinga, na keng na sui sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Na lup chiengin na zausih dinga, na i mut atui ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Thakhat a patauna zau sinlen, migiloute tunga sietna ahing tun chiengin zong zausin."},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen na lungmuonna Mangpa ahi dinga, na keng awhlouna dingin aveng ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Na bawl thei ahi nahpou leh, a tang dinga kilawmte silhoi it sin."},"28":{"text":"Na nei nah pouleh, na innveng kungah “Pei phot inlen, zing chiengin hing hawkia in hing na pevang,” chi’n nuasawl kia sin."},"29":{"text":"Na innveng in nang hing muonga, na kunga teng ahiziehin asietna ding ngaituo sin."},"30":{"text":"Na sietna ding bangma abawl sih pouleh, azieh bei in mi toh kihau sin."},"31":{"text":"Thagum suo mi eng sinlen, agamtatnate uh khatbeh zong zuisin."},"32":{"text":"Aziehpen mi tatsete Mangpa’n akidah a, hinanleh midihtatte pen athuguh kem dingin zong amuong nalai hi."},"33":{"text":"Migiloute innsung ah Mangpa hamsietna a um a, hinanleh midihte innsung aguolzawl hi."},"34":{"text":"Misimmawhatte aman asimmaw ngei ngei dinga, mi kingaingiemte kungah hepina apie hi.","ref":"Jak. 4.6; 1 Pet. 5.5"},"35":{"text":"Mipilte’n thupina aluo ding ua, hinanleh zumna khu mi mote kaisanna ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tate aw, pa thuhilna ngai unlen, theisiemna thei dingin lungluttah in ngai un.","title":"Pilna athupipen ahi"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen ken thuhilna hoitah ka hing pie hi, ka dan taisan sih un."},"3":{"text":"Ka pa tapa ka hi a, ka nu mitmu a adeithaw ata neisun ka hi nalai in,"},"4":{"text":"Ka pa’n ahing hil a, ka kungah, “Na lungtangin ka thute kem inlen, ka thupiehte zui inlen, hing in, ahing chi hi."},"5":{"text":"Pilna nei inlen, theisiemna nei in, ka kam a thute manghil sinlen, ki heimangsan sin."},"6":{"text":"Pilna taisan sih pou lachin ahing kembit dinga, pilna it lachin aman ang veng ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Pilna athupi masa pen ahi a, tuaziehin pilna nei inlen, na nei zousie pum in theisiemna nei in."},"8":{"text":"Pilna pahtawi lachin aman nang ahing tawisang ding hi, na pom chinten pouleh aman zatatna ahing peding hi."},"9":{"text":"Na lutanga dingin hepina kizepna ahing khipsah dinga, thupina manglukhu ahing khusah ding hi.”"},"10":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, ka thugente ngai inlen zuiin, tuachi’n na damsung kumte a sawt ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ken nangma pilna lampi ka hing hil a, lampi dih ah ka hing pui hi."},"12":{"text":"Na pei chiengin na kalsuon ahasa sih dinga, na tai chiengin na kisuikha sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Thuhilna tukip chinten inlen, hasuo vawt sinlen, kem in, aziehpen na hinna ahi."},"14":{"text":"Migiloute lampi ah lut sinlen, mi hoiloute lampi ah zong pei sin."},"15":{"text":"Tua lampi zui sinlen peel in, kiheisan inlen nuasie in."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen migiloute’n silsie khat tei abawl sih u’leh, a imu thei sih ua, tualeh mi khat puana ding abawl sih u’leh, a imu thei sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen amauten gitlouna tanghou ane ua, thagumsuona uoin adawn uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh midihte lampi zingmawng khovah bang ahi a, sunlai nisa banga tangpha sem sem bang ahi."},"19":{"text":"Migiloute lampi pen a miel keikui a, banga kipal ahi uoi chi nangawn athei sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ka tapa ka thute ngaikhie inlen, ka thugente ah na bil daw in."},"21":{"text":"Na mitmu akipat in peimangsah sinlen, na lungsim sunggil ah kem in."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen tuate mukhete adingin hinna ahi a, atahsa pumpi ua ding damna ahi."},"23":{"text":"Bangteng sangin na lungtang kem hoi in, aziehpen tuana kipat a hinna tuinah hing luongkhie ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Khelhamna kam koimang inlen, tualeh lepchiena kamte nanga kipat, gamlatah ah koimang in."},"25":{"text":"Na mit in na mailam tangtah in en inlen, na mit in na masang tangtah in en kilkel in."},"26":{"text":"Na kengin azui ding lampi ngaituopha inlen, tualeh lampi dih leh dette zuiin.","ref":"Heb. 12.13"},"27":{"text":"Zietlam ahiei, veilam ahiei ah zong piel sinlen, sietna lampi ah na kalsuon vawt sin."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa ka pilnate ah lunglut inlen, ka theisiemna thute ah na bil daw in.","title":"Numei thanghuoite apat kiven ding"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n theikah siemna na nei dinga, na kam in pilna akem thei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen numei thanghuoi in akam khuoizu bangin ahum sah a, tualeh akam sathau sangin azol zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh atawp ah amanu aichimtangkha bangin akha a, namsau tattuo hiem bang ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amanu keng shina lam zuon in apei suh a, a kalsuonten mishi khuo lam azuon hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinna lampi ngaisut louin, alampite a kawi a, amanu’n lah aphawh kha sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka tate aw tuin, hing ngaikhie unlen, ka kam a thupawtte apat kiheimang sih un."},"8":{"text":"Amanu akipat in na lampi gamla pi ah peel inlen, a inn kot kung nai ah pei sin."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahisihleh na zatat huoina midangte kungah na pekha ding a, tualeh na kumte u’zong migiloute kungah na pekha ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Gamdang miten na nei nalam atang ding ua, na sep gimna in midangte ahausah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Atawpna lam ah, na tel na vou ahing thawp chiengin, da leh kap in na um ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuahun chiengin “Bangdinga thuhilna kana huot a, tualeh ka lungtang in phawhhilna, Kana simmaw ata diei,"},"13":{"text":"tualeh kei hinghil mite thu kana manlou a, ahing thuhilna lam a ka bil na daw lou kata diei;"},"14":{"text":"tu’n lah mipi kikhawmte leh khawmpite, lah ah mangthai petma ding lah kata’n na chi pan ding uhi.”"},"15":{"text":"Nangma tuibel a tui kidawn inlen, nangma tuikhuh a tuiluongte kidawn in."},"16":{"text":"Na tuinah khu munchin ah a luong zah ding a, tualeh na lui tuite kholai a luongzah ding ahiei mah?"},"17":{"text":"Tuate khu nangma a maimai hisah inlen, midang toh kikop sin."},"18":{"text":"Na tuinah guol zawl in um henlen, tualeh na sen zi toh nuomsa in um in."},"19":{"text":"Amanu a etla huoi sazuh leh a it huoi sazuhpi bang hihenlen, anawi in nang bangchihlai pou in hing lungkim sah henlen, tualeh a itna in na lungsim kipahsah ngitnget hen."},"20":{"text":"Ka tapa aw bang zieh a numei thangtat a kilungkimsah kawi a, tualeh bangdinga numei kam zolnu ang na kawi lai zang ding adiei?"},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen mihingte gamtatna Mangpa mit in amu ngitnget a, alampite zousie a enchien zel hi."},"22":{"text":"Migilou pen ama gitlouna thangkam ah a awh a, akhelna khau in ama aman hi."},"23":{"text":"Kithuhilna tahsap ziehin ashi dinga, amot seng ziehin a piel mang ding hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa na innveng a dinga mawpotu a na pan a, gamdang mi vuohna dinga na khut na lap leh,","title":"Thasietna leh zuou gen zieha kigiihna"},"2":{"text":"Nangma ham kamte ah na awh a, na kam a thupawtten ahing manta hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka tapa tambangin bawl inlen, kihunkhedoh in, na innveng khutsunga awh na hitahzieh in, kintah in pei pai inlen, amasang ah kingiemkhieh inlen na innvengpa va lut in."},"4":{"text":"Na mit imusah sinlen, na mitte lusu sah sin."},"5":{"text":"Sabengmi khut a sakhi asuohtat bang in leh, thangkam mi khut a va apit khieh bangin nangma leh nangma kihunkhedoh in."},"6":{"text":"Nang mithasie aw, mesite kungah pei inlen, agamtat dan uh ngaituo inlen pil in.","title":"Mithasie leh Mesi"},"7":{"text":"Amauten lamkai ahiei, hausa leh vaihawm anei vateh sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Nipi laiin neh ding asutuo ua, tualeh pawltah chienga aneh ding uh akholkhawm uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aw Mithasie bangtan vei ahiei na imut ding a, imutna apat bang chih chienga thoudoh ding na hiei?"},"10":{"text":"Bakhat imu tadivang, bakhat mitsing nalai vang, bakhat ka khut hing pheh tadi vang na chi sungin;","ref":"Thu. 24.33,34"},"11":{"text":"zawnna suomhat bangin ahing tung dinga, tahsapna in galvan a kivonmi bangin ahing lap ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Miginalou, mi gilou khu thumanlou gen in avah kawi kawi a,","title":"Migilou hindan"},"13":{"text":"mit sih et in mi ahoupi kawi a, akengtawtat in thu agen a, akhutme in mi akawh hi."},"14":{"text":"Alungtangah gitlouna ngen a um a, silhoilou bawl ding ngen atum a, kituohlouna a pieng sah hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin atungah sietna thakhat in atung dinga, suhdam guollouin thakhat in asegawp ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa’n ahuot sil guh a um a, kidahhuoi asah sil sagi a um hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuate khu, kisahtheina mit ha, lei zuouthei, mawna neilou sisansuo khutte,"},"18":{"text":"gitlouna ngaituona lungtang, silgilou bawl dinga kintah a tai kengte,"},"19":{"text":"zuou gen a theipitu dihlou, leh unau lah a kituohlouna piengsah mite."},"20":{"text":"Ka tapa na pa thupieh zui inlen, na nu dan nuasie sin.","title":"Angkawm thu a hilna"},"21":{"text":"Na lungtang ah viel ngitnget inlen, na ngawng ah khi ngitnget in."},"22":{"text":"Na peina lampi ahing hil dinga, na imut kaal in ahing veng dinga, na khanlaw chiengin ang houpi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen thupiehte khu meivah ahia, tam dan khu vah ahi, tualeh thununna kihilna khu hinna lampi ahi."},"24":{"text":"Numei thanghuoi lah apat nang ahing veng dinga, numei thangtat mi zawlsiem kamhum akipat."},"25":{"text":"Na lungtangin amanu melhoina enla sinlen, a mitmei a azawlphah in um vawt sin."},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen kizuanu a dingin ann kamkhat giap bang na hi dinga, tualeh angkawmnu’n na hinna manphatah asui leng hi."},"27":{"text":"Mi’n apuon kasahlouin mei-am a angpom thei diei mah?"},"28":{"text":"Mi khat akeng kasahlou in mei-am tungah avah thei diei mah?"},"29":{"text":"Koipou a innvengpa zi luppi mi khu tuabang ahi dinga, koipou amanu va khoikha mi khu mawnabei in a um sih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Gilkiel a shi dinga kisa mikhat in agilva theina dinga, mi van aguh leh koiman asimmaw sih ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh akimat khah leh pen ale sagi in adin ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Koipou numei toh angkawm pouma in theisiemna atasam a, tuabanga bawl mi in ama hinna asusie hi."},"33":{"text":"Liemna leh zumhuoina amu dinga, tualeh aminsietna akiphietmang sih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Aziehpen thangsietna khu apasal thangpaina ahi a, tua ziehin phuba alah ni chiengin bangma ahinkhawi sih ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Aman zangnadopna asang nuom sih dinga, amanbei a silpiehte in zong alungkim sih ding hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa thute kem inlen, ka thupiehte na lungsim sungah kholkhawm in.","title":"Numei kizua apat kigiihna"},"2":{"text":"Ka thupiehte zui inlen hingin, ka dan khu na mitlaidum bangin kemin."},"3":{"text":"Na khutmete ah viel inlen na lungtang, suongpeh tungah giel in."},"4":{"text":"Pilna kungah “Ka sanggamnu na hi chi inlen,” theisiemna kungah, ka unaunu na hi chi in."},"5":{"text":"Tuahileh amauten numei thangtat nu akipat, ahing kem ding ua, numei thangtat nu kam zol leh, kamhum mizawlsiem akipat, ahing kembit ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen ka inn kotta vathang kikaal awng, apat in ka en a,"},"7":{"text":"Mi mawlte lah a tangvalnou khat ka mu a, khanglaite lah ah theisiemna neilou tangvalnou khat ka mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Kizuanu umna inn kunga gawlzing ah, ahing pei a, tualeh amanu inn lam zuon in apei hi."},"9":{"text":"Nitah khomiel zui leh zan khomiel nuoi ah."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh ngaivawi, kizua puonsil a kizem, lepchie lungtang puo numei khat in ana kimu ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Amanu ahi selsul a, agelsuoh a, akengte a inn ah a um det thei sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Khatvei teng gawlzing lah ah, khatvei teng kholai lah ah a um kawi a, tualeh mi inn ning kawmkaal teng ah, mi adap ngah kawi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n amapa aman a atawpa, zum maw mel tah in akung ah thu agen hi."},"14":{"text":"“Lemna sillatte ka kungah aum a, tuni’n ka thuchiemte ka tangtung sah hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n nangma mu dingin ka hing pawtdoh hi; phatuomngai tah in ka hing sui a, ka hing muta hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka lupna tungah puonpha hoitah ka phata a, singthal te ka lupna tungah ka theta hi."},"17":{"text":"Agimnamtui mama murate, aloete leh singthal te ka lupna tungah ka theta hi."},"18":{"text":"Hing pei inlen zingmawng khovah dong iki-itna, lungchim tahin izang khawm ding a, i ki-itna in ikilungnuom sah tuo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen ka pasal ka inn uah a um sih hi, khuol gamlapi a zin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Aman dangka ip apuo a, ha lia laitah chiengin ahing tung bep ding hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Amanu’n akamsiem in amapa azawlzouta a, akamdam toh azawlpua zouta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua tangvalnou in ama adap zui pai a, bawngtal in a thatpa anua zui bangin, ahisihleh mimo apilna dinga, kol kibul dinga apei bangin,"},"23":{"text":"leh thaltangin asin akap pailet masangsie, ashina ding ahilam theilou a, thang baw a leeng va bang ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin nou ka tate aw, ka thu ngaikhie unlen, ka kam a thupawtte lunglut tahin ngai un;"},"25":{"text":"khum minu lam zuon in na lungtang uh, kihei sah sih unlen, Amanu lampi zui in, lampiel kha vawt sih un."},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen tuabang numei in mi tampi aliemsa in apuasahta hi."},"27":{"text":"Amanu inn pen hankhuh zotna lampi ahi a, shina pindante zotsuhna lampi ahi bou hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pilna akikou sih amah? tualeh theisiemna ngaitah in akikou sih amah?","title":"Pilna pahtawi na","ref":"Thu. 1.20,21"},"2":{"text":"Pilna muol sang tungah adinga, lamka thuom tengah ading hi."},"3":{"text":"Khopi lutna kotpite ah leh khopi lutna, kotkhate ah pilna akikou hi."},"4":{"text":"“Mihingte aw noute hing han ka hi, mihing tapate han a ka aw suo ka hi."},"5":{"text":"Aw nou mi mawlte in pilna theisiem unlen, nou mi mote aw, theisiemna lungtang nei un."},"6":{"text":"Ngai un, silhoipente gen ding ka hi, ka kam akipat thudih hing pawtkhe ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen ka kam in thudih agen dinga, ka muh a dingin gitlouna khu kidahhuoi ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ka kam a ka thugen zousie dihtatna ahi a, thu kawi leh thugilou a um sih hi."},"9":{"text":"A theisiemte adingin ka gen zousie akichiena, theina mute adingin adih sieng kei hi."},"10":{"text":"Dangka sangin ka thuhilna tel zaw inlen, sana siengset sangin theina tel zaw in."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Rubi suong manpha sangin, pilna amanpha zaw a, na lunggul thei sil dang bangma toh, tepi thei guol ahi sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei, pilna khu pilvanna toh ka tengkhawm a, theina leh sie leh pha khensiemna zong ka nei hi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa giin khu gilou huotna ahi a, kiletsahna, kisahtheina leh gamtat hoilou leh, zuou genna kamte ken ka huo hi."},"14":{"text":"Thuhilna leh pilnagil kei a ahi a, kei theisiemna ka hi a, hatna ka nei hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima vangin leengten vai ahawm ua, vaihawmten danthupieh dihna abawl uhi."},"16":{"text":"Keima vangin leengtapate leh, miliente tualeh vaihawmte zousie in, leitung vai ahawm uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kei hing itte ka it a, phatuom ngaitah a hing suiten ahing mu ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hausatna leh zatatnate ka kungah aum a, sawtpi dai hausatna leh dihtatna kei a ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ka gasuote sana sangin ahoi zaw a, Ahi, sana siengset sangin zong ahoi zaw hi; tualeh ka sepsuo teng dangka sangin amanpha zaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Dihtatna lampi ah ka pei a, thudih lampite ka zui hi."},"21":{"text":"Kei hing itte hauna ka luosah a, tualeh a goubawmte uh ka dimsah hi."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa’n anasep apatchil a kipat in kei ahing neita a, tanglai a anasep apat masang nangawn in,","title":"Pilna hing kipat dan","ref":"Kihil. 3.14"},"23":{"text":"kumtawn a kipat in, achiil a kipat in, ahisihleh leitung um masang nangawn a zong, phudet kana hita hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuithuhpite um masangin lahdoh kana hita a, tuikhuh tui a dimte um masang tham in."},"25":{"text":"Muol leh taangte adin masangin, kei ka umzouta hi."},"26":{"text":"Leitung leh gamte ahisihleh leivuite, akisiem masang peh in kei ka umzou thamta hi."},"27":{"text":"Vante asiem masang leh, tuipi thupite tung agitkuol laiin, kei ka umzouta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tunglam a meilumte a koi laiin, Tuipi thuhpi tuinahte abawl laiin,"},"29":{"text":"tuipiten athupieh apalsat louna ding ua, gamgi ahun pieh laiin leh leitung kingahna aphum laiin, Kei ka umzouta hi."},"30":{"text":"Khum hunlai in Ama kungah nasem khutsiem, khat bangin agei ah kei ka umta hi. Nisima alungdamna ka hi a, Amatoh umkhawm nuom kasa ngitnget hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama tenna leitung khovel in nuom asa hi. Ka kipahna khu mihingte tapate ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh tuin, ka tate aw, ka thu ngai un, ka lampi zuite mi hampha ahi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Thuhilna ngaikhie unlen, pil un, tualeh nelsie vawt sih un."},"34":{"text":"Ka thu ngaikhie mite, mi nuomsa ahi uhi, ni sim a ka kotpi vengte leh, ka kotkha bul a, hing ngahten nuom asa uhi."},"35":{"text":"Aziehpen koipou kei hing muten hinna amu ua, tualeh Mangpa deisahna zong amu ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Hinanleh koipou ka tunga khiel mi in ama hinna aliemsah bep ahi, kei hing muda pouma shina it ahi uhi.”"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pilna in a inn alam a, khuom sagite aphutta hi.","title":"Pilna kipahtawina"},"2":{"text":"Agantate athatta a, aman a zu toh atohhal a, ann nehna ding dawkan zong adaw zouta hi."},"3":{"text":"A suoh nungahte asawldoh a, khopi sunga munsang tengah mi han in akikou sah hi."},"4":{"text":"“Nou mi mawlte pouma tamlangah hing kihei unlen,” theisiemna neilou pouma kungah;"},"5":{"text":"“Hing pei inlen ka ann hing ne unlen, ka zu halsa dawn un,"},"6":{"text":"Motna taisan unlen, hing pei un, theisiemna lampi ah pei un,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi simmawhat mi phawhpa in zumna alawdoh giap a; migilou phawhhilpa in ama liemna ding alawdoh giap hi."},"8":{"text":"Misimmawhatte phawhhil sin, ahisihleh nang ahing muda kha ding hi, mipil phawh lachin nang ahing it ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mipil kungah thuhilna pe lachin, ahing pil deu deu dinga, midih hil lachin atheitam sem sem ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa giin khu pilna kipatna ahi a, Asiengthoupa theina khu theisiemna ahi.","ref":"Job. 28.28; Late. 111.10; Thu. 1.7"},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen keima ziehin na damsung nite akibelap dinga, na damsung kumte zong akibelap ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na pil leh nanga dinga pil na hi dinga; hinanleh mi na simmaw leh pen, nangman amaw na kipuoh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Numei mo khu akam atam a abil ap huoi hi, amawl a bangma athei sih hi.","title":"Numei maw"},"14":{"text":"A inn kotlam ah atou a, khopi munsang touna tungte ah atou hi."},"15":{"text":"Amauh lampi a tangtah a pei a, agei a suoh khate pouma na han ding in:"},"16":{"text":"“Koi pou pilna tasam leh,” mi mawlte pouma tanah hing ki heilut u’heh, ana chi hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tui kigu ahumdeu se a, simtham a ann neh atuideu se hi.”"},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun mi shite khunah a um uh chi leh, amanu mi hatte shina hankhuh, thutah ah a um uh chi, athei sih uhi, achi hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon thupilte: Tapa pilin apa akipah sah a, tapa moin anu alunggim sah hi.","title":"Solomon paunahte"},"2":{"text":"Gitlouna toh kilamdoh hausatna aphatuom sih a, hinanleh dihtatnain shina apat mi ahunkhie hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa’n midihtatte hinna gilkiel in akoi phal sih dinga, migilou lunggulte apaimang pieh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi thasie khut in zawnna atun a, mi thanuom khut in hausatna atun hi."},"5":{"text":"Nipi lai a lakhawm mi khu tapa pil ahi a, hinanleh bu lah hunlai a imu mi khu, zumna tungsah tapa ahi."},"6":{"text":"Guolzawlna khu midihtatte lutungah a um a, hinanleh hiemngamna in migiloute, kam atuomkhum hi."},"7":{"text":"Midihtat theizingna khu guolzawl in aum a, hinanleh migiloute min pen amuot mang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Lungtang pil in thupiehte asanga, hinanleh mimo kamtam pen apua ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Midihtatte muonhuoi tah in apei hit hiet ua, hinanleh miletatte akitheidoh pai ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amit sih at a mi enpa’n buoina apiengsah a, hinanleh mi mo kamtam apua ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Midihtatte kam khu hinna tuikhuh ahi a, hinanleh migiloute kam pen, hiemngamna in atuom hi."},"12":{"text":"Kimudana in kihauna apieng sah a, hinanleh itna in khelna akhu khum hi.","ref":"Jak. 5.20; 1 Pet. 4.8"},"13":{"text":"Theisiemna nei mi kam ah pilna akimu a, theisiemna neiloute el duong ah, chiengpum atu ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mipilten theina akholkhawm a, mi mote kam in sietna a nai hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihausa hausatna khu ama adinga, khopi dettah ahi a, tahsapna khu mi zawngte sietna ahi."},"16":{"text":"Mi dihtat sepgimna in hinna atun a, migiloute thaman pen khelna ahi."},"17":{"text":"Thuhilna kemhoi pouma hinna lampi ah a um a; phawhhilna zada mi in lampi azuikhiel zel hi."},"18":{"text":"Amudana im mi in muh zuouthei a nei a, mi gensiet hat mi khu mi mo ahi."},"19":{"text":"Thu tampi kigenna ah khelna abei sih hi, hinanleh akamsip thei mi khu mi pil ahi."},"20":{"text":"Midihtatte lei khu dangka sieng sitset bang ahi a, migilou lungsim pen manna bei ahi."},"21":{"text":"Midihtatte muhin mi tampi avah a, mi mote pen pilna tahsam in ashi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa guolzawlna in mi ahausa sah a, lunggimna abelap sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi mote adingin gitlouna bawl khu, kisuhhalna bang ahi a, hinanleh theisiemna nei mi in pilna anei hi."},"24":{"text":"Migilou in agiin pen ma atuohkha dinga, midihtatte pen alunggulte uh akipe ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Pingpei aman bangin, migiloute a um nawn sih ding ua, midihtatte pen kumtawn in adet den ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Grep tuithua in ha azausah a, mei khu in mit asip sah bangin, mi thasie khu ama sawltute a dingin tuabang ahi."},"27":{"text":"Mangpa giinna in damsung nite asau sah a, hinanleh migiloute damsung kumte tom sah ahi ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Midihte kinepna khu kipahna ahi dinga, migiloute lam etna pen amangthang ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Midih a dingin Mangpa lampi khu hatna ahi a, hinanleh manthaina khu sietna nasemte ading ahi."},"30":{"text":"Midihtatte pen suonmang ahi ngai sih ding ua, migiloute pen gamsungah atengden sih ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Midihtatte kam in pilna thu agenkhie a, hinanleh hamselawna lei pen satkhieh ahi ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Midihtat muh in pomthei ding athei a, hinanleh migilou kam in thusie agen thei hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Buhna dihlou Mangpa adingin, kidahhuoi ahi a, hinanleh tena dih khu akipahna ahi."},"2":{"text":"Kisahtheina a um chiengin zum na zong, a um a hinanleh kingaingiemte, kungah pilna a um hi."},"3":{"text":"Midihte adihna un amauh apui ding a, mi gin umloute pen azuoutatna un, amauh sietna atun ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Thangpai niin hausatna aphatuom sih a, dihtatna in shina akipat mi hunkhe zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Gensietbei mi dihtatna in ama adingin, lampi tang a bawl pieh a, migilou pen ama gitlouna ah apua ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Midihte adihtatna un amauh ahunkhe dinga, mi gin umloute pen, amauh ngaisutna gilou ah a awh ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Migilou ashi chiengin akinepna amangsieng dinga, midihloute kinepna pen amang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Midihtat khu alunggimmna apat in hutdoh in a um dinga, ama taangin migilou ahing pei hi."},"9":{"text":"Milepchie in akam in a innveng asusie a, theina ziehin midih hunkhieh in a um ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Midihtatte ading a sil apei hoi laiin khopi mite akipah a, migiloute ashi chiengun lungdamna kikou thawm a kiza hi."},"11":{"text":"Midihte guolzawlna vangin khopi pahtawi in a um a, hinanleh migiloute kam ham in khopi aguollel hi."},"12":{"text":"Pilna neilou mi in a innveng asimmaw a, hinanleh theisiemna nei mi pen a sip khinkhian hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi kamtam in thuguh ki imte agenkhie a, mi ginum in thuguh a im hi."},"14":{"text":"Kithuhilna umlouna ah mi mipite apua zel a, thuhilthei mi tamna ah bitna aum hi."},"15":{"text":"Mikhuol ading a mawpo dinga kipe mi pen, athuohgim ngeingei dinga, hinanleh mawpuohna hawte abit ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihepisiem numei in pahtatna alaw a, hinanleh thagumhat suongmiten, hausatna anga uhi."},"17":{"text":"Khotuona nei mite ama hinna mama adingin silhoi abawl a, hinanleh mitatsete pen, ama tahsa tung ngei ah lunggimna atungsah hi."},"18":{"text":"Migilou in thaman dihloutah in asanga, dihtatna haichi tupa’n kipahman, dihtah amu ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Dihtatna in hinna lampi a mi a pui bangin, koipou gitlouna del in ama shina ding anua del hi."},"20":{"text":"Lungtang dihlou pomite pen, Mangpa a dingin kidahhuoi ahi ua, hinanleh a umdan ua dihtatte khu, akipahna ahi."},"21":{"text":"Migiloute pen gawtlou in asuohta sih ding ua, hinanleh midihtatte hahlesuonte pen, hutkhiet in a um ding uhi, chi thei in."},"22":{"text":"Ngaituo siemna neilou numei melhoi khu, vohpi na kua a sana gui kibasah bang ahi."},"23":{"text":"Midihtatte lunggul khu silhoi ngen ahi a, hinanleh migiloute lam et khu thangpaina ahi."},"24":{"text":"Kiphal taha hawmzah mi in anei tam deudeu a, mi chippongte pen a zawng sem sem hi."},"25":{"text":"Sil phal mi hinna suhhausat ahi dinga, midangte bawlhoi mi khu, bawlhoi sem in a um ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Koipou bu leh bal it mi khu miten ahamsiet ding ua, hinanleh azua nuompa lutung ah guolzawlna atung ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Koipou thanuomtah a silhoi sui teitei ten, deisahna amu ua, hinanleh silhoilou suiten silhoilou ma amu ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Ama hausatna muong mi khu apua dinga, hinanleh midihtat khu sing bawhpha bangin alun ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Koipou ama innsung buoi sah mi khu, akihawmkhai dinga mi hatte leh, mi pilte nasemin apang ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Midihtatte ga khu hinna singkung ahia, tualeh koipou hagau man khu mipil ahi."},"31":{"text":"Midihtatte leitunga akithuh kia pai a ahileh, migilou leh mikhielte nasa sem in akithuh kia pai ding hi.","ref":"1 Pet. 4.18"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Koipou thuhilna ngaina in theina angaina hi, hinanleh phawhhilna zada pouma mi mo ahi.","title":"Dihtatna leh gitlouna akibahlouna"},"2":{"text":"Mi hoi in Mangpa akipat deisahna a mua, hinanleh gitlouna ngaituo mi khu, Aman amawpai ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Gitlouna in mi asudet thei sih ding a, hinanleh dihtatna thahui akisuon sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Zi hoi khu apasal a dingin Manglukhu ahi a, hinanleh zumhuoina bawlnu khu, apasal a dingin gu leh taang natna ahi."},"5":{"text":"Midihtat lunggel khu adih a, hinanleh migilou thuhilna pen solna ngen ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Migiloute thu pen sisansuo dinga, dapbuhna thu ahi a, hinanleh midihte kam in amauh ahunkhie hi."},"7":{"text":"Migiloute paikhieh in a um ua, a um nawn sih uhi, hinanleh midihtatte inn pen adingden ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi apilna dungzuiin phat in a um dinga, hinanleh lungsim semi pen akimuda ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama kingaithupi a tanghou neilou sangin, simmaw a um a suoh nei ahoizaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Midihtat in aganta hinna angaikhoh a, migiloute khotuona neempen zong agilou nalai hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama gam hou khinkhian mi in ann neh ahau dinga, mi mantheilou nuazui mite pen theisiemna bei ahi."},"12":{"text":"Migilouten migiloute sepsuosa adeigaw ua, hinanleh midihtatte thagui in ga asuong hi."},"13":{"text":"Migilou pen ama thugen gilou mama ah a awh a, hinanleh midih pen lungkham buoina, pat apawtdoh ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi’n akhut nasep apat neh amu bangin, akam siemna ga silhoi in atai ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Mimote agamtatna pouma uah dih akisa ua, hinanleh kithuhilna ngaikhemi khu mipil ahi."},"16":{"text":"Mi mo in alungthahna akilangsah pai a, hinanleh mi lunggel siem mi in, kizumsuona athusim sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Koipou thudih gen miin dihtatna thu agen a, theipi dihtahlou in zuou agen hi."},"18":{"text":"Namsau a sut banga thugen mi a um a, hinanleh mipil lei khu damna ahi."},"19":{"text":"Thutah genna kamte kumtawn in a umden dinga, hinanleh zuou genna lei in, hun tomnou khat adai giap hi."},"20":{"text":"Silgilou sep tumte lungsim ah lepchiena thu a um a, lemna umsah tumte lungsim ah lungnopna a um hi."},"21":{"text":"Midihtatte a dingin sietna atung sih dinga, migiloute pen lungkham buoina in adim ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Kam zuouthei khu Mangpa a dingin kidahhuoi ahi a; dihtah a bawlte pen akipahpi hi."},"23":{"text":"Lunggel siem mi in theina aphuol khin khian a, mi mote lungtang in motna aphuongdoh hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi thanuom khut in vai ahawm dinga, mithasete pen mite nasem in apang ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Mihing lunggimna in kingaisietna atun a, hinanleh thuhoi in akipah sah hi."},"26":{"text":"Midihtatin pilvangtahin alawm ding atel a, migiloute gamtatin amauh apielmang sah hi."},"27":{"text":"Mithasie in asabehna a amatsate, nangawn a em ngap sih a, hinanleh mithanuomte silnei khu amanpha hi."},"28":{"text":"Dihtatna lampi ah hinna a um a, tua lampi ah shina a um sih hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tapa pil in apa thuhilna a ngaikhie a, hinanleh misimmaw hat miin phawhhilna, a ngaikhe nuom sih hi."},"2":{"text":"Mi’n akamsiem ga silhoi ane dinga, hinanleh mi gin umloute hinna, in hiemngamna ane ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Akam vengzou miin ahinna akembita, hinanleh a kam lienpi a kaah miin sietna atuoh ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Mithasie hinna in alunggul a, bangma anei sih hi, hinanleh mithanuom hinna pen, hausat sahin a um ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Midihtat in zuou ahuo a, hinanleh migilou khu ahuothuoi a, zumna atuoh zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Genbanglou a gamta mi khu dihtatna in a kem a, hinanleh gitlouna in mikhiel apuasah hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi ama leh ama kihausa sah a bangma neilou a um a, hinanleh mi ama leh ama kizawng sah, napi hauna thupitah nei a um hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihing hinna tatna khu ahausatna ahi a, hinanleh mizawng in vau hilna angai nuom sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Midihtatte vah khu anuom a, hinanleh migiloute meivah pen sumit ahi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Kiletsahna in kihauna apiengsah giap a, hinanleh thuhilna ngaisah miten pilna anei uhi."},"11":{"text":"Lepchietah a hausatnate akiem pai dinga, hinanleh sepgimna thaman kholkhawm mi khu, apung deu deu ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Kinepna ahing zekai chiengin lungtang anasah a, hinanleh lunggulna ahingtun chiengin, hinna singkung ahi."},"13":{"text":"Koipou thupieh simmaw khu suhsiet ahi dinga, hinanleh koipou thupieh giing mi khu, kipahman pieh in a um ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mipil dan khu hinna tuikhuh ahi a, shina thangte apata suohtatna ahi."},"15":{"text":"Theisiemna hoiin deisahna apie a, hinanleh mi gin umloute lampi ahasa hi."},"16":{"text":"Lunggelsiem mi pouma in theina toh kituohin, nna asem ua, hinanleh mi moten amotna uh asulang paipai uhi."},"17":{"text":"Thupotu gilou khu buoina ah akelut zel a, palai gin um in chidamna atut hi."},"18":{"text":"Hoina dinga phawhhilna ngainuomlou mi in gentheina leh zumna atuoh dinga, bawlhoina ngaikhe miin pahtatna alaw ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Lunggul bangbang a pichinsah a um khu, hinna a dingin anuom a; hinanleh mi mote a dingin, gitlouna taisan khu sil kidahhuoi ahi."},"20":{"text":"Mipilte toh zawhkhawm mi ahing pila, mi mote toh kigop mi pen suhmang ahi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Silhoilou in mikhielte anuadel a, hinanleh midihtatte kungah nuomman akipe ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mihoi in atu leh atate adingin gou anuasie a, tualeh mikhielte hausatna pen midihtatte, dinga gou kikholkhawm asuoh hi."},"23":{"text":"Mizawngte lou hawna ah ann tampi apieng thei a, hinanleh thudih a vaihawmna atahsap ziehin, suhsiet in a um leng hi."},"24":{"text":"Koi zong chieng zanglou mi khu atapa muda ahi, atapa it in thununna ape mengmeng hi."},"25":{"text":"Midihtatten ahinna uh ataimasang sie’n ane ding ua, hinanleh migiloute agilkiel ding uhi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Numei pil poumain a inn alama, hinanleh numei moin ama khut mama in a inn aphelsie hi."},"2":{"text":"Dihtattah a gamta mi in Mangpa agiing a, gamtat gilou miin Ama asim maw hi."},"3":{"text":"Mimo kam ah kiletsahna chieng a um a, hinanleh mipil kam in amauh akembit ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Bawngtalte umlouna ah gankuong asienga, bawngtal thahatna in bulah ding tampi apiengsah hi."},"5":{"text":"Theipitu gin um in zuou agen sih a, hinanleh theipitu dihlou in zuou agen ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Misimmawhat mi in pilna asui a, amu sih hi; hinanleh theisiemna nei mi in, bailamtah in theina amu hi."},"7":{"text":"Mimo umna apat kihemkhie in, aziehpen ama kam apat theina na mu sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Lemguotsiem pilna khu alampi theisiem ahi a, hinanleh mimote motna khu lepchie na ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mimoten khelna anuisan ua, hinanleh midihtatte lah ah deisahna a um hi."},"10":{"text":"Lungtangin ama khelna athei a, tualeh mikhuol khu ama nopsahna ah akikum sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Migilou inn suhsiet ahi dinga, midihte puonbuh pen akhangtou sem sem ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihinga dinga dih hileh kilawm lampi a uma, atawpna khu shina lampi ahi.","ref":"Thu. 16.25"},"13":{"text":"Nuina ah zong lungsim natna a um thei a, tualeh nopna tawpna khu dana ahi."},"14":{"text":"Lungtanga nuatol mi khu ama ngaidan in adim ding a, tualeh mihoi in pen a umdan hoina pahtatman asang ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi mawl in thu zousie agingta a, hinanleh mi lunggelsiem in apeina lampite a en chien hi."},"16":{"text":"Mipil in silhoilou agiinga ataisan hi, hinanleh mi mote athangpai ua, akimuong uhi."},"17":{"text":"Milungthah baite mot huoitah in agamta ua, tualeh ngaituona a gitlou pilte pen, mi muda in aum hi."},"18":{"text":"Mi mawlten motna alawtah ua, hinanleh mi lunggelsiemte pen, theina manglukhu akikhusah hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihoite mai ah mihoiloute akun ding ua, tualeh midihtatte kotpiphungah, migiloute akun ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mizawngte pen a innvengte nangawn in a muda a, hinanleh mihauten lawm tampi anei uhi."},"21":{"text":"Koipou a innveng muda mi in khelna abawl hi, mi zawngte hepi mi khu mi nuomsa ahi."},"22":{"text":"Gitlouna bawlte alampiel uh hilou amah? Hinanleh hepina leh thutah pen, silhoi bawlte a ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Sepgimna zousie ah metna a um a, hinanleh kam guoh a genthaw in zawnna ah hing puilut hi."},"24":{"text":"Mipilte lallukhu pen ahausatna uh ahi a, hinanleh mi mote motna khu motna ma ahi."},"25":{"text":"Theipitu dihtahin hinna ahunkhie hi, theipitu lepchie in zuou thu agen hi."},"26":{"text":"Mangpa giinna ziehin kimuonna hattah a um a, ataten kibutna mun anei ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Mangpa giin khu hinna tuikhuh ahi a, shina thang toh kipel theina ahi."},"28":{"text":"Mitampi umna ah leengpa avanglien a, hinanleh mipi umlouna ah leengtapate manthaina a um hi."},"29":{"text":"Lungthah ha mi khu theisiemna nei ahi a, lungthah bai mi pen amotna uh sulang bep ahi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Lungnopna khu tahsa damna ahi a, thangsietna pen gute nangawn muotna ahi."},"31":{"text":"Koipou taga bawlgenthei khu asiempa simmaw ahia, tasamte hepi mi khu Pasian zatat mi ahi."},"32":{"text":"Migilou khu ama gitlouna ah pailut in a um a, hinanleh midihtat in ashi na ah lam etna anei hi."},"33":{"text":"Theisiemna nei mi lungsim ah pilna akhawl hi, hinanleh mi mote lungsim a um khu akithei hi."},"34":{"text":"Dihtatna in nam atawisang a, hinanleh khelna khu nam zalatna ahi."},"35":{"text":"Suoh piltahin leengpa deisahna atanga, hinanleh zumna umsah mi tungah athangpaina atung hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Dawnna nem in thangpaina aheimang a, hamkhau in lungthahna asousah hi."},"2":{"text":"Mipil lei in theina dihtah in a zang a, hinanleh mi mote kam in motna thu asekhie hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa mit in mun chinteng amu a, asie leh apha zong a en a, achiemte hi."},"4":{"text":"Kamdam athugen lei khu hinna singkung ahi a, kamsie in lungsim asusie hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi moin apa thuhilna asim maw a, hinanleh koipou phawhhilna ngaisah mi khu lunggelsiem ahi."},"6":{"text":"Midihtat innsungah gou tampi a um a, hinanleh migilou hausatna pen buoina bep ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mipil kam in theina ahawmzaha, hinanleh mi mote lungtangin tuabangin abawl sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Mimo kithoina khu Mangpa’n akidah a, hinanleh midih thungetna pen akipahpi hi."},"9":{"text":"Migiloute gamtatna khu Mangpa’n akidaha, hinanleh dihtatna zui mi khu a it hi."},"10":{"text":"Umdan hoi lampi taisante adingin, bawlhoina khautah apoimo a, tualeh bawlhoina thuhil mudate pen ashi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Gawtmun leh manthaina khu, Mangpa mai ah kihongsa in a um a, tuaziehin mihing tapate lungtang, bangzata in amuchien sem diei izaw!"},"12":{"text":"Mi simmaw hat mi in bawlhoina thuhilpa a it sih a, mipil kungah zong avahaw sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Lungsim nopna in mai ataisah a, hinanleh lungsim dana in, hinna asusie hi."},"14":{"text":"Theisiemna nei lungtangin theina asui a, hinanleh mi mote kam, motthu in akivah hi."},"15":{"text":"Gentheina thuoh mite damsung ni sietna ngen ahi a, hinanleh lungnopna nei miin pen lungnopna ankuong alui zing hi."},"16":{"text":"Gou tampi nei a lungkhampi sangin, Mangpa giing kawm a gou tawmnoukhat nei ahoi zaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Kimudana toh bawngnou thau sa neh sangin, ki itna toh annteme neh ahoizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Lungthah bai miin kihauna apiengsah a, lungthah ha miin kihauna asudai hi."},"19":{"text":"Mithasete lampi linglah bang ahi a, midihte lampi pen lamlienpi bang ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tapa pil in apa akipah sah a, tapa maw in anu asimmaw hi."},"21":{"text":"Sie leh pha khensiemna neilou miin motna khu, nuom asa a theisiemna nei mi pen dihtah in apei hi."},"22":{"text":"Lemguotna tellou in siltup khu chimawna ahi a, thuhiltu tampi umna ah lawchinna a um hi."},"23":{"text":"A kam a dawnna mama in mi akipah sah a, tualeh ahuntah a thugen hoi hina maizen e."},"24":{"text":"Mipil a dingin hinna lampi atou pei a, nuoilam a hankhuh apat akiheimang theina dingin."},"25":{"text":"Mangpa’n mi kiliensah inn asuse dinga, meithaite gamgi asuhdet pieh ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Migiloute ngaituona khu Mangpa a dingin akidahhuoi a, hinanleh misiengthoute thugen pen akipahpi hi."},"27":{"text":"Punna dei a huoiham mi in ama innsung asubuoi a, hinanleh golguhna homi pen ahing ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Midihtat lungtangin dawn dan ding angaituo det det a, hinanleh migiloute kam in pen silhoilou asekhie hi."},"29":{"text":"Mangpa khu migiloute apat gamlapi ah a um a, hinanleh midihtatte thungetna pen aza hi."},"30":{"text":"Mit vahna in lungsim asunuom a, tualeh thutut hoiin in gute athausah hi."},"31":{"text":"Hinna dinga phawh hilna, ngaikhie bil mipilte lah ah a um den ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Koipou thuhilna ngaisahlou in ama hinna asimmaw a, hinanleh bawlhoina ngaikhe mi in theisiemna amu hi."},"33":{"text":"Mangpa giinna in pilna thuhilna ahi a, tualeh zatat huoina masangah kingiemkhiehna a um masa hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungtang a kisahkholna khu mihing a ahi a, lei a dawnna pen Mangpa akipat ahi."},"2":{"text":"Mihing lampi zousie ama mitmu in asienga, hinanleh Mangpa’n lungsim a tupnate tena in ate zel hi."},"3":{"text":"Na sep nabawl ding pouma Mangpa kungah, aap sieng lachin na ngaisutnate asudet ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa’n sil zousie Ama a dingin abawl a, migiloute nangawn zong ni hoilou a dingin asiem hi."},"5":{"text":"Lungtang kisathei pouma Mangpa a dingin, kidahhuoi ahi a, kithutuoh nan u’le zong gawtlouin aum sih ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Khotuona leh thutah in gitlouna asawpsiengta a, tualeh Mangpa giinna ziehin gitlouna ataisan uhi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing khat umdan in Mangpa akipahsah chiengin, amelmate nangawn ama toh kilem dingin abawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Dihloutah a hauna tampi sangin, dihtatna toh tawm noukhat nei ahoizaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihing lungtangin agamtatna ding angaisut masa a, hinanleh Mangpa’n akalsuonte apui zel hi."},"10":{"text":"Leengpa kam sungah Pasian thutah a um a, thukhenna ah akam in zuouthu agen sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Buhna dih leh tena dih Mangpa a ahi a, ip gihdante zousie Ama nasep ahi."},"12":{"text":"Lengpa adingin gitlouna bawl khu sil kidahhuoi ahi, aziehpen leengtoupha khu dihtatna a suhdet ahi."},"13":{"text":"Dihtatna kamte leengte kipahna ahi a, tualeh thudih gen pouma khu a it uhi."},"14":{"text":"Leengpa lungthahna khu shina thangkou khat bang ahi a, hinanleh mipilten asulungdam ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Leengpa amaitai chiengin hinna a um a, adeisahna pen guo nukhia zusah meilum bang ahi."},"16":{"text":"Pilna mu khu sana sangin hoizaw hina va-ia e! tualeh theisiemna khu dangka sanga tel zawh ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Midihte lamlien khu silhoilou taisan ahi a, koipou alampi vengin ahinna avengbit hi."},"18":{"text":"Kisahtheina khu sietna masangah apei a, tualeh lungsim ki uongsah khu puasietna masangah apei hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi kisatheite toh gallahsum hawm sangin, mi zawngte lah a lungsim kingaingiem tah a umkhawm ahoizaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Koipou kithuhilna piltah a ngaikhe mi in silhoi amu dinga, tualeh koipou Mangpa muong mi ahampha ahi."},"21":{"text":"Lungtang pil khu milemthei akichi dinga, tualeh kam humin siemna apungsah hi."},"22":{"text":"Theisiemna nei mi a dingin hinna tuinah ahi a, hinanleh mi mote bawlhoina dinga thuhilna khu motna ahi."},"23":{"text":"Mipil lungtangin akam ahil a, tualeh akam ah pilna abelap hi."},"24":{"text":"Thu lungdamhuoite hinna a dingin khuoizu humbang ahi a, gu leh taanga dingin damna ahi."},"25":{"text":"Mihinga dinga adih hileh kilawm lampi a um a, hinanleh atawpna khu shina lampite ahi thei hi.","ref":"Thu. 14.12"},"26":{"text":"Koipou nasemgim miin ama adinga sem ahi a, aziehpen akam gilkielna in asepsah ahi."},"27":{"text":"Pasian ngaisahlou miin silhoilou abawldoh a, tualeh akamham nangawn meikuong abang hi."},"28":{"text":"Mi kiuongsahin kihauna apiengsah a, tualeh bilkawm a thudapgen siu siau in, lawmta hoipen zong akikhensah hi."},"29":{"text":"Thagum suonga gamtaten a innvengte azawl a, tualeh lampi hoilou lam ah apeipi hi."},"30":{"text":"Mit sih at a mihoupi mi in gitlouna angaituo a, Amuh chidet mi in sietna atungsah hi."},"31":{"text":"Tehsie samkang pen thupina manglukhu ahi a, tam khu dihtatna gamtat apat kimu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Koipou lungthah ha mi khu galhang mi sangin ahoizaw a, tualeh koipou ama lungsim thuzaw mi khu, khopi khat simzou mi sangin ahoi zaw hi."},"33":{"text":"Pheipi tunga ai akisan hangin, thukhennate pouma pen Mangpa a hing kipan ahi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kihau kawm kawm a ann neh ding tuitah, inn dim a umna inn sung sangin, kithutuoh tah a annkhing kam khat nehna, innsung a nuom zaw hi."},"2":{"text":"Suoh pil in zumna piengsah tapa tungah, vai ahawm dinga, tualeh asanggamte lah a khat bangin, goutan anei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Sana leh dangkate, meiphuolpi sunga etchien leh suhsieng ahi a, mihing lungtang pen Mangpa’n a enchien a asiengsah hi."},"4":{"text":"Silgilou bawlmi in kam gilou angaikhie a, mi zuou in lah thuginalou gen lei lam ah abil adaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi zawngte simmaw mi in, ama Siempa simmaw ahi a, tualeh vangsietna ni a, kipah mi khu gawtlou in asuohta sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tehsete adingin atute uh amanglukhu uh ahi a, tate athupina khu apulepate uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Mi mo a dingin thupha genna kam akilawm thei sih a, leengpa adingin zuou genna kam akilawm maw dieh nalai hi."},"8":{"text":"Silpieh khu aneitu mitmu ah suong mantam bang ahi a, akiheina lam phot ah alaw ching ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Koipou tatkhelna ngaidam itna asui a, hinanleh thukhat avelvel a gen mi in, alawm hoite nangawn akikhensah hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi mo zakhatvei sat sangin, mipil in khatvei phawhhilna athei siem zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Migilou in kiphinna ding maimai asui a, tuaziehin atungah thangkou gilou khat, ama dou dingin akisawl ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi mo khat amot laitah a kituohpi sangin, vawmpi noukai anou kiluoh pieh toh, kituoh a ut huoi zaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Koipou silhoi silhoiloua thuh kia mite, innsung thusie in anuasie sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Kihauna pat pen tui kiching hakhiet bang ahi a, tuaziehin kihauna a um masangin kiselna tawpsan in."},"15":{"text":"Koipou migilou siemtangsah a midih, mawpai mite ani un Mangpa adinga, kidahhuoi ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin pilna leina dingin, mi mo khut ah aman a um eimah, tuakhu a dingin ama’n theisiemna anei sih, chi thei in."},"17":{"text":"Lawm khat in bangchihlai pouin a it ngitnget a; sanggam khu vangsietna ni a dinga pieng ahi."},"18":{"text":"Theisiemna neilou mi in a innvengte taang a, mawpo dingin akichiem pai hi."},"19":{"text":"Kihauna it miin khelna a it hi, koipou akotpi tawisang in sietna asui hi."},"20":{"text":"Koipou kiuohsahna lungtang nei mi in silhoi amusih a, tualeh lei thulimlou neiin vangsietna atuoh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tapa mo nei pa’n buoina ahingdoh a, mi mo nu leh paten lungnopna aneisih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Lungsim nopna khu chidamna damdawi ahia, lungtang hasie in gute agawsah hi."},"23":{"text":"Migilou in thudih a vaihawmna heikawina dingin, golguhna sum adap neh hi."},"24":{"text":"Sie leh pha khensiemna nei mi masangah pilna a um a, mi mo mit khu kawlmong ah a um hi."},"25":{"text":"Tapa mo pen apa adinga lungkhamna ahi a, apienna anu a dingin khatna a hi."},"26":{"text":"Mawna neilou mi gawt ahoi sih a, miliente athudih zieh ua zep zong ahoituom sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Koipou theina nei mi khu athugen ah akiveng a, koipou lungsim tawldam mi in theisiemna anei hi."},"28":{"text":"Mimo nangawn asip dide leh apil a ngai ahi a, tualeh koipou akam sip khinkhian leh, theisiemna nei khat a sim ahi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi ama leh ama kituomkoi in alunggulte asui a, vaihawmna pilhuoi zousie tungah alungthah hi."},"2":{"text":"Theisiemna ah mi moin kipahna anei sih, hinanleh a lungtang a umte genkhieh nuom asa bep hi."},"3":{"text":"Migilou ahing um chiengin simmawna ahing um pai a, tualeh minsietna a um chieng zumna ahing um hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihing kam a thute khu tuithuhpi bang ahi a, tualeh pilna tuikhuh pen luita luong bang ahi."},"5":{"text":"Migilou deisah tuom ahoi sih a; thukhenna a midihtat paikhieh zong ahoi tuom sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi mo kamte khu kinielna ah alut a, tualeh akam in zepna ahan hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi mo kam khu ama sietna ahi a, tualeh akamhamte ama hinna adinga thang ahi."},"8":{"text":"Thuse gente gensietna thute ann tuitah bang ahi a, mihing tahsa sunglam ah alutsuh uhi."},"9":{"text":"Nasep thase mi pen sietna bawlmite a dingin sanggam ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa min khu innsang dettah bang ahi a, midihtatte atailut, ua, abit uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mihausa hausatna khu ama dinga akhopi dettah ahia; ama ngaidan in kulbaang sangtah bang ahi."},"12":{"text":"Manthaina masangah lungtang kisahtheina a um a, tualeh za umna masang ah kingai ngiemna a um hi."},"13":{"text":"Koipou thu chientah a azah masanga, dawng pai mi khu ama a dinga motna leh zumna ahi."},"14":{"text":"Mi alungsim a apan zou nahpouleh natna athuohzou a, hinanleh lungsim liem khu koi in athuohzou diei?"},"15":{"text":"Mi lungsim gelsiem in theina amu a, tualeh mipil bil in theina asui hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi khat a silthawn piehin ama a dingin, umna abawl pieh a, mithupite masangah ahing zawpi hi."},"17":{"text":"A innveng hing pei a akidohchien masang sie a, asiemna thu gen masa pen khu adihin akilang hi."},"18":{"text":"Ai san in kihauna akhawlsah a; mi hatte kikaal akhentan hi."},"19":{"text":"Sanggam kisunua lungdam sahkia khu, kulpi muonhuoi lah sangin ahasa zaw a, akihauna u’zong kulpi kotkhah kilna zawlte bang ahi."},"20":{"text":"Mi’n ama kamham ga akipat agilvana amu a, tualeh akam a athugente gasuo akipat agilva ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Shina leh hinna khu lei sil bawltheina ah a um a, tualeh tuami it pouma in aga ane ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Koipou zi mu in silhoi amu hi, tualeh Mangpa akipat deisahna tang ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi zawng in kam neem zangin azawl zel a, hinanleh mihausaten khautah in a dawng hi."},"24":{"text":"Lawm tamtah nei mi in ama sietna ding abawl a, hinanleh sanggam sanga muonhuoi zaw lawm zong a um hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi zawng adihna toh gamta mi khu, mimo thusie gen sangin ahoizaw hi."},"2":{"text":"Tualeh theina neilou hinna ahoi sih a, tualeh kalsuon kinawten lampi azui khiel uhi."},"3":{"text":"Mihing motna in agamtat asesah a, alungtang Mangpa tungah akiphin hi."},"4":{"text":"Hausatna in lawm tampi asiem a, mi zawng pen alawm nangawn in ataisan hi."},"5":{"text":"Theipitu dihlou khu gawtlou in a um sih dinga, tualeh zuou thu gen pouma asuohta sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi tampi in vaihawm mi deisahna asui a, tualeh koipou sil thawnpieh pe mi adingin, michin alawm ahi zel uhi."},"7":{"text":"Mizawng pen asanggamte zousie nangawn in amuda ua, alawmten gamlapi ah akihepmangsan sem ding uhi! Kampha toh maute anuadel vangin anuasie ua, ataisanta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Koipou pilna mu in ama hinna a it a, tualeh theisiemna kemching miin sil hoi amu ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Theipitu dihlou pen gawtlou in a umsih dinga, zuouthu gente amangthai ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi mo adingin nuomtat akilawm sih a, Suoh khat in leengtapate tunga, avaihawm khum ding akilawmmo zawsem ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Alunggelsiemna in mi alungthah ha sah a, tualeh tatkhelna mumo akipan pen athupina ahi."},"12":{"text":"Leengpa lungthahna khu humpibahnei hawh bang ahi a, hinanleh adeisahna khu hampa tunga daitui kia bang ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tapa mo khu apa adinga vangsietna ahi a, tualeh zi hangsan phunhat khu intung ke a guotui tahkhie bang ahi."},"14":{"text":"Inn leh hausatna pen pate akipat a gou kiluo sawn ahi a, hinanleh lunggelsiem zi pen Mangpa a hing kipan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Thasietna in mi nuomtahin a imu sah a, tualeh mi thasie in gilkiel a thuoh ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Koipou thupieh kemchingin ahinna akembit a, hinanleh agamtatna simmaw mi khu ashi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Koipou mi zawngte hepi miin, Mangpa leitawisah ahi a, asilpiehte Mangpa’n adinkia teitei ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Lam etna a umlai in na tapa thunun inlen, amangthai mai dingin ngaituo sin."},"19":{"text":"Mi lungthah bai in gawtna athuoh dinga, aziehpen va hundoh nanlachin, na hutdoh kia teitei angai ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Lemguotna ngaikhie inlen thuhilna zuiin, na hinkhuo nukhia lam ah na pil law ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihing lungsim ah tupna tampi a um a, ahivangin Mangpa deilam bou atangtung ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mihingin alunggul pen hepina ahi a, mi zuouthei hi sangin mi zawng hi ahoizaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Mangpa giinna in hinna atun a, tualeh hinna nei mi sungah lungkimna aumden dinga, silhoilou in ama ave ngai sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi thasie in akhut hengkuong sungah adie a, akam nangawn atuntou ngap sih hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi simmawhat khat satthop lachin, mi mawl ahing pilvang dinga, theisiemna nei mi phawhhil lachin, sie leh pha theina a nei ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Koipou apa bawlsie a, anu delmang mi khu zumna leh minsietna umsah tapa ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ka tapa sil bawlkhiel dinga, pilna thuhilna ngaikhieh tawpsan in."},"28":{"text":"Theipitu dihlou in vaihawmna dih asimmaw a, migilou kam in thulimlouna anawmval hi."},"29":{"text":"Thukhenna khu mi simmawhatte a dinga, guonggal masah ahi a, tualeh mi mote elduongah zepna chieng atu ngei ngei ding hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zu in mi azawnkhaw vagiap a, zuchia dawn pen kihau kikohna ahi a, koipou zu in apuisiet pouma mipil ahisih hi."},"2":{"text":"Leengpa lungthahna khu humpibahnei hawh bang ahi a, Koipou ama phin lungthah mi in ama hinna abawlkhiel hi."},"3":{"text":"Kihau kiselna lah a kihemkhe thei mi khu mizatat huoi ahi a, hinanleh mi mo pouma kihau kiselna ah akikumthaw paipai uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mi thasie in phalbi vawt ziehin lou ahou ngap sih dinga, tuaziehin pawltah chiengin khut adaw dinga, bangma anei sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing lungsim a tup leh ngimte khu tuili thuh banga vei ahi a, theisiemna nei mi in tuate apholdoh ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi tamzaw in amauh hoina chiet gen in akiphat ua, hinanleh mi gin umtah tah koi in amudoh thei diei?"},"7":{"text":"Midihtat ama dihna bangin agamta a, ama nua ah atate ahampha uhi."},"8":{"text":"Thukhenna leengtoupha tunga tou leengpa’n, sil hoilou zousie amit in athemangta hi."},"9":{"text":"Koi ahiei: “Ka lungtang ka susiengthou a, ka khelna apat in ka siengthouta,” chithei ding?"},"10":{"text":"Tena kibanglou leh buhna kibanglou, ani in Mangpa’n akidah hi."},"11":{"text":"Naupang nangawn asilbawl ah ami hin zie akithei a, anasep siengthou leh dih akithei hi."},"12":{"text":"Khozahna bil leh khomuna mit, ani in Mangpa bawl ahi."},"13":{"text":"I mut khela sin, tuachilou in na zawnlaw kha ding hi, na mit hah sah in ann neh na nieng ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Van lei miin, tami hoisih,” bangma ding hisih chinapi, apeinua chiengin akisahtheipi hi."},"15":{"text":"Sana a um a, rubi suongmanpha tampi um nanleh, pilna kam khu gou manpha zaw ahi nalai lai hi."},"16":{"text":"Theingailou mikhuol a dinga, mawpo dinga kipe mi puonsil la inlen, tualeh numei zuoutat a dinga, mawpuohna kichiemna khu ama apat in la in."},"17":{"text":"Lepchiete lawdoh ann mihing adingin atuise a, hinanleh anuachiengin akam ah suonghum adim ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tupleh ngim pouma thuhilna hoitah toh suhdet ahi a, tualeh piltah a lemguotna toh gal dou ahi."},"19":{"text":"Koipou thuginalou gen a vahkawi miin thuguh ava gendohvade a, tuaziehin mi kamtam toh kigop sin."},"20":{"text":"Koipou apa ahiei, anu ahiei, hamsiet pouma miel kiingkin lah ah, athaumei akimut mit pieh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A kipat chiil a gou kintah a kimute pen, atawpah hamphatna ahisih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tam silhoilou ka thuh ding hi” chi sinlen, Mangpa ngahzaw in, Aman ang hundam na ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tena suong kibanglou Mangpa adingin kidahhuoi ahi a, Tualeh khaina dihlou ahoi sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Mihing kalsuonte Mangpa a ahi a, mihingin ama kalsuon bang achi theisiem thei diei?"},"25":{"text":"Mihinga dingin “Asiengthou” hina chia kipumpieh pai khu, thang ahi tualeh kichiemnate nua dohchien kia zel zong."},"26":{"text":"Leeng pil in migiloute asepkhie a, tualeh bu vuohna leengpei atung uah ahuol sah hi."},"27":{"text":"Mihing lungsim pen Mangpa meivah ahi a, Asunggil tawng lah nangawn asui kawi hi."},"28":{"text":"Khotuona leh thutahin leengpa akembit a, tualeh aleengtoupha zong khotuona a tunding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Tangvalte thupina khu ahatna uh ahi a, tualeh tehsete kilawmna khu asamkang uh ahi."},"30":{"text":"Satna maliem in gitlouna asiengsah a, tuabanga zepna in lungsim tawng thuh, pente zong a sieng sah hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa lungtang Mangpa khut ah a um a, Aman luituite bangin adeina lam lamah ahei kawi hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihing umdan pouma amitmu in a dih a, hinanleh Mangpa’n lungtang a en hi."},"3":{"text":"Kithoina sangin dihtatna leh, thudihna Mangpa a dingin apomtah zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Mit sang ha, lungtang kiliensah leh, migiloute meivah khu khelna ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mithanuom tupna in hausatna atun tahpi a, hinanleh mikinaw pialpual in zawnna atun hi."},"6":{"text":"Lei zuouthei toh kimu goute pen, tuihu leengmang pai bang leh shina thang ahi."},"7":{"text":"Migiloute thagum suona in amauh asumang ding hi, amaun vaihawmna dih apom nuom lou zieh un."},"8":{"text":"Mikhielte lampi asiein akawi a, hinanleh misiengthou nasep pen adih hi."},"9":{"text":"Numei hangsan khat toh inn khat a tenkhawm sangin, inntung vum ning khat a tangten ahoizaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Migilou lungtangin gitlouna alunggul a, a innveng nangawn in amitmu ah deisahna amu sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Misimmawhat akigawt chiengin mimawlten apillaw ua, mipil akithuhil chiengin theina anga belap uhi."},"12":{"text":"Adihtat Pasian in, migilou innsung pilvang tahin angaituo a, agitlouna ziehun migiloute aphietmang hi."},"13":{"text":"Mizawngte kaana zalou dinga abil hum pouma, ama mama zong aka hun a um ding a, koiman aza sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Simthama silthawnpieh in lungthahna adaisah a, simthama kiguhgolna in thangpaina adaisah hi."},"15":{"text":"Thudih a nasep khu midihte kipahna ahi a, hinanleh khelna nasemte tungah sietna atung ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Theisiemna lampi apata vahmang mi pen, mi shite kikhopna ah akhawl ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Koipou nopsahna khela khu migenthei ahi ding ua, koipou zu leh sathau ngaina pouma, ahausa ngai sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Migilou khu midihtat tatna man ahi ding a, tualeh mi muonhuoilou zong midih a dingin, tatna man ahi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Numei hangsan leh phunhat toh tenkhawm sangin, gamdai a tangten ahoizaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Mipil tenna ah gou leh sathau lunggul ding a um a, hinanleh mi moten anekhawng zel uhi."},"21":{"text":"Koipou dihtatna leh hepina zui mi in, hinna dihtatna leh zatatna amu uhi."},"22":{"text":"Mipil khu mihatte khopi kulbangah akal a, amuon mama uh kulpi asuhchip pieh hi."},"23":{"text":"Koipou akam leh alei venghoi mi in, buoina a kipat ahinna akembit hi."},"24":{"text":"Ki uongsah leh kisatheimi min khu, “Misimmawhat” akichi hi. Aman ki uongsah leh kisathei tah in nna asem hi."},"25":{"text":"Mithasie pen alunggulna in ama athat a, Aziehpen akhut in nna asem nuom sih hi."},"26":{"text":"Sun nitum in huoiham tahin mi neisa adeigaw a, hinanleh midihtat in apie a, kheet anei sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Migilou kithoina akidahhuoi a, lungsim gilou pum a ahing tawi chiengin, akidahhuoi zawsem hi."},"28":{"text":"Theipimi dihlou khu amangthai dinga, hinanleh athugen na zapa’n tawplou in agen ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Migilou in amai akhausah a, hinanleh midih in, aumdante abawl hoi hi."},"30":{"text":"Mangpa douna dingin, pilna ahiei, theisiemna ahiei ahisihleh lemguotna a um sih hi."},"31":{"text":"Sakol pen kidouna ni chienga dingin chilsa in akikoi a, hinanleh guolzawna pen Mangpa a ahibou hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hausatna thupitah sangin min hoi tel zawh ding ahi a, tualeh sana leh dangka sangin, ittah a deisahna tel zawh ding ahi."},"2":{"text":"Mihau leh mi zawngten kikop khat anei ua, Mangpa khu amaute zousie siempa ahi."},"3":{"text":"Mipil in silhoilou amu masa a, akiphuolmang hiau hi, hinanleh mi mawlten aphusuoh tentun ua, athuohlaw zel uhi."},"4":{"text":"Kingaingiemna leh Mangpa giinna khu, hausatnate, zaumnate leh hinna ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mitatsete lampi ah ling leh khaute leh thangte a um a, ama hinna kemsiem mi in tuate gamlapi ah apel ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Naupang apeina ding lampi ah chil in, a upat dongin zong tuate akipat in apeimang sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihauten mi zawngte tungah vai ahawm ua, tualeh mi sum leitawite asum leitawinapa suoh in apang hi."},"8":{"text":"Koipou thulimlouna haichi tu miin lunggimna a at dinga, tualeh alungthahna chieng alawsam ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Koipou silphal mi khu guolzawl in a um ding a, aziehpen aman mi zawngte kungah neh ding apie hi."},"10":{"text":"Misimmawhat notmangdoh lachin kinielna abei dinga, Ahi, kihauna leh kisietna atawp ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Koipou lungsim siengthouna ngaina mi leh, hepina kamnem nei mi khu, leengpa lawm ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa mitten theina akembit a, hinanleh mi gin umloute thugen apaimang hi."},"13":{"text":"“Mithasie in innpulam ah humpibahnei a um a, gawlzing ah hing na that khava,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Numei thangtat kamsuo khu leihawm thuhtah ahi a, koipou Mangpa’n ahuot mi khu, tua leihawm sungah akesuh ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Motna khu Naupang lungtang ah kanlawm in a um a, bawlhoina chiengin tuami gamlapi ah ahawlmang ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Koipou ahausatna belapna dinga, mizawngte nuoisie leh, mihaute kunga pieh belap mite khu, ahing tasam ngeingei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mipilte thugen ah na bil daw inlen ngaikhiein, ka theina ah na lungtang pie in."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen na lungtang sunga na kep hoi a, na kam a mansa a na koi leh mi hampha na hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na muonna Mangpa ah ahitheina dingin, tuni in nangma mama ka hing thuhil hi."},"20":{"text":"Thuhilna leh theina a silhoi pente, na kungah ka hing gelpieh hilou ahiei mah?"},"21":{"text":"Nang hing sawlmite thudihtah a na dawn theina dinga, thutah leh thudih thuhilnate ka hing gelpieh hilou ahiei mah?"},"22":{"text":"Mi zawngte azawn man un suom sin, ahisihleh kulpi kotkha a genthei thuohte bawlse sin."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n amauh tungtang thu agen pieh dinga, tualeh amauh suom mite hinna asuom ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi lungthah hatte lawm in nei sinlen, mi lungpheng toh zong kigop sin."},"25":{"text":"Tuachilouin ama gamtat zui kha vachin, na hinna thangkam na hikha ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Midang dinga mawpuo a kichiem in pang sinlen, Leibat thu a mawpuo in zong pang sin."},"27":{"text":"Pieh ding na neilou leh, bang dinga na nuoi a na lupna nangawn ladoh ding ahiei mah?"},"28":{"text":"Na pu leh paten nidanglai a ana phusa gamgi chiemtena khin sin."},"29":{"text":"Mi anasep nalam a siem leh thanuom na mu ei mah? Ama leengpa masang ah adinga, mi maimai masang ah ading sih ding hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vaihawmpa toh annkuong na imkhawm chiengin, na masang a kiluite hoitah in en masa in."},"2":{"text":"Gongsan mi na hileh na lawl ah temta koi in"},"3":{"text":"A ann tuite ngen lunggul seng sin, aziehpen solna ann ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hausat ding lunggulna in semgim seng sinlen, nangma theisiemna a kingah tawp in."},"5":{"text":"A umloupi na mit a enla ding na hiei mah? Aziehpen hausatnaten ama ua dingin, ha akibawl ua, muvanlai bangin van lam ah aleengmang zel uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mi chippongte ann ne sinlen, a anntui zong enla sin."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen ama khu, alungtanga angaituo bang banga um mi ahi a, “Ne inlen dawn in” achi hangin ang deisah tah tah ahi sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Na ann nehsate nangawn na lawkhe kia dinga, na kipah thugente amawhna asuoh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi mokhat zahna ah thugen sin, aziehpen na pilna thugente asimmaw kha ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nidanglai gamgi suong khin sinlen, Pa neiloute gam sungah na gam keh sin."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen amaute tanpa ahat mama a, amaute hum in nang hingdou in apang kha ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Kithuhilna ah na lungtang nga inlen, theina thute ah na bil dawin."},"13":{"text":"Naupang bawlhoina dingin na khut nualah sin, Aziehpen chiengin sat nan lachin ashi vawtsih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Chiengpum toh na zep lachin, Sheol akipat in ahinna na hundoh ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, na lungtang apil leh, Kei lungsim zong akipah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi na kam in thudih agen chiengin, ka lungsim a nuom ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na lungtang in mikhielte eng sih henlen, hinanleh sun nitum in Mangpa giing in."},"18":{"text":"Pellou in huntawpna ahing um dinga, na kinepna suhmangin a um sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, ngaikhie inlen pil in, tuami lampi ah na lungtang pui in."},"20":{"text":"Zu haite lah ah pang sinlen, tualeh mi gongsan a sa nete lah ah zong pang sin."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen zu haite leh gongsante ahing zawng ding ua, imut haiten puonsie asil ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Na pienna na pa thugen ngai inlen, na nu ateh chiengin simmaw sin."},"23":{"text":"Thutah lei inlen zua sin, pilna thuhilna leh theisiemna lei in."},"24":{"text":"Midihtat pa akipah ma ma dinga, tapa pil nei pouma atapa tungah, alungdam mama ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na nu leh na pa kipah uhenlen, nang hing pai na nu lung nuom hen."},"26":{"text":"Ka tapa na lungtang hing pie inlen, na mit in ka lampite en hen."},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen numei kizua khu guomthuhtah ahi a, tualeh numei tavai pen tuikul kochih thuhtah bang ahi."},"28":{"text":"Suomhatte bangin mi abuhdap a, mihingte lah ah gin umlouna akibelap sah hi."},"29":{"text":"Koi ahiei tunggihna nei? Koi ahiei lungkham? Koi ahiei lungkimlouna nei? Koi ahiei phunna nei? Koi ahiei aziehbei a liemna nei? Koi ahiei mit san gegaw nei?"},"30":{"text":"Zu mun henglate, zu bungbuta dawnte ahi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Zu asan kilkel laitah in en sinlen, nou sunga azie akilat lai leh, aluonsuh zieh zieh lai in enla vawt sin."},"32":{"text":"Atawp ah gul bangin mi atu a, gulngan bangin mi atu vagiap hi."},"33":{"text":"Na mit in sil lamdang tahtahte amu dinga, na lungtangin sil kilawmlou agenkhe ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi, tuipi lai tah a lum bang leh, tembaw puonzahna khuom dawn a lum bang na hi ding hi."},"35":{"text":"“Ang vuo ua na kasa sih,” “Ang sat ua ka liem sih,” bangchih chienga khanglou ding a, zu dawn a kuonkia ding ka diei? na chi ding hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Migiloute eng sinlen, amau’toh kigop ding zong lunggul sin."},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen alungtangun thagum a suhsiet atum ua, akam un buoina bawl ding ngen agen uhi."},"3":{"text":"Pilna ziehin inn akilam a, theisiemna toh khumi inn akiphutdet hi."},"4":{"text":"Theina ziehin pindante ah van manpha zousie leh, hausatna lungdamhuoi in adim hi."},"5":{"text":"Mipil khu ahat a, Ahi, theina nei mi’n thahatna akhang sah hi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen thuhilna piltah in gal na dou ding a, tualeh thuhil mi tampi umna ah bitna a um hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi mo adingin pilna asang senga, kulkotpi a kikhopna ah thu gen in akam kaah sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Silhoilou bawl dinga, lung geel pouma thuse bawl mi akichi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi mo lungsim ngaisutna pen khelna ahi a, mi simmawhatte pen mite dingin muda huoi ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Vangsietna nia ba a na pua leh, atha zawngkhal na hi."},"11":{"text":"Shina lam zuon a kikaimangte hunkhedoh inlen, tualeh thadinga kipalpuate nuakai kia in."},"12":{"text":"“En in, tami ka theikha sih uhi na chi pouma leh,” mihing lungtang buh pa’n angaituo sih ding amah? tualeh Ama na hinna kem pa’n tami athei sih ding adiei? Tualeh Ama’n michin anasep dungzuiin athuh sih ding adiei mah?"},"13":{"text":"Ka tapa khuoizu nein aziehpen ahoi ahi, tualeh khuoikhah a khuoizu chiem in ahum ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tuabangma in, pilna theina zong na hinna dingin ahum dinga, tuami na mu chiengin kipahna a um dinga, na lam etna khu suhmang ahi sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Aw migilou, midihtat tenna buhdap sinlen, akhawlna mun zong suhsiet pieh sin."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen midihtat sagivei pua nanleh, athoukia dinga, hinanleh migiloute pen tuohsietna ah a pua ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na melma apua chiengin kipah sinlen, tualeh akipalpua chiengin na lung nuom sah sin."},"18":{"text":"Tuachilouin Mangpa’n ahing mu dinga, alungkim sih kha ding a, ama apat in alungthahna aheimang kha ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Silhoilou bawlte ziehin kisulungkham sinlen, migiloute zong eng tuom sin."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen migiloute a dingin lam et ding bangma aum sih a, ameivah u’zong mutmit ahi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka tapa Mangpa leh leengpa giing inlen, lungsim heng themthumte toh kigop sin."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen avangsietna uh thakhat in ahing umdoh ding a, Amautegel tunga sietna hing tung ding, koi in athei ei?"},"23":{"text":"Tamte zong mipil thugen ahi. Vaihawmna a, deisah tuom nei ahoi sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Koipou migilou kunga, “Mawna na nei sih hi” chi pouma, miten ahamsiet ding ua, namten akidah ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh migilou phawhhilte akipah ding ua, tualeh guolzawlna hoitah atung uah atung ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Dawnna dihtah pe mi muh khu michin in atawp ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Pulam a na nasep guonggal masa inlen, tualeh loulai ah nanga ding toh, kituoh in koimasa inlen, tuazou chiengin na inn lam in."},"28":{"text":"Aziehbei in na innvengte sietna dingin, theipitu in pang sin; Bangzieh a na kam a solna thu, gen ding na hiei mah?"},"29":{"text":"“Ka tunga abawl bangbanga ken zong, ama tunga bawl ding ka hi, chi sin, Anasep dungzui a ama tunga thuh ding ka hi chi sin.”"},"30":{"text":"Mithasepa loulai ka zawt kha ngaita a, theisiemna neilou mipa grep huon ah zong, ka suohkha hi."},"31":{"text":"Loupa in a dep a, loulingnei in akhukhum sieng a, tualeh a imna suong daite achim siengta hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuate ka mutah in hoitah in ka ngaituota hi, tuate ka en a, thuhilna manphatah ka muta hi."},"33":{"text":"Banoukhat imut a, tomkhat lusuh zuol a, tomkhat khut phan a khawldam zuol kaal in,","ref":"Thu. 6.10,11"},"34":{"text":"zawnna khu suomhatte bangin, na tungah ahing tung dinga, tualeh tahsapna in zong, galvan a kivon bangin ahing delpha ding hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tamte zong Juda leengpa Hezekiah miten, ateikhieh uh Solomon thupilte ahi.","title":"Solomon Thupil dangte"},"2":{"text":"Sil im khu Pasian thupina ahi a, hinanleh tua silte suikhieh khu leengpa thupina ahi."},"3":{"text":"Vante sandan, leithuhdan, tualeh leengpa lungtang suiguol ahisih hi."},"4":{"text":"Dangka apat in sam eeh nawtkhie in, tuahileh dangka khengpa’n, manpha tahin akheng thei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Lengpa masanga akipat migilou lakhie in, tuahileh leengtoupha khu dihtatna toh suhdet ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Lengpa mai ah nangma kiphat sinlen, mi thupite dinna mun ah ding sin.","ref":"Luk. 14.8-10"},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen na mitin amusa miliente masanga, koingiem a na um sangin, “Tamlangah hing peitou in hing chileh” ahoizaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi toh kiheh dingin thukhenna lamah nawvah sin, aziehpen atawpna ah na innvengten, hing zumsah khata u’leh bang na lawta diei?","title":"Innvengte toh kinaina dan"},"9":{"text":"Na thubuoi na innveng tawh kimaituo in genkhawm pai unlen, tuami thuguh khu midang kung ah gendoh sin."},"10":{"text":"Khuchilouin na thu zakha tapouin na zumna dingin, agendoh kha ding ua, na minsietna amangmaw kha ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Akituoh cheta thu kamkhat gen khu, dangka bawm sunga sana apple kikoi bang ahi."},"12":{"text":"Taihilna piltah khu mi thumang bil ah, sana bilba bang leh sana siengtah, akipat akibawl kizepna bang ahi."},"13":{"text":"Thangkou gin um khu asawltute a dingin, bu at lai a vua vawt bang ahi a, aziehpen aman apute hinna asuhal zel hi."},"14":{"text":"Silpieh dihlou tah akisahtheipi pouma, meilum guotui pailou leh hui toh kibang ahi."},"15":{"text":"Thuohtheina mama in gam vaihawmpa akizawl lungdam zou a, tualeh kam nemtah in gute asutan zel hi."},"16":{"text":"Khuoizu na mukha ngai ei? Nanga dinga hungiap ne in, na tam neh seng leh ahing ngap ding a na lawkha ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na innvengte inn ah hawmun seng sin, tuachilouin ahing chimtah ding a, ahing muda kha ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A innvengte tunga theipitu dihlou a pang, mi pen khetbuh leh, namsau leh thaltang toh kibang ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hasat lai a, mi gin umlou gintat khah khu, habal leh kenggu kituona kilawi toh kibang ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ada leh lungkham mi kunga la sa mi khu, phalbi vawt laitah a apuon sutkhie leh, zuthua leh tang al halkhawm toh kibang ahi."},"21":{"text":"Na melma agilkiel leh neh ding ann pie inlen, adang ataa leh dawn ding tui pie in.","ref":"Rom. 12.20"},"22":{"text":"Tuabanga na bawl leh alutunga mei-am sung na hi ding a, Mangpa’n nuomman ahing pe ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Mallam hui in guo azusah teitei a, gensietna in lungthahna apiengsah teitei hi."},"24":{"text":"Numei hangsan toh inn lienpi khat a tenkhawm sangin, inntung vum ning khat a ten ahoizaw hi."},"25":{"text":"Gamlapi apat a thupha pen, hinna dangtahte a dinga tui vawt bang ahi."},"26":{"text":"Migiloute zawlzou midihtat khu, tuinah nieh leh tuikhuh nieh toh kibang ahi."},"27":{"text":"Khuoizu tampi neh ahoi sih hi, tuamabangin mi’n ama thupina ding akibawl khu, thupina ahi sih hi."},"28":{"text":"Koipou ama kithunun zoulou pen, khopi chimsa kulbang neilou bang ahi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nipi lai a vua kie leh, bulah lai a guozu akilawmlou bangin, mi mo kunga pahtawina pieh akilawm sih hi."},"2":{"text":"Vatou kitawm kawi kawi leh, sielpaleng leeng kawi kawi bangin, azieh bei a, hamselaw atangtung sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Sakol a dingin zepna, sabiltunga dingin kamkaina, tualeh mi mote elduong zepna ding in chieng ahi."},"4":{"text":"Mi mo amotna dungzui in dawng sin, Nang zong ama bang na hikha ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi mo amotna dungzui in dawng in, ahisihleh apil in akingai kha ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Koipou mi mo khut a thuvaihah poumain, akeng asattan a, sietna adawn hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi mo kam a pawtdoh paunahte pen, mi kengbai kikhai nilnel toh kibang ahi."},"8":{"text":"Mi mo khat kunga zatatna pe pouma khu, suongtang saili toh khauzam a kaan khawm bang ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mi mo kam a pawtdoh paunah khu, zukham khut loulingnei in asut bang ahi."},"10":{"text":"Mi vahvai leh mi mo nasem dinga guoikha pouma pen, thalkap siemmi liemsah toh kibang ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ui in ama luoh aneh kia bangin, mi mo in amotna anua bawlkia zel hi.","ref":"2 Pet. 2.22"},"12":{"text":"Mi ama leh ama apil a kingai na mu kha ngai ei? ama a kipat sangin mi mo a kipat in kinepna aum zaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi thasie in lampi ah humpibahnei a um a, kholai dungah “Humpibahnei giinhuoi tah a um hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Kotkha kopza tunga akihei kawikawi bangin, mithasie alupna tungah akihei hei hi."},"15":{"text":"Mithasie in annkuong sung akhut in asohsuh a, akam ah akhut a tuttou ngap nawn sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi thasie khu ama ngaiin, piltah a dawng thei mi sagi sangin pil akisa zaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Midangte kihauna va tuohkha a va kikumthaw mi khu, ui vahlai abil a kiman bang ahi."},"18":{"text":"Shi theina meisel leh, thal mawhkap lungsim venglou mi khu,"},"19":{"text":"a innvengte a sol zou chienga, “Ka chiemmuina chi mi toh kibang ahi.”"},"20":{"text":"Singkhuo umlouna ah mei amit a, tuamabangin gensietna thu zong, agensawn mi umlouna ah kihauna atawp hi."},"21":{"text":"Meihol khu mei aam sah dingin, singkhuo khu mei kuongsah ding ahimabangin, mi phunsie in kihauna apiengsah ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mi gensiet hatte thugen khu hima toh kibang ahia, mihing tahsa sungah thuhtah in alutsuh thei hi."},"23":{"text":"Lungtang gilou kam zol mi pen, leibel dangka tui a kiluonkhum bang ahi."},"24":{"text":"Mi muda senga lungsim tahtah genlou a, akam a kilep mi lungtang pen, lepchie na in adim hi."},"25":{"text":"Thu kilawmtah agen vangin ama gingta sin, alungtang sungah kidahhuoi sagi a um hi."},"26":{"text":"A mimudana khu lepchiena in liekhu nanleh, agitlouna khu mipi kikhawmte mai ah, suhlat in a um ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Lei hum tou pouma atawsa lei hum sungah, ama mama ake dinga, tualeh suongtum lia pouma, asuongtum in ama adeng ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Lei zuoutheiin ama liemsahte a muda a, tualeh maitangphatna kam in zong mi asusie hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zing chienga ding thu ah kisathei sin, aziehpen tua ni in bang ahiei ahing, suohpi ding chi na thei sih hi.","ref":"Jak. 4.13-16"},"2":{"text":"Nangma kam in kiphat sinlen, midangin hing phatzaw hen, nangma muhin kiphat sinlen, meltheilou mi khat in hing genphazaw heh."},"3":{"text":"Suongtum agih a, senel zong, agih a, tuate gel sangin mi maw khat lungthahna agihzaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Thangpaina atatsie a, lungthahna zong asitsie hi; hinanleh thangsietna masanga koi ahiei ding thei ding?"},"5":{"text":"Aguuh a ki itna sangin alangtanga kiphawh ahoizaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Lawm hoitah apat liemna khu aginum a, hinanleh melma khat in a hing tawp leh ang leh bawl nop man ahi."},"7":{"text":"Agilva mi a dingin khuoizu nangawn akidahhuoi a, hinanleh agilkiel mi a dingin, akha nangawn ahum hi."},"8":{"text":"A innsunga kipat a vahthap mi pen, vaa abu sunga kipat a leengmang toh kibang ahi."},"9":{"text":"Sathau namtui leh gimnamtui in lungsim asunuom a, tuamabangin lungtang tahtah a hing, kuondoh lawmhoi thuhilna hoiin alawm asulung nuom hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma lawm leh na pa lawm taisan sinlen, vangsietna na tuoh ni in na unaupa inn ah va haw sin, gamlapi a um sanggampa sangin, innveng kinaipi ahoizaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka tapa pil inlen, ka lung nuomsah in, tuachi’n kei hing gensete ka dawng thei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi lunggelsiemten mailam hun a silhoilou amu masa a, akihemkhe thei hi; mi mawl in aphusuoh teitei a, gawt in a um zel hi."},"13":{"text":"Meltheilou gamdang mi a dinga, mawpo dinga kichiem mi puonsil lah pieh inlen; numei thanghuoi a dinga mawpo dinga, kichiem ahi leh akichiemna sum dingin koi in."},"14":{"text":"Mi koi in zong zingkhangpi a, a innveng awngaitah a kikou a aguolzawl leh gausapna a, kisim ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Guochiin ni a inntung ke leh, numei hangsan phunsie akibang hi."},"16":{"text":"Koipou amanu kham pen hui kham toh kibang ahi a, akhut ziet lam a sathau luongkhie khaam toh kibang giap ahi."},"17":{"text":"Sia in sia atathiem thei bangin, mihingin alawm mel ahiemsah hi."},"18":{"text":"Theikung kemhoi mi in aga ane dinga, tuabangma in apu kemching mi in pahtat alaw ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tui a mel akimu bangin, mihing lungtangin ama mihin zie akilang sah hi."},"20":{"text":"Mishikhuo leh gawtmun in hun chi anei ngai sih a, tuabangma in mihing mitten zong tai hun anei ngai sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Suhsiengna bel khu dangka a ding ahi a, tualeh tumphuolpi khu sana suhsieng na ding ahi, tualeh mihing pen midangten pahtatna dungzui un akize et hi."},"22":{"text":"Bu suhna sum sunga mi mokhat suh a na suh hangin, amotna toh na kikhen sah zou sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na belam honte umdan theichien dingin, thanop suo inlen, tualeh na ganhonte hoitahin kem in."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen hausatnate kumtawn a ding ahisih a, Lenglukhu zong akhang akhanga umden ding ahisih hi."},"25":{"text":"Bupawl puohkhiet a aum chiengin, loupa noute
