ahing khangdoh a, tualeh muoldawn a hampate lahkhawmin a um hi."},"26":{"text":"Belamnouten na puonsil ding ahing pe dinga, tualeh kelten na lou man ding."},"27":{"text":"Tuaban ah na neh ding leh na innkuonpite neh dingin, kelpi nawitui kichingtah na nei dinga, tualeh na innsunga nasem numeite a dingin, kichingtah na nei nalai ding hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Migilou pen koima dellou in atai a, hinanleh midihtatte pen humpibahnei bangin ahangsan uhi."},"2":{"text":"Gamsung tatkhelna ziehin vaihawm mi tampi lal in apang ua, hinanleh theisiemna leh theina nei khat ziehin, tua gam adin sawtlaw ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi zawngte bawlsie mizawng khu, neh ding bangma nuasie neilou a, haichigate tawmang sieng guo toh kibang ahi."},"4":{"text":"Koipou dan taisanten migiloute apahtawi ua, hinanleh dan zuimite’n amaute akal uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mi hoilouten vaihawmnadih atheisiem sih ua, Mangpa suiten vang sil zousie atheisiem uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mi hausa umdan dihlou tah a gamta sangin, mi zawng dihtah a gamta ahoizaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Dan zuikim mi pouma tapa pil ahi a, mi gongsante toh kigop miin apa azumsah hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi koipou aneisa tunga sumpung del a, dihloutah a asum supung mi in, migenthei khotuo mi a dinga sum kholpieh ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mi koipou dan zui utlou a abil lehei pouma, athunget nangawn kidahhuoi ahi."},"10":{"text":"Midihtat sietna lampi a peimang sah pouma, ama hum tawsa ma ah akesuh dinga, hinanleh genbanglou mi hoiin, Gou hoitah atang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihausa khu ama ngaidan in pil akisa a, hinanleh mi zawng theisiemna nei miin, ama asuikhedoh zel hi."},"12":{"text":"Midihtatte a lungnop chiengun thupina nasatah a um a, hinanleh migilou alet chiengin mite akibu hi."},"13":{"text":"A khelna im mi pouma alawching ngaisih dinga, hinanleh akhelnate kipuongkhie a, tawpsan mi in khotuona amu ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Zatattham ching a um zing mi a hampha hi, hinanleh alungtang khausah mi tungah vangsietna atung ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi zawngte tunga vaihawm migilou khu, humpibahnei hawh bang leh vompi hang mi del toh kibang ahi."},"16":{"text":"Theisiemna tasam vaihawm mi khu, nasatah a mi sugenthei ahi a, hinanleh huoihamna huoin adam sung asusau ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Koipou mi sisan suo ding puohgih a nei mi khu, kokhuh ah atailut ding a, koiman hou sih heh."},"18":{"text":"Koipou dihtah a gamta pouma hundam in a um ding a, hinanleh agamtatna zousie a, letat pouma thakhat in apua ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama lou kihaw pouma in neh ding ann ahau dinga, hinanleh koipou pannabeite zui a, taapvahte pen atasam nasa mama ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi ginum in guolzawlna kiching atang dinga, hinanleh hausat pai ut mi pen, gawtlou in asuohta sih ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi deisah tuom nei ahoi sih hi, aziehpen tanghou themkhat zieh in, mi’n sil abawl khiel thei hi."},"22":{"text":"Koipou kintah a hausat ding tum miin mit hoilou anei a, tualeh tahsapna atung a tung ding angaituokha sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Koipou alei a mi maitang phat hat mi sangin, phawhhil mi in atawp ah deisahna anga zaw ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Koipou anu leh apa neisa tomgam pieh a, “Tami tatsietna hisih chipouma” sietna bawl mite kithuopi ahi."},"25":{"text":"Mi lungtang kiliensah in kihauna apiengsah a, hinanleh Mangpa muong poumate suhhausat in a um ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama kimuong mi khu mi maw ahi a, hinanleh piltah a gamta pouma hutdoh in aum ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Koipou mi zawngte kunga sil pe pouma, atasam sih dinga, hinanleh amauh kimu maw bawl pouma in, gausapna tampi athuoh ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Migiloute ahing khanlet chiengun mite akibu ua, hinanleh amaute amanthai chiengun midihtatte akibelap uhi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Koipou kiphawhhil nanleh, angawng khau sah tei tei mi pen, thakhat a suhmangthai in a um ding ua, suhdam kia thei ahisih ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Mi dihtatten thuneina atan chiengun mipite akipah a, hinanleh migilouten vai ahawm chiengin, mite thumlemau in a um uhi."},"3":{"text":"Pilna it mi in apa alungdam sah a, hinanleh kizuate toh kigop miin aneisa teng azangbei zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Thudih a vaihawm leengpa’n agamsung asudet a, hinanleh golguhna lapa’n agam asusie hi."},"5":{"text":"A innveng maitangphat miin, ama keng awhna dingin lenthang akizah hi."},"6":{"text":"Migilou ama tatkhelna thangah awh a, hinanleh midihtatin la asa a akipah hi."},"7":{"text":"Midihtat in mi zawngte tungtang angaituo pieh a, hinanleh migilou in tuabang theisiemna theina anei sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi simmawhatten khopi pumpi thang ah a awsah ua, hinanleh mipil in pen lungthahna aheimang hi."},"9":{"text":"Mipil in mi mo khat akinielpi leh, tua mi mopa lungthah in, ahisihleh nuitaleh zong kilemna a um tuom sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Sisan suo dinga dangtah in midih mawnabei amuda a, hinanleh midih in ahinna hoina ding asui pieh hi."},"11":{"text":"Mi mo in alungsim zousie agendoh a, hinanleh mipil pen a ki ip thei hi."},"12":{"text":"Vaihawmpa khat in zuou thu angaisah leh, anasemte zousie agilou sieng ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mi zawng leh mi simmawhat in kikop khat anei ua, Mangpa’n ani un khovah khomutheina mit ape tuoh tuoh hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi zawngte thudih a vaihawm pieh leengpa, mangtoupha kumtawn a sudet in a um ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Thununna chiengin pilna apie a, hinanleh naupang kihazan in anu amaizum sah hi."},"16":{"text":"Migiloute atam sem sem leh, gamtat khelna atam sem sem a, hinanleh midihtatte’n a puana uh amu ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na tapa bawlhoina ah thuzawlechin, ang tawldam sah dinga; Ahi na hinkhuo anuom sah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Kilahna mulouna ah mipite amangthai a, hinanleh dan zui mi pen ahampha hi."},"19":{"text":"Thu a kihilna maimai in suoh khat akibawlhoi thei sih hi; aziehpen theisiem nanleh azui tuomsih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Kamlawp tah a thugen mi na mu ngai ei? tua mipa sangin mi mopa khat a dingin, kinepna a umzaw hi."},"21":{"text":"Asuohpa khat aneu apata hawmthaw tah a kemhoi miin, atawp ah atapa bangin amapa anei khong ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mi lungthah bai mi in kihauna apiengsah a, tualeh mi lungtom in bawlkhel ahau hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi khat akiletsahna in angiemsah dinga, lungsim a kingaingiem mi pouma in pahtatna anga ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Guta toh kizopna nei pouma in ama hinna nangawn ahuo a, akichiem hangin thutah agen tuomsih hi."},"25":{"text":"Mihing giinna in thang asiem a, hinanleh Mangpa muongte abit ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Mitampiten vaihawmpa deisahna asui ua, hinanleh mihinga dinga vaihawmnadih pen, Mangpa a hing kipan ahi bou hi."},"27":{"text":"Midihloute pen midih a dingin kidahhuoi ahi a, agamtat a dihtatte pen migiloute a dingin kidahhuoi ahi hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakeh tapa Agur thute, agenlawhna thute ngel: Tam mipa’n Ithiel kung ah leh Ukal, kungah thu aphuongkhie hi.","title":"Agur thupilte"},"2":{"text":"Adihtah in midangteng sangin ka mawlzaw dieh a, tualeh mihingte theisiemna ka nei sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Pilna lah ka zil ngaisih a, asiengthoupa lah kana theikha ngai sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Vantunga kaltou a kumsuh kia khu koi ahiei? akhut sunga hui humthei koi ahiei? Leitung ning tawpna zousie sudetpa koi ahiei? tua mipa min bang ahiei? Tualeh atapa min bang ahiei? Nangman na theichien hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian thu chinteng adih a; Ama muonga belte adingin lum le phaw ahi."},"6":{"text":"Athute belap sin, ahisihleh ahing phawhhil kha dinga, mi zuou na suoh kha ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nanga kipat in sil ni ka hing ngen hi, ka shi masangin tuate hing nelsie pieh sin."},"8":{"text":"Kei akipat in thudihlou leh, zuou thu kigente gamlapi ah koimang inlen, zawng sengin hing koi sinlen, hausengin zong hing koi sin, ni sima ka neh ding khop hing pie in."},"9":{"text":"Hausa seng leng nang ka hing manghil kha dinga, “Mangpa khu koi ahiei ka chikha viel dinga,” zawng seng taleng lah mi neisa ka guhpieh kha dinga, ka Pasian min ka daisah kha ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Suoh khat apu kungah hehse sin, ahing hamsiet kha dinga, ahing kimawsah kha ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Apate uh gausap leh anute uh, guolzawllou khang khat a um uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amauh mitmu a siengthou kisa, hinanleh athanghuoina ua pat a, sawpsieng nailou khang khat a um uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ki-uongsah tah a mit tungha a, amit vunte uh sangsah a vandah ving veng, khangkhat a um uhi."},"14":{"text":"A zawngte leitung apat a valtum ding leh, mite lah apat a tasamte netum dinga, ahate uh namsau bang ahia, ahate uh temta hiem bang mi pawlkhat a um hi."},"15":{"text":"Vot in tanu ni anei a, tuaten “Hing pie’n hing pie’n” chi’n akikou uhi. Lungkim thei ngailou sil thum a um a, Ahi, “Ahunta” chi ngai vawtlou sil li a um hi.","title":"Paunah tuom tuomte"},"16":{"text":"Haankhuh naupaina naubu chiing, tuidu a dangta ngitnget leitang, “Ahunta” chi ngailou mei ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Pate simmawna leh, nute thumanna nuisatna mitte khu, phaijang va-ah ten akheupieh dinga, langta nouten ane ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Keima’n lamdang seng ka sah sil thumtah aum hi; tualeh ka thei zoulou sil li apha hi."},"19":{"text":"Vanlaizawla muvanlai lenna lampi, suongpi tunga gul lampi, tualeh tuipi tunga tembawh peina lampi leh, nungah leh tangval ki itna lampi."},"20":{"text":"Aangkawm numei gamtatna tambang ahi; ane a anehzou in anephu asia sienga, “Sildihlou bangma kabawl sih hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Sil thum ziehin leitung akiling a, tualeh athuoh zoulou sil li a um hi."},"22":{"text":"Suoh khat leengpa ahing pan chiengin, mi mo annkham a um,"},"23":{"text":"Numei mudahuoi in pasal anei chiengin, suohnu khat in api asuon chiengin,"},"24":{"text":"Leitungah sil neu mama hinanleh pil mama li a um hi,"},"25":{"text":"mesite ahat hetlou ganhing hon ahi ua, nipi laiin a ann neh ding uh akholkhawm uhi."},"26":{"text":"Zupite thahatna neivawtlou ganhing ahi ua, suongpi kawm ah inn abawl uhi."},"27":{"text":"Khuongbaiten leengpa anei vateh sih ua, hinanleh ahonhon in akitawl vaduam uhi."},"28":{"text":"Inn ngah khu khut sunga mat thei hinapi in, leengte innpi sungah ateng uhi."},"29":{"text":"Kituoh tah a kalsuon khawm thum apha ua, akalsuon kilawm leh pisuoh mama li a um uhi,"},"30":{"text":"Humpibahnei gamsa lah a hat pen ahi a, bangma mai a tai ngailou ahi."},"31":{"text":"Aa tal kimuongtah, keltal kimuongtah a vah lingliang leh, amipite masanga leengpa’n pitah a akalsuon khu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Mot huoi tah a nangma na kiphat khahleh, ahisihleh sil hoilou na bawl tup leh, nakhut in na kam hum in."},"33":{"text":"Aziehpen bawngnawi tohhal in hot lei, bawngnawi dat ahing suoh a, tualeh nahkuo heh lei nahkuosi aluong hi, tuabangma in kinielna in kihauna apiengsah hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Lemuel thute anu’n ama anahil athugendohte:","title":"Leengpa Lemuel paunahte"},"2":{"text":"Ka tapa bang ahiei? Ka sunga pieng ka tapa bang ahiei? Bang ahiei ka kichiemna tapa?"},"3":{"text":"Na hatna numei kungah pe sinlen, leengte susetute kungah na lampite pe sin."},"4":{"text":"Aw Lemuel, leengte ading hilou, zu dawn khu leengte ading ahisih a, vaihawm mite adingin zuchia dawn ahoi sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Dawnta uleh danthupiehte amanghil ding ua, suhgentheina thuohte a dingin, thudih a vaihawmna akaikawi kha ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mangthai dinga kisate kungah zu chia pie inlen, tualeh milunggimte kungah zu chia pie in."},"7":{"text":"Ama’n dawn henlen azawnna uh manghil uhenlen, agentheina uh thei nawn sih uhen."},"8":{"text":"Hamtheiloute adingin na kam kaah inlen, Ashi dinga kiguotsa mite tungtang thu gen pieh in."},"9":{"text":"Na kam kaah inlen, dihtah in thu khen inlen, mi tasamte leh mi gentheite tungtang thu gen pieh in."},"10":{"text":"Zi umdan hoi koi in amuzou diei, Amanphatna pen Rubi suongmanpha sangin, amanpha zaw tham hi.","title":"Zi hoi"},"11":{"text":"Apasal lungtangin amanu amuong chinten a, phattuomna atasam ngai vawt sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Amanu’n adamsungin apasal a dingin, aselam hilou ahoilam nna asep pieh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amanu’n samul khau leh naikhau asui a, thanuom tahin akhut in lungkimtah in nna asem hi."},"14":{"text":"Amanu khu summet bawlte tembawh bang ahi a, amanu’n gamlapi akipat in ann neh ding, ahing paw zel hi."},"15":{"text":"Khovah masangin amanu athou a, a innkuonte kungah ann apie a, tualeh anasem nungahte ading tanvou apie hi."},"16":{"text":"Amanu’n lou angaituo a, tuakhu alei a, akhut nasep ga in grep huon abawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Thahatna in atai agah a, abantha ahat sah hi."},"18":{"text":"Asummet bawlte ahoi hi chi amu a, zanlai chieng in zong ameivah amit sih hi."},"19":{"text":"A khut in mui azom a, akhutin muitung atu ngitnget hi."},"20":{"text":"A khut migenthei lam ah azah a, Ahi, akhotuona khut in tasamte abanpha hi."},"21":{"text":"Amanu’n a innkuonpite akhuolnain vua kieh ding agiing sih hi; aziehpen a innkuonpite zousie puonlum sandang aguon a asil chiet uhi."},"22":{"text":"Puonpha kilawmtah ama a dingin abawl a, amanu puonsilte puon malngat leh, puonsandup ahi."},"23":{"text":"A pasal gamsunga upate lah a, kulkotkha bula atou chiengin theiphah in a um hi."},"24":{"text":"Amanu’n puon malngatte puonsil in abawl a, tuate azua hi, summet bawlte kungah puon kawnggahte azua zel hi."},"25":{"text":"Thahatna leh zatatnate amanu puonsil ahi a, hun hing tung dingte ah amanu anuom ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amanu’n pilna toh akam akaah a, alei ah hepina dan a um hi."},"27":{"text":"Amanu’n a innkuonpite khohei danding hoitahin akhuol a, thasietna ann a ane ngai sih hi."},"28":{"text":"Atate ahing thou ua, amanu khu hamphanu achi uhi; tualeh apasal in zong amanu hamphanu chi’n apahtawi hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tanu tampiten silhoi ana bawl ua, hinanleh nangman amaute na khup sieng hi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ngai banna pen solhat ahi a, tualeh melhoina zong bangmalou ahi; hinanleh Mangpa giindansiem numei in pahtat alaw ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Akhut nasep gate amanu pie unlen, tualeh khopi kulkotkhate ah amanu nasepte, mama in amanu pahtawi hen."}}}}},"21":{"info":{"name":"Thugenpa","shortname":"Thug.","abbr":[],"desc":"Thugenpa"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem leengpa David tapa thugenpa thute.","title":"Sil zousie bangmalou ahi"},"2":{"text":"Bangmaloute bangmalou, bangkim abawn in bangmaloute bangmalou ahi bou hi chi’n thugenpa’n agen hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihingin nisa nuoi a anasepgimna zousie apat bang alawtaah ei mah?"},"4":{"text":"Khangkhat abei a, khangdang khat ahing um zel a, hinanleh leitung pen angaingai in kumtawn in a umden hi."},"5":{"text":"Ni ahing suoh a, tualeh atum zel hi, tualeh kintah in ahing suohna mun lam atungkia pai hi."},"6":{"text":"Hui khu simlangah alaanga, tualeh mallam a kihei in akiviel tou a, tualeh akuol in alaang kawi kawi a, alaanna lampi ngaima ah a nuakia kia hi."},"7":{"text":"Lui zousie tuipi ah aluonglut a, hinanleh tuipi adim tuom sih hi; luituite ahing kipatna nah lam ah anua luonkie zel uhi."},"8":{"text":"Bangma zousie lunggimna a dim ahia, mihing gen sanga lunggim huoi zaw ahi; mit lah asilmu ah alungkim ngai sih a, ahisihleh bil zong azah ah alungkim tuom sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Ana umsa silte ma hing um kia ding ahi a, a kibawl zousate ma kibawl kia ding ahi, tuazieh in ni nuoi ah bangma atha a um sih hi."},"10":{"text":"“En vawi un,” tami sil tha ahi chi ding a um ei mah? Tamte ni danglai a, eihaw um masanga na umsa ngen ahita hi."},"11":{"text":"Nidanglai a sil masate theizingna a um sih a, ahing um ding hi in, ahing umtou zel dingte nangawn theizingna a um tuom sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei thugenpa Jerusalem a Israelte leengpa kana hita hi.","title":"Pilna sui bangmalou ahi"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh pilna in vannuoi a sil kibawl zousie tungtang sui ding leh theichien dingin ka lungsim kana mangta a, tuachi’n Pasian in tami gimna nasep nasatah khu mihing tate kungah buoipi dingin ana peta hi, chi ka theita hi."},"14":{"text":"Bangkim ni nuoi a kibawl nasep zousie ka muta a, tualeh ngai in, abawn in bangmalou ahia hui nuadel toh kibang giap ahi."},"15":{"text":"Akawisa lah zezang thei ahi nawn sih a, akimlou lah sim thei ahisih hi."},"16":{"text":"Keima leh keima ka kihou a, “Ngai vawi, ka masanga Jerusalem a vaihawma na pangte sangin pilna leh theina ka nei zaw hi,” chi’n ka kingaisut hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 4.29-31"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh pilna thei ding leh motna leh mot gamtatna theina dingin ka lungsim kana zanga, tamte zousie hui nua del bang mai ahi giap hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen Pilna atam sem sem leh gentheina asang sem sem a, tualeh theina atam sem sem leh gentheina atam sem sem hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka lungsim in “Kisa in, nopsahna in ka hing en chien ding, nopsahna in noptaal in,” ka chi a, hinanleh nopsahna zong bangmalou ahi veve hi.","title":"Nopsahna bangmalou"},"2":{"text":"Nuina lah “Mothuoina” ahi giap a, nopsahna in “Bang ahiei alawtah?” ka chita hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihing taten adamsung tomnoukhat sunga vannuoi a abawl ding uh silhoi pen bang ahiei mah, chi ka mu theina dingin, ka lungtang pilna zangin zu a kei leh kei kipah sah tum a ka kingaituo leh, motna tu chinten ka hi dan ka lungtangin asuidohta hi."},"4":{"text":"Na thupitah ka sem a, keima a dingin innte kana lam a, grep huonte ka bawl hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 10.23-27; 2 Khang. 9.22-27"},"5":{"text":"Keima ding huon leh thei huonte ka bawl a, khunah thei kung namkimte ka suon a;"},"6":{"text":"ka theikung suon hing khangdohte tui buohna dingin tuikulte ka bawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Suohnu leh suohpate ka lei a, tualeh ka innsunga pieng suoh dangte zong ka nei hi. Ka masanga Jerusalem a na um zousiete sangin bawnghonte leh belam honte ka hauzaw nalai hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 4.23"},"8":{"text":"Sana leh dangka zong keima dingin ka khawm a, leengte leh gamkaite akipat goute ka lakhawm hi. Mihingte kipahna Pasal leh numei lasa siemte leh tam lasahna vanjah ding tampi zong ka nei hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 10.10,14-22"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka masanga Jerusalem a na um masate zousie sangin ka thupi zaw tham a, ka pilna zong keima toh a um den hi.","ref":"1 Khang. 29.25"},"10":{"text":"Ka mitin alunggul pouma neila ka nei sih a, nopsahna pouma akipat ka lungtang ka tutang sih a, ka sepgimna zousie ah ka lungtang akipah ziehin, tami ka sepgimna kipahman ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka khut a ka sepkhiet zousie leh ka sepgimna zousie ka et chiengin, ngai vawi bangma zousie bangmalou aguohtangpi ahibou a hui nuadel bang giap ahi bou hi. Ni nuoi ah bangma lawtah ding a um sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n pilna, motna leh mot huoinate ngaisut ding in ka lungsim ka hei a, leengpa nua a hing um ding mihingin akibawlsate ban ah, bang bawl thei tuom ding ahiei?","title":"Pilna leh motna bangmalou"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n khomiel sangin khovah ahoi zaw a, motna sangin pilna ahoizaw hi, chi, ka mukheta hi."},"14":{"text":"Mipil mit khu alungtangah a um a, hinanleh mi mo pen miel lah ah avah hi. Hinanleh, sil tung khat poupou ani ua tungah atung hi chi, ka mudohta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka lungsim in keima leh keima ka kihou a, mi mo tunga tung “Bangin kei tungah zong hing tung ding ahi a, bangzieh a kei pil zaw ka hiei?” Ka kichi hi, tuachi’n ka lungsim in, tamte zong bangmalou ahi, ka chita hi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen mipil mi mo sanga kumtawn a thei den zawhna a um tuom sih a, ahing tung ding hun leh nite ah ani ua manghil a um ding ahi uh, chi thei in. Tualeh bangchi dan a mi mo zong mipil bang a shi ahiei?"},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin hinna ka huo hi, ni nuoi a sil kibawl zousie kei a dingin lunggimna ahi ziehin; tuate zousie bangmalou ahi a, hui nuadel bang giap ahibou hi.","title":"Sepgimna bangmalou"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n ni nuoi a ka sepgimna a ka silbawl sate, ka nua a hing um ding midangte nuasie ding ka hi ziehin van nuoi a ka sepgimnate zong ka muda hi."},"19":{"text":"Koi ahiei ka nua a hing um ding khu mipil ahi ding leh, mimo ahi ding thei? Hinanleh ka sepgimna a ka nasep zousie tungah leh ni nuoi a ka kipil sahna zousie vai ahing hawm khum nalai ding hi. Tami zong bangmalou ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin ni nuoi a ka sepgimnate zousie lungkieh huoi sa in ka lungtang ka leheita hi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen mi’n pilna, theina leh siemna toh nna asem a, tuate sem khalou midang khat tanvou dinga a nuasie pieh ding ahi. Tamte zong bangmalou leh nasatah a, hoilou ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mi’n ni nuoi a asepgimna zousie leh alunggimpi akipat bang ahiei anei?"},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen adamsung nite zousie lunggimna leh gentheitah a nasepna tualeh zanlai nangawn in alungsim atawldam sih hi. Tami zong bangmalou ahi.","ref":"Job. 5.7; 14.1"},"24":{"text":"Mi’n asepgimna aneh a, adawn a, tualeh ahinna alungkim sah kaan a hoizaw bangma aum sih hi. Tamte zong Pasian khut a kipat a hing um ahi chi ka mudohta hi.","ref":"Thug. 3.13; 5.18; 9.7; Isai. 56.12; Luk. 12.19; 1 Kor. 15.32"},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen kei sanga ne thei zaw koi ahiei um, ahisihleh koi ahiei kei sanga nuomsa zaw?"},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in ama mitmu a hoite kungah pilna, theina leh, lungnopna apie hi, hinanleh mikhielte kungah pen, Pasian masanga mi hoite kunga apieh theina dinga, lakhawm ding leh kholkhawm dingin sepgimna apie hi. Tamte zong bangmalou leh hui nuadel bang giap ahi.","ref":"Job. 32.8; Thu. 2.6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sil chintenga dingin hun a um chiet hi. Vannuoi a siltup chintenga dingin, hun khat a um chiet hi.","title":"Sil zousie in ama hun a nei chiet hi"},"2":{"text":"Pien hun a um a, shi hun a um hi. Suon hun a um a, Suon sate bawdoh hun a um hi."},"3":{"text":"Tha hun a um a, suhdam hun a um hi. Phekhiet hun a um a, lam hun a um hi."},"4":{"text":"Kaa hun a um a, nui hun a um hi, daa hun a um a, laam hun a um hi."},"5":{"text":"Suongte paimang hun a uma, suongte lahkhawm hun a um hi kikawi hun a um a, kihakhiet hun a um hi."},"6":{"text":"Sil sui hun a um a, mansuo hun a um hi, sil kep hoi hun a um a, paikhiet hun a um hi."},"7":{"text":"Bawkeh hun a um a, khuikhawm hun a um hi. Sip dide hun a uma, ham hun a um hi."},"8":{"text":"Ki it hun a um a, ki muda hun a um hi. Kidou hun a um a, kilem hun a um hi."},"9":{"text":"Na sempa’n asepgimna apat bang phattuomna anei ei mah?"},"10":{"text":"Pasian in mihingte kunga buoipi dinga ana pieh sepgimna khu ka muta hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian in sil zousie ahun chiet ua dinga hoi leh kilawm in asiem a, Aman mihingte lungtang ah tangtawn akoi nalai a, hinanleh achiil apat atawp donga Pasian in abawlte koiman amudoh louna ding in."},"12":{"text":"Mihingte a dingin adamsung ua dinga kipahna leh silhoi abawl uh kaan a hoizaw bangma a um sih, chi ka thei hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh michin in aneh a, adawn a, asepgimna silhoi zousie nuomtah a aman ding ahi; tua khu Pasian silpieh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Pasian in abawl pouma tangtawn a um ding ahi, chi ka thei hi. Bangma akibelap thei sih dinga tualeh bangma akiladoh thei sih ding hi. Mihingten Pasian agiin theina ding ua Aman tambanga abawl ahi, chi ka thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tulaitah a sil umte khu ana um zousa ahi a, ahing um dingte zong ana umzousa ahita hi; Tualeh Pasian in ana umzousate asuidoh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuathamlouin ni nuoi a vaihawmna mun ah gitlouna a um a, tualeh dihtatna umna mun ah thulimlouna zong a um hi chi ka mu hi.","title":"Sil zousie tunga Pasian vaihawmna"},"17":{"text":"Ka lungsim in, Pasian in midihtat leh migiloute tungah thu akhen tuohtuoh ding hi, Aziehpen siltup chinteng leh nasep chintenga dingin hun guotsa um chiet hiven chiin ka geeldoh hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihing tapate tungtang thu ah amauh mama khu gamsa bang bep ahi uh, chi akitheina dingun Pasian in amaute a enchien hi, chi’n ka lungtangin ka ngaisut hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen mihing tapate tunga sil tung khu gamsate tungah zong atung hi; ani ua tungah tawpna kibang atung dinga, khat ashi leh adangte zong ashi hi; abawn un nahna hu kibang anei ua, mihingin ganhing tungah hamphatna anei tuom sih hi; aziehpen sil zousie bangmalou ahibou hi."},"20":{"text":"A bawn un mun khat ah apei ua, abawn un leivui a kisiem ahi ua, abawn un leivui ah a kia kia zel uhi."},"21":{"text":"Mihing hagau tunglam ah apeitou a, gantate hagau lei nuoi langah apeisuh hi, chi koi ahiei athei?"},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin mihing ama nasep a alungkim kaan a hoizaw bangma a um sih, chi ka mukheta hi; aziehpen tua khu ama tanvou ahi a, anua a bang hing um ding ahiei chi, mu dingin ama koiin ahing pui diei?"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka kihei a, ni nuoi a kibawl gentheina zousie ka ngaituo a, suhgenthei a umte hitui ka mu a, hamuon ding mi a nei sih uhi. A langkhat ah amauh sugentheiten thuneina anei ua, suhgenthei a umte’n hamuon ding anei sih uhi.","title":"Mihing gentheina dangte"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh mihing ahing nalaite sangin ana shisa mishite ahampha zaw uhi, chi’n ka ngaituo hi."},"3":{"text":"Amautegel sangin zong apieng nailoute, ni nuoi a silhoilou kibawl mukha nailoute ahampha zaw nalai hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaban ah sepgimna zousie leh, nasep siemna chinteng khu, innvengten a enna zieh a hing piengdoh ahi, chi, ka muta hi. Tamte zong bangmalou ahi a, hui nuadel bang ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mi mo in akhut aphan a, ama tahsa ane hi."},"6":{"text":"Sepgimna toh khut lang ni dim a hui mat sangin, lungmuong tah a khut khat dim nei ahoi zaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka kihei a, ni nuoi a bangmalou ka muta hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi khat lawm le guol neilou amatanga um khat a um hi; Aman tapa leh sanggam anei sih hi; khuchi hinapiin asepgimna in tawp hun anei sih a, amittegel lah ahausatna ah alungkim tuom sih hi. Hinanleh “Koi a dinga semgim a, ka nopsah na ka taanlaw a hiei?” achi ngai tuom sih hi. Tami zong bangmalou ahi a, lunggimna bou ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Khat sangin ni ahoizaw hi. Aziehpen asepgimna uh kipahman hoitah amu uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen khat apua chiengin a lawm in aphong thei hi. Aphong ding neilou a pua mi hepihuoi ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachiengin, mi ni alupkhawm uleh lum asa ua; hinanleh mi khattanga lum in bangchin lum asa thei diei?"},"12":{"text":"Mi khat pen midang khat in zou nanleh; mi ni azou sih ding hi. Tualeh khauhuol zang thum a kiheh zong atan meng meng sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Lengpa tehtah leh, motah thuhilna sang thei nawnlou sangin, tangval genthei leh piltah ahoizaw hi.","title":"Minthan hunsung tomnoukal ahi"},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen suong kul akipat in leeng ding ahing pei a, Ahi, ama gam mama a gentheisa a pieng hinanleh."},"15":{"text":"Ni nuoi a hinna nei vahthei zousie in, leengpa thahenga leenga hing pang ding, tangval ninapa azui uh chi ka muta hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi zousieleh amaute masanga, leeng ana kibawlna mipite tawp chi a um sih hi. Hinanleh anua chienga hing um ding zong miten, akipahpi tuom sih ding uhi. Tami zong bangmalou ahi a, huimut bang giep ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian inn a na haw chiengin, pilvang tah in na kalsuon in; Sil bawlkhiel ahilam uh kitheilou mi mote, kithoina bang kithoina lat sangin, thungaikhe dingin kuon zaw in.","title":"Pasian zatatna"},"2":{"text":"Na kam lawpsah seng sinlen, tualeh Pasian masanga thugen dingin, na lungtang kinawsah sin. Aziehpen vantunga um ahia, nang pen leitunga um na hi, tuaziehin thu gen tawm zaw in."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen mang khu, lunggimna tampite zieh a hing um ahia, tualeh mi mo aw pen athugen tam ziehin akithei hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian kunga thuchiem na bawl chiengin, tangtungsah dingin kihalsah sin; aziehpen Aman mimote ah kipahna anei sih hi; na thuchiem tangtungsah pai in.","ref":"Late. 66.13,14"},"5":{"text":"Thuchiem bawl a tangtunlou sangin, thuchiem bawllou ahoizaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Na kam in na tahsa khielsah sih henlen, tualeh Pasian sawltahte kungah ka thuchiem bawlte, ka bawlkhiel khata hi chi sin. Bangzieh a na kamtengkhat a Pasian lungthah sah a na khut nasep suse ding na hiei?"},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen mang tampi leh thu tampi zong bangmalou ahi. Hinanleh nangman Pasian giingin."},"8":{"text":"Gamsung a mi zawng gentheite suhgenthei leh hiemngamnain thudih leh dihtatna aheimang na mu leh lamdang sa sin, aziehpen Ulienten uliente aveng ua, tualeh amauh sanga sangzaw a um nalai hi.","title":"Hauna bangmalou"},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh zong gamsunga piengte mi zousie a ding ahi a, tualeh leengpa zong agam leitanga piengin akivah hi."},"10":{"text":"Koipou dangka dei mi khu, dangka in alungkim sih ding a, punna tampi toh hausat tumte zong, alung kim ngai sih ding hi. Tami zong bangmalou ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nei leh lam apun chiengin, aneding zong apung zel hi, tualeh aneipa a dingin amit a a et chiloungal, bang phattuomna a um ei?"},"12":{"text":"Ne tawm in ne tam taleh nasem mi a imut anuom a, hinanleh mi hausa pen ahausatna in a imu sah thei sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Ni nuoi a sil hoilou mama ka mu khat a um hi, hausatna khu aneipa a dinga sietna tuntu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh tua hausatnate pen, vangsietna ziehin amangthangta hi; tualeh tapa anei a akhut sungah bangma a um sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Anu gilsunga kipat a saguoh a ahing pien mabangin, saguoh ma in akia kia dinga, asepgimna ga bangma akeng thei sih dinga, akhut in zong bangma atawidoh thei sih ding hi.","ref":"Job. 1.21; Late. 49.17; 1 Tim. 6.7"},"16":{"text":"Tami zong sil hoilou vawt khat ahi, ahing pei bang ngelngel in anua pei kia ding hi. Tualeh hui dinga asepgimna ah, bang alawtah ei?"},"17":{"text":"Adamsung nite zousie ah miellah ah ann ane a, tualeh lunggimna, natna leh, lungthahna toh athuoh nalai hi."},"18":{"text":"En in, ka sil mu khat tami ahi: Pasian in mihinga dinga damsung ni tomnou apieh sunga aneh a, adawn a, ni nuoi a asepgimna a, alungkim leh ama a dingin ahoi ahi. Aziehpen tuami ama tanvou ahi."},"19":{"text":"Pasian in michin kunga hausatna leh nei leh lam apiehte ne ding leh agoutante la dingin, tualeh anasepgimna gate a kipah dingin thuneina apie hi. Tami Pasian silpieh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in tuabang mite lungkimtah a akoitah ziehin, adamsung nite anua suikia sese nawn sih hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni nuoi a ka mu sil hoilou khat a uma, tua sil hoilou khu mihingte adingin agih mama hi.","title":"Hauna ah lungkimna umlou"},"2":{"text":"Mihingte kunga Pasian in hausatna leh nei leh lam leh zatatnate apie a, alunggul pouma bangma tasap anei sih hi. Hinanleh tuate nuomtah a ne dingin Pasian in ama thuneina ape sih a, hinanleh gamdang miten ane khawng zaw uhi. Tami bangmalou leh suhgentheina hoilou ahi."},"3":{"text":"Mi khat in tapa zakhat nei henlen, kum tampi dam in, adam sung kumte tam mama nanleh, ahinna silhoi a lungkim louin, hoitah nangawn a vui alaw sih leh ama sangin ahun lou a apieng naungehte ahampha zaw hi, ka chi ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ama bangmalou in ahing pienga, miellah ah apeimang pai a, amin zong mielin akhu khum hi."},"5":{"text":"Aman ni lah mulou, bangma lah theilou, hitamananleh khatpa sangin aman khawldamna amu zaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Kum tul khat leni dam nanleh, silhoi amu tuom sih leh bang phatuom ahiei? Mi zousie tunna kibang mun khat a pei uh hilou amah?"},"7":{"text":"Mihing sepgimna zousie akam a ding ahia, hinanleh ahinna alungkim thei tuom sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen mipil in mimo sangin, bang phattuomna anei tamzaw a ahiei? Mi zawngin bang anei a, mihing masanga akhohei dan thei migenthei in, bang amu a ahiei?"},"9":{"text":"Lunggulna tapvah sangin, mit a mu thei sil ahoizaw hi. Tami zong bangmalou hui mut bang giap ahi."},"10":{"text":"Sil hing um khat pou khu min phuosa ngen ahi a, mihing ahi chi akithei hi. Ama sanga hatzaw toh akihau thei sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Bangmalou tamsah sil tampi a um hi chi thei in; mihing bang chidan a hoi tuom ahiei?"},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen mihing damsunga dinga hoi koiin athei ei? Ama lah damsung ni tomnou a dinga pannabei limliep banga pei ahi a, ama um nawnlou nua chienga ni nuoi a sil hing um ding koi in mihing ahil thei diei?"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Min hoi khu kinuna sathau gimnamtui, manphatah sangin ahoi zaw a, pien ni sangin shi ni ahoi zaw hi.","title":"Pilna leh motna tekahna","ref":"Thu. 22.1"},"2":{"text":"Pawi bawlna inn a haw sangin, lu suunna inn a haw ahoizaw hi; Aziehpen shina pen mizousie tawpna ahi a, adam nalaiten alungtang uah akoi ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Nuina sangin dana ahoizaw hi, aziehpen lungtanga dingin da mel ahoi zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Mipilte lungtang lu suunna inn ah aum a, mi mote lungtang pen nopbawlna inn ah a um hi."},"5":{"text":"Mimote lasah ngaikhieh sangin, mipilte phawhhilna ngaikhieh ahoizaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen mi mote nui, bel nuoi a ling poh phek phek bang ahi a, tamte zong bangmalou ahi."},"7":{"text":"Adihtah in nuoisiena in mipil ngaisutna asusie a, golguhna in lungtang asesah hi."},"8":{"text":"Sil zousie akipatna sangin atawpna ahoizaw a, kisahtheina sangin dawzawna ahoizaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Lungthah bai dingin na lungsim kinawsah sin, aziehpen lungthahna khu mi mote angsung ah a um hi.","ref":"Jak. 1.19"},"10":{"text":"“Bangzieh a tulai nite sanga, nidanglai nite hoi zaw ahiei?” Chi sin; aziehpen tamte pilvangtah a kanchien na hi sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Pilna khu gouluo tuh a hoi ahi a, ni mute a dingin phattuomna aum hi."},"12":{"text":"Dangka sum kiven bitna ahi bangin, pilna zong kivenbitna ahi. Hinanleh theina hoidan ahileh, pilnain ama neimite, hinna apie hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian nasep ngaituo in, Aman akawi a abawlsa, koiin abawl tang thei diei mah?"},"14":{"text":"Lawchin ni chiengin kipah inlen, Hinanleh vangsiet ni ahing tun chiengin tami ngaituo in, Pasian in khat abawl bangin adang zong abawl hi. Tuachia mihingin anua a sil hing um ding, bangma amu theilouna dingin."},"15":{"text":"Ka damsung nite bangmalou sungah, silzousie ka na muta a, midih adihtatna abeimanga, tualeh migilou agitlouna toh adamsung suhsau in a um hi."},"16":{"text":"Kidihtatsah seng sinlen, kipil sah seng sin, bangdinga nang leh nang kisuse ding na hiei mah?"},"17":{"text":"Gilou seng sinlen kimosah seng sin; Bangzieh a na hun tun masanga shi ding na hiei mah?"},"18":{"text":"Tami na tuhdet chinten ahoi hi, adang zong hasuolou ahoi hi. Aziehpen Pasian giing pouma, tuate zousie akipat in asuohta ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Khopi sunga vaihawm sawm sangin, pilna in mi asuhat zaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen silhoi bawla khiellou, midih khat zong leitungah a um sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi thugen zousie na lungtang ah vom sin, na suohin ang hamsietna na zakha ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen nang zong midangte tamveipi na hamsietta hi, chi nangman zong na lungtangin na thei leng hi."},"23":{"text":"Pilna zangin tamte zousie kana enchienta hi; “Pil tavang” ka chi a, hinanleh kei bawlthei guol ahisih hi."},"24":{"text":"Bangteng hitaleh pilna pen agam a gamla, athuh a thuh ahi a, koi in amudoh thei diei?"},"25":{"text":"Pilna leh sil zousie hing umna azieh, theichien ding leh suikhe dingin ka lungsim ka zangta a, gitlouna mothuoi dan leh, motna ngolhuoi dan theikhe ding in zong, ka lungtang ka zang ta hi."},"26":{"text":"Shina sanga khazaw sil ka mu pen, numei lungtang thang leh len kikamsa ahi a, akhutte khu siakol bang mai ahi; koipou Pasian kipahsah mi khu amanu apat asuohta dinga, hinanleh mikhielte pen mat in aum, ding hi."},"27":{"text":"En vawi, tami ka mudoh ahi, thugenpa’n achi hi. Sil zousie ahinatah azieh mukhe dingin, khat khat in ka suichien hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuakhu ka hinna in asui nalai a, hinanleh ka mu sih hi. Mi tul khat lah ah pasal khat ka muta a, hinanleh amaute zousie lah ah numei khat zong ka mu sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Adihtahin ka mukhiet sun tami ahi. Pasian in mihing adih in abawl a, hinanleh amaun bawlthu tampi asuikhie uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Koi ahiei mipil toh kibang? Tualeh silte hilchiena thei koi ahiei? Pilna in mihing mel ataang sah a, Tualeh amaigumna akiheng sah hi.","title":"Vaihawmte thu man ding"},"2":{"text":"Ka hing hil ahi: Pasian kunga na kichiemna ziehin, leengpa thupieh zui in."},"3":{"text":"Leengpa mitmu apat pawtkhe dingin kinaw seng sin, sil hoilou lam hum in pang tei tei sin, aziehpen aman a ut pouma abawl zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Leengpa thu umna phot ah, sil bawltheina a um hi. Koiman akungah “Bang ahiei na bawl?” achi thei sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Thupieh zui poumaten silhoilou atheikha sih dinga, tualeh mipil lungtangin hun leh vaihawmna atheikhen zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen mihing lunggimna atungah nasatah in kibelap nanleh, sil zousie in ama hunbi leh vaihawmna anei chiet hi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen bang hing um ding ahiei chi aman athei sih hi. Tuaziehin sil hing tung ding koiin ama ahil thei diei?"},"8":{"text":"Hagau hentang dinga hagau thuneina nei koima a um sih a, shi niin zong koiman thuneina anei sih hi. Galdou sungin khawl a um sih a, gitlouna in gitlouna bawl mite asuohta sah sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ni nuoi a sil kibawl zousie ngaituoin lungsim ka senga, tamte zousie ka mu hi; mihingin ama sietna ding bepin midang tunga athunei hun a um hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n migiloute ki vui ka mu zel a, amaute mun siengthou a haw a peikiate ahi ua, silgilou abawlna khopi miten amanghilta uhi. Tami zong bangmalou ahibou hi."},"11":{"text":"Tatsietna tunga gawtna kitungsah pailou ahi ziehin mihingte lungtang khu silgilou bawl ding in ama uah suhat in a um hi."},"12":{"text":"Migilou in silgilou zakhat vei bawl in adamsung nite uh suhsau in um nanleh, Pasian giing a, Ama masanga zaudan siem mite a dingin ahoizaw ding chi ka thei hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh migilouten Pasian agiinlou ziehun amauh tan ahoi sih dinga, adamsung nite uh limliep abang dinga, asawt sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Bangmalou leitunga bawla um aum hi. Tua pen, migiloute nasepna dungzui a migiloute tan dinga kilawm midihtatten atan khah uh a um a, midihtatte tan dinga kilawm migilouten atan khah u’zong a um hi, tami zong bangmalou ahi, ka chi ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin mihing in aneh a, adawn a, tualeh nuomtah a aum sanga hoizaw ni nuoi a umlou ahi ziehin, damsung nopsahna mama ka genphata hi. Pasian in ni nuoi a damsung nite apieh sunga asepgimna lungnopna in zui ding ahi ziehin."},"16":{"text":"Pilna thei ding leh leitunga kibawl nasepte mu tum a ka lungtang ka senlai in, sun leh zan a mittung mitmuoi singlou mi a um hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian nasep zousie ka muta a, ni nuoi a ana kibawl, nasep zousie mihingin amudoh thei sih hi, suidoh ding in nasatahin pang nanleh amu tuomlou ding ziehin, tuathamlou in mipil in thei tum ngong nanleh amudoh zou tuom sih ding hi, chi ka muta hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tamte zousie phuongdoh dingin ka lungtang sunga koi in ka ngaituo a, midihtatte leh mipilte tualeh asilbawlte uh Pasian khut a um ahia, itna hiin mudana hitaleh amasang ua atuoh ding ua sil um zousie bangmalou ahi chi koiman athei sih uhi.","title":"Mi zousie adinga thukhenna kibang"},"2":{"text":"Mi zousie mi dihtat leh migilou asie leh apha, asieng leh asienglou kithoina sillat bawlte leh, abawlloute atawpna uh kibang ahi. Mihoi tunga tung bang bang mikhiel tungah atung hi. Kichiemna bawlte tunga, tung bangbang kichiemna bawlngailoute tungah atung hi."},"3":{"text":"Ni nuoi a kibawl sil zousiete lah ah tami sil hoilou khat ahi: tua khu mi zousie tunga tawpna akibang chiet a tung khu ahi. Adihtah in mihingtapate lungtang khu gitlou in adim a, adamsung un motna alungtang uah a um a, tuazou chiengin mishite kungah apei uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh ahing nalaite toh kizop pouma in lam etna anei hi, aziehpen humpibahnei shisa sangin ui hinglai ahoizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen ahing nalai ten zong, shiding ahi uh chi akithei ua, hinanleh mishi in bangma athei sih hi; kipahman zong anei nawn sih uhi. Amaute thei ngitngetna nangawn zong manghil in a umta hi."},"6":{"text":"A itna uleh amudana uh, tualeh athangsietna uh tuin amangthang siengta hi, tualeh ni nuoi a sil kibawlzousie ah, tanvou anei ngai nawn sih ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Pei inlen kipahtah in na ann ne inlen, lung nuomtah in na zu dawn in, aziehpen nasep nabawl zousie, Pasian in ahing pompiehta hi."},"8":{"text":"Puon ngou ngen sil ngitnget inlen, na lutang sathau nu ngitnget in."},"9":{"text":"Ni nuoi a na hinna bangmalou Pasian in, ahing pieh na damsung in na it, na zi toh nuomsatah in um in; aziehpen tuomi na damsung nite a, ni nuoi a na sepginaman ahi."},"10":{"text":"Na khut in bawl ding amu pouma theitawpin sem in; aziehpen na peina ding han sungah nasep ahiei, theina ahiei ahisihleh pilna ahiei, a um sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka kihei a, ni nuoi a ka mu kia khat ahileh: Kitai demna khu agangte ading ahi tuom sih a, kidouna zong mihatte ading ahi tuom sih hi, Ann zong mi pilte ading ahi sih a, Hausatna zong theisiemna neite ading ahi sih a, deisahna zong khutsiem mite ading ahi tuom sih hi. Hinanleh hun leh hunlem amaute zousie tunga tung ahibou hi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen mihing in ama hun athei sih hi: len a kiman nga bang leh, thanga kiman vate bangin, mihingte zong atung ua vangsietna hun, thakhat a ahing tun chiengin hun hoiloute ah a awh uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua pilna zong ni nuoi ah ka muta a, tuomi kei adingin athupi in ka thei hi.","title":"Thagum hat leh pilna"},"14":{"text":"Mi tawmnou khat tenna khopi neu khat a um a, tualeh leeng thupitah khat in ahing sim a, a imkhumta hi, tualeh akimkot ah thang thupitah akam khumta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua khopi sungah mi migenthei pil mama khat a tenga, ama’n apilna in tua khopi ahunkheta hi, hinanleh koiman tua mi zawngpa athei ngitnget sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken hatna sangin pilna ahoi zaw hi, ahivangin migenthei pilna simmawin a um a, athugente ngaikhieh in aum sih, ka chi hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi mote lah a vaihawmpa kikou sangin, awlnou nou a mipil thugen akiza thei zaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Kidouna galvan sangin pilna ahoizaw a, hinanleh mikhiel khat in silhoi tampi asusie hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thoupi shisaten, gimnamtui bawlpa sathau anamsietsah bangin, gamtat motna neu noukhat in, pilna zatat umna adaisah thei hi.","title":"Pilna pien zie"},"2":{"text":"Mipil lungtang aziet lam khut ah a um a, hinanleh mi mo lungtang pen aveilam ah a um hi."},"3":{"text":"Mi mo in lampi a peilai nangawn in pilna atasam hi."},"4":{"text":"Vaihawm mi lungthahna, na tunga asou leh na dinmun taisan sin; Aziehpen thunuoilutna in bawlkhelna thupitah asudai leeng hi."},"5":{"text":"Ni nuoi a silhoilou ka mu khat a um hi, vaihawmpa akipat a bawlkhelna pawtkhie khu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Motna nasatah a sangpi ah akikoi a, mi hausate mun ngiem ah atou hi."},"7":{"text":"Suohte sakol tunga tuong leh, miliente leitunga suoh banga kenga pei ka mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Lei hum tou pouma, atawsa lei hum sungah ake dinga, koipou bang phetvang khu gul in atu ding hi.","ref":"Late. 7.15; Thu. 26.27"},"9":{"text":"Suonglahna khuh a suong laidoh mi, suong in aliem dinga, sing eh mi khu, a sing ee in azauthawngsah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Heitang abol a akitathiem sihleh, thatanghat zah angai hi. Hinanleh pilna in lawchinna atun hi."},"11":{"text":"Akihim masanga gul in mi atuh leh, gul himpa phattuomna a um sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Mipil kam a thupawtte hepina ahi a, hinanleh mimo kam in ama apumval hi."},"13":{"text":"Akam a thute kipatna khu amotna ahia, tualeh ahoulimna tawpna khu agitlou huoi motna ahi."},"14":{"text":"Mimo in thu agen tam a, hinanleh mihing koiman bang hing um ding, ahiei chi agenthei sih hi. Ama nua chienga bang hing um ding, ahiei chi koiman agen thei sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi mote sepgimna in amauh alungkham sah a, Aziehpen amauten khopi a peidan nangawn athei sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Aw, gam na leengpa naupang ahi lai in, tualeh zingmawng a na milienten guolnop annkuong alui lai un, na tung agih hi."},"17":{"text":"Aw gam, na leengpa khu miliente tapa ahia a, tualeh na milienten khamna ding hilou a, thahatna dinga ahun tah a guolnopna abawl lai un, na hampha hi."},"18":{"text":"Thasietna ziehin inntung achim a, khut thasete inn ake hi."},"19":{"text":"Guolnopna pen nuina dinga kibawl ahi a, tualeh zu in mi akipahsah a, hinanleh sum in tahsapna awng zousie ahu hi."},"20":{"text":"Na lungsim nangawn in leengpa gausap sinlen, na lupna pindan ah mi hausate gense sin. Aziehpen tungleeng va khat in na aw theiin, na thugen agen sawnkha ding hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tui tungah na tanghou pai in, Ni tampi nua chieng in na mu kia ding hi.","title":"Na hoi sem dinga ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Sagi kungah tanvou hawm in, ahi giet kungah; Aziehpen leitungah bang sil hoilou hing um ding ahiei, chi na thei sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Meilumte guotui a adim leh, leitungah guo zusahin akisu awng ua, tualeh sing khat simlam ahiei mallam ahiei a apua leh, apua na mun ah a umden ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Hui ngaikhoh zousie’n haichi pawlou ding a, tualeh meilum en en pouma in bu a at ngaisih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Hui lampi heisung ahiei, chi leh, nau painu sunga gu leh, taangte bangchidan a hing khangdoh ahiei, chi na theilou mabangin, sil zousie siempa Pasian nasepte na theizou sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Zingmawng lam in na haichi tu inlen, nitah lam chiengin na khut khawlsah sin; Aziehpen, heipen ahiei lawchingtah a hing poudoh ding, tami ahiei, tuami ahiei, ahisihleh ani a hing hoi tuoh tuoh ding ahiei, chi na theisih hi."},"7":{"text":"Adihtah in khovah anuom a, tualeh mit a dingin nisa mu khu anuom hi.","title":"Khangdawng leh asiempa"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh mi kum tampi adam a, tuate zousie a akipah mama leh, mielna nite theizing heh, aziehpen tam mama ding ahi uhi. A hing um ding zousie bangmalou ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Aw khanglai, na khangdawnna ah kipah inlen, Na khangdawn lai nite in, na lungtangin hing kipahsah henlen; na lungtang deidan danin um inlen, na mit mu a hoi na sahna lamlam zuiin; Hinanleh tami zousie ziehin, Pasian in thukhenna ah hing zawpi ding ahi; chi thei in."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin na lungtang apat lunggimna koimang inlen, na tahsa apat in silhoilou koimangin, aziehpen naupanlai leh khanglai nite bangmalou ahibou hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni hoiloute ahing tun a, kum leh hate ahing nai a, atung uah kipahna mawngmawng ka nei sih, na hing china ding hun ahing tun masangin; na khangdawn lai in nang hing siempa thei ngitnget in.","title":"Na khangdawn laiin Pasian theiin"},"2":{"text":"Ni leh khovah leh ha leh aasite suhmiel a a um a, guo zuh nua a meilumte akitawlmang masangin."},"3":{"text":"Inn ngahte ahing chitut ua, mi hatte ahing kun khiukheu ua, ann sute atawmtah zieh ua akhawl ua, tualeh kotta a dahdohte avahphat nawnlou masangin,"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh kholai dawngkotte akikha, nailou laiin ann sute thawmgin adai deu deu a, va ham ging a mite athaw chieng in, Tualeh la sa siem tanute zousie aw aheu masangin."},"5":{"text":"Teehse senga munsang kaltou ding giinga, kholai dung zousie zauhuoina ngen a adim a, kawlthualu sing ahing pahlun a, khaukhuppite tunggihna ahing hi a, tualeh lunggulnate abei sienga, mihing in atangtawn innlam zuon a apei a, mishi suunte kholai a apei hun uh atun masangin."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh dangka khau ahing kiphel a, sana kuong akeh a, ahisihleh tuikhuh a tuibelte akeh zah a, ahisihleh tuikul a, tui khaina leengpei akisiet masangin, Nang hing siempa thei ngitnget in."},"7":{"text":"Leivui ahina banga ahing kipatna lei a anuakia kia ding a, Tualeh hagau khu apepa Pasian kungah, akia kia ding hi,"},"8":{"text":"Bangmaloute bangmalou, sil zousie bangmalou ngen ahibou hi thugenpa’n achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaban ah, thugenpa ana apil ziehin mite theina ahil nalai hi, Ahi, thupil tampi a ngaituo a, a suidoh a, tualeh akizom ditdet in a guoltuo hi.","title":"Pasian giing inlen athupiehte zuiin"},"10":{"text":"Thugenpa’n pomtah thute mu tum in asui a, akigielkhete thutah leh thudih ahi."},"11":{"text":"Mipil thugente pen sutna siazum bang ahi a, tualeh misiemte thugente khu, belampu in apieh siatuhkil khetlut bang ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh ka tapa aw, tamte ban ah, tam thute ah hilna ngaikhie in; laibu tampi bawl in tawpni anei sih a, zil tam zong tahsa gimna bep ahi."},"13":{"text":"Thu pumpi khupsinna ingaikhe ding uh; Pasian giing inlen, athupiehte zuiin, Aziehpen tami mihingte bawl ding mawng ahi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in sil kibawl zousie, ahoi leh asia hitaleh, sil kiphuol gu zousie thukhenna mun ah atut ding hi."}}}}},"22":{"info":{"name":"Solomon La","shortname":"Solo","abbr":[],"desc":"Solomon la"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Late Solomon la ahi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 4.32"},"2":{"text":"A mi tawpna kam in hing tawpleh izaw! aziehpen na itna lah uoin sangin ahum zaw hi.","title":"Mounu"},"3":{"text":"Na sathau gimnamtui kinu ziehin, na min khu sathau buhkhieh bang mai ahi a, tuaziehin nungah siengthouten ahing ngai uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hingpui in, nanua hing zui va ung; leengpa’n a pindan sungah ahing puilutta hi, Nangma ah kipahin ka nuom ding ua, na itna khu uoin sangin ka thei ngitnget zaw ding uh a, dihtah in ahing it ding uhi.","title":"Jerusalem tanute leh Shunem numei"},"5":{"text":"Aw nou Jerusalem tanute aw, Ka mel avom vangin, Kedar puon innte bang leh Solomon puonjahte bangin ka kilawm veve hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka melvom zieh leh nisa’n ahing kah ziehin hing en en sih un. Ka nu tapate ka tungah alungthah ua, amaun kei grep huonte veng in ahing koi ua, hinanleh keima grep huon ka veng tasih hi."},"7":{"text":"Aw nang ka ngainou, hing hil vawi in, na belamhonte heisunga na vah ahiei? bangzieh a kei na lawm na guolte belamhonte lah a, maikhu lienu bang ding ka hiei?"},"8":{"text":"Lienu zatam lai a sahmel etlawm pen aw; na theisih leh belamhonte sulnua zui inlen, belam chingte puonbuh gei ah na kelnoute chingin.","title":"Jerusalem nungahte"},"9":{"text":"Ka ngainou aw, ken nangpen Pharaoh sakolleng kaite lah a, sakol la khat toh kahing tekah hi.","title":"Ki it tuona"},"10":{"text":"Na biengte gel na kizepna in aetlawmsah a, na ngawng toh sana khi awte akilawm hi."},"11":{"text":"Kouten nanga dingin dangka gui a kizem, sana khi ka hing bawlpieh ding uhi.","title":"Jerusalem nungahte"},"12":{"text":"Lengpa dawkan a ann ne a atou laiin, ka spikenat sathau namtui in agimnamtui, akikhawkhesah va hiau hi.","title":"Shunem nungah"},"13":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa khu kei a ding in mirrah gimnamtui thawl zan tungtawn a ka nawite gel kikaal a lum bang ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ka ngainou khu kei a dingin, En-gedi grep huona heisapahlun bang ahi."},"15":{"text":"En vawi, ka ngainou aw, na sahmel etlawm hi, En vawi, na kilawm seng seng a, na mitte gel zong khuvanu mit abang hi.","title":"Ngainou tangpa"},"16":{"text":"Envawi, ka ngai tangpa, sahmel etlawm na hi a, duongkuoi etlawm na hi; i laikhun tung zong tulsingna bangin eng ding deng hi.","title":"Shunem"},"17":{"text":"I innkamte sidar sing ngen ahi a, Tualeh innkute zong taa sing ngentang ahi.","title":"Ngainou tangpa"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei Sharon rose pahlun ka hia, phaijang lili pahlun ka hi."},"2":{"text":"Linglah lili pah bangin lienu zatam lai ah, ka ngai lienu sawlbang a hei hi.","title":"Ngainou tangpa"},"3":{"text":"Gammang tulsing lah a epul singkung bangin, ka ngai tangpa zong, taang zatam lai ah sawlbang ahei a, alim nuoi ah nunnuom tutvum khawl in, aga ka tepleh ningzu humnou abang hi.","title":"Sannem lienu"},"4":{"text":"Aman guolvahna ann kuong luina inn ah ahing zawpi a, tualeh apuonlap khu ka tungah anbang itna ahi."},"5":{"text":"Grepga gawte in hing kaihing unlen, epul theiga in hing suhal un, lawmngai khamkha ka veita hi."},"6":{"text":"Akhut veilam ka lutang nuoi ah akoi a, aziet lam khut in ahing kawi hi."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem tanute aw, sasan leh gam sazuhpite siel in ka hing ngen ahi; ki it kingaina pen, alungkim masangsie’n tohthou sih unlen, phawng zong phawng sih un."},"8":{"text":"Ka ngaitangpa tongdam ka za hi, En in ahing pei hi, muol dung tawn in ahing kidieng suh a, muolte ahing kantan hi.","title":"Ngailienu"},"9":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa khu sazuhtal leh sakhital dawnglai bang ahi a, En vawi, ka baang pang uah adinga, kotta hawmte ah ahing en a, ka baanghawmte uah ahing kaihit hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa’n ka kungah, “Ka ngainou melhoi hing thou inlen, hing zui maive, chi’n ang houpi hi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen en in phalbi abeita a, Guo atheuta a khuo aphata hi."},"12":{"text":"Leitungah papete ahing kilangta a, la sah hun ahing tungta hi, Tualeh igamah huivanu tong awi kizata hi."},"13":{"text":"Theipi kungin aga hingte asuongta a, grep pahlun in agimnamtui langsahta hi; Thou in duongsuo kilawm ka ngainou hing zuiin."},"14":{"text":"Kawlhawm suongpi kaal a kibu ka khuvanou aw, munsang kawlhawm a kibu ka khuvanou aw, na mel hing musah inlen, na aw nem hing zasah in, na tongdam anem a, na sakmel etlawm seng hi."},"15":{"text":"Koute dingin grep gui susie si-alnoute hing mat pieh un, aziehpen ka grepguite asusie ua grepga hoitah agasah sih uhi.”","title":"Lienu sanggamte"},"16":{"text":"Ka ngaitangpa keia ahia, kei zong ama a ka hi. Ama’n lili pahte lah ah belam aching hi.","title":"Sannem lienu"},"17":{"text":"Ni ahing nema, ni himte akiheimang masangsie’n; kiheiven ka ngainou, Bether muolte tunga sazuhtal leh, sakhitalnou dawnglai akihei bangin."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zankhang kimchieng laikhun tungah, lunga ka it sabang vai veng, nanleh sahmel mu zou lang e.","title":"Ngailienu lunggel"},"2":{"text":"“Tuin ka thou dinga, vangkholai teng sabang ka vai dinga, khopi kot zing teng leh, mun chin teng ah ka vah kawi dinga, ka ngai tangpa ka sui dinga,” ka sui ngitnget a, ka muzou tuom sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Khopi sung venga vah kawi miten, Kei ahing mu ua, Ken amau kungah “Ka ngai tangpa na mukha uoi?” Ka chita hi."},"4":{"text":"Amauh ka hen bepin, ka ngai tangpa ka muta a, ka nu innsungah ka puilut a, keima hing na pai kanu pindan sunga, ka puilut masangsie’n, ka tudetta a, apei ding ka phal nawn sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem tanute aw, itna alungkim masangsie’n, phongsih unlen, khanglousah sih un, chi’n gamlah sazuhtal leh, sakhital noute siel in ka hing ngen ahi."},"6":{"text":"Gamdai a kipat a meikhu kitung banga, hing peidoh khu koi ahiei? Murra leh begaw akizut a, summetbawl mite gimnamtui vui a, kizut khu koi ahiei?","title":"Ngai tangpa"},"7":{"text":"En vawi, alupna khu Solomon lupna ahi, mihangsan sawmguhin akimkot ah a imkhum ua, Israel mihangsante’n."},"8":{"text":"A bawn un namsau atawi chiet ua, galdou siem ngen ahi uh, zanlai chienga zauna zieh in apheizum uah namsau akuo chiet uhi."},"9":{"text":"Leengpa Solomon in Lebanon singin, sakolleng touna khat ama a dingin abawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Akhuomte dangka sia in abawl a, a tunna sana, atouna puonsan dup in atuom a, asunglam Jerusalem tanuten, anbang itna toh apha suoh uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aw nou Zion tanute pawtdoh unlen, azi ding moulop ni leh alungtang kipah ni in; Atunnu’n akhusah leengpa Solomon leenglukhu hing en un."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En vawi, ngainou na kilawm hi, En vawi, na kilawm seng seng hi. Na maikhuna sungah na mitte khuvanu mit abanga, na sam zong Gilead muol a hing, kumsuh kelhonte abang hi.","title":"Mounu melhoi phatna ngai tangpa"},"2":{"text":"Na hate lah belamhon mul kimetsa, kisilsieng sitset bangin avaam hi, Keelpi zousie’n akop kopin nou anei ua, alah uah achiing khat beeh a um sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Na nephute sawn au san abanga, na kamsung zong a etlawm mama hi. Na maikhuna diel lie ah na biengte, kawlbuthei kiphalhah abang hi."},"4":{"text":"Na ngawng lah galhangte namtem leh lum leh, phaw kikhaina David innsang bang ahi."},"5":{"text":"Na nawite gel lah lili pah lah a aphit a, pieng sazuhtalnou gamta bang ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ni ahing nem a, nihimte akikhin mang masangsie’n mirrah taang leh, begaw muol kava pha ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Na melhoi seng taluo hi ka ngai lienu, na kungtungah nuolna ding a um vawt sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka ngai lienu Lebanon akipat in hing pei in, Lebanon apat in peikhawm vai, Amana muolvum leh Senir leh Hermon muolvum akipat, tualeh humpibahnei kuote apat leh, kamkei muolte akipat in en suh vai."},"9":{"text":"Nang kalaizom ka ngai lienu, ka lungsim na zougawpta hi. Na mit langkhat a nang mitsih atnain, ka lungsim na lamangta a, Na suong manpha khigui khat in zong, ka lunglai akuoi hi."},"10":{"text":"Anbang na itna kilawm hina va-ia e, ka laizom leh ka ngai lienu, Anbang na itna ningzu sangin, humzaw na duong gimsi, gimnamtui dangteng sangin namtui zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka ngai lienu na nephute khuoiphanga khuoizu bangin atakhie a, na lei nuoi ah khuoizu leh nawitui a um a, na puonsil gimnamte lebanon gimsi a nam hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka laizom ka ngai lienu aw, huon ki imbang na hi a, tuinah kihu, tuikul ki sing bang na hi."},"13":{"text":"Na singkungte lah kawlbuthei huon a, ga kilawm tahtah adim, heisapah leh spikenat gimnamtui bang ahi."},"14":{"text":"Spikenard leh saffron, kawltu gimnamtui leh singthal, begaw, murrah leh aloe gimnamtui theitawp singkung zousie toh ahi."},"15":{"text":"Huonte a tuinahnei, tuihing tuikhuh leh, Lebanon apata lui luongte abang hi."},"16":{"text":"Aw mallam huikhi khanglou in, Aw hing peiin sim huikhi, ka huonsungah hing lang inlen, gimnamtuite azamdoh theina dingin, Kangainou ka huonsungah hing lut henlen, theiga tui pente hing ne hen."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka laizom ka ngai lienu, aw, ka huonsungah ka hing peita hi, Ka murrah leh gimnamtuite ka lakhawm a, khuoizuphang leh khuoizu ka neta hi; Ka uoin zong ka nawitui toh akidawnta hi; Aw ka lawm leh guolte ne unlen dawn un, nou aki it akingaite aw nieng leh, tai tah in ne unlen dawn un.","title":"Ngai tangpa"},"2":{"text":"Laikhun tung maimit ka sin hangin, sinlailungin maimit singlou, “Ngai vawi, ka ngai tangpa’n kot ahing kiu a, ka ngai tangpa tongdam nem in, kot hing hon ven, ka tuoi, ka ngai lienu ka vakhunou, ka deiteng kimna nu aw, Aziehpen ka lutang daitui in anom siengta, ka sam zousie daitui in apah siengta,” ahing chi hi.","title":"Ngai lienu"},"3":{"text":"Ka puonsilte ka sut zouta a, ka bangchi sil kia ding a diei? Ka kengte ka silzouta a, bangchin ka niehsah thei kia diei?"},"4":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa’n akhut kothawm ah ahing gol lut a, tuabep in ka lungsim a tunta hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa kot hon dingin ka thoudoh a, ka khutte murrah in ka zut a, ka khutmete murrah tui gimnamtui ka nu a, kot kilna tungte ah zong ka nu suoh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa kot kava honta a, hinanleh ka ngai tangpa ana nua pei kiata a, ana peitumta hi. Aman thu agen laiin ka lungsim in ama lam ka zuon a, Ama ka sui a, hinanleh ka muzou sih, ama ka han a, ahing dawng sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Khopi venga vahkawi kawiten ahing mu ua, ahing vuo ua, ahing liemsahta uhi kulbang vengten, ka maikhuna puon kei apat in alamangta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem tanute aw, ka hing ngen vanguo hi, ka ngai tangpa na mu khah u’leh, ama vangngai khamkha veilawta ka hi, chi’n na hil un."},"9":{"text":"Lienu zatam lai a etlawm tungtuong pen aw, na ngaitangpa tangdang sanga atungtuonna bang ahiei? Na ngainou, midangte ngainou sanga, a etlawmna bang atuom ei? Bang dinga koute tambang lawma nei nget ahiei?","title":"Jerusalem tanute thugen"},"10":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa angou a asan hiu hiau hi, tul sawm lai a etlawm tungtuong ahi.","title":"Ngai lienu"},"11":{"text":"Alutang zong sana sieng set bang ahi a, asamte akil hoi mama va-ah bangin a vom dingdeng hi."},"12":{"text":"Amitte gel lui tuite gei a vahui mit, nawitui a kisilsieng kituohtah a kiphut bang ahi."},"13":{"text":"Abiengte gel pen pape gimnamtui pouna huonsung a, gimnamtui zam sah bang ahi a, anephu zong lili pallun murrah tui takhie bang ahi."},"14":{"text":"A khutte lah beril suongmantam a, kizem sana chieng bang ahi a, atahsa zong saiha kisui zol, saphire suongmantam a kiluonkhum bang ahi."},"15":{"text":"Akengte gel zong sana sieng set, khuom tunna tunga kitung suong ngou khuomte bang ahi a, amel etlawm dan lah sidar sing sangte a kizem, Lebanon muol bang mai ahi."},"16":{"text":"A kam ahum penpen a, Ahi, amapa apumpi’n adeihuoi ahi; Aw Jerusalem tanute, Ama ahi anbang ka it tangpa, ama ahi kalawmpa."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lienu zatam lai a, sahmel hoipen nu aw, na ngai tangpa heikuom sawlbang ahei a hiei? Hing hil vawi in, sangbang ka hing vaipi theina ding un.","title":"Jerusalem tanute thugen"},"2":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa ahuonsung gimnamtuite, pouna huon sungah ava haw hi; ahuonsunga belamte ching ding leh, lili pahte lakhawm dingin.","title":"Ngai lienu"},"3":{"text":"Kei ka ngai tangpa a ka hi a, ka ngai tangpa zong kei a ahi; ama’n lili pah lah ah abelamte aching hi."},"4":{"text":"Aw anbang ka it lienu, Tirzah bangin na melhoi a, Jerusalem bangin na dei huoi hi, puonlap tawi galkap hon bangin na giin huoi hi.","title":"Mounu melhoina akiphatna Ngaitangpa tongdam"},"5":{"text":"Na mitte gel kei apat in heimangin, aziehpen ahing et chieng un, ahing zou seng ua ka duong anem hi; na samte zong Gilead muol dunga, kelhon kizawtsuh abang uhi."},"6":{"text":"Na hate lah belamhon kisil zoupan abanga, abawn un ta a nei kop chiet ua, alah uah achiing khat zong a um sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na mai khuna lie ah na biengnou, kawlbuthei kiphalhah ausan hiu hiau abang hi."},"8":{"text":"Lengnu sawm guh a um a, amei sawm giet a um a, tualeh ngahnu siengthou sim senglou a um hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka lungdeinou, ka huivanu, hoibukimnu atunnu von lienu neisun, tunnu von lungdeinou hibou, vontawi lie dangtengin, lie nunnuom chi tuomse uh; Lengnute leh meinuten zong, ka ngai lienu aphat chiet uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Zing taikhovah banga et lawmnu khu koi ahiei? Hapi banga etlawmnu, ni banga tangphanu leh, galzawna diellap tawi a kizawt galkap hon banga zau huoinu khu koi ahiei?”"},"11":{"text":"Phaijanga theigate en dingin be lei huon ah ka peisuh a, grep guite adawn suongta uoi en dingin, kawlbutheite apahta uoi en dingin ka kuonsuhta hi.","title":"Ngai lienu"},"12":{"text":"Ka khophawh masang lai nangawn in, ka lunggulna in ka miliente sakolleng bangin, ahing bawlta hi."},"13":{"text":"Hing kile kia in, hing kile kia in, Aw nang Shulam nu Kouten ka hing et theina ding un. Lamgui ni a kichiengte kikaal a, lam banga bang dinga, Shulam nungah a et et ding ahiei mah?","title":"Shulam nu"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na kedap toh na kengte kilawm hina e, Aw leengtapate tanu, na malpitegel suongmantam kheng siemte, khut suoh bang mai ahi.","title":"Ngai tangpa"},"2":{"text":"Na laikuoh khu ningzu kihal tasamlou a umna, nou bem bang ahi a, na kawng zong mangbu vum akimvel a, lili pape pou bang ahi."},"3":{"text":"Na nawite gel zong sazuhnou piengkop bang ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Na ngawng zong saiha akibawl innsang bang ahi a, na mitte gel khu Bath-Rabbim kotpi gei a, Heshbon tuikhuhte bang ahi ua, na nahkuo lah Damaska lam nga a, Lebanon muol a innsang kilam bang ahi."},"5":{"text":"Na lutang zong Karmel muol bang kumpinu lukhu ahi. Na sam kaisuhte zong puonsandup kikhai abang ahi; tua na sam bawhte ah leengpa sal a mat in a um hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka ngai lienu aw, kilawm sengin, lungkim huoina va-ia chie; Na itna in hing kipah sah hi."},"7":{"text":"Na duong kilawm tum sing bang ahi a, na nawite gel zong grepga bawh bang ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tum singah ka kaltou dinga, aba hiengte ka tudet ding ka chi a; tuin na nawite gel grepga bawhpha bang henlen, na nah hute apple gimsi nam hen."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh na kam tunglam ningzu humpen abang hi. Tua ningzu humnou ka ngai tangpa kamsungah, dam di diei in luongsuh henlen; imute muh leh kam ah luong suh hen.","title":"Ngai lienu"},"10":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa a ka hi a, alaikuoi leh lunggul kei ka hi bou hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa hing pei vawi, gamlah ah va vah vaiin, khota ah gieh den mai vai!"},"12":{"text":"Zingmawng matah in ithou dinga grep huon ah ihaw ding a, grep guite ameng doh taimah, tualeh kawlbutheite amumdoh taimah, va enta vai; tua mun ah anbang kang itna ka hing pe ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Zawldei ai agimnam alaangsah a, ikotpi phung ah zong, theiga tuituoh chi tuom tuom alui atha, nanga dinga ka kholkhawm a um hi, Aw ka ngai tangpa."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Nangpen ka nu nawitui tep a, ka sanggampa hing hita mai lachin maw! Pulam a ka hing mu chiengin ka hing tawp dinga, Ahi, koiman ahing simmaw sih ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Ka hing zawpi dinga, ka nu innsungah ka hing lutpi dinga, ka nu’n ang hilna bangin, ka kawlbuthei tui akipat ningzu hum leh, gimnamtui kihal ka hing dawnsah nuom hi."},"3":{"text":"Aban veilam ka tangkhapa, aban zietlam in ahing kawi hi.","title":"Jerusalem tanute kungah"},"4":{"text":"Ka hing ngen vanguo hi; Aw Jerusalem tanute anbang itna, alungkim masangsie’n phawng sih unlen, khanglou sah sih un."},"5":{"text":"Gamdai akipat a, angai tangpa tunga kingam a hing pei koi ahiei mah? Apple sing nuoi ah ka hing phawnga, tuanah na nu’n nangma ahing hingdoha, tua mun ah nang hing pai, na nuin nang ang neikheta hi.","title":"Ngai tangpa"},"6":{"text":"Na ban a chiemtena na nam bangin, na lungtang ah kei chiemtena nam in, aziehpen itna zong shina bangin ahat hi, thangsietna zong hankhuh bangin agilou hi; tuatah kammei kuongte, meikuong nasatah a kileh bangmai ahi uhi.","title":"Ngai lienu’n angai tangpa kungah"},"7":{"text":"Tui tampi in abuohmit theilou, tui sanglet ten zong atawmang thei lou anbang itna; mi khat in anbang itna sesum, lamtam in lei sawm nanleh leizou lou dinga, bangman kingai piehlou ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Kouten sanggam numei neu nalai khat ka nei uhi, nawi anei nai sih a, mite’n amanu ahing dawp ni chiengin, ka sanggamnu dingin bang ka bawlta ding uoi?","title":"Ngai lienu sanggam pasalte"},"9":{"text":"Amanu kulbang hitaleh, atungah dangka sia in innsang ka lam ding ua, tualeh amanu kotkha hitaleh, sidar peh in ka imkhum ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Kulbaang ka hi a, ka nawite zong innsang bang ahi uhi. Tuachi’n kei zong, ama mitmu ah lungmuonna mu mi khat ka hita hi.","title":"Ngailienu tongdam"},"11":{"text":"Solomon in Baal-Hamon ah grep huon khat anei a, huon hou a kilawte khut ah akemsah a, akemte zousie’n agate man ding, dangka tul khat chiet ahing tawi ding uh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ka grep huon pen kei a mawng ahi a, Nang, Aw Solomon, dangka tul khat na kitan dinga, a kem miten dangka zani a tang ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Huonsunga teng noute aw, ka lawm guolten na aw gin angaikhie ua, kei zong hing zasah in."},"14":{"text":"Ka ngai tangpa hing kinaw in, muoldawn tumtai pouna muol dungah sazuh tal leh, sakhitalnou bangin hing kidieng suh in."}}}}},"23":{"info":{"name":"Isai","shortname":"Isai.","abbr":[],"desc":"Isai laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amoz tapa Isai in Juda leengte Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz leh Hezekiahte vaihawm lai a Juda leh Jerusalem tungtang thu a mengmuna amu khu tambang ahi.","title":"Judate tunga thukhenna","ref":"2 Leeng. 15.1-7; 2 Khang. 26.1-23; 2 Leeng. 15.32-38; 2 Khang. 27.1-9; 2 Leeng. 16.1-20; 2 Khang. 28.1-27; 2 Leeng. 18.1—20.21; 2 Khang. 29.1—32.33"},"2":{"text":"Aw vante ngai unlen, leitung aw na bil dawin, aziehpen Mangpa’n thu agen hi: “Tate ka vah a, ka khangliensah hi, hinanleh ka tungah ahelta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Bawngtal in aneipa athei a, sabiltungin zong apu annpiehna kuong athei hi; hinanleh Israelten athei sih ua, ka miten angaituo ngaisih uhi.”"},"4":{"text":"Ka dei aw! Nam tawnkhiel, thulimlouna vanga puo mite, silhoilou bawlte hahlesuonte milepchiete tate ahi ua, Mangpa ataisan ua, Israelte Misiengthoupa athangpai sah ua, akinuahei mangsanta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Bangzieh a hel nalai lai a, vuoh a um nalai lai ding na hi uoi mah? Lutang apum in achina a, lungtang pumpi aba gawpta hi."},"6":{"text":"Kengtaw nuoi apat in lutang dongin adamna mun mawngmawng a um sih hi, liemnate, vuohsidupnate, hima nai ngen a dim ahi; tuate mehbinglou ahi a, koiman atuom sih a, sathau zong nulou ahi nalai hi."},"7":{"text":"Na gam uh asesuoh ta a, na khopite uh meiin akatumta a, namitmuna ngel uah gamdang miten na gam uh ane gam siengta uhi Gamdang mite susiet leh nuoisie in a umta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zion tanu khu grep-huon a buh neu nou leh tangmai lei a venna buhte bang ahita a, galte simsa khopi kinuasie bang ahita hi."},"9":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n asuohta sun tawmnou khat hing na nuasie lou hitaleh Sodom ibangta ding a, Gomorrah ibangta ding uhi.","ref":"Siem. 19.24; Rom. 9.29"},"10":{"text":"Aw nou Sodom vaihawmte, Mangpa thu ngaikhie unlen, nou Gomorrah mipite aw, i Pasian dan ah na bil daw un."},"11":{"text":"“Mangpa’n na kithoina neu noute uh kei a dinga bang phatuom ahiei mah? achi hi. Belamtal halmang sillatte leh ganta vathau ka deikhop ka neita hi. Bawngtalte, belamte ahisihleh kelte sisan ah kipahna ka nei sih hi.","ref":"Amos. 5.21,22"},"12":{"text":"“Ka masanga kilan dinga na hing pei chiengun, ka inn huongsung tuon dingin koiin nou hing phut ahiei mah?"},"13":{"text":"Pannabei sillat ding hing tawi nawn sih un, gimnamtui zong kei a dingin kidah huoi ahita hi, ha thate, khawl nite leh na khawmpi hatte u’toh na gitlouna uh ka thuohzou nawn sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Na ha thate uleh na hunbi nei pawite uh ka hinna in ahuo hi, kei dingin anohphah giap a, ka chimtah gawpta hi."},"15":{"text":"Thungen a na ban uh na zah pouma chiengun ka mit noute akipat ka phuol dinga; thungetna tamsem neinan u’lachin zong ka ngaikhe sih ding hi. Na khutte uh sisan a dim ahi."},"16":{"text":"Kisil unlen, kisusiengthou un, ka masanga ka mitmuna akipat in na silbawl hoiloute uh koimang unlen, silgilou bawl tawpta un."},"17":{"text":"Silhoi bawl kizil unlen, thukhen-vaihawmna dih sui unlen, mi sugentheite thu hil unlen, pa neiloute hum unlen, meithaite thu genpieh un."},"18":{"text":"“Hing pei unlen ngaituokhawm tadi vai, Mangpa’n achi hi, na khelnate uh san-au bang in san nanleh vua bangin avaam dinga, sandup bang in san nanleh samul bangin angou ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Gennoptah leh thumangtah a na um uleh gam a pieng silhoite na ne ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh na utlou ua, na hel uleh, namsau a sattan in na um ding uhi, aziehpen Mangpa kam in agensa ahi.”"},"21":{"text":"Bangzieh a khopi muonhuoi kizuanu suohta adiei! thudih a vaihawmna toh kidim ana hi a; dihtatna asungah ana umngai a hinanleh tuin tuolthatte a um zawta hi."},"22":{"text":"Na dangkate sam-eeh akai siengta a, na zu tui toh akihalta hi."},"23":{"text":"Na leengtapate ahelhat ua, gutate lawm asuohta ua, michin in golguh sil adei ua, athawn a silpieh adel uhi. Pa neiloute ahum sih ua meithaite vai ahawm pieh sih uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa galkapte Mangpa Israelte Mihatpa’n tambangin agen hi, “Ah! Ka melmate tungah ka thangpaina ka tangtung sah dinga, ka galte tungah phuba kala ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na tungah ka khut ka ha dinga, na sam-eeh khu tang-al in kasil sieng ding a, tualeh nanga kipat sia tahlou zousie ka lamang ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Na vaihawmnate amasapen bangin ka siempha kia dinga, tualeh nang hing thuhilte achiil lai a bangin ka siemtha kia dinga; tu nua chiengin miten khopi muon huoi leh dihtatna khopi ahing chita ding uhi.”"},"27":{"text":"Thudih a vaihawm-thukhenna toh Zion ka tankhe dinga, tualeh asunga mi piengthate zong dihtatna toh tatkhieh ahi ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh mi tawnkhielte leh mikhielte amangthai khawm ding ua, tualeh Mangpa taisan mite mei in akatum ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Aziehpen a gangpi sing milim dei tahte uh azumpi ding ua, tualeh nahuon telte uh ziehin na zala ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Aziehpen gangpi singna vul bangbang na hita ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Mihatte khu patzam ziel bang ahi dinga, tualeh asilbawlte uh meisi bang ahi dinga ani un akakhawm ding ua, koiman aphelzou sih ding hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amoz tapa Isai in Juda leh Jerusalem tungtang thu amu khu tambang ahi.","title":"Ni nukhiate ading thuchiem"},"2":{"text":"Ni nukhia chiengin tambang ahing hiding a, Mangpa inn umna muol khu, taangte vum ah suhdet in a um dinga, tualeh muolte tungah, tawisangin a um ding hi; tualeh namte zousie apeikhawm ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Mi tampite ahing peikhawm ding ua, “Hing peiun Mangpa muol ah, Jakob Pasian inn ah pei vaiin, tuachi’n Aman alampite ahing hil dinga, alampite ah ipei ding uh,” achi ding uhi; aziehpen zion akipat in, dan ahing pawt dinga, tualeh Mangpa thu Jerusalem apat in, ahing pawt ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman namte kaal ah thu akhen dinga, Aman mi tampite athuhil dinga, tualeh a namsaute uh, lou hawna tuin akheng ding ua, tualeh ateipite uh, theikung heuna siakawite in akheng ding uhi; nam khat in namdangte douna in, namsau aleh nawn sih ding ua, kidou dan zong azil nawn sih ding uhi.","ref":"Joel. 3.10; Mik. 4.3"},"5":{"text":"Jakob innkuonte aw hing pei unlen, Mangpa vaah ah vah va ui."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen na mi Jakob innkuonte na taisanta a, amaun suolam mite tat dan zuina in adim siengta uh a; Philistin mite banga aisan mite ahita ua, gamdang mite toh akizopta uhi.","title":"Mangpa hing peina ding ni"},"7":{"text":"Agamte u’zong sana dangka in a dim a, agoute un beini a neisih hi; agam uh sakol in adim a, asakollengte un beini aneisih hi."},"8":{"text":"Agamte u’zong milimte in adim a, akhut mama ua abawlte uleh amauh khutmete a abawl uh, amauh bawlte ma abie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mite atakhiel siengta ua, hoilou na ngen a adim taziahun ngaidam sin."},"10":{"text":"Suongpi kawm ah lut unlen, leivui lah ah kibu un; Mangpa achizat huoina leh athupina apat kiphuol un.","ref":"Kihil. 6.15; 2 Thes. 1.9"},"11":{"text":"Mihing kiletsahnate khu suhngiem in a um dinga, mite kideikhopna zong kunsah in a um ding hi; tua ni chiengin Mangpa bou tawisangin a um ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa ni khu ki liensah leh kingaisang zousiete tung ah atung dinga, amauh kitawi sang pouma akiluoi ngiem ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Lebanon muola sidar sing sangpipite leh tawisang a umte leh Bashan gam a gangpi sing zousie tungah;"},"14":{"text":"Muolsang zousiete tungah leh, tawisanga um muol zousie tungah;"},"15":{"text":"Inn sawngsang chinteng tungah leh kulpi bang nei zousie tungah,"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Tarshish tembaw chinteng tung leh sil lim kilawm zousiete tungah atung ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihing kiletsahnate suhngiem ahi dinga, mite kideikhopnate loingiem ahi ding hi. Tua ni chiengin Mangpa bou tawisang in a um ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Aman milimte asubei sieng ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Leitung nasatah a kilingsah dinga Mangpa athawchiengin, agiinhuoina leh avangletna thupina apat mite atai ding ua, suongpi hawmte leh leihawmte ah atai lut ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin miten bieh ding a abawl uh sana leh dangka milimte buite leh baahte kung ah apei ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Leitung nasatah a hotling ding a athaw chiengin, Mangpa zauhuoina chizat huoina apat avangletna thupinate akipat mite suongpi kawm leh kawlhawmte ah alut ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Anahkohawm a anahna hu um mihing gintat tawpsanta un; banglam panga muontah hi mama uh ahiei mah."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngaiun, Mangpa galkapte Mangpa’n Jerusalem leh Juda gam a kipat in akingaatna uleh ahinna uh anneh tuidawn zousie alamangta hi.","title":"Jerusalem gawtna"},"2":{"text":"Mihat leh galhang, vaihawmmi leh guolnei, ai-sanmi leh upate,"},"3":{"text":"sawmnga tung lamkai, mi zatat huoi, lemguottu, mi khut siem leh aisansiem mi zousie alamangta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin amauh tunga lamkai dingin naupangte ka koi dinga, naungehten amauh tungah vai ahawm ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mite khat leh khat akinuoisie tuo ding ua, tualeh michin ama innvengte toh kinuoisie in a um ding uhi; naupangte upate tungah kiliensahtah in agamta ding ua, mi thulimlouten mi zatathuoite tungah akiliensah ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mi’n apa innsunga a unaupa atuuh a, “Nang sil leh ten na nei a ka tung uah vaihawm inlen, tualeh tami sietgawpna na khut nuoi ah um hen,” achi chieng in;"},"7":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin, aman a niel dinga, “Ken na natna ka damsah thei sih ding hi; Aziehpen ka inn ah neh leh taah leh silleten ding a um sih hi; mite tungah vaihawm ding in hing koi sin,” achi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen Jerusalem akipalpua a, Juda apuata hi athugente u’leh anasepte uh Mangpa kalna ngen ahi ziehin, athupina mit alungthah sah ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amel puoh dan un, amauh aheh a, akhelnate uh Sodom bangin akilang sah ua, akhelna uh aliakhu siengta ua; ahinna uh atung agih hi; aziehpen amauleh amauh sietna kitut uh ahita hi."},"10":{"text":"Midihtatte ahing hoi ding hi, chi un, aziehpen anasep ga uh ane ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Migilou tung agih hi, ama a dingin bangma ahoi sihding hi, aziehpen akhut nasep ga ama kunga pieh ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka mite ahileh, naupangte amauh nuoisiete ahi ua, tualeh numeiten atung uah vai ahawm uhi. Ka mite aw na lamkaite un nou ahing sukhiel sahta uhi, tualeh na lampite uh asuseta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa agen pieh dingin adingdoh a, tualeh mite vaihawm dingin ading hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa’n amite lah a upate leh miliente tungah vaihawm ding ahi: “Aziehpen nouten grep-huon nane khawngta ua, mi zawngte apat a na lah sum leh neitahte na inn uah a um hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka mite na tawhguoi ua, mi zawngte mai na gawtguoi uh, bang na china uh ahiei mah?” Mangpa galkapte Pasian in a chi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Mangpa’n Zion tanute akiliensah ua, ngawng vaipuohin leh mi mitsih et kawm in tawhei lot lot in apei ua, akengte uh asuon ging kong kong zieh un;","title":"Jerusalem numeite galgihna"},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n Zion tanute lutangah hima a umsah dinga, tualeh Mangpa’n azamawte uh adawhsah ding hi; achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Mangpa’n kizepna kilawmte kengbute, diel khuhte, ngawng awte;"},"19":{"text":"bilbate, taute kikhuna puonte,"},"20":{"text":"lugahna dielte, kenga khainiengte, kawngtente gimnamtui bawmte, taute,"},"21":{"text":"khutsipte, nakuo abate,"},"22":{"text":"pawi ni puonte, puonah tuolte, puontung silte, sum ipte leh,"},"23":{"text":"himlangte, puon malngatte, diel khitte leh puon tuolte, alamang ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hiding hi, Gimnamtui taangin sil-ui gim a um dinga, kawngten taangin khauhuol, samphatah taangin lukieuna, puontuol hoitah taangin sai-ipuonten a um dinga, tualeh melhoina taangin melsietna a um ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na mite namsau in a pua ding ua, na mihatte kidouna phuol ah apua ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Zion kulkotpite mi shi suun in akap ding ua, tualeh amanu ahawm guoh ahi dinga, tuol ah atou ding hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tua ni chiengin numei sagi in pasal khat atudet ding ua, “Kouma ann ka kineh ding ua, kouma puon silin ka kitengna ding uhi; ka minsietna uh liemang dingin hing kitenpi in” achi ding uhi."},"2":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Mangpa silbawl theina khu kilawmtah leh thupitah in a um dinga, agam gate zong Israel suohta um sunte a dingin, kiletsahpi leh kithupisah tham ching ahi ding hi.","title":"Zion siem tha kiana"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hidinga, Zion a kinua sie sunte leh Jerusalem a um sunte, mi siengthou chia min law ahi ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa’n Zion tanute puohban nateng asawpsieng pieh a, tualeh vaihawmna hagau leh halmangna hagau in Jerusalem sisan alah ua kipat asawpsieng chieng in."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Zion muol tunga mun chinteng leh akikhawmpite tungah sun in meilum leh meikhu tualeh zan chiengin meikuong vah phatah a umsah dinga, aziehpen sil zousie tungah thupina in aliekhu ding hi.","ref":"Pawt. 13.21; 24.16"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh sun chienga nisa apata lie dingin, tualeh huipi leh guopi apat a kihumbitna ding leh bel dingin biehbuh a um ding hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka it pen kung ah agrep huon tungtang thu ah ka it dan thu lain kasa maiding hi. Ka it pen in muol tung leihoina mun ah grep-huon anei hi.","title":"Grep huon gentena thu","ref":"Mat. 21.33; Mak. 12.1; Luk. 20.9"},"2":{"text":"A kimkot in lei atou kuoh a, suongte atom sienga, grepgui hoipente asuon a, alai ah innsang alam a, khunah grep suhna khuh zong atou a, tuachi’n grep ga hoitah a ga dingin alam en a, hinanleh grep-hem ahing gata hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuin Jerusalem a tengte leh Juda mite aw, kei leh ka grep huon kaal thu hing khen pieh un."},"4":{"text":"Ka grep huon tunga kana bawlsa ban ah ka bawl thei ding kana bawl khah nailou bang a um nalai ei mah?
