Grep ga-pha mama ding ka lam et-et laipi, bangzieha grep-hem hing gata mawh adiei?"},"5":{"text":"Tuin ngai un, ka grep huon tunga ka bawl ding ka hinghil ding, a imna dailing ka lamang dinga, ka haltum dinga, abaangte ka suse dinga, totchil in a um ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ka suse sieng dinga, akiselnou sah nawn sih dinga, aleitang zong akisatnen nawn sih ding hi; hinanleh loulingnei leh khau lingneiten apou khum dinga, atunga guoh zuh louna dingin meilumte zong thu ka pe nalai ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa grep huon khu Israel innkuonte ahi a, tualeh Juda mite khu grepgui deithawhuoi tah ahi uhi; Aman thukhenna dih alam en a, hinanleh ngaivawi, suhgentheina ahing um zawta hi; dihtatna a lam en a, hinanleh ngaiin kaana a um hi."},"8":{"text":"Gam zanglai a amauh maimai tenna ding mun um nawnlou khop a, inn leh inn kimat a, lou leh lou kipe a um mite atunguh agih hi.","title":"Tunggihna leh thukhenna"},"9":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n ka zahna ah thu agen a “Adihtah in inn thupi leh inn hoi tampite ateng ding umlou a nuasie in a um ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen grep-huon acre sawm in Greptui bath (8 gallon) khat mai mai piengsah bep van in, tualeh buchi homer khat kituna in ephah khat maimai apiengsah bep ding hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Zu chiatah dawn dinga zingmawng matah a thou a, adawn kham masangsie a zan sawt pipi donga hahte, tung agih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tumging leh kaiging, khuongte leh theile thuoin zu dawnkhawm in guolnop abawl ua, hinanleh Mangpa nasepte angaisang sih ua, akhut sil bawlte zong angaituo ngai vateh sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka mite’n theina atahsapzieh un sal a puimangin a umta uhi; ami zatathuoite uh gilkiel in a um ua, a mipite uh dangta in adanggaw gawpta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin sheol a kikeh lien a, akam teguollou a lien in akaah a, tuachi’n athupinate uh, amipite u’leh, akihisahnate uh tualeh akipah thanopna teng u’toh Sheol ah alut suh ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mite suhngiemin a um ding ua, mi chin ngiem sahin a um ding ua, mi kiliensah a mit tung hate akisungiemta ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh galkapte Mangpa khu vaihawmna ah tawisangin a um ding a, tualeh siengthoupa Pasian khu dihtatna ah siengthou in aum ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n belam noute atatna mun ngai uah ata diem diem ding ua, tualeh gam sesate lah a athaute mituom ten ane ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Solna khau a gitlouna kaite leh kangtalai khau a kai banga khelna kaite, tung agih hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama kinmeng henlen, “Anasep imu theina dingin kinaw hen, Israelte Siengthoupa lemguotna, imu theina dingun hing nai in, hing tung hen, chi te;"},"20":{"text":"Silhoilou silhoi chia, silhoi lah silhoilou chizel, miel lah vah chi a, vah lah miel chi zel, sil hum lah sil kha a ngai a, sil kha lah sil hum a ngaite tung agih hi."},"21":{"text":"Amauh ngaidan a pil kisate leh amauh mitmu a, thei kisate tung agih hi."},"22":{"text":"Zu dawn lam a hatte, leh zu chia hai hangsante tung agih hi."},"23":{"text":"Golguhna neh zieha migilou siem tangsah a, midihtat dihna alahmang pieh zel uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin meikuongin bupawl akahtum sieng bang in, bu-si mei in ahaltum bangin, amauh thaguite amuot bangin a um dinga tualeh apallutna uh leivui bangin aleengmang tou ding hi. Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa dan adeilou ua, Israel Misiengthoupa thu a simmaw zieh un."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa lungthahna amite tungah akuonga, amauh tungah akhut ahata a, avuo hi; tualeh muolte akilinga, amishi luongte uh kholai dungah, silnieh kibuo bangin avum hi. Tamte ziehin alungthahna akihei mang sih a akhut aha nalai lai hi."},"26":{"text":"Gamlapi akipat namte adingin puonlap alehtou dinga, kawlmonga pat amaute hankhawm dingin khutkawi amut dinga, ngai vawi amauten kintahin ahing zuon pai ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Alah ua koima agim sih ding a, akisuikha sih ding uhi, Koima a lusu sih ding ua, a imu sih ding hi; a kawnggahna uh akiphel sih dinga tualeh akedap khaute uh atan sih ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Athaltangte uh ahiem mama a, tualeh athalpite uh loisa in aum a; a sakol kengchinte uh meisa suong abang dinga, asakolleng kengte uh zong pingpei bang mai ahi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Athawmgin ukhu humpibahnei hawh abang dinga, humpibahnei lunlai bang maiin ahawh ding uhi; Ahi ahawhkhum ding ua, asa mat ding uh aman ua, bittah in apeimangpi ding ua, tualeh koiman ahundoh zou sihding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin, tuipi ging hethut bangin atung uah a hawh zoi zoi ding ua, tualeh mi’n gam ahing et uleh, Ngaiin, mielna leh lungkhamna ngen ahi a, tualeh vah khu meilum in amielsahta hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Uzziah ashi kumin Mangpa a leengtoupha sangtah a tawisanga um tunga tou ka mu a apuon tuol silin biehinn sung aluodim hi.","title":"Isai hatna leh sawlna","ref":"2 Leeng. 15.7; 2 Khang. 26.23"},"2":{"text":"Atunglam ah Seraphimte ading ua, ha guh chiet anei ua, aha nite un amaitang uh akhu ua, ha nite in akephang uh akhu ua, ha nite in aleeng uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Seraphimte khat leh khat kidawng tuo-in: “Galkapte Mangpa asiengthou hi, asiengthou hi, leitung pumpi athupina in a dim hi,” chiin akikou tuo zel uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 4.8"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh akikou thawm gingun kotpi khuomte akiling sah a, biehinn sung meikhu in adim hi.","ref":"Kihil. 15.8"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken: “Ka tung agih hi, Mangthai ka hita ve! Nephu nieh mi kahi a, nephu nieh mite lah a teng kahi; ka mit in leengpa galkapte Mangpa ka muta hi” ka chi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Seraphimte lah khat, maitam akipat mei-am taite a ate tawiin ka kungah ahing leenga,"},"7":{"text":"tua mei am in ka kam akhoi a, tualeh Aman: “Ngai vawi, tami in na nephu ka khoita a, na thulimlouna lahmang ahita a, na khelna sawpsieng ahita hi,” a chi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa aw kaza a, tua aw in, “Koi ahiei ka sawl ding, koi ahiei kou a dinga kuon ding?” achi hi. Tuachi’n ken “Tanah ka um hi, Kei hing sawl in,” ka chi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama’n: “Kuon inlen, tam mite vahil in; “Zah pen za unlen, hinanleh theisiem sih un; mu pen mu unlen, hinanleh thei thei sih un; achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 13.14,15; Mak. 4.12; Luk. 8.10; Jn. 12.40; Nasep. 28.26,27"},"10":{"text":"Tam mite lungtang khausah inlen, abilte uh bingsah inlen, amitte uh singsah in. Tuachilou in amit un amu ding ua, abil un aza ding ua, alungtang un atheisiem kha ding ua, ahing kihei kha ding ua, hundam in a um kha ding uhi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken, “Mangpa bang tanvei hiding adiei?” Ka chi hi. Tualeh Ama’n. “Khopite susiet a aum a, ateng ding umlou a, innte a um ding mi umlou a, gam sung suhsiet sieng kilkel masang sie in,"},"12":{"text":"Mangpa’n mite gamlapi a asuonkhieh a, gam sunga mun tampi taisan a a um masang sie dong ahi ding hi;"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh asungah sesawm suo se khat a um nalai dinga, tualeh ahing kile kia dinga, hinanleh haltum in a um belap ding uhi. Nahii sing lienpi ahisihleh gangpi sing lienpi kiphuasa abul a um nahlai bangin tua gam a abulte ah, chi siengthou bul khu a um ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu in Juda leengpa Uzziah tapa Jotham Jotham, tapa Ahaz, damlai in hichi ahing hi a, Siria leengpa Rezin leh Israel leengpa Ramaliah tapa Pekah Jerusalem dou dingin akuontou ua, hinanleh azou sih uhi.","title":"Immanuel chiemtena (2 Leeng. 16.5 ; 2 Khang. 28.5-15)","ref":"2 Leeng. 16.5; 2 Khang. 28.5,6"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh “Siria leh Ephraim apangkhawm uh” chi David innkuonte ava hil uhi. Tuachi’n a lungtang leh amite lungtang gamlah a sing huiin asem chienga akilin bangin akilingta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Isai kungah, “Nang leh na tapa Shear-Jashub, tuikhuh sahtapen tui lahna tawpna a, puonsawp mite lou lam ah, Ahaz kimupi dingin kuontou unlen;"},"4":{"text":"akungah, pilvang inlen, sip khin khian in umin, Rezin leh Siria leh Remaliah tapa lungthahna ziehin zau sinlen lungkesin. Amaute gel ani un meisel tumbang khu-liliei bang giap ahibou uhi."},"5":{"text":"Siria, Ephraim leh Remaliah tapa in nangma dou na ding in thu gilou aphiel ua;"},"6":{"text":"“Juda gam douin ikuontou ding ua, iva subuoi ding a, akulpi bang uh ivu-vang pieh dinga atung ua leeng vaihawm dingin Tabeel tapa ikoi ding hi,” a chi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Athu sawm uh alawching sih ding a, atangtung tuom sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen Siria lutang Damaska ahi a, tualeh Damaska lutang khu Rezin ahi bep hi. Kum sawmguh le-nga sungin Ephraim ase dim dem dinga, nam khat a simtah ahi nawn sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Ephraim lutang Samaria ahi a, tualeh Samaria lutang khu Ramaliah tapa ahi giap hi. Na gintat sih uleh tundingin na umngai sihding uh,” chi in, achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Mangpa’n Ahaz ahoupi kia a,","title":"Chiemtena dingin Immanuel"},"11":{"text":"“Mangpa na Pasian akipat in chiemtena ngen in, thuhpiin ahiei, ahisihleh tunglam sangtah in ahiei, ngen in,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Ahaz in, “Ka ngen sih dinga Mangpa zong ka ze-et sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isai in: “Nou David innkuonte aw, tuin ngaiun, mihing suh lunggim khu nou a dingin sil neu-nou ahiei mah, ka Pasian nangawn zong sulunggim nalai ding na hi u’maw?"},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa ngeiin chiemtena noute ahing pe ding hi. Ngai in nungah siengthou agai dinga, tapa anei dinga, tualeh amin dingin Immanuel a chi ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 1.23"},"15":{"text":"Ama’n silhoilou nielna dan leh silhoi telna dan athei chiengin, bawngnawidat leh khuoizu ane ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen silhoilou niel dan leh ahoi tel dan athei masangin, tua na giin leeng ni tegel taisan in a um ding hi, achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ephraim in Juda gam apawtsan ni akipat a ana tung ngai nailou nite nang leh na mite tungah leh napa innkuonte tungah Mangpa’n Asiria leengpa ahing tungsah ding hi.”","title":"Juda gam sim ding genlawhna"},"18":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin hichi ahing hi dinga, Mangpa’n Izipt luipite tan donga um thoute leh Assiria gam a um khuoite han dingin saisip atum ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh a hing pei ding ua, abawn un bangma umlouna phaijang lah leh suongpi keh kalte ah, tualeh lingkung zousie tung leh gantatna munte ah a dim ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ni main Mangpa’n Euphrates luipi gal lam a Assiria leengpa apata akawm mulmetna tem in na luzang a samte leh na keng multe aheu dinga, ahi, na khamul nangawn aheu kieu ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin mi khat in bawngla khat leh belam ni maimai akhoi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n nawitui kichingtah ziehin bawngnawidat a ne ding ua, Aziehpen gam sunga um michinin bawng nawidat leh khuoizu ane ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin hichi ahi dinga, dangka shekel sangkhat man grepgui sang khat pouna mun zousie ah, loulingnei leh khau lingneite apou ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Gamsung pumpi lingnei leh khau lingnei ngen asuohtaah ding ziehin, thalpi leh thaltang tawi in mite ahing pei ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh mi’n muol tupi a ahawsa munte nangawn ah, loulingnei leh khaulingneite na gin ziehun, koima na kuon nawn sih ding ua, bawngtalte leh belamte gamtatna mun asuohta ding hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Laibu ziel lienpi la inlen, Maher-shalal-hash-Baz tungtang mihing laikungin giel in.","title":"Isai a dinga tapa khat piehna"},"2":{"text":"Kei dinga theipitu muonhuoi siempu Uria leh Zeberekiah tapa Zekariah ka han dinga, amaun giel in achiemte ding uh, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolneinu kungah, ka haw a, tualeh amanu agai a, tapa aneita hi. Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Amin dingin Maher-shalal-Hash-Baz phuo in achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen tua naupangin kanu ka pa chia kan dan athei masangin, Assiria leeng pa’n Damaska khopi hausatna leh Samaria khopi apat gallah sumte apomang ding hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa’n ahing houpi kia a."},"6":{"text":"“Tam mite’n nem hiu hiau a luong diel diel Shiloah tuite adeisih ua, Rezin leh Ramaliah akipahpi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin ngai vawi, Mangpa’n Assiria leengpa leh athupina zousie toh amaute tungah luitui lien leh hattah aluong sah dinga, tuachi’n luiguom zousie aluonglet dinga, apieu teng adimlet ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Juda gam sungah aluong dinga, tuipi bangin aluonglet ding a, ngawng tan tumin aluong ding hi. Tualeh aha zah in Aw Immanuel nagam vailam adaapsuoh ding hi.”"},"9":{"text":"Nou namte aw, pangkhawm un suhthelthang a um ding nahi uhi. Mun gamlapi a umte zousie’n nabil uh daw unlen, na kawng uh gah un, suhnen a um ding na hi uh, kigal gingun, gal dou dingin, galvan in kithuom un."},"10":{"text":"Thu kikumkhawm un, hinanleh phatuom sih va, thu gen un, apiching sih ding, aziehpen Pasian koute toh umkhawm ahi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n khut hattah ka tunga nga pum in tambangin ahing houpi a, tam mite gamtat dan zuilou dingin ahing hil hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tam miten thu guhphiel achina tungtangte uh thu guhpiel chipi sinlen, agiinte u’zong giing sinlen, zau sihun.","ref":"1 Pet. 3.14,15"},"13":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa, Ama ngel khu susiengthou unlen, ama ahi na giin ding uh."},"14":{"text":"Ama khu na mun siengthou ahi dinga, hinanleh Israel innkuonte gel adingin kipalpuana suong leh kidalna suongpi ahi dinga, Jerusalem a tengte adingin thang leh piel ahi ding hi.","ref":"1 Pet. 2.8"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh alah ua mi tampite akipalpua ding ua, akehzah ding ua, thangah a awh ding ua, tualeh mat in a um ding uhi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tam theipina thu kaan inlen, ka nuazuite lah ah dan namkip in, chiemte in."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh ken Jakob innkuonte lah a amai phuol a um Mangpa ka ngah dinga, Ama ka kineppi ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 2.13"},"18":{"text":"Ngai vawi, keima leh Mangpa’n ahing pieh naupangte tanah ka um uhi, koute Zion muol a teng galkapte Mangpa apata Israel gam sung chiemtena leh sil lamdangte ka hi uhi.","ref":"Heb. 2.13"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh amaun na kung ua “Dawisiemte leh aisan siem a phuisamte dong un ahing chi chiengun,” miten a Pasian uh asui zoh ding uh hilou ahiei mah? Mihingin mi shi a dong zaw ding amah? Chi un."},"20":{"text":"Dan thu leh theipina thu doh ding ahi a, tam thu dungzui a thu agen sih uleh ama uah vah a umlou zieh ahi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mangbang leh gilkiel pum in apei suoh ding ua, tualeh hichi ahing hi dinga, ahing gilkiel chiengun, ahing lung himaw ding ua, vandah in aleengpa uleh a Pasian uh ahamsiet ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh leilam a en ding ua, lungdonna leh mielna, lam et beina leh lungkham mielna, amu ding ua, miellah a nawlut in a um ding uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh lunggim a umnu adingin nguina mawngmawng a um nawn sih ding hi. Nidanglai in Zebulun gam leh Naphtali gam simmaw huoi in ana umsah a, hun nukhia lam ah Jordan gal a Zentelte galili gama tuipi gei a lampite a thupisahta ding hi.","title":"Tapa pieh in i um","ref":"Mat. 4.15"},"2":{"text":"Miel nuoi a gamta miten vah thupitah amuta ua, shina lim gam a tengte tungah khovah ahing taangta hi.","ref":"Mat. 4.16; Luk. 1.79"},"3":{"text":"Nangman namte na pungsahta a, tualeh alungnopna uh na pungsah a, bu lah laia kipahna bang leh miten, galvanlah akihawm chieng ua akipah, mabangun na masangah akipah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen apuohgih puohna hahkol leh, aliengzang ua zawl leh ama bawlsepa, chieng zong Midiante zawna nia na sattawng, pieh bangin na sattawng piehta hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen Husa thupitah a kidouna phuol a, galhatte kedapte leh sisan banna puonsilte, meiphuolpi tawna dingin akizang ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen ei a dingin naupang apienga tapa, pieh in iumta hi; aliengkou ah vaihawmna akinga dinga; tualeh amin: “Lamdang, thumoppa, Bangkimbawlthei Pasian, kumtawn pa, Lemna Mang,” akichi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A gam vai hawmna leh, kilemna pundanin tawp ni anei sih ding a. David Mangtoupha tungah leh, aleenggam tunga thu pe dingin, vaihawmna leh thudihna sudet dingin, tuani akipat kumtawn dongin, galkapte Mangpa phatuomngaina in, bawl ahi ding hi.","ref":"Luk. 1.32,33"},"8":{"text":"Mangpa’n Jakob douna in thu ahah a, Israel tungah atuta hi.","title":"Ephraim tunga thukhenna"},"9":{"text":"Mi zousie, Ephraimte leh Samaria khopi a tengte leh lungtang kisathei leh ki-uongsahtah a thugente zousie’n athei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Tehleite achimta a, hinanleh suong kikhengte in ilamthana ding hi, theipi kungte akiphuata a, hinanleh Sidar singte a heng ding ihi,” achi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n Rezin melmate ama dou dingin asuhat ding a, agalte atohthou dinga, ading khawm sah ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Siriate amailam uah, tualeh Philistinte anualam uah a um ding ua, tuachi’n amaun akam uh kaah in Israelte anomval ding uhi. Tamte ziehin alungthahna adai tuom sih dinga, amaute dou in akhut aha nalai ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen amauh vopa kung lam ah mipite akihei sih ua, galkapte Mangpa zong asui tuom sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n Israel apat in alutang leh amei, tumsing kung leh abate ni khat thu in asattan ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Upa leh mizatathuoi khu alutang ahi a, zuou thu hil guolnei khu amei ahi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen tam mipite lamkaiten amauh asukhiel sah ua, Tualeh ami puite uh amangthai sah uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin atangvalte u’tungah Mangpa’n kipahna anei sih a, Pa neiloute leh meithaite tungah zong hepina anei sih ding hi. Aziehpen michin lepchie leh silhoilou bawl ngen ahi ua, tualeh kam zousie in sil mothuoi agen uhi. Tamte zousie ziehin alungthahna akiheimang sih a, amaute tung ah akhut aha nalai lai ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen gitlouna in meikuong bangin akaa a, ling le-khaute zong akatum ding a, gammang satah lahpi zong akaa-a, tunglam ah meikhu akizieltou vapual ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa thangpaina ziehin gam akatumta a, mipite pen mei a vah ding sing bang ahi ding hi. Koiman asanggampa nangawn zong ahudoh sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh akhut zietlam in amaithop ding ua, hinanleh agilkiel veve ding hi, aveilam khut un avaltum ding ua hinanleh alungkim tuom sih ding uhi, michinin ama sa ane ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Manasseh in Ephraim adou ding a, Ephraim in Manasseh adou ding hi; Amaute-gel in Juda adou khawm ding uhi; tamte zousie ziehin alungthahna akihei mang tuom sih a, akhut aha nalai lai hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thutanna dihtatloutah a thutante leh mite suhgentheina ding bep a dan thupieh gielte tung agih hi."},"2":{"text":"Ka mite lah a tasamte apat thukhenna dihna lahmang pieh a, tualeh mi zawngte lah apat hamphatna lamang ding leh meithaite galvan tom banga tom dinga kisate tualeh pa neiloute ne gam dinga a kiguongte tung agih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh gamlapi apat a gawtna leh na sietna uh ahing tun chiengin, bang chita ding nahi uoi mah? Panpina ngen a koi kunga tai ding nahi uoi mah? Tualeh na thupina uh hei ah na nuasie ta ding uoi?"},"4":{"text":"Keima louin suongkultaangte lah ah akun ding ua, tualeh tha a umte lah ah apua ding uhi. Tamte zousie ziehin alungthahna adai tuom sih a, hinanleh amaute douna in akhut aha nalai lai hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka lungthahna chieng, Assiria tung agih hi, tualeh akhut ua chiengpum khu ka lungkimlouna ahi.","title":"Assiria gawtna","ref":"Isai. 14.24-27; Nah. 1.1—3.19; Zeph. 2.13-15"},"6":{"text":"Pasian neilou namte douding leh ka thangpaina mipite dou dingin ama ka sawl a, amaute gallah banga la ding leh samat bang a man dingin ama thu ka pe dinga, kholai buonnawi chil bangin amaute chiil dingin zong thu ka pe ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Assiria in tuabang a tup ahi sih a, alungsim ah zong angaituo khasih hi. Hinanleh a tawmtham hilou in, nam tampite susiet ahi alungsim a atup zaw."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen aman: “Ka miliente zousie leengte ahi sih uh amah?"},"9":{"text":"Kalno khuo khu Karkemish khuo bang hitalou amah? Hamath khuo khu Arpad khuo bang hilou amah? Samaria khopi zong Damaska khopi bang hilou amah?"},"10":{"text":"Ka khut in milim biehna leenggamte amukheta hi, Amilim khenthute uh Jerusalem leh Samaria a milimte sangin athupi zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Samaria leh amilimte tunga ka bawl banga, Jerusalem leh a milimte tunga bawllou ding ka hiei mah?” achi chi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin hichi ahing hi dinga, Mangpa’n Zion muol tung leh Jerusalem tunga anasep zousie a tangtunsah chiengin, Assiria leengpa lungtang kisahtheina leh akiletsahna mit sanghana ziehin ka gawt ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen aman: “Ka bantha hat a tamte ka bawl ahia, tualeh ka pilna leh ka lemgel siem na ziehin nam dangte gamgi zong ka suonmanga, agoute uh kalah pieh a, tuachi’n bawngtal hang bang leengtoupha a toute ka kaikheta hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka khut in mite hausatna khu vabu bangin amuta hi; tualeh mi’n vatuite api’n aloisan nua a, alahkhawm bangun leitung pumpi ka lakhawmta hi; Tualeh ha-jap leh kamkaah a, en kiu-kieu mawngmawng koima a um sih hi.”"},"15":{"text":"Heipi ama zanga singsatpa tungah akiliensah ding amah? Ahisihleh sing-atna ama zanga sing-atpa sangin athupizaw amah? Chieng in ama lamtoupa, doptou tum henlen phohbul in sing hilou khat alehtou mawh thei diei mah? a chi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa, galkapte Mangpa’n ami hat thahoi leh thaute lah ah gawnna ahing sawl dinga tualeh athupina nuoi ah meikuong bang khat akuongsah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel vah khu meikuong ahing hi ding a, a Misiengthoupa khu meikuong ahing hi ding hi; tualeh nikhat thu in ling leh loulingneite akatum ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh agammang thupina akatum ding a, agam gasuo Hagau leh tahsa pum nasan in; tualeh china gim gawng gawp bang ahita ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n gammanglah a sing umsunte, naupang nangawn in agel phah giap banga tawm ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin hichi ahing hidinga, Israel dam nalai sunte leh Jakob innkuonte lah a na suohta sunte, amauh zougawpte tungah akingam nawn sih ding ua, Mangpa Israelte Misiengthoupa tungah thutahin akingam zawta ding uhi.","title":"Israel dam sunte"},"21":{"text":"Adam sunte akia-kia ding ua, Jakob umsunte Pasian kungah akile kia ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen Aw Israel na mite tuipi pieu a senel bangin tam nan uleh, adam sunte maimai ahing kinuale kia ding uh a, susietna thutanna khu ditatna toh aluonglet ding hi.","ref":"Rom. 9.27"},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa Pasian in tawpna tung ngei dinga aguot khu agam pumpi laikim tah ah atang tun ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin galkapte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, “Zion a teng ka mite aw, Assiriate giing sih un, Izipt mite bawl bangin, phohbul in ahing sat dinga, tualeh achieng na tungah aleh ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen tomnou sungin ka lungthahna abei dinga, tualeh ka lungthahna khu amaute manthaina ahi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh galkapte Mangpa’n Oreb suongpi a Midiante atha lai bangin, amaute dou dingin vuohna khauhuolte atohthou dinga; Ama’n tuipi tunga achieng avihtou lai a, Izipt gama sil tung bang ahi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin hichi ahing hi dinga, na liengkou apat apuohgihte lahmang ahita dinga, tualeh na ngawnga kipat in ahahkol lahmang ahita ding hi, Ahi sathaunu ziehin hahkol khu suhsiet in a umta ding hi.”"},"28":{"text":"Ama Aiath khuo ahing tunga, Migron khuo tawnin apeisuoh a, Mikmash khuo ah agalthuomte akoi hi."},"29":{"text":"Muol dung tawn in apei a, Geba khuo ah agieh hi, Ramah khuo a zau a, Saul khuo Gibeah ataimang hi."},"30":{"text":"Aw Gallim tanu, nahpitahin kikou in, Laish khuo dongin kizasah inlen; Aw Anathoth hepihuoi."},"31":{"text":"Madmenah khuo zau in ataimanga, Gebim khuo a tengte kibutna ding sui in ataizah uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ni mama in Nob khuo ah ataam nalai dinga, Zion tanu muol leh Jerusalem muol khu akhuttum athinkhum ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Ngaivawi, Mangpa, galkapte Mangpa’n chizathuoi tahin aba mengte asattan dinga, asang tuomte aphua ding a tualeh akisatheite akaingiem ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Aman gammang satahte khu heipi in aphua dinga, tualeh Lebanon gammang zong mihatpa mai ah apua ding hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesse kungpi akipat aba khat ahing mengdoh dinga, Tualeh ahuite akipat in, aba ahing khangdoh ding hi.","title":"Lemna leenggam","ref":"Kihil. 5.5; 22.16"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa Hagau, pilna leh theisiemna hagau, lemguotna leh hatna hagau, theina leh Mangpa giinna hagau, atungah a um ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Akipahna khu Mangpa giindan siemna ahi ding hi; tualeh amit a amu bangin thukhenna abawl sih dinga, abil a azah bangin thutanna abawl sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh dihtatna toh mi zawngte thu akhen pieh ding a, Tualeh leitunga minunnemte adingin khentuom neilou in thutanna abawl zaw ding hi. Ama’n akam a chiengpum in leitung asat ding a, tualeh akama hu in migiloute athat ding hi.","ref":"2 Thes. 2.8"},"5":{"text":"Dihtatna khu akawng gahna ahi dinga, tualeh ginumna khu atai gahna ahi ding hi.","ref":"Eph. 6.14"},"6":{"text":"Ngie khu belamnou toh a umkhawm ding ua, kamkei toh kelnou alum khawmta ding hi; tualeh bawngnou leh humpibahnei lunlai leh gan vah thaute a lumkhawmta ding hi; tualeh naupang neu khat in amaute apui kawi kawita ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 65.25"},"7":{"text":"Bawngpi leh vompi loupa pet in atakhawmta ding ua, anoute uh a lumkhawmta ding uhi. Humpibahnei in bawngtal bangin bu pawlte aneta ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Naupang nawi nelaite muoltan ko gei ah aki apmaita ding ua, naupang nawi neh tawp pan panten, gulsie ko sung akhut un asawhta ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ka muol siengthou zousie ah kisuh natna leh kisuhsietna a um nawnta sih ding hi. Aziehpen tui in tuipi atuomsuoh bangin, leitung Mangpa theinain adim ding hi.","ref":"Haba. 2.14"},"10":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin, Jesse zungpi khu namchin a dingin chiemtena in a ding diinga, Aziehpen Jentelte’n Ama asui ding ua, tualeh akhawlna mun khu thupitah ahi ding hi.","ref":"Rom. 15.12"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tua ni chiengin, Mangpa’n amite ashimawh nuasie a umsunte nuapuidoh kia dingin; Assiria gam leh Izipt gam akipat Pathros gam leh Ethiopia gam akipat Elam gam leh Shinar gam akipat Hamath khuo leh tuipi pang gamte leh tui laisie gamte apat a puikhawm kia dingin Mangpa’n anivei na dingin akhut aha kia ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Aman namte adingin chiemtena puonlap atadoh dinga, Israel kinotdohte apuikhawm dinga, Juda taizahte, leitung ning li apat in apuikhawm ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ephraim thangsietna abeita dinga, Juda mite lungkham mangbatna tunte sattan ahita ding ua, Ephraim in Juda athangsiet nawn sih ding hi. Tualeh Juda in zong Ephraim asubuoi nawn sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute khu tumlam manaw in aleeng suh ding ua, Philistinte liengkou ah atu ding ua, tualeh ni suona lam a mite ani un asimkhawm ding ua, Edom leh Moab tungah khut aha ding ua, tuachi’n Ammon miten athu uh amangta ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Izipt tuipi lei banga zum khu nasatahin asuse dinga, tualeh huipi lum-vapom alangsah dinga, tuipi tungah akhuttum aleh dinga, tualeh luidung sagi suoh ding khopin asat dinga, tuachi’n mite akengphang u’zong pahlou in agalkai ding uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 16.12"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt gam akipat a ahing peitou lai ua, Israelte dinga lamlien ana um bangin, Amite ashimawh umsun nuasie a umte dingin, Assiria gam akipat in lamlienpi ana umta ding hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin nangman: “Aw Mangpa nang ka hing phat ding hi Ka tungah lungthah nanlachin zong, na lungthahna akiheimangta a, nangman na hing hamuonta hi.","title":"Messiah leenggam tunga lungdam na"},"2":{"text":"“Ngai in Pasian ka hinna ahi a, Ka muong dinga, ka zau nawn sih ding hi. Aziehpen Jehovah Mangpa khu, kahatna leh ka la ahi a, Ama ka hundamna zong ahing hita hi;” na chi ding hi.","ref":"Pawt. 15.2; Late. 118.14"},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin hundamna tuikhuh akipat in kipahtahin tui na tawita ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin nouten “Mangpa phat unlen, Amin lou unlen, asil bawlte Zentelte lah ah theisah unlen, Amin tawisanga um ding ahi, chi’n phuong un."},"5":{"text":"“Mangpa kungah pahtawina la sa un, Aman sil thupite abawltah ziehin, tam khu leitung pumpi ah theisahin a umta hi."},"6":{"text":"Zion a tengte aw, ngaitah in kikou unlen, nuom in la sa un, aziehpen Israelte Siengthoupa na lah uah,” thupitah in a um hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon tunga puohgih Amoz tapa Isai in ana mu khu;","title":"Babilon tunga genlawhna","ref":"Isai. 47.1-15; Jer. 50.1—51.64"},"2":{"text":"Mi liente a alut theina ding un muolvum sang tungah chiemtena puonlap tahkhie unlen, aw ngaitah in amauh han unlen, khut zap un."},"3":{"text":"Keima mama in, ka suhsiengthoute thu ka peta hi, ka lungthahna sutangtung dingin, ka galkap hangsante leh, ka pahtawina nuomsate zong ka hanta hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngai un, mipi tampi husa banga muol tunga thawmging vengvung khu ngai un, Mi atam atam husa, namchin leenggam kikhawm-khawmte husa chieh vengvung khu, Galkapte Mangpa’n kidouna adinga galkapte akhopkhawm ahita hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute gam, gamlapi kawlmonga kipat in ahing kuon ua, Gam pumpi suse dinga Mangpa thangpaina galvanzah ahi ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Kap in mau vengvung un, Mangpa ni anaita hi, Bangkimbawlthei akipat a manthaina hing tung bang mai in ahing tung ding hi.","ref":"Joel. 1.15"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin khut zousie azaw dinga, tualeh michin lungtang azunmang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh azau ding ua, natna leh thuohgimna in amaute amanta dinga, numei nau vei bangin natna thuoh in a um ding ua, khat leh khat lamdang kisa tuoin amai uh meikuong abang ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ngai in, gam suse ding leh asung a, mikhielte mangthaisah dingin, Mangpa ni khu thangpaina leh lungthah na, giloutah leh zauhuoitah toh, ahing tung ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen van aasite leh bawm luoiten avah uh ataangsah nawn sih ding ua, ni a hing suoh chiengin mielsah in a um dinga, tualeh hapi in zong avahna ataangsah sih ding hi.","ref":"Ezek. 32.7; Mat. 24.29; Mak. 13.24,25; Luk. 21.25; Kihil. 6.12,13; 8.12"},"11":{"text":"Leitung agitlouna ziehin ka gawt dinga, migiloute zong athulimlounate ziehun ka gawt ding hi, tualeh mikiliensahte uonghamna ka tawpsah dinga, tualeh mi kisatheite zauhuoina ka luoingiem ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihingte khu sana siengset sanga vaangzaw in ka bawl dinga, Ophir sana tang sanga vaangzaw in ka bawl ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin galkapte Mangpa thangpaina leh, alungthahna zauhuoina niin vante ka lohling dinga, tualeh leitung amun apat akisuon mang ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Gamvah mi dellai sasan bang leh, ching ding neilou belam bang ahi dinga, mi chin amauh mite lam ah akihei ding ua, tualeh michin amauh gam chiet ah atailut ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Michin akimukha pouma dawtpailetin a um dinga, tualeh koipou matkhah a um pouma, namsau in ashi ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Atate u’zong amitmu ngel uah tuoltang satna in akinei ding a aguoi dimdem ding uhi; a innte uh akibulu dinga, azite uh pawngsuol in a um ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ngai in, amauh dou dingin Medete ka tohthou ding a, amaun dangka zong angaisah sih ding uhi.","title":"Babilon sietna"},"18":{"text":"Athalpite un tangvalte athatgam ding a, naubu apata piengkhe pouma tungah hepina malmal anei sih ding ua, amit un naupangte akhawi tuom sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Babilon leenggamte thupina, Kaldea mite kisahtheipi kilawmna khu, Pasian in asuhmang chiengin Sodom leh Gomorrah abangta ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 19.24"},"20":{"text":"Bangchihtan in mi ateng nawn sih dinga, akhang akhangin koiman aluo nawn sih ding hi; khunah Arab miten apuon inn uh azah nawn sih ding ua, belam chingten khunah abelamhonte uh, alumsah nawn sih ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh khum gamdai a gamsate alumta ding uh a, tualeh a innte uah simbute adim dinga, Gamva kengsangte ateng ding ua, sakelte khunah aki-apmaita ding uhi.","ref":"Isai. 34.14; Zeph. 2.14; Kihil. 18.2"},"22":{"text":"Akulpi venna innsangte uah ngiate aham ding ua, aleeng innpi nuomtahsungah si-alte aham ding uhi. Ahun a hing tung pai ding a, anite suhsau ahi sih ding hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n Jakob tungah lainatna anei dinga, tualeh Israelte atel kia dinga amauh gam mama ah atengsah ding hi. Tualeh gamdang miten amaute azop ding ua, Jakob innkuonte abel denta ding uhi.","title":"Israel leenggam tun dingna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n mite’n amauh azawpi ding ua, amun uah atut ding uhi; tualeh Israel innkuonten amaute, Mangpa gamsungah, suohpate leh suohnute’n aneita ding uhi; Tualeh amauh sal a nei mite khu, sal in alenei zawta ding ua, amauh bawlgentheite tungah vai ahawmta ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh na lungkhamna apat, na zauna apat leh nasem ding a bawl a na umna na koltanna hasatah apat bang Mangpa’n nou Israel ang khawldamsah hun chiengin,","title":"Babilon leengpa puana"},"4":{"text":"Tami paunah Babilon leengpa elhouna a zang pum in na kikou khum dinga, “Bangchidan a mi bawlgentheipa khu khawl ata e! Sana khopi asip dide tamawh a! na chi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa’n migiloute chieng leh vaihawmte leengchieng asattanta hi."},"6":{"text":"Thangpaina pum a mipite tawplou a vuo vuo-a lungthah pum a namte tunga vaihawm mi khu, gawt in a um a tualeh koiman adal sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Leitung pumpi atawldamta a, asip dide a, la sain akikoukhie uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi, Saipras singte leh Lebanon a sidar singte nangawn na tungah lungdam in, suhngiem a na um akipat in, koute hing phua ding koima a um nawn sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Nuoilam a Sheol nang hing na tuoh ding ngahlain aphe vengvunga, nangma dingin mi shite tohthou in a um ua, leitunga milien zousie leh nam chin a leengte zousie a leengtoupha ua kipat in akaithouta hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute zousie in na kungah thu agen ding ua, nang zong koute banga hatlou nahita maw? Nang zong koute bang nata ve maw? ang chi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Na kithupisahna na tum ging husa gingngai tengtoh Sheol a puisuh in a umta hi. Na nuoi ah than akipha dim a, na tungah lungnouten ang tuom ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Aw Lusifer phalvah tapa, Bangchidan a van akipata hing kesuh na tai? Nang namchin suzawngkhalpa, bang achileh lei lah a satkhiet suh a um natai mah!","title":"Lusifer kiehna","ref":"Kihil. 8.10; 9.1"},"13":{"text":"Na lungtang in van ah ka kaltou dinga Pasian aasite tungah ka mangtoupha ka domsang ding a, maltawp a kikhopna muol ah ka tou ding hi, na chita hi.","ref":"Mat. 11.23; Luk. 10.15"},"14":{"text":"Meilum sangpente tunglam peh ah ka kaltou dinga, Tungnung Pen bangin ka um ding hi, nachi viel hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Sheol kokhuh thuhpi tawpa puisuh a um ding na hi."},"16":{"text":"A hing mu pouma in ahing en saal ding ua, tampa himaw leitung sulinga leenggam zousie kilingsahpa, chi’n ahing ngaituo ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Leitung gamdai banga bawla, tualeh akhopite susie a, asuongkul taangte a innlam a nuapeisah nuomloupa ahing chi ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Namchin leengte zousie abawn un a inn chiet uah athupina u’toh a lum ua a imu chiet uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh nangpen ahunlou a pieng, kidah-huoitah bangin, na hankhuh apata paidoh in na umta hi. Namsau a dawtpaileta tha a umte, hankhuh suongte donga peisuhte bang leh miten mishi luong atotchil bangmai nahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Na gam na suseta a, na mipite na tha ziehin, alah uah amaute toh vuikhawm a umlou ding na hi. “Silhoilou bawlte hahlesuonte min akilou kha sih ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Apu apate uh khelna ziehin atate uh that dingin kigingkhol masa un, gam luo dinga ahing khandoh louna ding u’leh leitung pumpi khopite a dimsah louna ding un.”"},"22":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa’n amauh dou dingin ka kisa ding hi,” achi hi, “Babilon akipat in min leh ashimawh umsunte hahlesuonte ka sattan ding, Mangpa’n achi hi.","title":"Babilon suhsiet na"},"23":{"text":"Babilon gam sakute tenna ding leh tui leh buonnaang kihal ka suohsah dinga, suhsietna munphie in ka phiet nalai ding hi,” galkapte Mangpa’n, achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa akichiemta a, “Pelloin ka geel bangin ahing tung ding hi, tualeh ka tup leh guotsa bangin a um ding hi.","title":"Assiria susietna","ref":"Isai. 10.5-34; Nah. 1.1—3.19; Zeph. 2.13-15"},"25":{"text":"Ka gam sungah Assiria ka khenthang dinga, ka muol tungte kengin ka tuonchil ding hi. Tuachi’n amaute apat in a hahkol a sutkhe dinga, aliengkou ua kipat in apuohgih uh ka lamang ding hi.”"},"26":{"text":"Tami ahi, leitung pumpi adinga ka tup leh ka guot, tualeh tami ahi nam pumpi tung a khut kizah khu."},"27":{"text":"Mangpa’n ana tupsa khu koi ahiei dal thei ding? Tualeh akhut azahta a, koi ahiei nua heikia thei ding?"},"28":{"text":"Lengpa Ahaz shi kumin tami puohgih kigen khu ana tangtungta hi.","title":"Philistinte puohgih","ref":"2 Leeng. 16.20; 2 Khang. 28.27"},"29":{"text":"“Aw nou Philistin zousiete, nouma ahing satna chieng akitan ziehin lungnuom in kipah sih un, gulpi zungpi akipat in gul gukha ahing pawtdoh dinga, tualeh aga khu gul leengthei zauhuoitah ahi ding hi.","ref":"Jer. 47.1-7; Ezek. 25.15-17; Joel. 3.4-8; Amos. 1.6-8; Zeph. 2.4-7; Zek. 9.5-7"},"30":{"text":"Mi zawngte tamasaten neh amu ding ua, mi tasamte bittah in alum ding ua, hinanleh nangma hahlesuonte kiel in ashi ding ua, tualeh ashimawh umsunte, kiel in athat ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Kotpite aw kap in mau un, Aw khopi kikoukhie in, nou Philistin zousiete na zunmang siengta un, aziehpen mallam akipat meikhu hing pawt ding ahi, tualeh ahun guotsate ah koima amatangin a umsih ding hi.”"},"32":{"text":"Mi’n nam thangkoute bang chi’n adawngta ding uoi? “Mangpa’n Zion amukheta a, amite lah a gentheite tua sungah akibu ta ding uhi.”"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moab puohgih khu, zankhat thu a Moab gam a Ar khopi suhsietin a um a, bangmalou a bawl ahita, zankhat thu a Moab gam Kir khopi suhsiet ahiziehin, Moab suhmangthai ahita hi.","title":"Moab sietna ding genna","ref":"Isai. 25.10-12; Jer. 48.1-47; Ezek. 25.8-11; Amos. 2.1-3; Zeph. 2.8-11"},"2":{"text":"Ama biehinn leh Dibon dongin apeitou a, munsangte a kap dingin apeitou ua, Moab in Nebo leh Medeba akaa khum ding hi. Alutangte zousie uh akiheu kieu ding a, khamul teng zong akiheu kieu ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A kholai lampite uah sai-ip puon asil ding ua, a inn tungte uleh akholai dungte uah michin nasatah in kap in amau ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Heshbon leh Elealeh akikoukhe ding ua, akikou aw uh Jahaz tandongah akiza ding hi; Tuaziehin Moab galkap galvan a kivonte akikoukhe ding ua, akawngte uh akithing ding a ahinna uh patau in achi tunding hi."},"5":{"text":"Moab ziehin ka lungtang akikou dinga, a galtaite Zoar khuo atai ua, bawngla kumthum a upa bang maiin, Luhith kholam ah kap kawm in akaltou ding ua, Honoraim lampi ah sietna ding kakhumin akikou ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen, Nimrim tuite suhsietin a um dinga, hampa hingte avuoimang siengta a; hampate apuata, hampa hing mawngmawng a um nawn sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin anei alamte u’leh, agou kholkhawmte uh huisum luita lam ah, agalte un apomang sieng ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen kap a akikouna aw uh Moab gamgi kim vel ah atungta hi; Aka le maunate uh Eglaim leh Beer Elim atungta hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen Dimon tuite sisan in adim sieng dinga, Dimon tungah atamzawsem ka tungsah nalai ding hi. Moab akipata taidohte leh agama shi mawh umsunte tungah humpibahneite ka sawl ding hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gam vaihawmte kungah Sela akipat in gamdai dongin, Zion tanu muol tandongin belamnou hah un.","title":"Moab sietna"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen va abu apata kiheudoh a leeng kawi kawite bangin, Moab tanute Arnon lui kaanna ah a um ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"“Hing lemguotpieh unlen vai hing hawm piehun, suntanglai in na him zanlai bangin bawl inlen, akinotdohte phuol inlen, galtai suohtate man sahsin."},"4":{"text":"Aw Moab ka mi nawdohte na kung uah tengsah tadi inlen, amaute susepa akipat in akibutna uh hi in. Sum lahpieh mi abei dinga, Suse mi atawpta hi; mi nuoisiete zong gamsung apat suhmangin aumta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hepina toh mangtoupha tunding ahita dinga, tualeh mi khat thutah in David puon inn sungah atou dinga, vaihawmna dih sui in thu akhen dinga, tualeh dihtatna atungsah pai ding hi.”"},"6":{"text":"Moab kisahtheina thu leh akiletsah mama nate, aki-ot sahnate, akiletsahna leh alungthah dante kana zata uhi; hinanleh azuou thu gente bangmalou ahi bou hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin Moabte, Moab gam a dingin kap leh mau in a um ding ua, michinteng kap in amau ding uhi. Ker-hareseth a suongphumte ziehin na suun ding uh, pellou a vuoh in a um ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen Heshbon loute atulta a, Sibmah grepguite avuoita hi; namchin milienten grepgui hoi penpente asutan siengta ua, tuate khu Jazer khuo dongin azam a, gamdai tandong ah a zam lut ua, abate azam sau sengseng a, tuipi ah azam galkai uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jazer grepgui khu Sibmah grepgui ka-in ka kakhum ding a: Aw Heshbon leh Elealeh, ka hitui ka hing buohkhum ding hi; Aziehpen na nipilai theigate uleh na bulahte uh tunga galdouna kikou aw atawpta hi."},"10":{"text":"Thei huonte tunga kipahna lahmang ahita a, lou hoitah akipat in lungnopna zong akilamangta hi; tualeh grep huonte ah la akisa nawn sih dinga, kikou husa zong a umnawn sih ding hi; grep chilna khuh ah koiman uoin achilkhe nawn sih ding ua, grep la a akikouna uh ka tawpsahta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka lungtangin gawsem ging bangin Moab asuun a, tualeh ka lungsim sung lam ah Kir-Hereseth suunna a um hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh munsangte a Moab ahing kisuhgim akimu chiengin, thungen dingin amunsiengthou ah ahing pei ding a, hinanleh alawching sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tam thu nidanglai a Moab tungtang a, Mangpa’n ana gensa ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin Mangpa’n ana genta a, “Kilaw mite kum sim banga sim a, kum thum sungin Moab thupina leh amipi zousiete toh simmawhuoi tah a bawl in a um dinga, asuohta sunte zong tawmnou khat ahi ding ua, azawngkhal mama ding uhi;” achi hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami Damaska khopi tungtang a puohgih kigen khu ahi. Ngaiun, Damaska khu khopi ahina atawpta dinga; tualeh innchim kisevum ahita ding hi.","title":"Damaska mawpaina","ref":"Jer. 49.23-27; Amos. 1.3-5; Zek. 9.1"},"2":{"text":"Aroer khopite zong nuasie in aumta a, belamhonte gamtatna ahita dinga, khunah alum ding ua, koiman azausah nawn sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ephraim apat in kulpite abei dinga, Damaska akipat in leenggam abei ding hi. Tualeh Siria mi ashimawh umsunte khu Israel tate thupina ahita ding uhi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuani chiengin Jakob na thupina suhngiemin aum dinga, tualeh atahsa thauna zong ahing gawngta ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n bu lapa’n bu vuite akhut a alah a butangte alahkhawm bang ahi ding hi; tualeh Rephaim phaijanga buvui lapa bang ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinapiin grep sang kinuasie bangin a um nalai dinga, mi’n Olive sing anuhthop chienga adawn dang lam a aga ni leh thum toukhat um bang in, abazamte dawnlam ah li tou nga tou aum ding; Israelte Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin mi’n ama siempa lam a en dinga, Israelte Misiengthoupa azatat ta ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aman akhutsuoh uh maitamte a en nawn sih dinga, akhutme ua abawl uh Ashera songlaite ahisihleh gimnamtui halna maitamte zong azatat nawn sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin a khopi dettahte u’khu adawn vum a singba kinuasie leh Israelte zieh a ataisansa uh munte abang dinga, lou gam asuoh siengta ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen na hundamna uh Pasian na manghilta ua, na hatna uh suongpi na theipha nawn sih uhi. Tuaziehin singkung kilawmtahte nasuon ding ua, tuanah aba tuomte phut lut in na zop ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Na suonni in na khangsah pai dinga, tualeh zingmawng chiengin na chi na pahpalsah ding hi; hinanleh bu lahna khu lungkhamna leh natna thupitah ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuipi luong ging banga, mipi tampi husa neite aw, tualeh tuipi hattah luong ging banga ging zoizoi namte na tung uh agih hi."},"13":{"text":"Namte tui tampite luong ging bangin ging henhon bang nan uleh Pasian in amaute aphawh dinga, gamlapi ah ataimang ding uhi. Muol tunga bushi huiin amut leeng bang leh pingpei mai a sil khat kilia bangin del in a um ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n envawi, nitah lam in sietna chizat huoi ahing tunga, phalvah masangin ama aum nawn sih hi. Tami ei hing bulute tanvou ahi a, ahing tomgamte vang etna ahi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ethoipia gam luigal lam a, ahazah lim nuoi a um gam tung agih hi.","title":"Ethiopia tunga thu kigente","ref":"Zeph. 2.12"},"2":{"text":"Tuipi tunga kibawl gunkuongte a palai sawlte, Nou thangkou taihatte aw, din sang zetzot leh vun mam het hot namte kungah peiun, achiil apat a tutan a nam zauhuoite kungah peiun; nam thahat leh guoltungtuong agam uh luiten akhenzah gam ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nou khovel a um zousiete leh leitunga tengte aw, muol tunga chiemtena diallap akhai laiin enun, tualeh pengkul amut chiengin ngai un."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n ka kungah tambangin agen hi, “Kei pen ka kitawldam dinga, ka tenna mun akipat in ka gal et dinga nisa tang nuoi a kholum siengtah bangleh bulah kholum lai a meizun bangin ka gal et ding hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen grep law hun masanga, apate aheu a, apate grep puom ahing suoh hun chiengin, Aman azihdawnte khu aheuna temta in a attan ding hi, tualeh abazamte aheungim ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuate khu muol a sasiel ne vate leh gamsate adinga nuasie ahi ding uhi. Sasiel ne vate’n tuate nipi sungin ann in asen ding ua, leitung gamsaten phalbi sungin ann in asen ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin mi sang zehzawhte leh vun mamte leh achiil apat a tutan a nam ginhuoiten galkapte Mangpa kungah silpiehte ahing tawi ding a, nam thupi totden a um, agam uh luiten akhenzah ten, galkapte Mangpa min umna Zion muol ah silpiehte ahing tawi ding uhi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Izipt tungtanga puohgih kigen khu, Ngaiin, meipi hattah tunga tuongin Izipt gam tungah ahing tung dinga, Izipt mite lungtang asung uah a zunmang ding hi.","title":"Izipt tungtanga thukigente","ref":"Jer. 46.2-26; Ezek. 29.1—32.32"},"2":{"text":"Izipt mite leh Izipt mite ka kidousah dinga, michin in ama sanggampa adou dinga, michin in ama innveng adou dinga, khopi leh khopi akidou dinga, leenggam leh leenggam akidou ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt mite hagau asung uah ahawmguoh in a um dinga, alemguotna uh ka suse ding hi. Tuachi’n milimte leh bum siemte, dawi siemte leh aisan siemte a dong ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Izipt mite khu thuneitu giloutah khat khut ah ka pekhe dinga, tualeh leeng ginhuoitah khat in atung uah vai ahawm ding hi, Mangpa galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuipi akipat tuite akang dinga, tualeh luipi akangsan dinga, agaw ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Lui dungte anamse dinga, kivenbitna luitate akiem dinga, pumpengte leh phaipheng phungte a gaw sieng ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Luipi gei leh luipi pieu a pumpeng kung poute leh luipi panga haichi kichiing zousie avuoi sieng dinga, nawmangin a um ding ua, a um nawnsih ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Nga man mite’n a suun ding ua, Nile luidunga ngakuoi khai mite zousie in akaa ding uhi, tualeh tui tunga lensepte’n zong athuohgim ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuathamlou in, puonmalngat khau bawl a nasemte alungke ding ua, tualeh puon vam gaan mite azala ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aneh suina suongphum akise gawp dinga, tualeh sum law a nasem zousie alunggim ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Zoan vaihawm miliente amo tahtah uhi; Pharaoh mipil lemguotpiten thu mothuoi ahil uhi. Bangchidan a Pharaoh kunga, “Kei mipil tapa ka hi, khanglui lai a leengte tapa ka hi,” nachi thei ahiei?"},"12":{"text":"Hei sunga um ahi uoi? Na mipilte heilang a um ahi uoi? Tu in galkapte Mangpa’n Izipt gam tunga asiltup amauten thei uhenlen hing hil uleh asih diei!"},"13":{"text":"Zoan miliente ahing mota uh a, Noph miliente solzouin a umta uhi; agam sunga namte kingahna Izipt khu puimangin a umta hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa’n Izipt mite lah ah lung-apna hagau akoi a, tualeh zukhammi aluoh a ahawi dengdong bangin, Izipt mite anasep chinteng uah abawlkhiel sahta hi."},"15":{"text":"Izipt mite adingin lutangin ahiei, meiin ahiei, tumsing ba in ahiei, pumpengin ahiei, bawlpieh thei bangma a um nawn sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuani chiengin Izipt mite numei abang ding ua, galkapte Mangpa’n atung ua akhut athinkhum ziehin zau in achitun ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Juda gam khu Iziptte adingin chizat-huoitah ahi dinga, amin uh loukha pouma azau ding uhi, atung ua tung ding galkapte Mangpa silguotte ziehin."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Izipt gamsunga khopi ngate, Kanaan ham in aham ding ua, galkapte Mangpa kungah akichiem ding uhi; khopi khat khu sietna khopi akichi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Izipt gam laikim tah ah Mangpa dingin maitam khat a um dinga tualeh agam zul ah Mangpa adingin suongkhuom khat akiphut ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua suong kiphut khu Izipt gam a galkapte Mangpa adingin chiemtena leh theipitu ahi ding hi; aziehpen sugenthei mite ziehin Mangpa ahan ding ua, tualeh aman amaute adingin hundampa silbawtheitah leh hattah, asawl dinga, tuachi’n amauh ahundoh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt ah Mangpa akitheita dinga, tuani chiengin Izipt miten Mangpa atheita ding ua, kithoina leh sillat alan ding ua, Ahi, Mangpa kungah akichiem ding ua, atangtun ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Iziptte asat dinga, avothop dinga, asudam ding hi; tualeh Mangpa kungah ahing kinuale kia ding ua, Aman angetna uh angaikhe dinga, amauh adamsah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Izipt akipat in Assiria gam tan dongin lamlien khat a um dinga, tuachi’n Assiriate, Izipt gam ah ahaw ding ua, tualeh Iziptte zong Assiria gam ah ahaw ding uhi. Tuachin Izipt miten Assiriate toh Pasian nna asemkhawmta ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin, Israel, Izipt leh Assiria toh thumte lah a khat ahi dinga, agamsung uah guolzawlna ahita ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n “Ka mi Iziptte leh ka khutsuoh Assiriate leh ka goutan Israelte guolzawl in um hen,” chiin aguolzawl ding hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Assiria leengpa Sargon in a galkap lamkai lienpen Tartan asawl lai a, Ashdod ahing tun kum in, Ashdod adou a, alata hi.","title":"Izipt leh Ethiopia, Assiria in asuhsiet ding genna"},"2":{"text":"Tuami hunlai main Mangpa’n Amoz tapa Isai kam zangin thu agen a; “Kuon inlen na kawng a sai-ip puon sutkhie inlen, na kenga kedap sutkhie in,” chi’n agen hi. Ama’n tuabangin abawl a, guohtang leh keng guoh in apei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n “Ka suohpa Isai in Iziptte tung leh Ethiopiate tunga chiemtena leh sillamdang ding a, kum thum sung saguoh leh kedap but lou a avah bangin,"},"4":{"text":"Assiria leengpan Izipt mi suongkul taangte leh Ethiopia saltangte ateh akhangin saguoh leh keng guoh in, tualeh tawdoh sain Iziptte zalahna dingin apuimang ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n akinepna pen uh Ethiopiate leh akithupisahna pen uh Izipt ziehin lunggim leh maizum in a umta ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin tami luipi gei a teng te’n En un, i muonpen leh eite hing panpi ding leh hing hunkhe dinga itaina uh Assiria lah hichi ahita a, bang ichi suohtatta ding uoi?” achi ding uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuipi gei a gamdai puohgih khu tami ahi: Simlam a pingpei apeisuoh bangin, gamdai akipat leh gam zauhuoi a kipat in ahing pei hi.","title":"Babilon puana"},"2":{"text":"Mengmuna lunggim huoitah ka kungah phuon in a uma, lepchietah a bawl miin lepchietah in abawl a, mangthaisah mi in amangthaisah hi. Aw Elam peitou in, Aw Media imkhum in, Keima’n athum leh maunate uh ka beisah ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka kawng natna in adim a, numei nauvei natna bangin, natna in ahing manta hi; ka zah in ka kunsuh a, ka mu in kalungkham hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka lungtang abata a, zauna in ahing chizasahta hi; ka ngahla zan khu, kei a dinga zauna zan asuohsahta hi."},"5":{"text":"Annkuong lui unlen, galvenna innsangah veng mi koi unlen, ne unlen dawn un, nou miliente aw, thou unlen lum khu sathau nu un!"},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n ka kungah tambangin agen hi, “Pei inlen galveng mi koi inlen, ama’n amu pouma phuongzah heh."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n sakolleng khat toh sakol tung tuong kop khat leh sabiltung leengkai leh sangawngsau leengkai amu a, pilvang tah leh ngaisahna thupitah toh angai khe kilkel hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n humpibahnei bangin akikou a, “Ka Mangpa sun chiengin galvenna innsang tungah ka ding ngitnget a, zan chinin ka galvenna mun ah ka um ngitnget hi."},"9":{"text":"En vawi, tanah sakolleng a tuong mi leh sakol tungtuong mi akop-kop in ahing pei uhi, chiin akikou hi. Tualeh Ama’n ahing dawnga, “Babilon apuata, apuata amilim bawlthute zousie, lei lah ah akeehzahta hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Kihil. 14.8; 18.2"},"10":{"text":"Aw ka buphuol, ka phuol a butang zapsiengsate galkapte Mangpa, Israelte Pasian akipat a ka zah noute kungah ka phuongzahta hi."},"11":{"text":"Dumah tungtanga puohgih khu tami ahi. Aman Seir muol a kipat in kei ahing han a, “Galvengpa zan bang achi tai? Galvengpa zan bang achi tai?” a chi hi.","title":"Dumah (Edom) tungtang genlawhna"},"12":{"text":"Galvengpa’n a dawnga, “Zingmawng hiding hita tualeh zan zong hing tung hita, na kan nop leh kan inlen, hing kilekia in” achita hi."},"13":{"text":"Arabia puohgih khu tami ahi, Aw Nou Dedan mi ahonhon a khuolzin Arabia gamlah ah na gieh ding uhi.","title":"Arabia puona"},"14":{"text":"Aw Tema gam a tengten, dangtahte a dingin tui ahing tawi ua, ataimangte tanghou toh ana lamdawn uhi."},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen amauh namsaute leh namsau kidohsate akipat, thalpi kiluoisa akipat leh kidouna huoisetah akipat a taimang ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n tambangin ka kungah agen hi, “Sum thalawte kum sim banga sim, kum khat sungin Kedarte thupina zousie abei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh thalkap lah a suohta umsun leh Kedar mite lah a mihat phaza akiem hiei hiei ding hi; aziehpen Israelte Mangpa Pasian in ana gensa ahita hi,” achi hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mengmuna phaijang puohgih tami ahi. Bang nachi na uh ahiei, na bawn ua inntunga na kaltou sieng uh?","title":"Jerusalem tungtang genlawhna"},"2":{"text":"Lungnopna husa a dim noute, khopi nunnuom leh khopi buoi vengvungte, na mi kithatte namsau a kithat ahisih a, kidouna a shi zong ahisih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Na vaihawmte zousie ataizah khawmta ua, thalkap mite kaan in a um uhi, Nangma sung a um zousie kaankhawm in a um ua, gamlapi apat a taimangte khu."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ken, “Hing ensih unlen lelam en un, ka mite tanute gallah a kilate zieha hasetah a kap ut kahi, hing hamuon buoise vanglah da mai un,” ka chi hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa galkapte Pasian akipat in Mengmuna phaijangah mangbatna, totchilna leh chimawna ni ahia, kulbangte suhchipna ni leh muolte kunga kikouna ni ahi."},"6":{"text":"Elam in thaltangbawm akuo a, sakolleng leh sakol tungtuongte toh, Tualeh Kir in alum adawhsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh na phaijang deipente sakolleng in adim dinga; Tualeh sakol tungtuong mite zong khopi kulpikotpi ah galdou dingin akichieng uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aman Judate kihumbitna ahohkhie a, tualeh tua ni in gammang inn a galvan kikoikhawmte na enta uhi."},"9":{"text":"David khopi sietna zong na muta a, tua khu tampitah ahi, tualeh tuikhuh hangtazaw tuite na kholkhawmta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem a innte na sim ua, kulbang huhna dingin innte na phelsie uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuikul lui a tui umna dingin, kulpibaang nite kikaal ah tuibem na bawl ua, hinanleh tuami bawlpa na en sih ua, nidanglai a abawl dingdan na ngaituopa zatatna malmal na nei sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua niin galkapte Mangpa Pasian in, kap ding leh suun dingin leh na sam uh heukieu ding leh sai-ip puon sil dingin ahing han ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh ngaivawi, lungnopna leh nopbawlna, bawng gawnate, belam thate sa nehnate leh zudawnnate a umzawta hi; “I ne un idawn ding uhi, aziehpen zing chienga shi ding ihi uh,” achi uhi.","ref":"1 Kor. 15.32"},"14":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Pasian in kabil ah tami ahing hil hi; “Pellou in tami tatkhielna khu na shi masangsie un, ngaidam ahi nawn sih ding hi,” galkapte Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi; “Pei inlen, tam sumkempa a innkuon sung ua thuneipa Shebna kungah vagen in.","title":"Shebna thahenga Eliakim apan ding thu"},"16":{"text":"Tanah bang na nei ei, tualeh koi na nei a ahiei? Mi’n ama a dinga mun sanga han akikhuoh bang leh, suongpi a umna ding akikhuoh banga, tam mun a han na kikhuoh ahiei mah?"},"17":{"text":"Ngaiin, Mangpa’n nang ahing man dinga ahing paimang ding hi; a hing man dinga ahing tudet ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Pellouin Aman nang ahing peilumlet dinga, gam lienpi sungah bawlung bangin ahing seplut ding hi; khunah na shi dinga, tualeh na thupina sakolleng khu napu innsung maizumna ahita ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n na panna sangtah akipat in ka hing notkhe dinga, tualeh na dinmun apat in ka hing luoikhe ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Hilkiah tapa ka suohpa Eliakim ka han ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh na leeng puontuol ama ka silsah dinga, na kawnggahin ama ka suhat dinga, nagam vaihawmna thuneina akhut ah ka peta ding hi. Tuachi’n ama khu Jerusalem a umte leh Juda innkuonte a dingin pa ahita ding hi."},"22":{"text":"David innkuonte chabi aliengkou ah ka koi dinga; tuachi’n aman ahong dinga, koiman akha sih dinga, akha dinga koiman ahong sih ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 3.7"},"23":{"text":"Ama khu mun khat a siakil khetdet bangin ka khendet dinga, tuachi’n ama khu apa innkuonte a dingin Mangtoupha thupitah ahi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Apa innkuonte thupina leh ahah-asuonte thupina zousie leh bel leh kuong aneu a lien, hengkuong akipat tuibel tanpha in ama tungah akikhai ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Pasian in, tua ni chiengin siakil mundettah a kikildette khu bawdoh in a um dinga, sattan ahi ding, apua ding a, tualeh atunga puohgih khu satkhiehin a um dinga, aziehpen Mangpa’n agensa ahi.”"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tai-ar tungtanga kiphuong puohgih tami ahi, Nou Tarshish tembawte, kap in mau un, Aziehpen khopi sung lutna ding tembawh khawlmun umlou khop a susiet in a umta hi; Saipras gam a kipat in amaute kungah suhlat in a umta hi.","title":"Tai-ar tungtang genlawhna","ref":"Ezek. 26.1—28.19; Joel. 3.4-8; Amos. 1.9,10; Zek. 9.1-4; Mat. 11.21,22; Luk. 10.13,14"},"2":{"text":"Nou tuipi panga tengte aw sip dide un, Aw Sidon gam a summet bawlte, na thupote un tuipi gal akaita uhi."},"3":{"text":"Sidon in Shihor akipat buchi tuilienpi tungah ahing puo a, Nile luipi bulahte khu Tai-ar adinga sum muna ahi a, namte a dinga summet bawlna mun ahita hi."},"4":{"text":"Aw Sidon, maizum in, Aziehpen tuipi in thu agenta hi, tuipi thahatna in, “Nauvei natna ka thuoh ngaisih a, tate zong ka hing ngai sih hi tangvalte lah ka khoilien sih a, nungah siengthoute zong ka vahlien sih hi.”"},"5":{"text":"Tai-ar khopi puana thu Izipt gama hing tung azah chiengun, nauvei bangin athuoh ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tarshish ah galkai unlen, tuipi panga tengte kap in mau un."},"7":{"text":"Tami hi maw na nopsahna khopi uh, tanglai nite khutsuoh ahita bou hi; akengte in gamlapi a um ding a pui zel khu?"},"8":{"text":"Manglukhu khusah a um Tai-ar khopi tungtang a thuhil ding koi ahiei? Asummet bawlte lah milien ngen ahi ua, summet bawla kivaite lah leitunga mi zatat-huoi ngen ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n thupina leh kiletsahna zousie loingiem ding leh zatat-huoi lou a koi a, leitunga mizatat huoite khu simmaw huoitah a bawl dingin ana guot zouta hi."},"10":{"text":"Aw Tarshish tanu, Nile luipi bangin na gam sung ah luonglet in, thahatna a um nawn sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuipi tungah akhut azah a, leenggamte akiling sah hi. Mangpa’n Kanaan gam tungtangah akulpite uh suse dingin thu apeta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Ama’n, “Aw nang nungah siengthou bawlsiet a um Sidon tanu aw, lungnuom in na kipah nawn sih ding hi, thou inlen Saipras gam ah galkai in khunah zong khawldamna na mutuom sih ding hi.”"},"13":{"text":"En in, Kaldai mite gam, tam mite aum nawn sih uh; Assiriaten gamdai a gamsate umna dingin abawlta uhi, Galvenna inn sangte alam ua, leeng innpi huongsungte abawl ua asuse dimdem uhi."},"14":{"text":"Nou Tarshish tembawhte aw, kap in mau un, Aziehpen na hatna uh suhsiet in a umta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin hichi ahi dinga, leengpa khat damsung kum sawm sagi bangin Tai-ar khu kum sawm sagi manghil in a um ding, Kum sawm sagi abei chiengin, Kizuanu la bangin Tai-ar tungah ahing tung ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Nang kizua manghil a umnu, kaiging la inlen, khopi sungah vah kawikawi inlen, ginglawm ngaitah bawl inlen, thei ngitnget a na umna dingin la ngai tampi sa-in.”"},"17":{"text":"Kum sawmsagi abei chiengin hichi ahi ding, Mangpa’n Tai-ar ave ding a, tuachi’n amanu khu asum lawna ah anua kia dinga, leitung pumpi leenggam zousie lah ah akizua ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A metna leh asum lawsate, Mangpa adinga siensuo ahi ding, koikhawm ahiei kholkhawm ahiei ahisih ding a, aziehpen amanu sum mu khu Mangpa mai a, umte a ding ahi dinga niengtah a neh ding leh, puonsil hoitah kichingtah a, asil theina ding uh ahi ding hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngaiin, Mangpa’n leitung ahawm in abawl a, tenna giehna lou in a umsah a, alumlet a, asunga tengte zong athethangta hi.","title":"Leitung thu a Mangpa thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi ding, Mipite tunga um bangin siempu tungah zong a um ding, suohpa tunga umbangin apu tungah a um ding, Suohnu tunga umbangin azuapa tungah a um ding, Leitawi mi tunga um bangin leitawi sahmi tungah a um ding, Leibasahpa tunga um bangin leiba ba mi tungah a um ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Gam pumpi susiet dimdem leh ahawm a koiin a um ding hi; aziehpen Mangpa’n tam thu ana gensa ahita hi."},"4":{"text":"Leitungin asuun a, atulta hi, khovel aba gawpta a, atulta hi, Leitunga mi kisatheite zong abata uhi."},"5":{"text":"Leitung zong asunga tengte nuoi ah abuata a; Aziehpen amaun dan abotseta ua; thupieh asulamdang ua, kumtawn thuhun asuseta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin hamselawna in leitung apumvalta a, asunga tengte zong athulim nawn sih uhi, tuaziehin leitunga tengte meiin akata a, tawmnoukhat nuasie in a um uhi."},"7":{"text":"Uoin tha atung nawn sih a, grepgui zong avuoi gawpta, tualeh lungtanga kipahte zousie thum in amau uhi."},"8":{"text":"Khuongta tum a lungnop nate atawpta a, kipah a nopsahna husate asipta a, kaiging tum a kipahna zong adaita hi."},"9":{"text":"Zu dawn kawm in la asa nawn sih ding ua, Zuchia dawnten kha asata ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Buoina khopi susiet in a umta a, koima lut theilouna dingin inn zousie akikhata ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Kholaidungah zu duin akikou ding ua, lungnopna zousie lungkhamna asuohta a, gamsung lungnopna zousie abeita hi."},"12":{"text":"Khopi sungah sietna nuasie in a um a, kulkotpite satsiet in a umta hi."},"13":{"text":"Gamsunga mipite lah a hichibang ahing um chiengin, Olive singkung kinuhling bangin, tualeh grep ga law nua a asang um bangin a um ding hi.","title":"Juda shimawh umsunte"},"14":{"text":"Amaun aw ngaitahin Mangpa thupina ziehin la asa ding ua, tuipi akipat in ngaitah in akikou ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin zingmawng khovah ah Mangpa thupina pahtawi unlen, Israelte Mangpa Pasian tuipi panga gamte ah pahtawi un."},"16":{"text":"Leimong tawp akipat midihtatpa kungah thupina um hen chia la kisa ka zata uhi Hinanleh ken “Mangthang ka hita, mangthang ka hita, ka tung agih hi! Lepchietah a gamta ten, lepchietah in abawl ua, lepchietah a gamtaten nasatah a lepchie in abawl uhi,” ka chi hi."},"17":{"text":"Leitunga teng noute aw, zaunate, kokhuhte leh thangte na tung uah a um hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hiding hi, koipou thawmging zauhuoi apat taimangte kokhuh sungah ake dinga, tualeh koipou kokhuh laikim akipat kaltoute khu thangah a awh ding hi. Aziehpen tunglam a kottate honsa in a um a, leitung kingahna suongphumte zong akihotling hi."},"19":{"text":"Leitung nasatah a susiet in a um a, leitung akehgawpa akihong hi, tualeh leitung nasatah a suhlingin a um hi."},"20":{"text":"Leitung zukhammi bangin ahawi dong donga, sahle-hang dennan akinei dinga, buh e kihot bangin akihot ding hi. Asil bawlkhelnate atungah agih mama ding a, apua dinga, athoudoh nawn sih ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin hichi ahi dinga, Mangpa’n tunglam a mi vangliente agawt dinga, leitunga leengte zong agawt ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh suongkul a taangte kokhuh a agawmkhawm bangin, gawmkhawm in aum ding ua, tuachi’n suongkul a khakhum in a um ding ua, tualeh ni tampi nuachiengin gawt in a um ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin hapi azala dinga, tualeh ni zong amaizum ding hi, Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa’n Zion muol leh Jerusalem khuo a upate masangah, leeng hina toh thupitah in vai ahawm ding hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nang ka Pasian nahi a, Ka hing pahtawi dinga, na min ka phat ding hi. Aziehpen nangman sillamdangte na bawl a, Ni danglai a na lemguotte khu, gin umna leh thutah ahi.","title":"Mangpa lungkim zieh a phatna"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen, Nang khopite silsie kisiekhawm bangin na bawla, Kulpi nei khopite na susie a, gamdang mite leeng innpi, khopi hinawnlou dingin na bawl a, akilam tha kia nawn sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin mihatten nang ahing pahtawi ding ua, nam zauhuoitah khopiten nang ahing giing ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen nangma mi zawngte thahatna na hi a, mitasamte leh lunggimte hatna nahi a, huipihat chienga kibuhna nahi a, nisat chienga limbel nihim nahi hi. Aziehpen hepina neiloute husa khu, huipi’n baang amut bang ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mun gaw a kholum bangin, gamdangmite thawm na sipsah ding hi; kholum khu meilum him in alie vot bangin, mi zauhuoite lasah na sipsah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tam muol ah galkapte Mangpa’n mi zousie a dingin sil thaute in pawi abawl dinga, zuningkai leh ganta a thau mama chintuigute toh; tualeh zuning kikhai siengthou tuipen pen toh pawi abawl ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Aman tami muol tungah mi zousie kikhuna puon, nam chinteng tunga kizah maikhuna khu hohkhie in asumang ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama shina khu kumtawn a dingin apumval dinga, tualeh Mangpa Pasian in mi zousie mai akipat in ahitui uh asia sieng pieh ding hi; tualeh leitung pumpi akipat in amite zalatna alamangta ding hi; aziehpen Mangpa’n tam thu agensa ahita hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 15.54; Kihil. 7.17; 21.4"},"9":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin, “Ngai un, tami i Pasian uh ahi, Ama ahi ina ngah ngitnget uh, Ama’n eite ahing hundam ding hi; Tami ina ngahngah uh Mangpa ahi; Ahundamna ah ikipah in inuomta ding hi,” akichi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen tam muol tungah Mangpa khut akingata ding a, Moab khu bupawl eehthahna a akitotchil bangin Ama nuoi ah totchil in a um ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 15.1—16.14; Jer. 48.1-47; Ezek. 25.8-11; Amos. 2.1-3; Zeph. 2.8-11"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tuizap miten banzah a tui azap bangun, Ama’n alah uah akhut azah dinga, tualeh Ama’n akiletsahna uleh alepchiena khut uh asat ngiem ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na kulpi baangte leh kulpi sangtahte, Ama’n asungiem dinga, achimsah dinga, tuol lah ah leivui asuohsah ding hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Juda gam sungah tam la akisa ding hi, “Khopi muonhuoitah i nei ua, Pasian in hundamna khu kulbaangte leh kulpite a dingin aguot ding hi.","title":"Israel leenggam la"},"2":{"text":"Nam dihtat, thutah zuite alut theina dingun, kulpi kotkhate hongun."},"3":{"text":"Na tunga lungtang kiptah a nga mi in nangma ahing muon ziehin, lungmuonna kim nei dingin na kem ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa khu kumtawn in muongun; aziehpen Jehovah ah tangtawn hatna a um hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman mun sangtah a umte aluoikhie a, khopi sangtahte aluoi ngiem a, Lei toh kikim in a sungiem a, Leivui lah ah aluoi ngiemta hi."},"6":{"text":"Kengin atuonchil ding ua, mi zawngte keng leh mi tasamte kalsuon in, atuonchil den ding hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Mi thudihte lampi khu dihtatna ahia, Aw Nang midihtat tawp in midih lampi khu, na guot pieh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi, Mangpa aw, na vaihawmna lampi ah, Nangma ka hing ngah uhi, Ka hinna un alunggul khu Na min leh, nangma thei ngitngetna khu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Zanlai chiengin ka hinna in Nangma ahing lunggul a, Ahi ka sunga ka hinna hagau in zingmawng matahin nangma ahing sui hi, aziehpen na vaihawmna leitunga a um chiengin, Khovel a tengten dihtatna azil ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Migilou pen deisah nanlachin, dihtatna azil tuomsih ding hi, dihtatna gam ah dihloutah in abawl ding a, Mangpa thupina amusih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa na khut zahtou a aum chiengin, amusih ding uhi, hinanleh amu ding ua, mite athangsiet ziehun azum ding uhi, ahi, na galte mei in amauh akatum ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 10.27"},"12":{"text":"Mangpa kou a dingin galmuonna nang bawl pieh a, aziehpen ka nasep zousie uh nangma hing bawl pieh ngen ahibou hi."},"13":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka Pasian uh, nangma chilou leeng dangten zong ka tung uah vai ahawm uhi, Hinanleh nangma ziehin kouten na min bou ka thei ngitnget ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute a shita ua, ahing sih ding uhi, nihim bang bep ahi ua, athou nawn sih ding uhi. Tuaziehin amauh na gawta, na mangthaisahta hi. Tualeh amauh theizingna zong na sumangta hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa nam na pungsah a, nam na supung a, Nangma pahtawi in na um hi. Nangman agamgite uh na kehlienta hi."},"16":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, mangbangin nangma ahing sui ua, Na gawtna atung ua atun chiengin, na mai ah thungetna anei zel uhi."},"17":{"text":"Numei naupai anau nei hun kuon chienga, na sasenga kap a kipeh in a um a, Mangpa aw, na mitmu ah tuabangin ka um uhi."},"18":{"text":"Nau ka pai ua, nauvei in na kasa ua, hui hingkhie bang bep ka hi uhi; leitungah tatdohna nasep bangma ka sem doh sih uhi; tualeh leitunga tengte zong apua sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na mishite ahing kia ding ua, keima tahsa shisa luong toh athou khawm ding uhi. Nou leivui lah a umte aw, khanglou unlen, la saun, Aziehpen na daituite uh haichi daitui ahi a, tuachi’n leitungin mi shite adeldohta ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka mite hing pei unlen, na pindan sung uah lut un, tualeh kot kikhakhum unlen, lungthahna abei masangsie’n hun tomnou sung ki phuol tadi un."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen Ngai un, agitlouna zieh ua leitunga tengte gawt dingin Mangpa a umna akipat in ahing pei hi. Tualeh leitungin atunga sisan kisuote agendoh dinga, tualeh atunga tha-a umte khukhum in a sel nawn sih ding hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Mangpa’n A namsau hiem, lien leh hattah in Leviathan gulpi leng leh Leviathan gulpi kiviel ngeungou a gawt ding a, Tuipi a gulpi athat ding hi.","title":"Israel hutkhietna","ref":"Job. 41.1; Late. 74.14; 104.26"},"2":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin “Zu san piengsah grep-huon kilawmtah pahtawi in la sa un."},"3":{"text":"Kei Mangpa khu a vengpa ka hi a, hunchin in tui ka buoh a, Koiman asuhsiet louna dingin, sun leh zan in ka veng hi."},"4":{"text":"Lungthahna ka neisih a, louling neite leh khauling neiten, hing dou uleh aw, amauh ka palsuoh dinga, ka haltum khawm sieng ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahisihleh ahing kileppi theina dingin, ka hatna tudet hen, tuachi’n kilemna a bawl ding hi.”"},"6":{"text":"Hun hing tung dingah, Jakob in hui ahing hadinga, Israelte aselnou ding ua, apallun ding uhi, tuachi’n leitung pumpi aga in adimsah ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ama vawte avuoh bangin, Israelte avota amah? Ahisihleh Ama kithana bangin, Ama tha in a umta amah?"},"8":{"text":"Ama na sawlmang laiin ahun giap in ama na kinielpi a, suolam hui alaan niin ahu thupitahin ama na semmangta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin tami’n Jakob khelna khukhum ahita dinga, tualeh tami akhelna zousie uh lahmangna bukim ga ahi ding hi. Maitam a suong zousie suongngot gawtguoi banga abawltah chiengin, Asherim leh gimnamtui halna maitamte ading nawn sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Kulpi dettah nei khopite suhmangin aum dinga, khuna tengte gamdai kinuasie bangin taisan in a um ding uhi, khunah bawngnoute agamta ding ua, khunah alum ding ua, abamengte ane khawng ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Abamengte avuoi a agaw chiengin hiehtawng ahi ding ua, numeite ahing pei ding ua, mei ah avang ding uhi. Aziehpen theisiemna neilou nam ahi ua, tuaziehin amauh siempa’n amauh ahepi sih dinga, amauh bawlpa’n amauh deisahna amusah sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuani chiengin hichi ahi dinga, Mangpa’n Euphrates luipi luong apat Izipt luita dongin agate asatkhe dinga, tualeh nou Israel tate aw khat khat a lahkhawm in na umta ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin pengkul thupitah ahing kimut dinga, Assiria gam a mangthai dinga umsate bang, Izipt gam a nawdoh a umte bang, ahing peita ding ua, Jerusalem muol siengthou ah Mangpa abeta ding uhi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephriam zukhamhatte leh kisahtheina manglukhu athupina kilawmna uh, pahpe vul kuon zu in athuzawgawp phaijang hausatah lutanga um, zu in aloingiem, tung agih hi.","title":"Ephraim tunggihna"},"2":{"text":"Ngai in, Mangpa’n mihat leh silbawltheitah khat anei hi, Ama gielpi leh sietna huipi leh gamsung tummang tui luong hattah bang mai in akhut in tuolse nan anei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ephraim zukham hatte kisahtheina manglukhu uh kengnuoi a totden in a um ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh akilawmna thupitah, phaijang hausatah lutanga um khu, pape vul kuon bangleh nipi hing tun masanga theipi min masapen a entu in amu a, akhut a law pai a, anehkhawng pai bang ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin galkapte Mangpa khu amite lah a suohta umsunte a dingin thupina manglukhu leh kilawmna lukhu ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Vaihawmna ding a toupa adinga thudihna hagau ahi dinga, galphuol a kipat a kulpi kotpi lam zuon a hing pei kiate a dingin ama thahatna ahi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun zu ziehin asukhielta ua zuchiatah khamin apua thop thop ua, siempute leh zawlneite zuchia khamin akilawmlia ua, amaute zukham in apua siengta ua, zu thuzaw in a um siengta uhi; zuchia akham ziehun apua thop thop ua, mengmuna dihloupi amu ua, vaihawmna ah akipalpua uhi.","title":"Jerusalem giihna leh thuchiem"},"8":{"text":"Dawkan tung zousie luoh leh silnieh ngen in adim a, kidahhuoi umlouna mun mawngmawng a umsih hi."},"9":{"text":"“Koi ahiei theina hil ding, tualeh koi ahiei thuhilna atheisiem sah ding? Nawi neh tawpte leh nawi ngawlsate ahil ding uh adiei?"},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen thuhilna tunga thuhilna, aguol tunga aguol, tanah tawmnoukhat, khunah tawmnoukhat.”"},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n kam lamdang leh gam tuom mite ham in, tam mite kungah thu agen ding hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 14.21"},"12":{"text":"Amaute kungah, “Tami ahi khawldamna, thatawlte khawldamsah un, tualeh tami kisuhhalna ahi,” achi a, hinanleh amaun angaikhe ut sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute a dingin Mangpa thu khu thuhilna tunga thuhilna aguol guol a kichiengtou in tanah themkhat khunah tawmkhat ava pei ua, athalpua ua, akitatkeh gawp ua, thanga a awh na ding uleh mat a aumna ding uh ahita hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin nou mi simmawhatte, Jerusalem a tam mite tunga vaihawmte Mangpa thu ngaiun.","title":"Ephraim vangphatna, Judate thuhilna"},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen “Nouten shina toh thuhun ka bawl ua, mishikhuo toh kithukimna ka neita uhi, vuohna leh satna khauhuol in tuilien banga ahing luonkhum chiengin, koute ahing sukha sih ding hi, aziehpen zuouthu kibutna in ka nei ua, tualeh zuouthu nuoi ah ka kiphuol uhi,” nachi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, “Ngai un, Zion ah suong, suong etchiensa, aninga suong manphatah kingahna kiptah hiding suongphum dihtah ka phum hi. Koi hinanleh ama gingta pouma akin hehu sih ding hi.","ref":"Late. 118.22,23; Rom. 9.33; 10.11; 1 Pet. 2.6"},"17":{"text":"Vaihawmna dih khu tena khau kahisah dinga, tualeh dihtatna khu atenadih sialum kikhaiin ka zang ding hi. Tuachi’n zuouthu a kibutna giel in aphietmang dinga, tualeh tuiten kibutna munte a tummang ding hi.”"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n shina toh na thuhun uh bangmalou asuoh dinga, tualeh mishikhuo toh na kithukimna uh apiching sih ding hi; tualeh vuohna leh satna khauhuol tuilien banga ahing let chiengin, totchil in na um ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"A hing luon chin-in noute ahing taimang zel dinga, zingmawng chin leh asun azan in aluong dinga, thutut umzie theisiemna khu zauna chizathuoi ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen lupna khu mi khat ki-zietzang na ding in atom senga, tualeh puonsil zong mi khat ki lukhuna dingin a neu seng hi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen anasep, chizat huoitah asep theina dingin leh asilbawl, chituom asep theina dingin, Mangpa khu Perazim muol a athaw bangin athou dinga, Gibeon phaijanga alungthah bangin alungthah ding hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 5.20; 1 Khang. 14.11; Josh. 10.10-12"},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin simmawhatte hinawn sihun, tua asihleh na kolbute uh asudet semsem kha ding hi, aziehpen leitung pumpi nangawn suhmangthai ding a aguotsa ahi chi galkapte Mangpa Pasian apat in ka zata hi."},"23":{"text":"Bil daw unlen ka aw za un, ngaikhie unlen ka thugen za un."},"24":{"text":"Loukaipa’n buchithena dingin sunkhuoin lou akai amah? Aleikhalte sukehin asatnen ngitnget ngai amah?","title":"Loukaipa gentena thu"},"25":{"text":"Aloukaite azeljang zou chiengin leengmasel tangte athe sih amah? Tualeh pasikhawm tangte zong athe sih amah? Tualeh mim aguol guol in asuon a, sakolbu leh taang akiguotna munte ah athe sih uh amah?"},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen ama dihtah a thuhil in a um a, a Pasian in ama ahil hi,"},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen koiman busatna in leengmasel asat ngai sih a, pasikhawm tungah kangtalai keng lia in achilsah ngai sih uhi, leengmasel khu chiengkangin akisat a pasikhawm pen khetbuh in akisat hi."},"28":{"text":"Tanghou dingin butang akigawtguoi a, Tuaziehin aman phuol ah achil ngaisih ding akangtalai keng leh sakolte chil sah in agawtvui ngai sih ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tamte zong galkapte Mangpa, thumoppa lamdang leh pilna hoitah a, hing kipan ahi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ariel aw Ariel David tenna khopi na tung agih hi, akum akum a belapin pawite avelvel in hing tung hen.","title":"Ariel leh Jerusalem tunggihna"},"2":{"text":"Hinapiin Ariel ka lunggimsah nalai dinga, tuachi’n ka leh mauna a um dinga, tualeh tami kei a dingin Ariel kana bang ahi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nangma douna dingin na kimkot ah giehphuol ka sat dinga, na kimkot ah leipal ka hing sekhum dinga, nangma douna dingin kulpite ka hing khokhum ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang pen puasah in na um dinga, lei lah akipat na ham ding a, na thugen lei vui lah akipat in ngiemnou in ahing pawtkhe ding a, na aw pen leinuoi akipat dawi aisan siemte aw abang ding hi, tualeh na thugen khu leivui lah akipata dapham abang giap ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuathamlou in nangma hing dou mipi tampite leivui nel bang ahi ding ua, mi zauhuoi mipite khu bushi leeng mang bang ahi ding uhi; Ahi, tuate khu mitphiet kaal in thakhat in ahing um ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n vanpi ging leh zilling leh thawmging ngaitah toh kithuo pingpei leh huipi hattah toh, katum thei meikuong a noute hing gawt ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ariel dou nam zousie, ama leh akulpi doute zousie nangawn leh ama sulunggimte zanlai a manglam a mengmuna bang ahi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi gilkielten amang ua ann aneh ua, akhahlaw chieng ua agilva tuomlou bang ahi ding ua, ahisihleh dangta miten amang ua tui adawn ua, akhahlaw chieng ua aphattuomlou bangin Zion muol dou mite nam zousie mipite khu tuomi bang giap ahi ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Um khinkhien unlen, lamdang sa un; na mitte uh tosah unlen mitto in um un, akham uh a, hinanleh zukham ahisih uhi, ahawi vadong ua, hinanleh zukham a hawi vadong ahisih uhi.","title":"Israel thumanlouna leh mittawtna"},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n imutduna hagau na tung uah ahing sungbuo hi;
