namit uh ahing singsahta a guolneite leh mutheite na lu uh ahing khukhumta hi.","ref":"Rom. 11.8"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n mengmuna zousie nou a dingin laibu a um thu kikhakhum, tua laibu laisim theimi kungah pie henlen, “Hepitahin hing simpieh in” kichi leh ama’n, “Ka simthei sih, akikhakhum ahi,” achi sanbang ahita hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n laibu khu laisim theilou mi khat kungah kipie in, “Hepitahin tam laibu sim vawi,” kichi leh ama’n “Lai kasiem sih,” achi zel hi."},"13":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mangpa’n tam miten kam in ahing nai ua, akam un ahing pahtawi ua, hinanleh alungtangun ahing gamlat uhi, tualeh keima ahing giinna ulah mihing thupieh leh kihil thaw maimai ahibou hi.","ref":"Mat. 15.8,9; Mak. 7.6,7"},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin ngaiin, tam mite lah ah sil lamdang ka bawl dinga, nasep lamdang, thumahtah khat, aziehpen a mipilte uh pilna amangthai ding a, tualeh amilunggel siemte uh theisiemna uh phuolguhin a um ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 1.19"},"15":{"text":"Athuhilnate uh Mangpa akipat a phuol dinga, thuhtah sui mite atung uh agih hi; anasepte uh miel lah abawl ahi a, koi ahiei ahing mu ding? “Koi ahiei ahing thei ding?” achi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Adihtahin silzousie na lebul siengta uhi Belkhengpa khu atungman bang lel a ngaisut in a um ding amah? Sil siem in asiemtu khu, “Ama hing siem hikoi sing achi thei diei”? Ahisihleh silbawldoh in abawldohpa khu, “Theisiemna mawngmawng nei vawtsih achi ding amah”?","ref":"Isai. 45.9; Rom. 9.20"},"17":{"text":"Hun tomnoukhat nuachieng in Lebanon khu leihoi haichi pienna mun suohsah lou ding amah? Tua leihoi mun khu gammang lah banga ngaiin umlou ding ahiei mah?","title":"Israel hundamna"},"18":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin bilbingten laibu a thu umte azata ding ua, tualeh mit tote mit in miel nuoi leh khomiel lah apat in amuta ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Mi kingaingiemten zong Mangpa ah kipahna thupizaw anei ding ua, mipite lah a mi zawngten Israelte Misiengthoupa ah anuomta ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen migilou zauhuoi lah bangmalou a bawlin a umta a, mi simmawhatte zong suhmang in a umta hi; tualeh silgilou bawl dinga ngahte zousie sattan in a umta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua miten kamteng khat in mite asukhielsah ua, kulpi kotpi a thuhil mite awhna dingin thang akam ua, tualeh midih khu bangmalou in akiheimangsan zel uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Abraham tandoh pa’n Jakob innkuonte tungtang thu ah tambangin agen hi, “Jakob tuin amuolphou nawn sih dinga, amai muol nawn sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh ka khut suoh atate alah ua, amu chiengin, ka min asiengthousah ding ua, Jakob Misiengthoupa khu asiengthousah ta ding ua, tualeh Israel Pasian agiingta ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh hagau lam a sil bawlkhielten zong ahing theisiemta ding ua, tualeh phunhatten thuhilnate apom siemta ding uhi.”"}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mangpa’n ta helhatte tung agih hi,” achi hi, “Mi dangte lemguotna ala ua, kei ahing dong sih uh, sil tup leh guon anei ua, Keima hagau akipat ahi sih hi, Khelna tunga khelna abelap theina ding bep uh ahi.","title":"Izipt toh kizopna bawlte tung agih hi"},"2":{"text":"Izipt gam ah a peisuh ua, ka thuhilna hing donglou in, Pharaoh hatna a kisuhat ding leh Izipt limbel ding muongin, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pharaoh thahatna khu na zumna uh ahi ding a, Izipt limbel ding na muonna ulah na zalatna uh ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen alamkaite uh Zoan ah a um ua, apalaite uh Hanes ah ahing tung uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute aphattuompilou ziehun, mipite zousie azum ding ua, ahisihleh panpina hilou, phattuomna hilou, hinanleh zumna leh minsietna ahi zaw ding hi.”"},"6":{"text":"Simlam gamsate tunggihna buoina leh lungkhamna gam, tuana kipat in humpibahnei nu leh humpibahnei, gul gupha leh gulpi leengtheite ahing pawtdoh ua, ahausatnate uh sabiltung hatlai tungah apuo ua, tualeh sangawngsau thu-vum tungah agoute uh posahin, ama ua dinga phattuomna neilou mite kung lam ah apeipi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Iziptte panpina khu phattuomna bei leh bangmalou ahi dinga, tuaziehin Izipt khu “Rahab-Hem-Shebeth” ka chita hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuin pei inlen, amasang ua suongpeh tungah giel inlen, laibu ziel sungah giel in, tuakhu hun hing tung dingte a, kumtawn tan a chiemtena ahiden theina dingin."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen amauh mi helhatte, ta zuoutheite leh Mangpa dan ngaikhe nuomlou tate ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Mutheite kunga mu sih un,” guolneite kunga “Genlawhna dihtah hing hil sih un, azahnop huoi lamlam gen unlen, kisolna thuzuou genlawh un."},"11":{"text":"Lampi dih nuasie unlen, lamdih apat kiheimang unlen, Israel Mi Siengthoupa ka masang ua kipat sumang un chi ngitnget te.”"},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin, Israelte Mi Siengthoupa’n tambangin agen hi; “Tam thu na simmaw zieh uleh nuoisie na leh suhgentheina na muon ziehun tuate ah na kinga uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin tami gitlouna khu noute a dingin kulbang sangtah khi khang chim dinga kisa puoh kengkung thakhat a chim ding bang ahi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh aman belkhengpa bel asatguoi dimdem bangin asatguoi ding a, akhawisih ding hi; tuachi’n athemnengte lungthukhua apat mei luohna ding leh tuikhuh akipat tui sawhna ding athem nangawn umlou,” bang ahi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa Pasian Israelte Mi Siengthoupa’n tambangin agen hi. “Nua kia unlen khawldam in um ulachin hundam in na um ding ua, dai dide a muonna leh gintatna in na hatna uh ahizaw ding hi; hinanleh na ut sih uhi.”"},"16":{"text":"Nouten, “Hilou e! Sakol tunga tuongin hattah in ka taimang zaw ding uhi,” na chi uhi, tuaziehin taimang ngut ve ua, “Tualeh sakol hattah tungah i tuong ding nachi u’maw!” Tuaziehin nou hing nuadelten hattah in ahing nuadel ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Mi khat phawn in mi sangkhat ataizah ding ua, mi nga phawn in na taimang ding uhi; muol vum a diellap khaina mung kiphut bang leh muol tunga puonlap kinuasie bang na hi masangsie un na taizah ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin noute ahing hepi theina dingin Mangpa’n noute ahing ngah ding a, tuaziehin na tung ua lainatna anei theina dingin tawisangin a um ding hi. Aziehpen Mangpa khu dihna Pasian ahi a, Ama ngah zousie ahampha uhi."},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem a teng Zion mite aw, na kap nawn sih ding uhi. Aman na kaa ging husate ua pat in pellou in ahing hepi mama dinga, azahtah chiengin ahing dawng ding hi.","title":"Tunua chienga Israel hamphatna"},"20":{"text":"Mangpa’n lungkham mangbatna ann leh gimthuohna tui hing na pe nanleh, nou hing zilsah na Siete uh akibu nawnsih ding ua, na mit un noute hing hil na siete uh amuta ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Na zietlam uh ahiei na veilam uh ahiei a na pieltah chiengun, “Tami lampi ahi tanah pei un,” tami zuiun chiin na nualang ua pat na bil un aw khat na za ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh dangka tui a na luon uh na milimte uleh sana tui a na milim khenthute uh na zepna uh na buasah ding ua, sil nieh bangin na paimang ta ding ua, amaute kungah “Peimangun” nachita ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman buchi lei a natu dingte ua dingin guotui ahing pe dinga, lei a silpiengte apat ann hoitah, pungtah leh atam atam ahi dinga, tua ni chiengin na ganta honte uh gamtatna mun lienpi ah agamta ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuamabangin bawngtalte leh sabiltung loukaiten ann chisawsa, suohdul leh phazapa kizap siengsa ane ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Kithana thupitah ni chienga, galvenna inn sangte achip ni chiengin, taang sang chinteng leh muol sang chinteng tungah luipite leh luitate aluong ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Mangpa’n amite kisuhliemna maa atuom pieh a, aliemna maa uh asuhdampieh ni chiengin, ha vah khu ni vah abang dinga tualeh ni vah zong alesagi in, ni sagi vah kigawm bang tuh in avah ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ngaiun, Mangpa min khu gamlapi akipat in alungthahna meikuong leh apuohgih tahtoh ahing pei hi; akam khu thangpaina in adim a, tualeh alei zong mikatum thei meikuong bang ahi.","title":"Assiria sietna"},"28":{"text":"Anah hu khu luitui luonglet ngawng chieng tum bang ahi ding a, manthaina lawpi a sep a, namchinteng khenzah dingin, namchin kam ah suhkhel sahna kamkaina khau avaw dinga tuami’n mite apielmangsah ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Pawi siengthou zan lai a na bawl lai ua, la kisa bangin la nasa ding ua, tualeh Mangpa muol siengthou a, Israel Mihatpa kunga tung dinga, theile toh apei lai ua, lungsim kipahna anei bangun lungtang kipahna nanei ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Mangpa’n a aw thupitah akiza sahta dinga, alungthahna huoisetah toh, mi katumthei meikuong toh, huipi leh guopi toh, tualeh gielpi toh akhut a ami vuoh dan ahing ensahta ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Mangpa aw thupitah ziehin, khetbuha misat zelpa Assiria khu susiet dimdem in a umta ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n gawtna chienga amauh asatna mun tengah khuong leh zam ging abang ding a, tualeh kidouna ah akhuttumin adou ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n lai peh akipat Tophet aguotsa ahi, Ahi leengpa a dinga guot ahia; athuh athuh, a let alien a ana bawl ahi. Asil koikhawm khu mei leh singtampi ahia; kaat luiluong bangin Mangpa huu in akuong sah vapual ding hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Panpina ngen dinga Izipt gam a peisuhte tung agih hi, Sakolte muonga, asakollengte uh tamna muonga, a sakol tungtuongte uh thahat mama na muonga, Israel Mi Siengthoupa lam enlou a, Mangpa sui loute tung agih hi.","title":"Pasian muongloute khelna"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama zong piltah ahi a, sietna atungsah dinga, athu gensa aheng sih dinga, hinanleh silgilou bawlte innkuon, dou ding in akipan dinga, khelna bawl mite panpite zong a dou ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Iziptte khu mihing ahi ua Pasian ahi sih uhi, Asakolte u’zong hagau ahi sih a, tahsa ahibou uhi; Mangpa’n aban azahtou chiengin, panpina apua dinga, Panpi a umpa zong apua dinga, ani un amangthai khawm ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n ka kungah, tambangin thu agen hi, Humpibahnei ahum ham a, Humpibahnei lunlai asamat tungah ahum ham hi; Belam chingmi tampite dou dingin, akihatkhawm chiengun, a aw ziehun azau sih dinga, athawmging un asubuoi sih ding hi. Tuachimabangin galkapte Mangpa khu Zion taang leh, amuolte panpi dingin ahing peisuh ding hi.","title":"Pasian in Jerusalem ahunkhe ding"},"5":{"text":"Vaten abu venga a len kawi bangun, galkapte Mangpa’n Jerusalem avengdinga, aven kawmin atandoh dinga, apeikan kawm in ahumbit ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Israel hahlesuonte aw, nasataha na helsanpa uh langah hing kinuahei kiata un,"},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen tuami ni chiengin michin in, na khelna khut ua na bawlthu uh dangka milimte leh, sana milimte na paimangta ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Tuachi’n Assiriate khu mihat satpua hilouin, namsau in apua ding ua, mihingte namsau hilou in amauh athatgam ding a, hinanleh namsau akipat ataimang dinga, tualeh akhanglaite uh autlou sasa ua, nasepsah teitei in a um ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Zauna ziehin kulpi kaan in atai ding ua, chiemtena puonlap ziehin a miliente uh azau ding uhi,” tualeh Mangpa meikuong Zion ah a um a, Jerusalem ah haltuina meilipi a um hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngaiin, dihtat tah a vaihawm leeng khat ahing um ding hi, tualeh milien vaihawm miten dihna toh vai ahawm ding uhi.","title":"Dihtah a vaihawm leeng hing um dingpa"},"2":{"text":"Mi khat huipi lah a kibutna mun leh guopi lah a bitna bang ahi dinga, mun gawa tuiluong bang leh thatawlna gam a suongpi lim bang ahi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh amute mit amiel sih dinga, azate bil in angaikhe ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi nawthomte lungtangin theina atheisiemta dinga, tualeh mi dang awhte lei chientahin aham theita ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi mote khu mikiphal a kichinawn sih ding ua, michippawngte zong mipha achi nawn sih ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen mi gilouten thu agen ding ua, alungtang un thulimlouna nna asem ua, Pasian ngaisahlouna abawl ua, Mangpa demna’n thudihlou agen ua, gilkielte anndu a taisahlou in akoi ua, tuidu a dangtate tui dawnsah louin akoi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Milepchiete lunggel silgilou ahi a, asiltup giloute un mi zawngte leh tasamten thudih agenlai nangawn un zong zuouthu a suhsiet ding dan angaituo nalai uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh misilphal in vang silphallam angaituo ding ua, silphaltah in ading det ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Nou numei noplening a umte aw, thou unlen, ka aw ngaikhie un, nou noplening a um tanute aw, ka thugen ah bil daw un.","title":"Jerusalem numeite giihna"},"10":{"text":"Nou noplening a um numeite aw, kum khat leh ni bangza ahiei nua chiengin, na buoi ding uhi; aziehpen grep ga alawsam dinga, aga khopkhawm ding a umsih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Numei nop lente aw chitun unlen, noplening a umte aw, na puonsilte uh hawhkhie unlen, guohtangin um unlen na kawng uah sai-ip puon teng un."},"12":{"text":"Lou hoi deihuoite leh grepgui ga nuom mamate itna ziehin miten a awm uh atum ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ka mite gam loulingnei leh khaulingnei in, ahing poukhum dinga, Ahi, khopi nuom tah a, kipahna innte zong apoukhumta ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Leng innpi taisana a um ding ziehin, khopi sunga mitampi husa vengvung nuasie in a um dinga, tualeh kulpite leh inn sangte zong gam sabiltungte noptah a buolna leh ganhonte tatna ahi kumtawnta ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tunglam akipat a hagau ka tung ua sunbuoh a um a, gamdai gamgaw zong ga piengsahthei lei hoi ahing hi a, tualeh ga piengsah leihoite gammang abah masangsie’n;"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamdai ah thudih a vaihawmna a um dinga, tualeh dihtatna khu gamhoitah ah a umta ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Dihtatna nasep khu lemna leh muonna ahi dinga, tualeh dihtatna ga khu kumtawn a muonna leh kitheichienna ahi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka mite galmuonga umna mun leh bitna mun ah ateng ding ua, tawldamna mun ah ateng ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Gammang tungah giel hing kesuh in, tualeh khopite suhngiem in um nanleh,"},"20":{"text":"Tui luonna gei a haichi thete leh bawngte leh sabiltungte zalen tah a ha zelte, mi hampha na hi uhi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nang mibulu a panga, bulu a um ngailou, lepchietah a bawla, lepchietah a bawl a umngailou, na tung agih hi mi bulu na tawp chiengun, noute min ahing suse ding ua, tualeh lepchietah a na bawlzou chiengin, lepchietah a bawl in na um ding hi.","title":"Jerusalem susete (Assiria) tung agih hi"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa aw koute hing hepiin, nang ka hing ngah uhi. Zingmawng chin in ka bantha un hing pang inlen, ka buoi hun chiengun zong ka hundamna uh hing hiin."},"3":{"text":"Thawmging hehu ah mipite ataimang ua, Nangma na hing kidop sangtah chiengin namte thezah in aum uhi."},"4":{"text":"Na galvanlahte uh lungnou in sil alahkhawm bangin khopkhawm in a um dinga, khauphete akitawm duom duom bangun, amauh galvanlahte tungah akitawm ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa tawisangin a umta, aziehpen tunglam sangtah ah a um a, Aman Zion khu thudih a vaihawmna leh dihtatna in adimsahta hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama na damsung kingahna dettah ahi dinga, Hundamna, pilna leh theina kiningching mama ahi ding hi, Mangpa zaudan siemna khu Ama gou manpha ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ngai un, mihangsante kholaidung lah ah patau in akikou ding ua, Lemna palaite hasetah in akap ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Lamliente zuilouin a umta a, khuolzin mi a um nawn sih hi, lemna thuhun abotsie a, kichiemnate asimmaw a, koima kizatatna a um sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Gam sung da leh kap in achimaw a, Lebanon maizum in avul ningniengta, Sahron lah gamdai gamgaw asuohta, Bashan leh Karmel in agate uh athing kheta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa’n, “Tuin ka thou dinga,” tawisangin ka um ding a, “Ka kitawisang ding hi, achi hi.","title":"Zion tunga thukhenna nai"},"11":{"text":"Bushi naupai in na pai ding ua, bupawl na hingdoh ding uhi, na nah hu un meikuong bangin, nouma ahing katum ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh mipite lah lungngou haltum bang ahi ding ua, loulingnei mei in akahtan chet chet bangin,” hal in na um ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Nou gamla tah a umte aw, ka silbawl za un, nainou khat a umte aw, ka hatna thei un."},"14":{"text":"Zion a mikhielte a zau ua, Pasian ngaisahloute zau a chitutna in amanta hi; I lah ua koi ahiei, katum thei meikuong toh um khawm thei ding? “I lah ua koi ahiei kumtawn a katum thei, meikuong toh um khawm ding?”"},"15":{"text":"Dihtattah a gamta mi leh thudih genmi, nuoisiena punna bangma a ngailou mi, golguhna sang dinga khut zankhelou mi, sisan suona thuza nuomlou a bilhum mi, sil hoilou en nuomlou a, amit singmi,"},"16":{"text":"Tuabang mi khu tunglam sangtah ah ateng dinga, suongpite akiven bitna kulpi ahi dinga, tanghou pieh ahi dinga, adawn ding tui a um ngei ngei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na mitin leengpa kilawmna amu dinga, gamlapi a um gam amu ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Na lungtangin sil zauhuoite angaituo ding a, “Laigielpa hei a um ahiei? Atepa hei a um ahiei? Innsangte simpa hei a um ahiei?” achi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi zauhuoite, a ham uh na theithei lou a ham mite, dang awh ham kitheichien lou a ham mite, na mu nawn sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"I pawi bawlna khopi Zion khu envawi, na mit in Jerusalem galmuonga tenna, biehbuh kisuondoh ngailou ding, akaidetna khetphimte bangchih tan a, bawdoh nawnlou ding leh, akhina khaute bangchihtan a tan ngailou ding, khu na muding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua mun ah Mangpa thupitah khu eite a ahita ding a, tuanah tembaw azapna chieng neite apei nawn sih ding a; tembaw lien leh thupite apei nawn sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa khu i vaihawmpa ahita ding hi. Mangpa khu eite dan hing pepa ahi a, Mangpa khu i leengpa uh ahi a, Aman eite a hing hundam ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na tembaw khina khaute akolta a, apuonzahte amungah akikhidet thei nawn sih a, puonzah khu akizahpal thei nawn sih hi. Tualaitah in galvanlah tampi akihawm a, kengbaiten zong galvanlah ala uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh tua khuo a tengte’n, “Ka chi ana hi” achi sih ding ua, khuna teng mite thulimlouna ngaidam ahita ding hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nou namte aw, ngaikhe dingin hing naiun, nou mipite aw, ngaisah un! Leitung leh asunga um zousie in za uhen, leitung pumpi leh asung apat hing pawtkhie zousie in zong za uhen.","title":"Namte tunga thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen Namte zousie tungah Mangpa alungkim sih a, tualeh agalkapte uh zousie tungah athangpai a, amaute nasetah in asumang kilkel a, amaute tha dingin mithatte kung ah ape dohta hi."},"3":{"text":"Amithate uh paidoh in aum ding ua, amishi luongte ua kipat a-ui apawtkhe dinga, muolte a sisan utoh azun ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Van aasite zousie a zunmang ding a, vante zong laibu ziel bangin akiziel ding a, van aasite zousie grepgui akipat anate akieh bang leh theipi ga akung akipat apul bangin apulkhe ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 24.29; Mak. 13.25; Luk. 21.26; Kihil. 6.13,14"},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen ka namsau van ah silsieng ahi dinga, en in, Edom tung leh ka hamsiet mite tungah thukhen dingin ahing tung ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 63.1-6; Jer. 49.7-22; Ezek. 25.12-14; 35.1-15; Amos. 1.11,12; Obad. 1.1-14; Mala. 1.2-5"},"6":{"text":"Mangpa namsau khu sisan in adim a, thauna a suhthau in a umta a, belamnoute leh kelte sisan in, belamtalte kala thauin: Mangpa’n Bozrah khuo ah kithoina anei a, Edom gam ah mithana nasatah anei hi."},"7":{"text":"Gam bawngtalte ama utoh ahing puisuh ding ua bawngtal tuoite leh bawngtal hattahte toh; agam un sisan akham ding a, aleivuite uh thauna a suhthauin a um ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa phubalahna ni ahia, Zion kalna lam thu a thuhna kum zong ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh aluite uh long-nai asuoh dinga, aleivuite uh kaat asuoh dinga, agam uh zong long-nai meikah luoi luoi asuohta ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Sun leh zan in meikuong amit sih dinga, meikhu kumtawn in azamtou den dinga, akhang akhangin gamsung aseden dinga, koiman a zawtkha nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 14.11; 19.3"},"11":{"text":"Simbute leh sakuten tua gam aluo ding ua, simbupi leh va ahte zong atengta ding uhi. Mangpa’n atungah lungbuoigawpna khaujen ahung dinga, hawmguohna suong atungah akhai ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Amiliente uh leenggam ah ahan ding ua, hinanleh koima a umsih dinga, aleeng tapate u’zong bangma ahisih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh lingte leeng inn huongsungah apouta dinga, akulpi sung uah ling leh khaute apouta dinga, si-alte leh gamva kengsangte tenna ahita ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Gamdai a gamsate leh si-alte akimutuo ding ua, sakelten alawm aguolte ahan ding ua, gamsa zantatte zong tuanah akhawl ding ua, ama a dingin khawlna mun akimuta ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Khunah simbupiin abu abawl dinga, atui atha dinga, akeu dinga, ahalim nuoi ah anoute a awpkhum ding hi; khunah langtate anupa-paun a um khawm ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa laibu sunga kipat suidoh unlen sim un: tam silte khat zong akimlou a um sih dinga, koppi neilou a um sih ding hi. Aziehpen Ka kam ngelngel in thu ka pie a, tualeh A hagau in tuate alakhawmta hi."},"17":{"text":"Aman ama ua dingin ai asan pieh a, akhut a tein ahawmpieh chiet a, kumtawn in anei den ding ua, akhang akhangin tuanah ateng ding uhi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gamdai leh gamgawte ama uh ziehin, akipahta ding ua, gamgaw zong nuom in heisa bangin, apallunta ding hi.","title":"Israel leenggam hing um ding guolzawlna"},"2":{"text":"Nasatah in apallun ding a, nuom a kipah in la asa ding a, Lebanon thupina khu, akunga piehin a umta dinga, Karmel leh Sharon kilawmna thupitah, Mangpa vangletna leh, i Pasian kilawmnathupitah amu ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Khut hatloute hatsah unlen, khup zawte zong khausah un.","ref":"Heb. 12.12"},"4":{"text":"Lungsim meipuote kungah, “Hattah in um unlen, zau sih un! En un, na Pasian uh phuba la dingin, ahing pei ding a, Pasian ngei khu thuhna toh, ahing pei dinga, noute ahing hundam ding hi,” chi un."},"5":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin mittote mit vahsah in a um dinga, bilbingten aza theita ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 11.5; Luk. 7.22"},"6":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin kengbaite sakhi bangin, a kidieng ding ua, hamtheiloute lei in la asata ding hi; aziehpen gamdaiah tui ahing apuldohta dinga, gamgaw ah luite aluongta ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Sehnel sa mama mun zong diil a suoh dinga, tualeh gam dangtatah zong tuinah ahingsuoh dinga; si-al tenna leh lupna munte ah, hampa leh pumpeng, tualeh gulphitte apouta ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh khunah lampi leh lamlienpite aum ding a, tua khu Sienthouna lamlien akichi ding a, misienglouten tua lampi azui thei sih ding ua, hinanleh midangte a ding ahizaw ding hi. Tuami lampi zui mi mote nangawn zong, apielmang sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Khunah humpibahneite a um sih dinga, sa sielne mawngmawng khunah apeitou sih dinga, mu khah in a um sih ding hi. Hinanleh tatsate khunah avahkawi ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa tatsate ahing kinuale kia ding ua, la sa kawm in, alutung ua kumtawn kipahna toh, Zion ah apeitou ding uhi. Amaun nopna leh kipahna amuta ding ua, lunggimna leh mauna aumnawnsih ding hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Hezekiah vaihawm kum sawm leh kumli achin kum in, Assiria leengpa Sennakerib Juda gama khopi kulpi nei zousie dou dingin ahing peitou a, alata hi.","title":"Pasian tunga Sennakerib kiletsahna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Assiria leengpa’n Rabshakeh galkap tampi toh Lakish apat in Jerusalem ah leengpa Hezekiah kungah asawl hi. Tualeh Rabshakeh khu dil sahtazaw a tuilahna kunga puonsopmite gamlam zotna lamlien ah a ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa innsung vaisaipa Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigielpa Shebna, tualeh tanchin gielpa Asaph tapa Joah, ama kungah haw dingin ahing pawtdoh uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rabshakeh in akung uah, “Hezekiah kungah gen un: Lengpa thupitah Assiria leengpa’n tambangin agen hi: Bang kimuonna nei na hiei mah, Koi muong na hiei mah? achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Kidouna dinga thahatna leh lemgelna ka nei nachi viel a, thumanlou gen nahi bou hi. Tuin koi muonga ka tunga hel na hiei?"},"6":{"text":"Ngaiin, tami pumpeng chiengkhut tawngsa Iziptte muong na hi; mi ama tunga akingap leh akhut sung asun dinga, Izipt leengpa Pharaoh khu ama muongte tungah tuabangin a um ngitnget hi.","ref":"Ezek. 29.6,7"},"7":{"text":"“Hinanleh Mangpa ka Pasian uh muong kahi uh” nachi viel uleh, Ama khu Hezekiah in Judate leh Jerusalem kunga, tami maitam masang maimai a, Pasian na bieh ding uh ahi, chia amunsangte uleh “Amaitamte uh asuhmang pieh khu hilou ahiei mah?"},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin ka hing ngen ahi, ka pu Assiria leengpa kungah thu chiem inlen, tuachi’n atunga tuong ding mi na mungap pou u’leh sakol sang ni ka hing pe ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Bangchidan a, Sakolleng leh sakol tung tuong thu a Iziptte na muon a, ka pu suohte lah a lamkai neupen nangawn na nangzou na ding amah?"},"10":{"text":"Tam gam dou ding leh suse dingin Mangpa tellou a hing kuontou ka hiei mah? Mangpa’n ka kungah tam gam dou dingin kuontou inlen, susegawp in ahing chi hi, chiin va gen un, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Eliakim, Shebna leh Joah in Rabshakeh kungah “Hepitah in na suohte Siria ham in hing houpi in aziehpen ka theina uhi, kulbang tunga mite zahin ka kung uah Hebru ham in thu gen sin” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Rabshakeh in: “Ka pu in na pu u’leh noute kung maimai a tam thute gen dinga ahing sawl ahiei mah? Kulbang tunga touten noute toh a eeh uh ne a, azun uh dawn dingte kunga zong tam thute gen dinga ahing sawl ka hisih amah?” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rabshakeh adingdoh a, Hebru ham in aw ngaitah in akikou a, akung uah “Leengpa thupitah, Assiria leengpa thu ngai un,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tambangin leengpa’n thu agen hi, Hezekiah sol in um sihun, ama’n noute ahing hundoh zou sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Hezekiah in, “Mangpa’n ahing hundam ngeingei dinga, tam khopi Assiria leengpa khut ah pieh in a umsih ding hi;” chiin Hezekiah in Mangpa hing muongsah sih heh."},"16":{"text":"Hezekiah thu ngaikhe sih un, aziehpen Assiria leengpa’n tambangin agen hi: Keima toh kilemna bawl unlen, keilam ah hing pang un; tuachi’n michin in ama grepguiga kineh chiet unlen, michin in ama theipi-ga chiet kineh uhenlen, tualeh michin in ama tuikhuh apat tui kidawn chiet u heh."},"17":{"text":"Ka hing pei a, nouma gam bang banga, bu leh bal, zu leh sa tamna gam, tanghou leh grep huonte umna gama kang tut masangsie in;"},"18":{"text":"Pilvang un, tuachilou in, Hezekiah in “Mangpa’n eite ahing hundoh na ding hi” chi’n ahing zawl zou kha ding hi. Namte pasiente lah ah mi khat mawngmawng in zong Assiria leengpa khuta pat in agam ahumbit kha tai mah?"},"19":{"text":"Hamath leh Arpadte pasiente hei a um ahita uoi? Sepharvaimte pasiente hei a um ahi uoi? Ngaiin ka khut sung apat Samaria ahunkhe ngai uh amah?"},"20":{"text":"Tam gamte pasiente zousie lah a koipen in ahiei ka khut sunga kipat agam uh ahutkhieh ngaitah uh, ka khut sunga pat Mangpa’n Jerusalem ahutkhiet thei mawngmawng ding?” chi un, achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh amauh asip dide ua, adawng vawt sih uhi, aziehpen leengpa thupieh khu amauh “Dawng vawt sih un,” chi ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa innsung vaisaipa Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigielpa Shebna, tualeh tanchin gielpa Asaph tapa Joah in apuon uh abotkeh ua, Hezekiah kungah ahing pei ua, Rabshakeh thugente ahilta uhi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Hezekiah in tam thu azah tahin, apuonsilte abotkeh a, sai-ip puon kikhukhum in Mangpa inn ah apeita hi.","title":"Sennakerib khut apat Juda kihuhdohna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n a innsung vaisaipa Eliakim toh, laigielpa Shebna toh, siempute lah a upate sai-ip puon silin Amoz tapa guolnei Isai kungah asawlta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh amaun akungah, Hezekiah in “Tambang achi hi, tuni khu mangbatna leh kihousietna leh Pasian gensietna ni ahi: aziehpen tate apien uh ahunta a, hinanleh amauh hingkhe dingin thahatna a umsih hi."},"4":{"text":"Rabshakeh apu Assiria leengpa’n Pasian hing gense dinga asawlpa thugente, Mangpa na Pasian in ana za ngei ngei dinga, Mangpa na Pasian in athuzahte ziehin ama ahouse nuom khamaw sih ding hi. Tuaziehin ashimawh nuasie a umsunte a dingin na thumna lantou in achi hi,” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuabanga leengpa Hezekiah miliente Isai kunga ahing tuntah un,"},"6":{"text":"Isai in amaute kungah, “Tambangin na pu uh kungah na gen un, Tambangin Mangpa’n agen hi, Assiria leengpa suohten keima ahing gensietna thu na zahte ziehin zau vawt sin;"},"7":{"text":"Ngai in atungah bang hagau ahiei khat ka sawl dinga, ama’n thuthang khat aza dinga, ama gam lam ah anuakia ding a, ama gam ngel ah namsau in ka puasah ding hi, achi hi,” chi un, achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rabshakeh akinuale ta a, Assiria leengpa’n Libnah adou laitah amu a, aziehpen leengpa’n Lakish khuo anuasieta chi athei hi.","title":"Hezekiah kunga Sennakerib thuvaihah"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Assiria leengpa Sennakerib in Ethiopia leengpa Tirhakah “Nangma dou dingin ahing kuon hi” chi thuthang aza hi. Tua thu azah tahin Hezekiah kungah mi asawl a,"},"10":{"text":"“Tambangin Juda leengpa Hezekiah kungah gen un, Na muon na Pasian in Jerusalem khuo Assiria leengpa khut ah pieh ahi sih ding chi in hing sol sih heh."},"11":{"text":"Ngaiin, Assiria leengten gam zousie asuhsiet sieng dan uh na zata uhi, tualeh nang zong ahing kihunkhe tuom ding amah?"},"12":{"text":"Namte pasiente’n, kapu kapate un ana suhsiet uh, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, tualeh Telassar khuo a um, Eden mite ahunkhe ngel uoi mah?"},"13":{"text":"Hamath khopi leengpa, Arphad khopi leengpa, Sepharvaim khopi leengpa, tualeh Hena leh Ivah leengpate hei a um ata uoi?” Chi’n lai ape sah hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Hezekiah in palaite apat in laihah amu a, asimta hi, tuachi’n Hezekiah Mangpa inn ah apeitou a, Mangpa mai ah tuo laihah aphata hi.","title":"Hezekiah thumna (2 Leeng. 19.14-19)"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hezkiah Mangpa mai ah athumta a,"},"16":{"text":"“Aw galkapte Mangpa, Israelte Pasian Cherubimte kikaal a tengpa aw, leitung leenggam zousie a nang bou Pasian na hi a, Nangman lei leh van na siem hi.","ref":"Pawt. 25.22"},"17":{"text":"Mangpa aw nabil hing daw inlen, hing ngaikhie in; Aw Mangpa na mit hah inlen en in, Nang Pasian hing, hing gense dinga mi hing sawlpa Sennakerib in thu ahing hahte zousie ngaikhie in."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa aw Assiria leengten namte leh agamte uh asusie uhi chi khu atahtah ahi ngut hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaun apasiente uh meikhuh ah apailut uhi, aziehpen tuate pasiente ahisih ua khut a bawlthu sing leh suongte ahi zaw uhi. Tuaziehin tuate asusie uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, Aw Mangpa ka Pasian uh, leitung leenggam zousie in Nang maimai Pasian na hi chi ahing theina dingun akhut apat in hing hundam in,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amoz tapa Isai in Hezekiah kungah mi asawl a, “Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Assiria leengpa Sennakerib toh kisaia ka kunga na hing thum ziehin;","title":"Sennakerib puana ding"},"22":{"text":"Mangpa’n ama tungtanga athugen tami ahi: “Zion tanu nungah siengthou in, nang ahing simmaw a, simmaw in ahing nuisan hi, Jerusalem tanu in alu ahing thinkhum hi."},"23":{"text":"“Koi ahiei na minsietsah a, na gensiet, Koidou a na aw nasansah a, na mit ha na sangdah sah ahiei? Israelte Mi Siengthoupa dou na hi maw!"},"24":{"text":"Na suohte mangin Mangpa na simmaw a, ka sakolleng tampite toh muolsangtahte tungah, Lebanon gamgi hasa mama lah ah, ka hing kuontou a, a sidar sing sangte ka phua dinga, ta-sing hoi penpente ka phua dinga, tualeh muolsang gamla pente leh, gammang lei hoina munte ah ka lut ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tui ka toudoh a, ka dawn hi; ka ketaw in Izipt luitate zousie ka tuon kangta hi, na chi hi."},"26":{"text":"“Keima’n ni danglai a ka nabawl, tanglai peh a ka na guotsa ahi chi na za ei? tuazieh a nang kulpi muonhuoite na suhsiet a, inn sie kisievum na bahsah dingin, tuin ka tangtungsah ahi?"},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin asung a um miten hatna anei nawn sih ua, mangbangin azalata ua, gamlah hampa pou bang, hampa hing bang, leh inn tunga hampa pou bang leh, akhandoh masang a haivuoi a um, bu hing poudoh bang bep ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"“Hinanleh keiman, na umna mun, na pawtdoh leh na lutdan, tualeh ka tunga na thangpai dante ka thei hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka tunga na thangpai zieh leh, na ki-uohsahna kamsuote, ka bil a ahing lut ziehin, ka siakawi na nahkuo ah ka vaw dinga, ka kamkaina na kamah ka vaw ding hi. Tualeh na hing peina lampi mama ah, ka hing nuakia sah ding hi."},"30":{"text":"“Tualeh Hezekiah aw tami nanga dingin, chiemtena ahi dinga, tukum in bu-li poute nane ding ua, tualeh akum nina ah zong bu-li apat a, hing poudohte nane nalai ding ua, akum thumna ah pen, bu tu-unlen, at unlen, grep-huonte bawl unlen aga nane ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Juda innkuonte lah a suohta umsunten, nuoi lam ah hui ahasuh ding ua, tunglam ah ga asuong ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Aziehpen Jerusalem apat in a umsunte apawtdoh ding ua, Zion muol akipat in asuohta sunte apawtdoh ding uhi. Galkapte Mangpa phattuomngaina in, tami atang tungsah ding hi."},"33":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mangpa’n Assiria leengpa tungtangah, tambangin agen hi: Ama tam khopi sungah ahing lut sih dinga, tuanah thaltang khat zong akap lutsih dinga, amasang ah lum le phaw toh ahing peisih dinga, akimkot ah zong panmun khawin leipal atou sih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahing kuonna lampi mama ah anuakia dinga, tam khopi sungah alut sih ding hi; Mangpa’n achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Aziehpen keima ziehin leh ka suohpa David ziehin, tam khopi ka vengbit dinga, ka hundam ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi,” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa vansawlsieng akuonkhie a, Assiriate giehphuol ah mi tulza leh tulsawmgiet leh tulnga ava thatta hi; tualeh zingmawnga mite ahingthaw tahun, en vawi, mishisa luong ngen ana hita uhi.","title":"Sennakerib guollelna leh shina"},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n Assiria leengpa Sennakerib giehphuol nuasie in apawtkhie a, a inn lam ah akinuale a, Nineveh khuo ah a umta hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuin hichi ahing hi a, apasien Nisrok inn a pasien bie a aumlaiin, atapate Andramelek leh Sharezer in namsau in ama ava satlum ua, tualeh amautegel Ararat gam ah ataimangta uhi. Tuachi’n atapa Esar-haddon ama thahengin leeng in apangta hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hunlaiin, Hezekiah shi ding khopin achina hi. Tualeh Amoz tapa guolnei Isai akungah avahaw a, akungah “Tambangin Mangpa’n achi hi: Na innsung um ding dan geltupsa in koiin, aziehpen shi ding nahi, na damdoh zou nawnsih ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Hezekiah damsung belapna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hezekiah banglam nga in akihei a, Mangpa kungah athum a,"},"3":{"text":"“Aw Mangpa ka hing ngen ahi, na masanga thutah leh lungtang hoibukim puo a ka gamtat dan leh namit mu a silhoi ka bawl dante thei ngitnget in,” achi a, hasetah in akapta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu Isai kungah ahing tunga,"},"5":{"text":"“Pei inlen, Hezekiah kungah va gen in, Mangpa na pa David Pasian in tambangin agen hi: na thumna ka zata a, na hituite zong ka muta hi; Ngaiin, na damsung nite kum sawm leh nga ka belap ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Assiria leengpa khut akipat in nangma leh tam khopi ka humbit ding, tualeh tam khopi ka vengbit ding hi, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tami nanga dingin Mangpa akipat chiemtena ahi ding hi Mangpa’n agensa abawl ngeingei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"En in, Ahaz Kalbi a nisa him tena, tena sawm dong kanua kia sah ding,” achi hi. Tuachi’n nisa khu kalbi sawmna dong akinua khinta a, adiepnasa khu akhawkiata hi."},"9":{"text":"Juda leengpa Hezekiah achinatna akipat a ahing damdoh kia bep a alaigel tami ahi:"},"10":{"text":"Ke’n ka damsung nite vanglaitah in, mishi khuo kotpi a, lut dingin ka kisa a, ka damsung kum um nalaite lahpieh a, um ding kata diei izaw, ka chi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ke’n, Mangpa mihing gam ah ka mu kia nawn sih dinga; leitunga umte lah ah mihing ka mu kia nawn sih ding, ka chi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka damsung kumte abeita a, belamchingpa puon inn kiphelkhie bangin, ka hinna kei akipat lahmangin a umta hi. Siemgan miten apuon a ziel bangin, ka hinna ka ziel a, aman siembu apat in ahing attan a, sun akipat zan dongin, ka hinna na tawpsah hi."},"13":{"text":"Zingmawng dongin panpi ngaiin ka kikou a, humpibahnei bangin kagu katang zousie atawng sah a, sun akipat zan dongin ka hinna na tawpsah hi."},"14":{"text":"Vakang ahiei, sielpaleng ahiei bangin, ka ham ham a, vakhu bangin ka thum thum a, tunglam etna in ka mit avaita hi. Aw Mangpa suhgenthei in ka um hi, kei hing panpi in."},"15":{"text":"Bang ka genta diei? Aman ka kungah thu agen a, agen bangin abawl pai hi; ka hinna aningkitel ziehin, ka damsung kum tengteng awlnou nou in, ka vah khien khienta ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Aw Mangpa tam silte in mihingte ahing ua, tualeh tam silte zousie ah ka hagau hinna a um hi. Tuaziehin ka hinna na hing bawlhoipieh dinga, na hing hingsah ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ngaiin ka hamuonna dingin, ningkitelna nasatah ka nei hi, hinanleh nangman ka hinna na it ziehin, sietna kokhuh apat in na hunkheta a, ka khelnate zousie na nualam ah na paimangta hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen hankhuh in ahing kipahpi thei sih a, shina in nang ahing phat thei sih hi; hankhuh sung tungsuhte’n, na thutah ahing kineppi thei sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Mihing, mihing dama hing nalaite’n, tuni-a ka bawl bangin Nang ahing phat ding uh a, pa in tate kungah na thutah atheisahta ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa khu kei hing hundam dingin, kimansain a um ngitnget a, tuaziehin kadam sung nite zousie in, Mangpa inn ah ka late tumging guineite toh kasa ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Isai in: “Theipi ga beu khat la uhenlen, abe a be-thaw dingin bawl uhenlen, a uilut-ma ah beh hen, tuachi’n adam ding hi,” ana chita hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Hezekiah in zong: “Mangpa inn ah ka peitou kia ding, chi chiemtena bang hi ding ahiei?” ana chita hi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun laiin Babilon leengpa Baladan tapa Merodak Baladan in laithon leh silpiehte Hezekiah kungah ahah hi, aziehpen achina a adam kiata chi aza hi.","title":"Hezekiah khelna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Hezekiah khu atung uah ana kipah a, agou kholkhawmna inn, sana, dangka, gimnamtuite leh sathau manphate, tualeh agalvan zousie koinate leh agou koikhawmna a sil um zousie amauh a ensahta hi; a innsung leh a leenggam sung a um zousie etsahlou bangma anei sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Khum hun laitah mama in, guolnei Isai leengpa Hezekiah kungah ahing pei a, akungah: “Tam miten bang agen uoi, hei sunga kipata nang kunga hing haw uh ahiei?” achi hi. Tualeh Hezekiah in “Amaute gamlatah a Babilon gam a kipat a ka kunga hing haw uh ahi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isai in: “Na inn sungah bang amu uoi?” achi hi. Tualeh Hezekiah in, “Ka innsunga sil um zousie amu uhi; ka goute lah ah amauh ka etsahlou bangma a um sih hi,” chi in adawnghi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Isai in, Hezekiah kungah, “Galkapte Mangpa thu na ngaiin:"},"6":{"text":"Ngaiin, na innsunga umte zousie leh na pu na paten tuni donga ana kholkhawmte uh, Babilon a puohmang nite hing tung ding ahi; bangma nuasie ahi sih dinga."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh na hah na suon, nangma akipat a piengkhie na tapate lawikhat apomang ding ua, Babilon leengpa inn sungah michilge in a um ding uhi;” achi hi.","ref":"Dan. 1.1-7; 2 Leeng. 24.10-16; 2 Khang. 36.10"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hezekiah in Isai kungah, “Mangpa thu na gen khu ahoi hi! Azieh pen aman ka damsung teng beh muonna leh thutah a um na lai ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hamuon un, hamuon un, ka mite hamuon un, na Pasian un achi hi.","title":"Zion a dinga hamuonna"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem kungah kamnem in gen unlen, galdouna abeita chi’n akungah kikou un, akhelnate uh ngaidam ahita a, akhelna tengteng ziehin, Mangpa khut a ale niin amuta uh chi hil un."},"3":{"text":"“Kikou aw khat in, Gamdai ah Mangpa lampi bawl unlen, i Pasian ua dingin gamgaw ah lamlien siem tang un.","ref":"Mat. 3.3; Mak. 1.3; Jn. 1.23  ;     \n        Luk. 3.4-6"},"4":{"text":"Guom chinteng suhdim ahi dinga, muol chin leh taang chin suhngiem ahi ding hi, lampi kawina munte suh tang ahi dinga, abaw na munte akisu mam ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa thupina khu suhlat ahita dinga, mi zousie in tua khu amu chiet ding uhi; aziehpen Mangpa kam in tua khu ana gensa ahita hi.”"},"6":{"text":"Tua aw in, “Kikou khie un” achi hi. Tualeh ke’n “Bang thugen a kikou ding ka hiei?” ka chi hi. Tahsa zousie hampa bang ahi a, akilawmna zousie uh gamlah pape bang bep ahi.","ref":"Jak. 1.10,11; 1 Pet. 1.24,25"},"7":{"text":"Hampate avuoi a, papete apul hi. Aziehpen Mangpa hui in asem a, mihingte hampa bang bep ahi tahpi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hampa avuoi a, pape zong apul hi; hinanleh Mangpa thu pen kumtawn in aumden ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Aw Zion, thu kipahhuoi hing tun mi, muol sang tungah katou inlen, Aw Jerusalem thu kipahhuoi tun mi, Hatna toh in kikou inlen, zau sin, Juda khopite kungah, “En un na Pasian uh,” chi un."},"10":{"text":"En un, Mangpa Pasian ban thahat toh ahing pei hi, aban in ama dingin vai ahawm ding hi. En un, akipahman akungah a um a, tualeh anasep amasang ah a um hi.","ref":"Isai. 62.11; Kihil. 22.12"},"11":{"text":"Aman belam chingpa bangin, abelamte ava ding a, Aban in belamnoute ahuoi khawm ding a, A angsunga pom in apeipi dinga, tualeh anou-kaite awl nounou in apui hi.","ref":"Ezek. 34.15; Jn. 10.11"},"12":{"text":"Koi ahiei tuite akhut kuoh sunga te a, van akhap a te a, leitunga leivuite tuot a, tena a te thei ding leh, tangte tena chienga te a, muolte tena sel a khai thei ding koi ahiei?"},"13":{"text":"Koi ahiei Mangpa Hagau bawldan ding kohmu a, ahisihleh Ama thumoppa banga thuhilchien?","ref":"Rom. 11.34; 1 Kor. 2.16"},"14":{"text":"Mangpa’n ama navah sah ding a koi ahiei adoh a, koi ahiei ama kunga dihtatna lampi hil? Koi ahiei ama theina hil a, ahisihleh theisiemna lampi akunga ensah?"},"15":{"text":"Ngaiin, Namte khu baltin a tui hi khat bang bep ahi ua, sil tena a leivui neng bang banga sim ahi giap hi. En in, Aman tuikuolkhum gamte sil neunou khat bangin, adomkangtou hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Lebanon singte sillat halna tham ahisih a, asunga gamsa um zousie zong halmang sillat, dingin akiching sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Nam zousie Ama masangah, bangmalou bang bep ahi ua, Ama ngaiin bangmalou sanga neu zaw leh, panna bei ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahileh Pasian khu, koi toh kibangin na ngaituo ding uoi? ahisihleh bang toh na tekah ding uoi?","ref":"Nasep. 17.29"},"19":{"text":"Na sempa’n milim pasien akhenga, Sana khengpa’n sana tui in aluonkhum a, dangka khengpa’n dangka khainieng asun pieh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua bang silpieh pe zoulou a zawng taluoten, sing muot theilou atel ua, khutsiem mi asui a, atawngsan lou ding suithaw milimte abawl sah hi."},"21":{"text":"Theikha nailou na hi uoi mah? Zakha nailou na hi uoi mah? Achiil apat a hing ki hilkhalou ahiei mah? Leitung kisiem chiil apata theisiem nailou na hi uh amah?"},"22":{"text":"Ama khu leitung kuolkhum tunga toupa ahi a, tualeh asunga tengte khauphe bang bep ahi uh, Aman vante puon inn zah bangin azahkhie a, tualeh tenna dingin puon inn zah bangin azahkhie hi."},"23":{"text":"Aman leengtapate bangmalou asuoh sah a, leitunga thukhen mite pannabei asuoh sah hi."},"24":{"text":"Tasamtah a suon ahi ding ua, Tasamtah a tu ahi ding ua, Tasamtah in akungte un leinuoi ah hui ahading ua Ama’n amaute asem chiengin, ahing vuoi ding ua, pingpei in bushi bangin atawmang ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Kei koi toh na hing te-un, ahisihleh koi toh ka kikim ei? Asiengthoupa’n achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tunglam ah dahtou unlen en un, Tam silte zousie koisiem ahiei en un, Ama’n van aasite khat khat in apuidoha, amaute amin min un ahan hi. Ama vangletna thupina leh, A silbawltheina thahatna ziehin akimlou khat beh zong umsih hi."},"27":{"text":"Jakobte aw bang dinga, hichi banga chi nahi uoi, Israelte aw bang dinga tambang thu gen na hi uoi, “Ka lampite Mangpa akipat phuol ahia, ka dihna ka Pasian lah ah lahmang ahita, chi nahi uoi mah?”"},"28":{"text":"Na theikha naisih uh amah? Na za kha ngai naisih uh amah? Kumtawn Mangpa khu Pasian ahi a, leitung tawpnate siempa khu agim ngai sih a, zong aba ngai sih hi, atheisiemnate suidoh guol ahi sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama’n mi hatloute kungah thahatna apie a, basamte kungah thahatna abelap pieh hi."},"30":{"text":"Khanglaite nangawn agim un, aba ding ua, tualeh tangvalte apua ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa ngahte pen ahatna uh, siemtha ahi ding ua, muvanlai bangin ha in aleengtou ding ua, atai ding ua, agim sih ding uhi; tualeh kengin apei ding ua, aba sih ding uhi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nou tuipi panga gamte aw, Ka masangah dai dide unlen, mipiten ahatna uh siemtha kia u’henlen, hing pei nai u’henlen, thu gen uhen, vaihawm dingin pei khawm chiet vai.","title":"Pasian thupina zieh a, hamuonna"},"2":{"text":"Suolam akipat a mi tohthou khu koi ahiei? Dihtatna akeng bula ama hanpa koi ahiei? Amasanga namte pie a, a tung ua vaihawm sahpa koi tundoh ahiei? Ama’n amaute anamsau in leivui bangin abawl a, athalpi in bushi hui mut leng a bang sah hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama’n amauh anuadel a, ni danga a kenga apei khah ngailouna lampi ah, bittah in apei suoh zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Achila kipat a suon zousie han a, tami sem a bawl zou koi ahiei? Kei Mangpa amasapen leh anukhiapen Ama khu, Keima ka hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuipi panga gamten tua khu amu ua, azau uhi, Kolmongate zong a zau ua, ahing nai ua, ahing pei uhi."},"6":{"text":"Michin in a innvengte apanpi ua, a unaupa kungah “Hangsantah in um in,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Khutsiempa’n sana khengpa ahantawh a, seh a khengmampa’n, seh nuoipha siakhengpa ahantawh a, “Asoumatna ding mansa ahi,” achi a, akitollouna dingin akilna in akildet hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh nou ka suoh Israel, ka tel tuom Jakob, ka lawm Abraham hahlesuonte nahi uhi.","ref":"2 Khang. 20.7; Jak. 2.23"},"9":{"text":"Noute kawlmong akipat a ka hing lah doh, gam ning gamla pen akipat a ka hing hatdoh, “Noute ka suohte na hi ua, ka teltuomte nahi uhi; Noute ka hing paimang sih hi,” ka chita hi."},"10":{"text":"Zau sih un, ka hing umpi hi, Lungke sih un, Keima na Pasian uh ka hi. Ka hing hat sah dinga, Ahi, ka hing panpi dinga, ka dihtatna khut zietlam in ka hing tudet ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ngai un, noute tunga lungdamlou zousie muol phoutah in aum ding ua, azala ding uhi, bangma ahi sih ding ua, nou hing kidoupite amangthai ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Nou hing kihaupite na sui ding ua, na muzou sih ding uhi, Nou hing doute bangmalou bang ahi ding ua, sil umlou bang ahi ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen keima Mangpa na Pasian un na khut zietlam ka hing tudet ding hi, “Zau sihun, ka hing panpi ding hi,” na kung ua chipa khu keima ka hi."},"14":{"text":"Jakob nang tangtel leh, Nou Israel mite aw, zau sihun, ka hing panpi ding hi, Mangpa leh noute hing Tanpa, Israel Misiengthoupa’n, achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ngai un, bu satna chieng tha ha hiemtah nei in, ka hing bawl dinga, taangte na satnen dinga, muolte bushi bangin na bawl ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Amauh na zap dinga, hui in amutleeng dinga, pingpei in athethang ding hi. Nangpen Mangpa ah na kipah dinga, tualeh Israel Misiengthoupa na suongta ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mizawng leh tasamten tui asui chiengun a um sih a, aleite uh dangta a agaw chiengin, Kei Mangpa’n amauh ka ngaikhe dinga, Keima Israelte Pasian in, amauh ka nuasie sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Muol gumgawta lah ah lui ka luongsah dinga, phaijang lai ah tuinah ka pulsah ding hi, gamdai gamgaw khu tuikul in ka bawl dinga, gamgaw khu tuinah in ka siem ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Gamdai ah sidar singte, gisingte, mui singte, leh Olive singte ka suon ding a, gamgaw ah, tasingte, phante leh singgil chinteng, ka suonkhawm ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa khut in tua silte abawl a, Israel Misiengthoupa’n asiem ahi chi, amu ua, athei ua, ahing ngaituo ua, ahing theisiem khawm chiet na dinguh ahi."},"21":{"text":"Na tung thu uh hing gen un, Mangpa’n achi hi, na paulap pansan liente uh hing tahlang un, Jakob leengpa’n, achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaun tuate hing tahlang uhenlen, sil hing tung dingte hing musah uheh, ingaituo a, atawpna nukhialam itheina ding un, ahisihleh sil hing tung ding hing theisah uhen."},"23":{"text":"Tu nua chienga sil hing tung dingte, hing hil u’lachin pasiente na hi na uh, chi ka hing thei ding uhi; ilungkieh khawm chiet ua, i et khawm chiet theina dingun, silsie ahiei silhoi ahiei, khat poupou hing bawl madi ua-le."},"24":{"text":"En un, noute bangmalou na hi ua, na nasep u’zong bangmalou ahi a, noute hing tel dohpa zong, kidah huoi ahi."},"25":{"text":"Mallam a kipat in mi khat ka tohthou a, ama ahing kuon ding a, Ama’n ni suohnalam akipat in ka min a han dinga, Ama’n leeng tapate sum sunga bu suh bangin, asuguoi dinga, belkhengmi’n tungman achil bangin achil ding hi."},"26":{"text":"I theina ding ua, a chiil akipat a na genkhie koi ahiei? “Ama adih” ichi theina dinga nagen masa thei koi ahiei? Agenkha mawngmawng a um sih ua, Koiman zong ahilkha mawngmawng sih ua, Na thugente ngaikhe mawngmawng a um sih uhi."},"27":{"text":"Amasapen in Zion kungah, En in khunah amauh a um hi ka chi dinga, tualeh Jerusalem kungah, thu kipahhuoi tuntu mi khat ka peding hi."},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen ka en a, koima a um sih hi, Ama ulah ka en a, thumop mi koima a um sih hi, Amauh ka doh chiengin, kam khat a hing dawng thei koima a um sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"En un amaute pannabei ngen ahi ua, anasepte u’zong bangmalou ahi a, amilim khenthute uh hui ahia, buoina bep ahi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En un, ka tawisang ka suohpa ka teltuom ka hinna hagau in akipahpi mama, Atungah ka hagau ka koita a, Aman namte kungah, dihtah a vaihawmna thu podoh ding hi.","title":"Pasian suohpa zieh a hamuonna","ref":"Mat. 3.17; 17.5; Mak. 1.11; Luk. 3.22; 9.35  ;     \n        Mat. 12.18-21"},"2":{"text":"Ama akikou sih dinga, aw sangin thu agen sih dinga, gawlzing lah ah a aw akizasah sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama’n pumpeng kihiehgawpsa asutawng sih dinga, thaumei kuong mem mem asumit sih ding a, dihna in thutah ahing podoh ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Leitunga dihna toh vaihawmna a umsah masangsie, abasih dinga, zong alungke sih ding hi; Tuipi panga gamten adan thu angah zing ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian vante siem a, puonbang a jahpa, leitung leh asunga pat a pawtte zousie, puon banga pha-pa, leitunga mihingte kunga nahna hu pepa leh, leitunga tengte hinna hagau pepa’n; tambangin agen hi.","ref":"Nasep. 17.24,25"},"6":{"text":"“Kei Mangpa’n dihtatna in nang ka hing han a, na khut in ka hing tudet dinga, ka hing keem dinga, tualeh mite thuhun ding leh Jentelte vah hi dingin, ka hing pe ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 49.6; Luk. 2.32; Nasep. 13.47; 26.23"},"7":{"text":"Mittote mit vah sah ding leh, suongkul tangte suongkul apat suohtasah ding leh, suongkul miellah a toute, puidoh dingin."},"8":{"text":"Kei Mangpa ka hi a, tua khu Ka min ahi, ka thupina midang kungah ka pesih dinga, Ka patat lawnate zong milim bawlthute, kungah ka pesih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"En un, sil masate khu ahing tungta a, tualeh sil thate ka phuongkhie hi, ahing poudoh masang un, amaute tanchin nang ka hinghil ahi.”"},"10":{"text":"Nou tuipi a peisuhte leh asunga um zousiete, tuipi panga um gamte leh asunga umte aw, kawlmong akipat in Mangpa phatna la tha sa unlen, aphatna la sa un.","title":"Mangpa’n amite ahuhdoh zieh a phatna"},"11":{"text":"Gamdai leh akhopiten aw ngaitah suo uhenlen, Kedarte tenna khoneute leh, Sela a tengten la sa uhenlen, muolvum ah kikou uhen."},"12":{"text":"Thupina Mangpa kungah pie uhenlen, tuipi panga gamte ah, Ama phatna phuongzah uhen."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa khu mihattah bangin apawtdoh dinga, galdoumi bangin aphattuomngaina atohthou ding hi. Akikoudoh dinga, Ahi, ngaitahin akikou ding hi; agalte tungah aguolzou ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hun sawtpi hamuongin ka um a, dai dide in ka kideh a, tuin numei nauvei banga kikou ding ka hi, thakhat in ka nah hehu dinga, ka naw-nah ding hi.","title":"Mangpa’n amite panpi ding achiemna"},"15":{"text":"Muol leh taangte bangmalou ka suohsah dinga, atung a hampa pou zousie ka gawsah sieng dinga, luite khu tuikuol gam in ka bawl ding a, tualeh tuikulte ka kanggaw sah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Mittote atheingailouna uh lampite ah ka tut dinga, atheingailou uh lampi ah ka pui ding hi. Amasang uah miel khu vah ka suohsah dinga, akawina munte ka tangsah ding hi. Tam silte ama ua dingin ka bawlpieh dinga, ka taisan sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Milim bawlthute muonga, milimte kunga “Ka pasiente na hi uh,” chite pen kinuahei sah in a um ding ua, nasatah a maizum in a um ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Nou bilbingten za un, nou mittoten na mu theina ding un en un."},"19":{"text":"Ka suohpa hilou koi e mitto? ahisihleh ka sawlkawi, ka sawl banga bilbing koi ahiei? Ama a hoibukim banga mitto koi ahiei? tualeh Mangpa suohpa bang a mitto koi ahiei?"},"20":{"text":"Sil tampi na mu a hinanleh, lungsim in navom zing ngaisih hi, abilte a honga hinanleh a za tuom sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Adihtatna ziehin Mangpa akipah mama a, ama’n adan atawisanga, tualeh zatathuoi in abawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh tam mite pen gutate guhpieh leh, suom gawp a umte ahi ua, ahawm lah a thanga awhte ahi ua, suongkul a phuol mang a umte ahi ua, koima huhdoh lou a, sielneh ding ahi ua, galvan lah a lah dingte ahi ua, “Koiman nuasawl kia un,” achi sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Na lah ua koi ahiei tam thu a bil daw dinga, hun hing tung ding ngaikhie a za ding koi ahiei um?"},"24":{"text":"Koi ahiei gallah dinga Jakob pekhie a, tualeh Israel suomhatte khut a pie koi ahiei? Atunga ina khelnapa uh, Mangpa pieh hilou ahiei mah? Aziehpen alampi azui nuom sih ua, Adan thute thumang tah a zui nuom koima a um sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aman atungah alungthahna meisa leh, kidouna thahatna asung buo hi; tuami’n akimvel uah mei akasahta a, hinanleh amaun athei sih uhi; tuami’n amauh akaa a, hinanleh alungtang un a ngaituo sih uhi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin Aw Jakob, nang hing siempa leh, Aw Israel nang hing bawlpa Mangpa’n, tambangin agen hi: “Zau sin, ka hing tandohta a, Na min in ka hing hanta hi, Kei a na hita hi.","title":"Israel tunding kia zieh a lungmuonna"},"2":{"text":"Tuite na pal galkai chiengin, ka hing umpi dinga, luite na pal chiengin, tuiin ang tum sih ding hi. Meikuong lai a na peisuoh chiengin, a hing ka sih ding a, meikuongin zong ang hul khasih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen kei Mangpa na Pasian, Israel Misiengthoupa, nang hing Hundampa ka hi. Noute tatna dingin Izipt ka pie a, Ethiopia leh Seba gamte noute taangin ka pie hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka mitmu in manpha mama na hiziehin, zatathuoi nahi a ka hing itta a, tuaziehin na taangin midangte ka pe dinga, na hinna taang un mite ka pe ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Zau sih un, na kung uah ka um hi, suolam akipat in nahah nasuonte, ka hing zawpi ding a, tumlam akipat in ka hing kaikhawm ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mallam kungah ha un ka chi dinga, simlam kungah amaute tu taang sih un, ka chi ding hi; gamlapi akipat in ka tapate hing pui unlen, kawlmong akipat in ka tanute hing pui un, kachi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka min a kilou pouma, ka thupina dinga ka siem mi pouma, ama khu ka sutuo a, ama ka bawlta hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Mit nei ngal a, mittote leh bil nei ngal a bilbingte hing puidoh un."},"9":{"text":"Namte zousie khop khawm in um henlen, tualeh mipite kikhawm uhen, alah ua koi ahiei in tamte phuongzah thei in, sil masate koute kunga hing ensah thei ding? Siemtanga a um theina dingun, amauh theipitute hing puidoh uheh; ahisihleh tami thutah ahi chi za uhenlen, gen uhen."},"10":{"text":"“Noute keima theipitute, ka teltuom ka suohte na hi uh;” Mangpa’n achi hi. “Na hing thei ua, na hing gintat ua, kei khu ama kahi chi na hing theisiem theina ding un, Keima masangah Pasian dang a umsih a, ka nua ah zong a umsih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima ngel khu Mangpa ka hi a, Keima chilou hundampa a umsih hi."},"12":{"text":"Na lah ua gamdang pasiente a umlou laiin, Keima’n ka phuongdoh a ka hundamta hi, ka tangkoupi a tuazieh in, noute ka thu hing theipite nahi uhi.”"},"13":{"text":"Ahi, ni um masangin “Kei khu Ama ka hita hi; ka khut akipat hing ladoh thei koima a umsih ding hi; nna ka sema, koi ahiei phel thei ding?”"},"14":{"text":"Mangpa nou hing tanpa, Israel Misiengthoupa’n tam bangin agen hi, “Noute ziehin, Babilon ah mi ka sawl dinga, tuachi’n Kaldai mite zousie abawn un, akiletsahpi uh tembawte in, mi vahvai zawpi bang in ka zawpi suh ding hi.","title":"Pasian zangaina"},"15":{"text":"Kei Mangpa na Misiengthoupa uh, Israel siempa na Lengpa uh ka hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Mangpa tuipi tunga lamlien sielpa leh, tui thuhpitah tunga lampi sielpa;"},"17":{"text":"Sakolleng leh sakolte, galkapte leh asilbawltheina a, hing puidohpa’n alumkhawm sah dinga, athou nawn sih ding ua, suhchimit in a um ding ua, thaumei kuong mutmit abangta uhi."},"18":{"text":"“Tumasanga sil umsate theingitnget sih unlen, ni danglai a silte ngaituo nawn sih un."},"19":{"text":"Ngaiun sil tha khat ka bawl ding hi, tu in ahing poudoh ding a, na theisih ding uoi mah? Gamdai ah lampi ka siel dinga, tualeh gamgaw ah luite ka luongsah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Gamlah a gamsaten kei ahing zatat ding ua, si-alte leh gamva ngawnsaute nangawn in zong ahing zatat ding uhi, aziehpen gamdai ah tui ka pie a, ka telsa ka mite dawn dingin, gamgaw ah luite ka luongsah hi."},"21":{"text":"Tam mite keima a dinga kabawl ahia, amaute kei hing phat ding a ka bawlte ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"“Hinanleh Jakob aw, na hing han nai sih a, Israel aw, kei na hing chimtah zawsop hi.","title":"Israel muonhuoilouna"},"23":{"text":"Halmang sillat dingin na belamte uh, na hing tawi sih ua, Na kithoinate un na hing zatat nawn sih uhi. Sillat eng in puohgih ka hing guon sih a, gimnamtui eng in ka hing sugim sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Phai humtah sum in nang leipieh ngai sih ua, na kithoina thaute un zong na hing taisah ngai sih uhi. Hinanleh na khelnate ziehun, puohgih na hing guon zawsop uhi. Na khelnate un na hing lunggim sah zaw uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Kei, keima mama, ka hi, Keima zieha na tatkhielnate uh nawtmangpa ka hi a, na khelnate uh ka thei ngitnget nawn sih ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Hing theipi un, ngaituo khawm vai, siemtansah a na um theina dingun, na tungtang thu uh gen un."},"27":{"text":"Na pu masapen un akhielta a, tualeh na palaite u’zong ka tungah atakhielta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin munsiengthou a miliente, ka buasah dinga, tuachi’n Jakobte hamse thuoh dingin ka bawl dinga, Israelte gensiet dingin ka bawl ding hi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n, “Tuin ka suoh Jakob leh ka telsa Israel aw, ngai un.","title":"Israel tunga Pasian guolzawlna"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa noute hing siempa leh, naubu sunga kipat hing siempa, nou hing panpi dingpa’n tambangin agen hi: ka suoh Jakob leh, ka telsa nang Jeshurun aw, Zau sin."},"3":{"text":"Dangtate tungah tui ka buoh khum dinga, gamgaw tungah lui ka luongsah ding a; nahah nasuonte tungah ka hagau ka sungbaw dinga; tualeh na tate tungah guolzawlna ka sung ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh amaute pen lui panga huisumte bangin, hampa lah ah apoudoh ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mi khat in, Mangpa a kahi, achi dinga, midang Jakob min in ama leh ama akihan dinga, tualeh midang khat main, Mangpa a ding, chiin akhut agiel in, ama leh ama Israel min akivaw ding hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa Israelte Lengpa amaute Tanpa leh, galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Keima amasapen leh keima a nukhia pen ka hi, Keima loungal Pasian dang a um sih hi.","ref":"Isai. 48.12; Kihil. 1.17; 2.8; 22.13"},"7":{"text":"Ka phuondoh banga phuongdohthei koi ahiei? tuachi’n aman phuongdoh henlen, ka masang ah luikhie heh, nidanglai mite ka guot akipat sil umte leh, sil hing um dingte amaute kungah sulang uheh."},"8":{"text":"Zau sih unlen, giing sih un, Ken tam thu na kung uah khum hun lai akipat, noute ahing theipite nahi uhi, chiin ka hing hil masa sih amah? Kei loungal Pasian dang a um amah? Ahi, Pasian dang a um sih hi, khat zong ka thei sih hi.”"},"9":{"text":"Milim khenthu bawlte zousie bangmalou ahi uhi; sil manpha asahte un phattuomna anei sih ding uhi, amauh theipite amauh ma ahi ua, azum theina dingun, amusih ua athei sih uhi.","title":"Milim bieh mothuoina"},"10":{"text":"Koi ahiei bangma phattuomna neilou pasien leh, sunthaw milim na bawl?"},"11":{"text":"En in, alawm aguolte zousie azala ding ua, akhutsiemte ulah mihing bep ahi bou uhi, abawn un kigawm khawm uhenlen, pangkhawm uheh, khuchi in zong azau ding ua, azala khawm ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Siakhengpa’n taite toh mei-am lah ah sia a em a, seh toh milim akhenga, abantha hat in pum azap a, ahing gilkiel a athahatna abei a, tui adawn sih a, tuachi’n abata hi."},"13":{"text":"Singbawlpa’n tena khau in sing ate a, chiemtena laikungin amelchi a, sing nawtna in anawt tuoh a, tena chiengin ate tuoh a, mihing lim bangin abawl a, innsung a koi dingin mihing kilawmna bangin azem hi."},"14":{"text":"Aman sidar singte ama a dingin aphua a, se sing leh gangpi singte ala a, gammanga singte lah ah khat ama a dingin akhawi a; ta-sing asuon a, tua khu guotui in akhangsah hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n mihingte dinga singvah ding ahita dinga, tua khu ahal ua a awilum ua, meiin atawkuong ua, tanghou a em uhi; tua singte ma in pasien abawl ua, abie uhi. Milim bawlthu akheng ua, amai ah akuun uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua singte kimkhat mei ah a vanga, ann huonna in anei a, sa zong a em a, taitah in ane hi, tua mei a awi a, “Ah! lum e, mei ka muta” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh avalte in milim pasien abawl a, amilim bawlthu mai ah bie in akuun a, akungah thu angen a, “Hing hundoh in ka pasien na hi” achi zel hi."},"18":{"text":"Amauten athei sih ua, atheisiem sih uhi, Aziehpen amu theilouna dingun amitte uh asingsah hi; tualeh atheisiemlouna dingun, alungtang uh a suhmiel pieh hi."},"19":{"text":"Koiman alungtangun angaituo ngai sih ua, Koiman; “Kimkhat singvah dingin ka zanga, mei-amte tungah tanghou ka kanga, sa ka em a, ka ne hi, tualeh avaltenga sil kidah huoi bawl ding ka hi diei? Singtun val mai a kun a be ding ka diei? chitheina leh theisiemna nei a um sih uhi.”"},"20":{"text":"Vut in akivah a, ahinna ahumbit theilouna ding leh, ka khutzietlam ah zuou thu umlou ahiei mah? “Achi theilouna dingin alungtang sol zou a um in,” ama aleheita hi."},"21":{"text":"Jakob aw, tamte thei ngitnget in, Israel aw ka suoh na hi; Ka hing siema ka suohpa na hi; Aw Israel ka hing manghil sih ding hi.","title":"Israel kimanghillou"},"22":{"text":"Na tatkhelna zousiete uh meipi satah bangin, ka phietmangta a, tualeh na khelnate meilum bangin ka phietmang ta hi; ka hing tatdoh tah ziehin, ka kungah hing kinuale un."},"23":{"text":"Vante aw, la sa un, aziehpen Mangpa’n, abawl zouta hi! Leinuoi thuhtahte aw kikou un; Aw nou muolte leh gammangte leh, asunga sing chinteng aw, la sa in kikoukhie un, aziehpen Mangpa’n Jakob atankheta a, Israel ah amaleh ama akipah tawita hi."},"24":{"text":"Mangpa nang hing tanpa, naubu sunga kipat a hing siempa’n, tambangin agen hi: “Kei Mangpa sil zousie siempa ka hi a, keima ka hi vante amatanga kizahkhesahpa, leitung kiphasahpa zong keima ka hi."},"25":{"text":"Zuou thu gente chiemtenate bangmalou suohsah a, aisan siemte mimaw suohsah a, mipilte nuakia sah a, atheinate uh motna suoh sahpa keima ka hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 1.20"},"26":{"text":"Asuohpa thugen tangtung sah a, asawltahte lemguotna subukimpa keima ka hi, Jerusalem kunga, mite ahing teng ding uhi, chipa leh Juda gam khopite tungthu a, lamtha in na um ding ua, amun sesate kitungding kia ding hi, chipa keima ka hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuithuhtah kunga, Kanggaw in, na lui tuite kanggaw sah ding ka hi, chipa keima ka hi."},"28":{"text":"Sairas tungthu a; Ama ka belamchingpa ahi a, Aman ka kipahna lam zousie abawl dinga, Aman Jerusalem kung nangawn ah, kilamtha kia ding na hi, chipa leh Biehinnpi kunga, na suongphum lep in a um ding hi; chipa khu keima ka hi,” achi hi.","ref":"2 Khang. 36.23; Ezr. 1.2"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n asathaunusa Sairas kungah, amasanga namte kipesah ding leh, leengte kawnggah sutpieh ding leh, amasanga kotpi nite hongsah ding leh, kulpi kot khate honlou a, um sah dinga, akhut zietlam a ka tuhpa kungah, tambangin agen hi:","title":"Sairas Pasian khutzah"},"2":{"text":"“Keima na masangah ka pei dinga, akawina munte ka sutang dinga, sum-eng kotpite ka satguoi dinga, kotpi kalna sia zawlte ka hiehtawng ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Kei Mangpa na min a hing hanpa khu, Israelte Pasian ka hi chi na theina dingin, miel lah a um gou kikoikhawmte leh mun simthama gou kiphuolte ka hing peding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka suoh Jakob leh ka telsa Israel ziehin, na min in ka hing han a, nangman hing theikha ngai sih nanlachin, na min ka hing phuopieh hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima Mangpa ka hia, adang a um sih hi, Keima chilou Pasian dang a umsih hi, hing theikha ngai sih nanlachin, na kawngah ka hing gah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima loungal koima dang a um sih chi nisuonalam akipat nitumnalam donga miten atheina ding un, Keima Mangpa ka hi a, adang mawngmawng a um sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima’n khovah ka umsah a, khomiel zong ka siem hi, vangphatna ka bawl a, vangsietna zong ka siem hi. Kei Mangpa’n tam silte zousie ka bawl hi."},"8":{"text":"“Nou vante aw, tunglam akipat in zu sah un, tualeh vanlaizawlin dihtatna guo bangin zu sah henlen; leitung kihong henlen, hundamna hing pawtdoh hen, tualeh dihtatna toh hing pawtdoh khawmsah heh, kei Mangpa’n ka siem ahi."},"9":{"text":"“Ama siempa toh kihau mi tung agih hi! Ama leibel kehgawp leh leibel themneng khat bang leltah hilou amah? Tungman in akhengpa kungah, bang ahiei na bawl? Achi thei diei? Ahisihleh na nasep in khut aneiloupi, achi thei diei mah?","ref":"Isai. 29.16; Rom. 9.20"},"10":{"text":"Apa kunga bang ta ahiei na nei? Ahisihleh anu kunga, bang ahiei na hinkhiet?” Chi mite tung agih hi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa Israelte Siengthoupa leh amauh bawlpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Ka tapate tungtanga sil hing tung dingte hing dong ding na hiei mah? Ahisihleh ka khut nasepte tungtang a thupieh hing pe ding na hiei mah?"},"12":{"text":"leitung ka bawl a, atunga mihingte siempa keima ka hi; ka khut mama in vante ka zah a, asunga aasihonte thu ka pie hi."},"13":{"text":"Dihtatna in Sairas ka tungdingta a, alampite zousie ka tangsah ding hi; Ama’n ka khopi alam dinga, tualeh ka mi saltangte ahadoh ding hi; tatnaman leh kipahman deina hi sese lou in,” galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Izipt gama sepgimna ga leh Ethiopia summet bawlte van zuate leh Sebean mi, dinsangpipite, na kung uah ahing tung ding ua, tuate nou a ahi ding hi. Na nua ahing zui ding ua, khainienga hensain ahing pei ding ua, na kungah ahing kun ding ua, na kungah ngetna abawl ding ua, nangma ah Pasian a um tahtah a, adang malmal a um sih a, Pasian dang a um sih hi,” achi ding uhi.","title":"Hundamna um sun Mangpa ahi"},"15":{"text":"Aw Israelte Pasian, Hundampa, akiphuol Pasian na hi tahtah hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute azum ding ua, abawn un a zala khawm ding ua; milim khengte pouma, alungbuoi khawm chiet ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Israelte pen kumtawn hundamna in, Mangpa’n ahundam ding a; kumtawn kumtawn in na zumsih dinga, na zala sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa vante siempa’n, tambangin agen hi; Pasian leitung siem a bawlpa ngel in asukip a, bangmalou dingin asiem sih a, mihing tenna dingin abawl zaw hi. “Kei Mangpa ka hi a, adang mal mal a um sih hi.”"},"19":{"text":"Leitung mielna mun ah, aguh in thu ka gen ngai sih a, Jakob hahlesuonte kungah, amawhna in, hing sui un kachi ngaisih hi. Kei Mangpa’n dihtatna thu kagen a, thudih ka phuongdoh zel hi."},"20":{"text":"“Hing kikhawm unlen, hing pei khawm un, Nou namte lah akipata suohta te’n, hing nai khawm chiet un; amilim bawlthu singte uh viel puoh a, hundam theilou pasien kunga thungente’n, bangma theina anei sih uhi."},"21":{"text":"Phuongdoh unlen, na tungthu uh hing pawdoh un, amauten ngaituokhawm uheh, nidanglai akipat a tam thu phuongdoh koi ahiei? khanglui lai apat tua thu na gen koi ahiei? Kei Mangpa hilou ka hiei mah? Kei chilou Pasian dang malmal a um sih hi; Pasian dihtah leh Hundampa ka hi a, Kei chilou adang malmal a um sih hi."},"22":{"text":"“Kawlmong donga um zousiete aw, Kei lam hing en unlen, hundam in um un! Aziehpen Kei Pasian ka hi a, adang malmal a um sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Keima min lou in ka kichiemta hi, dihtatna in ka kam a kipat in thu apawt a, ka thu gensa a hing ki le kia nawn sih ding hi; Tua thu khu: khup chin teng ka masang ah akuun dinga, lei chinteng akichiem ding hi.","ref":"Rom. 14.11; Phil. 2.10,11"},"24":{"text":"“Amaun: Adihtah in, Mangpa ah dihtatna leh, hatna ka mu hi achi ding ua, akungah mite ahing pei ding ua, tualeh atunga lungkimlou zousie, azala ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Israel hahlesuon zousie Mangpa ah, siemtansah in a um ding ua, tualeh thupitah in a um ding uhi, achi ding uhi,” achi hi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bel akhupboh a, Nebo a kun suh hi; amilimte uh ganhingte leh gantaten apuo ua, na kangtalaite un gihtah in na viel puohsah ua, ganta thatawlte a dingin puohgih ahi giap hi.","title":"Babilon milimte leh Pasian hing"},"2":{"text":"Akuunsuh ua, akhupboh khawm chiet ua, vangihte lah adawnjang thei tuom sih ua, hinanleh amauh mama sal a puimangin a um zawta uhi."},"3":{"text":"“Jakob innkuonte aw, ka thu ngaikhie un, asuohta umsun Israel innkuonte aw, naubu sunga na um lai ua pat a Kang kep leh, na pien ua pat a ka hing vielpuoh kawite aw, na bawn un ka thu ngaikhie un."},"4":{"text":"Na hing tehsiet dongun, kei khu Ama ka hia, tualeh nasam akaan dong nangawn un zong, noute ka hing poding hi! Ke’n ka bawlta a, ka po ding hi, nou ka hing po dinga, ka hing hunkhe ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Kei koi toh hing te ding nahi uoi? koi toh kikim a hing bawl ding nahi uoi? koi toh kibang hing chi ding nahi uoi?"},"6":{"text":"Amaun a ip ua kipat sana abungkhie ua, atena in dangka ate ua, sana khengte aguoi ua, tualeh amaun pasien lim a kheng ua, tuachi’n khupboh in abie uhi."},"7":{"text":"Aliengkou uah akhang ua apuo ua, akoina ding mun ah akoi ua, tuanah a umden hi. Tua mun apat akisuon thei sih a, mi’n ahan dinga hinanleh adawng thei sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Nou sil bawlkhielte aw, tami thei ngitnget un, kipasal sah unlen, ngaituo kia un."},"9":{"text":"Khanglui lai a sil um masate, thei ngitnget un, Aziehpen Kei Pasian ka hi a, adang malmal a um sih hi; Kei Pasian ka hi a, Keima bang koima dang a umsih hi."},"10":{"text":"A chiil akipat in a tawpna ding ka phuong a, tanglai hunte akipat in sil tung nailoute ka gen zel a, ka sil guotte akipden ding hi, tualeh ka dei bangbangin ka bawl ding hi, ka chi hi."},"11":{"text":"Suolam akipat in va sasielne leh, gamla tah akipat ka guotsate semkhe dingin, mi ka han a ahi, ka genta a, ka tangtungsah dinga, ka tumta a, ka bawl ngeingei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Nou kilungtang khausahte leh, dihtatna apat a gamlate aw, ka thu ngaikhie un."},"13":{"text":"Ka dihtatna nainou khat ah ka hing koi hi, gamlapi a um ahisih hi; ka hundamna akiheh sih ding hi, Ka hundamna Zion ah ka koi dinga, Aziehpen ka thupina Israel,” ahi ding hi."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumsuh inlen, leivui lah ah touin, Aw nang Babilon tanu nungah siengthou; Mangtoupha tung hilou in tuol ah touin, nang Kaldai mite ta nu aw! Aziehpen dawng thinthen leh nou-ngingei, hing kichi nawnlou ding na hita hi.","title":"Babilon puana","ref":"Isai. 13.1—14.23; Jer. 50.1—51.64"},"2":{"text":"Bu hehna suong la inlen, tangbuong bawl in, na kikhuna lakhie inlen, na nih lemtou inlen, na malpi dawhsah inlen, luite pal galkai in."},"3":{"text":"Guohtang na hina khu, khulou in a um dinga, Ahi, na zamaw akimu ding hi; Phuba ka la dinga, koima ka hinkhawi sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Eite hing tanpa ahileh, Amin galkapte Mangpa, Israel Misiengthoupa ahi."},"5":{"text":"Kaldai mite tanu aw, sip khinkhien in tou inlen miel lah ah lut in, aziehpen nang koiman leenggamte leengnu, ahing chi nawn sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka mite tungah ka na lungthah a, ka goutan ka bua sahta a, na khut ah ka hing pekhie hi. Nang atung uah hepina malmal na sulang sih a, tehsete nangawn na hahkol gihtah na posah hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tualeh nang lah kumtawn in, leengnu hiden vang na chi a,” tam silte lah na lungtangin na ngaituo ngai sih a, atawpna ding zong na thei sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin nang mi kinoptal, khohsah neilou, na lungsim a keima ka hi, “Kei lou midang koima a umsih, meithai in tousih vangin, tate zong taan ngai sih vang, chi nu’n tam thu ngaiin.","ref":"Kihil. 18.7,8"},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh tam sil nite, tate taanna leh meithaina in, thakhat in, ni khat thu in, ahing tung ding hi. Na dawithusiemna leh, nabum siemna nasatah in tam mama nanleh, tam silte na tungah kimtah in ahing tung ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen na gitlouna na muonga: koiman ahing musih na chi a, kei ka hi, “Kei chilou koima dang a umsih” na chi laiin, na pilna leh na theinain nang ahing suseta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin, na tungah sil hoilou ahing tung ding a, hei a hing kipan ahiei chi na thei sih ding hi; vangsietna in ahing buohkhum dinga, na thoidam thei sih ding hi. Tualeh thakhat in, na tungah man thaina ahing tung dinga; Nang na thei sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na naupan lai akipata na sepgimna, na dawithusiemna leh, na aisan siemna tampi toh tuin pangin: na phattuompi khamaw sih dinga; na lawching khamaw sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Thuhilna tampi na don zouzaite’n, nang ahing lunggim sah hi. Tuin na vanlam aasi suisiemte leh, aasi en siemte leh ha china, ha tha en a thumavang gen mite’n, hing dinpi uhen len, na tunga sil tung dingte apat hing hunkhie u’leh asih diei!"},"14":{"text":"En in, amauh bupawl bang giap ahi ding ua, mei in akatum ding uhi; meikuong lah akipat in amauleh amauh, akihundam thei sih ding ua, kisuhlumna ding mei-am ahi sih dinga, tualeh awithaw ding meikuong bep hilou ding a hi."},"15":{"text":"Na neulai apat a na sepgimpi leh, na summet bawlpite tambang bep ahi ding uhi. Amaute amauh lampi chiet ah, avahvai ding ua, noute hing hundam ding koima a um sih ding hi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam thu ngaikhie un, nou Israel min a, kihan Jakob innkuonte aw; tami ngaikhie un, Nou Juda khanggui thutah hilou, dihtatna lah hi samlou, Mangpa min lou akichiema, Israel Pasian min lou zelte aw tami ngaikhie un.","title":"Pasian thupina ding leh Israel suhsiengthouna"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen khopi siengthou a mi akichi ua, tualeh Israel Pasian tungah akinga ua, galkapte Mangpa khu amin ahi."},"3":{"text":"“Achiil akipat in sil um masate ka phuongkhie a, ka kam akipat in apawtdoh a, amauh ka theisah hi, thakhat in ka bawl a, ka gensate atangtung pai hi."},"4":{"text":"Noute migenha nahi uh chi ka thei a, na ngawng thagui uh sia bang ahia, na talpang u’zong sum eng ahi."},"5":{"text":"Achiil a kipat tamte na kung uah ka genta a; ahing tun masangin ka hing theisahta hi, tuachilouin, nouten ka milim in abawl a ka milim khenthute leh, ka milim sunthuten thu apieh ahi, na chikha ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"“Na zata a tamte en in, tualeh gendohlou ding na mah? Tua kipat sil thate, sil kiphuol nathei ngailoute ka hing theisah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute tu a kisiem ahi ua, achiil asiem ahi sih uhi; tu masang in tamsilte na za-khangai nai sih uhi, khuchilou in vang, ngai in tuate ka thei na chikha ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Na za kha ngai sih ua, na thei ngai sih uhi, Ahi, hun sawtpi na bil uh akihong naisih a, lepchie tahin na bawl uh chi ka thei hi. Naubu sunga kipat a mikhiel hing kichi ahita hi."},"9":{"text":"“Ka min ziehin ka lungthahna ka khawlsan tadi dinga, phat ka law theina ding leh, noute ka hing suhmang louna dinga kideh ka hi bou hi."},"10":{"text":"Ngai un, ka hing susieng a, hinanleh dangka suhsieng bang hilou in, suhgentheina haltuina mei ah kahing enchienta hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima ziehin, Keima mama ziehin, tami ka bawl ding hi; bang zieh a ka min buasah a um ding ahiei mah? Tualeh ka thupina midang kungah ka pesih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Jakob leh ka hatdohsa Israel aw, ka thungaikhie un, Kei Ama ka hi a, Kei amasapen ka hi a, Kei anukhiapen ka hi.","ref":"Isai. 44.6; Kihil. 1.17; 22.13"},"13":{"text":"Ahi ka khut in leitung kingah na ka phum a, tualeh ka khut zietlam in vante ka zahpal a, ka hat chiengin ading khawm zel uhi."},"14":{"text":"“Na bawn un kikhawm unlen, ngai un, amau’lah a koipen in tam silte aphuongdoh ei? Mangpa’n ama a it a; aman Babilon tungah a ut dan dan abawl dinga, tualeh akhut in Kaldaimite a dou ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Kei, Keima ngelin ka genta a, Ahi, ama ka hanta a, ka hing zawpita a, tualeh anasep alawching ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka kunglam hing nai unlen, tam thu ngaikhie un; Achiil akipat in thu kadap gen ngai sih hi. Khum hun lai akipat in, Kei ka umta hi.” Tualeh tuin, Mangpa Pasian leh, Hagau in kei ahing sawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa nou hing tanpa Israel Mi Siengthoupa’n, tambangin agen hi: “Kei Mangpa na Pasian, na phattuomna dinga nangma hing hilpa leh, na peina ding lampi a hing zawpipa ka hi."},"18":{"text":"Oh! nou ten ka thupiehte ana ngaikhie himai u’lachin izaw, na hamuonna uh lui-luongbang himai ding hi a, na dihtatna uh tuihuol bang himai ding hiven."},"19":{"text":"Nahah nasuonte zong senel banga tam ahita ding a, na khal a pieng na tate zong senel bang ahita ding a, amin ka masanga kipat in phiet mangin a um sih dinga, suhmangthai a umlou ding uh hima ven maw,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Babilon akipat pawt unlen, Kaldai mite apat in taimang un, Lungnop lasah aw toh, tami phuong unlen, Kawlmong dongin phuongzah unlen, “Mangpa’n asuohpa Jakob atandohta,” chi un.","ref":"Kihil. 18.4"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh gamdai gamgaw a amaute apui lai in adangta sih ua, amaute dawn ding suongpi apat tui aluongsah a, Aman suongpi akhipawh sah a, tuite apuldoh hi."},"22":{"text":"“Mangpa’n migiloute a dingin, galmuonna a um sih hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 57.21"}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuipi panga gamte haw, ka thu ngaikhie unlen, gamlapi a um miten na bil uh hing daw un, Mangpa’n naubu sunga kipat in, kei ahing handoh a, ka nu sunga kipat in Ama’n ka min alouta hi.","title":"Mi siengthou Israel tandohpa","ref":"Jer. 1.5"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Ama’n, ka kam namsau hiemtah bangin abawlta a, akhut lim nuoi ah ahing phuol a, tualeh thaltang nawttet sitset bangin ahing bawl a, athaltang bawm ah ahing phuol hi.","ref":"Heb. 4.12; Kihil. 1.16"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ka kungah, “Israel aw nang kasuoh na hi a, nangma ah pahtawi in ka um ding hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken akungah, “Amawhna a semgim ka hita, ka hatna bangmalou leh pannabei a zangbei ka hita; hinanleh ka dihna kipahman khu Mangpa kungah a um a, ka nasep zong ka Pasian kungah a um hi,” ka chi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuin Mangpa Jakob te nua puikia ding leh, Ama kunga Israelte puikhawm dinga, naubu sung a kipat a. A suoh a hingbawlpa Mangpa’n, tambangin agen hi. Aziehpen Mangpa mitmu in thupitah kahi dinga, tualeh Mangpa khu ka hatna ahita ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi, “Ama’n Jakob namte tungding ding leh, Israel humbit a umte siempha dinga ka suoh a na um, nanga dinga sil neu noukhat ahi. Jentelte lah a vah tuntu hi dingin, ka hing bawl dinga, kawlmong donga ka hundamna na hi theina dingin,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 42.6; Luk. 2.32; Nasep. 26.23; Nasep. 13.47"},"7":{"text":"Mangpa Israel Tanpa leh Mi Siengthoupa’n, tambangin agen hi: Mite simmawpa, namte kidah leh huotpa, vaihawmte suohpa kungah, Mangpa muonhuoi leh Misiengthoupa’n, nangma ahing tel ziehin, “Leengten ahing mu ding ua, adingtou ding ua, leengtapaten zong ahing be ding uhi.”","title":"Israel tunding kia dinga thuchiem"},"8":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; “Hun kipah um ah ka hing ngaikhie a, Hundamna ni ah ka hing panpi hi, Gamsung tungding ding leh, Goutan sesate luosah kia dingin, nang ka hing keem dinga mipite thuhun dingin, ka hing peding hi.","ref":"2 Kor. 6.2"},"9":{"text":"Suongkul taangte kungah hing pawtdoh un, na chi dinga, miel lah a umte kungah, hing kilah un nachi theina ding un. Lampite ah ne in akivah ding ua, mun sang kieu zousie atatna mun uh ahi ding."},"10":{"text":"Agilkiel nawn sih ding ua, adangta nawn sih ding uhi. Kholum in asugenthei sih dinga, nisa in zong asuna sih ding hi.
