Aziehpen amauh hepipa’n a zawpi dinga, tuinah nei kungah apui ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 7.16,17"},"11":{"text":"Ka muolte zousie lamlien ka suohsah dinga, ka lamliente ka sangsah ding hi."},"12":{"text":"En in, tamte gamla tah a kipat in ahing pei ding ua; En in, tamte mallam leh tumlam a kipat in ahing pei ding ua, tualeh Sinim gam a kipat in ahing pei ding uhi.”"},"13":{"text":"Vante aw la sa unlen, leitung aw nuom in, muolle taangte aw lasa in kikoukhie un, Mangpa’n amite ahamuonta hi; Ami hasatna thuohte tungah khotuona aneita ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Zion in, “Mangpa’n ahing taisanta a, Ka Mangpa’n ahing manghilta,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"“Nu in ata nawine lai amanghil thei diei mah? a gil a pieng ata alainat lou thei diei mah? Ahi, amanghil mai thei uhi; hinanleh Ken vang kang manghil sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"En in, ka khutphang sungte gel ah ka hing gielta hi, na kulbangte ka masangah a um ngitnget hi."},"17":{"text":"Na tapate akintat ding ua, nangma hing sumangthaite leh, bangmalou a hing bawlte nanga kipat, apawtmang ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Dahkhie’n len na kim na pam en in, tamte zousie akikhawm ua, na kungah ahing pei uhi. Ahin a ka hin bangin, Nang pahtawina kisil bangin tamte zousie kizepna in, na silta ding mou akizep bangin na kizemta ding hi, chiin Mangpa’n agen hi."},"19":{"text":"“Aziehpen na munte suhsietsa leh nuasiesa leh, na gam suhsietsa a um khu atengte ziehin, a neu sengta dinga, tualeh ahing pumvalte khu gamla tah ah a umta ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Adangte na taan nua a na ta nei kia dingten, tam mun koute adingin aneu seng hi, tenna ding mun lien zaw hing pie in, chi in na bil kawmah ahing gen ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin nang na lungtangin tam mite, koi hahlesuon ahi uoi? Kei lah tate suun a nuasie leh taisan a um hi inga, saltaanga sah leh hang a vahvai hilou ka hiei mah? Koi ahiei tamte khoilien, Keima tanga nuasie a um hilou ka hiei mah? Tamte hei a um ahi uoi? na chi ding hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “Ngai vawi, Jentelte lam ah ka khut ka zahtou ding a, mite adingin ka chiemtena diellap ka tadoh dinga; Amaun na tapate uh a ang ua pomin, tualeh na tanute u’zong aliengkou ua puo in, ahing pui ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh leengpate nou hing keem na pa uh ahi dinga, leengnute zong na nau donnu un apang ding hi; amaun amai ua tuol suin a kun ding ua, na kenga leivuite alieh ding uhi. Tuachi’n kei Mangpa ka hi chi na hing thei ding uhi; aziehpen kei hing ngahte a muolphou ngai sih ding uhi.”"},"24":{"text":"Mihat khut akipat a gallahte koiin alahpieh zou diei, ahisihleh saltang dihtatte hutkhiet in a um diei mah?"},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Mihattah khuta saltangte nangawn lahpieh in a um dinga; mizauhuoite gallahte zong hutkhiet in a um ding hi; aziehpen nang hing doute ka dou ding a, na tate ka hundam ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh nou hing simmawte khu, amauh sa mama ka nesah dinga, tualeh zu humtah kham bangin amauh sisan akham ding uhi. Tua hun chiengin michin in Kei Mangpa na hundampa uleh, na Tanpa u’leh Jakob mihatpa ka hi,” chi athei ding uhi."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Na nu Israel ka naw khiet in, khulna lai ka pekha amah? Ahisihleh, Ka leibatnate koipen kungah noute ka hing na zua ei? Ngai in, na khelnate ziehun, nou leh nou na kizua ua; na tatkhielnate ziehun na nu uh khul in a um hi.","title":"Messiah thumanna"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh a ka hing peilai a koima umlou ahiei? tualeh ka hing hatlai a kei hing dawng ding, koima umlou ahiei? Noute hing tandoh theilou dinga, ka khut suhtom a um ahiei mah? Ahisihleh hing hunkhe dinga, silbawltheina neilou ka hiei mah? Ngai in, ka phawhthopna in tuipi akangsat a, luite gamdai ka suohsah hi, tui umlou ziehin ngate dangta in ashi ua, a ui uhi."},"3":{"text":"Vante meivom in ka khu a, tualeh akituomna dingin sai ip puon ka bawlpieh hi.”"},"4":{"text":"Mi lunggim leh basamte kunga ahuntah a thu gen ding, ka theina dingin Mangpa Pasian in, thuhilsiemte lei ahing pie a, Aman zingmawng chin in ahing phonghal a; thuhilsiemte banga za dingin, ka bil aphawnghal zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in ka bilte avangsah a, ka hel sih a, ka le-ngatsan sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Ang satte ka elduong ka daw a, khamul botkieute kungah ka bieng ka daw hi. Zumna leh chilphitkhumna akipat, ka maitang ka phuol ngai sih hi.","ref":"Mat. 26.67; Mak. 14.65"},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa Pasian in ang panpi dinga, tuaziehin ka zala sih ding hi; tuaziehin meisa suong bangin ka mai ka tahsah hi, tualeh ka zala sih ding chi ka thei hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei siem hing tangsahpa anai hi, koi ahiei hing dou ding? Ka dingkhawm ding ua, Koi ahiei melma? Aman hing nai heh.","ref":"Rom. 8.33,34"},"9":{"text":"Ngai un, Mangpa Pasian in ahing panpi tahtah dinga, koi ahiei siemlou hing tangsah ding? Ngai un, amaute abawn un puonsil bangin, alui ding ua, nget in anekhawng ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na lah uah koi ahiei Mangpa zaudan siem? Asuohpa thumang koi ahiei? Miel lah a vah a, meivah neilou koi ahiei? Mangpa min muong henlen, a Pasian tungah kinga hen."},"11":{"text":"Nou mei tawkuonga, meisi a ki-im kuolkhumte ngai un, na meikuong vah uah leh, na meisi halkuongte uah vah un. Tami ka khuta kipat a na tan ding uh ahia, genthei thuoh in na lum ding uhi."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Nou dihtatna zuite leh nou Mangpa suite, ka thu ngaikhie un, satkhieh a na umna uh suongpi leh, nou hing kitawdohna kokhuh lam en un.","title":"Messiah in Israelte ahantawhna"},"2":{"text":"Na pu uh Abraham en unlen, tualeh nou hing na hing nu Sarah en un; Ka hat laiin amatang ahia, tualeh ama ka guolzawl a, ka pungsah hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n Zion ahamuon dinga, amun sesate zousie ahamuon dinga, agamdaite Eden bangin abawl dinga, tualeh agamgawte Mangpa huon abangsah ding hi; lungnopna leh kipahna asungah mu in a um ding a, kipahthugenna leh ginglawm a um ding hi."},"4":{"text":"“Ka mite aw ka thu ngaikhie un, Aw, ka namte na bil uh daw un, aziehpen keima apat in dan apawt dinga, tualeh ka vaihawmna khu mite vahna dingin, khawldamna in ka bawl ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka dihtatna anaia, ka hundamna apawtdoh a, tualeh ka bantha in mite thu akhen dinga, tuipi panga gamten ahing ngah ding ua, amauten ka bantha muong ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Dahtou unlen vante en un, tualeh nuoi langa leitung en un, aziehpen vante meikhu bangin azammang dinga, tualeh leitung zong puonsil bangin alui dinga, asunga tengte zong tuamabangin ashi ding uhi. Hinanleh ka hundamna kumtawn in a umden dinga, ka dihtatna zong suhmangin a umsih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Nou dihtatna theite leh, ka danthu lungtang sunga vom mite aw, ka thu ngaikhie un, mihingte gensietna zausih unlen, ahing housiet ziehun zong zausih un."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen nget in puonsil aneh siet bangin, amauh anese sieng dinga, tualeh puonhih in Samul anehsiet bangin, amauh a nese sieng ding hi. Hinanleh ka dihtatna kumtawn in a umden dinga, tualeh ka hundamna zong akhang akhangin, a umden ding hi.”"},"9":{"text":"Mangpa banthahat aw, khanglou in, khanglou in, hatna in kivon in, tanglai nite leh nidanglai khangte bangin, khanglou in! Rahab satnen a, gulpi satliempa nang hilou na hiei mah?"},"10":{"text":"Tuipi kangsahpa leh tuithuh tahte kangsahpa, nang hilou na hiei mah? Tatsate galkai masangsie tuipi thuhtah a, lampi bawlpa nang hilou na hiei mah?"},"11":{"text":"Tuabangin Mangpa tatsate ahing kinuale kia dinga, lasa kawm in Zion ah ahing pei ding ua, kumtawn lungnopna alu tung uah akhu ding ua, lungnopna leh kipahna atang ding ua, lungkhamna leh dana ataimangta ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Kei keima mama noute hing hamuonpa ka hi, ashi thei ding mihing giing ding leh, hampa banga bawl mihing tapa giing ding, nang koi na hiei?"},"13":{"text":"Nang vante zahpal a, leitung kingahna suongphum phumpa, nang hing siempa na manghil a, ahing sumang dinga kimansa nuoisiemi, lungthahna zieh a nisim a zau na hi. Tua nuoisiemi lungthahna hei a um ahiei?"},"14":{"text":"Sal puimanga umte kintah a hadoh pai ahi ding ua, kokhuh sungah neh ding atasam sih ding ua, si zong ashi sih ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh kei Mangpa na Pasian uh, tuihuol ging zuo zuote kikhentansahpa ka hia, Amin galkapte Mangpa ahi."},"16":{"text":"Na kamsungah ka thute ka koita a, ka khut limnuoi ah ka hing phuol a, Vante ka zahpal theina ding leh, leitung kingahna suongphumte ka phum theina ding in; Zion kunga noute ka mite na hi uh,” chipa ka hi."},"17":{"text":"Aw Jerusalem Mangpa khut a, alungthahna nou a dawnnu, khanglou in khanglou in, nangman hawi dongdongna noua na dawn a, ahi nangawn na dawnbei siengta hi.","ref":"Kihil. 14.10; 16.19"},"18":{"text":"Jerusalem tapate zousie lah ah ama pui ding, koima a um sih a; akhanletsah atapate zousie lah ah ama khut a tu, koima a um sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Tam silnite na tungah ahing tungta, koi ahiei nang hing dapi ding? Sietna leh manthaina, kiel leh namsau ahing tungta, koi ahiei hing henem ding?"},"20":{"text":"Na tapate abata ua, sapeng len a awh bangin, kholai lamkathuom chin ah alum phengphung uhi; Mangpa lungthahna leh na Pasian uh phawhna toh, kidim ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin nou hasatna thuohte, zukham hilou a, thangpaina khamte hepitah in tamthu ngai un."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh amite dinga, genpiehpa’n tambanga khama na hoi dong dongna uh nou, “Ka lungthahna nou ka lakheta hi, tua khu na dawn nawn sih ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh tam pen nangma hing sugentheite, khut ah ka koita ding hi; na kung uah, na tung ua ka hing pei theina ding un lum un, ahing chi uh hi. Tuachi’n nouten na tung ua hing totkhumte adingin, na sapum uh tuol bangin na pha ua, tualeh gawlzing bangin na pumpi uh na dawta uhi.”"}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Zion khanglou in, khanglou in, na hatna in kivon in, Khopi siengthou Jerusalem aw, na puonsil kilawmte silin! Teptanloute leh siengthou loute na sungah, a lut nawn sih ding uhi.","title":"Pasian in Jerusalem atatdohna","ref":"Kihil. 21.2,27"},"2":{"text":"Aw Jerusalem leivuite lah a kipat kithing sieng inlen, thou inlen, touin; Zion tanu saltang aw, na ngawnga na kolbutte sutkhie in."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Nou leh nou bangmalou in na kizua ua, tualeh sum panglou a tatdoh na hi ding uhi, achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Achiil in ka mite Izipt gama um dingin apeisuh ua; tuachi’n azieh umlou in Assiriaten ana sugenthei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin ken tanah bang ka neita diei, Mangpa’n achi hi. Ka mite lah bangmalou a lahmang ahita ua, amaute tunga vaihawmten amauh kap leh mau in, abawlsie uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi, tualeh sunnitumin, ni chin in ka min agensie uhi.","ref":"Rom. 2.24"},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka miten ka min athei ding ua, tuaziehin tua ni chiengin agenpa keima ka hi,” chi athei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Muol leh taangte tunga khantanhoi tun-a, lemna thu tangkoupi a, tanchin kipahhuoi, silhoi tun a, hundamna thupha tangkoupi a Zion kunga, na “Pasian in vai ahawm hi” chi mite, keng kilawm hina va-ia e.","ref":"Nah. 1.15; Rom. 10.15; Eph. 6.15"},"8":{"text":"Na galvengmite aw ngaitah in akikou ding ua, aw ngaitahin la asa khawm ding uhi. Aziehpen Mangpa Zion a ahing kinuale kia chiengin, amauten amit ngei un amu ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Nou Jerusalem mun sesate aw, lungnopna toh la sa khawm un, aziehpen Mangpa’n amite ahamuon a, Jerusalem atandohta hi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa’n nam zousie mitmu in aban siengthou a lemta a, tualeh kawlmong donga mi zousie in, i Pasian hundamna amu ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Pawtkhie un! Pawtkhie un! tua mun apat pawtkhie unlen, sil sienglou khoi sih un; nou Mangpa bel pawte aw, amanu lah apat hing pawtkhie unlen, Siengthou un.","ref":"2 Kor. 6.17"},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen kinawtah in na pawtkhe sih ding ua, na taikhieh thawlou ding uh ahi. Aziehpen Mangpa na masang ua pei ding ahia, tualeh Israelte Pasian na nua uh dalpa ahi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Envawi ka suohpa’n piltah in abawl dinga, pahtawi leh sangtah a tawisangin a um ding hi.","title":"Khelna puo suohpa"},"14":{"text":"Mi tampiten nang lamdang ahing sah bangun, amel khu mihing mel sanga suhsiet zoh in a um a, amel piendan lah mihing tate mel puohdan sanga, suhmelsiet in a um zaw nalai hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman nam tampite athekhum dinga, Ama ziehin leengten akam uh ahum ding uhi; aziehpen ama’ukunga kihil khalou silte amu ding ua, azah khalou uh silte atheisiemta ding uhi.","ref":"Rom. 15.21"}}},"53":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka thu puoh uh koi ahiei gingta? Tualeh Mangpa khut zong koi kunga kihil ahiei?","ref":"Rom. 10.16; Jn. 12.38"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen ama khu amasang ah, singnou dawng banga hing khangdoh bang leh, leigaw a ahui apat hingkhangkhie bang ahia, lim leh mel kilawmna mawngmawng anei sih a, ama imu chiengin i lunggulna dingin hoina leh, kilawmna mawngmawng aum sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama mite simmaw leh nuol in a um a, danate nei mi leh lungkhamna theimi ahi; ama lah ah imai phuol bangmai ihi ua, Ama simmaw in a um a, eiten lah ingaisah tuom sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Adihtah in Aman inatnate apuo a, i danate apo tahpi hi hinanleh eiten lah, Pasian vuoh leh bawl genthei in ingai uhi.","ref":"Mat. 8.17"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh itatkhelnate ziehin Ama liemsahin a um a, igitlounate ziehin vuohsidup in a um hi; ilungmuonna dingun gawtna atungah atung a, akivuohna huoltaite ah suhdam in i umta hi.","ref":"1 Pet. 2.24"},"6":{"text":"I bawn un belam bangin ina vahmangta ua, michin eima lampi chiet ah ina pielta uhi; tualeh Mangpa’n ibawn ua, igitlounate uh ama tung ah angata hi.","ref":"1 Pet. 2.25"},"7":{"text":"Ama simmaw leh suhgenthei in a um a, hinapiin ama’n akam akeeh sih hi, sa thana mun a, gawding belamnou banga peipi in a um a; belam amulmette masanga adai dide bangin, akam akeeh sih hi.","ref":"Kihil. 5.6\n        ;     \n        Nasep. 8.32,33"},"8":{"text":"Ama suongkul apat leh vaihawmna apat a, lahdoh in a um a, Koiin ahiei ama tungthu sut a genta ding? Aziehpen Ama mihing gam akipat, satkhieh in a um a, Ka mite tatkhelna ziehin suhgenthei in a um hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh amaun ahan migiloute toh, abawlpieh ua, tualeh ashi nuain mihausa kungah a um zawta hi, gumtatna abawl ngai sih a a kam a, zehotna mawngmawng a um ngailou ziehin.","ref":"1 Pet. 2.22"},"10":{"text":"Ahivang in Mangpa’n ama vuohsidup a a um khu, hoi anasah mawng ahia, dana athuohsahta ngut ngei a, Ahinna khelna ding a sillat a na bawl chiengin, aman ahah asuonte amu dinga, adamsung nite asau sah ding hi. Tualeh ama khut ah Pasian deilam alawching ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Aman ahinna nauvei thuohgimna amu dinga, alungkimta ding hi. Ka suoh dihtatin atheinain, mi tampi siem atangsah ding hi; Aziehpen aman athulimlounate uh apuoh pieh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin, miliente tanvou ama ka hawm ding a, tualeh mihatte toh gallah sum ahawm ding hi; Ahinna shikhop hiela a sunbuoh zieh in; tualeh takhielte toh simkhawm in aumta a, tualeh mi tampite khelna a puo a, Tualeh mikhielte a dingin thu anget pieh hi.","ref":"Mak. 15.28; Luk. 22.37"}}},"54":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Aw ta nei ngailou a chiing nu, nuomsatah in la sa in! Nang nauvei ngailou nu la sa in kikou khie inlen, ngaitah in kikou in! Aziehpen pasal nei nu tate sangin, lungzuongnu tate atamzaw uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","title":"Israel siemphatna ding thuchiem","ref":"Gal. 4.27"},"2":{"text":"Na puonbuh mun kehlien inlen, na tenna puonbuh tungte zahlien inlen, khet sinlen, na khaute susau inlen, na khetphimte detsah in."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen zietlang leh vei lang ah na kehlien dinga, nahah nasuonten namte gou aluo ding ua, tualeh khopi Kisesa te ah tenna abawl ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"“Zau vawt sin, aziehpen na zum sih dinga, na zalasih ding a, selphou in zong na um sih ding hi. Na khangdawng zumna na manghilta dinga, tualeh na meithai minsietna, na thei ngitnget nawn sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang hing siempa khu na pasal ahita dinga, galkapte Mangpa khu amin ahi; tualeh nang hing Tanpa khu Israel Mi Siengthoupa ahi a, Ama pen leitung pumpi Pasian akichi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen nang zi khulsa lungsim a chimaw nu, tualeh khanglai zi khensa hatkia bangin, Mangpa’n ahing han hi, na Pasian in achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Hun tomnoukhat sung kang taisan a, hinanleh lainatna thupitah in ka hing pui kia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka thangpaina sousan laitah in, hun tomnoukhat ka mai ka phuol a, Hinanleh kumtawn khotuona toh na tungah, lainatna ka nei ding hi; Nang hing Tanpa Mangpa’n achi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Aziehpen tami kei a dingin Noah damlai tuite bang ahi a, Noah damlai tuite in leitung atum nawn sih ding, chi’n ka kichiemta a, tuamabangin na tungah ka lungthah nawn sih dinga, ka hing phawh nawn sih ding hi, chi-in ka kichiemta hi.","ref":"Siem. 9.8-17"},"10":{"text":"Taangte peimangin, muolte kisuonta nanleh, ka hepina nang akipat apeimang sih dinga, ka hamuonna thuhun zong, nang akipat akisuon mang sih ding hi, Mangpa na tunga khotuona neipa’n achi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Aw nang suhgenthei, huipi mut leng leh hamuon lou, En in, suongmantam chi tuom tuom a na suongte lem ding ka hi, na suongphumte Saphire suongmantam in ka lem ding hi.","title":"Tundinga um Israel bitna leh guolzawlna","ref":"Kihil. 21.18-21"},"12":{"text":"Na inntung sipvum Rubi suongin ka bawl dinga, na kotpite kristal suongin ka bawl ding a, na kulbangte suongmantam ngen a bawl ding ka hi."},"13":{"text":"Na tate zousie Mangpa’n thu ahil dinga, tualeh na tate hamuonna athupi mama ding hi.","ref":"Jn. 6.45"},"14":{"text":"Dihtatna a phudet nahi dinga, bawlgentheina in ahing gamlat dinga, na zau nawnsih ding hi, tualeh sil zauhuoite apat na gamlata dinga, na kung nai a aum nawn tahlou ding ziehin."},"15":{"text":"Ngai in, adihtah in akikhawm ding ua, kei zieh hilou in. Nang hing dou dinga kikhawm pouma, nangma ziehin apua ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"En in, Pum zap a, meihol amsah a, anasepna ding vanzah hiem-hei bawl, siakhengpa bawlpa Keima ka hi a, Tualeh suse ding in, suse mi zong ka siem hi."},"17":{"text":"Nangma douna ding galvan bawl pouma, alawching sih dinga, tualeh vaihawmna a nang hing kal, lei chinteng siemlou na tangsah ding hi. Tami Mangpa suohte goutan ahi. Adihtatna uh keima akipat ahi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."}}},"55":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Hingpei un! nou dangta poumate aw, tam mun a tui a um hi, nou sum neiloute zong hing pei unlen, lei unlen, ne un! Ahi, hing pei unlen, uoin leh bawngnawi sum pelou in, aman bei in lei un.","title":"Aman bei kumtawn hinna","ref":"Kihil. 21.6; 22.17"},"2":{"text":"Bangdinga ann hiloupi sum seng na hi uoi? gilvana lou dinga bangdinga tha seng na hi uoi? Pilvangtahin ka thu ngai unlen, ahoi hoi ne un. Na hinna uh ann neh hoi in kipah sah un."},"3":{"text":"Na bil uh hing daw unlen, ka kungah hing pei un, na hin theina ding un, ngai un. Noute toh kumtawn thuhun David kunga, hepina ka chiem hingpe vang.","ref":"Nasep. 13.34"},"4":{"text":"Ngai un, ama mipite a dinga theipitu dingin ka bawl a, mipite lamkaipa leh houtu in ka guot hi."},"5":{"text":"Ngai un, na thei ngailou uh namte na han ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian leh Israelte Mi Siengthoupa ziehin, nou hing thei ngailou namte na kungah ahing pei ding uhi, aziehpen Aman noute ahing pahtawita hi."},"6":{"text":"“Mu bai dinga a um lai in Mangpa sui unlen, anai lai in ama han un."},"7":{"text":"Migilouin a umdan tawpsan henlen, midihtatlou in angaituonate tawpsan henlen, Mangpa kungah hing kinuale kia heh. Aman ana khotuo dinga, i Pasian kungah kile kia heh, Aman ana ngaidam mama ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen ka ngaituonate lah, ka ngaituonate uh ahisih a, na umdante uzong ka umdan ahi sih hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen vante leitung sanga asan zoh mabangin, ka umdante na umdante uh sangin asangzaw a, tualeh na ngaituonate uh sangin, ka ngaituonate asangzaw hi."},"10":{"text":"“Van akipat guo leh vua ahing zu suh a, akiatou nawn sih a, bu chi thepa kungah haichi apie a, ane mi kunga ann apieh theina dingin tui abuoh a, apousah a, adawnsuong sah hi.","ref":"2 Kor. 9.10"},"11":{"text":"Tuamabangin ka kam akipat in thu apawt dinga, bangma louin ka kung ah ang kile kia sih dinga, Ka deilam atangtung sah dinga, tualeh ka sawlna zieh khu alawching sah ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Lungnopna toh na kuonkhe ding ua, Lungmuong tah a puiin na um ding ua, muol leh taangte na masang uah la sain akikou ding ua, gamlah singkungten khut abeng ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ling taangin tasing apou dinga, tualeh khauling nei taangin mui sing apou ding hi, tua khu Mangpa a dinga min phatna ding leh, kumtawn a chiemtena ahi dinga, suhsiet in a um nawn sih ding hi.”"}}},"56":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Dihtahin vaihawm unlen, dihtattah in sil bawl un. Ka hundamna hing tung ding ahita, tualeh ka dihtatna zong suhlat a um pai ding ahita hi.","title":"Pasian thumanna zieh a kipahman"},"2":{"text":"Tami bawl mi leh tami tudet chinten mi leh, Khawlni subua lou a, tang hoi mi, sil gilou bawllou dinga khut veng hoi mi,” ahampha hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa toh kizop gamdang mi in: “Mangpa’n amite lah akipat ahing tuom-khen vawt ahita,” chi sih henlen, tualeh michilgein zong, “Kei pen singkung gaw ka hibou hi” chi sih heh."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Michilge ka khawlni tanga, ka deilam telte leh ka thuhun tudet chintente kungah;"},"5":{"text":"Ka inn sung leh ka kulbang sung ah, amaute a dinga, tapate leh tanute sanga manphazaw, kumtawn a mang nawnlou ding, mun leh min ka pe ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Gamdang mi Mangpa nasem ding leh, Mangpa min it te, Ama be dinga, Ama toh kizop a, Khawlni subua lou a tangte leh, ka thuhun tudet poumate zong;"},"7":{"text":"Amaute nangawn ka taang siengthou ah ka pui dinga, tualeh ka thumna inn ah lungnop tahin ka um sah dinga, ahalmang sillatte uleh akithoinate uh, ka maitam tung ah pom in a um ding hi. Aziehpen ka inn namte zousie adingin, thumna inn akichi ding hi, achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 21.13; Mak. 11.17; Luk. 19.46"},"8":{"text":"Nawmanga um Israelte puikhawmpa Mangpa Pasian in, akung apuikhawmsate ban ah, adangte zong akungah ka puikhawm nalai ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Nou gamsate zousie hing pei un, gammang sate zousie, anetum sieng dingin hing pei un.","title":"Israel lamkai muonhuoiloute"},"10":{"text":"Israel galvengte mitto ahi ua, bangma theilou ngen ahi uh, amaute ui ham theilou ngen ahi ua, akawh thei sih uhi, alusu ua, alum suh ua, imut du mi ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi, amauh ui huoiham, hunta chi nei ngailou ahi ua, tualeh theisiemna neilou belampute ahi uhi. A bawn un amauh lampi chiet aki-et ua, michin in ama metna ding asui uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Hing pei un,” zu ka va la dinga, zu chia idawnkhawm ding hi, “Zing chiengin zong tuni mabang ahi dinga, tu a sangin ahoizaw tham nalai ding hi,” achi uhi."}}},"57":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Midihtatte amangzel ua, Koiman lungtangin angaituo ngai sih hi. Zangai thei mite zong lahmangin a um ua, sil hoilou hing tung ding akipat midihtatte lahmang in, a um uh chi koiman angaituo ngai sih hi.","title":"Israel milim biehna"},"2":{"text":"Lungmuonna ah alut ding ua, alupna uah akhawl tawldam ding ua, michin ama dihna a umpoumate."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh nou aisansiem nu tapate, angkawm leh kizuate, hahlesuonte aw, tanah hing pei un."},"4":{"text":"Nuizat bawlna a nanei uh koi ahiei? koi tungah ahiei na kam uh golpi a na kaah ua, nalei uh nahah khum uh? mi khielte tate leh zuou theite tate hilou nahi uoi mah?"},"5":{"text":"Noute sing hing bawh chinteng nuoi a, milimte toh kinou a, phai zang leh suongpi kawmte lah a, tate that zelte hilou na hi uoi mah?"},"6":{"text":"Lui guom sung suong mam lah ah, na tanvou uh a uma, tuate mama na tanvou uh ahi, amaute kungah dawn sillatte na sungbuo ua, ann sillatte na lan uhi. Tamte kitheimaw bawla, kilungkim sah ding ka hiei mah?"},"7":{"text":"Muolsang tungah na lupna uh napha ua, tua mun mama ah kithoina lan dingin na kuontou uhi."},"8":{"text":"Kotkha nualam leh kotbiengte ah, theizingna na tung ua, Kei ding hilouin midangte a dingin na lupna uh, na hawhkhie ua, na kaltou ua, na lupna uh na sulien ua, amautoh thuhun na bawl ua, akhut ua ang kawina uh, lupna tung na lunggul denta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Sathau namtui kinuthaw toh Molek kungah na haw ua, na gimnamtuina uh na belap ua, na palaite uh gamlapi ah na sawl ua, sheol nangawn ah na sawlsuh uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na peina uh lampi sau ziehin na gim ua, hinanleh “Kinepna a um sih na chi ngai sih ua,” na hatna uh siemthana na mu ua, Tuaziehin na basam ngai sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Koi giing leh zau a, Kei hing theikhata lou a, zuou na gen ua, na lungtang ua zong na ngaituo ngailou uh? Hun sawtpi ka khongai zieh hilou ahiei mah, agiin a nang giinlou uh?"},"12":{"text":"Na dihtatnate uleh na nasepte uh ka genlang ding, bangma na phattuompi lou ding ziehun."},"13":{"text":"Na kikou chiengun, na milim koikhawmte un hing hundoh uheh. Hinanleh amauh hui in atawmang sieng dinga, nahna hu in amauh amut mang ding hi. Hinanleh kei hing muongten gam anei ding ua, ka muol siengthou aluo ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"“Tualeh sungvum un, sung vum un, alampi bawl unlen, ka mite lampi akipat akipalpua theinate uh hemkhie un,” achi ding hi.","title":"Nuatolte demna"},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen Mitungnung tawisang a umpa kumtawn Mi, “Amin Siengthoupa’n tambangin agen hi; Kei mun sang leh siengthou ah ka tenga, mi kingaingiemte hagau suhhal ding leh, mi kisia tentunte lungtang suhal dingin, lungtang a kisia tentunte leh, kingaingiemte kungah zong ka um hi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen kumtawn in kadou sih dinga, ka lungthah ngitnget sam sih ding hi. Tua chilouin, ka masang ah mihing lungsim aba gawp dinga, ka bawlsa ahinna uh zong agim gawp kha ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A huoihamna khelna ziehun kana lungthah a, ka vuo a, ka kiphuol a, ka thangpai hi. Hinanleh a lungtang dei dan dan un anuatol kia ta uhi."},"18":{"text":"A umdante uh ka muta a, ka damsah dinga, amauh ka pui nalai dinga, amauleh, asuunpite hamuonna toh ka siemtha ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Keima’n akam ga uh ka siem a; lungmuonna, lungmuonna, gamlapi leh, anai a umte kungah um hen, Mangpa’n achi hi; tualeh amauh ka damsah ding hi.","ref":"Eph. 2.17"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh migiloute pen, tuipi kihot um khinkhien theilou bang a, atuite’n buonnawi leh, sil nieh ahing nawkhiet zel bang ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Migiloute a dingin lungmuonna a um sih hi,” ka Pasian in achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 48.22"}}},"58":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ngaitah in kikou inlen kidiem sin, Pengkul banga ngaiin na aw suo vengvong inlen, ka mite a tatkhelnate theisah inlen, Jakob inn kuonte kungah akhelna uh hil in.","title":"Pasian deilam ann ngawlna"},"2":{"text":"Nichin in kei ahing sui ua, tualeh ka lampite thei akilawp ua, dihtatna bawl leh, a Pasian uh danpiehte taisan ngailou namte bang in, vaihawmna dih kei ahing dong ua, Pasian nai akilawp uhi."},"3":{"text":"Bangziah a ka ann ngawl uh, nang mulou ahiei? ka hinna uh sugenthei unga nang theilou ahiei? achi uhi. Ngai un, na ann ngawl ni chiengun, nouma nopsahna ding na kibawl ua, na nasemte uh na nuoisie uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ngai un, kihauna ding leh kinielna ding, tualeh gitlouna khuttum a kituptuona bep a, ann na ngawl uh ahibou hi; Na aw uh tunglam a akizahna dingin, tuni a na ann ngawl bang ua, na ngawllou ding uh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tambanga ann ngawl ka deilam leh, mihing khat a dinga nikhat ahinna suhgenthei, ka deilam ahiei mah? luonglau kung banga alu uh kunsuh a, saiip puon pha a, vut lah a lup khu, ann ngawlna ahiei mah? Tua khu ann ngawlna leh Mangpa dinga, ni kipahhuoi na chi ding uoi?"},"6":{"text":"“Ka deilam ann ngawlna ahileh, gitlouna kolbute sutkhiet a, puohgih gihtahte lahkhiet a, suhgenthei deldoh a umte zalen sah a, hahkol chinteng suhtan pieh ahi zaw sih amah?"},"7":{"text":"Na tanghou gilkielte kunga hawm leh, mi zawng deldoh a umte na in sunga, hing puilut ahi sih amah? Saguoh a umte na mu chienga puon silsah a, nangma tahsa bang puo apat a, kibuh lou ahisih amah?","ref":"Mat. 25.34"},"8":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin na vah zingmawng ni suoh bangin, ahing taangkhe dinga, na damna ahing kilang pai dinga, na dihtatna na masangah apei dinga, Mangpa thupina khu na kipahman, ahing ahita ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin na han dinga, Mangpa’n ang dawng ding hi. Na kikou dinga, Aman tanah um inge, ahing chi ding hi. “Na lah ua kipat hahkolte, khutme a kikohnate, leh gitlouhamte na koimang uleh;"},"10":{"text":"Gilkiel dangtate a dinga na hinna na zah a, suhgenthei a umte hinna na taisah leh, na vah miel lah ah avah dinga, tualeh na mielna khu suntanglai abang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa’n ahing pui ngitnget ding a, gamgaw chiengin zong na hinna a taisah dinga, na gute zong ahatsah ding hi; tualeh tui in atapnom huon bang na hi dinga, tuinah kang ngailou tuikhuh bang na hi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh nangma akipat a hing pieng ding miten, mun lui sesate alamtha kia ding ua, Khang tampite suongphumte, nangman na tungding kia dinga, tualeh nangpen Asesate bawltha kia pa leh, tenna dinga gawlzingte siemtha pa ahing kichi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Khawlni tanglou ding leh ka ni siengthou, nangma deidan dan a bawllou dinga, na kengte na lehei a; Khawlni kipahhuoi ahi na chi a, Mangpa ni siengthou zatathuoi na chi a, Ama na zatat a, nangma ut dan dan a umlou a, nangma deidan a zong umlou a nangma deidan thu, na mawhgen sih pou leh;"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa tungah na kipah dinga, tualeh Ken leitung muol sangte ah ka hing tuongsah dinga, na pu Jakob gouluo, neilelamte in ka hing va ding hi; aziehpen Mangpa kam in tami ana genta hi.”"}}},"59":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngaiun, Mangpa khut hundam theilou dinga, suh tom ahi sih a azah theilouna dinga, abil binsah ahi sih hi.","title":"Israelte khelnate"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh na thulimlounate un, na Pasian ua kipat in noute ahing khenkheta hi; tualeh na khelnate un, nouma akipat in, amai aliemangta a, tuaziehin ahing za thei sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen na khutte uh sisan a buasah in a um a, na khutmete uh khelna in abua hi, na kam un zuouthu agen a, na leite uh gitlouna thu gen in aphun nem nom hi."},"4":{"text":"Koiman vaihawmna dih ahan ngai sih a, koiman thutah agen pieh ngai sih hi; ama un thumanlou agingta ua, zuouthu agen uhi. Silgilou apai ua, thulimlouna ahingkhie uhi."},"5":{"text":"Thangtom tui opkhum in akeusah ua, Momlen puon in agan uhi; atui nekha pouma ashi ua, tualeh suhkeh a umte apat in gulsie ahing keudoh hi."},"6":{"text":"A momlente ulah puonsil in apang sih dinga, anasepte uh asil vawt sih ding ua, anasepte ulah gitlouna nasep ahi a, gumtatna nasep akhut uah a um hi."},"7":{"text":"A kengte uh silgilou del in atai a, mawnaneiloute sisan suo dingin anawtat uhi, angaituonate uh thulimlouna ngaituona ahi a, sietna leh manthaina alampite uah a um hi.","ref":"Rom. 3.15-17"},"8":{"text":"Lungmuonna lampi athei sih ua, alampi uah dihna a um sih hi; ama ua dingin lamkawi akibawl ua, tuami lampi a pei poumain, lungmuonna athei sih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin thudihna eite akipat in agamlata hi, dihtatna in zong ahing nuaphah sih hi; khovah ingah ua, hinanleh mielna ahizel hi; khovahna isui ua, hinanleh khomiel lah ah ivah zel uhi.","title":"Mipiten akhelna uh aphuong uh"},"10":{"text":"Mittote bangin baang imai kawi ua, tualeh mitneilou bangin ikimai kawi kawi ua, suntang lai nangawn in khomielzui a pei bangin, i kisuikha zel uhi; mihatte lah a mishi bang ihi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Vompite bangin ibawn un iham leulou ua, vakhu bangin ithum ngut ngut uhi; thudih a vaihawmna ingah ua hinanleh a um sih, Hundamna ingah ua, hinanleh eima akipat in, gamla tah ah a um zel hi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen ka suhkhelnate uh na masangah a um a, ka khelnate un kouma ahing heh hi; ka suhkhelnate uh ka kung ua a um zing ziehin, ka tatkhelnate uh ka thei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa tung a takhiel leh zuou in, i Pasian akipat in ipeimang ua, nuoisiena leh helna thute gen in, lungtanga zuouthute pai in, igenkhie uhi."},"14":{"text":"Thudih a vaihawmnain ahing kinua hei santa a, dihtatna gamlapi ah a ding hi; thutah gawlzinga apuatah ziehin, dihna alut thei nawn sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n thutah a umnawn sih a, sil hoilou tawpsante lah, gallah in akibawl zel a, Tuachi’n Mangpa’n amuta a, thudih a vaihawmna a um sih a, Mangpa alungkim sahta sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama’n mi koima umlou athei a, thunget pieh ding mawngmawng a umlou, lam dang asa hi; Tuaziehin Ama ban mama in, Hundamna akibawl a, Ama dihtatna mama in atukip hi.","title":"Mangpa Zion tandoh dingin akiguong","ref":"Isai. 63.5"},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen dihtatna khu awmphaw bangin asil a, Hundamna lukhu alu ah akhuh a, Phubalahna puonsilte puonsil in anei a, phatuomngaina puonahtuol bangin asil hi.","ref":"Eph. 6.14,17; 1 Thes. 5.8"},"18":{"text":"A silbawlte uh dungzui in, Aman asilbawlte uh dungzui mama in athuh ding hi, Ama doumite lungthahna in, amelmate thuhna in athuh ding a, tuipipanga gamte thuhna in phuba ala ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa min khu tumlam akipat in, agiing ding ua, tualeh athupina zong nisuohna lam akipat in, agiing ding uhi; Tuisanglet banga galte ahing kuon chiengin, Mangpa hagau in, amauh dou in puonlap a domsang ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Zion ah Tanpa ahing pei ding a, Jakobte lah a khelna kiheimangsante kungah, ahing tung ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Rom. 11.26"},"21":{"text":"“Kei ka hileh, amaute toh ka thuhun tami ahi, Mangpa’n achi hi: Ka hagau na tung ua um leh, ka thu na kam ua ka koiten, tua kipat kumtawn dongin na kam uleh, nahah nasuonte kam leh nahah nasuonte, hahlesuonte kam a pawtsan nawn sih ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."}}},"60":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thou inlen taangkhie in, aziehpen na vah ahing tungta a! Mangpa thupina na tungah ahing suohta hi.","title":"Jerusalem thupi ding dan"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen ngai in, mielna in leitung akhu khum dinga, miel satah in mite akhu ding hi; hinanleh Mangpa na tungah asuoh dinga, tualeh athupina khu na tungah akimu ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Jentelte na vah ah ahing pei ding ua, tualeh leengte khu na hing suohdohna vahna ah, ahing pei ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Dahkhie inlen, na kim na pam en vel in abawn un akikhawm ua, na kungah, ahing pei uhi; na tate uh gamlapi akipat in ahing pei ding ua, na tanute uzong amauh kemten, a ang uah ahing pom ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin na mu dinga, na vahta dinga, na lungtang kipah in akithing dinga, suhlet in a um ding hi. Tuipi hausatnate nang lam ah ahing kihei dinga, Jentelte hausatna in nang ahing zuon ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Sangawngsau tampiten na gam atuom dim dinga, Midian leh Ephah gam leh, Sheba gam akipat in, sangawngsau tung tuong mite ang pei ding, amauten sana leh gimnamtui ahing puoh ding ua, Mangpa phatna aphuongzah ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Kedar ganhon zousie na kungah ahing kikhawm ding ua, Nebaioth belamtalten na nna asem ding ua, ka maitam tungah kipahtahin akaltou ding ua, ka thupina inn khu ka pahtawi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam meilum banga lengkawi kawite leh, vahui a bu zuon a leengte banga, lengkawi kawite koite ahi uoi?"},"9":{"text":"Adihtahin, tuipipanga gamten keima ahing ngah ding ua, Tarshish tembawte ahing masa ding ua, Mangpa na Pasian min Israelte Misiengthoupa, pahtawi dingin gamlapi akipat in na tapate uh, a sana uleh a dangkate utoh ahing puo uhi."},"10":{"text":"Gamdang miten na kulbaang alamtha ding ua, tualeh aleengpate un na nna asem ding uhi; ka thangpaina ziehin, ka hing sat a, hinanleh kang deisah a, na tunga khotuona ka nei ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin na kotpite akihong ngitnget dinga, sun leh zan in kha ahi sih ding hi, tuachi’n miten Jentelte hausatna ahing polut ua, aleengte uzong kizui a ahing puilut theina ding un.","ref":"Kihil. 21.25,26"},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen nangma nna sem utlou nam leh, leenggamte abeimang ding ua; Ahi, tua namte suhsiet dimdem in a um ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Lebanon thupina na kungah ahing pei dinga, tasingte phan singte leh vongnam singten, ka mun siengthou kilawmtah in azem ding ua, ka keng ngapna mun thupitah in ka bawl ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Nou hing sugentheite tapate zong na kung uah, kun in ahing pei ding uhi; tualeh nou hing simmawte zousie, na kengtaw nuoi ah abohkhup ding uhi; tualeh nangpen Mangpa khopi Israelte Mi Siengthoupa, Zion ahing chi ding uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 3.9"},"15":{"text":"Koima totkhah ngailou, muda leh taisan hinanlachin, kumtawn a suon umpen khang tampite kipahna dingin, ka hing bawl ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Nam zousie nawitui na tep dinga, tualeh leengte nawitui zong na tep ding hi. Tuachi’n kei Mangpa na Hundampa uleh, nou hing Tanpa leh Jakob mi hatpa ka hi, chi nang thei ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Sum-eng taangin sana, kang puoh dinga, sia tangin dangka, sing tangin sum-eng, ka hing puoh ding hi; na vaihawmte uh dihtatna ka guon ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Na gamsung uah gumtatna mawngmawng, akiza nawn sih dinga, sietna leh manthaina na gamgi sungah, zah ahinawn sih ding hi. Na kulbaangte uh Hundamna na chi ding ua, na kotpite uh phatna, ahi zawta ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ni khu, sun chienga nangma hing salvah ahinawn sih ding a, hapi zong nangma hing salvah ahi tuom sih ding hi. Mangpa na kumtawn vah ahita dinga, na Pasian khu na thupina ahi zawta ding hi.","title":"Pasian amite thupina","ref":"Kihil. 21.23; 22.5"},"20":{"text":"Ni atum ngai nawn sih dinga, hapi zong amang ngai nawn sih ding hi; Mangpa khu na kumtawn vah ahita ding a, na da leh kana nite abeita ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Na mite zousie zong mi dihtat ahita ding ua, kumtawn in gam aluodenta ding ua, pahtawi a ka um theina dingin, keima phudoh, ka khutsuoh ahita ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Na lah ua tawmpen zong tulkhat a hing pha dinga, aneupen zong nam hattah ahing hi ding hi. Kei Mangpa ka hi a, a huntah a bawl pai ding ka hi, achi hi."}}},"61":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa hagau khu ka kungah aum a, Aman gentheite kunga khantan hoi gen dingin, Mangpa’n sathau ahing nuta hi. Aman lungtang hasete damsah ding leh, saltangte kunga suotatna thu gen ding, tualeh suongkul taangte hadohna ding, thu phuong dingin, kei ahing sawl hi.","title":"Hundamna khantan hoi","ref":"Mat. 11.5; Luk. 7.22  ;     \n        Luk. 4.18,19"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa lungdam kum thu leh, i Pasian phubalahna ni phuongdoh ding leh, da leh kapte hamuon dingin,","ref":"Mat. 5.4"},"3":{"text":"Zion a dalekapte henem ding leh, vut taanga pahkhi pe ding, da leh kaana taanga lungnopna sathau pe ding leh, nguina hagau taanga phatna puon pe dingin, kei ahing sawl hi; Mangpa pahtawi a a um theina dinga, amauh dihtatna singte, Mangpa phusa akichi theina ding un."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh amaun munlui sesate alamtha kia ding ua, masanglai a kitaisansate atungding kia ding ua, Khang tampi luolou a um khopite abawlpha kia ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Gamdang miten na belamhonte uh, ahing vah pieh ding ua, thei ngai lou gamdang mite na loute uh hou leh, na grep huonte uh hing kep piehin apang ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh noute pen Mangpa siempute, chi a min law in na um ding ua, miten i Pasian nasemte ahing chi ding uhi. Nouten namte hausatna na ne ding ua, athupina uh na kiletsahpi ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na zumna taang un aleni a zatatna na mu ding uhi; lungbuoina taangin atanvou uah akipah ding uhi; tuaziehin amauh gam sungah, aleni a gouluona atang ding ua, kumtawn lungnopna ama ua ahita ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen Kei Mangpa’n thudih a vaihawmna ka it a, halmang sillat dinga, guhtatna ka huo hi, anasep uah keiman thutah ka kohmu dinga, amaute toh kumtawn thuhun ka hung ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahah asuonte uh namte lah ah akithei dinga, tualeh atate uzong, mipite lah ah thei in a um ding uhi; amauh mu poumain Mangpa guolzawl ahi uh, achi ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa ah nahpitahin ka kipah dinga, ka Pasian ah ka hinna anuom ding hi; aziehpen ama’n mouneidingpa pahkhigui a akizep a, mounu ding zong suong manpha a akizep bangin, Aman kei hundamna puonsilte ahing silsah a, dihtatna puonahtuol ahing silsah hi.","ref":"Kihil. 21.2"},"11":{"text":"Leitung in sil adawn suong sah a, huon in haichi akhankhieh sah bangin, Mangpa Pasian in dihtatna leh, phatna apoudoh sah ding hi."}}},"62":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A dihtatna uh vahpha mama banga ataankhieh a, ahundamna thaumei kuong banga akuon masangsie’n, Zion ziehin hamlouin ka um sih ding a, Jerusalem ziehin ka mawh um sih ding hi.","title":"Zion leitung pumpi tanvah hiding"},"2":{"text":"Nam zousie’n na dihtatna amu ding ua, tualeh leengte zousie in na thupina amu ding uhi; Mangpa kam in aphuo ding minthain, ahing kihanta ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nang pen Mangpa khuta thupina, Manglukhu na hi dinga, tualeh na Pasian khut a thupina leenglukhu na hi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Taisansa chi na hinawn sih dinga, na gam zong nuasiesa akichi nawn sih dinga, Hephzibah ahing kichi zawta dinga, na gam zong Beulah chi ahi zawta ding hi. Mangpa na tunga akipah ziehin na gam akitenpi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tangval in nungah siengthou akitenpi bangin, na tapaten nang ahing kitenpi ding uhi; Mouneipa mounu tunga akipah mabangin, Tuamabangin na Pasian na tungah akipah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Aw Jerusalem na kulbang tungah galveng mi ka koita a, amauh sun leh zan in amawh um sih ding ua; Nou Mangpa theiphah a um mite aw, ham lou in um khinkhian sih un."},"7":{"text":"Ama zong um khinkhian sah sih un, Jerusalem asuhkip a leitunga phat huoi a, abawl masangsie in."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa akhut zietlam leh ahatna ban lou in akichiemta a, “Adihtahin na butangte uh na melmate uh ann neh dingin, ka pe nawn sih ding a; gamdang miten na sepsa na uoin tha uh, adawn nawn sih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh a lakhawmten ane ding ua, Mangpa aphat ding uhi; tualeh ahing tawikhawm miten, ka inn-huongsung siengthou ah adawn ding uhi.”"},"10":{"text":"Pei suoh un, ka kotpite ah pei suoh unlen, mipite a dingin lampi bawlpha un, Siel un, lamlienpi siel unlen, suongte tom sieng unlen, mite adingin puonlap domsang un!"},"11":{"text":"Ngai un, kawlmong dongin Mangpa’n aphuongzahta a, Zion tanu kungah “Ngai in, na hundamna ahing tungta, en in akipahman akungah a um a, anasep zong amasangah a um hi;” chi in gen un, achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 40.10; Kihil. 22.12"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh ama ukhu, Mi Siengthou Mangpa tatsa mite achi ding ua, tualeh Nangpen, Suidoh taisanlou khopi, ahing chi ding uhi, chiin achi hi."}}},"63":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Edom akipat a hing pei, Bozrah khuo akipat a, asandupa-kibum puon sil a hing pei, leengpuon thupitah a kizem a, athahatna thupitah toh kal suon a hing pei koi ahiei? “Keima dihtatna thugen a, hundam ding a hattah ka hi.”","title":"Pasian phubalahna ni","ref":"Isai. 34.5-17; Jer. 49.7-22; Ezek. 25.12-14; 35.1-15; Amos. 1.11,12; Obad. 1.1-14; Mala. 1.2-5"},"2":{"text":"Bangzieh a na puonsil san a, na sil naten grep chilna khuh a kidie bang ahiei?"},"3":{"text":"“Keima tangin in grep chilna khuh kachilta a, mipite lah akipat koiman ang chilpi sih ua, lungthah pum a amauh ka totden ziehin leh, ka lungthah man a ka totchil ziehin, a sisan uh ka puonsilte tung ah akithe a, ka puonahtuol ah abaang hi.","ref":"Kihil. 14.20; 19.15; Kihil. 19.13"},"4":{"text":"Ka lungtang ah phuba lah ni a um a, tualeh ka Tatsate kum ahing tungta hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka en a, ang panpi ding koima a um sih a, tualeh atutang ding koima a umlou ziehin, lamdang ka sa hi; Tuaziehin keima ban mama in hundamna ahing tut a, ka lungthahna in keima ahing tudet hi.","ref":"Isai. 59.16"},"6":{"text":"Ka lungthahna ziehin mite ka tuonchil a, ka thangpaina ka dawnkham sah a, athahatna sisan uh tuol ah ka sungbota hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Mangpa’n sil bangkim ahing vua dungzui in, Mangpa itna hepina leh, Mangpa phatna thute ka gen ding a, akhotuona leh ahoina thupitah dungzui a, Israel innkuonte tunga asilbawl tampite, ka gen ding hi.","title":"Asuohta umsunte thumna"},"8":{"text":"Aman amauh ka mite ahi tahtah ua, zuou lou ding tate ahi uh, achi hi. Tuachi’n Ama khu a hundampa uh ahing hita hi."},"9":{"text":"Suhgentheia a umna pouma uah, ama zong suhgenthei in a um a, A umpina vansawlsieng in amaute a hundamta hi; A itna leh khotuona in amauh a Tanta a, nidanglai nite tengteng ah amauh, puoin apom zel hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute ahel ua, A Hagau Siengthou alungkhamsah uhi. Tuachi’n Ama akihei a, amelma un alepanta a, amauh adouta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun khanglui lai a asuohpa Mosi leh, amite damlai nite athei zing ua, Tuipi akipat a abelamhonte uh chingpa toh, amaute hing puidohpa hei a um atai? Asung ua A Hagau Siengthou koipa, hei a um atai mah? Achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"A ban thupina toh, Mosi khut zietlam zanga, amauh puipa, Ama adinga kumtawn minthanna anga na ding a, amaute masanga tuipi kikhensahpa hei a um ahiei?","ref":"Pawt. 14.21"},"13":{"text":"A kipal pua louna ding ua, amauh gamdai a sakol puibanga, tuithuhpi kantan a puipa hei a um ahiei?"},"14":{"text":"Phaijanga ganhon peisuh bangin, Mangpa Hagau in amauh akhawldamsah hi. Tuachi’n Nangma min thupitah a kibawlna dingin, na mite na pui zel hi."},"15":{"text":"Van akipat in hing en suh in, Na Sienthouna leh, na thupina umna mun akipat hing mu in. Na phattuomngaina leh na thahatna, koute nang ngaina leh hepina lungtang hei a um atai? phallou leh tawpsah atai mah?"},"16":{"text":"Abraham in koute hing theilouin, Israel in hing donpha sih nanleh, ka pa uh na hi a, Aw Mangpa Nang ka pa uh na hi a; Namin kumtawn akipat ka Tanpa uh, ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, bangzieh a na lampi akipat a nang pielmang sah a, Nangma giinna apat a, ka lungtang uh nang suhkhau pieh ahiei mah? Na suohte Nangma goutan namte ziehin, hing kinuale kia in."},"18":{"text":"Na mi siengthouten na mun siengthou ka tang uh a, hinanleh hun tomkhat sung ahi bou hi; Ka melmate un na mun siengthou atuonchil gawpta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Koute nidang lai a, na vaihawm khah ngainalou leh, na min a kihan ngailou mite ka bang khongkhongta uhi."}}},"64":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na masang a taangte akilinna dingun, vante phukeh in hing kum suh lachin aw!","title":"Khrist hing peikia chienga hundamna ngena asuohta umsunte thumna"},"2":{"text":"Mei in singkangte ahal kuong bangin, mei in tui asousah bangin, nang hing doute’n na min atheina ding uleh, na masanga namte akilinna dingin."},"3":{"text":"Ka kinepphah lou uh, sil chizat huoi na bawllai in, na hing kumsuh a, na masangah muol leh taangte akithing hi."},"4":{"text":"Leitung umchil akipat in ama ngah mi a dinga, bawlpieh nangma loungal Pasian dang, athei ngai sih ua, bil in aza ngai sih ua, mit in zong amu ngai sih uhi.","ref":"1 Kor. 2.9"},"5":{"text":"Nang kipah tah a um leh dihtattah a bawlmi, tualeh na lampite a nangma hing thei ngitnget mi khu na kimupi zel a, Ngai in ka kheltah ziehun, Nang na lungthah a, tambang in ka khiel toupeh ua, tuachi’n hundam ngai ka hi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh ka bawnpi un sil sienglou bang ka hi ua, ka dihtatna zousie u’zong puonse nieh bang giap ahi, ka bawn un singna bangin ka vuoi sieng ua, ka khelnate un hui bangin ang tawmang zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh koiman na min ahan sih a, koima nang hing tu chinten dingin, akithathou sah sih a, aziehpen kou akipat na mai na phuolta a, ka gitlounate ziehun, nang mangthai sahta hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin vang Mangpa aw, ka pa uh na hi; Koute atungman ka hi ua, Nang belkhengpa na hi. Koute zousie na khut suoh ka hi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aw Mangpa lungthah seng sinlen, ka khelna uh kumtawn in thei ngitnget sin, Ahi, hing en in, Koute ka bawn un Na mite ka hi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na khopi siengthoute gamdai asuohta, Zion khopi nangawn gamdai asuohta hi, Jerusalem nangawn zong akilawita hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka pu le pate un nangma ahing phatna uh, ka biehinn siengthou uleh ka inn kilawmtah ukhu, mei in akatumta a, ka sil manphate uleh, deihuoi zousie asegawp siengta hi."},"12":{"text":"Aw Mangpa tambangteng nua a zong, kideh nalai ding na hiei mah? Hamlou phunlou a nasa sem a, hing sugenthei nalai ding na hiei mah?"}}},"65":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahing kan ngailoute sui in ka um a, ahing sui ngailoute mu in ka um a, Ka min a kihan ngailou namte kungah, “Tanah ka um hi, tanah ka um hi,” ka chi hi.","title":"Asuohta umsunte kunga Mangpa dawnna","ref":"Rom. 10.20"},"2":{"text":"Amauh ngaituona dungzui a, lampi hoilou a peite leh mi helhatte adingin, sun nitum in ka ban ka zah hi.","ref":"Rom. 10.21"},"3":{"text":"Ka maitang mama a hing phin lungthah ngitnget mite, huonsung pou a kithoi a, tehlei maitam tungte a gimnamtui hal te,"},"4":{"text":"Haan lah ah atou ua, hanmuol lah ah agieh zel ua, vohsa ane ua abel sungte uah, sil kidahhuoi satui-hang ahuon uhi."},"5":{"text":"“Ki hemkhie in hing nai sin, nang sangin ka siengthou zaw hi,” achi uhi; tuate khu ka nahkaw hawm a meikhu um, sun nitum a meikuong ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"En in, ka masang ah gelsa in a um hi; “Hamlou in ka sip khinkhien sih dinga, ka thuh dinga, a angsung ngei uah ka thuh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Noute khelna leh na pu na pate uh khelnate toh, kang thuhkhawm ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi; Amaun taang tungte ah gimnamtui ahal ua, muol tungte ah ka min agensie uhi; tuaziehin anasep masate uh a angsung ngei uah, kimtah in ka te ding hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Grepga bom a uoin tha akimu a, miten suse sih un, asungah guolzawlna a um hi, achibang un, ka suohte zal in tuabangin ka bawl dinga, amaute abawn un ka sumang sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Jakob akipat in hahlesuon ka umdoh sah dinga, Juda akipat in ka muol leh taangte, luo ding mi ka umdoh sah dinga, Ka mi telten tuo khu aluo ding ua, ka suohte tuanah ateng ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Kei hing sui ka mite a dingin, Sharon khu belam hon huong ahi dinga, tualeh Akor phaijang khu ganhonte, lupna mun ahita ding hi.","ref":"Josh. 7.24-26"},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh noute pen, Mangpa na taisan a, Ka taang siengthou manghil a, Gad pasien a dinga annkuong luite leh Meni pasien a dinga, dawn sillat na lan mite na hi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka hing hat laiin nang dawng sih ua, thu ka gen laiin na ngai sih ua, ka mit mu ah sil hoilou na bawl ua, ka kipahpi lou silte na tel zoh ziehun, namsau a shi dingte lah ah, Kang simkhawm dinga, kithana mun a tha dingin na bawn un, na kun chiet ding uhi.”"},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “En in, ka suohten ane ding ua, hinanleh noute na gilkiel ding uhi; En in, ka suohten adawn ding ua, hinanleh noute na dangta ding uhi; En in, ka suohten nuom asa ding ua, hinanleh noute na zum ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"En in, ka suohten lungnuom tah in la asa ding ua; hinanleh noute pen lungtanga dana toh nakap ding ua, Hagau a lungkhama chimaw in, Kap leh mau in na um ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Nouten na min uh hamse dingin ka mitelte kungah, na nuasie ding uhi; aziehpen Mangpa Pasian in noute ang that dinga, asuohte min tuom in ahanta ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n leitunga ama leh ama thupha kipepa khu, thutah Pasian ah thupha akipe ding hi; leitunga mi akichiem leh, thutah Pasian min in akichiem ding hi; aziehpen masanglai a lungkhambuoinate manghil ahita a, ka mitmu akipat akiselmangta ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen “En vawi, van tha leh lei tha ka siem hi; sil masate kithei ngitnget nawnlou dinga, lungsim ah zong kiphawhkha nawnlou ding hi.","title":"Van tha leh lei tha","ref":"Isai. 66.22; 2 Pet. 3.13; Kihil. 21.1"},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh ka sil siemte ah kumtawn in kipah in, lungnuom un; Aziehpen Envawi, Jerusalem lungnopna in ka siem a, amite zong kipahna in ka siem hi."},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem tungah ka lungnuom ding a, ka mite tungah zong ka kipah ding hi; a sungah kaana aw akiza nawn sih ding a, mauna aw zong a kiza nawn vawtsih ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 21.4"},"20":{"text":"Asungah naungeh ni tomnoukhat dam chi a um nawn sih dinga, tehsia a damsung nite kuitung lou a um sih ding hi; naupang kum zakhat a upa in ashi dinga, hinanleh mikhiel kum zakhat damte hamse thuoh ahi ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Inn alam ding ua, asung ah ateng ding uhi, grep huonte abawl ding ua, aga ane ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Midang tenna dingin inn alam nawn sih ding ua; midangte neh dingin grep huonte abawl nawn sih ding uhi. Aziehpen ka mite dam kum, singte dam kum toh kibang ding hi. Ka mi tel tuomten akhut nasep ga uh sawtpi ane ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amaun amawhna’n na asem sih ding ua, vangse ding giap in tate anei nawn sih ding uhi, aziehpen ama uleh atate uh pum in, Mangpa guolzawl hahlesuonte ahi ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, ahing hat masang un ka dawng dinga, agen lai lai un ka za ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Ngie leh belamnou agamta khawm ding ua, humpibahnei in zong bawngtal bangin, bupawl aneta ding hi; tualeh leivuite gulpi ann neh ahita ding hi. Ka taang siengthou ah akisuna nawn sih ding ua, akisuse nawn sih ding uhi,” Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 11.6-9"}}},"66":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; “Van ka mangtoupha ahi a, leitung ka keng ngapna ahi; Kei a dinga na hing inn bawlpieh dinguh, hei a um ahiei? Ka khawlmun ding heisung hi ding ahiei?","title":"Leenggam guolzawlna","ref":"Mat. 5.34; 23.22; Mat. 5.35  ;     \n        Nasep. 7.49,50"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen tam silte zousie ka khut in abawlta a, tua silte ahing um uhi; Mangpa’n achi hi. Hinanleh mi gentheitah a um, lungsim kisia tuntun, tualeh ka thu a chitun zel mi ka en zaw ding hi."},"3":{"text":"“Bawngtal that mi pouma pen, mihing that bang ahi, Belamnou a kithoi mi zong, ui ngawng hehtan bang ahi; ann sillat lan mi zong voh sisan lan bang ahi. Gimnamtui hal a lan pouma zong, Milim bie bang ahi. Amauh lampi chiet akitel ua, ahinna un akidahhuoina uh akipahpi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin ken zong amaute adingin, vangsietna ka tel dinga, agiin pen uh atung uah ka tungsah ding hi. Aziehpen ka hat chiengin koiman ang dawng sih ua, thu ka gen chiengin, koiman ang ngaikhe nuom sih uhi.”"},"5":{"text":"Nou Athuza a chitunte aw, Mangpa thu ngaikhie un, “Noute hing muda a, ka min zieh a, hing notdoh na unaute un, na kipahna ka mu theina dingun, Mangpa pahtawi in umta hen, achi uhi. Hinanleh azum ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"“Khopi sung akipat husa vengvung ngai un, biehinn akipat aw ging, amelmate tung a kimtah a, Mangpa phuba lahna thawm ging ahi."},"7":{"text":"“Amanu’n anauvei masangin ta anei a, nauvei natna anei masangin, tapa aneikhie hi.","ref":"Kihil. 12.5"},"8":{"text":"Tambang sil koi in azakha ngai ei? Tambang sil koi in amukha ngai ei? Nikhat thu in gam khat apieng thei diei? ahisihleh thakhat thu in nam khat apieng thei diei? Hinapiin Zion in nau aveitah in tate aneikhe pai hi."},"9":{"text":"Nau nei hun tungsah ngal inga, ka suohkhesah pai sih ding amah? Mangpa’n achi hi. Kei nau piengsah zelpa’n, naubu ka bing sah ding amah? na Pasian in achi hi."},"10":{"text":"“Nou Jerusalem it zousiete aw, ama lungnoppi unlen, ama toh kipah khawm un, ama nada nakapite zousie aw, ama kipahpi in lungnuom un."},"11":{"text":"Na tep ua ahamuonna nawite a, na tai theina dingun leh, na dawn tam ua athupina kiningchingtah a, na kipah theina ding uh ahi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Ngai un, ahamuonna lui bangin akungah, ka luongsah ding a; tualeh Jentelte thupina zong luitui luong bang in, ka luongsah ding; tuachi’n a angsungah ang pom dinga, na kiva ding a, aphei tungah ahing kitomsah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Nu in ata ahamuon bangin, ka hing hamuon dinga, tuachi’n Jerusalem ah hamuon in na umta ding uhi, achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tami na mu chieng un na lungtang uh anuom dinga, na gute zong hampa bangin, adawng thinthen dinga, Mangpa khut khu asuohte kungah theisah ahi ding a, athangpaina khu amelmate tungah theisah ahi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Aziehpen En vawi, Mangpa khu meikuong toh, a sakolleng pingpei bang toh hing pei ding ahi, alungthahna thangpaina, huoisie atung ding a, athuhilna meikuong toh azawh ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n meikuong leh namsau in, mihing zousie tungah vaihawmna atungsah dinga, Mangpa’n athate atampi ahi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"“Huon sung lah ah apei ua, alaikim a milim nualam ah amauleh amauh kisiensuo a, kisieng sah a, vohsa leh sil kidahhuoi nete leh, chiapi sa nete, amangthai khawm sieng ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"18":{"text":"“Aziehpen asilbawlte uleh angaituonate uh ka thei a, nam chin leh ham chin ka puikhawm ding a, ahing pei ding ua, ka thupina amu ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"A lah uah chiemtena ka koi dinga, tualeh alah ua pat a suohta namte kungah: Tarshish ah, Pul ah, thalkap siem mi lud te kungah, Tubal ah, Javan ah, leh ka minthan dan za ngailou leh, ka thupina mu ngailou, tuipipang gam a gamlapi tah a umte kung ah, ka sawl ding hi. Tualeh amaun Jentelte kungah, ka thupina aphuong ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel taten asillat uh bel siengthou a, Mangpa inn sunga ahing tawi lut bang un, amaun Mangpa kunga sillat dingin, nam zousiete laha pat in na unaute zousie uh, sakol tungte sakollengte kizawn nate, sabiltung tungte leh sangawngsau tungte ah, ka muol siengthou Jerusalem ah, ahing pui lut ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh ken amaute lah a pawl khat, siempu ding leh, Levi hi dingin ka pang sah ding, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"22":{"text":"“Van tha leh lei tha ka bawl dingte, ka masanga umden ding ahi bangin, nahah nasuonte uleh na min uzong a umden ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 65.17; 2 Pet. 3.13; Kihil. 21.1"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi dinga, ha tha khat akipat ha tha dang khat, Khawlni tha khat a kipat Khawlni tha dang khat dongin, mi zousie ka masangah ahing pei ding ua, keima ahing be ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"24":{"text":"“Tualeh amaute apei doh ding ua, ka tunga takhielte mishi luong haw ava en ding uhi. Athante uh ashi sih dinga, ameikuong uzong amit sih dinga, ama upen mi zousie a dingin, kidahhuoi mama ahi ding uhi.”","ref":"Mak. 9.48"}}}}},"24":{"info":{"name":"Jeremiah","shortname":"Jer.","abbr":[],"desc":"Jeremiah laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin gam a Anathoth khuo a siempute lah a khat Hilkiah tapa Jeremiah thugente:","title":"Jeremiah"},"2":{"text":"Juda leengpa Amon tapa Josiah vaihawm kum, akum sawm leh thumna hunlai in Jeremiah kungah Mangpa thu ahing tung hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 22.3—23.27; 2 Khang. 34.8—35.19"},"3":{"text":"Juda leengpa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim hun laiin zong ahing tunga, Juda leengpa Josiah tapa Zedekiah vaihawm kum sawm leh khatna tawp dong ha ngana a Jerusalem sal a puimanga aum tandong in.","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.36—24.7; 2 Khang. 36.5-8; 2 Leeng. 24.18—25.21; 2 Khang. 36.11-21"},"4":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Jeremiah hatna"},"5":{"text":"“Naubu sungah ka hing siem masangin, nang ka hing theita hi; na pien masanga ka hing suhsiengthousa na hita hi, Namte kunga guolnei hi dingin ka hing guotta hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken “Eh! Mangpa Pasian, Ngai vawi, naupang nou ka hiziehin thu ka genthei sih,” ka chi hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Naupang ka hi chisin, ka hing sawlna poumate kungah na pei dinga, ka hing thupieh pouma nagen ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Amauh giing sin, aziehpen nangma hunkhe dingin na kungah ka um hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n akhut ahing hakhie a, kakam ahing khoi a, tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah, “En in, ka thute na kam ah ka koita hi."},"10":{"text":"Ngaivawi, tuni’n keiman nangpen namte leh leenggam tungah, botdoh ding leh luoikhe ding leh, sumangthai ding leh paikhe ding leh, lam ding leh phut dingin ka hing guotta hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga, “Jeremiah bang na mu ei?” achi hi. Tualeh ken “Kawlthualu sing ba khat ka mu hi,” ka chi hi.","title":"Vaihawmna chiemtena nite"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Na mudih hi, aziehpen tam khu bawla ka thu tangtung sah pai dinga mansa ka hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa thu aniveina dingin ka kungah ahing tungkia a; “Bang na mu ei?” ahing chi hi. Tualeh ken “Bel sou but but akam in mallam nua ngat khat ka mu hi,” ka chi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Mallam akipat in sietna, gamsunga tengte zousie tungah ahing tung ding hi, achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen ngaiin, mallam leenggam a namte zousie ka han ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Tuachi’n leengte ahing pei ding ua, Jerusalem kulpi lutna kotpi bul ah, akimvel a kulbaang zousie bul ah leh, Juda khopi zousie ah aleengtoupha chiet uh, atungchiet ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Kei ahing nuasie ua, pasien dangte kunga gimnamtui ahal ua, amauh khut suohte abieh zieh ua, agitlouna zousie uh tungtanga amauh dinga, ka vaihawmnate ka gendoh ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin na kawng gah inlen dingdohin, tualeh kang thupieh pouma amaute kungah genin, amaitang uah lungke vawt sin, tua ahisih leh ken amaute masang ah, ka hing lungkesah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen ngaiin, tuni in agam pumpi Juda leengte, amiliente leh asiempute leh tua gam a mite lah ah, khopi kulnei leh sia khuom sum-eng kulbangin, ka hing bawlta hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaun nang ang dou ding ua, hinanleh ahing zousih ding uhi; aziehpen nang hing hundoh dingin ka hing umpi hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Israelten theisasa in khelna abawl uh: Jeremiah thugen chilna"},"2":{"text":"“Pei inlen, Jerusalem zah in Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi chi’n va kikou in. Haichi tu louna gam, gamdai a ka nua na zui lai a, na khangdawn lai a na hoinate, mou dinga na kikham lai a na itnate, ka thei ngitnget hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel khu Mangpa a dingin sienthouna leh, agapung masa pen ahi. Ama negam zousie in, maw atang ding ua, atung uah sil hoilou atung ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi,” vachi in."},"4":{"text":"Jakob innkuonte leh Israel innkuonte zousie aw, Mangpa thu ngaiun."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Napu napate un keima ah bang dihtatlouna mu ahi ua, Kei a kipat a gamla taha apeimang ua, milimte azui ua, bangmalou milim bete ahing hi tah mai uh?"},"6":{"text":"Amauten, Izipt gam a kipat a hing puidoh a, gamdai gamgaw guom kokhuh lah leh, tui umlouna leh shina lim guom tawn a, Koima pei ngailouna leh koima tenna ngailou gam tan a, hing puipa khu hei a um ahi tai? achi hetsih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ken noute gam hoitah ah, agam ga leh ahoina kiningchingtah ne dingin, ka hing tutta hi; hinanleh na lut tah un ka gam na subuata ua, tualeh ka goutan khu kidah huoi nasuoh sahta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Siempute’n lah Mangpa hei a um ahiei? chiin akan ngai sih ua; dan thu saiten lah kei ahing thei sih uhi; Vaihawmte lah keima kalin atakhiel ua, guolneiten zong Baal thu agen ua, tualeh bangma phatuomlou silte nua azui uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Tuaziehin noute kang gawt nalai dinga, natu nate uh zong ka gawt nalai ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuipi gei a Saipras gam ah galkai unlen, en unlen, Kedar ah mi sawl unlen, kitup tahin ngaituo un, tambang sil a um ngaita mawngmawng eimah, en un."},"11":{"text":"Nam khat in a pasiente uh, pasiente hisihnanleh aheng ngai uh amah? Hinanleh ka miten a thupina uh, phattuomna neilou milimte toh ahengta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Aw vante, tami dipkawzen in lamdangsa unlen, chizat huoi sahna toh zau unlen, segawp siengun, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen ka miten sil hoilou ni abawlta uhi: Kei hinna tuinah ahing nuasieta ua, amauh tuikhuh ding akitaw ua, tui veitheilouna tuikuong sesa abawl uhi."},"14":{"text":"“Israel suoh ahiei mah? Suoh leh sal hisa a pieng ahiei mah? Bangdinga susiet a um ahiei?"},"15":{"text":"Humpibahnei hatlaiten ahawhkhum a, angih uhi; agam uh asuhsietpieh ua, akhompite uh akihaltum a, Koima ateng nawn sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Noph leh Tahpanhes miten zong na lutunga manglukhu ahing suhsiet piehta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Lampi a ahing pui lai a, Mangpa na Pasian na taisan zieh a, tamte nangma tunga na tunsah hilou ahiei mah?"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh bangdinga tu a Sihor tuite dawn dinga, Izipt lampi a pei na hi uoi? ahisihleh bangdinga Luipi tuite dawn dinga, Assiria lampi a pei nahi uoi mah?"},"19":{"text":"Nouma gitlouna mama in ahing sudih dinga, na nuatolna un nou ahing phawh ding hi; tuaziehin Mangpa na Pasian uh na taisan ua, Keima giinna na neilou pen uh sil hoiloutah leh khatah ahi, chi thei unlen mu un, galkapte Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"20":{"text":"“Masang laipeh a kipat in, na hahkol uh kang suhtan piehta a, na kolbute zong kang sutawng piehta hi; tualeh ka takhiel nawn sih ding na chi a, singbawh chinteng nuoi ah, kizua bangin na lum kawi kawi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuabang pumpum in ken nang grepgui dihtah leh chi hoi penpen in ka hing suon a, bangchi dana kei a dinga grepgui dihlou, leh gam grepgui suohdoh nahi tai?"},"22":{"text":"Tang al a kisil in sabon tampi zang nan lachin zong, na gitlouna ka masangah chiemte in a umta hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Bangchidan a ka kisubua sih a, Baalte nua zong ka zui sih na chithei ahiei mah? Phaijanga na gamtat dan en inlen, na sil bawlte thei ve, sangawngsau la hua, khau khi theilou a tai kawi kawi bang na hi."},"24":{"text":"Gamdai a um zel gamsabiltung, hua seng kisa a dah iau uou a, huinam vutvut toh kibang na hi. A utna koiin ahiai khamzou ding, Amanu sui zousie kisu gim nuom da uheh, aha chin chieng amuna ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Na kengah kedap bunlouin um sinlen, na dang zong tasah sin. Hinanleh nang kinepna ding um sih, gamdang pasiente ka itzawta a, amaute nua ka zui ding hi nachi hi."},"26":{"text":"“Guta akimudoh chienga azum bangin, Israel innkuonte azum uhi. Ama uleh aleengte uh, amiliente uh, tualeh a siempute u’leh, a guolneite u’toh abawn un azum siengta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Singbul kungah ka pa nahi, achi ua, suongbul kungah ahing hingkhepa na hi, chiin kei ang nua ngatsan ua, ahing maingat sih uhi. Hinanleh abuoi hun chiengun, thou inlen hing hundam in, achi ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh na pasien ding ua na kisiemthu, uh milim na pasiente uh hei a um ata uoi? Thou u’leh asih diei, Na buoi hun chieng ua, hing hundam thei ding ahi u’leh. Aziehpen Aw Juda, na khopi uh tam dungzui a na pasien uh tam ahi."},"29":{"text":"“Bangzieh a ka tunga lungkimlou na hi uoi? na bawn un ka tungah na takhielta uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Na tate uh amawhna in kana gawtbawl khata a, bawlhoina asang tuom sih uhi. Humpibahnei gongsan bangin, na namsau un na guolneite uh avaltumta hi."},"31":{"text":"Khangthate aw, Mangpa thu thei un, Israel a dinga gamdai bang mai, ahisihleh mielna gam bang mai kata amah? Bangdinga ka miten, zalen ka hita uh, na kungah hing pei nawn sih va ung, achi thei uh ahiei?"},"32":{"text":"Nungah in akizepna amanghil thei diei? Ahisihleh mounu’n akitenna puon silte amanghil thei diei? Hinapiin ka miten ni simsenglou sung kei ahing manghilta uhi."},"33":{"text":"“Bangdinga itna suina dinga, na umdan na kilawmsah mawh ahiei? Tuaziehin numei giloute kungah na umdan na hil zouta hi."},"34":{"text":"Na nihte tungah zong, mi zawng mawna neiloute hinna sisan akimu hi; aguh agal a kasui a ka mu ahisih a, hinanleh tamte zousie tunga ka mu ahizaw hi."},"35":{"text":"Hinapiin nangman, mawna neilou ka hi ziehin, pellouin alungthahna kei akipat akiheimang ding hi, na chi hi; Ngaiin, Ka khiel sih nachi ziehin na tungah, thukhenna ka tungsah ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Bangdinga na umdante henga hichi viel dien kawi na hiei? Assiriate masanga na zum bangin, Iziptte masang ah zong na zum ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahi, na khuta na lutung hum kawm in ama akipat in, na pawtdoh ding hi. Mangpa’n na mimuon leh, na kizoppite anuoltah ziehin ama ute ziehin, na lawching sih ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Amaun pasal khat in azi khul henlen, azi in ama nuasiein pasal dangtoh vakiteng taleh, tua pasal in azi anua nei thei kia diei mah? Tua gam khu, nasatah a kibuasah gawp sieng hitalou ding amah? Hinanleh na kingaipi tampite a dingin, kizua bangin na um a, tuabang hinapiin zong ka kungah na hing kile kia hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","title":"Kisiemthana"},"2":{"text":"Muol sang lam ah dahtou inlen, en in. Ahingluppi louna mun uh a um mawngmawng ei mah? Gamdai a Arabmite bangin, lampi gei lah ah ang luppi ding amaute ngah in na tou a, gam sung kizuana leh gitlouna in na buasah siengta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin guo zuh ding akikhatan a, guotui nukhia zong azutasih hi; tualeh kizuate mel na puo a, zumdan mawngmawng na thei sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tumama akipat in ka kungah, Kapa ka khangdawn lai a hing puipa nang chi sih ding amah?"},"5":{"text":"Ama kumtawn a lungthah den ding ahiei mah? Aman tua khu atawp dong akem diei mah? Ngaiin, na genta hi, tualeh na bawl theitawpin sil hoilou na bawlta hi.”"},"6":{"text":"Lengpa Josiah vaihawm sungin Mangpa’n ka kungah: “A nuatol Israel sil bawlte na mu eimah? Muolsang chinteng tungah leh sing hing bawh lim chinteng nuoi ah apeitou a, kizuana gamtatna abawl hi.","title":"Israelte tuoh sietna, Juda in khohsalou","ref":"2 Leeng. 22.1—23.30; 2 Khang. 34.1—35.27"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tam silte zousie abawl nuain, ken ka kungah hing kinuale kia in kachi hi. Hinanleh ama ang kinuale kia sih hi, tualeh asanggamnu ginatlou dan Juda in amuta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n anuatol Israel in angkawmna abawlna san leh aziehte ka mutah ziehin, amanu ka koimanga, khulna lai ka pieh laiin, asanggamnu lepchiena Juda in azau tuon sih a, apei a angkawm in kizuana ava bawl hi, chi ka muta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n tambang ahing hi a, ahuana gamtat aman khawh asahlou ziehin gamsung asubua a, sing leh suong chinteng toh ang akawmta hi."},"10":{"text":"Asanggamnu lepchiena tambang teng hinapi Juda alungtang zousie toh ka kungah ahing kinuale sih a, akisiakhem kipang ahi bou hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah, a nuatol Israel in alepchie Juda sangin akidihtatsah zaw nalai hi."},"12":{"text":"Pei inlen tam thute mallam ah va phuongzah in: Nang nuatol Israel hing kinualekia in, Mangpa’n achi hi, Kei khotuona adim ka hi ziehin na tung ah, ka lungthahna ka tungsah sih ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi, tualeh na tungah kumtawn in ka lungthah den sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian tunga na tatkhelnate leh, singbawh hing nuoi chintenga, gamdang pasiente toh na gamtat thanghuoinate leh, ka aw na sanlounate, thupha tawi phot maiin, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Hing kinuale un Aw nuatol tate, Mangpa’n achi hi. Aziehpen nang ka hing kitenpita a, noute lah akipat, khopi a mi khat, innkuon khat akipat mi ni, ka la dinga, Zion ah kang tut ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tualeh theina leh thesiemna toh noute hing vaa dingin ka lung tuoh mama belampu ka hing pe ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi ding, chiin Mangpa’n agen hi; gam sunga na hing pun ua, na hing tam deu deu hun chiengun, tuami ni chiengin, amaun “Mangpa thuhunbawm” achi nawn sih ding ua, alungsim uah zong a gel kha nawn sih ding ua, thei zong atheikha nawn sih ding ua, ve zong ave ngai nawn sih ding ua, bawl zong abawl kia nawn sih ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin Jerusalem khu Mangpa Mangtoupha achita ding ua, tualeh nam zousie Mangpa min in Jerusalem ah ahing kikhawm ding ua, amaun alungtang gilou u’leh genhanate uh azui nawn sih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Juda innkuonte khu Israel innkuonte toh a umkhawmta ding ua, mallam gam akipat in napu napate uh kunga, agoutan ding ua ka piehsa gam ah ahing peikhawm ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh ken: “Bangchidan in nang tate lah ah ka hing koi in, gam nuomtah nam zousie dinga, goutan kilawm pen hing pe ding ka hiei mah? ka chi hi. Tualeh ken: Ka pa, na hing chi dinga, kei a kipat na pielmang sih ding hi, ka chi hi."},"20":{"text":"Zi muonhuoilou apasal akipat a ataimang bangin, tuamabangin lepchietahin kei na hing bawl uhi, Aw Israel innkuonte,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Muolsangtung lah a, Israel tate kaa leh mauna leh, thungetna aw ging akiza hi; aziehpen amaun aumdan uh asegawp sah siengta ua, Mangpa a Pasian uh amanghilta uhi."},"22":{"text":"“Hing kile kia un nou nuatol tate, na nuatolna uh ka hing damsah ding hi.” Ahi, na kungah “Ka hing pei uhi, aziehpen nang Mangpa ka Pasian uh na hi."},"23":{"text":"Adihtah in, muol tungte leh muol tampite akipat a, hundamna kinep khu amawhna ahi bou hi. Adihtahin Mangpa i Pasian uah, Israelte hundamna a um hi."},"24":{"text":"“I khangdawn lai akipat in zumna in ipu ipate, sepgimna gate, abelam honte uh, aganhonte uh atapate u’leh atanute uh anegamta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Zum sasa in tuol ah ilumsuh ua, izalatna un ahing khuta hi; eite leh ipu ipate un ikhangdawn lai ua kipat, tuni dong in Mangpa i Pasian uh tungah ikhielta ua, Mangpa i Pasian aw ina zuita sih uhi.”"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Aw Israel, na kinuale kia ding leh, keima kungah hing kile kiain, Mangpa’n achi hi. Tualeh ka mitmu akipata na kidahhuoinate, na koimanga ahileh na kisuonkhe sih ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa ahina ahin sungsie chi a, thutahna in thukhendihna in, tualeh dihtatna in na kichiem dinga namte khu, Ama ah amauleh amauh hampha akichi ding ua, Ama ah akisuongta ding uhi.”"},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Juda leh Jerusalem mite kungah, Mangpa’n tambangin thu agen hi: “Na leikhalte uh satnen unlen, ling lah ah haichi tu sih un.","ref":"Hos. 10.12"},"4":{"text":"Mangpa kungah na tep uh tan unlen, na lungtang tep vunte uh paidoh un, nou Juda mite leh Jerusalem a tengte aw, tua ahisihleh, na silgilou bawlte ziehun, ka lungthahna mei bangin akuong dinga, koima’n aphelzou sih ding hi.”"},"5":{"text":"Juda gam ah phuongdoh unlen Jerusalem ah genthang un, tualeh gamsungah “Pengkul mut unlen, kikou unlen, kikhawm khawm un, tualeh hing kikhawm unlen, kulpinei khopi sungah lutvai, chiun.","title":"Mallam akipat Juda sietna"},"6":{"text":"Zion langah puonlap khai unlen, zekai louin bitna delun, aziehpen mallam akipat in keiman sietna leh manthaina, hing tungsah ding ka hi, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"A umna gammang zing keikui nuoi akipat in, humpibahnei ahing pawtta a, tualeh namte sumang dingpa zong lampi ah a umta hi. Ama khu nagam uh suse ding in amun apat akuondohta hi; na khopite uh atengmi umlou in asuse gawp sieng ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin sai-ip puon sil unlen, dalekap in mau un, aziehpen Mangpa thangpaina eite apat akiheimang sih hi.”"},"9":{"text":"“Tua ni chiengin tambang hing hiva, Mangpa’n achi hi: Lengpa leh a miliente hansanna lungtang abei sieng dinga, siemputen lamdang asa ding ua, guolneiten zong lamdang asa ding uhi.”"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken, “Ah! Mangpa Pasian, tam mite leh Jerusalem nahpi taha solgawp in hamuonna na nei ding uh na chi a, lah namsau in alungtang uh adawt zaw valongin ka chi hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin tam mite leh Jerusalem kungah, “Gamdai a munsang kieute akipat hui lum ka mite tanute zap sieng ding lah hilou susieng ding lah hilou."},"12":{"text":"Tamte adinga hat mama hui khat kei a dingin ka lang sah ding a, tuin amaute tunga ka thukhenna genkhe ding ka hi,” achi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"En in, Ama meipi bangin ahing peitou dinga, aasakollengte khu pingpei bang ahi dinga, asakolte muvanlai sangin agang zaw ding hi. I tung uh agih hi, suhsiet a um ihita uhi."},"14":{"text":"Aw Jerusalem gitlouna akipat na lungtang silsieng in; tuachi’n hundam in na um thei ding hi. Ngaituona giloute bangtan vei na sung a kem ding na hiei?"},"15":{"text":"Dan gam akipat in aw khat in aphuonga, Ephraim muol akipat in suhgentheina atangkoupi hi."},"16":{"text":"Namte kungah hil unlen Ahing dou dingte gamlapi akipat in ahing kuonta ua,” Juda khopite aw ngaitahin akikou khumta uhi chiin Jerusalem ah phuong un."},"17":{"text":"Juda gam ka tunga ahelzieh un, tua galkapten louveng mite bangin akimvel in a im khum uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Na umdante u’leh na silbawlte un, na tung ua tam silte ahing tut ahi. Tami na gitlouna ahia, akha mama a, na lungtang a sun hi.”"},"19":{"text":"Ka lungtang na e, ka lungtang na e! Ka lungtang mama ana hi. Ka lungtang na in kasung kihawt ging sah a, ka um khinkhian thei sih hi, aziehpen Aw ka hinna in, ki galginna pengkul gin azata hi."},"20":{"text":"Sietna tungah sietna atunga, gamsung pumpi suhsiet in a um ta hi. Thakhat in ka puon innte suhsiet in a um a, ka puonzahte zong mitphiet kallou in a sie hi."},"21":{"text":"Bangtanvei kidouna puonlap mu dinga, pengkul ging za ding ka hiei?"},"22":{"text":"“Ka mite amo seng ua, kei ahing theita sih uhi. Naupang mo ahi ua, amaun theisiemna anei sih uhi. Silhoilou bawl asiem ua, silhoi bawl dan athei sih uhi.”"},"23":{"text":"Leitung ka et leh, Ngai vawi, ahawm leh aguoh ahi a, tualeh vantein zong vahna anei sih uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tangte ka en a, Ngai vawi, akiling uhi, tualeh muol zousie aki thing uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ka en a, Ngai vawi, mihing koima a um sih a, tungleeng vate zousie aleengmang siengta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ka en a, Ngai vawi, louma hoiteng gamdai asuoh siengta, tualeh akhopi zousie Mangpa masang leh, alungthahna maiah achim siengta hi."},"27":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Gam pumpi nuasie hivan in, hinanleh atawpna tahtah hisah naisih vang, achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam ziehin leitungin suun van in, tunga vante amiel ding hi. Aziehpen keiman ka genta a, Keima’n ka tumta hi, ka lungsim ka heng sih dinga, tualeh tami apat in ka kinuahei kia sih ding hi.”"},"29":{"text":"Khopi pumpi sakol tungtuong mite leh, thaltawi mite thawmging za in ataimang ding uh a, gammang ah atailut ding ua, suongpi tungte ah akaltou ding uhi. Khopi chinteng akitaisan dinga, asungah mi koima ateng nawn sih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh nang suhsieta na um hun chiengin, bang na bawl diei? Puonsandup silinlen sana in kizem nanlachin, na mit na mai nutheiteng nu nanlachin, na kihoisahna amawhna ahi bou hi, Nang hing it hing ngaiten, ang simmawta ding ua, na hinna asui ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Aziehpen numei nauvei nat thuoh kikou aw ging leh, taluchil hingkhe ding, natna thuoh Zion tanu kaa leh mauna awgingleh, akhutte leh a, tuin ka tung agih hi! Aziehpen tuolthatte ziehin ka hinna agimgawpta hi, chi a “Zion tanu kaa leh mau aw ging ka za hi.”"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem gawlzing tengah suhtai toutai kawi unlen, tuin en unlen, thei un, vai dihtah a hawm a, thutah sui mi khatbeh na mu uoi mah, mun awngte ah sui un, na mu u’leh ka ngaidam ding hi.","title":"Juda khelna"},"2":{"text":"Amaute, “Mangpa hinna louin” kichiem nan u’leh, zuou a kichiem ahibou uhi."},"3":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na mitte thutah tunga tu hilou ahiei mah? Nangman amau na vuo a, hinanleh alunggim sih uhi; amauh na sumanga, hinanleh bawlhoina asang nuom sih uhi; amaitangte uh suongpi sangin atah sah zaw ua, akinuale ut vawt sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin ken, “Tamte mitaga ahi ua, mi mo ahi uh, aziehpen amaun Mangpa lampite athei sih ua, a Pasian uh thukhenna athei sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mi liente kungah va pei vangin, akung uah kava gen ding hi, aziehpen amaun Mangpa lampi leh, a Pasian uh vaihawmna atheita uhi.” Hinanleh tam miten hahkol asutan ua, akolbute uh atansahta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin gammanga hing kipan, humpibahnei in amauh athat dinga, gamgaw a ngia in amauh anegam ding hi; Kamkei in akhopite uh abuh dinga, tua mun akipat a pawtdoh pouma ana eehmal ding hi; aziehpen atatkhielna uh atam a, anuatolna uh apung semsem hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tami ziehin nou bang ka hing chi ngaidam diei? na tate un kei ahing taisanta ua, pasien hiloute min in akichiemta uhi; gilva tah a ka vah nua in, Aang nangkawm san ua, ahon hon in kizuate inn ah akikhawm vapual uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute hoitah a kivah sakoltal hua abang ua, michin a innvengte zi enla in ngeu hua tau abang uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tam silte ziehin amauh ka gawtsih ding amah? Mangpa’n achi hi, tualeh tambang nam tungah phuba kala sih ding amah?"},"10":{"text":"“Aguol a kisuon grep gui lah ah peitou unlen, susie un ahivangin abei den dingin bawl sihun, aba zamte satkhie un, Mangpa a ahi sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Israel innkuonte leh Juda innkuonten, zuoutat in ahing bawl uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaun Mangpa tungtangah zuou agen ua, Aman bangma hing lawsih va, silhoilou zong itung uah tungsih vanin, namsau leh kiel ahiei zong imu sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Guolneite lah huisi bang ahi ua, asung uah bangma thu a um sih hi.
