Tuabangin atung uah akibawl ding hi.”"},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin galkapte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “Tam thu nagen ziehun, Ngaiun, ka thu na kam uah meikuong in ka bawl ding a, tam mite sing toh kibang va un, ka mei kuongin amauh akatum ding hi."},"15":{"text":"En vawi, Israel innkuonte aw, gamlapi a um namkhat noute dou dinga, hing pui ding ka hi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Nam hattah ahi ua, nam lui mama ahi ua, aham uh na theilou u’leh agen uh na theisiemlou uh nam ahi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Athal bawmte uh han kihongsa bang ahi a, amaute abawn un mihat ngen ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amaun, na tapate leh na tanute uh neh ding, na bu na balte uh aneh beipieh ding ua, na belamhonte u’leh na ganhonte uh ahing nehkhawng pieh ding ua, na grepte u’leh na theipite uh ang neh khawng pieh ding uhi. Na muon mama uh khopi kulneite namsau in asuse sieng ding uhi.”"},"18":{"text":"“Hinanleh tuami ni chiengin, ka hing sumang den sih ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh na miten bangdinga, Mangpa i Pasian un tam silte zousie i tung ua abawl adiei? achi hun chiengun Kei nang taisan ua, na gam sung ua pasien dangte, nna nasep pieh mabangun, noua hilou gam ah midangte nna naseppieh ding uhi,” chi’n amauh na dawng ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Jakob innkuonte lah ah phuongzah unlen, Juda gam ah tam thu genzah un."},"21":{"text":"“Nou mimote leh theina neiloute, mit nei napi a muloute, bil nei napi a zaloute tami zaun.","ref":"Isai. 6.9,10; Ezek. 12.2; Mak. 8.18"},"22":{"text":"Kei nang giing sih uh amah? Mangpa’n achi hi. Ka mai ah na chitun sih ding uh amah? Keima’n tuipi alet theilouna ding senel in gamgi ka bawl a, aumden a, tuipi in akaan thei sih hi. Tui kihot in kinawng vutvut in luong nanleh alet thei sih dinga, ging het hut nanleh akaan zou tuom sih ding hi.","ref":"Job. 38.8-11"},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh tam miten Paupenna lungtang leh, helhatna lungsim anei uh, ahel ua a peimangta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Amaun, tuin Mangpa i Pasian uh ahun tah a guo masa leh, guo nukhia hing pepa leh, bu lah hun nipi kaalte hing bawl piehpa, i giing ding uhi alungtang un achi ngai vawt sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"Na gitlounate un tam silte aheimangta hi, Tualeh na khelnate un silhoite nou akipat ahentaangta hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka mite lah ah migiloute a um ua, thangkam miten thang akam ua, abuh dap bang un, mihing matna dingin thang akam uhi."},"27":{"text":"Va bawmsunga, va adima a um bangin, a innte uh zuoubawlna in a dim hi. Tuaziehin ahing thupi ua, ahing khang lienta ua, ahing hausata uhi."},"28":{"text":"Ahing thau ua, ahing mamta uhi; Ahi, migiloute silbawlte akhupkhel uhi, Pa neiloute thu agen pieh sih ua, hinapi alawching zel uhi; tualeh mitasamte dihna ahumbit pieh sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tam silte ziehin amaute ka gawtsih ding amah? Mangpa’n achi hi. Tambang nam tungah keiman phuba ka lasih ding amah?”"},"30":{"text":"Gamsungah lungsimphawng leh, sil chizat huoi akibawlta hi."},"31":{"text":"Guolneiten zuouthu agen ua, siempute’n lah athu thu un vai ahawm uhi, tualeh ka miten lah tambanga bawlte adeilam uh ahi hi; hinanleh atawpna ah bang na bawlta ding uoi leh?"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Oh! nou Benjamin tate aw; Jerusalem akipat taidoh dingin kikhawm unlen, Tekoa ah pengkul mut unlen, tualeh Beth-Hakkerem ah chiemtena meikuong phutdoh un, aziehpen mallam akipat in sietna leh, suhsietna thupitah ahing kuon hi.","title":"Jerusalem sietna"},"2":{"text":"Zion tanu khu numei melhoitah leh noutah toh ka tekahta hi."},"3":{"text":"Belamchingte khu a belamhonte u’toh akungah ahing pei ding ua, akim vel ah apuon innte uh azah ding ua, amauh michin ama uh mun ah akivah ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"“Amanu dou dingin kigalging un, thou un, suntang laiin douvai,” i tunguh gih e, “Nisa lah a kiemsuh ta a, nitah lam ni him asau sem semta hi.”"},"5":{"text":"“Thou un, zan laiin i kuontou ding ua, a leeng innpi huongsung uh isuhsiet pieh ding uhi.”"},"6":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Singte phua unlen, Jerusalem douna dingin muolvum bawl un, tami gawta um ding khopi khu ahi, asung khu kinuoisiena a dim ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tuikhuh in tuite apuldohsah mabangin, aman zong gitlouna apawtdohsah hi. Asungah gummtatna leh kipawngbawlna akiza a, ka masangah lungdon chimawna leh liemnate a um ngitnget hi."},"8":{"text":"Aw Jerusalem, vau hilna ngaisah in, tuachilouin ka hinna in ang pawtsan kha dinga, na gam ka suse dinga, koima tenlouna gam ka hing suohsah kha ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Israel mi umsunte bu sang bangin khonkhawm unlen, grep sang khonte bangin abate na khut un khon sieng un.”"},"10":{"text":"Azah theina ding ua koi kunga thu gen a, koi ahiei vau hilna ka pieh ding? Ngaivawi, abil uh teptanlou bil ahi a, angaikhe thei sih uhi, Ngai in, Mangpa thu khu ama ua dingin simmaw huoi ahi a, kipahna mal mal anei sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa lungthahna in ka dim a, kideh ka chimtah gawpta hi, “Kholai a naupangte tungah leh khanglai kikhawmte, tungah ka sungkhe ding hi; Aziehpen pasal nangawn zong azi toh lahkhawm ahi dinga, tesie kum tam tahte zong ama toh lahkhawm ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh a innte uh midangte kung a pieh ahi dinga, aloute u’leh azite u’tawh piehkhawm ahi ding uhi; aziehpen gamsunga tengte douna in ka khut ka lam ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"13":{"text":"“Aziehpen alah ua aneu pen a kipat alien pen dongin, michin huoihamna ah akipe siengta ua, tualeh guolneite leh siempute tanpha in, michin azuoutat chiet uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amaun ka mite liemna a ngai khoh pieh sih ua, hamuonna umloupi in, hamuonna, hamuonna achi uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 13.10"},"15":{"text":"Sil kidahhuoi abawl chiengun azum uoi leh? Azum vawt sih uhi, kisuon na dan zong athei mawngmawng sih uhi. Tuaziehin apuate lah ah ama u’zong apua ding ua, tua hun chiengin amauh ka gawt dinga, nawkhiet in a um ding uhi,” Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Jer. 8.10-12"},"16":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Lampite ah ding unlen, en un, Lampi lui hoi um na khu dong unlen tua lampi hoi zuiun, Tuachi’n na hagau ua dingin khawldamna na mu ding uhi, ka chi a, hinanleh a maun tua khu ka zui sih ding uhi, achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na tung uah galveng mite zong ka koi a, pengkul ging ngaikhie un, ka chi hi. Hinanleh amaun, ka ngaikhesih ding uh, achi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin namte aw, ngaikhie unlen, mipi kikhawmte aw, atung ua hing tung ding thei un."},"19":{"text":"Aw Leitung ngaikhie in, En in, tam mite tungah angaituona ga uh sietna ka tungsah ding hi, aziehpen amaun ka thute khoh asa sih ua, ka dante zong anuolta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Bang tupna a Sheba a kipat a Panamtui leh, gamlapi akipat a phai hum, hing kipuo adiei? Na halmang sillatte uh kei dingin pomtah ahi sih a, na kithoina sillatte uh kei a dingin anamtui sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: En in, tam mite masangah kipalpuana ding ka koi dinga, Pate leh atapate apua khawm ding ua, a innvengpa leh alawmpa amangthai ding uhi.”"},"22":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “En in, mallam gam a kipat in nam khat ahing kuon dinga, lei ning gamla penpen akipat in, nam thupitah khat ahing dingdoh ding hi, achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaun thalpi leh teipi atawi ding ua, atatsie ua hepina anei sih uhi, a aw uh tuipi ging abanga, sakol tunga tuongin, nangma dou dingin galdou mi bangin akichieng uhi; Aw Zion tanu.”"},"24":{"text":"Amauh tungtanga thu kigen izata ua, ikhutte azawgawp sienga, mangbatna in numei nauvei natna bangin ahing manta hi."},"25":{"text":"Gamlah ah pawtkhe sih unlen, lampi ah zong pei sih un, aziehpen melma in namsau atawi a, mun chin ah dipkuotna a um hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka mite tanute aw, sai ip puon sil unlen vut vai lah ah kilia un, tapa neisun suun bangin, kap in mau vengvung un, aziehpen sumangthaipa itungah thakhata hing tung ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"“Nangpen ka mite lah ah innsang leh, kulpiin ka hing guotta a, a umdan uh na thei a, na et chientheina dingin."},"28":{"text":"Amaute mi phengphi, helhat, migensie a vahkawite ahi ua, sum-eng sie bang ahi ua, abawn un silsie ngen abawl uhi."},"29":{"text":"Pum nasatahin akizap hut hut a, ngentang mei ah azunmang hi, asusiengpa suhsiengna khu amawhna asuoh a, migiloute paimang ahituomlou ziehun."},"30":{"text":"Mangpa’n amaute anuoltah ziehin, miten dangka sia deiloute, achita ding uhi.”"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa akipat a Jeremiah kunga thu hing tung khu;","title":"Gamdang sakhuo tunga Juda khelna"},"2":{"text":"“Mangpa innkotpi ah ding inlen, tuanah tam thu phuongin: Mangpa be dinga tami kotpi a hing lut Juda zousiete aw, Mangpa thu ngaikhie un chiin genin."},"3":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Na umdante u’leh na silbawlte uh siempha un, tuachi’n tam mun ah ka hing tengsah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tamte khu Mangpa biehinn ahi, Mangpa biehinn Mangpa biehinn, Mangpa biehinn tamte ahi, chi a zuouthu kigente tahsang sih un."},"5":{"text":"“Na umdante u’leh na silbawlte uh na siemphat ua, mi khat leh a innveng kikal a, vaihawmna dihtah na bawl u’leh;"},"6":{"text":"Gamdang mite, Pa neiloute leh meithaite, na nuoisie sih ua, mawna neiloute sisan nasuolou ua, nouma kisuhliemna ding bep a gamdang pasiente nua na zui sih pou u’leh;"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam mun ah, na pu napate u’kunga ka pieh gam ah kumtawn in kahing teng densah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“En un, phattuomna neilou zuouthute na tahsang uhi."},"9":{"text":"Na guta un, tuolnathat un, ang na kawm un, zuoua kichiem in, Baal kunga gimnamtui hal in na theingailou uh pasiente nua na zui un;"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka min pua tam inn a, ka mai a hing dingin, tam silkidahhuoite zousie bawl dingin, hutkhiet in iumta uh chi ding na hi uoi mah?"},"11":{"text":"Ka min pua, tami inn na mitmu ua, suomhatte kokhuh hing suoh ahita amah? En un, Keima ngelngel in ka mu ahi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 21.13; Mak. 11.17; Luk. 19.46"},"12":{"text":"Ka min umna dinga ka bawl masah, Shiloh mun ah pei unlen, ka mi Israelte gitlouna zieh a tua mun a ka silbawlte va mu un.","ref":"Josh. 18.1; Late. 78.60; Jer. 26.6"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh tuin tamsilte zousie na bawl ziehun, zingmawng matah a thouin na kung uah thu ka gen a, hinanleh naza nuom sih ua, ka hing hat leh lah nang dawng nuom sih uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin Shiloh tunga ka bawl bangin, ka min pua na muon mama uh tami inn tungah leh noute leh napu napate kunga ka piehsa mun tungah ka bawl ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh na unaute uh Ephraim hahlesuonte zousie ka paidoh bangin, noute zong ka mitmu akipat hing paimang ding ka hi; Mangpa’n achi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tuaziehin tam mite a dingin thungetpieh sinlen, kikou ging ahiei, thungetna ahiei bawl sinlen ka kungah ngetna leh thumna zong bawl sin, ka hing ngaikhe sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Juda khopite leh Jerusalem kholai dunga asil bawlte uh mulou na hiei mah?"},"18":{"text":"Naupangten sing atom ua, apate un mei ataw kuong ua, numeiten van leengnu kunga lat ding tanghou ameh ua, Keima ang suh lungthah theina dingun pasien dangte a dingin dawn sillatte alan uhi.","ref":"Jer. 44.17-19"},"19":{"text":"Kei maw ahing lungthahsah uh? Mangpa’n achi hi; amauleh amauh kimaizumsuona bep hilou ahiei mah?"},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: En un, ka thangpaina, leh lungthahna, tam mun tungah leh mihing leh gamsa tungah tualeh gamlah singte leh leitung a theigate tungah ka sungbo dinga, aka dinga, akiphelmit sih ding hi.”"},"21":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “Na kithoinate uah, na halmang sillatte uh belap unlen, asa ne un!"},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen Izipt gama kipat a napu napate uh ka puidoh niin, halmang sillat ahiei, kithoina tungtang akung uah ka genkha sih a, thupieh zong ka bawl khasih hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh tami ahi ka thupiehte: Ka thu mangun, na Pasian uh ka hi dinga tualeh noute ka mite nahi ding uhi. Tualeh na umdan ding ua ka hing thupiehte zuiun, tuakhu nou a dingin ahoi ding hi, achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh amauten azui utsih ua, abil un zong angaikhe ut sih ua, tuanahsangin a lungtang giloute uh deidan leh ngaituona bangin agamta ua, mailam sawnlouin anuatawn zawta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh Izipt gam akipat ahing pawtdoh ni ua kipat tuni dongin, ka suoh guolneite nichin a matah a thou in na kung uah ka hing sawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun ka thu asang sih ua, abil uzong adaw ut sih ua, angawng uh akhausah ua, apu leh pate uh sangin agilou zawta uhi."},"27":{"text":"“Tuaziehin tam thute zousie akung uah na gen dinga, hinanleh amaun ahing ngaikhe sih ding uhi; amauh na han dinga, hinanleh ahing dawng sih ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n akung uah Mangpa a Pasian uh aw zuilou, bawl hoina zong pom nuomlou, nam ahi uh, na chi dinga; thutah abeimangta a, akam ua pat in satkhieh ahita uhi."},"29":{"text":"Na sam heu inlen, paimangin, tualeh munsang tung kieute ah kaa teng louin awi inlen, aziehpen Mangpa’n athangpaina khangte anuol a, anuasieta hi."},"30":{"text":"“Aziehpen Juda taten ka mitmu ah silgilou abawlta uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Ka mina kihan innsung suhbuana dingin silkidahhuoi, milimte atungdohta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh ka lungsim a ka gelkhah ngailou leh thu ka pieh khahlou, atapate u’leh atanute uh mei a halna dingin, Hinnom tapa guom a um Tophet mun ah munsangte alam uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.10; Jer. 32.35; Siempu. 18.21"},"32":{"text":"Tuaziehin ngai un, nite hing tung ding ahita, Mangpa’n achi hi. Tam mun pen Tophet akichi nawn sih ding a, Hinnom tapa guom zong akichi nawn sih dinga, kithana guom akichizawta ding hi, aziehpen mun dang aum nawnlou masangsie Tophet ah avui ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tam mite mishi luongte khu tungleeng vate leh leitunga gamsate ann neh ahita dinga, koiman amaute aheumang zou sih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda khopite apat leh Jerusalem gawlzingte apat in, lungnopna leh kipahna husate tualeh mouneipa leh mounu lungdam awte ka tawpsahta ding hi; aziehpen gam luolou a segawp ding ahi.","ref":"Jer. 16.9; 25.10; Kihil. 18.23"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tua hun chiengin Mangpa’n achi hi, Juda leengpate gute, amiliente gute, siempute gute, zawlneite gute leh Jerusalem a tengte gute ahankhuh ua kipat in ahing ladoh ding uhi."},"2":{"text":"Tualeh a it uh, ana ana seppieh uh, anua azuiuh, asui u’leh abieh uh, ni leh haleh van a um zousie masangah akipha ding ua, akilakhawm nawn sih ding ua, akivui sih ding uhi, tualeh leitung masang ah eeh bang giap ahita ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka delmangna mun aum tam innkuon gilouten hin sangin shi atel zaw ding uhi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"4":{"text":"“Tuathamlouin, amaute kungah, Mangpa’n tambangin thu agen hi: Mi apua leh thoukia lou dinguh amah? Mi apielmang chiengun, hing kinuale kia lou dinguh amah? na chi ding hi.","title":"Juda khelna leh gawtna"},"5":{"text":"Ahileh bangdinga, Jerusalem mite kumlekhua a nuatol den ata uoi leh? Lepchiena atukip ua, hing nuakia ut nawnlou uh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ke’n ka ngaikhie a, kaza hi, hinanleh amaun thudih agen sih uhi. Agitlouna ua pat koima akisia utsih ua, bang ka bawl ngel ei? achi uhi. Michin ama lampi chiet ah akihei ua, sakol kidouna phuol lam del abang uhi."},"7":{"text":"Vanlai a tuivapi nangawn in ahunbi kiguotte athei a, vakhu leh tuiva tualeh sielpaleeng in ahing tun hun uh athei uhi. Hinanleh ka miten Mangpa vaihawmna athei sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Bangchidan a, kapil uhi, Mangpa dan ka kung uah a um hi nachi thei uh ahiei mah? En un, laigiel miten laikung zuou thei azang ua zuou thumal agiel uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mipilte azum ua, alungdong ua, mat in aum uhi. En un, amaun Mangpa thu adeisih ua, tuachi’n ama uah bang pilna a um ei?"},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin azite uh midangte kungah ka pe dinga, tualeh aloute uh aluo ding mite kungah ka pe ding hi. Aziehpen aneupen akipat alien leh thupipen dongin, michin abawn un punna dei a enna leh, huoihamna ah akipe siengta uhi. Zawlneite leh siempute na ngawn azuoutat chiet uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amaun ka mite tanute liemna awlmawlou tahin athoi ua, hamuonna umloupi, hamuonna, hamuonna, achi uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 13.10"},"12":{"text":"Sil kidahhuoi abawl chiengun azum uoi mah? Zumlou uh, zumna mawngmawng anei sih ua, zalatdan zong athei vateh sih uhi. Tuaziehin apuate lah ah atel ding ua, gawt a aum ni chiengun, amaute paikhieh ahita ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Jer. 6.12-15"},"13":{"text":"Pellou in amauh ka sumang ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Grepgui ah grepga a um sih dinga, theipi kunga ah zong theipiga a um sih ding hi; anate avuoi dinga, tualeh akung ua ka silpiehte ama ua kipat in ka lamang ding hi.”"},"14":{"text":"Bangdinga daptou ihi uoi? Hing kikhawm unlen khopi kulpineite ah lut vaiin, khunah sip khinkhian va ui. Aziehpen Mangpa i Pasian un, sip khin khian dingin ahing koita a, Mangpa tunga ikheltah ziehun, dawn dingin gu tui ahing peta hi."},"15":{"text":"Hamuonna ding isui ua, hinanleh silhoi bangma ahing tung sih hi, Damna hun ikineppi vangin buoina ahingtung hi."},"16":{"text":"“Asakol nahging Dan akipat in akiza a, asakol hattahte uh ham gingin gamsung pumpi achitun sah hi. Aziehpen ahing tung ua gam leh asunga um zousie, khopi leh asunga tengte netum dingin ahing pei uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ngai vawi, khawizuol theilou gulte leh, gulgukhate na lah uah kang sawl ding a, ahing tu ding uhi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka dana tunga kei leh kei kihamuon ka tup chiengin, ka lungtang ka sung ah aba gawp hi.","title":"Juda tunga Jeremiah kaalate."},"19":{"text":"Gamlapi a kipat a ka mite tanute kaa awging khu, ngaiun, “Zion ah Mangpa umlou amah? Asungah aleengpa umlou amah?” “Bangdinga amilim siemthute u’leh, agamdang milimte utoh ang lungthahsah uh ahiei mah?”"},"20":{"text":"“Bu lah hun akikhelta a, nipi abeita, Eite lah hundam in ium sih nalai lai uhi!”"},"21":{"text":"Ka mite tanute liemna khu, kei liemna ahi. Ka suuna, chizatna in ahing manta hi."},"22":{"text":"Gilead ah singnai damdawi umlou ahiei mah? khunah sudamthei mi a umsih amah? Ahileh bangdinga ka mite tanute liemna khu, damdoh theilou ahiei?"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Oh! ka lutang tuikhuh hihenlen, ka mit hituite tuinah hileh aw, tha a um ka mite tanute asun azan a, ka kaa theina dingin.","title":"Juda khansietna"},"2":{"text":"Gamdai ah khuolbuh neita maileng aw, ka mite nuasie a, peisan thei ding hi vengin. Azieh pen amauh abawn un, angkawm hatmi ahi ua, solhat mihon um khawm ahibou uhi."},"3":{"text":"A thalpite uh kap dinga a loibang un, aleite uh zuou gen dingin azang uhi. Leitungah thutah adingin ahangsan sih uhi. Silhoilou khat akipat silhoilou dang khat abawl ua, Kei ahing theisih uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Michin a innvengte chiet lah ah pilvang henlen, aunaupa koima khat zong tahsang sih heh, aziehpen unau chinteng mi solhat ngen ahi ua, innveng chinteng zong migensiet hatte toh avah kawi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Michin in a innvengte chiet uh asol ua, thudih agen sih uhi, alei uh zuouthu gen ding dan ahilta ua, gitlouna bawl dingin akisugim gawpta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Na tenna khu solhatte lah ahi a, solna ziehin kei ahing thei utsih uhi; Mangpa’n achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; “Ngai un, ka halsieng dinga, tualeh amauh ka enchien ding hi, Ka mite tanute ziehin bang chin ka bawlta diei?"},"8":{"text":"Aleite uh thaltang kikapdoh bang ahi a, zuouthu agen uhi, mi khat in a innvengpa kungah, kilemna thu gen nanleh alungtangah ama abuh dap ngitnget hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam silte ziehin amauh gawtlou ding ka hiei mah? Mangpa’n achi hi. Tambang namte tungah phuba ka lasih ding amah?"},"10":{"text":"“Muol leh taangte adingin kap in ka mau dinga, gamdai a lou dawnna munte, suun in kaateng lou in ka awi dinga, aziehpen koima pei khah thei nawnlouna dingin akatumta uhi, Ganta ham aw ging miten aza nawn sih ding ua, tungleeng vate leh gamsate zong, ataizahta ua, apeimang siengta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Jerusalem khu silsie kikoikhawmna vum leh, si-alte kuo in ka bawl ding a, tualeh Juda khopite khu ateng ding umlou, ahawmguoh ka suohsah ding hi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tami theisiem ding mipil koi ahiei? Tualeh aphuonzah theina dinga, Mangpa kam in akunga thu agenna mi khu koi ahiei mah? Bangzieh a gam mangthai gawpa, koima peithei nawnlouna dinga gamdai banga kahtum sieng atai?"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n, “Amaute masanga ka koi ka dan ataisan ziehun, ka thu amang sih ua, zui zong azui sih uhi, achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh amauh lungtang ngaituona bangin agamta ua, apu apate un ana hil uh Baal nua azui zawta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: En un, tam mite gamsai in ka vah dinga, tualeh tuikha ka dawnsah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama u’leh apu apate un athei khah ngailou uh namte lah ah ka thethang dinga, ka suhmang sieng masangsie’n namsau in ka nuadel sah ding hi.”"},"17":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Ngaituo unlen, kap leh mau a suun dingin, numei kapsiemte hankhawm un,"},"18":{"text":"Amaute hing kinaw u’henlen, imitte ua hitui aluona, imitvunte un hitui ahing luondoh sah theina dingun, eite adingin kap leh mau in sun uhen."},"19":{"text":"Zion akipat in ka leh mauna aw ging akiza hi: Bangchi tuha suhsiet ihita uoi! Aziehpen igam uh inuasieta ua, itenna munte ua kipat a nawdoh ihita ziehun.”"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh, Numeite aw Mangpa thu ngaikhie un, Akam a thupawt na bil uah lut henlen, na tanute uh kaala hil un, tualeh michin in a innveng kaa leh mau dan zilsah uhen."},"21":{"text":"I kottate ah shina ahing lutta a, i leeng inn huong sungah alutta hi. Khopi gawlzingte a naupangte that ding leh, kholaidungte atangvalte sattan dingin."},"22":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin gen in achi hi: Mishiluongte gamlah ah sil deilou, kipaite bangin alum ding ua, bu atte nua a buphaite abang ding ua, koiman akhawm sih ding hi,” chiin gen in achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Mipil in apilna suong sih henlen, mihat in ahatna suong sih heh, tualeh mihausa in zong ahausatna suong sih heh."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh asuong pouma in tami suong heh: Kei Mangpa khu itna hepinate, adiha vaihawmnate dihtatnate leitunga bawl zing. Mangpa kahi chi ahing thei u’leh, tua theisiemna khu ka kipahna ahi,” Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 1.31; 2 Kor. 10.17"},"25":{"text":"“Ngai un, nite hing tung ding ahita, Mangpa’n achi hi: teptan himel a teptanloute banga umte zousie kagawt ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Iziptte, Judate, Edomte, Ammon tate leh Moabte leh gamdai ningkawi gamla tawpa teng namte zousie teptanlou ahi ua, tualeh Israel innkuonte zousie zong lungtanga teptanlou ahi uhi.”"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel innkuonte aw, Mangpa’n na kung ua athugen ngaikhie un.","title":"Pasian leh milim pasiente"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Namdangte umdan zui sih unlen, van a chiemtenate ziehin lungke sih un, Aziehpen namte amauh ziehin alungkie uhi."},"3":{"text":"Namte tawndan ngainate bangmalou ahi bou hi, amaun gamlah a singte ava phua ua, heipi toh mi khutsiemten singmilim akheng uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua sing milim dangka leh sana in azem ua, akitatloh louna dingin sehta in siakilna toh akildet uhi."},"5":{"text":"Muisum sing bangin pielou in a ding ua; Hinanleh, aham theisih ua, apei theilou ziehun, puoh kawi kawi angai hi. Amauh giing sih un, silhoilou abawl thei sih ua, silhoi zong abawl thei sih uhi.”"},"6":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangma bang koima a um sih hi, Nang na thupi a, na min zong hatna in athupi hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma hing giinglou ding koi ahiei, Aw namte leengpa? Tami na tan ding mawng ahi, aziehpen namte laha mipilte zousie leh, a leenggam pumpi sung uah zong, Nangma bang koima a umsih hi.","ref":"Kihil. 15.4"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute pen lungtang thasie leh mimo ahi ua, sing milim khu akithuhilna uh phatuomlou ahi."},"9":{"text":"Dangka sia kikheng pehte Tarshish apat in ahing pua ua, tualeh Uphaz apat in sana, khutsiemte nasep leh sana khengte khut suoh ahing puo ua; Puon dum leh asandup in azem ua, tuate zousie mikhutsiemte nasep ngen ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa khu Pasian dihtah ahi a, Ama khu Pasian Hing leh kumtawn Lengpa ahi. Alungthah chiengin leitung akiling dinga, namten alungthahna athuoh zou sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tambangin akung uah nagen ding uhi: “Lei leh vante siem theilou pasiente khu, leitung leh vante nuoi akipat amangthai sieng ding uhi.”"},"12":{"text":"Aman Avangletna in leitung abawl a, Ama’n apilna in khovel aphutdet hi. Tualeh atheisiemna in vante azahkhie hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama’n aw asuo chiengin vante ah tui tampite a umsah a, tui meite kawlmong akipat in akaitou sah hi, guozuhna dingin tun aphesah a, agoubawmte akipat in hui alaangsah hi."},"14":{"text":"Michin theina neilou in amawl ua, sana kheng chinteng amilim khen in azumsah hi, aziehpen amilim sunthaw khu kisolna ahibou hi, ama uah nahna hu a umsih hi."},"15":{"text":"Bangmalou ahi ua bawlkhelna nasep ahi giep uhi, gawt a aum hun chiengun amangthai siengding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Jakob tanvou khu ama ubang ahisih, aziehpen Ama sil zousie siempa ahi, Israel khu agoutan nam ahibou hi; Galkapte Mangpa Amin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nou kulpisunga imkhum a umte aw, gamsung akipat in na puonlomte uh lakhawm un."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, “En un, tu hun in gamsunga tengte zousie ka paikhe dinga, atheitham ding un ka gentheisah ding hi.”"},"19":{"text":"Ka liemna ziehin ka tung agih hi, ka liemna khu anase mama hi, hinanleh ken, “Adihtahin tampen kei a dinga gawtna khat ahi, ka thuoh teitei ding ahi,” ka chi hi.","title":"Bawl hoina ding a Jeremiah thumna"},"20":{"text":"Ka puon inn suhsietin a umta a, ka khaute atan siengta; ka tate kei apat apeimang siengta ua, a um nawn sih uhi. Ka puon inn hing zah pieh kia ding leh, ka puon zahte hingkhai pieh ding koima aumta sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen Belamchingte alungmawl siengta ua, Mangpa suidan athei sih uhi. Tuaziehin alawching thei sih ding ua, abelamhonte uh akithethang ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ngai un, mallam akipat in buoina thusie, thawmging ahing tung a! Juda khopite luo loua koi a, si-alte umna suohsah ding in."},"23":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, mihing umdan pen ama ah aum sih chi ka thei hi. Mihingin ama kalsuon dingte akipui thei sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Aw Mangpa, hing sudihin, hinanleh vaihawmna dih in, na lungthahnain vang hilou in, tuachilouin bangmalou na hing suo kha ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Nang hing theikhalou namte tungleh, namin loukha ngailou namte tungah, na lungthahna sungbuo in; aziehpen amaun Jakob anetumta ua, apumval ua anegam siengta ua, atenna gam uh asuhsiet pieh ua, tenna giehnalou asuoh sahta uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa akipat a Jeremiah kunga thu hing tungin:","title":"Thuhun palsietna"},"2":{"text":"“Tami thuhun thute ngai unlen, Juda mite kung leh Jerusalem a tengte kungah gen un; achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh akung uah gen inlen, Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi, tam thuhun thute zuilou mi khu samsiet in um heh, chi’n gen in."},"4":{"text":"Tua thu khu: Izipt gam a sia haltuina meilipi akipat a napu napate uh ka puidoh ni a ka thugente mang unlen, na kung ua ka hing thupiehte dungzui in bawl un, tuachi’n Ka mite nahi ding ua, Kei na Pasian uh kahi ding hi, ka chi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachia, napu napate u’kunga tuni a banga, nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam pieh dinga kana kichiemna tangtung sah ding kahi,” achi hi, chiin gen in, achi hi. Tuachi’n “Ken hiheh Mangpa” chiin ka dawng hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah: “Tam thute zousie Juda khopite leh Jerusalem gawlzing tengah phuongzah inlen, tam thuhun thute ngaikhie unlen, bawl un, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen Izipt gam a kipata ka puidoh ni akipat tuni dongin, Ka aw ngaikhie un chi’n matah a thou in, phatuomngai tahin, napu napate uh kungah thuhil kawm in ka phuut zing hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun amang sih ua, abil u’zong adaw sih uhi, tua nahsangin michin in amauh lungtang gilou ngaituona uh azuita zawsop uhi; tuaziehin, akung ua bawl dinga ka pieh thuhun thute zousie atung uah ka tungsah ding ka chi a, hinanleh amaun abawl sih uhi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Juda mite lah leh Jerusalem atengte lah ah aguh a thuphielna a um hi, achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka thu ngaikhe nuomlou, apu leh pate uh khelna lam ah akinua heita ua, ana uh seppieh dingin pasien dangte nua azuita uhi; Israel innkuonte leh Juda innkuonten, apulepate utoh ka bawl ka thuhun abawtseta uhi, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: apel thei guollou uh sietna amaute tungah ka tungsah ding hi. Kei hing han nan u’leh ka ngaikhe sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachiengin Juda khopite leh Jerusalem a tengte apei ding ua, gimnamtui hal a alatna uh pasiente kungah akikou ding ua, hinanleh, tuaten abuoi hun chiengun ahundam thei mawngmawng sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aw Juda, na khopi uh tam dungzuiin na pasiente u’zong atam zel hi, tualeh Jerusalem gawlzing tamdan dungzui in, pasien zum huoi Baal kunga gimnamtui halna maitam na daw uhi."},"14":{"text":"“Tuaziehin tam mite adingin thungetpieh sinlen, ama ua dingin thumna ahiei thungetna ahiei zong nei sin, abuoi chieng ua ahing hatna uh dawnglou ding ka hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi tampite toh silkidahhuoi bawl khawm in, ka itpen in ka inn ah bang bawl ding ahiei anei? Tahsa siengthou nanga kipat apei suohta chi thei in, sil hoilou na bawl chiengin na kipah deu deu hi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa’n na min dingin Olive sing hing hoitah leh ga hoi, ahing chi hi. Hinanleh buoina nasatah thawmging toh atungah, mei ataw kuonga abate atawng siengta hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel innkuonte leh Juda innkuonten gitlouna abawl ua, Baal mai a gimnamtui hal a, ahing lungthah sah ziehun, galkapte Mangpa nang hing phutpa’n, na tunga sietna hing tung ding aphuongdohta hi.”"},"18":{"text":"Tuin Mangpa’n tam thu kei ahing theisah a, ka thei hi, tuachi’n nangman asil bawlte uh na hing musah hi.","title":"Anathoth miten Jeremiah atha sawm uh"},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh keipen gaw dinga kikai belamnou bang ka hi a, Kei hing tha sawm uh ahilam ka phawhkha sih hi. Amauten: “Sing kung khu aga pum in sumang vaiin, amin kithei nawn louna dingin mihing gam akipat ama satkhe vai,” akichi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw galkapte Mangpa, Nang dihtattah a vaihawmpa sunggil lam leh, lungtang enchien zelpa, atung ua na phulahna hing musah in, Na kungah ka tungthu ka hing sulangta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin “Ka khut ua na shi louna dingin, Mangpa min in thu gen sin” chia, na hing sui Anathoth mite tungtang Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Ngai un, amauh ka gawt dinga, tangvalte namsau in ashi ding ua, atapate u’leh atanute uh kiel in ashi ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh ashimawh umsun chi mawng mawng a umsih ding uhi; aziehpen Anathoth mite tungah sil hoilou hing tungsah ding ka hi, akigawtna ding uh kum ngei in.”"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na kunga, ka phun in zong Nang na dihtat hi; hinanleh na vaihawmna thu ah nang hing houpi vang. Bangziah a migiloute gamtatna lawching ahiei? Bangzieh a lepchietah a sil bawlte kipah ahi uoi?","title":"Jeremiah phunna Pasian in adawnna"},"2":{"text":"Nang amauh na suon a, tuachi’n hui aha ua, akhang uhi, Ahi, ga ahing asuong ta uhi. Akam uah nanai a, alungsim uah na gamla hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Mangpa, Nangman kei nahing thei a, nahing muta a, Ka lungtang nangma lam ah na enchien zel hi. Gaw ding belamte bangin amauh kaidoh inlen, gawna ni a dingin amauh guolsain koi in."},"4":{"text":"Gam sungin bangtan vei suun dinga, lougam mun tenga hampate bangtan vei vuoi ding ahiei? Asunga tengte gitlouna ziehin, gamsate leh vate amangthai sieng ua, “Amaun itawpna ni ding ama’n amu sih ding hi,” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"“Kenga pei mite toh na kitaidem a, gim nakisah leh, bangchidan a sakol toh kitaidem thei ding na hiei? Tualeh muonna leh bitna gam a, bawn ahing gimsah u’leh, Jordan gammang nuoi ah bang na chita ding ahei?","title":"Pasian dawnna"},"6":{"text":"Na unaute leh na pa innkuonpite, nangawn in lepchietah in ahing bawlta uhi; Ahi, amaun kikou in ahing nuadel uhi. Na kungah thuhoi gennan u’leh tahsang sin.”"},"7":{"text":"“Ka inn ka taisanta a, Ka nei kalamteng ka nuasieta hi; ka hinna in a it angaipen amelmate khut ah ka peta hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka goutan khu kei adingin, gamlah a humpibahnei bang ahing hita a, ahing ngih khum a tuaziehin ka mudata hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka goutan khu kei adingin langta pawl bang ahia, akimvel a um langta dangten ama a dou uh, bang hitalou ahiei amah? pei unlen gamsa zousie amauh negam dingin khawm un."},"10":{"text":"Belamchingmi tampiten ka grep huon asuseta ua, amaun ka satan akengtaw un atuonchilta uhi; ka tanvou deitah khu gamdai gamkieu asuohsahta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amaun asusegawpta ua gamsie asuohta a, ka kungah akap hi; gam pumpi asegawpta, koiman lungsim in aveina sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Gamdai munsang kieu zousie tungah susemite ahing tunga, Mangpa namsau in anehtum ding ziehin, gam tawp langkhat akipat, alelam gam tawp donga mi koiman muonna anei sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Bu atu ua, hinanleh ling ga a at uhi, Ama u’leh amauh akisugim mama ua, hinanleh bangma alemlaw sih uhi. Mangpa lungthahna chizat huoi ziehin, na gasuote uah zumna muva u’teh,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: ka mi Israelte kunga ka luosah goutan khoikha ka innveng giloute zousie tungah, “Ngai un agam ua pat in ka botdoh ding a, alah ua pat in Juda innkuonte ka botdoh ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n tambang ahi ding a, amauh ka bawdoh nua chiengin, ka hing kinuahei kia dinga, atung uah lainatna ka nei dinga, michin agam u’leh agouluona mun chiet uah, ka nua pui kia ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh tambang a hing hi ding: Baal kunga ka mite kichiem azilsah mabang ua ka min siel a, Mangpa ahing hi chia, kichiem akizilsah ua, ka mite umdan pilvangtah a azilsah u’leh, ka mite lah ah tunding in a um ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh thu amansih u’leh vang, tua thumanglou nam khu ka phungkal dinga, ka sumang ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.”"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin ka kungah agen hi: “Pei inlen puonmalngat a kibawl kawnggah khat lei inlen, na kawngah gah inlen, tui lah ah koisin.”","title":"Puonmalngat kawngah"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu dungzuiin, kawnggah khat ka lei a, ka kawng ka gahta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thu ka kungah ani veina ahing tung a,"},"4":{"text":"“Na kawnggah lei, na kawnga na gah khu tawi inlen, thou inlen, Euphrates lui ah pei inlen, suongpi hawm sung khat ah va phuol in,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ahing thupieh dungzuiin kava pei a, Euphrates luipi gei ah kava phuolta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh ni tampi nua in hichi ahing hi a, Mangpa’n ka kungah thu agen a, “Thou inlen Euphrates lui ah pei inlen, khuna phuol dinga thu ka hing pieh kawnggah khu, khuna kipat in valadoh in,” a chi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Euphrates lui ah ka peita a, ka tou doh a, ka phuolna mun apat in kawnggah ka ladohta a, tualeh kawnggah khu ana ngot siengta a, bangmain akimang thei nawn sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,"},"9":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Tambangmain Juda kiletsahna leh Jerusalem kithupisahna ka suse ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka thute ngaikhe nuomlou tam nam gilouten amauh lungsim ngaituona banga gamta a, pasien dangte nuazui a, ana uh seppiehte khu phattuomna neilou tam kawnggah bang ahi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen kawnggah khu mihing kawnga abel chinten bangin, Israel innkuon pumpi leh Juda innkuon pumpi, ka mite hi ding leh, ka minthanna, ka pahtawina leh ka thupina ahi theina dingun, ka kunga bel chinten dingin ka bawl a, hinanleh amaun angaikhe nuom sih uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tuaziehin amaute kungah tam thu nagen ding ahi: Israelte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “Tuithawl chinteng ah zu akithal dim ding ahi.” Tualeh amaun na kungah, tuithawl chinteng ah zu akithal dim ding chi ka thei sih uh amah? achi ding uhi.","title":"Savun zuthawlte"},"13":{"text":"Tuachiengin nang akung uah, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, na chi ding hi: Ngai un, tam gamsunga teng zousie, David leengtoupha tunga tou leengpa ngel leh siempute, guolneite leh Jerusalem a tengte zousie zukhamna in ka dimsah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh amauh khat leh khat ka tattuo dinga, pa leh atate nangawn ka sutuo ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Amaute ka hepi sih dinga, ka hinkhawi sih dinga, ka khotuo vawt sih dinga ka suse zaw ding hi.”"},"15":{"text":"Bil dawin ngaiun, Kiliensah sih un, Mangpa’n thu agenta hi.","title":"Sal taang ding a vauna"},"16":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian u’kungah thupina pie un, mielna ahing tunsah masangin, taang miel tunga na kengte uh akipal pua masangin, Vah mu ding na kinep laitah un, Aman shina lim asuohsah a, miel satah in abawlta hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh na ngaikhieh nuom sih u’leh, na kiletsahna ziehun ka hinna aguh in akap dinga, ka mitte a hitui luong zungzungin hasetah in ka kap ding hi, aziehpen Mangpa belam honte sal a puimang in aumta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Lengpa leh leengnu kungah gen in, “Kingai ngiem unlen, tou suhun aziehpen na vaihawmna uh kise ding ahita a, na thupina leenglukhu uzong nalutung ua pat ke ding ahi.”"},"19":{"text":"Simlam khopite kha in a um dinga, Koiman ahong sih ding hi. Judate sal a puimangin a um ding ua, abawn un sal a puimangin a um ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Dahtou unlen, sahlang akipat a hing peite en un. Nangman hing kipie na belam hon, kilawm mamate hei a um uh atai le?"},"21":{"text":"Aman ahing gawt hun chiengin bang na genta diei? Aziehpen nangman amaute khu, na tunga lamkai leh houtu a pang dingin na hilta hi, gimna in numei nauvei bangin ahing man sih ding amah?"},"22":{"text":"Na lungsim a bang zieh a tambang silte ka tunga hing tung ahiei? nachi khah leh, na gitlouna uh athupi seng zieh a, na nihten kihawhkhie a, zumna lientah na tuoh ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ethiopia miin avun aheng thei diei? ahisihleh gielbem in agiel aheng thei diei? Tuachi’n nou silgilou bawl zongsangten zong, silhoi bawl thei tuomlou nahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin gamdai huiin bushi amut leeng bangin, amauh ka thethang ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tami nahaitan uh, nou a dinga atuoma ka hing te pieh, kei apata na satan uh ahi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Kei na hing manghiltah ziehun zuouthu na tahsangta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin keiman na maitang dongin, na nih ka lemtou dinga, tuachi’n na za maw akilang ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Na angkawmnate uh, ngeu hua tau na bah koinate uh, huasantah a na kizuanate, muol tungte a nasil kidah huoi bawlte uh ka muta hi. Aw Jerusalem na tung agih hi! Tutan chienga zong kisusieng lou ding na mah?”"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khikhal ding tungtanga Jeremiah kunga Mangpa thu hing tung khu:","title":"Khokhal kiel leh namsau"},"2":{"text":"“Juda in asuun a, akulkotpite anguita hi; Gamsung suun in kap in amau ua, Jerusalem kaa aw ging azamtou hi."},"3":{"text":"A miliente un anaupangte uh tui sui dingin asawl ua, tuikhuh ah ava pei ua, tui amu sih uhi. Abel hawm utoh ang kinuale kia uhi; azum ua, alungdong ua, akilukhu uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen lei akhikhang a, gamsunga guo azuhlou zieh in, louhoumite ahing zumta ua, akilukhuta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi, Sakhiten gamlah ah nou anei ua, hinanleh loupa a umlou ziehin anuasieta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh gam sabiltungte munsang kieute ah ading ua, si-alte bangin huikhuo anam vutvut ua, loupa a umlou ziehin amit uh avaita hi."},"7":{"text":"“Aw Mangpa ka khelnate un hing heh nanleh, na min ziehin tami bawl in, aziehpen ka nuatolna uh atam sengta a, na tungah ka khielta uhi.","title":"Jeremiah thungetna masa pen"},"8":{"text":"Aw Israelte kinepna, mangbat hun chieng ua Hundampa, Bangzieh a gamsunga mikhuol banga, zan khat bep taam ding khuolzin mi bang na hiei mah?"},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh a mi lungkegawp bang leh, hundam zoulou mihat bangmai na hiei mah? Hinanleh aw Mangpa nang ka lah uah na um a, Koute na min a kihante ka hi ua, hing nuasie vawt sin.”"},"10":{"text":"Mangpa’n tam mite kungah tambangin agen hi: “Amauten tambanga vahvai a ut ua, akalsuon uh akideh zousih uhi. Tuaziehin Mangpa’n amauh a pom thei sih a, Tuin Aman agitlouna uh athei ngitnget ding a, akhelnate uh agawt ding hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kung ah “Tam mite hoina dingin thungen sin, ang chi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ann angawl chiengun akikou uh ka ngaikhe sih dinga, halmang sillat leh ann sillat alat chieng un ka pomsih ding hi. Hinanleh amaute, namsau in, kielin tualeh natna hi in ka thatgam ding hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ken, “Eh, Mangpa Pasian, ngaiin, guolneiten akung uah namsau na mu sih ding ua, kiel zong na thuoh sih ding uh, hinanleh tam munah, Lungmuonna ka hing pe ding hi,” chiin ahil uhi, ka chi hi.","title":"Jeremiah thunget niveina"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Guolneiten ka min in zuou thu agen uhi. Ken amauh ka sawl sih a, thu ka pekha sih a, akung uah thu zong ka genkha sih hi; Amaun na kung uah kilahna dihloute leh dawi aisante leh silphatuomlou leh alungtang lepchienate uh agen zaw uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n ka min a thugen guolneite leh ka sawl zong hiloupi a, namsau leh kiel tam mun ah atung sih ding chi a gente tungtang tambang in agen hi; Namsau leh kiel in tua guolneite thagam ahi ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua athugen lawhna mite uh khu, kiel leh namsau ziehin Jerusalem gawlzingte ah paidoh in a um ding ua, ama u’leh azite uh, atapate u’leh atanute uh hitaleh avui ding koima a um sih ding hi, aziehpen agitlouna uh atung ua sungbaw ding ka hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tuaziehin tam thute akung ua nagen ding ahi: Ka mit ah hituite sun leh zan in luong henlen, khawl sih uhen. Aziehpen ka mite tanu nungah siengthou khu, nasatah a vuoh leh liemna thuoh in aumta hi."},"18":{"text":"Gamlah a ka pawtdoh leh en vawi, namsau a kithatte a um ua, Khopi sunga ka lut le lah, En vawi, kiel zieha chinate a um uhi! Ahi, guolnei hiin siempu hileh, ani un athei ngailou uh gam ah avahvai uhi.”"},"19":{"text":"Juda pum dei a deilou na hita amah? Na hinna in Zion akidah mawngmawng ahita amah? Bangdinga suhdam theilou khop a koute hing vuo na hiei mah? Kouten muonna ka lam en ua, silhoi lah hing tung lou a, damna hun lam en unga, buoina bou a um hi.","title":"Jeremiah thunget thumveina"},"20":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka gitlouna u’leh ka pu leh pate uh, khelnate ka hing phuong uhi, aziehpen na tungah ka khielta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Na min ziehin hing muda sinlen, na thupina leengtoupha suminse sin. Hing thei zing inlen Koute toh na thuhun suse sin."},"22":{"text":"Namte pasiente lah ah guo zusah thei a um eimah? ahisihleh vanten guopi akaisah thei uoi mah? Aw Mangpa ka Pasian uh nang khu, ama hilou na hiei mah? Tuaziehin nang ma ka hing ngah ding uhi, aziehpen nangman tam silte zousie, na bawl ahi bou hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah: “Mosi leh Samuel ka mai ah dingnan u’leh, ka lungtang tam mite langah akihei tuom sih ding, ka muphahlouna ah amauh deldoh inlen, peimang uhen.","title":"Juda tunga Pasian lungthahna","ref":"Pawt. 32.11-14; Kisim. 14.13-19; 1 Sam. 7.5-9"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi dinga, amaun na kunga hei a pei ding kahi uoi achi u’leh, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, chi’n hil in. “Koi zong natna ashi dingte natna shina ah, namsau a shi dingte namsau kungah, Kiel a shi dingte kiel kung ah, sal a mat dingte sal ah,” achi hi, chi in.","ref":"Kihil. 13.10"},"3":{"text":"“Tualeh amaute tungah sil li ka guotpieh ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi: A that dingin namsau, atawmang dingin uite, negam ding leh suse ding in tungleeng vate leh leitunga gamsate."},"4":{"text":"Keima’n ama u’khu Juda leengpa Hezekiah tapa Manassehin Jerusalem a asilbawl ziehin leitung leenggam zousie a koimang ding in ka bawl ding hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 21.1-16; 2 Khang. 33.1-9"},"5":{"text":"“Aw Jerusalem koi ahiei na tunga khotuona neiding? Ahisihleh koiin ahing suun diei? Ahisihleh koi ahiei bang nachi ei, chia dong dinga hing kihei ding?"},"6":{"text":"Na hing nuasieta, na nuatolta hi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Tuaziehin na tungah ka khut ka ha dinga, kang suse ding hi; kisia ka chimtahta hi."},"7":{"text":"Khum gam a kulpi kotkhate ah zapsiengna in ka zapdinga, Atate uh ka lahpieh ding a, ka mite ka sumang ding hi, a umdan ua pat ahing kinua heikia lou ziehun."},"8":{"text":"Ameithaite uh ka kungah, tuipi pieunel sanga tamzawin ka pungsah dinga, suntang laiin tanvalte nu tungah susetu ka tung sah ding a, amaute tungah lunggimna leh zauna, chizat huoitah thakhatin ka tungsah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ta sagi neinu thazoi in apua a, anah hu atawpta hi, sunlai hinapi amanu adingin ni atumta hi, zum leh zalain a umta hi; asuohta umsunte, amelmate uh masangah, namsau a tha dingin ka pekhe ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka dei nu ka tung agih hi, gam pumpi kihauna leh, kinielna mi dinga nangna neikhah ka hi ta. Apung in koima ka leitawisah sih a, Apung in koima leiba kaba sih hi, hinanleh abawn un ahing hamsiet chiet uhi.","title":"Pasian in Jeremiah ahantawhna"},"11":{"text":"Mangpa’n, adihtahin na mi umsunte a dingin ahoi ding hi, pellouin sietna hun leh suhgentheina hunin, na melmate na kungah ka kitulutsah ngei ngei ding hi, achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi’n sia mallam sia leh sum-eng akuoitan zou ding adiei?"},"13":{"text":"“Na gamsung pumpi a na khelna ziehin, na hausatna leh na goute amanbei a gallah dingin ka pe ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na melmate toh na thei ngailou gam ah, ka hing peisah ding hi, aziehpen ka lungthahna na tunga ka dingin, mei khat akuongdoh ta hi.”"},"15":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nang na thei hi; Hing thei ngitnget inlen hing ve inlen, kei hingbawlsete tungah phuba hing lahpiehin, Na thuoh hatna apat in kei hing lamang sinlen, Nangma zieh a selphouna tuoh kahi lam hing thei in."},"16":{"text":"Na thute mukhiet ahi a tualeh ka neta hi, Na thute kei a dingin lungtang nopna leh kipahna ahi; Aw galkapte Mangpa Pasian, Kei na min a kihan ka hi hi."},"17":{"text":"Misimmawte kikhopna lah ah ka tou ngai sih a, ka kipahpi sih hi; ka lungthahna a na hing dimsahta zieh in; Keimatangin ka tou hi."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh a ka natna bei theilou a, ka liemna suhdam utlou bang mai a, dam theilou ahiei mah? Kei a dinga, kingapna tahtah taahlou luita tui kang zel bang na hita amah?"},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Na hing kinuale kia leh ka hing pui kia dinga, ka masangah na ding ding hi. Thuginalou akipat a, thumanpha na gen leh, Keima kam bang na hi ding hi. Amauh nanglam ah hing kihei u’henlen, Nangpen ama ulam a na kihei ding ahi sih."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh ama-ua dingin sum-eng kulpi in ka hing bawl dinga, amaun nang ahing dou ding ua, hinanleh ahing zou sih ding uhi, aziehpen nangma hing hundam ding leh, hing hunkhe dingin na kungah kang umpi hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"21":{"text":"“Migilou khut akipat kang hunkhe dinga, mi zauhuoite khut akipat kahing tankhe ding hi.”"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga:","title":"Jeremiah in zi aneilou ding ahi"},"2":{"text":"“Tam mun ah zi na nei ding ahisih a, tapate, tanute zong na nei ding ahi sih hi, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n tammun a pieng tapate leh tanute tungtang leh tam gamsunga, amaute paitu anute u’leh ahingkhie apate uh tungtangah tam bangin agen hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute shi sie in ashi ding ua; Koiman asuun sih dinga, vui zong akivui sih ding uhi, leitung ah sil nieh paikhawm bang ahi zaw ding uhi, namsau leh kielin amauh athatgam ding a, a shi luongte uh tungleeng vate leh leitunga gamsate adingin ann ahita ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"“Aziehpen Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Shisuunna inn ah lut sinlen, amauh kaapi ding ahiei, ahisihleh adaapi dingin zong vahaw sin; aziehpen tam mite apat ka hamuonna, ka itna leh ka khotuona, ka lamangta hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Alienpen leh aneu pen zong tam gam sungah a shi tuoh tuoh ding ua, vui in aum sih ding ua, mihing koiman akaa sih ding ua, amaute ziehin koima aki atkeh sih ding ua, alu uh zong aheu kieu sih ding ua, amauh ziehin koima akizihkeh un alu uh aheukieu sih ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Mishi ngai a dalekapte henemna dingin koiman neh ding ann luilou ding hi, ahisihleh apa ahiei, anu ahiei shite hamuonna dingin dawn ding koiman amauh ape sih ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Guolnop bawlna innah zong ne ding leh dawn dingin ama utoh toukhawm dinga na peilou ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngaiun, keiman tam mun akipat in na mitmu u’leh na damlai nite ua, lungnopna leh kipahna husa leh mouneipa leh mounu aw te ka tawpsah ding hi.","ref":"Jer. 7.34; 25.10; Kihil. 18.23"},"10":{"text":"“Tualeh tam mite kunga tam thute zousie na hil chiengin, amaun na kunga Bangzieha Mangpa’n Ka tung ua tambang tuohsietna tung dinga aphuondoh ahiei? Ahisihleh ka gitlouna uh bang ahiei? Ahisihleh Mangpa ka Pasian uh tunga bang khelna bawl kha ka hi uoi? ahing chi chiengun;","title":"Juda milim biehna"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n nang amauh kungah: Mangpa’n napu leh pate un ahing taisan tah zieh un pasien dangte nua ahing zuisanta ua, ana uh asem ua, abeta ua, Kei ang taisanta ua, ka dante azui nawn sih uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh noute napu leh pate uh sanga gilouzaw in na gamta uhi; En un, michin ama lungsim ngaituona gilou dungzuiin agamta ua, ka thugen na ngaisah sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin noute tam gam akipat in na thei khah ngailou u’leh napu napate un zong athei khah ngailou uh gam ah ka hing notdoh dinga, khunah pasien dangte nna sun leh zan in nasem ding ua, khunah noute deisahna ka hing musah sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Ngaiun, anite ahing tung ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi, Izipt gam a kipat a Israeltate puidohpa Mangpa khu ahing ahi akichi nawnlou a,","title":"Pasian in Juda atunding kiana"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Israelte mallam gama kipat leh adelmangna gam zousie akipata hing puidohpa Mangpa Ahing ahi achizohna ding uh nite hing tung ding ahita hi, tualeh keiman amauh apu leh pate uh kunga ka pieh gam ah ka puilut kia ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Ngai un, ngaman mite tampi ka sawl dinga amauh aman ding uh, Mangpa’n achi hi. Tuazou chiengin sabeng mite tampi ka hansah dinga, amaun muol chin leh tangchin ah abeng ding ua, tualeh suong hawm lah apat asuidoh ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ka mit in agamtatna zousie uh a mu ziehin ka mai akipat akiphuol sih hi; agitlounate u’zong ka mit apat akiphuol sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh agitlouna u’leh akhelnate uh aleni in ka thuh masa phot ding hi, aziehpen amaun ka gam asubuata ua, tualeh kidahhuoi leh luohsuoh huoi a milim luongte un ka goutan gam adimsahta uhi.”"},"19":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka hatna leh ka kulpi, genthei nia ka kibutna, kawlmong apat in Jentelte na kungah ahing pei ding ua, “Ka pu leh pate un, zuou leh bangmalou leh phattuomna mawngmawng, umlouna ana luota uhi, achi ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Mihingten ama dingin pasiente akibawl thu ding uh adiei? Tuate lah pasiente hiloupi!”"},"21":{"text":"“Tuaziehin ngaiun, Keima’n amaute tami ka theisah phot ding hi. Ka bantha leh ka hatdan ka theisah ding; Tuachi’n amaun ka min khu, Mangpa ahi chi atheita ding uhi.”"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Juda khelna khu sia laikung leh suongmantam muh hiem khuohthaw a kigiel ahia, tuakhu alungtang suongpeh u’leh amaitam kiite tunga gel ahi.","title":"Juda khelna chiemte ahi"},"2":{"text":"Atate nangawn un muol sangtung chintenga sing hing bul chintenga kidaw leh kiphut maitamte leh Ashera songlaite atheizing lai un."},"3":{"text":"Aw gam a um ka taang, na gamsung pumpi, khelna zieh in, tua gam a taangte leh na hausatna u’leh nagoute zousie uh na munsangte utoh gallah vante bang in pekhe sieng ding ka hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh nangma mama ka hing pieh na goutan na tangden nawn sih dinga, na thei ngailou gam ah nna ka hing semsah ding hi; aziehpen ka lungthahna mei kuong, akuong den dingin na hal kuongta uhi.”"},"5":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Mihing muonga, mihing bantha hatna muong a, alungtanga Mangpa kiheisan mi khu, hamsiet in um hen."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen gamgaw gam a hampa pou bang ahi dinga, silhoi ahing tun chiengin amukha sih dinga, gamdai gamgaw leh koima tenlouna gam ah ateng ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Mangpa muong mi leh a kinepna uh, Mangpa hi mi khu ahampha hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama khu tui luong kunga sing kisuon, lui gei a ahui ha bang ahi dinga, kholum hun hing tun chiengin azau sih ding a, a nate ahing ngitnget ding hi; khokhal kum khoh asa sih dinga, ga suo lou in a um sih ding hi.”","ref":"Late. 1.3"},"9":{"text":"Lungtang khu sil zousie sanga lepchie zaw leh gilou tawpkhoh ahi a, koi in atheizouta diei?"},"10":{"text":"“Kei Mangpa’n michin aumdan dungzui u’leh asilbawl ga dungzui ua, pe dingin lungtang ka ensuoh a, tualeh lungsim ka enchien zel hi.”","ref":"Kihil. 2.23; Late. 62.12"},"11":{"text":"Dihloutah a hausatna nga mi khu, ama tui loupi op keu mengkeng bang ahi, adamsung nite ngeiin tua hausatna in anuasie dinga atawp ah mi maw ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Achiil a kipata pahtawina mangtoupha thupi sangtah khu mi siengthou te umna mun ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aw Mangpa Israelte kinepna, nang hing taisan zousie amuolphou ding uhi; Nang hing kiheisan poumate leivui lah a gel bang bep ahi ding uhi, aziehpen Mangpa hinna tuinah khu a hing ataisanta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Aw Mangpa hing sudam in, tuachi’n ka dam ding hi, hing hundam in tuachi’n hundam ka hi ding hi. Nang ka phat ngitngetpa khu nahi."},"15":{"text":"Ngai vawi, amaun ka kungah, “Mangpa thu hei a um ahiei? Tuin hing tungta heh,” a chi zel uhi."},"16":{"text":"Kei ka hileh na nuazui, na belamchingpa ka hina apat ka taimang sih a, tunggihna ni zong ka lunggul sih hi, ka kam apata hing pawt dohte, na masangah adih ahi chi na thei hi."},"17":{"text":"Kei adingin a giinhuoi hi sin, sietna ni a ka kinepna na hi."},"18":{"text":"Kei hing bawlsete zalatsah in um u’henlen, hinanleh keipen hing zalasah sin, ama u pen lungkie in chimaw uhenlen, hinanleh kei pen hing lungkesah sin. Atung uah tuohsietna tungsah inlen, sietna ale niin amauh sumang in."},"19":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin ka kungah agen hi: “Pei inlen Juda leengte lutna leh pawtna mipite kulkotpi leh Jerusalem kulkotpi zousie ah vading inlen;","title":"Khawlni tang ding a Jeremiah hatna"},"20":{"text":"tualeh akung uah, Juda leengte leh Juda mi zousie leh tam kulkotpi a hing lut Jerusalem a tengte zousie aw, Mangpa thu ngaikhie un, chiin gen in achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Khawl ni in van gih posih unlen, ahisihleh Jerusalem kulkotpite a zong hing polut lou dingin pilvang un.","ref":"Neh. 13.15-22"},"22":{"text":"Khawl ni in na innte ua kipat in van gih podoh sih unlen, bangma nna zong sem sihun, napu napate uh kunga ka thupieh bangin Khawlni tang siengthou un.","ref":"Pawt. 20.8-10; Danp. 5.12-14"},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun athu amang sih ua, abil u’zong adaw sih uhi, hinanleh angaikhiet louna ding u’leh athuhilnate apomlouna ding un, a ngawng uh akhausah uhi."},"24":{"text":"“Tualeh ka thu pilvangtah a na ngaikhiet u’leh tambang ahi ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi; Khawlni a tam khopi kulkotpite a, van gih nang puohlut sih ua, tua ni a nna naseplou ua, Khawlni natan siengthou u’leh;"},"25":{"text":"David leengtoupha tunga tou leengte leh a uliente utoh tam khopi kulkotpite ah ahing lut ding ua, Amaute leh a Uliente uh, sakollengte leh sakolte tunga tuongin ahing pei ding ua, Juda mite leh Jerusalem a tengten zong ahing zui ding ua, tam khopi kumtawn in a umden ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda khopite leh Jerusalem kim a munte akipat in leh Banjamin gam leh gam ngiem a kipan leh taanggamte a kipan leh, simlam gam a kipan bangin, halmang sillatte leh kithoinate leh ann sillatte leh gimnamtui sillatte leh phatna sillatte Mangpa inn ah ahing tawi ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Khawlni tang siengthou ding leh Jerusalem kulkotpite a, khawlni a van gih popum a lutlou dinga ka thu na manlou u’leh Jerusalem kulkotpite ah phelmit guollou mei ka ka tawkuong dinga, Jerusalem leeng inn huongsung leh a kotpite ka katumsah ding hi,” chiin, achi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa akipat a Jeremiah kunga thu hing tung khu:","title":"Jeremiah belkhengpa inn a apeina"},"2":{"text":"“Thou inlen, belkhengpa inn ah vahaw suhin, khunah ka thu ka hing zasah ding hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n belkhengpa inn ah kava hawsuh a, aman belkhenna kuol kipei in nna anasem hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh tungman a abawl bel khu, belkhengpa khut ah adeibang mel polou in ahing um a, tuachi’n belkhengpan hoi asah bangbangin bel dangkhat in akheng zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,"},"6":{"text":"“Aw Israel innkuonte tam belkhengpa bawl banga na tung ua bawl theilou ding ka hiei mah? Mangpa’n achi hi. Ngaiun belkhengpa khut a tungman a um bangin, ka khut ah na um uhi, Aw Israel innkuonte."},"7":{"text":"Bangchih lai ahiei a, nam ahiei, ahisihleh leenggam ahiei tungtang thu a, bawtdoh ding leh loingiem ding thu kana genta a;"},"8":{"text":"Atunga vauhilna thu ka genna tua nam in agitlouna akiheisan u’leh atung ua ka bawltup silgilou apat ka lungtang ka hei ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh nam khat ahiei, leenggam khat poupou tungtang a lamdoh ding leh phutdet ding thu ana gen hita nanleng zong,"},"10":{"text":"Ka mitmu a, silgilou abawl ua, ka aw angai sih u’leh amauh phattuomna ding a silhoi bawlvang ka chi apat ka lungsim ka kikhelsah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin Juda mite leh Jerusalem a tengte kungah thu gen in; Mangpa’n tambang in thu agen hi, Ngai un, na tung uah tuohsietna tunsah ding ka lemguot a, thu ka phiel laitah ahi, noute michin, tuin na umdan hoilou ua kipat in hing kihei unlen, na umdan u’leh na silbawl hoiloute uh bawlpha un, chi’n gen in."},"12":{"text":"“Hinanleh amaun phatuom sih! Ka lemguot dan dungzui un umva ungin, michin in ama lungtang ngaituona hoilou bang zelin kabawl ding uhi, achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Tuin namte lah ah dong madi uale, koiin tambang thu aza ngaita uoi mah? Nungah siengthou Israel in sil chizat huoi pen khat abawlta hi."},"14":{"text":"Lebanon vuaten gamlah a ahing luonsuhna, suong kenlah anuasie ngai a mah? Ahisihleh muoltunga pata hing, luongsuh tuivot kikiehte akang ngai amah?"},"15":{"text":"Ka miten Kei ahing manghil tah ziehun, pannabei milimte kungah gimnamtui ahalta ua, tualeh amaun nidanglai lampite azui ua, amauleh amauh akipalpua sah ua, lamlienpi hilou in lam siellou lam ah apeisah uhi."},"16":{"text":"Agam uh chizat huoi khop a susegawp ding leh, tawp neilou a enghouna tuohsah dingin; akunga suohkha pouma chiza sengin alu uh athinkhum ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Sualam huipi bangin amelmate uh masang ah ka thethang dinga, avangsiet ni chieng un ka mai hilou in, ka nualam ka ensah ding hi.”"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun, “Hing peiun, Jeremiah tungah silgilou iphiel ding uhi; aziehpen siempu akipat in dan thu amang sih ding a, mipil akipat in thuhilna leh guolneite apat thu amang sih ding hi. Hing pei un ama ilei toh idou ding a, athugente mawngmawng ingaikhietpieh sih ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Aw Mangpa hing ngaikhie inlen, tualeh ahing doute thugen ngaikhie in."},"20":{"text":"Silhoilou khu sil hoi a thuh ding ahiei mah? Aziehpen amaun ka shina dingin kokhuh atou uhi. Ama ua dinga hoina thu gen ding leh ama uapat a na lungthahna heimang dinga na masanga ding ka hi dan thei ngitngetin."},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin atate uh kiel a shi dingin pekhie inlen, namsau hatna in asisan uh sungbuo in, tualeh azite uh meithai sah inlen, atate uh suun sahin. Tualeh apasalte uh thain um uhenlen, atangvalte uh kidouna mun ah namsau a tha in um uhen."},"22":{"text":"Atung ua galkap hon thakhat a na tunsah chiengin, ainnte ua kipat in kaa aw ging kiza sah in, aziehpen amaun ka kiehna dingin kokhuh atou ua, tualeh ka keng awhna dingin thang aguhin akam uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinapiin Mangpa aw, Kei tha hing sawm a athu dapphielte zousie uh nangman na thei sieng hi, agitlouna uh ngaidam sinlen, na mitmu apat akhelnate uh nuoimang sin, hinanleh amaute na masangah paimangin um uhenlen, amaute nalungthah ni in tuabangin bawl in."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Pei inlen belkhengpa leibel khat va lei in, tualeh mipite upate leh siempute lah a upate zawpiin.","title":"Belkhengpa belsie etsahna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh suolam kulkot lutna kunga um Hinnom tapa guom ah pei inlen, khunah na kunga ka hing gen ding thute va phuongzah in.","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.10; Jer. 7.30-32; 32.34,35"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh tambangin vagen in: Aw Juda leengte leh Jerusalem a tengten, Mangpa thu ngaikhie un; galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi; Ngaiun, tam mun tungah thakhat thu in tuohsietna ka tungsah dinga, aza pouma bil akhen ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun kei ahing taisan ua, tammun pen gamdang pasiente mun asuohsahta uhi; tualeh tam mun ah, amauleh apu apate u’leh Juda leengten zong athei ngailou uh pasien dangte kungah gimnamtui ahal ua, tualeh tam mun khu mawna neilou mite sisan in adimsahta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ken amauh thu ka pieh khahlou, gen zong ka genkhah ngai lou, ka lungsim a zong lutkha ngai mawngmawnglou, Baal kunga halmang sillat dinga, atapate uh mei a ahalna dingun Baal mun sangte zong alampieh uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.21"},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin ngai un anite hing tung ahita, Mangpa’n achi hi: tam mun pen Tophet ahisihleh, Hinnom tapa guom akichi nawn sih dinga, hinanleh kithana guom akichi zawta ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tam mun a Juda leh Jerusalem sil guotte bangmalou ka suohsah dinga, tualeh amelmate uh masangah namsau leh ahinna uh suite khut ah ka puasah dinga, ashi luongte uh tungleeng vate leh leitunga gamsate ann dingin ka pe ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tam khopi tennalouin ka hawmsuoh sah dinga chizat huoi khop a simmaw in ka bawl dinga akunga suoh kha pouma in akigawtna zousie zieh a chiza sengin a enghou ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh amauten atapate u’leh atanute uh sa ka ne sah dinga, tualeh amelmate u’leh ahinna uh suiten amauh a imkhum ua, lunggima chimawna atuoh chiengun michin in alawmpa sa ane ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Tuachi’n nang na zawpite mitmu ah na leibel khu na sat keh ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh akung uah, galkapte Mangpa’n tambang in agen hi, nachi ding hi. Tambangma in tam mipite leh akhopite nangawn uh, bawlphat kia thei nawnlou dinga, mi’n leibel asatguoi bangin ka suguoi ding hi. Kivuina ding mun awng umlou dongin, amishite uh Tophet ah avui ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tambangin tam mun tung leh asunga tengte tungah ka bawl dinga, tam khopi khu Tophet bang ka hisah ding; Mangpa’n achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Jerusalem innte leh Juda leengte innte khu Tophet munbangin ka buasah ding hi, tua inntungte khu vanlam a aasi honte kunga gimnamtui ahalna u’leh pasien dangte kunga dawn sillat asunbuohna mun uh ahi ziehin.”"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeremiah khu Mangpa’n thugen ding a asawlna Tophet mun akipat ahing pei a, Mangpa biehinn tuol ah adinga, mipite zousie kungah thu agen hi."},"15":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai un, tam khopi leh khopi neute zousie tungah sietna ka tungsah ding chia ka gendohsa zousie ka tungsah ding hi, aziehpen ka thugente ngai nuomlou in a ngawng uh akhausah uhi.”"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Immer tapa, Mangpa inn a houtu lienpen siempu Pashur in Jeremiah in tam genlawhna thute agen chi azata hi.","title":"Pashur in Jeremiah agawtna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pashur in Jeremiah avua-a, Mangpa inn kunga um, Benjamin kulkot sahta zaw a kul sungah akoltang sahta hi."},"3":{"text":"A zing niin Pashur in Jeremiah akoltanna apat in ahing ladohta hi. Tuachi’n Jeremiah in Pashur kungah, “Mangpa’n na min dinga aphuoh Pashur ahisih a, Magor-Missabib ahi zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ngai in, nangma ding leh na lawmte zousie adingin mi giinhuoi in ka hing bawl dinga, amauh amelmate uh namsau a apua laitah uh na mit ngel in na mu ding hi; tualeh Juda mi zousie Babilon leengpa khut ah ka pe doh dinga, ama’n amaute Babilon ah apomang dinga, ahisihleh namsau in athat ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuathamlouin tam khopi hausatna zousie, asepsuo zousie u’leh asil manpha zousie u’leh, Juda leengte gou zousie amelmate khut ah ka pedoh dinga ama un gallah vante bangin atom khawm ding ua, ala ding ua, Babilon ah apawta ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh nang Pashur leh na inn sunga tengte zousie saltangin na pei ding ua, Babilon ah na hing tungta dinga, khunah na shi dinga, na kivuidenta ding hi, nang leh thu zuou na genlawhna na lawmte zousie toh, shi in na ki vui ding uhi.”"},"7":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangman na hing sol a, sol in ka umta hi, Nang kei sangin na hatzaw a, Nang zouta hi. Nichinin nuizabuh ka suohta a, michin in ahing simmaw uhi.","title":"Jeremiah Pasian kungah aphun"},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen thu kagen chiengin, “Ka kikoukhie a thagumsuona leh, manthaina chiin ka tangkoupi hi,” aziehpen Mangpa thu khu kei a dingin nichin in, simmawna leh selphouna ahi zing hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ken “Ama min ka loukha nawn sih dinga, Amin in zong thu ka gen nawn sih ding” ka chi hi. Hinanleh A thu ka lungtang sungah, meikuong bangin akuonga, Ka gute sungah akikhumkha bangmai ahi a, ka thuohzouta sih a, ka um khinkhian theita sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen mi tampi kiguhhou kaza a, aning chin ah zauhuoina a um hi! “Heh unlen, heh khawm chiet vai,” achi ua, Ka meltheite zousie in, “Ka kipalpua ding ngahten sol in hing um vanin, izou ding ua, phuba ila ding uhi,” akichi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n mihat zauhuoitah bangin, ahing umpi a, tuaziehin kei hing bawlsete akipal pua ding ua, ahing zousih ding uhi. Nasatah in azum ding ua, alawching sih ding ua, akumtawn zalatna uh manghil in aum ngaisih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw galkapte Mangpa, midihte enchienpa leh, lungtang leh lungsim mu pailetpa aw, amaute tunga na phulah hing musah in Ka tungtang thu na kungah ka hing kemsahta hi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa kungah la sa unlen, Mangpa phat un; aziehpen silhoilou bawlte khut a kipat in, mi zawng leh tasamte hinna ahundoh ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka pien ni hamsiet in um henlen, ka nu’n ahing hinkhiet ni khu guolzawl in, umsih hen,","ref":"Job. 3.1-19"},"15":{"text":"“Ka pa kunga tapa na neita hi,” chia thu hoi vagen a, ama kipahsahpa khu hamsiet in um hen."},"16":{"text":"Tua mipa khu Mangpa’n kisia keilou a khopi asuhsiet bang hi henlen, tualeh zingmawng in kaa ging za henlen, sunlai chiengin kikou aw ging za heh."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman naubu sungah ahing na that sih a, tuahileh ka nu gilsung khu kahaan ahimai ding a, naubu in kumtawn a hing pai ding hi ven."},"18":{"text":"Bangzieh a, sepgim, lungkhamdana mu ding leh, ka damsung nite zumhuoitah a beisah dinga, naubu apat hing pawtdoh ka hiei?"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Zedekiah in Melkiah tapa Pashur leh Ma-aseiah tapa siempu Zephaniahte akunga asawl lai a Mangpa akipata Jeremiah kunga thu hing tung khu.","title":"Zedekiah thumna nielna"},"2":{"text":"“Hepitahin Mangpa hing na dohpieh in; Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar eite dou dingin akisa hi, tuachi’n Mangpa’n anasep lamdangtahte zousie dungzui in ahing panpi in anua peisah kia khamaw diei mah?” a chi hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.1-11; 2 Khang. 36.17-21"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeremiah in akung uah: Zedekiah kungah tambang na gen ding uh ahi."},"4":{"text":"“Israelte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai un, Babilon leengpa leh Kaldai mite kulpi pulam a nou hing imkhumte na douna galvan na khut ua na tawite uh, nouma tungah ka le hei ding a, amaute tam khopi laikimtah ah ka kikhawm sah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh keima ngel in, lungthahtah leh thangpai pum in ka banzah in, ka banthahattah zangin noute kang dou ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam khopi sunga tengte ami asa in ka satlum dinga, natna hipi huoisetah in ashi ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Khum nua chiengin, Keima’n Juda leengpa Zedekiah leh asuohte leh mipite leh tam khopi sunga hipi apata suohtate leh namsau leh kiel a pat a suohtate khu, Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar khut leh amelmate uh khut leh ahinna uh tha tum a suite khut ah ka pedoh dinga, amaute namsau in athat dinga, koima ahinkhawisih dinga, ahepisih dinga, akhotuo vawt sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tuin tam mipite kungah Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, nachi ding hi: Ngai un, na masang uah, hinna lampi leh shina lampi a hung hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam khopi sunga umte, namsau, kiel leh natna hipi in ashi ding ua, hinanleh taidoh a nou hing bulu Kaldai mite khutsunga kipelut pouma ahing ding ua, ahinna ukhu ama ua dingin kidouna nuomman ahi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen tam khopi tungah ahoina hilou in asietna dingin, ka mai gum ka ngatzouta hi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Tam khopi Babilon leengpa khutah piehkhiet ahi dinga, aman, mei in ahaltum ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Tualeh Juda leengpa innkuon tungtang thu ah: Mangpa thu ngaikhie un, chi’n gen in."},"12":{"text":"Aw David innkuonte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Zingmawng chiengin vaihawmna dihtahin vaihawm unlen, mi bawlgenthei pa khut apat bawlsietna thuohpa hundoh un, tua ahisihleh na silbawlgiloute ziehun, ka lungthahna mei bangin akuongzah dinga, koima phelzou guollou in a kakha ding hi.”"},"13":{"text":"“Ngai un, nou phaikuoma tengte leh, phaijang suongpi lah a tengte, Eite koiin ang dou thei ding uoi? ikibutna sungah koi ahiei hing lut thei ding? Chite aw, Ken noute hingdou ka hi, chi’n Mangpa’n agen hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh na silbawl ga dungzui un ka hing gawt dinga, agammang sung lah meiin ka hal kuong dinga, akimvel a sil um zousie akatum sieng ding hi.”"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Juda leengpa inn ah peisuh inlen, khunah tam thu gen in.","title":"Leeng giloute tunga thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"David leengtoupha tunga tou, Aw Juda leengpa nang leh na suohte leh tam kulkotpite a lut na mipiten, Mangpa thu ngaikhie un."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, vaihawmna dihleh dihtatna bawl unlen, mi bawlgentheipa khut apat bawlsietna thuohpa hundoh un, mikhuolte, paneiloute leh meithaite tungah dihloutah in bawlsih unlen, hiemngamna bawlsih un, ahisihleh tam mun ah mawnaneilou sisan zong suo vawt sihun."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen tamte pellou a na bawl u’leh, David leengtoupha tunga touin, sakolleng tung leh sakol tunga tuongin leengte leh asuohte leh amite tam kulkotpite ah alut ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh tam thute na ngaikhietsih u’leh, tam leeng innpi ahawm a nuasie in a um ding hi; chi’n keima leh keima ka kichiemta hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 23.28; Luk. 13.35"},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n Juda leengpa innkuonte kungah tambangin agen hi: “Nang pen kei a dingin Gilead bang na hi a, Lebanon muolvum bang na hi. Hinanleh pellou in gamdai ka hing suohsah dinga, mihing tenlouna khopi bang ka hing hisah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma sumang dingin sumang mite, agalvan uh tawichiet ka bawlkhol dinga; amaun na sidar sing hoipen pente uh aphua ding ua, mei khuo ah apai lut ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Tualeh nam tampite tami khopi kungah apei ding ua, michin in ama innvengte chiet kungah, “Bangzieh a Mangpa’n tam khopi thupitah tambanga abawl ata diei?” achi ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun, “Aziehpen amauten Mangpa a Pasian uh thuhun ataisan ua, pasien dangte abie ua, anate asep pieh zieh uh ahi, chiin adawng ding uhi.”"},"10":{"text":"Mishisa kaa sih unlen, sun zong suun sih un, hinanleh puimanga umpa adingin hasetah in kap un, ama ahing kinuale kia ngainawn sih dinga, apienna gam mukia nawnlou ding ahi.","title":"Shallum douna thutung"},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Josiah tapa Shallum apa taanga vaihawm, tam muna kipat a peidohta tungtang thu Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi. “Ama pen ahing kinuale ngai nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.31-34; 2 Khang. 36.1-4"},"12":{"text":"Ama sal a apuina mun lam ah ashi dinga, tam gam amu kia ngai nawn sih ding hi.”"},"13":{"text":"“Dihtatlouna a inn lam a, dihlouna toh a pindante bawl a, asepthaman pelou a a innvengte na semsah mi atung agih hi.","title":"Jehoiakim tungthu"},"14":{"text":"Aman inn lienpitah ka lam dinga, indan awngthawltah ka bawl dinga, kottate ka hong dinga, sidar sing ka thuo suoh dinga, lousan ka mu ding, a chi hi."},"15":{"text":"Sidar singa na ki imkhum zieh a vaihawm a pang ding a, kingaisut na hiei mah? Na pa in ane in adawn a, vaihawmnadih leh dihtatna abawl a, tuakhu ama adingin ahoi hilou ahiei mah?"},"16":{"text":"Aman mi zawngte leh mitasamte vai ahawm pieh a, tuachi’n ama a dingin ahoi hi. Tua khu kei ahing theina hilou ahiei mah? Mangpa’n achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh na mitte leh na lungtang khu, na huoihamna ding leh, bawlgentheina leh thagum suona dingin na nei hi.”"},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin Juda leengpa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim tungtangah Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Ehe! Ka unaupa ahisihleh Ehe! Ka unaunu chiin ama akaa sih ding uhi, Ehe! ka pu aw, ahisihleh Ehe! athupina chiin ama akaa sih ding uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.36—24.6; 2 Khang. 36.5-7"},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem kulpikotte pulam a talkai leh, paidoh a um in sabiltung kivui bangin akivui ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Lebanon ah hawtou inlen, kapkhie inlen Bashan ah, na aw uh suo in, Abarim apat in kikou in. Nang hing itte zousie suhmang in a um siengta uhi.”"},"21":{"text":"Na lawchin laitah in na kungah thu ka gen a, hinanleh nangman ngaikhe sih vang na chi hi. Tam khu khangdawng na hing hi akipat a na umdan ahita a, tuachi’n ka thu na mang sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Huiin na belampute zousie anegam ding a, tualeh na itte sal a taang dingin apei ding uhi; Tuachi’n na gitlounate ziehin pellou in na zum dinga, na zala ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Aw Lebanon a tenga, sidar singte lah a bu bawlpa natna na tunga, ahing tun chienga numei nauvei naa sa banga na um chiengin, hepihuoi sam va chie maw!"},"24":{"text":"“Ka hin laisie, Mangpa’n achi hi: Juda leengpa Jehoiakim tapa Koniah khu ka khut ziet lam suoi namna khutsip hinanleh ka hing sut khe veve ding hi.","title":"Jehoiakin tung thu (Koniah)","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.8-15; 2 Khang. 36.9,10"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh nang pen na hinna suite khut ah leh amel uh mu ding na zaute khut ah tualeh Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar khut leh Kaldai mite khut ah ka hing pelut ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n nang leh na pienna na nu, na pienna gam uh hilou gamdang ah ka hing notdoh dinga, khunah na shi ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun hing kinuale kia dinga alunggul na gam uah ahing nuakia nawn sih ding uhi.”"},"28":{"text":"Tam mi Koniah kichi khu Koima deilou, simmawhuoi kipahna um nawnlou bel kehgawpsa ahiei mah? bangzieh a ama leh ahah asuonte athei ngailou uh gam sena kinei uh ahiei mah?"},"29":{"text":"Aw Gam, gam aw, gam, Mangpa thu ngaikhie in."},"30":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Tam mipa ta neilou banga adam sung nite a, lawching ngailou dingin amin giel in. Aziehpen ahah asuonte koima alawching sih dinga, David leengtoupha tungah atou sih dinga, Juda tungah vai ahawm nawn sih ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka gantatna mun a belamte sumang a, thethang belampute, tung agih hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi.","title":"Ahing tung ding dihtatna leengpa"},"2":{"text":"Tuazieh in ka mite vahtu belampute tungtang Israelte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “Ka belamhonte na thethang ua, na notmang ua, amauh na kem sih uhi, Ngaiun, na silbawl giloute ziehun ka hing gawt ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Keima’n ka ganhon umsunte ka nawmangna gam zousie akipat in ka khawm dinga, ahuong sung uah ka hing puikhawm kia ding hi, tualeh gan chiphatah ahi ding ua, apung ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amauh vah ding in atung uah belampute ka koi dinga, a zau nawn sih ding ua, ahisihleh alungdong nawn sih ding ua, amanga kimlou zong a um nawn sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"“Ngai un, David dinga bazam dihtah ka tundoh ding, hun hing tung ding ahita, Mangpa’n achi hi; aman leengpa bangin pilvang tahin vai ahawm ding a, gamsung ah thudih leh dihtatna a tungsah ding hi.","ref":"Jer. 33.14-16"},"6":{"text":"Ama hun sungin Juda hundam ahi dinga, Israel bittah in ateng ding hi. Ama kihatna min tami ahi ding “MANGPA I DIHTATNA UH”."},"7":{"text":"“Tuaziehin ngai vawiun, ani hing tung paiding ahi, Mangpa’n achi hi, Izipt gama kipata Israel mite puidohpa Mangpa ahin laisie achinawn sih ding ua;"},"8":{"text":"hinanleh mallam gam leh amauh ka delmangna gam zousie akipat Israel innkuonte hahlesuonte puidohpa Mangpa ahin laisie achi zawh hun uh hing tung ding hi; tuachi’n amau gam chiet ah ateng ding uhi.”"},"9":{"text":"Zawlneite ziehin ka sungah, ka lungtang akeehgawpa, ka gute akithing a, Mangpa zieh leh a sienthouna thute ziehin, zukham mi bang leh zuin athuzaw mi bang ka hita hi.","title":"Juda gam a guolnei zuoute"},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen gam sungah angkawmmite adimta, hamsietna ziehin gamsungin asuun a, gamdai mun nuomte agaw siengta, zawlneiten lampi hoilou azui ua, ahatna uh adih sih hi."},"11":{"text":"“Aziehpen guolneite leh siempute’n, Pasian khawh asa sih ua, ka inn sung ngel ah agitlouna uh ka mu hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin alampite uh anal ding a, miel lah a delmangin a um ding ua, tuate ah akipalpua ding ua, atung uah sietna ka tungsah dinga, amauh gawtna kum ngei ah, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Samaria guolneite tungah khelna kidah huoi ka mu a, Baal min suongin thu agen ua, ka mi Israelten sil abawlkhiel sah uhi."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem guolneite lah ah zong sil chizat huoitah ka mu hi, ang akawm ua, zuou thu toh akhosa uhi; silgilou bawlte khut ahatsah ua, tuaziehin koima agitlouna akipat ahing kinuahei nuom sih uhi. Abawn un kei a dingin Sodom bang ahi ua, tualeh asunga tengte Gomorrah bang ahi uhi.”","ref":"Siem. 18.20; Ezek. 16.49"},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin galkapte Mangpa’n guolneite, tungtang ah tambangin agen hi: “Ngai un ama ute gamsa in ka vah dinga, tuikha ka dawnsah ding hi; aziehpen Jerusalem guolneite akipat in, gamsung pumpi ah Pasian khosahlouna apawtdohta hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “Guolneiten na kung ua thumavang agente uh ngaikhe sih un, bangmalou ahing suo ua, Mangpa kam a thupawt hilouin, amauh lungtanga angaituote uh agen uhi."},"17":{"text":"Kei hing simmawte kungah thu agen ngitnget ua, muongtah in na um ding uh Mangpa’n achi hi, achi uhi, tualeh mi ama lungtang ngaituona banga, gamta zousie kungah sietna bangma na tung uah, atung sih ding hi,” achi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Koi ahiei Mangpa thuhilna a, dingkha a athu thei a za kha ngai? A thuchiemte ngaikhe ngai koi ahiei?"},"19":{"text":"Ngai un, Mangpa lungthahna pingpei apawtdohta hi, pingpei huoisetah in migiloute lutang anuoi gawp ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa’n alungtanga atupte atangtun kim masangsie in, alungthahna akinuahei kia sih ding a, ni nukhia lam ah bukimtahin na theisiemta ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Tam guolneite ka sawl hilou napi atai uh a, Amaute kung ah thu ka gen sih a hinanleh, thumavang agen uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh ka lemguotna a dinga, ka mite ka thu zasah hi u’leh, tuachi’n a umdan giloute u’leh a silbawl hoiloute ua kipat in, amauh akinua heisahta ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"“Nainou khat a um Pasian hi a, gamlapi a um Pasian zong ka hisih amah? Mangpa’n achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka mu theilouna dinga, mun guh a kiphuol thei mi a um diei mah? Mangpa’n achi hi. Lei leh van ka dim suoh sih amah? Mangpa’n achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Mangin ka man hi, chia ka min a zuouthu gen guolneite thugen ka zata hi."},"26":{"text":"Zuouthu gen zawlneite lungtangah, tami bangtan vei um ding ahiei mah? Ahi ama lungtanga kisolthu guolneite bep ahibou uhi."},"27":{"text":"Apu apate un Baal biehna zieh a, ka min amanghil bang ua, michin in ainnvengpa kunga ahil, amang zieha ka mite ka min manghilsah ding ngaituo mite ahi uh."},"28":{"text":"Guolnei mang neiin a mang gen henlen, ka thu nei miin ka thu gin umtah in gen heh. Bupawl leh butangin kibahna bang ahiei anei uh? Mangpa’n achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka thu meikuong bang hilou amah? Tualeh suongpi satguoi thei sehpi bang hilou ahiei mah?
