Mangpa’n achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaziehin ngaiun, michin a innvengpa akipata, ka thute guhpieh guolneite khu ka dou ahi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Ngai un, guolnei kidangnalsah a, Aman achi hi, chi mite khu ka dou ahi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Ngai un, mang zuou gen a akung ua hil a, azuou thu u’leh khohsaloutaha ka mite silbawl khielsah guolneite khu ka dou ahi, Mangpa’n achi hi, Hinanleh ken amauh ka sawl sih a, thu ka pesih hi; tuaziehin amaun tam miten aphattuompi sih uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"33":{"text":"“Tuachi’n tam mipite ahiei, guolneite ahiei, ahisihleh siempute ahiei in na kunga Mangpa puohgih bang ahiei chia ahing doh chiengun, akung uah bang puohgih e? Na chi ding ua, noute hing taisan ding kahi; Mangpa’n achi hi, na chi ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh guolnei ahiei, siempu ahiei, ahisihleh mi koi ahiei in, ‘Mangpa puohgih’ chi aum leh Keima’n tua mipa leh a innkuonte ka gawt ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Noute michin in na innvengte u’leh na unaupa uh kungah tambangin na gen ding uhi: Mangpa’n bang achi dawn in, Mangpa’n bang agen ei? na chi ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa puohgih na genkha kia nawn sih ding uhi. Aziehpen michin ama thugen khu ama puohgih ahita ding hi, aziehpen nouten Pasian hing, galkapte Mangpa, i Pasian thu na heikawita uhi."},"37":{"text":"Guolneite kungah tambangin na gen ding hi: Mangpa’n nang bang ahing chi dawn ei? tualeh Mangpa’n bang agen ei?"},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa puohgih na chikhah pouma u’leh, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; “Mangpa puohgih na chilou ding uh ahi,” chia ka hing sawl hinapi, “Mangpa puohgih khu chia thute na gentaah ziehin;”"},"39":{"text":"tuaziehin ngai un, Keima ngelngel in noute leh napu napate kunga ka pieh khopi khu ka manghil dinga, ka nuasie ding hi; tualeh ka mitmu akipat ka hing delmang ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh na tung uah kumtawn simmawna leh zumna beitheilou ka hing tungsah ding hi.”"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in Juda leengpa Jehoiakim tapa Jakoniah leh Juda miliente, sing bawlmite leh siakheng mite, Jerusalem apata Babilon a ahing pui tung nua in, Mangpa’n, Mangpa biehinn mai a theipi ga law ni a kikoi ahing ensah hi.","title":"Theipiga law dimni","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.12-16; 2 Khang. 36.10"},"2":{"text":"Law khat ah theipi hoi mama, theipi min masa bangbang aum a, law dangkhat pen ah theipi ga hoilou, neh theilou khop a sie a um hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Jeremiah bang na mu ei?” Chi’n ang dong hi. Tualeh ken theipi, “Theipi hoi mama leh ahoilou, ahoilou mama zieh a nehtaah nawnlou khop hiel a hoilou,” ka chi hi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a,"},"5":{"text":"“Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Tam mun a kipata Kaldai mite gam a ahoina ding ua ka sawlmang Juda mite lah a sal a puimangte khu tam theipi hoite bangin ka en ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A hoina dingun atung uah ka mit ka hahsah dinga, tam gam ah ka hing puikia dinga, amaute ka lamtou dinga, ka luoingiem sih dinga, ka phut dinga, ka botdoh sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi ahing theina dingun, lungtang ka pe dinga, tuachi’n amauh ka mite ahi ding ua, Kei a Pasian uh ka hi ding hi; aziehpen alungtang zousie utoh ka kunga ahing kinuahei kia dinguh ahi."},"8":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Theipi hoilou nehtaahlou khop a hoilou bangin, Judate leengpa Zedekiah leh a miliente leh Jerusalem a thamden a, tam gam a umden nalaite leh Izipt gam a umte ka pe ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute leitung leenggam zousie a dingin chizat huoi in ka siem dinga, ka delkhietna mun chinteng ah, simmaw, paunah, enghou leh hamsiet a um dingin ka pekhe ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh amau’leh apu apate uh kunga ka pieh gam apat a suhmang a aum masangsie uh alah uah, namsau, kiel leh hipi ka sawl ding hi.”"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim leenga apan kum li na a Juda mite zousie tungtanga Jeremiah kunga thu hing tung hi (tua hun khu Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar leenga apan kum khatna ahi.),","title":"Babilon a saltaan sung kum sawm sagi","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.1; 2 Khang. 36.5-7; Dan. 1.1,2"},"2":{"text":"Tua thu khu guolnei Jeremiah in Juda mite zousie kung leh Jerusalem a tengte zousie kunga agen khu ahi."},"3":{"text":"“Juda leengpa Amon tapa Josiah vaihawm kum sawm leh thumna apat tuni tandong in kum sawmni leh kumthum sung Mangpa thu ka kung ah ahing tung ngitnget hi, tualeh zingmawng matah a thou in na kung uah ka gen leng hi; hinanleh na ngaikhe nuom sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa’n asuoh guolneite zingmawng matah a thou in na kung uah ahing sawl a, hinanleh na ngaikhe nuom sih ua, aza dingin na bil u’zong na daw ut sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amaun tuin michin na umdan hoiloute u’leh na silbawl giloute ua pat in kisia unlen, Mangpa’n noute leh na pu napate uh kunga kumtawn kumtawn a ding a, ahing piehna gam ah teng un."},"6":{"text":"Ana uh seppieh ding leh be dingin pasien dangte nuazui sihun, na khut nasepte un hing sulungthah sih unlen, tuachi’n ka hing suna sih ding hi, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinapiin, na sietna dingun, na khut nasepte ua, kei na hing lungthah sah theina dingun, ka thu na ngaikhe nuom sih uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tuaziehin galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi ka thu na ngaikhieh lou ziehun;"},"9":{"text":"Ngaiun, mallam a um nam zousie leh ka suohpa Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar ka han dinga, tam gam leh asunga tengte leh akim apam a namte zousie ka dou sah ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Amaute ka sumang kilkel dinga, tualeh amaute mite chizat, enghou leh akhang akhanga segawp dingin ka bawl ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuathamlou in ama ua pat in, lungnopna leh kipahna aw gingte, mouneipa awte, mounu awte leh ann suh thawmgingte leh thaumei vahte ka lamang sieng ding hi.","ref":"Jer. 7.34; 16.9; Kihil. 18.22,23"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tam gam pumpi gamsie asuoh dinga, mite chizatna ahita ding hi, tualeh tami namten Babilon leengpa nna kum sawm sagi sung aseppieh ding uhi.","ref":"2 Khang. 36.21; Jer. 29.10; Dan. 9.2"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n tambang ahing hi ding a, kum sawmsagi abei chiengin, Babilon leengpa leh tua nam leh Kaldai mite gam agitlouna ziehun ka gawt dinga, gamsie ka suohsah den ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua gam tunga tung ding a ka phuondoh ka thute zousie, Jeremiah in nam zousie tunga tung dinga ana genlawhsa, tam laibu a kigielte zousie khu ka tungsah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Nam tampite leh leeng thupitahten alah ua adeidei uh suoh leh sal dingin akitel ding ua, asilbawl dan u’leh akhut nasep dan dungzui un ka thuhkia ding hi.”"},"15":{"text":"Israelte Mangpa Pasian in ka kungah tambang in agen hi: “Tam lungthahna zu nou khu ka khut apat in la inlen, akung ua ka hing sawlna nam zousiete dawn sahin.”","title":"Pasian thangpaina nou"},"16":{"text":"Amaun adawn ding ua, ahawi vadong ding ua, alah ua ka sawl ding namsau ziehin amodoh ding uhi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa khut apat in nou khu ka la a, Mangpa’n ahing sawlna nam zousiete ka dawn sahta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuate khu Jerusalem leh Juda khopite, aleengte u’leh a miliente uh segawp sienga, chizat huoi a enghounate, hamsietnate tang dingin, tunia a umdan bangun:"},"19":{"text":"Izipt leengpa Pharaoh leh asuohte leh amiliente leh amipite zousie;"},"20":{"text":"nam kitohpol zousie, Uz gam a leengte zousie, Philistin gam a leengte zousie (Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron leh Ashdod a um leengte)."},"21":{"text":"Edom, Moab leh Ammon mite,"},"22":{"text":"Tai-ar leengte zousie, Sidon leengte zousie leh Tuipi gal a, tuipi panggam a leengte,"},"23":{"text":"Dedan, Tema leh Buz tualeh gam ningkawi tawpa umte zousie,"},"24":{"text":"Arabia leengte zousie leh gamdai-gamgaw a teng nam kitohpolte leengte zousie;"},"25":{"text":"Zimri leengte zousie leh Elam leengte zousie tualeh Medes leengte zousie;"},"26":{"text":"mallam leengte zousie agamla leh anai a umte leh leitung maikai a um leitung leenggam zousie in aban ban in adawn ding ua, tua zou chiengin Sheshak leengpa’n zong adawn ding hi."},"27":{"text":"“Tuaziehin akung uah, galkapte Mangpa Israelte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, na chi ding uhi: Na lah ua ka hing sawl ding namsau ziehin, dawn unlen, kham unlen, luo unlen, pua unlen, thoukia nawn sihun."},"28":{"text":"“Tualeh tambang ahi ding hi: Na khut a nou dawn dinga alah nuom sih u’leh, akung uah galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: na dawn ngeingei ding uhi, achi hi, na chi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Ngai un, Ka min puo khopi tungah sietna tunsah kipan ding ka hita a, noute maw gawtlou a na um ding uh? gawtlou in na um vawt sih ding uhi; aziehpen leitunga tengte zousie a dingin, namsau han ding ka hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"30":{"text":"“Tuaziehin atung uah tam thute gen inlen, akung uah hichi in chi in: Mangpa khu tunglam mun sang akipat ahawh ding a, tualeh a tenna mun siengthou akipat, in aw ngaitahin thu agen ding hi; ahuong tungah huoisetah in ahawh dinga, Grep chilte bangin akikou dinga, leitunga tengte zousie douin, akikou ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Leimawng tawp dong thawmging in athawn dinga, Mangpa’n namte adou a, tahsa zousie tungah vai ahawm ding, Aman migiloute namsau kungah ape ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"32":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi Ngaiun, tuohsietna nam khat apat nam dang kungah atung ding, pingpei thupitah lei mawng gamla pen a kipat in ahing kipandoh ding hi."},"33":{"text":"“Tua ni chiengin Mangpa mihatten, leitawpmong akipat in leitawpmong, langkhat tan adapsuoh ding hi; Koiman akaa sih ding ua, Koiman akhawm khawm sih ding ua, vui zong akivui sih ding ua, lei lah ah deimaw paiin akipai ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"“Nou belampute mau unlen kap un, vut lah ah kilawm lie un, Nou belamhon lamkaite, tha a na umna ni ding u’leh, na kithethangna ding nite uh hing tung tahtah ding ahita; noute bel deihuoi bangin na pua ding uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh belamputen taina ding lampi anei sih ding ua, belam honte lamkaiten suotatna lampi anei sih ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Belampute kaa aw ging leh belamhonte lamkaite mauna akiza hi, Mangpa’n agantatna munte uh asuhsiet pieh taah ziehin."},"37":{"text":"Mangpa thangpaina zauhuoitah ziehin, hamuongtaha tenna munte, susiet in a umta hi."},"38":{"text":"Aman humpibahnei bangin akibutna mun anuasieta hi, kibawlgentheina zauhuoitah zieh leh, alungthahna zauhuoitah ziehin agam uh asegawpta hi.”"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim leenga apan chiil laiin, Mangpa akipat tam thute ahingtung hi:","title":"Jeremiah in biehinn huonga thu agetna","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.36—24.6; 2 Khang. 36.5-7"},"2":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Mangpa innhuong sungah ding inlen, Mangpa inna Pasian be dinga hing pei Juda khopi zousie kungah thu gen inlen, akung ua na gen dinga kang thupieh pouma tengkhat zong imlouin gen siengin."},"3":{"text":"Michin in a umdan gilou uh peisan in angaikhe kha maw sih ding uhi, tuachi’n asilbawl uh hoiloute zieha, atung ua sietna bawl ka tup khu ka kideh ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh akung uah, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Nang ngaikhieh sih ua, na masang ua ka koi ka dan thute na zui sih u’leh,"},"5":{"text":"na kung ua zingmawng matah a thou a, ka hing sawl ka suoh guolneite thu, ngaikhe dinga ka gen na ngaikhieh sih u’leh;"},"6":{"text":"tuachi’n tam inn khu Shiloh bangin ka bawl dinga, tam khopi pen leitung nam zousie a dinga hamsiet in ka bawl ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi,” chiin gen in.","ref":"Josh. 18.1; Late. 78.60; Jer. 7.12-14"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempute, guolneite leh mipite zousie in, Jeremiah in tam thute Mangpa inn a agen aza uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuin Jeremiah in mipite zousie kunga, gen dinga Mangpa’n thu apieh zousie agen sieng nuain siempute, guolneite leh mipi zousie in ama aman ua, “Na shi ngeingei ding ahi achi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Bangzieh a tami inn Shiloh bang in aum dinga, tualeh tam khopi sunga teng ding umlou in asegawp ding hi, chia Mangpa min a thu mavang nagen ahiei mah?” achi uhi. Mipi zousie Mangpa inn sungah akikhawm ua, Jeremiah a imtawm va luoi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Juda milienten tam thute azahtah un, leengpa inn akipat in Mangpa inn ah ahing peitou ua, Mangpa inn lutna kotpi tha ah atouta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempute leh guolneiten, miliente leh mipi zousiete kungah, “Tam mipa shitah ahi, aziehpen na bil ngel ua na zah chiet ma bangun tami khopi sietna ding thu agen hi,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeremiah in miliente leh mipite zousie kungah, “Mangpa’n tam inn sietna ding leh tam khopi sietna dinga na thuzahte zousie uh gen dinga kei ahing sawl ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin na umdante u’leh na sil bawlte uh siempha unlen Mangpa na Pasian uh thu mangun, tuachi’n Mangpa’n na tung ua sietna hing tung ding a aphuondohsa akikhelsah thei ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Kei ka hileh na khut ua um ka hi, hoi nasah bang u’leh na dei dandan un, hing bawl mai un."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh na hing tha u’leh mawnaneilou sisan maw nouma ngelngel tung leh, tam khopi tung leh asunga tengte zousie tungah na tusah ding uhi, chi chientah in thei un, adihtah in Mangpa’n kei tam thute na kung ua gen dinga ahing sawl ahi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n miliente leh mipite zousie in, siempute leh guolneite kungah, “Tam mipa shitah ahisih; Mangpa i Pasian uh min a, ikung ua thu agen ahi bou hi,” achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamsunga upa koi ahiei a dingdoh a mipi kikhawmte zousie kungah thu agen hi."},"18":{"text":"“Moresheth mi Mikah in Juda leengpa Hezekiah damlai in thumavang ana gen a, Juda mipite zousie kungah, galkapte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin thu agen hi: Zion lou bangin akikai dinga, Jerusalem khu silsie kisekhawm bang ahidinga, tualeh abiehinn muol khu gammang munsang bangmai ahi ding chiin agen hi.","ref":"Mik. 3.12"},"19":{"text":"Juda leengpa Hezekiah leh Juda mipite zousie in ama athat ngel uoi mah? Aman Mangpa giing lou a, Mangpa deisahna ngenlou amah? Tualeh Mangpa’n amaute tunga sietna atun sah dinga aphuonsa khu akikhelsah sih amah? Hinanleh eiten itung uah sil hoilou thupitah itun sah ding uh ahi.”"},"20":{"text":"Tu in midang khat Mangpa min a thugen, Kiriath-Jearim mi Shemaiah tapa Urijah a um a, aman zong Jeremiah thugen zousie bangin tam gam leh khopi siet ding thu agen hi."},"21":{"text":"Lengpa Jehoiakim leh amihatte leh a miliente zousie in athugen azahtah un tha atum uh a, hinanleh Urijah in tam thu azahtah in azauta, ataimanga Izipt gam ah apeita hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Jehoiakim in Izipt ah mi asawl a, Akbor tapa Elnathan leh midangte Izipt ah asawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Urijah Izipt apat in ahing zopi ua, leengpa Jehoiakim kungah ahing tut uhi, aman anamsau in asatlum a, aluong khu mi maimaite han ah apailut hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahivang in Shaphan tapa Ahikam in Jeremiah apanpi a, mipite khut ah thalup dingin apekhe sih hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim leenga apan chiillai in Mangpa akipat Jeremiah kung thu ahing tung a:","title":"Hahkol etsahna","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.18-20; 2 Khang. 36.11-13"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n ka kungah tambangin agen hi: “Nouma a dingin khau leh hahkolte kibawl unlen, tuate na ngawng uah baat un."},"3":{"text":"Tuate khu Edom leengpa kungah, Moab leengpa kungah, Amon leengpa leh Tai-ar leengpa leh Sidon leengpa kungah, Jerusalem a leengpa Zedekiah kunga hing haw thupote khut ah hahin."},"4":{"text":"Apute uh kunga thu gen dingin amauh thu pie inlen, galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: na pute uh kungah tambang in na gen ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"“Ka silbawltheina thupitah leh kabanzahin, leitung leh mihing leh sate ka siem a, piehtaah ka sahte kungah ka pezel hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tuin tam gamte zousie Babilon leengpa ka suohpa Nebukadnezzar kungah ka pekheta a, gam lah a sate na ngawn zong ama nasep pieh dingin ka peta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama gam gawtna hun ahing tun masangsie in nam zousie in ama leh atapa leh atupa nna aseppieh ding ua, tuazou chiengin nam tampite leh leeng thupitahtah ten ama suoh in abawl ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Tualeh tambang hing hivan in: Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar nna seppieh nuomlou leh Babilon leengpa hahkol paw nuomlou nam leh leengpa pouma keiman namsau in, kiel in, tualeh natna hipi in, ama khut zanga ka thagam masangsie’n ka gawt ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin Babilon leengpa nna sem sihun, hing chi, na guolneite uh, na aisansiemte uh, na mangsante uh, na mitphieldawisiemte uh ahiei ahisihleh na dawithusiemte uh ahiei thu na ngaikhieh lou ding uh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun na gam ua kipat gamlatah a ahing kisuonmangna ding leh ka hing delmang theina dingin na kung uah zuouthu agenlawh uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh nam khat poupou in Babilon leengpa hahkol nuoi a, angawng a guonlut a, ana aseppieh leh tuabang nam khu amauh gam ah ka um sah dinga, agam uh ahou ding ua, asungah ka tengsah ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Juda leengpa Zedekiah kungah zong tam thute zousie dungzui in “Babilon leengpa hahkol nuoi ah na ngawng lutsah inlen, ama leh amite nna seppieh mai inlen, hingin, kana chita hi."},"13":{"text":"Bangzieha, nang leh na mite namsau a, kiel a, tualeh natna hipi a, Babilon leengpa nasem nuomlou namte tungtanga Mangpa’n agensa banga shi ding na hi uoi mah?"},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin na kung ua Babilon leengpa nna nasep piehlou ding uh ahi, chi a guolneite thugen ngaisah sih un, aziehpen amaun na kung uah zuouthu agen uhi."},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen ken amauh ka sawl sih, Mangpa’n achi hi; hinapiin noute ka hing delmang a nou leh na kung ua zuou thugen na guolneite uh na manthai theina ding un amaun ka min in zuou thu agen uhi.”"},"16":{"text":"Ken siempute kung leh mipite zousie kungah zong ka gen a, “Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: na kung ua, ngaiun, Mangpa inn a, bel leh kuongte tomkhat zou chiengin Babilon apat ahing nua puoh kia paita ding uhi, chi a guolneite thugen ngaisah sih un, amaun na kung ua zuou agen uh ahibou hi."},"17":{"text":"A thugen uh ngaikhesih unlen, Babilon leengpa nna sem unlen, hing un, bangzieha tam khopi suhsiet a um ding ahiei mah?"},"18":{"text":"Amaute guolnei ahi ua, Mangpa thu akung ua um ahileh, Mangpa inn leh Juda leengpa inn tualeh Jerusalema nuasie a um bel leh kuongte Babilon a kipomang lou dingin galkapte Mangpa kungah ngetna bawl uheh."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa’n khuompite tungtang tuikuong tungtang, khuom kingahna tungtang leh tam khopi a um nalai bel leh kuong umsunte tungtangah, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi."},"20":{"text":"Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in Juda leengpa tapa Jekoniah leh Juda leh Jerusalem a, miliente zousie, Jerusalem apat Babilon a apuimang lai a, alahloute tungtang ah;"},"21":{"text":"Ahi, Israelte Pasian, galkapte Mangpa’n, Mangpa inn leh Juda leengpa inn leh Jerusalema um nalai, bel leh kuongte tungtang ah, tambangin agen hi:"},"22":{"text":"Babilon langah ka pomang sieng dinga, amauh ka hing nua kan kia masangsie in, khunah a um den tadi ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Tuachi’n amauh ka hing zawpi kia dinga tam mun ah ka koikia ding,” achi hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh khumi kum main, Juda leengpa Zedekiah leenga apan chiillai, akum lina, aha ngana ah Gibeon a um Azur tapa guolnei Hananiah in Mangpa inn a siempute leh mipite zousie mai ah, ka kungah thu tambangin agen hi:","title":"Hananiah thugen dihlou leh ashina","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.18-20; 2 Khang. 36.11-13"},"2":{"text":"“Israelte Pasian, galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin thu agen hi: Keima’n Babilon leengpa hahkol ka tawngsan sahta hi."},"3":{"text":"Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in, Mangpa inn a bel leh kuong tam mun akipat a apuohmanga Babilon a atutte zousie kum ni sungin tam mun ka hing tut sieng kia ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Juda leengpa Jehoiakim tapa Jekoniah leh Juda gam akipata saltang ding Babilon a kipui mangte zousie tam mun ah ka hing tut kia ding hi, aziehpen Babilon leengpa hahkol suhtawng pieh ding ka hi, Mangpa’n achi hi,” chiin agen hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Jeremiah in, siempute mai ah leh Mangpa inn a ding mipite mai ah, guolnei Hananiah kungah thu agenta hi."},"6":{"text":"Guolnei Jeremiah in, “Amen, tuabangin Mangpa’n bawl heh, Mangpa inn a bel leh kuongte leh suoh leh sal a kikaimang zousiete Babilon apat in tam mun a hing puitung kia dinga na genlawh bangin Mangpa’n sutangtung ta hen."},"7":{"text":"Ahivang in tuin nangma zah leh mipite zousie zah a ka thugen khu ngaikhie in."},"8":{"text":"Nidang lai a Kei leh nang masanga guolnei na um masaten gam tampite tung leh leenggam thupite tungah, kidounate, sietnate, leh natpi hite tunding ana gen zel uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hamuonna thugenlawh guol nei khu, agenlawh thute ahing tangtun chiengin, guolneipa khu Mangpa sawl dihtah ahina chi akithei ding hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Hananiah in guolnei Jeremiah ngawng apat hahkol alakhie a ahiehtawngta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Hananiahin mipi zousiete masangah thu agen a, “Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Tambangma in Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar hahkol khu nam zousiete ngawng apat in kum ni sungin ka hiehtawng ding hi,” achi hi. Tualeh guolnei Jeremiah apeimangta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Hananiah in guolnei Jeremiah ngawnga pat hahkol ahiehtan nua sawtlou in Jeremiah kungah Mangpa thu ahing tung hi,"},"13":{"text":"“Pei inlen, Hananiah vahil in, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; Nang sing hahkolte na hiehtawngta a, hinanleh tuami taangin sia hahkol na bawlpieh ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar nna aseppieh theina dingun, tam namte zousie ngawng ah sia hahkol ka baat piehta hi; tuachi’n amaun ana aseppieh ding ua, tualeh keiman gam lah a gamsate nangawn zong ama ka peta hi.”"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Jeremiah in guolnei Hananiah kungah, “Tuin ngaiin, Hananiah, Mangpa’n nang ahing sawl sih hi; hinanleh tam mipite zuou thu na tahsangsah hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; Ngaiin, leitung apat in ka hing deldoh ding a, tukum mama in na shi ding hi, Nangman Mangpa tunga heldan na hiltaah ziehin achi hi.”"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n khumi kum mama a ha sagina ah guolnei Hananiah ashita hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin tamte guolnei Jeremiah in, Jerusalem akipata sal a puimanga um upate, kung leh siempute, guolneite leh Nabukadnezzar in Jerusalem akipat a Babilon a apuimang mipite zousie kunga alaihah a agen thute ahi.","title":"Saltaangte kunga laihah masa","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.12-16; 2 Khang. 36.10"},"2":{"text":"Tam pen leengpa Jekoniah leh leengpa nu leh michilgete, Juda leh Jerusalem miliente, singbawlsiemte leh siakheng mite Jerusalem apat puimanga a um nua uh ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tua laihahpen, Shaphan tapa Elasah leh Hilkiah tapa Gamariah khut ah aposah hi. Juda leengpa Zedekiah in amaute Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar kunga asawl ahi. Tua laihah ah tambangin akigiel hi:"},"4":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in, Jerusalem apat a Babilon a sal a puimanga, ka umsahte kungah tambangin agen hi."},"5":{"text":"Innte lam unlen, khunah teng khinkhian un, huonte bawl unlen, aga kineh un."},"6":{"text":"Zite nei unlen, tapate leh tanute nei unlen, na tapate uh zi ding lah pieh unlen, na tanute uh pasal neisah un, tua chia, tapate leh tanute anei theina ding u’leh na kiemlou ua, na pun deudeu na dingun."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh sala ka hing puimangsahna khopi hoina ding sui unlen, tuami adingin Mangpa kungah thu nget pieh unlen, aziehpen tua khopi hamuonna ah, nou zong hamuonna na nei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa, Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: na lah ua um guolneite leh aisansiemte solzou in um sih unlen, mangsante mang zong gingta sih un."},"9":{"text":"Amaun ka min in na kung uah zuou thu agen uhi. Ken amauh ka sawl sih hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"10":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Babilon a sal tanna kum sawmsagi achin zou chiengin, ka hing ve dinga, tam mun ah noute ka hing kinuale sah kia ding a, na kung ua ka thuchiemsa khu ka subukim ding hi.","ref":"2 Khang. 36.21; Jer. 25.11; Dan. 9.2"},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen noute a dinga ka lungsim geldan ka theizinga, na hun hing tung dingte uah kinepna pe ding, hoilouna ding hilou in na hamuonna ding uh ka ngaituo hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n kei nang han ding ua, tualeh na pei ding ua, ka kungah na thum ding ua, ka hing ngaikhe ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh nang sui ding ua, na lungtang zousie ua na hing sui chiengun nang mu ding uhi.","ref":"Danp. 4.29"},"14":{"text":"Kei noute mu in ka umta ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi, Ken nasal tanna ua kipat in kang nua pui kia ding hi; Ken noute nam zousie akipat leh, ka hing deldohna mun zousie akipat in, ka hing khawm kia ding a, tualeh sal a ka hing puimangsahna mun ngei ah, ka hing puilut kia ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"15":{"text":"“Nouten Babilon gam ah zong, Mangpa’n guolneite ahing tundoh pieh hi, na chitah ziehun."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa’n David leengtoupha tunga tou leengpa tungtang leh, tam khopi sunga tengte zousie leh, noute toh sal a puimanglou na sanggamte uh, tungtangah tambangin agen hi, chi thei un."},"17":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ngaiun, atung uah namsau leh kiel leh natpi hi, ka sawl dinga, amuot seng tah zieh a, neh theilou khop asie theipite bangin ka bawl ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh amaute namsau leh kiel leh hipi toh ka nuadel dinga, leitung leenggam zousie a dinga zauhuoi leh ka deldohna namte lah ah hamsiet leh chizat huoi, simmaw leh enghou dingin ka pekhe ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen ka thu angaikhe nuom sih uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi, ka suoh guolneite zingmawng matah a thou a, akung ua ka sawlten agen uh ka thute angai nuom sih uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jerusalem apata, Babilon a kang sawlmang saltang zousiete’n, Mangpa thu ngaikhie un."},"21":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in, Kolaiah tapa Ahab leh Ma-aseiah tapa Zedekiah, ka min suonga na kung ua, zuou thugente tungtang tambangin agen hi. Ngai un, Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar khut ah amaute ka pekhe dinga, ama’n na mitmu uah a maute athat ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute zieh in Babilon a um Juda saltang zousie in, Babilon leengpa’n meia a em Zedekiah leh Ahab bangin, “Mangpa’n nang zong hing bawl heh, chiin hamselawna paunah in azang uhi.”"},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun Israel gam sungah sil mot huoi abawlta ua, a innvengte uh zite toh angkawmna abawl ua, amauh thu kapieh loupi ka min in zuou thute agen uhi. Keima ngeiin ka thei a, theipitu ka hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Nehelam mi Shemaiah kungah zong tambangin nagen ding hi.","title":"Shemaiah kunga laihah"},"25":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Nangman na min in Jerusalem a um mi zousie kung leh siempu Ma-aseiah tapa Zephaniah kung leh siempute zousie kungah."},"26":{"text":"Mimo guolnei kichi pouma suongkul a khum ding leh kolbul dinga, Mangpa inn a houtu a pang dingin, Mangpa’n nang Jehoiada taangin siempuin ahing pangsahta hi, chiin lai na hahta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin bangdinga noute lah a, guolnei a kibawl Anathoth mi Jeremiah phawhthop lou na hiei mah?"},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen ama’n “Saltan hunsung sawt ding ahi; innte kilam unlen teng un, tualeh huonte bawl unlen, agate kineh un chi’n Babilon a um eite kungah lai ahing hah hi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh siempu Zephaniah in tam laihah khu, guolnei Jeremiah zahin asim hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu khu Jeremiah kungah ahing tung a,","title":"Saltaangte kunga laihah nina"},"31":{"text":"“Saltangte zousie kungah hah inlen, Nehelam mi Shemaiah tungtang thu ah Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ka sawlloupi a, Shemai in na kung ua thu agen zuou thu ahing tahsansah ziehin;"},"32":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ngaiun, Nehelam mi Shemaiah leh ainnkuonte ka gawt dinga; tam mite lah a teng ding mi anei sih dinga, ka mite dinga ka bawl pieh ding silhoi zong amu sih ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi; aziehpen aman Mangpa tunga helna thu ahilta hi,” chiin laihah in achi hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa akipat a Jeremiah kunga thu hing tung khu:","title":"Israel tunding kiana"},"2":{"text":"“Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin thu agen hi: Na kunga ka thugente zousie laibu khat ah giel in, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen ngaiun ka mi Israelte leh Juda saltangte ka puikiana ding nite ahing tung ding ahi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Tualeh Keima’n apu apate uh kunga ka pieh gam ah ka kinuale sah dinga, aluota ding uhi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n Israelte leh Judate tungtanga athugente khu tamte ahi."},"5":{"text":"“Aziehpen Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, muonna hilou a, chitutna zauna thawmging kaza hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuin dong unlen, en un, pasal in nau avei ngai amah? Bangzieh a numei nauvei banga pasal chintengin, akawng ua akhut uh akoi ua, amaite uh daang gawp sienga ka mu ahiei?"},"7":{"text":"Kasai! tua ni thupi hina mai e, akibatpi mawngmawng a um sih hi, tuakhu Jakob mangbat hun ahi, hinanleh ama pen tuate lah akipat hundam ahi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Aziehpen khum ni chiengin tambang ahi ding, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi; angawng ua pat hahkol ka hieh tawng ding a, na kolbu uh ka tawngsah ding a, gamdang miten amauh suoh leh sal in akhawi nawn sih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun Mangpa a Pasian u’leh amaute leeng dinga ka tun ding aleengpa uh David nna asep pieh zota ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Tuaziehin aw ka suohpa Jakob zausin, aw Israel lungke vawt sin, Mangpa’n achi hi; aziehpen Ngaiun, ken gamlapi akipat nang leh na chi hahte asaltaanna gam ua kipat in ka hundam ding hi. Jakob ahing kinuale kia ding a, akhawldam ding a, a um khinkhian ding hi, koiman a zausah nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Jer. 46.27,28"},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen nang hing hundam dingin, na kung ah ka hing umpi hi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Ka hing thethang na namte zousie subei sieng nanleng, nang pen ka hing subei kilkel sih ding hi; dihna toh nang ka hing sudih ding a, gawtlou in ka hing koi sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Na liemna suhdam theiguol ahisih a, na kisuhliemna khu anase sengseng hi."},"13":{"text":"Na tungtang thu gen ding mi koima a um sih a, na damna ding, damdawi a um sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Na it na ngaite zousie’n ang manghil siengta ua, nang ang sui nawn sih uhi, melma satliem bangin ka hing liemsahta a, na gitlouna atam seng ziehin, mi gilou gawt bangin ka hing gawt hi."},"15":{"text":"Bangdinga na gimthuoh zieh a kap na hiei? Na gitlouna tampite ziehin na dana pha ding guol ahisih hi; na khelnate apun deu deu ziehin, tam silte na tungah ka bawlta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuazieh in nang hing negam zousie nehgam in a um ding ua, tualeh na melmate zousie sal a puimang ahi ding uhi; tualeh nang hing bulute zousie bulu in a um ding ua, gallah a hing late zousie gallah dingin ka bawl ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen keiman damtheina ka hing pekia ding a, na liemnate ka damsah ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi, amaun tami delmang a um Zion ahia, Koiman asuikia nawn sih ding hi, achi ziehun."},"18":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ngai vawi, Jakob puon inn saltangte khu, ka hing nua puikia dinga, atenna munte uah khotuona ka nei ding hi; Khopi khu a umna muol ngaingai ah akilam dinga, leengpa inn zong a umna mun gaima ma ah a um kia ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute akipat in kipah thugenna leh, lungnopna thawmgingte ahing pawtkhe ding hi; amauh ka pungsah dinga, ka kiemsah sih ding hi, amauh ka pahtawi dinga, aneu vawt sih ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"A tate uzong nidang lai bangin a um ding ua, ka masanga akikhopnate uh suhdet ahita dinga, amauh sugentheite keiman ka gawt ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Alamkaite uh amau’lah a mi ngeingei ahita dinga, avaihawm mite uh khu amau’lah a hing pawtdoh ahi ding uhi, tuachi’n amaute ka kinai sah dinga, aman kei ahing zuon ding hi, aziehpen ama thu a kei hing zuon dinga, alungtanga kichiemngam koi ahiei? Mangpa’n achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Noute ka mite na hi ding ua, Kei na Pasian uh ka hi ding hi.”"},"23":{"text":"En un, Mangpa pingpei khu thangpaina toh apawtkhie hi, pingpei tawplou khu; migiloute lutung huoisetah in anuoi gawp ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Mangpa lungthahna zauhuoitah khu alungtanga atupte abawl bukim masangsie’n akinuale sih ding hi. Ni nukhia lam chiengin tamte na hing theisiem ding uhi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tua hun chiengin Israel innkuonte zousie Pasian ka hi dinga, amauh ka mite ahi ding uhi,” achi hi.","title":"Israel tunding kiana"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, “Namsau a tha mawhmiten gamdai ah khotuona amu uh, Israel kunga khawldamna pe dinga ka pei laiin."},"3":{"text":"Nidang lai a ka kunga Mangpa hing kilang in, tangtawn itna in nang ka hing itta a, tuaziehin lainatna toh nang ka hing nua pui kiata hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka hing tungding kia dinga, tundingin na um ding hi, Aw nungah siengthou Israel, khuongta toh na kizem kia dinga, nopbawlna lamna mun ah na telta ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Samaria muol dung ah grep huon na bawlta dinga, asuon miten asuon ding ua, agate nuomtah in a ne ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ephraim taang gama vengmiten, thou un, Zion ah Mangpa i Pasian kung uah ipeitou ding uh, chi a, akikou ni uh hing um ding ahi.”"},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; “Jakob a dingin nuomin lasa unlen, namte lah a thupipen a dingin kikou un, phuongzah unlen, phat un, Aw Mangpa na mi Israel umsunte khu hundam in, chi un."},"8":{"text":"Ngai un amauh mallam gam akipat ka hing pui dinga, kawlmong tawp akipat in ka puikhawm dinga, amau’lah ah mittote, kengbaite, numei naupaite leh numei nauvei chiilte, toh ka hing puikhawm dinga, mipi tampi hing kinualete ahing tung khawm ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Kap kawm in ahing pei ding ua, lungmuong tahin ka pui tung ding, luitui luonna langah ka peisah dinga, akipalpua louna ding uh lampi tangtah ah, ka peisah ding hi, aziehpen Kei Israel pa ka hi a, tualeh Ephraim ka ta masa ahi."},"10":{"text":"“Nou namte aw Mangpa thu ngaikhie unlen, gamlapi a um tuipi panga gamte ah phuongzah un, Israel thethangpa’n amauh apuikhawm kia ding a, belampu in abelamhonte aven bangin aveng ding hi, chi un."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n Jakob atandohta a, ama sanga hatzawte khut akipat atandohta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaute Zion muol vum ah lasa kawm in, ahing pei ding ua, Mangpa hoina ziehin akipah ding uh a, bute, uointe, sathaute, Belamte leh gan guol noute tungah zong akipah ding uhi; ahinna uh khu huon tui kibuoh nom bang ahi dinga, kumtawn in alungkham nawn sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n nungah siengthoute khu nuom in alam ding ua, tangvalte leh tehsete zong akipah khawm ding uhi; aziehpen alusun liengvainate uh, nopna ka suohsah ding a ka hamuon ding hi, alungkhamna ua pat ka kipahsah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Siempute hinna khu kiningchinna toh ka taisah ding a, ka hoina ziehin ka mite zong atai ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Ramah khuo ah aw ging akiza hi mishi ngai a, kaa leh mau husa ahi a, Rachel in atate akaa a, atate a um nawnlou ziehin henem thei ahi sih hi.”","title":"Israel dinga Mangpa hepina","ref":"Siem. 35.16-19; Mat. 2.18"},"16":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Kaplou dingin na aw kideh inlen, na hitui luong sah sin, Mangpa’n achi hi, amaute melma gam akipat in ahing peikia ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na hun hing tung dingte ah kinepna aum hi, na tate agam uah ahing peikia ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ephraim in “Nangman nang phawhhil a, bawngtal lah nailou bangin phawhhil in ka um ta hi. Hing siemtha in Kang kinuahei ding hi, Nang ka Pasian na hi ziehin. Chia akaana ka zata hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahing kiheisah nua in, ka kisia a, thuhil a ka um nua in ka pheipi ka beenga, ka zumta a, ka khangdawn lai minsietna ka thuoh ziehin, ka amgawp hi, achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Ephraim ka tapa deitah ahiei? Ka ngainat ka ta ahiei? Ken ama demin thugen ma nanleng, ka lung sungah kagel chinten hi; tuaziehin ka lungtangin ama ka lunggul a, pellou in ama ka khotuo ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"21":{"text":"“Lampi chiemtenate bawl inlen, Lampi kohmunate phut in na peina lamlienpi na lungtangin chiemte hoi inlen, Aw Israel nungah siengthou, hing kile kia in, na khopite ah hing kile kia in."},"22":{"text":"Bangtan vei vahthap ding na hiei, Aw nang tanu nuatol? Mangpa’n leitungah sil tha khat abawlta hi; numei in pasal ahun zota ding hi.","title":"Juda tunding kiana"},"23":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambang in agen hi: “Asaltaangte uh ka nuapui kia chiengin, Juda gam leh akhopite uah, tam kamham azang kia ding uhi; Aw dihna umna leh siengthouna muol! Mangpa’n hing guolzawlta hen, chi khu."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh khunah Judate leh akhopi zousie uah lounei mite leh belam ching mite atengkhawm ta ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen mi basamte ka halsah dinga, lungkhamte zong ka taisahta ding hi.”"},"26":{"text":"Tuazouin ka khanglouta a, Ka en kimvel a, ka imut atuita mama hi."},"27":{"text":"“Ngai un, Israel innkuonte leh Juda innkuonte ah mihing chi leh ganta chi ka tuna nite hing tung ding ahita, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hiding, amaute botdoh ding, suguoi ding, paikhe ding, suse ding leh suna ding ka ven bangin amaute tungding ding leh phut kia dingin, ka vengding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua nite ang tun chiengin amaun: Pate’n grep thua ane ua, tate ha aza hi, achi ngai nawn sih ding uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 18.2"},"30":{"text":"Tuanahsangin michin in ama khelna ashipi dinga, grep thua ne pouma ama ha mama aza ding hi."},"31":{"text":"“Ngai un, Israel innkuonte leh Juda innkuonte toh thuhun tha ka bawl nite hing tung ding ahi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 26.28; Mak. 14.24; Luk. 22.20; 1 Kor. 11.25; 2 Kor. 3.6  ;     \n        Heb. 8.8-12"},"32":{"text":"Apu apate uh Izipt gam akipat a puidoh dinga akhut ua ka tuh lai a, amautoh ka bawl thuhun bang hilouin, ama ua dinga apasal uh hinapi inga, amaun tua thuhun abotseta uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh tua nite zou chienga Israel innkuonte toh ka bawl ding thuhun khu tami ahi ding hi; Mangpa’n achi hi; Amaute lungsim sunggil lam ah ka dan thu ka koi dinga, alungtang uah ka giel ding hi, tualeh a Pasian uh ka hi dinga, amauh ka mite ahi ding uhi.","ref":"Heb. 10.16"},"34":{"text":"Koima’n ainnvengpa kungah tualeh michinin aunaupa kungah, Mangpa theiin, chi’n ahil nawn sih ding uhi; aneupen akipat alienpen tan in kei ahing thei chiet ding uhi, aziehpen agitlouna uh ka ngaidamta dinga, akhelnate uh ka thei ngitnget nawn sih ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Heb. 10.17"},"35":{"text":"Mangpa’n sun a vahsah dinga ni pepa, ha leh aasite dinga dante guot pieh a zan a taang dinga thu pepa leh tui kinawhte ging he hu dinga tuipite tohthoupa’n tambangin agen hi, Amin khu galkapte Mangpa ahi, achi hi."},"36":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tam dan thupiehte ka masang a pat a abeimang vawt tahleh, tuachiengin ka masang akipat Israel hahlesuonte nam khat ahina uh abei ding hi,” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Tunglam van khu tethei ahi a, nuoilam leitung kingahna suidohguol ahileh, ken zong Israel suonte zousie asil bawlsate zousiezieh un, ka paimang ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"38":{"text":"“En un, anite hing tung ding ahita! Hananeel innsang akipat kulpi ninglam kotpi dongin, Mangpa dingin khopi akilam tha ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Atena khau khu Gareb muol dongin tangtah in akizan dinga, Goath lam ah akihei suh ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh mishi luong paina guom leh vut kipaina muol pumpi leh gamlah zousie, Kidron luita guom tan dong; nisuona lam ah sakol kulkotpi ning tan dong, Mangpa a ding a siengthou ahi ding hi. Tua khu kumtawn in bawdoh leh paidoh ahi nawn sih ding hi.”"}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Zedekiah leenga apan kum sawmna, tuakhu Nebukadnezzar vaihawmna kum sawm le giet achin kum in, Mangpa akipat Jeremiah kungah thu ahing tung hi.","title":"Jeremiah lou leina","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.1-7"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen tua hunlaiin, Babilon leengpa galkapten Jerusalem ahing sim ua, tualeh guolnei Jeremiah khu Juda leengpa inn huongsung suongkul ah akikhum hi."},"3":{"text":"Juda leengpa Zedekiah in ama suongkul ah akhum a, hichiin achi hi: “Bangzieh a, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ngai vawi, Babilon leengpa khut ah tam khopi ka pe dinga, aman ala ding hi, chia thu na genlawh ahiei? achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Juda leengpa Zedekiah zong Kaldai mite khut apat asuohta sih dinga, hinanleh pellouin Babilon leengpa khut a pieh khiet in a um dinga kimaituo in akihou ding ua amit un aki entuo ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Zedekiah khu Babilon langah pui vanin, khunah ama ka ve masangsie’n a um ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi, Kaldai mite dou nan ulachin zou sih va uteh, chia bang dinga nagen ahiei? chia ataan sah ahi.”"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Jeremiah in agen a, “Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung a:"},"7":{"text":"Ngai vawi, na paneu Shallum tapa Hanameel na kungah ahing haw dinga, Anathoth a um ka lou leiin, ka innkuon kinaipi pen na hi ziehin gouluo ding mawng na hi, ahing chi ding hi, achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka pa neu tapa Hanameel khu, Mangpa gen bang dungzui in suongkul huongsung ah ka kungah ahing pei a, ka kungah Benjamin gam a Anathoth khuo a um ka lou leiin, gamluo thei na hi ziehin na tat thei mawng ahi, kilei mai in achi hi. Tuachi’n ken tami Mangpa thu ahi chi ka theita hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tuachi’n Anathoth khuo a um ka paneu tapa Hanameel lou ka leita a, tualeh adangka ka te pieh a, dangka sia shekel sawm le sagi tah ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n lai ka giel a, suoi ka nam a, theipimite ka han a, tuachi’n dangka khu atena ah ka khaita hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n kileina lai gelna tawndan ngaina leh dan dungzui a kikha leh kihongte kala a;"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka pa neu Hanameel mitmu leh, kileina a mintuong theipi mite mitmu leh suongkul huongsunga tou Judate zousie masang ah Ma-aseiah tapa Neriah tapa Baruk kungah kileina lai ka pie hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n amasang uah Baruk thu ka pie a,"},"14":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Tam kileina laite akikha leh akihongtegel aniin la inlen, ni tampi a um theina dingin leibel sung khat ah koiin."},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Innte leh loute leh grep huonte tam gam sung ah akilei kia ding hi, achi hi, ka chi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tuin tua kileina lai Neriah tapa Baruk ka pieh zou in, Mangpa kungah thu ka ngen a,","title":"Jeremiah thumna"},"17":{"text":"Eh! Mangpa Pasian ngaiin, nangman na silbawltheina thupitah leh na ban jahin van leh lei na siem a, nang dingin ahaseng taluo bangma a um sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Nangman tul tampite kungah lungsietna leh hepina na langsah a, tualeh pate khelna khu anua ua atate angsungah na thuh lenga, Athupi leh ahat tungnung, galkapte Mangpa khu Na min ahi."},"19":{"text":"Lemguotna a thupi nasepna a hat, mihing tate umdan zousie na en chien a, michin a umdan leh a nasep dungzui a kipahman piea thuh zelpa na hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangman Izipt gam akipat in chiemtena leh sillamdang na bawl a, tuni tandongin Israel leh midangte lah ah na bawl zel a, tuni a mabangin min khat na kibawldohta hi."},"21":{"text":"Sil lamdangte, chiemtenate leh banthahat leh banzahdoh leh zauhuoina thupitah toh na mi Israelte Izipt gam a kipata puidohpa na hi."},"22":{"text":"Apu apate uh kunga pieh dinga na chiem gam nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam khu amauh na peta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahing lut ua, tam gam ahing luota uhi; hinanleh na thu amang sih ua, na dan lah azuisih uhi. Akung ua bawl dinga na thupiehte zousie bangma abawl sih uhi; Tuaziehin tam sietnate zousie amauh tungah na tungsahta hi."},"24":{"text":"Lei kisepvumte en vawi, khopi la dingin asung ah ahing lut ta uhi. Namsaute, kiel leh natpite ziehin tam khopi hing sim kaldai mite khut ah pieh ahita ding hi; na gensa zousie ahing tungta hi, en in, tami na muta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Aw Mangpa Pasian nang ka kungah “Lou mun khu sum in lei inlen, theipimite han in,” khopi khu Kaldai mite khut a kipie ahita hi,” na chi hi, achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu Jeremiah kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Pasian dawnna"},"27":{"text":"“Ngai un, Kei Mangpa tahsa zousie Pasian ka hi, Kei a ding in sil hasa seng taluo a um eimah?"},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ngaiin tam khopi khu Kaldai mite khut leh Babilon leengpa khut ah ka pe dinga ama’n ala ding hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.1-11; 2 Khang. 36.17-21"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh tam khopi hing dou Kaldai mite ahing pei ding ua, tam khopi meiin ahal ding uhi; tualeh atung ua keima ahing lungthahsahna dingun, inntung vumte ah Baal kungah gimnamtuite ahalna u’leh pasien dangte kunga dawn sillatte asunbuohna innte uh ka haltum ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Aziehpen Israel tate leh Juda taten akhangdawn lai ua pat in, ka mai ah sil hoilou ngen abawl uhi. Israel taten akhut nasepte un kei ahing sulungthah uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tam khopi in akilam chiil ni a kipat tuni dongin ka lungthahna leh ka thangpaina atohthou sengta, tuaziehin ka mitmu akipat ka suonmang ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Israel tate leh Juda taten gitlouna abawl zousiete ziehun aleengte u’leh, amiliente uh, asiempute uh, aguolneite u’leh, Juda mite leh Jerusalem a tengte zousie in Kei ahing lungthah sah uhi."},"33":{"text":"Kei ahing nuangat ua, ahing maingat sih uhi; zingmawng matah a thou in, amaute hilhil nanlengzong, thuhilna zui dingin angaikhe nuom sih uhi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh ka min pua, tua inn asuhbua na ding un, asil kidah huoite uh akoi uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.10; Jer. 7.30,31; 19.1-6"},"35":{"text":"Tualeh sil kidahhuoi bawl a, Juda khielsah dinga thu ka pieh ngai vawtlou, ka lungsim a zong tuabang lut ngai vawtlou hinapi amauten atapate u’leh atanute uh Molek kunga meikuong laia apailut theina dingun, Hinnom tapa guom ah Baal munsangte alam uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.10; Jer. 7.31; Siempu. 18.21"},"36":{"text":"“Tuaziehin tuin, Mangpa Israelte Pasian in, namsau, kiel, leh natpi zang in Babilon leengpa khut ah akipekhe ding chia na gen uh tam khopi tungtang tambang in agen hi."},"37":{"text":"Ngai un, ka lungthahna, ka lunghilouna leh ka thangpaina thupitah a, amauh ka delmangna gam akipat in ka puikhawm kia dinga, tam mun ah bittah in ka tengsah ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh ka mite ahi ding ua, Kei a Pasian uh ka hi ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh hoina ding leh anua ua atate uh hoina dinga, kumtawn a kei ahing giin theina dingun, lungtang mun khat leh umdan kibang ka pe ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh amautoh kumtawn thuhun ka bawl dinga, atung ua hoina ka bawl akipat ka kiheimangsan sih ding hi; alungtang uah keima giinna ka koi ding a, kei akipat apeimang ngai nawn sih ding uhi."},"41":{"text":"Ahi atung ua silhoi bawl khu ka kipahna ahi ding a, ka lungtang zousie leh ka hinna pumpi in amauh tam gam ah ka phutdet ding hi."},"42":{"text":"“Aziehpen Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Tam mite tunga tuohsietnate zousie ka hing tunsah mabangin, akung ua ka chiem silhoite zousie atung uah ka tungsah ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Gam suhsietsa mi leh sa tenlouna Kaldai mite khut ah akipeta hi, chia na gen uh gam sungah loute akilei ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Benjamin gam leh Jerusalem khopi kimvel lah leh Juda khopite ah leh singtanggam khopite ah leh phaijang khopite ah leh simlam khopite ah miten sum in loute alei ding ua, kileina lai agiel ding ua, akha ding ua, tualeh theipimite ahan ding uhi, aziehpen asaltaan ua pat uh ka kinuale sah kia ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Mangpa thu Jeremiah kungah suongkul huongsunga aki khakhum laiin aniveina in ahing tunga,","title":"Thuhun namdet kiana"},"2":{"text":"“Mangpa leitung siempa, leitung lim leh mel nei a bawl a sudetpan tambangin agen hi: Amin khu Mangpa ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hing han inlen, ka hing dawng dinga, tualeh na theingailou sil thupi leh sil kiphuol ka hing musah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa Israelte Pasian in, khopi simna dinga lei kisepvumte leh namsau a suhsiet a um tam khopi a innte leh Juda leengte innte tungtangah tambangin agen hi."},"5":{"text":"Kaldai mite toh kidou dingin ahing kuon ua, hinanleh ka lungthahna leh ka thangpaina a ka tha ding mite shi luong in amunte uh adim ding hi; agitlouna zousiete ziehun tam khopi apat in ka mai ka phuolta hi."},"6":{"text":"Ngaiun, chidamna leh suhdamna ka hing puohpieh dinga, amauh ka sudam dinga tualeh muonna leh thutah kiningching ka neisah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Juda saltangte leh Israel saltangte ka kinualesah kia dinga, amasa lai bangin amauh ka tungding kia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka tunga akhelnate zousie ua pat amauh ka siengsah dinga, tualeh ka tunga athulimlou nate u’leh atatkhelnate zousie uh ka ngaidam ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam khopi tunga silhoi ka bawl dingte zousie tam leitunga na zakha namte zousie masangah kei a dingin, kipahna, pahtawina leh zatatna, min ahi dinga, tam khopi a dinga hoina leh lawchinna ka piehte ziehin zau in achitun ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Tam mun mihing lah umlou sa lah umlou ahawm guoha um Juda khopi leh Jerusalem gawlzingte suhsietsa mi leh sa umlou chia na genna mun ngei uah;"},"11":{"text":"Nopna leh kipahna awgingte, mouneipa aw leh mounu awte bang leh Mangpa inna kipahthu genna sillat hing tawite aw te leh tua sillat hing tawiten: Galkapte Mangpa khu phat un, Mangpa a hoi hi, A itna khu kum tawn in a umzing hi, achi uh akiza kia ding hi. Aziehpen Juda saltangte agam uah ka hing nuapui kia dinga masang lai bangin ka umsah kia ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"1 Khang. 16.34; 2 Khang. 5.13; 7.3; Ezr. 3.11; Late. 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; 136.1"},"12":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Mi lah umlou sa lah umlou a, kiloisa tam mun ah leh akhopite zousie ah belamchingten abelam honte uh akhawldam sahna ding uh gantatna munte a umtha kia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Singtanggam khopite ah, Phaizang khopite ah, simlam khopite ah, Benjamin gam ngiem lahte ah Jerusalem kim a munte ah leh Juda khopite ah, amauh simpa khut nuoi ah belamhonte akizui zung zung kia ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"“Ngai un, Israel innkuonte leh Juda innkuonte kunga silhoi bawl dinga ka chiemsate ka tangtunsahna ding nite ahing tungta hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Jer. 23.5,6"},"15":{"text":"Tua nite leh tua hun chiengin David khanggui akipat in, dihtatna Bameng khat ka poudohsah dinga, Ama’n gamsungah vaihawmna dihtah leh dihtatna in vaiahawm ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Juda hundam in a um dinga Jerusalem bittah in ateng ding hi; tualeh amin ding khu tami ahi ding hi, “MANGPA KHU I DIHTATNA” ahi."},"17":{"text":"“Aziehpen Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: David in Israel innkuonte leengtoupha a tou ding mi atasam ngai sih ding hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.12-16; 1 Leeng. 2.4; 1 Khang. 17.11-14"},"18":{"text":"Levi mi siemputen zong ka mai a tawplou a halmang sillatte lan ding, ann sillatte lan ding leh kithoinate bawl dingin mi atasam ngai tuom sih ding uhi.”","ref":"Kisim. 3.5-10"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thu Jeremiah kungah ahing tunga;"},"20":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ahun ding ua kiguot banga, sun leh zan umlou dinga, sun dinga ka thuhun leh zan dinga ka thuhun, na suhsiet thei u’leh,"},"21":{"text":"tuachi’n aleengtouna tunga tou ding tapa neilou ding leh, siempu Levi mite ka masang nasemte umlou dingin, ka suohpa David toh ka thuhun na suse thei ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Van a aasite akisim senglou bang leh tuipi gei a pieunelte te guol ahilou bangin, ka suoh David hahlesuonte leh ka mai a nasem Levimite ka pungsah ding hi.”"},"23":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Mangpa thu Jeremiah kungah ahing tunga,"},"24":{"text":"“Tam miten Mangpa’n ateldoh innkuon khu apaidohta hi chia agen uh ngaituo ngailou na hiei mah? Amaun tambanga ka mite amit mu ua nam chitham ahilouna dingun ka mite a simmaw uhi."},"25":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Sun dinga ka thuhun leh zan dinga ka thuhun adetlou a, tualeh van leh leitunga sil umdante ka guotlou ahileh;"},"26":{"text":"Jakob hahlesuonte leh ka suoh David zong ka paimang dinga, tuachi’n Abraham, Isak leh Jakob, hahlesuonte tunga vaihawm dingin ahah asuonte lah ah koima ka la sih ding hi; aziehpen asaltanna ua pat ka kinuale sah kia dinga, atung uah lainatna ka nei ding hi.”"}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar leh agalkapte zousie, athuneina nuoia um leitung leenggam zousie leh mipi zousiete’n Jerusalem leh akhopite zousie sim a ahing dou lai ua, Mangpa a kipat a Jeremiah kunga thu hing tung khu:","title":"Zedekiah saltanna dingthu","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.1-11; 2 Khang. 36.17-21"},"2":{"text":"“Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Pei inlen Juda leengpa Zedekiah kung ah va hilin; Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ngai in, tam khopi Babilon leengpa khut ah ka pe dinga, ama’n meiin ahal ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh akhut a pat in na suohta sih ding a, ahing kiman ngeingei ding a, ama khut ah ahing kipekhe ding hi, tuachi’n na mit in Babilon leengpa na mu dinga, aman nang kimaituo in ang houpi dinga, tualeh Babilon ah na pei ding hi, achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw Juda leengpa Zedekiah, Mangpa thu ngaikhie in, Mangpa’n na tungtang thu tambangin agen hi; namsau in na shi sih dinga;"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh hamuong tahin na shi ding hi, tualeh na masanga na um leeng masate, napu napate adinga gimnamtui ahalpieh bangun, nanga dingin zong ahal ding uhi. Tualeh “Kadei! pu aw,” chi’n ahing kaa ding uhi; aziehpen athu ka phuongdohta hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Jeremiah in Jerusalem a Juda leengpa Zedekiah kungah tam thute zousie agenta hi."},"7":{"text":"Babilon leengpa galkapten Jerusalem leh Juda khopi kinuasie zousie leh Lakish leh Azekah ahing dou laiun, tamte Juda khopite lah a kulpi nei khopi um nalaite ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tami leengpa Zedekiah in Jerusalem a um mi zousie toh, akung ua zalenna phuongdoh dinga thuhun abawlpi nua a, Mangpa akipat Jeremiah kunga thu hing tung khu ahi:","title":"Suohte tunga kizuoubawlna"},"9":{"text":"Michin in asuohpa ahiei, asuohnu ahiei, Hebru pasal ahiei, Hebru numei ahiei ahileh ahadoh ding ahi, mi koima aunau Hebru mi naseppieh a aumlou ding ahi, chi ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin tam thuhun a pang miliente leh mipite zousie in asuohpasalte u’leh asuohnumeite uh suotasah ding leh amaute saltangsah nawnlou dingin, tua thuhun apom ua, a suoh leh salte uh ahadohta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh anua in alungsimte uh aheng ua, ahadohsa uh asuohpasalte u’leh asuohnumeite uh anuamat kia ua athunuoi uah suoh leh sal in ataangsah kia uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa akipat Jeremiah kungah thu ahing tung hi."},"13":{"text":"“Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi; Izipt gam asaltanna inn ua kipat na pu napate uh ka puidoh laiin ama utoh thuhun ka bawl a;"},"14":{"text":"Kum sagina bei kuon chiengin michin in na unaupa Hebrumi na kung ua suoh dinga hing kizua mite na hadoh chiet ngeingei ding uh ahi. Kum guh na nna asep nua chiengin nang apat na zalensah ding ahi, ka chi hi. Hinanleh na pu leh pate un ka gente azui sih ua, abil u’zong adaw ut sih uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 21.2; Danp. 15.12"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n tumasang zepin na hing kisia ua, ka mitmu ah sildih na bawl ua, michin in a inn vengpa kungah zalenna na phuong uhi. Ka min puo inn ah, ka masangah thuhun nangawn na bawl uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n na kilehei ua, ka min na buasah uhi; michin in nouma utna a na zalensah uh, na suohpate u’leh na suohnute uh na nuamat kia ua, na thunuoi ua, suohpasal leh suohnumei dingin napui kia uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Noute michin in asanggampa kungah leh ainnvengpa kunga zalenna na phuondohna uah, ka thu na mang sih uhi, ngai un, noute adingin, namsau, kiel leh hipi kungah, zalenna ka phuong hi, tualeh noute leitung leenggam zousie lah ah chizat huoi in ka hing bawl ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh ka thuhun botsete, ka masanga athuhun bawl uh zuiloute khu bawngnou phal ni suo a, akaal a apei suoh bang in ka bawl ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Juda miliente leh Jerusalem miliente, michilgete, siempute leh mipi zousiete bawngnou phal ni kisuo kaala peisuohte khu,"},"20":{"text":"Amelmate uh khut ah leh a hinna uh tha sawma suite khut ah ka pekhe dinga, tuachi’n ashiluongte uh tungleeng vate leh leitung gamsate ann ahi ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Juda leengpa Zedekiah leh amiliente khu amelmate u’leh ahinna tha sawma suite khut ah, noute apat a peimangsa Babilon leengpa galkapte khut ah ka pekhe ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ngai un, amauh thu ka pe dinga, tam khopi ah ka hing kinuale sah kia dinga, amaun ahing dou ding ua, ala ding ua, meiin ahaltum ding uhi, tualeh ken Juda khopite ka suse gawp ding a, koima ateng thei sih ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim, leeng vaihawm lai a, Mangpa akipat Jeremiah kunga thu hing tung khu:","title":"Jehoiakim vaihawm laia Rekab mite","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.36—24.6; 2 Khang. 36.5-7"},"2":{"text":"“Rekab inn kuonte kungah haw inlen, amauh houpi inlen, Mangpa inn sunga pindan khat ah hing puilut inlen, adawn ding uh zu pie in,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken Habazziniah tapa Jeremiah, Jeremiah tapa Zaazaniah leh asanggamte leh atapate zousie u’toh Rekabmite innkuon zousie toh ka pui a;"},"4":{"text":"Ama ukhu Mangpa inn a Pasian mi khat Igdaliah tapa Hanan tapate pindan, kotpivengpa Shallum tapa Ma-aseiah pindan tunga, miliente pindan kunga um ah ka hing puilutta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Rekabmite innkuonte tapate masangah zu a dim belte leh noute, akung uah ka tunga, “Dawn un” ka chi hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun “Zu ka dawn sih dinguh, aziehpen ka pa uh Rekab tapa Jonadab in, noute leh na tapate un, kumtawn a zu na dawnlou ding uh ahi;"},"7":{"text":"Inn zong na lamlou ding uh, haichi zong na thelou ding uh, grep-huon na bawllou ding uh, neh zong na nehlou ding uh, hinanleh na dam sung teng uh puon inn a na ten ding uh ahi, mikhuol na hina gam ua ni tampi na ten theina dingun, chiin thupieh ahing pie hi, achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuamabangin koute leh ka zite hiin ka tapate uh, ka tanute uh hitaleh ka damsung sie uh zu dawnlou dingin ka pa uh Rekab tapa Jonadab in thu ahing pieh pouma ka zui uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ka tenna ding uh innte ka lamsih ua, grep huonte ka neisih ua, loute lah ka bawl sih ua, tualeh haichite zong ka tu sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh puon innte ah ka teng ua, thu ka mang ua, ka pa uh Jonadab in ahing thupieh zousie dungzuiin ka bawl uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh tambang ahing hi a, Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar tam gam dou dinga ahing kuontou laiin, hing pei un, Kaldai galkapte leh Siria galkapte azauhuoi zieh un Jerusalem ah ipeitou ding uhi ka kichi ua, tuachi’n Jerusalem ah ka umdenta uhi,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu Jeremiah kungah ahing tunga;"},"13":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambang in agen hi, Pei inlen Juda mite leh Jerusalem a tengte va hilin, ka thute ngaikhe dingin thuhilna sanglou ding na hi uoi mah? Mangpa’n achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Rekab tapa Jonadab in zu dawnlou dingin atapate thu apie a, athupieh azui ua, tuni tan dongin apu uh thupieh azui ziehun zu adawn sih uhi. Hinanleh ken zingmawng matah a thou in noute kungah thu kagen a, ka thu namang sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Na kung uah ka suoh guolneite zousie, matah a thouin ka sawl a, michin na umdan hoilou ua kipat in hing kinuale unlen, na sil bawlte uh siempha un, tualeh pasien dangte nuazui sih unlen, anna u’zong seppieh sih un, tuachi’n noute leh napu leh napate u’kunga ka pieh gam ah na teng ding uhi, achi uhi. Hinanleh nabil uh nadaw sih ua, ka gen zong na ngaikhe sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Rekab tapa Jonadab taten apa un akung ua athupieh amang ua, hinanleh tam miten ka thu amang sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai un Juda leh Jerusalem a tengte zousie tungah ka gensa sietna ka tungsah ding hi. Aziehpen amaute kungah thu ka gen a, hinanleh angaikhe sih uhi, amaute ka han a hinanleh ahing dawng sih uhi.”"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Jeremiah in Rekabmite innkuonte kung ah, “Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Na pa uh Jonadab thupieh na man ua, tualeh athuhilnate zousie na zui ua tualeh ahing thupieh dungzui a na bawl ziehun;"},"19":{"text":"tua ziehin galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Rekab tapa Jonadab in ka masang a ka nasem ding mi atasam ngai sih ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim leenga apan kum lina ah, Mangpa akipat Jeremiah kungah tam thu ahing tung hi.","title":"Laibu ziel halna","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.1; 2 Khang. 36.5-7; Dan. 1.1,2"},"2":{"text":"“Laibu ziel khat la inlen, tuanah Israel leh Juda tungtang thu leh namdang zousie tungtang thu na kunga kagen ni apat leh, Josiah hun lai apat a tuni tandonga ka thugen zousie giel in."},"3":{"text":"Juda innkuonten atung ua sil hoilou ka bawl tup zousie azah chiengun, michin a umdan gilou uapat ahing kinuahei khamaw sih ding ua, Ken agitlounate u’leh akhelnate uh ka ngaidam theina dingin,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeremiah in Neriah tapa Baruk ahana, tuachi’n Baruk in Mangpa thu Jeremiah kunga kigen zousie Jeremiah in akunga ahil bangbangin laibu ziel khat ah agielta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Jeremiah in Baruk kungah thu apie a, “Kei pen khakhum a um ka hita a, Mangpa inn ah ka haw theita sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin nang va haw inlen, Mangpa thu ka hing hil laibu ziel a na gelte, Mangpa inna mipite zah ah ann ngawl in vasim in, tualeh akhopite ua kipat a hing pawtdoh Juda mite zah ah zong na sim ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Amaun Mangpa mai ah thungetnate bawlin michin a umdan gilou ua kipat in ahing kihei kia khamaw ding uoi mah; aziehpen Mangpa’n tam mite tunga a thangpaina leh alungthahna aphuondoh khu athupi mama hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Neriah tapa Baruk in, guolnei Jeremiah in bawl dinga thu apieh zousie abawl a, Mangpa inn ah laibu ziel akipat, Mangpa thute asimkheta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuin Juda leengpa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim leeng vaihawm kum ngana, aha kuona ah tambang ahing hia, Jerusalem a mi zousie ding leh, Juda khopite akipata Jerusalem a hing peimi zousie a dingin, Mangpa mai a ann ngawlna aphuong uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Baruk in Mangpa kul kotpi tha kunga um, huongsung leituol sahtazaw a laigielpa Shaphan tapa Gemariah pindanah mi zousie zahin laibuziel apat Jeremiah thugente asimkhie hi."},"11":{"text":"Shaphan tupa, Gemariah tapa Mikaiah in laibu akipat a Mangpa thute azah tahin,"},"12":{"text":"leengpa inn a laigielpa pindan ah ava peisuh a, khunah milien zousie ana toukhawm ua; laigielpa Elishama, Shemaiah tapa Delaiah, Akbor tapa Elnathan, Shaphan tapa Gemariah, Hananiah tapa Zedekiah leh milien dangte ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Baruk in mipite zah a, laibuziel apat asim, zou in Mikaiah in azahte zousie amaute kungah aphuongdohta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin miliente zousie in, Kushi tapa, Shelemiah tapa, Nethaniah tapa Jehudi khu Baruk kunga, mipite zah a na sim laibuziel khu “Na khut in hing tawi inlen, hing peiin,” chi dingin asawl uhi. Tuachi’n Neriah tapa Baruk in laibuziel khu akhut a tawiin akung uah ahing peita hi."},"15":{"text":"Amaun akungah “Touphot inlen, ka zah ngei uah hing sim vawi” achi ua, tuachi’n Baruk in azah un asimta hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaun tam thute azah tahun, zauin khatlekhat aki entuo ua, Baruk kungah “Tam thute zousie leengpa kungah kahil ngeingei ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Baruk kungah, hing Pei vawi, “Tam thute zousie pi, Jeremiah hing gen banga nagel amah?” chiin a dong uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Baruk in amauh a dawnga, “Tam thute zousie akam in ka kungah aphuongdoh a, tualeh ken laibu sungah laitui in ka giel hi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n milienten Baruk kungah, “Pei inlen Jeremiah toh va kiphuol un, tualeh na umna mun uh koima theisah sihun,” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amaute leengpa kungah, ahuongsung leituol ah ava haw ua, hinanleh laibuziel khu laigielpa Elishama pindan ah akoi ua, thu zousie leengpa zah ah ahilta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Jehudi laibuziel la dingin asawl a, Jehudi in laigielpa Elishama pindan apat ahing tawi hi. Tualeh Jehudi in leengpa zah leh leengpa kunga ding miliente zah in asimta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh aha kuona ah, leengpa aphalbi inn ah atou a, amai a meikhuh ah mei akuong hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hi a, Jehudi in bung thum ahiei, li ahiei asim zou tahin, leengpa’n laigiel mi temta ala a, a attan a, meikhuh a meikuong a apailut a, meikhuh a meiin tua laibuziel akahtum masangsie in ahalta hi."},"24":{"text":"Hinapiin tam thute zousie za leengpa leh anasemte azau mawngmawng sih ua, apuonsilte u’zong abotkeh sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ahivangin Elnathan, Delaiah leh Gemariah in laibuziel haltumlou dingin leengpa kungah angen ua, hinanleh ama’n angaikhiet pieh sih hi."},"26":{"text":"Ngaikhiet pieh nahsangin, Lengpa’n Hamalek tapa Jarahmeel leh Azriel tapa Seraiah leh Abdeel tapa Shelemiah, laigielpa Baruk leh guolnei Jeremiah man dingin thu apie a, hinanleh Mangpa’n amauh aphuolmangta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n laibuziel leh Jeremiah gen banga Baruk in agel thute leengpa’n ahaltum nua in Jeremiah kungah Mangpa thu ahing tunga:","title":"Laibuziel kisusie gelkiana"},"28":{"text":"“Laibuziel dang khat la kia inlen, asungah Juda leengpa Jehoiakim in ahaltum laibuziel masapen sunga thute zousie giel in."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Juda leengpa Jehoiakim kungah, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Babilon leengpa pellou in ahing kuon dinga, tam gam asuse dinga, tana mi leh sa um zousie asugam sieng ding hi, chia na gel ahia, ana hal tum ta hi.”"},"30":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n Juda leengpa Jehoiakim tungtang thu ah tambangin agen hi: Ama’n David leengtoupha tunga tou ding mi koima anei sih dinga, aluong khu sun a nisa leh zan a daitui thuoh dingin ka paidoh ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama leh atate, tualeh asuohte, akhelna ziehun ka gawt dinga, ama u’leh Jerusalem a tengte tungah leh Juda mite tunga tung ding a ka phuondoh sil hoilou zousie ka tungsah ding hi; hinanleh angaikhe sih ding uhi,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeremiah in laibuziel dangkhat ala kia a, Neriah tapa laigielpa Baruk kungah apie a, ama’n tua sungah Juda leengpa Jehoiakim in mei a ahaltum laibu a thu umte zousie Jeremiah kam apat in agiel lut a, tuate ban ah zong akibahpi thu tampi abelap hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in Josiah tapa Zedekiah Juda gam a leengpa dinga aguot khu, Jehoiakim tapa Koniah taangin leengpa in ahing pangta hi.","title":"Jeremiah suongkul tana","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.17; 2 Khang. 36.10"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh ama hiin, anasemte hiin, gamsunga mite hitaleh, Mangpa’n guolnei Jeremiah tungtawn a athugente angaikheta sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Zedekiah in guolnei Jeremiah kungah Shelemiah tapa Jehukal leh siempu Ma-aseiah tapa Zephaniah asawl a, “Mangpa i Pasian kungah kou a ding tuin thungen in,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tulaitah in Jeremiah khu suongkul a kikhum nailou ahiziehin mipite lah ah, lut in apawt zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharaoh galkapte khu Izipt a kipat in ahing kuontou ua; tuachi’n Jerusalem va sim a um Kaldai miten tuabang tanchin azah tahun, Jerusalem apat apawtdohta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu Jeremiah kungah ahing tunga:"},"7":{"text":"“Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ka kunga thu dong dinga noute hing sawl, Juda leengpa kungah tambangin na gen ding uhi: Ngai un noute panpi ding a hing kuondoh Pharaoh galkapte amauh gam Izipt ah anuakia ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Kaldaimite ahing nua kia ding ua, tam khopi ahing dou ding ua, ala ding ua meiin ahaltum ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; “Kaldai miten eite hing peisan ngeingei ding uh ahi” chiin, nou leh nou kisol sihun; ahing peisan sih ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen noute hing dou Kaldai galkapte zou nan ulachin, alah ua miliem umsunte apuonbuh chiet ua kipat hing thoudohin tam khopi meiin ahal thou thou ding uhi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hia, Pharaoh galkapte a zau zieh ua, Kaldai miten Jerusalem asimlai uh a nuasie laiun,","title":"Jeremiah suongkul tawnga khumna"},"12":{"text":"Jeremiah Benjamin gam a amite lah a, anei alam umte va kemtup dinga, kuon dingin Jerusalem khopi apat apawtdoh panta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Benjamin kotpi a aumlai tahin, vengmite lamkai khat amin Hananiah tapa, Shelemiah tapa, Irijah kichi khat ana um a; ama’n “Guolnei Jeremiah khu Kaldai mite langa pang nahi,” chiin ana man hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeremiah in, “Tami zuou ahi, Kaldai mite langah ka pang vawt sih hi” achi a; hinanleh athugen angaikhe sih hi. Tuachi’n Irijah in Jeremiah aman a, miliente kungah ahing zawpita hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin miliente khu Jeremiah tungah athangpaita ua, avuo ua, laigielpa Jonathan inn ah suongkul ah akoita uhi. Aziehpen Jonathan inn khu suongkul a azah uh ahi."},"16":{"text":"Jeremiah khu suongkul sung tawng thuh leh pindan sung ah alut a khunah hun sawtpi ataang hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Lengpa Zedekiah in mi asawl a, ava ladoh sah a, leeng inn sungah aguh in ama adap doh a, “Mangpa akipata thu hing tung a um ei?” achi hi. “Um ma e” chiin, Jeremiah in adawnga; “Nang pen Babilon leengpa khut ah piehin na um ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Zedekiah in Jeremiah akimupi ni veina"},"18":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Jeremiah in leengpa Zedekiah kungah “Nang tung hiin, na nasemte tung hiin ahisihleh tammite tungah bang bawlkhiel ka nei a suongkul a nang khum ahiei?"},"19":{"text":"Babilon leengpa khu noute dou ding leh tam khopi dou dingin hing kuon sih va chia, na kunga gen na guolneite tu in hei a um ata uoi?"},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin hepitahin ngaiin, ka pu leengpa aw, ka thugen na mitmu ah pomtah hihen, laigielpa Jonathan inn ah hing nua peisah kia vawt sin, tuachilouin ka shi kha ding hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Zedekiah in Jeremiah khu suongkul huongsunga koi ding leh khopi sunga tanghou abei masangsie, nichin a tanghou bawlte gawlzinga pat tanghou pe dingin thupieh abawl hi. Tuabangin Jeremiah khu suongkul huong sungah a um denta hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Mattan tapa Shephatiah, Pashur tapa Gedaliah, Shelemiah tapa Jukal leh Malkiah tapa Pashur in mipite kunga Jeremiah thugen ana za uhi.","title":"Tuibem sunga Jeremiah kikhumna"},"2":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Tam khopi sunga umden pouma, namsau, kiel leh natpite in ashi ding uhi; hinanleh Kaldai mite kunga pei pouma ahing ding hi, ahinna khu ama dingin kipahman ahi dinga, ahing ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Tam khopi Babilon leengpa galkapte khutah akipe ngei ngei dinga, ala ding uhi, chia agen khu azata uhi.”"},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin milienten leengpa kungah, “Hepitahin tam mipa kithat heh, aziehpen ama’n tam khopi sunga umden galdou mite leh mipite zousie, tambanga agen ziehin azawngkhal sahta hi. Aziehpen tam mipa’n mipite hoina ding asui sih a, asietna ding uh asui zaw hi,” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zedekiah in akung uah, “En un, ama na khut ua um ahi. Lengpa’n noute kal in bangma abawl thei sih hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Jeremiah aman ua, suongkul huong sung a um, leengpa tapa Malkiah tuikul sungah akhesuh ua, khauhuol in Jeremiah khu akhaikhesuh uhi. Tualeh tua tuikul sung ah buonnaang chilou tui a umsih hi, tuachi’n Jeremiah buonnaang lah ah atumta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa inn a um michilgete lah a khat, Ethiopiami Ebed-Melek in, Jeremiah tuikul sungah akhesuhta uh chi azahtah in, leengpa khu Benjamin kulkotpi a atou laitah ahi a;"},"8":{"text":"Ebed-melek leengpa inn akipat apawtkhie a, leengpa ava houpi hi:"},"9":{"text":"“Ka pu leengpa aw, tam miten guolnei Jeremiah tuikul sunga apailut ukhu sil hoiloutah bawl ahi uhi; a umna mun ah gilkiel a shi mai ding ahi, aziehpen khopi sungah tanghou a um nawn sih hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Ethiopia mi Ebed-Melek thu apie a, “Tana pat in mi sawmthum zawpi inlen, guolnei Jeremiah khu tuikul sunga kipat in ashi masangin ladoh in,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ebed-melek in tua mite azawpi a, Sum koina nuoia leengpa inn ah alut ua, tuana kipat in puonsil lui kipaite leh puonsete aladoh a, tuikul sunga Jeremiah kungah khauhuol in akhaikhe suh uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ethiopia mi Ebed-melek in Jeremiah kungah, “Tami puonsil lui leh puonsiete na zah nuoi ah khauhuol toh gah det in,” achi a, Jeremiah in tuabangin abawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Jeremiah tuikul sunga kipat in khauhuol in akaidoh ua, aladohta uhi. Tualeh Jeremiah suongkul huong sungah a umdenta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuazou in leengpa Zedekiah in mi asawl a, guolnei Jeremiah khu Mangpa inn lutna thumna ah akungah azawpi a, tualeh leengpa’n Jeremiah kungah, “Sil khat ka hing dong ding hi, ka kungah bangma im neisin” achi hi.","title":"Zedekiah toh kimuna thumveina"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeremiah in Zedekiah kungah, “Na kungah hing phuongkheta leng na hing that sih ding amah? achi hi. Thuhilna hingpe leng zong hing ngaikhe sih vateh,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kungah aguh in akichiem a, “I hinna hing bawlpiehpa Mangpa ahin ziehin, ka hing shi sah sih ding a, na hinna sui mite khut ah zong ka hing peh sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuazou in Jeremiah in Zedekiah kungah, “Galkapte Pasian, Israelte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Babilon leengpa miliente khut a na kipieh leh na hing ngeingei dinga, tami khopi zong meiin akihal sih dinga, nang leh na innkuonpite na hing ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Babilon leengpa miliente kunga na kipieh sih leh tami khopi Kaldai mite khut ah akipe dinga, amaun meiin ahal ding ua, akhut ua pat na suohta sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kungah, “Kaldai mite khut a kipelut Judate ka giing hi, Kaldai miten amauh khut ah ahing pekhe ding ua, amaun ahing bawlse kha ding uhi,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Jeremiah in, “Amauh khut ah ahing pekhe sih ding uhi; hepitah in na kunga Mangpa thu ka gente sang mai in, tuachi’n nanga dingin ahoi dinga, na hing ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh na kipieh khieh nuom sihleh pen, Mangpa’n ka kunga alatsah tami ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ngai un tuin, Juda leengpa inna kinuasie numeite zousie Babilon leengpa uliente kunga piehkhiet ahi ding ua, tua numeiten: Na lawm hoipen pente un ahing solta ua, ahing zouta uhi Na kengte buonnawi lah ah atumta a, Amaun ahing kinua heisan kiata uhi; achi ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n na zite leh na tate zousie Kaldai mite kunga piehkhiet ahi ding ua, akhut ua pat na suohta vawt sih dinga, hinanleh Babilon leengpa khut a mat in na um dinga, tam khopi meiin ahal ding uhi, achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuazou in Zedekiah in Jeremiah kungah, “Tam thute koiman thei sih henlen, hileh na shi sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh milienten nang kang houpi chi azah ua, na kunga ahing haw ua, leengpa kunga bang ahiei nagen, tuin ka kung uah phuongdoh in, tualeh leengpa’n na kungah bang agen ei, ka kung uah bangma im nei sin, ka hing that sih ding uhi, ahing chi u’leh;"},"26":{"text":"tuachi’n nang ama u’kungah, Jonathan inn a shi den dinga hing sawlkia lou dinga, leengpa kunga ngetna va bawl ka hi, na chi mai ding hi,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n miliente zousie Jeremiah kungah ahing pei ua, adongta uhi. Tualeh leengpan athupieh zousie dungzui in amauh ana hil hi. Tuachi’n ama toh ahoulimna uh asutawpta uhi, sil umdan atheilou zieh un."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem kilah zou ni tan dongin Jeremiah suongkul huong sungah a umdenta a, Jerusalem kilah ni in, khunah a um hi.","ref":"Ezek. 33.21"}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Zedekiah leenga apan kum kuona aha sawmna ah, Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar leh agalkapte zousie, Jerusalem dou dingin ahing kuon ua, a imtawmta uhi.","title":"Jerusalem puanaleh Judate sal a puimangna tawpna (2 Leeng. 25.1-12)"},"2":{"text":"Zedekiah leenga apanna kum sawm leh khat, ha lina, ani kuo ni in, khopi kulbang phukeh in khopi sung ah alut uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Babilon leengpa miliente zousie ahing lut ua, Kulkotpi laita ah ahing tou uhi. Amaute: Nelgal-Sharezer, Samgar Nebo, Sarsekim, Rabsari, Nelgal-Sharezer, Rabmag leh Babilon leengpa milien dangte zousie ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hia, Juda leengpa Zedekiah leh galkapte zousie in, amauh amutahun, ataita ua, khopi apat zanlai in, leengpa huon lampi a kulbang ni kikaal a, kulkot ah apawtdohta uhi. Tualeh ama khu phaijang lampi langah apawtdoh hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Kaldai galkapten ama anuadel ua, Jeriko phaijang ah Zedekiah adelphata uhi; Ama aman ua, Hamath gam a Rebla ah, Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar kungah ahing zawpi ua, khunah aman atunga gawtna ding thutanna abawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Babilon leengpa’n, Riblah ah Zedekiah tapate Zedekiah mitmu ngel ah athat a, tualeh Babilon leengpa’n Juda miliente zousie zong athat hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Zedekiah mitte gel zong akheudoh pieh hi, tualeh sia khau in ahen a, Babilon langah azawpita hi."},"8":{"text":"Kaldai miten leengpa inn leh mipite innte meiin ahal ua, Jerusalem kulbangte asuchimta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n vengpawlte lamkai Nebuzaradan in khopi a mipi umsunte leh ama lam a pang dinga hing kipelutte leh mipi um nalai dangte toh, Babilon langah sal in apuimangta hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa vengpawl lamkai Nebuzaradan in Juda gam a mi zawng bangma neiloute anuasie a, grep huonte leh loute ama u’kungah apie hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in Jeremiah tungtangah leengpa vengpawl lamkai Nebuzaradan thu apie a,","title":"Jeremiah kiha khietna"},"12":{"text":"“Ama zawpi inlen, hoitahin bawl in, bawlse vawt sin, amabou na kunga agen bang bangin atung ah bawl in,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa vengpawl lamkaipa Nebuzaradan leh Nebushasban, Rabsari, Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag leh Babilon leengpa miliente zousie in mi asawl ua;"},"14":{"text":"tuachi’n Jeremiah khu suongkul huong sung apat in apuidoh ua, Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kungah, inn langa pui ding in akemsahta uhi, tuachi’n ama khu mite lah a atengta hi."},"15":{"text":"Jeremiah suongkul huongsunga khum a aum laiin Mangpa thu akungah ahing tunga:","title":"Ebed-Melek nuom man piehna"},"16":{"text":"“Pei inlen Ethiopia mi Ebed-Melek kungah va houpi inlen, galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai un, tam khopi tungah ahoina ding hilou in, asietna dingin ka thu gente tangtung sah ding ka hita, tua hun chiengin na mitmu ah ka bawl ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh tua ni chiengin nang pen ka hing hunkhe ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi, tualeh na giin mama mite khut a pieh in na umsih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen pellou in kang hunkhe ngeingei dinga, namsau in na shi sih ding hi, hinanleh na hinna khu nang a dingin na nuomman ahi ding hi; aziehpen keima tungah namuonna na koita hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem leh Juda akipat a Babilon a saltaanga puimangte lah a leengpa vengpawl lamkaipa Nebuzaradan in Jeremiah siakhau a hen pum a apui lai a, Ramah a kipata apeisah nua a, Mangpa akipat a Jeremiah kunga thu hing tung khu:","title":"Jeremiah kihadohna"},"2":{"text":"Lengpa vengpawl lamkai pa’n Jeremiah apui a, akungah, “Mangpa na Pasian in tam mun a sil hoilou tung ding ana phuongdohta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuin Mangpa’n tami ahing tungsahta a, agen bangin abawlta hi; aziehpen Mangpa tungah na khielta ua, athute na zui sih ua, tuazieh a tam silte na tung ua hing tung ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tuin en in, na khut a siakhaute akipat nang ka hing hadohta hi. Kei toh Babilon langa pei ding nanga dingin hoiva nachi leh hing zuiin hoitahin ka hing keem ding hi.
