Hinanleh Babilon a ka kunga hing pei hoi sihva na chileh hing zuida mai inlen, tanah um maiin; En in gam pumpi na masang ah a um hi, nanga dinga hoi leh lemtang nasahna mun mun ah peiin, achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuin Jeremiah anua peikia masangin, Nebuzaradan in akungah, Babilon leengpa’n Juda khopite tunga uhpipa dinga aguot Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kungah pei inlen, mipite lah ah ama toh tengkhawm in, Ahisihleh peina ding lem nasah na lamlam ah peiin,” achi hi. Tuachi’n leengpa vengpawl lamkai pa’n neh ding silpieh apie a, apeisahta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuazouin Jeremiah khu Mizpah khuo a Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kungah apeita hi, tualeh gam sunga kinuasie mipite lah ah ama toh atengkhawmta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuin gamlah a um galkap lamkaite zousie leh agalkapte un, Babilon leengpa’n Ahikam tapa Gedaliah khu gamsung uhpipa in abawlta a, tualeh Babilon a sal a puilou pasalte, numeite, naupangte leh gamsunga azawng bangma neiloute akhut ah akeemsahta hi, chi azahtah un;","title":"Gedaliah Jerusalem uhpipa apanna","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.22-24"},"8":{"text":"amaute Mizpah khuo a Gedaliah kungah ahing haw ua, khuna hing hawte, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael, Kareah tapate Johanan leh Jonathan, Tanhumeth tapa Seraiah, Netophath mi Ephai tapate, Maakath mi tapa Jezaniah leh amite utoh ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah in ama u’leh a galkapte uh hamuon dingin kichiemna abawla; “Kaldai mite nna sep ding zau sih unlen, gamsungah teng khinkhian unlen, Babilon leengpa nna sem un, nou a dingin ahoi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Kei ka hileh Mizpah ah ka um dinga, ikung ua hing pei Kaldai mite nna ka sem ding hi. Hinanleh nouten grep zute, nipi lai theigate leh sathaute lakhawm unlen na belte uah koi unlen, na lahsa khopite uah tengun,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuabangma in Moab gam leh Ammon mite lah a umte leh Edom gam leh gam tuom tuom a teng Judate zousie in, Babilon leengpa’n Juda mi lawikhat anuasie a, atung ua uhpipa dingin Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa Gedaliah akoita hi chi azahtah un,"},"12":{"text":"Delzaha a umna gam zousie ua kipat in Judate zousie ahing kinuale kia ua, Juda gam a Mizpah khuo ah, Gedaliah kungah ahing pei ua, uoin leh nipi lai a theigate kiningching tahin alakhawm uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Kareah tapa Johanan leh gamlah a um galkap lamkai zousie Mizpah khuo a Gedaliah kungah ahing pei ua,"},"14":{"text":"akungah “Ammon mite leengpa Baalis in Nethaniah tapa Ishmael, nangma that dingin ahing sawl hi chi na theichien ei mah?” achi ua, hinanleh Ahikam tapa Gedaliah in amauh atahsang sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kareah tapa Johanan in Mizpah khuo a Gedaliah kungah guhsim in agen a, “Hepitahin hing peisah inlen, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael kava that dinga, koiman athei sih ding hi. Bangzieh a aman nang ahing tha a, na kunga kikhawm Judate zousie akithethang ua, tualeh Juda mi umsunte abeimang ding uh chi’n agen hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Ahikam tapa Gedaliah in, Kareah tapa Johanan kungah, “Tambang sil na bawllou ding ahi; aziehpen Ishmael tungtang dihloutah in na gen hi,” achi hi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin aha sagina ah tambang ahing hia, leeng innsung mi, leengpa miliente lah a khat, Elishama tapa, Nathaniah tapa, Ishmael, Mizpah khuo ah mi sawm toh, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kungah ahing haw ua, tualeh Mizpah khuo ah ann anekhawm uhi.","title":"Ishmael in Gedaliah athana","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.25"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nathaniah tapa Ishmael leh akunga um mi sawmte ading doh ua, Babilon leengpa’n gam sung uhpipa dinga aguot Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah namsau in asat ua, athatta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ishmael in Mizpah a Gedaliah toh umkhawm Judate zousie athat sienga tualeh khuna um Kaldai galkapte zong athat hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Gedaliah athat chi koiman atheilou ni ni nua in;"},"5":{"text":"Shekem apat in, Shiloh apat in tualeh Samaria apat in, mi sawm giet akhamul uh metsiengin, apuonte uh botkeh in, atahsa uh kikuikeh gawpsa in akhut ua sillatte leh gimnamtuite tawi in Mangpa inn a lan dingin ahing pei uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuin Nathaniah tapa Ishmael khu amaute kimupi dingin Mizpah a kipat in lam tungtawn a kap kawm in ahing pei a, ama utoh akituoh tahin, ama’n akung uah, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kungah “Hing peiun” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n khopi sunga ahing luttah un, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael leh akunga a umpiten, amaute athat ua, tuikul sungah apailutta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh alah ua mi sawm in Ishmael kungah, “Hing that sih un, aziehpen kouten lou ah bu leh taang, sathau leh khuoizu phuolguh ka nei uhi,” achi uhi. Tuachi’n ama’n amaute a unaute lah uah athattel ta sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Ishmael in Gedaliah zieh a amithate luong apailutna tuikul khu leengpa Asa in, Israel leengpa Baasha a giin zieh a abawl ana hia; Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in tua tuikul khu mishi luongin adimsahta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuazou in Ishmael in Mizpah a mihing umsun, leengpa tanute leh Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kunga, leengpa vengpawlte lamkai Nebuzaradan in akepsah Mizpah khuo a um nalai zousiete sal in apui siengta hi. Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in amaute sal in apuimanga, Ammon mite kunga peipi dingin akipandohta hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Kareah tapa Johanan leh akunga um galkap lamkaite zousie in Nethaniah tapa Ishmael silgilou bawl zousie azah tahun;"},"12":{"text":"akunga um agalkapte zousie uh apui ua, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael toh kidou dingin akuon ua, tualeh amaun Gibeon a tuikul lienpi umna kungah adelphata uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ishmael kunga um mipi zousie in Kareah tapa Johanan leh akunga um galkap lamkaite zousie amu tahun, akipahta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ishmael in Mizpah apata sal a apuimang mipite zousie akinuahei ua, ahing kinua le ua, Kareah tapa Johanan kungah ahing peita uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Nethaniah tapa Ishmael khu mi giet toh Johanan apat asuohta ua Ammon mite kungah apeita uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kareah tapa Johanan leh akunga um galkapte lamkaite zousie in, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah nua a, Mizpah khuo akipat a Nethaniah tapa Ishmael apat Johanan in ahutdoh mi umsunte zousie, galkapte, numeite, naupangte, michilgete, Gibeon apat anua puikiate ahi uhi.","title":"Izipt gam a taina"},"17":{"text":"Amaute apei zel ua, Izipt gama pei sawm in Bethlehem kung nai a um Geruth Chimham mun ah a umta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah, Babilon leengpa’n gamsung uhpipa dinga akoi khu atha ziehin amauten Kaldai mite agiing mama uhi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkap lamkaite zousie leh Kareah tapa Johanan leh Hoshaiah tapa Jezaniah leh mipite zousie aneupen apat alienpen tan dongin ahing pei nai ua,","title":"Gamsunga nuasiete kunga Jeremiah vauhilna"},"2":{"text":"Guolnei Jeremiah kungah “Hepitahin ka ngetna na masangah pomtah hi henlen, kou tam mun a mi umsun nalaite adingin, Mangpa na Pasian kungah hing thumpieh dingin ka hing ngen uhi, (na hing mu bangmain tampi hilaipi tawmnoukhat nuasie in ka umta uhi)."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian in ka peina lampi ding u’leh, ka bawl ding uh silte ahing kohmu theina dingin ahing chi uhi.”"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Jeremiah in amaute kungah, “Na gen uh kana zata hi, Ngai un nagen bangun Mangpa na Pasian uh kungah, ka ngen dinga, tualeh Mangpa’n ahing dawnna pouma Kang hil dinga na kung uah bangma ka hing im sih ding,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Jeremiah kungah, “Mangpa na Pasian in nang hing sawl a, ka kung ua ahing thugen banga ka bawllou pouma u’leh, Mangpa khu ikaal ah theipitu dih leh ginum, hi heh,"},"6":{"text":"Ahoi hiin ahoilou hitaleh, ka hing sawlna uh Mangpa ka Pasian uh kamsuo ka zui ding uhi; Mangpa ka Pasian uh kamsuo ka zui u’leh kou a dinga hoina ahi ding hi,” achi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ni sawm nua in Jeremiah kungah Mangpa thu ahing tung a:"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n Kareah tapa Johanan leh akunga um galkap lamkaite zousie tualeh mi zousie aneupen apat alienpen tandong ahankhawm a,"},"9":{"text":"akung uah; “Na ngetna uh amasanga tut dinga nang sawlnapa uh Israelte Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi:"},"10":{"text":"Tam gam a na umden u’leh ka hing luoipua sih dinga, ka hing tungding ding hi, ka hing botdoh sih dinga, ka hing phutdet ding hi; aziehpen na tung ua ka silhoilou bawlte ka kisia hi."},"11":{"text":"Na giin mama chiet uh Babilon leengpa giing sih un, ama giing nawn sih un, Mangpa’n achi hi, aziehpen noute hing hundam ding leh akhut apat hing hunkhe dingin keiman ka hing umpi hi."},"12":{"text":"Noute ahing khotuo theina dingin, na tung uah khotuona ka langsah dinga, na gam mama uah ka hing kinuale sah kia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten, tam gam ah teng sihva ung chia, Mangpa kamsuo thute na zui utsih u’leh."},"14":{"text":"Hilou e! Izipt gam ah ka pei zaw ding ua, khunah ka teng ding uhi, khunah kidouna ka musih ding ua, pengkul gingte ka za nawn sih ding ua, tualeh ann du a gilkiel lou ding ka hi uh na chi u’leh pen;"},"15":{"text":"Tuin nou Juda umsunte aw, Mangpa thugen ngai un, Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Izipt gam a lut a khuna ten tum chinten na hi u’leh;"},"16":{"text":"Tambang ahing hi ding: Na giin uh namsau in Izipt gam ah ahing delpha ding a, khunah na shi ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt gam a tengdinga pei tum chintente zousie tungah tambangin atung ding hi, namsaute, kielte leh natpite in ashi ding ua, atung ua ka tunsah ding sietna a kipat in koima asuohta sih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"“Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi; Ka lungthahna leh ka thangpaina Jerusalema tengte tunga ka sunbuoh bangin, Izipt gam a na lut chiengun, noute tungah zong ka lungthahna ka sungbaw ding hi. Tualeh noute pen mite hamse lawkhum, mite chizat, kamthauhauna leh simmaw, na hita ding ua, tam mun na ngai nawn sih ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Aw nou Juda umsunte, noute tungtangah Mangpa’n agen hi: Izipt ah pei sih un, tuniin noute kang vauhil ahi chi chientahin thei un."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa ka Pasian ukung ah thu hing ngetpieh inlen, tualeh Mangpa ka Pasian un agen zousie bangin ka kung uah phuongdoh inlen, tua dungzui in ka bawl ding uhi, na chi lai un, lepchie tahin nang gen uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh tuni’n na kung uah ka phuongdohta hi, hinanleh Mangpa na Pasian uh aw hiin, na kung uah kei ahing sawl a athugente zousie na zui tuom sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin teng dinga na zotna mun uah namsau in, kiel in, tualeh natpi in na shi ding uh, chi chientah in thei un.”"}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hi a: Jeremiah in mipite zousie kunga Mangpa a Pasian uh thugente zousie, Mangpa a Pasian un gen ding a akung ua asawlna thu zousie mipite kunga agen zouin,","title":"Izipt gam a suohta umsunte lah a Jeremiah thu nasepna"},"2":{"text":"Hoshiah tapa Azariah leh Kareah tapa Johanan leh mi kiliensah zousie in, Jeremiah kungah, zuou gen na hi, “Mangpa ka Pasian un nang, Izipt gam a teng dingin pei sih un, chi a gen dingin ahing sawl sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Kaldai miten ahing tha theina ding u’leh Babilon a ahing puimang theina ding ua, Kaldaite khut a hing pekhe ding a, Neriah tapa Baruk in, koute dou dingin ahing thusawl ahi,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kareah tapa Johanan leh agalkap lamkaite leh mipite zousie in, Juda gam a teng dingin Mangpa kamsuo khu a zuita sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Kareah tapa Johanan leh galkap lamkaite zousie in Juda gam a teng dinga, delmanga a umna nam zousie lah a kipat hing kinua le;","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.26"},"6":{"text":"Pasalte, numeite, naupangte, leengpa tanute leh michin teng; leengpa vengpawl lamkai Nebuzaradan in Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah leh guolnei Jeremiah toh, Neriah tapa Baruk toh, a nuasie zousie apuimangta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten Mangpa kamsuoh zuilou in Izipt gam ah apeita uhi, tualeh Tahpanhes tan dong apeita uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Tahpanhes ah Mangpa thu Jeremiah kung ah ahing tung hi:"},"9":{"text":"“Na khut in suong lienpi la inlen, Tahpanhes a Pharaoh inn lutna bul a um tehlei halna tungman lah ah, Juda mite mitmu ngelngel in phuol in;"},"10":{"text":"tualeh akung uah, galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: ngaiun ka suohpa Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar ka hansah dinga, tam ka suong phuolte tungah aleengtouna ka tungsah ding a, Aman a leeng puon inn azah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama ahing pei chiengin Izipt gam ahing dou dinga, shi dinga aguotte tungah shina atun dinga, saltang ding a guotte sal ah ataang ding ua, tualeh namsau a shi dingte namsau kungah apekhe ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Keima’n Izipt pasiente innte ah mei ka tawkuong ding a amauh ahal ding a, sal in apui ding hi. Tualeh belamchingpa’n apuonte asil bangin, Izipt gam in akivon dinga, tuana pat in galmuong in apei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama’n Izipt gam a um Beth-Shemesh a um suong milim khuomte ka satchim dinga, Izipt gam pasiente innte mei in ahal ding hi,” chiin gen in achi hi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Izipt gam a um, Migdol khuo a, Tahpanhes khuo a, Noph khuo a, tualeh Pathros gam a um Judate zousie tungtang thu a Jeremiah kunga Mangpa thu hing tung khu;","title":"Izipt gam a Judate milim bieh Jeremiah in ademna"},"2":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Jerusalem tung leh Juda khopite zousie tunga sietna ka hing tunsah zousie na muta uhi, tualeh ngaiun, tuni’n asegawpta ua, koima tenna lou a, taisan leh loi ahita uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amauh hiin, noute hiin, napu napate uh hitaleh, na theikhah ngailou uh pasien dangte be ding leh gimnamtui hal dinga akung ua peiin, Kei na hing suhlungthahna ding ua, na gitlou zieh uh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahivang in ka suoh guolneite zousie na kung uah matah a thouin, tam ka huot sil kidahhuoite bawl sih un chia gen dingin ka hing sawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun agitlouna ua pat kihei ding leh pasien dangte kunga gimnamtui hallou dingin abil uh dawin angaikhe nuom sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka lungthahna leh ka thangpainate sunbuoh in aumta a, Juda khopite leh Jerusalem gawlzingte ah, akuongzahta hi; tualeh tuni a aum bangin khopi sie leh nuasie in a umta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuniin, Mangpa galkapte Pasian, Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Bangzieh a, Pasal numei, naupang leh naungehte Judate lah a, koima asuohta umlou a, satkhieha a umna ding ua, tambang gitlouna thupitah bawl nahi uoi?"},"8":{"text":"Na tenna uh Izipt gam pasiente kunga gimnamtui hal a, leitung nam zousiete lah a, hamsethuoh leh gensiet na hi theina ding ua, nouma leh nouma na kisatkhiet theina dingun na khut nasepte un, na hing sulungthahta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Napu napate u’leh, Juda leengte leh azite uh gitlouna leh nouma gitlouna leh na zite uh gitlouna, Juda gam leh Jerusalem gawlzing lah a, gitlouna na bawlte uh manghilta nahi uoi mah?"},"10":{"text":"Tuni tandongin amaute akingaingiem sih ua, tualeh nou leh napu napate uh masanga ka koi ka dante leh ka thugousiete azui sih ua, zong agiing tuom sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"“Tuaziehin galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai un, na sietna ding u’leh Juda mite zousie sattan dingin ka hing maingat ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Izipt gam a teng dinga pei tum chinten Juda mi umsunte, ka thatgam sieng dinga, Izipt gam sungah apua ding uhi. Amaute namsau leh kiel a thagam sieng ahi ding ua, aneupen apat alienpen dongin namsau leh kiel in ashi ding uhi, tuachi’n amaute hamsethuoh leh chizat huoi leh kamthauhauna leh simmaw ahi ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen Jerusalem ka gawt bangin, Izipt gam a tengte namsau leh kiel leh natpi in ka gawt ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda gam a umsun Izipt gam a teng dinga peite koima asuohta sih ding ua, hing pei kia a, tenna ding a alunggulna uh Juda gam a tung dinga suohta koima a um sih ding uhi; aguh a taidohte chiloungal koima ahing kinuale sih ding uhi.”"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n azite u’leh akung ua ding numei zousie toh mi tampi in pasien dangte mai ah gimnamtui ahal uh, chi thei pasal zousie leh Izipt gam a teng mipite zousie in Pethros ah Jeremiah a dawng ua;"},"16":{"text":"“Mangpa min a ka kung ua na thugen kouten ka ngaikhe sih ding uhi, achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh kou leh ka pu ka pate u’leh, ka miliente un, Juda khopite leh Jerusalem gawlzingte a, ana bawl bangun, van leengnu kunga gimnamtuite hal ding leh akunga dawn sillatte sung dinga ka kam ua thupawt pouma, ka bawl ngei ngei ding uhi; aziehpen tuabanga ka bawl chiengun, nehletah ka kiningching ua, ka damthei ua, sietna ka thuoh sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh van leengnu kunga, gimnamtui hal leh akunga dawn sillatte sun ka tawpsan ua kipat in sil zousie ka tasam ua, namsau leh kiel a thagam in ka umta uhi.”"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh “Numei ten zong, van leengnu kunga gimnamtuite ka hal ua, amai a dawn sillatte ka sun laiun leh amanu biehna dinga tanghoute ka bawl lai un, ka pasalte uh phalna lou in ka bawl ngai uh amah?” achi belap na lai uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeremiah in ama kunga dawnna pie mipite zousie leh numeite zousie kungah;"},"21":{"text":"“Juda khopite leh Jerusalem gawlzingte a nou leh napu napate u’leh, na leengpate u’leh na miliente u’leh gamsunga mipite’n na hal uh gimnamtuite khu Mangpa’n theizing louin, alungsimah alut ngai sih amah?"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n na gamtat uh ahoilou zieh leh na silbawl hoiloute uh, tualeh na sil kidahhuoi bawlte ziehun, Mangpa’n ahing thuoh zou nawn sih hi. Tuaziehin na gam uh asegawpa chizat huoi, hamsethuoh leh tuni a, a um bangin koima tenlouna ahita hi."},"23":{"text":"Gimnamtui na hal zieh u’leh, Mangpa tunga na khelzieh u’leh Mangpa kamsuoh na zuilou ua, adante, athuguotte leh athutheisahnate na zuilou ziehun, tuni a banga, na tung ua sietna hing tung ahi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuathamlouin, “Jeremiah in mipite zousie kung leh numeite zousie kung ah, Izipt gam a um mi zousie in Mangpa thu ngai un.”"},"25":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Nou leh na zite un, van leengnu kunga gimnamtui hal ding leh dawn sillatte sungbo dinga kichiemna ka bawlte uh, ka tangtun ngeingei ding uh hi, chi in nou leh na zite un na kam un na gen ua, na khut nasep un na tangtung sahta uhi. Na kichiemnate uh na bawl ding ua na tangtung sah ngutngei ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin Izipt gam a teng Judami zousiein Mangpa thu ngai un, Ngai un, ka min thupitah sielin ka kichiemta hi, Mangpa’n achi hi, Mangpa Pasian ahing hi, chi’n Izipt gamsung mun chinteng a teng Juda mi koima kam ah ka min akiloukha nawn sih ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ngaiun, Keima’n ama ua dinga hoina hilouin, asietna dingun ka enkhe zing hi. Tualeh Izipt gam a um Juda mi zousie abeisieng masangsie un, namsau leh kiel in ka thatgam sieng ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh namsau apat suohta mi tawmnoukhat Izipt gam akipat in Juda gam ah ahing kinuale kia ding ua, tua hun chiengin Izipt gam a teng dinga va pei Juda mi umsunten koi thu ahiei adihzaw, kei thu ahiei, ahisihleh amauh thu, chi ahing thei ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh ka thu na sietna dingun na tung uah adingdet ding chi na theina dingun tami nou a dingin chiemte ahi ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ngai un, Juda leengpa Zedekiah melma ahinna lah sawm a suikawi, Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar khut a ka pieh bangin, Izipt leengpa Pharaoh-Hophra khu amelmate khut leh ahinna lah sawma sui amelmate khut ah ka pekhe ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.1-7"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim leenga apan kum lina a, Jeremiah in agenthaw thute Baruk in laibuziel a gelnua a, goulnei Jeremiah in Neriah tapa Baruk kunga ahilte tami ahi.","title":"Baruk kunga Jeremiah in hamuonna thu avaihah","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.1; 2 Khang. 36.5-7; Dan. 1.1,2"},"2":{"text":"“Aw Baruk, Mangpa Israelte Pasian in na kungah tambangin thu agen hi:"},"3":{"text":"Ka tung agih hi, aziehpen Mangpa’n ka dana tungah, lunggimna ahing belappieh ta hi, ka mauna in ka balaw gawpta a, khawldamna mawngmawng ka musih, na chi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tambanga akunga nagen ding ahi; Mangpa’n tambang in agen hi: Gamsung pumpi a ka lamsa khu ka phelse dinga, ka phusa khu ka botdoh ding hi, achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh nangma a dinga sil thupi sui na hiei mah? Suida konin, aziehpen ngaiin, tahsa nei zousie tungah sietna hing tut ding ka hi, Mangpa’n achi hi; hinanleh na hinna pen na peina mun teng ah, gallah nuomman bangin ka hing pe ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Namte tungtanga, guolnei Jeremiah kunga Mangpa thu hing tung khu:","title":"Izipt tungtang genlawhna"},"2":{"text":"Izipt tungah: Juda leengpa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim leeng apan kum lina a, Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in, alah Karkemish gama Euphrates luipi panga um Izipt leengpa Pharaoh Neko galkapte tungtang thu ah:","ref":"Isai. 19.1-25; Ezek. 29.1—32.32"},"3":{"text":"“Lum leh phaw neutawite thu pie unlen, galphuollam naiin hing kuon un."},"4":{"text":"Sakolte aphaw toh von unlen, sakol tungte ah tuong tou unlen, nou sakol tungtuong mite aw, na sia lukhu utoh dingdoh un, Na teipite uh tat hiem unlen, na sia puonahte uh silun."},"5":{"text":"Bangdinga amaute lungkie leh chimaw a, nua tai a ka vamu ata diei? Amihatte uh aguolelta ua, kintahin ataizahta ua, akinuahei vawt sih uhi; aziehpen munchin tengah zauna a um hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Taihatte zong tai mansah sih unlen, Mihatte zong suohta sih uheh; Euphrates luipi pang mallamah, akipal pua ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Tam Nile luipi khan banga khanga atuite luipi khan banga khanga atuite luipi luong banga kihot khu, koi ahiei?"},"8":{"text":"Izipt khu Nile lui bangin akhanga, atuite luipi luong kihot bangin akhanga, Aman, ka khangtou nalai dinga, leitung katuom suoh dinga, khopi leh asunga umte ka sumang ding, achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Sakolte aw hing peitou un, Kangtalaite aw kintah in delun, Mihatte hing pawtdoh unlen, lum tawi Ethiopia mite leh Ethiopia mite, tualeh thalpi toi Lidia mite, ma suon un."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen tua ni khu, galkapte Mangpa Pasian ni ahi, amelmate tunga phuba lah theina dinga phulahna ni ahi. Namsau in athatgam dinga, alungkim dinga, asisan uh khamtahin adawn ding hi. Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa Pasian in, mallam gam Euphrates lui pangah, kithoina lan ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Aw Izipt tanu nungah siengthou, Gilead ah kuontou inlen, singnai damdawi vala in, phattuomna bei in damdawi tam na zang dinga, na dam tuom sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Namten na zumna ana zata ua, na kaa husa gamsung adimta hi, mihat tunga mihat akipalpua ziehun, ani un apuakhawm ding uhi.”"},"13":{"text":"Guolnei Jeremiah kunga Mangpa thugen khu, tambang ahi; Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar ahing kuon dinga, Izipt ahing dou ding hi.","ref":"Jer. 43.10-13"},"14":{"text":"“Izipt gam ah phuongdoh unlen, Migdol ah phuongzah un, tualeh Memphis leh Tahpanhes phuongzah un, Dingkip unlen, kimansain um un, aziehpen na kimvel a umte namsau in thatgam ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Bangzieh a na galhangte taimang ahiei? Mangpa’n adelmang zieh a ding theilou ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Aman tampi apuasah a, Ahi, khat tungah adangte apua ua; Tualeh Amaun, Thou un, nuoisiena namsau taisan in i mite kung leh, i pienna gam ah ipei kia dinguh, achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Khunah akap ua, Izipt leengpa, Pharaoh athawmging ngai bep ahibou hi, Aman a hun kiguot khu apelta hi, a chi ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"“Amin galkapte Mangpa ahi, Leengpa’n achi hi, Ka hin laisie in, taangte lah a Tabor taang bang leh, tuipi panga Karmel taang bangin, Ama ang pei kia ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Aw nang Izipt gam a teng tanu, saltaang dingin kigingsa in um un, aziehpen Memphis khopi akisuse dinga, ateng ding umlouin, a hawm in akinuasie ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Izipt khu bawngla hoitah bang ahi a, hinanleh sietna ahing tung dinga, mallam akipat in ahing tung ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Alah ua sumthalaw a galdou dinga, agoite uh zong bawngtal thautah bangin, alah uah a um uhi, aziehpen amauh akinua hei ua, ataimang khawmta uhi; atuohsietna ni u’leh, akigawtna ni uh atung ua ahing tun taah ziehin, ading thei tasih uhi."},"22":{"text":"“Athawmging khu gulpi kithol ging bang mai ahi dinga, aziehpen galkap hon toh ahing pei ding ua, sing phuate bangin heipi toh amauh dou dingin, ahing kuon ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"A gammangte sa mama nanleh, aphua kieu ding uhi, amaute khauphe hon sanga tamzaw ahi ua, simseng guol ahi sih uhi."},"24":{"text":"Izipt tanu khu azala dinga, mallam gam mite khut ah piehkhiet in a um ding hi.”"},"25":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in agen hi: “Ngai un, No khuo a Amon leh mipite leh Pharaoh tualeh Izipt khu apasiente utoh, aleengpa utoh Pharaoh leh ama tahsang zousie ka gawt ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh ama ukhu ahinna uh suite khut leh Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar khut leh asuohte khut ah ka pekhe dinga, tuazou chiengin masang lai nite bangin luo in a um kia ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"27":{"text":"“Hinanleh zausin Aw nang ka suoh Jakob tualeh lungke sin, Aw Israel, aziehpen Ngai un, nang pen gamlapi akipat kang hundam dinga, tualeh na hah nasuonte asaltaanna gam ua pat in ka hundam ding hi. Jakob ahing kinuale kia dinga, akhawldam dinga, lungmuong tahin a um dinga, koiman azausah nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Jer. 30.10,11"},"28":{"text":"Ka suohpa Jakob aw zau vawtsin, nang ka hing umpi hi; aziehpen ka hing delmangna namte zousie, ka subei sieng dinga, hinanleh nang pen ka hing subei sih ding hi hinanleh a hun giap in ka hing bawl hoi dinga, gawtlou keei innvang ka hing nuasie sih ding hi.”"}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pharaoh in Gaza asim masanga, Philistinte tungtang a goulnei Jeremiah kunga Mangpa thu hing tung khu:","title":"Philistin tungtang genlawhna","ref":"Isai. 14.29-31; Ezek. 25.15-17; Joel. 3.4-8; Amos. 1.6-8; Zeph. 2.4-7; Zek. 9.5-7"},"2":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ngai un, mallam akipat in tui ahing lien a, tui sanglet ahing hi dinga, Gamsung leh asunga umte zousie, tualeh khopi leh asung a tengte atum dinga a, tuachi’n mite akikou ding ua, Gam sunga tengte zousie, amau ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Asakol hattahte kengchin totgingte, Sakolleng taigingte, sakolleng keng kipei gingte ah, hansanna atahsap tah ziehun, paten atate uh anua et ngam sih ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Philistinte suhmangthaina ni leh, Tai-ar leh Sidon apat panpi thei ding mi, Umsunte sattan nading ni ahing tun ziehin, Mangpa’n Kaphtor gam a Philistin mi um sunte asumang ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Gaza lutang akiheu kieuta Ashkelon aphaijang a mi umsunte toh satkhieh ahita. Bangtan vei nouma leh, nouma ki at ding nahi uoi?"},"6":{"text":"Aw nang Mangpa namsau, bangtan vei sip dildel ding na hiei? Na pai sungah kisietlut inlen, um khinkhian inlen, sip in."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa’n bawl dinga thu hing pie hiven, bang dingin asip dildel thei diei? Ashkelon leh tuipi pieu dou dingin, Ama’n tami aguotta hi.”"}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moab tungtang ah galkapte Mangpa Israelte, Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “Nebo tung agih hi, aziehpen suhsiet in a umta hi, Kiriathaim zumsah in a umta a, lah in a umta, akulpi sangtahte zumsah ahita a achimawta hi.","title":"Moab tungtang genlawhna","ref":"Isai. 15.1—16.14; 25.10-12; Ezek. 25.8-11; Amos. 2.1-3; Zeph. 2.8-11"},"2":{"text":"Moab in pahtat alaw nawn sih ding hi, Heshbon ah asietna ding angaituo uhi, hing peiun, nam khat ahina uh sattan vai, akichi uhi. Madmen khuo aw nang zong sattan a um ding na hi; namsau in ahing del ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"“Horonaim apat in kikou aw ging leh, manthaina leh sietna a um ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Moab suhmangthai ahita, ataneute uh kaa aw ging zahin a umta."},"5":{"text":"Luhith peitouna lampi ah kapkawm in apeitou uhi. Aziehpen Horonaim peisuhna lampi ah, melmaten manthaina kikou aw ging azata uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tai unlen, na hinna uh humbit un, Gamdai a, gam sabiltung bangin um un."},"7":{"text":"Na kulpite u’leh na hausatnate uh na muon ziehun, noute zong puimangin na um ding uhi. Tualeh Kemosh khu asiempute leh amiliente, toh sal a puimang khawm in a um ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh suse dingpa khopi chinteng tungah, ahing pei dinga, khopi khat zong asuohta sih ding hi. Phaizawlte amangthai dinga, phaijang khu suhsiet ahi ding hi, Mangpa’n agensa bang ngeiin."},"9":{"text":"“Alenmang theina dingin, Moab kungah ha pie un, akhopite nuasie ahi dinga, asungah koima ateng nawn sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Koi zong thase kawm a Mangpa nasem khu, hamse law in um heh, sisan suolou dinga anamsau, apai a siet kia khu hamse law in um heh."},"11":{"text":"“Moab khu khangdawng ahilai apat in nuomsa tahin a um a, adeibanga nuomtah a buol ahi a, bel khat apat bel danga hei awngin a um ngaisih a, sal a pui in zong aum ngaisih hi, tuaziehin atui ngaiin atui a, agimnamtui zong akiheng ngai sih hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tuaziehin ngaiun, anite hing tung ding ahita, Mangpa’n achi hi. Sungkhe ding mite ka sawl dinga, tuachi’n amaun asungkhe ding ua, abelte ahawmsah ding ua, athawlte atawkeh ding hi;"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Israel innkuonten amuon uh, Bethel azumpi bangun, Moab in Kemosh azumpi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Bangchidan a koute galhat, kidouna phuol a gal hangte kahi uh, na chi thei uh ahiei mah?"},"15":{"text":"Moab suhmang in a umta a, akhopite ukhu meikhu in azamtouta, atangval teltuomte uh thagam in a um siengta uhi, Amin galkapte Mangpa ahi. Lengpa’n achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Moab tuohsietna huoisetah hing tunna ding anaita, thuohgimna ahing tung pai ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Nou akimvel a umten ama kaa unlen, Nou amin theikha poumaten, Bangchidan a leengchieng khautah leh, kilawm khu sattan a um ahiei? chi un."},"18":{"text":"“Debon a tengte tanu aw, na thupina akipat hing kumsuh inlen, dangtah in touin, Moab susepa nangma dou dingin ahing kuontou a, na kulpite ahing suhsiet pieh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Aroer a tengte aw, lampi gei a dingin en un, ataidohpa leh asuohtanu dong unlen, Bangchidan ahiei? chi un."},"20":{"text":"Moab zumsah in a umta, suhsiet ahitaah ziehin, kap unlen kikoukhie un, Moab suhsiet ahita chi Arnon ah phuong un."},"21":{"text":"“Muoltung zang gam ah vaihawmna ahing tungta, Holon, Jahzah leh Mephaathte tung ah zong,"},"22":{"text":"tualeh Dibon tung leh, Nebo leh Beth-Diblathaim tungah,"},"23":{"text":"Kiriathaim leh beth-gamul leh Beth-meon tungah,"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Kerioth leh Bozrah leh a gamla leh, anai a um Moab gam khopite tungah atungta hi."},"25":{"text":"Moab kii khu sattan ahita a, tualeh aban zong sattan ahita hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"26":{"text":"“Ama zu khamsah un, Mangpa tungah akiliensah ta hi, Moab ama luoh ah akibuol ding a, mi nuisat in a um ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Israel khu nanga dinga nuizat huoi hitalou amah? Gutate lah a ama mukhah ahiei mah? Ama tungtang nagen chinin simmaw in na lu na lawkhum hi."},"28":{"text":"“Nou Moab a tengte aw, Khopite nuasie unlen, suongpi kawm lah ah teng un, leihawm kam gei a bu bawl vakhute bang un."},"29":{"text":"Moab kiletsahdan (Ama akiliensah sengseng hi) akikoisangdan, akisahtheidan leh kiletsahdan, tualeh alungtang kisahtheidan, ka zata uhi."},"30":{"text":"Athangpaina ka thei hi, Mangpa’n achi hi, Hinanleh adih sih hi, azuougenna in bangma aphatuomsah sih ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaziehin Moab a dingin ka kap dinga, Moab zousie a dingin ka kikoukhe dinga, Kir-Heres mite ka suun ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Aw Sibmah grepgui, Jazer ka kakhum bangin nangma ka hing kakhum ding hi. Na bazamte tuipi tungah azam a, Jazer tuipi tan dong atung uhi. Na nipi theigate leh, na grepga tungah susepa ahing tung hi."},"33":{"text":"Nopna leh kipahnate, ga tamtah suong theihuonte apat leh, Moab gam apat in lahmang ahita hi; grep suhna khuh a pat greptui ka kangsahta hi, Koiman kikou pumin achil nawn sih dinga, akikou u’leh zong kipahna kikou ahisih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"“Heshbon apat akikoukhie ua, Elealeh Jahaz tan dong aw asuo ua, Zoar apat Horonaim tan dongin, tualeh Eglath-Shelishyah tan dong in zong akiza hi, aziehpen Nimrim tuite zong akangta hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuathamlouin, Moab gam a munsangte a sil lanmite leh, apasiente u’kunga gimnamtui halte ka tawpsah ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuaziehin Moab suunna in ka lungtang theile bangin amau a, Kir-heres mite suunna in theile bangin amau ding hi. Tuaziehin hausatna amusa zousie uh abeimang siengta hi."},"37":{"text":"“Aziehpen lutang chinteng akiheukieu dinga, khamul chinteng metkieu ahita, khut tung zousie at-keeh ahi dinga, kawng tungah saiip puon akiteng ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Moab gam a inntungvumte leh agawlzingte ah, kaa leh mauna chilou bangma a um sih, aziehpen koima deilou bel bangin, Moab ka tokehta hi."},"39":{"text":"Bangchidan a suhsiet a um atai? Bangchidan a Moab zalataha anua langa zumkia vawt atai? chiin amau vengvung ding uhi. Tuachi’n Moab khu akim avel a umte dingin, nuizatbuh leh lungkieh umtah ahita ding hi.”"},"40":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Ngai un, muvanlai bangin aleengdinga Moab tungah aha azah ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Kerioth lah ahita, akulpite uh thakhat in akisim ding hi, tua ni chiengin, Moab galhangte lungtang numei nauvei abang ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh Moab khu nam khat ahina apat suhmang ahita ding, Mangpa kal a ama leh ama akitawisang ziehin."},"43":{"text":"Nou Moab gama teng mite aw, zauna kokhuh leh thang na masang uah a um hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"44":{"text":"Zauhuoina kipata taite kokhuh ah akeding ua, kokhuh apat pawtdoh pouma thangah a awh ding uhi. Aziehpen Moab tungah, amauh gawtna kum ka tungsah ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"45":{"text":"“Heshbon lim nuoi ah galtai basamte akhawl uhi. Hinanleh Heshbon apat mei ahing kuongdoh dinga, Sihon lah a akipat in akuongdoh ding a, Moab talpang leh mi kikou vengvung tate lutunga, manglukhu akatum ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Aw Moab na tung agih hi, Kemosh mite a mangthaita, na tapate uh sal a puiin a um ua, na tanute uh sal ataangta uhi."},"47":{"text":"Hinanleh, ni nukhia chiengin Moab vangphatna ka pe kia ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.” Tamtan chieng Moab tunga vaihawmna ahi."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ammon mite tungtangah Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Israel in tapate neilou ahiei mah? Gouluo ding neilou ahiei mah? Tua ahileh bangzieh a, Milkom in Gad aluo a, amite akhopi sunga teng ahi uoi?","title":"Ammon mite demna thugenlawh","ref":"Ezek. 21.28-32; 25.1-7; Amos. 1.13-15; Zeph. 2.8-11"},"2":{"text":"Tuaziehin ngai un, anite hing tung ding ahita, Mangpa’n achi hi: Tuachi’n Ammon mite khopi Rabbah ah kidouna thawmging kaza sah dinga, tam pen silsie kisevum kinuasie giap ahi ding. Tualeh akhoneute uh meiin akihal ding hi. Tuachi’n Israel in ama deldohte adeldoh ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"3":{"text":"“Aw Heshbon kap in mau in, aziehpen Ai khuo suhmang ahita, nou Rabbah tanute kap unlen, saiip puon teng unlen, kaa un, Kulpi sungah suhtai toutai un, aziehpen Milkom asiempute leh, amiliente toh saltang khawm ding ata uhi."},"4":{"text":"Bangdinga na phaijang hoite kisahtheipi na hiei? Aw muonhuoilou tanu, na hausatna muongin koi ahiei, kei dou a hing kuon ngam ding? na chi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ngaiun, na kim na pam a umte akipat in, zauna na tungah ka tungsah dinga, mi zousie deldoh in na um sieng ding ua, michin amazawn chiet uah atai ding ua, galtai vahthapte koiman apuikhawm kia sih ding hi, galkapte Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"6":{"text":"“Hinanleh, anuachiengin Ammon mi saltangte ka hing puikia ding, Mangpa’n achi hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Edom tungtang, galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Teman ah pilna um nawnlou ahiei mah? mipilte apat thuhilna beimang ahita amah? apilnate uh mangsieng ata amah?","title":"Edom tungtang genlawhna","ref":"Isai. 34.5-17; 63.1-6; Ezek. 25.12-14; 35.1-15; Amos. 1.11,12; Obad. 1.1-14; Mala. 1.2-5"},"8":{"text":"Dedan a tengte aw, tai unlen, kinua heiun, mun thuhtah ah tengun, aziehpen atung ah Isau tunga, sietna ka hing tungsah ding hi, ama ka gawt ni chiengin."},"9":{"text":"Na kungah grepga khawmte hing peita u’leh, grep sang themkhat beh nuasie neilou ding ahi uoi mah? Zanlai in gutate hing peita u’leh, adei za uh alah masangsie uh agu sih ding uh amah?"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh ken Esau saguohin ka umsahta, aselguh munte ka hawhkheta a, akisel thei nawn sih ding hi; ahah asuonte suhsiet ahita a, ama leh a unaute leh a innvengte toh, a um nawn sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Na naupang paneiloute nuasie unlen, Keima’n ka keem hing na ding hi, Tualeh na meithaite un kei hing muong uheh.”"},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Ngai un, nou dawntahlou ding achiten, adawnta ngei mai ua, gawtlou in na um thei pouma ding uoi mah? Gawtlou in na um vawt sih ding a, na dawn teitei ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Keima min louin ka kichiemta Bozrah khu, ahawma nuasie gensiet leh suhsiet, tualeh samsiet ahing hi dinga, akhopite zousie ase den ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa akipat thuthang khat ka zata hi, “Tualeh namte kungah palai khat sawl ahita, Kikhawm khawm unlen, ama dou dingin hing kuon unlen, galdou dingin kipan un.”"},"15":{"text":"Ngaiun, namte lah ah ka hing suneuta hi mihingte lah ah, simmawhuoi in ka hing bawl ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na chizat huoina leh na lungtang kisahtheina in ahing solta hi, Aw nou suongpi kawm lah a tengte leh, muolvum sanga tengte, Muvanlai bangin sangtah ah, na bu bawl nanlachin, khuna pat in ka hing luoikhe ding, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"17":{"text":"“Edom zong chizat huoi asuoh dinga, akunga peikha poumain chizat huoi asa ding ua, lamdang sa sengin a chiza ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Sodom leh Gomorrah leh akim apama khopite toh, suhsiet a a um bangin, khunah koima a um nawn sih dinga, mihing tapa khat zong ateng sih ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 19.24,25"},"19":{"text":"Ngai un ama khu Jordan gammang akipat in humpibahnei bangin, mihat tenna mun ah ahing kuontou dinga, hinanleh ama khu amanu a kipat in thakhat in ka taimang sah ding a; tualeh amanu tunga thunei dinga ka guot koi ahiei? Kei bang koi ahiei? Koi ahiei kei hing ngoh ngam ding? Ka masanga ding ding tua belampu khu koi ahiei?"},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin Edom tungtanga Mangpa lemguot leh Teman a tengte tungtanga asiltupte ngaikhie un, belamhon lah aneute pellou in akikaimang dinga, pellou in atenna uh amauh pumin asuse ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A pua ging un leitung akithingsah dinga, akaa ging uh tuipisan ah akiza hi."},"22":{"text":"Ngai un, ahing kuontou dinga, muvanlai bangin aleengtou dinga, Bozrah muol ah ahate azah ding, tuani chiengin Edom mihatte lungtang khu numei nauvei nat thuoh abang ding hi.”"},"23":{"text":"Damaska tung thu ah: “Hamath leh Arpad azalata uhi, thuthang hoilou azah ziehun, alungtang uh zauin azunta, amaute tuipi kihot siptheilou bangin abuoita uhi.","title":"Damaska tungthu","ref":"Isai. 17.1-3; Amos. 1.3-5; Zek. 9.1"},"24":{"text":"Damaska ahing zawngkhalta a, taimang dingin akihei a, zauna in ama amanta hi; lung khamna leh danain numei nauvei bangin amanta hi."},"25":{"text":"Bangzieh a, khopi minthang, ka kipahna khopi taisan a umta ahiei."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin atangvalte uh kholai dungah apua ding ua, tuani chiengin agalkapte zousie suhmang in a um sieng ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Damaska kulbangah mei ka tawkuong dinga, tami’n Ben-hadad kulpite akatum ding hi.”"},"28":{"text":"Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in ana zawsa Kedar leh Hazor leenggamte, tungtang thu ah Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Thou inlen Kedar ah kuontou unlen, suolam mite vasumang un.","title":"Kedar leh Hazor tungtang genlawhna"},"29":{"text":"A puon innte u’leh abelamhonte uh lamang un, apuonzahte u’leh a um abelte uh lamang unlen, nouma a dingin a sangawngsaute uh pomang un, kilchin ah zauna a um chi’n akikou ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Taimang unlen gamla pi ah vahmang unlen kokhuh thuhtah ah teng un, Aw nou Hazor a tengte, Mangpa’n achi hi. Aziehpen Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in nang douna ding siltup khat aneita hi."},"31":{"text":"“Thou unlen nam nuomsa lungmuong tah a amatang a teng kulkotpi leh a kalna zawl neilou, dou dingin mailam nawt un, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"32":{"text":"A sangawngsaute u’khu galmat ahi dinga, aganhonte uh galvanlah ahi ding, gamlapi a umte huilah ah ka thethang dinga, kilchin akipat in sietna atung uah ka tung sah ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Hazor khu si-alte tenna ahita dinga, akinuasie denta ding hi. Khunah koima ateng nawn sih dinga, mihing ta koima ateng sih ding hi.”"},"34":{"text":"Juda leengpa Zedekiah leenga apanchil lai a, Elam tungtanga guolnei Jeremiah kungah Mangpa thu ahing tung a;","title":"Elam tungtang genlawhna"},"35":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Ngai un, Elam thalpi ahatna bulpipen ukhu, ka tawngsah ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Van ning li apat hui lite Elam dou dingin ka hing tungsah dinga, amaute tua huite lah ah ka thethang ding hi; Elam mi deldoh a umte tunphah louna nam koima mawngmawng a umsih ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Aziehpen Keima’n Elam amelmate leh ahinna suite masangah ka lungke sah dinga, tualeh atung uah sietna leh ka lungthahna zauhuoitah ka tungsah ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi; tualeh abawn ua ka thagam masangsie’n anua uah namsau ka sawl ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Elam ah ka mangtoupha kadaw ding a, khuna pat in leengpa leh amiliente ka sumang ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"39":{"text":"“Hinanleh ni nukhialam chiengin, Elam saltangte ka hing puikia ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.”"}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon leh Kaldai mite tungtanga guolnei Jeremiah kunga Mangpa thugen khu:","title":"Babilon tungtang genlawhna","ref":"Isai. 13.1—14.23; 47.1-15"},"2":{"text":"“Namte lah ah phuongzah unlen, kitangkoupi un, tualeh puonlap khaisangun, phuongzah unlen bangma im sihun, Babilon laah ahita a, Bel Mualphou ahita, Merodak akehgawpta, a milimte Mualphou ahita, amilim pasiente akehgawpta hi."},"3":{"text":"“Aziehpen mallam akipat in ama dou dingin, nam khat ahing kuon dinga, agam asuse ding hi, asungah koima ateng sih dinga, mihing leh gamsate ataimang ding ua, koima tenna lou a, nuasie in a um ding hi."},"4":{"text":"“Tua nite leh tua hun chiengin Israelte ahing pei ding ua, Ama utoh Juda tate kap pumin ahing peikhawm ding ua, Mangpa a Pasian uh asui ding uh, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaun Zion zotna lampi adong ding ua, amai uh khumlang nga kawm in, hing peiun manghil ni umlou dingin, kumtawn thuhun in Mangpa toh ikizop ding uh, achi ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"“Ka mite belam mang ahita uh, aching miten alam pielsah ua, muoltung lah ah avahthangsah ua, muol apat tangtung lah ah avahthang ua, akhawlna mun uh amanghilta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute mu zousiein anegam ua, agalte un koute ka khiel sih uhi, Mangpa apu apate uh kinepna, dihna umna Mangpa tunga, akhel ziehuh ahi, achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Babilon apat in taikhie unlen, Kaldai mite gam apat pawtkhie un, kelhonte masang a keltalte bangun.","ref":"Kihil. 18.4"},"9":{"text":"Ngai un, Babilon dou dingin mallam gam a kipat nam thupi tahtah, kikhawmte ka tohthou dinga, tualeh ama dou dingin pan mun akhaw ding ua, tuana kipat ama lahzou ahi dinga, athaltangte u’khu galdousiem mihattah, khut guoh a nuakia ngailou bang ahi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Kaldai khu tomgam in a um dinga, ama tomgamte zousie alungkimta ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Kipah in nuomsa mama nan u’lachin, nou ka goutan sumang mite aw, loudawng lah a bawngla thau kidieng kawi bang nan u’lachin, tualeh bawngtal bangin ham nan u’lachin zong;"},"12":{"text":"na nu uh azum mama dinga, nangma hing pai nu khu azala ding hi. Ngai in amanu khu namte lah a neupen, gamdai, gamgaw leh senelgam, asuoh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa lungthahna ziehin, luolou gam ahi dinga, apumpi a luolou a, nuasie ahita ding hi. Babilon kunga peikha michin in, asiet dimdem dante lamdang sa in achiza ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Nou thalpi tawite aw, Babilon kimkot in panmun khawin kiguol unlen, kap un, thaltang khet sih un; aziehpen Mangpa tungah ana khielta hi."},"15":{"text":"Akimkot ah kikoukhum un, Ama leh ama akipedohta, akingapna suongphum apuata a, akulbangte a chimta hi, tami Mangpa phubalahna ahi, atungah phula unlen, aman midangte tunga abawl bangin, ama tungah bawl un."},"16":{"text":"Haichi thepa Babilon apat satkhie unlen, bu lahlai a kawite tawipa sattan un; nuoisiena namsau zauna ziehin michin amite kungah kile kia henlen, michin amau’gamlam chiet ah tai uhen."},"17":{"text":"“Israel khu belam kithethang bang ahita, humpibahneiten ama adelmangta, amasa in Assiria leengpan anegamta a, tuin atawpna ah Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in agute asutanta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin galkapte Mangpa Israelte, Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai un, Assiria leengpa ka gawt bangin, Babilon leengpa leh agam ka gawt ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel khu atenna gam ah ka puikia ding a, Karmel leh Bashan ah akivah dinga, ahinna khu Ephraim leh Gilead taang ah atai ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Khumi ni leh hun chiengin, Israel gitlouna akisui dinga, a um sih ding hi, tualeh Juda khelna akisui dinga, hinanleh akimu sih ding hi. Aziehpen ken ka mikhet umsunte ka ngaidam ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"21":{"text":"“Merathaim gam dou dingin kuontou unlen, Pekod a tengte dou dingin kuontou un; thatgam unlen, sumang siengun, tualeh thu ka hing pieh zousie bangin bawl un, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Gam sungah kidouna husa leh sietna nasatah a um hi."},"23":{"text":"Bangchidan a leitung pumpi sehpi khu, aphal phal a kisatkeh gawp atai! Bangchidan a Babilon namte lah a susiet gawpa um atai!"},"24":{"text":"Aw Babilon nang dingin thang ka kam a, na theilou kaala awh na hita ve, mu in na um a, mat na hita; Mangpa na dou ziehin."},"25":{"text":"Mangpa’n agalvan koikhawmna ahongta a, alungthahna galvan ahing ladoh a, tami Kaldai mite gam a galkapte Mangpa Pasian nasep ahi."},"26":{"text":"Gam ning tawp gamlapen akipat in, ama dou dingin hing kuon unlen, a bu innte hong unlen, bu vum bangin siekhawm unlen, nasetahin sumang unlen; bangma khawi nei sihun."},"27":{"text":"A bawngtalte zousie that unlen, sagoute kungah peisuhsah un, atung uh agih hi! Aziehpen amauh gawtna ni hing tung ahita."},"28":{"text":"“Mangpa i Pasian aphulahna, abiehinn a aphulahna Zion a phuongzah dinga, Babilon gam a pat a suohtate leh, galtaite awging khu ngaivawi un!"},"29":{"text":"“Babilon dou dingin thalkap siemte hankhawm un, Nou thalpi tawite zousie akimkot ah giehphuol sat unlen, koima suohta sah sihun. Anasep bangbangin thuh unlen, ama bawl bangbangin atungah bawl un. Aziehpen Mangpa Israelte Misiengthoupa, tungah akiliensahta hi.","ref":"Kihil. 18.6"},"30":{"text":"Tuaziehin atangvalte uh kholaidungah apua ding ua, agalkapte zousie uh tua ni chiengin, satkhieh in a um ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"31":{"text":"“Ngai vawi, mikiliensahpa ka hing dou hi, galkapte Mangpa Pasian in achi hi; aziehpen nang ka hing gawtna ni leh hun ahing tungta hi."},"32":{"text":"Akiliensah pen pa akipal dinga apua ding a, Koiman aphong sih ding hi, tualeh akhopite sungah mei ka tawkuong dinga, akimkot a umte zousie akatum ding hi."},"33":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi Israel tate leh, Juda tate suhgenthei khawmin a umta ua, amauh sal a mante’n dettahin atu ua, apawtdoh sah nuom sih uhi."},"34":{"text":"Atanpa uh ahat a, Amin galkapte Mangpa ahi, Aman amaute tungtang pellou in agen pieh dinga, agam uh khawldamna apieh theina dingin, hinanleh Babilon a tengte akhawldam sih ding uhi."},"35":{"text":"“Kaldai mite douin namsau aleeng hi, Babilon a tengte leh a miliente u’leh amipilte tung uah zong, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"36":{"text":"A phunsante uh douin namsau a leeng hi, mi mo asuoh theina dingun! amihatte uh dou in namsau aleeng hi, amaute suhsiet ahi theina dingun."},"37":{"text":"A sakolte u’leh a sakollengte u’leh alah ua, gamdangmi galkap umte dou in namsau aleeng hi, amaute numei ahing suoh theina dingun, agoute tungah namsau a leeng hi, lahpieh a a um theina dingun."},"38":{"text":"Atuite akangta, agaw gawp sieng theina dingun, aziehpen agam uh milim khenthu biehna gam ahi a, a milimte uh a motlaw siengta uhi."},"39":{"text":"“Tuaziehin gamdai gamsate leh ngiete ateng ding ua, vangawngsang zong asungah ateng ding ua, kumtawn in koima ateng nawn sih dinga, akiluo nawn sih dinga, akhang akhangin akilawi denta ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 18.2"},"40":{"text":"Pasian in Sodom leh Gomorrah leh, akimvela um khopite asuhmang mabangin, khunah koima ateng nawn sih ding a, mihingta asungah ateng sih ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 19.24,25"},"41":{"text":"“Ngai un, mallam akipat mi hon khat ahing kuon ding ua, tualeh nam thupi leh hat mama khat leh, leeng tampite leitung ning tawp akipat in ahing kitungdoh ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Amaun thalpi leh teipi atawi ding ua, agilou ua, khotuona anei sih ding uhi. A aw uh tuipi bangin ahawh ding a, sakol tungah atuong ding ua nangma dou dingin, galdou ding bangin akiguol ding uhi, Aw Babilon tanu."},"43":{"text":"“Babilon leengpa’n amauh tungtanga thutut azata a, akhut azawta, mangbatna in numei nauvei natna thuoh, bangin ama amanta hi."},"44":{"text":"“En un, ama khu Jordan luigei gammang lah a kipat in, mihat tenna mun a humpibahnei bangin ahing kuontou dinga; hinanleh ama apat in amauh thakhat in ka tai mang sah pai ding hi. Tualeh ama utunga thunei dingin ka deitel pen ka guot ding a, Keima bang koi ahiei um? Koi ahiei kei hing ngoh ngam ding? Belampu koi ahiei ka mai a ding ngam ding?"},"45":{"text":"Tuaziehin Babilon tung a Mangpa lunggel za un, tualeh Kaldai mite gam tungtanga asil tup khu, ganhonte lah a, anou neupen zong kai mangin a um dinga, pellou in gantatna mun a mite achi za ding uhi."},"46":{"text":"Babilon kilahzou ziehin leitung chitun in akiling ding a, akikou awging uh namte lah ah akiza ding hi.”"}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “En un, Babilon tungah leh Leb-Kamai a tengte tungah suse dingin, huipi hattah ka sawl ding hi.","title":"Babilon tunga vaihawmna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Babilon tungah zapsiengding mi ka sawl dinga, aman azapsieng dinga, agam ka hawmsuohsah ding hi. Aziehpen mangbat niin akim avel a umten ama adou ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Thalkap miten athalpi luoi sih uhenlen, sia puonah silin ding zong dingda uheh, atangvalte uh khatbeh hinkhawi sih unlen, agalkapte zousie uh that siengun."},"4":{"text":"Tuabangin galthate khu Kaldai mite gam ah apua ding ua, kholai dungah sutpailet a liem in a um ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Agamsung uh Israelte Misiengthoupa douna khelnain, dim nanleh Israel leh Juda galkapte, Mangpa a Pasian un ataisan ngaisih hi."},"6":{"text":"“Babilonte lah apat taikhie un, Tualeh michin in ahinna humbit hen, agitlouna ah sattan in um sih un, aziehpen tami Mangpa phubalahna hun ahi; Aman athuhkiana akungah ape ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Babilon khu Mangpa khut a leitung zousie, khamsahtu sana nou ahi! Namten a zu adawnkham ua, tuaziehin namte amota uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 17.2-4; 18.3"},"8":{"text":"Babilon khu thakhat in apuata a, susiet in a umta hi. Ama suun in mau unlen, anatna a dingin dam dawi la un, ahing damkia kha maithei hi."},"9":{"text":"Babilon ka sudam nuom uh hi, hinanleh adam thei sih hi. Nuasie unlen, michin eima gam chiet ah ikipei ding uhi; aziehpen atunga vaihawmna in van asuta a, vanthamzawl donga dopsang ahita hi.","ref":"Kihil. 18.5"},"10":{"text":"Mangpa’n idihtatna ahing kilangsahta, hing peiun, Mangpa i Pasian uh nasep Zion ah phuongzah vai."},"11":{"text":"“Thaltangte nawtval unlen, lumte khawm un! Mangpa’n Medes leengpa lungsim atohthouta hi, aziehpen ama siltup khu Babilon suhsiet ding ahi a, Mangpa phubalahna ahi; abiehinn a dinga aphulbalahna ahiziehin."},"12":{"text":"Babilon kulbangte ah puonlap khai unlen, venna hatsah unlen, vengmite koi un, galbuhnate bawl un, aziehpen Mangpa’n Babilon a tengte, sietna ding agensa khu angaituo a abawlta hi."},"13":{"text":"Aw nou tui tampi gei a tenga sum leh pai haumamate, na tawpna uh a hing tungta a, na hinna tena khau atanta.","ref":"Kihil. 17.1"},"14":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Ama min louin akichiem a, pellouin nang khauphete bangin, mihingin ka hing dimsah dinga, tualeh amaun na tungah guolzawna aw ngaitah toh, ahing kikou khum ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"“Ama’n asilbawltheina in leitung abawla, Apilna in leitung atungdoh a, atheisiemna in van akizahsah hi.","title":"Pasian phatna la"},"16":{"text":"Ama’n a aw asuohdoh chiengin, vante ah tui tampite ahing um khawm a, kawlmong apat in, tui meite azamtou sah hi, guo zuhna dingin tunphe aphesah a, a goubawm apat in hui alaangsah hi."},"17":{"text":"Michin theina neilou in, alungmawlta uh, dangkakheng michinteng amilim khente un azalasah ta hi; amilim sunthute uh zuou ngen ahi a, amau’sungah nahna hu a umsih hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute bangmalou suhkhelna nasep ahibou hi; akigawt ni chiengun abeimang ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Jakob tanvou khu ama uh bang ahisih a, Ama silbangkim siempa ahi a, tualeh Israel khu ama gouluo nam ahi a, Amin khu galkapte Mangpa ahi."},"20":{"text":"“Nang khu ka galdouna heitang na hi a, ka galdouna vanzah na hi. Nangma zangin namte ka satguoi a, nangma zangin leenggamte ka susie hi.","title":"Leengpa tha tupna"},"21":{"text":"Nangma zangin sakol leh atunga tuongpa, ka satguoi ding a, nangma zangin sakolleng leh, atunga tuongpa ka satguoi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Nangma zangin numei pasal ka satguoi a, nangma zangin tehsete leh khanglaite, ka satguoi hi; nangma zangin tangvalte leh, nungahte ka satguoi hi."},"23":{"text":"Nangma zangin belamchingpa leh, abelamhonte ka satguoi a, nangma zangin loubawlmi leh, abawngtal hahkolte ka satguoi a, nangma zangin uhpipate leh, vaihawmte ka satguoi hi."},"24":{"text":"“Na mitmu ngel ah Babilon leh, Kaldai a tengte zousie in Zion a, sildihlou abawlte zousie uh ka thuh ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","title":"Babilon gawtna"},"25":{"text":"“Ngai in, nang suhsiet hat taang aw, leitung pumpi susie, nangma ka hing dou ahi, Mangpa’n a chi hi. Nangma douna in ka khut kalam dinga, kawl suongte lah apat ka hing lia suh dinga, meikah kieu muol ka hing suohsah ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Koiman nang akipat inn ninga, pang ding suong ala sih dinga, inn suongphum dingin zong suong ala sih ding hi, hinanleh kumtawn a donloua segawp den nahi ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"27":{"text":"“Gam sungah puonlap khai unlen, namte lah ah pengkul mut un, ama dou dingin namte kisa sah unlen, ama dou dingin Ararat, Minni leh, Ashkenaz, leenggamte hankhawm un, ama dou dingin galkap lamkaite guot unlen, khauphehon kitawm un, ama dou dingin galkap lamkaite guot unlen, khauphehon kitawm letlut bangin, sakolte kuontou sah un."},"28":{"text":"Ama dou dingin namte, Medes leengte, a uhpipate leh, a vaihawm liente, tualeh athuneina nuoi a gam um zousie toh kisa sah un."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh gam khu lungkham in, akiling ding hi, aziehpen Babilon gam koima tenna lou dinga, suse dingin Babilon tunga Mangpa siltup khu, suhtangtung ahi ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Babilon galhatte kidou atawpta ua, akulpite uh sungah a um khinkhianta uhi, ahatna uh abeita a, numei abangta uhi, a umna munte uh ahalta ua, akotpi zawlte uh atanta hi."},"31":{"text":"Babilon leengpa kunga, akhopi ning chin apat lah ahita chi a gen dingin, patong khat in patong dang khat mu dingin atai a, thangkou khat thangkou dang khat mu dingin atai hi."},"32":{"text":"Alui kaannate khatan ahita a, pumpengte meiin ahalta uhi, tualeh agalkapte uh a zauta uhi."},"33":{"text":"Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in, tambangin agen hi: Babilon tanu khu bu vuohna phuol a bu kivuo bang ahia, hinapiin dachieng hun sawtlou nua chiengin, ama bu laah banga kilaah hun ahing tung ding hi.”"},"34":{"text":"“Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in ahing negamta a, ahing gawtguoita hi; aman bel hawmguoh ahing suohsahta a, Gulpi bangin kei ahing valtumta hi, ka tahsa tuituoh na lai tein agilpi avasah a, ahing nuasetdoh kiata hi."},"35":{"text":"Ka tung leh ka tahsa tunga hiemngamna kibawl khu, Babilon tungah tu heh;” Zion a tengten achi ding uhi; Tualeh “Ka sisan khu Kaldai gam a teng mite tungah tu heh,” Jerusalem in achi ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Ngai un, na tungthu uh ka hing genpieh dinga, na phuba ka hing lahpieh ding hi; tuipi ka kangsah dinga, atuinahte ka gawsah ding hi.","title":"Mangpa’n Israelte panpi ding"},"37":{"text":"Babilon silsie kisievum asuoh dinga, si-alte tenna mun ahi ding a, mun chizat huoi leh, chilphit khum leh, koima tenlouna ahita ding hi."},"38":{"text":"“Amaute humpibahnei bangin ahawhkhawm ding ua, humpibahnei noute bangin mi angih ding uhi."},"39":{"text":"Alungnop kipah laitahun annkuong ka luipieh dinga, ka khamsah dinga, akipah theina dingun, tualeh thou nawnlou a, a imutden theina dingun, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Gaw ding belamnoute leh belamtal leh, keltalte bangin amauh ka zawpi suh ding hi."},"41":{"text":"“Oh, bangchidan a Sheshak kila mawh atai leh! Oh, bangchidan a leitung pumpi pahtawi khu, mat a um atai! Bangchidan a Babilon khu namte lah a, chizat huoi khop a suhsiet atai!","title":"Babilon tanvou"},"42":{"text":"Babilon tung ah tuipi ahing khangtou a, atuikihot tampiten ama atuumta hi."},"43":{"text":"A khopite segawpin akiloita a, gamgaw leh gamdai, koima tenlouna leh, mihing tate vapei khahlouna gam asuohta hi."},"44":{"text":"Babilon ah Bel ka gawt dinga, akam sunga pat avalsate ka ladoh dinga, tualeh akungah namte apeikhawm nawn sih ding ua, Ahi, Babilon kulbang achimta."},"45":{"text":"“Ka mite alah ua pat in hing pawtdoh unlen, Mangpa lungthahna zauhuoitah apat in, na hinna uh humbit un."},"46":{"text":"Gam sunga thuthang na zah chiengun, lungke sih unlen, zau sih un. Kum khat in thuthang khat ahing thang dinga, akum kia chiengin thuthang dangkhat ahing thang kia dinga, tua thu khu gamsunga kigumbawlna thuthang ahi dinga, vaihawm mi leh vaihawm mi kidemtuona thuthang ahi ding hi."},"47":{"text":"“Tuaziehin ngaiun, Babilon milim khenthute tung a vaihawmna, ka bawlna ding nite ahing tung ding a, agam pumpi azala ding hi; tualeh ami kithatte zousie agam sungah apua ding uhi."},"48":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin lei leh van leh asunga um zousiete’n, Babilon tungah kipah thanuom in la asa ding uh, Aziehpen mallam akipat in akungah mi ahing pei ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Kihil. 18.20"},"49":{"text":"Babilon zieh a leitung pumpia tha a umte, zousie apua bangin, Israela tha a umte ziehin Babilon apua ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 18.24"},"50":{"text":"“Nou namsau apat a suohtate, peidoh kin un, muongin ding nalai sih un, gamlapi apat Mangpa thei ngitnget unlen, na lungsim uah Jerusalem geeldoh un.","title":"Babilon a um Israelte kungah Pasian thu"},"51":{"text":"Gensietna ka zah ziehun zum in ka umta uh, zumna in ka mai uh akhut a, aziehpen Mangpa inn mun siengthou sungah, gamdang mi ahing lutta hi."},"52":{"text":"“Tuaziehin ngaiun amilim khenthute tung a, vaihawmna ka tunsahna nite ahing tung ding hi, tualeh agam sung pumpi ah mi limte thum in amau ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"53":{"text":"Babilon van sunin sang nanleh, ahatna sangtah in kulpi kikhokhum nanleh, kei apat in sumang dingte akungah atung sah veve ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"54":{"text":"“Babilon apat in kaa leh mauna husa ahing um a, Kaldai mite gam a kipat suhmangna thawmging thupi ahing um hi."},"55":{"text":"Mangpa’n Babilon asuseta a, A aw ging ngaitah khu asipsahta, athawmging ukhu tui pi kihot ging bang nanleh, achimaw kikou ging un gamsungteng athawn hi."},"56":{"text":"Sumangtu khat Babilon dou dingin ahing tungta, agalhangte uh mat in a umta a, athalpite uh atawng siengta, aziehpen Mangpa Pasian khu athuhkia pa ahi a, Aman pellouin athuh kia ding hi."},"57":{"text":"Ken amiliente, amipilte, a uhpipate, alamkaite leh agalhangte, ka khamsah ding hi. Amaute alumden ding ua akhanglou nawn sih ding uhi, Lengpa, Amin galkapte Mangpa’n, achi hi."},"58":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Babilon kulbang liente khu achimse dinga, akulkotpi sangte meiin akihal ding a, amipiten amawhna’n nna asemgim ding ua, tualeh namte’n mei a halvaam ding bou ahi,” a gimpi uh."},"59":{"text":"Juda leengpa Zedekiah leenga apan kum lina a, Ma-aseiah tapa Neriah tapa Seraiah, Zedekiah toh Babilon langa apei lai ua, akunga guolnei Jeremiah thupieh tami ahi. Seraiah khu leengpa inn sunga neh leh dawn vaisai lien khat ahi.","title":"Jeremiah thu Babilon ah ahah uh"},"60":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeremiah in Babilon tunga sil hoilou hing tung ding zousie laibu khat ah agielkhie hi. Tam thu kigiel zousie Babilon tungtang thu a kigente ahi."},"61":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeremiah in Seraiah kungah, “Babilon ah na tun chiengin, tam thute zousie na simdoh ngeingei ding hi."},"62":{"text":"Tuazouchiengin, Aw Mangpa tammun tungtang ah thu na gen a, tam mun satkhieh in a um dinga, mi hiin sa hitaleh koima tenna lou a, kum tawn a suhsiet a um dingin thu nana genta hi; nachi ding hi."},"63":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, tam laibu nasim zou chiengin suong khat toh na kaanbeh dinga, Euphrates luipi lai ah na pailut ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 18.21"},"64":{"text":"Tuachi’n tambangin Babilon atummang dinga, atunga ka hing tut ding sil hoilou akipat athoudoh kia nawn sih ding hi. Tualeh amaute aba mama ding uhi,” chiin gen in achi hi. Tamte Jeremiah thute beina ahi."}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zedekiah leenga apan chiil in kumsawm ni leh khat a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm leh khat leeng in apang hi. Anu min Hamutal ahia, Libnah khuo a Jeremiah tanu ahi.","title":"Jerusalem puana"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Jehoiakim bawl bangbangin aman zong Mangpa mitmu ah sil hoilou abawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa lungthahna ziehin, Jerusalem leh Juda gam ah tambang sil ahing umta a, Amitmu apat amauh apaikhieh dongin, Zedekiah khu Babilon leengpa tungah ahelta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zedekiah vaihawm kum kuona aha sawmna ani sawmni in, Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar agalkapte zousie toh Jerusalem dou dingin ahing kuon a, khopi pulam ah giehphuol asat ua, khopi kimkot ah kul kikhokhumin panmun akho uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 24.2"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Zedekiah vaihawm kum sawm leh khatna tan dongin khopi khu imbuchip in a umta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh aha lina, ni kuo niin, khopi sungah kiel anase mama a, gamsung a mipite neh ding a umta sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n khopi kulbang asatvang ua, galkap zousie atai ua, leengpa huon kunga um kulbang nite kikaal a lampi ah zanlai in khopi apat in ataimangta uhi; Kaldai galkapten khopi kimkot in im nan u’leh, amaute phaijang lampi ah apeita uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 33.21"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Kaldai galkapten leengpa anuadel ua, Jeriko phaijang ah Zedekiah adelphata uhi, tuachi’n galkapte zousie ama apat ataizah siengta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun leengpa aman ua, Hamath gam a Rablah khuo ah, Babilon leengpa kungah ahing pui uhi, tuanah Babilon leengpa’n atunga gawtna ding thukhenna apuongkheta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Babilon leengpa’n Zedekiah tapate amitmu ah athat a, Juda miliente zong ama’n Rablah ah athat hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuazou in ama’n Zedekiah mitte akheudoh pieh a, tualeh Babilon leengpa’n sum-eng kol abun sah a, Babilon ah azawpi a, a shi ni tan dongin suongkul ah akhumdenta hi.","ref":"Ezek. 12.13"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n aha ngana, ni sawmni in, tua khu Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar vaihawm kum sawm leh kuona kum ahi a, Babilon leengpa vengpawl lamkai Nebuzaradan khu Jerusalem ah ahing tung hi.","title":"Jerusalem suh sietna"},"13":{"text":"Ama’n Mangpa inn leh leengpa inn tualeh Jerusalema innte zousie leh mi thupite leh miliente inn zousie zong meiin ahaltum sieng hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 9.8"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa vengpawl lamkaipa kunga um Kaldai galkapten Jerusalem kimvel a kulbang zousie asatchimta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n vengpawl lamkai Nebuzaradan in mizawngte pawl khat leh khopi sunga um nalaite leh Babilon leengpa kunga kipelutte tualeh khutsiem dangte zousie sal in apuita hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh vengpawlte lamkai Nebuzaradan in gam sunga mizawng pawlkhat khu grep huon kem ding leh loute bawl dingin anuasie hi."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa inn a um sum-eng khuomte leh akingahnate leh Mangpa inn a um tuikuongpi leh Mangpa inn a um zousiete Kaldai miten asatgawp ua, asum-eng zousie Babilon ah apawta uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 7.15-47"},"18":{"text":"Amaun belte, vut luohnate, meisuhmitnate, hengkuongte, tawkeute, leh siempute vanzah sum-eng um leh belte, zousie apomang siengta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh vengpawlte lamkaipa’n khutsilna kuongte, mei-am luohnate, hengkuongte, belte, meivah tunnate, tawkeute leh noute, sana sieng a kibawl zousie, abawn in apomang siengta hi."},"20":{"text":"Khuom nite leh tuikuongpi khat leh akitunnate, sum-eng a kibawl bawngtal sawm leh nite leh atunna ding kikhuohte, leengpa Solomon in Mangpa inn a dinga abawl tua sum-eng te gih dan teguol ahi sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Khuomte ahileh, khuom khat sandan tong sawm leh giet ahia, apum letdan tong sawm leh ni ahia, asa dan zung li ahi a; alaihawm ahi."},"22":{"text":"Khuompi dawn ah, khuomluboh khat a um a, tua khuomluboh khat tong nga in asanga, tua sum-eng khuom luboh kimvel khu khutsiemtah in akizem a, kawlbuthei lim a kizem ahi. Akhuom ni na zong kawlbuthei lim a kizem akibang ahi."},"23":{"text":"A pang ah kawlbuthei lim sawmkuo leh guh a um a, akimvel zousie a kizepna kawlbutheite khu zakhat ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh vengpawl lamkaipa’n siempulien Seraiah leh siempu ni na Zephaniah tualeh kot veng mi thumte sal in apuita hi.","title":"Babilona sal a puina"},"25":{"text":"Ama’n khopi sung a kipat in, galkap mite lamkai leengpa vaihawmpi mi sagi, khopi sunga um nalaite leh gam sunga galkap umte min gelna kempa laigielmi lamkai lienpa leh khopi sunga um gamsung mi sawm guhte toh sal in apuidohta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh vengpawlte lamkaipa Nebuzaradan in amaute zousie azawpi a, Rablah khuo a Babilon leengpa kungah atutta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hamath gam a Riblah khuo ah Babilon leengpa’n amauh asatlum siengta hi. Tambangin Juda agam apat in sal a puimangin a umta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tamte Nebukadnezzar in sal a apuimang mite tam dan ahi: Akum sagi na ah Juda mi tul thum leh sawmni leh thum;"},"29":{"text":"Nebukadnezzar leeng apan kum sawm leh gietna kum in Jerusalem apat mi za giet leh sawmthum leh ni,"},"30":{"text":"avaihawm kum sawmni leh thumna ah, vengpawl lamkai Nebuzaradan in Juda mi za sagi leh sawm li leh nga sal in apuimang hi; abawn un mi tul li leh zaguh ahi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda leengpa Jehoiakin saltan kum sawmthum leh sagina, ha sawm leh ni na, khum ha ni sawmni leh nga, ni in tambang ahing hi a, Babilon leengpa Evil-Merodak in, avaihawm kum khatna kum in, Juda leengpa Jehoiakim lutang adopkaang pieh a, suongkul apat aladohta hi.","title":"Jehoiakin hakhietna"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n kam nemtah in ama ahoupi a, Babilon a akunga um leeng dangte sangin leengtoupha sang zaw apie hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jehoiakin in asuongkul taanna puonte aheng a, tualeh ni sim in adam sungtengin leengpa toh ann ane khawm denta hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh ni sim a aneh ding leh apoimaw leengpa’n adam sung tengin, ashi ni tan dongin neh ding ape ngitnget hi."}}}}},"25":{"info":{"name":"Kaala","shortname":"Kaala.","abbr":[],"desc":"Kaalate"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mipi adim a umna khopi, bang achileh lungzuonga tou mawh ata diei! Namte lah a liensa nu, bang achileh meithai banga hing um ata diei! Gamkaite lah a leengtanu bang hinapi bangzieh a, gamdanga toukai khota hing suoh tavalong adiei!","title":"Kaala khatna: Jerusalem sietna"},"2":{"text":"Zan chiengin hasetah in akap a, abiengte ah hituite aluong hi, a it angaite lah ah ama hamuonding koima a um sih hi. Alawmte zousie’n ama lepchie tahin abawl ua, amelma asuoh siengta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Suhgentheina leh sepgimna nuoia saltang dingin, Juda apeita hi; namte lah ah atenga, khawldamna amu sih hi. Ama gawttute zousie in, apatau seng ziehin adelphata uhi."},"4":{"text":"Zion zotna lampite angui zouta, pawi bawlnate koiman ahing siim nawnlou ziehin, kulkotte akisegawpta a, anungah siengthoute suhgenthei in a umta, amanu lunggim tahin a umta hi."},"5":{"text":"Amelmate atunga vaihawm in apangta ua, agalte alawchingta uhi; Akhelna tampite zieh un, Mangpa’n dana athuoh sahta hi. Amelmate mai ah atate saltang dinga, puimangin a umta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Zion tanu apat in amelhoina zousie apeimangta. Amiliente zousie lah loudawng mu zoulou, sazuhtal abangta ua, ama delte mai ah thahatna neilou in ataita uhi."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem in suhgenthei a aum lai nite leh, alungkham a um lai in, nidanglai anopsahna zousie ageldoh hi. Amite, a galte khut a apua ua, koiman apanpilou tah in, agalten ama amu ua, akiehngiemna anuisat uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem in khelna huoisetah abawl a, tuaziehin abua gawpta hi. Ama zatat zousie’n asimmawta ua, aziehpen amaun asaguohna a muta uhi, Ahi, chimawin akihei mangta hi."},"9":{"text":"Asienthoulouna aniih ah abaang a, atawpna ding angaituo kha sih hi; tuaziehin apuana achizat huoi senga, ahamuon ding koima a umsih hi. “Aw Mangpa suhgenthei a ka umna en in, ka galpa akiguolzousah sengta hi.”"},"10":{"text":"Agalten amanu gou manpha zousie tungah akhut azah a, amunsiengthou sunga namte lut amuta a, na mi kikhawmte lah a, lut dinga na phalloute ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amite zousie achimaw ua, nah ging vahuoi in neh ding asui ua, ahinna uh humbitna dingin agou manphate u’toh, ann neh ding aheng ua, “Aw Mangpa hing en inlen simmaw a ka um dan ngaituo in!”"},"12":{"text":"“Nou lampi a vah leh peite a ding in, tami bangma lou ahiei mah? En unlen mu vawi un, Mangpa’n alungthahna zauhuoi ni a, ka tunga ahing tunsah ka gimthuohna, gimthuohna dang toh kibang mawngmawng a um ei mah!"},"13":{"text":"“Ama’n tunglam akipat mei ahing sawl a, ka gu ka taangte sungah thuhtah in alut hi; Ama’n ka kengte awhna dingin len azah a, ahing kinuahei sah a, sun nitum a khophawhlou a ba in ahing nuasie hi."},"14":{"text":"“Ka bawlkhelna hahkol khu a khuta kaan in aum a, phankhawm ahi uh, tualeh ka ngawng ah ahing kibaat a, ka thahatna abeisah hi, Mangpa’n ka nanzouloute khut ah ang pekheta hi."},"15":{"text":"“Ka lah a ka galhatte zousie Mangpa’n atuonchilta a, ahing dou ding leh ka khanglaite tuonchil dingin, galkapte ahankhawma, grep zu chil bangin Mangpa’n, Juda nungah siengthoute atuonchilta hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tam silte ziehin ka kap a, ka mit ah hitui aluong hi, ka hinna suhal dinga, hamuon ding mi kei akipat in agamla hi; ka galte a guolzaw taah zieh un, ka tate tasam in alieng vaita uhi.”"},"17":{"text":"Zion in akhutte azahkhie a, hinanleh ama hamuon ding koima aum sih hi. A innvengte amelma asuohna dingin, Jakob tung thu ah Mangpa’n thupieh abawlta hi. Jerusalem khu amaute lah ah sil sienglou asuohta hi."},"18":{"text":"“Mangpa khu adihtat a, kei pen athupieh kalin kana helta hi. Tuin mite zousie aw, ngai un, tualeh ka lungkhamna en un, ka nungahsiengthoute leh, ka tangvalte sal a puimangin a umta uhi."},"19":{"text":"“Ken ka it ka ngaite ka han a, hinanleh amaun ahing solta ua, Ka siempute leh ka upate lah ahinna uh, humbitna ding a aneh ding uh asui lai un, khopi sungah ashita uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Aw Mangpa ka genthei dan en ve! ka hinna abuoi gawpta a, Ka lungtang ka sungah akilumleta hi; aziehpen nasatahin kana helta hi. Pulam ah namsau a leenga, innsungah shina a um hi."},"21":{"text":"“Amauten ka chimaw thumna a za ua, Koima kei hing hamuon ding a um sih hi; Ka galte zousie in ka patauna azata ua; na bawldan mu in akipah uhi. Na puondohsa ni na hing tungsah dinga, ama u’zong keima bang ahing hi ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"“Agitlouna zousie uh na masangah hing tung henlen, ka bawlkhelnate zieh a ka tunga na bawl bangin, amau’tungah bawlin; aziehpen ka lungdonna atam sengta a, ka lungtang abata hi.”"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bangchidan a Mangpa’n Zion tanu alungthahna meilumpi a apumtuom adiei! Israel melhoina van apat lei ah apaikhie a, tualeh alungthah ni in akengngahna athei ngitnget sih hi.","title":"Kaala nina: Pasian lungthahna"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n Jakob tenna zousie avaltum siengta a, ahepi zouta sih hi. Athangpaina in Juda tanute kulpi dettahte achimsahta a, amaute tuol ah apaikheta hi, Ama’n leenggam leh leengtate, asubua ta hi."},"3":{"text":"Aman alungthahna zauhuoitah in Israel kii zousie asattan piehta hi; amelmate masangah, ama apat in akhut zietlam anua lahdoh kiata hi. Tualeh Jakob tungah akim avel, katum meikuong bangin akata hi."},"4":{"text":"Melma bangin athalpi aluoi a, melma bangin akhut zietlam toh adinga, amitmu a kilawm zousie athatta a, Aman alungthahna meikuong bangin, Zion tanu puonbuh tungah asungbuo hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa khu melma bang ahita a, aman Israel avaltumta hi, Aman aleeng innpite zousie anawmvalta hi; akulpi dettah asusie a, Juda tanute lah ah suunna leh kana apungsahta hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama’n abiehbuh khu huon bangin hiemngam tah in alamangta a, akikhopna munte uh asuhsiet pieh a; Mangpa’n pawi thupite leh khawlnite Zion amanghil sahta hi; athangpaina ziehin leengpa leh siempu anuolta hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa’n amaitam anuolta a, amunsiengthou ataisanta hi, Ama’n leeng innpi kulbaangte agalte khut ah apekheta hi. Amaun pawi bawlni thupi bangin, Mangpa inn ah akikou uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa’n Zion tanu kulbang suhsiet atumta hi. Aman tena khau azankhie a, suse lou dingin akhut anualah kia sih ding hi. Tuaziehin leikichieng leh kulbaangte, daa leh kap in, angui khawm uhi."},"9":{"text":"Akulkotpite lei ah atum a, akamna zawlte asusie a atawngsan sah hi. A leengpa leh aleeng tapate namte lah ah a um ua, dan a um nawn sih hi. Guolneiten Mangpa akipat in kilaahna amu nawn sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Zion tanu upate tuol ah atou ua, hamlou in a um uhi, alutung uah leivui akibuoh khum ua, sai ip puon sil in a um uhi. Jerusalem nungah siengthoute, lu tuol lam ngain akun suh uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ka hitui ziehin ka mit amiel gawpta, ka lungtang abuoi gawpta a; Ka sinkha tuol a sunbuoh ahita; ka mite tanu suhmangthai ahizieh in, naupangte leh naungehte kholai dung ah, sidangin abuhshi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amaun anute kung uah, “Bu leh uoin hei a um ahiei?” achi uhi; Khopi gawlzing teng a, shibup a aluplaiun, anute uh angsungah ahinna uh sunbuoh a aum lai un."},"13":{"text":"Nanga dinga bang ahiei ka gen thei ding? nang bang toh kangte thei diei, Aw Jerusalem tanu? ka hing hamuon theina dingin bang toh kang tekah diei? Aw nungah siengthou Zion tanu! Na sietna tuipi banga alet ziehin, koi in ang sudam thei diei?"},"14":{"text":"Na guolneiten nanga dingin, mengmuna dihlou leh mot huoi amu ua, na saltanna ua pat hing kinuale na dingin, na khelna uh, ahawhkhe sih uhi. Hinanleh nang a dingin mengmuna dihlou ahing mupieh ua, puikhelna genlawhna ahing genpieh uhi."},"15":{"text":"Na kunga hing peikhate pouma in khut ahing beh khum ua, Jerusalem tanu enghou in alu athinkhum ua, “Tami khopi himaw, kilawmna bukim leitung pumpi kipahna achi u’khu?” achi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Na melmate zousie in, nang gensietna in akam uh akah ua, engham in aha uh agawt ua, “Amaute’n amanu inawmvalta uhi, Tami ni khu galdot a ingah zing ni ngei u’khu ahi a, itangta ua, imuta uhi,” achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa’n alungtup abawlta a, nidang lai a athupieh atangtung sahta hi. Ama’n apaikheta a, alainat tasih hi, na tungah na melmate akipahsah a, Ama’n na melmate kii atawisangta hi."},"18":{"text":"Alungtang uh Mangpa kungah akikou khie a, Zion tanu kulbang aw, Na hituite luipi bangin sun leh zan in luong henlen, khawldamna kipe vawt sinlen, na mitte zong tawlnga sah sin."},"19":{"text":"Thou inlen, zanlai in kikoukhie in, zan ven hun kipat chiil in, Mangpa mai ah na lungtang tui bangin sungkhie in, gawlzing tenga gilkiela buhshi ding, nataneute hinna dingin, ama kunglangah na khutte zahtou in,"},"20":{"text":"Aw Mangpa en inlen, ngaituo vawi! tami koi kung abawl na hiei mah? Numeiten agil ua ga atate uh, aduot mama u’leh, a ang ua apomlai atate uh, sa ne talawm ding ahi uoi mah? Siempu leh guolnei Mangpa munsiengthou a, kithat talawm ding ahiei mah?"},"21":{"text":"Khangdawng leh tehsete kholai dunga, tuol lah ah alum ua, Nungah siengthoute leh tangvalte namsau in apuata uhi. Nangman amaute na lungthahna niin na that a, lainatna neilou in amauh na thatta hi."},"22":{"text":"Pawi bawl ni a mite na hatkhawm bangin, ka kim ka vel ah zauna na hankhawm hi. Mangpa lungthahna ni ah Nuasie leh, suohta koima a um sih hi. Ka dontei ka khawilette leh, ka galten asumangthaita uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Akungthahna chieng zanga suhgentheina, mupa khu keima ka hi.","title":"Kaala thumna: Jeremiah lungdonga akaana"},"2":{"text":"Ama’n ahing pui a, vah ah hilouin miel lah ah ahing pei sah hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama’n ka tungah pellou in akhut ahing ha a, sun nitumin ahun hun in ahing thuoh sah hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama’n ka tahsa leh ka vun avuoi sah a, ka gu kataang atawngsahta hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama’n kei ahing simta a, khatna leh tunggihna in ahing imkuol hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama’n nidang lai a shisate bangin, miel lah ah ahing koita hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama’n ka pawtdoh theilouna dingin, ka kimkot ah dai ahing kaikhum a, ka khainieng bu agih sah hi."},"8":{"text":"Kap a ka kikou chieng nangawn in, ka thumna ahing kha pieh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama’n suong kikhengte in ka lampi akhasan a, ka lampite akawi sahta hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama khu kei a dingin vompi mi ngah a lum bang ahia, humpibahnei mi buhdap bang ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ama’n ka lampi aheimanga, ahing mal neen a, hing taahlou in ahing bawlta hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama’n athalpi aluoi puoh a, athaltanga ngim dingin ahing taadoh ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Athal bawm a thaltangte ka sisan guizamte ah alutsahta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ka mite zousie nuisat ka hing hita a, sun nitum in la el toh ahing eng hou uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ama’n khatna in ahing dimsahta a, annkhapi tui ahing dawnsahta hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama’n ka hate suongtat in ang suhtawng pieha, vut ahing buohkhum hi."},"17":{"text":"Nangman lungmuonna apat, ka hinna gamlapi ah na suonmang a, nopsahna ka manghilta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Ken “Ka hatna leh ka kinepna, Mangpa akipat abeimangta hi,” ka chi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka thuohgimna leh ka vahvaina gamsai leh, khatna thei ngitngetin.","title":"Jeremiah in ginumna aphuonna"},"20":{"text":"Ka hinnain tuate athei zing nalai a, ka sungah lungkie in akunsuh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tami ka lungsim in ka phawhkhe kia a, Tuaziehin kinepna ka nei hi."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa khotuona zieh a nehgam a umlou ihi, aziehpen alainatnate azuou ngai sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuate zingmawng chin in atha zel a, Na gin umna alien hi."},"24":{"text":"“Mangpa khu ka tanvou ahi,” ka hinna in achi hi, “Tuaziehin ama ah ka kinem hi.”"},"25":{"text":"Mangpa khu ama ngahte ading leh, hagau a suite dingin ahoi hi."},"26":{"text":"Mi’n kinemtah leh sipkhinkhian a, Mangpa hundamna angah ahoi hi."},"27":{"text":"Mi’n akhangdawnlai a, hahkol apuoh ama a dingin ahoi hi."},"28":{"text":"Sip khinkhian in amatangin tou hen, aziehpen Pasian in ama tungah angata hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama’n akam leivui lah ah koi hen, kinepna a um thei nahlai na dingin."},"30":{"text":"Ama’n aphebengpa langah aphe dawhenlen, gensietna in dim hen."},"31":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n kumtawn in apaidoh sih ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Lunggim dana hing tungsah nanleh, alainatna tamdan dungzui in, khotuona alangsah nalai ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama’n, gimthuohna a ut mawnga ang tunsah ahi sih a, mihing tate zong asuh lunggim ahi sih hi."},"34":{"text":"Leitunga suongkul tangte zousie, akeng nuoi a tuonguoi dingin."},"35":{"text":"Tungnung Sangpen masang a, mi khat dihna heimang pieh dingin,"},"36":{"text":"Atuon aval a mikhat tunga thudih, heimang pieh Mangpa’n pha asa sih hi."},"37":{"text":"Mangpa’n thu apieh loupi a, thugen a, tangtung sah thei koi ahiei?"},"38":{"text":"Tungnung Sangpen kam akipat, asie leh apha hing pawtdoh hilou amah?"},"39":{"text":"Akhelnate zieh a mi khat akigawt chienga, bangdinga phun ahiei mah?"},"40":{"text":"I lampite uh suichien in, enchien vaiin, Mangpa lam ah kinuale kia va ui.","title":"Jeremiah in khelna phuongdinga angetna"},"41":{"text":"I lungtangte u’leh i khutte uh, van a Pasian kungah domsangtou va ui."},"42":{"text":"“Koute kana khielta ua, kana helta ua, nang
