lah nang ngaidam sih hi."},"43":{"text":"“Lungthahna in na kituomkhumta a, na hing nuadel a, lainatna neilou in na that ta hi."},"44":{"text":"Meilum in na kituomkhum ta a, tuachi’n ka thungetna uh apeisuoh thei sih hi."},"45":{"text":"Koute mipite lah ah buathah leh, silnieh paikhawm bangin na hing bawlta hi."},"46":{"text":"“Ka melmate zousie un, koute douna in akam uh ahing kahkhumta uhi."},"47":{"text":"Zauna leh thang ka tung uah, ahing tunga sietna leh manthaina toh."},"48":{"text":"Ka mipite tanu suhmangthai a a um zieh un, ka mit ah hitui luitui luong bangin aluong hi."},"49":{"text":"“Ka mit ah hitui khawl lou, tatlou in aluong ding a,"},"50":{"text":"Mangpa’n van apat in ahing en suh a, ahing mu masangsie in."},"51":{"text":"Ka khopi tanute zousie ziehin, ka mit in ahing lungkham sah hi."},"52":{"text":"“Ka melmaten azieh bei in va beh bangin, ahing beng uhi.","title":"Jeremiah suongkul taanna"},"53":{"text":"Ka hinna beisah tumin ka hingtangin, kokhuh sungah ahing pailut ua, ka tungah suong asep uhi."},"54":{"text":"Tui in ka lu atum manga, sattan a um hitavang ka chi hi!"},"55":{"text":"“Suongkul sung ngiempen akipat, na min ka hing han hi, Aw Mangpa."},"56":{"text":"Nangman ka aw na zata hi, panpina ngen a, ka hu la a, ka kikouna ah na bil hum sin."},"57":{"text":"Nang ka hing hat niin na hing nai a, zau sin na hing chi hi."},"58":{"text":"“Aw Mangpa, ka hinna tungtang thu nang nahing gen pieh a, ka hinna na tandohta hi."},"59":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka tunga sildihlou kibawlte na muta a, ka tungtang thu hingkhen pieh in."},"60":{"text":"Aphuba lah dan uh na muta a, ahing phielguh dan zousie uh na mu hi."},"61":{"text":"“Aw Mangpa ahing gensietna zousie u’leh, ahing phielguhna zousie uh na zata a,"},"62":{"text":"Ka melmate, kei hing dou a sun nitum tum a, akidap hounate uh na zata hi."},"63":{"text":"Atou suh uleh, adindoh uh, en vawi, a enghouna la uh ka hita."},"64":{"text":"“Aw Mangpa akhut nasep uh dungzui in, amaute thuhkia in."},"65":{"text":"Amaute lungtang khau sah inlen, na hamsietna atung uah tuta hen."},"66":{"text":"Na lungthahna in, amaute nuadel inlen, Mangpa van nuoi akipat in sumang in.”"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bangachileh sana khu hing muolta ahiei! bangachileh sana sieng sitset amel hing kiheng ata diei? Mun siengthou suongte, gawlzing tuohchilna mun tengah akithethangta hi.","title":"Kaala lina: Zion asietnua dinmun"},"2":{"text":"Amanpha mama Zion tapate sana banga manphate khu, bangachileh belkhengte khutsuoh, leibelte bang giap a ngai ahita uoi?"},"3":{"text":"Si-alte nangawn in zong anoute uh vahna dingin, anawite uh apie ua, atep sah uhi, hinanleh ka mite tanu khu gamdai a, gamva ngawnsang bangin ahing gilou hi."},"4":{"text":"Naungeh nawinete lei khu dangta na ziehin, adangtawng uah abeh a, Naupangten ann angen ua, koima’n ape sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Ann tui tahtah nete khu, kholai dungah amangthaita uhi, puonsandup sil a khanglienten vutvum akawita uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ka mite tanu gitlouna gawtna khu, Sodom khelna gawtna sangin anasa zaw a, khut mawngmawng in akhoi khahlou a, mitphiet kallou a suhsiet a um khu.","ref":"Siem. 19.24"},"7":{"text":"Amiliente uh vua sangin asieng zaw ua, nawitui sangin angou zaw uhi, amauh tahsa pum rubi suong mantamte sangin, chisan suoh zaw a, amel latdan uh saphire suongmanpha abang uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuin vang amel latdan uh innking sangin, avom zaw uh a, gawlzingte ah koiman athei theita sih uhi, avunte uh agu uah abeh a, chiengkang gaw abangta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Kiel a shite sangin namsau a shite ahampha zaw uhi, aziehpen tam miten lou apieng ann anehlou zieh un, agawngtam suh suh ua, gilkiel in apuashi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Lainatna hau numeite khutin, amauh tate sa ngelngel ahuon ua, amaute ka mite tanu suhmangthai a a um lai a; a ann uh ahi talawm uhi.","ref":"Danp. 28.57; Ezek. 5.10"},"11":{"text":"Mangpa’n athangpaina asutangtungta a, alungthahna zauhuoitah asungbota hi. Aman Zion ah mei atawkuongta a, tami’n asuongphumte akatumta hi."},"12":{"text":"Melmate leh galte, Jerusalem kotpite ah lut thei va uh chi, leitung leengte leh khovel a tengte zousie in, agingta sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Alah ua midih sisan suo, aguolneite khelna zieh leh asiempute gitlouna zieh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute mittote bangin gawlzing tengah avahvaita ua, sisan in akisubua ua, koiman apuonsilte uh nangawn atham ut tasih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Miten akung uah: “Peimang un! Siengloute!” peidoh un, peimangun, “Hing khoikha sih un!” chi’n miten akikou khum uhi. “Amaute ataimang ua, avahvaina lah ua namte lah a miten, “Amaute tam mun ah um nawn sih va uh,” achi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa ngel ngel in amauh athezah a, a ngaisah nawn sih ding hi. Mipiten siempute azatat nawn sih ua, Upate adeisah nawn sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Panpina thawn ngah in ka mitte uh avai siengta a, ingah ulah ahing hundam theilou nam khat, ngah ihi bou uhi."},"18":{"text":"I gawlzingte ua ipei theilouna dingun, miten isulnua azui uh, itawpna ding anaita, inite akimta, itawpna uh ahing tungta hi."},"19":{"text":"Ei hing nuadelte lah vanlaizawl a, muvanlai sangin a gang zaw ua, muolte tungah ahing nuadel ua, gamdai ah ahing buhdap uhi."},"20":{"text":"Inahkohawm ua ihaina hu uh, Pasian sathau nusa khu, akokhuh ua laah in aumta a, namte lah a “Ama halim nuoi ah ihing diing uh,” ina chi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Nuom inlen, kipahin, Aw nang Uz gam a teng Edom tanu; Nou khu nang kungah zong ahing tung ding a, na kham dinga, na kihawhkhe dinga guohtang in na um ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Aw Zion tanu na gitlouna gawtna khu abukimta hi; Ama’n saltang dingin ahing sawlmang nawn sih ding hi; Aw Edom tanu, na gitlouna, aman ahing gawt ding a, Aman nakhelna ahawhkhe ding hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka tung ua hing tungte thei ngitnget in, Ngaikhie inlen ka zalatna uh en in!","title":"Kaala ngana: Hepina ngen a thumna"},"2":{"text":"Ka gouluote uh meltheilou mite kunga, lehei ahita a, Ka innte uh gamdang mite kungah akipeta hi."},"3":{"text":"Taga leh pa neiloute ka hita ua, ka nute uh meithai bang ahita uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka tuisihte uh aman nei in ka dawnta ua, ka singte uh ka kung ua zua ahita hi."},"5":{"text":"Ngawnga hahkol vaw toh naw in ka um ua, ka semgim mama ua, khawldamna ka mu sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Neh ding ann khamkhop ka mu theina dingun, Iziptte leh Assiriate kungah khut ka daw uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ka pu leh pate uh ana khiel ua, a um nawn sih uh, hinanleh kouten akhelna gau uh ka pota uhi."},"8":{"text":"Suohten ka tung uah vai ahawm ua, akhut ua kipat hing hundoh ding koima a um sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Gamdai a namsau ziehin ka hinna uh, mansuo ding zauna toh ann neh ding ka mu uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ka vunte uh lungthukhuh bangin asa hi, kiel ahuoisiet seng ziehin."},"11":{"text":"Zion ah numeite apawngsuol ua, Juda khopite ah nungahsiengthoute, pawngsuol in a um uhi."},"12":{"text":"Lengtate akhut un akhailum ua, upate akizatat nawn sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Tangvalte buhehna suong ahehsah ua, Pasal naupangte singtun gihtah nuoi ah akisui uhi."},"14":{"text":"Upate lah kulpi kot ah atoukhawm nawn sih ua, khanglaiten lah tumging tum nawnlou uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ka lungsim kipahnate uh atawpta a, ka lamnate uh lu sunna asuohta hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka lutung ua pat manglukhu aketa, ka tung uh agih hi, ka kheltah zieh un.","title":"Khelna kisiana"},"17":{"text":"Tami ziehin ka lungtang uh abata a, tam silte ziehin ka mit uh amiel gawpta hi."},"18":{"text":"Zion muol khu nuasie a aumtah ziehin, si-alte atungah agamtata uhi."},"19":{"text":"Nang khu aw Mangpa, kumtawn in na umzinga, na Mangtoupha zong akhang akhangin a umden hi.","title":"Tunding kiana dinga ngetna"},"20":{"text":"Bangzieh a koute nang manghil den tahlawm a, tualeh tamtanveipi nang taisan ahiei?"},"21":{"text":"Nangma langah hing kiheisah in Aw Mangpa, tuachi’n nang lamah ka hing nuakia ding uhi; nidanglai bangin ka nite uh thasah kia in."},"22":{"text":"Koute hing nuol den a, ka tung ua lungthah den nata amah!"}}}}},"26":{"info":{"name":"Ezekiel","shortname":"Ezek.","abbr":[],"desc":"Ezekiel laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saltaan kum sawmthumna halina, khum ha ni nga niin tambang ahing hi a, Kebar lui gei a saltangte lah a ka um laiin, vante ahing kihonga Pasian apat kilahnate ka mu hi.","title":"Pasian thupina kilahna","ref":"Kihil. 19.11"},"2":{"text":"Khumi ha ni nga niin, tuakhu leengpa Jehoiakin saltan kum ngana kum ahi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.10-16; 2 Khang. 36.9,10"},"3":{"text":"Kaldaite gam a Kebar luipi gei ah Buzi tapa siempu Ezekiel kungah Mangpa thu ahing tunga, tualeh khunah Mangpa khut atungah a um hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka et leh Ngai vawi, mallam akipat in huipi hattah ahing langa, meilum thupitah meikuong in akimkot a apumtuom ahing umdoh a; avahin a kimvel atanvah a asunga mei-am laitah ah sia am banga am a um hi.","title":"Silsiem lite muna"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh tua lah a kipat in silhing li kibahpi ahing pawtdoh hi. Tambang amel puoh dan uh ahi a, mihing mel toh kibahna anei uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 4.6"},"6":{"text":"Mai li a nei chiet ua, tualeh ha li anei chiet uhi."},"7":{"text":"Akengte uh atang zetzot a, akengtaw uh bawngnou kengtaw abanga, tuate khu sum-eng kinot val sitset bangin ataang zuol zuol zel hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaun apang li ua, ahate uh nuoi ah, mihing khut bangbang anei chiet uhi. Ali un maitang li leh ha li anei chiet uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ahate uh khat leh khat akisutuo chiet hi, apei chieng un akihei vateh sih ua, hinanleh amaizawn chiet uah tangtah in apei chiet uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amaitangte uh tambang ahi: mihing maitang bang anei chiet ua, azietlam pang uah humpibahnei maitang bang anei chiet ua, aveilam pang uah bawngtal maitang bang anei chiet ua, ali un muvanlai maitang bang anei chiet uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 10.14; Kihil. 4.7"},"11":{"text":"Tambang khu amaitangte uh ahi. Ahate uh vanlam ah azahtou chiet uhi. Aha nite uh khat leh khat akisutuo chiet ua, tualeh aha nite un atahsapumpi uh akhu chiet uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh amaizawn chiet uah tangtah in apei chiet ua, hagau deina lam lam ah apei uhi, tualeh apei chieng un akihei vateh sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua silhingte a melpuoh dan u’leh akilat dan u’khu suong meihol am kuong leh meisel kuong bangmai ahi ua, tua khu sil hingte lah ah asuh atungin apei hi; tua mei khu atangpha mama a, tua meikuong lah ah tunphe aphezot zot hi.","ref":"Kihil. 4.5"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh sil hing lite khu tunphe phezot zot bangin mailam a tai in, anua tai kia zel uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua sil hingte ka et laitah in, Ngai vawi, sil hingte maitang lite pang a leilah ah kangtalai keng khat chiet um khu ka muta hi.","title":"Kangtalai kengli muna","ref":"Ezek. 10.9-13"},"16":{"text":"Tua kangtalaite melpuohdan, anasep dan u’khu beril suong bangmai ahi a, ali un amelpuoh uh akibang chiet hi. Anasep dan uh kilah dan ahileh kangtalai khat laikim tah a, kangtalai keng dangkhat um bangmai ahi."},"17":{"text":"Apei chieng un aning lite ngatna lang khat pou pou ah apei ua, apei chieng un akihei vateh sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"Akangtalai keng kuol uh asang mama a, achizat huoi uhi, akuol lite kimvel khu mit in adim hi.","ref":"Kihil. 4.8"},"19":{"text":"Silhingte apei chiengun, kangtalai kengte zong apang uah apei uhi; tualeh silhingte leitung apat dopkanga a um chiengun, kangtalai kengte zong dopkangin a um uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hagau pei utna lam lam ah, amauh zong apei ua, kangtalai kengte zong ama utoh zoh in apei zel uhi, tualeh kangtalai kengte tunglam ah amautoh dopkang in a um uhi; aziehpen silhing lite hagau khu kangtalaite sungah a um hi."},"21":{"text":"Silhingte apei chieng un, Kangtalai kengte zong apei ua, tuate akhawl chiengun tamte zong akhawl uhi, tualeh tuate khu leitung apat dopkang ahi chiengun tua kangtalai kengte zong amautoh dopkang khawm ahi zel uhi, aziehpen silhingte hagau khu kangtalai kengte sungah a um hi."},"22":{"text":"Silhingte lutung zawn a vanthamzawl kilat dan khu Kristal suong bang te-selsol chizat huoi tah bang ahi a, alutung zawn uah akipha zeizoi hi.","ref":"Kihil. 4.6"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh vanthamzawl nuoi ah ahate uh khat leh khat kisutuo chiet in tangtah in azah chiet uhi. Aha nite chiet un atahsapumpi uh langkhat akhu ua, aha ni dangte un alangkhat akhu chiet uhi."},"24":{"text":"Apei chiengun ahazap ging ukhu tui luong ging bang, Bangkimbawlthei aw ging bang leh galkap hon husa thupitah ging bangin ka za hi. Amaute akhawl chiengun ahate uh akhup uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 1.4-15; 19.6"},"25":{"text":"Akhawl ua, ahate uh akhup chiengun, alutung zawn ua vanthamzawl tunglam a kipat aw khat ahing ging hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh alutung zawn ua vanthamzawl tunglam ah Mangtoupha bang khat, saphire suong bang melpuo a um a, tualeh Mangtoupha bang tunglam sangtah ah, mihing lim leh melpuo khat a um hi.","ref":"Ezek. 10.1; Kihil. 4.2,3"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh akawng tunglam sie sum-eng mei a kihal am banga kilang, asung lam kimkot a meikuong banga kilang ka mu a, tualeh akawng nuoilam sie zong meikuong hileh kilawm melpuo in ka mu a, avah kimvel sengsong hi.","ref":"Ezek. 8.2"},"28":{"text":"Guo chiin ni a meilum lah a sakhituihup kilatdan bang khu akimvel a vah kilatdan ahi. Tua khu Mangpa thupina kibahpi a kilat dan ahi. Tuachi’n tami ka mu tahin ka mai lei toh sutuo in khupboh in ka pua a, ahing houpi aw khat ka za hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aman ka kungah: “Mihing tapa na kengin dingin, na kunga thu gen ding ka hi,” achi hi.","title":"Ezekiel hatna leh sawlna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka kunga thu agen laitah in, ka sungah Hagau ahing lut a, ka kengin ahing dingtou sah a, ka kunga athugen ka zata hi."},"3":{"text":"Aman ka kungah “Mihing tapa Israel tate, nam helhat, ka tunga helte kunga hing sawl ding ka hi. Ama uleh apu apate un tuni mama chieng dong in ka tungah atawnkhiel uhi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute mi genha leh lungtang phengphi hahlesuonte ahi uhi. Amaute kunga ka hing sawl ahia, akung uah Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, na chi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaun ngaikhie in, ngaikhe sih tale u’zong innkuon helhat mawng ahi uh, hinanleh alah uah guolnei ana umta chi athei ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh nang mihing tapa amauh giing sinlen, athu gente u’zong zau sin, khau lingneite leh lou lingneite’n hing imkuol in, mom aite lah ah teng nanlachin athugen uh zau sinlen, innkuon helhat hinan u’leh ahing du et vang un zong lungke tuom sin."},"7":{"text":"Helhat innkuon ahizieh un, ngaikhie in ngaikhe tasih u’leh zong ka thu amaute kunga na gen teitei ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"“Hinanleh nang mihing tapa, na kunga ka thugen ngai in. Tua innkuon helhatte bangin hel sin; na kam kaah inlen, nang ka hing pieh khu ne in,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi a ka et leh ngai vawi, kei lam hing sawh khut khat ka mu a, en vawi, laibuziel khat akhut sungah a tawi hi.","ref":"Kihil. 5.1"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka mai ah apha a, asung leh apuo ah, kaanate, lusunnate leh tunggihnate akigiel hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuathamlouin aman ka kungah, “Mihing tapa ahing kipie khu ne in, tam laibuziel ne inlen, tualeh pei inlen Israel innkuonte kungah thu va gen in,” achi hi.","ref":"Kihil. 10.9,10"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka kam ka kaah a, tua laibuziel ahing nesahta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh aman ka kungah, “Mihing tapa tam laibuziel ka hing pieh ne inlen na gil va sah in,” achi hi. Tuachi’n ken tuakhu ka neta a, ka kam ah khuoizu bangin a hum hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman ka kungah, “Mihing tapa, Israel innkuonte kungah pei inlen akung uah ka thute vagen in, achi hi.","title":"Ezekiel nasep ding kihilna"},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen ham tuom leh ham thei loute kunga hing kisawl na hisih a, hinanleh Israel innkuonte kunga hing kisawl na hizaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Na thei ngailou ham leh aham uh theiha nasah mite kunga hing sawl ka hi sih hi. Tuabang mite kunga hing sawl hileng pen na thugen angaikhe tham ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel innkuonten kei a ahing ngaikhieh lou zieh un, nang thugen zong angaikhe sih ding uhi. Aziehpen Israel innkuonte zousie milungpheng leh lungtangkhau ngen ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ngai in amai uah na mai ka khau sahta a, na talpang amaute talpang masang ah khautahin ka hing bawlpiehta hi."},"9":{"text":"Na talpang suong taah pen meisasuong sanga tahzaw bangin ka bawlta hi. Amaute giing sinlen, innkuon helhatte hinan u’leh amauh giingin lungke vawt sin,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuathamlou in aman ka kungah, “Mihing tapa na kunga ka thugente zousie na lungtangin chiemte inlen na bil in za in."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh na mipi saltangte kungah pei inlen, ngaikhie in ngaikhe ut sih u’leh zong, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, chiin akung uah va gen inlen vahil in,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n hagau in ahing domtou a, ka nua langah vanpi ging banga ngai aw khat in, Tam mun a kipat in Mangpa thupina khu phat in umta hen, chi kaza hi."},"13":{"text":"Silhingte ha khat leh khat kizaptuo ging leh agei ua kangtalai kengte ging lemlum husa zong ka za hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n hagau in ahing domkang a ahing pomangta hi; lunggimtah leh lungthah pumin ka peita a, hinanleh Mangpa khut ka tungah ahat mama hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kebar luipi gei a Tel-Abib a um saltangte kung ka hing tung a, tualeh amaute touna ah ka tou a, alah uah lunggimna chizat huoitah in ni sagi ka um hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh ni sagi abei tah in Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga:","title":"Israel Vauhilna"},"17":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Israel innkuonte adinga galveng mi khat in ka hing bawlta hi, tuaziehin ka kam a thu ngaikhie inlen, kei akipat vauhilna amaute pie in."},"18":{"text":"Migilou kungah na shi ngei ngei ding ahi ka chia, amauh vauhilna lah pelou a, tualeh ahinna uh huhhingna dinga, tua migilou khu a umdan gilou apat kihei dinga vauhilna thu na genlou leh, tua migilou khu agitlouna ah ashi dinga, hinanleh asisan maw nangma khut ah ka hing phul ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh migilou khu na vauhila, hinanleh agitlouna apata akihei tuomlou a, a umdan gilou atawpsan tuomlou leh ama khu akhelna ah ashi dinga, hinanleh nangman na hinna na hunkhe ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh midihtat in adihtatna apat akihei a, sil gilou abawl a, tualeh amasanga kipalpuona ka koi chiengin ashi ding hi. Nang ama kunga vauhilna na piehlou ziehin, akhelna ziehin na shi ding hi, tualeh adihtatna bawlsate akithei ngitnget sih dinga hinanleh amawna sisan khu na khut ah ka hing phul ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh midihtat khu khiellou dinga na taihil a, akhel sih leh, aman vauhilna angaisah ziehin ahing ngei ngei ding hi, tualeh nang zong na hinna na humbit ding hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuamun ah Mangpa khut ka tungah a um a, Ama’n ka kungah, “Dingdoh inlen phaijang ah pei inlen, khunah kang houpi ding hi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka dingdoh a, phaijang ah ka peita hi, tualeh En vawi, Mangpa thupina khu Kebar luipi gei a ka mu bangin, khunah ading hi, tuachi’n ka mai a lei suin ka puata hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n hagau ka sungah alut a, ka kengin ahing dingsah hi; tualeh ka kungah “Pei inlen, na inn ah kot vakikhumkha in, chiin ahing houpi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh nang mihing tapa aw, ngaiin, na tungah khauhuol ahing baat ding ua, ahing kaan ding uhi, tuachi’n na mite lah ah na peidoh thei sih ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Na lei na dang tawngah ka behsah dinga, na ham thei nawn sih ding hi, tualeh innkuon helhatte ahi zieh un, amauh na phawh nawn sih ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hing houpi chiengin, na kam ka hing kaah sah ding a, akung uah, “Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, chi’n na gen ding hi; Angaikhe ut in ngaikhie henlen, angaikhe utlou in, ngaikheda heh, aziehpen amaute helhatte innkuon ahi uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Nang mihing tapa tungman tangkhat la inlen na mai ah koi inlen, atungah Jerusalem khopi lim gielin.","title":"Etsahna nei a thu gente"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh tami khopi kisimna dinga ki imkhumna lei kisep sangte bawl inlen, galkapte giehmun zong bawl inlen, kulbang suhsietna ding zawlte akimkot ah koi in."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh sia peh khat zong la inlen, nang leh khopi kikaal ah sia bang dingin tung inlen, tua khopi lang mai ngat in, tua khopi imkhum in aum dinga, nangman tua khu na imkhum ding hi. Tami Israel innkuonte dingin chiemtena ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"“Na veilam netpha in sihlup inlen, Israel innkuonte gitlouna a tungah nga in, atunga na lup sung ni phaza dungzuiin, agitlouna uh na puoh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen amaute gitlou sung kum phaza nang tunga ni phaza a sim ding ka hi, tuaziehin Israel innkuonte gitlouna ni zathum leh ni sawmkuo sung na poding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tuate na bawl zou chiengin, na zietlang netpha in sihlup kia inlen Juda innkuonte gitlouna ni sawmli sung na poding hi; kum khat khu ni khat a sim ahi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jerusalem ki imkhum lang namaingat dinga na ban na hawh dinga, tua khopi tungah genlawhna thu na phuong ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh en in, khauhuol in ka hing kaantom dinga, khopi na sim sung nite na bukim sah masangsie khat lang khat lang ah na kihei thei sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Nangma a dingin, mangbu leh barli bu, be leh belite, mim leh taangte la inlen kuong sung khat ah koikhawm inlen tanghou in kibawl inlen, na pang khat netpha a na lup sung, ni zathum leh ni sawmkuo sungtengin na ne ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh na neh ding akite valeh dinga, nikhat in shekel sawmni ahi dinga, hunbi nei tah a na neh ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tui zong tethaw in na dawn dinga, hin khat se guh suo sekhat, hunbi nei tah in na dawn ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Barli tanghou bangin na ne dinga, mihing eehgaw singa zangin amit mu uah na kang ding hi.”"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n, “Tambangin Israel taten amauh ka delmangna namte lah ah tuabang tanghou suhbuasa ane ding uhi, achi hi, chiin gen in, achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken, “Ehe, Mangpa Pasian, Ngai in, ka neu lai apat tutan in ka kibuasah nai sih a, ganhing amathu a shi leh gamsa in atha ahisihleh sa sienglou kidahhuoi mawngmawng ka kam sunga lut in, ka ne nai sih hi,” ka chi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n ka kungah, “En in, mihing eeh gaw taangin bawng eehgaw ka hing pedinga, tuami toh na tanghou na kang ding hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Ama’n ka kungah, “Mihing tapa Jerusalem a tanghou puohlut ka tawpsah dinga zauna toh tena a te detdet a hawm in tanghou ane ding ua, tui zong atena a te detdet in lamdangsahna toh adawn ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh ann neh tui dawn akichin louna dingun tambangin ka bawl ding a, khat leh khat lungkie in aki en tuo ding ua, agitlouna ziehun, amangthai ding uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh nang Mihing tapa, namsau hiemtah khat la inlen, samheute tem zah bangin zang inlen, na lu leh na khamul heu inlen, tuachiin a tena ding khat la inlen, tua samte te inlen khenzah in.","title":"Samheuna temhiem chiemtena"},"2":{"text":"Sethum suo sekhat, na khopi imkhum aum nite achin chiengin khopi sungah mei in hal inlen, se thum suo sekhat khu la inlen khopi kimkot ah, namsau in sat nen inlen, tualeh sethum suo sekhat dang pen hui lah ah thethang in: namsau dohkhie in ka nuadel sah ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh samzam tawmnoukhat la inlen, na puontuol mongah na tuun ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuate lah apat tawmnoukhat la kia inlen, meikhua lai ah pailut inlen, haltum in, aziehpen tuana kipat in meikuong ahing pawtdoh dinga Israel innkuon sung zousie lah ah akuongdoh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Tami Jerusalem ahi, namte laikim tah ah ka koi a, akimkot ah gamte ka um sah hi.","title":"Chiemtenate hilchienna"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh ama khu akim avel a um namte leh gamte sangin ka dan thupiehte leh ka dan thugousiete dou in gitlouna bawl in ahel zawtham hi. Tualeh ka vaihawmte leh ka danthupiehte anuol ua, ka dan thuguosiete azui sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Na kim na vel ua umte sangin, na genha zaw ua, ka danthuguotte na zuilou ziehun, ka danthupiehte na kem sih uhi; hinanleh na kim na vel ua um namte vaihawmna dungzui in na gamta zawta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai un, Kei, keima ngelngel in ka hing dou ahi, tualeh namte mitmu in na lah uah thukhenna ka tungsah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh na kidahhuoinate zousie zieh un, ka bawl ngainailou leh tuabanga ka bawl ngai nawn lou ding na tung uah ka bawl ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin na lah uah, paten atapate uh sa ane ding ua, tapaten apate uh sa ane ding uhi; tualeh na lah uah thukhenna ka tungsah dinga, tualeh na lah ua asuohta umsunte hui lah ah ka thethang ding hi, a chi hi.","ref":"Kaala. 4.10"},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in, ka hinna sielin ka gen ahi, na sil mudahuoite u’leh na sil kidahhuoite zousie ua, ka munsiengthou na suhbua zieh un, Ken zong noute ka hing kiemsah dinga, kang hinkhawi sih dinga, lainatna mit in kang en sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na lah ua sethum suo sekhat natpi leh kielin na shi ding ua ashigam ding uhi; sethum suo sekhat na kimvel uah namsau in ashi ding ua, tualeh sethum suo sekhat hui lah ah ka hing thethang dinga, namsau dohsa in ka hing nuadel nalai ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Tambangin ka lungthahna ka tungsah dinga, ka thangpaina atung uah ka sungbaw ding a, ka lungkimta ding hi; tualeh, atung ua ka thangpaina ka sunbuoh hun chiengin, Kei Mangpa’n ka phattuom ngaina in thu ka genta, chi ahing thei ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuathamlouin, na kimvel ua um, namte lah leh na kung ua hing pei mi vahlete mitmu ah bangmalou leh segawpsa leh simmaw huoiin ka hing bawl ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n thangpai tah leh lungthah mama a, nasatah a vauhilna toh na tung ua, ka hing vaihawmkhum chiengin, na kimvel ua namte adingin, simmaw um, nuizat nopna, vauhilna leh chizat huoi, na hi ding uhi. Kei Mangpa’n ka gensa ahita hi."},"16":{"text":"Na tung ua, shina, sietna leh kielna thaltang, zauhuoitah na tung ua ka hing sawl chiengin, noute sumang dingin ka hing sawl dinga, na tung uah kiel nasezaw sem in ka pungsah dinga, na hinna bul uh ann leh tuite ka sutawp ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n na tung uah kielna leh gamsagilou ka hing sawl dinga, ta leh nau bei in ahing koi ding ua, na lah uah natpi leh sisan suona atung dinga tualeh na tung uoh namsau ka hing tungsah ding hi, Kei Mangpa’n kana genzousa ahita hi.”","ref":"Kihil. 6.8"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga:","title":"Israel muolte mawsahna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa, Israel taangte lang ah na mai ngat inlen, amauh douna thumavang gen in, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Nou Israel taangte aw, Mangpa Pasian thu ngai un, Mangpa Pasian in, muol leh taangte kungah, kuomthuhte leh phaijawlte kungah tambangin agen hi. Ngai un, Kei, Keima ngelngelin na tung uah namsau ka tungsah ding a, na munsangte uh ka sumangthai ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n na maitamte uh asegawp dinga, na gimnamtui maitamte uh achim dinga, tualeh keiman na mikithatte uh na milimte uh masang ah ka pai ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate mishiluongte khu amilimte uh mai ah ka siel dinga; na gute uh na maitamte uh kimvel ah ka paithang ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Na tenna mun zousie uah, khopite khu tenna lou a nuasie in a um dinga, na mun sangte uh akisuse dinga, na maitamte uh a kisuchim dinga phietmangin a um ding hi; na milimte uh, akisatguoi dinga, akisuse ding hi, na gimnamtui maitamte uh akisattan dinga, tualeh na nasepte uh akiphietmang ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi kithatte na lah uah apua ding ua, tuachi’n kei khu Mangpa ka hi chi na hing thei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Hinanleh gam china thethanga na um chieng un, namte lah a, namsau apat na suotat theina dingun, suohta um sun honkhat ka hing nuasie ding hi.","title":"A umsunte hundamna"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n sal a kaimanga a umna uh namte lah a, suohta sunten Kei ahing thei ngitnget ding uhi. Aziehpen a angkawmna lungtangte ua, kei ahing kiheisan ua, amilimte uh lam nga a kizuana mit ha a, akimawlthang nua un, asilgilou bawlte u’leh asil kidahhuoi bawl zousiete ziehun amauleh amauh akimuda ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Kei Mangpa ka hi chi leh atung ua sil hoilou ka bawl ding chia ka thugente amawhna ahisih chi athei ding uhi.”"},"11":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “Na khut bengin, na kengtaw tat inlen, Kadei Aw! Israel innkuonte gitlouna kidah huoi ziehin maw chiin, aziehpen namsau in, kiel in, tualeh natpi, in apua ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Gamlapi a umte natpi in ashi ding ua, anai a umte namsau in ashi ding ua, asuohta sunte leh hing khawi a umsunte kiel in ashi ding uhi. Tambangin ka thangpaina atung uah ka sungbaw ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n nouten amilimte zousie kunga gimnamtui alatna mun uh muol sang chinteng tungah, muolvum zousie tungah, sing hing chinteng nuoi leh gangpi sing bawhpha chinteng nuoia amaitamte uh kimkot a, amilimte ulah a, amikithatte a um chiengin, Kei khu Mangpa ka hi chi na hing thei ding uhi, achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute douin ka khut ka laam dinga, Diblah langa atenna mun uh gamdai zousie sanga sezawtham in ka bawl ding hi. Tua hun chieng in kei khu Mangpa ka hi chi ahing thei ding uhi,” achi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga:","title":"Israel tawpna ding naita"},"2":{"text":"“Nang mihing tapa, Mangpa Pasian in Israel gam zousie kungah, tambangin agen hi: Tawpna ding! Gam ning li tungah, atawp na ding ahing tungta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuin tawpna na tungah ahing tungta hi, na tungah ka lungthahna ka hing sawl dinga, na umdan dungzui in vai ka hing hawm khum ding a, na kidahhuoina zousie na tungah, ka hing thuhkia ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka mit in nang ahing khawi sih dinga, lainatna zong ka hing nei sih ding hi. Hinanleh na umdante ka hing thuh ding a, na kidahhuoinate na lah uah a um ding hi. Tuachi’n kei Mangpa ka hi chi nang thei ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Sietna khat nua ah sietna, En in, ahing tungta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tawpna ahing tungta, tawpna ahing tungta; nang dou dingin akhanglouta, En in ahing tung petma hi."},"7":{"text":"Sietna na tungah ahing tungta hi. Aw nang gam sung a tengpa, Ahun a tungta, buoina ni anaita, Tang tung a lungnopna kikou hi lou in."},"8":{"text":"Tuin ka thangpaina na tungah ka buohkhum pai dinga, ka lungthahna na tungah ka sungbaw ding hi. Na um dan dungzui in thu ka khen dinga, na kidah huoina zousie ziehin ka hing gawt ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka mit in ahing khawi sih dinga, ka hing lainat sih ding hi. Na umdan dungzui in ka hing gawt dinga, na kidah huoina zong na lah uah a um ding hi. Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa khu nou hing gawtpa, ahi chi na thei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"“En in, ni khu! En in ahing tungta! Na sietna ni apawtkheta, chieng khu apah ta a, kiletsahna amumta hi."},"11":{"text":"Hiemngamna khu gitlouna chieng asuohta, amauh koima a umden sih ding ua, akiningchinnate u’leh ahausatnate uh, koima’n a kaa sih ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahun ahing tungta, ani ahing naita, aleite kipah sih uhenlen, azuate zong da sih uheh, aziehpen lungthahna khu abawn ua tungah tung ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Azuatu inlah dam nalai nanleh asil zuasa amu kia nawn sih ding hi; aziehpen kilahna khu abawn ua tungthu ahi ngal a, koima anuakia sih ding ua, Koima gitlouna hinkhuo ah akisuhat zou sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Mizousie kiginna dingin pengkul amut ua, hinanleh kidouna ah koima akuon sih uhi aziehpen ka lungthahna abawn ua tungah a um hi."},"15":{"text":"Pulam ah namsau a uma, asunglam ah natpi leh kiel a um hi; gam a umte namsau in ashi ding ua, khopi sunga umte natpi leh kiel in ashi ding uhi.","title":"Israel khelna gawtna"},"16":{"text":"Dam a suohta umsunte khu, taang tungvumte ah phaijang vakhu bangin, aum ding uhi. Abawn un michin akhelna chiet uah, kap a lungzuong in a um ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Khut zousie azawi dinga, khup zousiete tui bangin anem ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Sai ip puon asil ding ua, zauna in atuomkhum dinga, amaisuo uah zumna akilang dinga, alutang zousie uh akieu sieng ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Adangkate uh gawlzing ah apai ding ua, asanate uh siengthou loua ngai ahi dinga, adangkate u’leh asanate un, Mangpa lungthahna ni ah amauh ahundoh thei sih ding hi; ahinna uh ataisah sih dinga, agil uh zong avaa sah sih ding hi. Aziehpen tam agitlouna uh kipalpuana ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Akizepna kilawmna uh akiletsahpi ua, tuate akipat akidah huoina uh milimte leh, athanghuoina uh asuohsah zawsawp uhi; tuaziehin ama ua dinga silsienglou ka suohsah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tamte gamdang mite khut ah gallah van dingin ka pedoh dinga, leitunga migiloute kungah gallah sum in ka pe ding hi, Amaun tami asubua ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ka mai ama-ua pat ka heimang dinga, Amaun ka mun siengthou asubua ding ua, suomhatte alut ding ua asubua ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Khainieng bawl un, “Aziehpen gam pumpi sisan suona gitlouna in adim siengta hi, tualeh khopi khu hiemngamna in adimta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin namte lah a giloupen ka hing pui dinga, amaun a innte uh aluopieh ding ua, mi hatte Kisahtheina ka tawpsah dinga, amun siengthou uh suhbua ahi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Manthaina ahing tung hi, Amaun lungmuonna asui ding ua, a um sih ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Sietna tungah sietna ahing tung dinga, thuthang tungah thuthang ahing tung ding hi. Tuahun chieng in guolneite apat mengmuna asui ding ua; Hinanleh siempute apat dan thu abeimangta dinga, upate apat thuhilna abeimangta ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Lengpa’n asuun dinga, lengpa tapa in lungkhamna puon asil dinga, gamsung mite khut akithing dinga, a umdan dungzui un ka bawl dinga, agamtatna dungzui un atung uah thukhenna ka bawl ding hi. Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi ahing thei ding uhi.”"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum guhna, ahaguhna, tuomi ha ani nga ni in hichi ahing hia, Ka inn sunga ka tou a, Juda upate ka mai a atou laiun, Mangpa Pasian khut ka tungah ahing tung hi.","title":"Pasian thupina kilahna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka en a, ngai vawi, mihing lim leh melpuo meikuong banga hing kilang khat ka mu hi, akawng apat anuoilam bangdan a kilang meikuong ahi a, akawng apat atunglam teng sia ki emsan pempom taang setsot bang ahi.","ref":"Ezek. 1.27"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh aman khut bangbang khat ahing zankhie a, ka zangsam ahing man a; Hagau in van leh lei kikal ah ahing domkang a, Pasian apat mengmuna in Jerusalem huongsung inntuol sungnungzaw a mallam kulkotpi lutna ah ahing tut hi; khunah thangsietna tohthou milim a ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh ngai vawi, phaijang a mengmuna ka mu bangin Israel thupina khunah a um hi.","ref":"Ezek. 1.28"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, “Mihing tapa tuin mallam nga in dahtou vawi,” ahing chi hi. Tuachi’n mallam nga in ka dahtou a, maitam kotpi lutna ah, tam thangsietna milim ka mu hi.","title":"Thangsietna milim"},"6":{"text":"Tuaban ah zong aman ka kungah, “Mihing tapa bang ahiei abawl uh na mu ei, ka munsiengthou akipat gamlapi a ka peimang theina dinga Israel innkuonten sil kidahhuoi abawl uh na mu ei? Tuin kihei kia lachin akidah huoi zawsem silte na mu nalai ding hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n biehinn huongsung lutna ah ahing zawpi hi; tualeh ka et leh bang vang khat ka mu hi.","title":"Bieh inn bang kigiel muna"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman ka kungah, “Mihing tapa baang khu khuohin,” achi a, tuachia baang ka khuoh leh kot khat ana um hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Aman ka kungah, “Lut inlen khuna sil gilou leh kidah huoi abawlte uh en in” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka lut a, ka en a, aboh a vah ganhing leh gamsa kidah huoi chinteng lim leh baang tung kimvel a kigiel Israel innkuon milim zousie ka mu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tuate mai ah, Israel innkuon upate sawm sagi a dinga, amaute lah ah Shaphan tapa Jaazaniah ding ka mu hi. Michin in akhut uah gimnamtui halna hengdai atawi chiet ua, tua gimnamtui khu meilum bangin azamtou hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman ka kungah, “Mihing tapa Israel innkuon upaten miel lah a, michin in amauh milim pindan sung chiet a asil bawl uh na mu ei? Aziehpen amauten Mangpa’n eite ahing mu sih a, Mangpa’n gam ataisanta hi,” achi uhi, achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Ama’n ka kungah, “Kihei kia lachin asil bawl uh kidah huoi thupi zawsem na mu nalai ding hi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman mallam a um Mangpa inn kotpi lutna ah ahing zawpi a, tualeh ngai vawi, khunah Tammuz suun a kap numeite atou uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman ka kungah, “Tami na mu ei, Aw mihing tapa? Kihei kia lachin, asil bawl uh kidah huoi thupi zawsem na mu ding hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman Mangpa inn huong sungnung zaw ah ahing puilut a, tua Mangpa biehinn lutna kotkha bul a innhim leh maitam kikaal ah pasal sawmni leh nga ding vel Mangpa biehinn nuangat in amai uh ni suolam ngain a um ua, tualeh amauten suolam nga in ni abie uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, “Aw Mihing tapa tam khu na mu ei? Juda innkuonte dinga tam mun a silkidah huoi abawlte uh sil neu nou ahiei mah? Aziehpen amaun gamsung hiemngapna in adim sahta ua, ahing sulungthah dingin ahing kinua heisanta uhi. Tualeh en un, anahkuo uah singba asiet uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin ken zong lungthah in amauh tungah ka gamta dinga, ka mitin mulou in akhawi sih dinga, lainatna zong ka nei vawt sih ding a, tualeh ka bil ah ngaitah in kikou nan u’leh ka ngaikhe sih ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama ka bilkawm ah aw ngaitahin akikoukhie a; “Khopi vengte zousie shi theina a galvan tawi chiet utoh hing naisah chiet un,” a chi hi.","title":"Jerusalem a milim bete thana"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh kotpi sahtazaw mallam nga akipat in pasal guh mi tha theina galvan tawi chiet thakhat in ahing pei uhi. Alah ua mi khat in puonmalngat asil a, apangah laigielmi laitui bawm akuo hi. Amaute ahing lut ua, sum-eng maitam gei ah ading uhi."},"3":{"text":"Israel Pasian thupina khu aumna ngai cherubimte akipat in Mangpa innkot bul ah apeitou hi. Tualeh Aman puonmalngat sil a apanga laigiel mite laitui bawm kuopa ahan hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n akungah, “Khopi Jerusalem sung tuonsuoh inlen, asunga silkidah huoi bawlte zieh a dalekap a maute talpang ah chiemtena bawl in” achi hi.","title":"Mi gilou that ding a thupiehna","ref":"Kihil. 7.3; 9.4; 14.1"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh midangte kungah, “Ka zah ngelngel in Anuazui unlen khopi sung tuon suoh unlen, that unlen na mit un amu pouma khawi sih unlen, lainatna zong nei sih un."},"6":{"text":"Putehte leh tangvalte, nungahte leh naupang neute, tualeh numeite, thatgam siengun, hinanleh chiemtena nei mite nai sih un, ka munsiengthou ah pan un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amaun biehinn mai a um upate ah apan pai uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama’n akung uah, “Biehinn subua unlen ahuongsung mishi luongin dimsah unlen, pawtkhie un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n apawtta ua, khopi sungteng ah mi athat panta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n tambang ahing hi a, khopi sunga mi atha lai un, Keimatanga nuasie in ka um a, Ka mai a lei suin bohkhup in ka pua a, “AW MANGPA PASIAN” Jerusalem tungah na lungthahna na sunbuohna ah Israel umsunte zong abawn ua thatgam sieng ding na hiei mah,” chi in ka kikoukheta hi.","title":"Ezekiel kana"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman ka kungah, “Israel leh Juda innkuonte khelna khu alien sengseng a, gamsung sisan suona in adima, tualeh khopi sung khu dihlouna in adimta hi; aziehpen Mangpa’n gam ataisanta a, Mangpa’n amu nawn sih, achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Keima mit in zong mu manghil anei sih dinga, lainatna neukhat zong ka nei sih ding hi, hinanleh anasep dungzui un alutung chiet uah ka khuh sah ding hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuazou chetin tua puonmalngat sila apanga laitui bawm kuopa’n, “Na hing thupieh bangin ka bawlzouta chi’n thu ahing tut hi.”"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka en a, Cherubimte lutung zawn a vanthamzawl ah Saphire suongmantam hileh kilawm Mangtoupha mel bang pua khat ahing kilang hi.","title":"Pasian thupina in biehinn apawtsanta","ref":"Ezek. 1.26; Kihil. 4.2"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Aman puonmalngat silpa kungah, “Cherubimte nuoi a kangtalai kengte kikaal ah pei inlen, cherubimte kikaal a mei-am na khut dim in la inlen, khopi tungah thethang in, achi hi. Tuabanga ka et lai in ama ava lutta hi.”","ref":"Kihil. 8.5"},"3":{"text":"Tua mipa ava lut laiin cherubimte Biehinn simlam pangah ading ua, tualeh huongsung sungta zaw dim in meilum ahing zing hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thupina khu cherubimte apat apeitou a, biehinn lutna innhim ah akhawl a, inn khu meilum in adimta hi; tualeh ainn huongsung leituol pumpi khu Mangpa thupina in atanvah sengsong hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh cherubimte hazap ging khu Pasian bangkimbawlthei in thu agen chiengin awging bang maiin huongsung inntuol pawnungzaw dongin akiza hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Ama’n puonmalngat silpa kungah thu apie a, “Cherubimte lah a, kangtalai keng kipeite kikaal a mei la in achitah in, ama ava lut pai a,” kangtalai keng gei ah ava dingta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh cherub khat in, cherubimte lah a kipat in akhutin, cherubimte kikaal a mei-amte a sawh a bangza ahiei ala a, puonmalngat silpa khut sung ah akoi a, aman tua mei-amte ala a, apeita hi."},"8":{"text":"Cherubimten aha nuoi uah mihing khut bang nei in akilang hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka et leh, Cherubimte siih ah kangtalai keng li, cherub khat kungah kangtalai keng khat, kangtalai keng dang cherub dang khat chiet kung ah a um a, tualeh kangtalai kengte mel kilat dan khu beril suongmantam zem abang hi.","title":"Kangtalai kengte leh Cherubimte kimudan","ref":"Ezek. 1.15-21"},"10":{"text":"Tua kangtalai keng lite amellat dan uh akibang chiet a, kangtalai keng khat sunga, kangtalai keng dang khat kikokal a kithuop abang chiet uhi."},"11":{"text":"A pei chiengun cherub lite ngatna lam ah apei ua, apei chiengun akihei vateh sih uhi; hinanleh alutang ngatna lam lam ah apei ua, apei pumun akihei ngai vateh sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Atahsa pumpi u’leh anua lam uh, akhutte u’leh ahate uh, tualeh kangtalai kengte zong akimkot in mit in adim a, kangtalai keng lite zong tuabang in mit in adim uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 4.8"},"13":{"text":"Kangtalai kengte khu, pingpei banga kipei ahi uh, kichi kaza hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuate khat in mai li chiet anei ua, mai khatna khu cherubmai ahi a, mai nina khu mihing mai ahi a, mai thumna khu, humpibahnei mai ahi a, alina khu mupi mai ahi.","ref":"Ezek. 1.10; Kihil. 4.7"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh cherubimte khu dopkangtou in a umta uhi. Tami Kebar lui panga ka mu silhing khu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Cherubimte apei chiengun, kangtalai kengte agei uah apei uhi; cherubimten lei apat leengtou dinga ahate uh azahtou chiengun kangtalai kengte khu amaute gei apat akihei tuom sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Cherubimte adin khinkhian chiengun, kangtalai kengte zong ading khinkhian uhi, cherubimte khat dopkanga a um chiengun, tamte zong amauleh amauh akidomkang mai uhi. Aziehpen silhingte hagau asung uah a um hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thupina khu Biehinn lutna innhim akipat in apawtkhie a, cherubimte tungah ava dingta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh cherubimten aha uh azahtou ua, ka mitmu in lei apat aleengtou ua, kangtalai kengte zong agei uah a um uhi, Mangpa inn lutna suolam kotpi bul ah ading chiet uhi, tualeh Israelte Pasian thupina amaute tungzawn ah a um hi."},"20":{"text":"Tami Kebar luipanga Israelte Pasian nuoi a, ka silhing mu cherubimte ahi uh chi ka theikheta hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaute’n maitang li chiet, ha lichiet anei ua, aha nuoi uah mihing khutte bang a um chiet hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh amaitangte uh kilat dan khu, Kebar luipanga ka mu maitangte bang bang ahi ua, amaute chiet masang zawn ah tangtah in apei chiet uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hagau in ahing domkang a, suolam ngat a um, Mangpa inn suolam kotpi ah ahing tut a; tualeh ngai vawi, kotpi lutna ah pasal sawmni leh nga a um ua, alah uah mipite lamkai Azzur tapa Jaazaniah leh Benaiah tapa Pelatiah ka mu hi.","title":"Israel vaihawm sawmni leh ngate tunga thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Aman ka kungah, “Mihing tapa tam mite khu khopi sunga sietna bawldohte leh lemguotna gilou pe mite ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute’n inn lamna ding hun anei naisih hi; tam khopi khu sa huonna bel ahi a, eite pen asa ihi uh, achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaute dou in thu phuongzah in, Aw Mihing tapa va phuongzah in,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa Hagau khu ka tungah ahing tunga, ka kungah, “Mangpa’n tambangin a gen hi vachi in, achi hi; Aw Israel innkuonte noute’n tambangin na gen uhi; na lungsim ua na geelte uh, ken ka thei suoh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tam khopi sungah mi na that tam sem sem ua, na gawlzingte uh na mitha luongte un na dim sahta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: tam na lupsah uh na mithate luongte uh asa ahi ua, tualeh khopi khu asabel ahi; hinanleh tamte lah akipat in noute ka hing notdoh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Namsau na ging ua, namsau na tung uah ka hing tungsah ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Khopi apat noute ka hing notdoh dinga, gamdang mite khut ah ka hing pekhe dinga, na lah uah vaihawmnadih ka hing tut ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Namsau in na pua ding ua, Israel gamgi ah na tung uah thu ka khen ding hi, tuachi’n kei Mangpa ka hi chi nang thei ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tam khopi na sahuonna bel uh ahi sih dinga, noute zong alai a sa na hisih ding uhi, Israel gamgi ah na tungthu uah thukhenna ka bawl ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh kei Mangpa ka hi chi nang thei ding uhi, aziehpen ka thugousiete leh ka vaihawmnate na zui sih uhi, hinanleh na kimvel ua um namte tawndan na zuizaw uhi.”"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, tua banga genlawhna thu ka gen laiin, Benaiah tapa Pelatiah ashita mawh hi. Tuachi’n lei lam nga in bohkhupin ka pua a, aw ngaitah in ka kikou a, “Ah! Mangpa Pasian Israel shimawh umsunte nangawn beimangsah sieng talawm ding na hiei mah?” Ka chi hi.","title":"A umsunte tunding kiana ding thuchiem"},"14":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tungkia a, ka kungah:"},"15":{"text":"“Mihing tapa na saltaanpi na unaute, na hieng nasante leh Israel innkuon pumpi leh Jerusalem a teng zousiete’n, Mangpa akipat gamlapi ah um un, tam gam ka tan ding ua hing kipie ahi, na chite ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: gamlapi a namte lah ah notmang nanleng tualeh gam tengah thethang nanleng zong ava peina gamte uah Keima hun tomkhat sung ama ua dingin amunsiengthou neu noukhat bang ka hi ding hi, chi in, achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Keima’n namte lah akipat ka hing puikhawm dinga, thethanga na umna uh gamte apat ka hing hankhawm ding a, Israel gam ka hing pe kia ding hi, chi-in, achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Khunah ahing pei ding ua, khuna silkidah huoite leh luohsuoh huoi zousie apaimang ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken amaute lungtang khat ka pe ding a, amaute sungah Hagau tha ka koi ding a, atahsa ua pat asuong lungtang uh ka lakhe ding a, tualeh tahsa lungtang ka pe ding hi.","ref":"Ezek. 36.26-28"},"20":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin ka danthute azui ding ua, ka thugousiete kem in azuita ding uhi. Amaute ka mite ahi ding ua, kei a Pasian uh ka hi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh asil huot huoite u’leh asil kidah huoite uh lam a alunguh hei nalaite pen asil bawl uh bangin amauh lutung ah ka thuh ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in, achi hi,” chiin, achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Cherubimten akung ua um kangtalai kengte toh aha uh azahtou ua, tualeh Israel Pasian thupina atunglam uah a um hi.","ref":"Ezek. 43.2-5"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh khopi lai akipat in Mangpa thupina khu apeitou a, khopi suolam a muol tungah a khawlta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hagau in kei ahing domkang a, tualeh mengmuna in Pasian Hagau in Kaldai gam a saltaangte kung ah ahing tutta hi. Tuachi’n mengmuna khu kei apat in apeitouta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n saltaangte kungah, Mangpa’n ahing musah zousie ka genta hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga:","title":"Saltaanna ding alim a etsahna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa mihelhat innkuonte lah a teng na hi, muna ding mit nei napi mulou, zahna ding bil neinapi a zalou, aziehpen amaute innkuon helhatte ahi uhi.","ref":"Isai. 6.9,10; Jer. 5.21; Mak. 8.18"},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mihing tapa saltaanna a pei ding bangin na vante ziel in, kisa inlen amitmu uah suntang lai in kipandoh inlen na umna mun apat mun dang ah saltang ding bangin pei in. Tua hileh innkuon helhatte ahivangun atheisiem khamaw sih ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Saltaang dingte bangin suntaang lai in amuna uah na vante na hing podoh ding hi, tualeh nitah lam chiengin amitmu uah, saltang dinga puidoh bangin na potdoh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amitmu uah kulbaang khuohvang inlen khunah potdoh in."},"6":{"text":"Amitmu uah na vante na liengkou ah puo inlen, khomui in pawtkhie in; tuol na mu theilouna dingin na mai tuom in; aziehpen Israel innkuonte a dingin nang chiemtena in ka hing bawlta hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n thupieh a ka um bangin ka bawlta hi. Sunlai in ka vante saltang ding van puo bangin ka podoh a, tualeh nitahin ka khut in kulbaang ka khuohvanga, nitah khawmui in ka potdoh a, amitmu uah, ka vante ka liengkou ah ka puo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh zingmawng in Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga, ka kungah:"},"9":{"text":"“Mihing tapa, Israel innkuon helhatten na kung ah bang bawl na hiei, ahing chisih uh amah? achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute kungah, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Tam puohgih khu Jerusalem leeng tapate leh alah ua um Juda innkuonte zousie tungthu ahi, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Kei khu noute ading in chiemtena ka hi, chiin. Ka bawlsa bangbang in amaute tungah ka bawl ding hi; amaute saltaang dinga puimang in a um ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"A lah ua leeng tapa in, khomui chiengin avante aliengkou ah akipuoh dinga, apawtdoh ding hi. A potdohna ding kulbaang akikhuohvang dinga, amit a tuol amulouna dingin amai atuom ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka len zong atungah ka zah dinga, ka thang ah a awh ding hi. Kaldaite gam Babilon khopi ah ka pui ding a, khuna shi ding ahivangin tua khopi amu sih ding hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.7; Jer. 52.11"},"14":{"text":"Ama panpi dinga akim avel a umte zousie leh agalkapte zousie hui lah ah ka thethang dinga, namsau dohsa in amauh ka nuadel ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Namte lah a amauh ka thethang a, gam chintenga ka thezah chiengin, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi ahing thei ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ahivangin ama u’lah a tawmnoukhat namsau akipat, kiel akipat leh natpi akipat in ka khawi dinga, tuachia nam dangte lah a, apei na zousie ua, akidahhuoina zousie uh aphuondoh theina ding un. Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi ahing thei ding uhi.”"},"17":{"text":"Tuathamlouin Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a:"},"18":{"text":"“Mihing tapa chitun kawm in na ann ne inlen, zau a kithing pum in na tui dawn in, achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Gamsung mite kungah, Mangpa Pasian in Jerusalem leh Israel gam a tengte tungtang thu ah tambangin agen hi: Amauten lungdong pum in a ann uh ane ding ua, zau pum in atui uh adawn ding uhi, agam khu asunga tengte hiemngamna ziehin asunga sil um zousie phietmang a a um theina dingin."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi tenna khopite zousie suhsiet in a um dinga, agam pen tennalou ahawm asuohta ding hi, tuachi’n kei Mangpa ka hi chi ahing thei ding uhi.”"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga, ka kungah:"},"22":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Israel gam a miten paunah ana nei uh: Nite asawt a mengmuna zousie lah bangma ahisih hi, kichi khu bang genna ahiei? achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin amauh hil in, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Tami paunah ka beisah dinga, Israel gamsungah amauten paunah in azangkha nawn sih ding uhi. Hinanleh amaute kungah, mengmuna zousie atunkimna ding nite ahing naita, chi in gen in."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen Israel innkuonte lah ah mengmuna dihlou leh kisolbawlna ai san mawngmawng a um nawn sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen kei Mangpa ka hi, thu kagen a, ka thugen khu atangtung dinga, avaigei nawn sih ding hi; aziehpen Aw nou helhat innkuonte, ka thugen pouma na damsung un ka tangtung sah ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.”"},"26":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a:"},"27":{"text":"“Mihing tapa, Israel innkuonten, mengmuna amu uh, tu akipat kumtampi nua chienga hing tung ding ahi, tualeh hun gamlapi ding thu agenlawh ahi bou hi, achi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in akung uah, tambang in agen hi: Ka thute khat zong avaigei nawn sih dinga, ka thugente pouma atangtung ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.”"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga:","title":"Guolnei zuoute tunga thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa, alung phut phut ua genlawhna gen Israel guolneite kalna in genlawhna gen inlen akung uah, Mangpa thu Ngaikhie un, chiin."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Bangma muchienna neiloupi a amauh lungsim ngaituona zui guolneite tung agih hi."},"4":{"text":"Aw Israel na guolneite khu khopi sesa nua a si-al umte bang giap ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa ni a kidouna a kulbaangte adinkip theina dingin, tua kulbaang kisete Israel innkuonte a ding a puopha dingin, na kuontou sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amaun mengmuna dihlou leh zuouthu a aisannate amu ua, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: achi uhi. Hinanleh Mangpa’n lah amauh asawl sih a, hinanleh athugen uh tangtung dingin akinem uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ke’n ka gen vawtloupi, ‘Mangpa’n agen hi, na chi ua, hinanleh mengmuna dihlou leh kisolna aisanna zuou thu giap na gen uh hilou ahiei mah?” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Thuzuoupi na gente u’leh mengmuna dihloupi na mute uh ziehin, ngai un noute ka hing dou ahi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka khut in mengmuna dihlou mute leh zuouthu a aisan guolneite adou dinga; amaute khu ka mite kikhawmte lah ah atel sih ding ua, Israel innkuonte minkhumna ah zong gellut ahi sih ding uhi, ahisihleh Israel gam sungah zong alut sih ding uhi. Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa Pasian ka hi chi na hing thei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen, azieh dihtah khu, amaun muonna umloupi, hamuong un, chiin ka mite ahenem uhi, tualeh kulbaang alep chieng un, amandet theilou senel in azut zol uhi.","ref":"Jer. 6.14; 8.11"},"11":{"text":"Tua banga amandet theilou senel a zutzolte kungah, tua baang chim ding ahi chi’n gen in. Guopi nasatah azu dinga, gieltang lienpipi akedinga, khopi hui in anuoi chim ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Adihtahin Kulbaang achip chiengin, mite’n na kung uah na zutmatna uh hei a umta ahiei ahing chisih dinguh amah? achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ka thangpaina khopihui langin ka phuse sah dinga, ka lungthahna guopi nasatah ka zusah ding hi, tualeh ka lungthahna gieltang lienpipi ten asumang ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n amantheilou senel a na zut uh kulbaang khu tuol dongin ka chimsah dinga, asuongphum nangawn ka dawhsah ding hi, achim dinga, alah ah suhmang in na um ding uhi. Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi na hing thei ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tambangin ka lungthahna baang tung leh amandet theilou senel a zutte tungah ka subuching dinga, tualeh na kung uah, Baang a um nawn sih a, azutmat mite zong a um nawn sih uhi, ka chi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuakhu Jerusalem tungtang thugen Israel guolneite muonna umloupi, ama a muonna dinga, mengmuna mute a um nawn sih uh, china ahi, Mangpa Pasian in, achi hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tuamabangin Mihing tapa, amauh lungtang apat a thugenlawh na mite tanute, kimaituopi inlen amauh kalin genlawhna gen in.","title":"Guolnei numei dihloute tunga thukhenna"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, chiin: Numeiten mite ban a, zawldei ai bun sah a, mite hinna mat na dinga miliente lukhu khui numeite tung agih hi! Nouma hinna humbitna dingin ka mite hinna na sui tuom ding uh amah?"},"19":{"text":"Barli bu sipdimkhat leh tanghou themkhat thalaw in, zuouthu ngainuom ka mite kunga zuouthu genin ashilou dingte that in, ashi dingte hingkhawi in, ka mite lah ah Kei na hing subua ding uh amah?"},"20":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai un, vate mat banga ka mite hinna na matna uh na mitphieldawi ai bute uh ka muda a, na ban uapat ka bottan ding hi, va bang a thanga na mat uh ka mite hinna ka hakhe dinga ka pei sah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Na lu khuna dielte ka botkeh dinga, ka mite na khut apat ka hunkhe dinga, tuachi’n va bet banga na bet dingun na khut uah aum nawn sih ding uhi, Tuachi’n kei Mangpa ka hi chi na hing thei ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ken midihtat ka lunggim sah lou lai in, nouten zuouthu gen in midihtat na lunggim sah uhi, tualeh, ahinna humbitna dinga migilou a umdan gilou kiheisan ding lai kiheisan lou dingin akhutte uh na suhat zawsop uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin nouten mengmuna dihlou na mu nawn sih ding ua, zuouthu zong na genlawh nawn sih ding uhi, aziehpen ken ka mite na khut uapat ka hunkhe ding a, tualeh kei Mangpa ka hi chi na thei ding uhi.”"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel upate lawikhat ka kungah ahing haw ua ka mai ah ahing tou uhi.","title":"Upate milim biehna"},"2":{"text":"Tualaitahin Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung a:"},"3":{"text":"“Mihing tapa tam miten alungtang uoh a milimte uh akoi ua, amasang uah kipalpuana khelnate akoi uhi, Kei amaute kankhiet in ka um ding amah?"},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin amauh houpi inlen akung uah; Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Israel innkuonte michin in alungtang ua milimte a um sah ua, amasang ua kipalpuana khelna akoi ua, guolnei mai a hing pei pouma, Kei Mangpa mama in amilimte tamdan dungzui in ka dawng ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel innkuonten a milimte uh zieh a, ahing kituom bawlsan ziehun, alungtang ua ka mat theina dingin."},"6":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Israel innkuonte kungah thu gen inlen, Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Kisia unlen, na milimte ua kipat hing kihei unlen, na kidahhuoinate ua pat na maite uh heimang un."},"7":{"text":"Israel innkuonte lah a mi koi ahiei, ahisihleh Israel gam a teng mikhuol hitaleh, Kei akipat a kituomkoi a, alungtanga amilimte vom a, amasang a kipalpuana ding a khelna koi a, guolnei kunga keima tungtang dong dinga ava haw leh Keima Mangpa mama in ka dawng ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua mipa khu ka kimaituopi ding a, ama khu mite chiemte leh Paunah in ka bawl ding a, ka mite lah akipat ama ka satkhe ding hi; tuachi’n kei Mangpa ka hi chi na hing thei ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh guolnei khu silkhat poupou gen dinga sol leh zawlzou a a umleh, Kei, Mangpa’n tua guolnei khu ka zawlzou ahi ding a, ama dou in ka khut ka lamtou dinga, ka mi Israelte lah akipat ama ka sumang ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaun agitlouna maw uh akipuoh ding ua, guolneipa zong ama kunga thukanpa toh akigawtna akibang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel innkuonte kei akipat avahmang nawn sih ding ua, akhelnate zousie u’toh amauleh amauh akisubua nawn sih ding uhi. Tuachi’n amaute ka mite ahi ding ua, Kei a Pasian uh ka hi ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi,” chiin, achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a,","title":"Jerusalem suhsiet ding ahi"},"13":{"text":"“Mihing tapa, gam khat in ka tung ah ginum louna toh gamta akhel chiengin, atungah ka khut ka laam dinga, tua gam ne leh taah kipieh tuona ka sattan dinga, atungah kiel ka sawl dinga, mihing leh sate gam sung apat ka tengsah sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tam mi thumte: Noah, Daniel, leh Job, tam gamsung ah na um nan u’leh, adihtatna un amauh hinna bep ahundoh ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ken tua gamsungah gamsate tuonsuoh sah in, tua gam nekhawngin, gamsate ziehin koima vah theilouna khopin kilawita leh;"},"16":{"text":"Tam mi thumte nangawn gam sungah umnan u’leh keima ka hin zing mabangin, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi; tapate ahiei, tanute ahiei, ahundoh thei sih ding ua, amaute maimai hutdoh in a um ding uhi, hinanleh agam pen tenna giehna lou in akilawi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"“Ahisihleh tua gam tung a namsau ka lensah a, namsau kunga gam sung tuonsuoh inlen, mi leh sa thatgam in ka chi leh;"},"18":{"text":"Tam mi thumte gam sung ah umnan u’leh, Ka hinna sielin ka gen ahi, tapate hiin, tanute hitaleh ahundoh sih ding ua, hinanleh a mauh maimai akihundoh ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahisihleh tua gam sunga natpi ka sawl a, tua gam tungah ka thangpaina sisan, sungbuo in, asung a mi leh sate thatgam siengta leng;"},"20":{"text":"Noah, Daniel leh Job, asunga um manan u’leh zong, ka hinna siel in ka gen hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi, amauten tapa hiin tanu hitaleh ahunkhe sih ding ua, adihtatna un amauh maimai ahunkhe ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Jerusalem khopi sunga mi leh sate thatgam dinga, tam Jerusalem tung a ka thukhenna chizat huoi li, namsau, kiel, gamsa giloute leh hiipi, ka sawl hun chiengin bang chitah a huoisie zaw ding ata diei!","ref":"Kihil. 6.8"},"22":{"text":"Ahivang in ngai un, khunah tapate leh tanute puidoh a um ding mi asuohta umsun honkhat nuasie in a um ding ua, ngai un na kung uah ahing pei ding ua, a umdan u’leh asilbawlte uh na mu ding uhi, tuachi’n Jerusalem tunga sietna ka hing tunsah pouma tungtang thu ah, ahi, atunga ka hing tunsah sil zousie toh kisai in hamuon in na umta ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh a umdan u’leh a silbawlte uh na mu chiengun, ahing hamuon ding ua, atunga ka bawl zousie, azieh bei a ka bawl ahisih chi na thei ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.”"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga;","title":"Grep gui a gentena"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa grepsing khu sing dangte sangin ahisihleh gammang sing laha ba khat sanga grep sing bangchi dan a hoizaw adiei?"},"3":{"text":"Silmanthei khat pou pou bawlna dingin grep apat sing akila ngai amah? Ahisihleh min van khaina dingin themkhet grepgui apat ala ngai uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"Tuanahsangin, meikhuh ah akivang lut a, among lang ni tuoh, mei in akahtum chiengin alai meihol asuoh a, amanna ding a um eimah?"},"5":{"text":"Ngai in, ahoilai in zong bangma phattuomna anei sih leh, akahtuma meihol asuoh nua in, bang in akimang thei nawn diei? achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin a gen hi: Mei a vah dinga ka pieh, gammang singte lah a grep singte bangin, Jerusalem a tengte zong ka pe ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh amauh ka kimaituopi dinga, meikuong khat apat apei ding ua, meikuong dangin amauh akatum ding hi; tualeh amauh ka kimaituopi tah chiengin, Kei Mangpa ka hichi ahing thei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute aginumlou seng ziehun, tambanga tenna giehna lou in agam uh ka suse ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi,” chi in."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Pasian in Israel akhotuo nalai"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Jerusalem akidah huoinate theisah inlen, akungah gen in;"},"3":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in Jerusalem kungah tambangin agen hi: Na kipatna leh na pienna khu Kanaan mite gam ahi a, na pa khu Amormi ahi a, na nu khu Hit mi ahi."},"4":{"text":"Na pienna thu ahileh, na pienni in na laigui at ahi sih a, na sienthouna dingin tui in ahing kisil sih a, chi ahing kinu sih a, puon in zong ahing kituom sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tam silte na tunga bawl ding leh na tungah lainatna nei dingin koima mit in nang ahing hepi sih a, hinanleh gamlah a paidoh a um na hizaw hi, na pien ni akipat nasatah a deilou leh kidah na hiziehin."},"6":{"text":"“Tualeh na kunga ka hing suohkhah laiin nangma sisan lah a na kipeh lai ka hing mu a, sisan lah a na kidie laiin, ‘Hing in’ ka hing chi hi."},"7":{"text":"Gamlah singnou dawng bangin ka hing khangsah a, tuachi’n na hing khang lien a, na hing piching a, nungah melhoitah na hing hita hi. Na nawite ahing baw a, na sam ahing sau a, ahivangin saguoh leh guohtang in na um nalai hi."},"8":{"text":"“Na kungah ka hing suohkia a, Ka hing en a, Ngai in na deihuoi hun laitah ahi a, tuachi’n na tungah ka puon mong ka hing zawn a, na guohtanna ka hing khupieh hi. Ahi, na kungah kihahsiel in ka kichiem a, tualeh nang toh thuhun ka bawlta hi, tuachi’n kei a na hing hita hi, Mangpa Pasian in, achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n tui in ka hing silsienga, Ahi, na tunga sisan bangte hoitah in ka silsienga, tualeh sathau ka hing nu hi."},"10":{"text":"Puonzem hoitah ka hing silsah a, savunnem kengtodap ka hing bun sah a, tualeh puonmalngat ka hing silsah a, puonnem nouin ka hing tuom hi."},"11":{"text":"Kizepna vante in ka hing zem a, na khut ah tau ka hing but sah a, na ngawng ah, khainieng ka hing awsah hi."},"12":{"text":"Na nahkuo ah sana kuol ka hing khai pieha, na bil ah bilba ka hing butsah a, na lutungah lukhu hoileh kilawm kang khusah hi."},"13":{"text":"Tambang in, nang pen sana leh dangka in na kizem a, na puonsilte puonmalngat, puonnem leh puonzem kilawmtahte ahi, na ann neh lah tangbuongnel hoite, khuoizu leh sathau ngen ahi, tuachi’n na mel ahing hoi mama a, leenggam khat hithei ding khopin na hing khangdoh ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Na melhoina ziehin namte lah ah na minthangta a, na tunga ka koi thupinate ziehin ahing bukimta hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"15":{"text":"“Hinanleh na melhoina na suongta a, na minthanna ziehin na kizuata hi. Koi hinanleh na kunga suohkha pouma kungah na mingaihatna na hohkheta hi.","title":"Israel in Pasian anuolta"},"16":{"text":"Na puonsilte khenkhat na sutkhie a, na munsangte chituom tuom in na zem a, atungah na kizua hi. Tambang silte a um ding ahisih a, atun zong atun ngai ding ahisih hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka hing piehsa kizepna manpha, sana leh dangkate na la a, pasal milimte na bawl a, tuate toh ang na kawm a, na kizua nalai hi."},"18":{"text":"Na puonzem hoilekilawmte na la a, amaute na zawnkhum a, tualeh ka sathau leh ka gimnamtuite amasang uah na lan hi."},"19":{"text":"Na ann neh dinga ka hing piehsa, ka hing vahna tangbuong nel hoi leh sathau leh khuoizute zong amasang uah gimnamtui dingin na lui a, tuabang ahita hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuathamlou in tanu leh tapa kei ding na hing hinpiehte, na zawpi a, katum dingin akung uah kithoina in na lan hi. Tambanga na huasanna nasepte sil neutham ahiei mah?"},"21":{"text":"Ka tate na that a, amaute meikuong lai ah na peisuoh sah a, meikuongah vangin na lan hi."},"22":{"text":"Na kidahhuoina zousie leh na huana nasep zousie ziehin, na khangdawn lai nite leh saguoh leh guohtanga sisan lah a na kipeh lai na theikha nawn sih hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tuachi’n hichi ahing hi a, na gitlouna zousie nua in, Na tung agih hi, na tung agih hi, Mangpa Pasian in, achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Nangma ding munsiengthou na kilam a, tualeh gawlzing tengah nangma adingin munsangte na kibawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Lamkathuom chintengah nangma a dingin munsangte na lam a, na melhoina khu kidahhuoi na suohsahta hi. Na kunga hing suohkha pouma kungah, na pum in na kipha a, na huasanna na supung sem sem hi."},"26":{"text":"Mi etlahat salam a na innveng Izipt mite toh na kingai a, kei hing sulungthah dingin na huana na pungsah sem sem hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin ngai in, nang douin na tungah ka khut ka laamta a, na ann mudan ngaina ka kiemsahta, tualeh nang hing muda mama Philistin tanute, na huasan dan hing zumpi mamate khut sungah a ut dandan ua ahing bawl ding un ka hing pedohta hi."},"28":{"text":"Assiria mite kung ah zong na kizua a, hunta chi na neilou ziehin, akung uah na kizua a, ahivangin na lungkim thei naituom sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuathamlouin na kizua thangtatna in, summet bawlte gam, Babilon dongchieng ah na pungsah semsem a, tambangteng nangawn ah na lungkim zou nai nalai sih hi."},"30":{"text":"“Bangzata a lungtang zawngkhal nei va-ia talawm a, tambang a numei tele kizuanu umdan banga um talawm na hiei, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Lamkathuom chintengah mun sesang na kibawl a, gawlzing tengah inn sang na kilam hi. Ahivang in aman na lah lou ziehin kizua zong na bang sih hi."},"32":{"text":"Nang zi angkawm, apasal sanga midangte deizaw nu na hi."},"33":{"text":"Miten kizuate kungah aman ape zel ua, hinanleh nang na angkawmpite kungah aman na pezaw a, heisung mun pou a, nang ahing zot ua, ahing luppi theina dingun, na golgu zawsop hi."},"34":{"text":"Na kizuana thu ah koiman nang luppi dingin ahing chiel sih ua, nangman aman na pieh zawsop a, nang aman ahing kipieh lou ziehin numei dangte toh kilebul na hi, tuaziehin nangpen akilebul na hi."},"35":{"text":"“Tuachi’n tuin Aw nang kizuanu, Mangpa thu na ngai in.","title":"Pasian in Israel agawtna"},"36":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, Na kidahhuoina sunbuoh a um a, na angkawmpite toh na pahtatna zieh a, na guohtanna na dohsah ziehin leh akidahhuoi mama na milimte ziehin leh, na tate sisan amaute kunga na pieh ziehin;"},"37":{"text":"Tuaziehin pellouin, nuom na sahpi na angkawmpite zousie leh na itte zousie leh na mudate zousie nangma dou dingin, ka khawm khawm ding a, na kimkot ah ama uh ka hankhawm dinga, amaute mai ah na puonsil ka hawhkhe dinga na guohtanna amu ding uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh nang khu kiten dan botsie leh sisansuo numei vaihawmkhum bangin ka hing vaihawmkhum dinga, Ka thangpaina leh thangsietna sisan phuba na tungah kala ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Akhut sung uah ka hing pelut dinga, amaun na mun dawsangte asuchim ding ua, na munsangte asuse ding uhi. Amaun na puonsilte ahing hawhkhiet pieh ding ua, na suongmantam kizepna hoite ala ding ua, saguoh leh guohtangin ahing nuasie ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"Amaun nang hing dou dingin mipi ahing zawpitou ding ua, suongin ahing sep ding ua, namsau in ahing satnen ding uhi."},"41":{"text":"Na innte uh mei in ahal ding ua, numei tampite mitmu in na tungah thukhenna abawl ding uhi; tualeh ken na kizuana ka tawpsah dinga, na angkawmpi ding koima na lei nawn sih ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n na tunga ka lungthahna ka khawlsahta dinga, ka thangsietna nang akipat akiheimang dinga, ka sip khin khian dinga, ka lungthah nawn sih ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Na khangdawn lai nite thei ngitnget lou a, tam silte zousie a na hing suh lunggim tah ziehin, Ken zong na silbawlte, pellou in na lutungah ka hing thuh ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi. “Na kidah huoina zousie belapna dingin tambang huana na bawl nawn sih ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Ngai in, michin paunah zang pouma in, na tungah tami paunah azang ding uhi, Tanu in anu asun hi, achi ding uhi."},"45":{"text":"Nang pen apasal leh atate muda, na nu tanu na hi a, tualeh apasalte u’leh atate uh muda sanggam numeite sanggam numei na hi, na nu khu Hitmi ahia na pa Amormi ahi hi."},"46":{"text":"Na u numei khu Samaria ahi a, ama atanute toh nanga kipat mallam ah ateng ua, tualeh na nau numei khu nanga pat simlam ateng Sodom leh atanute ahi uhi."},"47":{"text":"Amauh umdan banga na um a, asilkidahhuoi bawlte uh na bawl guoh hilou in, hun tomnou khat sungin amaute sangin, na hing sezawta hi."},"48":{"text":"Ka hinna siel in ka gen hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi: Na sanggamnu Sodom leh atanuten zong, nang leh na tanute bawl bangin abawl sih uhi."},"49":{"text":"En in, tami na sanggamnu Sodom khelna ahi: Ama leh atanute, akisathei ua, ann nehval anei ua, nuomsa tah in a um ua, ahivangin mizawng leh tasamte apanpi sih uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tualeh akithupisah ua, Ka masang ah silkidahhuoi abawl uhi, tuaziehin ka mu bepin amauh ka lamangta hi."},"51":{"text":"Samaria in na khelna bawl kimkhat zong abawl zou sih hi, hinanleh amauh sangin na kidahhuoina na supung sem sem a, na kidahhuoi bawlte ziehin na sanggamnute siem na tangsahta hi."},"52":{"text":"Na sanggamnute awimawnuin, amaute sanga silkidahhuoi na bawltam zoh ziehin leh na khelnate ziehin, na zumnate nangman na kikhuh ding ahi; amaute khelna sangin, nangma khelnate akidahhuoi zawh ziehin, nang sanga amaute dihtatzaw a kilang uh ahi. Ahi, na sanggamnute dihtatzaw a kilangsah na hi zieh in maizum inlen, na zalatna ki puoh in."},"53":{"text":"“Asaltaanna ua pat ka hing pui kia a, Sodom leh atanute leh Samaria leh atanute a saltaanna ua pat ka hing puidoh kia hun chiengin, amaute lah a nangma saltaangte zong asaltaanna ua pat ka hing puikia ding hi."},"54":{"text":"Ama ua dinga hamuonna na hi tahzieh a, na zalatna na kipuoh a, na silbawlte zousie na zumpi theina dingin."},"55":{"text":"Na sanggamnu Sodom leh atanute masanglai a adinmun ua ahing umkia chieng un, tualeh Samaria leh atanute masanglai a adinmun ua ahing umkia chiengun, nang leh na tanute zong masanglai a na dinmun uah na hing umkia ding uhi."},"56":{"text":"Aziehpen na kiletsah lai in na sanggam nu Sodom na kam in na genkha ngai sih hi."},"57":{"text":"Na gitlouna mudoh ahi masangin. Tuinvang Siria tanute leh akimvela mi zousie, na kimvel a um Philistin tanute leh akimvel a mi zousie, na kimvel a um Philistin tanute simmaw in na umta hi."},"58":{"text":"Na huana leh na kidahhuoina khelna leh gawtna na kipuoh ahi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"59":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, Thuhun palsan a, kichiemna khoh nasah lou ziehin na silbawl bang bangin in ka hing thuh ding hi."},"60":{"text":"Ahivang in na khangdawnlai nite a, nang toh ka thuhun ka thei ngitnget ding a, nang toh kumtawn thuhun ka hung ding hi.","title":"Pasian in athuhun athei ngitnget hi"},"61":{"text":"Tuachi’n na u numeite leh na nau numeite, na mu chieng in, na umdante na hing thei ngitnget dinga na zumta ding hi; Ken amaute na tanute hi dingin na kungah ka hing pe dinga hinanleh nang toh ka thuhun zieh ahisih ding hi."},"62":{"text":"Tualeh nang toh ka thuhun ka sudet ding hi. Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi na hing thei ding hi."},"63":{"text":"Na silbawlte zousie ka hing ngaidamtah chieng in, na zumnate na thei ngitnget a, zalatah a um ding na hi ziehin, ham dingin na kam na kaah nawn sih ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.”"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Mupi lienni gente thu"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa thuhasa khat podoh inlen, Israel innkuonte kungah gentena thu khat gen in."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambang in thu agen hi: Muvanlai lientah, ha lienpi leh sautah nei amul zetuom tuom a pawl bielbuol khat Lebanon ah ahing leenga, sidar singkung sangdawn ah atu hi."},"4":{"text":"Azih dawng sang pen atutan a, summet bawlna gam ah apuo a, summetbawlte khopi ah asuonta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman agam haichi zong ala a, lei hoina mun ah a suon a, tui kiningchinna mun ah akoi a, huisum sing bang in asuon hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh ahing khangdoh a, grepgui bazam ngiem bilbel, abate ama lam a zamlut, hinanleh ahuite a nuoi ah a umden hi. Tuachi’n grepgui ahing suoh a, abate ahing mengdoh a, anate ahing selnouta hi."},"7":{"text":"“Muvanlai lientah, ha lienpi leh mul tampi nei dang khat ahing um hi. Ngai vawi, tami grepgui in ama lam ah ahuite aha a, abate azam sah hi, akisuonna leikuohte a tui abuoh theina dingin."},"8":{"text":"Abate ahing zamdoh theina ding leh, ahing ga theina dingin, Tualeh grepgui hoitah ahing hi theina dingin, tui tampi gei a, lei hoina mun a kitha suonkia ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Tami grepgui ahingdoh zouna diei mah? Ahuite a botdohin, agate muot sah in, ana tha hing selnoute vuoisah in, apulsah sih ding amah? Ahui pum a botdoh dingin, ban thahat leh mi tampi angai sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mundang ah kitha suonkia nanleh, akhangdoh zou na dieimah? Suolam hui in asem chiengin, avuoi gawp sih ding amah? Apouna mun mama ah, avuoi ding hi,” achi hi, chiin."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu ka kung ah ahing tunga,"},"12":{"text":"“Tuin helhat innkuonte kungah, Tam silte bang genna ahiei chi na theisih uh amah? Chi inlen, Babilon leengpa Jerusalem ah ahing pei a, leengpa leh amiliente Babilon lang ah azawpita hi, chi in hil in, achi hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.15-20; 2 Khang. 36.10-13"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh aman leengpa hah leh suon mi khat aman a, thuhun abawlpi a, kichiemna aneisah hi. Aman gamsung a mihatte zong apuimangta hi."},"14":{"text":"Aleenggam aloingiemna ding leh ama thu a adindoh zou lou a, hinanleh athuhun zuina zieh a adindoh theina ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh sakolte leh galkap tampite pe ding a ngen dingin Izipt ah palai sawlin Babilon leengpa tungah ahelta hi. Alawching na diei? Tambang silte bawlpa asuohta na diei? Thuhun palsanin asuohta na diei? Chiin hilin, achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahinna ka hin laisie Mangpa Pasian in achi hi; pellouin, ama leeng a pangsahpa, kichiemna a simmaw pieh a, athuhun bawl apalsan piehpa leengpa tenna mun Babilon mama ah ashi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Kidouna a mi tampi thaliana ding a, lei sesang leh kulte abawl hun chiengun zong, Pharaoh leh agalkap hon hatte leh pawl thupitahten zong, ama dingin bangma abawlpieh thei sih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Thuhun palsan in, kichiemna asimmawta a, en in, thuchiem dinga akhut apieh nua a, tam silte zousie abawl mawhpen, asuohta vawt sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ahin a ka hinlaisie, pellou in, asimmaw kichiemna leh apalsan tua thuhun ama lutung ah ka thuh ngei ngei ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A tung ah ka lenthang ka zah ding a, ka thang ah a awh ding hi. Tuachi’n Babilon langah ka zawpi dinga, ka tunga abawl khelnate ziehin khunah ama ka gawt ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Apawlte toh taizah zousie namsau in ashi ding ua, asuohta sunte hui lah ah ka thethang ding a, tuachi’n Kei Mangpa’n tam thu ka gen ahi chi na thei ding uhi.”"},"22":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi. “Keima mama in sidar sing sang pen, dawn a azih sangpen ka la dinga, ka suon ding hi. Azihpipen azih dawng ngihngeh khat ka hiehtan dinga, muol kitawi leh sang pen ah ka suon ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Israel muolsangte ah ka suon dinga, abate ahing nei dinga, ahing ga dinga, tualeh sidar sing hoitah ahing hi ding a, anuoi ah va chinteng ateng ding ua, abazam himte lah ah bu abawl ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Gamlah a singte zousie in, Kei Mangpa’n sing sangte ka luoi ngiem a, sing ngiemte ka sangsah a, sing hingte ka gawsah a, sing gawte ka hing sah hi, chi athei ding uhi. Kei Mangpa’n kagenta a, ka tangtung sahta hi,” chiin achi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a:","title":"Mimal khelna zieh a atunga thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"“Pate’n grep thua ane ua, tate ha aza hi, chi a Israel gam tungtang a tam paunah na zah uh bang na china uh ahiei?","ref":"Jer. 31.29"},"3":{"text":"Ahin a ka hinlaisie, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi, Israel gam ah tami paunah na zang nawn sih ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ngai un, hinna zousie kei a ahi a, Pa hinna mabangin tapa hinna zong kei a ahi; khelna bawl hinna pouma ashi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Hinanleh mi adihtat a, dan bang leh thudih abawla ahileh;"},"6":{"text":"muol tunga aneh ngailou a, Israel innkuonte milim pasiente en a, adahtou lou a, a innvengpa zi asuhbua lou a, numei sinei lai ava luppi lou a."},"7":{"text":"Koimakhat zong asuhgenthei lou a, leiba mi kunga akichiemna silkham apieh kia a, hiemngam taha mi asuomlou a, gilkielte kunga ann neh ding apieh a, guohtanga umte puon apieh a;"},"8":{"text":"a pung del a leitawi sah lou a, sum pung zong la lou a, gitlouna apat akhut anua lahkia a, mihing leh mihing kikaal a, thukhenna dih abawl a;"},"9":{"text":"Ka danthupiehte azui a, ka vaihawmnate ginumtah a akep leh, Ama mi dih ahi a, ahing ngeingei ding hi! Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.5"},"10":{"text":"“Aman tapa ahin a, suomhat, ahisihleh sisan suomi khat, tualeh tam silte lah a khat pen pen bawl ahi a;"},"11":{"text":"Abawl dinga mawpuohna silte bawllou a, ahivanga muoltung a biehna innte a aneh a, a innvengpa zi asuhbua a,"},"12":{"text":"mi zawng leh tasamte asuhgenthei a, hiemngam tah a asuom a, Leiba kichiemna silkhamna anuapieh lou a, milim pasiente amit a entou a, ahisihleh silkidahhuoite bawl a,"},"13":{"text":"Sumpung del a mi aleitawi sah a, apung alah a ahileh tuabang mi ahing diei? Ahing sih ding hi!
