Tambang silkidahhuoite abawl leh, ashi ngeingei ding a; asisan maw ama tungah a tuding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Hinanleh tam mipa’n tapa khat nei henlen, apa silgilou bawl zousie amu a, angaituo a, tuabangin abawl sih a,"},"15":{"text":"muoltungte ah ane sih a, Israel innkuonte milim pasien lang en in amit ahahtou sih a, a innvengpa zi asubua sih a,"},"16":{"text":"Koima bawlgenthei lou a, leiba mi kichiemna silkhamna atuhdenlou a, hiemngam tah a suomlou a, hinanleh gilkielte kunga ann pie a, saguoh a umte puon asil sah a,"},"17":{"text":"mizawngte akipat a akhut nualah a, sumpung leh amet lalou a, ka vaihawmte zui a, ka danthupiehte bang a gamta mi khu, apa khelna ziehin ashi sih ding a, ahing ngei ngei ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Apa ahileh, aman tatsetah in mi asugenthei a, hiemngamtah a a sanggampa a suom ziehin, tualeh amite lah a, ahoilou silte abawlziehin, En in akhelna zieh in ashi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"“Hinapi in nouten, bangzieh a tapa in apa khelna polou ding ahiei? na chi uhi. Tapa in danbang leh adih abawl a, ka thupiehte azui a, abawl zieh in ahing ngei ngei ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi hinna khiel pouma ahi ashi ding. Tapa in apa mawna aposih ding a, pa in zong tapa mawna aposih ding hi. Midihtat dihtatna khu ama tung ah a um dinga, migilou gitlouna zong ama tung ah a um ding hi.","ref":"Danp. 24.16"},"21":{"text":"“Ahivang in migilouin khelna a na bawl zousie akiheisan a ka thupiehte zousie azui a dan bangtah leh adih abawl leh, tuabang mi khu ahing ngei ngei dinga ashi sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Asilbawl khelsate khatbeh zong atungah thei ngitnget ahi nawnta sih ding hi, asildih bawlte ziehin ahing ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Migiloute shina ah ka kipah ngai mawngmawng amah? A umdan ua kipat ahing kihei ua ahin chiengun ka kipah zaw sih amah? Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh midihtat khat, adihtatna apat kilehei henlen, khelna bawl in, migiloute silbawl kidahhuoite bawlta leh ahing diei mah? Adihtatna bawlsa zousie khat beeh zong thei ngitnget ahi nawnta sih ding hi; a ginumlouna zieha gitlouna abawlte leh akhelnate ziehin ashi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"“Hinanleh nouten Mangpa lampi adih sih, na chi uhi. Israel innkuonte aw tuin Ngai un, Ka lampite adih sih amah? Nou lampite hilou i adih louzaw?"},"26":{"text":"Midihtat adihtatna apat akilehei a, khelna abawl a, akhelna bawlte a ashi leh akhelna bawl ziehin ashi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahivang in migilou khat agitlouna bawlsate apat akilehei a, dan bang leh dihtah a abawl leh ahinna a hundam ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Akhelnate zousie angaituo ngetngut a, tuate akiheimangsan zieh in, ahing ngeingei ding a, ashi sih ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel innkuonten Mangpa lampi adihsih na chi uhi. Israel innkuonte aw, Ka lampite dihlou maw? Nou lampite hilou i adih lou?"},"30":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Israel innkuonte aw, thukhenna hing bawl khum ding ka hi, michin agamtat dan dungzui ua, thukhen ding ka hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi. Kisia unlen na khelnate zousie ua pat kihei un, tuachi’n na khelna uh khu na manthaina uh ahisih ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Na sil bawlkhelsate zousie uh nou akipat paimang unlen, lungtang tha leh hagau tha kiguon un. Israel innkuonte aw, bangzieha shi ding na hi uoi mah?"},"32":{"text":"Aziehpen koima shina ah kipahna ka nei sih hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi. Tuaziehin lunghei unlen hing un.”"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaban ah Israel leeng tapate adingin, kaateng lou inlen;","title":"Israel miliente suunna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh na nu khu bang ahiei? Humpibahneinu ahi: Humpibahneite lah ah a lum a; Humpibahnei lunlaite lah ah, anoute avah lien hi."},"3":{"text":"Aman anoute lah a khat avah lien a, humpibahnei hattah ahing hita a, Samat dan ahing kizil a, mihingte nangawn anegamta hi."},"4":{"text":"Namten zong ama tungtang azata ua, ahumtawna sung uah amanta ua, tualeh siakhau a khi in Izipt gam ah ahing tutta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ama’n angah thawn a, a lawsam a, akinepna abeita chi a mu tahin, anoute lah a khat ala kia a, humpibahnei hattah in abawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Humpibahneite lah ah avah kawi a, humpibahnei hattah ahing hita a, aman samat dan ahing zil a, mihingte nangawn anetumta hi."},"7":{"text":"Aman akulpite uh aphetgawp a, akhopite uh tenna louin akoi a, ahumhamna in gam leh, asunga um zousie azausah hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamkai munchin akipat in, namten ama adou ua, atungah alenthangte uh azahkhum ua, ahumtawkuoh uah amanta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Siakuoi toh abawm sungah akhum ua, Babilon leengpa kungah ahing zawpi ua, ahawh ging Israel taang tungte a, akizah nawnlouna dingin, kulpi sungah akhumta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na nu u’khu na grep huon ua, tui gei a kisuon grepgui bang ahi a, tui atam ziehin ga tamtah asuonga abawhpha mama hi.","title":"Grepgui vuoi toh gentena"},"11":{"text":"Aman vaihawm mite leengchieng ding, akung khautah tah anei a, abazam dangte lah ah asang pen a, abawhpha mamate khupin akimu thei hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh ama khu lungthahna a bawdoh in a um a, tuol a pai in a um a, suolam hui in agate asem gawta a, aba khautah tahte atawng a, avuoi siengta a, mei in akatum siengta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuin ama khu gamdai ah, gamgaw leh tui umlouna ah akisuonta hi."},"14":{"text":"Abate khat akipat mei ahing kuonga, tuamin agate akatumta hi, tuachi’n Vaihawmna dinga leengchieng ding, akung khau a um nawnta sih hi. Tami Kaala ahi a, Kaatenga sah ding ahi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Akum sagina, aha ngana, ani sawm niin Israel upate pawl khat Mangpa thu kan dingin ahing haw ua, ka mai ah atou uhi.","title":"Izipt a Israelte"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,"},"3":{"text":"“Mihing tapa, Israel upate houpi inlen akung uah Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Kei thu kankhe dinga hing pei na hi uh amah? Ahin a ka hinlaisie noute kankhiet dingin ka um sih ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute tungah thu na khen ding amah? Mihing tapa aw amaute na vaihawm khum ding amah? Apu apate uh kidahhuoina akung uah theisah in."},"5":{"text":"Akung uah, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Israelte ka tel ni in, Jakob innkuonte hah leh suonte lam ah banzah in ka kichiema, Izipt gam ah amaute kungah Keima ka kitheisah a, banzah in ka kichiem a, akung uah, Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi, ka chi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 6.2-8"},"6":{"text":"Tuani in, Izipt gam a kipat amaute ka puidoh dinga, ama ua ding a ka suikhiet nawitui leh khuoizu a luonna gam, gam zousie lah a hoi pen ah ka puilut ding chi in, banzah in ka kichiemta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hunlai in amaute kungah, noute michin in, enlatah a na et uh milim kidahhuoite na mit ua pat paikhie unlen, Izipt gam milimte in kisubua sih un, Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi chiin thu ka gen hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh amauh ka tungah ahel ua, ka thu amang sih uhi. Amaun amit ua pat silkidahhuoite zousie apaimang ut sih ua, Izipt gam milimte ataisan tuom sih uhi. “Tuachi’n ken Izipt gam ah atung uah ka lungthahna ka sungbaw ding a, ka thangpaina ka tangtung sah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahivang in Izipt gam akipat, amauh ka puidoh na dinga, amitmu ua ka kitheisahnate leh alah ua aumna uh namte masanga ka min subua a aumlouna dingin, ka min ziehin ka bawlzawta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin Izipt gam pawtsan dingin amaute gamdai ah ka hing puita hi.","title":"Gamdai ah"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh ka danthubawlte ka pie a, ka danthupiehte zong ka theisah hi; tuate zui pouma ahing ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.5"},"12":{"text":"Tuatebanah Kei leh amaute kikaal a chiemtena hi dingin ka khawlnite zong ka pie hi, Kei amauh susiengthou Mangpa ka hi chi atheina ding un.","ref":"Pawt. 31.13-17"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel innkuonte gamdai ah ka tungah ahelta ua, ka danthubawlte azuisih ua, ka danthupiehte mi’n azui a ahileh ahinna ding uh hinapi, asimmaw uhi, tualeh ka khawlnite nasatah in asubua uhi. “Tuachi’n ken gamdai ah amauh thatgam dingin ka lungthahna atung uah ka sungbaw ding hi, ka chi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahivang in amitmu ua amauh ka hing puidohna namte masangah suhbua a, a umlouna dingun ka min ziehin ka bawlzawta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute ka piehsa gam, zousie lah a hoipen, nawitui leh khuoizu luonna gam ah amauh ka puilut sih ding chiin, gamdai ah banzah in ka kichiemta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 14.26-35"},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun ka vaihawmnate a simmaw ua, ka danthubawlte azui sih uhi, hinanleh ka khawlnite a subua uhi, alungtangte un amilimte uh azui ziehin."},"17":{"text":"Ahivang in ka mit in amaute sumanglouin a khawi a, gamdai ah amauh ka beimang sah sih hi."},"18":{"text":"“Hinanleh gamdai ah atate uh kungah, Na pu napate uh danthubawlte zui sih unlen, avaihawmnate u’zong zui tuom sih unlen, amilimte uh zong kisubua sih un."},"19":{"text":"Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi. Ka danthubawlte zui unlen, Ka vaihawmnate kemching unlen bawl un."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh ka khawlnite noute leh keima kikaal a chiemtena hi dingin siengthou sah un, tuachi’n Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi chi na thei ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahivang in atate uh ka tungah ahel ua, Ka danthubawlte azui sih ua, Ka danthupiehte zui dingin apilvang sih uhi, mi’n tuate azui u’leh ahing ding uh chi hinapi, azui ut sih uhi; hinanleh ka khawlnite asubua uhi. “Tuachi’n amaute tungah ka thangpaina ka sungbaw ding a, gamdai ah amaute tungah ka lungthahna ka tangtung sah ding ka chi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahivang in ka khut ka nualah kia a, amauh mitmu leh amauh ka puidohna namte mitmu a ka min suhbua a aum louna ding in ka min ziehin ka bawlzawta hi."},"23":{"text":"Namte lah ah amaute ah ka thezah dinga, gamte lah ah ka thethang ding, chiin gamdai ah amaute kungah banzah in ka kichiem nalai hi.","ref":"Siempu. 26.33"},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun ka danthupiehte azui sih ua, ka danthubawlte asimmaw ua, Ka khawlnite asubua ua, amitte un apu apate uh milimte alunggul uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin danthubawl hoiloute leh ahin zoulou na ding uh vaihawmnate ka pie hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh amauh khu asilpieh mama uah ka subua a, ta masa pouma mei apeisuohsahna uah, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi ahing theina ding ua, amauh ka thagam theina dingin."},"27":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mihing tapa Israel innkuonte houpi inlen, akung uah, Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Tam thu ah zong na pu na pate un kei ahing gensie ua, ahing suminse nalai uhi, chiin.","title":"Kanaan gam sungah"},"28":{"text":"Khut zah hiel a kichiem a amauh ka pieh gam a ka puilut tahin, muol sangte leh sing bawhpha chinteng amu ua, Kei hing lungthah sah dingin akithoinate uh alan ua, asilla thangpai huoite uh apie uhi. Amaun khunah gimnamtuite alan ua, adawn sillatte uh asungbuo uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken amaute kungah, Tam nava hawna zel uh mun sangte bang ahi mawng a ahiei? Ka chi hi. Tuachi’n khum mun min khu tuni tan in Bamah akichi hi.","title":"Ezekiel hun lai in"},"30":{"text":"Tuaziehin Israel innkuonte kungah, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Na pu napate uh dungsun in nouma kisubua in, asilkidahhuoi bawlte uh banga kizua ding na hi uoi mah?"},"31":{"text":"Aziehpen sillatte na lat chieng un leh, na tapate uh meikuong lai a na peisuohsah chiengun, tuni tandongin na milimte ua nouma leh nouma kisubua nalai lai na hi uhi, tuachi’n Israel innkuonte aw, Kei noute kankhiet ding ka hina amah? Ahin a ka hin laisie, noute kankhiet in ka um sih ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"32":{"text":"“Pasian theilou namte bang leh gamdang mite bangin singbul suongbul be mi ihi ding uh chia na lungsim ua, hing um vang ahi ngaingai sih ding hi."},"33":{"text":"“Ahin a ka hin laisie, pellou in khut hattah leh banzah pum in, tualeh lungthahna kisungbuo in na tung uah vai ka hawm ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.","title":"Pasian in Israelte atunding kiana ding thupha"},"34":{"text":"Khut hattah toh banzah pum in, tualeh lungthahna kisungbuo toh, namte lah a kipat leh, thezah a na umna uh gamte akipat in ka hing puikhawm ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh noute mipite gamdai ah ka hing puilut dinga, khunah kimaituo in, na tung uah thukhenna ka hing tungsah ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Izipt gam, gamdai a na pu napate uh tunga thukhenna ka tut bangin, noute tungah zong thukhenna ka hing tun ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Chieng nuoi ah ka hing lutsah dinga, thuhun kikankhawm sungah ka hing puilut ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Na lah ua pat mi helte leh ka tunga khielte ka susieng dinga, khuolzin tambang a aumna gam ua kipat ka puidoh dinga, hinanleh Israel gam ah vang alut sih ding uhi. Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi na hing thei ding uhi."},"39":{"text":"“Noute na hi u’leh, Aw Israel innkuonte, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Noute na milip un pei unlen, na milimte uh va kibieh un; tunua chieng a zong ka thu manglou ding na hi u’leh, hinanleh na silpiehte u’leh na milimte un ka min siengthou subua nawn sih un."},"40":{"text":"“Aziehpen ka muol siengthou, Israel muolsang tungah, khum gam a um Israel innkuonte’n abawn un ka nna asem ding uhi; khunah amauh ka sang dinga, tualeh khunah na sillatte u’leh, na kithoina uh na ga masate u’leh, na silsiengthoute zousie uh ka sang theita ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Namte lah apat ka hing puidoh a, thezah a na umna gamte ua kipat ka hing puikhawm hun chiengin, gimnamtui mama bangin ka hing sang ding a, namte masang ah noute ah suhsiengthou in ka umta ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n na pu na pate uh kung a pieh dinga banzah a ka kichiemna gam a ka hing puilut hun chiengin, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi na thei ding uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh khunah na umdante u’leh na sil bawlte ua na kisuhbuanate zousie uh na theidohta ding ua, tualeh na sil bawl hoiloute zousie ziehin nouma leh nouma na kikidahta ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Na umdan giloute uh ahisihleh na silbawl setahte uh bang hilou a, ka min zieh a noute ka hing bawlzoutah chiengin, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi na thei ding uhi, Aw Israel innkuonte, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi,” achi hi."},"45":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Gammang meikuong etsahna"},"46":{"text":"“Mihing tapa na mai simlam ngat inlen, simlam douna in thu gen inlen, simlam gammang demna in thu genlawh inlen,"},"47":{"text":"tualeh simlam gammang kungah, Mangpa thu ngai khie in, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, chi in, Ngai in na sung ah mei ka tawkuong ding a, na sunga sing hing chinteng leh singgaw chinteng akatum ding hi, meikuong amit sih ding a, simlam apat mallam tandong in, maitang zousie a sanggaw ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Michin in tua mei khu kei Mangpa’n ka tawkuong ahi chi amu ding ua, akiphelmit zou sih ding hi.”"},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken “Ah, Mangpa Pasian! Kei khu, Gentena thu gen hibou lou amah? ahing chi ding uhi,” ka chi hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kung ah ahing tunga,","title":"Namsau kidohsa etsahna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa na mai Jerusalem lam ngat inlen, mun siengthou douna in thu gen in, tualeh Israel gam douna in genlawhna thu gen inlen;"},"3":{"text":"Israel gam kungah, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi chi in, Ngai in, Ka hing dou ahi, Ka namsau apai apat ka dohkhe dinga, na lah ua midihtatte leh migiloute akibangin ka satkhe ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin na lah ua pat midihtat leh migilou ka satkhieh ding ziehin, simlam apat mallam tandongin mi zousie dou dingin, ka namsau apai apat apawtdoh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Michin in Kei Mangpa’n ka namsau apai apat ka dohkhie ahi, chi atheina ding un, akinua siet kia nawn sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mihing tapa lungtang kehzah pum in, amasang ua amitmu ngel uah hasetah a khoisa a nah vahuoi in."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh amaun bangdinga nah vahuoi na hiei? chia ahing doh chiengun, Thuthang ziehin, chi’n na dawng dinga, aziehpen ahing tun chiengin, lungtang chinteng azun dinga, khut zousie azoi dinga, lungsim zousie aba ding a, khup zousie tui bangin anem ding hi. Ngai in atung ding ahi, hing tung pai ding ahi,” Mangpa Pasian in achi hi, chiin."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a,"},"9":{"text":"“Mihing tapa genlawhna gen inlen, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Namsau, namsau taat hiem ahita a, nawtval zong ahita, chiin."},"10":{"text":"Mithana zauhuoi tah dinga tat hiem ahita, tunphe banga nawtval ahita. Nop ibawl nalai ding uh adiei? Ka tapa chieng khu sing bang bep in, na simmaw uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh aman namsau khu nawtval ding leh, zah pai thei dingin apeta hi. Tam namsau khu mithatpa khut a pieh dinga, tat hiem leh notval ahita."},"12":{"text":"Mihing tapa aw, kap inlen mau in, aziehpen tami ka mite tunga tu ding ahi a, Israel miliente tunga tu ding ahi. Namsau pum a zauna ka mite tunga tungding ahi, tuaziehin na malpi beeng in."},"13":{"text":"Tami etkhiehna ahi ziehin, namsau in asimmaw lengchieng um sih nalai leh, bangchita ding?” Lengchieng a um nawn sih ding hi. Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tuaziehin nang Mihing tapa genlawhna thu gen inlen, nakhut beeng in. Athumveina ah namsau in ale ni in sat hen. Tami mithana namsau ahi a, tami namsau mithupite that leh, a innsung tawng ua lut namsau ahi."},"15":{"text":"Alungtangte uh zunna ding leh, mi tampi puana dingin, akotpi teng uah namsau ka pangsahta hi; ka dei aw! tunphe banga te val sitset mithana ding namsau ahi."},"16":{"text":"Namsau kimansa aw! Na zietlam sat inlen! Na temma hiem hei inlen, na veilam sat in! Na temma hiem kiheina lam lam ah!"},"17":{"text":"Ken zong ka khuttum ka ziel dinga, ka lungthahna ka khawlsahta ding hi; Kei Mangpa’n ka genta hi, achi hi” chiin, gen in, achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tungkia a,","title":"Namsau nivei sat etsahna"},"19":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Babilon leengpa namsau hing peina dingin gam khat akipan a kipankhie lampi ni guot in. Khopi tung ding lampi kathuom ah chiemtena khuom phut in."},"20":{"text":"Ammonmite khuo Rabbah leh kulpi a kivengbit Jerusalem a Judate kunga, namsau ahing tun theina dingin lampi khat guotin."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen Babilon leengpa lamka thuom, tua lampi kaani kisuhtuona ah, ai san dingin adinga, athaltangte aloh a, teraphim a dong a, sa sin khu a en hi."},"22":{"text":"A khut zietlam a, a aisan khu Jerusalem tungah atu a, tua khu, bang phuhvangna ding singzawlte bawl ding, mithat ding mi han ding, kidouna aw ngaitah a kikou ding, Kotpite phuhvang na ding zawlte bawl ding, khopi douna dinga lei sesang ding, tualeh kulbangte bawl ding, chi khu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh tam pen amauh, kihahsiel a kichiemte mitmu ah, aisan dihlou bang ahi ding a, hinanleh mat a a um theina ding ua, athulimlouna uh thei dohna ding bep ahi."},"24":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Na tatkhielnate uh mudoh a um a, na silbawl zousie ua na khelnate uh kilanga, na gitlounate uh thei zing na ding a na bawl tah ziehun, khut a mat in na um ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuin nang Israel houtu bua leh gilou aw, na ni ahing tungta, na gitlouna zieh a na kigawtna tawpkhawh ahing tungta hi."},"26":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Na dielkop leh na manglukhu lakhie in; angaina bangin bangma a um sih ding hi. Angiemte tawisang inlen asangte sungiem in."},"27":{"text":"Ka lumlet ding, ka lumlet ding Ka lumlet sah dinga! Aneipa dihtah hing pei masang sie’n, Angai in aum nawn sih ding, tami ama kungah ka pe ding hi."},"28":{"text":"“Tualeh Mihing tapa genlawhna gen inlen, Mangpa Pasian in Ammon mite tungtang leh amigensietna tungtang uah tambangin agen hi: Namsau, namsau dawsa ahita, mithana dinga nawtval, tunphe banga not tetsetsot ahita.","title":"Ammon mite kigawtna","ref":"Jer. 49.1-6; Ezek. 25.1-7; Amos. 1.3-15; Zeph. 2.8-11"},"29":{"text":"Mengmuna phatuomlou nang ahing musah ua, zuouin ai ahing san sah ua, namsau tha ding migiloute ngawng ah a kinga ding hi. Tua nite ahing tungta a, gawtna huntawp atungta hi."},"30":{"text":"Namsau apai ah siet kia in, Na pienna mun ah, na hing kipatna gam mama ah, na tungah thukhenna ka bawl ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Ka lungthahna na tungah ka sungbaw dinga, ka thangpaina mei na tung ah Ka sem kuong ding a, mitatsetah leh mi sumangthai siemtah, khut ah ka hing pedoh ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Nangpen meikhuh a kivang singkhuo na hi ding a, na sisan gam sungah aluong ding hi. Nangpen theizingin na um nawn sih ding hi. Aziehpen Kei Mangpa’n Kana gensa ahita hi” chiin, achi hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaban ah Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Jerusalem khelnate"},"2":{"text":"“Tuin nang Mihing tapa thu nakhen diei, tami sisansuohat khopi tungah thu na khen diei? Ahi, akidahhuoina zousie amanu na musah ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, chi in, Khopi in ahun ahing tun theina dingin asung ah sisan asuo a, tualeh ama akisuhbuana dingin milim akibawlthu hi."},"4":{"text":"Na sisan suote ziehin amaw na hita hi, tualeh na milim bawlte ziehin nangma leh nangma na kisubuata hi. Na nite na naisahta a, na kumte tawpna na hing tung phielta hi; tuaziehin namte gensiet ding leh gam zousie nuisat in ka hing bawlta hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang a kipat anai a umte leh agamlapia um miten, nang minsepuo leh buoina adim, chiin ahing nuisat ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"“En in, Israel miliente: michin in sisan suona dingin athuneina uh azang uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na sungah nulepa asimmaw ua, na lah uah mikhuolte asugenthei ua, na sung ah Pa neiloute leh meithaite abawlsie uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.12; Danp. 5.16; Pawt. 22.21,22; Danp. 24.17"},"8":{"text":"Ka sil siengthoute na simmaw ua, ka khawlnite na buasah uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.30; 26.2"},"9":{"text":"Na sungah sisansuo dingin mi hehsiet hatte a um ua, na sungah muol tunga milim biehinn a ann ne a um ua, na lah uah kizuana bawlte a um uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na sungah apate uh zi toh mawna bawl a lumkhawm a um ua, numei sineilai luppite na sungah a um uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.7-20"},"11":{"text":"Na sungah mi khat in a innvengpa zi toh silkidahhuoi abawl a, midang khat in huasan tahin amounu abuasah a, tualeh na sungah midang in, asanggam numei, apa tanu aluppi hi."},"12":{"text":"Na sungah sisansuo dingin golna ala ua, sum pung leh amet na la ua, na innvengte sum pauhat in amet na pawng lah pieh a, tualeh kei nang manghilta hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 23.8; Danp. 16.19; Pawt. 22.25; Siempu. 25.36,37; Danp. 23.19"},"13":{"text":"“Tuaziehin en in, dihtat loutah a, sum pung leh amet na lahna tung uah leh na lah ua sisan na suona tung uah ka khuttum ka zielta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuabanga na tung ua ka bawl ni chiengin, na lungtang in athuoh zou na diei? Ahisihleh na khut ahat zouna diei? Kei Mangpa’n ka genta a, ka bawl ngei ngei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Nang pen namte lah ah ka hing thezah dinga, gam chin ah ka hing thethang ding hi; nanga kipat na sienthou lounate ka lamang sieng ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Nangma leh nangma namte mitmu ah na kisubua dinga, Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi na hing theiding hi.”"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,"},"18":{"text":"“Mihing tapa, Israel innkuonte kei a dingin sia ehsie asuohta uhi, abawnpi un haltuina mei lai a, sum-eng, dan, sia leh ngen, ahi ua, dangka sia ehsie bang bep ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, Na bawn ua sia eeh na suoh siengtah ziehun, tuaziehin Ngai un, Jerusalem laikim tah ah ka hing khawm ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Miten haltuina meiphuolpi lai a zap ding leh haltui dinga, dangka sia, sum-eng, sia, dan leh ngen, akoikhawm bang un, ka lungthahna leh ka thangpaina sung ah noute ka hing koikhawm dinga, hing haltui ding ka hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi, ka hing khawm ding a, na tung uah ka thangpaina mei ka zap dinga, alai ah na zunmang ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Haltuina meiphuolpi lai a dangka azunmang bangin, khopi sungah noute zong na zunmang ding uhi, tuachi’n Kei Mangpa’n na tung uah ka lungthahna ka sungbota hi chi na hing theita ding uhi.”"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,"},"24":{"text":"“Mihing tapa aw, akung ah nang pen gam suhsienglou leh lungthah ni a atunga guozuh louna gam khu na hi, chi in."},"25":{"text":"Humpibahnei humham in asamat abawtel bangin alah ua aguolneite thu phielguhna a um a, mite hinna anetum ua, mi goute leh sil manphate alah pieh ua, alah uah meithai tampi abawlta uhi."},"26":{"text":"A siemputen ka dan abotsie ua, ka sil siengthoute abuasahta uhi; Amaun sil sieng leh sienglou akhen sih ua, a sienglou leh a sieng kikhiehna zong atheisah sih uhi, tualeh ka khawlni apat amitte uh aphuolta ua, tuachi’n kei alah uah suh minsietin ka umta hi.","ref":"Siempu. 10.10"},"27":{"text":"A lah ua miliente lah, sisansuo dingin, mite hinna sumang dingin leh, dihlou tah a punna muna dingin, ngia gilkiel asamat uh kitu a bottel bang mai ahi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Aguolneite’n lah akimat theilou senelte in bang azutzol ua, mengmuna dihlou leh zuouthu in ai asan pieh ua, Mangpa’n bangma genloupiin, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, achi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Gamsung miten pauhat a sum kilah piehna leh kisuomna abawlta ua, mi zawngte leh tasamte abawl genthei ua, gamdang mite dihloutah in abawlgenthei uhi."},"30":{"text":"Gam ka suhsietlouna dingin, alah ua mi khat kulbang bawl ding leh agam taang a, ka mai a, mun awnga ding ding ka sui a, hinanleh koima ka mu sih hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka lungthahna atung uah ka sungbota hi; amaute ka thangpaina meikuong in ka katum sahta hi; asilbawlte uh amauh lutung ngei ah ka thuh ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in a chi hi.”"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga","title":"Kizua unau numei ni gente thu"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa aw, nu khat hah tanu ni a um ua,"},"3":{"text":"Amaute gel Izipt gam ah akizua mang ua, khangdawng ahi lai ua pat kizua ahita ua, khunah anawi uh akimeh pieh a, akhangdawng nawi uh a meh pieh uhi."},"4":{"text":"A u nu min Oholah ahi a, anau nu min Oholibah amaute Kei a ahi ua, tualeh tanu leh tapate anei uhi. Amin uh tambang ahi, Oholah khu Samaria ahia, Oholibah pen Jerusalem ahi."},"5":{"text":"“Oholah kei a ahi pumpum in akizua a, a innveng Assiria mite toh ang akawm hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaun puonsandup asil ua, galkap lamkai leh vaihawm liente ahi ua, amaute abawn un tangval deihuoi, sakol tungtuong mi ngen ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tambangin Assiria tangval melhoi zousie toh, angkawm in alumkhawmta ua, hua in apum a kiphal in anua del a, amilimte uah akisubuata hi."},"8":{"text":"Izipt akipat a ahing puoh ahuana lah, atawpsan tuom sih a, aziehpen akhangdawn laiin, amanu aluppi ua, anungah chiillai nawi amehpieh ua, atung ah ahuana uh asungbuo uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin ken amanu akingaipi, apum a akiphalna, Assiriate khut ah ka pekheta hi."},"10":{"text":"Amauten asaguohna ahawhkhiet pieh ua, atanute leh atapate alahmang pieh ua, amanu zong namsau in athat uhi; Ama numeite lah paunah khat asuoh a, atungah thukhenna tunsah ahita hi."},"11":{"text":"“Tuin anaunu Oholibah in tami munapi in asanggamnu sangin amingaihatna a uong zaw a, ahuana leh akizuana ah zong a unu sangin a uong zawsem nalai hi."},"12":{"text":"Aman Assiria mi a innveng, galkap lamkai leh vaihawm miliente, kilawmtah a kivon, sakol tungtuongmi abawn ua tangval deihuoi ngentang khu a deigawta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama zong akibuasah gawpta chi ka mu a, ani un lampi khat azuikhawm uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh amanu’n akizuana a uongzawsem in abawla; aman baanga pasal lim kigielte, Kaldai mite lim asan au a kigiel;"},"15":{"text":"akawng ua, kawnggah akigah, diel kilawmtah alu ua kop, abawn ua galkap lamkai bang ngen, apienna gam uh Kaldai gam a, Babilon mite bang ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amit a amauh amu tah in, amauh adeigawta a, Kaldai gam a, amaute kungah thangkou asawlta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Babilon mite amanu kungah, a angkawmna lupna tungah ahing haw ua, ahuana un amanu asubua ua, tuachi’n abuasah zou chiengin adeinawn sih ua, akikhenpita uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amanu’n alangtangin kizuana abawl a, aguohtan na ahawhkheta hi. Tuachi’n asanggamnu ka kikhenpi bangin, ama zong ka kikhenpita hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Izipt gam a akhangdawn lai a, akizua lai nite theizingin, akizuana a uongbawl semsem hi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen a angkawmpite uh, tahsa sabiltung tahsa bang ahi a, asilpawtte uh sakolte silpawt bang mai ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tambangin na khangdawnlai huasanna, Izipt miten na khangdawn lai nawi ahing, mehpieh ukhu na lunggul nalai hi.”"},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aw Aholibah Mangpa, Pasian in tambangin agen hi; “Ngai in, nang hing luppi na lungsim a na huotna, kikhenpisate ka tohthou dinga, kilchin apat nang dou dingin, ka hing puikhawm ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Babilon mite, Kaldai mite zousie, Pekod, Shoa leh Koa mite leh Assiria mite zousie, tangval melhoi leh deihuoi ngen, uhpipate, vaihawmtute, milien leh minthang, galkap lamkaite, sakol tungtuong mite ngen ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh amaute nangma dou dingin, asakollengte utoh, galvante toh, kangtalai kengte toh mipi tampi toh, ahing kuon ding ua, lum lien leh lum neu tawi in, sia lukhu khu in, na kimkot ah panmun khawin akichieng ding uhi. Amauh kung ah thukhenna ka koi dinga, athukhenna uh dungzui in ahing vaihawm khum ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Na tungah ka thangsietna ka tungsah dinga, amauten lungthah tahin ahing bawlse ding ua, na nahkuo leh na bilte atan ding ua, nuasie a umsunte namsau in ashi ding ua, na tapate u’leh na tanute uh, ahing lahpieh ding ua, adam umsunte meiin akatum ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Na puonsilte ahing hawhkhietpieh ding ua, na kizepna van manphate alamang ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tambangin na huasanna leh, Izipt gam a kipat a na kizuana ka tawpsah ding a, tuachi’n amau’lam en in, na mitte na hahsah nawn sih ding hi, Izipt gam zong na thei ngitnget nawn sih ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; Pellou in Keima’n noute, na mudate u’leh na kikhenpisate uh khut ah, ka hing pekhe ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Amaun mudatah in ahing bawlse mama ding ua, nasepga zousie ahing lahmangpieh ding ua, nang pen guohtang leh saguoh in ang nuasie ding uhi. Saguoha na kizuana leh na huasannate adawh ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tam silte na tungah ka tungsah ding hi, namdangte lunggul a na kizua a, amilimte ua na kisuhbuatah ziehin."},"31":{"text":"Na sanggamnu lampi na zuitah zieh in, anou na khut ah ka koi ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tambangin Mangpa Pasian in thu agen hi; “Na sanggamnu nou lien leh thuhtah, Na dawn ding a, nuisat leh simmaw in na um ding hi. Tua nouin tampi adawl hi."},"33":{"text":"Zukhamna leh lunggimna in na dim ding a, tua nou khu zauna leh sietna ahi a, na sanggamnu Samaria nou ahi."},"34":{"text":"Na dawn dinga na tawpkang ding hi, agei na keibal ding a, na sepkeh dinga athem in na nawi a at keh ding hi, aziehpen Kei Mangpa’n ka gensa ahi, achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Kei nang manghilta a, nang nuangatsantah ziehin, na huasanna leh na kizuana maw na kipuoh ding ahi,” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Mihing tapa aw, Oholah leh Oholibah tungah thu na khen diei? Tuachi’n asilkidahhuoi bawlte uh, akung uah phuongdoh in."},"37":{"text":"Amaun angkawmna khelna abawl ua, akhut uah sisan abang hi. Amaun amilimte utoh ang akawm ua, Kei dinga ahin uh atapate uh nangawn kithoina in meikuong lai ah apeisuoh sah ua, akatum sah uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuathamlouin tami kei tung ah zong abawl ua: Ka munsiengthou tuami ni mama in asubua uh a, Ka khawlnite abotsie uhi."},"39":{"text":"Aziehpen amilimte ua dinga atate uh atha zou chieng un, tuami ni mama in, ahing pei ua, ka munsiengthou sungah alut ua, asubua uhi, en in tambangin ka inn sungah sil abawl uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuabanah zong gamlapi a pat a hing haw dingin mi na vaihah a, mi na sawl hi; tualeh ahing haw ua, amu ding un na kisilsieng a, na mitte mitlou na nu a, kizepna vante in na kizem hi."},"41":{"text":"Lupna thupitah tungah na tou a, amasangah dawkan khat na bawl a, atungah ka gimnamtui leh ka sathau na koi hi."},"42":{"text":"Khohsahna neilou mipi tampi husa a um hi; tualeh minautangte leh zukham mite gamdai apat ahing zawpi ua, amauten akhuttawng uah tau abun ua, alutung uah manglukhu kilawmtahte akhu uhi."},"43":{"text":"“Tuachi’n ken angkawm a tehse vawtnu tungtang thu ka gen hi. Amaun amanu toh, tualeh amanu’n amautoh angkawm angapna ding uoi izaw? Ka chi hi."},"44":{"text":"Ahivang in amauh kizuate kunga ahaw bang un, amanu kungah alut ua, tuachi’n amaute numei kizua Oholah leh Oholibah kungah ahaw ua, huasanna bawl in aluppi uhi."},"45":{"text":"Hinanleh midihtatten angkawmte leh sisan suo numeite gawtna thu akhenpieh bangun atung uah thu akhen ding uhi, aziehpen amaute angkawmnute ahi ua, akhut uah sisan abang hi.”"},"46":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “Amauh dou dingin mipi puikhawm unlen, amaute chizat huoitah leh gallah vante in bawl un."},"47":{"text":"Mipiten amauh suongin asep ding ua, namsau in asatlia ding uhi; Atapate u’leh atanute uh athapieh ding ua, a innte uh mei in ahaltumpieh ding uhi."},"48":{"text":"Tambangin gam sung apat huasanna ka beisah dinga, numeite zousie in vauhilna athei ua, na huasanna uh azui louna ding uh ahi."},"49":{"text":"Na tungah na huasanna ahing thuh ding ua, na milim biehna khelnate uh maw nouman na kipuoh ding uhi. Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa Pasian ka hi chi, na thei ding uhi.”"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Akum kuona, hasawmna, ani sawmniin Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Bel sou gentena"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa ni min tuni mama min giel in, tami ni mama in, Babilon leengpa’n Jerusalem ahing sim pat ni ahi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.1; Jer. 52.4"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh innkuonte kungah gentethu khat gen inlen, tambangin gen in, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Lungthu tungah bel suong inlen, asung ah tui sung in."},"4":{"text":"Asungah sa atnente bua inlen, asa hoite zousie, amal leh alieng bua inlen, agu hoi ngen bua inlen, tua bel dimsah in."},"5":{"text":"Belamhon lah a ahoipen la inlen, anuoi ah singtun sie in, mei taw inlen, hoitah in sousah inlen, agubomte khu asungah ui hihen."},"6":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Sisan suona khopi, bel asung kagep, akagep bei ngailou khu atung agih hi; asa khu tel tuom umlou in beu khat khat in thua in."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen asisan suo ama sung ah a um a, aman tami suongpi tungah asungbuo a, leivui a khukhum dingin leitung ah asung bawsih hi."},"8":{"text":"Phuba la ding a lungthahna ahing kipatdoh theina dingin, asisan suongpi tungah ka sungbuo hi, akikhukhum louna dingin."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Sisansuo khopi tung agih hi. Ken zong amei ding sing ka sie vum ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Sing sie vum unlen, mei tawkuong unlen, sa hoitah in huon min unlen, atuisah dingin menam hal unlen, agute katumsah un."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n bel khu mei-am tungah aguoh in suong den un, a sum-eng ahing sat a akaah theina dingin, tualeh aniehnate ahing zunmang theina ding leh, akagepte akahtum theina dingin."},"12":{"text":"Chimtah khop a abawl nuain zong, akagepte akohsieng tuom sih a, mei in zong akasieng tuom sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Na sienlouna ah huana a um a, ka hing susieng a, na sien tuomlou zieh in, na tunga ka lungthahna ka tunsah masangsie in, na sienlouna khu sawpsieng ahi ngai nawn sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Kei Mangpa’n tami ka gen zouta a, ahing tangtung ngei dinga, ka bawl ding hi! Ka nua tawp sih ding a, ka hinkhawi sih dinga, Ka lungsim ka hei vawt sih ding hi. Na umdan leh na silbawl dung zuiin, na tungah thu akhen ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi,” chiin."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a:","title":"Ezekiel zi shina a chiemtena"},"16":{"text":"“Mihing tapa na mit hing taisah pen Thakhat in ka hing lahpieh dinga, na suun ding ahisih a, na kaa ding zong ahisih a, na hitui zong na luon sah lou ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Sip khinkhian in tau hit hit in, mi shi suunna zong bawl sin, na lu ah na diel khip inlen, na kengah na kedap but in, na kam hum sinlen, mihingte daana ann zong ne sin."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n zingmawng in mipite kungah thu ka gen a, nitahlam in ka zi ashita hi; tualeh azingmawngin thupieh a ka um bangin ka bawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Mipiten ka kungah, “Tambanga na umdante kou a dingin bang etsahna ahiei, nang hil sih ding amah?” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken amauh ka dawng a, “Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga;"},"21":{"text":"Israel innkuonte kungah genin, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, Ngai un, na kisahtheipi mama uh na mittaina uh, na hinna uh kipahna, ka munsiengthou khu buasah ding kahi, tualeh na nuasie uh na tapa u’leh na tanute uh namsau in ashi ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh ken ka bawl bangin nouten zong na bawl ding uhi, na kamte uh na hum sih ding ua, mishi suun a lunggim mite ann na nehlou ding uh ahi."},"23":{"text":"Na dielte uh na lu uah khip unlen, na kedapte uh na but ding uhi, na daa sih ding ua, kap zong na kaa louding uh ahi, hinanleh na gitlounate ziehun khat leh khat kikatuo un."},"24":{"text":"Tambangin Ezekiel khu noute a dingin etsahna ahi ding a, abawl bangin nouten zong na bawl ding uhi, tambang sil ahing tun chiengin, Kei Mangpa Pasian ka hi chi nang thei ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Nang Mihing tapa, alungnopna uh, athupina uh, amittaina uh, alunggul uh, alungtang uh angatna uh, tua kulpi leh atapate u’leh atanute u’toh ka lahmang ni chiengin;"},"26":{"text":"tua ni chiengin asuohta mi khat in, tam thu na bil a zasah dingin, na kungah ang pei ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin, asuohta mi kungah na kam akikaah dinga, thu na gen dinga, na sip sih ding hi; tuachi’n nang khu ama ua dingin chiemtena na hi dinga, tualeh Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi.”"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga.","title":"Ammon mite tungthu genlawhna","ref":"Jer. 49.1-6; Ezek. 21.28-32; Amos. 1.13-15; Zeph. 2.8-11"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa aw, na mai Ammon mite lang ngat inlen, atungtang uh thu genlawhin."},"3":{"text":"Ammon mite kungah, Mangpa Pasian thugen ngaikhie un, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ka munsiengthou akisuhbua lai a, Israel gam suhsiet a a umlai leh Juda innkuonte sal a puimang ahi lai ua, Awi ngel inge, na chi ziehun."},"4":{"text":"Ngai in, tuaziehin, suolam mite kungah agoutan uh hi dingin ka hing pedoh dinga, amaun na lah uah giehphuol sat in, tenna innte abawl ding uhi, amaun na thei gate uh ane ding ua, na bawngnawite uh adawn ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Rabbah khu sangawngsaute buh in ka bawl dinga, tualeh Ammon pen belamhonte khawlna mun ka suohsah ding hi, tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi. Israel gam sietna tunga na khut na beng a, na keng na tat a, na lungtang zousie a na kipah ziehin."},"7":{"text":"Ngai in, tuaziehin, na tungah ka khut ka laam dinga, namte kungah, atomgam ding un ka hing pedoh ding hi. Namte lah akipat ka hing satkhe ding a, gamte akipat ka hing sumang ding a, Ka hing suse ding hi, tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi nang thei ding uhi, achi hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tambangin Mangpa Pasian in thu agen hi: Moab leh Seir in, En un, Juda innkuonte zong namdang zousie bang thou ahi uh a chi ziehun;","title":"Moab tunga thukhenna ding","ref":"Isai. 15.1—16.14; 25.10-12; Jer. 48.1-47; Amos. 2.1-3; Zeph. 2.8-11"},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin, ngai un, Moab gam ning khat ka susieng ding a, gamgi zul a khopite, agam thupina pente, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, leh Kirjathaim, ah ka pan ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Suolam mite goutan dingin Moab mite Ammonmite toh ka pekhawm ding hi; Ammonmite khu namte lah ah thei ngitnget ahi nawnta sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Moab tungah thukhenna ka tun dinga, tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Tambangin Mangpa Pasian in agen hi: Edomin Juda innkuonte tunga phuba la a, asunat seng ziehin.","title":"Edom tunga thukhenna tungding","ref":"Isai. 34.5-17; 63.1-6; Jer. 49.7-22; Ezek. 35.1-15; Amos. 1.11,12; Obad. 1.1-14; Mala. 1.2-5"},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Ken Edom tung ah ka khut ka laam ding a, tamna kipat mite leh gantate ka satkhe ding a, Teman akipat tenna lou gamsie ka suohsah dinga, Dedan mite namsau in ashi ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ka mi Israelte khut zangin, Edom tungah phuba ka la dinga, ka lungthahna leh ka thangpaina dungzui in Edom tungah abawl ding uhi, tuachi’n amaun ka phubalahna athei ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"15":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Philistin miten phuba la a, kimudana luite zieh a, hing suhmang nopna lungsim pua a, phuba alah ziehun;","title":"Philistin tunga thukhenna tung ding","ref":"Isai. 14.29-31; Jer. 47.1-7; Joel. 3.4-8; Amos. 1.6-8; Zeph. 2.4-7; Zek. 9.5-7"},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai un Philistin mite tung ah ka khut ka laam dinga, Kerethmite ka satkhe dinga, tualeh tuipi gei a mi umsunte ka sumang ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Thangpai mama pumin vauhilna toh atungah phuba huoisetah in ka la ding hi; atung ua phubalahna ka tunsah hun chiengin Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi,” achi hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, kum sawm leh khatna, tuami ha, anikhat niin, Mangpa thu ka kung ah ahing tung hi.","title":"Tai-ar tunga thukhenna tung ding genlawhna","ref":"Isai. 23.1-18; Joel. 3.4-8; Amos. 1.9,10; Zek. 9.1-4; Mat. 11.21,22; Luk. 10.13,14"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Tai-ar in Jerusalem tung thu a Awi ngel inge, mite ding a kotpi khu akiseta a, kei a dingin kotpite akihongta a, tua khopi asegawpta a, kei tan hoi ding ahita, achi ziehin."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai in, Tai-ar aw ka hing dou ahi, tuipi in atuikinawhte avawhsang bangin, nang dou ding in nam tampi ka hing kuonsah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaun Tai-ar kulbangte asuse ding ua, a innsangte asuchim ding uhi; ama apat in aleivuite zong ka phietsieng ding a, ama khu suongpi tungvum bangin ka bawl ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuipi lai ah len phouna mun ahita ding hi; aziehpen ka gensa ahita hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi. Tualeh namte gallah van giap ahita ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Gamlah a khoneu a um atanute namsau a tha in a um ding ua, tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Aziehpen Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai in, Tai-ar dou dingin mallam akipat leengte leengpa, Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar khu sakolte toh, kidouna sakollengte toh, sakoltungtuongmi leh galkap hon tampi ka hing pui ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aman gam lah a khoneu a um na tanute namsau in athat dinga, nangma nanna dingin kulte akhaw dinga leipalte abawl ding a, nang apat kidalna in lumte adomsang ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aman na kulbangte suhsietna dingin, sing zawlte in ahing sun ding a, aheitangte in na innsangte a satchim ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A sakolte a tam seng ziehin leivui in nang ahing tuom dinga, sakoltungtuong mite leh sakolleng keng kipeiging husa in na kulbangte akiling sah ding hi, tualeh khopi kulbangte kisusie a, mite alut ni banga, na kulpi kotte a alut chiengin tuabang ahi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Asakolte kengchin in na gawlzing zousie uh atuonchil dinga, namsau in na mite athat ding uhi, tualeh na khuompi dettahte tuol ah leilah ah apua ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaun na hausatnate leh na summet bawlna vante gallah vante in atomgam ding ua, na kulbangte asuchim ding ua, na inn nuomtahte uh asusegawp ding uhi, tualeh na suongte leh na singte leh na leitangte tuili lai ah apailut ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh na la sah gingte ka tawpsah dinga, na kaiging husate uh akiza nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 18.22"},"14":{"text":"Nangkhu suongpi vum bangin ka hing bawl dinga, len phouna mun na hita ding a lamtha kia na hinawn sih ding hi, aziehpen Kei Mangpa’n tami ka gensa ahita, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"15":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in Tai-ar kungah tambangin agen hi: Na sunga kithana a um a, miliemte akikou chieng un, na pua ging in tuipi gamte achitunsah sih ding amah?"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuipi gei a leeng tapate zousie a mangtouna ua pat ahing kumkhe suh ding ua, aleengpuonte uh asutkhe ding ua, apuonsil zemhoite uh ahawhkhe ding uhi; chitutna puonsil in tuol ah atou zawta ding uhi, tualeh achitun den ding ua, chizat huoi ahing sa ding uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 18.9,10"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh nanga dingin kaateng alou ding ua, na kungah: Tuisiem mite tenna khopi minthang aw, Tuipi tunga hat, amaleh asunga teng zousie, zausah leh agin mama uh, Bangchidan a suhsiet a um na hiei? achi ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuipi panga gamte, na pua niin achitun ding ua, Ahi, tuipi gei a gamte na peimang niin abuoita uhi."},"19":{"text":"“Aziehpen Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Mi tenlouna banga khopi segawp a ka hing bawl chiengin, tuipi thuhtahte na tunga ka hing vuakhum a, tuiten nasatah a ahing tup hun chiengin;"},"20":{"text":"Tuahun chiengin, hankhuh a na lutsuhte toh ka hing lutkhawm sah dinga, tanglai mite kungah na tung suh ding uhi. Tanglai mun sesa a teng bangin, hankhuh a lut suhte toh nuoilam lei sung ah kang tengsah ding a, na hing kinuale kia nawn sih ding hi, tualeh mihing gam ah thupina ka koi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Nang khu zauhuoi in ka hing bawl dinga, na um nawnta sih ding hi; hing kisui nanleh, ahing kimu kia nawn sih ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi,” chi in.","ref":"Kihil. 18.21"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a,","title":"Tai-ar kikaana kateng"},"2":{"text":"“Tuin Mihing tapa Tai-ar tungtang ah kaateng lou inlen;"},"3":{"text":"“Tai-ar kungah genin: Tuipi lutna ding kotpi kung a um Tai-ar aw, Tuipi gei ateng mite kunga summetbawlpa kungah; Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Aw Tai-ar melhoi bukim ka hi, na chi hi."},"4":{"text":"Na gamgite tuipi lai ah a um a, na innlam miten na melhoina abukim sah uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amaun Senir apat taasingtein singpeh ahing bawlpieh ua; Lebanon apat sidar singte in na tembawh mung ding abawl uhi."},"6":{"text":"Bashan gam akipat gangpi singin, na kuongzapnate abawl ua, Ashur miten, Saipras tuikuol gam a pat a hing kipuo, taasing peh in tembawh tuong ahing phapieh ua, saiha aphakhum uhi."},"7":{"text":"Izipt gam a pat a hing kila, khut a khui a kizem puonmalngat khu, na tembawh puonzah ahi a, tua khu na diellap uh ahi a, Elisha tuipi gei gamte a kila puondum leh, puonsandup khu ahing zahkhumna ahi."},"8":{"text":"Sidon leh Arvad a tengte na kuongzapte ahi ua, Tai-ar aw, na sunga um na mipilte, na tembawh hehte ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Gebal upate leh amipilte u’khu natembawh phawbit in na tembawh sung ah a um uhi; Tuipi a tembawh zousie leh apute zousie, nang kunga hing pei in summet ahing bawl uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Persia, Lidia leh Libia mite na galkapte leh galhangte ahi uhi, nangma ah alumte u’leh, asialukhute uh akhai ua, na kilawmna atahlang uhi."},"11":{"text":"Avad mite khu na galkapte toh na kimvel a kulbang tung ah a um ua, Gammad mite khu na galvenna innsangte ah a um uhi; alumte uh na kulbang kimkot ah akhai ua, na kilawmna abukim sah uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Na hausatna chituom tuomte ziehin Tarshish toh summet na bawlkhawm uhi. Amaun dangka, sia, langva leh ngen, in na summet vante uh ahing heng uhi."},"13":{"text":"Javan, Tubal leh Meshek gamten nang toh summet abawl khawm ua, mihing leh sum-eng umlebelte, na zua sumte ahing kihenpi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Togarmah miten sakol nasemte, galdou sakolte leh sakolneute in, na summet vante uh ahing kihenpi zel uhi."},"15":{"text":"Dedan mite toh zong summet na kibawltuo ua, tuikuol gam tampite khu na summet bawlna munte ahi ua, Amaun saiha leh eboni singin na vante uh ahing lei uhi."},"16":{"text":"Na gama sil pieng tampite ziehin Siria toh zong summet na kibawltuo ua, Emerald suong, puonsandup, puonzem kilawm, puonmalngat nem, khipi suong leh Rubi suongin na Van zuate ahing kihenpi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Juda leh Israel gam in zong nang toh summet abawl ua, amaun na van zuate, Minnith apat mangbu, taang, khuoizu, sathau leh singnai damdawi toh ahing heng zel uhi."},"18":{"text":"Na hausatna ziehin Damaska toh zong summet na kibawltuo ua, gousil chinteng, Helbon zu leh samul kaang na nei ziehin."},"19":{"text":"Uzal apat Dante leh Javanten na van zuate lei in asuh pei atoupei ua, Sia khensa, singthal leh thangkhuai in na vanzuate ahing heng uhi."},"20":{"text":"Dedan in zong nang toh sakol tungtuonna puonpha toh summet abawl uhi."},"21":{"text":"Arabia leh Kedar milien zousie na van zuate leite ahi uhi, Amaun belamnoute, belamtalte leh kelte a, na summet bawlpite ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Sheba leh Raamah summet bawl mite toh zong summet na kibawltuo ua, na van zuate, gimnamtui hoi namkim leh suongmantam leh sana in ahing heng uhi."},"23":{"text":"Haran, Kanneh, Eden, Sheba, Ashur leh Kilmad summet bawlmite khu na vanzuate leitute ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tamte khu na summet bawlna muna na puon hoipen chinteng, puon dumte, khuta kikhui puonzephoite, leh tuongtung a kipha puon zem tuom tuom pawlte leh khauhuol chiptah a kihehte toh na kungah ahing kivei uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tarshish tembawhte khu na van pote ahi ua, “Tuipi lai ah thupina toh na kidimta hi.","ref":"Kihil. 18.11-19"},"26":{"text":"Na tembawh puten tuipi kinawh lai ah ahing puilut ua, suolam huipi in tuipi lai ah ahing mut leengta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Na hausatna, na sumlepaite na summet bawlna vante, na kuongpute, na kuonghehte, na kuong phawte, na summetbawl mite, na galkap mite na sunga um zousie leh na lah a um mihonte zousie, na manthai ni in tuipi sungah akelum ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Na kuong hehte kikou husa ah, tuipi gei gamte akithing ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Kuong zapna tawite zousie, kuongpute leh tuipi tunga kuong hehte zousie, kuong apat ahing kumsuh ding ua, gamgaw tungah ading ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Nangma ziehin aw ngaitah in akikou ding ua, hase tahin akap ding ua, alu uah leivui akibuoh ding ua, vut lah ah akilawmlia ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Nang ziehin alu uh amauleh amauh akiheukieu ding ua, Sai ip puon ateng ding ua, nang a dingin akap ding uhi. Lungtang na sa mama leh, hase tahin nang ahing kaa ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Nang hing suun a akaa amau chiengun, nang tungah kan ateng alou ding ua, Tuipi lai a suhsiet a um Tai-ar khopi banga gielbang dai, a um ngai amah achi ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Na summet bawlna vante tuipi tung a akipuoh chiengin, nam tampi na lungtai sah a, na hausatna chi tuom tuomte leh, na summet bawlna vante a leitung leengte na hausat sah ahi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh tuipi thutah lai a na kehgawp chiengin, na summetbawlna vante leh, na kithuopi mihonte zousie, na lah uah atummang ding uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuikuolkhum gam a tengte zousie in, lamdang ahingsa ding ua, aleengte uh nasatah in a zau ding ua, amel uh muol in achimawta ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Mite lah ah summetbawl miten, ahing siukohta ding ua, nang khu mi zauhuoi na suohta dinga, tualeh kumtawn in na um kia nawn sih ding hi.”"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a,","title":"Tai-ar lengpa puana ding genlawhna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Tai-ar leengpa kungah gen in: Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi. “Na lungtangin na kiliensah a, Kei pasien khat ka hi a, tui pi lai ah, pasiente toupha, tungah ka tou hi, na chi a, hinanleh, na lungtangin pasien bangin, kigel nanlachin zong, mihing na hi a, pasien na hisih hi."},"3":{"text":"Ngai in, Daniel sangin na pilzaw a! Nang a kipat thuguh kisel a um sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Na pilna leh na theisiemna toh, hauna na kikhol a, na goukholna ah sana leh dangka na kholta hi."},"5":{"text":"Na summetbawl pilna thupitah in, na hausatna na khangsah a, na hauna ziehin, na lungtang akisathei hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, “pasien lungtang bang lungtang na puohtah ziehin:"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ngai in, nam zauhuoi gamdang mite nang hing dou dingin, Ka hing pui ding hi, amaun na pilna kilawmna tungah anamsau uh adoh ding ua, na thupina tangpha khu asumuol ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amauten hankhuh ah ahing puikhesuh ding ua, tuipi sunga kithatte shi bangin na shi ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Nang hing thatte masangah, Kei pasien khat ka hi, na chi thei nalai diei? Ahivang in nang hing thatte masang ah, mihing giap na hi ding a, pasien na hisih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Gamdang mite khut ah, teptan loute shi bang a shi ding na hi, azieh pen Keima’n ka gen zouta hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tuaban ah Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung a,"},"12":{"text":"“Mihing tapa, Tai-ar lengpa tungah, kateng lou inlen akungah, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Nang bukimna chiemtena leh, pilna a dim leh hoina a bukim."},"13":{"text":"Nang Pasian huon Eden ah na um a; Suongmantam chinteng na kizepna a hi a, Sardius, topaz leh diamond, Beril, Onix leh Jesper; Saphire, Karbunkul leh emeral, sana toh, akiphumkipna leh agelkilawmte khu nangma hing kisiem ni a bawlzou ahita."},"14":{"text":"Nang khu avengtu sathaunu cherub na hi a, Tuabang dingin nang ka hing koi hi; Pasian muol siengthou tungah na um a, mei-am suongte lah ah na suhvah na touvah hi."},"15":{"text":"Siem a na um ni apat, na umdan apat gitlouna akimudoh tandongin, na hoibukim hi."},"16":{"text":"Na summetbawlna kiningchinna in, hiemngapna in ahing dimsah gawpta a, na khielta hi. Tuaziehin Pasian muol apat, sil sienglou bangin ka hing notkheta hi, vengtu Cherub in ahing notdohta hi, mei-am suongte lah akipat in."},"17":{"text":"Na melhoina ziehin na lungtang ahing kisathei a, na thupina ziehin na pilna na suseta hi; Tuoltang sena’n ka hing nei a, leengte mai ah ka hing siel a, amauh etnop ka hing hisahta hi."},"18":{"text":"Na khelna tampite leh na summetbawl zuoutatnate in, na munsiengthou na buasahta hi. Tuaziehin na lah ua pat mei ka kuongdoh sah a, nang ahing katumta hi. Nang hing ente zousie mitmu ah, leilah a vutvai ka hing suoh sahta hi."},"19":{"text":"Mite laha nang hing theikha nam zousieten, lamdang ahingsa ua, chizat huoi na suohta, na um kia ngai nawn sih ding hi.”"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a,","title":"Sidon tungtang genlawhna","ref":"Joel. 3.4-8; Zek. 9.1,2; Mat. 11.21,22; Luk. 10.13,14"},"21":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Sidon lam maingat inlen, atungthu genlawh inlen;"},"22":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, chi in: “Ngai in, Sidon aw, nang hing dou ka hi, na lah a pahtawi a um ding ka hi, asungah thukhenna ka tungsah dinga, asunga siengthou a ka kilat hun chiengin, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi, ahing thei ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen asungah natpi ka sawl dinga, agawlzing tengah sisan ka luongsah ding a, asungah mi liemte, ning chin ah namsau in apua ding ua, tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi ahing thei ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"“Tua hun chiengin Israel innkuonte dingin amauh suntu leh sunatu loulingnei leh ling hi ngitnget leh amauh simmaw tah a bawl innvengte anei nawn sih ding uhi. Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa Pasian ka hi chi, athei ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, ka thethangna namte lah a kipat Israel innkuonte ka khopkhawm hun leh namte mitmu a amaute lah a sienthou sah a ka um hun chiengin, ka suohpa Jakob kunga ka pieh gam ah a teng ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n asung ah bittahin ateng ding ua, innte alam ding ua, grep huonte abawl ding ua, Ahi, akimvel ua amauh simmaw mite zousie tunga phubalahna ka tunsah hun chiengin lungmuong tah in atengta ding uhi; Tuachi’n amauten Kei Mangpa a Pasian uh ka hi chi ahing theita ding uhi,” chiin, achi hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Akum sawmna, aha sawmna khumi ha ani sawm leh ni, ni in, Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga;","title":"Izipt sietna ding genlawhna","ref":"Isai. 19.1-25; Jer. 46.2-26"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Izipt lengpa Pharaoh kimai tuopi inlen, atung thu leh Izipt tungtang thu genlawh in."},"3":{"text":"Tambangin gen in; Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “Ngai in, Aw Izipt lengpa Pharaoh, luipidung lah alum Olepi aw Ka luipi khu keima a ahi a, Kei a dinga ka kibawl ahi, chipa Ka hing dou ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh na khadang ah ngakuoi in ka hing kuoi dinga, na luipi a ngate na lip ah ka behsah dinga, na luipite sung apat, hing khaikhe ding ka hi. Tuachi’n na luipi a ngate zousie, na lip ah abeh ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Nang leh na luipite a ngate zousie, gamdai ah ka hing nuasie ding a, gamlah ah na pua ding a, top lou leh phohlou in na um ding a, Gamsate leh tungleeng vate ann dingin, ka hing peta hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tuachi’n Izipt gam a tengte zousie in, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi; aziehpen amaute Israel innkuonte adingin, pumpeng chieng ahita uhi.","ref":"Isai. 36.6"},"7":{"text":"Amaun na khut a ahing tuh chiengun, na tawngta a, aliengkoute uh na liem sah a, na tunga ahing kingap chiengun, na tawngsan a, akawngte uh na kiheh sah hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai in, na tungah namsau ka hing tungsah dinga, nanga kipat mihing leh, gantate ka thatgam sieng ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt gam khu gamsie, koima tenna lou, khogem nua bang ahita ding hi; “Tuachi’n amaun Kei Mangpa ka hi chi atheita ding uh; aziehpen ama’n Nile luipi kei a ahia, Keima bawl ahi achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuazieh in Ngai in, nang leh na luipite ka hing dou ahi, tualeh Izipt gam, Migdol akipat Syene tandong leh Ethiopia gamgi dongin, gamsie leh koima tenna lou, gamtul ka suohsah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihing koima keng ahisihleh ganhing kengin atuon ngai nawnsih dinga, kum sawmli sung koima ateng sih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Izipt gam khu, luolou gamsete lah a gamsie luolou gam khat in ka bawl dinga, akhopite zong kum sawmli sung suhsiet a um khopite lah a khopi tulnua ka suohsah ding hi; tualeh Izipt mite khu namte lah ah ka thethang ding a, gam chin ah ka thezah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Ahivang in Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Kum sawmli abei chiengin Izipt mite khu ka thethangna gamte lah apat ka puikhawm kia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Izipt saltang mite ka hing nuapui kia ding a apienna gam uh Pathros gam ah ka hing kinuale sah ding a, khunah leenggam ngiemtah in a um ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tamkhu leenggam lah a ngiempen ahi ding a, namte tungah akitawisang ngai nawn sih ding hi; aziehpen namte tunga vaihawm nawnlou dingin amauh ka sungiemta ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Izipt pen Israel innkuonte a dingin muontham ahi nawnsih ding a, amaute panpina dei a, amauh lam angat uh, akhelna uh ahi zaw chi theidohna ding uh ahi zaw ding hi. Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa Pasian ka hi chi athei ding uhi,” chi in achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh kum sawmni leh sagina, ha khatna, ni khat ni in, Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga;","title":"Babilonten Izipt mite apui mang ding"},"18":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar in Tai-ar douna dingin agalkapten sil thupitah abawlsah a, michin lutang aheukieu pieh a, tualeh michin liengkou akoh sah a, ahivangin ama leh agalkapten Tai-ar adou ziehun bangma lawtah amu sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Pellou in Izipt gam khu Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar kung ah ka pe ding a, ama’n tua gam hausatna apomang dinga, Izipt gam asim dinga, gallah vante ala ding a, tuate khu agalkapte thaman ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama’n tuabanga nna aseppen kei a ding ahiziehin, akipahman ding a Izipt gam akhut a ka pieh ahi; Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"21":{"text":"“Tua ni chiengin Keima’n Israel innkuonte kii ka poudoh sah dinga, amaute lah ah nakam kaah in thu ka hing gensah ding hi; tuachi’n amaun Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi.”"}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Izipt gam suhsiet hi ding"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa genlawhna thu gen inlen, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, chi in: “Kap in, mau in, Ekadei! tuami ni va-ia talawm! chi in."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen ani anaita, Mangpa ni ngel khu anaita, meipizin ni khu, Pasian theilou namte ni ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Izipt gam tungah namsau atung dinga, Ethiopia tungah lungzinna a um ding Izipt gamsunga tha a umte a pua chiengun, ahausatnate alahmang pieh ding ua, akingaatna suongphumte achimzah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ethiopia, Libia, Lidia leh nam chin umkhawmte leh Kub leh akithuopi gam mite zousie Izipt toh, namsau in apua khawm, ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"“Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Izipt panpite apua ding ua, akisahtheipi ahatna akengiem dinga, Migdol akipat Syene tandonga umte namsau in apua ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute gam sessa leh koima ten nawnlouna gam kiloisa ahi ding ua, akhopite uh zong susiet a um khopite lah ah susietsa ahi ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Mei a Izipt gam ka hal a, ama panpite zousie suhmanga, a um hun chiengun, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua ni chiengin khohsahna neilou Ethiopia mite zausah dinga, Kei akipat a thupote kuonga akuondoh chiengun, Izipt lungzin chimaw ni bangin, lungzin chimawna nasatah amauh tungah atung ding hi; Ngai un, hing tung pai ding ahita."},"10":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Babilon lengpa Nebukadnezzar khut zangin, Izipt hausatna tampite ka beisah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama leh amipi a umpite, namte lah a huham leh zauhuoi penpente, gam suse ding in ahing kizawpi dinga, amaun Izipt dou dingin namsau adoh ding ua, gam sung pumpi mi kithatte luongin adim ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Luipite ka kangsah dinga, tualeh agam migiloute kungah ka zua ding a, Gamdang mite khut zangin, agam leh asunga um zousie ka sumang sieng ding hi: Kei Mangpa’n ka gen zouta hi."},"13":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ken amilimte uh ka suse dinga, Memphis a amilimte uh ka subei ding hi, Izipt gam sungah leeng vaihawm a um nawn sih ding a, tuaziehin Izipt gam sung zousie ah zauna ka koi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Pathros khu gamsie koima tenlouna ka suohsah ding a, Zoan mei in ka hal dinga, Thebes tungah gawtna ka tungsah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Izipt thahatna Sin tungah ka lungthahna ka sungbo dinga, Thebes mihon tampite ka satkhe ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Izipt mei in ka hal dinga, Sin in nasatah in na asa ding hi; Thebes akehgawp dinga, Memphis nichin in alungkham ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Aven leh Pi-Beseth khanglaite namsau in apua ding ua, khopimite zong sal a puimang in a um ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Izipt hahkol ka suhtawngpieh chiengin, Tehaphnehes ah sunlai amiel dinga, akisahtheipi ahatna abeita ding a, amapen meilum in atuomkhum dinga, atanute khopi neute sal a pui in a um ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tambangin Izipt tungah thukhenna ka tungsah dinga, tuachi’n amaun Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi.”"},"20":{"text":"Akum sawm leh khatna, aha khatna, ani sagi niin, Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,"},"21":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Izipt leengpa Pharaoh ban ka sutawngta hi; en in, namsau tawi dinga hat ding khopin, damdawi akinu sih dinga, akituom sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, Ngai in, Izipt leengpa Pharaoh ka dou ahi; aban ahat lang leh a tawngsa lang zong ani in ka suhtawng pieh dinga, akhut apat in namsau ka Kesah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Izipt mite khu namte lah ah ka thethang ding a, gam chingtengah ka thezah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Babilon leengpa bantha ka hatsah dinga, akhut ah ka namsau ka koi dinga, hinanleh Pharaoh bante ka suhtawng pieh dinga, Babilon leengpa masang ah shi ding khop a liem bangin atau hut hut ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Babilon leengpa bantha ka hatsah dinga, hinanleh Pharaoh bante pen azaw ningnieng ding hi; Babilon leengpa khut a ka namsau ka koi a, ama’n Izipt gam tunga, tua namsau alap hun chiengin, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Izipt mite khu namte lah ah ka thezah dinga, gam chinteng ah ka thethang ding hi; tuachi’n amaun Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi.”"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum sawm leh khatna, aha thumna, ani khat ni in Mangpa thu ka kung ah ahing tunga,","title":"Assiria banga Izipt satkhiehna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Izipt leengpa Pharaoh kung leh, amihon tampite kung ah, gen inlen, “Na thupina ah koi na bang ei?"},"3":{"text":"Ngai in, Lebanon a sidar sing sang kilawm bazam hoitah leh, bawhphatah leh sangtah Assiria toh ka hing tekah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuiten tua sing akhanglien sah a, leinuoi langa tuiten sangtahin akhang sah a, apouna kimvel ah luituite aluong a, gam a singkungte tui apie hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin gamlah sing zousie sangin asangzaw a, ahing bawhpha deu deu a, tui nieng tah a akham ziehin, abate asau a, azam zei zoi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tungleeng vate zousie in abawh lah ah bu abawl ua, abazam lim nuoi ah gam sate zousie in nou a nei uhi, tualeh nam thupite zousie alim nuoi ah ateng uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tambangin athupina leh abazamte sau ziehin akilawm hi, Aziehpen ahuite tui kiningching leh, tamna mun ah alutsuh hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian huon sung a sidar singten adep zou sih a, tasingte lah ama bawh abang zou sih a, tualeh se singten zong abate apha zou sih uhi; Pasian huon sunga singte’n zong akilawmna apha zou sih uhi.","ref":"Siem. 2.9"},"9":{"text":"Ken aba tampi nei in Ka kilawm sah a, Pasian huon a um, Eden a singkung zousie in ama a eeng uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: asanna ahing kibelapa, abawhpha lah ah adawn ahing kikhotou a, asanna ziehin alungtang ahing kisathei ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ken ama khu namte lah a hattah khat khut ah ka pedoh ding a, ama’n ama khu abawlse ngei ngei ding hi; Ken ama khu agitlouna ziehin ka deldohta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh gamdang mite, namte lah a huham leh zauhuoi pente in ama asatkhie ua anuasie ta uhi; Abate khu muoltung lah leh phaiguom zousie ah aketa hi. Abawhte khu gam sunga luidungte ah atawngsa in a umta hi. Leitunga namte zousie alim nuoi apat apawtdoh ua, anuasieta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Asietna tungah, tungleeng vate zousie a umden ding ua, tualeh gamsate zousie abahiengte tungah a um ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n tui a kivah sing zousie akisansah lou ua, azih uh sing bawhphate lah a adawhtouna ding u’leh, tui kham mama sing dang pouma in zong abatphah zoulouna ding ahi. Aziehpen amaute zousie leinuoi thuhtah a, hankhuh sunga Peisuh mihing tate lah a, shina tuoh ding a piehdoh sieng ahita uhi."},"15":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen Hi: Sheol a apeisuh ni in asuunna ka umsah a, tui thuhtahte ama ziehin ka khukhuma alui luongte ka khawl sah a, tui tamtahte aluong sih uhi. Lebanon in ama ka suunsah a, gamlah sing zousie ama ziehin abata uhi."},"16":{"text":"Kokhuh a kesuhte toh ama mishikhuo a ka paikhieh suh lai in, a pua ging za in namte ka kithing sah hi. Tualeh Eden a singkung zousie, Lebanon sing hoipente, tui kham mama singkungte zousie leinuoi thuhtah ah hamuong tah in a umta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute zong namsau a thate toh mishikhuo ah apei suhta ua, tualeh namte lah a, alim nuoi a teng akhut akeng hite ngei toh zong."},"18":{"text":"Eden singte lah ah thupina leh letna lam ah koi ahiei nang bang um? Hinanleh Eden a singte toh leinuoi thuh pen ah ahing kizawpi suh ding hi; teptanloute lah ah, namsau a kithatte toh na lumkhawm ding hi. “Tami Pharaoh leh amipi tamtahte ahi uh, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.”"}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum sawm leh ni na, aha sawmlenina, ani khat ni in, Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Izipt dinga Suunna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Izipt leengpa Pharaoh a dingin kaateng lou inlen, akungah, “Nangpen namte lah ah, Humpibahnei khanglai bang na hi a, tuipi a awlepi bang na hi luipi a tuite na kiloh sah a, na kengte in tuite na tohphuon a, tualeh luipi tuite na sunieh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tambangin Mangpa Pasian in agen hi, Tuaziehin mihon tampi toh ka len in, Ka hing khu dinga, amaun Ka len in ahing kaikhe ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n leigaw tungah ka hing nuasie ding a, gam lah ah ka hing paidoh ding hi; tualeh tungleeng vate zousie na tungah ka tusah dinga, leitung pumpi a gamsate na sa ane in ka gilvasah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Taangte tungah na tahsa ka lumsah dinga, luiguomte na luongin ka dimsah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Gam sung zousie muol sangte nangawn ah, zong na sisan ka luongsah ding a, luidungte ah na luong ka dimsah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nang ka hing phietmang ni chiengin, vante ka khukhum ding a, aasite ka miel sah ding hi; ni meilum in ka khu dinga, hapi ataang nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 13.10; Mat. 24.29; Mak. 13.24,25; Luk. 21.25; Kihil. 6.12,13; 8.12"},"8":{"text":"Van a taang vah zousie na tungah ka miel sah dinga, na gam tungah mielna ka tungsah ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in a chi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Namte lah a na sietna ka tunsah hun chiengin, na thei ngailou gamte lah a, mi tampite ka lungkham sah ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi, mitampite nangma ah, ka chizasah dinga, amasang ua ka namsau ka le hun chiengin aleengpate uh nang ziehin chiza sengin azau ding uhi; tualeh na pua ni chiengin michin ahinna uh taan ding zau in mitphietkaal chin achitun ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, Babilon leengpa namsau na tungah ahing tung ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihat namsau in mihonte ka puasah dinga, amaute namte lah a huham leh zauhuoi pente ahi uhi; “Tuachi’n amaun Izipt thupina asuse ding ua, tualeh mipi zousie suhmangthai in a um ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Agantate zousie luitui tampite gei apat ka sumangthai ding a, mihing kengin asubuoi nawn sih dinga, gantate kengin zong a zausah nawn sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n atuite uh ka siengsah dinga, alui tuite sathau bangin ka luong sah ding hi; Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Izipt gam koima tennalou gamsie ka suohsah hun chiengin, tualeh agam a tengte hausatna ka phietmang chiengin, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi ahing thei ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tami ama suunna kilou ding kaala ahi, namte tanute’n ama aka ding ua, amaun Izipt leh amihonte zousie suun in akap ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.”"},"17":{"text":"A kum sawm leh nina, tuami ha, ni sawm leh nga niin, Mangpa thu ka kungah a hing tung hi;","title":"Izipt dinga suunna"},"18":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Izipt mihonte kaa in mau inlen, ama leh nam minthangtah tanute, hankhuh a peisuhte toh leinuoi thuhtah ah paikhie in."},"19":{"text":"Nang koi ahiei melhoina a na khup? Peisuh inlen, teptanloute lah ah valum in."},"20":{"text":"Amauh namsau a kithatte lah ah apua ding ua; Izipt khu namsau kunga pieh ahita. Ama leh amihonte zousie kaikhedoh in."},"21":{"text":"Galhatmite lah a mihatten, hankhuh sunga pat in ama leh apanpite kung ah thu agen ding ua, teptanlou namsau a kithatte toh alum uhi."},"22":{"text":"“Assiria leh alawmte zousie khunah a um ua, akimvel ah ahante a um a, abawn ua thasa, namsau a puasa ahi uhi."},"23":{"text":"A hankhuhte u’khu leinuoi thuhpi ah a um a, alawmte uh ahankhuh kimvel ah a um uhi; abawn un thasa, namsau a puasa, mihing gam a chizatna umsahte ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"“Khunah Elam leh amihon tampite zousie ahankhuh kimvel uah a um uhi; abawn un thasa, namsau a puasa, teptanlou a, leinuoi thuhpen a, peisuh, mihing gam a, chizatna umsahte ahi ua, amaun hankhuh a peisuhte toh a zumna uh apota uhi."},"25":{"text":"Akithatsate lah ah ama leh ahankhuh kim a amihonte zousie a dingin lupna abawl ua, amaute abawn un teptanloute namsau a kithat ahi uhi, azau huoina uh khu mihing gam ah a umsah vang un, kokhuh sung tungsuhte toh a zumna leh zalatna uh apuo ua thasate lah ah siel in a um uhi."},"26":{"text":"“Khunah Meshek leh Tubal tualeh amihon tampite a um ua, ahante uh akimvel uah a um hi; amaute abawn un, teptanlou ahinglaite gam a zauhuoina a umsah zieh ua namsau a kithatte ahi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Amaute khu hankhuh sunga agalvante u’toh peisuh, teptanlou a pua, mihatte toh alumkhawm sih ding ua, anamsaute uh atangkhap ua, hinanleh mihing gam a mihat zauhuoi hinan u’leh zong; atatkhelnate uh agute uh tungah aumden ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi, Nangkhu teptanloute lah ah, na kehgawp dinga, namsau a kithatte toh na lumkhawm ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Khunah Edom, a leengte leh a leengtapate zousie namsau a kithatsate lah ah siel khawm in a um uhi; teptanloute leh hankhuh sunga na peisuhsate toh akisiel khawm ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"“Mallam leengtapate zousie leh Sidon mite toh abawn un, mikithatsate toh apeisuhkhawm uhi; azauhuoina u’toh ahatna uh azumpi ua; teptanlou in namsau a thasate toh a lumkhawm ua, hankhuh sunga peisuhte toh azumna, uh apokhawm uhi."},"31":{"text":"“Pharaoh leh agalkap hon in amaute amuding ua; Pharaoh leh agalkap honte ziehin amauh tungah akihenem ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Ken mihing gam ah ka zauhuoina umsah nanleng zong, Pharaoh leh amihonte zousie teptanloute lah ah namsau a, thate toh siel khawm in a um ding uhi; Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.”"}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a,","title":"Ezekiel galvengpa a guotna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa na mite kungah thu gen inlen, akung uah, gam tunga namsau ka lensah chiengin, agam miten alah ua mi khat ateldoh ua, galveng dinga akoi u’leh;"},"3":{"text":"aman gamtunga namsau hing tung ding amu chienga, mipite kigalginna ding a, pengkul amut chiengin;"},"4":{"text":"mi koipou tua pengkul gin za napi a, khohsalou a aum leh; namsau hing tung a, tuabang mi hinna alah leh, asisan maw ama lutungah atu ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Aman pengkul ging za napi a, khawh asahlou ziehin asisan maw ama lutungah atu ding hi. Hinanleh akigalgingpa in ahinna ahumbit ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh galvengpa in namsau hing kuon mu napi a, mite kigalginna dinga pengkul amut sih leh namsau ahing tun a, alah ua pat mi koi ahiei khat hinna alah leh akhelna ziehin lahmang ahi dinga, hinanleh a sisan phuba khu galvengpa tungah ka la ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tuachi’n Nang Mihing tapa, Israel innkuonte dinga galvengpa in ka hing koi ahi; tuaziehin ka kam a thupawt ngaikhie inlen, Kei apat in amauh kigalging sah in."},"8":{"text":"Migilou kunga, Aw Migilou na shi ngeingei ding ahi ka chi a, tua migilou khu agamtatna kiheisan ding a na hil sih leh, tua migilou khu agitlouna ziehin ashi ding a, hinanleh a sisan phuba na tungah ka la ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahivang in, migilou khu a umdan apat kihei dinga na hil a, a umdan apat akiheituom sih leh akhelna ziehin ashi dinga, hinanleh nang na hinna na humbit ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tuaziehin nang Mihing tapa aw, Israel innkuon kungah thu gen in, nouten tambangin na gen uhi, I tatkhelnate leh ikhelnate i tung uah a um a, tuate zieh a tummang suh ihi u’leh, bangchin ihing thei ding uoi? na chi uhi, chiin.","title":"Mimal mawpuohna"},"11":{"text":"Amaute kungah, Mangpa Pasian in ahin a ka hin laisie; Keima’n migiloupa shina ah kipahna mawngmawng ka nei sih a, hinanleh migilou khu a umdan gilou apat ahing kinuahei a hin khu ka deilam ahi, na umdan gilou ua pat hing kinuahei un, hing kihei un, aziehpen bangdinga shi ding na hi uoi mah? chiin."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin nang Mihing tapa na chi na namte tate kungah gen in: Midihtat adihtatna in atatkhelna ni in ahundam sih dinga, migilou khu agitlouna apat ahing kihei ni in, apuasih ding a; midihtat zong akhel niin, adihtatnate ziehin ahing tuom sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Midihtat kunga na hing ngeingei ding ahi ka chia, aman adihtatna muong a, silgilou abawl leh, asil bawl dihtatte lah a khat beeh zong akithei ngitnget sih dinga, hinanleh asilgilou bawl ziehin ashi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh migilou kunga na shi ngeingei ding ahi ka chi kia a, aman akhelna akiheisan a, danbangtah leh adih a abawl a;"},"15":{"text":"migilou in sum leitawi a kichiemna sil alahte anua pieh kia a, avan guhsate anua pieh kia a, hinna danpiehte azui a, gitlouna bangma abawl sih leh, ahing ngeingei ding a ashi sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ana bawlsa khelnate khat beeh atungah thei ngitnget ahi nawnsih ding hi, aman danbang leh adih abawl ahita a, ahing ngeingei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"“Hinanleh na mite taten Mangpa sil bawldan adih sih achi uhi. Ahivangin amauh bawldan ahi adihlou zaw."},"18":{"text":"Midihtat in adihtatna akiheisan a, silgilou abawl leh ashi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh migilou khu agitlouna apat ahing kihei a, adih atang abawl leh, tua asilbawl ziehin ahing ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten Mangpa sil bawldan adih sih, na chi uhi. Aw nou Israel innkuonte, michin asilbawl dungzui un, atung chiet uah thu ka khen ding hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh ka saltaan uh kum sawm leh nina, aha sawmna ani nga ni in, Jerusalem apat a suohta mi khat ka kung uah ahing pei a, “Khopi apuata,” ahing chi hi.","title":"Jerusalem sietna thu hing tung","ref":"2 Leeng. 25.3-10; Jer. 39.2-8; 52.4-14"},"22":{"text":"Tua mi suohta pa hing tun masang nitahlam in Mangpa khut ka tungah a um hi. Tualeh zingmawng a tua mipa, ka kunga ahing tun masangsie in ka kam ahing kaahsah a, tuachi’n ka kam akikaah a hamtheilou in ka um nawnta sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung a,","title":"Mipi khelna"},"24":{"text":"“Mihing tapa, Israel gam sesa mun a tengten: Abraham mi khat maimai hinapi, aman tam gam aluo hi. Hinanleh eite mi tampi ihi ua, gam khu iluo ding ua hing kipie ahi, chiin agen uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin akung uah, Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Sa a sisan toh na nekhawm ua na mitte uh milimte langah na dahtou sah ua, sisan na suo ziehun, gam na luo ding uh amah?"},"26":{"text":"Na namsau uh na muong ua, sil kidahhuoite na bawl ua, noute michin in na innvengpa uh zi na subua chiet uhi. Tuabangpi in gam na luo ding uh amah? achi hi, chiin."},"27":{"text":"Tambangin akung uah gen in, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ahin a ka hin laisie, gam sesa a tengte namsau in ashi ding ua, gamlah a umte khu gamsate nehmang dingin ka pe dinga, kulpi sunga umte leh kolhawm sunga umte natpi in ashi ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen gam khu koima tenlouna gamsepen ka suohsah dinga, akisahtheipi ahatna ka beisah ding a, Israel taangte koima totnawnlou gamsie leh akinuasie gam ahita ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n sil kidahhuoi abawlte zousie zieh ua, akiloisa gamsie ka suohsah zou chiengin, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"“Mihing tapa aw nang na hileh, na mite tate in nangma hing gensie kulbaang geilah leh inn kotkhabul lah ah akihoudap uhi, tualeh khat le khat kihouin michin in a unaupa kungah, hepitah in hing pei vawi, Mangpa a kipat a thupawt bang ahiei chi ngaikhe un, akichi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute mite hing pei bang in na kung ah ahing pei ua, na masangah ka mite bangin atou ua, na thugen angaikhie ua, hinanleh abawl sih uhi, akam un itna thu nasatah in agen ua, hinanleh alungtang un huoiham tah in punna adel uhi."},"32":{"text":"En in, nangpen ama ua ding in, aw ngainuom huoitah neimi la hoitah bang leh tumging tum siemtah ging bang na hi, amaun na thugen aza ua, hinanleh azuituom sih uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh tamte ahing tun chiengin, (ngai in hing tung ngei ngei ding ahi,) tuachi’n amaun alah uah guolnei aum hi chi a thei ding uhi.”"}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Israel belampu dihloute kunga thuvaihah"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Israel belampute demna in genlawhna gen in. Akung uah genlawhna gen inlen, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ama uleh amauh kivahthau Israel belampute tung agih hi!
