Belamputen belamhon avah ding uh hizawlou ding amah?"},"3":{"text":"Athaute na ne ua, amulte puon in na kisil ua, akivahthaute na that ua, hinanleh belamhonte na vah sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Azawngkhalte na suhat sih ua, achinate na kemdam sih ua, aliemte lah na tuom sih ua, nawmanga umte lah na hing nuapui kia sih ua, amangte lah na suidoh sih uhi; hinanleh thagum leh giloutah in atung uah vai na hawmkhum uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n belampu umlou zieh in, amaute akithezahta ua, tuabanga akithezah chieng un, gamlah a gamsate ann asuohta uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 27.17; 1 Leeng. 22.17; Mat. 9.36; Mak. 6.34"},"6":{"text":"Ka belamte taang sangte leh muol tung lah ah avahvaita uhi; Ahi, Ka belamhonte leitung maikai ah akithethang zou siengta ua, Koiman asui sih ua, kan lah akankhe sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Tuaziehin nou belampute aw, Mangpa thu ngai un."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in ahin a ka hin laisie: ka belamten belampu anei lou ua, ka belam honte samat mai ahing hi ua, gamsate ann asuohta ua, ka belamputen lah amauh suilou ua, hinanleh ama u’leh amauh akivah ua, ka belamhonte a vahsih uhi, achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin nou belampute aw, Mangpa thu ngai un;"},"10":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai un, Belampute ka dou ahi, tualeh ka belamhonte sisan man akhut uah ka phuut dinga, belamte avahna uh ka sutawp ding a, belampute ama u’leh amauh akivah nawn sih ding uhi. Akam sung ua pat ka belamte ka hundoh ding a, amaute ading in ann ahi nawn sih ding uhi, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Aziehpen Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai in, Keima mama in, ka belamte ka kankhe dinga, ka suidoh ding hi.","title":"Belampu dih"},"12":{"text":"Belampu in kithethangte lah a, a um lai a, abelamte asuidoh mabangin, Ken zong ka belamte ka suidoh dinga, khonim leh miel lah ah zong akithethangna mun zousie ua pat ka hundoh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh namte lah a kipat in amaute ka puidoh ding a, gamchin apat ka puidoh dinga, amauh gam ngei ah ka polut dinga, Israel taangte ah, luipangte ah leh gam sunga mite tenna mun chintengah amauh ka vah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hampa hoina munte ah amauh ka vah dinga, Israel muol sangte tungah amauh ka va ding hi. Khunah huong hoitah sungah aboh ding ua, Israel taang hampa hoina munte ah amauh ka va ding a, akhawldamta ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Keima’n ka belamhonte ka va dinga, amaute ka khawldam sah ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Amangte ka suidoh dinga, avahmangte ka nuapui kia dinga, aliemte ka tuom ding a, achinate ka hatsah dinga, hinanleh athaute leh ahatte ka sumang ding a, vaihawmna in ka va ding hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tualeh noute nahi u’leh, Aw ka belamhonte, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai un belam leh belam kikaal tualeh belamtal leh keltal kikaal keima’n, thukhenna ka bawlpieh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Loupa hoina mun nou a dinga na kivah na ding ua neutaluo ahithei a, na ann maina uh loupa mundangte nangawn na keng un na tuonchil ding uh amah? Nouten tuichimtah na dawnzou chieng un, na dawnmawhte nangawn uh na keng un na pal nieh tei tei ding uh amah?"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh ka belamten ahileh, na keng ua na totchilsate uh ane ua, tualeh na keng ua na palniehsate uh adawn uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in akung uah tambang in agen hi: Ngai un, Keima mama in ganta thau leh ganta gawng kikaal thu ka khenpieh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen nouten na pang u’leh na liengkou un, belam zawngkhal leh hatloute na phu ua, na delmang masangsie uh na kii un na su uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin ke’n ka belamhonte ka hundam ding a, samat ding ahinawn sih ding ua, tualeh ken belam leh belam kikaal thu ka khenpieh ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh atung uah belampu khat ka koi ding a, amauh avaa ding hi, ka suoh David ngel in amauh avaa ding a, a belampu uh ahi ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 7.17"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Kei Mangpa khu a Pasian uh ka hi dinga, ka suohpa David khu alah uoh leengtapa ahi ding hi. Kei Mangpa’n tami ka gensa ahita hi.","ref":"Ezek. 37.24"},"25":{"text":"“Ken amau’toh lemna thuhun ka bawl dinga, gamsung apat gamsa giloute ka beisah sieng dinga, gamdai ah bittah in ka tengsah dinga, tualeh gammang lah ah zong nuomtah in a imu ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ama uleh ka muol kimvel a munte ka guolzawl ding a, ahun hun in guo ka zusah ding a, guolzawlna guo azu ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamlah singten ga asuota ding ua, leitungin aga apungsah ding a, agam uah bittah in a um ding uhi, tualeh ahahkol uh ka suhtawng a, sal a mante khut apat amauh ka hutdoh hun chiengin, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi atheita ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh namdangte samat giap ahi nawnta sih ding ua, gamsate nehmang ding bep ahi nawn sih ding uhi; hinanleh lungmuongtah in a teng ding ua, Koiman azausah nawn sih ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ama ua dingin annte louhing kichinna huon minthang tah ka siem pieh ding a, kiel in amauh asumang nawn sih ding hi, tualeh nam dangte simmawna zong a thuoh nawn sih ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tambangin Kei Mangpa a Pasian un, amaute ka umpi a, tualeh amauh Israel innkuonte ngei khu, ka mite ahi uh chi, ahing theita ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Noute ka belamhonte, ka gantatna mun a ka belamte, ka mite na hi ua, Kei na Pasian uh ka hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi,” chiin, achi hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaban ah Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a,","title":"Edom gawtna ding genlawhna","ref":"Isai. 34.5-17; 63.1-6; Jer. 49.7-22; Ezek. 25.12-14; Amos. 1.11,12; Obad. 1.1-14; Mala. 1.2-5"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Seir muol lang maingat inlen, ama douna thu genlawh in."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh akungah, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, chiin: Ngai in, Aw Seir muol ka hing dou ahi, nang dou in ka khut ka lam ding a, koima tennalou gam setawp in ka hing bawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Na khopite ka suse dinga, akisie leh akiloi khopi na suoh dinga, tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi na thei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen Israeltate, khanglui lai apat na muda tawntung ua, atatkhelna uh gawtna nukhia pen a sietna atuoh ni un, namsau thahatna in a sisan uh na suo hi;"},"6":{"text":"tuaziehin ahin a ka hinlaisie, Noute sisan a dingin ka hing bawlkhol ding a, sisan in ang nuadel ding hi; sisan na huotlou zieh un, sisan in ahing nuadel ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tambangin Seir muol koima tennalou a kiloi leh kisegawp ka suoh sah ding a, khuna pawtdohte leh hing lut kiate pouma khuna pat ka satkhe ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh a muol leh taangte mi kithatsa siluongin ka dimsah ding a, na muolte leh na phaiguomte ah leh muol kikaal guomthuh zousie ah ka dimsah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Asegawp leh loi den in ka hing bawl ding a, na khopite akiluo kia nawn sih ding a, tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi na thei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Nang: tam nam nite leh tam gam nite khu kei a ahi ding ua, Mangpa khunah umtamananleh iluo ding uh, na chi zieh in;"},"11":{"text":"tuaziehin A hinna ka hinlai sie, Na lungthahna bang dungzui leh amauh na mudana zieha na suhlat, na thangsietna dungzui in ka hing bawl dinga, tualeh na tunga thu ka khen zou chiengin amaute lah ah ka kitheisahta ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi leh, suhsiet in aumta ua, koima tenna lou a susiet dingin ikung uah pieh in a umta uh chi a, Israel muol leh taangte na gensietna zousie ka zata hi chi na hing thei ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tambangin na kam un ka tungah na kiuongsah ua, ka tung ah na thu uh na tamsah uh, chi kaza hi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: leitung pumpi lungnuom a akipah laitah noute koima tenna lou a kiloi gamsie ka hing suohsah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Israel innkuonte goutan suhsiet leh loi ahi laitah a nang lungnuom a na kipah ziehin, tuamabangin nang zong kang bawl ding hi. Aw Seir muol leh Edom zousie abawn in asegawp ding uhi. Tua hun chiengin, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi, chiin achi hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh nang Mihing tapa Israel muolte kung ah genlawh inlen, nou Israel muolte aw Mangpa thu ngai un, chi in.","title":"Namte tunga thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Melma in na tung tang ah: Ka chita vele! nidanglai muol sangte, eite tan ahing hita achi ziehun:"},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin genlawhna gen inlen, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Amaun nang ahing suhsiet ua, namdang umsunten nei na hing theina ding a, ning chin a, ahing nawmval ua, mi kamtamte houlim nopna leh mite gensiet a ahing um sah zieh un."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin Nou Israel taang te aw, Mangpa Pasian thu ngai un, Mangpa Pasian in taangte kungah; luite, phaiguomte leh mun sesate, nuasie a um khopite kungah, akimvel a um namdangte samat ding giap nuisat ding leh nuizatbuh hing hite kungah tambang in agen hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Adihtah in, lungtang kipahtah leh sim mawna lungsim toh, ka gam amauh tan dinga ana kiguot tawm a, gallah vante a na bawltum, namdang umsunte tungleh Edom zousie tung ah, ka thangsietna meikuong pumin thu kana genta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin Israel gam tungtang genlawhna thu gen inlen, muol leh taangte kungah, luiguomte leh phaiguomte kungah, gen in, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai un, namte simmawna na thuoh ziehun ka thangsietna leh ka thangpaina zieh in thu ka genta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: na kimvel ua namten zong simmawna athuoh ding uhi, chiin banzah in ka kichiemta hi."},"8":{"text":"“Ahi vangin nou, Aw Israel taangte, na bazamte uh hoitah in na mengdoh sah ding ua, Ka mi Israelte kung ah ga hoitah suong un, aziehpen hing pei pai ding ahi uhi.","title":"Israel Mangpa kunga hing kinua le na"},"9":{"text":"Ngai un, nou lam a pang ka hia, nou lam ka nga ding a, hawin na um ding ua, haichi tuna in na um ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachiengin na tungah mihingte ka pungsah ding a, Israel innkuonte abawn un, tualeh khopite akiluo ding a, tualeh akisesate akilamtha ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Na tungah mihing leh gantate ka pungsah dinga, ahing chipha ding ua, ga ahing suong ding uhi; nidanglai mabangin mi ka hing tengsah dinga, na kipatchil laisang ua hoizaw in ka hing bawl ding hi; Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi na thei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi, na tungah ka mi Israelte ka vahsah kawi kawi ding a, tuachi’n amaun nang ahing luo ding ua, agoutan uh na hi dinga, atate uh na taansah ngai nawn sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Aziehpen amaun na kungah, Nouten mite na ne gam ua, a nam u’leh atate uh na taansah leng uhi, achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin nouten mi na negam nawn sih ding ua, na namte na taansah ngai nawn sih ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in a chi hi."},"15":{"text":"Namte hing phinna ka hing zasah nawn sih ding a, namte simmawna zong na thuoh nawn sih ding ua, na nampite zong na kipalpua sah nawn sih ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tuaban ah Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung a,"},"17":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Israel innkuonte amau’gam sung ua aten lai un, a umdan u’leh asil bawlte un gam abuasah uhi; agamtatna ukhu kei a dingin numei asinei lai ua asienthoulou bang ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin amauten gam sunga sisan aluonsahna uh amilimte ziehin atung uah ka lungthahna ka sungbota hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken amauh namte lah ah ka thezahta a, gam chin ah akithethangta uhi, a umdan uh dungzui leh a silbawl uh dungzui in amaute tungah thukhenna ka tunta hi."},"20":{"text":"Namte lah a apeina chin uah, tamte Mangpa mite ahi ua, hinapi agam ua patpeidoh ahi uh chia, anachizel na uah ka min siengthou asubua uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel innkuonten apeina uh namte lah a asuhthanghuoi uh ka min siengthou ka lainat ahi."},"22":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Israel innkuonte kungah gen in, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi, Israel innkuonte aw, tam sil ka bawlte noute zieh ahi sih a na tenna uh namte lah a na suhbua uh ka min siengthou zieh ahi zaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh ka min thupitah namte lah a suhbua a um, na lah ua na suhbua u’khu, ka susiengthou ding a, tuachi’n noute vanga namte lah a suhsiengthou a ka um hun chieng in, namdangten kei Mangpa ka hi chi ahing theita ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen namte lah a kipat ka hing ladoh dinga, gamchin apat ka hing puikhawm ding a, nouma gam ngei ah ka hing puilut kia ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n na tung uah tui sieng ka hing the dinga na hing siengta ding uhi; na niehna zousie ua kipat leh na milimte zousie ua kipat ka hing susieng ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Lungtang tha ka hing pe ding a, na sung uah hagau tha ka koi ding hi. Tualeh na salah ua pat suong banga taah lungtang ka ladoh dinga, sa bang a nip lungtang ka hing pe ding hi.","ref":"Ezek. 11.19,20"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh na sung uah ka hagau ka koi dinga, ka danthupiehte ka hing zui sah ding, tualeh ka vaihawmnate na kem ding ua, na bawl ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n na pu napate uh kunga ka pieh gam ah na teng ding ua, noute ka mite na hi ding ua, Kei na Pasian uh ka hi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Na sienthou lounate zousie ua pat, ka hing hundam dinga, tualeh bu leh bal ka piengsah ding a, ka pungsah ding a, na tung uah kiel ka tungsah sih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Na sing gate u’leh na louma hawsuohte uh ka pungsah dinga, tuachi’n namdangte lah ah maizumna na thuoh nawn sih ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin na umdan giloute u’leh na silbawl hoiloute uh na hing theidoh ding ua, tualeh na gitlounate u’leh na kidahhuoinate ziehun, na mitmu uah nouma leh nouma na kikidah ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Noute zieh a tami ka bawl ahi sih chi thei un, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi. Israel innkuonte aw, na umdan zieh un zum unlen, zala un."},"33":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Na khelnate zousie ua pat ka hing silsieng ni chiengin, khopite ah zong ka hing tengsahta ding a, asesate akilam tha kia ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Gam kiloisa leh sesa, atuonkha zousie mitmu a asesa hi nawn lou in, gam sesate akihou kia ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten gam sesa leh kiloisa khu Eden huon ahing bangta hi, tualeh khopi tulsa leh mangsate khu tuin kulpi a im leh luokia in ahing umta hi, achi ding uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tua hun chieng in na kim na pam ua nuasie a umten, Kei Mangpa’n gamsesa munte ka bawl tha a, gam tulsate ka pua tha ta hi, chi ahing thei ding uhi, Kei Mangpa’n tami ka gensa ahi a, ka bawl ding hi."},"37":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Tami ama ua dinga bawlpieh dingin Israel innkuonte nget leh kandoh in ka um nalai ding a, amite uh belamhon bangin ka pungsah ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Kithoina siengthou a zah ding ganhon bangin leh pawi bawl thupitah ni a, Jerusalem a belamhon bang khop in, khopi sesate khu mihonpi in ahing dimta dinga, tuachi’n Kei Mangpa ka hi chi atheita ding uhi, achi hi.”"}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa khut ka tungah a um a, tualeh Mangpa hagau in ahing puidoh a, gu ngen a dim phaijang laikim tah ah ahing koi suhta hi.","title":"Phaijanga gu gaw muna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n a lah uah ahing vahsah ta a, Ngai vawi, phaijang ah gu ngentang atam a tam a um lemlum a, tualeh en vawi, agawta ngen ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n ka kungah, “Mihing tapa tam gute ahing thei ding uoi? achi hi. Tuachi’n “Ken Mangpa Pasian aw, Nangman na thei hi,” chi in ka dawng hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman ka kungah, “Tam gute kungah thu gen inlen, nou gu gawte aw, Mangpa thu ngai un,"},"5":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tam gute kungah tambangin agen hi, Ngai un, na sung uah nahna hu ka lutsah dinga, na hing ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Na tung uah thagui ka koi ding a, na tung uah tel lehvou ka umsah ding a, vunin ka hing tuom ding a, na sung uah nahna hu ka koi ding hi; tuachi’n na hing hing ta ding ua; tuachi’n kei Mangpa ka hi chi na thei ding uhi,” chi in a chi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n thupieh a ka um bangin ka genta hi; tuabanga thu ka gen lai in, thawmging husa ahing um a, thakhat in akigawttuo lemlum ging ahing um a, gute ahing kizuontuo ua, gute khat leh khat ahing kizop uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ngai vawi, ka et leh thagui leh tahsa tel lehvoute atung uah ahing um a, vun in akhukhum hi; hinanleh ama uah nahna hu a um sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, thu gen in, “Mihing tapa nahna hu kungah, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Aw nahna hu kawlmong ning li akipat hing pei inlen, ahintheina dingun tam mikithatsate tungah na hu hing hakhum in,” chiin, achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n thu ahing kipieh bangin, thu ka genta a, tuachi’n hinna hu amaute sungah ahing lut a ahing hing ta uhi; tualeh akeng un ahing dingta ua, galkap hon tampi ahing hita uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 11.11"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n ka kungah, “Mihing tapa, tam gute khu Israel innkuon pumpi ahi uhi. Ngai in, amauten ka gute uh a gawta a, ka kinepna uh abeita a, satkhieh ka hita uh achi uhi.","title":"Kilahna hilchienna"},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin thu gen inlen akung uah, Mangpa Pasian in tambang agen hi: Ka mite aw ngai un, na hankhuhte uh ka hong ding a, na hankhuhte ua pat ka hing pawtdoh sah dinga, Israel gam ah ka hing puilut ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua banga na hankhuhte uh ka hon a, na hankhuh te ua pat a noute kang lahkhiettou chiengin, Aw nou ka miten, Kei Mangpa ka hi chi na theita ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Na sung uah ka hagau ka koi ding a, na hing ding uhi; tualeh nouma gam sung mama ah ka hing koi ding hi. Tua hun chiengin Kei Mangpa’n ka gensa, ka bawl ahi chi na theita ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi, chiin, achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kung ah ahing tung kia a,","title":"Chieng ni chiemtena"},"16":{"text":"“Mihing tapa chieng khat la inlen, atungah Juda ading leh akipawlpi Israel tate a ding, chiin giel in, tuazou chiengin chieng dang khat lakia inlen, atung ah Joseph a ding, Ephraim chieng, tualeh akipawlpi Israel innkuon pumpi a ding, chi in giel in."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n chiengte khu khat leh khat zoptuo inlen, tuachi’n tua chiengte na khut ah khat ahing hita ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh na mite taten na kunga; Tamte bang na china ahiei, koute na hing theisah sih ding amah? chi a ahing doh chieng un,"},"19":{"text":"amaute kungah, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ephraim leh akipawlpi Israelte khut a um Joseph chieng khu ka ladoh dinga tua khu Juda chieng toh akizop dinga, chieng khat ka hisahta dinga, ka khut ah khat ahita ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh atunga lai na gelna chiengte amit mu un amasang uah tawi inlen,"},"21":{"text":"amaute kungah tambangin gen in, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Pellou in, Israel tate apeimangna namte lah apat ka la doh ding a, ningchin apat ka puikhawm dinga, amauh gam mama ah ka puilut ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh amaute Israel gam sunga muol leh taangte tungah minam khat in ka bawl dinga, amaute zousie tungah leengpa khat a um dinga, nam ni ahi nawn sih ding ua, leenggam ni in akikhen ngai nawn sih ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Amilimte uh ahiei, asilkidah huoi bawlte uh ahiei, abawlkhelnate uh ahiei in akisubua nawn mawngmawng sih ding ua, hinanleh atenna ua a khelnate ua pat ka hundam ding a, ka susiengthou ding hi, tuachi’n amauh ka mite ahi ding ua, Kei a Pasian uh ka hi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"“Amaute tungah ka suohpa David leengpa ahi ding a, amauten abawn un belampu khat anei ding uhi. Ka thukhennate azui ding ua, ka danthupiehte a kem ding ua, abawl ding uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 34.24"},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka suoh Jakob kunga ka pieh na pu napate uh tenna gam ah ateng ding uhi; khunah ama u’leh atate u’leh atute uh kumtawn in atengta ding uhi, tualeh ka suohpa David khu kumtawn in aleengpa uh ahidenta ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaban ah amautoh kilemna thuhun ka bawl dinga, tami amau’toh kumtawn thuhun ahi ding hi. Amaute ka sudet dinga, ka pungsah ding a, ka munsiengthou khu amaute lah ah ka koiden ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka biehbuh zong amaute toh a umkhawm ding a, a Pasian uh ka hi ding a, ama uzong ka mite ahi ding uhi.","ref":"2 Kor. 6.16; Kihil. 21.3"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka munsieng thou khu alah ua kumtawn a aum hun chiengin namte zousie in zong, Kei Mangpa’n Israelte ka susiengthou ahi chi atheita ding uhi,” chiin, achi hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Gou tungtang genlawhna"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Meshek leh Tubal lamkai lienpen Magog gam a Gog lang ngain ama douna thu genlawh in.","ref":"Kihil. 20.8"},"3":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi. Ngai in, Meshek leh Tubal lamkailienpen Gog aw, ka hing dou ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ka hing kinuahei sah dinga, na khadang ah ngakuoi ka baat ding a, na galkap honteng toh, na sakolte leh galvan bukim a kigalvonsa sakol tung tuongte lum lien leh lum neu tawi mihonte abawn ua, namsau lehte toh hing kaikhe ding ka hi."},"5":{"text":"Persia, Ethiopia leh Libia toh abawn ua lum leh sia lukhu neite ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Gomer leh agalkap honte zousie mallam gam a, Togarmah innkuonte leh agalkapte zousie leh mitampi nang toh apangkhawm uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Kiging inlen, nang leh na kipawlpite na kunga umte zousie kigingsa in um unlen, nang amaute vengtu in pangin."},"8":{"text":"Nitampi nua chiengin hatkhawm na hi ding ua, kum nukhia lamte ah namsau a kipat kinuapui leh nam tampite lah akipat a puikhawmte umna gam sesa leh kiloisa, Israel taangte dou ding in na hing kuon ding uhi; namte lah apat puidoh ahi ua, abawn un hamuong tah in ateng ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Nang leh na galkapte zousie, na kunga um nam tampite toh khopihui laang bangin na kuontou ding ua, meilum bangin khum gam na tuomkhum ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Khum ni chiengin, na lungsim sung uah kingaituona giloutah nei in sil na geel ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n nangman kulbaang neilou khoneute umna gam ah ka kuontou dinga, abawn ua, kulbaang neilou a lungmuongtah a tengte, kulkot leh kulkot khana zawl zong neilou a bittah a tengte ka dou ding, na lungsim in na chi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Gallah sumte leh gallah vante la ding leh gam tulsa leh kiloisa nua luokiate leh namte lah a kipata puikhawm ganhonte leh neitah tampi nei gam lailunga tengte tungah khut hah na tum ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Sheba, Dedan leh Tarshish summet bawl mite, a humpibahnei khanglai zousieten na kungah gallah sumte tomkhawm dinga hing kuon na hiei mah? Gallah vante sana, dangka leh gantate pomang dinga, na galkapte toh hing kuon na hiei mah? a hing chi ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mihing tapa genlawhna thu gen inlen, Gog kungah Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ka mi Israelte galmuonga aten uh tua ni chieng in na theina sih diei mah?"},"15":{"text":"Mallam gamlapi a na umna mun akipat in nang leh na umpi mi tampite a bawn ua sakoltungtuong ngentang, pawl thupitah leh galkap hon toh nang kuon ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ka mi Israelte dou dingin meilum in gam a tuom khumbang in nang kuon ding uhi. Tami ni nukhialam chieng in ahi ding, nangma zieh a amitmu ua suhsiengthou a ka um hun chiengin namten Kei ahing theina dingun, Gog aw, nang ka gam dou dingin ka hing pui ding hi."},"17":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Nidanglai a ka suoh Israel guolneite, khum hun laia kum tampi sung thu na genlawhte zanga, amauh dou dingin ka hing pui ding, ka chipa khu hilou na hiei mah?","title":"Pasian thukhenna"},"18":{"text":"Israel gam dou dinga, Gog ahing kuon hun chiengin ka lungthahna ka maitang ah ahing kilang ding hi; Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka thangsietna zieh a, ka lungthahna meikuongin thu ka genta hi. Tua ni chiengin pellou in Israel gam ah zilling thupitah a um ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuipi a ngate, tunga leeng vate, gamlah a gamsate leh ganhing leitunga bohvah zousie leh leitung a teng mihing zousie, ka masang ah akithing ding uhi. Taangte paidoh ahita dinga, kawlte achimta ding ua, kulbang zousie lei ah apua ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ka taangtung teng ah Gog dou dingin namsau ka han ding a, michin in namsau in asanggampa asat ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Gog tung ah natpi leh sisansuona gawtna ka tungsah ding hi; Ama leh agalkap hon leh akipawlpi nam tampite tungah, gielpi leh mei leh kaat ka zusah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tambangin Keima leh keima ka kitawisang ding a, ka kisusiengthou ding hi, Nam tampite mitmu ah thei in ka umta ding hi. Tuachi’n amaun Kei Mangpa ka hi chi atheita ding uhi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh nang mihing tapa aw, Gog douna thu genlawh inlen, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ngai in, Meshek leh Tubal lamkai lien Gog aw, ka hing dou ahi.","title":"Gog kizawna"},"2":{"text":"Kang lengatsah dinga, ka hing pui zel ding a, mallam gam tawp apat ka hing puidoh ding a, Israel taangte tungah ka hing puitung ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n na veilam khut a pat na thalpi tawilai ka hing suhtawng pieh dinga, na khut zietlam apat na thaltangte ka kesah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel taang tungte ah na pua ding hi, nang leh na galkap honte leh na pankhawmpi namte toh; sa sielne va chinteng leh gamlah gamsa kung ah nehgam dingin ka hing pe ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Gamlah ah na pua dinga, aziehpen Keima’n ka gensa ahita hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Magog tung ah leh tuipi gei a, galmuongtah a tengte tungah mei ka sawl ding hi. Tuachi’n amaun Kei Mangpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"“Tuachi’n ka min siengthou ka mi Israelte lah ah ka theisah ding a, Ka min siengthou amauh ka subuasah kia nawn sih ding hi; tua namten Kei Mangpa Israelte Siengthoupa ka hi chi athei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Pellou a hing tung pai ding ahita, bawlzou pai ahi ding, tua khu ka gensa ni khu ahi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tuachi’n Israel khopite a tengte akuonkhe ding ua, agalvante, lumte leh phawte, thalpi leh thaltangte, chiengzumte leh teipite, kum sagi sung mei in avaang ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amauten gamlah a sing aponawn sih ding ua, gammanga sing zong asat uh ngai nawnlou ding ahi, aziehpen agalvante uh singin avang ding ua, amauh na tomgamte, ale tomgamta ding ua, avan uh na lahpiehte, a nualahpieh kia ding uh, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Tua ni chiengin Israel gam sunga, tuipi suolampanga khuolzin mite phaiguom ah Gog a ding in kivuina mun ding ka pe ding hi. Tua mun a Gog leh a mihon tampite kivui ding ahizieh in khuolzin mite lampi adal ding hi. Tuaziehin tua mun khu Hamon Gog phaijang akichi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Gam sung asuhsiengna ding un, ha sagi sung Israel innkuonten amauh avui ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi, gam sung mi zousie in, amauh avui ding ua, tamini khu ama ua dinga pahtawi a ka umna ni minthangtah ahi ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaun agam uh susieng dingin, khuolzin mite toh luong vuiloute suidoh a vui dingin mi a guoi ding uhi. Ha sagi bei nua chiengin asui pan ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Shi luong sui pawl in gam sung a tot suoh chieng ua, alah ua mi khatpou pou in mishi gu amu leh hankhuh touten Hamon Gog phaijang a tua gu avui masangsie un, gu amuna mun ah, chiemtena khat aphut ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua khopi min zong Hamonah akichi ding hi. Tambangin amaun gam sung asusieng ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"“Tualeh nang Mihing tapa Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: va namkim kungah leh gamlah a gamsa chinteng kungah thu gen inlen: Hing kikhawm unlen, hing pei un, Noute a dingin, kithoina sillat bawl ding ka hi, Israel taangte tunga kithoina thupitah ah, ning chin a kipat hing kikhawm unlen, tua mun a, sa ne a, sisan na dawn theina ding un, hing kikhawm un.","ref":"Kihil. 19.17,18"},"18":{"text":"Mihatte sa na ne ding ua, leitunga miliente sisan, belamtalte, belamnoute leh kelte, bawngtalte, Bashan gam a bawngtal vahthaute zousie, sisan na dawn ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Noute ding a kithoina sillat ka bawlna ding ah, gilvatah in sate thau nane ding ua, na kham masang sie un sisan na dawn ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Gilva tah in ka ann kuong ah, sakolte leh atungtuong mite, mihatte, tualeh galsat mite zousie sa na ne ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"21":{"text":"“Ken ka thupina, namte lah ah ka koi dinga, Nam zousieten, ka suhtangtunsa ka vaihawmnate leh ka khut hatdante amu ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Israel innkuonten, Kei Mangpa a Pasian uh ka hi chi, khum ni apat in atheiden ta ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n namdangten, Israel innkuonte akhelna zieh ua sal a puimanga um ahi uh chi athei ding uhi; aziehpen amaute kei a dingin agin um sih uhi, tuaziehin amaute apat ka mai ka phuol a, amelmate uh khut a ka piehdoh ahi; tuachi’n namsau a tha in a umta uhi."},"24":{"text":"A sienthou louna dungzui u’leh, abawsietna dungzui un atung uah ka bawlta, ama ua pat in ka mai ka phuolta hi."},"25":{"text":"“Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Tuin Jakob saltaangte ka hing nuapui kia dinga, Israel innkuon pumpi tungah lainatna ka nei ding a, Ka min siengthou ka kihuhpi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amauh gam mama a, hamuongtah a aten ua, koiman amauh asuhzau nawnlou chiengin, amuolphouna u’leh ka tunga amuonhuoi louna zousie uh amanghilta ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Namte lah apat amaute ka puikia a, amelmate uh gam apat ka khopkhawm a, nam tampite mitmu a, amau’zieh a suhsiengthou a, ka um hun chiengin;"},"28":{"text":"Kei Mangpa a Pasian uh, namte lah a sal a puimangsahpa leh amau’gam mama a nuapui kia a khat beeh zong sal a taang dinga nuasie loupa ka hi chi atheita ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh ama ua pat ka mai ka phuol ngai nawn sih ding hi, aziehpen Israel innkuonte tungah ka hagau ka sungbota hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.”"}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka saltaan uh akum sawmni leh nga na, kum kipatna ha, ni sawm achin ni, khopi siet nua kum sawm leh lina kum in, tuami ni mama in, Mangpa khut ka tung ah ahing um a, aman khunah kei ahing pui hi.","title":"Tena chieng tawi mi leh ahing um ding biehinn muna"},"2":{"text":"Pasian mengmuna in, Israel gam sungah ahing pui a, muol sangtah mai tungah ahing koi a, tuami hanglampang ah khopi umsa lim leh guong bang khat a um hi.","ref":"Kihil. 21.10"},"3":{"text":"Aman khunah ahing pui a, tualeh ngai vawi, amel kilatdan sum-eng bang mikhat ana um hi. Aman a khut ah, khaujen khat leh tena chieng khat tawi in, kotpibul ah ana ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 11.1; 21.15"},"4":{"text":"Tua mipan ka kungah, “Mihing tapa ka hing musah dingte zousie, na mit in en inlen, na bil in za inlen, na lungsim in ngaituo in; aziehpen amauh ka hing etsah theina dinga tam mun a ka hing pui ahi, na sil mute zousie Israel innkuonte kung ah phuong doh in,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ngai vawi, biehinn pulam kimkot a imsuohna bang khat a um a, tualeh tua mipan akhut ah tena chieng tong guh a sau atawi hi, tualeh tong khat leh zabeeh a sau ahi, tuachi’n aman inn vailam ate a chiengtawn khat ahi a, a saulam zong chiengtawn khat ma ahi.","title":"Huongsung pawnung lutna suolam kotpi","ref":"1 Leeng. 6.1-38; 2 Khang. 3.1-9"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama khu suolam nga kotpi ah ava pei a kalbite ah akahtou a, kotpi lutna inndan sung ateta a, chiengtawn khat a lien ahi a, tualeh inndan sung khat zong ate kia a, chiengtawn khat ma a lien ahi."},"7":{"text":"Kotpi gei a inndante saudan leh letdan chiengtawn khat tuoh tuoh ahi a, tualeh inndante kikaal tong nga chiet kihal ahi; tualeh kotpi lutna inndan sunglam innhim khu chiengtawn khat ahi."},"8":{"text":"Aman kotpi sunglam innhim zong ate a, chiengtawn kimkhat ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n kotpi innhim ate a, tong giet ahi; khuna kotpi khuomte tong ni chiet ahi; tualeh kotpi innhimte khu asung langah a um hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh suolam a kotpi inndan neute khu langkhat ah thum a um a, a langkhat dang ah thum ma a um hi, tua khuom thumte akikim chiet uhi, tualeh tamlang panga khuomte leh khumlang pang a khuomte akikim chiet uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh kotpi lutna letdan ate a, tong sawm ahi a, kotpi saudan tong sawm leh thum ahi."},"12":{"text":"Inndan neute mai ah mun awng a um a, tamlang pangah tong khat ahia, khumlang pang ah zongtong khat ma ahi, tualeh mun awngte khu alang ni in tong guh tuoh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman kotpite ate a, inndan neu inntung khat apat inntung dang khat tandong, tong sawmni leh nga, ahi, kotkha leh kotkha kisutuo in."},"14":{"text":"Aman huong sung kotpi khuomte zong ate a, tong sawmni a sang ahi a, kotpilampi huong sung pumpi khu kotpi khuomte toh kisutuo ahi."},"15":{"text":"A sung lutna kotpi mai akipat, kotpi sungnung zaw innhim mai tandong tong sawm nga ahi."},"16":{"text":"Inndan lutna kotpi pulam baang ah kotta neu a um chiet a, inndan sungnung zaw baang kikaalte azong kotta a um chiet hi, tua kotpi bieng chin ah tum sing lim a um chiet hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman kei huongsung ponung zaw ah ahing puilut a, tualeh khunah pindante leh huongsung kimkot ah keng lampite a um hi. Pindan sawm thum in tua kenglampi lang amaingat uhi.","title":"Huongsung ponung zaw"},"18":{"text":"Kelkot siih ah keng lampite a um a, tua kotpi lutna lampi saudan bang a bawl ahia, tuakhu keng lampi nuoinung zaw ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman kotpi nuoinung pen maizawn a kipat pulam a huong sungnung zaw maizawn tandong letdan ate a, suolam leh mallam ah tong zakhat ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh huongsung ponungzaw mallam nga a um, kelkot saudan zong ate a, aletdan zong ate hi."},"21":{"text":"Kelkot lutna gei a inndante, tamlangpangah thum khumlangpang ah thum a um a, akotpi khuomte leh a innhimte khu kotpi masa pen chie ahi, adung tong sawm nga, avai tong sawmni leh nga ahi."},"22":{"text":"Akottate ainnhimte leh akizepna tumsingte suolam nga kelkot lutnate toh akikim chiet uhi; kalbi sagi a kaltou ahi a, innhimte amaizawn ah a um hi."},"23":{"text":"Huong sungsungnung zaw kelkot khu mallam kelkot toh kizawn in a um a, suolam nga a um kelkot bangbang ahi, tualeh aman kelkot khat apat kelkot dang kikaal ate a, tong zakhat ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tuazou in aman simlang ah ahing zawpi a, khunah simlang nga kelkot khat a um hi; aman kotpi khuomte leh innhimte tam tena dungzuiin ate hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua kelkot lutna leh innhim in, kelkot dangte mabangin kotta akimkot in a nei a, adung lam tong sawmnga ahi a, availam tong sawmni leh nga ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tanah kaltouna ding kalbi sagi akidawtou a, tuate toh kizawn in innhimte a um hi, tualeh apang tuoh ah kelkot khuomte kizepna tumsing limte a um hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh simlang huong sung, sungnung zaw ah simlang nga kelkot khat a um a, aman simlam a kelkot leh kelkot kikaal ate a, tong zakhat ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman simlam kelkot kunga huongsung inntuol sungnung zaw ah ahing lutpi a, tualeh simlam kelkot khu atena dungzui in ate hi,","title":"Huongsung sungnungzaw"},"29":{"text":"Kelkotpi gei a inndante leh akhuomte leh a innhimte, tam tena dungzui in ate a, kelkot lutna leh a innhimte kimkot ah kottate a um a, tong sawmnga a sau leh tong sawmni leh nga a lien ahi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh akimvel a innhimte khu tong sawmni leh nga a sau ahia, tong nga a lien ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ainnhimten huongsung ponung zaw lam anga ua, tumsing lim a kizem khuomte a um a, kaltouna kalbi giet a um hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman suolam nga, huongsung sungnung zaw ah ahing lutpi a, kelkot khu atenate dungzui in ate hi."},"33":{"text":"Kotpi gei a inndante, akotpikhuomte leh a innhimte zong tam tena dungzui in ate hi; asungah leh a innhim kimkot ah, kottate a um a, tami tong sawmnga in asau a, tong sawmni leh nga in alien hi."},"34":{"text":"A innhimte khu huongsung ponung zaw lam nga ahi a, akelkot khuompite apang lang tuoh ah tumsing limte a kizem a um hi; tanah kaltouna kalbi giet a um hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman mallam kelkot ah ahing lutpi a, tam tenate dungzui in ate hi."},"36":{"text":"Kelkot gei a inndante leh akhuomte leh a innhimte, tualeh akimkot a kotta umte asaulam tong sawm nga ahi a, availam tong sawmni leh nga ahi."},"37":{"text":"A kotpi khuomten huongsung ponungzaw lam anga a, akhuomte apang tuoh a tumsing lim a kizem a um hi; tanah akaltouna kalbi giet a um hi."},"38":{"text":"Inndante leh asunga lutna ding lampi khu kelkot khuompite kungah a um hi; khunah halmang sillatte asawp zel uhi.","title":"Kithoina latna ding inndante"},"39":{"text":"Tua kelkot lutna innhim ah, apang tuoh ah dawkan ni tuoh a um a, khunah, halmang sillat, khelna sillat leh tatkhelna sillatte a ding gan akigou hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua innhim pulampanga, mallam kelkot lutna tandong ipeitou leh dawkan ni a um a, tualeh alelampang kelkot innhim ah dawkan ni aum hi."},"41":{"text":"Dawkan li tamlangpang ah a um a, dawkan li khumlangpanga kelkotpi pangah a um hi; akithoina sa thana uh dawkan giet a um hi."},"42":{"text":"Dawkan lite khu halmang sillat latna ding a suong kikheng, tongkhat leh akim a sau, tong khat leh a kim alien, tualeh tong khat a sang ahi, tuate tungah halmang sillatte leh kithoinate athana uh hiemzatte akoi uhi."},"43":{"text":"A sunglam ah zabeeh chia alien, akimvel a kikanbeh kuoika a um a, tualeh dawkante tungah sillat sate akikoi hi."},"44":{"text":"Kelkot sungnungzaw pulam ah, mallam kelkot gei a um huongsung sungnung zaw ah lasamite inndan a um a, simlam amaingat a, khat pen simlam kelkot pangah mallam nga in a um hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, Tam simlam ngat inndan khu, biehinn a na sem siempute umna ding ahi a;"},"46":{"text":"mallam nga inndan pen khu maitam a nasem siempute umna ding ahi. Tamte pen Mangpa nasem dinga, Ama kung nai a hing pei Levi tapate lah a Zadok tapate ahi uhi, achi hi."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh aman huongsung khu ate a, tong zakhat a sau, tong zakhat a lien ahi a, ning li kibang chiet anei a, tua maitam khu biehinn mai ah a um hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman biehinn innhim ah ahing zawpi a, innhim kotkhuomte ate a, tamlang pang ah tong nga, khumlang pang tong nga ahi a, tualeh kelkot lutna letdan, tamlangpangah tong thum khumlang pangah tong thum ahi."},"49":{"text":"Innhim saudan tong sawmni ahia, aletdan tong sawm leh khat ahi, tualeh aman akaltouna uh kellei ah ang zawpitou a, kotbieng khuomte kungah sutpi khat tamlangpang ah, khumlang pang ah sutpi khat a um hi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman munsiengthou ah ahing zawpi a, tualeh kotkhuomte ate a, apang langkhat tong guh in alien a, alelampang zong tong guh ma a lien ahi a, tuakhu biehinn vailam letdan ahi.","title":"Biehinn tung genchienna"},"2":{"text":"Alutna kot vailam leldan tong sawm ahia, alutna kot azietle vei a bangte khu tong nga tuoh ahi uhi. Tualeh biehinn sung ate a, adung tong sawm li ahia, avai tong sawmni ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama inndan sungnung zaw ah alut a, kotkhuomte ate a, tong ni chiet a lien ahi ua, tualeh alutna vailam tong guh ahi a, tualeh alutna gei a bangte tong sagi ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ama’n inn sung saudan ate a, adunglam tong sawm ni ahia, availam zong tong sawmni ma ahi a, biehinn laikim tellou in, tualeh aman ka kungah, “Tami munsiengthou pen ahi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman biehinn bang ate a, tong guh ahi, biehinn pang chinteng kim kot a inndante pen tong li alien chiet ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Apanga inndante khu sawng thum ahia, khat tunga khat kisuong sawn ahia, sawng khat ah inndan sawmthum chiet a um hi. Tua baangte kimkot ah apanga inndante tuhdetna aum a, apanga inndante tuhdetnate pen biehinn baang a thunlut ahi sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Biehinn kimvel a, apanga inndante khu sawngkhat tunga sawngkhat kilamtou in akimkot in alientou deudeu hi, a ziehpen biehinn baang kingapna zawlte kellei banga kikaltousah ahizieh in asang sem sem hi; atuong nuoinung pen a kipat in, atuong laita pen zawttou in asawng tungnung pen tandong akaltou hi."},"8":{"text":"Ken biehinn kimvel a a inn sandan ka mu a, apang a inndante kingatna suongphumte khu tong guh a ahi."},"9":{"text":"Apulam a apanga inndante bang sadan tong nga ahi a, tualeh amohteng khu asung lam a um apang pindan mun ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh inndante kikaal pen biehinn kimkot suohin tong sawmni a lien a kikaah ahi."},"11":{"text":"Apanga inndante kotte khu mun awng lam nga a hon ahi a, kot khat mallam nga ahia kotdang khat simlam nga a hon ahi, tualeh akimvel a mun awng khu tong nga a lien ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh tumlam a biehinn sia a mun awng mai a inn khu avai tong sawmsagi a lien ahia, adung tong sawmkuo a sau ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman biehinn khu ate a, tong zakhat a sau ahi a, biehinn-sia mun awng leh tua inn baang sadan simtel in tong zakhat ma ahi a, biehinn huongsung leituol khu tong zakhat alien ahi."},"14":{"text":"Suolampanga biehinn huongsung leituol, biehinn mailam huopin zong tong zakhat ma ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tuazou in aman biehinn nualang huongsung lam nga akilam apang tuoh a kem kidaw te pumin ate a; Biehinn laikim a mun singthoupen leh inndan sungnungzaw leh inn mai leituol pum in tong zakhat ahi."},"16":{"text":"A kotkhuomte toh, kotta hontheiloute toh akimvel a, tuong kidawsang sawng thumte khu kot tunglam tandong in, tuol apat kottate tandongin singpeh a thuop ahi a, tualeh kottate zong singpeh a thuop khum ahi."},"17":{"text":"Akot tunga mun awngte leh munsiengthoupen leh apulam baangte nangawn akimkot a, te suoh sieng ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tamte cherub lim leh tumsing limte a zep ahi a, tualeh tumsingte khu cherub leh cherub kikaal ah a um zel hi, tualeh cherub chin in mai ni anei chiet uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n mihing maitang bang in langkhat ah tumsing lang a nga a, humpibahnei khanglai maitang bangin lelampang ah tumsing lang anga hi; Biehinn kimkot in tuabangin akigiel suoh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuol apat kottung hawm tandongin, munsiengthou pulam baang tungah, cherubte limte leh tumsing limte khuohthawin akigiel hi."},"21":{"text":"Biehinn sung laikimtah a kotkhuomte ningli nei ahi a, munsiengthou mai ah zong tuabang ma a kibawl a um hi."},"22":{"text":"Sing a kibawl tong thum a sang maitam khat a um a adung tong ni asau, avai lamzong tong ni ma a lien, ataw leh apangte zong sing a kibawl ngen ahia; tualeh aman ka kungah, “Tami Mangpa mai a um dawkan khu ahi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Biehinn laikim leh munsiengthoupen in kotpi ni tuoh anei uhi."},"24":{"text":"Akotpiten kotpeh ni tuoh akibuptuo anei ua, kotpeh nite akihip thei ding in akhaina kopza abul uhi."},"25":{"text":"Biehinn laikim tunga, kotte tungah, bangte tunga khuohthaw a kigel bangin, cherub limte tumsing limte khuohthaw in akigiel hi, innpulam a innhim mai tungah singpeh nihimsun abawl uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tua innhim baang langkhat tuoh tuoh leh innpi pang pindante tung leh singpeh a kibawl nihimsunte tungah vathangkal leh tumsing limte a um hi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuazouin aman sahlam panga um huongsung ponung zaw ah ahing zawpi a, biehinn huongsung leituol zawn leh mallam pang baang ponung zawn inndante ah ahing puilut hi.","title":"Biehinn kunga Inn ni"},"2":{"text":"Mallam panga inn um khu adung tong zakhat asau, availam tong sawmnga a lien ahi."},"3":{"text":"Huong sungnung zaw mun awng tong sawmni lam ngat in leh huong ponungzaw suong kilem lam ngat in, chiel kidaw sawngthum tuoh aum hi."},"4":{"text":"Inndante mai ah asunglam zotna lampi tong sawm a sau, tong khat a lien khat a um a, a kotten mallam angat uhi."},"5":{"text":"Chiel kidawten mun aluo ziehin, Inndan tungnungte pen innsawng laita leh asawng nuoinunga inndante sang in a neu zaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen inn sawng thum a lam ahi a, huongsung pulamte nei banga khuom aneilou ziehun, inndan tungnungten, innsawng laita leh innsawng nuoinung inndante sangin mun neuzaw aluo ua akochihzaw uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh huongsung ponungzaw gei ah, tua inndante toh kizom hilhel in bang khat a um a, tong sawmnga a sau ahi."},"8":{"text":"Huongsung ponungzaw toh kizom, agei a inndan aguola kizomte tong sawmnga a sau ahi a, tualeh biehinn zula inndan pen khu tong zakhat a sau ahi."},"9":{"text":"Inndan nuoinungte suolam pang ah, huongsung ponungzaw akipat Inndan sung lutna khat a um hi."},"10":{"text":"Simlam pangah zong, mun awng zawn a, kulbaang zul a, biehinn mai ah inndante a um hi."},"11":{"text":"Inndante peina khu, mallam inndante peina bang bang ahi a, asaudan leh aletdan akibang hi; tualeh apawtdohnate leh alutnate akigeeldan dungzui a bawl ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh simlam panga um kotte dungzui in tua inndante lutna ding peisuohna tawp suolam bangzul ah kot khat a um hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, “Mun awng lam nga simlam leh mallam pindante khu, Mangpa kung lam hing zuon siemputen sillat siengthou pente aneina ding uh inndan siengthoute ahi; khunah amaun sillat siengthoupente, ann sillatte, khelna sillatte leh bawsietna sillatte, akoi ding uhi, mun siengthou ahizieh in."},"14":{"text":"Siempute tam sunga alut chieng un mun siengthou apat huongsung ponungzaw ah apeidoh sih ding ua, hinanleh khunah anasepna puonte uh anuasie ding uhi; aziehpen tuate asiengthou ahi uhi. Amaun puondang asil ding ua, mipite lah ah a pei thei ding uhi.”"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman biehinn sungnungzaw atezou in suolam ngat kotpi ah ahing pawtkhietpi a, akimvel in ate hi."},"16":{"text":"Aman suolampang tena chiengin ate a, tena chienga te in tong zanga ahi."},"17":{"text":"Mallampang ate a, akimvel a tena chienga te in, tong zanga ahi."},"18":{"text":"Simlampang ate a, akimvel in tena chienga tein, tong zanga ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tumlampang kimvel in akihei a, tena chiengin tong zanga ate hi."},"20":{"text":"Aman aning li in ate a, akimvel ah baang tong zanga a sau, tong zanga a lien, mun sieng leh sienglou munte kikaal ah kikhenna bang aum hi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuazou in aman suolam nga kotpi langah ahing zawpi hi.","title":"Mangpa thupina biehinn sung aluodimna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh ngai vawi, Israel thupina khu suolam apat in ahing pei hi. Tualeh a aw khu tuitampi ging abanga, leitung athupina in ataanvah hi.","ref":"Ezek. 10.3,4,18,19; 11.22,23; Kihil. 1.15"},"3":{"text":"Tami khopi suse ding a ka hing pei lai a ka mengmu leh kebar luipi gei a ka mengmu bang ahi a, tualeh kei khu khupboh in ka puata hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa thupina khu suolam kotpi tawn in biehinn sungah ahing lut hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n hagau in ahing domtou a, huong sungnungzaw ah ahing puilut a, tualeh ngai vawi, Mangpa thupina in biehinn aluodimta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi khat ka kunga adin laitah in aman biehinn apat kei ahing houpi ka za hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh aman ka kungah, “Mihing tapa, tami ka mangtoupha umna mun leh ka kengtongatna mun, Israel tate lah a kumtawn a ka tenna ding mun leh ka min siengthou khu Israel innkuonte’n amauh hiin, a leengpate uh hitaleh, akizuana uh ahiei leh, a mun sangte ua, a leengte uh luong in abuasah ngai nawn sih ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"A innhimte uh ka innhim toh kizom in abawl ua, akotbiengte uh ka kotbieng toh kizomin a bawl in, kei leh amauh kikaal ah baang khat maimai in ahing hal sah ua, asil kidahhuoi bawlte un ka min siengthou asubuata uhi, tuaziehin ka lungthahna in amauh ka sumangta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuin akizuanate u’leh aleengte uh luongte keima akipat gamlapi ah koimang uhen, tuachi’n alah uah kumtawn in ka teng denta ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Mihing tapa Nang akhelnate uh azumpi theina ding un, biehinn thu Israel innkuonte kungah gen inlen, akibawldan zong te uheh."},"11":{"text":"A sil bawlsate zousie uh azumpi ua ahileh, biehinn kigelkhieh dante, akilep dante, apawtdohnate leh alutnate leh alim amel kigeldan zousie leh a kizat ding dan, dante leh thupiehdangte zousie toh amaute theisah in. Akigelkhieh dante, thei a, akizat ding dan, dante zousie muonhuoitah a azui theina ding un amaute mitmu ah giel in."},"12":{"text":"Tami biehinn toh kisai a dan ahi: Muolvum tung jang kimvel mun zousie asiengthou pen ahi ding hi. Tami biehinn toh kisai a dan ahi."},"13":{"text":"“Tami tonga te a maitam let dan ahi (tong khat chipen tongkhat leh zabeeh a sau ahi) akingahna tong khat a sang ahia, tongkhat a lien ahi, tualeh agei guol khap khat peisuoh a pawng ahi; tami maitam sandan ahi.","title":"Halmang latna maitam","ref":"Pawt. 27.1,2; 2 Khang. 4.1"},"14":{"text":"Tua maitam tuoltunga akingaatna apat dawdan nuoinungzaw tandong tong ni a sang, tong khat a lien ahi, dawdan neuzaw apat dawdan lienzaw tan tong li ahia, aletdan tongkhat ahi."},"15":{"text":"Maitam taptung khu tong li a sang ahi a, maitam taptung apat kii li adawhtou hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh maitam taptung khu tong sawm leh ni a sau, tong sawm leh ni a lien, adung avai kibang ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tua dawdan khu tong sawm leh li asau, tong sawm leh li a lien, adung avai kikim ahi; tualeh agei guol tong kimkhat in a pawng hi, tualeh akingaatna khu akimvel in tong khat ahi a, tualeh maitam kalbiten suolam a ngat uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh aman ka kungah, “Mihing tapa, Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Tamte khu maitam kidawzou chienga, halmang sillatte latna ding leh atunga sisan thena ding toh kisai a maitam zah ding dante ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 29.35-37"},"19":{"text":"Nangman Zadok hahlesuon, Levimite ka nna hing seppieh dinga ka kung hing zuonte kung ah khelna sillat ding in, bawngtal tuoi khat na pe ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Asisan themkhat nala dinga, maitam kii lite leh dawdan ninglite, tualeh ageiguol tungah na taat ding hi, tambangin maitam na susieng dinga, na siengsah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Khelna thoina dingin tua bawngtal tuoi na la dinga, munsiengthou pulam a, biehinn huong sung tuami ding a kiguotna mun ah na haltum ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ani ni niin, genbanglou keltal khat, khelna sillat in na lan ding a, bawngtal tuoi a asiensuo bang un, maitam asiensuo ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuami na siensuo zou chiengin, genbanglou bawngtal tuoi khat leh belamhon lah a belamtal khat tuoh na lat ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tuate Mangpa mai ah na lan ding a, siemputen atung uah chi abuoh ding ua, tuachi’n Mangpa kungah halmang sillat dingin alan ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ni sagi sung nichin in khelna sillat dingin, keltal khat mansa in na koi dinga, genbanglou bawngtal tuoi khat leh belamhon lah a belamtal khat zong mansa in na koi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ni sagi sung maitam asiensuo ding ua, asusieng ding uhi; tualeh ama u’zong akisusiengthou ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tam nite abei chiengin, ani giet ni apat in, siemputen na halmang sillatte u’leh na lemna sillatte uh, maitam ah alan ding ua, tuachi’n ka hing pomtheita ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in chi hi,” achi hi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman suolam ngat munsiengthou kotpi ponung zaw ah ahing nuazawpi kia a, hinanleh tua kotpi ana kikha hi.","title":"Biehinn a siempute nasep"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Tam kotpi akikha dinga, akihong sih ding hi, tami kotpi ah koima alut sih ding hi, Mangpa Israel Pasian lutna ahizieh in, akikha den ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Leengtapa ahileh, leeng tapa ahiziehin asungah ann ne ding in Mangpa maiah atou ding hi; tua kotpi innhim lampi ah alut ding a, tuami lampi mama ah apawtdoh ding hi.”"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman biehinn mai a mallam kotpi tawn in ahing zawpi a, tualeh ka en a, ngai vawi, Mangpa thupina in Mangpa inn aluodim a, kei pen bohkhupin ka puata hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Mihing tapa chiemte hoi inlen, na mit in en inlen, tualeh Mangpa biehinn toh kisai a zahdan ding zousie leh, adanthute zousie tungtanga, ka gen zousie na bil in ngaikhie inlen, biehinn sung lutna leh munsiengthou a pawtdohna zousie melchi in."},"6":{"text":"Tuin ahelhat Israel innkuonte kungah, Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Aw nou Israel innkuonte na silkidahhuoi bawlte uh hunsah ta un."},"7":{"text":"Ka mun siengthou sungah gamdang mite, lungtang teptanloute leh tahsa a teptanloute na puilut ua, ann leh sathau leh sisan na lat sung un ka biehinn na buasah uh a, ka thuhun na palsan uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh ka silsiengthoute na kemsih ua, hinanleh midangte ka munsiengthou kem ding in na koizawta uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Lungtang teptanlou leh tahsa a teptanlou gamdang mi mawngmawng Israelte lah a teng gamdang mi nangawn ka mun siengthou a alutlou ding uh ahi.","title":"Nualam chienga biehinn a siempu dingte"},"10":{"text":"Israelte alampielmang lai ua, gamlapi a hing taisan a, amilimte uh nua del a kei hing pielmangsan Levi miten akhelna maw uh akipuoh ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh biehinn kotpite vengin leh biehinn a nasem in, ka munsiengthou sungah nna asem ding ua; halmang sillatte leh mipi kithoina gantate athat ding ua, amaute naseppieh in amai uah ading ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amaun amilimte uh masang ah ana aseppieh ziehun, Israel innkuonte khelna ah apuasah uhi; tuaziehin atung ua banzahin ka kichiemta hi, tualeh akhelna maw uh akipuoh ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh amaute khu ka kung nai a siempu nasem ding ahiei, ahisihleh munsiengthoupen a ka sil siengthoute kungnai a ahing pei ding uh ahisih hi, hinanleh azumna u’leh asilkidah huoi bawlte uh akipuoh ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ahivang in amaute biehinn kepna a mawpo ding leh asunga sep leh bawl ding zousie mawpo dingin ka guong ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Hinanleh Israel taten ahing pielmangsan lai ua, ka munsiengthou a nasem Levi mi, siempu Zadok tapaten ka nasem dingin ka kungah ahing nai ding ua, ka kunga sathau leh sisante lan dingin ka masangah ading ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute ka munsiengthou ah alut ding ua, ka nasem dingin ka dawkan ahing nai ding ua, ka nasem in a um ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh huong sungnung zaw kotpi a alut chieng un puonmalngat asil ding ua, huong sungnungzaw kotpi sung leh innsung lam a anasep sung un atung uah samul puon mawngmawng akibat sih ding hi.","ref":"Pawt. 28.39-43; Siempu. 16.4"},"18":{"text":"Puonmalngat diel alutang uah akhip ding ua, puonmalngat puonsungsilte ateng ding uhi, khosa pawtsah thei puon mawngmawng asil ding uh ahisih hi."},"19":{"text":"Huongsung ponungzaw a mipite umna a ahing pawtdoh ding chieng un, anasepna puonte uh asutkhe ding ua mun siengthou inndan sungah akoi ding ua, puonsil dang asil ding uh ahi, tuachia amaun mipite apuonsil pum un asusiengthou sih ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 16.23"},"20":{"text":"Alutang uh aheukieu ding uh ahisih a, asam uh zong akhoisau ding uh ahi sih, asam uh hoitah a apawnam ding uh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 21.5"},"21":{"text":"Huong sungnungzaw a alut chiengun, siempu koima in zu adawn vawt lou ding ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 10.9"},"22":{"text":"Meithai ahiei khulsa numei ahiei, zi ding a akitenpi vawtlou ding uh ahi, hinanleh Israel innkuonte hahlesuonte nungah siengthou ahisihleh siempute zi na hisa meithaite akitenpi thei ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 21.7,13,14"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh amaun ka mite asieng leh abua kibatlouna ahilchien ding uhi, tualeh asienglou leh asieng khensiemna azilsah ding uh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 10.10"},"24":{"text":"Thubuoi zousie ah siempute thukhen in apang ding ua, ka danthupiehte dungzuiin thu akhen ding uh ahi; tualeh ka guot tuom pawi bawl ni chiengin ka danthupiehte leh ka danguotte azui ding ua, ka khawlnite atang siengthou ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ama uleh amauh kisubua dingin mishi luong kunga ahing peilou ding uh ahi, hinanleh, apa ahiei, anu ahiei, atapa ahiei, atanu ahiei, asanggampa ahiei, pasal neilou asanggamnu ahiei ahileh akisubua thei ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 21.1-4"},"26":{"text":"Akisiensuo zou chiengin ni sagi zia atang nalai ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh munsiengthou huong sungnungzaw a munsiengthou a thunasem ding a alut ni chieng in, ama a dingin khelna sillat alan ding hi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"28":{"text":"“Tami ama ua dingin agoutan uh ahi dinga, keima agoutan uh ka hi; Israelte lah ah tanvou bangma na pesih ding uhi, kei amauh tanvou ka hi.","ref":"Kisim. 18.20"},"29":{"text":"Amauten ann sillatte, khelna sillatte leh bawsietna sillatte ane ding ua, Israel gam a sillat chinteng amauh tan ding ahi.","ref":"Kisim. 18.8-19"},"30":{"text":"Ga masa zousie lah a ahoipente, na sillat chinteng lah ua hoipente leh na kithoina chinteng uh siempute ading ahi ding hi. Na inn sung ua guolzawlna a umden theina dingin, na anntha huon masah pente uh siempu kungah na pe ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Siemputen apul ahiei ahisihleh shingaina lou a shi va hiin ganta hitaleh gamsa in athasate mawngmawng aneh vawtlou ding uh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 22.8"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tuaban ah goutan dinga aisan a gam na hawm chiengun, Mangpa a dingin gam adung saudan tong tul sawmni leh nga, availam letdan tul sawmni, mun khat na pe ding ua, tami gamsung pumpi ah asiengthou ahi ding hi.","title":"Gam hawmna"},"2":{"text":"Tami lah apat in munsiengthou a dingin adunglam tong zanga, availam tong zanga ma, ningli kikim munsiengthou a, ding ahi ding ahi. Tualeh akimvela te a, tong sawmnga a lien mun awnga koi ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tua gam khenkhieh kitedoh lah apat adung tong tul sawmni leh tul nga leh avai tong tul sawm alien na tedoh ding a, tam sungah mun siengthou leh mun siengthoupen a um ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tam gam guot siengthou mun khu Mangpa kunga thu nasem ding a hing pei, mun siengthou a nasem siempute a ding ahi ding a; a inn mun ding u’leh biehinn dinga a mun siengthou ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua gam tong tul sawmni leh tul nga a sau leh tong sawm a lien khu biehinn sung thunasem siemputen atenna ding un akitan ding ua, khunah inndan sawmni amaun akinei ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"“Gam siengthou dinga kiguot tuom zul ah khopi tanvou ding mun avai tong tul nga a lien adung tong tul sawmni leh nga a sau na guot ding uh ahi; tami Israel innkuon pumpi ading ahi, ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Leng tapate gam dingin, gam siengthou latsa ding a kiguotdoh siih tuoh a kigi gam leh tua khopi gam toh kigi atang ding hi, tuakhu tumlampang leh suolampang ah akihung suh ding a, tumlam apan suolam leh anam anam a gam tan khat toh kizom hilhel in a um ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tami Israel gam sung ah ama goutan ahi dinga, ka leeng tapaten ka mite asugenthei nawn sih ding uhi, tualeh gam um nalai teng Israel innkuonte kungah anam anam dungzui in a pe ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ahunta hi! Aw Israel leeng tapate, na hiemngamna u’leh na minuoisiete tawpsanta unlen, thudih leh dihtatna toh vaihawmna bawl unlen, ka mite na deldoh u’pen tawpsanta un, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tena dih leh buhna dih, ephah dih leh bath dih na zah ding uh ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.36"},"11":{"text":"Ephah leh bath khu tena kibang ahi ding a, bath khat khu homer se sawmsuo sekhat dawl ahi dinga, ephah zong homer se sawmsuo sekhat ahi ding a, Homer pen atena dih etna ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Shekel khat ahileh gerah sawmni ahi dinga, shekel nga khu shekel nga na ahi ding a, shekel sawmni leh nga leh shekel sawm leh nga khu nou a dingin mina khat ahi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Tam sillat, na lat ding uh ahi; mangbu homer khat lah a kipat ephah seguh suo sekhat, buman homer khat lah akipat ephah seguh suo sekhat ma na pe ding uhi.","title":"Silpiehte leh ni siengthoute"},"14":{"text":"Sathau bath a te a lat ding dan khu, kor khat apat bath se sawm suo sekhat na lan ding uhi. Kor kichipen homer mabangin bath sawm dawl ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Israelte gantatna loudawng hoina mun akipat belamhon lah a zani lah ah belamnou khat pieh ding ahi. Tam pen ann sillat, ding leh halmang sillat ding leh lemna sillat ding, tualeh amaute ding a kilemna bawlna ding a alat ding uh ahi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Gam sunga mi zousiein, Israel leengtapa a dingin tam sillat ape ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n, pawite, hathate leh khawlnite ah, tualeh Israel innkuonte pawi ni poimawte zousie ah, halmang sillatte, ann sillatte leh dawn sillatte pieh khu leengtapa ngaituo ding ahi ding hi. Aman Israel innkuonte ading a kilemna, bawlna dingin, khelna sillat, ann sillat leh halmang sillatte leh lemna sillatte asihpieh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Ha khatna tuami ha, ni khat niin, bawngtal tuoi genbanglou khat na la ding a, munsiengthou na siensuo ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Siempuin khelna sillat sisan ala ding a, biehinn khuomte tungah leh maitam dawdan ning lite tung ah leh huong sungnungzaw kotpi khuomte tungah ataat ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh tuami ha, ani sagi ni chiengin zong atheilou zieh u’leh atheisiemlou zieh ua khelna bawlkha pouma a dingin, tuabang main na bawl ding a, tuachi’n biehinn a dingin siensuona na bawl ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Aha khatna tuami ha, ani sawm leh li ni in, peikan pawi ni sagi sung na nei ding ua, tolsawlou tanghou na ne ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-20; Kisim. 28.16-25"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh khum ni chiengin leeng tapa in ama a ding leh gamsung mite zousie a dingin, khelna sillat dingin bawngtal khat atuoh ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ni sagi pawi kibawl sung, nichin in ni sagi sung, bawngtal sagi, belamtal sagi leh khelna sillat ding keltal khat, genbanglou ngen Mangpa kunga halmang sillat dingin ni sagi sung atuoh ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ann sillat adingin bawngtal khat zel ah tangbuongnel ephah khat, belamtat khat zel a ding in tangbuong nel ephah khat, tualeh tangbuong nel ephah khat zel a dingin sathau hin khat atuoh ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Aha sagina, khumi ha ani sawm leh nga ni in, khelna sillat, halmang sillat, ann sillat leh sathau lat dungzui in, tuabangin ni sagi pawi bawl sungtengin atuoh ding hi.","ref":"Siempu. 23.33-36; Kisim. 29.12-38"}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: Nesep hun ni guh sung suolam nga huong sungnung zaw kotpi akikha dinga, ahivangin khawlni in akihong ding a, tualeh ha tha niin zong akihong ding hi.","title":"Lengtapa leh pawite"},"2":{"text":"Lengtapa khu pulam apat in tua kotpi innhim ah alut ding a, kotpi khuom kungah ading ding hi. Siemputen a halmang sillat ding leh alemna sillatte alan ding uhi. Aman kotpi lutna innhim ah Pasian abe ding hi. Tua zou chiengin apawtdoh ding a, hinanleh kotpi khu nitah dongin akikha sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuamabangin agam mipiten zong khawlnite leh ha tha nite in tam kotpi lutna ah, Mangpa mai ah Pasian abe ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Khawl nia leengtapa in Mangpa kunga alat ding halmang sillat khu genbanglou belamnou guh leh genbanglou belamtal khat ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh ann sillat ding, belamtal khat a dingin ephah khat, belamnoute adingin apieh zou zaza; tualeh ephah khat ah sathau hin khat ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ha tha ni in genbanglou bawngtal tuoi khat leh belamnou guh leh belamtal khat ahi ding a, genbanglou ngen ahi ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Aman ann sillat in, ephah khat bawngtal khat a ding in, ephah khat belamtal khat a dingin, tualeh belamnoute a dingin apieh zou zaza, ephah khat zel ah sathau hin khat atuoh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Lengtapa alut chiengin kotpi innhim tawn in alut ding a, tualang ma ah apawtdoh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Hinanleh agam mipite pawi siengthou hun chienga Mangpa mai a ahing pei chiengun, Pasian be ding a mallam kotpi a lut pouma, simlam kotpi ah apawtdoh ding ua, tualeh simlam kotpi a lut pouma mallam kotpi ah apawtdoh ding uhi, ahing lutna kotpi ah ahing kinuale sih ding ua, hinanleh alelam kotpi ah apawtdoh ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Leng tapa khu alah uah aum dinga, amaute alut chieng un alut dinga, amaute apawtdoh chieng un, apawtdoh ding hi."},"11":{"text":"“Nop bawlna leh hunbinei a pawi bawl nite a, ann sillat adingin, bawngtal khat ah ephah khat, belamtal khat ah ephah khat, belamnoute a dingin apieh zou zaza, tualeh ephah khat ah sathau hin khat ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh leengtapa in ama ut thu a halmang sillat alat ahiei, lemna sillat ahiei, Mangpa kunga alat nuom chiengin, suolam nga kotpi akihon pieh dinga, khawlni a abawl bangin ahalmang sillat leh, alemna sillatte alan dinga, tuazou chiengin apawtdoh dinga, apawtdoh zou chiengin kotpi akikha ding hi."},"13":{"text":"“Nichin a Mangpa kunga halmang sillat dingin belamnou kumkhat a upa genbanglou khat na zang ding a, zingmawng chin a na bawl ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh zingmawng chin in ann sillat ding in, ephah seguh suo sekhat leh tangbuong nomsah dingin sathau hin khat sethum suo sekhat na bawl dinga, tami ann sillat Mangpa mai a kitatloua bawl den ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tambangin, amaun, halmang sillat tanlou a, zingmawng chin a, lat dingin belamnou leh ann sillat leh sathau angaituo ding uh ahi."},"16":{"text":"“Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: Lengtapa in, a tapate lah a koipen ahiei kunga agoute silpieh a apieh leh tua agou khu atapate a, ahi ding hi; tuakhu agouluo uh ahi mai ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh asuohte lah a khat kungah agou themkhat silpieh a pieh leh salpawtkhietna kum tandong ama a ahi ding a, tuami nua chiengin leeng tapa kungah anuapieh kia ding hi. Hinanleh agou khu atapate a ahi dinga.","ref":"Siempu. 25.10"},"18":{"text":"Tuaban ah leeng tapa in amite neilelam apawng lahpieh ding ahisih a, a inn leh lou uapat anawdoh lou ding ahi; ama neilelam apat a atapate goutan apieh ding ahi, tuachi’n ka mite khat zong ainn alou ua pat akithethang sih ding uhi.”"},"19":{"text":"Tuazou in aman mallam nga siempute inndan siengthou lutna kotpi gei a um lampi zui in ahing zawpi hi, tualeh khuna, tumlam pang mong tawp ah mun khat ka mu hi.","title":"Sillatte huonna mun"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, “Tam mun khu siemputen bawsietna sillat leh khelna sillat sa ahuonna ding mun uh ahia, tualeh ann sillat akanna ding mun uh ahi; tuachia mite suhsiengthouna ding a, huongsung ponungzaw a, atawidoh louna ding un,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuazou in aman huongsung ponungzaw ah ahing puidoh a; huongsung ning lite zuul ah ahing peisah a, tualeh ngai in, huongsung ning chin ah huong dang khat a um hi."},"22":{"text":"Huongsung ning li ah, huongsung ki-im, tong sawmli a sau, tong sawmthum alien, a ning lite khu akikim chiet uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua huongsung ning lite kimkot ah suong inn aguol in akilem hi, tua suong guol kilemte nuoi ah ann huonna ding tapjang akibawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n ka kungah; “Biehinn a nasemten mipite kithoina sillatte a huonna ding uh annhuonbuh tamte ahi,” achi hi."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman biehinn lutna kotlam ah ahing nuapui kia a, Ngai vawi biehinn kotpi bul nuoi apat suolam manaw in tui ahing luongkhie a, biehinn khu suolam nga ahi a, tualeh tui khu biehinn zietlam pang nuoi a pat in, maitam simlam pangah ahing luong suh hi.","title":"Biehinn apat luipi","ref":"Zek. 14.8; Jn. 7.38; Kihil. 22.1"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman mallam kotpi lampi zui in ahing puidoh a, akimkot a pei in, suolam nga kelkot ponungzaw tandong ahing zawpi a, ngai in, azietlam pangah, tui aluong khie hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akhut a tena khau tawikawm in suolam manaw in apeidoh a, apei kawmin tong tul khat atedoh a, tualeh tui palkai in ahing zawpi a, tui khu ka siehmit tan agei hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman tong tul khat ate kia nalai a, tui palkai in ahing zawpi kia a, tui khu khup tan gei ahi; tualeh tong tul khat ate kia a, ahing palkaipi kia a, tui khu kawng tan gei ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aman tong tul khat atedoh kia a; ka palkai zou guollou luipi ana hita hi; aziehpen tui khu athuhta a, azap a zaplou a, palgalkai zou ding guol ana hita sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman ka kungah, “Mihing tapa tami na mu ei?” ahing chi hi. Tuachi’n ahing zawpi a lui gei ah ahing nua tut kiata hi."},"7":{"text":"Khuna ka hing tun kia tahin, tua lui gei lelam tuoh ah singkung tampi ana um hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, “Tam luite khu suolam gam manaw a luong ahi ua, phaijang ah aluong suh ua, tuipi ah a luonglut uhi; tuipi ah aluonglut ding ua, atuite a sudam ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua luitui luon khahna pouma ah, ganhing pia thei chintengin ahin lawding ua, Tam tuite khuna aluonlut zieh un, nga atam atam ahing um ding a, tui asientah zieh in, luitui luonna pouma ah sil chinteng ahingta ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hiding a, Engedi apat En-eglaim tandong in ngaman mite atung uah ading ding ua, len phouna mun ahita ding hi; angate uh tuipi lien a ngate bang in, nga chituom tuom atama tam a hiding hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh buonnaang munte leh tuiveina mun a tuite asieng sih dinga, chikhuh dinga nuasie ahi ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua luigei ah, luigei lang ni tuoh ah, anate vul ngailou ding, agate pul ngailou ding, aga neh ding theikung chi tuom tuom apou ding hi. Munsiengthou apat luongkhie tuite ahizieh in, ha chin in ga tha asuongdoh ding a, tualeh agate khu ann ahi dinga, anate damna ahi ding hi.”","ref":"Kihil. 22.2"},"13":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “Tami Israel nam sawm leh nite lah a, agoutan ding ua, gam hawm dan ding ahi: Joseph in tan ni atang ding hi.","title":"Gam gite"},"14":{"text":"Amaute lah ah akikim chiet in gam na hawm pieh ding ahi; na pu na pate u’kunga pieh ding a banzah a kana kichiemna gam ahi a, tam gam na goutan gam uh ahi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tami gam pumpi gamgi ahi ding hi: Mallam pang ah: tuipi lien apat in Heth-lon lampi zuiin Labo-Hamath paltan in, Zedad tandong in,"},"16":{"text":"Hamath, Berothah, Damaska gamgi leh Hamath gamgi kikaal a um Sebraim leh Hauran gamgi zula um Hazar-Hattikon tandong in,"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamgi khu Tuipi akipat in apei dinga, Damaska gamgi Hazar-enon tandong ahi ding hi; tam pen mallam pang gamgi ahi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"“Tualeh suolam pang ah Hauran leh Damaska kikaal ah gamgi apei ding a, Gilead leh Israel gamgi kikaal a Jordan lui zui in Tamar dong in suolam tuipi tandong ahi ding hi, Tami suolam pang gamgi ahi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"“Tualeh Simlam pang gamgi pen, Tamar apat in Meribah Kadesh tuite tandong in apei dinga, khuna kipat in Izipt luipi a zui dinga tuipi ah alut ding hi, Tami simlam pang gamgi ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Tumlam pang ah Lebo-Hamath gal a Tuipilien tandong gamgi ahi ding hi. Tambangin tumlam pang gamgi apei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Tuachi’n tam gam khu Israelte nam dungzui in na kihawm ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Noute leh na lah ua teng talenau nei gamdang mite tan dingin ai san a na hawm ding uh ahi. Tua gamdang mite khu gamsunga pieng Israel tate mabanga na ngai ding uh ahi. Israel namte lah ah noute mabangin goutan na got ding uh ahi."},"23":{"text":"Tua gamdang mi koi nam lah ah tengta nan u’leh zong, agoutan ding uh na pieh teitei ding uh ahi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tuin tamte anamte uh minte ahi: Mallam pang gamgi akipat in Hethlon lampi zuiin, Lebo-Hamath apat in Hazar-Enon tandong (tua khu mallam a Damaska leh Hamath gamgi ahi) ahi ding; tamte khu suolam leh tumlam pang ah, Dan tanvou ahi ding hi.","title":"Israel namte lah a gam kihawmna"},"2":{"text":"Asher in gam tan khat atang dinga, suolam apat tumlam dongin, Dan toh akigamgi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Naphtali in gam tankhat atang ding a, suolam apat tumlam dongin, Asher toh akigamgi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Manaseh in gam tankhat atang ding a, suolam apat tumlam dong in, Naphtali toh akigamgi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ephraim in gam tankhat atang dinga, suolam apat tumlam dong in, Manasseh toh akigamgi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Reuben in gam tankhat atang ding a, suolam apat tumlam dongin Ephraim toh akigamgi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Juda in gam tan khat atang ding a, suolam apat tumlam dongin Reuben gam toh akigamgi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Suolam apat tumlam donga Juda gam toh kigamgi, atuoma silpieh a na lat ding uh gam khu availam tong tul sawmni leh nga ahi dinga, adunglam suolam pang a pat tumlam pang dongin, tanvou dangte gam tan chie chie ahi ding hi. Tua gam laikimtah ah munsiengthou a um ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Gam guottuom silpieh a na lat ding u’khu adunglam tong tul sawmni leh tul nga availam tong tul sawm ahi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh siempute a ding a gam lat siengthou ahileh tamte ahi ding: mallam ah adung tul sawmni leh tul nga, tumlam ah avai tong tul sawm, suolam ah avai tong tul sawm, tualeh simlam ah adung tong tul sawmni leh tul nga ahi ding a, alaikimtah ah Mangpa munsiengthou a um ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tami Israel tate apielmang lai ua, Levi mite pielmang banga pielmanglou ka thu kem mi Zadok tate lah a suhsiengthou a um siempute a ding ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua gam guot tuom siengthou apat a amaute a ding a kilan tuom mawngmawng ahi dinga goutan siengthoupen ahi ding hi Levite gam toh kigi ahi ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Siempute gamgi zawnah Levimiten gam adunglam tong tul sawmni leh tul nga, availam tong tul sawm anei ding uh ahi, adung saudan atawnsuoh in tong tul sawmni leh tul nga, avai lam tong tul sawm ahi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Siemputen tam gam azua ding uh ahi sih a, sil toh zong akihenpi ding uh ahisih hi; agam hoina munte zong midang kunga apieh vawtlou ding uh ahi, aziehpen Mangpa a dinga siengthou ahi."},"15":{"text":"“Tualeh availam tong tul nga leh adung lam tong tul sawmni leh tul nga um nalai teng, khopi in zahna tangpi a azah ding, tenna inn lamna ding leh gantatna mun ding, ahi ding hi. Tua gam laikim tah ah khopi a um ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Akitedan tambang ahi ding hi: Mallam pang tong tul li leh zanga, simlam pang tong tul li leh za nga, suolam pang tong tul li leh zanga, tualeh tumlam pang tong tul li leh zanga."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh khopi a dinga gam awng, mallam pang ah tong zanileh sawmnga, simlam pangah tong zani leh sawmnga, suolam pangah tong zani leh sawmnga, tualeh tumlam pang ah tong zani leh sawm nga ahi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Gam val umnalai teng, gam guottuom kilansa teng toh, adunglam a kigi, suolam pang ah tong tul sawm, tumlam ah tong tul sawm, ahi ding hi. Gam lat siengthousa kimvel zul ahi ding hi, tualeh asunga ga piengte khu khopi a nasem mite neh ding ahi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Khopi a nasemmi Israel nam zousie apat a miten agam louin ahou ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tua gam let dan apumpi in adung tong tul sawmni leh tul nga, availam tong tul sawmni leh tul nga ahi dinga, gam guot tuom lat siengthou ning li nei khu, khopi gam tan toh na lat ding uh ahi."},"21":{"text":"“Gam guottuom siengthou akilan gam pang tuoh a, gam umnalai teng leh khopi gam neiteng leengtapa ading ahi. Gam siengthou tong tul sawmni leh tul nga ban a kipat suolam gamgi tan, tumlam pang tong tul sawmni leh tul nga, ban ah gam guottuom dangte zulzul khu leeng tapa a ahi dinga, tua khu gam lat siengthou ahi ding a, alaikim tah ah biehinn munsiengthou a um ding hi.","title":"Leng tapa tanvou ding"},"22":{"text":"Tuaban ah Levite gam tan leh khopi gam tan leengtapa tante kikaal ah a um ding a; Juda gamgi leh Benjamin gamgi kikaal khu leeng tapa tan ding ahi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"“Nam um nalai dangte ahileh suolam apat tumlam dongin, Benjamin gam tan khat chie atang ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Benjamin gam tan toh kigamgi in Simeon in gam tan khat atang ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Simeon gamgi zul ah suolam apat tumlam dongin Issakar in gam tan khat atang ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Issakar gamgi zul ah, suolam apat tumlam dongin Zebulun in gam tan khat atang ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Zebulun gamgi zul ah, suolam apat tumlam dongin Gad in gam tan khat atang ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Gad gamgi zul ah, simlam pang ah, simlam manaw in gamgi, Tamar a kipat in Kadesh-Meribah tuite leh tuipi Lien lam a luineute tan ahi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tami Israel namte kunga, agouluo ding ua ai san a na hawm ding uh gam khu ahi a, tualeh tamte khu agam tan dingdan uh ahi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"30":{"text":"“Tamte khu mallam panga khopi pawtdohnate ahi, tena tul li leh zanga ahi.","title":"Khopi kotpite","ref":"Kihil. 21.12,13"},"31":{"text":"Khopi kotpite khu Israel namte min dungzui a phuo ahi. Mallam ah kotpi thum: Reuben kotpi khat, Juda kotpi khat, Levi kotpi khat."},"32":{"text":"Suolam pang ah tena tul li leh zanga, kotpi thum: Joseph kotpi khat, Benjamin kotpi khat, Dan kotpi khat."},"33":{"text":"Simlam pang ah tena tong tul li leh zanga, tualeh Kotpi thum: Simeon kotpi khat, Issakar kotpi khat Zebulun kotpi khat."},"34":{"text":"Tumlam pang ah tong tul li leh za nga, akotpi thumte: Gad kotpi khat, Asher kotpi khat leh Naphtali kotpi khat."},"35":{"text":"A kimkot a te a asau dan tong tul sawm leh tul giet ahi ding a, tua ni akipat khum khopi min khu, MANGPA KHUNAH AUM HI, chi ahita ding hi.”"}}}}},"27":{"info":{"name":"Daniel","shortname":"Dan.","abbr":[],"desc":"Daniel laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Jehoiakim vaihawm kum, akum thumna ah Babilon leengpa Nebukadnezzar ahing kuon a Jerusalem ahing sim hi.","title":"Leengpa Nebukadnezzar inn ah Daniel","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.1; 2 Khang. 36.5-7"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n Juda leengpa Jehoiakim leh Pasian inn sunga um leh bel phabep khat Nebukadnezzar khut ah apeta hi; Ama’n tam vante shinar gam a a pasien inn ah apeipi a, apasien gou kholna inn ah akoita hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 20.17,18; 24.10-16; 2 Khang. 36.10; Isai. 39.7,8"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Nebukadnezzar in a michilgete lamkaipa Ashpenaz kungah Israel tate lah a, leengpa hahlesuonte leh miliente hahlesuonte pawl khat akunga hing zawpi ding in thu apie hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua mite pen, tangval asatunga melhemna umlou, melhoitah, pilna leh theina leh siemna lam a kizen tualeh theisiemna lam sil thei bai, leengpa innpi sunga na sem dinga ching, amaute pen Kaldai mite ham leh siemna ahil thei ding uh mite ahi ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Lengpa’n ama ann nehna annkuong a leengpa ann neh tui pen pente leh dawn ding guotsa diem in akoi hi. Kum thum sung tuabanga azil ding uh, tuazou chienga, leengpa nna asep ding uh, chi ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tua tangvalte lah ah Juda tate: Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael leh Azariah atel uhi."},"7":{"text":"Akung uah michilge lamkai pan, amaute min ding uh aphuo pieh a: Daniel min dingin Belshazzar, Hananiah min dingin Shadrak, Mishael min dingin Meshak, tualeh Azariah min dingin Abed-Nego, aphuo hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Daniel in leengpa ann neh ahiei, ahisihleh uoin dawn ahiei a, kisuhbua lou ding alungtangin atum chinten a, tuaziehin michilgete lamkaipa kungah akisuhbua louna ding in angenta hi.","title":"Babilon a Daniel muonhuoina"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in Daniel khu michilgete lamkaipa mitmu in deisahna leh lainatna aneisahta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh michilgete lamkaipa’n Daniel kungah, “Na neh ding uleh na dawn ding uh hing guot pieh ka pu leengpa ka giing hi; aziehpen bang dinga na khanguolpite sanga hoilou zaw a hing mu sese ding ahiei mah? Tuachi’n leengpa lah ah ka lutang zauhuoi sah ding na hi uhi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Daniel in Michilgete lamkaipa’n, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael leh Azariah enkol dinga ase sawnpa kungah:"},"12":{"text":"“Na suohte ni sawm sung hing enkhie in hepitahin neh ding ante louhing leh dawn ding tuisih maimai hing pie u’heh,"},"13":{"text":"Tuazou chiengin, ka mel puoh dan u’leh leengpa ann neh ne tangvate mel puoh dan toh etkah hi henlen, tualeh na mu bang bangin na suohte tungah bawl in,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n tami tungtang ah amauh athukimpi a, ni sawm sung amauh a enkheta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh ni sawm abeitah in, amel uh leengpa ann neh ne tangvalte mel sang a hoizaw leh atahsate uh thauzaw in akilangta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tambangin amaute enkolpa’n aneh ding u’leh adawn ding ua kipie ann tuipente leh uointe ahemkhie a, ante louhing ngen apeta hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian in tam tangval lite zilna lam a siemna, theina leh pilna zousie a pie a; tualeh Daniel in mengmuna leh mangte zousie theisiemna anei hi."},"18":{"text":"Lengpa’n amaute puilutna dinga ahun guot nite atuntah in, michilgete lamkai amaute leeng innpi sunga, Nebukadnezzar masang ah ahing zawpita hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n amaute ahoupi a, amaute zousie lah ah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael leh Azariah, toh kibang koima a um sih hi;
