tuaziehin amaun leengpa nna asemta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n pilna leh theisiemna lam thu a adoh zousie ah, aleenggam sung pumpi a, mitphieldawi siemte leh ai san siemte, zousie sangin alesawm a hoizaw in amaute amuta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tambangin Daniel khu Lengpa Sairas vaihawm kum khatna tandong a umtoupeh nalai hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nebukadnazzer in avaihawm kum, akum ni na ah, Nebukadnezzar in, mang aman a, tuamin alungsim a subuoi a, a imu theita sih hi.","title":"Nebukadnezzar mang"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n mitphieldawisiemte ai san siemte, leh aasi lam siemte tualeh Kaldaimite khu leengpa mang hil dinga han dingin thu apie hi. Tuachi’n amaute ahing pei ua, leengpa mai ah adingta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n akung uah, “Mang khat kaman a, tua mang thei ut in ka lungsim abuoi mama hi.”"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kaldaimiten leengpa kungah, Aramaik ham in, “Aw leengpa dam sawt in, na suohte kungah na mang hing hil in, akhiehna kang hil ding uh” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa’n adawnga, Kaldaimite kungah, “Tami ka thupuana dettah ahi: ka kunga ka mang leh akhiehna, nang theisah theisih uleh ahing kisatnen dinga, na innte uh vut vum asuoh ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahivang in mang leh akhiehna na hing theisah thei ua ahileh, silpiehte, kipahmante leh zatatna thupitahte kei akipat na mu ding uhi. Tuazieh in mang leh akhiehna hing hil un,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Amauten adawng kia ua, akungah, “Lengpa’n asuohte kungah amang hing hil henlen, tuachieng in akhiehna ka hil ding uh,” achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Lengpa’n adawnga akung uah, “Ka thupuana dettah na thei zieh ua, hun sawtsah sawm na hi uh chi chientah in ka thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Mang khu ka kunga nang theisah sih uleh, nou a dingin thukiehna khat umsun a um hi! Hun kihen masang sie a ka mai a thuzuou leh thusie gen dinga kithukim hi uteh. Tuaziehin mang hing hil phot un, tuachi’n akhiehna nang hilchien thei ding uh chi ka thei ding hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Kaldaimiten leengpa adawng ua, akungah, “Leitung ah leengpa sil phut bawl thei ding koima um sih va! Tuazieh in koima leengpa, milien leh vaihawm hitaleh zong, mitphieldawi siemte, aisan siemte leh aasi lam siemte hita leh ama ua kipat tambang silphut anei ngai sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Lengpa sil nget pen sil hasatah ahi; mihingte lah a um hilou pasiente loungal midang koiman leengpa masangah ahil thei sih ding hi,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tambang dawnna in leengpa alungthah sah mama a, Babilon gam a mipil zousie thagamna ding thu apeta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipilte thana ding thukiehna apawtkheta a, Daniel leh alawmte zong tha dingin asuita uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Babilon mipilte that ding a kuondoh leengpa veng galkap lamkai Ariok kungah piltah leh lemguot siemtah in ama adawng hi.","title":"Daniel kunga thuguh kiphuongdoh"},"15":{"text":"Ama’n leengpa galkap lamkai Ariok adonga, akungah, “Bangzieh a leengpa thuguot hichi talawm a kin ahiei mah?” Achi hi. Tuachi’n Ariok in sil umdan Daniel kungah athei sahta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Daniel alut a, leengpa kungah ama hun pe ding leh amang khiehna hilchienna dingin ava ngen hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuazouin Daniel a inn ah apeita a, thu umdan zousie alawmte Hananiah, Mishael leh Azariahte kung ah atheisahta hi."},"18":{"text":"Daniel leh alawmte nangawn zong Babilon mipil dangte toh thagam khawm a a um louna ding un, tam thuguh tungtanga van Pasian khotuona ngen dingin amauh ahilta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n thuguh khu Daniel kungah zanlai mengmunain ahing kilangta hi. Tuachi’n Daniel in van Pasian aphatta hi:"},"20":{"text":"“Pasian min kumtawn kumtawn in phat in umta hen, aziehpen pilna leh hatna Ama a ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ama’n hunte leh hunbite aheng a, Aman leengte alakhie a, leengte atung ding zel hi. Ama’n mipilte kungah pilna apie a, tualeh theisiemna neite kungah theina apie hi."},"22":{"text":"Aman sil thuh leh thuguhte aphuongdoh a, Miellah a umte Aman athei a, vah khu Ama toh um khawm ahi."},"23":{"text":"Aw ka pu ka pate uh Pasian, Na tungah ka kipah a, Nang kang phat hi. Pilna leh vangletna nang pie a, Na kunga ka hing ngette uh, tuin na hing theisah a, leengpa thu ka kung uah na hing theisah ta hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuazieh in leengpa’n Babilon mipilte thatgam dinga aguotpa Ariok kungah Daniel ava pei a, akungah tambangin agen a, “Babilon mipilte that vawt sin. Lengpa kungah kei hing zawpi inlen, Keima’n leengpa kungah amang khiehna ka hil ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Daniel in mang akhiehna"},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ariok in leengpa kungah Daniel azawpi pai a, leengpa kungah tambangin agen hi, Lengpa kungah, “Mang khiehna hing hilchien thei ding Juda saltangte lah ah mi khat ka muta hi,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Lengpa’n adawnga, amin Belteshazzar kichipa Daniel kungah, “Nang maw ka manga ka mu leh akhiehna ka kunga na hing hilchien thei ding?” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Daniel in leengpa adawnga, “Leengpa’n aphut thuguh khu Babilon mipilte, aasilam siemte, mitphieldawi siemte leh aisan siemte’n leengpa kungah ahil chien thei sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh thuguhte kilangsah leh leengpa Nebukadnezzar kunga, ni nukhia lam chienga, bang hing um ding ahiei chi theisah van ah Pasian khat a um hi. Na mang leh na lupna tunga na mengmute khu tamte ahi."},"29":{"text":"Nang na hileh, Aw leengpa, tunua chienga bang hing um ding ahiei chi ngaituo kawm a na lupna tung a na lup lai in, thuguhte langsah zel pa’n, bang hing tung ding ahiei chi, nang ahing theisah ahi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh Kei kahileh, ahing nalai midang koi ahiei khat sanga ka pil zoh zieh a ka kunga tami thuguh latsah ahisih a, Aw leengpa akhiehna na theina ding leh na lungsim sunga um na theisiemna ding ahi zaw hi."},"31":{"text":"“Lengpa aw, nang milim lientah khat na en a, namu hi. Tam milim lientah, te sesol khu na masang ah adingta hi, tualeh amel um dan khu achizat huoi mama hi."},"32":{"text":"Tam milim lutang khu sana siengtah ahi a, a awm leh abante khu dangka ahia, agil leh apheipite khu sum-eng ahi."},"33":{"text":"Akengte khu sia ahi a, akephangte sia leh tungman kihal a kibawl ahi."},"34":{"text":"Tuabanga na etlaitah in, mihing khut a laidoh hilou suongtum khat in, tua milim kephang sia leh tungman kihal laitah a deng a, aden guoi dimdem na mu hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua sia, tungman, sum-eng, dangka leh sanate khu ahing kehnen siengta a, nipi lai a buphuol a bushi bang ahing hita uhi. Tualeh hui in tuate atawmang sienga, a umna uh akitheita sih hi. Tualeh tua milim deng guoi dimdem suongtum pen muol lienpi ahing suoh a, leitung pumpi adimsuohta hi."},"36":{"text":"“Tami ahi na mang. Tuin leengpa mai ah akhiehna ka hing hil ding hi.","title":"Mang khiehna leh leenggam lite"},"37":{"text":"Nang pen na hileh Aw leengpa, leengpate leengpa na hi. Van Pasian in nang pen, leenggam leh silbawltheina, thahatna leh thupina ahing pie a,"},"38":{"text":"tualeh mihingte tenna pouma leh gam lah a gamsate leh vanlaizawl a vate tenna pouma, Aman na khut ah ahing peta hi, tualeh atung ua vaihawm in ahing bawlta hi. Tami sana lutang khu nangma na hi."},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh nangma nua ah, nang sanga ngiemzaw leenggam dang khat adingdoh ding hi. Tuazou chiengin, leenggam thumna sum-eng leenggam dangkhat leitung pumpi a vaihawm ding ahing dingdoh ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh leenggam lina khu sia banga khau ahi dinga; sia in akehnen sah a, sil zousie anuoisie bang maiin, tualeh sia in tamte asuhguoi bangin, ama’n zong leenggam dangte asuguoi ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua milim kephang leh akengmete, belkhengpa tungman leh sia kihal na mu bang bangin tam leenggam akikhen ding a, hinanleh sia leh tungman kihal na mu ma bangin, ama ah sia khauna a um ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh akengphang a akengmete kimkhat sia, kimkhat tungman ahibangin, leenggam in hatna leh zawnkhalna anei ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Sia leh tungman kihal na mu bangin, amau’khu mihing tate toh akizahal ding ua, hinanleh sia leh tungman akihalkhawm theilou mabangin tua leenggam mite zong khat leh khat akipumkhat thei sih ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tam leengte vaihawm hun sungin, van Pasian in bangchihtan a susiet ngailou ding leenggam khat aphutdoh dinga, tua leenggam khu midangte kung a nuasie ahisih ding. Tam leenggam in leenggam dangte zousie a gawtguoi sieng dinga, asubei sieng ding a, ama pen kumtawn in ading den ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Muol a kipat, mihing khut a laidoh hilou, suongtum na mu khu akhiehna tami ahi. Tua suongtumin, siate, sum-eng te, tungmante, dangkate leh sanate, agawtguoi mabangin, Pasian thupitah in tunua chienga bang hing um ding ahiei chi leengpa kung ah, a theisah ta ahi. Tualeh mang khu akichien a ahilchienna zong adih ahi” achi hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Nebukadnezzar Daniel masang ah abohkhupa, pahtawina apie a, tualeh amasanga sillat leh gimnamtuite lan dingin thu apie hi.","title":"Daniel kaisangna"},"47":{"text":"Lengpa’n Daniel adawnga, akungah, “Adihtah in na Pasian khu pasiente Pasian leh leengte Mangpa thuguhte sulangpa ahi tahtah hi; tuazieha tam thuguhte na sulat thei ahi,” achi hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n Daniel akaisang sah a, silpieh lien tahtah tampi apie a, tualeh Babilon pumpi tunga vaihawmtu leh Babilon gam a mipilte zousie tunga lamkai lienpen in abawlta hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n Daniel in leengpa kunga, angetna bangin leengpa’n, Shadrak, Meshak, Abednegote zong, Babilon gam tunga vaihawm in akoi a, Daniel pen leengpa vaihawm thukhenna ah atou denta hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Nebukadnezzar in sana milim khat tong sawmguh a sang, tongguh a lien abawl a, ama’n tua khu Babilon gamkai a um Dura phaijang ah atungdoh hi.","title":"Nebukadnezzar in milim lienpi atun dingna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Lengpa Nebukadnezzar in gamkai neuzaw uhte, vaihawmte, uhpipate, thumoptute, thukhen mite, sumkemte, dansiemte, gamkai tenga vaihawmte zousie, leengpa Nebukadnezzar milim tundoh latna a hing tel dingin ahankhawm hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamkai neuzaw uhte, vaihawmte, uhpipate, sumkemte, thukhente, dansiemte leh gamkai teng a vaihawm zousiete, leengpa Nebukadnezzar milim tundoh latna ah, ahing peikhawm ua, tua milim masangah adingta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n tangkoupa aw ngaitah in ahing kikou a: “Na kung uah tami thupieh ahi, Aw michin, namchin leh hamchin a mite aw."},"5":{"text":"Pengkulte, theilete, kaigingte, gawsemte, nawtgingte, tumging bi ni neite, silging chinteng gin na zah chiengun, na bohkhup chiet ding ua, leengpa Nebukadnezzar in atundoh milim na bieh ding uh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tuabang a bohkhup loua belou pouma, haltuina meiphuolpi sunga pailut pai ding ahi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi zousiein Pengkulte, theilete, kaigingte gosemte, nawtgingte leh silging chinteng gin azah tahun, mipi zousie, nam zousie leh ham chin a mite, abohkhup ua, leengpa Nebukadnezzar milim tundoh khu abeta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin tua hun laiin, Kaldaimi koite ahiei, amai lam ah ahing pei ua, Judate ahing heh uhi.","title":"Daniel lawmten abe ut sih uh"},"9":{"text":"Amauten leengpa ahoupi ua akungah, “Aw leengpa dam sawt in! achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Nangman Aw leengpa, michin in, pengkulte, theilete, Kaigingte, gosemte, nawtgingte, tumging bi ni neite leh silging chinteng gin azah chieng ua, bohkhup a tua sana milim abieh ding uh ahi, chiin thupieh na bawl a;"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh koipou tuabanga, bohkhup lou a, belou pouma haltuina meiphuolpi sunga pailut ding ahi, chiin thupieh na bawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Babilon gamkai sunga vaihawm dinga na koi, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego, kichi Juda mi koite ahiei a um ua, Aw leengpa tam miten, nang bangma’n ahing simsih ua, amaun na pasiente nna zong asem sih ua, na sana milim tundoh zong abe nuom sih uhi, achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nebukadnezzar thangpai leh lungthah tahin, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednegote hing zawpi dingin thu apie hi. Tuachi’n amaun tam mite leengpa mai ah ahing zawpi uhi.","title":"Daniel lawmten Pasian amuong uh"},"14":{"text":"Nebukadnezzar in amauh ahoupi a akung uah: “Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego, ka pasiente nna na sem sih ua, ka sana milim tundoh zong na be sih uh, kichi adih ahiei?"},"15":{"text":"Tu in bang hun hitaleh, Pengkulte, theilete, kaigingte, gosemte, nawtgingte, tumgingte leh silging chinteng gin, na zah chieng ua, bohkhup a ka milim tundoh be dinga na kiman uleh, ahoi! Hinanleh na bieh sih u’leh pen, haltuina meiphuolpi sunga pailut na hi pai ding uhi. Ka khut sunga kipat noute hing hundoh ding tua Pasian koi ahiei mah? achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednegoten leengpa adawng ua, akungah, “Aw Nebukadnezzar tam thu ah hing dawng vateh da kon va ung."},"17":{"text":"Tuabang ding ahitahleh zong, ana ka sep uh Pasian in, haltuina meiphuolpi apat ahing hundoh thei a, tualeh Aman na khut apat ahing hundoh ding hi, Aw leengpa."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh ahing hunkhe sihta zongin, Aw leengpa na pasiente nna ka sem sih ding ua, na sana milim tundoh zong ka be sih ding uhi, Aw leengpa, achi uhi.”"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nebukadnezzar khu Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego tungah alungthah sengsenga, amel puohdan ahing kiheng vawtta hi. Tuaziehin ama’n haltuina meiphuolpi khu asat dan ngaina sanga ale sagi a satsah dingin thu apie hi.","title":"Meiphuolpi sunga pailutna leh hutkhietna"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh aman agalkapte lah a mi hatpente Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego kantom a, haltuina meiphuolpi sunga pailut dingin thu apie hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam mite apuonahtuol utoh, atokatuol utoh, adielkhipte utoh akantom ua, haltuina meiphuolpi sungah pailut in a umta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuazieh in leengpa thupieh lah akinaw a, haltuina meiphuolpi lah asat seng ziehin, meikuongin Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego meiphuolpi a pailutte akalumta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh tam mi thumte, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednegote, kantomsain haltuina meiphuolpi sungah akesuhta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Nebukadnezzar khu lamdang sa sengin kintah in adingdoh a, athudohmite kungah: “I kantom a meiphuolpi sunga ipailut uh mithum hilou ahi uoi mah?” Chiin adong hi. Amaun adawng ua, leengpa kungah adih hi, “Aw leengpa” achi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Aman: “En vawi un, mi li phelsa a um, mei lah a vah kawikawi ka mu a, bangma achi sih uhi; tualeh alinapa melpuoh dan Pasian tapa abang hi,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nebukadnezzar khu haltuina meiphuolpi gei ah ahing pei a, “Thu agen a, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego, noute Pasian tungnung pen suohte, hing pawtdoh unlen tanah hing pei un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego te meikuong lai akipat in ahing pawtdohta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh gamkai neuzaw uhte, vaisaite, uhpipate leh leengpa thudohmite ahing kikhawm ua, tam mite tahsa tungah meikuongin thuneina anei sih a, alutung ua sam zam khat zong akasih a, apuonsilte u’zong meiin akasih a, atahsa tung u’zong meikhu gim anam sih uh chi amuta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nebukadnezzar in thu agen a, “Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego Pasian phat in umta hen, Ama’n avansawlsieng ahing sawl a, Ama muong asuohte ahundoh hi. Tualeh amaun leengpa thu asang sih ua, tualeh amaun a Pasian uh chilou pasien dang mawngmawng abieh louna dingun leengpa thupieh sulamdangin atahsa uh apephal uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n michin, namchin leh hamchin a mi koipou Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego Pasian tunga thu hoilou gen pouma sat nen in a um ding a, a innte uh vutvum asuoh ding hi, chiin thupieh ka bawl ahi; aziehpen tambang hundohthei Pasian dang a um sih hi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednegote Babilon gamkai sungah akaisang sahta hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Nebukadnezzar in michinte, namchinte, hamchinte leh leitung pumpi a tengte kungah na tung uah hamuonna suhpungin umta hen.","title":"Nebukadnezzar mang a singkung"},"2":{"text":"Tungnungpen Pasian in kei a dinga, abawl chiemtenate leh sil lamdangte, phuondoh hoi kasa hi."},"3":{"text":"Achiemtenate athupi senga, a sillamdangte anasa seng hi! Aleenggam khu kumtawn leenggam ahi a, avaihawmna zong akhang akhangin a um hi."},"4":{"text":"Kei Nebukadnezzar ka inn ah ka khawldam a, ka leeng innpi huongsungah nuomtah in ka um hi."},"5":{"text":"Mang khat ka manta a tua mangin ahing zau sah mama hi; ka lupna tunga ka ngaituonate leh ka lutanga mengmunaten, ahing subuoi mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka mang khiehna ka kunga, ahing theisah theina dingun, Babilon mipil zousie ka mai a, hing puikhawm dingin thupieh khat ka bawlta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n mitphieldawi siemte, aasi lam siemte Kaldaimite leh ai san siemte, ahing peikhawm ua, tualeh ken amauh ka mang ka hil a, hinanleh amaun ka mang khiehna, ahing theisah thei sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh atawpah, ka pasien min dungzui a amin kiphuo Belteshazzar kichi asunga Pasian Siengthou hagau neipa Daniel ka masang ah ahing pei a, tualeh ken amasang ah ka mang ka hilta hi."},"9":{"text":"“Aw Belteshazzar mitphieldawi siemte lamkaipa Pasian ziehin leh thuguh bangma in ahing subuoi sih chi ka thei ziehin, ka mang a kilahna ka mu leh akhiehna hing hilchien in."},"10":{"text":"Ka lupna tunga ka luplai a, ka mengmute tamte ahi: Ka khodah leh, Ngai in, leitung laizang tah ah, singkung pou khat ka mu a, asandan anasa mama hi."},"11":{"text":"Singkung khu ahing khang lien a, ahat mama a, asan lam in van asutou a, kawlmong tawp tandongin akimupha hi."},"12":{"text":"Anate a etlawm a, agapha mama hi, tua khu mi zousie a dingin ann ahi a, gamlah a gamsaten alim nuoi abel ua, abazamte ah tungleeng vate ateng uhi, tualeh ganhing zousie tua singkung apat akivah uhi."},"13":{"text":"“Ka lupna tunga ka lup laiin, mengmunate ka mu a, ngai vawi, vengtu misiengthou khat van a pat ahing kumsuh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama ngaitah in akikou a, tambangin agen hi, tua sing khu phua inlen, abazamte satkhie inlen, anate heu inlen, agate thethangin, gamsate alimnuoi apat taimang uhenlen, abate apat in vate leengmang uheh."},"15":{"text":"Hinanlezong abulsum leh athahui zungte gamlah ah siakhau leh sum-eng gui a hensa in hampa dawng lah ah nuasie in um hen. Van daitui in ama pahsah henlen, leitunga hampate gamlah a gamsate toh nekhawm uheh."},"16":{"text":"Alungtang khu mihing lungtang apat kiheng henlen, gamsa lungtang pieh hihen; tualeh atung ah hun sagi beisah hi heh."},"17":{"text":"Tungnung sangpen in mihingte leenggam ah vai ahawm a, a ut ut kungah apie a, mi nuoinungpente zong atungding zel hi chi, mihingten atheina ding un, vengtu misiengthouten tam thupuana leh thutanna aphuongdoh uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tam mang khu Kei leengpa Nebukadnezzar in ka man a, ka leenggam sung a mipil koima’n akhiehna ahing hil theilou ziehin, tuin Belteshazzar aw, nang hing khiehpieh inlen hing theisah in, aziehpen Pasian Siengthou hagau nangma ah a um hi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Daniel amin Belteshazzar kichipa khu hun khat sung lamdangsa in abuoi a, angaituonaten apatausah mama hi. Tuachi’n leengpa’n “Belteshazzar aw, mang leh akhiehna in kisubuoisah sin,” achi hi. Belteshazzar in adawngta hi. “Ka pu mang pen nang hing mudate a ding hi henlen, akhiehna zong na melmate ading hizaw heh, achi hi.","title":"Daniel in mengmuna ahilchienna"},"20":{"text":"Na singkung mu, hing khanglien a, hing phungchinga, asan lam in van su a, kawlmong tawp donga kimupha a,"},"21":{"text":"anate etlawm a, agapha mama a, ganhing zousie ann neh ding pie a, alim nuoi a gamsate tenga, abazamte a tungleeng vaten umna a aneina u’khu:"},"22":{"text":"Tua singkung hing khang a hing hatta khu, Aw leengpa, Nangma na hi. Na thupina ahing khangtou a, van asuta a, na vaihawmna leenggam in kawlmong tawptan aphata hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Lengpa’n van akipat vengtu Misiengthou khat hing kumsuh a mu a, Sing khu phua inlen, sumangin, ahivangin abulsum pen athahuite siakhau leh sum-eng gui a hensa in leitunga hampa dawngte lah ah nuasie in. Tualeh van daitui in pahsah henlen, gamlah gamsate toh hampa ne khawm heh, atunga hun sagi abei masangsie, hing chi na mu hi."},"24":{"text":"Lengpa aw tami akhiehna ahi; tualeh tami ka pu leengpa tung a hing tungding Tungnung Sangpen thupieh ahi."},"25":{"text":"Mihingte lah a kipat ahing delmang ding ua, na tenna ding khu gamlah a gamsate lah ahi ding a, bawngtal bangin hampa ahing nesah ding ua, van daitui in na pah ding hi. Tualeh Tungnung Sangpen in mihingte leenggamah vai ahawm a, a ut ut kungah ape zel hi chi na hing theidoh masangsie in, na tungah hun sagi abei ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh singkung bulsum leh athahuite nuasie ding a thupieh pen ahileh, van in vai ahawm chi na hing theidoh nua chiengin na leenggam khu nanga dingin suhdet kia ahi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aw leengpa ka hing thuhilna nanga dingin pomtah hihen; na khelnate tawpsan inlen sildih bawlin, na gitlouna tawpsan inlen, mi genthei tung ah khotuona langsah in. Tamte’n na nopsahna asusau khamaw sih ding hi,” a chi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tamte zousie leengpa Nebukadnezzar tungah ahing tungta hi.","title":"Mang tangtunna Nebukadnezzar kiehngiemna"},"29":{"text":"Ha sawm leh ni abei nua in, leengpa Babilon leeng innpi sunga avah kawi kawi lai in;"},"30":{"text":"leengpa’n thu agen a, “Tami Babilon thupitah khu, leenggam innpi dinga ka silbawltheina hatna leh ka thupina zatatna dinga, ka lamdoh hilou ahiei mah? achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Lengpa kam sunga tua thute a um nahlai sungin, van a kipat aw khat ahing kumsuh a, “Aw leengpa Nebukadnezzar na kungah thu akigen hi: Leenggam nang akipat apeimangta hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh nang pen mite lah apat in ahing delmang ding ua, gamsate toh na tengkhawm dinga, bawngtal bangin hampa na ne ding a, tualeh Tungnung Sangpen in mihingte leenggam tung ah vaiahawm a, a ut ut kungah ape zel hi chi na hing theidoh masangsie in, na tung ah hun sagi abei ding hi.”"},"33":{"text":"Tuami dahkal mama in tua thute Nebukadnezzar tungah ahing tangtung paita a, ama pen mite lah akipat delmangin a umta a, bawngtal bangin hampa aneta hi; Asamte muvanlai mul ahing bah a, achinte zong vate chin ahing bah masang sie in, van daitui in apumtangin apah sah hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh tua hunte abeitahin, Kei Nebukadnezzar vanlam en in ka dahtou a, ka theisiemnate ka kungah ahing kinuale kiata hi; tualeh ken Tungnung Sangpen ka pahtawi a, ka phat a, zatatna ka pie hi: Aziehpen, Ama thuneina khu kumtawn thuneina ahi a, Aleenggam zong akhang akhangin a umden ding hi.","title":"Nebukadnezzar tunding kiana"},"35":{"text":"Leitunga tengte zousie khu, bangmalou banga ngai ahi ua, Aman van galkapte lah leh, leitunga tengte lah ah a ut bangbangin, abawl a koiman akhut atutang thei sih a ahisihleh “Bang ahiei na bawl” achi thei sih hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua hun laitah mama in ka kingaituotheina ka kungah ahing kinuale kia a, tualeh ka leenggam thupina dingin, ka zatat huoina leh ka thupina ka kungah ahing kinuale kiata hi. Tualeh ka thukikuppite leh ka milienten ahing suidoh ua, ka leenggam ah suhdetin ka um kiata a, thupina nasa zawsem ka kungah belapin aum ta hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuin Kei Nebukadnezzar in, van leengpa ka phat a, ka tawisanga, zanate ka pie hi; Anasep zousie thutah ahi a, alampi zousie dihna ahi. Tualeh mi kisatheitah a gamtate, Aman asungiem thei hi achi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Belshazzar in a miliente tul khat a ding in, annkuong thupitah alui a, tul khatte masang ah zu adawnta hi.","title":"Belshazzar annzaluina"},"2":{"text":"Belshazzar in zu achep lai in, apa Nebukadnezzar in, Jerusalem biehinn apat a ahing puoh, sana leh dangka noute a, leengpa leh amiliente leh azite leh a meiten zu a dawn theina ding un, tua noute hing tawi dingin thu apie hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem a Pasian biehinn akipata kiladoh sana noute ahing lata ua, tuachi’n leengpa leh amiliente leh azite leh a meiten, tua noute in zu adawn uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuabang zu adawn kawm un amauten, sana, dangka leh sum-eng leh sing leh suong a kibawl pasiente aphatta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Thakhat in mihing khutme ahing kilangdoh a, leengpa innpi sunga thaumei tunna toh kitang bang ahing gielta hi; tualeh leengpa’n tua khut tumbong lai giel khu amuta hi.","title":"Bang a lai kigiel"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa mel ahing kihengta a, angaituonatein asubuoita a, akengte ahing zawi a, akhupte ahing kitat tuota hi."},"7":{"text":"Lengpa’n aasi lam siemte, Kaldaimite leh aisan siemte hing puilut dingin ngaitah in akikouta hi. Tualeh leengpa’n Babilon mipilte kungah thu agen a, akung uah: “Tam lai kigiel sim a, agen leh alena ka kunga hing hil thei pouma, puonsandup silsah ahi dinga, angawng ah sana khainieng awsah ahi ding a, leenggam sungah vaihawm athumna in apang ding hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa mipilte zousie ahing lut ua, hinanleh amaun lai kigiel asim thei sih ua, alena zong leengpa kungah atheisah theisih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Belshazzar nasatah in alungbuoita mama a, amel puohdan ahing kihengta a, miliente zong achiza siengta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Lengnu’n leengpa leh a miliente kikou husa azahtah in annkuong luina inndan sungah ahing lut a; tualeh Lengnu’n thu agen a: “Aw leengpa dam sawt in, na ngaituonaten hing patausah sih heh, na mel puohdan zong kiheng sih heh.","title":"Khut a kigiel khu Daniel in aletkheta hi"},"11":{"text":"Na leenggam sungah, asunga Pasian Siengthou hagau tenna mi khat a um hi. Na pa damlai in, pasiente pilna bang, lungsim chiim leh theisiemna leh pilna nei ahilam ama ah akimu hi. Na pa, kachi Lengpa Nebukadnezzar in tua mipa mitphieldawi siemte, aisan siemte, aasilam siemte mangsan siemte lamkai lienpen a apansah ahi."},"12":{"text":"Lungsim hoitah, theina leh theisiemna, mangte khiehna, silhasate theichientheina, thubuoite genveng theina nei ahi lam zong akimu hi; leengpa’n Belteshazzar achipa a um hi, tuin Daniel hat hi henlen, tuachi’n aman ahilchienna ahing hil mai ding hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Daniel leengpa mai ah ahing puilut ua, tualeh leengpa’n Daniel ahoupi a, akungah “Lengpa ka pa’n Judate lah apata a puidoh Juda saltang mite lah a Daniel kichipa na hiei mah?"},"14":{"text":"Na sung ah Pasian hagau a um a, lungsimpilna leh theisiemna leh pilna hoitah nangma ah akimu hi chi, ka naza hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu in mipilte, aasilam siemte, tam lai kigiel sim ding leh, agente hing hilchien dingin ka masang ah ahing puilut ua, hinanleh ahing hilchien thei a um sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Nangman hilchiennate na bawl thei a, silhasate na genveng thei hi chi ka naza hi. Tuin laigel na simthei a ahilchiennate ka kunga na hing theisah thei leh puonsandup silsah in na um dinga, na ngawngah sana khainieng na awding a, leenggam sung ah vaihawmlien thumna in na pang ding hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Daniel in adawnga, leengpa mai ah, “Na silpiehte nangma ading hi henlen, na nuommante zong midang kung ah pie in. Ahivang in lai kigiel khu leengpa kung ah ka sim dinga, ahilchienna ka theisah ding hi.","title":"Laigel hilchienna"},"18":{"text":"Lengpa aw, Tungnung Sangpen Pasian in na pa Nebukadnezzar, leenggam leh vangletna, thupina leh pahtawinate ana pie hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh akunga apieh vangletna zieh in, michin namchin leh ham chinteng amasangah achitun ua azau uhi. A ut ut athat a, a ut ut ahing khawi a, atawisang nuomte atawisang a, asuhngiem utte a sungiem hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh alungtang ahing kisathei a, kiletsahna a alungsim ahing khau tah in, aleengtoupha apat kaikhieh in a um a, athupina alahpiehta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama mihingte lah akipat delmangin a umta a, alungtang gamsa banga bawl in a umta a, tualeh gam sabiltungte lah ah atenga, bawngtal bangin hampa nein a kivah hi. Tungnung Sangpen Pasian in mihingte leenggam ah vaiahawm a, a ut pouma vaihawm dingin aguot hi, chi atheidoh masangsie in, van daituiin apah hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh nang atapa Belshazzar aw, tamte zousie thei napiin na lungtang na ngiemkhieh nuom sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Kingiemkhieh nahsangin van Mangpa douin na kitawisang a; abiehinn anoute na masang ah na lasah a, nang leh na miliente leh na zite leh na meiten zu dawnna in na zang uhi. Tualeh mutheilou, zatheilou, thei-theilou, sana, dangka, sum-eng sia leh sing leh suong a, kibawl pasiente phat in na pahtawi hi, tualeh Pasian akhut a na haitheina kempa leh na gamtat dan zousie Ama a hipa khu na pahtawi sih hi."},"24":{"text":"“Tuachi’n khutmete Ama akipat sawl in ahing um a, tualeh tam lai ahing gielta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh lai kigiel khu tami ahi: “MENE, MENE TEKEL UPHARSI.”"},"26":{"text":"Tua thumalte akhiehna tamte ahi: ‘MENE’: Pasian in leenggam vaihawmna nite asim a abeisahta hi."},"27":{"text":"‘TEKEL’ Tena ah tein na um a, na ching zou tasih hi."},"28":{"text":"‘PERES’: Na leenggam akihawmzah a, Medes leh Persiate kunga pieh ahita, achi hi.”"},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Belshazzar in thu apie a, tuachi’n Daniel puonsandup asilsah ua, a ngawng ah sana khainieng a awsah ua, tualeh leenggam sung vaihawm lien thumna a pang ding ahi chiin ama toh kisai in thuphuon abawl uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuami zan mama in Kaldaimite leengpa Belshazzar tha in a umta hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Medesmi Darius, kum sawmguh leh ni a upa ahi kum in leenggam alata hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darius in aleenggam pumpi tunga vaihawm dingin uhpi za leh sawmni, agamkai teng tungah akoi hi.","title":"Darius in Daniel akaisang sahna"},"2":{"text":"Tamte tungah uhpipate thum akoi kia a, tuate lah ah Daniel khat ahi. Lengpa a dinga manna a umlouna dingin uhpi neuzawten, amaute kungah thu leh la atut sawn ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam Daniel khu uhpipate leh uhpi neuzawte sanga deisah tuom in a um a, ama a lungsim hoitah mu a a um ziehin, leengpa’n ama khu, a leenggam pumpi tunga koi ding angaituo hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n uhpipate leh gamkai neuzaw uhmiten gamsung vaihawmna toh kisai in Daniel hehsietna ding a suita ua, hinanleh hehna ding amu thei sih uhi, ama mi dihtat, muonhuoi leh lungsimsie neilou ahizieh in asietna bangma amu sih uhi.","title":"Darius suoikaina mot huoi"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam miten: “A Pasian dan tungtang lam toh kisai ahilou ngal leh tam Daniel hehna ding mu ngai sih vai,” akichi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n uhpipate leh gamkai neuzaw uhmite leengpa kungah ahonpi un ahing hawkhawm ua, akungah tambang in ahing gen uhi: “Aw leengpa Darius damsawt in, achi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Lenggam uhpipate, vaihawmte, gamkai neuzaw uhmite, thudohmite leh thumopmite zousie ka kihou khawm ua, tuban ni sawmthum sunga nang kung chiloungal, mi dang ahiei, pasien dang ahiei, kunga thungetna nei pouma, humpibahnei kul sungah pailut in um hen, chi leeng innpi thupieh um henlen tua khu suhdet hiheh, chiin ka kithukim uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuin Aw leengpa thupieh namdet inlen, Medes leh Persia dan lamdang ngailou dungzui a akihen lamdang thei louna dingin laikigiel khu suoi kaikhum in, achi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Darius in Dan kigiel tungah suoi akaita hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuin Daniel in lai kigiel tungah suoi akikaita chi atheitah in inn langah apeita hi. Tualeh a inndan tungnung ah akaltou a, Jerusalem lam nga in akottate ahong a, ni dang a anabawl ngaina bangin, ni khat in thumvei a Pasian masang ah, thu angen a, tualeh kipah thu agen hi.","title":"Daniel gin umtah a athumna"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam mite ahing kikhawm ua, Daniel a Pasian masanga panpina ngen a athunget laitah ahing muta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute leengpa kungah ahing pei ua, leengpa thupieh tungtang ahing gen ua: “Aw Lengpa, ni sawmthum sung mawngmawng nangma kung loungal pasien dangte kung ahiei, ahisihleh mi dang kung mawngmawng a thungetna nei a um pouma leh humpibahnei kul sung a pailut ding thupieh khautah ah suoi na kai sih amah?” ahing chi uhi. Lengpa’n adawnga: “Tua thupieh Medes leh Persia dan kiheng theilou dungzui in akiheng sih hi” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun adawng ua, leengpa masang ah: “Lengpa aw, Juda saltaangte lah a mi Daniel in, nang bangma in ahing ngai sih a, na suoikaina na thupieh lah bangma in asim sih hi, ni khat in thumvei thungetna abawl nalai lai hi,” achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tam thute azah tah in leengpa alungdong mama a, tuachi’n Daniel huhdoh ding alungsim in angaituo a, ni tum masangsie in ahuhdohna ding ngaituo in theitawp suo in asem hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam mite leengpa kungah ahing peikhawm kia ua, leengpa kungah: “Aw leengpa, Medes leh Persia dan a leengpa’n anamdetsa thupieh leh danthu mawngmawng kiheng theilou ahi,” ahing chi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n thupieh apie a, Daniel ahing zawpi ua, humpibahnei kul sungah apailutta uhi. Hinanleh leengpa’n Daniel ahoupi a, akungah, “A nna nasep ngitnget na Pasian in hing hunkhe nava,” achi hi.","title":"Daniel humpibahnei kul sunga pailutna"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n suongtum khat ahing la ua, humpibahnei kul kot akha ua, Daniel tungtang a siltup akihen thei nawnlouna dingin, leengpa’n ama suoi namna khutsip leh amiliente suoi namna khutsip in anam chiet uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuin leengpa aleeng innpi ah apeita a, ann ngawl in zan tungtawn in azanhah a, amasangah tumging malmal ahing tawi sih ua, ama lah a imu thei vawt sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa zingmawng matahin athou a, humpibahnei kulpi lam ah kintah in apei pai hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh kul ahing tuntah in, kaa aw pumin Daniel han in akikou a: Lengpa’n Daniel ahoupi a akungah, “Aw Daniel Pasian hing suohpa ana nasep ngitnget na Pasian in humpibahneite lah apat ahing hunkhe thei nai mah?” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Daniel in leengpa kungah, “Lengpa aw damsawt in!"},"22":{"text":"Ka Pasian in avansawlsiengte ahing sawl a, kei ahing suhnat louna ding un humpibahnei kamte ahum pieh hi; Ama masanga mawna neilou ka hizieh leh, Aw leengpa nangma masanga zong bangma ka bawl khiellou ziehin,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa ama ziehin akipah seng senga, tua kul sung apat Daniel ladoh dingin thu apie hi. Tuachi’n Daniel kul sung apat akiladohta a, asatung ah liemna mawngmawng akimu sih hi, Pasian agintat ziehin."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa thupiehin, adihloupi a Daniel hehte ahing zawpi ua, humpibahnei kulpi sungah azite u’leh atate u’toh pailut in a umta uhi, tualeh anuoi a atuhsuh masang un humpibahneiten ana eehmal gawp ua, agu atangte uh atawngsah siengta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Darius in leitung pumpi ateng michin, namchin leh ham chintenga mite kungah lai agiel a, “Hamuonna na kung uoh suhpungin umta hen."},"26":{"text":"Ka leenggam thuneina mun china um miten, Daniel Pasian masangah chitun in zau uheh. Aziehpen Ama Pasian hing ahi a, kumtawn a umden ahi. Ama leenggam suhsiet ahi ngai sih dinga, aleenggam thuneina in bei ni anei sih ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Aman a hunkhie a, ahundoh hi, Aman van leh leitung ah, chiemtenate leh sillamdangte abawl a, Daniel khu humpibahnei thahatna akipat ahunkheta hi,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam Daniel khu Darius vaihawm sungteng leh Persia mi Sairas vaihawm sungteng, alawching a, amavang denta hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Belshazzar leenga apan kum khatna kum in, Daniel alupna tunga alup laiin mang aman a, alungsim ah mengmute ahing kilang hi. Tuachi’n amang agielkhie a, athupite kimtah in ahil hi.","title":"Daniel in gamsa li amuna"},"2":{"text":"Daniel in thu agena, “Zanlai, ka mengmuna ah ka mu a, tualeh ngai in, van hui li ten tuipi amut a, akilohsah zuazua hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh tuipi apat gamsa lienpipi akibanglou chiet li ahing pawt tou uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 13.1; 17.8"},"4":{"text":"Amasa pen humpibahnei abanga, muvanlai hate anei hi. Ahate akibawdoh masangsiein ka en a, tua gamsate leitung apat dopkang in a um a, mihing bangin keng in akiding sah a, mihing lungtang pieh in a um hi.","ref":"Kihil. 13.2"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh thakhat in gamsa dang, anina vompi bang a um a, tuapen asihlangkhat apat akidomkangtou a, akamsunga aha kikal ah nahgu thum anei hi. Tualeh tambangin agen uhi: Thou inlen tahsa tampi nekhawng in."},"6":{"text":"Tua zou a ka et leh gamsa dang, kamkei bang khat ahing kilang a, a eljang ah va ha bangbang ha li anei hi. Tua gamsa in lutang li zong anei a, vaihawmna thuneina akunga pieh in a um hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuami nua in, ka zanmang in mengmuna ka mu a, gamsa lina, ginhuoi leh chizat umtah ahia ahat mama hi. Ama’n sia ha lien tahtah anei a, anegam a, abottel dimdem a, aneh mawhte akeng in atuonchil nalai hi. Gamsa masate toh akibang sih a, ki sawm anei hi.","ref":"Kihil. 12.3; 13.1"},"8":{"text":"Tua kite ka ngaituo lai in, tua kite lah, ki neu khat ahing poudoh a, tua ki neu masang ah ki masate lah a thumte bulkal khieh a bawdoh in a um hi. Tam kii in mihing mit bang mitte anei a, sil thupitahtah gen kam khat zong anei hi.","ref":"Kihil. 13.5,6"},"9":{"text":"Tuabanga ka et laiin, mangtoupha khat ahing kidaw a, khanglui lai ni in atouna aluo dong ka en a, A puonsil vua bangin avam a, Alutunga samte samul siengtah bang ahi. Amangtoupha khu meikuong ahi a, atouna kengte khu meikuong lai bang ahi.","title":"Khanglui nite apat ahing zingpa","ref":"Kihil. 20.4; Kihil. 1.14"},"10":{"text":"Meikuong luipi khat aluongkhie a, Ama kunga kipat a hing luongkhie ahi. Atul atul in Ama nna asem ua, tul sawm mun tul sawmte Amasangah ading uhi. Vaihawm thukhen pat ahita a, laibute akiphenta hi.","ref":"Kihil. 5.11; Kihil. 20.12"},"11":{"text":"“Tuachi’n ken tua kii thugen sil thupitahte ziehin ka en nalai a, tua gamsa akithat a, atahsa suhsiet a um a, meikuonga haltum dinga, pieh ahi dongin ka en nalai lai hi."},"12":{"text":"Gamsa dangte pen avaihawm thuneina uh lahmang pieh in a umta ua, hunbi khat leh hunkhat sung ahinna uh suhsau in a um hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka zanlai mengmuna in ka en a, tualeh ngai vawi, Mihing Tapa bang Mikhat van meipite toh ahing pei a, Ama khangluilai Mi kungah ahing pei a, tualeh Ama khu Ama kungah ahing zawpi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 24.30; 26.64; Mak. 13.26; 14.62; Luk. 21.27; Kihil. 1.7,13; 14.14"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama kungah, vaihawmnate thuneinate, thupina leh leenggam, pieh in a um a, mi chin, nam chin leh hamchin a miten Ama nna asem ding uhi. Ama vaihawmna leenggam khu tawpni neilou ding kumtawn vaihawmna leenggam ahi a, tualeh aleenggam khu suhsiet a um ngailou ding leenggam ahi.","ref":"Kihil. 11.15"},"15":{"text":"“Kei Daniel ka tahsa sunga um ka lungsim alungkham a, ka lungsim a hing kilang mengmunate’n ahing lungbuoi sah hi.","title":"Gamsa lite hilchienna"},"16":{"text":"Ka kunga dingte khat kungah ka va pei a, tam silte zousie tungtang a thutah ka va dongta hi. Tuachi’n Aman tam silte akhiehna ka kungah ang hil a, ahing theisahta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tam gamsa lien tahtah lite khu, leitung apata hing umdoh ding leeng lite ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Tungnung Sangpen misiengthouten leenggam ala ding ua, tua leenggam khu kumtawn kumtawn dong in anei den ding uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 22.5"},"19":{"text":"“Tuachi’n ken gamsa dangte toh kibanglou, agiinhuoi mama gamsa li na, ahate sia ha, achinte sum-eng hi, bottel dimdem a, negam a, aneh mawhte akenga tuonchilgawp pen tungtang thutah thei ka ut hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh alutunga kii sawm poute tungtang leh kii dangkhat hing poudoh a, a masang a kii thumte puata, tungtang: tua kii in mitte nei leh sil thupitah genna kam nei a, amel latdan zong alawite sanga hattuoh zaw pen thu ka thei nuomta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuabang ka et lai in, tua kii mama in misiengthoute akidoupi a, amauh azouta hi.","ref":"Kihil. 13.7"},"22":{"text":"Khangluilai ni ahing pei a, Tungnung Sangpen misiengthoute kunga vaihawmna pieh in aum a tualeh misiengthouten, leenggam anei ding hun uh atun masangsie in.","ref":"Kihil. 20.4"},"23":{"text":"“Aman tambangin agen hi: Gamsa lina khu, leitunga leenggam lina ahi. Lenggam dangte zousie toh kikhiehna anei ding a, leitung pumpi negam ding leh, tuonchil in abotnen gawp ding hi.","title":"Gamsa lina hilchienna"},"24":{"text":"Tua kii sawmte khu tam leenggam sung akipat hing dingkhe ding leeng sawmte ahi uhi; tualeh amauh nua ah, leeng dang khat ahing dingdoh dinga, amasate toh akibang sih dinga, Ama’n leeng thumte azou ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 17.12"},"25":{"text":"Ama’n Tungnung Sangpen dou in thu thupitahtah agen dinga, Tungnung Sangpen misiengthoute asugenthei dinga, Hunte leh dan hen asawm ding a, Tuachi’n misiengthoute khu hun khat leh hunte leh hun kimkhat sung akhut sung a pieh ahi ding uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 12.14; 13.5,6"},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh vaihawm thukhenna ah atou dinga, kumtawn dong a sumangthai ding leh negam dingin, avaihawmna alahmang pieh ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n leenggam leh thuneina, tualeh van nuoi pumpi a, leenggamte thupina khu, Tungnung sangpen misiengthou mite, kunga pieh ahita ding hi. Aleenggam khu kumtawn leenggam ahi a, leenggam vaihawm thunei zousiete’n, Ama abe ding ua, athu amang ding uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 20.4; Kihil. 22.5"},"28":{"text":"“Tami athu tawpna ahita, Kei Daniel ka hileh, ka ngaituonate’n ahing subuoi mama a, ka melpuoh dan ahing kihengta hi; hinanleh sil umdante ka lungtang ah ka vom chinten hi.”"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Belshazzar leenga apan kum thum achin kum in, ka kungah, Kei Daniel kung ngelngel ah, kilahna masapen akilah zou nua in, kilahna khat ahing kilang kia hi.","title":"Belamtal leh Keltal muna"},"2":{"text":"Ka mengmuna ah, Elam gamkai a Shushan leeng innpi kulpi a ki-im sunga um hi in ka kithei a, tualeh mengmuna in ka mu a, Ulai lui gei ah ka um hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka dahdoh leh lui gei a belamtal kii ni nei khat ding ka mu a, akiite gel asau a, hinanleh khatpen adangkhat pen sangin asau zaw a, hinanleh apou nukhia zaw ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tua belamtal in, tumlam, mallam leh simlam avih kawikawi in ka mu a, tuachi’n gamsa dangten ama adou zou sih ua, akhut apat hundoh zou koima a um sih a, a ut dan dan in sil abawl a ahing thupi mamata hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh ka kingaituo laiin, thakhat in, amittegel kikaal a pou kii lienpi nei keltal khat tumlam akipat ahing pei a, tuol sukhalou in leitung pumpi ah apeisuoh hi.","title":"Keltal khat muna"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n lui gei a ding belamtal kii ni nei ka mu kungah ahing pei a, lungthah tah a hing tai in abaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh keltal in tua belamtal ahing zuon ka mu a, tualeh lungthahtah a belamtal asuh leh akii tegel asuhtawng piehta hi. Belamtal in ama nan zouna ding thahatna mawngmawng anei sih hi. Keltal in belamtal khu tuol ah asupua a, leilah ah atuonchil a, tualeh akhut apat a belamtal hunkhe thei koima a um sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuazieh in keltal khu nasatah in ahing khanglien ta a, hinanleh ahing hat laitah in, akilienpi khu atawngta hi, amun ah, van hui lite lam nga in kii lamdang li ahing poudoh uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua kiite lah a khat apat, kii neu khat ahing poudoh a, simlam, suolam leh gam thupi lam ah nasatah a thahat in ahing khanglienta hi.","title":"Ki neu khat"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh van galkap hon tan aphah dongin akhangtou a, galkap hon lah leh aasite lah a lawikhat leilah ah apaikhesuh a, atuonchilta hi.","ref":"Kihil. 12.4"},"11":{"text":"Van galkap hon leengtapa banga lien leh sang in ama leh ama akitawisanga, tualeh nisim kithoina sillatte alamanga, Amun siengthoumunte suhmang in a um hi."},"12":{"text":"Gitlouna ziehin galkap honpi leh nisim kithoina sillatte ama kunga pieh in a um hi; aman thutah khu tuolsena’n anei a, asep abawl ah amailam avanga, alawching zel hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken misiengthou khat in thu agen lai ka za a, misiengthou dang khat in tua misiengthou thugenpa kunga, “Nisim kithoinate, susegawppa bawlsietnate, munsiengthou leh galkap honte totchil a aumna ding tungtang a mengmuna khu bangtan a sawt ding ahiei?” achi hi.","title":"Mengmuna sawtdan"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh aman ka kungah, “Ni tul ni leh zathum tandong ahi dinga, tuazou chiengin munsiengthou siensuo ahi ding,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuin hichi ahing hi a, Kei Daniel in, mengmuna ka mu tahin, akhiehna thei ka tum a, tualaitah in, thakhat in ka masangah mihing melpuohdan bang khat ahing ding hi.","title":"Gabriel in mengmuna ahilchienna"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Ulai luipang tegel kikaal ah mihing aw khat ka za a, tua aw in, “Gabriel, tam mipa kungah mengmuna khu theisiem sah in,” achi ka za hi.","ref":"Luk. 1.19,26"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama ka dinna kung nai ah ahing pei a, ahing pei tah in ka zau mama a, bohkhup in ka puata a, hinanleh aman ka kungah: “Aw mihing tapa, Theisiemin, mengmuna pen hun tawpna hun a ding ahi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuin Kei ahing houpi lai in, leilah a bohkhup in nasatah in ka imuta hi, hinanleh Aman kei ahing khoi a, tangtah in ahing ding sah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh aman “En in, lungthahna hun nukhia lam chienga sil hing um ding ka hing theisah ding hi, aziehpen hun tawpna ding hun guot ah ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Belamtal kii ni nei na mu khu, Media leh Persia leengte ahi uhi.","title":"Belamtal hilchienna"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Keeltal khu Greece leengpa ahi a, amittegel kikaal a, kii lientah pen leengpa masapen ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tua akii tawngsan doh a, amun a kii-li hing poudoh pen khu, ama nam akipat leenggam li ahing dingdoh dinga, hinanleh ama silbawltheina ahisih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh aleenggam uh hun nukhia lam chiengin takhielte aphahtawp uh ahing tun chiengun; leengpa mel giinhuoitah leh thugilou bawldante theisiem khat ahing khangdoh ding hi.","title":"Ki neu hilchienna"},"24":{"text":"Asilbawltheina ahat dinga, hinanleh ama thahatna vang ahisih ding a, Aman giinhuoitah in asumang ding a, asep abawl ah alawching dinga; Aman mihatte leh misiengthoute asusegawp ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Apil khelna ziehin, solna akhut ah alawching sah dinga, alungtang in ama akitawisangdinga, nuomsatah a aumlai un mitampi asuse ding hi. Lengte Lengpa dou dingin adingdoh ding a, Hinanleh mihing khut hilouin, ama suhsiet in a um ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh nitah lam leh zing mawng lam mengmuna kigensate khu adih ahi; Tuaziehin tam mengmuna pen mailam hun, ni tampi nua chieng toh kisai ahizieh in khahkhum in.”"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh kei Daniel ka bagawpta a, ni tampi sung china in ka lum hi; tuazou in ka thoudoh a, leengpa nna ka sem hi. Tua mengmuna lamdang kasa a, ka theisiem sih hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kaldai gam sunga leengpa a bawl, piendan a Medes mi Ahasuerus tapa Darius leeng apan kum, akum khatna kum in,","title":"Daniel thumna"},"2":{"text":"Avaihawm kum khatna kum in Kei Daniel in guolnei Jeremiah kunga Mangpa’n thu agen Jerusalem sietna kum sawmsagi dai ding ahi chi, laibute apat in ka theisiemta hi.","ref":"Jer. 25.11; 29.10"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa Pasian lam nga in, thumna leh ngetna, anngawlna leh sai-ippuon sil in, vutvai lah a kilawmlie in ka thum ngetngut hi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa ka Pasian kungah ka thum a, akung ah: Khelnaphuonna ka nei a, “Aw Mangpa Pasian thupi leh chizat huoi, Ama itte leh athupieh zuite kunga thuhun leh khotuona vomzingpa."},"5":{"text":"Koute kana khielta ua, silgilou ka na bawlta uhi; giloutah in kana gamta ua, tualeh kana helta uhi; Na thuhilnate leh Na danthute kana pielmangsanta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ka leengte u’leh ka miliente u’leh, Kapu ka pate u’leh gam sunga mi zousiete kunga Na min a thu na gen na suoh guolneite thugen ka na ngaikheta sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Aw Mangpa dihtatna khu Nanga ahi a, hinanleh tuni a mabangin koute adingin maizumna ahi; Juda mite, Jerusalem a tengte leh Israel mi zousiete na tung a amuonhuoi louna zieh ua, anai leh agamla leh gam chin a, na tunga gitlouna abawl zieh ua, na delzahte lah tuabangma ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na tunga ka na kheltah zieh un maizumna koute leh ka leengte u’leh ka miliente u’leh ka pu ka pate u’tung ah atungta hi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa i Pasian kungah khotuona leh ngaidamna a um a, Ama tungah na helta nanlei zong."},"10":{"text":"Asuoh guolneite zanga, Ka masang ua akoi adante zuiin, Mangpa Ka Pasian uh aw ka na ngaikhe sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi, Israelte zousie in, na aw angaikhiet louna ding un hing lampielsan in, na dan abawtseta uhi. Tuaziehin Pasian suohpa Mosi danbu sunga kigiel hamsietna leh kihahsielna ka tung uah sunbuoh in a umta hi; Atunga kana kheltah zieh un."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Aman ka tung ua vangsietna thupitah hing tutin koute tung leh ka vaihawm-thukhente uh tunga athugen asudetta hi; aziehpen Jerusalem tunga kibawl bangin vannuoi pumpi zong akibawlkha ngai nai sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Mosi dan a kigiel bangin tam vangsietna zousie ka tung uah ahing tunga, hinanleh kouten ka khelnate ua pat hing kihei a na thutah ka theisiem theina ding un, Mangpa ka Pasian uh masang ah thungetna ka neikha nalai sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n vangsietnate ana koizinga, ka tung uah ahing tung sahta hi, aziehpen Mangpa ka Pasian u’khu asilbawl zousie a dihtat ahi a, kouten A aw ka mangtuom sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh tuin Aw Mangpa ka Pasian uh, Izipt gam a kipat a na mite khut hattah a hing puidoh a, tunia ma banga na min umden ding a kibawlpa aw, koute ka na khielta ua, giloutah in ka bawlta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ka hing ngen ahi, na dihtatna zousie dungzuiin, na khopi Jerusalem, na muol siengthou apat in, na thangpaina leh na lungthahna kiheimangsah in, aziehpen ka khelnate uleh kapu ka pate uh thulimlounate ziehin Jerusalem leh na mite ka kim ka vel ua umte zousiete simmaw in ka umta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aw ka Pasian uh tuin, na suohpa thumna leh thungetna ngaikhie inlen, akisesa na munsiengthou tungah Mangpa ziehin na mel tangsah in."},"18":{"text":"Aw ka Pasian na bil hingdaw inlen, ngai in, Na mit hah inlen, ka sietdan uleh na min a kihan khopi khu en in; ka dihtatnate u’zieh a ka thungetnate uh na masanga hing tut ka hisih ua, na khotuona thupitah zieh ahizaw hi."},"19":{"text":"Aw Mangpa ngai in! Aw Mangpa ngaidam in! Aw Mangpa ngaikhie inlen bawlin, Nangma min ziehin zekai sin; Ka Pasian aw, na khopi leh na mite khu Nangma min a kilou a hi uhi,” ka chi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuin ka thugen lai, ka thum lai leh ka khelna leh ka mi Israelte khelnate phuonga, Mangpa ka Pasian masanga, muol siengthou a dinga, thungetnate ka tut lai in;","title":"Gabriel kigolna"},"21":{"text":"ahi, thungetna a thu ka gen lai in, mengmuna amasalam a ka mu pa Gabriel khu nitahlam kithoina sillat hun vel in hattah in ahing leenga ka kungah ahing tung hi.","ref":"Luk. 1.19,26"},"22":{"text":"Aman thu ahing hil a, ahing houpi a, ka kungah, “Aw Daniel, pilna leh theisiemna hing pe dingin tuin ka hing pei hi."},"23":{"text":"Na thunget chiil apat in, thupieh apawtdoh a, nang hing hil dinga hing pei ka hi; aziehpen nang nahpitah a itpa na hi a, tuazieh in athu ngaituo inlen, mengmuna theisiem in."},"24":{"text":"“Tawnkhelna suhbeina ding leh khelnate tawpna bawl ding leh, gitlouna a dinga kilemna bawlna ding leh kumtawn dihtatna lahlutna ding leh mengmuna leh genlawhna khakhumna ding leh Munsieng thou pen sathau nuna dingin, na mite leh na khopi Siengthou tungah hapta sawmsagi guot ahi.","title":"Hapta sawmsagi mengmuna"},"25":{"text":"Tuazieh in thei inlen theisiem in, Jerusalem tungding kia ding leh lamtha dinga thupieh apawtdoh akipata Mang Messiah hing tun dongchieng, hapta sawmguh leh ni ahi dinga, agawl zingte leh akul baangte, hun buoihuoilaitah sunga kilam ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh hapta sawmguh leh ni zou chiengin, Messiah satkhieh in a um ding a, bangma anei sih ding hi; tualeh ahing pei ding leengpa miten khopi leh munsiengthou asuse ding uhi, tualeh hun tawpna khu tuisanglet bangin ahing tung ding a, atawp dongin kidouna a um dinga, sietnate pen guotsa ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh aman mi tampite toh thuhun kiptah hapta khat sunga ding abawl dinga, tualeh hapta kimkhat ah kithoina leh sillatte atawpsah ding hi, tualeh akidahhuoinate uh atam sengtah luot zieh in, aman asegawpsah dinga, atawp tandong in ahing tung ding a, guotsa lungthahna susegawpmi tung ah sunbuoh in a um ding hi.”","ref":"Dan. 11.31; 12.11; Mat. 24.15; Mak. 13.14"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Persia leengpa Sairas vaihawm kum thumna ah amin Belteshazzar kichi Daniel kungah kilahna khat pieh in a um hi. Tua kilahna thupuoh adih a, hinanleh ahun kiguot asau a, tualeh aman tua thupuoh khu atheisiem a, tualeh mengmuna theisiemna anei hi.","title":"Mengmuna hun"},"2":{"text":"Tua nite sungin, Kei Daniel in hapta thum sung pumpi ka suun hi."},"3":{"text":"Ann tuitah ka ne sih a, zu leh sa mawngmawng ka kam sungah alut sih a, ahisihleh hapta thum achin masangsie in sathau zong ka kinu vawt sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuin aha khatna ni sawmni leh li niin, Tigris luipi lien gei a ka din laiin."},"5":{"text":"Ka dahtou a ka et leh, Ngaivawi, puonmalngat sil mi koi ahiei khat, akawng Uphaz sana chiimtah a kigah ka mu hi.","title":"Mengmuna a vanlam thuphapuo muna","ref":"Kihil. 1.13-15; 2.18; 19.12"},"6":{"text":"A tahsa pumpi beril suong mantam abanga, amaitang kilatdan tunphe abanga, amittegel meisel kuong bang ahi a, abante leh akengte sum-eng nawtval bang leh a aw suoh ging khu mitampi aw ging bang ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tua mengmuna mu Kei Daniel maimai in ka mu ahi a, ka kunga um miten amu sih uhi; hinanleh zauna chizat huoi atung uah atunga, tuachi’n ataizah ua, akibu uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin tami mengmuna ka mu laiin keimatang a nuasie in ka um a, tualeh thalezung mawngmawng ka neita sih hi; tualeh ka mel lah mishi mel bangin amuol a, thahatna mawngmawng ka nei nawnta sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh athugen ging ka za a, tualeh athugen ging ka zah lai in, ka mai lei lam a kunsuh in ka bohkhupa, ka mai tuolsu in nuomtahin ka na imu hit hietta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n thakhat in khut khat in ahing khoi a, tuami’n ka khutphang leh ka khupte a kingam in chitun kawmkawm in ahing phongtou hi.","title":"Vanlam thuphapuoin a khoina"},"11":{"text":"Aman ka kungah “Aw Daniel nasatah a itpa na kunga ka thugente theisiem inlen dingtangin, azieh pen na kunga kei hing kisawl ahi” achi hi. Tam thu ka kunga agenlai in, chitun kawm in ka dingta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, “Zausin Daniel, theisiemna deina zieh leh na Pasian mai a kingaingiem dinga, na lungsim na pieh ni masapen apat, na thugente zah ahita a, tualeh na thute zieh a kei hing pei ka hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Persia gam uhpipan ni sawmni leh khat sung ahing doudal a, hinanleh en vawi Mikael houtute lah a lienpen khat kei hing panpi dingin ahing pei a, khunah keimatangin Persia leengte toh nuasie in ka umta hi.","ref":"Kihil. 12.7"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n ni nukhialam chienga, na mite tunga bang ahiei hing tung ding chi, hing theisiem sah ding a hing pei ka hi, mengmuna lah nitampi nua chienga ding ahi bou hi, achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tam thute ka kunga agen sungin, ka mai tuol suin ka kunsuh a, hamtheilou in ka umta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh thakhat in, mihing tapate mel bang puo mi khat in ka nephute ahing khoipieh a, tuachi’n ka kam ka kaah a, tualeh thu ka genta a, ka mai a dingpa kungah, “Aw ka mangpa, mengmuna ziehin lungkhamna leh patauna in ka dim a, thalezung mawngmawng ka neita sih hi, kachi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tam ka mangpa suohpa’n bangchin ka mangpa ahoupi thei diei? Ken lah thalezung mawngmawng ka nei nawnta sih a, ka nah hu nangawn a um zou nawn sih hi.”"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua mihing mel bang popa’n ahing khoikia a, ahing asuhatta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Nahpitah a itpa aw, zau sin, na kung ah hamuonna um heh, hattah in um inlen, ahi hat in” ahing chi hi, Tuabanga ahing houpi lai in, “Kei khu hatsah in ka umta hi. Ka Mangpa aw, Nangman na hing suhhattah ziehin, Ka Mangpa’n thu gen heh,” ka chita hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman: “Na kunga bangzieh a hing haw ka hiei chi na thei ei? Tualeh tuin Persia leengpa dou dingin ka kilekia pai dinga, ka peidoh zou chiengin Greek leengpa ahing kuon ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Laisiengthou sunga kigiel Thutah nang kang hil ding, na Mangpa Mikael chiloungal ahing doupi thei ding koima a um sih hi, achi hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mede mi Darius vaihawm kum, akum khatna kum in, keima mama ama sudet ding leh suhat dingin ka dingta hi.","title":"Persia leeng vaihawmna"},"2":{"text":"“Tuin thutah kang hil ding hi: Ngai in, Persia gam sungah leeng thum ahing dingdoh nalai dinga, alina pen adangteng sanga hausa zaw tham ahi ding; ahausatna zieh a athahatna in Greek leenggam pumpi dou dingin mi zousie atohthou ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n vangletna thupitah toh vaihawm ding leeng hattah khat ahing dingdoh dinga, a utdan danin agamta ding hi.","title":"Greek leenggam vaihawmna"},"4":{"text":"Ama ahing dindoh hun chiengin a leenggam akehzah dinga, kawlkil li ah khenzah in a um ding hi, hinanleh ahah asuonte kungah lah hilou ahisihleh avangletna a, avaihawmna lah hidiehlou in, aleenggam pen bawdoh a, tam mite hilou midangte kunga pieh ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tuachi’n simlam leengpa ahing hat dinga, alamkaite lah a khat ama sangin ahatzaw ding a, thuneina anei ding hi. Athuneina khu thuneina thupitah ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumbangza ahiei nuachiengin, amaute ahing kizomkhawm ding ua, simlam leengpa tanu khu mallam leengpa kungah pangkhawm dinga kinoptuona bawl dingin ahing pei ding hi, hinanleh amanu’n athahatna vangletna aneiden sih ding a, tualeh amapa zong athuneina ading zou tuom sih ding hi, hinanleh tua hun a amanu hing zawpite leh ama hingtu apa leh ama suhatpa toh piehdoh in a umta ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Hinanleh amanu zungzamte ba meng khat apat mi khat ama mun ah ahing dingdoh dinga, ama galkap hon toh ahing kuon dinga, mallam leengpa kul sung ah alut dinga, tualeh amauh adou dinga, azou ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aman a pasiente uh, amilimsunthute u’leh dangka leh sana a kibawl a um leh bel manphate uh Izipt gam lam ah apomang ding hi. Aziehpen ama’n kum bangza ahiei sung mallam leengpa dou lou a khawlsan ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n mallam leengpa’n simlam leengpa asim dinga, hinanleh ama gamlam mama ah akinualekia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Ahivang in atapate gal dou dingin akitawhthou ding ua, galkap hon tamtah akhawm khawm ding ua, tualeh galkap honten tuisanglet bangin anawh ding ua, simlam leengpa kulpi dong adou ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh simlam leengpa alungthah mama in ahing kuonkhe dinga, mallam leengpa toh akidou ding uhi. Tualeh galkap hon thupitah nei nanleh a guollel ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua galkap honte a puimang tah chiengin alungtang ahing kiliensah ding a, mi tul tampi athat dinga, hinanleh aguolzou den sih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen mallam leengpa ahing peikia ding a, amasanga sanga tamzaw tham mipi tamtah toh ahing kuondoh dinga, kum bangza ahiei nuachieng in, galkap hon leh galvan tamtah toh ahing kuon ngeingei ding hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tua hun chiengin, simlam leengpa douin mi tampi ahing dingdoh ding ua, na mite lah apat in hiemngamte mengmuna sutangtung dingin ahing kitawisang ding ua, hinanleh aguollel ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n mallam leengpa ahing kuon dinga, kidouna leipalte atou ding a lei asepvum dinga khopi kulpi nei khat ala dinga, tualeh simlam leengpa galkapten anang zou sih ding uhi; ami hat teltuomte nangawn in zong, nan zouna ding thahatna anei sih ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh ama dou dinga hing kuonpa’n a ut dan dan in abawl dinga, amai a ding zou koima a um sih ding hi. Ama gam thupi ah adingdoh dinga, akhut suhsiet in a um ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A leenggam pumpi thahatna zousie toh hing lut atum dinga, midihte ama toh tambangin abawl ding hi. Tualeh a kungah numeite tanu susiet ding in akungah ape dinga, hinanleh amanu ama toh apangkhawm sih dinga, amapa ading zong ahisih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuazouchiengin aman amai tuipi gei gamte lam ah ahei dinga, tua gamte tampi ala ding hi. Hinanleh vaihawm lien khat in akisahtheina khu atawpsah dinga, ami gensietna khu ama tung mama ah atusah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama gam lam kulpite ah amai ahei kia dinga, hinanleh akipal dinga, apua ding hi, tualeh mukhah ahinawn sih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Ama mun ah mi khat leenggam thupina a siekhon mi khat ahing dingdoh dinga hinanleh ni tomnoukhat sungin, lungthahna zieh hilou kidouna zieh zong hilouin suhmang in a um ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh ama mun ah misimmawhuoi khat ahing dingdoh dinga, akungah leenggam zatatna apesih ding uhi; hinanleh lemna thu toh ahing kuon dinga, zebawlna toh leenggam asim ding hi.","title":"Kii neu Antiokus Epiphane"},"22":{"text":"Tuisan luong banga galkap hon thahatna in amai akipan in phietmangin a um ding ua, asuse gawp ding ua, thuhun leengtapa nangawn zong suhmang thai in a um ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh ama toh kithukimna abawlzoutah chiengin zuoutat tahin abawl dinga, mi tawmnoukhat toh thuneina nei in ahing khangkhe ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Galmuongtah in gamkai sunga mun hausa penpen te ah alut ding a, apate leh a puten abawl ngailou uh sil ahing bawl dinga, amaute lah ah gallah vante leh gallah sumte leh ahausatnate ahawmzah ding hi; kulpi dettahte sim dingin aguh in thu aphiel dinga, hinanleh hun tomnoukhat sung ahi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Simlam leengpa kidoupi dingin galkap hon thupitah toh, asilbawltheina leh ahansanna atohthou ding hi. Tualeh simlam leengpa zong galdou dingin agalkap hon tampitah leh hattahte toh tawhthou in a umta ding hi; hinanleh ama douna dinga athuguh phielte zieh un ading zou sih ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi, ama ann tuitah nete mama in ama asumangthai ding ua, agalkap honte phietmang in a um dinga, mitampite tha in a um ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tam leengte gel, silgilou tupna lungtang pokawm in, dawkan khat ah a toukhawm ding ua, zuouthu agenkhawm ding uhi, hinanleh alawching sih ding ua, atawpna ding pen ahun guotsa a hing tung ding ahizieh in."},"28":{"text":"Mallam leengpa hausatna thupitah toh agam lam a akinuale kia lai in, a lungtang in thuhun siengthou adou ding a, a dei bang bangin abawl ding a, tuachi’n ama gam lam ah akile kia ding hi."},"29":{"text":"“Hun kiguotsa ah ahing kinuale kia dinga, simlam ah akuon dinga, hinanleh amasang a bang khu, a nua ah ahinawn sih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Aziehpen Saipras apat tembawhte ama dou dingin ahing kuon ding ua, tuazieh in ama alunggim mama dinga, thuhun siengthou dou dingin lungthah tahin akinuale dinga, a ut ut in abawl ding hi. Tuachi’n ahing kinuale kia ding a thuhun siengthou nuangat a taisante tungah deisahna alangsah ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh galkapte ama lam ah apang ding ua, amaun munsiengthou kulpite asubua ding ua, tuachi’n nisim kithoina sillatte alamang dinga, sietna tuntu kidahhuoi atungdoh zawta ding uhi.","ref":"Dan. 9.27; 12.11; Mat. 24.15; Mak. 13.14"},"32":{"text":"Giloutah a thuhun dou mite maitangphat in a suse ding hi, hinanleh a Pasian uh thei mite pen ahat ding ua, sil thupitah abawldoh ding uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh mite lah a theisiemna neiten mi tampite athuhil ding uhi, hinanleh ni tampi sung namsau leh meikuong, saltaana leh gallah vante in apua ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"Apua chiengun panpina themkhat amu ding uhi, hinanleh mitampiten akamsiemna utoh abel ding uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh theisiemna nei mite lah a lawikhat halsieng ding, suhsieng ding leh huntawp donga suhsiengthou ahi theina dingun apua ding uhi, aziehpen hun guotsa a ding ahi nalai hi."},"36":{"text":"“Tuachi’n leengpa’n ama utdan dan in sil abawl ding a, pasien chinteng tungah kitawisang in ama leh ama kipahtawi in akikoisang ding a, pasiente Pasian dou in thumahtahte agen ding a, thangpaina hun suhbukim ahi masangsie alawching ding hi; aziehpen guot a umsa sil kibawl teitei ding ahi.","title":"Ama kipahtawi leengpa","ref":"2 Thes. 2.3,4; Kihil. 13.5,6"},"37":{"text":"Aman apu apate Pasian ahita zong in numeite lunggul ahita zong in ahisihleh, pasien dang mawng mawng zong zatatna ape sih ding a, tuate zousie tunglam ah ama leh ama akipahtawi ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute mun ah kulpite pasien azatat zaw dinga, apulepate theingailou pasien, sana, dangka leh suongmantamte leh sil hoi tahtahte in azatatbawl ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Tambangin ama’n gamdang pasien panpina toh kulpi detpente adou dinga, ama’n atheipi dinga, athupinain akhangsah ding hi, tualeh amaute mi tampite tung ah vai ahawmsah dinga, punna ding in gam ahawm ding hi."},"40":{"text":"“Atawpna hun ah simlam leengpa’n ama ahing dou ding a, mallam leengpa zong ama dou dingin pingpei bang mai in sakolleng toh, sakol tungtuong mi toh, tembawh tampi toh, ahing kuon ding hi; tualeh gamte ah alut ding a, tualeh amaute atummang ding a, apei galkai ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Ama gam Thupitah ah zong alut dinga, tualeh gam tampite azou ding hi; hinanleh tamte akhut apat asuohta ding uhi: Edom leh Moab tualeh Ammon mipi lamkai liente bang."},"42":{"text":"Ama’n gamte tung ah akhut alaam ding a, Izipt gam asuohta sih ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Ama’n Izipt gam a sana, dangka leh gou manphate zousie tung ah thu anei dinga, Libia mite leh Ethiopia mite in aketot azui ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Hinanleh simlam akipat leh mallam akipat thuthangte’n ama apatausah ding a, tuazieh in mi tampi sumang ding leh suchimit kilkel ding in ama lungthah tah in akuondoh ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Tualeh aman aleeng puonbuhte tuipi leh amuol siengthou thupitah kikaal ah azah dinga, hinanleh atawp in ama beina ahing tung dinga koiman ama apanpi vawt sih ding hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tua hun chiengin na mite tapate dinga na ding zelpa, lamkai thupitah Mikael adingdoh dinga, Namte um chiil a kipat tuni hun donga na umkha ngainailou lungdon chizatna hun ahing um ding: tualeh tua hun chiengin na mite laibu sunga min kigiel kimukha pouma hutdohin a um ding uhi.","title":"Atawpna hunte","ref":"Kihil. 12.7; Mat. 24.21; Mak. 13.19; Kihil. 7.14; 12.7"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh alah ua mi tampi leitunga leivui lah a imute khu ahing khanglouta ding ua, kimkhatte kumtawn hinna tang dingin, tualeh kimkhatte zumna leh kumtawn simmawna tang ding in.","ref":"Isai. 26.19; Mat. 25.46; Jn. 5.29"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh apilte pen van a vahnate bangin ataang ding ua, tualeh mi tampi dihtatna lam a heite khu aasite bangin kumtawn kumtawn in ataang denta ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh nang aw Daniel thute khahkhum inlen, laibu khu atawp hun tan adingin kha in; mi tampi asuhtai atoutai ding ua, theina apung ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 22.10"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kei Daniel in ka en a, tualeh ngai in, mi dang ni ka mai ah a ding uhi; khat lui gei tamlang pang ah, tualeh khat pen luigei khumlang pang ah, a ding uhi.","title":"Buoina thupitah hun ding."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh khat in, puonmalngat sil a lui tuite tunga umpa kungah, Tam sil lamdangte tawpna ding bangtan a sawt ding ahiei?” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n puonmalngat sil a lui tuite tunga umpa in akhut zietlam leh akhut veilam vanlam ah azahtou a, Ama kumtawn a ahing zingpa min a kichiem in, hun khat leh hunte leh hun kimkhat sung ahi ding a, tualeh Misiengthoute thuneina asiet dimdem nua chiengin, tam silte zousie zaw ahita ding achi ka zata hi.","ref":"Kihil. 10.5; Kihil. 12.14"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Keima’n kaza a hinanleh ka theisiem sih hi. Tuachi’n “Aw ka Mangpa, tam silte tawpna bang hi ding ahiei?” ka chi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Ama’n Daniel aw, “Na peina ding ah peita in; aziehpen tawpna hun dong a dinga thute khah leh sinkhum ahita hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi tampite suhsiengthou ahi ding ua, suhngou ahi ding ua, sienthousah in a um ding uhi; hinanleh migilouten giloutah in abawl ding ua, migiloute lah a koima’n atheisiem sih ding ua, hinanleh mipilten atheisiem ding uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 22.11"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh nichin kithoina sillat lahmang ahi a, sietna bawltu kidahhuoi tundoh ahi hun akipat in ni tul khat zani leh sawmkuo a um ding hi.","ref":"Dan. 9.27; 11.31; Mat. 24.15; Mak. 13.14"},"12":{"text":"Koi zong ni tul khat leh zathum leh sawmthum leh nga, ngah kenkon a, tua huntan tung mi khu mi hampha ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh nang pen atawpna atun masangsiein na peina ding ah peita in, na khawldam dinga, nite tawpna ah, na gouluona mun ah na thoudoh ding hi,” achi hi."}}}}},"28":{"info":{"name":"Hosea","shortname":"Hos.","abbr":[],"desc":"Hosea laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda gam a leengte Uzzia, Jotham Ahaz leh Hezekiah ten vai ahawm lai uleh Joash tapa Jeroboam in Israel gam leeng vai ahawm lai a, Beeri tapa Hosea kunga Mangpa thu hing tung khu tami ahi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 15.1-7; 2 Khang. 26.1-23; 2 Leeng. 15.32-38; 2 Khang. 27.1-8; 2 Leeng. 16.1-20; 2 Khang. 28.1-27; 2 Leeng. 18.1—20.21; 2 Khang. 29.1—32.33; 2 Leeng. 14.23-29"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n Hosea kam manga thu agen pat laiin, Mangpa’n Hosea kungah, “Gam in Mangpa taisan a, kizuana thupitah abawltaah ziehin, Pei inlen kizua mite tate lah a, kizua mi khat zi in va neiin,” achi hi.","title":"Hosea zineina"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n ava pei a, Diblaim tanu Gomer azi dingin alata hi, tualeh amanu agai a, Hosea adingin tapa khat anei piehta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Hosea kungah, “Amin dingin Jezreel hisah in, aziehpen tomkhat zou chiengin, Jehu innkuonte tungah, Jezreel sisan phuba kala pai ding hi, tualeh Israel innkuonte leenggam ka beisah ding hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 10.11"},"5":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Jezreel phaijang ah Israel thalpi ka tansah ding hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Gomer agai kia a, tanu khat anei hi. Tuachi’n Pasian in Hosea kungah, “Israel innkuonte ka lainat nawnlou ding ziehin, na tanu min dingin Lo Ruhamah na hisah ding ahi. Aziehpen Israel innkuonte ka khotuo nawn sih ding a, hinanleh ka sumang kilkel ding hi, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahivang in Juda innkuonte tungah lainat ka nei ding a, Mangpa a Pasian un amauh ka hundam ding hi, thalpite, namsaute, kidounate leh sakolte leh sakol tungtuong mite in amaute ka hundam sih ding hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Gomer in Lo-Ruhamah nawineh akhawlsah zouin agai kia a, tapa khat anei hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in: “Amin dingin Lo-Ammi hisah in, aziehpen nou ka mite na hisih ua, tualeh kei zong na Pasian uh ka hisih ding hi achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel tate tamdan pen koima te senglou leh koima simsenglou, tuipi pieu a senel bang ahi ding ua, “Noute, ka mite hisih uteh” kichina mun ah, “Noute, Pasian hing tate nahi uh,” akung uah chi ahita ding uhi.","title":"Israel tunding kiana","ref":"Rom. 9.26"},"11":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin Juda mite leh Israel mite akigawmkhawm kia dinga, tualeh amaun lamkai khat akiguot ding ua, khum gam apat in ahing peitou ding uhi, Jezreel ni khu thupi ding ahiziehin."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na sanggampate uh kungah Ammi chi unlen, na sanggamnute uh kungah Ruhamah, chi un."},"2":{"text":"“Na nu genpi unlen, ngawh un, amanu ka zi ahisih a, Kei zong apasal ka hisih hi! Amaitang apat akizuanate leh, anawite gel kikaal apat in, a angkawmnate koimang heh.","title":"Israel khelna leh hagaulam angkawmna"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahisihleh apuonsilte ka hawhkhe dinga, guohtang in ka umsah dinga, gamdai bangin ka bawl dinga, gamgaw bangin ka koi ding a, dangta in ka thatlia kha ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Atate ka khotuo sih ding hi, kizua tate ahi ziehun."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen anu uh akizua a, amaute painu in zumhuoi tahin abawlta hi. Amanu’n, Ka tanghou leh ka tui, ka samul leh ka puonnem, Ka sathau leh ka dawn ding hing pie, ka itte nuazui ding ka hi, achi ziehin."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin ngai in, na lampite lingin ka khabing dinga, bang ka bawlkhum ding a, apeinate amu thei sih ding hi.","title":"Pasian thutanna"},"7":{"text":"Ama itte anuadel dinga, hinanleh adelpha sih ding hi; Ahi amauh asui dinga, hinanleh amu sih ding hi. Tuachi’n ama’n ka pasal masa kungah ka nua peikia ding hi, aziehpen tua khu Kei a dingin tu a sangin ahoizaw hi, achi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen a manu’n bute, uoin thate leh sathaute, ka pie a, tualeh Baal a dinga abawl uh dangka leh sanate ka suhpung pieh lam athei sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka kinuale kia dinga, ka bute alah hun laitah chiengin ka lamang ding a, ka uoin thate alah hun chiengin ka lamang dinga, tualeh asaguoh khuna samulpuon leh puonmalngat ka nualah pieh kia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuin amanu itte mitmu in azamaw ka dawhsah ding a, Koima’n ka khut apat ahunkhe zou sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Aguolnopnate zousie, apawite, ahathate, akhawlnite leh a annzaluina thupitahte ka sutawp nalai ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh a grepguite leh atheipi kungte, ka suhsiet pieh ding hi; Aman: Tamte kei hing itte apat a ka kipahman ahi, achite khu, Ken tuate gammang lah ka suohsah dinga, gamsaten ane ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Baal pasiente abieh ua, akung ua gimnamtuite ahal lai nite u’zieh a amaute gawt ding ka hi. Amanu bilba leh suongmantamte a kizem a, amanu itte nuadel in, Kei ahing manghilta hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tuaziehin ngai in, ama ka zawl dinga, gamdai ah ka puilut ding a, akungah lungmuonhuoi tah in thu kagen ding hi.","title":"Israel tunding kiana"},"15":{"text":"Khuna kipat in a grephuonte ama ka pe dinga, tualeh Akor phaijang kinepna kotpi ka suohsah ding a, khunah akhangdawn lai bangin la asa ding a, Izipt gam a kipat a ahing pawtdoh lai nite bangin la asa ding hi.","ref":"Josh. 7.24-26"},"16":{"text":"“Tualeh tua ni chiengin tambang ahi dinga, nouten kei khu Ishi na hing chi ding uh a, Baali na hing chi nawn sih ding uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"17":{"text":"A kam apat in Baalte minte ka lamang ding a, Tualeh aminte ua theizing in aum nawn sih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Gamlah a gamsate toh, tunga leeng vate toh, ganhing leitunga bohvahte toh, thuhun ama ua dingin, ka bawlpieh ding a, thalpite, namsaute, kidounate, leitung apat in ka subei ding a, amaute galmuong tahin ka lumsah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumtawn a kei a dingin, ka hing khamta dinga, Ahi, dihtatna leh thudih a vaihawmna toh itna muonhuoi leh, khotuona in ka hing khaam ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ginumna toh keima dingin, ka hing khaam ding a, tualeh Mangpa na thei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Tua ni chiengin tambang ahing hi ding a: Keima’n ka dawng ding a, Keima’n vante ka dawng ding a, amaun leitung a dawng ding uhi; Mangpa’n achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Leitungin bu leh uoin tha, tualeh sathau toh a dawng dinga, Amaun Jezreel adawng ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama pen Kei a dingin lei ah haichi bangin ka tu dinga, khotuona mu ngailounu, ka khotuo dinga, Tuachi’n Ka mi hiloute kungah, ka mite na hi uh chi vangin, amaun ka Pasian na hi, ahing chi ding uhi.”","ref":"Rom. 9.25; 1 Pet. 2.10"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Pei kia inlen, numei midang toh kingai lai, angkawmnu va it in; Israel taten pasien dangte lam a kihei in, grep ga gaw tanghoute ngaina nan uleh, Mangpa’n a it zing mabangin,” achi hi.","title":"Gomer leh Hosea kiten kiana Pasian itna tultheilou"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Keima a dingin amanu dangka shekel sawm leh nga leh barli bu homer khat leh homer kimkhat in ka leita hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ken amanu kungah, “Ka kungah ni tampi na umden ding a, na kizua nawn sih dinga, pasal koima dang zi na hi sih dinga, tuamabangin Kei zong nanga ka hi ding hi,” ka chi hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Israel tate a dingin leeng ahisihleh vaihawm umnonsihvan, kithoina ahisihleh milim khuomte umnonsihvan, siempu puonah ahisihleh teraphim umnonsihvan, ni tampi tambangin a um ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuazou chiengin Israel tate ahing kinuale kia ding ua, Mangpa a Pasian u’leh, David aleengpa uh asui ding ua, tualeh ni nukhia lamte ah Mangpa leh ahoina zau kawm in ahing zuon ding uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nou Israel tate aw, Mangpa thu ngaiun, Aziehpen gam sunga tengte tungah, Mangpa’n ngawhna ahing tun ding hi, gam sungah thutah a um nawn sih a, gin umna leh hepina a um nawn sih a, Pasian theina mawngmawng a um sih hi.","title":"Israelten Pasian thei utlou"},"2":{"text":"Kichiemna leh zuougenna, tuolthana, guhtatna leh angkawmna bawlin, sisan, suona ngenin apum dim siengta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin gam in asuun dinga; tualeh khuna tengte zousie, gamsate leh tunga leeng vate, aba gawp siengta ding ua, tuipi a um ngate zong lahmang in a um ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahivang in koima kihau sih henlen, koima khat leh khat kiphawh sih u’heh, na mite pen siempu kihaupite bang ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin suntang laiin na kipalpua dinga, guolneipa zong zanlai in nang toh apua ding a; Tualeh na nu ka sumangthai ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka mite theina atahsap zieh un, suhmangthai in a um uhi. Theina na nuol ziehun, Ken zong ka siempu na hina uapat in, ka hing nuol ding hi. Na Pasian dan na manghiltah ziehin, Ken zong na tate ka manghil ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A hing pun tam deudeu u’leh, ka tungah akhiel tam deudeu uhi; athupina uh zumnain ka heng ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka mite khelna kivahnain anei ua, alungtang uh athulimlouna uah anga uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahi ding: Mipite leh siempute akibang ahi ding ua, agamtatnate uh ziehin amauh ka gawt dinga, asilbawlte uh ka thuh ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ane ding ua, atai tuom sih ding uhi; aziehpen amaun Mangpa thumanna atawpsanta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Kizuana, zu leh zu tha in lungtang sal in ataangsah hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka miten asing milimte uh kungah thu adong ua, tualeh achieng un atheisah zel uhi. Aziehpen akizuana lungsimte un amauh apielmangsah a, a Pasian uh nuasie in akizuata uhi.","title":"Israelte milim biehna"},"13":{"text":"Muol tungte ah kithoina alan ua, muolvumte, gangpi singte, begaw singte leh hiengzau sing, lim nuomtah nuoite ah gimnamtui ahal uhi. Tuaziehin na tanute uh akizua uh a, na moute un angkawm na abawl uhi."},"14":{"text":"Na tanute uh akizua chiengun, ka gawt sih dinga, na moute un ang akawm chieng un zong, amaute ka gawt sih ding hi; aziehpen pasalte nangawn zong, kizuate toh atuom in apei ua maitam ah kizuate toh, kithoina alan khawm uhi. Tuaziehin mipi atheisiemloute, akipal pua ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Nang Israel kizua nanlachin zong, Juda vang kizuana ah puasih heh, Gilgal ah hawsih unlen, Beth-Aven ah zong pei sih unlen, “Mangpa ahin a ahin pouleh,” chiin, kihahsiel in kichiem sih un."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen Israelte bawngla genha bang ahi ua, Tuin gam lientah ah Mangpa’n amaute, belamnou bangin agamta sahta ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ephraim in milimte toh akizopta, a um umin na umta heh."},"18":{"text":"A zu dawn uh atawp chiengun, kizua bangin agamta nalai lai uhi, avaihawmte un, zumhuoina gamtatte a it nalai kenkon uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hui in amanu ahate in atun a, tualeh akithoina ziehun azum ding uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siempute aw tami zaun, Israel innkuonte aw, ngaisah un, Lengpa innkuonte aw, bildaw un, Mizpah a ding a thang na hizieh u’leh, Tabor muol a lenthang kizah na hizieh un, thukhenna na tung uah tung ding ahi.","title":"Israel tunga thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Kei amaute zousie phawhhiltu na hinanleng zong, mihelte khu mithana ah akihal thuh mama uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ephraim ka thei a, Israel khu, keima lah ah phuol ahisih hi. Tu’n vang Ephraim aw, nangman kizuana na bawltah ziehin, Israel abuata hi."},"4":{"text":"A Pasian uh lam a kihei kia dingin, asilbawlte uh a tawpsan sih ua, alah uah kizuana lungsim a um a, tualeh Mangpa athei sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Israel kiletsahna in amaitang ah atheisah a, tuaziehin Israel leh, Ephraim athulimlouna uah akipalpua ding ua, Juda zong amautoh akipalpua ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa sui dingin agan honte u’leh, abelam honte utoh akuon ding ua, hinanleh amusih ding uhi, alah ua pat in akihemkheta hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa tungah lepchie tahin agamta ua, aziehpen namdang zawlta anei uhi. A hathate un amaute leh agoutante uh, ane bei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Gibeah ah belamtal ki mut unlen, Ramah ah pengkul mut un, Beth-Aven ah ngaitah in kikou unlen, Benjamin aw na nualang en in, chi un."},"9":{"text":"Phawhna ni atun chiengin, Ephraim asegawp ding a.
