Ken atung ngeingei ding silte, Israel namte lah ah ka theisah hi."},"10":{"text":"Juda miliente gamgi suondohte bang ahi ua; atung uah ka thangpaina tui bangin, ka sungbaw ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ephraim in mihing thupieh kilawp tah a azui ziehin, thukhenna ah suhgenthei leh kisegawp in a um hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuazieh in Ephraim a dingin nget bang ka hi a, Tualeh Juda innkuonte a dingin, muotna bang ka hi."},"13":{"text":"Ephraim in anatna a mu a, Juda in aliemna amu tahin, Ephraim Assiriate kungah ahaw a, Lengpa Jareb kungah a sawlta hi; hinanleh ahing sudam thei sih a, na liemnate zong adamsah thei sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Ephraim a dingin humpibahnei, bang ka hi ding a, Juda innkuonte a ding in humpibahnei, hatlai bang ka hi ding hi. Kei, Keima ngelngel in ka bottel dinga, ka peimangsan ding a, Amaute ka pomang dinga, koiman amauh ahunkhe sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"A khelna uh kiphawh a, ka mel asui masangsie uh, Ka umna ah ka kia san ding hi; agimthuohna uah kei pilvang tahin ahing sui ding uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Hing pei un, Mangpa kungah kinuale kia vai, Aman ahing bottelta a, hinanleh ahing sudam ding hi. Aman ahing liemsahta a, hinanleh ahing tuom pieh ding hi.","title":"Lunghei dinga hatna"},"2":{"text":"Ni ni nua chiengin aman ang suhal ding a; a ni thum ni in Aman ahing kaithou ding a; Amasangah i hing ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Pasian thei vai, Mangpa theina del zel vai. Zingmawng nisuoh akikhellou bangin, Ama apawtdohna suhdet ahi. Ama ikungah guozu bangin ahing pei dinga, Guo masa leh guo nukhia leitung buohnom bang in,” ahing pei ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aw Ephraim bang hing law ding kata diei? Aw Juda bang ka hing law ding adiei? Na muonhuoina uh zingmawng meilum bang ahi a, Zingmawng daitui bangin, amang pai hi.","title":"Theisasa a thuhun bawsietna"},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin guolneite zangin amaute ka heukhie a, ka kam a thute in amaute ka thatta a; tualeh vaihawmnate khovah bangin ataangkhie hi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen ken kithoina hilou in khotuona ka dei a, Tualeh halmang kithoina sangin, Pasian theina ka lunggul zaw hi.","ref":"Mat. 9.13; 12.7"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Adam bangin thuhun apalsan ua, tuachi’n lepchie tahin ka tungah agamta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Gilead khu silgilou bawlte khopi ahi a, sisan a buasah in a um hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh suomhat pawl in mi adapbuh bangun, siempu honten Sekem lampi ah mi athat ua, sil zumhuoi abawl uhi."},"10":{"text":"Israel innkuonte lah ah sil chizat huoi ka muta hi. Khunah Ephraim akizua a, Israel abuata hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka mipi saltaangte ka puikia chiengin, Aw Juda nanga ding in zong bu lah ding, ka hing guotpiehta ding hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel damsah ka tup chiengin, Ephraim thulimlouna leh, Samaria gitlouna akilangdoh zel hi. Amauten zuouthu agen ua, asung lam ah guta alut a, apulam ah suomhat hon in ana suom uhi.","title":"Theisasa a Mangpa kunga kinuale utlou"},"2":{"text":"Agitlouna zousie uh ka theizing ahi chi, alungtang un angaituo ngai sih uhi; tuin vang asilbawlte un amauh aimkimkotta a, ka masangah a um uhi."},"3":{"text":"Agitlouna un leengpa akipahsah ua, azuou gen un a miliente uh akipahsah uhi."},"4":{"text":"A bawnpi un angkawm ngen ahi ua, tanghou kangmiin tol in ajelsuoh masangsie a, tangbuong amehman zieh a mei sawn atawpsan, lungthu kisulum bang, ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"I leengpa ni chiengin, miliente zu chia dawn in akham ding ua, Aman misimmawhatte toh akhut azah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi adapbuh lai un alungtang uh, lungthukhua a mei-am sa bangin abawlzouta ua, alungthahna uh zankhuo in adai a, zingmawng in mei bangin akuongdoh hi."},"7":{"text":"A unpi un lungthukhua bangin asa ua, vaihawmte uh anetum uhi, aleengte zousie uh apua ua, alah uah koima kei hing han a um sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ephraim lah namdangte toh akigopta a, Ephraim khu tanghou kan khulelou ahi.","title":"Israel leh namdangte"},"9":{"text":"Gamdang miten athahatna anehkhawng piehta ua, hinanleh aman athei sih hi, Ahi, asatunga amulte akaang siengta a, hinanleh aman athei sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel akiletsahna in amai ah aheeh a, hinanleh Mangpa a Pasian uh kungah, akinuale kia sih ua, tamte zousie zieh in Ama asui tuom sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ephraim khu vakhu lungmawl, lunggel theilou ahi nalai a, Izipt ahan a, Assiriate kungah ahaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Apeinachinteng uah, ka len ka zah khum dinga, tungleeng vate bangin ka kaikhesuh ding hi; akhawmpite un azahsa mabangin, amaute ka phawh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Atung uh agih hi, Kei apat a ataimang ziehun! Amaute adingin sietna ahi. Ka tunga atatkhel ziehun! Amaute tankhe nanleng zong, Keima kal in zuou agen nalai uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amauten alungtang tahtah un, Kei ahing han nuom sih ua, alupna tungte uah kap leh mau in aum uhi. Bu leh zu tha a dingin akikhawm ua, ka tungah ahel uhi."},"15":{"text":"Keima mama in amaute chiil in, abantha uh hatsah nanleng zong, ka tungah silhoilou abawlsawm nalai uhi."},"16":{"text":"A nuakia ua, hinanleh Tungnung Sang Pen kungah ahisih hi; thalpi lepchie bang ahi ua, alei ua samsietnate ziehin amiliente uh, namsau in apua ding uhi. Tamte Izipt gam a, nuisat a aumna ding uh ahi ding hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na kam leh pengkul sutuo in, Ka thuhunte abotsie ua, ka danthupieh ahelsan ziehun, Ama muvanlai bangin, Mangpa innkuonte dou dingin ahing pei ding hi.","title":"Theisasa a milim biehna"},"2":{"text":"Israelte Kei lam ah akikou ding ua, Ka Pasian uh, Nang ka hing thei uhi, achi ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Israel in silhoi apaimangta a, melma in ama anuadel ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Lengte atungdoh ua, hinanleh kei bawl hilou in, miliente abawldoh ua, Ken ka theikha sih hi. Kei apat satkhieh a a umna dingun, adangka uleh sanate un milim abawl uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aw Samaria, na bawngnou milim nuol ahita, Ka lungthahna atung uah akuong hi. Mawna bei a ahing umna ding uh, bangtan vei hiding adiei?"},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen bawngnou milim Israelte akipat ahi a, akhutsiemte un abawl ua, tuazieh in Pasian ahi sih hi. Hinanleh Samaria bawngnou milimte, akeh in akise gawp ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hui atu ua, pingpei a at uhi. Bukung in vui anei sih a, bu vui in neh ding apieng sah sih ding a, piengsah tamananleh gamdang miten anebei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Israel nawmval in a umta a, tuin um leh bel deihuoilou bangin Jentelte lah ah a umta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen Assiria gam a peitou gam sabiltung tangtat bang ahi uhi. Ephraim in alawmngaite a guoita hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi, namte lah ah kiguoitama nan u’leh, tu in ken amaute ka khawm dinga, tualeh miliente leengpa puohgih ziehin, hun tomkhat lunggimna athuoh zuol ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ephraim in khelna dinga maitam tampi abawl ziehin, maitamte khu ama a dingin khelna ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute a dingin ka danpieh thupite ka gielta a, Hinanleh tuate khu sildang khat bang giapin angaisut uhi."},"13":{"text":"Kei a dinga kithoina sillat in, sa alan ua, akineh zel uhi; hinanleh Mangpa’n tuate apom sih hi. Tuin Aman athulimlouna uh athei ngitnget dinga, akhelnate uh agawt dinga, Izipt gam ah anuakia kia ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Israel in ama siempa amanghilta a, bieh innte alam hi; Juda in zong kulpi nei khopite a pungsah hi. Hinanleh keiman a khopite tungah, mei ka sawl dinga aleeng innpite uh mei in akatum ding hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Israel midangte bangin kipahin nuom sin, Aziehpen na Pasian kalin kizua in na umta hi. Na buphuol tung teng ah kizuana man na lunggul hi.","title":"Israel khelna gawtna"},"2":{"text":"Bu vuoh na phuol leh grep suhna khuh in, amauh avah sih dinga, uain tha akitasam ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa gam ah ateng sih ding ua, hinanleh Ephraim Izipt gam ah akinuale kia dinga, Assiria gam ah sil sienglou ane ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa kungah uoin sillat alansih ding ua, Ama adingin asillatte uh lungkimhuoi ahi sih ding hi. Ama ua dingin mishi suunte tanghou bang ahi ding a, ane zousie abua ding ua, aziehpen ahinna ua dingin atanghoute uh, Mangpa inn ah alut sih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ni tan guottuom ni in bang na bawl ta diei, tualeh Mangpa annkuonglui niin bang na bawl ding uoi?"},"6":{"text":"Ngai in, sietna ziehin apei ua, Izipt in amauh akhawm dinga, Memphis in amauh avui ding hi, a dangka koina munte uh lahkhai in apoukhum dinga, apuonbuh sungte uah loulingnei apou ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Gawtna nite ahing tungta a, thuhkiana nite ahing tung hi, Israel in athei ding hi! Guolneipa khu mi mo a ngai ahi a, Hagau mi zong mi mo a ngai ahi. Aziehpen na khelna uh athupi seng a, na kihuotna uh athupi seng hi.","ref":"Luk. 21.22"},"8":{"text":"Ephraim galvengpa Ka Pasian toh a umkhawm a, hinanleh guolnei khu alampi tengah vathang kampa thang ahi a, Pasian inn ah kigal bawlna a um hi."},"9":{"text":"Gibeah nite a bangin nasatah in akisuse gawpta ua, Aman athulimlounate uh athei ngitnget dinga, akhelnate uah agawt ding hi.","ref":"Vai. 19.1-30"},"10":{"text":"Gamdai a grep bangin Israel ka mu a, ahun a ga, theipi gamasa bangin na pu leh pate uh ka mu hi. Hinanleh Baal-peor langah apeita ua, zumhuoi dingin akituom koita uhi. Asil lunggulte uh bangin, amaute akidahhuoi uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 25.1-5"},"11":{"text":"Ephraim thupina va bangin aleengmang dinga, nau pieng lou dinga, gai umlou ding a, naupai zong umlou ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tate khoi lien nan u’leh, Ken a maute ka suunsah sieng dinga, atawp dongin pasal khat zong ka umsah sih ding hi. Ahi, amaute ka peisan chiengin, atung uh agih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tai-ar ka mu bangin, Ephraim khu mun nuomtah a suon ahi a, hinanleh Ephraim in tuolthat mite kungah, atate uh ahing puidoh ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Aw Mangpa amauh pie in: bang ahiei na pieh ding? Nau pai theilou naubu leh, nawitui kang nawite pie in."},"15":{"text":"A gitlouna uh Gilgal ah a um a, khunah amauh ka mudata hi. Asilbawl giloute zieh un, ka inn apat amauh ka notdoh dinga, amaute ka it nawn sih ding hi; a miliente zousie uh mihelte ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ephraim vuoh in a um a, a thahuite agaw a, ga asuong sih ding uhi. Ahi, tate nei nan u’leh, gil aga ta deihuoite ka that ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A thu amanlou zieh un, Ka Pasian in amaute apaimang ding a, tuachi’n namte lah ah vahvai ahi ding uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel pen grep ga nuomtah, ama a dinga kiga bang ahi a, aga tam dungzui in maitam apungsah deu deu hi. Agam hoina dungzuiin, milim suong kikhuoh kilawm tahtah aphut zel uhi.","title":"Israel khelna leh saltaanna"},"2":{"text":"Alungtang uh akikhen a, Tuin mawtansah in a um uhi. Ama’n amaitamte achimsah dinga, amilim suong khente uh, asuse ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuin amaun, Mangpa igiinlou zieh un, “Leengpa inei sih uhi. Tua leengpa’n ei a dingin bang ahiei abawl ding?” achi ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Thuhun bawl a zuou a kichiem in thute agen uhi. Tuabangin lou kaizousa lai a namtul hing poudoh bangin, thukhenna apoudoh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Samaria a tengte khu, Beth-Aven bawngnou milim ziehin azau ding uhi. Mipiten bawngnou milim asuun ding ua, akipahpi siempute’n, akaa ding uhi, aziehpen athupina in apawtsan taah zieh in."},"6":{"text":"Tua milim khu Assiria leengpa Jareb kunga, silpieh dingin akipo dinga, Ephraim in zalatna amu ding a, tualeh Israel in ama lemguotna ah amaizum law ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Samaria ahileh, aleengpa tui tunga kilam chiengkang bangin, sattan ahi ding."},"8":{"text":"Israel khelna Aven mun sangte zong suhsiet ahi ding hi. Amaitamte uh tungah ling leh loulingneite apou ding a; tualeh amaun taangte kungah hing khukhum un, muolte kungah hing netkhum un, achi ding uhi.","ref":"Luk. 23.30; Kihil. 6.16"},"9":{"text":"Aw Israel Gibeah nite akipat in nana khielta hi; khunah na ding ua. Thulimlouna tate tunga Gibeah a kidouna in, amauh a nuaphah sih hi.","title":"Mangpa’n Israel tungah thukhenna apuong","ref":"Vai. 19.1-30"},"10":{"text":"Amauh ka phawh ut chiengin ka phawhhil ding hi. Tualeh abawsietna uh thuo nite zieh a, phawhhil ahi hun chiengun, amauh dou dingin mipite ahing kikhawm ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ephraim pen bawngla chiilsiemsa ahi a, bu chil nuomtah ahi; Hinanleh keiman angawng kilawm tah ah, Ngawngkol ka posah ding a, lou ka kaisah ding. Juda in lei akal dinga Jakob in leitangte asunen ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Dihtatna chi tu unlen, Khotuona at unlen; na leikhalte uh satnen un, Mangpa sui hun ahita hi, Ama ahing pei a, na tung ua dihtatna guo ahing, zuhsah masangsie Ama sui un.","ref":"Jer. 4.3"},"13":{"text":"Gitlouna na kai ua, Thulimlouna na at uhi. Na zuouthu gen ga na ne ua, aziehpen nouma gamtatnate leh, na mihat tampite uh na muong uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuazieh in na mite lah ah, buoina ahing piengdoh dinga, Shalman in kidouna ni a, Beth-Arbel asuhsiet bangin, Na kulpite zousie susiet ahi ding a, Nu in atate tuolsena’n anei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Aw Bethel na gitlouna alet seng tah zieh in, tuabangin na tungah bawl ahi ding hi. Zingmawng phalvah chiengin, Israel leengpa huoisetah a sattan in a um ding hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel naungeh ahilai in Kana itta hi. Izipt gam a kipat ka tapa ka handoh hi.","title":"Pasian in Israel it nalai lai","ref":"Pawt. 4.22; Mat. 2.15"},"2":{"text":"Amaute a hat bangun tuachi’n, amaute apat in apei ua; Baalte kungah kithoina alan ua, milim siemthute kungah gimnamtui ahal uhi."},"3":{"text":"Keima’n Ephraim aban ua kai in pei ka kizilsah a, hinanleh amauh ka sudamta chi athei sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mihing khaujen nemtah, itna khau in amauh ka kai a; Kei khu ama ua dingin, angawng ua hahkol sutkhete bang ka hi a. Ka kunsuh a amauh ka vah hi."},"5":{"text":"Izipt gam ah akinuale kia sih dinga; hinanleh Assiria khu aleengpa ahi ding, akisia utlou ziehun."},"6":{"text":"A khopite uah namsau aleeng dinga, akulpi kot kalnate uh asuse ding a, akatum ding hi, amaute mama lemguotna zieh in."},"7":{"text":"Ka mite kei apat nuatol dingin akumsuh ta ua, Tungnung sanga umpa han nan u’leh, Koiman Ama atawisang sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Ephraim, bangchin ka hing tawpsan thei diei? Israel aw, bangchi’n ka hing pekhe thei diei? Bangchi’n Admah bangin ka hing bawl thei diei? Bangchi’n Zeboiim bangin nang ka hing koi thei diei? Ka sungah ka lungtang akikhule a, ka hing lainatnate akitohthou hi.","ref":"Danp. 29.23"},"9":{"text":"Ka lungthahna zauhuoi ka suohkhe sah sih ding a, Ephraim ka suse nawn sih ding hi. Aziehpen Kei Pasian ka hia, Mihing ka hisih hi. Na lah ua um a Siengthoupa ka hi a, zauhuoina toh ka hing pei sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaun Mangpa nua azui ding ua, tualeh Ama ahawh chiengin, humpibahnei bangin ahawh dinga, tuachi’n atate tumlam a kipat in, chitun kawm in ahing pei ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Izipt gam akipat in va banga, chitun kawm in ahing pei ding ua, Assiria gama pat vakhu bangin, ahing pei ding ua, Tualeh ken amaute a inn uah ka tengsah ding hi; Mangpa’n achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ephraim in zuouthu in ahing imkuol a, tualeh Israel innkuonte’n zehemna in ahing imkuol uhi; Hinanleh Juda in Pasian azui nalai a, A Siengthoupa lah ah a ginum nalai hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephriam hui in akivah a, tualeh suolam hui anuadel hi, ni chin in zuouthu leh, thagum suona akhangsah semsem uhi. Assiriate toh zong thuhun abawl ua, Izipt gam ah sathau akipolut hi.","title":"Israel leh Judate siemmawtanna"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n Juda zong akinielpi a, Jakob agamtat dan dungzui in agawt ding hi; a silbawl dungzui in athuh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Naubu a aumlai in asanggampa ketul atu a, ahatna zal in Pasian abuon hi.","ref":"Siem. 25.26\n        ;     \n        Siem. 32.24-26"},"4":{"text":"Ahi, ama’n vansawlsieng abuon a, azouta hi; akap a Ama apat deisahna angen a, Bethel ah Ama amuta a, tualeh khum mun ah Ama’n i kungah thu agen hi.","ref":"Siem. 28.10-22"},"5":{"text":"Tua khu galkapte Mangpa Pasian ahi a, Mangpa chi khu Ama theizingna min ahi."},"6":{"text":"“Tuachi’n nangpen na Pasian kungah kihei inlen, hepina leh dihna a vaihawmna tudet inlen; na Pasian ngah ngitnget in.”"},"7":{"text":"Kanaanmi lepchiete bangin Israel in, akhut ah buhna dihlou atawi a, suhgenthei a utlam ahi.","title":"Agitlou zieh ua gawt ding"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Ephraim in, “Ka hing hausata a, Keima a dingin hausatna ka muta” ka sepgimna zousie ah keima ah, thulimlouna khelna bangma amu sih ding uh, achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh kei khu Izipt gam a kipat a, Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi a, pawi kiguottuom nite lai bangin, puonbuhte ah ka hing tengsah kia ding hi.","ref":"Siempu. 23.42,43"},"10":{"text":"Ken guolneite zangin zong thu kana genta a, mengmunate ka tamsah sem sem a, Guolneite theipina mangin chiemtenate ka peta hi."},"11":{"text":"Gilead ah milimte umnanleh, amaute bangmalou ahi uh. Gilgal ah bawngtalte lan nan u’leh, Ahi, amaitamte uh loukaina a suong, kisievumte bang ahi bou hi."},"12":{"text":"Siria gam ah Jakob ataimang a, Israel in zi ding thalaw in na asem a, zi ding thalaw in belamte aching hi.","ref":"Siem. 29.1-20"},"13":{"text":"Mangpa’n guolnei zangin, Izipt gam apat in Israel apuidoh a, tualeh guolnei zangin Israel avengbit hi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.50,51"},"14":{"text":"Ephraim in nasatahin alungthah sah a, tuaziehin asisan mawna, Mangpa’n ama tung ah anga ding a, tualeh agensietna u’khu amauh tungah, akinuale sah ding hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephriam in thu agen chieng, mite achitun ua, Israelte lah ah ama leh ama akitawisang hi; Hinanleh Baal biehna khelna a apua bep in, ashita hi.","title":"Israel tunga gawtna"},"2":{"text":"Tuin akhiel semsem ua, a dangka siate un milimte asunthu ua, amauh siem dan dungzui a bawlthu ahia; Tamte zousie abawn in khutsiemte khutsuoh ngen ahia; Kithoina lan zousie in bawngnou limte tawp uhen, achi zel uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaute zingmawng tuimei bang leh, zingmawng daitui matah a mangkia bangmai, buphuol a bushi hui in amutmang bang leh, meikhulawng a pat meikhu pawt leengmang bang ahi ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Keipen, Izipt gam akipat a Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi a, Kei loungal Pasian dang na neitheilou ding uh, aziehpen Kei loungal Hundampa dang a umsih hi."},"5":{"text":"Gamdai gamgaw nasatah muna hing kempa khu Keima ka hi.","ref":"Danp. 8.11-17"},"6":{"text":"Amaute ann a ka vah chiengin atai ua, atai chieng un alungtang uh akisathei a, tuazieh in amaun Kei ang manghilta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama ua dingin humpibahnei bang ka hi ding a, kamkei bangin lampi gei lah ah amaute ka buh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Vompi anoute kilahpieh bangin, amauh ka bawthop dinga, alungtang tuomtu anahgute uh ka bawttel ding a, khunah humpibahnei bangin amauh ka negam ding hi. Gamsain abawtel bangin."},"9":{"text":"Aw Israel suhsiet na hita, hinanleh nangma panpina khu Keima a kipan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kei na leengpa ka hi dinga, na khopi zousie a hing hundam dingin, leengpa dang hei ah a um ei? “Leng leh vaihawmtu hing pie in na china uh,” tuin hei a um atai?","ref":"1 Sam. 8.5,6"},"11":{"text":"Lungthah pum in leengpa ka hing pie a, ka thangpaina ziehin ama ka lamangta hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 10.17-24; 1 Sam. 15.26"},"12":{"text":"Ephraim thulimlouna tunkhawm in a um a, akhelna kholkhawm in a um hi."},"13":{"text":"Numei nauvei gimthuohna atungah atung dinga, ama tapa pillou ahi a; tate piendohna mun a aum den ding ahi sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Hankhuh silbawltheina apat in amaute ka tankhe dinga, shina akipat in amaute ka tankhe ding hi. Aw shina na gawtna ka hi ding a, Aw hankhuh na manthaina ka hi ding hi. Ka mit apat hepina akiselmangta hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 15.55"},"15":{"text":"Ephraim asanggamte lah ah ga pha mananleh, suolam huipi ahing laang dinga; Mangpa huipi gamdai apat in ahing laang tou ding hi. Tuachi’n atuinah ahing gaw dinga, tualeh atuikhuh zong akang ding hi. Agou koina akilu dinga, agou deihuoi manpha teng akipomang ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Samaria in akhelna akikhuh ding hi, Aziehpen amanu a Pasian tungah ahel hi. Amaute namsau in ashi ding ua, atangehte uh tuoltang satna’n akinei ding hi. Tualeh anumei gailaite uh gil akikhuo pieh ding uhi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Israel Mangpa na Pasian kungah kinuale kia in. Na thulimlouna zieh in na kipalpuata hi.","title":"Israel tunding kiana"},"2":{"text":"Thute hing keng inlen, Mangpa kungah hing kile kia inlen, Ama kungah, Ka khelnate zousie uh lamang inlen, khotuona toh hing na sangin, ka muh kithoinate uh ka hing lan ding uhi, chi un."},"3":{"text":"Assiria in ahing hundam sih dinga, sakolte tungah ka tuong sih ding ua, ka khutsuohte u’kungah zong, noute ka pasiente uh na hi uh, ka chi nawn sih ding uhi.” Aziehpen pa neilouten Nangma ah khotuona amu uhi."},"4":{"text":"Keima’n anuatolna uh ka damsah dinga, Amauh manbei in ka it ding hi. Aziehpen ka lungthahna amaute apat akiheimangta hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel a dingin daitui bang ka hi dinga, Ama zong lili bangin apoudoh ding a, Lebanon muol a singkungte bangin, ahui ahadoh ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Abate azamdal dinga akilawmnate khu, Olive sing bang ahi dinga, agimnamtui khu Lebanon abang ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A lim nuoi a tengte ahing kinuale kia ding ua, Bu tang bangin ahing hingdoh kia ding ua, grepgui bangin akhangdoh ding ua, tualeh agimtui khu Lebanon uoin bang ahi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ephraim in, milimte tungah bang ahiei ka bawl nahlai ding? achi dinga, Ken ka zata a, amauh ka khotuo ding hi; Kei theipi sing hing bang ka hi a, keima apat in na ga uh akimu hi."},"9":{"text":"Koi ahiei mipil? Aman tam silte theisiem heh. Koi ahiei theikah siemna nei? Aman amauh theisiem hen. Aziehpen Mangpa lampite adih a; midihtatten azui ding uhi. Hinanleh akheltat a palsante akipalpua ding uhi."}}}}},"29":{"info":{"name":"Joel","shortname":"Joel.","abbr":[],"desc":"Joel laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pethuel tapa Joel kungah Mangpa thu ahing tung hi.","title":"Khauphe a gamsung gawtna"},"2":{"text":"Nou upate aw, tam thu za un, Tualeh gamsunga tengte zousie in bildaw in ngai un! Noute khanlai leh na pu na pate uh, khanlai nangawn in tambang ana um kha, ngai mawngmawng tai mah?"},"3":{"text":"Na tate uh kungah tam thu hil unlen, na tate un atate u’kungah hil sawn u’henlen, atate un khangsawnte kungah hilsawn u’heh."},"4":{"text":"Singnget khauphete nehmawh teng khauphe hon in ane a, Khauphehon nehmawh teng atawnkawi khauphete in ane a, atawnkawi khauphete nehmawh teng, asugam khauphete in ane beita hi."},"5":{"text":"Nou zukhamte aw, khanglou unlen kap un, zudawn mite zousie aw, na kam ua kipat zu tha akilahmangtah zieh in, kap in mau un."},"6":{"text":"Nam khat in ka gam ang dou ua, ahat a, atamdan uh simseng lou ahi a, aha uh humpibahnei ha bang ahi a, humpibahnei ginhuoitah hapi bang anei uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 9.8"},"7":{"text":"Aman ka grepgui asusegamta a, Ka theipi kungte asusie a, ahaw zousie akhoh sieng kilkel a, apaimangta hi, abate angiet ngou siengta hi."},"8":{"text":"Nungah siengthou akhangdawnlai pasal suun a, sai ip puon sil bangin kap in mau un."},"9":{"text":"Ann sillat leh dawn sillatte khu, Mangpa inn apat suhbei ahita hi. Mangpa nasem, siempute kap in amau uhi."},"10":{"text":"Loute suhsiet ahita a, gam sungin asuun hi; bute suhsiet ahitah zieh in, uain thate akangta a, sathau a gina ta sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Nou lounei mite zum unlen, nou grep huon bawlmite kap in mau un, aziehpen lou a mang bu leh, Barli bu lah ding a um nawn sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Grepguite agaw siengta a, Theipikungte avuoi siengta a, Kawlbuthei kungte, tum singte leh apple thei kungte zong, tualeh lou lai a theikung zousie zong avul siengta hi. Mihing tapate lah a kipat lungnopna zousie adaita hi."},"13":{"text":"Nou siempute aw, na kawng uh gah unlen, kap unlen suun un; Nou maitam nasemte aw, Kap in mau un, Nou ka Pasian nasemte aw hing pei unlen, zankhovah in sai ip puon sil in lum un, aziehpen ann sillatte leh, dawn sillatte na Pasian uh inn apat khaam ahita.","title":"Kisia dinga ngetna"},"14":{"text":"Ann ngawlna siensuo unlen, Khawmpi siengthou bawl un; Upate leh gam sunga teng zousie, Mangpa na Pasian uh inn ah kikhawm unlen, Mangpa kungah kikoukhie un."},"15":{"text":"Eh kadei! tua ni khu a tung agih hi! Aziehpen Mangpa ni anaita; Bangkimbawltheipa akipat suhmangthaina bangin, ahing tung ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 13.6"},"16":{"text":"I mitmu uapat ann neh ding lahmang hitalou ahiei mah? Lungnopna leh kipahna i Pasian uh, inn apat lahmang hitalou amah?"},"17":{"text":"Haichite leikhal nuoi ah agawta a, bupangte lah ahawm siengta bu atun nawnlou ziehin, bu innte ase siengta hi."},"18":{"text":"Gantate hathum hina mai uh e, Ganhonte chimaw in amangbangta uh, louhing mun aumlou zieh in belamhonte, nangawn athang gawpta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Aw Mangpa nangma kungah ka kikou hi, aziehpen gamdai louhing munte akatumta a, meikuongin gamlah sing zousie akatumta hi."},"20":{"text":"Gamlah a saten zong nang a hing han uhi, luita tuite akangta a, gantatna mun louhingte akahtum siengtah zieh in."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zion ah pengkul mut unlen, Ka muol siengthou ah patau dah gingsah un, Gamsunga tengte zousie chitun u’heh, Aziehpen Mangpa ni hing tung ding ahita, hing tung pai ding ahita.","title":"Mangpa ni hing tungding"},"2":{"text":"Mielna leh khonimna ni, meilum zin ni leh miel nasat ni, zingmawng meilum in muolte atuom bangin, mipi tamtah leh thahattah ahing pei dinga, tambang mawngmawng aumkha ngai nai sih a, anua chieng leh khang tampi nua chieng in zong, a um kia nawn sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Amasang uah mei in akatum a, anualang uah meikuong in akaa hi; amasang uah gam khu Eden huon bang ahi a, anua uh gamdai suhsietsa bang ahi; Bangmain amauh asuohtasah sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amel latdan uh sakol mel bang ahi ua, Sakol tungtuongmi bangin atai uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 9.7-9"},"5":{"text":"Kangtalai ging husa bangin muolvumte ah akitawm uhi, Meikuongin hampa gaw akaah ging bangin, kidou dinga mansa galkap hon bangin akiguol uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amasang uah mipite apatau ua, amaitang zousie uh amuolta hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihatte bangin atai ding ua, galdou mite bangin bang dawn ah akal ding uhi; michin mailam nawt in apei chiet ua, lampam a piel a um sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute khat leh khat kiphutuo lou in michin amauh mailam chiet ah apei uhi. Thaltang kaal a alut chieng un zong, khawl lou in apeisuoh uhi."},"9":{"text":"Khopi sungah asuh tai atou tai ua, kulpi bang tungah atai kawi ua, inn tungah akaltou ua, guta bangin kotta ah alut uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute mai ah lei akiling a, vante achitun uhi; Ni leh ha amiel a, Aasite zong ataang nawn sih hi.","ref":"Kihil. 8.12"},"11":{"text":"Mangpa’n agalkap honte mai ah a aw asuo a, agiehphuol khu athupi mama ngal a, Athupieh sutangtungte athahat uhi. Mangpa ni khu athupi mama a, achizat huoi hi, Koi in athuoh zou diei?","ref":"Kihil. 6.17"},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin “Tuin Mangpa’n, “A lungtang zousie u’toh ann ngawlna toh Kap pumin, ka kungah hing kinuale kia un,” achi hi.","title":"Kisia a, anngawl dinga chielna"},"13":{"text":"Na puonsilte uh hilou in, na lungtangte uh botkeh unlen,” Mangpa na Pasian kungah hing kinuale un. Ama khotuona leh hepina adim lungthah bailou, hepina lientah nei, sietna tunlou dinga lunghei zelpa ahi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh kunga, Na ann sillatte leh dawn sillalte u’zong, Ama hing kiheikia in, lungsim hengin, guolzawlna ahing nuasie sih ding chi koi in athei ei?"},"15":{"text":"Zion ah pengkul mut unlen, Ann ngawlna siengthou phuong unlen, Khawmpi siengthou bawl un."},"16":{"text":"Mipite hankhawm unlen, mipi kikhawmte susiengthou un, upate hankhawm unlen, Naupangte leh naungeh nawitep laite puikhawm un, Mouneipa apindan apat pawtdoh henlen, Mounu zong akizepna pindan apat in hing pawtdoh heh."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa nasem siempute khu innhim leh, maitam kikaal ah kap u’henlen, “Amauten Aw Mangpa na mipite khawi in, tualeh na goutante simmaw a um a, atung ua Pasian theilou namten, avaihawmkhum ding un na goutante pe vawt sin. Bangzieh a amaun namte lah a, A Pasian uh hei a um ahiei,” chi sese ding ahi uoi? Chi uhen."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n agam thangsetah in akihuhpi ding a, tualeh amite alainat ding hi.","title":"Hundamna ding thuchiem"},"19":{"text":"Mangpa’n adawng dinga, amite kungah, “Ngai un, bu leh uoin tha leh sathau ka hing pe ding hi. Taitah leh gilva tahin na um ding ua, namte lah ah simmaw in ka hing umsah nawnsih ding hi."},"20":{"text":"“Mallam galkap honte noute apat, gamlapi ah ka notmang ding a, Gamdai gamgaw leh gamse lah ah, amasalamte suolam tuipi ah alut dinga, anukhia lamte tumlam tuipi ah ka notlut ding a, A silbawl thupitahte ziehin, agim namsie ahing zamtou ding a, a ui gimnamsie akiza ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Gam aw, zau sin, Mangpa’n sil thupitah abawltaah ziehin kipah in thanuom in."},"22":{"text":"Nou gamlah a gamsate zaunawn sih un, gamdai hampahing munte ahing seldohta hi; singte’n ga asuongta ua, theipi kung leh grepguiten zong gahoitah asuongta uhi, achi ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"“Tuachi’n nou Zion tate kipah un, tualeh Mangpa na Pasian uah nuom un, aziehpen Aman noute guo masa ginumtah in ahing zusahta hi. Aman nou adingin guo ahing zu sah dinga, aha khatna ah guo masa leh, guo nukhia ahing zusah ding hi."},"24":{"text":"“Buphuol khu bu in adim dinga, tualeh um leh belte khu uoin leh, sathau in adimlet ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Keima’n na lah ua ka hing sawl, ka galkap hon thupitah Pettan khauphete, akitawnkawi khauphete leh asugam khauphete in, anehbei kumte ka hing nua dit kia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"“Nouten niengtah leh taitah in na ne ding ua, tualeh lamdangtah a noute a dinga hing bawlpiehpa, Mangpa na Pasian uh min na phatta ding uhi. Tualeh ka mite a zala ngai nawn sih ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kei Israelte lah ah ka um chi leh, kei khu Mangpa na Pasian uh ka hi a, Pasian dang mawngmawng a um sih chi na thei ding uhi. Ka mite azala ngai nawn sih ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"“Tuami nua chiengin mi zousie tungah, Ka Hagau ka sungbaw dinga, na tapate uleh na tanute un thu agenlawh ding ua, na putehte un mang aman ding ua, na tangvalte un mengmuna amu ding uhi.","title":"Mangpa ni a hagau pieh ding chiemna"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh ka suohpate leh ka suohnute tungah zong, ka hagau ka sungbaw ding hi."},"30":{"text":"“Van tungah leh lei lam ah, sillamdang ka langsah dinga, sisan, meikuong leh meikhutung ka musah ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Ni amiel ding a hapi sisan asuoh ding hi. Mangpa ni thupitah leh chizat huoitah, atun masangin tam silte atung ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 24.29; Mak. 13.24,25; Luk. 21.25; Kihil. 6.12,13"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahi dinga, Mangpa min lou pouma hundam ahi ding hi. Aziehpen Mangpa’n agensa bangin, Zion muol tung leh Jerusalem ah, asuohta umsunte lah a kipat Mangpa’n ahat ding umsunte lah ah, hutkhietna a um ding hi.","ref":"Nasep. 2.17-21\n        ;     \n        Rom. 10.13"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ngai un, tua nite leh hun a, Juda leh Jerusalem saltangte, ka puikia hun chieng in;","title":"Jentel tunga vaihawm thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Nam zousie zong ka khawm dinga, amaute Jehoshaphat phaiguom ah ka zawpisuh dinga, ka gam ahawmzah ua, namte lah a athezah uh ka mite leh, ka goutan Israelte ziehin, tua mun ah amaute tungah thukhenna ka bawl ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaun ka mite adingin ai asan ua, pasal naupangte numei kizuate leina’n anei ua, Zu adawn theina dingun, numei naupangte zu man dingin azua uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi, nou Tai-ar, Sidon leh tuipi gei Philistin gam zousiete aw, Ka tungah bang bawl ding nahi uoi? Ka tunga hing thuh ding nahi uoi mah? Na hing thuh ua ahileh na hing thuhna u’khu, kintah leh gangtah in na tung uah ka hing thuh kia ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 23.1-18; Ezek. 26.1—28.26; Amos. 1.9,10; Zek. 9.1-4; Mat. 11.21,22; Luk. 10.13,14  ;     \n        Isai. 14.29-31; Jer. 47.1-7; Ezek. 25.15-17; Amos. 1.6-8; Zeph. 2.4-7; Zek. 9.5-7"},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen nouten ka dangka, leh ka sana, tualeh ka van manpha tahtahte na pomang ua, na bieh inn sungte uah na kipuoh lut uhi."},"6":{"text":"Juda mite leh Jerusalem mite zong agamgi ua kipat a, gamlapi a na hepmang theina ding un, Greek mite kungah na zuata uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ngai un, amaute na zuana munte ua kipat in ka tohthou dinga, na thuhna bangbang un nouma lutung ngei ah, ahing lethuh kia ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Na tapate u’leh na tanute uh, Juda mite khut ah ka zua dinga, tualeh amauten amahaw gamlapi a um, Sabean mite kungah azuasawn ding uhi, chia Mangpa’n agensa ahi."},"9":{"text":"Namte lah ah tami phuongzah un: Galdou dingin kisa un! Mihatte phawng unlen, galdou mi zousie hing kikhawm u’henlen, hing peitou u’heh."},"10":{"text":"Na louhawna tute uh namsauin kheng unlen, na grepgui heusiengna siakuoikate uh teipi in kheng un. “Athazawngkhal in zong ka hat ahi, chi uheh.","ref":"Isai. 2.4; Mik. 4.3"},"11":{"text":"Hing kikhawm unlen, hing kuon un, akimvel a um nam zousiete hing kikhawm khawm un, khum mun ah na mihatte hing peisuh sah in, Aw Mangpa!"},"12":{"text":"Namte khanglou u’henlen, Jehoshaphat phaiguom ah hing peitou u’heh; Kei tua mun ah ka tou dinga, akim avel ua namte tungah vaihawmna bawl ding ka hi."},"13":{"text":"Kawite keng un, bu lah ding aminta hi hing pei unlen, kuon suh un, grep suhna kuong adimta, greptui belte adimletta hi agitlouna uh athupi sengta hi.","ref":"Kihil. 14.14-16; Kihil. 14.19,20; 19.15"},"14":{"text":"Mihonpite, thukhentatna phaiguom a um mihonpite, thukhentatna phaiguom ah, Mangpa ni khu thukhentatna phaiguom ah. Anai mamata hi."},"15":{"text":"Ni leh hapi amiel dinga, aasite ataang nawn sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Zion akipat Mangpa ahawh dinga, Jerusalem apat A aw asuo ding a, lei leh vante akithing ding hi, hinanleh Mangpa khu amite kibutna ahi dinga, Israel tate thahatna ahi ding hi.","title":"Juda tunding kiana","ref":"Amos. 1.2"},"17":{"text":"“Tuachi’n Kei Mangpa na Pasian uh, Ka muol siengthou Zion a teng ka hi chi, na thei ding uhi. Tuachi’n Jerusalem asiengthouta dinga, Tualeh gamdang mite koima asungah, apeisuoh nawn sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"“Tua ni chiengin muolten uoin tha atakhesahta dinga, Muolte khu nawitui in aluongta ding hi. Juda gam luite ah tui aluonglet ta dinga, Mangpa in akipat tuinah khat ahing pawtkhe ding a, Shittim phaikuom atapnou ding hi."},"19":{"text":"“Izipt akisegawp dinga, Edom khu gamdai kisesa asuoh ding hi aziehpen Juda mite tunga atatsiet ziehun, agam sung ua mawna neiloute sisan, asuo zieh uh ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Juda gam khu kumtawn in a umden dinga, Jerusalem khu akhang akhangin a umden ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A sisan khelna uh ka suhsieng loute, ka susieng ding hi; Mangpa Zion a aten zieh in.”"}}}}},"30":{"info":{"name":"Amos","shortname":"Amos.","abbr":[],"desc":"Amos laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Uzziah vaihawm lai leh Israel leengpa Joash tapa Jeroboam vaihawm lai a, zil kilin masang kum ni laiin Tekoa khuo a ganchingte lah a mi khat Amos in Israelte tungtang a amu thute.","title":"Amos pulahna","ref":"2 Leeng. 15.1-7; 2 Khang. 26.1-23; 2 Leeng. 14.23-29"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Aman, “Zion akipat Mangpa ahawh a, Jerusalem akipat a aw asuo a, belamchingte gantatna munte’n asuun ua, Tualeh Karmel muol vum akieuta hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Joel. 3.16"},"3":{"text":"Tambangin Mangpa’n agen hi. “Damaska tatkhelna thum leh lite ziehin, agawtna ka heimang sih ding hi, Gilead gam buvuohna sia ha neite a avuoh zieh un.","title":"Damaska tunga thukhenna","ref":"Isai. 17.1-3; Jer. 49.23-27; Zek. 9.1"},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Hazael inn ah mei ka sawl ding a, tuamin Ben Hadad leeng inn akatum ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Damaska khopi kotpi kalna zawl ka sattan ding a, Tualeh Aven phaijang akipat in atengte leh, Beth Eden akipat in leengchieng tawipa ka sattan ding hi. Siria mite Kir ah suoh leh sal a puiin a um ding uhi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Gaza tatkhelna thum leh lite ziehin, agawtna ka heimang sih dinga, Edomte kunga piehdoh dinga, mi zousie sal a apui zieh un.","title":"Gaza tunga thukhenna","ref":"Isai. 14.29-31; Jer. 47.1-7; Ezek. 25.15-17; Joel. 3.4-8; Zeph. 2.4-7; Zek. 9.5-7"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Gaza kulbang tungah mei ka sawl ding a, tuamin aleeng innpi akatum ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Ken Ashdod a tengte leh, Ashkelon a leengchieng tawipa khu ka sattan ding a, tualeh Ekron khopi tungah ka khut kaha dinga, Philistinte lah a asuohta umsunte abeimang ding uhi, Mangpa Pasian in achi hi.”"},"9":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi. “Tai-ar tatkhelna thum leh lite ziehin, agawtna ka heimang sih dinga, Saltaangte zousie Edomte kunga apiehkhiet ua, a unau kaal a thuhun atheizing lou ziehun.","title":"Tai-ar tunga thukhenna","ref":"Isai. 23.1-18; Ezek. 26.1—28.19; Joel. 3.4-8; Zek. 9.1-4; Mat. 11.21,22; Luk. 10.13,14"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Tai-ar kulbaang tungah meikuong ka sawl ding a, tua meikuongin leeng innpi akatum ding hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, “Edom tatkhelna thum leh lite ziehin, agawtna ka heimang sih dinga, aziehpen ama’n asanggampa namsau in anuadel a, lainatna zousie apaimanga, alungthahnain abotse ngitnget a, athangpaina asousah ngitnget hi.","title":"Edom tunga gawtna","ref":"Isai. 34.5-17; 63.1-6; Jer. 49.7-22; Ezek. 25.12-14; 35.1-15; Obad. 1.1-14; Mala. 1.2-5"},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Teman khopi tungah meikuong ka sawl dinga, tua meikuongin Bozrah leeng innpite akatum ding hi.”"},"13":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, “Ammon mite tatkhelna thum leh lite ziehin, agawtna ka heimang sih dinga, agamgi uh akehlet theina ding ua, Gilead gam a numei naupai laite akuikeh ziehun.","title":"Ammon tunga gawtna","ref":"Jer. 49.1-6; Ezek. 21.28-32; 25.1-7; Zeph. 2.8-11"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Rabbah kulbaangah mei ka tawkuong dinga, kidouna ni a kikou aw toh, tualeh pingpei kipei ni banga huipi toh, leeng innpi akatum ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Aleengpa uh sal in akipui dinga, ama leh amiliente akipui khawm ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.”"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tambangin Mangpa’n agen hi, Moab tatkhelna thum leh lite ziehin, agawtna ka heimang sih dinga, Edom leengpa gute nangawn sunu banga ahalvam zieh in.","title":"Moab tunga gawtna","ref":"Isai. 15.1—16.14; 25.10-12; Jer. 48.1-47; Ezek. 25.8-11; Zeph. 2.8-11"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh Moab tungah meikuong ka sawl dinga, Kerioth leeng innpite akatum ding hi; tualeh Moab khu buoina leh kikou leh, pengkul ging husa in ashi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Alah ua akipat in thukhen vaihawmte ka satkhe ding a, tualeh ama toh pum in amiliente zousie ka thatgam ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, “Juda tatkhelna thum leh lite ziehin, agawtna ka heimang sih ding a, ama un Mangpa dan asimmaw ua, athupiehte azui sih ua, tualeh apu apate uh umdan banga azuou gente un, asuhkhelsah ziehun.","title":"Juda tunga thukhenna"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Juda tungah meikuong ka sawl dinga, tua meikuongin Jerusalem khopi a leeng innte akatum ding hi.”"},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, “Israel tatkhelna thum leh lite ziehin, agawtna ka heimang sih ding hi, aziehpen midihtat dangka sum in azua ua, mizawng tasamte kedap bukhat akhoh ziehun.","title":"Israel tunga thukhenna"},"7":{"text":"Mizawngte lutang lei a leivui lah ah atuonchil ua, migentheite lampi apata sawnkhete, pa leh atapa in nungah khat aluppi khawm ua, ka min siengthou asubua uhi."},"8":{"text":"Maitam chinteng kunga khamna puonte tungah alum suh ua; tualeh apasien inn ua mi alieusah mante un zu adawn zel uhi."},"9":{"text":"“Ahi, amaute masangah sidar sing banga sang leh, gangpi sing banga khau Amorte ka sumanga; Ahi, tunglam aga leh nuoilam a athahuite ka sumang hi.","ref":"Danp. 3.8-11"},"10":{"text":"Amormite gam luo dingin Izipt apat ka hing puikhie a, gamdai a kum sawmli sung hing puipa zong, Keima ka hi."},"11":{"text":"Na tapate ulah a mi pawlkhat guolnei in ka siemdoh a, tualeh na tangvalte ulah a pawlkhat Nazirmite dingin ka bawl hi. Aw Israel tate, tambangin ka bawl sih amah?” Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Kisim. 6.1-8"},"12":{"text":"“Hinanleh Nazirmite kungah dawnding zu na pie ua, tualeh guolneite kungah thu genlawh sih un, chi’n thu na pie uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"13":{"text":"“Ngai un, bawngkari buphai dimset in anetkhum bangin, noute netkhum in ka umta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin taihatte ganna abei dinga, mihat in ahatna amansuo dinga, galhatpa zong amaleh ama akihumbit zou sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Thalpi tawi mi apang zou sih ding a, kenga taihatmi akihumbit zou sih dinga, Sakol tungtuong mi zong akihumbit zou tuom sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin, mihat hangsan pente zong guohtangin ataimang ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel tate aw, Izipt gam a ka hing puidoh innkuonte zousie, Mangpa’n noute ahing douna tam thu ngaikhie un."},"2":{"text":"“Leitunga innkuonte zousie lah ah, noute bou ka hing thei nahi ua, tuaziehin na thulimlouna zousie zieh ua, hing gawt ding ka hi, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"“Akilungtuoh sih u’leh mi ni azawhkhawm thei ding uoi mah?"},"4":{"text":"Sa mat ding neilou in humpibahnei, gamlah ah ahumham ngai amah? Humpibahnei nou zong sa mat neiloupi in, akawhawm sung apat aham ngai amah?"},"5":{"text":"Thang annta umlou a tuol a thang kikamte, ah va a awh thei ding amah? A awh ding umlou in tuol a thang kikamte akipeh ngai amah?"},"6":{"text":"Khopi sunga pengkul akimut chiengin, mipite zau lou in a um ding uoi mah? Khopi sunga sietna atun chiengin, Mangpa bawl ahisih amah?"},"7":{"text":"Adihtah in Mangpa Pasian in asuoh guolneite kunga, Athuguh theisah louin bangma abawl sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Humpibahnei ahumhamta a, koi ahiei zau lou ding? Mangpa Pasian in thu agenta a, koi ahiei genlawh lou thei ding?”"},"9":{"text":"Ashdod leeng innpi ah tualeh, Izipt gam leeng zousiete innpi ah thu phuong unlen, “Samaria muol tungte ah kikhawm unlen, a sunga buoina lientah leh alah ua nuoisie a umte en un,” chi un, achi hi."},"10":{"text":"“Amaun sildih bawl dan athei sih uhi,” Mangpa’n achi hi. “A innpi huongsungte uah gumtatna leh, suomhatna akholkhawm uhi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Pasian in tambangin agen hi: “Gam kimkot ah melma aum nalai dinga, nou apat in na hatna uh alamang dinga, na leeng innpite uh abulu ding uhi.”","title":"Israel khelna zieh a gawtna"},"12":{"text":"Tambangin Mangpa’n agen hi: “Belamchingpan humpibahnei kam sung apat, belam keng ni ahiei, ahisihleh bil ni ahiei atudoh bangin, Samaria khopi ateng Israel tate lupna, ningtawnga umte leh touna sih a toute, ka hing hunkhe ding hi.”"},"13":{"text":"“Ngai unlen, Jakob innkuonte douna thu theisah un,” Galkapte Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tua ni chiengin Israelte atatkhelna ziehun ka gawt dinga, Bethel maitamte zong ka gawt ding hi, tualeh maitam kite suhtan in a um dinga tuol ah ake ding hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.15"},"15":{"text":"Phalbi inn khu nipi inn pumin ka suse dinga, Saiha innte amangthai ding a, tualeh inn thupite abeita ding hi” Mangpa’n achi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Nou Bashan gam bawngpite, Samaria muol tunga umte mizawngte nuoisie a, mi tasamte tuonchil a, na pasalte uh kunga zu hing tawi un, dawnkhawm vai chite, tam thu ngaikhie un.","title":"Samaria numeite gawtna"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in ama siengthouna siel in akichiemta a, Ngai un, noute sia kuoika in ahing lamang dinga, na hah na suonte uh ngakuoi a ahing lahmang ni ahing tung ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Kulbang vangte ah pawtdoh unlen, michin ama mazawn chiet ah apei ding ua, Hermon lang ah paidoh nahi ding uhi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"4":{"text":"“Bethel ah hing pei unlen, takhiel un, Gilgal ah hing pei unlen, tatkhelna pung sah un, zingmawng chin in na kithoinate uh lan unlen, na sawm ua khatte uh ni thum chin teng in hing tawi un."},"5":{"text":"Kipah thugenna sillat tol kisawte lan unlen, ut thu a silpiehte phuong unlen, theisah un; Aw nou Israel tate, tam khu na utlamtah uh ahi,” Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."},"6":{"text":"“Na khopi zousie uah ha sienna ka hing pie a, tualeh na umna teng uah tanghou tahsapna ka hing pie a, hinanleh ka kungah na hing kile kia sih uhi,” Mangpa’n achi hi.","title":"Israel in thumanna ngaikhohlou"},"7":{"text":"“Bu lahna ding ha thum asap laiin, na tung ua guo zu ding zong ka tutang a, khopi khat tungah guo ka zusah a, khopi dang tungah ka zusah sih a, Lou khattungah guo azu a, lou dangin guo mu lou in, avuoi gawp hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin khopi ni leh thum a mite, khopi dang ah tui du in aban tai ua, hinanleh dangta phatna khop amu sih uhi; hinanleh ka kungah nang kinuale nuom sih uhi.” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Gawna hui leh muotna in ka hing gawt a, na huonte uh, na grep huonte uh, na theipi kungte u’leh na Olive kungte uh, ahing let sem sem chiengin, khaupheten anetum sieng ua, hinanleh ka kungah na hing kinuale nai tuom sih uhi.” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"10":{"text":"“Izipt gam a bangin na lah uah gawtna ka hing sawl a, na khanglaite uh namsau in ka that a, na sakol matte uh pumin ka that khawm a; tualeh na giehphuol uite uh na nahkohawm ua, namse khop in ka bawl a, hinanleh ka kungah na hing kinuale sih uhi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Pasian in Sodom leh Gomorrah khopite alumlet bangin, noute pawlkhat ka hing lumlet a, meikuong lai a singkhuo katum ding lahdoh bang nahi uhi; hinanleh ka kungah na hing kinuale na lailai sih uhi.” Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 19.24"},"12":{"text":"“Tuazieh in, Aw Israel, na tung uah tambangin ka bawl ding hi, tualeh na tung ua tambanga ka bawl ding ziehin, Aw Israel, na Pasian tuoh dingin kimansa in um in.”"},"13":{"text":"Ngai un, muol leh tangte bawlpa leh hui siempa, mihingte kunga angaituonate gendohpa, zingmawng zong miel sahpa leh, leitung mun sangte akengtaw a tuonpa khu, amin galkapte Mangpa Pasian ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel innkuonte aw, noute dou a ka thugen, ka kaala na ngaiun:","title":"Israelte suunna"},"2":{"text":"“Israel nungah siengthou apuata, athou zou nawn sih ding hi. Ama gam sung ah taisan in alum a, ama phong ding koima a um sih hi.”"},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa Pasian in tambang in agen hi: “Galdou ding a mi tul khat pawtdohna khopi in, za khat anuasie dinga, mi za khat pawtdoh na khopi in, mi sawm khat Israel innkuonte kungah nuasie ding hi.”"},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Israel innkuonte kungah, Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Kei hing sui unlen tualeh hing un.","title":"Kisia dinga hatna"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Bethel suisih unlen, Gilgal ah lut sih unlen, Beersheba ah galkai sih un; aziehpen Gilgal sal a puimangin a um dinga, Bethel zong bangmalou ahing hi ding hi.”"},"6":{"text":"Mangpa sui unlen tualeh hing un, Tuachilou in Ama mei bangin akuong dinga, Joseph innkuonte akatum ding hi. Tualeh aphel ding Bethel khosungah koima a um sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Nou vaihawmnadih gamsai khatah suoh sah a, dihtatna tuol sena neite,"},"8":{"text":"Bawmluoi leh zuheisuhtun siem a, shina lim zingmawng suohsahpa leh, sun zong zan banga mielsahpa Ama suiun; Tuipituite hankhawma, leitunga guo a zusahpa Ama sui un, Amin khu Mangpa ahi.","ref":"Job. 9.9; 38.31"},"9":{"text":"Aman mihatte tungah sietna guobang in azusah a, Khopi kulpite tungah sietna keh bangin akesah hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaun kul kotpi a thuhil mite amuda ua, dihtah a thugen mite akidah uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin nouten mizawngte na tuonchil ua, ama ua pat in tangseute na lahpieh ua. Suongkhenthawin innte lam nan u’lachin, asungah na teng sih ding uhi, Grep huon hoitahte na bawl ua, hinanleh grep zu na dawn tuom sih ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen na tatkhelna uh tampite leh, na khelna thupitahte uh ka thei a, midihtatte na sugenthei ua, golguhnate na la ua, kulkotpi ah mizawngte tan ding na lehei pieh uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin tua hun chiengin mi pilvangte asip dide ding uhi, hun hoilou ahi ziehin."},"14":{"text":"Na hin theina dingun, silhoi sui unlen, silhoilou sui sih un. Tuachi’n na gen bangun, galkapte Mangpa Pasian in ahing umpi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Silhoilou huo unlen, Silhoi bawl un; Kulkotpi ah thukhenna dih tungkhie un; tuachi’n Joseph innkuonte lah a damsunte dingin galkapte, Mangpa Pasian in hepina anei kha ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuazieh in Mangpa Pasian galkapte, Mangpa’n tami agen hi: “Kholai chinteng ah ka leh mauna a um dinga, lamlien dungte ah, khohna e! Khohna e! achi ding ua, asuun dingin lou bawl mite ahan ding ua, akap dingin kaasiemte ahan ding uhi.","title":"Mangpa ni khu"},"17":{"text":"Grep huon tengah ka leh mauna a um ding hi, aziehpen na lah uh tawnsuoh in kei ka hing pei ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Nou Mangpa ni hing tunkal ngahlate, na tung uh agih hi. Mangpa ni khu noute dinga bang phatuom ding ahiei? Tam khu miel ahia, vah ahi sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi khat humpibahnei akipat tai nanleh, vompi toh kituoh bang ding ahia, ahisihleh inn a pei in, banga akhut ngam a, gul in ana tuh bang ding hi uteh."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa ni khu vah ahisih a, mielna hilou ahiei mah? Avahna nangawn taanglou a, miel keikui ding hilou ahiei mah?"},"21":{"text":"“Na pawite uh ka hua a, ka kidah hi, tualeh na khawmpi siengthoute uh tungah zong ka kipah sih hi.","ref":"Isai. 1.11-14"},"22":{"text":"Halmang sillatte leh ann sillatte hing lan nan u’lachin, ka sang sih ding hi; na bawngnou vahthaute uh, kilemna sillat a na latte u’zong ka pahta sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na lasah bil aphuoite uh kei akipat lamang un, aziehpen na pehging guineite uh, ging kilawmte ka ngaikhe sih ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh thukhenna dih tui bangin luongsah unlen, tualeh dihtatna khu tuipi hattah bangin luongsah zaw un."},"25":{"text":"“Aw Israel innkuonte gamdai ah kum sawmli sung, ka kungah kithoina leh sillatte na hing lankhata uh amah?","ref":"Nasep. 7.42,43"},"26":{"text":"Na kibawlthu uh na leengpa uh Sikkuth leh na Chiun milimte uh, tualeh na Aasi pasiente uh na kipuoh kawi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin Damaska khel lam ah, noute sal in ka hing puisah ding hi,” Amin galkapte Pasian, Mangpa’n achi hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Nou Zion a nuomtah a umte leh, Samaria muol a muonna ngate, namte lu pen chi a um mi thupite, akung ua Israel innkuonte hing hawnate, na tung uh agih hi.","title":"Dihtatlouna ni a nuomtah a umte tung agih hi"},"2":{"text":"Kalneh khuo galkai unlen, va en un; tualeh khuna kipat in Hamath khothupitah ah haw un, tuazou chiengin Philistinte khopi Gath ah hawsuh un. Tam leenggamte sangin, noute na hoizaw uh amah? Ahisihleh amaute gam sangin noute gam athupi zaw amah?"},"3":{"text":"Sietna ni gamla sah a, gumtatna vaihawmna ni naisah noute na tung uh gih hi."},"4":{"text":"“Saiha lupna tunga lum a, toupha sau nuom tunga kizie a, belamhon lah a belamnoute ne a, bawngbuh apat bawngtuoi sa tuitah tah nete nahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"David banga kaiging tum a, tumging toh kituoh a lasa a, tumging vanzah ding kibawlte na hi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Noutunga zu dawn a, sathau hoipente kinute na hi ua, Hinanleh Joseph thuohgimna dapiloute na hi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin sal a pei masate toh tuin apei ding ua; tualeh kize ngeingui a, annkuongluina nopsahna lahmang ahita ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian Ama min sielin akichiemta a, galkapte Mangpa Pasian in, “Jakob kiletsahna ka kidah a, tualeh aleeng innpite ka huo hi; tuazieh in khopi leh a sunga um zousie, mite khut ah ka pedoh ding hi, achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n tambang ahing hi ding hi, inn khat ah mi sawm um nalai ta u’leh ashi ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh tua mishi khat pen ahieng asan khat in, mishi gute hal dingin, tua inn apat mishi luong la a apuohkhiet chiengin, Inn sunga umpa kungah, “Na kungah mi dang a um nalai ei”? achi dinga, Tuachi’n koi ahiei mikhat in “Umlou” achi ding hi. Tualeh aman “Sip khinkhian in Mangpa min ilou sih ding hi,” achi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Ngai un, Mangpa’n thu apie hi: Aman inn thupi achim guoisah sieng a, inn neute asunen ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Suongpi tungah sakolte atai ngai amah? Mi’n suongpi tungah bawngtal in lou akaisah ngai amah? Hinanleh adih a vaihawmna shina gu na suohsahta ua, tualeh dihtatna ga gamsaikha na suoh sahta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Noute Lo Debar tungah na kipah ua, “Eima hatna zieh a Karnaim ikilah uh ahi na chi uhi.”"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Israel innkuonte aw, “Ngai un, nouma dou dingin nam khat ka dingsah ding hi,” Tualeh amauten “Lebo Hamath lutna kipat in, Arabah phaijang tan dong ahing sugenthei ding uhi.” Galkapte Mangpa Pasian in achi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tambangin Mangpa Pasian in kei ahing ensah a, Ngai vawi, haichi nukhia pen poudoh chiillai in Aman khauphe hon a um sah a, Ahi leengpa haichi lahkhawm dan in tam khu haichi pou nukhia pen ahi.","title":"Khauphete mulawhna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh khauphehon in gam sunga loupa anehkhawng nua un, “Ken, Aw Mangpa Pasian ngaidam in, Kang ngen ahi! Jakob bang achi din zou diei? Ama lah aneunalai ngal a,” ka chi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n tami tungtangah Mangpa’n alungsim ahei a, “Tami kibawl nawn sih va,” Mangpa’n achi ta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tambangin Mangpa Pasian in Kei ahing ensah a, Ngai vawi, Mangpa Pasian in sugenthei dingin mei ahan a, tua mei in tuipi thuhpite ahalkanga, gam zong akatum siengta hi.","title":"Mei muna"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n “Ke’n Aw Mangpa Pasian tawpsah photin, Kang ngen ahi! Jakob bang achi din zou diei? Ama lah aneu nalai ngal a,” ka chi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n tami tungtangah zong, Mangpa’n alungsim ahei a; “Tami kibawl nawn sih va,” Mangpa’n achita hi."},"7":{"text":"Tambangin Ama’n Kei ahing ensah a: Ngai vawi, Mangpa khu tena sialum khau toh kibawl kulbang tungah adinga, akhut ah vaukhau khat atawi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Amos bang na mu ei?” ahing chi hi? “Ken sialumkhau” ka chi hi. Tuachi’n Mangpa’n, “Ngai vawi, ka mi Israelte lah ah sialumkhau ka khai dinga, amauh ka pel nawn sih ding hi, achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Isak mun sangte ka sumang dinga, Israel mun siengthoute susiet in a um ding hi. Jeroboam innkuonte namsau in ka dou ding hi.”"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Bethel siempu Amaziahin Israel leengpa Jeroboam kungah mi asawl a, tambang in agen sah hi, “Amos in Israel innkuonte lah ah nang douna in thu aphiela athugen zousie gamsungin athuoh thei sih hi.","title":"Bethel siemputen leengpa kunga Amos ahehna uh"},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Amos in tambangin agen hi: Jeroboam namsau in ashi dinga, Amau’gam ngei a kipat in, Israel sal a pui ahi ngeingei ding uhi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amaziah in Amos kungah “Aw nang guolnei, pei inlen, Juda gam ah taimang inlen, khunah neh ding thalaw in thu vagen lawh in."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Bethel ah thugen nawn sin, aziehpen tam mun pen leengpa munsiengthou ahi a, leengpa tenna innpi ahi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amos in adawng a, Amaziah kungah, “Kei guolnei ka hisih a, Guolnei tapa zong ka hisih hi, kei ganhon ching mi leh theipiga lakhawm mi ka hi.","title":"Amos dawnna"},"15":{"text":"Tuachia belamhon ka zui laiin, Mangpa’n ahing ladohta a, tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah, Pei inlen, ka mi Israelte kungah thu vagenin, ahing chi hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tuaziehin tuin Mangpa thu na ngaiin Nangman, Israel douna in thu gen sinlen, Isaak innkuonte douna thu sekhe sin na hing chi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuazieh in Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, Na zi khopi ah akizua dinga, na tapate leh na tanute namsau a thain a um ding ua, na gam tena khau a hawmzah in a um dinga, Nangma zong gam sienglou ah na shi ding a, Tualeh Israelte zong amauh gam ngei ua kipat in, sal a puimangin a um ding uhi.”"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian in tambangin ahing ensah hi, Ngai vawi, nipi lai theiga law khat ana kilui hi.","title":"Nipi theiga min muna"},"2":{"text":"Aman ka kungah, “Amos bang na mu ei?” ahing chi hi. Tuachi’n “Ken nipi lai theiga min law sunga um ka mu hi,” ka chi hi. “Ka mi Israelte tungah atawpna ahing tungta hi; amauh ka peipel nawn sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuani chiengin biehinn a la kisate Kalemauna asuoh ding a,” “Mun chinteng ah mishi luong tampi sip dide a paithang ahi ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tami Ngai un, nou tasamte tuonchil a, gam sunga mi zawngte lawsam sahte aw,"},"5":{"text":"“Bu izua theina ding ua, bangchih chienga ha tha bei dinga; tualeh ibu ikhoh theina dinga, bangchih chienga khawlni bei ding ahiei? Chi kawm in, Ephah na suneu ua, shekel na sulien ua lepchietah in tena dihlou na zang uhi."},"6":{"text":"Dangka a mizawngte ilei thei a, tasamte kedap bu khat ilei thei a, bu hoiloute nangawn izua theina dingin na chi uhi.”"},"7":{"text":"Mangpa Jakob kiletsahna siel in akichiem a, “Pellouin anasepte uh khat zong ka manghil ngai sih ding achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam ziehin gam sung kiling in asunga, tengte chintengin asuun sih ding amah? Nile luipi bangin gam buppi akhang dinga, Izipt luipi banga khangin akiemsuh kia ding hi.”"},"9":{"text":"“Tualeh khum ni chiengin” hichi ahing hi ding hi; “Suntanglai in ni ka tumsah dinga, tualeh suntanglai ma in leitung ka mielsah ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Na pawi bawlte uh sunna ka suoh sah dinga, na late zousie uh kaala ka suohsah dinga, kawng chintengin sai ip puon ka tengsah dinga, lutang chinteng tung ah lukieuna ka tungsah ding hi; tapa tang neisun asuun bangin ka bawl ding a, tualeh atawpna khatna ni ka bangsah ding hi, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Ngai vawi, Mangpa Pasian in nite hing tung ding ahita,” “Gam sung ah kielna ka tungsah ding, Ann du a kielna hilouin, tui du a kielna zong hilouin, Hinanleh Mangpa thu zahna lunggulna lam a kielna, ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuipi a kipat tuipi dang khat dong, Mallam akipat suolam dongah avah kawi kawi ding ua, Mangpa thu sui in asuhvah atouvah ding ua, hinanleh amu sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin nungah siengthou melhoite leh, tangval thahat laite dangta in apua ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Samaria khelna lou a kichiem miten, Dan aw, na pasien ahin laisie! Tualeh Beersheba umdan ahin laisie! chizousie apua ding ua, athou kia nawn sih ding uhi,” achi hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maitam kunga Mangpa ding ka mu a, “Aman, kotpi khuomte sat in innhim khuomte, akilin theina ding un abawn in alu ah sattan in tualeh, Ken anukhia pente namsau in ka that ding hi. Amaute lah akipat taikhie koima asuohta sih ding ua, asuohta sun zong hutkhiet ahisih ding uhi, achi hi.","title":"Kithedal ding genlawhna tawpna"},"2":{"text":"“Mishi khuo tan tousuh nan u’leh, khuna pat in amaute ka khutin ka lakhetou dinga, van ah kaltou nan u’leh, khuna pat in ka luoikhesuh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Karmel muol tungah kiphuol nan u’leh, ka suidoh dinga khuna pat in ka ladoh ding hi; Ka muphahlou dingin tuipi tawdop ah kibu nan u’leh, khuna pat in gulpi thu ka pe dinga, amauh ava tu ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Agalte uh masangah saltaang dingin pei nan u’leh, khuna kipat namsau thu ka pe dinga, amauh athat ding hi. Ahoina ding uh hilou in asietna dingun, amauh tungah ka mit ka tusah ding hi.”"},"5":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa Pasian, Ama ngel in leitung atham a azunta a, asunga tengte zousie in asun uhi; Gam pumpi Nile luipi bangin akhang dinga, Izipt luipi bangin akiemsuh kia ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Vanlaizawl adan adan a chieldaw banga dawpa, leitung athuop athuop a mukhepa, tuipi tuite hankhetou a, leitunga maikai a guo a zusahpa, Amin khu Mangpa ahi."},"7":{"text":"“Israel tate aw! noute kei a dingin, Ethiopia mite bang na hisih uh amah?’ Mangpa’n achi hi. Izipt gam akipat Israel puidohlou ka mah? Kaphtor akipat Philistinte, tualeh Kir akipat Siria mite puidohlou ka mah?"},"8":{"text":"Ngai vawi, Mangpa Pasian mit khu leenggam giloute tungah atu hi, tualeh leitung maikai apat in ka sumang dinga, hinanleh Jakob innkuonte ka sumang sieng sih ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Aziehpen pellou in, Keima’n thu ka pe dinga, lawpi a bu akisep bangin, namte lah ah Israel innkuonte ka sep ding, hinanleh atang neupen nangawn tuol ah akesih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuohsietna in ahing delpha sih ding a, ahing maituo sam sih ding hi, chite; ka mite lah a mikhielte zousie namsau in ashi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"“Tua ni chiengin David biehbuh chimsa ka tungding dinga, asietna munte ka siemtha dinga, apuasate ka phongtou dinga, nidanglai a bangin ka lamtha ding hi.","title":"Israelte tunding kiana dinga thuchiemte","ref":"Nasep. 15.16-18"},"12":{"text":"Edom gam a asuohta umsunte leh ka min a kihan Jentel zousie anei thei ding uhi,” Mangpa tam silte bawlpa’n achi hi."},"13":{"text":"“Ngai vawi, nite hing tung ding hita,” Mangpa’n achi hi. Loukaipa’n bu atpa adelphah hun chiengin, Grep chilpa in achi thepa adelpha ding hi; tualeh muol leh taangte’n grep zu humtah atakhesah ding a, muol zousiete akipat aluongkhe zengzung ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka mi Israelte asaltanna uapat in ka puikia dinga, khopi sesate alam tha ding ua, asungah ateng ding uhi; Grep guite asuon ding ua, uoin adawn ding uhi, huonte zong abawl ding ua, agate ane ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Amaute agam uah ka suon dinga, amauh ka piehsa gam apat in, koima’n abawtdoh nawn sih ding hi, Mangpa na Pasian un achi hi."}}}}},"31":{"info":{"name":"Obadiah","shortname":"Obad.","abbr":[],"desc":"Obadiah laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Obadiah mengmuna Mangpa Pasian in Edom tungtang tambangin agen hi: Mangpa akipata thu hing tung khat ka za ua, tualeh namte lah ah thupotu khat akisawl a, ama’n “Kisa un, Kidouna ah ama dou dingin ikuon dinguh” achi hi.","title":"Edom tunga gawtna ding genlawhna"},"2":{"text":"Ngai vawi, Keima’n namte lah a neunoukhat in ka hing bawl dinga, nasatah a simmaw na hi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Na lungtang kiletsahna in nang ahing solta hi; Nang kawlsuong kawm lah a tengpa, nang asanna munte a tengpa, “Koi ahiei leilah a kei hing kaikhe suh ding?” na lungtanga chipa."},"4":{"text":"Nang leh nang muvanlai bangin, kitawisangtou nanlachin zong, aasite lah ah na bu sep nanlachin, khuna pat in hing kaikhe suh veve ding ka hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Gutate na kungah hing pei u’henlen, zanlai in suomhatte hing pei taleh, bangzata a suhsiet na hita diei! adei zaza uh aguh masangsie uh, agu sih ding uh amah? Grepga khawmte na kung ah hing peita u’leh, Grep sang maimai hing nuasielou ding uh amah?"},"6":{"text":"Bangchidan a Esau kisuidoh ding ahiei mah? bangchidan a agou phuolguhte mudoh ahiei!"},"7":{"text":"Na pankhawmpite zousie in, gamgi dong ahing notdoh ding ua, Kilemtah a na umpi miten nang ahing sol ding ua, ahing zouta ding uhi; Na tanghou nete’n na awhna ding thang akam ding ua, ama uah theisiemna a um mawngmawng sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Edom mipilte nangawn ka sumang in, theisiemna neite khu Esau muolte a kipat, ka subei sih ding amah?"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aw Teman, Esau muol a mi chinteng tha a sattan ahitheina dingun, na mihatte alungke ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na sanggampa Jakob tung a na hiemngapna ziehin zumna in ahing khu ding a, kumtawna satkhiehin na umta ding hi.","title":"Edom kigawtna ding aziehte"},"11":{"text":"Lelampanga na din ni chiengin Gamdang mite’n, agalkapte sal a apuimang pieh ni chieng a, Gamdang mite akulkotpi a alut a, Jerusalem tunga ai asan chiengun, Nang nangawn zong alah ua khat bang na hi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh na sanggampa sal a pui ahi lai ni a, na awi ding ahi sih a, Juda tate suhmang a a um ni un zong, na kipah ding ahisih hi. Alungkham mangbat ni chiengun zong, kiliensahtah in thu gen sin."},"13":{"text":"Avangsiet ni un Kamite kulkotpi a na lut lou ding ahi, avangsiet ni un agimthuohna uh na en sih dinga, avangsiet ni ua, anei alamsa tung ua na khut na hahlou ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Alah ua suohta taidohte sattan dinga, lamkathuom a na din ding ahisih a; alungkhamna ni ua suohta umsunte, galte khut a na piehkhiet ding ahisih hi.","ref":"Isai. 34.5-17; 63.1-6; Jer. 49.7-22; Ezek. 25.12-14; 35.1-15; Amos. 1.11,12; Mala. 1.2-5"},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa ni khu nam zousie tungah anaita hi; na bawl bangbangin na tungah akibawl dinga, na silbawlte mama nangma lutungah atu ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen ka muol siengthou tunga na dawn bangin, nam zousie ten adawn ding uhi, adawn ding ua, aval ding uhi, tualeh a um ngailou bangin amang den ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Zion muol ah hutkhietna a um ding a, Khunah sienthouna aum ding hi; Khunah Jakob innkuonte’n agouluo uh atangta ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Jakob innkuonte mei ahi ding ua, Joseph innkuonte meikuong ahi ding uh, hinanleh Esau innkuonte pen, bukungbul gaw ahi ding uhi; Jakob in Esau akaa dinga, akatum ding hi. Esau innkuonte koima asuohta a um sih ding hi; aziehpen Mangpa’n agensa ahita hi."},"19":{"text":"Simlam a teng miten Esau muol atang ding ua, Tualeh phaijang gam a a teng miten, Philistin a tang ding ua; Ephraim lougamte leh, Samaria lougamte aluo ding ua, Benjamin in Gilead aluo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate lah a saltang Halah gam a umten, Kanaan mite gam Zarephath dongin aluo ding uhi. Jerusalem mi Shapharad a saltanga umten, Simlam khopi aluo ding ua."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Esau muola vaihawm dingin, hunkhemite Zion muol ah akaltou ding ua, tualeh leenggam khu Mangpa a ahita ding hi."}}}}},"32":{"info":{"name":"Jonah","shortname":"Jon.","abbr":[],"desc":"Jonah laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amittai tapa Jonah kungah Mangpa thu ahing tunga:","title":"Jonah thumanlouna","ref":"2 Leeng. 14.25"},"2":{"text":"“Dingdoh inlen, tua khopi lientah Nineveh ah pei inlen, agitlouna uh ka masanga ahing tuntou tah zieh in a tungtang thu uh va tangkoupi in,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Jonah adingdoh a, Mangpa mai a kipat in Tarshish lam a taimang dingin akisata hi. Joppa khuo ah apeisuh a, Tarshish zuon ding tembawh khat amu a, tuachi’n atuonman ding apie a, Mangpa mai a kipat a taimang dingin tembawh sungah alut a, Tarshish lam a pei dingte toh in tembawh sungah atuong khawmta hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n tuipi tungah huipi hattah ahing sawl a, tuachi’n tuipi tungah khopihui nasatah alaanga, tuachi’n tembawh sedingin akisata hi.","title":"Huipi hattah Pasian alaansahna"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n tembawhpute azauta ua, tualeh mi chin in ama pasien chiet ahanta uhi, tualeh tembawh azanna dingin a sunga avan puohte uh tuipi ah apaidohta uhi. Hinanleh Jonah khu tembawh sung nuoinung pen ah ana lutsuhta a, alum a nuomtah in ana imu zieu zuou hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n tembaw heh lamkaipa akungah ahing pei a, akungah, “Bangchidan a nang nuomtah a imu na hiei? Thou inlen na Pasian han in, Aman eite manthai louna ding ahing ngaituo khamaw diei mah,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n tembaw hehte khat leh khat akihou ua, “Hingpei un, koi zieh a tam buoina itung ua hing tung ahiei mah,” chi itheina dingun aisan vai akichi uhi. Tuabanga ai asan uleh Jonah tungah atuta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten Jonah kungah, “Hepitahin hing hil in, Koi zieh a itung ua tambang buoina hing tung ahiei mah? Nang bang nasem na hiei? Hei a hing kipan na hiei? Bang gam mi na hiei?” achi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ama’n akung uah, “Kei Hebru mi ka hia, Mangpa van Pasian tuipi leh leitung siempa giing mi ka hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n mite azauta mama ua, akungah “Bangzieh a tambang sil na bawl atai?” achi uhi. Aziehpen ahiltah zieh in mite’n Mangpa mai a kipat a taimang ahi chi atheita uhi.","title":"Jonah tuipi sungah"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah “Eite ding a tuipi kihot asipdide theina dingin nang bang hing law ding kahi uoi?” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n akung uah, “Hing dom unlen tuipi ah hing pai un, tuachi’n nou a dingin tuipi adai ding hi. Aziehpen keima zieh a tam khopihui nasatah na tung ua hing laang ahi chi ka thei hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahivang in miten tembaw khu tuipi pieu geilam a hawlkai tum in theitawp suo in apang ua, hinanleh tuipi kihot anasat sem sem zieh in azou sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuazieh in Mangpa ahanta ua, “Aw Mangpa hepitahin tam mipa hinna zieh in koute hing mangthaisah sinlen, mawna neilou sisan phuba ka tung uah tusah sin, aziehpen Aw Mangpa, Nang na dei bang banga na bawl ahi,” achi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Jonah adom ua, tuipi ah apai lutta uhi; tuachi’n tuipi kihot atawpta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n miten Mangpa agiing mama ta ua, tualeh Mangpa mai ah kithoinate alan ua, thuchiemte abawl uhi."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa’n Jonah val dingin ngapi lientah khat mansain ana koi hi. Tualeh Jonah khu ngapi gil sungah nithum leh zan thum a umta hi.","ref":"Mat. 12.40"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonah ngapi gilsung a kipat in Mangpa a Pasian kungah thu angen a,","title":"Jonah thumna"},"2":{"text":"“Ama’n ka gimthuohna ziehin Mangpa ka han a, Ama’n ahing dawng hi, Sheol gilsung a pat in ka kikoukhie a, ka aw a naza hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Nang tuithuhpi sungah, tuipite sung laikimtah ah na hing pailutta hi, tualeh tuipiten ahing tuom kimvel a, Na ki tuihuolte leh na tui kihotten ahing tum uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ken, Na muphahlou ah paimangin ka umta a, hinanleh na biehinn siengthou lam ka enkia ding hi, ka chi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuiten ahing tuom kimvel a, ka hinna nangawn zong tuithuhpiin akimkot a, hampaten ka lutang atuom kimvel uhi."},"6":{"text":"Taang bulte kiphuna dong ah ka peisuh a, Leinuoi leh akotzawlten kumtawn in, ahing khakhum denta ua, Hinanleh Aw Mangpa ka Pasian, Nangman kokhuh akipat ka hinna na domtouta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka hinna ka sunga aba lai in, Mangpa ka thei ngitnget hi; Ka thungetna na kungah, Na biehinn siengthou ah ahing tung hi."},"8":{"text":"Pannabei milim ngaisah ten, amauh khotuona ataisan uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Kenvang lungdam thugenna awging toh, na kungah ka kithoi dinga, Ka thuchiemsa ka tangtung sah ding hi. Hundamna khu Mangpa a ahi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n ngapi kungah thu agena, Ngapi in pieu gei ah Jonah alawkheta hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu aniveina Jonah kungah ahing tung kia a.","title":"Jonah nivei kisawlna"},"2":{"text":"“Dingdoh inlen tua khopi lientah Nineveh ah va haw inlen, gen ding a thu ka hing pieh va gen in,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonah akipandoh pai a, Mangpa thu bangin Nineveh khopi ah ava hawta hi. Nineveh khu khopi lientah nithum peina ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Jonah ni khat peina chieng, khopi sungah alutta hi. Tuachi’n aman, “Nineveh khopi kisietna ding ni sawm li maimai a um giapta hi,” chiin akikou kawikawita hi.","ref":"Mat. 12.41; Luk. 11.32"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nineveh khopi a miten Pasian agingta ta ua, anngawl ding thu aphuong ua, aneu pen apat alienpen tandong in sai ip puon asilta uhi.","title":"Ann ngawlna thupitah"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Nineveh leengpa kungah thu ahing tunga, tuachi’n ama zong aleengtouna apat in adingdoh a, aleengpuonsilte asutkhie a, sai ip puon akikhu a, leivui lah ah atousuhta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n Nineveh khopi sung pumpi ah amilienten thuphuon abawlsahta a, “Mihing leh ganta hitaleh, bawnghon leh belamhon hitaleh Koiman bangma chiem sih heh, ann zong nesih u’henlen, tui zong dawn sih uheh."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh mihing leh gantate sai ip puon kikhu uhenlen, Mangpa kungah nasatahin kikou uheh; Ahi, michin a umdan hoilou apat hing kihei u’henlen, akhut a um hiemngamna apat hing kinuahei kia heh."},"9":{"text":"I manthai louna ding un, Pasian in asiltupte kikhelsah in, alungthahna zauhuoitah apat in alungsim aheimang sih ding chia genthei ding koi ahiei?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian in amaute asilbawl hoiloute u’leh a umdan hoiloute ua kipat in akisia ua, alungheita uh chi anasepte uh amu a, Pasian in atung ua bawl dinga agensa silhoilou apat alungsim ahei a, abawl nawn sih hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh tam thu in Jonah alungkim sah sih mama a, alungthahta hi.","title":"Jonah lungthahna leh Mangpa lainatna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa kungah thu angen a, “Mangpa Aw, ka gam a ka um lai a ka gen tami mama hilou ahiei mah? Tuazieh a amasa a Tarshish lam a ka taina tami zieh ma ahi; aziehpen Nang hepisiem leh khotuosiem Pasian lungthah paipailou leh itna adim Pasian na hi a, sietna tunlou dinga lunghei Pasian na hi chi ka hing thei hi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.6"},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa aw, hepitah in tuin ka hinna la mai in, Kei a dingin hin sangin shi ahoizaw hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 19.4"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n akungah, “Na lungthah khu nanga dingin adihna amah? achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jonah khopi akipat in apawtkhie a, khopi suolam pang ah atouta hi. Khunah sawlbuh khat alam a, ahim a tou in, tua khopi bang ahing suoh eimah chi’n angah hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa Pasian in Jonah in nuomtah a abel thei dingin umgui khat asawlbuh tungah azam sah hi. Tuachi’n Jonah umgui ziehin akipah mama hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh azing ni zingmawng khovah in, tua umgui keitan dingin Pasian in lungnou khat ana guotta a, tua lungnou in umgui apettan a, avuoita hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hi a, ni ahing suohtah in Pasian in suolam hui sa hethut alaangsah a, Jonah lutang nisa in akhaw a, ashibupta hi. Tuachi’n Jonah shi a utzawta a, “Kei dingin hin sangin shi ahoizaw hi, achita hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in Jonah kungah; “Umgui tungtanga na lungthah pen bawldih na kisana amah?” achi hi. Ama’n “Dih kisa ma-ing, shi ngap a lungthah ka hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n, “Na sepgimna leh na kepsa zong hilou, na pousah zong hilou, zan khat kaal thu a hing poudoh tualeh zan khat kaalma a mangkia umgui tungah hepina na nei hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuabang ahileh Ke’n Nineveh khopi lientah sunga zietlam leh veilam khen theilou mi tul za leh tul sawmni sanga tamzaw, leh ganta tampi umna, ka lungkhampi sih ding amah?” achi hi."}}}}},"33":{"info":{"name":"Mika","shortname":"Mik.","abbr":[],"desc":"Mika laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda gam leengte Jotham, Ahaz leh Hezekiah vaihawm lai a, Moresheth khomi Mikah kunga Mangpa thu, Samaria leh Jerusalem tungtang a hing tung amu khu tami hi.","title":"Samaria gawtna","ref":"2 Leeng. 15.32-38; 2 Khang. 27.1-7; 2 Leeng. 16.1-20; 2 Khang. 28.1-27; 2 Leeng. 18.1—20.21; 2 Khang. 29.1—32.33"},"2":{"text":"Nou mipite aw Ngai un, Aw leitung leh asunga um zousie’n ngaikhie un, Mangpa Pasian, Mangpa ngei khu, Abieh inn siengthou apat noute douna theipitu hiheh."},"3":{"text":"Ngai un, Mangpa khu amun apat ahing pawt a, ahing peisuh dinga, leitung mun sangte ahing tuonsuh ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Mei kunga khuoilu bang leh a, mun ken a tui sunbuoh bangin, taangte anuoi ah azun ding a, guomte akhipawh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tamte zousie Jakob tatkhelnate zieh ngen ahi a, Israel innkuonte khelna zieh ahi. Jakob tatkhelna bang ahiei? Samaria hilou amah? Tualeh Juda mun sangte bang ahiei? Jerusalem hizaw lou amah?"},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin Samaria gamlah a silsie kisievum bangin, ka bawl ding a, grep huon bawlna mun ka suohsah dinga, asuongte guom ah ka liakhe suh dinga, a suongphumte ka dawhsah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A milim khuohthaw zousie uh, akisatguoi sieng ding a, akizua man zousie uh akihaltum ding a, amilim zousie ka suse ding hi. Ki zuana man ding a alahkhawmte, kizuana man ding mamain a kipekia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin Kap leh mau in ka awi dinga, kisutkhie in guohtangin ka pei dinga, si alte bangin kikou in ka mau dinga, vangawngsaute bangin ka thum ding hi.","title":"Israel leh Juda suun a kana"},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen aliemnate suhdamthei ahisih a, Juda gam tunga atuntaah zieh in, ka mite kotpi Jerusalem ngel ah atungta hi."},"10":{"text":"Gath khuo ah gendoh sih unlen, Kap vawt sihun; Beth-Aphrah khuo ah leivui lah ah kilawmlie un."},"11":{"text":"Nou Saphire khuo a tengte saguoh a, maizum in pei un, Zaanan a tengte apusuoh sih ua. Beth-Ezel in a suun a, adinna mun nang apat a lahmang ahita hi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen Maroth khomite’n; tan hoi angah ua, Hinanleh Mangpa akipat sietna, Jerusalem kotpi ah ahing tungta hi."},"13":{"text":"Nou Lakish khuo a tengte aw, Sakolleng khu sakol hattah ah vaw un. Amanu khu Zion tanu khelna kipatnabul ahi; aziehpen Israel tatkhelna khu nangma ah mudoh a hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin Moresheth-Gath kungah, silpieh napieh ding ahi. Akzib innte khu Israel leengte a dingin, zuou ahi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Aw Nou Mareshah a tengte aw, nou a dingin gouluotu khat ka hing pui ding a; Adullam ah Israel thupina ahing tung ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na ta deitahte ziehun, kiheukieu unlen, na sam uh heukieu un, Noute akipat saltang a puimang ding ahizieh un, na lutang uh langta lu bangin kieu sah un."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Alupna tung ua thugilou ngaituo a, silgilou sawm mite tung agih hi. Amaute khut a silbawltheina um ahi zieh in zingmawng khovah chieng in tami abawl zel uhi.","title":"Gawtna tunna ziehte"},"2":{"text":"Amaun mi loute adeigaw ua, thagum in alahpieh ua, innte adeigaw ua, akilah zel uhi Tambangin mi leh a inn, mihing leh a goutan simmawtahin a sugenthei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuazieh in Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ngai in, tam innkuon tungah sietna tunsah sawm ka hi a, khuna pat na ngawng uh na ladoh sih ding ua, kisathei tahin na pei nawn sih ding uhi; aziehpen tami hun hoilou ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin noute demna in, paunah agendoh ding ua, Kaala lungsiet huoitah sakawm in, “Nasatah a suhsiet ihita! Ama’n ka mite goutan aheng lamdangta a, bangchidan a kei apat a alahmang atai! mihelhatte kungah iloute ahawmzahta achi ding uhi.”"},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin aisan a gamgi khau te ding, Mangpa mi kikhawmte lah ah, koima na nei sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Thu gen sihun,” thugenlawh mite kungah na chi uhi. Tuachi’n na kung uah “Thu agen sih ding ua, zumna khu zumna in athuh sih ding hi.”","title":"Guolnei dihloute"},"7":{"text":"Aw Nou Jakob innkuonte chia kihante, Mangpa Hagau in dawtheina atasam amah? Tamte Ama bawl ahiei mah? Dihtah a umte tungah, ka thu in silhoi abawl sih amah?"},"8":{"text":"Tumasang zepin ka mite melma bangin, ahing dingdoh uhi; Kidou utlou a, galmuongtah a, nouma hing muongmi vahvielte, akipat in apuonsilte u’leh, apuontuolte uh na hawhkhiet pieh uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ka mite lah a numeite a inn nuomtahte, ua kipat na notdoh ua, atate ua kipat ka thupina na lamang denta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Dingdoh unlen peimang un! tami na khawlna ding uh ahisih hi, suhbua ahitaah ziehin manthaina, nasatah in noute ahing suse ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mi koi ahiei in zuou gen a, “Zu leh zuchia kham thei thu ka gen ding hi” achi leh, tam mite guolnei in apang thei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Aw Jakob na unpiun ka hing, khawm khawm kia ngei ngei ding hi, Israel umsunte ka puikhawmkia ngeingei dinga, Belam huonga belam khumkhawmte bangin, a ann maina mun ua belamhonte bangin, amaute ka khumkhawm dinga, mihing atam sengseng ziehun, akikouthang zeng zung ding uhi.","title":"Tunding kiana ding thuchiem"},"13":{"text":"Amasang uah lampi phuvangpa apei ding a, Amauten kotpi phuvangin apawtkhe ding uhi; Aleengpa uh a mai uah apei ding a, tualeh Mangpa’n amauh ma akai ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Ken, Aw! Nou Jakob lamkaite leh, Israel innkuon vaihawm miliente, Ngai un, vaihawmna dih noute thei ding hilou amah? Ka chi hi.","title":"Guolnei leh lamkai giloute"},"2":{"text":"Nouten silhoi na huo ua, silhoilou na ngaina uhi, Ka mite avun uh na lem pieh ua, agute ua pat atel avou uh na kheu pieh uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ka mite sa nane ua, amaute apat avunte uh na lipkhie ua, agute uh na sutawng ua, bel sunga sa huon ding bang leh belpi sunga, huon ding sa bangin na atnen uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuahun chiengin Mangpa ahan ding ua, Hinanleh Ama’n adawng sih ding hi. Khum hun chiengin, asil bawlte ua atatsiet ziehun, Ama’n amaute apat in Amai aphuolta ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa’n guolneite tungtangah tambangin agen hi: Ka mite lampielsah a, khat in neh ding apieh chienga “Lemna” thu gen a, Koiman pieh ding aneilou chiengin, ama dou ding in akisa zel uhi.","title":"Guolneite tunga thukhenna"},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin mengmuna mu theilouna, zan hun ahing tung ding a, ai san theilouna hun miel ahing tung ding hi.
