Guolneite tungah ni atum ding a, amaute ding in suntanglai zong amiel ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n mutheite azum ta ding ua, ai san siemte azala ding ua, abawn un pellou in akam uh ahum chiet ding uhi; aziehpen Pasian akipat dawnna a um sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh adihtah in kei pen, Jakob kunga atatkhelna uh phuongzah ding leh, Israelte kunga akhelna uh theisah dingin, Mangpa hagau sibawltheina zieh a, adih a vaihawmna leh thahatna in ka dim hi."},"9":{"text":"Nou Jakob innkuon lamkaite leh, Israel innkuon vaihawm liente, adih a vaihawmna huo a, thudih pouma lehei a lumlette aw, tuin tam thu ngaiun."},"10":{"text":"Sisan suona toh Zion a lam ua, tualeh Jerusalem thulimlouna toh za un."},"11":{"text":"Alamkaiten nehguhna ziehin thu akhen ua, asiempute’n aman neiin thu ahil ua, guolneiten sum deina in ai asan uhi. Tuachi pumpum in Mangpa tungah akinga ua, “Mangpa eite kungah umlou amah? itung uah sietna atung sih ding hi,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin noute ziehin Zion khu, loukai bangin akikai dinga, Jerusalem silsie kisevum bang ahi dinga, Biehinn muol khu gamlah gamgaw mun, bang ahita ding hi.","ref":"Jer. 26.18"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin tambang ahi dinga: Ni nukhia chiengin, Mangpa inn umna muol khu muolte vum ah suhkip ahi dinga, muolte tung ah tawisang ahi ding a, miten azuon zeng zung ding uhi.","title":"Tu nua chieng hing um ding Messiah leenggam"},"2":{"text":"Nam tampite ahing pei ding ua, “Hing pei un, Mangpa muol a Jakob Pasian inn ah pei vai, Ama’n alampi ahing na hil dinga, tuachi’n alampite izui ding uhi;” achi ding uhi. Zion apat in dan ahing pawtkhe dinga, Jerusalem apat Mangpa thu ahing pawtdoh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama’n mi tampite kikaal ah vaihawm dinga, gamla tah a nam hattahte zong athuhil dinga, anamsaute uh loukaina siazum in akheng ding ua, tualeh ateipite uh theikungte heuna temkawiin akheng ding uhi. Nam khat in namdangte douna in, anamsau uh aleh nawn sih ding ua, kidou dan zong azil nawnta sih ding uhi.","ref":"Isai. 2.4; Joel. 3.10"},"4":{"text":"Michin ama uh grepgui nuoi leh atheipi kung, nuoi uah atou hit hiet zawta ding uhi; tualeh koima’n amaute azausah nawn sih ding hi; aziehpen galkapte Mangpa kam in tua thu agenta hi.","ref":"Zek. 3.10"},"5":{"text":"Michin ama pasien min chiet in aumta ding ua, hinanleh eite pen Mangpa i Pasian min in, kumtawn kumtawn in i umta ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Tua ni chiengin, kengbaite ka kaikhawm dinga, Keima’n nawdoh a umte leh, ka suhgentheite ka khawm khawm dinga;","title":"Israel saltaangte khopkhawm hun ding"},"7":{"text":"Aliem abaite asuohta umsun in ka bawl dinga, nawmanga umte nam hattah ka suohsah ding hi; Tuachi’n tu akipat kumtawn dongin, Mangpa’n Zion muol ah, amaute tungah vai ahawmta ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Aw Nang belamhonte venna innsang, Zion tanu kulpi muonhuoi, Nangma ah lalna masapen ahing tung ding a, Jerusalem tanu kungah leenggam ahing tung ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tulaitah a bang ding a nahpitah a kap na hiei? Na lah uah leengpa umlou amah? Nou hing thuhil mite amangthai sieng ata uh amah? Numei nauvei natna bangin ahing manta hi."},"10":{"text":"Aw Zion tanu, numei nauvei bangin, nau suohdoh ding bangin gim inlen, nau veiin, gamlah a giehphuol sat dinga, khopi na nuasie hun ahita hi, Babilon gam nangawn ah na pei ding hi. Khunah hutkhieh in na um dinga, khunah Mangpa’n na melmate, khut a kipat in ahing tandoh ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu in zong nam tampite, nangma dou dingin akikhawm uhi; “Ama suhbua in um hen, i mit un Zion etthaw mai vai;” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun Mangpa lunggel atheisih ua, alemguotnate atheisiem sih uhi. Buphuol a buphaite khopkhawm bangin. Ama’n akhawm khawm ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Aw Zion tanu dingdoh inlen, chiil in, aziehpen na kii khu sia bangin ka bawl dinga, na chinte zong sum-eng in ka bawl ding a, mi tampite na tuonchil ding hi. Tualeh asil met uh Mangpa a dingin, atuom in ka susiengthou ding a, anei alamte uh leitung pumpi, Mangpa kung ah ka tuomkoi ding hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw galkap honte tanu, eite hing kisimna dingin ikimkot ah panmun khawin ahing imkhumta uhi: na galkap honte khawmin. Amauten Israel vaihawmpa abieng ah chiengin asat ding uhi.","title":"Messiah pienna"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh nang Bethlehem Ephrathah Juda gam a tul tampite lah ah neu mananlechin, nangma a kipat in kei a dingin Israel vaihawmpa ding khat ahing pawt ding hi. Ama kipatchilna tanglai hun, kumtawn kumtawn akipat ahita hi.","ref":"Mat. 2.6; Jn. 7.42"},"3":{"text":"Tuazieh in nauveinu’n nau apien masangsie in, amanu’n amauh anuasie ding a, Tuachi’n asanggam umsunte Israel tate kungah ahing kinuale kia ding uhi.","title":"Messiah deilouna"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Ama adingdoh dinga, Mangpa hatna in abelamhonte ava ding a, Mangpa a Pasian min vangletna in ava ding hi; tualeh amauh aumdenta ding uhi. Aziehpen tuin Ama lei tawp donga thupi ding ahita hi.","title":"Messiah nasepte"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh tam mipa khu hamuonna ahi ding hi, Assiriate igam sunga ahing peitah chiengun, tualeh i leeng innpi huongsung ang totchil chiengun, Ama dou dingin belampu sagi leh lamkai lien mi giet itungdoh ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amauten namsau toh Assiria gam ah vai ahawm ding ua, namsau apai apat dawsa toh Nimrod gam sung avaihawm khum ding uhi. Assiria mite igam dou dinga ahing kuon chieng ua, igamgi sung ahing tot chiengun, Ama’n tambang in Assiriate apat ahing hundoh ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 10.8-11"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakobte lah a ashimawh umsunte mi tampite lah ah Mangpa akipat a daitui bang leh hampa tunga guophin koima ngahselou leh mihing tapate zong ngah selou bang ahi ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jakob shimawh umsunte khu namte lah a mi tampite lah ah, gammang a gamsate lah a humpibahnei bang, leh belamhon lah a humpibahnei bang leh belamhon lah a humpibahnei hatlai bangin, apeina lam lam ah atuonchil a abalnen gawp a, ahunkhe ding koima a um sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Na melmate tungah na khut dopsang ahi ding a, tualeh na galte zousie sattan in a um ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi. Tua ni chiengin na lah ua na sakolte uh ka sattan dinga, tualeh na sakollengte uh ka suse ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Na gamsung ua khopite ka suse dinga, Na kulpidet tahte zousie uh ka suse sieng ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na khut ua kipat in na bumsiemnate uh ka sumang ding a, tualeh aisansiem na nei nawn sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Na milim khenthute uleh, na milim khuomte uh, na lah ua pat in ka suse ding a, na khutsuohte uh na be nawn sih ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Na lah ua kipat in na Asherimte uh ka botdoh dinga, na khopite uh ka phietmang ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh ka thu manglou namte tungah lungthahna leh thangpaina phuba lahna ka tungsah ding hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangpa thugen tuin ngai un, Dingdoh unlen, taangte kungah na tungtang thu uh gen unlen, Tualeh muolten na aw za uhen.","title":"Israelte tunga Mangpa lungkimlouna"},"2":{"text":"Aw nou taangte Mangpa hing hehna ngaikhie un, Nou leitung kingapna suongphum dettahte aw, Ngai khie un; aziehpen Mangpa’n amite aheh a, tualeh Israel tungthu agen ding hi."},"3":{"text":"“Ka mite aw, na tung ua bang ahiei ka bawl? Bangchidan a noute ka hing lungkham sah ahiei? Hing dawng un."},"4":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipat in noute ka hing puidoh a, Saltaanna inn apat ka hing tandoh a; na masang uah, Mosi, Aaron leh Miriam ka sawl hi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.50,51; Pawt. 4.10-16; Pawt. 15.20"},"5":{"text":"Aw ka mite, Moab leengpa Balak in bang agen a, Beor tapa Balaam in bangchin adawng ei, Mangpa dihtatnate na theina ding un, Shittim apat Gilgal dong na khuolzinna uh thei ngitnget un.”","ref":"Kisim. 22.2—24.25; Josh. 3.1—4.19"},"6":{"text":"“Mangpa maiah bang toh hing pei ding ka hiei, Tungnung Sangpen Pasian mai a bangchi kun ding ka hiei? Bawngnou kum khat a upa toh, Halmang sillat toh, Amai a hing pei ding ka diei?"},"7":{"text":"Mangpa khu belamtal tul tampi leh, sathau luitui tul sawm banga luong tungah alungkim na diei? Ka tatkhelna ziehin ka ta chiil ka pie in, ka hagau khelna ziehin ka tahsa ga pe ding ka hi diei?”"},"8":{"text":"Aw mihing, Aman ahoi ahing ensahta a, Mangpa’n nang akipat ahing phut bang ahiei? Dihtat taha bawl, hepina ngainat, tualeh kingaingiem tah a na Pasian toh, zawhkhawm ahi sih a mah?"},"9":{"text":"Mangpa aw khu khopi lam ah akikou a, tualeh pilna nei miin namin athei ding, chieng leh abawlpa, “Ngaikhie un."},"10":{"text":"Migiloute innsungah gitlouna goubawm, tualeh tena chinglou kidah huoi a um eimah?"},"11":{"text":"Buhna dihloute leh lepchietah a ip gihsahte, asiengthou hi, kachi thei ding amah?"},"12":{"text":"A mi hausate uh hiemngamna in adim ua, khuna tengte’n zuou agen ua, akamsung ua aleite uh lepchie hattah ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin keima’n zong natah a sat in, ka hing chinasah dinga, na khelnate ziehin ka hing suse ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Na ne ding ua, na gilva tuom sih ding ua, na lah uah gilkielna a um ding a, Na koimang ding a, hinanleh na humbit zou sih dinga, na humbit sun nangawn zong namsau ka pe nalai ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Na tu dinga, hinanleh na at sih dinga, Olive na chil ding a, hinanleh athau na kinu sih ding, Uoin hum tah na bawl ding a, hinanleh na dawn tuom sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen Omri thugousiete na zui a, Ahab innkuonte tatdan zousie na zui a, athuhilnate bangin na gamta uhi. Tuaziehin ka hing sumang dinga, na sunga tengte chizatin na um ding ua; Tuaziehin ka mite minsietna na khu ding uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 16.23-28; 1 Leeng. 16.29-34; 21.25,26"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tung gih hina e! Nipi lai a theiga khonkhawm mi leh, grep sang khonkhawm mi bang ka hi bou hi; neh ding aga bomte a um sih a, Ka hinna in alunggul theipi ga min masa lah aum sih hi.","title":"Guolnei Mika in adawnna"},"2":{"text":"Pasian miginumte leitung apat in amangthaita ua, tualeh mihingte lah ah midihtat khat zong a um nawn sih hi. Amauten sisan suo dingin mi abuh ua, Michin in a unaupa man dingin lenthang toh a sui kawi uhi."},"3":{"text":"A khut langni un silhoilou lawching tahin abawl ua, leengtapa in silpieh angen a, vaihawm mi in neguh ding asui a, milien in lah silhoilou alunggulte agenkhie a, tuabangin apangkhawm chiet uhi."},"4":{"text":"A lah ua mihoipen zong loulingnei bang ahi a, midih pen zong dailingnei sangin ahiemzaw hi. Na galvengte ni leh, nangma hing kigawtna ni ahing tungta hi; Tu khu abuoisietna ni uh ahita ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na lawmpa muong sinlen, na lawm na guolte zong muong sin, na angsunga lumnu akipat na kam kotkha vengin."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen tapa in pa azatat sih a, tanu in anu adou a, mounu in a innpinu adou hi, mihingte melma khu ama innsunga mite mama ahi.","ref":"Mat. 10.35,36; Luk. 12.53"},"7":{"text":"Tuazieh in kenvang Mangpa lam ka en dinga, ka hundamna Pasian ka ngah ding a, ka Pasian in ahing ngaikhe ding hi.","title":"Hundamna leh tun dingna"},"8":{"text":"Aw ka melma, ka tungah kipah in Thangpai seng sin, ka pua chiengin ka thoukia dinga, miel lah a katou chiengin, Mangpa khu Kei a dingin vah ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Keilam a panga ka tungthu ahing gen pieh a, kei a dinga vaihawmna dihtah atangtun masangsie in, atunga ka khelna ziehin, Mangpa thangpaina thuoh ding mawng ka hi. Ama’n vah ah ahing puidoh dinga, Adihtatna ka mu ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuahun chiengin ka melma in tuakhu amu dinga, “Ka kunga Mangpa na Pasian hei a um ahiei?” Chi nu zumnain atuomkhum, Ka mitten amu ding hi. Tuin amanu kholai a buonnawi bangin, totchil in a umta ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua niin na kulbaangte bawl ahi ding a, Tua niin thutanna gamlapi a suonmang ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Assiria akipat kulpi nei khopite akipat in, kulpi akipat Euphrates luipi tandong, tuipi akipat tuipi tandong, muol akipat muol tan dongin na kungah, ahing pei ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Khuchi pumpum in zong gam khu, asunga tengte zieh leh asilbawlte uh ga ziehin, suhsiet in a um ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Karmel muol lah a gamnuoi a, lungheltah a um na goutan lah a na belamhon, na mite na khetbuh zangin ching inlen, nidanglai bangin Bashan leh, Gilead gam sungah vah in um chiet u’heh."},"15":{"text":"Izipt gam akipat a na hing pawtdoh lai bangun, amaute kungah sil lamdang tahtahte ka ensah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Namte’n tua khu amu ding ua, asilbawltheina zousie uh azumpi ding uhi; akam uh ahum ding ua, abilte uh abing ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Gul bangin leivui alieh ding ua, leitunga bohvah ganhingte bangin, akuo ua pat in chitun kawmkawm in ahing pawtdoh ding ua, amauten Mangpa i Pasian uh agiing ding ua, noute ziehin azau ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Nang banga thulimlounate ngaidam a, agoutan umsunte tatkhelna peikan Pasian koi ahiei um? Hepina akipahpi ziehin alungthahna kumtawn in avomden sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Akiheikia dinga itung uah lainatna anei ding a, ithulimlounate uh a nuoi ah akoi ding a, Nang ka khelnate zousie uh tuipi thuhtah sungah na pai lut ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Nidanglai a kapu leh pate uh na kichiemna bangin, nang Jakob kungah thutah, tualeh Abraham kungah khotuona na pe ding hi."}}}}},"34":{"info":{"name":"Nahum","shortname":"Nah.","abbr":[],"desc":"Nahum laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nineveh khuo puohgih, Elkosh khuo a um Nahum mengmuna laibu ahi.","ref":"Isai. 10.5-34; 14.24-27; Zeph. 2.13-15"},"2":{"text":"Pasian khu thangsiet hat ahia, Mangpa’n phuba ala hi. Mangpa’n phuba ala a, lungthahnain adim hi; Mangpa’n ama doute tungah phuba ala ding a, Amelmate adingin thangpaina akholkhawm hi.","title":"Nineveh khopi tunga Mangpa lungthahna"},"3":{"text":"Mangpa alungthahbai sih a, nasatah a silbawlthei a hi, Migilou siem atangsah, ngai mawngmawng sih ding a, Mangpa’n pingpei leh, huipi lah ah lampi anei a, meilumte khu akenga leivuite ahi bou hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama’n tuipi aphawh a akangsah a, luipite zousie akanggaw sah hi. Bashan leh Karmel avuoigawp sah a, Lebanon pah lunlaite avul sahta hi."},"5":{"text":"Amasangah taangte akiling a muolte azunmang hi; Amasang ah lei akatum a, khovel leh asunga umte zousie toh."},"6":{"text":"A lungthahna masanga ding ngam ding koi ahiei? koi ahiei alungthahna zauhuoina thuoh zou ding? A lungthahna khu mei banga sunbuoh in aum a, tualeh suongpite Aman asepkehta hi."},"7":{"text":"Mangpa ahoi a, lungkhambuoi ni a kulpi dettah ahi a, Ama’n ama muongte athei hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh tuisang luonglet zangin, amelmate asubei dinga, mielna in agalte anuadel ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa douna a bang ahiei na phielguh uh? Aman asubei sieng kilkel dinga, suhgentheina niveina atung nawn sih ding hi.","title":"Nineveh suhsietna leh Juda hutkhietna"},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen amaute ling banga zieltom leh, zukhamhatte banga zukham a a um lai un, bupawl gaw bangin akatum sieng ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mangpa tunga silgilou ngaituo leh, lemguot mi giloutah khat, nang akipat in ahing pawtdoh hi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Amaute bittah in um nan u’leh, tualeh khumbangin tampi um nan u’leh zong, a lah uh ahing tot chiengin, tuabang a satkhieh in a um ding uhi. Nang hing na sugentheita nanleng zong, Kang sugenthei nawnsih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen tuin nang akipat in, ahahkol ka sutawng dinga, na kolbute ka phelkhe ding hi.”"},"14":{"text":"Mangpa’n nangma tungtangah, thupieh khat apeta hi: “Na min umsah ngitnget ding, hahlesuon nanei nawn sih ding hi. Na pasien innte akipat in na milim, khenthute leh sunthute ka satkhe dinga, na han ka tou ding,” na gitlou ziehin."},"15":{"text":"Taangte tunga khantanhoi, kipahna thupha hing puohpa leh, lungmuonna thu phuongpa kengte endi ua! Aw Juda na pawi guot tuomte mang inlen, na thuchiem sutangtung in, aziehpen migilouten ahing dou nawn sih ding uhi, amaute suhmangthai ahita uhi.","ref":"Isai. 52.7"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Satzahpa na masang ah ahing peitou hi: Kulpite ah vengmi koi inlen, lampi veng hoiin, Na kawngte uh hatsah unlen, Na tha uh khausah un.","title":"Kidou ding a hatna"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen Israel vangletna bangin, Jakob vangletna, Mangpa’n apekia ding hi. A su awng miten amauh asu awng zouta ua, a grep bate uh asuseta uhi."},"3":{"text":"A mihatte lumte khu san sah ahi a, a mihangsanten puonsandup asil uhi, Akisahkhol ni un asakollengte uh, meisel kuong sengsong bang in avah a, ateipite uh ate setsot hi.","title":"Nineveh khopi suhsietna"},"4":{"text":"Kidouna sakollengte kholai dung a, lam liente ah khat leh khat akiphutuo butbut uhi; Meisel kuong abang ua, tunphe bangin atai uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aman amiliente atheidoh a, alam peina uah akipalpua ua, kulbang lam zuon in akin pei ua, kidalna pan mun abawlkhol uhi."},"6":{"text":"Luipi kotpite akihongta a, leeng innpi suhbei ahita hi."},"7":{"text":"Tami thupieh ahi: Huzzab sal a puimang ahi dinga, akivahkhang lien ding a; tualeh asuoh numeite un, a awm uh tum in, khuvanu bangin kap ngetngut kawm in, ama apui ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Nidanglai apat Nineveh khu tuikul bang ahi a, Tuin ataimangta uhi, “Khawl in, khawl in” chi’n akikou ua, hinanleh koima akinuahei aum sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Dangkate galsumte lahpieh unlen, galsum lah in sanate lahpieh un, Sil hoi kikholkhawm leh athupina in, tawpni anei sih ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama khu ahawmguoh, bangmalou leh kisegawp ahita! Lungtangte azunmanga, khupte akithing hi; tahsa tung chinteng ana siengta a, Amaite zousie uh amuol siengta hi."},"11":{"text":"Koima suhzau lou a aumna uh, humpibahnei talte, humpibahnei pite leh, humpibahnei noute avah kawina u’leh, humpibahnei tenna mun leh, humpibahnei noute ann nehna hei tah atai?"},"12":{"text":"Humpibahnei tal in anoute khamkhop ding abotnen a, humpibahnei pite a dingin akeilia pieh hi, abuh sungte asamat in adim sah a, akohawmte asamatte luongin adim hi."},"13":{"text":"Ngai vawi, ka hing dou ahi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi. Na sakollengte uh mei in ka hal khu liai luoi ding a, na humpibahnei hatlaite uh namsau in athatgam dinga; tualeh leitung akipat in na samatte ka sutawp ding a, tualeh na thangkoute aw, akiza nawn mawngmawng sih ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sisan suohat khopi tung agih hi; zuou leh kisuomna in adim siengta a, Suomhatte nang a kipat apeimang sih ding hi.","title":"Nineveh khopi in Pasian atheilou dan uh"},"2":{"text":"Kizepna khauhuol ging leh, Sakolleng keng kigawt gingte, Sakol ketot gingte bang, sakolleng tai vutvut gingte toh;"},"3":{"text":"Sakol tungtuong miten a namsau valsetsot leh, ateipi tesetsette uh alaam ua, akithatlia mitampi a um ua, mishi luong atam atam a um uhi; mishi luong simsenglou a lum pheng phung a, tua mishi luongte tungah akipalpua uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuate khu kizuanu melhoi huasanna zieh leh, a angkawmnate zieh a, Hagau lam a muonhuoi louna ahisihleh gin umlouna. Namte zua a, adawi aisan siem zieh a, innkuonte zua dawi ai san siemnu zieh a hing um ahi."},"5":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n Ngai vawi, ka hing dou ahi achi hi, Na puonten na mailam ah ka hawh dinga, na saguohna namte ka musah ding hi. Na zumhuoina leenggam ten ka ensah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Silnieh kidahhuoitah na tungah Kang the ding a, zumhuoitah in ka hing bawl dinga, etnop huoi in Kang koi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, Nang hing en zousie in, ahing taimangsan ding ua, Nineveh asegawpta, Koi ahiei ama suun ding? Nang dingin hamuonna heilang ka suita ding adiei? achi ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Nile luipi gei a um, akimvel a tuiin akuolkhum tuipi akulbang imna hi a, tuite akulbang hi, No Amon sangin na hoizaw amah?","title":"Nineveh leh No Amon tekahna"},"9":{"text":"Ethiopia leh Izipt ahatna ahi a, Tawp chin neilou ahi, Put leh Lubim khu nang hing panpite ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh puimangin a um a, Sal ding in apeita hi, Ata ngehte uzong kholai dung teng ah, tuolsatnan anei uhi. Kholai dung lamka thuom chinteng ah, ami zatat huoite ua dingin ai asan uhi, amiliente zousie siakhau a kaan in a um uhi."},"11":{"text":"Nang zong na dawnkham dinga, phuol in na um ding hi; Melmate akipat bitna dingin, kibutna na sui ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na kulpi zousie theipi ga min masa, theipi kung abang ding ua, akinuh chiengin, anete kamsung ah akesuh ding hi.","title":"Nineveh kulpite achimta"},"13":{"text":"Adihtah in na lah ua na mipite numei ahi ua, na gam kulkotpite khu na galte ua dingin, akihong lien dinga; Na kalna zawlte mei in akatum ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Imchimit a na um sunga dingin, tui kitawi masah inlen, na kulpite sudet inlen, tungman umna ah pei inlen, azutmatnate chil inlen tehlei a kibawl bangte sudet in."},"15":{"text":"Khunah mei in nang ahing katum dinga, namsau in ahing sattan ding hi; tuami’n nang khauphe nehgam bangin, ahing negam ding hi. Khauphe bangin nouma leh nouma kipungsah unlen, khaukhuppite bangin nouma leh nouma kisupung un."},"16":{"text":"Na summetbawl mite uh, van aasite sanga tamzaw in na tamsah zawta hi; khauphete’n anegam ua, aleengmangta uhi.","title":"Nineveh lamkaite hatnawnlou"},"17":{"text":"Na galkap liente khauphe hon tampi bang ahi ua, na galkap lamkaite khu khovot ni a, dai dawn a khauphe hon boh khepkhup bang ahi uhi, hinanleh ni ahing sat chiengin aleengmang ua, a umna mun uh akithei nawn sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Aw Assiria leengpa na belampute uh a imu ua, na miliente leivui lah ah akhawldam uhi. Na mipite muolte tungah akithezah ua, Amaute koiman apuikhawm sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Na liemna damna ding a um sih a, na liemna anase mama hi. Na tungtang thuthang zakha poumain, akhut uh ahing behkhum ding uhi; aziehpen na gitlouna bei theilou, athuoh khalou a um mawngmawng amah?"}}}}},"35":{"info":{"name":"Habakuk","shortname":"Haba.","abbr":[],"desc":"Habakuk laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Guolnei Habakuk in puohgih amu khu:","title":"Habakuk phunna masa"},"2":{"text":"Aw Mangpa kei bang tanvei, ahiei ka kikou dinga, “Nang na hing dawn lou ding?” Hiemngamtah a kigumnawna aum hi, chiin na kungah ka hing kikou a, nang na hing hunkhe sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Bangding a thulimlouna hing musah a, tualeh gentheina hing ensah na hiei? Ka masangah manthaina leh, hiemngapna a um a, tualeh kihauna leh kinielna apiengsah hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin dan in thuneina anei nawn sih a, thudih a vaihawmna a um ngai sih hi. Aziehpen migilouten midihtatte a imkuol uhi; tuaziehin vaihawmna heikawi in a um hi."},"5":{"text":"Namte lah en unlen, kaihit un, lamdang sa in chiza un, aziehpen na damsung un nna khat ka sem ding, tuakhu hing kihil nanleh nouten na gingta sih ding uhi.","title":"Pasian adawnna masa","ref":"Nasep. 13.41"},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen Ngai un, Kaldai mi ka tungding a, nam hel leh gangtah ahi ua, amauh tenna mun hilou, munte lahpieh dingin, leitung vailam tuonsuohin apei ding uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.2"},"7":{"text":"Amaute nam ginhuoi leh chizat um ahi ua, Avaihawmna uleh athupina uh ama ua, kipat mama in apawtdoh hi."},"8":{"text":"Asakolte uh kamkeite sangin agangzaw ua, nitahlam ngie gilkielte sangin azauhuoi zaw uhi. Asakol tungtuong galkapte uh hattah in ahing tai ua, asakol tung tuongte uh gamlapi akipat in ahing kuon uhi. Sa ne dinga gangtah a bawsuh muvanlai leeng bang ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Thagumsuo dinga hing kuon ngen ahi ua, suolam hui bangin mailam anaw ua, pieunel khopkhawm bang mai in, salte aman khawm uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amaun leengte asimmaw ua, vaihawmte anuisan uhi. Kulpi muonhuoi chinteng simmaw in anuisan uhi; aziehpen panmun leipal asepvum ua, khopi ala zel uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n alungsim akiheng a atakhiel ding a, akhelna abawl ding a asilbawltheina uh khu, Pasian a angai ziehun."},"12":{"text":"AW MANGPA Ka Pasian, ka Misiengthoupa, Nang kumtawn akipata a umsa hilou na hiei mah? Ka shisih ding uhi. Aw Mangpa nang amaute vaihawmna a dingin na guotta a, Aw Suongpi, Nangman amaute suhdih dingin na phutdohta hi.","title":"Habakuk phunna niveina"},"13":{"text":"Nang khu silgilou en theilou khop a mitchim na hi a, tualeh gitlouna na en nuom sih a, bangding a lepchie tah a gamtate en a, migilouin ama sanga dihtatzawte abawlsiet chienga, bangdinga sip dide a um thei na hiei?"},"14":{"text":"Bangdinga mihingte tuipi a ngate banga na bawl a, atung ua vaihawm ding neilou ganhing, bohvahte banga na bawl ahiei?"},"15":{"text":"Amaun ngakuoi in amaute akhaidoh sieng ua, alen un aman ua, alenvaite un ahuikhawm ua; tuaziehin kipahin nuom asa uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin alen uh kung uah akithoi ua, alenvai kung uah gimnamtui ahal ua, tuate ziehin atuohpha ua, neh leh taah kichingtah aneilaw uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin amauten alen uh aguoh a umsah in, hepina bei a namte, that ngitnget ding ahi ding uoi?"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka galvenna ah ka ding dinga, innsawng tung ki-im na dai ah ka tuong dinga, lungkimlou a ka phunna thu ah, Ka kungah bang ahiei ang gen ding, tualeh kei ang mawpai taah leh, bangchi’n ka dawng diei, chi kava ngah ding hi.","title":"Pasian dawnna niveina"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n kei ahing dawngta a: “Mengmuna gielin, asim miin tai kawm a asim thei ding, khop a kichien in suongpeh tungah giel in, ahing chi hi."},"3":{"text":"Mengmuna khu hun guotsa sunga, ding maimai ahia, atawp lam ah thu ahing gen dinga, azuou sih ding hi. Zekai deu in sawt deu nanleh, Ngah in, ahing tun ngeingei ding ziehin, akiheh sih ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 10.37"},"4":{"text":"En vawi, mi kiliensah, hinna khu ama ah adihtat sih hi; hinanleh midihtat khu ginnain ahing ding, hi.","ref":"Rom. 1.17; Gal. 3.11; Heb. 10.38"},"5":{"text":"Ahi, tuathamlouin zu a takhiel pouma mi kiliensah ahi a, inn ah a um khinkhian thei sih a, alunggulte gawtmun bangin ahong lien a, Shina bang ahi a, lungkim chi neilou ahi zieh in, namchin ama kungah ahuoi khawm a, mi zousie ama a dingin asiekhawm hi.”"},"6":{"text":"Tamte zousie in ama demna gentena thu agen ua, tualeh ama elhouna paunah “Ama a hiloupi supung a, khamna sil avum aval a koi a kilalien mi khu atung agih hi, bangtan tuabang in abawl diei?” chiin agen sih ding uh amah?"},"7":{"text":"Na sumbate thakhat a hing lungthah, phut lou ding uh amah? Amaute hing khanglou a nang hing, sugenthei lou ding uh amah? Ama ua dinga agallah uh himai ding na hi."},"8":{"text":"Nam tampite na bulutah ziehin, nam na bululou umsunten nangma, ahing bulu ding uhi. Mite sisan na suo zieh leh, gam tung leh khopi sunga tengte, thagum a na pawngbawlnate ziehin."},"9":{"text":"Migilou silbawltheina akipat a, akihundoh theina dinga, tunglam sangtah a abu sep a, a inn a dinga punna dihlou a, huoiham mi atung agih hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi tampi thatin na hinna tunga khiel in, na innkuonte tung ah zumna na pie hi."},"11":{"text":"Baang akipat suongte a kikoukhe ding ua, singa kibawl innkamten ana dawng ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Sisan suo puma khopi bawl a, thulimlouna toh khopi tungding mi atung agih hi."},"13":{"text":"En un, mipite sepgimna meiin akahtum ding leh, namte lung gimna bangmalou a abei ding, galkapte Mangpa deilam ahisih amah?"},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen tuiin tuipi akhukhum mabangin, Mangpa thupina theina in leitung aluodim ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 11.9"},"15":{"text":"A innvengte kunga dawn ding pie a, asaguohna na et theina dinga akhamsietna ding a, na zu thawl na tul teitei mi tung agih hi!"},"16":{"text":"Thupina sangin zumna in na dim zaw hi, Nang zong dawn inlen! Saguoh in umsuh mai ve! Mangpa zietlam khut a nou khu, nangma lam ah ahing kilehei dinga, na thupina tungah zumhuoina, nasatah ahing um ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Lebanon tunga hiemngapna in, nang ahing khukhum ding a, gamsate sietna in amauh azausah a; Mihing sisan zieh leh gamsung, khopite leh asunga tengte hiemngapna ziehin."},"18":{"text":"Milim bawlthu in bang phattuomna anei a, abawlpa’n ana bawl adiei? Asiemtu in ama khutsuoh ale gintat kia a, Milim ham theilou a bawlpa’n abawl khu, bang ahiei aphattuomna?"},"19":{"text":"Sing kungah Khanglou in! tualeh suong hamtheilou kung a thou in! Chi mi tung agih hi! Tuakhu in ahil thei mama diei? En vawi, Sana leh dangka tui a kiluon khum ahi bou a, tualeh asungah nahtheina mawngmawng a um sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa khu abiehinn siengthou ah a um a, leitung pumpi amai ah sip dide in um chiet uhen."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Shigionoth kai dan a guolnei Habakuk thungetna:","title":"Habakuk in Pasian hepina angetna"},"2":{"text":"Aw Mangpa na thugen ka zata a, ka zau hi. Aw Mangpa Kumte lah ah, na nasep suhal inlen, Kumte lah ah kitheisah kia in; Na lungthah chiengin khotuona thei zingin."},"3":{"text":"Teman akipat in Pasian ang pei a, Paran muol apat in, Mi Siengthoupa ahing pei hi. Selah Athupina in vante akhu a, tualeh leitung Ama phatna in adim hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama taanphatdan khu vah bang mai ahi a, akhut apat in ni keng ahing kikapdoh hi, khunah asilbawltheina akiphuol hi."},"5":{"text":"Amasang ah natna hipi apei a, khosihpi natna in anua azui hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama adingdoh a, leitung ate a, a en a namte akiling sah a, tualeh kumtawn taangte thedal in a um a, kumtawn muolte akun ua alampite kumtawn dai ahi."},"7":{"text":"Kushan mite puon inn gentheithuoh in ka mu a, Midian gam puonzahte akithing uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aw Mangpa luite tungah na lungkimsih amah? Na lungthahna luite tungah aum amah? Na sakolte tunga na tuon lai leh, hundamna sakolleng tung a, na tuon laiin, tuipi tungah na lungthahna aum amah?"},"9":{"text":"Mansa diema koi ahita na thalpi, Na thaltang tungah kihahsiel in akichiem uhi; Selah Nang luite in leitung na kikhen sahta hi."},"10":{"text":"Taangten nang ang mu ua, akithing uhi. Tuisang lette muol aliemzouta uh. Tuithuh in aw suoin aging vengvunga, akhut tunglam ah avawhsangta hi."},"11":{"text":"Na thaltangte vah set sot in aleengkhie ua, na teipite te zolzol in akikhaw ua, Ni leh hapi a umna mun uah, ading den khinkhian uhi."},"12":{"text":"Lungthah in leitung na tuonsuoh a, Lungthah pum in namte na tuonchilta hi."},"13":{"text":"Na mite hundamna dingin leh, na sathaunupa hundamna dingin, nang kuonkhie hi. Nang migilou innkuonte akipat, lutang na satliem a, ataw akipat alu dong na hawh khiet pieh a, guohtangin na um sahta hi. Selah"},"14":{"text":"A khote uh lamkaipa, ama chieng ngel in na sun pailet a, Kei thezah dingin pingpei bangin ahing kuon ua, akipahna u khu aguh a migentheite suhmang ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nang na sakolte toh tuipi ah na vah a, tui kisevum venvon thupitah tawn in na pei hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka zah in dipkuo in ka chitun a, aw ging in ka muhte atunsah a, ka gute sung ah muotna ahing lut a, Chitun in ka kithing hi, vangsietna ni a ama dou dinga, agalkapte toh ahing kuontou chienga, ka khawldam theina dingin, sip khinkhian in ka ngah ding hi.","title":"Habakuk in Pasian hundamna amuong hi"},"17":{"text":"Theipi kung pah sih henlen, grepguite ga sih henlen, Olive sepgimna guohsuohin, tualeh louten neh ding piengsah lou in, ahuong apat ganhonte suhbei a um in, bawngbuhte ah ganta um nawn sih nanleh."},"18":{"text":"Tuachiin zong Mangpa ah ka kipah dinga, ka hundamna Pasian ah ka nuom nalai ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian ka hatna ahi a, Aman ka kengte sazuh keng abangsah dinga, tualeh Aman ka muol sangte ah ahing vahsah ding hi. Lapu lien a ding; ka tumging guineite toh sah ding.","ref":"2 Sam. 22.34; Late. 18.33"}}}}},"36":{"info":{"name":"Zephaniah","shortname":"Zeph.","abbr":[],"desc":"Zephaniah laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Juda leengpa Amon tapa Josiah hunlai a, Hezekiah tapa Amariah, Amariah tapa Gedaliah, Gedaliah tapa Kushi, Kushi tapa Zephaniah kunga Mangpa thu hing tung khu:","title":"Leitung pumpi tunga vaihawmna tung ding","ref":"2 Leeng. 22.1—23.30; 2 Khang. 34.1—35.27"},"2":{"text":"“Leitung a um sil zousie ka phietmang sieng ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"3":{"text":"“Keima’n mi leh sa ka phietmang dinga, Vanlaizawl aleengvate leh tuipi a ngate, tualeh migilou mi kipalpuasahte pumin, ka phietmang ding a, Leitung akipat in mihing ka sattan ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"4":{"text":"“Juda douna leh Jerusalem a, tengte zousie douna in ka khut ka laam ding a, tam mun akipat in Baal umnalaite leh, milim bie siempute leh lawkite siempute, min ka sumang ding hi.","title":"Juda tunga vaihawmna"},"5":{"text":"Inntungvum lah a vanlaizawl a aasi bie a kunte, leh Mangpa bie a amin a kihahsiel a kichiemte, hinanleh Milkom min siel a zong kichiemte;"},"6":{"text":"Mangpa nuazuilai kinuaheisante leh, Mangpa suilou, kan zong kanvateh loute ka phietmang ding hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Mangpa Pasian masang ah sipkhinkhian un, Mangpa ni anai tah ziehin, Mangpa’n kithoina aguong zouta a, Amichielte asusiengthouzouta hi."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa kithoina ni ah tambang ahi ding, “Milien milalte, leengpa tate, leh gamdang puon a kizemte zousie, ka gawt ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ni main phuol tunga kitawm kawite zousie leh, hiemngapna leh lepchiena a, apute uh inn dimsahte, ka gawt ding hi.”"},"10":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, “Tua ni chiengin” Nga kotpi a kipat in, “Daa leh kaana husa akiza dinga, Umna Nina lam a kipat mauna, Tualeh muol lam akipat in puana, ging ngaitah a um ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Nou Maktesh a tengte kap in mau un, aziehpen summetbawl mite zousie, suhmangin a umta ua, sum a summet bawlte zousie, sattan in aumta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin ken meivah de in, Jerusalem ka suidoh ding a, khophawh lou a, lungkimtah a um a, alungtang ua, Mangpa’n silhoi abawl sih ding a, sil hoilou zong abawl sih ding chi mite, ka gawt ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin anei alamte uh gallah vante ahing hi dinga, a innte uh ahawm in akinuasie ding hi. Innte abawl ding ua, hinanleh aluo sih ding uhi; grep huonte abawl ding ua, hinanleh grep zu adawn sih ding uhi.”"},"14":{"text":"Mangpa ni thupi anaita a, anaiin akinaw mama ta hi. Mangpa ni a kaana husa ahuoisie hi, khunah mihatte akap hut hut ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuani khu thangpaina ni ahia, Lungzin lungkhamna ni ahi, buoina leh sietna ni ahi a, mielna leh lungkiehna ni ahi, meilum kai a mielna thupi ni ahi."},"16":{"text":"Kulpi nei khopite leh galvenna innsangte, douna a pengkul ginni leh, kigal ginna ni ahi."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa tunga akheltah ziehun, mite tungah lunggimna ka tungsah dinga, mittote bangin avah ding ua, a sisan uh leivui bangin akibokhe dinga, atahsa uh eeh bang mai a pai ahi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Mangpa thangpaina ni ah, adangka uleh asanate un, ahunkhe theisih ding hi; Hinanleh gam pumpi a thangsietna, meiin akatum ding hi; Aziehpen Aman agam sunga teng mi zousie, kintah in asubei pai ding hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kikhawm un, Ahi, kikhawm un, Aw nou zumna theilou namte,","title":"Kisia dinga hatna"},"2":{"text":"Thutanna ahing tun masangin, Bushi banga lenmangna ni abei masangin, Mangpa lungthahna zauhuoi na tung ua, ahing tun masangin, Mangpa lungthahna ni na tung ua, ahing tun masangin!"},"3":{"text":"Mangpa sui unlen, athutan na zui, nou leitunga mi kingaingiemte in, dihtatna sui unlen, nunnemna suiun, Mangpa lungthahna ni ah, phuolguh in na um theikha maw sih ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Gaza khuo taisan in a um ding a, Ashkelon khuo ahawm a nuasie in a um dinga, Suntanglai in Ashdod khuo anotdoh ding uhi. Ekron khuo bawdoh in a um ding hi.","title":"Philistin (tumlam) tunga thukhenna","ref":"Isai. 14.29-31; Jer. 47.1-7; Ezek. 25.15-17; Joel. 3.4-8; Amos. 1.6-8; Zek. 9.5-7"},"5":{"text":"Tuipi gei a teng Kereth namte Na tung uh agih hi, Aw Kanaan, Philistin mite gam Mangpa thuin noute ang dem hi Koima ateng ding umlou khop in, ka hing suse ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuipi geite louhing pouna mun ahi ding a, Belam chingte tenna buh leh, belamte huong ahi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuipi gei gamte khu Juda innkuon umsunte a ding ahi dinga, Khunah abelamhonte uh aching ding ua, Nitahlam chiengin Ashkelon innte ah a lum ding uhi. Aziehpen Mangpa a Pasian un, amauh ave dinga, asaltanna uapat apuikia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Moabte hing gensietna leh “Ammon mite hing simmawna ka zata a, Ka mite asimmaw ua, tualeh akigamgitpite u’tung ah, ki uongsah tahin avau uhi.","title":"Moab leh Ammonte tunga thukhenna (suolam)","ref":"Isai. 15.1—16.14; 25.10-12; Jer. 48.1-47; Ezek. 25.8-11; Amos. 1.13-15; Jer. 49.1-6; Ezek. 21.28-32; 25.1-7; Amos. 1.13-15"},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin ahin a ka hinlaisie,” “Moab Sodom bangin ka bawl dinga, tualeh Amon mite khu, Gomorrah bang ahi ngeingei ding uhi, Lahkhai pouna mun leh, chikhuh leh, kumtawn a luolou gam ahiden ding hi; Ka mi umsunten amauh gallah in, ala ding ua, Ka nam umsunten aluo ding uhi, Galkapte Mangpa Israelte Pasian in achi hi.”","ref":"Siem. 19.24"},"10":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa mite tunga kiliensah tah a avau ziehun, alawtah ding uh tambang ahi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama ua dingin Mangpa khu, chizat huoitah ahi ding a, Leitung a pasiente zousie a sumang ding a, tualeh michin in ama umna mun chiet akipat, leh tuipi gei a namte zousie in Ama abe ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Nou Ethiopia mite zong, namsau a thain na um ding uhi.","title":"Ethiopia tunga thukhenna (simlam)","ref":"Isai. 18.1-7"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Aman mallam douna in, akhut azahtou ding a, Assiria asumang ding hi, tualeh Nineveh khopi koima tennalou ahawm guoh, gamdai bangin a gaw ding hi.","title":"Assiria tunga thukhenna (mallam)","ref":"Isai. 10.5-34; 14.24-27; Nah. 1.1—3.19"},"14":{"text":"Alaikimtah ah ganhonte aboh ding ua, Gamsa namkim zong a boh ding uhi, Simbupi leh simbuneute, akhuompite ah agieh ding ua, Kotta ah, aw kilawmtah in la asa ding uhi; kotphung innhim ah sietna a um ding a, Sidar sing umte zong bangmalou asuohta ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tam khopi nuomsatah leh kimuong zou tah a khosa, alungtanga, “Keima ka hi, kei chilou koima a umsih hi” chinu khu Bangchia ahawm a hing um a, gamsate lupna mun hing suohdoh ata diei, Koi zong a kunga peikha poumain achilphitkhum ding ua, akhuttum uh alekhum ding uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Helhat leh polte nu, leh mi nuoisie hat khopi tung agih hi!","title":"Jerusalem ginatlouna"},"2":{"text":"Amanu’n A aw angaikhe sih a, suhdihna zong apom sih a, Mangpa zong amuong sih a, a Pasian lam anai utsih hi."},"3":{"text":"A lah ua vaihawm liente, humpibahnei humham bang ahi ua, a vaihawmte lah nitahlam ngiete, zingmawng donga kheu ding, sagu nuasie lou bangte ahi uhi."},"4":{"text":"A guolneite lah mizumsuo hat leh, lepchie mite ahi ua, Asiempute un munsiengthou asubua ua, dan thu apalsan uhi."},"5":{"text":"Alah ua um Mangpa khu adihtat a, Aman dihtatlouna abawl sih ding hi. Zingmawng chin in adihna vah ah akilang sah a, apelngai sih hi. Hinanleh midihtatlouten zumna athei sih uhi.","title":"Mangpa dihtatna"},"6":{"text":"“Ken namte ka sattanta a, akulpite uh akiphetse gawpta a, Ken a gawlzingte uh ahawm in ka umsah a, koima apeisuoh sih hi. Akhopite uh suhsiet in a umta a, Koima a umsih a, ateng zong a umsih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Adihtahin Kei na hing giing ding a, thuhilna na pom ngeingei ding, Tuachi’n bang chituh in gawt nanleng, atenna khopite uh susiet ahisih ding ka chi hi. Hinanleh zingmawng matahin athou ua, asilbawl zousie uh asusie uhi.”"},"8":{"text":"“Tuaziehin theipitu hi dinga, ka dindoh masangsie’n hing na ngah un,” Mangpa’n achi hi. “Ka siltup ahileh atung ua, Ka thangpaina leh, ka lungthahna zauhuoitah mai sunbuoh na ding a, leenggamte khopkhawm a, namte hatkhawm ahi. Leitung pumpi ka thangsietna meikuongah, akatum sieng ding hi.","title":"Leitung pumpi gawtna"},"9":{"text":"“Tuahun chiengin mite kungah ham siengthou ka pe dinga, lungsim munkhat pua a Mangpa min, alaw theina ding u’leh ana asep theina dingun."},"10":{"text":"Ethiopia lui gallam a, Keima hing bie, akithezah ka mite tanuten, ka sillatte ahing tawi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"“Tuami ni chiengin ka tunga, na tatkhelna silbawlte ziehun na zum nawn sih ding ua, Tua hun chiengin na lah ua kipat in, na kisahtheina uh thangphatpite ka lamang dinga, ka taang siengthou ah kisatheitah in, na um thei nawn sih ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Na lah uah mi kingaingiemte leh, nunnemte ka nuasie dinga, tuachi’n amaun Mangpa min a muong ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Israel mi umsunten dihtatlouna abawl sih ding ua, zuou thu agen sih ding uhi, akam uah lepchiena thu akimu sih ding hi; amaun abelamhonte uh avah ding ua, alumsah ding ua, Koiman azausah nawn sih ding hi.”","ref":"Kihil. 14.5"},"14":{"text":"La sa in, Aw Zion tanu, Kikoukhie in Aw Israel! Aw Jerusalem tanu na lungtang teng teng a, kipah in nuomsa in.","title":"Tunding kiana ding thuchiem"},"15":{"text":"Na vaihawmnate Mangpa’n alamangta a, Na galte anotdohta hi. Israelte Lengpa, Mangpa na lah uah a um hi; vangsietna na tuoh nawn sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Jerusalem kungah, “Zau sin, Zion, na khut zengan sih heh, achi ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Mangpa na Pasian uh nalah uah a um hi, Mihatpa Aman ang hundam ding hi, na tungah nuom in akipah dinga, A itna in ang siemtha ding hi. La sa kawm in na tungah akipah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"“Na lah ua, akiguotsa khawmpi a tel phalou a, lungkhamte ka puikhawm ding a, Nangma zieh a gensietna puahgih pawte khu."},"19":{"text":"Ngai vawi, tua hun chiengin nou hing sugentheite zousie, tungtang ken ka ngaituo ding a, Kengbaite ka hundam ding a, deldoh a umte ka puikhawm ding hi; tualeh maizumna leh zalatsah a aumna uh, gam chintengah, phatna leh minthanna ka pe ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin noute ka hing, nua puilut kia ding a, Tua hun a ka hing puikhawm kia chiengin, Na mitmu ngel ua na saltanna ua kipat a, kang nua puikia hun chiengin, leitunga mizousie lah ah minthang leh, phat in ka hing umsah ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."}}}}},"37":{"info":{"name":"Haggai","shortname":"Hag.","abbr":[],"desc":"Haggai laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leengpa Darius leenga apan kum, akum nina aha guhna, ani khat niin Juda gam uhpipa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel kungah leh siempu lienpen tapa Jehozadak tapa Joshua kungah guolnei Haggai akipat in Mangpa thu ahing tung hi,","title":"Bieh inn lam ding thu","ref":"Ezr. 4.24—5.2; 6.14"},"2":{"text":"“Tambangin galkapte Mangpa’n agen hi: Tam miten Mangpa inn lam hun atung naisih achi uhi.”"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Haggai a kipat in Mangpa thu ahing tung a;"},"4":{"text":"“Tami inn kisie a aum laitah a, noute inntung thuo ni neite a na ten hun uh ahiei mah? achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Na umdan uh ngaituo un."},"6":{"text":"Tampi natu ua, tomnoukhat na polut uhi; nane ua hinanleh na kham sih uh; na dawn ua hinanleh na gilva tuom sih uhi. Puon na sil ua hinanleh koima’n lum nasa tuom sih uh; sum nalaw ua, na lawsate uh ip tovanga guon dingin law na mu uhi, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Na umdan uh ngaituo un!"},"8":{"text":"Muol ah kuontou unlen, sing va la unlen inn lam un, tuachi’n tuakhu ka kipahpi dinga tuachi’n pahtawi in ka um ding, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tampi mu ding na kinem ua hinanleh Ngai un, tawmnoukhat namu uhi, tualeh inn a na hing tut chiengun, ken kana semmang hi. Bangzieh ahiei? Galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi. Noute nouma inn lam chiet zuon in na kitai chiet ua, Kei inn asesa a a umden zieh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin na tung ua van in daitui ahentaanga, tualeh leitungin aga ahen hi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Keima’n Gam leh muolte tung leh bu leh bal leh uoin tha leh sathau tungah, leitung gasuoh chinteng tungah, mihing leh ganta tungah, tualeh na khut nasep gimna zousie tungah, khokhalna ka tun sah ahi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh siempu lienpen Jehozadak tapa Joshua leh mipi umsunte zousie in Mangpa a Pasian uh aw leh Mangpa a Pasian un asawl mabangin guolnei Haggai thu amang ua, tualeh mipiten Mangpa azau mama uhi.","title":"Miten Mangpa thupieh azui uh"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thupopa Haggai in Mangpa thuvaihah khu mipite kungah agen a, “Na kung uah ka um hi” Mangpa’n achi hi, achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n Juda gam uhpipa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel lungsim, leh siempulienpen Jehozadak tapa Joshua lungsim, tualeh mipi umsunte lungsim atohthou a, tualeh ahing kuon ua galkapte Mangpa a Pasian uh inn bawl in na asem uhi."},"15":{"text":"Darius leengpa vaihawm kum, akum nina, ahaguhna anisawm leh li ni in, inn alampanta uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aha sagina, ani sawmni leh khat niin guolnei Haggai akipat in Mangpa thu ahing tunga,","title":"Inn tha thupina"},"2":{"text":"“Juda gam uhpipa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel kungah, siempu lienpen Jehozadak tapa Joshua kungah tualeh mipi umsunte kungah tuin thu gen in, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Nidanglai a tami inn thupina mu noute lah a adam nalai koi a um ei? Tualeh tuin tami bangchi na sa uoi? Amasa pen toh tekah in, na mitmu uah tam pen bangma ahisih amah?","ref":"Ezr. 3.12"},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin Aw Zerubbabel hattah in um in, tualeh siempulien pen Jehozadak tapa Joshua aw kisuhat in, tualeh nou gamsung a um mipite aw, hattah in um unlen nna sem un, Mangpa’n achi hi, aziehpen na kung uah ka um hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi.","title":"Biehinn masa pen sanga biehinn nukhia pen athupi zawh ding ahi"},"5":{"text":"Noute Izipt gam akipat a, na hing peidoh lai ua na kung ua ka thuhunsa dungzuiin, ka hagau na lah uah a umden hi, zau sih un!","ref":"Pawt. 29.45,46"},"6":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: khat vei tah, sawt senglou ding ahi, van leh lei, tuipi leh gamgaw ka hotling ding hi.","ref":"Heb. 12.26"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh namte zousie ka hotling ding a, namte zousie lunggul ahing tung dinga, tualeh thupina in tam inn ka dimsah ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Dangka kei a ahia, Sana zong kei a ahi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam inn nukhiazaw thupina khu inn masa pen thupina sangin athupi zaw ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi. Tualeh tam mun ah hamuonna ka pe ding hi,” galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Darius vaihawm kum, akum nina, aha kuona, ani sawmni leh li ni in, guolnei Haggai akipat in Mangpa thu ahing tunga,","title":"Umsunte thumanlouna"},"11":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Tuin dan tungtang thu, siempute dongun."},"12":{"text":"Mi khat pou in a puonsil mongah sa sieng tuun in puo henlen, tua puon mong in tanghou ahiei, metuitah ahiei, zu ahiei, sathau ahiei, ahisihleh ann dang khat poupou ahiei, sukha taleh ann asukhah pen a siengthou sah diei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n siemputen adawng ua, “Siengthou lou,” achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Haggai in: “Mi khatpou mishi luong zieh a bua khat in, tambang ann te khat pen pen zong sukha taleh tua ann asienglou ahi diei?” achi leh siemputen adawng ua, “He sienglou ding,” chiin adawng uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 19.11-22"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Haggai in adawnga tambangin adawng hi, “Tam mite hichibang ahi ua, tam namte hichibangin ka mai ah a um hi, Mangpa’n achi hi, Tualeh akhut nasep chinteng u’zong hichibangma ahi a, asillat chingteng u’zong asienglou ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh tuni apat maban lam ah, Mangpa inn a suong khat tung a suong dang akilep masangin pilvang tah in ngaituo un.","title":"Umsunte thumanna"},"16":{"text":"Khum hunlai a tena ephah dimvum sawmni mu ding kinem a ahing pei u’leh, ephah sawm ana um hi, uoin suhna khuh a thawl sawm nga thal doh dinga ahing pei chieng un, sawmni ana um giap hi."},"17":{"text":"Na khut nasepna zousie uh nget in ka nesah a, ka muot sah a tualeh giel in ka suse sah hi, hinanleh kei lam ah nang kihei tuom sih uhi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"18":{"text":"A ha kuona ni sawmni leh li na, tuni akipat in maban hundongin, tumasang lam ngaituo un, Mangpa biehinn suongphum ni a kipat ngaituo un."},"19":{"text":"Tangsal sung ah buchi a um nalai ei mah? Ahi, tuni dongin grepgui ahiei, theipi kung ahiei, kawlbuthei ahiei leh Olive sing ahiei, aga nai sih hi. Hinanleh tuni akipat mailam hun ah noute ka hing guolzawl ding hi,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh tuami ha ani sawmni leh li niin Haggai akipat in Mangpa thu ahing tung a,","title":"Tunua chienga Jentel thuneina suhbeina"},"21":{"text":"Juda gam uhpipa Zerubbabel kungah thugen in: “Keima’n lei leh van ka hotling ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Leng gamte leengtoupha ka paikhe dinga, namte leenggam thahatnate ka suse ding hi. Kangtalaite leh atunga tuongte ka paikhe dinga, Sakolte leh atung ua tuongte ahing kumsuh ding ua, Michin asanggampa namsau a shi ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin, Shealtiel tapa ka suohpa Zerubbabel aw, nang ka hing la ding; Mangpa’n achi hi, tualeh suoinamna khutsip bangin ka hing bawl ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Aziehpen keiman nang ka hing telta hi,” galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."}}}}},"38":{"info":{"name":"Zekariah","shortname":"Zek.","abbr":[],"desc":"Zekariah laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darius vaihawm akum ni na, aha gietna ah Iddo tapa Berekiah, Berekiah tapa guolnei Zekariah kung ah Mangpa thu ahing tung a,","title":"Mangpa kunga kinuale kia dinga hatna","ref":"Ezr. 4.24—5.1; 6.14"},"2":{"text":"“Napu napate uh tungah Mangpa ana lungthah mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin nang akung uah, galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, va chiin, galkapte Mangpa’n Kei kungah hing kinuale un, Kei zong nou kung ah ka hing kinua le ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh bangin umsih un, guolnei masaten amaute kungah, na umdan giloute uleh na sil hoilou bawlte ua kipat in hing kinuahei un, ana chi ua, hinanleh kei ahing ngaikhe ut sih ua, ahing thudon sih uhi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Napu napate uh hei ah a umta uoi? Tualeh guolneite zong kumtawnin ahing den uh amah?"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh ka thute leh, ka thugousiete ka suoh guolneite kunga, ka thupiehte’n napu napate uh adelpha sih amah? Tuachi’n amaute akinuahei ua, galkapte Mangpa’n itung ua bawl ding atup bangin, i umdan bang leh isilbawlte dungzui in itung uah abawlta hi,” achi uhi, chiin, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Darius vaihawm akum ni na, aha sawm leh khatna tua khu Shebat ha ahia, ani sawmni leh li na ah Iddo tapa Berekiah, Berekiah tapa guolnei Zekariah kungah Mangpa thu ahing tunga:","title":"Mangmu khatna: Sakol san tunga tuongpa"},"8":{"text":"“Zanlai in mengmuna ka mu a, Ngai vawi, mi khat sakol san tunga tuong, phaihawm a muising lah ah ading a, tualeh anua lang ah sakol san, abuong leh akang a um hi.","ref":"Kihil. 6.4; Kihil. 6.2"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ken ka Mangpa aw tamte bang ahi uoi? Ka chi hi. Tuachi’n kei hing houpi vansawlsiengin ka kungah, tamte bang ahi uoimah ka hing ensah ding hi, achi hi.","title":"Mengmuna masa hilchienna"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh muising lah a dingpa’n, ahing dawnga, Tamte leitung pumpi tuonsuoh dinga Mangpa’n asawlte ahi uh, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun muising lah a Mangpa vansawlsieng khu adawng ua, Leitung pumpi ka tuonsuoh zouta ua, tualeh Ngai vawi, leitung pumpi sip dide in akhawldam khipkhep hi, achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa vansawlsiengin adawnga, Aw galkapte Mangpa, Jerusalem leh Juda gam khopite tungah kum sawmsagi sung vingveng na lungthahta a, bang tanvei ahiei hepilou a na um nahlai ding, achi hi.","title":"Mangpa’n Zion ahamuon ding"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n kei hing houpi vansawlsieng kungah thuhoi leh lungmuonhuoi thu in adawng hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kei hing houpi vansawlsiengin ka kungah, galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi, chiin phuongkhie in, achi hi. Jerusalem leh Zion ka kihuhpi seng ziehin, ka sitse mama hi."},"15":{"text":"Anop aning a um namte tungah, ka lungthah mama hi; aziehpen tomnou khat a lungthah sung in, amaun asugenthei semsem uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Khotuona toh Jerusalem ah ka kinuale ding hi, asungah ka inn akilam kia ding a, tualeh Jerusalem tung ah tena khau akizan ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ka khopite kiningchinna in adim kia ding a, Mangpa’n Zion ahamuon kia ding a, tualeh Zion atel kia ding hi, chiin phuongzah kia nalai in,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n dahtou a ka et leh kii li ka mu hi.","title":"Mengmuna nina kii lite"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh kei hing houpi vansawlsieng kungah, “Tamte bang ahi uoi?” ka chi hi. Tuachi’n aman ahing dawnga, “Tamte pen, Juda, Israel leh Jerusalem thezah kiite ahi uh,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n siakhengmi li ahing ensahta hi.","title":"Mengmuna thumna; Siakhengmi lite"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh ken “Tamte bang bawl dinga hing pei ahi uoi?” Chiin ka dong hi. Tuachi’n ahing dawnga: “Tamte pen koima’n alu aphawhdoh zou nawnlou na dinga, Juda thezah kiite ahi uhi, hinanleh tam siakheng mite pen, Juda gam dou a Juda mite thezah dinga akiite uh sangsah namte, kiite paikhe ding leh notdoh dinga hing kuonte ahi uh,” achi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n dahdoh a ka et leh, akhut a tena khau tawi mi khat ka mu hi.","title":"Mengmuna lina tena khau tawipa muna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken “Hei a hawding na hiei?” chiin ka dong a, ama’n ka kungah, “Jerusalem bangchia a lien a, bangtan a sau ahiei, chi thei dinga hing pei ka hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh kei hing houpi vansawlsieng apeidoh a, vansawlsieng dang khat ama kimupi dingin ahing pei hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama kungah, “Tai inlen, tua tangvalpa kungah Asunga mihing leh ganta atam seng ziehin Jerusalem khu kulbaang neilou khopite banga luo in a um ding hi, chiin va gen in, achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen keima akimkot ah, meikuong kulbaang ka hi dinga, tualeh alah uah thupina ka hi ding hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Thou un, thou un, mallam gam akipat taimang un, Mangpa’n achi hi, aziehpen vanhui lite bangin noute ka hing kizalsah ta hi, Mangpa’n achi hi.","title":"Saltangte kile kiana"},"7":{"text":"Oh! Zion kigelmangin, Nou Babilon tanu toh tengkhawmte."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Thupina zouin Aman nang hing tomgam namte kungah kei ahing sawl a, aziehpen nou hing khoikha pouma a mit laidum khoikha ahi."},"9":{"text":"“En un, Keima’n atung uah ka khut ka thinkhum dinga, amaute asuohte ua dingin galvanlah ahi ding uhi. Tuachi’n galkapte Mangpa’n kei ahingsawl ahi, chi na thei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aw Zion tanu lasa inlen kipah in. Aziehpen ngai in, Kei kang pei dinga, na lah ua hing teng ding ka hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuani chiengin nam tampite’n Mangpa azomta ding ua, tualeh amauh ka mite ahi ding; Tualeh kei na lah uah ka teng ding hi. Tuachi’n nouten galkapte Mangpa’n kei noute kunga ahing sawl ahi chi na thei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n gam siengthou a atanvou, dingin Juda aluo dinga, tualeh Jerusalem atel kia ding hi.”"},"13":{"text":"Mi zousiete aw Mangpa masangah sipdide in um un, Ama atenna mun siengthou akipat in ahing thoudohta hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n vansawlsieng mai a siempulien Joshua ding, tualeh ama heh dinga aziet lam a Setan ding ahing ensah hi.","title":"Mengmuna ngana siempulien Joshua suhsiengthouna","ref":"Ezr. 5.2; Kihil. 12.10"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa’n Setan kungah, “Aw setan Mangpa’n nang ahing phawh heh! Jerusalem telpa Mangpa ngelin nang hing phawh heh! Tam mipa mei apat ki lahdoh meisel kuong hilou ahiei mah?” achi hi.","ref":"Jud. 1.9"},"3":{"text":"Joshua khu puon nieh deldul silin vansawlsieng mai ah ading hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Aman adawng a, amai a dingte kungah, “Apuonsil nieh deldulte lakhie un,” achi hi. Tualeh Aman Joshua kungah, “En in, nang akipat na khelnate ka hing lahmang piehta hi, tualeh puon manphate ka hing silsahta ding hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh ken, amaute kungah, “Alu ah diel siengthou khuh sah un” kachi nalai hi. Tuachi’n diel siengthou alu ah akhusah ua, tualeh puonte asilsah uhi. Tualeh Mangpa vansawlsieng akungah ading hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa vansawlsiengin Joshua thu ahil a, akungah;"},"7":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ka lampite zui a na pei a, ka thupiehte na zui leh, ka innsung vai nahawm dinga, tuamabangin, ka vaihawmna munte na enkol ding a, Tualeh tamna dingte lah a napei theina ding, mun kang pe ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuin Siempulien Joshua aw, Nang leh na mai atou na seppite’n ngai un: Amaute khu sil hing tung dingte, chiemtena lamdangte ahi uhi; Aziehpen Ngai un, ka suoh Bameng khu ka hing puidoh ding hi.","title":"Mengmuna guhna, Jehovah suoh bameng","ref":"Jer. 23.5; 33.15; Zek. 6.12"},"9":{"text":"En un, tua suong Joshua masangah ka na koita hi, tua suong tungah mit sagi a um ding a, tua suong tungah akhuohthaw in lai ka giel ding hi; galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi; tualeh tua gam thulimlouna ni khat thu in ka lamang ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin michin in agrepgui nuoi leh, atheipi kung nuoi a tou dingin, na innvengte uh na chielta ding uhi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi.”","ref":"Mik. 4.4"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin kei hing houpi vansawlsieng ka kungah ahing kilekia a, imu lai phawnhal bangin ahing phawnghal hi.","title":"Mengmuna guhna: Sana thaumei tunna leh olive kung nite"},"2":{"text":"Ama’n ka kungah “Bang na mu ei?” ahing chi hi. Tuachi’n ken “Ka en a, sana siengset a kibawl thaumei tunna leh adawna noubem leh atunna tung a thaumei sagite leh atunga meivahgui lawng sagi toh kithuo;"},"3":{"text":"Tua ban ah, a kunga Olive singkung nite, tua noubem zietlam ah khat, tualeh aveilam ah khat um ka mu hi,” ka chita hi.","ref":"Kihil. 11.4"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken ka dawnga, “Kei hing houpi vansawlsieng kungah, ka mangpa tamte bang ahiei?” ka chi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n kei hing houpi vansawlsiengin ahing dawnga, ka kungah, “Tamte bang ahiei chi theilou nave maw?” ahing chi hi. Tualeh ken, “Theilou ka mangpa,” ka chi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n ahing dawnga, ka kungah: “Tami Zerubbabel kunga Mangpa thu ahi: Thahatna in hilou in, silbawltheina zong hilou in, hinanleh ka hagau zal in, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Aw muol sang lienpi, nang koina hiei? Zerubbabel mai ah phaijang na hing suoh ding! A kungah Hepina, hepina chia kikou kawm in aman suong poimaw pen, ahing ladoh ding hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Tuabanah Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga."},"9":{"text":"“Zerubbabel khutte’n, Tami biehinn suongphum aphumta a, ama khutte mama in alam zou ding hi. Tuachi’n galkapte Mangpa’n na kung uah, kei ahing sawl hi, chi na thei ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen koi ahiei sil neunoute ni simmaw? Kipah tah in a um ding ua, Zerubbabel khut a khaitang amu ding uhi. “Tam sagite khu Mangpa mit ahi ua, leitung pumpi en chien a asuh atou a vah kawite ahi uhi.”","ref":"Ezr. 5.2\n        ;     \n        Kihil. 5.6"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken ka dawng a akung ah, “Thaumei tunna zietlam leh veilam panga um tam Olive singkung nite bang ahiei?” Ka chi hi.","title":"Olive singkungte hilchienna","ref":"Kihil. 11.4"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh ka dongkia nalai a, akungah, “Sana meivahgui lawng nite kunga um, tam Olive ba nite apat a sana thaumei tui ahing luon khieh zelna khu bang ahiei?” ka chi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n kei ang dawng a, “Tamte bang ahiei chi theilou nave maw?” ahing chi hi. Tualeh ken “Theilou ka mangpa,” ka chi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n “Tamte pen leitung pumpi Mangpa kung a ding, sathau kinu nite ahi uhi,” achi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh kihei a ka dahdoh leh laibu ziel leenglai ka muta hi.","title":"Mengmuna gietna: Laibu ziel leengthei"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n ka kungah, “Bang namu ei?” achi hi Tuachi’n ken “Laibu ziel leenglai ka mu hi, adung tong sawmni asau, avai tong sawm a lien” ka chi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, “Tami leitung pumpi tunga hamsie peisuoh khu ahi, tam laibu ziel pang lang khat a kigiel dungzuiin guta pouma akinotmang ding a, tualeh apang lelam a kigiel dungzui in dihlou tah a kichiem pouma akinotmang ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua hamsie khu ka sawldoh ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi; guta innsung ah alut ding a, tualeh ka min a dihloutah a kichiemte inn sungah alut ding a, a umden dinga, asing asuong pum in akatum ding,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kei hing houpi vansawlsieng ahing pawtdoh a, ka kungah, “Khodah inlen, bang ahiei apawtdoh, en vawi,” achi hi.","title":"Mengmuna kuona: Seu sunga numei"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken “Bang ahiei?” chi’n ka dong hi. Tualeh ama’n “Tami tena seu peidoh ahi” achi hi. Tualeh ama’n “Gam sung pumpi a akhelna uh zong ahi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ngai in, tua seu husin ngeen a kibawl akihonga, tua seu sungah numei khat atou hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh vansawlsiengin, “Tami gitlouna ahi,” achi a! Seu sungah asawntum kia a, agong tungah ngeen husin in asinkhumta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n dahtou a ka et leh numei ni ahing pawt a tualeh a hate sungah hui a um a, amaun tuivapi ha bangbang ha anei ua, lei leh van kikaal ah tua tena seu adomtou uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n keiman ahing houpi vansawlsieng kungah, “Tam miten seu khu heilanga puoh sawm uh ahiei?” chiin ka dong hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n ka kungah, “Shinar gam a inn lam ding a apuoh uh ahi, tualeh akilam zou chiengin akikoina ding mun tahah akikoi ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka kihei a, ka khodah a, ka et leh ngai vawi, muol ni kikaal apat in sakolleng li hing pei ka mu a, tualeh tua muolte khu sum-eng muolte ahi uhi.","title":"Mengmuna sawmna: Kangtalai lite"},"2":{"text":"Sakolleng masa pen ah sakol san ngen, aum ua, Sakolleng nina pen ah sakol vom ngen aum ua.","ref":"Kihil. 6.4; Kihil. 6.5"},"3":{"text":"Sakolleng thumna pen ah sakol kaang ngen, aum ua, Sakolleng lina pen ah sakol puong hattah ngen chi a um uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 6.2"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken ka dawnga, Kei hing houpi vansawlsieng kungah, “Tamte bang ahi uoi ka mangpa aw?” ka chi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng in ahing dong a, ka kung ah, “Tamte vantunga hagau lite, leitung pumpi Mangpa mai a, a umna mun uapat a hing pawtdohte ahi uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 7.1"},"6":{"text":"Sakol vomte kaipen mallam gam a pei ding ahi a, sakol kangte kai pen tum lam gam ah, tualeh sakol puongte kaipen simlam gam a pei ding ahi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n sakol hatte apeidohta ua, leitung pumpi tuonsuoh a apei theina ding uh angahla mama uhi. Tualeh ama’n “Leitung pumpi tuonsuoh dingin pei un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n leitung pumpi atuonsuohta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n Kei ang han a, ahing houpi a, ka kungah, “En vawi, mallam gam zuon a peiten mallam gam ah ka hagau akhawldam sahta uhi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung a:","title":"Joshua manglukhu khuhsahna"},"10":{"text":"“Babilon akipat a hing pei saltaangte, Heldai, Tobijah leh Jedaiah a kipat silpieh sana leh dangkate la inlen, tua ni main Zephaniah tapa Josiah inn ah lut in."},"11":{"text":"Tua sana leh dangka, la inlen manglukhu khat bawl inlen Jehozadak tapa siempulien Joshua khusah in."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n akungah, galkapte Mangpa’n tambang in agen hi: “Ngai vawi, mi amin ABAMENG kichi! Ama mun apat ahing mengdoh ding a, Aman Mangpa biehinn alam ding hi.","ref":"Jer. 23.5; 33.15; Zek. 3.8"},"13":{"text":"Ahi, Aman Mangpa biehinn alam ding a, Aman thupina amu dinga, leengtoupha tunga tou in vai ahawm dinga, tuachi’n aleengtoupha tungah siempu ahi ding a, tualeh kilemna lemguotna, amauh tegel ah a um ding hi.”"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh leenglukhute khu Helem kungah, Tobijah kungah, Jedaiah kungah, tualeh Zephaniah tapa Hen kungah, Mangpa biehinn athei zing nading un a um ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Gamlapi a umte nangawn ahing pei ding ua, Mangpa biehinn ahing lam ding uhi. Tuachi’n galkapte Mangpa’n noute kungah kei ahing sawl hi, chi na thei ding uhi. Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian uh aw, pilvang tah a na zui chinten u’leh tami ahing tangtung ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darius leengpa vaihawm akum lina aha kuona Kislev ha, ani li niin Mangpa thu Zekariah kungah ahing tung hi.","title":"Ann ngawlna thu dohna"},"2":{"text":"Bethel kho miten Sherezer leh Rege-Melek leh amite utoh, Mangpa mai a deisahna ngen dingin, Pasian inn ah asawlta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa inn a siempute leh guolneite kunga thu va dong ding in: “Kum tampi ka na bawlsa mabangin keima kituom koiin, aha ngana ah kap in ann ka ngawl diei mah?” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkapte Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga;","title":"Lepchiena thuhil"},"5":{"text":"“Gam sunga mi zousie kung leh siempute kungah vagen in: Apeisa kum sawm sagi sung aha ngana leh aha sagina teng a kap kawm a ann na ngawl chieng un, Kei a ding in, Kei a ding mama in na ngawl tahtah ngelna uoi mah?"},"6":{"text":"Na neh ua na dawn chieng un zong nouma adinga kineh a kidawn hilou nahi uoi mah?"},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem leh akim apam a khopite a aten dim lai u’leh, nei lelam akiningchin lai uleh, simlam phaijang gam ngiemte a mi atendim lai ua, guolnei masate tungtawn a Mangpa thuphuon thute na zuisih di uoi mah?” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu Zekariah kungah ahing tunga;","title":"Thumanlouna kisiading"},"9":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: vaihawmna dihtah bawl unlen, Michin in asanggam tungah, Itna hepina leh lainatna ensah u’hen."},"10":{"text":"Meithaite, leh pa neiloute, gamdang mi leh mi zawngte bawl genthei sih un. Na lah uah koiman asanggam sietna ding, alungtang ah geel sih heh,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh amauten athudon sih ua, aliengkoute uh asangsah ua, azah louna ding un abil uh ahum uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi, amauten alungtangte uh meisa suong bangin atahsah ua, dan leh athute, galkapte Mangpa’n ahagau a guolnei masate tungtawn a athugente ana ngaikhe nuom sih uhi. Tuaziehin galkapte Mangpa akipat thangpaina ahing tungta hi."},"13":{"text":"“Tuaziehin, a thuphuonte angai nuomlou bangun, amauten ang hat chiengun ken zong ka ngaikhe sih ding hi,” galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"14":{"text":"“Hinanleh atheikhah ngailou uh nam zousiete lah ah pingpei in amaute ka thethangta hi. Tambangin gam khu amaute nua in akilawi a asegawpta khunah koima vapei in ava tuon nawn sih ua, Koima zong akile kia sih uhi, gam hoi leh gam nuomtah segawp a akiloitah ziehin.”"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tung kia a;","title":"Israel tunding kiana"},"2":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Thangsetah in Zion ka kihuhpi a deisahna thupitah toh, ama a dingin ka sitse mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Zion ah ka kinuale kia dinga, Jerusalem laikimtah ah ka teng dinga, Jerusalem khu thutah khopi akichi ding a, galkapte Mangpa muol khu Muol siengthou, akichi ding hi, a chi hi."},"4":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Jerusalem gawlzingte ah aputehte u’leh, pitehte uh atou kia ding ua, atehsiet sengtah ziehun, akhut uah chiengkhut atawi chiet ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua khopi gawlzingte ah, Pasal naupang leh numei naupangte, akholai chiet uah kimawl in adim ding uhi, achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Tam nite ah tam mite lah a umsunte, mitmu ah lamdang ahileh, Kei mitmu ah zong alamdang tuom sih ding amah? Gal kapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Ngai un, suolam gam akipat leh tumlam gam akipat, ka mite ka hundam ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute ka hing nuapui kia dinga, Jerusalem ah ateng ding uhi. Thutah leh dihtatna in, amauh ka mite ahi ding ua, Kei a Pasian uh ka hi ding hi.”"},"9":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Bieh inn lamzou ahi theina dinga, galkapte Mangpa inn suongphum, kiphum ni a, guolneite kam a kipat thute, ana ngaikhie noute’n na khut uh hatsah un."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen tam nite masangin, mihingte adingin kilawna ana um sih a, gantate ading in zong kilawna a um sih hi. Khum hunlai in koimapou apawtkhete leh, ahing lutte dingin, galte akipat in muonna a um sih hi; aziehpen michin a innvengte toh kidouin ka umsah hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh tu’nvang tam mipi umsunte, nidanglai bangin ka bawl nawn sih ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen lemna haichi apou hoita dinga, grepguiten ga asuongta ding ua, leiin neh leh taah apungsah dinga, vanten daitui ape ding a, Ke’n tam mipi umsunte, tam silte zousie ka neisah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tambang ahing hi ding: Namte lah a hamse thuoh nana hitah mabang un, Aw Juda innkuonte leh Israel innkuonte, Keima’n kang hundam ding a, noute guolzawlna nahi ding uhi. Zau sih unlen, na khutte uh hatsah un.”"},"14":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: “Napu napate un, ahing suhlungthah lai ua, hing gawt ding ka hi chia ka na tup khu, ka heng sih ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuin vang Jerusalem leh, Juda innkuonte a ding in silhoi ka bawlpieh tup kiata hi, Zau sihun."},"16":{"text":"Tam silte ahi na bawl ding uh: Michin in na innvengte kung uah, thutah gen un, na kulkotpite uah thutah thudihna leh, lemna toh thukhen un.","ref":"Eph. 4.25"},"17":{"text":"Noute koima’n na innvengte uh, sietna ding na lungtang un ngaituo sih heh; Tualeh zuou a kichiem kilawp sih un, Aziehpen tam silte zousie ka huot ahi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkapte Mangpa thu ka kungah ahing tunga,","title":"Mailam hun a Israel kipahna ding"},"19":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa’n tambang in agen hi: Aha lina a ann ngawl, Aha ngana a ann ngawl, Aha sagina a ann ngawl, Tualeh aha sawmna a ann ngawl khu, Juda innkuonte a dinga kipah thanopna leh, lungsim kilawptah a pawi bawlna ahi ding hi. Tuaziehin thutah leh lemna it un."},"20":{"text":"“Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: khopi tampi a teng, mipite ahing pei na lai ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Khopi khat a tengte khopi dang ah apei ding ua, Mangpa mai a thungen ding in pei nalai vai, tualeh galkapte Mangpa suivai, kei zong hing pei vang, a chi ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi, mi tampite leh nam hattahte, Jerusalem ah galkapte Mangpa sui ding leh, Mangpa mai a thungen dingin ahing pei ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi: Tua ni chiengin ham chin leh, namchin akipat in mi sawm in, Juda mi khat puon mong atu ding ua, Pasian in noute ahing umpi hi, chi ka za ua, zawhkhawm vai aw achi ding uhi,” achi hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hadrak gam a Mangpa thu, puohgih Damaska akingahna mun ding ahi, aziehpen mite leh Israel namte zousie mit Mangpa tungah atu hi.","title":"Israel kimvel a um namte gawtna","ref":"Isai. 17.1-3; Jer. 49.23-27; Amos. 1.3-5  ;     \n        Isai. 23.1-18; Ezek. 26.1—28.26; Joel. 3.4-8; Amos. 1.9,10; Mat. 11.21,22; Luk. 10.13,14"},"2":{"text":"Akigamgitpi Hamath khopi tungah leh Tai-ar leh Sidon tung ah zong atung ding pil mama nan ule zong."},"3":{"text":"Tai-ar in kulpi muonhuoi akibawlta a, dangka leivui bangin asie vum a, Sana siengset kholai buonnawi bangin asie vum hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngai vawi, Mangpa’n ama apaidoh dinga, Ama’n a silbawltheinate tuipi ah asumang ding a, Tualeh mei a haltum in a um ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ashkelon in amu dinga azau ding, Gaza in zong amu dinga, alunggim mama ding; Ekron zong akinepna, agawtah ziehin, azum ding hi. Lengpa khu Gaza apat amangthai dinga, Ashkelon khu tenna lou in a um ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 14.29-31; Jer. 47.1-7; Ezek. 25.15-17; Joel. 3.4-8; Amos. 1.6-8; Zeph. 2.4-7"},"6":{"text":"Ashdod ah nam kipolzahte ateng dinga, Philistinte kiletsahna ka sumang ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Akam sung ua kipat sisan ka lamang ding a, ahate uh kikaal a kipat in akidahhuoinate ka lakhe ding hi. Hinanleh a um nalaite ama ngel khu i Pasian ua ding ahi ding hi, tualeh ama khu Juda gam ah lamkai khat bang ahi ding a, tualeh Ekron khu Jebusmi bangin aum ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka inn kim ah, veng mi bangin panmun kakho ding a, sugenthei mi koiman ama uh palsan in, apeisuoh in akinuale nawn sih ding hi, aziehpen tuin keima mit ngelin ka muta hi."},"9":{"text":"Aw Zion tanu nasatah in nuom in, Jerusalem tanu aw ngaitah in kikou in, En in, na leengpa na kungah ahing pei hi, Ama khu adih a, hundamna zong anei hi; Kingaingiem tah in, sabiltung nou tunga tuongin, sabiltung nou tung ngei a tuongin ahing pei hi.","title":"Messiah hing pei masahna","ref":"Mat. 21.5; Jn. 12.15"},"10":{"text":"Ephraim apat sakollengte leh, Jerusalem apat sakolte ka sattan dinga, kidouna thalpite sattan in a um ding hi. Aman namte kungah lemna thu agen dinga, agam tuipi akipat tuipi dong ahi ding a; Tualeh luipi akipat leitung tawp dong ahi ding hi.","title":"Messiah hing pei niveina","ref":"Late. 72.8"},"11":{"text":"Nang a dingin zong, Na thuhun sisan ziehin, tui umlouna kokhuh a kipat in, na suongkultaangte ka pawtkhe sahta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 24.8"},"12":{"text":"Nou kinepna suongkultaangte aw, Kulpi lam ah kinuale kia un, tuni mama in aleni in ka hing pe ding hi, chiin ka phuong hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka thalpi bangin Juda ka luoi kun a, Ephraim thaltang in ka zanga, Aw Zion na tapate ka tohthou dinga, Na tapate’n ahing dou uhi. Aw Greece, Mihat namsau bangin ka hing bawl ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute tungah Mangpa, ahing kilang dinga, athaltangte kawlphe bangin aleengkhe dinga, tualeh Mangpa Pasian in pengkul amut dinga, simlam apat pumpai toh zawhin, apeikhawm ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Galkapte Mangpa’n amauh aveng ding a, Amauten apumval ding ua, suongtanga sepin aguolzou ding uhi. A dawn ding ua, zukham bangin ahumham ding uhi. Belkuongte bangin sisan in adim ding ua, maitam ningte bangin adim ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Mangpa a Pasian un, amite belam honte bangin ahundam ding hi. Amaute Manglukhu a suongmantamte bang ahi ding ua, agam tung ah puonlap bangin, dopsang in a um ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ahoina uh bangzatah a thupi a, akilawmna uh bangzata a loupi atai! Bu leh bal in tangvalte akhanghoi sah dinga, Tualeh uoin tha in nungahte akhanghoi sah ding hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Guo nukhia zuh hun chiengin, Mangpa kungah guo ngen un. Guotui puo meilumte bawlpa Mangpa ahi a, Aman guo ahing zusah dinga, gamlah a hampa chinteng a dingin.","title":"Tunua chienga Juda leh Ephraim suhhatna"},"2":{"text":"Milim pasienten bangmalou thu agen ua, ai san siemte’n mengmuna zuou amu ua, mang dihlou gen in, athawn in mi ahamuon uhi. Tuaziehin mite belam bangin amauh lampi chiet ah avahthangta ua, aching ding belampu aumlou ziehin abuoi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 9.36; Mak. 6.34"},"3":{"text":"“Belampute tungah ka lungthahna akuong a, alamkaite uh ka gawt ding hi. Aziehpen galkapte Mangpa’n abelamhon Juda innkuonte akem dinga amaute kidouna sakol hoitah bangin abawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama apat aninga suong, ama akipat puonbuh khetphim, ama akipat kidouna thalpi, ama akipat vaihawm mi zousie ahing pawtdoh ding ua, akikhawm ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute kidouna phuol gawlzing buonnawi lah a amelmate uh tuonchil mi hatte bangin a um ding ua, tualeh akung ua Mangpa a um ziehin adou ding ua, tualeh sakol tungtuongte azum sah ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"“Ken Juda innkuonte ka hatsah dinga, Joseph innkuonte ka hundam ding hi. Amaute ka lainat ziehin ka puikia ding hi. Amaute pen ka pampai ngailoute ma abang ding uhi. Aziehpen Kei Mangpa a Pasian uh ka hi a, Tualeh amauh ka ngaikhe ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ephraim mite khu mihat tungtuong bang ahi ding ua, Tualeh zu dawn bangin alungnuom ding uhi. Ahi, atate un tua khu amu ding ua, Mangpa ah alungtang uh akipah ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Ken amaute ka khutzap ding a, ka huoikhawm ding hi. Amaute ka tandoh dinga, nidang lai a apun bangun apung kia ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Namte lah ah amaute ka the ding a, gam gamlapi apat kei ang thei zing ding uhi; khunah atate utoh atengkhawm ding ua, ahing kinuale kia ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Izipt gam a kipat in amaute ka hing puidoh kia dinga, Assiria apat amauh ka khawm ding hi. Amaute Gilead gam leh Lebanon gam ah ka puilut ding a; ama ua ding a mun umlou khop in apung ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amaun gimthuohna tuipi apalsuoh ding ua, Tuipi a tuikihotte asat ding ua, tualeh luitui thuhtahte akangsan ding hi. Tuachi’n Assiria kiletsahna suhngiem in a um ding a, tualeh Izipt leeng chieng apeimang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa ah amauh ka hatsah dinga, tualeh Ama min in avahsuh avahtou ding uhi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Lebanon na kotte hongin, na sidar singte meiin akahtum theina dingin.","title":"Messiah hing peina masa leh adeilouna uh"},"2":{"text":"Tapi sing aw, kap in mauin aziehpen sidar singte apuata hi, ahoi leh thupite susiet ahitah ziehun; Aw nou Bashan gangpi singte kap in mau un, gammang sing zousie akiphua siengta hi."},"3":{"text":"Belampute kaa leh mauna ngaiun, aziehpen athupina uh asegawpta hi. Humpibahnei hawhging ngaiun, Jordan kisahtheina suhsiet ahitah ziehin."},"4":{"text":"“Mangpa Ka Pasian in tambang in agen hi, tha dingin belamhonte vaa in."},"5":{"text":"Aneiten amauh athat ua, khiel louin akingai uhi, tualeh amauh zuaten Mangpa phat in um hen, Kei ka hauta achi uhi, tualeh amauh chingten ahepi sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen gam sunga tengte ka hepi nawnsih ding, Mangpa’n achi hi. Hinanleh ngai in, michin ainnveng khut ah leh a leengpa khut ah ka pe ding hi. Amaun gam sung adou ding ua, tualeh ken amauh, akhut uapat ka hunkhe sih ding hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n thading belamhonte khu, ka vaa ding a diehin belamhon lah a azawngkhalte khu. Tualeh kei a dingin chieng ni ka lata a, khat khu Deisahna ka chi a, akhat pen kigawmna kachi hi. Tuachi’n belamhonte ka vah hi."},"8":{"text":"Ha khat sungin belampu thum ka paikhie hi. Ka hinna in amauh adeisih a, tualeh amauh hinna in kei ahing chimtah uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ken, “Noute ka hing vaa nawn sih ding hi. Ashi shi shisuh u’henlen amang mang mangsuh heh. Ahingsunte khat leh khat kinetuo mai u’heh,” ka chi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh ka chieng deisahna ka chi pen ka la a, tunni kasuo hi, tuachia namte toh ka bawlsa ka thuhun ka suhsiet theina dingin."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuami ni mama in ka thuhun phel ahita, tualeh tambangin belamhonte lah a azawngkhal kei hing na ngahten, Mangpa thu ahi chi athei ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken amaute kungah, “Hoi nasah u’leh ka thaman hing pie unlen, hoi nasah sih ulelah hing pieh daun,” ka chi hi. Tuachi’n ka thaman ding dangka sawmthum atedohta uhi.","ref":"Mat. 27.9,10; Mat. 26.15"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Ka man dinga kilawmhun asahza uh belkhengpa kungah paikhie in achi hi. Tuachi’n dangka sawmthum khu ka la a, belkhengpa a dingin Mangpa inn sung ah ka pailutta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka chieng dangkhat kigawmna ka chipen tunni suoin ka hiehtawnga, Juda leh Israel kikaal a ki unauna ka suhsiet theina dingin."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah, “Belampu mo vanzahte nangma dingin kilah in, achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen ngai un, gam sungah belampu khat ka tungdoh dinga, ama’n amangte a sui dinga, anoute asui sih dinga, aliem abaite asudam sih ding a, adam nalaite zong ava sih ding hi. Hinanleh ama’n athaute sa ane dinga achinte nangawn uh atolkhiet pieh ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Belamhonte nuasie belampu pannabei tung agih hi! Namsau khu aban leh a mit zietlam tungah atu dinga, aban azoi dildel dinga, amit zietlam pumtawt in,” ataw ding hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel tungtanga Mangpa thu puohgih khu. Mangpa vante zahpal leh leitung kingahna suongphum phumpa leh mihing sunga um hagau siempa Mangpa’n tambang in agen hi.","title":"Jerusalem hutkhiehna"},"2":{"text":"“Ngai vawi, Jerusalem zukhamna nou in ka bawl dinga, akim apam a miten Juda leh Jerusalem dou a a imtawm chiengun."},"3":{"text":"Tuani chiengin tambang ahi dinga, Jerusalem khu mi zousie adingin suong gih mama in ka bawl dinga, leitunga mizousie adou dingin kikhawm nan u’leh, amazieh a tunggih kisate zousie satnen in a um ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin, sakol chinteng amhaina toh, tualeh atunga tuongte motna toh ka sat ding hi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Tualeh Juda innkuonte tungah ka mit ka hahsah dinga, tualeh mite sakol chinteng mittawtna in ka sat ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Juda uhpipaten alungtangun, Jerusalem a tengte khu galkapte Mangpa a Pasian uh ka hatna ahi, achi ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"“Tua ni chiengin Juda uhpipate khu singkhuo lah a mei-am bangin ka bawl ding a, buphai lah a meisel kuong bangin ka bawl ding hi.
