Tualeh akim apama mite, ziet leh vei ah akatum ding uhi; hinanleh Jerusalem pen ama mun ah Jerusalem mun ngei ah mite’n aluokia ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Mangpa’n Juda puon innte a hundam masa dinga, tuachi’n David innkuonte thupina leh Jerusalem a tengte thupina khu Juda thupina sangin athupi zaw sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Mangpa’n Jerusalema tengte ahumbit dinga, tua ni chieng in alah ua hatlou pente nangawn David bang ahi ding ua, tualeh David innkuonte pen Pasian abang ding ua, amasang ua Mangpa vansawlsieng bang ahi ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Jerusalem dou namte zousie suhmangna ding ka sui ding hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tualeh David innkuonte tung ah leh Jerusalem a tengte tungah hepina leh thugetna hagau ka sungbaw dinga; tuachi’n teipi a asutpa uh kei ahing en ding ua, tualeh mi’n atapa neisun a suun bangin Ama asuun ding ua, tualeh mi’n atachiil tunga athuohnat bangin athuohna ding uhi.","title":"Hagau lam a Juda hundamna","ref":"Jn. 19.37; Kihil. 1.7  ;     \n        Mat. 24.20; Kihil. 1.7"},"11":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Jerusalem ah suunna thupitah a um dinga, Megiddo phaijang a Hadad Rimmon a suunna abang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh gam in asuun ding a, innkuon chinin atuomin, David hahlesuonte innkuon toh atuom in, azite un, amau’tuom in, Nathan hahlesuonte innkuon ten amau’tuom in, tualeh azite un atuom in;"},"13":{"text":"Levi hahlesuonte innkuonten amau’tuom in, tualeh azite un atuomin, Shimei hahlesuonte innkuonten amauh tuom in, tualeh azite un atuom in."},"14":{"text":"Innkuon dang um zousie in, innkuon chinteng in atuom in, tualeh azite un atuom chietin."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tua ni chiengin David innkuonte leh Jerusalem a tengte dingin tuinah khat akihong ding hi.","title":"Jerusalem leh akim apam a namte"},"2":{"text":"“Tua ni chiengin, gam sunga milimte minte ka subei dinga, theizing ahi nawn sih ding uhi. Ken guolneite leh hagau siengloute gam sunga pat in ka pawtsah sieng ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahi ding, mi koi ahiei in thumavang agen nahlai leh apienna nu leh pa’n, akungah Mangpa min a zuou thu nagen ziehin na hing sih ding hi, achi ding uhi. Tualeh apienna nu leh pa in thumavang agen laitah in adawtpailet ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin guolneite zousie’n amengmuna thu uh agen chiengun azum ding uhi. Mi solna dingin goulnei puontuol multe asil nawn sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh ama’n Kei guolnei ka hisih, loubawl mi ka hibou hi. Ka neulai akipat ganhon kem ding a mi’n ahing hil ka hibou hi, achi zaw ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh mi koi ahiei in akungah na khut kaala liemnate khu bang ahiei? achi ding hi. Tuachi’n ama’n adawng ding a, Tamte khu ka lawmte inn a ka liem khahna ahi, achi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Kisa in, Aw ka namsau, ka belampu leh ka kigoppi kalawmpa dou dingin,” galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi. Belampu sat in, belamte akithethang ding uhi; Tuachi’n ken anoute tungah ka khut kaha ding hi.","title":"Belam chingpa kisatna","ref":"Mat. 26.31; Mak. 14.27"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh gam sung pumpia umte, sethumsuo seni sattan ahi ding a, ashi ding uh, Hinanleh sethum suo se khat nuasie ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Keima’n sethum suo sekhat te, mei ah ka pailut dinga, dangka sia suhsieng bangin ka susieng dinga, tualeh sana etchien bangin ka enchien ding hi. Ka min in ang han ding ua, amauh ka dawng ding hi. Ken ka mite ahi uh kachi dinga; Amauten Mangpa ka Pasian uh ahi achi chiet ding uhi.”"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En un, Mangpa ni hing tung ding ahita, tualeh na galsum lahte khu nouma lah a hawm ahi ding.","title":"Jerusalem simna nukhia pen"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen Jerusalem dou dingin, nam zousie ka khawm dinga, tualeh khopi lahin a um dinga, innte suhsiet ahi dinga, numeite bawlsiet ahi ding uhi, khopi kimkhat sal a puimang in a um dinga, a umsunte pen khopi apat in suhmang ahisih ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa akuondoh dinga, kidouna nia adou mabangin tua namte a dou ding hi.","title":"Messiah hing pei niveina"},"4":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin suolam a, Jerusalem mai ngat a um Olive muol tunga, akeng nga in ading ding a, tualeh Olive muol khu suolam leh, tumlam ah phal ni kisuo in akeh dinga, akaal ah phaijang lienpi a um ding hi, tua muol kimkhat mallam ah akikhin ding a, akimkhat simlam ah akikhin ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n noute ka muol kikaal phaijang ah, na taimang ding ua, aziehpen muol kikaal phaijang in Azal dong asuding hi. Ahi, Juda leengpa Uzziah dam lai a, zilling a ana tai mabang un, na taimang ding uhi. Tambangin Mangpa ka Pasian ahing pei dinga, amisiengthoute zousie toh ahing zawhkhawm ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin khuo avah sih dinga, amiel seng sam sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tam pen Mangpa adinga thei a um ni khat ahi dinga, sun hilou zan lah hilou, hinanleh nitah lam chiengin khuo avah ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin Jerusalem apat in, tui hing aluongkhe dinga, akimkhat suolam tuipi ah, akimkhat tumlam tuipi ah nipi lai leh phalbi laiin zong, aluong ding hi.","ref":"Ezek. 47.1; Jn. 7.38; Kihil. 22.1"},"9":{"text":"Mangpa khu leitung pumpi ah leeng ahi dinga tua ni chiengin Mangpa khat ahi dinga, Amin zong khat ahi ding hi.","title":"Messiah leenggam"},"10":{"text":"Gam sung pumpi Geba akipat Jerusalem simlam Rimmon dongin phaijang asuohta ding hi. Jerusalem tawisangin a um ding a, Benjamin kotpi akipat in kotpi masapen tan dongin leh aning a kotpi dongin, tualeh Hananeel innsanga pat leengpa grep tui suhna tandong, amun mama ah mite ateng dim ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mite asungah ateng ding ua, sietna nasatah a um nawn sih dinga, Jerusalem ah bittah in akitengta ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 22.3"},"12":{"text":"Jerusalem dou mipite zousie tunga, Mangpa’n natna hii alensah ding khu tambang ahi: Akeng ua adin lai un atahsa uh amuotkhe dinga, amitte uh amitkhuh sung uah, amuot dinga, alei uh akam sung uah amuot ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin, hichi ahi dinga, Mangpa akipat buoina thupitah alah uah a um dinga, michin in a innveng khut atu ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Juda in zong Jerusalem ah gal adou dinga, akim apama namte zousie hausatna sana, dangka nihten puonsil tampi akhawm khawm ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tambang natna hipi a gawtna pen, sakolte, sakol neute, sangawngsaute sabiltungte leh giehphuol a ganta zousiete tungah atung ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem dou a hing kuon namte zousie lah a, ahing sunte Lengpa galkapte Mangpa be dingin, tualeh Biehbuh pawite mang dingin kum simin Jerusalem ah akuontou ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 23.39-43"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh koipou Lengpa galkapte Mangpa be dinga Jerusalem a peitou lou leitung a innkuonte zousie tungah guo azu sih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Izipt innkuonte ahing peitou lou ua, ava hawsih ding uleh, guotui amu sih ding uhi; Mangpa biehbuh pawi mang ding a peilou namte tung ah Mangpa gawtna natna hipi amaute tung ah atung zaw ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tami Izipt mite leh Biehbuh pawi mang dinga kuontou lou namte zousie gawtna ahi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin “MANGPA ADINGA SIENGTHOU” chiin sakol lawngte tungah khuoh thawin akigiel ding hi. Mangpa inn a belte khu maitam mai a noubemte bang ahita ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi, Jerusalem leh Juda gam a bel chinteng galkapte Mangpa a dinga siengthou ahing hita dinga, kithoina lan ding a hing pei pouma in tua belte ala ding ua, tuatein ann ahuon ding uhi. Tua ni chiengin galkapte Mangpa inn ah Kanaan mi mawngmawng aum nawn sih ding hi."}}}}},"39":{"info":{"name":"Malaki","shortname":"Mala.","abbr":[],"desc":"Malaki laibu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israelte kunga Mangpa puohgih Malaki akipat thu hing tung khu.","title":"Pasian in Israelte a itna"},"2":{"text":"“Ken noute ka hing na itta hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi. Ahivang in nouten, “Bangchidan lam a koute nang it ahiei?” nachi uhi. “Esau khu Jakob sanggam hilou ahiei mah?” Mangpa’n achi hi. “Hinapi in Jakob ka itta hi.","ref":"Rom. 9.13; Isai. 34.5-17; 63.1-6; Jer. 49.7-22; Ezek. 25.12-14; 35.1-15; Amos. 1.11,12; Obad. 1.1-14"},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Esau ka mudata a, ataangte leh a goutante khu gamdai a si-alte a dingin ka suhsiet piehta hi,” Mangpa’n achi hi."},"4":{"text":"“Esau hahlesuon Edom mite susiet in ka umna ua,” hinanleh ka nuakia kia ding ua, mun sesate ka lamkia dinguh achi ziehun, galkapte Mangpa’n tambangin agen hi; “Lamtha kia nan uleh, Keima’n ka suse dinga, Amaute gam gilou leh kumtawn a Mangpa lungthah denna nam,” achi ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Na mit un amu dinga, “Noute’n Mangpa khu Israelte gamgi henlam peh ah tawisangin um hen,” na chi ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"“Tapa in apa azatat a, suohin apu azatat hi. Pa ka hileh, kei nang zatatna uh hei a um ahiei? Tualeh kei apu ka hileh, kei nang zatatna uh hei a um ahiei? Galkapte Mangpa’n nou siempu Amin simmawte kungah achi hi. Hinanleh nouten, bangchidan a kouten na min ka simmaw uh ahiei? nachi uhi.","title":"Siempute’n Mangpa min asimmaw uh"},"7":{"text":"Ka maitam tungah tanghou suhbuasa na lan ua tualeh nouten, bangchidan a nang ka hing buasah uh ahiei? nachi uhi. Mangpa dawkan simmawhuoi na chi na uah, ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh nouten kithoina dingin ganta amitto lan u’lachin sil gilou ahi sih ding amah? Tualeh akengbai leh adamlou zawngkhal lan ulachin sil gilou hilou ding ahiei mah? Na uhpipa u’kung ah tambangte pe vawi un alungdam naimah, ahisihleh ahing na pompieh thei diei mah? Galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 15.21"},"9":{"text":"Tu in Aman ahing hepi theina dingin Pasian deisahna ngen un, Tambang silpiehte na khut un abawl lai in, deisahtahin ahing sanpieh na diei? Galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka maitam tunga athawn a mei na tawkuong louna dingun, na lah uah biehinn kot kha ding mi khat beh um leh izaw! Na tung uah kipahna ka neisih a, na khut ua sillatte zong ka hing pompieh sih ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ni suohna lam a kipat, nitumna lam dongin, ka min Jentelte lah ah athupi ding hi. Mun chin ah ka min a dingin gimnamtui leh sillat siengthou akilan ding hi. Aziehpen Jentelte lah ah ka min athupi ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten, Mangpa dawkan abuata hi, atunga ann sillat nangawn zong kidahhuoi na china uah na buasahta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Nouten, chimtahhuoi sam e, na chi ua, na hahthiei khum uhi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi. Tualeh thagum a na lahpiehte uh, akengbaite leh adamlou azawngkhal pou, kithoina dingin na hing tawi uhi, Tambanga sillat ding na hing tawite uh, na khut uapat kana sang pouma ding amah? Mangpa’n achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh ganhonte lah a atal nei ngal a, pieh dinga zong kichiemna neita ngal a, Hinanleh Mangpa kunga kithoina dinga ganta melhem lan a zuoutat mi hamsethuohin um heh, Kei leengpa thupitah ka hi a, Namte lah ah ka min akigiin ding ahi galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tualeh tuin Nou siempute aw, tam thupieh khu noute a ding ahi.","title":"Mangpa’n siempute asamsietna"},"2":{"text":"Na ngaikhieh sih ua, ka min thupina dinga na lungtang ua navom utsih ua ahileh, na tung uah samsietna ka hing sawl dinga, na guolzawlna tante uh awsie ka lawkhum ding ahi, awsie ka lawkhumta hi, na lungtang ua navom utlou ziehun, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ngai un, nahah nasuonte uh ka house dinga, na maitang uah eeh ka hing nu dinga, na pawibawlna thupite uh eeh mama ka hing nu dinga, tuate toh suoh leh sal a puimangin na um ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levi toh ka thuhun a umden theina dinga tam thupieh na kung ua, ka hing sawl ahi chi nathei ding uhi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Kisim. 3.11-13"},"5":{"text":"Amatoh ka thuhun pen, hinna leh lungmuonna thuhun ahi a, Kei ahing giin theina dinga akunga tuate ka pieh ahi. Tuachi’n ahing giingta ngut ngei a, ka min azatat mama ta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 25.12"},"6":{"text":"Thutah dan khu akam ah a uma, amuh ah thudihlou akimu sih hi. Hamuongtahin ka mai ah agamta a, mi tampi gitlouna apat akiheimang sah hi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen siempute muh in theina akep ding ahi a, tualeh miten akam apat dan asui dinguh ahi, aziehpen ama galkapte Mangpa thupopa ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh noute lampi apat na pielmangta ua, na dan thuhilnate un mi tampi akipalpua sahta hi. Nouten Levi thuhun na suseta uhi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ken zong mi zousiete mai ah simmawhuoitah leh zala tahin ka hing bawlta hi, ka lampite na zuilou zieh uleh, deisahtuom nei a dan thute na hil ziehuh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Eite’n i bawnpi un Pa khat inei sih uh amah? Pasian in ahing siem ihisih uh amah? Bangzieha eite khat leh khat lepchietah a kibawl a ipu ipate thuhun buasah ihi uoi?","title":"Mipite khelna"},"11":{"text":"Juda lepchietah in agamta a, Israel gam sung leh Jerusalem khopi sungah, sil kidahhuoi akibawlta hi. Juda in Pasian dangte tanu akitenpita a, a it mama Mangpa munsiengthou abuasahta hi."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa’n tambang silbawlpa, ahilpa leh azuipa hitaleh tualeh galkapte Mangpa kunga sillat lanpa khu, Jakob puon inn apat in sattanta hen."},"13":{"text":"Sil dang na bawl nahlai uh khat tami ahi, Mangpa maitam kaa leh mauna leh nasatah a kikouna hitui in na dimsahta uhi; tuachi’n sillatte bangma in angai nawn sih a, na khut ua pat lungkimtahin asang nuom nawn sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahivang in nouten, “Bangzieh ahiei?” na chi uhi. Aziehpen Mangpa khu nang leh lepchietah a na bawl na senzi toh kikaal a theipitu ahi; hinanleh amanu khu na kigoppina thuhun zi ahi."},"15":{"text":"Pasian in ni khu khat in ahing abawl sih amah? Tahsa leh hagau ah amautegel ama a ahi ua, bangzieh a nite sakhat a abawl ahiei? Aman amaute gel apat Pasian ngaisah chihah asui zieh ahi. Tuaziehin na hagau lam uah pilvang unlen, Koiman asenzi tungah lepchietah in bawl sih heh."},"16":{"text":"“Aziehpen Mangpa Israelte Pasian in kikhul ka huo hi achi hi, tualeh puonsil banga pawngbawlna kikhukhum ka hua hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi. Tuaziehin na hagau lam uah pilvang unlen, na senzi tung uah lepchie sih un.”"},"17":{"text":"Na thugen un Mangpa na lunggim sahta uhi; hinanleh Nouten bangchi dan a Ama ka lunggim sah uh ahiei? na chi nalai uhi. “Michin in silgilou abawlte uh Mangpa mitmu in ahoi ahi, tualeh ama khu tuate tungah akipah hi” nachi na uah, ahisihleh thudih a vaihawm “Pasian hei a um ahiei?” nachi chieng ua Ama lunggim sah nahi uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ngai in, ka thangkoupa ka hing sawl dinga, aman ka masang ah ka lampi asiel masa ding a, na suipa uh Mangpa a biehinn ah thakhat in ahing pei ding hi; na kipahna uh, thuhun thangkoupa, Ngai un, hing pei ding ahi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi.","title":"Baptispa Johan leh Mangpa Jesu hing peina ding genlawhna","ref":"Mat. 11.10; Mak. 1.2; Luk. 1.76; 7.27"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh koi ahiei Ama hing pei na ni thuoh zou ding? Tualeh ahing kilat hun chiengin koi ahiei ding zou ding? “Aziehpen Ama khu halsiengpa mei bang leh puonsawppa sabon bang ahi.","ref":"Joel. 2.11; Kihil. 6.17"},"3":{"text":"Ama khu dangka halsiengpa leh siengthousahpa bangin atou dinga, Aman Levi tapate a susieng dinga, Mangpa kunga dihtattah a sillat alat theina ding un, sana leh dangka bangin a susieng ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin Juda leh Jerusalem sillat khu ni danglai a bang leh tanglai kumte a bangin, Mangpa a dingin alungdam huoita ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tualeh vaihawm dingin na kungnai uah ka hing pei ding a, ai san siemte, angkawmte, zuou a kichiemte, sum thalaw a nasemte, sugenthei a athaman nehpieh mite, tungah leh meithaite leh pa neiloute, nelsiete leh gamdang mite sugenthei mite leh kei hing giing loute tungah theipitu gangtah ka hi ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"6":{"text":"“Aziehpen Kei Mangpa ka hia, ka kiheng sih hi; Tuaziehin nou Jakob tate aw suhchimit a umlou na hi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh napu na pate uh hunlai akipat in ka thugousiete apat in na pielmang ua, na zui sih uhi. Ka kungah hing kile kia unlen, Kei zong noute kungah kang kile kia ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi. Hinanleh nouten Bangchi kilekia ding nachi uhi.","title":"Miten Pasian a suom uh"},"8":{"text":"Mihingin Pasian asuom ding ahiei mah? Hinanleh nouten kei na hing suom uhi. Hinanleh nouten Nang kang bangchi suom ua ahiei? Nachi uhi. Sawm a khatte leh sillate ah kei nang suom uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hamse law a samsiet na hita uh, nang suomtah ziehun, na nam pumpi nangawn un kei nang suomta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ka inn a neh ding ann a um theina dingin, sawm a khat zousie bu pangah hing koi unlen, tamte in hing enkhie un, van kotkhate hongin, akoina ding umlou khop in na tung uah guolzawlna ka hing sungbaw sih mawng eimah, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 27.30; Kisim. 18.21-24; Danp. 12.6; 14.22-29; Neh. 13.12"},"11":{"text":"Noute ziehin na haichi uh negamte ka phawh dinga, amaun na lei gate uh asuse sih ding ua, na lou ua grepguite zong nou a dingin galouin a um sih ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n nam zousieten noute mihampha ahing chi ding uhi, aziehpen gam kipah umtah na hi ding uh, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"13":{"text":"“Kei douna a na thugente uh akhau thei mama hi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Hinanleh nouten, Nang douna in bangthu ka gen ngel uoi? na chi nalai uhi."},"14":{"text":"Nouten Pasian nasep amawhna ahi, adan thute izui a, galkapte Mangpa mai a shisunte banga i um ua adeilam isui uh, bang phatuom ahiei? nachi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin, akiliensahte hampha isa ua, ahi, gitlouna bawlte alawching ua, Pasian ze ette nangawn hutkhiet in aum uhi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa zau mite khat lekhat akihou ua, Mangpa’n angaikhie a, aza hi. Tuachi’n thei ngitngetna laibu khat Ama mai ah, Mangpa giing mite leh amin ngaituote a dingin akigiel ta hi."},"17":{"text":"“Amaute ka goumanpha a ka bawl nichieng in, amauh kei a ahi ding uhi. Mi’n anasem atapa akhawi bangin amaute ka khawi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin, nouten midihtat leh migilou, kikaal leh Pasian nasem mi leh semlou mi kikaal thu na theikhen theita ding uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ngai un, lungthu khuh sunga meikuong banga kaatna ni hing tung ding ahi; mikiliensah zousie, ahi, giloutaha gamtate zousie khu bupawl bang ahi ding ua, tua ni hing tungin amauh akatum ding hi, Tuachi’n ahui leh aba, bangma anuasie sih ding hi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi.","title":"Mangpa ni"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh ka min giing noute a dingin, dihtatna Ni, ahate a suhdamna toh ahing suoh ding hi. Tualeh na pawtdoh ding ua, bawngbuh a bawngnou vahthau bangin na khanglien ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tam silte ka bawl ni chiengin nouten migiloute na tuonchil ding ua, na kephang nuoi ua vutvai ahi ding uhi, galkapte Mangpa’n achi hi."},"4":{"text":"“Ka suohpa Mosi kunga ka pieh dan Israel mi zousie a dinga, Horeb muol a ka thupieh, thugousiete leh vaihawmnate thei ngitnget un."},"5":{"text":"“En un, Mangpa ni thupitah leh zauhuoitah ahing tun masangin, guolnei Elijah ka hing sawl ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 11.14; 17.10-13; Mak. 9.11-13; Luk. 1.17; Jn. 1.21"},"6":{"text":"Ama’n pate lungtang tate lam ah, tualeh tate lungtang pate lam ah akihei sah ding hi, tuachilouin ka hing pei dinga, leitung hamsiein ka gawt ding hi.”"}}}}},"40":{"info":{"name":"Mathiu","shortname":"Mat.","abbr":[],"desc":"Mathiu gel khantanhoi"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham tapa, David tapa, Jesu Khrist khanggui kisutna laibu.","title":"Jesu pienna khanggui (Ruth. 4.18-22 ; 1 Khang. 1.34 ; 2.1-15 ; Luk. 3.31-34)"},"2":{"text":"Abraham tapa Isaak ahia, Isaak tapa Jakob ahia, Jakob tapa Juda leh asanggam pasalte ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tamar akipat a Juda tapate Perez leh Zerah ahi a, Perez tapa Hezron, Hezron tapa Ram ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ram tapa Aminadab ahia, Amminadab tapa Nahshon ahia, Nahshon tapa Salmon ahi."},"5":{"text":"Salmon tapa Rahab akipat in Boaz ahia, Boaz tapa Ruth akipat in Obed ahia, Obed tapa Jesse ahia,"},"6":{"text":"tualeh Jesse tapa David leengpa ahia, Lengpa David tapa Uria zi lah a kipat in Solomon ahi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 24.14,15; 2 Khang. 36.10; Jer. 27.20"},"7":{"text":"Solomon tapa Rehoboam ahia, Rehoboam tapa Abijah ahia, tualeh Abijah tapa Asa ahi."},"8":{"text":"Asa tapa Jehoshaphat ahia, Jehoshaphat tapa Joram ahia, tualeh Joram tapa Uzziah ahi."},"9":{"text":"Uzziah tapa Jotham ahia, Jotham tapa Ahaz ahia, Ahaz tapa Hezekiah ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hezekiah tapa Manasseh ahia, Manasseh tapa Amon ahia tualeh Amon tapa Josiah ahi."},"11":{"text":"Babilon lam a sal a apuimang lai vel un Josiah in Jekoniah leh asanggamte ahing hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Babilon lam a sal a puimanga aum nua ua Jekoniah tapa Shealtiel ahia, Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel ahi."},"13":{"text":"Zerubbabel tapa Abiud ahia, Abiud tapa Eliakim ahia, tualeh Eliakim tapa Azor ahi."},"14":{"text":"Azor tapa Zadok ahia, Zadok tapa Akim ahia, tualeh Akim tapa Eliud ahi."},"15":{"text":"Eliud tapa Eleazar ahia, Eleazar tapa Matthan ahia, tualeh Matthan tapa Jakob ahi."},"16":{"text":"Jakob tapa Mari pasal Joseph ahia, tua Mari apat in Khrist kichi Jesu ahing pieng hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n khang zousie Abraham akipat David dongchieng khangsawm leh khang li ahia, David akipat a Babilon gama sal a puimanga aum dong chieng uh, khang sawm leh khang li ahia, tualeh Babilon gama sal a puimang a aum ua kipat Khrist dong chieng khang sawm leh khangli ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tuin Jesu Khrist hing pien dan hichi bang ahi: Anu Mari khu Joseph toh akikham lai ua, a umkhawm masang un, Hagau Siengthouin nau apaisahta chi akitheita hi.","title":"Jesu pienna","ref":"Luk. 1.27"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n apasal Joseph midihtah ahia, zapi mai a amanu zumsuo ding a utlou ziehin, aguh a tawpsan atumta hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh ama’n tam thute angaituo laiin, Ngai vawi, amangin akung ah, Mangpa vansawlsieng khat ahing kilah a, “David tapa Joseph, na zi khamlai Mari kitenpi ding zau sin, anau pailai khu Hagau Siengthoua paisah ahi bou hi."},"21":{"text":"Amanu’n tapa khat hing nei van in, amin Jesu na phuo ding hi, Aman a mite akhelna ua kipat ahundam ding zieh in,” a chi hi.","ref":"Luk. 1.31"},"22":{"text":"Tuin tamte zousie Mangpa’n a guolnei kam a ana gente atangtun theina dinga hing um ahi."},"23":{"text":"“Ngai un, nungah siengthou agai ding a, tapa anei dinga, amin Immanuel achi ding uhi”, tua khu ikungah “Pasian a um china ahi”.","ref":"Isai. 7.14"},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph imu lai athou a, Mangpa vansawlsieng in thu apieh bangin abawl a, azi akitenpita hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh amanu’n atapa masa pen anei khieh masang sie’n aluppi sih hi. Tualeh amin Jesu aphuota uhi.","ref":"Luk. 2.21"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin leengpa Herod in vai ahawm lai a, Judia gam a Bethlehem khuo a Jesu ahing pien in, En vawi, suolam akipat in mipilte Jerusalem ah ahing pei ua,","title":"Suolam mipilte vena"},"2":{"text":"“Judate leengpa hing pienna heisung ahiei? Suolam ah aasi ka mu ua, Ama be dinga hing pei ka hi uh,” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Lengpa Herod in tam thute azahtah in alungbuoita a tualeh Jerusalem mite zousie zong ama toh abuoita uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh siempu liente leh mipite laigielmite zousie ahankhawm a, Khrist hing pienna ding heisung ahiei chi’n adongta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah “Judia gam a Bethlehem khuo ah; azieh pen guolnei in tambang in ana giel hi:"},"6":{"text":"‘Nang Juda gam a Bethlehem, Juda khopite lah ah na neupen vawt sih hi, Nang akipat in vaihawmpa khat hing pieng ding ahizieh in, ka mi Israelte vengpa dingin, akichi hi,’ achi uhi.”","ref":"Mik. 5.2"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Herod in mipilte adap hat a, aasi kilat hun kichientah in akankheta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh amaute Bethlehem ah asawl a, “Peita unlen naungeh thu kichientah in va kankhie un, tualeh na mu tah chieng un hing hil kia un, kei zong hing pei a ka hing bieh thei sam na dingin,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Lengpa thu azah nua un apeita uhi, tualeh en vawi, suolam a amu uh aasi khu naungeh umna tung zawn atun a akhawlden masangsie’n amasang uah apei zel hi."},"10":{"text":"Aasi amu tah un nasatah a nuom in akipah mama uhi."},"11":{"text":"Innsunga aluttah un, naungeh anu Mari toh um amu ua, tualeh akhupboh ua, abeta uhi. Tualeh a goubawmte uh ahong ua, akungah sana, begaw, leh Murrahte apie uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Herod kung a kile kia lou dinga amang ua, vauhil a aum zieh un, lampi tuom zui in agam lam uah apeita uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuin amauh pei nua in, en vawi, Mangpa vansawlsieng khat Joseph kungah amang in ahing ki laha, “Thou inlen naungeh leh anu pui inlen Izipt gam ah taipi in, tualeh ka hing hil kia masangsie tuanah umden in, Herod in naungeh tha dinga sui ding ahi ziehin,” achi hi.","title":"Izipt gam a taimangna"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n athou pai a, naungeh leh anu a pui a azan azan in Izipt gam lam ah apeita hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Herod a shi masangsiein khunah aumdenta hi; Mangpa’n guolnei kam a, “Ka tapa Izipt gam a kipat ka handohta hi,” chi a agen ahing tangtun theina dingin.","ref":"Hos. 11.1"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Herod in mipilten asol uh chi atheitah in alungthah mama a, mi asawl a, mipilte kunga ahun thu kichientah a adoh khieh bangtahin, Bethlehem khuo leh akim avel a pasal naupang kum ni nuoi lam zousie athatta hi.","title":"Herod in Bethlehem naupangte athana"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Jeremiah thugen khu tua hun laitah in atang tungta hi."},"18":{"text":"“Khum hunlai in guolnei Jeremiah in, Ramah khuo ah aw akiza, mishi ngai a kaa leh mauna, Rachel in atate akaa a, a umnawn lou zieh un, hamuon thei ahi sih,” chia a gen khu.","ref":"Jer. 31.15"},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Herod ashi bep in, Ngai in, Mangpa vansawlsieng khat Izipt gam a Joseph kungah amangin ava kilah a;","title":"Izipt gam akipata anuakiana"},"20":{"text":"“Thou inlen naungeh leh anu pui inlen, Israel gam ah pei in, naungeh tha tumte ashitah zieh un,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n athou a naungeh leh anu apui a, Israel gam ah apeita uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Arkelaus khu apa Herod tangin Juda gam ah vai ahawm chi azah in khum lang a pei ding azauta hi. Tualeh amanga Pasian in athuhil ziehin Galili gam lam ah akile hei a apeita hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Nazareth kichi khuo khat ah a umta hi; guolneiten “Ama khu Nazareth mi” achi ding uh chia agen uh atangtun theina dingin.","ref":"Mak. 1.24; Luk. 2.39; Jn. 1.45"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hunlaiin Baptispa Johan khu Judia gamdai ah thu genin ahing pei hi,","title":"Baptispa Johan leh athuhil"},"2":{"text":"“Kisia un, vangam anaita hi!” achiin agen hi.","ref":"Mat. 4.17; Mak. 1.15"},"3":{"text":"Ama ahi, Guolnei Isai in, “Gamdai a mi kikou aw in, Mangpa lamlien siel unlen, alampite sutang un, achi hi,” chia a nagen khu.","ref":"Isai. 40.3"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh tua Johan in sangawngsau mul puon asil a, akawng savun kawnggahin agah a, a ann khu khaukhup leh gam khuoizu ahi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 1.8"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem leh Judia gam pumpi leh Jordan gamkai kimvel a um mi zousie akungah ahing pei ua,"},"6":{"text":"akhelnate uh thupha tawiin, Jordan lui ah ama kungah baptisma atangta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman Pharisaite leh Saddukaite tampi akunga baptisma tang dinga hing pei amu tahin akung uah “Nou gul suonte aw, lungthahna hing tung ding taisan ding a hing thuhil koi ahiei?","title":"Baptispa Johan thugen (Mak. 1.7-9 ; Luk. 3.7-9 , 16-17)","ref":"Mat. 12.34; 23.33"},"8":{"text":"Tuazieh in kisiana min potaahin ga suong un."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Abraham ka pu uh ahi chi’n kingaituo sih un, Pasian in tam suongte zong Abraham hahlesuonte in adingsah thei hi, chi’n ka hing hil ahi.","ref":"Jn. 8.33"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh tuin zong sing bul chin ah heipi koi ahita hi. Tuaziehin sing chin ga hoia ga lou pouma akiphua a mei ah akipailut zel hi.","ref":"Mat. 7.19"},"11":{"text":"“Ken kisiana dingin noute tuiin ka hing baptis ngei a, hinanleh ka nua a hing pei ding pa kei sangin athupizaw a, akedap tawitah zong ka hi sih hi; Aman Hagau Siengthou leh mei in ahing baptis ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Akhut ah a phazap atawi a, aphuol a bute azap chiil dinga, bu pangah abute asungkhawm ding a hinanleh bushite pen mei mit theilou in ahaltum ding hi.”"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu, Johan kunga baptisma tang dingin Galili gam akipat in Jordan lui ah ahing pei a;","title":"Jesu Baptisma tanna (Mak. 1.12 , 13 ; Luk. 4.1-4)"},"14":{"text":"Johan in Nang, “Kei na hing baptis kiphamawzaw hinapi a, kei kunga hing peizawsop ding na hiei mah? chiin ana kham tum hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n a dawnga akungah, “Tuin pha sain, tambanga dihtatna zousie bawl bukim ei a dingin ahoi hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n pha asata hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n baptisma atan zouin, tui akipat in apawtdoh pai a, tualeh Ngai vawi, van khu ama dingin ahing kihong a, Pasian Hagau vakhu banga hing kumsuh in atunga hing tu khu amuta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai vawi, thakhat in van a kipat in aw khat in, “Tami ka tapa deita, ka kipahna mama ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 22.2; Late. 2.7; Isai. 42.1; Mat. 12.18; 17.5; Mak. 1.11; Luk. 9.35"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu dawimangpa sol aum dingin gamdai ah Hagau puilut in a umta hi.","title":"6 Gamdai a Jesu sola aumna khatveina (Mak. 1.12 , 13 ; Luk. 4.1-4)","ref":"Heb. 2.18; 4.15"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh sun sawm li leh zan sawmli anngawl a a um nua in agil ahing kielta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n asoldingpa ahing pei a, akungah, “Pasian tapa na hileh tam suongte tanghou suohsah dingin thu pie in” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman adawnga akungah, “Mihing tanghou guoh in ahing sih dinga, Pasian kam a thu chin pawtin ahingzaw ding, chi gel ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 8.3"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n dawimangpa’n Ama khopi siengthou ah apuitou a, Pasian biehinn khumvum ah akoi a,","title":"Solna niveina (Luk. 4.9-12)"},"6":{"text":"tualeh akungah, Pasian tapa na hileh kesuhin aziehpen tambanga gel ahi: “Na tungtang thu ah Aman avansawlsiengte thu ape dinga, akhut un ahing na dom tou ding uh, tuachilouin na kengin suong khat asuikha ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Late. 91.11,12"},"7":{"text":"Jesu’n akung ah, “Mangpa na Pasian ze et sin chi gel ahi kia hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 6.16"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh dawimangpa’n ama khu muol sangtah tung khat ah azawpitou kia a, leitung leenggam zousie leh athupina uh a ensah a;"},"9":{"text":"tualeh akung ah, “Khupboh a na hing bieh leh tamte zousie ka hing pe ding hi” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akungah, “Tana kipat in peimang in Setan, Mangpa na Pasian na be dinga, Ama nna bou nasep ding ahi, chi gel ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 6.13"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n diabol in, anuasieta a, tualeh Ngai vawi, Vansawlsiengte ahing pei ua, ana aseppiehta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuin Johan suongkul ah akhum uh chi Jesu’n azahtah in Galili gam lam ah akihemkheta hi.","title":"Jesu in nasep apatna (Mak. 1.14 , 15 ; Luk. 4.14 , 31)","ref":"Mat. 14.3; Mak. 6.17; Luk. 3.19,20"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Nazareth khuo nuasie in, Zebulun leh Naphtali gamkai sunga, tuipi gei a um Kapernaum khuo ah ava tengta hi.","ref":"Jn. 2.12"},"14":{"text":"Guolnei Isai in, tambanga athugente ahing tangtun theina ding ahi:"},"15":{"text":"“Tuipi lam a Jordan gal a Zebulun gam leh Naphtali gam, Jentelte Galili!","ref":"Isai. 9.1,2"},"16":{"text":"Miel lah a touten vah thupitah amuta, shina gam leh lim a toute tungah, khovah ahing suohta hi,” ana chi khu."},"17":{"text":"Khum huna kipat in Jesu’n “Kisia un van gam anaita hi, chi’n thugen apanta hi.”","ref":"Mat. 3.2"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu Galili tuipi gei a avah laiin Simon kichi Peter leh asanggampa Andru, tuipi a lensep a um amu a, ama uh nga man mi mawng ahi uhi.","title":"Anuazui masate ahatna (Mak. 1.16-20)"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Hing zui un, mihing manin ka hing bawl ding,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n a maun alente uh anuasie pai ua, Ama azuita uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh khuna kipat in apei zela, unau dang ni Zebedi tapate Jakob leh asanggampa Johan apa u’toh kuong sunga alente uh phaw a um amu a, tualeh amauh ahan a,"},"22":{"text":"tualeh amaun kuong leh apa uh anuasie pai ua, Ama azuita uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu Galili gam pumpi ah apei kawi kawi a, akikhopna innte uah, leenggam khantanhoi thu agen a, mite lah a natna chinteng leh damlouna chinteng, adam sah zel hi.","title":"Galili gam a Jesu nasepna","ref":"Mat. 9.35; Mak. 1.39"},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siria gam pumpi ah aminthangta a, tualeh amaun natna chi tuom tuom a damlou zousie leh dawi matte buhshite, zengte, akungah ahing pui ua, Aman ana sudam zel hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Galili akipat, Dekapolis akipat, Jerusalem akipat, Judia gam leh Jordan gallam a kipat in mi tampiin Ama azui uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh mipite amuin muol tungah apeitou a, atou a, anuazuite akungah ahing pei ua;","title":"Muol tung a athugen"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akam akaah a, amauh thu ahil a:"},"3":{"text":"“Hagau a gentheite ahampha uhi, van gam ama-ua ahi zieh in."},"4":{"text":"“Da a lungkhamte ahampha uh, hamuon a um ding ahi zieh un.","ref":"Isai. 61.2"},"5":{"text":"“Lungnemte ahampha uh, lei gouluo ding ahizieh un.","ref":"Late. 37.11"},"6":{"text":"“Dihtatna zieh a gilkiel leh, dangtate ahampha uh, tai ding ahi zieh un.","ref":"Isai. 55.1,2"},"7":{"text":"“Mi hepi siemte ahampha uh, hepina mu ding ahi zieh un."},"8":{"text":"“Lungsim a siengthoute ahampha uh, Pasian mu ding ahi zieh un.","ref":"Late. 24.3,4"},"9":{"text":"“Lemna bawlte ahampha uh, Pasian tate chi a um ding ahi zieh un."},"10":{"text":"“Dihtatna zieh a gawtna thuohte ahampha uh, van gam ama ua ding ahi zieh in.","ref":"1 Pet. 3.14"},"11":{"text":"“Miten keima zieh a ahing housiet ua, ahing bawlsiet ua, zuou a sietna chinteng a ahing heh hun chieng un, na hampha uhi.","ref":"1 Pet. 4.14"},"12":{"text":"Kipah unlen, nasatah in nuom un, van ah na nuom man ding uh athupi mama hi, tuamabangin na masang ua guolnei umte zong ana bawlgenthei uhi.","ref":"2 Khang. 36.16; Nasep. 7.52"},"13":{"text":"“Noute lei chi na hi uhi, hinanleh chi khu tamta leh bang achi ki al sah kiata diei? tuachi’n paidoh a mite totchil ding loungal in bangma dingin aphatuom nawn sih ding hi.","title":"Chi leh meivah","ref":"Mak. 9.50; Luk. 14.34,35"},"14":{"text":"“Noute leitung vah na hi uhi, muol tunga khopi um khu akiphuol thei sih hi.","ref":"Jn. 8.12; 9.5"},"15":{"text":"Mi’n meivah dein law nuoi ah akoi ngai sih ua, atunna tungah akoizaw uhi; tuachi’n inn sunga mi um zousie ataanvah hi.","ref":"Mak. 4.21; Luk. 8.16; 11.33"},"16":{"text":"Tuama bangin na vah uh mi mudingin vah heh, tuachi’n na silbawl hoite amu thei ding ua, Van a um na Pa uh apahtawi thei ding uhi.","ref":"1 Pet. 2.12"},"17":{"text":"“Dan thu leh guolneite thu sumang dinga hing pei ahi chiin hing ngaisut sih un, asumang dinga hing pei ka hi sih a, asutangtung dinga hing pei ka hizaw hi.","title":"Dan lui leh Jesu dan"},"18":{"text":"Chitahtahin na kung uah ka gen ahi, lei leh van aman masangsiein, danthu apat sutvom neunoukhat ahiei, thaivom neunoukhat zong amang sih ding hi, abawn a atangtun kim masangsiein.","ref":"Luk. 16.17"},"19":{"text":"Tuazieh in koihinanleh tam thupiehte laha neupen khat maimai zong susie a, tuabanga bawl dinga mite thuhil pouma vangam ah mi neupen akichi ding hi; hinanleh azui a tualeh tuabanga zui dinga mite thuhil pouma vangam ah milien akichi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen ka hing hil ahi, Na dihtatna un laigiel mite leh Pharisaite dihtatna akhup sih leh vangam ah na lut vawt sih ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"“Nidanglai a mite kunga tuol na thalou ding ahi, tualeh koizong tuolthat pouma vaihawmna zauhuoitah dinmun ah ading ding uh kichi na zata uhi.","title":"Lungthahna leh tuolthana","ref":"Pawt. 20.13; Danp. 5.17"},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh ken na kung uah ka gen ahi, Koipou azieh bei a a unau tunga lungthah khu thukhenna zauhuoi dinmun ah ading ding a, tualeh koi zong a unau kunga Raka chi pouma thukhen vaihawmte vaihawmkhumna zauhuoitah dinmun ah ading ding a, tualeh koipou “Nang mi mo” chi pouma gawtmun meidil a pai ding zauhuoitah dinmun ah a ding ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin maitam bul a na silpieh na lat laitah a, na unau in na tunga lungkimlouna anei chi na theidoh leh,"},"24":{"text":"na silpieh khu maitam mai ah nuasie inlen, pei inlen na unau toh kilem masa phot inlen, tuachi’n hing pei inlen na silpieh lan in."},"25":{"text":"Na langpa toh thukhenna lam zuon a lampi a na peikhawm lai un, kilempi zuai in, tua ahisihleh na langpa’n thukhenmi khut ah ahing pe dinga, thukhen miin, mi manpa khut ah ahingpe dinga, tualeh mi manpan suongkul ah ahing khum kha ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Chitahtahin ka hinghil ahi, paisa san khat nangawn na pieh kim masangsie tuana kipat in na pawtdoh sih ding hi."},"27":{"text":"“Nidang lai a mite kunga, ang na kawm ding uh ahisih kichi na zata uhi.","title":"Angkawmna","ref":"Pawt. 20.14; Danp. 5.18"},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh Ken vang na kung ua ka gen ahi, koipou in numei khat mawpi utna toh a et leh alungsim ah amanu toh ang akawm zouta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh na mit zietlam in ahing khelsah leh kheukhie inlen pai mai in, na tahsa pumpi gawtmuna pai ahi sangin na tahsa hieng khat amanthai nang a dingin ahoizaw hi.","ref":"Mat. 18.9; Mak. 9.47"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh na khut zietlam in ahing khelsah leh sattan inlen nanga kipat paimangin, na tahsa pumpi gawtmuna pai ahi sangin na tahsa hieng khat amanthai nang ading in ahoizaw hi.","ref":"Mat. 18.8; Mak. 9.43"},"31":{"text":"“Tuaban ah koizong zi khul pouma in khulna lai amanu pie heh, ana kichi nalai hi.","title":"Nupa kikhulna","ref":"Danp. 24.1-4; Mat. 19.7; Mak. 10.4"},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh ken vang na kung uah ka gen ahi: Mi koipou in mi toh lupkhawm zieh hilou a, azi akhul leh amanu angkawm sah ahi tualeh koipou tua khulsanu kitenpi khu angkawm ahi.","ref":"Mat. 19.9; Mak. 10.11,12; Luk. 16.18; 1 Kor. 7.10,11"},"33":{"text":"“Tuachiengin nidanglai, in mite kunga zuouin kichiem sinlen, hinanleh na kichiemnate Mangpa kungah tangtunzaw in, kichi zong na zata uhi.","title":"Kihahsielna leh thutahna","ref":"Siempu. 19.12; Kisim. 30.2; Danp. 23.21"},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh ken vang na kung uah ka gen ahi: Kichiem mawngmawng sih un, van lou in kichiem sih un, tua khu Pasian Mangtoupha ahi;","ref":"Jak. 5.12; Isai. 66.1; Mat. 23.22"},"35":{"text":"Ahisihleh lei louin zong kichiem sih un, tua khu akeng ngapna ahi, ahisihleh Jerusalem louin zong kichiem sih un, tua khu leengpa thupitah khopi ahi.","ref":"Isai. 66.1; Late. 48.2"},"36":{"text":"Na lutang lou a na kichiem ding zong ahi tuom sih, aziehpen na samzam khat zong na kang sahin, na vomsah thei sih hi."},"37":{"text":"Hinanleh na thugen uh ahite ahi, ahiloute ahilou hi mai heh, akan aval pen gitlouna lah a hing pawt ahi."},"38":{"text":"“Mit taangin mit, ha taangin ha, ana kichi na zata uhi.","title":"Phuba lahna","ref":"Pawt. 21.24; Siempu. 24.20; Danp. 19.21"},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh ken ka hing hil ahi, migilou thuh sih un, hinanleh koipou in na bieng zietlam abeh u’leh, alelam zong dawzaw un."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh mi koipou in na tunga thusie bawl a na puonah lah atup leh na puongjal zong lasah in."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh koipou tai khat pei dinga hing paubawlte kungah ama toh tai ni peikhawm un."},"42":{"text":"Mi’n na kunga ang nget leh pie inlen, tualeh ahing leitawi ut leh, kiheimangsan sin."},"43":{"text":"“Na innvengte it inlen, na melmate muda in kichi na zata uhi.","title":"Itna leh umdan hoikim (Luk. 6.27 , 32)"},"44":{"text":"Hinanleh kenvang na kung uah ka gen ahi, na melmate uh it unlen, nou hing bawlseta thungetpieh un."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n na Pa uh van a um tate na hi thei ding uhi; Aman migiloute leh mi hoite tungah ni asuohsah a, tualeh midihtat leh midihtat loute tungah zong guo azusah hi."},"46":{"text":"Nou hing itte beh na it uleh kipahman bang ahiei na mu ding uh? Siedongte nangawn in zong tuabang a bawl hilou ahi uoi mah?"},"47":{"text":"Tualeh na unaute beh uh chibai na buh u’leh midangte sang a bang ahiei na bawl tam tuom uh? Siedongte nangawn in zong tuabanga bawl hilou ahi uoi mah?"},"48":{"text":"Tuazieh in van a um na Pa uh ahoibukim mabangin noute zong hoibukim un.","ref":"Siempu. 19.2; Danp. 18.13"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Na sil hoi bawlte uh mihingte mitmu a amasang ua bawllou dingin pilvang un, tuachilouin pen na Pa uh van a um kungah nuomman muding na nei sih ding uhi.","title":"Aguh a itna silpieh","ref":"Mat. 23.5"},"2":{"text":"“Tuaziehin mi kunga silpieh na pieh chieng un mi lepchieten mi pahtat alawtheina ding ua, kikhopna inn leh kholaidung lah a abawl bangun, na masang uah pengkul mut sih un. Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, amaun anuomman uh amu zouta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten mi kunga silpieh na pieh chiengun, na khut zietlam un abawl, na khut veilam un theisih heh."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n na sil pieh khu aguh ahi thei ding hi; tualeh na Pa uh aguh a hing mu pa’n langtang tah in ahing din ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tualeh na thunget chieng un, milepchiete banga na bawllou ding uh ahi, amaun miten amu theina ding un, kikhopna innte leh kholaidung lamka thuomte bangah ding kawm in thunget aut sese uhi, chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, amaun anuomman uh amuta uhi.","title":"Aguh a thungetna (Luk. 11.2-4)","ref":"Luk. 18.10-14"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh noute pen na thunget chieng un na pindan sung gil uah lut unlen, na kot uh kha unlen mun simtham a um na Pa uh kungah thungen un, tuachi’n aguh a hing mu na Pa un langtangtah in nou ahing pe ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Hinanleh na thunget chieng un Jentelte bangin thuginalou gen sawn sawn sih un, amauten agen tam zieh ua zah a um dingin akingaituo uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin amauh bang sih un, aziehpen na nget masang un, na Pa un na tasapte uh atheita hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin tambangin thum un: Ka Pa uh van a um, Namin kizatat hen,","title":"Mangpa thungetna"},"10":{"text":"Na gam hing tung hen, na deilam van a akibawl bangin, lei ah zong kibawl hen."},"11":{"text":"Tuni’n nichin a ka neh ding uh ann hing pie in."},"12":{"text":"Ka leibate uh ka ngaidam bang un, ka batte uh hing ngaidam in."},"13":{"text":"Solna ah hing puilut sinlen, gilou lah ah hing hunkhe zawin, gamte, silbawltheinate, leh thupinate kumtawn a Nanga ahizieh in, Amen! chiin."},"14":{"text":"Mite atatkhelnate uh na ngaidam u’leh, na Pa uh van a um in zong noute ahing ngaidam ding hi.","ref":"Mak. 11.25,26"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh mite tatkhelnate na ngaidam sih uleh na Pa un zong na tatkhelnate uh ahing ngaidam sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tuachiengleh ann na ngawl chiengun milepchiete bangin ngui mel posih un, amaun mite mitmu a anngawl uh akilat theina ding un, amaisuo uh atuom sah leng uhi. Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, amaun anuomman uh amuta uhi.","title":"Ann ngawlna"},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten ann na ngawl chiengun na lutang uh sathau nu unlen, na mai uh phiet un."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n mun simthama um na Pa uh muna loungal, mihingte mitmu a, anngawl na bahlouna ding un, tualeh na Pa uh aguh a hing mupa’n langtang tahin kipahman ahing pe ding hi."},"19":{"text":"“Lei a nget leh sam eeh in anehsiet na ah leh gutaten aphevang ua aguh theina uah gou kikhol sih un.","title":"Hausatna dih","ref":"Jak. 5.2,3"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh van ah, nget leh sam eeh in anehsiet louna leh, gutaten aphevang ua, aguh louna uah gou kikholzaw un."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen na gou uh umna mun ah, na lungtang u’zong a um ding hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tahsapumpi meivah khu mit ahi, tuaziehin na mit ahoi leh na tahsapumpi vahin adim ding hi.","title":"Vah leh miel"},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh na mit asiet leh na tahsapumpi amiel sieng ding hi. Tuaziehin na sunga vah khu miel hita leh tua mielna khu nasa va-ia va e izaw."},"24":{"text":"“Koiman houtu ni nna asemkop thei sih, aziehpen khat amuda ding a, khat pen ait dinga, ahisihleh khat humin, khatpen asimmaw kha ding hi. Pasian leh sum nna nasemkop thei sih ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Tuaziehin ka hing hil ahi, Bang ahiei ka neh ding, bang ahiei ka dawn ding, ahisihleh na tahsa ua dinga bang ahiei ka sil a ka ten ding chi’n na tahsa ua dingin lunghimaw sih un, neh ding sangin hinna athupizaw sih amah? Silleten sangin tahsa a thupi zaw sih amah?","title":"Lunghimawna leh Pasian muonna"},"26":{"text":"Tungleeng vate en un, bu atu sih ua, at zong a at sih uh, tualeh bu inn ah zong asunglut sih uh, ahivangin na Pa uh van a umin amauh ava hi; Noute amauh sanga nahpitah a thupizaw hilou na hi uoi mah?"},"27":{"text":"Noute lah a koi ahiei lunggim zieh a, adung lam tong khat a susang tuon thei?"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n bang ding a sil leh ten thu a lunggim na hi uoi? Gamlah a lili pahte khan dan hoitahin ngaituo un, nna asemgim sih ua, mui zong azom ngai sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh, ka hing hil ahi, Solomon ngelzong athupina zousie toh akizep vangin, tam lili pahte khat bangin akizem zou sih hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 10.4-7; 2 Khang. 9.3-6"},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamlah loupa tuni banga hing a, azingni chieng a thuhkhuh sung a pailut ding bawn Pasian in ahichi zep leh Aw nou ginna tawmte Aman noute tuasangin nihten puonsil in ahing zemzaw tham sih ding amah?"},"31":{"text":"Tuazieh in bang ahiei ineh ding? Bang ahiei idawn ding? bang ahiei isil ding? Chi’n lunghimaw sih un."},"32":{"text":"Aziehpen tam silte zousie Jentelten asui uhi; tam silte na tasam uh chi na Pa uh van a um in athei hi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian Gam leh adihtatna sui masa un, tuachi’n tam silte zousie piehbe na hi ding uhi."},"34":{"text":"“Tuaziehin zing chienga dingin lunggim sih un, aziehpen zingin ama a ding silte akilunggimpi na ding hi. Ni khat gimthuoh khu ni khat a dingin ahun ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Midang tung thu khen sih un, na tungthu uh khen a a umlouna ding in.","title":"Midangte tungah thukhen sin"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen na khenpieh mabang un noute zong ahing kikhenpieh ding hi, tualeh na tena mama un ahing kitepieh ding hi.","ref":"Mak. 4.24"},"3":{"text":"Bangdinga nangma mit a singtun um ngaituo loua na unaupa mit a nin neng neunou mu thei na hiei?"},"4":{"text":"Ahisihleh bangchidan a na unau kunga, na mit a ninneng neunou khu hing lahdoh pieh vang na chi thei ding ahiei? En in, nangma mit ah singtun a um hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang milepchie, nangma mit akipat in singtun khu ladoh masa in, tuachi’n na unau mit a ninneng neunou lahdoh ding khu kichientahin na mu thei ding hi."},"6":{"text":"“Uite kungah sil siengthou pe sih un, ahisihleh voh masang ah na suongmantam uh pai sih un akeng un atuonchil ding ua, tualeh hing kihei in nangma ahing balnen kha ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ngen un, pieh in na um ding uh, sui un na mu ding uh, kiu un honpiehin na um ding uhi.","title":"Ngen un pieh in na um ding uh (Luk. 11.9-13)"},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen a ngen pouma piehin a um ua, Koipou a sui in amu ua, koipou akiu pouma hon pieh in a um ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ahisihleh na lah uah, koi ahiei atapain tanghou ngen taleh suong pe ding?"},"10":{"text":"Ahisihleh nga ngen taleh koi ahiei gul pe ding?"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi ahileh, nou migilouin bawn na tate uh sil hoi piehna dan na thei uleh, na Pa uh van a umin akunga ngente sil hoi petham lou ding ahiei mah?"},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin sil zousie miten na tung ua abawl dinga na dei pouma uh, nouten zong mite tungah bawl un, tua khu dan thu leh guolneite thu ahi.","title":"Dan hoi leh lampi nite","ref":"Luk. 6.31"},"13":{"text":"“Kot kochih ah lut un, manthaina lampi kot khu alien a, alampi zong agol hi, tualeh khuna lutte khu tam zong atam uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinna zotna kot khu akochih a, alampi zong ahamsa a, amute zong atawm uhi."},"15":{"text":"“Guolnei dihloute lah ah pilvang un, amaute khu belam vun sil in na kung uah ahing pei leng ua, asunglam uah lah ngia gongsan ngen ahi uhi.","title":"Thudih leh dihlou kihilna (Luk. 6.43-45)"},"16":{"text":"Amaute aga uah na thei pai ding uhi, mi’n khaulingnei gui ah grep ga alou ngai uh amah? Ahisihleh theimiling kung ah theipi alou ngai uh amah?"},"17":{"text":"Tuachimabangin sing hoi pouma aga ahoi a, hinanleh sing siein ga hoilou asuong hi."},"18":{"text":"Sing hoi aga ase thei sih a, sing sie zong aga ahoi thei sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Sing chin ga hoilou pouma aphua ua, mei ah apai uhi.","ref":"Mat. 3.10; Luk. 3.9"},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaute aga un na thei ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 12.33"},"21":{"text":"“Mangpa, Mangpa hing chi zousie, vangam alut sih ding uhi, hinanleh ka Pa van a um deilam bawlte bou khu alut ding uhi.","title":"Noute kang thei ngai sih hi (Luk. 6.46)"},"22":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin mi tampiin, Mangpa, Mangpa na min in thumavang ka gen ua, na min in dawite ka deldoh un, na min in sil lamdang tampi ka bawl uh hilou amah? Achi ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin ken akung uah noute ka hing thei ngai sih hi; nou silgilou bawlte aw, ka kung akipat in peimang un, ka chi ding hi.","ref":"Late. 6.8"},"24":{"text":"“Tuaziehin mi koipou tam ka thugente za a, zui pouma mipil suongpi tunga inn lam mi toh ka gente ding hi.","title":"Inn lamdan nite (Luk. 6.46-49)"},"25":{"text":"Guo ahing zu a, tui ahing khang a, huipi ahing langa, tuo inn khu ahing mut vapual a, hinanleh apua sih hi, suongpi tung a lamdet ahi ziehin."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh michin tam ka thugente za a, zuilou pouma khu, mimo senel tunga innlam mi toh ka gente ding hi.”"},"27":{"text":"Guo ahing zu a, tui ahing lien a, huipi ahing laang a, tua inn ahing mut vapual a, apuata hi, tua inn khu apua nasetah ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Jesu’n tam thute agen zou in mipi’n athuhilte lamdang asa mama uhi.","ref":"Mak. 1.22; Luk. 4.32"},"29":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama’n laigiel mite banglou a, thu neina nei bang tahin amauh thu ahil hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh muolvum akipat a ahing peisuh laiin mipi thupitahin Ama azuita uhi.","title":"Phah suhdamna (Mak. 1.40-44 ; Luk. 5.12-14)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh En vawi, miphah khat akungah ahing pei a Ama abie a, “Mangpa na ut leh na hing siengthousah thei hi,” a chi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akhut in azam a, akhoi a, “Ka ut hi, siengthoutain” achi hi. Tuachi’n aphah khu asiengthou pai lien hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n akungah, “Koima na hillou ding ahi, hinanleh pei inlen, siempu kungah va kilah inlen, Mosi in silpieh pieh dinga, athupiehte va pie in, atheichetna ding un,” achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 14.1-32"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu Kapernaum khuo a alut in, akungah galkap zahoutu khat ahing pei a,","title":"Roman galkaplien suohpa adamsahna (Luk. 7.1-10)"},"6":{"text":"“Mangpa ka suohpa zengin inn ah alum a, nasatah a sunatin a um hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akungah, “Hing pei vangin sudam na vang,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Galkap zahoutuin a dawnga, “Mangpa ka innsunga na hing lutnataah ka hi sih hi, thu tengkhat genlachin ka suohpa adamta ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen kei zong thuneina nuoi a um ka hia, ka nuoi ah galkapte a um ua, tualeh khat kungah pei in ka chileh apei a, tualeh adang khat kungah hing peiin, ka chileh ahing pei hi; tualeh ka suohpa kungah tami bawlin ka chileh abawl zel hi,” achita hi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu’n tam thu azah tahin lamdang asa a, Ama zuite kungah, “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, Israelte lah ah zong tambang va-ia a ginna thupi ka mukha ngai sih hi, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh ka hing hil ahi, suolam leh tumlam akipat in mi tampi ahing pei ding ua, van gam ah Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob toh atoukhawm ding uhi.","ref":"Luk. 13.29"},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh gam tate pen pulam miel ah paidoh in aum ding uhi. Khunah kaa leh hagawtna a um ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 22.13; 25.30; Luk. 13.28"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n galkap zahoutu kungah, “Peita in na gintatna bangin nanga dingin bawl hita heh,” achi hi. Tuachi’n tuami dahkal mamain asuohpa adamta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu Peter inn sunga alut tahin, Peter sungnu khosih a lum amuta hi.","title":"Peter sungnu damsahna (Mak. 1.29-34 ; Luk. 4.38-41)"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Ama’n amanu khut atham a, tuachi’n akhosih abeita hi. Tuachi’n amanu athou a ana uh aseppiehta hi."},"16":{"text":"Nitahlam ahing hi tahin, akungah dawimat tampi ahing pui ua, Ama’n thu in dawite adeldoh a, damlou zousie asudamta hi."},"17":{"text":"Guolnei Isai in, “Ama ngel in ihatlounate ala a, inatnate a pota hi.” Chi a agen khu ahing tangtun theina dingin.","ref":"Isai. 53.4"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n akimvel a mihon thupitah amu tahin, gal langkhat a pei dingin thu apie hi.","title":"Nuazui dingte telna (Luk. 9.57-62)"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n laigiel mi koi ahiei khat a hing pei a, akung ah, “Siepa na peina tengah hing zui vang,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Jesu’n akung ah, “Si-alten kuo anei ua, tungleeng vate’n bu anei uhi, hinanleh Mihing Tapa in vang alu ngahna ding mun anei sih hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh anua zuite lah a mi dang khat in akungah, “Mangpa va pei vangin ka pa vavui masa tavang” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n akungah, “Hing zuiin mishi in a mishi uh kivui uheh” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh kuong sunga atuon tahin, anuazuite’n Ama azui uhi.","title":"Tuipi adaisahna (Mak. 4.35-41 ; Luk. 8.22-25)"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh thakhat in khopihui thupitah ahing laang a, tua tui kihawt in kuong ahing tumta a, hinanleh Ama pen a imu hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n anuazuite akung ah, ahing pei ua, ama aphong ua, “Mangpa hing hundam in, mangthang ding hitalou ka hi uoi mah!” Achi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman akung uah, “Aw nou ginna tawmte bangding a zau na hi uoi mah?” achi a, Tuachi’n athou a, huipi leh tuipi aphawha, ahing dai dide ta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n miten lamdang asa mama ua, “Tam mipa bang chibang mi ahiei? Khopihui leh tuipi nangawn in, athu aman uh,” achi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh gal langkhat lam Gadara mite gam ahing tun tahin, dawimat mi ni, han a kipat a hing pawtin akituohpi ua, agiinhuoi mama zieh un, tuomi lampi ah koima apei ngamsih uhi.","title":"Gadarami dawimatte (Mak. 5.1-17 ; Luk. 8.26-37)"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh amaute thakhat in ahing kikoukhie ua, Jesu, “Nang Pasian Tapa, kou bang hing law ding na hiei mah? Ahun tun masanga koute sugenthei ding a hing pei na hiei mah?” achi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh a umna ua kipata gamla sim tah ah voh hon tampi ata uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n dawiten “Na hing nawdoh a ahileh, voh honte sunga lut ding hing phalpieh in” chi’n Ama angen uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Pei un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amauh ahing pawtdoh ua, vohhon sungah alut ua, thakhat in voh honte khu kawl ah ataikhe suh ua, tuipi ah atai lut ua, tui lah ah ashi gamta uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n voh chingte atai ua, khopi sung ah alut ua, sil tung zousie leh dawimat mi nite tunga sil tungte abawn in ahilta uhi."},"34":{"text":"En vawi, khopi mite zousie Jesu kimupi dingin ahing pawt ua, tualeh Ama amu tah un, agam ua pat pawtdoh dingin hatang nget in angenta uhi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama kuong sung ah alut a, agalkai a, Ama khopi ah ahing tungta hi.","title":"Zeng damsahna (Mak. 2.1-12 ; Luk. 5.17-26)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh En vawi, mi khat zeng a damlou lupna a lum in akung ah ahing zawng ua, tuachi’n Jesu’n aginna uh amu tahin, zenga damloupa kungah, “Tapa lungmuong tahin um in, na khelnate, ngaidam ahita,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ngai vawi, lai gielmi koite ahiei in, “Tam mipa’n Pasian agensie hi,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n angaituote uh athei a, “Bangding a na lungsim ua silgilou ngaituo na hi uoi?"},"5":{"text":"Na khelnate ngaidam ahita, chi leh, thou inlen na kengin pei in, chi koi abailamzaw diei? achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Mihing Tapa’n leitung ah khelnate ngaidam theina anei chi na theina ding un, (zeng a damloupa kungah) thou inlen, nalupna la inlen na inn ah peita’n,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n amapa athou a, a inn ah apeita hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua khu mipiten amu tah un, lamdang asa ua, tuabang bawltheina mihingte kunga pepa Pasian apahtawita uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuana kipat in Jesu a pei zel a, sie piehna mun a tou, mi khat amin Mathiu kichi amu a; akungah “Hing zuiin,” achia, tuachi’n amapa adingdoh a Ama azuita hi.","title":"Mathiu hatna (Mak. 2.14-17 ; Luk. 5.27-32)"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Jesu ann ne dinga inn sunga atou lai in, En vawi, siekhon mite leh mikhielte tampi ahing pei ua, Ama leh anuazuite toh annkuong a imkhawmta uhi.","ref":"Luk. 15.1,2"},"11":{"text":"Tuakhu Pharisaiten amu tahun, anuazuite kungah “Bangdinga na siepa un siekhon mite leh mikhielte toh ann aneh khawm ahiei?” Achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n tuakhu azah tahin akung uah, “Mi damtheiten daktorpa akiphamaw sih ua, mi chinaten bou akiphamaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh pei unlen, kithoina deilouin, hepina ka lunggul hi, chi umdan va zil un, aziehpen midihtatte han dinga hing pei kahisih a, mikhielte kisiasah dinga han a hing pei ka hizaw hi.”","ref":"Mat. 12.7; Hos. 6.6"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Johan nuazuite akungah ahing pei ua, “Bangding a kou leh Pharisaiten ann ngawl zel unga, na nuazuiten ngawllou ahi uoi?” Achi uhi.","title":"Ann ngawl thu"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n akung uah, “Mouneipa akung ua a um laisie moupuiten asuun thei ding uh amah? Hinanleh mouneipa alah ua kipata lahmang ni ahing tung ding a tua hun chiengin ann angawl ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Koiman puon lui puontha them in aphaw ngaisih uhi, aziehpen aphawna in puon aluoikehzaw dinga, ahing keh semsemzaw ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahisihleh koiman zu tha savun thawl lui ah athun ngai sih uhi, tuachilouin vang savun thawlte apohkeh dinga, zu khu akibo ding a savun thawl zong asegawp ding hi; tuaziehin zu tha khu savun thawl tha ah athunzaw ua, tuachi’n ani in abit tuohtuoh hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Aman tam thute akung ua agen laiin, En vawi, vaihawmpa khat akung ah ahing pei a, Ama abie a, “Ka tanu tu mama in ashita hi, hinanleh hing pei inlen atung ah na khut koilachin ahing mai ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Jairas tanu leh numei sipawt damsahna (Mak. 5.21-43 ; Luk. 8.40-56)"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu adingdoh a, ama azuita a, tualeh anuazuiten zong a zuita uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh thakhat in numei khat kum sawm leh kum ni sipawt a damlou, anua ah ahing pei a, apuon mong akhoi a,"},"21":{"text":"Amanu’n alungsim in, “Apuon mong khoi leng zong ka dam mai ding hi,” chiin angaituo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu akinuohei a, amanu amutahin, “Tanu lungmuong tahin um in na ginna in ahing damsahta hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n numeinu khu tuami dahkal akipat in adamta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu vaihawmpa inn sunga alut tahin, theile tumte leh mipi kapleh mau vengvung ava mu a,"},"24":{"text":"Aman akung uah “Mun awng sah un, naupangnu ashi sih hi,” a imu ahi bou hi achi hi. Tualeh amaun anuisan giap uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh mipite apulam a asawldoh nua in, alut a, amanu akhutin atu a, tuachi’n naupangnu ahing thouta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam thu khu tuo gam pumpi ah athang suohta hi."},"27":{"text":"Jesu khuna kipat a apawtdoh tahin, mitto ni in azui ua, “David tapa ka tung uah zangai in,” chiin akikou uhi.","title":"Mitto ni damsahna"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh inn sunga alut tahin mitto tegel akung ah ahing pei ua, tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Tami bawlthei dingin na hing gingta uh amah?” achi hi. Amaun akungah “Gingta e, Mangpa,” achi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman a mit uh akhoi pieh a, “Na gintat bang un na tung uah tungta hen,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh amit uh ahing vahta hi. Tualeh Jesu’n “Koima theisah lou dingin khautah in thu apie hi.”"},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute gel apawtdoh tah un, tua gam pumpi ah Ama tungtang thu agen thang ta uhi."},"32":{"text":"Amaute gel apawtdoh tahun, En vawi, mi hamtheilou dawimat khat akungah ahing zawpi uhi.","title":"Hamtheilou damsahna"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh dawi khu anawdoh tahin, hamtheilou khu ahing hamta hi, tuachi’n mipiten lamdang asa mama ua, “Israel gam ah tambang akimu ngai sih hi” achi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh “Pharisaiten dawimangpa zieha dawite anawdoh ahi,” achita uhi.","ref":"Mat. 10.25; 12.24; Mak. 3.22; Luk. 11.15"},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akikhopna innte uah thu hil in, leenggam khantanhoi thu genin, damlouna chinteng leh natna chinteng damsah in, khopi leh khoneute zousie tuon in avah kawikawi hi.","title":"Khrist in mipite ahepina","ref":"Mat. 4.23; Mak. 1.39; Luk. 4.44"},"36":{"text":"Aman mipite amu tahin chingding neilou belamte banga gimthuoh leh kithethanga aumzieh un alainatta mama hi.","ref":"Kisim. 27.17; 1 Leeng. 22.17; 2 Khang. 18.16; Ezek. 34.5; Mak. 6.34"},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman anuazuite kungah, “Adihtahin bu lah ding atam mama a, hinanleh a nasem mite atawm hi.","ref":"Luk. 10.2"},"38":{"text":"Tuaziehin bu la dinga nasemte hing sawl dingin bu neipa kung ah ngen un,” achi hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Aman anuazui sawm leh nite ahat zou in, akung uah dawibuate nawdoh theina leh damlouna chinteng leh natna chinteng damsah theina thuneina apie hi.","title":"Sawltah sawm leh nite leh anasep uh"},"2":{"text":"Sawltah sawm leh nite min khu tamte ahi: Amasa pen in Simon, Peter kichipa leh a sanggampa Andru; Zebedi tapa Jakob leh asanggampa Johan;"},"3":{"text":"Philip leh Bartholomai; Thomas leh siekhonpa Mathiu; Alphai tapa Jakob leh Lebbai amintah Thaddeus;"},"4":{"text":"Kanaan mi Simon leh amansahpa Judas Iskariotte ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Sawm leh nite khu Jesu’n asawldoh a, amaute thu apie a, “Jentelte lampi ah pei sih unlen, Samarite khopi sung ah zong lut vawt sih un.","title":"Sawm leh nite Jesu’n athuhilna (Mak. 6.8-13 ; Luk. 9.2-6 ; 12.2-10)"},"6":{"text":"Ahivang in Israel innkuon belam mangte kung ah peizaw un."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh na pei kawm un, vangam anaita chiin gen zel un."},"8":{"text":"Damloute sudam unlen, phahte siengthousah unlen, mishite kaithou unlen, dawite notdoh un, amanbeiin na mu ua, amanbei main pie un."},"9":{"text":"Na sum ip sung uah, sana, dangka leh sum-eng guong sih un."},"10":{"text":"Na khuolzinna uah thungpi ahiei, puonah ni ahiei, kengdap ahiei, ahisihleh chiengkhut ahiei, keng sih un, aziehpen nasem mi khu neh mutah ahi.","ref":"1 Kor. 9.14; 1 Tim. 5.18"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh khopi ahiei, khoneu ahiei, na lutna pou uah, na tunna ding taah uh mi kandoh unlen, na pawtdoh masangsie uh khunah tung khinkhian un."},"12":{"text":"Innsunga na lut chiengun chibai buh un."},"13":{"text":"Innsunga mite chibai buh taah ahi u’leh na tung ah hamuonna hing tung heh. Hinanleh atah sih uleh, na hamuonna uh na kung uah hing kilekia heh."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh koipou nou hing kipahpi lou a, na thute uh angai nuom sih uleh, tua inn ahiei akipat ahisihleh tuomi khuo ahiei akipat na pawtdoh chiengun, na kengphang ua leivui thingkhie un.","ref":"Nasep. 13.51"},"15":{"text":"Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, thukhen ni chiengin, tua khopi thuoh ding sangin, Sodom leh Gomorrah gam thuoh ding khu adan aum zaw ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 11.24; Siem. 19.24-28; Luk. 10.4-12"},"16":{"text":"“Ngai un, ngiete lah a belam bangin ka hing sawl ahi; tuaziehin gul bangin pil unlen, vakhu banga poikhoi louin um un.","ref":"Luk. 10.3"},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh mite lah ah kiveng un, aziehpen amaun vaihawmte ahing mansah ding ua, akikhopna innte uah noute ahing zep sah kha ding uhi.","ref":"Mak. 13.9-11; Luk. 12.11,12; 21.12-15"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Keima ziehin, gam uhpipate leh leengte masangah, amauleh Jentelte theipimi hi dingin ahing pui ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh ahing matsah chieng un, bangchi ding a, bang gen ding ka diei chiin lunggim sih un, na gen ding uh ahuntah a hing kihil ding na hi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Agenpa nouma na hisih ding ua, na Pa uh Hagau in nouma ah genzaw ding ahi zieh in."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh asang gampan thalup dingin asanggampa amansah ding a, tualeh pain zong atate, aman sah ding; tualeh tate’n zong nulepate adou ding ua, athatlum sah ding uhi.","ref":"Mak. 13.12; Luk. 21.16"},"22":{"text":"Ka min ziehin mi zousie muda na hi ding uh, hinanleh atawp dong a thuoh zou pouma hundam ahi ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 24.9; Mak. 13.13; Luk. 21.17; Mat. 24.13; Mak. 13.13"},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh tam khopi sunga nou ahing suhgenthei chiengun, khopi dangah tailut un. Chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, Mihing Tapa hing pei masangin, Israel khopi zousie na tuonsuoh sih ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"“Nuazui khat asiepa tungah a um ngai sih a, ahisihleh suoh khat apu tungah a um ngai sih hi.","ref":"Luk. 6.40; Jn. 13.16; 15.20"},"25":{"text":"Nuazui khat asiepa banga ahing um leh suohpa zong a pupa um banga aum khu ahunbep ahi. Amaun inntehpa bawn Beelzebub achi uleh a innkuonpite uh achi tham valeh masih ding uoi.","ref":"Mat. 9.34; 12.24; Mak. 3.22; Luk. 11.15"},"26":{"text":"“Tuaziehin amauh giing sih un. Aziehpen langlou dinga ki phuol bangma um sih a, theilou dinga im zong bangma a um sih hi.","ref":"Mak. 4.22; Luk. 8.17"},"27":{"text":"Miel lah a nou ka hing hil pouma, khovah ah gen unlen, na bil ua na zahte uh inntungvum ah kitangkoupi un."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh tahsa that thei a Hagau that theiloute giing sih un, hinanleh Hagau leh tahsa ani a gawtmun a sumang theipa Ama khu giing zaw un."},"29":{"text":"Vatou ni paisasan khat in akizua zel asiei mah? Ahivang in alah ua khat zong na Pa uh theilouin tuol ah akesih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Na lutung ua na samzamte zousie uh nangawn sim sieng ahita hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaziehin zau sih un, vatou tampi sangin na manphazaw uhi."},"32":{"text":"Koipou mite masang a hing hum pouma, ken zong van a ka pa mai ah, ama ka hum ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh koipou mite mai a, kei hing kilepsan pouma Ken zong van a ka Pa masang ah ka kilepsan ding hi.","ref":"2 Tim. 2.12"},"34":{"text":"“Leitunga lemna leengsah dinga hing peiin hing ngaisut sih un, lemna leengsah dinga hing pei ka hi sih a, namsau leengsah dinga hing pei ka hizaw hi."},"35":{"text":"Mi apa dousah dinga, tanuin anu dousah ding leh mouin a innpinu dousah ding a hing pei ka hi.","ref":"Mik. 7.6"},"36":{"text":"Tualeh mi amelma khu ama innkuonpite mama ahi ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Koipou apa ahiei, anu ahiei, kei sang a itzaw pouma ka mi hitah ahi sih; tualeh atapa ahiei, atanu ahiei, kei sang a it zaw khu ka mi hitah ahi sih hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh koipou a kros pua a hing zui lou khu ka mi hitah ahi sih hi.","ref":"Mat. 16.24; Mak. 8.34; Luk. 9.23"},"39":{"text":"Koipou ahinna muin ataan dinga, keima zieh a ahinna taan pouma in amu ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 16.25; Mak. 8.35; Luk. 9.24; 17.33; Jn. 12.25"},"40":{"text":"“Koipou noute hing kipahpi khu, Kei hing kipahpi ahi a, tualeh koipou kei hing kipahpi khu, Kei hing sawlpa kipahpi ahi.","ref":"Luk. 10.16; Jn. 13.20; Mak. 9.37; Luk. 9.48"},"41":{"text":"Koipou guolnei khu, guolnei ahizieh a kipahpi in guolnei kipahman amu ding hi. Tualeh koipou mi dihtat ahi zieh a kipahpi in midihtat kipahman amu ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh koipou tam mi neute lah a khat nuazui ahi zieha tuisih nou khat maimai pie zong, chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, akipahman uh ataan vawt sih ding uhi.”"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing ahi a, Jesu’n anuazui sawm leh nite thu apieh zou tahin, khuna kipat in khuote a thuhil ding leh thugen dingin apeita hi."},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Johan in suongkul sung a pat a Khrist nasepte ana zahtahin anuazuite ni asawl a,","title":"Baptispa Johan anuolna uh (Luk. 7.19-30)"},"3":{"text":"Akungah “Ahing pei dingpa na hiei mah, ahisihleh adangkhat ngah nalai ding ka hi uoi mah?” ava chi sah hi."},"4":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga akung uah, “Pei unlen, na sil zahte u’leh na mute uh Johan va hil un;"},"5":{"text":"Mittote mit in khuo amu theita ua, Kengbaite avah theita ua, phahte ahing siengthouta ua, bilbingte’n khuo aza theita ua, mishite kaithouin aumta ua, tualeh mizawngten zong khantanhoi kigen azata uhi.","ref":"Isai. 35.5,6; Isai. 61.1"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh koupou ka tung a lunghimawna mu lou khu a hampha ahi.”"},"7":{"text":"Amauh apei tahun Jesu’n mipite kungah Johan tungtang agen panta a, “Bang en dinga gamdai a vapeita na hi uoi? Pumpeng hui sem ling ahiei?"},"8":{"text":"Ahisihleh bang en ding a pawtdoh na hi uoi? puonnem sil mi khat i? Ngai un, puonnem silte khu leengpa innpi sungah aum uhi."},"9":{"text":"Ahisihleh bang en ding a pei doh na hi uoi? guolnei en dingin i? Ahi, ka hing hil ahi, guolnei sanga zong thupizaw ahi."},"10":{"text":"En vawi, ka thangkou na masang ah ka sawl a, Aman na masang ah na lampi asiel ding hi, chi a atanchin kigielpa khu ama ahi.","ref":"Mala. 3.1"},"11":{"text":"Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, numei sunga pieng lah ah Baptispa Johan sanga thupizaw apieng kha nai sih hi, ahivangin van gama mi neupen zong ama sangin athupi zaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Baptispa Johan um akipat tutan dongin van gam in thagum a kinawhna athuoh leng hi, tualeh thagum a nawhten apawng lah zel uhi.","ref":"Luk. 16.16"},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen zawlneite zousie leh dan thuin Johan hing um tandongin ana genlawhta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh nouten na pom nuom u’leh, ama khu ahing pei dingpa Elijah ma khu ahi.","ref":"Mala. 4.5; Mat. 17.10-13; Mak. 9.11-13"},"15":{"text":"Koipou zahna ding bil nei pouma in za heh!"},"16":{"text":"“Hinanleh tulai khangthate bang toh ka gente diei? Naupang vanzuona mun lah a tou a, alawmte uh han a,"},"17":{"text":"Theile hing tumpieh unga, na lam sih ua, noute hing kaapi ung a na hing dapi sih uhi; chite bang ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Johan ahing pei a, ane in a dawn sih a, dawilawm nei ahi, achi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Mihing tapa ahing pei a, ane in a dawn a, En vawi uo, ann haipa, zu haipa, siekhonte leh mikhielte lawmpa,” achi uhi. Hinanleh pilna khu anasepten siem atangsah hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n akisialou zieh un a sil thupi bawl tamna pen khopite aphawhta hi;","title":"Ginglou khopite tunggihna (Luk. 10.13-15)"},"21":{"text":"“Korazin na tung agih hi! Bethsaida na tung agih hi! Aziehpen noute lah a sil thupi kibawlte Tai-ar leh Sidon khopite a kibawl hitaleh, sai ip puon sil a, vut lah a kibuol in sawtlaipi in akisiata ding uhi.","ref":"Isai. 23.1-18; Ezek. 26.1—28.26; Joel. 3.4-8; Amos. 1.9,10; Zek. 9.2-4"},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hing hil ahi, thukhen ni chiengin noute thuoh ding sangin Tai-ar leh Sidon khopite thuoh ding khu, adan aum zaw ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh nang Kapernaum, van tana tawisanga um ding kisa na hiei? Mishi khuo tandonga puisuh a um ding na hi, aziehpen na sunga sil lamdang thupi kibawlte Sodom khuo a kibawl hileh tutan dongin a um nalai ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 14.13-15; Siem. 19.24-28"},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hing hil ahi, thukhen ni chienga noute thuoh ding sangin Sodom khuo in a thuoh ding khu adan aum zaw ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.15; Luk. 10.12"},"25":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin Jesu’n adawnga, “Aw, Pa van leh leitung Mangpa, nang mipil leh misiemte kungah tam thute na im a, naupangte kunga na phuon ziehin ka hing phat ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi, Pa tuabang bawl khu nangma ngaiin ahoi ahi, achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka Pa’n sil zousie ka kungah ahing kemsahta hi, Pa louin Koima’n Tapa athei sih uhi, Tapa leh akung ua a theisah ding, Tapa in akunga aphuon utnate chilou ngal in koima’n Pa athei sih hi.","title":"Jesu kunga hing pei dinga chielna","ref":"Jn. 3.35; Jn. 1.18; 10.15"},"28":{"text":"Nou semgim leh puohgih pote zousie ka kungah hing pei un, Keima’n khawldamna ka hing pe ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka hahkol puo unlen, ka kungah zil un, aziehpen kei khu zainemtah leh lungtanga kingaingiemtah ka hi; tuachi’n na hagau ua dingin khawldamna na mu ding uhi.","ref":"Jer. 6.16"},"30":{"text":"Aziehpen ka hahkol a nuoma, ka puoh zong a zang hi,” achi hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hunlaiin Jesu khu Khawlni in bulei lai kantan in apei a, anuazuite agil uh akiel a, buvuite asihtan ua, ane panta uhi.","title":"Khawlni tan thu a dohna (Mak. 2.23-28 ; Luk. 6.1-5)","ref":"Danp. 23.25"},"2":{"text":"Tua khu Pharisaiten amu tah un akungah, “En vawi, na nuazuiten khawlni a bawl sienglou abawl uhi,” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “David in agilkiel lai a alawmte toh bang ahiei abawl uh simkhalou na hi uoi amah?","ref":"1 Sam. 21.1-6"},"4":{"text":"Bangchidan a Pasian inn a aluta ama leh alawmten neh sienglou siempute maimai neh thei tanghou siengthou aneh uh ahiei?","ref":"Siempu. 24.9"},"5":{"text":"Ahisihleh Khawlni a Pasian biehinn a siempute’n khawlni asuhbua un zong siemtanlou in a um tuon sih chi dan thu simkhalou na hi uh amah?","ref":"Kisim. 28.9,10"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh tam mun ah Pasian biehinn sang a thupi zaw khat a um hi chi ka hing hil ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahivang in nouten kithoina hilou in zangaina ka dei hi, chi umdan na theita hi u’lachin mawna neilou khu siemlou tangsah lou ding hi ve u’chin.","ref":"Mat. 9.13; Hos. 6.6"},"8":{"text":"Mihing tapa khu khawlni Mangpa ahiziehin achita hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuana kipat in apei a, akikhopna inn uah aluta.","title":"Khawlni a khutzaw suh damna"},"10":{"text":"Ngai vawi, khunah mi khat khutzaw a um a, tualeh amawpai theina ding un, amaun “Khawlni a mi suhdam asieng ei? chiin Ama adong uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Na lah ua koi ahiei khat in belam khat nei henlen, khawlniin kokhuh ah keta leh koi ahiei vatu-a kaidoh lou ding?","ref":"Luk. 14.5"},"12":{"text":"Belam khat sanga mihing khat bang chituh a manpha zaw ahiei? Tuaziehin khawlni a nahoisep asieng hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua mipa kungah “Na khut zahdoh in,” achi a, tuachi’n azahdoh a, alangkhat bangin ahing damta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharisaite apawtdoh ua, Ama thalup theina ding kikum in akihou uhi.","title":"Jesu tha ding asawmna uh (Mak. 3.6-12 ; Luk. 6.11)"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh tuakhu Jesu’n atheitahin khuna pat in akihemmangta hi; tualeh mipi tampi in Ama azui ua, Aman ana damsah sieng hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Ama tanchin koima hillou dingin amauh thu apie hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua khu guolnei Isai in:"},"18":{"text":"“En vawi, ka suoh ka tel, Ka deitah, ka lungdamna mama ahi; Ka Hagau atungah ka koi ding a, tualeh Aman Jentelte kungah, dihtah a vaihawmna thu agen ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 42.1-4"},"19":{"text":"Aman akinielpi sih dinga, akikou sih ding hi, Koiman kholai dung ah, a aw aza sih ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Dihtah a vaihawmna aguolzawsah, masangsiein pumpeng gawpsa, ahiehtawng sih dinga, meivah detna gui zong asumit sih ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Ama min in Jentelten kinepna anei ding uh, chi a agen ahing tangtun theina dingin."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n dawimat, mitto leh hamtheilou khat Akungah ahing zawpi ua, Aman ana sudam a, tuachi’n mitto hamtheiloupa ahing ham thei a, amu theita hi.","title":"Pharisaiten hagau siengthou asuhminsietna uh (Mak. 3.22-27 ; Luk. 11.17-23)"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh mipite zousiein lamdang asa ua, “Tam mipa David Tapa hilou amah?” achi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Pharisaiten tam thu azah tahun, “Tam mipa’n dawimangpa Belzabub zieh loungal in dawite anotdoh sih ding,” achi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 9.34; 10.25"},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n angaituonate uh athei a, akung uah, “Leenggam chinteng akilangkhen a amaleh ama akidou leh amangthai lenga, tualeh khopi chinteng ahisihleh innsung chinteng akilangkhen a akidou uleh ading zou sih ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Setan in setan mama notdohta leh ama leh ama kidou ahi dinga, bangchi’n aleenggam adingta diei?"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh ken Belzabub zieh a dawite notdoh ka hileh, na tate un koi zieh a anawdoh uh ahiei? Tuaziehin amaute khu noute tunga vaihawm mite ahi ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh Ken Pasian Hagau vanga dawite notdoh ka hi leh, Pasian gam na kung ua hing tung ahita hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahisihleh mi’n mihat khu alepkaan masah sih leh bangchi’n a inn sunga lut in avante atommang pieh thei diei? Lepkaan masa in tua zou chiengin atommang pieh thei bep ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Kei lam a panglou pouma kei hing dou ahi a, koipou ahing khopkhawmpi lou pouma in athethang ahi.","ref":"Mak. 9.40"},"31":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ka hing hil ahi, mite akhelna chinteng u’leh Pasian agensietna chinteng uah ngaidam ahi dinga, hinanleh Hagau gensietna hilhiel pen ngaidam ahi sih ding hi.","title":"Ngaidam theilou khelna (Mak. 3.28 , 29)"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Koipou Mihing Tapa kala thugen khu ngaidam ahi dinga, hinanleh Hagau Siengthou kalna a thugen pouma, akalna uh khu tu khang leh khang hing um ding ah zong ngaidam ahi sih ding hi.","ref":"Luk. 12.10"},"33":{"text":"“Sing khu ahoi a, aga zong ahoi hi na chi loungal uleh, sing khu asie a, aga zong asie hi, chi vanglah un; aziehpen sing khu aga in akithei hi.","title":"Singkung leh aga","ref":"Mat. 7.20; Luk. 6.44"},"34":{"text":"Gul suonte aw, na gitlouna pum ua bangchia sil hoigen thei ding na hi uoi? Aziehpen lungtang a dimlet kam in agen zel hi.","ref":"Mat. 3.7; 23.33; Luk. 3.7; Mat. 15.18; Luk. 6.45"},"35":{"text":"Mi hoiin alungtang goubawm hoi akipat in sil hoi ahing ladoh a, tualeh migilou in agoubawm hoilou akipat in sil hoilou ahing ladoh zel hi."},"36":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hing hil ahi, miten thu ginalou agen pouma uh thukhen ni chiengin, azieh agen ding uhi."},"37":{"text":"Na thuin siem tansahin na um ding a, na thu main siemlou tansah in na um ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n laigielmite leh Pharisaite pawlkhat in adawng ua, “Siepa nang akipat in chiemtena ka mu nuom uhi,” achi uhi.","title":"Pharisaiten chiemtena angen uh (Luk. 11.24-26 , 29-32)","ref":"Mat. 16.1; Mak. 8.11; Luk. 11.16"},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman adawng a, akung uah, “Khang gilou leh angkawm hatten chiemtena asui ua, hinanleh guolnei Jonah chiemtena loungal akung uah pieh ahi sih ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 16.4; Mak. 8.12"},"40":{"text":"Jonah sun thum leh zan thum ngapi gilsunga, a um mabangin, Mihing Tapa zong sun thum leh zan thum leigil sung ah a um ding hi.","ref":"Jon. 1.17"},"41":{"text":"Nineveh khuo a mite khu thukhenna ah tulai khangthate toh ading ding ua, a mawpai ding uhi, amaute Jonah thugen zieh in akisia pai ua, En vawi un, Jonah sanga thupizaw tanah a um hi.","ref":"Jon. 3.5"},"42":{"text":"Simlam leengnu khu thukhen ni chiengin, tulai khangthate toh athou khawm ding ua, amawpai ding hi, Solomon pilna ngaikhe dingin bawn kawlmong apat ahing pei ngap hi, tualeh en un Solomon sanga thupi zaw tanah a um hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 10.1-10; 2 Khang. 9.1-12"},"43":{"text":"“Dawibua khu mipa akipat apawtdoh tahin, khawlna ding suiin tui um louna mun lah ah avah kawikawi a, amu zou sih hi.","title":"Kisiemthana bukimlou zauhuoina"},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka pawtdohna inn ma ah lutkia mai vang achi hi. Tualeh ahing peikia tahin tua khu ana awnga, suhsiengsa leh kikem hoi in amu hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n ava pei a, ama sanga gilou zaw dawi dang sagi ahing zawpi a, khunah alut ua, atengta uhi; tuachi’n tua mipa umdan nukhia lam khu amasa sangin ase zaw semsemta hi. Tulai khangtha giloute tung ah zong tuabangin a um ding hi,” achi hi."},"46":{"text":"Mipite kunga thu agen lai in, En vawi, Anu leh asanggamten Ama houpi nuom in inn pulam ah Ama ngah in ading uhi.","title":"Jesu leh a unau dihtahte (Mak. 3.31-35)"},"47":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi khat in akung ah, “En vawi, na nu leh na sanggamte Nang hing houpi nuom in inn pulam ah ading uhi, achi hi."},"48":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman adawnga, Ama hilpa kungah, “Ka nu koi ahiei? Tualeh Ka sanggamte zong koite ahi uoi?” achi hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n a nuazuite lam ah akhut azah a, En un, “Tanah Ka nu leh ka sanggamte a um uhi!"},"50":{"text":"Koi hinanleh van a um ka Pa deilam bawl pouma Ka sanggampa, ka sanggamnu leh ka nu ahi uhi,” achita hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni main Jesu khu inn apat in apeidoh a, tuipi pieu ah atouta hi.","title":"Buchithepa gentena thu (Mak. 4.1-20 ;
