Luk. 8.4-15)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh akungah mipi tampi ahing kikhawm ua, tuachi’n Ama kuong khat ah alut a, atouta hi, tualeh mipi zousie luipieu ah ading uhi.","ref":"Luk. 5.1-3"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, gentenain thu tampi agen a, Ngai vawi un, “Buchithepa khat buchithe dingin akuon a;"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh athe laiin kimkhatte lamgei ah akie a, vate ahing pei ua, atom beita uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kimkhatte suongsilei lah ah akie a, lei asalou ziehin ahing pou pai a;"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh ni ahing suoh in a emvuoi a, thahui aneilou ziehin avuoi paita hi."},"7":{"text":"Kimkhatte loulingnei lah ah a kie a, lingte ahing khang lien a, adepmangta hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh adangte lei hoi ah akie a, Kimkhatte ale za bangin, kimkhatte ale sawmguh bangin, kimkhatte ale sawmthum bangin ahing gata hi."},"9":{"text":"Koipou zahna ding bil nei pouma in za heh,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n nuazuite ahing pei ua, akungah, “Bangdinga akung ua gentena thu nagen ahiei?” achi uhi.","title":"Gentena thu kigenna zieh"},"11":{"text":"Aman adawnga akung uah, “Aziehpen vangam thuguh khu noute thei ding phal ahia, hinanleh amaute thei ding pen phal ahi sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Koipou aneite pieh be ahi dinga, ahau semsem ding, hinanleh koipou aneilou khu, anei sun zong lahpieh ahi ding.","ref":"Mat. 25.29; Mak. 4.25; Luk. 8.18; 19.26"},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin akung uah gentena in thu ka gen ahi, aziehpen amauten mu napiin amu sih ua, tualeh za napiin aza sih ua, thei zong atheisiem sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Isai in ana genlawh khu atung uah ahing tangtungta hi: Zahpen na za ding ua, na theisiem sih ding uhi; Mu pen na mu ding ua, na theichien but sih ding uhi.","ref":"Isai. 6.9,10"},"15":{"text":"Azieh tam mite lungtang amawlgawpta a, abil uh abingta a, a mitte uh asingta uhi, tuachilouin amit un amu kha ding ua, abil un aza kha ding ua, tualeh alungtang un athei kha ding ua, ahing kinuahei kia kha ding ua, Ken amauh ka na sudam kha ding hi, chi a ana gen khu."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh noute mit vang amu ziehin ahampha hi, na bil uh zong azah zieh in ahampha hi.","ref":"Luk. 10.23,24"},"17":{"text":"Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, guolnei tampi leh midihtat tampiin zong na sil mute uh mu aut ua, ahivangin amu sih uhi, tualeh na sil zahte uh zong aza nuom ua, hinanleh aza sih uhi."},"18":{"text":"“Tuaziehin buchithepa gentena thu za un.","title":"Buchithepa gentena hilchienna"},"19":{"text":"Koipouin leenggam thu azah a, atheisiem sih leh, migiloupa khat ahing pei a, alungtanga thesa khu alahmang pieh zel hi. Tua khu lam gei a thepa ahi."},"20":{"text":"Suongsilei lah a kithete khu, thu za a, kipahtah a pom pai bang ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahivang in ama a thahui anei lou ziehin tomnou khat sung a um a; thu ziehin gimthuohna ahiei, gawtna ahiei, ahing um chiengin apua pai zel uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh loulingnei lah a the pen, thu khu za a hinanleh leitung awlmawnate leh hausatna solnain thu khu adep a, tuachi’n ama khu ga nei louin a umta hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh lei hoi tunga the pen, thu khu za a theisiem mi ahi; tua khu ga zong aga a, kimkhatte aleza bang, kimkhatte ale sawmguh bang, kimkhatte ale sawmthum bang in apung uhi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Gentena dang akung uah agen kia a, “Van gam khu, mi alou a haichi hoi thepa toh gente ahi.","title":"Bulemte gentena"},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh mite a imut kaal un amelmapa ahing pei a, bu lah ah bulem athe a, apeimangta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n bu khu ahing pou a, ahing vui a, tuachi’n bulemte zong ahing kilangta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n inn neipa suohte ahing pei ua, akung ah, Pu na lou a chi hoi the hilou na hiei mah? bulemte hei akipat a hing um ahi uoi? achi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Aman akung uah, melma khat in abawl ahi, achi hi. Asuohten a kungah, ahileh koute va peiin tuate va lakhawm u’leeng hoi na sa ei? achi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman hoisa lou e, bulemte na lahkhawmna lam uah, butahte zong na botkhawm kha ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Bu lah dongin poukhawm u’heh, tualeh bu at hun chiengin, bu atte kungah, bulemte lakhawm masa phot unlen, mei a hal dingin alom lom in kaan un; hinanleh bute pen ka bupang sungah koilut un, ka china ding hi,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Gente thu dang akung uah agenkia a, “Van gam khu ankam tang khat mi’n alaah a, alou a athe bang ahi;","title":"Ankamtang gentena (Mak. 4.30-32 ; Luk. 13.18 , 19)"},"32":{"text":"tua khu, haichi lah a neupen ahi a, hinanleh ahing khanlet chiengin, hampate sangin ahing lienzaw a, singkung ahing hita hi; tuachi’n tungleeng vate ahing pei ua, abazamte ah ahing gieh uhi,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Gentena dang khat akung uah agen kia a, “Vangam khu numei khat in tol alaah a, tangbuong tena thum lah a abawn a ajelsuoh masangsie a, aphum bang ahi,” achi hi.","title":"Tol gentena"},"34":{"text":"Tam silte zousie Jesu’n gentena thuin mipite kungah agen a, gente thu louin akung uah bangma agen sih hi."},"35":{"text":"Guolnei in, “Gentena in ka kam ka kaah ding a, Leitung siemchil a kipat sil aguh a, kiphuol khu ka gendoh ding hi, achi khu ahing tangtunna dingin.”","ref":"Late. 78.2"},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n mipite asawlmanga, innsungah alut a; tuachi’n nuazuite akungah ahing pei ua, “Lou a bulem gentena thu hing hilchien in” achi uhi.","title":"Bulem gente thu hilchienna"},"37":{"text":"Aman adawnga, akung uah, “Tua haichi hoi thepa khu Mihing tapa ahi a,"},"38":{"text":"Lou khu Leitung ahi, haichi hoite khu, leenggam tate ahi ua, tualeh bulemte khu migilou tate ahi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Melma athepa khu Diabol ahi a, bu lah hun khu leitung tawpna ding ahi, a atte khu vansawlsiengte ahi uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuazieh in bulemte khu akhopkhawm ua, mei a ahal bangun, leitung tawp hun chiengin a um ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Mihing Tapa in vansawlsiengte asawldoh ding a, aleenggam akipat in khelnabawlsahte leh silgilou bawl zousie akhawm khawm ding ua,"},"42":{"text":"tualeh meilipi sungah apailut ding ua, khunah ka leh hagawtna a um ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin midihtatte khu a Pa uh gam ah, ni bangin ataang ding uhi. Koipou zahna ding bil neiin za heh."},"44":{"text":"“Van gam khu lou lai a gou kiphuol bang ahi, tua khu mi khat in amu a, aphuoldap a, akipah ziehin, lungnuom tahin apei a, anei zousie azua a, tua lou khu aleita hi.","title":"Suongmanpha gou leh lenpi gentena"},"45":{"text":"“Tualeh van gam khu summetbawl mi suongmanpha hoitah sui bang ahi kia hi."},"46":{"text":"Aman suongmanpha mantamtah khat amu a, apei a, anei zousie azua a aleita hi."},"47":{"text":"“Vangam khu lenpi tuipi a sepluta nga namkim huoikhawm bang ahi kia hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua khu adimtahin pieugei ah akaikhie ua, atou ua, ahoite khu bawm sungah aguong ua, ahoiloute pen apaimang uhi."},"49":{"text":"Leitung bei chiengin tuabangin a um ding hi. Vansawlsiengte ahing pawtdoh ding ua, migiloute khu midihtatte lah akipat akhenkhe ding ua;"},"50":{"text":"Haltuina meilipi ah amaute apai ding uhi, khunah ka leh hagawtna a um ding, achi hi."},"51":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Tam silte zousie na theisiem na uoi?” achi hi. Amaun akungah “Ing” Mangpa, achi uhi."},"52":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Tuaziehin laigielmi vangam thu a hil a um pouma khu, inn neipa agoubawm akipata sil lui leh sil tha pholdohpa bang ahi,” achi hi."},"53":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Jesu’n tam gentena thute agen zouin, khuna pat in apeidohta hi."},"54":{"text":"Tualeh Ama a umna gam lam a ahing tun tahin, akikhopna inn uah amauh thu ahil a, tuachi’n amauten lamdang asa mama ua; “Tam mipa’n tambang pilna leh sil thupi bawltheina hei akipat a amu ahiei? achi uhi.","title":"Nazareth ah Jesu anuol uh"},"55":{"text":"Tam Mipa, sing bawlsiempa tapa hi ngel lou amah? Anu Mari kichinu hilou ahiei mah? Tualeh asanggamte khu Jakob, Joseph, Simon, leh Judas hilou ahi uoi mah?"},"56":{"text":"Tualeh asanggam numeite zong ikung ua um hilou uh i? Tua ahileh tam Mipa’n tam silte zousie hei akipata amu ahiei?” achi uhi."},"57":{"text":"Tuachi’n atungah, alunghimawta uhi. Hinanleh Jesu’n akung uah, “Guolnei ama gam sung leh ama inn sung loungal ah, pahtawi louin a um ngai sih hi,” achita hi.","ref":"Jn. 4.44"},"58":{"text":"Tualeh agintatlou zieh un, Aman khunah sil thupi tampi abawlta sih hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hunlai in leengpa Herod in Jesu thu kithang ana zata hi.","title":"Baptispa Johan shina (Mak. 6.14-29 ; Luk. 9.7-9)"},"2":{"text":"Asuohte kungah, “Tam pen Baptispa Johan ahi ve, ama pen mishi lah akipat a thoudoh kia ata ve maw; tuaziehin silbawltheinate’n ama ah nna sem ahita ve,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Herod in asanggampa Philip zi Herodia zieh in Johan aman a, alepkaan a, suongkul ah akhumta hi.","ref":"Luk. 3.19,20"},"4":{"text":"Johan in akungah “Amanu na kitenpi asieng sih hi achi zieh ahi.”","ref":"Siempu. 18.16; 20.21"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh aman Johan that ut nanleh mipite agiing a, amaun Johan khu guolnei khat a angai zieh un."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Herod pien ni ahing tun in, Herodia tanu khu amasang uah alam a, Herod alungdamsahta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin amanu’n anget pouma pe dingin kihahsiel in thu achiemta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu’n anu thusawl in, “Baptispa Johan lutang kuong khat in tanah hing pie in,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa khu alunggimta a, hinanleh akihahsielna leh a annkuong impite ziehin, pieh ding in thu apeta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi asawl a, suongkul sunga um Johan lu ava tansahta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh alutang khu kuongin ahing tawi ua, naupangnu apie ua, tualeh amanu’n anu kungah ahing tawita hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n anuazuite ahing pei ua, aluong ahing la ua, avui ua, tualeh Jesu ava hilta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Jesu’n tua thu azahtah in, khuna pat in, kuong a kitawlin gamgaw lam ah Amatangin apeita hi. Hinanleh mipiten azahtahun, khopite akipat in akeng ua peiin azuita uhi.","title":"Mipi tulnga vahna"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu ahing pei khiet leh mipi tampi a muta a, alainat sengseng a, adamloute uh asuhdampieh hi."},"15":{"text":"Nitahlam ahing hitahin, anuazuite akungah ahing pei ua, “Tam mun gamgaw ahi a, tualeh ni lah avaigeita a, khuote a pei a aneh ding uh a lei theina dingun mipite sawldoh tain” achi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n akung uah, “Apeimang uh angai sih, nouman neh ding pie un,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akung ah, “Tanah tanghou pheng nga leh nga ni beh i nei uhi,” achi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Aman tanah ka kungah “Hing tawi un,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite loupa tunga tou dingin thu apie a, tanghou pheng nga leh nga ni khu ala a, vanlam en in aguolzawl a, aphalsuo a, tanghoute khu anuazuite kungah apie a, tuachi’n nuazuiten mipite kungah ape sawnta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n abawn un ane ua, agilva chietta ua, anehval nengte uh akhopkhawm u’leh seu sawm leh ni adim nalai hi."},"21":{"text":"Anete khu numei leh naupang simlouin piching ngen tul nga vel ahi uh."},"22":{"text":"Jesu’n mipite asawlmang kaala Ama masanga na pei masa a, gal langkhat a na kai masa dingin; anuazuite kuongah kintah in atuongsah hi.","title":"Jesu tuipi tunga kenga avahna (Mak. 6.45-52 ; Jn. 6.14-21)"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh mipite asawlmang zou tahin, Ama tanga thungen dingin muol ah akaltou hi. Tualeh nitahlam ahing hitah in, khunah amatangin a umta hi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh kuong pen tuipi laikimtah ah a um a, huipi in ale nawh zieh in tuihuol in aseep kawikawita hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh zanlai khovah kuon lam in, Jesu amauh lam zuon in tuipi tungah akengin ahing pei hi."},"26":{"text":"Nuazuiten Ama tuipi tunga kenga hing pei amu tah un, “Shiha hiva” chiin abuoita ua, zauin akikouta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh kintahin Jesu’n amauh ahing houpi a, “Lungmuongtahin um un, Keima ka hi, zau sih un,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Peter in adawng a, “Mangpa Nangma ngel na hileh tui tunga nangma kunga hing pei dingin thu hing pie in,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman “Hing pei in” achi hi. Tuachi’n Peter kuong a pat in akumsuh a, Jesu kunga pei dingin tui tungah kengin apeita hi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh huipi hattah amu tahin, azau a, tum dingin akisa a, “Mangpa hing hundam in” chiin akikouta hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n thakhat in a zam pai a aman, akungah “Nang ginna tawmpa, bang ding a ginglel na hiei?” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh kuong sunga amauh atuontah un, huipi asipta hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n kuong sunga umte’n “Nangpen Pasian Tapa tahtah na hina hi achi ua,” abeta uhi."},"34":{"text":"Gallang khat agalkai tahun, Gennesaret gam ahing tungta uhi."},"35":{"text":"Khum muna miten Ama atheitah un, tua kim a gam chinteng ah mi asawl ua, damlou zousie akungah ahing pui ua,"},"36":{"text":"tualeh apuon mong beh tham thei dingin angen ua, tuachi’n athamkha pouma adam zel uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem khuo a um laigielmite leh Pharisaite Jesu kungah ahing pei ua,","title":"Pulepate thugousie angaisah sih chia demna Jesu’n adawnna"},"2":{"text":"“Bangdinga na nuazuite’n upate thugousie palsana takhiel zing uh ahiei? a ann neh ding chieng un akhut uh asil ngai sih uhi,” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman adawnga akung uah, “Bangzieh a nouten zong, na thugousie zieh ua, Pasian thupieh palsana takhiel na hi uoi?"},"4":{"text":"Pasian in na nu leh na pa zatat in, koipou anu ahiei a pa ahiei, gausap pouma shi sah ngeingei ding chi ahi thuoi a, achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.12; Danp. 5.16; Pawt. 21.17; Siempu. 20.9"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten koipou anu ahiei apa ahiei kunga, kei kunga kipat a phattuomna na mu ding pouma Pasian kunga pieh ahita, chi pouma in,"},"6":{"text":"a nu leh apa azatat ding ahi sih na chi uhi. Tambangin, na thugousie zieh un, Pasian thupieh bangmalou na suohsahta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Nou milepchiete aw, Isai in na tungtang thu uh ana genlawh adih mama hi!"},"8":{"text":"Tam miten akam un ahing nai ua, akam un ahing zatat uhi; Hinanleh alungtang un ahing gamlat uhi.","ref":"Isai. 29.13"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh athuhilna uah mihing thupieh akihil zieh un, Kei ahing bieh uh amawhna ahibou hi, ana chi khu,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman mipite ahan a, akung uah “Ngai unlen theisiem un."},"11":{"text":"Kam a lut in asubua sih a, Kam apawtin, tuami ngei in mi asubua hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n anuazuite ahing pei ua, akungah, “Pharisaiten tam thu azah ua alungkimlou dan uh na thei ei?” achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman adawnga akung uah, “Singkung chinteng, van a um ka Pa suonlou khu phungkal in a um ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute awlmaw sih un, amaute khu mitto lamkaite ahi uh. Mittaw in mitto apui leh ani un kokhuh ah akekhawm ding uhi,” chi’n adawnghi.","ref":"Luk. 6.39"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in adawnga akungah, “Tam gentena thu koute hing hilchien in,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n, “Noute zong tutan dong theisiem lou a um nalai na ve uoh maw? achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Kam sunga lut zousie gilpi ah atungsuh a, dailenna ah paidoh in a um chi na theisiem nai sih uh amah?"},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Kam a pawtte pen lungtanga kipat a hing pawt ahia, tuaten mi abuasah hi.","ref":"Mat. 12.34"},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen lungtang akipat in ngaituona giloute, tuolthanate, angkawmnate, numei leh pasal kaal a mawnate, guhtatnate, theipitu dihlou a pannate leh mi gensietnate ahing piengdoh zel hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam silte khu ahi mihing buasah, hinanleh khut sil lou a ann neh in mi asubua sih hi, achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n khuna kipat in Jesu apawtdoh a Tai-ar leh Sidon gam lam ah apeita hi.","title":"Jentel numei tanu suhdamna (Mak. 7.24-30)"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai vawi, tua gam akipat in Kanaan numei khat ahing pei a, “Aw Mangpa David Tapa Kei hing khotuo in, ka tanu dawimatin agim mama hi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman kamteng khat in zong adawng sih hi. Tualeh anuazuite ahing pei ua, akungah, “Amanu sawlmangin, inua ah akikou kou mai hi,” chiin angen uhi."},"24":{"text":"Aman adawng a, Israel innkuonte lah a belam mangte kung loungal ah sawl ka hi sih, achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu ahing pei a, “Mangpa hing panpi in chi’n Ama abeta hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman adawnga, “Tate tanghou lahpieh a, ui noute kunga pieh akilawm sih hi achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n, “Mangpa ahivang ahina hi, hinanleh uiten zong apu uh dawkan akipat a tanghou neng kete ane zel sam uhi, achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawnga, amanu kungah, “Numei aw, na ginna thupi hina va-ia e, na lunggul bang tahin na tungah umta heh,’” achi hi. Tuachi’n atanu khu tua hun mama in adamta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu khuna pat in apei a Galili tuipi gei ah ahing tunga, tualeh muol ah apei tou a, khunah atouta hi.","title":"Jesu’n mi tampi adamsahna (Mak. 7.31-37)"},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi tampi, kengbaite, mittote, hamtheiloute, piengkhielte, leh natna dang neite hing pui in, Jesu kengbul ah alumsah ua, Aman ana sudam zel hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachia hamtheiloute ahing ham ua, piengkhielte ahing hoi ua, kengbaite kenga hing peitheita, mittoten khuo amu theita uh, chi mipiten amu tah un, lamdang asata ua, tuachi’n Israelte Pasian apahtawita uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n anuazuite akungah ahan a, mipite tuin ka kungah ni thum a umta ua, neh ding bangma aneilou zieh un, ka hepi mama hi. Tualeh amauh ann ngawl in ka peisah nuom sih hi, dachiengin lamkaal ah basam khava uh, achi hi.","title":"Mipi sangli vahna (Mak. 8.1-10)"},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n anuazuiten akungah, “Mipi hichiza a tam gilvana tham ching tanghou gamdai ah, hei apat imu diei?” achi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Tanghou pheng bangza na nei uoi? achi a; tuachi’n amaun, pheng sagi leh nga neu tawmnou khat, achi uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman mipite tuol a tou dingin thu apie hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh tanghou pheng sagi leh nga ala a, kipah thu agen a, aphal suo a, nuazuite kungah apie a, tualeh nuazuiten mipite kungah apie uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n abawn un ane ua agilva chietta uhi; tualeh aneh val neng uh akhop uleh seu sagi adim nalai hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh anete pen numei leh naupang simlou in piching ngen tulli ahi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite asawlmang a, kuong sungah atuong a Magdala gam lam ah atungta hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharisaite leh Saddukaite ahing pei ua, Ama ze etna dingin van akipat chiemtena amauh ensah dingin angen uhi.","title":"Chiemtena ngetna Jesu’n penuomlou (Mak. 8.11 , 12)","ref":"Mat. 12.38; Luk. 11.16"},"2":{"text":"Aman adawnga akung uah, “Nitahlam chiengin khuo apha ding hiva, mei san asuoh na chi zel uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh zingmawng chiengin, Tuni khuo ase ding hiva, mei san a suoha angiemkai hi, na chi thei zel uhi. Nou milepchiete aw, van umdan na theisiem ua, hinanleh hun chiemtena na thei siem sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Khangtha gilou leh angkawm hatte’n chiemtena asui ua, hinanleh guolnei Jonah chiemtena loungal akung uah chiemtena dang pieh ahi sih ding, achi hi. Tualeh amauh anuasie a, apeita hi.","ref":"Mat. 12.39; Luk. 11.29"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh anuazuite gallang khat atun un, tanghou apo manghil uhi.","title":"Pharisaite leh Saddukaite tol (Mak. 8.13-21)"},"6":{"text":"“Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite tol lah ah kiveng unlen, pilvang un” achi hi.","ref":"Luk. 12.1"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh amaun “Tanghou ipuoh lou zieh ave maw,” chiin akingai sut uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jesu’n tuakhu atheidoh tahin akung uah, “Nou ginna tawmte aw, tanghou na puohlou zieh ua bang ding a kingaituo na hi uoi?"},"9":{"text":"Tu nangawn a na lungsim ua thei nailou na lailai na hi uoi mah? Mi tulnga, vahna tanghou pheng nga leh na seupi dimsah za uh, na thei zing sih uh amah?","ref":"Mat. 14.17-21"},"10":{"text":"Mi tulli, vahna tanghou pheng sagi leh na seupi dim zat uzong?","ref":"Mat. 15.34-38"},"11":{"text":"Tanghou thu na kung ua gen ka hi sih a, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite tol lah ah kiveng un, chia gen ka hizaw chi bang ding a theisiemlou na hi uoi?” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuabepin amaun tanghou tol lah a kiveng ding a thuhil hilou in, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite thuhilna lah ah pilvang dingin amauh athuhil ahizaw chi atheita uhi."},"13":{"text":"Jesu Kaisaria Philippi gam ahing tun tahin Anuazuite Kungah, “Mite’n Kei Mihing Tapa khu koi ahi achi uoi?” chi’n adong hi.","title":"Peter in Jesu Khrist ahi chi a aphuonna (Mak. 8.27-30 ; Luk. 9.18-21)"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun, “Kimkhat in Baptispa Johan ahi ahing chi ua, Kimkhat in Elijah ahi achi ua, tualeh adangten Jeremiah, ahisihleh guolneite lah a khat ahi, ahing chi uhi,” achi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 14.1,2; Mak. 6.14,15; Luk. 9.7,8"},"15":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Ahileh nouten kei koi ahi na hing chi uoi?” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Simon Peter in adawng a, “Khrist Pasian hing Tapa khu na hi,” a chi hi.","ref":"Jn. 6.68,69"},"17":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga akungah, “Simon Bar-Jonah na hampha hi, tahsa leh sisan in ahing theisah na hi sih a, Ka Pa van a um in ahing theisah na hi zaw hi.”"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Ken zong na kungah, Nang Peter na hi, chi ka hing hil ahi, tualeh tami suongpi tungah ka hattuom ka lam dinga, mishi khuo kul kotkhaten tuami azouthaw sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Ken vangam chabite nang ka hing pe dinga, leitunga na kaan pouma van ah zong kaan ahi dinga, tualeh leitunga na sutkhieh pouma van ah zong sutkhieh ahi ding,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 18.18; Jn. 20.23"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama khu Jesu Khrist ahi chi koima hillou dingin anuazuite khautah in thu apie hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hun akipat in Jesu’n Jerusalem ah apei dinga, upate, siempu liente, leh laigiel mite, lah a sil tampi athuoh dingte leh tha a a um dingdan leh, ni thum ni a athawkia ding dante, anuazuite atheisah panta hi.","title":"Jesu’n a shina ding leh athawkiana ding thu agen lawhna (Mak. 8.31—9.1 ; Luk. 9.22-27)"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in Ama apuituom a, Pasian in phalsih heh, “Mangpa! Tambang na tungah tung ngai sih heh,” chi’n aphawhhilta hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama akihei a, Peter kungah, “Setan ka nua ah pei in, Kei a dingin kipalpuana na hi, Pasian silte ngaituo louin, mihing silte na ngaituo zaw zieh ahi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n anuazuite kungah, “Mi koipouin ahing zui ut leh ama gimthuoh khawhsa louin, a kros puo in hing zui heh.","title":"Jesu nuazui dan ding (Mak. 34-37; Luk. 9.23-25)","ref":"Mat. 10.38; Luk. 14.27"},"25":{"text":"Koipou ahinna humbit ut in ataan dinga, tualeh Koipou keima zieh a ahinna tan in amu ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.39; Luk. 17.33; Jn. 12.25"},"26":{"text":"Mi khat in leitung pumpi nei henlen, ahinna taan taleh ama adingin bang aphatuom diei? Ahisihleh min ahinna taangin bang ahiei apieh ding?"},"27":{"text":"Mihing Tapa khu vansawlsiengte toh a Pa thupina a kizemin ahing pei ding zieh in, tua hun chiengin michin anasep dungzui un nuomman ape chiet ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 25.31; Late. 62.12; Rom. 2.6"},"28":{"text":"Chitahtahin ka hinghil ahi, Tana dingte lawikhat Mihing Tapa aleenggam a hing pei amu masangsie uh, shina chiem vawtlou ding a um uhi,” achi hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh ni guh nua in Jesu’n Peter, Jakob leh asanggampa Johan atuom in muol sangtung khat ah azawpi touta hi,","title":"Mel lamdanna (Mak. 9.2-13 ; Luk. 9.2-36 ; 2 Pet. 1.17 , 18)"},"2":{"text":"Amasang uah amel ahing kiheng lamdangta hi. Amai ni bangin ahing taangta a, apuonsilte vah bangin ahing vamta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh En vawi, Mosi leh Elijah akung ua hing kilah in Ama toh akihou uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in Jesu ahoupi a, akungah, “Mangpa ei a dingin tana um ahoi hi, pha na sah leh tanah bawhinn thum bawl vai in, Nanga dingin khat, Mosi adingin khat tualeh Elijah ading in khat achi hi.”"},"5":{"text":"Agen lai zingin, En vawi, meilum vah tahin amauh ahing lieta a, tualeh Ngai vawi, thakhat in meilum lah akipat in aw khat in, “Tami ka Tapa ittah, ka lungdamna mama ahi. Ama thu ngai un,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 22.2; Late. 2.7; Isai. 42.1; Mat. 3.17; 12.18; Mak. 1.11; Luk. 3.22; Danp. 18.15  ;     \n        2 Pet. 1.17,18"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh nuazuite’n tami azahtah un bohkhup in apua ua, azau mama uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu ahing pei a, amauh akhoi a “Thou unlen zau sih un,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh adahdoh uleh, Jesu chilou koima amu sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Muol a kipat ahing kumsuh un, Jesu’n amauh thu apie a, “Mihing Tapa mishi lah akipat a thawkia masangsie, tam na sil mu uh koima kungah hil sih un,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tualeh Anuazuiten tua ahileh bang dinga laigielmiten Elijah hing pei masa ding achi uh ahiei?” Chiin adongta uhi.","ref":"Mala. 4.5"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawnga akung uah, “Elijah hing pei masa ding mawng ahi, sil bangkim asiempha ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hing hil ahi, Elijah pen ahing pei zou thamta hi, ama athei sih ua, atung ah a ut ut un abawl zouta uhi. Tuamabangin Mihing Tapa in zong akhutlum uh athuoh ding hi, chiin adawng hi.”","ref":"Mat. 11.14"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n nuazuiten Baptispa Johan thu akung uah agen ahi chi ahing theita uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh mipi lah ahing tuntah un, mi khat akungah ahing pei a, amasang a khupdin in,","title":"Pasal naupang dawimat Jesu’n a suhdamna (Mak. 9.14-29 ; Luk. 9.37-42)"},"15":{"text":"“Mangpa ka tapa hing khotuo piehin, shibup vei ahi a, agim thei mama hi, tam veipi mei ah apua lut a, tam veipi tui ah zong apua zel hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh na nuazuite kungah ka hing pui a asudam thei sih uhi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawnga, “Khangtha ginnabei leh chimawte aw, bangtan vei ahiei na kung ua ka um ding, ama khu ka kung ah hing pui un,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n dawi aphawh a, asunga kipat in apawtta a, tualeh naupang khu tua huntahin adamta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuazouin nuazuite akungah, atuom in ahing pei ua, “Bangdinga kouten notdoh theilou ka hi uoi?” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Na gintatlou zieh uh ahi, chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, ankam tang khat chie ginna na nei uleh, tami muol kung ah, Tana kipat in khunah kisuon in na chi ding ua, akisuon mai ding hi, tualeh nou a ding in bangma bawlmaw a um sih ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 21.21; Mak. 11.23; 1 Kor. 13.2"},"21":{"text":"“Bangtenghitaleh, tambang pen thumna leh anngawlna loungal in apawtdoh sih hi achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Galili gam a aum lai un, Jesu’n akung uah, “Mihing Tapa pen mihingte khuta matsahin a um ding a,","title":"Jesu’n a shina ding agen kiana (Mak. 9.30-32 ; Luk. 9.43-45)"},"23":{"text":"tualeh Ama athat ding ua, tualeh ani thum ni in kaithouin a um ding,” achi hi. Tuachi’n alunggim mama uhi."},"24":{"text":"Kapernaum ahing tun tahun Pasian biehinn a sie dongte Peter kungah ahing pei ua, “Na siepa un biehinn sie pe zel samlou ahiei mah?” achi uhi.","title":"Jesu leh Peter in sie apiehna uh","ref":"Pawt. 30.13; 38.26"},"25":{"text":"Aman “Pie e,” achi hi. Tualeh peter inn sunga ava lut tahin, Jesu’n ama ahoupi masa a, “Simon nang bang nachi ngai ei? Leitunga leengten sie leh sum leiman koite lah akipat ala zel uoi? Atate u’lah ah ahiei, ahisihleh mi dangte lah ah?” chiin ana gen khal hi."},"26":{"text":"Peter in akungah, “Mi dangte lah ah,” achi hi. Jesu’n akungah, “Tuachi ahileh tate awl a ve maw, achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahivang in amaute lung himawhsah da vai, tuipi ah va pei inlen, ngakuoi va kam inlen, nga hing pei masa pen man inlen, akam keh lachin dangka khat na mu ding a, tuakhu la inlen Kei leh nang a dingin akung uah pie in, tuachilou in vang isulungkim sih kha ding,” achi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitah in nuazuite Jesu kungah ahing pei ua, “Van gam ah koi alienpen diei?” Achi uhi.","title":"Van gam ah koi alien pen diei (Mak. 9.33-37 ; Luk. 9.33-37 ; Luk. 9.46-48)","ref":"Luk. 22.24"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n naupang neu khat akungah ahan a, alah uah ading sah a,"},"3":{"text":"“Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, Na kikhel ua, naupang neute bang na hisih u’leh van gam ah na lut vawt sih ding uhi.","ref":"Mak. 10.15; Luk. 18.17"},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin koipou tam naupang neu banga kingaingiem mi khu, van gam ah alienpen ding hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tualeh koipou ka min zieh a tambang naupang neu nou khat kipahpi khu, Keima hing kipahpi ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh tam Keima hing gingta neu noute lah a khat zong kipalpuasah pouma angawng uah bu hehna suongsum ki awsah henlen tuipi thutah ah kipailut leh ama a dingin ahoizaw ding hi.","title":"Midangte dallou ding (Mak. 9.42-48)"},"7":{"text":"“Puanate ziehin leitung atung agih hi, Puanate hing um ding mawng ahi a, hinanleh puana umsahpa tung agih hi."},"8":{"text":"Na khut ahiei ahisihleh na keng ahiei in ahing puasah leh sattan inlen paimangin, khut ni ahiei, keng ni ahiei nei a, kumtawn mei a pailut a um sangin khut langkhat bei leh kengbai a hinna a lut nanga dingin ahoizaw ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 5.30"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh namit in ahing puasah leh kheikhie inlen, paimang in; mit ni nei a gawtmun mei a pailut a na um sangin, mit khat nei a hinna a lut nanga dingin ahoizaw hi.","ref":"Mat. 5.29"},"10":{"text":"“Tam mi neute lah a khat zong simmawlou dingin pilvang un, aziehpen avansawlsiengte un, van a um ka Pa maisuo a en zing uhi, chi ka hinghil ahi.","ref":"Luk. 19.10"},"11":{"text":"Mihing Tapa khu Mangthaite hundam dinga hing pei ahi."},"12":{"text":"Bang nachi ngaituo uoi? Mi khat in belam zakhat nei henlen, alah ua khat vahmang taleh, sawmkuo leh kuote nuasie in muol leh taangte a pei in, avahmang pen vasui lou ding ahiei mah?","title":"Belam mang gentena thu (Luk. 15.4-7)"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh va mu kiata henlen hileh, chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, sawmkuo leh kuo vahmang loute tungah sangin, tua belam pen tungah akipah zaw ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuamabangin tam mi neute lah a khat zong amanthai ding van a Ka Pa deilam ahi sih hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tuathamlouin na sanggam in na tunga sil abawlkhiel leh pei inlen nang leh ama beh thei in akhelna khu hil in, aman na thu asan leh na sanggampa na zouta hi.","title":"Sanggam sil bawlkhielte hilding dan","ref":"Luk. 17.3"},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh asannop sihleh, theipi mi ni ahiei, thum ahiei, kama namdet ahi thei na dingin, mi khat ahiei, ni ahiei zawpi in.","ref":"Danp. 19.15"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh amauh thugen zong asan nuom sih leh hattuomte kungah tutin, tualeh hattuomte thugen asan nuom nahlai sih leh, ama khu nanga dingin, ginglou leh siedong mi bang hi mai heh."},"18":{"text":"Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, leitunga na kaan pouma uh van a zong kaan ahi dinga, tualeh leitung a na sutkhieh pouma uh van ah zong sutkhiet ahi ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 16.19; Jn. 20.23"},"19":{"text":"Adihtahin ka hinghil kia ahi, leitunga mi ni asilnget tungtang ua akithutuoh u’leh ka Pa van a um bawlpieh in a um ding uhi.","title":"Kithutuoh a thumna"},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen mi ni ahiei thum ahiei ka min a akikhop na phot uah, alah uah ka um zel ahi,” a chi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter ahing pei a akungah, “Mangpa ka sanggam in bangzat vei ahiei ka tunga akhel leh ka ngaidam ding? Sagi vei tandong adiei?” achi hi.","title":"Ngaidamna nasep leh kipahdan theilou suoh gentena thu","ref":"Luk. 17.3,4"},"22":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Sagi vei dong ka hing chi sih a, sagi vei mun sawmsagi tandong ka chizaw ahi.","ref":"Siem. 4.24"},"23":{"text":"“Tuaziehin van gam khu leengpa koi ahiei in asuohte toh sum thu tuot a suhtup tum toh gente ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh asuhtup pat tahin, mi khat talent tul sawm ba akungah ahing pui uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh aman apieh zoulou ziehin, apu in ama leh azi atate toh, tualeh anei alam teng toh zua a dit ding thu apie hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin suohpa khu apu mai ah akhupboh a, Pu aw, ka tungah zangai tadi in, ka bat zousie hing sang sieng navang, achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua suohpa khu apu in ahepita mama a, ahakhie a, abat angaidamta hi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh tua suohpa khu apawtdoh a, asuoh hipite lah a khat, ama sum za khat bapa ava mu a, tualeh ama aman a, Na bat hing pie’n chi’n alawl mehta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n asuoh hipipa akengbul ah akhupboh a, ka tungah zangai tadiin, hing sang sieng navang, chiin a ngen hi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh a ut sih a, abat teng asan zou masangsie suongkul ah akhumta hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n asuoh hipiten asilbawl dan amu tah un, alunggim mama ua, ahing pei ua, a sil bawl dan teng a Pu uh kungah ahilta uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuabep in a Puin ama ahan a, akungah, Nang suoh giloupa, na hing nget ngutngut zieh a na bat zousie hing ngaidam ing a;"},"33":{"text":"Ken nang ka hing hepi banga, nang zong na suoh hipipa na hepi ding hilou amah achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh apu alungthahta a, abat zousie a san zou masangsiein, migawtte kungah apeta hi."},"35":{"text":"Michin in na lungtang sunggil ua, na sanggamte uh na ngaidam sih u’leh ka Pa van a um in zong tuabangmain na tung uah abawl ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n tua thute agen zouin, Galili gam akipat in apawt a, Jordan lui gal Judia gam ah atungta hi.","title":"Ki khul tungtang dohna (Mak. 10.1-16 ; Luk. 18.15-17)"},"2":{"text":"Mipi tampi in Ama azui ua, Khunah Aman amaute ana sudam hi."},"3":{"text":"Pharisaite zong akungah ahing pei ua, “Ama aze et ua, akungah, bang ahiei zieh khat poupouin mi’n azi akhul a sieng ei?” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Aman adawnga, akung uah, “Achiil akipat a ama uh siempa’n numei leh pasal in ana siem hi, chi simkhalou na hi uoimah? achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 1.27; 5.2"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh tamte ziehin pasal in anu leh apa anuasie dinga azi atu ding hi, tuachi’n ani un sapumkhat ahing hita ding uhi, achi hi; chi na sim sih uh amah?","ref":"Siem. 2.24"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh ni ahi nawn sih ua, Sapumkhat ahita uhi. Tuaziehin Pasian in agawmsa mihingin khen sih heh,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaun akungah, “Ahileh bangding a Mosi in kikhulna lai pieh a khul ding ahi, chia thu apieh ahiei?” achi uhi.","ref":"Danp. 24.1-4; Mat. 5.31"},"8":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Mosi in na lungtang uh akhau zieha, na zite uh khul ahing phalpieh ahi, hinanleh achiil akipat in tuachibang ahi sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh ken ka hing hil ahi, Koipou in, angkawm zieh hiloupi a azi akhul midang akitenpi leh angkawm ahi, tualeh khulsa kitenpi pouma zong angkawm ahi, achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 5.32; 1 Kor. 7.10,11"},"10":{"text":"Anuazuiten akungah, “Pasal azi toh kaal thu tuabang ahileh, zi neilou ahoizaw hi,” achi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman akung uah, “Tam thu kigen pen mi zousie in apom thei sih uhi, akung ua pieh a umte loungal in."},"12":{"text":"Michilge khenkhat anu uh gilsung apat tuabang mawnga pieng a um ua, tualeh michilge mihing khuta gete zong a um ua, tualeh michilge, vangam zieh a, amau’leh amauh michilge a kibawl zong a um uhi. Koipou apom theiin pom uheh,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n atung ua akhut koi a, athumpieh dingin akungah naupang neute ahing zawpi ua, hinanleh nuazuiten amauh ana phawh uhi.","title":"Jesu’n naupangte a guolzawlna"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n “Naupangte ka kungah hing pei sah un, amauh khaam sih un, vangam khu tambang mite a ahi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh atung uah akhut akoi a, khuna kipat in apeita hi."},"16":{"text":"En vawi, mi khat ahing pei a akungah, “Siepa hoi, kumtawn hinna ka nei theina dingin sil hoi bang ka bawl diei?” achi hi.","title":"Tangval hausa in kumtawn hinna asui (Mak. 10.17-27 ; Luk. 18.18-27)"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akungah, “Bangdinga mi hoi hing chi na hiei? Pasian chilou mi hoi dang a um sih hi; bangtenghileh hinna a na lut nuom leh thupiehte zui in,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Aman A kungah, “Abangpente ahiei?” achi a, Jesu’n akungah, “Tualthat sin, angkawm sin, guta sin, theipitu dihlou in pang sin,","ref":"Pawt. 20.13; Danp. 5.17; Pawt. 20.14; Danp. 5.18; Pawt. 20.15; Danp. 5.19; Pawt. 20.16; Danp. 5.20"},"19":{"text":"Na nu leh na Pa zatat in, tualeh nangma na ki it banga na innvengte na it ding ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.12; Danp. 5.16; Siempu. 19.18"},"20":{"text":"Tangvalpan akungah, “Tamte zousie ka neulai apat ka zui zel hi, bang ka tasam nalai ei?” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Hoibukim na ut leh, pei inlen na neisa zua inlen mi zawngte kungah pie in, tuachi’n van ah gou na nei ding hi; tualeh hing pei inlen Kei hing zui in,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh tangvalpa’n tua thu azahtah in lunggim tahin apei mangta hi; sum tampi nei ahi zieh in."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n anuazuite kungah, “Adihtahin ka hinghil ahi, mi hausa adingin vangam lut ahasa hi.","title":"Hausatna nohphah dan"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh ka hinghil kia ahi, mi hausa Pasian gam a alut sangin sangawngsau phinbil hawm a alut suoh abailam zaw hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Anuazuiten tami azah tahun lamdang asa mama ua, “Koi hundam in a um zou diei?” achi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n amauh a en a akung uah, “Tami mihing bawlthaw guol ahi sih a, hinanleh Pasian a dingin bangkim bawl thei ahi,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in akungah, “Ngai vawi, kouten bangteng taisan in Nangma ka hing zuita uhi. Tuaziehin bang ahiei ka lawtah ding uh?” Chiin adongta hi.","title":"Pasian gam a sawltahte tanding (Mak. 10.28-30 ; Luk. 18.28-30)"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Adihtahin ka hinghil ahi, sil zousie siemtha ahi chienga, Mihing Tapa avangletna toupha a atou chiengin, nou Kei hing zuite khu Israel nam sawm leh nite vaihawm in mangtoupha sawm leh ni tungah na tou sam ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 25.31; Luk. 22.30"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh michin ka min zieh a innte ahiei, asanggampa ahiei asanggamnu ahiei, a pa ahiei, anu ahiei, azi ahiei atate ahiei, agamte ahiei, taisan pouma in aleza amu ding ua, kumtawn hinna atang ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh mi tampi amasa pente anukhia ding ua, anukhiapente amasa ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 20.16; Luk. 13.30"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Vangam khu gamneipa khat agrep huon a nasem ding mi chiel ding a zingmawng matah a kuonkhie bang ahi.","title":"Grep huona nasemte gente thu (Mak. 10.31)"},"2":{"text":"Ama’n anasem dingte toh ni khat a makhai khat law dinga akithukim tahun, agrep huon ah asawlta hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama khu nai kuo ding vel in apawtdoh a, mi dangte van zuana muna mawh dinte amu a,"},"4":{"text":"Akung uah, nou zong grep huon ah vakuon un, akilawm hun ka hing pen a ding hi, achi hi. Tuachi’n amau’zong akuonta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh sunkim leh nitah lam nai thum ding velin ava pawtdoh kia a, tuabangmain ava bawl kia hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh nitahlam nai nga ding vel in ava pawtdoh kia a, midang ding maimaite amu a, aman akung uah, Bangdinga sunnitum a tana mawh din na hi uoi mah? achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaun akungah, Koiman ahing goi lou zieh in achi uhi. Aman akung uah noute zong grep huon ah va kuon un, akilawm bang zel na mu ding uhi, achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n nitahlam ahing hitahin, grep huon neipa’n asumkempa kungah, nasem mite han inlen, anukhia pen apat in amasa pen tan in alaw uh pie in, achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.13; Danp. 24.15"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n nitahlam nai sawm leh khat ding vel in, ami goite uh ahing pei u’leh makhai khat chiet asang uhi."},"10":{"text":"Akuon masate ahing pei un, mu tam deu dingin akingaituo ua, hinanleh amaun zong makhai khat chiet ma asang uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh sum asan zou un, gam neipa tungah aphunta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tam anukhia pente’n naikal khat sung beh na asem ua, kou nisa thuoh a khosa kai a, sun nitangtum a semgimte toh na hing kibangsah hi, achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh aman alah ua mi khat adawng a, Lawm aw na tungah bangma ka bawlkhiel sih hi, makhai khat law dinga kihoutuoh hilou imah?"},"14":{"text":"Nangma a kilah inlen peitain, tam anukhia pen kungah zong nang ka hing pieh bangin ka pe nuom hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka neisa ka ut ut a ka bawlthei hinalou amah? Ka hoi zieh a thangsie na hiei mah? achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuamabangin anukhia pente amasa pente ahing hi ding ua, amasapen te anukhiapente ahing hi ding uhi. Aziehpen chielte tampi ahi ua, telte tawmnou ahi, achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 19.30; Mak. 10.31; Luk. 13.30"},"17":{"text":"Jesu’n Jerusalem khuo a apeitou lai in anuazui sawm leh nite Lampiah atuom in azawpi a akung uah,","title":"Jesu’n ashiding agen thumveina (Mak. 10.32-34 ; Luk. 18.31-34)"},"18":{"text":"“Ngai un, Jerusalem zuon a peitou ihi ua; Mihing Tapa khu Siempu liente leh laigiel mite khut ah matsah in a um dinga, tualeh amaun shi dingin amawpai ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Ama khu chiemmui bawlna ding leh zep ding leh Kross a kilbeh dingin Jentelte khut ah ape ding uhi. Tualeh Ama ni thum niin athou kia ding hi, achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zebedi tapate nu atapate toh Jesu kungah ahing pei ua, akhupboh a, Ama apat bang ahiei deisahna khat angen hi.","title":"Leitung zatatna ngetna (Mak. 10.36-45)"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman amanu kungah, “Bang ahiei na dei?” achi hi. Amanu’n akungah, “Tam ka tapate gel na leenggam ah khat na ziet langah khat na veilang a tou dingin deisahna pie in,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n adawnga, “Na nget khu na thei sih hi. Nouten ka nou dawn ding na dawn thei ding uoi? Tualeh ka baptisma tan ding na tang thei ding uoi?” achi hi. Amaun akung ah, “Thei e,” achi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Ka dawn ding nou khu na dawn ngei ding ua, Ka baptisma tan ding zong na tang ngei ding uhi, hinanleh ka zietlam leh ka veilam a tousah ding thu pen Keima pieh ding ahisih a, ka Pa’n abawlpiehsate ading ahibou hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh sawmten tam thu azahtah un, sanggam nite gel tungah alungthahta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n amaute akungah ahan a, “Jentel vaihawmte atung uah alien mama ua, tualeh milien milalten atung uah thu anei mama uhi, chi na thei uhi.","title":"Thupina dihtah","ref":"Luk. 22.25,26"},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh noute lah ah tuabang ding ahisih hi, koihitaleh na lah ua let ding lunggul pouma, na nasem un pang phot heh.","ref":"Mat. 23.11; Mak. 9.35; Luk. 22.26"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh na lah ua, masapen hi nuom khu na suoh un pang phot heh."},"28":{"text":"Mihing Tapa nangawn zong naseppieh a um ding in ahing pei sih a, nna sem ding leh mi tampi tatna dinga ahinna pe dinga hing pei ahizaw hi, achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Jeriko khuo apeisan tah un mipi tampiin Ama azui uhi.","title":"Mitto ni in mitvahna amu uh (Mak. 10.46-52 ; Luk. 18.35-43)"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai vawi, mitto ni lamgei a touten Jesu lampi ah apei hi chi azah tahun, “Aw Mangpa David Tapa ka tung uah zangai in,” chi’n akikouta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipiten sip dingin avau ua, hinanleh amaun, “Aw Mangpa David Tapa ka tung uah zangai in” chi’n akikou semsemta uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu ading denta a, amaute ahan a, “Na tung uah bang bawlleng na ut uoi?” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Amaun akungah, “Mangpa mitvah ka ut uh” achi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n ahepi a, amit uh athampieh a, tualeh thakhat in amu thei pai ngal ua, tualeh Ama azuita uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem atun kuon ua, Olive muol a Bethphage khuo atun un, Jesu’n anuazuite ni asawl a,","title":"Jesu guolzou a Jerusalem alutna (Mak. 11.1-10 ; Luk. 19.29-38 ; Jn. 12.12-15)"},"2":{"text":"Akung uah, na mazawn ua khuo ah “Va pei unlen, sabiltung kikhi akunga anou toh na mu pai ding uhi. Tuate sut unlen ka kungah hing kai un."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh mi koipouin na kung ua gen anei leh Mangpa’n ama uh atuulmaw hi, na chi ding uhi, tuachi’n aman ahing sawlpai ding hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tamte zousie guolnei kam a kigensa ahing tangtun theina ding a hing um ahi:"},"5":{"text":"En in, “Na leengpa kingaingiem tahin sabiltung tungah, sabiltung nou tung ngei a tuong in, na kungah ahing pei chiin, Zion tanu hil in” chi khu.","ref":"Zek. 9.9"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n nuazuite ava pei ua, Jesu’n akung ua thu apieh bangin abawlta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amaun sabiltung leh anou ahing kai ua, atungah apuonte uh apha ua, atungah Jesu atousah uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh mipi tamtah in, apuonte uh lampi ah apha ua, midangten singbawh asat ua lampi ah apha uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n amasanga pei mipite leh anua a zuiten, David Tapa kungah “Hosanna, Mangpa min a hing pei khu ahampha hi, Tungnung pen ah Hosanna,” chiin akikou uhi.","ref":"Late. 118.25,26"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem khosung a lut tahin, “Tam mipa koi ahiei?” chiin khopi sung pumpi akilingta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipiten “Tam mipa guolnei Jesu, Galili gam a Nazareth khuo a mi ahi,” achita uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu Pasian biehinn sungah alut a, biehinn a van zuate leh van leite zousie adeldoh a, tualeh sum heng mite dawkante leh vapal zuate touna haw akhule pieh hi.","title":"Bieh inn suhsiengna (Mak. 11.15-17 ; Luk. 19.45-46)"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh akung uah, “Ka inn khu thu nget na inn akichi ding hi chi gel ahi, hinanleh nouten gutate munpi na suohsahta uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 56.7; Jer. 7.11"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh mittote leh kengbaite bieh inn sung ah akungah ahing pei ua, Aman ana damsahta hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh siempu liente leh laigiel miten asil lamdang bawlte leh biehinn a, “David Tapa kungah Hosanna, chia naupang kikoute amu tah un,” alungthahta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Akung ah, “Tamten bang ahiei agen uh naza ei?” achi uhi. Tualeh Jesu’n akung uah, “Kaza hi. Naungehte leh nawitep lai nausente kam a kipat in pahtawina abukim sahta, chi khu na simkha ngai sih uh amah?” achi hi.","ref":"Late. 8.2"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute anuasie a, khopi apat in apawtdoh a, Bethani zuon in apei a, khunah agiehta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh zingmawng a, Khopi lam zuona ahing kilekia lam in agil akielta hi.","title":"Theipi kung samsietna (Mak. 11.11-14 , 20-24)"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh lamgei ah theipi kung khat amu a, abul a hing pei a, ava et leh ana loungal bangma amu sih a, tuachi’n theipi kung kungah, “Kumtawn in na ga nawn sin” achi a, tuachi’n theipi kung avuoi paita hi."},"20":{"text":"Nuazuiten tuakhu amu tah un, “Bangchidan a, theipi kung vuoi pai ahiei?” Chi’n lamdang asata mama uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Adihtahin ka hinghil ahi, ginna na nei ua, na ginlel sih pou u’leh, theipi tunga bawl bang giep na bawl sih ding ua, tam muol kungah zong na kisuon inlen tuipi sungah kipai lut in chi u’lachin zong na chi bang un a um ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 17.20; 1 Kor. 13.2"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh sil zousie gingta a, thu nget na toh na nget pouma uh na mu ding uhi.”"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Ama Pasian bieh inn ah ahing lut a thu ahil laitah in, siempu liente leh nautaang upate akung ah ahing pei ua, “Bang thuneina nei a nang tam silte na bawl ahiei? Tualeh tam thuneina koi in ahing pieh ahiei?” Achi uhi.","title":"Jesu thuneina aginglel uh (Mak. 11.27-33 ; Luk. 20.1-18)"},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n adawnga akung uah, “Ken zong thu khat ka hing dong ding hi, tuakhu na hing hil u’leh, ken zong koi thu a tam silte ka bawl ahiei ka hing hil ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Johan Baptisma khu hei a hing kipan ahiei? Van a hing kipan ahiei, ahisihleh mihing a kipan ahiei?” chi’n adongta hi. Tualeh amaute “Akingaituo ua, van akipat chilei lah, Aman tua ahileh bang ding a, ama gingta lou? ahing chi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Mihing akipat chilei lah mipite igiing ngal a, mi zousie in Johan khu guolnei a asim zieh un,” achi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Jesu adawng ua, “Ka thei sih uhi,” achi uhi. Tuachi’n Aman zong akung uah, “Tam silte koi thuneina a ka bawl ahiei chi ka hing hil sih ding hi, achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh “Nouten bang na chi ngai uoi? Mi khat in tapa ni anei a, amasa penpa kung ah ahing pei a, Tapa tuni in ka grep huon ah va kuon inlen nna vasem in, achi hi.","title":"Tapa nite gente thu"},"29":{"text":"Aman adawnga, kuon sih vang, achi a, hinanleh adachiengin alungsim aheng a akuonta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n a ninapa kungah ahing pei a, tuabangma in ava chita hi. Tualeh aman adawnga Pu aw kuon navang achi hi. Hinanleh akuonta sih hi."},"31":{"text":"Amautegel koizaw in apa uh deilam abawl uoi le?” achi hi. Amauten akungah “Amasazaw pen in,” achi uhi. Jesu’n akung uah, “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, siedongte leh kizuaten Pasian gam ahing lut khal ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"Johan khu dihtatna lam thu ah na kung uah ahing pei a, ama na gingta sih uhi, hinanleh siedongte leh kizuate’n ama agingta uhi; tualeh nouten tua khu na mu nua un zong ama na gintatna ding un, na kisia sih uhi.","ref":"Luk. 3.12; 7.29,30"},"33":{"text":"“Gentethu dang ngaikhie un, gam neipa koi ahiei khat a um a, tua mipa’n grep huon khat abawl a, palin akimkot in a im a, tua sungah grep suhna khuh atou a, innsang alam a, tuachi’n grep huon bawl mite kungah kilaw a hou dingin apekhie a, gamdang gamlapi ah azinsanta hi.","title":"Grep huon gentena thu","ref":"Isai. 5.1,2"},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n aga law ahun ding kuonin, asuohte aga la dingin huon bawlmite kungah asawl hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh huon bawlmite’n asuohte aman ua, khat avuo ua, khat athat ua, adang khat suongin asep uhi."},"36":{"text":"Aman asuohte amasanga sanga tamzaw asawl kia a; amaute tung ah zong amasang ua mite abawl bangma un ana bawl kia uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n atawpna pen ah, ka tapa zatat ngei nava uh chiin atapa khu akung uah asawlta hi."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh huon bawlmite’n atapa amu tahun, Tam mipa khu gouluo ding pa ahi, hing pei un, that vai in, agouluo dingte kilah vai, achi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama aman ua, grep huon pulam ah apai ua, athatta uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuaziehin grep huon neipa ahing peitah chiengin tua huon bawlmite tungah bangchin angbawl diei le? achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Amauten akungah, “Aman tua migiloute khu genthei tahin asumang ding a, grep huon pen huon bawl midangte, aga law hun teng a, agate akunga pe zel dingte kungah kilaw a hou dingin ape ding hi,” achi uhi."},"42":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Inn lammite suong deilou pen, Tuami ngel khu aning a suong poimaw pen ahing hita; Tami Mangpa bawl ahi a, imitmu un alamdang ahi, kichi laisiengthou khu, simkha ngailou na hi uh amah?","ref":"Late. 118.22,23"},"43":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian gam khu na kung ua kipat in ahing kilah pieh dinga, aga suo ding namte kunga pieh ahi ding, chi ka hing hil ahi.”"},"44":{"text":"“Tualeh tami suong tunga pua pouma akehjah dinga, tualeh anetkhahte pouma agawtguoi ding hi,” achi hi."},"45":{"text":"Tualeh siempu liente leh Pharisaiten gente thute azah tah un, amauh tungthu gen ahi chi atheita uhi."},"46":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama mat atup chiengun, mipite agiing uhi, amaun Jesu khu guolnei a angai zieh un."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n amauh ahoupi a, akung uah gentena thu agen kia hi.","title":"Kitenna anzaluina gente thu"},"2":{"text":"“Van gam khu leengpa koi ahiei in, atapa dinga kitenna annzaluina a bawl toh a gente hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh aman kitenna anzaluina a, chielte han dingin asuohte asawl a, hinanleh amaute ahing haw nuom sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aman asuoh dangte asawl kia a, chielte kung ah, Ngai un, ka anzalui ka manta a, ka bawngtalte leh ka gan vahthaute ka gouta a, bangma zousie mansa ahita, kitenna ankuong im dingin hing peita un, va chita un, achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun ana thusim sih ua, khat alou ah, khat asummet bawlna ah, akipeimangta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh adangten asuohte aman ua, simmawhuoi tahin abawl ua, athatta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh leengpa’n tua thu azah tahin alungthahta a, tualeh agalkapte asawl a, tua tuolthatte asumang a, akhopi uh ahaltum piehta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman asuohte kungah, kitenna ankuong mansa ahita, hinanleh ka chielte lah ne taah ahi sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin lamkathuomte ah pei unlen, tualeh na mu taphot uh, kitenna ann ne dingin hing chiel un, achita hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua suohte khu apawt ua, lamkathuomte a va pei in amu pouma uh, misie leh miphate zong abawn un ahing hankhawm ua, tualeh kitenna innsung khu michielte in ahing dimta hi."},"11":{"text":"“Hinanleh leengpa khu michielte en dinga ahing lut leh, kitenna puon sillou mi khat khunah amuta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n akungah, Lawm bangchidan ahiei kitenna puon sillou a tana na hing lut? achi hi. Tualeh ama ahamta sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa’n asuohte kungah, akhut leh akeng kaan unlen, pulam miel ah paidoh un, khunah kaa leh hagawina a um ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 8.12; 25.30; Luk. 13.28"},"14":{"text":"Chielte tampi ahi ua, telte tawmnou ahi uh,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharisaite apawtdoh ua, athugente apat amat theina dingun ava kikum khawm uhi.","title":"Sie pieh thu a dohna (Mak. 12.13-17 ; Luk. 20.20-26)"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh amaun anuazuite u’leh Herod pawlte akungah asawl ua, tua miten akungah, “Siepa midihtah na hia, Pasian lam thu dihtahin na hil a, khawh sahtuom koima na nei sih chi ka thei uhi, aziehpen koima khentuom na nei sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin hing hil in bang na chi ngai ei? Kaisar kunga sie pieh asieng ei, sieng lou?” achi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n alungsim gitlou dan uh athei a, akung uah, nou milepchiete “Bangdinga kei hing ze et na hi uoi?"},"19":{"text":"Sie sum khu hing ensah un” achi hi. Tuachi’n amaun makhai khat akungah ahing tawi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Tami koi lim leh koi min ahiei?” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaun akung ah “Kaisar” a achi uhi. Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Kaisar silte Kaisar kungah pie unlen, Pasian silte Pasian kungah pie un,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaun tam thute azah tah un, lamdang asata ua, Ama anuasie ua, apei mangta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuami ni main, Saddukaite, thawkiana aum sih chite Akungah ahing pei ua, Akung ah,","title":"Thawkiana thu dohna","ref":"Nasep. 23.8"},"24":{"text":"“Siepa aw, Mosi in mi khat ta neilou a ashi leh, asanggampa’n azi aluo ding a, asanggampa dingin chi ahahpieh ding ahi, achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 25.5"},"25":{"text":"Tuin ka kung uah, sanggam pasal sagi a um ua, tualeh a upa pen in zi anei a, ashita a, chihah anei lou zieh in azi pen a sanggampa kungah anuasieta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuamabangin anina pa zong ashi a, athumna pa in aluo a, asagina dongin akitenpi chietta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n atawpna pen ah, numeinu zong ashita hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin thawkiana ah, amanu khu sagite lah ah koipen zi ahita diei? Abawn un akitenpi chiet ngal ua, chi’n adong uhi.”"},"29":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga akung uah, “Laisiengthou leh Pasian silbawltheina na theilou ziehun, na sukhiel leng uhi."},"30":{"text":"Thawkiana ah kitenna aum nawn sih ding a, vansawlsiengte abang zawta ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh mishi thawkiana thu a, Pasian in na kung ua agen khu simkha ngailou na hi uoi mah?"},"32":{"text":"Kei Abraham Pasian, Isaak Pasian, leh Jakob Pasian ka hi, achi khu. Pasian khu mishi Pasian ahisih a, Mihing Pasian ahizaw hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 3.6"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh mipiten tam thu azah tah un, athuhilte lamdang asa mama uhi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu’n Saddukaite gen ding theilouin aniel dongta chi Pharisaiten azah tah un, ahing kikhawm uhi.","title":"Thupieh lienpen thu a dohna (Mak. 12.28-34)"},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n alah ua dansiem mi khat in, Ama ze etna in thu khat adong a,"},"36":{"text":"“Siepa aw, dan thu ah thupieh lienpen bang ahiei?” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Mangpa na Pasian khu na lungtang zousie in, na hagau zousie in, tualeh na lungsim zousie in, na it ding ahi.","ref":"Danp. 6.5"},"38":{"text":"Tami thupieh masa leh lienpen ahi."},"39":{"text":"Anina khu tambangma ahi a, Nangma na ki it bangin na inn vengte it in.","ref":"Siempu. 19.18"},"40":{"text":"Tam dan thupieh tegel tungah, dan thu leh guolneite thu zousie akikhaikhawm sieng ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Luk. 10.25-28"},"41":{"text":"Pharisaite akikhop lai un, Jesu’n amauh thu adong a,","title":"Messiah thu dohna (Mak. 12.35-37 ; Luk. 20.41-44)"},"42":{"text":"Khrist khu “Bang na chi ngai uoi? Koi tapa ahiei?” achi hi. Amaun “David tapa ahi,” achi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Tua ahileh bangchidan a, David in hagau a Ama khu,"},"44":{"text":"Mangpa’n ka Mangpa kungah, Na melmate na kengtaw nuoi a, Ka koi masangsie’n, ka ziet langah touin, chia, Mangpa achi ahiei?”","ref":"Late. 110.1"},"45":{"text":"David in Ama khu Mangpa achi leh atapa bang achi hi diei? achi hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n koiman ama kam khat in zong adawng thei sih ua, tua ni akipat in koiman thu dang mawngmawng adong kia ngam nawn sih uhi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n mipite leh anuazuite kungah thu agen a,","title":"Jesu’n laigiel mite leh Pharisaite ademna (Mak. 13.1 , 2 ; Luk. 21.5 , 6)"},"2":{"text":"“Laigiel mite leh Pharisaite khu Mosi toupha ah atou uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin zui dinga ahing hil pouma uh zui unlen, bawl zel un, hinanleh amauh silbawl bang khu bawl sih un, amaun agen ua, abawl tuom sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Puohgih hasatah abawl ua mite liengkou ah apat ua, amaun lah akhutme khat un zong akhoi nuom sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"A sil bawl zousie u’khu mihing mitmu ding a abawl uh ahi, asil bute u’leh alutang ua akopte uh asulien ua apuon mongte uh atuol sah uhi.","ref":"Mat. 6.1; Danp. 6.8; Kisim. 15.38"},"6":{"text":"Pawi bawlna ah mun hoipen, kikhopna inn ah touna nuom pen,"},"7":{"text":"Van zuana mun a miten chibai abuh ua, Rabbi, Rabbi, chia ahat u’bang a ut sese uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh noute pen Rabbi chiin um sih un, aziehpen na siepa uh khat a um, Khrist ngei khu ahi, tualeh noute pen sanggamta ngen na hi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Leitungah koima pa chi sih un, aziehpen na Pa uh khat ahia, Ama van ah a um hi."},"10":{"text":"Siepa chiin um sih un, aziehpen na siepa uh khat a um hi, Khrist khu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Na lah ua thupipen khu, na nasem ua a umzawh ding ahi.","ref":"Mat. 20.26,27; Mak. 9.35; 10.43,44; Luk. 22.26"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh koipou akiliensah khu, suhneu ahi dinga tualeh koipou akingai neu khu tawisang in a um ding hi.","ref":"Luk. 14.11; 18.14"},"13":{"text":"“Hinanleh nou laigielmite leh Pharisai lepchiete aw, na tung uh agih hi van gam lampi mite na khah pieh ua, nouma lah na lut tuom sih ua, mi alut dingte lah na phal sih uhi.","title":"Jesu’n laigiel mite leh Pharisaite amawpaina"},"14":{"text":"Nou laigiel mite leh Pharisai lepchiete aw, na tung uh agih hi! Aziehpen meithai innte na negam ua, mi solna dingin thungetna sawtpi pi na nei ua; tuazieh in mawpaina liensem na mu ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Nou laigielmite leh Pharisai lepchiete aw, na tung uh agih hi! Aziehpen phungkai khat bawl ding in, tuipi leh gam ah na zinkuol ua, ama na thuzawtah chieng un, ama khu noumate sanga ale nia gawtmun tapa in na bawl zel uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Nou mitto lamkaite, koipou Pasian biehinn loua kichiem khu bangma ahisih a, hinanleh koipou Pasian biehinn a sana loua kichiem in, atangtun sah ding ahi chite aw, na tung uh agih hi."},"17":{"text":"Nou mimaw leh mittote aw, sana leh sana siengthousah Pasian biehinn koizaw athupizaw ei?"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh koipou maitam loua kichiem khu, bangma ahi sih, hinanleh atung a um silpieh loua kichiem in, atangtun sah ding ahi, na chi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Nou mimo leh mittote aw, silpieh leh silpiehte susiengthou maitam khu, heipen thupizaw ahiei?"},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin koipou maitam loua kichiem pouma in maitam leh atunga um zousie louin akichiem ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh koipou Pasian biehinn loua kichiem khu, Pasian biehinn leh asunga um zousie lou in akichiem ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh van loua kichiem pouma khu, Pasian Mangtoupha leh atunga toupa lou a kichiem ahi.","ref":"Isai. 66.1; Mat. 5.34"},"23":{"text":"“Nou laigielmite leh Pharisai lepchiete aw, na tung uh agih hi, aziehpen nouten leengmaselte leh pasikhawmte, tualeh Jirate, nangawn sawm a khat na pie ua, dan thu khawhzaw adih a thukhenna bang, khotuona leh gin umnate bang, na thusim sih uhi. Tamte ahi na bawl ding uh, adangte nelsie tuomlou in.","ref":"Siempu. 27.30"},"24":{"text":"Nou lamkai mittote, thousi hisienga, sangawngsau pumvalte aw."},"25":{"text":"“Nou laigielmite leh Pharisai lepchiete aw, na tunguh agih hi! Nouten nou leh kuong pulam na silsieng ua, hinanleh asung lah lepguhna leh kidehlounain adim hi."},"26":{"text":"Nou Pharisai mittote aw, nou leh kuong sunglam susieng masa un, tuachi’n apulam zong ahing siengthei ding hi."},"27":{"text":"“Laigielmite leh Pharisai lepchiete aw, na tunguh agih hi, noute pen han kizutngou apulam kilawmtah a kilang, asunglam lah mishi gu leh silnieh chintenga dim bang na hi uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 23.3"},"28":{"text":"Tuabangmain noute zong pulam ah mihing mitmu in dihtat bangin na lang ua, hinanleh na sunglam uh khu lepchiena leh gitlouna in adim hi."},"29":{"text":"“Nou laigielmite leh Pharisai lepchiete aw, na tunguh agih hi, aziehpen guolneite han na bawl ua, midihtatte han zong na zem uhi,"},"30":{"text":"tualeh, ka pu ka pate uh damlaia na um hi u’leng, guolneite sisan asuona uah telkha lou ding hi ve ung na chi phuat uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaziehin guolneite thatte tate na hi uh chi nouma leh nouma na kitheisah ta uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n na pu na pate uh gitlouna tena dan sudim vanglah un."},"33":{"text":"Nou gulte leh gul suonte aw, gawtmun thukhenna bangchiin na pel thei ding uoi?","ref":"Mat. 3.7; 12.34; Luk. 3.7"},"34":{"text":"Tuaziehin, Ngai un, na kung uah guolneite, mipilte leh laigielmite, ka hing sawl ahi; alah ua kimkhatte na that ding ua, kros ah na khailia ding ua, kimkhatte na kikhopna innte uah, na jep ding ua, tualeh khochin ah na bawlgenthei ding uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n midihtat Abel sisan kisuo apat, Pasian biehinn leh maitam kikal a Barakiah tapa Zekariah na tha uh sisan tandongin, leitunga midihtat sisan kisuo zousie na tung uah ahing tung thei ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 4.8; 2 Khang. 24.20,21"},"36":{"text":"Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, tam silte zousie tulai khangthate tungah ahing tung ding hi."},"37":{"text":"“Aw Jerusalem, Jerusalem, guolnei that a, na kunga ahing sawlte uh suonga na seplum! aapi in anoute ahalim nuoi a a opkhum bangin, ken zong na tate bangzatvei ahiei opkhum katum a, hinanleh na ut sih uhi.","title":"Jesu’n Jerusalem akakhumna"},"38":{"text":"En un, na inn uh ahawm a na kung ua nuasie in a umta hi.","ref":"Jer. 22.5"},"39":{"text":"Na kung uah ka hinghil ahi, Mangpa min a hing pei ahampha hi na chi masangsie uh tukal na hing mu nawn sih ding uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Late. 118.26"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu apawtdoh a, Pasian biehinn apat a apei lai in, Pasian biehinn kilamdan Ama ensah dingin anuazuite akungah ahing pei uhi.","title":"Pasian biehinn suhsiet a aum ding leh huntawpna ding Jesu’n agen lawhna (Mak. 13.1-4 ; Luk. 21.5-6)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n akung uah, “Tam silte zousie na mu sih uh amah? Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, suhchip lou dinga suong kithuop mawngmawng tanah a um sih hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Olive muol tunga atou lai in, nuazuite amau’tang in akungah ahing pei ua, “Tam silte bangchih chiengin ahing um diei? Tualeh na hing pei kiana ding leh leitung tawpna ding chiemtena bang ahi diei?” hing hil in, achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Jesu’n amauh adawnga akung uah, “Koiman ahing sol louna dingin pilvang un.","title":"Hun hasa tunna ding (Mak. 13.5-23 ; Luk. 21.5-24)"},"5":{"text":"Mi tampi in, Khrist ka hi, chiin Keima min in ahing pei ding ua, mi tampi asol zou ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh kidouna leh kidouna thuthangte na za ding uhi. Na mangbat louna dingun pilvang un, tuate pen ahing tung ding mawng ahi, hinanleh atawpna ahi nai sih ding."},"7":{"text":"Nam tuom leh namtuom akidou ding ua, gam tuom leh gam tuom akidou ding ua, tualeh mun tuom tuom ah kiel atung ding a, natna hi aleeng dinga, zil aling ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tamte zousie khu gentheina kipatna ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua hun chiengin noute genthei thuoh dingin ahing mansah ding ua, ahing thatlum ding ua, tualeh ka min ziehin nam zousie huot na hi ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 10.22"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh mi tampi apua ding ua, khat leh khat akimansah ding ua, khat leh khat akimuda ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuahun chiengin guolnei tahlou tampi ahing pawtdoh ding ua, mi tampi asol zou ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh gitlouna apun ding ziehin ki itna adai deu deu ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh atawp donga thuohzou pouma hundamin a um ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.22"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh tami leenggam khantanhoi khu nam zousie theisahna dingin, leitung pumpi ah hilin a um dinga, tuazou chiengin atawpna ahing tung ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tuazieh in sumangthaipa kidahhuoi, guolnei Daniel in ana genpa, mun siengthou a hing ding na mu chieng un (asim pouma in theisiem uheh.)","title":"Gimthuohna thupi hing um ding","ref":"Dan. 9.27; 11.31; 12.11"},"16":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin Judia gam a umte taangte ah tai uheh."},"17":{"text":"Inn tunga umte zong, a inn sung a bang ahiei ladoh dingin hing kumsuh sih heh.","ref":"Luk. 17.31"},"18":{"text":"Lou a umte zong, apuonsilte la dingin hing nuakia sih heh."},"19":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin agaite leh naungeh neite tung agih hi!"},"20":{"text":"Na taimang hun ding uh phalbi lai leh khawlni ahi louna dingin thungen un."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen tua hun chiengin gimthuohna huoisetah um ding ahi, tuabanga gimthuohna huoisie khu leitung siemchil apat tuni tandongin a um ngai nai sih a, um zong a umkia nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Dan. 12.1; Kihil. 7.14"},"22":{"text":"Tua nite khu suhtom hisihleh mihing mawngmawng ahinga hutdoh ahi sih ding hi, hinanleh telte zieh in tua nite suhtom ahi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin, mi koipou in na kung ua, En vawi tanah Khrist a um hi, ahisihleh khunah a um hi, chinan uleh tahsang sih un."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen Khrist tahlou leh guolnei tahlou ahing pawt dinga, chiemtena leh sil lamdangte hing ensah in ahing sol ding uhi; tuaten hithei liei leh telte nangawn zong asol ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Ngai un, ka hing hil masah na hita uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuazieh in, na kung ua, En vawi, gamdai ah aum, ahing chi u’leh peidoh sih un, En un, pindan sung tawngah a um achi u’leh zong tahsang tuom sih un.","ref":"Luk. 17.23,24"},"27":{"text":"Suohlam a tunphe ahing pheta tumlam dong asalvah bangin, Mihing Tapa hing pei kiana zong tuabangma ahi ding hi.","title":"Ahing pei kiana ding (Mak. 13.24-27 ; Luk. 21.25-28)"},"28":{"text":"Heisung hinanleh shiluong umna phot ah Langtate zong a um khawm ding hi.","ref":"Luk. 17.37"},"29":{"text":"“Gimthuohna nite zoutah chiengin, ni suhmiel in a um dinga, hapi zong avah nawnsih ding hi, van a kipat in aasite ake ding a, tualeh van silbawltheinate suhling ahi ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 13.10; Joel. 2.10,31; 3.15; Kihil. 6.12; Isai. 13.10; Ezek. 32.7; Joel. 2.10; 3.15; Isai. 34.4; Kihil. 6.13"},"30":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin van ah Mihing Tapa chiemtena ahing kilang dinga, tua hun chiengin, leitung nam zousie in asuun ding uhi, tualeh Mihing Tapa khu silbawltheina leh guolzawna thupitah toh van meilum tunga hing pei amu ding uhi.","ref":"Dan. 7.13; Zek. 12.10-14; Kihil. 1.7"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh avansawlsiengte pengkul ging ngai thupitah toh ahing sawl dinga, amaun lei ning li a kipat leh van mong langkhat akipat alangkhat dongin, atelte akhawm ding uhi."},"32":{"text":"“Tuachi’n theipi kungah gentena thu zil un: Abate ahing men a, anate ahing selnou chiengin, nipi anaita chi na thei uhi.","title":"Theipi kung gentena (Mak. 13.28-31 ; Luk. 21.29-33)"},"33":{"text":"Tuachimabangin nouten zong tam silte na mu chieng un, Ama ahing naita a, kotkha bul mama ah aumta hi chi thei un."},"34":{"text":"Chitahtahin Ka hing hil ahi, Tam silte zousie atunkim masangsie’n tulai khangthate amang sih ding uhi."},"35":{"text":"Lei leh van amang dinga, hinanleh ka thu amang sih ding hi."},"36":{"text":"“Hinanleh tua ni leh ahun ding thu khu, koiman athei sih a, van a vansawlsiengte leh Tapa nangawn in zong athei sih a, hinanleh ka Pa maimai in athei hi."},"37":{"text":"Noah damlai mabangin, Mihing Tapa hing pei kiana zong ahi ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 6.5-8"},"38":{"text":"Tuani a tuichim tun masangin Noah kuong sunga alut ni dongin, ane un adawn ua, zi leh pasalin a kinei ua,"},"39":{"text":"tualeh tuichim ahing tunga, abawn ua alahmang masangsiein bangma athei sih uhi; Mihing Tapa hing pei kiana zong tuabang ahi ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 7.6-24"},"40":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin lou ah mi ni a um ding ua, khat lahmang in a um ding a, khatpen nuasie ahi ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Numei ni ann sukhawm in a um ding ua, khat lahmangin a um ding a, khat pen akinuasie ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuazieh in kiging un, na Mangpa uh bangchih hun a hing pei ding ahiei chi na theilou zieh un."},"43":{"text":"Hinanleh tami thei un, inn neipa’n guta hing pei ding hun thei leh, aveng ding a, a inn aphetvang sah sih ding hi.","ref":"Luk. 12.39,40"},"44":{"text":"Tuazieh in noute zong kiging zing un, na gintat lou hun laitah ua, Mihing Tapa hing pei ding ahi ziehin."},"45":{"text":"“Suoh muonhuoi, pil tah apu in ahun chin a, atan ding uh hawmpieh dinga, a innkuonpite tunga houtu dinga, akoi khu koi ahi diei?","title":"Suoh hoi leh hoilou gente thu (Luk. 12.41-48)"},"46":{"text":"Apu ahing pei chieng a, tuabanga bawla ahing mu, tua suohpa khu ahampha hi."},"47":{"text":"Chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, aman tua suohpa khu anei zousie tunga vaihawm in apangsah ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Hinanleh suoh gilou in alungsim in Ka pu hing tung pai zuai sih nava, chiin,"},"49":{"text":"asuoh hipite na vuoin, zukham annkhamte toh na ne in na dawnkhawmta leh,"},"50":{"text":"tua suohpa pu khu, agintat lou ni, akiven lou laitahin ahing tung ding a,"},"51":{"text":"tua suohpa khu tun ni asuo dinga, milepchiete tan bangbang atangsah dinga, khunah ka leh ha gawt a um ding hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tua hun chiengin van gam khu nungah siengthou sawm, athaumeite uh kenga mouneipa dawn dinga, kuonte toh gente ahi ding hi.","title":"Nungah siengthou sawmte gentena","ref":"Luk. 12.35"},"2":{"text":"Alah ua ngate apil ua, ngate amo uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amoten athaumei uh a keng ua, athautui akengtel sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh apilte in pen athaumei utoh a athawl ah atui zong akengtel uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mouneipa ahing vaigei zieh in, abawn un alusu ua ana imuta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh zankim lai in, Ngai un, mouneipa ahing pei hi, adawn dingin hing pawt un, chi kikou ging akizata hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua nungahte athou chiet ua, athaumeite uh ade chiet uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh amoten apilte kungah, na thautui uh hing hawm un, ka thaumeite uh mit ding ahita hi, achi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh apilten adawng ua, kou a ding leh noute a dingin akiching sih ding hi, azuate kungah pei unlen va leizaw un, achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh alei dinga ava pei lahkal un, mouneipa khu ahing tungta a, tuachi’n kigingsa a na umte khu moulopna inn ah ama toh alutkhawm ua, tuachi’n kot akikhata hi."},"11":{"text":"Khum nuain nungah siengthou dangte zong ahing tung ua, Mangpa, Mangpa kot hing honin achi uhi.","ref":"Luk. 13.25"},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman adawnga, adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, noute ka hing theikha ngai sih hi, achita hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin kiging un, Mihing Tapa hing peina ding ni leh ahun na theilou zieh un."},"14":{"text":"“Van gam khu mi khat, gamdang gamlatah a, khuolzin dinga kisa, asuohte hankhawm a, aneisate akhut ua kemsah bang ahi.","title":"Talent gentena thu","ref":"Luk. 19.11-27"},"15":{"text":"Asuohpa khat kungah talent nga, asuoh dangkhat kungah talent ni, tualeh asuoh dang khat kungah talent khat apie a, amauh bawlthei hun ding chiet apie hi, tuazouin ama azinkhe pai ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n talent nga tangpa’n tuateng toh summet ava bawl pai a, talent nga dang amube hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuabangma in talent ni tangpa’n zong talent ni dang a mube hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh talent khat tangpa pen apei a lei ava tou a, apu sum ava phumta hi."},"19":{"text":"Hun sawtpi nuain tua suohte pu khu ahing tungta a, tualeh amautoh atuotkhawm ua asutupta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n talent nga tangpa ahing pei a, talent nga dang ahing tawi a, Pu aw, nang talent nga na hing kemsah a, En vawi, talent nga dang ka mu be hi, achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Apuin akungah, Suoh hoi leh muonhuoi, na bawl hoi hi, sil tawmnou tungah na muonhuoi a, sil tampi tung a vaihawm in ka hing koi ding hi. Na pu kipahna ah lut in, achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Talent ni tangpa zong ahing pei a, Pu aw, nang talent ni na hing kemsah a, en vawi, talent ni dang ka mu be hi, achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Apu’n akungah, suoh hoi leh muonhuoi, na bawl hoi hi, sil tawmnou khat tungah na muonhuoi a, sil tampi tunga vaihawm ding in ka hing koi ding hi. Na pu kipahna ah lut in, achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n talent khat tangpa zong ahing pei a, pu aw, migenhapi na hi chi ka hing thei a, na tu louna ah zong na at kuom a, haichi na thelouna ah zong na khawm zel hi;"},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka zau a, ka va pei a na talent lei nuoi ah ka phuolta hi, En vawi, tanah nanga ma na mukiata hi, achi hi."},"26":{"text":"A puin adawnga, akungah, Nang suoh gilou leh thasepa, Ka tu louna ah ka at a, ka thelouna ah ka lakhawm zel hi, chi na thei amah?"},"27":{"text":"Tuabang ahivanglah leh ka sum khu sum kemte kungah na koi lachin, ka hing tun chienga, ka sum apung toh mu ngel ding hivengin."},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin atalent khu lahpieh unlen, talent sawm neipa kung ah pie un."},"29":{"text":"Koipou anei khu piehbelap ahi dinga, tampi ahing nei ding hi, hinanleh koipou anei lou khu anei sun zong lahpieh ahi ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 13.12; Mak. 4.25; Luk. 8.18"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh suoh phatuomlou khu pulam miel ah paidoh unlen, khunah ka leh ha gawtna a um ding hi, achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 8.12; 22.13; Luk. 13.28"},"31":{"text":"“Mihing Tapa khu vansawlsiengthoute zousie toh athupina a, ahing pei chiengin Ama khu aleengtoupha tungah atou ding hi.","title":"Thukhenna ni","ref":"Mat. 16.27; Mat. 19.28"},"32":{"text":"Nam zousie amasangah akikhawm ding ua, belamchingpa’n kel lah a, abelamte akhenkhieh bangin, amauh akhenkhe ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Belamte khu aziet lam ah akoi dinga, kelte pen aveilam ah akoi ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin leengpa’n azietlam a mite kungah, nou ka Pa thuphangate aw, hing pei unlen leitung siemchil akipata noute dinga kibawlsa leenggam khu luo un."},"35":{"text":"Aziehpen, ka gil akiel in nouten ann na hing pie ua; ka dang ata in dawn ding na hing pie uhi; mikhuol ka hi in na hing zintun ua;"},"36":{"text":"Guohtanga ka um in, puon na hing silsah ua, damlou a ka um in, na hing ve ua, suongkul a ka tanin, ka kungah na hing haw uhi, achi ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin midihtatten, Mangpa bangchih in ahiei gilkiel a ka hing mu ua, ann ka hing pieh uh?"},"38":{"text":"Bangchihin ahiei mikhuol a ka hing mu ua, ka hing na zintun uh? Guohtanga ka hing mu ua puon ka hing silsah uh?"},"39":{"text":"Bangchih in ahiei china ahiei a, ahisihleh suongkul a ka hing mu ua, na kunga ka hing haw uh? Chi’n adong ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n adawng ding a, akung uah, chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, Tam ka sanggamte lah a neupen khat tunga na bawl u’khu ka tunga bawl na hi uh, achi ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuazou chiengin aveilam a mite kungah, nou hamsethuohte aw, ka kung apat peimang unlen, kumtawn meidil, dawimangpa leh asawltahte dinga abawl uah, lut un."},"42":{"text":"Aziehpen ka gilkiel in, ann na hing pe sih ua, ka dangtain, dawn ding na hing pe sih ua;"},"43":{"text":"Mikhuol ka hiin, na hing zintun sih ua, guohtang ka hiin, puon na hing silsah sih ua, ka chinat leh suongkul a, ka taan in na hing ve sih uhi, achi ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun zong, Mangpa bangchihin ahiei, gilkiel ahiei, guohtangin ahiei, china in ahiei, suongkul ah ahiei, ka hing mu ua, na nna ka hing seppieh lou uh? Chiin adawng ding uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akung uah, chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, Tam mineupente lah a, mi khat tunga na bawl lou u’khu, ka tunga bawllou na hi uhi, chiin adawng ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh tuate khu kumtawn gawtmun ah apeita ding ua, hinanleh midihtatte pen kumtawn hinna ah a peita ding uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Dan. 12.2"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu’n tam thu zousie agen zou in anuazuite kungah,","title":"Jesu tha ding sawmna (Mak. 14.1 , 2 ; Luk. 22.1 , 2)"},"2":{"text":"“Ni ni nua chiengin peikan annkuong luina a um ding a, Mihing Tapa kilbeh dinga, matsahin a um ding hi,” chi na thei uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-27"},"3":{"text":"Tua hun laitah in siempu liente, laigielmite leh vantang upate khu siempu lienpen Kaiapha kichipa innpi ah akikhawm ua,"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu khu solbawla man a atha theina ding un akikum uhi."},"5":{"text":"“Ahivang in pawi niin vang hida heh, tuachilouin mipite lah ah buoina hing pieng khava achi uhi.”"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu khu Bethani khuo a mi phahpa Simon inn a aum laitah in,","title":"Bethani a Jesu sathau nuna (Mak. 14.3-9 ; Jn. 12.2-8)"},"7":{"text":"Numei khat alabastar bawm a thau namtui manphatah tawiin akungah ahing pei a, a annkuong im laitah in Jesu lu tungah a buohsuhta hi.","ref":"Luk. 7.37,38"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh anuazuiten tuakhu a mutah un, alungthah ua, “Bangdinga ahichi suhmangthai ahiei?"},"9":{"text":"Tam sathau namtui man tamtah a zua a, mi zawngte kunga pieh thei hingel hia,” achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu’n tuakhu atheitahin akung uah, “Bangdinga tam numeinu subuoi na hi uoi? Amanu’n ka tung ah sil hoi abawl ahi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen mi zawngte na kung uah, a um ngitnget uhi, hinanleh Kei pen na kung ua um ngitnget ka hi sih hi.","ref":"Danp. 15.11"},"12":{"text":"Tami thau namtui ka tahsa tung a asun khu vui a ka um ni a dinga abawl ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi; leitung pumpi heisung mun ah zong, tam khantanhoi kigenna phot ah, tam numeinu silbawl zong amanu thei zingna dingin akigen zel ding hi.”"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n sawmlenite lah a khat, Juda Iskariot kichipa khu siempu liente kungah ava haw a,","title":"Juda Iskariot in Jesu azuana (Mak. 14.10 , 11 ; Luk. 22.3-6)"},"15":{"text":"Akung uah, “Ama hing mansah ta leng, kei bang na hing pe ding uoi?” ava chi hi. Tuachi’n amaun dangka sawmthum, asim ua apeta uhi.","ref":"Zek. 11.12"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n khum ni akipat in Ama matsahna ding hun lemtang asuita hi."},"17":{"text":"Tanghou tolsawlou pawi ni masapen in, nuazuite Jesu kungah ahing pei ua, akungah, “Peikan annkuong na nehna ding heisung ah hing bawlpieh u’leng na ut ei?” achi uhi.","title":"Nitah ann nukhia pen (Mak. 14.12-16 ; Luk. 22.7-13)"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh, Aman “Khopi ah pei unlen, mi koi ahiei khat kungah, Siepipa’n ka hun anaita a, ka nuazuite toh na inn ah peikan annkuong ka nekhawm ding uh, achi hi, va chi un,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n nuazuiten Jesu’n ahil bangin ava bawl ua, Peikan annkuong abawlta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Nitahlam ahing hiin, nuazui sawm leh nite toh annkuong a im ua,","title":"Juda Iskariot in amatsah ding Jesu’n agenna (Mak. 14.17-21 ; Luk. 22.14 , 21-23 ; Jn. 13.21 , 22)"},"21":{"text":"ann aneh laitah un Aman akung uah, “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, na lah ua mi khat in kei ahing mansah ding hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh amauh alungdong mamata ua, akungah “Mangpa kei ka hi amaleh?” achi chietta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman, “Kei toh annkuong sohkhawmpa mama in ahing zuousan ding a, ahing mansah ding hi, chi’n adawng hi.","ref":"Late. 41.9"},"24":{"text":"Mihing Tapa khu atanchin kigiel bangin apei zel ding hi, hinanleh Mihing Tapa mansah dingpa tung agih hi!
