Tuapa khu ana pienglou hileh ama dingin ahoizaw ding hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n amansah dingpa Juda in, “Siepa kei ka hi amah?” achi a, Aman akungah “Nangma’n na genta hi,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh ann aneh lai un, Jesu’n tanghou ala a, aguolzawl a, aphalsuo a, tualeh anuazuite apie a, “La unlen, ne un, tami ka tahsa ahi,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n nou ala a, kipahthu agen a, akung uah apie a, “Na bawn un tami dawn un”"},"28":{"text":"Tami ka sisan, khelnate ngaidamna dinga mi tampite dinga luongkhie thuhun tha khu ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 24.8; Jer. 31.31-34"},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hing hil ahi, Ka Pa gam a noute toh atha a ka dawn ni atun masangsie tuban grepgui a ga ka dawn kia nawn sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh la khat asah zou un, apawt ua, Olive muol ah apeita uhi.","title":"Anuazuiten ataisan ding Jesu’n agenna (Mak. 14.26-31 ; Luk. 22.34 , 39 ; Jn. 13.37 , 38)"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Tuzan chiengin na bawn un keima zieh in na lungke sieng ding uhi, aziehpen: Belampu ka jep dinga, Belamhon lah a belamte akithethang ding uh, chi gel ahi.","ref":"Zek. 13.7"},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh ka thawkia nua chiengin, Galili gam ah na masang uah ka pei ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 28.16"},"33":{"text":"Peter in adawnga akungah, “Mi zousie na tung ah lungke sieng nan uleh, keivang ka lung kesih ding hi,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, tuzan chiengin aah khuon masang in thum vei na hing kitheimawbawl ding hi,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Peter in akungah, “Nang toh shi khawm ding hinanleng zong ka hing kitheimawbawl sih ding hi,” achi hi. Tuabangmain nuazuite zousie in zong achi chiet uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu amautoh Gethsemani achina mun uah atung a, tualeh nuazuite kungah, “Khuna kava thunget lahkaal in tanah na tou un,” achi hi.","title":"Jesu Gethsemani huon ah (Mak. 14.32-42 ; Luk. 22.40-46)"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Aman Peter leh Zebedi tapate ni azawpi a, alunggim sengin achimaw panta hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Ka hinna shina khopin alunggim mama hi, tanah um unlen, hing venpi un,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Themkhat a gamla zaw deu ah apei a, Amai tuolsu in akhupboh a, “Ka Pa Aw, ahitheileh tam nouin hing pelsah in, Ahivang in Keima thu hilouin Nangma thuthu hizaw heh,” chiin thu angen hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuazouin nuazuite kungah ahing pei a, amauh imu in ahing muta a, “Tualeh Peter kungah nouten naikaal khat zong hing venpi zoulou na hi uh maw?"},"41":{"text":"Solna a na lut louna dingun kiging ngitnget in thungen un, hagau in angap a, hinanleh tahsa pen ahat sih hi,” achi hi."},"42":{"text":"Aniveina ah ava pei a thu angen kia a, “Pa Aw ka dawn lou a tami nouin hing pel thei mama lou ahitah leh Nangma thuthu hi heh,” achi hi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh ahing pei kia a, amauh imu in amu kia a, aziehpen a imut suoh mama uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n, amauh anuasie a, ava pei kia a, athum veina ah agen ngaiteng gen in, thu angen kia hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuazouin a nuazuite kungah ahing pei a, akung uah, “Tu dong a i mu na lai a, na khawldam na hi nalai uh amah? Ngai un, ahun ahing tungta hi. Mihing Tapa migiloute khut ah matsah ahita ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Thou unlen pei vai, En un, ahing mansah dingpa ahing tungta hi,” a chi hi."},"47":{"text":"A thugen lai mamain, En vawi, sawm leh nite lah a khat, Juda khu, siempu liente leh upate kunga kipat, mipi tampi namsau leh khetbuh tawite toh ahing tungta hi.","title":"Jesu kimatna (Mak. 14.43-52 ; Luk. 22.47-53 ; Jn. 18.1-11)"},"48":{"text":"Tualeh amansah ding pa’n chiemtena ahil masa a, “Ka tawp penpen khu Ama ahi dinga, na man pai ding uhi, achi hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n Jesu azuontou pai a, “Salam Siepa!” achi a, Ama atawpta hi."},"50":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n akungah, “Lawm, bangdinga hing pei na hiei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n amauh ang pei ua, Jesu tungah khut aha ua amanta uhi."},"51":{"text":"Tualeh thakhat in, Jesu umpite laha mi khat in akhutin asawh a, anamsau adohkhie a, siempulien suohpa asat a, abil asatkhieh pieh hi."},"52":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akungah, “Na namsau apai ah siet kia in, namsau pan pouma namsau ma a, shi ding ahi ziehin."},"53":{"text":"Tuin zong, vansawlsieng tulguh mun sawmleni sang a tamzaw hing sawl ding a, Ka Pa kunga ngen theilou a hing ngaisut na hi uoi mah?"},"54":{"text":"Hinanleh tuabangin ngenta leng, Laisiengthou in tambangin ahing um ngeingei ding, achi khu bang achi tang tun thei diei?"},"55":{"text":"Tua hun laitah main Jesu’n mipite kung ah, “Suomhat khat man ding bang zenin, namsau leh khetbuh tawi in, Kei man ding in na hing kuon u’maw? Nichin in Pasian bieh inn ah thuhil in ka tou a, na hing man sih uhi.","ref":"Luk. 19.47; 21.37"},"56":{"text":"Hinanleh guolneite laisiengthou thute ahing tangtun theina dinga tamte zousie hing um ahi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n nuazuite zousiein Ama anuasie ua ataimangta uhi."},"57":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu mante’n Ama khu siempu lienpen Kaiapha inn a, laigiel mite leh upate kikhopna ah azawpita uhi.","title":"Siempu lien mai a Jesu adinna (Mak. 14.53-65 ; Luk. 22.54 , 55 , 63-65 ; Jn. 18.12 , 18 , 24)"},"58":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter in gamla simkhat ah siempu lien inn huongsung dong Jesu azui a, tualeh ava lut a atawptan thei tum in vengmite lah ah ava tou hi."},"59":{"text":"Tualeh siempu liente, upate leh vaihawm mite zousie in, Jesu atha theina ding un, theipimi dihlou asui ua,"},"60":{"text":"hinanleh amu sih uhi. Theipimi dihlou tampi ahing pei vang un koiman a mu zou tuom sih uhi. Hinanleh atawp ah theipimi dihlou ni ahing pei ua,"},"61":{"text":"“Tam mipa’n Pasian biehinn susiet a ni thum sunga lam kia thei ka hi, achi hi,” achi uhi.","ref":"Jn. 2.19"},"62":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu lienpen adingdoh a, Akungah “Adawnna ding bangma theilou na hiei mah? Tam mite hing hehna bangchidan ahiei?” achi hi."},"63":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu aham vawt sih hi. Tuachi’n siempu lienpen in akungah, “Pasian hing min in ka hing vau ahi, Pasian Tapa Khrist na hileh hilou hing hil in,” achi hi."},"64":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Na chita hi. Ahivang in ka hing hil ahi, Tunua chiengin Mihing Tapa silbawltheina zietlam a tou leh van meilum tunga hing pei na mu ding uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Dan. 7.13"},"65":{"text":"Tuatah in Siempu lienpen in apuonte abotkeh a, “Pasian agenseta, theipimi dang bangding ichi nalai diei? Ngai un, tuin Pasian agensietna na zata uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 24.16"},"66":{"text":"Bang nachi ngai uoi?” Amauten adawng ua, “Shi taah ahi,” achi uhi."},"67":{"text":"Tuachi’n Amaitang ah chil asietkhum ua, avuo ua, kimkhatten akhutpeh un abengthop uhi.","ref":"Isai. 50.6"},"68":{"text":"“Nang Khrist, koi ahiei ahing beng?” hing hil in, achi uhi."},"69":{"text":"Tualeh Peter khu inn pulam huong sungah atou a, tualeh nungah khat akungah ahing pei a, “Nang zong Galili mi, Jesu toh umkhawm na hive maw?” achi hi.","title":"Peter in Jesu akilepsanna"},"70":{"text":"Hinanleh aman “Na thugen thei vawt sing chi’n amauh zousie mai ah akilepsanta hi.”"},"71":{"text":"Tualeh kotlam bihaliep a apei laitah in, nungah dang khat in ana mu a, khuna umte kungah, “Tam mipa zong, Nazareth Jesu kunga um ahi,” achi hi."},"72":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Tuapa vang ka theikha sih,” chia kichiem in akilepsan kiata hi."},"73":{"text":"Tualeh tomkhat zouin akiim a dingte ahing pei ua, Peter kungah, “Nang zong alah ua khat na hi ngel ve, aziehpen na kamsuoin akithei hi,” achi uhi."},"74":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Tua mipa ka theikha ngai mawngmawng sih hi,” chiin amaleh ama awsie kilawkhumin akichiemta hi. Tuachi’n a khuong paita hi."},"75":{"text":"Tualeh Peter in Jesu thugen, “A khuon masangin thumvei na hing kilepsan ding achi khu ahing theidohta hi.” Tuachi’n pulam ah apawtdoh a, hasetahin akapta hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zingmawng ahing hitahin, siempu liente leh vantang upate zousie Jesu thana ding thu akikum uhi.","title":"Pilat mai a Jesu adinna (Mak. 15.1 ; Luk. 22.66 ; 23.1 ; Jn. 18.28)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Ama akaan ua, azawpi ua, gam uhpipa Pontius Pilat kungah apekheta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama mansahpa Judas in Jesu amawpaita uh chi atheitahin akisia a, dangka sawmthum khu siempu liente leh upate kungah, ahing tawi kia a,","title":"Judas kisiana leh shina (Nasep. 1.18 , 19)","ref":"Nasep. 1.18,19"},"4":{"text":"“Mawna neilou sisan ka matsah khu ka khielta hi,” ava chi hi. Tualeh amaun “Kou a dingin bang akhoh diei? Nang na lawlaw kilawin achisanta uhi.”"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman dangka khu Pasian biehinn sungah aseplut a, apei a, ava awhlumta hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh siempu lienten dangka khu ala ua, “Tampen sisan man ahiziehin thawlawm bawm a koi asieng sih hi,” achi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh akikumkhawm ua, mikhuolte vuina dingin tua sumin belkhengpa mun aleita uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin khum mun khu tutan in, sisan mun achita uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n guolnei Jeremiah thugen, “Israel tate lah a koite ahiei in ana sah uh, Ama man ding dangka sawmthum khu ala ua.","ref":"Zek. 11.12,13"},"10":{"text":"Mangpa’n ahing hil bangin, belkhengmi mun man dingin apie uh achi khu hing tangtung ta hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu gam uhpipa mai ah adinga tualeh gam uhpipa’n, “Nang Judate leengpa na hiei mah?” Chiin adonga, tuachi’n Jesu’n akungah, “Na genta hi,” achi hi.","title":"Jesu pilat mai ah (Mak. 15.2-5 ; Luk. 22.2-5 ; Jn. 18.29-38)"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh siempu liente leh upaten ahehsiet laitah un, bangma in adawng sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in akungah, “Ahing hehsietna tengpi uh zalou na hiei mah?” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Aman kamteng khat in zong adawng sih hi, tuachi’n gam uhpipa’n lamdang asa mama hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh pawi bawl ni chiengin gam uhpipa in henta khat, mipiten adeidei uh, ngaina dan in ahakhiet pieh zel hi.","title":"Jesu khailup a, Baraba hakhiet ding (Mak. 15.6-14 ; Luk. 23.17-23 ; Jn. 18.39 , 40)"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh khum hun laitah in henta minthangtah Baraba kichi mi khat anei uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaute ahing kikhop tah un, Pilat in akung uah, “Koizaw hing hadoh leng na ut uoi? Baraba ahiei ahisihleh Jesu Khrist kichipa?” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Thangsietna zieh a amatsah uh ahi chi aman athei hi."},"19":{"text":"Vaihawmna toupha a atou laiin, azi in akungah mi asawl a, “Tua midih tungah bangma bawl sin, tuniin Ama ziehin ka mangin sil tampi ka thuoh hi ava chisah hi.”"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh siempu liente leh upaten Baraba khu ngen ua Jesu thatlum dingin mipite asol lungdam uhi."},"21":{"text":"Gam uhpipa’n amauh ahoupi a, “Nite lah a koizaw hing hakha leng chi na hi uoi,” achi a; Amaun Baraba, achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Pilat in akung uah, “Ahileh Jesu Khrist kichi bang ka lawta diei le?” achi hi. Abawnpi un “Ama pen kross ah kilbeh in um heh,” achi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n gam uhpipa’n bang dingin e? “Bang bawl khiel anei a ahiei?” achi hi. Amauten abawn un, “Kross ah kilbehin um heh,” chiin akikou nasa semsem uhi."},"24":{"text":"Pilat in bangma alaw thei sih a, hing buoi deudeu ding hi chi atheitah in, tui ala a, mipite mai a akhut sil in, “Tam midih sisan ah mawna ka nei sih hi, nouten na lawlaw kilawta un” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 21.6-9"},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite zousie in, “Asisan pen kouma leh ka tate uh tung ah tu heh,” achi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Baraba khu akung uah, ahakheta a, tualeh Jesu ajep a, kilbeh dingin apeta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuazou in gam uhpipa galkapten Jesu khu innpi huong sungah apuilut ua, apawlpawla um galkap zousie akimkot ah ahing kikhawmta uhi.","title":"Jesu ajepna uh (Mak. 15.15-17 ; Luk. 23.24 , 25 ; Jn. 19.16)"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Apuonsilte ahawhkhiet pieh ua, puonsandup asilsah uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh linglukhu aphan ua, akhusah ua, akhut ziet langah pumpeng chiengkhut khat atawisah ua, amai ah akhupdin ua, “Salam Judate leengpa!” Chi’n chiemmui bawlnan anei uhi.","title":"Jesu Golgotha a apuina uh (Mak. 15.18-22 ; Luk. 23.26-33 ; Jn. 19.17)"},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n atungah chil asietkhum ua, pumpeng chiengkhut alahpieh ua, alutang satnain anei uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama chiemmui bawlna a anei zou un, puonsandup khu ahawhkhiet pieh ua, Ama puonte asilsah kia ua, Kross a kilbeh dingin apuita uhi."},"32":{"text":"Ahing pawtdoh lai un, Sairin khuo a mi amin Simon kichi mi khat a mu ua, ama khu Kross paw dingin aman uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Golgotha kichi mun ahing tun tah un, (tuakhu lugu mun china ahi.)"},"34":{"text":"Uain thua, silkha toh kihal dawn ding in apie ua, Aman tua khu achiem a, adawn nuom tasih hi.","title":"Jesu kilbeh a aumna (Mak. 15.23-32 ; Luk. 23.33-43 ; Jn. 19.18-24)","ref":"Late. 69.21"},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama Kross ah akhenbeh ua, tualeh aisanna in apuonsilte akihawm uhi; guolnei in, Ka puonte akihawm ua, ka puonsil tung ah ai asan uhi, chia anagen atangtunna dingin.","ref":"Late. 22.18"},"36":{"text":"Tualeh khunah atou ua, Ama avengta uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh ahehsietna uh, “TAMI JUDATE LENGPA JESU AHI”, chia kigiel alutung ah atahta uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Ama toh suomhat mi ni zong akilbeh ua, azietlam ah khat, aveilam ah khat."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh akunga suohkha poumain, alu uh thing in, a elhou uhi.","ref":"Late. 22.7; 109.25"},"40":{"text":"“Nang Pasian biehinn susie a, ni thum sunga lam kiapa, nangleh nang kihunkhe ve, Pasian tapa na hileh hing kumkhie in,” achi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 26.61; Jn. 2.19"},"41":{"text":"Tuamabangin siempu liente, laigielmite leh upaten zong, a enghou uhi,"},"42":{"text":"“Aman midangte ahundam a, Ama leh Ama akihundam thei sih hi. Israelte leengpa ahileh kross dawn apat hing kum leh asih diei, tuahileh Ama i gingta mai ding uhi."},"43":{"text":"Aman Pasian amuong vele, Ama aut leh tuin hundam leh aveleh, Pasian tapa ka hi achi hilou i,” achi uhi.","ref":"Late. 22.8"},"44":{"text":"Suomhat Ama toh akilbehte un zong, tuamabangin a elhou uhi."},"45":{"text":"Sunkim akipat in nitahlam nai thum dongin leitung pumpi ahing mielta hi.","title":"Jesu shina (Mak. 15.33-37 ; Luk. 23.44-46 ; Jn. 19.28-30)"},"46":{"text":"Tualeh nai thum ding vel in Jesu aw ngaitah in akikou a, “Eloi Eloi lama Sabakthani?” tuakhu “Ka Pasian Ka Pasian bangdinga hing taisan na hei?” china ahi.","ref":"Late. 22.1"},"47":{"text":"Khuna akunga dingten tuakhu azah tahun “Tam mipa’n Elijah ahan hi,” achi uhi."},"48":{"text":"Alah ua mi khat atai pai a, Spanji khat ala a, uoin thua ah adie a, pumpeng chieng dawnah ata a, dawn dingin ape tou hi.","ref":"Late. 69.21"},"49":{"text":"Adangten Amatangin umsah un, “Ama hunkhe dingin Elijah ahing pei mawng ei mah enva ui,” achi uhi."},"50":{"text":"Jesu aw ngaitahin akikou kia a, ahagau ahata hi."},"51":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai un, Pasian biehinn puonjah khu, atunglam apat in anuoilam dongin phal ni kisuoin akehsuoh a, zilpi ahing ling a, suongpite ahing pohkeh a,","title":"Jesu shi laitah a sillamdang umte (Mak. 15.38-41 ; Luk. 23.45 , 47-49)","ref":"Pawt. 26.31-33"},"52":{"text":"tualeh hante ahing kihong a, misiengthou imusate tahsa tampi kaithawin a umta hi,"},"53":{"text":"tuate Ama thawkia nuain hante apat hing pawtdoh in khopi siengthou ah alut ua, mi tampi kungah akilah uhi."},"54":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkap za lamkaipa leh Jesu venga umten zilling leh sil umdante amu un, azauta mama ua, “Tam Mipa Pasian Tapa dihtah ahi,” achi uhi."},"55":{"text":"Tualeh khunah numei tampi ana seppieh kawm zela Galili gam akipata hing zuite aum ua, gamlapi ah a en ua;","ref":"Luk. 8.2,3"},"56":{"text":"tuate lah ah Mari Magdalene, Jakob leh Joseph nu, Mari, tualeh Zebedi tate nu, a um uhi."},"57":{"text":"Nitahlam ahing hitah in, Arimathai khuo a um Jesu nuazui khat, amin Joseph, mi hausa khat ahing pei a,","title":"Jesu vui a umna (Mak. 15.42-47 ; Luk. 23.50-55 ; Jn. 19.38-42)"},"58":{"text":"tua mipa khu Pilat kungah ava pei a, Jesu luong angen hi. Tuachi’n Pilat in aluong khu pieh ding thu apie hi."},"59":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph in aluong khu ala a, diel puon nemtahin atuom a,"},"60":{"text":"ahantha suongkhuoh hawm sung ah, asiel a, tualeh hankot ah suong lienpi khat alia lut a apeita hi."},"61":{"text":"Tualeh Mari Magdalene leh Mari dang khat han mazawn ah atou uhi."},"62":{"text":"Azingni, tuakhu kiginni zing ni ahia, siempu liente leh Pharisaite Pilat kungah ahing kikhawm ua;"},"63":{"text":"“Pu, tua misolhatpa’n adamlai in, Ni thum nuain Ka thoukia ding achi ka theizing uhi.","ref":"Mat. 16.21; 17.23; 20.19; Mak. 8.31; 9.31; 10.33,34; Luk. 9.22; 18.31-33"},"64":{"text":"Tuaziehin han khu anithum ni tan hoitah a veng dingin thu pie in, tuachilouinvang zanlaiin anua zuiten ava gu khading ua, mipite lah ah, mishi lah akipat in athou kiata achi khading uhi; tuachi’n solna nukhia zaw khu amasa sangin asezaw khading hi,” achi uhi."},"65":{"text":"Pilat in akung uah, “Vengmi galkapte na nei ve ua le, pei unlen, na theitawp un veng hoisah ta un,” achi hi."},"66":{"text":"Tuachi’n vengmi galkapte toh apei ua, han khu a enchien ua, a suong achiemte ua, vengmi akoita uhi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khawlni beizou, nipikaal khat a ani masapen ding khovah kuonin, Mari Magdalene leh Mari dang han en dingin akuon uhi.","title":"Jesu thawkiana"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai vawi, zil nasatah in alinga; Mangpa vansawlsieng van akipat in ahing kumsuh a, suong khu aliakhie a, atungah atouta hi."},"3":{"text":"Amel lat dan khu kawlphe bang ahi a, apuonsilte vua bangin avaam hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama agiin zieh un vengmite khu achitun ua, mishi bangin aumta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh vansawlsiengin numeite ahoupi a, akung uah “Zausih un; Jesu kilbeh a umpa sui na hi uh chi ka thei hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama tanah a um nawn sih hi, agensa bangin Ama athouta hi. Alupna mun hing en vawi un."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh kintah in pei unlen, Anuazuite kungah, mishi laha kipat in athoukiata; tualeh Ngai un, Galili gam ah na masang uah apei hi, tua mun ah Ama na mu ding uh, chi’n va hil un. Ngai un, Ka hing hilzouta hi, achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun thakhat in zau leh kipah mama kawmin han anuasie ua, anuazuite hil dingin ataita uhi."},"9":{"text":"Anua zuite hil ding a apei lai un, Ngai vawi, Jesu’n amauh ana kituohpi a, “Nuom un!” achi hi. Tualeh amauh ahing pei ua akeng atu ua, abeta uhi.","title":"Numeite kunga Jesu kilahna"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Zau sih unlen ka sanggamte Galili gam a pei dingin va hil un, khunah kei ahing mu ding uhi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh amauh apei lai un, Ngai vawi, vengmite lawikhat khopi sungah ahing lut ua, siempu liente kung ah, sil umdan zousie ava hilta uhi.","title":"Galkapte agolguhna uh"},"12":{"text":"Siempu liente upate toh akikhawm ua, akikup khawm zou un, galkapte kungah sum tampi apie ua,"},"13":{"text":"akung uah, “Zanlai ka imut kaal un, anuazuite ahing pei ua, Ama ana gumangta uhi chi un, achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Gam uhpipa’n ana zahkhah tahleh, Kouman ama ka sulungkim ding ua, noute na bit nading uhi” achi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n sum khu ala ua, ahil bangbang un abawlta ua, tuachi’n tam thu khu Judamite lah ah tuni tan in tambangin akigen nalai hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n nuazui sawm leh khatte khu Galili gam a Jesu’n aguotpiehna muol ah apeita uhi.","title":"Jesu nuazuite kunga kilahna","ref":"Mat. 26.32; Mak. 14.28"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Ama amu tah un abie ua, hinanleh kimkhatten aginglel uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu akung ua hing peiin, amauh ahoupi a, “Van leh lei a thuneina zousie ka kunga pieh ahita hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuazieh in pei unlen, namchin apat nuazui ding bawl unlen, Pa leh Tapa leh Hagausiengthou min in baptis unlen;","ref":"Nasep. 1.8"},"20":{"text":"thu ka hing piehte zousie zui dingin thu hil un, tualeh ngai un, Kei bangchih tan in, leitung tawp dongin na kung uah ka um ding hi, achi hi.” Amen."}}}}},"41":{"info":{"name":"Mak","shortname":"Mak.","abbr":[],"desc":"Mak gel khantanhoi"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian Tapa Jesu Khrist khantanhoi kipatna;","title":"Baptispa Johan leh athupuoh (Mat. 3.1-11 ; Luk. 3.3-16 ; Jn. 1.19-34)"},"2":{"text":"Guolnei Isai laibu ah: “Ngai vawi, ka sawltah na masang ah ka sawl a, aman na lampi asiel ding hi.","ref":"Mala. 3.1"},"3":{"text":"Gamdai a mi kikou aw in, Mangpa lamlien siel unlen, alampite sutang un,” achi chia kigiel bangin.","ref":"Isai. 40.3"},"4":{"text":"Johan in gamdai ah abaptis a, khelnate ngaidamna dingin kisiana baptis thu gen in ahing pei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Judia gam a mi zousie leh Jerusalem a umte zousie apawt ua, akung ah ava pei ua, akhelnate uh thupha tawi in Jordan lui ah baptisma atang chiet uhi."},"6":{"text":"Johan khu Sangawngsau mul puon silin, akawng savun kawnggah in agah a, tualeh a ann khu khaukhup leh gam khuoizu ahi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 1.8"},"7":{"text":"“Tualeh ka nua ah, kei sanga thupizaw ahing pei a, Kei pen kun a akedap khau sut taah zong ka hi sih hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Kei pen in tui in ka hing baptis a, hinanleh Aman Hagau siengthou in ahing baptis ding hi, chiin agen hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua hun lai in, Galili gam a Nazareth khuo akipat in Jesu ahing pei a, Jordan lui ah, Johan in baptisma atangsahta hi.","title":"Jesu baptisma tanna"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh tui akipat ahing pawtdoh tahin, vante kihonga, Hagau vakhu banga atunga hing kumsuh amu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n, “Nang ka Tapa ittah na hi a, Na tungah ka lungdam mama hi, chiin van akipat in aw khat ahing pawt hi.”","ref":"Siem. 22.2; Late. 2.7; Isai. 42.1; Mat. 3.17; 12.18; Mak. 9.7; Luk. 3.22"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Hagau in Jesu gamdai ah asawldoh pai hi.","title":"Jesu sol a a umna (Luk. 4.1-13 ; Mat. 4.1-11)"},"13":{"text":"Ama gamdai ah ni sawmli Setan sol in a um a, tualeh gamsate toh a um khawm a, vansawlsiengten ana aseppieh uhi."},"14":{"text":"Johan amat ua suongkul a akhum nua un, Jesu Pasian gam khantanhoi gen in Galili gamah ahing pei hi,","title":"Jesu’n nasep apatna (Mat. 4.12-17 ; Luk. 4.14 , 15)"},"15":{"text":"ahun atungta a, “Tualeh Pasian gam anaita hi, kisia unlen, khantanhoi gingta un,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 3.2"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Galili tuipi gei a avah lai in, Simon leh asanggampa Andru tuipi a lensep amu a, amauh nga man mi mawng ahi uhi.","title":"Jesu’n nuazui masate ahatna (Mat. 4.18-22)"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Hing zui un, mihing man dingin ka hing bawl ding hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh amaun alente uh nuasie in azui paita uhi."},"19":{"text":"Khuna pat a themkhat apei gamlat deu leh Zebedi tapate Jakob leh asanggampa Johan amu a; amaute alen uh phaw a kuong sung a um ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman amauh a han pai a, tuachi’n amaun apa uh Zebedi leh suoh athalahte utoh kuong ah anuasie ua, Ama azuita uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute Kapernaum khuo ah alut ua, tualeh khawlni in kikhopna inn ah alut pai a, thu ahilta hi.","title":"Kapernaum a dawimat Jesu’n asuhdamna (Luk. 4.31-37)"},"22":{"text":"Athu hil khu lamdang asa mama ua, Aman laigiel mite banglou a, thuneitah banga thu ahil ziehin.","ref":"Mat. 7.28,29"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh akikhopna inn uah hagau bua nei mi khat a um a, aman,"},"24":{"text":"Kouma tangin hing um sah in; “Nazareth Jesu nang leh kouten bang ahiei kizopna inei? Koute sumang dinga hing pei na hiei mah? Nang koi na hiei chi ka hing thei uhi; Pasian Misiengthoupa na hi, chiin akikoukhie hi.”"},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n ama aphawh a, “Sip inlen asunga pat in hing pawt in,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh dawi buain tua mipa abawlgenthei a, ngaitah a kikou in asung apat in ahing pawtdohta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh a unpi un lamdang asa mama ua, tuachi’n “Tami bang avalong eile? Bang thuhilna tha khat ata ei le? Aman thuneitah in dawi buate nangawn thu apie a, Athu amang uhi, chiin akidongtuo uhi.”"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Galili gam kimvel zousie ah, gam chinteng ah aminthang paita hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh kikhopna inn akipat apawtdoh tahun, Simon leh Andru inn ah Jakob leh Johan toh alut pai uhi.","title":"Jesu’n Peter sungnu leh midang tampi asuhdamna (Mat. 8.14-17 ; Luk. 4.38-44)"},"30":{"text":"Tuanah Simon sungnu chithuo a damlou in ana lum a, tualeh amanu tanchin ana hil pai ua,"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama ahing pei a, amanu khut a vatuin aphong a; tuachi’n achithuo in a nuasie pai a, tualeh amanu’n ana uh aseppiehta hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh nitahlam ni tum zouin, damlou zousie leh dawi matte akungah ahing zawpi ua,"},"33":{"text":"khopi sunga mi zousie kotphung ah ahing kikhawm uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman mi tampi natna chi tuomtuom a nate ana sudam a, dawi tampi anotdoh a, tualeh dawiten Ama atheizieh un, aham ding uh aphal sih hi."},"35":{"text":"Zingmawng khovah masangin athou a, apawtdoh a mun sip khat ah apei a, thungetna ava nei hi.","title":"Jesu thungen ding a akuonna leh Kapernaum anuasiena"},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Simon leh akunga umten Ama asuita uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n amu tah un, akungah mi zousie’n “Nang ahing sui uhi,” achi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Aban a khuote ah zong pei vai khuna thu ka gen theina dingin, tuami ding mawnga hing pei ka hi ziehin.”"},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Aman Galili gam pumpi a a kikhopna innte uah thute gen in, dawite a notdoh zel hi.","ref":"Mat. 4.23; 9.35"},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipha khat akungah ahing pei a, amasang ah akhupdin a, “Na ut leh na hing siengsah thei hi chiin angen va ngua hi.”","title":"Mi pha damsahna (Mat. 8.1-4 ; Luk. 5.12-16)"},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n ahepi mama a, akhutin azam a, akhoi a, “Ka ut hi, siengthou tain,” achi hi."},"42":{"text":"Agenzou tahin, aphahna in anuasie pai a, ahing siengthouta hi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n ama khautahin akham a, asawlkhe paita hi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh akungah, “Koima kunga bangma genlou dingin pilvangin, hinanleh pei inlen siempu kungah va kilah inlen, na kisiensuona dingin Mosi thupieh silte valaanin, na dam siengta chi atheina dingun,” achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 14.1-32"},"45":{"text":"Hinanleh ama apawt a, tua thu nasatah a tangkoupi in aphuongzah panta. A, tuachi’n Jesu alangtang in khopi sungah alut theita sih a, gamdai munte ah a umzawta hi, tualeh mun chin a kipat in akung ah mite ahing pei uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh ni bangza ahiei nuain Kapernaum khuo ah ahing lut kia a, inn ah a um chi thu akithangta hi.","title":"Jesu’n mizeng asuhdamna (Mat. 9.1-8 ; Luk. 5.17-26)"},"2":{"text":"Innsung leh kotkha kim nangawn ah umna ding umlou khopin mi tampi ahing kikhawm pai ua, tualeh Aman akung uah thu agen hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi li in mi zeng khat ahing zawng ua akung ah ahing pui uhi."},"4":{"text":"Mipi atam seng zieh a, akung nai a ahing pei theilou tahun, a umna inntung aphetvang ua, aphevang zou un, mi zeng khu alupna toh akhaikhe suh uhi."},"5":{"text":"Jesu’n aginna uh amu tahin, mi zengpa kungah, “Tapa na khelnate ngaidam ahita,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh laigielmite pawlkhat khum mun ah atou ua, alungsim un,"},"7":{"text":"“Bangdinga tam mipa’n Pasian gensie a, tambang thu agen ahiei? Pasian chi loungal koi ahiei khelnate ngaidam thei?” chiin angaituo uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n alungtang un tambangin angaituo uh chi alungsim in ana thei pai a akung uah, “Bangdinga tam thute na lungtang ua ngaituo na hi uoi?"},"9":{"text":"Mi zengpa kunga, na khelnate ngaidam ahita chi leh Thou inlen, na lupna la inlen, kengin peitain chi koizaw agen nuomzaw ei?"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Mihing Tapa in leitung ah khelnate ngaidam theina anei hi, chi na theina dingun,” mi zengpa kung ah,"},"11":{"text":"“Thou inlen, na lupna la inlen, na innlam ah pei in, ka hing chi ahi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh ama khu adingtou pai a, amaute zousie mitmu ah alupna ala a, apeita hi, tuachi’n a unpi un lamdang asa mama uhi. “Tambang sil mawng mawng imu ngai sih uhi,” chi’n Pasian aphat uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n apawtdoh a, tuipi gei ah apei kiata hi, tualeh mipite akungah ava pei ua, tualeh Aman thu ana hil hi.","title":"Levi hatna (Mat. 9.9-13 ; Luk. 5.27-32)"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh apei kawmin Alphai tapa Levi, sie donna muna tou amu a, akungah, “Hing zui in,” achi hi. Tualeh adingdoh a Ama azuita hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n Levi inn a annkuong a im laiin, siedongmite leh mikhiel tampiin Jesu leh anuazuite a impi ua, mi tampiin, anua azui uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh laigielmite leh Pharisaiten Jesu siedong mite leh mikhielte toh ann nekhawm amu tahun anuazuite kungah, bangchidan ahiei? “Siedongte leh mikhielte toh aneh a adawn?” achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Jesu’n tuakhu azah tahin, akung uah, “Mi chidamten daktorpa atulmaw sih ua, mi damlouten atulmaw zaw uhi, midihtatte han ding a hing pei ka hisih a, mikhielte han dinga hing pei ka hizaw hi” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Johan nuazuite leh Pharisaiten ann angawl zel uhi. Tualeh mite ahing pei ua akungah, “Bangdinga Johan nuazuite leh Pharisaite nuazuiten ann angawl ua, Nang nuazuiten angawllou uh ahiei?” achi uhi.","title":"Ann ngawl thua dohna (Mat. 9.14-17 ; Luk. 5.33-39)"},"19":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Moupuite kunga mouneipa aum laisie moupuiten ann angawl thei ngai uh amah? Mouneipa akung ua aum laisie ann angawl thei sih ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh mouneipa akung ua kipat a puimang nite ahing tung dinga, tua ni chiengin ann angawl ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Koiman puonlui puon tha them in aphaw ngai sih hi, phawta uleh, aphawna pen in aluipen aluoi keh dinga, asuse zaw sem ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Koima’n uoin tha, savun thawl lui ah athun ngai sih hi; thunta uleh uoin tha in savun thawl aphukeh dinga, uoin akibo dinga, tualeh savun thawl zong aseta ding hi; uoin tha khu savun thawl tha a thun ding ahi zaw hi, achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh khawlni in bulei lai kantan in apei ua, tualeh anuazuiten apei kawm un, buvuite azut panta uhi.","title":"Khawlni tan thu a dohna (Mat. 12.1-8 ; Luk. 6.1-5)","ref":"Danp. 23.25"},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharisaiten akungah, “En vawi, bangdinga amaun khawlni a bawl sienglou abawl uh ahiei?” achi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “David leh alawmte atahsap ua, agilkiel lai ua, asil bawl uh na simkha ngai sih uh amah?"},"26":{"text":"Abiathar siempu lienpen ahilai a, Pasian inn a alut a, siempute loungal in aneh sienglou tanghou siengthou kikoi aneh a, alawmte zong apieh thu,” achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 24.9; 1 Sam. 21.1-6"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Aman “Khawlni khu mihing a dinga bawl ahi a, mihing khu khawlni a dinga bawl ahi sih hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mihing Tapa khu Khawlni Mangpa zong ahi,” achi hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu kikhopna inn ah alut kia a; tuanah mi khutzaw khat ana um hi.","title":"Mi khutzaw suhdamna (Mat. 12.9-13 ; Luk. 6.6-10)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama amawsiet theina dingun, khawlni a asuhdam leh suhdamlou a sim-et uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman khutzawpa kungah, na mailam ah “Hing pei vawi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Khawlni in silhoi bawl ahiei sieng, ahisihleh sil hoilou bawl?” hundam ahiei sieng ahisihleh thalup, achi hi. Hinanleh amaute asip dide uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n alungtang uh khau zieha lunggim mama leh lungthah puma, amaute a etvel nuain, Aman tua mipa kungah, “Na khut zahdoh vawi,” achi hi. Tualeh aman azahdoh a, alangkhat bangin adamta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharisaite apawtkhie ua, Ama athalup theina dan ding uh ngaituoin Herod pawla mite toh akithukum pai uhi.","title":"Pharisaiten Jesu thalup dan ding akikum uh (Mat. 12.14-16 ; Luk. 6.11)"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu khu anuazuite toh tuipi langah apeita ua, tualeh Galili gam a kipat mi tampiin Ama azuita uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh asil bawl thupi dante azah un, Judia gam a kipat, Jerusalem akipat, Idumea akipat bangin, Jordan gal akipat bangin; Tai-ar leh Sidon khokim a kipat bangin, mipi thupitah akungah ahing pei uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh mipite ziehin, Ama dinga kuong neu khat mansa a na koi dingin anuazuite ahil a, tuachilouin Ama atuonchil kha ding uhi.","ref":"Mak. 4.1; Luk. 5.1-3"},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen mi tampi asudamta a; tuachi’n natna nei poumain Ama akhoikhah theina ding un abaw valuoi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n dawibuate’n Ama amutah chiengun amasang ah akhupboh ua, “Nang Pasian Tapa na hi” chiin akikou uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Aman atanchin gendoh vawtlou dingin khautah in thu apie hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama muol tung ah apeitou a, adeituomte akungah ahan a, tualeh amaute akungah ahing pei uhi.","title":"Jesu’n sawm leh nite atelna (Luk. 6.12-16)"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Akunga um ding leh thugen a asawlkhieh theina dingin sawm leh nite aguot a,"},"15":{"text":"Damloute suhdam theina leh dawite deldoh theina thu nei dingin,"},"16":{"text":"Aman Peter chia amin aphuopiehpa Simon,"},"17":{"text":"Zebedi tapa Jakob leh Jakob sanggampa Johan; amaute min Boanerges aphuo a, tua khu vanging tapate china ahi;"},"18":{"text":"Andru, Philip, Batholomai, Mathiu, Thomas, Alphai tapa Jakob, Thaddai, Kanaan mi Simon,"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh amansahpa Juda Iskariot zong ahi uhi. Tualeh amaute inn sung ah alutta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh mipi tampi ahing peikhawm kia ua, tuachi’n ann nangawn zong ane thei sih uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh ama mite mamain tam thu azah tahun, amaw ahita, chiin “Ama mat tum in apawtdohta uhi.”"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh laigielmite “Jerusalem khuo a kipat a hing peisuhten Belzabub toh kizawl ahi, tualeh dawimangpa zieh a dawite anawdoh ahi,” achi uhi.","title":"Ngaidam theilou khelna (Mat. 12.24-32 ; Luk. 11.17-23)","ref":"Mat. 9.34; 10.25"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman amaute akung ah ahan a, akung uah, gente thuin thu agen a, “Bangchin Setan in Setan anawtdoh thei diei?”"},"24":{"text":"Gam khat kilangkhen in kidouta leh tua gam khu adingdoh thei sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh innkuon khat kilangkhenin kidouta leh tua innkuon zong adingdoh thei sih ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Setan zong ama leh ama kidou in, kilangkhen leh adingdoh zou sih dinga, amangthaizaw ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Mi Koiman mihatpa kaantom masa louin mi hatpa inna lut in aneitahte alahpieh thei sih a, akaantom nua chiengin aneitahte alahpieh thei ding hi."},"28":{"text":"“Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, Mihing tate a khelna zousie uleh, Pasian agensietna lam ua, bangpou agente uh ngaidam ahi ding ua,"},"29":{"text":"hinanleh Hagau Siengthou gense poumain bangchih tan in ngaidamna amu sih dinga, kumtawn mawpaina ah a um zaw ding hi.”","ref":"Luk. 12.10"},"30":{"text":"Amaun dawibua nei ahi achi zieh ua, “Tam thu agen ahi.”"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n a nu leh asanggamte ahing pei ua, inn pulam ah a ding ua, Ama han ding in mi asawl uhi.","title":"Ki unauna dih (Mat. 12.46-50 ; Luk. 8.19-21)"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh akim ah mipi tampi atou ua, amaun akungah, “En vawi, inn pulam ah na nu leh na sanggamten ahing sui uhi,” achi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman adawnga akung uah, “Kanu leh ka sanggamte koite ahi uoi?” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n akim a toute a en kuol a, “En un ka nu leh ka sanggamte!"},"35":{"text":"Koipou Pasian deilam bawl poumate ka sanggampate, ka sanggamnute leh ka nute ahi uh,” achi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh tuipi pieu ah thu ahil pan kiata a; tualeh mipihon tampi akungah ahing kikhawm ua, tuachi’n tuipi tunga kuong sungah alut a, atouta a, tualeh mipi zousie lui pieu a leitungah, tuipi lam ngain a um uhi.","title":"Buchi thepa gentena thu (Mat. 13.1-23 ; Luk. 8.4-15)","ref":"Luk. 5.1-3"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh amaute gentena thu in sil tampi ahil a, athuhilna ah akung uah;"},"3":{"text":"“Ngaikhie unlen en vawi un, buchithepa khat buchithe dingin akuon a;"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, athe laiin, kimkhat lam gei ah akie a, tualeh tungleeng vate ahing pei a, ane khawngta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kimkhatte suongsilei lah ah akie a, lei asalou ziehin apou pai hi;"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh ni ahing sat in emvuoi in a um a, hui ahahlou ziehin a gogawp siengta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh kimkhatte loulingnei lah ah akia a, loulingnei khu ahing khang a, adepmangta a, ga aneita sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh kimkhatte lei hoi ah akie a, apou a, ahing khanglien pai a, agata a, ale sawmthum bang, ale sawmguh bang, ale zakhat bangin ahing pungta hi, achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Koipou zahna ding bil nei in za heh,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Amatanga a um laiin akima sawm leh nite toh umten gentena thu adongta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Pasian gam thuguh khu noute kung a na thei ding ua pieh ahi, hinanleh pulam mite a dingin pen sil zousie gentena thu a hil ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachia, Mu pen amu thei na ua, atheisiem sih ding uh, zah pen aza ding ua, atheisiem tuom sih ding uh; tuachilou in pen, ahing kihei kia ding ua, akhelnate uh ngaidam ahi kha ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 6.9,10"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Tam gentena thu na theisiem sih uh maw? Tuachi ahileh bangchi’n gentena thu dangte zousie na theisiemta ding uoi?","title":"Buchithepa gentena thu hilchienna (Mat. 13.18-23 ; Luk. 8.11-15)"},"14":{"text":"Buchithepa in thu athe ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh lam gei a thu thenate khu tambang ahi uh, thu khu azah tah un, Setan ahing pei a, alungtang ua thu kithe khu alamang pai hi."},"16":{"text":"Tambangma in suongsi lei a kithe khu tamte ahi uh, amauten thu azah tahun kipahtahin apom pai ua;"},"17":{"text":"hinanleh amauah thahui anei sih ua, hun tomnou khat a um ua, tuami nua a thu zieh a gimthuohna ahiei ahisihleh suhgentheina ahing um chieng in apua pai uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh loulingnei lah a kithete khu tamte ahi uh, amauten thu aza ua;"},"19":{"text":"leitung hinkhuo ngaituonate, hausat utna solnate leh sil dangdang deigawnate, ahing lut chiengin, thu khu a deep a galouin a umta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh lei hoi a kithete tamte ahi uh; thu aza ua apom ua, ale sawmthum bang, ale sawmguh bang, ale zakhat bangin aga uh,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Meivah akoina koilou a, law nuoi ahiei, ahisihleh lupna nuoi ahiei a koi dingin ahing la ngai uh amah? Meivah tunna ah akitungzaw hilou amah? achi hi.","title":"Meivah gentena (Luk. 8.16-18)","ref":"Mat. 5.15; Luk. 11.33"},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen phuonzah lou ding a im bangma a um sih a, langlou ding a phuol zong bangma a um sih hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.26; Luk. 12.2"},"23":{"text":"Koipouin zahna ding bil anei leh za heh,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Na zah uh bang ahiei pilvang un, na tena mama uah ahing te pieh ding ua, tualeh nou angaikhete kungah, ahing pieh belap ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 7.2; Luk. 6.38"},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen koipou anei kungah, piehbe ahi dinga, tualeh koipou aneilou khu anei sun zong lapieh ahiding,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 13.12; 25.29; Luk. 19.26"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Aman “Pasian gam khu, tambang ahi, mi’n lei ah haichi tu henlen;","title":"Hichi gentena"},"27":{"text":"Zan chiengin a imu a, sun chiengin athou zel a, haichi khu ana pouin, ana khanglien a, bangchidan a poua, bangchidan a khanglien ahiei chi, athei sih hi."},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen leiin amain ga ahing suong zel a, amasapen in ana, tuachi’n avui, tuazou chiengin avuiah atangpiching."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh aga khu ahing mintah chiengin, bu lah ahun taah ziehin kawite in a at paita hi.”","ref":"Joel. 3.13"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Aman “Pasian gam khu bangtoh itekah ta diei? ahisihleh bang toh gente a gen ding i ta uoi?","title":"Ankamtang gentena (Mat. 13.31-35)"},"31":{"text":"Tami ankam chi tang khat lei a akitu chiengin, haichi zousie sangin neupen nanleh,"},"32":{"text":"Atu nua un ahing pou a, loupa zousie sangin ahing lienzaw a, bazam lien tahtah ahing nei a, tuachi’n tung leeng vaten aliim nuoi ah bu asep uhi, tuabang ahi,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh tambang gentena thu tampiin, amauh theisiem thei dandan in thu agen hi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh gentena thu louin akung uah, thu agen ngai sih hi; tualeh nuazuite toh amauh ngen a a um chieng un, nuazuite kung ah sil zousie ahilchien zel hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuami ni mama in nitahlam ahing hitah in, Aman akung uah, “Galkhat lam ah igalkai ding uh” achi hi.","title":"Jesu’n tuipi asipsahna (Mat. 8.23-27 ; Luk. 8.22-25)"},"36":{"text":"Amaun mipite apeisan nua un, Ama aum ngai bangbangin kuong ah apeipi paita uhi. Tualeh akungah kuong neute zong a um hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n khopi hui thupitah ahing laangta a, tualeh tui kihawt khu akuong sung uah, ahing lut vazung ta a, tuachi’n ahing dim phielta hi."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama pen kuong meilam ah taangkhap khap in imuin a um a, tuachi’n aphong ua, akungah, “Siepa ka manthai uh khoh salou na hiei mah?” achi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama ahing thou a, huipi aphawh a, tuipi kungah “Sip inlen um khinkhian in” achi hi. Tuachi’n hui khu atawpta a, ahing sip dideta hi."},"40":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Bangding a hichi zau na hi uoi? Ginna mawngmawng na neilou uh bangchidan ahiei?” achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh zau chitahin azau ua, khat leh khat akihou ua, “Tam mipa koi ahia, huipi leh tuipi nangawn in athu ahichi man uh,” achi uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuipi gal langkhat Gadara mite gam ahing tungta uhi.","title":"Gerasin mi dawimatpa damsahna"},"2":{"text":"Kuonga kipat ahing pawtdoh tahin, dawi nin pai mi khat han akipat a hing pawt in Ama ana lamtuo pai hi,"},"3":{"text":"ama pen han lah ngen a teng ahi a, koiman siakhainieng nangawn in akaan thei sih uhi;"},"4":{"text":"kolbul in sia khainieng bangin ana kan ngaita ua, hinanleh siakhainiengte abottan a, kolte bang asutan a, mi koiman athunun zou sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Sun leh zan in muol leh taangte leh hante ah a um a akikou a, suong in ama leh ama aki at zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh aman gamla tah a pat Jesu amu tahin atai a ava beta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh aw ngaitahin akikoukhie a, Jesu Pasian Tungnungpen Tapa, “Nang kei bang hing law sawm na hiei? Hing sugim lou dingin Pasian min in ka hing ngen ahi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Nang dawibuapa tua mipa sung akipat in hing pawt in,” achita hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n “Na min bang ahiei?” chi’n adong a, tualeh aman “Ka min Ligion ahi, aziehpen tampi ka hi uh,” chi’n adawng hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh tua gam akipat amauh sawl khe lou dingin Jesu kungah hatang nget in angen hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh khuna muol pangah voh hon tampi ata uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh “Dawibuate zousiein voh sungah hing sawl in, a sung ua ka lut theina dingun,” chi’n akungah angen uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n phalna ape pai hi. Tuachi’n dawibuate khu apawtdoh ua, voh sungah alut ua, voh hon tul ni phiel ahi ua, ken ah tuipi lam ah hatai in atai suhta ua, tuachi’n tui sung ah ashita uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n voh chingte atai ua, khopi sung leh gam sungah tam thu ava hil ua, tuachi’n tua sil hing um khu bang ahiei chi en dingin mite ahing pei uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu kung ahing tung ua, dawi pai, nuoi matpa khu puonsil a, lungsim ngaina puo a, na tou ahing mu ua, azauta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh tua sil umdan na muten, dawi matpa tunga sil tun dan leh vohte um dante amauh ana hil uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama khu agam ua kipat a pawtkhe dingin angenta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh kuonga tuong ding a akisah laitah in dawimat pa’n Jesu kunga um ding angen hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahivang in Jesu’n aphal sih a, akung ah, “Na inn ah na lawmte kungah pei inlen, Mangpa’n nanga dinga sil thupi ahing bawlpieh dante leh nang ahing hepi dante va hil in,” achi zawta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n apei a, Jesu’n ama dinga sil thupi abawlpieh dante, Dekapolis khuo ah ataangkoupita a; tualeh mizousie in lamdang asa mama uhi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu kuonga galkhat lam a ahing galkai kia tahin, mipi tampi akungah ahing peikhawm ua, tualeh Ama pen tuipi pieu ah a um hi.","title":"Jairas tanu suhdamna (Mat. 9.18 , 19 ; Luk. 8.41-42)"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh En un, kikhopna inna vaihawmte laha mi khat amin Jairas ahing pei a, Jesu amutahin akengbul ah abohkhup a,"},"23":{"text":"“Katanu naupang neunou shi dihdih in alum a, ahing dam a, ahing hin kia na dingin, hing pei a atunga na khut koi dingin ka hing ngen hi; chiin hatang nget in angen hi.”"},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu ama toh azawh a, mipi tampi in azui ua, atuom valuoi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh numei khat kum sawm leh kum ni si luonga china a um a,","title":"Numei sinei damsahna (Mat. 9.20-22 ; Luk. 8.43-48)"},"26":{"text":"Zatou tampi akipat in sil tampi ana thuohta a, anei zousie ana zang siengta a, phattuom nahsang in ase zaw sem sem hi."},"27":{"text":"Amanu’n Jesu tanchin azah tahin, anua ah mipi lah ah ahing pei a apuon akhoi a;"},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen alungsim in, “Apuon bep khoi leng zong suhdam in ka um mai ding hi,” chiin angaituo hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n asi luong khu akang paita a, anatna adamta chi atahsa ah akitheita hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n asunga kipat in silbawl theina apawt chi athei pai a, mipi lah ah akihei kawikawi a, “Koi ahiei ka puon khoi?” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh anuazuiten akungah, “Mipi in ahing tuom valuoi chi na mu a, Koi ahiei ahing khoi?” nachi, achi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Aman tua sil bawlnu mu tumin a en kawikawi hi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh tua numei in atunga sil kibawl athei a, zau leh chitun pumin ahing pei a, amasangah abohkhup a, akungah thudih zousie ahilta hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman numei kungah, “Tanu na ginna in ahing damsahta hi, hamuong tahin pei inlen, na natna akipat in damta in” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Aman thu agen laitah in kikhopna inn a vaihawmpa inn akipat in mi ahing pei ua, “Na tanu ashita hi, bang dinga Siepa subuoi nalai ding na hiei mah?” ahing chi uhi.","title":"Jairas tanu adamta hi (Mat. 9.23-26 ; Luk. 8.49-56)"},"36":{"text":"Jesu’n thu kigen azah tahin, kikhopna inn a vaihawmpa kung ah, “Zau sin gingta mai in,” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Aman Peter leh Jakob tualeh Jakob sanggampa Johan chilou mi dang koiman Ama azui uh aphal sih hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n kikhopna inn a vaihawmpa inn ah ahing tunga, Jesu’n ana buoi vengvung u’leh, ngaitah a, kap leh mau a, na umte amuta hi."},"39":{"text":"Ava lut tahin, akung uah, “Bangding a buoi vengvung a kap na hi uoi? Naupangnu ashi sih a, imu ahi bou hi,” achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten tahsanglou seng in anuisan uhi. Hinanleh Aman a unpi un anotdoh a, naupangnu nu leh pa leh azawpite apui a, naupangnu umna ah alutta uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman naupangnu khut atu a, akungah “Talitha kumi,” achi a, tua khu “Naupangnu aw thouin ka hing chi hi” china ahi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n naupangnu khu athou a, apei pai ngal hi; amanu khu kum sawm leh kum ni mi ahita hi. Tualeh amaute lamdang sahnain adim uhi."},"43":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman akung uah, tam thu koima’n thei sih heh, chi’n khautah in thu apie hi; tualeh amanu khu aneh ding bang ahiei khat pie un achi hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n khuna kipat in a pawt a, Ama umna gam lam ah ahing tungta a, tualeh anuazuiten Ama azui uhi.","title":"Nazareth ah Jesu anuol uh (Mat. 13.54-58)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh khawlni ahing hiin kikhopna inn ah thu ahil panta hi. Tualeh mitampi athuhil zaten lamdang asa mama ua, “Tam mipa’n tam thute hei a kipat a amu hiei? Akunga pilna kipie bang pilna ahi a, akhutin hichi va-ia a sillamdang abawl bangchidan ahiei? achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ama khu Mari tapa, Jakob, Jose, Judas leh Simon sanggampa sing bawl siempa khu hilou amah? Asanggam numeite zong tana ikung ua um hilou uh i?” achi uhi. Tuachi’n atungah alungkimta sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n akung uah, “Guolnei khu ama gam sung leh ama hienglesante lah leh ama innkuonte lah chiloungal ah pahtawi lou in a um ngai sih,” achi hi.","ref":"Jn. 4.44"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi damlou tawmnou khatte tunga khut koi a asuhdamte chiloungal khunah sil thupi mawngmawng abawl theita sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Agintat lou zieh un lamdang asa mama hi. Tuachi’n khoneute ah thuhil in avah kuol zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Aman sawm leh nite akungah ahan a, ni niin asawldoh a, dawibuate tunga thuneina zong apie hi.","title":"Sawltah sawm leh nite nasem dinga sawlna (Mat. 10.1-42 ; Luk. 9.1-6)"},"8":{"text":"Aman akhuolzinna dingun chiengkhut chiloungal bangma, thungpi zong, tanghou zong, akawnggahna uh asum ip ua sum zong kenglou dingin, amaute thu apie hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh kedappen but unlen, puon ah ni sil sih un achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Aman akung uah agenbe nalai a, “Heisung mun ah na tunna inn phot uah, khuna kipat na pawtdoh masangsie un umden un."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh koi hinanleh ahing tunsahlou ua, na thu u’zong angai nuom sih u’leh, khuna kipata na pawtdoh chieng un, amaute theipitu hiding in na kengtaw ua leivui thingkhie un. Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, vaihawm ni chiengin tua khopi thuoh ding sangin Sodom leh Gomorrah thuoh khu adan a um zaw ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 13.51; Luk. 10.4-11"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n akuondoh ua, mite akisia ding uh ahi, chi thu agenta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh dawi tampi anotdoh ua, damlou tampi sathau nu in asudam zel uhi.","ref":"Jak. 5.14"},"14":{"text":"Tuin leengpa Herod in Jesu tanchin ana zata a, (Amin athan tah ziehin), “Baptispa Johan mishi lah akipat ahing thou kiata a, tuazieh in tam silbawltheinate’n ama ah sem ahi ve,” achi hi.","title":"Baptispa Johan shina (Mat. 14.1-12 ; Luk. 9.7-9)","ref":"Mat. 16.14; Mak. 8.28; Luk. 9.19"},"15":{"text":"Mi dangten “Elijah ahi” achi ua, midangten “Guolnei ahi, ahisihleh guolneite lah a khat ahi,” achi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Herod in, “A lu katan piehpa Johan ngel ahi; mishi lah akipat hing thou kia ahi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Herod in asanggampa Philip zi Herodia akitenpi taah zieh in, Herodia ziehin mi asawl a Johan amansah a, kaan in suongkul ah ana khumta hi.","ref":"Luk. 3.19,20"},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen Johan in Herod kungah, “Na sanggampa zi na kitenpi ngaina dan ahi sih,” ana chi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin Herodia in ama amuda a, thalup a ut a, hinanleh athat thei sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen Herod in Johan khu midihtat leh siengthou tah ahi chi athei zieh in agiinga ama ana humbit zel hi. Tualeh athugen azah chiengin lungdong zel nanleh kipah tahin a ngaikhe zel hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Herod in apien niin, ami thupite, galkap lamkai liente leh Galili gam a miliente adinga annkuong alui lai in, hun lemtang ahing umta hi."},"22":{"text":"Herodia tanu ahing lut a, alam a, Herod leh akunga toute akipah sahta a, tuachi’n leengpa’n naupangnu kung ah, “Na dei dei ngen in ka hing pe ding hi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Amanu kungah, “Na nget pouma, Ka gam kimkhat nangawn zong ka hing pe ding,” chiin akichiem nalai hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu apawtdoh a, anu kungah “Bang ka ngen diei?” ava chi hi. Tualeh “Anuin Baptispa Johan lutang”, ana chi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu kintah in leengpa kung ah ahing lut pai a, “Baptispa Johan lutang tu mamain kuong khat ah hing pe lachin ka ut hi,” chiin angen hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa alunggim mama ta a, hinanleh akichiemnate leh a kunga toute ziehin ana niel nuom sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh leengpa’n ama vengte lah a galkap khat asawl pai a, Johan lutang hing tawi dingin thu apeta hi; tualeh amapa ava pei a suongkul sungah alutang ava tanta hi."},"28":{"text":"Alutang khu kuong khat in ahing tawi a, naupangnu apie a, tualeh naupangnu’n anu kungah apeta hi."},"29":{"text":"Anuazuiten azah tahun, ahing pei ua, aluong ahing la ua, han ah asielta uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n sawltahte Jesu kungah ahing kikhawm ua, asil bawlte zousie uleh, athuhilnate uh ahing hil uhi.","title":"Sawm leh nite hing kile kiana (Luk. 9.10)"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Nouma tangin gam sip mun ah hing pei unlen khawldam tadi un” achi hi. Aziehpen mi tampi ahing kuon leh apei lam akiphamat den ua, ann nangawn zong ane man sih uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute kuongin mun sip ah atuom peita uhi.","title":"Mipi tulnga vahna (Mat. 14.13-21 ; Luk. 9.11-17 ; Jn. 6.1-14)"},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh mipi tampi in apei lai uh amu ua, tualeh mitampi in athei ua, khopi chintenga kipat in kengin ahing tai ua, amauh ana makhel ua, akung uah ahing pei khawmta uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu ahing pawtdoh tahin mipi tampitah amuta a, chingding neilou belamte bang ahizieh un ahepi sengseng ta a, thu tampi ahil panta hi.","ref":"Kisim. 27.17; 1 Leeng. 22.17; 2 Khang. 18.16; Ezek. 34.5; Mat. 9.36"},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n ni ahing ngiem seng tah ziehin anuazuite akungah ahing pei ua, “Tam gamsip mun ahi a, hun lah avaigeita a,"},"36":{"text":"amauten ikim vel a loute leh khuote a ava pei ua aneh ding uh bang ahiei khat beh, alei theina ding un, sawlkhie in, neh ding bangma anei sih uhi,” achi uhi."},"37":{"text":"Aman adawng a akung uah, “Nouten neh ding bang ahiei pie un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amaun akungah “Tanghou makhai zani man valeiin neh ding peding ka hi uoi?” achi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Aman akung uah “Tanghou pheng bangza na nei uoi? hing en vawi un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amaun anei za uh athei tah un, “Tanghou pheng nga leh nga ni,” achi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman abawn un loupa hing tungah apawl pawl a tousah dingin thu apie hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh aguol in zakhat bang, sawmnga bangin atouta uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Aman tanghou pheng nga leh nga nite ala a, vanlam en in aguolzawl a, tualeh tanghoute aphalsuo a, amasang ua luipieh dingin nuazuite kungah apie a, tualeh nga nite zong amaute zousie lah ah ahawmsah suohta hi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh abawn un ane ua, agilva chiet uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh aneh mawh uh tanghou nengte leh nga nengte seu sawm leh ni dim in aluoh uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh tanghou nete khu pasal ngen tul nga vel ahi uhi."},"45":{"text":"Aman mipite akikhensah sungin, nuazuite khu galkhat lam a Bethsaida khuo a na pei masa dingin kuong ah atuongsah pai hi.","title":"Jesu tuipi tunga kenga apeina (Mat. 14.23-33 ; Jn. 6.15-21)"},"46":{"text":"Tualeh mipite akikhensah nua in, thungen dingin muol ah apeita hi."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh nitahlam ahing hi tahin, kuong khu tuipi lai ah a umta a, Ama pen atangin tuol ah a umta hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman amauh khu huiin alelam lam a asem zieh a, kuong zap a, lungdong leh chimaw ahi uh amuta hi. Tuachi’n khovah kuon lamin tui tunga akenga peiin amauh lam hing zuon in, amauh peisuohsan atum hi."},"49":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama tui tunga keng a pei amu un, shiha khat hiva chi’n akikoukhie uhi."},"50":{"text":"Abawn un Ama amu chiet ua, abuoita uhi. Tuachi’n amauh ahoupi pai a, “Hamuong tahin um un, Keima ka hibou hi, zau sih un,” achi hi."},"51":{"text":"Tuachi’n kuong sungah akung uah atuong a, huipi atawpta hi. Tuachi’n amauten gen theiguollouin lamdang asa mama uhi."},"52":{"text":"Amauten tanghou thute atheisiem nawn sih uhi, alungtang uh ana akhau taah zieh in."},"53":{"text":"Galkhat lam agalkai tah un, Genesaret gam ahing tung ua, khunah kuong akhi uhi.","title":"Genesaret-a damnate"},"54":{"text":"Tualeh kuong akipat a ahing pawtdoh tah un, mipiten Ama ana theipai ua,"},"55":{"text":"Khum gam kimvel a mite ahing tai khawm ua, Ama a um chi atheiphahna tan uah, damloute alupna pum in ahing zawng uhi."},"56":{"text":"Heisung hinanleh, Khoneute leh kholiente, tualeh khopam lam ah zong alutna phot ah, damloute, vanzuona mun lah ah alumsah ua, Apuon mong beeh khoi theina angen vanguo ua, tualeh Ama khoi pouma adam zel uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharisaite leh laigiel mite lawikhat Jerusalem a kipat in akungah ahing hawkhawm uhi.","title":"Jesu’n Pharisaite aphawhna (Mat. 15.1-20)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh amaun anuazuite lawikhat in, khut bua pum a, chipen khut sillou a ann aneh uh amu tah un, dih asa sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Pharisaite leh Judate zousiein upate thugousie azui chinten zieh un akhut uh hoitah a sillou in ann ane ngai sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh van zuana muna kipat a ahing pei chiengun kisil masa louin ann ane ngai sih uhi. Tualeh thugousie dang tampi azui uh a uma; tuate khu noute, belte leh taubelte silsieng bang ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharisaite leh laigiel miten, “Bangdinga na nuazuite’n upate thugousie banga umlou a, khut sillou a, ann ne ahi uoi?” chi’n Ama adong uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman adawnga akung uah, “Isai in nou milepchiete thu ana genlawh khu adih ahi: Tam miten akam un ahing pahtawi ua, Hinanleh alungtang un kei ahing gamlat uhi.","ref":"Isai. 29.13"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Kei ahing bieh ukhu amawhna ahi, mihing thupiehte thugin dan a ahilzieh un, chia gel bangin."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen nouten Pasian thupieh na pampai ua, mihing thugousie na tudet chinten uhi; belte leh noute silsieng bang leh sil dang tampi tambang in na bawl uhi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Na thugousie uh na zui theina dingun, Pasian thupieh tangtah in na pampai uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen Mosi in, Na nu leh na pa zatat in; koipou anu ahiei apa ahiei hamselaw khu shi teitei heh, achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.12; Danp. 5.16; Pawt. 21.17; Siempu. 20.9"},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten mi khat in anu ahiei, apa ahiei kunga, Keima vang a na phattuomna ding uh “Korban” ahita tuakhu Pasian kunga (pieh ahita) achi uleh amapen azalen ding na chi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n anu ahiei, apa ahiei, a dingin bangma abawlpieh ding na phal nawn sih ua;"},"13":{"text":"na thugousie uh mi na piehsawn zieh un Pasian thu bangmalou na suohsahta uhi. Tualeh tambang sil tampi na bawl uhi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman mipi zousie akungah ahan a, akung uah, “Michin in ka thu ngaikhie unlen, theisiem un;"},"15":{"text":"Mihing pulam akipat a asunga lut a ama subua thei bangma a um sih hi; hinanleh ama a kipat a hing pawtdoh silte, tuate ngel khu mihing subua ahi zaw hi.”"},"16":{"text":"“Mi koipou zahna ding bil nei in za heh,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh mipite inn sunga alutsan nua in, anuazuiten tua gente thu adong chienta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Noute zong hichi va-ia a theisiemna neilou hi uchie izaw? Bangteng pulam akipata mihing sunga lut in, ama abuasah thei sih chi theilou na hi uoi mah?"},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen lungtang sunga lut lou a, agil sunga alut zawh zieh in leh adailenna a pawtkhe mai ahi ziehin” achi hi. (Tua khu ann chinteng asieng achina ahi)"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Aman “Mihing sung a kipata hing pawt tuami ngelngelin mihing abuasah hi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen sunglam a, mihing lungtanga kipat in, ngaituona giloute, angkawmnate, numei leh pasal zinei nailoute thangtatnate, tuolthanate;"},"22":{"text":"guhtatnate, ennate, gitlounate, lepchienate, teletnate, kimitsipnate, kigensietnate, kiletsahnate leh mottatnate, bang ahing pawtdoh zel hi."},"23":{"text":"Tam silgiloute zousie sunglam akipat hing pawt in mihingte asubua leng hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n adingdoh a, khuna kipat in Tai-ar leh Sidon gam sung ah apeita a, inn khat ah alut a koima thei ding adei sih a, hinanleh akiphuol zou sih hi.","title":"Jentel Phoinisia numei tanu suhdamna (Mat. 15.21-28)"},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n numei khat, atanu naupang nou dawi bua nei khat in atanchin ana za pai a, ahing pei a, akengbul ah abohkhupta hi."},"26":{"text":"Numei khu Greek mi ahi a, piendan thu ah Siro-Phoinikia mi ahi, amanu’n atanu sunga dawi nawdoh pieh dingin angen hi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n adawng a akungah, “Tate hing gilva phot uheh, tate tanghou lah pieh a uite kunga pieh akilawm sih hi,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n adawng a, akungah, “Adih hi Mangpa, hinanleh dawkan nuoi a uiten zong tate ann-neng kia ane zel sam uh hilou i,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akungah, “Na thugen zieh in peita ve leh, dawi khu na tanu sunga kipat apawtta hi, achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh amanu apei a, inn ahing tuntahin, atanu dawiin apawt khietsan, lupna tunga lum a muta hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Tai-ar gam akipat in apawt kia a, Sidon khuo, tawn in Dekapolis gam kantan zel in Galili tuipi ahing tungta hi.","title":"Mi bilbing leh hamtheilou suhdamna"},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi bilbing, ham zong ham chien theilou khat, akung ah ahing zawpi ua, atung a akhut koi dingin angen uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Aman mipi lah akipat in ama atuom in apeipi a, akhutmein abilsung akhoi pieh a, tualeh achil asiet a, alei akhoi a;"},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n vanlam en in anahkhe huoi-a, akungah “Ephphatha” achi hi, tua khu “Kihongin” china ahi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n abilte ahing kihong pai a, alei akiham a, chientahin aham theita hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman koima hillou dingin amauh thu apie a, hinanleh anah kham pou leh agenzah zaw sem sem uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh genthei guollou in lamdang asa ua, “Aman sil zousie abawl hoita hi, bilbingte khuo azasah a, ham theiloute aham sahta,” achi uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun lai in mipi atam mama ua, neh ding bangma anei sih ua, Jesu’n anuazuite akungah ahan a akung uah;","title":"Jesu’n mipi tul li avahna (Mat. 15.32-38)"},"2":{"text":"“Mipite tuin ka kungah ni thum neh neilou a um ahi tahzieh un ka hepi mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh amaute a inn lang uah peisahta leng lamkaal ah abasam kha ding uhi; pawlkhatte gamla tah akipata hing pei ahi ngal ua,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n anuazuiten adawng ua, “Koiin tam gamdai ah mihing hizapi tanghou in avazou diei?” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n “Aman tanghou pheng bangza na nei uoi?” chiin adonga; tualeh amaun, “Sagi” achi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman mipite tuol a tou dingin thu apie a; tanghou beu sagi ala a, kipahthu agen a, aphalsuo a, tuachi’n amasang ua lui dingin anuazuite kungah apie a, tualeh amaun mipite masangah aluita uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh nga tawmnoukhat zong anei ua, Aman tuate aguolzawl a, tuate zong amasang ua lui dingin thu apie hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n ane ua, agilva chietta uhi; tualeh akham val nengte uh akhop u’leh seu sagi adim nalai hi."},"9":{"text":"Anete khu mi tul li vel ahi ua; tuachi’n Aman amauh apeisah ta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Ama khu anuazuite toh kuong sungah atuong pai a, Dalmanutha gam atung ta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Pharisaite ahing pei ua, Ama ze etna dingin Ama akipat chiemtena ngen in Ama akinielpita uhi.","title":"Pharisaiten chiemtena asui uh","ref":"Mat. 12.38; Luk. 11.16"},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama khu alungsim in anah huoi a, “Bangding a tulai khangthaten chiemtena sui ahi uoi? Chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, tulai khangthate kungah chiemtena mawngmawng akipesih ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 12.39; Luk. 11.29"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh amaute nuasie in kuong ah atuong kia a, galkhat lam ah apeisanta hi."},"14":{"text":"Anuazuiten tanghou akeng manghil ua, tanghou pheng khat chilou kuong ah tanghou dang mawngmawng a nei sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Pilvang unlen, Pharisaite leh Herod tol lah ah kiveng un,” achi hi.","ref":"Luk. 12.1"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun tanghou “I nei lou zieh ahi chiin akingaituo uhi.”"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n atheitah in akung uah, “Bang dinga tanghou na neilou zieh ua kingaituo na hi uoi? Tutan a thei nailou leh theisiem nailou na hi uoi mah? Na lungtang uh tutan a tahsah nalai nahi uh maw?"},"18":{"text":"Mit nei napi a mulou na hi uoi mah? Bil nei napi a za lou na hi uoi mah? Tualeh thei ngitnget lou na hi uoi mah?","ref":"Jer. 5.21; Ezek. 12.2; Mak. 4.12"},"19":{"text":"Mi tul nga lah a tanghou pheng nga ka phalsuo lai in aneng seu bangza ahiei na luoh dim uh?” achi hi. Amaun akung ah, “Sawm leh ni” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Tualeh mi tul li lah a sagi ka phalsuo lai in aneng seu bangza ahiei na luoh dim uh?” achi hi. Amaun “Sagi” achi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Tu nangawn in na theisiem nalai sih uh maw?” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Bethsaida ah ahing tunga, akungah mitto khat ahing zawpi ua, Ama khoi dingin angen uhi.","title":"Bethsaida a mitto asuhdamna"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman mittopa khut atu a, kho pulam ah apuidoh a, tualeh amit ah chil asieta, atunga khut akoi zouin, “Khuo na mu thei ei?” chi’n adong hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n amapa ahing dahkhie a, “Mite sing pei bangin ka mu hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n amit ah akhut akoi kia a, amit ahahsah kia a, tuachi’n ahing damta a, mi chinteng chientah in amu theita hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman khosungah lut sinlen, “Khosung a mi koima zong hil sin, chiin a inn lam ah asawlta hi.”"},"27":{"text":"Jesu leh anuazuite apawtdoh ua, Kaisaria Philippi khuote ah apei ua, tualeh lampi ah anuazuite kungah, “Miten kei koi hi ahing chi uoi?” chiin adong hi.","title":"Peter in Jesu, Khrist ahi chia aphuonna (Mat. 16.13-23 ; Luk. 9.18-22)"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh amaun, “Baptispa Johan ahi, ahing chi uhi, hinanleh kimkhatten, Elijah ahi, ahing chi uh, tualeh mi dangten, Guolneite lah a khat ahi, ahing chi uhi,” chiin adawng uhi.","ref":"Mak. 6.14,15; Luk. 9.7,8"},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Ahileh nouten kei koi hi na hing chi uoi?” achi hi. Tuachi’n Peter in adawnga, akung ah, “Khrist na hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Jn. 6.68,69"},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman atanchin koima hil lou ding in amauh akhap chinten hi.","title":"Jesu’n ashi ding leh athawkiana ding agenlawhna"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, Mihing Tapa in sil tampi athuoh dingte upate, siempu liente leh laigiel mite, deilou a a um ding bang, leh tha a aum ding bang, tualeh ni thum nia a athaw kia dingte amauh ahil panta hi."},"32":{"text":"Aman tam thute kichien tahtahin agen hi. Tuachi’n Peter in Ama apui tuom a, aphawhta hi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama akihei a, anuazuite a en a, Peter a phawh a, “Setan, ka nua ah pei in, Nang Pasian silte ngaituo louin, mihing silte na ngaituo zaw hi,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Aman mipite leh anuazuite ahan a, akung uah, “Mi koipou in ahing zui ut leh ama gimthuoh khohsa louin, a kros puain hing zui heh,","title":"Nuazui hina dihtah (Mat. 16.24-27 ; Luk. 9.22-26)","ref":"Mat. 10.38; Luk. 14.27"},"35":{"text":"Mi koipou ahinna humbit ut in ataan dinga, hinanleh mi koipou keima leh khantanhoi zieh a ahinna taanin ahumbit ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.39; Luk. 17.33; Jn. 12.25"},"36":{"text":"Aziehpen mi’n leitung apum in nei henlen, ahinna tanta leh bang aphatuom diei?"},"37":{"text":"Ahisihleh, mi’n ahinna taangin bang ape diei?"},"38":{"text":"Mi koipou tulai khangtha angkawm hat leh giloute lah a keima leh ka thu zumpi khu, Mihing Tapa in zong vansawlsiengthoute toh a Pa thupina a kivon a ahing pei chiengin tua mi khu azumpi ding hi” achi hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Adihtah in ka hing hil ahi, Tamna ding lawikhatte, Pasian gam silbawltheina toh hing tung amu masangsie uh, shina chiem vawt lou ding a um uhi.”","title":"Mellamdanna (Mat. 16.28—17.3 ; Luk. 9.27-36)"},"2":{"text":"Ni guh nua in Jesu’n Peter, Jakob leh Johan azawpi a, atuom in muol sang tung khat ah amauh apei toupi a, tualeh amasang uah amel ahing kiheng lamdangta hi.","ref":"2 Pet. 1.17,18"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n apuonsilte leitunga puonsawpmi koima’n tuabanga asawp ngou theilou ding khopin, vua bang mai in angouin ahing ngouta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Elijah leh Mosi akung ah ahing kilangta ua, Jesu toh akihou uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in ahoupi a, akung ah “Rabbi, ei a ding in tana um ahoi hi; buh thum ibawl ding a, nanga ding khat, Mosi adingin khat, tualeh Elijah adingin khat,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Azau mama zieh un gen ding pen zong athei sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n meilum lom khat in amauh ahing lie a, tualeh meilum lah akipat in, aw ahing ging a, “Tami ka Tapa deitah ahi, ama thu ngai un,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 3.17; Mak. 1.11; Luk. 3.22"},"8":{"text":"Thakhat in akimvel uh a et u’leh, Jesu chilou akung uah midang koima amuta sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Muol apat a ahing kumsuh lai un, Mihing Tapa shina lah a kipata athawkia masangsie asil mute uh koima kunga hillou dingin thu apie hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua thu khu alungsim uah avom chinten ua, Mishi laha kipat thoukia achipen bang achina adiei? Chi’n akidong uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh amaun, “Bangdinga laigielmiten Elijah hing pei masa ding ahi achi uh adiei?” chi’n, Ama adong uhi.","ref":"Mala. 4.5; Mat. 11.14"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman adawnga akung uah, “Elijah pen ahing pei masa a, sil zousie abawl hoi mawng ahi, ahileh Mihing tapa in sil tampi, athuoh dinga muda-a bawlsiet a um ding ahi chia, atungtang thu bangchi dan a kigiel adiei? achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hing hil ahi, Elijah ahing pei zou thamta a, tualeh atanchin agel bang ngei un atung ah a ut ut un abawl zouta uhi,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Ama anuazuite kunga ahing tuntah in akim ua mipi tampitah leh laigiel miten amauh ana kinielpi uh amu hi.","title":"Pasal naupang dawimat hamtheilou suhdamna (Mat. 17.21 ; Luk. 9.37-42)"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh mipi zousie in Ama amu tah un, lamdang asa mama ua, akungah atai pai ua, chibai abuh uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman laigielmite kungah, “Amau’toh bang thu a kiniel na hi uoi?” chi’n adong hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite lah a khat in ahing dawnga, “Siepa aw, Ka tapa dawi hamtheilou nei na kungah ka hing zawpi hi."},"18":{"text":"Amatna mun pou ah tuol satna’n akinei sah a, tuachi’n achilphuon abuo a, aha agawt a, agawng deu deu hi; tuachi’n na nuazuite kunga hing nawdoh pieh un ka chi leh, abawl thei sih uhi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman adawng a, akungah, “Ginna neilou khangthate aw, na kung ua bangtan ahiei ka um ding a, bangtan ahiei ka hing thuohpi nahlai ding? ama khu ka kungah hing pui in,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama khu Jesu kung ah ahing zawpi ua, tualeh dawiin Ama amu tahin napitahin asugenthei pai a, tuachi’n tuol ah apua a, chilphuon kai niainuai in akilumlet kawi kawi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman apa kungah, “Tambanga ahing umna bangtan ahi tai?” chi’n a dong hi. Tuachi’n apa’n “Anaupan lai a kipan ahita hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh sumangthai dingin tamveipi mei ah leh tui ah asawnpua a; hinanleh Nangman bang ahiei khat beh na bawl thei leh hing hepi inlen, hing panpi in,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesu’n akung ah, “Na gintat pou leh agingtate a dingin sil zousie bawl thei ahi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n naupangpa pa khu akikoukhe pai a, mit hi luong pum in, Mangpa “Ka gingta hi, ka ginlana hing panpi in,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Jesu’n mipi hing taikhawmte amu tahin dawi bua khu aphawh a, akungah, “Nang hamtheilou leh bilbing, thu ka hing pie hi, asung apat hing pawt inlen lutkia nawn sin,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n dawi khu akikoukhie a, hatangpiin abawlgenthei a, tuazou in apawtta hi. Tualeh naupang khu mishi bangin a um a, mitampiten “Ashi ahi” achi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n ama khu akhut in atu a, aphonga, tuachi’n ahing thouta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu inn sunga ahing lut tah in, anuazuiten “Bangdinga kouten notdoh theilou ka hi uoi leh?” Chiin simthamin a dong uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Tambangte pen thungetna leh ann ngawlna loungal in apawt thei sih hi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n khuna kipat in apeidoh ua, Galili gam akantan ua, tualeh koima thei ding a ut sih hi.","title":"Ashina ding agenlawh niveina (Mat. 17.22 , 23 ; Luk. 9.43-45)"},"31":{"text":"Aziehpen anuazuite thu ahil a, akung uah, “Mihing Tapa khu mihingte khut a matsah ahi ding a, tuachi’n athat ding ua, atha nua uh ni thum ni in athoukia ding,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun athugen atheisiem sih ua, Ama lah a dong ngam sih uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama khu Kapernaum khuo ahing tunga, inn sunga a um lai in, anuazuite kungah, “Lampi a na kinielna uh bang thu ahiei?” chiin adong hi.","title":"Kingaingiemna thu a hilna (Mat. 18.1-5 ; Luk. 9.46-50)"},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh amauh hamlouin a um ua, aziehpen lampi ah koi ahiei alien pen ding chiin ahing kiniel malamta uhi.","ref":"Luk. 22.24"},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama atou a, sawm leh nite ahan khawm a, akung uah, “Mi koipou amasa pen a ut leh anukhiapen ahi ding a, tualeh mi zousie nasem in a um ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 20.26,27; 23.11; Mak. 10.43,44; Luk. 22.26"},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman naupang neu khat akai a, alah uah ading sah a, tualeh apom a, akung uah,"},"37":{"text":"mi koipou ka min a tambang naupang neu nou kipahpi pouma “Keima hing kipahpi ahi; tualeh Keima hing kipahpi pouma khu kei hing kipahpi ahisih a, kei hing sawlpa kipahpi ahi” zaw ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 10.40; Luk. 10.16; Jn. 13.20"},"38":{"text":"Johan in akungah, “Siepa mi khat na min a dawite notdoh ka mu ua, aman eite ahing zuilou zieh in ka khamta uhi,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh “Jesu’n ama kham sih un, aziehpen ka min a sil lamdang bawl ngal a anua chienga Kei hing gense pai mi a um sih hi, chi’n ama adawng hi."},"40":{"text":"Koi hitaleh ei hing doulou pouma khu ei lam a pang ahi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 12.30; Luk. 11.23"},"41":{"text":"Koipou Khrist mi na hi zieh ua ka min a dawn ding tui nou khat hing pe pouma khu, chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, akipahman mu ding ataan vawt sih ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.42"},"42":{"text":"Tualeh “Koipou kei hing gingta tam naupang neu nounoute lah a khat zong puasah mi khu angawng ah sumheh suong kikhi henlen tuipi ah kipailut leh ama adingin ahoizaw ding hi.","title":"Midangte dal lou ding (Mat. 18.6-9)"},"43":{"text":"Tualeh na khut in ahing puasah leh tankhie in. Khut ni nei a gawtmun mei mit theiloua na lut sangin; khut neilou a hinna a lut nanga dingin ahoizaw ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 5.30"},"44":{"text":"Athan uh ashi louna leh, meikuong ami louna ah."},"45":{"text":"Tueleh na kengin ahing puasah leh tankhie in; keng ni nei a gawtmun mei mit theilou a na lut sangin, kengbei a hinna a lut nanga dingin ahoizaw ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Athan uh ashi louna leh meikuong ami louna ah."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh na mit in ahing puasah leh kheikhie in, mit lang ni nei a gawtmun mei kuonga pailut a na um sangin mit langkhat nei a Pasian gam a lut nang a dingin ahoizaw hi.","ref":"Mat. 5.29"},"48":{"text":"Athan uh ashi louna leh meikuong a milouna ah.","ref":"Isai. 66.24"},"49":{"text":"Aziehpen michin meikuonga saw-al in a um dinga kithoina chinteng chi a saw-al in a um ding hi."},"50":{"text":"Chi pen ahoi a, hinanleh chiin a alna mansuo taleh, bang nachi alsah kia ta diei? Nouma mama ah chi kinei unlen, khat leh khat kilemtah in um un,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 5.13; Luk. 14.34,35"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n khuna kipat in adingdoh a, Jordan luigal lang khat a Judia gam ah apeita hi. Tualeh mipite akungah ahing kikhawm kia ua, Aman abawl ngaina bangin, thu ahil hi.","title":"Kikhulna thua dohna (Mat. 19.1-9)"},"2":{"text":"Pharisaite ahing pei ua, “Ama ze etna dingin mi’n azi akhul asieng ei?” chi’n a dong uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Aman adawng a, akung uah, “Mosi in noute bang thu ahing pie ei?” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun “Mosi in kikhulna lai giel a, kikhul aphal hi,” achi uhi.","ref":"Danp. 24.1-4; Mat. 5.31"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawnga, akung uah, “Na lungtang khau zieh ua, tam thupieh noute ding a, ahing na gelpieh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh leitung siem chiil a kipat in Pasian in amauh Pasal leh numei in asiem hi.","ref":"Siem. 1.27; 5.2"},"7":{"text":"Tam thu ziehin pasal in anu leh apa anuasie ding a azi langah abeh chinten ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 2.24"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n ani un sa pum khat ahita ding ua; tuachi’n ni ahi nawn sih ding ua, tahsa pumkhat ahizawta ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian in agawmsa khu mihingin khen sih heh, achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh inn sung ah anuazuiten tua thu khu Ama adong uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Mi koipou in azi akhul a, zi dang anei leh azi a angkawmsan ahi.","ref":"Mat. 5.32; 1 Kor. 7.10,11"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh numei in apasal akhul a, mi dang anei leh angkawm ahi hi.”"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n akhoi theina dingin naupangte akung ah ahing pui ua; hinanleh anuazuiten ahing puite ana phawh uhi.","title":"Naupangte Jesu’n aguolzawlna (Mat. 19.13-15 ; Luk. 18.15-17)"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n tua khu amu tahin alungkimta sih a, akung uah “Naupang neute ka kungah hing peisah unlen kham sih un, aziehpen Pasian gam khu hichibang mite a ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, mi koipou naupang neute banga Pasian gam kipahpi lou pouma asung ah alut sih ding uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 18.3"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman amaute apom a, atung uah akhut akoi a, amauh aguolzawlta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh lampi a pei dinga apawtdoh laiin, mi khat ahing tai a, Amasangah akhupdin a, akung ah, “Siepa hoi, kumtawn hinna ka tan theina ding in bang ahiei ka bawl ding?” chi’n adong hi.","title":"Tangval hausa in kumtawn hinna asui (Mat. 19.16-22 ; Luk. 18.18-23)"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akungah, “Bangding a hoi hing chi na hiei? Mi khat chiloungal ahoi Koima a um sih, tua khu Pasian ahi."},"19":{"text":"Thupiehte na thei vele, angkawm sin, tuolthat sin, Gu sin, theipitu dihlou in pang sin, mi sol sin, Na nu leh na pa zatat in, chite ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.13; Danp. 5.17; Pawt. 20.14; Danp. 5.18; Pawt. 20.15; Danp. 5.19; Pawt. 20.16; Danp. 5.20; Pawt. 20.12; Danp. 5.16"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman adawng a akung ah, “Siepa aw, tamte zousie, ka naupan lai a kipat a ka zui ahita hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n ama a en a, a itta a, akung ah, “Sil khat na sam nalai hi; pei inlen na neiteng zua inlen, mi zawngte kungah pie in, tuachi’n van ah gou na nei ding hi; tualeh hing pei inlen kross puo in hing zui in,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n amapa khu tua thu ah amai ahing muola, lunggim tahin apeita a, sum tampi nei mi ahi zieh in."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n a kimvel a en a, anuazuite kungah, “Mi hausate Pasian gam a lut hasat tuoh na mai e!” achi hi.","title":"Hauna in lampi adal (Mat. 19.23-26 ; Luk. 18.24-27)"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh anuazuiten athugente lamdang asa thei mama uhi. Hinanleh Jesu’n adawngkia a, akung uah, “Tate aw, hausatna muongte dingin Pasian gam a lut hasa hina va-ia e!"},"25":{"text":"Mi hausa Pasian gam a alut sangin, Sangawngsau phin bil vanga alutsuoh abailam zaw hi,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun genthei guollouin lamdang asa ua, tuabang ahileh “Koi hundam in a um zou diei?” akichi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n amauh a en a, “Tua khu mihing a dingin bawlguol ahisih a, hinanleh Pasian a dingin ahi theilou ahisih hi, aziehpen Pasian a dingin sil zousie ahi thei hi.”"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in akungah, “En vawi, kouten bangkim nuasie in ka hing zui ua, chi’n ahing gen panta hi.”"},"29":{"text":"Tuabep in Jesu’n a dawnga, “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, mi koipou keima zieh leh khantanhoi zieh a, inn ahiei, sanggampa ahiei, sanggamnu ahiei, pa ahiei nu ahiei, zi ahiei, tate ahiei, tualeh gamte ahiei nuasie khu;"},"30":{"text":"tu dam sung mama in, innte, sanggampate, sanggamnute, nute, tate leh bawlgentheinate toh, ale za a mu lou ding a um sih uh, tualeh hun hing tung ding a kumtawn hinna toh."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh mi tampi amasapente anukhia pente ahi ding ua, anukhiapente amasapente ahi ding uhi.”","ref":"Mat. 20.16; Luk. 13.30"},"32":{"text":"Amaute Jerusalem khuo zuontou a lampi a apeitou lai un, Jesu amasang uah apei a, tualeh amaun lamdang asa mama ua, azuipum un azau uhi.
