Tuachi’n Aman sawm leh nite atuom in azawpi kia a, atunga sil hing tung dingte ahil panta hi.","title":"Ashina ding agenlawh thumveina (Mat. 20.17-19 ; Luk. 18.31-34)"},"33":{"text":"“Ngai un, Jerusalem khuo a hawtou ding ihi ua, Mihing Tapa khu siempu liente leh laigiel mite kunga matsahin a um dinga, tualeh ama khu shi dingin amawpai ding ua, Jentelte khut ah apekhe ding ua;"},"34":{"text":"amaun apmai bawlna’n anei ding ua, ajep ding ua, chil asietkhum ding ua, tualeh athat ding ua, tualeh ani thum ni in athoukia ding hi,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zebedi tapate Jakob leh Johan ahing pei ua, akung ah, “Siepa ka nget pouma uh nang bawlpieh ding ka ut uhi” achi uhi.","title":"Jakob leh Johan ngetna (Mat. 20.20-28)"},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n akung uah, “Nou a dingin bang hing bawlpieh leng na ut uoi?” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, Na thupina ah, khat na zietlam ah, khat na veilam ah hing tousah in, achi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n akung uah, “Bang ahiei na nget uh na thei sih uhi; ka nou dawn ding na dawn thei ding uoi? tualeh Ka baptisma tan ding zong na tang thei ding uoi?” achi hi.","ref":"Luk. 12.50"},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, “Bawl ngam e,” achi uhi. Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, Ka dawn ding nou pen na dawn ngei ding ua, tualeh ka baptisma tan ding zong na tang ngei ding uh;"},"40":{"text":"hinanleh ka zietlam leh ka veilam a tou ding pen Kei pieh ding ahi sih a, ama-ua ding a kibawlpiehte ading ahi zaw ding hi, achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh sawmten tua thu azah tahun, Jakob leh Johan tungah alungkim tasih uhi."},"42":{"text":"Jesu’n amauh ahan a akung uah, “Jentelte tunga vaihawm dinga a guotte uh atung uah alal mama ua, ami liente un atung uah thuneina toh vai ahawm uh, chi na thei uhi.","ref":"Luk. 22.25,26"},"43":{"text":"Hinanleh noute lah ah tuabang ahi sih ding hi, mi koipou na lah ua mi lien hi ut khu na nasem un apang zaw ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 23.11; Mak. 9.35; Luk. 22.26"},"44":{"text":"Tualeh mi koipou na lah ua, masa pen ut khu mi zousie suoh a apan masah ding ahi."},"45":{"text":"Aziehpen Mihing Tapa zong miten a nna aseppieh dinga hing pei ahi sih a, mite nasep pieh ding leh mi tampi tatna dinga ahinna pe dinga hing pei ahi zaw hi,” achi hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerikou ah ahing tung ua; tuachi’n Jesu Jerikou akipat in anuazuite leh mipi tampi toh apeidoh lai un, Timai tapa Bartimai mitto lam gei ah khutdawin ana tou hi.","title":"Mitto Bartimai suhdamna (Mat. 20.29-34 ; Luk. 18.35-43)"},"47":{"text":"Tualeh Nazareth Jesu ahi chi azah tahin “Jesu’n, David tapa kei hing khotuo in,” chiin akikouta hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi tampiten ama sip dingin akham ua, hinanleh ama’n “David tapa kei hing khotuo in” chi’n akihakou semsem hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu ading a, “Ama hing han un” chiin thu apie hi. Tuachi’n amaun mittopa ahing han ua, akung ah, “Hamuong tahin um inlen, thou in, Aman nang ahing han hi” achi uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman apuonsilte paikhie in ading a, Jesu kung ah ahing peita hi."},"51":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n ama ana houpi a, akungah, “Na tungah bang bawl leng na ut ei?” achi hi. Mittopa in akung ah, “Mangpa mu thei ka ut hi,” achi hi."},"52":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung ah, “Peita in, na ginna in ahing dam sahta hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amit ahing vah paita a, lampi ah Jesu azuita hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem kunga Olive muol a Bethphage leh Bethani khuo kung ahing tun tah un, anuazuite lah a mi ni asawl a;","title":"Jesu guolzou a Jerusalem alutna"},"2":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Na mai zawn ua khuo ah vapei unlen, na lut tah chieng un, sabiltung nou kikhi, atunga koima tuon ngailouna khat na mu ding ua, tua khu hing sut unlen, hing kai un."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh mi koi ahiei in na kung ua, bang dinga na sut uh ahiei? ahing chi leh Mangpa’n atulmaw ahi, tammun ah ahing koi kia pai na ding hi,” chi un achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh ava peita ua, gawlzinga kot pulam a, sabiltung nou kikhi ava mu ua, tua khu asutta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh khuna ding koite ahiei in akung uah, “Bangdinga sabiltungnou sut na hi uoi?” achi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akung uah, Jesu’n thu apieh bangin agen ua, tuachi’n apei sahta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun sabiltungnou khu Jesu kungah ahing kai ua, atungah apuonte uh apha ua, tualeh atung ah atuongta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh mi tampi in apuonte uh lampi ah apha ua, adangten zong gamlah a sawlbawhte satin lampi ah apha uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n amailam a peite leh anua lam a zuiten “Hosanna! Mangpa min a hing pei ahampha hi!","ref":"Late. 118.25,26"},"10":{"text":"Gam hing tung ding ipa David gam ahampha hi; Tungnung pen ah, Hosanna,” chiin akikou uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu Jerusalem a Pasian bieh inn ah a lut a, tuachi’n sil zousie a et kimvel zou in, nitah lam zong ahing hita a, sawm leh nite toh Bethani khuo ah apeita uhi."},"12":{"text":"Azing ni in Bethani akipata ahing pei lai un, agil ahing kielta hi.","title":"Theipi kung hut samsietna (Mat. 21.18 , 19)"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh theipi kung na-pha mama khat gamlapi a um a mu a, aga ka mu khahleh chin ava zuon a, amun atun tahin, anaa loungal bangma amu sih hi; theipi ga hun ahi lou zieh in."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n theipi kung ahoupi a, “Tubansie bangchitan in, nanga kipat koiman ga ne nawn sih heh” achi hi. Tualeh anuazuiten tua khu aza uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem ahing tung ua, tualeh Jesu Pasian bieh inn ah alut a, biehinn sunga van zua leh leite anotdoh panta a, sum heng mite dawkante leh palva zuate tounate asawnpua piehta hi.","title":"Jesu’n biehinn asuhsiengna (Mat. 21.12-13 ; Luk. 19.45-46)"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian biehinn a koiman van alut peisuohpi uh aphal sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Ka inn khu namchin dinga thunget na inn akichi ding, chia kigiel hilou ahiei mah? Hinanleh nouten gutate muna munpi inn na bawlta uhi.”","ref":"Isai. 56.7; Jer. 7.11"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh laigiel mite leh siempu lienten tam thu aza ua, Ama asuhmangthai theina ding uh asuita uhi; mi zousie’n athuhilte lamdang asah zieh un, Ama agiingta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh nitahlam ahing hitahin, khopi akipat in apawtdoh ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Zingmawnga ahing pei kawm un theipi kung khu azung tandonga agaw gawp khu ahing muta uhi.","title":"Ginna silbawl theina (Mat. 2.20-22)"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Peter in hing theidoh in akungah, “Rabbi en vawi, theipi kung na hamsiet khu agaw gawpta hi” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawnga, akungah, “Pasian ah ginna nei un."},"23":{"text":"Adihtah in ka hing hil ahi, mi koipou in tami muol kungah, kisuondoh inlen, tuipi ah kipailut in, chia alungtang a ginglel lou kei a agen khu hing tung ngeingei ding a hi, chia gingta poumain agen pouma amu ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 17.20; 1 Kor. 13.2"},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin na kung uah ka gen ahi, sil bangkim na thum chieng ua na nget pouma uh, musa in kingai un, tuachi’n na mu ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh thungen a na din pouma chieng un, koi tung hitaleh na lungdam louna uh aum leh, ngaidam un; tuachi’n na Pa uh van a um in zong na khelnate uh ahing ngaidam theina dingin.”","ref":"Mat. 6.14,15"},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh na ngaidam sih u’leh, “Na Pa uh van a um in zong na khelnate uh ahing ngaidam sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem khuo ah alut kia ua; tualeh Pasian biehinn sunga avah kawi lai in, siempu liente leh laigielmite akung ah ahing pei ua;","title":"Jesu thuneina aginlelna uh (Mat. 21.23-27 ; Luk. 20.1-8)"},"28":{"text":"akungah, “Bang thuneina na nei a, tam silte na bawl ahiei? tualeh tam silte bawlna dinga thuneina hing pie koi ahiei?” achi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n adawnga akung uah, “Ken zong thu khat ka hing dong ding, hing dawng un, tuachi’n bang thuneina nei a tam silte ka bawl ahiei, chi ka hing hil ding."},"30":{"text":"Johan Baptisma khu van akipan ahiei, mihing a kipan? hing dawng un,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh “Akingaituo ua, van apat chilei lah, bangding a ama gingta lou, ahing chiding a;"},"32":{"text":"hinanleh mihing akipat ichi mai ding ade aw!” akichi ua, hinanleh mipite agiing zel ua, aziehpen mi zousie in Johan khu guolnei tahtah in a bawl chiet uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Jesu adawng ua, akung ah, “Ka gen thei sih uh,” achi uhi. Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawng a, akung uah, “Ken zong bang thuneina nei a, tam silte bawl ka hiei chi ka hing hil sih ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah gentena thuin thu agen panta hi. “Mi koi ahiei in grep huon abawl a, daiin aim kimkot a, grep tui suhna khuh atou a, inn sang khat alam a, louhoumite kung ah, asan in apie a, gam dang ah apeisanta hi.","title":"Grep huon gentena (Mat. 21.33-46 ; Luk. 20.9-19)","ref":"Isai. 5.1,2"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aga law hunin, huon a ga atan ding lou houmite kunga kipat va la dingin lou houmite kungah asuohte khat asawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh amapa ana man ua, avua ua, khut guohin asawl kiata uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman asuoh dangkhat asawl kia a, amapa suongin ana sep ua, alutang ana suliem ua, zumhuoi taha na bawl in asawlmangta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman suoh dang khat asawlkia a, ama ana that ua, tualeh adang tampi zong, kimkhatte avua ua, kimkhatte athat uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin tapa ittah khat anei nalai a, ka tapa pen azatat ding uh, chi’n ama zong anukhiapen in akung uah asawlta hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh tua lou houmiten, Tampa pen gouluo dingpa ahi; hing pei un, ithat ding ua, agouluo ding khu ei a ahi mai ding hi, akichi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama khu aman ua, athat ua, tualeh grep huon pulam ah apaita uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuazieh in grep huon neipa’n bang a bawlta diei? Ama ahing pei dinga, lou houmite asumang dinga tualeh grep huon khu mi dangte kungah ape ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tam Laisiengthou a kigiel: Inn lam mite suong deilou pen, tua ngel ngel khu, aninga suong phatuom pen ahing hita hi.","ref":"Late. 118.22,23"},"11":{"text":"Tam khu Mangpa bawl ahi, imitmu uah alamdang hi. Kichi simkha ngailou na hi uoi mah?” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Ama mat atumta uhi, agentena thu khu amauh agenna ahi chi athei ua, hinanleh mipite agiing ua, tuachi’n Ama anuasie ua, apeimangta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun athugente a man dingin Pharisaite leh Herod pawl ami koite ahiei Ama kungah asawl uhi.","title":"Kaisar kung a sie pieh thu a dohna (Mat. 22.15-22 ; Luk. 20.20-26)"},"14":{"text":"Amauh ahing tun tah un, akungah, “Siepa Nang mi dihtah na hia, deisah tuom koima na nei sih a, mihing koima zatat tuom zong na nei sih hi, hinanleh Pasian lampite dihtahin na hil zel chi ka thei uhi. Kaisar kunga sie pieh adih ahiei, dihlou?"},"15":{"text":"Pe ding ka hi uoi ahisihleh pelou ding ka hi uoi?” achi uhi. Hinanleh Aman alepchie dan uh athei a, akung uah, “Bangdinga hing ze et na hi uoi? Makhai khat hing tawi un ka en ding” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahing tawi ua, tualeh Aman akung uah “Tam koi lim leh koi min ahiei?” achi a, tualeh amaun “Kaisar a,” achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawng a, akung uah, “Kaisar silte Kaisar kungah pie unlen, Pasian silte Pasian kungah pie un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amaun lamdang asa mama uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Saddukaite mishi thawkiana a um sih chite akungah ahing pei ua,","title":"Thawkiana thu a dohna (Mat. 22.23-33 ; Luk. 20.27-40)","ref":"Nasep. 23.8"},"19":{"text":"“Siepa, Mosi in mi khat asanggampa’n ta neilou in azi shisan taleh, asanggampa’n a zi luoin asanggampa a ding a ta ahinpieh ding ahi, chi’n ahing gelpieh hi.","ref":"Danp. 25.5"},"20":{"text":"Tuin sanggam pasal sagi a um ua, a upa penin zi anei a, hahlesuon neilou in ashita hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n anina pa’n amanu akitenpi a, hahlesuon neilou in ashi zel a, tualeh athumna pa’n zong hichi mabangin."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n asagi un akitenpi chiet ua, hahlesuon neilou in ashi chietta uhi, tualeh atawp ah tua numei zong ashita hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuazieh in mishi lah akipat thawkiana ni a, ahing thawkia chieng un, alah ua koipen zi ahita diei leh? Asagi un akitenpi chiet ngal ua,” chi’n adong uhi."},"24":{"text":"Jesu’n amauh adawnga, akung uah, “Tamte zieh hilou ahiei mah, na theikhel zelna uh, Laisiengthou leh Pasian silbawltheina na theilou zieh un."},"25":{"text":"Mishi lah akipat athawkia chiengun, zi leh pasal in akiteng nawn sih ding ua, hinanleh van ah vansawlsiengte abang zawta ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh Mishite kaithaw a a um ding thu uh, Mosi laibu a, sawlbawh lah a, Pasian in, kei Abraham Pasian, Isaak Pasian leh Jakob Pasian ka hi, chia ahoupi dan simkha lou na hi uoi amah.","ref":"Pawt. 3.6"},"27":{"text":"Ama pen mishi Pasian ahisih a, mihing Pasian ahi zaw hi, tuaziehin nah theikhiel na va-ia uchie,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n laigiel mite lah a khat ahing pei a, akiniel uh aza a, Jesu’n amauh hoitahin adawng chi athei a, Akungah “Thupieh tengteng lah a masa pen bang ahiei?” chiin adong hi.","title":"Thupieh thupipen thu a dohna (Mat. 22.34-40)"},"29":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga akung ah, “Thupieh zousie lah a masa pen khu, Israelte Aw Ngai un, Mangpa i Pasian u’khu, Mangpa khat ahi.","ref":"Danp. 6.4,5"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa na Pasian khu, na lungtang zousie, na hinna zousie, na lungsim zousie, tualeh na hatna zousie toh, na it ding ahi. Tami Thupieh masa pen ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ani na khu tami ahi, Nangma na ki it bangin na innvengte na it ding ahi. Tamte sang a thupi zaw thupieh dang a um sih hi, achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.18"},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n laigiel mipa’n a kung ah, “Adih hi, Siepa thudih na gen hi, Pasian khat a um a, Ama chilou adang a um sih.”","ref":"Danp. 4.35"},"33":{"text":"Ama khu lungtang zousie a, theisiemna zousie a, hinna zousie a, tualeh hatna zousie a it a, tualeh eima iki it bang a innvengte it khu, halmang sillat leh kithoina zousie sangin ahoizaw hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Hos. 6.6"},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n pil tahin adawng chi Jesu’n athei tahin, akungah, “Pasian gam akipat na gamla sih hi,” achi hi. Tuami nua kalsie koiman thu adong ngamta sih uhi.","ref":"Luk. 10.25-28"},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n Pasian bieh inn a thu ahil laiin amauh ahoupi a, laigiel miten, “Khrist khu David tapa ahi, bangchidan a achi uh ahiei?","title":"Khrist David tapa (Mat. 22.41-45 ; Luk. 20.41-44)"},"36":{"text":"Ama David ngel in, Hagau Siengthou in: Mangpa’n ka Mangpa kung ah, Na melmate na keng ngapna a ka bawl masangsie in ka ziet lam ah touin, achi a, achi hi.","ref":"Late. 110.1"},"37":{"text":"Tuazieh in David ngel in Ama khu Mangpa ahi, achi ngal a, hei akipat a Ama atapa hi ata diei?” achi hi. Tualeh mipi vantangin kipahtah in athu angaikhie uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung ua athuhilna ah, “Laigielmite lah ah kiveng un, amaute puontuol sil a, van zuana munte a chibai buh bang a ut uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh kikhopna inn a toupha hoipen leh annkuongluina a mun hoi pen bang angaina tuom uhi."},"40":{"text":"Meithaite inn sungte anegam ua, tualeh sawtpipi thungen khem akipang uhi, tuabang miten mawpaina lienzaw sem amu ding uhi,” achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu sumkoina lelam pang ah atou a, mipiten sumkoina bawm a asum khieh dan uh a en a, tualeh mi hausa tampiten, tampipi akhie uhi.","title":"Meithainu thawlawm pieh"},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n meithai zawng mama khat ahing pei a, paisa san ni ahing khie hi, tuakhu paisa khat toh kibang ahi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman anuazuite ahan a akung uah “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, sum kholna bawm a sum khete zousie sangin, tam meithai zawng tahin akhe tam pen hi."},"44":{"text":"Aziehpen amaute zousiein aneival uh akhieh uh ahia, hinanleh tam meithainu’n anei zousie akitundingna ding teng akhieh sieng ahi,” achi hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian bieh inn akipat apeidoh lai un anuazuite lah a mi khat in, akungah, “Siepa, en vawi, asuongte bangchituh a lien a, akilam dan bangchituh a thupi atai,” achi hi.","title":"Jesu’n Pasian biehinn sietna ding leh hun tawpna ding agen lawhna (Mat. 24.1-3 ; Luk. 21.5-7)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawnga, akungah, “Tam inn thupitah na mu maw? Suhchip lou a, suong khat tunga khat kichieng mawngmawng tanah a um sih ding,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Olive muol tung a Pasian bieh inn lam nga a atou lai in, Peter, Johan, Jakob leh Andru ten simtham in akung ah,"},"4":{"text":"“Tam silte bangchih chieng a hing tung ding adiei? Tualeh tam silte hing tun ding chiengin chiemtena bang ahing um diei?” hing hilin chi’n adong uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n amauh adawng a, akung uah, “Koiman ahing sol louna dingun pilvang un.","title":"Gim thuohna hing tung ding (Mat. 24.4-26 ; Luk. 21.8-24)"},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen, Kei Khrist ka hi chiin mi tampi ka min in ahing pei ding ua mi tampi asol ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh gal thute leh kidou thuthangte na zah hun chieng un lunggim sih un, tuate ahing tung ding mawng ahi; hinanleh atawpna ahi nai tadi sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Nam tuom leh nam tuom akidou ding ua, gam tuom leh gam tuom akidou ding uh, tualeh mun tuom tuom ah zil akiling dinga, kielte leh buoinate atung ding hi, tamte nauvei kipatna ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"“Hinanleh pilvangun, vaihawm mite khut ah ahing mansah ding ua, kikhopna innte ah ahing vaw ding ua, tualeh keima ziehin gam uhte leh leengte mai ah theipina pe dingin na hing ding ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 10.17-20; Luk. 12.11,12"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh khantanhoi khu nam zousie kunga gen masah ahi ding."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh ahing mat ua, ahing pieh doh hun chieng un bang ka gen diei chi’n kingaituo masa sih un, hinanleh ahun tah a hing kipeteng gen zaw un, aziehpen agen pen nouma na hi sih ding ua, Hagau Siengthou ahi zaw ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh sanggampa’n sanggampa tha dingin amansah ding a, tualeh pa in ta amansah dinga, taten zong nu leh pate a dou ding ua, athat sah ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Keima min zieh in mi zousie huot na hi ding uhi, hinanleh atawp donga thuoh zoupa khu hundam in a um ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.22"},"14":{"text":"“Hinanleh guolnei Daniel in ana gen sumangthaipa kidahhuoi khu adin louna dinga ding na mu chiengun (asim poumain aumdan thei heh) tua hun chiengin, Juda gam a umte muol tung ah tai uheh;","ref":"Dan. 9.27; 11.31; 12.11"},"15":{"text":"Inn tunga umte kumsuh sih heh, a inn sunga sil umte lakhe dingin va lut sih heh;","ref":"Luk. 17.31"},"16":{"text":"lou a umte zong apuon la dingin nuakia sih heh,"},"17":{"text":"tua ni chiengin gaite leh nausen neite tung agih ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hun khu phalbilai ahilouna dingin thu ngen un."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen khum nite banga gimthuohna thupi mawngmawng Pasian in leitung asiem chiila kipat tuni tandong a um ngai nai sih a, um zong a um kia nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Dan. 12.1; Kihil. 7.14"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n tua nite sutom sih leh mihing mawngmawng hingin asuohta sih ding uhi; hinanleh mi tel, ateltuomte ziehin, anite asutomta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua hun chienga mi koi pouin na kung ua, En un, tanah Khrist a um, ahisihleh En un, khunah Khrist a um, achi uleh tahsang sih un."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen Khrist tahlou leh guolnei tahlou ahing pawt ding ua, tuaten chiemtenate leh sil lamdangte mite solna in a ensah ding uhi, hithei leh telte nangawn asol ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh pilvangun, en un, sil zousie ka hing hil masa zou siengta hi."},"24":{"text":"“Hinanleh khum nite a, tua gimthuohna tun zou chiengin, ni suhmiel in a um ding a, hapi zong avah nawn sih ding hi;","title":"Mangpa hing peikia na ding (Mat. 24.29-31 ; Luk. 21.25-28)","ref":"Isai. 13.10; Joel. 2.10,31; 3.15; Kihil. 6.12; Isai. 13.10; Ezek. 32.7"},"25":{"text":"Vana kipat in aasite ahing kesuh ding ua, van a silbawltheina umte suhlingin a um ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 34.4; Kihil. 6.13; Joel. 2.10"},"26":{"text":"Tua hun chieng in Mihing Tapa silbawltheina leh thupina toh meilum lah a hing pei amu ding uhi.","ref":"Dan. 7.13; Kihil. 1.7"},"27":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin, Aman avansawlsiengte a sawldoh ding a, atelte lei ning li a kipat, kawlmong leitawpna kipat in van tawpna dongin, akhawm khawm ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"“Tuachi’n theipi kung ah gentena thu zil un, abate ahing dawn suong a, anate ahing sel chiengin nipi anaita chi na thei uhi.","title":"Theipi kunga chiemte ding (Mat. 24.32-35)"},"29":{"text":"Tuamabangin nouten zong, tam silte ahing tun na mu chiengun, Ama ahing naita a, kotkha bul ah a umta, chi thei un."},"30":{"text":"Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, tam silte zousie atunkim masangsie’n tulai khangthate amang sih ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Lei leh van amang dinga, ka thu ahileh amang sih ding hi."},"32":{"text":"“Hinanleh tua ni leh ahun pen Pa loungal koima’n, van a vansawlsiengten zong, Tapa in zong, athei sih uhi.","ref":"Mat. 24.36"},"33":{"text":"Pilvang unlen, kigingsa a um in thungen un, ahun na theilou zieh un."},"34":{"text":"Mi khat a inn nuasie a, asuohte kunga thuneina pie a, anasep ding uh pe chiet a, kotkha vengte zong kiging ding a thu pe phot a, gamlapi a va khuolzin bang ahi.","ref":"Luk. 12.36-38"},"35":{"text":"Tuazieh in Kiging zing un, inn neipa hing pei ding hun, nitah ahiei, zanlai ahiei, Aa khuon hun in ahiei, ahisihleh zingmawngin ahiei, chi na thei sih uhi."},"36":{"text":"Ahisihleh thakhat in hing pei khataleh imu in ahing mu kha ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh na kung ua ka gen khu mi zousie kunga ka gen ahi, kiging zing un.”"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni ni nuain Peikan pawi leh tanghou tolsawlou pawi um ding ahi a; siempu liente leh laigielmiten Ama khu solbawl a, mat a, tha theina ding dan asui uhi.","title":"Jesu tha tum a aphielguhna uh. (Mat. 26.1-5, Luk. 21.1,2)","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-27"},"2":{"text":"“Hinanleh pawi hun sung hi da heh, tuachilou in mipi vantang lah ah, buoina hing um kha va,” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Bethani khuo a Simon miphapa inn a a um lai a, annkuong a im lai in, numei khat alabastar bawm a spiknard sathau gimnamtui man tamtah tawi in ahing pei a; tualeh amanu’n abawn a tawkeh a, alutung ah asungta hi.","title":"Bethani khuo a Jesu sathau nuna","ref":"Luk. 7.37,38"},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh alah ua lungkimlou pawlkhat a um ua, “Bangding a tam thau gimnamtui kimawh suhmang ahiei?"},"5":{"text":"Tam sathau namtui makhai zathum sanga tamzaw a zua a, migentheite kunga pieh thei ding ahi,” achi ua; atungah aphunta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n “Amanu khu aum umin umsah un, bangdinga subuoi na hi uoi mah? Ka tungah sil hoi abawl ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen mi gentheite na kung uah a um zing ua, na ut hun hun un na panpi thei uhi, hinanleh kei pen na kung uah ka um zing sih ding hi.","ref":"Danp. 15.11"},"8":{"text":"Amanu’n abawl thei khamkham abawl ahita hi, ka sapum vui dinga sathau anu masah ahi."},"9":{"text":"Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, leitung pumpi a tam khantanhoi kigenna phot ah, tam numeinu sil bawl amanu theizingna dingin akigen ding hi, achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda Iskariot, sawm leh nite lah a khat in Jesu zuousana amat sah theina dingin siempu liente kung ah ava hawta hi.","title":"Judas muonhuoi louna (Mat. 26.14-16 ; Luk. 22.3-6)"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n tami athei tah un, akipah ua, ama sum pieh achiemta uhi. Tuachi’n aman amatsahna ding lemtang asuita hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh tanghou tolsawlou pawi ni masapen peikan pawi belamnou agaw ni un, anuazuiten akung ah, “Peikan annkuong na neh theina dingin, heisung ah vabawl u’leng na ut ei?” achi uhi.","title":"Nitah ann nukhia pen (Mat. 26.17-19 ; Luk. 22.7-13)"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman anuazuite ni asawl a, akung uah, “Khopi sung va lut unlen, khunah pasal bel a tui puo khat in ahing tuoh dinga, ama zui un."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh na lutna penpen uh inntehpa kungah, Siepa’n Ka nuazuite toh peikan annkuong ka neh na ding uh mikhuol pindan heisung ahiei? achi hi chi un."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n inndan tungnung lientah vanzah ding umsa leh guotsa diem a um ahing ensah ding a, tuanah ei a dingin bawl un,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n anuazuite apawtta ua, khopi sungah ava lut ua, akung ua agen bangin ava mu ua, peikan annkuong luina abawlta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Nitahlam ahing hitahin Ama sawmlenite toh ahing peita uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tou a, ann aneh lai un, Jesu’n “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, na lah ua mi keima toh ann ne khawm khat in ahing zuousan dinga, ahing mansah ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Late. 41.9"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh alungdong panta ua, khat khat in a kung ah kei ka ma leh? achi ua, aban ban in “Kei ka ma leh?” achi chiet uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman adawnga akung uah, “Sawm leh nite lah a mi khat, ka annkuong sawhkhawmpipa ahi, achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihing Tapa atungtang thu ana gel bangtah un apei ding a, hinanleh Mihing Tapa zuousan a mansah dingpa tung a gih hi. Tua mihing khu piengda vanglah leh ama adingin a hoi zaw ding hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n aneh lai un, Jesu’n tanghou ala a, aguolzawl zouin aphalsuo a, akung uah apie a, “La unlen ne un, tami ka tahsa ahi.”"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n nou ala a, kipahthu agen zouin, akung uah apie a, tuachi’n abawn un adawn chietta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Tami kasisan mi tampi a dinga luong thuhun tha khu ahi, achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 24.8; Jer. 31.31-34"},"25":{"text":"Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, Pasian gam a atha a ka dawn ni atun masangsie in grepgui a ga ka dawn nawn sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh la khat asah zou un, apawt ua olive muol ah apeita uhi.","title":"Jesu’n nuazuite taisan ding agenlawhna"},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Tuzan chiengin na bawn un ka tung ah na lungke sieng ding uhi; Aziehpen, belamchingpa ka sat dinga, Belamte akithethang ding uhi, chi gel ahi.","ref":"Zek. 13.7"},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh ka thawkia zou chiengin Galili gam ah na masang uah ka pei ding,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 28.16"},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter in akung ah, “Abawn un lungke siengin hing taisan nan u’leh, Ken vang kang taisan sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, tuni, tuzan ngei in, aa ni vei akhuon masangin thumvei na hing kitheimawbawl ding hi,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh aman khautahin, “Nang toh shi khawm ding hinanleng ka hing kitheimawbawl sih ding,” achi hi. Tuamabangin abawn un, achi chiet uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun mun khat Gethsemani kichina mun ahing tung ua, tualeh Aman anuazuite kungah, “Ka thunget sungteng tanah na tou un” achi hi.","title":"Jesu Gethsemani huon ah (Mat. 26.36-46 ; Luk. 22.39-46)"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Aman Peter, Jakob leh Johan azawpi a lunggim sengin achimaw panta hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n akung uah, “Ka hinna hagau alunggim sengseng a, shina khop hiel ahi. Tanah na um unlen, kiging zing un” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n mailam ah gamla deu ava pei a, tuol ah apua a, ahitheileh tua hunin Ama apel theina dingin thu angen hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh “Abba Pa, nanga dingin sil zousie ahithei hi; Tam nou kei akipat in lamangin, hinanleh kei thu hilou in, Nangma thuthu hizaw heh,” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahing pei a, amaute imu in amu a, tualeh Peter kungah, “Simon imu na hiei mah naikal khat zong kiginga um zoulou na hiei mah?"},"38":{"text":"Solna a na lut louna ding un kiging zing unlen, thungen un. Hagau in angap a, tahsa pen ahat sih,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Apeimang kia a, thu angen a, agen ngaima agen hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahing nua pei kia a, amauh imu in ahing mu kia zel a, a imut uh asuoh mama ziehin Ama dawn ding dan athei sih uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n athumvei hing peina ah, akung uah, “I mu nalai a, tawldam na lailai na hi uoi mah? ahunta hi, ahun ahing tungta hi, en un, Mihing Tapa zuousan a mikhielte khut a pieh ahita."},"42":{"text":"Thou un pei vai, en un Keima hing mansah dingpa ahing tungta hi.”"},"43":{"text":"Tualeh athugen laitahin, Juda sawm leh nite lah a mi khat, siempu liente, laigielmite leh upate akipat in mipi tampi namsau leh khetbuh tawite toh ahing tung pai hi.","title":"Jesu kimatna (Mat. 26.47-56 ; Luk. 22.47-53 ; Jn. 18.1-11)"},"44":{"text":"Tuin Ama mansah dingpa’n, “Ka tawp penpen khu Ama ahi dinga, man unlen, kituptahin peimangpi ta un, chiin chiemtena ape masa zouta hi.”"},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahing tun tahin akungah ava pei pai a, Akungah “Siepa, Siepa” chiin atawp pai hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun atungah khut aha ua, amanta uhi."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh akung ua dingte lah a khat in namsau adoh a, Siempu lienpen suohpa asat a, abil asatkhie hi."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n amauh adawnga, akung uah, “Suomhat man ding bang hiel in, namsaute leh khetbuhte kengin kei man dingin na hing kuon uh maw?"},"49":{"text":"Ni chin in Pasian bieh inn ah thuhil in ka um ngitnget a, na hing man sih uhi, hinanleh Laisiengthou thu atangtun ngei ding ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Luk. 19.47; 21.37"},"50":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama anuasie ua, abawn un ataimang siengta uhi."},"51":{"text":"Tualeh tangval koi ahiei khat in, diel puon nem khat sil in Ama azui a, tualeh tangvalten ama ana man ua,"},"52":{"text":"tuachi’n adiel puonnem nuasie in aguohtangin ataimangta hi."},"53":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu Siempu lienpen mai ah a zawpi ua, tualeh ama toh siempu liente leh upate tualeh laigiel mite zousie ahing kikhawmta uhi.","title":"Jesu siempu lien mai a adinna (Mat. 26.57-68 ; Luk. 22.54-55 , 63-65 ; Jn. 18.12 , 18 , 24)"},"54":{"text":"Tualeh Peter in gamlapi ah, siempu lienpen innpi huongsung tandong azui a, tualeh suohte toh a toukhawm ua mei a awi uhi."},"55":{"text":"Tualeh siempu liente leh vaihawm mite zousie in Jesu atha theina dingun, Ama hehna ding asui ua amu sih uhi."},"56":{"text":"Mi tampi in theipina dihlou toh aheh ua, hinanleh ahehna thute uh akituoh sih hi."},"57":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi koite ahiei ading doh ua, zuou thu in aheh ua;"},"58":{"text":"Tam khut a kibawl biehinn ka suse dinga; “Nithum sungin, khut a bawllou adang khat ka lamdoh ding achi ka za uhi,” achi uhi.","ref":"Jn. 2.19"},"59":{"text":"Hinanleh tuabanga a heh nangawn un zong, ahehna akituoh thei tuom sih hi."},"60":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu lienpen alah uah adingdoh a Jesu kung ah, “Bangma a dawng lou na hiei mah? Tam mite hing hehna bangchidan ahiei?” Chiin adongta hi."},"61":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama asip dide a, Bangma in adawng sih hi; Siempu lienpen in “Nang Khrist hampha Tapa na hi ama leh?” chi’n adong kia hi."},"62":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n ka hihi. “Mihing Tapa silbawltheina zietlam a tou leh van meilum lah a hing pei na mu ding uh,” achi hi.","ref":"Dan. 7.13"},"63":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siempu lienpen in apuonte abotkeh a, “Theipimi dang bang ding ichi nalai diei?"},"64":{"text":"Pasian agensiet dan na zata uhi, bang chi nasa uoi?” achi hi. Tualeh abawn un Ama khu shitah ahi chiin amawpai chietta uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 24.16"},"65":{"text":"Tuachi’n pawlkhat in chil asietkhum panta ua, Amai atuom pieh ua, avuo ua, tualeh akungah, “Siem in,” achi uhi. Tualeh vengmiten zong akhut peh un abeng uhi."},"66":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter khu nuoilam a innpi huongsunga a um lai in, Siempu lienpen suoh nungahte lah a khat ahing pei a,","title":"Peter in Jesu akitheimaw bawlna (Mat. 26.69-75 ; Luk. 22.56-62 ; Jn. 18.15-18 , 25-27)"},"67":{"text":"Amanu’n Peter mei awi a um amu tahin, a en a, “Nang zong Nazareth Jesu toh umkhawm na hi,” achi hi."},"68":{"text":"Hinanleh aman kitheimawbawlin, “Ka thei kha sih, na thugen zong ka theisiem sih,” achi hi. Tualeh innhim ah ava pawtdoh a, tuachi’n aa akhuongta hi."},"69":{"text":"Tualeh suoh nungahnu’n amu kia a, akunga dingte kungah, “Tampa alah ua khat ahi,” achi kia hi."},"70":{"text":"Hinanleh akitheimawbawl kiata hi. Tuachi’n tomkhat zouin akunga dingten Peter kungah, “Alah ua mi khat hizen teh, Galili mi nahi a, na ham in zong akithei hi achi uhi.”"},"71":{"text":"Hinanleh aman tua na mihing genpa uh “Ka thei kha sih, chiin hamsie louin akichiemta hi.”"},"72":{"text":"Tualaitah in “Aa ahing khuonga aniveina ahi. Tuachi’n Peter in Jesu’n akunga, aa nivei khuon masangin thumvei na hing kitheimawbawl ding hi,” achi thu atheidohta hi. Tualeh aman tua thu angaituo a, akapta hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zingmawng ahing hitahin siempu liente khu upate leh laigielmite, tualeh vaihawm mite zousie toh akikumkhawm ua, Jesu akaan ua, azawpi ua Pilat kungah apedoh ta uhi.","title":"Jesu Rome gam uhpipa Pilat mai adinna (Mat. 27.1 , 2 , 11-23 ; Luk. 23.1-5 , 13-23 ; Jn. 18.28—19.15)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in “Judate leengpa na hi amah?” chi’n adong a, Aman adawnga, “Nang na genta hi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh siempu lienten thu tampiin aheh ua, hinanleh aman adawng sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in a dong kia a, akungah, “Bangma a dawng lou na hiei mah? En in, sil tampi in ahing heh uhi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n bangma in adawng nawnta sih a, tuachi’n Pilat in lamdang asa mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Pilat in pawi ni chiengin henta mi khat anget penpen uh apawt sah zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh mi khat amin Baraba kichipa ahelpite toh kolbut khat a uma, amaun ahelna zieh un tuol athat uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite ava peitou ua, ama ua dinga abawlpieh zel banga bawl dingin a ngen uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Pilat in a dawng a, akung uah, “Judate leengpa hing hadoh pieh leeng na ut uoi?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen siempu lienten thangsietna zieh a Ama apiehdoh uh ahi chi athei hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh siempu lienten, Baraba hing hadoh zaw in, chia ngen dingin mipite achiilta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in adawnga, akung uah, “Judate leengpa na chipa uh bang ka lawta diei leh?” achi kia hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun “Kross ah kilbeh in,” chiin akikou kia uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in akung uah, “Bangdingin la, Aman bang bawlkhiel anei ei?” achi hi. Tualeh ama un “Kross ah kilbeh in,” chiin akihakou semsem uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in mipite suhlungkim a ut a, Baraba ahadoh piehta hi, Tualeh Jesu ajep zouin Kross a kilden dingin apeta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkapten Ama khu innpi huongsung Praitorium achi uah, apuilut ua, tualeh galkap zousie akihankhawm uhi.","title":"Sepaiten Jesu asimmawbawlna uh (Mat. 27.26-34 ; Luk. 23.24-32 ; Jn. 19.16-22)"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh puonsandup a silsah ua, ling lukhu aphan ua, akhusah ua,"},"18":{"text":"tualeh Ama asalam ua, “Judate leengpa chiin salam abuh uhi!”"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n alu pumpengin asat ua, chil asietkhum ua, tualeh khupdin in Ama abie uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh chiemmui bawlna a azah zou un, puonsandup khu asatunga pat ahawhkhie ua, Ama puonte asilsah kia ua, Kross a kilden dingin azawpita uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh mi khat gam lam a kipata hing pei, Sairin khuo a mi, Simon, Alexander leh Rufus pa khu Kross paw dingin amanta uhi.","ref":"Rom. 16.13"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu khu Golgotha mun ah azawpi ua, tuakhu lugu mun, china ahi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n uoiin murrah toh kihal dawn dingin apie ua, hinanleh Aman asang sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Kross a akilbet zou tahun, michin in atan ding chiet uh theina dingin aisan in apuonsilte akihawm uhi.","title":"Jesu kildenna","ref":"Late. 22.18"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Ama akilbet hun u’khu nai thumna vel ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh ahehna lai uh, atunglam ah atah ua, “JUDATE KUMPIPA” chiin agiel uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Ama toh suomhat mi ni akilbet ua, khat azietlam ah, khat avei lam ah.","ref":"Isai. 53.12"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Laisiengthou in, “Ama khu mi giloute toh simtha ahi,” achi khu atangtungta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh khum mun a hing pei kha pouma in alu uh thinkhum in, “Ehei! Nang Pasian biehinn susie a, ni thum sunga lamdoh kia pa;","ref":"Late. 22.7; 109.25; Mak. 14.58; Jn. 2.19"},"30":{"text":"Nangma kihundoh inlen, Kross akipat hing kumkhie in, chiin a elhou uhi.”"},"31":{"text":"Tuachibangmain siempu lienten zong laigielmite toh amau’leh amauh kihouin, a elhou ua, “Aman mi dang ahundoh a, Ama akihunkhe thei sih hi."},"32":{"text":"I mu a, tualeh igintat theina dingin, Khrist, Israel leengpa tuin Kross apat hing kumkhie heh” achi uhi. Tualeh Kross a Ama toh akilbet khawmte un zong Ama a elhou uhi."},"33":{"text":"Nai guhna ahing hitah in, gam pumpi tungah nai kuona tandongin mielna a umta hi.","title":"Jesu shina"},"34":{"text":"Tualeh nai kuona ah, Jesu aw ngaitah in “Eloi, Eloi lama Sabakthani?” chiin akikoukhie a, tua khu “Ka Pasian, Ka Pasian bangdinga hing taisan na hei?” china ahi.","ref":"Late. 22.1"},"35":{"text":"Akunga ding pawlkhatten tuami azah tahun “Ngai un, Elijah ahan hi,” achi uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi khat atai a, spanji khat zu thua a die dimin, pumpeng chieng dawna tahin adawn dingin apie a, ngaisahda un, “Ama lakhe dingin Elijah ahing pei ngel ei mah en vai,” achi u hi.","ref":"Late. 69.21"},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu aw ngaitah in akikou a, a hagau ahata hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian biehinn a puonjah khu atunglam a kipat anuoilam tan dongin phalni kisuo in ahing kehsuohta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 26.31-33"},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Ama maingat a ding galkap lienpan tuabanga kikoudoh leh ahagau ahata chi amu tahin “Tam mipa pen Pasian Tapa hi ngeingei va,” a chi hi."},"40":{"text":"Khunah numeite zong gamlatah akipat a en in a um ua, tuate lah ah, Mari Magdalene, Jakob naupangzaw leh Joses nu Mari, tualeh Salomi apang uhi.","ref":"Luk. 8.2,3"},"41":{"text":"Amaute khu, Galili gam a aum lai a Ama zui a, a nna seppiehte zong ahi uhi. Tualeh numei dang tampi Jerusalema Ama toh zawhtoute zong a um uhi."},"42":{"text":"Nitahlam ahing hitah in, kiginni ahi ziehin, tua khu khawlni masang ni ahi.","title":"Jesu kivuina (Mat. 27.57-61 ; Luk. 23.50-55 ; Jn. 19.38-42)"},"43":{"text":"Joseph Arimathai khomi vaihawm zatathuoitah Pasian gam hing tung ding kilam en zinga um, ahing pei a hangsantahin Pilat kungah alut a, Jesu luong ava ngenta hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in hichibanga ashi pai khu lamdang asa mama a, tuachi’n galkap lamkai khat ahan a ashina asawt taimah chiin adong hi."},"45":{"text":"Tualeh galkap lamkaipa a kipat ashita chi atheichien tahin, aluong Joseph kungah apeta hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman puon nem alei a, Jesu alakhie a, puon nem in atuom a, suong khuoh kuoh han khat ah asielta hi, tualeh suong khat hankot ah alia a, akhata hi."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh Mari Magdalene leh Joses nu Mari in asielna amu uhi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh khawlni ahing bei tahin, Mari Magdalene leh Jakob nu Mari leh Salomite, ahing pei ua, Ama anu ding un thau namtuite alei uhi.","title":"Jesu thawkiana (Mat. 28.1-8 ; Luk. 24.1-9)"},"2":{"text":"Nipikal khat sung ni masa pen ni zingmawng matahin ni suoh lai in, han ah ahing pei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh hankot akipat in suong “Koiin hing liakhiet pieh ding adiei?” chi a akihou laitah un,"},"4":{"text":"a et u’leh, suong khu liakhietsain amuta uhi, asuong khu alien mama hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh han sunga alut u’leh, tangval khat puon ngou tuol sil azietlam pang a tou amu ua, azau mama ta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman akung uah “Zau sih un, Kross a kikilbeh Nazareth Jesu sui na hi uhi. Ama athou kiata, Tanah a um nawn sih hi. Ama asielna mun uh en un."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh pei unlen anuazuite leh Peter kungah, Galili gam ah na masang uah apei hi; na kung ua agen bangin, Ama na mu ding uh, chi’n va hil un,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 26.32; Mak. 14.28"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh kintahin apawt ua, han akipat in ataita ua, chitun a lamdang asah zieh un. Tualeh azau seng zieh un koima kungah bangma agen sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu khu nipikal khat a ni masapen zingmawng matah a athawkia ni in, Mari Magdalene, asunga pat dawi sagi anawdohna nu kungah akilah masa pen hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu apei a, Jesu toh na umkhawm zelte, Ama suuna na kapte ava hilta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Jesu ahing ta hi, tualeh amanu’n amu hi chi azah un, atahsang sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuami nuain alah ua mi ni gam lam zuon a apei lai un, mel tuom puoin akung uah ava kilah hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n amautegel apei ua, nuazui dangte ava hil ua, hinanleh amauh thu gen zong atahsang sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuami nualam in, annkuong im a atou lai un, sawm leh khatte kungah akilah a, athawkia nua a Ama mute thu atahsan lou zieh u’leh alungtang khau thu uah aphawhhil hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah “Leitung pumpi ah pei unlen silsiem chinteng kungah khantanhoi gen un.","ref":"Nasep. 1.8"},"16":{"text":"Koipou a gingta a baptisma tang khu hundam in aum ding a; hinanleh agingtalou khu siemmaw tangin aum ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh agingtate khu tam chiemtenain azui ding; Ka min in dawite anotdoh ding ua, ham thatein aham ding uhi;"},"18":{"text":"gulte khut in aman ding ua; shina gu bangchibang dawn nan uleh zong, bangma achi sih ding uhi; tualeh damloute tungah khut angam ding ua, adam zel ding uhi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachia Mangpa’n akung ua, thu agen zouin, Ama van a puitou in a um a, Pasian zietlam ah atouta hi.","title":"Jesu van a akaltouna (Luk. 24.49-53 ; Nasep. 1.9)","ref":"Nasep. 1.9-11"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh amaute akuondoh ua, mun chin ah khantanhoi thu agenta ua, Mangpa’n amaute aseppi a, chiemtenate in a zui a, athu asudet zel hi, Amen."}}}}},"42":{"info":{"name":"Luk","shortname":"Luk.","abbr":[],"desc":"Luk gel khantanhoi"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"I lah ua kichientah a gintat a na um, tua silte mi tampiin athu gel ana tup uh;","title":"Thumakai"},"2":{"text":"Achiil a kipat a mit a mute leh thu nasemten ahing hil bangun,"},"3":{"text":"Zatat umpen Theophilus aw, abul akipat in sil zousie theichienna bukimna nei in akizom diudeu a na kunga gel hoi kasa hi;"},"4":{"text":"Tuahileh tumasang lai a nang hing nakihil thute adih ngel ahina chi na theichien ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Judia gam a leengpa Herod dam lai in, Abijah pawl a mi, amin Zakaria kichi siempu nasem khat a um a, tualeh azi khu Aaron tanute lah a khat ahia amin Elizabeth ahi.","title":"Pasian biehinn a Zakaria nasepna","ref":"1 Khang. 24.10"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh ani un Pasian mitmu in dihtat tahin a um ua, gensiet beiin Mangpa thupiehte leh adan zousie zui in a um uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Elizabeth a chiin ziehin ta anei sih ua, ani un kum upa lam ahi tuohta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahing hia, apawlte uh bawldan dungzui a ama hun a Pasian masanga siempu nna asep lai in,"},"9":{"text":"Siempu dan dungzui in Mangpa biehinn alut chienga gimnamtui hal khu atan ahi a."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh gimnamtui akihal lai in mipite abawn un innpulangah thu ana ngen uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa vansawlsieng khat gimnamtui halna maitam zietlam a dingin akungah ahing kilah hi.","title":"Vansawlsiengin Johan pien ding thu agenna"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Zakaria in ama amu tahin, amangbanga zauna in adimta hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh vansawlsiengin akungah, Zakaria, “Zau sin, na thungetna zah ahitah zieh in, na zi Elizabeth in tapa ahing neipieh dinga, amin Johan na hisah ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh nang nuomin na kipah ding a, tualeh mi tampite ama pienziehin akipah ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mangpa mitmuin ama milien ahi ding a, uoin leh zu mawngmawng adawn sih ding, tualeh anu sunga kipat nangawnin Hagau Siengthouin adim ding hi.","ref":"Kisim. 6.3"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Israel tate tampi Mangpa a Pasian uh langah akiheisah kia ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh pate lungtang tate lam a kiheisah ding leh thumangloute midihtat pilna lam a kihei sah ding, tualeh Mangpa ding a mite kimansa a umsah dinga na bawlmasa ding in, Elijah lungsim leh silbawltheina toh Mangpa mai ah apei ding hi, achi hi.","ref":"Mala. 4.5,6"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zakaria in vansawlsieng kungah, “Tami bangchin ka thei thei diei? Kei lah tehsie hita ing a, ka zi zong ateh mama tahi,” achi hi.","title":"Zakaria ham theilouna"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng in adawnga, akungah, “Kei Gabriel Pasian masanga ding zel ka hi; na kunga thu gen ding leh tam thu kipah huoite hil dinga sawl ka hi.","ref":"Dan. 8.16; 9.21"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Ngai in, ahun banga hing tung ding tam ka thugente, na gintat lou ziehin, tam silte ahing tun masangsie’n hamtheilou leh thugen theilouin na um ding hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh mipiten Zakaria ana ngah ua, Pasian biehinn sunga a um sawt seng ziehin lamdang asa mama uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ahing pawtdoh tahin akung uah thu agenthei tasih a; tuachi’n biehinn sungah kilahna amu ahi chi atheita ua; aziehpen akung uah akhut in theisahnate abawl a, tualeh hamthei louin a umden ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Anasepna ni abei tahin a inn langah apeita hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua nite nua in, azi Elizabeth ahing gaita a, ha nga sung akibuta hi."},"25":{"text":"Mite lah a ka minsie sel dingin, “Mangpa’n ahing mu tahin tambangin ka tungah abawlta hi.”"},"26":{"text":"Aha guhna ah Pasian in vansawlsieng Gabriel Galili gam a khuo khat, amin Nazareth kichi ah,","title":"Gabriel in Jesu pian ding agenna"},"27":{"text":"Nungah siengthou khat kungah asawl a, tua nungah khu David hahlesuon mi khat amin Joseph toh kikhamsa ahi ua, nungah siengthou min khu Mari ahi.","ref":"Mat. 1.18"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh vansawlsieng khu a kungah alut a, akungah, “Nuomin nahpitaha deisahnu, Mangpa na kungah a um hi, numei lah ah hamphanu nahi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh amanu’n ama amu tahin athugente ah alungbuoi a, tami bangchibang kinousietna ahitabep diei izaw, chiin akingaituo hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng in akungah, “Mari zau sin Pasian deisahna na tang hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai in, nau na pai dinga, tapa na nei dinga, amin JESU na hisah ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 1.21"},"32":{"text":"Ama mi lien ahing hi dinga, Tungnungpen tapa akichi ding hi, tualeh Mangpa Pasian in, akungah, apa David Mangtoupha ape ding hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.12,13,16; Isai. 9.7"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Jakob hahlesuonte tungah kumtawn in vai ahawm ding hi, achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mari in vansawlsieng kungah, “Tami bang achi hi thei diei? Pasal lah nei nailou inga,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh vansawlsieng in adawnga akungah, “Hagau siengthou na tungah ahing tung dinga, Tungnungpen silbawltheina in ahing liekhu dinga, tuaziehin Mi siengthou hing pieng ding zong Pasian Tapa akichi ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai in, na sanggamnu Elizabethin zong ateh nua in tapa khat apaita hi, achiing achi nu uh tuin aha guhna ahita hi."},"37":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian dingin ahitheilou bangma a um sih ding hi, achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 18.14"},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Mari in “Ngai in, Mangpa suohnu ka hi, na thu bangin ka tungah tung heh,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Vansawlsieng in anuasieta hi."},"39":{"text":"Khum hun lai in Mari akisadoh a, singtang gam a Juda khopi khat ah kintah in ahawta hi.","title":"Mari in Elizabeth avena: pahtawina la"},"40":{"text":"Tualeh Zakaria inn ah alut a, Elizabeth anousiet hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Elizabethin Mari nousietna azah tahin asunga naungeh khu akidieng hi, tualeh Elizabeth khu Hagau Siengthouin ahing dimta hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n aw ngaitah in akikoukhie a, “Numei lah ah hamphanu na hi, tualeh na gil a ga zong ahampha hi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh ka Mangpa nu ka kunga na hing haw, bangchidan ahiei?"},"44":{"text":"Ngai vawi, na hing nousietna aw gin kabil a alut tahin, ka gil sunga naungeh nuom in akidieng hi."},"45":{"text":"Tualeh agingta nu zong ahampha hi, Mangpa’n akunga athugente tangtung ding ahizieh in, achi hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mari in, “Ka hinna in Mangpa apahtawi a,”"},"47":{"text":"ka hagau zong ka hundampa, Pasian tungah anuom seng hi."},"48":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman asuohnu ngiem dan athei a, Ngai in, tu akipat in khangtha zousie in, hampha ahing chi ding uhi.","ref":"1 Sam. 1.11"},"49":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama mihat in ka tungah, sil thupitah ahing bawlpieh a, Amin zong Siengthou ahi."},"50":{"text":"Ama zaudan siemte tungah, ahepina akhang akhangin a um hi."},"51":{"text":"Abantha in athahat dan a ensah a, mi kiliensahte lungtang ngaituona athethang hi."},"52":{"text":"Aman mi hatte khu amangtoupha ua pat in akaikhie a, mi ngiemte atawisangta hi.","ref":"Job. 5.11; 12.19"},"53":{"text":"Aman gilkielte sil hoi in agilva sah a, tualeh mihausate khu khutguohin asawlmangta hi."},"54":{"text":"Ahepina theizingnain asuoh Israel apanpita hi;"},"55":{"text":"kumtawn a dinga ipu ipate, Abraham leh ahahasuonte kunga, ana chiemsa mabangin.","ref":"Siem. 17.7\n        ;     \n        1 Sam. 2.1-10"},"56":{"text":"Tualeh Mari akungah ha thum vel ataam a, tuachi’n a inn ah apei kiata hi."},"57":{"text":"Tualeh Elizabeth khu anau suoh hun ahingtungta a; tapa ahing neita hi.","title":"Baptispa Johan pienna"},"58":{"text":"A innvengte leh asanggamten, Mangpa’n ahepina thupitah atungah asulangta chi azah tahun akipahpi uhi."},"59":{"text":"Tuachi’n a ni giet niin naungeh teptan dingin ahing pei ua, amin dingin apa min mama Zakaria hisah atum uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 12.3"},"60":{"text":"Tuabepin anu’n adawnga, “Tuabang hilou e, Johan hisah zawh ding ahi,” achi hi."},"61":{"text":"Tualeh amaun amanu kungah, “Na be na phung lah ah tami min puo koima umloupi,” achi uhi."},"62":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun apa kungah, amin bang na hisah nuom ei chiin theisahna abawl uhi."},"63":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n laigelna suonglai khat angen a, “Amin Johan ahi,” chi’n agielta hi. Tualeh amaun lamdang asa mama uhi."},"64":{"text":"Thakhat in akam ahing kihongta a, alei ahing kiham a, ahing ham a, Pasian apahtawita hi."},"65":{"text":"Tuabepin akim ua, umte zousie azauta ua, tualeh tam thute Judia singtang gam zousie ah, athangsuoh ta hi."},"66":{"text":"Tualeh azakha zousiein, alungtang uah a vom chiet ua, “Tam naungeh bangchibang ahing hi tabep diei izaw?” achi uhi. Tualeh Mangpa khutin ama a umpi hi."},"67":{"text":"Tuachi’n apa Zakaria Hagau Siengthouin ahing dim a, thu agenta a,","title":"Zakaria in Johan nasep ding agenlawhna"},"68":{"text":"“Israel Mangpa, Pasian pahtawi in um heh, Aziehpen Aman amite ahing ve a, ahing tanta hi."},"69":{"text":"Tualeh asuoh David innkuonte lah ah hundamna kii ahing tungdoh ta hi."},"70":{"text":"Leitung pienchil apat aguolnei siengthoute kam a ana gensa mabangin;"},"71":{"text":"Igalte lah a kipat leh ahing mudate zousie khut akipat hundam in i um a;"},"72":{"text":"Ipu ipate kunga ana chiemsa khotuona tangtungsah ding leh athuhun siengthou thei ngitnget dingin;"},"73":{"text":"ipu uh Abraham kunga kichiem a akihahsiel na khu,"},"74":{"text":"I galte lah a kipat in ahing hunkhie a, zauloua Ana isep theina dingin,"},"75":{"text":"I damsung nite a, Amasang a siengthou leh dihtattah a um dingin."},"76":{"text":"Tualeh nang naungeh, Tungnungpen guolnei ahing kichi ding hi; aziehpen alampite bawl dingin Mangpa masangah na pei ding hi.","ref":"Mala. 3.1"},"77":{"text":"Akhelnate uh ngaidamna dinga, amite kunga hundamna theina pe dingin."},"78":{"text":"I Pasian uh khotuona nemtah zal in; tunglam a kipat nisuoh in ahing khawta hi.”"},"79":{"text":"Miel lah leh shina lim nuoi a toute tanvah ding leh hamuonna lampi a i kengte hing puipieh ding in, achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 9.2"},"80":{"text":"Tuachi’n naungeh khu ahing khang lien a, hagau lam ah ahing hat deudeu a, Israelte kunga ahing kilah masangsie in gamdai ah a umta hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khum hun lai in Kaisar Augustus in leitung pumpi min khum ding thu apie hi.","title":"Jesu pienna"},"2":{"text":"Tam pen Siria gam a, Kuirinius gam uhpipa ahi lai a kisimpina masa pen ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi zousie amin uh khum dingin ama uh khopi chiet azuonta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Joseph zong David innkuon leh ahahasuonte ahi zieh in, Galili gam a Nazareth khuo akipat in Judia gam a David khopi Bethlehem kichi ah ahawta hi;"},"5":{"text":"Mari azi kham gaiham toh, min khum dingin akuonta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n khuna a umlai un, anau nei ahing hunta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh a tapa masa pen ahing neikheta a, tualeh puonnemin atuom a, zintunna inn a, ama ua dinga mun a umlou ziehin gan annkuong sungah asiel hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh khum gam ma ah, belam chingte a um ua, zanlai in gamlah ah abelamte uh aveng uhi.","title":"Vansawlsiengten belampute kunga Jesu pien thu ahilna uh"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai vawi, Mangpa vansawlsieng khat akung uah ahing dinga, Mangpa thupina in akim uh atanvah a, tuachi’n azauta mama uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsiengin akung uah, “Zau sih unlen, Ngai un, michin a dingin thu hoi kipah huoi mama ka hing puoh hi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen tuni’n nou a dingin David khuo ah Hundampa apiengta hi, Ama Khrist Mangpa ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh tami nou a dingin chiemtena ahi ding hi; naungeh puon a tuom, gan annpiehna kuonga lum na mu ding uhi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh thakhat in vansawlsieng kungah van mipite tampi ahing umkhawm ua, Pasian aphat uhi:"},"14":{"text":"“Tungnung pen ah Pasian thupi henlen, Leitunga akipahpi mihingte lah ah, lemthu leeng hen,” achi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh vansawlsiengten van a apeisan tah un, belamputen, “Tuin Bethlehem khuo ah va pei vaiin Mangpa’n thu ahinghil hing tung khu iva en ding uhi” akichi uhi.","title":"Belamputen Jesu avena uh"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n kinawtahin ahing peita ua, Mari leh Joseph toh gan annpiehna kuonga naungeh lum ava muta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Ama ava mu tahun, tam naungeh tungtang thu ama uh kihil khu agenthangta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh azakha poumain tua belampute thugen lamdang asa chiet uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Mari in tam thute zousie alungtang ah avom a, angaituo ngitnget hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n belampute khu, ama uh kihil bang ngei a sil zousie azah ua amu zieh un, Pasian pahtawi leh phat kawm in anua pei kiata uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh ateptanna ding ni giet ahing chin tahin, tua naungeh khu amin dingin, naubu sunga a um masanga van sawlsiengin aphuosa Jesu aphuota uhi.","title":"Jesu min phuona leh biehinn a latna","ref":"Siempu. 12.3; Luk. 1.31"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi dan dungzui a, amanu kisiensuo ni ahing tun tahin Jerusalem ah ama ahing pui ua, Mangpa kunga ama lat dingin."},"23":{"text":"Mangpa dan dungzui a kigiel bangin, “Ta pasal naubu hong masa pouma Mangpa a dinga siengthou akichi ding hi.”","ref":"Pawt. 13.2,12"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa dan thu a kigen dungzui in vakhu kopkhat ahiei, “Vapal nou ni ahiei, kithoina a lan ding in.”","ref":"Siempu. 12.6-8"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai vawi, Jerusalem ah mi khat amin Simeon kichi a um a, tam mipa khu midihtat leh Pasian ngaina mi ahi a, Israelte hamuonna ding angah ngitnget a, Hagau Siengthou atung ah a um hi.","title":"Simeon kipah thugenna la"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa Khrist amu masangsie ashi sih ding chi Hagau Siengthouin ana theisahta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hagau theisahna in Pasian biehinn ah alut a, tualeh naungeh Jesu khu anu leh apa’n ngaina dan dungzuia bawl dinga, ahing lutpi lai un;"},"28":{"text":"Aman ana angpom a, Pasian aphat a:"},"29":{"text":"“Mangpa tuin na thu bang zel in, na suoh hamuong tahin na peisah ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Aziehpen ka mitin na hundamna amuta hi:"},"31":{"text":"Mi zousie mit mu a na bawlsa khu,"},"32":{"text":"Jentelte kunga hundamna vah tun ding leh, na mi Israelte thupina dingin,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 42.6; 49.6; 52.10"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh naungeh tungtang thu agen khu anu leh apa’n lamdang asa mama uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Simeon in amauh aguolzawl a, anu Mari kungah; “Ngai in, tam naungeh Israel lah a, mi tampi puana ding leh tundingna dinga guot ahi. Tualeh gensietna chiemtena zong ahi ding hi."},"35":{"text":"(Ahi nangma lungtang zong namsau in adawt pailet ding a) tuachi a mi tampi lungtang ngaituona akilat theina dingin.”"},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Asher nam a mi, Phanuel tanu, Anna kichi numei guolnei khat a um a, amanu tesetah ahita a, anungah tawp nuasie apasal kungah kum sagi a um a;","title":"Anna kipah thugenna"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh tam numeinu khu meithai kum sawmgiet leh kum li vel mi ahi a, amanu’n Pasian bieh inn peisan louin sun leh zan in ann ngawlna toh thungen in Pasian abie hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin amanu ahing pei a, Pasian kungah kipah thu agen a, Jerusalem khuo a tatna ding lamen zousie kungah, Jesu tanchin agen hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa dan dungzui a sil zousie abawl zou un, Galili gam a amauh khuo Nazareth ah anua pei ta uhi.","title":"Jesu Nazareth khuo ah akinualeta","ref":"Mat. 2.23"},"40":{"text":"Tualeh naungeh ahing khanglien deudeu a, alungsim ahing hat hiei hiei a, pilnain ahing dimta hi, tualeh Pasian khotuona atungah aumta hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n pei Kaan pawi mangin anu leh apa Jerusalem ah kum chinin ahaw zel uhi.","title":"Jerusalem bieh inn sung ah naupang Jesu","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-27; Danp. 16.1-8"},"42":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu kum sawm leh ni ahing hi in, pawi ngaina dan dungzuiin Jerusalem ah ava haw tou uhi."},"43":{"text":"Apawi man uh ahing kiven bep a ahing kinuale laiun naupang Jesu khu Jerusalem ah a um denta a, tualeh Joseph leh anuin athei sih uhi."},"44":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun alawite lah ua um hiva achi ua, ni khat lam apeita uhi; tuachi’n ahieng asante ulah leh ameltheite ulah asui uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachia amu lou tah un, ama sui kawm in Jerusalem ah akinuale kiata uhi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh ni thum nua in, Pasian biehinn ah Siete lah a, athu uh ngaikhie leh ama uh thu dongin ava muta uhi."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh Ama thu za pouma in atheisiemdan leh adawndante lamdang asa mama uhi."},"48":{"text":"Anu leh apa’n ava mu tahun lamdang asa mama ua, anu’n akungah, “Bawi bangdinga tambanga nang bawl ahiei? Ngai in, na pa leh ken lunggim tahin ka hing sui uhi,” achi hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n akung uah, “Bangdinga hing sui na hi uoi mah? Ka Pa inn a um a ana ka sep ding mawng ahi chi theilou na hi uoi mah?” achi hi."},"50":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun akung ua athugen atheisiem sih uhi."},"51":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama uh azui suh a, Nazareth khuo ahing tung ua, athu uh mangin a um hi. Tualeh anuin tam silte zousie alungtangah avom ngitnget hi."},"52":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu khu pilna lam leh tahsa ah ahing khanglien deudeu a, Pasian leh mihing deisah in a um deudeuta hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 2.26; Thu. 3.4"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tiberia Kaisar vaihawm kum sawm leh kum nga kum in, Pontius Pilat, Judia gam uhpipa ahi a, tualeh Herod khu Galili gam a kumpipa ahi a, asanggampa Philip khu Ituria leh Trokoniti kumpipa ahi a, tualeh Lisanias khu Abilene gam kumpipa ahi.","title":"Baptispa Johan leh anasepte (Mat. 3.1-12 ; Mak. 1.2-8 ; Jn. 1.18-31)"},"2":{"text":"Annas leh Kaiapha khu siempu lienpente ahi ua, khum hun laiin gamdai ah Zakaria tapa Johan kungah Pasian thu ahing tung hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ama khu Jordan lui kimvel a gam zousie ah khelnate ngaidamna dinga kisiana baptisma thugen in apei kawikawi hi."},"4":{"text":"Guolnei Isai laibu a, “Gamdai a mikikou aw in, Mangpa lamlien siel unlen, alampite sutang un.","ref":"Isai. 40.3-5"},"5":{"text":"Guom chin suhdim ahi dinga, muol leh tang chin suhngiem ahi dinga, tualeh akawina munte suh tang ahi dinga, aphawhnate suhmam ahi dinga;"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh mi zousie in Pasian hundamna amu ding uh,” chia kigiel bangin."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akunga baptisma tang dinga hing pei mipite kungah, “Nou gul suonte aw, lungthahna hing tung ding taisan dinga, hing vauhil koi ahiei?","ref":"Mat. 12.34; 23.33"},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin kisiana tham chingin ga suong un, tualeh Abraham ka pu uh ahi chiin na lungsim un ngaituo sih un, aziehpen Pasian in tam suongte Abraham hahlesuonte in ading sah thei hi.","ref":"Jn. 8.33"},"9":{"text":"Tu mamain zong sing zung chin ah heipi koi ahita, tuaziehin sing chin ga hoi a galou pouma phuain a um a, meikuong lai a pai in a um zel hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 7.19"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipiten akungah, “Ahileh Kouten bang ka bawl ding uoi leh?” chiin adong uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aman adawnga, akung uah, “Koipou puon ah ni neiin, aneilou hawm heh, tualeh koipou ann neiin tuamabangin bawl heh.”"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n siedongmite zong baptisma tang dingin ahing pei ua, akung ah, “Siepa kouten bang ka bawl ding uoi?” achi uhi.","ref":"Luk. 7.29"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh aman akung uah, “Ahing bihieh sah val uh khon nawn sih un,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuamabangin galkapten zong akungah, “Kouten bang ka bawl ding uoi?” chiin adong uhi. Aman akung uah “Koima pawngbawlin sum lahpieh sih unlen, dihlou tahin koima heh sih unlen, na law uah lungkim un,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite kinemtahin a um ua, mi zousiein Johan khu Khrist ahi kha de aw, chia alungtang ua angaituo lai un;"},"16":{"text":"Johan in adawnga, akung uah, “Ken tuiin ka hing baptis a, hinanleh Kei sanga thupi zaw khat ahing pei dinga, Kei pen akedap khau sut taah zong ka hi hisih hi. Aman Hagau Siengthou leh meiin nou ahing baptis ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Aman akhut in phazap atawi a, aphuol azap sieng kilkel dinga, tualeh bute abupangah asungkhawm ding hi, hinanleh bushite pen mei mit theilou toh ahaltum ding hi.”"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh hanthawnna thu dang tampi toh mipite kungah khantan hoi thu agen hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh kumpipa Herod in asanggampa Philip zi Herodia zieh leh asilgilou bawl zousie tung thu a Johan in aphawhhil ziehin;","ref":"Mat. 14.3,4; Mak. 6.17,18"},"20":{"text":"Asil bawlkhel zousie belapnain Johan suongkul ah akhumta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh mipi zousie in baptisma atan zou tah un, Jesu’n zong baptisma atanga, thungetna anei laiin van ahing kihonga,","title":"Jesu baptisma tanna (Mat. 3.13-17 ; Mak. 1.9-11 ; Jn. 1.32-34)"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Hagau Siengthou tahsa puoin vakhu bangin ahing kumsuh a, “Atungah atuta a, tualeh van a kipat in aw ahing pawt a, Nang ka Tapa deitah na hi, na tungah ka lungdam mama hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 22.2; Late. 2.7; Isai. 42.1; Mat. 3.17; Mak. 1.11; Luk. 9.35"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n nasep apat chiil lai in kum sawmthum vel ahita a, mite ngaidanin Joseph tapa ahia, tua khu Heli tapa ahia,","title":"Jesu khanggui sutna (Siem. 5.1-32 ; 11.10-26 ; Ruth. 4.18-22 ; 1 Khang. 1.1-4 , 24-27 , 34 ; 2.1-15 ; Mat. 1.2-6)"},"24":{"text":"Heli khu Matthat tapa ahia, Matthat khu Levi tapa ahia, Levi khu Melki tapa ahia, Melki khu Janna tapa ahia, Janna khu Joseph tapa ahia,"},"25":{"text":"Joseph khu Matathiah tapa ahia, Matathiah khu Amos tapa ahia, Amos khu Nahum tapa ahia, Nahum khu Esli tapa ahia, Esli khu Naggai tapa ahia,"},"26":{"text":"Naggai khu Maath tapa ahia, Maath khu Mattathiah tapa ahia, Matathiah khu Semei tapa ahia, Semei khu Joseph tapa ahia, Joseph khu Juda tapa ahia,"},"27":{"text":"Juda khu Joannas tapa ahia, Joannas khu Rhesa tapa ahia, Rhesa khu Zerubbabel tapa ahia, Jerubbabel khu Shealtiel tapa ahia, Shealtiel khu Neri tapa ahi,"},"28":{"text":"Neri khu Melki tapa ahia, Melki khu Addi tapa ahia, Addi khu Kosam tapa ahia, Kosam khu Elmodam tapa ahia, Elmodam khu Er tapa ahia,"},"29":{"text":"Er khu Joshua tapa ahia, Joshua khu Eliezer tapa ahia, Eliezer khu Jorim tapa ahia, Jorim khu Matthat tapa ahia, Matthat khu Levi tapa ahia,"},"30":{"text":"Levi khu Simeon tapa ahia, Simeon khu Juda tapa ahia, Juda khu Joseph tapa ahia, Joseph khu Jonan tapa ahia, Jonan khu Eliakim tapa ahi a,"},"31":{"text":"Eliakim khu Melia tapa ahia, Melia khu Menan tapa ahia, Menan khu Mattathah tapa ahia, Mattathah khu Nathan tapa ahia, Nathan khu David tapa ahia,"},"32":{"text":"David khu Jesse tapa ahia, Jesse khu Obed tapa ahia, Obed khu Boaz tapa ahi, Boaz khu Salmon tapa ahia, Salmon khu Nahshon tapa ahi,"},"33":{"text":"Nahshon khu Aminadab tapa ahia, Aminadab khu Aram tapa ahia, Aram khu Hezron tapa ahia, Hezron khu Perez tapa ahia, Perez khu Juda tapa ahia,"},"34":{"text":"Juda khu Jakob tapa ahia, Jakob khu Isaak tapa ahia, Isaak khu Abraham tapa ahia, Abraham khu Terah tapa ahia, Terah khu Nahor tapa ahia,"},"35":{"text":"Nahor khu Serug tapa ahia, Serug khu Reu tapa ahia, Reu khu Peleg tapa ahia, Peleg khu Heber tapa ahia, Heber khu Shelah tapa ahi a,"},"36":{"text":"Shelah khu Kainan tapa ahia, Kainan khu Arpaksad tapa ahia, Arpaksad khu Shem tapa ahia, Shem khu Noah tapa ahia Noah khu Lamek tapa ahia,"},"37":{"text":"Lamek khu Mathuselah tapa ahia, Mathuselah khu Enok tapa ahia, Enok khu Jared tapa ahia, Jared khu Mahalalel tapa ahia, Mahalalel khu Kainan tapa ahia,"},"38":{"text":"Kainan khu Enos tapa ahia, Enos khu Seth tapa ahia, Seth khu Adam tapa ahia, Adam khu Pasian tapa ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu khu Hagau Siengthoua dim in Jordan lui a kipat in akinuale kia a, tualeh gamdai ah Hagau puiin aum a,","title":"Jesu Khrist sol a a umna (Mat. 4.1-11 ; Mak. 1.12 , 13)"},"2":{"text":"Ni sawmli sung diabol sol in a umta a; tua nite sungin Aman bangma ane sih a, tuachi’n atawpin agil ahing kielta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n diabol in akungah “Pasian Tapa na hileh tam suong tanghou suoh dingin thupie in,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n adawnga “Mihing tanghou guohin ahing sih dinga, Pasian thu chin in ahing zaw ding chi gel ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 8.3"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n diabol in Ama khu muol sang tung khat ah apuitou a, mitphiet kallouin leitung leenggam zousie a ensahta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n diabol in akungah, “Tamte zousie tunga thuneina leh athupina ka hing pe ding, ka kunga piehkhiet ahitah ziehin, ka pieh ut tapou kungah ka pe zel hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin kei na hing bieh pouleh abawnin nanga ahi ding, achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawnga akungah, “Setan ka nualangah um in; Mangpa na Pasian na be dinga Ama nna bou na sep ding ahi, chi gel ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 6.13"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n diabol in Ama khu Jerusalem ah apui a, “Pasian biehinn sipvum ah akoi a, akungah, Pasian Tapa na hileh tana kipat in kesuh in;"},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman nang hing humbit dingin, avansawlsiengte thu ape dinga,","ref":"Late. 91.11,12"},"11":{"text":"Amaun akhut un ahing dom ding ua, tua ahisihleh na kengin suong asui kha ding hi, chiin akigiel hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n adawnga, akungah, “Mangpa na Pasian ze et sin,” akichi hi.","ref":"Danp. 6.16"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n diabol in asolna ding tenga asol zouin hun lemtang a dingin apeisanta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu khu Hagau silbawltheinain Galili gam ah akinuale kiata a, tualeh atanchin khu khum gam kimvel ah athang suohta hi.","title":"Jesu Nazareth a aumna (Mat. 4.12 ; Mak. 1.14)"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh akikhopna innte uah, thu ahil zel a mi zousie pahtat in a um hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n akhanletna khuo Nazareth ahing tungta hi. Tualeh abawldan ngaina bangin khawlni in kikhopna innah aluta, Laisiengthou sim dingin ading hi.","title":"Nazareth ah Jesu anuol uh"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh akungah guolnei Isai laibu apie ua, tuachi’n Aman tua laibu aphen a tam thu kigelna mun laitah aphendoh hi,"},"18":{"text":"“Mi liengvaite kunga khantan hoi, gen dinga sathau ahing nutah ziehin, Mangpa Hagau ka tungah a um hi, Aman lungtang hasete sudam ding leh, saltangte kunga suotatna thu leh, mittote kunga mitvah kiana thu gen ding leh, bawlsietna thuohte zalenna leh,","ref":"Isai. 61.1,2"},"19":{"text":"Mangpa lungdam kum thu gen dingin ahing sawl hi,” chi khu."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n laibu khu aziel a, thu nasempa apekia a, atouta hi. Tualeh kikhopna inn a um mi zousie mit atungah atuta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Tuni’n tam Laisiengthou thu na zah un atangtung ta hi,” chiin agen panta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi zousiein athu atheipi ua, tualeh akama pawt hepina thute lamdang asa mama uhi. Tualeh amaun “Tampa khu Joseph tapa hilou amah?” achi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Nouten tam paunah Daktor nang leh nang kisudam in, Kapernaum khuo a na silbawlte ka na zah zousie uh tanah, nangma kholam ah zong bawl in na hing chi ding uhi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, guolnei koima ama gam sung ah akipahpi ngai sih u hi.","ref":"Jn. 4.44"},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh thudih ka hing hil ahi, Elijah damlai a kum thum leh ha guh van akikha a, leitunga kiel nasatah atun laiin Meithai tampi a um uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 17.1"},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh Sidon gam a Zarephath khuo a meithainu khat kungah chilou alah ua koima kungah Elijah sawl ahi sih hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 17.8-16"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh guolnei Elisha damlai in, Israel gam ah phah tampi a um uh, hinanleh Siria mi Naaman chilou koima suhsiengthou in a um sih hi achi hi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 5.1-14"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n kikhopna inn a um zousie in tam thute azah tah un alungthah chietta ua;"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh adingdoh ua, khopi akipat a deldoh ua, akhuo uh umna muolvuma kawlkhoua sawnkhieh dingin apuita uhi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh ama khu akikaal uah apeisuoh a, apei mangta hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Galili gam a khuo khat Kapernaum ah ahing peisuh a, tualeh khawlnite in amauh thu ahil a;","title":"Hagau bua nei mi suhdamna (Mak. 1.21-28)"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh thuneitah a thu agen ziehin athuhil khu lamdang asa mama uhi.","ref":"Mat. 7.28,29"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh kikhopna inn ah hagau bua nei mi khat a um a, tualeh aw ngaitahin akikou a;"},"34":{"text":"“Kouma tangin hing um sahin, Nazareth Jesu nang leh kouten bang ahiei kizopna inei? Koute sumang ding a hing pei na hiei mah? Nang koi na hiei chi ka hing thei hi, Pasian Mi Siengthou na hi,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n aphawh a, “Sip inlen asunga pat in hing pawtdoh in achi hi. Tualeh dawi in amapa alah ua asawnpua zouin ahing pawtdoh a, bangma alaw nawn sih hi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh abawn un lamdang asa mama ua, Tami bang thu atai le! Thuneitah leh silbawltheitahin dawibuate thu apie a, apawt mai uhi,” chiin akihou uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua kim gam mun chin ah atanchin athangta hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Ama adingdoh a, kikhopna inn apat apawt a, Simon inn ah alutta hi. Tualeh Simon zinu nu khu napitahin ana khosih a, tuachi’n Ama khu amanu a dingin ana nget pieh uhi.","title":"Peter sungnu damsahna (Mat. 8.14 , 15 ; Mak. 1.29-31)"},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama khu amanu geiah a dinga, khosih khu aphawh a, tuachi’n aphata hi, tualeh ahing thou pai a ana uh asep piehta hi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh nitumkuon ahing hi tahin, natna tuomtuom a na, damlou nei zousie in akungah ahing pui ua; tualeh Aman ama uh tung chiet ah khut angama asudamta hi.","title":"Galili gam pumpi a Jesu nasepna (Mat. 4.23-25 ; 8.16-17 ; Mak. 1.32-39)"},"41":{"text":"Tualeh dawite zong “Nang Khrist Pasian Tapa na hi chia kikou in,” mi tampite sunga kipat in ahing pawtdoh uhi. Tualeh Aman amauh aphawh a, aham ding uh aphal sih hi, amaun Khrist ahi chi athei zieh un."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh khuo ahing vah bepin, apawtdoh a koima umlouna mun sip ah a peita hi. Tualeh mipiten Ama asui ua, akungah ahing pei ua, amauh nuasie lou dingin tuhtaang atum uhi;"},"43":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman akung uah, “Pasian leenggam tanchin khodanga zong ka gen ding ahi, tua ding mawnga sawl ka hi zieh in,” achi hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n Galili gam a kikhopna innte ah thu agen zel hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Pasian thu ngai dinga mipiten Ama a bawbuoi lai un, Genesaret dil gei ah Ama adinga;","title":"Nuazui masate hatna","ref":"Mat. 13.1,2; Mak. 3.9,10; 4.1"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh dil gei a kuong ni um amu a, hinanleh nga manmiten akuong uh nuasie a, alente uh sawp in a um uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n kuongte lah a khat, Simon a pen ah atuonga, akungah pieugei apat themkhat tawldeu ding in angen a, tualeh atou a, kuong tung apat in mipite kungah thu ahilta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh thu gen atawp bep in, Simon kungah, “Li thuh lam nai unlen, nga man dingin na lente uh sep un,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Simon in adawnga, akungah, “Siepa aw, zan khovah in gimtahin ka pang ua, bangma ka man sih uhi, ahivangin na thuin len ka sep ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Jn. 21.3"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh len ase u’leh nga tampi akhukha ua, tualeh alente uh keh dingin akisa hi.","ref":"Jn. 21.6"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n kuong danga um alawmte uh ama uh hing panpi dingin akhutzap ua, tuachi’n amauh ahing pei ua, kuong nite gel ah asung dim ua, tuachi’n tum dingin akisa phielta hi."},"8":{"text":"Simon Peter in tami amu in, Jesu khup kunga khupboh in, “Mangpa Aw hing peisan in, mikhiel ka hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"A nga mat uh ama leh alawmten lamdang asah mama zieh un."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Simon kithuopite Zebedi tapate Jakob leh Johan in zong lamdang asa uhi. Tualeh Jesu’n Simon kungah, “Zau sin, Tu bansie mihing na manta ding achi hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n akuongte uh luipangah ahing tawldoh ua, bangma zousie nuasie in Ama azuita uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahia, khuo khat a a um laiin, Ngai in, mi khat apumtanga phah tuom aum a, aman Jesu amu tahin tuol ah akhupboh a, “Mangpa na ut leh Kei nang susieng thei hi, chiin angen ngenngut hi.”","title":"Phah khat damsahna (Mat. 8.2-4 ; Mak. 1.40-45)"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akhut in asawh a, akhoi a, “Ka ut hi, siengthoutain,” achi hi. Tuachi’n thakhat in aphahnain anuasie paita hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akungah, Koima hil sinlen, hinanleh “Va pei inlen, siempu kungah va ki ensah inlen na sienthouna dingin Mosi thupieh bangin sil va lan in, amaute theisahna dingin,” chiin thu apie hi.","ref":"Siempu. 14.1-32"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu tanchin athang nasa zawsemsem a, mipi tampi athu za nuom leh anatna uh kisudamsah nuomin ahing peikhawm uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama gamdai ah atuom pei a, athumta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh ni khat hichi ahing hi a, Jesu’n thu ahil laitahin, Galili leh Judia gam kho chin akipan leh Jerusalem khuo akipat a hing pei Pharisaite leh dan siemte akung ah atou ua, tualeh amauh suhdamna dingin, Mangpa silbawltheina khu akungah a um hi.","title":"Zeng khat suhdamna (Mat. 9.1-8 ; Mak. 2.1-12)"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ngai vawi, miten zeng khat lupna in ahing zawng ua, Amasang a zawnlut atum uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh mipi ziehin azawnlutna dan amu thei sih ua, inn tungah akaltou ua, tualeh bichiing aphetvang ua, inn tung akipat alaikim tah a Jesu mai ah alupnatoh akhaikhe suh uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n aginna uh amuin akungah, “Mihing na khelnate ngaidam ahita hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n laigielmite leh Pharisaiten Pasian gensie “Tam mipa koi ahiei? Pasian chilou ngal koi ahiei khelna ngaidam thei?” chiin angaituo panta uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n angaituonate uh athei tahin, adawng a, akung uah, “Bang dinga na lungsim ua kidongtuo na hi uoi mah?"},"23":{"text":"Na khelnate ngaidam ahita chi leh, thou inlen na kengin peita in chi heipen abailam zaw ei? achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Mihing Tapa in leitungah khel ngaidam theina anei hi chi na theina ding un,” zeng a damloupa kungah, “Thou inlen, na lupna la inlen na innah peita in, ka hing chi ahi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n amasang uah athou pai a, alupna ala a a inn langah Pasian phat kawmin apeita hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n abawn un lamdang asa mama ua, Pasian aphat ua, “Tuni’n sil lamdang tah imu uhi,” achi ua, azau mama uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tam silte zouin apawtkhie a, sie piehna mun a tou, amin Levi kichi siedongmi khat amu a; tualeh akungah “Hing zuiin,” achi hi.","title":"Matheu kihatna (Mat. 9.9 ; Mak. 2.13 , 14)"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman bangkim nuasie in, adingdoh a, Ama azuita hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Levi in a inn ah Jesu dingin annkuong thupitah a lui a, khunah siedongmite tampi leh midangten amauh annkuong a impi uhi.","title":"Jesu’n mikhielte toh ann anehkhawmna (Mat. 9.10-13 ; Mak. 2.15-17)"},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh alaigielmite u’leh Pharisaite khu anuazuite tungah aphun ua, “Bangdinga siedongmite leh mikhielte toh ne a dawn khawm nahi uoi?” achi uhi.","ref":"Luk. 15.1,2"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawng a, akung uah, “Mi chidamten Doktor atulmaw sih ua, mi damlouten atulmaw zaw uhi."},"32":{"text":"Midihtatte han dinga hing pei ka hi sih a, hinanleh mikhielte han a kisiasah dinga hing pei ka hi zaw hi,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, “Johan nuazuiten ann angawl zel ua, tualeh thu angen zel uhi, tuamabangin Pharisaite nuazuiten zong abawl uhi; hinanleh Nang nuazuiten bangdinga ne a dawn ahi uoi?” achi uhi.","title":"Annngawl thu a dohna (Mat. 9.14 , 15 ; Mak. 2.18-20)"},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Moupuite kunga mouneipa a um laisie moupuite ann na ngawlsah thei uoi mah?"},"35":{"text":"Hinanleh alah uapat mouneipa lahmang nite ahing tung dinga, tua ni chiengin ann angawl ding uh,” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n akung uah gente thu khat zong agen a, “Koima’n puon thain puon lui aphaw ngai sih, phawta leh atha pen in alui khu kaikeh dinga, tualeh atha thempen alui toh akituoh sih ding hi.","title":"Puon leh savun thawl gentena thu (Mat. 9.16 , 17 ; Mak. 2.21-22)"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Koima’n uoin tha khu savun thawl lui ah akoi ngai sih, koitaleh uoin thain savun thawl lui khu apawhkehsah dinga, akibo dinga, tualeh savun thawlte zong ase ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh uoin tha khu savun thawl tha a koi ding ahi, tuachi’n ani in abit ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Mi koiman uoin lui adawn zouin, uoin tha alunggul pai ngai sih ua, alui ma tuizaw achi zel uhi,” achi hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Khawlni masapen zou a khawlni nina pen niin buleilaite ah apeisuoh ua, anuazuiten buvuite asihtan ua, akhut ua nuoiin ane uhi.","title":"Khawlni tan thu a dohna (Mat. 12.1-8 ; Mak. 2.23-28)","ref":"Danp. 23.25"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Pharisai koite ahiei in akungah, “Bangdinga khawlni a bawl sienglou na bawl uh ahiei” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu’n adawng a, akung uah, “David leh alawmten agilkiel lai ua, asilbawl uh simkha lou na hi uoi mah?"},"4":{"text":"Tuachia Pasian inn a alut a, siempute loungal neh sienglou tanghou alah a, aneh a, tualeh alawmte kunga zong apieh thu,” achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 24.9; 1 Sam. 21.1-6"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah “Mihing Tapa khu khawlni Mangpa zong ahi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Khawlni dangin, kikhopna inn ah alut a, thu ahila, tualeh khunah mi khat akhut zietlam zaw ana um hi.","title":"Jesu’n khutzaw khat asuhdamna (Mat. 12.9-14 ; Mak. 3.1-6)"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh laigielmite leh Pharisaiten, ahehsietna ding amu theina dingun, khawlni a asuhdam leh suhdamlou asim et uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman angaituote uh atheia, khut zawpa kungah, “Thou inlen tanah hing dingin,” achi a, tualeh ama athou a adingta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Sil khat ka hing dong ding hi, Khawlni a sil hoi bawl asieng ei, ahisihleh sil gilou bawl? Hinna hundam ahiei sieng ahisihleh suhlup?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh akima umte a enkuol a, “Tua mipa kung ah na khut jahin” achi a, tuachi’n aman azah a, tuachi’n alangkhat bangbangin adamta hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh amauh alungthah mama ua, Jesu tunga abawldan ding uh khat leh khat akikum uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua hun laiin apawtkhie a, muol ah thungen dingin apei a, tualeh zankhovah in Pasian kungah athum den hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh sun ahing hi bepin, anuazuite akungah ahan a, alah ua kipat sawm leh ni ateldoh a, amin u’zong sawltahte achi hi.","title":"Nuazui sawm leh nite atelna (Mak. 3.13-19)"},"14":{"text":"Simon, Aman Peter achipa leh asanggampa Andru, Jakob leh Johan; Philip leh Bartholomai;"},"15":{"text":"Mathiu leh Thomas, Alpheus tapa Jakob leh Zealot kichipa Simon,"},"16":{"text":"Jakob tapa Juda leh amansahpa Juda Iskariot, ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh amautoh apei suh a, mun jang tung khat ah ading a, anuazuite mipi tampi leh Judia gam pumpi leh Jerusalem akipat leh Tai-ar leh Sidon kholam a, tuipi gei akipat mipi thupitah athu ngai nuom leh adamlounate uh suhdam ut in ahing pei ua;"},"18":{"text":"Dawibua in asuhgenthei mite zong ahing pei uhi.
