Tualeh amaute zong suhdam in a umta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Ama akipat a silbawltheina apawtkhie a, amauh zousie adamsah ziehin, abawn un Ama thamkhah atum chiet uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama adahtou a, anuazuite a en a, “Nou gentheite aw na hampha uhi, Pasian gam noute a ahiziehin.","title":"Hamphatnate leh tunggihnate (Mat. 5.1)"},"21":{"text":"“Nou tu a gilkielte na hampha uhi, gilva ding na hi zieh un; “Nou tu a kapte na hampha uhi, nui ding na hi zieh un."},"22":{"text":"“Mihing Tapa zieh a miten ahing muda ua, ahing nawdoh ua, ahing housiet ua, na min uh ahoi sih chia ahing pampai chiengun na hampha uhi.","ref":"1 Pet. 4.14"},"23":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin kipah unlen, nuomin kitawm un, Ngai un, van ah na nuomman uh athupi ahi. Aziehpen tuamabangin apu leh pate un guolneite ana bawl uhi.","ref":"2 Khang. 36.16; Nasep. 7.52"},"24":{"text":"“Hinanleh nou mihausate na tunguh agih hi, aziehpen nouten na hamuon na uh na mu zouta uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Nou tu a gilvate na tung uh agih hi, aziehpen gilkiel ding na hi uhi. Nou tu a nuite na tunguh agih hi aziehpen Kap a mau ding na hi uhi."},"26":{"text":"“Mi zousie in ahing phat chieng un na tung uh agih hi, Aziehpen apu lepate un, tuamabangin, guolnei tahloute tungah ana bawl uhi."},"27":{"text":"“Hinanleh nou ka thu ngaikhete kungah kang hil ahi, na galte uh it unlen, ahing mudate tungah silhoi bawl un.","title":"Na galte it un (Mat. 5.39-48 ; 7.1-2 , 12)"},"28":{"text":"Nou hing hamsiette guolzawl unlen, ahing simmawte thum pieh un."},"29":{"text":"Na pheta hing behpiehte kungah alangkhat lam zong dawin, tualeh na puonzal hing lahpiehpa kungah na puonah zong it sin."},"30":{"text":"Na kunga hing ngen pouma pie inlen, tualeh na neitah hing lahpiehpa kungah ngenkia nawn sin."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh miten na tung ua abawl dinga na dei banguh mi tungah zong bawl un.","ref":"Mat. 7.12"},"32":{"text":"“Hinanleh nou hing itte maimai na it u’leh pahtat bang na law ding uoi, Mikhielten zong amauh itte a it sam uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh na tung ua silhoi bawlte tung maimai a, silhoi na bawl uleh pahtat bang nalaw ding uoi? Mikhielten zong tuabangin abawl uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh mukia na kinepnate kung maimai a na palahsah u’leh bang pahtat na law ding uoi? Mikhielten zong apalahsah za mu kia dingin mikhielte kungah apalahsah uhi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanleh na melmate uh it unlen, bangma mu kia ding kinem louin palasah un, tuahileh na nuomman uh athupi dinga; Tungnungpen tate na hi ding uhi. Aziehpen Aman kipahna dan theiloute leh migiloute ahepi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuazieh in na Pa uh mi hepi asiem bangin noute zong mi hepi siem un."},"37":{"text":"“Thukhen sih un, tuachi’n thukhenpieh in na um sih ding uhi, mawpai sih un, tuachi’n mawpai in na um sih ding uhi, tualeh ngaidam un tuachi’n ngaidam in na um ding uhi.","title":"Midangte demna thu ah"},"38":{"text":"Pia un, tuachi’n pieh in na um ding uh, hoitaha tein, namdet inlen, loh thopin, tuachi’n adimlet in na angsung uah pieh in na um ding uhi. Aziehpen na tena mama un ahing kitepieh ding hi,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah gentena khat agen a, “Mitto in mitto ma apui thei diei? Ani un guomkuoh ah kekhawm talou ding uh amah?","title":"Mitto leh mitto gentena thu (Mat. 7.3-5 , 16-18)","ref":"Mat. 15.14"},"40":{"text":"Nuazui khu apu tungah aum sih a, hinanleh michin bukimtah a azil siem chieng un apu bangin a um ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.24,25; Jn. 13.16; 15.20"},"41":{"text":"Tualeh bangdinga nangma mit a singtun um lam theilou a, na unaupa mit a ninneng neunou um na mu ahiei?"},"42":{"text":"Nangma mit a singtun um mu loupi a, na unaupa kunga, unaupa na mit a ninneng neunou um hing lakhesahin bangchi a chi thei na hiei? Milepchie nangma mit apat singtun lakhe masa in tuachi’n na unaupa mit a ninneng lahkhiet ding khu chientahin na mu thei ding hi."},"43":{"text":"“Sing hoi gasie a ga a um ngai sih, sing sie lah ga hoia ga a um sih hi.","title":"Singkung aga in aki thei hi"},"44":{"text":"Singchin amauh ga chiet ah akithei hi. Mi’n lingkung ah theipi alou ngai sih ua, tualeh lingnoh lah ah grep alou ngai sih uhi.","ref":"Mat. 12.33"},"45":{"text":"Mi hoi in alungtang goubawm hoi akipat in sil hoi ahing pawtkhe sah zel a, tualeh migilou in alungtang goubawm sie a kipat in sil hoilou ahing pawtkhe sah zel hi, aziehpen lungtanga dimval kam in agenkhe zel hi.","ref":"Mat. 12.34"},"46":{"text":"Tualeh nouten “Bangdinga ka gente bawl loupi a Mangpa Mangpa hing chi na hi uoi?","title":"Inn lamdan nite gentena"},"47":{"text":"Mi koipou ka kunga hing pei a, ka thugente za-a, zui khu, koi bangte ahi uoi ka hing ensah ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Ama khu inn lam mi thuh tah a tou a, suongpi tunga suongphum lem mi bang ahi; tualeh tui ahing let a, tuikhauin tua inn ahing kho a, asuling zou sih hi, suongpi tunga lam ahi ziehin."},"49":{"text":"Hinanleh za ngal a zuilou khu suongphum dettah a lem loua leitunga inn lam mi bang ahi; tua inn khu tui khau in ahing kho a apua pai hi; tua inn siet khu anasa mama hi,” achi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu’n mite zah a athugen zousie azaw nuain Kapernaum khuo ah alut a;","title":"Galkap lamkaipa suohpa suhdamna (Mat. 8.5-13)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh galkap zahoutu koi ahiei khat asuohpa deitah china in ashi dihdih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu tanchin azah tahin, asuohpa hing sudam dinga ngen dingin Juda upate akungah asawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh amauh Jesu kung avatun un, “Tam sil ama a dinga na bawlpieh taah ahi chiin angen uhi”"},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen aman ka nam uh a it a, ka kikhopna inn u’zong ama hing lampieh ahi, achi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu amautoh ahing peita hi. Tualeh inn akipat gamlalou ahing tun un galkap zahoutupa’n alawmte asawl a akungah, “Mangpa kisugim nuomda mai in, aziehpen ka innsung na lutna taah ahi sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin kei zong na kunga hing haw taahin ka kisim sih hi. Hinanleh athuin gen poulachin ka suohpa adam mai ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen Kei zong mi thunuoi a um ka hi a, ka nuoi ah galkapte a um ua, khat kungah peiin, ka chi leh apei a, tualeh adang khat kungah, hing peiin, ka chi leh ahing pei hi; tualeh ka suohpa kungah tami bawlin, ka chi leh abawl hi, achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Jesu’n tam thute azah in, amapa khu lamdang asa mama a, akihei kuol a, mipi ama zuite kungah “Ka hing hil ahi, Israelte lah ah zong hichi va-ia a ginna thupi ka mu kha mawngmawng sih hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh ami sawlte inn langah anua pei kia ua, suoh damloupa khu, dam in amuta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n hun sawt lou nua in, Nain kichi khuo khat ah ahaw a, tualeh anuazuite tampi leh mipi tamtah in Ama azui uhi.","title":"Nain khuo a meithainu tapa kaithawna"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh khopi kotpi kung ahing tunin, Ngai vawi, mishi khat ahing zawngkhie ua, anu tapa neisun ahi a, amanu meithai ahi a, tua khuo a mipi tampi akungah a um uhi."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa’n meithainu a mutahin ahepita mama a, “Kap sin” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n ava pei a, kuong kihongsa khu ava tham a, tualeh azawngte adingta uhi; tuachi’n “Aman tangval thou in, ka hing chi ahi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh mishi khu ahing toudoh a, ahing hamta hi, tuachi’n Jesu’n amapa khu anu kungah apeta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi zousie azauta ua, Pasian aphat ua, “I lah uoh guolnei thupitah ahing umta,” tualeh “Pasian in amite ahing veta hi,” achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Ama tungtang thu khu Judia gamsung pumpi leh akimvel gamte ah athang suohta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Johan nuazuiten tam thu zousie Johan kungah ahilta uhi.","title":"Baptispa Johan in a nuazuite Jesu kunga asawlna (Mat. 11.2-6)"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Johan in anuazuite lah a mi ni ahan a, Jesu kunga “Ahing pei dingpa na hiei mah? ahisihleh midang hungai nalai ding ka hi uoi mah?” chi ding in asawlta hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi nitegel akung ahing tun tahun, akungah “Baptispa Johan in, Ahing pei dingpa na hiei mah? ahisihleh midang hungai nalai ding ka hi uoi mah? chi a na kunga ahing sawlte ka hi uhi,” ava chi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hun lai tahin chinate hipi veite, dawi matte tampi asudam a, tualeh mitto tampite zong amit uh avah sah hi."},"22":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga akung uah, “Peita unlen na sil mute u’leh na zahte uh Johan vahil un; mittote mit ahing vahta a, Kengbaite kengin ahing peita ua, phate ahing siengthouta ua, bilbingten ahing za theita, mishite kaithawin a umta ua, tualeh mi gentheite kungah khantan hoi genin a umta hi.","ref":"Isai. 35.5,6; Isai. 61.1"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh koipou ka tunga lungkimlouna muloute ahampha uhi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Johan mi sawlte apei nua un, Jesu’n mipite kungah, “Johan tungtang thu agen panta a, Bang en ding a gamdai a peidoh na hi uoi? pumpeng hui sem kinuh en dingin maw?","title":"Jesu’n Johan apahtatna (Mat. 11.7-15)"},"25":{"text":"Ahisihleh bang en ding pen a peidoh na hi uoi? Puonnem silmi maw? Ngai un puon thupi sil leh mi nuomsate pen leengte innpi ah a um uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ahileh bang pen en dinga peidoh na hi uoi? guolnei maw? Ahi na kung uah ka gen ahi, Guolnei sanga thupi zaw ahi."},"27":{"text":"En un, ka sawltah na masang ah ka sawl a, aman na masang ah na lampi asiel ding chia atanchin kigiel khu ama ahi.","ref":"Mala. 3.1"},"28":{"text":"Numei sunga pieng lah ah, Baptispa Johan sanga thupi zaw guolnei a um sih hi, hinanleh Pasian gama neupen zong ama sangin athupi zaw hi, chi ka hing hil ahi.” Achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh athu za zousie leh siedong mite zong Johan baptisma tangin, Pasian siem atan uhi.","ref":"Mat. 21.32; Luk. 3.12"},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh Pharisaite leh dansiem miten akunga baptisma tanglouin, Pasian in ama ua dinga aguotsa khu anuolta uhi."},"31":{"text":"“Tuachi’n Mangpa’n tulai khangthate bang toh ka gente ta diei? Tualeh bang chibang ahi uoi?"},"32":{"text":"Amaute khu naupang vanzuona mun a tou a, khat leh khat, Theile hing tumpieh ung a, na lam sih ua, ka hing dapi u’leh lah na kap tuom sih ua, kichituate bang ahi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Aziehpen Baptispa Johan ahing pei a, tanghou ane sih a, uoin zong adawn sih hi, noute’n Dawi pai ahi na chi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Mihing Tapa ahing pei a, ane in adawn a, nouten En vawi uo, ann haipa, uoin haipa, siedongmite leh mikhielte lawmpa na chi zel uhi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanleh pilna khu atate zousie in siem atan chiet uhi, achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharisaite lah a khat in, Ama ann neh khawmpi dingin achiel a, tuachi’n Ama Pharisaipa inn ah alut a, annkuong ah atouta hi.","title":"Numei khat in Jesu keng sathau anuna"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai vawi, tuami khuo a um khelnanei numei khat in Jesu Pharisaipa inn ah ann ne in atou chi atheitahin alabastar bawm in thau namtui ahing tawi a,","ref":"Mat. 26.7; Mak. 14.3; Jn. 12.3"},"38":{"text":"Anualang ah akengbul ah kap kawmin adinga akephangte ahitui in asawp pieh a, asam in asia a, akephang atawp a, thau namtui anu hi."},"39":{"text":"Ama ann ne dinga chielpa Pharisai in tami amu tahin alungsimin “Tam mipa guolnei ahileh akhoinu koi ahiei, tualeh mi bangchibang ahiei, chi thei leh kilawm a, amanu lah mikhiel ahi ngal a,” achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawnga, akungah, “Simon na kungah thu gen ding khat ka nei hi,” achi hi; tuachi’n aman “Siepa gen in” achi hi.","title":"Leiba ba nite gentena"},"41":{"text":"“Sum leitawisah mi koi ahiei in, sum leitawi mi ni anei hi. Khatin makhai za nga aba a, tualeh khat in sawmnga aba hi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh asanna ding aneilou tah un, ani un angaidam tuohta hi. Tuazieh in hing hil in, tua mite gel koi zohin amapa a it zaw ding uoi?”"},"43":{"text":"Simon in adawnga, “Angaidam tam zoh pen pain hi dingin ka ngaituo hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Aman akungah “Na gen dih hi,” achi hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n numei lam anga a, Simon kungah, “Tam numei na mu ei? Na inn ah ka hing lut a, ka kephang silna ding tui na hing pe sih a, hinanleh amanu’n ahituiin ka kephang asil a, asam in asia hi."},"45":{"text":"Nang tawp zong na hing tawpsih a, hinanleh tam numeinu’n ka hing lut akipat in ka kephang tawp akhawl nai sih hi."},"46":{"text":"Nang ka lu sathau na hing nu sih a, hinanleh tam numei in ka kephang thau namtui ahing nu hi."},"47":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka hing hil ahi, akhelna tampite ngaidam ahita, amanu’n nahpitaha ahing it zieh in, hinanleh ngaidam tawmten a it tawm uhi,” achi hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman numeinu kungah “Na khelnate ngaidam ahita,” achi hi."},"49":{"text":"Tualeh ama toh annkuong a impiten “Mikhielte nangawn ngaidam thei, tam koi ahiei?” akichi uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman numeinu kungah, “Na ginnain ahing hundamta hi, hamuong tah in pei ta’n” achi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuami nua in, Jesu khu thuhil kawm leh Pasian gam khantan hoi gen kawmin kho lien leh kho neute ah avah kawikawi a, tualeh sawm leh nite akungah a um ua;","title":"Jesu na seppieh numeite"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh numei koite ahiei, dawi mat dam kia leh, natnate apata dam kiate leh Mari Magdalene achi uh asung apata dawi sagi pawtdohnanu zong a um uhi,","ref":"Mat. 27.55,56; Mak. 15.40,41; Luk. 23.49"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Herod sumkempa Chuza zi Joanna leh Susanna toh, tualeh midang tampite toh ahi ua, tuaten amauh neisa in, Ama apanpi zel uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh mipi tampi ahing peikhawm ua, khochin a mi akunga ahing pei tah un, gentenain thu agen a:","title":"Buchithepa gente thu (Mat. 13.1-23 ; Mak. 4.1-20)"},"5":{"text":"“Buchithepa khat abuchithe dingin akuon a, tualeh athe laiin, kimkhat lampi gei ah akie a, tua khu akituonchil a, tungleeng vaten anegam siengta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh kimkhatte suong tungah akie a, tualeh ahing pou tahin, alei anom lou ziehin avuoi pai hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh kimkhatte loulingnei lah ah akie a, loulingnei toh ahing pou khawm a, adep mangta hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh kimkhatte lei hoi ah a kie a, ahing pou a ale za in agata hi,” achi hi. Tualeh tam thute agen zou in akikou a, “Koipou zahna ding bil nei in za uheh,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n anuazuiten tam gentena thu bang china ahiei? chi’n Ama adong uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Aman “Pasian gam thuguhte noute thei dinga pieh ahia, midangte kungah pen gentena thu a gen ahi; mu napi a amu louna ding u’leh, za napia atheisiem louna ding un.","ref":"Isai. 6.9"},"11":{"text":"Tua gentena thu khu tami ahi: Buchi khu Pasian thu ahi.","title":"Gentena thu hilchienna"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh lampi gei a kete khu thu zakhate ahi ua, tuachi’n diabol ahing pei a agintat lou ua, hundam ahi thei louna ding un, alungtang ua kipat thu khu alah mangpieh zel hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh suong tunga kete ahileh azah tah ua thu kipah tah a pom paite ahi ua, hinanleh tamten bulbal anei sih ua, bakhat sung agingta ua, solna atuoh chieng un apua pai zel uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh loulingnei lah a kete ahileh, thu azah nua un apei ua, khosah dingdan ngaituonate, hausatnate leh damsung nopsahnate’n adep a, aga piching ngai sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh lei hoia kete pen, thu khu za a, lungtang hoitah leh za um tah a pomdet thuohhatna toh ga suongte ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Mi koima’n thaumei adet chiengun law akhu ngai sih, ahisihleh lupna nuoi ah akoi ngai sih hi, hinanleh alut pouma in amu theina dingun atunna ah akoi zaw uhi.","title":"Meivah akipat a kihilna","ref":"Mat. 5.15; Luk. 11.33"},"17":{"text":"Akiphuonglou dinga im bangma a um sih a, tualeh theilou ding leh langlou dinga phuolguh bangma a um sih hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.26; Luk. 12.2"},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin bangchibanga na zah uh ahiei, pilvangun; aziehpen koipou anei khu pieh belap ahi dinga, tualeh koipou aneilou khu nei a akingaisut nasan zong lahpieh ahi ding achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 25.29; Luk. 19.26"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh anu leh asanggamte Jesu kungah ahing pei ua, hinanleh mipi ziehin akung ahing tung thei sih uhi.","title":"Ki unauna dih (Mat. 12.46-50 ; Mak. 3.31-35)"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh “Na nu leh na sanggamte nang hing mu nuom in inn pulang ah ading uhi,” chi’n ahil uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman adawnga akung uah, “Ka nu leh ka sanggamte khu tam Pasian thu ngai a, zuite ahi uh,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n hichi ahing hia, ni khat anuazuite toh kuong ah atuong a, tualeh akung uah “Dil gal langkhat ah galkai va ui,” achi hi. Tualeh kuongte asut ua, atawlta uhi.","title":"Jesu’n tuipi kihot adai sah (Mat. 8.23-27 ; Mak. 4.35-41)"},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh akitawl lai un Ama a imuta a; tualeh dil ah huipi ahing laang suh a, akuong sung uah tui adim khielkhiel a, zauhuoi tahin aumta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n akungah ahing pei ua, aphawng ua, “Siepa, Siepa, mangthang ding ka hita uh” achi uhi. Tuachi’n Ama ahing thou a, huipi leh tui kihot khu aphawhta a, tuachi’n atawp ua tualeh asipta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Na ginna uh hei a um ahiei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n a zau ua lamdang asa mama ua, “Tam mipa koi ahiei? Aman huipi leh tui nangawn thu apie a, Athu aman mai uh” akichi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Galili gam gallang khat a um Gadara mite gam ahing tung uhi.","title":"Gadara gam a dawibua nei damna (Mat. 8.28-34 ; Mak. 5.1-20)"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Ama tuol a akumkhiet tahin, hun sawtpi dawi mat koi ahiei khat in khopi apat Ama ana lamdot a, tualeh aman puon mawngmawng asil sih a, inn ah zong aum ngai sih a, han mun lah pou ah a um zel hi."},"28":{"text":"Aman Jesu amu tahin akikou a, Amasangah apua a, aw ngaitah in, Jesu, Nang Pasian tungnung pen Tapa, “Kei bang hing law sawm na hiei? hing sugenthei lou dingin ka hing ngen ahi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Jesu’n dawibua khu tua mipa sunga kipat pawtkhe dingin thu ana peta hi. Tua mipa khu dawiin tamveipi amanta a, tualeh miten ama aveng zing ua, Khainieng leh kol abun sah ua, hinanleh aman akigahna kolte aphutan a, gamdai ah dawi delmangin a um zel hi."},"30":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Na min bang ahiei?” chi’n adong hi. Aman “Legion” achi hi, asunga dawi tampi alut ziehin."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh amaun kokhuh mongbei a pei ding a thu pelou ding in Jesu kungah angen uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua muna muol tungah, voh hon tampi annmai in ata uhi. Tualeh amaun vohte sunga luttheina ding phalna akungah angen uhi. Tualeh Aman aphalpiehta hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n dawite tua mipa sunga kipat apawt ua, vohte sungah alut ua, tualeh voh hon khu dil gei ken lah ah a tai suh ua, dil ah atai lut ua, tui valin ashi siengta uhi."},"34":{"text":"Voh khawiten sil umdan amu tah un, atai ua, tam thu khopi leh khoneute ah ava agenta uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n bang thu um atai? chia en dingin mipite apawtdoh ua, Jesu kung ahing tun un, dawi matpa khu puon sil a, lungsim dihtah puo a Jesu kengbul a tou amu ua, tuachi’n azauta uhi."},"36":{"text":"Dawi matpa suhdama a umdante mit a muten ama uh ana hil uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n Gadara mite gam kiim a um mipite zousie in azau mama ziehun Ama khu akung ua kipat a peimang dingin angen ua, tuachi’n Ama zong kuongah atuong a, apei kiata hi."},"38":{"text":"Asunga kipat dawite pawtdohna mipain Ama kunga umden ding angen a, hinanleh Jesu’n asawlkhie a,"},"39":{"text":"“Na inn ah peikia inlen, Pasian in nang dinga sil thupitah ahing bawl pieh dan va hil in,” achi hi. Tuachi’n ama zong apeita a, Jesu’n ama a dinga sil thupitah abawl pieh dan khopi sung pumpi ah aphuongzah ta hi."},"40":{"text":"Jesu ahing kinuale kia in, mipi in Ama ana kipahpi ua, abawn ua Ama na ngah, zing ahi zieh un.","title":"Numei sipawt damsahna (Mat. 9.12-22 ; Mak. 5.21-34)"},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai vawi, mi khat amin Jairas kichi kikhopna inn a vaihawmpa ahing pei a, Jesu kengbul ah akhupboh a, a inn a haw dingin angen vangut hi."},"42":{"text":"Aziehpen aman tanu tangkhat kum sawm leh kum ni vel pha pan khat anei a, amanu shi dingin akisata hi. Hinanleh Jesu apei laiin mipi hon in abaw valuoi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh numei khat kum sawm leh kum ni si pawt, anei alam zousie daktorte kungah azangbeita a, koiman asuhdam zoulou uh,"},"44":{"text":"Anua ah ahing pei a, apuon mong akhoi a, tuachi’n thakhat in asi pawt akangta hi."},"45":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n “Koi ahiei ahing khoi?” achi hi. Tualeh mi zousie’n kei hilou achi chiet bep un, Peter leh akunga umten, “Siepa aw, mipi hon in ahing baw valuoi ua, ahing tuom hehu uh hilou ahiei mah, Koi ahiei kei hing khoi na chi,” achi uhi."},"46":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n “Koi ahiei khat in hing khoi hi ve aw, aziehpen silbawltheina kei a kipat in apawt chi ka thei hi,” achi hi."},"47":{"text":"Tuachi’n numei in akiphuol thei sih chi athei in chitun pumpumin ahing pei a, amaiah akhupboh a, akhoina zieh leh thakhat a adamtah dan mi zousie masangah agendohta hi."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n akungah, “Tanu lungnuom tahin um in; na ginna in ahing damsahta hi, hamuong tah in peita’n,” achi hi."},"49":{"text":"Aman thu agen zing lai in, kikhopna inn vaihawmpa inn akipat in mi khat ahing pei a, “Na tanu ashita hi, Siepa subuoi nawnda mai in,” achi hi.","title":"Jairas tanu kaithawna (Mat. 9.23-26 ; Mak. 5.35-43)"},"50":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n tam thu azah tahin adawnga, akungah, “Zau sin, gingta maiin, tuachi’n adamkia ding hi,” achi hi."},"51":{"text":"Tualeh inn sunga lut tahin, Peter, Jakob leh Johan tualeh naupang nu leh pa chilou koima lut aphal sih hi."},"52":{"text":"Tualeh abawn un amanu ana kaa lieiluoi ua, amau vengvung uhi; hinanleh Jesu’n “Kap sih un, ashi ahisih a, a imu ahi zaw hi,” achi hi."},"53":{"text":"Amaun amanu ashita chi athei zieh un, zumhuoi sain anuisan uhi."},"54":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n abawn un asawldoh sienga, amanu khu akhut in atu a, “Nungah thou in” chiin ahan hi."},"55":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahagau ahing kinuale kia a, thakhat in athou pai a, tualeh bang ahiei neh ding pe ding in thu apie hi."},"56":{"text":"Tualeh anu leh apa’n lamdang asa mama ua, hinanleh Aman asilbawl khu koima hil lou dingin akhamta hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n anuazui sawm leh nite ahankhawm a, dawi zousie tunga silbawltheina leh thuneina tualeh natnate suhdam theina apie hi.","title":"Sawltah sawm leh nite nasep (Mat. 10.1-14 ; 14.1-14 ; Mak. 6.7-13)"},"2":{"text":"Aman amaute Pasian gam thu gen ding leh damloute sudam dingin asawlkheta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Na khuolzin chiengun, chiengkhut ahiei, thungpi ahiei, tanghou ahiei, sum ahiei, bangma keng sih un, puonah zong athuop in keng sih un."},"4":{"text":"Na lutna inn uah tungden unlen, tualeh tuana kipat in kipankhie un."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh ahing na lamdawn lou pouma tua khopi akipat na peidoh chiengun amauh mawpaina etsahna dingin, na kephang ua leivui thingkhie un,” achi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 13.51; Luk. 10.4-11"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n akuonta ua, khantanhoi gen kawm leh munchin a mite sudamin khochin ah apei kawikawi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n leengpa Herod in asilbawl zousie ana zata a; kimkhat in Johan ahing kiata hi, achi ua,","title":"Herod lungbuoina","ref":"Mat. 16.14; Mak. 8.28; Luk. 9.19"},"8":{"text":"Kimkhat in Elijah hing kilah ahita, achi ua, tualeh midangten, Nidang lai a guolneite khat hing thou kia ahita achi zieh un, alungbuoita hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Herod in “Johan lah alu tanta ing a, hinanleh hichi lawmlawm a athu ka zahzah nalai koi adiei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n Ama mu atumta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh sawltahte ahing kinuale un, asilbawl zousiete uh Ama ahil uhi. Tuachi’n Jesu’n amauh azawpi a Bethsaida kichi khopi a koima umlouna mun sip khat ah atuom in apeipita hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh mipiten athei tah un Ama azui ua; tualeh Aman amauh ana kipahpi a, akung uah Pasian gam thu ahil a, suhdam kiphamaw pouma asudam hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh ni tumkuon ahing hi tahin, sawm leh nite ahing pei ua akungah, “Eite tana, mun sip a um ihi ziehun, mipite ikimvel a khopite leh khoneute a pei a giehna leh nehledawn ding sui dingin sawlkhetain,” achi uhi.","title":"Mipi tul nga vahna (Mat. 14.15-21 ; Mak. 6.35-44 ; Jn. 6.1-14)"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman akung uah, “Nouten aneh ding uh pie un” achi hi. Amaun “Mipi hizapi ading iva leipieh sih leh tanghou pheng nga leh nga ni chiloungal bangma inei sih uh,” achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen mi tul nga vel ahi uhi. Tuachi’n Aman anuazuite kungah, “Sawm nga nga in, apawl pawl in tousah un,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachibangin abawl ua, tualeh abawn un atousah chietta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman tua tanghou ngate leh nga nite ala a, van lam en touin aguolzawl a, aphalsuo a, anuazuite kungah, mipite mai a lui dingin apie hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n abawn un ane ua agilva chiet ua, tualeh aneh val nengte uh seu sawm leh seu ni aluoh dim uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu amatanga athum lai in anuazuite akungah aum ua; Aman akung uah “Mipite’n kei khu koi ahi ahing chi uoi?” chi’n adong hi.","title":"Peter in Khrist ahi chia aphuonna (Mat. 16.13-21 ; Mak. 8.27-31)"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun adawng ua, “Baptispa Johan ahing chi uh, hinanleh kimkhatten Elijah ahing chi ua, tualeh adangten nidanglai a guolneite lah a khat hing thou kia ahi ahing chi uhi,” achi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 14.1,2; Mak. 6.14,15; Luk. 9.7,8"},"20":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Ahileh nouten koi ka hi na hing chi uoi le?” achi hi. Peter in adawng a, “Pasian Khrist na hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Jn. 6.68,69"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Aman tam thu koima kunga hillou dingin khau tahin thu apie hi."},"22":{"text":"“Mihing Tapa in sil tampi ah thuohgimna athuoh dinga, upate leh siempu liente, tualeh laigielmite deilouin a um dinga, thain a um dinga, tualeh ni thumniin athou kia ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Jesu’n ashi ding leh athawkiana ding agen lawhna"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman amaute zousie kungah, “Mi koipou in ahing zui ut uleh amaleh ama kingaisah louin nichin in akross puo in hing zui heh.","title":"Nuazui dihtah hinaman (Mat. 16.24-27 ; Mak. 9.34-38)","ref":"Mat. 10.38; Luk. 14.27"},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen koi hinanleh ahinna humbit ut in, ataan dinga, hinanleh koipou keima zieh a ahinna taanin ahumbit ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.39; Luk. 17.33; Jn. 12.25"},"25":{"text":"Mi’n leitung pumpi nei henlen, ama kisumang in, ahisihleh ahinna taan taleh ama adingin bang aphatuom diei?"},"26":{"text":"Koipou keima leh ka thute zumpi khu, Mihing Tapa in Ama thupina toh, a Pa thupina toh, vansawlsiengte thupina toh, ahing pei chiengin ahing zumpi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh thudihtah ka hing hil ahi, tana ding mi pawlkhat, Pasian gam amu masangsie uh shina chiem vawt lou ding a um uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tam thute agen nua ni giet ding velin, Peter, Johan leh Jakob, azawpi a muol tung a thungen dingin apei uhi.","title":"Mel lamdanna (Mat. 16.28—17.9 ; Mak. 9.1-9 ; 2 Pet. 1.17 , 18)"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh thungetna anei lai in amel puohdan leh amaisuo ahing kiheng lamdanga, tualeh apuonsilte avam a atesitset ta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ngai vawi, mi ni Ama toh akihou ua, tuate gel khu Mosi leh Elijah ahi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Amauh thupina toh ahing kilah ua, Jerusalem a, ashina suhbukim ding thu agen uhi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter leh akunga umte a imut uh asuoh mama a, hinanleh ahah teitei ua, Jesu thupina leh akunga Ama toh mi ni dingte amu uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Jesu apeisan kuon lai un, Peter in Jesu kungah, “Pu aw, ei a dingin tana um ahoi hi, bawhinn thum i bawl dinga, Nanga dingin khat, Mosi adingin khat, tualeh Elijah a dingin khat,” achi a, bang ahiei agen chi zong theilou in."},"34":{"text":"Tambanga a genlai in, meilum ahing kai a, amauh alie a; meilum lah a alut bep un azauta uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n meilum lah akipat in aw khat ahing pawt a, “Tami ka Tapa deitah ahi, a thu Ngai un,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 42.1; Mat. 3.17; 12.18; Mak. 1.11; Luk. 3.22; 2 Pet. 1.17,18"},"36":{"text":"Tualeh aw gin akhawl tahin, Jesu amatanga um amuta uhi. Tualeh asip dide ua, tua hun laiin asil mute uh, koima kungah, ahil sih uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh azing nia muol akipat ahing kum suh lai un, mipi thupitah in Ama ana dawn uhi.","title":"Pasal naupang dawi mat suhdamna (Mat. 17.14-18 ; Mak. 9.14-27)"},"38":{"text":"Mipi lah a kipat thakhat in mi khat akikoukhie a, “Siepa aw, ka hing ngen ahi, Ka tapa en in, ka tapa nei sun ahi."},"39":{"text":"Ngai vawi, dawi in aman a thakhat khat in akikoudoh zel a, tuachi’n akama chilphuon bozen in asugenthei lenga, tualeh a sidupsah a, genthei tahin anuasie zel hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n na nuazuite kungah deldoh dingin ka ngen a, hinanleh adeldoh thei sih uhi,” achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuabepin Jesu’n adawnga, “Ginna neiloute leh khang hilhate Aw, na kung ua bangtan vei hing umpi a, hing thuohpi ding ka hiei? Na tapa tanah hing pui in,” achi hi."},"42":{"text":"Amapa ahing peilai in dawiin tuolsenan anei a, abawl gentheita hi. Tuabepin Jesu’n hagau bua khu aphawh a, naupang khu asudam a, apa kungah apeta hi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh amaute zousie in Pasian silbawltheina thupi khu lamdang asa mama uhi. Hinanleh mi chin in Jesu silbawl zousie lamdang asah mama chiet lai un, Jesu’n anuazuite kungah,","title":"Ashina ding Jesu’n agenlawh niveina (Mat. 17.22 , 23 ; Mak. 9.30-32)"},"44":{"text":"“Tam thu kigente na bil sung uah lut heh; Mihing Tapa khu mite khuta matsah a um ding ahizieh in,” achi hi."},"45":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun, a thugen atheisiem sih ua, athei louna ding ua, ama ua dinga im ahi ziehin, tualeh athugen khu Ama adong ngam sih uhi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n alah uah koi ahiei alien pen ding chiin kiselna aneita uhi.","title":"Kingaingiemna thupina dih ahi (Mat. 18.1-5 ; Mak. 9.33-40)","ref":"Luk. 22.24"},"47":{"text":"Jesu’n alungtang ua angaituo uh athei a, naupang neu khat akai a, akungah a um sah a,"},"48":{"text":"Akung uah, “Koipou ka min zieh a tam naupang neu kipahpi khu kei hing kipahpi ahi; tualeh kei hing kipahpi khu, ahing sawlpa kipahpi ahi; Noute zousie lah a aneupen khu, athupi pen ahi ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.40; Luk. 10.16; Jn. 13.20"},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n Johan in adawnga, “Pu aw, mi khat na min a dawite deldoh ka mu ua, ka hing zuina ua apan khah lou zieh in, ka khamta uhi,” achi hi."},"50":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n akungah, “Ama khaam sih un, aziehpen ei hing doulou pouma ei lam a pang ahi,” achi hi."},"51":{"text":"Tualeh Ama lahtou a aum ding hun ahing nai tahin Jerusalem khuo a pei ding atum chinten a,","title":"Samaria miten Jesu anuolna uh"},"52":{"text":"Tualeh amasangah thupo ding mi asawl masa a, amauh na pei masa in Ama dinga guotsa diem a na koi dingin Samarimite khuo khat ah alutta uhi."},"53":{"text":"Hinanleh amai suo khu Jerusalem lam a pei dinga akilat ziehin amaun, Ama ana kipahpi sih uhi."},"54":{"text":"Anuazuite Jakob le Johan in tam thu athei tah un, “Mangpa, Elijah bawlbangin amauh katum dingin, van a kipat in mei hankhesuh lei hoi nasa ei?” achi uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 1.9-16"},"55":{"text":"Tualeh Ama akihei a, “Amauh aphawh a, bangchibang lungsim puo na hi uoi chi na kithei sih uhi.”"},"56":{"text":"Aziehpen Mihing Tapa mihingte hinna sumang dinga hing pei ahi sih a, hinanleh amauh hundam dinga hing pei ahi zaw hi, achi hi. Tuachi’n khodang ah apeita uhi."},"57":{"text":"Tualeh lampi a apei lai un mi khat in Mangpa, “Na peina phot ah ka hing zui ding,” achi hi.","title":"Nuazui dihtah hina (Mat. 8.18-22)"},"58":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Si-alten kuo anei ua, tungleeng vaten zong bu anei uh, hinanleh Mihing Tapa in alu ngatna ding mun anei sih,” achi hi."},"59":{"text":"Tualeh Aman midang khat kungah “Hing zuiin” achi hi. Hinanleh aman, “Mangpa, ka pa hing vui sah masa phot in,” achi hi."},"60":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Mishi in a mishi uh kivui uheh, hinanleh nangpen pei inlen Pasian gam thu va hilin” achi hi."},"61":{"text":"Tualeh midang khat in zong, Mangpa, “Ka hing zui ding, hinanleh ka inn a mite Mangpha ka va hah masa phot ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 19.20"},"62":{"text":"Jesu’n akung ah, “Mi koipou loukaina langkawn akhut a tukawm a nualam en khu, Pasian gam mi hitaah ahi sih,” achi hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte nuain, Mangpa’n midang sawmsagi zong aguot a, Ama peina ding khochin leh mun chin ah Amasangah ni niin asawl hi.","title":"Nuazui sawmsagite sawlna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Bu lah ding atam mama a, hinanleh nasemmite atawm uhi, tuazieh in Abu la dinga nasem mite hing sawl dingin bu neipa kungah ngen un.","ref":"Mat. 9.37,38"},"3":{"text":"Pei unlen, Ngai un, ngehon lah a belamnoute bangin ka hing sawl hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.16"},"4":{"text":"Na dangka ip uh ahiei, na thungpi uh ahiei, na kedap uh ahiei, kengsih un, tualeh lampi ah koima chibai buh sih un."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh inn na lutna phot uah, Tam inn ah hamuonna tung heh, chi masa un."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh khuna lemna tapa aum leh na hamuonna thu uh atungah a um dinga; a um sih leh na kung uah ahing kilekia ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh tuami inn ma ah um den unlen, ahing pieh pouma uh nein dawn un, aziehpen nasemmi khu athaman mutaah ahi. Inn khat akipat inn khat ah kituon kawikawi sih un.","ref":"1 Kor. 9.14; 1 Tim. 5.18"},"8":{"text":"Khuo na lutna phot uah ahing kipahpi u’leh na masang ua alui pouma uh ne un."},"9":{"text":"Khuna damlou umte damsah unlen, akung uah, Pasian gam na kung uah ahing tungta, chi zel un."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh khuo na lutna phot ua ahing na kipahpi sih uleh akhuo gawlzingte uah pei unlen,","ref":"Nasep. 13.51"},"11":{"text":"Na khopi ua leivui ka kephang ua bangte nangawn zong noute hing dou dingin ka tatsieng uhi; ahivangin Pasian gam na kung uah ahing tungta chi thei un, na chi ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 10.7-14; Mak. 6.8-11; Luk. 9.3-5"},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hinghil ahi, tua ni chiengin, tua khuote thuoh ding sangin, Sodom khopi thuohna khu adan aum zaw ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 19.24-28; Mat. 11.24; Mat. 10.15"},"13":{"text":"“Korazin, na tung agih hi! Bethsaida, na tung agih hi! Aziehpen na sung ua sil thupitah kibawlte Tai-ar leh Sidon khopite a kibawl hita leh sai ip puon sil in vut lah a touin akisia zou thamta ding uhi.","title":"Jesu’n gingta lou khopite aphawhna","ref":"Isai. 23.1-18; Ezek. 26.1—28.26; Joel. 3.4-8; Amos. 1.9,10; Zek. 9.2-4"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh vaihawm ni chiengin noute thuoh sangin Tai-ar leh Sidon thuoh khu adan a um zaw ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Nang Kapernaum van tan a pahtawi a um ding kisa na hiei mah? Hilou, mishikhuo a sawnkhieh suh na hi zaw ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 14.13-15"},"16":{"text":"“Koipou na thugen uh ngaikhie khu, kei thu ngaikhie ahi uhi, tualeh kei hing nuol khu ahing sawlpa nuol ahi uh,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.40; Mak. 9.37; Luk. 9.48; Jn. 13.20"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n sawmsagite khu kipahtah in ahing kinuale kia ua, Mangpa, na min ziehin dawite nangawn ka thuthu un aum uh, achi uhi.","title":"Sawmsagite hing kinuale na"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Setan van a kipat kawlphe banga hing kesuh ka mu hi."},"19":{"text":"Ngai un, gulte leh mom aite totden theina leh na melma silbawltheina zousie tunga thuneina ka hing pie hi, bangmain ahing suliem vawtsih ding hi.","ref":"Late. 91.13"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh dawite na thuthu ua a um ziehin kipah sih unlen, van a na min uh gel ahi ziehin kipah zaw un,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hunlai tahin Jesu Hagau a lungnuom in akipah mama a, “Pa aw, lei leh van Mangpa, Nangman mipil leh misiemte kungah tam thute na im a, naungehte kunga na suhlat ziehin ka hing phat ahi; ahi, Pa aw, tambang khu Nangma khotuona deidan ahi.","title":"Jesu kipah thugenna"},"22":{"text":"Sil zousie ka Pa’n Kei ahing peta a, Tapa koi ahiei, chi Pa loungal koima’n athei sih; tualeh Pa koi ahiei, chi zong Tapa leh akung ua Tapa in atheisah nuomte loungal koiman athei sih,” achi hi.","ref":"Jn. 3.35; Jn. 10.15"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh anuazuite lam nga in akihei a, “Simtham in, na sil mute uh muna mitte ahampha hi;"},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen ka hing hil ahi, guolnei tampite leh leeng tampite’n na sil mute uh, mu ana ut ua, hinanleh amu sih uhi; tualeh na zahte uh zong zah ana ut ua, hinanleh aza sih uh,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai un, dan theimi khat adingdoh a, Ama ze etna in, “Siepa aw, kumtawn hinna ka mu theina dingin bang ahiei kabawl ding?” achi hi.","title":"Kumtawn hinna mu dingdan","ref":"Mat. 22.35-40; Mak. 12.28-34"},"26":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Dan laibu ah bang akigiel ei? Bang nachi sim ei?” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman adawnga, akungah, “Mangpa na Pasian khu na lungtang zousie, na hagau zousie, na hatna zousie leh na lungsim zousie toh na it ding ahi; tualeh nangma na ki it bangin na innvengte na it ding ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 6.5; Siempu. 19.18"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akungah, “Na dawng dih hi, tam bangin bawl in, na hing ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.5"},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh ama siemkitan nuom in Jesu kung ah, “Ka innvengte koi ahiei?” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawnga, “Mi koi ahiei khat Jerusalem akipat in Jeriko ah apei suh a, suomhatte atuohkha a, amaun apuonte ahawhkhiet pieh ua, avaw liem ua, bupshi in anuasie uhi.","title":"Samarimi hoi gentena thu"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu khat tuami lampi ah ahing pei suh khalaizang a; ama amutahin lampi gei lang khat ah apelta hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuamabangin Levimi khat khum mun ahing tunga, ava en a, lampi gei lang khat ah apelta hi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh Samari mi koi ahiei khat khuolzin lai tua mipa umna mun ah ahing pei kha a, aman amu tahin atungah lainatna aneita hi.","ref":"2 Khang. 28.15"},"34":{"text":"Akungah ava pei a, aliemnate sathau leh uoin abuoh pieh a, atuom pieh a; ama ganta tungah atuongsah a, khuolbuh ah apeipi a akem ta hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh azing nia apei ding kuonin makhai ni aladoh a, khuolbuh neipa kungah apei a, ama na kem inlen, tam ban a na sen teng ka hing pei kia chiengin ka hing sang na ding hi, achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam mi thumte lah ah, suomhatte tuohpa adingin koipen a innveng hi dingin na ngaituo ei? achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh aman, “Atunga khotuona neipa” achi hi. Tuachi’n Jesu’n akungah, “Pei inlen nang zong tuamabangin va bawl in,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh lampi a apei lai un, khuo khat ah alut a, numei khat amin Martha in a inn ah ana tungsah hi.","title":"Mari leh Martha kitekahna","ref":"Jn. 11.1"},"39":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n sanggam numei khat anei a amin Mari ahi, amanu Jesu kengbul ah atou a, athugente angaikhie hi."},"40":{"text":"Hinanleh Martha neh leh taah bawl in abuoi mama a, Jesu kungah ang pei a, “Mangpa ka sanggamnu in Keima tanga nasem a ahing ngansie khoh salou na hiei mah? Kei hing panpi dingin hing sawl ve,” achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga amanu kungah, “Martha, Martha, sil tampi na ngaituo a buoi na hi."},"42":{"text":"Hinanleh sil khat na tasam hi, Mari in tan hoi atelta, tua khu lahpieh ding ahi sih,” achi hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Jesu heisung mun ahiei khat ah thu angen a, athunget zou in anuazuite khat in akung ah, “Mangpa Johan in anuazuite ahil bangin, kou zong thunget dan ding hing hil in” achi hi.","title":"Mangpa thumna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akungah, “Na thunget chiengun: “Ka Pa uh van a um, Na min kizatat hen, Na gam hing tung hen, Na deilam van a akibawl bangin, Leitung ah zong kibawl hen."},"3":{"text":"Nichin in ka neh khop uh ann hing pie in."},"4":{"text":"Ka tung ua leibat neite ka ngaidam mabangun, ka khelnate uh hing ngaidam in, tualeh solna ah hing puilut sinlen, gilou lah apat hing hunkhe zaw in, chi un,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Na lah ua koi ahiei in lawm khat nei henlen, zankhang laiin akungah va peiin, lawm aw, tanghou pheng thum hing palah sahin;","title":"Thumna kukal ding thu gentena"},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen ka lawm khat khuolzin ahing tunga, amai a lui pieh ding bangma ka nei sih hi, chi henlen;"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh innsunga um pa’n dawngin, hing subuoi sin, tun vang kot kha ahita, Ka tate zong ka kungah lupna ah a imuta uh, thouin ka hing pe thei sih chiin dawngta leh,"},"8":{"text":"Ka hing hil ahi, alawm ahiziehin vathouin vape sih nanleh, anget teitei ziehin, vathouin adei zaza ava pe ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka hing hil ahi ngen un piehin na um ding uh, sui un, na mu ding uh, tualeh kiu un, honpieh in na um ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen angen pouma pieh in a um a, asui poumain amu hi, tualeh akiu pouma akihonpieh ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Na lah ua pa khat pou in, atapa in tanghou ngenta leh koi ahiei suong pe ding? ahisihleh nga ngen leh nga taangin gul ape diei le?"},"12":{"text":"Ahisihleh aatui ngen leh mom ai ape diei mah?"},"13":{"text":"Tuachia Nou migilouin bawn na tate u’kunga sil hoi pieh dan na thei uleh, na Pa uh van a um in angen mite kungah Hagau Siengthou atamzaw tham hing nahpieh zawsem lou ding ahiei mah? achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n dawi ham theilou khat anotdoh a, tualeh dawi apawtdoh bepin hamtheilou khu ahing hamta a; tuachi’n mipi in lamdang asa mama uhi.","title":"Jesu thuneina Setan akipat ahisih (Mat. 12.25-30 , 43-45 ; Mak. 3.22-27)"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh pawlkhat in “Dawimangpa Beelzebub zieh a dawite adeldoh ahi,” achi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 9.34; 10.25"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh mi dangten Ama ze etna in van a kipat chiemtena angen uhi.","ref":"Mat. 12.38; 16.1; Mak. 8.11"},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman angaituo uh athei a, akung uah, “Leenggam chinteng ama leh ama kidou pouma amangthai leng uhi, tualeh inn sung khat zong akidou uleh apua leng hi."},"18":{"text":"Setan zong ama leh ama kidou taleh bangchin agam ading thei diei? Aziehpen Beelzebub zieh a dawite ka deldoh ahi na hing chi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Ken Beelzebub zieh a dawite notdoh ka hileh, na tapate un koi zieh a ana deldoh zel uh ahiei? Tuaziehin amauh khu noute vai hing hawmpieh dingte ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Ken Pasian khutme zieha dawite deldoh ka hileh, Pasian gam na kung uah ahing tung tahtah ta ahi."},"21":{"text":"Mihat in galvankim tawi a, a innpi aven leh anei alamte abit hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh ama sanga hatzaw khat ahing pei a, abulu a, azawchiengin akimuonna agalvan zousie alah pieh a, tualeh anei alam alahpiehte ahawmzah zel hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei lam a panglou pouma, Kei hing dou ahi a, tualeh koipou ahing lahkhawmpi lou in athezah hi.","ref":"Mak. 9.40"},"24":{"text":"“Dawibua mi sunga kipat apawtdoh chiengin, khawlna ding sui in gamgaw mun ah avah kawikawi a, amu sih a; ka hing pawtdohna ka inn ah ka kinuale mai ding, achi hi.","title":"Kisiemphatna bukimlou zauhuoi dan"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh khuna ahing tun in, phiet siengsa leh hoitah a kizem amu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n apei a, ama sanga gilou zaw dawi dang sagi ahing zawpi a, asungah alut ua, atengta uhi; tualeh tua mipa umdan amasang a sangin ahing sezaw semta hi.”"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, tam thute agen lai in mipi lah akipat in numei koiahiei khat ahing kikoudoh a, “Nang hing kipaina gil leh na nawitep khu ahampha hi,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman tuate sangin “Pasian thu za a zuite ahampha zaw uhi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh mipi nasatah ahing kikhop khawm lai un, Jesu’n “Tulai khangthate pen khang giloutah ahi uh; chiemtena asui ua, hinanleh guolnei Jonah chiemtena loungal chiemtena dang pieh ahisih ding uhi.","title":"Jonah khu Khrist chiemtena ahidan (Mat. 12.39-42)","ref":"Mat. 16.4; Mak. 8.12"},"30":{"text":"Aziehpen Jonah khu Nineveh khuo a mite dinga chiemtena ahi bangin, Mihing Tapa zong tulai khangthate dingin chiemtena ahi ding hi.","ref":"Jon. 3.4"},"31":{"text":"Vaihawm ni chiengin simlam kumpinu khu tulai khangthate toh ahing ding ding a; amauh amawpai ding hi; aziehpen amanu Solomon pilna ngaikhe dingin kawlmong a kipat in ahing pei hi; Ngai un, Solomon sanga thupi zaw tanah a um hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 10.1-10; 2 Khang. 9.1-12"},"32":{"text":"Thukhen ni chiengin Nineveh khuo a mite khu tulai khangthate toh ading ding ua, siemmaw atangsah ding uhi; amauh Jonah thugen ziehin akhelnate uh akisia uhi, Ngai un, Jonah sanga thupi zaw tanah a um hi.","ref":"Jon. 3.5"},"33":{"text":"“Mi koima’n meivah adet chiengin mun simtham leh law nuoi ah akoi ngai sih hi, ahing lutten amu theina dingun, meivah tunna ah akoi zaw uhi.","title":"Meivah akipat gentena","ref":"Mat. 5.15; Mak. 4.21; Luk. 8.16"},"34":{"text":"Na tahsa meivah khu na mit ahi, na mit ahoi laisie na tahsa pumpi abawn in avah suoh hi, hinanleh na mit ahoilou chiengin na tahsa pumpi zong amiel sieng zel hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuaziehin na sunga vah um khu amiel ahilou na dingin pilvangin."},"36":{"text":"Tua hileh na tahsa pumpi amielna mun umlou a, avah suoh leh, meivah in ahing tan vah bangin avah suoh sieng ding hi.”"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh athugen lai in, Pharisai koi ahiei khat in akunga ann ne dingin Ama achiel a, tuachi’n alut a, ann ne dingin atouta hi.","title":"Jesu’n Pharisaite leh laigiel mite ademna"},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Pharisaipa’n a ann neh masanga akhut asil masah lou amu in lamdang asa mama hi."},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n akungah, “Nou pharisaiten nou leh kuong pulam na silsieng nguttah ua, hinanleh na sunglam ulah, lepguhna leh gitlouna in adim hi."},"40":{"text":"Nou mimote aw, apulam bawlpa’n, asunglam zong abawl sih amah?"},"41":{"text":"Hinanleh nou leh kuong sung a umte migentheite kungah pezaw unlen, tuachi’n Ngai un, sil zousie nou a dingin asiengthousa ahi."},"42":{"text":"“Hinanleh Pharisaite aw, na tunguh agih hi! aziehpen nouten leengmasel leh Pasikhawmte nasan leh haichi zousie sawma khat na pie ua, vaihawmna dih leh Pasian itna na thudon sih uhi. Tamte ahi na bawl ding uh, adangte bawllou tuonlou in.","ref":"Siempu. 27.30"},"43":{"text":"Nou Pharisaite na tunguh agih hi; kikhopna innte ah touna hoipente leh vanzuona mun laha mi’n ahing chibai ding na ut uhi."},"44":{"text":"Nou laigielmite leh Pharisai lepchiete aw, na tunguh agih hi! Aziehpen noute pen, mi’n hankhuh ahilam thei vateh lou a, atunga lampi ahahna uh akimulou hankhuh bang na hi uhi,” achi hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n alah ua dansiemmi khat in adawnga akungah, “Siepa, tam na thugen in Koute zong na hing phawh kha hi,” achi hi."},"46":{"text":"Tualeh Aman “Nou dansiemte zong na tunguh agih hi, aziehpen noute’n vangih puo hasa tahtah mi na guon ua, nouma’n lah tua puohgihte na khutme khat un zong na khoi nuom sih uhi."},"47":{"text":"Na tunguh agih hi, aziehpen na pu na pate un athasa uh, guolneite han inn na lampieh uhi."},"48":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh silbawlte na theipi ua, hoi nasahpi tahtah uhi; amaun ana that ua nouten ahan uh na lampieh uhi."},"49":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian pilnain zong, Akung uah guolneite leh sawltahte, ka sawl ding a alah ua, pawlkhat ana that ding ua, pawlkhat abawl genthei ding uh achi hi."},"50":{"text":"Leitung siemchil a kipat a guolnei sisan kisuo zousie, tulai khangthate tungah phu akila thei ding hi,"},"51":{"text":"Abel sisan kisuo akipat maitam leh biehinn kikaal a shi Zekariah sisan dongin, achi hi, Ahi, ka hing hil ahi, tam phuba tulai khangthate tungah akila ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 4.8; 2 Khang. 24.20,21"},"52":{"text":"Nou dansiem mite aw na tunguh agih hi! aziehpen nouten pilna chabi na pei mangpi ua, nouma lah na lut sih ua, mi lut ding lah na khaam zel uhi,” achi hi."},"53":{"text":"Khuna kipat a Jesu apawtdoh tahin laigiel mite leh Pharisaiten Ama aphin panta ua, sil tampi gensah atum ua;"},"54":{"text":"Aheh theina dingun, ahamkhielna mat tum in, abuhdap denta uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuabang hun lai a mipi simsenglou khat leh khat kituonchil khop hiel a ahing kikhop khawm laiun Aman amasapenin anuazuite kungah, “Pharisaite lepchiena tol lah ah pilvang un, achi panta hi.","title":"Lepchiena thua nuazuite vauna","ref":"Mat. 16.6; Mak. 8.15"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen langlou dinga, phuolguh bangma a um sih a, tualeh theilou dinga im zong bangma a um sih hi.","ref":"Mak. 4.22; Luk. 8.17"},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin miel a na gen pouma uh vah a zah in a um ding a, tualeh inndan sunggila bilkawma na gen uh, inntungvum a tangkoupiin a um ding hi."},"4":{"text":"“Tualeh nou ka lawmte ka hinghil ahi, tahsa thatlum thei a anua a bangma bawlthei nawnloute giing sih un."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh koi ahiei na giin ding uh ka hing hil ding hi, athalup nua ua zong gawtmuna paitheina thuneipa giing un, ahi, ka hinghil ahi Ama giing un."},"6":{"text":"Vatou nga paisa san niin azua zel uh hilou ahiei mah? Hinanleh alah ua khat zong Pasian mai ah manghil in a um sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh na lu ua samzamte nangawn abawn a sim siengsa ahi uh. Tuaziehin zau sih un; vatou tampite sangin na manpha zaw uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Tualeh ka hinghil ahi, koipou mite mai a kei hing hum pouma, Mihing Tapa in zong Pasian vansawlsiengte mai ah ama ahum ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh mite mai a hing kitheimawbawlte khu Pasian vansawlsiengte mai ah kitheimawbawlin a um ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Mihing Tapa gensietna thu gen pouma ngaidam ahi ding ua, hinanleh Hagau Siengthou gense pouma agensietna khu ngaidam ahisih ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 12.32; Mak. 3.29"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n noute kikhopna innte leh thukhente, tualeh thuneite kunga ahing pui tah chiengun, bang ka gen in bang ka chi dawn diei, chiin lungdong sih un.","ref":"Mat. 10.19,20; Mak. 13.11; Luk. 21.14,15"},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen Hagau Siengthouin tua hun tahin na gen ding uh ahinghil ding hi.”"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite lah a khat in akungah, “Siepa aw, Ka sanggampa kungah gou hing kihoppi dingin gen in,” achi hi.","title":"Mi hausa mopa gentena thu"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman akungah, “Mihing aw, Koiin ahiei kei noute tunga thukhen ahiei, tanhawmpiehpa ding ahiei a hing guot?” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Pilvang unlen, enna lah ah kiveng un, aziehpen hausatna khu mihing damsan ahi sih hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Gente thu khat agen a, Mi hausa koi ahiei khat khu alou a pieng ahing pung mamata hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh akingaituota a, ka bulebal koina ding lah ka nei sih a, bang law ding kata diei? achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n tami ka bawl ding hi: Ka bu inn phet vangin, alienzaw in lam vangin khunah ka bulebalte leh ka nei ka lam zousie abawnin koi vang, achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh ka hagau kungah, Hagau, kum tampi a dingin nei lelam tampi na kholkhawmta hi, kitawldam inlen, nein dawnin, tualeh nuom tahin umin, ka chi ding, achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in akungah, Nang mimo, tuzan chiengin na hinna hing kilahpieh ding ahi, Tuahileh na sil kholkhawmte zousie koi a ding ahita diei? achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin ama a ding maimai a gou kholkhawm a Pasian lam a hausa lou khu tuabang ahi zel uh,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Aman anuazuite kungah, “Tuazieh in ka hing hil ahi, bang ka ne diei chiin na hinna, ding uleh, bang ka sil diei, chiin na tahsa ua dingin lungdong sih un.","title":"Pasian gam sui masa un (Mat. 6.25-33)"},"23":{"text":"Neh ding sangin hinna athupi zaw a, tualeh tahsa zong puonsil sangin athupi zaw hi."},"24":{"text":"Va-ahte ngaituo un, bu lah atu sih ua, at zong a at sih uh, bupang leh tangsal zong anei sih uh; hinanleh Pasian in amauh avaa hi. Noute vate sanga bangzata a, manphazaw na hi uoi?"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh na lah ua koi ahiei alunggim zieh a adunglam tong khat a belap a susang thei?"},"26":{"text":"Tuabanga sil neunou khat nangawn na bawl thei sih uleh, bang dinga adangte lunggimpi na hi uoi?"},"27":{"text":"Lili pahte khandan ngaituo un, nna asem sih ua, mui zong azom sih uhi, hinanleh ka hing hil ahi, Solomon zong athupina zousie toh akizepin zong, tam lili pahte laha khat banga zepin a um sih hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 10.4-7; 2 Khang. 9.3-6"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n gam laha hampa tunia hing pou a, azingni chienga lungthukhua a pai a haltum mai ding bawn Pasian in hichi va-ia a azep leh nou ginna tawmte aw, bangchituh a noute silsah a um ding na hita uoi?"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh na neh ding uh ahiei, na dawn ding uh ahiei, sui sih un, ginlana lungsim nei in zong um sih un."},"30":{"text":"Aziehpen leitung pumpi a namten zong tam silte zousie asui uh, tualeh na Pa un tam silte na tulmaw uh chi athei hi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten Pasian gam sui zawun; tuachi’n tam silte ahing kipieh be ding hi."},"32":{"text":"“Pawl tawmte aw, zau sih un, aziehpen na kung ua, leenggam pieh ding khu na Pa uh kipahna lamtah ahi."},"33":{"text":"Na nei teng uh zua unlen, migentheite kungah pie un, van ah gutate peilouna leh leikhaten anehsiet thei louna ah, dangka ip lui theilou leh gou setheilou kikhol zaw un."},"34":{"text":"Aziehpen na gou umna uah, na lungtang u’zong a um ding hi."},"35":{"text":"“Na kawng uh gah unlen, tualeh na thaumei u’zong de kuong zing un.","title":"Khrist hing peikia na ding leh sumkempa gentena thu","ref":"Mat. 25.1-13"},"36":{"text":"Mi’n apu uh moulopna akipat a ahing kilekia a, kotkha ahing kiu tah chieng a na honpieh thei pai dinga na ngah zingte bangin um un.","ref":"Mak. 13.34-36"},"37":{"text":"Apu uh ahing pei chienga ama ngah zinga amu suohte ahampha uhi; chitahtahin ka hinghil ahi, Aman akawng agah dinga, ann ne dingin atou sah dinga, a neh uh abawlpieh ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Zankhanglai in ahiei zingthaw hun ahieiin hing pei taleh, tuabanga ahing mu suohte khu ahampha uhi."},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh tami thei un, guta hing pei ding hun inn neipa’n thei leh, aveng dinga, a inn aphenvang sah sih ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 24.43,44"},"40":{"text":"Tuaziehin nou zong kigingsa in um un, aziehpen na gintatlou laitah un, Mihing Tapa hing pei ding ahi,” achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in akungah, “Mangpa tam gentena thu koute ding maimai a na gen ahiei, ahisihleh mi zousie ding a zong na gen ahiei?” achi hi."},"42":{"text":"“Mangpa’n sumkempa ginum leh piltah, apu in ahunchina atan ding uh hawm pieh dinga a innkuon pite tunga vaihawm dinga abawl khu koipen ahi diei le?"},"43":{"text":"Apu ahing pei chienga suoh tuabanga bawl ahing mu dingpa khu ahampha hi."},"44":{"text":"Na kung uah thutah ka hinghil ahi, Ama khu anei zousie tunga vaihawm dingin abawl ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Hinanleh tua suohpain alungsim in, ka pu hing pei zuai sih nava chiin asuohpasalte leh asuohnumeite na vuain, tualeh ne a dawn in na khamta leh;"},"46":{"text":"Tua suohpa pu khu agintat lou ni khat in, atheilou kaal in ahing pei dinga, tun ni asuo dinga, ginglou mite tan bang atangsah ding hi."},"47":{"text":"Tualeh suoh apu deilam thei napi a, ana kiginglou leh adeilam banga bawl lou khu tamveipi vuoh ahi ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Hinanleh theiloupi a vuohna tham hiel a sil bawlpakhu tawmnoukhat vei vuoh in aum ding hi. Aziehpen tampi pieha um mi pouma kungah tampi akiphut dinga, tualeh mi’n tampi akepsahpa uh kungah atamzawsem aphut ding uhi."},"49":{"text":"“Leitunga meikuong sawl dinga hing pei ka hi; tuin zong kuong panta leh chi sam ing e!","title":"Jesu mite kikhensahpa"},"50":{"text":"Hinanleh baptisma tan ding khat ka nei hi, tuami ka suhtangtun masangsie’n ka ning kitel hina va-ia e!","ref":"Mak. 10.38"},"51":{"text":"Leitung a lemna leengsah ding a hing pei hiva na hing chi uh amah? Hikeilou, ka hing hil ahi, kikhenna umsah ding a hing pei ka hizaw hi."},"52":{"text":"Tua kipat in innsung khat a mi nga umna ah kikhenna a um dinga, mi thum in nite a dou dinga, niin thum adou ding hi."},"53":{"text":"Pa in tapa, tapa in pa, nuin, tanu, tualeh tanuin nu; innpinuin amounu tualeh amounu in ainnpinu, adou ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mik. 7.6"},"54":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman mipite kungah zong, “Nouten nitumna lam a meilum hing kai na mu chiengun guo zu ding ahi na chi pai ua, tuabangin ahing um zel hi."},"55":{"text":"Tualeh sim hui hing laang na mu chiengun khuo hing lum ding hi e, na chi ua, tuabangin ahing lum zel hi."},"56":{"text":"Nou milepchiete aw, lei leh van umdan na theisiem ngal ua, bang dinga tulai hun umdan theisiem lou na hi uoi."},"57":{"text":"“Tualeh bang dinga nouten nouma tungtang a thudih kikhenlou na hi uoi mah?"},"58":{"text":"Na kihehpipa toh thukhenpa kunga na pei chiengin, lamkaal ah, ama toh kilep theina ding khat ngaituo teitei in, tuachilou in vang thukhenpa mai ah ahing tut dinga, thukhenpa’n mi man lamkaipa kungah ahing pekhe dinga, tuachi’n mi man lamkaipa’n suongkul ah ahing khum kha ding hi."},"59":{"text":"Ka hing hil ahi, paisasan khat nangawn na pieh kim masangsie in, tuana kipat na pawtdoh nawn sih ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun lai in, Galili gam a mite sisan Pilat in akithoina sa u’toh ahalpieh thu Jesu kunga hing hil mi hunkhop a um uhi.","title":"Kisia dinga thuhilna"},"2":{"text":"Jesu’n adawng a akung uah, “Tuabang silte athuoh ziehun Galilimite khu Galili gam a mite zousie sanga khielzaw dieha ngaituo na hi uoi mah?"},"3":{"text":"Hilou e, ka hing hil ahi nou zong na kisia sih uleh, tuabangmain na mangthai sieng ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahisihleh Siloam innsangin apuakhum a anetlia mi sawmle giette zong Jerusalem khuo a umte zousie sanga khielzawdieh a ngaituo na hi uoi mah."},"5":{"text":"Hilou e, ka hing hil ahi, noute zong na kisia sih uleh, tuabangma in na mangthai sieng ding uhi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman tam gentena thu zong agen a, “Mi koiahiei khat in a grep huon ah theipi kung kisuon khat anei a; tualeh aga ahing sui a, khat zong amu sih hi.","title":"Theipi kung galou gente thu"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman grep huon kempa kungah, En vawi, kum thum sung tami theipi kungah aga ka va sui zel a, khat zong ka mu sih hi, phua mai in, bangdinga mun teng dep a um ahiei? achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh aman adawnga, akungah, Pu aw, tukum sung zong hichiin um sah tadi in, akimkot in lei tou phot vangin bawng eeh in ka phungvua tadi ding hi;"},"9":{"text":"Ahing ga tahleh ahoi ahi dinga, hinanleh ahing ga taah sih leh na phua na ding hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman khawlni in kikhopna inn khat ah thu ahil hi.","title":"Khawlni a numei damsahna"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai vawi, khunah, kum sawm leh kumgiet hatlouna dawi in amat numei khat a um a, a ngum kuul khiukheu a, ama thuin adingtang thei sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Jesu’n amanu amu tahin ahan a, akungah, “Numei, na hatlouna a kipat hakhiet na hita” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Aman atungah akhut akoi a, tuachi’n thakhat in adingtang pai a, Pasian a pahtawita hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh khawlni a Jesu’n mi asuhdam ziehin kikhopna inn a vaihawmpa’n lungthah pum in, “Mihingte nasepna ding ni guh um hilou ahiei mah; tua hun sungin hing pei unlen, hing kisudam ta un, khawlni hi sese louin” achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.9,10; Danp. 5.13,14"},"15":{"text":"Tuabepin Mangpa’n ama adawnga, “Nang milepchie! Khawlni in na bawngtal uh ahisihleh na sabiltung uh akikhina apat sutkhiein tui dawnsah dingin na puidoh zel uh hilou ahiei mah?"},"16":{"text":"Tam numei Abraham tanu ahi thuoi a, Ngai vawi, Setan in kum sawm leh kumgiet akhina khu khawlni a akolbuna sutpieh lou dan ahiei mah?” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachia Aman tam thute agen tahin, amelmate zousie azumta ua, tualeh mipite zousie, A sil bawl thupite zousie ziehin akipah chiet uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman “Pasian gam khu bangchi bang ahiei? tualeh bang toh gente ding ka hiei?","title":"Ankamtang leh tol gentena (Mat. 13.31 , 32 , 33-35 ; Mak. 4.30-32)"},"19":{"text":"Tam pen min ankam tang khat alah a, ahuona athe bang ahi, tua khu ahing poua, akhang lien a, sing lienpi ahing hi a, tungleeng vaten abazamte ah bu asep uhi,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh “Pasian gam khu bang toh gente ding ka hiei? achi kia hi."},"21":{"text":"Tam pen numei khat in tol alaah a, tena thum dim ann lah a, abawn a azel suoh masangsie aphum bang ahi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Aman thuhil pumin khopi leh khoneute atuon kawikawi a, Jerusalem lang zuon in apei zel hi.","title":"Hinna lutna kot kochih"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi khat in akungah, “Mangpa hundam dingte tawmnoukhat ahi uh ama leh?” achi hi. Tualeh Aman akung uah,"},"24":{"text":"“Kot kochih ah lut tum teitei un, aziehpen ka hinghil ahi, mi tampiin lut a tum ding ua, alut thei sih ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Inn neipa khatvei ahing thaw a kot akha nua chiengin, noute apulam a dingin, Mangpa Mangpa kot hing honin, chia kot na kiu chiengun, Aman heilang mi na hi uoi, ka hing thei ngai sih, chiin ahing dawng ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin nouten na masang ah ka ne un, ka dawn ua, tualeh ka gawldungte uah thu na hil zel ve le, na chi ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman, ka hinghil ahi, heilang mi nahi uoi mah ka hing thei sih; nou silgilou bawlte zousie, ka kunga kipat peimang un, ahing chi ding hi.","ref":"Late. 6.8"},"28":{"text":"Abraham, Isaak, Jakob leh guolneite zousie, Pasian gam a um na mu ua, noute pulam a paikhieh a um na hi uh na hing kithei chiengun, khunah kaa leh hagawtna a um ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 22.13; 25.30; Mat. 8.11,12"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh suolam leh tumlam, mallam leh simlam a pat in mite ahing pei ding ua, Pasian gam ah atou ding uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai un, anukhia pente zong amasa pen a pang ding a um uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 19.30; 20.16; Mak. 10.31"},"31":{"text":"Tua ni mama in Pharisai koite ahiei ahing pei ua, akungah, “Pawt inlen, tam mun apat peimangin; aziehpen Herod in tha ahing tum hi,” achi uhi.","title":"Herod huotna"},"32":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Pei unlen tua si al kungah va hil un, Ngai in, tuni leh zing chiengin dawite ka notdoh dinga, natnate zong ka sudam dinga, ni thum niin ka nasep ka zou ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahivang in, tuni toh zing chieng toh thai ni toh ka pei zel ding hi; aziehpen Jerusalem khuo pulam a guolnei shi ngaina ahi sih hi."},"34":{"text":"Aw Jerusalem, Jerusalem! guolneite that leh na kung a hing kisawlte suonga na seplia; aapi in anoute ahanuoi a a opkhum bangin, bangzavei na tate opkhum ka tum a, hinanleh na ut sih uhi."},"35":{"text":"En un, na inn uh ahawm a nuasie in a umta hi; tualeh chitahtah in ka hinghil ahi, Mangpa min a hing pei khu ahampha hi, na chi masangsie uh, na hing mu sih ding uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Late. 118.26"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Khawlni in Pharisai vaihawmpa khat inn a ann ne dinga apeiin amaun a enkhie uhi.","title":"Khawlni a chipawm a damlou adamsahna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh En vawi, amasangah chipawm a damlou mi khat a um hi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu’n dansiemmite leh Pharisaite ahoupi a akung uah, “Khawlni in suhdam sieng ahiei, sienglou?” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh amauh asip dide ua; tualeh Aman damlou khu atu a, asudam a, apei sahta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n akung uah, “Na lah uah koi ahiei na sabiltung uh ahiei, na bawngtal uh ahiei, kokhuh ah ketaleh, khawlni a kaikhe pai lou ding?” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 12.11"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tam thute amaun adawng thei sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n ami chielte un touna mun nuom pen atel zel uh amu a, akung uah gentena thu agenta hi.","title":"Kingaingiemna leh zin bawlsiem thu"},"8":{"text":"“Kitenna mou pawi a koi ahieiin ahing chiel chiengun touna mun hoipen ah tou sih un, tuachilouin nang sanga mi zatat huoi zaw khat ana chielkha ding a;","ref":"Thu. 25.6,7"},"9":{"text":"Nang hing chielpa leh ama na kungah ahing pei ding ua, tam mipa touna ding awn in ahing chi dinga, tuachi’n nang zumtah in mun hoilou pen ah na toupan phing ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh ahing kichiel chiengin pei inlen touna ngiem pen ah na vatou zaw ding a, tuachi’n nang hing chielpa ahing pei chiengin, na kung ah, lawm, touna mun sangzaw ah touin ahing chi thei ding hi. Tuachi’n na ann nehpite mitmuin pahtawi in na um ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Koipou ama kingaisang khu angiem dinga, tualeh ama kingaingiem pouma tawisangin a um ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 23.12; Luk. 18.14"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman achielpa kungah zong, “Sun ahiei, zan ahiei a, annkuong na lui chiengin, na lawmte, na sanggamte, na hieng nasante, ahisihleh na innveng mihausate, chiel sin, tuachilouin amaun zong ahing chiel ding ua, ahing thuh kha ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh annkuong na lui chiengin, tagate, mizawngte, piengsuolte, kengbaite, tualeh mittote chiel zaw in."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun ahing thuh zou lou zieh in na hampha dinga, aziehpen midihtatte thokia chiengin thuh in na um ding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh a annkuong impite khat in tam thute azah tahin akungah, “Pasian gam a ann ne dingte khu ahampha hi,” achi hi.","title":"Kitenna pawi thupi gentena"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akungah, “Mi koi ahiei khat in annkuong luina abawl a, mi tampi achiel hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh nitah anneh hun in, a mi chielte kung a, hing peita un, tuin bangkim akimanta hi, vachi dingin asuohpa asawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun kithutuoh tahin suonlam anei chiet uhi. Amasapen in akungah, Lou ka leita a, a en dinga ka va kuon akiphamaw hi, na hing ngaisiem kang ngen hi, achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Adangin Bawngtal kop nga ka leita a, ahoi leh hoilou en dinga ka vakuon akiphamaw hi; na hing ngaisiem kang ngen hi, achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh adang khat in zi ka neita a, tuaziehin ka hing pei thei sih hi, achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n a suohpa ahing pei a, tam thute apu ahing hilta hi. Tuabepin inn neipa a lungthah a, asuohpa kungah, kintahin pei inlen gawldung leh khopi sung ningkawm lah a, mizawngte, piengsuolte, mittote leh kengbaite tanah hing puilut in, achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh asuohpa’n pu Nang thupieh bangin ka bawl zouta hi, hinanleh mun a awng nalai hi, achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n a puin asuohpa kungah, lamlien leh daigei ah pei inlen, ka inn adim theina dingin mi hing zawllut teitei in,"},"24":{"text":"Ka hing hil ahi, ka mi chielte khatbehin zong ka annkuonglui achiem sih ding uh,” achi hi, achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh mipi thupitahin Ama azawpi ua, tualeh Ama akihei a, akung uah;","title":"Nuazui hina man"},"26":{"text":"“Mi koipou ka kunga hing peiin, apa, anu, azi, atate, asanggampa, asanggam nu tualeh ama hinna nangawn ahuot sihleh ka nuazui ahi thei sih ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.37"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh koi zong ama kross kipuoh a hing zuilou khu ka nuazui ahi thei sih ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.38; 16.24; Mak. 8.34; Luk. 9.23"},"28":{"text":"Noute lah a koipou in innsang lam tumin alam zouna ding sum anei leh neilou theina dinga tou masa phot a, alut dingza tuot masa lou ding koi na um uoi?"},"29":{"text":"Tuachilouin suongphum phum zou phot a, alamzou thei sih leh a en poumain anuisan ding ua,"},"30":{"text":"Tam mipa’n inn lam apanta ngal a, azou thei sih, achi kha ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ahisihleh leengpa koi ahiei leeng dang khat dou dinga kuon dingin, tou masa phot a, ama dou dinga mi tulsawmni toh hing kuonpa lamtuoh ngam ding leh ngam lou ding, ngaituo masa lou ding?"},"32":{"text":"Ahisih vanglah leh adangpen gamlapi a aum laiin kilemna thuchiem ngen dingin patong asawl ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachimabangin noute lah ah zong koipouin anei zousie peisan lou khu ka nuazui ahithei sih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"“Chi khu ahoi a, ahivangin chi khu tam taleh bangchin aki al sahta diei?"},"35":{"text":"Lei a dingin lah ahoi sih a, eehvum dingin lah ahoi tuom sih ding, mi’n apaidoh zaw zel uhi. Koipou zahna ding bil neiin za uheh,” achi hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n sie dongmite leh mikhielte zousie in athu ngaikhe dingin akunglam ahing zuon uhi.","title":"Belam mang gente thu (Mat. 18.12-14)","ref":"Luk. 5.29,30"},"2":{"text":"Pharisaite leh laigielmiten, “Tam mipa’n mikhielte akigoppi a, ann aneh khawmpi hi chiin a phunchiehta uhi.”"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, tam gente thu agen hi:"},"4":{"text":"“Noute lah a koi ahiei in belam za nei henlen, alah a khat mangsah taleh, sawmkuo leh kuote gamdai a nuasie a, amangpen amu masangsie va sui lou ding koi na hi uoi?"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh amu kia tahin kipahtahin aliengkou ah apuo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh inn atuntahin, alawmte leh a innvengte ahan khawma akung uah, Hing kipahpi un, ka belam mang ka mu kiata hi, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka hing hil ahi, tuachimabangin midih kisiana tuon ding neilou sawmkuo leh kuote tung sangin mikhiel khat kisiana tungah van ah kipahna a lien zaw ding hi."},"8":{"text":"“Tualeh numei koi ahiei in dangka sawm nei henlen khat mangsah taleh meivah de a inn phiet in amu kia masangsie lunglut tah a sui lou ding koi ahiei um?","title":"Sum mang gente thu"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh amu kia chiengin alawmte leh a innvengte ahankhawm a, hing kipahpi un, ka dangka mansah ka mu kiata hi, achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka hing hil ahi, tuachimabangin Pasian vansawlsiengte masang ah mikhiel kisia khat tungah kipahna a um hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman “Mi koi ahiei in tapa ni anei a;","title":"Tapa tangmang gente thu"},"12":{"text":"Anaupang zaw pen in apa kung ah, Pa Kei tan ding gou teng hing piein achi hi. Tuachi’n apa’n asum khu ahawm piehta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh ni sawtlou nuain tapa naupang zaw pa’n atan teng abawnin alakhawm a khuol gamlapi ah azinta a, tua mun ah anei zousie noptat tahin azang bei siengta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh azah bei sieng tahin khum gam ah kiel thupitah ahing tunga, neh ding ahing kitasamta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama apei a khum gam mi khat ava belta a, tuachi’n aman ama khu voh ann pe dingin alou lang ah ana sawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh vohte neh begapsau hawte a agil vasah a ut mama a, koiman lah bangma ape sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh ama leh ama ahing kiphawhkhiet tahin, Ka pa kunga kilaw suohte ann neh senglou nei atam tam u’toh, Kei lah tana gilkiel a shi ding hita mai veng in!"},"18":{"text":"Ka thou ding a, ka pa kungah ka pei dinga, akungah, “Pa aw van a tungah leh nangma mitmu in sil ka bawl khielta;"},"19":{"text":"Na tapa chi taah zong ka hi nawn sih, na kung a kilaw na suohte khat bangin hing bawlin, ka chi ding,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n athoua, apa kungah ahing peita hi. Hinanleh gamlapi a aum lai in apa’n ana mu a, alainat mama a, ana del a, a ngawngkawi a, tualeh atawpta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n atapa’n akungah, Pa aw van a tung ah leh nangma mitmuin sil ka bawlkhielta hi; na tapa chi taah zong ka hi nawn sih, achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh a pa’n asuohte kungah puontuol hoi penpen kintahin hing ladoh unlen, silsah un, akhut ah khutsip but sah unlen, akengah kengdap bun sah un."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh bawngnou thautah tanah hing la unlen, gou un, tuachi’n ine ding ua, kipah tahin i um ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen tam ka tapa ashi a ahing hingkiata hi; amanga akimu kiata hi, achi hi. Tuachi’n kipahtahin a umta uhi."},"25":{"text":"“Tualeh atapa upazaw pen lou ah a um hi. Inn ahing tun kuon in tumging leh lam husa azata hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n asuohte khat ahan a, Tamte bang china atai leh? chiin adongta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh aman akungah, na nau ahing tunga chidam lu dam a amukia ziehin na pa’n bawngnou thautah agou hi, achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama khu alungthah ta a, alut nuom ta sih hi. Tuaziehin apa ahing pawtdoh a, ahing zawlta hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman adawnga, apa kungah, Ngai in, kum hitan veipi na nna sem ing a, na thupiehte lah khat zong palsan ngailou inga; ka lawmte toh guolnop ka bawlna dingin kelnou khat nangawn zong na hing pe ngai sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh tam na tapa, kizuate kunga na neina lam teng va netum siengpa ahing tun tahin ama a dingin bawngnou thautah na gou pai viel a, achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n apa’n akungah, ka tapa nang pen ka kunga um ngitnget na hi a, Ka nei zousie zong nang a ahi."},"32":{"text":"Kipahtah leh nuomtah a i um ding hizawlou ahiei mah? Tam na nau ashi a, ahing hingkiata hi, amanga i mu kiata ahi, achi hi,” achi hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n anuazuite kungah, “Tam thu zong agen a, Mi hausa koi ahiei in sumkempa khat anei a, tua mipa’n asum amawh thangzah sieng pieh ta hi, chiin akungah hehna ahing tung hi.","title":"Sumkem mi dihtatlou gente thu"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman amapa ahan a, a kungah, Na tungtang thu ka zah khu bangchi dan ahiei? Na sum kep tuotna dan hing pelut in, tubansie sumkem a pang nawnlou ding na hi, achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n sumkempa’n alungsim in, Bangchi ding kata diei? Ka pu in ka sum kep hing tawpsah ding ahita a, lei lai ding lah ka ngap sih a, khutdaw ding lah ka zumin."},"4":{"text":"Sumkep ahing tawpsah chienga, a inn ua ahing um sah theina dingin, ka bawl dan ding ka theita, a chi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n apu sum bate zousie akungah ahan chiet a, amasapen kungah ka pu sum bangza ahiei na bat? achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman sathau tena za khat achi hi. Tuachi’n aman akungah, na lai la zuai inlen, tou inlen, kintah in sawmnga gielin, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh adang khat kungah, Nang bangza ahiei na bat? achi hi. Aman bu tena za khat achi hi. Tuachi’n aman akungah, na lai la inlen sawmgiet giel in, achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua sumkem dihtat lou pa’n lemgel theitah a abawl ziehin apahtat ta hi. Aziehpen vah tate sangin tam leitung tate atulai khang thu uah apilzaw uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh ka hing hil ahi, dihtatlouna sumin na lawm dinguh kibawl un, hausatna abei hun chienga kumtawna umna a noute ahing umsah theina dingun."},"10":{"text":"“Koizong tawmnou khat tunga gin um khu tampi tung ah zong a gin um ahi, tualeh koizong tawmnoukhat tunga gin umlou khu tampi tungah zong agin um sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin dihtatlouna sum tunga na gin um sih u’leh, koi ahiei noute hing muonga sumtah hing kem sah ding?"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh midang neisa tunga bawn na gin um sih u’leh koiin ahiei nouma a tahtah hing pe ding?"},"13":{"text":"Suoh khat in Pu ni nna asem khawm thei sih; aziehpen khat muda in khat a it ding a, ahisihleh khat hum in khat asimmaw kha ding hi. Pasian nna leh sum nna na sem khawm thei sih ding uhi, achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 6.24"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Pharisai sum ngainaten zong tam thute zousie aza ua, Ama anuisan uhi.","title":"Jesu’n Pharisaite avauna"},"15":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Noute pen mite mitmu a kisiem tangsahte na hi uhi. Hinanleh Pasian in na lungtang uh athei hi; aziehpen mite laha kitawisang khu Pasian mitmu a kidahhuoi tah ahi."},"16":{"text":"“Dan leh guolneite thu khu Johan hing um tan chieng aum a, tua bansie Pasian gam khantanhoi thu akigen a, tualeh michinin tuanah apaulut sawm chietta uhi.","ref":"Mat. 11.12,13"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh dan thu sut vom neunou khat aman sangin, lei leh van amanthai abailam zaw ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 5.18"},"18":{"text":"“Koipou azi khul a, zi dang kitenpi pouma angkawm ahi; tualeh koipou apasal in akhulsa kitenpi pouma angkawm ahi.","title":"Kikhulna thu a Jesu thuhil","ref":"Mat. 5.32; 1 Kor. 7.10,11"},"19":{"text":"“Mihausa koi ahiei khat a um a, puon sandup leh puon malngat asil a, ni chin in nuomsa tahin a um hi.","title":"Mi hausapa leh Lazar"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh amin Lazar kichi apumtanga hima a dim mi hausapa kotpi bul a alupsah zel uh khutdaw khat a um a,"},"21":{"text":"Mi hausapa dawkan a akipat khateneng kia pou neh a kigilva sah alunggul hi. Tuathamlouin uite ahing pei ua, ahimate alieh piehzel uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, tua khutdawpa ashi a, vansawlsiengten Abraham angsungah a peipi uhi. Mi hausapa zong ashi a akivui ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh mishi khuo ah gimthuohin a um a, adah tou a, gamlapi a Abraham leh a angsung a Lazar um khu amuta hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n akikou a, Pa Abraham Kei hing khotuo inlen, Lazar in akhutme dawn tui ah hing die henlen ka lei suvot dingin hing sawl in, tam meikuongah ka thuohgim sengta hi, a chi hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh Abraham in Tapa nangman na dam lai in sil hoite na kimu a, tuamabangin Lazar in sil hoiloute amu hi, chi geldohin, hinanleh tuin vang ama hamuonin a um a, nang pen gimthuohin na um hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh tamte chilou zong, koute leh noute kikaal ah guom thupitah a um hi; tua khu tamlang gal a kipat noute kunga hing pei utte ahing pei theilouna ding u’leh, tualang gal a kipata kou kunga hing pei utte, ahing pei thei louna ding un, achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ahileh, Pa ama khu ka pa inn a sawl dingin ka hing ngen hi."},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen sanggam pasal nga ka nei a, amauh vahil leh tuachilou in ama u’zong tam gim thuohna mun ah ahing pei kha ding uhi, achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Abraham in akungah, amaun Mosi leh guolneite anei uhi, tuate thu na ngaikhie uheh, achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Hilou e, Pa Abraham, mishi lah kipat mi khat va pei leh akisia ding uhi, achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh aman akungah, Mosi leh guolneite thu angaikhiet nuom sih u’leh, mishi lah akipat mi khat thoukia nanleh zong atahsang tuom sih ding uhi, achi hi,” achi hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n anuazuite kungah, “Puanate ahing tunglou thei ahi sih hi, hinanleh puana um sahpa tung agih hi!","title":"Jesu’n khelna thu ahilna"},"2":{"text":"Tam mi neute laha khat apuasah sangin angawng ah bu hehna suongsum awsahin tuipi sungah kipailut leh ama a dingin ahoizaw ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Pilvang un, na sanggampa’n na tunga sil abawlkhiel leh phawhhil inlen, akisia leh ngaidam in.","ref":"Mat. 18.15"},"4":{"text":"Ni khat sunga sagi vei na tunga sil abawlkhiel a, sagivei na kunga ka kisia hi achi a, nanglam a ahing kihei kia leh na ngaidam ding ahi.”"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh sawltahten Mangpa kungah, “Ka ginna uh khangsah in,” achi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n “Ankam tang khat chie ginna na nei uleh tam kawlsathau kung kungah, hing kiphungkal inlen tuipi sungah pouin, na chi ding ua, na thu uh amang mai ding hi."},"7":{"text":"“Noute lah a koi ahiei in, loukai ahiei, ahisihleh belamching ahiei, suoh khat nei henlen, lou apat ahing vaitun chieng a, Ann va kineh pai aw, chi ding koi na hi uoi?"},"8":{"text":"Tualemahin, ka neh ding bawl inlen, puon teng inlen, ka neh a ka dawn zou masangsie ka neh kataah bawl in, tuazou chiengin nangman na nein na dawn na ding hi, chizaw lou ding na hi uoi mah?"},"9":{"text":"Tua suohpan abawl ding thu kipete banga abawl ziehin kipah thu na gen ei le? Ka gingta sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachimabangin nouten zong na kung ua thupieh zousie na bawl zou chiengun, suoh phatuomlou ka hi uh ka bawl ding mawnguh bawl ka hi uh, chi un,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesu Jerusalem zuon a apei lai in, Samaria leh Galili gamgi zuul atuon suoh a;","title":"Jesu’n phah sawm a suhdamna"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n khuo khat a alut kuon in, pha ngentang mi sawm in ana dawn ua, amaute gamlapi ah ading ua,"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh aw ngaitah in akikou ua, “Siepa Jesu aw, koute hing khotuoin,” achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh amu tahin, Aman akung uah, “Pei unlen siemputen va ki en sah un,” achi hi. Tuachia apei lai un ahing siengthouta uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 14.1-32"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh alah ua khat in adamta chi akithei tahin anuakia kia a, aw ngaitah in Pasian apahtawita hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu kengbul ah akhupboh a, kipah thu agen a, tua mipa khu Samari mi ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawnga, “Mi sawm hing siengthouta na hisih uh amah?
