Hinanleh kuote hei a umta?"},"18":{"text":"Tam gamdang mipa chilou, Pasian pahtawi ding a hing kinualekia koima kimu khatalou hiven maw?” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akungah, “Thou inlen peita’n, na ginna in ahing damsahta hi,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Pharisaiten Pasian gam hing tun hun ding adoh u’leh, Aman adawng a akung uah, “Pasian gam pen mu theiin ahing tung sih hi.","title":"Jesu’n ahing peikiana ding agenna"},"21":{"text":"En un, tanah, ahisihleh En un, khunah, zong achi sih ding uhi, Aziehpen ngai un, Pasian gam khu na lah uah a um hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman anuazuite kungah, “Mihing Tapa damlai nite ni khatbeh na mu nop ni uh ahing um ding, hinanleh na mu sih ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh amaun na kung uah, En un, khunah, En un, tanah, ahing chi ding ua, pei sih unlen, anua u’zong zui sih un."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen tunphie vannuoi langkhat a aphiet a vannuoi langkhat tandong asalvah mabangin Mihing Tapa ahing pei ni chiengin tuabang ahi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman sil tampi athuoh masa ding a, tulai khangthate deilouin a um ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Noah damlai a sil umdan bangin, Mihing Tapa hing peikia chiengin zong a um ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 6.5-8"},"27":{"text":"Noah kuonga alut a tui ahing let a, a unpi ua amanthai ni uh atun masangsie, ane un, adawn ua, zi leh tain akinei ua, akiteng uhi.","ref":"Siem. 7.6-24"},"28":{"text":"Tuachimabangin Lot damlai in zong a um a, ane un, adawn ua, alei un azua ua, tualeh a suon ua, alam uhi.","ref":"Siem. 18.20—19.25"},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh Sodom khuo apat Lot apawt niin van akipat in meilekat azu a, abawn un asumangthai siengta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuamabangin Mihing Tapa ahing kilah ni chiengin a um ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin koipou inntunga um in innsung a neitah umte la dingin kumsuh sih heh; tuamabangin koipou lou a um zong hing nuakia sih heh.","ref":"Mat. 24.17,18; Mak. 13.15,16"},"32":{"text":"Lot zi thei zing un.","ref":"Siem. 19.26"},"33":{"text":"Mi koipou ahinna humbitna sui in ataan ding a; tualeh koipou ahinna taan in ahumbit ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 10.39; 16.25; Mak. 8.35; Luk. 9.24; Jn. 12.25"},"34":{"text":"Ka hing hil ahi, tua zanin lupna khat ah mi ni alum khawm ding ua, khat lahmangin a um dinga, khat nuasie in a um ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Nu mei ni ann sukhawm in a um ding ua; khat lahmangin a um dinga, khat nuasiein aum ding hi.”"},"36":{"text":"“Mi ni loulai ah aum khawm ding ua, khatpen lahmangin a um dinga, khat nuasie in a um ding,” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun adawng ua, akungah, “Heisungah e, Mangpa?” achi ua; Aman akung uah, “Shiluong umna phot ah langtate zong a um khawm ding uhi” achi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman miten lungkelou a athum ngitnget ding uh ahi chi atheina dingun akung uah, gente thu khat agen hi.","title":"Thukhen mi dihtat lou"},"2":{"text":"“Khopi khat ah Pasian giinglou leh mihing zong bangma a simlou thukhen mi khat a um hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua khopi sungah meithai khat a um a, amanu khu akunga hing hawin, akungah ka kilanpipa tungah phuba hing lahpieh in ahing chi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh amapa hun bangtan ahiei a na ut sih a, hinanleh anuain alungsim in Pasian giing louin, mihing bangma’n sim sih nanleng;"},"5":{"text":"Tam meithainu’n ahing suhbuoi ziehin, aphuba ka lahpieh mai ding hi, tuachilouin ahing pei thithe dinga ahing sugim kha ding,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n, “Thukhen dihtat loupa thugen ngai un."},"7":{"text":"Atung uah dawzou tadi nanlezong, Ami telte sun leh zan a Ama han mite phuba Pasian in alapieh sih ding amah?"},"8":{"text":"Ka hing hil ahi, Aman aphuba uh alahpieh pai ding hi. Hinanleh Mihing Tapa ahing pei chiengin leitungah tuabang ginna ahing muna diei?” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh mi dihtat hi a kigingta a, mi dangte simmaw koite ahiei kung ah zong tam gentena thu agen hi.","title":"Pharisai leh sie dongmi gentena"},"10":{"text":"“Mi ni Pasian biehinn ah thungetna nei dingin akuontou ua, khat Pharisai ahia, khat pen sie dongmi ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pharisaipa adinga amatangin tambangin athum hi: Pasian, mi dang pauhat thu a mite neisa lahpiehte, mi dihloute, angkawmte, ahisihleh tam siedong mi bang ka hilou zieh in na tung ah ka kipah hi."},"12":{"text":"Hapta khat in ni vei ann ka ngawl a, Ka nei zousie sawm a khat ka pe leng hi, achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh siedongmi khu gamla tah a dingin vanlam zong adahtou ngam sih a, hinanleh Aw Pasian, Kei mikhiel tungah zangai in, chiin a awm a tum hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka hinghil ahi, akhat pen pa sangin tam mipa khu siemtang in a inn ah apei suhta hi. Michin ama leh ama kitawisang pouma a ngiem dinga, akingaingiem pouma tawisangin a um ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 23.12; Luk. 14.11"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipiten, ana thampieh dingin naupangte akungah ahing pui ua; hinanleh nuazuiten amu tahun aphawh uhi.","title":"Jesu’n naupangte a guolzawl (Mak. 10.13-16 ; Mat. 19.13-15)"},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n ama uh akungah ahan a, “Naupang neute ka kungah hing peisah unlen khaam sih un, aziehpen Pasian gam khu hichibang mite a ding ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, koi hinanleh Pasian gam naupang neute banga kipahpi lou khu asungah alut vawtsih ding,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh vaihawm mi koi ahiei in akungah, “Siepa hoi, kumtawn, hinna ka tan theina dingin, bang ahiei ka bawl ding?” chiin adong hi.","title":"Hausatna in kumtawn hinna adal dan (Mat. 19.16-26 ; Mak. 10.17-27)"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akungah, “Bangding a hoi hing chi na hiei? mi khat chiloungal koima mi hoi a um sih, tua khu Pasian ahi."},"20":{"text":"Thupiehte na thei ve le: angkawm sin, tuolthat sin, gu sin, theipitu dihlouin pang sin, na nu leh na pa zatat in, chite,” achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.14; Danp. 5.18; Pawt. 20.13; Danp. 5.17; Pawt. 20.15; Danp. 5.19; Pawt. 20.16; Danp. 5.20; Pawt. 20.12; Danp. 5.16"},"21":{"text":"Aman “Tamte zousie ka naupan lai a kipat ka zui sieng ahita,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n tam silte zousie azahtah in akungah, “Sil khat na sam nalai hi, na nei zousie zua inlen, mi zawngte kungah hawmpieh in, tuahileh van ah gou na nei ding a, tualeh hing pei inlen hing zui in,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh aman tua thute azahin alunggim mama ta hi, mi hausa mama ahi ziehin."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n alunggim mama chi amu bep in, “Mi hausate Pasian gam a alut hasa hina va-ia e!"},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen Mi hausa Pasian gam a alut sangin, sangawngsau phinbil hawm a alut suoh abailam zaw hi,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh tam thu zaten, “Tuachi ahileh koi hundam in a um zou diei?” achi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman “Mihing dinga sil hitheilou khu, Pasian a dingin ahi thei hi,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in, “En vawi, Kouten bangkim nuasie in ka hing zui uhi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akungah, “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, Pasian gam zieh a, a inn alou ahiei, anu apa ahiei, asanggamte ahiei azi leh atate ahiei, nuasie khu;"},"30":{"text":"Tu damsung hun mama a ale tamzaw; tualeh hun hing tung ding a, kumtawn hinna toh mulou ding koima a um sih hi,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman sawm leh nite khu apui tuom a, akung uah, “Ngai un, Jerusalem khuo a hawtou ding ihi ua, Mihing Tapa tungtang thua guolneite thugel zou sie ahing tangtung ding hi.","title":"Jesu’n ashi ding agenlawhna thumveina"},"32":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama khu Jentelte khuta piehkhieh ahi ding a, chiemmui bawlna’n anei ding ua, zumhuoitahin chil aphit khum ding uhi;"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh avo ding ua, athat ding uhi. Tualeh nithum niin athoukia ding,” a chi hi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun tam silte atheisiem sih uhi, athugen khu alah uah phuol in a um a, thu kigente athei sih uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jeriko khuo atun kuon un, mitto koi ahiei khat khutdawin lam gei ah atou hi.","title":"Jesu’n mitto asuhdamna (Mat. 20.29-34 ; Mak. 10.46-52)"},"36":{"text":"Aman mihonpi pei thawmging azah in, bang thu um atai leh chi’n adong hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun “Nazareth Jesu hing pei ahi,” chiin ahil uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman “Jesu David tapa kei hing khotuo in,” chiin akikou hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n amasalam a peiten sip dingin aphawh ua, hinanleh aman “David tapa kei hing khotuoin chiin akihakou semsem hi.”"},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu adinga, ama khu akunga hing zawpi dingin thu apie a, tualeh akung ahing tun tahin ana donga;"},"41":{"text":"“Na tungah bang hing bawlpieh leng na ut ei?” achi hi. Aman “Mangpa mu thei ka ut hi” achi hi."},"42":{"text":"Jesu’n akung ah, “Mu theita in, na ginna na dampi ahi,” achi hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n thakhat in amu theita a, Pasian pahtawi kawmin ama azuita hi. Tualeh mi zousie’n tami amutah un Pasian aphat ta uhi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu Jeriko khuo ah alut a, apeisuoh hi.","title":"Jesu leh Zakai"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai vawi, mi khat amin Zakai kichi, siedong lamkai lien khat a um a, ahausa mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh aman Jesu khu mi bangchibang ahiei chi, mu atum a, hinanleh adin ngiem ziehin mipi lah ah amu thei sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin amasangah ana tai masa a, Ama en dingin theipi dawn ah akal tahi, Jesu’n tua lampi hing zui ding ahiziehin."},"5":{"text":"Jesu tuamun ahing tun in adah tou a, ama amu a, akungah, “Zakai hing kum mengin, tunia na inn a tungding ka hi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n kintah in ahing kumsuh a, kipah tahin Ama azintunta hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh tami amutahun, “Mikhielpa inn a tung dingin a pei tave, chiin aphun uhi.”"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Zakai adinga Mangpa kungah, “Ngai vawi, Mangpa Ka nei zousie akimkhat mi zawngte kungah ka pe dinga, tualeh mi neitah dihlou tah a ka lah a um leh ale li in ka sang ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akungah, “Tuni’n tam inn ah hundamna ahing tungta hi, ama zong Abraham tapa ahi ziehin."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangthaite suidoh a, hundam dinga Mihing Tapa hing pei mawng ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 18.11"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tam thute angaikhiet laiun, Jerusalem anai tah zieh leh, Pasian gam hing kilang pai ding a angaituo zieh un, gente thu dangkhat agenbe hi.","title":"Talent gentena"},"12":{"text":"Tuazieh in Aman, “Mi thupi koi ahiei khat, a leenggam vaihawmna ding thu la a, hing kinuale kia dingin khuolgamla tah ah a zinkhie hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman asuoh sawmte ahan a, akung uah, dangka mina khat chiet apie a, ka hing peikia masangsiein tamteng toh summet na bawl un, achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh amiten ama a muda ua, Tam mipa ka tung ua vaihawm dingin ka dei sih uh, chiin anua ah patong ataisah uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachia leenggam vaihawmna thu la a, ahing kinuale kia tahin, asum veipung dan uh, theina dingin sum apieh asuohte khu akungah ahan sahta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n khatnapa ahing pei a, Pu aw, na mina sawm in, kana pungsah hi, achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Aman akungah hoi e, suoh gin um, tawmnoukhat tunga na gin um ziehin, kho sawm tungah vaihawm in pangin, achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n aninapa ahing pei a, Pu aw na mina nga in a pung hi, achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Aman tuachimabangin akungah, nang zong kho nga tungah vaihawmin pangin, achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh midang ahing pei a, Pu aw, en in, na dangka mina tanah a um hi, khosanawtna puon in ka tun a kana kemtup chinten hi."},"21":{"text":"Nang khu mi gumtat na hiziehin ka hing giing hi, na koilou zong na lazel a, tualeh na tulou zong na at zel hi, achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Aman akungah, nang suoh gilou na kamsuoh ngelngel in siemlou ka hing tangsah ding hi. Migumtat ka hi a, ka koilou zong ka lah a, ka tulou zong ka at zel na thei ngel ei?"},"23":{"text":"Tua ahileh bang ding a, ka hing pei kia chienga a pung toh ka lah theina ding a, ka sum khu sum koina inn a na koilou na hiei? achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akunga dingte kungah adangka mina khu lahpieh unlen, sawm neipa kungah pie un, achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, Pu aw aman mina sawm anei hi, achi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Ka hing hil ahi koizong anei pouma pieh belap ahi dinga, tualeh koizong aneilou khu aneisun zong lapieh in a um ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 13.12; Mak. 4.25; Luk. 8.18"},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh tua ka galte, atung ua ka vaihawm ding deiloute hing zawpi unlen, ka masang ah that un, achi hi, achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 25.14-30"},"28":{"text":"Tam thute agen zouin, amasang ua pei in Jerusalem lam azuon touta uhi.","title":"Jesu guolzou a Jerusalem alutna (Mat. 21.1-9 ; Mak. 11.1-10 ; Jn. 12.12-19)"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi a, Bethphage leh Bethani khuo kung a Olive muol ahing tun un, anuazuite lah a mi ni asawl a,"},"30":{"text":"Na masang ua khuo ah va “Pei unlen, na luttah chiengun, sabiltungnou koima tuonna ngainailou nava mu ding ua, tua khu hing sut unlen, hing kai un."},"31":{"text":"Mi koipou in, Bangdinga na sut uh ahiei? chia ahing doh leh, Mangpa’n atulmaw a hi, hing chita un,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n asawlte khu ava peita ua, agen bang ngei in ava muta uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh sabiltungnou kikhina asut laiun, aneiten akung uah “Sabiltungnou bangding a na sut uh ahiei?” achi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Amaun “Mangpa’n atulmaw ahi,” achi uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu kungah ahing kai ua, tualeh Sabiltungnou tungah apuonte uh apha ua, atungah Jesu atuongsah uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n apei lai in, apuonte uh lampi ah apha uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama Olive muol kumsuhna ahing tun kuon tahin, anuazui mipi zousie in asil bawl thupi zousie amu zieh un akipah ua, aw ngaitah in Pasian apahtawi uhi."},"38":{"text":"“Mangpa min a hing pei kumpipa ahampha hi, van ah lemthu leeng henlen, tungnung pen ah thupina um hen,” achi uhi.","ref":"Late. 118.26"},"39":{"text":"Tualeh mipi lah a Pharisai pawlkhat in akungah “Siepa aw, na nuazuite phawh in” achi uhi."},"40":{"text":"Aman adawng a, akung uah, “Ka hing hil ahi, tamte asip uleh suongte akikoudoh pai ding uhi,” achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh atun kuon in khopi amu a, akakhum hi.","title":"Jesu’n Jerusalem akakhumna"},"42":{"text":"“Aw! nangma mama in, tu na hun sung beeh in na hamuonna thu hing theita mai lachin maw! Hinanleh tuin na mit apat akiphuolta hi."},"43":{"text":"Na galten na kimvel ah leipal ahing tawkhum ding ua, pawtdoh theilouin na kimkotin ahing imkhum ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n nang leh na sunga na tate tuol satna’n ahing nei ding ua, na sung ah suong khat beh kithuop in anuasie sih ding uhi, ve a na umlai nite na theilou ziehin.”"},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama Pasian biehinn ah alut a, sil zuate leh leite anotdoh hi.","title":"Pasian biehinn asuh siengna (Mat. 21.12 , 13 ; Mak. 11.15-17)"},"46":{"text":"A kung uah “Ka inn khu thungetna inn ahi, chi gel ahi; hinanleh nouten gutate munpi in na bawlta uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 56.7; Jer. 7.11"},"47":{"text":"Tualeh Aman nichin in Pasian biehinn ah thu ahil hi. Hinanleh siempu liente leh laigiel mite tualeh mipi lamkaiten Ama tha atum chinten uhi.","ref":"Luk. 21.37"},"48":{"text":"Hinanleh mipi zousie in athugen angai nuom ziehun, abawl dingdan athei tuom sih uhi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat Pasian biehinn a mipite thu ahil a, khantan hoi agen laiin, siempu liente, laigielmite leh upate akungah ahing pei uhi.","title":"Sakhuo lamkaiten Jesu thuneina adohna uh (Mat. 21.23-27 ; Mak. 11.27-33)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh akungah, “Bang thuneina in ahiei tam silte na bawl? hing hil in” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Aman adawnga akung uah, “Ken zong sil khat ka hing dong ding, hing dawng un."},"4":{"text":"Johan Baptisma khu van akipan ahiei, mihing akipan?” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh akingaituo ua, “Van a kipan chileilah, ahileh bangdinga gingta lou, ahing chi ding a,"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh mihing akipat chileilah mipiin suongin ahing sep ding uhi, aziehpen Johan pen guolnei ahi achi chiet uhi.”"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun hei a kipat a hiei ka gen thei sih uhi, chiin adawng uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Ken zong bang thuneina a tam silte ka bawl ahiei chi ka hing hil sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite kungah tam gente thu agen a, “Mi koi ahiei khat in grep huon abawl a, a huon kemmite kungah, kilaw a hou ding in apekhie a, gam tuom ah sawtpi tam dingin a hawta hi.","title":"Grep huon gentena thu (Mat. 21.33-44 ; Mak. 12.1-11)","ref":"Isai. 5.1"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh aga law hun in, huon a grep gate ana pieh dingun lou houte kungah, suoh khat asawl a, hinanleh lou houmiten, ama ana vuo ua, khut guoh in asawlmang ta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aman suoh dang khat a sawlkia a, ama zong ana vuo ua, zumhuoi tahin abawl ua, khutguohin asawlmangta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman athumna asawl kia a, ama zong ana vawliem ua, adeldoh ta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n grep huon neipa’n bangchi bawl ding ka ta diei? Ka tapa deitah sawl mai vang, ama beeh amu chiengun, ana zatat khamaw sih ding uhi, achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh huon bawl miten ama ana mu tah un, Tam mipa gouluo dingpa khu ahi, agou itan theina dingin that vai, chi’n akihou uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n grep huon apat adeldoh ua, athat ta uhi. Tuaziehin grep huon neipa’n amauh bang alawta diei leh?"},"16":{"text":"Ahing pei ding a, grep huon kemte a sumang ding a, grep huon khu midangte kungah ape ding hi,” achi hi. Amaun tam thu azah tah un, “Tambang pen tun da heh” achi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Aman amauh a en a, “Ahileh tam thu kigiel bang ahiei? Inn lam mite suongdeilou pen tua suong mama khu, aning a suong poimaw pen ahing hita, achi hi.","ref":"Late. 118.22"},"18":{"text":"Koipou tuami suong tunga pua khu akitatkehgawp dinga, tualeh akhiehkhum poumate a gawt guoi ding hi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin siempu liente leh laigelmiten Ama mat atum ua; hinanleh mipite agiing ua; tua gente thu amauh demna-a agen ahi chi athei uhi.","title":"Sie pieh thua a dohna (Mat. 22.15-22 ; Mak. 12.13-17)"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama khu abuhdap ua, gam uhpa vaihawmna leh thuneina a, atut theina ding un athu genkhiel man dingin midih kipang enkhemi asawl uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh amaun akungah, “Siepa, dihtahin thu na gen a na hil zel hi, tualeh koima deisahtuom neilou in Pasian lampi dihtahin na hil zel chi ka thei uhi."},"22":{"text":"Kou dinga Kaisar kunga sie ka pieh uh sieng ahiei sienglou?” chiin adong uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman ze etna a adoh uh ahi chi athei a, akung uah, Bang ding a hing ze et na hi uoi?"},"24":{"text":"“Makhai khat hing ensah un, koi lim leh koi min atuong ei?” achi hi. Amaun “Kaisar a,” chiin adawng uhi."},"25":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Tuaziehin Kaisar silte Kaisar kungah pie unlen; Pasian silte Pasian kungah pie un,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite mai ah athugen khiel mat ding amu sih ua, adawnnate lamdang asa mama ua, asipta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n thawkiana a um sih chi, Saddukaite pawlkhat akungah ahing pei ua, Ama adong ua,","title":"Thawkiana thu a dohna (Mat. 22.23-32 ; Mak. 12.18-27)","ref":"Nasep. 23.8"},"28":{"text":"“Siepa, Mosi in koipou asanggampa’n zi anei a, ta neilou in ashisan leh anaupa’n azi aluo dinga a upa dingin hahlesuon anei pieh ding hi, chiin Mosi in ahing na gel pieh hi.","ref":"Danp. 25.5"},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n sanggam pasal sagi a um ua, a upa penin zi anei a ta neilou in ashi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n aninapa in aluo a, taneilou in ashi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n athumna in aluo a, tuachimabangin sagi in anei ua, ta neilou in ashi chietta uhi."},"32":{"text":"Amauteng nua in numeinu zong ashita hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaziehin thawkiana ni chiengin amanu koi zi pen ahita diei? a sagi un ziin anei chiet zieh un,” achi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, akung uah, “Tulai khanga mite akiteng ua, zi leh tain akilatuo uhi."},"35":{"text":"Hinanleh khum hun chienga tel taah leh mishi lah akipat thawkiana tang taah a simtel pouma zi leh tain akinei nawn sih ding uhi;"},"36":{"text":"Amauh shi zong ashi thei nawn sih ding uhi, aziehpen vansawlsiengte bang ahi ua, tualeh thawkiana tate ahizieh un, Pasian tate ahita uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n mishite kaithawin a um chi Mosi in zong singbawh kuong thu ah, Mangpa khu Abraham Pasian, Isaak Pasian leh Jakob Pasian achi lai in alangsahta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 3.6"},"38":{"text":"Ama mishi Pasian ahi sih a, mihing Pasian ahi zaw hi; aziehpen Ama Ngai in, mi zousie ahing ahi,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n laigielmite pawl khat in adawng ua, “Siepa, na gendih ngel hi,” achi uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuami nua in thudang mawngmawng adong ngam nawn sih uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Bangchi dan a Khrist khu David tapa achi uh ahiei?","title":"Khrist khu David tapa ahiei mah (Mat. 22.41—23.4 ; Mak. 12.35-40)"},"42":{"text":"Ama David ngel in zong Late bu ah, Mangpa’n Ka Mangpa kungah,","ref":"Late. 110.1"},"43":{"text":"na melmate na kengngapna a, ka bawl masangsie ka ziet lam ah tou in, achi hi, ana chi hi."},"44":{"text":"David in Ama Mangpa achi ngal leh bangchi dan a atapa hi thei ding ahiei?” achi hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuami nuain Aman mipi zousie zahin anua zuite kungah;"},"46":{"text":"“Puontuol sil a vah lunggula, van zuona munte a, chibai buh bang, kikhopna inn a touna hoipente leh pawibawlna a, mun hoipente deituom sese laigielmite lah ah pilvang un."},"47":{"text":"Meithaite innsungte anegam ua, mi solna in sawtpipi thu angen uhi. Tam mite siemloutanna athupi sem ding hi,” achi hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuazou a Jesu adahtou leh, mi hausaten sum bawm a, silpieh akhieh lut lai uh amu a,","title":"Meithainu thawlawm khieh"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Aman meithai zawng tah khat in paisa san ni akhieh laitah zong amu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman noute “Thutah ka hing hil ahi, tam meithainu zawng tah in, midang zousie sangin akhetam zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen tam mite zousiein anei valte uh Pasian adingin silpieh in apie ua, hinanleh amanu’n ahinna dinga anei sun teng apie hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi pawl khat in Pasian biehinn thu, suong hoitahte leh silpiehte a jep hoi ahidan agen uleh, Aman,","title":"Jesu’n Jerusalem siet ding leh huntawp ding agenlawhna (Mat. 24.1-3 ; Mak. 13.1-4)"},"6":{"text":"“Tam na sil mute uh ahileh, suhchip lou a, suong khat tunga suong khat kichieng mawngmawng na mu lou nite uh ahing tung ding hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh amaun akungah, “Siepa, Tam silte bangchih chienga hing um ding adiei? tualeh tam silte ahing tun ding chiengin bang chiemtena ahing um diei?” chiin adong uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman “Sol a na um louna ding un pilvang un, aziehpen ka min suongin mi tampi ahing pei ding ua, Kei Khrist ka hi, ahun ahing tungta ahing chi ding uh hi. Tuaziehin amauh zui sih un.","title":"Khrist hing peina ding chiemtenate (Mat. 24.4-13 ; Mak. 13.5-13)"},"9":{"text":"Ahivang in kidouna thu leh buoina thu na zah chiengun zau sih un, tam silte atung masa ding mawng ahi. Hinanleh atawpna ahing tung pai nai sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuazouin Aman akung uah, “Nam khat in nam tuom adou ding a, leenggam leh leenggam akidou ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mun tuom ah zil nasatahin aling dinga, kielte atung dinga, natna hite aleeng dinga, van a kipat sil chizat huoipipi leh chiemtena thupi tahtah ahing um ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh tam silte zousie atun masangin noute ahing man ding ua, Keima min ziehin ahing sugenthei ding ua, kikhopna innte a kipat in ahing kaikhe ding ua, suongkulte ah ahing khum ding ua, leengte leh vaihawmte masang ah ahing pui ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute mai a Kei nang theipina ding ua hun lemtang ahi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin bangchi dawn ding na hiei chi ngaituo masa lou dingin na lungtang uh sudet un.","ref":"Luk. 12.11,12"},"15":{"text":"Na melmate zousie un ahing dou ua ahisihleh ahing soisel theilouna ding un, Keima’n kam leh pilna ka hing pe ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na nu na pate uh, na sanggamte uleh na be na phungte uleh na lawm na guolte uh nangawn in zong ahing kilepsan ding ua, na lah ua pawl khatte shina ah ahing tun ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Keima min ziehin mi zousie muda na hi ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh na lujang ua sam zamkhat zong amangthang sih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na thuohhatna un na hinna uh na humbit ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Hinanleh galkapten Jerusalem a imchimit uh na mu chieng un, amanthai nading anaita chi thei un.","title":"Jerusalem suhsietna (Mat. 24.15-21 ; Mak. 13.14-19)"},"21":{"text":"Tuahun chiengin Judia gam a umte muoltung lam ah tai u’henlen, khopi sung a umte zong pawtdoh uheh, tualeh gam a umte zong khopi sungah lut sih uheh."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen tam nite phu lahna ni ahi dinga, akigielsa zousie atangtunna hun ahi ding hi.","ref":"Hos. 9.7"},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh tua ni chiengin gaite leh naungeh nawitep nalai neite atung uh agih hi! Aziehpen gam sungah lungkhamna nasatah leh thangpaina tam mite tunga tung ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh amaute namsau hiemin ashi ding ua, nam zousiete lah ah suoh leh sal a puiin a um ding uhi. Jentelte hun a tunkim masangsie Jerusalem khu Jentelte totden in a um ding hi."},"25":{"text":"“Tualeh ni leh ha leh aasite ah chiemtenate a um ding a, leitungah namte lunggimna leh mangbatna atung dinga, tuipite kihawt in amau veng vung ding hi.","title":"Mangpa hing pei niveina (Mat. 24.29-31 ; Mak. 13.14-19)","ref":"Isai. 13.10; Ezek. 32.7; Joel. 2.31; Kihil. 6.12,13"},"26":{"text":"Leitunga sil hing tung dingte ngaituona ziehin mite zauin ashibup ding uhi; aziehpen van silbawltheinate kikungnuh ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin, Mihing Tapa asilbawltheina leh thupina nasatah toh, meilum lah a hing pei amu ding uhi.","ref":"Dan. 7.13; Kihil. 1.7"},"28":{"text":"Tam silte ahing tun kipat ni chiengin dahdoh unlen, entou un, aziehpen na tatna ni uh anaita hi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah gentena thu khat agen a, “Theipi kung leh singkung zousie en un;","title":"Theipi kung gentena (Mat. 24.32-35 ; Mak. 13.28-31)"},"30":{"text":"Anate ahing seltah chiengun, nipi ahing naita chi na mu ua, na thei uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuamabangin tam silte ahing tun na mu chiengun Pasian gam anaita chi thei un."},"32":{"text":"Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, tam silte atunkim masangsie, tulai khang thate amang sih ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Lei leh van amang dinga, hinanleh ka thu amang sih ding hi."},"34":{"text":"“Hinanleh pilvang un, tuachilouin nehva tahluot leh zukham leh damsung khosah ding ngaituonain, na lungtang uh aluodim seng kha dinga, tualeh tua ni na theilou kaal un, ahing tung zuai kha ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Leitung pumpi a umte zousie tung ah, thang kipel banga thakhat a hing tung ding ahi."},"36":{"text":"Tuaziehin sil hing tung zousiete pel taah leh Mihing Tapa mai a ding taah dinga guotna hi theina dingun, kiveng unlen, thu ngen ngitnget un.”"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Aman sun lai in Pasian biehinn ah thu ahil a, zan chiengin apawtdoh a Olive muol kichi ah ava um zel hi.","ref":"Luk. 19.47"},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n zingmawng matah in mipite zousie akungah ahing pei ua, bieh inn a athugen angaikhe zel uhi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Peikan pawi kichi, tanghou tolsawlou pawi ahing naita hi.","title":"Juda Iskariot lepchiena (Mat. 26.1-5 , 14-16 ; Mak. 14.1-2)","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-27"},"2":{"text":"Siempu liente leh laigiel miten Ama atha theina ding uh lampi asui ua, mipite lah agiing uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n sawm leh nite lah a tel amin Iskariot kichi Judas sung ah Setan alut a."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda Iskariot apei a, Siempu liente leh galkap lamkaite kung ah Jesu lebawl a amat sah ding dan ava houpita hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute akipah mama ua sum pieh ding athukimta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute thu achiem a, mipi umlou kaal a, Jesu lebawl a matsah dan ding hunlem asui panta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n tanghou tolsawlou, Peikan pawi belamnou thana ding ni ahing tungta hi.","title":"Peikan pawi nukhiapen (Mat. 26.17-19 ; Mak. 14.12-16)"},"8":{"text":"Jesu’n Peter leh Johan asawl a, “Pei unlen, peikan annkuong ineh theina ding un, va bawl un,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, “Heisung ah vabawl u’leng na dei ei?” achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Ngai un, khopi sunga na lut chiengun, Pasal khat tuibel puo a hing pei na kituohpi ding ua, alutna inn ah zuilut un."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh inn neipa kungah, Siepa’n ka nuazuite toh peikan annkuong ka nehna ding uh mikhuol pindan heisung ahiei ahing chi hi, na chi ding uh;"},"12":{"text":"Aman inndan tungnung lienpi guotsa diem khat ahing ensah ding hi, khunah hing bawl un,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n apei ua, akung ua agen bangin avamuta uhi; tuachi’n peikan annkuong abawlta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ahun ahing tun tahin Jesu atouta a, sawm leh ni ten zong a toupi uhi.","title":"Peikan annkuong luina (Mat. 26.20 , 29 ; Mak. 14.17 , 25)"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Ka thuoh ding ka thuoh masangin, tami peikan annkuong noute toh nehkhawm ka ut mama hi;"},"16":{"text":"Noute ka hing hil ahi, Pasian gam a suhbukim ahi masangsie’n tami ka ne nawn sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n nou ala a, kipah thu agen zouin, “Tami la unlen kihawm un;"},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen ka hing hil ahi, Pasian gam ahing tun masangsie’n uoin ka dawn nawn sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n tanghou ala a, kipahthu agen zou in abalkeh a, akung uah apie a, “Tami ka tahsa nou a dinga pieh khu ahi, na hing thei ngitngetna ding un, tami bawl zel un,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuamabangin nitah ann neh zouin nou zong ala a, “Tam nou ka sisan a thuhun tha, noute dinga luongkhie khu ahi.","ref":"Jer. 31.31-34"},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh En un, ahing mansah dingpa khut, kei toh annkuong sawhkhawmin a um hi.","ref":"Late. 41.9"},"22":{"text":"Adihtahin, Mihing Tapa khu akiguotsa bangbangin apei zel ding hi, hinanleh lebawl a mansahpa tung agih hi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n alah ua tambang sil bawl ding koipen hi ding adiei chi amauh akidongtuo panta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute lah a koi alienpen a ngai ahi diei, chia kinielna alah uah a um hi.","title":"Koi alien pen diei","ref":"Mat. 18.1; Mak. 9.34; Luk. 9.46"},"25":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Jentel leengte khu atung uah lal tahin a um ua, tualeh atung ua thuneite khu hoina bawlmite, achi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh noute lah ah pen tuabang na hisih ding uhi, tuanahsangin, na lah ua lien pen khu naupang zaw bangin um henlen, tualeh alamkai pen khu mi nasem bangin umzaw heh.","ref":"Mat. 23.11; Mak. 9.35; Mat. 20.25-27; Mak. 10.42-44"},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen annkuonga toupa leh anehbawlpa koizaw alienzaw diei? Annkuonga toupa alienzaw sih ding amah? Hinanleh keipen na lah uah nehbawlpa bangin ka um hi.","ref":"Jn. 13.12-15"},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh “Noute pen solna ka tuoh sungsie a hing umpite na hi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Ka Pa’n gam ahing pieh bangin, noute dingin gam ka hing pie hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka leenggam a ka dawkan a na neh ua, na dawn ua, tualeh Israel nam sawm leh nite vaihawmpieh a mangtoupha a na tou theina ding un, achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 19.28"},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n, “Simon, Simon, ngai in Setan in busep banga ahing sep theina dingin ahing ngen hi.","title":"Jesu’n, Peter in akitheimaw bawlna ding agenlawhna (Mat. 26.31-35 ; Mak. 14.27-31 ; Jn. 13.36-38)"},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh na ginna aba louna dingin, nanga dingin ka hing thumpieh hi. Kei langa na hing kihei kia chiengin, na sanggamte sudet in,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter in akung ah, “Mangpa Nang toh suongkul leh shina ah zong pei ka ngap hi,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman “Peter ka hinghil ahi, thumvei nang kitheimawbawl masangsie tuni’n aa akhuong sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Noute sum ip bei a, thungpi bei a, tualeh kedap bei a, ka hing sawl lai in sil khat beh na kitasam kha uh amah?” achi hi. Amaun “Tasam lou” achi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 10.9,10; Mak. 6.8,9; Luk. 9.3; 10.4"},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Hinanleh tuin vang sum ip nei in keng henlen, tuamabangin thungpi neiin zong, tualeh namsau neilou in apuon zua henlen, lei heh."},"37":{"text":"Aziehpen noute ka hing hil ahi, Ama pen dan botsete lah a simtel ahi, chia kigiel khu, ka tungtang thu ah atangtung ding mawng ahi. Kei toh kisai tam silte atawpna ahita hi.”","ref":"Isai. 53.12"},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, “En vawi, Mangpa tanah namsau ni a um hi” achi ua Aman akung uah “Ahun hi,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n apawtdoh a, abawl ngaina bangin, Olive muolah apei a, tualeh anuazuiten zong azui uhi.","title":"Gethsemani huon a Jesu thumna (Mat. 26.36-46 ; Mak. 14.32-42 ; Jn. 18.1)"},"40":{"text":"Amun atun tahun, akung uah, “Solna a na lut louna dingun thungen un,” achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Ama pen suonga sephahna tan dingah apei tuom a, akhupdin a, athumta hi,"},"42":{"text":"“Pa aw, na deilam ahileh tam nou kei apat in ladohin, ahivangin Kei deina bang hilouin Nang deina bang hizaw heh,” achi hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng khat van akipat in akung ah ahing kilah a, Ama ahing suhat hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama pen alunggim sengsenga, lunglut zaw sem in thu angen hi. Tualeh akhosa sisan khal lientah bangin leilah ah atakhie hi."},"45":{"text":"A thungetna apat ahing dingdoh a, anuazuite kung ahing tun tahin, amaute lunggimna zieh a gimgawpa imuin, amu hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuabepin akung uah, “Bang ding a imu nahi uoi? Solna a na lut louna ding un, thou unlen, thungen un,” achi hi."},"47":{"text":"Aman tuabanga thu agen lai in, En vawi, mipi tampi ahing pei ua, Judas kichi sawm leh nite lah a khat in amauh ahing makai hi. Jesu tawp dingin ahing zuon hi.","title":"Jesu amatna uh (Mat. 26.47-56 ; Mak. 14.43-50 ; Jn. 18.2-11)"},"48":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n akungah, “Judas Mihing Tapa khatvei tawp a mat sah ding na chi hiven izaw?” achi hi."},"49":{"text":"Akim a umten sil hing um ding khu amu tah un, “Mangpa namsau in ka sat ding uoi?” achi uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tualeh alah ua mi khat in Siempu lien suohpa asat leh abil zietlam asatkhieh piehta hi."},"51":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n “Tami bawl nawn sih un,” achi hi. Tualeh abil akhoipieh a, asudam ta hi."},"52":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akunga hing pei siempu liente leh biehinn veng lamkaite tualeh upate kung ah, “Suomhatte man ding bang khop in namsau leh phohbul tawi a hing kuon nave uah maw?"},"53":{"text":"Noute toh nichin a biehinn a ka um laiin lah ka tungah khut hah na tum vawt sih un, hinanleh tuhun nou thunei hun leh miel thuneina hun ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Luk. 19.47; 21.37"},"54":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama amanta ua, azawpi ua, Siempu lien inn sungah apuilut uhi. Tualeh Peter in gamla sim ah anua agal zui hi.","title":"Peter kilepsanna (Mat. 26.27 , 58 , 69-75 ; Mak. 14.53 , 54 , 66-72 ; Jn. 18.15-18 , 25-27)"},"55":{"text":"Tua huongsung leituol ah amauten mei ataw ua, mei awiin atoukhawm ua, Peter zong alah uah ava tou hi."},"56":{"text":"Tualeh suoh numei koi ahiei khat in, meikunga atou laiin amu a, chientahin a en a, “Tampa zong Ama toh umkhawm aveleh” achi hi."},"57":{"text":"Hinanleh aman “Numei Ama ka thei sih hi” chiin akilepsan hi."},"58":{"text":"Hun tomkhat zouin midang khat in amu kia a, “Nang zong alah ua mi nahi,” achi hi. Hinanleh Peter in, “Mihing aw, ka hisih,” achi hi."},"59":{"text":"Tuachi’n dahkal khat ding vel nuain, midang khat in, kimuongtahin, “Tampa zong Galili mi ahia, Ama toh umkhawm hima tham e,” achi hi."},"60":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter in “Mihing aw, na thugen bang ahiei ka thei sih” achi hi. Tuachi’n athugen laiin aa thakhat in ahing khuongta hi."},"61":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa khu akihei a, Peter a en a, tualeh Peter tuni’n “Aa khuon masangin thumvei na hing kilepsan ding chia Mangpa’n akung a agen khu a hing theidoh ta hi.”"},"62":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter apawtdoh a hasetah in akap hut hut ta hi."},"63":{"text":"Jesu aman miten chiemmui bawlnain anei ua, a vuo uhi.","title":"Jesu avua ua, a engbawlna uh (Mat. 26.67 , 68 ; Mak. 14.65 ; Jn. 18.22 , 23)"},"64":{"text":"Tualeh amit atuompieh zou un, “Amai ah abeeng ua, Koi ahiei hing vuo gen in” chi’n a dong uhi."},"65":{"text":"Tualeh thudang tampi zong Ama gensietna in agen uhi."},"66":{"text":"Zingkhuo ahing vahtah in, mipite upate leh siempu liente leh laigielmite ahing peikhawm ua, tualeh avaihawmna masang uah Jesu ahing pui uhi.","title":"Jesu vaihawmte mai a adinna (Mat. 27.1 ; Mak. 15.1)"},"67":{"text":"“Nang Khrist na hileh koute hing hil in” achi uhi. Aman “Hing hil nanleng gingta tuom sih va uteh."},"68":{"text":"Tualeh ken zong noute thu hing dong leng na hing dawng tuom sih ding ua, ha zong nang hakhe tuom sih ding uhi."},"69":{"text":"Tubansie Mihing Tapa khu Pasian silbawl theina zietlam ah atouta ding hi,” achi hi."},"70":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute zousie in, “Pasian tapa na hi maw leh?” achi uhi. Aman akung uah, “Na gen bangun Ka hi,” achi hi."},"71":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun theisahna dang “Bang angai nawn tuon eimah? Eima ngeiin akamsuo iza chiet ta uhi,” achi uhi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi zousie abawn un ading ua, Ama khu Pilat kungah apuita uhi.","title":"Jesu Rom gam uhpipa mai ah ading (Mat. 27.2 , 11-14 ; Mak. 15.1-5 ; Jn. 18.28-38)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh amauten Jesu khu ahing hehse panta ua; “Tam mipa’n Khrist kumpipa ka hi chiin Kaisar kunga sie pieh ding akhaam a, Ka namte uh asuhbuoi dan ka thei uhi,” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in “Nang Judate leengpa na hiei mah?” chi’n adong a, Jesu’n adawnga, “Na gen bangin ka hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in siempu liente leh mipite kungah “Tam mipa tungah mawna ka mu sih,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh amauh ahapan semsem ua; Aman “Galili gam akipat tam mun tan dong in Judia gam khochin ah thu ahil a, mipite achiilsie hi,” achi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Pilat in Galili kiminlaw azah tahin tam mipa Galili gam mi ahileh hilou adong hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Herod vaihawmna nuoi a um ahi chi athei tahin, Herod kungah asawlta hi. Khum hun lai in Herod zong Jerusalem a um ahiziehin."},"8":{"text":"Herod in Jesu amu tahin akipah mama a, atungtang thu tampi ana zahtah ziehin hun sawtpi a kipat Ama kimupi aut mawng ahi, tualeh asil lamdang bawl bang ahiei khat beeh mu akinem hi.","title":"Jesu Herod masanga adinna"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akungah thu tampi adonga, hinanleh Aman bangmain adawng sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh siempu liente leh laigiel mite adingdoh ua, nasatahin aheh uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuabep in Herod leh agalkapten simmaw bawl in chiemmui bawlna in anei ua, tualeh puontuol thupitah asil sah ua, Pilat kungah anuasawl kiata uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ni mama in Pilat leh Herod lawmta ahing hita uhi, tua ni masang in ama gel ana kimelma zing uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in siempu liente leh vaihawmte tualeh mipite ahankhawm a,","title":"Pilat masang ah Jesu adin kiana (Mat. 27.15-26 ; Mak. 15.6-15)"},"14":{"text":"Akung uah mite achiilsie hi chiin, “Tam mipa ka kunga na hing pui uh a, ngai un, na mai ua, hoitah a ka etchien nua in, na hehna tungtang uah, atungah dihlouna bangma ka mu sih;"},"15":{"text":"Herod in zong amu sih; noute ama kungah ka hing nua sawlkia a, Ngai un shina khop hiel in bangma abawl sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka jep sah ding a, ka ha mai ding hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"(Aziehpen tami pawi ni a mi henta khat ahakhiet sah teitei mawng uh ahi.)"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh kituohtahin akikou khie ua, “Tam mipa sumang inlen, Baraba hing hakhiet pieh in” achi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Baraba pen khopi sunga helna bang ahiei zieh leh tuolthana zieh a suongkul taang ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pilat in Jesu hakhiet a ut a, amaute kungah thu agenkia hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute akikou ua “Kross ah kilbeh in, Kross ah kilbeh in,” achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in athumveina dingin akung uah “Bangzieh in ahiei, Aman bang abawlkhiel a ahiei? Shina khop hiel atung ah bangma ka mu sih hi; Tuaziehin ka jepsah ding a, ka hakhe mai ding hi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh amauten aw ngaitah a kikouin Ama Kross a kilbeh dingin, angen teitei uhi. Amaute aw leh siempu liente aw in avau daita hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in anget bang ua bawl dingin thu atanta hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh helna leh tuolthana zieh a, suongkul taang ha dinga angetpa uh, ahahpiehta a, Jesu pen amaute deina bangin apekheta hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaun Jesu apeipi lai un lampi ah Sairin gam mi khat gamsunga kipat hing pei aman ua, Jesu nualanga kros puohpi dingin, atungah Kross angata uhi.","title":"Jesu kilbehna (Mat. 27.31-56 ; Mak. 15.20-41 ; Jn. 19.16-30)"},"27":{"text":"Mihon tampi leh Ama suun a kap leh mau numeiten zong anua azui uhi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu akihei a amauh lam hing ngat in, Jerusalem “Tanute aw, Kei hing kaa sih unlen, nouma leh na tate ua dingin kapzaw un."},"29":{"text":"Aziehpen Ngai un, miten chiingte leh nau pai ngailouna naubute leh naungeh tep ngailou nawite, hampha nah e, achi nite hing tung ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin amaun taangte kungah hing netkhum un, tualeh muolte kungah hing vuakhum un, achi ding uhi.","ref":"Hos. 10.8; Kihil. 6.16"},"31":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun tam silte sing hing nangawn a, abawl u’leh sing gaw ah bang akibawl tabep diei?” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Migilou dang ni zong Ama toh tha dingin apeipi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tualeh Kalvary achi mun uh atun tah un, khunah Jesu Kross ah akilbeh ua, migilou nite zong khat azietlam ah khat aveilam ah akilbeh uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n “Pa aw amaute ngaidam in, asil bawl uh atheilou zieh uh ahi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n apuonsil akihawm ua aisanna in anei uhi.","ref":"Late. 22.18"},"35":{"text":"Mipiten dingin a en zing ua, hinanleh vaihawm miten Ama a elhou ua, “Midang bawn ahundam vele, Ama Pasian mi tel Khrist ahileh, Ama leh ama kihunkhe leh asih diei,” achi uhi.","ref":"Late. 22.7"},"36":{"text":"Galkapten zong chiemmui bawlnain anei ua, ahing pei ua zu pawng apie uhi.","ref":"Late. 69.21"},"37":{"text":"“Judate kumpipa na hileh, Nangma kihunkhie in,” achi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh alutung zawn ah, Greek leh Latin leh Hebru ham in, “TAMI JUDATE KUMPIPA AHI” chia kigiel akita hi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh migilou kikhaite lah a khat in Ama agensie a, “Nang Khrist na hileh Nangma kihundam inlen kou gel zong hing hundam in,” achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Hinanleh adang khat pen in, ama phawh kawm in, “Pasian nangawn ging lou na hiei mah? Mawtansahkhawma na um thei taven."},"41":{"text":"Ei pen gawttah mawng ihia, isilbawlte man mu ihi, hinanleh Tam mipan bangma bawlkhiel anei sih hi,” achi hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Jesu kungah, “Mangpa, na gam na tun chiengin hing thei zingin achi hi.”"},"43":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, tuni’n ka kungah Pradise ah na um ding hi,” achi hi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh tam pen sunkimlai ahia, nitahlam nai thum tandongin gamsung pumpi ah simpi ahing zingta hi.","title":"Jesu shina","ref":"Pawt. 26.31-33"},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n ni ahing mielta a, Pasian biehinn a puongzah phal ni ahing kisuota hi."},"46":{"text":"Jesu aw ngai tahin akikou a, “Pa na khut sungah ka hagau ka hing kem sah hi” achi a, tami achi zouin ahagau ahata hi.","ref":"Late. 31.5"},"47":{"text":"Galkap lamkaipa’n sil umdante amu tahin; “Tampa pellou in midihtat ana hitahtah hi,” chiin Pasian aphat hi."},"48":{"text":"Tualeh a en dinga hing pei mipite zousie in sil um dante amu un a awm uh tum kawm in anua pei uhi."},"49":{"text":"Hinanleh ameltheite zousie leh Galili gam a kipat a Ama hing zui numeite gamlapi ah ading ua, tam silte agal et uhi.","ref":"Luk. 8.2,3"},"50":{"text":"Tualeh Ngai un, mi khat amin Joseph kichi vaihawm mi a um a, ama mi hoi leh dihtat ahi.","title":"Jesu kivuina (Mat. 27.57-61 ; Mak. 15.42-47 ; Jn. 19.38-42)"},"51":{"text":"Aman avaihawmna u’leh asil bawlte uh lem ana sahpi sih a, ama pen Arimathai kichi Judate khopi khat a teng ahi."},"52":{"text":"Tam mipa Pilat kungah ava pei a, Jesu luong ava ngen hi."},"53":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Jesu luong alakhie a, puonnem in atuom a, koima kisielna ngai nailou suong kikhuoh han khat ah asielta hi."},"54":{"text":"Tuani khu kiginkholna ni ahi a, khawlni kipan ding ahita hi."},"55":{"text":"Galili gam akipat a Ama toh hing zawhkhawm numeite’n zong anuazui ua, ahan leh aluong kisiel dan amu uhi."},"56":{"text":"Tuachi’n anua peikia ua, sil gimnamtui leh kinu ding sathau namtui abawl uhi. Tualeh thupieh dungzuiin, khawlni in akhawlta uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.10; Danp. 5.14"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin hapta khat a ni masapen zingmawng matahin agimnamtui bawlte uh tawi in, midang koite ahiei toh han ah ahing haw uhi.","title":"Jesu thawkiana (Mat. 28.1-8 ; Mak. 16.1-8 ; Jn. 20.1-10)"},"2":{"text":"Amaun hankhuh apat suong kiliakhesain amu uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n asungah alut ua, Mangpa Jesu luong amuta sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh amaute tam thu a nasatah a alungbuoi lai un, ngai vawi, mi ni puon vam tesilsel sil in a kung uah ahing ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute zau a leia abawhkhup lai un, amaun akung uah, “Bangding a mishi lah a mihing sui na hi uoi?"},"6":{"text":"Tanah a um nawn sih hi, athoukia ta hi; Galili gama aum lai a na kung ua agen khu thei ngitnget un,","ref":"Mat. 16.21; 17.22,23; 20.18,19; Mak. 8.31; 9.31; 10.33,34; Luk. 9.22; 18.31-33"},"7":{"text":"Mihing Tapa khu mikhielte khut a matsah in a um dinga, Kross ah akilbeh ding ua, tualeh ni thum niin athoukia ding achi khu,” achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun athugente ahing theidohta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n han akipat anuapei kia ua, tam silte zousie sawmlekhatte leh midang zousie kungah ahilta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Sawltahte kunga tam silte va hilte khu, Mari Magdalene toh, Joana toh, Jakob nu Mari toh, tualeh amaute toh umkhawm numei dangte toh ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh athugente u’khu thu maimai bangin angai ua, atahsang sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter adingdoh a, han lam ah ava tai a, kunsuh a hankhuh a et leh atuomna puonnemte maimai na um amu a, sil umdante lamdang sa kawm in inn lam ah apeikiata hi."},"13":{"text":"Ngai vawi, tua ni mama in alah ua mi ni Emmau kichi khuo khat, zuon in apei uhi. Tua khuo khu Jerusalem akipat a tai sagi a gamla ahi.","title":"Emmau lampi a Jesu kilahna (Mak. 16.12 , 13)"},"14":{"text":"Amaute gel khu tam sil hing tungte zousie genin ahoulim uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuabanga amautegel houlim a akikupkhawm lai tah un, Jesu mama in amauh ava nai a, amautegel toh azawhkhawmta hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama athei louna ding un, amitte uh suhvai in a um hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, na pei kawm ua, “Bang thu houlim a, tambanga daamel puo na hi uoi?” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n amagel lah a khatpa amin Kleopa kichi penin adawnga akungah, “Tulai a sil umdante na theilou, Jerusalem ah nang maimai mikhuol na hiei mah?” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Bang sil umdante la?” achi hi Tualeh amaun akungah, “Nazareth Jesu, Pasian leh mi zousie mitmu a silbawlthei leh thugen guolnei minthangtah tungtang thu:"},"20":{"text":"Ama pen siempu liente leh ka vaihawmte un shi dinga mawpai ding leh Kross a kilbeh ding a, apiehkhiet dan uh thu."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh kouten Israelte tankhepa ding Ama ahi chi ka kinem uhi, tualeh tamte chilou zong, tam silte hing tun kalsie tuni ani thumni ahita hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuathamlouin ka lawi lah ua numei pawlkhat han a mataha va hawten ahing lungdong sah mama uhi."},"23":{"text":"Aluong ava mu lou bep un ahing kinualekia ua, Ahing kiata chia hing hil vansawlsiengte zong ka mu uh, achi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Ka umpite u’lah a pawlkhat han ah ava pei ua, numeite gen bangbang ava mu ua, hinanleh Ama ava mu sih uhi,” achi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Oh, mi mote leh guolneite thugen zousie lungtanga tahsan hasa sate!"},"26":{"text":"Khrist in tam silte thuoh a, Athupina a lut ding mawng hilou ahiei mah?” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mosi leh guolneite zousie laibu a kipat Pasian Laisiengthou pumpi a Ama tungtang kigielte akung uah ahilchienta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n ahawna ding khuo uh atun kuon un, Ama pen gamlapi a peisuoh ding bangin a um hi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh amautegel in Ama ahou ua, “Ka kung uah taam mai ve aw, nitahlam ahita a, ni zong tum ding ahita hi,” achi ua, tuachi’n akung ua um dingin khuo ah alutta uhi."},"30":{"text":"Amaute gel toh annkuong a atou lai in, tanghou ala a, aguolzawl a, tualeh abalkeh a, amauh apie hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n amit uh ahing vahta a, Ama a theita uhi, tualeh Ama pen amitmu ua kipat amang ta hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh amautegel akihoulim ua, “Lampi a ahing houpi a, Laisiengthou thute ahing hilchien laiin ilungtang isung ah akuong hiel hilou ahiei mah?” akichi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuami hun mama in amautegel adingkhie ua, Jerusalem ah akinuale kia ua, Sawm leh khatte leh akung ua umkhawmte ava mu uhi."},"34":{"text":"Amauten “Mangpa athoukia tahtah ahi, Simon kungah zong akilahta hi,” ana chi uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh amaute gelin zong, lampi a asiltuohte u’leh tanghou aphalsuo a, Ama atheidoh dante uh ahil uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tambang silte agen lai un Jesu mama alah uah ahing ding a, akung uah, “Na tung uah hamuonna um hen,” achi hi.","title":"Sawltahte kung a Jesu kilahna"},"37":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute achiza ua, azau sengseng ua, shiha muin akingaituo uhi."},"38":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Bangdinga hichi patau na hi uoi? Tualeh bang zieh a na lungtang ua ginlana hing um ahiei?"},"39":{"text":"Ka khutte leh ka kephangte En un, Keima mama hilou ka hiei mah? hing tham unlen, hing vel un. Mishi ha in tua ka nei na mu uh tahsa leh guletaangte a nei sih hi,” achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tam thute agen zouin, akhut leh akengte amauh a ensahta hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh amauh akipah seng tahluot zieh ua, gingta ngamlou khop a lamdang asah lai un, Aman akung uah, “Tanah neh ding bang ahiei khat na nei uoi?” achi hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, nga emminsa khat leh khuoizu khal khat apie uhi."},"43":{"text":"Aman tuate ala a, amasang uah aneta hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Na kung ua ka um lai a, ka gen Mosi dan leh guolneite laibu leh Late laibu a ka tungtang kigielte zousie, tungkim teitei ding ahi chia, kagente khu tam thute ahi,” achi hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n Laisiengthou thute atheisiemna ding un Aman alungtang uh avahsahta hi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman akung uah, “Tambanga gel ahi, tambangin Khrist in gimna athuoh ding a, ni thum ni a mishi lah akipat athawkia ding mawng ahi.","title":"Khantanhoi gen ding a vaihahna (Nasep. 1.3 , 8)"},"47":{"text":"Tualeh kisiana leh khel ngaidamna khu Ama min in Jerusalem akipat in namchin lah ah gen ahi ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Noute pen tam silte theipite na hi uhi."},"49":{"text":"Ngai un, Ka Pa thuchiem noute tungah ka hing sawl ding hi; hinanleh tunglam akipat silbawltheina a thop na hi masangsie un Jerusalem khopi ah um khinkhien un,” achi hi.","title":"Jesu van a akaltouna (Mak. 16.19 ; Nasep. 1.9)","ref":"Nasep. 1.4"},"50":{"text":"Tualeh Aman Bethani khuo dongin amaute azawpi a, tualeh Aban azah a ama uh aguol zawl hi.","ref":"Nasep. 1.9-11"},"51":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, amauh aguolzawl laitahin, Aman apeisanta a, van ah puitouin aumta hi."},"52":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten Ama abie ua, lungnopna thupitah toh Jerusalem ah anuakiata uhi."},"53":{"text":"Tualeh biehinn ah Pasian phat leh pahtawi in a umdenta uhi, Amen."}}}}},"43":{"info":{"name":"Johan","shortname":"Jn.","abbr":[],"desc":"Johan gel khantanhoi"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Achil in thu a um a, thu khu Pasian kungah aum hi, thu khu Pasian ahi.","title":"Jesu Khrist Pasian hina"},"2":{"text":"Achiil in Ama Pasian toh a um khawm hi."},"3":{"text":"Sil zousie Ama tungtawn a siem ahia, silsiem chinteng Ama lou a kisiem bangma a um sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama ah hinna a um a, tua hinna khu mihingte vahna ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vah khu miel lah ah ahing vah a, miel in tua khu athei sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasiana kipat a sawl mi khat a um a amin Johan ahi.","title":"Baptispa Johan nasep","ref":"Mat. 3.1; Mak. 1.4; Luk. 3.1,2"},"7":{"text":"Tam mipa khu theipitu ding in ahing pei a, tua vah thu ama zieh a mi zousie’n atahsan theina dingun."},"8":{"text":"Ama pen vah khu ahisih a, hinanleh tua vah theipi ding a sawl ahi zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuakhu vah dihtah, michin leitunga hing pei pouma salvahpa ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ama leitung ah a um a, leitung Ama siem ahia, tualeh leitungin Ama athei sih hi.","title":"Leitungin ama theisih"},"11":{"text":"Ama amite kung ah ahing pei a, Ama amiten akipahpi sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama kipahpi poumate kungah Pasian tate hitheina ding hamphatna apie hi, Ama min gingtate kungah:","title":"Khrist pomte Pasian tate ahi"},"13":{"text":"Tua mite pen sisan a pieng ahisih ua, tahsa deidana pieng zong ahisih ua, tualeh mihing deidan a pieng zong ahi dieh sih ua, hinanleh Pasian a pieng ahizaw uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh thu khu tahsa ahing suoh a, i lah uah a um a, (Pa tapa tang nei sun thupi bangin athupina imu uhi) hepina leh thutah in adim hi.","title":"Khrist tahsa ahing suohna"},"15":{"text":"Johan in Ama theipina apie a akikou a, “Ka nua a hing peipa’n Kei ahing makhelta hi, Kei masanga um mawng ahi ziehin, chia atungtang thu ka genpa khu Ama ahi.”"},"16":{"text":"Ama bukimna itang chiet ua, hepina tungah hepina sawn sawn toh."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen dan thu Mosi tungtawna pieh ahia, hepina leh thutah pen Jesu Khrist tungtawn a hing um ahi."},"18":{"text":"Koiman bangmachihin Pasian amungai sih. Pa angsunga um Tapa tang nei sun in Ama tanchin aphuongkheta hi, achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Judaten Jerusalem a kipat in siempute leh Levimite Johan kungah, “Koina hiei?” chia dong ding a asawl lai ua, tambang theipina thu ana gen ahi.","title":"Siempute leh Levimite kung a Johan theipina thu (Mat. 3.1-12 ; Mak. 1.1-8 ; Luk. 3.3-16)"},"20":{"text":"Aman nielse louin agenkhie a, “Kei Khrist ka hi loupi” chi’n akiphuong hi."},"21":{"text":"Amauten “Ahileh koina hiei? Elijah na ma leh?” chi’n adong uhi. Aman ka hi sih achia, “Guolnei na hiei leh?” achi ua, Aman “Ka hi sih” chi’n adawng hi.","ref":"Mala. 4.5; Danp. 18.15,18"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akung ah, “Koi na hiei? Kou hing sawlte ka dawn theina ding un hing hil in. Nang leh nang koi kichi na hiei mah?” achi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Aman guolnei Isai genbang a, “Mangpa lampi siel tang un chi a, gamdai a Kikoupa aw khu kahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 40.3"},"24":{"text":"Ami sawlte u’pen Pharisaite lah a mite ahi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Amaun, “Khrist lah hilou, Elijah lah hilou, tualeh guolnei lah hilou, na hileh bang ding a na baptis ahiei?” chiin adong uhi."},"26":{"text":"Johan in amauh adawnga, “Ken tuiin ka baptis a hinanleh na theilou uh mi khat na lah uah ading hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama ahi kanua a, hing pei ahing makhel dingpa, Kei pen akedap khau sut taah zong ka hisih hi,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam silte pen Jordan gal a Bethabara a, Johan in abaptis na mun a kibawl ahi."},"29":{"text":"Azingni’n Johan in Jesu ama lam zuon a hing pei amu a, “En un, Pasian belamnou leitung khelna lamangpa khu.","title":"Jesu Baptisma tanna (Mat. 3.13-17 ; Mak. 1.9-11 ; Luk. 3.21-22)"},"30":{"text":"Ka nua a hing peipa, Kei um masanga umsa mawng ahizieh in, Kei sanga thupizaw ahi chia ka genpa khu tam mipa ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ken Ama kana thei sih hi, hinanleh Israelte kunga suhlat ahi theina dingin tui a baptis in ka hing pei ahi,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Johan in athu atheipi a, Hagau vakhu banga van a kipat a hing kumsuh a atunga tuong den ka mu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ken Ama kana thei sih a, hinanleh tui a baptis ding a hing sawlpa, Ama mama in ka kungah, koi hitaleh Hagau hing kumsuh a atunga tuongden na mu penpa khu, Ama ahi, Hagau siengthou a baptis ding pa khu, ahing chi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua khu ka muta a, tualeh tampa khu Pasian tapa ahi chi ka theipi hi, achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Azing nikia in Johan anuazuite ni toh ading uhi.","title":"Andru leh Peter in Jesu nuazui uh"},"36":{"text":"Jesu avah lai a en a, “En un, Pasian belamnou” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua nuazui nite’n athugen aza ua, Jesu azuita uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu akihei a, ahingzui uh amu a, akung uah, “Bang ahiei na sui uh?” achi hi. Amaun akungah “Rabbi (tua khu Siepa china ahi) hei a um na hiei?” achi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Hing pei unlen, En un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amaute ahing pei ua, a umna ava mu uhi. Tualeh nitah lam nai li vel ahitah ziehin tua ni akungah ataamta uhi."},"40":{"text":"Johan thugen za a, Jesu zuitegel lah a khat khu Simon Peter sanggampa Andru ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Aman amasapen in ama sanggampa ngel Simon ava mudoh a, akungah “Messiah Ka muta uh,” achi hi. (Messiah pen Khrist china ahi.)"},"42":{"text":"Tualeh aman Jesu kungah Simon ahing zawpi a, Jesu’n ama a en a, “Nang pen Jonah Tapa Simon na hi a, Kephas ahing kichita ding hi” tua khu suong china ahi."},"43":{"text":"Azingni in Jesu Galili gam ah pei asawm a, Philip amu a, akungah, “Hing zui in” achi hi.","title":"Phillip leh Nathanael in Jesu azuina"},"44":{"text":"Philip khu Andru leh Peter tenna khuo Bethsaida a teng ahi."},"45":{"text":"Philip in Nathanael amu a, akungah, “Mosi in dan laibu sunga atungtang thu ana gelpa guolneiten zong ana gel uh Nazareth Jesu Joseph tapa khu ka muta uhi,” achi hi."},"46":{"text":"Nathanael in akungah, “Nazareth akipat in sil hoi apawtkhe ngai amah” achi hi. Philip in akungah “Hing pei inlen hing en in,” achi hi."},"47":{"text":"Jesu’n Nathanael Ama kunglam zuon a hing pei amu tahin, ama tungthu ana gen a, “En un, Israel mi dihtah lepchie ngailoupa ahi,” achi hi."},"48":{"text":"Nathanael in akungah, “Kei bang nahing chi thei ahiei?” achi hi. Jesu’n adawng a akungah, “Philip in nang ahing hat masang a theipi phung nuoi a na um laiin, ka hing muta hi,” achi hi."},"49":{"text":"Nathanael in adawnga, akungah, “Rabbi, Nang Pasian Tapa na hia, Israel te leengpa na hi,” achi hi."},"50":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga akungah, “Theipi kung nuoi ah ka hing muta ka hing chi zieh a, na hing gintat amah? Tam silte sanga thupizaw na hing mu nalai ding hi,” achi hi."},"51":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n akungah, “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, Tunua chiengin, Van kihong na mu dinga, Pasian vansawlsiengte Mihing Tapa tunga kaltou leh kumsuh na mu ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 28.12"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ani thum niin, Galili gam a Kana khuo ah kitenna khat a um a, khunah Jesu nu zong a um hi.","title":"Jesu’n tui uoin asuohsahna"},"2":{"text":"Jesu leh anuazuite zong kitenna ah chiel ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh uoin ahing bei tahin, Jesu nu’n akungah “Uoin anei nawn sih uh,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, numei nang awlmawna toh kei bang kisai kha ahiei? Ka hun atung nai sih hi, achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Anu in tuonvaite kungah, Aman na kung ua “Agen pouma bawl un” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Judate tawndan ngaina dungzui a, tui a kisiensuona dinga kizang suongtuibel litar sawmgiet ahiei, zaleh sawmni ahiei, dawl chiet guh atung uhi."},"7":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Tuibelte ah tui sungdim un,” achi a, tuachi’n amaun belgong gei chiet in asung dim uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Themkhat sawhkhie unlen, pawi nehbawl tuonvai lamkaipa kungah vatawi un,” achi hi. Amaun ava tawi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Pawi nehbawl tuonvai lamkaipa’n tua tui uoin hing suoh khu achiem a, hei a kipata hing umdoh ahiei chi atheisih a, (ahivangin tuonvai tuisawkheten athei uhi) Pawi nehbawl tuonvai lamkaipa’n mouneipa ahan a,"},"10":{"text":"Akungah, “Michin in akipat chil in uoin chiate ahawm masa a, michielten akham nua chieng ua, achia loudeute ahawm uhia, nang lah tu dongin achia na nei na lailai a,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tami chiemtena lamdang kipatna Jesu’n Galili gam a Kana khuo a abawl ahia; tualeh athupina akilang sah hi, anuazuiten Ama agingta ta uhi.","title":"Nuazuiten agingta uh"},"12":{"text":"Tami nuain Kapernaum khuo ah Jesu anu toh, asanggamte toh, tualeh anuazuite toh apei suh ua, khunah ni tam ataam sih uhi.","ref":"Mat. 4.13"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh Judate peikan pawi anaita a, Jesu Jerusalem ah apeitouta hi.","title":"Jesu’n biehinn asuh siengna","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-27"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh biehinn huong sunga bawng leh belam leh vakhu zuate tualeh dawkan a sum hengmi toute amu hi."},"15":{"text":"Aman jepna khauhuol abawl zouin biehinn huongsung akipat in, belamte leh bawngte abawn in a notdoh sienga, tualeh sumheng mite dangka abuohkhup pieh a, adawkante uh a sawnpua pieh hi."},"16":{"text":"Aman vakhu zuate kungah, “Tam silte tana pat in lamang un, Ka Pa inn summet bawlna inn in bawl sih un,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n anuazuiten, “Na inn a dinga ka phattuom ngainain ahing ne tumta chi a David gel ahing theidoh uhi.”","ref":"Late. 69.9"},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judaten adawng ua, akungah, “Tam silte na bawl ngal leh koute lah a chiemtena bang ahiei na hing lah thei ding?” achi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga “Tam biehinn susie un, ni thum sungin ka tungding ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 26.61; 27.40; Mak. 14.58; 15.29"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judaten, “Tami biehinn lamna in kum sawmli leh guh alut a, nang maw ni thum sunga na tun ding kia ding?” achi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahivang in Aman atahsa pumpi biehinn agenna ahi zaw hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin mishi lah akipat a athawkia nuain anuazuiten tam akung ua athugente ahing thei thata ua, Pasian Laisiengthou leh Jesu thugen agingta ta uhi."},"23":{"text":"Peikan annkuonglui lai a Jesu Jerusalema a um laiin, chiemtena lamdang abawlte amu un mi tampiten amin agingta ta uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n mizousie atheichien ziehin amaute lah ah akikaang koi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Aman mihing sunga um athei ziehin, mihing thu koima hilchet akiphamaw sih hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pharisaite lah a mi, amin Nikodem kichi Judate vaihawmpa khat a um hi.","title":"Jesu leh Nikodem kihoulimna"},"2":{"text":"Ama zanlai in Jesu kungah ahing haw a, akungah “Rabbi, Pasian akipat a hing pei Siepa na hi chi ka thei uhi. Pasian umpilou mi koima’n na chiemtena lamdang bawlte abawl thei sih ding uhi,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu’n adawng a akungah, “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, mi koipou apientha sih leh Pasian gam amu sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Nikodem in akungah, “Mi ateh nuain bangchin apiengtha thei diei? anu sunga nivei lut in apieng thei diei mah?” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, “Adihtahin ka hing hil ahi, Mi koipou tui leh Hagau a, apientha sihleh Pasian gam alut thei sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tahsa a pieng pouma tahsa ahia, Hagau a pieng pouma Hagau ahi."},"7":{"text":"Na pientha ngeingei ding ahi, na kunga kachi lamdang sa sin."},"8":{"text":"Hui a utna lamlam ah alaang a aging na za hi, hinanleh heia hing kipan a, heilang a pei ding ahiei chi na thei sih hi. Michin Hagau a pieng pouma tuabang ahi.”"},"9":{"text":"Nikodem in adawnga, akungah, “Tam silte bangchi’n ahithei diei?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu’n adawng a, akungah, “Israelte Siepa khat hinapi a, tam silte theilou na mah?"},"11":{"text":"Adihtahin ka hinghil ahi, kouten ka thei uh ka gen ua, ka mu uh ka theisah uhi; ahivangin nouten koute theipina thu na pom sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Leitung silte ka hing hil nangawn tahsang utlou na hi u’leh, vanlam silte hing hil leng bang na chi tahsan ding uoi?"},"13":{"text":"Van a kipat a hing kumsuh, Mihing Tapa van a um chiloungal koima van ah akaltou nai sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Mosi in gamdai a gul akhaikang bangin Mihing Tapa zong khaikangin aum ngeigei ding hi.","ref":"Kisim. 21.9"},"15":{"text":"Koipou Ama gingtain mangthai lou a, kumtawn hinna anei zawhna ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in khovel a it sengsenga, tuachi’n a tapa tangkhat neisun apie hi, koipou Ama gingta in amanthat lou a kumtawn hinna anei zawhna dingin."},"17":{"text":"Khovel siemlou tangsah dingin Pasian in atapa leitungah asawl sih a, Khovel Ama vanga hundam ahitheina dingin asawl zaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama gingta pouma siemmaw tansahin aum sih a, hinanleh agingta lou pouma siemmaw tansah zou ahita, Pasian Tapa tangkhat neisun min agintat lou zieh in."},"19":{"text":"Tua khu siemlou tanna ahi, vah leitungah ahing pei a, hinanleh miten vah sangin miel adei zaw uhi, asilbawlte uh agitlou zieh in."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen Koipou sil gilou bawl in vah a huo uhi, tualeh vah ah zong ahing pei ut sih uhi; tuachilouin asil bawlte uh akilang kha ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh koipou sildih bawl khu vah ah ahing pei ua, asil bawlte uh Pasian a bawl ahi chi akilat theina dingin."},"22":{"text":"Tam silte nuain Jesu anua zuite toh Judia gamah ahing pei ua, khunah amautoh a umkhawm a abaptis zel hi.","title":"Johan in Jesu atheipina nukhia pen"},"23":{"text":"Johan in zong khuna tui atam ziehin Salim kunga Aenon ah abaptis a, tualeh amaute a hing pei ua, baptisma atang uhi."},"24":{"text":"Khum hunlai in Johan suongkul ah akikhum nai sih hi.","ref":"Mat. 14.3; Mak. 6.17; Luk. 3.19,20"},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Johan nuazuite leh Judate kikaal ah kisiensuona thu ah kinielna ahing umta hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute Johan kungah ahing pei ua, akungah “Rabbi Jordan gal a na kunga um atanchin na theipipa’n baptis abawl a, akungah mizousie ahing pei uhi,” achi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Johan in adawnga akung uah, “Van akipat a pieh ahisihleh mihingin bangma anei thei sih hi."},"28":{"text":"Kei Khrist khu ka hisih a, amasang a sawl ka hi zaw hi chi noute mama in na hing theipi uhi.","ref":"Jn. 1.20"},"29":{"text":"Mouneipa khu mou pasal ahia, hinanleh mouneipa lawmpa akung a dinga, athu ngaikhieh khu mouneipa aw ziehin alung nuom mama a, Tuaziehin tam ka lungnopna abukimta hi."},"30":{"text":"Aman khanlam anaw dinga, Ken kiemlam ka naw ding hi.”"},"31":{"text":"Tunglam a kipat a hing peipa khu mi zousie tung a ahi a, lei a pieng khu leimi ahia, leilam sil mama agen hi; van akipat a hing peipa khu mi zousie tunga ahi."},"32":{"text":"Aman amu leh azahte a theipi a, koiman a thu theipina thu apom sih hi."},"33":{"text":"Koipou athu theipina pom in Pasian a dih ahi chiin apom uhi."},"34":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian misawlpa’n Pasian thu agen a; Pasian in lah a kungah Hagau tedetdet in ape sih hi."},"35":{"text":"Pa in tapa a it a, akhut ah sil zousie apeta hi.","ref":"Mat. 11.27; Luk. 10.22"},"36":{"text":"Koipou tapa gingta in kumtawn hinna aneita, koipou tapa gingta louin hinna amu sih ding a, hinanleh Pasian thangpaina atungah a um den ding hi, achi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jesu’n Johan sangin nuazui tamzaw asiema abaptis hi chi Pharisaiten aza uh chi Mangpa’n atheitah in,","title":"Jesu leh Samaria numei kihouna"},"2":{"text":"(Ahivang in Jesu hiel in a baptis sih a anua zuiten abaptis uh ahi zaw hi.)"},"3":{"text":"Judia gam anuasie a, Galili gamah apei kiata hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Samaria gam tawn malam a apei ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samaria khopi khat Saikar achi uh, Jakob in atapa Joseph kunga mun apiehna kung ahing tungta a,","ref":"Siem. 33.19; Josh. 24.32"},"6":{"text":"Khunah Jakob tuikul aum a, Jesu zong akhuolzin lampeina agim ziehin tuikul geiah atou a, tua khu sunkim laitah ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samaria numei khat tuitawi dingin ahing pei a, Jesu’n akungah “Dawn ding hing pe vawi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Anuazuite lah khopi lam ah neh ding leiin apei siengta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samaria numei in akungah, “Bangchidan a nang Juda mi in Kei Samaria numei kunga dawn ding na hing nget ahiei?” Judaten lah Samaria mite bangma a na ngai lou uh hilou ahieimah? achi hi.","ref":"Ezr. 4.1-5; Neh. 4.1,2"},"10":{"text":"Jesu’n a dawnga akungah, “Pasian silpieh leh na kunga dawn ding hing piein chipa koi ahiei chi theilachin nang akunga ngen zaw ding hima ve chin, Aman tuihing hing pe ding hiven,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Numei in akungah, “Pu aw asawhna ding bangma na nei sih a, tuikul lah athuh mama in, hei a kipata tua tuihing la ding na hiei?"},"12":{"text":"Ka pu uh Jakob sanga thupi zaw na hiei mah? Aman tami tuikul ahing pie a, tualeh ama ngelin zong adawn a, atate leh aganhonten zong a dawn uhi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, akungah, “Koipou tami tui dawn pouma adangtah kia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh ken akunga ka pieh ding tui dawn pouma bangchih tanin adangtah nawn sih ding uhi. Akunga ka pieh ding tui khu ama ah tuinah ahing hi ding a, kumtawn hinna phain akikhotou ding hi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Numeinu’n akungah “Pu aw, Ka dangtah kia nawnlou na dingin leh tui tawi dinga tana ka hing kuon nawn louna dingin tua tui khu hing peve,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah: “Pei inlen na pasal va han inlen tanah hing pei kia in,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n numeinu’n adawnga, “Pasal ka nei sih” achi hi. Jesu’n akungah, “Pasal ka nei sih na chi, na chidih hi."},"18":{"text":"Atahtah in Pasal nga na neita a, tulai tah a na nei zong na pasal ahi sih hi, na thugen adih ahi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Numeinu’n akungah, “Pu aw guolnei khat na hi chi ka theita hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate un tami muol tungah Pasian abie ua, hinanleh nouten Jerusalem vateh a miten Pasian abieh ding uh ahi” nachi sese uhi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah “Numei aw, hing gingtain, tam muol tung sese lou ah zong, Jerusalem sese lou ah zong Pa na bieh hun uh hing tung ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Nouten na theilou uh na bie uhi, Kouten ka bieh uh ka thei uhi; aziehpen hundamna Judate a hing kipan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh ahun tung ding ahita, tu’n zong atung ahita, tua hun chiengin abe tahtahten Pa khu Hagau leh thutahin abe ding uhi, aziehpen Pa in tuabang mi Ama be ding in asui hi."},"24":{"text":"Pasian khu Hagau ahia, abe miten Hagau leh thutah a abieh ding uh ahi.”"},"25":{"text":"Numeinu’n akungah, “Khrist kichi Messiah ahing pei ding chi ka thei hi; Ama ahing pei chieng in bangkim ahing hil ding hi,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Kei na kunga thugenpa khu Ama ka hi,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua hunlai tahin anuazuite ahing tung ua, numeinu akihoupi lamdang asa mama ua; hinanleh koiman “Bang ahiei na dei?” “Bangding a numeinu toh kihou na hiei?” achi sih uhi.","title":"Nuazuite thuhilna"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n numeinu in atuibel anuasie a, khopi lam ah apei a, mite kung ah."},"29":{"text":"“Hing pei unlen hing En un, ka sil bawlsate zousie hing hil mi khat a um hi. Khrist hilou ding ahiei mah?"},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute khopi apat apawtdoh ua, akungah ahing peita uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuakaal in anuazuiten “Rabbi ann ne phot in” chiin asawl uhi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman akung uah, “Noute theilou ann neh ding ka nei hi,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaziehin anuazuite khat leh khat akihou ua, “Mi koi ahiei in a neh ding ahing tawipieh adiei?” achi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Ka ann khu kei hing sawlpa deilam bawl leh Ama nasep zaw ding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Nouten bu laah na ding hali avatna lai hi, na chi sih uh amah? Ngai un, ka hinghil ahi, Dahkhie unlen, loute en un, laah hun in amin siengta hi."},"36":{"text":"Bulapain thaman amu a, kumtawn hinna tana um ding ga alakhawm a; atu pa leh a atpa akipah khawm theina ding un."},"37":{"text":"Khat in atu a adangin aga a at zel chi thu tanah adih ngel hi."},"38":{"text":"Na sepgim louna uh ga at dingin ka hing sawl ahi. Midangten ana semgimta uh a, nouten asepgimna uh na sutzop uh ahi,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua numei in, “Aman ka silbawlsa zousie ahing hil hi” chi theipina thu agen ziehin tua khopi a, Samarimite tampi in Jesu agingta ta uhi.","title":"Jesu leh Samarimite"},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n Samarimite Jesu kung ahing tun un akung ua taam tadi dingin ahou ua, khunah ni ni atamta hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Ama thugen ziehin midang tampi in agintat belap uhi."},"42":{"text":"Amauten numeinu kungah, “Tuin vang nang thugen zieh a gingta ka hinawn sih ua, kouma mamain ka za ua tualeh tampa pen leitung hundampa, Khrist ahi chi ka thei uhi,” achi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tualeh ni ni nuain khuna kipat in apawt a, Galili gam ah apeita hi."},"44":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama Jesu ngel in guolnei ama gam lam ah pahtawi in a um ngai sih chi atheisah ta hi.","ref":"Mat. 13.57; Mak. 6.4; Luk. 4.24"},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n Galili gam ahing tun tahin, Galili miten Ama ana kipahpi uhi. Amaute Jerusalem khuo a peikan annkuongluina a, va haw ahizieh un asil bawl zousie ava mu uhi.","title":"Mithupi khat tapa damsahna","ref":"Jn. 2.23"},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu khu tui uoin asuohsahna Galili gam a Kana khuo ahing tung kia hi. Khunah mi thupi khat, atapa Kapernaum khuo ah china in a um hi.","ref":"Jn. 2.1-11"},"47":{"text":"Ama’n Judia gam a pat Galili gam ah Jesu ahing tung chi azahtah in, akung ah ahing pei a, tualeh vapeisuh a atapa va sudam dingin angen vanguo hi, aziehpen ama ashi, dihdih ahita hi."},"48":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah “Chiemtena leh sil lamdang na mu sih u’leh na gingta sih ding uh,” achi hi."},"49":{"text":"Mithupipa’n “Pu aw, Ka tapa ashi masangin hing hawsuh in,” achi hi."},"50":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Peita’n na tapa adamta hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amapa’n Jesu’n akunga athugen agingta a, apeita hi."},"51":{"text":"Ama lampi a apeisuh laiin asuohten atapa adamta chi thu toh ana dawn uhi."},"52":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ahing dampat lai hun adonga amaun akungah, “Zani nai sagi in a chithuo in ama anuasieta hi,” achi uhi."},"53":{"text":"Tuachi’n apain tua khu Jesu’n akunga “Na tapa adamta” achi hun laitah ahi chi atheita hi; tualeh ama leh a innkuonpi tengin agingta ta uhi."},"54":{"text":"Tam pen Judia gam a pat Galili gam ahing tun nua a, chiemtena lamdang Jesu’n abawl ni veina ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami nuain Judate pawi khat a um a, Jesu Jerusalem ah ahawtou hi.","title":"Bethsaida dil a mizaw damsahna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem ah belam kotpi kungah dil khat a uma, Hebrew ham in Bethsaida kichi innhim nga nei a um hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua inn himte ah damloute, mittote kengbaite tualeh zengte tampi tuikiloh ngah in alum uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen bangchihun ahiei khat chiengin vansawlsieng khat dil ah apeisuh a, tui ava sau zel hi, tuachi’n koipou tui kisau nua a lut masa pen pen khu bangchibang natna neinanleh suhdam in a um zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Khunah mi pasal koi ahiei khat kum sawmthum leh kum giet damlouin a um hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama khuna lum Jesu’n amutah in tambanga hun sawtpi um ahita chi athei a, akungah “Suhdam na ut ei?” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Damloupa’n “Pu, tui kisau chienga dil a hing koi ding mi ka nei sih a, Keima a ka pei chieng in, midangin ahing makhel zel hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah “Thou inlen, na netpha la inlen, na kengin in peita in” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua mipa thakhat in adam pai a, anetpha ala a, kengin a peita hi. Tuani khu khawlni ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin Judaten suhdam a umpa kungah, “Khawlni ahia, na netpha na puoh dan ahi sih hi,” achi uhi.","ref":"Neh. 13.19; Jer. 17.21"},"11":{"text":"Aman amaute adawng a, “Ahing sudampa ngelngel in ka kungah, na netpha la inlen, peita in, ahing chi hi” chiin adawng hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akung ah “Na netpha la inlen, na kengin peita in hing chipa koi ahiei?” chi’n adong uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh damsaha um pa’n, ama damsahpa koi ahiei chi athei sih hi; aziehpen tua mun a mipi umte lah akipat in ana kigelmangta hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuami nuain Jesu’n Pasian biehinn ah ama amu a, akungah, “En vawi, suhdamin na umta hi khielkia nawn sin, tuachilouin sil sezawsem na tungah ahing tung kha ding hi.”"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua mipa apawtkhie a, asudampa khu Jesu ahi chi Judate ava hilta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tamte ziehin Judaten Jesu abawlsie ua, tha a sawmta uhi; tam silte khawlni a abawl ahi ziehin."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu’n amauh adawnga, “Ka Pa’n tutan dong ana asem a, ken zong ka sem hi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin Judaten Jesu tha atum semsem ua, Aman khawlni abawsiet guoh hilouin, Pasian ka pa ahi achi a, Pasian toh kibang a akibawl zieh in."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n adawnga, akung uah, “Noute thutah ka hing hil ahi, Tapa in ama thuin bangma abawl thei sih hi. Pa in abawl amute loungal, aziehpen Aman abawl pouma tuate khu Tapa in zong abawl zel hi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen Pain Tapa a it a, asilbawl zousie akungah amusah leng hi, tualeh lamdang na sah dinguh tamte sanga nasep thupizaw amusah ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Pa in mishite akaithou a, ahinsah mabangin, Tapa in zong adeisahte kungah hinna apie hi."},"22":{"text":"Pain koima tungthu akhen pieh sih a, thukhenna zousie Tapa kungah apekheta hi."},"23":{"text":"Pa azatat bang ua mi zousie’n Tapa zong azatat theina dinguh ahi. Tapa zatat lou in, Pa Ama sawlpa zong a zatat sih uhi."},"24":{"text":"Noute thutah ka hing hil ahi, Koipou ka thu za a ahing sawlpa gingta in kumtawn hinna aneita; thukhenna ah alut nawn sih ding a, shina apat hinna ah a lut zawta ahi."},"25":{"text":"“Noute thutah ka hing hil ahi; Mishite’n Pasian Tapa aw azahna ding uh hun hing tung ding ahita, tuin zong atung ahita hi, tualeh aza pouma ahing ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen Pain Ama a hinna akinei bangin Tapa in zong ama a hinna akineina dingin a peta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Mihing Tapa ahizieh in thukhen vaihawmna thuneina zong a pie hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam silte lamdang sa sih un, aziehpen ahun tung ding ahita; khum hun chiengin hankhuh sunga um zousiein a aw aza ding ua,","title":"Thawkiana nite"},"29":{"text":"Tualeh ahing thoudoh ding ua, silhoi bawlte khu kumtawn hinna tangin athou ding ua, tualeh sil gilou bawlte khu siemlou tangin athou ding uhi.","ref":"Dan. 12.2"},"30":{"text":"“Ken ka thuin bangma ka bawl thei sih, ka zah bangin thu ka khen zel a, ka thukhen adih ahi. Aziehpen keima deilam bawl louin, Pa, kei hing sawlpa deilam ka bawl zaw hi."},"31":{"text":"Keima leh keima kitheipi hitaleng, ka thu theipi adih sih ding hi.","title":"Johan theipina"},"32":{"text":"Kei hing theipi midang khat a um hi, tualeh aman ahing theipina thu adih ahi chi ka thei hi."},"33":{"text":"Nouten Johan kungah mi na sawl ua, ama’n thutah tanchin atheipita hi.","title":"Jesu tanchin theipina lite","ref":"Jn. 1.19-27; 3.27-30"},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh mihing akipat theipina ka pom ka china ahi sih a, ahivangin hundam a na um theina ding un, tam silte ka gen ahi."},"35":{"text":"Johan pen meivah kuongpha leh taangpha tah ahi a, tualeh noute ama vah ah tomkhat nopsah na ut uhi."},"36":{"text":"Hinanleh Johan a sanga theipina lien zaw ka nei hi; Pa’n ka sep zou ding ahing pieh ka nasepte mama in, Pain Kei ahing sawl ahi chi ahing theipi hi.","title":"Jesu nasep theipina"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Pa kei hing sawlpa ngel in zong ka tanchin ahing theipi hi. Nouten bangmachihin a aw na za ngai sih ua, a mel zong na mu ngaisih uhi.","ref":"Mat. 3.17; Mak. 1.11; Luk. 3.22"},"38":{"text":"Tualeh athu na lung sung uah na vom sih uhi; Ama ahing sawlpa na gintat lou zieh un."},"39":{"text":"Laisiengthou na hoisim ngel uhi, aziehpen asunga kumtawn hinna nei in na kingaituo uhi, tuate khu keima tanchin theisahna ahi.","title":"Laisiengthou theipina"},"40":{"text":"Hinanleh hinna na neina dingun ka kungah na hing pei nuom sih uhi."},"41":{"text":"Ken mihingte pahtawina ka pom sih hi."},"42":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten Pasian itna na lungsung uah na nei sih uhi, chi ka thei hi."},"43":{"text":"Kei ka Pa min in ka hing pei a, noute’n na hing kipahpi sih uhi.
