Midang khat Ama min in hing pei leh na kipahpi ding uhi."},"44":{"text":"Noute, khat leh khat kipahtawi tuona ngaina a, Pasian khat bou akipat a hing pawt pahtawina sui loute’n bangchin na gingta thei ding uoi?"},"45":{"text":"Pa kunga noute hing heh dingin hing ngaituo sih un; noute hing hehpa khat a um hi, ama khu na gintat uh Mosi ahi."},"46":{"text":"Aziehpen Mosi ana gingta hita u’lachin kei zong na hing gingta ding uhi, aziehpen aman ka tungthu ana giel hi."},"47":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten a thugelte na gintat sih uleh bangchi’n ka thute na gingta thei ding uoi?” achi hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte nuain Jesu Galili tuipi, Tiberia zong kichi gal lamah apeita hi.","title":"Mipi tulnga vahna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman chinate tunga asil lamdang bawlte amu ziehun mipi tampiin Ama azui uhi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu muol tungah akaltou a, tuanah anuazuite toh a tou uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Judate peikan pawi hun a naita hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu adah a, mi tampi akung lam zuon a hing pei amu in Philip kungah, “Tam mite neh ding tanghou hei a lei ding ihiei?” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama’n tam pen Philip ze etna ding a agen ahia, aziehpen Aman bang ahiei abawl ding atheisa ahi."},"7":{"text":"Philip in “Michin in themkhat chiet a atan ding u’zong makhai zani man tanghou kiching nailou ding hi,” chiin adawng hi."},"8":{"text":"Anuazuite lah a khat, Simon Peter sanggampa Andru in akungah,"},"9":{"text":"“Tanah naupang khat barli bu tanghou tun nga leh nga neu nou ni nei a um hi; ahivangin mi hizapi lah a dingin bangtham ahi diei?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n “Mipite tousah un” achi hi. Tua mun ah loupa tampi a pou a, mipite loupa tungah atou ua, atam lam uh tul nga vel ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n tanghoute ala a, kipah thu agen zouin, nuazuite kungah ahawm a, anuazuiten mipi toute kungah ahawm uhi, tuabangmain Ngate zong adeikhop chiet uh ahawm uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n khamtaha aneh nua un, Aman anuazuite kungah, “Bangma amanthai louna dingin khamval nengthemte luoh un,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin aluohkhawm ua, barli bu tanghou tun nga nete khamval nente, aluoh uh seu sawm leh ni adim hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu sillamdang bawl amu un tua mipiten, Tam mipa leitunga guolnei hing pei dingpa ahi tahtah hi, achi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n amauh hing pei a thatang hat a Ama man a kumpipa a bawl ding ahi uh chi athei tahin, Amatangin muol tung lam ah akihemkheta hi.","title":"Jesu tuitunga apeina (Mat. 14.22-23 ; Mak. 6.45-52)"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh nitah lam ahing hitahin anuazuite tuipi lam ah a peisuh ua,"},"17":{"text":"kuong khat ah atuong ua, Kapernaum lam zuon in tui tungah apeita uhi. Tualeh khuo a mielta a Jesu lah akung uah ahing pei nai sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Huipi hattah ahing laan ziehin tuihuol sangpipi in akijawh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n tai thum ahiei, tai li ahiei, a jep nua un Jesu tui tunga akenga pei a, kuong lam hing zuon in amu ua, azau mama uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman akung uah, “Keima ka hi, zau sih un” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun thanuom tahin kuong sung ah a tuongsah ua, tualeh kuong khu azotna gam uh atung paita hi."},"22":{"text":"Azing ni’n tuipi gallang khat a ding mipiten anuazuite tuonna loungal kuong dang a um sih chi leh Jesu anuazuite toh kuongah atuong sih a, anuazuite amauh ngenin apeita uh chi amu uhi.","title":"Jesu’n hinna tanghou ahi dan agenna"},"23":{"text":"Ahivang in Tiberia tuipi akipat in, Mangpa’n kipahthu agen zou a tanghou anehna mun kung ah kuong dang ahing tung uhi."},"24":{"text":"Mipiten tua mun ah Jesu hileh a nuazuite hileh a um nawn sih uh chi athei tahun, ama u’zong kuong neute ah atuong ua, Jesu sui in Kapernaum khuo ahing tung uhi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute’n tuipi gal lang khatlam a Ama amu tah un, akungah, “Rabbi bangchih a tana tung na hiei?” achi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga akung uah, “Noute thutah ka hing hil ahi. Sillamdangte na mu zieh ua hing sui na hi sih ua, hinanleh tanghou na ne ua na gilva zieh ua na hing sui uh ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ann mangthang sui in phiephie sih unlen, Mihing Tapa in ahing pieh ding kumtawn hinna donga umden ding ann sui in phe zaw un. Pa Pasian in Ama tungah chiemtena a akoita hi.”"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, “Pasian nna ka sep theina ding un, bang ahiei ka bawl ding uh?” achi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga akung uah, “Pasian nasep khu tami ahi: Ama mi sawlpa gintat khu,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaun Akung ah, “Ahileh ka mu ua ka hing gintat theina dingun bang chiemtena na hing ensah diei?"},"31":{"text":"Ka pu ka pate un gamdai gamgaw mun ah manna ane uh; Aman van akipat in neh ding tanghou apie, chia kigiel bangin,” achi uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 16.4,15; Late. 78.24"},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Adihtah in ka hing hil ahi, Mosi in tua tanghou van a kipat in ahing pe sih a, hinanleh ka Pain Van a kipat in tanghou dihtah ahing pe zaw hi."},"33":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian tanghou khu van a kipat a hing kumsuh leitung kunga hinna pepa khu ahi,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Amaun akungah, “Mangpa tam tanghou khu koute hing pe ngitnget in,” achi uhi."},"35":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Kei hinna tanghou khu ka hi, koipou ka kunga hing pei agilkiel ngai sih dinga, tualeh koipou kei hing gingta khu adangta ngai sih ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hing hil ahi, Nouten kei hing muta napi in zong na hing gingta sih uhi."},"37":{"text":"Ka pa’n kei ahing pieh zousie ka kungah ahing pei ding, tualeh ka kunga hing pei pouma ka notdoh vawt sih ding."},"38":{"text":"Aziehpen Keima deilam bawl dinga van apata hing peisuh ka hi sih a, ahing sawlpa deilam bawl dinga hing peisuh ka hi zaw hi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Pa kei hing sawlpa deilam khu tami ahi. Aman ahing pieh zousie khatbeh mansuo lou a, hinanleh ni tawp ni chienga kaithou zaw ding in."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh tam khu ahing sawlpa deilam ahi, koipou Tapa mu a gingta in kumtawn hinna anei a, tualeh ken ni tawpni chienga ama ka kaithaw khu ahi.”"},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judate atungah aphun ua, “Kei van a kipat a Tanghou hing kumsuh ka hi” achi zieh in."},"42":{"text":"Amauten “Tam mipa Jesu Joseph tapa hilou amah? Anu leh apa zong ithei uh hilou amah? Van a kipat a hing kumsuh ka hi bangchi dan a achi ahiei?” achi uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jesu’n adawnga, a kung uah “Phun phun sih un."},"44":{"text":"Pa kei hing sawlpa’n ahiip sihleh koima ka kungah ahing pei thei sih hi, tualeh Ken ama ni tawpni chiengin ka kaithou ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Guolneite laibu ah: Pasian in amaute zousie ahil sieng ding, chi gel ahi. Tuaziehin michin Pa thu za a, thei pouma ka kungah ahing pei zel uhi.","ref":"Isai. 54.13"},"46":{"text":"Mi koima’n Pa amu ngai sih, Pasian a kipat a hing peipa loungal in, Ama’n Pa amuta hi."},"47":{"text":"Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, koipou kei hing gingtain kumtawn hinna aneita."},"48":{"text":"Kei hinna tanghou khu ka hi."},"49":{"text":"Na pu na pate un gamdai ah manna ane ua, hinanleh a shi uhi."},"50":{"text":"Tami van a kipat a hing kumsuh mi’n aneh a a shi louna ding uh khu ahi."},"51":{"text":"Kei van a kipat a tanghou hing, hing kumsuh khu ka hi, mi koiin zong tam tanghou aneh leh kumtawnin ahing ding uh, tualeh ka tanghou pieh ding khu leitung pumpi hinna dinga ka pieh ding ka tahsa ahi,” achi hi."},"52":{"text":"Tuaziehin Judate akiniel ua, “Bangchidan a tam Mipa’n atahsa neh dinga pe thei ding ahiei,” achi uhi."},"53":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, Mihing Tapa tahsa na neh ua, tualeh asisan na dawn lou u’leh nouma ah hinna na nei sih uhi."},"54":{"text":"Koipou ka tahsa ne a, tualeh ka sisan dawn in kumtawn hinna aneita; tualeh ken ama khu ni tawpni chiengin ka kaithou ding hi."},"55":{"text":"Aziehpen ka tahsa khu neh ding ann ahi a, ahi tahpi a; tualeh ka sisan zong dawn ding tahpi ahi hi."},"56":{"text":"Koizong ka tahsa ne a, Ka sisan dawn khu Keima ah a um zing a, tualeh kei ama ah ka um zing hi."},"57":{"text":"Pa hingin kei ahing sawl bangin Pa zieha ka hin bangin, tuaziehin koi zong kei hing ne pouma keima zal in ahing ding hi."},"58":{"text":"Tami vanna kipat a hing kumsuh tanghou hing khu ahi; na pu na pate un manna ane ua, ashi bang uh ahisih, koizong tami tanghou ne pouma khu kumtawn in ahing ding,” achi hi."},"59":{"text":"Tam thute khu Jesu’n Kapernaum kikhopna inn a athuhil lai a agen ahi."},"60":{"text":"Tuaziehin anuazuite tampi in tam thu azah tahun, “Tampen thu hasa ahi, koiin atheisiem mawh diei?” achi uhi.","title":"Nuazuite ginlana"},"61":{"text":"Jesu’n tam thu ah anuazuite aphun uh chi alungsima athei tahin, akung uah, “Tam thuin noute ahing sulung nopmaw amah?"},"62":{"text":"Mihing Tapa tu masang a aumna a kaltou mu u’lachin bang na suohta ding uoi le?"},"63":{"text":"Hinna pie khu Hagau ahi, tahsa pen bangma aphatuom sih, na kung ua ka thugente Hagau ahi a, tualeh Hinna zong ahi."},"64":{"text":"Hinanleh na lah uah gingtalou lawikhat na um uhi,” achi hi. Aziehpen Jesu’n achiil akipat a, agingtaloute leh Ama mansah dingpa atheisa ahi."},"65":{"text":"Aman tuaziehin ahi, “Ka Pa’n phalna apieh sih leh koima ka kungah ahing pei thei sih hi, chia na kung ua ka gen,” achi hi."},"66":{"text":"Tua hun a kipat in anuazuite tampi anua peita ua, Ama azui nawn sih uhi."},"67":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n sawm leh nite kungah, “Noute zong na peimang ding uh amah?” achi hi.","title":"Peter in Jesu Khrist agintatna aphuonna"},"68":{"text":"Simon Peter in adawnga akungah, “Mangpa koi kungah ka pei ding uoi? Nangma’n kumtawn hinna thute na nei hi.","ref":"Mat. 16.16; Mak. 8.29; Luk. 9.20"},"69":{"text":"Nang Pasian hing Tapa Khrist khu na hi chi ka gingta ua, thei zong ka thei uhi,” achi hi."},"70":{"text":"Jesu’n amauh adawnga, “Ken nou sawm leh nite ka hing tel hilou na hi uoi mah? Na lah ua mi khat dawimangpa ahi.”"},"71":{"text":"Ama’n Simon tapa, Juda Iskariot thu agenna ahi; ama zong sawmlenite laha tel hinapi Jesu lebawl a mansah dingpa khu ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte nuain Jesu Galili gam sung ah avah kawikawi a; Judate’n tha atup ziehun Judia gam apha nuom ta sih hi.","title":"Jesu sanggamte gintat louna"},"2":{"text":"Judate hampheng pawi ahing naita a,","ref":"Siempu. 23.34; Danp. 16.13"},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin asanggamten akungah, “Tana pat in Judia gam ah pei in, na nuazuiten silbawlte amu theina dingun."},"4":{"text":"Mi koizong zapi theiding a ut leh aguh in sil abawl ngai sih hi. Tam silte na bawl ngal leh leitung pumpi kungah kimusah in” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen asanggamte nangawn in zong ama agingta sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Ka hun atung nai sih hi, hinanleh noute hun pen bangchih laipou a mansa ahi."},"7":{"text":"Noute leitung pumpi in ahing muda thei sih a, Kei pen ahing muda uhi: asilbawl giloute uh ka theisah zieh in."},"8":{"text":"Noute pawi bawlna ah va haw un, Kei pen ka hun atun nailou zieh in tami pawi ah ka haw nai sih ding hi. Ka hun atun bukim nailou zieh in,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam thute agen nua in, Ama Galili gam ah atam nalai hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh asanggamte pawi bawlna ahawtou nua un, Ama zong koima theilouin aguh in ava hawtou hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n pawi bawlna mun ah Judaten Ama asui ua, “Hei a um ahiei?” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Ama tungtangah mipite lah phunna nasatah a umta a; kimkhat in, “Mihoi ahi” achi ua, Midangten “Hoivanhou mipi solgawp ahibou hi,” achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Judate agiin zieh un koiman langtang tahin agen ngam sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh annkuonglui san laitah in Pasian biehinn ah apeitou a, thu ahilta hi.","title":"Annzaluini a Jesu thugen"},"15":{"text":"Judaten lamdang asa ua; “Tam mipa’n zilna neiloupi a bangchidan a lai ahichi thei a hiei?” akichi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Jesu’n amaute adawnga, “Ka thuhilte keima a hing kipan ahi sih a, ahing sawlpa a hing kipan ahi zaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi koipou in Ama deilam bawl ding a utlam ahileh ka thuhilna khu Pasian a kipat ahiei ahisihleh Keima thuneina toh ka gen ahiei, chi athei ding uh."},"18":{"text":"Koipou ama phuohthu thugen pouma ama thupina ding sui ahia, hinanleh Koipou a sawlpa thupina sui mi khu mi dih ahi a, ama ah dihtatlouna mawngmawng a um sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Mosi in noute dan ahing pie hilou ahiei mah? Hinanleh koima’n dan na zui sih uhi. Bangdinga tha dinga hing sui na hi uoi?”"},"20":{"text":"Mipite’n adawng ua, “Dawi lawm nei na hive, koi ahiei nang hing tha sawm?” achi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu’n amaute adawnga, “Sil khat ka bawl a na bawn un lamdang nasa chiet uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mosi in teptan thu ahing pie a, Mosi pieh ahi sih a, na pu napate ua hing kipan ahizaw hi. Tualeh khawlni in mi tep na tan pieh zel uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 12.3; Siem. 17.10"},"23":{"text":"Nouten khawlni a mi tep tan pieh uchin a, Mosi dan botsie na hi tuon sih u’leh, ken khawlni a mi khat ka damsiengsah zieh a bangding a lungthah na hi uoi mah?","ref":"Jn. 5.9"},"24":{"text":"Akilatdan bangin thu khen sih unlen, dihtat tahin thu khen zaw un, achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem akipat mi pawlkhat in, “Tam mipa hilou ahiei mah tha dinga asui uh?"},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh En un, Aman lah hangsan tahin thu akigen a, amaun lah akungah bangma agen sih uhi. Ama khu Khrist ahi chi vaihawmten athei tahtah uh adiei?"},"27":{"text":"Ahivang in eiten lah Tam mipa hei a hing kipan ahiei chi ithei ngal ua, hinanleh Khrist ahing pei chiengin, Ahing kipatna koima’n athei sih ding,” achi uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n biehinn sunga a thu hil laiin ahing kikoukhie a, “Nouten kei na hing thei ua, kang kipatna zong na thei uhi; Keima thu a hing pei ka hi sih a, hinanleh Kei hing sawlpa adih ahi. Nouten Ama na thei sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh ken Ama ka thei hi; aziehpen Ama a pat a hing pei ka hia, tualeh Ama hing sawl ka hi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama mat a tum ua, hinanleh ahun atun nailou ziehin koiman atungah khut aha sih uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh mipi tampi in Ama agingta ua, “Khrist ahing pei chiengin, Tam mipa bawl sanga tamzaw sillamdang abawl tuom diei izaw?” achi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tambanga mipite kidaphou a aphunna uh Pharisaiten aza ua, tualeh Pharisaite leh siempu liente’n Ama man dingin biehinn veng galkapte asawl uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Noute kungah hun tomkhat ka um dinga, tuazou chiengin ahing sawlpa kungah ka pei ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Nouten na hing sui ding ua, na hing mu sih ding uhi, tualeh ka umna ah zong na hing pei thei sih ding uhi,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Judate khat leh khat akihou ua, “I mu lou dinga hei langa pei ding adiei? Greekte lah a kithethang imite lah a va pei a, Greekte thu vahil ding adiei?"},"36":{"text":"Na hing sui ding ua, na hing mu sih ding uh, tualeh ka umna ah noute na hing pei thei sih ding uh, achi khu bang achina adiei?” akichi uhi."},"37":{"text":"Annzalui ni nukhia pen leh thupi pen niin, Jesu adingtou a, akikoukhie a, “Mi koizong adangtah leh ka kungah hing pei henlen, dawn heh.","title":"Jesu’n tui hing agenchienna","ref":"Siempu. 23.36"},"38":{"text":"Koizong kei hing gingta pouma, Laisiengthou gen bangin, asunga kipat in tui hing luite aluongkhe ding,” achi hi.","ref":"Ezek. 47.1; Zek. 14.8"},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh tam thu khu Ama gingtaten amu ding uh Hagau Siengthou agenna ahia, aziehpen Hagau Siengthou pieh ahi nai sih hi, Jesu pahtawi a aum nailou zieh in."},"40":{"text":"Tuaziehin mipite lah a tampite’n tam thu azah tah un, “Tam mipa guolnei tahtah ahi,” achi uhi."},"41":{"text":"Midangte’n lah “Ama Khrist ahi,” achi uhi, hinanleh pawlkhat in “Khrist Galili gam ah ahing pieng diei mah?” achi uhi."},"42":{"text":"Laisiengthou in Khrist khu David hahlesuon a kipat leh David tenna khuo Bethlehema kipat in hing pieng ding ahi, achi hilou amah? achi uhi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.12; Mik. 5.2"},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama ziehin mipite lah ah kikhenna a umta hi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh alah ua pawlkhat in Jesu mat atumta ua, hinanleh koiman atungah khut aha sih uhi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n biehinn veng galkap lamkaite, khu siempute leh Pharisaite kungah ahing pei ua, tualeh amaun akung uah, “Bangdinga Ama hing zawpilou?” ana chi uhi."},"46":{"text":"Biehinn veng galkap lamkaiten, adawng ua, “Tam mipa thugen bangin koiman thu a gen ngai mawngmawng sih,” achi uhi."},"47":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharisaiten “Noute zong sol a um na hita uh maw?"},"48":{"text":"Vaihawm pawlte leh Pharisaite lah ah, Ama gingta a um khata uh amah?"},"49":{"text":"Hinanleh dan theilou tam mipite pen hamse thuoh ahi uh,” achi ua, adawng uhi."},"50":{"text":"Nikodem Janlai a Jesu kunga va hawpa alah ua mi khat a hia, aman akung uah,","ref":"Jn. 3.1,2"},"51":{"text":"“I dan un mi ama kam a thu zah masah leh asilbawlte thei masah masangin siemlou atangsah ngai amah?” achi hi."},"52":{"text":"Amaun adawng ua, akungah, “Nang zong Galili mi na maw leh? Sui inlen, envawi in, Galili gam ah guolnei mawngmawng apieng ngai sih hi,” achi uhi."},"53":{"text":"Tuachi’n michin a inn chiet uah apeita uhi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu Olive muol ah apeita hi.","title":"Numei angkawmlai matna"},"2":{"text":"Zingmawng matah in biehinn ah ahing pei kia a, mi zousie akungah ahing pei ua, tualeh ama atou a, amauh thu ahilta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n laigielmite leh Pharisaiten numei khat angkawmlai amat uh, akungah ahing zawpi ua, alaikim tah uah ading sah ua,"},"4":{"text":"a kungah “Siepa, tam numei a angkawm laitah a kiman ahi."},"5":{"text":"Dan laibu ah Mosi in tambang mi khu suonga selup ding thu ahing pie hi. Hinanleh Nang bangchi ding na chi ei?” achi uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 20.10; Danp. 22.22-24"},"6":{"text":"Tam pen Ama hehna ding amu theina ding ua, aze etna ua agen uh ahi. Hinanleh Jesu akunsuh a, amaute thugen zalou bangin akhutme in lei lah agiel hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuabanga a doh mun seng zieh un, Ahing dahtou a, akung uah, “Na lah ua khelna neilou pen in amanu sep masa heh,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Akunsuh kia a leilah agiel kia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun tam thu azah un, asie leh pha theina un mawpai in, a upa pen a kipat atawp dongin khat khat in apei mang ta ua, Jesu leh alai a ding numeinu maimai anuasieta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu adahdoh tahin, “Numeinu chilou midang koima amuta sih a, akungah, Numei nang hing hehte heia umta uh ahiei? Koiman siemlou hing tangsah lou hi maw?” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Amanu’n “Mangpa koiman siemlou ang tangsah sih,” achi hi. Jesu’n akungah “Ken zong siemlou ka hing tangsah sih hi, pei inlen khiel kia nawn sin,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n akung uah “Kei leitung vah ka hi; kei hing zui pouma miel ah akhohei sih dinga, hinna vah anei zaw ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Jesu leitung khovah ahi","ref":"Mat. 5.14; Jn. 9.5"},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pharisaiten akungah, “Nang leh Nang kitheipi na hi bou hi. Na theipina thu adih sih hi,” achi uhi.","ref":"Jn. 5.31"},"14":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga akung uah, “Kei leh kei kitheipina thu gen hitaleng zong, ka theipina thu adih ahi, aziehpen heisunga hing kipan a heilang pei ding ka hiei chi ka thei hi. Hinanleh nouten ka hing kipatna na thei sih ua, heilang a pei ding ka hiei chi zong na thei sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Nouten tahsa dan in vai na hawm ua, Ken koima tungah vai ka hawm sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Vaihawm pieh na hita leng zong ka vaihawm adih hi; aziehpen kei ngentang ka hi sih a, Kei leh ka Pa ahing sawlpa ka hi zaw uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na dan laibu sung uah zong, mi ni thutheipi khu adih ahi, chi akigiel hi.","ref":"Danp. 19.15"},"18":{"text":"Kei pen keima thutheipi khat ka hi a, tualeh Pa ahing sawlpa’n ka thu ahing theipi ahi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, “Na Pa hei a um ahiei?” achi uhi. Jesu’n adawnga, “Nouten kei lah nang thei sih ua, ka pa zong na thei sih uhi; Kei hing thei u’lachin ka Pa zong theita ding hi ve u’chin,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam thute Jesu’n biehinn huongsunga sillatte koikhawmna mun a athuhil laia agen ahi, tualeh koiman atungah khut aha sih uhi, ahun atun nailou ziehin."},"21":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah agen kia a, “Ka peimang ding a nouten na hing sui ding ua, na khelna uah na shi ding ua, Ka peina ah na hing pei thei sih ding uhi.”","title":"Jesu’n apeimang thu agenlawhna"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judaten “Ama leh Ama kithat ding adiei, ka peina ah na hing pei thei sih ding uh achi ziehin?” akichi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Noute pen nuoi lam a kipan na hi ua, Keipen tunglam a kipan ka hi; Noute tam leitunga na hi ua, Keipen tam leitunga ka hi sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin na kung uah, Na khelna uah na shi ding uh, aziehpen Kei ama ka hi chi na gintat sih u’leh, na khelna uah na shi ding uh, ka chi ahi,” a chi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, “Nang koi na hiei?” achi uhi. Jesu’n akung uah, “Achiil a na kung ua ka gen mama khu ka hi, achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Na tungtang thu uah gen ding leh vaihawmna ding tampi ka nei hi; hinanleh ahing sawlpa pen adih ahi, Ama apata ka zahte leitung mi zousie kungah ka gen zel hi,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Aman Pa thu amaute kunga agen ahi chi athei sih uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Mihing Tapa na khaikang zou chiengun, Kei ama ka hi chi leh. Keima thuin bangma ka bawl sih a, hinanleh ka Pa’n ahing hil bangin tam thute ka gen zaw ahi, chi na thei ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ama kei hing sawlpa ka kung ah a um hi. Pain Kei ngentangin ahing nuasie sih hi, Ama kipahnalam silte ka bawl ngitnget ziehin,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tam thute agen lai in mi tampi in Ama agingta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n Ama gingta Judate kungah, “Ka thu a na um zing u’leh ka nuazuite na hi tahtah uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh thutah na thei ding ua, tua thutah in noute ahing suohtasah ding hi,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Amaun adawng ua, “Koute Abraham hahlesuonte ka hi ua, koima suoh leh sal in ka taang ngai sih uhi; bangchidan a noute suotatsah na hi ding uh, na hingchi ahiei?” achi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 3.9; Luk. 3.8"},"34":{"text":"Jesu’n amauh adawnga, “Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, Koizong khelna bawl pouma khelna suoh ahi."},"35":{"text":"Suoh pen kumtawnin inn ah a umden sih a, hinanleh tapa pen kumtawn in a umden hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuaziehin Tapa in ahing suotatsah leh na suohta tahtah ding uhi."},"37":{"text":"Abraham hahlesuonte na hi uh chi ka hing thei hi; hinanleh nouten kei tha na hing tum uhi, ka thu nouma lungsim a a umlou ziehin."},"38":{"text":"Ken ka Pa kunga ka mute ka gen a, nouten na pa uh kunga na mute uh na bawl uhi,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Amauten adawng ua akungah, “Abraham ka Pa uh ahi,” achi uhi. Jesu’n akung uah “Abraham tate hi u’lachin Abraham nasepte na sem ding uhi."},"40":{"text":"Hinanleh tu in Kei Pasian kunga kipata ka zah thutah hing hilpa tha na hing tum uhi. Abraham in tambangin abawl sih hi."},"41":{"text":"Nouten na pa uh silbawlte na bawl uh ahi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amaun akungah, “Koute zawlta ka hi sih uhi. Pa khat ka nei uh, tuakhu Pasian,” ahi achi uhi."},"42":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Pasian na Pa uh hileh kei na hing itta ding uhi, aziehpen Pasian a kipat a hing pei ka hi a, Keima thu a hing pei ka hi sih a, Ama sawl ka hi zaw hi."},"43":{"text":"Bangchidan a ka thugen theisiemlou na hi uoi? Ka thugen na pom theilou zieh uh ahi."},"44":{"text":"Noute na pa uh dawimangpa a na hi ua, na pa uh deilam na bawl uhi. Ama khu achiil a kipata tuolthatpa ahia, ama thutah ah aumlou ziehin thutah ah ading sih hi. Zuou agen lezong ama a um khu agen ahia, aziehpen ama zuoutheipa ahia, tualeh zuouna pa zong ahi."},"45":{"text":"Thutah ka gen ziehin nouten na hing gingta sih uhi."},"46":{"text":"Na lah uah koi ahiei khelna thu a siemlou hing tangsah? Thutah ka gen leh bangdinga hing gingta lou na hi uoi?"},"47":{"text":"Pasian a kipan mi in, Pasian thute angaikhie hi. Tuaziehin Pasian a kipat na hi lou zieh un, Ama thu na ngaikhe nuom sih uhi,” achi hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judaten a dawng ua akungah, “Nang Samari mi na hi a, dawi zawl na hi ka hing chi uh, ka chi dih mama uh hilou ahiei amah?” achi uhi."},"49":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga “Kei dawi zawl ka hi sih a, Ka Pa ka pahtawi ahi zaw, nouten kei na hing pahtawi sih uhi."},"50":{"text":"Ken keima thupina ka sui sih a, vaihawmna sui mi khat a um hi."},"51":{"text":"Chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, mi koipouin ka thu azui leh shina achiem kha ngai sih ding,” achi hi."},"52":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judaten akungah, “Tuinvang dawi zawl na hi chi ka hing theita uh, Abraham ashita a, guolneite zong ashita uh, hinanleh Nang, mi’n ka thu azui leh shina achiem kha ngai sih ding na chi hi!"},"53":{"text":"Ashisa ka pu uh Abraham sangin Nang na thupi zaw amah? Guolneite lah ashita uh; Nang leh nang koi a hing kibawl na hiei?” achi uhi."},"54":{"text":"Jesu’n “Kei leh Kei kipahtawi hitaleng, ka kipah tawina bangma ahi sih ding, ahing pahtawi khu ka Pa, nouten Ka Pasian uh ahi na chipa uh ahi."},"55":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten Ama na thei sih ua, ken Ama ka thei hi. Ama ka thei sih chileng noute banga mi zuou ka hita ding hi, hinanleh Ama ka thei tahtah a, athu zong ka zui hi."},"56":{"text":"Na pu uh Abraham in ka ni mu ding anuom mama a, amuta ngei a, akipah mama hi,” achi hi."},"57":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judaten akungah, “Nang kum sawmnga zong ching nailouin Abraham na mu khata amah?” achi uhi."},"58":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, Abraham um masangin ka umta hi,” achi hi."},"59":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten asena dingin suong ala ua, hinanleh Jesu akiphuol a, biehinn a pat apawtkhie a, alah ua peisuoh in apeita hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu lampi a apei laiin, apien apat mitto khat amu hi.","title":"Apien apat mitto suhdamna"},"2":{"text":"Anuazuiten akungah, “Siepa tam mipa mittosa a apien, koi khelna ahiei? Ama khiel ahiei, ahisihleh anu leh apa’n?” chiin adong uhi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, “Tam mipa lah akhiel sih a, anu leh apa’n zong akhiel sih uhi, hinanleh Pasian nasepte ama tunga akilat na dinga tam sil tung ahi zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Sun ahilaiin Ama kei hing sawlpa na ka sep ngeingei ding ahi; zan hing tung ding ahita, khum hun chiengin koima’n na asem thei sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Leitunga ka um sungteng, leitung adingin vah ka hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 5.14; Jn. 8.12"},"6":{"text":"Tam silte agen zouin, lei ah achil asie a, achil in tungman abawl a, tua tungmanin mitto pa mitte anu a,"},"7":{"text":"Mittopa kungah, “Pei inlen Siloam dil ah vasil in” achi hi. (Siloam khu sawl china ahi.) Tuachi’n apei a avasilta a, mitvah in ahing kilekiata hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin a innvengte leh masang lai a amittot lai na musaten, “Tam mipa khutdaw a touzelpa hilou amah?” achi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Pawlkhatte’n “Ama ahina hi” achi ua, pawl dangten “Hilaizang sih akisutpi hibou” achi uhi, hinanleh amapa’n, “Kei ama ka hi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaun akungah, “Na mitte bang hing chi vah ahiei?” achi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aman adawnga, “Jesu kichi mi khat in tungman abawl a ka mitte ahing nu pieh a, ka kungah Siloam dil ah pei inlen vasil in, ahingchi a, tuachi’n ka pei a, ka sil a, tuachi’n ka mu thei ta hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, “Ama hei ah a um ei “achi ua; Aman “Ka thei sih,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaun masang lai a mittopa khu Pharisaite kungah ahing zawpi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Jesu’n tungman abawla amit avahsah ni khu khawlni ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pharisaiten zong amitte hing vah dan akungah adong kia uhi. Aman akung uah, “Ka mit ah tungman anu a, ka vasil a, tuachi’n ka muta hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pharisaite Pawlkhat in, “Tam mipa Pasian a pat a hing kipan ahi sih, aziehpen khawlni atang sih hi,” achi uhi. Midangte’n “Bangchidan in mi khiel in tambang sillamdang abawl thei diei?” achi ua, tuachi’n alah uah kikhenna a umta hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaun mittopa kungah, “Na mit hing vahsahpa tungtang ah nang Ama bangchi mi hiva” na chi ei? Nang mit hiven avahsah, achi uhi. Aman “Guolnei hiva,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Judaten amit hing vahpa nu leh pa ahat masangsie uh, tua mipa mittosa a pieng ahia, tu a khuo hing muthei ahi, chi atungtang thu agingta sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh amaun anule pa kungah, “Tam mipa na tapa uh mittosa a pieng na chipa uh ahi nai mah? Bangchidan a tua hing mu theita ahiei?” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Anu leh paten amauh adawng ua, “Tam mipa ka tapa uh ahi a, mittosa a pieng ahi chi ka thei uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh bangchidan a tu a khuo hing muthei ahiei, ahisihleh koi ahiei amit suhvahpieh chivang ka thei sih uhi. Ama dongun, mi piching ahita, ama tungthu kigen thei ahita,” achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Mittopa nulepaten tambanga thu agen u’khu Judate agiin zieh uh ahi; aziehpen koizong Ama Khrist ahi chi a gen pouma kikhopna inn apata nawdoh ding ahi chiin Judaten kithukimna khat aneisa uh ahi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin ahi anulepate’n mi piching ahita, “Ama dongun,” achi uh."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten mittopa khu ahan kia ua, akungah, “Thupina Pasian pie in, kouten tam mipa mikhiel ahi chi ka thei uhi,” achi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Aman adawnga, “Mikhiel ahileh hilou ka thei sih, sil khat ka thei hi, mitto kana hi a, tuin ka mu theita hi,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun akungah, “Aman na tunga bang ahiei abawl? Na mit bang ahing chi suhvahpieh ahiei?” achi kia uhi."},"27":{"text":"Aman “Ka hing hil zouta hi, na ngai nuom sih uhi. Bangdinga na zah ut kia uh ahiei? Nou zong anuazui hi na ut uh amah?” chiin adawng hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama aphawh ua, “Nang Ama nuazui na hi a, Koute pen Mosi nuazui ka hi uh."},"29":{"text":"Pasian in Mosi kungah, thu agen chi ka thei uh, Tam mipa ahileh hei a hing kipan a hing pei ahiei chi ka thei sih uh,” achi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Amapa’n adawnga, akung uah, “Tami ahi vele alamdanna! Hei a hing kipan ahiei na theilou uh, hinapi a, Aman lah ka mit ahing suhvah pieh hi!"},"31":{"text":"Pasian in mikhielte thu angaikhe sih chi ithei uhi, hinanleh mi koizong Pasian bieh ngaisah a adeilam bawl mi khu angaikhie hi."},"32":{"text":"Leitung pien chiil akipat in mittosa a pieng mitte akisuhvah pieh chi koiman aza ngai sih."},"33":{"text":"Tam mipa. Pasian a hing kipan hisih leh bangma abawl thei sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Amaun adawng ua, akungah, “Nang khelna bukim apieng in koute na hing hil ngam viel maw?” achi ua; ama anotdohta uhi."},"35":{"text":"Jesu’n tua mipa anotdoh uh chi aza a, tualeh ama amu tahin, akungah, “Pasian Tapa na gingta ei?” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Aman adawnga akungah, “Mangpa Ama koi ahiei? Ka gintat theina dingin,” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Ama na muta a, nang hing houpipa ahi,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuabepin aman “Mangpa ka gingta hi,” achi a, Ama abeta hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n “Mu theilouten ahing mutheina ding u’leh, mitvahte mit ahing tawt theina dinga vaihawm dingin leitunga hing pei ka hi,” achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Akunga um Pharisai pawlkhatten tam thute azah tahun, akungah, “Koute zong mitto ka hi uoi mah?” achi uhi."},"41":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Mitto hi u’lachin khelna neilou ding hi ve uchin, hinanleh tuin mu thei na kichi ua, tuaziehin na khelna uh a umden hi,” achi hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, koipou kotpi a lut lou a lam tuom a kal a belam huonga lut khu guta leh suomhat ahi.","title":"Belam chingpa hoi"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh koipou kotpi alut khu belampu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ama khu kotpi vengpa’n ana honpieh a, belamten a aw aza uhi, tualeh aman abelam khu amin un ahan a, amauh apuidoh zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n abelamte apuidoh chiengin amasang uah apei a, belamten anua azui uhi; a aw athei zieh un."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh midang pen azui sih ding ua, ataimangsan zaw ding uh, aziehpen mi dang aw aza thei sih uhi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Jesu’n tambang gentena thu zangin thu ahem gen a, hinanleh amaun akung ua bang thu ahiei agen atheisiem sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah agenkia a, “Chitahtahin na kung uah ka gen ahi, kei belam kotpi khu ka hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka masanga hing pei zousie khu gutate leh suomhatte ahi uh, hinanleh belamten athu uh angai sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Kei kotpi khu ka hi, Koipou keima a alut leh hundam in a um dinga, tualeh lut in apawt dinga, neh ding amu ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Guta khu gu ding leh that ding leh suse ding loungal in ahing pei sih, Kei pen amaun hinna anei na ding u’leh, kiningching tah a aneina ding ua hing pei ka hi."},"11":{"text":"Kei belamchingpa hoi ka hi, belampu hoiin belamte dingin ahinna apie hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh nehthalaw, belamchingpa dihtah hilou, belamte ama a hilou mi in, ngie hing pei amu chiengin belamte anuasie a ataisan leng hi, tualeh ngiein belamte aman a adelzah zel hi."},"13":{"text":"Nehthalaw ahiziehin belamte awlmawna anei sih a, ataimangsan zel hi."},"14":{"text":"Kei belamchingpa hoi ka hi, Ka belamte ka thei a, ka belamten kei ang thei uhi.","ref":"Mat. 11.27; Luk. 10.22"},"15":{"text":"Pain kei ahing thei bangin, Ken zong Pa ka thei hi, tualeh belamte a dingin ka hinna ka pie hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh tam belam huong a hilou, belam dang zong ka nei hi, amauh zong ka hing pui dinga, ka aw aza ding uhi; tuachi’n belamchingpa toh hon khat in aum ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka Pain Kei ahing it hi, lah kia dinga ka hinna ka pieh zieh in."},"18":{"text":"Koiman ka hinna ahing lahpieh ahi sih a, keima thu a ka pieh ahi zaw hi. Pieh theina leh lahkia theina thuneina ka nei hi. Tam thupieh ka pa apat ka mu ahi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin tam thute ziehin Judate lah ah kikhenna a um kia ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh alah ua tampi in “Dawi lawm ahi, amo ahi, Bangdinga athu na ngaikhieh uh ahiei?” achi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Adangten, “Tam thute dawi lawm nei mi thugen ahi sih, dawi in mittote mitte avah sah thei amah?” achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem a kipumpiehna pawi hun lai ahia, Phalbi lai ahi.","title":"Jerusalem ah Jesu anuol uh"},"23":{"text":"Jesu khu biehinn huong Solomon innliep ah aviel vah kawikawi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Judate akim ah ahing kikhawm ua, akungah, “Bangtan vei lungnawngkai a hing koi ding na hiei? Khrist na hileh, chientahin hing hil in,” achi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Jesu’n amauh adawnga, “Ka hing hilta a, na tahsang sih uhi; Ka Pa min a ka sil lamdang bawlte’n ka khantan ahing theipi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh na kung ua ka gen tah mabangin ka belamte na hilou ziehun na gingta sih uhi."},"27":{"text":"Ka belamte’n ka aw aza ua, ken amauh ka thei hi, tualeh amaun ahing zui uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh ken kumtawn hinna ka pie hi; kumtawnin amangthai sih ding ua, koiman ka khut apat ahing lahpieh thei sih ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Ka pa amauh hing pepa mi zousie sangin athupizaw hi; Koima’n ka Pa khut apat ahing lahpieh zou sih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Kei leh Ka Pa khat ka hi uh,” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judate’n asena dingin suong ala kia uhi."},"32":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Ken ka Pa akipat nasep hoi tampi noute ka hing musahta hi. Tuate laha hei pen zieh a, suonga hing se sawm na hi uoi?” achi a, adawng hi."},"33":{"text":"Judaten adawng ua, “Nasep hoi ziehin suonga se ka hing tum sih ua, hinanleh Pasian na gensiet zieh leh Nang mihing hi ngal a, Pasian banga na kibawl zieh ahi zaw hi,” achi uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 24.16"},"34":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Na dan laibu sung uah, noute pasiente na hi uh ka hing chi hi, chi akigiel asiei mah?","ref":"Late. 82.6"},"35":{"text":"Pasian thu tunnate nangawn pasiente na hi uh chi ahileh, Laisiengthou thu lah suhsiet ahi sih hi."},"36":{"text":"Ken Pasian tapa ka hi kachi zieh a, Pain asuh siengthou a, leitunga a Sawlpa tunga Pasian gensie na hing chi uh ahi maw?"},"37":{"text":"Ka Pa nate semlou ka hileh hing gingta sih un."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh ana ka sep ahileh, kei hing gingta sih nan u’lachin zong, na kisemte beh gingta un, Pa keima ah a um a, Kei Ama ah ka um chi na thei ua, na gintat theina ding un,” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ama mat atum kia ua, hinanleh akhut ua pat asuohta hi."},"40":{"text":"Johan in achiil a baptisma abawlna mun Jordan gal ah apei kiata a, khunah ava umta hi.","ref":"Jn. 1.28"},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi tampi akungah ahing pei ua, “Johan in sillamdang bangma bawl anei sih a, hinanleh Tam mipa tungtang Johan in agen zousie adih kim hi,” achi uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh khunah mi tampi in Ama agingta uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lazar kichi mi khat achi ana hi. Ama Mari leh asanggamnu Martha tenna Bethani khuo mi ahi.","title":"Lazar kaithawna","ref":"Luk. 10.38,39"},"2":{"text":"Asanggampa Lazar china nu khu Mangpa thaunamtui nu asam a akeng siapiehnu Mari khu ahi.","ref":"Jn. 12.3"},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin asanggamnuten Jesu kungah, “Mangpa Ngai vawi, na itpa achi ana hi,” chiin mi asawl uhi."},"4":{"text":"Jesu’n tua thu azah tahin, “Tam natna pen shina khop hiel ahisih a, hinanleh Tami zieh a Pasian Tapa’n pahtawina atan theina dinga, Pasian thupina ding ahi zaw hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Jesu’n Martha leh asanggamnu leh Lazar a it a,"},"6":{"text":"Lazar chinat azah nuain ni ni dang a um na ah ataam nalai hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuazouin anuazuite kungah, “Judia gam ah pei kia vai” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Nuazuiten akungah, “Siepa masang zepin Judaten suongin ahing se sawm ua, nang khuna haw sawm kia na hiei mah?” achi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga “Sun hun sungin naikal sawm leh ni a um hilou ahiei mah? Mi koizong suntang lai a avah chiengin akisuipua ngai sih a leitung vannuoi vah amu zieh un."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh mi koizong zanlai a avah chiengin akisuipua leng uhi, ama a vah aumlou ziehin,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Aman tam thute agen a tua zouin akung uah, “I lawmpa uh Lazar a imuta, ama phawng dingin ka va pei ding hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n anuazuiten “Mangpa imu ahileh hing dam kia nava maw?” achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amabou Jesu’n ashi thu agenna ahi a, amaun imu a khawldam agenna hiva chiin angaisut uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, chientah in agen a “Lazar ashita, achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Na gintat theina ding ua, khuna ka umkhah lou, noute ziehin ka kipah hi. Hinanleh akungah va haw vai,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Thomas Didum kichipain anuazuipite kungah, “Eite zong Ama toh ishikhawm theina dingun vahaw va ui,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu ahing tun in Lazar hankhuh sung ah ni li ana umta chi athei hi."},"18":{"text":"Bethani khuo pen Jerusalem khuo kung nai a um Kilometer thum vel a gamla ahi."},"19":{"text":"Judate tampi Martha leh Mari kungah, asanggampa uh shina tunga henem dingin ahing pei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Martha khu Jesu ahing pei chi azah tahin ava pei a, Jesu ava lamdawn a, hinanleh Mari pen innsungah atou nalai hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Martha in Jesu kungah, “Mangpa tana um hilachin ka sanggampa shilou ma ding hiven,"},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin zong Pasian kunga na nget pouma Pasian in ahing pe ding, chi ka thei hi,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesu’n amanu kungah, “Na sanggampa athoukia ding hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Martha in akungah, “Ni tawpni chienga thawkiana ah athoukia ding chi ka thei hi,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Kei thawkiana leh hinna ka hi, koizong kei hing gingta khu shinanleh ahing ding,"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh koipou hing a hing gingta pouma ashi ngai nawn sih ding hi, tami na gingta ei,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Amanu’n akungah, “Hina, Mangpa Nang Khrist, Pasian Tapa, leitunga hing pei dingpa khu na hi chi ka gingta hi,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Amanu’n tamte agen zouin apei a, asanggamnu Mari aguhin ahan a, “Siepa ahing tunga, nang ahing han hi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Mari in tam thu azah tahin kintah in adingdoh a, Jesu kungah ahing pei hi."},"30":{"text":"Jesu pen khosung ahing lut nai sih a, Martha in ava lamdotna mun ah a um nalai hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judate, inn sunga amanu henem a, amanu toh umten, Mari kintah a dingdoh a pawtdoh amu un anua azui ua, han a kap dinga va pei ding hiva achi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mari Jesu umna mun ahing tunga Jesu amu tahin akengbul ah apuasuh a, akungah “Mangpa, Tana um hilachin ka sanggampa shilou ding hima ven,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Jesu’n Mari kap leh ama toh hing zawhkhawm Judate kap a um amuin lungsim in athum a, tualeh amangbang hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh “Ama hei ah na siel uoi?” achi hi. Amauten akungah, “Mangpa hing pei inlen en in,” achi uhi."},"35":{"text":"Jesu a kapta."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judate’n “En vawi ua, it hina va-ia!” achi uhi."},"37":{"text":"Pawlkhat in “Tam mittopa mitte vahsahpa’n Lazar zong shilou a koi theilou adiei,” achi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jesu alungsim a thum kawm in han ah ahing pei a, han khu kokhuh ahia, han kot khu suonga kisin ahi."},"39":{"text":"Jesu’n “Asuong hemkhie un,” achi hi. Mishipa sanggamnu Martha in, akungah, “Mangpa tuin vang uita va, ashina ni li aphata hi,” achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Jesu’n amanu kungah, “Na gintat a ahileh Pasian thupina na mu ding, na kungah ka chisih amah?” achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun han kotkhana suong ahemkhie ua, tualeh Jesu avandah a, “Pa aw ka thu na ngaikhieh ziehin ka kipah hi;"},"42":{"text":"Tualeh na hing ngaikhe ngitnget chi zong ka thei hi, hinanleh ka kiim a ding mipite ziehin tami ka gen ahi, Nangman na hing sawl ahi chi agintat theina ding un,” achi hi."},"43":{"text":"Tam thute agen zouin, Aw ngaitahin akikoukhie a, “Lazar hing pawtdohin,” achi hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n mishi khu akhut akeng han puon a kituomsa in ahing pawtdoh a, amai zong puon in akituom hi. Jesu’n amaute kungah “Phel unlen pei sah un,” achi hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mari kunga hing haw a Jesu sillamdang bawl mu Judate tampi in Jesu agingta ta uhi.","title":"Pharisaiten Jesu tha atum uh"},"46":{"text":"Hinanleh pawlkhatte Pharisaite kungah apei ua, Jesu silbawlte ava hil uhi."},"47":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu liente leh Pharisaite’n vaihawmte ahankhawm ua; “Bang ilawta diei? Tam mipa’n sillamdang tampi abawl hi."},"48":{"text":"Tambanga ihazan u’leh mi zousiein, Ama agingta ding ua, tualeh Romemite ahing pei ding ua, igam leh inamte ahing lahpieh ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"49":{"text":"Tualeh amaute lah a mi khat, tuami kum a siempu lien Kaiapha achipa un akung uah, “Bangma thei sih uteh;"},"50":{"text":"Inam pumpi amanthai louna dinga mipi taang a mi khat ashi eite dingin ahoizaw chi zong na ngaituo sih uhi,” achi hi."},"51":{"text":"Tami aman ama phuothu agen ahisih a, tua kum a siempu lien ahi a, Juda namte tanga Jesu ashi ding agenlawhna ahi,"},"52":{"text":"Tualeh tua namte bep hilouin, Pasian ta kithethangte zousie pawlkhat a apuikhawm theina ding zong ahi."},"53":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua ni akipat in Ama tha ding dan ngaituo in akihou zingta uhi."},"54":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jesu Judate lah ah alangtangin avah nawn sih a, tuana kipat in gamdai nai lam ah Ephraim kichi khopi khat ah apei a, tuanah anuazuite toh a umta hi."},"55":{"text":"Tualeh Judate peikan pawi ahing naita a, tuami masanga kisiensuo dingin mi tampite gam sung lam a kipat in Jerusalem ah ahing pei uhi."},"56":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun Jesu asui ua, biehinn huong sungah ding kawm in akihou ua, “Bangchin na ngaisut uoi? Peikan pawi a hing hawlou ding adiei?” akichi uhi."},"57":{"text":"Siempu liente leh Pharisaiten mi koizong a umna thei aumleh Ama amat theina ding ua, amaute hil pai dingin thupieh khat ana bawl zouta uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n peikan pawi na ding ni guh masangin, shina akipata akaithawpa Lazar tenna Bethani khuo ah, Jesu ahing haw hi.","title":"Bethani a Mari in Jesu sathau namtui anuna (Mat. 26.6-12 ; Mak. 14.3-9)"},"2":{"text":"Tuanah Ama a dingin nitah ann abawl ua, Martha in ann apie a, Lazar pen Ama toh annkuong impite lah a khat ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mari in Spikenard thau namtui man tamtah buh khat ahing tawi a, Jesu kengphang anu a asamin anawtpieh hi. Tua sathau namtui in inn sung pumpi azel suoh hi.","ref":"Luk. 7.37,38"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n nuazuite lah a khat, Ama man sah dingpa Simon tapa Juda Iskariot in,"},"5":{"text":"“Bangdinga tami sathau gimnamtui makhai za thum a zua a mi zawngte kunga kipe lou ahiei?” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman mi zawngte akhotuo zieha tam thu agen ahisih a, ama guta ahia, dangka ip akem a, asung a kikoite alahdoh zel zieh a agen ahi zaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n “Amanu subuoi da un, amanu’n tami ka kivui ni a dinga akoi ahi."},"8":{"text":"Mi zawngte pen na kung ua um ngitnget ding ahi uh, hinanleh kei pen noute kunga ka um ngitnget sih ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 15.11"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judate tampi in Jesu tuanah aum chi atheita ua, Jesu zieh bep hilouin shina apat akaithaw Lazar zong amu nuom ziehun, ahing pei khawm uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh siempu lienten Lazar zong atha theina ding dan uh akikum uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Lazar ziehin Judate tampi in amaute nuasie in Jesu agingta ta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Azing ni in annzaluina a hing pei mi tampi in, Jesu Jerusalem a hing haw ding ahi chi ana za uhi.","title":"Jesu Jerusalema guolzou a alutna (Mat. 21.1-9 ; Mak. 11.1-10 ; Luk. 19.2-38)"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n tum nate atawi ua, Ama lamdawn dingin apawtdoh ua, “Hosanna! Mangpa min a hing pei, Israel kumpipa, ahampha hi,” chiin akikou uhi.","ref":"Late. 118.25,26"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n sabiltung nou khat amu a atungah atuong hi."},"15":{"text":"“Zion tanu aw zau sin, En vawi, na kumpipa, sabiltungnou tunga tuongin ahing pei hi,” chia kigiel bangin.","ref":"Zek. 9.9"},"16":{"text":"Tam silte achiil in nuazuiten atheisiem sih uhi; hinanleh Jesu pahtawi a aum nua in, tam thute Ama tungtanga kigiel ahi a, tualeh atunga tam silte abawl uh ahi, chi ahing theidohta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin han a pat Lazar ahatdoh leh shina akipata akaithaw lai a akunga umten a thu atheipita uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tam thute ziehin mipiten zong, tam chiemtena sillamdang abawl chi azah ziehun, Ama ana lamdot uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pharisaite akihou ua, “En un! bangma na law thei sih uhi chi na mu uoi? En un leitung pumpiin Ama azuita” achi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh annzaluina a hing hawte lah ah Greekmi koite ahiei a um uhi.","title":"Greek mi koite ahiei in Jesu amu tupna uh"},"21":{"text":"Amaute khu Galili gam a Bethsaida khuo a um Philip kungah ahing haw ua, “Pu Jesu ka mu nuom uhi” chiin ahing ngen uhi."},"22":{"text":"Philip apei a Andru ava hil a, tualeh Philip leh Andru in Jesu ahil uhi."},"23":{"text":"Jesu’n amauh adawnga, “Mihing Tapa pahtawi a a umna ding hun atungta hi."},"24":{"text":"Chitahtahin na kung uah ka gen ahi, Butang khat lei a akieh a, ashi sih leh, ama tangin a umden a hinanleh ashi chiengin ga tampi ahing suong hi."},"25":{"text":"Koipou ahinna it in ataan dinga, tualeh koipou tam leitunga ahinna huoin kumtawn hinna dongin ahumbit ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.39; 16.25; Mak. 8.35; Luk. 9.24; 17.33"},"26":{"text":"Koipouin ka nna asep leh hing zui heh, tualeh ka umna ah ka nasempa zong a um ding hi. Mi koipou in ka nna asep leh ka Pain ama akipahpi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"“Tuin ka lunggim mama hi, bang ahiei ka gen ding? Pa aw tambang hun akipat hing hundam in, chi ding ka diei? Hinanleh tami ding zieh a tam hun ahing pei ka hi thuoi a.","title":"Jesu shi ding genlawhna"},"28":{"text":"Pa na min pahtawi in,” achi hi. Tuachi’n van apat in aw khat ahing ginga, “Ka pahtawita, ka pahtawi kia ding hi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaziehin akunga dinga, tua thu zaten van ging ahi, achi ua, adangten lah “Vansawlsiengten Ama ahoupi ahi,” achi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, “Tam aw pen kei dinga hing ging ahi sih a, noute a dinga hing ging ahizaw hi, achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tu khu tam leitung vaihawm hun ahi a, tuin tam leitung vaihawmpa paikhiet ahi ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh kei leitung apat khaikanga ka um chiengin mi zousie keima lam ah ka hip ding hi,” achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tam pen Aman bangchibang shinain ahiei ashi ding chi theisahna a agen ahi."},"34":{"text":"Mipiten Ama adawng ua, “Khrist khu kumtawn a umden ahi, chiin Dan laibu sunga pat kouten ka za uhi, bangchidan a Nang, Mihing Tapa khaikanga um ding ahi, na chi ahiei?” achi uhi.","ref":"Late. 110.4; Isai. 9.7; Ezek. 37.25; Dan. 7.14"},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n a kung uah, “Vah khu na lah uah hun tomkhat a um nalai ding hi. Vah na nei sungun kalsuon un, tuachilouin miel in ahing lap kha ding hi, koipou miel lah a vahin hei a pei ahiei chi a thei sih hi."},"36":{"text":"Vah na nei sungun vah khu gingta un, vah tate na hing hi theina dingun, achi hi. Jesu’n tam thute agen zouin apawt doh a, ama ua pat akibuta hi.”"},"37":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute mitmu ah sillamdang tampi bawl nanleh Ama agingta tuom sih uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tam pen guolnei Isai in ana genlawh atangtunna ding ahi Aman: “Mangpa ka thu tutte uh, koi ahiei gingta? Mangpa khut zong koi kungah ahiei akilat?” ana chi hi.","ref":"Isai. 53.1"},"39":{"text":"Tuaziehin agingta thei sih uhi aziehpen Isai in:"},"40":{"text":"“Aman a mitte uh atosah a, alungtangte uh a khausah hi; tuachilou in amitte un amu kha ding ua, tualeh alungtang ua theisiem in, Kei lam ah ahing kihei ding ua, ken kana sudam kha ding hi,” achi kia hi.","ref":"Isai. 6.10"},"41":{"text":"Tam thute pen Isai in Athupina amu lai a agen ahi a, tualeh a tungtang thu agenna ahi."},"42":{"text":"Ahivang in vaihawm lamkaite lah nangawn ah, mitampiin Ama agingta ua, hinanleh Pharisaite agiin ziehun, Ama agintatna uh agendoh ngam sih uhi, tuachilouin pen kikhopna inn apat in nawsuoin a um kha ding uhi."},"43":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun Pasian patat a um sangin mihingte pahtat a um a dei zaw uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu akikoukhie a “Koipou kei hing gingta khu, kei hing gingta ahisih a, Kei hing sawlpa gingta ahi zaw hi."},"45":{"text":"Koizong Kei hing mu khu ahing sawlpa mu ahi."},"46":{"text":"Kei leitung vah dinga hing pei ka hi, koipou ahing gingta khu miel a aumden louna ding in."},"47":{"text":"Mi koiinzong ka thugente zain gingta sih nanleh ken ama mawsah dingin thu ka khen sih hi, aziehpen leitung thukhen a, mawsah dinga hing pei ka hisih a, leitung hundam dinga hing pei ka hizaw hi."},"48":{"text":"Mi koiinzong kei hing nuol a, ka thugente apom sih leh, ama tunga thukhen ding khat anei hi, ka thugente mama in ni tawpni chiengin ama siemlou atangsah ding hi."},"49":{"text":"Aziehpen keima phuothuin thu ka gen sih a, hinanleh Pa kei hing sawlpa’n, ka gen ding leh ka hil ding thu ahing pie hi."},"50":{"text":"Athupieh khu kumtawn hinna ahi chi ka thei hi; tuaziehin ka gen pouma khu Pa in ka kunga agen bangbanga ka gen ahi,” achi hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Peikaan pawi akipat masangin, Jesu’n tam leitung nuasie a, Pa kunga apei hun atungta chi athei hi. Leitunga um ama ate a it a, atawp dongin a amauh a it hi.","title":"Nuazuite keng asilpiehna"},"2":{"text":"Nitah ann aneh lai un dawimangpa’n Simon tapa Juda Iskariot lungtangah Jesu matsah ding angaituosah zouta hi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu’n Pain sil zousie akhut ah apeta chi leh, Pasian akipat a hing pei a, Pasian kunga pei kia ding ahidan athei hi."},"4":{"text":"Nitah ann ne lai adingdoh a, apuonsilte akoikhie a, kinawtna puon ala a, ateng hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh kisilna kuonga tui asun zouin nuazuite keng asil pieh a, kinawtna puon atenin a nawt hul pieh zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Simon Peter kunga a hing pei tahin, Peter in akungah, “Mangpa Nang ka kengte sil talawm ding na mah?” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, akungah, “Ka sil bawl tuin na thei sih, hinanleh tunua chiengin na hing thei ding,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Peter in akungah, “Nang ka kengte sil talawm lou e!” achi hi. Jesu’n adawnga “Ka hing sil sihleh kei kungah tan bangma na nei sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Simon Peter in akungah, “Mangpa ka kengte guoh hilouin, ka khut leh ka lu zong sil in,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Koipou akipumsilsa mi pen akengte loungal sil angai sih hi, hinanleh apum in asieng ahita, na unpi un vang na hi sih uh,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman Ama lebawl a mansah dingpa athei a, tuaziehin, “Na unpi un na sieng kim sih uh,” achi ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachia akengte uh asil zouin, apuonsilte asil a, atou kia a, akung uah, “Na tung ua ka silbawl bang ahiei na thei uoi?","ref":"Luk. 22.27"},"13":{"text":"Nouten Kei pen Siepa leh Mangpa na hing chi ua, na chi dih ngel uhi, ahi ma ka hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachia kei na Mangpa u’leh Siepa un bawn na kengte uh hing silpieh ka hileh noute zong khat leh khat, keng na kisilpieh ding uh ahi."},"15":{"text":"Na tung ua ka bawl bangbang a na bawl na ding ua, etton ding ka hing pieh ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, suoh khu apu sangin alienzaw sih a, tualeh sawl a umpa zong asawlpa sangin alien zaw sih hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.24; Luk. 6.40; Jn. 15.20"},"17":{"text":"Tam silte na thei ua na bawl u’leh mi hampha na hi ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Na unpi uh tungtangthu gen ka hi sih, ka telte ken ka thei hi, hinanleh ka annkuong impipa’n ka tungah aketul alehta chi Laisiengthou sunga kigiel a tangtun theina ding ahi.","ref":"Late. 41.9"},"19":{"text":"Ahun tun masangin tuin ka hing hil ahi, ahun tun chienga Ama ka hi chi na gintat theina ding un."},"20":{"text":"Noute thutah ka hing hil ahi, koi hinanleh ka mi sawl khat poupou na kipahpi khu, kei hing kipahpi ahi, tualeh koipou kei hing kipahpi in ahing sawlpa akipahpi hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.40; Mak. 9.37; Luk. 9.48; 10.16"},"21":{"text":"Jesu’n tambanga agen zouin, alunggim mama a, “Noute thutah ka hing hil ahi, na lah ua khat in kei ahing mansah ding hi,” chiin atheisahta hi.","title":"Jesu’n amansah dingpa agendohna (Mat. 26.21 , 22 ; Mak. 14.18 , 19 ; Luk. 22.21-23)"},"22":{"text":"Anuazuite khat leh khat aki entuo ua, koipen gen adiei chi theilouin lamdang asa uhi."},"23":{"text":"Nuazuite lah a khat Jesu’n a itpa khu Jesu angah akingam phei hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin Simon Peter in “Koi pen agenna ahiei chi dong dingin amitmei in ahoupi hi.”"},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Jesu anga kingam kawm in, “Mangpa koipen ahiei?” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, “Tanghou them ka die zou a, ka pieh penpen ahi ding,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Aman tanghou them adie zouin Simon tapa Juda Iskariot apie hi."},"27":{"text":"Tanghou them asan zouin, asungah Setan alutta hi. Jesu’n akungah, “Na bawl ding pen bawl meng in,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh dawkan a toute koima in, bang zieh a tam thu akunga agen ahiei chi athei sih uhi."},"29":{"text":"Amaute pawlkhat in, Juda in dangka ip akep zieh a Jesu’n akunga, “Annzaluina dinga kisam silte lei ding ahiei,” ahisihleh mizawngte kunga bang ahieikhat pe ding ahiei a asawl hiva chiin angaituo uhi."},"30":{"text":"Juda in tanghou them alah zouin apawtdoh pai hi. Tua hun khu zanlai ahita hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Juda apawtdoh nuain, Jesu’n: “Tuin Mihing Tapa pahtawi in a umta, tualeh Pasian zong Ama vangin pahtawi in aumta hi.","title":"Ki itna thupieh tha"},"32":{"text":"Ama a Pasian pahtawi a aumleh, Pasian in zong Ama mama ah Tapa apahtawi dinga, apahtawi pai ta ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Naute aw noute toh tomnoukhat sung um nalai ding ka hi, Nouten na hing sui ding ua, Judate kunga ka peina ah na hing pei thei sih ding uh, ka chi mabangin tuin noute kungah zong ka chi ahi.","ref":"Jn. 7.34"},"34":{"text":"Thupieh tha ka hing pie hi, noute khat leh khat ki ittuo chiet un, ken noute ka hing it bangin noute ki ittuo chiet un.","ref":"Jn. 15.12,17; 1 Jn. 3.23; 2 Jn. 1.5"},"35":{"text":"Noute khat leh khat na ki it tuo chiet uleh, ka nuazuite na hi uh chi miten ahing thei ding uhi,” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Simon Peter in akungah, “Mangpa hei a pei ding na hiei?” chi’n a dong hi. Jesu’n adawnga “Ka peina dingah, tuin na hing zui thei nai sih ding, hinanleh tunua chiengin nang zui ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Peter in akitheimawbawlna ding genlawhna (Mat. 26.34 , 35 ; Mak. 14.30 , 31 ; Luk. 22.33 , 34)"},"37":{"text":"Peter in akungah, “Mangpa bangdinga tu a hing zui thei lou ding ka hiei? Nang dingin ka hinna ka pekhe ding,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Jesu’n ama adawnga, “Keima ziehin na hinna na phal ngel na diei? Chitahtahin na kung ah ka gen ahi, aa khuon masangin thum vei na hing kilepsan ding hi achi hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Na lungtanguh mangbangsah sih un, Pasian gingta unlen, Kei zong hing gingta un.","title":"Lampi thutah leh hinna"},"2":{"text":"Ka Pa inn ah umna tampi a um hi, a umlou hileh noute ka hing hilta ding hi. Nou a dinga mun bawla pei ding ka hi."},"3":{"text":"Nou a dinga mun bawl a ka vapei leh ka hing pei kia ding a, ka kung ah noute ka hing la ding hi; ka umna a noute zong na um theina dingun."},"4":{"text":"Ka peina ding na thei ua, alampi zong na thei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Thomas in akungah, “Mangpa na peina ding mun ka thei sih uhi, alampi bangchi’n ka thei ding uoi?” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Kei lampi leh thutah leh hinna ka hi, Keima a peilou in koima Pa kung ah atung ngai sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Nouten kei hing thei hi u’lachin, ka Pa zong na theita ding uhi; tu a kipat Ama na thei ua, mu zong na muta uhi,” achi hi.","title":"Jesu leh Pa pumkhat"},"8":{"text":"Philip in akungah, “Aw Mangpa, Pa khu koute hing musah in, tuachi’n ka lungkimta ding uhi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah “Philip aw, tamtanveipi na kung uah, ka uma hing thei naiva-ia lou na mah? Koipou kei hing muin, Pa amu ahi; bangchidan a Pa khu kou hing musahin na chi ahiei mah?"},"10":{"text":"Kei Pa ah ka um a, Pa keima ah a um chi gingta lou na hiei mah? Na kung ua ka thugente, keima thuin ka gen sih a, hinanleh Pa keima a um in tua nnate abawl ahi zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Kei Pa ah ka um a, Pa keima ah a um, chi hing gingta un, ahisihleh silbawlte zieh beeh in hing gingta un."},"12":{"text":"“Chitahtah in ka hing hil ahi, koipou kei hing gingta in ka nasepte aman zong asem ding hi; tualeh tamte sanga thupi zaw zong asem ding, ka pa kunga ka pei ding ziehin."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh ka min a na nget pouma uh, tua khu ka bawl ding hi, Pa Tapa a pahtawi a aum theina dingin."},"14":{"text":"Ka min a bang ahiei na nget pouma u’leh ka bawl zel ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Kei na hing it u’leh ka thupiehte zui un."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh ken Pa kungah ka ngen dinga, Aman noute toh kumtawn a umden ding panpitu dang khat ahing pe ding hi.","title":"Hagau pieh ding chiemna"},"17":{"text":"Tuakhu Thutah Hagau ahi; leitungin Ama anei thei sih, aziehpen Ama amu sih ua, thei zong athei sih uh, ahivangin nouten Ama na thei uhi, aziehpen na kung uah a um a, na sung uah ateng hi."},"18":{"text":"“Ken noute taga dingin ka hing nuasie sih ding, na kung uah ka hing pei ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Hun tomnoukhat nua chiengin leitungin kei ahing mu nawn sih ding; hinanleh nouten na hing mu ding uh; aziehpen kei ka hinga, noute zong na hing ding uh."},"20":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin, Kei Pa ah ka um a, noute keima ah na um ua, Kei nouma ah ka um, chi na thei ding uhi."},"21":{"text":"Koipou ka thupiehte nei a, zui pouma kei hing it ahi uh, tualeh koipou kei hing it khu ka Pa’n a it ding a, ken ama ka it dinga, akungah ka kilaah ding hi” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Iskariot hilou pen Juda in akungah, “Mangpa koute kunga na kilaah a, leitung kunga na kilaah lou ding, bangchidan ahiei?” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga akungah, “Mi koipou in kei ahing it leh ka thu azui dinga, ka Pa’n ama a it dinga, Ama kungah ka hing pei ding ua, Ama toh ka teng khawmden ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Koipou kei hing it lou mi in, ka thugente azui sih a, na thu zahte uh keima a ahisih a, Pa kei hing sawlpa a ahizaw hi."},"25":{"text":"“Na kung ua ka um tahdi sungin, tam thute na kung uah ka gen hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh Hamuonpa Hagau Siengthou, Pain ka min in ahing sawl ding a, aman sil zousie noute ahing hil ding hi, tualeh na kung ua ka thugensa zousie noute ahing theidohsah ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Hamuonna ka hing nuasie hi, Keima hamuonna ka hing pie hi, leitungin apieh bangin ken noute ka hing pe sih hi. Na lungtang uh mangbangsah sih unlen, zau zong zausah sih un."},"28":{"text":"Ka peimang dinga, na kung uah ka hing pei kia ding, chia na kung ua ka gen na zata uhi. Kei na hing it u’leh, Pa kungah ka pei ding ka chi ziehin na kipah ding uhi, aziehpen kei sangin ka Pa alienzaw hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahun tun masangin tuin ka hing hil ahita, ahun hing tun chienga na gintat theina ding un."},"30":{"text":"Tukalsie na kung uah thu tampi ka gen nawn sih ding, aziehpen tam leitung vaihawmpa hing pei pai ding ahi; aman keima ah bangma anei sih hi."},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh Ken Pa ka it a, thu ahing pieh bangin ka bawl zel hi chi leitungin atheina ding un. Dingdoh un tana pat in ipeita ding uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Kei grepgui dihtah ka hi, ka Pa ahuon neipa ahi.","title":"Gingtute leh Khrist kizopna"},"2":{"text":"Keima aum ba galou pouma apaimanga aga pouma asusiengthou zel hi, aga tam semna ding in."},"3":{"text":"Noute pen, na kung ua ka thugen ziehin asiengsa na hita uhi."},"4":{"text":"Keima ah um ngitnget un, Kei zong nouma ah ka um ngitnget ding hi. Bahieng pouma grepguia aum ngitnget sih leh amatangin aga thei lou mabangin, noute zong keima a na um sih u’leh na ga thei sih ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Kei grepgui khu ka hia, noute abahiengte na hi uh, Mi koipou keima a aum ngitnget leh, Kei ama a ka um ngitngetna pa’n ga tampi asuong zel hi. Aziehpen keima louin bangma na bawl thei sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mi koipou keima a aum ngitnget sihleh bahieng banga paidoh in a um a, avuoi zel hi; mi’n tuabang bahiengte atomkhawm ua meiphuol ah apai ua, akatum hi."},"7":{"text":"Noute Keima a na um ngitnget ua, ka thute nouma a, aum ngitnget leh na lunggul pouma uh ngen un, Nou a dingin bawl ahi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Noute na gaphat chiengun, tua khuin, Ka Pa apahtawi hi, tuachi’n ka nuazuite na hi ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Pain Kei ahing it bangin, Ken noute ka hing it hi, ka itna ah um ngitnget un."},"10":{"text":"Nouten ka thupiehte na zui u’leh ka itna ah na um ngitnget ding uhi; Ken ka Pa thupiehte ka zui a, a itna a ka um ngitnget ma bangin."},"11":{"text":"Ka kipahna nouma a aum ngitnget theina ding leh, na kipahna uh abukim theina dingin tam thute na kung uah ka gen ahi."},"12":{"text":"“Tami ka thupieh ahi: Ken noute ka hing it bangin noute khat leh khat ki ittuo chiet un.","ref":"Jn. 13.34; 15.17; 1 Jn. 3.23; 2 Jn. 1.5"},"13":{"text":"Mi’n alawmte a dinga ahinna apieh sanga lienzaw itna a um sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka thupiehte na zui u’leh ka lawmte na hi ding uhi."},"15":{"text":"Suohte ka hing chi nawn sih ding, aziehpen suohin apuin bang ahiei abawl athei sih hi; lawmte ka hing chi zawta ding, aziehpen ka Pa kunga ka zah zousie na kung uah ka hing theisah ta hi."},"16":{"text":"Nouten kei na hing tel sih ua, Ken noute ka hing telzaw hi. Pei a va ga ding leh, na ga uh umden dingin, tualeh Ka min a Pa kunga na nget pouma uh ahing pieh theina dingin noute ka hing guot ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tamte ka hing thupieh ahi, noute khat leh khat ki ittuo chiet un."},"18":{"text":"“Leitungin noute ahing muda leh noute ahing muda masangin Kei ahing muda zouta chi thei un.","title":"Gingtute leh leitung kikaal"},"19":{"text":"Noute leitunga hi u’lachin, leitungin ama ate a it ding hi. Hinanleh noute leitunga na hilou zieh un, leitunga kipat noute ka hing teldohta hi, tuaziehin leitungin noute ahing muda hi."},"20":{"text":"Suoh apu sangin alienzaw sih chia na kung ua ka thugen thei ngitnget un. Amauten Kei ahing bawlsiet uleh, noute zong ahing bawlse ding uhi. Amauten ka thu zui uleh, noute thu zong azui ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 10.24; Luk. 6.40; Jn. 13.16"},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Ka min ziehin tam silte zousie na tung uah abawl ding uhi, Kei hing sawlpa atheilou zieh un."},"22":{"text":"Kei hing pei lou a, akung ua thu genlou hi leng, khelna neilou ding hi ua, hinanleh tuin vang akhelna uah paulap ding aneita sih uhi."},"23":{"text":"Koipou Kei hing muda in ka Pa zong amuda uhi."},"24":{"text":"Midang bawl ngailou silte alah ua bawllou hileng, khelna neilou ding hi ua, hinanleh tuin vang ka silbawlte amuta ua, Kei leh ka Pa ka ni un ahing muda uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh tampen, amauten azieh bei in ahing muda uh, chi adanbu ua kigiel thu atangtunna dinga hing um ahi.","ref":"Late. 35.19; 69.4"},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh Pa akipat na kung ua ka hing sawl ding, Hamuonpa, Pa akipat a hing pawt, thutah Hagau ahing tun chiengin, Aman ka tungtang thu atheisah ding hi.","title":"Hagau Siengthou pieh chiemna"},"27":{"text":"Tualeh nouten zong na theipi ding uhi, achiil a kipat a ka kunga um na hi ziehun."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Na kipalpua louna dingun tam thute na kung ua ka gen ahi."},"2":{"text":"Kikhopna innte akipat ahing notdoh ding ua, ahi, noute hing that pouma, Pasian nasem hoi a akingaituo hun uh, hing tung ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh tam silte na tung uah abawl ding uhi, amaun Pa lah theilou, Kei lah hing theilou ahizieh un."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh ahun ahing tun chienga, tam thute ka hing hilta chi na theidoh na ding ua, amauh tungtang ka hing hil masah ahi. “Na kung ua ka um nahlai ziehin, tam thute achiil in na kung uah ka gen sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh tu in Kei ahing sawlpa kunga pei ding ka hita, Koima’n hei a pei ding na hiei? chiin na hing dong sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh tam thute na kung ua ka gen ziehin, na lungtang uh lunggimna in na dimta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ahivang in thutah ka hing hil ahi. Ka peimang ding nou a dingin ahoizaw hi; aziehpen ka peimang sihleh, Hamuonpa na kung uah, ahing pei sih ding hi. Hinanleh ka peimang leh na kung uah Ama ka hing sawl ding hi.","title":"Hagau Siengthou nasepte"},"8":{"text":"Ama ahing tun chiengin, khelna thu ahte, dihtatna thu ahte, tualeh vaihawmna thu ahte, leitung asiemlou dan atheisah ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Khelna thu ah siemlou atangsah ding, kei ahing gintat lou zieh un."},"10":{"text":"Dihtatna thu ah, siemlou atangsah ding, Kei ka Pa kunga pei a, na hing mu nawnlou ding zieh un."},"11":{"text":"Vaihawmna thu ah, siemlou atangsah ding, tam leitung vaihawmpa thukhen pieh a aum tah ziehin."},"12":{"text":"“Na kung uah thu gen ding tampi ka nei nalai hi, hinanleh tuin na theisiem nai sih ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Bangtenghitaleh thutah Hagau ahing tun chiengin, thutah zousie ah noute ahing puilut ding; aziehpen Ama thuneina in bangma agen sih dinga, hinanleh azah pouma agen zaw ding hi; tualeh sil hing tung dingte noute ahing hil ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Aman kei ahing pahtawi dinga, Keima ate ala dinga, noute ahing hil ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Pa sil nei zousie kei a ahia, Tuaziehin Hagau in Keima ate ala dinga, noute ahing hil ding, kachi ahi."},"16":{"text":"“Hun tomnoukhat nua chiengin nouten na hing mu nawn sih ding ua, tualeh hun tomnoukhat nua chiengin na hing mukia ding uhi; Pa kunga pei ding ka hizieh in.”","title":"Jesu’n ashina ding leh athawkiana ding agenna"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Anuazuite pawlkhat in, “Hun tomnoukhat nua chiengin nouten na hing mu nawn sih ding ua, tualeh hun tomnoukhat nua chiengin na hing mu kia ding uh, Pa kunga pei ding ka hiziehin, ikunga achi khu bang achina adiei?” akichi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaun, “Tam athugen, Tomnoukhat nua chiengin, achi bang achina adiei?” Ithei sih uhi, akichi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama adong nuom uh chi Jesu’n athei a, akung uah, “Hun tomnoukhat nuachiengin na hing mu nawn sih ding ua, tualeh hun tomnoukhat nuachieng in na hing mu kia ding uh, chia ka gen, kidongtuo hi uteh maw?"},"20":{"text":"Chitahtah vawt in ka hing hil ahi, noute na kap ding ua, na mau ding uh, hinanleh leitung akipah ding; noute na lunggim ding ua, hinanleh na lunggimna uh kipahna asuoh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Numei, anau suoh hun atun chiengin, nauvei in gimgentheina athuoh a, hinanleh anau asuoh zou tah chiengin, tua agentheinate aphawh kha nawn sih hi, leitunga mihing khat hing pieng kipahna ziehin."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin nouten zong tuin lunggimna na nei uhi, Hinanleh noute ka hing mu kia dinga, na kipah mama ta ding uhi, tualeh na kipahna uh koiman ahing lahpieh sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin nouten bangma na hing ngen sih ding uhi. Chitahtahin ka hing hil ahi, ka min a Pa kunga na nget pouma uh, Aman noute ahing pe ding."},"24":{"text":"Tutanin Ka min in bangma na ngen nai sih uh; ngen un na mu ding uh, na kipahna uh abukimna dingin."},"25":{"text":"“Tam thute na kung uah gentena in ka gen hi; hinanleh gentena thu a na kung ua ka gen nawn louna hun hing tung ding ahita; Pa tungtang thu chientah in ka hing hilta ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua hun chiengin ka min in na ngenta ding ua; Noute a dingin, Pa kungah hing nget pieh vang ka china ahisih hi."},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen nouten Kei na hing it ua, Pasian akipat a hing pei ka hi chi na gintat zieh un, Pa mama in noute ahing it hi."},"28":{"text":"Kei Pa a kipat a hing pawt a, leitunga hing pei ka hi; tualeh leitung nuasie a Pa kunga pei kia ding ka hi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Anuazuiten akungah, “Ngai vawi, tuin vang gentethuin na hem gen sih a, kichientahin na genta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuin vang Nang bangkim na thei a, koiman ahing doh na kiphamaw sih chi ka theita uhi. Tami zieh in Pasian a kipat a hing pei na hi, chi ka gingta uhi,” achi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Jesu’n amaute adawnga, “Tuin na gingta khong khongta u’maw?"},"32":{"text":"Ngai un, ahun hing tung ding ahi, tuin zong atungta hi, michin na inn chiet uah na kithethang ding ua, keimatangin na hing nuasie ding uhi, ahivangin Keimatangin ka um sih hi, ka Pa’n ahing umpi ziehin."},"33":{"text":"Keima a hamuonna na nei theina dingun, tam thute na kung ua ka gen ahi. Leitungah gim gentheina na thuoh ding uhi; hinanleh kipah thanuom in um un, Ken leitung ka zouta hi,” achi hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu’n tam thute agen zouin, vanlam ngain adahtou a; “Pa aw ahun atungta, Na Tapa pahtawi in, na Tapa in zong Nang ahing pahtawi theina dingin.","title":"Jesu thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Nangman Ama kunga na pieh poumate kumtawn hinna apieh theina dinga, mi zousie tunga thuneina na pieh bangin."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh tami ahi kumtawn hinna, Nang Pasian dihtah thei leh na sawl Jesu Khrist athei uh."},"4":{"text":"Leitungah Na min ka pahtawita, ka bawl dinga na hing pieh nna ka sem zouta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu in Aw Pa, leitung masanga na kunga ka nei, thupinain nangma kung ngel ah hing pahtawi in."},"6":{"text":"“Leitunga kipat a kei nahing piehte kungah, Na min ka theisahta hi; amaute nanga ahi uh, Nang kei na hing pieh ahi, tualeh na thu azuita uhi.","title":"Jesu anuazuite ding a thu angetna"},"7":{"text":"Tu in Kei na hing pieh silte zousie, Nangma hing kipan ahi chi amauten atheita uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen nangman kei kunga thu na hing pieh zousie, ken amaute ka peta a, amaun zong apomta uhi; tualeh nanga kipat a hing pei tahtah ka hi, chi atheita ua, nangma hing sawl ahi chi agingta ta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute dingin ka ngetpieh hi, leitunga dingin ka ngetpieh sih a, Nangman na hing piehte dingin ka ngetpieh zaw hi; amaute nanga ahi ziehun."},"10":{"text":"Kei ate zousie nanga ahia, Nang ate zousie Kei a ahi, tualeh amauah pahtawi in ka um hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu in Kei leitungah ka um nawn sih dinga, hinanleh tamte pen leitungah aum ding uhi, kei na kunga hing pei ding ka hita, Pa siengthou aw, eigel pumkhat ihi mabanga, amaute zong pumkhat ahi theina dingun, Nangman na hing piehte Na min in kem in."},"12":{"text":"Nang kei nang piehsa teng toh leitunga ka um khawm sungin na min in amauh ka kem a, Laisiengthou thu atangtun theina dingin, mangthang tapa loungal khatbeeh amangthang sih uhi.","ref":"Late. 41.9; Jn. 13.18"},"13":{"text":"Tuin na kunga hing pei ding ka hita; tualeh ama ua ka kipahna abukim theina dingin, tam silte leitungah ka gen ahi."},"14":{"text":"Na thu amauh ka peta a, leitungin amauh amuda hi; Kei leitunga ka hilou mabanga amauh zong leitunga ahilou zieh un."},"15":{"text":"Amauh leitung akipat ladoh dinga hing ngen ka hisih a, hinanleh gitlouna akipat veng dinga ka hing nget ahizaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Amauh leitunga ahisih uh, Kei leitunga ka hilou mabangin."},"17":{"text":"Na thuin amauh susiengthouin; Na thu thutah ahi."},"18":{"text":"Kei leitunga na hing sawl mabangin, ken zong amauh leitungah ka sawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Amauh ziehin kei ka kisusiengthou hi, thutah jal a ama u’zong suhsiengthou a a um theina ding un."},"20":{"text":"“Tamte behbeh a dingin ka hing ngen sih a, hinanleh amauh thugenna zieh a, Kei hing gingta dingte a dingin zong ka hing ngen hi.","title":"Khrist in gingtu zousie a ding a thu angetna"},"21":{"text":"Pa aw, Nang keima ah na um a, Kei nangma a ka um banga, amauh zong eima a pumkhat ahitheina dingun, tualeh Nang kei na hing sawl ahi chi leitungin agintat theina ding un."},"22":{"text":"Nang leh kei pumkhat ihimabangin, amaute zong pumkhat ahing hitheina dingun, nangman kei na hing pieh thupinate, ken amauh ka peta hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei ama uah ka um a, Nang keima ah na um hi; tuachi’n amauh pumkhat a suhbukim a aum theina ding un, tualeh Nang kei na hing sawl a, kei na hing it bangin amauh na itta chi leitung in atheina dingun."},"24":{"text":"Pa aw, Nang kei na hing piehte zong ka umna a keima toh um a, Nang Kei nang it man a, leitung kisiem masang peha na hing pieh thupina amaun mu u’leh ka dei hi."},"25":{"text":"Pa dihtat aw, leitungin Nang ahing theisih a, hinanleh Ken ka hing thei hi, tualeh nang kei na hing sawl hi chi tam miten zong atheita uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh amaute kungah na min ka theisahta a, ka theisah zel ding hi; Kei na hing itna bangbang itna ama ua aum theina leh, kei ama ua ka um theina dingin,” achi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu’n tam thute agen zouin anuazuite toh apawtdoh ua, Kidron luita akan ua, tuanah huon khat aum a, tuanah anuazuite toh alut uhi.","title":"Jesu mat a aumna (Mat. 26.47-56 ; Mak. 14.43-52 ; Luk. 22.47-53)"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu lebawl a mansahpa Judas in zong tua mun athei hi, aziehpen tua mun khu Jesu’n anuazuite akimupi zelna mun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judas in siempu liente leh Pharisaite apat in Biehinn veng galkap pawl leh miman lamkaite apui a, thaumeite, meiselte leh hiemleheite tawi in tuanah ahing pei uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jesu’n atunga sil tung ding zousie theiin ava pei a, akung uah, “Koi ahiei na sui uh?” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Amauten adawng ua, “Nazareth Jesu” achi uhi, Jesu’n akung uah, “Kei ka hi,” achi hi. Tualeh amansahpa Judas zong akung uah a ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n “Kei ka hi,” achitahin, akinuatawn ua, tuol ah apuata uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n “Koi ahiei na sui uh?” chi’n adong kia a, amaun “Nazareth Jesu” achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, “Kei ama ka hi, chi’n ka hing hilta; Tuaziehin Kei hing sui nahi u’leh tam mite pei sah un,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Nangman kei na hing piehte khat zong ka mangsah sih hi” chia agen, atangtun theina dingin."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Simon Peter in anamsau kuo adohkhie a, siempulian suohpa asat a, abil zietlam asatkhiet pieh hi. Tua suohpa min khu Malkus ahi."},"11":{"text":"Jesu’n Peter kungah “Na namsau apai ah sietin, ka pain ahing pieh nou khu dawnlou ding ka hiei mah?” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 26.39; Mak. 14.36; Luk. 22.42"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n biehinn veng galkap pawlte leh lamkai vaisaite leh Judaten Jesu aman ua, akaanta uhi.","title":"Jesu siempulien Annas mai a adinna (Mat. 26.69 , 70 ; Mak. 14.66 , 68 ; Luk. 22.55-57)"},"13":{"text":"Ama Annas kungah apeipi masapen uhi, aziehpen ama tuami kum a siempulien apang Kaiapha sungpa ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tam Kaiapha khu, mipite taanga mi khat shi ahoizaw hi, chia Judate kung genpa ahi.","ref":"Jn. 11.49,50"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Simon Peter in Jesu nua azui a, tuamabangin nuazui dang khat in zong azui hi. Tua nuazuipa khu siempulien in amelthei ahia, siempulien inn huong sungah Jesu toh alut khawm uhi.","title":"Peter in Jesu akilepsanna"},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter khu pulam ah kotpi bul ah ading hi. Nuazui khatpen siempulien meltheipa khu ava pawt a, kotpi ngahnu ahoupi a, Peter a hing puilut hi."},"17":{"text":"Kotpi ngah nungahnu’n Peter kungah, “Nang zong tam mipa nuazuite lah a khat hilou na hiei mah?” achi hi. Aman “Ka hi sih” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh khuo avot ziehin suohte leh inn huong sung veng lamkaiten meihol tawi in akimkot a dingin akisanglum uhi. Tualeh Peter zong amau’toh ding khawm in mei ah akisanglum hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempulien in Jesu kungah, anuazuite tungtang leh athuhilna tungtang adong hi."},"20":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, “Ken alangtangin leitung thu ka gen a, Judate kikhopna innte leh biehinn ah thu ka hil ngitnget a, asimtham in bangma ka gen sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Bangdinga kei hing dong na hiei? Ka thugen zate kung ah dong ve, bangthu ahiei ka gen, amaun athei uhi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tam thute agen zouin, akunga ding, milien khat in akhut peh in Jesu ngeiphe abehpieh a, “Nang siempulien tambangin na dawng ngam vazuou maw?” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, “Thugilou ka gen leh ka gitlouna hing theisah in, hinanleh thudih ka gen leh bangding a nang beh ahiei?” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Annas in Ama hentomsain siempulien Kaiapha kungah asawlta hi."},"25":{"text":"Simon Peter in dingkawm in mei a awi a, tuaziehin, amaun akung ah, “Nang zong nuazuite lah a khat na hi, na hiei leh?” achi ua, aman theilou khem kipang in “Ka hisih,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in abil asatkhietpiehpa sanggam siempulien suohte khat in, “Huon a Ama toh na umkhawm uh ka hing mu ngel hilou amah?” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Peter in akitheimawbawl kia a, tualeh aah akhuong paita hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten Kaiapha inn apat in Jesu khu gam uhpipa thukhenna innpi huong sungah apeipita uhi, tua hun khu zingmawng matah ahi. Hinanleh amaute pen thukhenna innpi huong sung ah alut sih uhi, tuachilouin akisubua kha ding ua, Peikaan annkuong anethei sih kha ding uhi.","title":"Rom gam uhpipa Pilat masang a Jesu adinna (Mat. 27.2 , 11-14 ; Mak. 15.1-5 ; Luk. 23.1-5)"},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat akung uah ahing pawtkhie a, “Tam mipa na hehna uh bang ahiei?” chi’n adong hi."},"30":{"text":"Amaun adawng ua, “Ama silgilou bawl hisih leh na kungah ka hing pekhe sih ding uhi,” achi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in akung uah, “Ama peipi unlen, nouma dan toh kituohin atungah thukhenta un,” achi hi. Judaten akungah, “Kou a dingin mi ka thalup ding uh dan ahi sih hi,” achi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tami khu bangchibanga shi ding ahiei, chi Jesu mama in agensa atangtun theina ding ahi.","ref":"Jn. 3.14; 12.32"},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat thukhenna inn sung ah alut kia a, Jesu ahan a, akungah, “Judate kumpipa na hiei?” achi hi."},"34":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, “Tuakhu nang lungsim a hing suoh a na gen ahiei? ahisihleh midangin ka tungtang thu a ahing hil sawn ahiei?” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Pilat in adawnga, “Kei Juda mi ka hiei mah? Na china nampite leh siempulienten nang ka kungah ahing piehkhie uhi; bang na bawla ahiei?” achi hi."},"36":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, “Ka leenggam pen tam leitung ahi sih hi. Ka leenggam pen tam leitung toh kisai hitaleh, Judate khuta piehkhiet ka hilouna dingin ka suohte’n adou ding uhi. Hinanleh ka leenggam pen tam leitung ahisih hi,” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pilat in akungah; “Ahileh kumpi na hiei leh?” achi hi. Jesu’n adawnga, “Kumpipa nang chi nachi dih hi. Tami ding mawnga pieng ka hi a, tualeh thutah theipi dinga leitunga hing pei ka hi. Koipou thutah a um poumain ka aw aza uhi,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Pilat in akungah “Thutah bang ahiei?” achi hi. Aman tam thu agen zouin, Judate kungah ava pawtkhe kia a, akung uah, “Ama ah khelna ka mu sih hi, achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh peikan pawi hun a henta khat ka hing ha pieh ding ahi chi tawndan khat na nei uhi; tuaziehin Judate kumpipa hing hadoh pieh leng na ut uoi?” achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n abawnpi un akikou kia ua, “Tam mipa hilouin Baraba ahi nang ha zawh ding,” achi uhi.
