Baraba pen Suomhat ahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in Jesu apui a azepsahta hi.","title":"Jesu killup ding thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh galkapten linglukhu aphan ua, Jesu akhusah ua, tualeh puonsandup asilsah uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun, “Judate kumpipa salam” chiin akhut un abeng uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat ahing pawtkhe kia a, akung uah, “En un, Ama ah dihlouna ka mu sih chi na theina dingun na kung ua ka hing puidoh ahi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu linglukhu khuh leh puonsandup silin ahing pawtdoh a, Pilat in “En un, tam mihingpa! “achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin siempuliente leh biehinn veng lamkaiten ama amu tah un, “Kross ah khailia in, Kross ah khailia in” chiin akikou uhi. Pilat in akung uah “Nouma’n zawpi unlen khailia un, ken Ama dihlouna ka mu sih hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Judaten Ama adawng ua, “Dan khat ka nei ua, Pasian Tapa a akibawl ziehin, ka dan dungzui un shitah ahi,” achi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Pilat in tam thu a zah tahin azau semsemta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh thukhenna innpi sungah ava lut kia a, Jesu kungah, “Hei a hing kipan na hiei?” achi a, hinanleh Jesu’n adawng sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in akungah, “Ka kunga thu genlou ding na hiei mah? Kross a khailia theina leh hakhiet theina thuneina nei ka hi chi theilou na hiei mah?” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesu’n adawnga, “Tunglam a kipat a pieh hisih lachin ka tungah bangma bawlthei na nei sih ding hi; tuaziehin na kunga hing pekhepa’n khelna alien nei zaw hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Khumbansie Pilat in hadoh atum a, hinanleh Judaten “Tam mipa na hadoh leh Kaisar lawm na hi sih ding. Koipou ama leh ama kumpipa a kibawl khu, Kaisar dou ahi,” chi’n akikou uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pilat in tua thu kigen azahtah in Jesu ahing puidoh a, suongleptuoh kichi thukhenna toupha Hebru ham a Gabbatha tungah atou hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ni khu peikan pawi kiginni ahi a, nai guhna hun vel ahi. Tualeh Pilat in Judate kungah, “En un, na kumpipa uh!” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute akikou ua, “Puimangin, puimangin, Kross ah khailia in,” achi uhi. Pilat in akung uah, “Na kumpipa uh maw kross tunga ka khailup ding,” achi hi. Siempulienten “Kaisar loungal kumpipa dang ka nei sih uh,” chi’n adawng uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pilat in Jesu kross tunga killup dingin akung uah apekheta hi. Tuachi’n amaun Jesu ala ua, apuita uhi.","title":"Jesu kross a killupna (Mat. 27.32-38 , 48-50 ; Mak. 15.21-26 , 36 , 37 ; Luk. 23.26-33 , 38 , 46)"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akross kipuohin Hebru ham a Golgotha kichi lugu mun lam ah apeita hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuanah Jesu khu kross tungah akilbeh ua midang ni zong agei tuoh ah akilbeh ua, alai ah Jesu akilbeh uhi."},"19":{"text":"Pilat in ahina lai khat agiel a kross tungah atah hi. Tua alaigel khu, “NAZARETH JESU JUDATE KUMPIPA”, chi ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam Ahina kigiel Judate tampi in asim uhi, Jesu akilbehna khopi kung nai ahi zieh in. Tualeh tami khu Hebru ham leh Greek ham leh Latin ham a kigiel ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judate siempulienten Pilat kungah “Judate kumpipa chi’n giel sinlen, Judate kumpipa ka hi achi, chiin giel zawin,” achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Pilat in adawnga, “Ka gelsa khu ka gelsa ahita” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu akilbeh zou un, galkapten apuonsilte ala ua, khat chiet a atan dingun phal li asuo uhi, tualeh apuonah zong ala uhi. Apuonah pen akhuina umlou, angawnga pat apum a kigan zom suoh ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaun “Tampen botkeh sih vaiin koipen tan ding ahiei, aisan vai akichi uhi.” Laisiengthouin ka puonsilte akihawm ua, “Ka puontuol a dingin ai asan uh, achi atangtun theina dingin. Tuaziehin galkapten tam silte abawl uhi.”","ref":"Late. 22.18"},"25":{"text":"Jesu kros kungah anu leh anu sanggamnu, Kleopa zi Mari leh Mari Magdalene ading uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jesu’n anu leh anuazui a itpa akunga ding amu tahin, anu kungah “Numei en in na tapa!” achi a;"},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n nuazuipa kungah, “En in na nu!” achi hi. Tua huna kipat in nuazuipa’n amanu a inn ah apuita hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua zouin Jesu’n sil zousie tuin bawl zousieng ahita chi thei in Laisiengthou thugen a tangtunna dingin, “Ka dang atah” achi hi!","title":"Jesu shina","ref":"Late. 69.21; 22.15"},"29":{"text":"Tua mun ah greptui thua a dim bel khat akitung hi, amaun tua greptui-thua ah tuihupna khat adie ua hissop chiengkang dawn ah ata ua, Akam toh asutuo uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n greptui thua adawn zouin, “Zaw ahita,” achi a, alu akunsuh a, ahagau ahata hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua ni khu kiginni ahi ziehin, Judaten aluongte uh khawlni a kros dawn a aumden ding uh adei sih ua, aziehpen tua khawlni khu ni thupitah hi ding ahita hi, tuaziehin Judaten Pilat kungah akengte uh sat tawng pieh a, aluong uh ladoh dingin, angen uhi.","title":"Jesu shi zou a sil umte"},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkapte ahing pei ua, Jesu toh kikilbeh atuoh masahpen uh kengte leh khatpen kengte asat tawng pieh uhi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu kung ahing tun un, Ama ana shi zoute chi amu ua, akengte asat tawng sih uhi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh galkapte lah a khat in, teipiin anah asun a, sisan leh tui ahing luongkhe pai hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh tami mupa’n atheipita a, atheipina khu adih ahi. Tualeh nouten na gintat theina ding un agen dih ahi, chi athei hi."},"36":{"text":"Aziehpen Laisiengthou in, “Agu khat zong sattawng ahi sih ding achi tangtun na dingin tam silte ahing umta hi.”","ref":"Pawt. 12.46; Kisim. 9.12; Late. 34.20"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Laisiengthou sung mun dang ah, “Amaun asutpa uh a en ding uh, chiin akigiel kia hi.”","ref":"Zek. 12.10; Kihil. 1.7"},"38":{"text":"Tamte nua in Arimathai khomi, Judate agiin zieh a aguh a Jesu nuazui Joseph in Jesu luong alah theina dingin Pilat kungah ava ngen hi. Pilat in phalna apie a, tuachi’n ama ahing pei a Jesu luong ala ta hi.","title":"Jesu kivuina (Mat. 27.57-60 ; Mak. 15.42-46 ; Luk. 23.50-54)"},"39":{"text":"Tualeh tumasanga zanlai a Jesu kunga hing hawpa Nikodem zong ahing pei a murrah leh aloe kihal gimnamtui agihdan pound zakhat vel ahing tawi hi.","ref":"Jn. 3.1,2"},"40":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Jesu luong ala ua, Judate kivui ngaina dan bangin gimnamtui toh puonnem in atuom uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh kross a akilbehna mun uah huon khat a um a, tua huon ah, koima kivui ngai louna han tha khat a um hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judate kiginni ahiziehin, tua han ah Jesu asielta uhi, han khu nainoukhat ahi ziehin."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nipikal khat a ni masapen zingmawng khuo miel nalai in Mari Magdalene han ah ava haw a, tua hankot kisinna suong kilakhesa in amu hi.","title":"Jesu thawkia na (Mat. 28.1-8 ; Mak. 16.1-8 ; Luk. 24.1-12)"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n amanu ataipai vingveng a Simon Peter leh nuazui dang Jesu’n a itpa kungah, “Hankhuh akipat in Mangpa luong alamangta uhi, heisung a asiel uh ahiei ka thei sih uhi,” avachi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin Peter apawtdoh a, tualeh nuazui dangpen zong, tualeh han lam azuonta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n ani un ataikhawm ua, nuazui dang khat penin Peter amakhel a, han atung masa hi."},"5":{"text":"Aman kunsuh in hankhuh sung a en a, dielpuonnem kipha khu amu a, hinanleh hankhuh sung ah alut sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Simon Peter zong ama nua ah ahing tunga, hankhuh sungah alut a, dielpuonnem umte amu hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu lutang tuomna puon pen dielpuonnem toh umkhawm lou a, atuom a mun khat a kiziela um amu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua nuazui dang khat han a tung masapa zong asungah alut a, amu a, agingta ta hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen amaun Jesu mishi lah a kipat in athou kia ding ahi chi, Laisiengthou thu athei nai sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n nuazuite amauh inn lam chiet ah anua pei kiata uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Mari khu han pulam ah kap in ading a, tualeh kap kawmin akuun a han sung a en hi.","title":"Mari Magdalene kunga Jesu kilahna"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu luong kisielna mun ah vansawlsieng ni, aluhung lam ah khat, akenghuontaw lam ah khat, puon vam sil a tou amu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua vansawlsiengten akungah, “Numei bang dinga kap na hiei?” achi uhi. Amanu’n akung uah, “Ka Mangpa alamangta ua, hei a asiel uh ahiei chi ka theilou ziehin,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tam thu genkawma akinuahei leh tuana Jesu ding amu hi. Hinanleh Jesu ahi chi athei sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Numei bangding a kap na hiei? Koi ahiei na sui?” achi hi. Amanu’n huon bawlpa hiva achi ziehin, “Pu aw Ama na puohkhiet ahileh, na sielna hing hilin, tuachi’n ken. Ama ka lakhe ding hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Mari” achi a, amanu akihei a, akungah “Rabboni” achi hi. Tua pen Siepa china ahi."},"17":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Hing tuden sin, ka Pa kungah ka peitou nai sih hi. Hinanleh ka sanggamte kungah va pei inlen, akung uah, Ka Pa, na pa uh, tualeh ka Pasian na Pasian uh kunga peitou ding ka hita chi’n va gen in,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Mari Magdalene ahing pei a, nuazuite kungah, “Mangpa amu” thu leh tam silte ama’n akungah agen hi, chi amaute kungah ahilta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuani mama nipi kaalkhat a ni masapen nitahlam in, nuazuite mun khat ah aumkhawm ua, Judate agiin zieh ua, kot kikhakhum uh hinapi, Jesu ahing pei a alah uah ahing ding a, akung uah, “Na tung uah hamuonna um hen,” achi hi.","title":"Thomas umlou kaala Jesu nuazuite kunga akilahna (Mak. 16.14 ; Luk. 24.36-43)"},"20":{"text":"Tam thute agen zouin, akhutte leh anah amaute ala hi. Nuazuiten Mangpa amu tahun akipah mama uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Na tung uah lungmuonna um hen; Ka Pa’n ahing sawl mabangin noute ka hing sawl hi,” achi kia hi."},"22":{"text":"Tam thute agen zouin atung uah ahu ahakhum a “Hagau Siengthou tangta un achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi koipou khelna na ngaidam u’leh, ngaidam ahi ding a, mi koipou khelnate na ngaidam sih u’leh ngaidam lou ahi ding hi.”","ref":"Mat. 16.19; 18.18"},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Thomas didum kichipa nuazui sawm leh nite lah a khat, Jesu hing pei lai in alah uah a um sih hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin nuazui dangten akungah, “Mangpa ka muta uh” achi uhi. Hinanleh ama’n akung uah, “Akhut a siakilna pawnte ka mu a, siakilna pawnte sunga ka khutme ka guon vateh a, tualeh anah ka khut a ka tham vateh sih leh ka gingta sih ding,” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh ni giet nua in nuazuite inn sungah aum kia ua, Thomas zong alah uah a um hi. Kotte kikil hinapi Jesu ahing pei a, alah uah adinga “Na tung uah Hamuonna um hen,” achi hi.","title":"Thomas zong tel Jesu nuazuite kunga kilahna (1 Kor. 15.5)"},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n Thomas kungah, “Na khutme in hing tham inlen, ka khutte en in. Na khut in ka nah tham inlen sawhin. Ginglel nawn sinlen, gingta tain,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Thomas in adawnga akungah, “Ka Mangpa leh ka Pasian aw,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Thomas nang kei na hing mu ziehin na gingta ahi, mulou a gingtate ahampha uhi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Adihtahin Jesu’n anuazuite mitmu a chiemtena dang tampi abawlte tam laibu a kigiel lou a um hi.","title":"Johan in khantan hoi agelna zieh"},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh tamte pen nouten Jesu Khrist Pasian Tapa ahi chi na gintat na ding u’leh, na gintat zieh ua amina hinna na nei na ding ua kigiel ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte nuain Jesu Tiberia diilah, anuazuite kungah akilah kia a, tambangin akilah hi.","title":"Tiberia dil a Jesu kilahna"},"2":{"text":"Simon Peter toh, Didum kichi Thomas toh, Galili gam a Kana khuo a um Nathanael toh, Zebedi tapate toh, tualeh anuazui dang ni toh, umkhawm ahi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Simon Peter in akung uah, “Ngaman a kuon ding ka hi,” achi hi. Amauten akungah, “Kouzong hing haw va ung,” achi uhi. Tuachi’n akuonkhie ua, kuong sungkhat ah atou pai ua, hinanleh tuami zan in bangma aman sih uhi.","ref":"Luk. 5.5"},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh zingmawng ahing hitah in, Jesu diilpieu ah a ding a, hinanleh nuazuiten Jesu ahilam athei sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu’n akung uah, “Naute aw, nga khatbeh manlou na hi uoi mah?” achi hi. Amaun “Manlou” chiin adawng uhi."},"6":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Kuong gei zietlam pangah na len uh sep un, them khat na man ding uhi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n amaun asep ua, tuachi’n nga atamseng ziehin akaidohzou sih uhi.","ref":"Luk. 5.6"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jesu’n a it nuazuipa’n Peter kungah, “Mangpa lah ahi’n,” achi hi. Simon Peter in Mangpa ahi chi azah tahin apuonah tungnung asil zuai a (guohtanga um ahi ziehin) tui lah ah atawmkheta hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh nuazui dangten len a ngate kaikawmin kuong neu khat in ahing pei ua, aziehpen tuipi pieu gei gamla lou tong zani vel a um ahi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh pieu gaw ahing tun tah un, meihol kitaw kuong leh atunga nga leh tanghou kikoi amu uhi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Na nga matte uh themkhat hing tawi vawi un” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Simon Peter khu apeitou a, nga lienpipi za leh sawmnga leh thum dim len khu pieu gei ah ahing kaidoh hi tuabang khopin nga tam nanleh len akeh sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Jesu’n akung uah, “Hing pei unlen zing ann hing ne un” achi hi. Hinanleh nuazuite koiman, “Nang koi na hiei?” achi ngam sih uhi, Mangpa ahi chi athei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jesu ahing pei a tanghou ala a, akung uah apie a tuamabangin nga zong apie hi."},"14":{"text":"Tam pen Jesu shina akipat athawkia nua a, anuazuite kunga akilah thum veina ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n a zing ann neh zou un, Jesu’n Simon Peter kungah, “Simon Johan tapa, tamte sangin kei nang it zaw ei?” achi hi. Aman akungah, “Hi Mangpa ka hing it chi na thei hi,” achi hi. Jesu’n akungah “Ka belamnoute vah in” achi hi.","title":"Jesu leh Peter kihouna"},"16":{"text":"Jesu’n ani veina dingin akungah “Johan tapa Simon, Kei nang it ei?” achi kia hi. Aman akungah, “Hi, Mangpa ka hing it chi na thei hi,” achi hi. Jesu’n akungah “Ka belamte ching in,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Jesu’n athumveina dingin, “Simon Johan tapa Nang kei nang it ei?” achi hi. Jesu’n akunga thumvei tah, “Nang kei na hing it ei” achi ziehin Peter alunggim hi. Tuachi’n Peter in akungah “Mangpa nang sil zousie na thei a; Ka hing it hi chi na thei hi,” achi hi. Jesu’n akungah, “Ka belamte vaa in,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Chitahtahin ka hinghil a hi, na naupan lai in na kawng nangma’n na kigah a, na utna lamlam ah na kivah kawi hi; hinanleh na hing upat chiengin na khut na zah dinga, midangten na kawng ahing gahpieh dinga, na utlouna lamlam ah ahing kai ding uhi, achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Jesu’n tam thu agen pen, Peter in bangchibang shina thuoh a Pasian apahtawi ding ahiei, chi agenna ahi. Jesu’n tam thute agen zouin akungah “Kei hing zui in,” achi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter akinuahei leh Jesu’n nuazui a itpa, nitah ann neh lai a, a anga kingam a “Mangpa koi ahiei Nang hing mansah ding?” chipain hing zuiin amu hi.","ref":"Jn. 13.25"},"21":{"text":"Peter in amapa amu tah in Jesu kungah, “Mangpa tam mipa’n bang abawl diei?” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Jesu’n akungah, “Ka hing pei masangsie dam a umden dingin dei leng, nang bang phatmawna a um ei? Nang hing zui in,” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam nuazuipa khu shilou ding ahi chiin unaute lah ah tam thu kigen akithangta hi, Jesu’n lah ama ashi sih ding achi sih a, “Ama ka hing pei masangsie dam a umden dingin dei leng, nang bang phatmawna a um ei,” achi ahizaw hi."},"24":{"text":"Tam silte theisahpa leh tam thute gielpa khu tam nuazuipa ahi, tualeh athu theisah khu adih ahi chi ithei hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu’n abawl sil lamdang tampi zong a um nalai hi, tuate gelkim sieng ding hileh laibu kigiel dingte khu leitung pumpi in zong dawl zou dingin ka gingta sih hi. Amen."}}}}},"44":{"info":{"name":"Nasepte","shortname":"Nasep.","abbr":[],"desc":"Sawltate nasepte"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw Theopilus, ka laigel masa pen ah, Jesu nasep chiil a kipata anasep leh thuhil zousie ka giel hi.","title":"Thumapui","ref":"Luk. 1.1-4"},"2":{"text":"Hagau Siengthou panpina a, sawltah atelte kunga thupieh achiem zou a, van a puitou a aum ni donga thu ahi ka gel."},"3":{"text":"Gentheina athuoh nuain sawltahte kungah theichienna zuoulou tampiin, hingin akimusah a, ni sawmli tangchim akung uah akilah a, Pasian gam thu toh kisai agenden hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute toh kipawlkhawm zelin, Jerusalem nusie sih unlen, “Pa thuchiem ka gensa na zah uh khu ngah un chin thu apie hi.","ref":"Luk. 24.49"},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen Johan in tuiin ahing baptis a, hinanleh tua kipat ni sawtlou sungin Hagau Siengthou a baptis na hi ding uh,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 3.11; Mak. 1.8; Luk. 3.16; Jn. 1.33"},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaute ahing kikhawm ua, akungah “Mangpa tuin ahiei Israelte kunga leenggam na tunding kia ding?” chi’n adong uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Aman akung uah, “Pain ahun leh ani Ama thu thua um dinga aguot, noute thei ding ahisih hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh na tung ua Hagau Siengthou ahing tun chiengin silbawltheina na nei ding ua, Jerusalem khuo ah, Judia gam leh Samaria gam zousie ah, tualeh kawlmong dongin ka thu theipite na hi ding uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 28.19; Mak. 16.15; Luk. 24.47,48"},"9":{"text":"Tam thute agen zouin, amitmu ngel uah van ah lahtouin a um a, tuachia aetlai un, meilum in amu phahlou uah apuitouta hi.","title":"Jesu van a akaltouna (Mak. 16.19 ; Luk. 24.50 , 51)","ref":"Mak. 16.19; Luk. 24.50,51"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh van a akaltou lai mitphelou a aet zing lai un, mi ni puon vam silin akung uah ahing ding ua;"},"11":{"text":"Tua mi nite’n amaute kungah, “Nou Galili mite bangding a, vanlam en a dingden na hi uoi? Tam Jesu mama na kung ua kipat a, van a puitou a um, van a akaltou na mu bang ngelngel un, Ama ngel hing peikia ding ahi,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Olive muol achi ua kipat in Jerusalem khuo ah ahing peikia uhi, tua Olive muol khu Jerusalem khuo toh kinai ahia, Sabbath ni a peitheina tan bep ahi.","title":"Sawltah asawm leh nina guotna (Luk. 24.52)"},"13":{"text":"Amauh khopi ahing lut tah un, aumna uh Inndan tungnung ah akaltou uhi. Amaute khu, Peter, Jakob, Johan, Andru, Philip leh Thomas; Bartholomai leh Mathiu, Alphai tapa Jakob leh Simon Zealot leh Jakob tapa Juda ahi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 10.2-4; Mak. 3.16-19; Luk. 6.14-16"},"14":{"text":"Tam mite zousie leh numeite leh Jesu nu Mari toh Jesu sanggamte toh lungsim munkhat puain phatuom ngaitahin thu angen khawm uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ni in Peter nuazuite lah ah adingtou a (abawn un za leh sawmni vel a hi ua.)","title":"Mathias ateldona uh (Mat. 27.7 , 8)"},"16":{"text":"“Mite leh Sanggamte aw, masanglai a Hagau Siengthou in David kam a, Jesu mante lamkai a pangpa Juda tungtang thu Laisiengthou in ana gensa khu ahing tangtung ding mawng ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen amapa ilah ua simtel ahi a, tami nasepna ah zong tan anei hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuin tam mipa’n agitlouna thamanin mun khat alei a, abungbusipin akie a, agilpi apohkeh a, agilzam zousie alawtkhie hi.","ref":"Mat. 27.3-8"},"19":{"text":"Tua thupen Jerusalema um zousiein ana thei ua, tuachi’n tuamun khu amauh ham in Akeldama achi uhi. (Tua khu sisan mun china ahi.)"},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen late bu sungah: Ama umna suhgam in um henlen; asungah koima um sih heh; tualeh alamkai hina midangin luota heh, chiin akigiel hi.","ref":"Late. 69.25; Late. 109.8"},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa Jesu eite lah a lut leh pawt a a um sung sie a,","ref":"Mat. 3.16; Mak. 1.9; Luk. 3.21; Mak. 16.19; Luk. 24.51"},"22":{"text":"Johan baptisma akipat a, ilah ua kipata van a puitou a aum ni donga, eita hing na kithuopite lah a mi khat, athawkiana hing theipi dingin a um ngeingei ding ahi, achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi ni aguot ua, khat khu Joseph Barsaba (amindang Justus achipa uh) tualeh khat khu Mathias ahi.”"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh thu angen ua, “Mangpa Nang mihing zousie lungtang theipa, tam mi nite lah ah koizawh ahiei na tel hing theisah in,"},"25":{"text":"Juda lah ama umna mun ngai ah apei a, tami nasepna leh sawltah hina khelna zieh a apuasanna mun luo dingin,” achi uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh ai asan ua, a ai san u’khu Mathias tungah a tu a, tuachi’n ama khu sawltah sawm leh khatte lah a simtel ahita hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Pentikos ni ahing tunin a bawn un mun khat ah lungsim mun khat puoin a umkhawm uhi.","title":"Hagau Siengthou piehna","ref":"Siempu. 23.15-21; Danp. 16.9-11"},"2":{"text":"Thakhat in huipi hat tah laang banga ging, van a kipat ahing um phut a, atouna inn sung uh adim siengta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n leite ama leh ama kihawmzahin meikuong bangin atung uah khat chiet in ahing tuta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh abawn un Hagau Siengthouin adimta ua, Hagauin ahamsah bangbangin ham tuom in ahing hamta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuin van nuoi nam chin lah a kipat Pasian ngaisah Judate, Jerusalem ah a um uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tua husa ging azah tahun, mipi tampi ahing peikhawm ua, athugente uh mi zousie in amauh hamchiet a azah tah un alungbuoita uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n abawn un lamdang asa ua, amangbang uhi. “En vawi un, tana hamte zousie Galili gam mi ngen hilou ahi uoi mah?"},"8":{"text":"Bangchidan ahiei ibawnpi ua eima pienpi ham chiet a izah valong uh?"},"9":{"text":"Pawlkhat Parthia mite, Medes mite, Elam mite, Mesopotamia gama umte, Kappadosia gama umte, Judia gam a umte, Pontius gam a umte, Asia gam a umte,"},"10":{"text":"Phrigia gam a umte, Pamphilia gama umte Izipt gama umte, tualeh sairin gam kimvel a Libia gamkai a umte ihi ua, tualeh pawlkhatte Rome akipat khuolzin Juda mi leh abieh dan uh zuite ihi uhi,"},"11":{"text":"Pawl khatte Krit gam leh Arab gam mi bang ihi ua, hinanleh Pasian silbawl thupi agen uh eima ham chietin iza uhi,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh abawn un lamdang asa ua, angaina theilouin “Bangchi dan adiei?” chi’n, khat leh khat akidong uhi."},"13":{"text":"Pawlkhat in “El houin uoin tha kham hibou uh e,” achi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter khu sawm leh khatte toh ading khawm a, aw ngaitah in amaute kungah, thu agen a, “Nou Judia gam mite leh Jerusalem khuo a um zousiete aw, Tam thu thei unlen, ka thu zong ngaikhie un.","title":"Pentikos ni a Peter thugen"},"15":{"text":"Tam miten na gintat bangun zu akham sih uhi, vaihamsang ahi pan hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh tamte guolnei Joel in ana gen hing tangtung ahizaw hi:"},"17":{"text":"Pasian in ni nukhiate ah, tambang ahing hi ding: Mizousie tungah, ka Hagau ka sungbaw dinga, Na tapate u’leh, na tanute un ka thu agen ding ua, na tangvalte un mengmute amu ding ua, Na putehte un Mang amanding uhi, achi hi.","ref":"Joel. 2.28-32"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh ka suohpate leh, ka suohnute tungah zong, Ka Hagau ka sungbaw dinga amauten ka thu agen ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tunglam van ah sil lamdangte, nuoilam lei ah chiemtenate, Sisan leh mei leh meikhu hu, ka musah ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mangpa ni thupi leh, minthangtah ahing tun masangin, Ni a miel dinga, hapi sisan asuoh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh tambang ahi dinga, Koizong Mangpa min lou tapou, hundam ahi ding hi, achi hi, chi’n ana genta hi."},"22":{"text":"“Nou Israel mite aw, tam thu na ngai un, Nazareth Jesu, Pasian in Ama zangin na lah uah sil lamdangte sil thupite leh chiemtenate bawlin Pasian midih ahi chi noute lah ah akilangsahta hi, noute mama in zong na thei uhi."},"23":{"text":"Jesu khu Pasian lemguotsa leh theikholsa bangin noute khut a piehkhiet ahi a, nouten danbei a gamta migiloute khut in kross ah na kilbeh ua na thatta uhi.","ref":"Mat. 27.35; Mak. 15.24; Luk. 23.33; Jn. 19.18"},"24":{"text":"Ama khu Pasian in shina gahnate sutpiehin akaithouta hi, shina tuhden guol ahilou zieh in.","ref":"Mat. 28.5,6; Mak. 16.6; Luk. 24.5"},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen David in Ama tungthu ana gen a: Mangpa khu ka masangah bangchihlai pouin, ka mu ngitnget hi, Suhling a ka um louna dingin, ka zietlam ah a um hi.","ref":"Late. 16.8-11"},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka lungtangin nuom asa a, tualeh ka lei zong akipah hi; Tuathamlouin ka tahsa zong, kinem tahin akhawldam hi."},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen ka hinna mishi khuo ah, na nuasie sih dinga, Na misiengthoupa zong, amuot ding na phal sih ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Nangman hinna lampite Na hing theisahta a, Na hing umpi zieh in lungnopna toh, na hing sudim ding hi, ana chi hi."},"29":{"text":"“Mite leh sanggamte aw, ahing suongtu David thu hangsan tahin na kung uah ka gen thei hi, ama pen ashita, vui zong avuita uh, ahan zong tu dongin ikung uah aum na lai hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama khu guolnei ahi a, tahsa dan a, ama hahlesuona Mangtoupha a tou ding, Khrist, ka hing tungdoh ding chi’n Pasian in kihahsiel in agen hi, chi athei hi.","ref":"Late. 132.11; 2 Sam. 7.12,13"},"31":{"text":"Aman tam thu ana theikholsa ahi ziehin, Khrist thawkia ding thu ana gen hi. Ama mishikhuo ah nuasie in a um sih a, aluong zong amuot sih hi, achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tam Jesu khu Pasian in akaithou kiata ngei a, ka unpi un tuami theipite ka hi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian khut zietlam ah pahtawi in a um a, Hagau Siengthou chiem khu Pa kunga kipat in amu a, na mu uleh na zah uh khu ahing sungbuo ahi."},"34":{"text":"David pen van ah akaltou sih hi, ama mama in: Mangpa’n ka Mangpa kungah, ka ziet lam ah touin,","ref":"Late. 110.1"},"35":{"text":"Na melmate na kengphang ngahna a, ka bawl masangsiein, achi hi, ana chizaw hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jesu na kilbehpa ngel u’khu, Pasian in Mang leh Khrist in abawlta chi, Israel nam zousiein chientah in thei u’heh,” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Amaun tam thu azah tahun, alungtang uh sut bangin ahing nata a, Peter leh sawltah dangte kungah, “Mite leh unaute aw, bang ka bawlta ding uoi?” achi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in akung uah, “Kisia in lunghei unlen, na khelna uh ngaidam ahina dingin, Jesu Khrist min in baptisma tang chietun, tuachi’n Hagau Siengthou silpieh na tang ding uhi."},"39":{"text":"Athuchiem khu nouma dingin zong na tate uh dingin zong, gamla tah a umte dingin zong, Mangpa Pasian in ahat poumate dingin zong ahi,” achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tualeh thudang tampi in ahilchien a, “Tulai khangtha giloute lah ah kihumbit un,” chiin ahantawh hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n athu kipahtah a pom pouma in, baptisma atang chiet ua, tua niin mi tul thum vela belap in a um uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh sawltahte thuhil leh kipawlkhawmna ah, tanghou aphalsuo ua, phatuomngaitaha thungen in a um zing uhi.","title":"Hattuom masate"},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi zousie tungah zauna ahing uma, sawltahten sillamdang leh chiemtena tampi abawl uhi."},"44":{"text":"Agingta zousie akipumkhat ua a umkhawm ua, bangkim akikop uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 4.32-35"},"45":{"text":"Tualeh asil nei zousie uh azua ua, akitahsapna bangun a unpi lah uah ahawm zel uhi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n ni chinin lungsim munkhat puoin Pasian biehinn ah, phatuom ngaitahin a um zel ua, a inn lam na ngawn uah zong tanghou phalsuoin kipahtah leh lungkim tahin a ann uh ane zel uhi,"},"47":{"text":"Pasian phat in mi zousien deisahna atang uhi. Tualeh hundamna hing mu poumate, Mangpa’n ni chinin abelappieh zel hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat nai kuona, thunget hun lai in Peter leh Johan biehinn ah apeitou uhi.","title":"Peter in kengbai asuhdamna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh apien chiil a kipat kengbai koi ahiei pasal khat ahing puo ua, tua mipa khu bieh inn a lutte kunga khutdaw dingin biehinn “Kotpi hoi” kichi bul ah nichinin alumsah zel uhi."},"3":{"text":"Aman, Peter leh Johan biehinn huongsung a lut ding amu a, khut ana daw hi."},"4":{"text":"Peter in Johan toh kengbaipa a ensaal den ua, “Koute gel hing en vawi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman amautegel apat bang ahiei mu kinem in a en hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in, “Dangka leh sana bangma ka nei sih, hinanleh ka neisun ka hing pe ding; Nazareth Jesu Khrist min in thou inlen, kengin pei in,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi kawm in akhut zietlam a tuin akaithou a, thakhat in akengte leh asiehmitgute, ahing hatpai ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n amapa adingdoh a akengin apeita hi, tualeh akenga pei a, dieng dieng kawm leh Pasian phat kawmin, amautegel toh bieh inn huongsungah alutta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh akenga apei leh Pasian apahtawi mi zousie’n amu uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun biehinn kotpi hoi bul a khutdaw a tou zelpa ahi chi athei ua, a tunga siltung lamdang sa sengsengin achiza vawt uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh kengbai hing dampain Peter leh Johan akhuttuh lai in mi zousie in lamdang asa sengseng ua, Solomon innliep achi uah ahing taikhawm uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachia Peter in tua khu amu tahin mipite ahoupi a, “Nou Israel mite aw, bangdinga tami lamdangsa na hi uoi mah? Ahisihleh kouma silbawltheina leh Pasian ka ngaisah zieh ua, ama ka peisah uh bang hiel a hing en na hi uoi?","title":"Biehinn a Peter thugen"},"13":{"text":"Abraham, Isaak leh Jakobte Pasian ipu leh pate Pasian in, atapa Jesu atawisangta ahi. Ama na mansah ua, Pilat in ha a, peisah atup lai nangawn a zong amai tanga na nuol vevawpa uh ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 3.15"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten Misiengthoupa leh Dihtatpa na deisih ua, tuolthatpa khat hing ha pieh dingin na ngenzaw uhi.","ref":"Mat. 27.15-23; Mak. 15.6-14; Luk. 23.13-23; Jn. 19.12-15"},"15":{"text":"Hinna siempa na that ua, hinanleh Pasian in Ama khu mishi lah akipat in akaithou kia a, koute tuami theipite ka hi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ama min agintat ziehin, Amin in tam mipa na mu u’leh na thei uh khu asuhatta hi; Ahi, Jesu zieha ginna hing um in, na un ua mitmuin asudam sieng vilvelta hi."},"17":{"text":"“Hinanleh unaute aw, na lamkaite un ana bawl bangun na theiloupi ua tambanga bawl na hi uh chi ka thei hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in a guolneite zousie kam a, Khrist in genthei athuoh ngei ding ahi chi ana genlawhsa khu tambangin atangtung sahta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin kisia unlen, na khelnate uh phietmang ahi theina dingin Mangpa lam ah kihei un, tuachi’n, Mangpa kunga kipat in halna hun ahing tung thei dinga;"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu Khrist noute a dinga aguotsa khu ahing sawl ding hi;"},"21":{"text":"Bangkim bawlhoi hun atun masangsie, van in Ama akem tadi ding a, tuo bawlhoi hun pen Pasian in leitung kisiemchil apat a, aguolnei Siengthoute zousie kam in ana gensa diem ahita hi."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen Mosi in ipu ipate kungah, Mangpa Pasian in, Keima ahing siem bangin, na unaute lah ah guolnei khat ahing siem pieh ding, Aman thu zousie na kung ua agen pouma na ngaikhietpieh ding uhi.","ref":"Danp. 18.15,18"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh hichi ahi dinga, mi koipou tua guolnei thugen ngaikhe lou pouma mipite lah akipat suhmang ahi ding uh achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 18.19"},"24":{"text":"Ahi, Samuel um akipat a guolnei zousie leh anua a, guolnei um zousie thu ana gen pouma in tulai hun ding ana genlawh chiet uhi."},"25":{"text":"Noute, guolneite leh thuhun tate na hi uh, Pasian in Abraham kungah, nahah nasuonte ziehin leitunga innkuon zousie guolzawl in umva uh, chiin ipu ipate kungah achiem hi.","ref":"Siem. 22.18"},"26":{"text":"Pasian in a Tapa Jesu kaithouin, na khelnate uh kiheisansah ding leh guolzawl dingin, noute kungah ahing sawl masapen hi,” achi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Peter leh Johan in mite kunga thu agen lai un, siempute leh biehinn veng galkap lamkaipa leh Saddukaite akung uah ahing pei ua,","title":"Peter leh Johan vaihawmte masanga adinna uh"},"2":{"text":"Sawltahten Jesu zala mishi laha kipat a thawkiana thu mite ahil ziehun, alungkimta sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh aman ua, nitahlam ahi ziehin, azingni tandongin suongkul ah akhumta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh, thu ngaikhete lah a mi tampi in atahsang ua, atam lam uh pasal ngen tulnga vel apha uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh azingniin a vaihawmte u’leh upate leh laigiel mite,","title":"Juda vaihawmte mai a Peter thugen (Late. 118.22)"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh siempu lien Annas, Kaiapha, Johan leh Alexander leh siempu lienpa innkuonte zousie, Jerusalem ah akikhawm uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh amaun Peter leh Johan alai uah ading sah ua, “Bang thuneina leh bang min a tambang na bawl uh ahiei?” chi’n adong uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter khu Hagau Siengthouin adim a, “Nou vaihawm mite leh Israel upate aw,"},"9":{"text":"Kouten tunia mi hatlou khat tunga silhoi ka bawlna u’leh amapa bangchidan a hing damdoh ahiei chi na hing doh uleh;"},"10":{"text":"Noute, zousie leh Israel mite zousiein zong thei un, Nazareth Jesu Khrist kross a na killuppa uh, Pasian in mishi lah akipat akaithou kia a Ama min ngelngel in tam mipa na bawn ua masangah dam in adingta hi."},"11":{"text":"Nou innlam miten na suong deilou uh, aninga suong poimawpen kichi khu Ama ahi.","ref":"Late. 118.22"},"12":{"text":"Midang koima kungah hundamna a um sih, van nuoia mihingte kunga kipie min lah ah, ei hing hundam ding min dang mawngmawng a um sih hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaun Peter leh Johan hansan dan amu tah un, laisiemlou leh mi mawltah ahi uh chi athei ua, lamdang asa mama ua, Jesu kungah ana umta uh chi atheita uhi.","title":"Sanhedrinten thugen lou dingin thu apie uh"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh ami suhdampa uh amautegel kunga ding amu un, bangmain asoisel thei tuon sih uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh vaihawmpawl toukhawmte apata apei tuomsah nua un, thu akikum uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Tam mite bang ilawta ding uoi? Sil lamdang minthang abawl uh Jerusalem khuo a um zousie in kichientah in atheita ua, eiten zong iniel thei tuom sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh tam thu mite kunga akithan belap nawn louna dingin, tukalsie tam mipa mina, koima kunga thu gen nawnlou dingin, khautah in vau vai,” akichi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n amautegel ahan ua, Jesu min a thu gen kia nawn lou ding leh hilkia nawn lou ding in thu apeta uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter leh Johan in akung uah, Pasian mitmuin, “Pasian thu man sangin noute thu man adih zaw diei mah? nouten ngaisut un."},"20":{"text":"Kouten ka sil mute u’leh ka zahte uh, gen louin ka um thei sih uhi,” achi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun amautegel khau zawsem a vau toh ha athuo uhi, mipite ziehin gawtna lemtang amu sih uhi; asil bawl zieh un mi zousie in Pasian apahtawita uhi."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen lamdangtah a suhdam a umpa khu kum sawmli sanga upa zaw ahita hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Peter leh Johan kihakhiet tah un, aguolte uh kungah apei ua, siempu liente leh upaten agen zousie uh ahilta uhi.","title":"Sawltahten hansanna angen uh"},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten tua thu azah tah un, lungsim munkhat puoin aw ngai tah in Pasian kungah, “Mangpa Nang van leh lei tualeh tuipi leh asunga um zousie siempa Pasian na hi;","ref":"Pawt. 20.11; Neh. 9.6; Late. 146.6"},"25":{"text":"Nang na suohpa David kam in Hagau Siengthou in thu na gen a. Bangchidan a namte lungthah a, bangdinga mipiten, sil phatuomlou angaituo uh ahiei?","ref":"Late. 2.1,2"},"26":{"text":"Leitung kumpipate pangkhawmin ading ua, Mangpa leh Khrist dou in, vaihawm mite akikhawm uhi; achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Adihtah in, na Suohpa Siengthou, na thaunu Jesu dou in, tami khopi sungah Herod leh Pontius Pilat leh Jentelte leh Israel mite akikhawm uhi.","ref":"Luk. 23.7-11; Mat. 27.1,2; Mak. 15.1; Luk. 23.1; Jn. 18.28,29"},"28":{"text":"Nangma deina leh na khutin bawl dinga atup leh na guotlawhsa pouma bawl dingin."},"29":{"text":"Tuin Mangpa aw, koute ahing vaunate en inlen, na suohten hangsantaha na thu agen theina ding uh pie in."},"30":{"text":"Na suoh Siengthou Jesu min zal a chinate damsah ding leh chiemtenate leh sil lamdangte, abawl theina dingun na khut hing zah nalai in,” achi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh athum zou un, a umkhawmna mun uh ahing kilinga, tualeh abawn un Hagau Siengthouin ahing dim siengta ua, Pasian thu hangsan tahin agenta uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuin agingta mipite khu, lungsim munkhat leh ngaituona munkhat in a um ua, alah ua khat in zong a sil neite khu kei a tuom ahi achi sih a, sil zousie akitaang zel zaw uhi.","title":"Jerusalem khuo a hattuomte","ref":"Nasep. 2.44,45"},"33":{"text":"Tualeh sawltahten silbawltheina thupitah toh, Mangpa Jesu thawkiana theipina thu agen gen ua a, a unpi ua tungah khotuona thupitah a um hi."},"34":{"text":"Alah uah koima tasam a um sih ua, gamte, ahisihleh innte, anei tapouin azua ua, akhotna sumte uh ahing tawi ua,"},"35":{"text":"Sawltahte keng bulah ahing koi zel uhi, tualeh mi khat poupou in tahsap anei chiengin akihawm chiet zel uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tualeh Joses sawltahten Barnaba achi uh (amin khiehna ahileh kihantawhna tapa china ahi) Levimi Saipras tuikuolkhum gam mi ahi a,"},"37":{"text":"Agam nei khu azua a, asum ahing tawi a, sawltahte keng bul ah akoita hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh mi khat amin Anania in azi Saphira toh aneisa khat uh azua ua;","title":"Anania leh Saphira khelna leh shina"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aman sekhat ama a dingin a im a, azi in zong athei hi, tualeh sekhat hing tawi in sawltahte keng bul ah akoi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter in, “Anania Hagau Siengthou sol ding leh gam man sekhat im ding a, Setan in na lungtang aluodim bangchidan ahiei?"},"4":{"text":"Gam khu zua lou a aum lai in, nanga hilou ahiei mah? na zua nua in zong nangma thuthu hinalai lou ahiei mah? Bangdinga tambang sil bawl dinga na lungtang a ngaituo na hiei? Mihing sol na hi sih a, Pasian sol na hi zaw hi,” achi hi."},"5":{"text":"Anania in tam thu azah tahin apua a, ashita hi. Tuachi’n tam thu za zousie azau mama ta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n tangvalte akipan ua, Anania luong atuom ua, azawngdoh ua, avuita uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh naikal thum ding vel nuain, bang sil tung ahiei chi theiloupi in azi ahing lut hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in akungah, “Hing hil in gam na zuana uh hiza bep ma ahi na amah” chiin adonga, amanu’n “Hi hiza bep ma hina,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in akungah, “Bangchidan a, Mangpa Hagau ze et ding a kithutuoh na hi uoi? Ngai in, na pasal vuite keng kotkhah bul ah ahing tungta, nang zong ahing zawng ding uhi,” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuatahin akeng bulah apua pai a ashita hi. Tuachi’n tangvalte ahing lut ua, amanu shisa in amu ua, azawng doh ua, apasal kungah avuita uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin hattuom zousie leh tam thu za kha pouma nasatahin azauta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in Sawltahte khutin mite lahah, chiemtena leh sillamdang tampi abawl hi. Tualeh amaute abawn un lungsim munkhat puoin Solomon innliep ah a um uhi.","title":"Sawltahten chiemtena leh sillamdang abawlna uhi"},"13":{"text":"Ahinlah alah uah koima atel ngamta sih uhi; hinanleh miten amaute pahtatna lienpi anei uhi."},"14":{"text":"Gingtha mi apung semsem ua, numei leh pasal tampi Mangpa kungah ahing kibelap deudeu uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n miten chinate ahing zawpi ua, gawlzingte ah lupnate leh pheh tungte ah alumsah uhi; Peter ahing pei chienga ahim beeh mi pawlkhat tunga tu a alie theina dingin, abawl uhi."},"16":{"text":"Jerusalem kim a khuote akipat in zong mipite ahing peikhawm ua damloute leh dawibuain asuhgentheite ahing pui ua, amaute zousie suhdamin a um uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Siempu lien leh alawmte akisa ua ahing pei ua (alawmte khu Saddukai pawl ahi uhi,) thangsietna in adim uhi;","title":"Sawltahte suongkul apat lamdang tah a asuohtatna uh"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Sawltahte aman ua, mi vantang khumna suongkul ah akhum uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh zanlai in Mangpa vansawlsieng khat in suongkul kotkhate ahing honga, amauh apuidoh a, akung uah,"},"20":{"text":"“Pei unlen Biehinn sung ah ding unlen, mipite kungah tam hinna thu zousie va gen un,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tam thu azah tahun, zingmawng matahin bieh inn ah ava lut ua, thu ahilta uhi. Hinanleh siempu lien leh a lawmte ahing pei ua, vaihawmte leh Israel tate upate zousie ahan khawm ua, sawltahte va pui dingin suongkul ah mi asawl uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh biehinn veng lamkaite ava pei ua, suongkul ah amaute ava muta sih ua, ahing kinuale kiata uhi."},"23":{"text":"“Suongkul bittah a kikhain leh avengmite zong kotkhah bul a ding ka mu ua, hinanleh ka hon uleh asung ah koima ka mu sih uhi,” chiin agen uhi."},"24":{"text":"Siempu lienpen leh biehinn veng lamkaipa tualeh siempu lienten tam thu azah un lamdang asa ua, bang thu ahing thangdoh ta bep diei izaw, achi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi khat ahing pei a, akung uah, “En un, suongkul a na mikhumte un, biehinn ah dingin mi ahil uhi,” chiin ahing gen hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n biehinn veng galkap lamkaipa leh galkap lamkaite ava pei ua, mipite agiin zieh un, thagumsuo louin ahing zawpi uhi, tuahisihleh suonga se ahi kha ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh amauh ahing pui tung tah un, vaihawm pawlte mai ah adingsah ua, tuachi’n siempu lien in akung uah."},"28":{"text":"“Tampa min a thu hil nawn lou dingin thu khautahin ka hing peta uh hilou amah? Thei un, na thu hil un Jerusalem khuo na sudim siengta uhi, tualeh tam mipa asisan phuba koute tunga hing khuhsah sawm na hi uh,” achi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 27.25"},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter leh Sawltah dangten adawng ua, “Mihing thu sangin Pasian thu ka man zawh ding uh ahi,” achi uhi.","title":"Vaihawmte mai a sawltahte thugen"},"30":{"text":"Nouten singa na khai ua, na thapa uh Jesu, ipu ipate Pasian in akaithouta hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama khu Pasian in leengtapa leh hundampa hi dingin azietlam ah apahtawita a, Israelte kunga kisia a lungheina leh khel ngaidamna pe dingin."},"32":{"text":"Koute tam thute theipimite ka hi uhi, Pasian in Ama thu zuite pouma kunga apieh, Hagau siengthou zong Ama theipipa ahi."},"33":{"text":"Amauten tam thu azah tah un, alungthah mama ua, sawltahte tha atumta uhi.","title":"Gamlielin athuhilna"},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n vaihawm mite lah a Pharisai mi khat amin Gamiliel, dan hil sie, mi zousiein a zatat mama uh, adingdoh a pulam a sawltahte hun tomnoukhat puidoh tadi dingin thu apie hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh amaute kungah, “Nou Israel mite aw, tam mite tunga na sil bawl sawm uh pilvang un."},"36":{"text":"Tu masangin zong Theuda milien ka hi chi ahing um a, mi zali velin anua azui uhi. Ama tha in a um a, ama muonga zuite akithezah siengta ua, bangma ahita sih uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tua mipa nuain minkhum lai in Galili gam mi Juda ahing um kia a, akungah mi tampi ahip a hinanleh Ama zong amangthangta a, Ama muonga zuite zong akikhenzahta uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin noute kungah ka gen ahi, tam mite apat kihemkhie unlen, hichiin umsah kuom unlen, hata un, asil tup uleh asilbawlte uh mihing akipan ahileh, bangma louin ahing mang ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian akipan ahileh, na sumang zou sih ding uhi, Tuachilouin pen Pasian dou nahi kha zaw ding uhi.”"},"40":{"text":"Tualeh athugen khu pha asata ua, tuachi’n sawltahte ahan ua, ajep ua, ajep zou un, Jesu min a thu gen kia nawnlou dingin thu apie ua, ahata uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauh vaihawmte lah a kipat in apawtkhie ua, Jesu min zieh a zumna thuohtah a guot ahi zieh un akipah mama uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh nichin in Pasian biehinn leh inn chin ah Jesu khu Khrist ahi chia thuhil leh gen akhawl thei sih uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun lai a nuazuite ahing pun semsem laiun, ani china asil hawm thu uah, Greek ham zang meithaite na nelsie uhi chiin, Greek ham zang Judate Hebrute tungah aphun ta uhi.","title":"Upa masate telna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n sawm leh niten nuazui mipite ahankhawm ua, “Pasian thugen tawpsan a, nehletah ka sai uh adih sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin unaute aw, na lah ua Hagau Siengthou leh pilna adim, mi min hoi ngen sagi tel unlen, amaute tam nna sem dinga ka guot theina dingun, achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Koute pen thum leh thu nasem in ka um zom den zaw ding uhi,” achi uhi,"},"5":{"text":"Tua thuin mi zousie akipahsaha, tuachi’n Stephen ginna leh Hagau Siengthou a dim toh, Philip leh Prokora toh, Nikanor leh Timon toh Parmena leh Judate biehdan zui Antiok khuo a mi Nikola toh atel uhi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute khu sawltahte masangah a ding sah ua, tualeh thumna neiin, atung uah akhut uh anga uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian thu ahing kithedal semsem a, Jerusalem khuo ah nuazuite apungta mama ua, tuachi’n siempute lah ah zong mi tampi ginna lam ah athumangta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Stephen ginna leh silbawltheina a dimin, mite lah ah sillamdang leh chiemtena thupi tahte abawl zel hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n zalensah mite kikhopna inn kichi akipat Sairin khuo a mite Alexandria khuo a mite leh Silisia leh Asia gam a kipat Judate pawl khat ahing kisa ua, Stephen ahing kinielpi uhi.","title":"Stephen vaihawmte masanga adinna"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh apilna leh Hagau zal a athugente anielkhe theita sih uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten simtham in mi achiil ua, “Stephen in Mosi leh Pasian agensiet lam ka za uhi,” achisah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh amauten mipite, upate leh laigiel mite achiilsie ua, Stephen amansah ua, vaihawmte kungah ahing pui uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amauten theipi zuoutheite abawl ua, tua miten, “Tam mipa’n mun siengthou leh dan agensie ngitnget hi achi uhi;"},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen tami Nazareth Jesu’n tami mun siengthou asuse dinga, Mosi in dan ahing piehte asulamdang ding hi, chia agen kaza uhi,” achi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n vaihawmna a toute zousiein Stephen khu a en sal chiet ua, amel khu vansawlsieng mel bangin amu uhi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu lien in, “Tam thute adih ahina amah?” achi hi.","title":"Vaihawmna masanga Stephen thugen"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Stephen in unaute leh pate aw, “Ngai un, ipu uh Abraham, Haran khuo a aum masanga Mesapotamia gam a a um lai in, thupina Pasian khu akungah ahing kilah a,","ref":"Siem. 12.1"},"3":{"text":"Akungah na gam leh na innkuonpite lah a kipat hing peidoh inlen, keiman ka hing etsah ding gam ah hing pei in achi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama Kaldaite gam a kipat apeidoh a, Haran ah atengta hi. Tualeh apa shi nuain, Pasian in khuna pat in, tu a na tenna gam uah ahing pemlut sahta hi.","ref":"Siem. 11.31; Siem. 12.4"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh tam gam ah Pasian in ama mun luo ding ape sih a, akeng tatna ding khop nangawn ape sih hi. Hinanleh Abraham in ta aneilou lai nangawnin, Pasian in ama goutan ding leh anua a ahah asuonte goutan dingin pieh achiem hi.","ref":"Siem. 12.7; 13.15; 15.18; 17.8"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in tambangin agen hi, ahah asuonte mi gam ah atam ding ua, suohin akhawi ding ua, kum zali sung asugenthei ding uhi.","ref":"Siem. 15.13,14"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in, suoh a aumna ding uh nam khu keiman ka gawt dinga, tuazou chiengin ahing pawlkhe ding ua, tam mun ah ka nna asem ding uh, achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 3.12"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in akungah, teptan thuhun apie hi, tuachi’n Abraham in Isaak ahinga ani giet ni in atep atan hi; tuachi’n Isaak in Jakob ahing a, Jakob in chi suong mi sawm leh nite ahing hi.","ref":"Siem. 17.10-14; Siem. 21.2-4; Siem. 25.26; Siem. 29.31—35.18"},"9":{"text":"“Tualeh chi suong miten thangsietna a hing nei ua, Joseph khu Izipt gam ah azuata uhi. Hinanleh Pasian in Joseph a umpi a;","ref":"Siem. 37.11; Siem. 37.28; Siem. 39.2,21"},"10":{"text":"Agentheina zousie apat ahunkhe zel a, Izipt leengpa Pharaoh mitmu ah deisahna leh pilna apie a, tuachi’n ama khu Izipt gam leh a inn sung mite tungah uhpipa in abawl hi.","ref":"Siem. 41.39-41"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Izipt gam pumpi leh Kanaan gam ah kiel ahing tunga, gimthuohna nasatah ahing umta a, ipu ipate un neh ding mawngmawng amuta sih uhi.","ref":"Siem. 42.1,2"},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Jakob in Izipt gam ah bu a um chi azahtah in ipute uh asawldoh a, tuakhu apei masahna pen uh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh anivei peina uah, Joseph in asanggamte akitheisah a, tualeh Joseph sanggamte khu Pharaoh atheisahta uhi.","ref":"Siem. 45.1; Siem. 45.16"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Joseph in apa Jakob leh a innkuonte han dingin mi a sawl a, tualeh a innkuonte abawn un sawmsagi leh nga, ahi uhi.","ref":"Siem. 45.9,10,17,18; Siem. 46.27"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jakob khu Izipt gam ah apeisuh a, tualeh ama leh ipute uh ashita ua,","ref":"Siem. 46.1-7; Siem. 49.33"},"16":{"text":"Aluonguh Sekem khuo ah apotung ua Abraham in Sekem khuo a, Hamor tapate kunga dangka sum a alei, han ah avuita uhi.","ref":"Siem. 23.3-16; 33.19; 50.7-13; Josh. 24.32"},"17":{"text":"“Hinanleh Pasian in Abraham kunga athuchiem atangtunna hun ahing naitahin Izipt gam a imite ahing pung ua, atam deu deu ta ua.","ref":"Pawt. 1.7,8"},"18":{"text":"Joseph thei kha lou leeng dang ahing um masangsie in."},"19":{"text":"Tua leengpa’n imite aze bawl a, ipu ipate uh abawlgenthei a, atangehte uh hing lou dingin apaidoh sah zel hi.","ref":"Pawt. 1.10,11; Pawt. 1.22"},"20":{"text":"Tua hun lai in Mosi apieng a, amel hoi mama a, apa inn sungah ha thum akem uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 2.2"},"21":{"text":"Ama akoidoh tah un, Pharaoh tanu in ala a, ama tapa dingin akemta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 2.3-10"},"22":{"text":"Mosi in Izipt mite pilna zousie azil a, tuachi’n thugen leh silbawl ah, athupi mama hi."},"23":{"text":"“Mosi kum sawmli ahing chin tahin, a unau Israelte ve utna lungsim anei hi.","ref":"Pawt. 2.11-15"},"24":{"text":"Tuabanga ava ve lai in, alah ua mi khat dihloutah a suhgenthei a um amu a, ava hun a, suhgenthei a umpa phuba alah pieh a, Izipt mi khu asatlum ta hi."},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen ama’n ama khut a Pasian in a unaute hundoh ding ahi, chi amaun thei ding asa a, hinanleh amaun athei sih uhi."},"26":{"text":"Azing niin Mosi in Israelmi ni kihau laitah atuohkha a, lawmte aw, unau khat na ve uo le, bangdinga dihloutah a kibawl na hi uoi? chiin lep ava sawm hi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh a innvengpa tunga silgilou bawl zawpa’n Mosi asawndoh a, Koute tunga vaihawm ding leh thukhen dinga nang koiin ahing guot ahiei?"},"28":{"text":"Zanni a Izipt mi na tha banga, hing tha sawm na hiei mah? achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam thu ziehin Mosi ataimangta a, Midian gam ah khuolzin mi bangin ava tamta hi, Tuanah tapa ni ava nei hi.","ref":"Pawt. 18.3,4"},"30":{"text":"“Tualeh kum sawmli abei nuain, Sinai muol gamdai ah vansawlsieng khat sawlbawh meikuong in akungah ava kilah hi.","ref":"Pawt. 3.1-10"},"31":{"text":"Mosi in tuakhu amu tahin, asilmu khu lamdang asa mama a, en dinga ava nai lai in, Mangpa aw in akungah,"},"32":{"text":"Kei na pu napate Pasian, Abraham Pasian, Isaak Pasian leh Jakob Pasian, ka hi, achi hi. Tuachi’n Mosi achitun a, a en ngamta sih hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n akungah, na keng apat na kengdap sut in, na dinna mun lei siengthou ahi."},"34":{"text":"Izipt gam a um ka mite kibawlgenthei dan chientah in ka mu zing a, athum leh maunate u’zong ka zata a, amauh hunkhe dinga, hing peisuh ka hi. Kisa in Izipt gam ah ka hing sawl ding, achi hi."},"35":{"text":"“Tami Mosi khu ahi, koute tunga vaihawm ding leh thukhen dinga nang koi hing guot a hiei? chia a nuolpa uh, sawlbawh lah a akunga hing kilah vansawlsieng khut in, Pasian in ama ngel khu vaihawmpa leh hunkhepa hikhawm dingin asawlta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 2.14"},"36":{"text":"Mosi in Izipt gam a tuipisan leh gamdai ah kum sawmli sung sillamdang leh chiemtenate abawl nuain amauh apuidohta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 7.3; Pawt. 14.21; Kisim. 14.33"},"37":{"text":"Israel tate kunga, Mangpa na Pasian un na unaute lah a kipat in Keima bangbang guolnei khat noute adingin ahing piengsah dinga, Ama thu na ngaikhe ding uhi, chipa khu tam Mosi ahi.","ref":"Danp. 18.15,18"},"38":{"text":"Gamdai a hattuomte lah a umpa, Sinai muol tunga vansawlsiengin ahoupipa leh ipu ipate kunga umpa, eite kunga piehsawn ding a thu hingte lapa khu tam Mosi mama ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 19.1—20.17; Danp. 5.1-33"},"39":{"text":"I ipu ipaten athu azui ut sih ua, anuol ua, tualeh Izipt gam alunggul kia uhi."},"40":{"text":"Amauten Aaron kungah, hing pui dingin pasiente hing bawlpiehin, Izipt gam a kipat a hing puidohpa Mosi lah atanchin ka thei nawn sih uhi, achi uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 32.1"},"41":{"text":"Tua hun lai mama in bawngnou lim akibawl ua, tua bawngnou lim ah kithoinate alan ua, amauh khut suohte tungah anuom ua, alungdamta uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 32.2-6"},"42":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian in amaute akiheisan a van a aasite be dingin aleengatsanta hi. Guolneite laibu ah tambangin akigiel hi. Aw Israel innkuonte, gamdai ah kum sawmli sungin, gantate that in kithoinate leh sillatte, na hing lan ngai uh amah?","ref":"Amos. 5.25-27"},"43":{"text":"Molek biehbuh (puon inn) leh na Pasian uh Remphan ahsi bieh dinga alim na kibawlte uh, na zawng kawi kawi zaw uhi. Tuaziehin ken noute Babilon, khuohen lam ah sal taang dingin, ka hing puimang ding hi."},"44":{"text":"“Ipu ipate un gamdai ah Theipina biehbuh anei uhi. Tuakhu Pasian in Mosi ahil bangbang leh ette ding a alim leh guong amu banga kibawl ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 25.9,40"},"45":{"text":"Tuami biehbuh mama khu ipu ipate hahlesuonten aneiden ua, Joshua lamkaina nuoi ah Jentelte gam ah ahing polut uhi. Pasian in ipu ipate mai ah, tua Jentelte anawtdoh a, David khang dongin tua biehbuh azang uhi.","ref":"Josh. 3.14-17"},"46":{"text":"Tua David in Pasian mitmuin deisahna anga a, Jakob Pasian tenna ding biehbuh bawlpieh ding angen hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.1-16; 1 Khang. 17.1-14"},"47":{"text":"Hinanleh Solomon in tua inn alam zawta hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 6.1-38; 2 Khang. 3.1-17"},"48":{"text":"Ahivang in Tungnungpen khu khuta kilam innte ah ateng sih hi; Guolnei in:"},"49":{"text":"Van ka toupha ahia, leitung ka keng ngapna ahi a, Inn bangchibang na hing bawlpieh ding uoi? Mangpa’n achi hi, ahisihleh ka khawlna mun zong bang ahiei?","ref":"Isai. 66.1,2"},"50":{"text":"Tam silte zousie ka khutin abawl hilou amah? chia ana gen bangin."},"51":{"text":"“Nou milungphengte leh genha, lungtang leh bil vuloute aw, na pu napate uh bawl bangin Hagau Siengthou na doudal ngitnget uhi.","ref":"Isai. 63.10"},"52":{"text":"Na pu napate un guolneite laha koi ahiei abawlgenthei uh? Mi dihtahpa hing pei ding thu genlawhte athat ua, tua mi dihtahpa mansahte leh thatte khu noute mama na hi uhi."},"53":{"text":"Vansawlsiengte pieh sawn dan munapi a, zui loute aw,” achi hi."},"54":{"text":"Tam thute azah tah un, asintang uh akhoita a, Stephen khu ahagiel khumta uhi.","title":"Stephen shina"},"55":{"text":"Hinanleh ama pen Hagau Siengthoua dimin, van lam a en a, Pasian thupina leh Pasian zietlam a Jesu ding amu hi."},"56":{"text":"“Ngai un, van kihongsa ka mu a, Pasian zietlam a Mihing Tapa ding zong ka mu hi,” achi hi."},"57":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute Aw ngaitah in akikou ua, abil uh ahum ua, kithutuoh tahin apangkhawm ua, anot ua;"},"58":{"text":"khuo apat in adeldoh ua, suongin asep ua, tualeh atheipimite’n tangval khat amin Saul kengbul ah apuonte uh akoi uhi."},"59":{"text":"Tualeh, Stephen in, “Mangpa Jesu ka hagau na sangin chia ahat laiin suongin asep uhi.”"},"60":{"text":"Tuachi’n akhupdin a, aw ngaitahin akikou a, “Mangpa tam akhelnate uah, amaute mawpai sin,” achi a, achi zouin a imuta hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Saul in zong Stephen shi khu pha asahpi hi. Tua hun laiin Jerusalem khuo a hattuom umte, nasatahin abawlgenthei panta ua, sawltahte chiloungal Judia leh Samaria gamte ah akithezah siengta uhi.","title":"Khristiante suhgentheina leh adalzahna uh"},"2":{"text":"Pasian a mi kipezou koite ahiei in Stephen avui ua, nahpitahin akap uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Saul in hattuom pawlte asugenthei mama a, innchin ah alut a, numei pasal akaidoh a, suongkul ah akhum zel hi.","ref":"Nasep. 22.4,5; 26.9-11"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n akithezahte khu khochin ah apei ua thu agenta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philip khu Samaria khopi ah apeisuh a, akung uah Khrist thu agenta hi.","title":"Samaria gam a Philip nasep"},"6":{"text":"Mipi tampi in Philip thugen aza ua; chiemtena lamdang abawlte amu ua, lungsim munkhat puoin, angaikhie uhi."},"7":{"text":"Dawibuate aw ngaitah a kikouin mi tampi amatte sunga kipat in ahing pawt ua, tualeh zeng leh Kengbai tampi zong adam uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh tua khopi ah lungnopna thupitah aumta hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh amin Simon kichi mi khat a um a, ama’n milien ka hi chiin tumasang lamin tua khopi ah mitphieldawi zangin Samaria mite lamdangsatahin ana koi leng hi.","title":"Dawisiem Simon"},"10":{"text":"Mi zousie aneupen apat alienpen tandongin, “Tam mipa Pasian silbawltheina thupi ahi,” achi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aman mitphieldawi zang a hun sawtpi lamdangsataha ana koitah ziehin athu angaisah uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Philip in Pasian leenggam thu leh Jesu Khrist min agen khu, agintat tahun numei leh pasalten baptisma atangta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Simon nangawnin zong agingta a, baptisma atan nuain Philip kungah a umden a, sillamdang leh chiemtena kibawlte mu in lamdang asa thei mama hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jerusalem khuo a um sawltahten Samariten Pasian thu a awita uh chi azah tah un akung uah Peter leh Johan asawl uhi.","title":"Peter leh Johan Samaria gamah"},"15":{"text":"Amautegel Samaria ava tunsuh tahun, Hagau Siengthou atan theina dingun thungetna anei pieh uhi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen amaute lah a koima tungah Hagau Siengthou atung nai sih hi. Mangpa Jesu min a baptisma tang ahi bou uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter leh Johan in atung uah akhut uh anga ua, Hagau Siengthou atangta uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Simon in sawltahte khut ngah zieh a, Hagau Siengthou kipie ahi chi amu in;"},"19":{"text":"“Tambanga thuneina kei zong hing pie un, koi tungah zong khut ka ngahna pouin, Hagau Siengthou atan theina dingun, chiin sum pieh asawmta hi.”"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter in akungah, “Pasian silpieh dangka sum a lei na tup zieh in, na sum nangma toh mangkhawm heh."},"21":{"text":"Pasian mitmu a na lungtang adihlou ziehin, tam thu ah panna na nei sih a, tan zong na nei sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin tam gitlouna kisia inlen, Pasian kungah thungen in, tuachi’n na lungtanga na ngaituote ahing ngaidam kha maw sih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen khatna sinkha leh gitlouna khainienga kankhawm na hi chi ka mu hi,” achi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n Simon in adawnga, “Na sil gente uh ka tunga bangma atun louna dingin, nouman Mangpa kung ah thu hing ngetpieh un,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi a, Peter leh Johan in theipina thu leh Mangpa thu agen zou un, Jerusalem khuo ah apei kiata ua, lampi ah Samaria gam a khuo tampi ah, khantanhoi agen kawm zel uhi."},"26":{"text":"Mangpa vansawlsieng khat in Philip ahoupi a, “Thou inlen simlam a, Jerusalem khuo akipat Gaza zotna lampi ah pei inlen, tua lampi khu gamdai tawnsuh peh ahi,” achi hi.","title":"Phillip leh Ethiopia mi sumkempa"},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philip athou a apeita hi. Tualeh Ngai vawi, Ethiopia mi khat, Ethiopia leengnu Kandaki nuoi a michilge thunei lientah agou zousie kempa ahia, Jerusalem khuo a Pasian be dinga va haw ahi."},"28":{"text":"Apeikia lamin a sakolleng a toukawmin guolnei Isai laibu asim hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n, Hagau in Philip kungah “Va pei inlen tua sakolleng va nai inlen,” kithuopi in achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philip khu akungah ava tai a, guolnei Isai laibu asim azata a, Philip in akungah, “Na laisim na theisiem ei?” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Ethiopia mipa’n “Koima hilchet louin bang kachi theisiem diei?” achi hi. Tualeh Philip a kaltou a akunga tou dingin achiel hi."},"32":{"text":"Laisiengthou asimna mun khu tami ahi: “Tha ding Belam kipeipi bangin, ama apeipi ua, Tualeh belamnou amulmette mai a, asip khinkhian bangin, Aman akam zong akeeh sih hi.","ref":"Isai. 53.7,8"},"33":{"text":"Akingiemkhieh laiin, Atunga thudih genna lahmang ahi a, Ahahlesuonte tanchin koiin ahing gen diei? Leitung a kipat ahinna lahpieh ahi ngal a,” chi khu ahi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n michilge in Philip ahoupi a, akungah “Tam thu guolneiin koi tungthu agenna ahiei? ama tungthu ahiei, ahisihleh midang khat tungthu?” ka hing dong ahi, achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philip in akam akaah a, tua Laisiengthou apat in akungah Jesu tangthupha ahilta hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuabanga lampi a apei suh lai un, tui umna mun khat ahing tung ua, michilgein “En vawi, tanah tui a um hi, baptisma ka tanna ding bangin ahing dal ei?” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuachi’n Philip in “Na lungtang zousie a na gintat leh na tang thei hi.” Tualeh aman adawnga, “Jesu Khrist khu Pasian Tapa ahi chi ka gingta hi,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n a sakolleng khawldingin thu apie a, Philip leh michilge ani un tui sung ah apei suh ua, Philip in ama abaptista hi."},"39":{"text":"Amautegel tui akipat ahing peitou tahun, Mangpa Hagau in Philip alamangta a, michilgein ama amu nawn sih hi, tualeh michilge khu lampi ah nuomsa tahin apeita hi."},"40":{"text":"Hinanleh Philip pen Azotus khuo ah amu uhi, tualeh aman Kaisaria khuo atun masangsie in apeina khochin ah khantanhoi thupha agenta hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul in Mangpa nuazuite a vau thu leh tha atup thu genkhe kawmin, siempu lien kungah ava pei a,","title":"Saul pienthana"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Damaska khuo a kikhopna innte a pieh ding leh tami lampi zui pouma pasal hi in numei hitaleh amumu hensa a Jerusalem khuo a ahing pui theina ding lai angen hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh azinkhie a, Damaska khuo atun kuon tahin, thakhat in van akipat in vah akimah ahing taang suat hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n leiah apua a “Saul, Saul, nang bang dinga kei na hing bawlsiet ahiei?” chiin aw khat aza hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh aman “Mangpa koi na hiei?” achi hi. Tuachi’n “Mangpa’n adawnga, na bawlsietpa Jesu ka hi, kilna sia zum peh khu nanga ding in ahasa hi, achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman chitun kawm leh lamdangsa tahin, Mangpa bang bawl dingin na hing dei ei? achi hi. Tualeh Mangpa’n akungah, Thou inlen khopi sungah lut in, tuachi’n na bawl ding hilin na um ding,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh ama toh zin khawmte khu gen ding thei louin ading den ua, aw ging pen aza ua, hinanleh koima amu sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul khu leilah a kipat in athou a, amit aha leh Koima amu theisih hi. Hinanleh akhut in akai ua, Damaska khopi sungah apuilutta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n ni thum sung khomulouin a um a, bangma ne lou, bangma dawn louin a um hi."},"10":{"text":"Damaska khuo ah nuazui khat a um a, amin Anania ahi, tualeh Mangpa’n mengmuna a kilahin akungah, “Anania,” achi a, tualeh aman “Mangpa tanah ka um hi,” achi hi.","title":"Saul hagau a adimna"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n akungah, “Kisa inlen gawlzing tang achi uah pei inlen, Juda inn a um, Tarsas kho mi, amin Saul kichipa va kandoh in, Ngai vawi, athunget laitah ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh manglam bangin, mi khat amin Anania kichi hing lut a, akhomu theina dinga atunga khut ngain amuta hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Anania in adawnga, “Mangpa tam mipa tungtang thu leh Jerusalem khuo a na misiengthoute tung a atatsiet dante mi tampi gen ka na zata hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh tanah zong, Na min loute zousie mat a henna dingin siempu liente akipat in thuneina tawi a hing pei ahi,” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n Anania kungah, “Ama Jentelte, leengte leh Israel tate kunga ka min polut dinga ka belguot ahi ziehin na va haw ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen ka min zieh a gentheina bangzata thuoh ding ahiei chi ama ka theisah ding hi,” achi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Anania ava pei a, inn ah alut a, atunga khut ngain, “Sanggampa Saul, na mit vahna ding leh Hagau Siengthou a na dim theina dingin, Mangpa na hing peina lampi a na kunga kilahpa Jesu ngel in a hing sawl ahi,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh thakhat in amit apat in alip bang khat ahing kesuh a, khuo amu theita a, tuachi’n athoua baptisma atangta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh ann ane a, atha ahatta hi. Tuachi’n Saul khu Damaska khuo a nuazui umte kungah ni tam kuomtah atam hi."},"20":{"text":"Aman kikhopna innte ah, “Jesu Pasian Tapa” ahidan thu atangkoupi pai ngal hi.","title":"Saul in Damaska khuo ah Khrist atangkoupi"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama thugen za zousiein lamdang asa mama ua, “Tam mipa Jerusalem khuo a Jesu min loute tunga tatsepa hilou amah, tualeh tuabang mite man a hensa a siempu liente kunga pui tum a tam mun a hing pei hilou amah?” achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Saul khu ahing hat semsem a, tam Jesu khu Khrist ahi chi ahilchien a, Damaska khuo a Juda umte gen ding theilouin akoi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ni tampi nuain Judaten ama tha ding thu akidapkup uhi.","ref":"2 Kor. 11.32,33"},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Saul in asiltup uh ana thei hi. Tualeh amauten ama tha tumin khopi kotpi tengah sun leh zanin abuh uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n nuazuiten ama azawpi ua zanlai in kulbang tunga kipat bawm lienpi khat in akhaikhe suh ta uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Saul Jerusalem a ahing tuntahin nuazuite lah ah tel asawm a, hinanleh amaun nuazui khat hi tahtah dinga agintat lou zieh un, abawn un agiing chiet uhi.","title":"Saul Jerusalem leh Tarsas khuo ah"},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Barnaba in ama azawpi a sawltahte kungah apeipi hi, Lampi a Mangpa amu dan leh Mangpa’n ama ahoupi dante, tualeh Damaska khuo a Jesu min a hangsantah a thu agen dante, amaute kungah agenta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul zong Jerusalem khuo ah, lut zel pawt zelin amaute toh a umkhawmta hi."},"29":{"text":"Mangpa Jesu min in hangsan tahin thu agen a, tualeh Greek ham zang Judate akinielpi hi, hinanleh amaun ama tha atum uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tua thu unauten athei tahun, Kaisaria khuo ah apui suh ua, Tarsas khuo ah asawldohta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n hattuomte khu Judia gam, Galili gam leh Samaria gam zousie ah muonna anga ua, adet deu deu uhi. Tualeh Mangpa zaudan siem in, Hagau Siengthou hamuonin a um ua, ahing pung deudeuta uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuin tambang ahing hi a, Peter khu gingtute lah ah avah kawikawi a, Lidda khuo a misiengthou umte kungah zong apei suh hi.","title":"Lidda khuo ah Peter in Ainia asuhdamna"},"33":{"text":"Khunah aman amin Ainia kichi mi khat azenga, kum giet lupna a lumden amu hi."},"34":{"text":"Tualeh Peter in akungah, “Ainia Jesu Khrist in ahing damsah hi; thou inlen, na netpha ziel in” achi hi. Tuachi’n ama athou pai hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuachi’n Lidda leh Sharon phaijanga tengte zousie in ama amu ua, Mangpa lam angata uhi."},"36":{"text":"Joppa khuo ah amin Tabitha kichi nuazui khat a um hi. Tabitha min akhiehna Dorkas ahi. Tam numei pen nna hoi sem leh hepina silbawl ahau mama hi.","title":"Peter in Joppa khuoah Dorkas akaithou"},"37":{"text":"Hinanleh khum hun laiin, ahing china a, ashita hi, aluong asil zou un, inndan tungnungah asiel uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh Lidda khuo khu Joppa khuo toh kinai ahi a, nuazuiten Lidda khuo ah Peter a um chi athei ua, sawt hallou a akung ua “Hing pei pai dinga va gen dingin mi ni asawl uhi.”"},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter adingdoh a amautegel toh akizawh khawmta uhi. Ahing tun tahin ama khu inndan tungnung ah apuitou ua, tualeh meithaite zousie Peter kungah dingin akap ua, Dorkas in adam lai a amaute a dinga puonah leh puon abawlpiehte alah uhi."},"40":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter in amaute zousie apawtsah a, akhupdin a, thu angenta hi, tualeh mishi luong lam ngain “Tabitha thou in” achi hi. Tualeh amanu amit ahing hah a, Peter amu tahin ahing touta hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in akhut ahah a, akaithouta hi, tualeh misiengthoute leh meithaite ahan a, hingdam in apeta hi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh tua thu Joppa khuo a mi zousie in athei ua, mi tampi in Mangpa agingta ta uhi."},"43":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter Joppa khuo a Savun bawlpa Simon inn ah ni tampi atamta hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kaisaria khuo ah amin Kornelia kichi mi khat a um a, Itali pawl achi ua galkap zahoutu.","title":"Kornelia in Peter ahansah"},"2":{"text":"Pasian ngaisahmi ahia, a innkuonpite zousie toh Pasian giing mi ahi ua, mite kungah kiphal tahin hepina silpieh ape leeng hi, tualeh Pasian kungah zong thu angen ngitnget hi."},"3":{"text":"Nitah lam khat, nai thum ding velin mengmuna kichientahin, Pasian vansawlsieng khat akunga hing lut a, “Kornelia,” chiin amu hi."},"4":{"text":"Kornelia in ama a en a, azauta a, “Bang ahiei Mangpa?” achi hi. Tuachi’n vansawlsiengin akungah “Na thungetnate leh na sil piehte theizing dingin Pasian masang ah ahing tungtouta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuin Joppa khuo ah mi sawl inlen, Simon Peter va han sah in."},"6":{"text":"Ama tuipi gei a um, savun bawlpa Simon inn a tung ahi; aman na bawl ding ahing hil ding hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Kornelia houpi vansawlsieng khu apeizou tahin, Kornelia in ainnsunga nasem asuohte ni leh ama venga umte lah akipat Pasian adinga kipumpieh galkap khat ahan a;"},"8":{"text":"Amaute kunga thu umdan teng ahilchien zou in Joppa khuo ah asawlta hi."},"9":{"text":"Azing ni a apei lai un, tualeh khopi atunding kuon un, Peter khu thungen dingin inntung ah akaltou a, sun nai sawmleni hun vel ahi a;","title":"Peter in van akipata bawm hing kikhai suh a muna"},"10":{"text":"Peter agil ahing kiel a, bang ahiei khat neh a ut hi; hinanleh neh ding abawl lai un, mengmu bangin ahing um a,"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh van ahing kihonga, bang ahiei puon bawm lientah bang, aningli a kikhi a leitunga hing kikhaikhesuh amu hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua bawm sungah, leitunga kengli nei ganhing namkim, gamsate leh ganhing bohvahte leh tungleeng vate a um hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh aw khat in akungah, “Peter thou inlen, gou inlen ne in,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter in, “Hilou e, Mangpa; Ken asienglou leh abua mawngmawng bangma ka ne ngai sih hi.”"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh aw in ani veina dingin ama ahoupi a, “Pasian in asuhsiengthousa, nang sienglou na chi teitei ding ahi sih,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuabangin thumvei ahing um a, tuachi’n bawm khu van ah akilatou kiata hi."},"17":{"text":"Peter in tam amengmu khu bang genna adiei chia lamdangsa kawm a angaituo buoi laiin, Ngai vawi, Kornelia mi sawlten, Simon inn akandohta ua, kotkhah bul ah ading uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh amauten ahan ua, Simon amin khem Peter kichipa tuana atun leh tunlou ana dong uhi."},"19":{"text":"Peter in mengmuna asil mu khu, angaituo tuo laiin Hagau in akungah, “Ngai in, mi thum in ahing sui uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin thou inlen, kumsuh inlen, bangma ginglel louin amaute zui in, amaute keima hing sawl ahi uh,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter khu Kornelia hing sawl mite kungah apeisuh a, akung uah, “Na mi suipa uh Keima ka hi, nang peina uh azieh bang ahiei?” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh amaun galkap zahoutupa “Kornelia midihtat Pasian zaudan siem mi Juda nam zousiete lah a minphatna neipa kungah, Pasian akipat vansawlsieng khat in ama ahoupi a, ama inn a haw dinga nang hing hansah ding leh na thugen ngaikhe dingin ahil hi,” achi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute ahanlut a, agieh sahta hi. Tualeh azingni in, Peter amaute toh azawhkhawma, tualeh Joppa khuo a unau koite ahiei in zong ama azui uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh athai ni in Kaisaria khuo ahing tungta uhi. Tualeh Kornelia in amaute ana ngah a, ahieng asante leh alawm aguol ngaite ana hankhawm hi.","title":"Kornelia inn ah Peter"},"25":{"text":"Peter ahing lut kuon in, Kornelia in ana vaidawn a, akengbul ah khupboh in Pasian bieh bangin ana bie hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter in ama akaithou a, “Dingin, kei zong mihing ka hi,” achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh Peter ama toh kihoulim kawm in inn sungah alut a, mi tampi um khawm amuta hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute kungah, “Juda mi adingin nam dangte toh kipawl a, kive tuo asieng sih chi na theisa uh ahi. Hinanleh mi koima asienglou leh abua ka chi ding ahi sih chi, Pasian in ahing theisah hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuazieh in na hing hat tahun niel sese louin ka hing pei pai hi, tuin na hing hatna zieh uh bang ahiei? chi ka hing dong ahi,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kornelia in, “Ni li peita in, tu bang hun in ka inn sungah ann ka ngawl a, nitah lam nai thum hun vel in thu ka ngen a, tualeh Ngai vawi, mi khat puonvam silin ka masangah ahing ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Kornelia na thungetna zahin a umta, na hepina silpiehte zong Pasian in athei ngitnget hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaziehin Joppa khuo ah mi sawl inlen, Simon Peter kichipa han sahin Ama tuipi gei a teng savun bawlpa Simon inn a tung a hi. Ama ahing tun chiengin, na kungah thu agen ding hi, achi hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaziehin na kungah mi ka hing sawl pai hi, na hing pei ahoi ahi. Tuaziehin tuin Pasian in na kunga ahing thupieh zousie ngai dingin, Pasian mai ah ka unpi un tanah ka um uhi."},"34":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter in thu agen a, “Pasian in mi deisah tuom anei sih, chi dihtahin ka theita hi.”","title":"Kornelia inn a Peter thugen","ref":"Danp. 10.17"},"35":{"text":"Hinanleh namchin lah a Ama giing a, dihtattah a gamta pouma Ama dingin pomtah ahi."},"36":{"text":"Pasian in Israel tate kunga, a thu vaihah, Jesu Khrist tungtawna lungmuonna thu agen khu. Jesu khu mi zousie Mangpa ahi."},"37":{"text":"Tua thu khu, Johan in atangkoupi baptisma nua in, Galili gam akipat in ahing thang pan a, Judia gam zousie ah athang suoh a;"},"38":{"text":"Pasian in Hagau Siengthou leh silbawltheina toh Nazareth Jesu sathau anu dan, Pasian in a umpi ziehin ama silhoi bawlin leh dawiin asuhgenthei zousie damsahin apei kawi hi chi nouten na thei uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh Judate gam leh Jerusalem khuo a, asil bawl zousie theipite ka hi uhi, Judaten singdawn ah Ama akhai ua athatta uhi."},"40":{"text":"Ama khu Pasian in nithum niin akaithou kia a, mite mu dingin chientah in akilang sah hi."},"41":{"text":"Mi zousie kungah hilou in, Pasian in theipimi hi ding a atel koute kungah, akilah hi. Koute pen mishi lah a athawkia nua a, ama toh nekhawm a, dawnkhawmte ka hi uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tualeh Ama khu mihing leh mishite tunga thukhen dinga Pasian guot ahi chi, mite kunga tangkoupi ding leh theisah dingin Pasian in koute thu ahing pie hi."},"43":{"text":"Koipou Ama gingta ten Ama min ziehin khelnate ngaidamna amu ding uh, chi guolnei zousie’n ana theisah sa uh ahi,” achi hi."},"44":{"text":"Peter in tam thute agen laitahin, athu za zousie tungah Hagau Siengthou ahing tungta hi.","title":"Jentelte tunga Hagau Siengthou tunna"},"45":{"text":"Tualeh Peter hing zui teptante lah a gingtuten, Jentelte tung nangawn a Hagau Siengthou silthawnpieh sunbuoh a um amu tah un lamdang asa mama uhi."},"46":{"text":"Aziehpen amaute ham tuom tuom a ham a, Pasian phat in azata uhi. Tuachi’n Peter in,"},"47":{"text":"“Tam mite eima tan bangbang Hagau Siengthou tang mite tui a baptisma tan ding koi in akham thei diei?” achi hi."},"48":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa min a baptisma tang dingin amaute thu apie hi. Tuachi’n amauten ni tamlou sung tam tadi nalai dingin ama ahouta uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Judia gam a sawltahte leh unau umten Jentelten zong Pasian thu apomta uh chi azata uhi.","title":"Peter in Jentelte lah a anasep agupna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Peter Jerusalem a ahing tuntou tahin, teptante lah a gingtuten Peter ana kinielpi uh a,"},"3":{"text":"“Nang teptanlou mite lah ah na va haw a, amaute toh na ne khawm hi,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter in sil umdan abul akipat aban banin akung uah ahilchien hi."},"5":{"text":"“Joppa khuo a thungen a ka um laiin, mengmu bangin ka um a, manglam bangin puon bawm lienpi bang aningli a kikhi, van akipat a hing kikhaikhesuh ka mu a, ka kungah ahing tung hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua khu ka en kilkel a ka ngaituo a, leitunga ganhing kengli neite, gamsate, ganhing bohvahte leh tunga leeng vate, ka mu hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh aw khat ka za a, ka kungah Peter thou inlen, gou inlen, nein, achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh ken, hilou e Mangpa, asienglou leh abua mawngmawng bangma ka kam ah bangchih laiin zong alut ngai sih hi ka chi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh van akipat aw in, Pasian in asuhsiengsa nang sienglou chi sin, ahing chi hi."},"10":{"text":"Hichibang ngen thum vei ahing um a, tua zouin van lam ah akikhaitou kiata hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hun laitah in, mi thum Kaisaria apat a ka kunga ahing sawl uh, ka umna inn mai ah ana ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hagau in bangma ginglel loua amaute zui dingin ahing hil hi. Tuathamlouin tam sanggam guh ten zong ahing zui uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh aman ka kungah, a inn sunga Vansawlsieng vading amu dan leh, vansawlsiengin akunga Joppa khuo ah mi sawl inlen, amin Simon Peter kichipa hansah in."},"14":{"text":"Aman thu ahing hil dinga, tua thu in nang leh na innkuonpite hundam in na um ding uh, achi dan zong ahing hil hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachia thu ka gen pat leh, Hagau Siengthou itung ua ahing tun chiil lai mabangin, atung uah ahing tungta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thugen, Johan in tuiin ahing baptis a, hinanleh nouten Hagau Siengthouin baptisma na hing tang ding uh, achi khu ka theidohta hi.","ref":"Nasep. 1.5"},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin eiten Mangpa Jesu Khrist igintat ua Pasian in ahing pieh tua silpieh bangbang amaute kunga apieh nuain Pasian niel viel ding kei leltah koi ka hiei?” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Amauten tam thute azah tahun, asipta ua, Pasian aphat zawta uhi. “Tuachi’n Pasian in Jentelte zong hing dingin kisia a lungheisah ata ve maw,” achi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuin Stephen abawlsiet zieh ua tai thangte khu Phoinisia gamte, Saipras gamte leh Antiok khuo tan dongin azin ua, Judate chilou koima kung ah thu agen sih uhi.","title":"Antiok khuo a hattuomte","ref":"Nasep. 8.1-4"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh alah ua mi pawl khatte pen Saipras leh Sairin khuo a mite ahi ua, tua miten Antiok khuo atun un, Greek mite kungah thu agen ua, Antiok ah Jesu Khrist khantanhoi thu ahilta uhi."},"21":{"text":"Mangpa khut in amaute a umpi a, tualeh mi tampiin agingta ua, Mangpa lam angata uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n tam thute Jerusalem khuo a um hattuomten azata ua, tualeh Antiok tandong va haw ding in Barnaba asawl uhi."},"23":{"text":"Ama ava tun tahin Pasian khotuona amu a, akipah mama a, alungtang zousie ua kukal tah a, Mangpa a gin um zing dingin amaute ahantawhta hi."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen ama mi hoitah ahia, Hagau Sienthou leh ginna a dim ahi. Tuachi’n mi tamtah Mangpa lam ah akibelapta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n Barnaba khu Saul sui dingin Tarsas khuo lam zuon in akuonkheta hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Barnaba in Saul amu tahin, Antiok khuo ah ahing zawpi hi. Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, kum khat sung hattuomte toh akikhawm ua, mi tampi thu ahil uhi. Tualeh Antiok khuo a nuazuite khu Khristian akichi masa pen uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh tua hun lai in, guolnei pawlkhat Jerusalem khuo akipat in Antiok khuo ah ahing haw uhi.","title":"Antiok khuo a hattuomten Jerusalem ah panpina ahah uh"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n alah ua mi khat amin Agabus kichipa adingdoh a, leitung pumpi ah kiel tung ding ahi chi’n Hagau hil in, atheisahta a, tua kiel khu Klaudia Kaisar hun lai in ahing tung hi.","ref":"Nasep. 21.10"},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n nuazuiten angapdan chiet un, Judia gam a unau umte kungah panpina hah a sawm uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tua bangin abawl pai ngal ua, Barnaba leh Saul khut ah, upate kungah ahahta uhi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun lai in leengpa Herod in hattuom pawlte bawlsiet tumin akhut ahata hi.","title":"Herod in Jakob athana"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Johan sanggampa Jakob khu namsauin athatta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh tam asilbawlten Judate akipahsah chi a mu ziehin, Peter zong mat asawm nalai hi. Tua hun khu tanghou tolsawlou pawi hunlai ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachia Peter amat tahin suongkul ah akhum a, galkap lili a kipawl pawl li in aveng sah a, peikan pawi zou chienga mipite kunga puidoh a sawm hi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.1-27"},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin Peter suongkul ah akoi tadi a, hinanleh ama a dingin hattuomten Pasian kungah tawlnga louin thu angen uhi.","title":"Lamdangtah a suongkul apat Peter pawtdohna"},"6":{"text":"Herod in apuidoh ding ni, zanlai in Peter khu galkap ni kikaal ah khainieng ni a hensa in a imu hi, tualeh veng miten zong kotkhah bul a dingin suongkul aveng uhi."},"7":{"text":"Ngai vawi, Mangpa vansawlsieng khat akungah ahing dinga, suongkul sungah vah ahing taangta a, vansawlsiengin Peter pang bengin aphawng a, “Kintahin thou in,” achi a, tualaitahin asia khainieng bute akhut apat aketa hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsiengin akungah, “Na kawng gah inlen, na kedap but in,” achi hi. Aman tuabang in abawlta hi.
