Tualeh vansawlsiengin akungah “Na puon sil inlen hing zui in,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Peter apawta, azuita hi; vansawlsieng silbawl khu atahtah ahilam athei sih a, mengmu akisa hi."},"10":{"text":"Vengmite dinna mun khatna leh nina apel nua un, khopi lutna sia kotpi atungta uhi; tua kotpi khu amaute gel a dingin ama leh ama ahing kihong a, tuachi’n apawt ua, gawlzing khat azui lai un, vansawlsiengin thakhat in apeisanta hi."},"11":{"text":"Peter ahing khophawh bepin, “Mangpa’n vansawlsieng ahing sawl a, Herod khut leh Juda mite kinepna zousie akipat in ahing hundohta chi ka theichienta” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua sil angaituo nua in, John Mak nu Mari inn ah ava pei a, tuanah mi tampi thungetna neiin ana umkhawm uhi."},"13":{"text":"Peter in kotkhah akiu tahin, amin Rhoda ki chi nungah khat adawng dingin ahing pei hi."},"14":{"text":"Peter aw ahi chi athei tahin, akipah seng ziehin kot hong louin innsung lam ah atailut a, Peter kot khah bul ah ading hi, chiin ava gen hi."},"15":{"text":"Amaun akungah, “Amo na hita,” achi uhi. Hinanleh amanu’n atahtah ahi, achi tei tei hi. Tuachi’n amauten “Vansawlsieng hiva” achi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Peter in kot akiu kiu nalai a, tualeh kot ahon tahun, ama amu ua, lamdang asa mama uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Peter in amaute sip dingin akhutzap a, Mangpa’n suongkul apat ama apuidoh dan amaute ahilta hi. Aman “Pei unlen tam thute Jakob leh asanggamte kungah va hil un,” achi hi. Tuachi’n apawt a mundangah apeita hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n zingmawng ahing hitah in, Peter hei a um ahiei chiin galkapte buoi chitahin abuoita uhi."},"19":{"text":"Herod in Peter asui a, amulou tahin avengmite a endih a, tha dingin thu apeta hi. Herod pen Judia gam akipat Kaisaria khuo ah apeisuh a khunah a umden ta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuin Herod khu Tai-ar leh Sidon khomite tungah alungthah mama a, hinanleh agam miten tua leengpa gam a kipat neh leh dawn la zel ahiziehun kithutuoh tahin ahing pei ua, leengpa inn sung vaisaipa Blastus lawmbawl in kilemna ngen in a kungah ahing pei uhi.","title":"Herod shina"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n ani chiem ni in, Herod in aleengpuon sil in aleengtoupha tungah atou a, akung uah thu agen hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh mipite akikou ua, “Tam pen pasien aw ahi, mihing aw ahisih,” achi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Herod in Pasian thupina apieh lou ziehin, Mangpa vansawlsieng khat in asat a, hutin ane a ashita hi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian thu pen akhang semsem a, apung zel hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh Barnaba leh Saul in anasep uh azaw tahun Jerusalem apat akile kia ua Johan amin tah Mak kichipa azawpi uhi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Antiok khuo a hattuom umte lah ah, guolneite leh thuhil siete a um uhi: Amaute khu Barnaba, Nigar kichi Simeon, Sairin khuo a mi Lusia, vaihawmpa Herod toh khang khawm Manaen leh Saul te ahi uhi.","title":"Barnaba leh Saul sawlkhiehna"},"2":{"text":"Amaute Mangpa nasem a ann ngawl a aumlaiun, Hagau Siengthou in, “Barnaba leh Saul amaute ka hatna zieh sem dingin, kei a dingin hing setuompieh un,” achi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n ann ngawl a thungetna anei zou un, Barnaba leh Saul tungah akhut uh anga ua, asawlkheta uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Hagau Siengthou in asawldoh bangin Seliusie khuo ah apeisuh ua, tuana kipat in Saipras lam zuonin kuongin apeita uhi.","title":"Paul Missionary khuolzinna masapen"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Salamis khuo atuntahun Judate kikhopna innte ah Pasian thu agen uhi. Amaun Johan zong amauh panpi dingin azawpi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuin Saipras tuikul gam tuonsuohin Paphos khuo ah atung ua, khunah dawisiem guolnei tahlou, Juda mi khat atuoh kha ua, amin Bar Jesu ahi.","title":"Bar Jesu toh kibuoina"},"7":{"text":"Tua mipa pen, gam uhpa Sergius Paulus mi piltah khat nasem a akunga um ahi, tua gam uhpa’n Pasian thu azah ut ziehin Saul leh Barnaba ahansah hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh dawisiem Elima in, (Elima pen ama uh ham a Bar-Jesu min khiehna ahi) gam uhpa’n gintatlousah tumin, amaute ana doudal hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Saul (Paul zong akichi hi) Hagau Siengthou a dimin Elim a a ensaalden a,"},"10":{"text":"“Aw nang milepchie leh hoilouna chintenga dimpa, nang dawimangpa tapa, nang dihtatna zousie melmapa, Mangpa lampi tangtahte heikawi tawplou ding na hiei mah?"},"11":{"text":"Ngai in, tuin Mangpa khut na tungah ahing tuta hi, na mit ataw dinga bangtan ahiei ni vah mu louin na um ding” achi hi. Tuachi’n thakhat in, tuimei bang miel atungah ahing kie a, akhut a; kai ding mi suiin akimai kawita hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n gam uhpa’n tua sil kibawl amu tahin Mangpa tungtang thu kihilna lamdangsain agingta ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul khu alawite toh Paphos khuo apat in apei ua, Pamphilia gam a Perga khuo ahing tung ua, tualeh Johan in amauh nuasiein Jerusalem ah akinuale kiata hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute Perga khuo akipat in Pisidia gam a Antiok khuo atung ua, tualeh khawlni in kikhopna inn ah alut ua, atou uhi.","title":"Paul in kikhopna inn a athugen patna"},"15":{"text":"Dan laibu leh guolneite laibu asim zou un, kikhopna inn vaihawmte’n amauh achiel ua, “Mite leh unaute aw, mipite a ding hanthawnna thu gen ding na nei uleh gen un,” achi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul adingtou a, amaute akhutzapa, “Israel mite leh nou Pasian zaudan siem mite aw, ngai un."},"17":{"text":"Tam Israel mite Pasian in ipu ipate ana tel a, Izipt gam a mikhuol banga ataam lai un, amaute atawisanga, aban thahat in apuidoh kia hi.","ref":"Pawt. 1.7; Pawt. 12.51"},"18":{"text":"Kum sawm li sung vingveng gamdai a, agamtatna uh ana thuoh teitei hi.","ref":"Kisim. 14.34; Danp. 1.31"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh Kanaan gam a nam sagite asuhmang zouin, agam uh, ama ua dingin ahawm piehta hi.","ref":"Danp. 7.1; Josh. 14.1"},"20":{"text":"Tuami nuain kum zali leh kum sawm nga sung vaihawm mite apie a, guolnei Samuel hun chieng dongin.","ref":"Vai. 2.16; 1 Sam. 3.20"},"21":{"text":"Tuami nuain leeng khat ana ngen ua, tuachi’n Pasian in Benjamin nam a mi khat Kish tapa Saul apie a, aman kum sawmli sung vai ahawm hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 8.5; 1 Sam. 10.21"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh ama a lahdoh nuain aleengpa dingun David atungdoh ta hi; Pasian in tua mipa thu theipi in, Jesse tapa David ka lungtang bang puo mi ka mudohta, aman ka deilam abawl ding, achi hi.","ref":"1 Sam. 13.14; 1 Sam. 16.12; Late. 89.20"},"23":{"text":"Tam David hahlesuonte lah ah Pasian in athuchiemsa dungzuiin Israelte kungah Hundampa Jesu atung dingta hi."},"24":{"text":"Jesu ahing tun masangin Johan in Israelmi zousie kungah Kisiana baptisma ana hil masata hi.","ref":"Mak. 1.4; Luk. 3.3"},"25":{"text":"Johan in anasep azaw kuon lai in, nouten kei koi hi dingin na hing ngaituo uoi? Ama hilou ka hi. Hinanleh ngai un, ka nua ah mi khat hing pei ding ahi, Kei pen akedap khau sutpieh taah zong ka hi sih hi, achi hi.","ref":"Jn. 1.20; Mat. 3.11; Mak. 1.7; Luk. 3.16; Jn. 1.27"},"26":{"text":"“Mite leh Abraham hahlesuon ka sanggamte leh na lah ua Pasian giing Jentelte aw, na kung uah tam hundamna thu ahing kihah hi."},"27":{"text":"Jerusalem khuo a tengte leh avaihawmte un Jesu ana theilou zieh un, ahisihleh khawlni chin a asim khiet uh guol neite thugente theilou in Ama siemlou tangsah in, tua thute ana tang tungsahta uhi."},"28":{"text":"Amauten ashina ding khop azieh atungah bangma mu sihnan u’leh zong, Pilat kungah tha dingin angen teitei uhi.","ref":"Mat. 27.22,23; Mak. 15.13,14; Luk. 23.21-23; Jn. 19.15"},"29":{"text":"Amaun atungtang thu na kigielsa zousie asuhtangtun nua un, singdawn akipat Ama alakhie ua, han ah asielta uhi.","ref":"Mat. 27.57-61; Mak. 15.42-47; Luk. 23.50-56; Jn. 19.38-42"},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in mishi lah akipat Ama akaithou kiata a,"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh amatoh Galili gam akipat a Jerusalem khuoa apeipitoute kungah ni tampi sung akilah hi; tua mite khu mite kunga athu theipi mite ahi uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 1.3"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh Kouten zong ipu ipate uh kunga ana chiemsa, tua khantan hoi kipah huoi ka hing hil uhi.","ref":"Late. 2.7"},"33":{"text":"Pasian in Jesu akaithou kiana tungtawn in, tua thuchiem ei a tate adingin atangtungsahta hi. Late nina ah zong: Nang ka tapa na hi a, tuni in kang hingkheta hi, chia gel bangin."},"34":{"text":"Muotna mun a kilekia nawnlou dinga, Pasian in Ama mishi lah akipat akaithaw thu tambangin agen hi: David kunga guolzawlna Siengthou leh, muonhuoi kachiem, Nangma ka hingpe ding hi, chiin.","ref":"Isai. 55.3"},"35":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aman late dang khat ah, tambangin agiel hi, Nang na misiengthoupa khu, amuotmang ding na phal sih ding hi, achi kia hi.","ref":"Late. 16.10"},"36":{"text":"Aziehpen David in Pasian deina banga ama khanga mite adinga nna asep zouin ashi a apu apate kungah akivui a amuot mangta hi."},"37":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in akaithoupain muotmangna amu sih hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka unaute aw, theiun, tam Jesu tungtawn a khelna ngaidamna thu noute kunga gen ka hi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tualeh koipou agingta pouma khu, Mosi dan a siem natan zou louna uh sil zousie a kipat siemtansahin a um hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuaziehin pilvang un, tuachilouin guolneite laibu a thu kigen na tung uah ahing tung kha ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Nou mi simmaw hatte en un, lamdangsa unlen, Mangthai un; Aziehpen na damsungun, nna khat ka sem a, tua nasep khu noute hing kihil nanleh, na gingta vawtsih ding uhi, chiin ana gen uhi,” achi uhi.","ref":"Haba. 1.5"},"42":{"text":"Kikhopna inn apat Paul leh Barnaba apawtdoh laiun khawlni kia chienga tam thute gen nalai dingin mipiten angen uhi."},"43":{"text":"Mipi kikhawmte akikhenzah tahun, Judate tampi leh Juda biehdan zui Pasian a kipumpieh lah a mi tampi in Paul leh Barnaba azui ua, Paul leh Barnaba in amauh ana ahoupi ua, Pasian hepina a um ngitnget dingin amauh ahantawh uhi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh khawlni kia in, khopi sunga mi zousie akhojang phiel un Pasian thu ngaikhe dingin ahing kikhawm uhi.","title":"Paul in khawlni kia a athugen"},"45":{"text":"Hinanleh Judaten mipite amu tah un, thangsietna in adim ua, Paul thugen akal ua, agensie uhi."},"46":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul leh Barnaba in hangsan tahin agen uhi. “Noute kunga Pasian thu gen masah ding mawng ahi a, hinanleh nouten na nial ziehun, kumtawn hinna tang taahlou a na kibawl ziehun, ngai un, Jentelte lam ka ngat a uhi."},"47":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n koute tambangin thu ahing pie hi: Jentelte adinga vah hiding leh, kawlmong donga hundamna tun dingin, ka hing guot hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 42.6; 49.6"},"48":{"text":"Jentelten tam thu azah tahun akipah sengseng ua Mangpa thu atawisang uhi. Tualeh kumtawn a hing dinga guot taphot in agingta ta uhi."},"49":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa thu khu tua gamkai pumpi ah adalzahta hi."},"50":{"text":"Hinanleh Judaten tua khopi a Pasian a kipumpieh leh numei zatat huoite leh khopi sunga mipi lamkaite achiilsie ua, Paul leh Barnaba abawlsie ua, agam ua kipat anotdoh sahta uhi."},"51":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul leh Barnaba in akephang tung ua leivui bangte athingkhie ua, Ikonium khuo ah apeita uhi.","ref":"Mat. 10.14; Mak. 6.11; Luk. 9.5; 10.11"},"52":{"text":"Tualeh nuazuite khu lungnopna leh Hagau Siengthou in adimta uhi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ikonium khuo a Judate kikhopna inn ah Paul leh Barnaba alut khawm ua, thu agen ua, tuachi’n Judate leh Greekte mi tamtahin agingta ta uhi.","title":"Paul leh Barnaba Ikonium ah"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh agingta lou Judaten Jentelte achiilsie ua, unaute gel muda dingin alungsim uh asuhsietpiehta uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa min suongin hangsantah a thu gen in hun sawtpi aum uhi, Ama’n chiemtenate leh sil lamdangte akhut ua bawlsah in, A hepina thu atheisah zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh khopi sung a mite akilangkhenta ua, pawlkhatten Judate lam apanpi ua pawldang khatten sawltahte lam apanpi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Jentelte leh Judaten avaihawmte u’toh kithuo a zumhuoi taha bawla suonga selup atup lai un;"},"6":{"text":"Amaun tam thu ana thei ua, Likaonia gam a Listra leh Derbe khuote leh akimvel gamte ah ataita ua."},"7":{"text":"Tuanah khantanhoi agenta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Listra khuo ah kengbai koi ahiei mi khat thahatna neilou in atou a, apien chiil apat kengbai mawng ahia, akengin apei ngai sih hi.","title":"Kengbai pasal khat damsahna"},"9":{"text":"Tua mipan Paul thugen lunglut tahin angaikhie hi. Tualeh Paul in ama hoitah in a ensaal a, damna ding khop ginna a nei hi, chi athei hi,"},"10":{"text":"Aw ngaitahin, “Na kengin ding tangin,” achi a, tuachi’n ama akitawm a, akengin apeita hi."},"11":{"text":"Paul sil bawl mipiten amu tah un, aw ngaitahin akikou ua, “Likaonia ham in pasiente mihing mel pua a ikung ua hing kum suh ahi uh,” achi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute’n Barnaba khu Zeus achi ua, Paul pen thugenpipen ahi ziehin Hermis achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n khopi mai a um Zeus biehinn siempupa’n bawngtalte leh pahkhite kotpi bul ah ahing tawi a, mipite toh amaute gel mai ah kithoina bawl asawm uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh sawltahte Barnaba leh Paul in tam thu a zah tah un, apuonsilte uh abotkeh ua, mipite lah ah kikou pumin atailut ua,"},"15":{"text":"“Pute, bangding a tam silte bawl na hi uoi? koute zong noute piendan banga mihing ka hi bou uhi, tambang pannabei sil na bawlte ua kipata hing kihei a, van leh lei, tuisuogiet leh asunga sil um zousie siempa Pasian hing kunga na hing kihei theina ding un, khantanhoi ka hing tut uh ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.11; Late. 146.6"},"16":{"text":"Aman khanglui laiin namchin amauh ut bang chiet a agamtat ding uh ana phal hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahivang in Ama theipina panglouin ana umsah sih a, silhoi bawl in van akipat guotuite leh louhai gaphate ahing pie a, ilungtangte uh neh ding ann leh kipahnain adimsah hi,” achi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tam thute gen in, amaute kunga kithoina bawl lou dingin akham zou hamham uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Antiok leh Ikonium khuo akipat Juda koite ahiei khunah ahing haw ua, mipite athuzaw ua, tuachi’n Paul khu suongin asep ua, ashi hitava achi ziehun, khopi pulam ah akaikhie uhi.","title":"Paul suonga sena leh Derbe a taina"},"20":{"text":"Ahivang in nuazuite akim a ahing peikhawm lai un, ahing thou a khopi sungah ahing lut kiata hi; tualeh azing ni’n Barnaba toh Derbe lam ah apeita uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh amauten Derbe khuo ah khantan hoi agen ua mi tampi ahil zou un, Listra leh Ikonium tualeh Antiok ah akinuale kiata uhi.","title":"Antiok a apeikiana uh"},"22":{"text":"Gim gentheina tampi thuoh in Pasian leenggam ilut ding mawng ahi chiin nuazuite hinna hagau akhausah uhi. Ginna a umden dingin ahantawh uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hattuom chin ah upate aguot ua, ann ngawl a athum nua un, amuon uh Mangpa kungah amaute akemsah uhi."},"24":{"text":"Pesidia gam atotsuoh nua un, Pamphilia ah ahing tung uhi."},"25":{"text":"Perga khuo a thu agen zou un Attalia khuo ah apei suh uhi."},"26":{"text":"Attalia khuo akipat in Antiok zuon in kuongin apei ua, hattuom ten Pasian hepina sunga amaute akepsah ua, anasep zousa uh sem dinga aguotna uh Antiok khuo ahing tungta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh ahing tun un hattuomte ahankhawm ua, Pasian in amaute zanga asil bawl zousie leh Pasian in Jentelte dinga ginna kot ahon pieh dante ahil uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n nuazuite toh hun sawtpi a um khawmta uhi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi koite ahiei Judia gam akipat in, ahing hawsuh ua, “Mosi dan dungzui a tep na tan sih uleh, hundam na hi thei sih ding uhi chiin unaute ahil uhi.”","title":"Jentel Khristiante leh Mosi dan","ref":"Siempu. 12.3"},"2":{"text":"Tuaziehin Paul leh Barnaba amaute toh lungthah a kiniel a akisel ziehun, Paul leh Barnaba khu alah ua koite ahiei toh, tam thu toh kisai a Jerusalem a sawltahte leh upate kunga va haw tou ding in aguot uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n hattuomten asawlkhie ua, amauten Phoinisia gam leh Samaria gam atotna uah, Jentelte hing kihei dan agen ua, tuami’n unaute nasatahin akipahsah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Jerusalem khuo atuntahun, Hattuomte leh, sawltahte, tualeh upate’n ana kipahpi ua, tualeh amaun Pasian in amauh zanga, asil bawlte zousie ahil uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Pharisaite lah a gingtu pawlkhat adingdoh ua, “Jentelten tep atan ua, Mosi dan azui uh kul ahi, “achi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Sawltahte leh upate tam thu ngaituo dingin akikhawm uhi.","title":"Jerusalem khawmpi a Peter thugen"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh nasatah a akiniel nua un, Peter adingdoh a, akung uah, “Unaute aw, Jentelten keima kam a khantanhoi azah ua, agintat na ding ua, Pasian in hun peisa lai a, ilah ua pat kei ahing tel dan na thei uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 10.1-43"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n lungtang theipa Pasian in eite ahing pieh bangin Hagau Siengthou akung uah apie a, atheipita hi.","ref":"Nasep. 10.44; 2.4"},"9":{"text":"Aman eite leh amaute khentuom neilou in, ginna ziehin alungtangte uh asiengthou sahta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n ipu ipate hihen, eite hita lei, ipuoh zoulou hahkol bangdinga nuazuite ngawnga baat a, Pasian ze et sawm na hi uoi?"},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute mabangin, eite zong Mangpa Jesu Khrist hepina zieh a hundam ding hiin, ikigingta uhi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi zousie asipta ua, Barnaba leh Paul in, Pasian in amaute zanga, Jentelte lah a chiemtenaleh sillamdang abawl thute agen uh angaikhie uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute asip dide laitah un Jakob in thu agen a; “Unaute aw, ka thugen Ngai un:"},"14":{"text":"Pasian in Ama min paw dinga Jentelte lah apat mite lahdoh dingin, Jentelte ave masa hi chi thu Simon in agenta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh tam thu leh guolneite thu akituoh lien a, tambangin akigiel hi:"},"16":{"text":"Tamte nua chiengin ka hing kinuale kia dinga, achimsa David puonbuh ka lamtha dinga, asietnate ka bawl kia dinga, tuachi’n ka tungding ding hi.","ref":"Amos. 9.11,12"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n midangte leh, Jentel ka min a kihan zousiete nangawn in, Pasian asuina dingun, Tam silte zousie bawlpa, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"18":{"text":"A silbawlte zousie leitung kisiem chiil apat Pasian thei ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jentelte lah a Pasian lam a hing kiheite pen subuoi dalei chi ka ngaidan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Milim biehna, sil bua nehte, kingaina siengloute, hehlup sa leh sisan nehte, tawpsan dingin akung uah, lai giel lei ka chi zaw hi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.15-17; Siempu. 18.6-23; Siempu. 17.10-16"},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen ni danglai a pat in Mosi dan kho tengah akigen a, khawlni simsiel in kikhopna inn teng a kisim ahi zieh in,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n sawltahte leh upate leh hattuom zousiein alah ua mi tel a, Paul leh Barnaba toh Antiok khuo a sawl dingin pha asa ua, atelte uh min khu Judas amin dang Barsaba kichipa leh Silas ahi ua, amaute khu unaute lah a lamkaite ahi uhi.","title":"Jerusalem khawmpi in lai ahah"},"23":{"text":"Amauten tambangin laihah agiel uhi: “Sawltahte, upate leh na sanggamte un, Antiok khuo leh, Siria leh Silisia gam a um, Jentel unaute kungah, chibai ka hing buh uhi."},"24":{"text":"Koute lah a mi pawlkhat noute kunga, hing pei in, tep na tan ding uh, Dan na zui ding uh ahi, chi a, athugente un, noute ahing lungbuoi sah uhi, chi thu ka na za uhi. Tuabang thu gen dingin, amaute thu ka pe kha sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tuabanga lungsim mun khat puo a ka kikhop tah un mi teldoh a, ka it tah uh Barnaba leh Paul,"},"26":{"text":"Mangpa Jesu Khrist min a ahinna uh phalte gel toh na kung ua hing sawl dingin pha kasa uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin Judas leh Sailas ka hing sawl uhi, amauten zong tam thute kam in ahing gen ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen, Hagau Siengthou leh kouten, Tam thu poimawte chilou puohgih dang bangma na tung ua hing guonlou hoi kasa uhi."},"29":{"text":"Milim mai a kithoina sa nehte, sisan nehte, hehlup sa nehte leh kingaina thanghuoite tawpsan u’lachin nou a dingin ahoi ding hi. Mangpha, chiin agiel uhi.”"},"30":{"text":"Tuabanga sawl ahibang un, amaute Antiok khuo atung ua, tuachi’n mipi ahankhawm ua, laihah khu apeta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tua laihah asim zou un, amaute hanthawnna thu ahiziehin akipah mama uhi."},"32":{"text":"Judas leh Sailas zong guolnei ahi ua, thu tamtah genin unaute ahantawh ua, athahatsah uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tua mun a hun bangtan ahiei ataam nua un, unauten amaute hamuonna thu toh sawltahte kungah anuasawl kiata uhi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh Silas in khum mun a tam tahdi hoi asa hi."},"35":{"text":"Paul leh Barnaba Antiok khuo ah atam nalai ua, midang tampi toh Mangpa thu hil in aumden uhi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n ni bangza ahiei nuain Paul in Barnaba kungah, “Mangpa thu igenna khochin a sanggamte bangchin a um tou zel uoi, chia va ve dingin ikuonkhe kia ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Paul leh Barnaba kikhenna"},"37":{"text":"Tualeh Barnaba in Johan kichi Mak a mautegel toh zawpi a ut hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahivang in aman Pamphilia gam a amautegel nuasie a amaute gel toh na semkhawm nawnlou ahiziehin ama zawpi ding Paul in hoi asa sih hi.","ref":"Nasep. 13.13"},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n nasatahin akinielta ua, akikhenta ua, Barnaba in Johan Mak. Azawpi a Saipras gam ah kuongin apeita uhi."},"40":{"text":"Hinanleh Paul in Sailas atel a, unauten Pasian hepina sunga amaute akep sah nuaun akipandohta uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh Siria leh Silisia gam sung pumpi tuon in hattuomte athahat sah uhi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Derbe khuo leh Listra khuo ah ahing tung hi. Tualeh Ngai vawi, Listra khuo ah Timothi kichi nuazui khat a um a, ama khu gingtu Juda numei khat tapa ahi a, apa pen Greek mi ahi.","title":"Listra ah Timothi in Paul azui"},"2":{"text":"Ama pen Listra leh Ikonium khuo a um sanggamten agen phat mama uh ahi."},"3":{"text":"Paul in ama khu akhuolzinna a zawpi a ut a, tuachi’n azawpi a, tua gam a Judaten apa Greek mi ahi chi athei zieh un, atep atanpieh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaun khopi atotna teng uah, Jerusalem a sawltahte leh upaten zui dinga anamdet uh thupuasahte akung uah apekhe zel uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n hattuomte khu ginna lam ah ahatsah ua, tualeh ni chinin apung deudeu uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuin Paul leh alawmten Phrigia gam leh Galatia gam atotsuoh zou un, Hagau Siengthou in Asia gam a thugen akhamta hi.","title":"Paul Masidonia gam a hatna"},"7":{"text":"Misia gam ahing tun nua un, Bithinia gam a pei atum ua, hinanleh Hagau in aphal sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Misia gam pel in Troas khuo atungsuhta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh zanlai in Paul in mengmu khat anei a, Masidonia gam a mi khat dingin, “Masidonia gam ah hing galkai unlen, koute hing panpi un chi a ngen in amu hi.”"},"10":{"text":"Paul in mengmu amu zouin, Masidonia gam a pei dingin ka kisa pai ua, akung ua khantan hoi gen dingin Pasian in ahing hat ahi chi dihtahin ka thei uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Troas khuo apat kuongin ka pei ua, tangtahin Samothrase ah ka pei ua, azing niin Niapolis khuo ah ka tung uhi.","title":"Lidia pienthana"},"12":{"text":"Tuana kipat in Philippi khuo ah ka tung uhi; tua khu Masidonia gam a Rome mite pemkhawmna khopi lienpen ahi. Tua khuo ah ni tam kuomtah ka taam uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh khawlni in khopi pulam a luipi gei ah ka pei ua, tua luigei khu thungetna mun ahi a, tualeh ka tou ua, numei hing peikhawmte kungah thu ka genta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh numei khat amin Lidia, puonsandup zua a summet bawl, Thiatira khuo a teng Pasian be mi khat in ka thugen uh aza a, Paul thugen zui ding in Mangpa’n alungtang ahon pieh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh ama leh a innkuonpite’n baptisma atan zou un, “Mangpa a ginum a na hing ngaisut u’leh hing pei unlen ka inn ah hing tung un” chi’n ahing chiel hi. Tuachi’n koute ahing houtaangta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh thungetna mun a ka pei lai un, dawi lawmnei aisan siem suoh nungah khat in ahing kituohpi hi. Amanu’n aisan a vang gen in apute sum tampipi amusah zel hi.","title":"Dawi aisiem nungah sunga dawi deldohna"},"17":{"text":"Tua nungahin Paul leh koute ahing zui a, akikou a, “Tam mite Tungnungpen Pasian suohte ahi ua, eite kunga hundamna lampi kitangkoupite ahi uh,” achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tambangin ni tampi abawl hi. Hinanleh Paul in azada a, akihei a, dawi kungah, amanu sunga kipat hing pawtdoh dingin Jesu “Khrist min in thu ka hing pie hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n tua hun mama in apawtdoh pai ngal hi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh tua suohnu putein asum muna uh abeita chi athei tahun, Paul leh Sailas aman ua, vanzuona mun lah ah akai ua, thuneite mai ah alutpita uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh thukhenpa mai ah amaute ahing pui ua, “Tam mite Judami ahi ua, ka khopi uh asubuoi mama uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh ei Rome miten izui leh ichiin sienglou tawndan khat ahing hil uhi,” achi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipi tampite zong Paul leh Sailas dou in apangkhawm uhi, tualeh thukhenten apuonte uh ahawhkhiet pieh ua, chiengpum a jep dingin thu apie uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tam veipi ajep nua un suongkul ah akhum ua, bittah a veng dingin avengmipa kungah thu apie uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tambanga thupieh khautah muin, tangvengpa’n suongkul dantan sungnung ah amauh akhum a, akeng uah siakol abunsah hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh zankim lai in Paul leh Sailas in thu angen ua, Pasian kungah phatna la asa ua, suongkul tangten angai uhi.","title":"Paul leh Sailas suohtatna leh suongkul vengpa pienthana"},"26":{"text":"Thakhat in zil nasatahin ahing kilinga tuachi’n suongkul suongphumte nangawn akiling gawp a, tualeh suongkul kotkhate zousie ahing kihong pai a, michin kolbu zousie ahing kitol siengta hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n suongkul vengpa imu lai ahing khanglou a, suongkul kotkhate kihongsa a um amu tahin, suongkul taangte taimang sieng uh hitava achi a, anamsau adoh a ama leh ama akitha tum hi."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh Paul aw ngaitah a kikou in, “Bangma kilaw sin, ka bawn un tanah ka umkim uhi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n mitangte vengpain, meivah angen a, atai lut a, chitun kawm in Paul leh Sailas mai ah akhupboh ta hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh amaute ahing puidoh a, “Pute hundam a ka umna dingin bang ahiei ka bawl ding” achi hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun “Mangpa Jesu Khrist gingtain, tuachi’n hundamin na um ding hi, nang leh na innkuonpite toh achi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten ama kungah leh a inn a um zousiete kungah Mangpa thu agenta uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuami zanlai mama in aman amaute apui a ajepna huoltaite uh asawpsieng pieh a, tualeh ama leh aiinkuonpite zousie in baptisma atang pai ngal uhi."},"34":{"text":"Aman amaute a inn sungah apuilut a, amasang uoh ann neh ding alui a, ama leh a innkuonpiten Pasian thu a gintat zieh un akipah mama hi."},"35":{"text":"Zingmawng khuo ahing vahtahin, thukhenten, Suongkul vengpa kunga, tua mite ha in, chi dingin “Miman galkapte asawl uhi.”","title":"Suongkul apat Paul kihakhietna"},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n suongkul vengpa’n Paul kungah, “Thukhenmiten nang leh Sailas ha na ding thu ahing pie ua, tuaziehin tuin pawt unlen ha muongtahin peita un,” achi hi."},"37":{"text":"Hinanleh Paul in akung uah, “Rome mi ka hi ngal ua, mawpaina umlou a, vantang mitmu in ahing jep ua suongkul ah ahing khum ua, tuin hing dap hakhiet sawm uh hiven izaw? hi thei ngailou ding hi, amaute mama hing pei u’henlen, hing puidoh uheh,” achi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua miman galkap lamkaiten, tua thute thukhenmite kungah ahil ua, Romemite ahi uh chi azah tahun azauta uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute ahing pei ua, azawl ua, apuidoh ua, khopi nuasie dingin angen uhi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute suongkul apat ahing pawtdoh ua, Lidia inn ah ahaw ua, unaute amu tah un, ahantawh ua, apeita uhi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Amphipolis khuo leh Apollonia khuo nawt in apei suoh ua, Thessalonika khuo atungta ua, tuanah Judate kikhopna inn khat a um hi.","title":"Thessalonika a hattuom phuna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul in abawl ngaina bangin akung uah alut a, khawlni thumvei, Laisiengthou thu amaute akikuppi zel hi."},"3":{"text":"Khrist in athuohgim ding mawng ahidante, tualeh mishi lah akipat thoukia ngei ding ahidan leh tam na kung ua “Ka gen Jesu khu Khrist ahi chia hilchien in atahlang hi.”"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n alah ua mi pawlkhat in agingta ua, tualeh Pasian a mi kipumpieh Greek mite tampi leh numei lamkai tawm liei louten Paul leh Sailas azuita uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh agingtalou Judaten athangsiet ua, migilou thasie koite ahiei, vanzuona munte a kipat ahankhawm ua, khopisung zousie asubuoi ua, Jason inn abulu ua, Paul leh Sailas khu mipite kungah puidoh atum uhi.","title":"Jason inn buluna"},"6":{"text":"Amaute amulou tah un, Jason leh unau pawlkhatte khopi sung vaihawmte masangah akailut ua, akikou ua, “Leitung pumpi kikhulesah mihingte tami mun nasan ahing tungta ua,"},"7":{"text":"Jason in ana zintun a, tam miten Kaisar thupiehte kalin, Jesu kichi leeng dangkhat a um hi, achi uhi,” achi ua."},"8":{"text":"Mipite leh khopi sung vaihawm miten tam thu azah tahun a pumbuoita uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n amauten Jason leh midangte akipat kihenna silte ala ua, amaute ahadohta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n unauten azan zanin Paul leh Sailas Beria khuo ah asawlkhe pai ua; khuna ava tuntah un, Judate kikhopna inn ah alut uhi.","title":"Paul leh Sailas Beria khuo ah"},"11":{"text":"Beria mite khu Thessalonika khuo a mite sangin alungsim uh akihong zaw ua, lungsim kilawptah in thu apom ua, athugente uh adih leh dihlou theina dingin, nichin in Laisiengthou thu sui in a enchien zel uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Judate tampi in agingta ua, Greekte lah a numei leh pasal zatat huoi tawm thamlouten zong agingta uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh Thessalonika khuoa Judaten, Paul in Beria khuo ah Pasian thu agen hi chi, athei bep un, khunah zong ahing pei ua mipite hanthawn in achiilsie uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n unauten kintahin Paul khu tuipi lam a pei dingin asawlkhe pai ua, hinanleh Sailas leh Timothi pen Beria ah a um tadi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul vahaten ama Athen khuo ava tunpi uhi; tualeh Sailas leh Timothi khu akintheipen a akunga hing pei dinga athuhah thu puoin apeita uhi."},"16":{"text":"Paul in Athen khuo a, Sailas leh Timothi ana ngah sungin, tua khopi milim pasiente a dim in amu a, alungthah mama hi.","title":"Athen khuo ah Paul"},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin kikhopna inn ah, Judate leh Pasian bie Jentelte thu akinielpi zel hi, tualeh vanzuona muna na um poumate zong nichin in akinielpi zel hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Epikuriamite leh Stoik mite lah a, mipil koite ahieiin zong, ama ahing niel uhi. Tualeh Pawlkhat in tam mi kamtampa’n “Bang ahiei agen tup?” achi uhi. Pawl dangkhat ten lah “Gamdang pasiente thugen hileh kilawm veh aw” achi uhi, ama’n Jesu thu leh athawkiana thu agen zieh ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh ahing pui ua, Areopagus mun ah atutta ua, akungah, “Tam thuhilna tha na gen khu na hing theisah thei diei?"},"20":{"text":"Sillamdang bang ahiei khat ka bil uah na hing zasahta a, bangchina ahiei a umdan ka thei nuom uhi,” achi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen Athen mite leh tua mun a um gamdang mite zousiein, sil tha tha genna leh ngaikhiehna loungal bangma dangin ahunte uh azang sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Areopagus kikhopna lai ah Paul adinga, agenta hi Athen khuo a mite aw, Banglam pou ah sakhuo biehna ngaisah mi na hi uh chi ka mu hi.","title":"Areopagus a Paul thugen"},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen ka vah kawma na bieh silte uh ka et leh maitam khat atunga “THEILOU PASIAN A DING”, chi a kigiel nangawn ka mu hi. Tuaziehin theiloupi a na bieh pen uh, Ama ahi noute kunga ka kitangkoupi khu."},"24":{"text":"Leitung pumpi leh asunga sil um zousie siempa Pasian khu, lei leh van Mangpa ahiziehin, mihingte khuta bawl innte ah a um ngai sih hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 8.27; Isai. 42.5; Nasep. 7.48"},"25":{"text":"Ama pen tahsapna nei bangin, mihingte khuta nasep pieh in a um ngai sih hi, Aman mi zousie kungah hinna, nahna leh sil zousie ape zaw hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh Aman mi khat sisan a kipat in mi namchin leitung pumpi luosuoh dingin abawl a, amaute dingin hunbite abawl pieh a, tenna ding gamgite ahunpieh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachia amaun kinem tah a Mangpa asui ua; amai amai ua Ama amu teitei na ding un; Aman lah eite ahing gamlat chiet sih ngal a"},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen, Ama ah eite ihing ua, i pia ua, hinna inei uhi; Noute lah mama a na laphuoh siemte un: Eite zong Ama hahlesuonte i hi uhi, chi a agen bangun."},"29":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian hahlesuonte ihi zieh un, Pasian pen mihingte khutsiem silbawl Sana, dangka, ahisihleh suong, banga ingaisut ding uh ahi sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Adihtahin Pasian in bangma itheilou lai un, ahing kitheimaw bawl a, hinanleh tuin vang, mun chin a um mi zousie kisia dingin thu apeta hi."},"31":{"text":"Aman ni achiem ziehin, tua ni chiengin ami guotpa tungtawnin leitung pumpi dihtattah in vai ahawm pieh dinga, Pasian in ami guotpa mishi lah a kipat kaithouin mi zousie kungah atheisahta hi, achi hi.”"},"32":{"text":"Amauten mishi thawkiana thu azah tah un, Pawlkhat in anuisat ua, pawlkhat in lah “Tam thu nanga kipat ka ngai nuom nalai uhi,” achi uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul amaute lah akipat apeita hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahivang in mi bangza ahiei in Paul azui ua, agingta ta uhi. Amaute lah ah Areopagus mi Dionisius leh numei khat amin Damaris leh akung ua midangte toh ahi uhi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte nuain Paul Athen khuo akipat Korinth zuon in apeita hi.","title":"Paul Korinth khuo ah"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh amin Akuila kichi Juda mi khat amu a, tua mipa khu Pontius gam a pieng ahi a, Klaudia in Judate zousie Rome khuo akipat pawtdoh dinga thupieh apieh zieh a, azi Prisilla toh, tumasang zepa Itali akipat hing tung pan bep ahi ua, Paul amaute kungah ahing haw hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n anasep uh puonbuh bawl ahi a, anasep uh akibang ahi ziehin akung uah atunga, amautoh na asemkhawm uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh khawlni chinin kikhopna inn ah, Judate leh Greek mite gintat sah tum in thu akikupi zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Silas leh Timothi Masidonia gam akipat ahing tun tah un, Paul in Hagau theisahnain thu ngentang genin aumta a, Judate kungah Jesu khu Khrist ahi chi theipina thu genin ahil chien zel hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Judaten ama akal ua, agensiet tahun, aman apuonsilte athinga, akung uoh, “Na sisan maw uh nouma lutungah tuta heh! Keipen ka sieng ahi, tu kalsie Jentelte kungah ka peita ding hi,” achi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n khuna pat in apei a, mi khat amin Titus Justus kichipa inn ah alut a, tua mipa’n Pasian abe zel a, a inn zong kikhopna inn toh kizom ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Krispus kikhopna inn vaihawmpa’n a innkuonpite zousie toh Mangpa agingta ua, Korinth khuo a mi tampiin zong Paul thugen zain, agingta ua, baptisma atang uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangpa’n zanlai in mengmuna in Paul ahoupi a, “Zau sinlen, sip louin thu gen zelin;"},"10":{"text":"Kei na kungah ka um ngitnget hi, koiman hing suliem dingin na tung ah khut aha sih ding hi, aziehpen tam khuo ah mi tampi ka nei hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul khum khuo ah kum khat leh ha guh ataam a, alah uah Pasian thu ahil hi."},"12":{"text":"Gallio Akaia gam uhpa ahilai in Judaten kithutuoh tahin Paul aman ua, thukhenna mai ah ahing tut uhi.","title":"Gallio leh Paul"},"13":{"text":"“Tam mipa’n dan toh kituoh loupi a Pasian be dingin mi azawl hi,” chiin aheh uhi."},"14":{"text":"Paul in thu gen ding a akisah laitahin, Gallio in Judate kungah, “Aw nou Judate, sil hoilou bawl thu ahiei, gitlou gamtatna thu ahiei beeh hileh ka hing ngaisah tham ding hi;"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh thute leh minte tualeh nouma dan thute ahi giap leh, nouman kingaituo zaw un, tambang thute ah thukhenpain ka pang ut sih hi,” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n thukhenna toupha mai a kipat in amaute adeldohta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Greek mi zousiein kikhopna inn vaihawmpa Sosthenes aman ua, thukhenna toupha mai ah avuo uhi. Hinanleh Gallio in tam silte bangma in angai pieh sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul khu Korinth khuo ah hun sawttah ataam nalai a, tua zouin unaute toh akivaihah a, Siria gam lam zuonin kuongin apeita hi, tualeh Prisilla leh Akuila toh zong azawhkhawm uhi. Kichiemna khat anei ziehin Kenkeria khuo ah Paul in asam aheu hi.","title":"Paul Siria a akinuale kiana","ref":"Kisim. 6.18"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ephesa khuo atunga, tuanah Prisilla leh Akuila anuasie a, hinanleh ama pen kikhopna inn ah alut a Judate toh thu asuut khawm uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amauten akung ua sawtdeu taam tadi dingin ahou ua, ama a ut sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute avaihah a, ahing tung ding Jerusalem a annkuongluina ah tel teitei ka tum hi; “Pasian in pha asah leh na kung uah ka hing peikia ding hi” achi hi. Tualeh Ephesa khuo akipat kuongin apeita hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kaisaria ahing tunga, apeitou a hattuomte ava nousiet a, Antiok khuo ah apeisuhta hi."},"23":{"text":"Antiok a hun bangtan ahiei ataam nuain akipankhie a, Galatia gam leh Phrigia gam zousie atuon suoh a, nuazuite zousie a sudet a, athakhausah hi."},"24":{"text":"Juda mi khat amin Appolo, Alekzandria khuo a pieng, thugen siem leh Laisiengthou thu thei mama, Ephesa khuo ah ahaw hi.","title":"Ephesa khuo a Apollo nasep"},"25":{"text":"Tam mipa pen Mangpa lampi thu zilsa ahia; Johan baptisma thu maimai theinanleh lungsim a phatuom ngaitah in, Mangpa thu gen in ahilchien zel hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n kikhopna innte ah hangsan tahin thu agen panta a; Prisilla leh Akuilain athugen azah un, a inn uah azawpi ua, Pasian lampi thu kichien zaw sem in ahilchien uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tualeh ama’n Akaia gam a pei atup tahin, unauten ahantawh ua, ama ana kipahpina dingun khum gam a nuazuite kungah lai ahah uhi, tualeh ama atun tah in hepina zieh in gingtute nasatahin apanpita hi."},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen ama’n vantang theiin Judate anieldonga Laisiengthou thu pansan in Jesu khu Khrist ahi, chi athei sah hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Korinth khuo a Apollo aum sungin Paul in mallam gamkai tuonsuoh zouin Ephesa khuo ah ahing tunga, khunah nuazui koite ahiei amu hi.","title":"Baptispa Johan nuazuite Ephesa khuo ah"},"2":{"text":"Aman akung uah, “Na gintat chiillai un Hagau Siengthou na tang uoi?” achi hi. Amaun akungah, “Hagau Siengthou um chi zong ka zakha ngai mawngmawng sih uhi,” achi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman akung uah, “Bang baptisma ahiei na tan uh?” achi hi. Amauten “Johan baptisma,” achi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul in, “Johan in anua a hing pei dingpa gingta ding a mite hil in kisiana baptisma in a baptis zel hi. Tua ahing pei dingpa khu Khrist Jesu ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 3.11; Mak. 1.4,7,8; Luk. 3.4,16; Jn. 1.26,27"},"5":{"text":"Amauten tam thu azah tah un, Mangpa Jesu min in baptisma atangta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Paul in atung ua akhut angah tahin, Hagau Siengthou atung uah ahing tungta a, ham theilouin aham ua, thu agenta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute abawn un mi sawm leh ni ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Paul khu kikhopna inn ah alut a, ha thum sung hangsantah in thu agen a, Pasian leenggam thu ah kinielpi in, mi a zawl lut zel hi.","title":"Paul Ephesa khuo ah"},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh pawlkhatte kilungkhausah in agingta ut sih ua, mipite mai a tua Lampi agensiet tahun, Paul in amauh apeisan a, nuazuite azawpi a, Tiranus sekul ah nisim in thu akikuppi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tambangin kum ni sung a um a, tuachi’n Asia gam pumpi a um Judate leh Greekte zousiein, Mangpa Jesu thu azata uhi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian in Paul khut zangin sillamdang tuom mawngmawngte abawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul satung toh kisukha mainulna diel neu, ahisihleh puonah tungsilte, damloute kungah ahing tawi ua, anatnate uh adam zel a, tualeh asung ua dawi gilou umte zong apawtkhie uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n dawi thusiem vielvah Judate pawl khat in “Paul in athu atangkoupi zel Jesu min in ka hing vau hi,” chiin dawi vei mite tungah, Mangpa Jesu min alou zel uhi.”"},"14":{"text":"Juda siempu lien khat, Skeva in tuabanga bawl tapa sagi anei hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh dawi in adawnga, “Jesu ka thei a, Paul zong ka thei hi, hinanleh noute koite na hi uoi?” achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n dawi matpa’n amaute abaw a, azou a, abawnun anuoinet a, tuachi’n tua inn akipat in saguoh leh liem in ataidoh ta uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tam thu Ephesa khuo a teng Judate leh Greekte zousiein athei tahun azau mama ua, Mangpa Jesu min nasatah a tawisangin a umta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh agingtate tampi zong ahing pei ua, asilbawlte uh thupha tawi in akipuong uhi."},"19":{"text":"Mitphieldawi tawi mi tampi in alaibute uh ahing tawi khawm ua, mi zousie mitmu in ahalta uhi, tualeh aman atuot ua, dangka tul sawmnga man apha hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n thupitah maiin Mangpa thu adalzahta a, a guolzou zel hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua silte nuain Paul in alungsim in Masidonia gam leh Akaia gam atotsuoh zou chienga Jerusalem khuo a pei atum a, “Khuna ka pei zou chiengin Rome khuo zong kava pha teitei ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Paul siltup"},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama nasepna panpi mi ni Timothi leh Erastus Masidonia gam ah asawl a, hinanleh ama pen Asia gam ah hun bangtan ahiei ataam nalai hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua hun lai vel in tua Lampi thu ziehin buoina lientah a um hi.","title":"Ephesa khuo buoina"},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen mi khat amin Demetrius dangka-sia khengmi khat a um a, Dangka sia in Diana biehna inn neu limte bawlin khutsiemte kungah sum muna hoitah asuohsah hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama’n tuabanga khutsiem azahte leh tuabanga nasem dangte ahankhawm a, akung uah, “Lawmte aw, tam nasepna akipat in sum muna hoitah inei uh chi na thei uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tam Ephesa khuo guoh ah hilou in, Asia gam pumpi ah, tam Paul in khut a bawlte pen pasiente ahi sih uh chiin mi tampi athuzaw a akiheisah siengta chi, na mu un na za uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n eite nasep sum muna ahing suhsiet ding zauhuoina guoh hilouin, pasiennu thupitah Diana biehinn zong ahing kingai neu ding a, tualeh Asia gam pumpi leh leitung pumpi miten abieh uh Diana thupina suhsiet in ahing um kha ding hi,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tam thu azah tahun, alungthah mama ua, “Ephesa mite Diana athupi hi,” chiin akikou uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n khosung pumpi buoinain apumdimta a, Masidonia mi Paul in akhuolzinna a azawpite gel, Gaius leh Aristarkus apum mat ua, kituohtahin etnop bawlna inn ah atailutpita uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Paul in mipite lah a lut atup leh, nuazuiten aphal sih uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh Asia gam a houtu lienpente lah a Paul lawmte pawlkhat in akungah mi asawl ua, etnop bawlna inn a lut teitei lou dingin ahou uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tua mun a mipi kikhawmte apumbuoi ua, pawlkhat sil khat akikoupi ua, adangten sil tuom dang khat akikoupi ua, alah ua atamzawin akikhopna zieh uh athei sih uhi."},"33":{"text":"Mipite lah akipat Alekzandar akaidoh ua, Judaten ama mipite mailam ah asawn uhi. Tualeh Alekzandar in akhut azap a mipite kungah asiemna thu gen atum hi."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh ama Juda mi ahi chi athei tahun, naikal ni sung dingvel, aw kituohtah in “Ephesamite Diana athupi hi” chiin akikou uhi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh khopi laigielpa’n mipite asipsah a, Ephesa khuo a mite aw, “Ephesamite khu pasiennu thupitah Diana pen Zeus akipat hing kesuh milim biehinn venga kemte ahi uh chi theilou koi a um ei?"},"36":{"text":"Tuaziehin tam thu niel guollou ahi nuain, na sip khinkhian ding uh ahi, kinawhehu a bangma na bawllou ding uh ahi."},"37":{"text":"Aziehpen tam na hing mi zawpite uh pen, biehinn bulu mi lah ahi sih ua, i pasiennu uh gensie lah ahi sih uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tuaziehin Demetrius leh anaseppi khutsiem miten mi koi ahiei tunga thubuoi anei u’leh, thukhenna inn honsa in aum hi, tualeh gam uhpipate zong a um uhi; kiheh u’heh."},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh sildanga buoina nei na hi u’leh, dan banga kikhopna ah ngaituo ding ahi."},"40":{"text":"Tunia buoina ziehin, itung ua thu ahing um khah ding azauhuoi hi, ikikhopna san pen tami zieh ahi chi ding a um sih hi,” achi hi."},"41":{"text":"Tualeh aman tambanga agen zouin mipi kikhawmte akikhensahta hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Buoina aven nuain, Paul in nuazuite akung ah ahan a, amauh ahantawh zou in Mangpha ahah a, Masidonia gam zuonin apeita hi.","title":"Masidonia gam leh Troas a hathum nasepna"},"2":{"text":"Tua gam sungah azin a, amau hanthawnna thu tampi agen zouin Greek gam atungta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuanah ha thum ataam a, tualeh Judaten ama abuhdap zieh un, Siria gam langa kuonga pei dinga kisa lai, Masidonia gam langa pei dingin akisa kiata hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Berea khomi Pirhus tapa Sopatar, Thessalonika khuo a mite Aristarkus leh Sekundus, Derbe khomi Gaius leh Timothi, tualeh Asia gam mite Tikikus leh Trophimus in Asia gam dongin azui uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tam mite ka masang uah ana pei ua, Troas khuo ah ahing na ngah uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh koute pen Tanghou tolsawlou pawi bawl nua in, Phillipi akipat in tembaw in ka pei ua, ni nga zou in amaute umna Troas khuo ka tung ua, tuanah ni sagi ka taam uhi."},"7":{"text":"Nipikaal ni masapen ni in nuazuite tanghou balkeh dinga ahing peikhawm lai un, Paul in azing ni a pei atup ziehin amauh kungah thu agen a, zankim dongin akihoulimpi a thu ahil zom tou peh hi.","title":"Eutikus kaithawna"},"8":{"text":"Inndan tungnung a akikhopna uah, thaumei tampi akitaang hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh amin Eutikus kichi tangval khat kotta ah atou a, tuitahin ana imu hi, Paul in thu agen sawt seng ziehin, imu lai innsawng thumna akipat in akesuh a, ashisa in aphong uhi."},"10":{"text":"Paul avakumsuh a, atungah abawh a, apom a, “Patau sih un, ahing nalai hi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Paul inndan tunga akaltou kia bepin, tanghou abalkeh a, ane a, sawtpi zingmawng khovah dongin ahoulim a, apeita hi."},"12":{"text":"Amauten tangvalpa hingin ahing zawpi ua, akidawmpah sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n koute tembaw lam ah kana pei ua, tualeh Assos lam zuon in kana pei masa ua, tua mun ah Paul zong tuonsah ka sawm ua, aman keng lam a pei atup zieh in kengin hing pei zawvang achi hi.","title":"Mileta zuon a Paul zinna"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Assos khuo a ahing kimupi tahin, ka tuongsahta ua, Mitilene khuo ka tungta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuana kipat in tembawin ka pei kia ua, azing niin Kios tuikuol gam gallam ka tung ua, tualeh azing ni in Samos ka tung ua, Trogilium ah ka tam ua, azing niin Mileta khuo ka tung uhi."},"16":{"text":"Paul in Asia gama taam sawt a utlou ziehin Ephesa khuo tembaw a pei pel atupsa mawng ahia; ahithei liei leh Jerusalem khuo a pentikos pawi lap a tun a ut a, kin pei ahi."},"17":{"text":"Mileta khuo akipat, Ephesa khuo ah mi asawl a, hattuom upate ava hansah hi.","title":"Ephesa hattuom upate avaihahna thu"},"18":{"text":"Amaute a kunga ahing tun tahun,” Paul in amaute kungah, Asia gam a ka hing tun chiil ni masa ni akipata na lah ua ka um sungsie a ka umdan na thei uhi,"},"19":{"text":"Lungsim a kingaingiemna leh Judaten ahing zebawl ua ahing bawlsietzieh ua hitui tampi toh ka tung a hing tungte thuoh kawmin Mangpa nna ka sem hi."},"20":{"text":"Noute phattuomna ding bangma im ka nei sih a, ka hing theisah sieng hi, tangpi theiin thu ka gen a, inn chin ah noute thu kang hil ngitnget hi."},"21":{"text":"Judate leh Greekte kungah zong, Pasian lam a kihei kisiana thu leh i Mangpa Jesu Khrist lam a ginna thu ka theisah zel hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuin Ngai un, Hagau a kolbun in Jerusalem a hawtou dinga kisa ka hia, khunah ka tunga sil hing tungdingte ka thei sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Henna leh gimthuohna in ahing na dawn ding chi a, Hagau Siengthou in khochin a, ahing theisahte maimaite ka thei hi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh ka kitaidemna kipahtah a ka taitung theina ding leh Mangpa Jesu a kipat a ka mu, Pasian hepina khantanhoi theisah ding nasepna ka sep zou theina dingin, tam silte khat beehin ahing suling sih a, ka hinna zong it taahin ka ngai sih hi.","ref":"2 Tim. 4.7"},"25":{"text":"Tualeh tuin Ngai un, noute zousie lah a, Pasian leenggam thu gen a ka vah kawinate’n ka mel na mu nawn sih ding uh, chi ka thei hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin mi zousie sisan ah ka sieng ahi chi tuni’n ka hing theisah hi."},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian thuguot zousie noute kunga phuondoh lou a im ka nei sih hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin noute pilvang unlen, belamhonte zousie vengun, Pasian Hattuom Ama sisan a aleisate vah dingin, Hagau Siengthouin amaute lah a belampu hi dingin noute ahing guot ahi."},"29":{"text":"Aziehpen ka pei nua chiengin, ngia giloute na lah uah ahing lut dinga, belamhon akhawi sih ding uh, chi ka thei hi."},"30":{"text":"Nouma lah mama ah zong nuazuite amauh lam a kaimang dingin, thu alelam a gen ahing um ding uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaziehin kivengun, kum thum vingveng, asun azan a hitui luong kawma, michin phawhhil ka tawp lou dan thei ngitnget un."},"32":{"text":"Tuin unaute, noute hing lamtou a, hing khangsah thei a, mi suhsiengthousate lah a goutan pe thei Pasian leh akhotuona thu ah noute ka hing kemsah hi."},"33":{"text":"Koima sana, dangka leh sil leh ten, ka eng ngai sih hi."},"34":{"text":"Tam khutte’n keima leh ka kunga umte tahsap awng hu in ka sem zel chi noute mamain na thei uhi."},"35":{"text":"Bangkim ka bawl zousie nouten zong tambanga semgim leh Mangpa Jesu thu thei ngitnget kawmin mi hatloute na panpi ding dan uh hing ensah ka hi. Mangpa Jesu mama in lah sangin pieh hi guolzawlna sangzaw a hi,” achi khu thei ngitnget un."},"36":{"text":"Tam thute agen zouin, khupdin in amaute zousie toh athum khawm uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh a unpi un akap ua, Paul angawng kawi ua, atawp uhi."},"38":{"text":"Amel amu nawnlou ding uh, thu agenin amauh adasah pen hi. Tualeh amaun tembaw umna mun tan dong ava ha ta uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amautoh ka kikhen nua un, tembaw ah ka tuong ua, tangtahin ka pei ua, Kos ka tung ua, azingniin Rhodes ka tung ua, tuana pat in Patara khuo ka tung uhi.","title":"Paul Tai-ar ah"},"2":{"text":"Tuanah Phoenicia gam a pei ding Tembaw khat ka mu ua, ka tuong ua, ka peita uhi."},"3":{"text":"Saipras tuikuol gam ka galmu tahun, veilam ah ka pel ua, Siria gam zuon in ka pei ua, Tai-ar khuo ka tung uhi, tembaw vante suokhe ding ahizieh un, tua khopi ah ka kum uhi."},"4":{"text":"Nuazuite ka suidoh ua, tuanah ni sagi ka taam uhi; amaun hagau theisahnain, Paul kungah Jerusalem ah hawtou sin achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua mun a ni sagi ka taam zou un, ka kipandoh ua, ka peina ding uh ka zuonta ua, a unpi un azi leh atate utoh khopi pulam tan ahing ha ua, tuachi’n tuipi gei ah khupdin in thu ka ngen uhi."},"6":{"text":"Mangpha ka kihah zou un, koute tembaw ah ka tuong ua, amaute inn langah anua peikiata uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tai-ar khuo akipat tembaw in ka pei zel ua, Tolemai khuo ka tung ua, unaute ka nousiet ua, akung uah ni khat ka taam uhi."},"8":{"text":"Azingni in ka kipandoh ua, Kaisaria ka tung ua, sagite lah a khat, sawltah Philip inn ah ka lut ua, tuanah ama toh ka um uhi.","title":"Paul Kaisaria ah","ref":"Nasep. 6.5; 8.5"},"9":{"text":"Philip in tanu, nungah Siengthou li anei a, amauten guolnei bangin thu agen uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua khuo a ni tampi ka tam sungun, Judia gam a kipat amin Agabus kichi guolnei khat ahing haw suh hi.","ref":"Nasep. 11.28"},"11":{"text":"Ama ka kung uah ahing haw a, Paul kawnggah ala a, akhutte leh akengte akikaan a, “Tam kawnggah neipa, Jerusalem khuo a Judaten tambangin akaan ding ua, Jentelte khut ah ape ding uhi, Hagau Siengthou in achi hi,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tam thu ka zah tahun, koute leh tua mun a umten, Paul Jerusalem khuo a hawlou dingin ka hou uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul in nouten kap a na hing hasietsah uh “Bang na china uh ahiei? Mangpa Jesu min a Jerusalem a kaan a um bep hilouin shi ding nangawn ngap ka hi,” chi’n adawng hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachia hou zou guol ahilou tahin ka tawp ua, “Mangpa thu thu hita heh,” ka chita uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tua nite nuain ka kisa ua, Jerusalem ah ka pei touta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Kaisaria apat nuazui pawlkhat in zong ahing zui ua, amaun Mnason inn ah ahing zawpi ua, tuanah ka tung uhi. Ama Saipras gam a nuazui masate lah a khat ahi."},"17":{"text":"Jerusalem ka tuntah un unauten kipahtah in ang na dawn uhi."},"18":{"text":"Azingniin Paul leh kouten Jakob ka vave ua, tuanah hattuom upate zousie zong a um uhi.","title":"Paul in Juda ngainadan azui"},"19":{"text":"Paul in amaute a nousiet zouin, ama nasepna tungtawn a Jentelte lah a Pasian silbawlte abanban in agen hi."},"20":{"text":"Amauten tam thu azah tahun, Pasian apahtawi uhi. Tualeh amauten Paul kungah, “Sanggampa aw, Judate lah a mi tul tampiin agintat taah dan uh na thei hi. Tualeh amaute zousie in dan thu ah phatuom angai mama uhi;"},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh nang, Jentelte lah a Juda umte zousie kung ah, atate uh teptan lou ding leh tawndante zui lou ding, chiin Mosi dan paidohna ding thu na hil zel hi chi mi kam a kipat in na thu ana thei uhi."},"22":{"text":"Bangchi hita ding ahiei le? Na hing tung chi lah aza ngei ding ua, mipi ahing peikhawm ngeingei ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin na kunga ka gen bangun bawlin, kichiemna nei pasal li ka nei uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 6.13-21"},"24":{"text":"Amaute pui inlen, amau’toh kisiensuo inlen, asam heukieuna ding uh sum tuohpieh in, tuachi’n mi zousiein mi kam a na thu azah teng uh, bangmalou ahi chi athei ding ua, nang pen kituptah a dan zuiin na um zaw hi, chi athei ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Jentel gingtute tungtang thu ah pen, milim biehna sa anehlou ding uh, sisan anehlou ding uh, hehlup sa anehlou ding uh, kingaina thanghuoi lah apat akihepkhiet ding uh, chiloungal sildang atang sih ding uh, chiin ka gen ua, ka gielta uhi, achi uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 15.29"},"26":{"text":"Tuachi’n azingni in Paul in tua kichiemna nei mite azawpi a, amaute toh ava kisiensuo a, Pasian biehinn ah alut a, kisiensuona ni bei hun ding leh, amaute chiet a dinga asillat hun ding uh, siempu kungah ava theisah uhi."},"27":{"text":"Kisiensuona ni sagi abei ding kuon tahin, Asia gam a Judaten Pasian bieh inna Paul amutahun, mipi zousie achiilsie ua, Paul apum mat ua,","title":"Jerusalem a Paul kimatna"},"28":{"text":"akikou ua, “Israel mite aw hing panpi un! Tam mipa ahi, munchin a mi zousie kunga Judamite, dan leh tam mun gensie, tuathamlouin aman Greekte tam biehinn huongsungah alutpi a, tam bieh inn siengthou asubua zouta hi,” achi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Aziehpen tumasang laiin khopi sungah Ephesa khomi Trophima Paul toh umkhawm amu ua, Paul in ama bieh inn sunga hing puilut tain agingta uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 20.4"},"30":{"text":"Tuachi’n khojangin abuoipita ua, mipite hing taikhawmin Paul aman ua, biehinnpi akipat akaidoh ua, kotpite akha pai uhi."},"31":{"text":"Paul that dinga akisah laitah un, Jerusalem khuoa mi zousie abuoijahta uh chi thu galkap lamkai lienpen kungah atung hi."},"32":{"text":"Ama’n galkapte leh galkap zahoutu azawpi pai a, akung uah ataisuh a, tuachi’n amauten galkap lienpen leh galkapte amu tahun, Paul avuoh uh atawpta uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkap lienpen ahing pei a Paul aman a, sia khainieng ni a hen ding thu apie a, tualeh aman Paul khu koi ahia, bang ahiei abawl chiin adong hi."},"34":{"text":"Mipite lah a pawlkhat thu khat genin akikou ua, midangte lah thudang genin akikou uhi. Tualeh buoi zieh in thutah atheichien theisih a, galkapte giehbuh a, ama peipi dingin galkapte thu apie hi."},"35":{"text":"Tualeh Paul kalbi atun tahin, mipite alungthah mama zieh un, galkapten ama apuohthaw uhi."},"36":{"text":"Aziehpen mipiten azui ua, “Ama that un,” chiin akikou uhi."},"37":{"text":"Galkapten giehbuh sunga Paul lutpi ding a akisah lai un, aman galkapte lamkai lienpen kungah na kungah “Thu khat ka gen thei diei?” achi a, tualeh aman “Greek ham na thei ama?” chiin adong hi."},"38":{"text":"Tumasang lai a helna bawl a, mi that pawl, mi tulli val gamdai a puidohpa, Izipt mi hilou na hiei mah?” achi hi."},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh Paul in, “Kei Judami, Sillisia gam a Tursas khuo ami ka hi, khopi neu a piengka hisih hi, hing hepi inlen mipite kungah thu hing gen sahin,” achi hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuachia phalna apieh tahin, Paul kalbi tungah adinga, mipi lam ngain akhut azap a, amaute asip dide tah un, akung uah Hebru ham in thu agen hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Sanggamte leh pate aw, tuin na kung uah ka dihna thu ka gen ding hi,” na ngai un.","title":"Judate kunga Paul thugen"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh akung ua Hebru ham a thu agen azah tahun, asipta semsem uhi. Tuachi’n aman."},"3":{"text":"“Kei Judami ka hi a, Sillisia gam a Tarsas khuo a pieng ka hi, hinanleh tam khopi a Gamiliel kengbul a khanglien ka hia, ipu ipate uh dan khautah dungzui a zildoh a, tuni a noute banga Pasian lam a phatuomngai ka na hi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 5.34-39"},"4":{"text":"Tam Lam zui mite shina khopin kana bawlsie a, numei leh pasalte ka kaan a, suongkul ah ka khum zel hi.","ref":"Nasep. 8.3; 26.9-11"},"5":{"text":"Siempu lien leh upa vaihawmte zousie in zong tua thu ahing theipi uhi; amaute a kipat in Damaska a um unaute pieh dingin lai ka la a, tam mite Jerusalem a gawt dingin, kaansa a hing kai dingin Damaska lam zuon in ka peita hi."},"6":{"text":"“Damaska ka tun ding kuonin, sunkim lai tahin, thakhat in van akipat in vah thupitah ka kim ah ahing taang hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n kei tuol ah ka pua a, tualeh aw khat in Saul, Saul, nang bangdinga kei hing bawlsie na hiei? chiin ka za hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken Mangpa koi na hiei? chiin ka dawng hi. Tualeh Aman ka kungah, Kei na suhgenthei Nazareth Jesu ka hi, achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka kunga kei toh umkhawmten vah amu ua, azau uhi, hinanleh, Kei hing houpipa aw pen aza sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ken, Mangpa bang ka bawl diei? ka chi hi. Tualeh Mangpa’n ka kungah, Thou inlen Damaska khosung ah lut in, tuanah sil zousie na bawl dingte, ahing kihil ding hi, achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua vah athupi seng ziehin khuo ka mu thei nawn sih a ka lawmten akhut un ahing kai ua, Damaska khuo ah ka lutta hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tuachi’n Anania kichi mi khat, dan dungzui a mi kipezoutah leh tua khuo a um Judate zousie in agen phat uh;"},"13":{"text":"Ka kungah ahing pei a, ka kunga dingin, Sanggampa, Saul, khuo muta in ahing chi hi. Tualeh tua hun laitah mama in, ama ka mu thei pai hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n ama’n, ipu ipate Pasian in, Ama deilam thei ding leh Adihtatpa mu a, akam a pawt aw za dinga ahing teldoh ahita hi."},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen na mu leh na zah thu ah mi zousie kunga Ama theipi mi na hi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuin bang ngah nalai na hiei? Thou inlen baptisma tangin, Mangpa min in thungen inlen, na khelnate silsiengin, ahing chi hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tualeh hichi ahing hi a, Jerusalem a ka kinuale kia zou a, biehinn a ka thunget laiin, mengmuna ka mu a,","title":"Paul Jerusalem pawtsan dingin Mangpa’n ahilna"},"18":{"text":"Kinaw inlen, kintahin, Jerusalem a kipat in pawt in, aziehpen kei nang theipina thu amauten pom lou ding ahi uh, hing chi in Ama ka mu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken, Mangpa kikhopna innte a banluta, Nang hing gingtate suongkul a khuma ka vuoh zel dan amaun athei mama ding uhi;"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Na thu theipipa Stephen sisan asuo lai un thukimpi in amaute kungah ka dinga, ama thatte puonsilte kana keem hi, ka chi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 7.58"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman ka kungah, Pei in! tana kipata gamla tah a, Jentelte kunga hing sawl ding ka hi, ahing chita hi, achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Amauten Paul in tamtan dong agen angaikhie ua, tuachi’n aw ngaitahin akikou ua, “Tambang mihing leitunga pat sumangun, hingtaah ahi sih hi,” achi uhi.","title":"Paul in Rome khopi mi ahina atahlatna"},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n akikou pum un, apuonte uh abotkeh ua, van lam ah leivui athe ua,"},"24":{"text":"Galkap lamkai lienpen in, galkapte giehbuh sunga Paul puilut ding thu apie hi, tambang lawmlawm a atungthu a akikouna zieh uh theichienna dingin zep a dohchien ding, achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh ama savun khau a akaan laiun, Paul in akunga ding galkap zahoutupa kungah “Rome khopi mi khat poupou siemlou tansahna umlou a, vuohna ding thuneina na nei uoi mah?” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Galkap zahoutupa’n tua thu azah tahin galkap lamkai lienpen kungah ava pei a, “Na silbawl dingah pilvangin tam mipa Romemi ahi,” chiin ava hil hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkap lienpenpa ahing pei a, akungah, “Rome mi na hi amah?” hing hil in achi hi. Paul in hi ma “Inge,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh galkap lamkai lienpen pa’n, “Tam khomi hina ken sum tampi a ka lei ahi,” achi hi, Paul in “Kei pen Rome mi hisa a pieng ka hi,” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n dongchien dinga kisate akikangkoi pai uhi, tualeh galkap lamkai lienpenpa’n zong Rome mi khat kaan kha ahi chi akithei tahin a zauta hi."},"30":{"text":"Azingniin galkap lamkai lienpenpa’n Paul kolbute asutkhie a, bangzieh a Judaten aheh uh ahiei, chi theinuom in, siempu liente leh vaihawm mite zousie kikhawm dingin thu apie a, Paul ahing zawpi ua, amaute mai ah ading sahta hi.","title":"Sanhedrin masangah Paul apui uh"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul in vaihawm pawlte a en pimpem a, sanggamte aw, tuni tan in Pasian masanga ka sie leh pha theina siengtah toh ka hinkhuo zangtou zel ka hi, achi hi."},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu lien Anania in Paul kunga dingte kungah akam behpieh dingin thu apie hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuabep in Paul in akungah, nang baang kinungoupa Pasian in nangma hing beeng ding ahi aw! Dan toh kituoh a ka tunga thukhen dinga tou hinapi chin a, dan palsan a kei beeng dingin thu na pie maw? achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 23.27,28"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Paul kunga dingte’n, nang Pasian siempu lien, na hichi phawh ngam vielmaw? achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul in sanggamte aw, ama siempu lien ahi chi ka thei sih a ahi; Na mite uh tunga vaihawm mite tungah thu hoilou gen sin, chi gel ahima ve, achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 22.28"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Paul in amaute lah a pawl khat Saddukaite ahi ua, adangte Pharisaite ahi uh chi athei tahin, vaihawm na ah akikou a, Sanggamte aw, Kei Pharisai ka hi a, Pharisai tapa ka hi, kinepna leh mishi thawkiana thu toh kisaia vaihawmna masanga dinsah ka hi, achi hi.","ref":"Nasep. 26.5; Phil. 3.5"},"7":{"text":"Tam thu agen tahin, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite kaal ah kiselna a pieng a, vaihawm pawlte akilangkhenta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen Saddukaiten, thawkiana mawngmawng a um sih a, vansawlsiengte leh hagau zong a um sih hi, achi ua, hinanleh Pharisaiten tuate gel a um ahi chi ahum uhi.","ref":"Mat. 22.23; Mak. 12.18; Luk. 20.27"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n nasataha kiselbuoina a umta a, Pharisaite lam a pang laigiel mite adingdoh ua, tam mipa ah gitlouna bangma i mu sih uh, hinanleh hagau ahiei, vansawlsieng ahiei in akunga thu gen hikha leh, Pasian i dou sih ding uh, achi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahing kiniel sang deudeu tah un, galkap lamkai lienpenpa’n Paul abawtel khah ding uh azau a, galkapte va pei suh a, amaute lah a kipat Paul va pummat a, galkapte giehbuh a hing zawpi dingin thu apie hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh azingni zanin, Paul kungah Mangpa ava dinga, Paul hamuong tahin um in; Jerusalem khuo a ka thu theipina thu na gen bangin, Rome khopi ah zong ka thu na theisah ding hi, achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Zing khuo ahing vah tahin Judate pawlkhat thu akikum ua, Paul atha masangsie ua, bangma ne leh dawn lou dingin, akichiemta uhi.","title":"Judaten Paul atha sawm uh"},"13":{"text":"Tambanga thu phiel dap a pawl kibawlte mi sawmli sanga tamzaw ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute siempu liente leh upate kung ah ahing pei ua, Paul ka tha masangsie ua, bangma nelou dingin kichiemna dettahin ka kichiem uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin nouten vaihawm pawlte toh, athu dong chien zawsem ding kipang unlen, zing chienga na kung ua hing puikhe suh dingin galkap lamkai lienpenpa kungah vagen un, tualeh ama na kung uh ahing tun masanga na that ding a mansa ka hi uh, achi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh Paul sanggamnu tapa in, ana dapbuh thu uh aza a, galkapte giehbuh ah avalut a, Paul kungah avahil ta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul in galkap zahoutu khat akung ah ahan a, Tam tangvalpa, galkap lamkai lienpenpa kungah va zawpi in, aman akungah gen ut anei hi, achi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman galkap lienpenpa kungah azawpi a, hentapa Paul in akungah ahing han a, tam tangvalpa na kunga zawpi dingin ahing ngen hi. Aman na kungah gen ding bang ahiei khat anei hi, achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkap lamkai lienpenpa’n akhut in atu a, atuomin apuidoh a, ka kunga na gen ut bang ahiei? chi’n adap doh hi."},"20":{"text":"Aman, Paul thu kichien sema dongchien nuom kipangin zing chienga vaihawm pawlte kunga puisuh dingin Judaten hing nget lem asata uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh athu uh na zop sin, aziehpen alah ua mi sawmli sanga tamzawten adap buh ua, tua miten Paul atha masangsie ua, bangma nelou leh dawnlou dingin akichiem uhi, tualeh tuin na thu ngah in mansa in a um uhi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkap lamkai lienpenpa’n tangvalpa apei sahta a, Tam thu na hing theisahta chi, koima hil sin, chiin thu apie hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh galkap zahoutu ni ahan a: keng galkap zani toh, sakol tungtuong galkap sawm sagi toh, teipi tawi galkap zani toh, tuzan nai kuona a Kaisaria zuon a pei dingin kisa un.","title":"Paul hutkhietna"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Paul tuonna ding sakolte mansain guot unlen, uhpipa Felix kungah ama bittahin tunpi un, achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh aman tambangin laithot agiel hi."},"26":{"text":"Klaudia Lisia in, azatat huoi mama uhpipa Felix, chibai abuh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tam mipa, Judate’n amat ua atha ding kuon un, ama Rome khopi mi ahi chi ka za a, galkapte toh kuon in kava hunkhie hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama ahehna uh thei nuom in, avaihawm mite uh kungah ka peipi a;"},"29":{"text":"ahehna thu uh amauh dan toh kisai ahi a, shina ding khop leh khainienga kaanna ding khop hehna ahi sih, chi ka mu hi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Judaten ama alambuh uh chi, mi’n ahing hil tahin, na kungah ama ka hing sawl pai hi, tua ban ah, ama ahehna uh nang kung tun dingin ama hehte zong thu ka pie hi, Mangpha."},"31":{"text":"Tuachi’n athupieh bangin galkapten azan azan in Paul azawpi ua, Antipatri atun uhi."},"32":{"text":"Azingni in sakol tungtuong galkapte’n Paul azawpi ua, adang teng giehbuh ah akinuale ta uhi."},"33":{"text":"Amaute Kaisaria atun tahun, uhpipa kungah laithot apie ua, Paul zong amasangah ading sah uhi."},"34":{"text":"Uhpipa’n laithot asim a, Paul umna gam adonga, Sisillia gam ahi chi atheitah in;"},"35":{"text":"Nang hing hehte ahing tun chiengun, na thu ka ngaikhe ding achi hi. Tualeh Paul pen Herod vaihawmna innsunga koi dingin thu apie hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ninga nuain Siempu lien Anania, upate leh dansiem Tertullus toh ahing peisuh ua, Paul amawsahna thute uh uhpipa kungah ahing tun uhi.","title":"Paul uhpipa Felix masangah"},"2":{"text":"Paul hatlut ahitahin, Tertullus in Paul aheh pan pai a, zatat huoi Pu Felix aw, “Nangma vangin Kouten lemna leh muonna thupitah ka neita ua, mailam hun na mulawhna in tam nam a dingin nopsahna ahing tun a,"},"3":{"text":"Bangchih lai pouin mun chin ah, lungdam tahin ka kipah ngitnget uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ahivang in nang dinga chimtahhuoi ka hilouna dingin, na hepina a, ka thu uh themkhat hing ngaikhiet pieh dingin, ka hing ngen hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen kouten tam mi muda huoitah, leitunga Judate zousie tohbuoipa leh Nazareth mite pawl a alamkaipen khat uh ahi, ka thei uhi;"},"6":{"text":"Aman biehinnpi nangawn suhbua atum a, tualeh ama ka man ua, kouma dan toh kituoh a atunga thukhen ka sawm uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh galkap lamkai lien Lisia ka kung uah ahing pei a, thagum hat in ka khut ua kipat ang lah piehta hi;"},"8":{"text":"Ama hehte nangma kunga hing pei dingin thu ahing pie hi. Nangma mama in ama dongchien lachin, ka hehna thute uh na thei ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh Judaten zong, ama ahehna thu zousie adih ahina chi’n apang uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n uhpipa’n thugen dingin Paul akhutzap a, Paul in adawnna agen a: “Kum tam tah tam namte thukhen piehpa na hi chi ka thei ziehin, kipahtahin ka dihna thu ka gen ding hi.","title":"Felix masangah Paul in adihna agen"},"11":{"text":"Jerusalem a Pasian be dinga ka peitou nua ni sawm leh ni ni val ahi nai sih ding chi na thei thei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei hing hehte’n biehinnpi a mi toh ka kiniel ahiei, ahisihleh kikhopna inn leh khopi sunga mipi ka chiilsietna bangma amu sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuin zong ahing hehnate uh, kichientahin abul asuikhe thei sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh tam thu na kungah ka phuong ahi, Amaun bieh dan tuom achi uh Lam zui in ka pu leh pate uh Pasian ka bie a, dan leh guolneite laibu a kigiel zousie gingta ka hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi dihtatte leh mi dihtatloute thawkiana a um ding chia amaute’n zong agintat uh, tua khu ken zong Pasian ah ka kineppi ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tambang ahiziehin, Pasian leh mihing lama sie leh pha theikhenna nei a suhkhiel bei a um dingin ka kipaubawl vevaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Kum tampi nuain ka nampite kunga, silpiehte pe ding leh sillatte lan dingin ka hing pei a,","ref":"Nasep. 21.17-28"},"18":{"text":"Alah uah Asia gam a hing kipan Juda miten ka kisiensuo laitah ahing mu ua, mipite toh ka umkhawm nai sih a, buoina zong a um sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua miten ka tunga thubuoi nei ahi uleh tanah na masanga um in, hing heh u’leh ave le."},"20":{"text":"Ahisihleh tam mite ngel in zong vaihawm mite masanga ka din laiin, ka bawlkhelna mu anei u’leh tua na masanga ka din laiin gen uheh."},"21":{"text":"Amaute mai a mishi thawkiana thu ah, tunia noute masang a thukhenna tuoh dinga din sah a ka um, chia ka kikou khu ahiloungal leh chiin adawng hi.”","ref":"Nasep. 23.6"},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Felix in tam thute azah tahin, tua ‘Lam’ thu khu atheichien deuta a, amaute kung ah, “Galkap lamkai lienpen Lisia ahing tun suh chiengin na thu uh, thutanna ka bawl ding hi,” chiin akhawlsah ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman galkap zahoutu khat kungah, Paul khu venga zalen deu a um sah a, alawmten aneh leh dawn abawlpieh uleh ahing ve ding uh, khaam lou dingin thu apie hi."},"24":{"text":"Ni bangza ahiei nuain Felix khu azi Judami Drusilla toh ahing pei ua, Paul ahan sah a, Khrist aginna thu angaikhie hi."},"25":{"text":"Paul in dihtatna thute, kidehna thute leh vaihawmna hing tung ding thute agen leh Felix khu zau in achitun a, “Tuin peikia phot inlen, hun lem ka nei chiengin ka hing han kia ding” achi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuabangkaal ah ahakhietna dinga, Paul in sum apieh ding bang akinem a, Paul ahan sah mun mama a ahoupi thimthem hi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh kum ni zouin Porsia Festus in Felix ahing hengta a, tualeh Felix in Judate kipahsah a ut a, Paul khu kaansa in anuasieta hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Festus tua gam ahingtun nua ni thumin Kaisaria apat in Jerusalem ah ahaw tou hi.","title":"Festus mai a Paul adinna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n siempu liente leh Juda lamkaiten akungah Paul tungthu ahilou lam a atheisah kawm un hehna apie uhi;"},"3":{"text":"Lampi a ana buhdap ua, atha theina dingun, akungah Paul khu Jerusalem a ahattouna dingin deisahna angen uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Festus in Paul pen Kaisaria a kep ding ahi, Keima zong khum langa peipai ding ka hi, chiin adawng hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tuachi’n” aman, “Paul in gitlouna nei ahileh na lah ua thuneiten hing zui suh u’henlen, heh uheh” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Festus alah ua ni sawm val ataam nuain Kaisaria ah apei suh kiata hi. Azingniin thukhenna toupha ah atou a, Paul hing pui dingin thu apie hi."},"7":{"text":"Paul ahing tun tahin, Jerusalem akipata hing peisuh Judate akim ah ading ua, atungah agen chien theilou uh hehna nasatah tampiin aheh uhi."},"8":{"text":"Paul in adihna thu agen a, “Judate dan thu hiin, biehinnpi thu hitaleh, tualeh Kaisar tungah hitaleh, bangma ka bawlkhiel mawngmawng sih hi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Festus in Judate deilam bawl a ut a, Paul adawnga tualeh akungah, “Jerusalem a peitou a, khunah ka mai a tam thute ngaituo hileh na ut ei?” achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n Paul in, “Kaisar thukhenna toupha mai a thukhenpieh a um dingin ka ding hi; Judate tungah bangma ka bawl khiel sih chi nang chientahin na thei hi."},"11":{"text":"Migilou ka hi a, shina khop a sil bawlkhiel ka hileh, shi zong ka niel sih hi; hinanleh tam mite hing hehnate adihlou ahi nua in, Koiman amaute khut a ahing pieh thei uh ka hi sih, Kaisar kungah ka tut ding,” achi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n Festus in avaihawmpite toh akikup zou un, adawnga, “Kaisar kungah tut na tum maw? Kaisar kungah na tung ngei ding hi” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh ni bangza ahiei nua in, Lengpa Agrippa leh Bernisi Kaisaria ah Festus nousiet dingin ahing pei uhi.","title":"Agrippa mai ah Paul"},"14":{"text":"Amaute khuna ni tampi atam nua un, Festus in leengpa kungah “Paul tungthu agen a, Felix in, suongkul taangmi khat anuasie a;"},"15":{"text":"Jerusalem a ka um laiin siempu liente leh Juda upaten athu ahing theisah ua, siemlou tangsah dingin ahing ngen uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ken akung uah, ahehpa u’leh ahehte akimaituo ua, ahehna thu ua, ama adihna thu genna hun lemtang anei masangin, mi koima gawt dinga piehdoh pen Romemite dan ahisih hi, chiin ka dawng hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaute tam mun a ahing peikhawm tah un, zekai louin, azingni in thukhenna toupha ah ka tou a, tua mipa hing pui dingin thu ka pie hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama hehtute ahing din tah un, ka gintat bangtahin atung ah gitlouna hehna bangma agen thei sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh amauh bieh dante leh, mi khat, ashisa, Paul in ahing kia hi chia agen thu a, kinielna nei ahizaw uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh ken tuabang dohnate ka theisiem lou ziehin, Jerusalem a peitou a, khuna tam thute khen a ut leh utlou ka dong hi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Paul in athukhen dinga Augustus kunga thu atut zieh in, Kaisar kunga ama ka sawldoh thei masangsie ama veng dingin thu ka pie hi,” achi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi’n Agrippa in Festus kungah, “Ken zong tua mipa thugen ka ngaikhe nuom hi,” achi hi. Aman “Zing chiengin” “Ama thugen na ngaikhe ding” achi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n azingni in Agrippa leh Bernisi thupitah in ahing pei ua, galkap lamkai liente leh khopi miliente toh thugenna inn ah alut ua; Festus in thu apie a, Paul ahing pui uhi.","title":"Agrippa mai ah Paul"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Festus in “Leengpa Agrippa leh tammun a ka kung ua um mi zousiete aw, tam mipa na mu uhi, ama pen Juda mipite zousie in Jerusalem leh Kaisaria mun ah, ka kungah aheh ua, hing taah ahi nawn sih chiin akikou uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh shina ding khop hiel bangma abawl sih chi ka thei hi, aman Augustus kunga athu tut atup ziehin sawl dingin pha ka sat a hi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh ka toupa kunga ama tungthu gel ding kichientah bangma ka nei sih hi. Tuaziehin na masang uah ka hing puikhie ahi; leengpa Agrippa, adiehin nangma masanga hing pui tuonse ka hi, aziehpen athu na dohchien nua a gel ding themkhat ka nei theina dingin."},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen hehna kichientah genlou a, henta khat hing sawlpen kei adingin bawldan kilawm hiin ka thei sih hi,” achi hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Agrippa in Paul kungah, “Na dihna thu na gen thei hi,” achi hi. Tuachi’n Paul in akhut azah a adihna thu agen panta a;","title":"Agrippa mai ah Paul in adihna agen"},"2":{"text":"“Lengpa Agrippa aw, Judaten ahing hehna zousie ah ka dihna thu tunia na mai a ka gen thei ding ziehin hampha ka kisa hi;"},"3":{"text":"Adiehin, Judate toh kisai tawndan leh thubuoi zousie thu a pil mama na hi ziehin hampha ka kisa hi. Tuaziehin ka thu lungduoi tah a hing ngaikhiet pieh dingin ka hing ngen hi."},"4":{"text":"“Ka naupan lai akipat Jerusalem khuo a keima chi leh namte lah a ka hindan leh ka khankhiet dan achiil akipat, Judate zousie in athei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Achiil akipat in ka tanchin athei uhi, ka sakhuo dan ua akulmut pen dungzui a, hinkhuo na zang Pharisai ka hi chi a ut uleh agen thei tham ding uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 23.6; Phil. 3.5"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tuin, Pasian in ka pu ka pate uh kunga thuchiem ana bawl kineppina ziehin, thukhenpieh a umin ka ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua thuchiem kinem in ka minam uh nam sawm leh nam ni ten, sun leh zan in Pasian nna phatuomngai tah in ka sem uhi. Lengpa Agrippa aw, tam kinepna ziehin Judate’n ahing heh uh ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian in mishite akaithou chi bang dinga nouten gintat huoilou a ngaituo na hi uoi?"},"9":{"text":"“Keima mama in zong Nazareth Jesu min dou a sil tampi bawllou theilou in kana kingai hi","ref":"Nasep. 8.3; 22.4,5"},"10":{"text":"Tuabangin Jerusalem khuo ah zong ka na bawl zel hi. Siempu liente akipat in thuneina lai muin misiengthoute tampi suongkul ah ka khum hi, tualeh amauh atha lai un, phasahpi lam ah ka na pang zel hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh kikhopna inn chin ah amaute ka gawt zel a, Jesu min gensiet sah teitei ka tum hi; tualeh atung uah ka lungthah sengsenga, amaute gawt dingin gamdang khopite nangawn ah ka kuon zel hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tuabang bawl dingin, siempu liente akipat thuneina muin, asawlna lai uh tawi in Damaska khopi zuon in ka pei hi."},"13":{"text":"Lengpa aw, lampi a ka pei laiun, sunkim laitahin van a kipat in vah ni sanga vahpha zaw, kei leh ka zawpite kim a ahing taang ka mu hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka unpi un tuol ah ka pua ua, Hebru ham in Saul, Saul, nang bangdinga hing sugenthei na hiei? Kilna sia zumte peh nanga dingin ahasa hi, chi a hing houpi aw khat ka za hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken, koi na hiei Mangpa? Ka chi a, tualeh Aman na suhgenthei Jesu ka hi, achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh thou inlen na kengin dingin, tam na sil mute leh na kunga ka hing musah nahlai dingte, theipitu hi ding leh nna sem dinga hing bawl dingin na kunga hing kilah ka hi."},"17":{"text":"Judate leh tua ka hing sawlna Jentelte khut a kipat ka hing hundoh ding."},"18":{"text":"Jentelte mit suvah ding leh miel apata vahlam ngasah dingin, tualeh Setan thuneina apat Pasian lama akihei theina ding u’leh khelna ngaidamna amu theina ding u’leh kei ahing gintat zieh ua, kisusiengte lah a goutan anei theina ding uh ahi, achi hi."},"19":{"text":"“Tuaziehin, Aw leengpa Agrippa, vanlam kilahna thumanglou in ka um sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh amasa penin Damaska khuo a mite kungah, tuachi’n Jerusalem khuo a mite kungah, tuaban ah Juda gam pumpi a mite kungah, tualeh Jentelte kung ah zong, akisia ua Pasian lam a akihei ua, kisiana toh kituoh nna asepna dingun ka genzah ta hi.","ref":"Nasep. 9.20,28,29"},"21":{"text":"Tamte ziehin Judaten biehinnpi ah ahing man ua, tha ahing tum uhi."},"22":{"text":"Pasian a kipat panpina ka mu ziehin, tuni tan in mi neute leh mi liente kungah theipina thu gen in ka ding na lai hi. Guolneite leh Mosi in hing tung ding ahi chi a agente uh chiloungal thudang ka gen sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Khrist in genthei athuoh dinga, mishite lah a thoukia masapen ahi dinga, tualeh Judate leh Jentelte kunga vah amusah ding, chi thu ahi, achi hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 15.20; Isai. 42.6; 49.6"},"24":{"text":"Paul in tambanga adihna thu agen lai in, Festus in aw ngai tahin, “Paul amaw hita teh, na siemna in hing su maw gawp ahita,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh Paul in “Zatat huoi Festus aw, amaw ka hi sih hi, thudihtah leh pilna thu gen ka hi zaw hi."},"26":{"text":"Tam thute akunga leengpa’n zong athei hi, tuazieh in akung a zau lou a ka genna a hi, tam silte akungah bangma im ahisih chi ka thei hi, tam silte aningkawma kidap bawl ahi sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Lengpa Agrippa aw, guolneite thu na gingta ei?
