Na gingta chi ka thei hi,” achi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Agrippa in Paul kungah, “Hun tomnou sungin Khristian hing suoh sah tum na hi” achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Paul in, “Tom in sawt taleh, nang maimai hilou in, tuni a ka thu za zousie keima banga um dingin, Pasian kungah ka ngen hi, tam kolte vang bun louin,” achi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tam thute agen zoutah in, leengpa leh uhpipa leh Bernisi tualeh akunga toute zousie zong ading chiet uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tualeh atuom a apawtdoh nua un, akihou ua, “Tam mipa’n shina leh kolbuna khop hiel, sil bangma abawl sih hi,” achi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n Agrippa in Festus kungah, “Tam mipa’n Kaisar kunga a thu tut sawmlou hileh hakhiet thei mai ding hiven,” achi hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Itali gam a tembaw a ka pei dinguh thu phatsah ahi tahin, Paul leh suongkul taang koite ahiei khu Augustus pawl galkap zahoutupa amin Julius kichipa khut ah akemsah uhi.","title":"Paul Rome khopi zuon a apeina"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Asia gam tuipi gei tawn a peiding Adramitium tembaw ah ka tuong ua, ka kipankheta uhi. Aristarkus kichi, Thessalonika khuo a teng Masidonia gam mi khat ka tuonpi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Azingni in Sidon ka tung uhi. Tualeh Julius in Paul ahoi bawl a, Paul tahsapna ana pieh theina dingun alawmte kunga zalentaha ahaw ding aphal hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuana pat in tembawin ka pei kia ua, hui ahing le lan ziehin Saipras gam lie lam ah ka pei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Silisia gam leh Pamphilia lampang tuipi gei zuia ka peisuh nua un, Lisia gam a Mira khopi ka tung uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuanah galkap zahoutupain Itali gam zuon ding Alekzandria tembaw khat amu a, tuanah ahing tuongsah hi."},"7":{"text":"Awl-awl in ni tampi ka pei ua, hasatahin Nidas ka tung hamham ua, hui ahat ziehin tangtahin ka pei theita sih ua, Salmone zuon in Kret tuilaisie gam lie lam ah ka pei zawta uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hasatah a peisuohin Lasia khopi kunga um tembaw khawlna kilawm kichi mun ka tung uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n ni tampi abeita, tualeh tembaw a pei azauhuoi ziehin, anngawlni na ngawn abeita a, Paul in amaute thu ahilta hi.","title":"Tembaw siet ding Paul in athei"},"10":{"text":"“Pute aw, ikhuolzinna tembaw in sietna leh manna nasetah tuoh ding ahi chi ka thei hi, tembaw vante leh atembaw guoh hilouin, ihinna nasan uh azauhuoi ahi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahivang in, galkap lamkaipa’n Paul gen sangin tembaw hehpa leh aneipa thu agingta zaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh phalbi sunga umna dingin tembaw khawlna mun akitup lou ziehin, atamzawin, tuana kipata kitawldoh a Phoeniks tun teitei a, khuna phalbi sung um ding asawmta uhi. Phoeniks pen Kret tuilaisie gama tembaw khawlmun khat ahia, simtum lam leh maltum lam nga ahi."},"13":{"text":"Sim hui nem awl awl a ahing lan tahin, adei lam uh muta in akingaituo ua, tembaw henkipnate asut ua, Kret tuipi gei zuiin akitawl uhi.","title":"Tuipi tungah huipi hat"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh hun tomkhat zouin Kret tuilaisie gam a kipat in Euroklidon kichi huipi hattah ahing laang suh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua huipiin tembaw ahing phuta a, hui lah ah ka pei zou nawn sih ua, ka hakheta ua, tuachi’n ahing taw kawikawita hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Klauda achi uh tuilaisie gam khat zul zul ah ka tai ua, hasatahin kuong neu khu ka bitsah thei hamham uhi."},"17":{"text":"Akaidoh zou un, apanpina khaute azuun ua tembaw nuoi lam ah aviel ua, tualeh Sirtis senel lah ah hing lenlutpi khava chi zauin puonzahnate apuasah ua, tuachi’n ahing mawh taw kawikawita hi."},"18":{"text":"Huipi hat in hing mutleeng kawikawi ahiziehin, azingni in tembaw jangsah dingin tembaw vante tuipi ah apaidoh uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ani thum niin tembaw vante ka khut ngei un ka paidoh uhi."},"20":{"text":"Nitamtah ni leh aasite kilang louin, huipi hattah alaang zinga, hin ding mawngmawng ka ki nem nawn sih uhi."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh sawtpi ann ne lou a, a um nua un, Paul alah uah ahing dinga, “Pute aw, Kret tuilaisie apat kipandoh lou dingin ka thugen ngaikhie uh lachin, tambang sietna leh manna tuoh lou ma ding hive u’chin."},"22":{"text":"Tuin lungmuong taha um dingin ka hing ngen ahi, aziehpen na lah uah koiman ahinna amansuo sih ding uh, hinanleh tembaw pen ase ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama a ka hi a, ana zong ka sep Pasian vansawlsieng tuzanin ka kungah ahing dinga,"},"24":{"text":"Zau sin Paul, Kaisar mai ah na ding ngei ngei ding hi, tualeh ngaiin, tembaw a na tuonpite zousie zong Pasian in ahing pieh na hita, ahing chi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin pute aw, lungmuong tahin um un, Pasian ka gingta a, ahing hil bangbangin a um ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahivang in tuilaisie gam khat ah, ahing sepdoh ngei ngei ding hi, achi hi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Adria tuipi a huipi in asuh atunga ahing sem leng uh azan sawm leh li zanin zankim lai ding velin tembaw heh mite’n gam khat tungding hiin akitheita uhi;"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh tuithuh dan ate ua, lam sawmni hiin athei ua, gamla deu apei nua ua ate kia u’leh lam sawm leh nga, hiin athei uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n suongpi phuhkhah ding azau ziehun, tembaw mei lamah sia-ka li akhie ua khovah ngah in thu angenta uhi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh tembaw hehmiten tembaw mai lam a sia kate khie kipangin kuongneu khu tuipi ah akhaikhie ua, tembaw taisan atum uhi."},"31":{"text":"Paul in galkap lamkaipa leh galkapte kungah “Tam mite kuonga a umden sih u’leh, na bit sih ding uh,” achi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuachi’n galkapte’n kuongneu khaute asattan ua, akesuh sahta uhi."},"33":{"text":"Khovah kuonin Paul in a unpi un ann ne dingin asawl a, “Tuni ann ngawl a na ngah ua, bangma ne lou a na umna uh ni sawm leh ni li ahita."},"34":{"text":"Tuaziehin ann ne dingin ka hing ngen ahi; tam pen na hinna ding uh ahi, noute koiman asam zang khat zong amansuo sih ding,” achi hi."},"35":{"text":"Aman tam thute agen zouin tanghou ala a, amaute zousie masangah, Pasian kungah kipahthu agen a, tanghou abalkeh a, ane panta hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaute ahing kithakhausah ua, ann ane chietta uhi."},"37":{"text":"Tualeh tembaw sunga um zousie ka unpi un za ni leh sawmsagi leh guh ka hi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Tualeh ann aneh kham zou un tembaw jangsah dingin mangbute tui lah ah apaita uhi."},"39":{"text":"Zing khuo ahing vah tahin, agam chin athei ta sih ua, hinanleh tembaw khawlna pieutah nei tuipi pang khat amu ua, ahithei liei leh khuna tembaw tawllut atum uhi.","title":"Tembaw asie a mite asuohta uh"},"40":{"text":"Amauten sia kate akhesuh ua, tuipi ah anuasie ua, tualeh tembaw heina puonjahte asut ua, amailam a puonjahpen hui sem dingin azahtou ua, tuachi’n pieutah lam zuon in apei uhi."},"41":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuilienpi ni kisuhtuona ah ka lut kha ua, tembawin lei asusah ta ua, tembaw mailam lei ah akiphut detta a, suhling guollouin a umta hi, ameilam pen tuihuol ahat zieh in akehta hi."},"42":{"text":"Galkapten saltangte tuizap a galkai umkha va uh, achi zieh un, tha atumta uhi."},"43":{"text":"Hinanleh galkap lamkaipa in, Paul hundam a ut ziehin, asil tup uh akhaam a, tuizap siem pouma tuipi a tawmdoh a, pieutah a galkai masa dingin thu apie hi."},"44":{"text":"Tualeh adangte pawl khat kuong dang tungah pawl khatte tembaw sie singpeh ahiei a tuong a galkai dingin thu apie hi. Tuachi’n a unpi un bit tahin agalkai chiet ta uhi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuipi gei a bittah a ka suohtat nua un tua tuilaisie gam khu Malta ahi chi ka theita uhi.","title":"Malta galkaina leh Paul gul in atuhna"},"2":{"text":"Agam mite ka tung uah asiem mama ua, guozu a adap ziehin mei ataw ua, ka unpi un ahing na kipahpi mama uhi."},"3":{"text":"Paul in singkang lom khat atom a mei a avah leh meisa in ahul ziehin gul khat ahing pawtdoh a, akhut atu a, akikhai denta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n agam miten Paul khut a gul kikhaiden amutahun, “Tam mipa tuolthat hi ngeingei va, tuipi akipat suohta nanleh dihtah a thukhennain ahin ding phal nawnlou ahita,” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh Paul in tua gul khu meikhua ah athingkhie a, bangma achi sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahivang in amauten akhut hing pawm ahiei, ahisihleh thakhat a pua a shi pai dingin agingta uhi; hinanleh sawtpi angah nua ua bangma achilou tahin, alungsim uh aheng ua, pasien ahi achi zawta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua mun khu, tua tuilaisie a mi poimawtah amin Publius kichipa gam ahia, aman ahing na kipahpi a ngainatahin ni thum ahing zintungsah hi.","title":"Publius pa suhdamna lamdang"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Publius pa khosih leh santen in ana lum a; Paul akungah avalut a, atunga khut ngain, thu angen a asudam hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n tambanga abawl tahin, tua tuilaisie gam a mi dang natna nei zousie zong ahing pei ua, adam chietta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Amauten lam tampi ah koute ahing pahtawi ua, tualeh ka pei kuon un ka poimaw uh ahing guon uhi."},"11":{"text":"Ha thum nuain, Alekzandria tembaw phalbi sung tua tuilaisie a taam, achiemtena unau piengkop kichi ah ka tuong ua ka peita uhi.","title":"Paul Rome zuon a apeina"},"12":{"text":"Sirakus ah ka kinga ua, tuanah ni thum ka taam uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuana pat in ka pei kuol ua, Rhegium ka tung ua, tualeh ni khat zouin sim hui ahing langa, azing niin Puteoli ka tung uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua khuo ah sanggamte ka mu ua, akung ua ni sagi taam dingin ahing hou ua; tuachi’n Rome khopi lam zuon in ka pei zelta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Rome khopi a um sanggamte’n ka tanchin uh azah tahun Appii sumsinna mun leh zinbuh thum tandong hing peiin ahing dawn ua, Paul in amaute amu tahin Pasian kungah kipahthu agen a alungmuongta hi."},"16":{"text":"Rome khuo ka tun un galkap zahoutupain hentate khu vengmi galkap lamkaipa khutah apekhie a, hinanleh Paul pen vengmi galkap khat toh amatanga a um ding phalna apie hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh ni thum nuain Juda lamkaite ahankhawm a, amaute ahing kikhop tahun, Paul in akung uah, “Sanggamte aw, imite leh ipu ipate tawndan kal a bangma ka bawllou vangin, Jerusalem a kipat in henta a piehkhiet ka hita hi.","title":"Paul in Rome khuo a Judate akimupina"},"18":{"text":"A hing etdih nua un, ka tunga shina khop hiel bangma a umlou ziehin ahing hadoh ut uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Judaten aniel zieh un, Kaisar kungah ka thu tutlou thei ka hita sih hi; ka nampite hehna a bawl vang ka hi sih hi.","ref":"Nasep. 25.11"},"20":{"text":"Tuazieha tam thute a noute toh kimutuo a, kihoulim dinga ka hing hatkhawm mawng ahi; Israelte kinepna zieha tam khainieng a kaan ka hi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh amauten akungah, “Kouten Judia gama kipat, na tungthu ah laithot ka mu sih uh. Tua gam a kipat a tam mun a hing pei unaute koiman na tungthu aselam in bangma agen ngai sih uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh na ngaidan nangma akipat ka za nuom uhi. Aziehpen tam Pawlte gam chin a agensiet uh, ka na thei uhi,” achi uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuachi’n ani ding aguot ua, tua ni ahing tun tahin, ama umna ah mi tampi ahing pei ua, zingmawnga kipat nitah lam dongin akung uah Pasian leenggam thu hilchien in atheisah a, Mosi dan laibu leh guolneite laibute suutpi in Jesu lam ah amaute azawllut sawm hi."},"24":{"text":"Kimkhatten athugen agingta ua, pawlkhatten agingta sih uhi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute akithutuoh theilou bep un, Paul in thu khat agen zouin akikhenta uhi. Paul thugen khu tami ahi: “Hagau Siengthou in guolnei Isai kam a ipu ipate kunga ana gen khu thudih ahi:"},"26":{"text":"Tam mite kungah va pei inlen, va genin, zah pen na za ding ua, na theisiem sih ding uh; mu pen na mu ding ua, na theidoh sih ding uh;","ref":"Isai. 6.9,10"},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen tam mite lungtang angong gawpta a, abilte uh ahum ua, tualeh amitte uh asiing uhi; tuachilouin amit un amu kha ding ua, alungtang un atheisiem kha ding ua, tuachi’n ahing kihei ding ua, ken kana sudam kha ding hi,” achi khu."},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian hundamna thu Jentelte kunga sawl ahita a, amauten angaikhe ding uh, chi thei un, achi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tam thute Paul in agen zouin, Judate amaute lahah akiniel ua, akikhenta uhi."},"30":{"text":"Paul khu kum ni sung vingveng ama innluona ah atenga, ama mu nuom pouma ana kipahpi hi."},"31":{"text":"Pasian leenggam thu agen a, Mangpa Jesu Khrist tungthu hangsan tahin ahil zel a, koiman ama akham sih hi."}}}}},"45":{"info":{"name":"Rom","shortname":"Rom.","abbr":[],"desc":"Rom mite kunga sawltah paul laihah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Jesu Khrist suoh, sawltah hi ding a hat, Pasian khantan hoi dinga guottuom in,","title":"Nousietna"},"2":{"text":"Tua khantan hoi Pasian in masanglai a guolneite tungtawn a Laisiengthou a ana chiemsa,"},"3":{"text":"Tahsa dan a David suon a pieng, a Tapa Jesu Khrist, i Mangpa uh;"},"4":{"text":"Sienthouna hagau lam dan a, shina apat a thawkiana in, silbawltheina toh Pasian Tapa ahina aphuonkhietna tungtang;"},"5":{"text":"Ama min zieh a ginna thumanna nam chin lah a aum theina dingin, Ama ziehin hepina leh sawltah hina itangta uhi;"},"6":{"text":"Tuate lah ah noute zong Jesu Khrist a hatte na hi uhi;"},"7":{"text":"Pasian deitah, misiengthou hi dinga hat: Rom khuo a um zousiete kungah; i pa uh Pasian leh Jesu Khrist kunga kipat hepina leh hamuonna na kung uah umta hen."},"8":{"text":"Amasapen in, na ginna thu uh leitung pumpia akigenthang tah ziehin, noute zousie tunga ka kipahna, Jesu Khrist zal in ka Pasian kungah kipahthu ka gen hi.","title":"Paul Rom khuo a azin tupna"},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen ka thungetnate ah, tawplou in na min uh ka lou ngitnget hi chi, A Tapa khantanhoi a ka hagau a ana ka sep zing, Pasian khu ahing theipipa ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tu beeh a noute kunga hing haw theina ding, Pasian deilam ka mu thei teitei na dingin, ka ngen na lai hi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen noute hing detsah ding, hagau lam silpieh bang ahiei khat ka hing pieh theina dingin noute hing mu ka ut mama hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua pen na ginna u’leh ka ginna a khat leh khat kihanthawn tua lei ka china ahi."},"13":{"text":"Unaute aw, Jentel dangte lah a sepgimna ga ka mutah mabanga noute lah a zong ka mu theina dingin na kung uah tamveipi hing haw ka tumta hi, hinanleh tu dongin dalin ka um hi, chi na theilou uh ka dei sih hi.","ref":"Nasep. 19.21"},"14":{"text":"Greekte leh namngiemte lah leh mi pil leh mi pilloute kungah zong bat ka nei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n nou Rom khuo a umte kungah zong khantanhoi theitawp a gen dingin kimansa ka hi."},"16":{"text":"Ken Khrist khantanhoi ka zumpi sih hi, aziehpen agingta pouma dinga tam pen hundamna dinga Pasian silbawltheina ahi, Judate a dingin ahi masa a, tualeh Greekte dingin zong ahi.","ref":"Mak. 8.38"},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen tua khantanhoi sungah, Pasian in adihtatna alangsahta hi. “Mi dihtat khu ginna in ahing ding chi gel bangin.”","ref":"Haba. 2.4"},"18":{"text":"Dihtatlouna a thutah nuoinet mite, Pasian ngaisahlouna leh dihtatlouna zousie tungah Pasian lungthahna van akipat in ahing kilangta hi.","title":"Jentelte gitloudan phuonna"},"19":{"text":"Pasian in atheisah tah ziehin, Pasian in tanchin thei ding khu amauah chientah a theisahin a umta hi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen leitung siemchil a kipat a A silmutheiloute, Akumtawn silbawltheina leh a Pasian zie natan dong chieng silsiem ah akilanga, chientah a mu in a um hi. Tuaziehin mihingten suonlam ding anei sih uhi."},"21":{"text":"Amaun Pasian theinapi in, Pasian bangin apahtawi sih ua, kipahthu zong agen sih uhi, hinanleh alungsim uah sil thulimloute angaituo zawta ua, alungtang motnate uh amiel sahta hi.","ref":"Eph. 4.17,18"},"22":{"text":"Pil kisa nan u’leh ahing mawta uhi."},"23":{"text":"A shi theilou Pasian thupina khu ashi thei mihingte, vate, kenglinei sate leh abohvah ganhingte, kibahpi a bawl milimte in ahengta uhi.","ref":"Danp. 4.16-18"},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian in amaute khu lungtang gitlouna bangbanga numei pasal kaala thanghuoitah a buol ding leh apumpi uh pahtattah a kizangtuo dingin ahazanta hi.","title":"Jentelte khelna"},"25":{"text":"Tuabang miten Pasian thutah zuou toh hengtuoin asiempa sangin asilsiemte abie ua, ana zong asem zawta uhi, asiempa khu kumtawn a phattah ahi, Amen."},"26":{"text":"Tamte ziehin Pasian in zumhuoi taha ahua uh phal in ahazanta hi. Anumeite uh nasan zong apienpi umdan ngaina uh, banglouin akizang zawta uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuamabangin pasalte zong numei zahdan ngaina tawpsanin, huain aki enla ua, pasal leh pasal zumhuoi tahin akizangtuo ua, atatsietna man amu ding ukhu ama uah akimu uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh alungsim ua Pasian athei utlou ziehun Pasian in sil kilawmloute bawl dingin adeilou lam lungsim nei phal in ahazanta hi."},"29":{"text":"Dihtatlouna zousie, hua a lanna zousie, gitlouna zousie, du amna zousie, kimudana zousie a dim in, thangsietnate, tuolthanate, kihaunate, kisolnate, mi sietna ding ngaituonate in adim ua,"},"30":{"text":"Thudap genhatte, Pasian mudate, misimmaw hatte, kiliensahte, kithuneisahte, silgilou pandoh mite, nu leh pa thumangloute;"},"31":{"text":"Theisiemna neiloute, muonhuoina beite, itna beite, ngaidamna neilou leh hepina neiloute ahi uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tambang sil bawlte shitah mawng ahi uh chi leh Pasian thukhenna dih ahi chi theinapi in amauh bawl guoh zong hilouin midang tambang bawlte zong akipahpi uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aw mihing, mi selhat koi hinan lachin zong suonlam ding mawngmawng neilou na hi, aziehpen midangte na mawsahna mama ah nangma siemlou kitangsah na hi; nang mi mawsahpain, amauh na mawsahna silte mama na bawl ziehin.","title":"Judate khelna","ref":"Mat. 7.1; Luk. 6.37"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh tambang bawl mite tungah Pasian thukhenna khu thutah dungzui in atung hi chi ithei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Aw nang mihing tambang bawl mite mawsah napia tuabang silte na bawl zel leh, Pasian thukhenna pel thei dingin na kingaisut amah?"},"4":{"text":"Ahisihleh Pasian hoina dawzouna leh thuoh hatna, hoina hausatna simmaw na hiei mah? Pasian hoinain kisiana ah nang ahingpui chi theilou na hiei mah?"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh na lungtang khau dungzui a na kisia nuomlou ziehin, Pasian thangpaina ni leh thukhenna dihtat ahing kilat ni chienga ding in thangpaina na kikholkhawm ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ama’n michin asilbawl dungzui un, athuhkia ding hi.","ref":"Late. 62.12; Thu. 24.12"},"7":{"text":"Thuohhatna zieh a silhoi bawl teitei a, thupina, pahtawina leh shi theilouna sui mite kungah kumtawn hinna ape dinga;"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh amauh angsung khuola, thutah zuilou a, dihtatlouna zuite tungah, lungthahna leh thangpainate a um ding;"},"9":{"text":"Thuohgimna leh lunggimna nasatah, silgilou bawlte hagau tungah aum dinga, Judate hagau tungah aum masa ding a, Greekte hagau tungah zong a um ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh silhoi bawl poumate kungah, thupina, pahtawina leh lungmuonna pieh ahi dinga Judate kunga pieh masah ahi dinga, tualeh Greekte kungah zong pieh ahi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in deisah tuom anei sih hi.","ref":"Danp. 10.17"},"12":{"text":"Dan neilou a khelna bawl zousie, dan lou in amangthang ding ua, Dan nuoi a khielte zousie lah dan banga thukhenpieh in aum ding uhi;"},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen dan za mite pen Pasian mitmuin midih ahi sih ua, hinanleh dan banga bawlte pen midih ahi ding uhi;"},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen dan neilou Jentelten amaute ngaina dan abawl chiengun, dan nei sih nan u’leh tuate ama-ua dingin dan khat asuoh hi;"},"15":{"text":"Alungtang uah dan silbawlte akigiel hi chi alangsah uhi, tua khu asie leh pha theina un atheipi a, alungsimte uh kiniel in, siem leh siemlou akitangsah kawi kawi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ka khantanhoi gen dungzui a Pasian in Jesu Khrist zanga mihingte thuguh, vai ahawmpieh ni chiengin."},"17":{"text":"Ngai vawi, nang Judami kichi na hi a, dan na suong a, Pasian na kisahtheipi a,","title":"Judate mawsahna"},"18":{"text":"Pasian deilam nathei a, dan a hilin na um a sil hoi zawte na khenthei a,"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh nangma ngel khu mittote puipa leh miel a umte dinga vah hiin na kithei a,"},"20":{"text":"Dan a pil leh thutah umdan theina na nei zieh in, mi mote hilpa leh naungehte hilpa in na kigingta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin nang midangte hilpa, nangma kihillou na hiei mah? Guhtat lou ding ahi chia thugenpa’n, na gu zel maw?"},"22":{"text":"Nang, angkawmlou ding ahi chia genpa’n, ang na kawm zel maw? nang, milim kidahpa’n, milim biehna inn a milimte na gu zel maw?"},"23":{"text":"Nang, dan suongpa’n, na dan bawsiet ziehin Pasian na suminse zel maw?"},"24":{"text":"Noute ziehin “Jentelte lah ah Pasian min gensiet in a umta hi,” chi a gel bangin.","ref":"Isai. 52.5"},"25":{"text":"Dan na zuileh, teptan in phattuomna anei hi, hinanleh dan botse mi na hileh na teptan pen tanlou toh kibang ahita hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin teptan lou miin dan thusete azui leh ateptanlou khu atan banga ngai hilou ding ahiei amah?"},"27":{"text":"Ngaina dan a teptanlou mi in dan azuikim leh, nang, dan laibu leh teptan dan agel a nei napi a, dan botse mi khu ahing mawpai sih ding amah?"},"28":{"text":"Apudanga Judami hi pen, Judami tahtah ahi sih a, akilanga tahsa maimai a teptan zong teptan chietvawt ahi sih hi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh asunggil a Judami hi khu, Judami chietvawt ahi, tualeh teptan chietvawt khu lunggil lam a tan ahi; dan laibu a gel mai hilouin, hagau ah ahizaw hi, Ama pahtat law khu mihing apat ahi sih a, Pasian apat ahizaw hi.","ref":"Danp. 30.6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuabang ahileh, Judami in bang hamphatna ahiei anei tuom uh? ahisihleh teptan zong bang ahiei aphattuomna?","title":"Judaten dawnna agingta sih uh"},"2":{"text":"Lam chintengah aphatuom hi; amasapen in Pasian kamsuohte amaute kunga kepsah a um hizieh in."},"3":{"text":"Amaute lah a pawlkhat in gingta sihta u’leh bang achi diei? Agintat louna un Pasian ginumna bangmalou asuohsah diei?"},"4":{"text":"Suohsah lou e, Pasian khu midihtat hi henlen, michin zuou thei hizaw heh, “Na thugen a siemtanga na um theina dingin, thukhenpieh a na um chieng a zong, na zaw theina dingin,” chi a gel bangin.","ref":"Late. 51.4"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh i dihtatna in Pasian dihtatna asuhlat hoi sem leh bang igenta diei? Pasian in itung ua athangpaina ahing tun sah chiengin, dihtatlou ahi diei? Mihing bangin ka gen ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hivawtlou e, aziehpen tuabang hitaleh Pasian in leitung pumpi vai bangchin ahawmta diei?"},"7":{"text":"Ahivang in ka zuou gen zieh a, Pasian dihna, Ama thupina ding khop a alatsah sem leh, bang dinga kei mikhiel banga siemmaw tansah a um nalai ding ka hiei?"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh mi pawlkhat in ahing gensie ua, igenloupi ahing gensah bang ua, silhoi ahing pawt theina dingin sil hoilou i bawl ding uh bangding a chi zaw mailou ihi uoi? tuabang miten siemlou atan uh adih ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahileh bang? Amauh sangin eite i hoizaw tuon uh amah? Hoizaw mawngmawng lou! Judate leh Jentelte ani un khelna thunuoi ah a um siengta uh chiin kichientahin ingoh masa ta uhi.","title":"Pasian mitmu in mi zousie akhiel ahi"},"10":{"text":"“Midihtat koima a um sih, khat zong a um sih.","ref":"Late. 14.1-3; 53.1-3"},"11":{"text":"A theisiem koima a um sih, Pasian sui koima a um sih."},"12":{"text":"A unpi un alampielmang siengta ua, a unpi un phattuomna neilou asuoh siengta uh; Koima silhoi bawl a um sih ua, khat zong a um sih.”"},"13":{"text":"“Alawl uh han kihong ahia, a lei un solna thu agen ua,” amuh uah gulgu a um hi.","ref":"Late. 5.9; Late. 140.3"},"14":{"text":"“Akam uh hamselawna leh, khatna in adim a,”","ref":"Late. 10.7"},"15":{"text":"“Akengte uh sisan suo dingin, anawsuon uhi.","ref":"Isai. 59.7,8"},"16":{"text":"Manthaina leh lungzinna, alampi uah a um hi."},"17":{"text":"Lungmuonna lampi, athei sih uhi.”"},"18":{"text":"“Amit uah Pasian ginna mawngmawng, a um sih hi,” chiin ana kigiel hi.","ref":"Late. 36.1"},"19":{"text":"Dan in sil bangpou agen pouma, kam chinteng hum a a um theina ding leh, leitung pumpi Pasian mai a mawtanga aum theina ding un, dan nuoi a umte kunga agen ahi chi ithei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin dan silbawlte ziehin, koima Pasian mitmu a siemtangin a um sih ding uh, aziehpen dan ziehin khiel kiphawhna ahing um zaw hi.","ref":"Late. 143.2; Gal. 2.16"},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin vang dan leh guolneiten atheipina bangun, dan loua Pasian dihtatna sulat in aumta hi.","title":"Khrist gintatna zieh a dihtatna"},"22":{"text":"Tampen Jesu Khrist gintatna zieha, agingta poumate dinga sulat a um, Pasian dihtatna khu ahi. Alamdanna tuom bangma a um sih hi.","ref":"Gal. 2.16"},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen mi zousie in sil abawlkhielta ua, Pasian thupina atang zouta sih ua;"},"24":{"text":"Khrist Jesu a um tatna zala ahepina in manbei a siemtansah in a um uhi."},"25":{"text":"Pasian thuohtheina zieh a nidanglai a akhelnate uh kitheimawbawla a um ziehin dihtatna etsahna dingin Khrist Jesu khu asisan a ginna zieh a khelna thupha tawina hi dingin Pasian in aguot a;"},"26":{"text":"Ama khu midihtat ahitheina ding leh, Jesu gingta poumate siemtangsahpa ahitheina dinga tulai hun a dihtatna etsahna ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ahileh kisahtheina ding heiah a um ei? A um thei mawngmawng sih hi. Bang danin ahiei? danzuina silbawl in ahiei? Hilou, ginna dan in ahizaw hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin dan silbawlte zieh hilouin, ginna ziehin mi siemtangin ingai uhi."},"29":{"text":"Pasian khu Judate Pasian guoh ahiei mah? Jentelte Pasian zong hilou ahiei mah? Hi e, Jentelte Pasian zong ahi."},"30":{"text":"Teptante agintatna zieh ua siem tangsah ding leh, teptan loute zong agintatna zieh ma ua, siemtangsah ding Pasian khat maimai a um hi.","ref":"Danp. 6.4; Gal. 3.20"},"31":{"text":"Ahileh ginna ziehin dan khu bangmalou isuosah uh ahiei mah? Suohsah vawtlou, dan khu isukip zaw uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuabang ahileh tahsa dan a ipu uh Abraham in amu tungtang, bang igenta diei le?","title":"Abraham siemtansahna etsahna"},"2":{"text":"Nasep zieh a Abraham siemtansah a na um hileh suon ding bang ahiei khat anei hi, hinanleh Pasian mai ah anei sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Laisiengthou in bang ahiei agen? “Abraham in Pasian agingta a, tua ginna khu ama a dinga dihtatna a ngai ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 15.6; Gal. 3.6"},"4":{"text":"Nasem mi thaman pen hepina a pieh ahi sih a, bat a ngai ahizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh nasemlou a, Pasian ngaisah loute siemtangsahpa gingta zaw mi ginna khu dihtatna a ngai ahi."},"6":{"text":"Mi, Nasep tellou a, Pasian in dihtat a angai mi hamphatna khu, David in zong:"},"7":{"text":"“Dan bei a atatkhelnate uh ngaidam a um mite leh, akhelna uh khumanga umte ahampha uh.","ref":"Late. 32.1,2"},"8":{"text":"Mangpa’n khelna nei a asimloute ahampha hi, chiin ana gen bangin.”"},"9":{"text":"Ahileh tua hamphatna teptante tung maimai a um ahiei? ahisihleh teptan loute ding zong ahiei? Abraham ginna khu dihtatna a simtel ahi, ichi ngal uhi."},"10":{"text":"Ahileh tuakhu bangchi kisimtel ahiei? ateptan nuain ahiei? ahisihleh ateptan masangin ahiei? ateptan nuain ahisih a, ateptan masangin ahizaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Aman teptan loua aum lai a, aginna zieh a amu dihtatna pen chiemtenain teptan ahizaw hi; teptanlou hinan u’leh, agingta zousie pa ahitheina dingin, dihtatna khu amaute dinga zong simtel ahitheina dingin;","ref":"Siem. 17.10"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh teptan loute a dinga, teptante pa guoh ahisih a, ipu uh Abraham teptan lou a a um lai a, aginna nei banga neite pa zong ahi."},"13":{"text":"Abraham leh ahah asuonte kunga leitung gouluo dinga thuchiem pen dan zieha chiem ahisih a, ginna a ditatna zieh ahi zaw hi.","title":"Ginna zieh a Pasian thuchiem tangtun sah ahi.","ref":"Siem. 17.4-6; 22.17,18; Gal. 3.29"},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen dan zui mite gouluotu ding na hita u’leh, ginna pen bangmalou ahita dinga, thuchiem zong panna bei ahita ding hi.","ref":"Gal. 3.18"},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen dan in Pasian thangpaina apieng sah a, dan umlouna ah dan bawsietna zong a um sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin hepina zieh ahitheina dingin ginna ziehin ahi; hahlesuonte zousiein zong thuchiem khu pellou a amu na dingun; dan nei mite guoh hilouin i unpi ua ipu uh Abraham banga ginna nei zousie in zong amu ding uhi.","ref":"Gal. 3.7"},"17":{"text":"“Nam tampite pain ka hing bawlta hi, chia Laisiengthou a kigiel bangin;” agintatpa Pasian mitmu in ama eite pa ahita. Tua Pasian khu ahi, mishite hinna pie a, sil umloute nasan a umsa banga genpa.","ref":"Siem. 17.5"},"18":{"text":"Kinep huoi um vawtlou napi in, aman kinem tahin agingta a, nam tampite pa ahing hitheina dingin; “Tuabangin nahah nasuonte ahing hi ding chia kigen dungzuiin.”","ref":"Siem. 15.5"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh ginna a hatlou tuom louin, atahsa shisa banga um leh (ama khu kum za phiel ahita a), Sarah nauneiloua chiing zong angaituo vateh sih hi.","ref":"Siem. 17.17"},"20":{"text":"Ginlelna ziehin Pasian thuchiem tahsang louin a um sih a, ginna ah ahat a, Pasian apahtawi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in athuchiemsa khu atangtung sah thei hi chi theiin agingta hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin aginna khu “Adihtatna a simtel ahita hi.”"},"23":{"text":"Ginna pen dihtatna a simtel ahi chi, “Ama zieh guoh a kigiel ahi sih a;” hinanleh eite a dinga kigiel zong ahi."},"24":{"text":"I Mangpa Jesu mishi lah a kipat a kaithoupa Pasian igintatnain, eite zong iginna dihtatna in ahing simtelpieh mama ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua Jesu khu itatkhelnate ziehin piehkhietin a um a, tualeh siem itanna dingin kaithawin a um hi.","ref":"Isai. 53.4,5"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin ginna zieha siemtansah a um in i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist vangin Pasian toh kilem in i um uhi.","title":"Siemtansahna gate"},"2":{"text":"Ama ginna zieh main eiten hepina huongsung lut theina ineita uhi, tuin eite tua hepina ah iding uhi, tualeh Pasian thupina a kinem in nuomin zong i um uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuami guoh hilouin, gimthuohnain kukalna apiengsah hi chi theiin, gimthuohna ah zong ikipah uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh kukalnain theichienna asiem a, theichienna in kinepna asiem hi,"},"5":{"text":"Kinepna in ahing lungkesah sih a, aziehpen tua Hagau Siengthou ikung ua ahing piehin Pasian itna ilungtang uah asungbuo hi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen ihatlou lai in, ahuntahin Khrist khu Pasian ngaisah loute dingin ahing shita hi."},"7":{"text":"Midihtat tanga shingam mi akikhat dinga hinanleh mi hoi tanga shingam mi aum khamaw sih ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh mikhiel ihi lai nangawn in zong, Khrist itaanga ahing shina ah Pasian in ahing itna khu phat taah in alangsahta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaban ah asisana siemtansah a i um nuain Ama ziehin Pasian thangpaina apat in hundam in i um ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen melma ihi lai a bawn A Tapa shina zieh a Pasian toh kilem ihitah u’leh, kilem a iumzaw nua un, ahinna ziehin hundam in i um zaw sem ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuami guoh hilouin, tua kilemna hing musahpa i Mangpa Jesu Khrist ziehin Pasian ah nuomin i um uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin mi khat ziehin leitungah khelna ahing lut a, tualeh khelna zieh in shina ahing lut a, tualeh mi zousie ana kheltah ziehin, shina in mi zousie ajelsuohta hi.","title":"Adam zieh a shina, Khrist zieh a hinna","ref":"Siem. 3.6"},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen dan um masang tanin khelna leitung ah a umta hi, hinanleh khelna umlou laiin khelna khu khelna a ngai ahisih hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahivang in Adam akipata Mosi tandongin, Adam khelna banga silbawlkhiel loute tung nangawn ah zong shinain vai ahawm hi. Adam khu ahing pei dingpa etsahna ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh silthawnpieh khu gitlouna toh kibang ahisih hi, aziehpen mi khat gitlouna zieha bawn mi tampi ashileh, Pasian hepina leh mi khat Jesu Khrist hepina zieh a silthawnpieh khu mi tampi tungah vuain a um ngei ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh silthawnpieh khu, mi khat khelna zieh a sil hing um toh akibang sih hi; aziehpen siemlou tansahna thukhenna khu mi khat ziehin ahing um a, hinanleh silthawnpieh khu khelna tampite ziehin siemtansahna dingin ahing um zaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi khat tatkhelna zieh a shina in, tua mi khat ziehma a vai ahawm leh, Pasian hepina kiningching leh dihtatna silthawnpieh muten mi khat Jesu Khrist ziehin hinna ah vai ahawm ngei ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin mi khat tatkhelna zieh a siemlou tansahna thukhenna khu mi zousie tungah ahing um a; tuabangmain mi khat dihtatna silbawl ziehin hinna muna dingin siemtansahna silthawnpieh khu mi zousie tungah ahing um hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen mi khat thumanlou zieh a mi tampite mikhiel akihisah mabangin, mi khat thumanna ziehin mi tampite midihtat hisah ahi ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tuathamlou in gitlouna atam semna dingin dan ahing umbelap na lai a, hinanleh khelna apunna phot ah, hepina zong apung zawsem hi."},"21":{"text":"Khelnain shina a vai ahawm mabangin hepina in dihtatna zieh a vai ahawm theina dingin, hepina in i Mangpa Jesu Khrist ziehin kumtawn hinna ahing tun hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahileh bang igenta diei? Hepina apun semna dingin, khelna ah ium ngitnget ding uh adiei?","title":"Khelna a shina leh Khrist a hinna"},"2":{"text":"Um ngitnget lou e! Eite khelna a shisate, bangchin khelna ah ihing thei nalai diei?"},"3":{"text":"Eite Khrist Jesu a baptis a um poumate khu A shina ah baptis in i um uh chi theilou na hi uoi mah."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pa thupina in mishi lah a kipat in Khrist a kaithaw banga eite zong hinna tha a i hin theina dingun ashina ah baptis in ama toh vuiin i um uhi.","ref":"Kolo. 2.12"},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen a shina kibatpi a ama toh ina kizoptah u’leh, athawkiana kibatpi in zong ikizop ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Khelna tahsa mangthai sah a ium theina dingin leh khelna suoh a i um nawnlouna dingun i mihing lui uh Ama toh kilbeh in a um hi, chi ithei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen koizong a shisa mi pen khelna apat zalensah ahita hi."},"8":{"text":"Eite Khrist toh shikhawm i hitaah u’leh, Ama toh hin zong i hinkhawm ding uh ahi chi i gingta uhi."},"9":{"text":"Khrist khu mishi lah a kipat kaithawin a um a, ashi nawn sih ding chi ithei a, shina in atung ah thu anei nawnta sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Ashina khu khelna lam thu ah kumtawn a dinga khatvei shi ahia, hinanleh ahinna pen, Pasian lam ah ahing ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tuabangmain noute zong khelna lam thu ah ashisa in kingai unlen, hinanleh Pasian lam ah pen i Mangpa Jesu Khrist zal in ahingin kingai un."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin na tahsa uh deigawnate na zui na ding un, na tahsa uh shithei ah khelna in vaihawm sih heh."},"13":{"text":"Na tahsa hiengte uh zong dihtatlouna vanzah ding in khelna kungah pe sih un; hinanleh mishi lah a kipat a hing kia bangin, Pasian kungah kipie unlen, na tahsa hiengte u’zong dihtatna vanzah dingin Pasian kungah pe zaw un."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen khelnain na tung uah, thu anei nawn sih ding hi, aziehpen dan nuoi a um na hisih ua, hepina nuoi a um na hizaw uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ahileh bang chita ding? Dan nuoi a um hilou a, hepina nuoi a um i hiziehin, i khiel ding uh ahi diei?","title":"Khelna suoh apat Pasian suoh"},"16":{"text":"Khiel laizang lou e. Shina dinga khelna suoh hiin, dihtatna dinga thumanna suoh hitahleh, koipou kungah zong thumang dinga suoh a na kipiehlut chiengun, athu na manpa uh suoh na hi uh chi, na kithei sih uh amah?"},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian kungah kipahthu um hen, khelna suoh na hinan ulachin zong, noute hing kipie kihilna thu dan khu lunglut tahin na zuita uhi."},"18":{"text":"Khelna akipat zalensah in na hing um ua, dihtatna suohte na hing hita uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na tahsa uh hatlou ziehin, mihing dan in ka gen ahi; na tahsa hiengte uh sienthoulouna leh gitlouna kunga suoh dinga nana pieh bangun, tuin na tahsa hiengte uh sienthouna dingin dihtatna kungah suoh dingin pie un."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen khelna suohte na hilai un, dihtatna lam apat nana zalen uhi."},"21":{"text":"Ahileh tua na silzumpite uah, tua hun lai in ga bang ahiei na nei uh? Tua silte tawpna khu shina ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin khelna akipat zalensah in na umta ua, tualeh Pasian suohte na hing hi nua un, sienthouna khopin ga na nei ua, atawpna khu kumtawn hinna ahi."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen khelna thaman shina ahi, hinanleh Pasian silthawnpieh khu i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist ziehin kumtawn hinna ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Unaute aw, dan in mi adam sung teng atungah thu aneikhum ahi chi na thei sih uh amah? (Dan thei mite kunga ka gen ahi.)","title":"Dan a shina khu Pasian lam a hinna"},"2":{"text":"Tambangin, numei pasal neisa khu apasal damsungsie dana apasal a kaanin a um ahi; hinanleh apasal ashi leh pasal lam thu ah dan akipat zalensahin a um hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n apasal dam na lai pi a, mi dang akitenpi leh angkawmnu akichi ding hi; hinanleh apasal ashi leh tua dan akipat in a zalenta a, mi dang toh kiteng nanleh angkawmnu ahi sih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin sanggamte aw, Pasian lam a ga inei theina dingun, mi dang khat mishi lah a kipata kaithaw a umpa na kitenpi theina ding un, Khrist tahsa ziehin noute zong dan lamah ashi na hing hita uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tahsa a i um lai un, dan zieha khelna utna hing piengdohsahten, itahsa hiengte ah shina khop ga suong dingin na asem leeng hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin vang eite hing na tuden dan khu i shisantah ziehin, tua dan akipat hadohin i umta hi, laigel lui bang bep hilouin, Hagau a thana toh nna i sep theina dingin."},"7":{"text":"Ahileh bang igenta diei le? Dan khu khelna ahi diei? Hi vawtlou! Hinanleh dan zieh a thei hisihleh khelna kichi theilou ding hi-inga; dan in eng sin, na chi sihleh “Ken enna khu khelna ahi” chi ka thei sih ding hi.","title":"Dan in hing hundam theilou","ref":"Pawt. 20.17; Danp. 5.21"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh khelnain thupieh zieh a hun lemtang muin, ka sungah enna chinteng a umsah hi; dan umlouin khelna khu ashi ahi."},"9":{"text":"Khatvei lai in Kei danlouin kana hinga, hinanleh thupieh ahing umtah in keima a um khelna ahing haldoh kia a, Kei ka shita hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n hinna dinga thupieh khu, shina ding ahing hizawta chi ka theidohta hi."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen khelnain thupieh zieha hun lemtang muin ahing sola, thupieh zangin ahing sulumta hi.","ref":"Siem. 3.13"},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin dan asiengthou a, thupieh zong asiengthou a, adih in ahoi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahileh sil hoi khu kei a dinga shina hing hita adiei leh? Hilou e! Hinanleh khelna khu khelna a akilat theina dingin, khelnain silhoi zangin keima ah shina ahing semdoh hi; Khelna khu thupieh zieh a khelna nasatah ahing hitheina ding in."},"14":{"text":"Dan pen hagau lam sil ahi chi i thei hi, hinanleh kei pen tahsa mi, khelna suoh a khohsa ka hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka silbawl pen ka theisiem ngai sih hi aziehpen sil ka bawl utpen ka bawl sih a, hinanleh ka huotpen ka bawlzaw zel hi.","ref":"Gal. 5.17"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahileh, ka silbawl pen ka huotpen ahileh, dan ahoi chia zui ka ahita hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua silbawlpa khu kei ka hi nawn sih a, ka sunga um khelnain abawl ahizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen Keima ah (ka tahsa ah) silhoi malmal ateng sih chi ka thei hi; silhoi bawl ut ka nei a, hinanleh silhoi bawl theina ka nei sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen silhoi ka bawl utpen ka bawl sih a, hinanleh silhoilou ka bawl utlou pen ka bawlzaw zel hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka utloupen ka bawl chiengin abawlpa keima ka hisih a, khelna keima a um bawl ahizaw hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n tami dan ka hing theidohta; silhoi ka bawl ut chiengin, gitlouna keima ah ahing um zel hi."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen ka sunglam mi hinna giltahin, Pasian dan tungah ka kipah hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh ka tahsa hiengte ah, ka lungsim dou a nasem, dan dang khat a um hi chi ka thei hi; Tua ka tahsa hiengte a um khelna dan kungah suohin ahing pui zel hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi genthei hina lawmlawm ing e, Tam shina tahsa laha kipat koi ahiei hing lakhe ding?"},"25":{"text":"I Mangpa Jesu Khrist ziehin Pasian kungah kipahthu ka gen hi. Tuachi’n Keima’n ka lungsim tahtahin Pasian dan ka sem a, hinanleh ka tahsa in khelna dan ka sem hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin vang, Khrist Jesu a um a, khelna dan zuilou a, Hagau dan a, umte ding in siemmaw tansahna mawngmawng aum nawn sih hi.","title":"Hagau a umna hinkhuo"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen Khrist Jesu a um, hinna Hagau danin khelna leh shina dan akipat ahing zalensahta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tahsa zieh a dana hatlouna zieh a, dan in abawl guollou khu, Pasian in a Tapa ngei khelna tahsa melpuo in, khelna thoidamna dinga hing sawlin, tahsa a khelna um khu siemmaw atangsahta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tahsa dan a peilou a, Hagau dan a pei zaw eite tunga dihtatnain aphut dan khu suhtangtunga a um theina dingin."},"5":{"text":"Tahsa dan a hingten, tahsa lam silte a lunggul ua, hinanleh Hagau dan a hingten hagau lam silte alunggul uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tahsa lam silte lunggul khu shina ahi a, Hagau lam silte lunggul khu hinna leh hamuonna ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tahsa lam lunggulna khu Pasian toh kimelmatna ahiziehin, tuakhu Pasian dan nuoi ah a um sih a, um zong a um thei sih hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuabanga tahsa a umten Pasian akipahsah thei sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian Hagau nouma a um tahtah ahi nahleh tahsa ah na um sih ua, Pasian Hagau nouma sungah ateng zaw hi. Tuin mi koizong Khrist Hagau neilou khu Ama a ahi sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Khrist nouma a aum leh tahsa pumpi khelna ziehin ashi ahi. Hinanleh Hagau khu dihtatna ziehin ahing ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh mishi lah a kipat Jesu kaithoupa Hagau khu nouma a aum leh mishi lah a kipat a Khrist kaithoupah nouma a um Hagau ziehin na tahsapum uh shi theite zong ahingsah ding hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 3.16"},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin unaute aw bat inei hi, tahsa dan a hing dingin, tahsa lah ah vang ahi sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen tahsa dan a naum u’leh, na shi ding uhi; hinanleh tahsa silbawlte Hagau a na suhlup zel u’leh, na hing ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian Hagauin apui poumate, Pasian tate ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Zau a um kia dingin suoh hina Hagau na mu uh ahisih a, ta hina Hagau na mu uh ahizaw hi; tua Hagau ziehin “Abba Pa” chiin i kikou zaw uhi.","ref":"Gal. 4.5-7; Mak. 14.36; Gal. 4.6"},"16":{"text":"Hagau ngei in, eima hagau toh, Pasian tate ihi chi ahing theipi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuabanga tate ihi u’leh gouluote, Khrist toh Pasian gou luokhawmte ihi uhi. Ama toh ithuoh khawm pouleh, Ama toh pahtawi a umkhawm thei ding i hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu hun lai a ithuohgimnate pen dachienga eite a thupina sulat a um ding toh tekah tham in ka sep sih hi.","title":"Thupina inga dinguh"},"19":{"text":"Silsiem zousiein kinem tahin Pasian tate kilatna ding angahla mama uhi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen silsiem zousiete sil thulimlou thuthu a umsahin a umta hi, amaute ut thu hilouin, kinepna nei a amauh umsahpa ziehin ahi zaw hi.","ref":"Siem. 3.17-19"},"21":{"text":"Silsiem zousie zong shi theina saltaanna akipat suotatsah ahi ding ua, Pasian tate noplenna thupi a lut ding ahi uhi."},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen silsiem zousie tutan dongin thum leh nauvei natna thuohin a um uh chi ithei uhi."},"23":{"text":"Silsiemte guoh hilouin, Hagau ga masa nei eite ngei zong ta hina, itahsapum uh tatna ding ngahla in ilungsim sung uah thumin i um uhi.","ref":"2 Kor. 5.2-4"},"24":{"text":"Tam kinepna ziehin hundam in i um uhi, ahivangin muthei kinepna pen kinepna ahisih hi; mi’n amusa bangdinga kinem na lai lai ding ahiei?"},"25":{"text":"I mu nailou i kinep leh pen kukal tah in ingah teitei hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuabangmain ihatlounate uah Hagau in ahing panpi zel hi; aziehpen eiten bangchi banga thungen ding ihiei chi nasan ithei sih uhi, hinanleh Hagau in kamtenga genthei guollou a thumin ahing nget pieh hi."},"27":{"text":"I lungtangte vel a theichienpa’n Hagau lungsim athei a, tua Hagau in Pasian dei danin misiengthoute a dingin anget pieh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh sil bangkimah Pasian in Ama itte, Aman adei bang bawl dinga ahatte a dingin ahoina dingun silzousie asemkhawm chiet hi chi, ithei uhi."},"29":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in atheilawhte Ama Tapa bangtah a um dingin aguotlawh a, Atapa khu unau tampite lah a, ta masapen ahing hitheina ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh aguotlawhte ahan nalai a, ahatte khu siematangsah nalai a, tualeh siem atansahte khu apahtawi na lai hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahileh tam thute ah bang igenta diei leh? Pasian ei lam a apan leh koi ahiei hingdou thei ding?","title":"Pasian itna Jesu Khrist ah akilang hi"},"32":{"text":"Ama tapa ngel zong khetlou a, i unpi ua dinga hing pepa’n bang dingin sil zousie amanbei a Ama toh hing pekhawm lou ding ahiei?"},"33":{"text":"Pasian mi telte koiin ahiei heh ding? Siemtangsahpa lah Pasian ahi thuoi a."},"34":{"text":"Koiin ahiei siemmawtangsah ding? Ashi khu Khrist ahi ngal a, ahi, athoukia zawta a Pasian ziellam a uma hing nget piehpa ahi."},"35":{"text":"Khrist itna akipat eite hing khen ding koi ahiei? Gimthuohnain ahiei, lunggimnain ahiei, bawlsietnain ahiei, kielin ahiei, guohtanna in ahiei, shi zauhuoina in ahiei, ahisihleh namsau in ahiei, hingkhen ding?"},"36":{"text":"“Nangma ziehin sun nitum in thain ka um uh; gaw ding belamte bangin simtel ka hi uh, chi a kigiel bangin.”","ref":"Late. 44.22"},"37":{"text":"Khen vawtlou ding; tamte zousie ah, ahing itpa ziehin guolzoute sanga tungtuong zaw ihi uhi."},"38":{"text":"Shina ahiei, hinna ahiei, vansawlsiengte ahiei, thuneinate ahiei, silbawltheinate ahiei, tuhun a sil umte ahiei, sil hing um dingte ahiei,"},"39":{"text":"Sanna ahiei, thuhna ahiei, ahisihleh silsiem dang mawngmawngin zong, i Mangpa uh Khrist Jesu a um Pasian itna akipat ahing khen thei sih ding chi kichien tahin ka thei hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khrist ah thutah ka gen ahi, zuou ka gen sih, Hagau Siengthou ziehin, ka sie leh pha theinain zong ahing theipi hi.","title":"Paul lunggimna"},"2":{"text":"Ka lungtangah lunggimna lienpi leh gentheina beitheilou ka nei hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen tahsa dan a ka chipi ka nampi ka unaute taangin keima Khrist a pat in pampai leh hamsie thuohin um leng ka chi ahi;"},"4":{"text":"Israelmi ahi ngal ua, ta hinate, thupinate, thuhunte, dan thupiehnate, Pasian nasepnate leh thuchiemte ama ua a ahi a;","ref":"Pawt. 4.22"},"5":{"text":"Pu leh pate ama ua ahia, tualeh tahsa lam thu ah Khrist zong amaute lah a kipata hing pawtkhie ahia, Ama pen sil zousie tunga um, kumtawn a pahtawitaah Pasian ahi. Amen."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian thu bangmalou banga umta ahisih hi. Aziehpen Israel hahlesuonte aunpi un Israelmi ahi sieng sih uhi.","title":"Pasian thuneina"},"7":{"text":"Abraham hahlesuonte ahivang un, Abraham tate tahtah ahi sieng tuon sih uhi. “Tuanahsangin Isaak ah na hah na suonte akichi ding chi ahi zaw hi.”","ref":"Siem. 21.12"},"8":{"text":"Tuapen tahsa tate khu Pasian tate ahisih ua, hinanleh thuchiem tate khu Abraham hahlesuon a kisim ahizaw uh china ahi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen thuchiem khu tami ahi; “Tubang hunin ka hing pei dinga, Sarah in tapa anei ding,” chi ahi.","ref":"Siem. 18.10"},"10":{"text":"Tua guoh ahisih a, Rebekah in zong, mi khat, ipu uh Isaak lah ah nau apai laiin,"},"11":{"text":"Naupangte apien masangun, sie leh pha bangma abawl masangun, tel lam thu a Pasian silguot adet theina dingin, anasepte zieh hilouin ahanpa deina zieh ahizaw hi.","ref":"Siem. 25.23"},"12":{"text":"Akungah a “Upa zawin anaupang zawpa nna asep pieh ding hi,” Pasian in achi hi."},"13":{"text":"“Jakob ka itta a hinanleh Esau ka mudata hi” chia gel bangin.","ref":"Mala. 1.2,3"},"14":{"text":"Ahileh bang igenta diei le? Pasian ah dihtatlouna a um a adiei? um lou e!"},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman Mosi kungah, “Ka hepi nuomte ka hepi dinga, tualeh ka it nuomte pouma ka it ding hi, chi’n ana genta hi.”","ref":"Pawt. 33.19"},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin mihing deina zieh leh kipau bawlna zieh ahisih a, hinanleh a hepipa Pasian ziehin ahi zaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen Laisiengthouin Pharaoh kung ah, “Tami tupna ziehin, nangma a ka silbawltheina ka etsah theina dingin, tualeh leitung pumpi a ka min athan theina dingin nang ka hing tungding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 9.16"},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian in a ut pouma ahepi a, a ut pouma zong alungsim akhausah hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n nangman ka kungah, “Bang dinga Aman i dihlouna mu nalai ahiei? Adeilam koiin akal ei?” na chi ahi kha ding.","title":"Pasian bangkim tunga thunei ahina"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Aw mihing, Pasian dawng ngam ding nang koi na hiei? Silsiem in asiempa kungah, “Bang dinga tambanga na hing siem ahiei, achi diei mah?”","ref":"Isai. 29.16; 45.9"},"21":{"text":"Bel khengpa’n tungman tangkhat apat bel khat manpha tah a zah ding leh, thulimlou taha zah ding bel khat kheng dingin tungman tang tungah thu anei sih amah?"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh lungthahna bel suhsiet dingte tunga Pasian in alungthahna leh asilbawltheina latsah a ut a, kideh zoua, athuohzou hamham leh bang akhawh diei?"},"23":{"text":"Tualeh hepina bel, thupina tang dinga masanglai apat ana guotlawhte tunga, athupina haudan asuhlat theina dingin,"},"24":{"text":"Tua khotuona belte khu Judate lah guoh a hat hilouin, Jentelte lah a kipata hat eite nangawn zong ihi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hosea laibu a: “Ka mi hingailoute khu, ka mite ka chi dinga, it ngailounu zong, it nu ka chi ding hi.”","ref":"Hos. 2.23"},"26":{"text":"“Tualeh amaute kunga, ka mite na hisih uh, akichina mun ah, Pasian hing tate akichita ding uh, ana chi bang in.”","ref":"Hos. 1.10"},"27":{"text":"Israelte tungtangthu ah Isai in zong tambangin ana tangkoupi hi: “Israel tate tamdan tuipi pieu a, senel za hinan u’leh, asuohta umsunte bep, hundam in aum ding uhi.”","ref":"Isai. 10.22,23"},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n leitunga, nna tomkhat asep ding ziehin, tua nasep khu aman azou dinga, dihtatnain a sutom ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Isai main, “Mangpa silbangkim bawlpa’n, Hahlesuon hing na khoipieh lou hileh, Sodom ibangta ding ua, Gomorrah banga bawlin i umta ding hi,” chi a ana genlawh bangin.","ref":"Isai. 1.9"},"30":{"text":"Ahileh bang igenta diei? Dihtatna suilou Jentelten ginna ziehin dihtatna amuta uhi.","title":"Israelten nasep in dihtatna asui uh"},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh dan a dihtatna sui Israelten tua dihtatna khu amu zouta sih uhi."},"32":{"text":"Bang ziehin ahiei? Ginna in asui sih ua, dan silbawla muthei banga asui zieh uh ahi. Aziehpen kipalna suong ah akipalpua ta uhi."},"33":{"text":"“Ngai un, Zion ah, kipalpuana suong leh, Puana suongpi ka koi hi; Koipou ama gingta azumsah sih ding hi,” chi a kigiel bangin.","ref":"Isai. 28.16"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Unaute aw, Israelte dinga ka lunggul pen leh ka thungetna pentah khu amaute hundam ahing hitheina ding uh ahi.","title":"Israelten Khrist anuol uh"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen amauten Pasian lam ah phatuomngaina anei uh chi ka theipi hi, ahivangin theina dungzui ahisih hi."},"3":{"text":"Amuten Pasian dihtatna theilou in amauh dihtatna suhdet tumin, Pasian dihtatna ah akitulut sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen agingta pouma adingin Khrist khu dihtatna muna dinga dan tawpna ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mosi in, dan a dihtatna zui mi khu tua dihtatnain a hing ding, chi’n agiel hi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.5"},"6":{"text":"Hinna leh ginna a dihtatnain pen tambangin agen hi, “Na lungsim in van tungah koi akal tou diei?” chi sin. (Tua pen tunglam apat Khrist hing puisuh ding, china ahi.)","ref":"Danp. 30.12-14"},"7":{"text":"Ahisihleh “Lei nuoi ah koi akumsuh diei?” (Tuapen mishi lah akipat Khrist puitou ding china ahi) chi sin achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh bang ahiei agen? Thuin ahing nai hi, na kam leh na lungtang ah aum hi, tua khu ginna thu ka gen uh khu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Jesu Mangpa ahi chi na kam a na phuon a, mishi lah a kipat Pasian in akaithou hi chi, na lungtanga na gintat leh hundamin na um ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen mi’n alungtang un agingta ua, dihtatna amu uhi, tualeh akam un aphuong ua, hundamna amu zel uhi."},"11":{"text":"Laisiengthouin “Koipou Ama gingta khu azumsah sih ding,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 28.16"},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen Judate leh Greekte kilamdanna bangma aum sih hi; a unpi ua tunga Mangpa khu akibang ahia, tualeh Ama han zousiete tungah hoina ahau hi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen “Mangpa min han pouma hundam in a um ding uhi.”","ref":"Joel. 2.32"},"14":{"text":"Ahileh agintat loupi uh bangchin amin ahan ding uoi? tualeh athu azah loupi uh, bangchi’n agingta ding uoi? Agen ding mi um louin bangchin aza ding uoi?"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh sawl ahisih u’leh bangchi’n thu agen ding uoi? “Hamuonna khantan hoi leh, silhoi kipah huoi hing tut mite, Kalsuon khu kilawm hina e;” chia kigiel bangin.","ref":"Isai. 52.7"},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh amaun a unpi un khantanhoi azui kim sih uhi. Aziehpen Isai in, “Mangpa ka thugen uh gingta koi ahiei?” ana chi hi.","ref":"Isai. 53.1"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n ginna pen zahna ziehin, ahing um a, tualeh zahna khu Pasian thu ziehin, ahing um hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh aza sih uh amah? “Ka chi ahi; zatham e, athawmging uh leitung pumpi ah athang suoh a, athu uh kawlmong dongin athangta hi.”","ref":"Late. 19.4"},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Israelten athei sih uh amah? “Ka chi ahi, Amasapen in Mosi in, Nam a genthamloute zangin, thangsietna ka hing neisah dinga, nam mote zangin, Kang lungthah sah ding hi,” chiin ana genta hi.","ref":"Danp. 32.21"},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Isai in hangsan tahin; “Kei hing sui louten ahing mudohta ua, Ka kunga hing ngen loute kungah, suhlatin ka umta hi.”","ref":"Isai. 65.1"},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh Israelte kungah, “Mi genha leh thumang loute adingin, sun nitum in ka ban ka zah hi. Chi’n agen hi.”","ref":"Isai. 65.2"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n ken, Pasian in amite paikheta ahiei mah? Ka chi hi. Paikhe lou e! Aziehpen Kei zong Israelmi, Abraham hahlesuon, Benjamin phunga mi ka hi.","title":"Israelte pen paikhieh den ahisih ding uh","ref":"Phil. 3.5"},"2":{"text":"Pasian in a theilawhsa amite apaikhe sih hi. Laisiengthouin Elijah thu agen na theisih uh amah? Aman Israelte mawsahna thu Pasian kungah atut a;"},"3":{"text":"“Mangpa na guolneite athat ua, Na maitamte asatchim ua, tualeh keima tangin ka um a, Kei zong tha ahing tum uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 19.10,14"},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian dawnna bang ahiei le? “Baal mai a khupdin ngailou mi tul sagi keima dingin ka koituom hi,” chi’n adawng hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 19.18"},"5":{"text":"Tuamabangin, tu hun laiin zong hepina a tel dungzui in, asuohta sun themkhat a um na lai hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh hepina zieh ahi leh vang, na sep zieh ahi nawnta sih hi, tuachilouin pen hepina khu hepina ahitasih ding hi, hinanleh nasep zieh ahileh pen hepina ahi sih ding hi, tuachilouin pen nasep zong nasep ahita sih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahileh bangchi ahita diei? Israelten asui uh amu sih ua, hinanleh telten vang amu uhi, adang zousie pen khausah in a umta uhi."},"8":{"text":"“Pasian in tuni tan dongin, imut suohna hagau apie a, amu theilouna ding uh mitte apie a, azah theilouna ding uh bilte apie hi.” Chi-a kigiel bangin.","ref":"Danp. 29.4; Isai. 29.10"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh David in: “Amasang ua annkuong kilui khu, thang leh piel, kipalpuana leh phuba lahna suoh heh.","ref":"Late. 69.22,23"},"10":{"text":"Amu theilouna dingun amitte uh, suhmiel in um henlen, tualeh angumgu uh kun zing heh,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahileh ken akipal uh khu apuadenna ding uh ahiei mah? ka chi hi. Hilou e! Hinanleh amaute puana ziehin Jentelten hundamna amu ua, Israelte athangsietna tohthou a aum theina ding ahi.","title":"Israelte nuolna leh Jentelte hamphatna"},"12":{"text":"Amauh puana khu leitung pumpi a dinga hausatna ahing hi a, tualeh asupna uh zong Jentelte hausatna ahing hileh, abukimna uh bangchi zatah a hausatna ahita diei?"},"13":{"text":"Tuin nou Jentelte kunga ka gen ahi, Kei Jentelte sawltah ka hiziehin ka nasepna ka pahtawi ahi."},"14":{"text":"Bangchilam ahiei khat a, tahsa dana ka nampite ka thangsiet sah a, alah ua pawlkhat beeh ka hundam thei khah leh chi ka kinepna ahi."},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen amauh paikhieh a aumna uh, leitung pumpi toh kilem kiana ahileh, amaute pomkiana khu shina apat hin kiana loungal bang dang ahi diei?"},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen aga masa asienthou nah pouleh, alompi zong tuamabangin asiengthou hi; tualeh ahuite asianthou leh abate zong tuamabangin asiengthou hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh aba khenkhatte suhtana aum a, nang gam Olive alah ua phutlut in ahing zop a Olive sing tahtah zungpi leh ahoina kikoppite na hita hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh abate tungah kiliensah sin na kiletsah leh tami theizingin, nang abameng khat nahi giap a, azungpi vahpa nang na hisih a, azungpi in nang hing vah ahi zaw hi."},"19":{"text":"“Tuachi’n nang phulut leh zop a ka um theina dinga abamengte sattan a um ahi na chi ahi ding hi.”"},"20":{"text":"Adih hi, amauten agintatlouna zieh un sattan in a um ua, nang pen na ginna ziehin na ding ahi. Ki uongsah sinlen zau zawin."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in bamengdihtahte nangawn khawilou ahileh, nang zong ahing khawi tuom sih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian hoina leh thukhaunate ngaituoin: Apuate tungah athukhau a, hinanleh nang lamah ahoi ahi; ahoina a na um zing pou leh, tuachi ahisihleh, nang zong satkhiehin na um sam ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh amauh zong gingta loua aumden sih pou u’leh phulutin aum ding uhi, aziehpen Pasian in amauh aphutlut thei hi."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen nang piendan a olive tahlou apat satkhieh bawn, pienken ngainaloutah a olive sing hoi a phulut a na um leh, tam Olive tah bamengte, amauh olive sing ngei ah phulutin um zaw sem lou ding uh amah?"},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen unaute aw, nouma ngai a na kipilsah louna ding un tam thuguh kiphuol Jentelte bukimna ahing tun masangsie, Israelte tungah lungtang khauna bangza ahiei hing tung tadi ahi, chi na theilou uh ka dei sih hi.","title":"Israel tunding kiana ding thuchiem"},"26":{"text":"“Tuachi’n Israelmi zousie hundam in a um ding uhi; Zion akipat hundampa ahing pei dinga, Jakob akipat Pasian ngaisah louna asumang ding hi.”","ref":"Isai. 59.20,21"},"27":{"text":"“Aziehpen akhelna uh ka lahmang chienga, akung ua ka thuhun ding khu tami ahi,” chi a na kigiel bangin.","ref":"Isai. 27.9"},"28":{"text":"Khantanhoi lam thuah pen noute ziehin melma ahi ua, hinanleh telna thu toh kisai in pen pu leh pate zieh in it le ngaitahte ahi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian silthawnpieh leh hatna akiheng thei sih hi."},"30":{"text":"Khatvei lai in Pasian thumang loute na hi ua, hinanleh, tuin amaute thumanlouna ziehin hepina na muta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Tuamabangin tuin amaute zong thumangloute ahi ua, tua pen, noute tunga Pasian hepina zieha amauten zong hepina amu theina ding uh ahi."},"32":{"text":"Pasian in a unpi ua ahepi sieng theina dingin, mi zousie, thumanlouna ah akhakhumta hi."},"33":{"text":"Aw Pasian pilna leh theina tualeh hausatna thuh hina va-ia e, A thukhennate suikhiet guollou leh! Alampite zong mukhiet guollou hina va-ia e!","title":"Israel tunding kia zieh a Pasian pahtawina","ref":"Isai. 55.8"},"34":{"text":"“Mangpa lungsim koi ahiei thei? Ahisihleh koi ahiei alemguotpi a vapang ngai?”","ref":"Isai. 40.13"},"35":{"text":"“Ahisihleh koi ahiei ditkia dinga akunga sil pemasa phot?”","ref":"Job. 41.11"},"36":{"text":"Aziehpen sil zousie Ama akipan leh, Ama vang leh, Ama a dinga silzousie um ahi; Ama kungah thupina tangtawn in um hen, Amen.","ref":"1 Kor. 8.6"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n unaute aw, Pasian kunga na sapum uh, kithoina hing leh siengthou leh pomtah hi dinga kilan dingin Pasian khotuona ziehin ka hing ngen ahi; tuakhu na bawl ding ua kilawm mawng ahi.","title":"Khristian hinkhuo leh nasep"},"2":{"text":"Tam leitung hindan toh kituoh in um sih unlen, hinanleh Pasian deilam hoi leh pomtah leh hoibukim bang ahiei chi na thei chienna dingun na lungsim uh atha a umin hing lamdang zawta un."},"3":{"text":"Ka kunga hing kipie hepina ziehin, na lah ua mi koipou akingaisang ding hun kalval a, kingaisanglouin, hinanleh Pasian in michin ginna kihunkhop apieh bang zel a, kituptah a ngaituo zaw dingin ka gen ahi.","title":"Hagau silpiehte zahdan dih"},"4":{"text":"Sapumkhat ah hieng tampi inei ua, tualeh hieng zousie nasep akibang sih hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 12.12"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n eite tampi hinanlei zong, Khrist ah sapum khat ihi ua, khat leh khat i kihiengtuo chiet uhi."},"6":{"text":"I kung ua hepina hing kipie dungzui in silthawn pieh tuom tuom inei chiet ua, thumavang gen ding ahileh iginna toh kituohin igen ding uhi,","ref":"1 Kor. 12.4-11"},"7":{"text":"Ahisihleh, thunasep ding ahileh, sem vaiin thuhilmiin zong hil zel heh."},"8":{"text":"Mi dangte hanthawn mi in zong hanthawn zel henlen, silpieh pemi in it hetlouin pie heh, vaihawmmi in thanuom tahin hawm hen, midangte hepina nei miin kipahtahin hepi uhen."},"9":{"text":"Itna khu lepchiena tellou hiheh, gilou pouma huo unlen, ahoilam pouma tu chinten un.","title":"Khristian hinkhuo zah dan ding"},"10":{"text":"Unau ki itna in khat leh khat, kilainat tuo chiet unlen, kizabawlna lam ah kideisah tuo chiet un."},"11":{"text":"Kukalna lam ah thase sih unlen, Hagau lamah phatuom ngaitahin, Mangpa nna sem un."},"12":{"text":"Kinepna ah kipah zing unlen, gimthuohna ah thuohhat unlen, thungetna lamah hakat un."},"13":{"text":"Misiengthoute tahsap awng hu dingin na nei nalamte uh kitanpi unlen, zin bawldan siem un."},"14":{"text":"Nou hing bawlsete guolzawl un, guolzawl unlen gausap sih un.","ref":"Mat. 5.44; Luk. 6.28"},"15":{"text":"Kipahte kipahpi unlen, kapte kaapi un."},"16":{"text":"Khat leh khat lungsim kibangin um unlen, kisathei sih unlen, mi mawlte toh kipawl zaw unlen, nangma ngai in kipilsah sin.","ref":"Thu. 3.7"},"17":{"text":"Koima gitlouna gitlounain thuh sih unlen, mi zousie mitmu ah sil kilawm bawl tum zaw un."},"18":{"text":"Ahithei liei leh na thu ua ahithei laisie, mi zousie toh kituohin um un."},"19":{"text":"Ka itte aw, phuba kila sih un, hinanleh lungthahna khu Pasian awn zaw un, “Phuba lah Keima a ahia, keiman ka thuhna ding, Mangpa’n achi hi,” chi’n akigiel hi.","ref":"Danp. 32.35"},"20":{"text":"“Tuaziehin na melma agilkiel leh neh ding pie inlen, adang ata leh dawn ding piein. Tuabanga na bawl leh alutunga mei am buohkhum na hi ding hi.”","ref":"Thu. 25.21,22"},"21":{"text":"Gitlou thuzawin um sih unlen, hoina in gilou zou zaw un."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Michin atunga vaihawm thuneite thuthu in um heh. Aziehpen Pasian thu louin koima vaihawm a um sih hi; vaihawm a pangte khu Pasian guot ahi.","title":"Leitung vaihawmte thu man ding"},"2":{"text":"Tuaziehin koizong vaihawmmi niel pouma Pasian lemguot niel ahi uh, tuabanga niel miten ama u’tungah thukhenna amu ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Vaihawm mitepen silhoi bawl mite adingin agiinhuoi sih ua, hinanleh mi giloute a dingin mi giinhuoi ahi uhi. Ahileh vaihawmte giing loua um na ut ei? Silhoi bawl lachin apahtat na law ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen ama khu na hoina dinga Pasian nasem mi ahi, hinanleh sil hoilou na bawl leh giingin; aman namsau amawhtawi sih hi, ama pen Pasian nasem sil gilou bawlte tunga lungthahna phuba lapa ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin lungthahna giinna zieh bep hilouin, na sie leh pha theina ziehin zong vaihawm mi thuthu a na um ding mawng ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tami zieh in sie zong na pieh uh ahi; vaihawmte pen tambang bawl dinga Pasian nasemte ahi uhi.","ref":"Mat. 22.21; Mak. 12.17; Luk. 20.25"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin mi zousie kungah atan ding ua kilawm pie un: Sie piehna dingpa kungah sie pie unlen, leiman piehna dingpa kungah leiman pie unlen; giin dingpa giing unlen, zatat dingpa zong zatat un."},"8":{"text":"Ki it tuona loungal koima bangma basih un, Ama amihinpi it miin dan azuikim hi.","title":"Sanggam ki itna"},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen tam “Thupiehte, angkawm sin, tuol that sin, guta sin, theipitu dihlou in pangsin, eng sin,” chileh thupieh dang mawngmawng aum leh “Nangma na ki it bangin na innvengte na it ding ahi,” chiin akhaikhawm sieng hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.14; Danp. 5.18; Pawt. 20.13; Danp. 5.17; Pawt. 20.15; Danp. 5.19; Pawt. 20.17; Danp. 5.21; Siempu. 19.18"},"10":{"text":"Itna in innvengte sietna ding abawl sih hi, tuaziehin, itna khu dan zuikimna ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tu hun banghun ahiei chi na thei zieh un, tami bawl un, aziehpen igintat chiil lai sangin ihundamna anai zawta a, imut khanlaw ahun mamata chi hun umdan na thei uhi.","title":"Khrist hing peikiana ding naidan leh hinkho siengthou"},"12":{"text":"Zan abei dihdihta a, khuo vah ding ahita hi, tuaziehin miel a silbawlte paiin vah thuom in ikithuom ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Sun a um bangin kilawm tahin i um ding uh, huham leh zukham buoi a umlouin, hua leh numei pasal kaala thangtat a umlouin, tualeh kihau leh kithangsiet a um louin,"},"14":{"text":"Mangpa Jesu Khrist in kithuom unlen, na tahsa utna uh supiching dingin bangma kibawl sih un."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ginna a hatlou mi khu aginlanate nielse louin ngai un.","title":"Khristian noplenna","ref":"Kolo. 2.16"},"2":{"text":"Mi khat in bangkim ne thei in akigingta a, mi hatlouin pen ante louhing maimai ane hi."},"3":{"text":"Anete’n aneloute simmaw sih henlen, tualeh aneloute’n zong anete mawsah sih heh. Pasian in ama akipahpi tah ziehin."},"4":{"text":"Midang suoh tunga thukhen ding nang koi na hiei? A din leh a pua ding pen apu thu ahi. Ahi, ama dinsah in aum ding hi, aziehpen Pasian in ama adingsah thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi khat in ni dang sangin ni khat angai poimaw zaw hi. Midang khat in ni chinteng kibang chietin angai hi. Michin in amauh lungsim chiet ah kitheichien u’heh."},"6":{"text":"Tuani tang miin, Mangpa zatatna in atang hi, tualeh ni tangloupa’n Mangpa zatatna in atang sih hi. Bangkim ne mi in Pasian kunga kipahthu agen ziehin Mangpa zatatna in ane a, tualeh anelou mi in zong Pasian kunga kipahthu gen in ane sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen koima eima a dinga hing ihisih a tualeh koima eima a dinga shi zong ihisih hi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen i hin leh Mangpa a dingin i hinga, i shi in zong Mangpa a dingin i shi uh ahi. Tuaziehin i hin in zong ishi in zong Mangpa a ihi uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mishite leh mi hingte Mangpa a ahitheina dingin Khrist khu ashi a, athou a, ahingkiata hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh nang bangdinga na unau tunga mawsah a thukhen na hiei? Ahisihleh nang bangdinga na unau simmaw na hiei? Aziehpen eite i unpi ua Khrist thukhenna toupha mai a ding ding ihi uhi.","ref":"2 Kor. 5.10"},"11":{"text":"“Mangpa’n Kei ahingzing ka hi ziehin, khup chinteng ka masang ah akun ding ua, Lei chinteng zong Pasian kungah, akiphuong ding uhi,” chi a kigiel bangin achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 45.23"},"12":{"text":"Tuabang ahiziehin eiten Pasian masangah eima khantan chiet igen ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin eite khat leh khat kimawsahtuo nawn sih vai, hinanleh koiin zong aunau kipalna ding ahiei, ahisihleh kipuana ding bangma bawllou dingin kingaituo zaw heh."},"14":{"text":"Sil bangma, ama a sienglou mawngmawng aum sih chi, Mangpa Jesu ah ka theichien a ka tahsang mama hi, hinanleh mi koipou in sil khat asiengloua angaituo leh tuakhu ama adingin asienglou ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh bang ahiei sil khat na neh zieh a, na unau lungsim anat leh itna dana gamta nawnlou na hita hi. Na sil neh ziehin mi khat suse sin, Jesu Khrist ama dinga shi ahizieh in."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin na hoina u’khu ahoilou banga gen in um sih heh."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian gam khu neh leh dawn thu ahi sih a, hinanleh dihtatnate, kilemnate leh Hagau Siengthou a lungnopna thu ahi zaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Tambang Khrist nasem mipen Pasian pomtah ahia, tualeh mite patat zong alaw hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin eite’n kilemna ding leh kisuhhat tuona ding silte idel ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Na neh nadawn in Pasian nasep suse sin. Sil zousie asiengthou a, hinanleh naneh nadawn zieh ua mi lungsim asuhnat leh anemi dingin ahoilou ahi."},"21":{"text":"Na unau puana ding ahiei, ahisihleh lungnopmawna ding ahiei, ahisihleh suhzawngkhalna ding ahiei ahileh, sa nehloute, uoin dawnloute, tualeh sil bangma bawllou ahoi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ginna na nei amah? Pasian leh nangma kaal ah kinei in. Ama hoisahna lam a siemlou kitangsahlou mi khu ahampha hi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh ginlana nei kawmkawma aneh leh ginna a anehlou ziehin siemloutangin aum hi, aziehpen ginna lou a bawl pouma khelna ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n ei ahatten eima lungnopna ding suilou in, ahatloute hatlouna ithuohpi zaw ding uhi.","title":"Khristian noplenna zahdan"},"2":{"text":"Michin in i innvengte hoina dinga ilamtou ua, isuhlungkim ding uh ahi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Khrist nangawn in Ama lungnopna ding angaituo sih a, “Hinanleh nou hing selphoute selphouna khu keima tungah atuta hi,” chia na kigiel bangin ahi zaw hi.","ref":"Late. 69.9"},"4":{"text":"Masanglai a na kigiel pouma khu Laisiengthoua thuohhatna leh lungmuonna zieh a kinepna inei theina dinga eite kihilna dinga gel ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n thuohhatna leh hamuonna Pasian in Jesu Khrist mabangin khat leh khat lungsim kibang neiin hing umsahta hen."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n lungsim kibang leh gen kibanga, i Mangpa Jesu Khrist Pa, Pasian na pahtawi thei na ding un."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian thupina dinga Khrist in noute ahing pomtah mabangin, khat leh khat kipomtuo chiet un."},"8":{"text":"Pu leh pate kunga thuchiemte sukip dingin Pasian thutah ziehin, Khrist pen teptante a dingin suohin ahing pangta chi noute kang hil ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahepina zieh a Jentelten Pasian apahtawi theina dingun, “Tami ziehin Jentelte lah ah, Nang kang phat dinga, Na min phat in la kasa ding hi,” chi a na kigiel bangin.","ref":"2 Sam. 22.50; Late. 18.49"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh “Nou Jentelte aw, A mite toh lungdam un;” achi kia hi.","ref":"Danp. 32.43"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Nou Jentete zousiein, “Mangpa phat un, Mizousie in zong Ama phat un,” achi kia nalai hi.","ref":"Late. 117.1"},"12":{"text":"Isai in, “Jesse zungpi ahing zamdoh dinga, Jentelte tunga vaihawm dingin, ahing dingdoh dinga, Ama ah Jentelten kinepna anei ding uhi,” ana chi kia hi.","ref":"Isai. 11.10"},"13":{"text":"Hagau Siengthou silbawltheina zieha kinepna kiningching na nga theina dingun, kinepna Pasian in ginna a kipahna leh hamuonna chintengin hing sudimta hen."},"14":{"text":"Unaute, noute pen hoina in na dim ua, pilna kim neiin, khat leh khat na kihasot thei uh chi keima ngel in zong ka thei hi.","title":"Paul laihah tup leh ngim"},"15":{"text":"Ahivang in unaute, Pasian in ahing pieh hepina ziehin noute hing theidohsah kiana dan in akaal lahah thu poimaw them khat hangsantah in ka giel ahi."},"16":{"text":"Jentelte sillatte pomtah ahitheina ding leh Hagau Siengthou in asuhsiengthou theina dingin, Jesu Khrist khantanhoi nasep ka sem hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian lam silte ah, Jesu Khrist ah, kisahtheina ding ka nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Pasian thumang dinga Khrist in thugen leh nasep a, Keima zanga asilbawlte loungal bangma gen ngam ding ka nei sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Chiemtenate leh sillamdangte in, Pasian Hagau silbawltheinain; tuachi’n Jerusalem leh akimvel gam a kipat Illirikam gam tan dongin Khrist khantanhoi kimtahin ka gen zouta hi."},"20":{"text":"Khrist min kilawkhah nailouna munte a khantanhoi gen ka tup ahi, tuachilou in pen midang suongphum tunga inn lam ka hi kha ding hi."},"21":{"text":"“Hinanleh akhantan hoi Kigen ngailounaten amu ding ua, aza ngainailouten atheisiem ding uhi; chi a kigiel bangin gen ka tum zaw hi.”","ref":"Isai. 52.15"},"22":{"text":"Tamte ziehin na kung ua hing haw ding tamveipi dalin ka umta hi.","ref":"Rom. 1.13"},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin pen tam gamkai ah sepna ding mun ka nei nawn lou toh, noute kunga hing haw ding ka lunggulna kum tampi ahi taah toh,"},"24":{"text":"Spain gam a ka haw chienga noute kunga hing kiban malam a, ikimutuo ding uh kinem in ka um hi. Aziehpen, noute toh kithuo zou chienga, ka khuolzinna a nouten nang panpi ding u’zong ka kinem hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin pen Jerusalem a misiengthoute nasem dingin ka pei phot ding hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 16.1-4"},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen Masidonia gam leh Akaia gam a miten Jerusalem khuo a misiengthoute lah a migentheite adingin sum tuohkhawm pha asata uhi."},"27":{"text":"Amauten lungkimtah in atuohkhawm ut chiet uhi, tuabang bawl ding aleiba uh zong ahi mawng hi. Aziehpen Jentelten Judate hagau lam guolzawlna akitanpi u’leh, amaun zong a tahsa lam guolzawlnate uh Judate akitanpi uh abat uh ahi.","ref":"1 Kor. 9.11"},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin ken tam silpiehte ka piehkhiet a, asangna uh chi ka theichien zou chiengin, noute kunga hing kibang malam in, Spain gamah ka haw ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Noute kunga kang haw chiengin Khrist khantanhoi guolzawlna kim toh kang haw ding chi ka thei hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka unaute aw, Kei a dinga Pasian kunga lunglut tah a thungen khawm dingin i Mangpa Jesu Khrist tungtawn leh Hagau itna tungtawnin ka hing ngen ahi."},"31":{"text":"Judia gam a gingloute lah a kipat ka suotat theina ding leh Jerusalem khuo a ka nasep, misiengthoute a dinga pomtah ahitheina dingin."},"32":{"text":"Tua ban ah, Pasian deina banga, noute kunga lungnopna toh kang haw a, i kisuhhal khawm thei chietna ding un, thu na ngen un."},"33":{"text":"Lungmuonna Pasian in noute na unpi un hing umpita hen. Amen."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kenkrea khuo a hattuom nasem i unaunu uh Phoibi na kung uah ka hing meltheisah hi.","title":"Mimal mangpha hahna"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa min a misiengthoute banga nana pom ua, panpi angaina phot a na panpi ding un, aziehpen amanu’n zong mi tampi ana panpita a, kei zong ahing panpi hi."},"3":{"text":"Khrist Jesu a ka seppite Prisilla leh Akuila hing na nousiet pieh un.","ref":"Nasep. 18.2"},"4":{"text":"Amauten ka hinna dingin Jesu Khrist min in a ngawng uh adawta uhi; amaute tung guoh hilouin Jentel hattuomte zousie tungah zong kipahthu ka gen hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuabangmain a inn ua hattuom kikhawmte zong hing na nousiet pieh un. Akaia gam a Khrist a ga masapen ka ittah Epenetus zong hing na nousiet pieh un."},"6":{"text":"Na lah ua semgim Mari hing na nousiet pieh un."},"7":{"text":"Ka nampite lah a ka koltanpi, sawltahte lah a minthangtah, Khrist a zong kei sanga um masazaw, Andronika leh Juni hing na nousiet pieh un."},"8":{"text":"Mangpa a ka ittah Amplia hing nousiet pieh un."},"9":{"text":"Khrist a iseppi uh Urbanus leh Stakis hing nousiet pieh un."},"10":{"text":"Khrist a gin umtah Apelles, hing nousiet pieh un. Aristobulus inn sungmite hing nousiet pieh un."},"11":{"text":"Ka nampi Herodion hing nousiet piehun. Mangpa a um Narkissus inn sung mite hing nousiet piehun."},"12":{"text":"Mangpa a nasem Triphena leh Triphosa hing nousiet pieh un. Mangpa a nasem gim mama ka ittah Persis hing na nousiet pieh un."},"13":{"text":"Mangpa a tel tuom Rufus leh anu Kei nu zong hiveve, hing nousiet pieh un.","ref":"Mak. 15.21"},"14":{"text":"Asinkrita, Phligon, Hermas, Patrobus, Kritus, Hermes leh amaute toh umkhawm unaute hing nousiet pieh un."},"15":{"text":"Philologus, Julia leh Neriah leh asanggamnu leh Olimpas tualeh akung ua misiengthou umte zousie hing nousiet pieh un."},"16":{"text":"Kitawpna siengthou toh khat leh khat kinousiet tuo chiet un. Khrist hattuomten ahing nousiet uhi."},"17":{"text":"Unaute aw, kithuhilna dan noute hing kihil lou banga kikhenna leh puana siemte melchi ding leh kiheisan dingin ka hing ngen hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen tuabang miten i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist nna asem sih ua, amauh gilpi nna asem zaw uhi, tualeh kamsiem leh maitangphat siem thuin mimawlte asol uhi."},"19":{"text":"Na thuman dan uh mi zousie lah ah akithangta a, tuaziehin na tung uah ka kipah hi; hinanleh ahoi lam a pil ding leh aselam amawl dingin noute ka hing dei hi."},"20":{"text":"Lungmuonna Pasian in tomnoukaal in Setan na kephang nuoi uah ahing tuonchil sah paita ding hi. I Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist hepina na tung uah umta hen. Amen."},"21":{"text":"Ka naseppi Timothi leh ka nampi Lusia, Jason leh Sosipater in ahing nousiet uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 16.1"},"22":{"text":"Keima Tertius tami laihah gielpa in Mangpa min in ka hing nousiet hi."},"23":{"text":"Ka zintunnapa Gaius leh hattuom zousie zintunna pain noute ahing nousiet uhi. Khopi sumkempa Erastus leh unaupa Kuartus in ahing nousiet uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 19.29; 1 Kor. 1.14; 2 Tim. 4.20"},"24":{"text":"I Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist hepina na unpi ua tungah umta hen, Amen."},"25":{"text":"Leitung pien chiil akipat abeisa hun sawtpi na dapphuol thusim phuondoha hing um dungzui a ka khantanhoi leh Jesu Khrist thu kitangkoupina zieha noute hing phutdet thei Pasian ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin kumtawn Pasian thupieh dungzui a Laisiengthou a guolneite thugen, ginna thumanna dinga nam zousie kunga suhlat leh theisah ahi."},"27":{"text":"Pasian pil umsun kungah, Jesu Khrist ziehin thupina kumtawn in umdenta hen. Amen."}}}}},"46":{"info":{"name":"1 Korinth","shortname":"1 Kor.","abbr":[],"desc":"Korinth mite kunga sawtah paul laihah khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Pasian deilama Jesu Khrist sawltah hi dinga hat leh i unaupa uh Sosthenes in,","title":"Lungdam thupha piehna"},"2":{"text":"Korinth khuo a Pasian hattuom umte, Khrist Jesu a suhsieng leh siengthou dinga hatte kungah leh gam chin a i Mangpa, (amaute leh eite Mangpa) Jesu Khrist min lou zousie kungah,","ref":"Nasep. 18.1"},"3":{"text":"I Pa uh Pasian leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist kunga kipat hepina leh hamuonna na kung uah um hen."},"4":{"text":"Pasian in Khrist Jesu vanga ahepina noute ahing pieh zieh in, ka Pasian kungah kipahthu ka gen ngitnget hi.","title":"Kipahthu genna"},"5":{"text":"Ama Khrist vangin sil bangkim ah, thugen theina chinteng leh theina chintengah suhhausatin na um uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuabangin Khrist thu theipina khu noute ah suhdet ahita hi;"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n silpieh bangma lawsapna neilou in, i Mangpa Jesu Khrist hing kilahna ding kukaltah a ngah in na um uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aman i Mangpa Jesu Khrist ni chienga genbaangloua na um theina ding un atawp dongin noute ahing sudet ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Atapa Jesu Khrist i Mangpa toh kipawlna ah noute hing hanpa Pasian a muonhuoi hi."},"10":{"text":"Unaute aw, nouten na unpi un thu kibang na gen ua, tualeh na lah ua, kikhenna aumlouna dingin lungsim kibang leh ngaituona kibanga, hoina bukim a na kigawmkhawm theina ding un, Mangpa Jesu Khrist min in ka hing ngen hi.","title":"Hattuom sunga kipawlkhenna"},"11":{"text":"Ka unaute aw, Kloe innkuonpiten na lah uah kihauna aum hi, chi’n kei ahing hil uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tami ahi ka gen: noute lah a michin in, “Kei Paul pawl ka hi,” “Kei Apollo pawl ka hi,” “Kei Kipha pawl ka hi,” tualeh “Khrist pawl ka hi,” na chi uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 18.24"},"13":{"text":"Khrist hawmkhen in a um amah? Paul nou a dingin kilbeh in a um amah? Ahisihleh Paul min in baptisma na tang uh amah?"},"14":{"text":"Khrispus leh Gaius chilou noute koima ka hing baptis khahlou ziehin Pasian kungah kipahthu ka gen hi.","ref":"Nasep. 18.8; Nasep. 19.29; Rom. 16.23"},"15":{"text":"Tuachilou in Keima min a ka baptis ahi chi aum kha ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi, Stephenas innkuonte zong ka baptis a, tuate loungal ka baptis lam ka thei sih hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 16.15"},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen Khrist in baptis dingin ahing sawl sih a, khantanhoi gen dingin ahing sawl zaw hi; tuo zong mihing pilna thu a gen ahisih hi; tuachilou in Khrist kros bangmalou asuoh kha ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Kross thu khu Mangthangte adingin mot huoi ahia, hinanleh ei hundam a umte dingin Pasian silbawltheina ahi.","title":"Kross silbawltheina"},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen, “Mipil pilna ka suse dinga, lemguottu theisiemna bangmalou, ka suohsah ding hi,” chi a gelbangin.","ref":"Isai. 29.14"},"20":{"text":"Mipil hei ah a um ei? Laigielmi hei ah a um ei? Tam leitunga miselkhapa hei a um ahiei? Pasian in tam leitung pilna mot huoi asuohsah sih amah?","ref":"Job. 12.17; Isai. 19.12; 33.18; Isai. 44.25"},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian pilna ah, leitungin pilna zanga Pasian atheilou nua un, thugen mot huoite zieha, agingtate hundam khu Pasian kipahna ahi."},"22":{"text":"Judaten chiemtena angen ua, Greekten pilna asui uhi;"},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh eite pen in Khrist kilbeth thu igen uhi, tuapen Judate a dingin kipalpuana, tualeh Greekte a dinga mot huoi ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Judate hiin Greekte hitaleh hatte dingin Khrist khu Pasian silbawltheina leh Pasian pilna ahi."},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian motna khu mihing pilna sangin apil zaw a, tualeh Pasian hatlouna khu mihing hatna sangin ahat zaw hi."},"26":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, hat na hina uh ngaituo di ua,
