tahsa lam a mipil tampite, mi hat tampite leh milien tampite hat ahilou dan uh;"},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in mipilte azalatsahna dingin leitung sil mothuoite a tel hi, tualeh Pasian in ahatte azalatsah na dingin leitung sil hatloute atel zawta hi."},"28":{"text":"Pasian in leitung a sil ngiemte leh simmawhuoi silte atel a, sil um laite bangmalou asuohsah theina dingin, a umlou silte nangawn atel hi;"},"29":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian masangah, koima akiuongsah theisih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh noute pen Ama vangin Khrist Jesu ah na um uhi, Ama pen Pasian akipat eite a dinga pilna, dihtatna, suhsiengthouna, leh tatdohna hing hi ahi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaziehin “Akisiel ut pouma Mangpa ah kisiel heh,” chia kigiel bangin.","ref":"Jer. 9.24"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh unaute aw, noute kunga Pasian thu theipina gen a Kang pei lai in, thugen siemna leh pilna thupitah ahiei toh, hing pei ka hisih hi.","title":"Pilna leh kilahna kikhietna"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen ken noute lah ah Jesu Khrist leh killup a umpa Ama loungal bangma dang thei ka tum sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Kei pen na lah uah hatlou leh zauin, nahpitaha chitun kawmin ka um hi.","ref":"Nasep. 18.9"},"4":{"text":"Ka kamsuoh leh ka thugente pen mihing pilna leh thuzawsiemna ahisih a, Hagau leh silbawltheina a sulat in ahizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi a na ginna uh mihing pilna a kinga hilou a, Pasian silbawltheina a akingah zawh na dingin."},"6":{"text":"Bangtenghitaleh apichingte lah ah pilna thu zong ka gen zel uhi; ahivangin tu hun a leitung pilna thu ahisih a, tu hun a leitung vaihawm mangthang dingte pilna thu zong ahi tuom sih hi.","title":"Khantan hoi pen vanlam pilna ahi"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh koute penin Pasian pilna thuguh kiphuol, ithupina dinga Pasian in leitung um masanga anamdet pilna kiphuol thu ka gen zel zaw uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tua thu pen tuhun a leitung vaihawmte koima’n athei sih uhi. Na theikha hita u’leh, thupina Mangpa akilbeh sih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh, “Mit a mu ngailou, bil a zah ngai lou, Mihing lungtang a zong lut ngailou, Pasian in Ama itte dinga abawl pieh silte khu,” chi a gel bangin.","ref":"Isai. 64.4"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in tuate Hagauin i kungah ahing theisahta hi. Hagau in silbangkim asuidoh a, ahi, athuh mama Pasian thugilte zong."},"11":{"text":"Mihing lungsim ngaisut khu mihing sunga um hagau loungal koi ahiei thei ding? Tuamabangin Pasian Hagau loungal koima’n Pasian ngaisutte athei sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuin Pasian in manbei a ahing pieh silte itheisiem na dingun, eiten leitung hagau itan uh ahisih a, Pasian a kipat Hagau tang ihizaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tua silte khu mihing pilna thuhilna thu a genlouin, Hagau Siengthou thuhilna khu genzawin, Hagau lam thute Hagau mite kungah hilchienin igen zel uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh leitung mi’n Pasian Hagau silte atangthei sih hi, aziehpen tuate ama ngaiin mot huoi ahi; Hagau a thei ahiziehin thei zong athei thei sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh Hagau miin pen silbangkim atheichien zel a, ahinlah ama pen koiman atheichien sih hi."},"16":{"text":"“Aziehpen ama thuhil thei dinga koi ahiei Mangpa lungsim thei ta?” Hinanleh eite penin Khrist lungsim ipuo uhi.","ref":"Isai. 40.13"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Unaute aw, Hagau mite kunga thugen bangin noute kungah ka gen thei sih hi; tahsa mite kunga gen bangin, Khrist a naungehte kunga gen bangin ka gen zaw hi.","title":"Kipawlkhenna thu a hilna"},"2":{"text":"Tu donga anngum na neh thei nailou ziehun nawitui in Ka hing vah hi, tu nangawnin zong na ne thei nai sih uhi.","ref":"Heb. 5.12,13"},"3":{"text":"Noute na tahsami na lai uhi. Aziehpen na lah ua, kithangsietna leh kihauna leh kipawlkhenna a um zing ziehin, tahsami hi nalai in, mihing banga um nalai hilou nahi uoi amah?"},"4":{"text":"Mi khat in “Kei Paul pawl” adang khat in “Kei Apollo pawl” ka hi, na chi laisie uh tahsa mi na hisih uh amah?","ref":"1 Kor. 1.12"},"5":{"text":"Paul koi ahiei? Apollo zong koi ahiei? Noute pen amaute zieh a gingtute hing suohsah, Mangpa’n amaute aguot banga thunasemte chiet ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Ken ka suon a, Apollo in tui abuoh a, hinanleh Pasian in akhangsah hi.","ref":"Nasep. 18.4-11; Nasep. 18.24-28"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n akhangsahpa Pasian loungal, asuonpa bangma ahisih a, atuibuohpa zong bangma ahisih hi."},"8":{"text":"Asuonpa leh atuibuohpa in tupna kibang anei uhi, tualeh michin in asep bang bangin kipahman asang chiet ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen koute Pasian toh nasemkhawmte ka hi ua, noute pen Pasian louma na hi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian hepina Kei hing kipieh dungzuiin inn lammi piltah bangin ken suongphum ka phum a, mi dangin tua suongphum tungah inn alam uhi. Ahivang in mi chinin tua suongphum tunga a inn lamdan uah pilvang chiet uheh."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen suongphumsa loungal suongphum dang koiman aphum thei sih hi, tua suongphum khu Khrist ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tam suongphum tungah mi koipouin, sanain ahiei, dangkain ahiei, suongmantamin ahiei, singin ahiei, hampain ahiei tualeh bupawlin ahiei lam taleh;"},"13":{"text":"Michin anasep dan chiet uh ahing kilang ding hi, aziehpen aniin a phuongdoh ding hi, mei a suhlat a aum ding ahi ziehin, michin nasep bangchibang ahiei chi mei in a suchien ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi koipou nasep tua suongphum tunga lam khu a umden leh aman kipahman amu ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Koipou nasep akattum leh anasep kipahman ataan ding a, hinanleh ama pen mei a pei suoh bangin hundam in a um ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Noute Pasian biehinn na hi uhi, tualeh na sung uah Pasian Hagau ateng hi, chi theilou na hi uoimah?","ref":"1 Kor. 6.19; 2 Kor. 6.16"},"17":{"text":"Mi koipouin Pasian biehinn asuhbua leh ama Pasian in asuse ding hi, aziehpen Pasian bieh inn khu asiengthou a, tua inn khu noute na hi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Mi koima amaleh ama kisol sih heh. Na lah ua mi koi ahiei tam leitung dan a pil akisah leh ahing pil theina dingin mi maw hing suoh phot heh."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen tam leitung pilna pen Pasian adingin motna ahi. “Ama’n mipilte apil lepchiena uah aman a,”","ref":"Job. 5.13"},"20":{"text":"“Tualeh Mangpa’n mipilte ngaituona khu aphatuom sih chi athei hi,” chiin akigiel hi.","ref":"Late. 94.11"},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin mi koiman mihing suong sih heh, sil zousie noute a ahi."},"22":{"text":"Paul hileh, Apollo hileh, Kipha hileh, leitung hileh, hinna hileh, shina hileh, tu hun a um silte hileh, mai lam hun a sil hing um dingte hileh, sil zousie noute a ahi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh noute pen Khrist a na hi ua, Khrist pen Pasian a ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi’n koute pen Khrist nasemte leh Pasian thu guh kemte bangin hing ngaituo uheh.","title":"Sawltahte Pasian nasep"},"2":{"text":"Tuathamlouin kemtu hina ah gin umna akiphamaw hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh noute leh mihing thukhenna in kei na hing etkhiehna uh pen kei adingin sil neunoukhat ahi. Atahtahin Keima leh keima nangawn ka ki enkhe sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Ken keima kimawsahna ding bangma ka thei sih hi; hinanleh tami’n kei ahing siemtangsah tuom sih hi, hinanleh ahing enkhepa khu Mangpa ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa hing pei hun tun masang siein, bangma enkhe sih un, Aman miel a sil kiphuolte vah ah ahing kilangsah dinga, tualeh lungtanga ngaituonate zong ahing sulang ding hi. Tua hun chiengin michin in Pasian akipat phatna anga chiet ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Unaute, akigielsa kalval a koima na ngaituo louna ding ua koute apat na zil theina ding u’leh, na lah ua koiman khat suonga midangkhat na uohkhum louna ding un, tam thute nouma vangin. Kei leh Apollo etsahna in ka kipie ahi."},"7":{"text":"Koi ahiei noute midang apat hing tuom bawl? Tualeh na mu lou uh bang ahiei na nei uh? Na mu ua ahileh, bangdinga amulou banga kisathei na hi uoi?"},"8":{"text":"Tuin na dei uh na muta ua, na hauta uhi, koute tellouin leengte bangin vai na hawmta uhi; kouten zong noute toh vai ka hawm theina dingun, vaihawm ulachin ka ut hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasian in kou sawltahte pen shi dinga guotsa bangin anukhiapen a hing koi hiin ka ngaituo hi, tuachi’n leitung leh vansawlsiengte mai leh mihingte mitmu a etnop a, bawl in ka umta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Koute pen Khrist ziehin mi mo ka hi ua, hinanleh noute pen Khrist ah mipil na hi uhi; Koute pen ka hat sih ua, noute pen hat uhi; Noute pen zatat in na um ua, koute pen simmaw in ka um uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tu naikal hun nangawn in zong ka ni un, ka gilkiel un, ka dangtah ua, tualeh puonsil hoi ka nei sih ua, vuoh ka thuoh ua, inn leh lou beiin ka um uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh nna ka sem ua, Kouma khuta nasemgim in ka um uhi, bawlsiet a ka um chiengun, ka guolzawl ua, ka thuoh paupau uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 18.3"},"13":{"text":"Gensiet a ka um chiengun, ka zawl lungdam ua, koute pen leitung silnieh buohna bang abawlin ka um ua, tu tandongin zong leitunga buathah kidahhuoi sil zousie banga bawl in ka um uhi."},"14":{"text":"Noute hing zumsuo dingin tam silte ka giel sih a, ka ta ittahte bangin kang phawhhil ahi zaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Nouten Khrist ah hing hilmi tulsawm nei nan u’lachin zong, pa tampi na nei sih uhi; aziehpen khantanhoi ziehin Khrist Jesu ah noute kang hingkhie hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka umdan zuimite hi dingin ka hing ngen hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 11.1; Phil. 3.17"},"17":{"text":"Tami zieh main Mangpa a ka ta ittah leh ginum Timothi na kung uah ka hing sawl hi; aman munchina hattuomte ka hil zel bangin, Khrist a ka umdante noute ahing theidohsah kia ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Na kung ua hing peikia nawnlou ding banga hing na ngaituoin pawlkhat nana ki uongsah uhi."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n pha asah leh na kung uah sawt hal louin ka hing haw pai ding hi, tuachi’n aki uongsahte khu athugen uh hilouin, asilbawltheina uh, ka theita ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian gam khu thu ah aum sih a, silbawltheina ah a um zaw hi."},"21":{"text":"Bang ahiei na dei uh? Na kung ua chieng tawi a hing pei ding ka hiei, ahisihleh itna leh lungnemna hagau toh hing pei ding ka hiei?"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Noute lah a kingaina thanghuoi a um hi chi, akigen thang vengvung hi, tambang kingaina Jentelte lah nangawn a um ngailou kingaina thanghuoi, mi khat in apa zi akitenpi chite ahi.","title":"Kingaina thanghuoi leh thununna","ref":"Danp. 22.30"},"2":{"text":"Tambang sil bawlpa khu na lah ua kipat a na nawdoh ding uh lunggimpi nahsangin, nouten na ki uohsahpi zaw uhi."},"3":{"text":"Na lah uah tahsa a ka umlou vangin, hagau in ka um hi, tuabang bawlpa khu na lah ua umbangin atungah vaihawmna ka zouta hi."},"4":{"text":"I Mangpa Jesu Khrist min in, ka hagau leh i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist silbawltheina toh na kikhop khawm chiengun."},"5":{"text":"Tuabang mi pen Mangpa Jesu ni chienga ahagau hundam a aum theina dingin, atahsa suhmang na ding in Setan kunga pieh ding, ka chi hi."},"6":{"text":"Na kisahtheina uh ahoi sih hi. Tol themnoukhat in tanghou beu apum in ajelsuoh chi theilou na hi uoi mah?","ref":"Gal. 5.9"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin tolsawlou tahtah na himabang un, tanghou beu tha na hi theina dingun, tol lui khu paikhe sieng un. Aziehpen i peikan uh Khrist khu akigou zouta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.5"},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin pawi annkuong lui vai, tol lui tatsietna tol leh gitlouna tol toh hilouin, hinanleh gin umna leh thutah tolsawlou toh annkuong ilui zaw ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 13.7; Danp. 16.3"},"9":{"text":"Ka laihah ah, kingaina thanghuoi a kibuolte toh kigop sihun chi’n ka giel hi."},"10":{"text":"Tam leitung kingaina thanghuoi a buol mite, huoihamte, lepgute, ahisihleh milimbete toh, kigop vawtlou ding chi vang ka hisih hi, aziehpen tuabang ding hitaleh leitung apat na pawtdoh uh ngai ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin pen koipou sanggam kichinapi a, kingaina thanghuoi a buol, huoiham, milimbie, miphunsie, zukhamhat leh negu mi, ahi leh, ama pen kigoppi lou dingin na kung uah ka hing giel hi, tuabang mite toh neh zong nekhawm sih un."},"12":{"text":"Pulam mite ken ka ngaikhawhna ding bang a um ei? Asunga um mite hilou i nouten na vaihawmpieh leng uh?","ref":"Danp. 13.5; 17.7"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh pulam a um mite pen Pasian in atung uah thu akhen ding hi. Tuaziehin “Na lah ua kipat in tua migiloupa notdoh un.”"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na lah ua koipou in midang khat toh thubuoi neitaleh; misiengthoute masanga tutlou in, mi dihtatloute masang ah na tut ngam ding uoi mah?","title":"Khristiante dinga kiheh awilou"},"2":{"text":"Misiengthouten leitung thu khen ding ahi uh chi theilou na hi uoi mah? Tualeh leitung vaihawm ding na hi u’leh, sil neupente thukhen dinga tahlou nahi uh amah?"},"3":{"text":"Vansawltahte vaihawm ding ihi chi na thei sih uh amah? Tuabang ahileh tam damsung silte vai ihawm sem sih ding amah?"},"4":{"text":"Tuabang ahileh tam damsung silte thukhen ding na nei chiengun, hattuom ngai a aneupente thukhen dingin na guot uoi leh?"},"5":{"text":"Na zumna dingun ka gen ahi. Na lah uah mipil khat beeh umlou ahiei mah? Khat beh a unaute kikaal a vaihawm thei ding umlou ahiei mah?"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh unau in unau na heh ua, tua zong ginglou mite masangah ahi nalai hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin khat leh khat na kihehtuo uh pen na guollelna lienpi uh ahi. Bangdinga kimawsah zaw mailou na hi uoi? Bangding a zebawlna thuoh zou mailou na hi uoi?"},"8":{"text":"Tuanah sangin nouma mama in adihlou na bawl ua, na zebawl ua, tualeh tam silte na unaute uh tungah na bawl uhi."},"9":{"text":"Midihtatlouten Pasian gam aluo sih ding uh, chi theilou na hi uoi mah? Sol in um sih un. Kingaina thanghuoi a buolte, milimbete, angkawmte, pasal kizuate, tokohuate;"},"10":{"text":"Gutate, huoihamte, zukhamhatte, migensiethatte leh neguten, Pasian gam aluo sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Na lah ua pawlkhat tambang mi na hi ngaita uhi. Hinanleh Mangpa Jesu Khrist min leh i Pasian uh Hagau a sawpsieng na hita ua, suhsiengthou na hita ua, siemtansah na hita uhi."},"12":{"text":"“Kei dingin sil zousie bawl a sienga,” hinanleh sil zousie bawl ahoi kim sih hi; “Kei ding in sil zousie bawl asienga,” hinanleh bangma silbawltheina nuoi ah ka um sih ding hi.","title":"Thangtatna zieh a vauhilna","ref":"1 Kor. 10.23"},"13":{"text":"“Ann pen gilpi a ding ahia, gilpi zong ann a ding ahi,” hinanleh aniin Pasian in asumang ding hi. Tualeh tahsa khu kingaina thanghuoi a ding ahisih a, Mangpa a ding ahi zaw hi, tualeh Mangpa zong tahsa a ding ahi bou hi."},"14":{"text":"Pasian in Mangpa akaithou a, tualeh eite zong a silbawltheina in ahing kaithou ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Na sapumpi uh Khrist hiengte ahi chi theilou na hi uoi mah? Ken Khrist hiengte lain kizuate hiengin ka bawl ding adiei mah? bawl vawt lou ding."},"16":{"text":"Ahisihleh, kizuami toh kizop mi pouma amanu toh pumkhat ahi uh chi theilou na hi uh amah? “Aman ani un, pumkhat ahita dinguh,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 2.24"},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa toh kizop mi pen Ama toh Hagau a pumkhat ahi uhi."},"18":{"text":"Ki ngaina thanghuoi taisan un, mihing khelna zousie pen tahsa pulam ahi, hinanleh kingaina thanghuoi bawl miin ama tahsa tungah sil abawlkhiel ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ahisihleh, na tahsa pumpi uh pen na sung ua um, Pasian akipat a na mu uh Hagau Siengthou inn ahi a, nouma a na hisih uh, chi theilouna hi uoi mah?","ref":"1 Kor. 3.16; 2 Kor. 6.16"},"20":{"text":"Azieh pen man a leisa na hi ta uhi; tuaziehin na tahsapum u’leh na hagau un Pasian pahtawi un tuate Pasian a ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin ka kunga nang laihah uh tungtang thu ah; pasal a dingin numei suhkhahlou ahoi hi.","title":"Nupa hinkhuo"},"2":{"text":"Ahivang in kingaina thanghuoi a umlouna dingin pasal chin in ama zi chiet nei henlen, numei in zong ama pasal chiet nei heh."},"3":{"text":"Pasal in nupa hina a azi tan dinga kilawm azi kung ah pie henlen, tuamabangin azi in zong apasal tan dinga kilawm apasal kungah pie heh."},"4":{"text":"Zi in ama tahsa tungah thu anei sih a, apasal in anei zaw hi, tuamabangin pasal in ama tahsa tung ah thu anei sih a, azi in anei zaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Ann ngawlna leh thungetna a na kipumpieh theina ding ua hun khat pha na sahtuoh uh ahiloungal leh koima kidehtuo sih un, na kideh zoulou zieh ua Setan in ang sol louna dingin hing umkhawm zel un."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh tam thu pen thupieh banga ka gen hilouin phalna thu dan a ka gen ahi zaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi zousie keima bang chiet u’leh ka dei hi. Hinanleh michin in Pasian apat silpieh tuom chiet inei uhi. Mi khat in silpieh khat, midangin silpieh tuom khat anei hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuin zi leh pasal nei nailoute leh meithaite kungah ka gen ahi, Keima bangin um u’leh ama ua ding in ahoi ding hi;"},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh akideh zou sih u’leh, kiteng u’heh, aziehpen hua sangin kiten ahoizaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuin kitengsate kungah thu ka pie hi, kei pieh hilou in Mangpa pieh ahi zaw, ziin apasal taisan sih heh.","ref":"Mat. 5.32; 19.9; Mak. 10.11,12; Luk. 16.18"},"11":{"text":"Ataisan hiel tahleh pasal neilou in umden heh, ahisihleh apasal toh kilem kia u’heh. Tualeh pasal in azi akhul lou ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh midangte kungah, Mangpa gen hilou in Keima’n ka gen ahi; unaupa khat in gingloumi zi a anei a, amanu akunga a umden nuom leh khul sih heh."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh numei in ginglou mi pasal a anei leh apasal akunga a umden nuom leh nuasie sih heh."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen ginglou pasal pen azi ziehin suhsiengthouin aum hi, tuabang hisihleh na tate uh asieng sih ding hi, hinanleh tuin vang asiengthou uhi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh aginglou zaw penin akhen leh khen mai heh. Tambang thu ah unaupa ahiei, unaunu ahiei, kaan in a um sih hi. Hinanleh Pasian in eite kilemtah a um dingin ang han hi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen zi aw na pasal na hundam ding leh dinglou bang na thei ei? ahisihleh pasal in na zi na hundam ding leh dinglou bang na thei ei?"},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in michin kunga ahawmpieh tah bangin, Mangpa’n michin ahat tah bangin, tuabangin um u’heh. Tuabangin kenzong hattuom chin ah ka namdet hi.","title":"Pasian hatna banga um ding"},"18":{"text":"Hat a aum laitah a teptansa mi a um ei? teptanlou hing hi tuom sih heh. Teptan lou hat mi aum ei? Teptan tuom sih heh."},"19":{"text":"Pasian thupieh zui chiloungal teptan bangma ahisih a, Teptanlou zong bangma ahisih hi."},"20":{"text":"Michin hat a aum bangun um chiet uheh."},"21":{"text":"Suoh na hilai a hat na hiei? Khawhsa sin, hinanleh suotatsah thei ding na hileh, tuakhu zangin."},"22":{"text":"Suoh ahilai a Mangpa hat mi pen, Mangpa ah mi noplen ahi. Tuamabangin noplen ahilai a hat zong Khrist suoh ahi."},"23":{"text":"Man a leisa na hi ua, mihing suoh hisih un."},"24":{"text":"Unaute aw, michin hat a aum na bang chiet in, Pasian toh um chiet heh."},"25":{"text":"Tuin nungah siengthoute tungtang ah, Mangpa akipat thupieh ka nei sih hi, hinanleh Pasian in khotuona apieh muonhuoi a abawl mi bangin ka ngaidan ka gen ding hi.","title":"Zi leh pasal nei nailoute a ding"},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin tulai hasatna ziehin pasal a umdan ngai banga aum ahoi dingin ka ngaisut hi."},"27":{"text":"Zi a kaan na hiei mah? Kisutkhiet tum sin, zi apat kisutkhie na hiei? Zi sui sin."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh zi nei na hileh na khiel sih a, nungah siengthou in pasal anei leh akhiel sih hi. Ahivang in tambang miten tahsa a buoina a tuoh ding uhi, hinanleh ken hing awngsut ut ka hi zaw hi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh unaute tam thu ka gen ahi, hun atomta hi, tuachi’n zi neite nangawn zi neilou bangin um henlen,"},"30":{"text":"Kapte kaplou bangin, kipahte kipahlou bangin van leiten, neilou bangin, um henlen,"},"31":{"text":"Tualeh, tam leitung zangte khu zangvallou bangin um heh. Tam leitung umdan pen abeimang ngitnget ahi bou hi."},"32":{"text":"Ken noute lunghimawna neilou a na um uh Kang dei hi zi neilou pasal in Mangpa akipahsah theina dingin, Mangpa lam silte a awlmaw leng hi."},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh zi neisa pasal in pen, azi akipahsah theina dingin, leitung silte a awlmaw zel hi."},"34":{"text":"Pasal neisa numei leh nungah siengthou zong akibang sih hi. Pasal neilou numeiin, tahsa leh hagau a asienthou theina dingin, Mangpa lam silte a awlmaw hi. Hinanleh pasal neisa numei in pen apasal akipahsah theina dingin leitung silte a awlmaw zel hi."},"35":{"text":"Tam thute na phattuompi ding ua ka gen ahi. Na tung ua thukham bawl ka hisih a, hinanleh umdan kilawm a na um theina ding u’leh, Mangpa nna buoilou a nasep theina ding ua ka gen ahizaw hi."},"36":{"text":"Hinanleh mi koipou in ata nungah siengthou akul donga alensah a atunga dihlou akisah a, apasal nei ding hoi asah leh, hoi asah bangbang in bawl heh, akhiel sih hi, pasal neisah mai heh."},"37":{"text":"Ahivang in mi koipou lungsim dettah nei a, apoimawna neilou a, ama lungsim kithunun zou a, ata nungah siengthou kem dinga alungtang a, tupna nei mi in abawl hoi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuachi’n ata nungah pasal neisahpan abawl hoi hi, hinanleh pasal neisahloupa’n abawl hoizaw hi."},"39":{"text":"Zi pen apasal dam sungsie dan a kaan ahi, hinanleh apasal ashi leh Mangpa aum mi, a dei khat poupou akitenpi thei hi."},"40":{"text":"Hinanleh kei ngaituo dan in, amanu aum ngai bangin pasal neilou in um leh nuom asa zaw ding hi; tualeh Kei zong Pasian Hagau nei in ka kingai hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin milimte biehna sillatte tungtang pen “I unpi un theina inei chiet uh” chi ithei uhi. “Theina” in mi akisathei sah a, hinanleh itna in mi abawl hoi hi.","title":"Kithoina sa neh thu a kihilna"},"2":{"text":"Mi koipou in bang ahiei khat thei a akingaisut leh athei ding bang thei nailou ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh mi koipou in Pasian a it leh tua mipa khu Pasian thei in a um hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaziehin milim biehna kithoina sillatte neh lam thu ah, “Leitungah milim kichi bangma ahisih a,” tualeh “Pasian khat loungal adang a um sih,” chi ithei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Van ah hiin leitungah hitaleh pasien kichite um nan u’leh (tuabang “pasien” tampi leh “mangpa” tampi a um uhi)."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh eite adingin Pasian khat bou a um a, Ama pen sil zousie hing kipatna Pa ahi. Eite Ama a um ihi ua, Mangpa khat Jesu Khrist a um hi, Ama ziehin sil zousie ahing um a, eite zong Ama zieh a um ihi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Bangtenghileh, theina khu mi zousie ah aum kim sih a, kimkhat in tu tanin milimte angaisang mama ua, milimte kunga kithoina sillatte ane ua, asie leh pha theina uh ahatlou zieh in akibua sah zel uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh ann neh in Pasian pahtat ahing lawsah sih a, ineh ziehun i hoizaw uh ahi sih a, inehlou zieh un zong ise zaw tuom sih uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh pilvang un, tuachilouin pen na noplenna uh bangchi ahiei in, mi hatloute adingin puana ahing hikha ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen theina nei nang, mi koi ahiei in, milim biehna inn a ann ne dinga na tou lai hing mu taleh, ama sie leh pha theina hatlou khu milim biehna kithoina sillatte ne dingin maingalsah khalou ding na hiei mah?"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n na theina ziehin unau hatlou ama shi taanga Khrist shina khu, amangthang ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh tambanga na unaute uh tunga na khel ua; asie leh pha theina hatlou uh na liemsah khah chiengun, Khrist tunga khiel na suoh uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin, ka ann neh in ka unau akipalpuasah leh ka unau ka pua sah louna dingin bangchih tan in sa mawngmawng ka ne nawn sih ding hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sawltah hilou ka hiei mah? Noplen hilou ka hiei mah? Ken i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist ka mu sih amah? Noute Mangpa a ka nasepga hilou na hi uoi mah?","title":"Paul in ama etton dinga genna"},"2":{"text":"Midangte a dingin sawltah hisih nanleng, noute a dingin vang ka hi thamtham hi. Mangpa a sawltah ka hina chiemtena noute na hi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Kei hing enkhete kunga ka dawnna khu tami ahi."},"4":{"text":"Koute neh ding leh dawn ding tungtang thuneina neilou ka hi uoi mah?"},"5":{"text":"Sawltah dangte leh Mangpa unaute leh kipha banga gingta mi zi khat zawpi kawikawi theilou ka hi tuom uoi mah?"},"6":{"text":"Ahisihleh Barnaba leh kei guoh ka nasepna ua pat ki awngsut theilou ka hi uoi mah?"},"7":{"text":"Galkap koi ahiei ama neisa senga galkap a kuon ngai? Grep huon bawl a, aga ne lou koi a um ei? Ahisihleh koi ahiei ganhon khawi ngal a anawi ne lou?"},"8":{"text":"Mihing ngaisut dan a tam thute gen ka hiei mah? Dan thuin zong tambangma hilou amah agen?"},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen Mosi dan laibu ah “Bawngtal in bu achil lai in amuh kaan sin,” chi’n akigiel hi. Pasian in bawngtalte bou ahiei a awlmaw?","ref":"Danp. 25.4; 1 Tim. 5.18"},"10":{"text":"Ahisihleh Aman eite a ding zieh mama a agen hilou ahiei mah? Hitham e, tami eite adinga kigiel ahi; loukai miin kinem tahin akai dinga, tualeh kinem taha bu vawmi in zong akinepna amu ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Kouten noute kunga hagau lam haichi ka tu u’leh, na tahsa lam silte uh at ta u’leng sil thupi ahi diei mah?","ref":"Rom. 15.27"},"12":{"text":"Midangten na tung ua tam thuneina anei u’leh kouten neizawsem louding ka hi uoi mah? Ahivang in tam thuneina ka zang sih uhi, hinanleh Khrist khantanhoi ka dal louna dingun sil bangkim ka thuoh zaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"Sil siengthou a biehna nasemten, biehinn a silte ane ua, tualeh maitam a nasemten maitam a silte ah tan anei uh chi na thei sih uh amah?","ref":"Danp. 18.1"},"14":{"text":"Tuabangmain khantanhoi gen mite pen, khantanhoi ma a ahin ding uh chi’n Mangpa’n thu apie hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.10; Luk. 10.7"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh ken tam silte khatbeh ka zang sih hi, tualeh tam silte ka tungah kibawl leh chia giel zong ka hisih hi, mi koi ahiei in ka kisahtheinapen bangmalou asuo sangin kei dingin shi ahoizaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Khantanhoi gen nanleng kisahtheipi ding bangma ka nei sih hi; genlou theilou ka tunga kinga ahi ziehin, khantanhoi gen sih leng ka tung gih ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen tam sil keima ut thu a bawl hileng, kipahman mu ding ka nei hi, hinanleh ka ut thu lou a bawl ka hileh, kepna nna kei hing kingansie ahi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuahileh ka kipahman bang ahi diei? Khantanhoi ka gen chienga, khantanhoi a ka thuneina zangkhiel lou a, Khrist khantanhoi amanbei a ka pieh khu ka kipahman ahi."},"19":{"text":"Mi zousie akipat noplen hinapi in, mi tamsem ka lahlut theina dingin mi zousie suohin ka kibawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Judate ka lahlut theina dingin, Judate lah ah Judami bangin ka um a, dan nuoi a umte ka lahlut theina dingin, dan nuoi a umte lah ah dan nuoi a um bangin ka um hi."},"21":{"text":"Dan neiloute ka lahlut theina dingin, dan neiloute lah ah dan neiloute bangin ka um hi. Pasian lam ah pen dan neilou ka hisih a, Khrist dan nuoi a um ka hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahatloute ka lahlut theina dingin mi hatloute lah ah ahatlou bangin ka um hi, bangchi ahiei a, mi bangza ahiei beeh ka hundam theina dingin, mi zousie lah ah, sil bangkim ka hita hi."},"23":{"text":"Noute toh khantanhoi guolzawlna ka tan theina dingin, khantanhoi ziehin tami ka bawl ahi."},"24":{"text":"Kitaidemna ah kidemte zousie atai ua, hinanleh mi khat maimai in kipahman amu hi, chi na thei sih uh amah? Tua kipahman namu theina dingun tai un.","title":"Gingtute kitaidemna"},"25":{"text":"Mi koipou kipahman sang dinga kidemna a pang mite sil zousie ah ama leh ama akithunun uhi. Amauten guolzawna lukhu sethei sang ding in apang ua, eite pen in asetheilou guolzawna lukhu sang dingin ipang uhi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaziehin kei pen tupna neilou a tai ka hisih a, mi toh ka kisuh chiengin aguohtangpi su ka hisih hi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh ka tahsa ka thunun a, ka thuzawna nuoi ah ka koi hi tuachilou in pen midangte kunga khantanhoi ka gen nuain keima nasan chingzoulou in ka umkha ding hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuathamlouin unaute aw, tam thu nathei lou uh ka dei sih hi; ipu ipate a unpi un meipi nuoi ah ana um ua, tualeh a unpi un tuipi kaan in apeisuoh uhi;","title":"Israelte apat kithuhilna","ref":"Pawt. 13.21,22; Pawt. 14.22-29"},"2":{"text":"a unpi un meipi lah ah leh tuipi sungah Mosi kungah baptis in aum ua,"},"3":{"text":"tualeh a unpi un hagau lam ann kibang ane ua,","ref":"Pawt. 16.35"},"4":{"text":"a unpi un hagau lam dawn kibang adawn chiet ua, amaute zuitu hagau lam suongpi akipat adawn chiet uhi, tua suongpi khu Khrist ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 17.6; Kisim. 20.11"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh alah ua mi tampite tungah Pasian alungkimta sih a, gamdai ah apualum gamta uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 14.29,30"},"6":{"text":"Tam silte eite adinga i etton ding uh ahi, amaun silgilou alunggul bang ua, eiten ilunggul louna dingun.","ref":"Kisim. 11.4"},"7":{"text":"Alah ua kimkhatte milim bemi ahi bangun, milim bemi hisih un; “Mipite ne ding leh dawn dingin atousuh ua, tualeh nuomtal a laam dingin ading doh uh,” chi a kigiel bangin.","ref":"Pawt. 32.6"},"8":{"text":"Alah ua pawlkhat numei pasal kaal ah a thangtat ua, ni khat in tulsawmni leh thum a shi bang un eite thangtat sih vai.","ref":"Kisim. 25.1-18"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh alah ua pawlkhat in Mangpa a ze et ua gul a suhmanga aum bangun eiten vang Khrist i ze et sih ding uhi.","ref":"Kisim. 21.5,6"},"10":{"text":"A lah ua pawlkhat aphun ua, sumangtu suhmang a aum bangun, eite phun sih vai.","ref":"Kisim. 16.41-49"},"11":{"text":"Tamte zousie pen etton dingin atung uah ana tung hi, tualeh eite leitung huntawp hing tunnate kunga thuhilna dinga kigiel ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin dinga kingaituo mi pilvang heh, tuachilou in pen apua kha ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Mihing thuohzoulou solna na tung uah atung ngai nai sih, hinanleh Pasian amuonhuoi hi, Aman na thuoh zoulou uh solna na tuoh ding uh aphal sih ding hi; na thuohzouna ding un solna apat suotatna lampi ahing bawlpieh zaw ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka ittahte aw, milim biehna taisan un.","title":"Milim biehna annkuong leh Mangpa annkuong"},"15":{"text":"Mipilte thugen bangin ka gen ahi, ka thugen ngaituo un."},"16":{"text":"Guolzawlna nou iguolzawl u’khu Khrist sisan itankhawmna uh hilou ahiei mah? Tanghou ibalkeh u’khu Khrist tahsa itankhawmna uh hilou ahiei mah?","ref":"Mat. 26.26-28; Mak. 14.22-24; Luk. 22.19,20"},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen eite tampi hinapi in tanghou khat tualeh sapum khat ihi uhi, aziehpen tua tanghou pheng khat ah tan inei chiet uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tahsa dan a Israelte en un, kithoina sa nete, maitam toh tan neikhawmte ahisih uh amah?","ref":"Siempu. 7.6"},"19":{"text":"Ahileh bang ahiei ka gen? Milim khu sil bang ahiei khat ahia, ahisihleh milim biehna sil kilante khu sil bang ahiei khat ahi ka china ahiei mah?"},"20":{"text":"Jentelten kithoina sil alatte uh Pasian kunga lat hilou in dawite kunga lat ahi, ka china ahi, tualeh noute dawite toh na kipawlkhawm uh ka dei sih hi.","ref":"Danp. 32.17"},"21":{"text":"Mangpa nou leh dawite nou na dawnkhawm thei sih ding uh, Mangpa annkuong leh setan annkuong zong na nekhawm thei sih ding uhi."},"22":{"text":"Ahisihleh Mangpa thangsietna a lungthahsah ding ihi uh amah? Ama sanga hatzaw ihi uoi mah?","ref":"Danp. 32.21"},"23":{"text":"“Sil zousie kei a dingin asienga,” hinanleh sil zousie aphatuom kim sih hi, “Kei a dingin sil zousie asienga,” hinanleh silzousie in abawl hoi tuom sih hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 6.12"},"24":{"text":"Mi koiman ama hoina ding ngen sui sih henlen, midangte hoina ding sui chiet zaw heh."},"25":{"text":"Sa kizuana mun a, kizua sate, na sie leh pha theina uh dong sese louin ne un."},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen “Leitung leh asunga um zousie Mangpa a ahi.”","ref":"Late. 24.1"},"27":{"text":"Ginglou mite lah a koi ahiei khat in, ann ne ding a ahing chiel a, haw ding na lunggul u’leh, na masang ua kilui pouma na sie leh pha theina zieh uh dong sese lou in ne un."},"28":{"text":"Hinanleh mi koi ahiei khat in, “Tam pen milim kunga kithoina sa ahi” chi a ahing hil leh, ahing hilpa zieh leh sie leh pha theina ziehin ne sih un."},"29":{"text":"Nangma sie leh pha theina ka gen ahisih a, midang sie leh pha theina gen ka hi zaw hi. Aziehpen midang sie leh pha theinain bang dinga ka noplenna hing awimaw ding ahiei?"},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh Ken lungdamna toh ka neh leh, bangdinga kipahthu ka gen zieh a gensiet a um ka hiei?"},"31":{"text":"Tuaziehin na neh un hileh na dawn un hileh, na bawl pouma uh Pasian thupina dingin bawl un."},"32":{"text":"Judate ahiei, Greekte ahiei, ahisihleh Pasian hattuomte hitaleh apuana dingun bangma bawl sih un."},"33":{"text":"Ken sil bangkim ka bawlna ah, mi zousie lungkim sah ding ka tup bangin, keima phattuomna ding guoh suilou in, hundam ahi theina dingun, mi tampite phattuomna ding ka sui zaw hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei Khrist umdan lapa ka hi bangin, noute ka umdan late hi un.","title":"Hattuomte kikhopna numeite um dingdan","ref":"1 Kor. 4.16; Phil. 3.17"},"2":{"text":"Unaute aw sil bangkim a kei na hing thei ngitnget zieh u’leh, thugousie ka hing hilte na kep ngitnget zieh un noute ka hing pahta hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh pasal pouma lutang Khrist ahia, numei lutang pasal ahi, tualeh Khrist lutang Pasian ahi chi, nouten na thei uh ka dei hi."},"4":{"text":"Lutang khu puma pasal thungen ahiei, ahisihleh, thugen ahieiin alutang azatat lou ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh numei in alutang khulou a, thungen ahiei ahisihleh thugen ahiei pouma in, alutang azatat lou ahi, aziehpen tuabanga bawlmi pen asam heukieu toh kibang ahi."},"6":{"text":"Numei in alutang akhu sih leh, asam heukieu heh; hinanleh numei a dinga sam heu ahiei, ahisihleh heukieu ahiei azumhuoi leh alutang khu heh."},"7":{"text":"Pasal in pen alutang akhu lou ding mawng ahi, ama pen Pasian lim leh mel pua leh thupina ahi; numei ahileh pen pasal thupina ahi.","ref":"Siem. 1.26,27"},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen pasal khu numei apat a siem ahisih a, numei pen pasal apat a siem ahi.","ref":"Siem. 2.18-23"},"9":{"text":"Pasal pen numei a dinga siem ahisih a, numeipen pasal a dinga siem ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tamte ziehin numei in pasal thuneina chiemtena vansawlsiengte ziehin, alutang akhu ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahivang in Mangpa ah pasal lou in numei atangin a um thei sih a, pasal numei lou in atangin a um thei sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen numei pen pasal apat siem ahimabangin pasal zong numei akipat a pieng ahi, hinanleh sil zousie Pasian a kipata hing pieng ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nouma leh nouma ki ngaituo un, numei in alutang khu loua, Pasian kunga thungetna anei akilawm ei mah?"},"14":{"text":"Pasal in asam akhawisau leh ama a dingin azumhuoi ahi chi ngaina dan in zong ahing hil sih amah?"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh numei in asam akhawisau leh ama a dingin thupina ahizaw hi, aziehpen asam khu alutang khuna dinga pieh ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh mi koi ahiei in aniel ut leh, tambang tawndan inei sih ua, Pasian hattuomten zong anei sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tu a tam thute ka hing hilna ah noute ka hing phat thei sih hi; noute na kikhop chieng un hoizohna ding hilouin sietzoh semna dingin na kikhawm zel uhi.","title":"Mangpa nitah ann neh thu ahilna"},"18":{"text":"Amasapen in hattuoma na kikhop chiengun, na lah uah kilangkhenna aum hi chi ka za a, tualeh gin zong ka gingta hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen atahtah a kipomte akilat theina ding un, na lah uah kilangkhenna a um ding mawng ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin mun khat a nang kikhop chieng ua, na neh u’pen Mangpa nitah ann ahi sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen na neh chiengun, michin in, midangte neh masangin nouma nitah ann na kineh chiet ua, tuachi’n khat agilkiel a, midangin zu akham hi."},"22":{"text":"Bangchidan ahiei, nouten nehna ding leh dawnna ding inn neilou na hi uoi mah? Ahisihleh Pasian hattuom na simmaw un bangma neiloute na selphou uh ahiei mah? Na kung ua bang ahiei ka gen ding? Tam thu ah noute ka hing pahta ding amah? Kang pahta vawt sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa a kipat a ka mu khu noute ka hing hilsawn ahi, tuachia Mangpa Jesu matsah a aum zanin tanghou ala-a;"},"24":{"text":"kipahthu agen zouin aphalsuo a, la unlen ne un, “Tami noute a dinga kiphalsuo ka tahsa ahi, na hing thei ngitnget na dingun bawl zel un,” achi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachimabangin nitah ann a neh zouin, nou zong ala a, “Tam nou ka sisan a thuhun tha ahi, na dawn teng ua na hing thei ngitnget na dingun, tami bawl zel un,” achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 24.8; Jer. 31.31-34; Pawt. 24.6-8"},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen tam tanghou na neh ua, tam nou nadawn tengun, ahing peikia masangsie Mangpa shina na phuongzah uh ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaziehin mi koipouin chingloupi a, Mangpa tanghou ne leh nou dawn khu, Mangpa tahsa leh sisan tungah siemmaw atang ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Mi ama leh ama ki en chien zaw heh, tuachi’n tanghou khu ne henlen nou khu dawn heh."},"29":{"text":"Koipouin Mangpa tahsa ngaituo lou a, ne tahlou leh dawn tahloupi a, aneh a adawn leh ama leh ama siemmaw kitanna dingin ane in adawn ahi."},"30":{"text":"Tami ziehin na lah ua mi tampi na zawngkhal ua na china uhi, tualeh tampi na imuta uhi."},"31":{"text":"Ei ma leh eima’n thukhen in ki en chien masa lei, thukhen pieh a umlou ding ihi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh thukhenpieh a i um in zong, leitung mite toh siemmawtanga i umlouna dingin Mangpa vauhil in i um uhi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaziehin unaute aw, ne dinga na hing kikhop chiengun khat leh khat kingah chiet un."},"34":{"text":"Hinanleh na kikhopna uh siemmawtan a aumlouna dingin, mi koipou agil akiel leh a inn lamah ne heh, thudangte pen ka hing pei chiengin kang hil ding hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Unaute aw, tuin Hagau lam silpiehte tungtang theiloua na um ding uh ka dei sih hi.","title":"Hagau silpieh tungtanga hilna"},"2":{"text":"Noute Jentelte na hi lai un, puia na um bang zel ua, a ham theilou milimte lam a puimangin na um uh, chi na thei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin noute ka hing theisah ahi, Pasian Hagau a thugen koima’n “Jesu hamse thuoh ahi” achi ngai sih hi, tualeh Hagau Siengthou louin koima’n Jesu khu “Mangpa” ahi achi thei ngai sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuin silpieh tuom tuom a um a, hinanleh Hagau khat ahi.","title":"Silpieh tuom tuom","ref":"Rom. 12.6-8"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh nasep tuomtuom a um a, hinanleh Mangpa khat ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nasepdan tuom tuom a um a, hinanleh bangkim a bangkim nasempa kibang Pasian khat ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh phattuom chietna dingin michin kungah Hagau nasep kilahna pieh chiet a hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi khat kungah Hagau a pilna thu pieh ahi a, midang kungah tua Hagau main theina thu apie hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua Hagau main midang kungah ginna apie a, midang kungah tua Hagau main suhdam theina silpieh apieh hi;"},"10":{"text":"Midang kungah sillamdang bawltheina pieh ahia, midang kungah thugen theina pieh ahi; midang kungah Hagaute theikhen theina pieh ahi a, midang kungah ham tuomtuom a thugentheina pieh ahi, midang kungah ham tuomtuomte ledohtheina pieh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh tuate zousie khu Hagau khat main, Ama deina bangin mimal chinteng kungah hawmin asem hi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen tahsa pumpi khat ahia, hieng tampi anei hi, hieng zousiete tam nan u’leh sapum khat ahi uhi, tuamabangin, Khrist zong tuabang ahi.","title":"Silpiehte poimawna","ref":"Rom. 12.4,5"},"13":{"text":"Eite i unpiun Hagau khat in tahsapum khat ah ahing baptis lut hi; Juda mite hiin, Greek mite hitaleh, suoh hiin, noplen hitaleh, a unpi un Hagau khat ma a dawnsah in iumta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tahsapum pen hieng khat guoh ahi sih a, hieng tampi ahizaw uhi."},"15":{"text":"“Keng in kei khut ka hilou ziehin tahsa ah ka pang sih chitaleh,” tua achi ziehin tahsa panglou ahi diei?"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh bil in “Mit ka hilou ziehin tahsa a pang ka hi sih chitaleh,” tua achi ziehin tahsa a panglou ahi diei?"},"17":{"text":"Tahsa pumpi khu mit hisiengta leh khozahna hei ah aumta diei? Apumpi in khozahna hi sieng taleh, gimnam theina hei ah a um ta diei?"},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in ahieng chinteng tahsa tunga adeina mun mun ah akoi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tualeh a unpi un hieng khat hita mawh u’leh tahsa hei ah a umta diei?"},"20":{"text":"Tuin pen hieng tampi hinan u’leh tahsapum khat asuoh uhi."},"21":{"text":"Mit in khut kungah, “Nang kang poimaw sih” achi thei sih a, lutangin zong keng kung ah “Nang kang tulmaw sih” achi thei tuom sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuachi nahsangin ahatlou zaw a kilang tahsa hiengte apoimaw penpente ahi zaw uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tahsa hieng ngaisah thamlou a ingaisutte zatatna thupizaw i piehte ahi zaw uhi, tualeh itahsa hieng bangmathamlou a i ngaiten nahpitah in kilawmna anei zaw uhi."},"24":{"text":"I hieng kilawmten tuabang akiphamaw sih uhi. Hinanleh Pasian in apoimaw thamlou hiengte khu zatatna lien zaw piein tahsapumpi alemkhawm hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachia tahsa kikhenna a umlouna dingin, hiengte khat leh khat kibanga aki-awlmawtuo chiet theina ding uh ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tahsa hieng khat in athuoh leh hieng zousiein athuohkhawm zel ua, tualeh hieng khat pahtat a a um leh hieng zousie ama toh akipahkhawm chiet uhi."},"27":{"text":"Tuin noute Khrist tahsa na hi ua, amimal mal in ahiengte na hi chiet uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in kimkhatte hattuom ah ahing koi a, amasapen in sawltahte, anina ah guolneite, athumna ah thuhilmite, tuaban ah sillamdang bawl mite, tuazou chiengin suhdam na silpieh neite, midang panpi theinate, vaihawm siemnate, ham tuom tuom a hamtheinate aguot hi.","ref":"Eph. 4.11"},"29":{"text":"Aunpi un sawltahte ahi uoi? A unpi un guolnei ahi uoi? Aunpi un thuhil mite ahi uoi? Aunpi un sil lamdang bawlmite a hi uoi?"},"30":{"text":"A unpi un suhdam theina silpiehte nei ahi uoi? A unpi un ham theilou in thu agen uoi? Aunpi un ham theilou alet thei uoi?"},"31":{"text":"Hinanleh silpieh hoi pente lunggul zaw un, tuachi’n lampi hoizaw ka hing musah ding hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihing hamte leh vansawlsieng hamte in thu gen nanleeng itna ka nei sih leh dah ging ahisih leh dahkhubeh ging ahiei bang ka hi giap ding hi.","title":"Silpieh lah a lienpen itna"},"2":{"text":"Thumavang gentheina silpieh nei in, thuguh kiphuolte zousie leh theina zousie thei sieng nan leng, tualeh muol leh taangte kisuontheina khop ginna nei nanleng, itna ka nei sih leh bangma ka hi sih hi.","ref":"Mat. 17.20; 21.21; Mak. 11.23"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ka nei zousie mi gentheite vana dingin pe siengin, tualeh ka tahsa haltum dingin pengam nanleng zong, itna ka nei sihleh bangma aphatuom sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Itna in athuoh zou a, anunnem hi, Itna in athangse sih a, itna akisiel sih a, aki uongsah sih a,"},"5":{"text":"Agumtat sih a, ahuoiham sih a, alungthah bai sih a, silgilou angaituo ngai sih a,"},"6":{"text":"Dihtatlounate akipahpi sih a, hinanleh thutah akipahpi zaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Itna in sil zousie athuohsiem a, silzousie agingta a, sil zousie ah akinema, sil zousie athuoh muolsuo hi."},"8":{"text":"Itna abei ngai sih ding hi. Hinanleh thumavang gente um nanleh abei ding hi; ham theiloute ahing tawp ding a, theinate um nanleh ahing mang ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Eiten akim lou a ithei zieh un, akimlou in igen uhi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh abukimna ahing tun chiengin akimlou khu suhbei ahita ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka naupan lai in, naupang ham in ka ham a, naupang thei in ka thei a, naupang ngaituoin ka ngaituo hi. Hinanleh ka hing pichin bepin naupanlai silte ka paita hi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen tuin himlanga et bangin, chienglou milmiel in imu ua, hinanleh tua hun chiengin vang kimaituo in imuta ding uhi, tuin pen akimlou in ka thei a, hinanleh tua hun chiengin vang kei hing kithei bangin ka theita ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua leh tuin, ginna, kinepna leh itna, tamteng thum a umden hi, hinanleh tamteng lah a alien pen itna ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Itna del unlen, tualeh Hagau silpiehte adiehin thumavang gen theina lunggul un.","title":"Thumavang gen theina leh ham theilou silpiehte"},"2":{"text":"Ham theilou a ham miin mihingte kunga thugen ahisih a, Pasian kunga thugen ahi zaw hi. Koima’n ama atheisiem sih hi, hinanleh Hagau in thuguh kiphuolte agen hi."},"3":{"text":"Thumavang gen miin pen mihingte kungah, siemphatna ding, hanthawnna ding leh hamuonnading thute agen hi."},"4":{"text":"Ham theilou a thugen mi, ama leh ama akisiemhoi a, hinanleh thumavang gen miin, hattuom asiemhoi hi."},"5":{"text":"Na unpi ua ham theiloua na ham uh kang deisah a, hinanleh thumavang na gen thei uh ka hing deisah sem hi; hattuom siemhoina dinga ledoh ahi sih leh, ham theiloua ham sangin thumavang gen mi ahoizaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuin unaute ham theilou a thugen in na kung uah hing peita leng, kilahnain ahiei, theinain ahiei, thumavang gentheinain ahiei, ahisihleh, thuhilnain ahiei, na kung uah, gen sih leng noute bangin ka hing phatuom sah diei?"},"7":{"text":"Hinna neilou sil gingtheite theile ahiei, ahisihleh kaiging ahiei zong umzie nei a agin sih leh bang kimut a, bang kitum ahiei chi, bang achi kithei diei?"},"8":{"text":"Pengkul pen mumal bei in kimut gingta leh koi ahiei gal kuon dinga kisa ding?"},"9":{"text":"Tuamabangin noutenzong ham kithei bailam zanga thu na gen sih u’leh, bang kigen ahiei chi bang achi kithei diei? hui lah a ham bang giap na hi ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Leitungah ham chi tuom tuom tampi a um hi, hinanleh gen neilou ham a um sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin ham a thu kigen bang genna ahiei chi ka thei sih leh tua thugenpa adingin kei hammahpa ka hi dinga, ama zong kei a ding in gamtuom mi hammahpa ahi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuabangmain hagau lam silpiehte na lunggul bangun, hattuom bawlhoina dinga, na hing khantou theina ding uh sui un."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin ham theiloua thugen miin aledoh theina dingin thungen heh."},"14":{"text":"Ham theiloua thu ka nget leh ka hagau in zong thu angen a, hinanleh ka theina khu agasuo tuom sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahileh bang ka law ta diei leh? Hagau in thu ka ngen dinga, lungsim a theina in zong thu ka ngen ding hi. Hagau in la kasa dinga tualeh lungsim atheinain zong kasa ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachilouin Hagau a guolzawlna na gen chiengin bangma theilou miin, na kipahthu gen ah bangchi’n “Amen,” achithei diei? aman na thugen athei loupi."},"17":{"text":"Nangman kipahthu na hoi gen ngel a, hinanleh midang a bawlhoi tuom sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Noute zousie sanga ham theilou a thu kagen tam zawh ziehin ka Pasian kungah kipahthu ka gen hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahivang in hattuom sunga ham theiloua thu tul sawm ka gen sangin, ka thugen a midangte ka hil theina dingin ka theisiemna toh thu teng nga ka gen zaw ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Unaute aw, na ngaituona uah naupang sih unlen, gitlouna lam ah naungeh un, theisiemna lam ah piching un."},"21":{"text":"Dan laibu sungah: “Ham dang mite leh, gamdang mite ham in, tam mite kungah thu ka gen dinga, hinanleh ka thugen angaikhe, tuom sih ding uhi; Mangpa’n chi hi.” Chiin akigel hi.","ref":"Isai. 28.11,12"},"22":{"text":"Tuaziehin ham theilou khu, gingtute a ding hilou in, agingtalou mite a ding a chiemtena ahi, hinanleh thumavang gen pen agingta lou mite a ding hilou in, agingta mite a ding ahi zaw hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin hattuom pumpi mun khat a na kikhopna uah, mi zousie ham theilouin hamta u’lachin, tualeh tua mun ah athei nailou leh ginglou mi hing tel taleh noute mi maw ahing chi sih ding uh amah?"},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh mi zousie’n thumavang gen chietta u’lachin tuanah ginglou mi ahiei ahisihleh atheilou mi khat hing pei leh agitloudan na unpi ua theisah in aumta dinga na unpi ua awimaw ahing hita ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuachi’n alungtang thuguhte suhlat in a um ding a, tuachi’n khupboh a puain Pasian abe dinga, na lah uah Pasian a um tahtah na hi chiin aphuong ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Unaute aw, bangchi ahita diei le? Noute na hing kikhop chiengun, michin in phatna la bang, thukihilna bang, ham theilou bang, kilahna bang, ham theiloute ledohna bang, na nei chiet uhi. Sil zousie bawlhoina dinga bawl hi heh.","title":"Pasian biehna a thugen danding"},"27":{"text":"Mi koipou in ham theiloua thu agen leh mi ni ahiei, ahisihleh atam pen in thum in gen heh, tua zong khat khat in kiha zel u’henlen, khat in letdoh heh."},"28":{"text":"Alet ding mi a um sih leh hattuom kikhopna ah ham louin sip khinkhien heh, alungsim in ama leh Pasian kungah kigen heh."},"29":{"text":"Thumavang gente ni ahiei thum ahiei in gen henlen, midangten thu kigente ngaituo chien uheh."},"30":{"text":"Hinanleh akunga tou midang khat kunga kilahna ahing tun leh thugen masa pen sip heh."},"31":{"text":"Mi zousie in athei a, kihanthawn a aum theina ding un, na unpi un khat khat a kiha in thu na gen thei uhi."},"32":{"text":"Tualeh thumavang gente Hagau khu thumavang gente thuthu in aum uhi."},"33":{"text":"Pasian pen buoina Pasian ahi sih a, lemna Pasian ahi zaw hi. Misiengthoute hattuom zousie a ahi bangin;"},"34":{"text":"Na numeite uh hattuom sungte ah sip dide in um uheh, ama ua dingin thugen phal ahi sih hi, danin zong agen bangin, thunuoiluta a um zoh ding uh ahi."},"35":{"text":"Amauten bang ahiei thei nuom anei u’leh inn lam ah apasalte uh dong uheh, hattuom sunga thugen numei a dingin azum huoi ahi."},"36":{"text":"Pasian thu noute apat hing kipan ahiei mah? Ahisihleh noute maimai hing banpha ahiei mah?"},"37":{"text":"Mi koipouin guolnei ahiei, ahisihleh Hagau silpieh nei a hagaumi a akingaituo leh na kung ua kang gelte Mangpa thupieh ahi chi thei u’heh."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh mi koi zong atheilou a um leh, atheilou in um mai heh."},"39":{"text":"Tuaziehin unaute aw, thumavang gen lunggul unlen, ham theilou a ham zong khaam sih un."},"40":{"text":"Sil zousie hoitah leh kitup tah a bawl hi heh."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin unaute aw, na kung ua ka khantanhoi gen khu na pomta ua, tuama ah na dingkip uhi, chi ka hing theisah hi.","title":"Khristiante thawkiana thu"},"2":{"text":"Na kung ua ka thugen na pomdet u’leh tuami mama ah hundam zong na hi uhi, tuachi ahisihleh pen amawhna a gingta na hi ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Amasapen in ken zong ka mu khu noute kungah ka hing hil sawn ahi; tua pen Laisiengthou gen bangin Khrist khu ikhelnate ziehin ashi a,","ref":"Isai. 53.5-12"},"4":{"text":"Vui in a um a, Laisiengthou gen bangin nithum niin athoukiata hi.","ref":"Late. 16.8-10; Mat. 12.40; Nasep. 2.24-32"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kipha kungah akilah a, tuazouin sawm le nite kungah akilah hi.","ref":"Luk. 24.34; Mat. 28.16,17; Mak. 16.14; Luk. 24.36; Jn. 20.19"},"6":{"text":"Tuami nuain sanggam za nga sanga tamzawte kungah khatvei thuin akilah a, alah ua atamzawte tutan in adam na lai ua, hinanleh kimkhattepen a imuta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuami nuain Jakob kungah akilah a, tua zouin sawltah zousiete kungah akilah hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh atawpna pen ah ahunlou a pieng kei kungah zong akilah hi.","ref":"Nasep. 9.3-6"},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen sawltahte lah a aneupen ka hi a, Pasian hattuomte ka bawl genthei ziehin sawltah chitaah zong ka hi sih hi.","ref":"Nasep. 8.3"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian hepina ziehin ka hina bangbang ka hi hi ding ka hita, tualeh A hepina hing pieh khu athawn in a um sih hi. Hinanleh amaute zousie sangin ka sem gim zaw hi, hinanleh kei sep ahi sih a, Pasian hepina ka kunga um in asep ahi zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin kei hiin amaute hitaleh khantanhoi ka gen ua, tuachi’n nouten na gingta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuin mishite lah a kipat Khrist kaithawin a umta chi akigen ngal leh, bangchi dana na lah ua mi pawl khat in mishi thawkiana aum sih na chi uh ahiei?","title":"Mishite thawkiana"},"13":{"text":"Mishite thawkiana ana umlou hitaleh, Khrist zong kaithawin a um sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Khrist thoukia lou na hitaleh pen ka thugen uh amawhna ahi dinga, na ginna uh zong amawhna ahi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi, Pasian in Khrist akaithou hi chia, Pasian theipi mi hi a thu ka gen ziehun, koute Pasian theipi mi dihlou bangin ka kilangta uhi; mishite thoukialou ana hitaleh Pasian in Khrist zong akaithou sih ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen mishite thoukia lou hileh Khrist zong kaithouin aum sih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Khrist kaithoua na umlou hitaleh, na ginna uh amawhna ahi dinga, na khelna uah na um nalai ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n Khrist a na imusate amangthang ahita ding uhi."},"19":{"text":"Eiten tu damsunga dinga Khrist kineppi giap ihi u’leh mi zousie lah a mi hepi huoipen ihi ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin Khrist khu mishi lah a kipat kaithaw in a umta a, ana imu masate laha ga masapen ahing hita hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi khat zieh a shina ahing um bangin mi khat zieh main mishi thawkiana zong ahing umta hi."},"22":{"text":"Adam a mi zousie ashi mabangin, Khrist ah mi zousie suhhingin a um ding uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh michin amauh hunchiet ah, Khrist khu ga masapen ahi a, tuazou chienga, A hing pei kiana ah, Khrist ate athou ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuazou chiengin atawp atung dinga, tuahun chiengin, vaihawmna zousie, thuneina zousie leh silbawltheina zousie sumangin, Pa Pasian kungah leenggam khu apeta ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Aman amelmate zousie akeng nuoi a akoi masangsie vai ahawm ding hi.","ref":"Late. 110.1"},"26":{"text":"Melma nukhia pen suhmanga um ding khu shina ahi."},"27":{"text":"“Pasian in sil zousie akeng nuoi ah akoita hi.” Hinanleh “Sil zousie athu nuoi ah akoita hi achi chiengin athunuoi a sil zousie koipa ahuom kha sih,” chi akichien hi.","ref":"Late. 8.6"},"28":{"text":"Tualeh sil zousie athunuoi a aum chiengin, Tapa ngel zong, sil zousie athunuoi a koipa nuoi ah akitulutta dinga, Pasian khu bangkim a bangkim ahi theina dingin."},"29":{"text":"Tuachi ahisihleh mishite a dinga baptisma atansah uh bang ding ata diei, mishite thoukia mawngmawng lou ahi u’leh? Bangdinga mishite baptisma atansah uh ahi diei?"},"30":{"text":"Tualeh bang dinga eite zong naikal chin a shi zauhuoi a kikoi nuom ding ihi uoi?"},"31":{"text":"Jesu Khrist i Mangpa a ka hing nei unaute aw, noute kisahtheipiin nitengin ka shi hi, chi ka gen ahi."},"32":{"text":"“Mihing deidan banga Ephesa khuo a gamsate kisuolpi ka hi leh kei dingin bang aphatuom diei?” Mishite thoukia lou ahi leh: Ne in dawn lei asih diei, zing chienga shi ding ihi.","ref":"Isai. 22.13"},"33":{"text":"“Sol in um sih un, lawm gilou in umdan hoi asusie hi.”"},"34":{"text":"Dihtatna lam ah khanglou unlen, khiel sih un, aziehpen mi pawlkhat in Pasian theina anei sih uhi, tampen na zumna ding ua ka gen ahi."},"35":{"text":"“Mikoi ahiei in mishite bangchi banga kaitho ahi ding uoi? Bangchibang tahsa neiin ahing thoukia ding uoi?” achi ahi ding.","title":"Thawkiana tahsa umdan ding"},"36":{"text":"Nang mi mo na haichi tu zong ashi phot sihleh a hing thei sih hi."},"37":{"text":"Na tu chiengin akung hing um ding pen na tu sih a Bu hiin, haichi dangdang hitaleh atang ahi na tu."},"38":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian in hoi asah bang chietin akung apie hi, haichi chinteng kungah ama kung ape chiet hi."},"39":{"text":"Tahsa zousie tahsa kibang ahi sih a, hinanleh mihingten tahsa chi tuom khat anei ua, gamsate tahsa atuom a, ngate tahsa atuom a, tualeh vate tahsa atuom hi."},"40":{"text":"Vanlam tahsa aum a, leilam tahsa zong a um hi, hinanleh vanlam tahsa thupina atuom a, leilam tahsa thupina atuom hi."},"41":{"text":"Niin thupina tuom khat anei a, hapi in thupina tuom anei hi, aasiten zong thupina tuom akinei ua, aasi khat leh aasi khat zong athupidan akibang sih uhi."},"42":{"text":"Tuamabangin mishi thawkiana zong ahi. Muottheia tuin a uma, muotthei loua kaithaw in a um hi."},"43":{"text":"Simmaw huoitah a tuin a um a, thupitah a kaithaw in a um hi, hatloutah a tuin a um a, silbawltheitah a kaithawin a um hi."},"44":{"text":"Tahsalam sapum a tuin a um a, Hagau lam tahsa pum nei a kaithouin a um hi. Tahsalam sapum a uma Hagaulam sapum zong a um hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuachi’n “Mi masa Adam pen hinna nei mihinga siem ahi,” chia gel ahi; Adam nukhia pen hinna pepa Hagau ahi.","ref":"Siem. 2.7"},"46":{"text":"Ahivangin Hagau lam aum masa sih a, tahsa lam aum masa hi, tuami nuain Hagaulam ahing um hi."},"47":{"text":"Mihing masa khu leivui a siem leimi ahia, Mihing nina pen vana hing kipan Mangpa ahi."},"48":{"text":"Leivui a siem mi khu leivui a kisiempa bang ahi ua, vanlam mite zong vana mi bang ahi uhi."},"49":{"text":"Lei a kisiem mel ipuoh bangun vanmi mel zong ipaw ding uhi."},"50":{"text":"Hinanleh unaute aw na kung uah tam thu ka gen ahi, tahsa leh sisan in Pasian gam aluo thei sih a, muotthei in zong muottheilouna aluothei sih hi."},"51":{"text":"Ngai un, thuguh kiphuol ka hing hil ding hi; i unpi un i imu sieng sih ding ua, hinanleh i unpi un suhlamdangin i um sieng ding uhi.","title":"Suhlamdang tahsa umdan ding","ref":"1 Thes. 4.15-17"},"52":{"text":"Pengkul nukhia pen agin chiengin, thakhat in mitphiet kalin suhlamdangin i um ding uhi, aziehpen pengkul hing ging ding ahi; tua hun chiengin mishite muottheiloua kaithouin a um ding ua, eite zong suhlamdangin i umta ding uhi."},"53":{"text":"Tam muot theiin muottheilouna asil dinga, tualeh tam shi theiin shitheilouna asil ding hi."},"54":{"text":"Tam muot theiin muottheilouna asil a, tam shi theiin shitheilouna asil hun chiengin, “Zawna in shina avalzouta,” chia kigiel khu ahing tangtungta ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 25.8"},"55":{"text":"“Aw shina na gu hei a um ahiei?” Aw hankhuh na guolzawna hei a um ata e?","ref":"Hos. 13.14"},"56":{"text":"Shina gu khu khelna ahi a, tualeh khelna thahatna khu dan ahi."},"57":{"text":"Hinanleh i Mangpa Jesu Khrist vanga eite guolzawna hing pepa Pasian kungah kipahthu um hen."},"58":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka unau ittahte aw, dettah in suhling guollouin Mangpa nasep phatuom ngaitah in sem ngitnget un, na sepgimna uh Mangpa ah amawhna ahi sih, chi thei un."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin misiengthoute dinga tuohkhawm thu ah, Galatia gam a hattuomte kunga thu ka pieh bangin nouten zong bawl un.","title":"Jerusalem hattuom a migentheite dinga tuohkhawm donna","ref":"Rom. 15.25,26"},"2":{"text":"Ka hing pei chienga tuohkhawm donna aum louna dingin hapta kaal khat a ni masapen in Pasian in ahing guolzawlna bangin mi chinin na kholkhawm masa chiet un."},"3":{"text":"Ka hing pei chiengin koi hitaleh na muon penpen uh na silpieh uh va thah dingin na laihah u’toh Jerusalem ah ka sawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Kei zong ka va pei alem leh, kei toh ka kizoh thei ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuin Masidonia gam ka tot suoh zou chiengin na kung uah ka hing pei ding hi. Masidonia gam tot suoh ka sawm hi.","title":"Thu tawpna leh mangpha hahna","ref":"Nasep. 19.21"},"6":{"text":"Ka khuolzinna ka peina tenga nouten nang hah kawi kawi theina dingun, bangtan ahiei phalbi sungteng na kung uah ka tam maithei hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu tungin ahileh ka khuolzin kawma noute hing mu malamka ut sih hi, hinanleh Mangpa’n pha asah leh, tomkhat na kung ua taam ta di ka kinem hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Pentikos ni dong Ephesa khuo ah ka tam ding hi.","ref":"Siempu. 23.15-21; Danp. 16.9-11; Nasep. 19.8-10"},"9":{"text":"Kot lienpi leh nasepna phatuom tah kei a dingin akihonga, tualeh melma tampi zong a um hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuin Timothi na kung ua ahing pei leh, zau lou a na lah ua aum theina ding na ngaituo un, Ama zong kei bangbanga Mangpa nasem ahi.","ref":"1 Kor. 4.17"},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin koiman simmaw sih heh, ka kung a ahing pei theina dingin lungmuong tahin hing ha zaw un, unaute toh ka kunga ang pei ka kinem hi."},"12":{"text":"Unaupa Apollo tungtang thu ahileh, unaute toh na kung ua hing pei dingin ka dei mama hi, hinanleh tu tah a hing pei ding pen ama deidan ahi tadi sih hi, hinanleh hun lemtang anei chiengin ahing pei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Kiveng unlen ginna ah dingkip un, hangsan tahin um unlen, hat tahin um un."},"14":{"text":"Na bawl zousie uh itna a bawl hi heh"},"15":{"text":"Unaupa Stephenas innkuonpite, khu Akaia gam a Pasian thua ga masapen ahi ua, misiengthoute nasep pieh dingin akipumpieh uh chi na thei uhi.","ref":"1 Kor. 1.16"},"16":{"text":"Tambang mite kungah leh michin koute toh semkhawm leh semgimte kunga kitulut dingin ka hing ngen hi."},"17":{"text":"Stephenas, Fortunatus leh Akaikus ahing pei uh ka kipah hi, amauten na umlou kaal un ka tasap awng ahing huhpieh uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amaun ka hagau leh noute hagau ahalsah uhi, tuaziehin tambang mite theisiem un."},"19":{"text":"Asia gam a hattuomten ahing nousiet uhi. Akuila leh Prisilla in a inn ua hattuom umte toh, Mangpa a lungtai tahin ahing nousiet uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 18.2"},"20":{"text":"Unaute zousiein noute ahing nousiet uhi. Kitawp siengthouin kinousiet tuo chiet un."},"21":{"text":"Kei Paul in keima khut mama in tam nousietna kang giel ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mi koipou in Mangpa Jesu Khrist a it sih leh samsiet (Anathema) in um heh, Mangpa hing pei in (Maranatha)."},"23":{"text":"I Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist hepina na kung uah um hen."},"24":{"text":"Khrist Jesu a ka hing itna na unpi ua kungah umta hen, Amen."}}}}},"47":{"info":{"name":"2 Korinth","shortname":"2 Kor.","abbr":[],"desc":"Korinth mite kunga sawltahpawl laihah nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul Pasian deilam a Jesu Khrist sawltah leh i unaupa uh Timothi in Korinth khuo a um Pasian hattuomte leh Akaia gam pumpi a misiengthoute zousie kungah,","title":"Paul in Pasian kunga kipah thugenna","ref":"Nasep. 18.1"},"2":{"text":"Pasian ipa u’leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist kunga kipat hepina leh hamuonna na kung uah um hen."},"3":{"text":"I Mangpa Jesu Khrist Pasian leh Pa phat in um hen. Ama khotuona Pa leh lungmuonna Pasian ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian in koute ahing hamuonna mama khu a kouten zong hasatna thuoh poumate ka hamuon theina dingun, Aman ka hasatna zousie uah ahing hamuon zel hi."},"5":{"text":"Khrist thuohgimnate koute sunga akiningchin bangin, Khrist zieha ka kihenepna u’zong akiningching hi."},"6":{"text":"Kouten gimgentheina ka thuoh u’leh, noute kihenepna ding leh hundamna ding ahia, tua kihenepnain kouten ka thuoh bang uh thuohzouna ahing siem a, koute hamuon a ka um u’leh noute kihenepna leh hundamna ahi."},"7":{"text":"Noute gimgentheina thuohte na hi bangun, henepna tangmite zong na hi uh chi theiin ka hing kineppina uh adet hi."},"8":{"text":"Asia gam a gimgentheina ka thuoh uh chi theilou unaute na hi uh ka dei sih uhi. Kouten ka thuoh zou val uh, tunggihna te guollou ka thuoh ua, hinna nangawn mansuo ka zau uhi.","ref":"1 Kor. 15.32"},"9":{"text":"Ahi, kouma leh kouma kingaisutna ah, shina thukhenna thuohta bangin ka kithei uhi, tua pen kouma kimuonglou a mishite kaithoupa Pasian ka muon zohna ding uh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aman hichikhopa shina zauhuoi thupi lah a kipat ahing hundohta a, ahing hundoh lellel a, ahing hundoh nalai ding hi chi’n Ama ka muong uhi."},"11":{"text":"Mi tampite akipata silpieh ka mu zieh ua, mi tampiten koute dinga kipahthu agen theina dingun, nouten zong koute dinga thu na hing ngetpieh chietna un, na hing panpi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Koute’n ka kisuonpi uh tami ahi; ka sie leh pha theina uh hing theipi, sienthouna leh Pasian dihna neiin tahsa pilna a hilouin, Pasian hepina hizawin leitungah, ka gamta ua, tualeh adiehin noulam ah ka gamta hoizaw sem uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen na sim thei u’leh na theisiem dingte uh chilou adang bangma ka giel sih uhi, atawp donga na theikim dinguh ka gingta uhi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa Jesu ni hing tun chienga noute ka kisahtheipite na hi ding bang ua, koute zong na kisahtheipite uh ka hi ding uh, chi theina chieng na hing neita uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tambang kimuonna nei in, noute kung hing phah masah ka sawm hi. Nouten phattuomna nivei na tan theina ding un.","title":"A khuolzin ding akikhelsahna"},"16":{"text":"Masidonia gam a ka haw chiengin noute ka hing ve dinga, Masidonia gam a pat kang kilekia chiengin na kung ua hing peikia vangin tualeh Judia gam lam a ka peina dingah hing ha ulachin ka chi ahi.","ref":"Nasep. 19.21"},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin tami ka tup laiin bailamtaha ka tup ahiei mah? Ahisihleh ka siltupte tahsa dan a ahileh hi, ahilouleh hilou, chi kawma tum ka hiei mah?"},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian amuonhuoi bangin, noute lam a ka thugen uh, ahi, chileh hilou chi ahi sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen na lah ua Koute: Kei, Silvanus leh Timothi in athu kagen uh, Pasian Tapa Jesu Khrist khu, ahi chi leh hilou chi ahi sih a, Ama ah ahi, chi ahizaw hi.","ref":"Nasep. 18.5"},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian thuchiem zousie khu Ama ah ahi chi ahia, tualeh koute zieh a Pasian thupina dingin Ama ah, Amen ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Koute Khrist a nou toh hing sudetpa leh koute sathau hing nupa khu Pasian ahi."},"22":{"text":"Aman eite ahing chiemte a, tualeh ilungtang sung uah khamna hagau ahing peta hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuathamlouin ka hinna tunga theipipa dingin Pasian ka han ahi, noute kang khawi nopna a Korinth a hing haw nawnlou ka hi."},"24":{"text":"Na ginna tung ua thunei ut ka hisih ua, na lungnopna ding ua noute toh semkhawm ka hi zaw uhi, azieh pen ginna a ding det na hi uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh lunggim sasa a na kung ua hing hawkia nawnlou dingin ka lungsim ah thutanna ka bawlta hi.","title":"Sil bawlkhiela kisiate panpi ding"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen ken noute hing lunggimsah taleng, ka suh lunggimte ma chilou kei hing kipahsah ding koi dang a um diei?"},"3":{"text":"Na kung uah tam thu ma ahi ka hing gel, tuachilouin ka hing pei chiengin, ka kipahna ding noute lah ah lunggimna ka mu zaw kha ding hi; ka kipahna khu noute zousie kipahna hi ding in, kimuonna ka nei hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen lunggimna leh gimgentheina thuoh pumin hitui tampi toh tam thu ka hing giel hi, suh lunggim a na umlouna dingun, na tung uah itna kiningching ka nei hi chi na thei zohna ding uh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh mi koi ahiei in lunggimna abawl leh kei guoh ang suh lunggim sih a, ka gen uongna hilouin noute na bawn un ahing suhlunggim chiet ahi zaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Tambang mite adingin, noute atamzawin gawtna na pieh uh ama a dingin ahun giap ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tuanahsangin tuin na ngaidam zaw ding ua, na hamuon zoh ding uh ahi, tua ahisihleh tambang mi pen alunggim sengnain aval zou kha ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin ama na itna uh sudet zel dingin ka hing ngen ahi."},"9":{"text":"Noute kunga lai kang gelna ziehpen sil bangkim ah thu na mangna uoi chi kang etchien ut zieh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Sil khat poupou a mi khat pou na ngaidam u’leh, Ken zong ka ngaidam hi, sil khatpou ngaidamna ding poimawna a um pouma leh ka ngaidam mi khu, noute ziehin Khrist ah ka ngaidamta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi ahisihleh Setan in eite ah hun lemtang amukha ding hi, aziehpen Setan sil geel dante itheimaw uh ahi sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaban ah Khrist khantanhoi gen dinga Troas khuo a ka hing haw lai in, Mangpa’n kei ding in kot khat ahing honpieh a,","ref":"Nasep. 20.1"},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh ka unaupa Tita tua mun a ka mu lou ziehin ka ha amuong thei sih hi, tuachi’n amaute mangpha ka hah a, Masidonia gam zuon in ka peita hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Khrist a guolzawna hing pe zelpa leh koute zang a mun chin a Ama theina gimnamtui theisahpa Pasian kungah kipah thu umta heh.","title":"Khrist zieh a guolzawna"},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen hundam a umte leh mangthaite lah ah Pasian a dingin Khrist gimnamtui ka hi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Pawlkhatte a dingin shina dinga shina gimnam ka hi ua, pawldang khat a dingin hinna dinga hinna gimnam ka hi uhi. Tualeh tam silte dinga chingzou ding koi ahiei?"},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen mitampiten Pasian thu summet bawlna a azah bangun, kouten ka zang sih uhi. Hinanleh Pasian a kipata sawlte bangin gin umtah in Khrist ah Pasian thu ka gen zaw uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kouma leh kouma kigenpha pankia ka hita uoi mah? Ahisihleh, kouten midangte banga na kung ua ahisihleh noute akipat genphatna lai poimaw ka hi uoi mah?","title":"Gingtu laihah toh gentena"},"2":{"text":"Noute ka laihah uh, ka lungtang ua kigiel, mi zousie thei leh sim na hi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Noute pen Khrist laihah koute sepga na hi uh chi na kilangsahta uhi, laitui a kigiel hilou, Pasian hing Hagau hing gel, Suongpeh tunga kigiel hilou, tahsa lungtang peh tunga kigiel na hi zaw uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 24.12; Jer. 31.33; Ezek. 11.19; 36.26"},"4":{"text":"Kouten tambang muonna Khrist zal in Pasian lam ah ka nei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Bangpou kouma akipat a ahi chi ding in kouma bou kachin uh ka chi sih ua, kachin na u’khu pasien kunga kipat ahi zaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman thuhun tha nasem thei dingin koute ahing chingsah a, dan kigiel sate nasem hilou in Hagau nasemte ka hizaw uhi, aziehpen dan kigiel in athat a, Hagau in hinna apie hi.","title":"Thuhuntha khu nasepna kipatna ahi","ref":"Jer. 31.31"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh suhbei a um ding thupina a suhthupi a aum zieh a, Israel taten Mosi maitang entang ngamlou khop a, shina nasepna suongpeh a, akhuoh a kigiel bawn athupi leh;","ref":"Pawt. 34.29"},"8":{"text":"Hagau nasepna khu bangchi’n athupi zaw lou thei diei?"},"9":{"text":"Siemmaw tansahna nasep bawn tambanga thupi ahileh, dihtatna nasepna khu nahpitah in athupi zaw sem ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tam thu ah, thupina um masa khu thupina thupizaw in akhupkhel ziehin, athupi nawn sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Suhmanga um thupina bawn tambanga thupi ahileh a umden pen khu nasatah in a thupi zaw sem ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin tambang kinepna ka neiziehun thugen ka hangsan uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amuol a mang hiei hiei atawpdonga Israel taten tangtah a et theilouna ding ua amai puona khukhum Mosi bang ka hi sih uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.33"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh alungsim uh khausah in a um a, tuni dongin thuhun lui asim chiengun, tua maikhuna khu hawhkhiet lou in a umden a, tua maikhuna khu Khrist ah hawhkhietin aumta hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh tuni dongin Mosi laibu asim chiengun alungtang uah maikhuna khu a umden nalai hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahivang in Mi koi zong Mangpa lam a akihei chiengun tua maikhuna khu lahmangin aum hi.","ref":"Pawt. 34.34"},"17":{"text":"Mangpa khu Hagau ahi a, Mangpa Hagau umna phot ah noplenna a um hi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh eite pen i unpi un, maikhu lou in himlang a ki en bangin, Mangpa thupina khu en zingin, tua toh kibanga um dingin Mangpa Hagau in thupina apat thupina ah ahing sulamdang zing hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian khotuona ka mu bang ua tami nasepna ka tanziehun, ka lungke sih uhi.","title":"Pasian thugente hansanna"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh sil zumhuoi kiphuolte ka tawpsanta ua, lepchie na lungsim leh zebawl na zang ka hi sih ua, tualeh zebawlna thu toh Pasian thu ka heikawi sih uhi, Thutah kichientahin ka gen zaw ua, Pasian mitmu ah michin sie leh pha theina mit ka tungsah zaw uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ka khantanhoi uh khukhum a aum leh zong mangthaite kungah khukhum in aum ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tulai leitung pasien in agingtalou mite lungsim amielsah ta hi, Tuachilou in Pasian limleh mel kibatpi Khrist khantanhoi thupina in amaute asalvah kha ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen kouma leh kouma kigen ka hisih ua, Jesu Khrist khu Mangpa ahi, chi leh koute pen Jesu Khrist ziehin na suohte uh ka hi zaw uh chi ka gen zaw uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen Jesu Khrist mel a Pasian thupina theina vah hing pe dingin, “Miel lah a kipata vah hing vahdoh dinga” thupepa Pasian in ka lungtang uh asalvah ta hi.","ref":"Siem. 1.3"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh silbawltheina thupina khu koute akipat hilou a, Pasian apat ahizawh theina dingin, tua gou khu leibelte ah ka kem uhi."},"8":{"text":"Ningchin ah suhgenthei in ka um ua, hinanleh suhguoi in ka um sih uhi, lungdong in ka um ua, hinanleh kinepna bei in ka um sih uhi;"},"9":{"text":"Bawlgenthei in ka um ua, hinanleh Pasian taisan in ka um sih uh, Satpua in ka um ua, hinanleh suhmang in ka um sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Kouten ka tahsa pumpi uah Mangpa Jesu shina ka paw zing ua, ka tahsa pumpi ua Jesu hinna akilatna dingin."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen Jesu hinna zong ashi thei ka tahsa ua, sulat a aum theina dingin, kou ahing nalaite pen bangchih laipou in Jesu zieh a shi dinga piehkhiet in ka um zing uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n koute ah shina in nna asem a, hinanleh noute ah hinna in asem hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka gingta a tuaziehin ka genta hi, chia kigiel bangin, tua hinna hagau mama khu nei in, “Kouten zong ka gingta ua, tuaziehin ka gen uhi.”","ref":"Late. 116.10"},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa Jesu kaithou pa in koute zong Jesu toh ahing kaithou dinga noute toh Ama umna ah ahing puikhawm ding chi ka thei uhi."},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian thupina dinga, mi tampite kipahthugenna zal a, hepina apun semsem na dinga sil zousie noute zieh a um ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka lungke sih uhi, ka pulam mihinna uh zawngkhal semsem nanleh, ka sunglam mihinna uh pen nisim a siemtha in aum ngitnget hi.","title":"Tulai a thuohna leh kumtawn thupina"},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen mitphietkal sung ka gimthuohna uh jang noukhat in kumtawn thupina gih zaw ahing bawlpieh zing hi."},"18":{"text":"Sil mu theite enlou in, sil mu theiloute ka en zaw uhi. Aziehpen sil mu theite pen tomnou khat sunga ding ahi a, silmu theiloute pen kumtawn a ding ahi zaw hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aziehpen tam puonbuh itenna ileitung inn uh suhsiet in um nanleh khuta lamlou Pasian akipat kumtawn inndet van ah inei uh chi ithei uhi.","title":"Mangpa nasemte dinga shina zauhuoi loudan"},"2":{"text":"Van a kipat a i tenna dinguh silthuopsah a um ding lunggul in, tam mun ah thum in i um tadi uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tuabanga silthuopsah a ium chiengin saguoh in i um sih ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen ei tam puonbuh a umte pen puohgih pua in thum a mauin i um tadi uhi, sillou a i um ut zieh uh ahi sih a, hinna leh shithei khu hinna valzou a aum theina dingin, silthuop sah a ium ut zieh uh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tami ding mama a eite hing siem Pasian ahia khelna manbat ditna Hagau zong ahing peta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin kimuongtahin i um ngitnget uhi, tami tahsa inn a i um laisie uh, Mangpa toh i umkhawm sih uh chi ithei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen ginna in ipei ua, mu thei in ipei sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Kimuongtahin i um uh kachi ahi, tahsa a umlou in Mangpa toh ium ut zaw uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin um in um sih nan lei zong, Ama kipahpi lam ihi theina dingun isemgim uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen michin tahsa a aum sunga asilbawlte asie apha abawl dungzui a asepman anga theina dinga Khrist vaihawmna toupha mai ah ding teitei ding ihi uhi.","ref":"Rom. 14.10"},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin Kouten Mangpa ginhuoidan theiin mite ka zawl uhi; hinanleh ka hina uh Pasian kungah theichien in aum a, noute sie leh pha theina a theichien a ka um uh zong ka kinem hi.","title":"Khrist itna leh siltup"},"12":{"text":"Noute mai a kouma leh kouma kigenpha kia ut ka hi sih ua, lungtang sunglam hilou a, apulam a kisuongte na dawn theina dinguh bang ahiei na nei theina dingun, koute taanga na kisuon theina ding uh hing bawlpieh in ka gen zaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen Koute ka mot u’leh Pasian a ding ahia, ka pil u’leh noute a ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Khrist itna in koute ahing sawl teitei hi, aziehpen tambangin ka ngaituo uhi, mi zousie shi taang a mi khat ahing shina ah mi zousie shi ahita hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama mi zousie taanga ashina ziehpen, ahingte zong amau a dinga hing nawn lou a, ashi taang ua shi a thoukiapa adinga ahin zohna dingun, Ama mi zousie a dingin ashi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin tukalsie, tahsa lam ah koima ka thei nawn sih uhi, ahi, tahsa danin Khrist na theita nan u’leng zong, tuin vang ka thei nawn sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuazieh in mi koizong Khrist a a um leh, sil siemtha ahita hi, sil luite abeita a, ngai un ahing thata hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh sil zousie Pasian a kipat ahi a, Aman Jesu Khrist ah Ama toh kilem in ahing bawl a, ka kung uah kilemna nasep ahing peta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian khu Khrist a um in, leitung mite Ama toh akilemsah ta a, atatkhelnate uh tatkhelna a simpieh lou in, Aman tam kilepkiana thu koute ahing kem sah hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin koute pen Khrist palaite ka hi ua, Pasian in koute zanga noute ahing nget bangin, Pasian toh kilem un chi’n Khrist taang in ka hing ngen uhi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama a Pasian dihtatna i hing hi theina dingun, khelna mawngmawng thei ngailou, Ama khu Pasian in eite ziehin khiel in abawl ta hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Koute Ama toh semkhawmte ka hi ziehun, Pasian hepina phattuompilou a na tanlouna dingun ka hing ngen uhi.","title":"Pasian hepina phattuompi dinga ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman, “Hun kipah huoi ah ka hing ngaikhie a, Hundamna ni ah ka hing panpi hi,” achi hi. Ngai un, tu hun kipah huoi ahia, Ngai un, tu hundamna ni ahi.","ref":"Isai. 49.8"},"3":{"text":"Ka nasep uh gensiet a aum louna dingin, koima puana ding sil bangma ka bawl sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian nasemte bangin sil zousie ah pahtat huoi in ka langsah zaw uhi, thuohhatna nasatahte, bawlsietnate, tahsapnate, lunggimnate;"},"5":{"text":"Vuohnate, suongkul a khumnate, buoinate, sepgimnate, imutmawnate, ann ngawlnate;","ref":"Nasep. 16.23"},"6":{"text":"Sienthouna ah, theina ah, thuohgimna ah, hepisiemna ah, Hagau Siengthou ah leh itna ginumna ah;"},"7":{"text":"Thutah thu ah, Pasian sil bawltheina ah, ziet leh vei ah, dihtatna galvan ah,"},"8":{"text":"Zatatna leh zatatlouna ah, gensietna leh patatna ah, atah hinapi a, solhatmi banga ngohna ah,"},"9":{"text":"Thei mama hinapi theiphahlou banga bawlna ah, Ngai un, shi ding banga vuohthuoh hinapi tha a umlou in,"},"10":{"text":"Lunggim napi lungnop ngitngetna ah, zawng napi mitampi hausatsahna ah, bangma neilou hinapi bangkim neina ah, tamte zousie ah Pasian nasemte ka hi na uh pahtat huoi in ka langsahta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Aw nou Korinth mite, kouten na kung uah kichientahin thu ka genta ua, ka lungtang uh ka hong lien uhi.","title":"Kilem kia dinga Paul ngetna"},"12":{"text":"Kouten noute ka hing kham sih ua, hinanleh nouma deina lam ah na kikham zaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tate kunga thu gen bangin na kung uah ka gen ahi, kang pieh bangbang uh hing pe thuh dingin kihong lien un."},"14":{"text":"Ginglou mite toh kituohloupi in hahkol pokhawm sih un, aziehpen dihtatna leh danbeia gamtatna in bang kigopna anei uoi? tualeh vah leh miel in bang kipawlkhawmna anei uoi?","title":"Gingloute toh hahkol puohkhawm lou ding"},"15":{"text":"Khrist leh Belial in bang kilemna anei uoi? Ahisihleh gingmi leh ginglou miin bang tankhawm anei uoi?"},"16":{"text":"Pasian biehinn leh milimten kithukimna anei uh amah? Noute Pasian hing bieh inn na hi uhi, Pasian in, “Ama uah ka teng dinga, amaute lah ah ka vah ding, a Pasian uh ka hi dinga, ama u’zong Ka mite ahi dinguh, achi bangin.","ref":"1 Kor. 3.16; 6.19; Siempu. 26.12; Ezek. 37.27"},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin, alah ua kipat in hing pawtdoh unlen, atuom in um un, Mangpa’n achi hi. Asienglou mawngmawng khoi sih un, tuachi’n noute ka hing pom ding a;","ref":"Isai. 52.11"},"18":{"text":"noute a dingin na Pa uh ka hi dinga, noute zong ka tapa leh ka tanute na hi ding uhi. Mangpa bangkim bawlthei in” achi hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.14; 1 Khang. 17.13; Isai. 43.6; Jer. 31.9"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin it tahte aw, eiten tambang thuchiemte inei zieh un, Pasian giinna a, sienthouna bukim in, tahsa leh Hagau a buanate apat ikisusiengthou ding uhi.","title":"Lunggim nua a lungnopna"},"2":{"text":"Koute kungah na lungsim uh hongun, koima tungah adihlou ka bawl sih uhi, koima ka suse sih ua, koima ka zuoubawl sih uhi.","title":"Paul Tita toh kimuna"},"3":{"text":"Noute siemmaw hing tansahna dinga tam thu ka gen ahi sih hi, tumasang lam in zong, i hin leh hingkhawm ding i shi leh shi khawm dingin noute ka lungsim uah na um uhi, chi ka gen zouta hi."},"4":{"text":"Noute kunga thugen ka hansandan athupi a, noute taanga ka kisahtheidan a thupi hi, lungmuonnain ka dimta hi, ka genthei thuohna zousie uah nasatahin ka lungdam hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi, Masidonia gam ka hing tun un, ka tahsa un khawldamna anei sih a, lelam lelam ah suhbuoi in ka um uhi, apulam ah kihauna auma, asunglam ah zauna a um hi.","ref":"2 Kor. 2.13"},"6":{"text":"Ahivang in alungkete hamuonpa Pasian in Tita hing tunna tungtawn in ahing hamuonta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh ama hing tunna zieh guoh hilouin, aman noute a hamuonna anei dan leh nouten kei na hing lunggul dan uh, na hing hasietpi dan u’leh kei dinga na phattuomngai dan uh, ahing hil tahin ka lungnopna alien sem semta hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka laihah a noute hing lunggim sah kahi khahtah leh zong, ka kisia sih hi, na kisia kha ka hi tah leh zong, aziehpen tua laihahin tomnoukhat sung hinanleh noute ahing lunggim sah chi ka thei hi.","title":"Paul laihah Korinth miten adonna uh"},"9":{"text":"Tuin vang ka kipah ahi, suh lunggim a na um zieh uh hilouin, na lunggim na un kisia a lungheina ang tut zieh
