ahi zaw hi, aziehpen Pasian deilam a lunggim na hi ua, Koute zieh in bangma supna na nei sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Pasian deilam a lunggim na in kisia a hundam na atun hi, tua pen akisia huoi vawt sih hi, hinanleh leitung dan a lunggim na in shina atun zel hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian deilam a lunggim na in noute sungah bangchituh a noute pilvan na hing tun atai mah, ahi noute kisuhsiengnate, lungthahnate, zaunate, lunggul nate, phatuomngainate, phubalah nate, tam silte zousie ah na sieng uh china mu chiensahta uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin noute kungah laihah gel nanleng, adihlou bawlpa zieh a ka gel ahi sih a, dihloutah a thuohpa zieh a ka gel zong ahi tuom sih a, koute dinga na kipiehzou dan uh Pasian mitmu a, na kung ua suhlat a aum theina dinga ka gel ahi zaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin na hamuonna uah, ka hamuongta uhi. Tualeh Tita lungnopna ziehin ka kipah tungtuong uhi, na unpi ua alungsim na tohhal zieh un."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen bang ahiei a, noute ka hing kisahtheipina ama kungah nei nanleng ka zum sih hi, hinanleh thutah a sil zousie na kung ua ka gen bang un, Tita kunga ka hing kisahtheipina zong thu tah ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nouten na unpi ua, na thumandante u’leh zau leh chitun pum a, ama na kipahpi dante uh ageldoh chiengin, alungsungah noute ahing ngaina deu deu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin sil zousie a noute muonngamna ka nei zieh in ka lungdam hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuathamlouin unaute aw, Pasian in Masidonia gam a hattuomte kungah hepina apie chi ka hing theisah ding hi.","title":"Jerusalem a gentheite dinga tuohkhawm","ref":"Rom. 15.26"},"2":{"text":"Tuachia suhgentheina a ze etna thupitah akipahna uh kichingtah leh azawn mama na u’khu sil phalna lam a hepina hauna thupitah in aluonglet hi."},"3":{"text":"Amauten anei dungzui un apie ua, anei sang ua tamzaw zong ape nuom uhi chi ka theipi hi;"},"4":{"text":"Tua silpieh khu pompieh ding leh, misiengthoute nasepna a atel theina dingun hatang nget in ahing ngen uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tami koute kinepna banga bawl hilou in Pasian dei bangin, amauh mama Mangpa kung leh koute kungah akipe masa uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n Tita in ana patsa mabanga noute lah a hepina nasep bukimsah leh chi’n ama ka ngen uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n sil bangkim a, ginna, thugentheina, phatuomngaina zousie leh koute na hing itna ua na hausat bangun, tam hepina a zong na hing hausat theina dingun thanop suo un."},"8":{"text":"Thupieh bangin ka gen sih a, hinanleh midangte phattuom ngai na in na itna uh a tahtah ahi nai chi etchienna dinga ka gen ahi zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen nouten i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist hepina na thei uhi, agentheina zieh a na hing hausat theina dingun, Ama hausa mama nanleh, noute ziehin ahing gentheita hi."},"10":{"text":"Tam thu ah hoi ka sah dan ka gen ahi, aziehpen tami nou a dingin ahoi ahi, kum khat peita a bawlpan masa noute na hi ua, na bawlpat guoh uh hilouin pieh nopna nei masa pen na hi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuin tam nasep bukimsah unlen, na utna utoh kikhom leh, na nei utoh kikhom a pieh dinga na lunggul bang un sutangtung un."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen utna lungsim aum masah pouleh, mi aneilou dan dung zui a hilouin, anei dan dungzui a pompieh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Midangte tung jang sah a, noute puohgih hing guon ka hi sih a, hinanleh kibangguol a um ding ka dei man ahi zaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu huntah a na kiningchinna uh, amaute tahsap awnghuhna ahing hia, amaute kiningchinna zong noute tahsapna awnghuhna ahing hi theina ding leh kibahguolna ding ka chi ahi zaw hi, tuachi’n kibahguolna ahing um thei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"“Alakhawm tam in avalin bangma anei sih a, alakhawm tawm in zong bangma atasam tuom sih,” chia na kigiel bangin.","ref":"Pawt. 16.18"},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh na tung ua tuabangma a, phatuom ngai na Tita lungtang a koipa Pasian kungah kipahthu um hen.","title":"Tita leh midangte nasep"},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen koute hanthawnna akipahpi a, hinanleh ama kithalawpna mawng leh ama tupna mawnga na kung ua, hing haw ahi."},"18":{"text":"Unaupa khat toh ama ka hing sawl uhi, ama pen khantanhoi nasepna a hattuomte zousie patat khat ahi;"},"19":{"text":"Tua guoh hilou in, Mangpa thupina ding leh ka silhoi deina uh ensah dinga, tam hepina thu a ka nasepna ua koute toh zinkhawm kawi kawi ding a hattuomten ana telsa mawng uh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tam silpiehte ka hawmna uah koiman ahing gensiet louna dingun ka pilvang uhi."},"21":{"text":"Mangpa mitmu guoh ah hilou in, mihing mitmu ah zong sil kilawm bawl ka ut uhi.","ref":"Thu. 3.4"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh amaute toh i unaupa uh ka sawl ua, ama pen sil tampi ah aphattuomngaidan ka theichienta ua, ta diehin na tung ua tahsanna lientah anei ziehin aphatuom ngai sem sem hi."},"23":{"text":"Tita ahileh noute lah a ka seppi leh ka lawm ahi, i unaute uh ahileh, hattuomte thupote leh Khrist thupina ahi uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaute kungah leh hattuomte mai ah na itna uh theichienna ding leh noute kang kisuonpi dan uh ensah un."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin misiengthoute dinga nasepna tungtangthu na kung ua hing gel angai sih hi.","title":"Peding a mansa hiding"},"2":{"text":"Noute tuabang nasepna ah na kithalawp uh chi ka thei hi, Akaia gam silpieh pe ding a mansa a aumna kumkhat ahita, chi’n Masidonia gam a mite kungah ka hing kisahtheipita hi; tualeh na thanopna un, mi tamzawte akithalawp sah hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh tam thu toh kisai a noute ka hing kisahtheipina uh amawhna ahilouna dingin unaute ka hing sawl hi, ka gensa banga mansa a na um theina dingun;"},"4":{"text":"Tuachilou in Masidonia gam a mite khat pouin hing zui in noute kimansa louin hing muta u’leh (noute kang chi sih uh) kouten hing tahsanga ka hing kisahtheipina lam uah ka maizum kha ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin masanglai a na chiemsa uh, silpieh khu lahpieh thaw hilou in, phaltah a pezaw a mansa diema na koina dingun ahun masang in unaute na kung ua hing haw masa dinga hanthawn ngaiin ka ngaituo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tami ahi ka thugen, athe tawmin a at tawm dinga, athe tam in a at tam ding hi.","title":"Silpieh pieh dingdan"},"7":{"text":"Michin in alungtang ua atup bangin pie heh, phallou sasa a pieh ding ahi sih a, phut thaw banga ngai a pieh ding zong ahisih hi, aziehpen Pasian in kipahtah a pemi a it hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in hepina zousie kichingtah in noute ahing pe thei hi, tuachi’n noute bangchih laipouin, silzousie a buching taha umin, nna hoi chinteng sem dingin ahing kiningchingsah thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Aman gamtuom ah ahawmzah a, “Mi zawngte kungah apie hi. Adihtatna kumtawnin a umden hi.” Chiin akigiel hi.","ref":"Late. 112.9"},"10":{"text":"Ama haichi thepa kunga haichi pepa in, na neh dinguh tanghou ahing pie a, na haichi the uh apung sah a, na dihtatna ga uh zong akhangsah hi.","ref":"Isai. 55.10"},"11":{"text":"Sil phal dinga bangkima suhhausat a umin, tua khuin koute zieh a Pasian kunga kipah thu genna a um sah hi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen tami nasepna in misiengthoute tahsap awng ahuhpieh guoh ahi sih a hinanleh Pasian kunga kipah thugenna tampi zong aluonglet sah hi."},"13":{"text":"Tami nasepna a etkhieh a umin, Khrist khantanhoi na gintatna u’leh na zuidan u’leh, ama u’leh midangte adinga silpieh a na kiphal dan un, Pasian athupisah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh amauten zong noute tunga um Pasian hepina gensenglou ziehin noute a dinga thungen in ahing ngai mama uhi."},"15":{"text":"Silpieh gensengloute ziehin Pasian kungah kipahthu um hen."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin Keima Paul in Khrist zaidamna leh nunnemna in noute ka hing ngen ahi: Noute toh ka umkhawm chiengin na lah uah ka kingiemsah a, hinanleh ka umlou chieng in noute adingin ka hangsan hi.","title":"Paul in sawltah ahina atahlatna"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh koute tahsa lam a um hi a hing ngaituo pawl khatte tunga hansan ding ahi chia ka ngaisutnate, na kung ua ka um chienga tuabanga ka hansan louna dingin noute ka hing ngen hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Koute tahsain um nan u’leng, tahsa dan in ka dou sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ka galdouna galvante uh, tahsa galvan ahi sih a, kulpi dettah suchim thei Pasian silbawltheina nei galvante ahi zaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Kinielnate leh Pasian theina dou a kisangkoina chinteng ka paikhie ua, mihing ngaituona chinteng Khrist thumanna suoh a puiin."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh na thumanna uh suhbukim ahi chienga, thu manglou zousie gawt dinga mansa a um in."},"7":{"text":"Nouten sil apulam kilatdan en na hi uoi mah? Mi koipou Khrist a hi a, ama leh ama akitheichien ngam ahileh, tam pen aman ngaituo pha kia heh, ama Khrist a ahi bangin koute zong Khrist a ka hi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen noute suhsietna ding hilou a, bawlhoizawhna ding a, Pasian hing pieh ka thuneina uh, Kisahtheipi nan u’leeng zong ka zum sih ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachilou in ka laihah a noute hing suhzau sawm ka bang kha ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen amauten “Alaihahte pen agihin ahat hi, hinanleh ama ahing um chiengin atahsa azawngkhal a, athugen zong ahawmthaw huoi hi,” achi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuabang miten tami ngaituo u’heh, na kung ua ka umlou chieng ua laihah thute a ka um bangbang un noute lah a ka um chieng un zong ka um ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Koute pen ama leh ama kiphat mite lah ah ka kisimtel ngam sih ua, amaute toh zong ka kitekah ngam sih uhi. Hinanleh amaute pen ama u’leh ama uh tena akizangtuo in, amauleh amauh kitekahin lungsim neilou in aum uhi."},"13":{"text":"Bangteng hileh Kouten ka tena hun kalval un ka uong sih ding uhi, hinanleh Pasian in ahing guot mawpuohna toh kikhom in ka uong zaw ding uhi. Tua mawpuohna ka tan un noute zong ahing huop kha hi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Kouten noute hing huomkha lou bangin ka tena kalval un ka kisiel sih uhi. Khrist khantanhoi genin noute kung nangawn ah ka hing pei uhi."},"15":{"text":"Ka tena val uh, chi pen midangte sepsa tunga kisuong ka hi sih ua, na ginna uh akhan bang zel in, ka huopkhahna tan chieng uah, noute ziehin nahpitah a suhlet in ka um ding uh chi ka kinem uhi."},"16":{"text":"Na gam kallam uh tandonga khantanhoi gen ding ka hi uh, midangte sepna sunga nna kisemsate ka kisuonpi ut sih uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh akisuong pouma Mangpa ah kisuong heh.","ref":"Jer. 9.24"},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen ama leh ama kiphat khu pahtat in a um sih a, Mangpa’n apahtatte khu patat a um ahi zaw hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka motna neunou ah nouten hing na, thuohpi u’lachin ka dei hi. Ahi na hing thuohpita tham uhi.","title":"Paul in sawltah ahina aphuonna"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian thangsietnain ahi noute a dinga ka thangsiet. Pasal khat a dingin noute ka hing khamta hi, aziehpen Khrist kungah noute nungah siengthou banga ka hing pieh theina dingin."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh gul in apil lepchiena a Evi asol bangin Khrist a, na gin umna u’leh siengthouna a na kipumpieh na uapat na lungsim uh suhsiet a aum khah ding ka zau mama hi.","ref":"Siem. 3.1-5,13"},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen mi koi ahiei khat hing pei in ka gen ngailou uh Jesu dang khat hing genta leh, ahisihleh na tansa uh hagau pen hilou hagau dang khat na tan ua, ahisihleh na pom ngailou uh khantanhoi dangkhat na pom ua ahileh kipe bai taluo na hina sih ding uoi mah."},"5":{"text":"Sawltah thupipente sanga neu zawin ka kingaituo sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Thugen kizil a siem hi sih nanleng, theina lam ah tuabang ka hisih hi. Hinanleh silbangkim ah na lah uah suhlat in ka um uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na kung ua Pasian khantanhoi amanbei a ka gen a, noute tawisanga na umna ding ua, kei ka kingiemsah khu silbawlkhiel ka hiei mah?"},"8":{"text":"Noute nna ka sep theina dingin, ama ua kipat law na lain, hattuom dangte neisa ka lahpieh hi."},"9":{"text":"Na kung ua ka umlai a tahsap ka nei chiengin, noute a dingin puohgih ka hi sih hi. Masidonia gam a pat a hing pei unauten ka tahsap awng ahing huhpieh uhi, silbangkim ah, noute subuoilou dingin ka kikem a, tuabangin ka kikem zel ding hi.","ref":"Phil. 4.15-18"},"10":{"text":"Khrist thutah keima a aum ziehin kisiel nanleng, Akaia gam a mi koiman ka kisielna asutawp sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Bangzieh in la? Noute kang itlou ziehin maw? Pasian in athei hi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh lemtanna deite apat lemtanna ka sattan theina dingin ka bawl khu ka bawl zel ding hi, akisielna ua koute banga ahing um theina ding un."},"13":{"text":"Tambang mite pen sawltah dihloute ahi ua, solhat a nasemte, Khrist sawltah a kibawlthute ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tam pen alamdang ahisih hi, Setan nangawn zong vah sawltah bangin akibawlthu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin anasem mite, dihtatna nasem mite bangin kibawlthu nan u’leh zong alamdang ahi sih hi, atawpna uh pen anasep bang dungzuiun ahi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka gen kia nalai ding hi, koiman kei mi moin hing ngaituo sih u’heh; ahisih vanglah leh keima themkhat beeh ka kisiel theina dingin amo bang in hing pom phot un.","title":"Paul leh akidoupite kitekahna"},"17":{"text":"Ka thugen khu Mangpa thuneina toh ka gen ahi sih a, tam kisahtheina a mi mo bangin ka gen zaw ahi."},"18":{"text":"Mi tampite tahsa dan a akisiel ziehun, kei zong ka kisiel ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Noute na pil mama ziehun, mi mote kipahtahin na thuoh zou zel uhi."},"20":{"text":"Noute mi khat in suohin hing puiin, hing ne gamta leh mi koi ahiei in nou a kipat in lamang taleh, tualeh mi khat ama leh ama kiliensah in na maitang uh hing behpieh taleh, na thuoh zou zel uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuabanga bawl dingin koute ka hatmaw seng uhi, chia gen khu ka zumna giap uh ahi. Hinanleh midangte ahansan leh mi mo bangin genta leng, kei zong ka hangsan hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute Hebru ahi uh amah? Kei zong ka hi, Amaute Israel mi ahi uh amah? Kei zong ka hi. Amaute Abraham tate ahi uh amah? Kei zong ka hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute Khrist nasemte ahi uh amah? Kei zong ka hi sem hi, mi mo thugen bangin genta leng, sepgimna lam ah ka semgimzaw sem a, vuohna lam ah atuong avalin ka thuoh a, suongkul ah ka taang mun zaw a, shi zauhuoina ka tuoh mun zaw hi.","ref":"Nasep. 16.23"},"24":{"text":"Judate lah a kipat in satna sawmli vei chinna ding khat a sam ngavei ka tuoh hi.","ref":"Danp. 25.3"},"25":{"text":"Thumvei chienga zep ka thuoh a, khatvei suonga se in ka um a, thumvei kuong sietna ka tuoh a, nikhat leh zan khat tuipi thuhtah lai ah ka um a,","ref":"Nasep. 16.22; Nasep. 14.19"},"26":{"text":"Khuolzinna ah tamveipi; tuipi tung shi zauhuoina, ka tuoh a, suomhatte akipat shi zauhuoina ka tuoh a, ka chipi ka nampite lah a kipat shi zauhuoina ka tuoh a, Jentelte lah akipat shi zauhuoina ka tuoh a, khopi sungah shi zauhuoina ka tuoh a, gamdai ah shi zauhuoina ka tuoh a, Tuipi a shina zauhuoi ah, unau tahloute lah a shina zauhuoi ah;","ref":"Nasep. 9.23; Nasep. 14.5"},"27":{"text":"Gimtah a sepgimna ah, tampi vei imutlouna ah, gilkiel leh dangtahna ah, tam veipi ann ngawlna ah dapsa leh saguoh in ka um hi."},"28":{"text":"Tambangteng ban ah zong, hattuom chinteng ka awlmawna thuh tahin kei gihtahin nichin in ahing netkhum ngitnget hi."},"29":{"text":"Koi ahiei zawngkhal a um a ken ka zawnkhalpi lou? Koi ahiei khelna a pua a ken ka lunggimpi lou?"},"30":{"text":"Kisiellou theilou ka hileh, ka hatlouna lam silte ka kisielpi ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Pasian leh i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist Pa, kumtawn a pahtawi a umin, ka zuoulou dan athei hi."},"32":{"text":"Damaska a Aretas leengpa nuoi a uhpipain kei hing matsah tum in Damaska khopi galkapten aveng sah a,","ref":"Nasep. 9.23-25"},"33":{"text":"Hinanleh kulpi panga kotta apat bawma khaikhiehin ka um a, akhut apat ka suohta hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei dingin kisiel phatuom sih nanleh, ka kisiel na lai dinga, Mangpa apat mengmuna leh kilahna ka hing gen ding hi.","title":"Paul mengmuna"},"2":{"text":"Khrist a um mi khat ka thei hi. Apeisa kum sawm leh kumli peita hun laiin ama van thumna tanah lahtouin a um hi. Tahsa a lahtou a um ahiei, tahsa akipat pawtkhie a lahtou a um ahiei chi ka theisih, Pasian in athei hi, tuabang mikhat van thumna a lah tou in aum hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuabang mi khat ka thei hi, tahsa in ahiei, tahsa akipat pawtkhiein ahiei ka thei sih, Pasian in athei hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama khu Paradise a lahtouin aum a, mihing genkhieh theilou leh genkhieh sienglou thute ava za hi."},"5":{"text":"Tambang mi ka kisielpi dinga, Keima pen ka hatlounate chiloungal ka kisiel sih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kisiel ding lunggul tentun nanleng mi mo ka hi sih ding, thutah gen ding ka hi ziehin. Hinanleh mi koi ahiei in kei ahing mu leh ka thugen azah bang sanga thupi zaw a ahing koi louna dingin ka kidiem hi."},"7":{"text":"Kilahnate atam seng zieha ka kiletsah louna dingin kei hing bawl genthei dingin Setan sawltah ling khat ka tahsa tungah ahing kipie hi, tuachilou in ka kiliensah seng kha ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tam ling kei a pat a ladoh dingin Mangpa kungah thum vei ka ngen hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman ka kungah, “Ka hepina nanga dingin ahun hi, aziehpen kahatna khu hatlouna ah suhbukim in a um hi,” ahing chi hi. Tuaziehin Khrist silbawltheina ka tunga aum theina dingin, kipahtahin ka hatlounate ka kisielpi zaw ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin hatlounate ah, zumhuoinate ah, tahsapnate ah, bawlsietnate ah, hasatnate ah, Khrist ziehin ka kipah hi, azieh pen ka hatlou hun chiengin ka hat zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Kisahtheina in mi mo ka suohta, nouten alou theilou a na hing suohsah uh ahi, nouten kei na hing pahtawi zoh ding uh ahi, aziehpen bangma hisih nanleng zong sawltah lienpente sangin neunou khat in zong ka ngiem zaw tuom sih hi.","title":"Paul sawltah hina chiemtenate"},"12":{"text":"Atahtahin sawltah hina chiemtenate khu, chiemtenate, sillamdangte, silbawltheina nasepte, noute lah ah kukal tahin akibawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Noute dinga puohgih ka hilou chilou, hattuom dangte sanga na ngiem zohna uh bang a um ei? Tam dihlouna ah hing ngaidam un."},"14":{"text":"Ngai un, athum veina dinga na kung ua hing haw dingin tuin ka kimanta hi. Noute adingin puohgih ka hi sih ding hi; aziehpen na nei na lam uh dei ka hi sih a, nouma hing dei ka hi. Taten nulepa ading gou akhol ding uh ahi sih a, nu leh paten tate adinga gou akholkhawm ding uh ahi zaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh ken noute adingin kipahtahin ka seng dinga, ka ki seng bei ding hi; ken noute kang it semsem chiengin, nouten kei nang itna uh akiem semsem hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh ahi hi hitaleh, noute adingin puohgih ka hi sih hi. Ahivang in (pilkhel na hing chi ua,) pilkhel tah a ka hing matna hi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Na kung ua ka hing sawl mite lah a koi ahiei zangin noute phattuomna ka hing lahpieh amah?"},"18":{"text":"Tita na kung ua hing haw dingin ka na ngen a, tualeh unaupa khat toh ka hing sawl hi. Tita in na phattuomna uh ahing lah pieh kha ama leh? Koute lungsim kibang nasemkhawm ka hi sih uh amah? Kalsuon kibanga pei khawm hilou ka hi uoi mah?"},"19":{"text":"Noute kunga kouma leh kouma kingaisiem a hing ngaituo zing na hi uoi mah? Khrist ah Pasian masangah thu ka gen uhi. Hinanleh it tahte aw, sil zousie noute hoina dingin ka bawl uhi."},"20":{"text":"Na kung ua ka hing pei chienga ka dei banga um a, ka hing mulou khah ding leh nouten keina deibang ua na hing mu khahlou ding uh ka zau hi, tuachilouin na lah uah kihaunate, kithangsietnate, lungthahnate, kilangkhennate, kigensietnate, kiguhhounate, uonghamnate, tualeh buoinate aum kha ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Na kung ua ka hing pei kia chiengin, ka Pasian in na lah ua hing zalasah lou in, tu masanga na khielsate, lah a sienthoulouna leh kingaina thanghuoi a patatna uapat kisia a lung heilou nalai mitampite ka kakhum kha ding hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami na kung ua kang haw athum veina ding ahita hi. Theipi mi ni leh thum kam ah thu chinteng suhkip ahi ding hi.","title":"Paul thuneina","ref":"Danp. 17.6; 19.15"},"2":{"text":"Tumasangin ka hing hilta hi. Na kung ua Kang haw aniveina a, na kung ua ka um lai a ka gen bangin, tuin na kung ua umlou in, tumasanga sil bawlkhielte leh mi dang zousie kungah ka hing gen masah ahi, ka hing hawkia chiengin ka dawm sih ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nouten Khrist in Keima a thu agen khu theichienna na sui zieh un, Ama noute lam ah ahatlou sih a, na lah uoh silbawlthei tah ahi zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama hatlouna ziehin kilbeh in um nanleh Pasian silbawltheinain ahing ahi. Aziehpen koute zong Ama ah hatlou ka hi ua, hinanleh Pasian silbawltheinain noute lam ah Ama toh ka hingkhawm ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Ginna ah na umna uoi mah nouma leh nouma ki enchien unlen, kithei chien un. Nouma ah Jesu Khrist aum chi theilou na hi uoi mah? Tuachilouin na chinglakha ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Koute achinglou ka hi sih uh chi nang thei uh ka gingta hi."},"7":{"text":"Silgilou na bawllouna dingun tuin Pasian kung ah thu ka ngen hi, tuapen koute achinga ka kilatna ding uh ahi sih a, noute mitmu ah achinglou himaithei nan u’leng nouten apahtat huoi silte na bawltheina dingun thu ka ngen uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen thutah douin bangma ka bawl thei sih ua, thutah a ding ngen ka bawl uhi."},"9":{"text":"Koute ka hatlou ua, noute na hat chiengun ka kipah uhi. Tami zong ka thumna uh ahi, tuapen noute pichinsah a na umna dinguh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin suse ding hilou a, bawl hoi zaw dinga Mangpa’n ahing pieh thuneina dungzui a ka hing vau louna dingin na kung ua ka umlou pet in tam silte ka hing giel hi."},"11":{"text":"Unaute aw, atawpna pen in Mangpha, hing piching unlen, Hamuongtahin um unlen, lungsim munkhat puoin um un, kituohtah in um un, Itna leh lungmuonna Pasian noute toh a um ding hi.","title":"Thutawpna"},"12":{"text":"Kitawpna siengthouin khatlekhat kinousiet un."},"13":{"text":"Misiengthoute zousie in noute mangpha ang hah uhi."},"14":{"text":"Mangpa Jesu Khrist hepina leh Pasian itna leh Hagau Siengthou kipawlpina, noute toh umta hen. Amen."}}}}},"48":{"info":{"name":"Galatia","shortname":"Gal.","abbr":[],"desc":"Galatia mite kunga sawltah paul laihah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, sawltah mihinga kipat a sawl hilou, mihing vang zong hilou in, Jesu Khrist leh Pa Pasian mishi lah akipata Ama Kaithoupa, vang a hi zaw hi.","title":"Nousietna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh ka kunga um sanggamte zousie in, Galatia gam a um hattuomte kungah;"},"3":{"text":"Pa Pasian leh i hundampa uh Jesu Khrist akipat, hepina leh hamuonna noute kungah um hen."},"4":{"text":"Ama pen Pasian leh i Pa uh deidan dungzuiin tulai gitlouna leitung a kipat ahing huhdoh theina dingin, ikhelnate ziehin, Ama leh Ama akipeta hi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian kungah thupina kumtawn kumtawn in umdenta hen. Amen."},"6":{"text":"Khrist hepina a noute hing hanpa taisan a tukikaal a, khantanhoi tuom khat lam a na kiheisan pai uh lamdang ka sa hi.","title":"Khantanhoi dang a um sih"},"7":{"text":"Tuapen khantanhoi tuom ahi sih a, hinanleh noute hing subuoi in, Khrist khantanhoi a hiloulama heikawi ut mi pawlkhat a um uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh koute lah a mi nangawn hiin, van a kipat vansawlsiengte hitaleh, na kung ua ka gensa uh chilou khantanhoi dang mawngmawng na kung ua hing gen a um leh samsiet in um heh."},"9":{"text":"Tumasang lai a ka gensa mabangun, tuin ka gen kia ahi; khantanhoi na pomsa uh chilou khantanhoi dang mi koipou in na kung ua ahing gen leh samsiet in um heh."},"10":{"text":"Ken tuin mihing pahtat law sawm ka hiei, ahisihleh Pasian pahtat? Ahisihleh mihingte suhlungkim sawm ka hiei mah? Mihingte suhlungkim sawm ka hi nahlai leh, Khrist suoh ka hi sih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Unaute aw, ka khantanhoi gen khu mihing lam thu ahi sih chi ka hing thei sah ahi.","title":"Hepina khantanhoi Pasian pieh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen mihing a kipat ka mu ahi sih a, mihing hil zong ka hi sih hi, hinanleh Jesu Khrist kilahna zieh a ka mu ahi bou hi."},"13":{"text":"Masanglai a Juda mite biehna dan ka zui lai a, ka hindan masa, bangchi banga Pasian hattuom te akaan avala bawl in suhmang ka tup dan, nouten na zata uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 8.3; 22.4,5; 26.9-11"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh ka pu leh pate thugousie a phattuom ka ngai seng ziehin, Juda mite biehna dan lam ah zong ka nampite lah a ka khanguol tampi sangin ka tallang zaw hi.","ref":"Nasep. 22.3"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh ka nu gilsunga ka umlai a pat a, hing na koituompa leh ahepina a hing hanpa Pasian in;","ref":"Nasep. 9.3-6; 22.6-10; 26.13-18"},"16":{"text":"Jentelte lah a Ama khantanhoi ka gen theina ding a, A Tapa keima a kilatsah pha asah laiin mihing koima toh ka kihou sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Jerusalem khuo a, kei sanga sawltah na hi masate kungah zong ka haw tou sih a, Arabia gam ah ka pei zaw a, tuachi’n Damaska khuo ah ka hing kilekiata hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n kum thum nuain Peter toh kimu dingin Jerusalem ah ka haw tou a, ama kungah ni sawm leh ni nga ka um hi.","ref":"Nasep. 9.26-30"},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa sanggampa Jakob chilou sawltah dangte khatbeh ka mu sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuin na kung ua ka thu gelte tungtang ah Pasian mai ah, zuou ka gen sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua zouin Siria leh Silisia gamkai sungah ka peita hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Khrist a um, Judia gam a hattuomten ahing melthei nai sih uhi."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh “Tumasanglai a eite hing bawlgentheipa’n, khat vei lai a asuhsiet sa ginna thu khu tuin atangkoupita,” chi thu bou aza uhi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh amauten keima ziehin Pasian apahtawita uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n kum sawm leh kum li nuain, Barnaba toh Jerusalem ah ka peitou kia ua, tualeh Tita zong ka pui uhi.","title":"Paul nasepna Jerusalem a pom ahina","ref":"Nasep. 11.30; 15.2"},"2":{"text":"Kilahna ka mu dungzuiin ka pei touta a, Jentelte kunga ka khantanhoi gen khu akung uah ka gensawn kia a, hinanleh mi zatat um deute pen atuom in ka hil hi, tuachilou in pen, amawhna a tai ka hi kha ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh ka kunga ka umpi Tita nangawn Greekmi hinapi teptan sah teitei ahi sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh tam teptan thupen Koite ahiei in atahtah hilou unaute ilah ua guhsima ahing puilut zieh ua hing um ahi. Amauten eite suoh ahing hi sah theina ding ua, Khrist Jesu a inoplenna nei uh guhsima hing enkhie ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Khantanhoi thutah noute kunga a umden theina dingin naikal khat sung maimai zong amaute thunuoi ah ka kipelut vawt sih uhi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh mi zatat um deu a kigente khu, bangchibang na hita u’leh zong, kei dingin bangma lamdanna anei sih a; Pasian in koima deisah tuom anei sih a, mi thupi deu a kigenten bangma ahing gen pieh tuom sih uhi.","ref":"Danp. 10.17"},"7":{"text":"Genpieh nahsangin, teptante dinga khantanhoi Peter kunga ngansie a aum bangin, teptanloute dinga khantanhoi ka tungah ngansie in a um chi athei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen teptante sawltah hi dinga Peter guotpa ngelngel in, Jentelte kunga sawltah hi dingin keima zong ahing guot hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh hattuom khuompi bang hiel a um, Jakob, Peter leh Johan in ka kunga hepina hing kipie athei bep un, koute gel Jentelte kunga pei dingin, tualeh amaute teptante kunga pei dingin, Kei leh Barnaba kipawlkhawmna khut zietlam ahing pie uhi."},"10":{"text":"Migentheite ka thei zing dinguh adei ua, tuapen ken zong bawl ka tup mawng ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Antiok khuo a Peter ahing haw tahin amaitang ah kana phawhthop hi, aziehpen ama mawsah a umzieh ahi.","title":"Paul in Peter aphawhna"},"12":{"text":"Jakob akipat mi koite ahiei ahing haw masangun Jentelte kungah ann ane zel a, hinanleh amaute ahing haw tahun, teptante agiin ziehin anuatawn a aum tuomta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Judami dangten zong ama lepchie dan azui ua, Barnaba nangawn puimangin aum hi."},"14":{"text":"Khantanhoi thutah toh kituohin aum sih uh chi ka mu tahin, Peter kungah, “Nang Juda mi hinapi a Judate um banga umlou a, Jentelte um banga na um ngal leh bang dinga Jentelte Judate tawndan zui sah na tup ahiei” chi’n amaute zousie mai ah ka phawh hi."},"15":{"text":"Eite pen Juda mi mawnga pieng i hi ua, Jentel mikhielte ihi sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Dan nasepte ziehin mi siemtangin a um sih a, Jesu Khrist gintatna ziehin siemtangin a um uh chi ithei uhi, eiten zong dan sil bawlte zieh hilou a, Khrist ginna zieh a siemtanga i um theina dingin Khrist Jesu igingta uhi; aziehpen dan silte bawl ziehin koima siemtangin a um sih ding hi.","ref":"Late. 143.2; Rom. 3.20; Rom. 3.22"},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Khrist a siemtanga um tum kawmpia eima ngel zong mikhielte ina hi leh, Khrist khu khelna nasempa hita ven izaw? Hi vawtlou."},"18":{"text":"Keima’n ka suhsietsa silte bawlpha kiata leng, dan botsepa ka hi chi ka kilangsah giap ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian lam a ka hin theina dingin kei pen dan ziehin dan lam ah ka shita hi."},"20":{"text":"Khrist toh kilbehin ka umta hi, hinanleh ka hing ahi, Keima hing hi nawnlouin, Khrist keima ah hing ahizaw hi; tua tahsa a ka hinna pen, Kei hing it a, kei a dinga hing kipumpiehpa Pasian Tapa ginna a hing ka hi."},"21":{"text":"Ken Pasian hepina bangmalou ka suohsah sih hi, aziehpen dan zieh a siemtanna um hita leh Khrist athawn a shi ahi ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Galatia mimote aw, na mitmu ngel ua, na lah ua, Jesu Khrist khu killup ahi chi kichientahin alangta hi, tua thu khu zuilou dinga, koiin noute hing bum modoh ahi tai le?","title":"Ginna a Hagau Siengthou pieh ahi"},"2":{"text":"Noute akipat tami thei ka ut hi, Dan zuina nasepte zieh a Hagau thu na nga uh ahiei, ahisihleh na thu zah uh na gintat zieh uh ahiei?"},"3":{"text":"Bangdinga hichi mot talawm na hi uoi? Hagau thu a pan zouta ngal a, tahsa nasep a suhbukim sawm na hi uh amah?"},"4":{"text":"Sil tuazapi amawhna a thuoh na hi uoi mah? Amawhna bang na hita leh."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin na kung ua Hagau hing pepa leh na lah ua sillamdang bawlpa in, dan nasepte ziehin ahiei abawl, ahisihleh na ngaikhiet ua na gintatna zieh uh ahiei?"},"6":{"text":"Abraham in Pasian agingta a, “Tua agintatna khu dihtatna a simpieh ahi.”","ref":"Siem. 15.6; Rom. 4.3"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin ginna nei mite khu Abraham tate ahi uh chi thei un.","ref":"Rom. 4.16"},"8":{"text":"Laisiengthouin, ginna ziehin Pasian in Jentelte siem atangsah ding chi mu masa in, Abraham kungah, “Nangma ah nam zousie guolzawl in a um ding uh,” chi’n khantanhoi ana gen masata hi.","ref":"Siem. 12.3"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n ginna neite pen miginum Abraham toh guolzawl khawm in a um uhi."},"10":{"text":"Dan nasepte a kinga poumate pen gausapna nuoi a um ahi uh; “Aziehpen dan laibu sunga bawl dinga kigiel zousiete zui zinglou pouma gausapin um uheh” chi’n akigiel hi.","title":"Dan hamsietna kipat Khrist in a hing tandohta","ref":"Danp. 27.26"},"11":{"text":"Pasian mai ah koima dan a siemtang a um sih uh chi akichien hi, “Aziehpen mi dihtat ginna in ahing ding,” chi ahi.","ref":"Haba. 2.4"},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh dan pen ginna ah akinga sih a, “Tuanahsangin tuabang bawl mite pen tuate ah ahing ding hi,” chi ahi.","ref":"Siempu. 18.5"},"13":{"text":"Khrist khu eite sih leh taanga sapsiet a hing um in, dan sapsietna akipat in ahing tandohta hi; aziehpen “Tambangin akigiel hi, Singdawn a khailup pouma sapsietna thuoh ahi uhi.”","ref":"Danp. 21.23"},"14":{"text":"Tuapen Abraham tunga guolzawlna khu, Khrist Jesu zieh a Jentelte tunga ahing tun theina ding leh eiten ginna zieh a, Pasian chiemsa Hagau i nga theina ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Unaute aw, mihing dan in ka gen ahi, tam pen mihing thuhun hitamananleh, akinamdet tah chiengin, Koiman aphel ngai sih a, belap zong akibelap ngai sih hi.","title":"Dan leh thuchiem"},"16":{"text":"Tuin Abraham leh ahahasuonte kungah, thuchiemte a pie hi. Aman mi tampite gen bangin, “Nahahlesuonte” kungah achi sih a, “Mi khat gen in nahahlesuon” kungah, achi zaw hi, tua khu Khrist ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh tami ka gen ahi, Pasian in Khrist a asuhdetsa thuhun khu kum zali leh kum sawm thum nua a hing um danin thuchiem khu aphietmang thei sih a, bangmalou suo dingin asumang sih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 12.40"},"18":{"text":"Gouluona pen dan a kinga hileh pen, thuchiem a kinga ahi sih ding hi; hinanleh Pasian in gouluonapen thuchiem ziehin Abraham kungah ana peta hi.","ref":"Rom. 4.14"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahileh dan in atup bang hi ding ahiei leh? Tam pen hahlesuon, akunga thuchiem pieh a umpa ahing pei masangsie bawsietna ziehin belapin a um a, vansawlsiengte zanga palai khuta pieh ahi.","title":"Dan siltup khu"},"20":{"text":"Tuin palai pen mi khat guoh palai ahi sih a, hinanleh Pasian pen khat ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahileh dan khu Pasian thuchiem kal ahiei mah? Kal vawtlou, hinna pe thei dan ana kipie hitaleh siemtansahna khu dan ziehin ana umta ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh Laisiengthou in sil zousie khelna thuneina nuoi ah akhahkhum ta hi, tua pen agingtate kunga Jesu Khrist gintatna zieh a tua thuchiem atangtun sah theina ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ginna ahing tun masangin dan nuoi a kepin ina um a, ahing kilang ding ginna ah khahkhum in ina um uhi.","title":"Dan apat gingtute zalenna"},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin dan khu ginna zieh a siem itan theina ding ua, Khrist kunga hing pui dinga eite hing hilpa ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh ginna ahing tun nuain, eite hing hilpa nuoi ah i um nawn sih uhi."},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen na unpi un Khrist Jesu ginna ziehin Pasian tate na hi uhi."},"27":{"text":"Aziehpen na lah ua Khrist a baptisma tang pouma pen Khrist a kivon na hita uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuanah Juda leh Greek a um nawn sih a, sila leh zalen a um nawn sih a, tualeh numei leh pasal zong a um nawn sih hi, aziehpen noute na unpi un Khrist Jesu ah pumkhat na hita uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tualeh Khrist a na hi taah u’leh Abraham hahlesuon, thuchiem dungzui a gouluo dingte na hi uhi.","ref":"Rom. 4.13"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka gen khu tami ahi, gouluo dingpa pen bangkim neipa hinapiin naupang ahi laisie suoh toh kilamdanna anei tuom sih hi.","title":"Khrist gintatna zieh a Pasian ta hina"},"2":{"text":"Apa hun guot atun masangsie’n, ama don mite leh kem mite thunuoi ah a um hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuabangma in eite zong naupang ihi lai in leitung thubul kihilnate ah koltangin ina um uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh ahun guot bukim tah a ahing tun tah in, Pasian in A Tapa ang sawl a, Ama dan nuoi ah numei akipat ahing pieng hi."},"5":{"text":"Ta hina itan theina dinga, dan nuoi a umte hing tandoh ding in, Pasian in ahing sawl hi.","ref":"Rom. 8.15-17"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tate na hi zieh un, Pasian in a Tapa Hagau khu na lungtang sung uah ahing sawl a tua Hagau khu Abba Pa chia kikou khepa ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin noute suoh na hi nawnta sih ua; ta na hita uhi, tualeh a ta na hileh, Khrist zal a Pasian gouluopa ding zong na hita hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian na theilou lai un, piendan mawnga pasien hiloute nasem in na um uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh tu a Pasian na hing thei nua ua ahisihleh Pasian in ahing thei mi na hizaw nua ua, bangdinga thubul zawngkhal leh panna beite suoh a lutkia ut a, kilehei kia na hi uoi?"},"10":{"text":"Nite, hate, hunte leh kumte na tang zel ua,"},"11":{"text":"Na tung ua ka sepgimna athawn ahi khah ding ka zau hi."},"12":{"text":"Unaute aw ka hing ngen ahi, keima bangin um un, Kei zong nouma bangin ka um hi, ka tungah bawlkhiel na nei sih uhi."},"13":{"text":"Na kung ua khantanhoi ka gen masahna pen khu tahsa hatlouna zieh ahi chi na thei uhi."},"14":{"text":"Ka tahsa a dammawna pen, kei a dinga hasatna hinanleh na simmaw sih ua, nuol zong nahing nuol sih uhi, hinanleh Pasian vansawlsieng bang leh Jesu Khrist bang khopin na hing pom zaw u hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahileh vangpha na kisahna uh uh bang suoh atai leh? Hithei hileh na mittangte nangawn uh kheikhie in kei na hing pe nuom ding uh chi ka thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Thutah ka hing hil zieh a, na melma uh hing hita ka hiei mah?"},"17":{"text":"Amauten phatuom ngaitahin noute ahing sui ua, tuakhu ahoilam ahi sih hi, nouten amaute na sui theina ding ua, ahing puse sawm ahi zaw uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh bangchihlaipouin sil hoi phatuomngaitah a sui zing a um ahoi hi, na kung ua ka um sung guoh hilou in."},"19":{"text":"Ka ta deitahte aw, nouma a Khrist siem pichinga aum masangsie’n nau suoh nat vei in ka hing vei kia hi."},"20":{"text":"Tumama in noute kungah um in, ka aw suoh heng thei leng ut va-ia tei ing e, na tung thu uh ka hing lunggimpi hi."},"21":{"text":"Hing hil vawi un, nou dan nuoia um utte, danthu ngaikhe lou na hi uoi mah?","title":"Hepina leh dan umkhawm theilou"},"22":{"text":"Aziehpen tambangin ana kigiel hi: Abraham in tapa ni anei a, khat khu suohnu akipat ahia, adangkhat pen noplen nu a pata pieng ahi.","ref":"Siem. 16.15; Siem. 21.2"},"23":{"text":"Suohnu apata pieng tapa pen tahsa dan a pieng ahi a, noplennu akipat a pieng tapa pen thuchiem zieh a pieng, thuchiem tapa ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tam thute etsahna nei ahi uhi. Tam numei nite khu thuhun nite ahi uhi, khat pen Sinai muol apat saltang dinga ta neinu ahia, tua khu Hagar ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hagar pen Arabia gam a Sinai muol etsahna ahia, ama tulai a Jerusalem a um atate toh sal taangkhawm kigenna ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hinanleh tunglam Jerusalem pen a noplen a, tuakhu eite zousie nu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Azieh pen: “Nang ta neilou a chiing nu, nuom in, Nang nauvei natna thuohlou nu, kikoukhiein, pasal neinu sangin lungzuong nu’n, ta tampi anei zaw hi” chi’n akigiel hi.","ref":"Isai. 54.1"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n unaute eite pen Isaak banga thuchiem tate ihi uhi."},"29":{"text":"Hinanleh khum hun lai a tahsa dan a pieng tapa in, Hagau dan a pieng tapa abawlsiet bangin tuin zong tuabang ahi.","ref":"Siem. 21.9"},"30":{"text":"Ahivang in Laisiengthouin bang agen ei? “Suohnu pen atapa toh notmang un, suohnu tapa in noplen nu tapa toh gou aluokhawm sih ding hi,” chi’n akigiel hi.","ref":"Siem. 21.10"},"31":{"text":"Tuaziehin unaute eite pen suohnu tate ihi sih ua, noplen nu tate ihizaw uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin suoh hi nawnlou dingin Khrist in eite ahing zalen sahta hi, tuachi’n dingdet unlen suoh hahkol ah awhkia nawn sih un.","title":"Khrist a zalenna"},"2":{"text":"Ngai un Kei Paul in na kung uah ka gen hi, tep na tan laisie uh Khrist noute adingin bangma phatuom lou ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Teptante zousie kungah, dan zousie zui ding na bat ahi, chi ka hing theisah kia hi."},"4":{"text":"Dan zieh a siemtansahna nga tum noute, Khrist toh na kikhenta ua, hepina na puasanta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh kouten Hagau ziehin ginna a siemtanna kinepna khu thanuom tahin ka ngah uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen Jesu Khrist ah teptan leh teptan louin bangma phattuomna anei sih hi, hinanleh itna zieh a sep ginna khu aphatuom hi."},"7":{"text":"Hoitahin na tai uhi, thutah zuina a kipat noute hing dal koi ahiei?"},"8":{"text":"Tam banga kizawllungdamna pen noute hing hanpa a kipat ahi sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Tol tawmnoukhat in tanghou pheng pumpi athousah hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 5.6"},"10":{"text":"Nouten lungsim dang nei sih va uteh chi Mangpa ah ka hing muong hi, hinanleh koi hinanleh noute hing subuoi mi in thukhenna athuoh ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Unaute aw, ken teptan thu gen nalai ka hileh bang zieh a bawlsietna thuoh nalai ka diei? Tuachi ahileh Kross a kipalpuana khu suhbei ahita ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Noute hing subuoite ama uleh amauh kisatkhe vanglah u’leh ka ut hi."},"13":{"text":"Unaute aw, noute zalen dinga hat na hi uhi, na zalenna uh pen tahsa dinga lemtannain zang sih unlen, itnain khat leh khat nna kisep pieh zaw un.","title":"Khat leh khat ki it tuochiet un"},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen “Nangma na ki it bangin, na innvengte na it ding ahi,” chi thuteng khatah dan zousie suhbukim in aum hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.18"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh noute khat leh khat na kikeituo ua, na kinehtuo u’leh na kisuhmang louna dingun pilvang un."},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n tami ka gen ahi, Hagau ah um un, tuachi’n na tahsa utna uh na sutangtung sih ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen tahsain Hagau adou a, Hagau in tahsa a dou hi sil nabawl tupte uh nabawl theilouna dingun, tamte gel akikaltuo zel uhi.","ref":"Rom. 7.15-23"},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh Hagau pui a na um u’leh, dan nuoia um na hi sih uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuin tahsa silbawlte akilang chien hi, tuate pen tamte ahi; angkawmna, kingaina, thanghuoina, sienthoulouna, numei pasal kaal a pahtatna,","title":"Tahsa utna nasepte"},"20":{"text":"milimbiehna, bumna, kimudana, kihauna, thangsietna, lungthahna, kilangbawlna, huoihamna, kiselna, gintuomna;"},"21":{"text":"Deigawna, tuolthana, zukhamna, uongtatna leh tambang gamtatna dangdangte ahi, tambang a um miten Pasian gam aluo sih ding uhi, chia masang laia ka hing hil tah mabangin, ka hing hil khol ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hagau gate ahileh, Itna, kipahna, lungmuonna, thuohhatna, zainemna, hoina, ginumna;","title":"Hagau gate"},"23":{"text":"Thunuoilutna, kidehtheina, ahi, tambangte toh kikal dan a um sih hi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh Khrist a hita miten tahsa a a utnate u’leh adeigaw leh lunggulnate u’toh akilbehta uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hagau a hing ihi u’leh Hagau ma ah i um ding uhi."},"26":{"text":"Khat leh khat kilangbawl leh kithangsiet in um sih vai in, amawh a kithupisah itum sih ding uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Unaute aw, mi koi ahiei khat atatkhelzieha mat a aum leh nou Hagau miten, nangma zong solna na tuoh khah ding ngaituoin tuabang mi khu nun nemtahin tungding kia un.","title":"Puohgih kidawn jang un"},"2":{"text":"Khat leh khat na puohgihte uh kidawn chiet un, tuachi’n Khrist dan zuikim un."},"3":{"text":"Mi koipou bangma hilou napi a, ama leh ama akingai sang leh ama leh ama kisol ahi."},"4":{"text":"Michin in ama nasep ki etchien chiet zaw heh, tuachi’n midang tung ah hilou in, ama tungah akisiel thei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen mi chinin ama puoh chiet akipuoh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Thu hil a umpa in ahilpa kung ah silhoi pe phal heh."},"7":{"text":"Sol in umsih un, Pasian pen simmaw guol ahi sih hi, aziehpen mi’n atu phot uh tua ma a at ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen tahsa lam a tu miin tahsa lam a sietna a at dinga, hinanleh Hagau lam a tu miin Hagau a kumtawn hinna a at ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n silhoi bawl chimtah sih va ui, ilungkieh sih nah pouleh ahun tahin i at ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin hunlemtaang inei bang zelin mi zousie kungah silhoi bawl va ui."},"11":{"text":"Keima khut ngel a na kung ua, lai teng lienpi a ka hing gel en un.","title":"Galgihna leh lamdotna nukhia"},"12":{"text":"Tahsalam a mite pahtat lunggul miten teptan dingin noute ahing sawl teitei uhi, bangdang zieh hilouin, amauten Khrist Kross zieh a, bawlsietna athuoh louna ding un ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen Teptante nangawn in Dan azui sih uhi. Hinanleh amauten na tahsa tung ua akisiel nop man ua teptan dinga noute ang dei uh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh Ken vang i Mangpa Khrist Kross loungal ka suong sih ding hi, Ama ziehin leitung kei ding in kilbeh ahita a, Kei leitunga dingin kilbeh ka hita hi."},"15":{"text":"Khrist Jesu ah pen siemtana loungal, teptan bangma aphattuom sih a, teptanlou zong bangma aphatuom sih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tam dan zui mi zousiete tungah lungmuonna leh hepina umta hen, Israelte Pasian tung ah zong um hen."},"17":{"text":"Tua kipat in koiman hing subuoi nawn sih heh, aziehpen ka tahsa ah Mangpa Jesu chiemtena ka puo hi."},"18":{"text":"Unaute aw, i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist hepina khu noute kungah umta hen, Amen."}}}}},"49":{"info":{"name":"Ephesa","shortname":"Eph.","abbr":[],"desc":"Ephesa mite kunga sawltah paul laihah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul Pasian deilam a, Jesu Khrist sawltahin Ephesa khuo a um misiengthoute leh Khrist a mi gin umte kungah,","title":"Nousietna","ref":"Nasep. 18.19-21; 19.1"},"2":{"text":"Pasian i Pa u’leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist kunga kipat hepina leh hamuonna na kung uah umta hen."},"3":{"text":"I Mangpa Jesu Khrist Pasian leh pa phat in um ta hen. Aman van munte a hagaulam guolzawlna chintengin, Khrist ah eite ahing guolzawlta hi.","title":"Pasian phatna"},"4":{"text":"Ama mai a siengthou leh genbanglou a i um theina dingin, leitung kisiem masang in Khrist ah eite itna ziehin ahing telta hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama kipahna leh deilam banga Jesu Khrist zal a, Ama tate hi dingin eite itna in ahing na guotlawhta hi."},"6":{"text":"A hepina thupidan pahtawi thei dinga tua amanbei a ahing piehpa ah ittahin eite ahing pomta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama ah Asisan ziehin tatdohna ineita a, ahepina haudan dungzuiin ikhelnate a ngaidam hi.","title":"Tapa a tatdohna","ref":"Kolo. 1.14"},"8":{"text":"Tua hepina ah Aman pilna leh lemtheina zousie eite lam ah ahing kiching sah hi."},"9":{"text":"Aman adeilam a Ama-a abawl atup bangin alungtup Ama kipahna hoitah thuguh eite kunga ahing theisah bangin;"},"10":{"text":"Hunbi khenna bukim ahing tun chienga Ama a van a sil umte leh leitunga sil umte zousie a unpi a Khrist a khat a suhtuokhawmna dingin;"},"11":{"text":"Ama lunggel bang zela sil bangkim bawlpa siltup dungzui a guotlawhsa hita in Ama ah gouluo dinga guot ihita uhi."},"12":{"text":"Eite Khrist a muonna na nei masate athupina pahtawina ihi theina ding uh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ama ah noute zong thutah thu, na hundamna uh khantanhoi na zah nua ua, gin zong na gintat nua un Ama ah chiemsa Hagau Siengthou a chiemte in na um uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tua khu Pasian thupina pahtawina dinga gou aleisa, aneisate tatdohna hun masangsie a igouluo ding uh khaam na ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin ken zong Mangpa Jesu a na ginna u’leh, misiengthoute zousie tunga na itna uh ka na zah nua in,","title":"Thungetna"},"16":{"text":"Ka thungetnate ah na min uh louin noute zieha kipahthugen ka tawp sih hi,"},"17":{"text":"I Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist Pasian, thupina Pa in Ama theina lam thu a pilna leh kilaahna hagau noute ahing pieh theina dingin;"},"18":{"text":"Na lungsim mitte uh vahsah a hing um a, Ama hing hatna kinepna bang, ahiei chi na theina ding u’leh, misiengthoute a A goutan ding thupina hausatnate bang,"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh A silbawltheina thahatna nasep dungzui a ei Ama gingtate lam a, a silbawltheina thupi dan bang ahiei chi na theina ding uh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Mishi lah a kipat a Khrist akaithaw a van munte a, Ama zietlam a, atousah lai a, Khrist tunga abawl silbawltheina nasep ma khu ahi.","ref":"Late. 110.1"},"21":{"text":"Tuate zousie ban ah, vaihawmnate, thuneinate, silbawltheinate leh tu hun guoh hilou a, ahing tung ding hun donga, min kiphuo zousie tunglam peh ah Ama atousah hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Aman sil zousie Akeng nuoi ah akoita a, Ama pen sil zousie tunga lutang hi dingin hattuom kungah apie hi.","ref":"Late. 8.6; Kolo. 1.18"},"23":{"text":"Tua khu Atahsa ahi, bangkim a bangkim sudimpa kitangchinna ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh noute na bawsietna u’leh na khelna zieh ua shi khu ahing hingsah a,","title":"Hundam na khu hepina zieh ahi","ref":"Kolo. 2.13"},"2":{"text":"Tuate sungah tumasang lai in tam leitung danbangin na um ua, huikhuo a thunei vaihawmpa, tu hun a thumang lou tate sunga nasempa hagau dan bangin na hing uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua thumanglou tate lah ah eite zong tumasang laiin itahsa utna ah, itahsa leh ilungsim deilam supichingin i um uhi; tualeh piendan mawnga mi dangte bangin lungthahna tate ina hi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh khotuona hau Pasian in a itna thupitah ziehin eite ahing it hi.","title":"Pasian lam a hinna tha"},"5":{"text":"Khiel a shi ihi lai nangawn un zong Khrist toh ahing hing sah khawmta a, hepina a hundam na hi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh Ama toh ahing kaithou khawmta a, van munte ah, Khrist Jesu ah, ahing toukhawmsahta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n hun hing tung dingte ah, Khrist Jesu zieha i tunga ahoina-a ahepina hausatna thupidan a hing ensah thei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Hepina zieh a ginna a hundam na hi uhi, tua zong nouma a kipat a piengkhie ahi sih a, Pasian silthawnpieh ahi zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Nasep zieh ahi sih hi, tuachilouin mi’n akiletsahpi kha ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen eite silhoi bawl dinga, Khrist Jesu a siem a um, Ama khutsuoh ihi uhi, tua silhoi bawl khu Pasian in masang lai peh a i umna dinga ana guotlawhsa ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin tu masang lai a Jentelte, tahsa khuta tan teptan achite un, teptanlou ahing chite uh,","title":"Judate leh Jentelte kilemkiana"},"12":{"text":"Tua hun lai in noute Khrist neilou na hi ua, Israel khuo leh tui hina apat pulam mi na hi ua, thuchiem thuhun apat mikhuol, kinepna neilou leh leitunga Pasian neilou na hi uh, theizing un."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin vang, ni danglai a gamlapi a um noute Khrist sisan ziehin, Pasian in Khrist Jesu ah Ama toh ahing kinai sahta hi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama eite kilemna ahi a, ikikaal a kideidanna banglai asuchimta a, nite khu pumkhat in abawlta hi."},"15":{"text":"Dan thupieh sunga thuguot umte kimelmatna khu atahsa a sumangin, Ama a nite khu mihing tha khat a siem dingin kilemna abawl hi.","ref":"Kolo. 2.14"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh kimelmatna khu Kross ah ashisahta a, tua ashina in nite khu tahsapum khat in Pasian toh ahing kilemsah ta hi.","ref":"Kolo. 1.20"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Ama ahing pei a, nou gamlapia umte kungah lemna khantanhoi ahing gen a, tualeh nainoukhat a umte kungah zong agen hi.","ref":"Isai. 57.19"},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama ziehin eiten Hagau khat in Pa kunga lut theina inei tuohtuoh uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuin vang mikhuol leh gamdang mi na hinawn sih ua, misiengthoute toh khotuol khat leh Pasian innkuonte na hi zawta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Sawltahte leh guolneite suongphum tungah noute ahing lamtou hi, Jesu Khrist khu aninga suong poimaw pen ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ama ah tua inn kilam zousie a unpi in kituohtah in asutuo a, Mangpa ah biehinn siengthouin akhangtou hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama ah noute zong Hagau a Pasian tenna dinga lepkhawm na hi uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tami ziehin Kei Paul, nou Jentelte dinga suongkul taangpa in,","title":"Thuguh kiphuol kilahna"},"2":{"text":"Noute dinga Pasian hepina nasepna kei ang kepsah dan na zata tham ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tua khu kilahna a thuguh kiphuol ka kunga ahing theisah, tumasanga tomnoukhat a na kung ua ka hing gel thute, khu ahi;"},"4":{"text":"Tuate na sim chieng un, Khrist thuguh kiphuol ka theidan na theisiem ding uhi.","ref":"Kolo. 1.26,27"},"5":{"text":"Tua khu abeisa hun dang ah Pasian in tam thuguh kiphuol mihingte kungah tambangin alangsah ngai sih hi; tuin vang sawltah siengthoute leh guolneite kungah, A Hagau ziehin alangsahta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua khu tami ahi, Khantanhoi ziehin Khrist ah Jentelte khu gouluopite, tahsa khat a umte, thuchiem tanpite ahi ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Asilbawltheina nasepna a athawn a Pasian hepina hing kipie dungzui a, tua khantanhoi nasem dinga siem ka hing hita hi."},"8":{"text":"Misiengthoute zousie lah a neupen sanga neu zaw Kei kungah, Khrist hamsatna suiseng guollou thute Jentelte kunga gen dinga tam hepina pieh ka hi."},"9":{"text":"Kumtawn a kipat a Jesu Khrist tungtawn a sil zousie siempa Pasian a phuol a um; tua thuguh kiphuol kipawlkhawmna khu mi zousie musah dingin."},"10":{"text":"Pasian in atup pen khu, Pasian pilna thuo tampi van munte a vaihawmna leh thuneinate kunga hattuom zieh a tu hun a theisah a aum theina ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Akumtawn siltup dungzui in i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist ah asemkheta hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama iginna ziehin eiten Ama ah hansanna leh kimuongtah a lut theina inei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin noute dinga ka thuohgimnate zieha lungkelou dingin ka hing ngen hi, tuakhu na thupina uh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tami ziehin i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist Pa mai ah ka khupdin a,","title":"Ephesate dinga thungetna"},"15":{"text":"Lei leh van a innkuon chinteng min kiphuokhieh napa mai ah,"},"16":{"text":"Athupina haudan dungzui a, A Hagau zieh a mihing sung lam a silbawltheina a suhhat a ahing umsah theina dingin;"},"17":{"text":"Khrist khu ginna a na lungtang ua aten theina dingin, noute itna a huiha leh buldet tah a uma,"},"18":{"text":"misiengthoute zousie toh aletdan, asaudan leh athuhdan, na theichien theina ding u’leh,"},"19":{"text":"Khrist itna theiphah guollou, na hing thei ua, Pasian kiningchinna zousie toh suhdim a na hing um theina ding un."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n eima sunga semzel silbawltheina dungzui a inget leh ingaituo sanga thupizaw a bawltheipa kungah;"},"21":{"text":"Ama kungah, Khrist Jesu ziehin hattuom ah kumtawn in akhang akhangin, tawpni neilou in thupina umdenta hen, Amen."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin, kei Mangpa a suongkul taangpa in hat a na umna u’toh kituoh a gamta dingin ka hing ngen hi.","title":"Kipumkhat a um dinga hanthawnna"},"2":{"text":"Kingaingiemna leh nunnemna zousie, thuohzouna toh itna kithuohzou tuo chiet in um un.","ref":"Kolo. 3.12,13"},"3":{"text":"Lemna gui a kaankhawm Hagau kipumkhatna tudet chinten un;"},"4":{"text":"Hat a na umna pen uh, kinepna mun khat a hat na hi bangun, tahsa khat leh Hagau khat a um in,"},"5":{"text":"Mangpa khat, ginna khat, baptisma khat,"},"6":{"text":"Pasian khat leh mizousie Pa, bangkim tunga um leh bangkim a um, tualeh noute zousie a um, a um hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Khrist silthawnpie tena dungzui in hepina eite kung chiet ah ahing pie hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aman, “Tunglam a akaltou lai in, matte sal in apui a, tualeh mihingte kungah silpieh te apie hi,” chiin agen hi.","ref":"Late. 68.18"},"9":{"text":"“Akaltou” akichi leh amasa in lei mun ngiem pen ah ahing kum suh hi, chilou bangdang china ahi diei?"},"10":{"text":"Akumsuh penpa khu sil zousie asuhbukim theina dinga van zousie tunglam peh a, kaltoupa ma khu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ama mama in pawlkhat sawltah hina, pawlkhat guolnei hina, pawlkhat khantanhoi genna, pawlkhat Pastor hina, tualeh pawlkhat thuhilmi hina, apie hi."},"12":{"text":"Misiengthouten Khrist tahsa bawlhoina nna sem dinga akivon theina ding un;"},"13":{"text":"Ginna leh Pasian Tapa theina lam a kipumkhat a, pichinga, Khrist bukimna latdan banga ihing um masangsie un,"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n dihlouna solna leh lepchie pila mihing sol a uma, thuhilna huipi chintengin alang alanga asem leeng kawi kawi naupangte ihi nawn sih ding a;"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh itna a thutah gen in, sil bangkim ah Ama lutang hipa Khrist a ikhantou theina ding un;"},"16":{"text":"Aman Ama a kipat in tahsa pumpi a unpi in kizopna thagui zousie in akizomsah a, aphankhawm hi, tuate ziehin tahsa hiengte chietin ama ama sep ding chiet asep chiengin, tua tahsa pumpi akhangsah a, itna ah ama leh ama kibawl hoiin akhangtousah hi.","ref":"Kolo. 2.19"},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin tami ka gen ahi, tualeh Mangpa ah ka hing theisah ahi, Jentel dangte, lungsim mumal lou puo a aum bangun, um nawn sih un.","title":"Mihing lui leh mihingtha"},"18":{"text":"Atheisiemna uh suhmiel a umin, asung uah theitheina anei nawn sih ua, alungtang khau zieh un, Pasian hinna apat puse in a um uhi."},"19":{"text":"Amauten khohsahna anei nawn sih ua, sil sienglou chinteng huoiham taha bawl dingin, numei pasal kaal a pahtatna ah akipum pieh uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh noute’n Khrist na theidan uh tuabang ahi sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Jesu a um thutah dungzuiin Ama thu na zata ua, Ama thuhil a um na hi pouma u’leh."},"22":{"text":"Na ni danglai hindan ua, mihing lui, misol utna zieh a kisegawp deudeu hawhkhie unlen,","ref":"Kolo. 3.9"},"23":{"text":"Na lungsim hagau uah atha in hing um unlen,"},"24":{"text":"Mihing tha, dihtatna leh sienthouna a Pasian kibahpi a siem pen sil un.","ref":"Kolo. 3.10; Siem. 1.26"},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin zuou gen tawpsan in, michin in a innvengte kungah thutah gen chiet un, aziehpen eite khat leh khat kihiengtuo chiet ihi uhi.","ref":"Zek. 8.16"},"26":{"text":"Lungthah unlen, khiel vang khiel sih un, na lungthahna uh niin tumpi sih heh.","ref":"Late. 4.4"},"27":{"text":"Dawimangpa zong mun awn sih un."},"28":{"text":"Guta in gu nawn sih henlen, tasam mi kunga pieh ding anei theina dingin, akhut a nna hoi sem in gim zaw heh."},"29":{"text":"Na kam ua kipat thusie pawt sih henlen, hinanleh akhawh dan bang zel a bawl hoi dingin thu hoi chinteng pawt zaw hen; angaikhie mite kunga hepina ahi theina dingin."},"30":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian Hagau Siengthou sulunggim sih un, tatna ni a dinga Ama a chiemte na hi uhi."},"31":{"text":"Khatna, thangpaina, lungthahna, kihauna leh kigensietna te zousie na lah ua kipat koimang in umta heh, gitlouna zousie toh."},"32":{"text":"Khatlekhat kingainatuo chiet unlen, lungnem unlen, Pasian in Khrist zieh a noute ahing ngaidam bangin, noute zong kingaidam tuo chiet un.","ref":"Kolo. 3.13"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin ta deinoute bangin Pasian umdan zuite hi un.","title":"Vah a hin ding"},"2":{"text":"Khrist in eite ahing it a Pasian kunga sillat leh kithoina namtui dinga akipieh bangin itna ah um un.","ref":"Pawt. 29.18; Late. 40.6"},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh misiengthoute umdan dinga kilawm mawng in um unlen, kingainate leh sienthoulouna zousie leh huoihamna na lah uah lawkhah in um nawn sih heh."},"4":{"text":"Zummawthu leh thu mot huoi a houlimnate ahisihleh chiemmui thanghuoite akilawmlou ahi, tuate sangin kipahthu gen zaw un."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen ki ngaina thanghuoi a buol, sienglou leh huoiham mi pen milim bie ahia, Khrist leh Pasian gam ah goutan anei sih uh chi na thei uhi."},"6":{"text":"Thuginalou pou ah koima solzou in um sih un, tam silte zieh in Pasian lungthahna khu thumanglou tate tungah atung zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin tambang sil bawlte lah ah tel sih un."},"8":{"text":"Tumasang lai in noute miel na hi ua, hinanleh tu’n pen Mangpa ah vah na hita uh, vah tate bangin um un."},"9":{"text":"Hagau gate pen, hoina chinteng leh dihtatna leh thutah ahi."},"10":{"text":"Mangpa deilam bang ahiei chi thei un."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh miel nasep ga neiloute toh kipawlkhawm sih unlen, hinanleh adihloudan theisah zaw un."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen aguh a asilbawlte uh gendoh nangawn azumhuoi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh sil zousie adihloudan theisah a um khu vah sulat ahi, aziehpen sil zousie mutheia kilangsah khu vah ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tuazieh in Aman, “Nang imu khanglou inlen, mishi lah a kipat thou in, tuachi’n Khrist in ahing salvah ding hi,” ana chi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n na umdan uah pilvang un, mimote banga umlou in, mi pilte bangin um un."},"16":{"text":"Nite ahoilou ziehin, na hun neisunte uh zang hoi un.","ref":"Kolo. 4.5"},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin mosih unlen, Mangpa deilam bang ahiei chi theisiem zaw un."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh zukham in um sih unlen, tuanah kidehzou louna aum hi, hinanleh Hagau a dimin um zaw un,"},"19":{"text":"Pasian late, phatna late leh Hagau lam late a nouma leh nouma kihouin, na lungtang uah, Mangpa dingin kituohtah leh kilawm tahin la sa un.","ref":"Kolo. 3.16,17"},"20":{"text":"Sil bangkim ah i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist min in Pasian leh Pa kungah kipahthu gen ngitnget un."},"21":{"text":"Pasian zaudan siemna ah khat leh khat kitulut tuo chiet un."},"22":{"text":"Zite aw Mangpa kunga na kituh lut bangun nouma pasalte kungah kitulut un.","title":"Khristian innkuon um dingdan","ref":"Kolo. 3.18; 1 Pet. 3.1"},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen Khrist khu Ama ngel tahsa pumpi, hattuom lutang leh hundampa ahimabangin, pasal khu zi lutang ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin hattuom Khrist kunga akituhlut mabangin, zite khu sil bangkim ah apasalte uh kungah kitulut u’heh."},"25":{"text":"Pasalte aw, Khrist in hattuom a it a, ataang ua akipieh bangin, nouten zong na zite uh it un,","ref":"Kolo. 3.19; 1 Pet. 3.7"},"26":{"text":"Tuachia amaute tui a sil a, thu a suhsienga asawpsieng theina dingin,"},"27":{"text":"Tuachia hattuomte khu buohbanglou, melhemlou leh tuabang mawngmawng umlou a siengthou leh genbangloua hattuom thupitah Ama leh ama akipieh theina dingin,"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n pasalten zong ama uh tahsa bangbang in azite uh a it ding uh ahi, azi itpa khu ama ki it ahi."},"29":{"text":"Aziehpen koima’n ama tahsa amuda ngai sih a, Khrist in hattuom avah a akep bangin, avahin adeithaw zaw hi."},"30":{"text":"Aziehpen eite Ama tahsa hiengte ihi ua, Ama tahsa leh, agu hiengte ihi uhi."},"31":{"text":"“Tami ziehin pasal in anu leh apa anuasie dinga azi toh akizop dinga, tuachi’n ani un tahsa pumkhat ahing hita ding uhi.”","ref":"Siem. 2.24"},"32":{"text":"Tam pen thuguh kiphuol thupitah ahi, hinanleh ken Khrist leh hattuom thu ahi ka gen."},"33":{"text":"Ahivang in na lah ua mi koipou in ama aki it bangin azi it heh, tualeh zi in zong apasal zatat dingin pilvang heh."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Naupangte aw, Mangpa ah na nu leh na pate uh thu mang un, tami sil dih ahi.","title":"Tate leh nu leh pa","ref":"Kolo. 3.20"},"2":{"text":"“Na nu leh na pa zatat in,” tua khu thupieh chiem nei masa pen ahi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.12; Danp. 5.16"},"3":{"text":"“Tuachi’n nou a dingin ahoi dinga leitung ah na dam sawt ding uhi.”"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh nou pate aw, na tate uh, sulungthah sih unlen, Mangpa thununna leh thuhilna ah entup zaw un.","ref":"Kolo. 3.21"},"5":{"text":"Suohte aw, Khrist thu na man ding bangtah un zau leh chitun pum in lungtang chitahna toh tahsa a na pute uh thu mangun.","ref":"Kolo. 3.22-25"},"6":{"text":"Mihing kipahsah dinga mitmei guoh veng hilou in, Khrist nasemte bangin lungtang a Pasian deilam bawl zaw un."},"7":{"text":"Mihing nasem hilou a Mangpa nasem na hizieh un, hoi deina toh na pute uh nna sem un."},"8":{"text":"Suoh hiin zalen hitaleh michinin asep hoi leh Mangpa akipat kipahman sang ding ahi uh chi thei un."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh nou pute aw, tuabangmain akung uah bawl unlen, suohte vau tawpsan un, Na ni un van ah pu kibang khat na nei uhi, Aman mi deisah tuom anei sih chi thei un.","ref":"Kolo. 4.1; Danp. 10.17; Kolo. 3.25"},"10":{"text":"Atawppen in ka unaute aw, Mangpa ah leh athahatna silbawltheina ah hattah in um un.","title":"Pasian galvan in kivon un"},"11":{"text":"Dawimangpa zebawlnate na douzou na ding un Pasian galvan bukim in kivon un."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen idoute uh tahsa leh sisan ahi sih a, vaihawmnate, thuneinate, tulai hun a tam leitung miel tunga vaihawmtute leh van mun a hagau gilou umte ahi zaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin ni hoilou a na douzou na ding u’leh na bawlzou sieng nua ua zong na din theina dingun, Pasian gelvan bukim la un."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin na kawng uh thutah a gahin, dihtatna awmphaw bulin,","ref":"Isai. 11.5; Isai. 59.17"},"15":{"text":"Lemna khantan hoi kisahkholna khu na keng ua but in dingun.","ref":"Isai. 52.7"},"16":{"text":"Tuateng ban ah ginna lum la un, tuakhu in giloupa thal kuongthei zousie na sumit thei ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh hundamna sia lukhu leh Hagau namsau Pasian thu la un,","ref":"Isai. 59.17"},"18":{"text":"Thungetna leh ngetna chintengin bangchih lai pouin Hagau ah thu ngen ngitnget unlen, tambang lungsim nei in, misiengthoute zousie dingin thuohhatna leh ngetpiehna toh, atawp dongin kiveng zing un."},"19":{"text":"Khantanhoi thuguh kiphuol theisah dinga hangsantah a ka kam ka kaah theina ding leh thugentheina pieh a ka um theina ding in, Kei a dingin zong thu hing nget pieh un."},"20":{"text":"Tuami khantanhoi zieh a siakolbut palai ka hi. Tua khantanhoi ka gen ding bangtah a, hangsan tah a ka gen theina dingin."},"21":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten zong bangchi khosah leh bang bawl ka hiei chi, ka tanchin na theina dingun, unau it leh Mangpa nasem muonhuoi Tikikus in bangkim ahing theisah pai ding hi.","title":"Thutawpna","ref":"Nasep. 20.4; 2 Tim. 4.12  ;     \n        Kolo. 4.7,8"},"22":{"text":"Ka tanchin uh natheina ding u’leh aman noute ahing hamuon theina dingin, ama na kung uah ka hing sawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Pa Pasian leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist kunga kipat lungmuonna, ginna leh itna unaute kungah um hen."},"24":{"text":"Abei theilou itna tahtah toh i Mangpa Jesu Khrist it zousie kungah hepina umta hen. Amen."}}}}},"50":{"info":{"name":"Philippi","shortname":"Phil.","abbr":[],"desc":"Philippi mite kunga sawltah paul laihah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul leh Timothi Jesu Khrist suohten, Philippi khuo a um Khrist Jesu a misiengthoute zousie kungah leh hattuom lamkaite leh upate kungah,","ref":"Nasep. 16.12"},"2":{"text":"I Pa uh Pasian leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist kunga kipat hepina leh lungmuonna na kung uah um hen."},"3":{"text":"Noute ka hing geeldoh chintengin ka Pasian kungah kipahthu ka gen hi."},"4":{"text":"Noute zousie a dinga lungnop taha hing ngetpieha thu ka nget chintengin,"},"5":{"text":"Ni masa pen akipat in tu dongin, khantanhoi a na hing kipawlkhawmpina zieh un,"},"6":{"text":"Ama noute sunga nasep hoi panpain Jesu Khrist ni tandongin abawl muolsuo ngei ding chi dettah in ka gingta hi."},"7":{"text":"Noute zousie tungtang thu a tambang ngaituona ka nei khu adih mawng ahi; noute lungtanga ka hing vom zieh a, ka kolbuna leh khantanhoi dihna thu leh namdetna thu a hepina ka tanpite na hi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jesu Khrist lainatna in noute na unpi un ka hing ngai mama hi chi, Pasian ahing theipipa ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh theina leh theikah theina lam a noute itna akhan semsem theina dingin tami ka ngen ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachia sil hoipente na hing theichien ua, Khrist ni donga atahtah siengthou leh mawna bei na hing hi theina dingun."},"11":{"text":"Pasian thupina ding leh phatna dingin, Jesu Khrist a um dihtatna gate in dim un."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh unaute aw, ka tunga sil tungte pen khantanhoi dalzah semna dinga hing tung ahi chi na thei uh ka dei hi.","title":"Paul genthei thuohna"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kaisar innpi veng galkapte zousie leh mundang a mi zousie kungah Khrist a ka kolbuna khu akichienta hi.","ref":"Nasep. 28.30"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa a unau tamtahin ka kolbute zieh a Mangpa a muonna nei in Pasian thu zaulou a gen dingin ahangsan deu deu ta uhi."},"15":{"text":"Pawlkhatte’n thangsietna leh ki elna ziehin Khrist thu agen uhi, tualeh pawlkhatte’n lungsim hoina toh agen uhi."},"16":{"text":"Amasa pawl in ginumna toh hilou in amauh angsung khuolna toh Khrist thu agen ua, ka kolbuna ban ah gentheina abelap uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh anukhia pawl in pen, khantanhoi gupna zieh a thuoh ka hi chi thei in itna ziehin Khrist thu agen uhi."},"18":{"text":"Bang akhawh diei? Bawlthu hiin, thutah hitaleh, banglam pou ah Khrist thu akigen nah pouleh, ka kipah a, ahi ka kipah zel ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen tami na thumna u’leh Jesu Khrist Hagau panpina zal in ka tunga sil tungte ka hundamna ahing suoh ding ka thei hi.","title":"Paul gentheina in Mangpa apahtawi hi"},"20":{"text":"Ka lam etna leh ka kinepna mama dungzuiin, bangma ah zumsahin ka um sih dinga, hinanleh hangsantah a ka gen ngitngetsa bangin, tuin zong hinna ahiei, shina ahiei, ka tahsa ah, Khrist khu suhthupi in a um ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen keidingin hin Khrist ahia, shi zong metna ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh tahsa a hin khu ka tan hi henlen, tua khu ka sepgim ga hita leh bangpen ahiei ka tel zawh ding ka thei sih hi."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen sil ni tetuo kaal ah, chiding zawsang theilouin ka um a, pawtdoha Khrist toh umkhawm ding ka lunggul hi; tua pen ahoizaw tham hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahivang in tahsa a um khu noute ziehin apoimaw zaw hi."},"25":{"text":"Tami gindetna nei in, na ginna uh khanletna ding leh na ginna ua, na kipahna dingun, noute zousie toh ka umkhawm nalai ding chi ka thei hi."},"26":{"text":"Na kung ua ka hing haw kiana zieh a, Kei dinga Khrist Jesu a na kipahna uh atam sem theina dingin."},"27":{"text":"Na umdan u’leh Khrist khantanhoi kituohsah phot un; hing pei a noute hing mu a, ahisihleh ka umlou a zong, hagau khat a na dinkip dan u’leh, lungsim khat nei a, khantanhoi thuginna a na pankhawm dan uh, na tanchin uh ka zah theina dingin."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh bangma pou ah na melmate uh suhzau in um sih un; tuakhu ama ua dinga manthaina chiemtena kichientah ahi a, hinanleh noute a dinga Pasian akipata hundamna ahi."},"29":{"text":"Aziehpen Khrist zieha nouten Ama na gintat guoh uh hilou a, Ama vanga thuoh zong na thuoh ding uh ahi chi phal na hi uhi."},"30":{"text":"Kidouna Keima a um na musa bang u’leh tu a keima a um nalai na zah bang uh nouten zong na nei uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 16.19-40"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin Khrist a kihenepna bang, itna a lungmuonna bang, Hagau a kipawlkhawmna bang, tualeh kilainatna leh ki khotuona bang aum leh,","title":"Kingiem khieh dinga hanthawnna"},"2":{"text":"Lungsim kibanga um in, itna kibang neiin, tup kibang leh lungsim khat puo a umin ka kipahna subukim un."},"3":{"text":"Angsung khuolna ahisihleh kipilsahna ahiei in bangma bawlsih unlen, hinanleh michinin lungsim a kingaingiem tahin, mi dangte ama sanga hoizaw in ngaituo heh."},"4":{"text":"Na lah ua mi koipou in ama hoina ding guoh en sih henlen, midangte hoina ding zong en uheh."},"5":{"text":"Khrist Jesu a zong um tam lungsim khu noute ah zong um heh;","title":"Khrist kingaingiemna"},"6":{"text":"Ama Pasian banga um hinapi, Pasian toh kibanga um khu sil khiehla huoi in angaituo sih a,"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama hing kikoi ngiemin, suoh bangin ahing um a, mihing bangin ahing pieng hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh mihing lim leh mel bang hing puoin, ahing kingaingiem a, shi tandongin thu amanga, Kross ah shina nangawn ahing thuoh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian in zong Ama nasatahin atawi sangta a, min zousie lah a min tungnung pen apeta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachia Jesu min a, mizousie vantung sil um, leitunga sil umte leh lei nuoia sil um chintengte akhupdin ding a,","ref":"Isai. 45.23"},"11":{"text":"Lei chintengin, Jesu Khrist khu Pa Pasian thupina dinga Mangpa ahi chi aphuong ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka ittahte aw, ka um pet chieng guoh hilouin, tua ka umlou lai a zong thu na man zel mabangun, zau leh chitun pumin na hundamna chiet uh semkhie un."},"13":{"text":"Ama deilam bawl dinga noute hing utsahpa leh hing semsahpa khu Pasian ahi."},"14":{"text":"Sil zousie phunlou leh niel louin bawl un."},"15":{"text":"Tulai khang gilou leh sildihlou bawlte lah a leitunga vahte banga na taannate lah ua gensiet bei leh poikhoilou Pasian tate na hitheina dingun;","ref":"Danp. 32.5"},"16":{"text":"Hinna thu tudet un, Khrist ni hing tun chienga ken amawhna’n ka tai sih a, amawhna’n ka semgim sih chia ka kipah theina dingin."},"17":{"text":"Ahi, na ginna kithoina sillat u’leh na nasepna tung uah dawn sillatte banga sunbuoh a um hinanleng ka kipah a, noute zousie toh ka lungnuom khawm hi."},"18":{"text":"Tamte zieh main noute zong kipah unlen, kei toh zong lungnuom khawm un."},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh Timothi na kung ua hing sawl pai dingin Mangpa Jesu ah ka kinem hi, na tanchin uh ka thei chieng a kei zong lungmuong tah a ka um theina dingin."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen noute hoina ding ngaituo tahtah lungsim kibahpi midang ka nei sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi zousiein Jesu Khrist silte suilou in, ama uh angsung ding maimai asui uhi."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh ama pen tapain pa toh asepkhawm bangin, khantanhoi nasepna ah ahing panpi chi theichienna ama ah na nei uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin bangchibanga um ding ka hiei chi ka theichiengin ama hing sawl pai ding ka kinem hi;"},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh keima ngel zong hing pei pai ding in, Mangpa ah ka kigingta hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh ka unau leh ka naseppi leh ka galkappi, na sawltah u’leh ka tahsapna hing kithuopipa Epaphroditus na kung ua hing sawl poimaw kasa hi."},"26":{"text":"Aman noute na bawn un ahing ngaina mama a, achinat thu na zah zieh un alunggim mama hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama shi dihtahin achina ngaingut a, hinanleh Pasian in ama akhotuo a, ahi, amatung guoh hilou in Kei zong ahing khotuo hi; tuahisihleh kei a dingin lunggim na tungah lunggimna dang aban ban in aum ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin ama khawhsatah a hing sawl ka kithalawp dieh hi; ama na mu kia chieng ua na kipah ua, tualeh kei lunggim na zong aphatdawm deu na ding in."},"29":{"text":"Tuaziehin kipahtahin, Mangpa ah ama na pom unlen, ama bang mite zatat un."},"30":{"text":"Aziehpen, nouten kei dinga na hing seppiehna uh kimloute asuhbuchingna dingin Khrist nasepna ah aman ahinna zong khawhsa lou in ana shi dihtah hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Atawppen in ka unaute aw, Mangpa ah nuom un, na kung ua angaima gelkia, kei a dingin chimtahhuoi ahi sih hi. Nou dingin ahoizaw hi.","title":"Tahsa ah muonding umlou"},"2":{"text":"Uite lah ah kivengun, sil gilou bawlte lah ah kiveng unlen, tahsa atsegawpte lah ah kiveng un."},"3":{"text":"Eite pen, Hagau a Pasian bie teptante ihi ua, tualeh Khrist Jesu ah i kipah mama ua, tahsa ah vang suon ding inei sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tahsa lam a suon ding chileng ken suon ding ka neizaw khamaw sih ding hi. Mi koi ahieiin tahsa a suon ding nei a akithei leh ken ka nei sem hi."},"5":{"text":"Ni giet ni a teptan, Israel mi, Benjamin nam; Hebrute laha Hebru dihtah, dan theina lam a Pharisai mi,","ref":"Rom. 11.1; Nasep. 23.6; 26.5"},"6":{"text":"Phattuomngaina lam ah, hattuomte bawlsepa ka na hi a, dan a dihtatna lam ah, genbanglou ka hi.","ref":"Nasep. 8.3; 22.4; 26.9-11"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh kei a dinga metna zousie, Khrist ziehin supna in ka simta hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh adihtah in, Khrist Jesu ka Mangpa theina hoitah ziehin, sil zousie supnain ka sim a, Ama ziehin sil zousie ka tanta a, tualeh tuate Khrist ka nei theina dingin buathah kikholkhawm bang giapin ka ngaisut hi."},"9":{"text":"Dan a kipat a keima dihtatna nei hiloua, Khrist ginna zieh a um, ginna a Pasian a dihtatna khu nei a Ama-a mu a ka um theina dingin;"},"10":{"text":"Tuachia Ama leh athawkiana silbawltheina ka thei theina dingin, athuohgimna kikoppiin, ashina ah ama bah ka ut hi."},"11":{"text":"Bangchi ahiei beeha mishi lah akipat a thawkiana ka tan theikhah leh kachi hi."},"12":{"text":"Atang zouta ka hi sih a, abukimzouta zong ka hisih hi, hinanleh Khrist Jesu in kei ahing tuhdet bangin tuami ma ka tuhdet theina dingin ka del a hi.","title":"Phahchiemna mun del"},"13":{"text":"Unaute aw, kei pen neizouta in ka kingaituo sih a, hinanleh tam sil khat ka bawl hi; nualam a sil umte manghil in, mailam a sil umte ka del hi."},"14":{"text":"Kipahman sang dingin Pasian in vanlam hatnain Khrist ah kei ahing han a, tua kipahman mu tumin phahtawpna mun ka del a hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin ei apiching tengin tambang lungsim nei chiet vai, tualeh sil dang khat a ngaituona tuom na nei u’leh, tuomi nangawn zong Pasian in noute ahing theisah nalai ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahivang in itunna chieng chieng ah, tua dan ma zuiin gamta vai in, lungsim kibangin um vai."},"17":{"text":"Unaute aw, ka umdan entonte hi chiet unlen, tuabanga umte etton dinga na hing neite uh chiemte un.","title":"Paul etton ding","ref":"1 Kor. 4.16; 11.1"},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen mi tampi a umta ua, amauh umdan, ka hinghil munta hi, tuin zong hitui luongpum in, ka hing hil hi, amaute Khrist Kross melmate ahi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Atawpna uh khu sietna ahi a, apasien uh khu agilpi uh ahi a, tualeh athupina u’zong azumna uh ahi. Alungsimte un leitung silte angaituo uhi."},"20":{"text":"Eite khuoletui hina pen vangam ah ahia, tuana kipat in Mangpa Jesu Khrist hundampa kinem tah in ingah uhi."},"21":{"text":"Aman sil zousie Ama thu thua aumsah theina nasep dan dungzuiin itahsa thulimlou khu Ama tahsa thupitah batpi in ahing bawlthapieh ding hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka unau it leh ngaite aw, ka kipahna leh ka manglukhuhte, tuachi’n ka itte aw, Mangpa ah dingdet un.","title":"Hanthawnna thu tuom tuom"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa a lungsim munkhat paw dingin Euodia ka ngen a, Sintike ka ngen hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ka hahkol puohpi muonhuoi nang zong ka hing ngen ahi, khantanhoi nna ka seppi tam numeite leh Klemen zong, tualeh hinna laibu a min tuong, ka naseppi dangte panpi in."},"4":{"text":"Mangpa ah kipah ngitnget un, ka chi kia ding kipah un.","title":"Mangpa lungmuonna"},"5":{"text":"Na lungnemna uh mi zousie thei hi heh, Mangpa anai hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangma ah Patau sih unlen, hinanleh sil bangkim ah thumna leh ngetnain kipahthugenna toh, na sil deite uh Pasian kungah theisah un."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n theisiem guollou Pasian lungmuonnain, Khrist ziehin na lungtangte u’leh na lungsimte uh ahing venpieh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Atawppen in unaute aw, thutah pouma, azatat huoi pouma, sil dih pouma, sil siengthou pouma, sil deihuoi pouma, sil hoi a kigen pouma, hoina bang a uma, pahtawitham ching bang aum leh tam silte ngaituo un."},"9":{"text":"Keima apat a na zilsa uh, na tansa uh, na zahsa uh leh na musa uh, silte bawl un, tuachi’n lungmuonna Pasian in ahing umpi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nouten kei na hing awlmawna uh atawplam a na hing latsahkia zieh un, Mangpa ah nahpitahin ka kipah hi. Kei na hing awlmaw mama ua hinanleh na latsahna dinguh hunlemtaang na mu sih ua ahi.","title":"Philippite panpina tunga Paul kipahna"},"11":{"text":"Tahsap zieh a tam thu ka gen ahi sih, bangchibangin um nanleng lungkim dan ka theita hi."},"12":{"text":"Tasam tah a umdan ka thei a, kiningching taha umdan zong ka thei hi. Munchin leh silzousie ah gilva leh gilkiel a um theina leh hausa tah leh tasam a um dan ka zilta hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima hing hatsahpa Khrist ziehin sil zousie ka bawl thei hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahivang in ka mangbatna a na hing thuohpi zieh un na bawl hoi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Nou Philippimiten zong na thei uhi, khantanhoi kipat chiila, Masidonia gam a kipat, ka kipat doh lai in, noute chilou hattuom dang koima’n pieh leh lah lam thu ah ahing panpi sih uhi."},"16":{"text":"Thessalonika khuo a ka um lai nangawn in, ka tahsap chiengin nouten panpina nahing hah ua, na hing hahkia zel uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 17.1; 2 Kor. 11.9"},"17":{"text":"Silpieh ka dei man ahi sih a, noute dinga gapung sui ka hi zaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Sil zousie kiningching tahin ka nei a, ka hau hi, noute a kipat a hing kihah silte, gimnam tui kithoina, Pasian pomtah leh lungkim huoi khu Epaphroditus khuta kipat in ka muta a, ka kiningchingta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 29.18"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh ka Pasian in ahausatna thupi dungzui in, na tahsapna zousie uh ahing pe ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuin i Pasian leh Pa kungah kumtawn kumtawnin thupina umta hen. Amen.","title":"Thu hitna"},"21":{"text":"Khrist Jesu a misiengthou zousie hing na nousiet pieh un. Ka kunga um unauten, ahing nousiet uhi."},"22":{"text":"Misiengthou zousie’n adiehin Kaisar innsung miten ahing nousiet uhi."},"23":{"text":"I Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist hepina na unpi ua tung ah umta hen. Amen."}}}}},"51":{"info":{"name":"Kolossa","shortname":"Kolo.","abbr":[],"desc":"Kolossa mite kunga sawltah paul laihah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Pasian deidan a Jesu Khrist sawltah leh i unaupa uh Timothi in,","title":"Nousietna"},"2":{"text":"Kolossa khuo a um, Khrist a misiengthoute leh unau ginumte kungah; i Pa uh Pasian leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist a kipat hepina leh lungmuonna na kung uah um hen."},"3":{"text":"Noute a dinga thungen ngitngetin Pasian leh i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist Pa kungah kipahthu ka gen uhi.","title":"Kipahthu genna"},"4":{"text":"Khrist Jesu a na ginna u’leh, misiengthoute zousie tunga itna na nei dan uh ka zah nua lang kalsie un,"},"5":{"text":"Van a noute dinga kinepna hing kikoipieh ziehin, tua kinepna thu khu khantanhoi thutah thu ah tumasang lai in na zata uhi,"},"6":{"text":"Tua khantanhoi khu leitung pumpi a ga-a, akhan zel mabangin, na zah ua, thutah a Pasian hepina na hing thei ni ua kipat in na lah uah ga-a pung zel in na kung uah ahing tungta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua thutah pen ka suoh hipi deitah uh Epiphras, noute taanga Khrist nasem muonhuoi tah akipat a na theitah mabang un,","ref":"Kolo. 4.12; Phile. 1.23"},"8":{"text":"Aman Hagau a koute nang itdan uh zong ka kung uah ahing phuongdoh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tamte ziehin na itna thu uh ka zah ni ua kipat in noute a dinga thungetpieh leh pilna leh Hagaulam theichienna zousie a, Ama deilam theina a na hing dimna ding uh, hing ngetpieh ka tawp sih uhi.","title":"Kolossate ding Paul thungetna"},"10":{"text":"Tuachia Mangpa dinga hindan kilawm leh sil zousie a deihuoi a na gamtat ua, nna hoi chinteng a, gasuo a, tualeh Pasian theisiemna lam a na hing khanlet na ding u’leh;"},"11":{"text":"Asilbawltheina thupitah dungzui a kipahna toh kukalna leh thuohatna lam a hatna zousie a suhat a na um theina ding un;"},"12":{"text":"Vah a misiengthoute goutankhawmpi dinga achinga hing bawlpa, Pa kungah kipahthu gen un."},"13":{"text":"Aman miel silbawltheina a kipat in eite ahing hundoh a, A Tapa ittah gam ah ahing lutsah ta hi."},"14":{"text":"Eiten Ama ah Asisan zal in tatdohna i mu hi, ikhelna uh ngaidamna ngei khu.","ref":"Eph.
