1.7"},"15":{"text":"Ama pen mutheilou, Pasian kibahpi silsiem zousie lah a pieng masapen ahi.","title":"Sildangteng sang Khrist tungnunna"},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama zieh a sil zousie siem ahi a, leitunga umte hiin vantung a umte hitaleh, mu thei leh mutheilou hitaleh, mangtoupha hiin, lalnate leh vaihawmnate leh thuneinate hitaleh, sil zousie Ama tungtawn a siem leh Ama-a dinga siem ahi."},"17":{"text":"Sil zousie um masangin Ama a um a, Ama ah sil zousie a um khawm hi."},"18":{"text":"Khrist khu tahsa pumpi chipen hattuom lutang ahi, Aman bangkim a tungnunna aneitheina dingin silzousie kipatna bul ahia, mishite lah a kipat pieng masa pen ahi.","ref":"Eph. 1.22,23"},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama a bukimna a um khu Pa deilam ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh a Kross sisan zal a, lemna bawl in, Ama mama in sil zousie Ama toh a kilem sah hi, Ama ngel ah leitunga sil umte leh van a sil umte zong akilemsah hi.","ref":"Eph. 2.16"},"21":{"text":"Noute pen khatvei lai a na gitlouna nasepte zieh un na lungsim uah Pasian akipat mikhuol leh melma na hi uhi, hinanleh tuin,"},"22":{"text":"A shina zal in atahsa pumpi ah Ama toh noute ahing kilempi kiata hi, Ama mai a siengthou leh genbanglou leh phawhna ding bei a ahing dinsah theina dingin,"},"23":{"text":"Ginna a na um ngitnget ua, kibulphuna nei a dettah a na um ua, khantanhoi kinepna na zah ua kipat a na pielmanglou u’leh, tua khantanhoi khu vannuoi a silsiem zousie kunga kigenzah ahi a, Kei Paul zong tami khantanhoi nasempa ka hing hita hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuin noute a dinga ka gimthuoh na ah ka kipah hi, Khrist in atahsa-a dinga athuohna kisam nalaite keima tahsa ah ka sunzom zel hi, tua tahsa khu hattuom ahi.","title":"Paul sepgimna"},"25":{"text":"Pasian thu subukim dingin, noute dinga ka kung a Pasian in kepna nasep ahing pieh dungzui in hattuom nasempa ka hing hita hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua Pasian thu khu kumtawn leh akhang akhanga thuguh kiphuol ana hi a, hinanleh tuin vang Amisiengthoute kunga sulat ahita hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua thuguh kiphuol thupina haudan bang ahiei chi, Pasian in Jentelte kunga theisah aut mawng ahi, tua thuguh kiphuolpen thupina ding kinepna nouma a um Khrist khu ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ama Khrist ahi, kouten kagen uh, Khrist Jesu a michin pichinga ka dinsah theina dingun, pilna zousie zanga michin vauhil in ka zilsah uhi."},"29":{"text":"Tambang tupna in, keima a um Ama thahatna in Ama sep bangbangin theitawp suo a sem in ka pang hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Noute leh Laodisia khuo a umte leh tahsa a ka mel mu nailou tampite a dinga ka hapan dan na thei uh ka dei hi.","title":"Khrist toh kizopna leh kithuhilna dihlou apat kiven ding thu"},"2":{"text":"Pasian leh Pa leh Khrist a thuguh khu theidoh dinga theisiemna kichientah hausatna lam a itna kiphankhawma aum ua, hamuong tah a aum theina dingun, alungtangte uh hanthawn ka ut hi."},"3":{"text":"Khrist ah pilna leh theina gou zousie phuol in a um hi."},"4":{"text":"Koiman kamsiem thu a noute ahing sol louna dingun, tam ka gen ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tahsain na kung uah um sih nanleng, hagau in na kung uah ka um hi; Kilemtah a na umdan u’leh Khrist ginna a na detdan uh muin ka kipah hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuazieh in Khrist Jesu, Mangpa khu na pomtaah mabang un, Ama ah um un."},"7":{"text":"Ama a huiha leh lamtouin um unlen, ahing kihilna mabangin ginna a kipah tah a um in, kipahthu genna a dim in um un."},"8":{"text":"Pilvang un, tuachilouin mi koi ahiei in, Khrist thu banga kibulphu hilouin mihingte thugousie leh leitung thubulte bangzawin, leitung pilna leh solna hawmpi toh mi’n ahing manzou kha ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Khrist ah Pasian bukimna zousie tahsa nei in ahing um hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh Ama ah noute na bukimta uhi. Ama khu vaihawmna leh thuneina zousie lutang ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ama ah noute pen, khut a tan hilou a, tahsa khelna sapum paikhie a, Khrist teptanna a teptan na hita uhi."},"12":{"text":"Baptisma ah ama toh vuikhawm na hita ua, tualeh mishi lah a kipat a Ama kaithoupa Pasian nasep gintatna ziehin noute zong kaithou na hita uhi.","ref":"Rom. 6.4"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh noute, na khelnate u’leh, na tahsa ua teptanlouna zieh a shi na hi lai un, Pasian in Ama toh ahing suhingkhawmta a, na tatkhelna zousie uh ahing ngaidamta hi.","ref":"Eph. 2.1-5"},"14":{"text":"Dan thu izui ding ua um, eite hingdou leh ei toh kikaal lam a khut a kigiel khu nawtmang in Kross dawn a kilbeh in alamangta hi.","ref":"Eph. 2.15"},"15":{"text":"Aman vaihawmnate leh thuneinate susiein kross ah tuate zouin taangpi mu in alangsahta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin neh leh dawn thu ahiei, pawi tungtang thu ahiei, hatha thu ahiei, ahisihleh khawlni thu ahiei ah koiman noute hing mawsah sih u’heh.","ref":"Rom. 14.1-6"},"17":{"text":"Tuate pen sil hing tungdingte him ahi, hinanleh atahtah khu Khrist ahi."},"18":{"text":"Mi koima’n amaute bawlthu kingaingiemna dihlou leh vansawlsiengte bieh na pou kipahpi a mu theilou silte zanga ama pienken lungsim a kisang koi miin, na kipahman mu ding uh hing lahpieh sih heh;"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh lutang khu atudet sih ua, tahsa pen akizopna gu leh taangte leh thaguite zieh a, tua Lutang apat kivah leh kizomkhawm ahi a, Pasian akipat punna toh hing khangkhie ahi.","ref":"Eph. 4.16"},"20":{"text":"Tuaziehin leitung thubulte apat Khrist toh shi na hitaah u’leh, bangdinga leitung dan a hing banga, dan thupieh nuoi a kitulut na hi uoi?"},"21":{"text":"“Sukha sin, chiem sin, thamsin, kichite,”"},"22":{"text":"Tamte zousie pen akizah pum a mang sieng ding ahi, tamte bawl khu mihing thupieh leh thuhilna a zui ahi."},"23":{"text":"Tam silte khu akilat dan ah pil huoi bahna anei uh, hinanleh tam thuhilna amaute kibawlthu, biehna, kingaingiemna dihlou leh tahsa bangma a simlounate pen tahsa deilam suhpichinna lam ah bangma aphatuom sih hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachia Khrist toh kaithawkhawm na hitaah u’leh tunglam a Pasian zietlam a tou Khrist umna a sil umte sui un.","title":"Gingtute dinmun","ref":"Late. 110.1"},"2":{"text":"Leitung a sil umte ah hilou in, tunglam a sil umte ah na lungsim uh nga un."},"3":{"text":"Na shita ua, na hinna uh Khrist toh Pasian ah phuol ahita."},"4":{"text":"Khrist, ihinna uh, ahing kilat chiengin noute zong Ama toh thupiin na kilang ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin na tahsa hieng uh leitunga umte sulum un, huasannate, sienthoulounate, ki etlanate, utna giloute leh huoihamnate, huoihamna khu milim biehna ahi.","title":"Mihing lui"},"6":{"text":"Tam silte ziehin, thu manglou tate tungah Pasian lungthahna hing tung ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tumasang lai in noute tua silte sunga na um lai un, amaute ah na hing uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin vang tam silte zousie, lungthahna, thangpaina, ase lam kideisahna, kigensietna, ham giloute na kam ua pat koimang un."},"9":{"text":"Khat leh khat kisoltuo sih un, mihing lui khu asilbawlte toh na koimangta uhi.","ref":"Eph. 4.22"},"10":{"text":"Mihing tha sil na hita uhi, tua mihing tha khu theina nei a Asiempa batpi a siemthain aum hi.","ref":"Eph. 4.24; Siem. 1.26"},"11":{"text":"Tuanah Greekmi leh Judami, teptan leh teptanlou, nammawl leh Skithia mi leh sila leh noplen hitaleh kideidanna aum tuom sih a, Khrist khu bangkim a bangkim ahi zaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian mitel, misiengthou leh deitahte, bangin lainatna, nunnemna, kingaigiemna, lungnemna leh thuohhatnate sil un.","title":"Mihing tha","ref":"Eph. 4.2"},"13":{"text":"Khat leh khat kithuohpi tuo chiet unlen, kingaidam tuo chiet un, khat in khat tunga thubuoi na nei u’leh, Khrist in noute ahing ngaidam bangin, noute zong kingaidam un.","ref":"Eph. 4.32"},"14":{"text":"Tamte zousie tungah itna silthuo un, tua khu bukimna a kaankhawm ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian lungmuonna in na lungtang uah vaihawmsah un, tuabang hi dinga tahsa khat a hat zong na hi uhi, tualeh kipahna dan zong thei un."},"16":{"text":"Khrist thu khu a hausatna teng toh nouma ah umsah kingkeng un, pilna chintenga kizilsah leh kihil tuo a um in hepina lungtang nei in, Pasian kungah phatna late, Pasian late, Hagau lam late sain um un.","ref":"Eph. 5.19,20"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh na bawl pouma uh thugen lam hi in, nasep in hitaleh, abawnin Mangpa Jesu min in Ama zieh a, Pa Pasian kunga kipah thu gen kawm in bawl un."},"18":{"text":"Zite aw, Mangpa ah akilawm hun bangin na pasalte uh kungah kitulut un.","title":"Khristian innkuon um dan","ref":"Eph. 5.22; 1 Pet. 3.1"},"19":{"text":"Pasalte aw, na zite uh it unlen, atung uah gilou sih un.","ref":"Eph. 5.25; 1 Pet. 3.7"},"20":{"text":"Tate aw, sil zousie ah na nu leh pate uh thu mang un, tua khu Mangpa kipahna ahi.","ref":"Eph. 6.1"},"21":{"text":"Pate aw, na tate uh lungthahsah sih un, tuachilouin alungke kha ding uhi.","ref":"Eph. 6.4"},"22":{"text":"Suohte aw, sil zousie ah tahsa a na pute uh thu mangun, mihing lungkim sah sawm a mitmei veng bep hilou in, chitahna leh Pasian giing kawm in thu mangun.","ref":"Eph. 6.5-8"},"23":{"text":"Na bawl pouma uh mihingte tunga bawl bang hilou in, Mangpa tunga bawl bangin lunglut tahin bawl un."},"24":{"text":"Mangpa kunga kipat in kipahman gouluoding na mu ding uhi chi thei un, aziehpen Mangpa Khrist nasem na hi uhi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh sil dihlou bawl miin, asil dihlou bawlman amu kia ding hi, kideisahna tuom bangma a um sih hi.","ref":"Danp. 10.17; Eph. 6.9"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pute aw, nouten zong van ah Pu na nei uh chi thei kawm in, na suohte uh tungah, adih leh akilawm hun khu bawl un.","ref":"Eph. 6.9"},"2":{"text":"Lungluttah in thungen zingun, kipah thugen kawmin pilvang un.","title":"Kithuhilna dang"},"3":{"text":"Tuabang kaal ah, Pasian in koute thugenna ding kot ahing honpieh thei na ding leh Khrist thuguh kiphuol ka gendoh theina dingun Koute ding in zong thu hing nget pieh un, Khrist thuguh kiphuol zieha kolbun zong ka hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka gen ding banga ka gen thei na dingin."},"5":{"text":"Hun lemtang leiin pulam mite lah ah pil tahin um un.","ref":"Eph. 5.16"},"6":{"text":"Michin bangchi bang a dawn ding ahiei chi na thei na dingun na ham kamsuo uh hepina tel chi kisaw hi ngitnget heh."},"7":{"text":"Ka tanchin zousie unaupa ittah Tikikus nasempa muonhuoi leh Mangpa a ka suoh hipipain, noute ahing theisah sieng ding hi.","title":"Mimal mangpha hahna leh thutawp","ref":"Nasep. 20.4; 2 Tim. 4.12  ;     \n        Eph. 6.21,22"},"8":{"text":"Tami ding ma a ama na kung ua ka hing sawl ahi, na tanchin uh athei a, tualeh na lungtang uh ahamuon sah thei na dingin;"},"9":{"text":"I unau muonhuoi leh ittah Onesimus na lah ua mi’n ama ahing zui hi. Amaun tamlanga sil umdan zousie ahing theisah ding uhi.","ref":"Phile. 1.10-12"},"10":{"text":"Ka suongkul taanpi Aristarkus leh Barnaba sanggamnu tapa Mak in noute ahing nousiet hi, ama toh kisai thuhilna na muta uhi, ama na kung ua ahing pei chiengin na kipahpi un,","ref":"Nasep. 19.29; 27.2; Phile. 1.24; Nasep. 12.12,25; 13.13; 15.37-39"},"11":{"text":"Tualeh Justus kichi Jesu in zong noute ahing nousiet hi. Tamte Pasian gam a dinga ka seppite laha teptan umsunte ahi ua, kei a dingin hamuonna ahi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Noute lah a mi, Jesu Khrist nasem khat Epaphras in noute mangpha ang hah hi; Pasian deilam chinteng a piching leh bukim a na dindet theina dingun, ama thungetna te ah theitawp suoin apang hi.","ref":"Kolo. 1.7; Phile. 1.23"},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen aman noute a ding leh Laodisia leh Hierapolis khuo a umte dingin ahakat mama hi chi ka theipi hi."},"14":{"text":"Luk daktor ittah leh Dema in noute ahing nousiet hi.","ref":"2 Tim. 4.11; Phile. 1.24; 2 Tim. 4.10; Phile. 1.24"},"15":{"text":"Laodisia khuo a unau umte leh Nimphas leh a inn a hattuomte mangpha ka hah hi hing na gen pieh un."},"16":{"text":"Tam laihah noute laha na sim zou chiengun Laodisia hattuomte zong na simsah unlen, tuabangmain Laodisiate kunga laihah na sim un."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Arkippa kungah, “Mangpa a na mu nasepna khu na suhpiching theina ding in pilvangin,” na chi un.","ref":"Phile. 1.2"},"18":{"text":"Kei Paul in tam nousietna lai keima khut ngel a ka gel ahi, ka kolbute thei ngitnget un. Hepina na kung uah um hen. Amen."}}}}},"52":{"info":{"name":"1 Thessalonika","shortname":"1 Thes.","abbr":[],"desc":"Thessalonika mite kunga sawltah paul laihah khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Silvanus leh Timothi in, Pa Pasian leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist a um Thessalonika hattuomte kungah, i Pa uh Pasian leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist a kipat hepina leh hamuonna na kung uah um hen.","title":"Nousietna leh kipah thugenna","ref":"Nasep. 17.1"},"2":{"text":"Ka thungetna ua na min uh lou in, noute zousie ziehin Pasian kungah kipahthu ka gen ngitnget uhi."},"3":{"text":"I Pasian leh Pa uh masangah, na ginna nasepte uh, itna a nasepgimnate u’leh i Mangpa Jesu Khrist a kinepna zieh a na hakatnate uh ka manghil sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Unau deitahte aw, Pasian tel na hina uh ka thei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen ka khantanhoi uh, thu guoh a na kung ua hing tung ahi sih a, silbawltheina leh Hagau Siengthou leh theichienna lienpi toh hing tung ahi zaw a, noute ziehin na lah ua mibangchibang ka hi uoi chi na thei bang un."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh hasatna nasatah thuoh pum in, Hagau Siengthou a kipah kawm in thu na pom ua, koute leh Mangpa zuite na hita uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 17.5-9"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Masidonia gam leh Akaia gam a gingtute zousie dingin etton ding na hita uhi."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen noute akipat in Mangpa thu athangdohta a, Masidonia gam leh Akaia gam guoh ah hilouin, mun chin ah Pasian lam a na gindan uh athangta hi, Tuachi’n kouten bangma ka gen uh angai nawn sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Bangchibanga na lah ua hing lut ka hi uoi, chi leh Pasian hing leh dihtah be dinga milimte akipat a Pasian lam a na hing kihei dan bang uh amaute mama in agen ua,"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh a tapa mishi lah a kipat a akaitho, lungthahna hing tung ding lah a kipat a hing hundohpa van akipat a hing pei ding na ngah dingin."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Unaute aw, na lah ua kang lutna uh aguohsuoh sih chi noute mama in na thei uhi.","title":"Paul hattuom phudan"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh na theisa mabangun masanglai a Philippi khuo a zumhuoi tah a bawlsiet a ka um nua un buoi pumpum in, Pasian khantanhoi na kung ua gen dingin ka Pasian uah ka hangsan zaw uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 16.19-24; Nasep. 17.1-9"},"3":{"text":"Ka hing hanthawnnate uh zuouthu ahiei, asienglou ahiei, ahisihleh solbawlna a hing pawt zong ahi sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian phatsah a khantanhoi kem dinga ngansie mi ka hi bang ngei un, mihing lungkimna dingin thu ka gen sih ua, ka lungtang uh enchienpa Pasian lungkimsah sawm in thu ka gen zaw uhi."},"5":{"text":"Na theisa mabangun bangmachihin maitangphatna kam leh deigawna kam mal ka zang ngai sih uhi; Pasian ahing theipipa ahi."},"6":{"text":"Khrist sawltahte ka hi zieh un noute tungah ngetna bawl thei hinan u’leng, mihinga kipat leh noute akipat ahisihleh midangte tungah zong pahtawina ka sui ngai sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh nu in atate hawmthawtah a don a akep bangin na lah uah lungnem tahin ka um uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka it leh ngaitahte uh na hing hitah ziehun, noute hing ngaina mama in Pasian khantanhoi hing hil guoh lungkim khoplou in, ka hinna nangawn uh hing pieh ka ut uhi."},"9":{"text":"Unaute aw ka sepgim dan u’leh ka sepnasat dan uh na theizing uhi, na lah ua koima ka suhbuoi louna dingun sun leh zan a semgim in, Pasian khantanhoi noute ka hing hil uhi."},"10":{"text":"Nou gingtute lah a, siengthoutah leh dihtah leh genbanglou a ka gamtat dan uh ahing theipite na hi uh, tualeh Pasian zong ang theipipa ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pa in tate tunga abawl bangin noute ka hing hanthawn ua, ka hing hamuon ua, tualeh ka hing hil ua, na tung ua ka bawldante uh na thei uhi."},"12":{"text":"Aleenggam leh athupina sunga, noute hing hanlutpa Pasian mi hitaah a na um theina ding uh ka dei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tami ziehin Pasian kungah tawplou in kipahthu ka gen uhi, aziehpen koute akipata Pasian thu na zah ua na pom laiun, mihing thu banga pomlouin, nou gingtute a zong nasahtah a nasemthei Pasian thu bangin na pom zaw uhi.","title":"Thessalonikate ginna leh thuoh hatna"},"14":{"text":"Unaute aw, Khrist Jesu a um Judia gam a Pasian hattuomte umdan zuimite na hi ua, amauten Judate lah a athuoh bangun, nouten zong na gammite uh lah ah na thuoh uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 17.5"},"15":{"text":"Tua Judaten Mangpa Jesu leh aguolneite athat ua, koute zong ahing bawlsie uhi, tualeh Pasian asulungkim sih ua, mizousie adou uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 9.23,29; 13.45,50; 14.2,5,19; 17.5,13; 18.12"},"16":{"text":"Hundam ahi theina ding ua Jentelte lah a thugen ahing khaam ua, tam bangin akhelna uh a sudim ngitnget uhi, hinanleh Pasian lungthahna khu nasatah in ahing tungta hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Unaute aw, koute pen hun tomkhat sung lungtangah hilou in tahsa a kikhen a i um zieh un, kilawptah a na meel uh mu dingin ka hapan semsem uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin na kung ua hing pei ka ut uhi, Kei Paul mama in zong nivei zen hinghaw ka tumta hi, hinanleh setan in ahing dal leng hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen ka kinepna u’leh, ka kipahna uh, ahisihleh ka kipahna manglukhu uh bang ahiei? Ahing pei chienga i Mangpa Jesu mai ah noute mama na hisih ding uh a mah?"},"20":{"text":"Noute pen ka thupina u’leh ka kipahna uh na hi uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka thuohzou nawnlou bep un Athen khuo ah kouma guoh nuasie in um u’leng hoi dingin ka ngaituo uhi.","title":"Paul in Timothi asawlna","ref":"Nasep. 17.15"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n i unaupa uh Timothi Pasian nasempa, Khrist khantanhoi lam a ka seppi uh, noute hing sudet ding leh na ginna lam ua hing hamuon dingin ka hing sawl uhi."},"3":{"text":"Tam genthei thuohna zieh a koima akilin louna dingin, tam silte thuoh ding mawng a guot ihi uh chi noute mama in na thei uhi."},"4":{"text":"Na kung ua ka um lai un, gimthuohnate thuoh ding ihi uh chi ka hing hil masata uhi, tuabang ngei in ahing tungta, chi na thei uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tami ziehin, ka thuoh zou nawnlou bep un, solhatpa’n noute ahing solpua khah dinga, ka sepgimna uh athawn hi khava chi in na gindan uh thei dingin ama ka hing sawl ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin noute a kipat kou kungah Timothi ahing tunga, na ginna u’leh na hing itna uh, tualeh na hing thei ngitnget ua, kouten ka hing mu nuom mama bangun nouten zong na hing mu nuom mama uh chi, tanchin kipah huoitah ahing puo hi.","title":"Timothi thutut","ref":"Nasep. 18.5"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin unaute aw, ka thuohgimna u’leh ka hasatna zousie uah, na ginna zieh un, na tung uah lungmuong tahin ka um uhi."},"8":{"text":"Tuin ka hing huoi huoi ta uhi, Mangpa a na dindet phot u’leh."},"9":{"text":"I Pasian uh mai ah, noute zieh a ka kipahna zousie zieh un, noute tungthu ah Pasian kung ah bangchi bangin kipah thu ka gen tabep ding uoi?"},"10":{"text":"Na mel uh ka mu theina ding u’leh, na ginna lam ua, na tahsap uh ka hing suhbuchinsah theina dingun sun leh zan in nasatahin thu ka ngen tawntung uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuin i Pasian leh Pa mama in tualeh Mangpa Jesu Khrist in na kung lam uah hing pui hen.","title":"Paul in amaute ave utna"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh kouten noute kang it bangbang un Mangpa’n noute khat leh khat na ki it tuona u’leh mi zousie na itna uh khangsah semsem hen,"},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n i Mangpa Jesu Khrist amisiengthoute zousie toh ahing pei chieng a, i Pasian leh Pa mai a sienthouna a genbanglou hi dingin na lungtangte uh ahing sukip thei ding hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n atawp penin unaute aw, na umdan ding u’leh Pasian na lungkim sah dan dinguh ka kung ua kipata na ziltah mabang ua, na kiningchin semsem na dingun, Mangpa Jesu min in ka hing ngen un, ka hing hanthawn uhi.","title":"Hindan siengthou"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa Jesu tungtawn a thupieh ka hing piehte uh, bang ahiei chi na thei uhi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen Tami Pasian deilam ahi, na sienthouna dingun, numei pasal kaal a thanghuoina tawpsan un."},"4":{"text":"Michin in siengthou tah leh zatat huoitah in ama uh tahsa chiet kepdan athei chiet ding uh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian theilou Jentelte banga huasanna lam a kidehla a um louin,"},"6":{"text":"Tam thu ah koiman aval a gamtain aunaupa tungah silgilou bawl sih heh, Mangpa khu tambang sil bawlte zousie phulapa ahiziehin, kouten zong ka hing vau hil ua, ka hing theisah zouta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in asienglou dingin eite ahing han sih a, asiengthou dingin ahing han zaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin tam thuhilna nuol mi in, mihing nuol ahi sih a, Hagau Siengthou eite hing pepa nuol ahi zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh unau ki itna lam thu ah gelpieh na ngai sih uhi, ki-ittuo chiet dingin noute mama Pasian hil in na umta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Masidonia gam pumpi a, unau um zousie tungah tuabangin na bawlta uhi. Hinanleh unaute aw, tuabanga hing khang semsem dingin kang hanthawn uhi."},"11":{"text":"Thu ka hing pieh bangun, kamtamlou a um in, nouma sepding chiet awlmaw un, tualeh nouma khut mama a sepkhiet ding tum chiet un."},"12":{"text":"Tuachia pulam mite lam a kilawmtah a na um theina ding u’leh, tahsap bangma na nei louna ding un."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh unaute aw, kinepna neilou mi dangte banga, na lungkham louna dingun, imute tungtang na theilou uh ka dei sih hi.","title":"Khrist a shisate tungtang"},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Jesu ashi a, athoukiata chi igintat leh Jesu a imute zong Pasian in Ama toh ahing puikhawm ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tami Mangpa thuin na kung uah ka gen uh ahi, eite Mangpa hing pei donga, dam a na um nalaite’n imusate i makhel sih ding hi.","ref":"1 Kor. 15.51,52"},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa ngei khu kikou aw toh, vansawlsieng tungnung pen aw toh, tualeh pengkul gingtoh van a kipat hing kumsuh ding ahi, tualeh Khrist a shisate athou masa ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuazou chiengin ei hinga na um nalaite huikhuo ah Mangpa tuoh dingin amau’toh meipi lah ah lahtouin i um dinga, tuachi’n kumtawn in, Mangpa kungah i umta ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin tam thute in kihamuontuo chiet un."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh unaute aw, ahun leh ani lam thu pen na kung ua ka gel akipha maw sih hi.","title":"Mangpa ni"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa ni khu zan a guta banga hing tung ding ahi chi, noute mama in chientahin na thei uhi.","ref":"Mat. 24.43; Luk. 12.39; 2 Pet. 3.10"},"3":{"text":"“Muonna leh bitna chia agen laitah un,” numei nauvei bangin manthaina thakhat in atung uah atung dinga, asuohta vawt sih ding uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh unaute aw, noute pen tua ni in guta banga hing vabihphawn dingin miel ah na um sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Na unpi un, vah tate leh sun tate na hi uhi. Eite zan tate ihi sih a miel tate zong ihi sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin mi dangte bangin imu sih vai, pil kiukiau in umzaw va ui."},"7":{"text":"Imute pen zan a imu ahi ua, zu khamten zong zan a akham uh ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh eite pen sun tate ihi zieh un, ginna leh itna awmphaw silin, hundamna kinepna lukhuh khuin eima kithunun in um vai.","ref":"Isai. 59.17; Eph. 6.13-17"},"9":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in eite lungthahna thuoh dingin ahing guot sih a, i Mangpa Jesu Khrist vanga hundamna tang dinga ahing guot ahizaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama khu itaangin ashi a, ikhahlaw in zong i imut in zong Ama toh ihingkhawm ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ziehin na bawlsa mabangun, khat leh khat kihamuon tuo unlen, kisuhat tuo chiet un."},"12":{"text":"Unaute aw, na lah ua semgimte leh, Mangpa a na lamkaite u’leh noute hing vauhil mite thei dingin;","title":"Hindan siengthou dinga kithuhilna"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh anasep zieh ua amaute itna toh ngaisang dingin ka hing ngen uhi. Nouma lah a kituoh tahin um un."},"14":{"text":"Tuin unaute ka hing hanthawn uhi, danlou banga umte vauhil unlen, lungkete hamuon unlen, hatloute panpi unlen, mi zousie tungah thuohhattahin um un."},"15":{"text":"Koima’n koi gitlouna zong gitlou a thuh lou dingin pilvang un, hinanleh nouma leh mi zousie a dingin sil hoi del zaw un."},"16":{"text":"Kipah ngitnget un,"},"17":{"text":"Tawplou in thum un,"},"18":{"text":"Sil bangkim ah kipah thu gen un, Tami noute dinga, Khrist a Pasian deilam ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hagau sumit sih un,"},"20":{"text":"Pasian thu kigente simmaw sih un."},"21":{"text":"Sil zousie enchien unlen, ahoi pouma tudet un."},"22":{"text":"Sil hoilou a kilangte apat kihemkhie un."},"23":{"text":"Tuin hamuonna Pasian mamain noute hing susiengthou bukimta hen, tualeh na lungsim u’leh, na hinna hagau u’leh na tahsa zousie uh i Mangpa Jesu Khrist hing pei chienga, genbanglou dingin humbit in um hen.","title":"Thuzawna"},"24":{"text":"Noute hing hanpa aginum a, Aman a bawl ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Unaute aw, thu hing nget pieh un."},"26":{"text":"Unaute zousie tawp siengthou in ka nousiet uhi hing gen pieh un."},"27":{"text":"Tam laihah unau siengthoute zousie kungah, hing simpieh dingin, Mangpa min in thu ka hing pie hi."},"28":{"text":"I Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist hepina na kung uah um hen."}}}}},"53":{"info":{"name":"2 Thessalonika","shortname":"2 Thes.","abbr":[],"desc":"Thessalonika mite kunga sawltah paul laihah nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Silvanus leh Timothi in i Pa uh Pasian leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist a Thessalonika khuo a um hattuom kungah:","title":"Nousietna","ref":"Nasep. 17.1"},"2":{"text":"I Pa uh Pasian leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist a kipat hepina leh lungmuonna na kung uah um hen."},"3":{"text":"Unaute aw, na ginna uh nasatah a, akhan let a, khat leh khat na ki it tuona uh akhan semsem zieha, na tungtang thu ua bawl tuoh ahimabangin, Pasian kunga kipahthu gen den ding mawng ka hi uhi.","title":"Kipahthu genna"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n mi’n noute ahing bawlsietnate u’leh na gimthuohnate zousie ua, na thuohhat dan u’leh, na gindan zousie uh ziehin Pasian hattuom lah ah ka hing suong uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua khu Pasian gam mi a sim taah na hi theina ding ua, Pasian vaihawmna dihtatna kichientah ahia, tuami ding ma a zong genthei thuoh na hi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Nou hing subuoite gimthuohna a thuh khu Pasian a ding a sil dihtat huoi ahi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh nou suhgim a umte pen, Mangpa Jesu van a kipat a avansawlsieng hattah toh ahing kilah chiengin, koute toh khawldamna ahing pekhawm ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Meikuonga ahing kilah chiengin, Pasian theiloute leh i Mangpa Jesu Khrist khantanhoi thumang loute phuba ala ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute pen Mangpa mai leh asilbawl theina thupitah akipan in kumtawn manthaina ah gawt in aum ding uhi.","ref":"Isai. 2.10"},"10":{"text":"Tua ni chienga, Ama ahing pei a, amisiengthoute a suhthupi a aum a, agingta mi zousie lah a lamdang sah a aum ni chiengin. Noute lah a theipina thu ka gen uh na gintat zieh un, noute zong agingta mite lah a telkha na hi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin i Pasian un ahing hatna toh kituoh a sim taah ahing sah theina ding leh hoina leh ginna nasep zousie asilbawltheina toh atangtunsah theina dingin, noute a dingin zong thu ka ngen ngitnget uhi."},"12":{"text":"I Pasian u’leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist hepina dungzui a noute i Mangpa Jesu Khrist min pahtawi a aum a, Ama a noute pahtawi a na umna ding un."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin unaute aw, i Mangpa Jesu Khrist hing pei na ding leh eite Ama kunga i kikhop khawm na ding thu toh kisai in, ka hing ngen uhi,","title":"Mangpa hing peikiana dingthu a gaidan dihloute","ref":"1 Thes. 4.15-17"},"2":{"text":"Mangpa ni khu ahing tung zouta chi hagau in ahiei, thuin ahiei, tualeh koute akipan laihah ahiei in na lungsim uh kiling sah sih unlen, ahisihleh buoi pai sih un."},"3":{"text":"Banglam tengah koiman hing sol zou sih heh, aziehpen puasanna ahing tun masah a, khelna mipa mangthang tapa hing kilang masa louin, tua ni hing tunglou ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ama pen miten Pasian achi pouma u’leh abieh pouma uh douin tuate tungah ama leh ama akitawisang dinga, Pasian kihisah in Pasian biehinn ah Pasian bangin atou ding hi.","ref":"Dan. 11.36; Ezek. 28.2"},"5":{"text":"Na kung ua ka um lai in, tam silte ka hing hilta chi thei nawnlou na hi uoi mah."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh tuin ama pen ama hun tah a ahing kilat ding bang ahiei adal chi na thei uhi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen Danbei a gamtatna thuguh in asem panta hi, Ama dalpa lampi apat lahmang ahi masangsiein, Ama adal zing ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuazou chiengin danbei a gamtapa ahing kilang dinga, Mangpa Jesu’n akam a huin akatum ding a, tualeh ahing peina vah in, danbei a gamtapa asumang ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 11.4"},"9":{"text":"Tua danbei a gamtapa hing pei khu Setan nasepna dungzui a, silbawltheinate, chiemtenate leh zuouthu lamdangte,","ref":"Mat. 24.24"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh mangthaite adingin dihtatlouna solna zousie toh ahi dinga, hundam ahi theina ding ua, thutah itna apomlou zieh uh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tami ziehin zuouthu agintat na dingun, Pasian in dihlouna nasep hattah akung uah asawl dinga,"},"12":{"text":"Thutah gingtalou a, dihtatlouna kipahpite zousie mawpai in a um ding uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh unau Mangpa ittahte aw, hagau a suhsiengthouna leh thutah ginna zieha, hundam a um dinga achiil a kipat Pasian in noute ahing tel ziehin koute pen noute dinga Pasian kunga kipahthu gen ngitnget ding mawng ka hi uhi.","title":"Mangpa ni a gingtute hamuonna"},"14":{"text":"Ka khantanhoi genna zieh un, Aman i Mangpa Jesu Khrist thupina tangdingin noute ahing han hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin unaute dingkip unlen, thu gen hiin, ka laihah un hitaleh, thugousie noute ka hing hilte uh tudet un."},"16":{"text":"Tuin i Mangpa Jesu Khrist Ama ngel leh eite hing it Pasian leh i Pa uh hepina zal a kumtawn hamuonna leh kinepna hing pepa’n,"},"17":{"text":"Na lungtang uh hing hamuonin, thugen leh nasep hoi chintengah hing sudet tahen."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Atawp pen in unaute aw, Mangpa thu noute a aum banga khanga suhthupi a aumtheina ding leh;","title":"Kukal tah in Khrist na ngahun"},"2":{"text":"Mitatsete leh mi giloute laha kipat ka bit theina dingun thu hing nget pieh un, aziehpen mizousie in ginna anei kim sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa khu a ginum a, Aman noute ahing sudet dinga, mi gilou lah ah ahing veng ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Na kung ua ka hing thupiehte uh, na bawl ua na bawl zel ding uh chi Mangpa ah ka hing muong uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuin Mangpa’n na lungtangte uh, Pasian itna, leh Khrist thuohhatna ah hing pui heh."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh unaute aw, koute apat a thugousie namute uh banga umlou a, dan banglou a gamta sanggamte zousie lah a kihemkhe dingin i Mangpa Jesu Khrist min in thu ka hing pie uhi.","title":"Thasiet louding"},"7":{"text":"Noute mama in na hing zui dan uh na thei uhi, aziehpen na lah uah dan banglouin ka gamta ngai sih uhi;"},"8":{"text":"Koima tanghou aman beiin ka ne ngai sih ua, na lah ua koima ka suhbuoi louna ding un gimtahin sun leh zan in ka semgim zaw uhi."},"9":{"text":"Thuneina ka neilou zieh uh ahi sih a, hinanleh na hing zui ding ua etton dingin kouma leh kouma ka kibawl zaw uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na kung ua ka um lai nangawn un tam thu ka hing pie uhi, koipou in nna asep nuom sih leh nezong ne sih heh."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen na lah ua dan bangloua gamta a, nasep mawngmawng donlou a, kitahla taha mi nasepna tengah akikumthaw mi aum uhi, chi ka za uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuabang mite pen nna sem khinkhien ding leh amauh tanghou ki neh dingin, Mangpa Jesu Khrist min in thu pie in ka hanthawn zaw uhi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh unaute, noute’n vang sil hoi bawl chimtah sih un."},"14":{"text":"Koipou in tam laihah a ka thuhil uh azui sih leh tua mi khu chiemte unlen, azum theina ding in kigoppi sih un."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh melma bangin bawl sih unlen, sanggam bangin vauhil zaw un."},"16":{"text":"Tuin hamuonna Mangpa mama in lamchinteng ah, bangchih lai pouin noute hamuonna hing peta hen. Mangpa’n na unpi un hing umpita hen.","title":"Thukhupsin"},"17":{"text":"Tam ka hing nousietna lai pen Kei Paul in keima khut ngel a ka gel ahi, ka laihahte zousie ah chiemtena hi dingin tambangin ka giel hi."},"18":{"text":"I Mangpa Jesu Khrist hepina in na unpi un hing umpi ta hen. Amen."}}}}},"54":{"info":{"name":"1 Timothi","shortname":"1 Tim.","abbr":[],"desc":"Timothi kunga sawltah paul laihah khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"I hundampa uh Pasian leh ikinepna uh, Mangpa Jesu Khrist thupieh dungzui a, Jesu Khrist sawltah Paul in,","title":"Nousietna"},"2":{"text":"Ginna a ka tapa dihtah Timothi kungah, Pasian i Pa u’leh i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist akipat hepina, khotuona leh hamuonna, na kungah umta hen.","ref":"Nasep. 16.1"},"3":{"text":"Masidonia gam a ka pei ding kuon a, Kang thuhil bangin, Ephesa khuo ah umden in, mi pawlkhat in thugin dihlou ahil nawnlou na ding ua thu na hil theina dingin,","title":"Thuhil mi dihloute"},"4":{"text":"Amauten tangthu bulbal neilou khangthu sut beitheilou, kinielna apiengsah ua, ginna zieh a Pasian nasepna lam a phatuomlou thute taisan dingin thu hil in."},"5":{"text":"Tam thupiehin atup pen lungtang siengthou leh sie leh pha theina hoi leh ginna dihtah akipat a hing um itna nei ahi."},"6":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatten tamte a pielsan ua, thuginalou genna lam ah akiheisanta uhi."},"7":{"text":"Dan hilmite hi akilawp ua, athugen uh umdan leh athuhilte uh adihna atheichien sih uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh, mi’n dan ahidantaha azahdih nah pouleh dan ahoi chi ithei uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tam khu thei in, dan pen midihtatte dinga bawl ahi sih a, dan bei a gamtate, thumangloute ding, Pasian neiloute leh mikhielte a ding leh misiengloute leh buate, ading, Pate thatte, nute thatte leh mihing thatte a ding."},"10":{"text":"Kingaina lam a thangtatte ading, tokohuate ding, mihing gute a ding, zuou hatte a ding, zuouthu a kihahsielte a ding, tualeh thugin dihtah toh kikal mawngmawngte a dinga bawl ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ka kung a ngansiena hing kipie, pahtawi taah Pasian thupitah khantanhoi dungzui in."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh anasempa a ahing koi a, ginum a ahing sim ziehin, ahing suhatpa Khrist Jesu i Mangpa uh kungah kipah thu ka gen hi.","title":"Paul tunga Mangpa hepina"},"13":{"text":"Tumasang lai in Pasian gensepa, bawlsepa leh huhampa kana hi a, hinanleh theiloupi a ginna neilou a na bawl ka na hi ziehin khotuona ka nga hi.","ref":"Nasep. 8.3; 9.4,5"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh i Mangpa uh hepina, Khrist Jesu a um ginna leh itna in a dimlet hi."},"15":{"text":"Jesu Khrist khu mikhielte hundam dingin leitungah ahing pei hi, chi tam thu gintat um leh pomtah mama ahi, tua mi khielte lah ah Kei mikhiel lien pen ka hi."},"16":{"text":"Hitamananleh tunuachienga kumtawn hinna tang dinga, Ama hing gingta dingte etsahna dingin, Jesu Khrist in athuohzou dan keima a akilatsah thei na dingin, kei migilou pen hinanleng, tami ziehin khotuona ka mu hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuin tangtawn leengpa, shitheilou, mutheilou, Pasian pil umsun kungah zatatna leh thupina kumtawn kumtawn in umta hen, Amen."},"18":{"text":"Ka tapa Timothi aw, tumasanga nang toh kisai a thumavang kigenlawh thute dungzui in, tam thuhilna ka hing pie hi, tua genlawhna thute zui a kidouna hoi na dou thei na dingin,"},"19":{"text":"Ginna leh sielepha theina hoi tudet in, tuakhu mi pawlkhat in apampai ua, ginna lamah kuongsie bangin akehgawp sahta uhi."},"20":{"text":"Amaute lah ah Himenaeus leh Alekzandar, atel uhi, Pasian gensietlou azil thei na ding un, amaute Setan kungah ka peta hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin amasapenin deingetnate, thungetnate, thungetpiehnate leh kipahthu gennate mi zousie a dinga bawl pieh dingin ka hing hanthawn hi.","title":"Vantaang biehna thu a kihilnate"},"2":{"text":"Leengte leh thuneina neite zousie a dingin zong; tuachia Pasian ngaisah leh zatat huoitah a hinkhuo kituoh leh hamuon huoi taha i um theina ding un."},"3":{"text":"Tam khu ihundampa uh Pasian mitmuin ahoiin apomtah hi."},"4":{"text":"Aman mi zousie humdam a um ding leh thutah thei dingin a dei hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian khat a um a, Pasian leh mihing kikaal ah palai khat a um hi, mihing Khrist Jesu khu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ama pen mi zousie tatdohna man dingin ahing kipie hi, ahuntaha theipi a um dingin,"},"7":{"text":"Tua theipina thu gen dinga sawltah a guot ka hi; Khrist ah thutah ka gen a, ka zuou sih hi, ginna leh thutah a Jentelte thuhilpa ka hi.","ref":"2 Tim. 1.11"},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin pasalten mun chinah khut siengthou jahin, lungthah lou leh ginglel louin thu ngen u’leh ka dei hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuamabangin numei ten zong, puonsil kilawmhun leh zumthei leh umdan siem in kizem u’henlen, sam suhkiil ahiei, sana ahiei, tuikepsuong ahiei leh, sil mantam a kizem lou in,","title":"Taangpi biehna a numeite","ref":"1 Pet. 3.3"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh numei Pasian ngaisah kichite akilawm hun giapin nasep hoi toh kizem u’leh ka dei hi."},"11":{"text":"Numei in sip khinkhian in leh thunuoilutna kim toh zil u’heh."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh numei in thu ahil ka phal sih a, ahisihleh pasal tunga thu anei zong ka phal sih hi, sip khinkhian in umzaw u’heh."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen Adam siem masah ahi a, tuami nua in Evi siem ahi.","ref":"Siem. 2.7; Siem. 2.21,22"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Adam sol in a um sih a, hinanleh numei pen sol in a um a, bawsietna ah apuata hi.","ref":"Siem. 3.1-6"},"15":{"text":"Ahivang in ginna, itna leh siengthouna leh kidehzouna toh hindan kilawm a aum u’leh nau paina ah hundam in a um ding uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi koipou in hattuom lamkai a pan aut leh na hoi sem ut ahi, chia na kigen khu thudih ahi.","title":"Hattuom lamkaite leh upate chinna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n hattuom lamkai pen, gensietbei, zi khat nei, kidehthei, lungsim sieng, umdan hoi, mikiphal, thuhil siem;","ref":"Tit. 1.6-9"},"3":{"text":"Zu khamlou, gumtat lou, sum deigawmi hilou, hinanleh nunnem, kihau hatlou, enhatlou;"},"4":{"text":"Ama innsung vaihawm siem, zatat umtah a atate thunun siem mi ahi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen mi’n ama innsung nangawn vaihawm dan atheisih leh bangchi’n Pasian hattuomte akem thei diei?"},"6":{"text":"Gingtha mi ahilou ding ahi, tuachilouin akisathei kha ding a, dawimangpa toh kibanga mawpai ahi kha ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuathamlouin pulam mite pahtat zong ahi ngei ding ahi, tuachilouin minsie in dawimangpa thang ah a awh kha ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuamabangin hattuom upate khu mizatat um, kamtamlou, zu dawnlou, sum deigawlou ahi ding uhi.","title":"Hattuom upate chinna"},"9":{"text":"Sie leh pha theina a siengthouin ginna thuguh keem mi ahi ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tamte ah etchienin um masa u’henlen, tuazou chienga gensietbei ahi u’leh hattuom upa hina nna sem uheh."},"11":{"text":"Tuabangmain azite u’zong mi zatat um ahi ngei dinguh ahi, kamtamlou kideh thei, sil zousie a ginum ahi ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hattuom upate khu zi khatnei, atate u’leh a innsung uh kituptah a vaihawm siem mi hi u’heh."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen hattuom upa nna hoitaha semten dinmun hoitah leh Khrist Jesu a um ginna lam a hansanna thupitah anei uhi."},"14":{"text":"Sawtlou kaal a na kunga hing pei kinem nanleng tam thuhilnate na kungah ka hing giel hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hing zekai khah leh Pasian inn sunga bangchi gamtat ding ahiei chi na theina dingin ka hing giel ahi, Pasian innkuonte khu Pasian hing hattuom khuom leh kingahna suongphum ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian ngaisahna thuguh khu niel guollou in athupi hi: Pasian tahsain ahing kilanga, Hagau in siem atang a, Vansawlsiengten a mu ua, Jentelte lah ah tangkoupi in aum a, leitung pumpi gintat in aum a, thupina a lahtou in a umta hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hun nukhia lam chiengin mi pawlkhatten puimangna hagaute leh dawite thuhilna ngaisahin ginna ataisan ding uh chi Hagau in chientahin agen hi;","title":"Timothi thuhilnate"},"2":{"text":"Lepchiena a zuouthu genin, asie leh pha theina uh sia am a dep bang ahi ua,"},"3":{"text":"Kiten akham ua, neh ding annte, thutah gingta a theiten, kipahthu gen a saan ding a Pasian in asiemte khu nelou dingin thu apie uhi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian silsiem zousie ahoi hi, Kipah thugenna toh saan ahipouleh, bangma nuol ding a um sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian thu leh thungetna a suhsiengthou ahita hi."},"6":{"text":"Unaute kunga tam silte na zilsah leh nang pen thugin thutah leh pilvangtah a na zuisa, thuhilna hoi a khanglien Jesu Khrist nasempa hoi na hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian zatatlouna thu leh pitehte tangthu bulbal neiloute dei sinlen, Pasian ngaisahna lam ah kithunun zawin."},"8":{"text":"Tahsa lam kithununna in phattuomna themkhat anei a, hinanleh Pasian ngaisahna pen silbangkim ah aphatuom a, tu hun a hinna um leh ahing tung ding hun a hinna ding thuchiem anei hi."},"9":{"text":"Tam thugen pen a unpia pomtaah leh muonhuoi ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian hing i muon ziehin, i semgim a, gensietna thuoh in ipang teitei uhi, Ama mi zousie hundampa ahi a, agingtate dingin ahi dieh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tam thupiehte pie inlen zilsah in."},"12":{"text":"Na naupanna Koima’n simmaw sih heh, hinanleh hamkam suoh ah, gamtat dan ah, itna lam ah, hagau lam ah, ginna lam ah, sienthouna lamah, gingtute etton ding hi zawin."},"13":{"text":"Ka hing pei masangsiein laisiengthou sim, hanthawnna thugen leh thuhilna ngaisah in."},"14":{"text":"Nangma a um silpieh thumavang genna a pieh ngaisah lou in um sin, upaten na tunga khut ahing ngap lai ua, na kunga pieh ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tam silte ngaituo inlen, mi zousie kunga na phattuom dan kichientah alat theina dingin, tamte ah kizangbeiin."},"16":{"text":"Nangma leh na thuhil ah pilvang inlen, tuate ah um ngitnget in, tuabanga na um leh nangma kihumbit in, na thu ngaikhete zong na hundam ding hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tehsete phawh sinlen, pa bangin hanthawn zawin, tangval deute sanggamte bangin bawlin.","title":"Nasemhoi na sepding dan"},"2":{"text":"Pitehte nute bangin, nungah deute sanggamnu bangin sienthouna zousie toh hanthawnin."},"3":{"text":"Meithai tahtahte zatat in.","title":"Meithaite kep dingdan"},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh meithai koipouin tate leh tute anei leh, anu leh pate uh athuh kiana dingun, amauh innkuon sungah abiehna nasep uh tahsuohna ding zil masa u’heh, tam pen Pasian mitmu in ahoi a, tualeh apomtah hi."},"5":{"text":"Meithai tahtah ama tanga um in, Pasian amuonga, sun leh zan a ngen in athum ngitnget hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh meithai ama nopsahna a hing nu khu adamlai in zong ashi ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh genbanglou a aum theina dingun tam thute pie in."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh koipou in ama mite adiehin a innkuonpite ading ngaituolou mi khu ginna nuol ahi a, ginglou mi sangin asezaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Meithai kum sawmguh nuoi lam, mi khat zi na hita pen meithai a simlou ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Sil hoi bawl lam a mite pahtat a um a, tate khoilien a, mikhuolte na zintun a, misiengthoute keng na silpieh a, genthei thuohte na panpi a, silhoi chinteng thanuom tah a sem ngitnget ahileh, meithai a sim ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh meithai nungah deute pen gellut sin, aziehpen Khrist lam a ahing kiplou chiengun pasal nei alunggul zel uhi."},"12":{"text":"A ginna masa uh atawpsan ziehun siemloutangin a um zel uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaban ah a thasiet chieng un, inn chin ah aban vah kawi ua, athasiet guoh uh hilou in, mi gensiet ahat ua, genlou ding gen in sil teng ah akikum thaw uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin meithai nungah deuten pasal nei u’henlen, tate nei in innsung kem hoi uhenlen, melmapa a dingin gensietna hunlem bawlpieh sih u’leh ka dei hi."},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen tuin zong meithai pawlkhatte setan lam ah apielkheta uhi."},"16":{"text":"Gingtu numei ahiei, pasal ahiei, koipou in, inn sunga meithai anei u’leh, panpi uheh, hattuom puohgih guonlou ding ahi, tuachi’n hattuom in meithai tahtahte apanpi thei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Hattuom upa vaihawm siemte, adieh in thunasemte leh thuhilna nasemte aleni a pahtawina tangtah a guot hi u’heh.","title":"Upate thuhil dingdan"},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen Laisiengthou in “Bawngtal in bu achiil lai in akam kaan sin,” tualeh “Nasem khu law mutaah ahi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 25.4; Mat. 10.10; Luk. 10.7"},"19":{"text":"Hattuom upa ahehna u’khu, theipimi ni ahiei, thum ahiei apan sih leh pom sin.","ref":"Danp. 17.6; 19.15"},"20":{"text":"Mi dangte azau theina dingin, mikhielte pen mizousie mai ah phawhhil in."},"21":{"text":"Tam thuhilnate khentuom neilou a zui ding leh deisah tuom neilou a bawl dingin, Pasian leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist leh vansawlsieng telte mitmu in thu ka hing pie hi."},"22":{"text":"Mi koima tungah khut ngap kinaw sinlen, mi dangte khelna ah kikum sin, siengthou tahin kikem ngitnget in."},"23":{"text":"Na gilpi ziehin leh na chinat paipai ziehin, tui guoh dawn nawn sinlen, uoin themkhat khat zang zelin."},"24":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte khelnate chientah in akilanga, amaute thukhenna mun atung masa zel uhi; hinanleh mi pawlkhatte pen akhelna un anuazui hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuamabangin mi pawlkhatte nasep hoite chientah in akilang a, akilang loute zong akiphuol thei tuom sih hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian min leh athuhilna gensiet a aum louna dingin, suoh hahkol a taangte zousie’n ama uh pute khu bangkim a zatat taahin sim u’heh.","title":"Suohte kunga hanthawnna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh gingtu pu a neite’n unaute a hing hitah zieh un, simmaw sih u’heh, hinanleh amauh nasepna phattuompite khu ging tute leh ittahte ahi zieh un, a nna uh seppieh uheh. Tam thute hil inlen hanthawn in."},"3":{"text":"Mi koipou in kithuhilna dang ahil a, i Mangpa Jesu Khrist thutah toh kituohlou leh Pasian ngaisahna lam ahil khah sih leh,"},"4":{"text":"Ama pen akiliensah ahia, bangma theilou ahi; thei malahin kiniel leh kihauna lam ah utna mot huoi anei hi. Tuate a kipat, thangsietna, kihauna, kigensietna leh kiginmawna hoilou,"},"5":{"text":"Lungsimsie nei a, thutah neilou, mi nielhatna bang ahing pieng zel hi; tuabang mite khu Pasian ngaisahna khu metna a ngai mi ahi uhi; tuabang mite apat in kihemkhie in."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh lungkimna toh Pasian ngaisah khu metna thupitah ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen leitung ah bangma ipawlut sih a, bangma ipawtpi sih ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Neh ding leh sil ding inei pou leh, tamte toh lungkim ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh hausat lunggulte pen solna leh thang ah leh utna mot huoi leh ahing susethei tampite sungah apualut zel ua, tuaten sietna leh manthaina ah mite atumsah zel uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen sum ngainat khu sil hoilou chinteng zungpi ahi a, tuakhu pawlkhat in adeigaw ua, ginna akipat apielmang ua, lunggimna tampi in akisun pailet uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh nang Pasian mipa aw, tam silte taisan inlen, dihtatna, Pasian ngaisahna, ginna, itna, thuohhatna leh nunnemna del zaw in."},"12":{"text":"Ginna kidouna hoi dou inlen, kumtawn hinna khu tudet in, tua khu tang dinga hat zong na hi a, tualeh theipi mi tampi mitmu ah ginna hoi na gumta hi."},"13":{"text":"Sil zousie kunga hinna pepa Pasian mitmu leh Pontius Pilat mai a gupna hoi phuongkhepa Khrist Jesu mitmu in, thu kang pie hi.","ref":"Jn. 18.37"},"14":{"text":"I Mangpa Jesu Khrist hing kilat kia masangsie’n tam thupieh khu nieh banglou leh genbanglou in kem in;"},"15":{"text":"Tam kilahna pen phat taah leh umsun, thuneipa, leengte Leengpa leh mangpate Mangpa Pasian in Ama huntah ah Jesu Khrist ah akilangsah ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama guoh in shi theilouna anei a, koima nai theilou vah ah a um a, Ama koiman amu ngai sih a, mu zong amu thei sih hi; Ama kungah kumtawn pahtawina leh silbawltheina umta hen. Amen."},"17":{"text":"Tu hun a haute kisathei lou ding leh akiplou hausatna a muonna ngalou a, sil zousie i kipahna dinga kichingtaha hing pepa Pasian hing tunga nga zaw dingin,","title":"Mihaute hanthawnna"},"18":{"text":"Sil hoi bawl dingin leh nasep hoi a hausa dingin, sil phal dingin, mite pe dinga mansa leh mi dangte kihoppi ut dingin thu pie in."},"19":{"text":"Kumtawn hinna atuhdet theina dingun, ahing tung ding hun a ding a, suongphum dettah hi ding, gou kholkhawm dingin amaute hil in."},"20":{"text":"Timothi aw, na kep dinga hing kipie pen hoitahin kem inlen, Pasian zatat louna a thugen mawh mawhte leh dihloutah a pilna kichi kikalnate pumpel in."},"21":{"text":"Tua theina khu mi pawlkhatten nei akisa ua, ginna lam ah asukhielta uhi. Hepina na kung ah umta hen. Amen."}}}}},"55":{"info":{"name":"2 Timothi","shortname":"2 Tim.","abbr":[],"desc":"Timothi kunga paul laihah nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Khrist Jesu a um hinna thuchiem dungzui a Pasian dei lam a Jesu Khrist sawltah in;","title":"Nousietna leh kipahthu genna"},"2":{"text":"Ka tapa ittah Timothi kungah, Pa Pasian leh Khrist Jesu i Mangpa uh kunga kipat hepina leh khotuona leh lungmuonna umta hen.","ref":"Nasep. 16.1"},"3":{"text":"Sun leh zan a tawplou a ka thungetnate a ka hing thei ngitnget ziehin, ka pu leh pate akipat a, sie leh pha theina siengtah nei a, a nna ka sep Pasian kungah kipahthu ka gen hi."},"4":{"text":"Na hituite ka thei ngitnget a, ka lungnopna akim theina dingin, nangma hing mu ding ka lunggul mama hi."},"5":{"text":"Ginna tuoilou nangma a um khu ka ngaituotah chiengin, tua ginna khu amasapen in na pi Loisi ah aum a, na nu Eunisi ah zong aum a, tualeh nangma ah zong a um chi ka theichien hi.","ref":"Nasep. 16.1"},"6":{"text":"Tuazieh in na tunga ka khut ngap zieh a Pasian silpieh nangma a um mutkuong dingin ka hing theisah kia hi.","title":"Timothi mawpuohna hilkiana"},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in zauna hagau ahing pe sih a, hinanleh silbawltheina, itna leh kithununna hagau ahing pe zaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin i Mangpa thu theipina khu zumpi sinlen, Ama hentapa kei zong hing zumpi sin, hinanleh khantanhoi zieha ka gentheinate Pasian silbawltheina dungzui in hing thuohpi zaw in."},"9":{"text":"Aman inasepte dungzui hilou in, Ama guot leh ahepina dungzui in ahing hundam a, hatna siengthou in ahing hanta hi, tuakhu hun kipat masang a Khrist Jesu a ahing pieh ahita hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh i hundampa Jesu Khrist hing kilahna ziehin, tuin sulat in a umta hi, Aman shina subei in khantanhoi zal in hinna leh shitheilouna khu vah ah ahing tunta hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua khantanhoi thu Jentelte theisah dingin thugentu ding leh sawltah ding leh thuhiltu dingin kei ahing guotta hi.","ref":"1 Tim. 2.7"},"12":{"text":"Tamte ziehin, Ken zong tam silte ka thuoh ahi, ahivangin ka zum sih hi, aziehpen ka gintatpa ka thei hi, tualeh Ama ka kepsah khu tua ni a dingin, akembit thei chi chientah in ka thei hi."},"13":{"text":"Khrist Jesu a um ginna leh itna nei in, kithuhilna chidam huoi ka kunga kipata na zahte khu tudet in."},"14":{"text":"Sil hoi na kunga hing kikemsah khu, eima sunga Hagau Siengthou um in kem hoi in."},"15":{"text":"Asia gam a um zousie in Kei ahing kiheimangsanta uh chi na thei hi, amaute lah ah Phigelas leh Hermogenes atel uhi."},"16":{"text":"Mangpa’n Onesiphorus innkuonpite kungah khotuona pie hen, aziehpen ama’n ahing suhal zelzel a, ka siakhainieng bu zong azumpi sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama Rom khuo ahing tun tahin, phattuomngai tahin Kei ahing sui a, ahing mudoh hi."},"18":{"text":"Aman tua ni chienga, Mangpa a kipata khotuona amu ding, Mangpa’n phalpieh hen, tualeh aman Ephesa khuo ah lam tampi ah kei hing panpi in nna asem hi, chi na thei hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin nang ka tapa aw, Khrist Jesu a um hepina ah hattah in um in.","title":"Khrist Jesu galkap hoitah"},"2":{"text":"Theipitu tampite lah a ka thugen na zahte, mi muonhuoi, midangte zong hilsawn thei dingte kungah kemsah in."},"3":{"text":"Tuazieh in Jesu Khrist galkap hoitah bangin hasatnate hing thuohpi in."},"4":{"text":"Galkap a pang dinga telpa akipahsah theina dingin galkap koima kidou lai in tam damsung khosahnate in akisubuoi ngai sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh kidemnate bangah mi pang nanleh zong dan dungzui a abawl sih leh, guolzawna lukhu khuhsah in a um ngai sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Lou neimi gimtah a nasem in asepgim gate ne masapa ahi ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ka thugen ngaituo detdet in, Mangpa’n sil zousie ah theisiemna ahing pe ding hi."},"8":{"text":"David suon a pieng Jesu Khrist khu, ka khantan hoi gen dungzuiin, mishi lah a kipat kaithaw in a um hi chi thei ngitnget in."},"9":{"text":"Tam khantanhoi ziehin gitlouna bawl mi banga thuohsah in ka um a, siakhainienga kaan in hasatna ka thuoh hi, hinanleh Pasian thu pen kaan in a um sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin tel tuomte ziehin sil zousie ka thuoh teitei hi, tuachia amauten zong Khrist Jesu a um hundam na khu kumtawn a thupina toh amu sam theina dingun ka thuoh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tam thugen agintat huoi ahi: Ama toh shi khawm i hi taah leh, Ama toh i hingkhawm ding uhi;"},"12":{"text":"Ithuoh u’leh, Ama toh vai ihawm khawm dinga, Ama ikitheimawbawl leh, Aman zong ahing kitheimaw bawl ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 10.33; Luk. 12.9"},"13":{"text":"Eite muonhuoi sih nanlei zong, Ama pen amuonhuoi ngitnget a, Ama leh ama akitheimawbawl thei sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Tam silte amauh theisah kia inlen, thu phattuomlou, angaikhemite a dinga, manthaina hi giap thu a kiniel lou dingin, Mangpa mai ah hil in.","title":"Pahtat huoi nasemmi"},"15":{"text":"Thutah, thu dihtah in khen in, nasem mi zumna ding neilou bangin, Pasian pomtah hi dinga nangma kipe dingin theitawpsuo in kizil in."},"16":{"text":"Pasian zatatlouna thu gen a kamtamte kiheimangsan in, aziehpen amauten Pasian ngaisahlouna lam ah mite apui gamla deudeu uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh athuzilsahte uh hima damtheilou bangin adalzah ding hi. Ama ute lah ah Himeneus leh Philetus apang uhi."},"18":{"text":"Amauten thutah apielsan ua, thawkiana a um zouta achi ua, mi pawlkhatte ginna asuhsiet pieh uhi."},"19":{"text":"Ahivang in Pasian suongphum dettahin adinga, tam chiemtena anei hi, “Mangpa’n Ama ate athei hi,” tualeh “Khrist minlou pouma in gitlouna kiheimangsan heh,” chiin.","ref":"Kisim. 16.5"},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh inn thupi sungah, sana leh dangka belte guoh a um sih a, sing leh leibel a kibawl zong a um hi, pawlkhatte manphatah a zah, pawlkhatte manphaloutah a zah ding ahi uhi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaziehin mi koipou tam silte lah a kipat a akihepkhiet leh, um leh bel manphatah a zah ding a siengthou Mangpa zat taah, na hoi chinteng sem dinga mansa ahi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Khangdawng utna giloute zong taisan inlen, hinanleh lungtang siengtah a Mangpa min loute toh, dihtatna, ginna, itna leh kilemnate delzaw in."},"23":{"text":"Hinanleh amot huoi leh theiloupi a kinielnate pumpel in, tuate’n kihauna apiengsah chi thei in."},"24":{"text":"Mangpa nasem mi a dingin mi toh kihau ding ahi sih hi, hinanleh mi zousie tunga, nunnem, thuhil siem, thuohhat, ahi zaw ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama nielkalte nunnem tah a thu ahil leh Pasian in amaute akisiasah dinga thutah theina ah apui ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh dawimangpa in ama deilam bawl dinga sal a amatna akipat amaute hing kiphawh in dawimangpa thanga kipat asuohta thei ding uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh tam zong thei in, ni nukhia lam ah hun hasate ahing um ding hi.","title":"Hun nukhiate a Pasian phawhlouna"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen mi ama uleh amauh ki itte, sum ngainate, ki uongsahte, kisatheite, Pasian gensete, nulepa thumangloute, kipahdan theiloute, siengthou loute,"},"3":{"text":"Itna neiloute, ngaidamna neiloute, mi sietna ding bawlte, kidehtheiloute, mi huhamte, hoideiloute,"},"4":{"text":"Lepchiete, ngongtatte, kingaisangte, Pasian it sanga nopsahna it zawte ahi ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Pasian ngaisahna bahna anei ding ua, hinanleh asilbawltheina atahsang sih ding uhi; tambang mite kinuaheisan in."},"6":{"text":"Tambang mite pen mi innchin ah ava lut ua, numei khelna puohgih puo, numei mo deute sala mana utna tuom tuoma puimangte, ahi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tambang numeite pen zil ngitnget napi a thutah thei pha ngailoute ahi uhi."},"8":{"text":"Jannes leh Jambres in Mosi adou bangun, tam miten zong thutah adou uhi, mi lungsim kisegawp, ginna lam a Pasian deilou mite ahi uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 7.11"},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh amaute amasawn sih ding uhi, aziehpen amaute gel bangin amotna uh mi zousie kungah akilang ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh nang pen in ka thuhilna, ka hindan, ka tup leh ngim, ka ginna, ka gimthuohna, ka itna leh ka kukaldan,","title":"Timothi mopuohna"},"11":{"text":"Bawlsietna leh hasatna ka thuohte, Antiok khuo, Ikonium khuo leh Listra khuo a ka tunga siltungte zousie, bawlsietna ka thuohte na theikim sieng hi; hinanleh Mangpa’n tuate akipat kei ahing hundoh ta hi.","ref":"Nasep. 13.14-52; Nasep. 14.1-7; Nasep. 14.8-20"},"12":{"text":"Ahi, Khrist Jesu a Pasian ngaisah a hin ut pouma in bawlsietna athuoh ding mawng ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh migilou leh mi lepchiete ase semsem ding ua, mite asol ding ua, miten zong amaute asol ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh nang pen na zil sa leh na theichiensa ah um zing inlen, tamte koi kung a kipata na zil a, na theichien ahiei, chi na thei hi,"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh na naupan lai a pat in, Khrist Jesu a ginna zieh a hundamna mu dinga nang hing hilpil thei laisiengthou thei na hita hi."},"16":{"text":"Laisiengthou zousie Pasian huhakhuma pieh ahi a, thuhil na ding, phawhhilna ding, bawlhoina ding, leh dihtatna lam a kithuhilna dingin aphatuom hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian mi khu nasep hoi chinteng sem dinga kimtah a kithuoma abukim theina dingin."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian masang leh Ama leh aleenggam hing kilat chienga mihing leh mishite thukhen pieh dingpa Mangpa Jesu Khrist mai ah tam mawpuohna ka hing guon hi.","title":"Thugen dinga thupieh"},"2":{"text":"Thu gen in, ahun leh ahunlou ah zong mansa in um in. Thuzaw inlen, phawhhil inlen, thuohtheina zousie leh thuhil pum in hanthawn in."},"3":{"text":"Amauten thuhilna dih angaikhiet ngaplou hun uh hing tung ding ahi, hinanleh thu ngainuom a bildaw ahizieh un, amauh deilam gen dingin thuhilmi akhawm ding uhi,"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh thutah akipat abilte uh aheimang ding ua, tangthu bulbal neiloute lam ah abildaw zawta ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh nang pen sil zousie ah pilvang inlen, hasatna thuoh inlen, sawltah nna sem in, na nasepna khu sutangtungin."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen tuin keipen dawn sillat banga sunbuoh a um ka hita a, ka peidoh hun atungta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ken kidouna hoi ka douta a, kitaidemna ka zouta hi, ginna ka kemta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuin dihtatna mang lukhu kei a dingin koi in a umta, tua khu Mangpa vaihawmpa dihtah in tua ni chiengin kei ahing pe ding hi, tualeh kei kung guoh ah hilouin, Ama hing kilahna ngaina poumate kungah zong ape ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Kintah in ka kungah hing pei pai tei tei in."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen Demas in tulai leitung a it mama ziehin Kei ang taisanta a, Thessalonika khuo ah apeita hi; Kresen Galatia gam ah apeita hi, Tita zong Dalmatia gam ah apeita hi.","ref":"Kolo. 4.14; Phile. 1.24; 2 Kor. 8.23; Gal. 2.3; Tit. 1.4"},"11":{"text":"Luke maimai ka kungah a um hi, Mak hing chiel inlen, hing zawpi in, nasepna lam ah ama kei a dingin aphatuom mama hi.","ref":"Kolo. 4.14; Phile. 1.24; Nasep. 12.12,25; 13.13; 15.37-39; Kolo. 4.10; Phile. 1.24"},"12":{"text":"Tikikus pen Ephesa khuo ah ka sawlta hi.","ref":"Nasep. 20.4; Eph. 6.21,22; Kolo. 4.7,8"},"13":{"text":"Na hing pei chiengin Troas khuo a Karpus kung a puonahtuol ka nuasie khu laibute toh hing puo in, adieh in savun laibu zielte hing puo in.","ref":"Nasep. 20.6"},"14":{"text":"Alekzandar, sumsan khengpa ka tungah agilou mama hi, Mangpa’n anasep dungzui in athuh ding hi.","ref":"1 Tim. 1.20; Late. 62.12; Rom. 2.6"},"15":{"text":"Nang zong ama akipat pilvang mama in, aziehpen ama’n ithuhilte adou nasa mama hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka dihna thu ka gen masah lai in Koima’n ang dinpi sih a, mi zousie in ahing taisan sieng zawta uhi, a mawna uh kipuoh se da ta u heh."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa’n ahing dinpi a, ahing suhat ta hi, tuachia kei zieha khantanhoi kimtaha akigen thei a, Jentelte zousie in azah theina ding un, tualeh humpibahnei kam sung apat hutdohin ka umta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh Mangpa’n gitlouna nasep chinteng akipat kei ahing hundoh dinga, Avanlam leenggam a dingin bittah in ahing humbit ding hi. Ama kungah kumtawnin thupina um tawntungta hen. Amen."},"19":{"text":"Priska leh Akuila tualeh Onesiphorus innkuonte ka nousiet hi, hing na gen pieh in,","title":"Paul mangpha hahna nukhia","ref":"Nasep. 18.2; 2 Tim. 1.16,17"},"20":{"text":"Erastus khu Korinth khuo ah a um denta hi; Trophimus ahileh Miletus khuo ah damlou in ka nuasie ta hi.","ref":"Nasep. 19.22; Rom. 16.23; Nasep. 20.4; 21.29"},"21":{"text":"Phalbi masangin hing pei sawm chinten in, Eubulus in mangpha ahing hah hi, tualeh Puden, Linus, Klaudia leh unaute’n zong mangpha ang hah uhi."},"22":{"text":"Mangpa Jesu Khrist in na hagau umpita hen, hepina na kungah um hen. Amen."}}}}},"56":{"info":{"name":"Tita","shortname":"Tit.","abbr":[],"desc":"Tita kunga paul laihah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul Pasian suohpa leh Pasian mi telte ginna dungzui leh Pasian ngaisahna banga thutah theina lam a, Jesu Khrist sawltah in;","title":"Thu mapui"},"2":{"text":"Zuou theilou Pasian in hun kipat masang peh a achiemsa kumtawn hinna kinepna ah,"},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh Pasian i hundampa uh thupieh dungzui a, ka kunga kepsah a um thu genzahna ziehin ahuntah ah athu pen suhlat in aumta hi."},"4":{"text":"Ginna ka tankhawmpi ka tapa tahtah, Tita kungah, Pa Pasian leh i hundampa Jesu Khrist akipat hepina, khotuona leh lungmuonna na kung ah umta hen.","ref":"2 Kor. 8.23; Gal. 2.3; 2 Tim. 4.10"},"5":{"text":"Tamte zieh a nang Kret tuikuolkhum gam a ka hing nuasie ahi, nasep zawlou a umte na sep zou na ding leh ka hing thupieh banga khochin a upate na guot thei na dingin,","title":"Hattuom upate guotna"},"6":{"text":"Mi khat genbanglou, zi khat nei, atate Pasian gingta, tatselou leh phengphilou ahi teitei ding ahi.","ref":"1 Tim. 3.2-7"},"7":{"text":"Hattuom lamkai pen Pasian gou kempa ahiziehin genbanglou, mi kiliensah hilou, lungthah bailou, zu dawnlou, miphawhtat hilou, sum met dei a huoiham mi hilou ahi ding hi,"},"8":{"text":"Mi kiphal, sil hoi dei mi, lungsim dih, mi dihtat, mi siengthou, mi kidehthei ahi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Thugin toh kituoh pomtah thute dettaha tudet mi ahi ding hi, tuachi’n thudih ama na kihilsa akipat, mi dangte ahantawh theina ding leh thudih anielkal dan uh ahilchien theina dinga thuhil na dih a tudet ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen mi phengphi, thuginalou gente leh mi solhat tampite a um uhi, adieh in teptante lah a mi ahi uhi.","title":"Thuhilmi dihloute vauhilna"},"11":{"text":"Tuabang mite kam humpieh ding ahi, metna dihlou adei man un, ahillou dinguh thuhilnate ahil ua, mi innkuon sung a tohbuoi uhi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute lah a guolnei khat in, “Kret mite pen zuou gente, gamsa giloute, thasie anhaite ahi uh,” chiin agen hi."},"13":{"text":"Tam theipina adih ahi, tuaziehin ginna lam a alamzan theina ding un amaute khautah in vauhil in."},"14":{"text":"Judate tangthu bulbal neiloute abuoipi louna dingun thuhil in."},"15":{"text":"Mi siengthoute adingin sil zousie asiengthou hi, hinanleh mi bua leh gingloute adingin bangma asieng a um sih hi, alungsimte u’leh asie leh pha theina nangawn uh sienglou ahita hi."},"16":{"text":"Pasian ka thei chiin akam un aphuong ua, hinanleh a nasep un Ama anuol uhi, mi kidah huoite, thumang loute, na hoi sem dinga chinglou ahi uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh nang pen in thugin dihtah toh kituoh thute genin.","title":"Thuhilna dih genin"},"2":{"text":"Mi upa lamte lungsim dihtah, zatat huoi, kidehthei leh ginna dihtah, itna leh thuohhatna nei mi hi ding in thuhil in."},"3":{"text":"Tuamabangin nupi upa lamte, a umdan ua zatat huoi, mi gensiet hatlou, zu hailou, ahoilam pouma thuhilmi hi zaw dingin thuhil in."},"4":{"text":"Tuachia amauten nupi khanglaite, apasalte it ding leh atate uh it dinga athuhil theina ding un,"},"5":{"text":"Kidehthei, telelou, innsung nasem mi, mi navah, apasalte uh thu manga um ding leh Pasian thu kigente gensiet a aum louna dinga, thu ahil theina ding un."},"6":{"text":"Tuabangmain tangvalte pen lungsim dihtah nei dingin, hanthawn in."},"7":{"text":"Sil zousie ah nna hoi sema etton dingin nangma kimusah inlen, thugin ah sietna a umlou dan, azatat huoi dan leh asetheilou ahidan kilangsah in."},"8":{"text":"Thudih gen mawsahthei guollou ahi dan theisah inlen, tuachia alangpangten na tunga silgilou gen ding neilou a azum theina ding un."},"9":{"text":"Suohte khu apute uh thu mang ding, sil zousie a akipahna lam ua um dingin leh mi dawn hatlou dingin thu hil inlen,"},"10":{"text":"Pasian i hundampa uh thuhilna thu khu, sil zousie a azep hoi theina ding ua khut them neilou a, muonhuoina zousie sulang zaw dingin."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen hundamna hing tut Pasian hepina khu mi zousie kungah, ahing kilangta hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua hepina in Pasian ngaisah louna leh leitung utnate tawpsan a, tulai hun a, lungsim sieng leh dihtat tah a gamta ding leh, Pasian ngaisah a hing dingin eite ahing hil hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua kinepna kilawp huoi leh i Pasian thupi leh ihundampa Jesu Khrist hing kilahna ding thupitah ngah in i um ding uh chi ahing hil hi."},"14":{"text":"Danbei a gamtatna chintenga kipat a eite ahing tat theina ding leh, nna hoi sem a phatuomngai leh, Ama teltuom mite ihi thei na dinga hing siengsah dingin eite a dingin Ama ahing kipeta hi.","ref":"Late. 130.8; Pawt. 19.5; Danp. 4.20; 7.6; 14.2; 1 Pet. 2.9"},"15":{"text":"Tam thute gen inlen, thuneitah in, hanthawn kawm in vauhil in."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama u’khu vaihawmte leh thuneitute nuoi a kitulut a, thumang ding leh silhoi chinteng bawl dinga mansa a um dingin,","title":"Silhoi bawl denin"},"2":{"text":"Koima genselou dingin, kihau kisel tawpsan dingin, nunnem a, mizousie kunga kingaingiemna ensah dingin hilpha kia in."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen eite zong masang lai in, mimote, thumang loute, sola umte, utna gilou leh nopsahna tuomtuom suoh leh sal a na taangte ina hi ua, gilou leh kithangsieta umte, kimuda leh ki ensante tualeh khat leh khat kimudatuote ina hi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh mihing lam a Pasian i hundampa uh lungsiet na leh itna ahing kilat tahin,"},"5":{"text":"Dihtatna nasep eiten ina bawlte zieh hilou in, Ama khotuona dungzui in eite ahing hundamta hi, tua hundamna pen Hagau Siengthou zieh a pienthana a silsiengna leh siemtha kiana zieh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tua Hagau Siengthou khu i hundampa Jesu Khrist ziehin itung uah kiningching tahin ahing sungbuo hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama hepina a siemtansah a um in kumtawn hinna kinepna dungzuiin gouluote hi dinga siem in ium ngei ding uhi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian gingtaten silhoi bawl ding ngaituo u’heh chi thu amuonhuoi ahi, tualeh tam thute khautah a na gen zing dingin ka dei hi. Tamte pen mihingte dingin ahoi a, tualeh aphatuom hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh kihauna mot huoite, khangthu sutte, kinielnate, leh danthua kikalnate kihepmangsan in, aziehpen tamte sil phatuomlou leh mannabei ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kikhenna piengsah mi pen khatvei nivei na vauhil nua in kikuppi nawn sin."},"11":{"text":"Tuabang mi pen lampiel khiel ahia, ama leh ama kimawpai ahi chi na thei hi."},"12":{"text":"Artema ahiei, ahisihleh Tikikus ahiei, na kunga kang sawl chiengin, Nikopoli khuo ah, ka kungah hing pei teitei in. Tua mun a phalbi sung um dingin thukhenna ka bawlta hi.","title":"Thu nukhiate","ref":"Nasep. 20.4; Eph. 6.21,22; Kolo. 4.7,8; 2 Tim. 4.12"},"13":{"text":"Dan siempa Zena leh Apollo akhuolzinna ding uah bangma kitasamlou in na peisah pai in,","ref":"Nasep. 18.24; 1 Kor. 16.12"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh i mite’n nisim a atahsapte uh asuhtuo thei na ding u’leh gasuo loua a umlou na dingun, silhoi bawl dingin kizilsah in."},"15":{"text":"Ka kunga umte zousie in ahing nousiet uhi. Ginna a, eite hing itte ka nousiet hi hing na gen pieh in. Noute zousie kungah hepina umta hen. Amen."}}}}},"57":{"info":{"name":"Philemon","shortname":"Phile.","abbr":[],"desc":"Philemon kunga sawltah paul lai hah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Jesu Khrist suongkul taangpa leh i unaupa uh Timothi in ka lawm ittah u’leh ka seppipa uh Philemon kung leh,","title":"Thumapui"},"2":{"text":"Ka ittah uh Apphia leh ka galkappi uh Arkippa leh na inn a kikhawm hattuomte kungah;","ref":"Kolo. 4.17"},"3":{"text":"I Pa Pasian leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist akipat hepina leh lungmuonna na kungah um hen."},"4":{"text":"Ka thungetnate ah na min louin ka Pasian kungah kipahthu ka gen ngitnget hi.","title":"Kipahthugenna leh thungetna"},"5":{"text":"Mangpa Jesu lama na ginna leh misiengthou zousie lam a itna na neidan ka zah in,"},"6":{"text":"Na ginna midangte na kikoppina in, Khrist Jesu a nangma a um silhoi chinteng theikimna lam a ahing phattuom theina ding in."},"7":{"text":"Na itna ah kouten lungnopna leh kinepna thupitah ka nei uhi, aziehpen unaupa, nangma ziehin misiengthoute lungtangte ahalta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin akilawm hun banga bawl dingin Khrist ah thupieh hangsantah ahing pethei hinan leng,","title":"Onesimus adinga ngetpiehna"},"9":{"text":"Itna ziehin Keima Paul, tehsepu leh tu mama a zong Jesu Khrist hentapa’n ka hing ngen zaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka koltanna a ka hinkhiet ka tapa Onesimus a dingin na kungah ka hing ngen hi.","ref":"Kolo. 4.9"},"11":{"text":"Khatvei lai in ama nanga dingin aphatuom sih a, hinanleh tuin vang nang leh kei a dingin aphatuomta hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama pen ka hing nua sawl kia hi, Tuaziehin ama na pom in, ama ka lungtang ah atengden vawt hi,"},"13":{"text":"Khantanhoi zieha kolbun a ka um sungin nang taanga ka nna hing seppieh dingin ama ka umdensah ut mama a,"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh nang phatsahna umlou in bangma ka bawl ut sih hi, na nasep hoi pen, sep sah teitei hilou a, nangma utna a bawl ahi theizoh na ding ka dei hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama toh hun tomkhat na kikhen pen uh, ama na neiden theina ding ahizaw mai thei hi,"},"16":{"text":"Tuin pen suoh banga nei hi nawnlouin, suoh sanga hoizaw, sanggam ittah bangin ahi zaw ding hi, adiehin ama kei a dingin it huoitah ahita a, nanga dingin tahsa leh Mangpa lam ah it huoitah ahi zaw sem nalai ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin Kei na lawmhoi khat a na hing sim leh, keima bangin na pom in.","title":"Philemon kunga Paul thuchiem"},"18":{"text":"Na tunga bawlkhiel anei a, bat bangma anei lezong keima batin na sim in."},"19":{"text":"Keima Paul in tami ka khut ngel a ka gel ahi, Keima’n ka sanpieh ding hi. Nangma ngelin zong kei kungah bat na nei ka china ahi sih hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi, unaupa aw, nangma akipat kipahna Mangpa ah hing nei sah in, Khrist ah ka lungtang hing suthathou in."},"21":{"text":"Na thumanna a kimuongin leh ka gen sanga thupizaw tham in na bawl ding chi ka thei hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuabang kaal ah kei dingin zong tunna ding inn khat zong hing na ngaituo piehin, aziehpen na thungetnate uh zieh a, na kung ua pieh a ka um ding, ka kigingta hi."},"23":{"text":"Khrist Jesu zieha, ka hentatpipa Epaphras in mangpha ahing hah hi.","ref":"Kolo. 1.7; 4.12"},"24":{"text":"Ka naseppi Mak, Aristarkus, Dema leh Luke, in zong noute mangpha ang hah uhi.","ref":"Nasep. 12.12,25; 13.13; 15.37-39; Kolo. 4.10; Nasep. 19.29; 27.2; Kolo. 4.10; Kolo. 4.14; 2 Tim. 4.10; Kolo. 4.14; 2 Tim. 4.11"},"25":{"text":"I Mangpa Jesu Khrist hepina hagau na kung uah um hen. Amen."}}}}},"58":{"info":{"name":"Hebrute","shortname":"Heb.","abbr":[],"desc":"Hebrute kunga laihah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian, nidang lai a hun tuomtuom leh lam tuomtuom a guolneite tungtawn a ipu ipate kunga thu na genpa in,","title":"Khrist guolneite sanga thupizaw"},"2":{"text":"Tam ni nukhiate ah a Tapa in eite kungah thu agenta hi, Ama pen sil zousie a gouluopa dingin aguot a, Ama tungtawn mama in leitung zong asiem hi;"},"3":{"text":"Ama pen thupina vahpha leh Pasian lim leh mel ngelngel kilatna ahia, sil zousie asilbawltheina thuin atungdinga, Ama mama in ikhelnate asilsieng zou nuain, tunglam a thupipen ziet langah atouta hi."},"4":{"text":"Vansawlsiengte sanga min hoizaw tham luopa ahi mabangin, amaute sanga min tungnungzaw tham ahing hita hi.","title":"Khrist vansawlsiengte sanga thupi zaw"},"5":{"text":"Vansawlsiengte koipen kungah ahiei Pasian in ana gen ngai; “Nang ka Tapa na hi a, Tuni’n ka hing hingkheta hi,” Ahisihleh, “Ama dingin Apa ka hi dinga, Ama ka Tapa ahi ding, ana chi ngel ei?”","ref":"Late. 2.7; 2 Sam. 7.14; 1 Khang. 17.13"},"6":{"text":"Tuaban ah, Pasian in a Tapa pieng masapen, leitunga ahing puilut lai in, “Pasian vansawlsiengte zousie in, Ama bie u’heh,” achi kia hi.","ref":"Danp. 32.43"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh vansawlsiengte tungtang thu ah “Aman a vansawlsiengte khu hui in abawl a, Ana semte zong meikuongin abawl hi.” Achi hi.","ref":"Late. 104.4"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Tapa tungtang thu ah, “Aw Pasian, Na mangtoupha kumtawn, Kumtawn in a umden dinga, dihtatna leengchieng zong, Na leenggam leengchieng, ahi ding, achi hi.","ref":"Late. 45.6,7"},"9":{"text":"Nangman dihtatna Na it a, danbei a gamtatna na hua hi; Tuaziehin Pasian, Na Pasian in Nangpen, na lawmte tunga hing koi in, kipahna sathau ahing nuta hi.”"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh, “Mangpa Nangma’n achiil in leitung, Kingapna suongphum na phumta a, tualeh vante zong na khutsuoh ahi.","ref":"Late. 102.25-27"},"11":{"text":"Tuate ahing mangthang ding ua, hinanleh Nang pen na umden ding hi; tuate zousie puonsil bangin ahing lui ding a,"},"12":{"text":"Tuate puonzal bangin na ziel dinga, akihengta ding uhi, Hinanleh, Nang pen angaingai in na umden a, Na kumte zong abei ngai sih ding hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh vansawlsiengte koi pen kungah ahiei, Pasian in, “Na melmate na keng ngapna a, ka bawl masangsie ka ziet langah tou in, achi ngai ei?”","ref":"Late. 110.1"},"14":{"text":"Vansawlsiengte zousie khu hundamna gouluo dingte nasep siengthou seppieh dinga sawldoh hagaute ahi sih uh amah?"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin ithu zahsate lunglut tah leh phatuom ngaitahin ingaisah sem ding uhi, tuachilouin ikinilmangsah kha ding uhi.","title":"Vauhilna masa leh zauhuoi"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen vansawlsiengte zanga thu kigente nangawn anakip a, bawsietna leh thumanlouna chintengin akituoh bang thuhna dihtah amu uleh,"},"3":{"text":"Tambang lawmlawm a hundam na thupi inahsah sih leh, bang ichi suotat vazuou diei? Tua hundamna thu khu achiil in Mangpa zanga gen masah ahia, athu zaten eite kungah asukip uhi."},"4":{"text":"Pasian in zong chiemtenate, sillamdangte leh silmah tuomtuomte leh Hagau Siengthou silpiehte Ama deidan dungzuiin a theipi hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman atanchin igen uh, tunua chienga hing um ding leitung pen vansawlsiengte nuoi ah akoi sih hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh koi ahiei khat in mun khat ah theipina thu ana gen chien hi: “Mihing bang ahi talawm a na lunggul, Mihing tapa zong bang ahita lawm a, hichi tuh a na ngaituo.","ref":"Late. 8.4-6"},"7":{"text":"Nang ama vansawlsiengte sanga, nuoinung zaw deu in na bawla, thupina leh pahtawina na khusah a, na khut suohte tungah na koita hi."},"8":{"text":"Sil zousie athunuoi a um dinga, akeng nuoi ah akoi ziehin,” A nuoi a koilou bangma aum sih hi. Hinanleh tuin vang sil zousie a nuoi a kikoi in imu nai tadi sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu pen Pasian hepina zieh a michin a dinga shina achep theina dinga vansawlsiengte sanga nuoinung zaw deu a, bawl tadi a um a, shina athuohna zieha thupina leh pahtawina khuhsah a umin imu zaw uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama adinga sil zousie um a, Ama vang a sil bangkim umpa adingin ta tampite thupina a puilutpa leh amaute hundam na bawlpa thuohna zieh a suhbukim akilawm mawng ahi."},"11":{"text":"Mite siengthousahpa leh asienthousahte zousie Pa khat a kipan ahi ua, tuaziehin aman amaute unaute chi ding a zum pi sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Aman, Ka unaute kungah, “Na min ka phuong dinga, Kikhawmte lah ah la sa in, ka hing phat ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Late. 22.22"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh, “Ama ah hamuonna, ka koi ding” achi kia hi. Tualeh En un, “Tanah kei leh Pasian hing pieh, naupangte,” achi kia nalai hi.","ref":"Isai. 8.17; Isai. 8.18"},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n naupangte pen tahsa leh sisan tangkhawm ahi zieh un, Ama mama in zong tuabangma ahing tang hi, shina zieh a; shina thuneipa diabol asuhmang theina dingin,"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh shi zau zieh a adamsung teng uh sal a taang zousie asuotatsah theina ding in."},"16":{"text":"Aman vansawlsiengte apanpi ahisih a, Abraham hahlesuonte panpi ahi zaw hi.","ref":"Isai. 41.8,9"},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ama pen Pasian nasep lam ah, mi khotuo thei leh gin um, Siempu Lien ahi theina ding leh mite khelna thuphatawina abawl theina dinga bangkim a, a unaute bangbanga bawl a ahing um khu Ama dingin akiphamaw mawng ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ama mama in zong solna tuoh a anathuoh taah ziehin solna tuohte khu apanpi thei hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin unau siengthou, van hatna tangte aw, ithugin uh, Sawltah leh Siempu lien Khrist Jesu khu ngaituo un,","title":"Khrist anasep ah Mosi sanga tungnungzaw ahina"},"2":{"text":"Pasian innsung mite lah a Mosi agin um mabangin, Ama zong Ama guotpa kungah agin um hi.","ref":"Kisim. 12.7"},"3":{"text":"Tambang ahi ziehin inn sang lampain pahtawina thupizaw atan mabangin, Jesu’n Mosi sanga pahtawina thupizaw atan ding akilawm mawng ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen inn chinteng mi koi ahiei khat in alam ahia, hinanleh sil zousie lampa pen Pasian ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mosi pen tunua chienga hing kigen ding thute theipipa ahia, Pasian innsung mite zousie lah ah suoh bangin, aginum hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Khrist pen Tapa bangin Ama innsung ngei ah agin um a hi, atawp donga i muonhuoina uleh ikinepna kipahna uh ituhdet pou uleh a innsung mite ihi uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin Hagau Siengthou gen banga, “Tunia a aw na zah u’leh,","ref":"Late. 95.7-11"},"8":{"text":"gamdai a ze etna nia ahel bangun, na lungtang uh khausah sih un."},"9":{"text":"Tuanah na pu na pate un, Kei hing ze et in ahing enkhie ua, kum sawmli sung ka silbawlte amu uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin tuami khangte tungah, ka lungthah a, alungtang un apampiel ua, ka lampite zong athei kha nawn sih uhi. Ka chi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka thangpaina a kihahsiel in, ka khawldamna ah na lut ngai sih ding uh,” ka chi hi, chia agen bangin."},"12":{"text":"Pilvang un, unaute, tuachilouin Pasian hing apat pielmang dingin, na lah ua mi khat pou sungah ginlouna lungtang gilou ahing umkha ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Hinanleh “Tuni” akichi lai in, khat leh khat kihanthawn tuo chiet zaw un, tuachilou in na lah ua mi khat pou khelna, solna a khausahin na umkha ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen iginna kipatna uh atawp donga ituhdet nah pouleh, Khrist a tanvou neite ihi uhi."},"15":{"text":"“Tunia a aw na zah u’leh, tua helna na bawl lai bang un, nalungtang uh khausah sih un,” chia akigen lai in.","ref":"Late. 95.7,8"},"16":{"text":"Ahileh za napi a hel teiteite koite ahiei? Mosi in Izipt gam a kipat a ahing puidohte zousie hilou uh amah?","ref":"Kisim. 14.1-35"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh kum sawmli sung koite tunga lungthah ahiei?
