Sil bawlkhiel a gamdai a aluong uh lumte ahi sih uh amah?"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh thumang loute kung ahiloungal leh Akhawldamna ah alut sih ding uh chi a akichiemna koite kung hi ding ahiei leh?"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n agintat lou zieh un alut theita sih uh chi imu uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin zau vai, tuachilouin vang akhawldamna a lutna ding thuchiem umlai napiin na lah ua mi khattou achinglou bangin na umkha ding uhi.","title":"Khawldamna hoizaw"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen amaute kunga gen ahitaah bangin, eite kungah zong khantanhoi akigenta hi, hinanleh athu zahte uh, ginna toh akizoplou ziehin aphattuompi sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Ei agingtasate pen Akhawldamna ah ilut uhi, “Ka lungthahna a ka kichiem bangin, amaute khawldamna ah alut sih ding uhi,” Leitung kisiem chiila pata nnate, sep zou sieng hitama nanleh, chi a agen bangin.","ref":"Late. 95.11"},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman heisung mun ahiei ah, ni sagi ni thu tambangin agen hi: “Pasian in ni sagi niin anasep zousie akipat akhawldamta hi,” achi hi,","ref":"Siem. 2.2"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh, tam mun ah, “Ka khawldamna ah alut sih ding uh,” achi kia hi.","ref":"Late. 95.11"},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin mi pawlkhat khawldamna a a lut ding uh thuchien a um nahlai zieh leh, ni danglai a khantanhoi kigenna masate thuman louna ziehin tua khawldamna ah alut sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hun sawttah nuain David zangin, “Tuni,” chiin bang ni ahiei khat aguot kia a. “Tunia a aw na zah u’leh, na lungtang uh khausah sih un, chia hun sawtpi a na kigen bangin.”","ref":"Late. 95.7,8"},"8":{"text":"Joshua in amaute khawldamna na pie hitaleh, tuami nua in Pasian in ni dang khat thu agen nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Danp. 31.7; Josh. 22.4"},"9":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian mite a dingin khawldamna khat a um nalai hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian Anasepna apat akhawldam bangin, Ama khawldamna a lutte zong anasepte apat akhawlta ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 2.2"},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin tua khawldamna a lut dingin phatuom ngaitahin ipang ding uh, tuachilouin pen mi khatyou tua thumanlouna etsahna banga umin ipua kha ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian thu ahinga, sil abawl thei a, namsau alangni a tat tuo hiem sangin ahiem zaw a, hinna leh hagau, tuoleh gu kituona leh chintuigu khenthei khopin asun thei a, lungtang ngaituonate leh tupte akhen thei hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama mitmu ah silsiem khat zong phuolguh aum sih a; akunga itanchin itutna dingpa mitmu ah, bangkim saguoh leh kihongsa ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n vante a peisuoh Siempu Lien thupitah, Jesu Pasian Tapa inei ziehin, ithugin uh ipomdet ding uhi.","title":"Khrist siempu lien hina"},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen ihat lounate hing lainatpilou Siempu Lien nei ihi sih a, eite mabanga lam chintenga solna tuohsa, hinapi khiel vawtlou Siempu Lien nei ihizaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaziehin khotuona itan theina ding u’leh itahsap hun chienga panpina dinga hepina imu theina dingun, hangsantahin hepina mangtoupha khu inai ding uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siempu Lien mihingte lah a kipat a kiteldoh pouma khelnate zieha kithoina leh silpiehte lan dinga Pasian lam silte mihingte sihleh taanga lan dinga guot ahi uhi.","title":"I siempu lien uh"},"2":{"text":"Ama zong hatlouna nei ahi ziehin bangma theiloute leh lampielte tungah khotuona anei thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tamizieh main mipite khelnate kithoina alat chiengin, ama khelnate thoina zong alat akiphamaw hi.","ref":"Siempu. 9.7"},"4":{"text":"Koiman tam pahtawina dinmun ama a dingin akimawh la thei sih a, Aaron banga Pasian hatte ahi loungal u’leh.","ref":"Pawt. 28.1"},"5":{"text":"Tuamabangin Khrist in zong Siempu Lienpen a bawl dingin Amaleh Ama, kipahtawi ahi sih a, Ama kunga. “Nangpen ka Tapa na hia, tuni’n ka hing hingkhie hi,” chi a gen pa’n atawisang ahizaw hi.","title":"Melkizedek siempu lien bang Khrist","ref":"Late. 2.7"},"6":{"text":"Aman mun tuom khat a, “Nangpen Melkizedek umdan banga, kumtawn a siempu na hi.” Chi a gen bangin.","ref":"Late. 110.4"},"7":{"text":"Jesu tahsa a aumlai nitein shina akipat hundoh theipa kung ah nahpitah a kikou leh hitui luong pumin thungetnate leh thumnate alat nuain, Pasian zaudan asiem ziehin ngaikhieh in aum hi.","ref":"Mat. 26.36-46; Mak. 14.32-42; Luk. 22.39-46"},"8":{"text":"Tapa ahivangin athuohnate haw in thuman dan azilsahta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tualeh suhbukim a hing umin, Athumangte zousie a dingin kumtawn a hundamna siempa ahing hita hi."},"10":{"text":"Melkizedek umdan banga Siempu Lien, Pasian chiin a umta hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama tungtang gen ding tampi ka nei ua, na ngaikhiet thasiet zieh un ahilchien zong ahasa hi.","title":"Ginna taisan lou ding a kithuhilna"},"12":{"text":"Ahun lam ngaituoin, noute thuhil siete na hi taah ding uh ahi a, hinanleh Pasian thubulte hinghil tha kia dingin mi na poimaw nalai lai uhi. Ann gum hilou in nawitui na kiphamaw nalai uhi.","ref":"1 Kor. 3.2"},"13":{"text":"Nawitui ne poumate pen naungeh ahi nahlai ziehun, dihtatna thu ah theina bangma anei nai sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh ann gum pen mi pichingte a ding ahia, angaituona uh zanga, sie leh pha khenthei dinga atheitheina uh sawizoite ading ahibou hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin Khrist thubulte nuasiein, pichin lam manawna ding kikum zawta vai, nasep shisate apat kisianate, Pasian lam a ginnate,","title":"Pichin poimawna"},"2":{"text":"Baptisma tungtanga kithuhilnate, khut ngapna thute, mishi thawkiana thute, kumtawn thukhenna thuhilna thubulte phum kia nawn lou in."},"3":{"text":"Pasian in pha asahleh tambang ibawl ngei ding uh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen khatvei suhvaah a umta a, vanlam silpiehte chiemta a, Hagau Siengthou tangta a,"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian thuhoi leh hun hing tung dinga silbawltheinate chiemta napi a,"},"6":{"text":"Ginna apuamangsan u’leh pen, amaute kisia dinga bawltha thei guol ahi sih uhi, Pasian Tapa ama ua dinga khenbeh tha kia leh selphou ahi zieh un."},"7":{"text":"Lei tungin guotui kezelte na dawn in, ama ua dinga lou nakihawte dinga, ante louhing hing piengsah in Pasian apat guolzawlna amu hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh lingkung leh loulingnei piengsah khu deilouin a um a, tualeh hamsedong phiel in a um hi, atawpna khu mei a hal ahi.","ref":"Siem. 3.17,18"},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh ittahte aw, tambangin thu gennan u’leng zong, noute pen in tambang silte sanga hoizaw hundamna toh kithuo silte na bawl uh ka hing gingta uhi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen na nasep u’leh, Amin zieh a itna na sulatte u’leh, misiengthoute nna nasep pieh uh, tutan a zong nasep zing uh, manghil dingin Pasian adihtatlou ahi sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh noute koipou in, kinepna theichienna kim tang dingin, atawpdongin thanopsuo chiet u’lachin ka hing dei mama uhi,"},"12":{"text":"Tuachia na thasiet sih ua, ginna leh kukalna zieh a thuchiem gouluo mite umdan zuite na hi uh, ka hing dei uhi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian in Abraham kunga thuchiem abawl lai in, Ama sanga lienzaw a akichiem theilou ziehin Ama leh Amain akichiem a,","title":"Pasian thuchiemten kinepna aumsah hi"},"14":{"text":"“Pellou in nang ka hingguolzawl ngeingei dinga, tualeh pun zong ka hing pungsah ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 22.16,17"},"15":{"text":"Tuachia Abraham in kukal taha athuohzou nua in, thuchiem amuta hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihingte pen amaute sanga lienzaw min louin akichiem ua, tualeh thu namdetna ding a kihahsielna in kinielna zousie tawpna ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tambangin Pasian in alungtup kiheng theilou ahi dan thuchiem gouluo dingte kungah kichientaha latsah ut in, kihahsielnain asukipta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua khu Pasian zuouthei ahilouna kiheng kia theilou sil nite pansan a kihumbitna ding sui a taizah eiten imasanga kinepna kikoi tudet dinga hanthawnna nasatah ineina ding uh ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tua kinepna pen hinna sia ka kip in inei a, muonhuoi leh kiptah ahi, tuakhu puonzah sung mun siengthoupen Pasian umna ah alutta hi.","ref":"Siempu. 16.2"},"20":{"text":"Tua mun siengthoupen ah, Jesu Melkizedek umdan banga kumtawn a Siempu Lien hi ding in eite makai in ana lut masata hi.","ref":"Late. 110.4"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam Melkizedek pen, Salem leengpa, Pasian Tungnungpen Siempu ahia, Abraham in leengte ava ban tha zou a ahing kinuale kia lai in Melkizedek in ana dawna, ana guolzawl hi,","title":"Melkizedek siempu lien","ref":"Siem. 14.17-20"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Abraham in Ama kungah anei zousie sawma khat apie hi; amasapenin amin khiehna khu dihtatna leengpa, tua ban ah Salem leengpa, tua pen lemna leengpa china ahi;"},"3":{"text":"Ama pen pa neilou, nu neilou, khanggui neilou, umpat ni neilou, hintawp neilou, hinanleh Pasian Tapa banga bawl, tawp ni neilou siempu a umden ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tuin chihapa Abraham ngel in agallah vante sawma khat apiehnapa, tam mipa thupidan ngaituo di ua."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Levi hahlesuon siempu nasepna tang poumain, dan dungzuiin mite lah a kipat sawm a khat lah ding thupieh amu uhi, chi pen a unaute lah ua pat ahi, Abraham khaal a pieng hinan uleh;","ref":"Kisim. 18.21"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh ama ua kipata khanggui sut tela umkhaloupain Abraham apat sawma khat ala a, thuchiem neipa khu aguolzawlta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh aneuzaw khu alienzawin aguolzawl ahi chi nielguollou a dih ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tana kigenna ah ashi thei mihingten sawma khat atang ua, hinanleh khunah pen ama ahing zing hi chia atanchin theisah a umpa’n atang hi."},"9":{"text":"Sawma khat tangpa Levi nangawn in zong Abraham tungtawn in sawma khat apie hi, chi thei ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen Melkizedek in Abraham ava lamdot lai in, Levi pen ama suongpa Abraham khaal ah a um nalai hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin Levite siempu hina-a bukimna mu thei hitaleh, (aziehpen tami nuoi ah miten danthu ana mu uhi) Aaron umdan bang kichi louin, Melkizedek umdan bang nei siempu dang ahing um ding akiphatmawna bang ahiei?","title":"Aaron siempu hina bukimlou"},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen siempu hina ahing kihen tah chiengin dan zong ahing kihen akiphamawta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuin Ama tambanga atungtang thu na kigennapa pen nam tuom mi ahi a, tua nam a kipat koima maitama nasem aum ngai sih uhi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen i Mangpa u’khu Juda nam a pat hing pieng ahi chi akichien mama hi, tua nam tungtang ah Mosi in siempu lam thu bangma agen sih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Melkizedek umdan bang siempu dang khat ahing um ziehin, ka thugen uh akichien semsem hi.","title":"Melkizedek bang siempu dangkhat"},"16":{"text":"Ama pen tahsa dan thupieh banga siempu hing hi ahi sih a, hinanleh hintawp neilou silbawltheina a siempu hing hi ahizaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen: “Nangpen Melkizedek umdan bang nei kumtawn a siempu na hi chiin atheisahta hi.”","ref":"Late. 110.4"},"18":{"text":"Thu khat ah tua dan thupieh masa pen, hatlou leh phattuomnabei ahi ziehin tuomkhin in a umta hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen dan in bangma abukimsah theisih a, alangkhat ah, kinepna hoizaw ahing polut a, tuami ziehin eiten Pasian inai uh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tam pen kihahsielna lou a siempu a bawl ahi lou zieh in, Ama khu siempu a bawl ahita hi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen tua siempute khu kihahsielna tellou a siempu a siem ahi ua, hinanleh Ama pen akungah “Mangpa akihahsiel a, alunghei kia sih ding hi, Nang pen Melkizedek umdan banga, Kumtawn a siempu na hi, chi a gentu kihahsielna toh siempu hing hi a hi.”","ref":"Late. 110.4"},"22":{"text":"Tuamabangin Jesu khu thuhun hoizaw kipsahpa ahing hita hi."},"23":{"text":"Siempu tampi ana umta uhi, amaute pen shi na in adal ziehin, koima apangden thei sih uhi."},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Jesu pen kumtawn a hingden ahiziehin akihengtheilou siempu hina anei hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ama tungtawn a Pasian kunga hing peite thunget pieh dinga hing zing ahizieh in, atawp dongin ahundam thei hi."},"26":{"text":"Tambang Siempu lien, itulmawte hing bawlpieh thei, inei uh eite a dingin akilawm mawng ahi, Ama pen misiengthou, nuolnabei, nieh banglou leh mikhielte lah akipata kikoituom, vante sanga sangzaw a tawisanga umpa ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ama pen tua siempu Lien dangte banga nichin a ama khelnate thoina lan masa phot a tuazou chieng a, mite khelnate zieha alat angai sih hi, Tami ziehin Ama leh Ama akilat lai in ngamden dingin khat vei in ana lanzouta hi.","ref":"Siempu. 9.7"},"28":{"text":"Aziehpen dan in mihing hatlouna neite siempu hi dingin aguot a, hinanleh kihahsielna thu, dan nua a hing um in, Tapa kumtawn a dinga suhbukimsa pen a guot zaw hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuin ithugen laigil pen tami ahi: Vantunga thupina Mangtoupha zietlam a toupa, tambang Siempu lien nei ihi uhi.","title":"Thuhun hoizaw","ref":"Late. 110.1"},"2":{"text":"Ama mihingte bawl hilou, Mangpa tunding mun siengthou leh biehbuh dihtah a nasempa ahi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen siempu lien pouma silpiehte leh kithoi nate lan dinga guot ahi ua, tuaziehin tam siempu lien in zong lat ding bang ahiei khat anei akiphamaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama leitunga um na hita leh pen siempu ahi sih ding hi, aziehpen dan dungzui a silpiehte lan ding siempute ana umta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Siemputen munsiengthou a anasep uh pen van silte etsahna lim leh him ahibou hi. Mosi in biehbuh bawl dinga akisah lai a, Pasian in athuhil bangin, “Aman muoltunga na kunga etton dinga ka hing musah dungzui a silzousie na bawl dingin pilvangin,” achi hi.","ref":"Pawt. 25.40"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin thuchiem hoizawte tunga kibulphu thuhun hoizawsem palai ahimabangin, nasepna hoizaw ana tangta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua thuhun masapen adihlouna umlou ana hita leh, thuhun nina mun ding sui ngailou ding ahi.","title":"Thuhun tha"},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian in amaute khelna mu in tambang in agen hi: “Ngai un, Israel innkuonte leh, Juda innkuonte toh thuhuntha ka bawl hun ding nite, hing tung ding ahita. Mangpa’n achi hi.","ref":"Jer. 31.31-34"},"9":{"text":"Apu leh pate uh Izipt gam a kipat, puidoh dinga abantaang ua, ka kaidoh ni a, akung ua ka thuhun pen bang hilou, aziehpen amaute ka thuhun ah, a umden sih ua, tualeh ken amaute ka ngaisah sih hi, Mangpa’n achi hi."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen tua nite nua chieng a, Israel innkuonte kunga, ka thuhun ding khu tami ahi, Mangpa’n achi hi. Alungsim uah ka dan thupiehte, ka koi dinga, alungtang uah ka giel ding hi, tualeh ama ua ding in, a Pasian uh ka hi dinga, amaute pen Kei a dingin, Ka mite ahi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute koiman a innvengte u’leh, aunaute u’kungah, Mangpa thei in chi’n athuhil nawn sih ding hi, Aziehpen aneupen apat alien pen dongin, Kei ahing theita ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen adihtatlounate uah ka khotuo dinga, akhelnate u’leh danbei a agamtatnate uh, ka thei ngitnget nawn sih ding hi.” Achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Aman thuhuntha chia agen ziehin, amasapen aluisahta hi. Tuachi’n lui a ahing upata khu amang ding mawng ahita hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n thuhun masapen in zong Pasian nasepna dante leh tam leitung munsiengthoute anei hi.","title":"Thuhunlui munsiengthou"},"2":{"text":"Biehbuh khat akibawl a, dantan masa pen ah meivah tunna leh dawkan leh atunga lat siengthousa tanghou kikoite a um hi, tami dantan pen mun siengthou akichi hi;","ref":"Pawt. 26.1-30; Pawt. 25.31-40; Pawt. 25.23-30"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh puonzah nina ban ah Munsiengthoupen kichi biehbuh khu a um hi.","ref":"Pawt. 26.31-33"},"4":{"text":"Tua munsiengthoupen sungah, gimnamtui halna sana maitam leh sana tui a kiluonkhum thuhun singkuong, asunga mana umna sana bel leh Aaron chiengsel, tualeh Thuhun suongpehte a um hi.","ref":"Pawt. 30.1-6; Pawt. 25.10-16; Pawt. 16.33; Kisim. 17.8-10; Pawt. 25.16; Danp. 10.3-5"},"5":{"text":"Tua singkuong tungah, thupina cherubimte a um ua, tuate’n aha un, khotuona Mangtoupha lie in azahkhum uhi. Tamte tungtang thu tuin kimtah in igen thei sih ding uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 25.18-22"},"6":{"text":"Tambanga silzousie guot zou dimdiam ahi chiengin, biehbuh dantan masa sungah siempute nasem dingin alut zel uhi.","title":"Thuhunlui kithoina","ref":"Kisim. 18.2-6"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh dantan nina ah pen, Siempu lien maimai kum khat in khat vei alut a, tua zong ama khelnate leh mite khelnate thoina dinga alat ding sisan tawi in alut zel hi.","ref":"Siempu. 16.2-34"},"8":{"text":"Hagau Siengthou in tami ahing theisah hi: biehbuh masa pen adin laisie, munsiengthoupen a lutna lampi akihong nai sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Tampen tulai hun etsahna ahia, tuanah sie leh pha theina lam thu a, abemite hoi bukimsah theilou silpiehte leh kithoinate alaan zel uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tua sillatte pen neh leh dawnte, kisuhsiengna tuomtuom leh tahsalam dante giap ahi a, kisiemphat kia hun hing tun masangsie a zah dinga bawl ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh Khrist khu sil hoi hing um dingte Siempu Lienpen ding a hing pei in, biehbuh thupizaw leh, bukimzaw mihing khut a lam hilou ah, tua pen tam silsiemte lah a ahi sih, china ahi.","title":"Thuhun tha munsiengthou"},"12":{"text":"Kelte leh bawngnoute sisan hilou in Ama ngel sisan a eite dinga kumtawn a tatkhietna muin munsiengthou ah ngamden dingin khatvei bep alutta hi."},"13":{"text":"Bawngtalte leh kelte sisan leh bawngla vutvamte, mi siengloute tunga thein bawn tahsa siengsah khop a asuhsieng thei leh,","ref":"Siempu. 16.15,16; Kisim. 19.9,17-19"},"14":{"text":"Khrist, kumtawn Hagau zieh a genbanglou a Pasian kunga kilan sisan in, Pasian hing nasem dingin, nasep shisa apat in na sie leh pha theina uh, bangchituhin asusiengthouta diei?"},"15":{"text":"Tami ziehin Ama khu thuhuntha palai ahi, thuhun masa nuoia tatkhelnate lah a pat a tatdohna dinga ashi taah ziehin hatten kumtawn a gouluo ding thuchiem khu atang thei ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Thugousie umna phot ah, athugousiepa shina zong aum ngeingei ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen tua thugousie pen athugousiepa ashi nua chiengin akizang thei pan a, thugousiepa hin laisie thu anei mawngmawng sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaziehin thuhun masa zong sisan panglou a lat hilou ahi."},"19":{"text":"Mosi in dan dungzui a thupieh pouma mipite zousie kunga aphuondoh zouin, bawngnoute leh kelte sisan, tui toh, sawnsan toh, hissop toh ala a, laibu ziel leh mipite zousie athe a,","ref":"Pawt. 24.6-8"},"20":{"text":"“Tami Pasian in na kung ua ahing pieh thuhun sisan khu ahi,” achi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuamabangin aman biehbuh leh nasepna a kizang um leh bel zousiete sisan athe hi.","ref":"Siempu. 8.15"},"22":{"text":"Tualeh dan dungzuiin sil zousie chiphiel dingte sisan a suhsiengthou in aum a, sisan suolouin ngaidamna manwgmawng a um sih hi.","ref":"Siempu. 17.11"},"23":{"text":"Tuaziehin Van a sil umte kibatpite tambang kithoinate a suhsiengthou ding mawng ahi, hinanleh vanlam sil dihtahte pen tamte sanga hoizaw kithoinate a suhsiengthou a um ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen Khrist khu khuta bawl munsiengthou ah alut sih a, tua pen atahtah kibatpi giap ahi, hinanleh tuin Pasian mai ah, eite taanga kilang dingin van ah alut zawta hi."},"25":{"text":"Siempu lien kum chin a ama sisan hilou, sisan dang tawi a, munsiengthoua alut zel bangin Ama pen ama leh ama kilan dingin alut sih hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuabang na hisihleh leitung siemchil apat tampi vei athuohta ding hi, hinanleh tu huntawp ah, Ama pen khelna suhbeina dinga ama leh ama hing kilan in khat vei ahing kilangta hi."},"27":{"text":"Mihinga dingin khatvei shi guotsa ahi a, tuazou chiengin thukhenna um ding ahi,"},"28":{"text":"Tuachi’n Khrist khu mi tampite khelna pomang dingin khatvei lat in a umta hi. Tualeh Ama na ngahte kungah khelna tel louin hundam na mu dingin aniveina dingin ahing kilang kia ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 53.12"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Dan pen sil hoi hing tung dingte lim giap ahia, akibahpite tahtah ahilou ziehin, kum chin a kithoina alat zelzelte un, ahing naite abukimsah thei ngai sih hi.","title":"Khrist kithoina in Mosi dan a kithoinate a khel."},"2":{"text":"Tuachi na hisihleh sillatte na tawpta lou ding ahi uoi mah? Aziehpen abemite khatvei suhsiengthou a um in khiel kiphawhna anei nawn sih ding uhi."},"3":{"text":"Hinanleh tua kithoinate ah kum chin a khelna kiphawhdoh kiana a um zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen bawngtalte leh kelte sisan in khelnate lamang thei guol ahi sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin leitunga ahing pei lai in Aman: Kithoina leh sillat na lunggul sih a, Kei a dingin tahsapum khat, na hing bawlpiehzawta hi.","ref":"Late. 40.6-8"},"6":{"text":"Halmang sillatte leh khel na, kithoinate ah kipahna, na nei sih hi, a chi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ken, Ngai in, laibuziel ah keima thu akigiel hi, Na deilam bawl dingin ka hing pei hi, Aw Pasian, ka chita hi."},"8":{"text":"Atungah, “Kithoina leh sillat, halmang sillatte leh khelna sillatte na dei sih a, ama uah kipahna zong na nei sih hi, Tuate khu dan dungzuia kilan ahi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman “Ngai in, Na deilam bawl dingin ka hing pei hi,” Aw Pasian, achi hi. Anina atunding theina dingin, amasapen khu alamangta hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama dei banga Jesu Khrist tahsapum setden dinga lat ahi ziehin eite suhsieng thouin iumta uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh siempu chin in nichin a nasem in khelnate lamang theilou kithoina ngaima lan tha zel in ading zing uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 29.38"},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman kumtawn a ngamden dinga khelnate dinga kithoina khat alat nua in, Pasian ziet lam ah atouta hi,","ref":"Late. 110.1"},"13":{"text":"Tua hun akipat amelmate akeng ngapna a bawl ahimasangsie uh ngah in a umta hi."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen Aman sillat khat in asuhsiengthousate kumtawn a dingin asubukimta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh Hagau Siengthou in zong eite kungah ahing theisah hi; aziehpen Aman:"},"16":{"text":"“Tua nite nua chiengin amaute toh, ka bawl ding ka thuhun tami ahi,” Mangpa’n achi hi. Alungtang uah ka danthute ka koi dinga, alungsim uah ka giel nalai ding hi, achi zou nua in,","ref":"Jer. 31.33"},"17":{"text":"Tuaban ah, “Akhelnate u’leh danbei a, agamtatnate uh, ka thei ngitnget nawn sih ding hi,” achi be nalai hi.","ref":"Jer. 31.34"},"18":{"text":"Tambanga khelnate ngaidamna umna phot ah khelna ding sillatte a um nawn sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuazieh in unaute Jesu sisan zieh a mun Siengthoupen lut ngamna hansanna nei in,","title":"Thugin dettaha tukip ding"},"20":{"text":"Eite dinga ahing bawlpieh lampi tha leh hing ah puongzah (tua khu Ama tahsa pumpi china ahi) kaantanin;"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian innkuonpite tunga Siempu lien khat inei zieh un;"},"22":{"text":"Sie leh pha theina hoilou apat ilungtangte uh siengthou a umin isapum u’zong tui chiima silsienga um in, tualeh ginna theichienna lungtang dihtah toh, Pasian inai ding uhi.","ref":"Siempu. 8.30; Ezek. 36.25"},"23":{"text":"I kinepna thugin uh kilohlouin kiptah in tudet va ui, Ama thuchiem hing pepa a muonhuoi ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh itna leh sil hoi bawlna lamah kithathousah dingin khat leh khat iki awlmawtuo chiet ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte bangin ikikhopnate uh tawpsan sih vai, hinanleh khat leh khat kihantawh tuo zaw vai, tualeh ni a hing naita chi na thei zieh un kihantawh tuo semsem un."},"26":{"text":"Aziehpen thutah theina inei nua ua, thei gehguh a ikhel teitei u’leh pen, khelnate dinga kithoina mawngmawng a um nawn sih hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahing tung ngeingei ding thukhenna zauhuoi leh Pasian melmate katum ding Pasian lungthahna meikuong aum zawta ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 26.11"},"28":{"text":"Mosi dan nuol mi pouma, theipimi ni ahiei, thum ahieite theipina ziehin, khotuona umlou keiin ashi zel uhi.","ref":"Danp. 17.6; 19.15"},"29":{"text":"Pasian Tapa akeng nuoi a tuonden a, thuhun sisan ama suhsiengthouna khu silsienglou banga ngaisut mi leh hepina Hagau Siengthou simmawbawl mi khu bangchituh a gawtna huoise zaw thuoh leh kilawm in na tuot uoi le?","ref":"Pawt. 24.8"},"30":{"text":"Aziehpen “Phuba mawngmawng keima lah ding ahi;” Keima’n ka thuh ding hi, Mangpa’n achi, chi leh, “Mangpa’n amite thu akhenpieh ding chia genpa ama ithei uhi.”","ref":"Danp. 32.35; Danp. 32.36"},"31":{"text":"Pasian hing khut a pua khah khu sil zauhuoi tah ahi."},"32":{"text":"Hinanleh masang lai a, suhvah a na um nua ua, thuohna hasatahte na thuoh lai nite uh ngaituo kia un;"},"33":{"text":"Khatvei tengin mipi mai ah simmawna leh bawlsietnate thuohin na um ua, khatvei tengin tuabanga suhgenthei a umte thuohpite na hing hi uhi."},"34":{"text":"Aziehpen Keima mama zong sia khainieng kolbuna ka umlai in van a gou hoizaw leh umden ding na nei uh chi na thei zieh un, nouten na hing lainat ua, miten nanei nalam uh ahing lahpieh lai un kipahtahin na thuoh uhi; ahi."},"35":{"text":"Tuaziehin na kimuonna uh paimang sih un, tami’n kipahman thupitah hing musah ding ahi."},"36":{"text":"Tuachi’n Pasian deilam na bawl nua ua, thuchiem na nga theina dingun, na kukal uh akiphamaw hi."},"37":{"text":"Aziehpen, “Tomnou kaal in, ahing pei dingpa, ahing pei dinga, sawt hal nawnlou ding hi.","ref":"Haba. 2.3,4"},"38":{"text":"Midih khu ginna in ahing dinga, hinanleh anuatol leh pen, ka lungsim in ama ah, kipahna anei sih ding hi.”"},"39":{"text":"Hinanleh eite pen mangthai dinga nuatolte lah a pang ihi sih ua, hinna humbit dinga gingtate lah a mi ihi zaw uhi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ginna pen ikinepna silte theichienna, silmuloute theichienna ahi.","title":"Ginna a mi minthangte"},"2":{"text":"Tam ginna ziehin ahi, nidanglai upaten phat ana law uh."},"3":{"text":"Ginna zieh a leitungte Pasian thu a lepkhawm ahi a, akimu thei silte zong, akilangthei silte a siem ahi sih chi ithei uhi.","ref":"Siem. 1.1; Late. 33.6,9; Jn. 1.3"},"4":{"text":"Ginnain Abel in Kain sangin kithoina hoizaw Pasian kungah alan a, tuami ziehin ama midihtat ahi chi theipina alaw hi, Pasian in asilpiehte athei a, tuakhu ziehin ama shita napiin, tua ginna ziehin thu agen nalai hi.","title":"Abel","ref":"Siem. 4.3-10"},"5":{"text":"Ginnain Enok khu shina mulou dingin lahmangin a um a, Pasian in alahmang ziehin muin aum nawnta sih hi, lahmanga aum masangin Pasian alungkim sah hi chi theisahna anei hi.","title":"Enok","ref":"Siem. 5.21-24"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh ginna panglouin Pasian lungkim sah thei guol ahi sih hi, aziehpen Pasian kunga hing pei mi in, Ama a um tahtah na hi, chi leh Ama kukal taha suimite kunga nuomman pepa ahi chi, gintat ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ginnain Noah in sil mu nailoute thua Pasian vauhil a aum lai in, zauna siengthou neiin, ainnkuonpite hundamna dingin, kuong abawl a, tami ziehin aman leitung siemmaw atangsahta-a, ginna zieha um dihtatna gouluopa ahing hita hi.","title":"Noah","ref":"Siem. 6.13-22"},"8":{"text":"Ginnain Abraham khu anua chienga ahing luo ding gam a pei dinga hat a a um lai in athumanga, tualeh apeina ding mun theilou hinapi, apeidohta hi.","title":"Abraham leh Sarah","ref":"Siem. 12.1-5"},"9":{"text":"Ginna in gam chiem ah, gamdanga khuolzin taam bangin ana taam den a, thuchiem kibanga agouluopi dingte, Isaak leh Jakob toh puon inn ah ateng uhi.","ref":"Siem. 35.27"},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen aman suongphum dettah nei Pasian lam leh bawl khopi khu angah hi."},"11":{"text":"Ginnain Sarah in zong naupai theina anei a, achiempa khu, muonhuoi asah ziehin atehnua in ta anei hi.","ref":"Siem. 18.11-14; 21.2"},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin ashisa toh kibang mi khat akipat in van a aasite banga tam leh tuipi pieu a senel simsenglou banga tam hahlesuonte ahing pieng ta hi.","ref":"Siem. 15.5; 22.17; 32.12"},"13":{"text":"Tam mite pen ginna nei in ashi siengta ua, thuchiem tang zoulou in, hinanleh gamlatah akipat galmuin amuong ngam ua, apomkip ua, leitung ah vang mikhuol leh khuolzin taambang giap ihi chi aphuong ta uhi.","ref":"Siem. 23.4; 1 Khang. 29.15; Late. 39.12"},"14":{"text":"Tambang thugenmiten ama-ua ding gam khat lunggul in asui uh chi akilangsah mama uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh adihtahin amauten ahing pawtdohna gam uh lunggul kia hi u’leh pen, kinuale kiana ding hun lemtang ana mu tham ding uhi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh gam hoizaw lunggul ana hi ua, tua khu van gam ahi. Tuaziehin Pasian khu a Pasian uh chi a hat ding azum sih hi, aziehpen ama ua dingin khopi khat bawlsa’n akoipiehta hi."},"17":{"text":"Ginna in Abraham ze et a aum laiin Isaak alan hi, thuchiemte tangpa’n atapa neisun alan hi.","ref":"Siem. 22.1-14"},"18":{"text":"“Isaak ah na hahlesuonte akichi ding, chipa ngel khu,”","ref":"Siem. 21.12"},"19":{"text":"Pasian in mishi lah akipat in akaithou thei hi chia geel in; khuna kipat in etsahnain mu zong amu kiata hi."},"20":{"text":"Gin na in Isaak in sil hing tung dingte thu ah Jakob leh Esau aguolzawl hi.","title":"Isaak","ref":"Siem. 27.27-29,39,40"},"21":{"text":"Gin na in Jakob in ashi kuon in, Joseph tate gel aguolzawl a, achiengkhut dawn a kingam in Pasian abie hi.","title":"Jakob","ref":"Siem. 48.1-20; Siem. 47.31"},"22":{"text":"Gin na in Joseph in ashi ding kuon in, Israel tate pawtdoh ding thu agen a, tualeh agute tungtangah thu apie hi.","title":"Joseph","ref":"Siem. 50.24,25; Pawt. 13.19"},"23":{"text":"Gin na in Mosi apien lai in, naungeh melhoi tah ahi achi zieh un, ha thum sung anu leh apa phuol in a uma leengpa thupieh zong azau sih uhi.","title":"Mosi nu leh pa","ref":"Pawt. 2.2; Pawt. 1.22"},"24":{"text":"Ginna in Mosi in ahing pichin nuain, Pharaoh tanu tapa chi a um ding a ut sih a,","title":"Mosi","ref":"Pawt. 2.10-12"},"25":{"text":"Hun tomkhat sung khelna nopsahnate man sang in, Pasian mite toh bawlgentheina thuoh atel zawta hi."},"26":{"text":"Khrist thuohgimnate khu Izipt gam hausatnate sanga hausatna thupizaw a ngai in, akipahman mu ding lam khu a en zing zaw hi."},"27":{"text":"Ginna in aman leengpa lungthahna zaulouin Izipt gam anuasie a; mutheiloupa khu amu ziehin athuoh teitei hi."},"28":{"text":"Ginna in aman peikan pawi leh sisan thena abawla, ta masa mangthaisahpa’n amaute akhoikhah louna dingin.","ref":"Pawt. 12.21-30"},"29":{"text":"Ginna in amauten leigaw tunga peibangin Tuipi san akaan ua; Izipt miten zong tuabanga bawl atum ua, tui ah atumta uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 14.21-31"},"30":{"text":"Ginna in Jeriko kulbaang khu ni sagi sung akimvelnua un, achimta hi.","title":"Joshua leh Rahab","ref":"Josh. 6.12-21"},"31":{"text":"Ginnain kizuanu Rahab zong ginglou mite toh amangthai khawm sih hi, aman enkhe mite lungmuongtah a azintun zieh in.","ref":"Josh. 6.22-25; Josh. 2.1-21"},"32":{"text":"Tualeh bang ka gen nalai diei le? Gideon leh Barak, Samson leh Jephthah, tualeh David leh Samuel leh guolneite thute gen ding chileng hun in ahing dai sih ding hi.","title":"Ginna a mihangsan tampite","ref":"Vai. 6.11—8.32; Vai. 4.6—5.31; Vai. 13.2—16.31; Vai. 11.1—12.7; 1 Sam. 16.1—1 Leeng. 2.11; 1 Sam. 1.1—25.1"},"33":{"text":"Tuate’n ginnain leenggamte azou ua, dihtatna abawlkhie ua, thuchiemte atang ua, humpibahnei kam achiipieh uhi.","ref":"Dan. 6.1-27"},"34":{"text":"Meikuong thahatna asudai ua, namsau hiemte apel ua, hatlouna akipat in hatsahin a um ua, galdouna phuol ah ahat mama ua, gamdang galkap honte adelzah uhi.","ref":"Dan. 3.1-30"},"35":{"text":"Numeiten amishite uh hinga thoukia amu uhi. Tualeh midangten bawlsietna athuoh ua, thawkiana hoizaw amuna dingun, hakhiet a um a ut sih uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 17.17-24; 2 Leeng. 4.25-37"},"36":{"text":"Midangten nuizat bawlna leh chienga jepnate athuoh nalai uhi, ahi, sia khainieng a hen leh suongkul nangawn a khum in a um uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 22.26,27; 2 Khang. 18.25,26; Jer. 20.2; 37.15; 38.6"},"37":{"text":"Suanga sein aum ua, sing-at a attan in a um ua, ze etna athuoh ua, namsau a satlupin a um uhi. Amaute belam vun leh kel vunte silin, tahsapna leh bawlsietna leh gawtna huoisetahte thuohin avahvai uhi.","ref":"2 Khang. 24.21"},"38":{"text":"Amaute dingin leitung umna taah ahi sih a, gamdai gamgawte, muoltungte, ah avahvai ua, kawlhawmte leh leikohawmte ah ateng kawikawi uhi."},"39":{"text":"Tam mite zousie in aginna zieh ua, phat ana law vang un thuchiem atang sih uhi."},"40":{"text":"Aziehpen eite tellou a amaute suhbukima aum louna dingin, Pasian in eite dingin sil hoizaw khat guotsain akoi hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin eite zong hichi khop a theipimi meipi thupitah im kimkot a i um uh thei in, ahing nohsah zousie leh khelna eima a behdente hemkhedoh vai in imasang ua taikidemna ah kukaltahin itai ding uhi.","title":"Jesu ginna a etton ding"},"2":{"text":"I ginna siempa leh subukimpa Jesu lam en in, Aman amasanga um kipahna ziehin zumnate zong khohsa lou in Kross ah gimna athuoh a, Pasian mangtoupha zietlam ah ava touta hi."},"3":{"text":"Na lungsim ua na tawl ua, na lungkieh louna dingun, Ama tunga mikhielte tatsietna thuohpa khu ngaituo un."},"4":{"text":"Noute sisan luong khop hiela khelna douin na pang nai tadi sih uhi."},"5":{"text":"Hanthawnna thu tate kihilna banga na kung ua kigen khu na manghilta uhi; “Ka ta, Mangpa thununna ngaidau sinlen, Phawh hil a na um chiengin zong, lungke sin.","ref":"Job. 5.17; Thu. 3.11,12"},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa’n a itte athunun a, ta banga apomte pouma ajep zel hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Thununna na thuoh u’leh, Pasian in atate bangin ahing bawl ahi, aziehpen pa thununlou ta koi aum ngai ei?"},"8":{"text":"Thununna na thuohlou na hi u’leh zawlta, na hi ua, ta tahtah na hi sih uhi, ta tahtah poumain thununna athuoh ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaban ah eite hing siemhoi tahsa a pate inei uhi, tualeh amaute izatat uhi, tuasanga Hagau lam Pa thua i um zawh sem ua, ihin ding uh hizawlou ding amah?"},"10":{"text":"I pate’n amaute hoisah bangin, bakhat sung ahing thunun uhi, hinanleh Aman eite phattuomna dinga, sienthouna itan theina dingin, ahing thunun zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Thunun na khat poupou pen aki thuoh laitahin kipah huoi in alang sih a, hasiet huoi in alang zaw hi, ahivangin anua chiengin, tuabanga thununna nuoia kituoinemte dingin, ga lungmuon huoi, dihtatna asuo zel hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin khut kaikhete leh khupzoite khausah un,","ref":"Isai. 35.3"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh na kengte ua dingin lampi tang siem un, tuachia kengbaite akihiehloi louna ding in damsah zaw un.","ref":"Thu. 4.26"},"14":{"text":"Mi zousie toh kilemna leh siengthouna del un, tua siengthouna louin Koiman Mangpa amu sih ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Pilvangtah in en un, tuachilouin mi khattou Pasian hepina tangzoulou na um kha ding ua, “Khatna hui khat hing mengdohin,” tuami’n mi tampite suhbuain a um kha ding uhi.","ref":"Danp. 29.18"},"16":{"text":"Koima numei pasal kaal a athangtat louna dingin pilvangun, tuachilouin Esau in a uzaw hina hamphatna ann neh khat a azua bangin, Pasian zatatlou khat a um kha ding hi.","ref":"Siem. 25.29-34"},"17":{"text":"Anualam in Esau in guolzawlna gou khu luo tumin, hitui luong pumin phatuomngai tahin sui nanleh kisiana ding mun amulou ziehin nuolin a umta chi na thei uhi.","ref":"Siem. 27.30-40"},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen noute pen muol khoikhah thei leh mei a kaa leh, vomna leh mielna tualeh huipi lanna mun,","ref":"Pawt. 19.16-22; 20.18-21; Danp. 4.11,12; 5.22-27"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh pengkul ginna leh thugen aw ging zaten azau ua, amaute kunga thu gen nawnlou dinga angetna mun uh, tua muol hing tungzong na hi nai sih uhi."},"20":{"text":"“Tua muol pen ganta nangawnin asuhkhahle suonga selup ding ahisihleh thaltanga kaplup ding ahi chia thupieh khu amauten athuoh zouta sih uhi.”","ref":"Pawt. 19.12,13"},"21":{"text":"Tua asilmu ukhu azauhuoi mama a, Mosi in “Ka zau sengseng a ka kithing vawt hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 9.19"},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh noute pen Zion taang leh Pasian hing khopi van Jerusalem, sim senglou vansawlsieng honpi leh,"},"23":{"text":"Khawmpi lien leh van a min kigiel ta pieng masa hattuom kung leh mi zousie vaihawmpa Pasian kung leh midihtat suhbukim a umte hagau kung ah,"},"24":{"text":"tualeh thuhuntha palai Jesu kung leh Abel a sanga sil hoizaw gen sisan thepa kunga hing tung na hi zaw uhi.","ref":"Siem. 4.10"},"25":{"text":"Tua thugenpa na nuol khah louna ding un pilvangun, aziehpen leitunga thugenpa anuol ua bawn suohtalou ahi u’leh, van a kipat a thu hing pepa ikiheisan u’leh isuohta maw sem ding uhi.","title":"Pasian nuol azauhuoi dan","ref":"Pawt. 20.22"},"26":{"text":"Tua hun lai in A aw in leitung akiling sah a, hinanleh “Tuin Aman leitung guoh hilouin van zong khatvei lingsah kia nalai ding ka hi,” chiin thu achiemta hi.","ref":"Hag. 2.6"},"27":{"text":"Tam thu “Khatvei” ka kilingsah kia ding achi pen, akiling loute a umden thei na ding a, akiling te khu silsiemte bang a suonmangin a um ding chi atheisah hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaziehin suhling guollou leenggam itan ziehun, zatatna toh, Pasian zaudan siem kawm a pomtah taha, Pasian nna iseptheina dingun, hepina inei ding uhi."},"29":{"text":"Aziehpen i Pasian u’khu ahing katum thei meikuong ahi.","ref":"Danp. 4.24"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Unau ki it tuona um ngitngetta hen.","title":"Hanthawnna tuomtuom"},"2":{"text":"Mikhuolte hoibawl ding manghil sih un, tuabanga bawl in mi pawlkhatten theilou kaal in vansawlsiengte ana zintun uhi.","ref":"Siem. 18.1-8; 19.1-3"},"3":{"text":"Suongkul taangte khu, amaute toh taangkhawm banga kingaisutin thei ngitnget un, tualeh bawlsietna thuohte zong tahsa pumkhat na hiziehun thei ngitnget un."},"4":{"text":"Mi zousie lah ah kitenna zatatin um henlen, tualeh lupna zong suhbua louin um heh, aziehpen numei pasal kaal a thangtatte leh angkawmte tung ah Pasian in thukhenna abawl ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na hinkhuo uh sum deigawna apat kem unlen, na nei teng tung uah lungkim un. Aziehpen Pasian in “Ka hing nuasie sih dinga, Kang taisan ngai sih ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 31.6,8; Josh. 1.5"},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin hangsantah in, “Mangpa kei hing panpipa ahia, Ka zau sih ding hi, mihingin kei bang ang law thei diei,” i chi ngam uhi.","ref":"Late. 118.6"},"7":{"text":"Na kung ua Pasian thugen, na lamkaite uh thei ngitnget un; a umdan ua kipat a sil hing umdohte ngaituo unlen, a ginna uh zui un."},"8":{"text":"Jesu Khrist khu, zani tuni leh tangtawn in angaingai ahi."},"9":{"text":"Thugin tuomtuom leh kithuhilna lamdangte puimangin um sih un. Aziehpen lungtang hepina a suhkip ahoi ahi; neh leh taah a suhkip ding ahi sih, tuabang a lungkhamten tuate ah phattuomna amu tuom sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Biehbuh a nasemten aneh theilouna uh maitam khat inei uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Siempu lien in khelna thoina dinga munsiengthou sungah gantate sisan atawilut zel a, aluongte pen giehphuol pulam ah akihaltum zel hi.","ref":"Siempu. 16.27"},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Jesu’n zong Ama sisan mama a mite asuhsieng theina dingin kulpi kotpi pulam ah athuohta hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ama a sim mawna uh puoin giehphuol pulam ah Ama kungah pei va ui."},"14":{"text":"Aziehpen tamnah khopi det leh umden ding inei sih a, ahing um ding khopi lunggul in isui zaw uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin Ama vangin Pasian kungah phatna kithoina sillat tawplouin ilan ding uhi, tua khu amin a ikipahna phuondohna kamte ga ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh sil hoi bawl leh na neisa uh mite hop ding manghil sih un, aziehpen tuabang kithoina sillatte ah Pasian akipah mama hi."},"17":{"text":"Na tung ua vaihawm lamkaite thu mang unlen, athunuoi uah lut un, aziehpen noute hing kem a, na hinna uh hing venpiehte ahi uhi, tuapen lunggimtaha bawllouin, lungnuomtahin bawlzaw u’heh, lunggimtah a abawl u’khu nou a dingin aphatuom sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Koute dingin thu hing ngetpieh un, sil zousie ah pahtat huoitah a hin ding lunggul in sie leh pha theina hoitah ka nei uh, chi ka kigingta uhi.","title":"Thutawpna leh guolzawlna"},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh akinthei lam a na kung ua sawl kia a ka um theina dingin, adieh in ka hing ngen ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tuin lungmuonna Pasian, i Mangpa uh Jesu Khrist mishi lah a kipata kaithoupa, kumtawn thuhunna sisan zieh a Belampu thupitahin,"},"21":{"text":"Jesu Khrist zala Ama mitmu a adeilam bawl dingin noute sil hoi chintengin hing subukim hen, Ama kungah kumtawn kumtawnin thupina umdenta hen, Amen."},"22":{"text":"Unaute aw ka hing hanthawnna thute na thuoh teitei, dingin kahing ngen hi, aziehpen, na kung uah thu tomnoukhat in ka hing giel hi."},"23":{"text":"I unaupa uh Timothi akihadohta china thei uh, ka dei hi, ama ahing tun baileh ama toh noute mu dingin ka hing haw ding uhi."},"24":{"text":"Na tung ua vaihawm lamkaite zousie leh misiengthoute zousie mangpha ka hah hi hing na gen piehun. Itali gama umten mangpha ahing hah uhi."},"25":{"text":"Noute zousie kungah hepina umta hen. Amen."}}}}},"59":{"info":{"name":"Jakob","shortname":"Jak.","abbr":[],"desc":"Jakob laihah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob, Pasian leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist suohpa’n nam sawm leh ni kithezahte anousiet hi.","title":"Nousietna","ref":"Mat. 13.55; Mak. 6.3; Nasep. 15.13; Gal. 1.19"},"2":{"text":"Ka unaute aw, ze etna chituom tuom na tuoh chiengun, lungnopna ngenin ngaisut un."},"3":{"text":"Na ginna uh, ze etna in kukalna asiem hi chi thei un."},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh bangma tasamloua na pichin ua, na bukim theina dingun, thuohhatna in sem bukim heh."},"5":{"text":"Na lah ua Koipou in pilna atahsap leh mi zousie kunga it lou leh house lou a pepa Pasian kungah ngen heh, tuachi’n akungah pieh ahi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh aman gingla hetlouin, gingta tahin ngen heh, aziehpen gingla mi khu tuipi kinawh, hui mut leeng leh seep bang ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tuabang miin Mangpa akipat bangma mu ding kinem sih heh;"},"8":{"text":"Ama lungsim thuoni nei ahia, asil bawl zousie akip sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Khosahna ngiem unaupa khu pahtawi a aum ziehin kipah heh.","title":"Tahsapna leh hausatna"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh mi hausa khu suhngiem a aum ziehin lungkim heh, aziehpen loupa pah banga mang ding ahi hi.","ref":"Isai. 40.6,7"},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen ni ahing suoh a asat mama chiengin loupate avul pai a, apahte apul a, akilawmnate amuol a amangta hi, tuamabangin mihausate zong asummet bawl lai un avuoi mang ding uhi."},"12":{"text":"Ze etna thuoh teitei mi khu ahampha hi, aziehpen etkhieh a aum zou chiengin Mangpa’n Ama itte kunga pieh dinga achiemsa hinna manglukhu asang ding hi.","title":"Ze etna leh solna"},"13":{"text":"Mi koima’n solna atuoh chiengin, “Pasian sol ka hi,” chi sih heh, Pasian pen gitlou a solguol ahi sih a, Aman zong koima asol ngai sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Michin amauh utna a kaimang leh hipmanga a um chieng ua, sol a um ahizaw uhi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n utnain nou apai chiengin khelna apiengsah a, tualeh khelna ahing pichin chiengin shina ahing tun hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka unau ittahte aw, sol in um sih un."},"17":{"text":"Silpieh hoi leh silpieh bukim pouma tunglam a kipan ahia, vahte Pa kunga kipata hing peisuh ahi a, Ama ah lamdanna leh kikhelna lim mawngmawng a um sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Asilsiemte laha ga masa pawl khat i hitheina dingin Ama deidan thutah a ahing piensah ihi uhi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka unau ittahte aw, michin thu ngaikhieh lam ah kilawp henlen, thugen lam ah kikangkoiin lungthah bai sih heh,","title":"Ginna khu thumanna ahi"},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen mihing lungthahnain Pasian dihtatna apiengsah sih hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuazieh in niehna zousie leh gitlouna dimlet koimang unlen, na hinna uh hundam thei na sung ua thu kitusate lungnemtahin pom un."},"22":{"text":"Hinanleh nouma leh nouma kisol in thungaikhe maimai hilouin, thuzuite hi zaw un."},"23":{"text":"Aziehpen mi koipou thu ngaikhie a, azuitu ahi sih leh ama pen mi himlanga apienpi mai ki en bang giap ahi."},"24":{"text":"Aki en a, apei manga, tualeh bangchibang melpuo ahiei chi akimanghil pai hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh koipou noplenna dan bukim en a, tua khu zui den a, manghilhat thungaikhie hilou a, thu zui mi ahileh, tuabang mi khu anasep ah guolzawlna amu ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Na lah ua mi koipou sakhomitah bang a kingaituo a alei veng hoi lou a, ama leh ama akisol leh tua mipa sakhuo bieh khu athawn ahi."},"27":{"text":"Pasian leh Pa mitmu a, sakhuo biehna sieng leh nieh banglou khu, nubei pabeite leh meithaite alungkham lai ua va ve leh leitunga nieh banglou a kikep ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka unaute aw, i Mangpa Jesu Khrist, thupina Mangpa gingta kawmin mi khentuom nei sih un.","title":"Ginna in khentuom neilou"},"2":{"text":"Na kikhopna uah sana khutsip bun, puon hoitah sil khat hing lut henlen, tualeh mi zawng khat, puon senipnep sil in hinglut ta leh,"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh puon hoi sil mi pen na limbawl ua, akungah “Nang tam mun hoi ah tou in,” na chi ua, tualeh mi zawng pa kungah, “Nang tuanah na dingin,” ahisihleh “Tanah ka keng ngahna bul ah touin,” na chi uhi."},"4":{"text":"Na lah uah khentuom na nei uh hilou ahiei amah, tualeh gitlou lungsim nei a thukhen na hi sih ding uoi mah?"},"5":{"text":"Ka unau ittahte Ngai un, Pasian in tam leitunga mizawngte khu ginna a hausa ding leh Ama itte kunga achiemsa gam luo dinga atel hilou ahiei mah?"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh nouten mi zawngte na zalasah uhi. Mihausaten noute ahing bawlsie un, thukhenna inn ah ahing kailut zel uh hilou ahiei mah?"},"7":{"text":"Amaute hilou amah noute hing kihatna min manpha gensie?"},"8":{"text":"Laisiengthou dungzui a, “Nangma na ki it banga na innvengte na it ding ahi,” chi kumpi dan na suhtangtung u’leh na bawl hoi uh hi.","ref":"Siempu. 19.18"},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh mi khentuom na nei u’leh, khelna bawl na hi uhi, tualeh dan in danbotsetu bangin ahing mawpai ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi koipouin dan zuikim henlen, munkhat ah zuila taleh dan zousie tung a khiel ahita veve hi."},"11":{"text":"“Aziehpen angkawm sin,” chipa’n “Tuolthat sin” zong achi thou hi, tuachi’n angkawm sih lachin zong tuol na tha leh, dan botsepa na hita veve hi.","ref":"Pawt. 20.14; Danp. 5.18; Pawt. 20.13; Danp. 5.17"},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin zalenna dan a vaihawmpieh dingte bangin thu gen unlen, sil bawl un."},"13":{"text":"Aziehpen khotuona neilou mi khu khotuona beia vaihawmpiehin a um ding hi, khotuona in thukhenna a zou zel hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka unaute aw mi’n ginna ka nei chi henlen nasep nei sih leh, bang aphatuom diei? Tuabang ginna in ama ahundam thei diei?","title":"Ginna leh nasep thu"},"15":{"text":"Unaupa ahiei, unaunu ahiei khat guohtangin um henlen nichin neh ding tasamta henlen,"},"16":{"text":"“Na lah ua khat in lungmuong tahin um inlen, lumtah leh gilva tahin umin” chi henlen, atahsapum tahsapte pe sih leh, bang aphatuom diei?"},"17":{"text":"Tuachimabangin ginna in nasep anei sih leh ashi ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh mi khat in, “Nang ginna na nei a, ken nasep ka nei hi,” achikha ding hi. Na ginna khu nasep panglou in hing ensah inlen, Ken ka ginna ka nasep in ka hing ensah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasian khat aum chi na gingta hi. Hoi e. Dawite nangawn in agingta ua, achitun uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh Oh nang mi mo, nasep panglou ginna khu ashi ahi chi na thei nuom ei?"},"21":{"text":"Ipu uh Abraham in atapa Isaak maitam tunga alat laiin, nasep zieh a siemtang hilou ahiei mah?","ref":"Siem. 22.1-14"},"22":{"text":"Gin na in anasepte toh asemkhawm a, tualeh nasep in ginna abukimsah hi chi na mu hi."},"23":{"text":"“Abraham in Pasian agingta a, tua agintatna khu Pasian in adihtatna in asimpieh hi, chia Laisiengthouin agen atangtung sah hi,” tualeh ama Pasian lawm akichita hi.","ref":"Siem. 15.6; 2 Khang. 20.7; Isai. 41.8"},"24":{"text":"Tuachi’n ginna zieh guoh hilouin nasep ziehin mi siemtansah in a um hi chi na thei hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuamabangin kizuanu Rahab in zong thupomite ana zintun a, amaute lam tuom a asawlkhieh lai in, nasep zieh a siemtang hilou ahiei mah?","ref":"Josh. 2.1-21"},"26":{"text":"Hagau tellou tahsapumpi pen ashi ahi bangin, nasep panglou ginna khu ashi ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka unaute aw, noute lah a mi tampi thuhilmi in hing pang sih un, ei mi thuhil a pangten thukhenna khauzaw tang ding ihi, chi thei un.","title":"Ginna in lei aveng hi"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen i unpi un sil tampi ah i kipalpua uhi. Mi koipou thugen lam a akipalpua sih leh mi piching ahia, tahsa pumpi thunun thei mi zong ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ngai un, ithu aman theina dingun sakolte kamkaina ivaw a, tuachi’n atahsa pumpi ikaihei thei hi."},"4":{"text":"En un, tembawte lienpipi hinan u’leh, hui hattah sem leng in a um hi, hinanleh tembaw hehpa’n ahehna neu nou khat in a utna lamlam ah akiheisah hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuamabangin lei zong tahsa bameng neu nou khat ahia, nasatahin aki uongsah zel hi. En un, mei neunoukhat in Gammang thupitah akatum thei hi."},"6":{"text":"Tualeh lei pen mei ahia, itahsa bamengte lah a tatsietna lompi khu lei ahi, tuachi’n tahsa pumpi buasahin asesah a, mihing hinkhuo kiheite akasah a, ama zong gawtmun meiin aka zel hi."},"7":{"text":"Ganhing namkim, va namkim, abohvah namkim, tuipi sunga silsiem namkimte, mihingin akhawizuol thei uhi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh mihing koiman lei akhawizuol thei sih uhi; gitlouna um khinkhian theilou, shina gu a dim ahi."},"9":{"text":"I lei in Pasian leh Pa iphat a, ileima in Pasian batpi a kisiem mihingte ihamsiet zel uhi.","ref":"Siem. 1.26"},"10":{"text":"Kamsung khat a kipat in phatna leh hamsietna apawtkhe zel hi. Ka unaute aw, tam silte hichibang ding hilou ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tuinah khat apat tui sieng leh chitui apawtkhawm thei amah?"},"12":{"text":"Ka unaute aw, theipi kungah Olive aga thei ngai amah, ahisih leh grep gui ah theipi aga thei amah? Tuamabangin chikhuh in zong tuisieng apawtsah thei sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Na lah ua pil leh theisiem koi ahiei um? thunuoilut leh piltahin anasepte khu umdan hoiin ensah heh.","title":"Ginna in pilna apiengsah hi"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh na lungtang sung ua, kithangsietna khatah leh angsung khuolna nei na hi u’leh uong sih unlen, zuou thu niel unlen thudih zuousan sih un."},"15":{"text":"Tambang pilna pen tunglama hing kipan ahi sih a, hinanleh leitung leh tahsa utna leh dawi a hing kipan ahizaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen thangsietna leh angsung khuolna umna pou ah, buoina leh sil hoilou chinteng aum hi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh tunglam a hing kipan pilna pen amasapen in asiengthou a, tuachiengin kilemna adei a, anunnem a, gasuo a ut a, khotuona leh ga hoi in adim a, khentuom anei sih a, alepchie sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh dihtatna ga khu lemna bawlten kilemna a atu uh ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na lah ua kidounate leh kihaunate heia hing kipan ahiei? Na tahsa hiengte ua kidou leng, na tahsa lunggulnate ua hing kipan a hing pieng hilou amah?","title":"Ginna in kingaingiemna Ga a suong"},"2":{"text":"Na lunggul ua nanei tuomsih uhi; tuol na that ua, na deigaw ua, na nei zou tuom sih uhi. Na kihau ua, na kidou uhi. Na ngetlou ziehun na nei tuom sih uhi."},"3":{"text":"Na ngen ua, na nget dihlou zieh un na mu sih uhi, nouma nopsahna dinga zah na tup zieh un."},"4":{"text":"Nou angkawmhatte aw, leitung lawm hina khu Pasian toh kimelmatna ahi chi theilou na hi uoi mah? tuaziehin koipou leitung lawm hi ut khu Pasian melmain akibawl ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahisihleh Laisiengthou in, “Ei ma sunga teng Hagau in thangse khopin ahing dei hi, achi khu amawhgen hiva chia thusimlou na hi uoi mah”"},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh Aman hepina tamsem ahing pie hi; Tuaziehin Aman: “Pasian in mi kiliensahte adoua, hinanleh kingaingiemte kungah hepina apie hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Thu. 3.34"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin Pasian kungah kitulut un. Dawimangpa doudal un, tuachi’n aman ahing taimangsan ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasian nai un, tuachi’n Aman ahing nai ding hi. Mi khielte aw, na khut uh silsieng un, nou lungsim thuop ni neite na lungtanguh susiengthou un."},"9":{"text":"Chimaw unlen, lunggim unlen, kap un, na nuina uh lunggimna suoh henlen, na lungnopna uh dana suoh heh."},"10":{"text":"Pasian mitmu in kingaingiem un, tuachi’n Aman ahing tawisang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Unaute aw, khat leh khat kigensetuo sih un, Mi aunau gensie leh aunau tunga vaihawm pouma dan gensie ahia, dan tunga vaihawm ahi. Hinanleh dan na gensiet leh, dan zuimi na hi sih a, vaihawmmi na hi zaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Dan pepa khat a um a, Aman ahundam theia, asuse thei hi. Midang tunga vaihawm ding nang koi na hiei?"},"13":{"text":"Hing pei un “Tuni ahiei, zingchieng ahiei in, khum khopi ah ihaw dinga khunah kum khat iva taam ding a, lei in izua ding ua, ipung ding chite aw,”","title":"Ginna in Pasian tunga kinepna asiem","ref":"Thu. 27.1"},"14":{"text":"Zingchienga bang hing tung ding ahiei, chi na thei sih uhi. Na hinna uh bang ahiei? Tuimei bakhat hing kilang a mang kia pai bang giap ahi."},"15":{"text":"“Tua sangin Mangpa’n pha asah leh idam dinga, tami ahiei, tuomi ahiei, ibawl ding, na chi zoh ding uh ahi.”"},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh tuin na ki uongsah ua, na ham uong uhi; tuabanga ki uohsahna zousie khu khelna ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin mi sil hoi bawl ding thei napi a, bawl tuonlou khu, ama a ding in khelna ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nou mi hausaten tuin ngai un, na tung ua gim thuohna hing tungdingte ziehin kap in mau un.","title":"Mihausate minuoinetna demna"},"2":{"text":"Na hausatnate uh asegawpta a, na puonte uh nget in anesiengta hi.","ref":"Mat. 6.19"},"3":{"text":"Na sana u’leh na dangkate uh sam eeh akai siengta hi, tuate sietgawpna khu na kheldan uh theisahna ding ahi dinga, tualeh na tahsa uh meikah bangin anetum ding hi. Nouten lah ni nukhia lam a dingin gou na kholkhawm na lai uhi."},"4":{"text":"Ngai un, na lou ua bu-at a kilawte thaman amaute sol a na pieh loute uh akikou ua, tualeh bu-atmite kikou aw khu, mipite Mangpa bil ah alutta hi.","ref":"Danp. 24.14,15"},"5":{"text":"Leitungah nuomsa leh nuomtat tahin na hing ua, na lungtangte uh gaw ding ni a gantate bangin na vathauta uhi."},"6":{"text":"Midih khu na mawpai ua, na thatta uhi, aman lah noute ahing dou sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka unaute aw, Mangpa hing pei masangsie thuohhattahin um un. En un, lounei miin lei ga manphatah khu angah a, guo masate leh nukhiate amu masangsie thuohhattahin angah zel hi.","title":"Ginna in athuoh zou hi"},"8":{"text":"Noute zong thuohhat tahin um un. Na lungtangte uh kipsah un, aziehpen Mangpa hing peina ding anaita hi."},"9":{"text":"Unaute aw, khat leh khat kiphunsan sih un, mawpai in na umkha ding uhi. Ngai un, vaihawmpa kotkhah bul ah ading hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka unaute aw, Mangpa mina thugen guolneite khu gimthuohna leh thuohhatna lam a etton dingin zangun."},"11":{"text":"Ngai un, athuoh mite hampha in isep uhi. Job thuohhat dan na za uhi, Mangpa’n atawpa abawl tupdan na mu uhi; Mangpa khu lainatna leh khotuona a dim ahi.","ref":"Job. 1.21,22; 2.10; Late. 103.8"},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh ka unau ittahte aw, Bang teng tungah, vanlam lou in ahiei, lei lam lou in ahiei, ahisihleh kihahsielna dang mawngmawngin kichiem sih un. Hinanleh Ahi na chi uh ahi hisah unlen, hilou na chi uh ahilou hisah un, tuachilou in siemmaw tangin na umkha ding uhi.","ref":"Mat. 5.34-37"},"13":{"text":"Na lah uah genthei thuoh a um ei? thungen heh. Kipah a um ei? phatna la sa heh.","title":"Ginna a midangte thunget pieh ding"},"14":{"text":"Na lah uah china a um ei? Hattuom upate han henlen, amauten Mangpa mina sathau nuin thungen uheh.","ref":"Mak. 6.13"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh ginna a thungetnain china khu adamsah dinga, Mangpa’n ama akaithou ding hi. Tualeh aman khelna ana bawlkhah leh ngaidam ahi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Suhdam a na um theina dingun na tatkhelnate uh thupha kitawituo chiet unlen, khat leh khat thu kingetpieh un. Mi dihtat thungetna in nna asem thei mama hi."},"17":{"text":"Elijah khu eima banga mihing pienken nei ahia, aman guo zuhlouna dingin phatuomngaitahin thu angen a, tuachi’n kum thum leh haguh sung leitung ah guo zulouin a um hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 17.1; 18.1"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh thu angenkia a, vanin guo a zusah a, lei in agate ahing suongsah ta hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 18.42-45"},"19":{"text":"Unaute aw, na lah ua mi koipou, thutah apat pielmang henlen, tualeh mi dang khat in nuapui kiataleh,"},"20":{"text":"Mi khiel alam manna akipat kiheisahpa in shina akipat hagau khat ahundam dinga, akhelna tampite akhumang ding ahi, chi kithei heh.","ref":"Thu. 10.12; 1 Pet. 4.8"}}}}},"60":{"info":{"name":"1 Peter","shortname":"1 Pet.","abbr":[],"desc":"Peter laihah khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Peter, Jesu Khrist sawltah in, Pontius gam, Galatia gam, Kappadosia gam, Asia gam leh Bithinia gamte a kithezah mivaithaamte kungah,","title":"Nousietna"},"2":{"text":"Thumang ding leh Jesu Khrist sisan the tang dinga Hagau suhsiengna zieh a Pa Pasian theilawhna dungzuia telte kungah, hepina leh lungmuonna na kung uah suhpungin umta hen."},"3":{"text":"I Mangpa Jesu Khrist Pa leh Pasian phat in umta hen, Aman akhotuona kiningchingtah dungzui in, shina a kipat a Jesu Khrist thawkiana ziehin pienthana kinepna hing, eite ahing peta hi.","title":"Mailam hun kinepna"},"4":{"text":"Gouluo ding setheilou, buatheilou leh tuoitheilou van a nou a dinga kikhet tang dingin,"},"5":{"text":"Hun nukhia lam chienga kilang dinga mansa a um hundamna tang dinga ginna zieh a Pasian silbawltheina a kep na hi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuin hun tomnou khat sung, ze etna tuomtuom thuohin lungkham tadi nan u’lachin, tam hundamna ah nasatahin na kipah uhi."},"7":{"text":"Na ginna uh etchienna khu, sana mei a halsieng nua nangawn a, mangthai zel sanga manpha zaw, Jesu Khrist hing kilah ni chienga, pahtawina leh thupina a mu a aum theina dingin."},"8":{"text":"Ama mu ngai lounapi in na it ua, tuin Ama mu sih nan u’lachin zong na gingta ua, kipahna gensenglou leh thupina a dimin na kipah uhi."},"9":{"text":"Na ginna uh buchinna, na hagau uh hundam na ngei khu muin."},"10":{"text":"Tam hundam na thu khu, na kung ua hing tung ding hepina thu na genlawh guolneiten ana kan kawikawi ua, phatuom ngai tah in ana suidoh uhi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute sunga um Khrist Hagau in, Khrist thuohna ding thu leh anua a hing zui ding thupina ana matheisah lai un, amauten bang hun leh bangchibanga hing tung ding ahiei chi thei tum in ana sui uhi."},"12":{"text":"Van akipat a hingkisawlkhie Hagau Siengthou pansan a na kung ua khantanhoi agen lai un, ama ua dinga nasem hilou in eite dinga sem ahi uh chi, amaute kungah theisahin aumta hi. Vansawlsiengte nangawnin tam silte mu ding alunggul mama uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin na lungsim kawnguh gah unlen, pilvangun, Jesu Khrist hing kilah chienga noute ahing puohpieh ding hepina ah na kinepna uh nga unlen,","title":"Siengthou ding"},"14":{"text":"ta thumangte bangin, na theilou lai ua na nidang lai tahsa utnate uh banga umlou in;"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh noute hing hanpa asienthou bangin, noute zong na gamtatdan zousie uah siengthou un."},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen “Noute siengthou un, Kei ka siengthou hi,” chi’n akigiel hi.","ref":"Siempu. 11.44,45; 19.2"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh deisahtuom neilou a mi chin anasep dung zuia thukhenpa khu, Pa chia han na hi u’leh, tam leitunga khuolzin banga na taam hun sungun zaudan siem in um un."},"18":{"text":"Napu napate ua kipat a, tawndan a nana nei uh na hindan uh kisesa apat, akisethei sana leh dangka a tatdoh na hi sih ua;"},"19":{"text":"Hinanleh belamnou gensiet bei leh nieh banglou sisan banga, amanpha mama Khrist sisan a tat na hi zaw uh, chi na thei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Ama pen leitung kisiem masang peh a guotlawhin aum ngei a, hinanleh tam hun nukhiate ah noute zieh a sulat in a umta hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama ziehin mishi lah a kipata, Ama kaithoupa leh thupina pepa Pasian na gingta uhi; tuachi’n na ginna u’leh na kinepnate uh Pasian a ahi theina dingin."},"22":{"text":"Unaute it tahtah ding a thutah zui a na hagau uh na suhsiengthou tahzieh un, phatuom ngaitahin khat le khat lungtang siengthouin ki it tuo chiet un.","title":"Ki ittuo chietun"},"23":{"text":"Chi sethei lah ah hilou in, chi setheilou Pasian thu kumtawn a hing zing leh umden lah a piengtha na hi zaw uhi."},"24":{"text":"Aziehpen, “Mihing zousie loupa bang ahia, athupina zousie u’zong gamlah, loupa pah bang ahi, loupate avuoi a, apahte zong apul hi.","ref":"Isai. 40.6-8"},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa thu pen kumtawn in aumden hi.” Tami na kung ua khantanhoi pansan a thu kigen khu ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin gitlouna zousie, kisolbawlna zousie, lepchienate, kithangsietnate leh kigensietna zousiete, koimang unlen;","title":"Thu nawitui banga sieng lunggul un"},"2":{"text":"Naungeh suohthate bangin, na hundam na ua na khantou theina dingun, hagau nawitui sieng bangma toh hallou lunggul un,"},"3":{"text":"Mangpa khu mi hepisiem ahi chi na chiem zouthamta uhi.","ref":"Late. 34.8"},"4":{"text":"Ama mite deilou hinanleh Pasian tel leh manpha suong hing kung lam nouten na hing zuonta ua,","title":"Suong hing leh tel"},"5":{"text":"Noute zong suong hingte banga, Pasian pomtah hagau lam kithoinate lan ding a siempu siengthou leh hagau inn a lamtou na hi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin Laisiengthou ah zong, “En un, Zion ah aningah suong poimawpen, tel leh manpha tah ka phum hi, Ama gingta pouma amuolphou, ngai sih ding hi,” chiin akigiel hi.","ref":"Isai. 28.16"},"7":{"text":"Tuaziehin nou agingtate dingin Ama amanpha hi, hinanleh agingtaloute a dingin, “Inn lammiten adeilou uh suong khu, aninga suong poimawpen ahing hita hi.”","ref":"Late. 118.22"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh, “Mite kipalpuasah suong leh, amauh kipuana suongpi ahi.” Amaun thu kigente amanlou ziehun, thu ah akipalpua ua, tuabang dinga guot zong ahi uhi.","ref":"Isai. 8.14,15"},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh avahna lamdang tah a lut dinga miel a kipat a noute hing handohpa phatnate na phuonzah theina dingun, noute pen nam tel leng siempu, nam siengthou, Pasian deituom, Ama mite na hi uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 19.5,6; Isai. 43.20; Pawt. 19.5; Danp. 4.20; 7.6; 14.2; Tit. 2.14; Isai. 43.21; Isai. 9.2"},"10":{"text":"Ni danglai in nam a sim na hi sih ua, tuin pen Pasian mite na hita uhi. Ni danglai in khotuona tangloute na hi ua, hinanleh tuin pen khotuona na tangta uhi.","ref":"Hos. 2.23"},"11":{"text":"Ittahte aw, mikhuol leh khuolzin bang na hi ziehun hagau doudal tahsa utnate tawpsan dingin ka hing ngen hi."},"12":{"text":"Jentelte lah a na gamtat dan uh kilawmtah hi heh, tuachia, silgilou bawlte banga ahing gensiet chieng ua, na nasep hoi uh amute u’zieh a ve a aum ni chieng ua, Pasian apahtawi theina ding un."},"13":{"text":"Tuaziehin Mangpa ziehin mihing thuneina tawi dansiemte nuoi ah kitulut un, thuneina sangpen nei ahi ziehin leengpa nuoi ah kitulut un;","title":"Vaihawmte thu manding"},"14":{"text":"Ahisihleh silgilou bawlte gawt ding leh sil hoi bawlte phat dinga, leengpa’n asawl uhpipate nuoi ah zong kitulut un."},"15":{"text":"Aziehpen na silhoi bawl ua, mi mote na sipsah thei ding u’khu Pasian deilam ahi."},"16":{"text":"Noplente bangin gamta un, hinanleh na noplenna u’khu gitlouna khukhumna dingin zang sih unlen, Pasian suohte bangin gamta zaw un."},"17":{"text":"Mi zousie zatat un. Na unaute uh it un. Pasian ging un. Lengpa zatat un."},"18":{"text":"Suohte aw, giin dan siem in na pute uh kungah kitulut un, ahoite leh anunnemte kung guoh ah hilou in, ahuhamte thu zong mangun.","title":"Nasep in kitulut un"},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian lam a sie leh pha theina zieh a mi’n gimna leh dihloutaha athuoh leh tua pen pahtat taah ahi."},"20":{"text":"Na dihlouna zieh ua vuoh na thuoh un, kukal tahin thuohnan u’lachin, pahtatna bang ahiei na law uh? Hinanleh silhoi na bawlna ziehun thuoh law unlen, kukaltahin thuoh u’lachin, tam pen Pasian pahtat lam ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tambang bawl dinga hat na hi uhi, aziehpen Khrist in zong aketot a na zui dinguh, etton ding hing nuasiein eite taangin ana thuohta hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama’n khelna mawngmawng abawl sih a, akam ah zong zebawlna thu akimu ngai sih hi.","ref":"Isai. 53.9"},"23":{"text":"Ama a enghou laiun, enghou in athuh sih a, genthei athuoh laiin zong avau sih hi, hinanleh ditattaha thukhenpa kungah akikemsah zaw hi.","ref":"Isai. 53.7"},"24":{"text":"Eite khelna lam a shi a, dihtatna lama i hintheina dingin Aman ama sapum mama in ikhelnate sing dawn ah apuo a, Ama kivuohna huoltaite ah suhdam in na umta uhi.","ref":"Isai. 53.5,6"},"25":{"text":"Aziehpen noute belam bangin nana pielmangta ua, hinanleh tuin vang belampu leh na hinna hagau uh entuppa kungah na hing kinuale kia ta uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tambangin nou zite aw, na pasalte u’kung chiet ah kitulut un, tuachi’n amaute lah a koi ahiei in Pasian thu gingta sihnan leh thu lou a, zite gamtatdan a zawin aum thei ding uhi.","title":"Zite leh pasalte","ref":"Eph. 5.22; Kolo. 3.18"},"2":{"text":"Zaudan siem kawma na gamtatdan siengthou uh a et chiengun,"},"3":{"text":"Na kilawmnate u’khu, pulam kizepna samphehte leh sana khi awte, ahisihleh puonsil a kizepnate hilouin,","ref":"1 Tim. 2.9"},"4":{"text":"Mihing lungtanga kiphuol lungsim kingaingiemna leh nunnemna puonsil setheilou hi heh, tuakhu Pasian mitmu in amanpha mama hi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen tambangmain nidanglai a numei siengthou, Pasian gingtate zong amauh pasalte thunuoi a lut in ana kizem uhi."},"6":{"text":"Sarah in Abraham khu mangpa chia han a athu aman bangin; noute zong zauna mawngmawng giinglou a sil hoi na bawl u’leh Sarah tanute na hi uhi.","ref":"Siem. 18.12"},"7":{"text":"Tuamabangin nou pasalte aw, na zite uh bel kikeh baizaw banga ngaituo in, hinna hepina tangkhawm ding na hina uh theisiemin pahtawidan siem in um khawm un, tua hileh na thungetna uh dalin a um sih ding hi.","ref":"Eph. 5.25; Kolo. 3.19"},"8":{"text":"Atawppen in lungsim mun khat puoin, khat leh khat kilainat tuo chiet unlen, sanggam bangin ki it unlen, kingiemkhieh unlen, lungnem un.","title":"Khristian kilainatna"},"9":{"text":"Gitlouna, gitlounain thuh sih unlen, gensietna zong gensietnain thuh sih un, hinanleh guolzawlna tang dinga hatna hi uh chi theiin, guolzawl zaw un."},"10":{"text":"Aziehpen, “Hinna it a, ni hoite mu ut in, gitlouna apat alei veng hoi henlen, akam zong solna thu genlou dingin veng heh.","ref":"Late. 34.12-16"},"11":{"text":"Gitlouna kiheisan henlen, sil hoi bawl hen, kilemna sui henlen del zel hen."},"12":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa mit khu midihtatte tungah atu a, athungetna lam uah abil adaw hi. Hinanleh sil gilou bawlte tungah pen,” Mangpa mai agum ahi."},"13":{"text":"Sil hoi bawl na ut u’leh, noute hing suse ding koi ahiei?","title":"Genthei thuoh chieng a Khrist etton ding"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh dihtatna zieh a na thuoh u’leh na hampha uhi; ahing giihnate ziehun zau sih unlen, tualeh lungkham sih un.","ref":"Mat. 5.10; Isai. 8.12,13"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh na lungtang uah, Mangpa Pasian khu susiengthou unlen, tualeh nouma aum kinepna azieh hing dong poumate, lungnemtah leh zaudan siemtah a dawng dingin bangchihlai pouin mansa in um un."},"16":{"text":"Khrist a na gamtat hoi dan uh, dihloutaha hing genseten, silgilou bawl banga ahing gensietna ua, a kizumsuo theina dingun, sie leh pha theina hoitah nei un."},"17":{"text":"Pasian deilam ahipou leh, gitlouna bawl zieha thuoh sangin, sil hoi bawl zieh athuoh ahoi zaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian kunga eite ahing pui theina dingin Khrist in zong khelnate ziehin khatvei athuohta a, midih in midihloute dingin tahsa a tha in a um a, hinanleh Hagau a hinsah in a um hi,","title":"Khrist thuoh gimna"},"19":{"text":"Tua Hagau ziehin Ama ava pei a, suongkul a um hagaute kungah khantanhoi ava gen hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuate khu nidanglai a, Noah damlaia kuong abawl sung teng, Pasian in thuohzoutah a angah lai in athumang sih ua, tua kuongah mi tawmnoukhat a unpi un mi giet bep tui a kipat hundamin a um uhi.","ref":"Siem. 6.1—7.24"},"21":{"text":"Tua lim etsahnain baptisma in tuin, tahsa niehna silsiengna hilouin, Pasian lam a sie leh pha theina hoi suhlungkimna hi zawin, Jesu Khrist thawkianain ahing hundam hi."},"22":{"text":"Jesu Khrist van ah apeita a, Pasian ziet lam ah a um a, vansawlsiengte leh thuneinate tualeh silbawltheinate Ama thunuoi a koi ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaziehin Khrist in eite a dinga tahsa a hing thuohta ahi ziehin, noute zong tuabang lungsim toh ki thuom un, aziehpen koipou tahsa a thuohsa in khelna atawpsanta hi.","title":"Khelna tawpsanna"},"2":{"text":"A hun um nalai teng tahsa a mihing utna lam banga hing nawnlou a, Pasian deilam a ahinzoh na dingin."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen huasannate, utnate, zukhamhatnate, zumun nopnate, zukhamnate leh akidahhuoi milim biehnate sunga buol a, Jentelte deilam bawlna i hun peisa hinkhuote uh ahunta hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuabanga na gamta thanghuoiten, tu a amaute bawl banga na bawl nawnlou uh lamdang asa ua, noute ahing gense zel uhi."},"5":{"text":"Amaun mihing leh mishite tunga vaihawm dinga mansa a umpa mai ah atanchin uh agen ding uhi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen tahsa a um mihingte banga thukhenpieh a aum ua, hagau a Pasian banga ahin theina ding ua, akung ua khantanhoi gena um ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh sil zousie tawpna ding anaita hi, tuaziehin lungsim dihtah puo unlen, lungluttah a thungen kawmin pilvang un."},"8":{"text":"Bangteng tungah kingainatahin khat leh khat ki ittuo chiet un, aziehpen ki itna in khelna tampi akhukhum hi.","ref":"Thu. 10.12"},"9":{"text":"Phunchieh lou in khat leh khat kizintun tuo un."},"10":{"text":"Michin in Pasian hepina chi tuom tuom kemmi hoitah bangin, silpieh na mu bangbang un nna kiseppieh tuo chiet un."},"11":{"text":"Mi koipou in thu agen leh Pasian kam a thupawt bangin gen heh. Mi koipou in nna asep leh Pasian in hatna apieh bang zel in sem heh, Jesu Khrist zieh a silbangkim a Pasian pahtawi a aum theina ding in, Thupina leh vaihawmna, kumtawn kumtawn a Ama a ahi. Amen."},"12":{"text":"It tahte aw, Noute ze et dinga, na tung ua ze etna hing tung khu, sil lamdang bang ahiei hing tung bangin ngaituo sih un.","title":"Khrist zieh a thuohna hamphat huoina"},"13":{"text":"Khrist thuohnate thuohpi na hi ziehun, kipah un, tuachia athupina ahing kilat hun chiengin noute zong nahpitah a nuomin na kipah thei ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Khrist min zieh a housieta na um u’leh mi hampha na hi uhi, aziehpen thupina Hagau leh Pasian Hagau na tung uah a um hi. Amauh lam thu ah Ama gensiet in a um a, hinanleh nou lam ah pen Ama pahtawi in a um hi."},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh noute koima’n, tuolthat bangin ahiei, guta bangin ahiei, silgilou bawl bangin ahiei, ahisihleh midangte sil bawlna a kikumthawna zieh bangin ahiei in thuoh sih heh."},"16":{"text":"Ahivang in mi koipou Khristian ahi zieh a athuoh leh zum sih heh, tami ziehin Pasian pahtawi zaw heh."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian innkuonte lah ah vaihawmna pat hun ahing tungta hi, eite tunga pat masah ahi leh Pasian khantanhoi gingta loute tawpna khu bang ahita bep de aw?"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh, “Midihtat bawn hundam ahi hamham leh, Pasian gingta loute leh mikhielte, hei ah akilangta diei”","ref":"Thu. 11.31"},"19":{"text":"Tuaziehin koipou Pasian phatsah dungzuia thuohten sil hoi bawl in ahagau uh siempa ginumtah kung ah kemsah uhen."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na lah ua upate khu, Kei na upa hipi u’leh, Khrist thuohnate theipipa leh ahing kilang ding thupina tang sam ding khat in, ka hing hanthawn hi.","title":"Upate belampute ahi uh"},"2":{"text":"Na lah ua Pasian belam pawl umte ching hoi un, aloutheilou ahizieh hilou in, na ut zieh uh hizaw in, punna dihlou dei zieh zong hilou in, sep ding kilawpna in hizaw heh.","ref":"Jn. 21.15-17"},"3":{"text":"Pasian in noute ahing kepsahte tunga kiliensah lou in, belamhonte etton dingin umzaw un."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh belampu lienpen ahing kilah chiengin, atul theilou thupina manglukhu na sang ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuamabangin nou khanglaite upate nuoi ah kitulut un. Ahi, na bawn un khat leh khat nuoi ah, kitulut tuo chiet unlen, kingaingiemna sil un, aziehpen: “Pasian in akiliensahte a dou a, akingaingiemte pen hepina apie hi.”","ref":"Thu. 3.34"},"6":{"text":"Tuaziehin ahuntah a noute ahing pahtawi theina dingin Pasian khut hattah nuoi ah kingaingiem un.","ref":"Mat. 23.12; Luk. 14.11; 18.14"},"7":{"text":"Aman ahing ngaisah ziehin, na lunggimna zousie uh Ama tungah nga un."},"8":{"text":"Pilvang unlen, kiveng zingin um un, aziehpen na melmapa uh Diabol humpibahnei hawh bangin anawmval thei ding suiin aviel vah kawi hi."},"9":{"text":"Na unaute uh leitung a umte tungah tuabang thuohnate atung sam hi, chi theiin, ginna a kiptah a umin dawimangpa dou un."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Khrist Jesu a kumtawn thupina tang dinga eite hing hanpa leh hepina Pasian in, hun tomkhat na thuoh nua chiengun, ahing hoibukimsahin, hing phut det in, hing hatsahin, tualeh ahing umdetsah ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama kungah kumtawn in thupina leh vaihawmna umta hen. Amen."},"12":{"text":"I unaupa uh ginumtah a ka thei Silvanus hunain, noute hanthawnna leh tami Pasian hepina dihtah i dinna uh ahi chi theisah kawmin na kung uah tomnoukhat in ka hing giel hi.","title":"Mangpha hahna","ref":"Nasep. 15.22,40"},"13":{"text":"Noute toh tel khawm Babilona um hattuomten mangpha ahing hah uhi, tuamabangin ka tapa Mak in zong ahing hah hi.","ref":"Nasep. 12.12,25; 13.13; 15.37-39; Kolo. 4.10; Phile. 1.24"},"14":{"text":"Itna a kitawp in khat leh khat kinousiet un, Khrist Jesu a um noute kungah, lungmuonna um hen. Amen."}}}}},"61":{"info":{"name":"2 Peter","shortname":"2 Pet.","abbr":[],"desc":"Peter laihah nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Simon Peter, Jesu Khrist suoh leh sawltah in, Pasian leh i hundampa Jesu Khrist dihtatna zal a ginna manpha itan bang tangte kungah:","title":"Nousietna"},"2":{"text":"Pasian leh i Mangpa Jesu theina ziehin, noute kungah hepina leh lungmuonna suhpungin umta hen."},"3":{"text":"Ama thupina leh hoina a eite hing hanpa theina ziehin Pasian silbawltheina bangin hinna leh Pasian ngaisahna lam thu ah sil zousie ahing peta hi.","title":"Khrist a khantou semna"},"4":{"text":"Tuate ziehin thuchiem manpha leh thupi mama khu ahing pie a, tuachia tahsa utna zieh a leitung sietna a pat a suohta a Pasian hinna kitanpite na hing hi theita uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehmain thanopsuo unlen, na ginna uah hoina belap unlen, na hoina uah theina belap unlen,"},"6":{"text":"Na theina uah kidehtheina belap unlen, na kidehtheina uah kukalna belap unlen, na kukalna uah Pasian ngaisahna belap un;"},"7":{"text":"Na Pasian ngaisahna uah unau kideisahna belap unlen, unau kideisahna ah, itna belap un."},"8":{"text":"Aziehpen tam silte nouma a um ahia, kichingtah a na nei u’leh, i Mangpa Jesu Khrist theina lamah chiing leh ga neilou in na um sih ding uhi."},"9":{"text":"Tam silte tasam mi pouma nainou khat mu a, mitto ahia, akhelna luite akipat siensah ahita chi manghil mi ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin unaute, noute hat na hina u’leh tel na hina uh kichiensah dingin thanop suo zaw sem un, tamte na bawl u’leh na kipalpua ngai sih ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n i Mangpa leh hundampa Jesu Khrist kumtawn leenggam a lutna noute kungah ahing musah nasa mama ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin tam silte theiin, thutah na kung ua uma na kipna uah tua silte khu hing theipi ngitnget dingin, ngaisah louin ka um mawngmawng sih ding hi.","title":"Thutah a kiphudetna"},"13":{"text":"Ahi, tam ka tahsa puon inn a ka um sungin noute hing theithasah zelin, hing tohhal hoi kasa hi."},"14":{"text":"I Mangpa Jesu Khrist hing theisah mabangin, tam ka tahsa puon inn ka koimang paita ding chi ka thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuathamlouin ka peikhieh nua chienga tam silte na thei tha zelzel theina dingun ka hakat ding hi."},"16":{"text":"I Mangpa Jesu Khrist silbawltheina leh ahing peikiana ding thu ka hing theisah lai un, pillepchie tah a phuothu tangthu pou zuite ka hi sih ua, Ama vangletna mute ka hizaw uhi.","title":"Mellamdanna theipina"},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama’n Pa Pasian kunga kipata pahtawina leh thupina amu laitahin, Avanglien thupi mama akipat tambangin aw khat ka kungah ahing tunga, “Tami Ka Tapa deitah ahi, atung ah ka lungdam mama hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 17.1-5; Mak. 9.2-7; Luk. 9.28-35"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh taang siengthoua akunga ka um lai un, tam aw khu van a kipata hing pawt koute mama in ka za uhi."},"19":{"text":"Genlawhna thu akip zaw sem i nei uhi, khuo ahing vah a, zingsol aasi na lungtang ua ahing suoh masangsie mun miel a um vah hing taang ding angaisah bang ua na ngaisah u’leh abawl hoi na hi ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"Laisiengthou thugen mawngmawng koiman ama deibanga aledoh ding ahi sih chi thei masa un."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen thugenlawh mawngmawng nidang laiin mihing deidan a pawt ahi sih a, Pasian misiengthouten, Hagau Siengthou phuut ahi bangzel ua ana gen uh ahi zaw hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hinanleh mite lah ah guolnei tahloute zong ana um zel mabangin, na lah uah zong thuhilmi tahloute ahing um ding uhi, amauten, amauh leipa Mangpa nangawn kitheimawbawlin, mi suse thei giindan tuomte aguhin ahing polut ding ua amauh tungah thakhat in sietna atungsah ding uhi.","title":"Thuhilmi dihloute zauhuoi dan"},"2":{"text":"Mi tampiten agamtatna zumhuoite uh a zui ding ua, amaute ziehin thutah lampi gensiet in aum ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh du amna ziehin zuou thuin neh sui na in noute ahing nei ding uhi, sawtpi lai a atung ua vaihawmna khu akhawl sih a, asiemloutanna u’zong a imu sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Vansawlsiengte nangawn akhel lai un, Pasian in akhawi sih a, gawtmun ah apai a, vaihawm pieh a um dingin kokhuh miel ah akhum zaw hi.","title":"Thuhilmi dihloute sietna"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Aman nidanglai leitung ahinkhawi sih a, Pasian ngaisahlou leitungah tuichim atungsah a, hinanleh dihtatna thugenpa Noah midang sagi toh ahundamta hi.","ref":"Siem. 6.1—7.24"},"6":{"text":"Sodom leh Gomorrah khopite vutvai asuohsaha, mawtangsahin apaikhie a, Pasian ngaisahlou a hin tum mi hing um dingte etsahna dingin abawlta hi.","ref":"Siem. 19.24"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh mi giloute umdan thanghuoitah zieha lungsim na mama midihtat Lot khu ahunkheta hi.","ref":"Siem. 19.1-16"},"8":{"text":"Tua miditatpa akung ua aten laiin, amit in amu a abil in aza a, danbeia agamtatnate un, midihtatpa hinna hagau nisimin asugenthei mama hi."},"9":{"text":"Mangpa’n Ama ngaisah mite khu solna akipat hutkhiet dan leh midihtat loute khu vaihawmni a dinga gawt kawm a khawidan a thei hi."},"10":{"text":"Adiehin utna thanghuoi lam a tahsa dan banga um leh, thuneina simmawte ngel hawi vaihawmni a ding a gawt kawma khawidan athei sem hi. Amaute pen mot hansan leh migenhate ahi ua, vantungmi thupite nangawn gensiet zaulou ahi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Vansawlsieng hatna leh silbawltheina nei zawten bawn, Mangpa mai ah, amauh tungthu demin agenpieh ngam sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Hinanleh tam miten gamsa gilou ngaituona neilou mat a suhmang dingte bangin atheisiemlou uh silte agensie ua, tuachi’n amauh sietna ah amangthai sieng ding uhi;"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh suntang lai a zukham annkham nuomsate ahi ziehun dihtatlouna man amu ding uhi. Na kung ua ankuong alui lai un amauh kisolna ankuonglui ahi zieh un, thanghuoina gensietna ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Aangkawmna mit a dim, khelna tawpsan theiloute anei ua, lungsim detloute asolpua ua, thangsiet lungsim apuo ua, hamse thuoh tate ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"Lampi dih ataisan ua, avahmang ua, dihtatlouna thaman ngainapa Beor tapa Balaam lampi azuita uhi;","ref":"Kisim. 22.4-35"},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh ama pen agitlouna ziehin phawhhil in a um a;
