sabiltung ham theilou khu mihing hama hing hamin guolneipa motna khu akhaamta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tamte pen tui umlou tuikhuh leh meilum huipi semmang bang ahi uhi, amaute a dingin mielna nasatah kumtawna kheet ahita hi."},"18":{"text":"Aziehpen amauten bangma umlou thute uongsan tahin agen ua, tahsa utna thanghuoi, khelna akipata suohtate azawl zou zel uhi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute mama gitlouna sala tang pum in mite kungah zalenna thu achiem leng uhi, tua mi athuzawna thu mamain ama khu sila in akailut zel hi."},"20":{"text":"Aziehpen Mangpa leh hundampa Jesu Khrist theina zieha leitung thanghuoinate anuasiasan nua ua tuate mama a ataankia ua, zaw a aum u’leh aumdan nukhia pen u’khu achiil a sangin ase zaw hi."},"21":{"text":"Aziehpen dihtatna lampi theinua a thupieh siengthou amau kunga kipesawn kinuaheisan sangin dihtatna lampi theilou ana hi vanglah u’leh ama ua dingin ahoizaw ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ui ama luoh lang ah akia kia a, vohpi kisilsiengsa abuol a buonnawi ah akibuol kia hi kichi, paunah khu amaute tungah ahing tungta hi.","ref":"Thu. 26.11"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"It tahte aw, tua na kung ua ka gel laihah anina ahi, tuategel ah na lungsim chiimtahte uh tohthouna dinga ka hing theisah kiana ahi.","title":"Khrist hing peina dingni"},"2":{"text":"Guolnei siengthoute’n ana gen masah uh thute leh, Kou Mangpa leh hundampa sawltahte thupieh na thei ngitnget na ding un."},"3":{"text":"Tami thei masa un, Ni nukhia lam ah, simmawhatte amauh tahsa utna bangbang a gamta ahing um ding uhi.","ref":"Jud. 1.18"},"4":{"text":"Amauten “A hing peikia na ding thuchiem heiah a um ei? I pu ipate lah ashita ua, tuami nualang kalsie siemchiil a kipat sil bangkim angai ngai in a umtou zel nalai hi,” achi ding uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aziehpen tam silte haw akitheimawbawl zel ua, nidang lai in vante Pasian thuin ahing uma leitung zong tui lah apat akilangdoh a, tui ah zong a um hi.","ref":"Siem. 1.6-9"},"6":{"text":"Tua hun lai a leitung um khu tuichim in ana tum a, abeimangta hi.","ref":"Siem. 7.11"},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh tua um vante leh leitung khu Pasian thu main, Pasian ngaisahlou mite vaihawmna leh manthaina ni a mei a suhsiet dinga kholkhawm ahita hi."},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh Ka ittahte aw, tam sil khat manghil sih un, Mangpa adingin ni khat khu kum tul khat bang ahi a, kum tul khat zong ni khat bang ahi.","ref":"Late. 90.4"},"9":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat in zekai asah bangun, Mangpa khu athuchiem ah azekai sih hi, koima manthai ding deilouin, mi zousie kisia ding adei ziehin eima lam a dawzou ahi zaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh Mangpa ni khu zan a guta banga hing tung ding ahi, tua ni chiengin, vante khu nasatah a gingin amang dinga, tualeh vanlam silte mei a haltui ahi ding a, leitung zong asunga nasep umte zousie toh haltum in aum ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 24.43; Luk. 12.39; 1 Thes. 5.2; Kihil. 16.15"},"11":{"text":"Tuaziehin tam silte zousie tuabanga zunmang sieng ding ahi chi theiin umdan siengthou leh Pasian ngaisahna lam phot ah mi bangchi bang ding na hi uoi mah?","title":"Kimansa um apoimawdan"},"12":{"text":"Pasian ni hing tung ding kinem leh kilawp kawmin ngah un, tua niin vante khu hing katum in amang ding hi, van a sil um zousiete mei a haltui in aumta ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahivangin athuchiem dungzuiin asunga dihtatna umna van tha leh lei tha ikineppi ahi.","ref":"Isai. 65.17; 66.22; Kihil. 21.1"},"14":{"text":"Tuaziehin ittahte aw, tam silte kineppi na hi uh chi theiin, nieh banglou leh gensietbei leh lungmuongtah a uma mu nahi theina dingun, thanopsuoin pang un,"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh i Mangpa thuohzouna khu hundamnain na tuot un, i unau ittah Paul in akunga kipie pilna dungzuia na kung ua agel bang in;"},"16":{"text":"Alaihah zousie ah tam silte agiel hi, tua alaihahte ah sil theisiem hasa pawlkhat aum a, tuate pen mipillou leh midetlouten Laisiengthou dang ama uh deibanga akaikawi bang ua kaikawi in amauh sietna dingin azang uhi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaziehin ittahte aw, nouten tua thute na thei masah ziehun pilvangun, tuachilouin vang migiloute khelna a puimanga umin na dinmundet ua kipat in na pua kha ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Hinanleh i Mangpa leh hundampa Jesu Khrist hepina leh theina ah hing khanglien un, Ama kungah tu leh kumtawn in thupina umta hen. Amen."}}}}},"62":{"info":{"name":"1 Johan","shortname":"1 Jn.","abbr":[],"desc":"Johan laihah khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A chiil a kipat a umsa, ka zahsa uh, ka mit ua ka musa uh, ka etsa uh leh ka khut ua ka thamsa uh, tua hinna Thu khu;","title":"Thumapui","ref":"Jn. 1.1"},"2":{"text":"Tua hinna khu akilangta a, kouten ka muta ua, ka theipi ua, tualeh tua kumtawn hinna Pa kunga um, ka kung ua suhlat a um khu noute kungah ka phuong uhi;","ref":"Jn. 1.14"},"3":{"text":"Nouten zong koute toh kipawlkhawmna na nei theina dingun, ka musa u’leh ka zahsa uh noute kunga hing phuongkhie ka hi uhi, tualeh adihtahin ikipawlkhawmna u’khu Pa toh a Tapa Jesu Khrist toh kipawlkhawmna ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh na kipahna uh akimtheina dingin tam thute na kung uah ka hing giel uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tami Ama akipata ka zah uh, na kung ua kang gen sawn uh thupuoh ahi, Pasian khu vah ahia Ama ah miel mawngmawng a um sih hi.","title":"Ama toh kipawlna khu vah a gamtatna ahi"},"6":{"text":"Ama toh kipawlkhawmna ka nei uh chi ngal a miel a igamtat leh zuou gen ihi ua, thutah zui a gamta ihi sih uhi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama vah a aum banga eite zong vah a i um leh, khat leh khat kipawlkhawmna i nei a, A Tapa Jesu Khrist sisan in khelna zousie apat eite ahing siengsah zel hi."},"8":{"text":"Khelna ka nei sih ichi leh, eima leh eima kisol ihi ua, thutah eima ah aum sih hi.","title":"Khelna kiphuonna"},"9":{"text":"I khelnate i phuon u’leh ikhelnate ngaidam ding leh, dihtatlouna zousie akipat hing siengsah dingin Ama amuonhuoi in adihtat ahi."},"10":{"text":"Khelna ka nei sih ichi leh Ama mi zuou ihisah a, tualeh athu zong eima ah a um sih hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ta ittahte aw, na khellouna dingun tam thute na kung uah ka hing giel hi. Tualeh mi koi ahiei akhel taah leh, Pa kunga hing genpiehpa Jesu Khrist midihtat inei hi.","title":"Eite hing panpi Khrist ahi"},"2":{"text":"Ama pen i khelnate dinga thupha tawina ahi, eite khelna guoh hilou in leitung pumpi khelna thupha tawina zong ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ama thupiehte i zuia ahileh, tamnah Ama i thei hi chi i thei uhi.","title":"Ama thupieh manna"},"4":{"text":"“Ama ka thei” chi ngal a athupiehte zuilou khu mi zuou ahi a, tualeh thutah ama ah a um sih hi."},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh A thuzui pouma khu ama ah Pasian itna abukim tahtah hi, tami’n Ama ah i um chi i thei hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama ah ka um chi mi’n Ama gamtat banga agamtat ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Unaute aw, noute kungah thupieh tha ka hing giel sih a, thupieh lui achiil a na neisa uh ka hing giel zaw ahi. Tua thupieh lui pen achiil apat na zahsa uh thu ahi.","title":"Ki it tuo ding ahi","ref":"Jn. 13.34"},"8":{"text":"Tuachiengleh thupieh tha khat na kung uah ka hing giel kia hi, tua khu Ama leh noute ah dihtahin a um hi, aziehpen Miel abeita a, vah dihtah ahing taangta hi."},"9":{"text":"Min vah ah ka um chi ngal a, aunau amuda leh, tutanin miel ah a um nalai ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aunau it mi pen vah ah a um a, tualeh ama ah kipalpua theina mawng mawng a um sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh aunau muda pouma miel a um ahi a, mielin amit atosah a apeina lam zong athei sih hi,"},"12":{"text":"Ta ittahte aw, Ama min zieha na khelnate uh, ngaidam ahitaah ziehin, na kung uah ka hing giel ahi."},"13":{"text":"Pate aw, achiila pat a um Ama na thei ziehun, na kung uah ka giel ahi. Tangvalte aw, giloupa na zawtaah zieh, un na kung uah ka giel ahi. Tate aw Pa na theitah zieh un, na kung uah ka giel ahi."},"14":{"text":"Pate aw, achiil a kipat a um Ama na theitah, ziehun na kung uah ka giel ahi. Tangvalte aw na hat ua, Pasian thu nouma ah um ngitnget a, tualeh giloupa na zawtaah ziehun, na kung uah ka giel ahi."},"15":{"text":"Leitung it sih unlen, leitunga sil umte zong it sih un, mi koipouin leitung a it leh, Pa itna ama ah a um sih hi.","title":"Leitung it louding"},"16":{"text":"Aziehpen leitunga sil um zousie tahsa utnate, mit utnate leh damsung kiletsahnate khu Pasian akipan ahi sih a, leitunga kipan ahi zaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Leitungpen a utna toh abeimang zel a, hinanleh Pasian deilam bawl mi pen kumtawnin aumden ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ta ittahte aw, hun nukhia ahita, Khrist doudalpa ahing pei ding chi na zahtaah uh bangin, tuin zong Khrist doudalmi tampi a umta hi, tamte ziehin tu khu hun nukhia ahita chi ithei hi.","title":"Khrist doudalpa hagau"},"19":{"text":"Amaute khu ilah ua kipat in apawtdoh ua, hinanleh ilah ua mi ahi sih uhi, aziehpen ilah ua mi na hita u’leh eite toh a umden ding ua, hinanleh a unpi ua apawtdohna un amaute khatbeeh zong eite lah a mi ahisih uh chi kilatna dingin apawtdoh uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh noute pen Mi Siengthoupa apat thaununa tang na hi ua, sil zousie na thei uhi."},"21":{"text":"Thutah na theilou zieh ua na kung ua hing giel ka hi sih a, thutah na thei zieh u’leh thutah apat zuou apawtlou zieha hing giel ka hizaw hi."},"22":{"text":"Jesu khu Khrist ahi sih chia nielkal loungal zuou gen mi koi ahiei? Pa leh Tapa niel mi khu Khrist doudal ahi."},"23":{"text":"Mi koipou Tapa nuol miin Pa anei sih a, hinanleh Tapa pom pouma in Pa zong anei hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaziehin achiil a pata na zahsa u’khu nouma ah umsah un. Tua achiil a pat a na zah u’khu nouma a aum ngitnget nahpou leh noute zong Tapa leh Pa ah na um ngitnget ding uhi."},"25":{"text":"Tualeh tami ahi Aman eite ahing chiemsa: kumtawn hinna."},"26":{"text":"Noute hing sol tumte tungtang ah tam thute ka hing giel ahi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh Ama akipat thaununa na tan u’khu nouma ah aum ngitnget a, koima hing hil na kiphamaw sih uhi, hinanleh tua thaununa mama in noute sil zousie ahing hil hi, tua thaununa pen adihtah ahia, zuou ahi sih hi. Ahing hil bangin Ama ah na um ding uhi."},"28":{"text":"Tuin ta ittahte aw, Ama ah um ngitnget un, Ama ahing kilat chienga kimuonna inei theina ding leh Ama ahing pei chienga Amai a izum louna dingun."},"29":{"text":"Ama khu mi dihtat ahi chi na thei u’leh, michin dihtatna bawl pouma Ama a pieng ahi chi na thei uhi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngai un, Pa hing itna thupi hina va-ia e, Pasian tate chia i um taah uh. Tuaziehin leitungin ahing thei sih hi, Ama atheilou zieh in.","title":"Pa itnain hinkhuo ahoisah hi","ref":"Jn. 1.12"},"2":{"text":"Ittahte aw, tuin eite Pasian tate i hita uhi, tualeh bangchibanga um ding i hiei chi akilang nai tadi sih hi, hinanleh Ama ahing kilat chiengin Ama bangin i um ding uh chi pen ithei uhi, Ama pen ahina bangbanga imu ding zieh un."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh michin Ama a kinepna nei pouma, Ama asienthou bangin akisusiengthou zel hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi Koipou khelna bawlin dan abawtsie hi; khelna khu danbei a gamtatna ahi.","title":"Dihtatna leh Pasian tate"},"5":{"text":"I khelnate lamang ding a Ama hing kilang ahi chi na thei uhi, Ama ah khelna mawngmawng a um sih hi.","ref":"Jn. 1.29"},"6":{"text":"Koipou Ama a um ngitnget mi pen akhiel sih hi. Khelna bawl mi koipou in Ama amu sih a, thei zong athei sih hi."},"7":{"text":"Ta ittahte aw, noute koiman hing solzou sih heh. Ama adihtat bangin, dihtatna bawl mi khu, midihtat ahi."},"8":{"text":"Khelna bawl mi khu diabol akipat ahia, aziehpen diabol in achiila kipat in akhiel tawntung hi. Pasian Tapa ahing kilatna zieh pen diabol nasepte suse dingin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mi koipou Pasian a pieng poumain khelna abawl ngaisih hi, aziehpen Pasian chii ama ah a um ngitnget a, Pasian a pieng ahiziehin khelna abawl thei sih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tam thu a kipat in Pasian tate leh diabol tate akithei thei hi; dihtat taha gamtalou mi pouma Pasian akipat ahi sih a, tualeh aunau itlou mi pouma zong Pasian akipat ahi sih hi."},"11":{"text":"Achiil a kipata thuhah na zah u’khu tami ahi; eite khat leh khat iki ittuo chiet ding ahi.","ref":"Jn. 13.34"},"12":{"text":"Giloupa a kipan asanggampa that Kain bang lou in: Bangzieh a atha ahiei? ama silbawlte ahoi sih a, asanggampa adihtat zieh ahi.","ref":"Siem. 4.8"},"13":{"text":"Ka unaute aw, leitung miten noute ahing muda leh lamdang sasih un.","title":"Dihtatna gamtat"},"14":{"text":"I unaute i it ziehin shina apat hinna ah i lutta chi ithei uhi. Mi koipou aunau itlou khu shina ah a umden hi.","ref":"Jn. 5.24"},"15":{"text":"Mi koipou aunau muda khu tuolthat ahi; tuolthat koima kumtawn hinna neiden a um sih chi na thei uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tanah Pasian itna i thei uhi, Aman eite dinga ahinna apiehkhiet ziehin, eiten zong unaute ding a i hinna i pieh sam ding uh ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh mi koipou in leitung nei leh lam hau henlen, a unau tasamin muhenlen, ama lainat vawt sih leh bangchi’n Pasian itna ama ah a um thei diei?"},"18":{"text":"Ka ta ittahte aw, athu maimai leh kamsiemin ki it sih vai, hinanleh nasep silbawl leh thutah in ki it zaw vai."},"19":{"text":"Tam thu apat in thutah a kipan i hi uh i thei a, tualeh Ama mai ah i lungtang uh i muongsah thei ding uhi."},"20":{"text":"I lungtang un siemlou ahing tansah leh, Pasian khu i lungtang sang un athupi zaw a, sil zousie athei hi."},"21":{"text":"It tahte aw, i lungtang un siemlou ahing tansah sihpou leh Pasian lam ah kimuonna inei hi."},"22":{"text":"Tualeh Athupiehte i zui a, amitmu a Ama lungkimna lam i bawl ziehin i nget pouma Ama apat i mu uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh Athupieh khu tami ahi, eiten A Tapa Jesu Khrist min i gintat ua, tualeh ahing thupieh banga khat leh khat iki it tuo chiet ding uh ahi.","ref":"Jn. 13.34; 15.12,17"},"24":{"text":"Mi koipou athupieh zui khu Ama ah aum a, Ama zong ama ah aum hi. Tam thu akipat Ama pen eite ah a um zing hi chi, Ahing pieh Hagau zal in ithei uhi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"It leh ngaite aw, hagau chinteng gingta sih unlen, hagaute khu Pasian a hing kipan ahileh hilou chien zaw un, aziehpen guolnei tahlou tampi leitungah apawtdoh zouta hi.","title":"Hagaute etchienna"},"2":{"text":"Tam thu ah Pasian Hagau na thei ding uhi: Jesu Khrist tahsa in ahing pieng chia phuong hagau pouma khu Pasian a kipan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu Khrist tahsa in ahing pieng chia phuonglou hagau pouma Pasian a hing kipan ahisih hi, tampen Khrist doudalpa hagau hing pei ding ahi chia na zah u’khu ahi, tuin zong leitungah a um zouta hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka ta it leh ngaite aw, noute pen Pasiana kipan na hi ua, amauh na zouta uhi; aziehpen Ama nouma a umpa khu leitunga umpa sangin athupi zaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Amauh pen leitunga kipan ahi ua, tuaziehin leitung silte agen uhi, tualeh leitungin amauh angaikhie uhi."},"6":{"text":"Eite pen Pasian akipan i hi ua, Pasian thei mi pouma in ithugen angaikhie uhi. Pasiana kipan hilouten i thugen angaikhe sih uhi. Tanah hagau dih leh dihlou ithei uhi."},"7":{"text":"It tahte aw, khat leh khat iki it ding uhi, aziehpen itna khu Pasiana kipan ahi, tualeh michin itna nei pouma Pasian apieng ahia, Pasian athei hi.","title":"Khrist itna banga ki-it ding"},"8":{"text":"Itna neilou mi in, Pasian athei sih hi, aziehpen Pasian khu itna ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tanah, Pasian in a itna eite lamah ahing langsahta, Ama zal a ihin theina dingin Pasian in A Tapa neisun leitunga ahing sawlna ah."},"10":{"text":"Tanah itna a um hi, eiten Pasian i it chi ahi sih a, Ama neite ahing it a, i khelnate thuphatawina hi dingin A Tapa ahing sawl chi ahizaw hi."},"11":{"text":"It tahte aw, Pasian in hichikhopa ahing it leh, eite zong khat leh khat iki it ding uh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Mi koiman bangmachihin zong Pasian amu ngai sih hi. Eite khat leh khat iki it leh, Pasian eima ah a uma, A itna zong eima ah abukim ahi.","ref":"Jn. 1.18"},"13":{"text":"Tanah eite Ama ah i um a, Ama zong eima ah a um chi ithei hi; A Hagau ahing pieh taah ziehin."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh Pa in Tapa khu leitung hundampa dingin ahing sawl chi i muta ua, i theisah uhi."},"15":{"text":"Mi koipou Jesu Pasian Tapa ahi chia phuong pouma khu ama ah Pasian a um a, ama zong Pasian ah a um hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualeh i tunga Pasian in itna anei khu ithei ua, ging zong i gingta uhi. Pasian khu itna ahia, koipou itna a um khu Pasian ah a uma, Pasian zong ama ah aum hi."},"17":{"text":"Tanah ilah uah itna abukimta hi, thukhen ni chienga hansanna i nei theina dingun, Ama hina bangbanga leitunga eite hina zong ahitah ziehin."},"18":{"text":"Itna ah zauna a um sih a, itna bukimin zauna anotmang zaw hi, aziehpen zaunain gawtna ahing ngaituosah hi; zauna nei mi khu itna ah abukim nai sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Aman eite ahing it masah zieh a, eiten Ama i it uh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Mi koiahiei in “Pasian ka it” chi ngal a aunau amuda leh ama mi zuou ahi, amu giaguo aunau bawn it loupi’n amulou Pasian bangchi’n a it thei diei?"},"21":{"text":"Ama a kipat tam thupieh eiten inei uhi, Koipou Pasian it in, aunau zong a it ding ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi koipou Jesu khu Khrist ahi chi gingta khu Pasian a pieng ahia, tualeh koipou ahingtu it in ata zong a it hi.","title":"Pasian Tapa ginna: Leitung guolzawna"},"2":{"text":"Tanah Pasian i it a, athupiehte izuina ah, Pasian tate i it hi chi i thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasian i itna khu athupiehte izuina uh ahi, tualeh athupiehte pen azui hasa vawt sih hi.","ref":"Jn. 14.15"},"4":{"text":"Pasian a pieng pouma in leitung pumpi azouta hi; tualeh tami ahi leitung pumpi izawna uh; i ginna uh."},"5":{"text":"Jesu Pasian Tapa ahi chi gingta mi loungal koi ahiei leitung pumpi tunga guolzou?"},"6":{"text":"Tami ahi tui leh sisan a hing pei, Jesu Khrist khu; tui guoh hilou in tui leh sisan in ahizaw hi. Tualeh theipipa khu Hagau ahi, aziehpen Hagau khu thutah ahi.","title":"Hundamna kitheichienna"},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen van ah theipitu thum a um hi, Pa, Thu, tualeh Hagau Siengthou, tualeh tam thumte pen khat ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh leitungah theipitu thum a um hi, Hagau, tui, leh sisan, tualeh thumte khat bangin akithukim uhi."},"9":{"text":"Mihing theipina bawn i pom u’leh, Pasian theipina athupi zaw hi, Pasian theipina khu A Tapa tungthu a atheisahna ahi."},"10":{"text":"Koipou Pasian Tapa gingtain ama ah theipimi hina anei hi, koipou Pasian thu gingtalou miin pen. Ama mi zuou ahisah hi; Pasian in a Tapa ahing pieh thu atheisah agintatlou zieh in."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh tami theipina khu ahi, Pasian in kumtawn hinna eite ahing peta a, tua hinna khu A Tapa ah a um hi.","ref":"Jn. 3.36"},"12":{"text":"Koipou Tapa nei in hinna aneita, Pasian Tapa neilou poumain hinna anei sih hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumtawn hinna na neita uh chi na theina dingun, noute Pasian min gingtate kungah tam thu ka giel ahi, tualeh Pasian Tapa min na gintat theina dingun."},"14":{"text":"Pasian a i kimuonna u’khu tami ahi, Ama deilam sil khat poupou i nget leh ahing ngaikhe zel hi.","title":"Thumna a kimuonna"},"15":{"text":"Aman inget pouma ahing ngaikhie chi ithei chiengin, akunga ingette uh imuta chi ithei uhi."},"16":{"text":"Mi koipou in asanggam in shina khop hilou khelna bawla amu leh, athumpieh dinga tuachi’n Aman shina khop hilou khelna bawlte dingin hinna ape ding hi. Shina tunthei khelna aum a, tuami a dingin athumpieh ding ahi ka chi sih hi."},"17":{"text":"Dihtatlouna zousie khelna ahi; shina khop hilou khelna zong a um hi."},"18":{"text":"Koipou Pasiana kipat a pieng khu akhiel zongsang sih chi ithei hi, hinanleh Pasian a piengpa in ama akembit a, giloupa’n ama akhoi kha sih hi."},"19":{"text":"Eite Pasian a ihi chi ikithei a, leitung pumpi giloupa thunuoi ah a um hi chi ithei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian Tapa ahing pei a, Midihpa Ama itheina dingin theisiemna ahing peta chi ithei uhi; eite pen tua Midihtah a Tapa Jesu Khrist mama ah i um uhi. Ama khu Pasian dihtah leh kumtawn hinna ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ta ittahte aw, milimte apat kihemkhie un. Amen."}}}}},"63":{"info":{"name":"2 Johan","shortname":"2 Jn.","abbr":[],"desc":"Johan laihah nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei upa in, tel tuom numei leh atate thutah a ka itte kungah tualeh kei guoh hilou in, thutah thei zousie in zong ahing it uhi,","title":"Nou sietna"},"2":{"text":"Eima a um tualeh kumtawn a zong ikunga umden ding thutah zieh in."},"3":{"text":"Pa pasien akipat leh Mangpa Jesu Khrist, Pa Pasian Tapa akipat hepina, khotuona leh hamuonna in thutah leh itna toh noute hing umpita hen."},"4":{"text":"Pa kunga kipat a thupieh imu banga, natate pawl khat thutah a um ka mu ziehin ka kipah mama hi.","title":"Khrist thupieh zuina"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh tuin numei zatat huoi aw, thupieh tha hing giel bang hilou in, achiil a kipata ineisa uh hing giel hizawin, ki it tuo chiet dingin ka hing ngen hi.","ref":"Jn. 13.34; 15.12,17"},"6":{"text":"Tami ahi itna: Athupiehte bang a i umna khu ahi. Thupieh khu tami ahi, achiila kipata na zahsa bang ua na zui ding uh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aziehpen Jesu Khrist tahsain ahing pei chia phuonglou solhat mi tampi leitung ah apawtkheta uhi. Tuabang mite pouma khu mi solhat leh Khrist doudalmi ahi.","title":"Thugintahlou hilmite"},"8":{"text":"Isepkhietsa silte mansuo lou a, kipahman akima imuthei zawhna dingun kiveng un."},"9":{"text":"Mi koipou dan palsan leh Khrist thugin kihilna dana umlouten Pasian anei sih hi. Khrist thuhilna a umden miin pen, Pa leh Tapa aniin aneikhawm hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi koipou tami thugin kithuhilna keng loua na kung ua hing pei a um leh, na inn uah tungsah sih unlen, kamdam in zong na lamdawn sih un."},"11":{"text":"Aziehpen tuabang mi na vaidawn mi in, agamtat gilou akitaanpi ahi."},"12":{"text":"Na kung ua thu tampi hing gel ding ka nei vangin laipeh leh laitui in ka giel ut sih hi, hinanleh na kung ua hing haw a, i kipahna uh akim theina dingin kimaituo a thugen ka kinem hi.","title":"Thutawpna"},"13":{"text":"Tel tuoma um na sanggamnu taten Mangpha ahing hah uhi. Amen."}}}}},"64":{"info":{"name":"3 Johan","shortname":"3 Jn.","abbr":[],"desc":"Johan laihah thumna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Upa in ittah Gaius, thutah a ka it mama kungah.","title":"Nousietna thu","ref":"Nasep. 19.29; Rom. 16.23; 1 Kor. 1.14"},"2":{"text":"It aw, na hinna hagau in lungnopna anga mabang a, na gamtatna zousie a hamphatna na nga theina ding leh na chidam theina dingin thu ka ngen hi."},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen unaute ahing pei ua, thutah zui a na umdan bang a, thutah nangma a aten thu ahing theisah tahun ka lungdam mama hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka tate thutah ah a um uh chi ka zah sanga kipahna lienzaw ka nei sih hi."},"5":{"text":"It aw, unaute tung leh mikhuolte tunga na silbawl pouma gin umtahin na bawl zel hi.","title":"Gaius silphalna"},"6":{"text":"Amaun hattuomte mai ah na itna theipimi a pangin agenta uhi. Amaute akhuolzinna ua Pasianmi bangtaha na makai zel leh a bawl hoi na hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amin zieh a Jentelte kunga kipat bangma lalou a peidoh ahi zieh un."},"8":{"text":"Tuaziehin thutah a kipanpituo nasemte ihitheina dingun, tam bang mite ingai ding uh ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hattuomte kungah lai ka hing giel a, hinanleh alah ua, tungtuon utpa Diotrephes in koute ahing ngai sih hi.","title":"Diotrephes"},"10":{"text":"Tuaziehin ka hing haw chiengin asilbawlte ka theidohsah ding hi, ka tung ua thu gilou genna akamtam dan, tua zong hunsalouin ama mamain unaute apom nuom sih a, apom nuomte nangawn akham nalai a, hattuom apat anotdoh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka it aw, sil gilou bawlte umdan la sinlen, sil hoi bawlzaw in, Silhoi bawl mi pen Pasian a kipan ahia, hinanleh silgilou bawlmi in Pasian amu sih hi."},"12":{"text":"Demetrius in mi zousie apat leh Thutah akipat in zong patat alaw hi, ahi, kouten zong ka theipi uhi. Tualeh ka theipina u’pen adih ahi chi na thei uhi.","title":"Demetrius pahtatna"},"13":{"text":"Gel ding tampi ka nei hi, hinanleh laipeh leh laitui in na kung uah ka giel sih ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh sawtlou kaal in ka hing kimupi dinga, kimai tuo in ikihou ding ka kinem hi.","title":"Mangpha hahna"},"15":{"text":"Na kungah lungmuonna um hen. I lawmten mangpha hing hah uhi. I lawmte amin chiet uh louin ka nousiet hi, hing na genpiehin."}}}}},"65":{"info":{"name":"Juda","shortname":"Jud.","abbr":[],"desc":"Juda laihah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei Jesu Khrist suohpa leh Jakob sanggampa Juda in, Pa Pasian hatte, akoituomte leh Jesu Khrist a kepbitte kungah.","title":"Nousietna","ref":"Mat. 13.55; Mak. 6.3"},"2":{"text":"Khotuona lungmuonna leh itna, na kung uah suhpungin umta hen."},"3":{"text":"Ka itte aw, i tankhawm uh hundamna thu na kung ua, gel kaal ka ngahla mama laitahin, misiengthoute kunga khatvei a setden dinga kipekhie thugin hum a phatuomngai tah a na pan na ding ua, hanthawn na thu hing gel poimaw kasa zaw hi.","title":"Kithuhilna dihloute"},"4":{"text":"Aziehpen nidanglai akipata siemlou tang dinga guotsa, Pasian ngaisahlou leh, i Pasian uh hepina khu huasanna suohsah a, tualeh i Mangpa Pasian umsun nuol in, i Mangpa Jesu Khrist gingtalou, mi koite ahiei, theiloukaal a simtham a hinglut a um uhi."},"5":{"text":"Mangpa’n Izipt gam akipat amite hundoh zouta napi in, anua a agingta loute asumangthang hi, chi na theisa uh hinanleh, ka hing thei thasah kia nuom hi.","title":"Thuhilmi dihloute thukhenna","ref":"Pawt. 12.51; Kisim. 14.29,30"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh ahina dinmun masa uh kemden loua, a umna mun uh taisan vansawltahte zong, tua ni thupi a gawt dingin miellah ah akoi a, kumtawn khainiengin akaan hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuamabangin Sodom leh Gomorrah leh akim avel a um khuote numei pasal kaal a thangtatnate a kipumpieh leh tahsatuom dang na delte khu, kumtawn mei a gawtna thuoh dingte etsahna in anei hi.","ref":"Siem. 19.1-24"},"8":{"text":"Tuamabangin, tam mang kidahhuoi manten zong, tahsa asubua ua, thuneina adei sih ua, thupinate agensie uhi."},"9":{"text":"Hinanleh Mikael, vansawlsieng Tungnungpen hilhiel in zong dawimangpa toh Mosi luong akitu a diabol toh akihau lai un ama agense ngam sih a, “Mangpa’n hing phawh heh” achi zaw hi.","ref":"Dan. 10.13,21; 12.1; Kihil. 12.7; Danp. 34.6; Zek. 3.2"},"10":{"text":"Hinanleh tam mite penin, atheiloute uh agensie ua, ngaituona neilou gamsate banga pienken theitheina a, atheite uh abawl ua, ama u’leh ama uh akisusie uhi."},"11":{"text":"Atunguh agih hi, Kain lampi azui ziehun, Punna deigawnain Balaam suhkhelna ah kilawptahin atailut ua, tualeh Korah helna ah amangthaita uhi.","ref":"Siem. 4.3-8; Kisim. 22.1-35; Kisim. 16.1-35"},"12":{"text":"Tam mite pen na itna ankuong luina ua mai ngaltah a na kung ua annkuong a imkhawm chieng un, tuiin atup suongmong hiem, zaunadan theilou a, amauh kivate ahi uhi, amaute khu, tui pailou meilum hui mutleengte leh khaal lai a, ga neilou singkung vuoi, ga neilou nivei shita, azunga kiphungkalte, ahi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute pen, ama uh zumna tuipi kinawh ziazuate leh aasi vahvai leeng kawikawite, bang ahi ua, ama-ua ding a Pasian in kumtawn a dinga mielna vomkeikui akoipiehte ahi uhi."},"14":{"text":"Adam a kipata akhang sagina Enok in zong tamte tungtang ana genlawh hi, “En un, Mangpa khu Amisiengthou tul sawmte toh ahing pei hi.”","ref":"Siem. 5.18,21-24"},"15":{"text":"Mi zousie tunga thu akhen ding leh, alah ua Pasian ngaisah loute nasep zousie siemlou atangsah dinga, Pasian ngainatna neilou mikhielte, Pasian ngaisahloutaha agamtatnate u’leh agensietnate uah siemmaw tangsah ding in achi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tam mite pen phunhatte, mi demna ding suite leh ama uh tahsa utna bangbanga gamtate ahi uhi, kam kisatheitah a amaute phattuomna ding gen a mi maitangphatte ahi uhi."},"17":{"text":"Hinanleh ka itte aw, nouten vang i Mangpa Jesu Khrist sawltahten ni danglai a, ana thugente uh thei ngitnget un."},"18":{"text":"“Hun nukhia chiengin pasien ngaisahlouna lam a amauh utna banga um, mi simmaw hatte ahing um ding uh,” ana chi uhi.","ref":"2 Pet. 3.3"},"19":{"text":"Tam mite pen, kituombawl hatte, tahsa mi, hagau neiloute ahi uhi."},"20":{"text":"Hinanleh ka itte aw, noute pen, a siengthou penpen na thugin uh tunga kilamtouin, Hagau Siengthou ah thum un."},"21":{"text":"Kumtawn hinna hing tut ding i Mangpa Jesu Khrist hepina ngah kawmin, Pasian itna ah kikem det un."},"22":{"text":"Aginglel pawlkhatte tungah lainatna nei unlen,"},"23":{"text":"Midangte zong meikuonga pat kaidoh unlen, hunkhie unlen, atahsa un asuhbua apuonsilte uh nangawn kidah un."},"24":{"text":"Tuin, na kipalpua louna ding ua, hing vengbit thei leh, athupina mai a nasatah a nuomsa a, gensietbei a noute hing koi theipa;","title":"Pasian phatna"},"25":{"text":"I hundampa uh Pasian apil umsun Ama kungah, thupina leh pahtawinate vaihawmna leh silbawltheina, Tu leh tangtawn in umdenta hen. Amen."}}}}},"66":{"info":{"name":"Kihilna","shortname":"Kihil.","abbr":[],"desc":"Johan kunga kihilna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu Khrist kihilna, Pasian in sil hing tung pai ngeingei dingte asuohte kunga atheisah dinga ama apieh khu, tualeh Aman asuohpa Johan kungah a vansawltah sawl in kihilnate atheisahta hi.","title":"Thumapui leh chibai buhna"},"2":{"text":"Johan in Pasian thu leh Jesu Khrist theipina thu leh a sil mute zousie theipi in apang hi."},"3":{"text":"Tam genlawhna thute sim a zate leh asunga thu kigielte zui pouma ahampha hi, aziehpen ahun anaita hi."},"4":{"text":"Johan in Asia gam a hattuom sagi umte kungah, Ama aum leh, a umsa leh a hing um dingpa akipat leh, A mangtoupha masanga um Hagau sagite akipat, Hepina leh lungmuonna na kung uah um ta hen,","ref":"Pawt. 3.14; Kihil. 4.5"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh Jesu Khrist theipipa ginum, mishi lah a piengmasapen leh leitung leengte tunga vaihawmpa akipat leh, Ama eite hing it a, i khelna ua kipata A sisan a hing silsiengpa leh,","ref":"Isai. 55.4; Late. 89.27"},"6":{"text":"Pasian leh a Pa kunga leeng leh siempu a hing siempa kungah thupina leh vaihawmnate kumtawn kumtawnin umta hen. Amen.","ref":"Pawt. 19.6; Kihil. 5.10"},"7":{"text":"En un, meipi toh ahing pei hi, mi chintengin Ama amu ding ua, Ama sunte ngelin zong amu ding uhi Leitung namte zousie Ama ziehin akap ding uhi. Tuabang hita hen. Amen.","ref":"Dan. 7.13; Mat. 24.30; Mak. 13.26; Luk. 21.27; 1 Thes. 4.17; Zek. 12.10; Jn. 19.34,37; Zek. 12.10; Mat. 24.30"},"8":{"text":"“Kei Alpha leh Omega, a Masapen leh a Tawpna ka hi,” Mangpa A umlel, a umsa leh ahing pei dingpa, Bangkimbawlthei in achi hi.","ref":"Kihil. 22.13; Pawt. 3.14"},"9":{"text":"Kei Johan na unaupa u’leh Jesu Khrist a gimthuohna leh kukalna a na thuohpi u leh leenggam zieh a na thuohpi uh, Pasian thu leh Jesu Khrist ka theipina ziehin Patmos kichi tuilaisie gam ah ka um hi.","title":"Khrist kilahna"},"10":{"text":"Mangpa ni in Hagau in ka um a, ka nua langah pengkul ging banga aw ngaitah ka za hi."},"11":{"text":"“Kei Alpha leh Omega, Amasapen leh Anukhia pen ka hi, na sil mute laibu ah giel inlen, Asia gam a um hattuom sagite: Ephesa hattuom, Smarna hattuom, Pergamos hattuom, Thiatira hattuom, Sardis hattuom, Philadelphia hattuom leh Laodisia hattuomte kungah hah in ahing chi hi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n kei hing houpi aw khu en dingin ka kihei a, tuachia ka kihei leh sana a kibawl meivah tunna sagi ka mu a,"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh tua meivah tunna laikimtah ah mihing Tapa bang mikhat, akephang donga puontuol sil, a awm sana puonhuol a kigah ka mu hi.","ref":"Dan. 7.13; Dan. 10.5"},"14":{"text":"Alutang leh asam khu samul bangin akaanga, vua bangin a vam hi, tualeh a mitte khu meikuong abang hi.","ref":"Dan. 7.9; Dan. 10.6"},"15":{"text":"Akengte sum eng mei a kihal taah, kinawtval bangin asienga, A aw lah tui tampi luong ging bang ahi.","ref":"Ezek. 1.24; 43.2"},"16":{"text":"Aman akhut ziet langah aasi sagi a tawi a, akam a kipat namsau alangni a tattuo hiem tah mai a pawt a, tualeh amel khu ni hasat a asat laitah bang ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Ama ka mu tahin akengbulah ashisa bangin ka puata hi. Hinanleh Aman akhut zietlam ka tungah angam a, ka kungah, “Zau sin, Kei Amasa pen leh a Nukhia pen ka hi.","ref":"Isai. 44.6; 48.12; Kihil. 2.8; 22.13"},"18":{"text":"Kei Ahingpa ka hi, tualeh ka shi a, Ngai vawi, kumtawnin ka hing ahi, Amen. Tualeh ken mishi khuo leh Shina kot chabi ka nei hi."},"19":{"text":"Na sil musate leh sil umlaite leh sil hing um dingte, giel in."},"20":{"text":"Ka khut zietlam a aasi sagi na mute leh, Sana meivah tunna sagite thuguh pen: aasi sagite khu hattuom sagite Vansawlsiengte ahi ua, meivahtunna sagi na mute pen hattuom sagite ahi uhi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ephesa hattuom vansawlsieng kungah tami giel in; A khut zietlam a aasi sagi tawipa, sana meivah tunna sagite laikim tah a vahkawi kawipa’n tam thute agen hi;","title":"Ephesa hattuom"},"2":{"text":"“Keima’n na nasepte, na sepgimnate, kukaltaha na thuoh hatnate, migiloute na thuohtheilou dan ka thei hi. Tualeh sawltahte ka hi uh kichi lah hivawtloute na etkhiet a mi zuou ahidan uh na mudoh dan zong ka thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Na thuohzou a, na kukal a, tualeh Ka min zieh a na sepgimdan leh na basap loudan ka thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahivang in Na itna masapen na nuasie taah ziehin, tam thu ah demna ka hing nei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaziehin na puana laitah theingitnget inlen, kisia inlen, tualeh na silbawl masate bawlkia in, na kisia sihleh kintahin na kungah kang pei dinga, na meivahtunna khu amun a kipat in ka suon ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hinanleh tami na nei uh ahoi hi, Nikolaitante nasep na hua a Ken zong tuakhu ka huo hi."},"7":{"text":"Hattuomte kunga Hagau thugen bilnei tapouin za heh. Aguolzoupa kungah, Pasian Pradise laikim a um hinna sikunga apat neh ding ka pe ding hi, achi hi.","ref":"Siem. 2.9; Kihil. 22.2; Ezek. 28.13; 31.8"},"8":{"text":"“Smarna hattuom vansawlsieng kungah tambangin giel in: Amasapen leh anukhiapen, shi a, hingkiapa’n tam thute agen hi.","title":"Smarna hattuom","ref":"Isai. 44.6; 48.12; Kihil. 1.17; 22.13"},"9":{"text":"“Na nasepte, na gimgenthei thuohna leh na zawn dan, ka thei hi, hinanleh na hausa hi, tualeh Juda ka hi uh chia, lah hivawtloute Pasian gensietna ka thei hi, amaute Setan kikhopna inn ahi uhi."},"10":{"text":"Na hing thuoh ding silte bangma Gingsin, Ngai un ze-et a na um theina dingun dawimangpa’n na lah ua pawlkhat suongkul ah ahing khum dinga, ni sawm sung gimthuohna na nei ding uhi, shi tandongin ginum un, tuachi’n hinna manglukhu ka hing pe ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Hattuomte kunga Hagau thugen zahna ding bilnei taphot in za heh. Aguolzoupa khu shi nina suhnatin a um sih ding hi, achi hi.","ref":"Kihil. 20.14; 21.8"},"12":{"text":"“Pergamos hattuom vansawlsieng kungah tambangin gielin: Ama namsau alangni a tattuo hiemtah neipa’n tam thute agen hi.","title":"Pergamos hattuom"},"13":{"text":"“Na nasepte leh na tenna mun tua Setan toupha umna ka thei hi. Tualeh ka Min na pomdet a, Setan tenna na lah ua ka martar muonhuoi Antipas tha a a umlai in zong Kei nang gintatna na tawpsan sih hi."},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh demna themkhat ka hing nei hi, aziehpen Balaam thuhilna zuite tuanah na umpi a, ama’n Israel tate masangah kipat puana bawl ding leh, milim biehna kilan silte ne ding leh numei pasal kaal a thangtatnate bawl dingin Balak athu hil hi.","ref":"Kisim. 22.5,7; 31.16; Danp. 23.4; Kisim. 25.1-3"},"15":{"text":"Tuamabangin Nikolaitan pawlte thuhilna zuimi pawlkhat zong na nei a, tua khu ka huo hi."},"16":{"text":"Kisia in, tua ahisihleh na kungah kintahin kang pei dinga, ka kama pawt namsau in amaute ka dou ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Hattuomte kunga Hagau thugen zahna ding bil neitaphot in za heh. Aguolzoupa kungah manna phuolguh a neh ding ka pe ding hi. Tualeh suong kaang khat, atunga min tha kigiel, atangpa loungal midang Koima’n atheilou ka pe ding hi.","ref":"Pawt. 16.14,15; 16.33,34; Jn. 6.48-50; Isai. 62.2; 65.15"},"18":{"text":"“Thiatira hattuom vansawlsieng kungah tambangin giel in: Pasian Tapa meikuong bang mit neipa leh sum-eng nawt eng bang keng neipa’n tam thute a gen hi.","title":"Thiatira hattuom"},"19":{"text":"“Na nasepte, na itna, na naseppiehte, na ginnate leh na thuohhatnate ka thei hi; tualeh na silbawl masapen sangin anukhia pen atamzaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahivang in demna themkhat ka hing nei hi, aziehpen tuo numei Jezebel na awiam hi, amanu’n ama leh ama guolneinu ka hi. Kichiin, ka suohte numei pasal kaala thangtatna leh milim biehna silte ne dingin athuhil a, asolzou gawp hi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 16.31; 2 Leeng. 9.22,30"},"21":{"text":"Amanu a angkawmna apat kisia dingin hun ka pie a, hinanleh akisia sih hi."},"22":{"text":"Ngai in, amanu china lupna tung sena’n ka nei dinga, tualeh a angkawmpite zong, asilbawlte uh akisia sih u’leh, gimgenthei thuohna thupitah ah ka pailut ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tualeh atate shina in ka thatgam dinga, tualeh hattuom zousie in kei khu, lungsim leh lungtang enchienpa ka hi chi athei ding uhi. Tualeh noute na nasep dungzui un ka hing pe chiet ding hi.","ref":"Late. 7.9; Jer. 17.10; Late. 62.12"},"24":{"text":"Hinanleh Nang leh Thiatira khuo a um, tam kithuhilna zuiloute leh Setan thugil thuhtah, kichite thei nailou midang zousie kungah ka gen ahi, puohgih dang na tung uah ka hing guon sih ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Hinanleh ka hing pei masangsie’n na neisa u’khu tukip chinten un."},"26":{"text":"Tualeh aguolzoupa leh atawpdonga ka nasepte kemchingpa kungah, namte tunga thuneina ka pe ding hi.","ref":"Late. 2.8,9"},"27":{"text":"Aman sia chieng toh amaute vai ahawm dinga, belkhengpa belte aneng nenga akehzah dimdem bang ahi ding hi, tua thuneina pen ken zong Ka Pa akipat ka mu bangin ka pe ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualeh ama kungah zingsol aasi zong ka pe ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Hattuomte kunga Hagau thugen zahna ding bil nei taphot in za heh."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Sardis hattuom vansawlsieng kungah tambang in giel in: “Pasian Hagau sagi leh aasi sagi neipa’n tam thute agen hi. Na nasepte ka thei hi, Ahing min na puo a, hinanleh ashi na hi.","title":"Sardis hattuom"},"2":{"text":"Khanglou inlen, shi dihdih a um nalaite suhat in, aziehpen Pasian mai ah na nasep abukim in ka mu sih hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaziehin na mudan leh na zahdan theizing inlen, tukip inlen, kisia in. Tuaziehin na kiven sih leh, guta bangin na kungah ka hing pei ding a, bangchih hun a hing tung ding ka hiei na theisih ding hi.","ref":"Mat. 24.43,44; Luk. 12.39,40; Kihil. 16.15"},"4":{"text":"Hinanleh Sardis ah apuonte uh subualou min tawmnoukhat na nei hi, tualeh amaute kei toh puon vam sil in aleeng ding uhi, aziehpen tuabang a umtah ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Aguolzoupa’n puon vamte asil dinga, tualeh amin khu hinna laibu apat nawtmang ahi sih ding hi, hinanleh ka Pa mai leh vansawlsiengte mai ah, amin ka puongkhe ding hi.","ref":"Pawt. 32.32,33; Late. 69.28; Kihil. 20.12; Mat. 10.32; Luk. 12.8"},"6":{"text":"Hattuomte kunga Hagau thugen zahna ding bil nei taphot in za heh, achi hi."},"7":{"text":"“Philadelphia hattuom vansawlsieng kungah tambangin giel in: Ama Asiengthoupa leh Adihpa, Ama David sawhehna neipa, ahon chienga koiman akha theilou, akha chieng a koiman ahon theiloupa’n tam thute agen hi.","title":"Philadelphia hattuom","ref":"Isai. 22.22; Job. 12.14"},"8":{"text":"“Na nasepte ka thei hi, na masangah koima kha theilou kot kihongsa’n ka koi hi, aziehpen thahatna neunoukhat na nei a, ka thu na kemden a, tualeh ka min na kitheimawbawl sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Ngai in, Setan kikhopna inn a mi, Judami ka hi, chia lah hivawtlou, zuou gente, ngai in, na mai ah kang peisah dinga na kengbul ah ka hing besah ding a, nang ka hing it chi ka theisah ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 49.23; 60.14; Isai. 43.4"},"10":{"text":"Kukal dinga ka hing thupieh na zui zing zieh in, leitung pumpi a mi umte ze etna hing tung pai ding, ahing tun hun chieng in, ken zong ka hing kembit ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ngai in, hing pei pai ding ka hi, na manglukhu koima’n ahing lahpieh louna dingin na neisa kembit in."},"12":{"text":"Aguolzoupa khu, Ka Pasian bieh inn ah suutpi in ka pangsah ding a, apawtdoh nawn sih ding hi, tualeh atungah ka Pasian min leh ka Pasian khopi Jerusalem tha min ka giel ding a, tua khopi pen vana Ka Pasian a kipata hing kumsuh ahia, atungah ka mintha ka giel ding hi.","ref":"Kihil. 21.2; Isai. 62.2; 65.15"},"13":{"text":"Hattuomte kunga Hagau thugen zahna ding bil neitaphot in za heh, achi hi."},"14":{"text":"“Laodisia hattuom vansawlsieng kungah tambangin giel in: Amen, Aginumpa leh Adihtah theipipa, Pasian silsiem kipatnapain tam thute agen hi.","title":"Laodisia hattuom","ref":"Thu. 8.22"},"15":{"text":"“Na nasepte ka thei hi; lum lah lumlou, vawt lah votlou a na um pen, na lum leh lum vanglah in, na vawt leh vawt vanglah lachin ka dei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuachia lumsim pelpul a, lumlah lumlou, vawt lah votlou a, na umziehin ka kam a kipat in ka hing sekhe ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen, Nangman ka hauta, ka neizouta a, bangma ka tasam sih na chi hi, hinanleh mi genthei, hepihuoi, tasam, mitto leh guohtang, na hi lam na kithei sih hi."},"18":{"text":"Na hing hausat theina dingin, sana mei a kihal siengset leh na guohtang zumhuoina dohlouna dinga na sil ding puon vam leh na muthei na dinga na mit a na nu ding, mitnalou ka kunga pat lei dingin ka hing deisah hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka itte ka phawhhil a, ka thunun hi, tuaziehin phatuomngai inlen, kisia in.","ref":"Thu. 3.12; Heb. 12.6"},"20":{"text":"Ngai in, kotkha bul a dingin kot ka kiu hi, mi Koipou in ka aw azah a, kot ahon leh a kungah ka lut ding a, ama toh nitah ann kane khawm ding a, tualeh aman zong kei toh ane ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Aguolzoupa khu ka kungah, Ka mangtoupha ah ka tousah dinga, Kei zong ka guolzaw a Ka Pa toh aleengtoupha a ka tou mabangin."},"22":{"text":"Hattuomte kunga Hagau thugen zahna ding bil nei taphot in za heh, chi in,” achi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte nuain ka en a, En vawi, van ah kot akihonga, tualeh ka aw zahmasah pen pengkul ging bangin kei ahing houpi a, “Tam langah hing peitou in, tunua chieng a sil hing um dingte, ka hing musah ding hi,” achi hi.","title":"Pasian mangtoupha"},"2":{"text":"Thakhat in Hagau in ka dimta a; tualeh Ngai vawi, van ah mangtoupha khat akidaw a, tua mangtoupha tungah Mi khat atou hi.","ref":"Ezek. 1.26-28; 10.1"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh tuana toupa pen Jasper leh Sardius suongmantam bangin akilanga, tua mangtoupha kimvel ah, Emerald suongmantam banga kilang sakhituihup azam hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua mangtoupha kimkot ah, mangtoupha sawmni leh li a um a, tualeh tua touphate tungah upa sawmni leh li puom vam sil a tou ka mu a, amauten sana lukhu alutung uah akhuh uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tua mangtoupha apat in, tunphete, vanpi gingte, awte ahing pawt hi. Tua leh tua mangtoupha mai ah, meivah sagi akuong a, tuate khu Pasian Hagau Sagite ahi uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 19.16; Kihil. 8.5; 11.19; 16.18; Ezek. 1.13; Kihil. 1.4; Zek. 4.2"},"6":{"text":"Tua mangtoupha masangah Kristal banga sieng tui himlang kuongpi a um hi. Tualeh tua mangtoupha laikim leh mangtoupha kimkot ah mailam leh nualam mit a dim silhing li a um uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 1.22; Ezek. 1.5-10; 10.14"},"7":{"text":"Silhing khatna pen humpibahnei toh akibanga, silhing nina pen bawngnou toh akibang hi, tualeh silhing thumnain mihing maitang bang maitang anei a, silhing lina pen mupi leenglai a bang hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua silhing liten ha guh chiet anei ua, tua hate asunglam leh akimvel ah mit in adim a Amauten sun le zan tawlngalouin: “Siengthou, Siengthou, Siengthou Mangpa Pasian bangkimbawlthei, Umsa leh umlel leh hing Umdingpa ahi,” achi uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 1.18; 10.12; Isai. 6.2,3"},"9":{"text":"Tua silhing liten mangtoupha tunga toupa, kumtawn kumtawn a hingzingpa kungah, thupina leh pahtawina pie a kipahthu agen tahchieng un,"},"10":{"text":"Upa sawmni leh lite khu tua mangtoupha tunga toupa mai ah abohkhup ua, kumtawn kumtawn a hingzingpa khu abie ua, tualeh tua mangtoupha mai ah alukhute koi in,"},"11":{"text":"Aw Mangpa Nangpen, “Thupina leh pahtawina leh, thuneina tang taah na hi. Aziehpen Nang bangkim na siema, Nangma deina banga siem leh, um ahi uh,” achi uhi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh Ama mangtoupha tunga toupa zietlam ah, asunglam leh apulam a kigiel chiemtena sagi a kichiemte laibuziel khat ka mu hi.","title":"Belamnou leh laibuziel","ref":"Ezek. 2.9,10; Isai. 29.11"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng hattah khat, aw ngaitah a kikouin, “Koi ahiei laibuziel khu honga, tua chiemtenate pheltaah, chi ka mu hi.”"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh van ah hiin, leitungah hileh ahisihleh leinuoi ah hitaleh, tua laibuziel hong thei leh en thei mi koima a um sih hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua laibuziel hong ding leh sim ding ahiei ahisihleh en taah koima akimulou ziehin ha ka in ka kap hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n upate lah a khat in ka kungah, “Kap sin; En vawi, Juda nam humpibahnei, David zungpi in tua laibuziel hong ding leh tua chiemtena sagite phel dingin aguolzouta hi,” ahing chi hi.","ref":"Siem. 49.9; Isai. 11.1,10"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh ka en a, Ngai vawi, mangtoupha leh silhing lite lai ah leh upate lai ah, thasa hileh kilawm, Belamnou, kii sagi leh mit sagi nei, ding ka muta a, tua silte khu Pasian Hagau sagi, leitung pumpi a sawldohte ahi uhi.","ref":"Isai. 53.7; Zek. 4.10"},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n Ama ahing pei a; mangtoupha tunga toupa khut zietlam a laibuziel khu alata hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua laibuziel khu alah tahin silhing lite leh upa sawmni leh lite khu Belamnou masangah abohkhup ua, amauten kaiging khat chiet leh gimnamtui a dim sana hengkuong khat atawi chiet ua, tua khu misiengthoute thungetnate ahi.","ref":"Late. 141.2"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh amauten la tha khat asa ua, “Nangpen laibuziel la a, tua chiemtenate phel taah na hi; aziehpen thain na um a, Pasian adingin chi chin, ham chin, mi chin, namchin, lah a kipat koute na sisan in, na hing tanta hi,","ref":"Late. 33.3; 98.1; Isai. 42.10"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh i Pasian ua dingin leengte, leh siempute in na hing siemta hi, tualeh leitungah vai ihawm ding uhi.”","ref":"Pawt. 19.6; Kihil. 1.6"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka en a, mangtoupha leh silhingte leh upate kimkot ah vansawlsieng tampite aw ka za a, atamdan uh pen tul sawm mun tul sawm leh atul atul tampi ahi uhi.","ref":"Dan. 7.10"},"12":{"text":"Aw ngaitah in, “Tha a um Belamnou khu, Thuneinate hausatnate pilnate, thahatnate, pahtawinate, thupinate leh guolzawlnate, tangtaah ahi,” achi uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tualeh vantunga um, leitunga um, lei nuoia um leh tuipi sunga um, silsiem chintengin Mangtoupha tunga toupa leh Belamnou kungah; “Guolzawlnate, pahtawinate, thupinate, thuneinate, kumtawn kumtawn in umzingta hen,” achi uh ka za hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n silhing liten, “Amen” achi uhi. Tualeh upa sawmni leh liten, khupboh in, Ama kumtawn kumtawn a hing zingpa khu abeta uhi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n Belamnou in chiemtena sagite lah a khat aphel ka mu a, tualeh silhing lite lah a khat in vanpi ging banga ngai aw in, “Hing pei inlen hing en in,” ahing chi zong ka za hi.","title":"Chiemtena masa"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh ka et leh, Ngai vawi, Sakol kang khat ka mu hi. Tualeh atunga tuongpa’n thalpi khat atawia; tualeh akungah manglukhu khat akipie a, ama khu guolzou leh guolzou zel ding in akuonkheta hi.","ref":"Zek. 1.8; 6.3,6"},"3":{"text":"Belamnou in chiemtena nina aphel tahin, silhing nina in “Hing pei inlen, hing en in” achi ka za hi.","title":"Chiemtena nina"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh sakol dang meikuong banga san khat ahing pawtdoh a, atunga tuongpa kungah, leitung apat galmuonna alahmang theina ding leh mite khat leh khat kithatuo sah theina thuneina akipie a, tualeh namsau lienpi khat zong akipie hi.","ref":"Zek. 1.8; 6.2"},"5":{"text":"Belamnou in chiemtena thumna aphel laitahin, silhing thumna in, “Hing pei inlen, hing en in,” achi ka za hi. Tualeh ka et leh, Ngai vawi, sakol vom khat ka mu a; atunga tuongpa’n akhutin tena atawi hi.","title":"Chiemtena thumna","ref":"Zek. 6.2,6"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh silhing lite lah a kipat in aw khat in “Mangbu chin khat man khu makhai khat ahia, barli chin thum man khu makhai khat man ahi, tualeh sathau leh uoin pen suse sin achi hi ka za hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Tualeh Belamnou in chiemtena lina aphel laitah in, silhing lina in, “Hing pei inlen, hing en in” achi ka za hi.","title":"Chiemtena lina"},"8":{"text":"Tuachia ka et leh, Ngai vawi, sakol daang khat ka mu a, atunga tuongpa min khu Shina ahi a, tualeh mishikhuoin ama azui hi. Tualeh amaute kungah, namsau toh, kiel toh, shina toh, leitung gamsahangte, that dingin leitung seli suo sekhat tunga thuneina pieh ahi.","ref":"Ezek. 14.21"},"9":{"text":"Belamnou in chiemtena ngana ahon laitah in, Pasian thu zieh leh atheipina apom zieh ua tha a na umte hinna hagaute maitam nuoi a um ka mu hi.","title":"Chiemtena ngana"},"10":{"text":"Amaute aw ngaitah a kikou in, “Aw Mangpa Thuneina bukim neipa, Siengthou leh dih, bangtan ahiei leitunga tengte tunga vaihawmlou leh ka sisan phuba uh la lou a um ding na hiei?” achi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hagaute kungah puonvam khat chiet akipie a, tualeh amaute banga tha a hing um ding, asuoh hipite u’leh a unaute uh akim masangsie, na ngah nalai tadi dinga hilin a um uhi."},"12":{"text":"Belamnou in chiemtena guhna aphel laitah in ka et leh, Ngai vawi, ziil nasatah in akilinga, tualeh ni khu samul sai ip puon bangin ahing vomta a, hapi khu sisan bangin ahing umta hi.","title":"Chiemtena guhna","ref":"Kihil. 11.13; 16.18; Isai. 13.10; Joel. 2.10,31; 3.15; Mat. 24.29; Mak. 13.24,25; Luk. 21.25"},"13":{"text":"Van a aasite khu theipi kung huipi hattahin a sem a, aga nuhkhiatte apul bangin leitung ah akie uhi.","ref":"Isai. 34.4"},"14":{"text":"Van khu laibuziel, kizielbei bangin amangta a muol leh taang leh tulaisie gam chinteng a umna mun ua kipat suon mangin a umta uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 16.20"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh leitung leengte leh, mithupite, mi hausate, galkap lamkai liente, mi hatte, tualeh saltang leh zalen mi zousie kohawm sung leh muol tunga suongpi kawmte ah akibuta uhi.","ref":"Isai. 2.19,21"},"16":{"text":"Muol leh taangte leh suongpite kungah, “Hing netkhum unlen, Ama mangtoupha tunga toupa mai a kipat leh Belamnou lungthahna apat in hing sel un!","ref":"Hos. 10.8; Luk. 23.30"},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen Ama lungthahna ni thupi hing tung ahita, koi ahiei dingzou ding?” achi uhi.","ref":"Joel. 2.11; Mala. 3.2"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte nua in, lei ning li a ding vansawlsieng li ka mu hi. Amaun leitung leh tuipi tung ahisihleh singkung mawngmawng tunga laang lou dingin leitung hui lite atutang uhi.","title":"Israel mi 144,000 chiemte a umna","ref":"Jer. 49.36; Dan. 7.2; Zek. 6.5"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng dang khat, suolam akipata hing peitou, Pasian hing chiemtena nei khat ka mu hi. Ama’n, leitung leh tuipi suhsietna ding thuneina kipie vansawlsieng lite kungah aw ngaitah in akikou a;"},"3":{"text":"“I Pasian suohte talpanga chiemte na ikoi sieng zou masangsie, leitung leh tuipi ahisihleh singkungte suse sih un,” achi hi.","ref":"Ezek. 9.4,6"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh chiemte a umte phaza ka za a; Israel tate nam zousie apat tul za khat tul sawmli leh tul li, chiemte ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Juda nam apat tul sawm leh tul ni, chiemte ahi; Reuben nam apat tul sawm leh tulni, chiemte ahi; Gad nam apat tul sawm leh tul ni, chiemte ahi;"},"6":{"text":"Asher nam apat tul sawm leh tulni, chiemte ahi; Naphtali nam apat tul sawm leh tul ni, chiemte ahi; Manasseh nam akipat tul sawm leh tul ni, chiemte ahi;"},"7":{"text":"Simeon nam akipat tul sawm leh tul ni, chiemte ahi; Levi nam akipat tul sawm leh tul ni, chiemte ahi; Issakar nam akipat tul sawm leh tul ni, chiemte ahi;"},"8":{"text":"Zebulun nam akipat tul sawm leh tul ni, chiemte ahi; Joseph nam akipat tul sawm leh tul ni, chiemte ahi; Benjamin nam akipat tul sawm leh tulni, chiemte ahi;"},"9":{"text":"Tam silte nua a ka et leh, Ngai vawi, mipi tampitah koima simsenglou, nam zousie, chi chin, michin leh ham chin apat puon vam sil a, akhut ua tum sing bate, tawi a mangtoupha leh Belamnou mai a ding ka muta hi.","title":"Jentel mi tampite"},"10":{"text":"Amaute aw ngaitahin akikou ua; “Hundam na khu Mangtoupha tunga tou, I Pasian u’leh Belamnou a ahi,” achi uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh vansawlsiengte zousie khu, mangtoupha leh upate leh silhing lite kimkot ah ading ua tualeh mangtoupha mai a khupboh a pua in,"},"12":{"text":"“Amen, guolzawlnate, thupinate leh pilnate, kipahthugennate leh pahtawinate, thuneinate leh thahatnate, i Pasian kungah kumtawn kumtawnin um zingta hen. Amen,” chiin Pasian abie uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n upate laha khat in kei ahing houpi a, ka kungah, “Tam puon ngou silte koite ahi uoi? Tualeh hei a kipata hing pei ahi uoi?” chi’n ahing donga,"},"14":{"text":"Tualeh ken akungah, “Pu aw Nangman na thei hi,” ka chi hi. Tuachi’n Aman ka kungah, “Tamte khu gimthuohna thupitah akipat a hing pawtdohte ahi ua, apuonte uh Belamnou sisan a sawpa ngousahte ahi uhi.","ref":"Dan. 12.1; Mat. 24.21; Mak. 13.19"},"15":{"text":"Tuaziehin amaute Pasian mangtoupha mai a um in, A biehinn ah sun leh zan in Ana asem uhi. Tualeh Ama mangtoupha tunga toupa khu alah uah ateng ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Agil uh akiel ngai nawn sih ding a, adangta ngai nawn sih ding uhi, Nisa in amaute aka nawn sih dinga, asatna zong athuoh kha nawn sih ding uhi.","ref":"Isai. 49.10"},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen mangtoupha laikimtah a, Belamnou khu amaute chingpa ahita dinga, hinna tuinahte ah apui ding hi. Tualeh Pasian in amit ua kipat ahituite, uh anot hul pieh ding hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Late. 23.1; Ezek. 34.23; Late. 23.2; Isai. 49.10; Isai. 25.8"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Belamnou in chiemtena sagina aphel laitah in, naikal kimkhat sung van asip dide hi.","title":"Chiemtena sagina"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian mai a ding tua vansawlsieng sagite ka mu a, tualeh akung uah pengkul sagi akipie hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng dang khat ahing pei a, gimnamtui halna sana belkuong tawi in, maitam mai ah ading hi. Tualeh ama kungah, Mangtoupha mai a sana maitam tunga, misiengthoute thungetna toh alat khawm dingin gimnamtui tampi akipie hi.","ref":"Amos. 9.1; Pawt. 30.1,3"},"4":{"text":"Tua vansawlsieng khut a kipat in gimnamtui khu leh misiengthoute thungetna Pasian mai ah azamtou hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng in gimnamtui hal na belkuong ala a, maitam akipat mei aluoh dim a, leitungah athe suhta hi. Tuabep in, husate, vanpigingte, Temple leh zil lingte ahing umta hi.","ref":"Siempu. 16.12; Ezek. 10.2; Pawt. 19.16; Kihil. 11.19; 16.18"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua vansawlsieng sagi pengkul sagi tawite khu amutging dingin akisa uhi.","title":"Pengkul khatna"},"7":{"text":"Vansawlsieng khat na in amutta a; Giel leh mei sisan toh kihal in azuita a, tuate khu leitungah akipaikhe suh a, sing kungte sethum suo sekhat akatumta a, hampa hing zousie akatumta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 9.23-25; Ezek. 38.22"},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n Vansawlsieng nina in amutta a; Muol lienpi mei a kaa hileh kilawm, bang ahiei khat tuipi sunga pailut in auma; tualeh tuipi sethum suo sekhat sisan asuohta hi,","title":"Pengkul nina"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh tuipi a um ganhingte sethum suo sekhat ashita a, tualeh tembawhte sethum suo sekhat suhsiet ahita hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng thumna in amutta a, van akipat aasi lienpi khat meisel banga kuong ahing kesuh a, luidungte sethum suo sekhat leh tuinahte tungah atu hi,","title":"Pengkul thumna","ref":"Isai. 14.12"},"11":{"text":"Tua aasi min khu Gamsai ahi, tualeh tuite sethum suo sekhat akhasahta a, tua tui akipat mi tampi asihta uhi, khatsah ahi tahziehin.","ref":"Jer. 9.15"},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng lina in amutta a, ni sethum suo sekhat, hapi sethum suo sekhat aasite sethum suo sekhat, suhsietin a umta, tuachi’n tuate sethum suo sekhat suhsiet a mielsah ahita a, sun sethum suo sekhat ataangta sih a, tuamabangin zan zong a um hi.","title":"Pengkul lina","ref":"Isai. 13.10; Ezek. 32.7; Joel. 2.10,31; 3.15"},"13":{"text":"Tuachia ka et leh vanlai zawl a leeng vansawlsieng khat in aw ngaitah in, “Tunggih! tunggih! tunggih! vansawlsieng um nalai thumte pengkul mut ding ziehin, leitung a tengte tung agih hi!” achi ka za hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng ngana in amut a, aasi khat van akipat leitunga kesuh ka mu a, tualeh akungah kokhuh tobei chabi pieh in a um hi.","title":"Pengkul ngana"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh aman kokhuh tobei ahonga, tuachi’n tua kokhuh a kipat in haltuina mei phuolpi khu bangin meikhu akitungtou hi; tua kokhuh meikhu in ni leh van amiel sahta hi.","ref":"Siem. 19.28"},"3":{"text":"Tua meikhu laha kipat in khauphe leitungah ahing pawtdoh a Ama-ute kungah leitung a mom aite silbawltheina bangbang, silbawltheina pieh ahi uhi.","ref":"Pawt. 10.12-15"},"4":{"text":"Amaute khu atalpang ua Pasian chiemtena neilou mite chilou, leitunga hampa ahiei, loupa hing ahiei, ahisihleh singkung mawngmawng suse lou dinga thupieh ahi uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 9.4"},"5":{"text":"Amaute tha theina thuneina pieh ahi sih ua, hinanleh ha nga sung sugenthei dinga hil ahi ua, a suhgentheina pen mom ai in mi akei chieng a anat bang ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ni chiengin miten shina a sui ding ua, amu sih ding uhi; shi a ut ding ua, hinanleh shina in amauh ataimangsan ding hi.","ref":"Job. 3.21; Jer. 8.3"},"7":{"text":"Tua khauphete mel puohdan khu galdou dinga kiguongsa sakolte bang ahi ua, alutung uah sana a kibawl hileh kilawm manglukhu akhu ua, a mai uh mihingte mai abang hi.","ref":"Joel. 2.4"},"8":{"text":"Amaun numei sam bang sam anei ua, aha ukhu humpibahnei ha abang hi.","ref":"Joel. 1.6"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh amaun sia awmphaw bang awmphaw anei ua, tualeh ahazap ging uh, kidou dinga tai sakolleng tampi ging bang ahi.","ref":"Joel. 2.5"},"10":{"text":"Amaun mom ai meibang mei anei ua, ameite uah gu a um hi, athuneina u’khu ha nga sung mihingte suhgentheina ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amaun tua kokhuh tobei vansawlsieng khu leengpa in anei uhi, Amin khu Hebru ham in Abaddon ahia, Greek ham in Apollion akichi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tunggihna khat a beita. Ngai un, tam silte nua chiengin tunggihna ni ahing tung ding a um nalai hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng guhnain amut a: Pasian mai a um sana maitam kii lite akipat in aw khat ka za a,","title":"Pengkul guhna","ref":"Pawt. 30.1-3"},"14":{"text":"Tua aw in, Pengkul tawi vansawlsieng guhna kung ah, “Euphrates luipi lien a vansawlsiengli hensa a kikoite hadohin” achi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua vansawlsieng lite pen, anaikal, ani, aha leh akum huntah a mihingte zousie sethum suo sekhat that dinga mansa a kikoite hakhiet ahita uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua sakol tungtuong galkap honte tamdan tul mun tul za ni, ahi uh chi amauh phaza ka za hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Mengmuna ka mu sakolte tambang ahi uhi: Tua sakol tungtuong te’n, meikuong banga san leh dumsan tualeh kaat banga eng awmphawte anei uhi, tua sakolte lutangte khu humpibahnei lutangte bang ahi."},"18":{"text":"Akamsung ua kipata hing pawt tam gawtna hipi thumte, mei leh meikhu leh kaat in mihing zousie sethum suo sekhat athatta hi."},"19":{"text":"Aziehpen tua sakolte silbawltheina khu akam sung u’leh amei ua um ahia, amei ukhu gul bang ahi, tualeh lutangte anei ua, tuate in mite asugenthei uhi."},"20":{"text":"Tam natna gawtna hite a shilou mihing um nalai teng lah, dawite leh mu lah mutheilou, zah lah zatheilou, pei lah peitheilou, sana milimte leh sing milimte abieh louna ding ua, akhut ua asilbawlte uh tawpsan dingin akisia tuom sih uhi.","ref":"Late. 115.4-7; 135.15-17; Dan. 5.23"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh atuolthana u’leh, dawithu a amibumna u’leh, numei pasal kaal a athangtatna u’leh aguhtatna ua kipat in zong akisia tuom sih uhi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tualeh ahat mama vansawlsieng dang khat meilum puon a silin van a kipat a hing peisuh ka mu hi. Alutungah sakhituihup khat a um a, amaitang ni bang ahi a, tualeh akengte meikuong khuom bang ahi.","title":"Vansawlsieng leh laibuneu"},"2":{"text":"Aman akhut in akiphensa laibu neu khat atawi hi. Tualeh akeng zietlam in tuipi tung atuon a, akeng veilam in leitung atuon hi,"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ama khu humpibahnei hawh bangin aw ngaitahin akikou hi. Tualeh akikou laitahin vanpiging sagiten aw asuota uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh vanpiging sagiten a aw uh asuotah un, giel dingin ka kisata a, hinanleh van akipat aw khat in ka kungah, “Vanpiging sagite thugente imchinten inlen giel sin,” hing chi’n ka za hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuipi tung leh leitung tuon a ding vansawlsieng ka mu pen in, akhut zietlam vanlam ah atungtou a,","ref":"Pawt. 20.11; Danp. 32.40; Dan. 12.7; Amos. 3.7"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh kumtawn kumtawn a hing zingpa, van leh asunga sil umte, leitung leh asunga sil umte, tuipi leh asunga sil umte, siempa min in akichiem a: Ahun sawtnawn lou ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hinanleh vansawlsieng sagina aw gin lai nite a, pengkul amut dingkuon chiengin, Pasian thuguh kiphuol khu asuoh guolneite kunga ana gensa bangin atungkimta ding hi, achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n van a kipat a aw ka zah pen in, Kei ang houpi kia a, “Pei inlen tuipi leh leitung tuon a ding vansawlsieng khuta laibu neu phensa a um, va la in,” ahing chi hi.","ref":"Ezek. 2.8—3.3"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng kungah ka vapei a, akungah laibu neu khu Kei hing piein ka vachi a, tualeh Aman ka kungah, “La inlen, nein, Laibu in na gilpi akhasah dinga, hinanleh na kam ah pen khuoizu bangin ahum ding,” ahing chi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua vansawlsieng khut a pat in laibu neu ka la a, ka neta hi, tualeh tami ka kam ah khuoizu bangin ahum hi. Hinanleh ka neh zouin ka gilpi akhata hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, “Mi tampite, namte, hamte leh leengte mai ah Pasian thu genlawhna na gen kia ngeingei ding ahi,” ahing chi hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n tena chieng bang pumpeng khat ahing kipie a, tualeh vansawlsieng khu a dinga, ka kungah “Thou inlen, Pasian Biehinn leh maitam leh asunga, abemite te in.","title":"Theipimi nite","ref":"Ezek. 40.3; Zek. 2.1,2"},"2":{"text":"Hinanleh biehinn huong pulam pen nuasie inlen, te sin, tampen Jentelte kunga pieh ahita hi. Tualeh khopi siengthou khu amaun ha sawm li leh ha ni sung atuonden ding uhi.","ref":"Luk. 21.24"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh ka theipimi nite kungah silbawltheina ka pe dinga amaun sai ip puon silin ni tul khat zani leh sawmguh sung thu agen ding uhi.”"},"4":{"text":"Tamte khu leitung Pasian mai a ding Olive singkung nite leh meivah tunna nite ahi uhi.","ref":"Zek. 4.3,11-14"},"5":{"text":"Mi koipou in amauh suhnat asawm chiengun a kam ua kipat mei hing pawt in agalte uh akatum a; tualeh mi koipou in amauh asuhnat sawm u’leh tambanga tha ngei ngei ding ahi uhi."},"6":{"text":"Tam miten athugen hun sung ua guo azuh louna dingin van khahbing theina thuneina anei ua, tualeh tui sisan suohsah theina leh a ut hun hun ua, hii namkim a leitung gawt theina thuneina zong anei uhi.","ref":"1 Leeng. 17.1; Pawt. 7.17-19; 1 Sam. 4.8"},"7":{"text":"Amaun atheipina thu uh agen zou chiengun, kokhuh tobei a pat a hing pawttou gamsain amauh akidoupi dinga, azou dinga, tualeh athat ding hi.","ref":"Dan. 7.7; Kihil. 13.5-7; 17.8; Dan. 7.21"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh aluong u’khu hagau lam a Sodom leh Izipt kichi i Mangpa u’zong kilbeh a aumna khopi thupitah gawlzing ah alum ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 1.9,10"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n mipite leh phung chin, hamchin leh namchin a kipat miten, ni thum leh akim aluong uh a en ding ua, aluong u’khu vui ding aphal sih ding uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh leitunga tengte amauh tungah akipah ding ua, lungnopna abawl ding ua, silpiehte akihah tua ding uhi, aziehpen tam guolnei nite’n leitunga tengte ana bawlgenthei mama uhi."},"11":{"text":"Hinanleh ni thum leh akimkhat nuain, Pasian akipat hinna hagau asung uah alut a, akeeng un adingta ua; amute zousie tungah zauna nasatah atungta hi.","ref":"Ezek. 37.10"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh van a kipat a, aw ngaitah in amaute gel kungah, “Tam langah hing peitou un,” achi khu azata uhi. Tualeh amaute gel khu meilum lah ah van ah akaltouta uhi, amelmate un zong amauh amu uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 2.11"},"13":{"text":"Tua hun laitahin zil nasatah in alinga, khopi sesawm suo sekhat achimta hi, tua zilling ah mi tul sagi ashi ua, adangte azau mama ua, van Pasian kung ah thupina apeta uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 6.12; 16.18"},"14":{"text":"Tunggihna nina abeita a, ngai un, tunggihna thumna hing tung pai ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng sagina in apengkul amutta a, van ah aw ngaitahte aging a, “Leitung leenggamte khu i Mangpa leh Ama Khrist leenggam ahing hita a, Aman kumtawn kumtawnin vai ahawm ding hi.”","title":"Pengkul sagina","ref":"Pawt. 15.18; Dan. 2.44; 7.14,27"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian mai a amangtoupha ua tou upa sawmni leh lite khu khupboh in apua ua, Pasian abie ua,"},"17":{"text":"Aw Mangpa Pasian, Bangkimbawlthei, A um zing, aum lai leh ahing um dingpa, Na kungah “Kipahthu ka hing pie uhi. Aziehpen Nangman Na silbawltheina, thupitah na lata a vai nahawmta hi."},"18":{"text":"Namte alungthah ua, na thangpaina ahing tungta hi, mishite thu na khenpiehna ding leh, Na suoh guolneite leh misiengthoute leh, Na min giingte, milien leh mi neute kunga, kipahman na piehna hun leh, Leitung suse mite na suhsietna ding hun, ahing tungta hi;” achi uhi.","ref":"Late. 2.5; 110.5; Late. 115.13"},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n van ah Pasian biehinn akihongta a, tualeh Abiehinn sunga Athuhun bawm ahing kimu hi. Tualeh tunphiete, husate, van gingte, zilling leh giel nasatah ahing umta hi.","ref":"Kihil. 8.5; 16.18; Kihil. 16.21"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n van ah chiemtena lamdang tah ahing kilang a; numei khat Ni a kijem, akeng nuoi a hapi um, tualeh alutunga aasi sawm leh ni a kijem manglukhu khuin ahing um hi.","title":"Numei leh gulpi"},"2":{"text":"Amanu agailai ahi a, nau suoh dinga nauvei natna thuohin akikou hi."},"3":{"text":"Tualeh van ah chiemtena dang khat ahing kilanga, Ngai vawi, dragon san lienpi, lutang sagi leh kii sawmnei, tualeh manglukhu sagi khu ahing um hi.","ref":"Dan. 7.7"},"4":{"text":"Amei in van a aasi sethumsuo sekhat apaikhie a leitung sena’n anei hi. Tualeh anau ahing suoh hun hun a na valzou pai dingin dragon khu numei nausuoh ding nu mai ah ading hi.","ref":"Dan. 8.10"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh amanu’n ta pasal khat nam zousie tunga sia chieng a vaihawm ding khat ahing neikheta hi, tua naungeh pen Pasian leh amangtoupha ah lahtouin aumta hi.","ref":"Isai. 66.7; Late. 2.9"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n numei pen Pasian in mun abawlpiehna ah ni tul khat zani leh sawmguh sung kep ding in ataimangta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n van ah kidouna a um a: Mikael leh a vansawlsiengten dragon adou ua, tualeh dragon leh avansawltahten zong adou uhi.","title":"Van kidouna","ref":"Dan. 10.13,21; 12.1; Jud. 1.9"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh dragon leh avansawltahten a zou sih ua, amun u’zong van ah muin a um nawn sih hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n dragon lien khu paidohin aumta a, tua tanglai gulpi, dawimangpa leh Setan kichi leitung pumpi solpa khu leitunga paikhiet in a umta a, avansawltahte zong ama toh paikhiet in a umta uhi.","ref":"Siem. 3.1; Luk. 10.18"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n van ah aw ngaitah khat ka za a tua aw in: “Tuin i Pasian uh hundamna leh, thahatna leh leenggam leh, A Khrist thuneina ahing tungta hi; aziehpen isanggamte uh hehpa, paikhiet in a umta hi; Aman asun azanin amaute, i Pasian mai ah aheh hi.","ref":"Job. 1.9-11; Zek. 3.1"},"11":{"text":"Amauten Belamnou sisan leh atheipina, thute zieh in ama azouta ua, tualeh shitandongin ahinna uh, a it sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaziehin Aw nou vante leh, asunga tengte kipah un, Leitung leh tuipi a tengte tung agih hi, aziehpen hun tomnou khat, aneita chi athei ziehin, Dawimangpa lungthah sengsengin na kung uah, ahing pei suhta hi,” achi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n dragon in leitunga paikhiet ahi chi akithei tahin, tua numei tapa neinu agawtta hi.","title":"Leitunga kidouna"},"14":{"text":"Hinanleh tua numeinu gamdaia aumna ding mun a alenlut theina dingin, muvanlai lientah ha ni pieh ahi a, tua mun ah hun khat leh hunte leh hun kimkhat, tua gulpi muphah louna ah kepin a um hi.","ref":"Dan. 7.25; 12.7"},"15":{"text":"Tuachi’n gulpi in numeinu tui in atawmang sah theina dingin anua langah tuisanglet bangmai in akam apat tui aphitkhie hi."},"16":{"text":"Hinanleh leitungin numeinu apanpi a, leiin akam akaah a, tua dragon in akam apat aphitkhiet tuipi lien khu avalbeita hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualeh dragon khu numeinu tungah alungthah a, ahahasuonte, Pasian thupieh zuite leh Jesu Khrist theipina thu pom mite dou dingin akuonta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuachi’n dragon khu tuipi pieu ah, a ding hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n tuipi pieunel tungah ka dinga, tuipi akipat in gamsa khat lutang sagi leh kii sawm nei, tualeh akiite tunga manglukhu sawm nei, tualeh alutangte tungchiet ua Pasian gensiet na min nei hing pawtdoh ka muta hi.","title":"Tuipi apat gamsahangte muna","ref":"Dan. 7.3; Kihil. 17.3,7-12"},"2":{"text":"Tua ka gamsa mu khu gielbem abanga, akengte vompi keng abanga, akam humpibahnei kam bang ahi. Tualeh dragon in, asilbawltheina leh amangtoupha leh athuneina, tua gamsa kungah apie hi.","ref":"Dan. 7.4-6"},"3":{"text":"Alutangte lah a khat khu shipi tham aliem hileh kilawm in ka mu a, hinanleh shipi tham a aliemna khu ahing damta a, leitung pumpi in tua gamsa khu lamdangsa in azui uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n amaun tua gamsa kunga thuneina pepa dragon khu abie ua, gamsa zong abie ua, “Tam gamsa bang koi a um ei? Ama dou thei ding koi a um ei?” achi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh sil thupitahte genna ding leh Pasian gensietna ding kam akunga pieh ahia, tualeh ha sawmli leh hani sunga dingin thuneina pieh in a umta hi.","ref":"Dan. 7.8,25; 11.36"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Pasian gensietna leh, Amin leh abiehbuh leh van a umte gensietna in akam akaahta hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh akungah misiengthoute dou ding leh zou dingin phalna apeta hi. Tualeh phung chin, ham chin, leh nam chin, tunga thuneina pieh ahita hi.","ref":"Dan. 7.21"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh leitunga teng zousie, leitung siemchil a kipat a gawsa Belamnou hinna laibu a amin uh kigiellou poumain tua gamsa abe ding uhi.","ref":"Late. 69.28"},"9":{"text":"Mi koipou in bil aneileh za heh."},"10":{"text":"Koipou in mi sal a apuilut leh ama zong sal a puilut ahi dinga, Koipou in namsau a mi atha leh ama zong namsau a thain a um ding hi. Tanah misiengthoute kukalna leh ginna akilang hi.","ref":"Jer. 15.2; 43.11"},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamsa dang khat leitunga kipat hing pawtdoh ka mu a, aman belamnou bangin kii ni anei a, tualeh dragon bangin thu agen hi.","title":"Leitungakipat gamsa"},"12":{"text":"Aman gamsa masapen thuneina zousie amit mu in azang a, aman leitung leh asunga tengte zousie in, tua gamsa masa pen shina khop aliem damkia khu abesahta hi."},"13":{"text":"Aman chiemtena lamdang thupitahte abawla, mihingte mitmuin van a kipat mei nangawn akesuh sah hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua gamsa masapen mitmu a chiemtena lamdangte bawltheina akunga pieh a umte zang in, leitunga tengte kungah, namsau a satna maliem nei a hing nalai tua gamsa lim na bawl ding uh ahi, chiin leitunga tengte asolta hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh gamsa masapen lim kibawl a ham sah theina ding leh, gamsa lim be nuomloute atha theina dinga, gamsa lim kunga hinna hu pieh theina thuneina piehin a um hi."},"16":{"text":"Aman mi zousie aneu alien, azawng ahau, saltang leh noplen hitaleh, akhut zietlam uh ahiei, ahisihleh atalpang uah chiemtena abawlpieh chiet hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua chiemtena ahiei, gamsa min ahiei, ahisihleh amin nambat ahiei, neiloute poumain a leithei sih ding ua, azua thei sih ding uhi."},"18":{"text":"Tanah pilna apoimaw dan alang hi. Koipou theisiemna neiten gamsa nambat tuot heh, aziehpen mihing nambat ahi, anambat pen zaguh sawmguh leh guh ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n ka en a, Ngai vawi, Zion muol tunga Belamnou leh mi tulza leh tulsawmli leh tul li ding ka mua, atalpang chiet uah ama min leh Apa min chiet uh akigiel hi.","title":"Belamnou leh mi 144,000","ref":"Ezek. 9.4; Kihil. 7.3"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh van a kipat aw khat ka za a, tui tampi luong ging bang leh, vanpi ging ngaitah bang ahi a, tualeh kaiging tumte kaiging tumging bang zong ka za hi."},"3":{"text":"Amauten mangtoupha mai leh silhing lite leh upate mai ah la tha hileh kilawm khat asa ua, tua la tha pen, leitunga pat a tatsa tua tulza leh tulsawmli leh tullite chilou koiman athei thei sih uhi."},"4":{"text":"Tamte pen numei a kibuasahlou a kikem siengthoute ahi uhi. Tamte pen Belamnou apeina lam lam a zuite ahi uhi. Tamte pen mihingte lah a kipat a tatsa, Pasian ading leh Belamnou a dinga ga masapente ahi uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tualeh amaute kam ah zuouthu a um sih a, Pasian mangtoupha mai ah genbanglou in a um uhi.","ref":"Zeph. 3.13"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng dang khat, van kimlai a leeng ka mu a, aman leitunga teng nam chin, phungchin, ham chin leh mi chinte kunga gen ding kumtawn khantanhoi anei hi.","title":"Vansawlsieng thumte thuphuon"},"7":{"text":"Aw ngaitah a kikou in,” Pasian giing unlen, akungah thupina pie un, aziehpen Athukhenna hun ahing tungta hi; tualeh Ama lei leh van, tuipi leh tuinahte siempa khu bie un,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualeh vansawlsieng dang khat in azui a, “Achimta, achimta tua Babilon khopi thupi angkawm hatna thangpaina uoin nam zousie adawnsah ziehin,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 21.9; Jer. 51.8; Kihil. 18.2"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng dang athumna in amauh azui a, aw ngaitahin: “Mi koipou in tua gamsa leh alim abieh a, atalpang ahiei, akhut ahiei a chiemtena anei leh,"},"10":{"text":"Pasian thangpaina uoin, bangma toh hallou alungthahna nou a kisung adawn dinga, tualeh vansawltah siengthoute mitmu leh Belamnou mitmu ah mei leh kaata gawtna thuohsah ahi ding uhi.","ref":"Isai. 51.17; Siem. 19.24; Ezek. 38.22"},"11":{"text":"Tua agawtna uh meikhu khu kumtawn kumtawnin azamtou ding, tua gamsa leh alim bete leh amin chiemtena nei poumaten, sun leh zan in khawldamna amu sih uhi.”","ref":"Isai. 34.10"},"12":{"text":"Tanah Pasian thupieh zuite leh Jesu gingta misiengthoute kukalna akilang hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuachi’n van a kipat aw khat ka za a, ka kungah, “Giel in, tua kipat mishi, Mangpa a shite khu” “Ahampha uhi.” Hagau in, “Ahi, asepgimna ua kipat akhawldam theita ding uhi, anasepte un amauh ahing zui ding ziehin,” achi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachia ka et leh, Ngai vawi, meilum ngou leh tua meilum tunga Mihing Tapa bang Mi khat Alutunga sana manglukhu khuh a, akhut a kawite hiem tawi ka mu hi.","title":"Leitung bu lah hun","ref":"Dan. 7.13"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh vansawlsieng dangkhat Pasian biehinn a pat in ahing pawt a, “Aw ngaitah a kikouin meilum tunga toupa kungah, na kawite zang inlen, bu at in, nang a dingin bu at hun atungta hi, aziehpen leitung bu akuoita hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Joel. 3.13"},"16":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua meilum tunga toupa’n, leitung ah akawite apaikheta a, leitung bu khu at in a umta hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng dangkhat van a um biehinn apat in ahing pawt a, aman zong kawite hiem khat atawi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh vansawlsieng dang khat maitam a kipat in ahing pawt a, aw ngaitaha kikou in kawite hiem tawipa kungah, “Na kawite hiem zang inlen, leitunga grep ga bomte khawmin, aziehpen grep gate amin siengta hi,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsiengin leitungah akawite apaikheta a, leitunga grepte akhawma, tua khu Pasian lungthahna uoin suhna khuh thupitah sungah apailutta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tualeh uoin suhna khu khopi pulam ah akichil hi, tualeh uoin suhna akipat sisan sakol kamkaina tan dongin, lou chiing tul khat leh zaguh tandong aluong hi.","ref":"Isai. 63.3; Kaala. 1.15; Kihil. 19.15"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n van ah chiemtena thupi leh lamdang tah: Vansawlsieng sagi, gawtna nukhia sagi tawi ka mu a, tuate a Pasian thangpaina abukim taah ziehin gawtna nukhia ahita uhi.","title":"Hengkuong sagi muna"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh bang ahiei mei toh kihal himlang tuipi hileh kilawm, tualeh gamsa tung leh, alim tung leh, achiemtena tung leh, amin nambar tunga, guolzawna tangte, Pasian kaiging tawi a himlang tuipi tunga ding ka mu hi."},"3":{"text":"Amauten Pasian suoh Mosi la leh Belamnou la asa ua, Mangpa Pasian bangkimbawlthei, “Na silbawlte a thupiin a lamdang hi! Misiengthoute leengpa aw, Na lampite dihin atang hi.","ref":"Pawt. 15.1"},"4":{"text":"Koi in Nang hing giinglou in, Aw Mangpa, Na min apahtawilou ngam diei? Nang bou na hi asiengthou, Namte zousie ahing pei ding ua, Na mai ah ahing be ding uhi, Na vaihawmna dihte suhlat a aum taah ziehin;” achi uhi.","ref":"Jer. 10.7; Late. 86.9"},"5":{"text":"Tam silte zoua ka et leh, Ngai vawi, van ah theipina biehbuh kichi biehinnpi akihong hi.","ref":"Pawt. 38.21"},"6":{"text":"Tua biehinn a kipat in gawtna sagi tawi vansawlsieng sagi puon malngat siengthou leh vam sil in, tualeh a awm uh sana kawnggah a kigah ahing pawtdoh uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tuachi’n silhing lite lah a khat in, tua vansawlsieng sagite kungah, kumtawn kumtawna hing zing Pasian lungthahna a dim hengkuong sagi apeta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua biehinn khu Pasian thupina leh silbawltheina a hing kipan meikhu in adimta a, tualeh vansawlsieng sagite gawtna sagi khu atunkim masangsie tua biehinn sungah koima alut theita sih hi.","ref":"Pawt. 40.34; 1 Leeng. 8.10,11; 2 Khang. 5.13,14; Isai. 6.4"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua biehinn sunga kipat in aw ngaitah khat ka za a, tua aw in vansawlsieng sagite kungah, “Pei unlen, Pasian thangpaina hengkuongte leitungah sungkhie un,” achi hi.","title":"Hengkuong khatna"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng khatna apei a, ahengkuong leitungah asungkhie a, gamsa chiemtena neite leh alim bemite tungah himasie nasetah leh kidahhuoi ahing tungta hi.","ref":"Pawt. 9.10"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng nina in ahengkuong tuipi tungah asungkhie a, tua tuipi pen mishi sisan bang ahing suohta hi, tuachi’n tuipi a um hinna nei zousie ashita uhi.","title":"Hengkuong nina"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng thumna in a hengkuong luidungte leh tuinahte ah, asungkhie a; tuate sisan ahing suohta hi.","title":"Hengkuong thumna","ref":"Pawt. 7.17-21; Late. 78.44"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh tuite vansawlsiengin: “Aw Mangpa tambanga vai na hawm ziehin, Nang umzing leh umta leh, ahing um dingpa na dihtat ahi."},"6":{"text":"Aziehpen amauten misiengthoute leh, guolneite sisan ana suo ua, tualeh Nangman adawn dingun sisan na pie hi, dawn taah mawng ahi ziehun,” achi ka za hi."},"7":{"text":"Tualeh maitam a kipat in, aw dang khat in ana dawnga, “Ahi, Mangpa Pasian bangkimbawlthei na, vaihawmnate adih in adihtat hi,” achi ka za hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng lina in ahengkuong ni tungah asungkhie a, ama kungah mihingte mei a halgawp theina pieh ahi.","title":"Hengkuong lina"},"9":{"text":"Tualeh mite khu mei satah a haigawin aum ua, Tam gawtnate tunga thuneipa Pasian min agensie ua, tualeh Ama kunga thupina pe dingin akisia sih uhi."},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng ngana in ahengkuong gamsa toupha tungah asungkhie a, tuachi’n aleenggam khu ahing mielta a, tualeh amauten na asah sengziehin alei uh apet uhi.","title":"Hengkuong ngana","ref":"Pawt. 10.21"},"11":{"text":"Tua natna leh himate ziehin, van Pasian agensie ua, asilbawlte ua kipat akisia tuom sih uhi."},"12":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng guhna in, ahengkuong Euphrates luipi tungah asungkhie a, suolam leengte dinga lampi bawl ahi theina dingin tua lui tuite akang siengta hi.","title":"Hengkuong guhna","ref":"Isai. 11.15"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh u’keng toh kibang hagau bua thum, dragon kam a kipat leh gamsa kama kipan leh, guolnei tahlou kama kipat a hing pawt ka mu hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute pen bangkimbawlthei tua Pasian ni thupi a kidouna a pang thei dinga leitung pumpi leengte puikhawm dinga kuonkhie, sil lamdang bawl dawite hagau ahi uhi."},"15":{"text":"“Ngai vawi, guta bangin ka hing pei hi.
