Kigingsa leh puon tengsa a um mi ahampha hi, tuachilou in pen aguohtang in avah dinga azumhuoina amukha ding uhi.”","ref":"Mat. 24.43,44; Luk. 12.39,40; Kihil. 3.3"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh amaute khu Hebru ham a Armageddon kichi mun ah apuikhawm uhi.","ref":"2 Leeng. 23.29; Zek. 12.11"},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng saginain, ahengkuong huikhuo ah, asungkhie a, van a biehinn a kipat leh mangtoupha a kipat in, aw ngaitah ahing pawt a, “Bawlzou ahita,” achi hi.","title":"Hengkuong sagina"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh awte, tunphiete, leh vanpi gingte ahing um a, zil nasatah ahing linga, tambang zilling nasa leh thupi leitunga mihing aum akipat aumkha nai sih hi.","ref":"Kihil. 8.5; 11.13,19"},"19":{"text":"Tua khopi thupi khu sethum in akikhena, namte khopite achimta hi. Tualeh alungthahna uoin nou khu akunga pieh dingin Babilon khopi thupi khu Pasian masangah theidoh in a umta hi.","ref":"Isai. 51.17"},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n tui kuolkhum gam zousie ataimangta a, muol leh taangte mu in aum nawn sih hi.","ref":"Kihil. 6.14"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh van a kipat gielpi nasatah mihingte tungah akia a, gieltang chinteng talen khat a gih ahi. Tualeh miten giel a gawtna ziehin Pasian agensie uhi, aziehpen tua gawtna khu ahuoise sengseng hi.","ref":"Pawt. 9.23; Kihil. 11.19"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n hengkuong sagi tawi vansawlsieng sagite lah a khat a hing pei a, Kei ahing kihoupi a, ka kungah “Hing pei vawi, tui tampite tunga tou kizuanu thupitah tunga vaihawmna kang ensah ding;","title":"Gamsa tunga tuong numei","ref":"Jer. 51.13"},"2":{"text":"Leitunga leengten ama toh mawna thanghuoi abawl ua, tualeh a mawna thangtatna uoin leitunga teng mite dawn khamsah in a um uhi,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 23.17; Jer. 51.7"},"3":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman kei pen hagau in gamdai ah ahing pomangta hi. Tualeh numei khat Pasian gensietna minte a dim, lutang sagi leh kii sawm nei gamsa sandup tunga tou ka mu hi.","ref":"Kihil. 13.1"},"4":{"text":"Tua numei khu puon sandup leh san au in akijem a, sana leh suongmantam leh tuikepsuong a kijem in ahuasanna kidahhuoi leh athanghuoina nieh a dim sana nou khat akhutin atawi hi.","ref":"Jer. 51.7"},"5":{"text":"Tualeh atalpangah min khat: “THUGUH KIPHUOL BABILON THUPI”, “KIZUATE LEH LEITUNG SIL KIDAH HUOITENU”, chi akigiel hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua numei pen misiengthoute sisan leh Jesu martarte sisan dawnkhamin ka mu hi. Ama ka mu tahin lamdang leh chizat huoi kasa mama hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua vansawlsiengin ka kungah, “Bang dinga lamdang sa na hiei? Tua numei leh atuonna lutang sagi leh ki sawm nei gamsa thuguh kiphuol kang hil ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua gamsa na mu khu aumsa ahia, tu a umlou khu, kokhuh tobei apat ahing pawtdoh tou dinga, manthaina ah apei ding hi. Tualeh leitung siemchil a pat a hinna laibu a amin uh kigiellou, leitunga tengten tua gamsa umsa, umlou leh, hing um ding khu amu chiengun lamdang asa ding uhi.","ref":"Dan. 7.7; Kihil. 11.7; Late. 69.28"},"9":{"text":"Tami theina dingin pilna lungsim nei akisam hi. Tua lutang sagite pen numeinu touna muol sagite ahi ua,"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh leeng sagite ahi uhi, ngate apuata ua, khat a uma, adang khatpen ahing kilang nai tadi sih hi, ahing kilatchiengin tomnoukhat sung aum ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua gamsa umsa, tulai tah a umlou pen khu agietna ahi a, sagite lah a pang ahi a, manthaina ah apei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua kii sawm na mute khu leenggam nei nailou leeng sawmte ahi uhi; hinanleh amaun gamsa toh naikal khat sung leengte banga thuneina anei ding uhi.","ref":"Dan. 7.24"},"13":{"text":"Amaun kithutuoh tahin lungsim munkhat apuo ua, athuneina u’leh ahatna uh gamsa kungah ape ding uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tamten Belamnou akidoupi ding ua, Belamnou in amauh azou ding hi; aziehpen Ama pen mangpate Mangpa leh leengte Lengpa ahi, tualeh Ama toh umkhawmte pen hatte, telte leh ginumte ahi uhi.”"},"15":{"text":"Tualeh aman ka kungah, “Tua kizuanu touna tui tampi na mute khu, mite, mitampite, namte leh hamte ahi uhi."},"16":{"text":"Tua gamsa tunga kisawm na mute leh gamsain kizuanu amuda ding ua, asa ane ding ua, tualeh mei in ahaltum ding uhi."},"17":{"text":"Aziehpen Pasian thute suhtangtunga aum masangsie Ama tup leh ngimte abawl theina ding u’leh aleenggam uh gamsa kunga apieh theina ding un lungsim khat pua a kithutuohna lungsim Pasian in akoi zouta hi."},"18":{"text":"Tualeh tua numei na mu khu leitung leengte tunga vaihawm khopi thupitah khu ahi,” achi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte nua in vansawlsieng dangkhat silbawltheina thupitah nei a van a kipat hing kumsuh ka mu a, athupina in leitung ataanvah hi.","title":"Babilon khopi thupi puana"},"2":{"text":"Tualeh ama aw ngai theitawpin akikou a: “Achimta Babilon thupi khu achimta! dawite umna leh hagau gilou chinteng kulpi, asuohta, va sienglou leh kidahhuoi, chinteng bawm asuohta hi.","ref":"Isai. 21.9; Jer. 51.8; Kihil. 14.8; Isai. 13.21; Jer. 50.39"},"3":{"text":"Aziehpen nam zousiein ahuasanna, lungthahna uoin nou adawnta ua, leitung leengten ama toh ang akawmta ua, amanu noptatna ziehin leitunga, summet bawlte ahausa gawpta uhi;” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 23.17; Jer. 51.7"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n van akipat aw dangkhat ka za a, “Ka mite aw, amanu khelna a na pan khahlouna dingun leh amanu toh na thuohkhawm louna dingun, amanu apat hing pawtdohun.","ref":"Isai. 48.20; Jer. 50.8; 51.6,45"},"5":{"text":"Amanu khelnate van atungta a, Pasian in akhelnate athei zing hi.","ref":"Siem. 18.20,21; Jer. 51.9"},"6":{"text":"Amanu hing pieh bangbangin pekia unlen, anasep dungzuiin aleni in thuh un, azuchia halna nou ah, aleni in halpieh un.","ref":"Late. 137.8; Jer. 50.29"},"7":{"text":"Akithupisah dan leh anoptat dan, bangbangin bawlgenthei unlen, lunggimsah un, aziehpen amanu’n alungtangin, leengnu in ka tou a, meithai ka hi sih, ka lunggim ngai sih ding, achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 47.7-9"},"8":{"text":"Tuazhiehin ni khat thuin ama gawtna, shina, lusunna, leh kielna, ahing tung dinga, amanu meiin akatum ding hi. Aziehpen atunga vaihawmpa Pasian ahaat ahi,” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama toh angkawm leh anoptatpi leitung leengten amanu kihalna meikhu amu chiengun, akaa ding ua, asuun ding uhi.","title":"Leitungin Babilon sietna akaapi ding","ref":"Ezek. 26.16,17"},"10":{"text":"Amanu thuohgimna mu a chiza sengin gamla tah ah a ding ding ua: “Talawm de! talawm de! Babilon khopi thupi leh silbawltheitah khopi, naikal khat sunga na tunga vaihawmna ahing tun ta lawm!” achi ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tualeh leitunga summetbawlten amanu kaain asuun ding uhi; mi koima’n avanzuate uh alei nawnlou ding ziehun.","ref":"Ezek. 27.31,36"},"12":{"text":"Tua avanzuate uh pen, sanate, dangkate, suongmantamte, tuikepsuongte, puonmalngatte, puonsan dupte, puonnemte, puon sandangte, sing gimnamtui chinteng, saiha a kibawl van chi tuom tuomte, sing manpha tuomtuomte, sum-eng te, siate, suongkanga kibawl van chi tuomtuomte,","ref":"Ezek. 27.12,13,22"},"13":{"text":"Tualeh siingthalte, begawte, sathau namtuite, silgimnamtuite, zu leh sathaute, tangbuongte leh mangbute, gantate leh belamte, sakol leh sakollengte, salte leh mihing hinnate bang ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh “Na hinna in alunggul mama theigaten nang ahing nuasieta ua, tualeh sil tuituoh leh hoi zousiein nang ahing peimangsanta hi. Tamte na mu kia ngai nawn sih ding hi.”"},"15":{"text":"Tam siltea summetbawl mi, amanu zieha hing hausaten, amanu kibawlsietna chiza sengin gamlatah a dingin kap in amau ding ua;","ref":"Ezek. 27.31,36"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh, “Talawm de! talawm de! tua khopi thupi, puon malngat leh puonsandup leh puon sandang sil a, tualeh sana leh suongmantam leh tuikepsuonga kizem nu!"},"17":{"text":"Naikaal khat sung bep a tambang hausatna thupi bangmalou ahing suohtah mai,” achi uhi. Tualeh kuongpute leh, kuonga khuolzin mi zousie leh kuong hehte, tualeh tuipi tunga summet bawl zousiete gamlatah ah ading ua;","ref":"Isai. 23.14; Ezek. 27.26-30"},"18":{"text":"Tualeh amauten tua khopi katna meikhu amutahun akikoukhe ding ua, “Tambanga khopi thupi a um ngai amah?” achi uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 27.32"},"19":{"text":"Amaun alutung ua leivui kibuoh khumin kap leh mauin akikou ding ua; “Talawm de! talawm de! khopi thupi aw! Ama hausatna zieha tuipi a, kuong nei zousieten hausatna amuna khopi, naikal khat sungin suhsiet ahita hi, achi ding uhi, achi hi.","ref":"Ezek. 27.30-34"},"20":{"text":"Aw nang van amanu sietna tungah nuom in, Misiengthoute leh sawltahte leh guolneite nuom un, Pasian in amanu tungah na phuba uh ahing lahpiehta hi;” achi hi.","title":"Babilon siet zieha van kipahna","ref":"Danp. 32.43; Jer. 51.48"},"21":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng hattah khat in bu hehna suong lienpi bang suong khat adomtou a, tuipi sungah apailut a, “Khopi thupi Babilon, tambanga gumtah a paikhiet suh ahidinga, akimu kia nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Jer. 51.63,64; Ezek. 26.21"},"22":{"text":"Na sungah gawsem tumte leh lasiemte, theile tumte leh pengkul tumte a kipat ging kilawm kiza ngai nawnlou ding hi. Khut siem banglam poua khut siemmi mawngmawng na sungah akimu nawn sih ding hi. Na sungah buhehna ging akiza nawn sih ding hi.","ref":"Ezek. 26.13; Isai. 24.8; Jer. 7.34; 25.10"},"23":{"text":"Na sungah meivah ataang nawnsih dinga, mou leh mouneipa aw zong akiza nawn vawt sih ding hi. Na summetbawl mite, tam leitunga miliente ahi ua, Na bumsiemna a nam zousie sol a aumtahzieh un."},"24":{"text":"Tualeh asungah guolneite leh misiengthoute sisan leh leitunga tha a um zousete sisan muin aumta hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Jer. 51.49"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tam silte nua in van ah mipi tampi aw ngaitah ka za a, “Halleluijah, Hundamna leh thupina leh silbawltheina leh zatatna i Mangpa Pasian a ahi.","title":"Van a guolzawna leh Belamnou zineina"},"2":{"text":"Aziehpen avaihawmnate athudiha adihtat hi. Aman kizuanu thupi angkawmna a leitung susenu khu vai ahawm khumta a, asuohte sisan phuba amanu tungah alahpiehta hi.” Achi hi.","ref":"Danp. 32.43; 2 Leeng. 9.7"},"3":{"text":"Amaun, “Halleluijah tua khopi kihalna meikhu kumtawn kumtawnin azamtou hi,” achi kia uhi.","ref":"Isai. 34.10"},"4":{"text":"Tuachi’n upa sawmni leh lite leh silhing lite khupboh in apua ua, “Amen Halleluijah” chiin mangtoupha tunga toupa Pasian abeta uhi."},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n mangtoupha a kipat in aw khat ahing pawt a, “Nou Ama suohte zousie leh Ama giingte zousie alien aneu in i Pasian phat un,” achi hi.","ref":"Late. 115.13"},"6":{"text":"Tualeh mipi tampi aw ging bang leh tui tampi luong ging bang leh, vanpi ging nasatah bang ka zata a: “Halleluijah, Mangpa Pasian bangkimbawlthei in vai ahawm zieh in.","ref":"Ezek. 1.24; Late. 93.1; 97.1; 99.1"},"7":{"text":"Eite kipah in nuom vai, pahtawina Ama pe vai aziehpen Belamnou zinei hun ahing tungta hi, azi zong akisa zoudiemta hi.","title":"Belamnou zineina"},"8":{"text":"Amounu khu puon malngat siengthou leh vam a akizep ding phal ahi a, tua puon malngat khu misiengthoute dihtatna ahi;” achi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, “Giel in, Belamnou zineina annkuong im dinga chielte ahampha uhi” achi hi. Tualeh aman ka kungah, “Tamte Pasian thudihtahte ahi uh,” achi hi.","ref":"Mat. 22.2,3"},"10":{"text":"Tualeh ama be ding in akengbul ah ka puata hi. Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, “Tuabang bawl sin, Kei Jesu theipina kem na suoh hipipa leh na unaute laha khat ka hi bou hi Pasian bie in, aziehpen Jesu theipina khu thugentheina hagau ahi,” achi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n van kihong ka muta a, Ngai vawi, sakol kaang khat leh atunga tuongpa amin Ginum leh Thutah kichi ka mu a, Aman dihtatnain vai ahawm a, tualeh gal abawl hi.","title":"Khrist hing pei niveina","ref":"Ezek. 1.1; Late. 96.13; Isai. 11.4"},"12":{"text":"Amitte khu meikuong bang ahi a, alutungah manglukhu tampi a um hi. Ama loungal koima theilou min kigiel khat anei hi.","ref":"Dan. 10.6"},"13":{"text":"Aman sisan a kidiesa puontuol asila ama min khu Pasian Thu akichi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualeh van a um galkap hon in puon malngat ngou leh siengthou silin sakol kaang tunga tuong in Ama azui uhi."},"15":{"text":"Akama kipat in namsau hiemtah namte satna ding in ahing pawtdoh hi. Tualeh Ama mamain amauh tungah siachiengin vai a hawm ding hi. Ama mama in Bangkimbawlthei Pasian giinhuoina leh thangpaina uoin suhna khu atuonchilta hi.","ref":"Late. 2.9; Isai. 63.3; Joel. 3.13; Kihil. 14.20"},"16":{"text":"Tualeh Aman apuontuol tung leh a pheipi tungah “LENGTE LENGPA, MANGPATE MANGPA” chia kigiel min anei hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng khat Ni tunga ding ka mu a, tualeh ama aw ngaitah a kikou in, vanlaizawl a leeng vate kungah “Hing pei unlen, Pasian annkuongluina thupitah ah hing kikhawm un;","ref":"Ezek. 39.17-20"},"18":{"text":"Lengte sa, galkap lamkaite sa, mi hatte sa, sakolte sa leh atung ua tuongte sa, tualeh mi zousie, zalen leh saltang, alien leh aneu sa na neh theina dingun,” achi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua gamsa leh leitung leengte leh agalkap honte khu, tua sakol tunga tuongpa leh agalkap honte dou dinga hing kikhawm ka muta hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuachi’n gamsa khu mat in aumta a, tualeh guolnei tahlou gamsa chiemtena neite leh, alim bete asolna a, amasanga chiemtena lamdang bawlpa zong ama toh mat khawm in a umta a, tamte gel pen ani un, kaat meidil ah ahinga pailut in a umta uhi.","ref":"Kihil. 13.1-18"},"21":{"text":"Tualeh adang teng pen, tua sakol tunga tuongpa kam a kipata hing pawt namsau a thain a umta uhi. Tualeh tungleeng vate zousie amaute sain agilvata uhi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng khat van a kipata hing kumsuh, akhut a kokhuh tobei chabi leh khainieng lienpi tawi ka mu hi.","title":"Kum sangkhat sung Setan henna"},"2":{"text":"Aman tua dragon thupi, nidanglai gulpi aman a, kum tul khat sunga dingin ahenta hi.","ref":"Siem. 3.1"},"3":{"text":"Kum tul khat achin masangsie a, namte asol kia nawnlouna dingin kokhuh tobei ah a pailut a, akha khum a, asindetta hi. Tam silte nua chiengin ama pen hun tomkhat sung hakhiet ahi ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tualeh mangtouphate leh atunga toute ka mua, akung uah vaihawmna pieh ahi a, tualeh Jesu thu theipina zieh leh, Pasian thu zieha alutang uh tan a um, gamsa leh alim bengailou, atalpang u’leh akhut ua zong chiemtena nei ngailoute hagau te ka mu a, amaute ahing hing ta ua Khrist toh kum sang khat vai ahawm uhi.","title":"Kum tul vaihawmna","ref":"Dan. 7.9,22"},"5":{"text":"Hinanleh mishi dangte pen kum tul khat abei masangsie ahing kia sih uhi. Tam pen thawkiana masa pen ahi."},"6":{"text":"Thawkiana masapen a pang mite ahampha leh asiengthou ahi uhi. Tuabang mite tungah shi ninain thuneina anei sih a, hinanleh amaute pen Pasian leh Khrist siempute ahi ding ua, Ama toh kum tul khat vai ahawm ding uhi."},"7":{"text":"Tua kum tul khat abei chiengin Setan khu ataanna apat hakhietin a um dinga,","title":"Setan hadohna leh kidouna tawpna"},"8":{"text":"Tualeh akuonkhe ding ua, leitung ning li a kipat namte Gog leh Magog asol ding ua kidouna a pang dingin apuikhawm ding uhi. Amaute tamdan tuipi pieu a pieunel bang ahi uhi.","ref":"Ezek. 7.2; Ezek. 38.2,9,15"},"9":{"text":"Amaute leitung vailam daapsuohin akuontou ua, misiengthoute giehphuol leh khopi deiumtah khu a imta uhi. Tuachi’n Pasian akipan in, van a kipat in meikuong ahing kesuh a amaute akatumta hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh amauh solpa dawimangpa khu, tua gamsa leh guolnei tahlou kipailutna kaat leh meidil sunga pailut ahita uhi. Amaute tuanah kumtawn kumtawn in sun leh zan a thuoh in a umden ding uhi."},"11":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangtoupha vam velvol thupitah khat leh atunga toupa, amai akipata lei leh van taimang ka mu hi. Ama ua dingin mun aum nawn mawngmawng sih hi.","title":"Mangtoupha vam a vaihawmna","ref":"Dan. 7.9,10"},"12":{"text":"Tualeh mishite alien aneu, Pasian mai a ding ka mu a, tualeh laibute phensain aum a, tualeh laibu dangkhat zong phensain aum hi, tua pen hinna laibu ahi, tualeh mishite khu laibu a kigiel bangin, a nasep dungzui ua, thukhenpieh in a um uhi."},"13":{"text":"Tuipi in asunga mishi umte ahing pawtdoh sahta a, tualeh shina leh mishikhuo in zong asunga um mishite ahing pedohta uhi. Michin tungah amauh nasep dungzui a thukhenpieh ahita uhi."},"14":{"text":"Tuachi’n Shina leh mishikhuo nangawn meidil sung a pailut in a umta uhi. Tua khu shi nina ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tualeh koipou hinna laibu sunga min kigiel khalou pouma meidil sunga pailut in aumta uhi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n leitha leh van tha ka muta a, van masa leh Lei masa pen abeita a, tuipi mawngmawng a um nawn sih hi.","title":"Lei tha leh vantha muna","ref":"Isai. 65.17; 66.22; 2 Pet. 3.13"},"2":{"text":"Tuachi’n Kei Johan in khopi siengthou Jerusalem tha, mou apasal a dinga kilawmtah a kizem banga bawlzousa Pasian a kipat leh van a kipat a hing kum suh ka mu hi.","ref":"Isai. 52.1; Kihil. 3.12; Isai. 61.10"},"3":{"text":"Tualeh van a kipan aw ngaitah khat in, “Ngai vawi, Pasian biehbuh khu mihingte lah ah a umta hi, Ama alah uah ateng dinga, amauh khu amite ahi ding ua, Pasian mama in amau aumpi dinga, a Pasian uh ahi ding hi.","ref":"Ezek. 37.27; Siempu. 26.11,12"},"4":{"text":"Tualeh Pasian in amit ua pat hitui zousie asia sieng pieh ding hi; tualeh shina a um nawn sih dinga, lunggimna leh kaana leh natna zong a um nawn sih ding hi; aziehpen sil masate, zousie abeita hi,” achi ka za hi.","ref":"Isai. 25.8; Isai. 35.10; 65.19"},"5":{"text":"Tuachi’n Mangtoupha tunga toupa’n, “Ngai vawi, sil zousie ka siem thata hi,” achi hi. Tualeh Aman ka kungah, “Giel in aziehpen tam thute adihin aginum ahi,” achi hi."},"6":{"text":"Aman ka kungah, “Bawlzou ahita! Kei Alpha leh Omega, a Bul leh a tawp ka hi. Ken dangtah poumate kungah hinna tuikhuh a tui amanbei in ka peding hi.","ref":"Isai. 55.1"},"7":{"text":"Aguolzoupa’n tam silte zousie aluo dinga, tualeh a Pasian ka hi dinga, ama zong ka ta ahi ding hi.","ref":"2 Sam. 7.14; Late. 89.26,27"},"8":{"text":"Hinanleh meipuote, gingtaloute, kidahhuoite, tuolthatte, numei leh pasal kaal a thangtatte, dawithusiemte, milimbete leh zuouhatte zousie tan ding khu mei leh kaat meidil ahia, tua khu shi nina ahi.”"},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n vansawlsieng sagi hengkuong sagitawite, gawtna sagi tawite lah a khat ka kungah ahing pei a, kei ahing houpi a, Tam lang ah “Hingpei in, Mou Belamnou zi ka hing ensah ding,” achi hi.","title":"Van Jerusalem muna"},"10":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman Hagau in muol sang lientah tungah ahing zawpita a, tua khopi thupitah, Jerusalem siengthou, Pasian a kipat leh van a kipata hing kumsuh khu ahing ensah hi.","ref":"Ezek. 40.2"},"11":{"text":"Tua khopi in Pasian thupina aneia, avah khu suong mantam pen Jasper suong bang ahi a, Kristal suong banga val ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tualeh kulbaang thupitaah leh sangtah anei a, kotpi sawm leh ni anei a, tua kotpite ah vansawlsieng sawm leh ni a um uhi. Tua kotpite tungah Israel nam sawm leh nite min akigiel hi.","ref":"Ezek. 48.30-35"},"13":{"text":"Suolam ah kotpi thum, mallam ah kotpi thum, simlam ah kotpi thum, leh tumlam ah kotpi thum a um hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua khopi kulbaangin suongphum sawm leh ni aneia, tuate tungah Belamnou sawltah sawm leh nite min atuong hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua kei hing houpi vansawlsieng in, tua khopi leh akotpite leh akulbaang tena ding in tena sana chieng atawi hi.","ref":"Ezek. 40.3"},"16":{"text":"Tua khopi ning li kibang chieta lam ahia adung leh avai akikim a, tualeh aman tua khopi ate a mel tul khat leh zanga ahi. Adunglam leh availam leh asandan akibang chiet ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman kulbaang ate a, tong za leh sawmli leh li a hi. Tua pen vansawlsieng in mihing tena dan a ate ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tua khopi kulbaang khu Jasper suonga kibawl ahi a, akhopi pen sana sienga kilam, himlang banga sieng ahi.","ref":"Isai. 54.11,12"},"19":{"text":"Tua khopi kulbaang suongphumte pen suongmantam namkima kizem ahia, suongphum khatna khu Jasper suong ahia, anina khu Saphire suong ahia, athumna khu kalsidon suong ahia, ali na khu Emerald suong ahia;"},"20":{"text":"Angana khu Sardonik suong ahia, aguhna khu Sardia suong ahia, asagina khu Krisolit suong ahia, agietna khu beril suong ahia, akuona khu topaz suong ahia, asawmna khu Krisopras suong ahia, asawm leh khatna khu Jasin suong ahia, asawm leh nina khu Amethist suong ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tualeh akotpi sawm leh nite pen tuikepsuong ahia, akotpi chinteng tuikepsuong khat chiet a bawl ahi; tualeh khopi kholai gawlzing khu sana a kibawl, himlang etpailet thei bang ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tua khopi sungah biehinn ka mu sih hi, aziehpen Mangpa Pasian bangkimbawlthei leh Belamnou khu biehinn ahi mai uhi."},"23":{"text":"Tua khopi in ataanvah dingin ni angai sih a, ha zong angai sih hi, aziehpen Pasian thupinain asalvah a, Belamnou khu ameivah ahi.","ref":"Isai. 60.19,20"},"24":{"text":"Tualeh hundam aum namte khu tua vah ah atuolleng ding ua, tualeh leitung leengten athupina u’leh azatat huoina uh apolut ding uhi.","ref":"Isai. 60.3"},"25":{"text":"Akotte khu sun in akikha ngai sih ding hi, aziehpen tua mun ah zan a um ngai sih ding hi.","ref":"Isai. 60.11"},"26":{"text":"Tualeh amaun tua sungah namte thupina leh zatat huoina ahing polut ding uhi."},"27":{"text":"Hinanleh tua khopi sungah bangchihlaipouin sil sienglou leh kidahhuoi bawl leh zuou bawl mawngmawng alut sih ding hi; hinanleh Belamnou hinna laibu a min kigielte bou alut ding uhi.","ref":"Isai. 52.1; Ezek. 44.9"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuachi’n tua vansawlsiengin hinna tui sieng luonna lui ahing ensah a, tua lui pen kristal banga sieng, Pasian leh Belamnou Mangtoupha apat a hing luong khie ahi.","title":"Hinna lui","ref":"Ezek. 47.1; Zek. 14.8"},"2":{"text":"Tua khopi gawlzing laikimtah leh luipang tuoh ah ga chi sawmleni nei, hachin a ga, hinna singkung apou hi, tualeh tua sing nate khu namte suhdamna ding ahi.","ref":"Siem. 2.9"},"3":{"text":"Tuanah hamsie mawngmawng a um nawn sih dinga, hinanleh Pasian leh Belamnou Mangtoupha aum zawta ding hi, tualeh asuohten Ana aseppieh ding uhi.","ref":"Zek. 14.11; Siem. 3.17"},"4":{"text":"Amauten A mel amu ding ua, a talpang uah A min atuong ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuanah zan aum nawn sih dinga, mei vah leh ni vah zong apoimaw nawn sih ding uhi, aziehpen Mangpa Pasian in amauh ataanvah dinga, tualeh amauten kumtawn kumtawn in vai ahawm ding uhi.","ref":"Isai. 60.19; Dan. 7.18"},"6":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, “Tam thute aginum in adih ahi, tualeh guolnei siengthoute Mangpa Pasian in sil hing tung pai dingte asuohte musah dingin a vansawlsieng asawlta hi.","title":"Thutawpna"},"7":{"text":"Ngai un, hing pei pai ding ka hi, tam laibu a genlawhna thute zui poumate ahampha hi,” achi hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei Johan in tam silte ka mu a ka zah ahi. Tualeh ka zah a ka mutahin, tam silte hing musah vansawlsieng be dingin akengbul ah ka puasuhta hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuachi’n aman ka kungah, ngaiin, “Tambangin bawl vawt sin, Keipen nang leh na unau guolneite leh tam laibu sunga thukigente zuite suoh hipipa ka hi bou hi; Pasian bie in,” ahing chi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tualeh aman ka kungah, “Tam laibu a genlawhna thute khakhum sin, aziehpen ahun tung ding ahita hi."},"11":{"text":"Mi dihlou khu dihlouin um nalai henlen, mi nieh khu aniehin um nalai heh, tualeh midihtat khu dihtatin um nalai henlen, misiengthou khu siengthouin um nalai heh.”","ref":"Dan. 12.10"},"12":{"text":"“Ngai in, hing pei pai ding ka hi, tualeh michin anasep dungzui a pieh ding ka nuomman ka kungah a um hi.","ref":"Isai. 40.10; 62.11; Late. 28.4; Isai. 40.10; Jer. 17.10"},"13":{"text":"Kei Alpha leh Omega, Amasapen leh a Nukhiapen a Bul leh Atawp ka hi.”","ref":"Kihil. 1.8; Isai. 44.6; 48.12; Kihil. 1.17; 2.8"},"14":{"text":"Hinna singkunga tan anei theina ding u’leh, tua khopi kotpite a alut theina ding ua, apuonsilte uh sawpsiengte khu ahampha uhi.","ref":"Siem. 2.9; 3.22"},"15":{"text":"Hinanleh pulam ah, uite leh dawithusiemte, numei leh pasal kaal a thangtatte, tuolthatte leh milimbete, tualeh koipou zuou ngaina a zuoubawlte a um uhi."},"16":{"text":"“Kei Jesu’n hattuomte dinga tam theipina thute na kunga hing theisah dingin ka vansawlsieng ka hing sawl ahi. Kei David zungpi leh ahah asuon leh zingsol aasi tangpha ka hi,” achi hi.","ref":"Isai. 11.1,10"},"17":{"text":"Tualeh Hagau leh Mou in, “Hing pei in,” achi uhi. Aza tapouin “Hing pei in” chi hen. Tualeh koizong adangta a pouma hing pei heh. Koi zong a ut pouma in hinna tui amanbeiin dawn heh.","ref":"Isai. 55.1"},"18":{"text":"Koipou tam laibu sunga genlawhna za taphot kungah ka theisah ahi, mi koipou in tam thute abelap leh Pasian in tam laibu a kigiel gawtnate, atungah abelap ding hi.","ref":"Danp. 4.2; 12.32"},"19":{"text":"Tualeh koipou in tam genlawhna thute tam laibu apat alahmang leh hinna singkung leh khopi siengthou leh, tam laibu a kigiel silte apata atan ding khu, Pasian in alahmang pieh ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tam silte theisahpa’n, “Pellou in, ka hing pei pai ding” achi hi. Amen. Hing pei in, Mangpa Jesu."},"21":{"text":"I Mangpa Jesu Khrist hepina na unpi ua kungah umta hen. Amen."}}}}}}}
